messages.en:
Agents working for Guristas recently managed to infiltrate one of our outposts in a nearby system.  We have reliable information that they did manage to find classified information about our various operations in the area.  Fortunately one of the officers at the outpost managed to slip a tracking device into one of their ships before they escaped.  We know they are located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} at this very moment.  I would like you to fly over there and ambush them immediately.  Return to me once their ships have been turned to dust.  
But be careful, they are armed and dangerous.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯的特工最近潜入了我们在附近星系的一个哨站。据可靠消息，他们收集到了我们在那个地区的各种活动情况的机密资料。幸运的是，在他们溜走之前，一个哨站官员悄悄在他们的一艘船上安装了跟踪器。我们知道此刻他们的位置在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。我想要你马上飞过去伏击他们。把他们的飞船炸成灰烬后回来向我报告。不过别大意，他们有武装力量，很危险。

messages.en: The Seven have showed their ugly faces again, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They've set up an illegal brothel inside the system, which is being guarded by some of their top pilots, including a member of the Seven's elite circle. I want that place shut down, immediately. Do whatever it takes.
messages.zh: 七人组的丑恶嘴脸再次出现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。他们在星系中建造了一所非法娱乐站，由他们一些顶尖的飞行员看守，包括一名七人组的精英。这个地方必须马上关闭。不惜一切代价。

messages.en: You took out their leader?  That should be enough, their members are nothing but freelance mercs in it for the gold.  Without the Seven's commanders their forces will wither up and die.
messages.zh: 你干掉了他们的首领？这就够了，他们的成员都是些唯利是图的雇佣兵。没有了七人组的指挥官，他们的军队将会日渐式微，走向灭亡。

name.es: El centro penitenciario de Los Siete

messages.en:
The Seven have showed their ugly faces again, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They've set up a prison facility where they keep captured personnel working for {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} and random civilians for a ransom. The people that are put in there are rarely the same after they've been released. The Seven have somehow managed to get a hold on Sansha mind altering gadgets, which they use on those who they kidnap to erase their memory among other things. Rarely does this not have serious side effects ...

I want that place shut down, immediately. Do whatever it takes.
messages.zh:
七人组的丑恶嘴脸再次出现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。他们建造了牢狱设施，关押着其抓获的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的工作人员和用于勒索赎金的无辜平民。在那里关押过的人被释放后几乎变了个人。七人组不知从哪搞到了萨沙的洗脑仪器，用来对被绑架者进行包括消除记忆在内的许多洗脑操作。这当然会产生严重的副作用……

这个地方必须马上关闭。不惜一切代价。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  With their commander out of the way, I don't expect any more incidents involving them for a while.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。指挥官丧命，短期内他们是别想恢复元气了。

name.ja: ザズマッタザーの右腕
name.ru: Правая рука Zazzmatazz (The Right Hand Of Zazzmatazz)

messages.en:
Something urgent just came up. A convoy delivering foodstuffs to {[location]agentStationID.name} was ambushed in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} by pirates which we identified as members of 'The Seven'. These pirates have crossed our path before, and are not to be taken lightly. They belong to an organization which split itself from the Serpentis many years ago, and has grown quite large in a surprisingly short amount of time. Their leader uses the nickname 'Zazzmatazz', which you might have heard of if you're into Gallente films.

Anyway, the convoy escort drove off the pirate attack and chased them to their outpost. Only a handful of ships survived the battle that ensued. They report being attacked by none other than Zor, Zazzmatazz´s right hand man. If their tale is correct, then we have an excellent opportunity to strike at The Seven's top leadership. His death will be a serious blow to the organization, no doubt.

So your orders are: Fly to The Seven outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy their forces. Zor must not escape. Good luck.
messages.zh:
刚有紧急事件发生。一支运送食品去{[location]agentStationID.name}的护航队在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}遭到海盗伏击。这些海盗被确认为七人组成员。不能小看这些海盗，我们曾与他们交过手。他们隶属于一个多年前从天蛇集团分裂出来的组织，并在短得惊人的时间内扩张到相当大的规模。他们的首领绰号“扎茨玛特”。如果你喜欢看盖伦特的电影，你可能听过这个名字。

言归正传，护航队击退了海盗，并一直追到他们的哨站。只有几艘飞船在接下来的战斗中幸存。据他们报告，攻击他们的正是扎茨玛特的左膀右臂——佐尔。如果他们的说法正确无误，那么我们就获得了攻打七人组最高领导层的绝佳机会。如果他死了，这个组织无疑将遭受沉重的打击。

所以给你的命令就是：飞去七人组在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的哨站，消灭他们的部队。绝不能放过佐尔。祝你好运。

messages.en: Excellent!  With Zor out of the picture we'll hopefully have far less encounters with 'The Seven' in the near future.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！佐尔死了，至少在近期不会再碰到“七人组”了。

messages.en:
Something urgent just came up. A convoy delivering foodstuffs to {[location]agentStationID.name} was ambushed in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} by pirates which we identified as members of 'The Seven'. These pirates have crossed our path before, and are not to be taken lightly. They belong to an organization which split itself from the Serpentis many years ago, and has grown quite large in a surprisingly short amount of time. Their leader uses the nickname 'Zazzmatazz', which you might have heard of if you're into Gallente films.

Anyway, the convoy escort drove off the pirate attack and chased them to their outpost. Only a handful of ships survived the battle that ensued. They report being attacked by none other than Zor, Zazzmatazz's right hand man. If their tale is correct, then we have an excellent opportunity to strike at The Seven's top leadership. His death will be a serious blow to the organization, no doubt.

So your orders are: Fly to The Seven outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy their forces. Zor must not escape. Good luck.

name.es: Salvar la carrera de un hombre

messages.en:
Recently a thief stole some valuable documents from a high ranking officer and friend of mine in {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.  These documents are very sensitive and we fear they were stolen by someone working for an enemy of ours.  
Fortunately, the information stored within the documents was encrypted using the very latest encryption software.  The thief probably did not expect this, and we believe the information has not yet been revealed to him or his 
employer.  Should it leak out however then the leader of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will be ... less than forgiving.  Would you please save my friends career?  I have been told by a reliable source of a shady 
person who docked here yesterday and was spotted near my friends apartment, and is most likely the thief of whom I speak.  This person has very recently left this station.  I will pay you {[numeric]rewardQuantity} 
{[item]rewardTypeID.name} if you intercept the thief, destroy his ship if he offers resistance and bring the documents back to me.  I know you probably do not want to harm someone who may not be guilty, but I assure you 
that this scoundrel has a history of criminal offenses within {[location]agentRegionID.name}.  The people of {[location]agentRegionID.name} will be glad to know of his demise.  You have only 24 hours to complete the mission, but 
he will most likely be located in this very constellation.
messages.zh: 最近有个人从{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}我的高官朋友那里窃得了一些极有价值的机密文件，我们担心这是敌人派来的奸细所为。所幸我们事先用加密技术对文件进行了保护。这一定出乎窃贼的意料之外，因而文件内容应该还没有泄漏。一旦泄密事件成为事实，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的头头脑脑绝不会放过我的朋友，他的前程也就毁了。帮忙救救他吧？昨天有一个形迹可疑的人在这儿进站，有人看见他在我朋友的寓所附近出现，我想这很可能就是那个奸细。他刚刚离开空间站。请你中途截住他，如果他反抗的话就干掉他，将文件带回给我，我会给你{[numeric]rewardQuantity}个{[item]rewardTypeID.name}。我知道你不想伤害无辜者，我向你保证，这个混蛋以前在{[location]agentRegionID.name}就有犯罪前科。{[location]agentRegionID.name}的人们恨不得他死。你只有24小时，他很可能就在这个星座的某处。

messages.en: Thank you for this. You have no idea how much this means to {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢。这对{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}来说太重要了。

messages.en: Travel to the designated system and retrieve the reports from the thief.
messages.zh: 请前往指定星系，从窃贼那儿拿回被偷的报告。

messages.en: It was just as we all suspected. Please accept our thanks and all the rewards that come from loyal service to {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}. Keep this up and you‘ll have more ISK than you know what to do with – I promise you that.
messages.zh: 一切如我们所料。你为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}作出了贡献，请接受我们的酬谢。只要你继续保持这股劲头儿，我保证你能赚到花不完的钱。

messages.en: It's alright. I'll find another capsuleer willing to bathe in all this ISK I have to offer.
messages.zh: 没事。我会找到另一位愿意为这一大笔星币而卖命的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: Small, independent trade hubs throughout New Eden are sometimes referred to by a most peculiar and archaic term: “Roadhouses.” Though no one quite remembers why they're called that, it's common knowledge that roadhouses are ideal locations for moving stolen goods, making underworld contacts, or getting hurt. Needless to say, these establishments are frequented by unscrupulous roughnecks for whom pain doesn't hurt.
messages.zh: 人们有时会用“客栈”这一特古老的词来形容新伊甸宇宙中那些小规模的独立贸易据点。虽然没人能确切地想起这种叫法的原因，但大家都清楚地知道客栈是藏污纳垢、从事地下活动及惹事生非的理想场所。所以，这种地方是道德低下、不怕皮肉之痛粗人的常顾之处。

messages.en: Roadhouses
messages.zh: 客栈

messages.en: Your timing couldn't be better, {[character]player.name}. We‘ve just uncovered a breach of security in our administrative offices, an inside job during which some sensitive reports were stolen. All information points to a disgruntled former employee with contacts in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. You‘ll probably find the culprit in a local – please forgive the term – "roadhouse."
messages.zh: 来得正巧，{[character]player.name}。就在刚才，我们发现我们行政办公室里发生了一起因安保措施不严而导致机密报告被盗的事件，这是内部人所为。所有信息都表明那人应该是过去一名对我们心怀不满的员工，他在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那儿和当地人有联系。你能在当地找到他的地方应该是一座“客栈”——不好意思，我实在找不出其他词来形容那地方了。

messages.en: I should have listened to my superiors and taken care of this internally instead of thinking for a second that a capsuleer would be willing to help.
messages.zh: 我怎么当初会考虑让一名克隆飞行员来帮忙呢？我应该听我上级的话，让内部人来处理这事才对。

messages.en: Have you found that worthless bastard yet?
messages.zh: 你找到那畜生了吗？

messages.en: Thank you for this. You have no idea how much this means to {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢。这对{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}来说太重要了。

name.ja: 迷惑な海賊を壊滅せよ
name.ru: Уничтожить досаждающих пиратов (Eliminate a Pirate Nuisance)

messages.en:
A couple rogue pirates have been harassing our corporation members in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}.  They are nothing more than a nuisance and have yet to do any real damage, other than delaying our members in their travels while they chase them off.  I will supply you with a bookmark to their suspected hideout.  It's located nearby, so this should be a relatively straight forward mission.  I will give you {[numeric]rewardQuantity} ISK for 
completing the task, and if you're fast I'll even throw in a bonus.
messages.zh: 一伙自由海盗在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}骚扰我们的军团成员。这群恼人的苍蝇没有造成任何实质损害，只是让我们的人白白浪费时间追赶他们而已。我会把他们的藏身处位标给你，就在这儿附近，所以这次任务应该比较直接。我会给你{[numeric]rewardQuantity}星币作为完成任务的酬劳；如果你行动迅速，还有额外的奖金。

messages.en: I have taken care of the little pest.  Now hand me my reward.
messages.zh: 我已经消灭了那群害虫。现在给我报酬吧。

messages.en: No problem, I'll do it.
messages.zh: 没问题，我愿意干。

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} recently sacked one of its employees after a routine inspection revealed a large amount of indecent pictures stored in his personal database.  Sadly, this ex-employee wasn't all too pleased with our 
decision, and has resorted to camping outside of our headquarters and harassing our customers.  Fortunately though, we dug up some old offenses this guy made and revealed them to the authorities, who promptly lowered his security rating quite a bit.  In effect, he's fair game.  Please warp over to the location on the bookmark I'm about to give you and squash this little pest.  I doubt he will survive for long, as some of our customers are 
heavily armed.  So hurry up and take him out if you want your reward.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}最近开除了一名雇员，原因是在例行检查中发现他的个人数据库中储存了大量违禁图片。糟糕的是，这个前雇员对我们的决定不甚满意，转而在我们的总部外面安营扎寨，不断骚扰我们的客户。幸好，我们查出了这家伙犯下的几桩罪状，并透露给了官方，他的安全等级立刻就被降低了很多。因此他实际上已经成为合法的击毁目标。马上把他的位标给你，请你飞过去挤扁这只小虫子。我想他本来就活不了多久，因为我们有些客户武装强悍。所以如果你想要你的那份酬金，就快去把他解决掉。

messages.en: Guristas pirate vessels have been terrorizing passersby in a nearby system. Find and destroy their leader. We're uploading the last known location of the enemy ships to your NeoCom.  We need you to put these pirates out of business ASAP.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯海盗不断在附近一个星系内制作恐怖，让过路的舰船担惊受怕。我们要你去他们的头儿揪出来干掉。我们会将这些海盗最后一次出现位置的位标提供给你。希望你尽快行动，废了他们。

messages.en: A few of those dratted Guristas pirate vessels are terrorizing passersby in a nearby system.  Find and destroy their leader.  We've uploaded the last known location of the enemy ships to your NeoCom.
messages.zh: 附近星系内一些可恶的古斯塔斯海盗不断让过路的舰船担惊受怕。我们要你去把他们的头儿揪出来干掉。我们会将这些海盗最后一次出现位置的位标提供给你。

messages.en: A few of those dratted Guristas pirate vessels have been terrorizing passersby in a nearby system.  Find and destroy them.  We'll upload the last known location of the enemy ships to your NeoCom.  We need to put them out of business ASAP.

name.ja: ブラッドレイダーのスパイ
name.ru: Шпионы Blood Raider (The Blood Raider Spies)

messages.en: Agents working for the Blood Raiders recently managed to infiltrate one of our outposts in a nearby system.  We have reliable information that they did manage to find classified information about our various operations in the area.  Fortunately one of the officers at the outpost managed to slip a tracking device into one of their ships before they escaped.  We know they are located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} at this very moment.  I would like you to fly over there and ambush them immediately.  Return to me once their ships have been turned to dust.  But be careful, they are armed and dangerous.
messages.zh: 血袭者的特工最近潜入了我们在附近星系的一个哨站。可靠消息显示他们收集了我们在那个地区的各种活动情况的机密资料。幸运的是，在他们溜走之前，我们的一个官员在他们的一艘船上安装了跟踪器。此刻他们的位置在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。我要你马上飞去那里，打个漂亮的伏击战。把他们飞船炸成灰烬后回来向我报告。别太大意，对方武装精良。

name.de: Bringen Sie den Informanten zum Schweigen

messages.en: He's as good as dead!
messages.zh: 我会让他永远闭嘴。

messages.en: We have a bit of a problem on our hands with a recently fired employee of ours. He was working as a deep cover agent for us, and now he is threatening to release all the information to DED about what we have been doing. We cannot have this happen. If he does make it to the DED headquarters in Yulai, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will face serious repercussions. Eliminate this threat as soon as possible to ensure that he doesn't get the information to DED agents. I'll put into your way-points where he was last seen. Return here and let me know that he is dead.
messages.zh: 我们不久前解雇了一名员工，结果他让我们遇到了些小麻烦。他曾是我们的资深卧底，如今他威胁说要把我们一直以来干的事告诉给DED。我们决不能让这事发生。如果他真的到达尤拉的DED总部，那么{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}将面临严重后果。尽快把这威胁解除，务必阻止他把信息带给DED特工。我会给你他上次出现位置的位标。干掉他之后，回来向我报告。

name.es: Ataque al escondite de los Ángeles
name.ja: エンジェルの隠れ家を攻撃せよ
name.ru: Нападение на укрытие Angel (Attack the Angel Hideout)

messages.en: Sure, I'm up for it.
messages.zh: 行，包给我了。

messages.en: You got something for me, bitch?
messages.zh: 你给我带来什么好消息了吗，恶棍？

messages.en: I have an important task for you, {[character]player.name}.  We need you to go in and kill my mother-in-law.
messages.zh: 我要交给你项重要任务，{[character]player.name}。我们要你去干掉我的丈母娘。

messages.en: I've killed your mother-in-law.
messages.zh: 我把你丈母娘解决了。

messages.en: What?  No way am I killing that sweet old lady.
messages.zh: 什么？我是绝不会加害一位和蔼的老妇人的。

messages.en: Fine, then.  That's just how it will have to be.
messages.zh: 好吧，好吧。也许这事注定了就这样。

messages.en: We've found out who's behind the Angel attacks in the area.  It is, in fact, my mother-in-law.  I should have known that old harridan was up to something.  We shall have to take care of her.  If you go to the location I've managed to provide for you and slay the crone I will reward you handsomely, handsome.  Snoogans.
messages.zh: 我们终于弄清了谁是这次天使袭击的幕后指使：是我丈母娘。我应该早就料到这老娘们在暗中使坏。我们要将她摆平。如果你能前去我提供给你的地址，将这妖婆斩断，那我会大大地奖赏你。

messages.en: Well, you took too long to decide, {[character]player.name}, so I had to give the mission to another of my associates.  Sure you understand.  Come and see me again for another assignment if you ever need work.
messages.zh: 你斟酌太久了，{[character]player.name}。我不得不将任务交给了另一个人。相信你懂的。如果你以后还想找活儿干，再来找我吧。

messages.en: Mission offer expired
messages.zh: 任务提案过期

messages.en: Ok, this is bull.  I'm outta here.
messages.zh: 这叫倚强凌弱。我闪了。

messages.en: I should have known you weren't up to it.  Oh well, whatever.
messages.zh: 我应该早就料到你不行的。算了，散了吧。

messages.en: Well, you failed me {[character]player.name}.  I honestly thought I'd be able to trust you with something like this, but I see now that I was wrong.  I hope I don't make the same mistake twice.
messages.zh: 你让我很失败，{[character]player.name}。我本来还真以为我能将此事托付于你，但现在看来我错了。我可不想再犯同样的错误。

messages.en: Mission failure
messages.zh: 任务失败

name.es: Extravagancia del Cártel de los Ángeles

messages.en:
We've been gathering information from our agents within the Cartel to prepare ourselves for a possible attack on our assets. So far, we've found out only that they are planning a major offensive against a target within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, possibly to occur today. While the target remains unknown to us, we've managed to discover the meeting point of some of their forces. I want you to gather whatever help you can muster, fly out to the meeting points, and deliver a devastating blow to their fleet. That should deter them from any attack inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and send them a message they won't soon forget.

Just don't forget what you're up against. We have no idea how many ships are out there ― all we know is where five of their rendezvous points are. Destroy any and all targets you can find there, then report back to me. If there're too many of them out there, then get some help; I'm sure some of our other agents in the vicinity would be willing to give you a hand.
messages.zh:
我们一直在从我们安插在天使企业联合体内的密探那里搜集情报，以应对天使可能将对我们产业发动的攻击。目前我们只发现他们正在策划对{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内的一个目标发动猛烈攻击，很可能是在今天。尽管他们的具体目标尚不清楚，但是我们成功地发现了他们几支部队的集结点。我希望你召集一切可能获得的力量，飞去集结点，给他们的舰队以毁灭性打击。那应能吓得他们不敢在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发动攻击，给他们点难忘的记忆。

只是别忘记你的真正目标。我们不知道在那儿到底有多少船，我们只是知道他们的五个会合地点。消灭你能在那儿找到的所有目标，然后回来向我报告。如果他们有太多的人手，就找些帮手；我相信你还有其他的代理人会非常愿意帮你。

name.de: Bringen Sie den Informanten zum Schweigen

messages.en: He's as good as dead!
messages.zh: 我会让他永远闭嘴。

messages.en: We have a bit of a problem on our hands with a recently fired employee of ours. He was working as a deep cover agent for us, and now he is threatening to release all the information to DED about what we have been doing. We cannot have this happen. If he does make it to the DED headquarters in Yulai, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will face serious repercussions. Eliminate this threat as soon as possible to ensure that he doesn't get the information to DED agents. I'll put into your way-points where he was last seen. Return here and let me know that he is dead.
messages.zh: 我们不久前解雇了一名员工，结果他让我们遇到了些小麻烦。他曾是我们的资深卧底，如今他威胁说要把我们一直以来干的事告诉给DED。我们决不能让这事发生。如果他真的到达尤拉的DED总部，那么{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}将面临严重后果。尽快把这威胁解除，务必阻止他把信息带给DED特工。我会给你他上次出现位置的位标。干掉他之后，回来向我报告。

messages.en: He's dead, now where's my money?!
messages.zh: 他已经死了，我的钱在哪儿？

messages.en: Well, I did not say every job would be pleasure planets and pie.  Perhaps you are more suited for the garbage-hauling missions?
messages.zh: 嗯，我可没说过每个工作都乐趣十足、报酬丰厚。或许你更适合运垃圾的工作？

messages.en: Yes, I do and I think this is something you'll love {[character]player.name}. We have a bit of a problem on our hands with a recently fired employee of ours. He was working as a deep cover agent for us, and now he is threatening to release all the information to DED about what we have been doing. We cannot have this happen. Return here and let me know that he is dead.

name.ja: エンジェルカルテルの制裁
name.ru: Цена ошибки в Картеле Angel (Failing The Angel Cartel Comes At A Cost)

messages.en: As you probably know, the pirate profession is a risky business.  A pirate can only afford to make so many mistakes.  If you mess up too often, you're out, literally.  One such case happened recently, where an employee of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} failed to accomplish a vital mission we had given him in time.  This was the 4th time he screwed up.  This particular failure cost us millions.  Unlike other businesses, we can't simply lay him off.  He knows too much.  I will give you a bookmark to his current location, jump over there and meet up with him and his ragtag band of renegades.  He knows what's coming for him, and will probably attack you on sight.  You know what to do.
messages.zh: 你可能已经知道，海盗是一个危险的职业。做海盗几乎不能出错。如果你经常搞砸事情，那么你就会被淘汰，这毫不夸张。最近就有一个这样的例子，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的一个员工没能及时完成我们交付给他的一项重要的任务。这是他第4次把事情办砸了。他的这一次失败让我们损失了几百万。与其他行业不同，惩罚不会是解雇那么简单。他知道的太多了。我会给你他现在的位标，你在那儿会见到他和他手下那帮上不了台面的叛徒。他知道自己的命运会怎样，很有可能一见到你就会发动攻击。你知道该怎么做。

name.ru: Угроза охотников за головами (Head Hunter Threat)

messages.en:
A few years ago we kidnapped a few people on a remote planet that we raided. One of their relatives has been on our backs ever since. He keeps hiring bounty hunters to retrieve them and bring them back to their former home. Little does he know that most of them are already dead *chuckle*.

Anyway, get yourself ready for some action; The latest bounty hunter assigned on another one of those pathetic rescue attempts has been spotted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Take care of him.
messages.zh:
几年前，我们袭击了一颗遥远的行星，并绑架了一些人。从那以后，他们的一个亲戚就处处和我们作对。他不断雇用一些赏金猎人来解救他们，把他们带回原来的家园。但他可能根本不知道很多人早就死了，*咯咯笑*。

不管怎么样，准备有所行动吧。他最近又要进行一次无谓的营救了，新雇佣的赏金猎人已经出现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}了。把他给我干掉。

name.ja: カルダリディテクティブ発見

messages.en:
We recently discovered a detective working for the Caldari State military snooping around {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Usually we don't touch these guys, but it so happens that we have a bunch of contraband stashed nearby that we looted in Caldari State space. I want you to go out there and eliminate him before he finds the stash and reports his findings to the Caldari authorities; we certainly don't want them complicating our operations.

Be warned, though, those detectives are tough, and they usually have a scout or two backing them up. I wouldn't want you getting hurt, 'cause pilots like you aren't easy to come by!
messages.zh:
我们最近发现一个为加达里军队工作的侦探常在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}附近转悠。一般情况下我们不去管这些家伙，但这次情况不同，我们恰好有一批从加达里空间获取的违禁品贮藏在那里。你去把这家伙找出来，在他发现违禁品并向加达里当局汇报前干掉他，我们可不想让这些碍手碍脚的人坏了我们的好事。

但是要小心，侦探们可不好对付，而且身后总有那么一两艘侦察飞船跟着。我可不希望你受伤，因为像你这样优秀的飞行员不好找！

messages.en:
A CONCORD scout drone was just spotted in this system by one of our men. As usual, these drones should always be eliminated before they cause any damage. I'm not sure why this lone drone has entered our territory. Might just be an accident, or maybe it's on some secret mission.

Either way, I'd like you to head out there and get rid of it before it manages to escape. Leave no trace of it behind. Don't be long!
messages.zh:
我们的人最近在这个星系里发现了一架统合部侦察无人机。照惯例，这些无人机应该在造成危害前就被摧毁。我不清楚为何只此一架无人机侵入我们的空域。可能是意外，也可能是它在执行某项秘密任务。

不管怎样，在他们逃走之前把他们干掉。不要留下任何痕迹。速战速决！

name.ru: Месть за павшего товарища (Avenge a Fallen Comrade)

messages.en:
Today is a sad day, {[character]player.name}. One of our freelancers, working on a simple reconnaissance job in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, was brutally murdered by Guristas thugs while on duty. He was well liked in {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and we will miss his loyal service to us greatly.

Now, you might be thinking, "How does this affect me?" Well I'll tell you. We aren't letting this outrage go unpunished. I want the people behind this brutal murder taken care of immediately. I will supply you with a bookmark to their hideout, which is heavily guarded by Guristas fighters. Head out there and avenge your colleague by destroying their habitation module; it's the primary residence of their leaders. Leave no pirate survivors behind.

Oh, and one other thing: They have an asteroid colony out there which is used to house their workers, miners, and such. I suggest you leave them in one piece, for we have no quarrel with them. We'll send a personnel transport to pick them up shortly after you return, as long as you have eliminated all of the pirates.
messages.zh:
今天是个伤心的日子，{[character]player.name}。我们的一个自由战士在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}执行侦察任务时被古斯塔斯恶棍残忍地加害了。他生前在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}很受欢迎，他的尽忠职守会令我们万分怀念。

你可能在想，“这和我有什么关系？”让我来告诉你。我们绝不能让凶手逍遥法外。我要你马上去料理了这起残忍伤害的真凶。我会把他们藏身地的位标提供给你，那里由许多古斯塔斯的战斗飞船严密守卫着。出发前往那里，摧毁他们的居住地为你同僚报仇。一个都不要留。 哦，还有一件事：他们在那里有个小行星殖民地，那里有他们的矿工之类的人。我建议你不要对他们下手。只要你能把那些海盗都干掉，我们就打算在你回来后派一艘运输舰把他们统统接过来。

你可能在想，“这和我有什么关系？”让我来告诉你。我们绝不能让凶手逍遥法外。我要你马上去料理了这起残忍伤害的真凶。我会把他们秘密基地的位标提供给你，那里由许多天使企业联合体的战斗飞船严密守卫着。出发前往那里，摧毁他们的居住地为你同僚报仇。一个都不要留。

哦，还有一件事：他们在那里有个小行星殖民地，那里有他们的矿工之类的人。我建议你不要对他们下手。只要你能把那些海盗都干掉，我们就打算在你回来后派一艘运输舰把他们统统接过来。

name.ru: Месть за павшего товарища (Avenge a Fallen Comrade)

messages.en:
Today is a sad day, {[character]player.name}. One of our freelancers, working on a simple reconnaissance job in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, was brutally murdered by Angel Cartel thugs while on duty. He was well liked in {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and we will miss his loyal service to us greatly.

Now, you might be thinking, "How does this affect me?" Well I'll tell you. We aren't letting this outrage go unpunished. I want the people behind this brutal murder taken care of immediately. I will supply you with a bookmark to their hideout, which is heavily guarded by Cartel fighters. Head out there and avenge your colleague by destroying their habitation module; it's the primary residence of their leaders. Leave no pirate survivors behind.

Oh, and one other thing: They have an asteroid colony out there which is used to house their workers, miners, and such. I suggest you leave them in one piece, for we have no quarrel with them. We'll send a personnel transport to pick them up shortly after you return, as long as you have eliminated all of the pirates.

messages.en: OK, I'll take this on.
messages.zh: 好的，交给我吧。

messages.en:
Your primary target will be a subspace UDI data miner thought to have been picking up on our communications frequencies. Once it is destroyed, report back to us and we will send in another team for the next stage of the operation.

You will probably encounter some mercenary resistance in the area. Orders are to kill on sight, and to refrain from any and all communication that may uncover your involvement with us. Should you be captured, we will disavow any knowledge of your actions.
messages.zh:
你的主要目标是一个次空间UDI数据收集器，这个装置目前正通过我们的通讯频率截取信息。一旦摧毁目标，请尽快回来向我们报告，我们会派人采取下一步行动。

如果在那里有雇佣兵抵抗，就把他们全部干掉，并且避免可能暴露我们之间关系的一切通讯联络。如果你不慎被抓，我们会否认与你次此行动有关。

messages.en: The job is done.
messages.zh: 任务完成。

messages.en: Sounds a bit too, uh, underhanded for me. Think I'll pass.
messages.zh: 听上去有点……呃……卑劣。我还是免了吧。

messages.en: Damn! Well, can't say I blame you, I guess, although I had hoped for more. I'll just have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 可恶！好吧，虽然不是责备你，但说实话，我曾对你期望很高。我得另找他人了。

messages.en:
Recent reports from the Federal Intelligence Office give us reason to believe that the UDI terrorist organization has begun setting up outposts in the names of front corporations at deadspace forward points within our sovereign space, with the intention of spying on Gallente corporations. I've just gotten word that there's one such suspected outpost in this system. The problem is that we cannot be fully sure whether the outpost in question is indeed a UDI hive. Obviously this means we can't go in flying our own banner, so non-contracted free agents such as yourself will be of paramount importance in the staging of preliminary operations. True, it is a harsh risk to take, attacking installations that haven't been absolutely proven to be hostile, but the UDI simply present too much of a threat for us to have the luxury of dilly-dallying.

Should you choose to accept this mission, I will upload this outpost's coordinates to your Neocom. Your primary target will be a subspace data miner thought to have been picking up on our communications frequencies. Once it is destroyed, report back to us and we will send in another team for the next stage of the operation.

You will probably encounter some mercenary resistance in the area. Orders are to kill on sight, and refrain from any and all communication that may uncover your involvement with us. Should you be captured, we will disavow any knowledge of your actions.
messages.zh:
联邦情报处最新的情报显示，在我们的领地内，那些UDI恐怖组织已经开始打着前线军团的旗号在死亡空间前部建立了一些哨站，来暗中监视盖伦特军团的行动。情报称我们星系内也有这么一个可疑哨站。问题是我不能百分之百确定这个可疑哨站就是UDI的。我想得到详细情报，但显然不能让我们的人去侦察，所以像你这样的自由飞行员是最合适的人选。攻击未验明正身的设施，的确得冒很大风险，但我们也是不得已而为之。UDI对我们是个极大的威胁，必须尽快铲除。

如果你愿意接受这个任务，我会把哨站位标上传到你的控制边栏中。你的主要目标是一个亚空间数据收集器，这个装置目前正通过我们的通讯频率截取信息。一旦你摧毁目标，请尽快回来向我们报告，我们会派人采取下一步行动。

如果在那儿有雇佣兵抵抗，全部干掉，避免可能暴露我们之间关系的一切通讯联络。如果你不慎被抓，我们会否认与你次此行动有关。

messages.en: This is crap. Find someone else to do your clandestine dirty work. My hands are clean. Do you hear me?! CLEAN!
messages.zh: 这太垃圾了。找其他人来干这个肮脏勾当吧。我不想脏了我的手。听到了吗？我的手是干净的！

messages.en:
Take it easy, there, pilot. I'll find someone else then.

Uhm, buh-bye.

...

Why are you still here? You can go now.
messages.zh:
放轻松，飞行员。我会另觅人选。

嗯，再见。

...

你怎么还在这？你可以走了。

messages.en:
Today is a day of mourning, {[character]player.name}. One of our most esteemed officers was brutally murdered by Sansha scum. He had been in the forefront of our campaign to rid {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space of those filthy pirate dogs, and now he is dead. We will miss his services to {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} greatly, and I hope to see you at his funeral, {[character]player.name}.

Now to the point. This great injustice demands retribution, and you will be the deliverer of our wrath. We know of a Sansha Outpost lurking in the fringes of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and you are to find it and destroy it. I'll supply you with a bookmark that should take you to an acceleration gate leading to it. Once there, your task is to completely obliterate their base. However be warned, their outpost is heavily guarded, I suggest you clear the guards before attempting to destroy the Outpost structure itself. Good luck.
messages.zh:
今天是个悲恸的日子，{[character]player.name}。我们一位最受敬重的长官被萨沙共和国的人渣残忍地害死了。他曾为肃清{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}里的肮脏海盗战斗在第一线，可是现在，他牺牲了。我们将深切缅怀他为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}做出的贡献，我希望能在他的葬礼上看到你，{[character]player.name}。

该说正事了。此仇不报非君子，而你将是我们的复仇使者。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的边缘潜伏着一个萨沙哨站，你要找到它并将其摧毁。我会提供给你一个位标，指引你到一个通往那地方的加速门。到了那里就把他们的基地给端了。但要小心，他们的哨站有重兵把守，我建议你先把那些守卫干掉然后再去摧毁哨站。

该说正事了。此仇不报非君子，而你将是我们的复仇使者。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的边缘潜伏着一个天蛇哨站，你要找到它并将其摧毁。我会提供给你一个位标，指引你到一个通往那地方的加速门。到了那里就把他们的基地给端了。但要小心，他们的哨站有重兵把守，我建议你先把那些守卫干掉然后再去摧毁哨站。

messages.en:
Today is a day of mourning, {[character]player.name}. One of our most esteemed officers was brutally murdered by Amarr Empire scum. He had been in the forefront of our campaign to rid {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space of those filthy military pigs, and now he is dead. We will miss his services to {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} greatly.

Now to the point. This great injustice demands retribution, and you will be the deliverer of our wrath. We know of an Imperial Outpost lurking in the fringes of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and you are to find it and destroy it. I'll supply you with a bookmark that should take you to an acceleration gate leading to it. Once there, your task is to completely obliterate their base. However be warned, their outpost is heavily guarded, I suggest you clear the guards before attempting to destroy the Outpost structure itself.

name.ru: Месть за павшего товарища (Avenge a Fallen Comrade)

messages.en:
Today is a sad day, {[character]player.name}. One of our freelancers, working on a simple reconnaissance job in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, was brutally murdered by Serpentis thugs while on duty. He was well liked in {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and we will miss his loyal service to us greatly.

Now, you might be thinking, "How does this affect me?" Well I'll tell you. We aren't letting this outrage go unpunished. I want the people behind this brutal murder taken care of immediately. I will supply you with a bookmark to their hideout, which is heavily guarded by Serpentis fighters. Head out there and avenge your colleague by destroying their habitation module; it's the primary residence of their leaders. Leave no pirate survivors behind.

Oh, and one other thing: They have an asteroid colony out there which is used to house their workers, miners, and such. I suggest you leave them in one piece, for we have no quarrel with them. We'll send a personnel transport to pick them up shortly after you return, as long as you have eliminated all of the pirates.
messages.zh:
今天是个伤心的日子，{[character]player.name}。我们的一个自由战士在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}执行侦察任务时被天蛇集团的恶棍残忍地加害了他生前在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}很受欢迎，他的尽忠职守会令我们万分怀念。

你可能在想，“这和我有什么关系？”让我来告诉你。我们绝不能让凶手逍遥法外。我要你马上去料理了这起残忍伤害的真凶。我会把他们秘密基地的位标提供给你，那里由许多天蛇战斗飞船严密守卫着。出发前往那里，摧毁他们的居住地为你同僚报仇。一个都不要留。

哦，还有一件事：他们在那里有个小行星殖民地，那里有他们的矿工之类的人。我建议你不要对他们下手。只要你能把那些海盗都干掉，我们就打算在你回来后派一艘运输舰把他们统统接过来。

messages.en:
A despicable crime was committed against us in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} yesterday, {[character]player.name}. One of our fighters was brutally murdered by DED pigs nosing around our operations. We will not let them waltz carelessly around our territory and get away with such offenses. They're on our turf now, and they'd better be ready for a fight.

Your job is pretty straightforward, {[character]player.name}. Find the DED drones who murdered your colleague, and put an end to their miserable existence.
messages.zh:
昨天有人在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}对我们犯下了滔天罪行，{[character]player.name}。我们的一个战士被刺探我们军情的DED蠢猪残忍加害了。我们决不允许凶手在家门口肆无忌惮，犯了罪还能若无其事。他们现在在我们的地盘上，血债要用血来偿。

你的工作很简单，{[character]player.name}。找到那些加害你同事的DED无人机，结束他们可悲的一生。

messages.en:
I have terrible news, {[character]player.name}. A major personnel convoy carrying countless {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} members was completely obliterated by Blood Raider ships, led by that damned commander of theirs, Faramon Mundan. His reputation as a brutal Covenant military leader has traveled far and wide these past few years, and it's time to put an end to his miserable existence.

I want you to be the bringer of our vengeance, {[character]player.name}. Strike him down like the dog he is. When his battleship has been turned to dust, then you shall receive your reward.
messages.zh:
坏消息，{[character]player.name}。一个载着很多{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}成员的护航队被血袭者舰队袭击，无人生还。对方的首领是法拉肯•蒙顿那个混蛋。这个残暴的血袭者军官这些年来无恶不作，臭名远扬，是时候把这个无耻之徒送上西天了。

我希望你能替我们复仇，{[character]player.name}，除掉那个废物。当他的战舰化为灰烬的时候，你可以到我这里领赏。

messages.en: I recieved some grave tidings from our command post, {[character]player.name}. Those blasted Mordus mercenaries have struck again, obliterating one of our convoys while conducting an assassination mission to take out one of our overseers. Our men fought valiantly, but their force was simply too great for them to handle. They're still on the loose somewhere in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, and we need them taken care of ASAP, before they manage to escape. They must be punished for their insolence, and I require that you bring back a few prisoners for questioning, after you have taken out their leader. We need to find out who sent them, although we have our suspicions it would be best to confirm them before we take further action.
messages.zh: 从我们的指挥站传来沉重的消息，{[character]player.name}。那些该死的莫德团雇佣兵又来进攻了。他们在加害我们的一位监察官时，消灭了我们的一支护航队。尽管我们的战士勇猛反击，但对方实在太强。他们依然在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的某处逍遥法外，我们需要在他们逃离前尽快将他们干掉。他们必须为自己的傲慢付出代价。你干掉他们的首领之后，抓几个活的回来问话。我们想知道幕后主使的身份，虽然我们有怀疑的对象，但在采取进一步行动之前最好确认一下。

messages.en: Sounds like a job for me.
messages.zh: 看起来这工作适合我。

messages.en: Glad to hear it.  Do us proud, soldier.
messages.zh: 很高兴听你这样说。我们为你感到骄傲。

messages.en:
Recent reports from the Federal Intelligence Office give us reason to believe that the UDI terrorist organization has begun setting up outposts in the names of front corporations at deadspace forward points within our sovereign space, with the intention of spying on Gallente corporations. We recently managed to confirm the existence of one such outpost in this system.

Operatives have already been sent in to cripple key outpost structures, and the UDI's response has been to call in a great deal of mercenary reinforcements, with our intel telling us more are on the way. We believe they may be planning a large-scale strike against this station sometime within the next 24 hours, so we need someone to go in there and put a dent in their current forces. This should delay their attack long enough for us to call in reinforcements of our own to take out the installation.

Should you accept, your mission would be to go in and take out every one of the mercenary ships you currently see at the installation. I would advise you to set up the most powerful combat fitting you possibly can, as according to our previous experience these people are not to be trifled with unless you know what you're doing. So what do you say?
messages.zh:
联邦情报处最新的情报显示，在我们的领地内，那些UDI恐怖组织已经开始打着前线军团的旗号在死亡空间前部建立了一些哨站，来暗中监视盖伦特军团的行为。我们已经确认了本星系中一个哨站的位置。

我们派遣了特工去破坏那些主要的哨站建筑，UDI方面的回应是召集大量的雇佣兵援军，情报表明还有大批增援正在向这里开进。他们可能策划在未来的24小时内对这个空间站发动一场大规模的袭击，所以我们需要找人袭击他们的部队，削弱其实力。这样可以拖延他们的进攻，为我们赢得时间来召集援军，摧毁那个哨站。

你的任务就是去那儿，消灭空间内所有的雇佣兵飞船。建议你尽可能多装备一些武器，根据以往的经验，这些人可不好对付。你意下如何？

messages.en: I've wiped out every last one of those terrorist slimeballs.
messages.zh: 我把这群寄生虫完全消灭了。

messages.en: I knew you'd come through.  Take this reward, and our gratitude.
messages.zh: 我就知道你能完成任务。这是你的报酬，我们对你表示感谢。

messages.en: UDI, you say?  I, uh, I have some pressing business to attend to elsewhere.
messages.zh: 你说的是UDI？呃，其实呢，我在其他地方还有一些紧要活儿要干。

messages.en: Can't say I blame you, though admittedly I had hoped for more from you.
messages.zh: 虽然不是责备你，但说实话，我曾对你期望很高。

messages.en: On second thought, I don't really think I'm up for this. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我重新想了一下，觉得我实在不能接受这个任务。抱歉。

messages.en: Very well. Thank you for letting us know in time.
messages.zh: 很好。感谢你及时让我们知道了这些。

messages.en: I have dire news, {[character]player.name}.  One of our deadspace asteroid belts in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has been infested by rogue drones!  We lost contact with the miners working there a few days ago, after they had reported sightings of mysterious craft nearby.  Our reconnaissance team then confirmed our suspicions, the entire belt has been infested with those pests.  Not only that but they have already erected a Drone Silo there, which the drones often use as the first building block for an actual Drone Hive.  We need to act fast before they manage to grow in numbers, {[character]player.name}.  Your job is to see to it that their silo is completely destroyed.  I'll send in ships later to clean up the mess.  However I warn you, the drones roaming the belt will no doubt all come to aid their silo once it is attacked, so it would be advisable to try and split them up and clear out the guards before you attempt to finish your objectives.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我有个可怕的消息告诉你。我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个死亡空间小行星带被自由无人机占领了！几天前那儿的矿工报告看到神秘飞行物，之后我们便和他们失去了联系。随后我们的侦察队证实了我们的怀疑，整个小行星带到处都是这些无人机臭虫。不仅如此，它们还建了一个无人机贮藏舱，通常情况下这是建造无人机母巢的第一步。在它们开始大规模增长之前，我们必须马上行动，{[character]player.name}。你的任务是设法完全摧毁他们的贮藏舱。之后我会派人去清理残骸。不过我得提醒你，一旦储藏库受到攻击，在小行星带游走的所有无人机都会过来增援，因此先把他们分散开来各个击破，最后攻击储藏库比较明智。

messages.en:
We just received an incoming transmission from one of our personnel convoys traveling through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They reported that they were under attack by unidentified craft which refused to reply to their attempts at communication. Soon afterwards the transmission was cut off, and we haven't heard from them since.

Normally I would send a reconnaissance mission to the last known location of the convoy and scout the area before attempting any further action, but this situation is different. The convoy that was destroyed was carrying a very valuable artifact which must be retrieved at all cost. It is sealed in a booby-trapped special delivery package. I require you to head out there and look for it, if fortune shines on us today then the attacker and our artifact will still be close by. Do this for me and you shall be rewarded, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
我们刚收到位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的护航队发来的讯息。他们正遭受不明飞船的攻击，而对方拒绝了他们的通信请求。随后通信就此中断，我们再也没收到任何消息。

通常我会先派人去事发地点侦察，根据收集的情报决定下一步该怎么做，不过这次的情况不一样。被袭击的护航队负责押运一件非常珍贵的文物，必须不惜代价找回来。文物放在一个安装了饵雷的包裹里。你的任务是到那里去找到包裹。如果咱们今天运气够好，那些袭击者和我们的古董应该还在附近。好好干，我会给你报酬的，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
I have grave tidings this time, {[character]player.name}. One of the ancient station ruins out in the fringes of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has been reportedly infested with rogue drones. They have made it their hive, and are busily producing more and more rogue drones. From there they have been launching attacks on our convoys and outposts nearby, some of which have been totally overrun. I request that you fly to the station ruins and eliminate their hive.

Rogue drones are a constant menace to our assets. They have no allegiance to any nation that we know of and their only purpose seems to be expansion and destruction of anything in their path. Once they have started infesting a system, it is very hard to exterminate the infestation for good. But it is possible to reduce the threat they pose by destroying their hives, fortunately.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我有个坏消息。{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}边缘的一个古老的空间站遗迹受到自由无人机的骚扰。它们把遗迹变成了机巢，并不断扩大自由无人机的数量。附近的护航队和空间站不堪其扰，有些甚至遭受了灭顶之灾。你的任务就是到空间站遗迹去把机巢彻底消灭。

自由无人机对我们的资产一直是个威胁。据我们所知，它们不与任何国家结盟，唯一目的就是扩张，以及毁灭一切阻挡它们扩张的东西。一旦它们出现在一个星系内，就很难将其彻底消灭。不过幸运的是我们可以通过端掉其机巢来降低它们的威胁。

name.ja: ローグドローンの嫌がらせ

messages.en:
We've just been informed of an official complaint from the mining division working in one of the asteroid fields in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, about their haulers being attacked on sight by roaming rogue drones in the area. At first it started with just a few unsuccessful attacks, but the situation has worsened greatly and the hauler pilots, along with the miners themselves, are on the verge of a strike. This is the perfect opportunity for someone like you to take care of business and earn your reward, {[character]player.name}. I'll supply you with a bookmark to the location of the asteroid belt, eliminate the rogue drone threat there and then report back to me.

Please note that this mission requires you to use acceleration gates. Please use them to get farther into the deadspace pocket to eliminate all of the drones.
messages.zh:
我们刚刚接到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的某个小行星带的矿务部门的正式投诉，说是他们的运输人员在该区域总是受到无人机的袭击。起初只是小规模的骚扰，而后情况愈演愈烈。运输人员和矿工都处于罢工边缘。这可是你表现自己并大捞一笔的绝好机会，{[character]player.name}。我会给你那个小行星带的位标，消除那里的无人机威胁，然后回来向我报告。

注意，这次任务需要用到加速轨道。请利用加速轨道进入死亡空间层，消灭所有无人机。

messages.en: {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} roamers in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have been hit by a rogue drone attack, again.  This time it happened while they were inspecting one of the asteroid belts near here, for any sign of mining activity.  This of course calls for some serious drone busting, {[character]player.name}.  These drones are a menace to all of us, and such a threat must be neutralized.  Head out to the location where the last attack occurred and eliminate any Rogue Drones you can find there, then report back to me.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的巡查人员在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}再次遭到自由无人机的袭击。这次袭击是在他们巡查附近的一个小行星带的采矿活动迹象时发生的。这当然引来了一群无人机的重炮，{[character]player.name}。这些无人机是我们所有人的威胁，这种威胁必须被解除。现在立即赶到上次攻击发生地点，消灭那里的所有无人机，然后回来向我报告。

messages.en: We have reason to believe that the owner of a certain warehouse located in a remote area of space in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} is secretly collaborating with the Cartel.  We haven't been able to pin anything on him yet, but I have my orders to launch a full scale investigation.  I want you to personally see to it that his property is thoroughly searched from top to bottom.  Retrieve any suspicious looking goods that you find there and bring them back here.  If you see any Angel activity in the area, then I expect you to neutralize it immediately, let none escape.
messages.zh: 我们有理由相信{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}边远地区一个库房的主人和天使企业联合体有秘密勾结。我们暂时还没有任何证据，但是我接到命令进行全面调查。我希望你亲自去把他的仓库查个底朝天。把在那里找到的任何可疑物品都带回来。如果你在那里附近发现有天使活动，就立刻干掉他们，一个都不要放走。

messages.zh: 我们有理由相信{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}边远地区一个库房的主人和萨沙共和国有秘密勾结。我们暂时还没有任何证据，但是我接到命令进行全面调查。我希望你亲自去把他的仓库查个底朝天。把在那里找到的任何可疑物品都带回来。如果你在那里附近发现有萨沙的活动，就立刻干掉他们，一个都不要放走。

messages.en:
We have reason to believe that equipment which was stolen from our storage silo near {[location]agentStationID.name} is going to be laundered through an unlicensed Merchants Hub in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It is a privately owned trading outpost which is renowned for attracting criminal elements, and I wouldn't be the least bit surprised that such activity is going on there.

We believe the goods are being transported to the outpost as we speak, in an industrial, a Bestower to be exact. I want you to fly out there immediately and find the equipment and bring it back to us. It may still be located in the same sealed containers as when it was stolen.

You have full authority to shoot anything that threatens you near the outpost, {[character]player.name}. They might send some of their mercenary ships to intercept you, once they know what you're after. After all, if we can prove the tycoon who owns that place had anything to do with the theft, we'll have the perfect excuse to bring that scrapheap down for good.
messages.zh:
我们位于{[location]agentStationID.name}附近的贮藏舱遭窃，情报表明失窃的设备将在位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个没有执照的贸易中心出手。这是个私人拥有的贸易哨站，以招揽犯罪分子著称，在那里销赃丝毫不令我感到惊讶。

就在我们说话的当口，货物正由一艘工业舰，更确切地讲一艘恩赐者级工业舰，运往那个哨站。我要你马上飞去那里，找到那些设备，并且给我带回来。它们应该还放在遭窃时的那个密封集装箱里。

你有权向哨站附近任何威胁你的东西开火，{[character]player.name}。一旦他们知道你的目的，他们可能会派一些雇佣兵来拦截你。说到底，只要能证明拥有那个空间站的大亨和这次事件有关，我们就有充足的理由把那个垃圾地方彻底夷平。

name.ja: ローグドローンの襲撃
name.ru: Банда восставших дронов (The Roving Rogue Drones)

messages.en: A small group of rogue drones have been reportedly roaming around {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, attacking civilian convoys and trade ships that happen to cross their path.  They were last spotted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  Rogue drones are a threat to anything that is not controlled by their Hive, and therefore must be destroyed.  Once you have eliminated them, return to me for your reward.
messages.zh: 据报告，一小队自由无人机在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}周围游荡，攻击路过的民用护航队和贸易船。它们最后一次出现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。自由无人机对任何不属于机巢控制的东西都会发动攻击，因此必须摧毁它们。你消灭了它们之后，就回来我这里领报酬。

messages.en: A couple of bold rascals working for the Angel Cartel just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours. They managed to escape the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, and they're now lurking in an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job.
messages.zh: 几个胆大包天的天使企业联合体恶棍刚伏击了我们一支全副武装的护航队。他们从迅速赶到现场的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}官员眼皮底下溜走了，现在潜伏在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的某个小行星带中。你去消灭他们，把他们从护航队手里抢走的东西带回来。如果你接受这个任务，我会把他们所处位置的大致坐标上传到你的控制边栏。

messages.en: A couple of bold rascals working for the Angel Cartel just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, completely wiping out the entire escort. They managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, and they're now lurking in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job.
messages.zh: 几个胆大包天的天使企业联合体恶棍刚伏击了我们一支全副武装的护航队，所有船只均被击毁。他们侥幸躲过赶到事发现场的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}官员，潜逃到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个死亡空间层。你去消灭他们，把他们从护航队手里抢走的东西带回来。如果你接受这个任务，我会把他们所处位置的大致坐标上传到你的控制边栏。

messages.en: A couple of bold pirates working for the Serpentis just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours. They managed to escape the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we did manage to trace their flight path to a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I'll upload the coordinates of the deadspace pocket into your NeoCom. Your job is to enter it and take out the pirates. Hopefully they will still have the goods they looted from the convoy; return the stuff to me.
messages.zh: 几个胆大包天的天蛇海盗刚伏击了我们一支全副武装的护航队。他们侥幸躲过赶到事发现场的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}官员，不过我们经过追踪，发现他们正逃往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个死亡空间层。我会把死亡空间层的坐标上传到你的控制边栏。你的任务是到那里去把海盗解决掉。从护航队手里抢走的货物应该还在他们手里，把它们带回来给我。

messages.en: A couple of Serpentis dogs just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, completely wiping out the entire escort. They managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we managed to trace them to a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. I'm counting on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 几个胆大包天的天蛇恶棍刚伏击了我们一支全副武装的护航队，所有船只均被击毁。他们侥幸躲过赶到事发现场的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}官员的追击，潜逃到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个死亡空间层。你去消灭他们，把他们从护航队手里抢走的东西带回来。如果你接受这个任务，我会把他们所处位置的大致坐标上传到你的控制边栏。我就靠你了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A couple of bold pirates working for the Blood Raiders just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, overwhelming the escort ships in no time. The survivors were captured, and God knows what those crazy cultists did to them. The Raiders managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, and are now lurking in an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there, destroy them, and bring back the goods they looted from the convoy; I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job.
messages.zh: 几个胆大包天的海盗刚伏击了我们一支全副武装的护航队，护航队无力招架，顷刻间全数尽毁。幸存者都被俘虏，天知道那些暴徒会做出什么事来。他们侥幸躲过赶到事发现场的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}官员的追击，潜逃到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个小行星带。你去消灭他们，把他们从护航队手里抢走的东西带回来。如果你接受这个任务，我会把他们的大致坐标上传到你的控制边栏。

messages.en: A couple of extremely dangerous Blood Raider battleships just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, wiping out the entire escort in moments. The survivors were captured, and God knows what they did to them. The Raiders managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we managed to trace them to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job.
messages.zh: 几艘极其危险的血袭者战列舰刚伏击了我们一支全副武装的护航队，所有船只均被击毁。幸存者都被俘虏，天知道他们会遭到怎样的对待。血袭者击退了赶到现场的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}军官，不过我们成功地追踪到了他们，他们已到达{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。我要你赶到那里消灭他们，然后带回他们从护航队抢去的物品。如果你接受这个任务，我会把他们所处位置的大致坐标上传到你的控制边栏。

messages.en: Bring it on.  Oh yes, bring it on.
messages.zh: 来吧。好，来吧。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you.  Show those terrorists the price of messing with us.
messages.zh: 我就知道你值得信赖。让那些恐怖分子明白骚扰我们的代价！

messages.en: I'd like something to kill, please.
messages.zh: 请给我些东西让我消灭。

messages.en:
Recent intelligence reports give us reason to believe that the UDI terrorist organization has begun setting up outposts in the names of front corporations at deadspace forward points within our sovereign space, with the intention of spying on Gallente corporations. We recently managed to confirm the existence of one such outpost in this system.

Operatives have already been sent in on two separate occasions and a good deal of the outpost's frontal defenses have been crippled or weakened. Our intelligence sources have reported, however, that the terrorists have another base hidden away in another location in system. It now appears that the first outpost was no more than a red herring which they intended us to expend resources finding and destroying, leaving us vulnerable to a full attack later on. Now, they don't know that we're aware of the real installation, and we believe they're calling in reinforcements to mount a large-scale offensive against this station within the next 24 hours. Currently they have only a few brass stationed there, guarding the premises. We need to nip this in the bud.

Should you accept, your mission will be to go in and neutralize every hostile you can find at the installation, then take out their armory. This should buy us the time we need to send in a demolitions force from HQ to destroy the outpost and fend off their coming reinforcements. Should you accept, I would advise you to pack as much firepower as you possibly can, as according to our previous experience these people are not to be trifled with unless you know what you're doing. So what do you say?
messages.zh:
最新的情报显示，在我们的领地内，那些UDI恐怖组织已经开始打着前线军团的旗号在死亡空间前部建立了一些哨站，来暗中监视盖伦特军团的行为。我们已经确认了本星系中一个哨站的位置。

特工已经通过两次不同的机会被派了进去，在他们的配合下，我们大幅削弱了哨站的正面防御力量。但事情没有这么简单，情报显示，恐怖分子在星系内还有另外一个秘密基地。看起来第一个哨站只不过是为了转移视线，浪费我们的时间和精力去破坏它，那群恶棍就能对分身不暇的我们发动总攻。目前他们还不知道我们已经看穿了这条毒计，估计现在还在召集援军，准备在未来的24小时内向这个空间站发动大规模的进攻。现在，他们只有一些散兵游勇驻守在那里，我们必须把这件事消灭在萌芽阶段。

你的任务内容就是潜入并消灭发现的所有敌人，然后破坏他们的兵工站。这样可以为我们赢得足够时间从总部调遣大军摧毁哨站，并且抵挡之后的援军。如果你接受任务，建议你尽可能多装备一些武器，根据以往的经验，这些人可不好对付。你意下如何？

messages.en: Those guys were nothing. What's for dessert?
messages.zh: 这些家伙算什么。小菜一碟。

messages.en: Excellent work, soldier.
messages.zh: 兄弟，干得好！

messages.en: UDI you say?  I, uh, I ... look behind you! A three-headed fedo!
messages.zh: 你说的是UDI？我，呃……看你背后！ 长着三个头的费多！

messages.en: Very well, then.  It will be a tough task finding someone as talented as you to take this on, but oh well - that's my job, I suppose.
messages.zh: 这样很好。再找到一个你这么精明的人来替我干活不容易，但不管如何，这是我的工作。

messages.en: This is too much for me.  I'm sorry, but you'll just have to find someone of stronger moral fibre.
messages.zh: 这对我来说太难了。很抱歉，你得找一个道德神经更坚强的人。

messages.en: Fine, I'll find someone else. Be gone from my sight, peon.
messages.zh: 好，那我另找他人。立即从我的视线里消失，懦夫。

messages.en: A couple of bold Guristas pirates just ambushed a convoy of ours, overwhelming the escort ships in no time. They managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, and are now lurking in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them; bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show them no mercy {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 几个胆大包天的古斯塔斯海盗刚伏击了我们一支护航队，护航队无力招架，顷刻间全数尽毁。他们侥幸躲过赶到事发现场的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}官员，正躲在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个死亡空间层里。你去消灭他们，把他们从护航队手里抢走的东西带回来。如果你接受这个任务，我会把他们所处位置的大致坐标上传到你的控制边栏。{[character]player.name}，为了那些在这次伏击中牺牲的人们，对他们绝不要手软。

messages.en: A couple of bold and extremely dangerous Guristas just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, wiping out the escort ships in no time. As usual, they left few survivors ― nothing but charred wreckage was left behind. The pirates managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we managed to trace them to an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show them no mercy {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 几个胆大包天而且极度危险的古斯塔斯海盗刚伏击了我们一支全副武装的护航队，护航队无力招架，顷刻间全数尽毁。一如往常，现场几乎没有留下任何幸存者，只剩下一堆烧焦的残骸。海盗击退了赶到现场的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}军官，不过我们成功地追踪了他们，他们已到达{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个小行星带。我要你赶到那里消灭他们，然后带回他们从护航队抢去的物品。如果你接受这个任务，我会把他们所处位置的大致坐标上传到你的控制边栏。为了给那些在袭击中丧生的人报仇，不要对敌方有任何的仁慈，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A couple of Sansha freaks just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, overwhelming the escort ships in no time. As usual, they left few survivors and lots of charred wreckage behind. They managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who responded to the distress signals and are now lurking in an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them; then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show these scum no mercy, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 几个疯狂的萨沙海盗刚伏击了我们一支全副武装的护航队，护航队无力招架，顷刻间全数尽毁。一如往常，现场几乎没有留下任何幸存者，只剩下一大堆烧焦的残骸。官员受到求救信号后迅速赶到现场，但他们已经从{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}那儿逃之夭夭，潜伏在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的某个小行星带内。去消灭他们，带回从我们的舰队手里抢走的东西。如果你接受这个任务，我会把他们所处位置的大致坐标上传到你的控制边栏。为了那些牺牲的人们，对他们绝不要手软，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A couple of pilots of the Sansha's Nation just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, wiping out the escort ships in no time. As usual, there were no survivors ― nothing but charred wreckage was left behind. The pirates managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we managed to trace them to an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show them no mercy {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 几个萨沙海盗刚伏击了我们一支全副武装的护航队，所有船只均被击毁。一如往常，现场没有任何人幸存，只剩下一堆烧焦的残骸。海盗击退了赶到现场的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}军官，不过我们成功地追踪了他们，他们已到达{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个小行星带。我要你赶到那里消灭他们，然后带回他们从护航队抢去的物品。如果你接受这个任务，我会把他们所处位置的大致坐标上传到你的控制边栏。{[character]player.name}，为了那些在这次伏击中牺牲的人们，对敌人绝不要手软。

messages.en:
As you well know, {[character]player.name}, we have an unfortunate amount of illegal Angel Cartel activity in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Well I believe we have found a target that will cripple their operations here for quite some time.

After countless hours of investigation, our agents have finally discovered their primary armory facility. This is a storage facility for their ship modules and weaponry for ground troops, and would explain how quickly their lost equipment is replaced in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

We believe that if we strike hard and fast, and take out this armory before they know what hit 'em, then we stand a good chance of seriously damaging their supply of spare weaponry, which will greatly impede their operations in this sector. Of course you are the pilot that I feel is most suited for this job, {[character]player.name}. Just remember, we get one shot at this. If you fail, they will undoubtedly relocate their armory and be far more prepared for us next time. So don't screw this one up!
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你应该知道，一些天使企业联合体的成员在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}里从事着数量惊人的违法活动。而我已经找到一个打击目标，可以使他们受到重创，一时半会儿恢复不过来。

经过漫长的调查，我们的特工终于发现了他们的主要军械库。这是一个储存设施，储藏着他们的飞船装备和地面部队所使用的武器。这也是他们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}可以迅速得到补给的原因。

如果我们的手脚够利落，在他们反应过来之前就摧毁这个军械库，对他们的武器补给无疑是次重大的打击，他们在这个区域的军事活动也会因此停滞不前。{[character]player.name}，我认为你是最适合这个任务的飞行员。记住，机会只有一次。万一你失败了，他们肯定会重新选择兵工站的位置，并且严加防范。所以这次绝对不要搞砸！

messages.en:
We've been wondering for some time now why the Guristas strikes on our convoys have been so well timed and coordinated, considering our people usually take the utmost caution when it comes to security and secrecy. But I think we've found the answer.

Some time ago our surveillance team stumbled across a hidden Guristas base located in a deadspace pocket not far from here. We didn't think much of it at first ... until we actually sent in one of our undercover agents to investigate. He did not return with his life, but we did manage to salvage his report from the wreckage of his ship. And from what he discovered, the area is being used to cover up a gigantic telescope, which the Guristas are apparently using to spy on our assets here in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. This telescope is so powerful that it's illegal to use in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space without a permit, and those are hard to come by. The interference from the deadspace pocket hides it from our scanners, but it is still able to scan everything outside. An ingenious method of espionage, don't you think?

Your task is simple. Since we've located the base already, all we require you to do is warp over there and destroy it. But although it may sound simple, you should expect heavy resistance. They wouldn't leave such vital equipment lightly guarded. Good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
虽然我们采取了最严密的保安措施，手下的人也守口如瓶，但古斯塔斯集团仍能在最佳时机，最佳地点对我们的护卫队进行袭击，对此我一直感到疑惑不解。现在答案终于揭晓了。

不久之前，我们的侦察部队在离这里不远的死亡空间入口处偶然发现了一个古斯塔斯的秘密基地。起先我们没有很在意……直到最近，我们派了个秘密间谍去调查。他没能活着回来，不过我们在飞船残骸里找到一份报告。从中得知，那里隐藏着一个巨大的望远镜，显然古斯塔斯利用它来暗中监视我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的活动。在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}空间要合法使用使用如此巨大的望远镜必须要有准许证，那可是挺难搞到的。死亡空间的信号干涉让我们扫不到它们的信号，但是空间外的一切还是躲不过我们的扫描的。非常有创意的间谍活动，不是么？

你的任务很简单。我们已经知道该基地在哪里，你只需要跃迁到哪里并将其摧毁就行了。虽然听起来不难，你还是要小心遭到抵抗。他们不会不好好保护这么重要的设备的。祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Hinterhalt im Dunkeln (1 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - Ambush in the Dark (1 of 10)

messages.en: I will do my best, you can count on that.
messages.zh: 我会尽力，相信我吧。

messages.en: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.
messages.zh: 不错！我就知道我们能指望你。

messages.en: So what's this important stuff you keep yammering about?
messages.zh: 那么你一直在唠叨的重要的事是什么呢？

messages.en:
I just received news of a grave incident that occurred in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now, I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser that was escorting our CEO, for we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, but there was no trace of the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any sign left behind by the pirates, who so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.
messages.zh:
我刚收到消息，几小时前在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}发生了一起严重的事故。载有我们尊敬的CEO的护航队遭到了一支异常庞大而且组织有序的海盗的伏击。但是今晚幸运之神眷顾了我们，由于CEO护卫队的英勇顽强，CEO安全逃脱，当然稍受惊吓是在所难免的。我们失去了很多优秀的战士，卫队长也光荣牺牲……愿他安息。

好了，我们切入正题。我们认为海盗俘虏了一些护送我们CEO的巡洋舰的船员，因为在事发地点我们找到了该船的残骸，但是没有发现大多数船员的尸骸。{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的特种部队被叫到现场进行搜索，看是否有这些海盗的线索，但到目前为止还没有任何海盗的信息。我们希望你能帮助调查。我们知道一个在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}星系海盗们常去的隐藏地点。我会把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中：请搜索这些区域找出可能存在的线索，如果你抓到了犯人就把他们带回来接受审讯。

messages.en:
Well done, {[character]player.name}. I see that, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members, my theory was correct. After we've given them proper trauma counseling, we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.

And don't you leave just yet. I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。看来我的计划没错，你成功把失踪船员带回来了。在他们接受适当的心理咨询后，我们会询问他们在被囚禁期间是否获得任何线索。

先别走。我还有别的任务给你！

messages.en: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.
messages.zh: 你以为我这样的娘娘腔能处理这样的事？拜托。

messages.en: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.
messages.zh: 好吧，我知道你不愿接受挑战。或许你的继任者会比你更有勇气。

messages.en: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.
messages.zh: 我很失望。推荐你的人对你的评价很高。

name.ru: Секретный проект X (Secret Project X) (1 из 3)

messages.en: Good, I knew I could count on you.  But just one other thing, I have a feeling that these mercs will fight for their leader, to the death.  Be prepared for a grueling fight.  If you fail, we might not get another chance at this, so do your very best.  That is all I expect of you, friend of {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}.
messages.zh: 好啊，我就知道你值得信赖。不过还有一件事，我有预感，这些雇佣兵会为他们的首领拼死抵抗。你要做好打一场恶战的准备。如果你失败了，我们可能再也没有机会了。所以，你要竭尽全力。这是我对你的全部期待，{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}的朋友。

messages.en:
I've heard good things about you, {[character]player.name}. They say you are a loyal servant of {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}, and that you have served us well in the past. I hope that my information is correct, for our sake ... and for yours.

The reason I sent for you is simple, we have visitors, and we need someone to give them a 'warm' welcome. These particular visitors are up to something, but we don't know what yet. And that's where you come in.

Bring us their leader. We need him for interrogation ... and to discover the meaning behind their activities here. Your job is a simple one, and I expect the one we seek here in no less than a day.

They are hauled up in an asteroid belt not far from here, incidently in a deadspace pocket which is blocking our long-range scanners. I will supply you to a bookmark to the acceleration gate leading into it.
messages.zh:
我听说了关于你的不少好话，{[character]player.name}。他们说你是{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}的忠实仆从，而且你过去为我们提供了出色的服务。我希望我的消息是正确的,这是为我们的利益着想……也是为你的。

我叫你来的原因很简单，我们有些来访者，我们要个人去向他们致以“热烈”的欢迎。这些特殊的来访者是有目的而来，不过我们还不知道是什么。这就该你出马了。

把他们的首领给我们带来。我们要审讯他……并找出他们行动的真实意图。你的任务很简单，我要你最多用一天就把该首领带来。

他们现在一个离此不远的小行星带里，我们的长距离扫描仪无法检测到他们。我会把通向那处的加速门的位标给你。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}, you have served us well as always.  We will begin the interrogation of our prisoner immediately.  I also presume you left the structure they were building intact, we'd like to investigate it.  Whatever they were building out there, it would almost certainly become a threat to our assets in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}，你的服务还是一如既往地出色。我们会立刻开始审讯俘虏。我猜你没有把他们正在建造的建筑弄坏吧？我们打算调查一下。无论他们在那里建造的是什么，那都一定会对我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的资产构成威胁。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你呢！

name.ru: Устранение беспорядка (Clearing Up the Mess) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
While we are interrogating the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to clear up the remnants of the merc forces you defeated in your last mission. I want you to enter the deadspace pocket from a different angle this time, using the other acceleration gate leading into it should put you right next to their base. It's a jumble of structures inside small asteroids connected to each other, which we call an asteroid colony. Destroy it and report back to me.

I'm sure the mercenaries still have a few ships left at their disposal, so be prepared for a fight. Their remaining forces, crippled from your last strike at them, should not cause you any serious problems.
messages.zh:
在我们审讯你抓获的俘虏时，我想让你去消灭上次任务遗留的佣兵部队。这次你从另一条路进入死亡空间层，使用别的加速门，直接把你带到他们基地的旁边。那是个小行星内一个互相连接的错综结构体，简单来说就是小行星殖民地。摧毁它，然后回来向我汇报。

情报显示，对方仍然拥有一些自由支配的舰船，要做好迎战准备。你上次的攻击已经让他们元气大伤，残余的部队应该不会造成很大的麻烦。

messages.en:

messages.zh:
在我们审讯你抓获的俘虏的时候，我想让你去消灭你在上次任务中击溃的雇佣军残余部队。这次你要从另一个角度使用另一条加速轨道进入这个死亡空间层，这样你会直接到达他们基地的旁边。那是个小行星群内一个互相连接的错综结构体，也就是我们说的小行星殖民地。摧毁它，然后回来向我报告。

我肯定那些雇佣兵手头还有一些飞船。所以要做好迎战准备。你上次的攻击已经让他们元气大伤，残余的部队应该不会造成很大的麻烦。

messages.en:
We've finally finished with the interrogation of the prisoner you captured in a previous mission, and our suspicions were confirmed. It took some ... convincing, to extract the information we needed from the poor, misguided soul. Which is quite ordinary, considering him being an undercover operative of the Amarr Empire. And a high ranking one at that.

Now you might ask, how could we possibly know that he is high ranking? After all, the Empire is very thorough when it comes to purging all records of the people who join their intelligence agency, to keep it from falling into the 'wrong' hands. Agents such as these tend to 'vanish', as if they had never existed. Quite difficult to track down, I tell you.

But when a large group of Amarrian cruisers appears at our doorstep, demanding the release of a certain individual ... well it's not hard to put 2 and 2 together.

This small fleet of imperial ships was spotted entering the same deadspace pocket which we sent you into on your two previous missions. They are here to investigate the disappearance of their agent, and are most likely ready for a fight. And I expect you to make sure they leave our space, feet first.

We also have reason to believe that they have control over a small outpost inside the asteroid belt. On your last two trips there we gave you bookmarks to two acceleration gates into the vast deadspace area our enemy has been hiding in. Well there is a 3rd gate which we just recently discovered, and we suspect the imperial raid force is located in there, planning their next move. Our sources tell us that their leader brought with him documents detailing their orders from the Empress. We would very much like to get our hands on these documents. Destroy their ships if you can, but your primary objective is to retrieve the reports from their leader. They might be located with him on his ship, or inside their base. Find them and bring them to me, this will be your final assignment for a while.
messages.zh:
通过对上次任务中你所抓囚犯的审讯，看来我们的怀疑不无道理。花了好大的功夫才撬开这个家伙的嘴，很正常，他毕竟是艾玛帝国的间谍，而且还是个高级间谍。

你可能要问，我怎么知道他是高级间谍？艾玛帝国往往会彻底清除那些加入其情报机关人员的记录，以防落入他人之手。这类的间谍都得“消失”，就如同不曾存在那样。所以，说实话，追查他们非常困难。

而当一支艾玛巡洋舰队出现在我们家门口，叫嚣要我们放人的时候……一切再明白不过了。

我们在你前两次执行任务的死亡空间区域内发现了一小撮帝国舰队，他们是来要人的，准备好打一场硬仗吧，你得让这群人从我们的地盘上消失。

有情报显示，他们在小行星带内控制了一座小型哨站。你前两次去那儿时我们给了你两个加速轨道的位标，它们通往敌人藏身的广阔死亡空间。可最近我们又发现了第三个加速轨道，我们怀疑皇家舰队正在那里面策划他们的下一次突袭行动。可靠消息指出他们的领导者随身携带的文件详细记载了女王的命令。我们需要那些报告。你的首要任务是从他们的领导者那里得到报告，条件允许把他们的船也都炸了。这些文件可能在船上，也可能在基地里。找到报告，带回来给我，这将是你当前最后一个任务。

messages.en: I have the reports you asked for, and I have taken care of the imperial scum.  Now I expect my reward.
messages.zh: 我拿到了你要的报告，也干掉了帝国的渣滓。现在该给我报酬了吧。

messages.en: Excellent, {[character]player.name}.  Your success will not go unnoticed within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}.
messages.zh: 好极了，{[character]player.name}。{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}会记得你的功劳。

messages.en:
I have some grave news, {[character]player.name}. A squadron of imperial ships just managed to lay waste to one of our supply depots in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. This was a hit and run attack, aimed at our drug smuggling business into the Amarr territories. I can understand their attacks inside their own sovereign space, but this cowardly act must not go unpunished.

The squadron is still located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We managed to block off all exits leading out of the system, and our ships are just waiting for the order to attack. I want you to personally deal with them, {[character]player.name}, and save us from possible casualties. Do this and you shall be well rewarded.
messages.zh:
我有一个坏消息，{[character]player.name}。一支皇家舰船中队刚刚破坏了我们在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的一个补给站。他们打了就跑，目的是打击我们对艾玛境内的违规药品非法贩售。如果他们在自己的领空内发动袭击，我还能理解，但这次，他们的胆小鬼行为一定要受到惩罚。

这支舰队目前仍然驻留在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。我们已封闭这个星系的所有出口，我们的战舰处于待命状态，随时可以发动进攻。我想让你个人去处理他们，{[character]player.name}，避免我方人员不必要的伤亡。干好了你会有丰厚的奖励的。

messages.en:
I need you for a simple courier mission, {[character]player.name}, as well as another job afterwards. It's fairly straight forward, nothing you wouldn't be able to handle.

Recently we acquired a heap load of sensitive Gallente Federation logs, which we want transferred to this station a.s.a.p.. We've made a deal with their government to return this data over to them, without breaking the seal covering the container which they came in, in exchange for a few million ISK. Now all we need is you to bring the stuff here, and then meet their agents at a rendezvous point for the payment.
messages.zh:
我要你帮我做个简单的快递任务，{[character]player.name}，之后还有另一项任务等着你。这事儿很简单，对你来说只是小菜一碟。

最近我们获得了一些高度敏感的盖伦特联邦日志，我希望能尽快把它们送到这个空间站。我们和对方政府达成了协议，原封不动地把这些日志交还，当然他们得付给我们几百万封口费。现在你带上这些文件去指定的地方，会有对方的特工和你交易。

name.ru: Транзакции Gallente - шантаж (Gallente Transaction - Blackmail) (2 из 2)

messages.en: Now that we have the transaction logs here at {[location]agentStationID.name}, it's time to finish the deal.  We arranged for a meeting with some of their forces in a remote deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  Meet them there and retrieve the payment they promised us, then report back to me.  If they try anything funny, then you have my permission to defend yourself.
messages.zh: 既然交易日志已经到了{[location]agentStationID.name}，是时候结束这笔交易了。我们与他们的一些部队安排在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个遥远死亡空间层里会面。去那里和他们见面，取回他们承诺的报酬，然后回来向我报告。如果他们耍花招，我准许你自卫。

messages.en:
The Gallente attacked you on sight? Interesting ... I expected as much, they have not been known to deal with us when their back is against the wall, so to speak. Well we have other uses for these logs anyway, blackmailing their citizens will fetch us a much better price.

You've done your job, take your reward and enjoy yourself.
messages.zh:
盖伦特人一看见你就攻击你？有意思……我就料到会这样，这么说吧，盖伦特人在处于绝境的时候从不喜欢和我们做交易。好吧，这些日志还有其他用处，用来勒索盖伦特平民可以开更高的价。

你的任务完成了，拿好你的报酬，去享受一下吧。

messages.en: Now that we have the transaction logs here at {[location]agentStationID.name}, it's time to finish the deal.  We arranged for a meeting with some of their forces in a remote deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  Meet them there and retrieve the payment they promised us, then report back to me.  If they try anything funny, then you have my permission to defend yourself.
messages.zh: 既然交易日志已在{[location]agentStationID.name}，该是结束这笔交易的时候了。我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}一个遥远的死亡空间层里安排了一次与他们军队的会面。去那里见他们并把对方承诺的报酬带回来。如果他们耍花招，你有权自卫。

messages.en:
I call upon you, {[character]player.name}, for an important task that I need accomplished. We have had numerous cases recently of rogue Minmatar miners exploiting our natural resources in the area. Our gangs have made sure most of them left our space feet first, but there is this one group of them that has caused us great pains. They have apparently brought with them a small group of highly skilled Minmatar Fleet pilots, who apparently will defend them with their lives. We can't afford to lose any more of our ships, so I ask you to do us a favor and eliminate the escort ships guarding the miners.

Once you have eliminated the Fleet vessels, my boys will come in and clean up the rest of the mess. Your objective is not to destroy the miners, but I won't hold it against you if you do.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我叫你来是为了交给你一项重要任务。最近，在这个地区发生了许多米玛塔尔矿船私自开发我国资源的事件。我们的人摆平了大多数矿船，但他们中有一伙人却给我们带来了很大的麻烦。显然跟这些矿船同行的有一支技术高超的米玛塔尔舰队，他们不顾一切地保护矿船。我们可不想赔上更多飞船了，所以我请你去消灭那些保护采矿者的护卫舰。

等你消灭那些舰队之后，我的人会过来收拾残局。你的目标不是摧毁采矿船，不过如果你想顺便捎上它们的话我也不反对。

messages.en:
