Once you have eliminated the Fleet vessels, my boys will come in and clean up the rest of the mess. Your objective is not to destroy the miners, but I won't hold it against you if you do.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我有个重要的任务交给你。最近在这个地区内发生了许多米玛塔尔矿船私自开发我国资源的事件。当然，他们中的大多数人很快被我们赶了出去，但是仍然有一小撮负隅顽抗，还重创了我们的巡逻队。显然有一批技术精良、经验丰富的米玛塔尔舰队飞行员，在不惜一切地保护他们。我可不想损失更多的舰船了，你去干掉保护那些采矿者的护卫舰。

等你消灭卫队之后，我的人会过来收拾残局。当然，如果你想一起参与击毁那些矿船的话，我也不反对。

messages.en:
I have some bad news, {[character]player.name}. The Republic wasn't all too pleased with our attack on the last batch of miners they sent here, which you took part in. Apparently they sent in some reinforcements to the area, to stage a counter-offensive. They must have been deployed nearby already, as it took them a very short time to get here.

I require you to take care of them. We can't afford to lose more ships in these never-ending skirmishes with their forces. Our lines are already thinning from constant battles with freelancers intent on exploiting our valuable resources.

Once you have eliminated the threat they pose, return to me for your reward.
messages.zh:
坏消息，{[character]player.name}。还记得上次你参与的攻击行动么，米玛塔尔共和国对采矿队遭受攻击愤懑异常。他们又向该区域增派了援军，并准备发动绝地反击。他们肯定已经在周围做了部署，部队在很短时间内就集结完毕。

去把他们全部歼灭。我们不能在永无休止的军事摩擦中失去更多的飞船了，要知道，我们的力量在与自由战士的纠缠中已经消耗了不少。

完成任务后，回来领你的报酬。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.  You've done us a great service by taking care of this business.  This won't be forgotten.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。这次任务你完成得很好，为我们做出了显著贡献。我们不会忘记的。

messages.en:
I have some bad news, {[character]player.name}. The Republic wasn't all too pleased with our attack on the last batch of miners they sent here, which you took part in. Apparently they sent in some reinforcements to the area, to stage a counter-offensive. They must have been deployed nearby already, as it took them a very short time to get here.

I require you to take care of them. We can't afford to lose more ships in these never-ending skirmishes with their forces. Our lines are already thinning from constant battles with freelancers intent on exploiting our valuable resources.

Once you have eliminated the threat they pose, return to me for your reward.
messages.zh:
坏消息，{[character]player.name}。上次你参与的对米玛塔尔采矿船的攻击行动让共和国很不高兴。事实上，他们向该区域增派了援军，准备发动反击。他们肯定就部署在这附近，因为他们赶到这里来的时间非常短。

我要你去解决他们。我们决不能在与他们永无休止的摩擦中失去更多的飞船了。我们的兵力已经在与觊觎我们宝贵资源的自由飞行员的纠缠中消耗了不少。

解除那里的威胁后，回来领你的报酬。

messages.en: Just make sure you remember to use all of the acceleration gates leading into the deadspace pocket to reach your target. There will probably be a couple defensive perimeters blocking your way to the control tower, so you will have to get by the Navy ships guarding those areas before you proceed to your target.
messages.zh: 记得激活一路上所有的加速轨道，它们将引领你到达目标所在的死亡空间层。在你去控制塔的路上可能会遇到一些拦路的防御圈，所以你得干掉那些守卫的海军飞船，然后才能到达目的地

messages.en:
What I'd like you to do is take care of a heavily fortified outpost located on the outskirts of the territory in which their forces are located. They have a number of these outposts guarding their territory, and by removing some of them we hope to open up their defenses enough for us to launch a full-scale attack at their headquarters. Because it's located in the middle of a large deadspace pocket, we haven't been able to do so thus far.

Now, all you have to do is destroy the control tower at the center of the outpost. By doing that, you effectively render the outpost useless, at least till they manage to erect a new tower. By that time, though, our forces will have moved in for the final attack.

Luck be with you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
我想让你做的是解决一个守卫森严的哨站，它就位于他们部队所处区域的外围。他们有很多这类哨站守卫自己的领地，通过摧毁其中一些，我们希望能在他们的防线上撕开一道口子，便于我们对其总部发动大规模进攻。由于总部位于一个大型死亡空间层的中心，我们至今还没成功。

你要做的就是摧毁哨站中心的控制塔。这样一来，该哨站就会彻底瘫痪，他们需要花上一段时间建一个新控制塔才能使其恢复。不过到那时，我们的部队已经大举进入，并准备发动最后的总攻了。

祝你幸运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Excellent work! Our forces are gathering even as we speak in preparation for the final attack. And it's all thanks to your quick work on that control tower.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！就在我们说话的当口，我们的军队已在集结中，准备最后的总攻。这都多亏了你迅速解决了那座控制塔。

messages.en:
I have a very important and risky assignment for you, {[character]player.name}. Considering your reputation, I'm sure you can handle it.

A few weeks ago, we discovered that the Caldari State was up to something big inside {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, but we didn't know what. Even the officers we have on our payroll among their navy didn't know what was going on. Then, just recently, one of our patrols stumbled upon an encoded signal coming from an area inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We traced the signal and sent a squadron of our best men to investigate, but we soon lost Comlink contact with them; they never came back.

We're almost positive that the State is building a massive military base where that signal came from, probably from where they intend on launching a major offensive against our positions here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. Now, I'd say we have the travel routes through the systems in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} covered pretty well, so this expedition of theirs must be costing them a fortune. If we strike hard and fast before they manage to complete the project, we might be able to convince them that such a foolhardy operation is not in their best interests.

But I'd like to reassure you of one thing, {[character]player.name}. I have no intention of sending you headfirst into the center of their operations ― that would be suicide even for someone with your skills. However, what I'd like you to do is take care of a heavily fortified outpost located on the outskirts of the territory in which their forces are located. They have a number of these outposts guarding their territory, and by removing some of them we hope to open up their defenses enough for us to launch a full-scale attack at their headquarters. Because it's located in the middle of a large deadspace pocket, we haven't been able to do so thus far.

Now, all you have to do is destroy the control tower at the center of the outpost. By doing that, you effectively render the outpost useless, at least till they manage to erect a new tower. By that time, though, our forces will have moved in for the final attack.

Luck be with you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
我有一个非常重要、风险很高的任务给你，{[character]player.name}。鉴于你的声望，我想你肯定能搞定它。

几个星期前，我们发现加达里合众国在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}内策划一些大动作，但我们不知道具体是什么。甚至连我们安插在他们海军里的军官也不知道情况如何。然后，就在最近，我们的一艘巡逻舰偶然收到一个来自{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内某区域的加密信号。我们跟踪了该信号，并派出我们最出色的一支中队的人马前去调查，但我们很快就与他们失去了联系，他们也没再回来。

我们几乎敢肯定加达里合众国正在建造一座大型军事基地，信号也是从那里发出的。也许他们还想从那面向我们{[location]agentConstellationID.name}这里发动一场进攻。我认为我们现在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的防御不错，他们真来侵袭的话会付出很大一笔代价的。如果我们能在他们这样做之前就给他们一个下马威，那他们可能就会退缩回去了。

但我向你保证，{[character]player.name}，我不会让你深入敌后去当炮灰的。我只要你去摧毁他们边境领域上的一个把守严密的哨站。他们有好几个像这样的哨站守卫着他们的边境。搞掉其中一些可以便于我们向他们发动一场全面攻击。那个哨站位于一个大型死亡空间的中心位置，这也是我们至今尚未端掉他们的原因。

现在你要做的就是去把哨站中央的控制塔摧毁掉。这样他们的哨站就废了，他们只能再另锚一个控制塔。等他们把新控制塔弄好，我们的大部队早就渗透进去准备总攻了。

祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Das Verhör (2 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: El interrogatorio (2 de 10)
name.ru: Атака похитителей - допрос (Kidnappers Strike - The Interrogation) (2 из 10)

messages.en: I'll do it in no time. Now please update me on how the investigation is going.
messages.zh: 我马上就去做。请随时告诉我审讯的进展。

messages.en: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.
messages.zh: 非常不幸，我们现在只有几条模糊的线索，目前没什么能透露给你的。等你完成手头的任务再回来，那时可能会有消息告诉你。

messages.en: After checking our logs, we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy. The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel. I need them transferred to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation; hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.
messages.zh: 我们检查了日志后，发现你带回来的俘虏中只有部分是我们护卫队遭袭时被海盗抓获的船员。剩下的显然是你击毁的一艘海盗船上的成员，他们在船只的爆炸中逃过一劫。我需要把他们转移到另一个空间站的一些同事那里进行进一步审讯；希望那里的专家能够撬开他们的嘴巴，获得伏击我们CEO的幕后黑手的有关线索。

messages.en: Great work once again, {[character]player.name}. But I need you back here urgently for another assignment; something terrible just happened. I'll get you posted once you are ready.
messages.zh: 又是个漂亮活儿，{[character]player.name}。不过我迫切需要你回来完成另一个任务；发生了件可怕的事情。等你准备好后，我会告诉你细节。

messages.en: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.
messages.zh: 我不能接受。这件事情至关重要，不能交给像我这样的人办。

messages.en: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.
messages.zh: 我尊重你的逻辑。我会另请高明。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Die Entführung (3 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: El secuestro (3 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Le kidnapping (3 sur 10)
name.ru: Атака похитителей - похищение (Kidnappers Strike - The Kidnapping) (3 из 10)

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en:
We urgently need help intercepting a group of kidnappers who just managed to snatch the niece of our CEO while she was visiting her uncle in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for an illegal organization called the Darkonnen. I'll fill you in on the details of that organization in the mission details in your Opportunities interface.

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, for we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with a Darkonnen agent in the past; we hope this pirate will be able to lead you to the agent. The only catch is that he will most likely require a bit of "convincing" on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom; once you have extracted the information from the middleman, I expect you to find the Darkonnen agent and bring him back to me.
messages.zh:
我们迫切需要你帮忙拦截一伙绑匪，他们趁我们CEO的侄女到这个星系拜访时绑架了她。绑匪是一伙雇佣兵，领头的是一名效力于非法组织达克农的重罪犯。我会把这个组织的详细信息发到你“机遇”界面的任务详情中。

你最好把他们的代理人活捉回来。我们怀疑这个人就是绑匪与幕后主使之间的联络人，必须要当面拷问他。我们要彻查谋划这起滔天罪行的幕后黑手。我们可以提供给你一个线人，是个海盗，曾与达克农的代理人打过不少交道，希望能指引你顺利抓捕代理人。但要想获得所需信息，你还得花点功夫让他“配合”。我会在你的控制边栏中上传他的位标，希望你能得到有用的消息，指引你找到达克农代理人，将他活捉回来。

messages.en:
Well done. We will proceed immediately to interrogating the prisoner, so expect some results soon. Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.

And don't go anywhere: I have another assignment for you.
messages.zh:
干得好！我们会立即开始审讯俘虏，你很快就会得到结果。我们的审讯官可是很有……“说服力”的。

别到处乱跑：我还有另一项任务给你。

messages.en: No, this does not interest me.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我对这个任务没兴趣。

messages.en: Well, I did not say every job would be sunshine and pleasurehalls. Perhaps you are more suited for the garbage-hauling missions?
messages.zh: 嗯，我可没说过每项工作都充满阳光和喜悦。或许你更适合运垃圾的工作？

messages.en: The Darkonnen is an organization that sprung up from rogue elements within the Khanid Kingdom, starting off as a small band of smugglers operating between lawless space and Khanid-controlled territory. They were renowned for their ruthlessness in dealing with their competitors, eliminating a good deal of small-time criminals within the Kingdom, as well as cleverly eluding the local authorities most of the time. A few years ago, their founder and leader, Michelin Adonnis, was captured by Khanid secret police and sentenced to life in prison for various offenses. His arrest caused a slight setback for the outlawed organization, but in the end it turned out to be not enough to halt their inevitable expansion. Today they are a well known pirate/smuggler network who base their operations in numerous systems in Amarr and Khanid space.
messages.zh: 达克农组织是由从卡尼迪王国内一些自由危险分子发起的，起初他们只是一小群非法贩售者，奔走于法外空间与卡尼迪所控领域之间。他们对付竞争对手的手段出了名的残忍，他们消灭王国境内许多小规模犯罪组织，而且多数时候都能巧妙避开当局的围捕。几年前，他们的创立者兼首领米其林·埃东尼被卡尼迪秘密警察逮捕，并以多项罪名被判处终身监禁。他的入狱使这个违法组织的发展受到些许挫折，不过最终事实证明，这不足以阻止他们扩张的步伐。今天，他们已经形成远近闻名的海盗/非法贩售网络，其业务主要遍及艾玛和卡尼迪空间中的无数星系。

messages.en: The Darkonnen
messages.zh: 达克农组织

name.en: Whispers in the Dark - First Contact (1 of 4)
name.es: Susurros en la oscuridad: Primer contacto (1 de 4)
name.fr: Murmures dans les ténèbres – Premier contact (1 sur 4)
name.ja: 闇からのささやき―最初の連絡（1/4）
name.ko: 어둠 속의 속삭임 - 첫 번째 접촉 (1/4)
name.ru: Шепот в ночи: первая встреча (Whispers in the Dark - First Contact) (1 из 4)
name.zh: 黑暗中的密语—第一次接触(1/4)

messages.en: Watch your back out there, {[character]player.name}.  And whatever you do, don't let them take you prisoner, I've heard some mighty frightening stories about what happens to people that are taken alive by those monsters...
messages.zh: 千万小心，{[character]player.name}。不论如何，别落到他们手里。我听说过很多耸人听闻的故事，那些魔鬼对待俘虏简直禽兽不如……

messages.en:
So good to see you, {[character]player.name}. I've been on a pretty tight schedule for the past two weeks, ever since we discovered the strange, and increasing, Sansha activity in the system. Our CEO demands an explanation, yet we still don't know enough about the situation to determine what's really going on. And that's where you come in.

Sanshas activity on this scale in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} is unheard of, and quite frankly we aren't well enough prepared at the moment to deal with any major conflict with the Nation. Not only that, but those damned zombies give us the creeps, and news of their appearance around here has sent parts of the populace into a state of panic. People are leaving this station already, making my superiors ... less than content if you know what I mean. We're losing good people because of this unacceptable situation and we need to put an end to it.

The first thing I want you to do is undertake a reconnaisance mission for us into an area where we have witnessed most of the Sanshas activity. We've already lost a few patrols that ventured into this area, so be careful. If you do find any Sanshas ships out there, eliminate them. We don't want any prisoners, interrogating the creatures won't do us any good. Report your findings to me a.s.a.p.
messages.zh:
很高兴见到你，{[character]player.name}。这两周我忙得焦头烂额，因为萨沙军队在这个星系的行动很不正常，而且愈演愈烈。CEO要我们对此给个说法，但目前情报非常匮乏，无法确定他们到底在干什么。这就是要你来这的原因。

以前萨沙军队从未在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}进行过如此规模的行动，坦白的讲，目前我们准备尚不充分，不能和他们正面冲突。不仅如此，那群怪人总让人感到毛骨悚然，一些平民对他们到来的消息非常恐慌，甚至已经有人开始撤离空间站，这让我的上级……不怎么满意，我想你能明白我的意思。由于这些尴尬的事件，我们失去了优秀的人民，不能让这样的情况再继续下去了。

我要你做的第一件事情就是到据报萨沙活动频繁的地区进行侦察。你要特别小心，先前派去的巡逻队都有去无回。如果你确实在那里发现了萨沙的舰船，消灭他们。留他们性命毫无意义，从疯子口中能问出什么呢。尽快把侦查情况回报给我们。

messages.en: You showed some class out there, {[character]player.name}.  Take your pay and report for your next assignment.
messages.zh: 你的表现很上档次，{[character]player.name}。这是你的报酬，下个工作正等着你呢。

name.es: Susurros en la oscuridad: Reza lo que sepas (2 de 4)
name.fr: Murmures dans les ténèbres – Poser et prier (2 sur 4)
name.ja: 闇からのささやき―力を尽くして祈れ（2/4）
name.ru: Шепот в ночи: лежи и молись (Whispers in the Dark - Lay And Pray) (2 из 4)
name.zh: 黑暗中的密语—守株待兔(2/4)

messages.en: Because of your successful reconnaissance mission, we've managed to narrow down the location of the main Sanshas activity a bit.  The data that we extracted from your system scanner also revealed to us a few Sanshas ships that were not mentioned in your preliminary report.  It appears to be some sort of convoy, at least one of their ships was clearly an industrial.  Because of this we guess that it may be a routine shipment, meaning that they might get a convoy at regular intervals.  We'd like you to fly out there, preferably with a cloaking device, and lay in wait for any possible sign of another Sansha convoy.  If you do see one, destroy it and bring back the contents of the industrials to me for inspection.
messages.zh: 由于你出色的侦查，我们已经缩小了萨沙部队主要的活动范围。分析人员仔细研究了你星系扫描仪中的数据，发现了一些你前期报告中没有提到的萨沙舰船。这是一支护航队，其中至少有一艘是工业舰船。因此我们猜想这也许是一次常规出货，每隔一段时间就会有一支护航队经过。带上隐形装置，去那里埋伏，如果真有护航队出现，歼灭他们，并把工业舰的货物带回来以供检查。

messages.en: Construction blocks?  I was afraid of that.  This doesn't seem to be a mere smuggling operation, but something much more sinister.  But we still don't know what they are building ... And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 建造模块？我就担心这个。这似乎不仅仅是非法贩售，而是些更邪恶的事情……可我们还是不知道他们在建造什么。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

name.en: Whispers in the Dark - The Outpost (4 of 4)
name.es: Susurros en la oscuridad: El puesto avanzado (4 de 4)
name.fr: Murmures dans les ténèbres – L'avant-poste (4 sur 4)
name.ja: 闇からのささやき―アウトポスト（4/4）
name.ru: Шепот в ночи: застава (Whispers in the Dark - The Outpost) (4 из 4)
name.zh: 黑暗中的密语—前哨驻地(4/4)

messages.en:
After reviewing the intel we received from the spy drones which you transferred for us in your last mission, we managed to pinpoint the location of a military outpost they are building in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It appears to be a part of a defensive perimeter that they are setting up around their territory, which has elevated our fears that they have actually managed to erect a large colony inside our solarsystem.

But for now let's keep our sights on the current task, to breach a hole in their defensive wall. We believe that the outpost in question hasn't been fully built, and therefore will be a fairly easy target for you if it's defensive installations aren't complete. Contact with the spy drones was cut off before we could fully analyze the Sansha forces in the area. But one thing's for sure, there will most certainly be guards nearby, and they will have to be dealt with. You will receive a bookmark to the location of the outpost, and your instructions are simple, destroy the habitat of their construction workers. That should slow them down a bit. Good luck.
messages.zh:
还记得上次任务里你运送的侦察无人机么，根据它发回来的信号，我们已成功定位萨沙在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造的军事哨站。似乎是他们建设中的领土防线的一部分。这意味着对方在这个太阳系里已经建造了一个大规模的殖民地，想到这个就让我不寒而栗。

不过现在还是把精力放到哨站上吧，我一直在考虑，如何能在对方的防御体系上开个口子。我们认为这个哨站并没有竣工，所以其防御设施相对比较薄弱，你可以应付。我们还没来得及从侦察无人机那里获取详细的萨沙军队布置，联系就中断了。有一点可以肯定，工地周围会有卫队，而你必须把他们都解决掉。哨站的位标已上传给你。指令只有一个，就是摧毁他们建筑工人的居住地，从而延缓工程的进度。祝好运。

messages.en: Magnificent job, {[character]player.name}.  Those Sansha really put up a fight didn't they?  However I believe you've done as much for us as we can possibly expect of you, the Sansha data sheets you brought back with you have confirmed our worst fears, the Sansha's Nation has a fully functional colony inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}!  It will take a massive force to take it out, and we can't expect you to handle a mission like that yet.  Good luck on your future endeavors.
messages.zh: 太漂亮了，{[character]player.name}。那些萨沙人抵抗地很激烈，是吧？不管怎样，我觉得你达到了我们对你的最大期望，你带回的萨沙数据单证实了我们最担心的事情，萨沙共和国在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内拥有一座功能齐备的殖民地！扫平它将需要一支超大部队，我们还不能指望你来执行这样一项任务。祝你一路顺风。

name.zh: 黑暗中的密语—侦察无人机(3/4)

messages.en:
Now that we've established the general location of the Sanshas activity within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, it's actually time to find out exactly what they are building. In your last mission you destroyed one of their construction block transports, but this brings us no closer to finding their base of operations. We've had no luck interrogating the mindless creatures before, and the surveillance teams we have sent to investigate the area have either found nothing or disappeared. This leaves us with very few options. But after brainstorming possible solutions to our problem, I came up with a devious plan.

We have in our possession so called 'spy drones', straight from our science labs, which attach themselves to a nearby ships hull and emits a low frequency signal which is picked up by one of our beacons which are strewn around {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, which in turn sends a high frequency signal to our control tower in {[location]agentStationID.name}.

Now we know that an agent of the Sansha's Nation regularly picks up shipments of Ectoplasm at a certain station near here. If we can place the spy drone into his next shipment, this might allow us to track his ship to its destination.

Our men have placed beacons throughout our constellation, so everything is in place. All you need to do is take these crates filled with ectoplasm, and our spy drones, to the station specified in the mission details, our agents there will take care of the rest. With luck we'll soon know the location of the Sansha base.
messages.zh:
我们已经掌握了萨沙在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}境内的大致活动位置，现在该去查出他们究竟在建造什么东西。上次任务时你虽然摧毁了他们一艘建材运输船，但我们在查找他们的军事基地方面仍然无所进展。之前对这些蠢货的审问都一无所获，而派去那个区域的调查队不是无功而返就是彻底消失。这让我们几乎束手无策。在听取多方意见后，我决定采用迂回战术。

目前我们手头有一些所谓的“侦察无人机”，是我们的实验室研发的，能够附着在附近舰船的船体上，并发出只有位于{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}附近的信标才能接收的低频信号，信标随后向{[location]agentStationID.name}里的控制塔发射高频信号。

我们得知萨沙共和国的代理人会定期在附近的固定空间站中提取外质。如果我们能把侦查无人机安置到他的下一批货物中，说不定能追踪到他的目的地。

我们的人在整个星座内都部署了信标，万事俱备，只欠东风。你要做的就是把装有外质和侦察无人机的箱子运送到任务详情中提到的空间站，我们的代理人会处理好后续事宜。运气好的话，我们很快就能知道萨沙基地的位置了。

messages.en: Good job {[character]player.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得不错，{[character]player.name}。先别走，我还有个任务等着你呢！

name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-見込みのある手がかり（4/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - возможные наводки (Kidnappers Strike - Possible Leads) (4 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—可能的线索(4/10)

messages.en: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to transport a data chip we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. We need it deciphered, and I happen to know the perfect man for the job, who lives at that station. We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless. By the time you get back, I expect our interrogators will have found some more leads.
messages.zh: 在我们审讯你上次任务中抓获的飞行员时，我想让你把这块芯片，从他包里搜出来的，送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。那里有个破译高手能帮我们的忙。现在还不清楚这芯片内是否有强有力的证据，但试一下总没什么坏处。希望等你回来的时候，这边的审讯也能有一些突破。

messages.en: Well, then... Perhaps you should seek volunteer service with the Sisters of Eve?
messages.zh: 呃，那好吧……也许你该去姐妹会做志愿者吧？

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Belastende Beweise (5 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: Pruebas incriminatorias (5 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Preuves compromettantes (5 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-犯罪証拠（5/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - инкриминирующие свидетельства (Kidnappers Strike - Incriminating Evidence) (5 из 10)

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Any news on the interrogation of the prisoner I brought to you?
messages.zh: 我带回的俘虏交待了什么吗？

messages.en:
Yes, the interrogation went well. We managed to find out who he was working for. Apparently he had been contacted by a Darkonnen agent and paid a vast sum of money to kidnap our CEO's niece. A foolhardy task, but he did manage to pull it off and transfer her into the hands of the criminals.

Also, the data disc you transported in your last mission has revealed even more to us. It contained the precise meeting points between the kidnappers and the Darkonnen agent for the past few weeks, as well as the exact coordinates for the next meeting, which is to take place very soon now. I'd like you to fly over there yourself and ambush the Darkonnen goons at that location. Be quick: I don't know how long they will wait for their contact to arrive.
messages.zh:
是的，审讯进行得十分顺利。我们已经得知幕后主使的身份了。显然他曾与一个达克农特工接触过，而且收受了一大笔佣金来绑架我们CEO的侄女。这任务不需要用什么头脑，不过他的确完成了，还把女孩送到了那些罪犯的手里。

你上次任务中运送的数据盘也向我们揭示了更多信息。上面清楚记录了绑架者和这个达克农特工过去几周内详细的接头地点，还有很快就要进行的下一次接头的精确坐标。我想要你亲自飞过去，在那儿伏击这些达克农的打手。动作要快：我不知道他们会在那里等多久。

messages.en:
Good work. I'm surprised, however, that you didn't find any survivors in the wreckage. Pirates usually don't fight to the death unless something big is at stake.

Oh, hey, don't you take off just yet. If you're willing, I have another assignment for you.
messages.zh:
干得好。不过有点我很惊讶，你居然没在残骸中发现任何生还者。除非是什么重要东西遭到了危险，否则海盗通常不会舍命相搏。

噢，嘿，先别急着离开。如果你愿意，我还有另一项任务给你。

messages.en: My ship is in need of some work, so I'm afraid I can't complete this in time.
messages.zh: 我的飞船需要修理，恐怕不能按时完成这个任务了。

messages.en: What?! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's niece executed! Don't bother coming back!!
messages.zh: 什么？！你的懦弱可能已经害死了我CEO的侄女！滚！不要让我再见到你！！

messages.en: What?! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's niece executed! Don't bother coming back!!
messages.zh: 什么？！你的懦弱可能已经害死了我CEO的侄女！滚！不要让我再见到你！！

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Ausbruch der Grippe (6 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - The Flu Outbreak (6 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: El brote de gripe (6 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – L'épidémie de grippe (6 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-インフルエンザの大流行（6/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - эпидемия гриппа (Kidnappers Strike - The Flu Outbreak) (6 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—流感爆发(6/10)

messages.en: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.
messages.zh: 我马上把抗病毒药物带来。

messages.en:
We've had a major influenza outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}. Because of it, our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon. We have a lot of personnel here; given the current state of affairs, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicine. I've taken the liberty of ordering the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}; I need you to transport them here.

Please hurry ― our staff is depending on you.
messages.zh:
一场严重的流感在{[location]agentStationID.name}这里爆发了。这造成了我们的抗病毒药物储备的大量消耗，恐怕很快就要用完了。我们这里人员众多；在如今的事态下，我们可不希望他们一半人因为缺药而请病假。我擅自在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}订了一批抗病毒药物；想让你去把它们运过来。

请快点——我们的员工都靠你了。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Das geheime Treffen (7 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - The Secret Meeting  (7 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: La reunión secreta (7 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – La réunion secrète (7 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-秘密の会合（7/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - тайная встреча (Kidnappers Strike - The Secret Meeting ) (7 из 10)

messages.en: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.
messages.zh: 很好。记住，除非被逼无奈，否则切勿在会面地点攻击任何人。先听他们把话说完。

messages.en: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's niece. I'm reluctant to send you, since this may be a trap, but I really have no choice. If I send someone else, though, I could be compromising the investigation. So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission. Be sure to record anything said to you and save it into your ship's database, and then return with it to me.
messages.zh: 我刚刚收到一个匿名消息，指名要你去{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的一个地点会面。同时还说你会见的人掌握着重要情报，有助于我们找到失踪的CEO侄女。我并不想派你去，因为这可能是个陷阱，但我别无选择。如果我派其他人去，就可能破坏我们的调查。所以我请求你，直接前往那条匿名消息上提供的位标地址。记得把所有的谈话内容都保存到你飞船的数据库里，之后带回给我。

messages.en: Very interesting indeed. You've done us a great service, {[character]player.name}. Now let's just hope that these Blood Raider swine can give us the true location of our CEO's niece.
messages.zh: 确实非常有趣。你帮了我们大忙了，{[character]player.name}。现在就等这些卑劣的血袭者说出我们CEO侄女的真正所在了。

messages.en: Sounds too risky for me. Sorry, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 这听起来太危险了，抱歉，{[character]agentID.name}。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Verteidigt den zivilen Konvoi (8 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - Defend the Civilian Convoy (8 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: La defensa del convoy civil (8 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Défendre le convoi de civils (8 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-民間船団を守れ（8/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - защитить гражданский конвой (Kidnappers Strike - Defend the Civilian Convoy) (8 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—守卫平民护航队(8/10)

messages.en: A Blood Raider strike force entered this system earlier today and wiped out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault! Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!
messages.zh: 今天早些时候，一支血袭者的部队进入了本星系，发动了一场突袭并摧毁了我们几艘巡逻舰！就在刚才，我们收到了一支民间护航队断断续续的求救信号，他们正在前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个补给站的途中。恐怕他们遭到了同一群海盗的袭击。请立即启航，在事情不可收拾之前赶去救援！我会把他们的精确坐标给你。好了，快去吧！

messages.en: Good job out there. Sadly, it seems that their attack on the civilian convoy was only a diversion; while the population here was in a state of panic, a few Blood Raider agents managed to break into the prison cell containing the captives you brought back on one of your previous missions. We must get those prisoners back, as we still don't know the location of their base! Let me know when you're ready for another assignment: I need you ASAP.
messages.zh: 表现很出色嘛！不过很遗憾，他们对民用护航队的袭击似乎只是声东击西；就在这里的民众陷入恐慌的时候，几个血袭者特工闯入了牢狱，救走了你在之前任务中抓获的囚犯。我们必须抓回那些犯人，因为我们还没问出他们基地的位置！你准备好做新任务了就通知我：我现在非常需要你。

messages.en: A Blood Raider strike force entered this system earlier today and wiped out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault! Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Bringen Sie die Gefangenen zurück (9 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - Retrieve the Prisoners (9 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: El rescate de los prisioneros (9 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Récupérer les prisonniers (9 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-捕虜を救出せよ（9/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - вернуть пленников (Kidnappers Strike - Retrieve the Prisoners) (9 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—追回俘虏(9/10)

messages.en: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from the Blood Raiders, a few of their agents broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. Our interrogation was not complete and we still don't know where their base is located, so we must get them back. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!
messages.zh: 我之前就说了，正当我们手忙脚乱地协助护航队抵御血袭者的袭击时，他们的一些特工闯入了我们的牢狱，救走了你抓来的囚犯。我们对他们的审讯还没结束，还不知道他们的基地所在，所以我们必须把他们抓回来。不过我们掌握了他们的航向。我要你在他们逃离这个星系前截住他们。在他们消失在无边的宇宙深处前，这或许是我们最后的机会，赶紧去吧！

messages.en: Fantastic! You really showed some skill out there, {[character]player.name}. I'm proud to say I know you. And be sure to come see me again ― I have one more job for you!
messages.zh: 太棒了！你在那真的大显身手，{[character]player.name}。认识你是我的荣耀。一定要回来找我哦——我还有一项任务给你呢！

This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Das letzte Gefecht (10 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - The Final Battle (10 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: La batalla final (10 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Le dernier combat (10 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-最後の戦い（10/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - решающая битва (Kidnappers Strike - The Final Battle) (10 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—最后的战役(10/10)

messages.en: I'll do my best.
messages.zh: 我会尽力的。

messages.en: You have some guts accepting this mission, {[character]player.name}, and for that I have the utmost respect.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，接下这项任务表示你拥有非凡的勇气，我向你致以最高敬意。

messages.en:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of new evidence that apparently points to the girl being held in a Blood Raider stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our information, she is being held in their chapel and is going to be sacrificed in the near future in one of their bloody rituals. We must see that she is returned to her family safely before those despicable Blood Raider fanatics murder her.

There is a fundamental problem, however; the Blood Raiders are fully aware of our intention to free her and have sent in a fleet of their battleships to guard their outpost. Now, I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the girl, and escaping with your ship intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the chapel. Once you arrive at the final room, all you have to do is destroy the chapel and retrieve the girl from the ejected safety capsule. (All of their chapels have this mechanism in place to save their priests from death should the structure be obliterated.) If we send in a fleet of ships, the Blood Raiders will simply kill her as soon as they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, with a small force, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the girl alive after destroying the chapel, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall, then I will personally make sure the Raider scum pay the price. Good luck.
messages.zh:
情报部门带来的最新消息，女孩被关押在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的血袭者据点内。据侦察，她被囚禁在一个小礼堂内，不久之后将会在一次血腥的祭祀中成为他们的祭品。我们有责任插手这件事，在那些血袭者的疯子干掉女孩之前，把她解救出来，安全送回家。

然而，这个计划有一个缺陷：血袭者对我们要解救女孩的意图十分清楚，专门派遣了一支战列舰队来保护他们的哨站。硬碰硬你的胜率为零，但以你的能力，应该可以潜入对方基地，和女孩一起毫发无损地归来。

我们已经设立了一系列加速轨道直接通往关押女孩的礼拜堂，你到了那儿以后，要做的就是摧毁那个礼拜堂，并将女孩从弹射舱内解救出来。血袭者所有的礼拜堂都有这样的安全弹射舱，可以在礼拜堂被摧毁时保护他们的牧师。希望他们对那个女孩足够重视，做了这样的安全措施。要是没有的话……现在我们别无选择。要是我们派舰队去攻打，一旦他们陷入劣势，就会拖女孩陪葬的。闪电战是唯一的出路，在他们还没搞清楚情况前就把女孩救出来。谨慎行动，你没有第二次机会。

要是你在摧毁礼堂后没有找到那个女孩，立即启动跃迁器离开。{[character]player.name}，我可不想失去你。但你放心，要是你真的为此牺牲了，我一定会让血袭者付出代价！愿幸运女神眷顾着你！

messages.en:
Nice work. This victory of yours will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the Blood Raider leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be sacrificed in one of their rituals as punishment ― ha! A fitting end to one of those bloodthirsty maniacs.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's niece is now in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since her capture. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunately this all ended ... I have a nagging suspicion that someone else was behind all of this and played us like fools.

But enough of this, let us rejoice at a job well done. Our CEO sends his utmost gratitude, as well as a special bonus reward from his own coffers, which he hopes you will enjoy.
messages.zh:
干得不错。你的胜利对负责哨站守卫的血袭者首领一定是个沉重的打击。我肯定他会成为血袭者某次宗教仪式上的祭品—哈！这种残忍成性的禽兽死有余辜。

还有一个好消息，我们CEO的侄女现正已在我们的保护之下。我们在这个空间站附近漂浮的安全舱里找到了她，她安然无恙。很明显，绑架者对她用了药，她对被绑架后发生的事情几乎一点印象都没有。但我总觉得这一切结束得太顺利。直觉告诉我，有人在背后操控这一切，把我们当猴耍。

算了，不想那么多了，我们该庆祝一下。我们的CEO对你感激不尽，并从他的私人金库拨出了特别奖赏给你，希望你能喜欢。

messages.en: You expect me to go out alone against a virtual armada of battleships, all for some snotty little girl? I expected more of you, {[character]agentID.name}. Be realistic.
messages.zh: 你希望我去为一个满脸鼻涕的小女孩独自对抗一整支战列舰队？我高估你了，{[character]agentID.name}。现实一点吧。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Hinterhalt im Dunkeln (1 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - Ambush in the Dark (1 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: Emboscada en la oscuridad (1 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Guet-apens dans les ténèbres (1 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-暗闇での待ち伏せ（1/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - засада в ночи (Kidnappers Strike - Ambush in the Dark) (1 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—黑暗中的伏击(1/10)

messages.en: I will do my best, you can count on that.
messages.zh: 我会尽力，交给我吧。

messages.en: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.
messages.zh: 好极了！我们就指望你了。

messages.en: So what's this important stuff you keep yammering about?
messages.zh: 那么你一直在唠叨的重要的事是什么呢？

messages.en:
I just received news of a grave incident that occurred in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now, I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser that was escorting our CEO, for we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, but there was no trace of the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any sign left behind by the pirates, who so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.
messages.zh:
我刚收到消息，几小时前在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}发生了一起严重的事故。载有我们尊敬的CEO的护航队遭到了一支异常庞大而且组织有序的海盗的伏击。但是今晚幸运之神眷顾了我们，由于CEO护卫队的英勇顽强，CEO安全逃脱，当然稍受惊吓是在所难免的。我们失去了很多优秀的战士，卫队长也光荣牺牲……愿他安息。

好了，我们切入正题。我们认为海盗俘虏了一些护送我们CEO的巡洋舰的船员，因为在事发地点我们找到了该船的残骸，但是没有发现大多数船员的尸骸。{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的特种部队被叫到现场进行搜索，看是否有这些海盗的线索，但到目前为止还没有任何海盗的信息。我们希望你能帮助调查。我们知道一个在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}星系海盗们常去的隐藏地点。我会把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中：请搜索这些区域找出可能存在的线索，如果你抓到了犯人就把他们带回来接受审讯。

messages.en:
Well done, {[character]player.name}. I see that my theory held merit, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members. After we've given them proper trauma counseling, we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.

And don't you leave just yet. I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。看来我的计划生效了，你成功把失踪船员带回来了。在他们接受适当的心理咨询后，我们会询问他们在被囚禁期间是否获得任何线索。

先别走。我还有别的任务给你！

I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.

messages.en: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.
messages.zh: 你以为我这样的懦夫能接受这么难的任务？求你了……

messages.en: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.
messages.zh: 好吧，我知道你不愿接受挑战。或许你的继任者会比你更有勇气。

messages.en: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.
messages.zh: 我很失望，推荐你的人对你的评价很高。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Das Verhör (2 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: El interrogatorio (2 de 10)
name.ru: Атака похитителей - допрос (Kidnappers Strike - The Interrogation) (2 из 10)

messages.en: I'll do it in no time. Now please update me on how the investigation is going.
messages.zh: 我马上就去做。请随时告诉我审讯的进展。

messages.en: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.
messages.zh: 非常不幸，我们现在的线索还非常模糊。等你完成手头的任务再回来，那时可能有进一步的信息。

messages.en: After checking our logs, we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy. The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel. I need them transferred to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation; hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.
messages.zh: 我们检查了日志后，发现你带回来的俘虏中只有部分是我们护卫队遭袭时被海盗抓获的船员。剩下的显然是你击毁的一艘海盗船上的成员，他们在船只的爆炸中逃过一劫。我需要把他们转移到另一个空间站的一些同事那里进行进一步审讯；希望那里的专家能够撬开他们的嘴巴，获得伏击我们CEO的幕后黑手的有关线索。

messages.en: Great work once again, {[character]player.name}. But I need you back here urgently for another assignment; something terrible just happened. I'll get you posted once you are ready.
messages.zh: 又是个漂亮活儿，{[character]player.name}。不过我迫切需要你回来完成另一个任务；发生了件可怕的事情。等你准备好后，我会告诉你细节。

messages.en: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.
messages.zh: 我不能接受。这件事情至关重要，不能交给像我这样的人办。

messages.en: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.
messages.zh: 我不想和你争辩，我会另请高明。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Die Entführung (3 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: El secuestro (3 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Le kidnapping (3 sur 10)
name.ru: Атака похитителей - похищение (Kidnappers Strike - The Kidnapping) (3 из 10)

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en:
We urgently need help intercepting a group of kidnappers who just managed to snatch the granddaughter of our CEO while she was visiting him in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for an illegal organization calling themeselves the "Komni Corporation."

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, for we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with this Komni agent in the past; we hope this pirate will be able to lead you to the agent. The only catch is that he will most likely require a bit of "convincing" on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom; once you have extracted the information from the middleman, I expect you to find the Komni agent and bring him back to me.
messages.zh:
我们迫切需要你去帮我们拦截一伙卑鄙的绑匪，他们趁我们CEO的侄女来这个星系拜访他的时候绑架了她。绑匪是雇佣兵，背后可能有达克农的指使。我会在你的任务日志里给出该组织更详尽的信息。

你最好把他们的代理人活捉回来，我们一定要审讯他，我怀疑这个人就是绑架者和幕后主使之间的联络人。我们要彻查这起滔天罪行的幕后黑手！我可以提供给你一个线人，是个海盗，曾与达克农成员有密切接触，他应该会给你带路。当然，我想你需要费一些功夫来取得他的“信任”。我会在你的控制边栏中上传他的位标，希望你能得到有用的消息，指引你找到达克农的代理人，并将他带回来。

messages.en:
Well done. We will proceed immediately to interrogating the prisoner, so expect some results soon. Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.

And don't go anywhere: I have another assignment for you.
messages.zh:
干得好！我们会立即开始审讯俘虏，你很快就会得到结果。我们的审讯官可是很有……“说服力”的。

别到处乱跑：我还有另一项任务给你。

messages.en: No, this does not interest me.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我对这个任务没兴趣。

messages.en: Well, I did not say every job would be sunshine and pleasurehalls. Perhaps you are more suited for simple wreck-hauling missions?
messages.zh: 嗯，我可没说过每项工作都充满阳光和喜悦。或许你更适合拖运残骸之类的简单工作吧？

messages.en: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to transport a data chip we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. We need it deciphered, and I happen to know the perfect man for the job, who lives at that station. We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless. By the time you get back, I expect our interrogators will have found some more leads.
messages.zh: 在我们审讯你上次任务中抓获的飞行员时，我想让你把这块芯片，从他包里搜出来的，送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。那里有个破译高手能帮我们的忙。现在还不清楚这芯片内是否有强有力的证据，但试一下总没什么坏处。希望等你回来的时候，这边的审讯也能有一些突破。

messages.en: I see. Well, perhaps you should look into a new career? Maybe teaching preschool might be more up your alley?
messages.zh: 我明白了。也许你该找份新职业？可能教学龄前儿童更合你的胃口？

name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-犯罪証拠（5/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - инкриминирующие свидетельства (Kidnappers Strike - Incriminating Evidence) (5 из 10)

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Any news on the interrogation of the prisoner I brought to you?
messages.zh: 我带回的俘虏交待了什么吗？

messages.en:
Yes, the interrogation went well. We managed to find out who he was working for. Apparently he had been contacted by a Komni agent and paid a vast sum of money to kidnap our CEO's granddaughter. A foolhardy task, but he did manage to pull it off and transfer her into the hands of the criminals.

Also, the data disc you transported in your last mission has revealed even more to us. It contained the precise meeting points between the kidnappers and the Komni agent for the past few weeks, as well as the exact coordinates for the next meeting, which is to take place very soon now. I'd like you to fly over there yourself and ambush the Komni goons at that location. Be quick: I don't know how long they will wait for their contact to arrive.
messages.zh:
是的，审讯进行得十分顺利。我们已经得知幕后主使的身份。显然他曾与一个克姆尼特工接触过，而且收受了一大笔佣金来绑架我们CEO的孙女。这任务不需要用什么头脑，不过他的确完成了，还把女孩送到了那些罪犯的手里。

你上次任务中运送的数据盘也向我们揭示了更多信息。上面清楚记录了绑架者和这个克姆尼特工过去几周内详细的接头地点，还有很快就要进行的下一次接头的精确坐标。我想要你亲自飞过去，在那儿伏击这些克姆尼的打手。动作要快：我不知道他们会在那里等多久。

messages.en:
Good work. I'm surprised, however, that you didn't find any survivors in the wreckage. Pirates usually don't fight to the death unless something big is at stake.

Oh, hey, don't you take off just yet. If you're willing, I have another assignment for you.
messages.zh:
干得好。不过有点我很惊讶，你居然没在残骸中发现任何生还者。除非是什么重要东西遭到了危险，否则海盗通常不会舍命相搏。

噢，嘿，先别急着离开。如果你愿意，我还有另一项任务给你。

messages.en: I have some other business to attend to, so I'm afraid I can't complete this in time.
messages.zh: 我有些别的事要去处理，恐怕不能按时完成这个任务。

messages.en: What?! Your incompetence has probably cost our CEO's granddaughter her life! I wouldn't bother coming back!!
messages.zh: 什么？！你的无能可能已经害死了我们CEO的孙女！我不想再见到你！！

messages.en: What?! Your incompetence has probably cost our CEO's granddaughter her life! I wouldn't bother coming back!!
messages.zh: 什么？！你的无能可能已经害死了我们CEO的孙女！我不想再见到你！！

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Ausbruch der Grippe (6 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - The Flu Outbreak (6 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: El brote de gripe (6 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – L'épidémie de grippe (6 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-インフルエンザの大流行（6/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - эпидемия гриппа (Kidnappers Strike - The Flu Outbreak) (6 из 10)

messages.en: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.
messages.zh: 我马上把抗生素带来。

messages.en:
We've had a major influenza outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}. Because of it, our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon. We have a lot of personnel here; given the current state of affairs, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicine. I've taken the liberty of ordering the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}; I need you to transport them here.

Please hurry ― our staff is depending on you.
messages.zh:
一场严重的流感在{[location]agentStationID.name}这里爆发了。这造成了我们的抗病毒药物储备的大量消耗，恐怕很快就要用完了。我们这里人员众多；在如今的事态下，我们可不希望他们一半人因为缺药而请病假。我擅自在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}订了一批抗病毒药物；想让你去把它们运过来。

请快点——我们的员工都靠你了。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Das geheime Treffen (7 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - The Secret Meeting  (7 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: La reunión secreta (7 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – La réunion secrète (7 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-秘密の会合（7/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - тайная встреча (Kidnappers Strike - The Secret Meeting ) (7 из 10)

messages.en: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.
messages.zh: 很好。记住，除非被逼无奈，否则切勿在会面地点攻击任何人。先听他们把话说完。

messages.en: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's granddaughter. I'm reluctant to send you, since this may be a trap, but I really have no choice. If I send someone else, though, I could be compromising the investigation. So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission. Be sure to record anything said to you and save it into your ship's database, and then return with it to me.
messages.zh: 我刚刚收到一个匿名消息，明确指定要你到{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}和他们见面。同时还说你会见的人掌握着重要情报，有助于我们找到CEO的侄女。就个人而言，我并不想让你去，那极有可能是个陷阱，但我别无选择。他们点名要你，如果我派其他人，就是在跟女孩的命过不去。具体的位标我已提供给你，直接去吧。记得把所有的谈话内容都存到你飞船的数据库里，活着把它带给我。你认为怎么样？

messages.en: Very interesting indeed. You've done us a great service, {[character]player.name}. Now let's just hope that these Guristas scoundrels can reveal the location of our CEO's granddaughter.
messages.zh: 确实非常有趣。你帮了我们大忙了，{[character]player.name}。现在就等这些古斯塔斯恶棍说出我们CEO孙女的真正所在了。

messages.en: Sounds too risky for me. Sorry, {[character]agentID.name}, but I´m outta here.
messages.zh: 这听起来太危险了。抱歉，{[character]agentID.name}，我得闪了。

messages.en:
I'm glad you made your way here, {[character]player.name}. We had an amazing breach of security earlier today when a band of Blood Raider agents managed to infiltrate one of our shipyards and steal some very valuable equipment from its compounds. We've tracked them down to a Blood Raider supply depot in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, where they have set up a defensive perimeter in preparation for an attack. I know this might be a difficult assignment for you, {[character]player.name}, but it's vital that we retrieve the stolen goods from those blood-sucking vermin.

Our spies tell us that the equipment we're looking for is located in one of their storage facilities in the depot, still in its sealed container. Don't hesitate to destroy the structure, in order to retrieve the goods. And you can keep anything extra you find there. Good luck.
messages.zh:
我真高兴你能来，{[character]player.name}。今天早些时候，由于安全上的漏洞，一撮血袭者特务潜入了我们的造船厂，拿走了一些非常宝贵的设备。我们追查到他们目前在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的一个血袭者补给站，那里有完整的防线来应付攻击。这个任务对你来说可能难了点，{[character]player.name}，但是我们一定要从那群吸血鬼手里把设备抢回来，这至关重要。

根据密探发回的消息，我们要找的设备在他们的一个存储设施里，依然好好地存放在密封货柜内。摧毁整个建筑，你就能找到它。除了设备外的任何战利品你都可以自己留着。祝好运。

messages.en: Masterfully done, {[character]player.name}.  We owe you one.
messages.zh: 非常漂亮，{[character]player.name}。我们欠你一个人情。

name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: La defensa del convoy civil (8 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Défendre le convoi de civils (8 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-民間船団を守れ（8/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - защитить гражданский конвой (Kidnappers Strike - Defend the Civilian Convoy) (8 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—守卫平民护航队(8/10)

messages.en: A Guristas strike force entered this system earlier today and wiped out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault! Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!
messages.zh: 今天早些时候，一支古斯塔斯部队进入了本星系，发动了一场突袭并摧毁了我们几艘巡逻舰！就在刚才，我们收到了一支民间护航队断断续续的求救信号，他们正在前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个补给站的途中。恐怕他们遭到了同一群海盗的袭击。请立即启航，在事情不可收拾之前赶去救援！我会把他们的精确坐标给你。好了，快去吧！

messages.en: Good job out there. Sadly, it seems that their attack on the civilian convoy was only a diversion; while the population here was in a state of panic, a few Gurista scumbags managed to break into the prison cell containing the captives you brought back on one of your previous missions. We must get those prisoners back, as we still don't know the location of their base! Let me know when you're ready for another assignment: I need you ASAP.
messages.zh: 表现很出色嘛！不过很遗憾，他们对民用护航队的袭击似乎只是声东击西；就在这里的民众陷入恐慌的时候，一些古斯塔斯恶棍闯入了牢狱，救走了你在之前任务中抓获的囚犯。我们必须抓回那些犯人，因为我们还没问出他们基地的位置！你准备好做新任务了就通知我：我现在非常需要你。

Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!

name.en: Kidnappers Strike - Retrieve the Prisoners (9 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: El rescate de los prisioneros (9 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Récupérer les prisonniers (9 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-捕虜を救出せよ（9/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - вернуть пленников (Kidnappers Strike - Retrieve the Prisoners) (9 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—追回俘虏(9/10)

messages.en: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from the Guristas, a few of them broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. Our interrogation was not complete and we still don't know where their base is located, so we must get them back. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!
messages.zh: 我之前就说了，正当我们手忙脚乱地协助护航队抵御古斯塔斯的袭击时，他们一些人闯入了我们的牢狱，救走了你抓来的囚犯。我们对他们的审讯还没结束，还不知道他们的基地所在，所以我们必须把他们抓回来。不过我们掌握了他们的航向。我要你在他们逃离这个星系前截住他们。在他们消失在无边的宇宙深处前，这或许是我们最后的机会，赶紧去吧！

messages.en: Fantastic! You really showed some skill out there, {[character]player.name}. I'm proud to say I know you. And be sure to come see me again ― I have one more job for you!
messages.zh: 太棒了！你在那真的大显身手，{[character]player.name}。认识你是我的荣耀。一定要回来找我哦——我还有一项任务给你呢！

name.en: Kidnappers Strike - The Final Battle (10 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: La batalla final (10 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Le dernier combat (10 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-最後の戦い（10/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - решающая битва (Kidnappers Strike - The Final Battle) (10 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—最后的战役(10/10)

messages.en: I'll do my best.
messages.zh: 我尽力吧。

messages.en: You have some guts accepting this mission, {[character]player.name}, and for that I have the utmost respect for you.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，接下这项任务需要勇气，我对你表示敬佩。

messages.en:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of new evidence that apparently points to the girl being held in a Guristas stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our information, she is being held in their central control tower, to be executed if their demands are not met. We must see that she is returned to her family safely before those lunatics murder her.

There is a problem, however; the Guristas are fully aware of our intention to free her and have sent in a fleet of their battleships to guard their outpost. Now, I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the girl, and escaping with your ship intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the chapel. Once you arrive at the final room, all you have to do is destroy the control tower and retrieve the girl from the ejected safety capsule. (All of their towers have this mechanism in place to save their ranking officers from death should the structure be obliterated.) If we send in a fleet of ships, the Guristas will simply kill her as soon as they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, with a small force, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the girl alive after destroying the tower, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall, then I will personally make sure those dirtbags pay the price. Good luck.
messages.zh:
我们刚刚收到情报小组的最新消息，女孩被关押在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的一个古斯塔斯要塞内。消息称，她被囚禁在他们的中央控制塔里，如果他们的要求得不到满足就会撕票。在那些疯子害死女孩之前，我们一定把她救出来，安全送回家。

然而，我们还有个麻烦；古斯塔斯对我们要解救女孩的意图十分清楚，并专门派遣了一支战列舰队来守卫哨站。我不指望你跟他们硬碰硬，但以你的能力应该可以潜入对方基地，并和女孩一起毫发无伤地回来。

我们发现了一组加速轨道，直接的连接到礼拜堂的中心位置。一旦你到达了最里面的一层，你所需要做的就是摧毁控制塔并且将从其残骸中被弹射出来的安全逃生舱找到，女孩儿就在里面。（他们所有的控制塔都有类似的机关用来在结构发生毁灭性爆炸的时候挽救高级官员的生命。）如果我们派大量的舰队进入这个区域，意识到必败无疑的古斯塔斯必定会当即将女孩儿处死。我们要快速迅猛的给予他们致命的打击，而且只采用一支较小的作战部队，在他们还没有反应过来的时候就将其制服。这是我们能把她活着从那儿带出来的唯一机会了。

如果，你没有在摧毁控制塔后找到活着的女孩儿，那么你就立即启动跃迁引擎离开那个地方！我不想再没有意义的失去你，{[character]player.name}。但要是万一，你没能活着完成任务，我一定会亲自让那些狗东西付出代价的，愿幸运女神眷顾着你！

messages.en:
Nice work. This victory of yours will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the pirate leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be duly executed by his superiors.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's granddaughter is now back in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since her capture. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunately this all ended ... I have a nagging suspicion that someone else was behind all of this and played us like fools.

But enough of this, let us rejoice at a job well done. Our CEO sends his utmost gratitude, as well as a special bonus reward from his own coffers, which he hopes you will enjoy.
messages.zh:
干得不错。你的胜利对负责哨站守卫的海盗首领一定是个沉重的打击。我肯定他会被上级按罪处死。

还有一个好消息，我们CEO的孙女现正已在我们的保护之下。我们在这个空间站附近漂浮的安全舱里找到了她，她安然无恙。很明显，绑架者对她用了药，她对被绑架后发生的事情几乎一点印象都没有。但我总觉得这一切结束得太顺利。直觉告诉我，有人在背后操控这一切，把我们当猴耍。

算了，不想那么多了，我们该庆祝一下。我们的CEO对你感激不尽，并从他的私人金库拨给你一笔特别的酬劳，希望你能满意。

messages.en: You expect me to go in there and risk life and limb just to rescue some snotty little rich kid?! Uh, no. You're crazy, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 你要我去那里冒生命危险，结果只是为救一个满脸鼻涕的富家小孩？呃，不。你疯了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of new evidence that apparently points to the girl being held in a Guristas stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our information, she is being held in their central control tower, to be executed if their demands are not met. We must see that she is returned to her family safely before those lunatics murder her.

There is a problem, however; the Guristas are fully aware of our intention to free her and have sent in a fleet of their battleships to guard their outpost. Now, I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the girl, and escaping with your ship intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the chapel. Once you arrive at the final room, all you have to do is destroy the control tower and retrieve the girl from the ejected safety capsule. (All of their towers have this mechanism in place to save their ranking officers from death should the structure be obliterated.) If we send in a fleet of ships, the Guristas will simply kill her as soon as they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, with a small force, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the girl alive after destroying the tower, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall, then I will personally make sure those dirtbags pay the price. Good luck.

messages.en:
I'm glad you made your way here, {[character]player.name}. We had an amazing breach of security earlier today when a band of Guristas Pirate agents managed to infiltrate one of our shipyards and steal some very valuable equipment from its compounds. We've tracked them down to a Guristas supply depot in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, where they have set up a defensive perimeter in preparation for an attack. I know this might be a difficult assignment for you, {[character]player.name}, but it's vital that we retrieve the stolen goods from those terrorist vermin.

Our spies tell us that the equipment we're looking for is located in one of their storage facilities in the depot, still in its sealed container. Don't hesitate to destroy the structure, in order to retrieve the goods. And you can keep anything extra you find there. Good luck.
messages.zh:
我真高兴你能来，{[character]player.name}。今天早些时候，由于安全上的漏洞，一撮古斯塔斯特务潜入了我们的造船厂，拿走了一些非常宝贵的设备。我们追查到他们目前在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的一个古斯塔斯补给站，那里有完整的防线来应付攻击。这个任务对你来说可能难了点，{[character]player.name}，但是我们一定要从那群吸血鬼手里把设备抢回来，这至关重要。

根据密探发回的消息，我们要找的设备在他们的一个存储设施里，依然好好地存放在密封货柜内。摧毁整个建筑，你就能找到它。除了设备外的任何战利品你都可以自己留着。祝好运。

messages.en: Masterfully done, {[character]player.name}.  We owe you one.
messages.zh: 非常漂亮，{[character]player.name}。我们欠你一个人情。

messages.en: Ah, {[character]player.name}, good to see you. To business. We've just detected a hidden Amarrian reconnaissance outpost nearby. I don't need to explain the threat to you, do I? We must wipe them out before they are able to expand their operations further into our territory. If you can take care of this problem for me, you will be well rewarded.
messages.zh: 很高兴见到你，{[character]player.name}。言归正传。我们刚刚侦测到附近有隐藏着一座艾玛人的侦察哨站。它的威胁有多大，不必我多说了吧？在他们进一步侵略我们的国土前，我们必须先下手为强。要是你能帮我解决掉这个麻烦，我一定不会亏待你。

messages.en: The Amarrians are taken care of ― now, about my reward!
messages.zh: 艾玛人都被摆平了——现在，给我报酬！

messages.en: I'll get somebody else on it then.
messages.zh: 那我另找个人。

messages.en: I can't do it. It's too hard.
messages.zh: 我做不了。太难了。

messages.en: You disappoint me: I guess I'll have to get someone else in here.
messages.zh: 你令我失望：看来我得另请高明了。

messages.en: I'll show them who's boss.
messages.zh: 我会给他们点颜色看的。

messages.en:
High command asked me to pass this on to you ― they seem to think you're ideal for the job.

We've detected a small Amarrian reconnaissance outpost nearby and would like you to eliminate the threat as fast as possible. We can't allow these Amarrian scum to come near our homes unharassed. Make them pay.
messages.zh:
最高指挥部让我把这个转交给你——他们似乎觉得你是完成这项任务的不二之选。

我们侦测到附近有一座艾玛人的小型侦察哨站，需要你尽快除掉这个威胁。决不能让这些艾玛帝国的人渣染指我们的家园。他们必须付出代价。

messages.en: The threat has been eliminated.
messages.zh: 威胁已被解除。

messages.en: You are not worthy.
messages.zh: 你真没用。

messages.en: Excellent. Make haste.
messages.zh: 很好。赶快。

messages.en: For a few weeks now, we've known of a small Amarrian reconnaissance outpost in the system. So far we've left them alone because we wanted to know what they were up to. Now we know. This morning they were joined by a highly respected Amarr general; we are certain he is planning a strike on one of our stations in the system. I will update the coordinates to the mission details in your Opportunity interface: if you can go and bring their plans to a halt - I think you know what I mean - you will be handsomely rewarded.
messages.zh: 近几周，我们发现这片星系里有一座小型艾玛人侦察哨站。我们想看看他们葫芦里卖的什么药，还没有打草惊蛇。现在知道了。今早有位地位崇高的艾玛将军加入了他们。这位将军肯定在策划一场袭击，目标是我们建造在这片星系内的某个空间站。我会更新坐标到“机遇”界面的任务详情：要是能前往此坐标并阻止他们的计划，就会得到丰厚奖励，你应该懂我的意思。

messages.en: I'll find someone else then.
messages.zh: 我会另觅人选。

messages.en: You have failed us miserably.
messages.zh: 你让我们非常失望。

name.de: Guristas schlagen zu - Hinterhalt im Dunkeln (1 von 10)
name.en: Guristas Strike - Ambush In The Dark (1 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los Guristas: Emboscada en la oscuridad (1 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque des Guristas – Guet-apens dans les ténèbres (1 sur 10)
name.ja: ガリスタス攻撃―闇の中の待ち伏せ（1/10）
name.ru: Атака Gurista - засада в ночи (Guristas Strike - Ambush In The Dark) (1 из 10)
name.zh: 古斯塔斯的进攻—黑暗中的伏击(1/10)

messages.en: I will do my best, you can count on that.
messages.zh: 我会尽力，交给我吧。

messages.en: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.
messages.zh: 好极了！我们就指望你了。

messages.en: So whats this important stuff you keep yammering about?
messages.zh: 那么你一直在唠叨的重要事是什么呢？

messages.en:
I just received news of a very grave incident that just occured in the system {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEOs valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser which was escorting our CEO, as we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, lacking the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any traces left behind by the pirates, which so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, please search the area for any clues left behind.
messages.zh:
我刚收到消息，几小时前在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}发生了一起恶性事件。载有我们尊敬的CEO的护航队遭到了一支异常庞大而且组织有序的海盗的伏击。但是今晚幸运之神眷顾了我们，由于CEO护卫队的英勇顽强，CEO安全逃脱，当然稍受惊吓是在所难免的。我们失去了很多精干的战士，包括我们的卫队长……愿他安息。

现在切入正题。我们认为海盗俘虏了一些护送我们CEO的巡洋舰的船员，因为在事发地点我们找到了该船的残骸，但是没有发现那些船员的尸骸。{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的特种部队被叫到现场进行搜索，看是否有这些海盗的线索，但到目前为止还没有任何海盗的信息。我们希望你能帮助调查。我们知道一个在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}星系海盗们常去的隐藏地点。请搜索这些区域找出可能存在的线索。

messages.en: Well done, {[character]player.name}.  I see that my theory held merit, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members.  After we've given them proper counceling and trauma relief we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。看来我的计划生效了，你成功把失踪船员带回来了。在对他们进行适当的心理咨询和外伤治疗后，我们会询问他们在被囚禁期间是否获得任何线索。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en:
I just received news of a very grave incident that just occured in the system {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser which was escorting our CEO, as we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, lacking the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any traces left behind by the pirates, which so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, please search the area for any clues which might help us, and bring any prisoners you manage to acquire back to us for interrogation.
messages.zh:
我刚收到消息，几小时前在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}发生了一起恶性事件。载有我们尊敬的CEO的护航队遭到了一支异常庞大而且组织有序的海盗的伏击。但是今晚幸运之神眷顾了我们，由于CEO护卫队的英勇顽强，CEO安全逃脱，当然稍受惊吓是在所难免的。我们失去了很多精干的战士，包括我们的卫队长……愿他安息。

现在切入正题。我们认为海盗俘虏了一些护送我们CEO的巡洋舰的船员，因为在事发地点我们找到了该船的残骸，但是没有发现那些船员的尸骸。{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的特种部队被叫到现场进行搜索，看是否有这些海盗的线索，但到目前为止还没有任何海盗的信息。我们希望你能帮助调查。我们知道一个在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}星系海盗们常去的隐藏地点。请搜索这些区域找出可能存在的线索，如果你抓到了犯人就把他们带回来接受审讯。

messages.en: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.
messages.zh: 你以为我这样的懦夫能接受这么难的任务？求你了……

messages.en: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.
messages.zh: 好吧，我知道你不愿接受挑战。或许你的继任者会比你更有勇气。

messages.en: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.
messages.zh: 我很失望，推荐你的人对你的评价很高。

name.de: Guristas schlagen zu - Verteidigt den zivilen Konvoi (8 von 10)
name.en: Guristas Strike - Defend The Civilian Convoy (8 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los Guristas: La defensa del convoy civil (8 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque des Guristas – Défendre le convoi de civils (8 sur 10)
name.ja: ガリスタス攻撃―民間船団を守れ（8/10）
name.ru: Атака Gurista - защитить гражданский конвой (Guristas Strike - Defend The Civilian Convoy) (8 из 10)
name.zh: 古斯塔斯的进攻—守卫平民护航队(8/10)

messages.en: A Serpentis strike force was spotted entering this system earlier today, wiping out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault!  We received a distress signal, only moments ago, coming from one of our civilian convoys traveling towards a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, it has been attacked by these pirate forces.  Please undock immediately and fly to their rescue, before it's too late!  I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates.  Now hurry!
messages.zh: 今天早些时候，一支天蛇部队进入了本星系，发动了一场突袭并摧毁了我们几艘巡逻舰！就在刚才，我们收到了一支民间护航队的求救信号，他们正在前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个补给站的途中，他们遭到了这些海盗的袭击。请立刻启航，在事情不可收拾之前营救他们！我会把他们的精确坐标给你。好了，快去吧！

messages.en: Good job out there. But sadly it seems that their attack on the civilian convoy was only a diversion, while the population here was in a state of panic, a few Serpentis agents managed to break into the prison cell containing the captives you brought back on one of your previous missions. We must get them back, we still don't know the location of their base! Tell me when you are ready, I need you for another assignment ASAP.
messages.zh: 表现很出色嘛！不过很遗憾，他们对民用护航队的袭击似乎只是声东击西；就在这里的民众陷入恐慌的时候，一些天蛇特工闯入了牢狱，救走了你在之前任务中抓获的囚犯。我们必须抓回那些犯人，因为我们还没问出他们基地的位置！你整装完毕后就告诉我，我需要你尽快去执行一项新任务。

messages.en: A Serpentis strike force was spotted entering this system earlier today, wiping out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault!  We received a distress signal, only moments ago, coming from one of our civilian convoys traveling towards a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, it has been attacked by these pirate forces.  Please undock immediately and fly to their rescue, before it's too late!  I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates.  Now hurry!
messages.zh: 今天早些时候，有一支天蛇集团的部队进入了本星系，在一次突袭中摧毁了我们的部分巡逻舰。之后不久我们就收到来自民间护航队的求救信号，他们在前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个补给仓库途中受到了那些海盗的袭击。赶快去救援他们，希望还赶得上。我会给你确切的位标。快出发！

name.de: Guristas schlagen zu - Belastende Beweise (5 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los Guristas: Pruebas incriminatorias (5 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque des Guristas – Preuves compromettantes (5 sur 10)
name.ja: ガリスタス攻撃―犯罪の証拠（5/10）
name.ru: Атака Gurista - инкриминирующие свидетельства (Guristas Strike - Incriminating Evidence) (5 из 10)

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Any news on the interrogation of the prisoner I brought to you?
messages.zh: 我带回的俘虏交待了什么吗？

messages.en:
Yes, the interrogation went well. We managed to extract out of him who he was working for. Apparently he had been contacted by an agent from the Odamian Renegades, a criminal organization which has been making quite a name for itself recently in these parts, and paid a vast sum of money to kidnap our CEO's niece. A foolhardy task, but he did manage to pull it off and transfer her into the hands of the criminals.

Also the data disc you transported in your last mission has revealed even more to us. It contained the precise meeting points between the kidnappers and the Odamian agent for the past few weeks, as well as the exact coordinates for the next meeting which is to take place any minute now. I'd like you to fly over there yourself and ambush the Odamian goons at that location. Try to be quick, I don't know how long they will stay there waiting for their contact to arrive.
messages.zh:
是的，审讯进行得十分顺利，我们已经得知背后的主谋。奥达米安的间谍和他联系过，这个犯罪组织这几年经常搞一些类似的绑架勒索。他们出高价让他把CEO的侄女绑架过来。虽然作案手法拙劣，但他成功了，现在那个可怜的女孩已经落到罪犯手里。

你上次任务中运送的数据碟片已被解密。清楚记录了绑架者和奥达米安间谍过去几周内详细的接头地点，还有下次见面的精确位标。你飞到那里，预先对奥达米安的蠢货们进行埋伏。迅速行动，对方不会久等。

messages.en: Good work.  Im surprised however that you didn't find any survivors in the wreckage, pirates usually don't fight to the death unless something big is at stake.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得好。不过我很惊讶，你居然没有在残骸中发现幸存者；除非是什么重要东西遭到了危险，否则海盗通常不会舍命相搏。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en: My ship is in need of repairs, so I'm afraid I can't complete this in time.
messages.zh: 我的飞船需要修理，恐怕我不能按时完成这个任务。

messages.en: What?!  Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEOs niece executed!  Don't bother coming back!!
messages.zh: 什么？！你的无能可能已经害死了我们CEO的侄女！滚！不要让我再见到你！！

messages.en: What?!  Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEOs niece executed!  Don't bother coming back!!
messages.zh: 什么？！你的无能可能已经害死了我们CEO的侄女！滚！不要让我再见到你！！

name.de: Guristas schlagen zu - Bringen Sie die Gefangenen zurück (9 von 10)
name.en: Guristas Strike - Retrieve The Prisoners (9 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los Guristas: El rescate de los prisioneros (9 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque des Guristas – Récupérer les prisonniers (9 sur 10)
name.ja: ガリスタス攻撃―囚人奪回（9/10）
name.ru: Атака Gurista - вернуть пленников (Guristas Strike - Retrieve The Prisoners) (9 из 10)
name.zh: 古斯塔斯的进攻—追回囚犯(9/10)

messages.en: While we were scrambling to defend our convoys from attacks by the Serpentis, a few of their agents broke into our prison module and managed to escape with the prisoners.  Our interrogation of them was not complete, we still don't know where their base is located, so we are quite desperate to get them back here.  We know where their ships are headed, and we request that you intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system.  This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!
messages.zh: 正当我们手忙脚乱地协助护航队抵御天蛇的袭击时，他们的一些特工闯入了我们的牢狱，救走了你抓来的囚犯。我们对他们的审讯还没结束，还不清楚他们的基地所在，所以我们迫切希望把他们抓回来。我们掌握了他们的航向，请你一定在他们逃离这个星系前截住他们。在他们消失在无边的宇宙深处前，这或许是我们最后的机会，赶紧去吧！

messages.en: Awesome!  You really showed some great talent out there {[character]player.name}, I'm proud of you.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 太出色了！你真地展示了过人的才干，{[character]player.name}，我为你而骄傲。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en: While we were scrambling to defend our convoys from attacks by the Serpentis, a few of their agents broke into our prison module and managed to escape with the prisoners.  Our interrogation of them was not complete, we still don't know where their base is located, so we are quite desperate to get them back here.  We know where their ships are headed, and we request that you intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system.  This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!
messages.zh: 正当我们手忙脚乱地协助护航队抵御天蛇集团的袭击时，居然有几个间谍闯入了我们的牢狱，劫走了部分囚犯。对他们的审讯刚开了个头，还不清楚敌方的基地所在，你必须不惜一切代价把他们抓回来。我知道他们的航向，你快去追，在他们离开这个星系前把他们拦下来！这或许是最后的机会，赶紧去吧！

name.de: Guristas schlagen zu - Das letzte Gefecht (10 von 10)
name.en: Guristas Strike - The Final Battle (10 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los Guristas: La batalla final (10 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque des Guristas – Le dernier combat (10 sur 10)
name.ja: ガリスタス攻撃―最後の戦い（10/10）
name.ru: Атака Gurista - решающая битва (Guristas Strike - The Final Battle) (10 из 10)
name.zh: 古斯塔斯的进攻—最后的战役(10/10)

messages.en: I'll do my best.
messages.zh: 我尽力吧。

messages.en: You have some guts accepting this mission, {[character]player.name}, and for that I have the utmost respect for you.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，接下这项任务需要勇气，我对你表示敬佩。

messages.en:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of fresh new evidence, which apparently points to the girl being held in a Serpentis stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our sources she is being held in the Central Hub structure of the base, where she will be executed if their demands aren't met. It is our civic duty to see to it that she is returned to her family safely before those despicable Serpentis villains murder her.

There is a fundamental flaw with our plan however, the Serpentis are fully aware of our intention to free her and have sent in a fleet of their battleships to guard their outpost. Now I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the girl and escaping with your ship, and life, intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the Central Control Hub. The Serpentis fleet guarding it will be expecting a large force of attackers, which will give you the advantage should you fly in there with a fast, agile ship, to avoid direct confrontation. Once you arrive at the final area, all you have to do is destroy the Central Control Hub and retrieve the girl from the ejected safety capsule, all of their Control Hubs have this mechanism to save their high-ranking personnel from death should the structure be obliterated. We hope that they consider the girl important enough to save in this way as well. If not ... well there is not much other choice. If we send in a fleet of ships they will simply kill her when they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the girl alive after destroying the Central Control Hub, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall then I will personally make sure the pirate scum pay the price. Good luck.
messages.zh:
情报部门带来的最新消息，女孩被关押在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的天蛇据点内。据侦察，她被囚禁在中央控制中心内，如果他们的要求得不到满足，她就会被处决。我们有责任插手这件事，在那些天蛇的暴徒干掉女孩之前，把她解救出来，安全送回家。

然而，这个计划有一个缺陷：天蛇集团对我们要解救女孩的意图十分清楚，专门派遣了一支战列舰队来保护他们的哨站。硬碰硬你的胜率为零，但以你的能力，应该可以潜入对方基地，和女孩一起毫发无损地归来。

我们已经设立了一系列加速装置直接通往关押女孩的控制塔。守卫在那里的天蛇集团舰队为防止大军来袭作了严密布防，但如果你驾驶一艘灵活的小船，应该会起到不错的效果。你到了那儿以后，要做的就是摧毁中央控制中心，并将女孩从弹射舱内解救出来。天蛇集团所有的中央控制中心都有这样的安全弹射舱，可以在控制中心被摧毁时保护他们的高级军官。希望他们对那个女孩足够重视，做了这样的安全措施。要是没有的话……现在我们别无选择。如果我们派舰队去攻打，一旦他们陷入劣势，就会拖女孩陪葬的。闪电战是唯一的出路，在他们还没搞清楚情况前就把女孩救出来。谨慎行动，你没有第二次机会。

要是你在摧毁控制塔后没有找到那个女孩，立即启动跃迁器离开。{[character]player.name}，我可不想失去你。但你放心，要是你真的为此牺牲了，我一定会让天蛇集团付出代价！愿幸运女神眷顾着你！

messages.en: You expect me to go out on a limb for some snotty little girl?  I expected more of you, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 你希望我为一个满脸鼻涕的小女孩而将自己置于险境？我高估你了，{[character]agentID.name}。
