messages.en:
Nice work. This will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the Serpentis leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be severely punished by Sarpati for failing in his duties.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's niece is now in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since she was captured. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunate this all ended ... I have a nagging suspicion that someone else was behind all of this and played us like fools.

But enough of this, let us rejoice at a job well done. Our CEO sends his utmost gratitude, as well as a special bonus reward from his own coffers which he hopes you will enjoy.
messages.zh:
干得不错。这对负责哨站守卫的天蛇首领一定是个沉重的打击。他肯定会因失职而被萨巴蒂严厉处罚。

还有一个好消息，我们CEO的侄女现正已在我们的保护之下。我们在这个空间站附近漂浮的安全舱里找到了她，她安然无恙。很明显，绑架者对她用了药，她对被绑架后发生的事情几乎一点印象都没有。但我总觉得这一切结束得太顺利了。直觉告诉我，有人在背后操控这一切，把我们当猴耍。

算了，不想那么多，我们该庆祝一下。我们的CEO对你感激不尽，并从他的私人金库拨给你一笔特别的酬劳，希望你能满意。

name.de: Guristas schlagen zu - Die Entführung (3 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los Guristas: El secuestro (3 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque des Guristas – Le kidnapping (3 sur 10)
name.ru: Атака Gurista - похищение (Guristas Strike - The Kidnapping) (3 из 10)

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en:
We need urgent help with intercepting a group of vile kidnappers who just managed to snatch the niece of our CEO while she was visiting her uncle in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for the illegal organization, the Odamian Renegades. I'll fill you in on the details of that organization in your mission details.

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, as we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with this Odamian agent in the past, who we hope will be able to lead you to him. The only catch is he will most likely require a bit of 'convincing' on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom, once you have extracted the information from the middleman then I expect you to find the Odamian agent and bring him back to me.
messages.zh:
我们迫切需要你帮忙拦截一伙卑鄙的绑匪，他们趁我们CEO的侄女到这个星系拜访时绑架了她。绑匪是一伙雇佣兵，领头的是一名效力于非法组织奥达米安叛军的重罪犯。我会把这个组织的详细信息发到你的任务详情中。

你最好把他们的代理人活捉回来。我们怀疑这个人就是绑匪与幕后主使之间的联络人，必须要当面拷问他。我们要彻查谋划这起滔天罪行的幕后黑手。我们可以提供给你一个线人，是个海盗，曾与奥达米安的代理人打过不少交道，希望能指引你顺利抓捕代理人。但要想获得所需信息，你还得花点功夫让他“配合”。我会在你的控制边栏中上传他的位标，希望你能得到有用的消息，指引你找到奥达米安的代理人，将他活捉回来。

messages.en: Well done.  We will proceed immediately to interrogate the prisoner, expect some results soon.  Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.
messages.zh: 干得好！我们会立即开始审讯俘虏，你很快就会得到结果。我们的审讯官可是很有……“说服力”的。

messages.en: No, this does not interest me.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我对这个任务没兴趣。

messages.en: Well, I did not say every job would be pleasure planets and pie.  Perhaps you are more suited for the garbage-hauling missions?
messages.zh: 嗯，我可没说每个工作都乐趣十足、报酬丰厚。或许你更适合垃圾收集工作？

messages.en: The Odamian Renegades named themselves after the system where their organization was founded, in the Gallente controlled Placid region.  The founders themselves were mostly made up of adventurers traveling from the Gallente capital system, Luminaire, searching for fame and fortune in the frontier.  There they came into contact with Dakeur Hullan, a charismatic pirate veteran who had been working for the Serpentis organization until an unfortunate incident saw him outlawed from their territory, with a sizeable bounty on his head.  Despite his misfortunes, Dakeur still had numerous contacts throughout the criminal world, both inside Serpentis and Gallente controlled space.  With Dakeurs experience within the underworld of the Gallente Federation and his co-founders surprising piloting skills, the Odamian Renegades quickly garnered a reputation as a powerful and infamous drug smuggling syndicate within the Gallente territories.
messages.zh: 奥达米安叛军取名自该组织创建时所在的星系，那座星系位于盖伦特所控的宁静之域。创始人中的大多数都是来自盖伦特主星系泛光之源的冒险者，他们当初来到边境，寻找荣誉和财富。他们在那里遇到了具有领袖气质的老海盗达克尔·乌兰，这个人曾一度为天蛇组织效力，不过一次不幸的事件使他被逐出了天蛇领地，还被人下了高额的击毁奖金。尽管他遭遇不幸，达克尔仍然在犯罪世界有着无数的联络人，无论是在天蛇内部还是盖伦特空间里。凭着达克尔在盖伦特联邦黑社会的资历以及合作创始人的高超驾驶技术，奥达米安叛军迅速发展成为盖伦特境内臭名昭著的大型违规药品非法贩售组织。

messages.en: The Odamian Renegades
messages.zh: 奥达米安叛军

name.de: Guristas schlagen zu - Das geheime Treffen (7 von 10)
name.en: Guristas Strike - The Secret Meeting (7 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los Guristas: La reunión secreta (7 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque des Guristas – La réunion secrète (7 sur 10)
name.ja: ガリスタス攻撃―秘密会合（7/10）
name.ru: Атака Gurista - тайная встреча (Guristas Strike - The Secret Meeting) (7 из 10)

messages.en: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.
messages.zh: 很好。记住，除非被逼无奈，否则切勿在会面地点攻击任何人。先听他们把话说完。

messages.en: Very interesting indeed.  You've done us a good service, {[character]player.name}.  Now let's just hope that these Serpentis scoundrels can reveal the true location of our CEO's niece.
messages.zh: 确实非常有趣。你帮了我们大忙了，{[character]player.name}。现在就等这群天蛇恶棍说出我们CEO侄女的真正所在了。

messages.en: Sounds too risky for me, sorry {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 这听起来太危险了，抱歉，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}.  It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's niece.  I'm reluctant to send you, as this may be a trap, but I really have no choice.  If I send someone else I could be compromising the investigation.  So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission.  Upload anything said to you and save it into your ships database, return with it to me.  Do you accept?
messages.zh: 我刚刚收到一个匿名消息，指名要你去{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的一个地点会面。同时还说你会见的人掌握着重要情报，有助于我们找到失踪的CEO侄女。我并不想派你去，因为这有可能是个陷阱，但我别无选择。如果我派其他人去，就可能破坏我们的调查。所以我请求你，直接前往那条匿名消息上提供的位标地址。把所有的谈话内容都上传到你的飞船数据库中，然后带来给我。你接受吗？

name.de: Guristas schlagen zu - Mögliche Hinweise (4 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los Guristas: Posibles pistas (4 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque des Guristas – Pistes possibles (4 sur 10)
name.ja: ガリスタス攻撃―証拠確認性（4/10）
name.ru: Атака Gurista - возможные наводки (Guristas Strike - Possible Leads) (4 из 10)
name.zh: 古斯塔斯的进攻—可能的线索(4/10)

messages.en: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured in your last mission to finish, I'd like you to transport a data chip that we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  We'd like it decyphered and I know of the perfect man for the job, who is residing on that station.  We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless.  When you get back, then hopefully our interrogators will have found some more leads.
messages.zh: 在我们审讯你上次任务中抓获的飞行员时，我想让你把这块芯片，从他包里搜出来的，送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。那里有个破译高手能帮我们的忙。现在还不清楚这芯片内是否有强有力的证据，但试一下总没什么坏处。希望等你回来的时候，这边的审讯也能有一些突破。

messages.en: Well then.  Perhaps you should seek employment with the Servant Sisters of Eve?
messages.zh: 那好吧。你大概应该在姐妹共济会那找份活吧？

messages.en: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured in your last mission to finish, I'd like you to transport a data chip that we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  We'd like it decyphered and I know of the perfect man for the job, who is residing on that station.  We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless.  When you get back, then hopefully our interrogators will have found some more leads.
messages.zh: 在我们审讯你上次任务中抓获的俘虏期间，我想让你把这块从他包里搜出来的芯片送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。我们得破译它，而那个工作站里住着这个任务的最合适人选。现在还不清楚这芯片内是否有他们的犯罪证据，但我们还是想确认一下。等你回来的时候，我想我们的审讯可能也有头绪了。

name.de: Guristas schlagen zu - Ausbruch der Grippe (6 von 10)
name.en: Guristas Strike - The Flu Outbreak (6 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los Guristas: El brote de gripe (6 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque des Guristas – L'épidémie de grippe (6 sur 10)
name.ja: ガリスタス攻撃―ウィルス性感冒（6/10）
name.ru: Атака Gurista - эпидемия гриппа (Guristas Strike - The Flu Outbreak) (6 из 10)
name.zh: 古斯塔斯的进攻—流感爆发(6/10)

messages.en: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.
messages.zh: 我马上把抗生素带来。

messages.en: We have a major flu outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}.  Because of this our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon.  We have a lot of personnel here, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicines.  I ordered the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and would like you to transport them here.  Please hurry, our staff is depending on you.
messages.zh: 一场严重的流感在{[location]agentStationID.name}这里爆发了。这造成了我们的抗病毒药物储备的大量消耗，恐怕很快就要用完了。我们这里人员众多，我们可不希望他们一半人因为缺药而请病假。我在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}订了一批抗病毒药物；想让你去把它们运过来。请快点，我们的员工都靠你了。

name.de: Guristas schlagen zu - Das Verhör (2 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los Guristas: El interrogatorio (2 de 10)
name.ru: Атака Gurista - допрос (Guristas Strike - The Interrogation) (2 из 10)

messages.en: I'll do it in no time.  Now please keep me updated on how the investigation is going.
messages.zh: 我马上就去做。请随时告诉我审讯的进展。

messages.en: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.
messages.zh: 非常不幸，我们现在的线索还非常模糊。等你完成手头的任务再回来，那时可能有进一步的信息。

messages.en: After checking our logs we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy.  The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel.  I need them transfered to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation, hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract out of them the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.
messages.zh: 我们检查了日志后，发现你带回来的俘虏中只有部分是我们护航队遭袭时被海盗抓获的船员。剩下的显然是你击毁的一艘海盗船上的成员，他们在船只的爆炸中逃过一劫。我需要把他们转移到另一个空间站的一些同事那里进行进一步审讯；希望那里的专家能够撬开他们的嘴巴，获得伏击我们CEO的幕后黑手的有关线索。

messages.en: Great work, {[character]player.name}.  But I need you back here urgently for another assignment, something terrible just happened.  I'll get you posted once you are ready.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。不过我迫切需要你回来完成另一个任务，发生了件可怕的事情。等你准备好后，我会告诉你细节。

messages.en: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.
messages.zh: 我不能接受。这件事情至关重要，不能交给像我这样的人办。

messages.en: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.
messages.zh: 我不想和你争辩，我会另请高明。

messages.en:
Okay, we have a situation here. A serious situation. A week ago, we detected a small Amarrian presence right next to the ruins of an old military station. Since then, they have been expanding in numbers; yesterday we found out that they have built an outpost. We believe they are trying to retrieve something from the station, something they could use against us.

Go, destroy the outpost and the ships protecting it. You will be well rewarded, I assure you.
messages.zh:
好吧，我们遇到状况了。一个很严重的状况。一个星期前，我们侦测到在一座老旧军事空间站的废墟旁边存在着有一小股艾玛人。从那以后，他们的数量不断扩大，昨天我们发现他们已经造了一座哨站。我们认为，他们正试图从空间站中获取某样东西，并要用那样东西来对付我们。

去吧，摧毁那座哨站和守卫它的飞船。我向你保证，你会得到丰厚的酬劳。

messages.en: The outpost is destroyed and the infidels eliminated. You mentioned a reward?
messages.zh: 哨站和异教徒都已消灭。你说过有报酬的是吧？

messages.en: This mission is damn near impossible! I can't do it.
messages.zh: 这个该死的任务几乎不可能完成！我做不了。

messages.en: Very well, then, pilot. I'll give this to somebody more competent.
messages.zh: 那么好吧，飞行员。我会让更有能力的人来做这件事。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Hinterhalt im Dunkeln (1 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - Ambush in the Dark (1 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: Emboscada en la oscuridad (1 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Guet-apens dans les ténèbres (1 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-暗闇での待ち伏せ（1/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - засада в ночи (Kidnappers Strike - Ambush in the Dark) (1 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—黑暗中的伏击(1/10)

messages.en: I will do my best, you can count on that.
messages.zh: 我会尽力，交给我吧。

messages.en: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.
messages.zh: 好极了！我们就指望你了。

messages.en: So what's this important stuff you keep yammering about?
messages.zh: 那么你一直在唠叨的重要的事是什么呢？

messages.en:
I just received news of a grave incident that occurred in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now, I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser that was escorting our CEO, for we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, but there was no trace of the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any sign left behind by the pirates, who so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.
messages.zh:
我刚收到消息，几小时前在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}发生了一起严重的事故。载有我们尊敬的CEO的护航队遭到了一支异常庞大而且组织有序的海盗的伏击。但是今晚幸运之神眷顾了我们，由于CEO护卫队的英勇顽强，CEO安全逃脱，当然稍受惊吓是在所难免的。我们失去了很多优秀的战士，卫队长也光荣牺牲……愿他安息。

好了，我们切入正题。我们认为海盗俘虏了一些护送我们CEO的巡洋舰的船员，因为在事发地点我们找到了该船的残骸，但是没有发现大多数船员的尸骸。{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的特种部队被叫到现场进行搜索，看是否有这些海盗的线索，但到目前为止还没有任何海盗的信息。我们希望你能帮助调查。我们知道一个在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}星系海盗们常去的隐藏地点。我会把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中：请搜索这些区域找出可能存在的线索，如果你抓到了犯人就把他们带回来接受审讯。

messages.en:
Well done, {[character]player.name}. I see that my theory held merit, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members. After we've given them proper trauma counseling, we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.

And don't you leave just yet. I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。看来我的计划生效了，你成功把失踪船员带回来了。在他们接受适当的心理咨询后，我们会询问他们在被囚禁期间是否获得任何线索。

先别走。我还有别的任务给你！

messages.en:
I just received news of a grave incident that occurred in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now, I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser that was escorting our CEO, for we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, but there was no trace of the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any sign left behind by the pirates, who so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.

我刚收到消息，几小时前在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}发生了一起严重的事故。载有我们尊敬的CEO的护航队遭到了一支异常庞大而且组织有序的海盗的伏击。但是今晚幸运之神眷顾了我们，由于CEO护卫队的英勇顽强，CEO安全逃脱，当然稍受惊吓是在所难免的。我们失去了很多优秀的战士，卫队长也光荣牺牲……愿他安息。

好了，我们切入正题。我们认为海盗俘虏了一些护送我们CEO的巡洋舰的船员，因为在事发地点我们找到了该船的残骸，但是没有发现大多数船员的尸骸。{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的特种部队被叫到现场进行搜索，看是否有这些海盗的线索，但到目前为止还没有任何海盗的信息。我们希望你能帮助调查。我们知道一个在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}星系海盗们常去的隐藏地点。我会把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中：请搜索这些区域找出可能存在的线索，如果你抓到了犯人就把他们带回来接受审讯。

messages.en: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.
messages.zh: 你以为我这样的懦夫能接受这么难的任务？求你了……

messages.en: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.
messages.zh: 好吧，我知道你不愿接受挑战。或许你的继任者会比你更有勇气。

messages.en: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.
messages.zh: 我很失望，推荐你的人对你的评价很高。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Verteidigt den zivilen Konvoi (8 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - Defend the Civilian Convoy (8 of 10)

messages.en: A Sansha strike force entered this system earlier today and wiped out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault! Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!
messages.zh: 今天早些时候，一支萨沙部队进入了本星系，发动了一场突袭并摧毁了我们几艘巡逻舰！就在刚才，我们收到了一支民间护航队断断续续的求救信号，他们正在前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个补给站的途中。恐怕他们遭到了同一群海盗的袭击。请立即启航，在事情不可收拾之前赶去救援！我会把他们的精确坐标给你。好了，快去吧！

messages.en: Good job out there. Sadly, it seems that their attack on the civilian convoy was only a diversion; while the population here was in a state of panic, a few Sansha zombies managed to break into the prison cell containing the captives you brought back on one of your previous missions. We must get those prisoners back, as we still don't know the location of their base! Let me know when you're ready for another assignment: I need you ASAP.
messages.zh: 表现很出色嘛！不过很遗憾，他们对民用护航队的袭击似乎只是声东击西；就在这里的民众陷入恐慌的时候，一些萨沙僵尸闯入了牢狱，救走了你在之前任务中抓获的囚犯。我们必须抓回那些犯人，因为我们还没问出他们基地的位置！你准备好做新任务了就通知我：我现在非常需要你。

name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-犯罪証拠（5/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - инкриминирующие свидетельства (Kidnappers Strike - Incriminating Evidence) (5 из 10)

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Any news on the interrogation of the prisoner I brought to you?
messages.zh: 我带回的俘虏交待了什么吗？

messages.en:
Yes, the interrogation went well. We managed to find out who he was working for. Apparently he had been contacted by a Maru Rebel agent and paid a vast sum of money to kidnap our CEO's daughter. A foolhardy task, but he did manage to pull it off and transfer her into the hands of the criminals.

Also, the data disc you transported in your last mission has revealed even more to us. It contained the precise meeting points between the kidnappers and the Maru agent for the past few weeks, as well as the exact coordinates for the next meeting, which is to take place very soon now. I'd like you to fly over there yourself and ambush the Rebel goons at that location. Be quick: I don't know how long they will wait for their contact to arrive.
messages.zh:
是的，审讯进行得十分顺利。我们已经得知幕后主使的身份。显然他曾与一个马鲁叛军的特工接触过，而且收受了一大笔佣金来绑架我们CEO的女儿。这任务不需要用什么头脑，不过他的确完成了，还把女孩送到了那些罪犯的手里。

你上次任务中运送的数据盘也向我们揭示了更多信息。上面清楚记录了绑架者和这个马鲁特工过去几周内详细的接头地点，还有很快就要进行的下一次接头的精确坐标。我想要你亲自飞过去，在那儿伏击这些叛军的打手。动作要快：我不知道他们会在那里等多久。

messages.en:
Good work. I'm surprised, however, that you didn't find any survivors in the wreckage. Pirates usually don't fight to the death unless something big is at stake.

Oh, hey, don't you take off just yet. If you're willing, I have another assignment for you.
messages.zh:
干得好。不过有点我很惊讶，你居然没在残骸中发现任何生还者。除非是什么重要东西遭到了危险，否则海盗通常不会舍命相搏。

噢，嘿，先别急着离开。如果你愿意，我还有另一项任务给你。

messages.en: Oh, dear! I've just remembered that I have a flan in the oven, so I'm afraid I can't complete this mission in time.
messages.zh: 噢，天啊！我刚想起来，我的烤箱里还烤着馅饼，所以恐怕我不能及时完成任务了。

messages.en: What?! Coward!! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's daughter executed! Don't ever show your face here again!!
messages.zh: 什么？！懦夫！！你的无能可能已经害死了我们CEO的女儿！别再跑来丢人现眼了！！

messages.en: What?! Coward!! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's daughter executed! Don't ever show your face here again!!
messages.zh: 什么？！懦夫！！你的无能可能已经害死了我们CEO的女儿！别再跑来丢人现眼了！！

messages.en: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from those Sansha's Nation pilots, a few of their assault troopers broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. Our interrogation was not complete and we still don't know where their base is located, so we must get them back. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!
messages.zh: 我之前就说了，正当我们手忙脚乱地协助护航队抵御萨沙共和国飞行员的袭击时，他们的一些突击队员闯入了我们的牢狱，救走了你抓来的囚犯。我们对他们的审讯还没结束，还不知道他们的基地所在，所以我们必须把他们抓回来。不过我们掌握了他们的航向。我要你在他们逃离这个星系前截住他们。在他们消失在无边的宇宙深处前，这或许是我们最后的机会，赶紧去吧！

messages.en: Fantastic! You really showed some skill out there, {[character]player.name}. I'm proud to say I know you. And be sure to come see me again ― I have one more job for you!
messages.zh: 太棒了！你在那真的大显身手，{[character]player.name}。认识你是我的荣耀。一定要回来找我哦——我还有一项任务给你呢！

name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: La batalla final (10 de 10)

name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-最後の戦い（10/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - решающая битва (Kidnappers Strike - The Final Battle) (10 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—最后的战役(10/10)

messages.en: I'll do my best.
messages.zh: 我尽力吧。

messages.en: You have some guts accepting this mission, {[character]player.name}, and for that I have the utmost respect for you.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，接下这项任务需要勇气，我对你表示敬佩。

messages.en:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of new evidence that apparently points to our CEO's daughter being held in a Sansha stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our information, she is being held in the base's Central Communication Tower; they will execute her if their leaders' demands aren't met. We must see that she is returned to her family safely before those mindless zombies murder her.

There is a big problem, however; the Sansha leaders are fully aware of our intention to free her, so they've sent in a fleet of battleships to guard their outpost. Now, I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the young woman, and escaping with your ship intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the Communication Tower. Once you arrive at the final room, all you have to do is destroy the tower and retrieve her from the ejected safety capsule. (All of their towers have this mechanism in place to save their leaders from death should the structure be obliterated.) If we send in a fleet of ships, they will simply kill her as soon as they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, with a small force, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the woman alive after destroying the tower, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall, then I will personally make sure the Raider scum pay the price. Good luck.
messages.zh:
情报部门带来的最新消息，女孩被关押在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的萨沙据点内。据侦察，她被囚禁在一个中枢联络塔内，如果他们的要求得不到满足，她就会被处决。我们有责任插手这件事，在那些萨沙的疯子干掉女孩之前，把她解救出来，安全送回家。

然而，这个计划有一个缺陷：萨沙对我们要解救女孩的意图十分清楚，专门派遣了一支战列舰队来保护他们的哨站。硬碰硬你的胜率为零，但以你的能力，应该可以潜入对方基地，和女孩一起毫发无损地归来。

我们已经设立了一系列加速轨道直接通往关押女孩的联络塔，你到了那儿以后，要做的就是摧毁联络塔，并将女孩从弹射舱内解救出来。萨沙所有的联络塔都有这样的安全弹射舱，可以在联络塔被摧毁时保护他们的高级军官。希望他们对那个女孩足够重视，做了这样的安全措施。要是没有的话……现在我们别无选择。要是我们派舰队去攻打，一旦他们陷入劣势，就会拖女孩陪葬的。闪电战是唯一的出路，在他们还没搞清楚情况前就把女孩救出来。谨慎行动，你没有第二次机会。

要是你在摧毁中枢联络塔后没有找到那个女孩，立即启动跃迁器离开。{[character]player.name}，我可不想失去你。但你放心，要是你真的为此牺牲了，我一定会让萨沙付出代价！愿幸运女神眷顾着你！

messages.en:
Nice work. This will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the Sansha leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be severely punished by Sansha for failing in his duties. The Communication Tower also serves as a ‘mother-brain' of sorts for a large portion of the Sansha fleet, with it destroyed their forces will be paralyzed for some time to come.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's niece is now in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since she was captured. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunate this all ended ... I have a nagging suspicion that someone else was behind all of this and played us like fools.

But enough of this, let us rejoice at a job well done. Our CEO sends his utmost gratitude, as well as a special bonus reward from his own coffers which he hopes you will enjoy.
messages.zh:
干得不错。这对负责哨站守卫的萨沙首领一定是个沉重的打击。他肯定会因失职而被萨沙严厉处罚。对于大部分萨沙舰队来说，那座通信塔也是某种“母体智慧”，既然它被毁了，萨沙部队在接下来一段时间里会处于瘫痪状态。

还有一个好消息，我们CEO的侄女现正已在我们的保护之下。我们在这个空间站附近漂浮的安全舱里找到了她，她安然无恙。很明显，绑架者对她用了药，她对被绑架后发生的事情几乎一点印象都没有。但我总觉得这一切结束得太顺利了。直觉告诉我，有人在背后操控这一切，把我们当猴耍。

算了，不想那么多，

messages.en: You expect me to go out on a limb for some snotty oligarch's daughter? I mean, ISK is great, sure, but it's not much good if you're not alive to spend it, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 你希望我为一个集团头目的满脸鼻涕的女儿而将自己置于险境？我是说，星币确实很丰厚，但要是挣了钱没命花，恐怕就不好了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en:
We urgently need help intercepting a group of kidnappers who just managed to snatch the daughter of our CEO while she was visiting her father in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for the Maru Rebels. I'll fill you in on the details of that organization in the mission details.

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, for we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it just so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with a Maru agent in the past; we hope he will be able to lead you to the agent. The only catch is that he will most likely require a bit of "convincing" on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom; once you have extracted the information from the middleman, I expect you to find the Maru agent and bring him back to me.
messages.zh:
我们迫切需要你帮忙拦截一伙绑匪，他们趁我们CEO的女儿到这个星系拜访时绑架了她。绑匪是一伙雇佣兵，领头的是一名效力于马鲁叛军的重罪犯。我会把这个组织的详细信息发到任务详情中。

你最好把他们的代理人活捉回来。我们怀疑这个人就是绑匪与幕后主使之间的联络人，必须要当面拷问他。我们要彻查谋划这起滔天罪行的幕后黑手。我们可以提供给你一个线人，是个海盗，曾与马鲁的代理人打过不少交道，希望能指引你顺利抓捕代理人。但要想获得所需信息，你还得花点功夫让他“配合”。我会在你的控制边栏中上传他的位标，希望你能得到有用的消息，指引你找到马鲁的代理人，将他活捉回来。

messages.en:
Well done. We will proceed immediately to interrogating the prisoner, so expect some results soon. Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.

And don't go anywhere: I have another assignment for you.
messages.zh:
干得好！我们会立即开始审讯俘虏，你很快就会得到结果。我们的审讯官可是很有……“说服力”的。

别到处乱跑：我还有另一项任务给你。

messages.en: No, this does not interest me.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我对这个任务没兴趣。

messages.en: Well, I did not say every job would be pleasure planets and sweetplum pie. Perhaps you are more suited for managing sewer drones?
messages.zh: 嗯，我可没说过每个工作都乐趣十足、报酬丰厚。或许你更适合管理下水道清洁机器人？

messages.en: The Maru Rebels were once part of a gang of pirates who turned into a sinister terrorist network claiming to fight for Minmatar freedom. In fact, they're little more a ruthless gang of criminals dealing in the black market, smuggling, and extortion and blackmail, even sometimes working as hired assassins. Their official agenda is to murder as many citizens of the Amarr nations as possible ― i.e., Amarr Empire, Ammatar, and Khanid Kingdom ― hoping to force them to withdraw eventually from historically Minmatar systems currently under Amarr control. The Minmatar Republic leadership has denounced them as being cutthroats and criminals even though they support Republic goals, and has put up a sizable bounty on their leader's head. But even so, the Rebels do maintain some support within the Minmatar Republic, which has allowed them certain freedoms other criminal networks do not have.
messages.zh: 马鲁叛军曾经隶属于某个海盗团伙，后来他们逐渐发展为一个庞大的恐怖分子网络，并自称为米玛塔尔自由而战。事实上，他们不过是一群无恶不作的罪犯。他们经营黑市，从事非法贩售，进行敲诈勒索，有时甚至受雇实施行刺。他们对外宣称要屠尽艾玛族人，也就是艾玛帝国、艾玛达共和国和卡尼迪王国的百姓，并最终迫使他们撤离那些原本属于米玛塔尔的星系——目前这些星系隶属艾玛境内。虽然他们是米玛塔尔共和国目标的支持者，但是共和国领导层仍然公开谴责他们为清道夫和罪犯，并在他们首领头上设置了可观的追击奖金。可即使这样，马鲁叛军依然在米玛塔尔共和国内维持着一定数量的支持者，正是这些支持者让他们拥有了一些其他犯罪团伙所不具备的某些自由权。

messages.en: The Maru Rebels
messages.zh: 马鲁叛军

messages.en:
We urgently need help intercepting a group of kidnappers who just managed to snatch the daughter of our CEO while she was visiting her father in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for the Maru Rebels. I'll fill you in on the details of that organization in the mission details.

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, for we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it just so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with a Maru agent in the past; we hope he will be able to lead you to the agent. The only catch is that he will most likely require a bit of "convincing" on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom; once you have extracted the information from the middleman, I expect you to find the Maru agent and bring him back to me.
messages.zh:
我们迫切需要你帮忙拦截一伙绑匪，他们趁我们CEO的女儿到这个星系拜访时绑架了她。绑匪是一伙雇佣兵，领头的是一名效力于马鲁叛军的重罪犯。我会把这个组织的详细信息发到任务详情中。

你最好把他们的代理人活捉回来。我们怀疑这个人就是绑匪与幕后主使之间的联络人，必须要当面拷问他。我们要彻查谋划这起滔天罪行的幕后黑手。我们可以提供给你一个线人，是个海盗，曾与马鲁的代理人打过不少交道，希望能指引你顺利抓捕代理人。但要想获得所需信息，你还得花点功夫让他“配合”。我会在你的控制边栏中上传他的位标，希望你能得到有用的消息，指引你找到马鲁的代理人，将他活捉回来。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Das geheime Treffen (7 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - The Secret Meeting  (7 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: La reunión secreta (7 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – La réunion secrète (7 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-秘密の会合（7/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - тайная встреча (Kidnappers Strike - The Secret Meeting ) (7 из 10)

messages.en: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.
messages.zh: 很好。记住，除非被逼无奈，否则切勿在会面地点攻击任何人。先听他们把话说完。

messages.en: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's daughter. I'm reluctant to send you, since this may be a trap, but I really have no choice. If I send someone else, though, I could be compromising the investigation. So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission. Be sure to record anything said to you and save it into your ship's database, and then return with it to me.
messages.zh: 我刚刚收到一个匿名消息，明确指定要你到{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}和他们见面。同时还说你会见的人掌握着重要情报，有助于我们找到CEO的侄女。就个人而言，我并不想让你去，那极有可能是个陷阱，但我别无选择。他们点名要你，如果我派其他人，就是在跟女孩的命过不去。具体的位标我已提供给你，直接去吧。记得把所有的谈话内容都存到你飞船的数据库里，活着把它带给我。你认为怎么样？

messages.en: Very interesting indeed. Thanks for your good service, {[character]player.name}. Now let's just hope that these monsters will reveal the true location of our CEO's daughter.
messages.zh: 确实非常有趣。感谢你出色的工作，{[character]player.name}。现在就等这群恶棍说出我们CEO女儿的真正所在了。

messages.en: Sounds too risky for me, {[character]agentID.name}. I´m out.
messages.zh: 这听起来太危险了，抱歉，{[character]agentID.name}。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Mögliche Hinweise (4 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: Posibles pistas (4 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – Pistes possibles (4 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-見込みのある手がかり（4/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - возможные наводки (Kidnappers Strike - Possible Leads) (4 из 10)
name.zh: 绑架者的进攻—可能的线索(4/10)

messages.en: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to transport a data chip we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. We need it deciphered, and I happen to know the perfect man for the job, who lives at that station. We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless. By the time you get back, I expect our interrogators will have found some more leads.
messages.zh: 在我们审讯你上次任务中抓获的飞行员时，我想让你把这块芯片，从他包里搜出来的，送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。那里有个破译高手能帮我们的忙。现在还不清楚这芯片内是否有强有力的证据，但试一下总没什么坏处。希望等你回来的时候，这边的审讯也能有一些突破。

messages.en: Oh, fair enough. Perhaps kitchen duty would be more to your liking?
messages.zh: 噢，有道理。也许你更喜欢做厨房的工作吧？

messages.en: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to transport a data chip we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Ausbruch der Grippe (6 von 10)
name.en: Kidnappers Strike - The Flu Outbreak (6 of 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: El brote de gripe (6 de 10)
name.fr: Attaque de kidnappeurs – L'épidémie de grippe (6 sur 10)
name.ja: 誘拐犯の攻撃-インフルエンザの大流行（6/10）
name.ru: Атака похитителей - эпидемия гриппа (Kidnappers Strike - The Flu Outbreak) (6 из 10)

messages.en: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.
messages.zh: 我马上把抗生素带来。

messages.en:
We've had a major influenza outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}. Because of it, our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon. We have a lot of personnel here; given the current state of affairs, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicine. I've taken the liberty of ordering the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}; I need you to transport them here.

Please hurry ― our staff is depending on you.
messages.zh:
一场严重的流感在{[location]agentStationID.name}这里爆发了。这造成了我们的抗病毒药物储备的大量消耗，恐怕很快就要用完了。我们这里人员众多；在如今的事态下，我们可不希望他们一半人因为缺药而请病假。我擅自在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}订了一批抗病毒药物；想让你去把它们运过来。

请快点——我们的员工都靠你了。

name.de: Entführer schlagen zu - Das Verhör (2 von 10)
name.es: Ataque de los secuestradores: El interrogatorio (2 de 10)
name.ru: Атака похитителей - допрос (Kidnappers Strike - The Interrogation) (2 из 10)

messages.en: I'll do it in no time. Now please update me on how the investigation is going.
messages.zh: 我马上就去做。请随时告诉我审讯的进展。

messages.en: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.
messages.zh: 非常不幸，我们现在的线索还非常模糊。等你完成手头的任务再回来，那时可能有进一步的信息。

messages.en: After checking our logs, we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy. The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel. I need them transferred to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation; hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.
messages.zh: 我们检查了日志后，发现你带回来的俘虏中只有部分是我们护卫队遭袭时被海盗抓获的船员。剩下的显然是你击毁的一艘海盗船上的成员，他们在船只的爆炸中逃过一劫。我需要把他们转移到另一个空间站的一些同事那里进行进一步审讯；希望那里的专家能够撬开他们的嘴巴，获得伏击我们CEO的幕后黑手的有关线索。

messages.en: Great work once again, {[character]player.name}. But I need you back here urgently for another assignment; something terrible just happened. I'll get you posted once you are ready.
messages.zh: 又是个漂亮活儿，{[character]player.name}。不过我迫切需要你回来完成另一个任务；发生了件可怕的事情。等你准备好后，我会告诉你细节。

messages.en: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.
messages.zh: 我不能接受。这件事情至关重要，不能交给像我这样的人办。

messages.en: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.
messages.zh: 我不想和你争辩，我会另请高明。

name.de: Der Gallente-Archäologe - Der Ahnungslose Reisende (1 von 9)
name.en: The Gallente Archaeologist - The Unsuspecting Traveler (1 of 9)
name.es: El arqueólogo gallente: El viajero inconsciente (1 de 9)
name.fr: L'archéologue gallente – Le voyageur crédule (1 sur 9)
name.ja: ガレンテの考古学者―うかつな旅行者（1/9）
name.ru: Археолог Gallente - доверчивый странник (The Gallente Archaeologist - The Unsuspecting Traveler) (1 из 9)
name.zh: 盖伦特考古学家—普通的旅者(1/9)

messages.en: Count me in.
messages.zh: 我参加。

messages.en: Good.  You will be adequately rewarded for your efforts when you get back of course.
messages.zh: 好的。当然，你回来后会得到可观的报酬。

messages.en:
I'm happy to announce that we just spotted a transport ship owned by the Archaeological Agency of Caille University not far from a stargate in this system. It is being escorted by some rather menacing Navy ships, and therefore we've been a bit wary to attack it. I'm sure it got lost and took a wrong jump somewhere along its travel route, no sane captain of a civilian transport ship would travel through these parts on purpose.

You probably guessed it but I'd like you to do the dirty work. Fly off to their current location and eliminate the escort. If the transport freighter puts up a fight then destroy it as well, but try to bring back as many of its passengers as you can. These civilian transport ships can be a goldmine for those in the kidnapping / ransom business, if you know what I mean. I'm sure the Gallenteans will pay a handsome amount of ISK for their precious archaeologists, if taken alive.
messages.zh:
哈哈，我们刚刚在本星系星门不远处发现了一艘属于凯勒大学考古学院的运输船。它由一些很厉害的海军飞船护送着，这也是我们至今没有攻击它的原因。我想船长一定犯了迷糊，在某个跳跃点上搞错了，以至于飞船偏离航线。只要有点头脑的民用舰船船长都不会去到这一区域的。

你很有可能已经猜到了，没错，我想把这件棘手的事情交给你。飞到他们现在的位置，消灭护航舰队。如果运输船参与反抗，把它一起击沉，不过带尽可能多的乘客回来。我的意思是，这些乘员可以作为人质换取赎金，那可是一个金矿啊！盖伦特人肯定会为他们珍爱的考古学家支付一大笔钱的，当然，要活的。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  I see you managed to bring back at least a few dozen of the passengers and crew members, now it's our turn to get them sorted out, to see who we sell to the slavers and who's worth keeping for ransom.  Ah what a fun job this is!  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。我看你至少带回了几十名乘客和船员，现在该我们把他们分选一下了，看看哪些卖给劳工贩，哪些值得留下换赎金。啊，这个工作多有趣啊！先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.
messages.zh: 你以为我这样的懦夫能接受这么难的任务？求你了……

name.ja: サーペンティスシップビルダー

messages.en: I'm expecting you back alive.
messages.zh: 希望你活着回来。

messages.en:
This one was issued from high command, specifically to be assigned to you.

Recently we have been picking up signals from an old ship wreckage nearby. We send a scout to go check it out and he reported a large Serpentis presence, led by a high-ranking colonel. They seem to be looting the wreckage and creating some sort of modified Megathron battleship. If you could go and eliminate this threat, we will reward you nicely.
messages.zh:
这个任务是最高指挥部发布的，指名要你来完成。

最近我们一直收到来自附近某个老旧飞船残骸的信号。我们派了一艘侦察机前去调查，结果他报告说，那里有一大队天蛇人马，由一名高阶军官率领。他们似乎正在搜寻残骸里的物品并建造某种改良的“万宝王座”级战列舰。如果你能帮我们解除这个威胁，我们会给你丰厚的报酬。

messages.en: The threat has been eliminated.
messages.zh: 威胁已被消除。

messages.en: The Federation is disappointed.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦对你很失望。

name.en: The Gallente Archaeologist - The Identification (2 of 9)
name.ja: ガレンテの考古学者―身分証明（2/9）
name.ru: Археолог Gallente - идентификация (The Gallente Archaeologist - The Identification) (2 из 9)
name.zh: 盖伦特考古学家—身份鉴定(2/9)

messages.en:
Welcome back {[character]player.name}. I'm excited here, we're pretty sure that the passengers you captured in a previous mission are of a very wealthy or important family. We can't say for certain yet, but there's something about them ...

Anyway, I'd like you to transfer a sample of their DNA to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where Zunbar Alefon, our expert on Gallentean internal affairs, is located. Hopefully he will be able to find a match for them in his gigantic DNA database and give us some information on their backgrounds. And don't tell ANYONE what you're up to, I'd rather keep a low profile on this for the time being, the fewer members of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} that know about this the better.
messages.zh:
欢迎归来，{[character]player.name}。我有点激动，我们相当肯定，上次任务中你抓回来的乘客来自一个非常富有或者有影响力的家族。我们现在还说不准，不过他们确实有些与众不同……

不管怎样，我希望你能把他们的DNA样本送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，那里居住着我们的盖伦特内务专家祖巴尔·阿勒弗恩。希望他能在他那巨大的DNA数据库内找到匹配的数据，从而获知他们的背景。不要向任何一个人透露这次任务的内容，目前我想保持低调，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}里越少人知道越好。

messages.en: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.
messages.zh: 我不能接受。这件事情至关重要，不能交给像我这样的人办。

无论如何，我希望你能把他们的DNA样本送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，在那儿，我们的盖伦特内务专家祖巴尔•阿勒弗恩应该能在他那巨大的DNA数据库内找到匹配的数据，从而获知他们的背景。不要向任何人透露这次任务的内容，目前我想保持低调，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}里知道的人越少越好。

name.en: The Gallente Archaeologist - The Bounty Hunter (3 of 9)
name.fr: L'archéologue gallente – Le chasseur de primes (3 sur 9)
name.ja: ガレンテの考古学者―賞金稼ぎ（3/9）
name.ru: Археолог Gallente - охотник за головами (The Gallente Archaeologist - The Bounty Hunter) (3 из 9)
name.zh: 盖伦特考古学家—赏金猎人(3/9)

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: The morning prison guard shift met with a grisly scene.  All of the guards on the 5th deck on the last shift had been brutally murdered and some of the prison cells had been forcibly opened.  2 of the prisoners that you captured in a previous mission were missing.  We are quite certain that this was the work of a bounty hunter, as he obviously intended to rescue these specific prisoners.  We immediately banned all craft from leaving the station, but it was too late.  However we have compiled a list of those who left the station this morning and we've narrowed it down to 3 suspects.  We know the location of each of them, they haven't managed to leave the system yet.  I'll upload their locations one by one, do whatever it takes to bring back those prisoners!
messages.zh: 早上守卫换班时发生了恐怖的一幕。5号甲板当值的所有守卫全被野蛮地加害了，部分牢房被强行打开。你上次任务中抓获的2个俘虏失踪了。我们肯定这是赏金猎人干的，他的目的明显是营救这几个特殊的俘虏。虽然我们立即禁止所有飞行器离站，但还是晚了一步。不过我们列出了今早离站的人员名单，并把范围缩小到了3个可疑对象。我有他们目前的位标，他们都没有离开星系。我会把位标逐个传给你。尽全力把犯人给我带回来！

messages.en: Well done.  I'll make sure the prisoners are kept at a more secure location this time, I've had enough of these screw ups.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得好！这次我会确保囚犯们被关在一个更安全的地方，我受够这些意外事件了。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en: Well, I did not say every job would be pleasure planets and pie.  Perhaps you are more suited for the garbage-hauling missions?
messages.zh: 嗯，我可没说每个工作都乐趣十足、报酬丰厚。或许你更适合垃圾收集工作？

messages.en: The morning prison guard shift met with a grisly scene.  All of the guards on the 5th deck on the last shift had been brutally murdered and some of the prison cells had been forcibly opened.  2 of the prisoners that you captured in a previous mission were missing.  We are quite certain that this was the work of a bounty hunter, as he obviously intended to rescue these specific prisoners.  We immediately banned all craft from leaving the station, but it was too late.  However we have compiled a list of those who left the station this morning and we've narrowed it down to 3 suspects.  We know the location of each of them, they haven't managed to leave the system yet.  I'll upload their locations one by one, do whatever it takes to bring back those prisoners!
messages.zh: 早上守卫换班时发生了恐怖的一幕。五号甲板当值的所有守卫全被野蛮地加害了，部分牢房被撬开。你以前任务抓获的2个俘虏失踪。我们肯定这是赏金猎人干的，他的目的是营救几个特定的俘虏。虽然我们立刻禁止所有飞船离开空间站，但还是晚了一步。不过我们列出了今早离站的人，并把范围缩小到了3个可疑对象。我有他们目前的位标，他们都没有离开星系。我会一个个地把位标传给你，全力把犯人给我带回来！

messages.en: Tsk, tsk.  Very well, I shall have to find some other lackey to do my work for me.
messages.zh: 啧啧。好吧，我会另找一个仆人来为我做事。

name.en: The Gallente Archaeologist - The Results (4 of 9)
name.es: El arqueólogo gallente: Los resultados (4 de 9)
name.ja: ガレンテの考古学者―照合結果（4/9）
name.ru: Археолог Gallente - результаты (The Gallente Archaeologist - The Results) (4 из 9)

messages.en:
I received a response from Zunbar Alefon, the person that was supposed to identify the prisoners that you captured in a previous mission. Apparently, one of them is a very famous Gallente archaeologist, Karzath Pinazi, distantly related to Senator Tarek Pinazi! This is an incredible stroke of fortune for us, capturing a relative of a Gallente senator and famous icon is almost unheard of. I've no doubt that he will get us a mighty fine ransom. The only bad news is that this will probably bring a lot of bounty hunters into our backyard ... but hey, we have you to deal with that problem.

Now, on to your assignment. I need you to go to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} with a data chip that I'll have dropped off into your hangar. This chip contains all of our demands towards the Gallente Federation in exchange for the release of the prisoners. In it, we also threaten them with the slaying of their dear archaeologist team if they dare to launch a full scale assault on our station. I'm pretty sure that will keep them at bay for the time being.
messages.zh:
我已经收到祖巴尔•阿勒弗恩的检验报告，他负责验证你之前所抓俘虏的身份。显然，其中一人是非常著名的盖伦特考古学家，卡扎斯•诺基，参议员塔瑞克•皮纳茨的远亲！这可是个意外的收获，这么重要的人质肯定能为我们带来一大笔赎金。唯一的问题是消息传出去后一定会有一大票赏金猎人到我们的后院捣乱，这件事情恐怕还要靠你解决了。

言归正传，我已经把一块数据芯片放入你的舱内，你负责把它带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。这块芯片里有我们向盖伦特政府提的要求，作为释放人质的条件。同时也威胁对方不要轻举妄动，不然就干掉整个考古小组，一个不留。我想这足以使他们投鼠忌器。

messages.en: Well then.  Perhaps you should seek employment with the Servant Sisters of Eve?
messages.zh: 好吧，我想你大概希望为姐妹共济会工作？
