name.en: The Gallente Archaeologist - Sudden Strike (5 of 9)
name.es: El arqueólogo gallente: Ataque repentino (5 de 9)
name.ja: ガレンテの考古学者―奇襲（5/9）
name.ru: Археолог Gallente - внезапный удар (The Gallente Archaeologist - Sudden Strike) (5 из 9)

messages.en: I'll be off immediately.
messages.zh: 我马上出发。

messages.en: Hit em hard, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 狠狠教训他们，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
After you delivered the data chip in your last mission, I've been flooded with reports of Gallente Navy sightings in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. A number of our gangs have been wiped out, and it's not considered safe anymore for a pirate to venture too far out into space in these parts. I'm positive that this new offensive is the direct result of the data chip we sent falling into the hands of the Navy generals. They know what we're up to and it's only a matter of time before the Gallente media get a hold of the story.

I didn't expect the Navy to venture this close to our station, after all we've threatened to kill the prisoners. But they seem intent on keeping their distance, this is just a ploy of theirs to frighten us. But by disrupting our trade routes and ambushing our patrols in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, all they accomplish is raising the price on our demands.

I want you to head out into the outer reaches of this system and eliminate 4 Navy groups. After we have given them the taste of defeat, then it will be time to deliver our new demands. Off you go.
messages.zh:
自从你在上次任务中递送了数据芯片以后，我频频收到有关盖伦特海军出现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}区域的报告。我们的不少团队遭到灭顶之灾；现在对海盗来说，进入这些地方的深层空间是非常危险的。我敢肯定那块数据芯片落到了海军将军们的手里，并且直接导致了这些攻击。他们知道了我们的目的，盖伦特媒体也迟早会得到消息。

我没料到海军敢如此逼近空间站，我们可是威胁要干掉所有俘虏的。但他们似乎执意要保持这种距离。这只是他们恐吓我们的一个策略。他们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}阻扰我们的交易路线，伏击我们的飞行员，这种做法不过是提高了我们开价的筹码。

我要你去这个星系的外围剿灭4个海军小分队。在他们尝到失败的苦果之后，我们就可以提出新的要求了。快去。

messages.en:
After you delivered the data chip in your last mission, I've been flooded with reports of Gallente Navy sightings in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. A number of our gangs have been wiped out, and it's not considered safe anymore for a pirate to venture too far out into space in these parts. I'm positive that this new offensive is the direct result of the data chip we sent falling into the hands of the Navy generals. They know what we're up to and it's only a matter of time before the Gallente media get a hold of the story.

I didn't expect the Navy to venture this close to our station, after all we've threatened to kill the prisoners. But they seem intent on keeping their distance, this is just a ploy of theirs to frighten us. But by disrupting our trade routes and ambushing our patrols in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, all they accomplish is raising the price on our demands.

I want you to head out into the outer reaches of this system and eliminate 4 Navy groups. After we have given them the taste of defeat, then it will be time to deliver our new demands. Off you go.
messages.zh:
自从你上次任务送完数据芯片以后，盖伦特海军频繁地出现在 {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}区域。我们的一个小队遭受了灭顶之灾，连那些胆大包天的海盗都不敢进入这块空域。我敢肯定那块数据芯片落到了海军高级将领的手里，他们知道了我们的目的。而盖伦特媒体也迟早会得到消息。

我没料到海军敢如此逼近空间站，我威胁过要干掉所有的俘虏，但他们依然我行我素。哼，这只是他们恐吓我们的一个策略。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}袭击我们的商队，伏击我们的巡逻队，他们所有的行动只是增加了赎金的额度。

飞到这个星系的边缘部分，消灭4个海军小队。一旦他们尝到失败的滋味，我们就能提出新的要求了。去吧。

messages.en: My ship is in need of repairs, so I'm afraid I can't complete this in time.
messages.zh: 我的飞船需要修理，恐怕不能按时完成这个任务。

messages.en: I see.  Well, perhaps you will be of some use next time.
messages.zh: 我明白了，好吧希望下次能用得到你。

name.ja: ガレンテの考古学者―余波（6/9）
name.ru: Археолог Gallente - последствия (The Gallente Archaeologist - Repercussions) (6 из 9)

messages.en: Consider the building preparations for that outpost officially terminated.
messages.zh: 包在我身上，他们的哨站建设到此为止。

messages.en: Your attack on the Navy groups has had unforeseeable consequences.  Instead of backing off, they have taken their offensive to another level.  We've noticed an unusually large concentration of their ships at a location within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and a construction freight or two heading their way.  We're quite sure they are planning on building something there, probably a military outpost from which they intend to launch a major offensive against this station.  We can't let them start building that outpost!  I want you to personally see to it that their convoy and all of the ships defending the area are destroyed immediately.
messages.zh: 你对海军部队的攻击产生了预料之外的后果。他们非但没有撤离，反而变本加厉。我们发现，有超乎寻常规模的海军船舰集结在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，还有一两艘建造货船正开往那里。我们肯定他们打算在那建什么东西，很可能是个军事哨站，好从那里发动对这个空间站的全面攻击。必须阻止他们建设哨站！我要你亲自出马，务必立刻全歼他们的护航舰队和守卫飞船。

messages.en: Your attack on the Navy groups has had unforeseeable consequences.  Instead of backing off, they have taken their offensive to another level.  We've noticed an unusually large concentration of their ships at a location within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and a construction freight or two heading their way.  We're quite sure they are planning on building something there, probably a military outpost from which they intend to launch a major offensive against this station.  We can't let them start building that outpost!  I want you to personally see to it that their convoy and all of the ships defending the area are destroyed immediately.
messages.zh: 你对海军集团的攻击产生了无法预料的后果。他们非但没有撤退，反而更疯狂地对我们发动反击。大批海军舰船不寻常地集结在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，还有一两艘建造货船正开往那里。很明显，他们正计划建造什么东西，很可能是个军事哨站，好从那里发动对这个空间站的攻击。必须阻止他们建设哨站！我要你马上去摧毁他们的护航舰队和守卫那里的飞船。

name.de: Der Gallente-Archäologe - Die Neuen Forderungen (7 von 9)
name.en: The Gallente Archaeologist - The New Demands (7 of 9)
name.es: El arqueólogo gallente: Las nuevas exigencias (7 de 9)
name.fr: L'archéologue gallente – Les nouvelles demandes (7 sur 9)
name.ja: ガレンテの考古学者―新たな要求（7/9）
name.ru: Археолог Gallente - новые требования (The Gallente Archaeologist - The New Demands) (7 из 9)
name.zh: 盖伦特考古学家—新的要求(7/9)

messages.en: I will do it.
messages.zh: 好吧，我做。

messages.en: Your last strike against the Navy forces in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} sent them into a disarray.  That should keep them in check for a day or two.  Meanwhile, I'd like you to bring our new demands to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  This time they better comply, or we might just go through with all of our threats.  We've already decapitated one of the prisoners, which we believe to be a personal aid of Karzath.  The footage has been compiled into the data disk along with our demands.
messages.zh: 你上次在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}对海军部队的进攻打乱了他们的阵脚。这应该能够拖住他们一两天。趁此机会，我想派你把我们的新要求捎给{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。这次他们最好合作，不然我们只好把口头威胁变成现实了。我们已经砍了一个俘虏的脑袋，那人估计是卡扎斯的私人助理。这段斩首录像与我们的要求一起制作进了这张数据盘里。

messages.en: Nice job mate.  Now let's keep our fingers crossed and hope those bastards cave in to our threats.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，伙计。现在让我们祈求好运降临，希望那些混蛋屈服于我们的威慑。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en: Sounds too risky for me.
messages.zh: 对我而言这太危险了。

messages.en: Your last strike against the Navy forces in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} sent them into a disarray.  That should keep them in check for a day or two.  Meanwhile, I'd like you to bring our new demands to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  This time they better comply, or we might just go through with all of our threats.  We've already decapitated one of the prisoners, which we believe to be a personal aid of Karzath.  The footage has been compiled into the data disk along with our demands.
messages.zh: 你上次在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}对海军的进攻造成了不小的混乱，应该能拖个一两天时间，趁此机会，我想派你把我们新的要求带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。这次他们最好顺从我们，不然我们只好让威胁成为现实了……事实上我已经下令处决了一个俘虏，我们相信他是卡扎斯的一个亲信。这段斩首录像会随我们的要求一起送到。

name.en: The Gallente Archaeologist - Final Attempt (8 of 9)
name.es: El arqueólogo gallente: Último intento (8 de 9)
name.ja: ガレンテの考古学者―最後の試み（8/9）
name.ru: Археолог Gallente - последняя попытка (The Gallente Archaeologist - Final Attempt) (8 из 9)
name.zh: 盖伦特考古学家—最后的尝试(8/9)

messages.en: I'm glad you're back {[character]player.name}.  The Gallente Navy have gone mad!  They've sent an entire fleet of ships to attack this station.  They must be utterly insane, if even one of them steps foot in here the prisoners heads will roll!  I need you to undock at once and meet the Navy head on before they get within firing range of the station, bring everyone you can, I suspect you'll need all the help you can get.  You'll be supplied with a bookmark of course, now get moving!
messages.zh: 真高兴看到你回来，{[character]player.name}。盖伦特海军发疯了！他们派了一整支舰队来攻打这个空间站！他们肯定彻底疯了，只要他们任何一艘飞船踏进这里，我就让所有俘虏人头落地！我要你马上起飞，把海军先头部队拦在空间站火力范围之外。尽可能带上所有人，你肯定用得着能获得的一切支援。我已经把位标上传给你了，现在就出发！

messages.en: Not bad, {[character]player.name}.  But this outrageous attack on our stronghold will not go unpunished.  I have personally ordered the execution of all of the prisoners save our prized possession, Karzath Pinazi.  The picture of the beheadings will be sent straight to the Gallente media.  This should teach them a lesson.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 不错，{[character]player.name}。不过这次对我们要塞的无耻攻击要得到应有的惩罚。我已经亲自下令处决所有囚犯，除了我们宝贵的塔瑞克·皮纳茨之外。斩首的画面会直接传送给盖伦特媒体。这应该会给他们一个教训。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en: I'm glad you're back {[character]player.name}.  The Gallente Navy have gone mad!  They've sent an entire fleet of ships to attack this station.  They must be utterly insane, if even one of them steps foot in here the prisoners heads will roll!  I need you to undock at once and meet the Navy head on before they get within firing range of the station, bring everyone you can, I suspect you'll need all the help you can get.  You'll be supplied with a bookmark of course, now get moving!
messages.zh: 我真高兴你回来了，{[character]player.name}。盖伦特海军疯了！他们派遣了一个舰队来进攻这个空间站！那群疯子，一旦他们踏进这里，我就下令处决俘虏，叫他们通通人头落地！我要你马上离站，在海军抵达空间站之前把他们拦下来！带上你能叫到的所有人，你必须全力以赴。我已经把位标上传给你了，现在就出发！

name.en: The Gallente Archaeologist - The Conclusion (9 of 9)
name.ja: ガレンテの考古学者―結論（9/9）
name.ru: Археолог Gallente - заключение (The Gallente Archaeologist - The Conclusion) (9 из 9)

messages.en:
Rejoice, {[character]player.name}, the Federation have finally caved in. They have vowed to meet our demands once the prisoner and his cargo have been transferred safely to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where their agents will pick it up. Ironically enough, we have no idea what cargo they were jammering about, everything that was on board the cargo ship containing the archeologists you captured originally was destroyed along with the ship. No wonder they were so adamant at retrieving whatever it was they were after. Karzath Nuoki was only a smokescreen, whatever he was transporting towards Gallente space was extremely valuable. It's unfortunate we will never find out what it was, as I'm sure you never saw anything suspicious in the wreckage of the cargo ship other than the stranded archeologists ... but just to be on the safe side, I had some of my men search your hangar just in case you have been less than honest with us. No hard feelings I hope.

And as you probably guessed, I want you to do the honors of transporting the prisoner to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where our agents will hand him along with a cargo container filled with various junk to our Gallente 'friends'. Once this final assignment has been completed, I ... err we will be able to enjoy the fruits of our hard work. In other words, I'll be rich!
messages.zh:
哈哈，{[character]player.name}，联邦最后还是妥协了，他们承诺实现我们的要求——只要我们把俘虏和他的货物安全地带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，在那里对方的特工会和我们交易。讽刺的是，我们根本没有货物可以交易，考古学家船上的所有货物都在你抓获他的时候随船一起消失在爆炸里了。他们如此坚定地要找回这批货物，很明显一定是非常重要的东西，卡扎斯•诺基只是一个幌子，他运送的货物才是盖伦特人真正想要的。可惜我们永远都没机会查出那到底是什么。我相信你在飞船遗骸附近回收那些考古学家的时候也没有看见什么可疑的东西吧……安全起见，我已派了一些手下搜查你的货舱，防人之心不可无，我想你也能理解。

可能你也猜到了，我想让你负责把这些俘虏送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，在那里我们的特工会准备一个装满废料的集装箱，然后随他一起送还给我们的盖伦特“朋友”，等事情结了，我……呃，我们就能享受胜利的果实。换句话说，我发财啦，哈哈哈！

messages.en: You have done well, {[character]player.name}.  {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} will not forget this.  The piece of Neophite that I received in exchange for the prisoner will fetch me an absurd price on the black market.  And the look on the faces of the Gallente agents who picked him up, after they rummaged through the cargo container ... simply priceless!
messages.zh: 你做得很好，{[character]player.name}。{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}不会忘记你的功劳。我用那个囚犯换来的这块新醇岩矿，在黑市上可以卖个夸张的价钱。想象一下那些来接他的盖伦特特工在搜遍货柜箱后的表情吧……简直花钱都买不到！

messages.en:
Rejoice, {[character]player.name}, the Federation have finally caved in. They have vowed to meet our demands once the prisoner and his cargo have been transferred safely to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where their agents will pick it up. Ironically enough, we have no idea what cargo they were jammering about, everything that was on board the cargo ship containing the archeologists you captured originally was destroyed along with the ship. No wonder they were so adamant at retrieving whatever it was they were after. Karzath Nuoki was only a smokescreen, whatever he was transporting towards Gallente space was extremely valuable. It's unfortunate we will never find out what it was, as I'm sure you never saw anything suspicious in the wreckage of the cargo ship other than the stranded archeologists ... but just to be on the safe side, I had some of my men search your hangar just in case you have been less than honest with us. No hard feelings I hope.

And as you probably guessed, I want you to do the honors of transporting the prisoner to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where our agents will hand him along with a cargo container filled with various junk to our Gallente 'friends'. Once this final assignment has been completed, I ... err we will be able to enjoy the fruits of our hard work. In other words, I'll be rich!
messages.zh:
哈哈，{[character]player.name}，联邦最后还是妥协了，他们承诺实现我们的要求——只要我们把俘虏和他的货物安全地带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，在那里对方的特工会和我们交易。讽刺的是，我们根本没有货物可以交易，考古学家船上的所有货物都在你抓获他的时候随船一起消失在爆炸里了。他们如此坚定地要找回这批货物，很明显一定是非常重要的东西，卡扎斯•诺基只是一个幌子，他运送的货物才是盖伦特人真正想要的。可惜我们永远都没机会查出那到底是什么。我相信你在飞船遗骸附近回收那些考古学家的时候也没有看见什么可疑的东西吧……安全起见，我已派了一些手下搜查你的货舱，防人之心不可无，我想你也能理解。

可能你也猜到了，我想让你负责把这些俘虏送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，在那里我们的特工会准备一个装满废料的集装箱，然后随他一起送还给我们的盖伦特“朋友”，等事情结了，我……呃，我们就能享受胜利的果实。换句话说，我发财啦，哈哈哈！

name.ru: Военные донесения — часть 1 (Tidings of Conflict - Part 1)

messages.en: I need work.
messages.zh: 我需要工作。

messages.en: The Republic needs you! Communications have been down all day, I need you to go and get me today's status reports, I have a feeling something big is going to happen today.
messages.zh: 共和国需要你！整整一天通讯都处于瘫痪状态，我要你去取今天的状况报告，我感到今天会有大事发生。

messages.en: The Republic needs you! Communications have been down all day, I need you to go and get me today's status reports, I have a feeling something big is going to happen today.
messages.zh: 共和国需要你！整整一天通讯都处于瘫痪状态，我要你去取今天的状况报告，我感到今天会有大事发生。

messages.en: I'm sorry, it's too hard, I can't do it.
messages.zh: 抱歉，这任务太难了，我没法完成。

messages.en: You disappoint me soldier.
messages.zh: 你令我失望，士兵。

name.ru: Военные донесения — часть 2 (Tidings of Conflict - Part 2)

messages.en: Those reports you just delivered to me were of great importance, it seems as though the Amarrians have made a huge mistake and want us to correct it for them. Before I can tell you more I need you to pass this info on to a nearby agent.
messages.zh: 你带给我的报告非常重要，看起来艾玛人似乎犯了一个天大的错误，希望我们来帮其纠正。在我能告诉你更多细节之前，我需要你先把这条信息告诉附近的一位代理人。

messages.en:
Those messages you delivered were essential, thank you. The Amarrians screwed up and want us to clean up their mess, what a day.

One of their generals has gone crazy. He ignored orders, broke communications with his commanding officers and then disappeared into thin air. They believe he might be heading our way, apparently he thinks an all-out war has started and wants to be a part of it. Anyway I'll have someone take care of the rest, thank you.
messages.zh:
你送来的信息非常重要，谢谢。艾玛人把事情搞砸了，还想要我们来帮忙收拾他们的烂摊子。真是糟糕的一天。

他们的一位将军疯了。他无视军令，和他的指挥官一起破坏了通讯设备，然后消失在太空里。据信，他可能正朝我们这来，显然他觉得一场全方位大战已经打响，并且希望参与其中。不管怎样，剩下的事情我会派人去处理。谢谢你。

messages.en: Any more news on the Amarr troubles?
messages.zh: 有没有更多关于艾玛帝国麻烦的消息？

messages.en:
Some Amarr officer has gone crazy - he ignored orders, broke communications with his commanding officers, commandeered an Imperial Navy vessel, and then disappeared. Our intel says he's headed our way: apparently he's not willing to let freelance capsuleers handle the fight, and instead wants to be a part of it himself.

Fix this little problem for us and you will be well rewarded.
messages.zh:
有一个艾玛官员做了些疯狂的事情，他不服从命令，拒绝同他的上级指挥官联络，驾驶了一艘帝国海军舰只潜逃了。我们的情报部门说他正朝着我们来了：很显然他不愿意让克隆飞行员佣兵来完成这次攻击，而是想要亲自出马。

帮我们解决掉这个问题，大大有赏。

messages.en: I want nothing to do with this.
messages.zh: 我不想跟这事扯上任何关系。

messages.en: I will give this to somebody more competent.
messages.zh: 我会让更有能力的人来做这件事。

name.en: The Numon Claim - First Attack (1 of 5)
name.es: La reclamación de los Numon: Primer ataque (1 de 5)
name.fr: La revendication numon – Première attaque (1 sur 5)
name.ja: ヌモンの要求―最初の攻撃（1/5）
name.ru: Претензии Numon  - первое нападение (The Numon Claim - First Attack) (1 из 5)
name.zh: 诺门的主张—第一次攻击(1/5)

messages.en:
A minor Amarrian noble has claimed ownership of a sizable portion of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, claiming one of his ancestors was given this part of space as a reward for his ancestor's duties to the emperor. The area includes a couple of planets, their satellites, and an asteroid field. Anyway, this guy has now sent us an official warning that any aggression against "his" assets will be met with an iron fist.

He completely underestimates our strength in the region, believing his small mercenary force sufficient to scare us off. Fly to the fool's position and destroy the Control Tower he's holding out there, along with the mercenary forces defending him. Let's put this idiot out of his misery.
messages.zh:
一个小喽罗地位的艾玛贵族，卡扎尔•诺门，声称大片{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}空域的主权归其所有，因为这是他的一个祖先效忠皇帝而得的封赏。那片区域包括好几个行星，它们的轨道人造卫星以及一个小行星带。他发给我们一份正式警告，声称任何对其“私有”财产的侵犯都会遭到强有力的回击。

他完全低估了我们在这个空域的力量，以为他那一小撮雇佣兵就能把我们吓倒。你飞到那个他们建立的空间站，把控制塔炸了，当然还包括那些防守的雇佣军，就当是我们为给这个精神病的悲惨生命做一个了断。

messages.en:
Nice work. He may have a clone somewhere, being a noble, but with his mercenary force eliminated, I'm sure Kazar will think twice before attempting anything like this again within our territory.

And don't you leave just yet: I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh:
干得漂亮。那家伙身为贵族，应该还有个克隆藏于某处。但现在既然他的雇佣部队被消灭了，卡扎尔如果打算再在我们的领地采取类似的行动，一定会三思而行。

先别急着走，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en:
We have a rather comical situation on our hands, {[character]player.name}. A foolhardy Amarrian noble named Kazar Numon has claimed ownership of a sizable portion of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, claiming one of his ancestors was given this part of space as a reward for his duties to the emperor. Turns out that, many centuries ago, {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} had just recently been discovered by an Amarrian exploration team, which apparently included a long-distant relative of his. The area includes a couple of planets, their satellites, and an asteroid field. Anyway, this guy has now sent us an official warning that any aggression against "his" assets will be met with an iron fist.

I want you to put this goofball out of his misery, {[character]player.name}. He completely underestimates our strength in the region, believing that his small mercenary force will scare us off. Fly to their position where they have set up a small outpost and destroy its Control Tower, along with the mercenary forces defending it.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我们遇到件滑稽事。一个有勇无谋的艾玛贵族，卡扎尔•诺门，声称大片{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}空域的主权归其所有，因为这是他的一个祖先效忠皇帝而得的封赏。在当时，也就是好多世纪前，{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}刚刚被一个艾玛探险世家发现，很显然其中也有这个人的一个远房亲戚。那片区域包括好几个行星，它们的轨道人造卫星以及一个小行星带。他发给我们一份正式警告，声称任何对其“私有”财产的侵犯都会遭到强有力的回击。

我想要你去给这个精神病的悲惨生命做一个了断，{[character]player.name}。他完全低估了我们在这个空域的力量，以为他那一小撮雇佣兵就能把我们吓倒。你飞到那个他们建立的空间站，把控制塔炸了，当然还包括那些防守的雇佣军。

name.en: The Numon Claim - Imperial Intervention (3 of 5)
name.es: La reclamación de los Numon: Intervención imperial (3 de 5)
name.fr: La revendication numon – Intervention impériale (3 sur 5)
name.ja: ヌモンの要求―帝国の介入（3/5）
name.ru: Претензии Numon  - Имперское вмешательство (The Numon Claim - Imperial Intervention) (3 из 5)
name.zh: 诺门的主张—帝国的介入(3/5)

messages.en:
The Amarr Empress has publicly declined to intervene officially in the territorial dispute between us and Kazar Numon. Sadly, she also expressly has not forbidden other Amarr Holders from acting privately in this matter.

As a result, the Sarum lords who originally campaigned for intervention have ordered an outlying fleet of Imperial Navy ships to aid Numon anyway. They are led by an Imperial Fleet Commander who's part of House Sarum, one Ishtai Sarum. We need to prevent him from moving his fleet into defensive positions around the area claimed by Numon. To do this, we must execute a number of hit-and-run attacks while they move through our territory.

We've located what seems to be a reconnaissance team of theirs, en route to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They are currently flying through {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, and we'd like you to intercept them immediately.

Leave no survivors - we don't want them reporting anything back to their commander.
messages.zh:
艾玛女王已经当众表态不会介入我们和卡扎尔•诺门的领土纠纷，但她也说不会干涉艾玛贵族自己处理这件事情。

这样一来，原本等待帝国插手干涉的萨拉姆贵族派遣了一支边远帝国海军舰队来帮助诺门。他们由出身于萨拉姆家族的帝国舰队指挥官伊什泰•萨拉姆指挥。我们必须阻止他把整个舰队部署到被诺门侵占的土地周围的防御位置上。为此，当他们的舰队通过我们的地盘时，得好好地和他们打一场游击战。

我们侦测到一队飞船，似乎是他们的侦察部队，正前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。他们现在正路过{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}，我要你马上前去拦截他们。

所有人一个不留——我们不希望任何人能活着把消息带回到他们的指挥官那儿。

messages.en:
I have some good and some bad news, {[character]player.name}. The good news is that the Amarr Empress has publicly declined to intervene officially in the territorial dispute between us and Kazar Numon. The bad news is that she also expressly has not forbidden other Amarr Holders from acting privately in this matter. It's a political game she's playing, and she plays it well.

As a result, the Sarum lords who originally campaigned for intervention have ordered an outlying fleet of Imperial Navy ships to aid Numon anyway. They are led by an Imperial Fleet Commander who's part of House Sarum, one Ishtai Sarum. We need to prevent him from moving his fleet into defensive positions around the area claimed by Numon. To do this, we must execute a number of hit-and-run attacks while they move through our territory.

We've located what seems to be a reconnaissance team of theirs, en route to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They are currently flying through {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, and we'd like you to intercept them immediately.

Leave no survivors - we don't want them reporting anything back to their commander.
messages.zh:
我有好消息也有坏消息，{[character]player.name}。好消息是艾玛女王已经当众表态不会介入我们和卡扎尔•诺门的领土纠纷，坏消息是她也说不会干涉艾玛贵族自己处理这件事情。她这政治手腕玩得可真高明。

这样一来，原本等待帝国插手干涉的萨拉姆贵族派遣了一支边远帝国海军舰队来帮助诺门。他们由出身于萨拉姆家族的帝国舰队指挥官伊什泰•萨拉姆指挥。我们必须阻止他把整个舰队部署到被诺门侵占的土地周围的防御位置上。为此，当他们的舰队通过我们的地盘时，得好好地和他们打一场游击战。

我们侦测到一队飞船，似乎是他们的侦察部队，正前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。他们现在正路过{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}，我要你马上前去拦截他们。

所有人一个不留——我们不希望任何人能活着把消息带回到他们的指挥官那儿。

name.en: The Numon Claim - Ruffled Feathers (2 of 5)
name.es: La reclamación de los Numon: Fuera de sus casillas (2 de 5)
name.ja: ヌモンの要求―動揺する情勢（2/5）
name.ru: Претензии Numon - взъерошенные перья (The Numon Claim - Ruffled Feathers) (2 из 5)

messages.en: I'll fetch that data chip for you in no time.
messages.zh: 我马上帮你把这块芯片送到。

messages.en:
Your successful attack on the Numon mercenary outpost seems to be sitting badly with certain factions in the Amarr Empire. A few members of the Sarum family have taken up Kazar's cause, and they've already started mobilizing their personal fleets to make a trip here to get involved in our little territorial dispute.

We've already sent out scan probes to collect data on any Imperial activity in the {[location]agentRegionID.name} region. This data will be stored in a computer disc which I expect you to fetch for me at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. Once we retrieve this data we will have a better picture of what we might be up against. But we still have our fingers crossed that this fiasco will die down before Empress Catiz herself gets involved.
messages.zh:
你对诺门佣兵哨所的攻击引起了艾玛帝国内几个派系的不安。一些萨拉姆家族的高层将卡扎尔的意愿直接传达给了女王，并开始怂恿他们的私人舰队介入我们这个小地方的领土争端。

我们已经派遣侦察机到{[location]agentRegionID.name}区域关注帝国舰队的一举一动，而这些侦查数据都被存放在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的一张电脑盘片里，我希望你能去帮我取来。一旦我们有了这些数据就能对敌人的实力做一个预估，但我们还是要祈祷这件事能在贾米尔女王亲自介入之前被摆平。

messages.en:
There has been an unfortunate turn of events. Your successful attack on the Numon mercenary outpost seems to be sitting badly with certain factions within the Amarr Empire. A few high-ranking members of the Sarum family have taken up Kazar's cause directly to the Empress, and they've already started mobilizing their personal fleets to make a trip here to get involved in our little territorial dispute.

We've already sent out scan probes to collect data on any Imperial activity in the {[location]agentRegionID.name} region. This data will be stored in a computer disc which I expect you to fetch for me at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. Once we retrieve this data we will have a better picture of what we might be up against. But we still have our fingers crossed that this fiasco will die down before Empress Catiz herself gets involved.
messages.zh:
我们的运气似乎越来越糟，你对诺门佣兵哨所的攻击引起了艾玛帝国内几个派系的不安。一些萨拉姆家族的高层将卡扎尔的意愿直接传达给了女王，并开始怂恿他们的私人舰队介入我们这个小地方的领土争端。

我们已经发射扫描探针到{[location]agentRegionID.name}星域关注帝国舰队的一举一动，而这些侦查数据都被存放在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.的一张电脑盘片里，我希望你能去帮我取来。一旦我们有了这些数据就能对敌人的实力做一个预估， 但我们还是要祈祷这件事能在凯蒂兹女王亲自介入之前被摆平。

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: Don't fail me now.
messages.zh: 别让我失望。

messages.en: Seems like those Amarrians you took out were just scouts, we're not quite sure where this fugitive is hiding. What we do know is the presence of another similar nearby scout outpost. Perhaps if you went there you could get some information out of them as to the whereabouts of our target. We need to find him as soon as possible, before he is able to strike.
messages.zh: 看来你干掉的那些艾玛人仅仅是侦察兵，我们还不清楚这个逃亡者藏在哪里。不过我们已经确信附近有另一个艾玛侦察机哨站。你可以去那儿获取一些情报，看看我们的目标究竟在哪里。在那个疯子行动之前必须赶快找到他。

messages.en: I am proud of you, nice work.
messages.zh: 做得漂亮，我真为你感到自豪。

messages.en: I don't care, give me something else.
messages.zh: 没兴趣，给我其他的任务吧。

messages.en: I can't do it, it's too hard!
messages.zh: 我干不了，太难了！

messages.en: You disappoint both me and the Republic, shame on you.
messages.zh: 你真让我和共和国失望，你应该感到羞愧！

name.de: Die Numon-Forderung - Teilen der Flotte (4 von 5)
name.en: The Numon Claim - Split The Fleet (4 of 5)
name.es: La reclamación de los Numon: Dividir la flota (4 de 5)
name.fr: La revendication numon – Diviser la flotte (4 sur 5)
name.ja: ヌモンの要求―フリート離脱（4/5）
name.ru: Претензии Numon  - расколоть флот (The Numon Claim - Split The Fleet) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
Our surveillance teams have reported a large force of Imperial Navy ships moving toward {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. If we let them all arrive safely at their destination, we will have a very difficult fight on our hands: We need to weaken them before they have a chance to settle in and fortify themselves at their destination.

Part of their fleet is currently in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. Their plan seems to be to move slowly between deadspace areas to prevent our heavy artillery from locking on to them. I want you to conduct an attack on the couple of squadrons that have already arrived at that deadspace pocket; I will provide you with bookmarks to the exact location.

Speed is crucial for your success here. You need to strike them hard and fast and get out of there before they know what hit them. Tarry too long, and you'll have the entire fleet on you.
messages.zh:
我们的侦察队报告说大批帝国海军飞船正向{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}前进。如果他们全都安全到达的话，战局会对我们非常不利，所以务必要在他们抵达目的地之前削弱他们的力量。

一部分敌方舰队现正聚集在位于{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的死亡空间中，他们似乎是想从死亡空间地带慢慢接近，以免遭受我们的重火力打击。你的任务是对已抵达死亡空间的敌方舰队进行攻击。我会把准确的位标给你。

速度是成功与否的关键，你必须以迅雷不及掩耳之势发动猛烈攻击，然后在他们缓过神来之前迅速撤离。千万别逗留太久，不然整个舰队都会来吃掉你。

messages.en:
Our surveillance teams have reported another large force of Imperial Navy ships moving through {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, probably heading toward {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. If we let them all arrive safely at their destination, we will have a very difficult fight on our hands: We need to weaken their forces before they have a chance to settle in and fortify themselves at their destination.

A part of their fleet is currently amassed in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. Their plan seems to be to move slowly between deadspace areas to prevent our heavy artillery from locking on to them. I want you to conduct an attack on the couple of squadrons that have already arrived at that deadspace pocket; I will provide you with bookmarks to the exact location.

Speed is crucial for your success here. You need to strike them hard and fast and get out of there before they know what hit them. Tarry too long, and you'll have the entire fleet on your ass.

Good luck.
messages.zh:
我们的侦察队报告说大批帝国海军飞船正从{[location]agentConstellationID.name}经过，很可能去往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。如果他们全都安全到达的话，战局会对我们非常不利，所以务必要在他们抵达目的地之前削弱他们的力量。

一部分敌方舰队现正聚集在位于{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的死亡空间中，他们似乎是想从死亡空间地带慢慢接近，以免遭受我们的重火力打击。你的任务是对已抵达死亡空间的敌方舰队进行攻击。我会把准确的位标给你。

速度是成功与否的关键，你必须以迅雷不及掩耳之势发动猛烈攻击，然后在他们缓过神来之前迅速撤离。千万别逗留太久，不然整个舰队都会来吃掉你。

祝你好运。

name.de: Die Numon-Forderung - Das Letzte Gefecht (5 von 5)
name.en: The Numon Claim - Last Stand (5 of 5)
name.es: La reclamación de los Numon: Última batalla (5 de 5)
name.fr: La revendication numon – L'affrontement final (5 sur 5)
name.ru: Претензии Numon - последняя преграда (The Numon Claim - Last Stand) (5 из 5)

messages.en:
Our guerrilla tactics have worked well. The remainder of the Amarr fleet has reached its destination, but they are substantially weakened. Now it's time to launch our final attack.

The remaining forces have started to rebuild the defensive perimeter around the Numon claim. The remnants of Numon's mercenary force guards the area now, along with the partial Navy fleet.

Best, though, is the fact that Kazar, head of House Numon, has apparently decided to risk his own hide to defend his precious section of space. Killing him will be the icing on the cake for us. Your task is simple, {[character]player.name}. Attack the Numon and Amarr forces head on, and obliterate them completely. Leave no survivors.

But do bring me Numon's head. It will make a nice souvenir.
messages.zh:
我们的游击战术效果非常好。艾玛残余舰队虽然到达了目的地，但他们已经元气大伤。是时候发动最后的攻击了。

那帮残余部队已经开始在诺门家族声称拥有的区域周围重新设立防卫线了。残余的诺门雇佣兵势力和残缺的艾玛海军一起守卫着那个地区。

对我们来说最好的消息就是对方的领袖，卡扎尔•诺门，决定拿自己的生命保卫他珍贵的领地。这倒不错，干掉他会为我们锦上添花。{[character]player.name}，你的任务很简单：直面干掉诺门与艾玛部队。全部消灭。

不过记得把诺门的头颅带回来给我，我要它留作纪念。

messages.en:
Our guerrilla tactics have worked wonderfully, {[character]player.name}. The remainder of the Amarr fleet has reached its destination, but they are substantially weakened. Some were destroyed in your attacks, some were destroyed by other pirate marauders, and, subsequently, some deserted. Now it's time to launch our final attack.

The remaining forces have started to rebuild the defensive perimeter around the territory the Numon family claimed for themselves. The remnants of Numon's mercenary force guards the area now, along with the partial Navy fleet. Kazar, head of House Numon, has apparently decided to risk his own hide to defend his precious section of space. Killing him again will be the icing on the cake for us.

Your task is simple, {[character]player.name}. Attack the Numon and Amarr forces head on, and obliterate them completely. Leave no survivors - but do bring me Numon's head. It will make a nice souvenir.
messages.zh:
我们的游击战术效果非常好，{[character]player.name}。艾玛残余舰队虽然到达了目的地，但他们已经元气大伤。你消灭了一些，其他海盗消灭一些，还有一些当了逃兵。是时候发动最后的攻击了。

那帮残余部队已经开始在诺门家族声称拥有的区域周围重新设立防卫线了。残余的诺门雇佣兵势力和残缺的艾玛海军一起守卫着那个地区。对方的领袖卡扎尔•诺门看来决定拿自己的生命保卫他珍贵的领地。这倒不错，干掉他会为我们锦上添花。

{[character]player.name}，你的任务很简单：直面干掉诺门与艾玛部队。全部消灭，不过记得把诺门的头颅带回来给我，我要它留作纪念。

name.de: Der Sukuuvestaa-Zwischenfall - Schnappt die Elektrogeräte! (1 von 6)
name.en: The Sukuuvestaa Incident - Nab The Consumer Electronics! (1 of 6)
name.es: El incidente Sukuuvestaa: Electrónica de consumo (1 de 6)
name.fr: L'incident Sukuuvestaa – Chopons l'électronique grand public ! (1 sur 6)
name.ja: スクーベスタ事件―家電製品を奪え!（1/6）
name.ru: Инцидент Sukuuvestaa - Захватить потребительскую электронику! (The Sukuuvestaa Incident - Nab The Consumer Electronics!) (1 из 6)
name.zh: 斯库维塔事件—把那些电子产品拿来！(1/6)

messages.en:
I've got a lucrative mission for you this time, {[character]player.name}. I need a convoy taken out and looted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Sounds rather standard, but before you go running off I'd like to explain the situation a bit.

There is a merchant corporation near here, which is basically a small offshoot of the Caldari mega-corporation Sukuuvestaa, who own the vast majority of it's shares. These Sukuuvestaa merchants like to transport all sorts of goods throughout the {[location]agentRegionID.name} region, and regularly pay tribute to us for protection. But sadly sometimes their cargo is simply too enticing.

This convoy is loaded with Caldari consumer electronics, and only guarded with the standard Sukuuvestaa hired mercenary ships, as the Caldari Navy do not frequent these parts. You can't imagine how eager some of the people in these parts are at getting these things. And the price they are willing to pay ... well, it's something that we simply can't pass up so easily. For that reason I want the convoy destroyed and looted, and make sure you are discreet. I don't want any witnesses at the scene to survive, nor any equipment that might record what transpired. As long as the Caldari do not know who attacked their ships, the most they will probably do is send more combat ships with the next convoy.
messages.zh:
我这次帮你揽了个有利可图的活，{[character]player.name}。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一支护航队，我要你除掉他们。听上去似乎和平常没什么两样，不过别急着走，让我把事情的原委告诉你。

这附近有一家商团，本质上是加达里超级集团斯库维塔的一个分公司，斯库维塔持有其大多数股份。这些斯库维塔商人常常在{[location]agentRegionID.name}星域运送各种商品，并且定期向我们进贡来换取保护。可惜的是，有时他们的货物实在太诱人了。

这次的任务一定合你胃口，{[character]player.name}。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一支护航队，帮我把他们的货物抢到手。听上去和平常没什么两样？别急着走，我把事情的原委告诉你。

那里附近有一个企业，算是加达里商业巨头斯库维塔的一个分公司吧，因为斯库维塔持有它大多数的股份。这些商人喜欢在{[location]agentRegionID.name}星系运送各种商品，并且定期向我们进贡来换取保护。可惜的是，有时候他们的货物太诱人了。

这支舰队运送的是加达里消费级电器，只有普通的斯库维塔佣兵护航，因为加达里海军不是经常来这地区。你绝对无法想象这里的人有多么渴望得到这些东西，他们肯支付的价钱嘛……总而言之，我们不能轻易放过这块嘴边的肥肉。去消灭他们，并把货物带回来。谨慎点，我不希望有任何幸存者，也不希望有什么摄像头，黑匣子之类的把你的行动记录下来。只要加达里查不出袭击者的身份，他们唯一能做的就只是下次派遣更多的护航飞船。

name.en: The Sukuuvestaa Incident - The Neophyte (2 of 6)
name.es: El incidente Sukuuvestaa: La neófita (2 de 6)
name.ja: スクーベスタ事件―改宗者（2/6）
name.ru: Инцидент Sukuuvestaa - Neophyte (The Sukuuvestaa Incident - The Neophyte) (2 из 6)
name.zh: 斯库维塔事件—新醇岩矿(2/6)

messages.en:
Greetings, {[character]player.name}. Because of the success in your previous mission, my superiors have one extra task for you. The Sukuuvestaa seem to be completely oblivious as to who attacked their last convoy through this area, and have accepted their loss as merely a freak occurrence. A most fortunate turn of events for us, but there is just one more target that we simply cannot let pass through our grasp. Our cargo scanners in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} spotted some extremely expensive material in one of the latest Sukuuvestaa convoys traveling through {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. We simply must get our hands on that Neophyte, I don't care how many ships it takes. Just do it.

I'll supply you with a bookmark to the current location of the convoy. It seems to have stopped in a deadspace area in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, perhaps for repairs. Strike it hard and fast with everything you got, and bring me that Neophyte! Don't bother showing your face back here before the task is complete!
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}。由于你在上次任务中的精彩表现，我的上级想安排你一个额外的差事。斯库维塔对上次的袭击事件全然不觉，仅仅将其视为一次反常事件。这是我们的运气，不过还有一个目标也不能放过。安置在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的货仓扫描仪显示，最近通过{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的斯库维塔护航队携带了一些非常非常值钱的物资。不管花多大的代价我们都要弄到那片新醇岩矿。放手去干！

我会把他们目前的位标上传给你。他们似乎在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的死亡空间里停了下来，大概是为了进行维修吧。发动快速袭击，干掉所有的人，把那块新醇岩矿抢到手！不完成任务就别回来见我！

messages.en: Interesting. This was all a trap set up by the Sukuuvestaa to find out who was behind the attack on the consumer electronics convoy earlier. Well, it was worth it. This piece of Neophyte will fetch us a fortune! And of course we have you, {[character]player.name}, to deal with any Caldari Navy threat that might materialize as a result. And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 真是有趣。这全是斯库维塔设置的圈套，想要查出谁策划了之前对消费电子产品护航队的袭击。算了，这一切都值。这块新醇岩矿能让我们发大财！当然了，我们还有你，{[character]player.name}。如果加达里海军的威胁真的成为现实，你都能帮我们打发了。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

name.ja: スクーベスタ事件―移送（3/6）
name.ru: Инцидент Sukuuvestaa - транспортировка (The Sukuuvestaa Incident - Transportation) (3 из 6)

messages.en:
Now that we have the Neophyte, I need it transported to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Don't ask why, just do it.

Watch out for any Navy vessels on the way. Now that they know who was behind the latest heist, they're bound to be on the lookout for any ship loyal to {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}.
messages.zh:
现在我们有了新醇岩矿，我要它被立刻转移到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。别问为什么，去做就是了。

小心沿途的海军船只。现在他们已经知道谁策划了最近的行动，他们一定会密切注视任何忠于{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}的船只。

name.en: The Sukuuvestaa Incident - In Defense (4 of 6)
name.ja: スクーベスタ事件―防護（4/6）
name.ru: Инцидент Sukuuvestaa - в обороне (The Sukuuvestaa Incident - In Defense) (4 из 6)
name.zh: 斯库维塔事件—防御姿态(4/6)

messages.en:
I have an urgent task for you this time, {[character]player.name}. The Caldari Navy have started a campaign of revenge attacks on our assets here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. They don't have the manpower to launch a full scale assault on us, but they do have various agents here and there setting up booby traps for our ships. This escapade is becoming a tad expensive, so we need to do something before it gets out of hand.

The first thing I want you to do is fly to one of our supply depots in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The Caldari have set up a trap there for any incoming ships, which has already cost us a fortune. Destroy the Caldari forces manning the guns, then report back to me. And stay away from our supply depot, they don't take kindly to un-invited visitors, ally or not.
messages.zh:
这个任务很紧急，{[character]player.name}。加达里海军对我们在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的产业开始了报复性攻击。虽然海军没有足够的人手发动一次全面进攻，不过这一区域潜伏着很多加达里特工，他们针对我方船只设置的陷阱让我非常头痛。在事态失控之前我们必须做点什么。

你要做的第一件事是飞去我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的补给基地。加达里在那里设置了一个针对往来飞船的陷阱，我们的不少船都吃了亏。消灭操纵炮台的加达里武装力量，然后回来向我报告。别太靠近补给基地，他们会主动攻击任何试图接近的不速之客。

messages.en: Good work, that should put a dent in their plans.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 做得好，那应该会沉重打击他们的计划。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

name.en: The Sukuuvestaa Incident - The Caldari Agent (5 of 6)
name.es: El incidente Sukuuvestaa: El agente caldari (5 de 6)
name.ja: スクーベスタ事件―カルダリ諜報員（5/6）
name.ru: Инцидент Sukuuvestaa - агент Caldari (The Sukuuvestaa Incident - The Caldari Agent) (5 из 6)
name.zh: 斯库维塔事件—加达里执事(5/6)

messages.en:
The Caldari Navy continue to harass us. They are famous for overreacting when it comes to minor incidents involving their fellow corporations. But I'm confident this will die down after you have completed your next mission.

The Caldari have sent a high profile agent of theirs, Whelan Machorin into {[location]agentConstellationID.name} to conduct a campaign of terror against our people. He must be stopped, at all costs. Kill him and bring me his head, which I will have stuck on a stake for all our men to view at their pleasure.
messages.zh:
加达里海军仍在骚扰我们。这群家伙喜欢小题大做是出了名的，凡是牵扯上他们集团的事情，哪怕再小，他们也总是反应强烈。不过我敢肯定，一旦你完成了下个任务，这事就会平息。

加达里海军派了一名行事高调的特工维兰•马克林到{[location]agentConstellationID.name}来指导针对我们人民的一系列恐怖行动。必须不惜一切代价阻止他。干掉他，带他的头回来见我，我要把它定在桩子上，让我们的人民尽情观赏。

messages.en:
The Caldari Navy continue to harass us. They are famous for overreacting when it comes to minor incidents involving their fellow corporations. But I'm confident this will die down after you have completed your next mission.

The Caldari have sent a high profile agent of theirs, Whelan Machorin into {[location]agentConstellationID.name} to conduct a campaign of terror against our people. He must be stopped, at all costs. Kill him and bring me his head, which I will have stuck on a stake for all our men to view at their pleasure.
messages.zh:
加达里海军依然在骚扰我们。这群家伙的脾气一直这么大，一旦有冲突涉及他们的盟友，哪怕是鸡毛蒜皮的事，他们的反应也非常强烈。但我确信一旦你完成了下个任务，他们会安分很多。

加达里海军派遣了一个高调的特工，维兰•马克林到{[location]agentConstellationID.name}，来指挥一场针对我们人民的恐怖行动。不惜任何代价都要阻止这一行动。找到他，提着他的头回来见我，我要把它定在桩子上，让我们的兄弟高兴一下。

name.en: The Sukuuvestaa Incident - The Constellation Scanner (6 of 6)
name.es: El incidente Sukuuvestaa: Escáner de constelaciones (6 de 6)
name.fr: L'incident Sukuuvestaa – Le scanner de la constellation (6 sur 6)
name.ja: スクーベスタ事件―コンステレーションスキャナー（6/6）
name.ru: Инцидент Sukuuvestaa - звездный сканер (The Sukuuvestaa Incident - The Constellation Scanner) (6 из 6)
name.zh: 斯库维塔事件—星座扫描仪(6/6)

messages.en:
From data we've collected, the Caldari Navy forces have set up some kind of constellation scanner in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} to monitor our activities in preparation for a sneak attack. We believe this is what has allowed them to use their small force in these areas so effectively. This also allows them to more effectively monitor the movements of the Caldari convoys flying through here and respond faster to any attacks.

I want you to destroy this high-tech telescope of theirs. It will be heavily guarded, so this is no small task for even you, {[character]player.name}. Once you have completed your mission, we will have dealt a devastating blow to the Caldari Navy plans in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, which I doubt they will recover from anytime soon.
messages.zh:
根据我们收集的资料，加达里海军在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}设置了某种星座扫描仪来监视我们的行动，为发动突袭做准备。我们相信这就是他们能如此高效地运用那一小支部队的关键所在。借助扫描仪，他们还能更有效地监控加达里运输队飞经这里时的情况，并对任何攻击作出更快反应。

我要你去摧毁他们这架高科技望远镜。那里一定守卫森严，即使对你来说也非轻而易举，{[character]player.name}。一旦你完成任务，加达里海军在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的计划必将遭受重创，并且在短时间之内肯定难以恢复。

Once you have completed your mission, we will have dealt a devastating blow to the Caldari Navy plans in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, which I doubt they will recover from anytime soon.
messages.zh:
根据我们收集的资料，加达里海军在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}布置了某种星座扫描仪来监视我们的行动，准备发动突袭。我想这就是他们能灵活运用少数部队的关键。借助扫描仪，他们能更有效地监控本国护航队的情况，并对我们的攻击迅速作出反应。

去摧毁这些高科技望远镜。那里一定守卫森严，即使是你也得小心应付，{[character]player.name}。一旦任务成功，对加达里海军在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的部署是一次重大打击，我想他们得过好一阵子才能恢复元气。

name.ja: リチュラリストの襲撃

messages.en: Not a problem, I'll take care of it.
messages.zh: 没问题，我会搞定的。

messages.en: Make haste, before they kill even more innocents!
messages.zh: 快一点！在更多无辜者牺牲之前阻止他们！

messages.en:
We have a problem, for the past few weeks the Blood Raiders have been growing increasingly aggressive. They seem to have set up a small base nearby and every few days our convoys, miners and even military personnel get attacked. This structure also serves as sacrificial grounds for the Covenant and they believe it to be holy, hence extremely tight security.

My superiors told me to find somebody competent to deal with the threat, and that's why I'm asking you. I suggest you find someone to help you with this, as I fear you will not return should you go alone.
messages.zh:
现在有个麻烦，在过去几个星期里，血袭者变得越来越嚣张。他们在附近建立了一个小型基地，从那儿隔三岔五地向我们的护航队、采矿船甚至正规军发起袭击。那里还被血袭者同盟奉为祭典圣地，因此守卫格外严密。

上级让我找一些骁勇善战的人来应付这一危机，所以我请你帮忙。我建议你找一些帮手。要是你孤身前往，恐怕有去无回。

messages.en: I'm not risking myself for that.
messages.zh: 我不想冒那个险。

name.ja: 流浪民-望まれない移住者（1/5）
name.ru: Кочевники - нежелательные поселенцы (Nomads - Unwanted Settlers) (1 из 5)

messages.en:
I have an assignment for you this time that you'll probably enjoy, {[character]player.name}. Some of our fighters recently stumbled upon a rogue settlement in a cluttering of asteroids in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. The settlers are of Minmatar origin, and apparently are here to steal some of our precious arkonor ore. We can't have that, now can we ...

You have been entrusted with the task of eliminating these pests. We know that they have a small militia guarding their fledgling colony, but that should be no trouble for an experienced vet as yourself.

Once you have destroyed the settlement, capture any survivors and bring them to me. They'll fetch us a decent price on the black market, alive or dead.
messages.zh:
这次我有个你会乐意做的任务，{[character]player.name}。我们的一些战船最近在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的小行星群中偶然发现了一些自由殖民地。居住者都是米玛塔尔人，显然是到这儿来偷我们珍贵的艾克诺岩的。这事我们决不能容忍，不是吗……

我想委托你来完成消灭这些害虫的任务。我们知道有一小队军队守护着那座羽翼未丰的殖民地，但对你这样经验丰富的老兵而言完全不成问题。

摧毁这个殖民地后，把活下来的人都抓回来给

messages.en: Hmmph, the prisoners you captured look a bit scrawny to me.  I guess they must have evacuated the old and young first, which seem to be the only ones who survived the destruction of their colony.  We'll have to make due ... but this is a slight disappointment nonetheless.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 哼，你抓来的囚犯看起来有点瘦弱。我猜测他们一定首先疏散了老人和小孩，其他人似乎都在他们殖民地的毁灭中丧生了。我们就得将就了……不过这还是有点令人失望。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en:
I have an assignment for you this time that you'll probably enjoy, {[character]player.name}. Some of our fighters recently stumbled upon a rogue settlement in a cluttering of asteroids in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. The settlers are of Minmatar origin, and apparently are here to steal some of our precious arkonor ore. We can't have that, now can we ...

You have been entrusted with the task of eliminating these pests. We know that they have a small militia guarding their fledgling colony, but that should be no trouble for an experienced vet as yourself.

Once you have destroyed the settlement, capture any survivors and bring them to me. They'll fetch us a decent price on the black market, alive or dead.
messages.zh:
这次我有一个你会感兴趣的任务，{[character]player.name} 。我们的一些战船最近在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的小行星群中偶然发现了一个米玛塔尔矿冶据点。很明显他们到这儿来偷盗我们珍贵的艾克诺岩。我们不能容忍有这样的事发生，现在我们该……

不介意的话，我想请你去摧毁这个据点。共和国派了一支民兵队伍在那儿守卫，但对你这样有实战经验丰富的战士而言不会有太大的麻烦。

一旦摧毁了这个据点，抓获任何幸存者，都带回来，在黑市上无论死活都能卖个好价钱。

name.en: Nomads - Request From The Republic (2 of 5)
name.es: Nómadas: Petición de la República (2 de 5)
name.fr: Nomades – Demande de la République (2 sur 5)
name.ja: 流浪民-共和国からの要求（2/5）
name.ru: Кочевники - запрос от Республики (Nomads - Request From The Republic) (2 из 5)
name.zh: 流浪者—来自共和国的请求(2/5)

messages.en: We have been informed by agents of the Minmatar Republic that they have sent an encoded data disc to {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, with information that must be transported to our leaders at all cost.  I have personally taken it upon me to investigate this information, and I'd like you to get the disc for me.  A simple task, just don't lose it on your way back, or I'll have your head delivered to me on a silver platter!  Understand?!
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔共和国的特工通知我们，他们已将一张加密数据盘发往{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}，盘上的信息无论如何都必须送到我们领袖手里。我主动接下了调查这些信息的任务，我希望你能帮我把数据盘取回来。这个任务很简单，只是别把盘在路上弄丢了，否则我会叫人切下你的脑袋！懂了吗？！

messages.en: Good work.  I'll take a look at the disc's contents immediately.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得好。我会立刻查看一下数据盘的内容。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en: We have been informed by agents of the Minmatar Republic that they have sent an encoded data disc to {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, with information that must be transported to our leaders at all cost.  I have personally taken it upon me to investigate this information, and I'd like you to get the disc for me.  A simple task, just don't lose it on your way back, or I'll have your head delivered to me on a silver platter!  Understand?!
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔共和国的特工告诉我们，他们把一个密码盘寄送到了{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}，并且嘱咐要不惜一切代价把里面的信息带给我们的领袖。我被任命解密数据，所以希望你能跑一趟帮我把密码盘取回来。这个任务很简单，别出岔子，不然小心你的脑袋！懂了么？

name.ja: 流浪民-秘密の軍需物資（3/5）
name.ru: Кочевники - тайные военные поставки (Nomads - Secret Military Supplies) (3 из 5)

messages.en:
After decyphering the data disc, we learned that the Minmatar Republic have issued a direct threat against us in retaliation for our attack on the colony in a recent mission of yours, {[character]player.name}. They claim there will be dire consequences if we do not hand over the prisoners you captured. Unfortunately I've already had these prisoners executed and either turned into biomass or sold their organs, so we have no option but to decline their request.

Now we have to prepare for their attack. Reports have indicated that 3 Fleet squadrons have entered our territory, probably heading to where they believe the captives are being held. We must prevent them from reaching their destination in full force.

One of our spies alerted us to an old secret military installation in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, guarded by Minmatar ships, which contains a large stockpile of weapons and ship modules. Apparently this was normally used by Minmatar Freedom Fighters to resupply their fighter ships after successfull attacks against our slave pens and drug convoys. This armory of theirs must be destroyed, before they can utilize it in their military offensive. Do this for me and you shall be well rewarded.
messages.zh:
在对数据磁盘解密之后，我们获悉米玛塔尔共和国已对我们发出直接威胁声明，这是为了报复我们对其殖民地的袭击——就是在最近一项由你执行的任务中，{[character]player.name}。他们声称，如果我们不交出你抓获的囚犯，将会产生可怕后果。不幸的是，我已经将那些囚犯处决了，不是将他们转化为生物体，就是变卖了他们的器官，所以我们别无选择，只能拒绝他们的要求。

现在我们必须为他们的进攻做准备。报告显示，有三支舰船中队已进入我们领地，可能正朝着他们认为关押囚犯的地方飞行。我们必须阻止他们大批到达目的地。

messages.en: The destruction of the Minmatar armory should be a serious blow for any long-term military offensive in the area.  Keep up the good work, {[character]player.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔军械库的被毁应该会在今后较长时间内严重阻碍他们在这个区域的军事行动。保持这种良好的工作状态，{[character]player.name}。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

name.ru: Кочевники - яростная атака (Nomads - Vicious attack) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
Your last attack on the Minmatar armory seems to have missed one of the targets that I hoped would be there. Yaekun Ogdin is a long-time enemy of ours, and self proclaimed 'freedom fighter'. His vicious attacks on our slave traders has resulted in a huge loss of revenue. To top it off, he obliterated at least five of our major drug convoys in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} in retaliation for our attack on the Minmatar settlement.

I have coordinates to Yaekun's other hideout, in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. If you find him there, show no mercy.
messages.zh:
你上次对米玛塔尔军械库的攻击似乎遗漏了一个目标，我本来希望他也会在那出现。耶昆•欧丁是我们的宿敌，自诩为“自由战士”。他对我们劳工商船的攻击造成了巨额收益损失。最过分的是，为了报复我们对米玛塔尔殖民地的袭击，他至少摧毁了五支我们在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}里的主要药剂护航队。

我有耶昆的另一个藏身地的坐标，就在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的一个死亡空间层。如果你在那找到他的话，不要手

name.ja: 流浪民-ミンマタースクアッド（5/5）
name.ru: Кочевники - эскадрильи Minmatar (Nomads - The Minmatar Squadrons) (5 из 5)

messages.en: I will take care of these Minmatar dogs, you have my word {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我会消灭这些米玛塔尔臭狗的，{[character]agentID.name}，我保证。

messages.en: I like your enthusiasm, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我喜欢的积极性，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
The Minmatar squadrons have arrived in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, and they mean business. We've been avoiding them thus far, but we can't ignore the threat they pose any longer. We aren't aware of their destination, but our spies have managed to locate them in a remote deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. Apparently they've been moving through deadspace to escape detection and our long-range artillery, although it would be foolish of them to expect to remain completely undetected in our backyard.

There is not much that I can tell you about their forces, other than the fact their commander is a seasoned veteran of the Minmatar Fleet. I am not familiar with their combat ability, and therefore I would advise you to hit them with everything you have. Do not underestimate them, bring everyone you can muster with you. This is no small task, even for you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔中队已经到达{[location]agentConstellationID.name}，他们都是动真格的。这么久以来我们一直避免与他们冲突，但现在再不能忽视他们所形成的威胁了。我们不清楚他们的目的地，但我们的侦察机发现他们位于{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}内的一个边远死亡空间层。显然，他们一直在死亡空间层中穿行以期躲过探测和远程大炮的攻击，但他们竟然以为能在我们的后院里神不知鬼不觉地行动，实在太蠢了。

关于他们的军队情况，我

messages.en:
You never cease to amaze me, {[character]player.name}. This victory of yours will send a powerful message to the Republic, their Fleet has no business in these parts. As long as we can keep our territory free of military threat, our people will prosper.

I bid you farewell, I have no need of further assistance ... for the time being.
messages.zh:
你总能给我惊喜，{[character]player.name}。你的胜利向米玛塔尔共和国发出了一条强有力的信息，让他们的舰队少来打这里的主意。只要我们让这块领地不受到军事威胁，我们的人民就能富足昌盛。

再会了，我不再需要援助了……至少目前如此。

name.ja: 侵入されたアウトポスト

messages.en:
It's those damned rogue drones again! They never seem to get enough!
This time it's big. Two of our main mining facilities in the system have been completely overrun by rogue drones. If you can go clear them out we can save some of the miners and perhaps even the facilities themselves. Please don't fail me on this one. Those facilities provide a large portion of both our incomes and it would be a big loss to both of us if they were lost
messages.zh:
又是那些可恶的自由无人机！有完没完！

这次无人机的规模很大。我们星系中有两个主要采矿设施已经被完全毁坏。如果你能及时去清除它们，或许还能挽救一些采矿船，甚至是采矿设施。这次不容许失败，那些设施是我们收入的重要来源，失去它们对你我都是巨大损失。

name.de: Der Traum eines verrückten Wissenschaftlers - Bezahlung (1 von 5)
name.en: A Mad Scientist's Dream - Payment (1 of 5)
name.es: Sueño de un científico loco: Pago (1 de 5)
name.fr: Le rêve d'un savant fou - Paiement (1 sur 5)
name.ja: マッドサイエンティストの夢-報酬（1/5）
name.ru: Мечта сумасшедшего ученого - плата (A Mad Scientist's Dream - Payment) (1 из 5)

messages.en: Oh, and if you're on time, I might even give you some ISK for your troubles!
messages.zh: 哦，如果你准时到达的话，我会额外支付你一些星币。

messages.en:
Good of you to stop by, {[character]player.name}! And you couldn't have chosen a better time to show up ― I've got some things that need to be taken care of, and you seem like the perfect pilot for the job.

It has been my goal for the past two decades to terraform this beautiful planet, Otomainen V, which we locals call Oshuron. Its temperature is extremely hostile to human life at present, but I believe its position in the solar system and its abundant supply of frozen H20 and CO2 makes it perfect for terraforming. I've even come to the conclusion that scientists residing in this once prosperous community here, in Rush Town, had plans to start the terraforming themselves, but never got around to it before the exodus.

To start the process, I need to acquire a form of extremely simple microorganism that has the ability to survive the terrible conditions on the icy planet. I've located a number of hot springs far beneath the surface that are ideal for harvesting microorganisms, and I believe they will eventually cause a chain reaction on the planet that will lead to a thickening of the atmosphere and thence to global warming.

Now, I´m sure you´re thinking, "Where do I fit into your marvelous scheme?" Well, all I need you to do is bring this stack of sealed containers, filled with old goods I scavenged from the ruins in the area, to an acquaintance of mine at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. Once that task is complete, I will receive a passcard to a stash of viral agents that have been genetically modified to withstand extreme temperatures, which is exactly what I need to start the terraformation process. But enough of that.

Finish your first task and then I will tell you what to do next. Just don't lose the passcard!!
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}你来得太巧了。我刚好有一些东西要找人运送，而你是最佳人选。

在过去的二十年里，我们一直想将这个叫做欧塔迈伦V的美丽星球改造成适合我们生存的地方，我们这里的人都管它叫欧树荣。虽然它的温度非常不适合居住，但其在太阳系中优越的地理位置以及丰富的固态水和二氧化碳资源使它具有很大的适生改造价值。我甚至可以断定，在奔走城这个曾繁华一时的社区里居住过的科学家都设想过对那里进行适生改造，但是在大迁徙之前这个愿望都没有实现。

这个计划中最关键的一环是能否找到一种简单的微生物，能在这个冰冷星球的恶劣环境中生存。我已经定位了一些地表深处的温泉，那里是获取微生物的理想地。我相信它们最终可以在星球上形成良性循环，厚化大气层，使全球变暖。

我猜你一定会问我：“我在你的宏伟计划中能做什么？”很简单，你的任务就是将这堆密封的容器带到{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}我的一个熟人手里，里面装的是我从这个地区废墟里搜寻的旧货，已修缮一新。完成这个任务以后，我就可以得到去病原体秘密存放点的通行卡。这些病毒通过转基因技术改造，能适应极端的温度，正是我进行适生改造所需的。

就到这吧，第一个任务完成以后我再告诉你下一步你要做的。不要遗失那张通行卡！

messages.en: Excellent! Now make sure you have Tsuna's passcard in your possession before your next assignment. You'll need it.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！继续下个任务之前，确保你带上了兹纳的通行卡。你会需要它的。

name.de: Der Traum eines verrückten Wissenschaftlers - Simple Mikroorganismen (2 von 5)
name.en: A Mad Scientist's Dream - Simple Microorganisms (2 of 5)
name.es: Sueño de un científico loco: Microorganismos simples (2 de 5)
name.fr: Le rêve d'un savant fou - De simples micro-organismes (2 sur 5)
name.ja: マッドサイエンティストの夢-単細胞生物（2/5）
name.ru: Мечта сумасшедшего ученого — простейшие микроорганизмы (A Mad Scientist's Dream - Simple Microorganisms) (2 из 5)
name.zh: 科学狂想曲—简单微生物 (2/5)

messages.en:
Alright, now that we have the passcard, it's time to get the goods. The viral agents that I need are located in a small secluded area near our moon, guarded by Mordu's ships. The Legionnaires were hired by Tsuna Qayse, an obnoxiously wealthy Caldari State citizen who happens to be a major shareholder in the Nugoeihuvi Corporation. She hired the mercenaries to protect her assets, which include the viral agents you are to retrieve for me. My source within the Mordu's Legion ― the same person who provided us with the passcard ― tells me Qayse intends to sell the viral agents on the black market. Unfortunately I don't have the kind of money she's asking for, but that's where you come in.

I want you to fly to her compound in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} and retrieve the stash. You might encounter some resistance from Mordu's guards within the complex, but just try avoiding any direct confrontation. The viral agents are located in a secure location within a high-tech science laboratory in the first area of the complex. The passcard will get you through the acceleration gate.

When you find the science labs, destroy them and retrieve the viral agents. They won't be harmed in the explosion, as they are protected by a safety evacuation system, according to my source. Find the ejected container after the labs have been obliterated, and grab them. Bring them back to me immediately, and just ignore the Legionnaires who may attack you as you attempt to destroy the science labs. Sounds simple, doesn't it!?

You'll be well rewarded for your efforts.
messages.zh:
终于有了通行卡，是时候去拿货了。我需要的病原体被存放在我们卫星附近的某个小型隐蔽区内，那里由莫德飞船守护着。兹纳•凯撒雇了这些士兵，这个讨厌的加达里爆发户，恰好也是纳基维公司的主要股东。这些士兵被雇来守护她的财产，当然，也包括我要的病原体。莫德团的眼线，也就是给我们通行卡的人，告诉我她打算在黑市上出售这些病原体。我可不想多花冤枉钱，所以我找到了你，相信你一定能帮我。

我要你去她在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的私人属地，把藏在那儿的东西带回来。如果遭遇莫德佣兵的抵抗，尽量避免与之正面交火。病原体被存放在复合体第一区域的一个高科技科学实验室里。通行卡可以让你通过加速轨道轻松进入那里。

在你找到科学实验室后，将其摧毁，然后把毒剂带回来。据可靠消息，病原体由一种安全撤离系统保护，所以不会在爆炸中损坏。摧毁实验室后，在病原体存放的位置找到弹出的集装箱，病原体就在里面。尽快把它带回来给我，注意，在你试图摧毁科学实验室时，可能会遭到攻击，不要回击。这听起来并不难吧？在你完成任务后，会得到丰厚的报酬。

messages.en:
Magnificent! I just can't wait to test my theory...!

Now, don't you look at me like that. I never said my plan was foolproof. I've only done, er, preliminary calculations on the effects these viral agents will have on the planet, true ... but it's worth a try! And if this works, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will make a fortune, and maybe I'll be able to redeem myself within the scientific community!

Oh, and don't you leave just yet ― I have another assignment waiting for you.
messages.zh:
漂亮！我已经等不及要测试我的理论了……！

现在，你不要那样看着我。我从没说过我的计划完美无缺。没错，我不过是，呃，对这些病原体将在行星上产生的效果进行了初步计算……不过这值得一试！如果这些有效的话，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}就会大发一笔，而我就可能挽回在科学界的声誉！

噢，先别急着走——我还有另一项任务等着你。

messages.en: Infiltrate Tsuna Qayse's compound in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} and retrieve the potent viral agents, then bring them to {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 潜入兹纳•凯撒在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的私人属地，把病原体带回来给{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Objectives
messages.zh: 目标

She hired the mercenaries to protect her assets, which include the viral agents you are to retrieve for me. My source within the Mordu's Legion ― the same person who provided us with the passcard ― tells me Qayse intends to sell the viral agents on the black market. Unfortunately I don't have the kind of money she's asking for, but that's where you come in.

I want you to fly to her compound in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} and retrieve the stash. name.en: A Mad Scientist's Dream - Transportation (3 of 5)
name.es: Sueño de un científico loco: Transporte (3 de 5)
name.fr: Le rêve d'un savant fou - Transfert (3 sur 5)
name.ja: マッドサイエンティストの夢-輸送（3/5）
name.ru: Мечта сумасшедшего ученого — транспортировка (A Mad Scientist's Dream - Transportation) (3 из 5)

messages.en: I'll get the shuttle here in a jiffy.
messages.zh: 我会很快会将穿梭机带到这里。

messages.en: What else do you need to complete your project, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，完成你的计划还需要其它什么吗？

messages.en:
Wonderful! However, now that I have the viral agents, I need a way to transport them down to the planet's surface. I'd like a small ship, one that´s easy to fly and can maneuver handily in the harsh atmosphere of the planet. A shuttle will do nicely. I only know how to fly the Caldari one, so you'll have to bring me that specific type.

Don't tarry, my life's work depends on this!
messages.zh:
好极了！现在我拿到了病原体，还得想个办法把它们传送到行星表面深处。我需要一艘小型飞船，必须易于飞行并能在行星恶劣的大气下自由操作。穿梭机就可以胜任。我只会驾驶加达里的穿梭机，所以你要帮我弄台那种特定型号的。

别耽搁，我毕生的事业就在此一举！

name.ru: Мечта сумасшедшего ученого - бур (A Mad Scientist's Dream - The Drill) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
Alright, now that I have the shuttle, there's just one more thing I need before I can get started. To infest the hot springs with these microorganisms, I will need to get to them through an enormous ice sheet. The only way to do that is to have an extremely powerful drill. And I know just the place to acquire one. Well, actually, four.

Jorek Lephny is an old mining tycoon who has been operating in the asteroid belts and moon orbiting Otomainen V for quite some time. The old coot has a mining outpost equipped with a hoard of high-tech drilling equipment, among other things. These drills should do the trick for me, but I need at least four of them in case of breakage or malfunction, which is quite likely due to the scope of the task at hand. The only problem is this: Lephny is extremely paranoid, and we had a falling out of sorts a few years back when I, er, borrowed some of his minerals to construct my lab equipment. He has also had to deal with many pirate attacks through the years and, as a consequence, recently hired a seasoned mercenary veteran from the Mordu's Legion to protect his assets. This mercenary operates a battleship, and he might pose some problems for you if Lephny refuses to hand over the drilling parts willingly.

You will find Lephny's mining outpost in a small asteroid belt near here. There is an acceleration gate close by, inside Rush Town, which will send you to it. Once there, use any means necessary to get those drilling parts! They are located inside the mining outpost itself. Good luck.
messages.zh:
好吧，有了穿梭机，我还需要一个东西就能出发了。要用这些病原体微生物感染那片温泉，必须透过一个巨大的冰盖才能办到。所以我得找个超级强力钻。我知道有个地方可以找到一个，甚至可能是四个。

乔瑞克•勒佛尼是一个老资格的矿业大亨，长久以来一直致力于行星带和欧塔迈伦V的卫星上的矿石开采。这个老东西有一个采矿站，里面有了大量高科技钻孔设备，这些设备尤其适用于卫星采矿。这些钻头应该能助我一臂之力，但就眼下的开采难度而言，我至少需要4个备用。问题是勒佛尼是个极端偏执的家伙，几年前我曾向他“借”些矿物来建造我的实验室，那时与他起了不少冲突。那年头他还不得不应付诸多海盗的攻击，所以后来他从莫德团雇了一个老兵来保护他的财产。这个家伙驾驶一艘战列舰，如果勒佛尼不愿将钻头零件拱手相让的话，他也许会给你制造点儿麻烦。

勒佛尼的采矿站就在这附近的一个小型行星带里。在奔走城内部有一个加速轨道通往这个矿站。到那儿以后，无论如何要把钻头零件带回来。它们就在采矿站里。祝你好运！

messages.en: Now that I have the drill parts, it's just a matter of assembling them and getting to work! I can't wait! And don't you leave just yet: I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 既然我有了钻探部件，那么只要把它们组装起来工作就行了！我都等不及了！你先别走：我还有别的任务给你！

messages.en: Use the acceleration gate to get to Lephny's mining outpost and obtain the drill parts. After you've found them, bring them to {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 通过加速轨道到达勒佛尼的采矿哨站，然后找到钻探部件。找到以后，把它们带给{[character]agentID.name}。

name.zh: 科学狂想曲—最后的障碍 (5/5)

messages.en: I hope you know what I meant when I said, "Take care of him"...
messages.zh: 我希望你明白我说“关照”的意思……

messages.en:
I am now on the verge of starting my project, but there is one last hindrance to be eliminated. There is a suspicious-looking craft hovering by a lone rock formation near here. I've tried hailing it, but I get no response. The ship is registered to Ratei Jezzor, whom I have never seen before in these parts. I'm convinced he is an agent working for Caldari Customs, here to spy on us.

I'd like you to take care of him for me, {[character]player.name}. This task will be the last one I give you, I am sure, before I'm on my way into the great annals of history. Just make certain he doesn't bother me when I make my descent to the planet. My life's work depends upon it!

When you finish this final job, you will have done me a great service that I can probably never repay in full. But I hope you'll like my gift ― it's an ultra-rare mineral that I scavenged from one of the ruins here in Rush Town. I have no use for it, but you might.
messages.zh:
在我实施计划前，还剩最后一个障碍必须被扫清。在这附近的一个人迹罕至的岩层带旁出现了一架可疑的飞行器。我试着与之取得联系，但却丝毫没有得到回应。这艘飞船为拉特•杰祖尔所有，但我从来没见他来过这里。他一定在为加达里海关工作，来这儿暗中监视我们的行动。

{[character]player.name}，我要你去好好关照他。这是我最后的要求了，当我翻开行星历史新的一页，写下华采篇章时，不想有人来妨碍我毕生的心血，成败在此一举。

当你完成这最后的任务，你给予我的帮助可能我今生今世都无以为报。但我希望你喜欢我给你的礼物，是一种世间罕有的矿物，是我从奔走城的废墟中找到的。这我用不着，希望对你会有用。

messages.en: Ratei will bother you no more, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，拉特不会再麻烦你了。

messages.en:
Excellent! Now everything is in place for this historic moment. I can just smell the sweet scent of success! Once the icy blue planet has turned green, my pesky colleagues will be forced to admit they were wrong about me.

Nyahahahaaaaa!
messages.zh:
干得漂亮！现在一切就绪，就等待这历史性的时刻来临了。我简直可以闻到胜利的气息！一旦冰蓝的行星变成绿色，那我的那些讨厌的同事就不得不承认他们是错的了。

哦哈哈哈！

messages.en: Destroy Ratei Jezzor's ship and bring his insignia to {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 摧毁拉特•杰祖尔的飞船，将他的勋章带给{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: All right all right, I'll help you out you crazy old coot.
messages.zh: 好吧好吧，老伙计，我会帮你的。

messages.en: Quickly now ... Old Michi can't wait much longer.
messages.zh: 赶快吧……老米茨等不了多久了。

messages.en:
So ... tired. Michi has been holed up here for longer than he can remember ... and he won't leave until his broken heart has been mended ... his lost love must be returned! Old Michi won't rest until he has found the truth! Been digging up these old ruins for years, but her body is nowhere in sight. Dead she is, Old Michi thought. Dead after those blasted Guristas scoundrels attacked the remnants of this once prosperous community. Dead after the metal walls of these beastly stations caved in from the assault.

But then Old Michi stumbles upon an old pirate he remembers from his younger years. A devilish man, who had a fancy for Old Michi's lost love he did. This troublesome pirate scoffed at Old Michi he did, and claimed his lost love was still alive! But reveal her location he did not. Old Michi will pay handsomely for that information. Bring it to Old Michi and you'll make him a happy man!
messages.zh:
太……累了。米茨在这儿蛰居了多久连他自己都记不清了……但在受伤的心灵复原之前他绝不会离开……他失去的爱必须完璧归赵！除非找到真相，否则老米茨绝不罢休！废墟挖了一年又一年，但她的尸体仍然无处可见。她已经死去，老米茨想。古斯塔斯恶棍对这片遗址狂轰滥炸，然后她就死了，死在这曾经繁华一时的地方。怪兽般的空间站在攻击下土崩瓦解，而她就埋葬在这些铜墙铁壁之下。

但后来，老米茨遇上了一个年轻时代见过的老海盗。一个邪恶之徒，曾经垂涎老米茨的爱人。这个讨厌的海盗对老米茨百般嘲弄，还声称他失去的爱人尚在世间。但他没有透露她的行踪。为了知道她的去向，老米茨愿意慷慨解囊。把这消息带给老米茨，你将使他在幸福中徜徉！

messages.en: Ok, I found and destroyed this Guristas goon called Manchura.  He dropped a data chip with some logs stored inside, I hope this will help you in your search.
messages.zh: 好，我找到并消灭了那个叫曼褚拉的古斯塔斯笨蛋。他落下了一块存有日志的数据芯片，我希望这对你的寻找会所有帮助。

messages.en: Old Michi thanks you from the bottom of his heart!  This information should lead straight to lost love!  Please stay and help Old Michi finish his search ...
messages.zh: 老米茨打从心底里感激你！这条信息将直接通向他失去的爱！请留下来帮助老米茨完成搜索……

messages.en: Reports indicate that Manchura was last sighted in the Otomainen system.
messages.zh: 报告显示，最后一次看见曼褚拉是在欧塔迈伦星系。

messages.en: Extra Info
messages.zh: 额外信息

messages.en:
So ... tired. Michi has been holed up here for longer than he can remember ... and he won't leave until his broken heart has been mended ... his lost love must be returned! Old Michi won't rest until he has found the truth! Been digging up these old ruins for years, but her body is nowhere in sight. Dead she is, Old Michi thought. Dead after those blasted Guristas scoundrels attacked the remnants of this once prosperous community. Dead after the metal walls of these beastly stations caved in from the assault.

But then Old Michi stumbles upon an old pirate, in the Guristas stronghold of Otomainen, that he remembers from his younger years. A devilish man, who had a fancy for Old Michi's lost love he did. This troublesome pirate scoffed at Old Michi he did, and claimed his lost love was still alive! But reveal her location he did not. Old Michi will pay handsomely for that information. Bring it to Old Michi and you'll make him a happy man!
