但后来，老米茨在古斯塔斯的欧塔迈伦要塞遇上了一个年轻时代见过的老海盗。一个邪恶之徒，曾经垂涎老米茨的爱人。这个讨厌的海盗对老米茨百般嘲弄，还声称他失去的爱人尚在世间。但他没有透露她的行踪。为了知道她的去向，老米茨愿意慷慨解囊。把这消息带给老米茨，你将使他在幸福中徜徉！

name.ja: 失われた愛-ウェイトドキ（2/3）
name.ru: Потерянная любовь - Wei Todaki (Lost Love - Wei Todaki) (2 из 3)

messages.en: Michi very thankful for your willingness to help ... very thankful indeed.
messages.zh: 米茨非常感谢你积极的帮助……真的非常感谢。

messages.en: Now that Old Michi has the location of his lost love, {[character]player.name} needs to find her! ... Wei was the light of Michi's life, back when he had a reason to live ... she was the cornerstone of his existance ... lost so long ago.  But now he has a chance of regaining that precious lost love, and reclaiming what was lost to him so long ago ... the logs you retrieved indicate that she is being held prisoner at a Guristas base in an asteroid belt in this very system ... you must find her, and bring her back to Old Michi.  Do this quickly, the end draws near for poor Michi ...
messages.zh: 老米茨知道了失去爱人所在的地方，{[character]player.name}需要前去将她寻找！……薇是米茨的生命之光，曾经是他生存的理由……她是他存在的基石……他却很久以前将她丢失。但他现在等到良机，可重拾失落的宝贵爱情，挽救很久以前的损失……你取回的日志显示，她被囚在一个古斯塔斯基地之中，就在这个系统的某个小行星带中……你必须找到她，把她重新带到老米茨这来。赶快去做吧，可怜的米茨时日无多了……

messages.en: I found Wei.  Now where's my money, you old coot?
messages.zh: 我找到了薇。我的钱呢，你个老傻瓜？

messages.en: Michi is eternally grateful to {[character]player.name} for completing such a difficult task!  Wei seems shocked at meeting Michi after so long, but he is sure that she will come to appreciate him before long.  Michi is a happy man indeed!  Take your reward, you've earned it!
messages.zh: 你完成了这么难的任务，米茨会永远感激你的，{[character]player.name}！与米茨久别重逢，薇似乎很震惊；但他确信她很快就会感激他的。米茨真是个幸福的男人！拿好你的奖励，这是你应得的！

messages.en: Now that Old Michi has the location of his lost love, {[character]player.name} needs to find her! ... Wei was the light of Michi's life, back when he had a reason to live ... she was the cornerstone of his existance ... lost so long ago.  But now he has a chance of regaining that precious lost love, and reclaiming what was lost to him so long ago ... the logs you retrieved indicate that she is being held prisoner at a Guristas base in an asteroid belt in this very system ... you must find her, and bring her back to Old Michi.  Do this quickly, the end draws near for poor Michi ...
messages.zh: 老米茨知道了失去爱人所在的地方，{[character]player.name}需要前去将她寻找！……薇是米茨的生命之光，曾经是他生存的理由……她是他存在的基石……他却很久以前将她丢失。但他现在等到良机，可重拾失落的宝贵爱情，挽救很久以前的损失……你取回的日志显示，她被囚在一个古斯塔斯基地之中，就在这个系统的某个小行星带中……你必须找到她，把她重新带到老米茨这来。赶快去做吧，可怜的米茨时日无多了……

name.es: Amor perdido: Lavado de cerebro (3 de 3)
name.fr: L'amour perdu – Lavage de cerveau (3 sur 3)
name.ru: Потерянная любовь - промывание мозгов (Lost Love - Brain Washed) (3 из 3)

messages.en: Michi will visit Wei from time to time, don't worry!  She will be well taken care of, and hopefully someday regain her happiness.
messages.zh: 米茨会不时去看望薇的，别担心！她会被照顾得很好，相信总有一天，久违的笑容会重新在她脸上绽放。

messages.en: Now that Michi and Wei have been reunited at long last, Michi has some worries ... Wei seems to have been brain washed by the Guristas scoundrels, she even thinks Michi is crazy!  Wei needs to come to her senses, and Michi has lost all hope of convincing her himself.  Therefore Old Michi has one final task for {[character]player.name} ... bring Wei to an old acquaintance of Michi ... this acquaintance runs a health clinic on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Bring Wei there and she will be taken care of, until her health problems have been dealt with ... do this for Michi and you shall be generously rewarded.
messages.zh: 米茨和薇终于久别重逢，但米茨还有担忧……薇似乎被古斯塔斯恶棍洗脑，她甚至认为米茨很疯狂！薇需要恢复神智，但米茨失去了独自将她唤醒的希望。因此老米茨还有最后一项任务给{[character]player.name}……把薇带到米茨的一位老朋友那……他在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}开办了一家健康诊所。把薇带到那去，她会得到照顾，直到她的健康恢复……替米茨办这件事吧，你会得到丰厚的奖赏。

messages.en: I've delivered the woman to the health clinic like you asked.  She seemed pretty worked up over this whole ordeal, as if she was being held against her will, but that's none of my business.  Now hand over the reward, before I get too trigger happy.
messages.zh: 我已照你的要求把那个女人送到了健康诊所。她看起来很不高兴，好像整件事都违背了她的意愿。但这不关我的事。在我脾气变得暴躁之前，赶紧把报酬给我。

messages.en: Michi is eternally grateful for your services, which can never be repaid in full ... Wei unfortunately has fallen into a deep depression, but Michi is sure she will recover ... time will heal old wounds ...
messages.zh: 米茨永远不会忘记你的大恩大德，她永远也无法完全报答你……虽然薇似乎得了严重的抑郁症，但米茨相信有朝一日她一定能摆脱这种情绪障碍……时间能治愈旧伤……

messages.en: Now that Michi and Wei have been reunited at long last, Michi has some worries ... Wei seems to have been brain washed by the Guristas scoundrels, she even thinks Michi is crazy!  Wei needs to come to her senses, and Michi has lost all hope of convincing her himself.  Therefore Old Michi has one final task for {[character]player.name} ... bring Wei to an old acquaintance of Michi ... this acquaintance runs a health clinic on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Bring Wei there and she will be taken care of, until her health problems have been dealt with ... do this for Michi and you shall be generously rewarded.
messages.zh: 尽管米茨和韦久别重逢了，但米茨依然非常担心……韦似乎被古斯塔斯歹徒洗过脑，她甚至觉得米茨已经疯了。韦需要时间恢复理智，而米茨无法独自说服她。所以年迈的米茨还有最后一个请求给{[character]player.name}……请将韦送到米茨的一个老熟人那儿……他在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}经营一家健康诊所。将韦带去，在那儿她会受到良好的照顾……帮米茨这个忙吧，你会得到丰厚的报酬。

name.de: Handelssiedler - Bestätigung für Ihre guten Absichten (1 von 5)
name.en: Mercantile Settlers - Confirmation For Your Good Intentions (1 of 5)
name.es: Colonizadores mercantiles: Confirmación de buenas intenciones (1 de 5)
name.fr: Colons du Mercantile Club - Confirmation de bonnes intentions (1 sur 5)
name.ja: 商業移住者-善意の確認（1/5）
name.ru: Меркантильные поселенцы - подтверждение ваших добрых намерений (Mercantile Settlers - Confirmation For Your Good Intentions) (1 из 5)
name.zh: 商业移民—证明你的良好企图 (1/5)

messages.en: I'll acquire the voucher from mr. Ultrainen a.s.a.p..
messages.zh: 我会尽快从尤堂恩先生那里拿到凭证。

messages.en: Well, if you have the voucher, then hand it over!  If not, then get lost.
messages.zh: 如果你有凭证，交给我！要是没有，就给我消失。

messages.en: Who are you?  I sent a request to my colleague, Kochi Utrainen, to find some suitable mercenaries for hire to help us out on a few missions.  If you are interested, I suggest you seek him out first.  I won't deal with anyone who hasn't been approved by Kochi.  Now leave me alone, please.
messages.zh: 你是谁？我已经请我同事考茨·尤堂恩去招些合适的雇佣兵来帮我们完成一些任务。如果你有兴趣，建议你先去找他。我不跟没经过考茨认可的人打交道。现在请让我一个人呆着。

messages.en: I have the voucher, here you go.
messages.zh: 我有凭证了，开始行动吧。

messages.en: Ah so you're not just some low life begging for work, eh.  If Kochi found you acceptable, then I'm sure you're perfectly capable for the missions I have to offer.  Now let's get started ...
messages.zh: 啊，那么你不是那种乞求工作的废物喽。如果考茨觉得你可以，那么我相信你一定能够胜任我的工作。那么我们开始吧……

messages.en: Who are you?  I sent a request to my colleague, Kochi Utrainen, to find some suitable mercenaries for hire to help us out on a few missions.  If you are interested, I suggest you seek him out first.  I won't deal with anyone who hasn't been approved by Kochi.  Now leave me alone, please.
messages.zh: 你是谁？我已经请我同事考茨·尤堂恩去招些合适的雇佣兵来帮我们完成一些任务。如果你有兴趣，建议你先去找他。我不跟没经过考茨认可的人打交道。现在请让我一个人呆着。

name.fr: Colons du Mercantile Club - Jorek Lephny (2 sur 5)
name.ja: 商業移住者-ジョレックレファニー（1/5）
name.ru: Меркантильные поселенцы - Jorek Lephny (Mercantile Settlers - Jorek Lephny) (2 из 5)
name.zh: 商业移民—乔瑞克•勒佛尼 (2/5)

messages.en: Just make sure you don't kill him, {[character]player.name}, if he's alive we will stand a better chance at striking a deal with Markus should he come after him.  We want to avoid a confrontation with that mercenary at all costs.
messages.zh: 记得千万别弄死他，{[character]player.name}。要是马库斯来救他，我们把他作为人质会比较有利。我们要不惜一切代价避免和那支雇佣军正面对抗。

messages.en:
Before you begin I'd like to explain a few things to you, {[character]player.name}. I am {[character]agentID.name}, of the Mercantile Club, which is a prominent corporation within the Caldari State. I came here with a little over 130 other settlers on a project put together by our Chief Operative, Anken Aronainen. Most of the others are miners or engineers, which are here to complete our building project in the area. We are building a small structure which is to serve as the Mercantile Club's headquarters in Otomainen. It is to serve as the meeting place between various State officials of this solarsystem. More you need not know.

The project has just started, but we've run into a few problems already. First of all, it was our intention to use the surrounding asteroid belts as a means to acquire minerals for maintaining our structures, as well as components for building extensions to them once we have imported the neccessary equipment and facilities. The problem is this run-down craphole, which was supposed to be abandoned, apparently has some rather stingy inhabitants. One of them is a crazy old miner called 'Jorek Lephny', who refuses any sort of deal with us to share the vast wealth of asteroids near here, which he claims as his own.

His license ran out ages ago, so we decided to ignore him and mine the area anyway. That's when we encountered his equally insane friend, Markus. Markus is ... or was ... part of Mordu's Legion, and was hired by Lephny who has made quite a fortune since he started strip mining the area. Markus is on a contract for Lephny to protect his assets from random pirate assaults, which I take it he has to deal with on occasion. However, I didn't expect him to attack law abiding citizens of the State ... but I was wrong. He destroyed our Badger and all our mining equipment on board, but allowed the miners to escape on the ejected capsule.

This is of course a treasonous act, and should be dealt with appropriately. I requested military aid from my superiors, but for some reason they would rather I use hired freelance mercenaries to do the job. Something about the legal implications ... anyway here is where you come in. Use one of the stargates in Rush Town to get to the asteroid belt where Lephny is currently stationed at. Find Lephny, and bring him to me. I will make sure he is brought to a mental institution where he belongs. I don't expect you to go up against Markus, he's way too powerful. Once Lephny has been take care of, I'm sure Markus will leave.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，在你开始之前我想先说明一下。我叫{[character]agentID.name}，来自加达里合众国的著名集团商业俱乐部。我和130多名殖民者到此来实施首席运作官安肯•阿诺耐恩构思的一个项目。其余大多数人都是矿工或工程师，负责完成这个区域内的建设计划。我们正在建造一座小型建筑，将用作商业俱乐部在欧塔迈伦的总部。它同时也是本恒星系各合众国官员的会晤场所。余下的你就不必知道了。

这个项目才开始没多久，但我们已经遇到了不少问题。首先，我们原本打算在周围的小行星带开采矿石作为维护建筑的原料；在我们引进了必要的设备和设施之后，这些矿石还能用作建筑扩展部分的原料。问题在于，这个破地方按理应该已经废弃，竟然还住着一些吝啬的居民。其中有个疯狂的老矿工叫“乔瑞克•勒佛尼”，他拒绝与我们达成任何协议来分享这附近小行星的巨大资源财富，还声称这一带都归他所有。<br><br>他的执照过期很久了，所以我们决定不理他，继续开采。这时我们遇到了他同样疯狂的朋友马库斯。马库斯是……或曾经是……莫德团的一员；勒佛尼在这里采矿发了大财，之后就雇佣了马库斯。马库斯与勒佛尼签了合同，要保护他的财产不受海盗攻击——马库斯有时也确实需要应付这些情况。我本以为他不会攻击我们这些遵纪守法的合众国公民……但是我错了。他摧毁了我们的“獾”级飞船以及船上所有的采矿设备，只让矿工坐着逃生舱逃离。<br><br>这当然是叛国行为，需要受到合理处置。我向上级寻求过军事援助，但出于某些原因，他们更希望我聘请些自由雇佣兵来干这活。可能是涉及到一些法律问题……不管怎样，这就用得着你了。使用奔走城的一座星门前往勒佛尼目前所在的小行星带。找到勒佛尼，把他带给我。我要把他送去精神病医院，那里才是他该待的地方。我不要求你直接与马库斯交手，他太强大了。一旦抓获了勒佛尼，我相信马库斯也会离开。

messages.en: Back already?  That was fast.  Maybe Kochi was right about your abilities as a pilot after all.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 已经回来了？好快啊。也许考茨对你飞行员技能的判断确实是正确的。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

{[character]player.name}，在你开始之前我想先说明一下。我叫{[character]agentID.name}，来自加达里合众国的著名集团商业俱乐部。我和130多名殖民者到此来实施首席运作官安肯•阿诺耐恩构思的一个项目。其余大多数人都是矿工或工程师，负责完成这个区域内的建设计划。我们正在建造一座小型建筑，将用作商业俱乐部在欧塔迈伦的总部。它同时也是本恒星系各合众国官员的会晤场所。余下的你就不必知道了。

这个项目才开始没多久，但我们已经遇到了不少问题。首先，我们原本打算在周围的小行星带开采矿石作为维护建筑的原料；在我们引进了必要的设备和设施之后，这些矿石还能用作建筑扩展部分的原料。问题在于，这个破地方按理应该已经废弃，竟然还住着一些吝啬的居民。其中有个疯狂的老矿工叫“乔瑞克•勒佛尼”，他拒绝与我们达成任何协议来分享这附近小行星的巨大资源财富，还声称这一带都归他所有。<br><br>他的执照过期很久了，所以我们决定不理他，继续开采。这时我们遇到了他同样疯狂的朋友马库斯。马库斯是……或曾经是……莫德团的一员；勒佛尼在这里采矿发了大财，之后就雇佣了马库斯。马库斯与勒佛尼签了合同，要保护他的财产不受海盗攻击——马库斯有时也确实需要应付这些情况。我本以为他不会攻击我们这些遵纪守法的合众国公民……但是我错了。他摧毁了我们的“獾”级飞船以及船上所有的采矿设备，只让矿工坐着逃生舱逃离。<br><br>这当然是叛国行为，需要受到合理处置。我向上级寻求过军事援助，但出于某些原因，他们更希望我聘请些自由雇佣兵来干这活。可能是涉及到一些法律问题……不管怎样，这就用得着你了。使用奔走城的一座星门前往勒佛尼目前所在的小行星带。找到勒佛尼，把他带给我。我要把他送去精神病医院，那里才是他该待的地方。我不要求你直接与马库斯交手，他太强大了。一旦抓获了勒佛尼，我相信马库斯也会离开。

name.en: Mercantile Settlers - To The Health Clinic (3 of 5)
name.es: Colonizadores mercantiles: Al centro de salud (3 de 5)
name.fr: Colons mercantiles – À la clinique (3 sur 5)
name.ja: 商業移住者-ヘルスクリニックへ（1/5）
name.ru: Меркантильные поселенцы - в оздоровительную клинику (Mercantile Settlers - To The Health Clinic) (3 из 5)

messages.en: Now that we have Lephny, we need to transfer him to the health clinic where we'll keep him until he comes to his senses.  My superiors within the Mercantile Club have rented a spot for him at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Bring him there for me today will ya, before he drives my men insane with his endless yammering.
messages.zh: 我们抓到了勒弗尼，现在要把他送到健康诊所，我们要让他在那里待到神智恢复为止。我商业俱乐部的上级在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}为他租了一个地方。今天你就把他送到那儿去，他无休无止的牢骚声都快把我的人逼疯了。

messages.en: Ah it's good to be rid of that silly old coot.  Now we can get back to business.  I have a couple additional jobs for you, {[character]player.name}, if you're interested.
messages.zh: 啊，终于摆脱了那个傻瓜。现在我们谈正事儿吧。如果你有兴趣，{[character]player.name}，我还有几份工作给你。

messages.en: Now that we have Lephny, we need to transfer him to the health clinic where we'll keep him until he comes to his senses.  My superiors within the Mercantile Club have rented a spot for him at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Bring him there for me today will ya, before he drives my men insane with his endless yammering.
messages.zh: 勒弗尼已经在我们手里，现在必须把他送到健康诊所让他慢慢恢复。我商业俱乐部的上级在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}为他租了一个住处。今天你就把他送到那儿去，我的人都快被他那无休无止的哭诉声逼疯了。

name.es: Colonizadores mercantiles: Escasez de láseres (4 de 5)
name.fr: Colons du Mercantile Club - Pénurie laser (4 sur 5)
name.ja: 商業移住者-レーザー不足（1/5）
name.ru: Меркантильные поселенцы - нехватка экстракторов (Mercantile Settlers - Laser Shortage) (4 из 5)

messages.en: The faster you are, the happier our miners will be!
messages.zh: 越快越好，我们的矿工都等着你！

messages.en: Since our Badger was destroyed by Markus a while back, with most of our mining equipment on board, we need to find some new supplies.  I have ordered a shipment already, but Prompt Delivery is taking it's sweet time to deliver it here.  In the meantime, I'd like you to acquire some Miner II's for me, 5 to be exact.  If you get them here in time, I'll let you have one of our Co-Processors in exchange, plus a bonus payment should you be extra fast.
messages.zh: 獾级飞船不久前被马库斯摧毁了，而我们的大多数采矿设备都在船上，因此需要找些新设备。我已经订购了一船货了，但疾速快递还在不紧不慢地运送，所以我要你先去找一些Ⅱ型采矿器来，确切地说是5个。如果你及时送到，我会给你一个协处理器作为交换，要是你行动迅速，我还会给你额外的奖励。

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}, now our project should get back on track in no time.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}，这样我们的项目就可以很快回到正轨了。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

name.fr: Colons du Mercantile Club - Hors-la-loi (5 sur 5)
name.ja: 商業移住者-アウトロー（1/5）
name.ru: Меркантильные поселенцы - преступники (Mercantile Settlers - Outlaws) (5 из 5)

messages.en: Give em hell.
messages.zh: 送他们下地狱！

messages.en:
We've been scouting the area's near here and have come across an abundance of outlaws. These pirates are a bit strange for city slickers like me, they wear very old fashioned garments and carry spurs (on their boots) instead of insignias as an identification marker. And they seem even more bold than their compatriots deeper within Caldari space, attacking us without warning. A few of our ships have been destroyed, and it's probably only a matter of time before they strike at our position here in Rush Town.

The toughest of the lot that we've encountered so far seem to be the pirates carrying the 'outlaw' spurs. They fly cruiser class ships, and are quire deadly. I can't afford to hire you on a permanent basis, {[character]player.name}, so I'll have to make due with clearing the area for us. You can find most of the outlaws hauled up near Otomainen II's moon. I don't care where you find them, just eliminate as many as you can. Bring back 40 of the outlaw spurs and I'll reward you with an ancient treasure map we discovered in one of the ruins here. I haven't been able to make heads or tails of the map, but someone with your experience might be able to make use of it. Good luck.
messages.zh:
根据我们在附近的巡视，这里似乎有许多不法分子。以一个城里人的眼光看，这群海盗的打扮非常奇怪：他们穿着非常老式的衣服，在靴子上戴着马刺，而不戴象征身份的徽章。他们比加达里空间深处的同胞更加胆大妄为，通常不加警告就对我们发动攻击。我们已经损失了一些飞船，估计他们对我们在奔走城的基地发动总攻是迟早的事。
我们目前遇到最大麻烦就是那些带着“放逐者”马刺的海盗，他们驾驶速度超快的巡洋舰，非常致命。我的预算可不够雇佣你做全职的工作，{[character]player.name}，所以请你帮我们清理一下这片区域吧。大部分不法分子都游荡在欧塔迈伦Ⅱ的卫星周围。我不管你去哪儿找他们，只要你尽可能多地消灭海盗。带回40个马刺，我会奖励给你一份古代藏宝图，是在一个废墟中发现的。我们目前还没有什么头绪，但像你这么有经验的人一定知道怎么好好利用它。祝你好运！

messages.en: Back so soon?  I didn't expect you to finish it in time ...  Well take the darn map and be off with you!
messages.zh: 这么快就回来了？我没料到你能及时完成……好吧，带着你的破地图走吧！

name.de: Ruchlose Geschäfte - Ein kleiner Gefallen (1 von 4)
name.en: Nefarious Business - A Small Favor (1 of 4)
name.es: Negocios perversos: Un pequeño favor (1 de 4)
name.fr: Une histoire pas très claire – Une petite faveur (1 sur 4)
name.ja: 非道なビジネス-小さな頼みごと（1/4）
name.ru: Зловещий бизнес - небольшая услуга (Nefarious Business - A Small Favor) (1 из 4)

messages.en: Gimme them guns.
messages.zh: 帮我给他们武器。

messages.en: That's the spirit, partner.
messages.zh: 伙计，精神可嘉啊！

messages.en: Got any work for me?
messages.zh: 有工作要给我做？

messages.en: Some associates of mine over at the Nugoeihuvi publishing station in system need some, uh, props delivered to them.  Just a few completely fake small arms, that's right.  Nothing real, nothing dangerous, certainly nothing that could, ya know, kill anyone.  Entertainment materials, you understand.  Heh heh.  If you can show me you're trustworthy, I may have something else for you later on.  What do ya say?
messages.zh: 我在纳基维空间站的一些同事要找人送些……呃……小玩意儿过去。没错儿，只是一些完全假冒的小型军械而已。你知道，那完全都是假货，没有危险，更不可能对人造成伤害。都是用来玩儿的，明白吗。呵呵。如果你的表现令我满意的话，接下来我还会给你其他的工作。你看怎么样？

messages.en: Your, ahem, props have been delivered.
messages.zh: 你的，咳咳，小玩意已经送到。

messages.en: Very good, very good indeed.  I have another job for you, if you're interested.
messages.zh: 不错，真不错。如果你有兴趣，我还有一份工作给你。

messages.en: Sounds pretty durned fishy to me.  I'll pass.
messages.zh: 你的话不怎么可信。找别人来干吧。

messages.en: All right then.  Probably just as well.  You don't look none too trustworthy anyhow.
messages.zh: 那好吧。就这样吧。怎么说，你看上去也不太可靠。

messages.en: So be it, then.  You just keep that to yourself, mind.
messages.zh: 那就这样吧。当心点，不要让别人知道。

name.fr: Une histoire pas très claire - Oiseau chanteur (2 sur 4)
name.ja: 非道なビジネス-密告者（2/4）
name.ru: Зловещий бизнес - певчая птичка (Nefarious Business - Songbird) (2 из 4)

messages.en:
I just got word that an operative working for the Hyasyoda corporation is about to make his way out of this system. Apparently, he's carrying evidence of several months' worth of "illicit arms deals" between the Nugoeihuvi corporation and my own. It's all complete hogwash, of course, but at this point in time neither our bosses nor our investors could stand to take the PR hit and the bothersome investigation that would no doubt follow.

This troublesome rodent has just left the Nugoeihuvi station in system, and my associates and I would be much obliged if you could find time to dispose of him for us. His name is Motani Ihura, and he hangs around in the contested mining facilities here in-system. Retrieve the evidence and bring it back to me, and you'll be even further within my good graces. How about it?
messages.zh:
我刚得到消息，三岛集团的一个特工正要离开这个星系。显然，他携带着纳基维集团和我们集团之间好几个月的“非法武器交易”的证据。当然，这些完全是胡言乱语！但是在现在这个时候，我的老板和我们的投资者都无法忍受公众形象受损，以及必然随之而来的烦死人的调查。

这个惹是生非的畜生刚刚离开这个星系的纳基维空间站，如果你能抽时间解决他，那么我和我的同事会非常感激的。他的名字是姆塔利·伊胡啦，正停留在这个星系争夺中的采矿设施附近。取得证据并带给我，那么你就将给我带来更大恩惠。你觉得如何？

name.en: Hidden Treasure - The Treasure Map (1 of 4)
name.es: Tesoro oculto: Mapa del tesoro (1 de 4)
name.fr: Trésor caché - La carte au trésor (1 sur 4)
name.ja: 隠されたトレジャー-トレジャーマップ（1/4）
name.ru: Скрытое сокровище - карта сокровищ (Hidden Treasure - The Treasure Map) (1 из 4)

messages.en: So you really think you can find that map eh? I've heard it may be located somewhere in Otomainen, but I've given up the search. If you find it, you'll make me a very happy man. I also promise to split whatever treasure I find there with you, 50/50 *wink*.
messages.zh: 那么，你真的以为你能找到那张地图？我听说它可能位于欧塔迈伦的某处，但是我已经放弃搜索了。如果你找到它，那么我会非常开心。我也保证，无论我在那里发现什么宝藏，我们都五五分成，*挤眼睛*。

messages.en:
Now look at what the cat dragged in ... another exhausted traveler looking for something cheerful to break the monotony of his existence. If that's really the case then you came to the right place! We got a casino here that's open all hours every day of the week, except on the major Otitoh holidays. If you're looking for a place to rest and have a pleasant evening, then spend the night in our pleasure hub nearby. If you want entertainment, you came to the right place dude! Echelon E. provides all your entertainment needs with prices unrivalled in the entire galaxy *cough*excluding some Gallente venues*cough*.

If you're looking for fame and fortune however, I might be of some help. I've been searching for a long lost treasure rumored to be hidden somewhere inside Otitoh, by the captain of a Gallente freighter who was ambushed here during the first Caldari-Gallente war. I've come across a number of clues, but have never managed to find that blasted treasure map which is supposed to lead me straight to it. Find me the map, and we can become rich together. What do you say?
messages.zh:
哟，看看谁来了……又一个疲惫不堪、想从单调的生活中找点乐子的旅行者。如果真被我说中了，那你可来对地方了！我们这有一个游乐场，除了欧提托的重要节日，24小时全天候开放。如果你正想找个休息的地方，过个愉快的晚上，那么就到附近我们的娱乐中心来度过今宵吧。伙计，如果你想尽情玩乐，你将不虚此行！梯队娱乐公司将满足你所有娱乐需求，而我们的价格在整个星系内是最低的*咳嗽*除了一些盖伦特人的场所*咳嗽*。

不过如果你想获得名声和财富，我也许能帮上些忙。我正在寻找一批失落已久的财宝，据谣传，这批财宝被一个盖伦特运输船船长藏在了欧提托内的某处，他的运输船在第一次加达里盖伦特战争中在这遭到了伏击。我发现了不少线索，但还没能找到那张该死的藏宝图，有了这张图就能直达财宝所在地。给我找到那张地图，我们都会发财的。你觉得怎么样？

messages.en: I got the map, but couldn't make much of it.  Now I'd like my reward, thank you.
messages.zh: 我拿到了地图，但看不大懂。现在我想拿到我的酬金，谢谢。

messages.en: Incredible!  You've found it!  I can't believe my eyes ... at last I have the map!  You'll help me find the treasure, if I tell you where it is?  I hope you will, {[character]player.name}, I'm not much of a fighter pilot and it seems to lead straight into pirate infested territory.  Accept this offer of a lifetime and you won't regret it.
messages.zh: 真难以置信！你找到了它！我没法相信我的眼睛……我终于拿到了地图！如果我告诉你地点，你会帮我找到宝藏的，对吧？我希望你会，{[character]player.name}，我不太擅长战斗，而宝藏所在地似乎直接通向海盗滋生的区域。接受这次千载难逢的提议吧，你不会后悔的。

messages.en: Retrieve an ancient treasure map for {[character]agentID.name}.  Rumor has it that Hitami Magye in Otomainen might know something about such a map ...
messages.zh: 为{[character]agentID.name}找回一张古老的藏宝图。传说欧塔迈伦的伊塔米•玛葛叶可能知道些关于图的事……

name.ja: 隠されたトレジャー-キーカードの回収（2/4）
name.ru: Скрытое сокровище - добыть ключевую плату (Hidden Treasure - Retrieve The Keycard) (2 из 4)

messages.en: It's quite heavy by the way, being a very old prototype I inherited from my father. The new ones are quite smaller. But as I said, either bring me my system scanner or you can forget about ever finding the treasure!
messages.zh: 顺便说一下，这原型样机是从我父亲那里传下来的，笨重的很。新款式的倒小巧很多。但是我说过了，把我的星系扫描仪拿回来，否则你就别指望能找到什么宝藏了！

messages.en:
After taking a quick look at the map you brought back, I'm positive that I need a system scanner to find the exact location that the map specifies. It's very vague, but does specify a relatively small area in space where I should be able to locate a cosmic signature.

I'll tell you what, retrieve my old system scanner at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and I'll give you a bookmark to the treasure. I won't accept any of those new fancy-pancy scanners, I wouldn't know how they work anyway. In other words, if you don't get me my scanner then the deal's off, understand?
messages.zh:
在匆匆看完你带回来的地图后，我确信我需要一个星系扫描仪来确定地图上所标示地点的精确位置。图上的地点很模糊，但确实指明了空间中的某个较小区域，我应该能在那确定一个空间信号。

听我说，去{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}把我的老式星系扫描仪拿回来，我就能确定宝藏的位标。我不要任何新型的花里胡哨的扫描器，我压根不知道怎么用它们。也就是说，如果你不把我的扫描器拿来，这事就得黄，明白吗？

messages.en: Great!  I'll get started locating the cosmic signature at once.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 太好了！我立刻开始搜索空间信号。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en:
After taking a quick look at the map you brought back, I'm positive that I need a system scanner to find the exact location that the map specifies. It's very vague, but does specify a relatively small area in space where I should be able to locate a cosmic signature.

I'll tell you what, retrieve my old system scanner at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and I'll give you a bookmark to the treasure. I won't accept any of those new fancy-pancy scanners, I wouldn't know how they work anyway. In other words, if you don't get me my scanner then the deal's off, understand?
messages.zh:
刚扫了一眼你带回来的那张地图，看来我真的需要一个星系扫描器来确定地图上所标示地点的精确位置。虽然那不会很清晰，但这却能在客观上使搜索范围变小，从而使我对这些地点进行定位。

听我说，去{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}把我的老式星系扫描器拿来，我就能确定宝藏的位标。我从来不用任何新型的扫描器，也不明白它们的运行原理。所以，换句话说，如果你没有拿回我的扫描器，那么我们的交易就到此为止，明白吗？

name.de: Versteckter Schatz - Holen Sie die Schlüsselkarte (3 von 4)
name.en: Hidden Treasure - Retrieve The Keycard (3 of 4)
name.es: Tesoro oculto: A por la tarjeta de acceso (3 de 4)
name.fr: Trésor caché - Récupérer la clé magnétique (3 sur 4)
name.ja: 隠されたトレジャー-キーカードの回収（3/4）
name.ru: Скрытое сокровище - добыть карту доступа (Hidden Treasure - Retrieve The Keycard) (3 из 4)

messages.en: Just a word of advice before you leave, the Kazka headquarters are inaccessible to anything larger than a battlecruiser, so I suggest bringing a friend or two if possible.  The pirates are no laughing matter.
messages.zh: 在你出发前，听我一句忠告，任何比巡洋舰更大的飞船都无法进入卡兹卡总部，所以你应该开一艘战列巡洋舰去，如果可能的话，带上一两个朋友。那些守卫小行星的海盗可不是闹着玩的。

messages.en:
Now that I have the system scanner, there is just one more item that's missing. Upon closer examination I noticed a small paragraph scribbled on the back of the map, where the map-maker claims a keycard is needed to enter the site where he hid the treasure. I had actually discovered this long ago, before I first came to Otitoh, when I spoke to a relative of the deceased Gallente pilot who originally hid the treasure. I tracked this keycard down to a famous Guristas buccaneer, Tao Pai Motow, who often roams the asteroid fields inside the Kazka Headquarter deadspace pocket in Sakkikainen. Needless to say, I barely escaped with my life when I confronted Tao and offered a generous deal for the keycard. Apparently he's fully aware of what the keycard is for, and has been searching for the treasure himself for many years.

I'm afraid we do not have any choice except to hunt this pirate down and nab the keycard from him by force. There isn't a Ark roid's chance in Curse of getting it from that brute without a fight. Once you've found him and acquired the keycard, we can continue our search.
messages.zh:
我有了星系扫描仪，现在只差一样东西了。仔细检查后，我发现在地图背面有段地图制作人留下的潦草文字，上面说必须凭一张钥匙卡才能进入藏宝地。事实上这个我早就知道了，在我还没来欧提托之前，曾和一位已故盖伦特飞行员的亲戚谈过，而那个飞行员正是当初埋藏宝藏的人。我顺藤摸瓜地追查起钥匙卡的下落，发现它在一个有名的古斯塔斯海盗手里，这个名叫陶派莫托乌的家伙，常在位于萨基凯伦的卡兹卡总部死亡空间层内的行星带附近转悠。当我直面陶，表示要重金购买钥匙卡时，后果显而易见——我差点丢了性命。显然，他完全知道钥匙卡的用场，多年来他自己也在搜寻这笔财宝。

恐怕现在我们别无选择，只能先追击这个海盗，再用武力夺取钥匙卡。想不大干一场就从那个野蛮人手里拿到钥匙卡简直是天方夜谭。一旦你找到他并获得钥匙卡，我们就能继续寻宝了。

messages.en: Ah, at last I have the keycard.  I suggest you keep the other copy safe, you'll need it in your next assignment.
messages.zh: 啊，我终于拿到了钥匙卡。我建议你好好保管另一份副本，下次任务时你会需要的。

name.fr: Serviteur Nugoeihuvi – Preuve de loyauté (1 sur 3)
name.ja: ノゴエイハヴィの公僕-忠誠の証（3/3）
name.ru: Слуга Nugoeihuvi - доказывая лояльность (Nugoeihuvi Servant - Proving One's Loyalty) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
So, you're interested in working for the Nugoeihuvi corporation, yes? This whole constellation is filled with riches, and I must admit, we could use some help in our quest to claim it all. Many large corporations have their eyes set on this place, but they won't get there before we do.

I have a few tasks for you. If you can complete them without messing anything up, perhaps we can begin to trust you. Firstly, I want you to take these weapons and deliver them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Our agents there are want to be well prepared should there be an uprising. The locals have been giving them some troubles lately and its time to show them who's boss.

Do you think you're up for it?
messages.zh:
这么说你很有兴趣为纳基维集团工作，是吗？这里财富遍地，多一点你这样的人手帮忙，我们就能称霸星座。其他的超级集团都对此地虎视眈眈，但我们绝不会让他们得逞。

我有一些任务，要是你能出色完成，或许我会更信任你。首先，把这些武器带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。我们的人必须全副武装来应付可能出现的抗争。最近当地人老是找我们麻烦，是时候给他们点颜色看看了。

你能胜任吗？

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. I foresee a bright future for you within our organization. Oh, and don't you leave just yet ― I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]player.name}，照我看你在我们集团里前程似锦。先别离开，我还有另一项任务等着给你呢！

name.fr: Trésor caché – Trouver le trésor Gallente (4 sur 4)
name.ja: 隠されたトレジャー-ガレンテフォーチュンの発見（4/4）
name.ru: Скрытое сокровище - отыскать богатство Gallente (Hidden Treasure - Find The Gallente Fortune) (4 из 4)

messages.en:
Now the time has arrived to claim the long lost treasure of Kepheur Buquet! You have his keycard, and I'll give you the coordinates of the deadspace pocket where he hid his treasure. I'm a bit worried that you might run into some trouble getting to it, as the area where I located the cosmic signature is heavily infested with rogue drones. It's officially a 'no-fly' zone according to the Caldari authorities here, and they refuse to offer any kind of assistance in clearing those pesky drones. Many pilots have lost their lives there, so be careful.

Once you have found the treasure, loot it and return immediately to me.
messages.zh:
克佛尔•巴奎特长眠的宝藏将在今天重见天日。用你得到的钥匙卡片进入密藏宝藏的死亡空间层，位标会上传给你，但到达之后还有一些麻烦。从那个区域发出的宇宙特征信号来看，该死亡空间似乎被自由无人机占领了。根据加达里当局法律，那里是一个禁飞区，因此政府不会协助我们清除那些讨厌的无人机。许多飞行员在那丧命，你要小心。

一旦你找到了宝藏，马上把它运回来。

messages.en:
WHAT? Is that all you could find in the treasure chest?! I cannot believe this. There must have been another clue there somewhere, leading to the real treasure. This cannot be!

*long pause*

Take your stinking reward and be off with you, {[character]player.name}. I've no need of you anymore. I've already lost enough money keeping you around ... AAARG!
messages.zh:
什么？那就是你在宝箱里面找到的所有东西？！我不能相信。什么地方一定还有另一条线索，通向真正的财宝所在。这不可能！

*长时间的停顿*

拿着你的臭奖励滚吧，{[character]player.name}。我再也不需要你了。把你留在身边已经花了我够多的钱了……啊啊啊！

name.es: Excavaciones de artefactos: Comida para los necesitados (1 de 5)
name.fr: Restes d'extraction  - De la nourriture pour les nécessiteux (1 sur 5)
name.ja: アーティファクト発掘-食料配給（1/5）
name.ru: Раскопки артефактов - пища для нуждающихся (Artifact Excavations - Food for the Needy) (1 из 5)

messages.en: I suggest you look for the food somewhere on the market nearby. It's bound to be sold somewhere in {[location]agentRegionID.name}.
messages.zh: 我建议你去附近的市场上找点食物。在{[location]agentRegionID.name}的某些地方一定能买到。

messages.en:
So good of you to drop by, {[character]player.name}. I've been looking for a freelancer to do a few tasks for quite some time. You see, I'm one of the chief supervisors of the STI archaeology team here in the Devil's Dig Site, and we've encountered a few problems recently that we need help solving.

Your first task is to retrieve a large quantity of frozen food to feed the wretched pilgrims who are camped in the asteroid bunkers near here. The last shipment of food still hasn't arrived, and some of them have become desperate. We'd rather not have a riot on our hands, so I'd like you to retrieve enough food to last them a few more days, until we can figure out why that last shipment didn't make it.

These pilgrims are mostly just poor souls who believe this dig site may contain relics of religious importance. Some are simply tourists who wish to take a look at the site with their own eyes, and our daily tours through the ancient ruins and relic museum have been a valuable fundraising mechanism for us in the past. So a famine crisis here would not only cause a riot, but it would be bad for business as well.
messages.zh:
很高兴你来了，{[character]player.name}。我找了好长一段时间，想要个自由战士替我做事。你知道，我是恶魔挖掘场科学及贸易学会考古小组的主管之一，目前我们遇到一些问题需要帮助。

你的第一个任务就是去找大量的冷藏食品，让那些在附近小行星堡垒里扎营的可怜朝圣者吃饱肚子。上批食物至今没有送到，但他们中一些人己经接近绝望了。我们可不想在当前有暴动发生，所以我希望你找到足够的粮食，尽量让他们多维持几天，直到我们查明那批货物没有到的原因。

大部分朝圣者非常单纯，相信能在挖掘现场会有宗教文物。其他的则是旅游者，想亲眼看看这个地方。每天来参观我们古迹和文物博物馆的人相当多，收入也很可观。这次饥荒不仅仅会造成暴动，还会给旅游业带来严重打击。

messages.en: Well done, {[character]player.name}! I'll have this food shipped directly to the pilgrims' quarters. And you'll be glad to hear I have another assignment waiting for you.
messages.zh: 干得不错，{[character]player.name}！我会直接把这些食物运送到朝圣者住所。你会很荣幸地得到我给你的下一个任务。

name.ru: Раскопки артефактов - нехватка инструментов (Artifact Excavations - Tools in Short Supply) (2 из 5)

messages.en:
The second task I'm going to give you is to retrieve a large shipment of research tools from our friends in Lai Dai, from their station in {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. We ordered the tools a few weeks ago and they are finally ready, but our contract with Promptus Delivery recently expired, so we've had to look for other non-conventional means to get them here.

If you can get this done within a few hours, I might even throw in a bonus. How does that sound?
messages.zh:
我给你的第二个任务是从我在莱戴集团的朋友那里拿回一批研究工具的货物，那批货在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的空间站中。我们几周前订购了这些工具，现在总算有了现货，可是我们与疾速快递的合同已经到期，所以需要找个人帮我们跑一趟。

如果你能在数小时之内完成任务，我会给你额外的奖励。怎么样？

messages.en: Oh, good. These tools will definitely come in handy; our staff has doubled in the past year and we've been severely lacking in high-tech equipment. Talk to me again in just a moment if you'd like some more work!
messages.zh: 噢，真不错。这些工具迟早都能派上用场，我们的员工人数在过去的一年中翻了一倍，因此我们现在急缺高科技装备。如果你还想干些活儿，别走开，我马上会有新的任务给你！

我给你的第二个任务是从我在莱戴集团的朋友那里拿回一批研究工具的货物，那批货在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的空间站中。我们几周前订购了这些工具，现在总算有了现货，可是我们与疾速快递的合同已经到期，所以需要找个人帮我们跑一趟。

如果你能在数小时之内完成任务，我会给你额外的奖励。怎么样？

name.de: Ausgrabungen der Artefakte - Banditen aufgepasst (3 von 5)
name.es: Excavaciones de artefactos: cuidado con los bandidos (3 de 5)
name.fr: Restes d'extraction  - Attention aux bandits (3 sur 5)
name.ja: アーティファクト発掘-盗賊に注意せよ（3/5）
name.ru: Раскопки артефактов — бандиты, берегитесь (Artifact Excavations - Bandits Beware) (3 из 5)

messages.en: We've finally figured out why the food supply convoy hasn't made it here yet: Apparently it was ambushed by a gang of bandits led by a local Minmatar scoundrel, Makele Kordonii. He's loosely allied with the Angel Cartel organization, which has some small influence in Okkelen, and has a gang of Caldari outlaws under his control. He has a hideout near one of the moons of Otitoh VI, from which he launches his attacks on unwary passersby. This latest attack was the last straw! I demand that he be brought to justice once and for all. Find him at his hideout, then bring his identification tag to me.  ou'll be well rewarded for your efforts.
messages.zh: 我们终于查明运送食品的护航队至今没有到达的原因：他们遭到了一伙强盗的伏击，对方首领是当地穷凶恶极的米玛塔尔无赖马克勒•科尔多尼。他多少算是个天使企业联合体的同盟，手下管了一伙加达里逃犯，而天使在欧克勒恩也有些小势力。他在欧提托VI的一个卫星附近有个藏身处，经常在那儿对大意的过路者发动袭击。最近的这次袭击让人忍无可忍了！我要他彻底受到正义的制裁。去他的藏身处干掉他，把他的身份验证铭牌带给我。你会得到丰厚的报酬。

messages.en: Good! Makele will bother us no more, at least not until those bastards in the Cartel manage to clone him. You've done me good service; I have some other work for you.
messages.zh: 不错！马克勒不会再来纠缠我们了，至少在那些天使企业联合体的混蛋成功克隆他之前不会了。你帮了我的大忙；我还有别的工作给你。

messages.en: Find and destroy Makele Kordonii in his hideout near one of the moons of Otitoh VI, then bring proof of your deed to {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 马克勒•科尔多尼的藏身处在欧提托VI的一个卫星附近 ，把他揪出来干掉，带回他已死的证物交给{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Objectives
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en: We've finally figured out why the food supply convoy hasn't made it here yet: Apparently it was ambushed by a gang of bandits led by a local Minmatar scoundrel, Makele Kordonii. He's loosely allied with the Angel Cartel organization, which has some small influence in Okkelen, and has a gang of Caldari outlaws under his control. He has a hideout near one of the moons of Otitoh VI, from which he launches his attacks on unwary passersby. This latest attack was the last straw! I demand that he be brought to justice once and for all. Find him at his hideout, then bring his identification tag to me. You'll be well rewarded for your efforts.
messages.zh: 我们终于知道食品供给队尚未到达的原因了：很明显，他们被一群强盗袭击了。那群强盗的首领是一个名叫马克勒·科尔多尼的当地米玛塔尔恶棍。他与在欧克勒恩稍有影响的天使集团有着松散的联盟关系，并且带领着一帮加达里罪犯。他藏在欧提托 VI的一个卫星附近。他对路人的袭击都是从那儿发起的。这次最新的袭击让人再也无法忍受了！我要求让他立马罪有应得。去他的藏身地把他找出来，然后把他的身份铭牌带来给我。你会得到相应回报的。

name.de: Ausgrabungen der Artefakte - Der letzte Schlag (4 von 5)
name.es: Excavaciones de artefactos: Golpe definitivo (4 de 5)
name.fr: À la recherche des reliques - Le coup de grâce (4 sur 5)
name.ja: アーティファクト発掘-最後の一撃（4/5）
name.ru: Раскопки артефактов - окончательный удар (Artifact Excavations - Final Blow) (4 из 5)

messages.en: Makele's gang is still at it, even after his death. This time a convoy of simple pilgrims was completely obliterated barely 1 AU from our dig site. This is completely unacceptable. I would like you to deliver another blow to the pirate scum that infest our troubled system. Once you have collected enough of their identification tags, then return to me for your reward.
messages.zh: 虽然马克勒死了，但是他的团队还在。这次是一支普通的朝圣者护航队，在距离挖掘现场仅仅1AU的地方全军覆没。这实在太过分了。我需要你去狠狠打击另一伙出没于我们不平静的星系的海盗渣滓。一旦你收集了足够多的海盗铭牌，那么就回来找我领赏。

messages.en: Again you surprise me with your vigor and ingenuity, {[character]player.name}. You are a fine pilot. If you're willing, I have one final task for you before you leave.
messages.zh: 你旺盛的精力和天才的创造力真让我吃惊，{[character]player.name}。你是个不错的飞行员。如果你愿意，走之前，接受我给你的最后一个任务吧。

name.de: Ausgrabungen der Artefakte - Lieferung des Sonderberichtes (5 von 5)
name.en: Artifact Excavations - Deliver the Special Report (5 of 5)
name.es: Excavaciones de artefactos: Entrega del informe especial (5 de 5)
name.fr: À la recherche des reliques – Livraison du rapport spécial (5 sur 5)
name.ja: アーティファクト発掘-特記レポートの配達（5/5）
name.ru: Раскопки артефактов - доставить особый доклад (Artifact Excavations - Deliver the Special Report) (5 из 5)
name.zh: 古物发掘—运送特别报告（5/5）

messages.en:
As a final favor, {[character]player.name}, I'd like you to bring this special report to our colleagues in the School of Applied Knowledge, who are co-organizing this project of ours here in Devil's Dig. The report details our progress for the past month, including the defeat of Makele and his pirate goons. Because of all the commotion recently, I completely forgot to send our monthly report in the last convoy heading toward {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Our relationship with them is already strained, given the recent setbacks, and I'd rather not complicate matters further by being late when it comes to such important matters. I'm already nervous thinking about the next project manager's meeting I have to attend with their employees...

Get this done for me in time, and I'll reward you generously.
messages.zh: 我想请你帮最后一个忙，{[character]player.name}，将这份特别报告送到我们在应用知识学校的同事那里，他们是这个恶魔挖掘场项目的合作组织人。这份报告详述了我们在过去一个月内的进展，包括击败马克勒和他的海盗打手。由于近期的骚乱，我竟然忘了让上支去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的护航队把月报捎过去。由于最近遇到的挫折，我们和那些同事的关系已十分紧张，我可不想在这么重要的事上有所延误，使事态更加复杂。光想到我要和他们的员工一同参加下一个项目经理会议，我就十分紧张了……<br><br>请及时完成这个任务，我会给你丰厚报酬的。

messages.en: You've been a great boon to me in these difficult times, {[character]player.name}. I'm afraid I don't have any more work for you, but I'm sure we'll meet again some day. Feel free to stop by the ancient ruins here sometime, and bring the family! I'd love to show you some of the artifacts we've discovered in the last few years.
messages.zh: 感谢你在我危难时伸出援手，{[character]player.name}。恐怕在你完成这个最后任务后，我就不再有任务给你了，但我相信我们有一天还会再见。随时欢迎你到古代遗迹来，记得带上家人！我很乐意向你展示一些我们近几年来发现的古董。

name.de: Station in der Krise - Caldarische Unruhestifter (1 von 3)
name.en: Station In Crisis - Caldari Troublemakers (1 of 3)
name.es: Estación en crisis: Alborotadores caldaris (1 de 3)
name.fr: Station en crise - Les fauteurs de trouble Caldari (1 sur 3)
name.ja: 窮地のステーション―カルダリの厄介者（1/3）
name.ru: Кризис на станции - смутьяны Caldari (Station In Crisis - Caldari Troublemakers) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 空间站危机—加达里捣乱者 (1/3)

messages.en:
I'm so glad to see you {[character]player.name}. I had almost given up hope on finding a skilled mercenary to do some dangerous work for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}. I've looked everywhere in this run-down system but you're the first ray of hope that I've encountered so far.

We have a serious problem on our hands at the State And Region Bank in Ihakana. A gang of hooligans has been terrorizing passersby in the area, allegedly causing damage to our property and pestering our customers. We haven't been able to pin anything major on them yet, but our patience has worn out. I will pay you a large sum of ISK if you take care of these pests yourself, before they do any serious harm.

The deadpsace pocket is hidden from passive sensors. You will need to use probes to scan down the Kazka blockade.
messages.zh:
见到你真是太好了，{[character]player.name}。我几乎绝望了，以为永远找不到一个经验丰富的雇佣兵来为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}执行一些危险任务。我找遍了这个衰败星系的每个角落，而你的出现，给我带来了第一线希望。

我们在以哈坎拿的国家星域银行碰到了一个棘手的问题。这个地区有一帮令路人胆战心惊的恶棍，他们不仅使我们的财产蒙受损失，还对我们的客户纠缠不休。我们尚未对他们采取大规模行动，但我们的忍耐是有限度的。如果你能亲自出马，在他们制造更多麻烦之前除掉这些祸害，我就会给你一大笔钱。

被动扫描器无法定位那个死亡空间层。你需要利用探针来找出卡兹卡这帮拦路劫匪。

name.de: Station in der Krise  - Miliz-Ausrüstung (2 von 3)
name.en: Station In Crisis - Militia Equipment (2 of 3)
name.es: Estación en crisis: Pertrechos militares (2 de 3)
name.fr: Station en crise – Équipement de la milice (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 窮地のステーション―民兵の武装（2/3）
name.ru: Кризис на станции - оборудование для ополчения (Station In Crisis - Militia Equipment) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
Because of the volatile situation here in Ihakana, we've been planning on funding a local militia to participate in the defenses of our station. CONCORD and the State have a very loose hold on the entire constellation, and Ihakana is no exception. We can't afford to ask them for any favors, we have to take matters into our own hands.

Because funding for our project here is limited, we've had to make due with cheap small arms, aka pistols. I've been promised a shipment of them at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, if you could be so kind as to transport them to the S.R.B. station in this system I would be very grateful.
messages.zh:
鉴于以哈坎拿目前不稳定的局面，我们一直在计划筹资建立一个本地的民兵组织，用以保卫我们的空间站。统合部和合众国对整个星座的掌控力度非常薄弱，以哈坎拿也不例外。如果请求他们帮助，后果将不堪设想；我们必须亲自来处理这些问题。

因为我们为这个项目筹得的资金有限，我们不得不使用一些廉价的轻武器，也就是手枪。我在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}弄到了一批货。如果你能劳驾把它们送到这个星系的国家星域银行空间站，我会非常感激的。

messages.en: Great, I'll send word immediately to my superiors to start equipping the militia volunteers.  Hopefully this will deter those thugs even further from bothering us or our customers.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 太好了，我会立刻向我的上级转告，可以开始武装民兵志愿者了。希望这能阻止那些暴徒继续骚扰我们以及我们的客户。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en:
Because of the volatile situation here in Ihakana, we've been planning on funding a local militia to participate in the defenses of our station. CONCORD and the State have a very loose hold on the entire constellation, and Ihakana is no exception. We can't afford to ask them for any favors, we have to take matters into our own hands.

Because funding for our project here is limited, we've had to make due with cheap small arms, aka pistols. I've been promised a shipment of them at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, if you could be so kind as to transport them to the S.R.B. station in this system I would be very grateful.
messages.zh:
鉴于以哈坎拿目前不稳定的局面，我们正在计划建立一个本地的民兵组织来保卫空间站。统合部和政府对整个星座的控制比较松散，以哈坎拿也不例外。我们不可能向他们寻求帮助，我们必须用自己的双手处理这些问题。

因为用于我们这个项目的基金很有限，我们不得不使用一些廉价的轻武器：阿卡手枪。我订了一批货，现正在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}等待运送。如果你能把它们送到这个星系的国家星域银行空间站，我会很感激的。

name.de: Station in der Krise - Anführer der Hooligan-Gang (3 von 3)
name.en: Station In Crisis - Hooligan Gang Leaders (3 of 3)
name.es: Estación en crisis: Líderes camorreros (3 de 3)
name.fr: Station en crise – Les chefs du gang de voyous (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 窮地のステーション―ならず者のリーダー（3/3）
name.ru: Кризис на станции - лидеры хулиганов (Station In Crisis - Hooligan Gang Leaders) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
Unfortunately your previous assignment for me was not a complete success. I was wrong about the bandits abandoning their plans of causing havoc near the State and Region bank in Ihakana when they start to get a taste of their own medicine. Despite a number of their ships having been destroyed, I've noticed a surge in their activity near the station. They are mainly compromised of the natives of Ihakana who are poor and jobless, and angry at the State for the lack of interest this system receives from the government. For some reason they believe attacking the State and Region Bank will help their cause … foolish if you ask me.

But when their leaders fall, we believe they will become discouraged and this temporary surge of unrest will dissipate. Bring me evidence of their demise and you shall be rewarded.
messages.zh:
很不幸，你为我做的上一个任务并不十分圆满。我原以为那些强盗在吃些苦头后会停止在以哈坎拿的国家星域银行附近大肆破坏，看来我错了。虽然他们的不少飞船已被摧毁，但他们在空间站附近的活动却变得更加猖獗。他们中大多数都是以哈坎拿本地人，又穷又没有工作，而且对合众国政府忽视这个星系感到极为不满。不知为什么，他们认为袭击国家星域银行会帮助他们改善自己的利益……在我看来这真是愚蠢。

不过只要他们的领袖垮台，我相信其他人就会一蹶不振，而这暂时的滔天风波也会平息。把可以证明他们死亡的证据带给我，你会得到奖赏。

messages.en: I've already noticed a severe drop in illegal activity and reports of harassment near the State And Region Bank.  This is good news indeed, and let's hope it deters Anniainen Aizaris from going through with her plans of closing down the station and moving our operations elsewhere.  Take your reward {[character]player.name}, you've certainly earned it.
messages.zh: 我已经注意到，国家星域银行附近的违法活动和骚扰事件的报道数量都在急剧下降。这确实是个好消息，希望这能阻止安妮埃恩·艾扎希斯完成她的计划。她本来是要关闭空间站，并把我们的部门移往他处的。拿着你的报酬，{[character]player.name}，这是你自己赚到的。

messages.en:
Unfortunately your previous assignment for me was not a complete success. I was wrong about the bandits abandoning their plans of causing havoc near the State and Region bank in Ihakana when they start to get a taste of their own medicine. Despite a number of their ships having been destroyed, I've noticed a surge in their activity near the station. They are mainly compromised of the natives of Ihakana who are poor and jobless, and angry at the State for the lack of interest this system receives from the government. For some reason they believe attacking the State and Region Bank will help their cause … foolish if you ask me.

But when their leaders fall, we believe they will become discouraged and this temporary surge of unrest will dissipate. Bring me evidence of their demise and you shall be rewarded.
messages.zh:
很不幸，你为我做的上一个任务并没有完全大功告成。原以为那些强盗会停止在以哈坎拿的国家星域银行附近进行的大肆破坏，显然我的看法错了。虽然我们摧毁了不少飞船，但在空间站附近他们的活动变得更加猖獗。他们主要由以哈坎拿的本地的失业人员组成，这些家伙都很贫困，而且对政府忽视这个星系极为不满。由于某些原因，他们认为通过袭击国家星域银行将会帮助他们改变现状……在我看来这真是愚蠢。

如果他们的领袖遇难，我相信其它的人就会一蹶不振，而这暂起的风波也将消失不见。把可以证明他们死亡的证据带给我，你会得到奖赏。

name.en: Foul Play - Organizing The Search (1 of 3)
name.es: Juego sucio: Organizar la búsqueda (1 de 3)
name.ru: Грязные игры - организация поисков (Foul Play - Organizing The Search) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
So you're the cigar smokin' traveler people have been talkin' about in these parts, eh {[character]player.name}? I've got just the job for you, a lil risk involved but nothin' someone with your abilities can't handle. You see, there was a terrible, terrible crime committed here in Otitoh recently, in the Lai Dai station. A dastardly sexual predator by the name of Ryoke Aura raped a young woman, my wife to be exact, in her quarters while I was away on duty. The no-good sheriff in these parts hasn't been able to track him down yet, and I think he's even given up on the search.

I can't let this pass, my wife deserves better! I want to inform the media about this, maybe if they plaster the bastard's face all across the region someone will notice him and contact the proper authorities. Bring this holoreel to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, my friend in the media center there will make sure it's shown on State television at least once in the next week. It depicts the suspect leaving my wife's bedroom in a hurry, with his cloths all ruffled up like he had just put them on.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你就是这一带人们经常谈论的那个抽雪茄的旅行者，是吗？我正好有适合你的工作，可能有点风险，但像你这样能干的人一定可以应付自如。跟你说，最近在欧提托里的莱戴空间站发生了一起非常可怕的案件。一个名叫留克•奥拉的混蛋污辱了一名年轻妇女，准确地说是我妻子，事情就发生在我家里，当时我正外出公干。那个负责这一带的治安官真是个窝囊废，到现在还没查到这个混蛋的下落，我想他根本就已经放弃了搜查。

但我不会让这事就这么算了，必须为我的妻子讨个说法！我要将一切公诸于众，让媒体了解此事，如果他们在整个星域贴满这个恶棍的画像，也许有人会发现他并联系有关部门。把这张全息记忆盘送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，我在那的媒体中心的朋友保证下周这将在合众国电视台上播出至少一次。它刻画了嫌犯匆匆离开我妻子卧室时的外貌，衣服皱巴巴的，就好象刚穿上一样。

messages.en: I've been informed the holoreel will be shown tonight!  This is great news!  But there's more to be done, so stick around buddy.
messages.zh: 有人告诉我说，全息记忆盘今晚会播放！这真是个好消息！还有许多事情要你做，不要走开，伙计！

messages.en:
So you're the cigar smokin' traveler people have been talkin' about in these parts, eh {[character]player.name}? I've got just the job for you, a lil risk involved but nothin' someone with your abilities can't handle. You see, there was a terrible, terrible crime committed here in Otitoh recently, in the Lai Dai station. A dastardly sexual predator by the name of Ryoke Aura raped a young woman, my wife to be exact, in her quarters while I was away on duty. The no-good sheriff in these parts hasn't been able to track him down yet, and I think he's even given up on the search.

I can't let this pass, my wife deserves better! I want to inform the media about this, maybe if they plaster the bastard's face all across the region someone will notice him and contact the proper authorities. Bring this holoreel to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, my friend in the media center there will make sure it's shown on State television at least once in the next week. It depicts the suspect leaving my wife's bedroom in a hurry, with his cloths all ruffled up like he had just put them on.

name.es: Juego sucio: El amigo de Ryoke (2 de 3)
name.ja: 不正行為―リョーケの友人（2/3）
name.ru: Грязная игра - друг Ryoke (Foul Play - Ryoke's Friend) (2 из 3)

messages.en: Just a word of caution, Zvarin has a powerful escort which you'll probably have to deal with.  Don't go unprepared.
messages.zh: 不过提醒你一句，兹瓦林有一支强大的护卫队，你可能必须收拾他们。你要准备充分。

messages.en: It's now time to take the law into our own hands, {[character]player.name}. Since the Sheriff is completely incompetent, we have no choice. I've done a little background research on Ryoke, and I've discovered that he has a close relative living near here, in Ihakana. If anyone knows Ryoke's whereabouts, it would be this guy. He's called Zvarin Karsha, and is a small time peddler dealing in foodstuffs and other goods. I heard he and his escort are currently located near the State and Region Bank in Ihakana. Go there and find him, then bring him alive to me. You will be well rewarded for your efforts.
messages.zh: 现在该我们用自己的双手来执行法律了，{[character]player.name}。那个治安官完全不中用，我们别无选择。我调查了一下留克的背景，发现他有个近亲住在这附近，就在以哈坎拿。假如有人知道留克的行踪，那么肯定是这家伙。他叫兹瓦林•卡尔莎，是个贩卖粮食杂货的小商贩。听说他和他的护卫队目前正在以哈坎拿国家星域银行附近。去那把他抓来给我，要活的。我一定会好好奖励你。

messages.en: Ha ha!  I'll make sure this goat lovin' scoundrel talks, no matter what!  Stay here 'til he coughs up the info, then hopefully we'll know where to find Ryoke.
messages.zh: 哈哈！我肯定会让这个罪犯开口说话的，不管他说什么！呆在这儿，等他透露出信息，然后我们就有希望能够找到留克。

name.es: Juego sucio: Buscando a Ryoke (3 de 3)
name.fr: Tricherie - Mettre la main sur Ryoke (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 不正行為―リョーケ発見（3/3）
name.ru: Грязная игра - поиск Ryoke (Foul Play - Finding Ryoke) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
I've managed to force Zvarin to cough up the location of his nephew, Ryoke. He admitted that Ryoke was actually a Guristas Pirate! I should have known it would turn out this way ... not only is this guy a rapist but he's also a member of the most feared criminal organization in the Forge!

Zvarin also gave me the location of his nephew. It took some 'convincing' on my part, but eventually he gave in. Ryoke is apparently on duty in the Guristas Stronghold in Otomainen. They use the area as their main base of operations in this constellation. Bring me his head, on a plate if possible. Nyhaha!
messages.zh:
我已经让兹瓦林吐出了他外甥留克的藏身之处。据他交代，留克竟然是一个古斯塔斯海盗！我早该猜到事情会这样……这家伙不仅是个罪犯，还是伏尔戈星域最恐怖的犯罪组织成员之一！

兹瓦林还给了我他外甥目前所在的位置。我用了不少“说服”手段，但他终于还是招了。留克正在欧塔迈伦的古斯塔斯要塞里值勤。那儿是古斯塔斯在本星座的主要军事基地。把他的人头带来，最好是盛在盘子上。呀哈哈哈！

messages.en:
This isn't Ryoke Aura! What is the meaning of this?!

I've been had! That Zvarin numbskull will pay dearly for this! And I spent most of my life savings paying you for completing that last mission ... aaaaarg!
messages.zh:
这不是留克·奥拉！这是什么意思？！

我上当了！兹瓦林那个笨蛋会付出沉重的代价的！而我却几乎花光了毕生的积蓄，雇你去完成那最后的任务……啊啊啊啊啊！

messages.en:
I've managed to force Zvarin to cough up the location of his nephew, Ryoke. He admitted that Ryoke was actually a Guristas Pirate! I should have known it would turn out this way ... not only is this guy a rapist but he's also a member of the most feared criminal organization in the Forge!

Zvarin also gave me the location of his nephew. It took some 'convincing' on my part, but eventually he gave in. Ryoke is apparently on duty in the Guristas Stronghold in Otomainen. They use the area as their main base of operations in this constellation. Bring me his head, on a plate if possible. Nyhaha!
messages.zh:
兹瓦林已经交代了他侄子的藏身之所，更令人吃惊的是，留克是古斯塔斯海盗成员！我早就该猜到事情是这样子的……这家伙不仅是一个罪犯，还是伏尔戈星域最恐怖的犯罪组织成员之一。

据兹瓦林说，留克在欧塔迈伦的古斯塔斯要塞里当差，那儿是古斯塔斯在本星座的主要军事基地之一。把他的人头带来，如果可能最好用盘子托着。啊哈哈！

name.en: Wrongfully Accused - Prove Your Worth (1 of 4)
name.es: Acusación injusta: Demuestra tu valía (1 de 4)

name.ru: Несправедливо обвиненный - докажите свои способности (Wrongfully Accused - Prove Your Worth) (1 из 4)
name.zh: 不正当控告—证明你的价值 (1/4)

messages.en: Bring me the neophite and we'll talk.
messages.zh: 给我新醇岩矿，我们再谈。

messages.en:
I'm in kind of a tight spot at the moment, but I can't reveal anything to you until I'm certain of your intentions. To prove yourself to me, bring me a piece of the extremely valuable mineral, neophite. You'll get it back when I'm done with you, but I really need to have something that will keep you from double-crossing me before I can give you any of the details of my situation.

I hear Akira Helkelen has a little neophite in stock; you might want to pay him a visit at the Rush Town Ruins if you don't have any neophite yourself.
messages.zh:
此刻我的处境有点险恶，在不了解你的真正意图之前，我不敢向你吐露半点信息。证明一下你的诚意吧，给我带一块极其昂贵的新醇岩矿来。当你完成任务，我会把它还给你。这只是作为抵押，以防在我告诉你详情之后你突然叛变。

如果你没有新醇岩矿，我听说阿基哈•艾尔可棱可能有一个，他在奔走城废墟，你可以去找他谈谈。

messages.en: It's really nothing personal, but I just don't know you well enough to trust you without some kind of collateral. So now that I have this to hang onto, I may be able to give you some real information.
messages.zh: 这并不是对你有什么个人的看法，只是如果没有担保，我无法真正的信任你。现在我有了你的担保，或许就能够向你透露一些真正的信息。

messages.en: Be prepared: I'm sure he has a few of his deputies along for the ride; together they are deadly.
messages.zh: 找到他的时候，做好战斗的准备，我肯定他出战时会随身带几个保镖，他们在一起的话就不好对付了。

messages.en:
I found this woman in a bar in the Lai Dai station in Otitoh, and she seduced me. The next morning, I woke up with a terrible hangover in her bed--a bed which also happened to belong to Officer Eteri Tazaki of the Lai Dai Protection Services.

I've been running ever since. The fact is, every law enforcement officer in this system seems to be corrupt, and by the virtue of his position alone, Tazaki has managed to convince the authorities that I raped his wife. I'm now a wanted man, hunted by those I once trusted with my life. I'm still trying to come to terms with what has happened, but it's hard. I just hope my family doesn't hear about this until I have time to explain everything in person.

Your first task will be a difficult one. The sheriff of Otitoh, Togany, has been snooping around the area looking for me. I think he must have been tipped off by one of the locals, because he's currently scouring the asteroid belts near here, where I usually run at the first sight of law enforcement officers. You must take him out. Destroy his ship or whatever; just prevent him from finding me. I fear that if he's not taken care of soon, I will be caught. If he catches me, he'll call in back-up, and there'll be no stopping them. He's currently located near one of the moons of Otitoh VII. Bring me proof of his demise and you will be rewarded.
messages.zh:
我在欧提托莱戴空间站的一个沙龙里遇到这个女人。实际上是她先同我搭讪的。第二天早上我带着酒后的全身疼痛醒来，发现自己躺在她的卧室床上。这张床同时也是属于艾塔·塔扎基——莱戴护卫服务公司的一个官员。我立即意识到自己犯了大错。

从那以后我就一直在逃命。问题是所有在这个星系的执法官员都被收买了。这还不说，塔扎基还向当局指控我侮辱了他的妻子。我现在是一个被通缉的人，被那些我曾经以命相授的人所追捕。我想和他协商解决这件事情，但这很难。我只希望在我能有机会亲自澄清事实之前，不要让我的家人知道这件事。

你的第一个任务非常困难。欧提托的托贾尼警长已经在这个地区寻找我的下落。为了不被发现，我每次都是一看到执法人员就马上逃走，而他正在对这儿附近的行星地带进行地毯式搜索，一定是某个本地人向他告了密。你必须去把他干掉。摧毁他的飞船或者随便什么，反正不要让他找到我。如果不尽快干掉他，估计不久我就会被发现。到时他请求增援，那事情就没有回旋的余地了。他目前在欧提托VII的某个卫星附近。把可以证明他死亡的证据带给我，我会给你报酬的。

messages.en:
Amazing stuff, {[character]player.name}. I didn't expect you to bring him here alive, but I'm quite pleased; this won't go over as badly with the authorities as killing him would've. I'll keep him prisoner on my ship until I've managed to get away from Okkelen, then I'll release him. Now we have to move fast: once the authorities figure out their sheriff is missing, they'll send out search teams, and then I'll be in serious trouble.

Get ready for your next assignment.
messages.zh:
本事不小啊，{[character]player.name}。我本没指望你能把他活着带来这里，不过我很高兴，这比干掉他更能让当局接受。我会把他囚禁在我的飞船上，等我逃出欧克勒恩，就放了他。现在我们必须迅速行动，一旦当局发现他们的郡长不见了，他们就会派出搜索队，那时我们麻烦就大了。

准备你的下一个任务吧。

messages.en: Find sheriff Togany near one of the moons of Otitoh VII, and bring proof of his demise to {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 去欧提托VII的某个卫星那儿找到托贾尼警长，把可以证明他死亡的东西拿给{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Objectives
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en:
Now that I have your attention, I'll tell you my story. I am a prominent salesman sent to Otitoh on a special assignment from Expert Distribution. Well… I was.

I was born and raised in New Caldari, and I wasn't prepared for the harsh life of this run-down system. My first few months here were quite difficult, and I often thought about abandoning my work here and running back to my family.

In my depressed and lonely state, I needed a companion: someone to ease the tension of everyday life here. My wife refused to leave our home in New Caldari, so I had no one. So, I was completely helpless when I stumbled upon a beautiful young woman who seemed to be caught up in the same situation that I was. There was no one around who gave a damn.

I found her in a bar in the Lai Dai station in Otitoh. She actually started the conversation— considering how I was brought up, I'm not used to a woman taking the initiative in such matters. Anyway, next thing I knew, I was waking up the next morning in her bedroom with a terrible hangover. Before I had time to fully clothe myself, I discovered my mistake: the door to the apartment opened and a short, gnarled old man came in. As soon as I saw him, I knew I was in trouble.

That man was Eteri Tazaki, an officer of the Lai Dai Protection Services. He was furious, but— fortunately for me—unarmed. He chased me out of the apartment, calling for the guards. I managed to escape into a nearby alley, and, with my heart about to explode, I ran as fast as I could to the hangar bay.

I've been running ever since. The fact is, every law enforcement officer in this system seems to be corrupt, and by the virtue of his position alone, Tazaki has managed to convince the authorities that I raped his wife. I'm now a wanted man, hunted by those I once trusted with my life. I'm still trying to come to terms with what has happened, but it's hard. I just hope my family doesn't hear about this until I have time to explain everything in person.

What I need from you, {[character]player.name}, is help to escape this constellation. I can't risk trying to make the jump out of here without adequate preparation; if I'm caught, I could end up in prison for the rest of my life. That's something I want to avoid at all costs, especially in these parts.

Your first task will be a difficult one. The sheriff of Otitoh, Togany, has been snooping around the area looking for me. I think he must have been tipped off by one of the locals, because he's currently scouring the asteroid belts near here, where I usually run at the first sight of law enforcement officers. You must take him out— destroy his ship or whatever; just prevent him from finding me. I fear that if he's not taken care of soon, I will be caught. If he catches me, he'll call in back-up, and there'll be no stopping them. He's currently located near one of the moons of Otitoh VII. Bring me proof of his demise and you will be rewarded.
messages.zh:
听好了，现在让我给你讲讲我自己的故事。我现在是……不，以前是一个杰出的销售员，从行家物流公司被派往欧提托执行某项特别任务。我在新加达里出生、长大，并没有想在这个逐渐恶化的星系里过如此残酷的生活。这么说吧，我到这里的前几个月是非常艰难的，而且我经常想放弃我在这儿的工作，然后回到我新加达里的家里。

当我沮丧和孤独的时候，我需要有个伴，一个可以缓解这里每天生活紧张的人。我的妻子拒绝离开我们在新卡达利的家，所以我是独身一人。在我孤立无援的时候，一个年轻漂亮的女人走进了我的生活，她似乎与我的境况相同，被她周围的人厌弃。

我在欧提托莱戴空间站的一个沙龙里遇到她。实际上是她先开口的，因为我来自新加达里，还不习惯这么热情的女人……长话短说，第二天早上我宿醉醒来，发现自己躺在她的卧室床上。我立即意识到自己犯了大错。在我还没有完全穿好衣服之前，公寓的门开了，进来一个又矮又粗糙的老男人。一看到他，我就知道麻烦来了。

这个人是艾塔•塔扎基，莱戴护卫服务公司的官员。他当然愤怒难当，幸好当时他没有带枪。我以百米赛跑的速度冲出公寓，他紧追不舍，还叫来了警卫。我逃到附近的一个小巷里，心跳不止，都快跳出胸口了。最后我成功抵达了飞机棚。从那以后，我就一直亡命天涯。艾塔在这个星系中也是有头有脸的人物，他很顺利地让权威人士相信，我污辱了他妻子。我现在是一个被通缉的人，被那些我曾经以命相授的人所追捕。我想和他协商解决这件事情，但这的确很难。我只希望在我能有机会亲自澄清事实之前，不要让我的家人知道这件事。

我要你帮我逃离这个星系，{[character]player.name}。在没有充分作好准备之前，我不敢冒险尝试。因为万一被抓住的话，我的后半生将在牢狱里度过。这就是我不惜任何代价想要避免事端，尤其在这种地方，牢狱很可能过于拥挤，并且要饱受疾病折磨。

你的第一个任务非常困难。欧提托的托贾尼警长已经在这个地区寻找我的下落。为了不被发现，我每次都是一看到执法人员就马上逃走，而他正在对这儿附近的行星地带进行地毯式搜索，一定是某个本地人向他告了密。你必须去把他干掉，摧毁他的飞船或者至少阻止他找到我。如果不尽快干掉他，估计不久我就会被发现，到时他请求增援，那事情就没有回旋的余地了。他目前在欧提托VII的某个卫星附近。把可以证明他死亡的证据带给我，我会给你报酬的。

name.en: Wrongfully Accused - The Cloaking Device (3 of 4)
name.es: Acusación injusta: El dispositivo de camuflaje (3 de 4)
name.fr: Accusé à tort - Le dispositif de camouflage (3 sur 4)
name.ru: Несправедливо обвиненный - устройство маскировки (Wrongfully Accused - The Cloaking Device) (3 из 4)

messages.en:
Now that you've neutralized the sheriff, it's time to prepare my getaway ship. I will need a cloaking device to keep myself from being detected, just in case CONCORD or Customs have been notified about me. Being cloaked doesn't make my plan foolproof, but it will increase my chance of escape significantly.

You should be able to find a Prototype Cloaking Device on the market; I'd buy it myself if I wasn't trying to lie low. If you don't think you'll be able to get ahold of one, don't screw me around.. just don't bother taking this job.
messages.zh:
你消除了那个要捉我的治安官的威胁，现在应该要给我准备一艘逃跑的飞船。我需要一个隐形装置，这样星门的海关官员或统合部巡逻兵就无法侦察到我，这也是为了以防万一，说不定他们已经收到了对我的逮捕令。使用隐形装备虽然不能确保万无一失，但至少大大减少了被抓获的几率。

你应该能够在市场上找到隐形装置的原型机，我不想自己去买是为了防止暴露自己的行踪。你的任务就是找到有卖这种装备的地方，然后给我弄台过来。如果你觉得自己没法找到这个东西，就省点力气不要接受这个任务，我现在的时间不容许失误。

messages.en: Ah, this will do nicely.  You did well, {[character]player.name}. Now there's just one more obstacle to overcome before I can get out of here.
messages.zh: 啊，这样就行了。干得不错，{[character]player.name}，要让我能离开这里，还剩下一个障碍需要清除。

messages.en:
I'm almost ready to set off for the outer regions, where I can hide until my lawyer clears my name, but there's one final obstacle. I was scanning the stargate to Ihakana from a great distance to avoid detection, when I noticed a few Caldari bandits led by Bai Tarziiki camping nearby. I remember seeing Bai's face in a news bulletin a while back; he's reputed to be a member of the Kazka Bandits, a notorious gang of outlaw mercenaries in these parts. They are also rumored to have close ties with the corrupt security forces in Otitoh, which Eteri is a part of.

I'm not sure what Bai is up to, but I have a sinking feeling that he was sent by Eteri to block my exit. He probably knows that Ihakana is the first place I would go to. Outlaws like Bai are experts at sniffing out people in hiding, so there's no doubt that he has an anti-cloaking device and multiple scanners on his ship. I can't afford to take this kind of chance: if they catch me I'll be tortured and killed.

Your last task is simple. Take out Bai, and bring me proof that he won't bother me anymore. His corpse will do.
messages.zh:
我差不多准备完毕，可以出发去外层空域了，我会一直藏在那儿直到人们淡忘这件事，或者直到我的律师能为我洗脱罪名。但现在还有一个问题。为了避免被发现，我从远处打探了一下通往以哈坎拿的星门，发现由拜•塔尔兹基率领的几个海盗在附近扎营。不久前在一个新闻公告板上，我见过拜的面孔，他是卡兹卡强盗组织的成员，这个海盗组织臭名远扬，由这片地区的一帮逃亡佣兵组成，他们常常充当刺客。不仅如此，据说他们还与艾塔所在的欧提托的腐败保安队关系密切。

我不清楚拜在搞什么鬼，但我隐隐感到艾塔派他来是阻止我出逃的。他很可能已经知道我要去的第一个地方就是以哈坎拿。找寻藏身地是拜这种逃犯的长项，毫无疑问，他的飞船上装有反隐形装置，还有许多扫描器。我不能冒被抓住的危险，一旦我落到他手里，绝对是死路一条。

交给你的任务很简单。消灭拜，把可以证明他已经死亡的东西带回来，就算他的尸体也可以。

messages.en: Finally, I'm ready to go.  It's been a pleasure working with you, {[character]player.name}. I hope you enjoy your reward.
messages.zh: 我终于要走了。能与你共事真太好了，{[character]player.name}，希望这些酬劳能使你满意。

messages.en: I'm not a friend of this 'Jakon' fellow, and I'll prove it by killing him if you want.  As long as the price is right of course.
messages.zh: 我不是和“贾恐”一伙的，如有需要，我可以干掉他来证明自己的清白。当然，只要价格合适。

messages.en:
Well in that case stay as long as you want. But don't bother going after Jakon, I don't want anything to do with killing him, it would get me into even deeper trouble. All I want is to clear my name. You see I used to be a respectable Caldari State citizen, with an unfortunate habit of finding myself in the nearest casino whenever I am on vacation. It so happens that a few weeks ago, when I was spending the night in the Diamond Ace Den, I got caught up in a bet with someone I shouldn't have. I was drunk at the time and not thinking straight, but excuses aside I lost the bet and didn't have the cash available to pay for it. So you see I'm kind of in a ... erm ... tight spot at the moment.

I've been hiding here ever since the incident in the Den. Nobody ever comes to these old ruins, so I'm pretty sure I'll survive. But I'm terribly bored, this feels like a prison to me. So you must help me clear my name, it's the only way I'll be able to leave this place with my head intact.

The man who won the bet against me is Jakon, an infamous Amarrian scumbag of the Blood Raider cult. He lives in Otitoh along with his Kazka Bandit friends. I wouldn't approach him if I were you, rumor has it that he can kill a man simply by looking at him. I don't know if it's true or not, but just stay clear of him will you.

Anyway, my first problem is that I lost my shuttle when I made my hasty escape from the Diamond Ace Den after I lost the bet. I had parked it outside but it was surrounded by Kazka goons, so I had to find another means of escape. The shuttle has some valuables on board, just some family photos and personal information, nothing a pirate would care for. Not to mention I received it as a birthday present from my father, and I definitely wouldn't want him to find out about my current situation.

Your first task is to retrieve this shuttle for me. Bring it here and I'll reward you well. You'll find it near one of the moons orbiting Otitoh VII, which is pretty close to the Diamond Ace Den. I tried going back after it myself just after I escaped, but I fled when I saw all the Kazka ships guarding it. I forget which moon it was, you'll have to find it yourself, can't be too hard though. Also, expect a number of cruisers as well as warp scramblers guarding it. You'll probably need friends to help you out clearing the guards, as well as an industrial to transport the shuttle to me. Jakon probably expects me to show up sooner or later looking for my shuttle, so he'll keep it there until he finds me.
messages.zh: 我曾经是个受人尊敬的加达里合众国国民，不过我不幸有个爱好，就是在假期时，一定要去赌两把。就在几个星期前，当我正在钻石王牌游乐场彻夜狂欢时，和某人打了一个不该打的赌。当时我醉意盎然，思路一片混乱，不过这些都是借口，我最后赌输了，身边没有足够的现金还债。所以如你所见，我现在的处境……嗯……十分尴尬。<br><br>在游乐场事件之后我就一直躲在这里。没人会到这种旧废墟来，所以我肯定能捡条命。但我实在无聊极了，这里就好象牢狱一样。所以你必须帮助我洗刷赌债，这是能让我活着离开这儿的唯一方法。<br><br>那个打赌赢了我的人叫贾恐，隶属血袭者，是个臭名昭著的艾玛流氓。他和他的卡兹卡强盗朋友一起住在欧提托。如果我是你，我绝对不会接近他，传说他可以用眼神吓倒你。我不知道这是不是真的，不过你最好和他保持距离。<br><br>好吧，现在的首要问题是，我在赌输了后从钻石王牌游乐场仓皇逃离时弄丢了穿梭机。我把它停在了游乐场外，但它四周围满了卡兹卡强盗，所以我只得用别的方法逃跑。那架穿梭机上有一些宝贵的东西，家庭相册和私人资料之类的，不过海盗绝不会感兴趣。那架穿梭机还是父亲送我的生日礼物，我可不想让他知道我现在的境况。<br><br>你的第一个任务就是帮我找回穿梭机。把它带过来，我会好好奖励你。你能在环绕欧提托VII的某个卫星附近找到它，那儿离钻石王牌游乐场相当近。在我成功脱逃后曾试着亲自去找回它，但一看到穿梭机旁重重守卫的卡兹卡强盗飞船，我就飞也似的逃了。我忘了具体是哪个卫星，你得自己找一下，应该不会很难。<font color=#EE0000>还有，要做好心理准备，穿梭机有许多巡洋舰和跃迁扰频器守卫。你可能需要一些朋友帮助你扫清守卫，别忘了还要带一艘工业舰把我的穿梭机运回来。</font>贾恐可能认定我迟早会回来找穿梭机，所以他把穿梭机留在那等我上钩。

messages.en: Amazing!  I didn't expect you to come back in one piece, {[character]player.name}.  But now that you're back, with my shuttle, I'm starting to regain the will to go on.  I've been on the verge of suicide for the past few days while hauled up in this barren dust-strewn wasteland, but you've just given me hope again!  Stick around, there's just a couple more things I need you to do for me before we're through.
messages.zh: 真不可思议！我本来没指望你能全身而退，{[character]player.name}。但现在你回来了，还带着我的穿梭机，这使我重新燃起成功的希望。我这几天被困在这个荒凉的鬼地方，好几次差点想要自尽，幸亏你又给我带来了希望！别急着走，我们还有很多事等着你帮助做完呢。

messages.en: You're not part of the Kazka Bandits, are you {[character]player.name}?  I'm warning you, I'm armed and dangerous ... I suggest you turn around and go your merry way before I send you back to Jakon in a bodybag.
messages.zh: 你不是卡兹卡强盗，对吗，{[character]player.name}？我警告你，我有武器，我很危险……趁我把你装在裹尸袋里送给贾恐之前，我劝你赶快溜之大吉吧。

name.es: La deuda del jugador: Se necesita dopamina (2 de 3)
name.fr: La dette du joueur – Besoin de dopamine (2 sur 3)
name.ja: ギャンブルのツケ―ドーパミン不足（2/3）
name.ru: Картежный долг — нужен допамин (Gambler's Debt — Dopamine Needed) (2 из 3)

messages.en: Now you might be asking yourself, why does he want these items of his if he's gonna escape from this place anyway?  Well simply put, I can't trust my life with you {[character]player.name}, the Kazka Bandits are just too powerful in these parts.  If something happens to you, I wouldn't want to be stuck here for the rest of my life without anything to pass time with.
messages.zh: 现在也许你会觉得奇怪，既然我想要从这个地方逃走，为什么还要这些东西呢？简而言之，{[character]player.name}，我不能将生命作为赌注倾注在你身上，卡兹卡强盗在这些地区势力太强大了。如果你发生了意外，我就得一个人在这儿度过余生，总得找些玩意来打发时间吧。

messages.en: To ease my suffering, I require my entertainment systems.  I left them on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} before I set off to the Diamond Ace Den, and I'm sure Jakon has some friends of his snooping about the area incase I try to get back to my apartment there.  You'll have to be extra careful not to be spotted, I wouldn't want them following you back here, that would be the end of me for sure.
messages.zh: 为了舒缓一下我的痛苦，我需要我的娱乐系统。在出发去钻石王牌游乐场前，我把这些娱乐设备都留在了{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}。我肯定贾恐派了朋友在这个地区巡视，以防我回那里的公寓去。你必须格外小心，不要被发现。我可不想他们跟踪你到这里，否则我就玩完了。

messages.en: You did good, {[character]player.name}.  Now there's just one thing left to be done, clear my name!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！{[character]player.name}。只剩一件事要做了，恢复我的名声！

messages.en: To ease my suffering, I require my entertainment systems.  I left them on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} before I set off to the Diamond Ace Den, and I'm sure Jakon has some friends of his snooping about the area incase I try to get back to my apartment there.  You'll have to be extra careful not to be spotted, I wouldn't want them following you back here, that would be the end of me for sure.
messages.zh: 我需要娱乐设施来放松一下。在我出发去钻石王牌游乐场前，把这些娱乐设备都留在了{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}。我敢肯定贾恐的朋友们正在这个地区四处巡视，以防我回到那里的公寓。你必须格外小心，不要被发现。如果他们跟踪你到这里，那我就玩完了。

name.en: Gambler's Debt - Repay The Debt (3 of 3)
name.es: La deuda del jugador: Saldar la deuda (3 de 3)
name.fr: La dette du joueur – Rembourser sa dette (3 sur 3)
name.ja: ギャンブルのツケ―借りを返す（3/3）
name.ru: Картежный долг — возвращение долга (Gambler's Debt — Repay The Debt) (3 из 3)

messages.en: There's just one final task I need you to complete.  And that is to help me acquire the one item that will help me clear my name.  I'm looking for a piece of neophite mineral, which is an extremely valuable mineral found in very remote areas of the galaxy.  I am certain that Jakon will forget my bet in exchange for this priceless item.  I've heard that you can find it somewhere in Okkelen, but I can't be too sure.  If you stumble upon it in your travels, then let me know.  Don't bother accepting this mission if you don't have it or know how to acquire it, because I have no idea where to find this item.
messages.zh: 我还有最后一个任务需要你完成。就是帮我获取一样能洗刷我债务的东西。我想找一块新醇岩矿，那是一种极其珍贵的矿物，只在星系的边远区域才有。我想如果用这块无价之宝做交换，贾恐一定会免去我的债务。我听说在欧克勒恩的某个地方能找到这种矿物，但我也不太肯定。如果你在四处飞行时碰巧发现了它，请通知我。如果你没有这种矿物，也不知道怎么弄到它，就省点力气，不要接下这个任务，因为我压根就不知道它在哪。

messages.en: Unbelievable!  I wasn't even too sure that neophite exists, but you found it!  I'm forever in your debt, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 真是难以置信！我甚至不敢肯定新醇岩矿是否存在，可你居然找到了它！我永远不会忘了你，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: There's just one final task I need you to complete.  And that is to help me acquire the one item that will help me clear my name.  I'm looking for a piece of neophite mineral, which is an extremely valuable mineral found in very remote areas of the galaxy.  I am certain that Jakon will forget my bet in exchange for this priceless item.  I've heard that you can find it somewhere in Okkelen, but I can't be too sure.  If you stumble upon it in your travels, then let me know.  Don't bother accepting this mission if you don't have it or know how to acquire it, because I have no idea where to find this item.
messages.zh: 我还有最后一个任务交给你：帮我找一样东西来还我清白。听说过新醇岩矿么，只有在星系的边远区域才有的稀有矿石，价值连城，足够支付我欠下的赌债。据说欧克勒恩的某个角落有这种矿石，但是我不能肯定。如果你曾经碰到过，请告诉我。不然就不用接受这个任务了，因为我完全不知道去哪儿找这种矿石，也没法提供任何线索给你。

name.en: Wagon Christ - Scanning The Heavens (1 of 3)
name.fr: Wagon Christ –Détection dans les cieux (1 sur 3)
name.ru: Wagon Christ - сканируя небеса (Wagon Christ - Scanning The Heavens) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 马厩中的圣人—扫描天堂 (1/3)

messages.en:
Hello {[character]player.name}, I'm {[character]agentID.name} and with me here in the Bustard is my entire family. We left our home on Airkio VII - Moon 3 - Lai Dai Corporation Factory, intent on settling somewhere in the wild frontier, and ended up here in Otomainen. We originally set off with two ships, one Badger carrying our supplies, and then the Bustard carrying us. The Badger was piloted by a close friend of mine, Tari Ykonan, may he rest in peace, who was killed in a cowardly pirate attack near the Rush Town Ruins in this system. The attack damaged our ship and left us stranded here in this desolate place.

Now we need to replenish our supplies to survive the rest of the trip. We are still intent on settling here, it's too late to turn back now. We have enough food supplies in the Bustard's cargo hold to last us at least a few months, so that's not a problem.

The first item I need is a system scanner. You'll find one that I purchased on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, bring it here a.s.a.p.
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}。我是{[character]agentID.name}，在这艘大鸨级运输舰上除了我，还有我的家人，他们和我一起离开了我们在埃尔克伊欧VII—卫3莱戴集团工厂的家园，一心想在荒芜的边境地区定居，最后，我们终于来到了欧塔迈伦。我们有两艘飞船，一艘獾级货船装载我们的给养，另一艘就是现在载着我们的大鸨级运输舰。我的密友塔利•科南曾是獾级货船的驾驶员，不幸的是他已在本星系奔走城附近的一次海盗袭击中丧生。我们的飞船在那次袭击中重创受损，使我们搁浅在这个渺无人烟的地方。

我们现在需要一些补给来保障我们接下来的行程。我们还在考虑在这里定点，因为返回已经是不可能的了。我们有一些食物在大鸨级运输舰的货柜里，这些食物能满足我们数个月的需要，所以食品问题并不是很严重。

我想要的第一件东西是一个星系扫描器，你会在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}找到一个，那是我买来的，尽快把它带到这里来。

name.ja: 宇宙の箱舟―失われた物資（2/3）
name.ru: Wagon Christ - утерянные припасы (Wagon Christ - Lost Supplies) (2 из 3)
name.zh: 马厩中的圣人—抢回补给 (2/3)

messages.en:
Now I'd like you to retrieve the supply crates which were stolen from us by the bandit vermin. They should be located somewhere near Rush Town Ruins, where we were ambushed. Possibly in one of the asteroid belts near the planet, we passed a large group of them there when traveling to Rush Town. You'll know you found them when you see a Mordu's ship accompanied by a bunch of Caldari bandits. The pilot flying the Mordu's ship is a renegade and has no affiliation anymore to the Legion, so you need feel no remorse in destroying him.

I do hope they still have our supply crates. If they do, retrieve them for me from the charred remains of their ships. Leave no survivors, I want them all dead. You hear me? DEAD!
messages.zh:
现在我要你取回被那些强盗拿走的补给箱。他们应该在奔走城废墟附近的某处，我们就是在那遭到伏击的。可能就在行星附近的一片小行星带里，我们在驶向奔走城时穿过了好大群行星带。当你看到一艘莫德团飞船和一帮加达里海盗时，你就找到了目标。驾驶莫德团飞船的是一个叛徒，与莫德团不再有任何关联，对他不必手下留情。

我真希望那些补给箱还在他们手里。要是果真如此，就从他们烧焦的飞船残骸里把补给箱取回来。消灭所有人，我要他们统统去死。听到了吗？死！

messages.en: You really are a good fighter pilot, {[character]player.name}, those bandits seemed pretty damn tough when they attacked us.  You're probably even good enough to complete the final mission I have in store for you.
messages.zh: 你真是个好战士，{[character]player.name}，不过那些强盗来袭击我们的时候似乎相当麻烦。你甚至很可能可以胜任我给你准备的最终任务了。

messages.en: You might be wondering how we'll store all the containers, due to their total size they won't all fit into our cargo hold.  Which is why we'll keep them stored in one of the asteroids here, and slowly transport them to our new settlement.
messages.zh: 你可能很好奇，我们该怎么储存所有这些集装箱呢，毕竟它们体积巨大，不可能全部放入我们的货柜舱中。所以，我们会先把它们存放在这里的一颗小行星里，然后慢慢运输到我们的新殖民地。

name.en: Wagon Christ - Into The Darkness (3 of 3)
name.es: Wagon Christ: Hacia la oscuridad (3 de 3)
name.fr: Wagon Christ – Dans les ténèbres (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 宇宙の箱舟―暗闇の中へ（3/3）
name.ru: Wagon Christ - во тьму (Wagon Christ - Into The Darkness) (3 из 3)
name.zh: 马厩中的圣人—遁入黑暗 (3/3)

messages.en:
Now that we have salvaged all the supplies we need for the time being, it's time to find the promised land. You see, we didn't come to Otomainen by pure chance, there is a reason for us choosing this system as our new home. A few years ago, we heard of a great Monolith, one of the famous Black Monoliths which are a very rare sight indeed in our galaxy. My wife actually stumbled upon it in a news report on the KLC network.

When we decided to leave on our adventure, we were convinced that this monolith would be the key to our fortune. Not only is it a beautiful sight, it also holds an enormous commercial value. Imagine how much people, especially the Amarrian religious fanatics who view the Monoliths as some kind of symbol of their faith, would pay for viewing the object. We'll change this run-down system into a major hub of tourist activity!

But there's one catch to our plan. The Black Monolith is located inside a deadspace pocket, which happens to be inhabited by the Sansha envoy to the Guristas forces in Okkelen. He has a sizable entourage with him as well. Eliminate this hindrance and we will be eternally grateful, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我们已经抢回了目前需要的所有供给，是时候去寻找我们的希望之乡了。要知道，我们来到欧塔迈伦并非纯属偶然，选择这个星系作为我们的新家是事出有因的。几年前，我们听说了巨型石块的事，那是一种有名的黑色巨石，这在我们的星系极为罕见。我妻子偶然在KLC网络的一则新闻中得知了这种巨石。<br><br>当我们决定踏上冒险之途时，我们深信这块巨石会是我们打开财富之门的钥匙。它不仅外观美丽，更具有巨大的商业价值。想想吧，会有多少人愿意付钱来一睹这种巨石的尊容，尤其是艾玛人中那些视巨石为信仰象征的狂热信仰者。我们会靠自己的努力将这个破败的星系变为一个人潮如织的观光胜地！<br><br>不过我们的计划还有一个阻碍。巨型石块位于一个死亡空间层内，碰巧那里居住着萨沙驻欧克勒恩的古斯塔斯部队特使。他周围还有一大堆随从。{[character]player.name}，清除这个障碍，我们会永远感激你的。

messages.en: I'm amazed that you managed to pull it off, {[character]player.name}.  Before we were attacked by the Kazka Bandits and our supplies stolen, I had sent 3 groups of mercenaries to clear the area of Sansha ships.  They all failed.  Yet you came through victorious.  Obviously, I have underestimated you.  Take your reward and enjoy.
messages.zh: 你竟然做到了，真让人吃惊，{[character]player.name}。在卡兹卡强盗袭击我们并劫走补给之前，我曾派出3组佣兵去清除那一区域的萨沙飞船。可他们都失败了。还好你得胜归来。很明显，我低估你了。这是你的报酬，拿好了。
