name.es: El dilema de Hotaru: Intruso (1 de 4)
name.ja: ホタルのジレンマ-侵入者（1/4）
name.ru: Дилемма Hotaru - нарушитель границ (Hotaru's Dilemma - Trespasser) (1 из 4)

messages.en:
Those bastards, the Zhara have gone over the line this time. First they offered to buy me out, then when I refused they sent in some of their goons to 'convince' me to change my mind. When that failed Gatti himself flew in on his blasted battleship and drove me out with force. And to top it all, the corrupt security forces won't do anything! That asteroid belt is mine, I tell you, MINE!

If you want to help me out, then you gotta prove yourself by killing Gatti. You'll find him camping the Otomainen XIII asteroid belt. He's a wealthy land-owner who has close ties with the Kazka Bandits. The Zhara family are very powerful in these parts, so I doubt killing Gatti will be enough to end this matter, but it's a start. Once you've finished the job, bring me evidence of his demise and I'll give you your reward.
messages.zh:
那些混蛋，扎拉人这次太过分了。他们一开始想出钱收买我，在遭到我的断然拒绝后，就派了一些打手来“说服”我改变心意。当这招也不灵时，盖提本人亲自开着那艘该死的战列舰，用武力将我赶了出来。更火上加油的是，那些腐败的保安部队竟然完全无动于衷！告诉你，那个小行星带是我的，我的！

如果你想帮我走出困境，那么就显示你的诚意，把盖提干掉。你会在欧塔迈伦XIII的小行星带找到他。他是个富有的地主，与卡兹卡强盗关系密切。扎拉家族在这些地方势力庞大，除掉盖提可能不足以了结此事，但这好歹也是个开始。一旦你完成任务，把可以证明他死亡的证据带回来，我会给你报酬的。

messages.en: Gatti's demise will surely anger the Zhara family, who will undoubtedly send some of their goons to settle the score.  I'll need you here for a few more assignments before I can safely fly back to my veldspar roids.
messages.zh: 盖提的死肯定会激怒扎拉家族，他们毫无疑问会派人来报仇。在我安全回到我的凡晶石小行星带之前，你得留下来再帮我执行几个任务。

name.en: Hotaru's Dilemma - Empty The Load (2 of 4)
name.es: El dilema de Hotaru: Vaciar la carga (2 de 4)
name.fr: Le dilemme d'Hotaru – Vider les soutes (2 sur 4)
name.ja: ホタルのジレンマ-積荷を片付けろ（2/4）
name.ru: Дилема Hotaru - избавиться от груза (Hotaru's Dilemma - Empty The Load) (2 из 4)
name.zh: 奥塔鲁的困境—清空负载 (2/4)

messages.en:
Now what I need you to do is deliver a batch of veldspar ore to a location not far from here. I was supposed to drop off the batch there for one of my clients, but Gatti's attack 'complicated' matters. I dare not leave my current location, if an agent of the Zhara family or Kazka Bandits spots me, I'm done for.

I managed to smuggle the ore out of the asteroid belt during my escape, so as long as you can bring an industrial over here then you're all set to go.
messages.zh:
现在我所要你做的是把这批凡晶石送到离这里不远的一个地方。我本该把这批矿石运给我在那儿的一个客户，但是盖提的袭击使事情“复杂化”了。我不敢离开现在的位置，要是让扎拉家族或卡兹卡强盗的特工发现，我就玩完了。

在逃跑的时候，我设法将矿石从小行星带偷偷运了出来，你只要开艘工业舰到这儿来就能出发了。

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。你暂时还不能走开，我有另外一个任务要你去完成。

messages.en:
Now what I need you to do is deliver a batch of veldspar ore to a location not far from here. I was supposed to drop off the batch there for one of my clients, but Gatti's attack 'complicated' matters. I dare not leave my current location, if an agent of the Zhara family or Kazka Bandits spots me, I'm done for.

I managed to smuggle the ore out of the asteroid belt during my escape, so as long as you can bring an industrial over here then you're all set to go.
messages.zh:
现在我所要你做的是把这批凡晶石送到离这儿不远的一个地方。我本来想把这批矿石给我在那儿的一个委托人的，但是盖提的袭击使情况变得有些复杂。我不敢离开，要是让扎拉家族的或卡兹卡强盗的某个代理人发现，我就玩完了。

在逃离的时候，我成功地将矿石从小行星带偷偷运了出来，只要你能开艘工业舰到这儿来就能提货了。

name.de: Hotarus Dilemma - Brechen der Blockade (3 von 4)
name.en: Hotaru's Dilemma - Break The Blockade (3 of 4)
name.es: El dilema de Hotaru: Romper el bloqueo (3 de 4)
name.fr: Le dilemme d'Hotaru – Forcer le blocus (3 sur 4)
name.ja: ホタルのジレンマ-封鎖を突破せよ（3/4）
name.ru: Дилемма Hotaru - прорыв блокады (Hotaru's Dilemma - Break The Blockade) (3 из 4)
name.zh: 奥塔鲁的困境—打破封锁 (3/4)

messages.en:
I just received a transmission from my family on Otomainen XI, apparently the Kazka Bandits have erected a blockade at key areas around the planet to prevent anyone associated with me to leave or enter in one piece. Of course the local authorities haven't lifted a finger yet to stop these pirates from going along with their business, since XI is so sparsely populated and the Kazka Bandits have close ties to some of the corrupt officials here.

Since the planet is not technically habitable, my family has to live inside an enclosed bio dome, and we are totally dependant on supply convoys to survive. We have a little agriculture going on down there inside the dome, but not enough to feed the entire population. I'm afraid that if the Kazka become desperate, they might cut off our food supply and force the mayor to order my family to leave. That would surely be their death sentence.

The blockade is comprised of Kazka thugs, lead by one of their leaders, Pata Wakori. Kill their leader, and I'm sure you'll kill the blockade.

The deadpsace pocket is hidden from passive sensors. You will need to use probes to scan down the Kazka blockade. Take care of them quickly will you, time is of the essence here.
messages.zh:
我刚刚从欧塔迈伦XI的我的家人那里收到消息，显然，卡兹卡强盗在行星周围的关键区域设置了封锁线，试图阻止任何与我有关的人进出。当然，由于 XI人烟稀少，并且卡兹卡强盗与这里的一些腐败官僚关系密切，所以，到目前为止，当局没有采取任何措施来对付这些横行的海盗。

因为这个行星并不适合居住，所以我们一家不得不住在一个模拟生态舱里，完全得依靠护航队送来的补给而生存。在舱内我们也进行了一些农业活动，但这不足以养活所有的人。我担心如果卡兹卡狂性大发，切断我们的食物补给，并勒令市长迫使我们一家离开，我们就死定了。

封锁线由卡兹卡的那些恶棍们组成，而他们由领袖帕忑•瓦戈里率领。干掉他们的领袖，封锁线自然而然会被瓦解。



被动扫描器无法定位那个死亡空间层。你需要利用探针来找出卡兹卡这帮拦路劫匪。尽快将他们消灭，时间宝贵啊。

messages.en: I am very pleased, {[character]player.name}.  My wife just called, and she said your attack on their forces allowed her and my nephew to escape unharmed away from Otomainen XI.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 我很欣慰，{[character]player.name}。我的妻子刚刚打电话来，说你对那些部队的袭击使她和我的外甥平安逃离了欧塔迈伦XI。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

name.es: El dilema de Hotaru: Piezas de la Moa (4 de 4)
name.fr: Le dilemme d'Hotaru – Les pièces du Moa (4 sur 4)
name.ja: ホタルのジレンマ-モアパーツ（4/4）
name.ru: Дилемма Hotaru - запчасти для Moa (Hotaru's Dilemma - Moa Parts) (4 из 4)
name.zh: 奥塔鲁的困境—巨鸟零件 (4/4)

messages.en:
Now for your final task, I need you to collect the parts for my new Moa cruiser. Once it has been assembled, I'll be ready to take on the remnants of those goons the Zhara sent to wreck havoc in my asteroid belt. With Gatti assassinated, I have no fear of those pirates anymore.

You'll find the crates containing the parts in {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, where I bought them off an old junk collector. I need them transferred to my workshop here in the Red Rock Outpost immediately.

You've been of enormous assistance so far, {[character]player.name}, so you fully deserve the generous reward I have in store for you when this job is done.
messages.zh:
这是给你的最后一个任务，我要你为我的新巨鸟级巡洋舰搜集需要的零件。一旦它组装完成，我就可以教训那些扎拉派到我的小行星带里搞破坏的走狗。盖提已死，我再也不用怕那些海盗了。

你会在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}找到装着零件的板箱，这些都是我从一个收垃圾的老头那买的。我要你马上把它们运送到我在红石哨站的工场。

{[character]player.name}，到目前为止，你给了我很大帮助，所以在这次任务结束后，我会给你非常丰厚的报酬。

messages.en: Great, now take your reward and be off with you.  I've got to start assembling that Moa immediately, before more scavengers show up on my property.  No time for chit chat!
messages.zh: 太好了，这是你的报酬，收好后赶快离开吧。在越来越多的人觊觎我的宝贝前，我得赶快装配我的巨鸟级巡洋舰。现在没空和你闲聊。

这是给你的最后一个任务，我要你为我的新巨鸟级巡洋舰搜集一些零件。等我组装完毕，就可以教训扎拉派到我的小行星带里搞破坏的那些散兵游勇。盖提死了，剩下的没一个是我的对手。

你可以在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}找到装着零件的板箱，那是我从一个收垃圾的老头那买的。我要你马上把它们运送到红石哨站的工作室里。

到目前为止，你给了我很大帮助，{[character]player.name}，所以这次任务结束后，我会给你非常丰厚的报酬。

name.fr: Une histoire pas très claire - Concurrence amicale (3 sur 4)
name.ja: 非道なビジネス-好敵手（3/4）
name.ru: Зловещий бизнес - дружеская конкуренция (Nefarious Business - Friendly Competition) (3 из 4)

messages.en: A few independent gun runners have been poking their noses around in my system, undercutting my business.  I've decided this won't go on any longer, and they will have to die.  If you want to act as the arbiter of my wrath, I'll reward you handsomely.  I don't know if these fellas are working for someone or if they're acting independently, but if you succeed in your task it won't matter anyway.  So what do you say?
messages.zh: 有几个独立军火贩子把触角伸到了我的星系，用低价跟我抢生意。我决定终止这一切，他们必须去死。如果你愿意为我发泄怒火，那么我会慷慨地犒劳你的。我不知道这些家伙是不是在为别的什么人工作，或者就是独立运营，不过只要你成功完成任务，那么这些就都无所谓了。那么，你怎么看？

name.en: The Lai Dai Research Project - Ore Shipment - (1 of 3)
name.es: Proyecto de investigación de Lai Dai: Cargamento de menas (1 de 3)
name.fr: Projet de recherche Lai Dai – Cargaison de minerai (1 sur 3)
name.ja: ライダイの研究プロジェクト―鉱石輸送（1/3）
name.ru: Исследовательский проект Lai Dai - поставка руды (The Lai Dai Research Project - Ore Shipment) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 莱戴研究项目—矿石出货 (1/3)

messages.en:
So glad of you to show up, {[character]player.name}. I've been on the lookout for a freelancer for some time now. We're completely overloaded with work here, and there's no end in sight. I am the project manager for the latest research project here in the Lai Dai research center, and we've employed dozens of miners to get us the minerals we need to complete our project but they haven't been able to keep up with the load.

I ordered some Veldspar ore this week, but haven't managed to find any pilot yet who's available for the run. It's not far, you can pick up the shipment at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. Bring it here to the research outpost, and I'll reward you well. After you're done I've got a couple more jobs for you.
messages.zh:
你能露面真是太好了，{[character]player.name}。我一直在找自由飞行员，已经找了好久了。这里的工作已经完全超负荷，我们每天都拼命地做，还是盼不到头。我是在这个莱戴研究中心负责最新研究项目的项目经理。我们雇用了很多矿工为项目开采矿石，但他们的供应量一直跟不上进度。

这星期我订购了一些凡晶石，但还没找到有空的飞行员去帮我取回来。那批货离这儿并不远，就在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}。把它带到研究站，我会给你丰厚的报酬。完成之后，我还有更多的任务给你。

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}.  You seem to be a competent enough pilot, maybe you're even good enough for the other two jobs I have in store for you.  Tell me when you're ready and I'll let you have the next one.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。看来你是一名能干的飞行员，我决定让你执行接下来的两个任务。准备好了之后告诉我一声，到时我会给你新任务。

name.de: Das Lai Dai-Forschungsprojekt - Für meine Freunde etwas mehr - (2 von 3)
name.en: The Lai Dai Research Project - A Little More For My Friends - (2 of 3)
name.es: Proyecto de investigación de Lai Dai: Un poco para mis amigos (2 de 3)
name.fr: Projet de recherche Lai Dai – Un petit coup de main pour les amis (2 sur 3)
name.ja: ライダイの研究プロジェクト―友人のためにもう一手間（2/3）
name.ko: 라이다이 연구 프로젝트 - 친구를 위해 좀만 더 (2/3)
name.ru: Исследовательский проект Lai Dai - кое-что для моих друзей (The Lai Dai Research Project - A Little More For My Friends) (2 из 3)
name.zh: 莱戴研究项目—再帮我个小忙？(2/3)

messages.en: In your last assignment for me you brought back a load of veldspar ore which I had ordered for our project here in the Lai Dai research outpost.  But unfortunately we also need some omber to finish our schedule for this week, and I have been unable to find any for reasonable prices in the vicinity.  But we've become quite desperate now, so I'm willing to pay a very high price for what I need.  Once you acquire the omber, return here and I'll drop it off at our reprocessing facility.
messages.zh: 在上个任务里，你取回了一批凡晶石，那是我为莱戴研究站内进行的项目而订购的。糟糕的是，我们还需要一些奥贝尔石来完成本周预定的工作，但我在附近找不到价位合理的矿石。不过我们现在已经迫不及待了，所以我愿出高价购买。一旦你获得奥贝尔石，回到这来，我会把它们运到加工厂。

messages.en: I had given up all hope of completing our scheduled work for this week, but you've just saved me the humiliation of listening to Arvalen Reurmanen berate me for another failure.  For that I am extremely grateful, Arvalen can be a real pain in the rear-end when she's angry.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 我已经完全放弃完成这星期预定任务的希望了，不过你刚刚使我免于阿珐棱·赫尤玛能的斥责，唉，他会说我总是失败。我实在太感激你了，阿珐棱生气的时候，可是实在让人头痛。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en: In your last assignment for me you brought back a load of veldspar ore which I had ordered for our project here in the Lai Dai research outpost.  But unfortunately we also need some omber to finish our schedule for this week, and I have been unable to find any for reasonable prices in the vicinity.  But we've become quite desperate now, so I'm willing to pay a very high price for what I need.  Once you acquire the omber, return here and I'll drop it off at our reprocessing facility.
messages.zh: 在上一个任务里，你带来了一批凡晶石，那是我为莱戴研究站内进行的项目而定制的。不幸的是，我们还需要一些奥贝尔石来完成本周预定的工作，我在附近找不到价格合理的矿石。但现在我们急需奥贝尔石，我愿出高价购买。找到奥贝尔石之后就赶快回来，我会托人把它们运到加工厂。

name.en: The Lai Dai Research Project - Rogue Drone Risk - (3 of 3)
name.es: Proyecto de investigación de Lai Dai: Drones rebeldes (3 de 3)
name.fr: Projet de recherche Lai Dai – La menace des drones renégats (3 sur 3)
name.ja: ライダイの研究プロジェクト―ローグドローンの危険（3/3）
name.ko: 라이다이 연구 프로젝트 - 로그 드론 위협 (3/3)
name.ru: Исследовательский проект Lai Dai - угроза восставших дронов (The Lai Dai Research Project - Rogue Drone Risk) (3 из 3)
name.zh: 莱戴研究项目—自由无人机风险（3/3）

messages.en:
For your final task I need you to do a quick combat mission for me, {[character]player.name}. You might need some help for this task, depending on your battle experience. But first I'll explain why we need this done.

The reason the miners we employed to strip-mine the local asteroid fields haven't been able to complete the job on time is not just because they're a bunch of lazy sods. Because this system has been relatively unsettled for the past years, a number of rogue drone infestations have cropped up in outlying areas. From their hives in Okkelen they launch their attacks against any human presence they can find. It's one of the reason's my wife didn't want me to take this job … maybe I should have listened to her after all. …

The miners have been driven off on more than one occasion by these drone pests as well as Guristas and Kazka pirate gangs. This has sometimes led to casualties, which is very bad for morale and our productivity here.

There is one particular asteroid belt near here which I have long wanted to strip-mine. It's only infested with a few rogue drones, nothing a veteran combat pilot wouldn't be able to handle. I want these drones eliminated completely, allowing my men to move in safely. Do this quickly so that we can get the job done before more of those things appear. Good luck.
messages.zh:
最后我要你执行一个快速战斗的任务，{[character]player.name}。即使你的战斗经验非常丰富，但或许执行这个任务的时候，你还会需要一些帮手。现在让我解释下这个任务的前因后果。

我们雇矿工在本地的小行星带进行剥挖采矿，但他们并没有按时完成任务。当然这不是因为他们懒惰，这个星系在过去数年里一直相对比较动荡，有大量的自由无人机经常在边远地区出没。它们从在欧克勒恩的机巢蜂拥而至，对能找到的任何人发动攻击。这也是我妻子不想我接手这个任务的一个原因……或许我应该听听她的建议……

我们的矿工已被这些可恶的无人机，外加古斯塔斯以及卡兹卡强盗驱赶了不止一次。有时甚至还有人员伤亡，这对我们的士气和生产都带来了严重的负面影响。

这儿附近有一个特别的行星带，那里有丰富的矿藏可供开采，不过自由无人机也是铺天盖地，对于一个历经战火洗礼的老兵来说消灭他们易如反掌。我要这些无人机统统从宇宙里消失，让我的人能安然入驻。赶快行动吧！

messages.en: With the rogue drones gone, our miners will be able to move in without risking their lives, at least for the time being.  You've been a great assistance to Lai Dai so far, {[character]player.name}, and I do hope you enjoy your reward.  Be safe.
messages.zh: 无人机没了，我的矿工们就可以不再冒着生命危险工作了，至少暂时是这样。这段日子你为莱戴集团提供了很大帮助，{[character]player.name}，希望这些酬劳能使你满意。注意安全。

messages.zh:
最后我要你执行一个快速战斗的任务，{[character]player.name}。即使你的战斗经验非常丰富，但或许执行这个任务的时候，你还会需要一些帮手。现在让我解释下这个任务的前因后果。

我们雇矿工在本地的小行星带进行剥挖采矿，但他们并没有按时完成任务。当然这不是因为他们懒惰，这个星系在过去数年里一直相对比较动荡，有大量的自由无人机经常在边远地区出没。它们从在欧克勒恩的机巢蜂拥而至，对能找到的任何人发动攻击。这也是我妻子不想我接手这个任务的一个原因……或许我应该听听她的建议……

我们的矿工已被这些可恶的无人机，外加古斯塔斯以及卡兹卡强盗驱赶了不止一次。有时甚至还有人员伤亡，这对我们的士气和生产都带来了严重的负面影响。

这儿附近有一个特别的行星带，那里有丰富的矿藏可供开采，不过自由无人机也是铺天盖地，对于一个历经战火洗礼的老兵来说消灭他们易如反掌。我要这些无人机统统从宇宙里消失，让我的人能安然入驻。赶快行动吧！

name.de: Diener der Nugoeihuvi - Vertrauen aufbauen (2 von 3)
name.es: Servir a Nugoeihuvi: Inspirar confianza (2 de 3)
name.fr: Serviteur Nugoeihuvi - Créer la confiance (2 sur 3)
name.ja: ノゴエイハヴィの公僕-信頼の醸成（3/3）
name.ru: Слуга Nugoeihuvi — укрепление доверия (Nugoeihuvi Servant - Creating Trust) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
Those weapons you delivered are being put to good use as we speak, {[character]player.name}. You did an excellent job; I'm beginning to see your qualities as a pilot. I can start giving you some worthwhile assignments now.

We at Nugoeihuvi cannot allow any security liabilities; spies try to infiltrate our ranks every day, and because of that we have to be extremely careful of where we place our trust. If you wish to prove yourself to us further, then go to this location and destroy these targets. They pose a substantial security threat to our nearby operations, and that is something we cannot allow. Complete this and we can be sure you are not on their side.
messages.zh:
我们说话的这当口，你运送的那批武器正充分发挥着作用呢，{[character]player.name}。你做得非常好；我开始察觉到你作为飞行员的资质了。我现在可以给你一些像样的任务了。

纳基维集团内不得出现任何安全问题；间谍们每时每刻都想潜入我们的组织，所以我们必须极其小心，不能错信任何人。如果你想进一步证明自己的诚意，那么就前去这个地点，摧毁这些目标。他们对我们附近的业务构成了严重威胁，这是我们绝不容许的。如果完成这个任务，我们就能相信你不是他们派来的。

name.en: Nugoeihuvi Servant - Advancing in Rank (3 of 3)
name.es: Servir a Nugoeihuvi: Subir de rango (3 de 3)
name.fr: Serviteur Nugoeihuvi – Montée en grade (3 sur 3)
name.ja: ノゴエイハヴィの公僕-昇進（3/3）
name.ru: Слуга Nugoeihuvi - повышение в звании (Nugoeihuvi Servant - Advancing in Rank) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
Well, it seems this will be your last assignment for me. My commanding officers have noticed your abilities and want to give you some tougher assignments. This is the first step to greatness, my friend. Don't screw it up.

These reports contain your employment and assignment history. Take them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for them to examine. If everything checks out alright, you can report back to me and I will tell you where to go next.
messages.zh:
好，这是我给你的最后一个任务。我的指挥官已经注意到了你的能力，今后会给你更有挑战性的工作。这是伟大成功的第一步，我的朋友。别把事情办砸了。

这些报告包含了你被雇用和工作的经历，把它们带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}接受检查。如果一切顺利，马上回来向我汇报，我会告诉你下一步该怎么做。

messages.en: It's been a pleasure, {[character]player.name}. Perhaps we will see one another again sometime in the future.
messages.zh: 合作愉快，{[character]player.name}，没准将来我们还会碰面。

name.de: Arbeiten für Wiyrkomi - Verschwundene Waffenladung (1 von 4)
name.en: Wiyrkomi Freelancing - Missing Weapons Stash (1 of 4)
name.es: Mercenarios de Wiyrkomi: El alijo de armas desaparecido (1 de 4)
name.fr: Indépendant au service des Wiyrkomi – Armes dérobées dans l'arsenal (1 sur 4)
name.ja: ウィルコミの依頼―行方不明の隠し武器（1/4）
name.ko: 위요르코미 프리랜서 임무 - 사라진 은닉 병기 (1/4)
name.ru: Наемник Wiyrkomi - потерянный запас оружия (Wiyrkomi Freelancing - Missing Weapons Stash) (1 из 4)

messages.en:
Are you looking for work? Wiyrkomi is expanding into this area and help would be greatly appreciated. This whole constellation seems to be infested with the scum of the universe. Rogue drones, pirates and ruthless scavengers are everywhere and everybody wants a piece of the action.

Yesterday we discovered that a big part of our weapon stash had gone missing. We have every reason to believe that the Guristas hanging out at the contested Lai Dai Refinery in the Airmia system are behind this theft and would like you, along with others, to go and try to retrieve some of the weapons. If you can complete this task, perhaps I will give you something more rewarding next time.
messages.zh:
你是在找活干吗？维克米集团正在本地区扩张，现在急需帮手。这个星座似乎充斥着宇宙败类。自由无人机、海盗和野蛮的拾荒者无处不在，所有人都想来分一杯羹。

昨天我们发现我们相当一部分武器储备失踪了。我们有充分理由相信，古斯塔斯成员是这起案件的罪魁祸首，他们现正在艾尔米亚星系争夺中的莱戴精炼厂附近出没；我们希望你和你的同伴能前去夺回部分武器。如果你能完成这项任务，可能下次我会给你报酬更高的工作。

messages.en: Thank you.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 谢谢。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

name.es: Mercenarios de Wiyrkomi: Otro trabajo (2 de 4)
name.fr: Indépendant au service des Wiyrkomi – Une autre tâche (2 sur 4)
name.ja: ウィルコミの依頼―更なる依頼（2/4）
name.ko: 위요르코미 프리랜서 임무 - 또 다른 임무 (2/4)
name.ru: Наемник Wiyrkomi - очередное задание (Wiyrkomi Freelancing - Another Task) (2 из 4)
name.zh: 维克米自由战士—另外的任务 (2/4)

messages.en:
Those weapons you retrieved were essential to our effort, thanks to you our troops will be well armed and ready for battle. If they think they can shove us out of this constellatiom they're wrong. We're getting a piece of this cake whether they like it or not.

The battle is far from being won, your services are required for another task. I need you to go to {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and pick up some afterburners. They are a gift from our friends at Propel Dynamics and I want them delivered here in perfect condition. Now, do not screw this up, or it will have dire consequences.
messages.zh:
你取回的武器对我们的事业至关重要，多亏了你，我们的部队能够全副武装应对战斗。如果他们认为能把我们挤出这个星座，那他们可打错算盘了。无论他们愿不愿意，这地方，我们吃定了。

但我们离胜利还很远，我想再让你帮我个忙。我要你去{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}拿一些加力燃烧器。那是推进动态集团的朋友给我们的礼物，我希望它们能完好无损地送到我手里。别把这事搞砸了，否则后果会很严重。

name.en: Wiyrkomi Freelancing - An Ancient Monument (3 of 4)
name.es: Mercenarios de Wiyrkomi: Un monumento ancestral (3 de 4)
name.fr: Indépendant au service des Wiyrkomi – Un antique monument (3 sur 4)
name.ja: ウィルコミの依頼―古代遺跡（3/4）
name.ru: Наемник Wiyrkomi - древний монумент (Wiyrkomi Freelancing - An Ancient Monument) (3 из 4)
name.zh: 维克米自由战士—古碑遗迹 (3/4)

messages.en: I have another task for you, {[character]player.name}. One of our excavators has stumbled upon what seems to be the remains of an ancient monument. The extinct civilizations worshipped many different gods and are believed to have buried hundreds of artifacts around their monuments. If this excavation is successful, it could make us all very rich men. Our problem is that we are sending more people out there right now and have run out of supplies. I need you to go pick up some excavation equipment and deliver it to me, if this goes well perhaps both of us can pay tribute to the only god that matters, the god of more money.
messages.zh: 我有新任务给你，{[character]player.name}。我们的一个挖掘者偶然发现了一个古碑遗迹。已经灭绝的古文明崇拜各种神祗，据信，他们会在墓碑周围埋藏数百件手工制品。如果这次挖掘成功的话，我们就都会成为有钱人。问题是，我们派了更多人前去挖掘现场，现在供给品不够了。我要你去取一些挖掘设备，并送到我这来。如果这事顺利的话，也许我们能向唯一重要的神祗进贡了，那就是财神爷。

name.de: Arbeiten für Wiyrkomi - Erfolglose Ausgrabung (4 von 4)
name.es: Mercenarios de Wiyrkomi: Excavación infructuosa (4 de 4)
name.fr: Indépendant au service des Wiyrkomi – Des fouilles infructueuses (4 sur 4)
name.ja: ウィルコミの依頼―発掘の失敗（4/4）
name.ru: Наемник Wiyrkomi - безуспешные раскопки (Wiyrkomi Freelancing - Unsuccessful Excavation) (4 из 4)

messages.en:
I'm sorry to inform you that our excavation didn't go as planned. Just as our lead scientist on location, Reilen Oshomi, announced that is team had come across some kind of ancient weapon, the whole operation was raided by Guristas pirates and only Reilen and a few others managed to escape. The Guristas captured the item and we believe they took it to the Lai Dai Refinery in Airmia. Perhaps if you went there you might be able to retrieve it for us. There is a lot fighting going on there between many factions, so be careful.

Also, I'm afraid this is going to be the last mission I can give to you. After this incident my commanders issued a no-fly policy of all Wiyrkomi vessels and it seems their interests in the area have severly dwindled. Please complete this mission for me, and perhaps one day we will have the pleasure of working together again.
messages.zh:
很遗憾地告诉你，挖掘没能按计划进行。就在我们的首席科学家海棱•奥索米宣布他们找到某种古代武器的时候，整个工程队遭到了古斯塔斯海盗的袭击，只有海棱和少数人逃了出来。古斯塔斯抢走了那件东西，我们相信他们把它带到了艾尔米亚的莱戴精炼厂。也许你能帮我们夺回武器。各个势力之间正在进行着无数大大小小的战斗，所以你要小心。

还有，恐怕这是我能给你的最后一个任务了。自从这次事件后，我的指挥官颁布了一条针对所有维克米飞船的禁飞令，看起来他们对这个地区的兴趣已经大大消退了。请为我完成这最后的任务，也许哪天我们还

还有，恐怕这是我给你的最后一个任务了。自从那个事件之后，我的指挥官对所有维克米集团的飞船实施禁飞令，看起来他们对这里已经没什么兴趣了。请为我完成这最后的任务，和你合作真的很愉快，或许哪天我们还能再见。

name.fr: Cela vous dirait de travailler pour moi ? (1 sur 5)

messages.en:
Welcome, {[character]player.name}. It is good to see capable pilots joining our ranks, these are troubled times and we certainly need all the help we can get. Your previous employer told me good things about you, perhaps if you do as well for me as you did for him, I will refer you to an even higher level agent. Now, for your first assignment.

We have had reports of Guristas pirates destroying a Wiyrkomi excavation operation. Aparently the Wiyrkomi scientists had come accross some sort of ancient weapon. The Guristas found out and raided the place, killing almost all the scientists and capturing the weapon. I want you to investigate this matter. Go to the Lai Dai Refinery in Airmia. Members of all factions are fighting over the refinery and if you move quickly, perhaps you could sneak in and steal the weapon.
messages.zh:
欢迎你，{[character]player.name}。很高兴看到这么能干的飞行员加入我们的行列，现在正是麻烦四起的时刻，我们绝对需要能够获得的所有帮助。你的前雇主跟我说了你很多好话，如果在我这儿你也能如此出色工作，我还会把你推荐给更高级的代理人。现在给你第一个任务。

我们接到报告说古斯塔斯海盗正在破坏维克米集团开展的一次挖掘行动。维克米的科学家无意间发现了某种古代武器。古斯塔斯听说了这事，袭击了挖掘现场，打死了几乎所有科学家，然后将武器据为己有。我要你去调查此事。飞去艾尔米亚的莱戴精炼厂。各种势力正在那里为争夺这座精炼厂打得不可开交，如果你行动迅速，或许可以神不知鬼不觉地把武器偷出来。

name.fr: Des ennuis avec les hors-la-loi (2 sur 5)
name.ru: Проблемы с рецидивистами (Troubles With Outlaws) (2 из 5)

messages.en: Guristas are a constant pain in the backside. This time they have taken five of our miners captive and are demanding a ransom for their return. Our policy has never been to negotiate with terrorists, so I want you to go in there full force and deal with them. They are hanging out at the contested Lai Dai Refinery in Airmia. Bring the miners back to me unharmed, it would not look good with the State if we became responsible for those people's deaths.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯一直是我们的心腹大患。这次他们又绑架了我们五个矿工，以此向我们勒索赎金。我们的原则是决不向恐怖分子妥协，我要你率全部兵力前去那里，结果他们。他们现正出没在艾尔米亚争夺中的莱戴精炼厂附近。把矿工安全带回给我，如果这些人因我们而死，合众国会颜面无光。

messages.en: Guristas are a constant pain in the backside. This time they have taken five of our miners captive and are demanding a ransom for their return. Our policy has never been to negotiate with terrorists, so I want you to go in there full force and deal with them. They are hanging out at the contested Lai Dai Refinery in Airmia. Bring the miners back to me unharmed, it would not look good with the State if we became responsible for those people's deaths.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯一直是我们的心头大患。这次他们又绑架了五个矿工，向我们勒索赎金。我们决不会向恐怖分子妥协，他们正聚集在艾尔米亚的莱戴精炼厂，去好好教训他们，将矿工安全地带回来。如果这些矿工因我们而死，对上头不好交待。

messages.en:
You're a blessing from the gods, {[character]player.name}. I've been scrounging the local bars for some sturdy, no-nonsense fighter pilots for weeks and haven't been able to find anyone up to the job, and then out of nowhere you appear. You have the look of someone who knows how to lock a railgun, if you know what I mean. Just the type I need for a few simple bounty hunting jobs.

But let me introduce myself before we get started with business. I am {[character]agentID.name}, head of the Lai Dai security forces in the Frontier Stockade. I was entrusted with the task of protecting Lai Dai workers from harm while they go about their business. But let me tell you, it's harder than it sounds. This whole system is filled to the brim with pirate scoundrels and other rogue elements. My men are simply not coping with the load, and I've had more than a few dropouts so far who don't have the balls to work in such an environment. Yeah, they can run back to New Caldari with their tail behind their legs for all I care. Sissies all of them...

But now to the job at hand. Like I said, I've been on the lookout for a freelancer to do a few assignments. The first assignment is very straightforward and should be easy enough for a pilot like you. There are a group of bandits holed up near the second moon of Sakkikainen VI. It so happens that a few of our scientists are currently living on the moon, in a biodome on the surface, and they've refused to do any more work until the pirates have been driven off. I only require evidence that you've eliminated a certain number of them; once you've killed a significant number, that'll boost morale and I can count on my men to do the rest.

And hey, if you can get it done on time, then I know I can trust you for some more work. So what do you say, up for it?
messages.zh:
你真是上帝的礼物，{[character]player.name}，不是吗？我一直在本地的沙龙里面寻找那种作风强悍，行动干净利落的飞行员，几周过去了，似乎还是一无所获，但就在此时，你出现在了我的眼前。你看起来是那种懂得如何使用磁轨炮的人，你明白我的意思吧。你就是我要找的人，我要你帮忙完成一些简单的赏金追捕任务。

在我们谈正事之前，先允许我做一下自我介绍。我是{[character]agentID.name}，前线围栏莱戴安全部队的头目。我负责莱戴工人干活时的安全工作，保护他们免受伤害。但我可以告诉你，这工作要比听上去困难得多。整个星系里到处都是海盗和其他的无赖。我的手下似乎疲于应对这一切，迄今为止，大负荷的工作量使很大一批人承受不了，纷纷当了逃兵。他们大可以夹着尾巴逃回新加达里，我不在乎。一群胆小鬼……

现在来看看手头的任务吧。为了减轻我手下的工作负荷，我一直在寻找一个自由战士来分担一部分工作。第一个任务步骤非常简单，对你这样的飞行员轻而易举。在萨基凯伦的第二个卫星附近有一群海盗。碰巧我们有几个科学家正在那个卫星表面的一个生化穹顶里，由于忌惮那些海盗，他们拒绝出去工作。所以那群海盗必须被消灭。我只要求你去对付一部分，剩下的交给我的人就行了。如果你能按时完成任务，那么我就可以信任你，分派其他的任务给你。你觉得如何？

messages.en:
Good, good! I'll send my men to the moon immediately to clear up the remaining pirates. It should be a piece of cake with so many of them killed; it wouldn't even surprise me if the remnants had fled the area by now.

And don't you leave just yet. I have another assignment for you!
messages.zh:
好，很好！我会立刻派我的人去卫星上清理残余海盗的。收拾这么点残兵败将应该只是小菜一碟；就算他们溜了，我也一点也不奇怪。

先别走。我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en: Lately, Propel Dynamics have been trying to infiltrate our ranks. They know we have the upper hand in this region and apparently they seem to be wanting to sabotage our operations. We have discovered the identity of this spy, yesterday we arrested him and he is currently in my custody. I want you to take him to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, there he will be tried and justice brought to the matter.
messages.zh: 最近，推进动态集团一直试图渗入我们内部。他们知道我们在本地区处于有利地位，显然他们想破坏我们的业务。我们已经发现了那名间谍的身份，昨天我们把他抓了起来，现在正被我监禁着。你去把他押到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，在那儿他将接受审判，正义将得到伸张。

messages.en: Lately, Propel Dynamics have been trying to infiltrate our ranks. They know we have the upper hand in this region and apparently they seem to be wanting to sabotage our operations. We have discovered the identity of this spy, yesterday we arrested him and he is currently in my custody. I want you to take him to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, there he will be tried and justice brought to the matter.
messages.zh: 最近，推进动态集团试图派人渗入我们内部。要知道，我们在本地区颇有地位，显然他们是想趁机翻江蹈海大干一场。看来他们是打错如意算盘了，昨天潜入的间谍刚被拘捕，现在正被我监禁着。你去把他押到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} ，在那儿他将接受法律的制裁。

name.es: Piratas llevados ante la justicia (4 de 5)
name.fr: Les pirates face à la justice (4 sur 5)
name.ru: Пиратов - к ответу (Pirates Brought to Justice) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
That spy is being tried for his crimes as we speak, thanks to you he will go away for a long time.

I, however, have another task for you. Around these parts, outlaws are a constant threat. Every day they raid caravans, steal their loot and murder innocents. Here in Ishisomo, we believe the source of these attacks is the Lai Dai Refinery in Airmia. I want you to go there, destroy every structure you see and leave none alive. Show them the might of Nugoeihuvi, show them justice. Bring me back five Gurista Outlaw Dogtags as proof of your actions.
messages.zh:
就在我们说话的当口，那个间谍正在接受关于所犯罪行的审问，多亏了你，他会离开好一阵子了。

可是，我还有另一个任务给你。在这一带，不法分子始终是和平的威胁。他们每天袭击商队，夺取财物，残害无辜。在伊什索蒙这里，我们确信这些袭击的源头是在艾尔米亚的莱戴精炼厂。我要你去那里，摧毁每一座建筑，消灭每一个罪犯。让他们见识一下纳基维集团的厉害，尝尝正义的铁拳！带五个古斯塔斯罪犯的铭牌回来作为你行动成功的证明。

messages.en:
The bank manager at the local State and Region vault has heard some worrying rumors that some thugs are planning a run on his bank. He is in no position to investigate the matter himself, so he sent for the cavalry. The Caldari Navy, that is. I was sent here by the Navy to check out the validity of these rumors. I haven't dug up anything of interest yet, but just to be on the safe side I'd like to put some heat on the bandits roaming in the area. I've asked my buddy Jali Tanaka to help me out too, but he's busy setting up a surveillance system, so I don't want to take too much of his time.

The Kazka bandits over in Sakkikainen seem like likely candidates for this sort of an operation. I don't know for sure, but it doesn't hurt to stir things up a little. You seem like a hardy pilot more than capable of roughing them up a bit. How about you get in there all guns blazing and bring me back, say, 30 drifter spurs? That should shake them up, hopefully enough for one of them to spill his beans into the wrong ear.

Finally, be very careful. The Kazka bandits are rough. Make sure you only target their grunts, the others are too tough to be worth the hassle.
messages.zh:
国家星域银行的主管听到一个令人担心的谣传，说有一些暴徒盯上了银行。为此他向加达里海军求助，而我正是海军派来调查真相的。迄今为止，我还没什么发现，但从安全角度考虑，必须对这里游荡的强盗进行打击。我曾向好友瑕里•塔娜卡求助，但他正忙于架设监视系统，所以我不想再麻烦他了。

依我看，萨基凯伦附近的卡兹卡强盗是这次打击行动的最佳对象。我个人认为把事情闹大一点没有关系。你看上去很强悍，肯定能把他们打得落花流水。去那儿大闹一场，带30个流浪者的马刺回来怎么样？这一定能打乱他们的阵脚，甚至会有人因此说漏嘴，露出关于非法货币的蛛丝马迹。

最后，要小心。卡兹卡强盗不好对付。确保你只对付他们的步兵级飞船，不要激怒那些你不该惹的。

messages.en: I've uploaded a bookmark to the mission details in your Opportunities interface which should lead you straight to Zarkona's hideout. Be warned, though, his place is heavily guarded.
messages.zh: 我已经在“机遇”界面的任务详情中上传了一个位标，它会指引你前往扎尔克纳的藏身处。那里守卫森严，千万要小心。

messages.en:
A few days ago one of my men got into a brawl in Sakkikainen with a local thug who goes by the name of "Duke." Unfortunately, the fight ended in tragedy, and my man was killed. This sort of incident is rather commonplace in Okkelen, but when it involves on-duty officers of the law, there need to be severe repercussions. I've been working hard these last few days to track down the murderer, and just today I stumbled upon a very interesting lead.

This "Duke" character's real name is Cheri Mirei. No wonder he uses a nickname... Anyway, his uncle, Zarkona Mirei, is rumored to be very close to Cheri, and he's employed by the infamous Guristas pirates. If anyone can lead us to Cheri, it's him.

Now Zarkona and I have a long history. He's been causing problems for me in this region for the gods only know how long. I know exactly where he spends time between his pirate activities in Sakkikainen, so finding him is not the tough part. The problem is, I haven't had the available manpower to take him out yet. Capture him for me and bring him here for interrogation. I can count on you, right?
messages.zh:
几天前我们的人在萨基凯伦的沙龙和一个绰号“公爵”的当地暴徒发生了争执。不幸的是，这场冲突以悲剧收场，我的同事丢了性命。这类事件在欧克勒恩是家常便饭，但这次有当值军官遇难，一定要严惩凶手。这几天我一直在努力寻找那个家伙，今天总算找到了一个有用的线索。

这个“公爵”真名叫切利•米勒。不管怎样，他的叔叔扎尔克纳•米勒在声名狼藉的古斯塔斯海盗手下工作，传言他和切利的关系十分“亲密”。如果有人能把我们带到切利那，一定是他没错。

我和扎尔克纳素有积怨，天晓得我有多讨厌他！我清楚他在萨基凯伦的一举一动，所以找他并不难。问题是我一直没有合适的人选去解决他，所以我找到了你。活捉他，并把他带回来审问，这个一箭双雕的办法不错吧。

messages.en:
I hope you didn't capture him single-handedly, {[character]player.name}! If you did, you're making my men look silly, to say the least...

Oh, hang on just a minute! I have another job for you.
messages.zh:
我希望你不是单枪匹马抓住他的，{[character]player.name}！如果真是那样，你就让我的人太没面子了……

噢，稍等一会儿！我还有另一项任务给你。

我和扎尔克纳素有积怨，天晓得我有多讨厌他！我清楚他在萨基凯伦的一举一动，所以找他并不难。问题是我一直没有合适的人选去解决他，所以我找到了你。活捉他，并把他带回来审问，这个一箭双雕的办法不错吧。

name.en: Protecting the Vault - Bad Money (2 of 4)
name.es: Protección de la cámara: Dinero falso (2 de 4)
name.fr: Protection du coffre – Argent sale (2 sur 4)
name.ru: Защищая хранилище - дурные деньги (Protecting the Vault - Bad Money) (2 из 4)

messages.en:
It seems you managed to stir up a hornet's nest over in Sakkikainen. The bandits there are in turmoil and intelligence has been picking up all kinds of interesting information lately. Alas, none of it has to do with the supposed bank robbery. But one transmission we intercepted was particularly interesting. It seems one of the gangs associated with the Kazka bandits has managed to forge some counterfeit credits. I don't have to tell you the effects it would have on the fragile economy in the constellation if these credits get into circulation. The gang in questioned is called Dry River.

We need to stop these guys before they go on a shopping spree. I need you to head back into Sakkikainen, find these counterfeiters and take them out. Pick up as much of the counterfeit credits as you can and get them back here to me. I will send them on to the Navy's crime labs for further analysis.

So gather up some friends and take care of business. Oh, and in case you were wondering, you'll be paid in real ISK for completing this mission.
messages.zh:
看来你成功地在萨基凯伦捅了个大马蜂窝，那里的强盗现在乱成一团。我们的情报人员最近搜集到了各种各样有趣的信息，唉，可惜没有一条与那宗谣传的银行劫案有关。不过我们截取到了一条特别有意思的信息：似乎某个与卡兹卡强盗勾结的团伙制造了一些非法货币。可想而知，如果这些非法货币流通起来，会给原本脆弱的星座经济带来怎样的影响。我所说的团伙叫做枯河小队。

我们必须在这些家伙大肆挥霍他们的非法货币之前阻止他们。我要你出发去萨基凯伦，找到这些制造非法货币的人，然后把他们统统干掉。尽可能多地装运非法货币，把它们带回我这来。我会把它们送到海军罪案实验室作进一步分析。

所以，叫上你的朋友，一起干这笔买卖。哦，你放心，事成之后我会付你货真价实的现钞。

messages.en:
Okay, there's been a spot of trouble. It seems the gun runners you hit for me earlier weren't no small timers, but contractors for a much bigger individual, one I'm not so sure I want to go up against. For your sake as well as mine, I need you to remain absolutely quiet about the business we've done together. I also need you to do one last job for me, one which I'll pay you handsomely for. I'm going to lay low for a while, so I need to set up a paper trail leading to somewhere else while I prepare to make my escape. If they find me here, I'm done for.

I need you to take these documents and get them to an associate of mine in a nearby station so he can start pulling the wool over their eyes. This is extremely important, and if you do this for me I'll give you one of my prized "Revolver" Railguns, tweaked to perfection by my very own self. What's your answer?
messages.zh:
好吧，现在有点小麻烦。似乎你之前袭击的那个军火商并不是一个小角色，相反他的后台很硬，是个厉害的家伙，我们可得罪不起啊。所以你我必须守口如瓶，此事绝不能向外透漏半点风声，这样对谁都好。现在帮我最后一个忙，我想要销声匿迹一段时间，所以在走之前需要制造一个逃往某地的假象，这样才不至于暴露我真正的行踪，如果被发现，我就死定了。

你去把这些文件送到我附近空间站的一个合伙人那里，这样他就能以此引开那些家伙的视线了。这很重要，如果你帮我这个忙，我会给你一门珍藏已久的磁轨炮，你看怎么样？

messages.en: Well, I don't mind tellin' ya, you've saved my hide.  Thanks, partner.  I'll be keeping my ship's signature in this place, so if they come for me they can blast away, but I'll be long gone.  Been a pleasure workin' with ya.  Stay safe.
messages.zh: 太好了，不怕和你说，你可救了我。谢谢，老伙计。只要我在那里伪造飞船信号，当他们来找我的时候，我早就逃得远远的了。合作愉快。多保重。

name.en: Protecting the Vault - Counterfeit Courier (3 of 4)
name.es: Protección de la cámara: Reparto de falsificaciones (3 de 4)
name.fr: Protection du coffre – Les faux-monnayeurs (3 sur 4)
name.ja: 金庫室の用心棒-調査チーム（3/4）
name.ru: Защищая хранилище - курьер фальшивок (Protecting the Vault - Counterfeit Courier) (3 из 4)
name.zh: 保护金库—快送非法货币 (3/4)

messages.en:
Ok, while you were out there collecting the counterfeit money, I was contacted by my superiors. It seems the Navy is taking this whole counterfeit operation very seriously. The Navy has sent out a team of investigators; they've set up shop in the State War Academy station in the Ishisomo system. They want me to send all counterfeit credits I get directly to them, no delay. The investigation team there is trying to determine the source of the forgery.

Anyway, while I can understand their concern, this whole thing is disrupting my own work in keeping the bank vault safe. So I want this dealt with promptly and with as little hassle as possible. I want you to take the bags of counterfeit credits you just procured and bring them to the investigation team immediately.
messages.zh:
好吧，你在收集非法货币时，我的上级联系了我。看来这次事件引起了海军方面的高度重视。他们派出一个调查团，在伊什索蒙星系内的国内战争学院空间站设立了办事处。并命令我马上把所有非法货币直接送到他们手里，那里的调查团会确认非法货币的来源。

虽然我能理解他们的做法，但这打乱了我自己的工作计划，无法保证银行保险柜的安全，所以我希望在这件事造成更大的影响前尽快解决它。把刚获得的非法货币立即送到调查团。

虽然我能理解他们的顾虑，但这打乱了我保障银行保险柜安全的工作。所以我希望这事尽快解决，动静越小越好。我要你把获得的几袋非法货币立刻送给调查团。

name.ja: コミュニティサービス―大事な輸送（3/4）
name.ru: Общественные услуги - важная доставка (Community Service - Important Delivery) (3 из 4)

messages.en:
While we wait for our interrogators to finish extracting the information we need from Zarkona, I'd like you to deliver some very important reports to my superiors on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. The last courier I sent to complete this task was ambushed and killed on the way there.

These documents are very important; they contain reports of our activities here for the last few days, and I wouldn't want them to fall into the wrong hands. So make sure you avoid any conflict if possible, and stay clear of pirate infested areas. Good luck.
messages.zh:
我们的审讯官正设法撬开扎尔克纳的嘴，获得我们需要的信息，在这当口，我希望你将一些机要报告交给我在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的上司那里。我上次派去的信使在途中遭伏击，已经遇害。

这些文件至关重要，它们涵盖了几天来我们行动的所有细节，我可不想让它们落入居心不良的人手里。所以请尽可能避免遭遇冲突，远离海盗肆虐的区域。祝你好运。

messages.en: On time, as usual, {[character]player.name}.  Now for your last assignment ...
messages.zh: 一如既往的准时，{[character]player.name}。现在你的最后一个任务是……

name.ru: Общественная служба - Cheri Mirei (Community Service - Cheri Mirei) (4 из 4)

messages.en:
Beautiful! The interrogation is finished! Zarkona revealed to us that Cheri is currently hiding in Otitoh until this latest incident blows over here in Sakkikainen. He said he wasn't sure exactly where in Otitoh Cheri is hiding, but he believes it's somewhere near one of the moons of Otitoh VI. This at least gives us something to work with. You wouldn't believe what we had to go through to drag the information out of this guy... he was one tough S.O.B.!

Alright, I want you to go to Otitoh and search the area around the 6th planet and its moons. Hopefully you'll stumble upon Cheri during your search. Once you do, kill him and return evidence of his death to me. I'll reward you generously for your time.
messages.zh:
漂亮！审讯结束了！扎尔克纳向我们供认，切利目前藏身在欧提托，想一直待到萨基凯伦的事情风头过去。他不确定切利在欧提托藏身的具体位置，但相信一定是在欧提托VI的某个卫星附近。这至少给了我们些有用的线索。你肯定不会相信我们用了什么方法才把信息从这家伙嘴里撬出来……他真是根硬骨头！

好吧，我要你到欧提托去，搜索第六行星及其卫星的周边地区。可能你会在搜索中撞到切利。一旦发现他，当场结果掉，把可以证明他死亡的证据带回给我。我会重重奖励你。

messages.en:
Great work! Now I will finally be able to look my murdered colleague's fiancé in the eyes and tell her we got the man who killed her beloved.

I am very thankful for your brave work for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and I hope our paths will cross again. Till then, good luck on your adventures.
messages.zh:
干得不错！现在，我终于敢于面对我那被伤害的同事的未婚妻，告诉她我们抓到了凶手。

我很感激你为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}勇敢的工作，希望我们还能再度合作。祝你在今后的旅途中一帆风顺。

name.ru: Защищая хранилище - смерть фальшивомонетчикам (Protecting the Vault - Dry Credit Death) (4 из 4)
name.zh: 保护金库—销毁非法货币 (4/4)

messages.en:
This counterfeit business is really getting on my nerves. Yet again I've been contacted by headquarters; they want me to bring this matter to an end. That means I can't do my job securing the bank vault properly, but they're not cutting me any slack. If the bank is actually robbed, all the blame will fall on me. Oh, well. At least I can make sure this counterfeit business has a happy ending.

The investigation team in Ishisomo got a breakthrough in their analysis. They've tracked the source of the forged credits to the Airmia system. The Dry River gang owns a warehouse there that was once part of a Lai Dai mining facility that's been overrun by bandits. The printing machines used in creating the counterfeit credits are located there.

I want you to take some stout fellows over to Airmia and blow that warehouse to bits. The warehouse is undoubtely guarded by some Dry River thugs, you'll have to deal with them first. Bring me back what parts of the printing machines you can find in the ruins of the warehouse once you've blown it up. I will send those to my superiors. Hopefully that will get them off my back and let me get on with my real assignment here. You're getting a nice reward for this one, so make sure you do it properly.
messages.zh:
非法货币事件真伤脑筋！指挥部又和我联系了，要我制止这件事。如果我亲自去追查，那就不能专心做好保护金库的工作，可我又我没法放松警惕。要是银行真的被抢，所有的责任都会落在我身上。好吧，至少我会保证非法货币事件会有一个圆满的结局。

欧塔迈伦调查小组的分析有了突破进展，他们追踪到假币的源头在艾尔米亚星系。枯河小队在那里有一个仓库，那里曾是莱戴矿石开采设施的一部分，强盗横行。制造假币的印钞机就放置在那里。

我希望你带一些勇敢的同伴去艾尔米亚，把仓库夷为平地。当然，仓库被枯河暴徒重兵把守，你必须先解决他们。炸掉仓库后仔细搜索废墟，把能找到的印钞机碎片都带回来，我会把它们转交给上级。希望这样能让他们满意，让我在这里安心干好本职工作。你会得到丰厚的报酬，一定要尽力去做。

name.es: Seguridad del banco: La valla (1 de 3)
name.ja: 銀行警備-監視フェンス（1/3）
name.ru: Безопасность банка - ограда (Bank Security - The Fence) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
I'm trying to install a station-wide surveillance fence, which would sound the alarm if any unidentified ships approached. It's not easy, but I'm using the latest technology for this, a so-called "Barbed Wire Scanner." These scanners can be very easily linked to each other to create a very potent security perimeter. The only problem is, it's pretty hard to get a hold of these scanners. Basically, what is out there are just prototypes and sample modules sent to potential customers. I've already managed to round up a few, but I need a whole heap of these bloody things. That's where you come in.

I just located one on a Spacelane Patrol station in a nearby constellation. I'm stuck here setting up the scanner array control unit, so I want you to pick it up for me. Interested?
messages.zh:
我会在空间站周围布下一道警戒网，如果有不明身份的飞船靠近，它就会发出警报。这并不容易，但我使用了名为“绞丝网式扫描器”的最先进技术。这种扫描器互相之间非常容易连接，可以建立起一条强有力的安全线。唯一的问题是，这些扫描器不容易得到。基本说来，现在市面上只有原型以及发给潜在客户的样品模型。我已经设法收集到了一些这种该死的玩意，但数量还远远不够。这就该你出马了。

我刚刚确定在相邻星座的空间航线巡管局空间站有一个这玩意。我要在这里安装扫描器阵列控制单元，抽不开身，所以我要你去帮我拿一下。感兴趣吗？

messages.en:
Ah, welcome, {[character]player.name}. I have something for you, but first a brief explanation might be in order: Mika Etsuya brought me out here to help him set up surveillance equipment around the bank vault in the State and Region Bank station in the system. Then he got his hands full with something else, so he leaves it to me to do the dirty work he's supposed to be doing. Not as if this hasn't happened before, mind you...

The security in the bank vault is woefully lacking. I'm frankly surprised no one has robbed the place already. Heck, if I wasn't such a coward when it comes to guns, I would probably do it myself. Uh, I'm joking, of course, so don't go running off to Mika to tell on me. Anyway, I'm trying to install a station-wide surveillance fence, which would sound the alarm if any unidentified ships approached. It's not easy, but I'm using the latest technology for this, a so-called "Barbed Wire Scanner." These scanners can be very easily linked to each other to create a very potent security perimeter.

The only problem is, it's pretty hard to get a hold of these scanners. Basically, what is out there are just prototypes and sample modules sent to potential customers. I've already managed to round up a few, but I need a whole heap of these bloody things. That's where you come in.

I just located one on a Spacelane Patrol station in a nearby constellation. I'm stuck here setting up the scanner array control unit, so I want you to pick it up for me. Interested?
messages.zh:
欢迎，{[character]player.name}。有件事需要你帮忙，我先简单说说事情的来龙去脉吧：米卡•艾促雅千里迢迢把我派来这里，帮他在这个星系内的国家星域银行空间站保险舱周围安装一些监视设备。他已经忙得不可开交，就把本该他做的脏活推给了我。为什么总是这样，见鬼……

这个保险舱的安全性真是差得可怜。我就是觉得奇怪，至今为止居然没人打劫这个银行！哎呀，如果我敢使用枪炮的话，我一定亲手做这件事。当然，这是玩笑话，不要向米卡告发我哦。我会在空间站周围布下一道警戒网，如果有不明身份的飞船靠近，它就会发出警报。这并不容易，但我使用了名为“绞丝网式扫描器”的最先进技术。这种扫描器互相之间非常容易连接，可以建立起一条强有力的安全线。唯一的问题是，这些扫描器不容易得到。基本说来，现在市面上只有原型以及发给潜在客户的样品模型。我已经设法收集到了一些这种该死的玩意，但数量还远远不够。这就该你出马了。

我刚刚确定在相邻星座的空间航线巡管局空间站有一个这玩意。我要在这里安装扫描器阵列控制单元，抽不开身，所以我要你去帮我拿一下。感兴趣吗？

name.ja: 銀行警備-盗聴器のエラー（2/3）
name.ru: Безопасность банка - дефектный жучок (Bank Security - Bug Error) (2 из 3)

messages.en: Get into the Kazka headquarters, locate Dyklan Harrikar, and take him down. Don't forget to retrieve the broken tracking device from his wreck; we can't afford to let his allies know we're tapping them.
messages.zh: 进入卡兹卡总部，找出迪克兰·哈里卡尔，干掉他。别忘了从尸体上取回那个损坏了的窃听设备，我们可不能让他的同伙知道我们在监听他们。

messages.en:
My colleague Etsuya is up to something over in the Sakkikainen system. He asked me to plant some bug devices on several bandits hanging out at Kazka's headquarters. I managed to bug a few of them when they docked for refit recently. Now all their transmissions are intercepted and relayed to us. All well and good, if you ask me, but we've had a slight hitch.

One of the bug devices is faulty and needs to be removed. It's creating an echo in the communication system that might be picked up by an alert bandit. If those guys find the bug, then the rest of the bugs are lost too. Not to mention the fact that they'll be much more careful about these things in the future. We can't let that happen, so we need to retrieve the device, pronto.

Trouble is, simply waiting for this bandit, Dyklan Harrikar, to dock here again is not an option. Somebody has to track the guy down, blow him to pieces, and retrieve the device so his buddies won't find it when they go digging through the debris. Now, I'm not a fighter and Etsuya is too busy tracking down some counterfeit money or something. Naturally, I thought of you, though I'd recommend you get some friends to help you out.

Just get into the Kazka headquarters, locate Dyklan Harrikar, and take him down. Sounds easy, right? Don't forget to retrieve the broken device; we can't afford to let them know we're tapping them.
messages.zh:
我的同事艾促雅在萨基凯伦星系正在忙些事情。他请求我在附近的卡兹卡总部的一些强盗身上装上窃听设备。他们最近进站整修时，我在几个人身上装了些。现在他们所有的通信都被拦截下来转给我们。那当然好，不过其实我们还是有些小麻烦。

其中一个窃听设备出了问题，需要移除。它使通信系统中产生回声，这可能会被警觉的强盗发现。如果那些家伙发现了这个偷听器，那么其他的也都会被找到。更不用说他们今后在这种事情上就会更加警惕了。我们不能让这种事情发生，所以我们要尽快收回设备。

问题是，单单在这里等待迪克兰•哈里卡尔这个强盗进站，不是个好办法。要有人跟踪他，把他消灭，然后取回偷听器，这样他的同伙在打扫战场时就不会找到它了。我本人不是战士，而艾促雅正忙于追踪一些非法货币之类的事情。很自然，我想到了你，我会推荐你找些朋友协助前往的。<br><br>进入卡兹卡总部，找出迪克兰哈里卡尔，干掉他。听起来很简单吧？别忘了取回那个损坏了的窃听设备，我们可不能让他们知道我们在监听他们。

messages.en:
You're moving even further up the corporate ladder, my friend. My superiors have taken a great interest in your talent and have decided that after this task, you will be reassigned to a new agent in Airmia. Aparently the troubles there are much greater than the ones here and they wish only for the most competent of pilots to head out there.

Your last assignment for me will be to deliver these reports to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, they are reports of all Propel Dynamics activity in the past two weeks. If there is another spy among us, this is how we will find him.

Be safe, my friend. Perhaps we will see each other in the future.
messages.zh:
你在军团里的位置越爬越高了，我的朋友。我的上级非常欣赏你的才华，他决定在这个任务之后，把你分配到艾尔米亚的一个新代理人那里。显然，那里的麻烦比这里多得多，他们只希望得到最能干的飞行员。

我给你的最后一个任务就是将这些报告送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这些报告记载了过去两周推进动态集团的所有活动。如果我们中间还有另一个间谍的话，这样就能把它引出来。

注意安全，朋友。我们可能将来还会见面的。

messages.en: Go to Airmia and find Istei Poyri, he will take care of you.
messages.zh: 快去艾尔米亚找伊斯特•部瓦希，他会照顾你的。

messages.en:
I cannot believe somebody ratted me out! Somehow, those damned Nugoeihuvi agents found out about my plan and fixed their security flaws. Had I been successful, high command definitely would have given me a raise!

Oh, sorry, I don't suppose you're interested in any of that. I do however have some tasks for you, perhaps we can get back at Nugoeihuvi some other way. This constellation is on fire, there are so many things to explore and discover. Everybody wants a piece of the action, and I'm here to make sure Lai Dai gets the whole cake

Firsly, I need you to take these reports and deliver them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. The reports contain data on all our discoveries within the constellation and it would be unfortunate if they fell into the wrong hands.
messages.zh:
不可置信，有人出卖了我！这些该死的纳基维集团探员不知怎么发现了我的计划，并弥补了他们的安全漏洞。要是这次我成功，高级指挥官肯定会提拔我！

不好意思，可能你不想听这些。 但我有些任务要分配给你，或许我们可以用其他方式对他们进行报复。这个星座现在炙手可热，有无数的资源有待发掘， 每个人都想参与其中，而我的任务就是确保只有莱戴集团才能得到它。

首先，我需要你将这些报告送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。这些报告包含了我们在星座内所有发现的数据。千万小心别让它落到其他人的手里。

messages.en: My mother is very old and very sick. Yesterday she contacted me and asked me to buy her some milk. I'm afraid my duties here require me to stay, but if you could see to it that she gets her milk, I would be grateful. Take this and deliver it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Be quick about it and don't get blown up. She gets grumpy if she doesn't get her milk, and she usually takes her rage out on me.
messages.zh: 我的母亲年老体衰，疾病缠身。昨天她联系上我，让我给她买些牛奶。恐怕我不能离开自己的岗位，如果你能帮我带点牛奶给她，我将感激不尽。拿上这个，把它送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。动作要快，还有当心别被海盗炸了。如果她收不到牛奶，就会脾气暴躁，到时我就变成她的出气筒了。

messages.en: My mother is very old and very sick. Yesterday she contacted me and asked me to buy her some milk. I'm afraid my duties here require me to stay, but if you could see to it that she gets her milk, I would be grateful. Take this and deliver it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Be quick about it and don't get blown up. She gets grumpy if she doesn't get her milk, and she usually takes her rage out on me.
messages.zh: 我的母亲年老体衰，身体常有不适。昨天她让我给她买些牛奶。而现在恐怕我正忙于公务，恐怕暂时脱不开身，如果你能帮我带点牛奶给她，我将感激不尽。拿上这个，把它送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。快去吧，别搞砸了。如果她没有收到牛奶，一定会很恼火，到时我就变成她的出气筒了。

messages.en: A few minutes ago, reports came in regarding Guristas pirates destroying a Wiyrkomi excavation operation. Apparently the Wiyrkomi scientists had come across some sort of ancient weapon. The Guristas found out and raided the place, killing almost all the scientists and capturing the weapon. I want you to investigate this matter. Go to the contested Lai Dai Refinery in Airmia, find this weapon and bring it back to me. I know the Nugoeihuvi are trying to get hold of it as well, but I want you to beat them to it.
messages.zh: 几分钟前，有报告称古斯塔斯破坏了维克米的挖掘行动。维克米的科学家无意间发现了某种古代武器。古斯塔斯听说了这事，袭击了挖掘现场，打死了几乎所有科学家，然后将武器据为己有。我要你去调查此事。前往艾尔米亚争夺中的莱戴精炼厂，找到这件武器，然后带回来给我。我知道纳基维也正试图得到它，但我要你抢在他们前面。

The Guristas found out and raided the place, killing almost all the scientists and capturing the weapon. I want you to investigate this matter. name.es: Destrucción del campo de entrenamiento (4 de 4)
name.ru: Атака на учебку (Training Ground Destruction) (4 из 4)

messages.en: The damned Guristas are constant pain in the backside. Their spies are everywhere and there seems to be no way of getting rid of them for good. We have exhausted almost all methods but they always come back for more. This time I want something really radical to be done. Go to the contested Lai Dai Refinery and destroy all their bunkers and training facilities. If we destroy their roots, maybe the whole tree will fall. Bring back five Guristas Outlaw Leader Insignias as proof of your actions.
messages.zh: 该死的古斯塔斯一直是我们的心腹大患。他们的间谍遍布各处，似乎没办法把他们永远根除。我们竭尽所能，但他们又一次次卷土重来。这次我要做得彻底一些。前往争夺中的莱戴精炼厂，摧毁他们所有的碉堡和训练设施。如果我们毁了他们的根部，也许这整棵大树就会轰然倒地。带五个古斯塔斯放逐者首领勋章回来，作为你行动成功的证明。

name.es: Seguridad del banco: La caja fuerte (3 de 3)
name.ru: Безопасность банка - сейф (Bank Security - The Safe) (3 из 3)

messages.en: I need someone to get the safe and bring it to the bank station for me. The safe is located at a Perkone station not far from here. Just be careful ― you might have to travel through some rough territory to get there.
messages.zh: 我要找个人帮我去取保险箱，并将它带回银行空间站。保险箱就在不远处的佩克昂集团空间站。不过千万要小心——你可能得穿过一些非常危险的区域才能到那。

messages.en:
Well, the barbed wire scanner fence is almost operational. But poor Etsuya is still neck deep in this counterfeit business and has had very little time to take care of the other security issues still unresolved at the bank. I feel sorry for the guy, with all these responsibilities and not enough time ... but it's not like he doesn't bring it on himself sometimes. Still, I'm trying to help him out as best I can.

While searching for more Barbed Wire scanners, I came upon a really impressive safe that would solve a lot of problems for the bank if it was installed there. I pulled some strings with some navy friends and they got me the safe. I've already talked to the bank manager at the station and he's agreed to fund the whole thing. However, I have to oversee the last stages of setting up the security perimeter; it's taken longer than I expected due to some unforeseen malfunctions and unlucky accidents. But I hope to have it up and running in a few days.

Thing is, as I'm sure you'd already guessed, I need someone to get the safe and bring it to the bank station for me. You interested? The safe is located at a Perkone station not far from here. Just be careful ― you might have to travel through some rough territory to get there.
messages.zh:
好了，绞丝网式扫描器警戒网很快就能工作了。但可怜的艾促雅仍然忙于手头的非法货币事件，几乎没有时间来处理银行里尚未解决的安全问题。我真为他感到难过，担负着这么重的责任，总是没有足够的时间来做完所有的事……但有时候他似乎喜欢把事情揽在自己身上。不管怎样，我会尽自己的全力来帮助他。

在寻找绞丝网式扫描器的时候，我偶然发现了一种非常不错的保险箱，如果我们在这个银行安装这种保险箱，一定可以解决很多问题。通过海军内的朋友，他们帮我搞到了这种保险箱。我已经和国家星域银行空间站的经理谈过了，他会全力支持。现在我得要去监管修建安全警戒线工程的最后阶段了；这要比我之前所预计的时间来的长，因为有些设施的故障和不巧的事故。但我希望它能够在几天之内就可以上线运行。

实际情况是，相比你也已经猜到了，我需要有人去帮我把保险箱带回到银行空间站。你有兴趣么？保险箱在离这里不远的佩克昂集团空间站。小心点，你可能需要穿越一些危险的空域才能到那儿。

name.de: Der Medizinmann - Eine Prise Gewürz (1 von 3)
name.en: The Medicine Man - A Pinch of Spice (1 of 3)
name.es: El hombre de la medicina: Una pizca de especias (1 de 3)
name.fr: L'homme médecine - La touche finale d'une décoction étonnante (1 sur 3)
name.ru: Врачеватель - щепотка специй (The Medicine Man - A Pinch of Spice) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
I've been working on this here concoction, see. It frees the mind from its everyday shackles, lets the spirit roam free among the hinterlands and is one hell of a laxative to boot! Only thing is, I need this one particular ingredient. Just a little spice to perfect the whole deal, see.

Now, I know of this feller who's got a bit of what I need. If you could see fit to - how to put it - relieve him of his fear of death, then you could bring me that special ingredient and I could give you a cut of my profits. Feller's called Wolf Skarkert, and he hangs around in that contested mining facility, peddling his wares to the lonely souls actually trying to eke out a living in them god-forsaken badlands. Get me his powdered cubensis, and we'll see if we can't make ya that tiny bit richer. How about it?
messages.zh:
看吧，我正在调制一种混合物。它能让人从每天的精神枷锁中解脱，让灵魂自由驰骋，排除一切烦恼！唯一的事情是，我需要一个特殊的配方。看吧，只要一点点调料就可以使整件事完美无缺了。

现在我知道有个小子手里有我需要的东西。如果你能处理——该怎么说呢——减轻他死亡的恐惧，然后给我带来那特殊的配方，我可以跟你利润分成。那小子名叫猎狼斯卡尔斯特，他就在争夺中的采矿设施附近游荡，向一些在死亡线上苦苦挣扎的穷人兜售他的商品。把他的粉状锢秘西锶带给我，我能让你这小伙计变得富有。你觉得如何？

name.de: Flucht aus der Höhle des Löwen - Unlösbarer Auftrag (1 von 3)
name.en: Escape From The Lion's Den - Mission Impossible (1 of 3)
name.es: Huida de la guarida del león: Misión imposible (1 de 3)
name.fr: Se sortir des griffes du loup - Mission Impossible (1 sur 3)
name.ja: 獅子の穴からの脱出―ミッションインポッシブル（1/3）
name.ru: Побег из логова льва - миссия невыполнима (Escape From The Lion's Den - Mission Impossible) (1 из 3)

messages.en: No I'm not working for the Guristas, and in fact I've come here to save your ass.  As long as you have ISK to cover my expenses, of course.
messages.zh: 不，我不为古斯塔斯工作，实际上我是来救你这个混蛋的。当然，只要你有星币付给我。

messages.en:
Unbelievable. I never expected to get out of this hell-hole in one piece. I've been stuck here for the last few days, tortured day and night by Guristas scoundrels trying to find information I don't have! It's been a total nightmare so far ...

However freeing me isn't as easy as it sounds. And I won't tell you how, until you prove to me that you're telling the truth. For all I know, you could be a Guristas agent in disguise, looking for security breaches.

To prove your worth, bring me Jakon's head. Jakon Tooka is the Blood Raider criminal I was sent here to capture over a year ago. Banished from the Blood Raider territories and with me on his tail, he had no choice but to flee.

After many months of searching for him, I finally discovered his scent here in Okkelen. I tracked him down to Otitoh, but that's as far as I got. A Guristas fleet ambushed us, killing everyone save myself. Since then they have kept me here in this run-down prison facility, attempting to scrounge out any valuable information that I have.

Once I have proof that Jakon is slain, I can return home with pride. I would rather spend my last hours in this stinking cell than fly back to the Emperor with my tail behind my legs. I will await your return anxiously, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
难以置信。我没指望能活着离开这个魔窟。过去几天里我一直被困在这，古斯塔斯的混蛋整日整夜地对我严刑拷问，想从我嘴里找出一些我根本不知道的信息！这一切到现在都是一场噩梦……

不过，想解救我不像听起来那么简单。除非你能证明你说的都是真话，否则我不会告诉你解救我的方法。天晓得，你可能是古斯塔斯特工伪装的，想从我这套取安全情报。

要证明你的诚意，就把贾恐的人头带给我。贾恐•图卡是血袭者犯罪分子，一年前我被派到这来抓他。他已被驱逐出血袭者领地，加上我对他穷追不舍，除了逃跑他别无选择。<br><br>经过几个月的搜查，我终于在欧克勒恩发现了他的踪迹。我追踪他到了欧提托，然后就止步于此。一支古斯塔斯舰队伏击了我们，除我之外的所有人都死了。从那以后他们就把我囚禁在这个破败的牢狱工厂里，试图从我这儿挖出有用的情报。<br><br>一旦我获得了贾恐已死的证据，我就能凯旋而归。不然我宁可在这个臭牢房度过余生，也不愿意夹着尾巴回到皇帝身边。我将热切期待你的归来，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Incredible!  You have succeeded where I failed, {[character]player.name}, and for that I salute you.  You can find your reward in my belongings near the entrance of the prison.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 真难以置信！你在我失败的地方取得了成功，{[character]player.name}，为此，我该向你致敬。你可以去牢狱入口附近，在我的财产中找出你的酬劳。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en: Jakon Tooka rarely shows his face in Okkelen.  Accepting this mission is unadvisable if you are not certain of completing it.
messages.zh: 贾恐·图卡很少在欧克勒恩露面。要是你不确定能否完成任务，那么我建议你不要接受这个任务。

messages.en: Warning
messages.zh: 警告

messages.en:
Unbelievable. I never expected to get out of this hell-hole in one piece. I've been stuck here for the last few days, tortured day and night by Guristas scoundrels trying to find information I don't have! It's been a total nightmare so far ...

However freeing me isn't as easy as it sounds. And I won't tell you how, until you prove to me that you're telling the truth. For all I know, you could be a Guristas agent in disguise, looking for security breaches.

To prove your worth, bring me Jakon's head. Jakon Tooka is the Blood Raider criminal I was sent here to capture over a year ago. Banished from the Blood Raider territories and with me on his tail, he had no choice but to flee.

After many months of searching for him, I finally discovered his scent here in Okkelen. I tracked him down to Otitoh, but that's as far as I got. A Guristas fleet ambushed us, killing everyone save myself. Since then they have kept me here in this run-down prison facility, attempting to scrounge out any valuable information that I have.

Once I have proof that Jakon is slain, I can return home with pride. I would rather spend my last hours in this stinking cell than fly back to the Emperor with my tail behind my legs. I will await your return anxiously, {[character]player.name}.

messages.en:
The reason I haven't asked you to release me from this habitation module yet is simple, if I leave the prison structure I die. The Guristas commander, Myrkai, had a micro-sized explosive device implanted into my brain. It activates as soon as I leave the area, or if someone tampers with it. They didn't say how powerful the explosion would be, but probably enough to destroy any ship I am in along with myself.

Upon checking the data logs here in the prison after you opened my cell, I discovered a device which acts as a remote control for the bomb inside my skull, apparently it's the only thing that can deactivate it. But I can't access this device, it requires a data chip that only Myrkai has access to. I'm convinced Myrkai has it stored in the officer's quarters near the prison, where he resides. If you could just find it for me, I'd be eternally grateful.

You'll find the officer's quarters nearby, but I warn you, it's equipped with a very high tech EM forcefield. It might take you a while to destroy it, and as soon as the guards at the lookout posts notice you firing on the structure they will attack.
messages.zh: 我还不让你把我从这个居住舱中放出来的原因很简单，只要我离开这个牢狱，我就会死。古斯塔斯指挥官米尔凯，在我的大脑里植入了一个微型爆炸装置。只要我一离开这个地区，或是有人破坏了它的话，这个装置就会激活。他们没有说这个爆炸的威力有多大，但可能足以炸毁任何一艘载着我的飞船。<br><br>在你打开我的牢房之后，我检查了这个牢狱里的数据日志，并发现了一个装置，它就是我脑袋里的那个炸弹的遥控器，显然它就是唯一可以使爆炸装置失效的东西。但我不能访问这个装置，这需要一个数据芯片，而这个数据芯片只有米尔凯才准许使用。我肯定米尔凯把它储存在了这个牢狱旁边的官员中心，也就是他居住的地方。如果你能帮我找到它，我会感激不尽的。<br><br>官员中心就在附近，但我告诫你，那里配备了一个尖端科技的EM力场。摧毁它可能需要一段时间，一旦监视哨的守卫发现你在向建筑开火，他们就会攻击你。

messages.en: Great work!  I'll get right to disabling this damn explosive device.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得不错！我就有权解除这个该死的爆炸装置了。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en:
What have we here? You look like a pilot not overburdened with morals or ethics. I like that. In fact, I might have a bit of work for someone like you. I'm planning something big, nothing you need to know about right now. Let's say it's just something to help me in my retirement. But before I let you in on my little plan, I must make sure you really are made of stern stuff.

There's a band of pirates hanging out in the Sakkikainen system that have been causing me all kinds of grief. They go by the name Kazka. Seems some of them have similar ideas as I and I don't want some idiot to ruin my plan by jumping the gun. If you would go in there and bring a bit of devastation to them, it would take their minds off things they shouldn't be thinking about. Do this and then we can start talking real business.
messages.zh:
看看谁来了。你看上去像是一个不受太多伦理道德束缚的飞行员。我喜欢那样。事实上，我可能有适合你这样人的工作。我正在策划一些大动作，细节现在还不便透露给你。这么说吧，这是一件能让我安享退休生活的事。在我让你加入我的小计划前，我必须确定你的手段的确够强硬。

有一帮海盗在萨基凯伦星系里出没，他们给我制造了不少麻烦。他们被称作卡兹卡。似乎他们中的某些人与我有类似的想法，我可不希望某些白痴捷足先登并毁了我的计划。如果你能去那儿给他们一点教训的话，他们就不会再有什么非分之想了。完成这个任务，我们就开始谈正事。

messages.en:
Now that I've disabled the explosive device preventing me from leaving this place, it's time to make my getaway. I managed to forge some documents, using the prison's central computer, that should allow me to escape the Guristas installation unharmed, but they require that I fly a Guristas Shuttle. The documents say I am being moved to another installation in Okkelen, this should allow me to leave unharmed. Although I'm no expert on Caldari ships, I've had some basic training that should be adequate to fly those shuttles.

I know you're probably eager to bring me along in your own ship, {[character]player.name}, but I'd rather not risk your life needlessly, nor my own. This plan of mine is pretty much fool proof, as long as you can get the shuttle here in time. I don't know how you managed to get in here before, but I'm sure you can do it again.

You'll find a Guristas shuttle in their supply depot within this complex, to get past the acceleration gate you'll need a Guristas Crystal Tag. Once you've brought it here I'll reward you generously.
messages.zh:
既然阻碍我离开此处的爆炸装置已被解除，现在该是胜利大逃亡的时候了。我利用牢狱的中央计算机伪造了一些文件，应该可以让我安全逃离古斯塔斯大牢，不过前提是我要开着一艘古斯塔斯穿梭机。这些文件说我正被转送到欧克勒恩的另一个牢狱，这应该能使我顺利离开。尽管我不是驾驶加达里飞船的行家，但我所受过的基本训练应该足以驾驶那些穿梭机。

或许你想开着自己的飞船带我离开吧，{[character]player.name}，可我不想拿你我的生命冒险。只要你能及时为我弄一艘穿梭机，我的计划几乎是万无一失的。我不知道你之前是怎么到这的，不过我相信你还能再做一次。<br><br>这个复合体的补给站里有我要的古斯塔穿梭机，要通过加速轨道，你需要一个古斯塔斯水晶铭牌。一旦你把穿梭机弄过来，我会重重奖励你。

messages.en:
Alright, partner, thanks to your good work I've been able to make my wonderful concoction, The Liberation Elixir. Greatest thing since Quafe Ultra, I tell ya. Now all I need is someone to help me get it to my distributor so it can start working for the greater good o' mankind.

That's right, friend, I'm eyeing you for the job. If you can be a dear and get it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} within a couple of hours, I can be makin' money in no time! And, of course, I'll reward you handsomely for your work. How's that sound to ya?
messages.zh:
很好，伙计，多亏你出色的工作，我才能完成我的配方，制出万能药。告诉你，年轻人，这是继酷菲特强之后最棒的东西了。我现在需要找人把它带给我的经销商，以便它更好地造福人类。

是的，伙计，我觉得你很适合这份工作。如果你能在几小时内帮我把它送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，现金就会源源不断地进入我的帐户，哈哈。当然，我也会给你丰厚的报酬。你觉得怎么样？

name.fr: Le hold-up – À la dynamite ! (2 sur 5)
name.ja: 銀行強盗―ダイナマイト（2/5）
name.ru: Ограбление банка - динамит! (The Bank Heist - Dynamite!) (2 из 5)

messages.en:
You've proven yourself to be a tough fighter, kid. I like your style. Now onto business. Maybe you have guessed it already, but the target is the local bank vault. Simply put, I'm gonna pick that place clean. And I want you to help me. Do well and you'll get a healthy cut of the profit.

That bank vault is ripe for the taking, but it's actively bolstering its defenses as we speak, so we need to act fast. There's a crate of dynamite I've procured sitting on a station not far from here. I want you to pick it up, I plan on using it to blast my way into the security vault in the bank. It's a mundane task, I know. But I'm sure that if you keep your thoughts on all that gold that awaits us, you'll be back in a jiffy.
messages.zh:
好小子，你已经证明了自己是一个坚强的战士。我喜欢你的风格。现在言归正传。或许你已经猜到了，我的目标就是本地银行的保险库。简单的说，我要把那个地方搬空。我需要你的协助。干的好的话，我会分给你一大笔钱。

搬空保险库的计划已经就绪，但就在我们说话的当口，保险库的防御正在不断加强，我们必须行动迅速。我有一箱爆炸物放在离这儿不远的一个空间站里。去把它拿过来，我要用它炸开一条通往银行安全保险库的路。我知道这个工作很无聊，但请你稍微想象一下在金库里静静沉睡的大笔财富，快去快回吧。

name.ru: Ограбление банка - список целей (The Bank Heist - Hit List) (3 из 5)

messages.en:
The planning for entering and leaving the bank is already well under way, but we're still left with finding the best targets once we're inside. I've been working on that while you've been away. I was getting rather frustrated in not finding anyone within the State and Region Bank that I could bribe. Then I got the bright idea of checking out some corporations associated with the bank. And wouldn't you know. I found this cash-strapped guy with the Caldari Funds Unlimited. It's an ideal match; he has all the information I need and I have all the money he craves.

I've already made all the arrangements with him, but the information he's giving us is too sensitive to send over the communication lines. I need someone to go and pick up that list and as you're still wearing your courier boots you're the best pilot for the job. To sweeten the deal a little I'll give you some Paradise Cruise Missiles as a reward. You can occupy yourself on the way by thinking of all those you'll want to blow up with them.
messages.zh:
闯入银行和逃离现场的准备已经就绪，现在的问题是如何在进入银行后确定最值钱的目标。在你离开的时候，我一直忙于此事。说来令人沮丧，国家星域银行里居然找不到一个可以贿赂的人。之后我想到了一个聪明的主意，检查一些和银行有关的集团。你猜怎样？我在加达里无限基金集团里找到了一个身无分文的家伙。这真是一个完美的组合，他有我需要的一切信息，而我有他渴望拥有的所有的金钱。

我已经和他安排好了一切，但是他给我们的信息非常机密，不能通过通讯线路发送。我想找人把名单带回来，考虑到上次的优异表现，你是最适合这个任务的飞行员。为了提高你的兴趣，作为回报，我给你一些“失乐园”巡航导弹。在路上你可以考虑怎么好好利用这些家伙。

name.en: The Bank Heist - Crisis Control (4 of 5)
name.es: Atraco al banco: Control de crisis (4 de 5)
name.fr: Le hold-up – État de crise (4 sur 5)
name.ru: Ограбление банка - антикризисные меры (The Bank Heist - Crisis Control) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
We have a bit of a situation here. While you were gone I received credible information that the bank we're about to hit is planning to install a new safe in their vault. I'm afraid the TNT you got for me earlier isn't enough to crack that baby open. We could hit the bank early, but the preparations are still not done, so I won't risk it. And if we wait while I get better explosives it could be too late.

So I took a big risk and put the word out in the underworld that I was looking for a solution. An hour ago I was contacted by this SuVee gal in a nearby constellation. A buddy of hers found a way to crack this new safe and she's willing to sell us the secret. Time is of the essence, so I'll go out on a limb and double your pay if you manage to bring it back to me within 15 minutes.
messages.zh:
我们这里出了些状况。在你走了之后，我收到了可靠消息，我们将要下手的那家银行正准备在他们的保险库里安装新的保险箱。我担心你之前弄到的TNT爆炸物根本不够把那玩意炸开。我们可以提前对银行下手，但是准备工作还没完全做好，所以我不想冒险。如果我们等待更好的爆炸物，可能时机就会错过了。

所以我不得不铤而走险，在黑社会里放出风声，寻求解决办法。一个小时前，附近星座一个名叫斯库维塔的小妞联系了我。她的一个伙伴有办法撬开这种新型保险箱，她愿意把这个秘密卖给我们。时间宝贵，我现在已经走投无路，如果你能在15分钟内把它带回来的话，我付你双倍费用。

name.en: The Bank Heist - Inside Track (5 of 5)
name.es: Atraco al banco: Rastreo interno (5 de 5)
name.fr: Le hold-up - Tenir la corde (5 sur 5)
name.ru: Ограбление банка - последние шаги (The Bank Heist - Inside Track) (5 из 5)

messages.en:
We're in the final stages of our planning. I'm in the process of tying up loose ends at the moment. I've been digging up more stuff about our friend with the Caldari Funds Unlimited. The man, Uchi Pakkori, is a total sleazeball by the looks of it. I can't trust him, he's liable to try and sell what he knows to the police.

I was going to take care of this myself, so I set up a meeting with him. But like the rat he is he smelled the ambush and fled. Now we have to take him out fast, before he comes out of his hiding hole and starts babbling. I've tracked down Pakkori's hiding place. He's locked himself up in and old warehouse over in Airmia system. He's hired some thugs to protect him, so they have to be dealt with as well.

Pakkori always wears an exceptionally ugly hat. With its wide brim I think he sees himself as some sort of a cowboy riding the steppes of Caldari Prime. I don't know. But that hat is as good as DNA, because no one else is crazy enough to wear something as ugly as that. Go and blow up his hiding hole and bring me his hat. I don't care if it has some burn marks on it, I'll probably use it to wipe my arse anyway. You'll be handsomly rewarded for this, but be careful. With the amount of money I paid Pakkori he could have hired a whole battalion to protect him. Not that I expect it from the cheap bastard, but you never know.
messages.zh:
我们已经计划得差不多了，还剩下一些收尾工作。我挖出了不少有关我们的朋友和加达里无限基金集团之间的资料。这个名叫乌兹•帕克里的人，一看就知道是一个彻头彻尾的混蛋。我不会信任他，他会把所知道的一切出卖给警察。

我原打算亲自除掉他，所以约他过来谈谈。但他精得就像一只老鼠，仿佛嗅出了火药味儿，一溜烟跑了。眼下，趁他还没出来胡言乱语之前，我们必须赶快除掉他。我已经追踪到了帕克里的藏身点。他把自己锁在艾尔米亚星系里一个旧的贮藏库里面。还雇佣了一些暴徒来保护他，把这些家伙也一并干掉吧。

帕克里总是戴着难看透顶的帽子。那个大帽檐想必真让他把自己当了加达里首星大草原上骑马飞奔的牛仔。真是匪夷所思。但那个帽子就像他的DNA一样独一无二，没有人会发疯去戴那么难看的东西。炸掉他藏身的窝洞，把他的帽子带回来。我不介意这顶帽子是否完好无损，反正我本来就把它当成垃圾。完成这个任务，你就能得到一大笔钱，不过要小心。帕克里可能用我给他的钱雇了一整支军队来保护自己。倒不是我想从那个混蛋那里得到什么，而是你永远不知道他会做些什么。

messages.en:
Hey there, I realize you might be busy with something else, but I could really use some help over here. My superiors have assigned a lot of tasks to me and I'm not sure if I can handle them all by myself.

There are some Nugoeihuvi excavators stepping on our turf at the contested Lai Dai Refinery in Airmia. If you could go there and "take care" of them, it would be well appreciated. Bring back some Nugoeihuvi dogtags as proof of your actions.
messages.zh:
嘿，你好，我知道你可能正在忙其他事，但我这里实在需要人手。我的上级给我布置了一大堆任务，可我不确定自己能不能都解决。

在艾尔米亚争夺中的莱戴精炼厂，有一些纳基维集团挖掘者闯进了我们的地盘。如果你能去那儿，帮我“好好照顾”他们，我会感激不尽的。带一些纳基维铭牌回来证明你已完成任务。

name.en: The Break In Expert - Wiretap (1 of 3)
name.ja: 侵入のエキスパート―盗聴（1/3）
name.ru: Проникновение в систему - прослушка (The Break In Expert - Wiretap) (1 из 3)

messages.en: I've been hired by my Corp mate Krakan Rost for a certain job he's planning. Go talk to him for details, if you haven't already. Anyway, I need some help from you. I have here a wiretap device that I need to get into the local State and Region Bank station. The only problem is that I have a history with that particular branch of the bank and can't enter it myself. I'll pay you well for such a small job. Just take the plant I've hidden the wiretap in and place it anywhere in the bank. I will take it from there and tap into the surveillance mainframe.
messages.zh: 我受雇于集团的同伴卡亢•诺斯特，正在从事他计划中的某个工作。想要知道细节，可以去找他谈谈。总之，我需要你的帮助。我这里有一个窃听装置，想把它安装在本地的国家星域银行空间站。唯一的问题是我在那个银行的支行有前科，不能亲自进去。虽然工作比较小，但酬劳还不错。拿着这盆植物，我在里面放了偷听器，把它放在银行里面的任何地方。我会从那里接进他们的监控主机。

messages.en: I have another task for you, my friend. Small outbreaks have been popping up around {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and the local police authorities are having troubles defusing the situation. Please deliver these rifles, they will prove a valuable aid and my superiors would definitely notice if you played a part in this.
messages.zh: 我有另一项任务给你，我的朋友。{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}周围不断出现小型暴动，当地警方难以平息场面。请你把这些步枪送去，它们会提供非常有价值的援助，而且如果你在这事中发挥作用，我的上级一定会注意到。

messages.zh: 我又有新的任务给你了，朋友。{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}周围突然发生了一些小暴动，当地警方难以控制场面。请你把这些步枪送去，应该能帮到那些警察，如果你顺利完成这次任务，一定能引起我上级的注意。

name.en: The Break In Expert - Sabotage (2 of 3)
name.ja: 侵入のエキスパート―妨害工作（2/3）
name.ru: Проникновение в систему - саботаж (The Break In Expert - Sabotage) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
Thanks again for a job well done with the wiretap. It looks as if there's someone attempting to set up a surveillance fence around the bank. That fence would make my job very difficult. Whoever is doing this is too clever by far, he's using state of the art scanners called Barbed Wire Scanners that are very hard to tamper with.

I managed to break into the cargo manifest at the State War Academy station in Ishisomo and discovered that a bunch of these scanners are sitting there waiting to be shipped out here. I have an accomplice on the station, but he doesn't have the means to deal with them. I want to provide him with those means. Rost gave me a crate of dynamite he's not using and I want you to smuggle it into the State War Academy station. My accomplice there will then use it to sabotage the scanners, making it all look like an accident of course. We have to move quickly before the scanners are shipped out, so I'm enticing you with a nice bonus reward if you get there within 20 minutes.
messages.zh:
再次感谢你出色完成了安防偷听器的任务。似乎有人试图在银行周围建立一条监视警戒网。那条警戒网会使我的工作非常困难。目前能想到这种方法的人真是太聪明了，他用的是称为绞丝网式扫描器的最高技术的扫描器，很难对付。

我拿到了伊什索蒙里国立军事学院空间站的载货清单，发现这批扫描器还在那里等着被运送到这儿来。我有个同伙在那个空间站，但他没有什么工具能处理掉那批扫描器。我想给他提供这些工具。诺斯特给了我一箱他用不着的爆炸物，我要你去把它偷运进国立军事学院空间站。我的朋友会处理省下的事情，当然，现场不会留下任何蛛丝马迹，对旁人而言，这只是一场意外。我们必须迅速行动，免得这些扫描器被运走，如果你能在20分钟到达那儿，我会给你不错的奖赏。

name.fr: L'expert – Le trousseau de clés (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 侵入のエキスパート―キーチェーン（3/3）
name.ru: Проникновение в систему - ключи (The Break In Expert - Keychain) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
I'm almost done with the job assigned to me. One last thing remains. A keychain to enter the outer security vault in the bank. I've been trying to get my hands on one for days now, but the personnel in the bank is on high alert. Thank Fate for human failings, though.

I have a friend that works in a brothel the Kazka bandits operate over in the contested complex in Sakkikainen. She contacted me earlier to let me know one of the assistant bank managers is indulging himself there now. I told her to get the hell out of there, because I would be bringing hellfire on the place in a short while. I need you to go into the Kazka complex, find the brothel and blow it up. The keychain is made from enforced Nocxium, so it will survive unscathed. Bring me the assistant's keychain to me and you'll get a great reward.
messages.zh:
我就快大功告成了。现在只剩下最后一样东西。一串能进入银行外层保险库的钥匙串。这么多天来，我一直在想方设法弄这东西，但是银行职员保持着高度警惕。幸好，是人总有弱点。

我有个朋友在萨基凯伦争夺中的复合体里的一家娱乐站工作，那个地方归卡兹卡强盗所有。她之前告诉我，有个银行助理经理正在那儿寻欢作乐。我叫她赶快滚蛋，因为我马上要把那里变成火红地域。我要你飞去那个卡兹卡复合体，找到娱乐站，把它炸掉。那个钥匙串是用增强的超新星诺克石制成的，所以爆炸不会对它有丝毫影响。把那个助理的钥匙串带给我，我会重重奖励你。

messages.en:
I'm almost done with the job assigned to me. One last thing remains. A keychain to enter the outer security vault in the bank. I've been trying to get my hands on one for days now, but the personnel in the bank is on high alert. Thank Fate for human failings, though.

I have a friend that works in a brothel the Kazka bandits operate over in the contested complex in Sakkikainen. She contacted me earlier to let me know one of the assistant bank managers is indulging himself there now. I told her to get the hell out of there, because I would be bringing hellfire on the place in a short while. I need you to go into the Kazka complex, find the brothel and blow it up. The keychain is made from enforced Nocxium, so it will survive unscathed. Bring me the assistant's keychain to me and you'll get a great reward.

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, go back to the Lai Dai refinery and destroy every single ship that might be there. Bring back to me every report you find, if we look hard enough we're bound to find the right one eventually. You have to hurry though, my superiors are getting suspicious of why I haven't made any progress on the excavation operations that were assigned to me. Letting your plans fall into enemy hands is bad for business.
messages.zh: >{[character]player.name}，回到莱戴精炼厂，摧毁那儿的所有舰船。带回你发现的每一份报告，如果我们看得够仔细，最后一定能找到我们要的那份。但你得赶快行动，我的上级已经对我在挖掘任务上毫无进展的原因感到怀疑。计划落入敌人手中实在是商业大忌。

name.ru: Становится все хуже… (It Gets Worse...) (2 из 3)

messages.en: I think I'm going mad! Those reports you gave me were nothing like the stolen ones! We have to make sure my superiors do not find out about the missing reports. Go to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and give them these status reports, any doubts they have should be cleared once they see these.
messages.zh: 我简直快疯了！你给我的那些报告根本就不是被偷的那些！我们绝不能让我的上级知道报告丢失的事。去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，把这些状态报告交给他们，一旦他们看到这些报告，就会打消疑念了。

messages.zh: 我简直快疯了！你给我的那些报告和失窃的那些根本就是两回事！绝不能让我的上级察觉报告已经丢失。去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，把这些状态报告交给他们，一旦他们看到这些报告，就会打消疑念了。

name.de: Sehen Sie, ich brauche Ihre Hilfe (1 von 3)
name.en: Look, I Need Your Help (1 of 3)
name.fr: J'ai besoin de votre aide (1 sur 3)
name.ja: なあ、君の助けが必要なんだ（1/3）
name.ru: Послушайте, мне нужна помощь (Look, I Need Your Help) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
You have to help me! I screwed up big time. My superiors trusted me with secret locations to ancient relics hidden by the civilizations that lived here centuries ago. If they find out about this I'm finished within Lai Dai, they will probably even make sure that I never find work again!

This document was stolen from me by one of our adversaries, I'm sure. Go to the contested Lai Dai Refinery and see if you can find it there. If you find it, bring it back to me.
messages.zh:
你一定得帮我！我把事情搞得一团糟。上级可是十分信任我，才告诉了我古文物的秘密存放地，这些古物是几个世纪前居住在此的文明留下的。如果他们发现此事，那么我在莱戴集团内的前途算是完了，他们甚至可能会让我永远找不到工作！

我肯定，这份文件一定是被一个对手给拿走了。前往争夺中的莱戴精炼厂，看看能否在那里找到。如果你找到了，请把它带回给我。
