messages.en:
You see this? I'm flying a capsule! Those damn Nugoeihuvi don't know who they're dealing with here. If they think they can blow up my ship and get away with it, they are horribly mistaken.

I'm going to build myself a new Merlin. If you could somehow find 2674 units of Isogen and bring it to me, you would have my gratitude.
messages.zh:
你看到了吗？我在开逃生舱哪！那些该死的纳基维的家伙不想想自己在和谁作对。如果他们觉得能够炸掉我的飞船，并逃之夭夭，那么他们就大错特错了。

我要给自己建造一艘新的“小鹰”级。如果你能帮我弄到2674个单位的同位聚合体，我将对你表示谢意。

我要给自己建造一艘新的“小鹰”级。如果你能帮我弄到2674个单位的同位聚合体，我将对你表示谢意。

name.de: Ich habe mein Zeug verloren (2 von 2)
name.ru: Я потерял свои вещи (I Lost My Stuff) (2 из 2)

messages.en: When I got blown up, most of the modules on my ship got destroyed. Some of my items survived the explosion but got looted by enemy ships shortly after. Before I can build my new ship, I need you to go and retrieve some of the lost modules. Please go to the contested Lai Dai Refinery and bring back one of my missile launchers. Maybe I will give you a nice reward if you complete this quickly.
messages.zh: 当我的飞船被炸时，大多数装备都被摧毁了。尽管有些物品免受爆炸损毁，但很快就被敌方飞船抢了过去。在我能建造新船之前，我要你去找回部分丢失的装备。请前往争夺中的莱戴精炼厂，把我的导弹发射器带一个回来。如果你快速完成任务，也许我会好好奖励你。

messages.en: When I got blown up, most of the modules on my ship got destroyed. Some of my items survived the explosion but got looted by enemy ships shortly after. Before I can build my new ship, I need you to go and retrieve some of the lost modules. Please go to the contested Lai Dai Refinery and bring back one of my missile launchers. Maybe I will give you a nice reward if you complete this quickly.
messages.zh: 当我的飞船爆炸时，大多数装备悉数被毁。尽管有些装备并没有因爆炸而损毁，但很快它们就被敌方飞船抢了过去。在我建造新船之前，我要你去找回部分失落的装备。前往争夺中的莱戴精炼厂，把我的导弹发射器带一个回来。如果你能尽快完成任务的话，我也许会给你很棒的报酬。

name.de: Freelancer der Nugoeihuvi - Schlechte Neuigkeiten (4 von 4)
name.es: Por libre para Nugoeihuvi: Malas noticias (4 de 4)
name.fr: Indépendant Nugoeihuvi – De mauvaises nouvelles (4 sur 4)
name.ja: ノゴエイハヴィの傭兵-悪い知らせ（4/4）
name.ru: Наемник Nugoeihuvi - плохие новости (Nugoeihuvi Freelancer - Bad News) (4 из 4)
name.zh: 纳基维自由飞行员—坏消息 (4/4)

messages.en: Thank heavens you're back, {[character]player.name}. I have horrible news. Propel Dynamics found out about our station construction and are planning an attack on this facility within the next hour. I'm sending all my men to destroy their forces located at the Lai Dai Refinery in order to halt the attack. Please go there and bring back five Propel Dynamics dogtags as proof of your actions.
messages.zh: 谢天谢地，你可回来了，{[character]player.name}。我有些可怕的消息。推进动态集团发现了我们的空间站，正计划在一小时内攻打这里。为了阻断他们的袭击，我派了手下所有人去消灭他们驻在莱戴精炼厂的部队。请前往那里，带五个推进动态集团成员的铭牌回来作为你行动成功的证明。

messages.en: Thank heavens you're back, {[character]player.name}. I have horrible news. Propel Dynamics found out about our station construction and are planning an attack on this facility within the next hour. I'm sending all my men to destroy their forces located at the Lai Dai Refinery in order to halt the attack. Please go there and bring back five Propel Dynamics dogtags as proof of your actions.
messages.zh: 谢天谢地，你终于回来了，{[character]player.name}。我有个很坏的消息。推进动态集团发现了我们的空间站，并计划在一个小时内对我们的工厂进行攻击。为了阻止他们的突袭，我已经派出了我所有的人力去摧毁他们在莱戴加工厂的军队。到那里去，带五个推进动态集团成员的铭牌回来作为你完成任务的证明。

name.de: Freelancer der Nugoeihuvi - Arbeiter brauchen Atemluft... (3 von 4)
name.en: Nugoeihuvi Freelancer - Workers Need Air... (3 of 4)
name.es: Por libre para Nugoeihuvi: Los trabajadores necesitan aire... (3 de 4)
name.fr: Indépendant Nugoeihuvi - Les ouvriers ont besoin d'oxygène... (3 sur 4)
name.ja: ノゴエイハヴィの傭兵-作業員には息抜きが必要...（3/4）
name.ru: Наемник Nugoeihuvi - рабочим нужен воздух... (Nugoeihuvi Freelancer - Workers Need Air...) (3 из 4)
name.zh: 纳基维自由飞行员—工人们需要空气……(3/4)

messages.en: Construction is about to start, but we still require more components for the station. Right now, hundreds of workers are being imported from nearby colonies. In order to keep them alive we will need some more Oxygen. Find 137 units of Oxygen and bring it to me.
messages.zh: 工程马上就要启动了，但我们的空间站还需要一些必需品。现在正有成百上千的工人被从附近殖民地输送过来。为了维持他们的是生命，我们需要更多的氧气。去找137个单位的氧气回来给我。

messages.en: Construction is about to start, but we still require more components for the station. Right now, hundreds of workers are being imported from nearby colonies. In order to keep them alive we will need some more Oxygen. Find 137 units of Oxygen and bring it to me.
messages.zh: 工程马上就要启动了，但我们还需要些人手来建造空间站。有数百名工人正从附近的殖民地赶来。我们还需要一些氧气来作为他们的生存保障。找137单位的氧气回来给我。

name.es: Por libre para Nugoeihuvi: Bloques de construcción (2 de 4)
name.fr: Indépendant Nugoeihuvi – Les blocs de construction (2 sur 4)
name.ja: ノゴエイハヴィの傭兵-建設資材（2/4）
name.ru: Наемник Nugoeihuvi - строительные блоки (Nugoeihuvi Freelancer - Construction Blocks) (2 из 4)
name.zh: 纳基维自由飞行员—建筑模块 (2/4)

messages.en: The station construction will be starting in a few days, and right now we are gathering minerals for the operation. I need you to head to a nearby system, pick up construction blocks and bring them over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Do this for me and I will give you your next assignment.
messages.zh: 几天内空间站的建设就将启动，目前我们正为此囤积矿物。我要你飞往附近一个星系去捡建筑石料，然后带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。帮我把这事搞定后我会给你安排下一个任务。

name.de: Freelancer der Nugoeihuvi - Lieferung des Stationsplans (1 von 4)
name.en: Nugoeihuvi Freelancer - Station Schematic Delivery (1 of 4)
name.es: Por libre para Nugoeihuvi: Entrega del diagrama de la estación (1 de 4)
name.fr: Indépendant Nugoeihuvi – Livraison des plans de la station (1 sur 4)
name.ja: ノゴエイハヴィの傭兵-ステーション概略図（1/4）
name.ru: Наемник Nugoeihuvi - доставка схемы станции (Nugoeihuvi Freelancer - Station Schematic Delivery) (1 из 4)
name.zh: 纳基维自由飞行员—运送空间站图纸(1/4)

messages.en: Hello there, traveler. Nugoeihuvi is happy that you chose to work for us instead of the other corporations trying to gain control of this constellation. In our quest to be at the top, a station would most certainly ease all our operations and give us an unmeasurable advantage over the other corporations. If you want to prove your loyalty to me, take this station schematic and deliver it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. They are eager to have a look at it before our construction starts, just to make sure everything in order.
messages.zh: 你好，旅行者。很高兴你选择为纳维基集团效力，而不是试图控制本星座的其他集团。为了实现我们的至高目标，一个空间站是必不可少的，它将缓解我们的工作难度，使我们在与其他集团的竞争中获得不可比拟的优势。如果你想证明对我的忠诚，就把这份空间站原理图送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。那里的人迫切希望在我们开工前看看这张图，以确保没有任何差错。

messages.en: Hello there, traveler. Nugoeihuvi is happy that you chose to work for us instead of the other corporations trying to gain control of this constellation. In our quest to be at the top, a station would most certainly ease all our operations and give us an unmeasurable advantage over the other corporations. If you want to prove your loyalty to me, take this station schematic and deliver it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. They are eager to have a look at it before our construction starts, just to make sure everything in order.
messages.zh: 你好。我很高兴你选择了纳基维，而不是星座中其他野心勃勃的超级集团。在我们追求完美境界的过程中，一个空间站肯定会减轻不少工作量，并帮助我们在激烈的竞争中取得领先。如果你想向我证明你的忠诚的话，把这个空间站原理图送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。在建设活动开始之前，这份图纸必须送到我们的工程师手中。一路顺风。

name.es: El hombre de la medicina: Mordedura de serpiente (2 de 3)
name.fr: L'homme médecine – Morsure de serpent (2 sur 3)
name.ru: Врачеватель — укус змеи (The Medicine Man - Snakebite) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
Well, friend, we're in it now. I just caught a whiff that there's one of them darned bounty hunters in system, looking for my hide. And I have a hunch you're next. See, this here's one of them Caldari fellers, and he's working for the corporation that synthesized the cubensis you stole. Cubensis is always a hot product on account of how much the Man hates it, so they hafta take extreme measures if'n it slips out.

He's hanging out at the Gravediggers Saloon, a filthy smuggler dive located in this system and filled with lowlives. I'll give ya the coordinates if ya can take him out for me. I'll also give ya something more. And remember, this feller could come for YOU next. And he's a tough one, I hear, so you'd better pack yer big guns. For good measure, I'm gonna ask ya to destroy the saloon well, so there won't be no evidence for those other scumbags to trace ya back here. Well, whatcha waiting for? Get to it!
messages.zh:
好吧，朋友，我们有事儿做了。我刚刚听到风声，有个可恶的赏金猎人在星系里四处打探我的藏身之地。我有预感你会是下一个目标。看，这加达里混蛋的雇主正是你窃得的锢秘西锶的那个集团。锢秘西锶真是炙手可热啊，想想有这些家伙对它是多么的深恶痛绝，所以他们不得不采取极端手段来防止这个东西的外泄。

他在掘墓者沙龙里，那是个藏污纳垢的地方，非法贩售者充斥，下等人齐聚。我会把他的位标给你，去帮我干掉他。记住，这个家伙的下一个目标就是你。听说他很难对付，所以你最好全副武装，准备好充足的弹药。另外，把这个沙龙也给摧毁，那样就不会留下任何线索给他的同伙了。你还在等什么？赶快吧！

name.de: Pit Stop Slash Saloon - Hilfe benötigt (1 von 4)
name.en: Pit Stop Slash Saloon - Need A Helping Hand (1 of 4)
name.es: Parada técnica y taberna: Una ayudita (1 de 4)
name.fr: Halte spatiale et saloon – Besoin d'un coup de main (1 sur 4)
name.ja: ピットイン酒場-求人募集（1/4）
name.ru: Питейное заведение - требуется рука помощи (Pit Stop Slash Saloon - Need A Helping Hand) (1 из 4)

messages.en: I'd like to help you out, {[character]agentID.name}, as long as the pay is good.
messages.zh: 只要酬劳令人满意，我愿意帮助你，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Your first job is to get me some able-bodied people to get this project started.  I located some out-of-work construction workers on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, I suggest you stop by that station and pick them up.  Once you get there here, drop them off in the habitation module that I've placed inside this hollow asteroid, for your reward.  I'll have them get to work with rebuilding the station ruins immediately once they arrive.
messages.zh: 你的第一个任务就是给我找些身强体健的人来使项目开工。我查到在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}上有一些失业的建筑工人。我建议你去那跑一趟，把他们装上你的飞船。一旦你把他们运过来，就把他们安放在位于这个中空小行星之内的居住舱里，然后我会给你报酬。他们到达后，我立刻会让他们投入空间站废墟的重建工作。

messages.en: Hmm, lack of work for a long period has really had it's effect on these people.  I just hope they are up to the strenuous work ahead of them.  Rebuilding this massive structure is no laughing matter, and will require years of effort with the limited staff I have available to me.  But enough small talk, lets get on to your next assignment.
messages.zh: 唔，长时间的待工对这些人造成了不小的影响。我只希望他们面对艰辛的工作能振奋起来。重建这个庞然大物不是一件开玩笑的事，我手下的员工人数有限，他们需要付出多年的努力。说得够多了，你接着做下一个任务吧。

messages.en: Your first job is to get me some able-bodied people to get this project started.  I located some out-of-work construction workers on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, I suggest you stop by that station and pick them up.  Once you get there here, drop them off in the habitation module that I've placed inside this hollow asteroid, for your reward.  I'll have them get to work with rebuilding the station ruins immediately once they arrive.
messages.zh: 你的第一个工作就是替我找一些适合的劳动力来启动这个项目。我查到在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}上有一些没事可干的建筑工人。去那个空间站把他们带过来，直接送到我在这内空的小行星里设置的居住舱，然后我会给你报酬。等他们到达，我会立即开始重建空间站遗迹的工作。

name.ru: Питейное заведение - материалы для постройки (Pit Stop Slash Saloon - Materials For Construction) (2 из 4)

messages.en:
Now that I have the staff needed to kick-start my project, I need to stockpile materials for the future. I already have a small stash of construction blocks inside the Caldari station ruins, but according to my estimates that will only last a few days.

A colleague of mine at the Propel Dynamics Factory in Ishisomo purchased a batch of construction blocks for me yesterday. If you could pick them up and drop them off at the ruins I would be very grateful.
messages.zh:
我已经有了启动项目所需的人手，现在该为日后储备材料了。在这些加达里空间站废墟里有一些建筑石料，但是照我估计它们只够用几天。

昨天我在伊什索蒙推进动态集团工厂的一位同事帮我购买了一批建造模块。如果你能去取一下，并把它们卸载在废墟那儿，我会万分感激。

messages.zh:
启动项目的员工已到位，我现在得储备材料。我在加达里空间站遗迹内已有一些建筑原料，但是照我估计它们只够用几天。

我昨天拜托一个伊什索蒙推进动态集团工厂的同事，帮我购买了一批建筑原料。如果你能去取来并送到遗迹那儿，我会感激不尽。

messages.en:
Unfortunately the construction workers I hired recently have already started complaining about the lack of decent tools. This has really started to slow down our progress, so I'd like you to get me a new batch of construction tools a.s.a.p. You'll find them stored inside my warehouse in Otitoh, at the first moon of the fifth planet in that system. The only catch is that the last time I dropped by the structure, I was attacked by bandits, who've apparently claimed the warehouse as their own. The lack of security in Otitoh is staggering, which is why I left that run-down system to begin with.

Once you bring the tools here, I'll reward you generously.
messages.zh:
倒霉，我才雇佣的建筑工人已经开始抱怨没有好工具了。这的确降低了我们的进度，所以我希望你尽快替我弄一批新建筑工具来。它们就储存在我在欧提托的仓库里，仓库位于欧提托星系第五行星的第一卫星上。唯一的麻烦是上次我到仓库时遭到了一伙强盗的袭击，显然他们已经将仓库占为己有。欧提托的治安一塌糊涂，这也是我离开那个破败星系的主要原因。

只要你把工具带来，我便会给你丰厚的报酬。

一旦你把工具带来，我会给你丰厚的报酬。

name.de: Zum Fahren verdonnert - Die Werkstatt (1 von 4)
name.ja: 指定ドライバー―ガレージ（1/4）
name.ru: Ответственный пилот - гараж (Designated Driver - The Garage) (1 из 4)

messages.en:
I'm setting up an escape route for my friend Krakan Rost, for some job he's planning. I already got two fast ships, a Crow and a Raptor, lined up as the getaway vessels. I'm plotting the escape course as we speak. I want to use the Crow as the first getaway ship, then switch over to the Raptor to confuse the police and any potential pursuers.

All I need now is a convenient place to stash the Raptor. It must be a place far from the prying eyes of the police. I've heard a rumor that local bandits in this constellation operate a garage somewhere in the area. That would be an ideal place to keep the Raptor. The only problem is, I don't know where it is. And the bandits are of course pretty secretive about the garage's location. But from what I've heard, the outlaw Wrecker, Despoiler, and Destructor bandits are the keepers of this fabled lore. Go kill some of them and see if any of them coughs it up.
messages.zh:
我正在为我的朋友卡亢•诺斯特制定某个任务的逃跑路线。我已经准备好了一艘黑鸦级飞船和一艘猛禽级飞船作为逃跑的工具，目前正在绘制逃跑线路。他们先用黑鸦级飞船，然后再改换猛禽级飞船，这样就能迷惑警察以及其他试图追踪他们的人。

现在，我需要一个合适的地方来隐藏猛禽级飞船。那个地方必须远离警察视线。听说这个星系的强盗在这里的某处有一个机修厂，那儿是停放飞船的好地方。唯一的问题是，我不知道这个机修厂的确切位置。这群强盗的嘴很严实，对机修厂的位置不露口风。但我听说放逐-肇事者，搜寻者和爆破者是这个神秘地方的守门人。去干掉几个，看看能不能有所发现。

name.ru: Ответственный пилот - дешифратор (Designated Driver - The Decoder) (2 из 4)

messages.en:
Congratulations again on a job well done. Sad thing is, these bandits are obviously more paranoid than most: The data chip you gave me is encoded with some heavy-duty codelock. The Data Analyzer I'll need for this is not something available on the common market.

I did some digging around, and turns out there's a black marketeer operating out of the Chief Executive Panel station in Otitoh. Strange place for such an operation, but I gather he's working under the protection of some high-level official there. Only goes to show what a strange place Okkelen is these days. Anyway, Rost wants me here, so I need someone to get that decoder for me. And as you did so well the last time, I think you're the one.
messages.zh:
再次祝贺你出色地完成了任务。可惜的是，这些强盗比他们很多同行都要多疑。你给我的数据芯片是用某种高效密码锁加密的。用来解这种锁的数据分析仪在普通市场上根本找不到。

我尽力搜集了些相关信息，结果发现在欧提托的CEO合作组织空间站外有一个黑市商人在那开展业务。竟然会选择这么个奇怪的地点做这种买卖，我猜他肯定有那里的高级官员罩着。再次证明了如今欧克勒恩是一个多么不可思议的地方。总之，诺斯特这里需要我，因此我要找个人把那个解码器带回来。上次任务中你的表现很出色，我想你是再合适不过的人选了。

messages.en:
Now that the rebuilding of the station ruins is well under way, it's time for your last assignment. There is a wealthy Gallente entrepreneur called Sefo Caraton who took the initiative a few years ago to extend his Pleasure Hub business to the Caldari territories. Apparently competition in Gallente space was getting fierce, and he believed the relative lack of luxury resorts here in the Caldari State presented a great opportunity for his business. He opened multiple resorts in the State, most of which seem to be very profitable. Unfortunately for him, the one in Okkelen has been doing quite badly, the economy here just doesn't support this type of thing. But despite that, he simply refuses to leave, for whatever reason. Perhaps he believes there are better times ahead, and he's been paying a huge amount of money from his own pocket to keep it running with relatively few customers.

The problem for me is that this pleasure hub has a built-in casino, and it will be in direct competition with my future pit-stop. It's also popular amongst the social elite, which poses a problem to me since they are the ones where the money's at, if you know what I mean.

I want this Gallente upstart's pleasure hub completely destroyed. Once his multi-million-ISK installation goes poof, I'm sure he will not even consider rebuilding it here due to the cost and lack of profits. That will clear the way for my own business to flourish, with no competition whatsoever!
messages.zh:
基地废墟的重建工作进行得很顺利，现在准备接受随后的任务吧。有一个名叫西佛•卡拉通的盖伦特企业家，他家财万贯，几年前他率先将自己的娱乐中心生意带到了加达里。盖伦特空域内竞争日益加剧，而在加达里豪华娱乐场却还是个新鲜事物，这使他相信在这片热土上，他将大有可为。他在合众国建立了多个娱乐场，而且大多数都生意兴隆。然而不幸的是，在欧克勒恩的一个门可罗雀。虽然那的情况很糟，但他并没有就此丧失信心，他相信迟早这里的生意会和别处一样红火，所以依靠少量的顾客，加上他自己的投资，那家娱乐场勉强地支撑了下来。

但是这似乎给我带来了一些麻烦，因为在这个娱乐中心内部有一个游乐场，而这将使我未来的小站承受不小的竞争压力。让我顾虑重重的是，目前游乐场内社会名流云集，而他们可都是一掷千金的大主顾，这会危及到我的生意，你应该理解吧。

我要把这个盖伦特暴发户的娱乐中心夷为平地。当眼睁睁看着数百万资产化为乌有，顾及成本与收益的问题他会打消在此东山再起的念头，没有了对手，我生意的前景将一片光明。

messages.en: The Caraton Pleasure Gardens have been destroyed, as you requested.
messages.zh: 按你的指示，卡拉通休闲园区已被彻底摧毁。

messages.en: Ah the sweet taste of victory is always as gratifying.  A few years from now, and I'll be one of the most successful businessmen in the entire Caldari State!  Just you wait and see, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 啊，胜利的甜蜜滋味总是那样耐人回味。今后几年内，我就会跻身加达里合众国最成功的商人之列！你就等着瞧吧，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en:
We've set up a few telescopes in the surrounding asteroid belts around Sakkikainen VI to establish a powerful surveillance network, which we will use to determine the magnitude of rogue elements in the area. This is necessary for us to be able to calculate the cost of maintaining an adequate police force in Sakkikainen VI.

A few days ago we lost contact with 3 of our telescopes. I hope that it was caused by a malfunction in the communication device inside the telescope, but I have to be prepared for the worst. And the fact that the last team I sent out there to investigate haven't returned yet ... well, it pretty much confirms my fears.

I want you to fly over to one of the surveillance telescopes and retrieve the scanner data chip from it's main computer. If lady luck is with us, the telescope will still be intact. If the data is retrieved, I will be able to access the logs and discover what caused the loss of communication.

I'm counting on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
我们在萨基凯伦VI周围的环绕行星地带设置了一批望远镜，用以构建一个强大的监控网络，通过这个网络，我们就能测定该地区内的自由分子数量。这对于我们在萨基凯伦VI警力配备的成本核算非常重要。

几天前，我们对三个望远镜的控制突然中断了。希望是望远镜内部的通信设备出了故障，但我必须做最坏的打算。实际上我最后派去调查的小组还没有回来……这进一步证实了我的担心。

我要你飞到其中一个监控望远镜那里，从主电脑上把扫描数据芯片拿回来。如果我们够幸运的话，那个望远镜应该仍然完好无损。只要你把数据拿回来，我就能够读取日志，从而发现通讯中断的真正原因。

我就指望你了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Interesting.  Well, I expected as much.  The Guristas organization has a very strong presence in Okkelen, it's not surprising that they would be opposed to any buildup of State forces in Sakkikainen.  But we can't let them hinder our progress here, I have a few more tasks for you.  Once they are accomplished my mission here will be complete, and I'll be able to report my findings to the Chief Executive Panel.
messages.zh: 真是有趣。我也是这么预计的。古斯塔斯组织在欧克勒恩活动猖獗，所以他们当然敌视萨基凯伦的所有合众国军事力量。不过我们不能让他们阻碍我们的工作进程，我有好几项任务要给你。一旦你的任务完成，那么我的任务也就完成了，那么我就能把我的发现报告给决策层了。

几天前，我们对三个望远镜的控制突然中断了。希望是望远镜内部的通信设备出了故障，但我必须做最坏的打算。实际上我最后派去调查的小组还没有回来……这进一步证实了我的担心。

我要你飞到其中一个监控望远镜那里，从主电脑上把扫描数据芯片拿回来。如果我们够幸运的话，那个望远镜应该仍然完好无损。只要你把数据拿回来，我就能够读取日志，从而发现通讯中断的真正原因。

我就指望你了，{[character]player.name}。

name.en: Designated Driver - State of Mind (4 of 4)
name.fr: Pilote désigné – Une envie pressante (4 sur 4)
name.ru: Ответственный пилот - состояние души (Designated Driver - State of Mind) (4 из 4)

messages.en:
Okay, I'm all set with my preparations, so now all I have to do is wait for Rost to finish ... well, whatever it is he's doing. My guess is it has something to do with the bank vault here in Vahunomi, but I have no idea really. Go talk to him about that, if you haven't already.

There's only one more thing I need, and then everything is perfect. It's my custom to down a bottle of spiked Quafe just before the action heats up. The only problem is, I don't have any with me, and as far as I know there's none to be found in this godforsaken constellation. Thankfully, I've located a supermarket station in the next constellation that carries it. Can you bring me a bottle? Such a simple task, I know, but I will pay you well for it.
messages.zh:
好啦，我已经准备就绪，现在只等诺斯特忙完手头的事了……谁知道他在做什么呢。我猜那事大概在与瓦胡诺米的银行保险库有关，但我真是一点也说不准。如果你还没跟他谈过这事，去找他聊聊。

我还需要最后一样东西就万事具备了。在办正事之前，我都喜欢灌下一瓶兑酒的酷菲。可惜，我身边一滴酒也没有，据我所知，在这个被上帝遗弃的鬼星座，根本没地方去弄那玩意。幸运的是，我在毗邻的星座里找到了一个有卖这种饮料的超市空间站。你能帮我带一瓶来吗？我知道，这活太简单了，不过我会好好犒劳你的。

name.fr: Pilote désigné - Le grand nettoyage (3 sur 4)
name.ru: Ответственный водитель - очистка (Designated Driver - Clean Out) (3 из 4)

messages.en:
I've finally managed to crack this damn data chip open, thanks to the decoder you got me. The garage is in the middle of nowhere, as I expected. No wonder the police have no idea of its whereabouts. It's just too perfect a place to switch ships. Definitely worth all this hassle.

I'm ready to ship the Raptor out to this garage, but first it has to be cleared out. I think you're the right person for that task. It shouldn't be too hard, though ― there are probably just a few mechanics over there ― but just to be on the safe side you might consider bringing some pals along. As soon as you accept this mission, I'll upload the location of the garage into your ship computer.

I have a nice reward lined up for you for doing this for me.
messages.zh:
多亏你带来的解码器，我终于破解了这块该死的数据芯片。正如我所料，机库的位置非常隐蔽。难怪警方连它的影子也找不到。那里实在是更换飞船的完美地点。我们的努力完全值得。

我准备把这艘“猛禽”级截击舰运过去，但首先得把那儿清除干净。我感觉你很适合这项工作。战斗应该不难，说不定那儿只有几个机修工——但为了保险起见，最好还是带几个朋友过去。如果你接受，我会把机库的位置上传到你的舰载计算机里。

好好干，报酬一定让你满意。

name.en: The Caldari Migrants - Reconnaissance Point 2 (2 of 5)
name.es: Los migrantes caldaris: Punto de reconocimiento 2 (2 de 5)
name.fr: Les migrants caldari – Point de reconnaissance 2 (2 sur 5)
name.ja: カルダリの移住者―偵察ポイント2（2/5）
name.ru: Мигранты Caldari - разведывательный пункт 2 (The Caldari Migrants - Reconnaissance Point 2) (2 из 5)

messages.en:
I've received word from two other teams I sent out to investigate the loss of communication with the surveillance telescopes. They reported that the other two telescopes have been completely looted, leaving nothing behind save the exterior hull of the structures. This obviously means they could not retrieve the scanner data as I had requested.

I believe that the scanner data, along with the expensive computer systems we had installed in the surveillance telescopes, is in the possession of the Guristas Pirates or other bandit elements within Okkelen. I want you to personally organize a search for the missing scanner data chips. Scourge the asteroid belts in Okkelen, the pirates responsible for stealing the data may be located anywhere within the constellation. If you miraculously find the computer chips, then return to me and I will reward you generously.
messages.zh:
我派去调查监测望远镜通信中断问题的另两个小队发来了消息。据他们报告，另两架望远镜已经只剩下空壳。也就是说，他们无法取回我要的扫描器数据。

我认为扫描器数据以及我们在监测望远镜里安装的价值不菲的计算机系统已落到古斯塔斯海盗或欧克勒恩的其他强盗手里。我要你亲自组织一次对失踪数据芯片的搜索行动。把欧克勒恩的小行星带翻个底朝天，拿走了数据的海盗可能躲在星座的任何地方。如果你运气好找到了计算机芯片，就带到我这来，我会重重赏你。

messages.en: So you found it off a pirate roaming one of the Okkelen asteroid belts?  Just as I expected.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 这么说你是从欧克勒恩小行星带的一个海盗身上找到它的？果然如此。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.zh:
调查监测望远镜通信中断原因的另两队人发来消息，说其他两个望远镜已经只剩下空壳。也就是说，他们无法找回扫描器数据。

我认为扫描仪数据以及我们在监测望远镜里安装的价值不菲的计算机系统正在古斯塔斯海盗或欧克勒恩的其他强盗手里。你去彻查一下欧克勒恩的小行星带，持有监测数据的海盗可能正躲藏在某颗小行星的阴暗处。若你能找到计算机芯片，带给我，我会给你丰厚的报酬。

name.en: The Caldari Migrants - Reconnaissance Point 3 (3 of 5)
name.es: Los migrantes caldaris: Punto de reconocimiento 3 (3 de 5)
name.fr: Les migrants caldari – Point de reconnaissance 3 (3 sur 5)
name.ja: カルダリの移住者―偵察ポイント3（3/5）
name.ru: Мигранты Caldari - разведывательный пункт 3 (The Caldari Migrants - Reconnaissance Point 3) (3 из 5)

messages.en: Now that we have two of the surveillance scanner data chips, there's just one more to go.  I expect you'll be able to find it in much the same way as the second data chip.  Search the asteroid belts in Okkelen for pirate elements, eventually you might stumble upon the computer chip.  If you do, I'll pay a great deal of ISK for it.
messages.zh: 我们已有两块监测望远镜数据芯片，现在去找最后一块。我估计你能用与寻找第二块数据芯片类似的方法找到它。在欧克勒恩的小行星带里搜寻海盗，也许能碰巧发现那块计算机芯片。如果你成功了，我会付你一大笔星币。

messages.en: Great job, {[character]player.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。不要离开，还有其他任务！

messages.en: Now that we have two of the surveillance scanner data chips, there's just one more to go.  I expect you'll be able to find it in much the same way as the second data chip.  Search the asteroid belts in Okkelen for pirate elements, eventually you might stumble upon the computer chip.  If you do, I'll pay a great deal of ISK for it.
messages.zh: 我们已有两个监测望远镜数据芯片，现在去找最后一个。和上次的方法一样，在欧克勒恩的小行星带搜寻海盗，也许碰巧能发现。如果你能找到芯片，我会付给你很多星币。

name.ja: カルダリの移住者―クアオ（4/5）
name.ru: Мигранты Caldari - Quao (The Caldari Migrants - Quao) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
After reviewing the data from the surveillance telescope logs, I've confirmed that the Guristas did in fact stand behind the sabotage. The leader of one of the attacks, Quao Kale, is a well known Guristas agent. I want him captured and brought to justice. With luck, he will lead us to someone higher in the Guristas chain of command who can be held accountable for organizing the entire operation. The Guristas who attacked our installations were far too coordinated for this to have been just a spate of random burglary.

You'll find Quao in the Kazka Bandit Headquarters within Sakkikainen. He's one of the Guristas envoys there, who are rumored to be controlling the Kazka behind the scene. You'll probably have to fight your way through a legion of bandits to get to him, so be prepared. And don't forget to bring him here alive, he's worth nothing to us dead! Good luck.
messages.zh:
在审查了从监测望远镜上获取的数据之后，我现在已确认古斯塔斯是这起破坏事件的幕后黑手。率领袭击的首领之一叫奎奥•卡勒，是个有名的古斯塔斯特工。我要他被捉拿归案，接受法律的制裁。幸运的话，我们还能顺藤摸瓜，通过他找到给他下命令的古斯塔斯高级官员，那人才是策划整起事件的罪魁祸首。袭击我们设施的古斯塔斯海盗行动协调有序，绝不是一起任意的行动。

你可以在萨基凯伦的卡兹卡强盗总部找到奎奥。他是那里的古斯塔斯特使之一，据说他们在幕后控制着卡兹卡。你可能得从海盗群中冲出条血路，才能接近他，所以要准备充分。记得一定要生擒，他的尸体对我们一文不值！祝你好运。

messages.en: Nice work as usual, {[character]player.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 你总是干得那么出色，{[character]player.name}。先别走，我还有别的任务要交给你！

name.en: The Caldari Migrants - Criminal Brought To Justice (5 of 5)
name.es: Los migrantes caldaris: Criminal llevado ante la justicia (5 de 5)
name.fr: Les immigrants Caldari – Un criminel face à la justice (5 sur 5)
name.ja: カルダリの移住者―法の裁き（5/5）
name.ru: Мигранты Caldari - преступник отдан в руки правосудия (The Caldari Migrants - Criminal Brought To Justice) (5 из 5)
name.zh: 加达里移民—正义的制裁(5/5)

messages.en:
I want you to bring Quao Kale, who you captured in your last mission, to our station in Silen. There he will be tried and punished accordingly. Once that is over with, he will be interrogated and perhaps even brain scanned, depending on the legal implications.

You've done well for us so far, and certainly have earned your reward. My mission here is nearing completion, soon I'll personally deliver my report to Hien Karnuras. I only hope I don't have any more encounters with the Guristas, I just can't wait to get back to my comfortable office on New Caldari Prime.
messages.zh:
把你上次行动中抓获的奎奥•卡勒带到我们位于斯勒恩的空间站去。他会在那里接收审判并得到相应惩罚。这事一结束，我们就会审问他，看他牵扯的罪行大小，甚至还可能扫描他的大脑。

你迄今为止的工作表现非常出色，你获得的所有报酬都受之无愧。我在这里的任务已接近尾声，很快我将亲自把报告发给伊恩•卡尔纽哈。我只希望古斯塔斯别再来找麻烦了，我已经等不及要回到新加达里首星舒适的办公室了。

messages.en:
I want you to bring Quao Kale, who you captured in your last mission, to our station in Silen. There he will be tried and punished accordingly. Once that is over with, he will be interrogated and perhaps even brain scanned, depending on the legal implications.

You've done well for us so far, and certainly have earned your reward. My mission here is nearing completion, soon I'll personally deliver my report to Hien Karnuras. I only hope I don't have any more encounters with the Guristas, I just can't wait to get back to my comfortable office on New Caldari Prime.
messages.zh:
把奎奥•卡勒带到我们位于斯勒恩的空间站。在那里他会依法得到应有的制裁。我们会审问他，法律允许的话，我们甚至会扫描他的大脑。

到目前为止，你的工作令人相当满意，当然你会得到应有的酬劳。我这里的任务快要完成了，不久我会亲自把我的报告发给伊恩•卡尔纽哈。真不希望再碰到那群可恶的古斯塔斯了。我迫不及待的想要回到新加达里舒服的办公室内。

name.de: Lager des Bankiers - Gestohlene Waren (1 von 3)
name.es: El alijo del banquero: Mercancía robada (1 de 3)
name.fr: L'argent du banquier – Marchandises volées (1 sur 3)
name.ru: Тайник банкира - краденые товары (Banker's Stash - Stolen Goods) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 银行家的财产—失窃的货物 (1/3)

messages.en: What do you need done?
messages.zh: 你需要我做些什么？

messages.en: Recover Jedon Hekkiren's belongings from Zaphiria Oddin and her henchmen. They're probably holed up in the Guristas Outrider Post within Otomainen.
messages.zh: 从扎菲里拉和她的党羽手中夺回杰顿·西肯瑞恩的东西。她很可能停留在欧塔迈伦的古斯塔斯先锋站。

messages.en: My god, I really didn't think you stood much of a chance! And I never thought I'd see those crates again. My friend, don't you leave just yet: I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 天啊，我真的没想到你竟有获胜的机会！我还以为我再也看不到那些箱子了。朋友，你先别走：我还有别的任务给你！

messages.en:
A few days ago, I was entrusted with guarding the freighters transporting Jedon Hekkiren's belongings to a vault in the Vahunomi system. All went well at first, until we were beset by pirates while traveling through Otomainen. Led by a nefarious criminal, Zaphiria Oddin, they managed to overpower my team after a brutal fight. I lost some very good friends that day.

Fortunately, or should I say unfortunately, I managed to escape with my life and with most of the crates containing Jedon's belongings. If I don't get the rest of the crates back, though, Jedon will have my head! I fear his wrath even more than I fear the Guristas. But without the rest of my escort team, I don't have a chance of defeating Zaphiria and her henchmen.

She is probably holed up in the Guristas Outrider Post within Otomainen, near where they ambushed us. The last I heard, she was inside the Guard Outpost of the deadspace complex.
messages.zh:
几天前，我受委托护送一些货船，他们要把杰顿·西肯瑞恩的东西送到瓦胡诺米星系的一个保险库中。起初一切顺利，直到我们通过欧塔迈伦的时候，一帮海盗包围了我们。在扎菲里拉率领下，这群狂徒在一场惨烈的战斗后，击败了我的队伍。那天，我失去了一些非常好的朋友。

不知是幸运还是不幸，我成功逃了出来，还带出了杰顿的大部分货箱。不过如果我没法把其余的箱子都弄回来，那么杰顿会要了我的脑袋！他的怒火甚至比古斯塔斯更可怕。可是没有我的护航队，我是没有机会打败扎菲里拉和她的党羽的。

她很可能还停留在伏击我们的欧塔迈伦的古斯塔斯先锋站。最后一点我知道的是，她藏在那死亡空间的守卫塔里。

name.de: Lager des Bankiers - Die Lieferung vervollständigen (2 von 3)
name.en: Banker's Stash - Complete the Transportation (2 of 3)
name.es: El alijo del banquero: Completa el transporte (2 de 3)
name.fr: L'argent du banquier – Achever le transport (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 銀行家の秘蔵品-輸送完遂せよ（2/3）
name.ru: Тайник банкира - завершить транспортировку (Banker's Stash - Complete the Transportation) (2 из 3)
name.zh: 银行家的财产—完成运输（2/3）

messages.en:
Now that you've recovered the rest of the stash that was supposed to be transported to Vahunomi, I'd like you to complete the shipment for me.

The total shipment is 250 crates. You'll need a sizable industrial ship to complete the mission.
messages.zh:
既然你已经找回了原本要送往瓦胡诺米的其余货物，我希望你能帮我完成运送。

货物共有250箱。你需要一艘大型工业舰来完成这个任务。

messages.en: Nice, my friend, fast and smooth! Hang on a sec ― I have one more assignment for you.
messages.zh: 不错嘛，完成得又快又顺利。先别走，我还有一个新的任务给你。

messages.en:
Now that you've recovered the rest of the stash that was supposed to be transported to Vahunomi, I'd like you to complete the shipment for me. My ship is still badly damaged and I'm in no position to risk another flight through this bandit-infested territory. You seem to be fully capable of completing my assignment with minimal risk to yourself, though.

The total shipment is 250 crates. You'll need a sizable industrial ship to complete the mission.
messages.zh:
既然你已经找回了原本要送往瓦胡诺米的其余货物，我希望你能帮我完成运送。我的飞船仍然损坏严重，而且我也不能再冒险穿越这个强盗横行的地方。不过你似乎完全有能力将风险降到最低，并完成我给你的任务。

货物共有250箱。你需要一艘大型工业舰来完成这个任务。

name.de: Lager des Bankiers - Die Toten begraben (3 von 3)
name.en: Banker's Stash - Bury the Dead (3 of 3)
name.es: El alijo del banquero: Enterrar a los muertos (3 de 3)
name.fr: L'argent du banquier – Enterrer les morts (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 銀行家の秘蔵品-死体埋葬（3/3）
name.ru: Тайник банкира - похоронить мертвых (Banker's Stash - Bury the Dead) (3 из 3)
name.zh: 银行家的财产—入土为安（3/3）

messages.en: Transport the remains of the Hakkuran brothers to their father in Usi.
messages.zh: 将哈克兰兄弟的遗骸运送到乌赛他们的父亲那里。

messages.en: You've done me a great service, {[character]player.name}.  I don't think I can every fully repay you, but I hope this reward will somewhat make up for it.
messages.zh: 你帮了我一个大忙，{[character]player.name}。我不能每次都给你很高的报酬，但希望这次的酬劳多少能弥补一些。

messages.en: As a final task for you, {[character]player.name}, I'd like you to transport the remains of two brothers who died when my ship was heavily damaged by Zaphiria and her crew. They were down in the lower decks trying to fix our warp core stabilizer when a Scourge missile hit the hull while our shields were down. After I had fled to Sakkikainen, their bodies were discovered buried under heaps of wreckage and debris. I gathered their remains into a container, and I'd like you to transport it to their father in Usi; he's a teacher there at the State War Academy. I would do it myself, but I have unavoidable business elsewhere right after I get this scrapheap of a ship fixed up, and this really can't wait. The Hakkuran brothers were good engineers and faithful employees, and I want them given a proper burial immediately.  Thank you, and good luck.
messages.zh: 最后一个任务了，{[character]player.name}。我希望你能帮我运送两位兄弟的遗体，我的飞船遭到扎菲里拉的袭击而严重损毁，他们是在那时牺牲的。当时他们正在下甲板修理跃迁核心稳定器，飞船的护盾处于关闭状态，突然之间，一颗“鞭挞”重型导弹击中了船体，他们也没有幸免于难。我逃到萨基凯伦后，才发现他们的遗体，深埋在一大堆船骸和碎片之下。我把他们的尸体放到了一个集装箱里，请把箱子送到他们在乌赛的父亲那里，他是国立军事学院的一个老师。如果可能，我想亲自运送他们的尸体，但在修理完这艘破烂不堪的飞船之后，我还有重要的事要办，而且还是没法延期的。哈克兰兄弟是很好的工程师和忠诚的雇员，我希望他们能马上得到应有的葬礼。谢谢你，祝你好运。

name.de: Viehdiebe - Banditen auf freiem Fuß (1 von 3)
name.en: Cattle Thieves - Brigands at Large (1 of 3)
name.fr: Voleurs de bétail – Bandits en fuite (1 sur 3)
name.ru: Скотокрады - разбойники повсюду (Cattle Thieves - Brigands at Large) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 牲畜乱序者—逍遥法外的歹徒 (1/3)

messages.en:
It so happens that the School of Applied Knowledge ordered a very large shipment of cattle to their station here in Sakkikainen. I was given the job after losing a bet with one of my co-workers ― as you might expect, Okkelen is one of the least popular constellations within the State for delivery people like me. It's simply swarming with pirates and other scum.

Needless to say, once I arrived through the stargate, I was immediately beset by pirates camping the other side of the gate. I hit my microwarpdrive and almost made it, but they managed to warp scramble me at the last moment. And of course my darned escort team fled like a bunch of pansies at the first sight of combat! So I had no choice but to eject my cargo. It was either that or death, and I'll be damned before I commit suicide in the name of those corporate pigs!

Anyway, you now know my dilemma, and my question is simple: Will you help me get my cattle back!? I'm in no position to do it myself, obviously, and I'd rather not return home empty-handed. You certainly look like someone who has some combat experience... so if you're up to it, then I'll give you directions to the bandit outpost where I believe they are keeping my cattle.
messages.zh:
正巧应用知识学院订购了一大批牲畜，要我们运送到萨基凯伦的空间站去。我和同事打赌输了，因此由我完成这个工作……你应该知道，欧克勒恩是这个国家中所有运送人员最不愿去的地方，充斥着各种海盗和社会渣滓。

不必说，我刚穿过星门，就立刻陷入海盗的重围。我马上开动了微型跃迁推进器，差一点就脱离战圈了，但是那群海盗在最后时刻把我拦了下来。我的护卫队，那群懦夫！一看这架势就四散逃跑了！

摆在我面前只有两个选择，货物还是我的小命？被迫无奈，我把货物弹出舱外。可是如果企业的头头知道我把货物丢了，他们一定会把我剁了。

不管怎样，你也看到了，我进退两难。现在我只有一个问题：你愿意帮我找回那些牲畜吗！？很明显我现在没法亲自完成这件事，但我又不能空手回去。你看上去很擅长战斗……所以，如果你愿意做的话，我会给你一些去那个强盗哨站的指示，我的牲畜应该关在那里。

messages.en: Ah, crap! They must have killed some of the cattle because this is only part of the shipment they stole from me. Think you can help me get some fresh cattle from somewhere else to complete my shipment?
messages.zh: 啊，可恶！他们肯定屠宰了一些牲畜，因为这只是失窃牲畜的一部分。我想你能从别的地方新弄点牲畜来填补我的货物空缺吗？

name.en: Cattle Thieves - Making Ends Meet (2 of 3)
name.es: Ladrones de ganado: Llegar a fin de mes (2 de 3)
name.fr: Voleurs de bétail – Joindre les deux bouts (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 牛泥棒―帳尻を合わせる（2/3）
name.ru: Скотокрады - свести концы с концами (Cattle Thieves - Making Ends Meet) (2 из 3)

messages.en: Please hurry, {[character]player.name}.  Time is of the essence.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，请抓紧。时间宝贵。

messages.en: Unfortunately, the cattle you retrieved from the pirates in your last mission are insufficient. In fact, I don't think the School of Applied Knowledge will even bother accepting such a low quantity of them; I need 2600 more units to complete the shipment. I'd like you to help me make ends meet: I've contacted my colleagues at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, and they have the cattle I need. If you could pick up those cattle and deliver them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, I would be extremely grateful.
messages.zh: 很可惜，你上次从海盗那里夺回的牲畜数量不够。我想应用知识学院会嫌货太少而拒不接收；我还需要2600头才能满足这次出货。我希望你能帮助我货款两全：我已联系了在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的同事，那儿有我需要的牲畜存货。如果你能运送那些牲畜到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，我将万分感谢。

messages.en: Phew, now my job here is finally done.  But there's just one more thing I'd like you to do, if you have time.
messages.zh: 呦，我在这边的事情总算办完了。不过要是你有时间，正好还有一件事交给你去办。

name.en: Cattle Thieves - Revenge Is Sweet (3 of 3)
name.es: Ladrones de ganado: Dulce venganza (3 de 3)
name.fr: Voleurs de bétail – Douce revanche (3 sur 3)
name.ru: Скотокрады - сладкая месть (Cattle Thieves - Revenge Is Sweet) (3 из 3)
name.zh: 牲畜乱序者—甜蜜的复仇 (3/3)

messages.en:
Damn that Loki Machedo. He headed up the bandit gang that stole my cattle and delayed me by many days. I'll probably get demoted for this! I will have my revenge.

I heard he wasn't at the bandit site where you found some of the cattle, so he must still be at large. I know a guy, Midoki Urigamu, who is surprisingly knowledgeable about the Guristas pirates. He told me that Loki works as a prison guard in the Guristas Outrider Post in Otomainen. So you might find him in the Prison Facility, as long as he's on duty and not raiding defenseless convoys...

I'll give you everything I have in exchange for proof that he's dead.
messages.zh:
那个罗基•马切多去死吧。他就是那伙抢我牲畜的强盗的头，他耽搁了我好几天。搞不好我会因此被降职！我一定要报仇。

听说他并不在你找到那群牲畜的海盗窝点，肯定还在逍遥法外。我认识一个叫米多基•尤希嘉穆的人，对古斯塔斯海盗了解甚多。他告诉我罗基在欧塔迈伦的古斯塔斯先锋站担当牢狱守卫。只要他当班，又没外出袭击无还手之力的护航队，你应该可以在牢狱设施找到他……

只要你把他的死亡证据带来，我可以用我的一切跟你换。

messages.en:
Wonderful! Even if I do get demoted, at least I know those bastards responsible for my current situation got what they deserved.

Here's your reward. Mind giving me a little privacy now? I need some time alone.
messages.zh:
好极了！即使我已经降职了，至少我知道那些造成我现在境遇的混蛋得到了应得的下场。

这是你的酬劳。你不介意让我独自呆一会儿吧？我想单独静一静。

name.fr: Le régiment – Vol d'un titre de propriété (1 sur 4)
name.ja: 引退した兵士―権利書を取り戻せ（1/4）
name.ru: Полк - украденный документ (The Regiment - Stolen Deed) (1 из 4)

messages.en:
Are you settling here in the Shady Acres as well? No? Lucky for you. My regiment retired last year after decades with the Navy. Our retirement gift was a piece of land in the Shady Acres. I can see the wisdom in it from the State's point of view; who are better suited to settle a bandit-infested territory than a group of Navy veterans? But that doesn't mean I have to like it. I was hoping that after a lifelong service they would cut me a little slack in my final days. But if life in the Navy has taught me anything it is never to give up.

I'm the first of my regiment to arrive here, the others will arrive in the next few weeks. I'm aiming to make this place a little friendlier for their arrival than it was for me. A few days after I arrived this guy came along claiming he was a representative for the Shady Acres development firm. He even had credentials to back up his claim and everything. In my naivety I lent him the deed to my land here. He took it and I haven't seen him since. I've heard rumors that he's hanging out in the old mining facility over in Friggi system. Along with a lot of other bandits, I understand. All I can tell you is that he was a member of the black mask gang, so concentrate your search on them.

I'm stuck here guarding my possessions, this territory is much too dangerous for me to leave them alone for even an hour. I would be much obliged if you could get my deed back. So much so that I would be willing to give you some navy issue ammo for your trouble.
messages.zh:
你也打算在阴暗领土定居吗？不是？你真幸运。我的军团在海军服役多年后于去年退役了。我们的退役礼物就是阴暗领土的一片土地。从合众国的角度看，这确实是一个明智之举：有谁比一群退役的老兵更适合居住在强盗横行的领土上呢？但这并不意味着我一定得喜欢国家的决策。我本希望在为合众国奉献终生后，他们能让我安享晚年。如果说我在海军学到了些什么的话，那就是永远不要放弃。

我是团里第一个到这的，其余人会在随后几周里抵达。我打算在他们到来之前，把这地方变得比我刚来时友善一些。在我到达后几天，有个家伙找到我，宣称自己是暗土发展公司的代表。甚至他还带有官方的正文件来说明自己身份还有其他若干说法的真实性，我天真地就信以为真的，把我这里的地产契约给了他，然后这个人就再也没有出现过。有传闻说他现在在弗瑞吉星系里面的一个陈旧采矿设施附近出没，和他一伙儿的还有其他的一群不法之徒，据我所知是这样的。我所能告诉你的就是他实际上是黑色假面社团的人，所以你只要集中精力找它们就一定能找到他。

我现在被滞留在这里保护我的财产，这里的治安情况太恶劣了，甚至不允许我离开我的东西哪怕一个钟头。如果你能帮我把契约找回来的那就太谢谢了。如果那样成功的话，我会给你一些海军弹药解决你的需要。

name.ja: 引退した兵士―婚約者を救出せよ（3/4）
name.ru: Полк - побег (The Regiment - Break Out) (3 из 4)

messages.en:
It seems these cursed bandits are more clever than I gave them credit for. They've become aware of my attempts to weaken them and are paying back in kind. Not since I was serving against the Anarchists way back when have I encountered such ruthlessness. My fiancé, Nakyo Fukoren, was making her way out here on my bequest. We've been looking forward to finally being able to settle down and start a family together. But she was ambushed on the way and kidnapped.

She's being held in a secret prison facility operated by the local bandits. I called in all the favors owed to me to get this information, but I don't care. Nakyo is everything to me. I'm even willing to offer you all my life savings as a reward if you can get her back to me. And if you get her back to me within the hour I'll even throw in a very rare BPC.

The jail she's being kept in is a high-security one, with stasis cells to make any break out attempts impossible. But those stasis cells are going to help us to set her free after all. They can withstand massive explosions, even the destruction of the jail itself. And that's exactly what I want you to do. Once you've blown up the prison, the stasis field around the cells will quickly run out of its internal power batteries. Then you'll be able to pick Nakyo up, but you'll have to act quickly because she will be exposed in space once the stasis field goes down. Please hurry, {[character]player.name}, I could never forgive myself if something happened to her.
messages.zh:
似乎这些该死的海盗比我想象的还要聪明得多。他们已经察觉到了我的意图，正以牙还牙进行反击。就在控制那些无政府主义者回来的路上，我接到了一个不幸的消息。我的未婚妻拿吉亚•弗克伦要过来和我团聚，我们盼望着能在这儿定居下来，建立美满的家庭。然而她在来的路上受到了伏击，并且遭到了绑架。

她被关押在一个由本地海盗掌控的秘密牢狱里。世上任何事情都比不上拿吉亚，她就是我的一切。如果你能把她带回我身边，我甚至愿意把我一生的积蓄倾囊相授。如果你能尽快把她带回来，我会给你一份罕见的蓝图拷贝。

关押她的牢狱安全设施相当完备，使用了滞力牢房，企图越狱是徒劳的。但是这些滞力牢房将会帮助我们把她解救出来。因为它们能抵抗巨大的爆炸冲击，甚至牢狱本身的毁灭也不会对其产生影响。一旦你把牢狱给炸了，牢房周围的停滞力场会很快耗尽内置的能量电池。之后你就可以营救拿吉亚了，但是你必须要行动迅速，一旦停滞力场被破坏，她就将暴露在太空里。请赶快，{[character]player.name}，万一她有个三长两短，我永远都不会原谅自己。

messages.en:
It seems these cursed bandits are more clever than I gave them credit for. They've become aware of my attempts to weaken them and are paying back in kind. Not since I was serving against the Anarchists way back when have I encountered such ruthlessness. My fiancé, Nakyo Fukoren, was making her way out here on my bequest. We've been looking forward to finally being able to settle down and start a family together. But she was ambushed on the way and kidnapped.

She's being held in a secret prison facility operated by the local bandits. I called in all the favors owed to me to get this information, but I don't care. Nakyo is everything to me. I'm even willing to offer you all my life savings as a reward if you can get her back to me. And if you get her back to me within the hour I'll even throw in a very rare BPC.

The jail she's being kept in is a high-security one, with stasis cells to make any break out attempts impossible. But those stasis cells are going to help us to set her free after all. They can withstand massive explosions, even the destruction of the jail itself. And that's exactly what I want you to do. Once you've blown up the prison, the stasis field around the cells will quickly run out of its internal power batteries. Then you'll be able to pick Nakyo up, but you'll have to act quickly because she will be exposed in space once the stasis field goes down. Please hurry, {[character]player.name}, I could never forgive myself if something happened to her.

name.fr: Le régiment – Une vengeance implacable (4 sur 4)
name.ja: 引退した兵士―許すまじ（4/4）

messages.en:
I'm totally devastated, {[character]player.name}. Those filthy bandits ravished my beautiful Nakyo while she was in their hands. Now she is but a broken shell, always breaking down in sobs and flinching every time I try to touch her. It's unbearable. I'm not usually a vengeful man, but these beasts went too far. I want you to be my avenging angel. Excuse me for sounding so melodramatic, it's my grief talking.

I know the name of the man that gave the orders for the kidnapping and mistreatment of my fiancé, one Sanku Pansya. He and his gang hang out in the contested mining facility over in Friggi system, I'm sure you know where to find it. I want that son of a gun dead. Bring me his head as proof that his evil doings have been avenged. You will receive a great reward for doing this, a blueprint copy I intended to pass down to my first born son. I fear he may never be conceived now.
messages.zh:
我被彻底击垮了，{[character]player.name}。那群肮脏的强盗居然强暴了我美丽的拿吉亚。现在她只是一具破碎的躯壳，经常精神崩溃，泣不成声。每当我试着接近她，她总是缩成一团。我再也忍不下去了。我通常不是个报复心强的人，但这些禽兽太过分了。我要你做我的复仇天使。原谅我的感情用事，我只有在过度悲伤时才这样。

我知道那个下令绑架并糟蹋我未婚妻的混蛋，他叫桑库•潘萨。他和同党在弗瑞吉星系争夺中的采矿设施出没，我肯定你能找到那地方。我要那个混蛋的命。把他人头带给我，证明他已经罪有应得。你将得到一张蓝图作为报酬，我本想把它传给我的第一个儿子的。但现在恐怕他永远也没法出世了。

name.fr: Le régiment – Course à l'armement (2 sur 4)
name.ja: 引退した兵士―武器密輸を阻止せよ（2/4）
name.ru: Полк - гонка вооружений (The Regiment - Arms Race) (2 из 4)

messages.en:
The bandits here in Ihakana aren't too happy with all these Caldari settlers coming here. Who can blame them? This constellation has been their little playground for years and now suddenly the State is arriving in force, effectively putting the bandits in a straight jacket. But they're planning something big, I can feel it in my bones. Call it an old warhorse's instinct, if you will.

I've pulled some strings with some friends in the Navy. One of them gave me the coordinates for a location favored by the local bandits for smuggling. And from another I got reliable news that a large shipment of armaments is due to be smuggled into the system. Even an old army idiot like me can put two and two together. The arms dealers are using the place as a rendezvous and if we could take them out in a lightning strike it will safe us all a lot of grief down the road.

Now, be careful. These bandits are not taking any chances, so don't expect them to be sitting in some indies waiting to be taken out. From past experience with these guys they're probably using battleships as smuggling vessels. I'm giving you some top-notch torpedoes as a reward for this mission, that should be incentive enough for you to round up a posse and take these guys down.
messages.zh:
对于这些加达里殖民者的到来，以哈坎拿的海盗似乎深恶痛绝。但那又能怪谁呢？这个星座数年来都是他们的天地，而现在合众国的军力大举来此，势必使他们无处容身。我从骨子里感觉到他们不会坐以待毙，一定在暗中准备，凭一个老兵的本能，我敢肯定短期内他们就会有所行动。

我暗中和一些海军的朋友碰了一下头。其中有人给了我一个本地海盗非法贩售地的位标。而从其中另一个口中我得到可靠消息，有一大船的军备会被非法贩售到这个星系。连我这样迟钝的家伙都能看出两者之间的联系。那些军火商将在这个位置接头，如果使用闪电战把他们一举消灭，我们就能一劳永逸，从此高枕无忧。

一定要小心。这些海盗不会轻易冒险，所以不要指望他们呆在某个角落里等着被消灭。从过去与他们作战的经验来看，他们很可能使用战列舰进行非法贩售。我会给你一批最棒的鱼雷作为这次任务的酬劳，带些人一起去消灭那些家伙。

name.de: Die Südliche Front - So sammelt eure Rosenblüten (1 von 4)
name.en: The Southern Front - Gather Ye Rosebuds (1 of 4)
name.es: Frente meridional: Coged las rosas (1 de 4)
name.fr: Front sud – Profiter du moment présent (1 sur 4)
name.ja: 南の最前線―違法取引の証拠（1/4）
name.ru: Южный фронт - созревание бутонов (The Southern Front - Gather Ye Rosebuds) (1 из 4)
name.zh: 南方前线—收集玫瑰花苞 (1/4)

messages.en:
As you may know, my organization is looking to find inroads into this constellation and we believe the Friggi system is a key location. Thing is, we've got some of those no-good Caldari troublemakers in this system, and they just won't stop hounding us. What could they ever have against peaceful businessmen like us, I wonder?

Well, no matter. I need you to bring me some information. In order to have a real impact here, we're going to need to have some dirt on our competitors and play it the ol' sly way. Brute force doesn't always work, and we don't really want to get the State's bristles up enough for them to send a Navy detachment down here. That would just ruin the whole peaceful vibe we've got going down here, don't you agree?

I've uploaded some coordinates to your Neocom, there. Upon arrival at these coordinates, you'll find a tiny asteroid belt whose signature is masked due to a deadspace pocket. The Nugoeihuvi chaps -- you're familiar with them, right? -- have been using this belt to conduct some illicit business with parties unknown. Now, when you arrive they're likely to attack you on sight, so you just use your superior firepower and show them what for. Bring me any evidence you can find of their dealings. I'll make sure you're rewarded properly.
messages.zh:
可能你知道，我们组织目前正在寻找进入这个星座的通道，而弗瑞吉星系对我们而言将会非常重要。问题是，我们在那个星系里遭到了一群加达里人的穷追猛打，真不知道攻击像我们这样爱好和平的商人对他们能有什么好处呢？

好吧，不管怎么样。我要你给我们收集些情报。为了能在这里站稳脚跟，我们得不失时机地在竞争对手脸上抹点黑。武力不能解决所有的问题，我们可不想让当局派海军特遣队过来。这儿的和平气息可来之不易啊！不是吗？

我已经上传了一些位标到你的控制边栏。到达这些坐标点之后，你会发现一条小型行星带，它的信号被一个死亡空间层面所覆盖。那些纳基维的家伙们——你很熟悉，对吧？——利用这个行星带与某些我们未知的团体进行违法交易。你一出现就会遭到他们的攻击。所以不要吝惜你强大的火力，狠很地反击，让他们尝尝厉害。把你所能找到的有关他们交易的任何证据带来给我。我保证你会拿到不错的酬劳的。

name.fr: Front sud – Réapprovisionnement des stocks (2 sur 4)
name.ja: 南の最前線―物資の補給（2/4）
name.ru: Южный фронт - восстановить запасы (The Southern Front - Restock) (2 из 4)

messages.en:
Okay, first off, the box you brought back with the unassembled weapon parts was a valuable find, so thanks for that. In addition to the weapons, it contained some evidence that Nugoeihuvi have certain plans for this system that conflict with ours - and they're not going about them through the proper, stiff-assed Caldari channels, which puts us in a fine position, leverage-wise.

But on to some other matters at hand. My organization has an outpost in the Otitoh system, one that is in dire need of supplies at the moment. In particular, they require some transmitters to keep the outpost's reconnaisance operations running. We've been expecting a large Caldari Navy incursion for a while now, and capsuleer forces have been hitting the complex pretty hard these past few weeks, so we need to keep a pretty steady stream of supplies coming in. If you can get these transmitters to the Caldari Executive Panel station in Otitoh within 20 minutes and drop them in your hangar there for pickup, I'll make it worth your while.
messages.zh:
好的，你带回来的盒子非常有价值，里面有未组装的武器部件，我们对此表示感谢。盒子里除了武器，还有一些证据表明纳基维集团正准备在这个星系采取行动，这与我们的计划有所冲突。当然他们不希望这些情报通过加达里国内正常的渠道被公布出去，因此我们掌握了消息，就掌握了十分有利的主动地位。

现在看看手头的事情吧。我的组织在欧提托星系有一个哨站急需供给。具体地说，他们需要传信器来维持哨站的侦察运作。鉴于这几周来空军都在猛烈地攻击该复合体，我预计加达里海军即将大举入侵，因此我们需要保持稳定的供给。如果你能在20分钟内将这些传信器送到欧提托的加达里执行小组空间站，我会好好答谢你。

name.de: Die Südliche Front - Ein Schlag in die Nieren (3 von 4)
name.en: The Southern Front - One To The Kidney (3 of 4)
name.es: Frente meridional: Una al riñón (3 de 4)
name.fr: Front sud - Là où ça fait mal (3 sur 4)
name.ja: 南の最前線―急所への一撃（3/4）
name.ru: Южный фронт - удар по почкам (The Southern Front - One To The Kidney) (3 из 4)

messages.en:
We have a situation that's come up. There's a Caldari Navy operative in this system by the name of Agent Maro Yama. We've discovered that he's the one who's supposed to be orchestrating the big attack on our Otitoh outpost in the coming weeks. Gurista High Command has instructed me to sabotage his operation, and to this end you can help.

Agent Yama is based at a place called the Clear Water Spring in this system, but anything as crass as an all-out attack will only send the Navy crashing down on our heads in full force, something which would be very detrimental indeed to our expansion efforts in this constellation. Agent Yama does, however, have extensive ties to the Lai Dai Corporation Factory station at Friggi VII - Moon 12, and we know him to have ships and equipment at that station ready for deployment at a moment's notice.

The mission, as it pertains to you, is relatively straightforward. This package here has been made to look like a standard shipment of holofeed receptors, egones and projectors but contains hidden parts that, when assembled correctly, will be capable of doing severe electromagnetic damage to Caldari Navy assets in the station. Bring this there, and don't get caught, and you will have done the Guristas a great service. Do this well, and we might discuss what else you can do for us - and how we can reward you.
messages.zh:
我们又发现了新情况。有一个叫玛诺•雅玛的加达里海军特工出现在了这个星系中。据报，他正着手组织未来几周对我们的欧提托哨站发动一场大规模袭击。古斯塔斯的高级指挥官已经发出指示，破坏他的阴谋。我需要你的帮助。

特工雅玛的基地位于星系中一个叫清流源泉的地方，我们不能正面进攻，这样会招致海军的全面回击，对我们在星座内的扩张非常不利。事实上，雅玛与弗瑞吉Ⅶ—卫12的莱戴军团制造站有密切关系，我们知道他在那里有大量飞船装备随时待命。

这个任务相对比较简单，非常适合你。这个包裹内看似装的是标准全息影像接收器和自尊集团的潜意识投射器，但实际上还藏有隐蔽的部件，经过正确组装，就能够对空间站内的加达里海军设备造成严重的电磁伤害。把它运过来，别落到海军手里。这件事对古斯塔斯非常重要，要是你做得好，我会考虑给你其他的任务，还有你的酬劳。

name.es: El hombre de las bebidas: Aguardiente (1 de 2)
name.fr: L'homme aux spiritueux – La gnôle (1 sur 2)
name.ru: Человек духа - огненная вода (Spirit Man - Firewater) (1 из 2)

messages.en:
Let me be the first to welcome you to the Ihakana system. I fear it may be the only welcome you'll receive, it's rough out here. I should know, small time crooks like me can easily be swallowed up by all the big sharks swimming around. I tried to make it as a peddler of neural boosters, but I couldn't stand the pressure. So now I'm just a small time booze dealer, making sure to keep my operation modest enough not to attract any unwanted attention.

I can't complain with how things are going, business is brisk. It's gotten to the point where I can't even keep up with all the orders coming in. Would you be interested in taking a small load of my fine merchandise over to the Ishisomo system? There's a NOH development studio there and it seems developers never get enough booze. Lucky for me.
messages.zh:
让我成为第一个欢迎你来到以哈坎拿星系的人吧。恐怕这也是你能唯一收到的一个欢迎了，到这里来很辛苦。我应该知道，像我这么小的角色很容易就被四周游荡的大鲨鱼给吞掉的。我试过贩卖神经强效剂，但你知道，这活压力太大了。因此现在我仅仅是一个小的酒精饮料经销商，低调经营，免得引来不必要的麻烦。

世事无常，再多抱怨也是多余。可现在的问题就是我根本来不及处理所有的订单。你有兴趣把一小部分我的精品货物送到伊什索蒙星系？那里有一个NOH发展工作室，看起来开发商永远都没有充足的酒。我很幸运。

让我成为第一个欢迎你来到以哈坎拿星系的人吧。恐怕这也是你能收到的唯一欢迎了，外面的人可不友好。我很清楚，像我这样的小角色很容易被四周游荡的大鲨鱼吞掉。我曾试着成为一名兜售神经强效剂的小贩，但我承受不了那种压力。因此现在我只是一个小的酒水经销商，低调经营，免得引来不必要的关注。

我对现在的状况无可挑剔，生意顺风顺水。业务规模已经发展到我跟不上所有订单了。你有兴趣帮我把一小部分上等货送到伊什索蒙星系吗？那里有一个NOH开发工作室，看来开发员都是海量。我真走运。

name.de: Die Südliche Front - Sturm auf die Vermögenswerte (4 von 4)
name.en: The Southern Front - Asset Assault (4 of 4)
name.es: Frente meridional: Asalto a los bienes (4 de 4)
name.fr: Front sud – Leurs biens, nos biens (4 sur 4)
name.ru: Южный фронт - атака на активы (The Southern Front - Asset Assault) (4 из 4)

messages.en:
It's time to act fast, {[character]player.name}. We've just received reports that the Caldari Navy has established a forward outpost in the Otitoh system, in preparation for a strike at our complex in the area. According to our information they have a sizable force there already, and are preparing to move in more people. We're happy to tell you, however, that the EMP charge you placed at the Lai Dai station had its desired effect, severely damaging a substantial number of support vessels and equipment the Navy had meant for use in Otitoh. Now is therefore the time to strike, while they are weakened and working to compensate for the loss of backup assets.

We need you to go in there and take out the Navy's Command and Control center in the area. Any losses you can inflict on them while doing so will be most appreciated, but the primary target is the Command and Control center. If that is taken down, the Navy will have to retreat from the area, and our plans for this constellation will be that much closer to fruition. Once the building is destroyed, report back to me and I will see to it that you are rewarded handsomely for your efforts. The Guristas will not forget this one, {[character]player.name}. Good luck.
messages.zh:
得赶快行动了，{[character]player.name}。我们刚刚接报，加达里海军在欧提托星系里建造了一个前线岗哨，准备对我们所在地区的设施进行攻击。据我们掌握的消息，他们在那儿囤积了大量兵力，而且还准备增派更多的人手。不过有个好消息，你安置在莱戴空间站的电磁脉冲弹药大显威力，摧毁了不少补给船，还让加达里海军准备在欧提托使用的装备被提前预支。现在进攻的时机到了，趁着他们力量被削弱，后备补给匮乏，我们得赶快下手！

我要你去那儿摧毁这个地区的海军指挥控制中心。尽可能摧毁你所发现的目标，给他们以沉重打击，但是要记住你的主要的目标是指挥控制中心，如果那个地方被毁，加达里海军会被迫从这儿撤退，那样我们在这个星系的计划就更容易实现了。摧毁指挥控制中心后，回来向我报告，我会给你一笔不错的报酬。古斯塔斯不会忘记你的，{[character]player.name}。祝你好运！

name.es: El hombre de las bebidas: Alcohol de barril (2 de 2)
name.fr: L'homme aux spiritueux – Le tord-boyaux (2 sur 2)
name.ja: 酒屋の悩み-ロットガット（2/2）
name.ru: Человек духа - пойло (Spirit Man - Rotgut) (2 из 2)

messages.en:
My suppliers can't keep up with all this demand for their excellent moonshine. So I've taken the liberty of modifying the booze a little bit. Yes, yes, I admit it, I'm adding water to it. To make certain the drunkards I deal with won't notice, I've come up with a devilish little scheme.

An old schoolmate of mine is a janitor on the School of Applied Knowledge over in Sakkikainen. Some graduation students there have come up with a strange little mixture they call Rotgut. I don't know the scientific mumbo-jumbo for how it works, all I know is that it increases the intoxication effects of alcohol many times. That's exactly what I need for my watered-down wares. I need someone discreet to pop over there and get me a bit of this Rotgut. Then, once the new concoction is ready, all I have to do is lay back and watch the dimes roll in.
messages.zh:
我的供货商供应美味非法贩售酒的速度根本跟不上需求。所以我自作主张对酒做了点手脚。好吧，好吧，我承认，我往里面兑了水。为了确保不被那些开发员和其他醉鬼顾客发觉，我想出了一个罪恶的小计划。

我的一位老同学是萨基凯伦的应用知识学院的看门人。那里的一些研究生发明了一种奇怪的混合剂，称为卢加特。我不知道那玩意被施了什么科学法术，只知道它能数倍增强酒精的致醉效果。那正是我的掺水酒所需要的。我需要一位慎重的飞行员去那儿一趟，帮我弄点卢加特来。然后，一旦新的混合酒水准备就绪，我只要舒舒服服地看着钱哗哗流进来就行。

name.es: Mano de obra: Bloques de construcción (1 de 3)
name.fr: Coup de main au ranch – Blocs de construction (1 sur 3)
name.ja: 農場での働き手-建設資材（1/3）
name.ru: Помощник  — строительный материал (Ranch Hand - Building Blocks) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
Greetings there, friend. The name's Helmi, Helmi Nakamuta. I'm here as an independent contractor working under the Caldari Provisions banner, subcontracting courier jobs to pilots who want them, helping to build this here frontierland. I got a job for you, if you want it. You need to be fast, though.

Got this shipment of construction blocks here need to get to the State and Region Bank station in Ihakana, one system over, reeeal quick like. You bring 'em there within 20 minutes, I may have another job for ya.
messages.zh:
你好，朋友。我的名字是艾尔米，艾尔米•纳卡穆塔。我是加达里后勤部隶属的一个独立承包人，给想要做运输任务的飞行员提供转包合同，帮助边疆建设。要是你愿意，我这有个工作给你。不过你的动作一定要快。

把这批建造模块尽快送到以哈坎拿的国家星域银行空间站，很近，只隔了一个星系。你要是在二十分钟内送到那里的话，我说不定会给你其他的工作。

name.es: Mano de obra: Tareas de socorro (2 de 3)
name.fr: Coup de main au ranch – Aide aux ouvriers (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 農場での働き手-救済活動（2/3）
name.ru: Помощник - гуманитарная работа (Ranch Hand - Relief Work) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
You did good on that last job, partner. I'm glad to have made your acquaintance.

I have a shipment of wheat here that needs to get to one of the settlements on Ishisomo III real fast. They're havin' a bit of a hard time foraging, what with the sparse natural resources on that old rock. If you can get this stuff to the Propel Dynamics Factory in Ishisomo within 10 minutes, it can be on the next suborbital shuttle down, and in some grateful family's belly tomorrow. What do you say?
messages.zh:
上次任务干得不错，伙计。很高兴认识你。

这有一批小麦需要火速送到伊什索蒙III的定居点。那个鬼地方自然资源稀缺，粮草缺乏，生活艰难。希望你在10分钟内把这些货物送到伊什索蒙的推进动态集团工厂，解决当下的燃眉之急，让一些家庭明天能吃饱肚子。你觉得怎么样？

name.de: Rancharbeiter - Mi agua es su agua (3 von 3)
name.fr: Coup de main au ranch – L'oasis (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 農場での働き手-オアシスの担い手（3/3）
name.ru: Помощник - создатель оазиса (Ranch Hand - Oasis Bringer) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
Glad you're back. There's an emergency in Vahunomi; a colony of archaeologists on one of the moons there have had an accident that rendered them devoid of drinkable water. Their distress call has only just been received, and due to factors of atmospheric interference we have no real way of knowing exactly how long they've been down there without water.

I need you to bring this supply of water to the State and Region Bank Vault in Vahunomi as soon as humanly possible. If you make it there fast enough, I'll throw in a very special reward. Go. Hurry.
messages.zh:
很高兴你能回来。在瓦胡诺米发生了一件紧急事件：某个卫星上有一群考古学家发生了意外，导致饮用水的短缺。我们刚刚才收到求救信号，而且由于天电干扰，我们无法确切知道他们断水多久了。

你的任务就是尽快地把这些补给水带到瓦胡诺米的国家星域银行保险库。如果你足够迅速，我会给你特殊的奖励。去吧。快。

name.es: Extravagancia del Cártel de los Ángeles

messages.en:
We've been gathering information from our agents within the Cartel to prepare ourselves for a possible attack on our assets. So far, we've found out only that they are planning a major offensive against a target within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, possibly to occur today. While the target remains unknown to us, we've managed to discover the meeting point of some of their forces. I want you to gather whatever help you can muster, fly out to the meeting points, and deliver a devastating blow to their fleet. That should deter them from any attack inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and send them a message they won't soon forget.

Just don't forget what you're up against. We have no idea how many ships are out there ― all we know is where five of their rendezvous points are. Destroy any and all targets you can find there, then report back to me. If there're too many of them out there, then get some help; I'm sure some of our other agents in the vicinity would be willing to give you a hand.
messages.zh:
我们一直在从我们安插在天使企业联合体内的密探那里搜集情报，以应对天使可能将对我们产业发动的攻击。目前我们只发现他们正在策划对{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内的一个目标发动猛烈攻击，很可能是在今天。尽管他们的具体目标尚不清楚，但是我们成功地发现了他们几支部队的集结点。我希望你召集一切可能获得的力量，飞去集结点，给他们的舰队以毁灭性打击。那应能吓得他们不敢在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发动攻击，给他们点难忘的记忆。

只是别忘记你的真正目标。我们不知道在那儿到底有多少船，我们只是知道他们的五个会合地点。消灭你能在那儿找到的所有目标，然后回来向我报告。如果他们有太多的人手，就找些帮手；我相信你还有其他的代理人会非常愿意帮你。

name.es: Extravagancia del Cártel de los Ángeles

messages.en: I'll make them regret they were ever born, {[character]agentID.name}, you can count on it.
messages.zh: 我会让他们后悔出生在这个世界上，{[character]agentID.name}，放心吧。

name.ru: Месть за павшего товарища (Avenge a Fallen Comrade)

messages.en:
A despicable crime was committed against us in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} yesterday, {[character]player.name}. One of our fighters was brutally murdered by DED pigs nosing around our operations. We will not let them waltz carelessly around our territory and get away with such offenses. They're on our turf now, and they'd better be ready for a fight.

Your job is pretty straightforward, {[character]player.name}. Find the DED drones who murdered your colleague, and put an end to their miserable existence.
messages.zh:
昨天有人在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}对我们犯下了滔天罪行，{[character]player.name}。我们的一个战士被刺探我们军情的DED蠢猪残忍加害了。我们决不允许凶手在家门口肆无忌惮，犯了罪还能若无其事。他们现在在我们的地盘上，血债要用血来偿。

你的工作很简单，{[character]player.name}。找到那些加害你同事的DED无人机，结束他们可悲的一生。

name.ru: Месть за павшего товарища (Avenge a Fallen Comrade)

messages.en:
A CONCORD scout drone was just spotted in this system by one of our men. As usual, these drones should always be eliminated before they cause any damage. I'm not sure why this drone has entered our territory, or if it's alone. Might just be an accident, or maybe it's on some secret mission.

Either way, I'd like you to head out there and get rid of it, as well as any others you might stumble across, before they manage to escape. Leave no traces. Don't be long!
messages.zh:
我们的人最近在这个星系里发现了一架统合部侦察无人机。照惯例，这些无人机应该在造成危害前就被摧毁。我不清楚为何只此一架无人机侵入我们的空域，也不知道它到底是不是单独行动。可能是意外，也可能是它在执行某项秘密任务。

不管怎样，在他们逃走之前把它干掉，如果还发现其他的，也一并解决。不要留下痕迹。速战速决！

name.fr: La menace des chasseurs de tête
name.ja: ヘッドハンターの脅威
name.ru: Угроза охотников за головами (Head Hunter Threat)

messages.en:
A few years ago we kidnapped a few people on a remote planet that we raided. One of their relatives has been on our backs ever since. He keeps hiring bounty hunters to retrieve them and bring them back to their former home. Little does he know that most of them are already dead *chuckle*.

Anyway, get yourself ready for some action; The latest bounty hunter assigned on another one of those pathetic rescue attempts has been spotted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Take care of him.
messages.zh:
几年前，我们袭击了一颗遥远的行星，并绑架了一些人。从那以后，他们的一个亲戚就处处和我们作对。他不断雇用一些赏金猎人来解救他们，把他们带回原来的家园。但他可能根本不知道很多人早就死了，*咯咯笑*。

不管怎么样，准备有所行动吧。他最近又要进行一次无谓的营救了，新雇佣的赏金猎人已经出现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}了。把他给我干掉。

name.fr: La menace des chasseurs de tête
name.ja: ヘッドハンターの脅威
name.ru: Угроза охотников за головами (Head Hunter Threat)

name.ja: ローグドローンの嫌がらせ

messages.en: We've just been informed of an official complaint from the mining division working in one of the asteroid fields in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, about their haulers being attacked on sight by roaming rogue drones in the area.  At first it started with just a few unsuccessful attacks, but the situation has worsened greatly and the hauler pilots, along with the miners themselves, are on the verge of a strike.  This is the perfect opportunity for someone like you to take care of business and earn your reward, {[character]player.name}.  I'll supply you with a bookmark to the location of the asteroid belt, eliminate the rogue drone threat there and then report back to me.
messages.zh: 我们刚刚接到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的某个小行星带的矿务部门的正式投诉，说是他们的运输人员在该区域总是受到无人机的袭击。起初只是小规模的骚扰，而后情况愈演愈烈。运输人员和矿工都处于罢工边缘。这可是你表现自己并大捞一笔的绝好机会，{[character]player.name}。我会给你那个小行星带的位标，消除那里的无人机威胁，然后回来向我报告。

name.ja: ローグドローンの嫌がらせ

messages.en: {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} roamers in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have been hit by a rogue drone attack, again. This time it happened while they were inspecting one of the asteroid belts near here, for any sign of mining activity. This of course calls for some serious drone busting, {[character]player.name}. These drones are a menace to all of us, and such a threat must be neutralized. Head out to the location where the last attack occurred and eliminate any Rogue Drones you can find there, then report back to me.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的巡查人员在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}再次遭到自由无人机的袭击。这次袭击是在他们巡查附近的一个小行星带的采矿活动迹象时发生的。这当然引来了一群无人机的重炮，{[character]player.name}。这些无人机是我们所有人的威胁，这种威胁必须被解除。现在立即赶到上次攻击发生地点，消灭那里的所有无人机，然后回来向我报告。

name.ja: ローグドローンの嫌がらせ

messages.en:
We have reason to believe that equipment which was stolen from our storage silo near {[location]agentStationID.name} is going to be laundered through an unlicensed Merchants Hub in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It is a privately owned trading outpost which is renowned for attracting criminal elements, and I wouldn't be the least bit surprised that such activity is going on there.

We believe the goods are being transported to the outpost as we speak, in an industrial, a Bestower to be exact. I want you to fly out there immediately and find the equipment and bring it back to us. It may still be located in the same sealed containers as when it was stolen.

You have full authority to shoot anything that threatens you near the outpost, {[character]player.name}. They might send some of their mercenary ships to intercept you, once they know what you're after. After all, if we can prove the tycoon who owns that place had anything to do with the theft, we'll have the perfect excuse to bring that scrapheap down for good.
messages.zh:
我们位于{[location]agentStationID.name}附近的贮藏舱遭窃，情报表明失窃的设备将在位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个没有执照的贸易中心出手。这是个私人拥有的贸易哨站，以招揽犯罪分子著称，在那里销赃丝毫不令我感到惊讶。

就在我们说话的当口，货物正由一艘工业舰，更确切地讲一艘恩赐者级工业舰，运往那个哨站。我要你马上飞去那里，找到那些设备，并且给我带回来。它们应该还放在遭窃时的那个密封集装箱里。

你有权向哨站附近任何威胁你的东西开火，{[character]player.name}。一旦他们知道你的目的，他们可能会派一些雇佣兵来拦截你。说到底，只要能证明拥有那个空间站的大亨和这次事件有关，我们就有充足的理由把那个垃圾地方彻底夷平。

messages.en: I recieved some grave tidings from our command post, {[character]player.name}. Those blasted Mordus mercenaries have struck again, obliterating one of our convoys while conducting an assassination mission to take out one of our overseers. Our men fought valiantly, but their force was simply too great for them to handle. They're still on the loose somewhere in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, and we need them taken care of ASAP, before they manage to escape. They must be punished for their insolence, and I require that you bring back a few prisoners for questioning, after you have taken out their leader. We need to find out who sent them, although we have our suspicions it would be best to confirm them before we take further action.
messages.zh: 从我们的指挥站传来沉重的消息，{[character]player.name}。那些该死的莫德团雇佣兵又来进攻了。他们在加害我们的一位监察官时，消灭了我们的一支护航队。尽管我们的战士勇猛反击，但对方实在太强。那群雇佣兵仍在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}逍遥法外，尽快干掉他们，别让他们逃了。他们必须为自己的傲慢付出代价。你干掉他们的首领之后，抓几个活的回来问话。我们想知道幕后主使的身份，虽然我们有怀疑的对象，但在采取进一步行动之前最好确认一下。

name.de: Geflüster im Dunkeln - Erster Kontakt (1 von 4)
name.en: Whispers in the Dark - First Contact (1 of 4)
name.es: Susurros en la oscuridad: Primer contacto (1 de 4)
name.fr: Murmures dans les ténèbres – Premier contact (1 sur 4)
name.ja: 闇からのささやき―最初の連絡（1/4）
name.ko: 어둠 속의 속삭임 - 첫 번째 접촉 (1/4)
name.ru: Шепот в ночи: первая встреча (Whispers in the Dark - First Contact) (1 из 4)
name.zh: 黑暗中的密语—第一次接触(1/4)

messages.en: Watch your back out there, {[character]player.name}.  And whatever you do, don't let them take you prisoner, I've heard some mighty frightening stories about what happens to people that are taken alive by those monsters...
messages.zh: 千万小心，{[character]player.name}。不论如何，别落到他们手里。我听说过很多耸人听闻的故事，那些魔鬼对待俘虏简直禽兽不如……

messages.en:
So good to see you, {[character]player.name}. I've been on a pretty tight schedule for the past two weeks, ever since we discovered the strange, and increasing, Sansha activity in the system. Our CEO demands an explanation, yet we still don't know enough about the situation to determine what's really going on. And that's where you come in.

Sanshas activity on this scale in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} is unheard of, and quite frankly we aren't well enough prepared at the moment to deal with any major conflict with the Nation. Not only that, but those damned zombies give us the creeps, and news of their appearance around here has sent parts of the populace into a state of panic. People are leaving this station already, making my superiors ... less than content if you know what I mean. We're losing good people because of this unacceptable situation and we need to put an end to it.

The first thing I want you to do is undertake a reconnaisance mission for us into an area where we have witnessed most of the Sanshas activity. We've already lost a few patrols that ventured into this area, so be careful. If you do find any Sanshas ships out there, eliminate them. We don't want any prisoners, interrogating the creatures won't do us any good. Report your findings to me a.s.a.p.
messages.zh:
很高兴见到你，{[character]player.name}。这两周我忙得焦头烂额，因为萨沙军队在这个星系的行动很不正常，而且愈演愈烈。CEO要我们对此给个说法，但目前情报非常匮乏，无法确定他们到底在干什么。这就是要你来这的原因。

以前萨沙军队从未在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}进行过如此规模的行动，坦白的讲，目前我们准备尚不充分，不能和他们正面冲突。不仅如此，那群怪人总让人感到毛骨悚然，一些平民对他们到来的消息非常恐慌，甚至已经有人开始撤离空间站，这让我的上级……不怎么满意，我想你能明白我的意思。由于这些尴尬的事件，我们失去了优秀的人民，不能让这样的情况再继续下去了。

我要你做的第一件事情就是到据报萨沙活动频繁的地区进行侦察。你要特别小心，先前派去的巡逻队都有去无回。如果你确实在那里发现了萨沙的舰船，消灭他们。留他们性命毫无意义，从疯子口中能问出什么呢。尽快把侦查情况回报给我们。

messages.en: You showed some class out there, {[character]player.name}.  Take your pay and report for your next assignment.
messages.zh: 你的表现很上档次，{[character]player.name}。这是你的报酬，下个工作正等着你呢。

messages.en: I'm so glad to have a friend of the Federation around here, {[character]player.name}.  Now if you can only eliminate some of those pesky Serpentis fighters in the area, I'll pay you a lot of ISK.  Bring me some of their Gold tags as proof of the deed.
messages.zh: 我很高兴能在这儿有一个联邦朋友，{[character]player.name}。只要你能消灭一部分恼人的天蛇战舰，我就会付你许多星币。给我带些他们的黄金铭牌回来作为行动成功的证明。

messages.en: Since your valiant efforts to aid our cause still hasn't provided us with the results we need, I'd like you to try something a little harder.  Some of the Serpentis top-tier battleship captains carry a Diamond embedded tag to display their status within the Serpentis fleet.  Bring me these tags as proof of their demise, and I'll reward you well.  That should put a serious dent in their forces.
messages.zh: 你对我们事业的英勇付出仍没有换来我们想要得到的结果，现在，我要给你稍微难一点的任务。某些天蛇集团的顶级战列舰舰长会配带镶嵌钻石的徽章，以此来显示他们在天蛇舰队里的地位。给我把这种徽章带来，作为他们死亡的证明，我会给你不错的报酬。你的行动能大大削弱他们的军力。

messages.en: Since your valiant efforts to aid our cause still hasn't provided us with the results we need, I'd like you to try something a little harder.  Some of the Serpentis top-tier battleship captains carry a Diamond embedded tag to display their status within the Serpentis fleet.  Bring me these tags as proof of their demise, and I'll reward you well.  That should put a serious dent in their forces.
messages.zh: 你为我们事业所做的英勇表现并未带来我们需要的结果，所以我想让你做些难度稍高的事情。一些天蛇集团的顶级战列舰舰长会配带镶嵌钻石的铭牌，以此来显示他们在天蛇舰队里的地位。给我带些这种铭牌来，作为他们死亡的证明，我会好好奖励你的。那应该能重创他们的部队。

name.ru: Гангстеры Serpentis - офицер Serpentis (Serpentis Gangsters - The Serpentis Officer) (3 из 3)

messages.en: Before we leave back to Federation space, I want a certain Serpentis officer killed.  Her name is Brynn Jerdola, and she roams the asteroid belts of Fountain, searching for unwary prey to murder in cold blood.  She, of all the Serpentis I've encountered, has caused my men the most grief.  We've lost over a dozen miners to her battleship, and the last encounter I had with her I barely escaped with my life.  Bring proof of her death and I will reward you greatly.  Then at least I can return home with the satisfaction of having caused the death of my greatest enemy.
messages.zh: 在我们回到联邦太空之前，我要你干掉一个天蛇军官。她名叫布瑞恩·杰尔朵拉，常在源泉之域的小行星带出现，残忍地加害那些毫无防备的人。在我遇到的所有天蛇成员里，她使我遭受了最大的人员损失。我手下有十几个矿工都在她的战列舰下丧命，我也险些在上一次遭遇中丢掉性命。带回她的遗物，我会重重赏你。除去了这个心腹大患，至少我能安心地离开这里。

Her name is Brynn Jerdola, and she roams the asteroid belts of Fountain, searching for unwary prey to murder in cold blood.  She, of all the Serpentis I've encountered, has caused my men the most grief.  We've lost over a dozen miners to her battleship, and the last encounter I had with her I barely escaped with my life.  Bring proof of her death and I will reward you greatly.  Then at least I can return home with the satisfaction of having caused the death of my greatest enemy.
messages.zh: 在我们回到联邦空间之前，我要除掉一个天蛇军官。她名叫布瑞恩·杰尔朵拉，常在源泉之域的小行星带游荡，搜寻掉以轻心的猎物并残忍加害。在我遇到的所有天蛇成员里，她使我遭受了最大的人员损失。我手下有十几个矿工都在她的战列舰下丧命；在上次和她的遭遇战中，我侥幸逃脱，捡了一条命。把可以证明她死亡的证据带给我，我会重重奖励你。然后我就能心满意足地回家，至少我让最大的对头送了命。

messages.en:
Welcome to this humble refugee camp operated by us, the Sisters of EVE. I am Fynnir Torsont, please call me Fynnir. We're swamped here at the camp and I'm on the lookout for volunteers of gentle spirit to lend aid.

Even if no one will admit it, there is a war raging here in Traun. Every day numerous skirmishes take place all over the system. I have no idea which side is winning, if any. If there are any sides, that is. No one seems to know who exactly is fighting whom. There are Republic forces here, Minmatar freedom fighters, Angel Cartel pirates, Thukker tribe nomads, Amarrians, you name it. We Sisters of EVE try to stay impartial in this chaos, it is often hard and always thankless. But someone needs to care for the weak, and I don't see the empires volunteering anything.

Every war, no matter the scale, always has its share of atrocities and this one is no different. I can't even start describing them, its too long and too sad a tale. Yet one requires mentioning. Recently a group of refugees arrived here in the camp. They are workers from an independent asteroid colony in a distant part of the system. When they arrived some of them showed symptoms of some unidentified illness and thus they were quarantined. Now, all of them are sick, many dying, or are already dead.

We don't have the resources here in the camp to determine what is causing this illness, but I have my suspicions. I don't think any of the factions slugging it out here are beneath chemical warfare and I fear that may be the case here. But investigating those suspicions must wait for another time. What matters now is getting the infected refugees to our station in the Lanngisi system, where they can be properly treated. Or at least receive their last rites in some peace and quiet. Time is of the essence here, their condition is grim and grows worse by the hour. If you're willing to take the task of ferrying some of them over to the Lanngisi system I will reward you well, but you can earn much more if you get them all there safely in just 40 minutes. Oh, and don't worry, they will be properly quarantined on the journey too.
messages.zh:
欢迎来到姐妹共济会简陋的难民营。我是芬尼尔•图松，可以叫我芬尼尔。我们处于困境之中，正在寻找好心的志愿者来助我们一臂之力。

尽管没有人愿意承认，但塔拉文确实遭受着战争的摧残。每天在整个星系中，小型冲突比比皆是，我不清楚哪方占了上风，事实上连敌我彼此都很难分清。没有人知道到底谁和谁在打仗。这里有米玛塔尔共和国军队，米玛塔尔自由战士，天使企业联合体海盗，图克尔部落游牧者，艾玛人，凡是你想得到的，这里都有。姐妹共济会坚持在混乱中保持公正，这很难，而且通常不讨好。但总要有人照顾那些弱势群体，那些帝国我是不指望了。

每一场战争，无论规模多大，都有它残暴的一面，这次也不例外。我不想去描述，这曲哀歌实在太长、太悲伤。但有一点不得不提，最近有一群难民抵达这个营地，他们来自星系内一个遥远的独立小行星殖民地。一部分人在到达时出现未确认的病症，因此我将整批人全部隔离。而现在他们都被感染了，许多人处于死亡的边缘，有的甚至已死去。

营地里没有仪器能让我们分析病因，不过我怀疑有组织在这里进行化学战，恐怕那就是病因。不过现在还不是证实我怀疑的时候，目前的首要任务是把受感染的难民送到我们朗基斯星系的空间站去，在那里他们会得到合适的医治——至少他们能在和平宁静的地方度过最后的时光。时间非常宝贵，情况严峻，他们的病情每分每秒都在恶化。如果你愿意护送一些病人去朗基斯，我会好好酬谢你。要是你在四十分钟之内安全送达所有人，我会给你更多报酬。哦，不用担心自己的安全，在旅途中他们会被有效地隔离。
