name.fr: Infiltration – Les apparences sont parfois trompeuses (1 sur 3)

messages.en:
Since you're a trusted operative of the State, I'm going to let you in on my current operation in the hope you can render me some assistance. I am, along with a few other agents, on an undercover mission to infiltrate some of the bandit gangs in this area, in an effort to get the Navy a better foothold in these blasted badlands.

We need some supplies from the outlying areas, but we need to maintain complete secrecy. In fact, it's best if we don't show our faces anywhere, and thus we need inauspicious people such as yourself to gather some materials for us. First off, we're creating a disguise to try and infiltrate the Roving Dodgers, a gang that's been terrorizing some of the outposts in this constellation. We're going to need some specialized polymer fabrics in order to create disguises that pass inspection, yet provide protection in the event that we're discovered.

I need you to head out to the Nugoeihuvi Development Studio in Sakkikainen and pick me up some TX-890 polymers. Nugoeihuvi manufactures them specially for that idiotic extreme reality show, and our insider has allowed us access to some of it. Head over there and bring me back some of it, and I'll probably have another job for you.
messages.zh:
作为特工，你深受合众国信赖，我将让你介入我目前的工作，希望你能给我一点帮助。我同其他一些代理人正在秘密执行一个潜入本地强盗黑帮的任务，这样可以为海军在这荒蛮之地提供一个良好的立足之处。

我们需要从偏远地区获得供给，但必须秘密进行不能被发现。实际上，我们最好不要在任何地方露面，所以需要像你这样的外人替我们收集这些材料。我们正准备伪装潜入漫游者组织，那是一个常在这个星系里的哨站进行恐怖活动的黑帮组织。我们需要一些特殊的合成纺织纤维来作掩护，使我们能顺利通过检查。

我要你去以哈坎拿的纳基维发展工作室走一趟，去那拿些TX-890合成纺织纤维。纳基维专为某个白痴透顶的实体秀生产这些材料。但我们在纳基维内部的同事设法为我们搞到了一些。你去那儿帮我把东西带回来，之后我有另外一个工作给你。

name.fr: Infiltration – Dans la peau du personnage (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 潜入-キャラクター作り（2/3）
name.ru: Внедрение - создание личины (Infiltration - Molding Character) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
First off - thanks again for the polymers. They will come in very handy. Our technicians have most things they need to complete the disguise now, but one crucial thing is still missing. In order to create certain facial characteristics required for the impersonation of one of the people we'll be, ahem, "replacing," we're going to need some silicon from one of the Lai Dai factories in the constellation.

Head out to Sakkikainen, get us that silicon, and we'll be one step closer to our goal.
messages.zh:
首先——再次感谢你弄来的合成纺织纤维。它们马上会派上用场。我们的特工已经有了伪装所需的大部分东西，现在只剩最关键的一样了。为了塑造某个我们要假冒的人的脸部特征，我们需要从这个星系的莱戴工厂获得一些硅。

去萨基凯伦，把硅带给我们，那样我们就离目标更近一步了。

name.ja: 潜入-メッセンジャーを消せ（3/3）
name.ru: Вторжение - убить посланца (Infiltration - Kill the Messenger) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
We've just discovered that one of the operatives on our team was a double agent from the very gang we're trying to infiltrate! Just before he decamped, we managed to plant a homing beacon on his ship. We can give you a bookmark to the location of the beacon. When you activate the bookmark, the beacon shoots out from his ship to prevent you colliding with him straight out of warp.

He's probably at a rendezvous point right now, waiting for someone to give the information to. Move quickly, or all our work here will be for nothing! I want his head. I will reward you handsomely if you complete this job in time for our mission to be salvaged.
messages.zh:
我们刚刚发现我们队里的一个特工是一个双重间谍，是我们正想渗透的那个团队派来的！刚好在他逃跑前，我们在他的飞船上装了个归航信标。我们可以给你提供信标的位置。一旦你激活位标准备跃迁，信标就会立刻射出飞船，以免你在跃迁后直接撞到他。

他现在很可能正在一个会面地点，等待有人给他送信。迅速行动，否则我们的所有工作都会白费！我要他的人头。如果你能够及时完成我们的补救任务，那么我会重重有赏。

name.en: The Plantation Workers - Caught In A Storm (1 of 4)
name.es: Los trabajadores de la plantación: El ojo de la tormenta (1 de 4)
name.fr: Les ouvriers de la plantation – Pris dans une tempête (1 sur 4)
name.ja: 農園作業員―嵐の中の救助（1/4）
name.ru: Работники плантации - попавшие в бурю (The Plantation Workers - Caught In A Storm) (1 из 4)
name.zh: 种植园的工人—风雨交加(1/4)

messages.en:
Ah so it's you, {[character]player.name}. You've made quite a name for yourself within the inner circles of the Empire, I'm sure you will come in handy. I have a few tasks that need to be carried out a.s.a.p., in the name of Joint Harvesting. Acquiring mercenaries in these parts has been quite difficult to say the least, considering the locals absolutely despise us. Their ungratefulness is astounding, considering how well we treated them during our reign over the Minmatar territories.

Well enough of that, I'll get to the point. We had a convoy incoming from the Amarrian territories to one of our plantations in Barkrik when disaster struck. A group of vile 'freedom fighter' terrorists ambushed them as soon as they appeared out of hyper-jump within Barkrik. The escort ships managed to fend off the attackers, allowing the freighter to escape relatively unharmed. But due to the interference, it went a little off course and ended up crashing into an area of deadspace we call 'The Dustbowl'. It's not far from here, and all travelers are advised to avoid it at all costs. What a stroke of bad luck for our convoy to end up in there!

Needless to say, we haven't heard from it since. The Dustbowl is infested with rogue drones and criminals hiding from the law. No sane person without a bounty on his head ventures in there, it's a virtual death trap. I'm certain our freighter has either been destroyed or so badly damaged that it can't escape. I want you to fly in there and investigate, if you find the freighter bring back anything you can salvage from it to me. And don't speak a word of your findings to anyone! This is top secret business.
messages.zh:
原来是你，{[character]player.name}。 如今你在帝国内声名鹊起。 现在助我一臂之力吧，我有些任务要以联合收割的名义尽快执行。 这些日子要找个好佣兵太不容易了，本地人对我们不理不睬的。 这些忘恩负义之徒，想想看在我们统治米玛塔尔的时候，我们对他们有多好啊！

好了，现在切入正题吧。 我们有一支从艾玛境内前往巴尔克里克种植园的护航队遇到了不幸。 他们刚跃迁至巴尔克里克，就遭到了一群自称“自由战士”的恐怖分子的伏击。 护卫队全力抵抗，使我们的货船逃脱了毁灭的命运。 但最后它稍稍偏离了航线，一头撞进了死亡空间里的某处，一个我们称为“空尘球域”的地方。 虽然离这儿不远，但所有星际旅行者都被告知要远离那地方。 护航队的运气实在太糟了不是吗？谁会想到那儿会成了他们的葬身之地呢？

不必说，直到现在我们都还没有他们的消息。 空尘球域遍地是自由无人机和亡命天涯的不法分子。 那是一个地地道道的死亡陷阱。除非被悬赏通缉，否则没有一个神志清醒的人会前去冒险。 我敢肯定我们的货船不是被摧毁，就是损坏严重了不能离开。 我要你去那儿调查一下，如果你找到了货船，把你可以抢救出来的任何东西带回来给我。 而且不要对任何人透露你的发现。 这可是最高机密！

messages.en: So some of the slaves actually survived the ordeal, very nice. You've earned your reward, slaves are an incredibly valuable asset so deep in Minmatar space. And do not forget, don't speak of this to ANYONE, not even your closest ally! There are already rumors afloat that our plantations in Barkrik have slaves on board, but if the rumors are substantiated then our entire operation within Minmatar space will be compromised. And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 这样看来，有些劳工实际上经受住了这次严酷的考验，很好。这是你的酬劳，在米玛塔尔空间的深处，劳工是一笔非常宝贵的财富。不要忘了，不要对任何人说这件事，即使是你最亲密的盟友也不行！关于我们巴尔克里克的种植园有劳工的事儿，外面早已谣言四起，可是如果谣言被证实，那么我们在米玛塔尔空间的整个行动都将危如累卵。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

name.de: Die Plantagenarbeiter - Behandelt die Verletzten (2 von 4)
name.en: The Plantation Workers - Treat The Injured (2 of 4)
name.es: Los trabajadores de la plantación: Curar a los heridos (2 de 4)
name.fr: Les ouvriers de la plantation – Sauver les blessés (2 sur 4)
name.ja: 農園作業員―負傷者の手当て（2/4）
name.ru: Работники плантации - лечение раненых (The Plantation Workers - Treat The Injured) (2 из 4)
name.zh: 种植园的工人—治疗伤者 (2/4)

messages.en:
The slaves you brought back in your last mission are almost all injured, some critically. We need medical supplies here ASAP, I don't even dare move them to the plantation in this state. I don't know how long some of them will last, so time is of the essence here. If you're fast, I'll give you a hefty bonus.

I couldn't come up with the required medical supplies fast enough, so you'll have to find them on your own. I suggest looking at the market in this or neighboring regions.
messages.zh:
你上次任务中带回的劳工几乎都受了伤，有一些伤势严重。我们需要尽快得到药物供给，这种状况下我不能把他们转移去国家种植园。我不知道他们还能撑多久，所以时间十分宝贵。如果你能迅速办到，我会给你丰厚的额外奖励。

我不能立刻发现哪里有急需的药品，所以你得自己去找。建议你在这个星域或临近的星域市场里寻找一下。

我没法马上买到急需的药品，所以你得自己去找。建议你在附近的市场里寻找一下。

name.de: Die Plantagenarbeiter - Rettet die Plantage (4 von 4)
name.en: The Plantation Workers - Save The Plantation (4 of 4)
name.es: Los trabajadores de la plantación: Salvar la plantación (4 de 4)
name.fr: Les ouvriers de la plantation - Sauver la plantation (4 sur 4)
name.ja: 農園作業員―農園を死守せよ（4/4）
name.ru: Работники плантации - спасти плантацию (The Plantation Workers - Save The Plantation) (4 из 4)
name.zh: 种植园的工人 - 拯救种植园(4/4)

messages.en: I'm ready for your assignment, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我已经准备好了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en:
Ok the assignment is simple, but easier said than done. One of our hidden plantations within Barkrik has been infiltrated by the Freedom Fighter terrorist organization! They somehow managed to follow me there undetected while I transported the slaves you ferried here in your last mission to the plantation premises. A very devious plan of theirs ...

The last I heard the security defenses around the plantation had been overwhelmed. The plantation itself is hidden deep within an asteroid belt within deadspace, it will take them a while to reach it. Hopefully this will give you enough time to intercept their forces before they destroy all of our structures there! Defend our control tower at all costs! Succeed in this task and you will be well rewarded.
messages.zh:
好吧，任务很简单，但说起来容易做起来难。恐怖组织自由战士已潜入我们在巴尔克里克的一个隐蔽种植园里！我在把你上次任务中带到这儿的劳工运往种植园时，他们不知用什么方法竟然一路跟踪我到了那儿，而我却丝毫没有察觉。这些狡猾的家伙……

我听说的最新情况是，种植园周围的安全防御力量已被彻底击垮。种植园本身隐藏在死亡空间的某个行星带深处，他们得花好些时间才能到那儿。但愿这会给你充分时间赶在我们所有建筑尽数被毁前，对他们实施中途拦截。你要不惜一切代价保卫我们的控制塔！任务成功之后，你会得到丰厚的报酬。

messages.en: You've done Joint Harvesting and the Empire a great service again, {[character]player.name}.  We won't forget this.
messages.zh: 你又一次为联合收割和帝国立了大功，{[character]player.name}。对此，我们会铭记在心的。

messages.en:
Ok the assignment is simple, but easier said than done. One of our hidden plantations within Barkrik has been infiltrated by the Freedom Fighter terrorist organization! They somehow managed to follow me there undetected while I transported the slaves you ferried here in your last mission to the plantation premises. A very devious plan of theirs ...

The last I heard the security defenses around the plantation had been overwhelmed. The plantation itself is hidden deep within an asteroid belt within deadspace, it will take them a while to reach it. Hopefully this will give you enough time to intercept their forces before they destroy all of our structures there! Defend our control tower at all costs! Succeed in this task and you will be well rewarded.
messages.zh:
好吧，任务很简单，但说远比做容易。自称自由战士的恐怖分子组织已派人潜入我们在巴尔克里克的一个种植园里！我把上次任务中你引渡到这儿的劳工运到了种植园，但不知道通过什么手段，他们竟然跟踪我到了那儿，而一路上我却丝毫没有察觉。这些狡猾的家伙……

最近，我听说种植园周围的安全防御设施被彻底破坏了。种植园本身隐藏在死亡空间的某个行星带深处，他们到那儿得花好些时间，所以你必须得赶在我们所有建筑尽数被毁前，对他们实施中途拦截，要不惜任何代价保卫我们的控制塔！任务成功之后，你会得到丰厚的报酬！

name.en: The Plantation Workers - Extra Hands (3 of 4)
name.es: Los trabajadores de la plantación: Arrimar el hombro (3 de 4)
name.fr: Les ouvriers de la plantation – Une aide supplémentaire (3 sur 4)
name.ru: Работники плантации - дополнительные руки (The Plantation Workers - Extra Hands) (3 из 4)
name.zh: 种植园的工人—额外的人手 (3/4)

messages.en:
Although it looks like we will save most of the injured slaves you brought back in a previous mission, the current number of them is insufficient to satisfy the plantation overseer. Plus many of the ones that are getting better won't be ready for work for some time.

Now I know we have an oversupply of slaves in Hjoramold currently, the Joint Harvesting plantations there don't really need so many workers. They've agreed to supply us with an extra 50 slaves from their own stock. If you could just bring them here, past the Minmatar customs officials undetected, I'll reward you well.
messages.zh:
尽管我们能救活你上次任务中带回来的大多数劳工，但现在他们的数量仍然不能满足种植园工头的需求。况且很多人还处于恢复期，有一段时间不能工作。

目前我们在加拉摩德的劳工过剩，那儿的联合收割种植园不需要那么多工人。他们已经答应从自己的劳工储备里多分出50个给我们。如果你能躲过米玛塔尔海关官员的检察，把他们带到这里，我会给你丰厚的报酬。

messages.en:
Although it looks like we will save most of the injured slaves you brought back in a previous mission, the current number of them is insufficient to satisfy the plantation overseer. Plus many of the ones that are getting better won't be ready for work for some time.

Now I know we have an oversupply of slaves in Hjoramold currently, the Joint Harvesting plantations there don't really need so many workers. They've agreed to supply us with an extra 50 slaves from their own stock. If you could just bring them here, past the Minmatar customs officials undetected, I'll reward you well.
messages.zh:
我们能拯救你上次任务中带回来的大部分劳工，但现在他们的数量仍然不够满足种植园监管人的需求，况且一部分人还处于恢复期，暂时不能从事工作。

目前我们在加拉摩德的劳工过剩，那儿的联合收割种植园并不需要那么多工人。他们已经同意调50个给我们。如果你能躲过米玛塔尔海关官员的检察，把他们带到这里，我会给你丰厚的报酬。

name.es: Casa de las flores: Lucia (1 de 3)
name.ru: Дом цветов — Lucia (House of Flowers - Lucia) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
I don't know if you've heard of me yet, but if you spend more time in this constellation you're sure to. Anyway, the name's Rie Nissiken. I'm owner and proprietor of the House of Flowers, finest little ladies' house in this here corner of the universe. Now, most days everything's just hunky-dory, but today I seem to have a problem.

See, there's this little sweetheart called Lucia whom I've been grooming to be one of my girls. She's a natural at it, and happy with the job and the money it pays, but there's a problem: her overbearing, abusive ex-fiancee, Roark. Just yesterday he grabbed her and whisked her off in his ship, screaming and cursing that this lifestyle wasn't for her.

Now, call me libertarian, but I do believe people should be allowed to choose what they do for a living. I think Roark needs to learn that the hard way. If you agree, then how about this: there's a little watering hole built in an old astrofarm in system, where he and scum like him hang out. Head on over there, show him the light, and bring darling Lucia back to me. Sound good?
messages.zh:
我不知道你是否听说过我，但如果你在这个星座多呆一阵，肯定会知道我，我叫希•妮斯肯，是鲜花会所的所有人和经营者。这个会所是本地区女性的最佳休闲胜地。平日里一切安好，但今天有点小问题。

你看，有个可爱的小女孩名叫露西亚，我想把她培养成我的女侍。她有这方面的天赋，也很喜欢这份工作和薪水，但问题出在她傲慢专横的前未婚夫罗亚克。昨天他把露西亚拽到自己的飞船里，狠狠打了一顿，叫嚣地训斥她，说这种生活不适合她。

然而我是自由主义者，坚信每个人都有选择自己生活的权利。依我看，罗亚克需要努力学习一下这方面的知识。如果你也同意，看看这样如何：星系里的宇宙农场有一个小型湖泊，他和同伙住在那里。你去那里教训他一下。并将亲爱的露西亚带回来。怎么样？

name.en: House of Flowers - Escort Service (2 of 3)
name.es: Casa de las flores: Servicio de escolta (2 de 3)

messages.en: There is a high-level executive party tonight at the Nugoeihuvi Corporation Publisher station in Friggi, and they've asked us to provide some discreet female companionship for some of these discerning gentlemen.  If you can bring a few of my ladies safely down to the station, I will see to it that you're rewarded for your efforts.
messages.zh: 今晚在弗瑞吉的纳基维集团出版社空间站有一个高级管理者舞会，他们要我为那些眼光独到的绅士们找些懂事儿的女士做舞伴。如果你能把这些女士安全的送到那个空间站，我一定会付给你报酬的。

name.de: Haus der Blumen - Wer Wind sät wird Sturm ernten (3 von 3)
name.en: House of Flowers - Hell Hath No Fury (3 of 3)
name.es: Casa de las flores: No hay furia para el infierno (3 de 3)
name.fr: La Maison fleurie - Chagrin d'amour (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 花の家-女の恨みは恐ろしい（3/3）
name.ru: Дом цветов — гнев страшнее ада (House of Flowers - Hell Hath No Fury) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
Today is a dark day for the House of Flowers, {[character]player.name}. A group of ruthless cads came barging into my beautiful establishment just yesterday, drunken and loutish, and manhandled some of my girls rather badly. Now, there's nothing which makes me quite as mad as just that - pathetic cowards rough-housing my ladies just for kicks.

These bastards like to hang out at the Red Roid, a sleazy, run-down miner's dive in this system. One of them is the proprietor, and the others are his two sons. They cater to the slimiest of clientele; half-hearted miners from the contested facilities in Friggi, good for nothing but downing firewater shots and killing plants with their breath. I want you to go in there, kill these worthless scum and destroy their disgusting little honky-tonk. For that, you will have my gratitude and a shedload of cash to boot.
messages.zh:
对我的鲜花会所来说，今天真是倒霉的一天，{[character]player.name}。一群醉鬼强行闯入我花了一整天精心打扮的会所，大嚷大叫不说，还对我的女侍动手动脚。我简直……气疯了！！！可悲的懦夫！为了找点乐子竟敢这样欺负我们！

那群混蛋喜欢聚集在赤色行星，由于星系里的矿脉几近枯竭，没事做的矿工整天泡在那个小沙龙里。其中一个是经营者，另两个是他的儿子。沙龙的常客都是些来自弗瑞吉的蠢货矿工，唯一擅长的就是往自己的肚子里猛灌烈酒，喷出来的气能熏死一头活牛！你要做的就是去那儿把这群废物统统干掉！沙龙也别留下，炸掉！如果你能做到，我会非常感激，并给你丰厚的报酬。

name.en: Treasure Hunter - The Vherokior Medallion (1 of 4)
name.fr: Chasseur de trésor – Le médaillon Vherokior (1 sur 4)
name.ja: トレジャーハンター―ヴェロキュオール勲章（1/4）
name.ru: Охотник за сокровищами - медальон Vherokior (Treasure Hunter - The Vherokior Medallion) (1 из 4)

messages.en: I'm interested.  Got any clues as to where I can find these artifacts?
messages.zh: 我很感兴趣。你有其他线索指引我找到这些古董吗？

messages.en:
The first artifact I'm looking for is the famous Vherokior Medallion. Since ancient times, the Vherokior tribe has awarded it's greatest achievers and leaders with medallions, signifying their status within the community. These medallions are rare, and usually they are buried along with the wearer after his death. The medallion worn by the leader of the Vherokior is an exception, as it is given to whoever takes control of the tribe to signify a change of leadership.

A long time ago, before the Great Rebellion, the Nefantar claimed the Vherokior Medallion as tribute when they took control of most Minmatar worlds. It was never returned to the Vherokior, and although it was eventually remade after the Minmatar rebellion, the original is worth more than you can imagine.

After tracking down this artifact for many years, I finally found out where it is being kept. To my utter dismay I was told it had fallen into the hands of the Cartel, sold to one of their leaders for an obscene amount of ISK from a private dealer. This Gist overlord's name is Arrak Nutan, and he currently resides in the Legendary Minmatar Stronghold within Hjoramold. Getting to him will be difficult, as the place is a virtual deathtrap.

I'll pay a very handsome amount for this medallion, as long as it's still fully intact. Not that I expect you to get past the Gist fleet inside ...
messages.zh:
我想找的第一件文物就是著名的维洛奇亚奖章。自古以来，维洛奇亚部落把奖章授予成就最突出的人和最伟大的领袖，以表明他们在族中的地位和身份。这些奖章非常稀有，通常在佩戴者死后一起下葬。维洛奇亚首领拥有的奖章却是一个例外，因为只有部落的掌权人才能拥有它以象征着权力的变更。

许多年前，那时米玛塔尔大叛乱还没发生，内凡达在占领大部分米玛塔尔领土后，将维洛奇亚徽章作为贡品夺走。此后它再也没能回到维洛奇亚部落，尽管米玛塔尔叛乱之后它被重制，可原物的价值依然超乎想象。

寻觅多年之后，我终于发现这件古物的下落。令我万分沮丧的是，据说它竟然落入了天使企业联合体之手，他们的一个首领从私人经销商那里以难以想象的高价购得了这个奖章。这个吉斯特领主叫阿那克•拿丹，现居住在加拉摩德的米玛塔尔传奇要塞中。要接近他非常困难，因为那里简直就是个死亡陷阱。<br><br>只要你将奖章完整无缺地带回，我就给你丰厚的酬金。因为我估计你没法避过要塞中的吉斯特舰队……

messages.en: I can't believe it!  You managed to get past the entire Gist armada defending their stronghold, take out Arak, and return unharmed?  You're amazing {[character]player.name}, and you definately earned your reward.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 简直不敢相信！你竟能突破吉斯特舰队的守卫，消灭阿拉克，还安然无恙地返回？你太厉害了，{[character]player.name}，你配得上这笔赏金。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

name.de: High Noon - Sprung in der Schüssel
name.en: High Noon - A Few Cards Short (1 of 2)
name.es: Mediodía: El tornillo que falta (1 de 2)
name.fr: Midi pile – Des cartes dans sa manche (1 sur 2)
name.ja: ハイヌーン-カードが足りない（1/2）
name.ru: Битва в полдень - без царя в голове (High Noon - A Few Cards Short) (1 из 2)

messages.en:
Have you ever had a nemesis, {[character]player.name}? If you have, you know how it feels. That everpresent lingering burn in the pit of your stomach, sweat and chills when you see his name written, the obsession, the overpowering strength of emotion. In fact, it's not unlike... ahem. Yes, well.

So! I have a nemesis. And hoo boy, what a nemesis. He's the most down-and-dirty rat bastard you'll ever meet, the meanest of the mean, vilest of the vile. Heck, he even has the Zs and Xs in his name to prove it. And tomorrow at noon, we've decided to settle our differences once and for all. A straight-up duel, the way men used to do it when men were men, women were women, violets were blue and that one other thing.

But, you see, I think my nefarious tub of nemesishood isn't playing with a full deck. A bit loopy in the head, you know? He's gotten it into his head that he can bring an additional friend to a two-man duel, that low-down fink, and furthermore, he thought he could do it without my finding out! So what I need you to do is head on down to the contested mining facilities over in Friggi and dispatch the friend he thought he'd be clever enough to bring, then grab his ID tags from the wreckage and show them to me as proof he's dead. We're gonna have a fair duel if it kills me.

The guy's name is Garp Soolim. Take him out for me, would ya?
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你曾有过报仇的念头吗？如果有过，你就会知道那是一种怎样的感觉。仿佛有一团火在你身体里燃烧，一看到仇人的名字，寒意会从骨髓中涌出，然后，颤抖，汗流不止，仇恨永驻心间，挥之不去。事实上，就是这样……咳，是的。

我有个仇人。好的，小伙子，让我告诉你那是个怎样的人，他是你能碰到的最无耻的混蛋，最最卑鄙无耻的家伙。他的名字中甚至还有Z和X，这足以证明这点。明天中午，我们决定来个彻底的了断。一场面对面的决斗，一次真正你死我亡的较量。

但，你看，那个卑鄙的家伙显然不明白什么是公平决斗。这家伙很过分，你知道吗？他竟然带了第三个人前来赴约，那个卑鄙的混蛋，居然认为可以瞒过我。所以我要你飞往弗瑞吉争夺中的采矿设施，干掉那个家伙想要带来的帮凶，从残骸里找到他的ID铭牌带给我。就算我会死，也必须死于一场公平的决斗。

那个家伙的名字是加尔普•苏利姆。干掉他，好吗？

name.de: High Noon - Die Entscheidung herbeiführen (2 von 2)
name.en: High Noon - Tipping the Scales (2 of 2)
name.fr: Midi pile – Faire pencher la balance (2 sur 2)
name.ja: ハイヌーン-局面を変える（2/2）
name.ru: Битва в полдень - чаша весов (High Noon - Tipping the Scales) (2 из 2)

messages.en:
Now that Xyxzorn's putrescent minions have been eliminated, it's time to see if we can't hedge our own bets a bit. What, did you think I was going to sit by and let that cheating bastard get a fair fight? Not a chance.

I have a few friends down at the station where we're going to have our duel. We're going to set up a little surprise for the old fella, but for them to work their magic they're going to need a spot of rocket fuel.

What, why are you looking at me that way? Trust me, there are perfectly good and honorable uses for rocket fuel within the context of a man-to-man duel. You think it's a coincidence that "fuel" and "duel" rhyme? Don't be naive, my friend.

Get the fuel to the Propel Dynamics factory at Ishisomo VII, and you'll have my eternal gratitude.
messages.zh:
既然扎斯佐恩的帮凶已被消灭，是时候增加我们这边的筹码了。什么，你不会以为我会愚蠢到给那个狡诈的混蛋公平决斗的机会吧？绝不可能！

我会带些朋友一起来这个空间站，给那个混蛋一点小小的惊喜，而这些朋友现在需要些火箭燃料。

干嘛，为什么那样看着我？单挑的时候不能让别人在一旁发射火箭么？你太天真了，伙计。

把这些燃料送到伊什索蒙 VII的推进动态集团工厂，我将对你感激不尽。

name.fr: Chasseur de trésor – La sculpture de Hraldar (2 sur 4)
name.ja: トレジャーハンター―ハラルダーの彫刻（2/4）
name.ru: Охотник за сокровищами - статуя Hraldar (Treasure Hunter - Hraldar's Sculpture) (2 из 4)

messages.en:
The next artifact on the list is Hraldar's sculpture. Hraldar was a Nefantar general which defected to the Minmatar cause during the rebellion. After his death a sculpure was made of him to honor his name. Originally it was placed within the Legendary Minmatar Stronghold, but after it was abandoned the sculpture was moved to the historical museum in Barkrik. A few years ago however, it was stolen by Maru raiders.

I have reliable information that the current owner of the sculpture is Bazeri Palen, one of the leaders of the Maru Rebels. He's an old-time criminal who pretends to be a 'freedom fighter', like most of those Maru scum. He flies a formidable battleship, and usually has a few of his goons around for protection. Taking him out will be hard, but I'm confident in you, {[character]player.name}.

I don't know where you will find him, but the last I heard he was orbiting one of the moons of Hjoramold. The Maru are extremely protective of their territory, so he might attack you when you find him. But don't worry about the legal implications of killing him, he's a wanted man within the Republic and therefore I doubt they will look harshly upon his murder.
messages.zh:
清单上的下一个文物是希拉达雕塑。希拉达原是内凡达的将军，在大叛乱中转投了米玛塔尔一方。在他死后，人们为了纪念他而铸了一尊雕塑。起初它被存放在米玛塔尔传奇要塞中，当要塞被遗弃后，雕塑就转移到了巴尔克里克的历史博物馆中。然而几年前，它被马鲁侵袭者拿走了。

目前有可靠消息证实，雕塑落到了马鲁叛军的首领之一巴兹尔利放聊苁掷铩这家伙是个老到的罪犯，和其他马鲁人渣一样伪装成“自由战士”。他驾驶的战列舰非常强悍，周围通常还有他手下保护。干掉帕能是个艰巨的任务，但我对你有信心，{[character]player.name}。<br><br>我不清楚他现在的位置，但我听说他最近出现在加拉摩德的一个卫星附近。马鲁人对自己的领地极具保护意识，他可能会主动攻击你。不过别担心干掉他会触犯法律，因为他是共和国的通缉犯，我相信共和国会对他的死睁一只眼、闭一只眼。

messages.en:
The next artifact on the list is Hraldar's sculpture. Hraldar was a Nefantar general which defected to the Minmatar cause during the rebellion. After his death a sculpure was made of him to honor his name. Originally it was placed within the Legendary Minmatar Stronghold, but after it was abandoned the sculpture was moved to the historical museum in Barkrik. A few years ago however, it was stolen by Maru raiders.

I have reliable information that the current owner of the sculpture is Bazeri Palen, one of the leaders of the Maru Rebels. He's an old-time criminal who pretends to be a 'freedom fighter', like most of those Maru scum. He flies a formidable battleship, and usually has a few of his goons around for protection. Taking him out will be hard, but I'm confident in you, {[character]player.name}.

I don't know where you will find him, but the last I heard he was orbiting one of the moons of Hjoramold. The Maru are extremely protective of their territory, so he might attack you when you find him. But don't worry about the legal implications of killing him, he's a wanted man within the Republic and therefore I doubt they will look harshly upon his murder.

name.fr: Chasseur de trésor – La pierre de Telligman (3 sur 4)
name.ja: トレジャーハンター―テリグマンの石（3/4）
name.ru: Охотник за сокровищами - камень Telligman (Treasure Hunter - Telligman's Stone) (3 из 4)
name.zh: 寻宝人—特里格曼的石头 (3/4)

messages.en:
Telligman's stone is an old symbol of Minmatar independence. Crad was the famous Amarrian architect who designed the Nefantar palace in Hjoramold, shortly before the Rebellion took place. When the Minmatar forces tore down the palace during the rebellion, they left a single stone intact which they called 'Telligman's stone'. It was later moved to the Bastion museum to be shown as one of the symbols of Minmatar victory in Ani over the occupation.

Find the Bastion museum and steal the stone. I don't care how you do it, just bring it to me intact and I will reward you well.
messages.zh:
特里格曼之石是米玛塔尔独立的古老象征。卡拉德是个著名的艾玛建筑师，在大叛乱前不久设计了位于加拉摩德的内凡达宫。米玛塔尔军队在叛乱中将内凡达宫夷为平地，唯独留下了一块完整的石头，他们称其为“特里格曼之石”。后来它被转移到堡垒博物馆展出，象征了米玛塔尔在安妮推翻统治者取得的胜利。

找到堡垒博物馆并偷出那块石头。我不管你用什么方法，只要把石头完整无缺地带给我，我会重重奖励你。

messages.en: Great!  Now that I have what I came for, it's time to head back to the Empire.  But there's one final assignment I have in store for you, so don't go anywhere yet.
messages.zh: 太好了！既然得到了想要的东西，那么我就该回帝国了。但是我还为你准备了一个最终任务，所以你先别走。

name.ja: トレジャーハンター―輸送（4/4）
name.ru: Охотник за сокровищами - перевозка (Treasure Hunter - Transportation) (4 из 4)

messages.en: I'll wait for you here in Hjoramold, you know where to find me.  I have some unfinished business here which I have to take care of.  My associate in Sasta will take care of the artifacts until I'm ready to make my own journey there.
messages.zh: 我在加拉摩德等你，你知道在哪儿能找到我。这里还有些事情得去办。我动身去那里之前，我在萨斯塔的同事会照看那些古董。

messages.en: The last task I have for you, {[character]player.name}, is to transfer my artifacts to Sasta, which is located within Ammatar space.  The system is en route to my home world within the Empire, so I'll pick up the goods there.  I'm much more confident in your abilities to smuggle these items out of Minmatar space undetected than my own, and I certainly wouldn't want to be caught by the Republic authorities with these items in my cargo hold.  No telling what they'd do to me, especially considering I'm a citizen of the Amarr Empire.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给你的最后一个任务是把我的文物送到艾玛达空间的萨斯塔去。这个星系是我回到帝国家园的必经之路，所以我可以在那里取货。我相信你比我更擅长神不知、鬼不觉地把这些东西偷运出米玛塔尔空间，我可不希望自己带着这些古董被共和国权威部门来个人赃并获。况且我是艾玛人，如果被抓，天晓得他们会对我做什么。

The system is en route to my home world within the Empire, so I'll pick up the goods there.  I'm much more confident in your abilities to smuggle these items out of Minmatar space undetected than my own, and I certainly wouldn't want to be caught by the Republic authorities with these items in my cargo hold.  No telling what they'd do to me, especially considering I'm a citizen of the Amarr Empire.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，这是我给你的最后一个任务，把我的古董送到艾玛达空间的萨斯塔去。这个星系是我回到帝国家园的必经之路，可以顺路提取货物。如果是你，应该可以瞒过检查官把这批货物偷运出米玛塔尔空间，我可不希望自己带着这些古董被共和国权威部门来个人赃并获。况且我是艾玛人，如果被抓住不知会死得多难看。

name.en: Attack of the Killer Drones - ST 58 (1 of 3)
name.es: Ataque de los drones asesinos: ST 58 (1 de 3)
name.fr: Attaque des drones tueurs – ST 58 (1 sur 3)
name.ja: キラードローンの攻撃-ST58（1/3）
name.ru: Атака дронов-убийц - ST 58 (Attack of the Killer Drones - ST 58) (1 из 3)

messages.en: Combat missions are my bread and butter. What's the problem?
messages.zh: 我以战斗为生。出什么事了？

messages.en:
Well, it's rather complicated. But to keep it simple, I'll give you the short version. A few days ago, I completed my latest project, the ST 50 series. They were supposed to be ultra-intelligent fighter drones, specifically ordered by the Minmatar Fleet to serve in our armed forces. In all of the tests I performed on them, they seemed to be in fine condition, easily dispatching all the previous models in our combat simulation tests. However, shortly after they were released from our lab and sent into action, they went missing. The loss was an enormous blow to Boundless Creation, especially considering all the time, effort, and money we spent creating those things.

The sortie that they were on when they went missing was to attack a massive rogue drone hive within Barkrik. They were accompanied by over a dozen human pilots, who also haven't been seen since. I'm not sure exactly what happened there, but a rumor is spreading that they were overwhelmed and captured by the rogue drone mothership. I can't imagine such a thing happening, but...

Anyway, a few days later we heard of a terrible tragedy in Hjoramold. An entire settlement was destroyed by rampaging rogue drones. I didn't think much of it at the time, considering rogue drone attacks are pretty frequent in these parts, but later that day I turned on the evening news I heard something that chilled me to the bone. The recent rogue drone attacks were led by none other than one of my own ST drones! I couldn't believe my ears at first, but it was true. I don't know how, but the rogue drones have somehow managed to reconfigure the ST's AI chip and turn it into a rampaging monster! It must be stopped at all costs; its existence is a terrible blow to my career, and the more damage it causes, the more likely I am to lose my job. You must help me!

Unfortunately, the rogues seem to have deactivated the tracking devices I had installed into the STs. However, I have managed to triangulate the location of two of them, and the third has already been destroyed by local independent capsuleers. You'll find ST 58 at the bookmarked location that I'm about to upload into your NeoCom, floating around a deadspace pocket filled with asteroids. Destroy all drones you find at that location and bring back ST 58's memory chip so that I can study it and find out what went wrong.
messages.zh:
呃，事情有些复杂，不过我向来言简意骇。几天前，我完成了对ST 50系列机型的研制。这一系列产品被荣称为超智能战斗无人机，是米玛塔尔舰队用于部队武装而订购的。我对它们进行了全面测试，情况都非常好，在一场模拟战斗测试中，它们甚至不费吹灰之力就干掉了所有的老式机型。但不久前，这些刚刚离开实验室，投入实战的机器全都不知所踪。这对无限创造集团来说可是个不小的打击啊，想想看，为了制造这些宝贝，我们动用了多少人力物力啊！

失踪前他们正在执行一项特殊任务，攻击巴尔克里克内某一大型自由无人机母巢。当时有超过十二个人类飞行员也参加了行动，但是后来他们竟然全都没了踪影。我不清楚到底发生了什么，有谣传说他们遭到自由无人机母舰的攻击而落败受擒。虽然有些令人难以置信，但是……

失踪事件仅过了几天，加拉摩德就上演了一场悲剧。某个定居点遭到了自由无人机的袭击，彻底被毁。当时对此我没太在意，要知道在这些地方，自由无人机袭击事件并不奇怪，但后来晚间新闻里播送的一则消息让我不寒而栗。这一幕悲剧原来正是由那些失踪的ST战斗无人机一手酿造的。这太不可思议了，但铁铮铮的事实摆在那里，我不知道那是怎么回事，这些自由无人机竟然改装了ST系列的AI芯片，重写了人工智能编码，将他们变成了一群十恶不赦的怪物！必须不惜一切代价阻止这一切！这些机器对我的职业生涯构成了威胁，它们多存在一天，我就多一天不得安宁。你必须得帮我！

很不幸，我安装在他们身上的跟踪装置似乎被停用了。不过，我已追踪到其中的两个，还有一个被当地的民兵摧毁了。我会上传ST 58的位标到你的控制边栏，希望能对你有所帮助，它飘浮在一个充满小行星的死亡空间中。干掉你见到的所有无人机，把ST 58的记忆芯片取回来，这样我就能一查究竟了。

messages.en: You've done me and Boundless Creation a great service, {[character]player.name}, but I have one other drone to recover, so please stick around.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你帮了我和无限创造一个大忙。我还有架无人机要去修下，请等我一会儿。

messages.en: You call that a short version?! You almost put me to sleep with your rambling! I refuse!
messages.zh: 你管那叫简要说明？！你的长篇大论都快让我睡着了！我拒绝！

name.ja: キラードローンの攻撃-ST59（2/3）
name.ru: Атака дронов-убийц - ST 59 (Attack of the Killer Drones - ST 59) (2 из 3)

messages.en: Model ST 59 has somehow ended up in Evati, many jumps from here. It was destroyed by militia forces in the system, and its remains transferred to the Republic Justice Department station there. I made a deal with them to allow me to access the memory chip to investigate the cause of the malfunction, but I couldn't find a convoy heading to Hjoramold in time. Could you fetch it for me ASAP? I have to return it in a couple of weeks, so the faster you get it here, the better.
messages.zh: ST 59不知怎么跑去了伊瓦提，那儿离这里有几个跳跃的距离。它被那个星系的民兵力量摧毁，其残骸已移交给那里的共和国司法部。我已和他们达成协议，允许我使用记忆芯片以调查故障原因，但一时间我找不到前往加拉摩德的护航队。你能尽快帮我取回它吗？我必须在几周后归还芯片，所以你越快拿来越好。

name.es: Ataque de los drones asesinos: ST 60 (3 de 3)
name.fr: Attaque des drones tueurs – ST 60 (3 sur 3)
name.ja: キラードローンの攻撃-ST60（3/3）
name.ru: Атака дронов-убийц - ST 60 (Attack of the Killer Drones - ST 60) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
The last drone memory chip I need you to fetch is ST 60's. The '60 is my finest drone of the ST series, a prototype, and certainly a force to be reckoned with. I think you might have to find some friends to help you take it on ― yes, it's really that tough, if I do say so myself.

It's currently orbiting a rogue drone installation near Hjoramold XII Moon I, located deep within what we call "Glittermore," the xenon gas cloud of Hjoramold XII. It's a very hostile part of space, but a magnificent sight nonetheless and one frequented by tourists. Good luck finding those drones, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
我需要你替我取的最后一个无人机记忆芯片是ST 60的。它是ST系列中最杰出的，还是个原型机，但它的力量绝对不容置疑。我想你可能得找些朋友帮你一起对付它——是的，要我说，它就是那么强大。

它正在加拉摩德XII—卫1附近的一个自由无人机设施周围游荡，那里位于一块我们称为“格里特莫”的加拉摩德XII氙气云的深处。那块空域十分危险，但景色壮丽，故而游客众多。祝你找到那些无人机，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: You've been an enormous help, {[character]player.name}, and I can't thank you enough. Hopefully by disabling those drones, you will have saved me my job at Boundless Creation. Good luck in your future endeavors.
messages.zh: 你帮了我们大忙，{[character]player.name}，我对你感激不尽。希望在你废了那些无人机后，我在无限创造的工作不会丢。祝你一路顺风。

messages.en:
The last drone memory chip I need you to fetch is ST 60's. The '60 is my finest drone of the ST series, a prototype, and certainly a force to be reckoned with. I think you might have to find some friends to help you take it on ― yes, it's really that tough, if I do say so myself.

It's currently orbiting a rogue drone installation near Hjoramold XII Moon I, located deep within what we call "Glittermore," the xenon gas cloud of Hjoramold XII. It's a very hostile part of space, but a magnificent sight nonetheless and one frequented by tourists. Good luck finding those drones, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
我需要你替我取的最后一个无人机记忆芯片是ST 60的。它是ST系列中最杰出的，还是个原型机，但它的力量绝对不容置疑。我想你可能得找些朋友帮你一起对付它——是的，要我说，它就是那么强大。

它正在加拉摩德XII—卫1附近的一个自由无人机设施周围游荡，那里位于一块我们称为“格里特莫”的加拉摩德XII氙气云的深处。那块空域十分危险，但景色壮丽，故而游客众多。祝你找到那些无人机，{[character]player.name}。

name.fr: Le prophète aveugle – Les phalanges (1 sur 4)
name.ru: Слепой провидец - кости (Blind Seer - Bones) (1 из 4)

messages.en: The asteroid belts here, as everywhere, are infested with pirates and murderers. I need you to bring me a few finger bones collected from pirates around the constellation. Yes, finger bones: I need nine for my divination to hold true.
messages.zh: 这里的小行星带像其他地方一样，充斥着海盗和罪犯。我需要你帮我去收集一些本星座周围海盗的指骨。是的，指骨：我需要九根来实现我的一个预言。

messages.en:
Come close, child. I am blind and my cerebro-audial sensors are weak. Still, even so I can sense your inner strength and passion. They match my own. That is good. Very good.

The Ani constellation is a place in turmoil. I can see it as frantic swirl in my mind's eye. This place has become the playground of many great powers, some visible to the eye and some not. Lives are being taken and lives are being thrown away. Right and wrong hold little sway here; anger and hate are the driving forces. This flood of emotions pouring into this melting pot makes it hard for me to perceive the currents of the future. I need to undertake my most potent divinations to pierce this veil of uncertainty and proclaim the great prophecy I feel building within me.

I need your help, {[character]player.name}. That is your name, correct? {[character]player.name}, the asteroid belts here, as everywhere, are infested with pirates and murderers, curs all, worthless dogs who prey on fear and passivity. I need you to bring me a few finger bones collected from pirates around the constellation. Yes, finger bones: I need nine for my divination to hold true.
messages.zh:
走近点，孩子。我是个瞎子，我的听觉传感器官也不灵敏了。不过即使这样，我还是可以感觉到你内在的力量和热情。这就跟我一样。很好。非常好。

安妮星座是个混乱的地方。我能用我的瞎眼看到，它犹如汹涌的漩涡一样。这个地方已经成为许多强大力量的竞技场，这些力量有些是看得见的，有些是看不见的。生命被随意剥夺。这里的正确与错误皆在一念之间；愤怒和仇恨才是驱动力量。感情的洪水倾泻在这熔炉之中，使我很难找出未来的方向。我需要进行我最有效的占卜，以穿破重重迷雾，揭示我体内感受到的伟大预言。

我需要你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。是这名字，对吧？{[character]player.name}，这里的小行星带像其他地方一样，充斥着海盗和罪犯。我需要你帮我去收集一些本星座周围海盗的指骨。是的，指骨：我需要九根来实现我的一个预言。

name.fr: Le prophète aveugle – La prédiction (2 sur 4)
name.ru: Слепой провидец - предсказание (Blind Seer - Divination) (2 из 4)

messages.en: My incantation is complete and my prophecy freed. I have another favor to ask of you, {[character]player.name}. I have a friend not far from here who has access to a public network. If I can get the prophecy to him, he can spread it throughout the Republic as a virus. What I need you to do is smuggle the prophecy virus to my friend. I'm much too well-known a figure to Republic authorities to have a chance of doing this myself.
messages.zh: 我已完成咒语，预言已被释放。我还想请你帮个忙，{[character]player.name}。离这不远有我的一个朋友，他可以使用公众网络。要是你能把我的预言送到他手里，那么他就能把这信息做成病毒，立即传遍整个共和国。我要你做的就是把预言病毒偷运给我的朋友。我的名气在共和国当局太大，不可能亲自做这件事。

messages.en:
My incantation is complete and my prophecy freed. Now I need to get it out to the people. But I'm not a popular man in the Republic. The tribal elders see me as a threat to their precious stability. Yet all I do is tell the truth as I see it. As I see it.

Lethargy has settled upon our government and the Amarrians are exploiting it to their own advantage. I have seen a dusty road filled with blood-covered slaves. Minmatar slaves. Yes, the Empire dreams of conquering us once again; already they have woven a web of deceit and treachery around our mighty Republic. The elders are being deceived and the public lulled. Only my prophecies can make them realize the peril we all are in. A peril that is all too real and all too close. The Empire is building its strength and its hunger is rising.

My words and my works have been banned from Republic space. But my message must be heard or all is lost. So I have another favor to ask of you, {[character]player.name}. I have a friend not far from here who has access to a public network. If I can get the prophecy to him, he can spread it throughout the Republic. Masking my prophecy as a virus is not something I relish, but it must be done. What I need you to do is smuggle the prophecy virus to my friend. I'm much too well-known a figure to Republic authorities to have a chance of doing this myself.
messages.zh:
我已完成咒语，预言已被释放。现在我要将它公布于众。可惜我在共和国内不受欢迎。部落的长者非常看重现在的稳定局面，总将我视为一个挑起事端的人。但在我看来，我所揭露的都是事实和真相。在我看来。

政府变得死气沉沉，而艾玛人就利用这一点来谋求私利。我已看到灰尘漫天中，一条遍布劳工尸体的血路。米玛塔尔劳工。是的，艾玛帝国正梦想着再次征服我们，他们已经在共和国内部到处散布谎言，鼓吹背叛。长者们蒙在鼓里，整个国家都被欺骗。只有我的预言才能使他们意识到我们所处的危险。这一危险不容否认，迫在眉睫。帝国正在堆积他们的实力，野心疯狂地膨胀着。

我的作品和我的言论在共和国区域已经被全面封禁了。但是我的信息必须要传达出去，不然一切都完了。因此我还有另一件事情需要你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。在这儿附近我有一个朋友，他能够进入到共和国网络中。如果我能够把预言带到他那里，他就能把信息散布到整个共和国。把我的预言伪装成病毒并不是什么我乐意做的事情，但目前看来只有这么办才能达成目的。我想让你做的，就是秘密的把我的语言病毒交给我的朋友。我没法亲自去完成这件事，因为在共和国区域内人人都认识我的脸长什么样子了。

name.fr: Le prophète aveugle – Le traumatisme (3 sur 4)
name.ja: 盲目の予言者–トラウマ（3/4）
name.ru: Слепой провидец - травма (Blind Seer - Trauma) (3 из 4)

messages.en: Please help these unfortunate souls by transporting them over to the Servant Sisters of EVE station in Lanngisi, where they can be properly cared for. Meanwhile, I will have my disciples locate this crazed Holder so he can be dealt with before he hurts anyone else.
messages.zh: 请帮我把这些不幸的人们送到朗基斯的姐妹共济会空间站吧，在那他们可以得到适当的援助。同时，我会让我的信仰者查出这个疯狂劳工主的位置，在他伤害更多人前结果他。

messages.en:
My head is still aching from my last divination. I don't think I will be ready for another one for some time now. These old bones of mine are getting tired; I must rest soon. But before I do, you must swear to me you'll take care of an ugly business that came to my attention just now.

It seems an Amarr Holder exiled from the Empire has taken up a residence here in Ani. This particular Holder is notorious for his disgusting depravities. He holds slaves like they were his pets, forcing them to participate in his cruel games. Fortunately, several of these poor slaves managed to escape the evil clutches of their master. They are now in my care, but are in need of more aid than I am capable of giving them.

Please help these unfortunate souls by transporting them over to the Servant Sisters of EVE station in Lanngisi, where they can be properly cared for. Meanwhile, I will have my disciples locate this crazed Holder so he can be dealt with before he hurts anyone else.
messages.zh:
自从上次的预言之后，我的头一直痛到现在。我认为目前不适合再做其它的预言。我这把老骨头经不起这样的折腾，必须马上休息。但在此之前，你必须保证会替我制止一项丑恶的交易，这也是我最近才注意到的。

一个被艾玛帝国放逐的劳工主在安妮居住了下来。这个劳工主有个令人作呕的嗜好，使他名声狼藉。把手下的劳工视为宠物，强迫他们参加他的残酷游戏。幸运的是，有几个可怜的劳工成功地逃脱了他的魔爪。他们现在由我照管，但他们需要更多的帮助，对此我爱莫能助。

请帮我把这些不幸的人们送到朗基斯的姐妹共济会，这样他们能够得到适当的照顾。同时，我会让我的下属找到这个肇事者，我能就能在他干下更多坏事儿之前对付他。

name.de: Blinder Seher - Auge um Auge, Zahn um Zahn (4 von 4)
name.en: Blind Seer - Tit for Tat (4 of 4)
name.es: Vidente ciego: Ojo por ojo (4 de 4)
name.fr: Le prophète aveugle – Le dilemme du prisonnier (4 sur 4)
name.ru: Слепой провидец - око за око (Blind Seer - Tit for Tat) (4 из 4)

messages.en: I managed to track down the depraved Amarr Holder of whom I spoke at our last meeting. He's in the Traun system, visiting a station controlled by some lackeys of the Angel Cartel. He has fitted out an old Bestower as a pleasure ship, so look for a Bestower docked at an Angel station. You should find it in the contested complex in the Traun system. I'm offering you a rare blueprint copy, to be given to you once you take care of this Amarrian.
messages.zh: 我已经追踪到了我们上次说到的那个邪恶的艾玛劳工主。他正在塔拉文星系走访一个由一些天使企业联合体的马屁精控制的空间站。他将一艘旧的恩赐者级工业舰改装成了豪华游船，所以你的目标就是停靠在一座天使空间站旁的恩赐者级。你可以在塔拉文星系争夺中的复合体内找到它。只要你料理了这个艾玛人，那么我就会给你一份稀有的蓝图拷贝。

messages.en: I thank you once again, {[character]player.name}. May Lady Fortünna shine upon you.
messages.zh: 再次感谢你，{[character]player.name}。愿幸运女神永远照耀你。

messages.en:
How good of you to visit me again, {[character]player.name}. I've been awaiting your return for some time now. I managed to track down the depraved Amarr Holder of whom I spoke at our last meeting. He's in the Traun system, visiting a station controlled by some lackeys of the Angel Cartel. I do not know what his business is there, and really I don't care. Whatever it is it will die with him. He has fitted out an old Bestower as a pleasure ship, so look for a Bestower docked at an Angel station. You should find it in the contested complex in the Traun system.

By the way, I was contacted by the Sisters in Lanngisi just before you arrived and they informed me that one of the slaves you brought them is a distant relative of mine. Even though my concern extends to all Minmatars, this makes the matter personal. As such, I'm offering you a rare blueprint copy, to be given to you once you take care of this Amarrian quickly and efficiently. Bring me his head when you're done. Then I can go and rest with my mind at peace.
messages.zh:
你又来了，太好了，{[character]player.name}。我一直在等你回来。我已经追踪到了我们上次说到的那个邪恶的艾玛劳工主。他正在塔拉文星系走访一个由一些天使企业联合体的马屁精控制的空间站。我不知道他在那里的生意是什么，其实我也不在乎。无论是什么，都将陪他下葬。他将一艘旧的恩赐者级工业舰改装成了豪华游船，所以你的目标就是停靠在一座天使空间站旁的恩赐者级。你可以在塔拉文星系争夺中的复合体内找到它。

顺便说一下，就在你来之前朗基斯的姐妹会刚刚联系了我，告诉我你带给她们的劳工中有个人是我的远房亲戚。虽然我

name.ru: Анархия - жгучее желание (Anarchy - Burning Need) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
Did you bring me that Tri-Vitoc I need? No? You're not the guy Tarkur sent out to me? Damn! Where is that guy? I'm starting to think he was waylaid by CONCORD on the way. Friggin' cops! I need that Tri-Vitoc!

Man, what am I gonna do now? Hey! Maybe you're willing to help. Could you scoot over to Eystur for me? My pal Tarkur works in the cargo hangar on a Security Service station there. Lousy job, excellent location. Gets him close to all kinds of good stuff. Got me hooked on that Tri-Vitoc awhile ago, brilliant stuff, highly recommend it... Oh yeah. Now, where was I?

Oh, yes, you. Go to Eystur, bring Tri-Vitoc from Turkur. Bring it to me. It sounds so simple a monkey could do it. So, stop this monkey business and get going! Har, har! Sometimes I kill myself... Mm, Vitoc. Yeah.
messages.zh:
你把我要的三崴砣柯带来了吗？不是？你不是塔尔卡派到我这来的那个人吗？可恶！那个人去哪了？我看八成他在半路中了统合部的埋伏。可恶的条子！我要三崴砣柯！

伙计，我现在该怎么办？嘿！也许你愿意帮帮忙。你能不能帮我跑一趟尤斯塔？我的朋友塔尔卡在那里一座安全服务空间站的货舱机库工作。工作虽然很烂，不过那里地段不错。他在那里很容易接触到各种各样的好东西。不久前我就迷上了他那儿的三崴砣柯，好东西啊，强烈推荐你试试……噢，爽。啊，我说到哪儿了？

噢，对，说到你了。快去尤斯塔，从塔尔卡那带些三崴砣柯到我这儿。这听起来太简单了，一只猴子都能做到。所以就别废话了，赶快行动吧！哈哈！有些时候我都感觉受不了自己了，恩……崴砣柯，哈哈。

name.de: Anarchie - Trautes Heim, Glück allein (2 von 3)
name.ja: アナーキー-安息の我が家（2/3）
name.ru: Анархия - дом, милый дом (Anarchy - Home Sweet Home) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
Good job on the Tri-Vitoc delivery. Ooh, yeah, I feel like a new man. Heck, with the potency of this stuff, I probably am! My DNA's probably all screwed up.

You're a pilot after my own heart, direct and brutal. So perhaps we can work together, what do you say? If you're interested in bringing a bit of mayhem to this uptight world, then follow my lead. I've been out hunting pirates in this constellation; there sure are a lot of them around here these days. Why do I hunt pirates, an inquiring pilot such as yourself might ask? Because they don't belong here, that's why. This is my home sweet home, and those pirates can go play their little bandit games somewhere else. This is my territory. Are you with me? I know you're with me ― if you weren't, you'd be dead.

No, that's just a little joke I make. Don't be alarmed. Heh. Man, this is some good Vitoc.

Uhm... oh, yeah, so some of the pirates around here, particularly those in the contested complexes, are sporting these new ID slices. I've become quite the avid collector of them, and I'm willing to reward you well if you bring me a few. The tags I'm looking for are dropped by tough cruiser pirates, so take care. Ah, what am I saying, it's those pirates that should take care. You're {[character]player.name} the menace! Har, har. I'm joking again, of course. You know I am.
messages.zh:
三崴砣柯的任务完成得不错，我现在感觉棒极了。哈，那玩意后劲真强，我现在还有点飘飘欲仙。嘻，你很合我意啊，行事勇猛。也许我们能在一起工作，你说呢？

如果你有意给这个忙碌的世界添一点乱的话，那就和我一起干吧。我一直在这个星系外围追捕海盗，这些日子里总有不少想发横财的家伙。你也许会问，为什么我要追捕海盗？很简单，他们不属于这儿。这是我的家，甜蜜的家，想玩强盗游戏大可以去其他地方玩儿，这是我的地盘！你会站在我这边吗？啊，你当然会，如果不，我就要你的命。

不，只是开个玩笑。别紧张。

在附近一些争夺中的复合体内，有些海盗正到处炫耀着他们的新式ID牌。我的嗜好是收集ID牌，如果你能搞些回来给我，报酬一定让你满意。我要的ID牌在驾驶巡洋舰的海盗那能找到，所以小心点。啊，我在说什么呢，该小心的是那些海盗。你是{[character]player.name}，不是泛泛之辈。哈哈，当然我在开玩笑。你知道的。

name.ja: アナーキー-良心の喪失（3/3）
name.ru: Анархия - потеря невинности (Anarchy - Innocence Lost) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
Well done on that tag-collecting business. These Sniper ID slices now hold a place of honor in my collection. That blood splatter on one of them, man, that was pure genius! Makes it so deliciously eerie! I feel like we're really bonding here, uh... what´s your... oh, yeah, {[character]agentID.name}. No, wait, that´s me. Ehh, {[character]player.name}, right? This might be the beginning of something beautiful, I tell you.

I have a bit of skill in forgery myself, so I altered them a bit to make them look like imperial orders instructing the bearer to head to a certain location here in Ani for colonization purposes. These Amarrians are always looking to expand, so it's easy to bait a group of wannabee colonists into thinking they have in their hands official permission to settle here. As if the Empire had any say in who settles here and who not? Bah, the fools!

Needless to say, the location here in Ani is in the middle of nowhere; just some old rogue drone hive long since cleaned out. I've already taken out several settlers in the past myself, but with you and me getting on so well, I thought I'd give you a shot at it.

It's nasty business, I can tell you, killing innocent Amarr civilians in cold blood when they're only looking for a place to call home. But I know you have the stomach for it. After all, how innocent can they be, with the blood of my ancestors on their hands? Kill them all, and good riddance to them is what I say. Spit in their eye as they die, mother, father, child and all. Show me you got the guts and I'll reward you with a rare BPC.

Oh, one more thing. Bring the forged documents back to me. This little trap is too sweet not to spring a few more times before they get suspicious.

name.fr: Recensement de l'Urban Management – Civil en sécurité (1 sur 3)
name.ja: アーバンマネジメントの国勢調査―囚われた調査員（1/3）
name.ko: 어반 매니지먼트 사의 인구조사 - 감금된 시민 (1/3)
name.ru: Перепись Urban Management - гражданские в беде (Urban Management's Census - Civilian In Custody) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 市政管理局的人口普查—陷入重围 (1/3)

messages.en: Yea, I'm lookin' for work.  What you got?
messages.zh: 对，我在找工作。你有什么？

messages.en:
I am in charge of Urban Management's annual census gathering operation here in Hjoramold. My team flies between settlements in every corner of the system and gathers information on the population count. Then we process this information and finally send it to our headquarters in Abudban along with our report.

Sounds like a pretty simple and straight forward job, eh? And in the more civilized areas of Republic space, it is. But out here you never know what can happen. Every year some disaster strikes, and this year is no exception.

Two of my team have gone missing in addition to one getting stranded in an asteroid belt on her way back, due to her ship breaking down. Needless to say, I need some help getting them back.

First I'd like you to go looking for Kardimo Palettan, one of the workers who went missing. He's my cousin twice removed, and we've known each other since we were kids. I would be terribly unhappy if something has happened to him.

He was on duty near Hjoramold X, collecting census data from some of the bio-dome settlements on the moons there, when he was beset by local thugs. We have a very strict policy here in Urban Management to stay well clear of all pirate infested areas, so we weren't expecting this. Seems one of the local gangs, calling themselves the 'Maru Rebels', thought Kardimo was trespassing on their territory and decided to punish him. I just hope he's still alive. I suggest you scour the area around Hjoramold X's moons, hopefully the Maru will have a base there somewhere. If you find him or any clues leading to him, then return to me for your reward.
messages.zh:
我负责市政管理局的年度人口普查，主要统计在加摩拉德工作的人口信息。我的队伍穿梭于星系的每个角落，收集人口信息。之后我们对这些信息进行处理并最终和我们的报告一起提交给阿布德班的总部。

这工作听起来很简单，是吧？在国内的文明区域的确如此；但在其他地方就难说了。每年多少都有意外发生，今年也不例外。

我们有两支队伍失踪，还有一支由于飞船故障在返回途中搁浅在小行星带上。毋庸质疑，需要有人把他们找回来。

首先，我希望你去找一个失踪的工作人员，他名叫卡迪莫•帕勒丹，是我的远房亲戚，我俩从小就互相熟识。我可不想他遭受任何不幸。

被当地暴徒围攻时，他正在加摩拉德Ⅹ附近当班，从卫星上一些生物技术园区收集普查数据。我们在城市管理上非常严格，从来不和海盗有任何瓜葛，因而谁都没料到会发生这样的事。据我推测，当地一个自称是“马鲁叛军”的团伙认为卡迪莫正在侵入他们的领土，因此决定惩罚他一下。希望那个可怜人还活着。建议你巡视一下加拉摩德Ⅹ卫星附近的区域，马鲁应该在那儿有基地。如果你找到他本人，或是和他有关的线索，回来告诉我并领取你的报酬。

messages.en: Seeing Kardimo alive again brings tears to my eyes.  You've done me a great service, {[character]player.name}, but there's still more to be done.  Two other members of my crew still need to be rescued before I can complete my report.
messages.zh: 看到卡迪莫还活着，我喜极而泣了。你为我做了一件大事，{[character]player.name}，但还有些事要做。我的另两个员工也要救出来，然后我才能完成我的报告。

messages.en: Look for a 'Maru Prison Facility' near Hjoramold X's moons, and rescue Kardimo Palettan.
messages.zh: 寻找加拉摩德X附近的卫星，一个叫做“马鲁牢狱”的地方，营救卡迪莫·帕勒丹。

name.ko: 어반 매니지먼트 사의 인구조사 - 함정에 빠지다 (2/3)
name.ru: Перепись Urban Management - в ловушке (Urban Management's Census - Trapped) (2 из 3)
name.zh: 市政管理局的人口普查—身陷困境 (2/3)

messages.en:
The other census worker who's having problems is currently stranded on Hjoramold XIII due to an unexpected rogue drone attack. Those drones seem to be randomly attacking all travelers going to and from the planet. The pilots are so scared Kyra, the census taker, can't even find a single one to transport her off XIII. I'd like you to eliminate this threat ASAP so that Kyra can finally get her ass back to base. Republic security forces are taking too damn long to get the job done.

The only thing I need you to do is destroy the Searcher Drone. That will render the drone squad unable to scan all areas around the planet and should allow travelers safe passage as long as they avoid the dust cloud the buggers have been hiding in.
messages.zh:
另一个遇到麻烦的普查人员由于遭到自由无人机的突袭，现正被困于加拉摩德XIII。那些无人机肆意攻击所有来往那个行星的人。飞行员都被这些无人机吓坏了，没人敢带普查员卡娅离开XIII。我希望你尽快化解这一威胁，使卡娅能返回基地。共和国安全部队办这事的速度真慢。

我要你做的就是消灭搜索无人机。这会让整个无人机群失去扫描星球周围的能力，这样往来旅客只要避开这些混蛋藏身的气云，就可以安全通行了。

messages.en: Another job well done, {[character]player.name}.  You've certainly earned your keep.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 又干得这么漂亮，{[character]player.name}。你当然赚得了你的收入。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

Those drones seem to be randomly attacking all travelers going to and from the planet. The pilots are so scared Kyra, the census taker, can't even find a single one to transport her off XIII. I'd like you to eliminate this threat ASAP so that Kyra can finally get her ass back to base. Republic security forces are taking too damn long to get the job done.

The only thing I need you to do is destroy the Searcher Drone. That will render the drone squad unable to scan all areas around the planet and should allow travelers safe passage as long as they avoid the dust cloud the buggers have been hiding in.
messages.zh:
另一个遇到麻烦的普查人员现正被困于加拉摩德XIII，一群自由无人机正在那儿肆虐，随意攻击来往于星球的人。所有的飞行员都吓坏了，无人敢带普查员卡娅离开XIII。我要你尽快解决此事，让卡娅安全回来。等共和国安全部队介入就太慢了。

我要你做的唯一一件事就是消灭搜索无人机，这会让整个机群失去扫描星球附近区域的能力，使他们的威胁范围缩小到自己的基地附近。这样往来旅客又能自由通行了。

name.es: Census de Gestión Urbanística: Varado (3 de 3)
name.fr: Recensement de l'Urban Management - Échouée (3 sur 3)
name.ja: アーバンマネジメントの国勢調査―取り残された調査員（3/3）
name.ru: Перепись населения - севшая на мель (Urban Management's Census - Stranded) (3 из 3)
name.zh: 市政管理局的人口普查 - 束手无策(3/3)

messages.en:
The last issue I need you to deal with is our stranded census worker, Yttora Lyn. She was sent into the infamous 'Gas Storm' of Hjoramold, which is really a massive gas cloud that orbits Hjoramold's star. Her objective was to take census of the populace in an asteroid colony located deep inside that hostile territory, a pretty dangerous task considering various pirate groups tend to use the area as a hideout. Not to mention it's been infested with rogue drones for years.

The last transmission I received from her was a call for help. Her ship apparently broke down not far from the colony, and as a result she's stranded there for at least a week, when the next convoy arrives. I'd like you to get her out of there ASAP, {[character]player.name}, we can't just leave her there with the psychopaths inhabiting that colony for a week!

If you're careful, you will be able to avoid contact with the pirates. But I warn you, the acceleration gates in the Gas Storm are old and crude and have drifted quite far from the beacons originally placed next to them. Due to the lack of interest in the area, nothing has been done to rectify the situation. So I suggest you head out there on a pretty fast ship, if you want to stay sane that is heh heh.
messages.zh:
要你去办的最后一件事有关托拉•琳，这位被困的人口普查员被派往加拉摩德里声名狼藉的“气体风暴”执行任务，那儿实际上是一团厚厚的气云，环绕在加拉摩德的恒星周围。她的使命就是深入到这团气云深处的某个小行星殖民地，进行人口普查。那里是众多海盗集团的藏身处，也是多年来自由无人机的滋生地，所以这个任务极其危险。

我最后一次收到的讯息是她的求救信号。显然她的飞船在离殖民地不远的地方出了故障，到下一支护航队到达前，她至少会被困一周。我要你尽快把她从那里解救出来，{[character]player.name}，我们不能让她和那儿的那些疯子在一起呆上一个礼拜！

如果你够小心的话，就可以避免与海盗交火。但我得提醒你，气体风暴老掉牙的加速轨道远远偏离了原来的位置。由于这个区域并不瞩目，所以一直以来没有人去修理。要是不想看自己的飞船慢慢爬行于死亡空间之中，建议你选择一艘比较快速的船去，呵呵！

messages.en: I'm sorry to see that Yttora didn't make it out alive.  She was one of my favorite subordinates, always joyful and energetic.  She was also always available for the risky missions, and I guess her luck finally ran out.  A sad day indeed, {[character]player.name}, but at least now we know what happened to her.
messages.zh: 很遗憾托拉没能活下来。她是我最得意的部下，总是乐观向上、精力充沛。她还经常执行危险的任务，我想这次她的好运到头了。真是伤感的一天，{[character]player.name}，不过现在至少我们知道她身上发生了什么事。

要你去办的最后一件事有关托拉•琳，这位被困的人口普查员被派往加拉摩德里声名狼藉的“气体风暴”执行任务，那儿实际上是一团厚厚的气云，环绕在加拉摩德的恒星周围。她的使命就是深入到这团气云深处的某个小行星殖民地，进行人口普查。那里是众多海盗集团的藏身处，也是多年来自由无人机的滋生地，所以这个任务极其危险。

我最后一次收到的讯息是她的求救信号。显然她的飞船在离殖民地不远的地方出了故障，到下一支护航队到达前，她至少会被困一周。我要你尽快把她从那里解救出来，{[character]player.name}，我们不能让她和那儿的那些疯子在一起呆上一个礼拜！

如果你够小心的话，就可以避免与海盗交火。但我得提醒你，气体风暴老掉牙的加速轨道远远偏离了原来的位置。由于这个区域并不瞩目，所以一直以来没有人去修理。要是不想看自己的飞船慢慢爬行于死亡空间之中，建议你选择一艘比较快速的船去，呵呵！

messages.en:
As you may know, Ihakana and the surrounding systems are completely infested by Gurista pirates. In my work for Internal Security in this system, I've had a number of deputies under me, every single one of whom has fallen prey to these dirty dogs. Fiderer, my last deputy, was a particularly good lad, and I hated to see him go down to those bastards.

I'm always on the lookout for people who know their way around a fight. If you're interested, I can deputize you: Plenty of work to be done around here.

If you feel like proving your mettle, there's a small Gurista forward base in this area that's been no end of trouble for quite a while now. It's not a large outpost as outposts go, but according to our intelligence it plays host to some very powerful Gurista cronies, people not to be trifled with. If you can go in there and eliminate the Gurista force, I'd be much obliged. I'd also be likely to have more work for you.
messages.zh:
你也许知道，以哈坎拿和周围星系是古斯塔斯海盗滋生蔓延的场所。我在这儿的内部安全局工作时，雇佣了许多副手，可是他们全都成了这些肮脏畜生的枪下冤魂。我的最后一个副手，菲德尔是个非常棒的小伙子，真不愿相信他毁在了那些混蛋手上。

我总是注视着在战斗中随机应变的飞行员的表现。如果你有兴趣，我可以委任你：这里有很多工作要做。

如果你想证明你的勇气，这个地区有个小型古斯塔斯前线基地，已经没完没了地骚扰我们好一阵子了。它并不像一般的哨站那么大，不过我们的情报显示，它招待的是一些非常有权势的古斯塔斯成员，都是些不能开玩笑的任务。如果你能去那儿把那些古斯塔斯部队都干掉，我会非常感激的，也会给你安排更多的工作。

messages.en:
Okay, listen up. I have some more Gurista butt for you to kick. Yeah, I thought you'd be happy.

There's another outpost in one of the outlying systems where the Guristas have a nice little drug lab going. This is a slightly bigger target than the last one we hired you to take out, so expect more opposition. Break through their defenses, destroy the outpost's storage silo, and get back to me for your reward.

Get to it, deputy.
messages.zh:
好，听我说。你还要帮我搞定一些古斯塔斯饭桶。对，我觉得你会很高兴。

在一个遥远的星系中，有个古斯塔斯哨站，他们在那里进行小规模违规药品实验。这次的目标比我们雇你做的上一个目标稍微大些，所以准备好迎击更多敌人吧。突破他们的防线，摧毁哨站的储藏库，然后回来领赏。

去吧，我的委托人。

name.fr: AVIS DE RECHERCHE ! – En fuite (1 sur 4)

messages.en: Uhm, ok.  Well, I'm here looking for something interesting to do ...
messages.zh: 哦，好的。我到这里看看有什么有趣的事情可以做……

messages.en:
I'm in a bit of a hard spot at the moment. I work for the Minmatar Freedom Fighters on the side, and a few days ago I was conducting a daring mission in Hjoramold, where I hacked into the Joint Harvesting station's mainframe and planted some grade-A Black Ice. Unfortunately the mainframe sported some grade-AAA watchdogs, which promptly alerted the station authorities to what I was up to. And they complained to the Republic security forces which have launched a formal investigation.

Joint Harvesting may be very unpopular amongst the public, but the government won't risk their multi-billion ISK deal to save my ass, I'm sure of it. I'm afraid there will be a lengthy jail term waiting for me if I turn myself in, so I've decided to go into hiding till this blows over. But hiding in Hjoramold is not easy, especially since Joint Harvesting have decided to send hired mercenaries after me.

So I gotta find a way to leave this system without being spotted by the local security forces or Joint Harvesting's people. So your first job is to find me a cloaking device. And you're in luck, I know of a rogue drone that carries such a device. It's not compatible with most standard ships, but I'm confident I can modify it to work. It's worth a try at least.

Look for a 'searcher drone'. The last I heard it was spotted near one of Hjoramold's outermost planets.
messages.zh: 目前我处境艰难。我为米玛塔尔自由战士做些兼职，几天前，我在加拉摩德执行一项危险任务，我侵入了联合收割空间站的主机，并且植入了一个A级的黑冰病毒。不幸的是，他们的主机向我炫耀了它的AAA级看门狗软件，空间站高层立刻接到了侵入警报。  他们向共和国安全部队投诉，后者已展开正式调查。<br><br>联合收割集团或许并不受公众欢迎，但政府绝对不会为了我的烂命而拿价值数十亿的交易冒险。要是去自首，恐怕我得在牢狱里待很长时间，所以我决定先藏起来避避风头。但在加拉摩德藏身并不容易，尤其现在联合收割已经派出雇佣兵四处追捕我。<br><br>所以我必须想出一个逃离这个星系的最佳方案，不能被本地安全部队或是联合收割的人发现。因此你的第一个任务是给我找个隐形装置。你运气不错，我刚好知道有种无人机携带着这样一个装置。它虽然与多数标准型号的舰船都不兼容，但我相信自己能把它改装过来。至少值得试试。<br><br>去找一架“搜索无人机”。据我所知，这家伙最近一次出现在加拉摩德最外围的行星附近。

messages.en: I see it's damaged.  Must have happened when you destroyed the drone.  We'll see if I can fix it up.  In the meantime though, I have more work for you.
messages.zh: 我发现它受损了。一定是你摧毁无人机时发生的。让我们看看我能不能修好它。不过同时，我还有任务给你。

name.fr: Adjoint – Le vaisseau de combat (4 sur 4)
name.ru: Помощник - артиллерийский корабль (Deputy - The Gunship) (4 из 4)

messages.en:
Deputy, we have a problem. The Guristas have brought in a special operative, rumored to be the cousin of Korako "The Rabbit" Korakami. His name is Choiji, and he's known throughout this area for his fearsome prowess in battleship combat.

Now, we're not certain what exactly it is he's doing here, but we're not going to wait to find out. Internal Security High Command has given the go-ahead for us to eliminate him, and I'm giving the job to you. I've uploaded the coordinates of his hideout to your Neocom. Be careful - he has two fanatically devoted bodyguards who won't take kindly to your attempt to kill their master.

Good luck.
messages.zh:
委托人，我们遇到了个问题。古斯塔斯吸收了一个特殊的间谍，传言是“野兔”克拉克·卡萨加米的表兄弟。他叫乔基，在这个地区以可怕的战列舰战斗力著称。

现在我们不能确定他到底在这里做什么，但是我们没时间调查了。内部安全局最高指挥部已允许我们消灭他，我把这个任务交给你。我已将他藏身处的坐标上传到你的控制边栏里。小心点——他有两个忠心耿耿的保镖，他们对你的行为不会不闻不问的。

祝你好运。

messages.en:
You've done us all a great service. Take this shield booster blueprint copy - our own design, no matter what anyone tells ya - and make yourself some cash... or fly around with the best damn booster this side of the nearest Gist complex.

In any case, Internal Security thanks you for your service, deputy. It's been a pleasure.
messages.zh:
你为我们大家做出了很大贡献。拿上这个我们自己设计的护盾回充增量器蓝图拷贝，不管别人怎么告诉你，你可以卖点钱……或者开着这个吉斯特复合体这里最强的增效器飞行。

无论如何，内部安全局都感谢你的协助，委托人。真是高兴。

messages.en:
I have a report here on my desk stating that the Guristas have been training a special frigate wing for hit-and-run operations in the vicinities of Ihakana and Friggi. Intelligence has given us the location of one of the training bases for this frigate wing, and we intend to put a dent in this little scheme of theirs.

I need you to go out to the next system, where the base is, kill the detachment of frigates being trained there, and destroy their training bunkers. Beware: The instructors are accomplished pilots, and there may be a battleship or two guarding the facilities. Go in with caution. Good luck.
messages.zh:
我桌上的报告显示，为在以哈坎拿和弗瑞吉周边地带实行游击战术，古斯塔斯一直在训练一支特种护卫联队。情报中给出了这支护卫联队其中一个训练基地的位置，我们打算给他们的阴谋制造点阻力。

我需要你去邻近星系中他们的基地，干掉正在那里训练的护卫舰分队，并摧毁他们的训练掩体。小心：那些教员都是技能娴熟的飞行员，而且那里可能会有一两艘战列舰守卫着那些设施。千万要谨慎行事。祝你好运。

name.en: WANTED! - The ID Card Generator (2 of 4)
name.es: ¡SE BUSCA!: El generador de tarjetas de identificación (2 de 4)
name.fr: AVIS DE RECHERCHE ! – Le générateur de carte d'identité (2 sur 4)
name.ru: РАЗЫСКИВАЕТСЯ! - генератор идентификационных карт (WANTED! - The ID Card Generator) (2 из 4)

messages.en:
The second thing I need you to do is get me an ID Card Generator. I need a fake ID Card where I'm going, and getting one ain't easy. Despite my skills, I haven't been able to make a generator that works, believe me I've tried. But I know a person who knows a person who has a friend who has one ... get my drift? The name of this person is Ketta Tommin, and she is one of Maru's commanders. The Maru are a really bad lot, pretending to fight for the same cause as us Freedom Fighters but in reality they're nothing but criminals.

Anyway, this Ketta is rumored to have an ID Card Generator, but you'll probably have to kill her to acquire it. She resides in a deadspace pocket within Hjoramold, and the entrance to her lair is inside one of the asteroid belts near here. Check each of the main asteroid belts in Hjoramold, you should find it somewhere around there. Just don't go unprepared, she's a tough little cookie.
messages.zh:
我要你做的第二件事是帮我弄个ID卡生成器。我需要随身带个伪造的ID卡才能动身，不过要弄一个来并不容易。尽管我技术精湛，但还是造不出一个可以以假乱真的生成器，我真的是竭尽所能了。不过我认识一个人，他认识一个人，那个人有个朋友，这个朋友有这么一个……明白我的意思了吗？这个人叫戈塔·多明，是个马鲁指挥官。马鲁都是一群坏蛋，表面上他们与我们自由战士一样，为着共同的理想而战，而骨子里他们都是彻头彻尾的恶棍。

不管怎样，据说这个戈塔有一个ID卡生成器，但你可能得干掉她才能拿到。她住在加拉摩德的一个死亡空间层里，而她老窝的入口就在这儿附近的某个小行星带里。搜查一下加拉摩德的几个主要的小行星带，你会在那儿的某处找到这个入口。出发前做好准备，她可非常难缠。

messages.en: She put up quite a fight didn't she, {[character]player.name}?  I'm surprised you made it back here in one piece.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 她顽强抵抗了，是吗，{[character]player.name}？你居然毫发无损地回来了，真让我吃惊。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！
