name.ja: 盗まれた情報を回収せよ

messages.en: I'll have the problem solved in no time.
messages.zh: 我会立刻解决这个问题。

messages.en: Great.  Just try to hurry over there, you never know when they might move the reports.
messages.zh: 很好。赶快去吧，谁知道什么时候那些报告就会被转移。

messages.en: Agents from the Angel Cartel managed to infiltrate one of our stations and gather information about the station's defenses. They've planted the reports out in space near an ancient abandoned stargate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to be picked up. Fortunately, we managed to intercept their transmission and know the location. I want you to travel to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and pick up the stolen reports. I'll give you {[numeric]rewardQuantity} ISK as a reward. Be careful, there will definitely be guards at the pickup place which you might have to deal with.
messages.zh: 来自天使企业联合体的间谍潜入我们的一个空间站，并收集了该站的防御信息。他们把这些待取的报告安放在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}里一个废弃的古老星门附近。值得庆幸的是，我们截获了他们的传送信息，得知了具体地点。我要你前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，取回那些被盗的报告。我会给你{[numeric]rewardQuantity} 星币作为酬劳。不过要小心，你可能得应付取货地点的那些守卫。

name.en: Caldari Incursion - Rogue Brigand Attack (1 of 3)
name.es: Incursión caldari: Ataque de forajidos rebeldes (1 de 3)
name.fr: Incursion Caldari – Attaque des renégats (1 sur 3)
name.ja: カルダリインカージョン - -盗賊の襲撃（1/3）
name.ru: Вторжение Caldari - атака коварных разбойников (Caldari Incursion - Rogue Brigand Attack) (1 из 3)

messages.en: I'm interested in working for the Sukuuvestaa. Let me hear what you have to offer.
messages.zh: 我对为斯库维塔工作很感兴趣。让我听听你打算提供什么任务。

messages.en: Excellent! For your first assignment, I want you to take care of a few pesky Minmatar brigands who've decided to sabotage one of our reconnaissance missions to Nakugard VIII's moons. These Minmatar belong to an unknown organization that opposes Caldari influence in Minmatar space. This attack was probably meant to scare us off.... Quite laughable. A few cutthroats won't prevent us from building a multi-million ISK station in Ani!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！你的第一个任务是，料理几个讨厌的米玛塔尔歹徒，他们蓄意破坏了我们对纳库加德VIII卫星的一次侦察任务。这些米玛塔尔人隶属于一个不知名的组织，专门抵抗米玛塔尔空间内的加达里势力。这次的袭击很可能是想把我们吓跑……真是很可笑。区区几个清道夫怎么可能阻止我们斥巨资在安妮建立空间站的宏伟计划！

messages.en: Find and destroy the Minmatar Brigands in one of Nakugard VIII's asteroid belts; loot their Punk ID Slices and bring them back to Mitsu Hekken. Note that you are not guaranteed to find all the ID Slices you need in one run.
messages.zh: 搜寻并消灭纳库加德Ⅷ的一个小行星带中的米玛塔尔歹徒，收集他们的朋克ID牌并将其带给米促•伊肯。注意，你一次未必能够找到全部的ID牌。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 击毁目标

messages.en:
Excellent! I'm glad you decided to work for us, {[character]player.name}. We're always happy to employ skilled capsuleers like yourself. Now, as for your first assignment, I want you to take care of a few pesky Minmatar brigands who've decided to sabotage one of our reconnaissance missions to Nakugard VIII's moons. These Minmatar belong to an unknown organization that opposes Caldari influence in Minmatar space. This attack was probably meant to scare us off.... Quite laughable. A few cutthroats won't prevent us from building a multi-million ISK station in Ani!

Anyway, your assignment is simple. Find them near Nakugard VIII: I believe they are lurking near one of its asteroid belts. Once you have found them, destroy them and bring me evidence of their demise. I'll put together a substantial reward when the task is done.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮！很高兴你决心为我们工作了，{[character]player.name}。我们总是乐于雇佣你这样技能娴熟的飞行员。现在你的第一个任务是，料理几个讨厌的米玛塔尔歹徒，他们蓄意破坏了我们对纳库加德VIII卫星的一次侦察任务。这些米玛塔尔人隶属于一个不知名的组织，专门抵抗米玛塔尔空间内的加达里势力。这次的袭击很可能是想把我们吓跑……真是很可笑。区区几个清道夫怎么可能阻止我们斥巨资在安妮建立空间站的宏伟计划！

不管怎样，你的任务很简单。在纳库加德VIII附近找到他们：我相信他们正潜伏在其中一个小行星带附近。你一发现他们，就给我干掉他们并带回他们死亡的证据。任务结束后，我会一并给你一笔可观的酬劳的。

name.en: Caldari Incursion - The Missing Logs (2 of 3)
name.es: Incursión caldari: Los registros perdidos (2 de 3)
name.fr: Incursion Caldari – Enregistrements numériques perdus (2 sur 3)
name.ja: カルダリインカージョン - 失われたログ（2/3）
name.ru: Вторжение Caldari - пропавшие записи (Caldari Incursion - The Missing Logs) (2 из 3)
name.zh: 加达里入侵—遗失的日志 (2/3)

messages.en: I'll find the missing digital recordings for you, {[character]agentID.name}, you can count on it.
messages.zh: 我会为你找到那些遗失的数码记录的，{[character]agentID.name}，你就放心吧。

messages.en:
Since you did so well in your previous assignment, here's another mission for you. Each of our scouts conducting reconnaissance missions keeps a digital recording of what transpires during their expedition, stored in a secret compartment within some cargo crates they're carrying on board. A few of the teams we recently sent out went missing, and we're hoping the recordings survived and are being kept by whoever attacked them (if that's in fact what happened).

I'd like you to scour the asteroid belts in the Ani constellation in search of these logs. Assuming pirates are at the root of this problem, they might still have the cargo crates on board that hold the recordings, likely quite unknown to them, of course. We've lost dozens of ships, but all I ask for you to receover five of their logs. I don't care where you find them; I just need that evidence brought to me ASAP so I have something to bring back to my superiors when they launch a formal investigation.
messages.zh: 鉴于你上次任务中的出色表现，我给你安排了另一个任务。我们的每个侦察员在执行任务时都会对途中发生的事情进行数码记录，并将其存放在随船货柜舱的秘密隔层里。最近我们派出的一些队伍失踪了，我们只希望记录还完好地保存在那些袭击者手里（如果真是发生了袭击）。<br><br>我希望你去安妮星座的小行星带寻找这些日志。假设确实是海盗干的，那么装有记录的货柜舱可能还在他们船上，当然他们很可能不知道里面有数码记录。我们损失了很多飞船，但我要你做的只是取回其中五份日志。不管你去哪里找；我只是要你尽快把那些证物带回来，这样在上级进行正式调查时我就能提供一些材料了。

messages.en:
Good day to you. I was sent out here to this constellation to compile a comprehensive dossier about the political situation. The recipient of the dossier is none of your business. I must admit I underestimated the difficulty of this mission. After all, how much can be going on in a remote, unimportant constellation such as this? But the political situation here is in a constant motion. It seems lot of people are taking a sudden interest in this place.

Fortunately, I have found a solution to my problems here. The Angel Cartel has a strong presence here in Ani and they are even more anxious than I am to keep a tab on the goings on here. What I need to do is get my hands on some of the information they've collected. Then, finishing my report should be a breeze. Or that's what I hope, at least. The constant fluctuations in the political climate makes me fear my task here will be endless. Just remember to fit your Relic Analyzer into your ship before you head out.
messages.zh:
你好。我被派到这个星系来编辑一份关于政治形势的综合档案。档案的取阅人你没必要知道。必须承认，我低估了这个任务的难度。毕竟，在这样一个无足轻重的偏远星系能有什么事发生呢？但这里的政治形势却变化万千。似乎有很多人突然对这个地方产生了兴趣。

所幸，我找到了一个解决问题的方法。天使企业联合体在安妮声势浩大，他们甚至比我更为关注这里平日所发生的一切。我要做的就是搞到一些他们搜集到的情报。那样，完成我的报告就是小菜一碟了。至少我希望如此。这里跌宕起伏的政治形势让我担心，我害怕在这的任务会永无终结。记住！在出发前把遗迹分析仪装上你的飞船。

messages.en:
Hiya there. I don't know if you've visited the contested complex here in Traun. If you haven't let me warn you, it can be real tough for someone of my stature. But the Angel Cartel is operating a listening outpost there that collects all kind of interesting data from around the system. And with all the factions that are converging here in Traun, they got info on more or less every major player operating in Ani. That info can yield sizeable income, but only while it's fresh.

Me, I'm too weak to have any chance of entering the outpost and collect anything of value. But perhaps you're up to the job? As long as you have the skill and equipment to hack their databanks, of course.
messages.zh:
你好啊，伙计。我不知道你是否去过塔拉文争夺中的复合体。如果还没有的话，我告诫你，对于我这样的人来说，那真是够受的。天使企业联合体在那儿有一个监听岗哨，用以收集星系周围各种各样的有趣数据。由于各种势力都聚集在塔拉文，天使获取了在安妮活动的所有主要集团的信息，只是多少有所不同而已。那些信息有时候能带来可观的收入，当然我指的是刚出炉的信息。

我战斗力太弱，不可能进入岗哨去搜集一些有价值的东西。或许你能胜任这工作？当然了，你必须要有适当的技术和装备才能侵入他们的数据库。

messages.zh:
你好。我不知道你是否进入过塔拉文竞争中的复合体。如果还没有的话，我警告你，对于和我一样不擅长战斗的人来说，那真是够受的。天使企业联合体在那儿有一个监听岗哨，用以收集星系周围各种各样的有趣信息。由于所有的势力都聚集在塔拉文，天使总能或多或少地获取在安妮活动的主要集团的有关信息。那些信息有时候能带来可观的收入，当然我指的是最新的信息。

我不够强大，不可能再进入岗哨里搜集那些有价值的信息了。或许你能做到？当然了，你必须要有不错的技术和合适的装备才有望侵入他们的数据库。

messages.en:
Well, well, here I sit in need of a bit of help and then you come along. Must be karma, or something. I'm a long time user and abuser of every illegal substance known to man, but now I'm looking to get proactive instead of always being reactive. You follow? Ok, you look a little clueless, so let me spell it out for you. I want to manufacture the stuff myself, ok?

It all sounds sunny up to this point, right? Yeah, well, there's one snag. I haven't the faintest idea of how to go about producing anything more complex than a boiled egg. But I've got an idea. The Angel Cartel has a strong presence here in Ani and they are bound to sit on some pretty neat recipes, me thinks. So here's what I want you to do for me. Enter one of the contested complexes around the constellation, locate an Angel data fortress and hack into it. Then get back here and give me what you find. Sooner or later something of interest must turn up. I recommend the complex over in Traun, it's your best bet of finding the stuff I'm looking for.

Oh, needless to say, you have to possess some minimal knowledge of hacking to have any chance of success.
messages.zh:
不错，不错，我正需要帮助的时候你就来了。这可能就叫缘份吧。长久以来我一直使用甚至滥用人类已知的所有非法物质，但现在我要变被动为主动。你明白吗？好吧，你看起来有点摸不着头脑，让我给你说明一下吧。我要自己制造这类东西，懂了吗？

到现在为止，一切都听起来充满希望，对吧？不过，还有一个障碍。我压根不知道如何生产比煮鸡蛋更复杂的东西。但我有了个主意。天使企业联合体在安妮势力强大，我想他们一定拥有一些非常棒的配方。我要你做的就是，进入星座内一个争夺中的复合体，找到一个天使数据要塞并侵入。然后回到这里，把你找到的东西给我。迟早会有些有趣的东西浮出水面的。 建议你去塔拉文的复合体，在那里最有可能找到我要的东西。

噢，当然，你必须掌握一些基本的计算机破译原理才有机会成功。

messages.en:
Are you proficient hacker? If you are I have need for your talents. The Sisters of EVE are conducting some very secretive research here in Ani and my master sent me out here to find out what it is. I'm already engaged in breaking into the Sister's mainframe, but it's proving to be troublesome. My master is getting restless and wants to start see some result. So I figured I could buy myself some time by sending him some interesting tidbits from around the constellation, preferably ones that have something to do with the Sisters.

I know that the Angels are actively gathering information themselves, so perhaps they're sitting on something of value to me and my master. I'll pay you a bit of money if you collect some tidbits for me. The Angels operate a listening outpost in a complex over in Traun. Head over there and snoop around. If you have the skills for it, that is.
messages.zh:
你精通破译吗？如果是的话，我正需要你的才能。姐妹会正在安妮进行一项非常秘密的研究，我的主人派我来查明这项研究的具体内容。我已经着手入侵姐妹会的主机，却发现这件事相当棘手。我的主人已经失去耐性，非常想看到些结果。所以我想，不如先从星座各地搜集些珍奇的信息给他，这样能给我争取些时间，而且那些信息最好是和姐妹会有关的。

我知道天使企业联合体正在积极收集情报，他们手头可能有一些对我和我的主人有价值的东西。如果你能为我搜集些珍奇信息，我会付你点钱。天使在塔拉文的一个复合体内有座监听哨站。去那里转转，获取些情报。当然，前提是你要有必需的技能。

messages.en:
Some weeks ago I was in a sleazy space bar over in Hek when I overheard a conversation between couple of Thukkers. One of them had this really incredibly story to tell about a human civilization that once lived here in Ani long before us Minmatars arrived. One day, they invented this virtual world that people could hook into and be completely immersed. They created this beautiful virtual world, where everyone was rich and happy. Before long, they were all hooked in, their bodies suspended in stasis chambers. And thus, they faded away, into this virtual world of theirs.

That's the gist of it. Well, forgive me for finding this fascinating. I came out here as soon as I could and now I'm collecting interesting relics to find out if it's real or just a fable. I'd like you to head out to Inder and investigate an ancient wreckage in a complex there. Perhaps the key to this whole mystery lies there. But you need some basic knowledge in archaeology to be of any help.
messages.zh:
几周前我在赫克的一家不上档次的沙龙里喝酒时，无意中听到一伙图克尔人的谈话。其中一个人讲了一个不可思议的故事，他说在我们米玛塔尔人到达之前，安妮星座内曾经存在过一支人类文明。有一天，他们发明了一个虚拟世界，它很容易让人上瘾，并完全沉浸其中。他们创造的这个虚拟世界非常美好，在那里人人都很富有而且快乐。很快，所有人都陷入其中不能自拔，而肉体则悬浮在滞力室里。就这样，这个文明消失了，消失在虚拟世界中。

故事大意就是这样。抱歉，不过这个故事实在是让人着迷。所以我以最快速度赶到这，并着手搜集有趣的文物，目的就是弄清这个故事究竟是真是假。我希望你能前往因德尔，调查那里一个复合体内的某座古迹。也许解开秘密的关键就在那儿。但是你得有些基础的考古学知识才帮得上我的忙。

name.de: Zu schön um wahr zu sein
name.ru: Слишком хорошо, чтобы быть правдой (Too Good to be True)

messages.en:
There are great riches to be had in the contested complex here in Hjoramold. The Nefantars operated a large research facility there that gathered great amount of mysterious relics, supposedly thousands of years old. Now that the facility lies in ruins the relics are scattered around, just waiting for someone to pick them up. And that's exactly what I've been trying. But so are countless other treasure hunters and some of them really know how to shoot a gun. So I've been setting my sight on the rather more relaxed ancient wreckage site over in Inder. It doesn't yield as interesting stuff, but it's easier to get at.

The Inder site is ideal for a budding archaeologist and if you fancy yourself to be one, then by all means head over there and bring me something of interest back. There's good money to be had in this field for those bold enough to get what they want.
messages.zh:
在加拉摩德，争夺中的复合体内藏有大量财富。内凡达人在一个大型研究设施中收集了海量的神秘文物，这些文物大概有数千年历史。如今，这个设施已成废墟，文物四处散落，唾手可得，就等着我去取。但无数其他财宝猎人也想这么做，他们中有一些擅长战斗，因而我只好把眼光投向防卫更为松懈的古老因德尔残骸遗迹那儿。虽然那里出土的文物价值稍逊，但更容易获得。

因德尔遗迹是启蒙考古学家的理想之地，如果你觉得自己就是这样的一个人，那么就想方设法去那儿吧，带些有价值的东西给我。对那些勇于追求，敢于冒险的人而言，那里有取之不尽的财富。

messages.en:
There are great riches to be had in the contested complex here in Hjoramold. The Nefantars operated a large research facility there that gathered great amount of mysterious relics, supposedly thousands of years old. Now that the facility lies in ruins the relics are scattered around, just waiting for someone to pick them up. And that's exactly what I've been trying. But so are countless other treasure hunters and some of them really know how to shoot a gun. So I've been setting my sight on the rather more relaxed ancient wreckage site over in Inder. It doesn't yield as interesting stuff, but it's easier to get at.

The Inder site is ideal for a budding archaeologist and if you fancy yourself to be one, then by all means head over there and bring me something of interest back. There's good money to be had in this field for those bold enough to get what they want.

messages.en:
Hello there, you're interested in a little bit of work, yes? For many years I've been making a brisk business selling Nefantar artifacts on the black market. The buyers are all kind of people, mostly Ammatars looking for lost heirlooms or idle-rich Gallenteans looking for something unique to flaunt at the next gala showing. I long since decided to outsource the gathering of artifacts to other, more capable pilots.

Lately, the pilots working for me have been returning with more and more of some strange artifacts that I'm beginning to suspect are not of Nefantar origin. I've seen these items on occasions in the past, but now a lot more are coming in. Not that I'm complaining, mind you, for I've always had an easy time shifting them. It's getting so easy, in fact, that I'm on a constant lookout for more pilots to collect for me. It is my understanding after having talked to my other pilots that a contested complex over in Inder is the best place to find the items I want. If you do well you can always get more work from me. Might even provide a steady income for you. To locate the right items you need the right knowledge and equipment, naturally.
messages.zh:
嗨，你好，你有兴趣做些工作，是吗？多年来我一直在黑市贩卖内凡达古物，生意相当兴旺。买家形形色色，主要是寻找遗失的传家宝的艾玛达人或者是有钱没处花的盖伦特人，这些盖伦特人总希望淘到些稀罕的玩意儿，然后在下一次富人的聚会上炫耀。我很久以前就决定把搜集古物的任务外包给其他更能干的飞行员了。

最近，这些替我工作的飞行员带回了越来越多的奇特古物，我开始怀疑它们并非出自内凡达之手。过去，我偶尔也见到过这些东西，但如今它们却大量出现。不过我可不是在抱怨，它们一直都很容易脱手。实际上，它们如此走俏，我一直在找更多的飞行员来为我搜集。在和其他飞行员聊过后，我得知，位于因德尔的争夺中的复合体是寻找这类古物的最佳地点。如果你干得不错，就能从我这里得到更多的任务。这样甚至可能让你有一份稳定的收入。当然，要正确找到这些东西，你必须要有适当的知识和装备。

messages.en:
A clan sister of mine owns a quaint little curiosities shop back in Pator. She sells all kind of weird and wonderful items from around the known Eve universe. When she heard I was coming here to Ani, she asked me to have a look around for items for her shop. Of course, I'm happy to oblige.

I expected to pick up perhaps a few Nefantar artifacts at most, but something else has caught my eye. While digging through an old spa here in Lanngisi, I came upon a most fascinating old manuscript, written in a language I'm unfamiliar with. I sent it to my clan sister and it thrilled her. She wants me to search for more. I haven't found any more here in Lanngisi, but I've heard from reliable sources that more can be found over in an old ruin in Inder. So I'm looking for pilots such as you to help me out.

Bring me some manuscripts and I'll pay you {[item]rewardTypeID.quantityName, quantity=rewardQuantity}. Of course, you have to have some basic knowledge of archaeology before you can make head or tail of what you find.
messages.zh:
我的一个部落姐姐在帕多尔有个古雅的稀有品小店。她出售各种各样神奇古怪的东西，这些东西来自已知世界的各处。当她得知我要离开这儿动身前往安妮时，她要我旅途中帮她留意，看看有没有适合她商店的东西。我很高兴能帮她。

我原想最多只能拣到一些内凡达古器，但是有些别的东西映入了我的眼帘。当我行至朗基斯的某个古老的旅游胜地时，我偶然发现了一份非常迷人的旧手稿，它是用一种我不熟悉的语言书写的。我把它发给了我的部落姐姐，她被吓了一跳。她要我再找一些。我在朗基斯没有再找到那种手稿，但我收到可靠消息，在因德尔一个废弃的遇难点能够找到更多。所以我在找像你一样的飞行员帮助我。给我带回一些手稿，我会付你{[item]rewardTypeID.quantityName, quantity=rewardQuantity}。当然了，在你弄清楚你所找到的东西是什么之前，最好对考古学有些基本了解。

messages.en: I have some time to spare.  So, what type of work do you have to offer and what's it worth to me?
messages.zh: 我倒有些空余时间。那么，你会给我什么类型的工作？对我会有什么价值？

messages.en:
Although I'm sure you're just itching to get into combat, I'd like to put you to a small test first ... to see if you're really sincere about helping us out. There's this minor task that needs to be done, which involves ferrying a load of medical supplies to this system. You see, Nakugard has been hit by strange viral infections of late which have devastated a few outlying settlements here and put a scare into the local populace. Not only that but it's really having a negative effect on our efforts with bringing more Krusual Tribe civilians here, a system with a viral outbreak is not exactly the first place on your list when you're thinking of relocating your family somewhere.

The Vherokior Tribe were kind enough to give us access to their Zemnar supplies on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. Zemnar has proven to be an effective antidote against this latest outbreak, and we desperately need a large supply of the drug to prevent any more deaths and more bad publicity. I would like you to pay a visit to the Vherokior station in Teonusude and pick up the shipment and bring it to me, I'll see to it that it's distributed to all the affected settlements in Nakugard.
messages.zh:
虽然你已经迫不及待想加入战斗，但是我想先对你进行一个小小的测试……看看你能否真的想帮我们。我还要你完成一个小任务，将一批药物供给运送到这个星系。你知道，纳库加德最近爆发了一种奇怪病毒，几个边远的殖民地因此被毁，本地居民也感到恐慌。不仅如此，我们打算引入更多克鲁夏部族居民的努力也受到了负面影响。你想想，要是你搬家，一个爆发病毒的星系肯定不是你的首选。

维洛奇亚部族非常友善，允许我们使用他们在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的泽姆纳尔补给. 泽姆纳尔看起来是用来对付最近发生的疫情暴发最有效的解药了，我们急需大批量的这种药物用来抑制病情的蔓延和死亡的增加。我想要你到提鲁苏德的维洛奇亚空间站去取这些货物并带给我，我会把他们分配给纳库加德所有感染了的居住区。

But although I'm sure you're just itching to get into combat, I'd like to put you to a small test first ... to see if you're really sincere about helping us out. messages.en:
Since you've been so successful at kill missions, I'll give you one final assignment that involves exactly that. There is a Thukker Tribe envoy to the Angel Cartel, Vanir Makono, who's been stirring up the Cartel against us; according to our intelligence, he's currently located within the Minmatar Military Depot in Inder. I don't know what his motives are, but they're probably related to the fact the Thukker Tribe hate our guts. Heh. He's been a thorn in our side for long enough. The Gist attacks on our assets have increased tenfold since he started spreading those rumors about us.

I already sent two of my best pilots out to kill him, but I haven't heard from them since. I suggest you prepare yourself well before you attempt to infiltrate the Military Depot; it's completely overrun by Gistum thugs. You'll probably find Vanir in the headquarters of the deadspace complex. Good luck.
messages.zh:
鉴于你很擅长突袭任务，我给你的最后一个任务就是去暗中消灭一个人。他的名字是范尼尔•马克诺，图克尔部落派去天使企业联合体的特使，他在因德尔的米玛塔尔军事营地里，煽动天使企业联合体来对抗我们。尚不清楚其动机，可能是因为图克尔部落对我们恨之入骨。自他传播那些谣言以来，吉斯特对我们的袭击次数大量增加，我早想拔掉这颗眼中钉了。

我已经派了两个最好的飞行员去取他的性命，可至今杳无音讯。建议你在潜入米玛塔尔军事营地之前好好准备一下，那儿满地都是吉斯塔姆的暴徒。范尼尔应该在死亡空间复合体内的总部里。祝你好运！

messages.en:
You've been quite a boon to {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} since I first spoke to you, {[character]player.name}. You've earned your reward and then some. Unfortunately, I have nothing more for you at this time, but I'll throw you a tip: I heard some things that might interest you about the Okkelen constellation within Caldari space; apparently they're desperate for more freelance mercenaries back there. You might want to give them a shot if you aren't too busy.

Good luck!
messages.zh:
自从我认识你那天起，你就成了{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的福星，{[character]player.name}。你用自己的实力赢得了报酬和荣誉。可惜，我现在没什么能给你做的，不过我可以给你个小道消息：我听说加达里空间内的欧克勒恩星座有些事情，可能会引起你的兴趣；显然他们那里现在急需雇佣更多的自由飞行员。如果你不是很忙，你也许可以去试一试。

祝你好运！

messages.en:
As your second assignment, I need you to fetch a valuable Nefantar artifact from one of the Nefantar ruins through Ani. Most people consider the Nefantar ruins a lost cause when it comes to treasure hunting, as they were all looted for decades after the Rebellion, and are now either used as a hideout by pirate forces or guarded by local militia intent on saving 'valuable relics of the past' from looters. I would like to reverse this myth by proving to the people of the Republic that Ani is in fact still full of surprises, including treasures from the past. All I require is some evidence of this to present to the media, in other words our propaganda machine.

To be more specific, I'd like some kind of Nefantar relic that will raise eyebrows. They were very keen on creating portraits and sculptures of their leaders, which were unfortunately mostly destroyed by the freedom fighters during the Rebellion, and I'm certain one of them would interest all sorts of people. The Krusual Tribe are renowned treasure hunters, so finding these nefantar objects here would undoubtedly increase their interest in Ani.

Now if you're completely clueless as to where to start looking, I'll suggest one promising spot. There are some Nefantar ruins in Barkrik which have been claimed by the Maru Rebels as one of their bases. Maru is a criminal organization that is not to be taken lightly, most of it's members are wanted by the law and can be killed on sight. And other than being prepared for a fight, I suggest you bring someone along that has experience as an archaeologist, you might need someone like that to dig up the artifact for you. Good luck.
messages.zh:
作为你的第二个任务，我要你从安妮某个内凡达遗迹中取回一个非常贵重的内凡达古器。许多人认为，去内凡达遗迹寻宝是白费功夫，因为叛乱后的数十年来，那儿早已没剩下什么了，现在那些遗迹不是沦为海盗的藏身地，就是为当地那些视保卫“旧有遗产”为己任的国民警卫队所把守。我要颠覆他们这种荒诞的想法，要向共和国的人证明，安妮依然遍地都是神奇异物，旧有的遗产只是已知的一部分。我需要做的就是拿出证据交给媒体，让这台宣传机器为我造势。

说得更具体一些，我需要某种可以吸引眼球的内凡达遗物。过去的内凡达人热衷于制作领袖的肖像和雕塑，而不幸的是，这些令人叹为观止的作品多半在叛乱时期毁于自由战士之手。我敢确定，其中的任何一件都能牢牢地吸引住世人的目光。克鲁夏部族以追逐财富而闻名，如果在这儿能找到这些内凡达遗物的话，毫无疑问，这帮家伙会逐财而至，对安妮产生浓厚兴趣。

如果你感到无迹可寻，全然不知道从何入手的话，我推荐你一个不错的地方。在巴尔克里克有些遗迹已经沦为了马鲁叛军的基地。马鲁是个不可小觑的犯罪组织，其大部分成员都是通缉要犯，任何公民都有责任为民除害。除了做好战斗准备外，我建议你找个有考古经验的人随行，你或许会需要他替你挖掘古董。祝你好运！

messages.en: You surprise me, {[character]player.name}.  I honestly didn't expect you to accomplish this task, many have tried to infiltrate the Maru base in Barkrik and failed.  But now that you've proven yourself to be a reliable fighter pilot, you've convinced me to let you have the most difficult mission yet.  Just tell me when you're ready.
messages.zh: 你令我惊讶，{[character]player.name}。老实说，我本没期望你能完成这项任务，很多人试图渗透进巴尔克里克的马鲁基地，不过都失败了。但现在，你已经证明自己是个可以信赖的战斗飞行员，我相信已经可以把最困难的任务交给你了。等你准备好了，只要告诉我就行了。

messages.en:
As your second assignment, I need you to fetch a valuable Nefantar artifact from one of the Nefantar ruins through Ani. Most people consider the Nefantar ruins a lost cause when it comes to treasure hunting, as they were all looted for decades after the Rebellion, and are now either used as a hideout by pirate forces or guarded by local militia intent on saving 'valuable relics of the past' from looters. I would like to reverse this myth by proving to the people of the Republic that Ani is in fact still full of surprises, including treasures from the past. All I require is some evidence of this to present to the media, in other words our propaganda machine.

To be more specific, I'd like some kind of Nefantar relic that will raise eyebrows. They were very keen on creating portraits and sculptures of their leaders, which were unfortunately mostly destroyed by the freedom fighters during the Rebellion, and I'm certain one of them would interest all sorts of people. The Krusual Tribe are renowned treasure hunters, so finding these nefantar objects here would undoubtedly increase their interest in Ani.

Now if you're completely clueless as to where to start looking, I'll suggest one promising spot. There are some Nefantar ruins in Barkrik which have been claimed by the Maru Rebels as one of their bases. Maru is a criminal organization that is not to be taken lightly, most of it's members are wanted by the law and can be killed on sight. And other than being prepared for a fight, I suggest you bring someone along that has experience as an archaeologist, you might need someone like that to dig up the artifact for you. Good luck.

name.de: Ani aufstocken - Treffen Sie sie dort, wo es weh tut (3 von 3)
name.en: The Ani Buildup - Strike 'Em Where It Hurts (3 of 3)
name.es: Refuerzos para Ani: Donde más duele (3 de 3)
name.fr: La construction d'Ani - Frapper là où ça fait mal (3 sur 3)
name.ru: Возрождение созвездия Ani - удар по болевой точке (The Ani Buildup - Strike 'Em Where It Hurts) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
The last mission I have for you is the most difficult. The heavy pirate presence in Ani has a very negative effect on our mission, as I told you before. And the Angel Cartel are at the heart of it. Their operations in Ani must be stopped, at all costs.

As the saying goes, cut the head off the snake and you kill the snake. I'm not sure if this holds true with the Cartel, but it's worth a try. Their leader within Inder is Lagaster Malotoff, by killing him we hope to paralyze their forces for some time at least, and give the local populace a morale boost. This is the final task I have in store for you, once you have accomplished it my mission in Ani should be complete.
messages.zh:
你的最后一个任务也是难度最大的。我之前就跟你说过，安妮内强大的海盗势力对我们的任务有巨大的负面影响。天使企业联合体就是所有海盗的核心力量。必须不惜一切代价阻止他们在安妮的所有活动。

有句谚语说过，擒贼先擒王。我不确定这对天使企业联合体是否同样适用，但值得一试。他们在因德尔的领袖是拉贾斯特•马洛托夫，我们希望干掉他至少能使他们的军队瘫痪一段时间，同时鼓舞本地民众的士气。这是我为你安排的最后一个任务，一旦你胜利完成，我在安妮的使命也就圆满结束了。

messages.en: Lagaster has been taken care of, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 拉贾斯特已经从世上消失，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Amazing work, {[character]player.name}.  After all you've done, I expect thousands of additional immigrants into Ani in the next few weeks!  We'll see if my prediction holds true, but either way I'm in your debt.  Good luck, friend.
messages.zh: 了不起，{[character]player.name}。在你完成了所有事情后，我希望在接下来的几周里会有成千上万的新移民来到安妮。我们来看看我的预测准不准，不过不管怎样，我欠你一份人情。祝你好运，朋友。

messages.en:
The last mission I have for you is the most difficult. The heavy pirate presence in Ani has a very negative effect on our mission, as I told you before. And the Angel Cartel are at the heart of it. Their operations in Ani must be stopped, at all costs.

As the saying goes, cut the head off the snake and you kill the snake. I'm not sure if this holds true with the Cartel, but it's worth a try. Their leader within Inder is Lagaster Malotoff, by killing him we hope to paralyze their forces for some time at least, and give the local populace a morale boost. This is the final task I have in store for you, once you have accomplished it my mission in Ani should be complete.
messages.zh:
最后一个任务将是最困难的。正如我之前告诉你的那样，在安妮大量涌现的海盗对我们的计划造成了严重的负面影响，尤其是天使企业联合体。不惜任何代价，一定得制止他们在安妮的行动。

有句谚语，擒贼先擒王。我不能肯定这对天使企业联合是不是同样适用，但值得一试。他们在因德尔的领袖是拉贾斯特•马洛托夫，干掉他至少能让他们的军队瘫痪一段时间，同时鼓舞本地平民的士气。这是我为你准备的最后一个任务，一旦你载誉而归，我在安妮的使命也就圆满完成了。

name.en: Purging Ani - The Amarrian Plantation (1 of 3)
name.es: Purga de Ani: La plantación amarriana (1 de 3)
name.fr: Le nettoyage d'Ani – La plantation Amarr (1 sur 3)
name.ja: アニの浄化-アマー農園（1/3）
name.ru: Очистка созвездия Ani - плантация Amarr (Purging Ani - The Amarrian Plantation) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 安妮大清洗—艾玛种植园 (1/3)

messages.en: Actually I'm looking for some work.
messages.zh: 其实我想找份工作。

messages.en:
I settled here in Nakugard many years ago, lured to this place by tales of riches and glory spread by the Republic Parliament who've been desperate to populate Ani with loyal supporters of the Republic. But I've never felt at home here, and ever since I discovered I was sharing space with minions of the Amarr Empire I've felt betrayed and depressed. These people are responsible for some of the most terrible crimes in human history! And they're living under the protection of those that have sworn to protect us, the Republic government! I couldn't believe it at first ...

Apparently the late Karin Midular made a deal with Joint Harvesting a few years back to allow them to build a few stations and plantations in Ani. I don't care how much ISK they had to pay to get this deal through, or the fact they pretended to apologize for the Empire's crimes before the Rebellion. An Amarrian is an Amarrian, they'll never change, and as long as their people are located within Minmatar space I will not be at peace. And fortunately there are more within the Krusual Tribe who think the same way.

There is a growing movement within the Krusual settlements in Ani which aims at uprooting the Amarr presence in this constellation. We already have a large fleet of ships ready to strike at any moment. Our first target is a 'secret' plantation within Hjoramold, called the Jakela Plantation. We managed to discover it by using system scanners, and we've even heard rumors from there that they are using slaves to work the fields!

Our only problem is that our agents haven't found a way through their second acceleration gate. It's being guarded by an Amarrian called Rekker, and a few of his henchmen. They aren't much of a problem for our forces, but we're afraid that if we send in an entire battalion he'll simply flee at the first sight of us and take his keycard with him.

What I want you to do, {[character]player.name}, is take a small fleet of ships and launch a surprise attack against Rekker. Loot his keycard and bring it back to me, that way we'll be able to access the acceleration gate leading deeper into the plantation grounds. You'll have to do this fast, before they change the gate's security system when they figure out Rekker has been killed.

Once you're back here with the keycard I'll supply you with your reward.
messages.zh:
我已经定居到纳库加德很多年。当年，共和国议会急于把共和国的忠实拥趸吸引到安妮居住，他们大肆宣扬这里的富饶和荣耀，我就被吸引来了。 但是在这里，我从没感受过家的温暖，而自从我发现我的邻居净是些艾玛帝国的奴才，那种上当受骗的沮丧就一直挥之不去。 这些人曾经犯下过人类历史上最恐怖的一些罪行！ 而他们却生活在曾承诺保护我们的共和国政府的保护下！ 一开始，我难以相信那是事实……

几年前，卡琳·米杜拉与联合收割种植园做了一笔交易，允许他们在安妮建造空间站及种植园。 这笔交易涉及金额多少我不关心，也不管他们对艾玛在大抗争之前犯罪行进行道歉这一事实。 艾玛人永远是艾玛人，本性难改。只要他们有人住在米玛塔尔区域，我就觉得不安心。 所幸的是克鲁夏部落里已经有越来越多的人和我想的一样了。

现在安妮的克鲁夏部落里已经有很多人想把艾玛从该星座中赶走。 我们已经有了一大批舰队随时准备待命。 我们的首要目标是加拉摩德里的一个叫雅克拉种植园的“秘密”种植园。 我们已经用探针查明了其位置，那里甚至爆出传闻他们在用劳工干活！

现在唯一的问题是我们的特工无法找到通过他们第二道加速轨道的方式。 那地方由一个叫勒科尔的艾玛人以及他的一些随从把守。 我们的力量要解决他们并不是什么问题，我担心一旦我们大部队过去，他就会带着钥匙逃跑的。

{[character]player.name}，我要你带一小队人过去打他个措手不及。 把他的钥匙拿来然后我们就可以深入那个敌后种植园了。 你动作要快，不要让他们在发觉勒科尔死了之后改掉轨道的安全系统。

你把钥匙拿来之后我便会给你报酬。

messages.en: Find the Jakela Plantation in Hjoramold using a system scanner.  Take care to bring a Hacker Slice ID to access the first gate.  Destroy Rekker Malkun and bring his keycard back to {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 在加拉摩德使用星系扫描仪找出雅克拉种植园。携带一块黑客ID牌，小心进入第一条加速轨道。干掉勒科尔•玛昆，将他的钥匙卡带给{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en:
Well why didn't you say so?! If you're good with a gun, then I have something that you'd like. If not, then get lost.

If you're still interested, I've uploaded some information to the mission details in your Opportunities interface. If you feel you're up to it, then let me know.
messages.zh:
你怎么不早说？！你要是擅长使枪，我还能拿出点好东西。不然就趁早滚蛋。

你如果仍有兴趣，就去看看我上传到“机遇”界面任务详情中的那些信息吧。要是有把握搞定就联系我。

name.en: Purging Ani - Arming The Marines (2 of 3)
name.es: Purga de Ani: Armando a los marines (2 de 3)
name.fr: Le nettoyage d'Ani – L'armement des marines (2 sur 3)
name.ja: アニの浄化-海兵隊員の武装（2/3）
name.ru: Очистка созвездия Ani - вооружение космических пехотинцев (Purging Ani - Arming The Marines) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
Since you managed to accomplish my first task with aplomb, I've decided you're worthy of another highly important mission for our cause. There are a large number of civilians in Ani who have offered to join our ranks during our campaign to rid the constellation of Amarr, but we don't have the weapons to spare to arm them. One of my contacts within the Republic Security forces has promised us a large shipment of small arms which we'll use to equip our new troops with. The only catch is that this shipment is currently located in Floseswin, which is a pretty dangerous area. Which makes this job perfect for someone like you, {[character]player.name}.

Get the shipment of small arms here in one piece and I'll give you a generous reward.
messages.zh:
你泰然自若地完成了我给你的首个任务，因此我认为你有资格接受另一项对我们事业极其重要的使命。在安妮，有大量平民自愿加入我们的队伍以共同将艾玛人赶出星座，但是我们没有多余的武器来武装他们。我在共和国安全军队内部的一个联络人已许诺给我们一大批小型军械，可以用来武装我们的新部队。唯一的问题在于，这批货目前正在弗洛瑟文，那是一个相当危险的区域。正因为这样，这个任务才非常适合像你这样的人，{[character]player.name}。

把那批小型军械完好无损地运到这来，我会给你丰厚的报酬。

messages.en: Great work!  This will benefit our cause immensely.  I'm sure our ground troops will now have the manpower they need to overpower the mercenary forces stationed within the plantations, so we don't have to blow up the structures which would potentially kill innocent Minmatar civilians working there.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得不错！这对我们的事业帮助很大。我能肯定，现在陆军军队已经有足够的人力去制服种植园内的雇佣军了，所以我们不需要炸毁建筑，殃及在那里工作的无辜米玛塔尔平民。先别离开，我有另一个任务给你！先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

messages.en:
Since you managed to accomplish my first task with aplomb, I've decided you're worthy of another highly important mission for our cause. There are a large number of civilians in Ani who have offered to join our ranks during our campaign to rid the constellation of Amarr, but we don't have the weapons to spare to arm them. One of my contacts within the Republic Security forces has promised us a large shipment of small arms which we'll use to equip our new troops with. The only catch is that this shipment is currently located in Floseswin, which is a pretty dangerous area. Which makes this job perfect for someone like you, {[character]player.name}.

Get the shipment of small arms here in one piece and I'll give you a generous reward.
messages.zh:
上一个任务里你表现得很沉着，所以这次我会布置一个更重要的任务。在战役中，有大量安妮的平民要求加入我们的队伍，一起把艾玛侵略者赶出星座。但问题是我们没有多余的武器来武装他们。我在共和国安全军队内部的一个联络人已许诺给我们一大批小型军械，用来武装我们的新部队。问题是那批货目前正在弗洛瑟文，那是一个相当危险的区域。这个任务非常适合你，{[character]player.name}。

一次性把那批小型军械带来，我会给你丰厚的报酬。

name.es: Purga de Ani: Kyan Magdesh (3 de 3)
name.fr: Le nettoyage d'Ani – Kyan Magdesh (3 sur 3)
name.ja: アニの浄化-カイアンマグデシュ（3/3）
name.ru: Очистка созвездия Ani - Kyan Magdesh (Purging Ani - Kyan Magdesh) (3 из 3)
name.zh: 安妮大清洗—卡扬•玛德什 (3/3)

messages.en:
If you're still willing I have one final mission that I think you're suited for. The Joint Harvesting corporation has become aware of our presence and we believe they are preparing for a counter-attack against our forces. Finding a Mordu's mercenary in Ani confirmed our suspicions, we're certain these Mordu's goons were hired by Joint Harvesting to sabotage our operation.

Not only that, but they apparently sent a Magdesh after us. The Magdesh are a powerful family within the Mordu's Legion, highly respected bounty hunters. One of their members, Kyan, is currently hauled up in Barkrik I - Asteroid Belt 1. He's been spotted on numerous occasions snooping around near our outposts there, but never long enough for our guards to catch him. I would like you to take care of this pest, before he manages to do us any harm. Just be warned, he operates a Caldari battleship and is not to be taken lightly. You might need help on this one, {[character]player.name}. Good luck.
messages.zh:
如果你愿意，我还有最后一个适合你的工作。联合收割集团已经注意到了我们的存在，估计正准备对我方军队进行反攻。在安妮发现的莫德团佣兵更证实了我的猜测：联合收割雇佣这些暴徒来阻碍我们的行动。

不仅如此，他们还派了一个玛德什人跟踪我们。玛德什家族是莫德团内一支强大的族群，是倍受尊敬的赏金猎人。他们的成员之一卡扬，正在巴尔克里克 I —— 小行星带 1 那儿。他一直在我们哨站附近鬼鬼祟祟，但每次总能从守卫眼皮底下逃之夭夭。我希望你能抢在他动手前干掉这个惹人厌的家伙。你要警惕些，他驾驶着一艘加达里战列舰，不好对付。最好带些帮手， {[character]player.name}。祝你好运。

messages.en: Well, that was the last assignment I have in store for you, {[character]player.name}.  I'm certain we can handle the rest by ourselves.  And if you want to further help our cause, I suggest sabotaging their plantations in Hjoramold and Barkrik.  We'll take all the help we can get.  Good luck on your future endeavors.
messages.zh: 那是我为你准备的最后一个任务，{[character]player.name}。我相信我们自己可以解决剩下的事情。如果你想要进一步协助我们的事业，那么我建议你破坏他们在加拉摩德和巴尔克里克的种植园。我们会尽最大能力给予你帮助。祝你一路顺风。

messages.en: Find Kyan Magdesh in Barkrik I - Asteroid Belt 1, destroy him and bring his DNA back to {[character]agentID.name} to confirm the deed.
messages.zh: 在巴尔克里克 I —— 小行星带 1 里找到卡扬·玛德什，摧毁他的飞船，把他的DNA带给{[character]agentID.name}作为证明。

The Joint Harvesting corporation has become aware of our presence and we believe they are preparing for a counter-attack against our forces. Finding a Mordu's mercenary in Ani confirmed our suspicions, we're certain these Mordu's goons were hired by Joint Harvesting to sabotage our operation.

One of their members, Kyan, is currently hauled up in Barkrik I - Asteroid Belt 1. He's been spotted on numerous occasions snooping around near our outposts there, but never long enough for our guards to catch him. I would like you to take care of this pest, before he manages to do us any harm. Just be warned, he operates a Caldari battleship and is not to be taken lightly. You might need help on this one, {[character]player.name}. Good luck.
messages.zh:
如果你愿意，我还有最后一个适合你的工作。联合收割集团已经注意到了我们的存在，估计正准备对我方军队进行反攻。在安妮发现的莫德团佣兵更证实了我的猜测：联合收割雇佣这些暴徒来阻碍我们的行动。

不仅如此，他们还派了一个玛德什人跟踪我们。玛德什家族是莫德团内一支强大的族群，是倍受尊敬的赏金猎人。他们的成员之一卡扬，正在巴尔克里克 I —— 小行星带 1 那儿。他一直在我们哨站附近鬼鬼祟祟，但每次总能从守卫眼皮底下逃之夭夭。我希望你能抢在他动手前干掉这个惹人厌的家伙。你要警惕些，他驾驶着一艘加达里战列舰，不好对付。最好带些帮手， {[character]player.name}。祝你好运。

name.ja: ラトルスネーク作戦-見えない危険（1/3）
name.ru: Операция «Гремучая змея» - скрытые опасности (Operation: Rattlesnake - Hidden Dangers) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 行动：响尾蛇—潜伏的危机(1/3)

messages.en: I'm ready and willing, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 一切就绪，乐意为您效劳，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en:
Your first assignment is to conduct a reconnaissance mission near an ice field in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. We have reason to believe a Serpentis drug baron has set up shop there, hoarding drugs and other contraband goods in the deadspace pocket surrounding the ice field, safe from our surveillance monitors. We have also been led to believe that this particular Serpentis pirate has been smuggling arms to the Angel Cartel criminal organization, which is a serious enough crime in itself.

I want you to examine the area and report your findings back to me. If our information is correct, then I will have no choice but to launch a full scale assault into the ice field and the surrounding asteroid belt to exterminate this Serpentis pest for good. I will await your findings here in the Dream Port. Farewell.
messages.zh: 你的第一项作业是去{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的冰域附近执行侦察任务。据我们判断，一个天蛇集团毒枭在那里开了一家店铺，在环绕冰域的死亡空间层里囤积违规药品和其他违禁货物，安全地避开了我们的监视器。我们还有理由相信，这个天蛇海盗一直向犯罪组织天使企业联合体非法贩售武器，这本身就是一项重罪。<br><br>我要你去检查一下这个区域，将发现结果报告给我。如果我们的情报属实，那我就别无选择，只能对冰域和周围小行星带发动全面进攻以彻底消灭这个天蛇败类。我会在梦幻港等候你的发现结果。保重。

messages.en: So our suspicions were confirmed ... I'll have to send one of our security teams in there to clean up what's left of the Serpentis ships.  But since you finished this task with flying colors, I'd like you to stick around for a couple other jobs that I need someone to take care of.
messages.zh: 那么说，我们的怀疑得到了证实……我必须派一支安全部队到那里歼灭所有的天蛇残余。不过既然你出色地完成了这个任务，我希望你留下来，我还有别的任务需要有人来做。

name.de: Operation: Klapperschlange - Die Reihen füllen sich (2 of 3)
name.en: Operation: Rattlesnake - Filling The Ranks (2 of 3)
name.fr: Opération : Rattlesnake – Renforcer les troupes (2 sur 3)
name.ja: ラトルスネーク作戦-任務の遂行（2/3）
name.ru: Операция «Гремучая змея»- пополняя ряды (Operation: Rattlesnake - Filling The Ranks) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
Now that you've proven yourself I'll fill you in on my secret assignment here in Ani. I was sent here by the Republic Fleet to prepare for a major assault that they've planned against the Angel Cartel strongholds in the constellation. The elimination of the Serpentis in the ice field was solely made to weaken the Cartel's position, as the Serpentis there were directly supplying them with arms and other equipment.

Your second task is to transport a regiment of our finest ground troops to The Sisters of Eve Bureau in Inder from the Brutor stronghold in Ivar. They will play a major role in our assault against the Cartel positions, so I need them here ASAP. I'll fill you in on your last, and most important, mission after you've completed this simple task.
messages.zh:
你已通过考验，我决定让你在安妮执行一项秘密任务。共和舰队派我到这来按计划筹备一次重大袭击，目标是天使企业联合体在这个星座内的要塞。剿灭冰域内的天蛇只是为了削弱天使企业联合体的力量，切断天蛇对他们的武器和装备供给。

你的第二个任务是把我们在伊瓦尔的布鲁特要塞中的一批最精良的地面部队运送到因德尔的姐妹会办事处。他们将在对天使企业联合体据点的攻击中发挥主要作用，所以我希望他们尽快到位。在你完成这个简单的任务后，我会给你布置最后也是最重要的任务。

messages.zh:
你表现得很出色，我决定让你执行秘密任务。共和舰队派我到安妮准备一次重要的进攻行动，他们计划攻击天使企业联合体在这个星系里的要塞。剿灭冰域内的天蛇只是为了削弱天使集团的力量，切断天蛇对他们的武器和装备供给。

给你第二个任务，把我们在伊瓦尔的布鲁特要塞中一批最好的地面部队送到因德尔的姐妹会办事处。他们会在针对企业联合体的攻击中担当主攻的重任，所以我希望他们尽快就位。这个对你来说只是小菜一碟，之后我会让你执行我们最重要的任务。

name.en: Operation: Rattlesnake - The Scanner Tower (3 of 3)
name.es: Operación Rattlesnake: La torre de escáner (3 de 3)
name.fr: Opération : Rattlesnake – La tour de scanner (3 sur 3)
name.ja: ラトルスネーク作戦-スキャナータワー（3/3）
name.ru: Операция «Гремучая змея» - наблюдательная башня (Operation: Rattlesnake - The Scanner Tower) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
Now we're entering the final stages of our preparations for the military offensive. But there is one last mission I'd like to offer you, that is critical to our objective. The Military Depot in Inder is currently under Angel Cartel control. Although the meager fleet guarding their positions there are no match for a full scale assault by the Republic armada, they have a huge advantage due to the terrain. The acceleration gate leading into the complex is not fit for large vessels, and if we take the longer route of manually flying through the deadspace area we will undoubtedly run into countless of their booby traps, potentially causing us heavy casualties.

But there is something that could turn the table in our favor, {[character]player.name}. Our agents have already infiltrated the pirate forces inside the Military Depot, and have reported a glaring weakness. They use a large scanner tower to detect any incoming ships from light years away, giving them extra time to prepare their defenses for any incoming assault. If this scanner tower is destroyed, they will lose one of their biggest advantages.

The scanner tower is located inside the Military Depot complex. Once you have destroyed it, bring me something from the wreckage as proof. I won't doubt your sincerity, {[character]player.name}, but I'm afraid my superiors are a little more skeptical and would require some sort of evidence before they launch the strike.
messages.zh:
我们现在到了准备军事进攻的最后阶段。我还有最后一个任务要给你，它对我们达成目标至关重要。因德尔的军事营地目前正在天使企业联合体的控制下。虽然守卫那里的为数不多的舰队抵挡不住共和国舰队的全面进攻，但他们却占据极大的地形优势。通向那个复合体的加速轨道不适于大型舰只通过，而且如果我们手动飞行穿过漫长的死亡空间区域的话，肯定会落入他们众多的陷阱中，造成惨重伤亡。

但有一个方法能让我们扭转局面，{[character]player.name}。我们的特工已经混入了军事营地内部的海盗部队，并发现了对方的一个致命弱点。他们使用一座大型扫描塔来侦测数光年外的来船，这给了他们额外的时间来准备针对外来进攻的防御工作。如果该扫描塔被毁，他们将失去一项最大的优势。<br><br>这座扫描塔位于军事营地复合体内。一旦你摧毁了它，从残骸中带些东西回来作为证明。我不是怀疑你的诚意，{[character]player.name}，但恐怕我的上级仍有疑虑，因此他们只有在获得一些证据后，才会发起进攻。

messages.en: I found this scanner data in the charred wreckage of the tower right after I destroyed it.
messages.zh: 在摧毁了那个塔之后，我在烧焦的残骸中找到了这些扫描数据。

messages.en: Fantastic!  I'll send this to Manneiri Rimbrumulf immediately.  You've done your duty, {[character]player.name}, and for that I salute you.
messages.zh: 太棒了！我会立刻把它发送给马内里·林布鲁姆的。你尽了你的责任，{[character]player.name}，为此我向你致敬。

messages.en: Find the Contested Minmatar Military Depot and destroy the Scanner Tower.  Return to {[character]agentID.name} in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} with the Angel Cartel Scanner Data.
messages.zh: 找到争夺中的米玛塔尔军事营地，摧毁扫描塔。带着天使企业联合体的扫描数据回到{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的{[character]agentID.name}那里。

messages.en:
I'm working toward my doctorate in Archaeology from the Science and Trade Institute. I'm already done with my thesis, but before my advisory committee allows me to submit it, they're demanding I get some more field experience. So they've sent me out here to collect some artifacts from the fabled dig sites here in Okkelen.

I've been out here for some time trying to get into these areas, but to no avail. I'm simply outclassed. The main dig site is over in Otitoh, but the excavation there is heavily infested with rogue drones, so it's very hard getting anything from there. I've heard rumors that something of interest might be found here in Otomainen, but I haven't found anything substantial yet. But I have one good lead. I understand that the artifacts the infamous Kazka bandits have pillaged or looted throughout the constellation are stored in their headquarters over in Sakkikainen.

If you're willing to help, assuming you have some basic knowledge of archaeological practices, I think that Sakkikainen is the best bet for finding something of interest that is not too dangerous to collect. My committee is mainly interested in old manuscripts, so if you could find something of that nature, I would be willing to pay you good money for it.
messages.zh: 我正在攻读科学及贸易学院的考古学博士学位。我已经写完了论文，但我的咨询委员会要求我先获得一些现场经验，然后才能上交论文。所以他们把我派到这里，在欧克勒恩传说中的挖掘现场搜集一些古物。 <br><br>我来这儿已经有段时间了，一直试图进入这些区域，不过毫无进展。因为我实在是不堪一击。主要的挖掘现场位于欧提托，但是由于自由无人机猖獗，要从那弄到些东西很难。我听说在欧塔迈伦这里也许能发现一些有趣的东西，但目前我还没有任何实质性的发现。不过我有了个不错的线索。我知道那些臭名昭著的卡兹卡强盗把从星座各处获取的古物存放在他们位于萨基凯伦的总部里。<br><br>如果你愿意帮忙，也懂一些基本的考古知识，我想萨基凯伦是个你不用冒太大风险就能找到些有趣玩意儿的绝佳场所。我的咨询委员会对旧手稿很感兴趣。所以，如果你能找到那类东西，我会很乐意付你个好价钱。

messages.en:
There are a lot of sharks swimming the dark waters of Okkelen these days. But that isn't all bad for small fish like you and me because these sharks are mainly interested in what the other sharks are doing. And wouldn't you know, they're even willing to pay good money to someone that can provide them with that information. Enter little ol' me. I've been making steady business ferreting out interesting stuff from various sources and selling them to the highest bidder.

There are a lot of places that such information can be gathered. The contested complex in Friggi is one such place, but not for those faint of heart, for it is heavily defended. But right here in Airmia is a place ideally suited for a bit of old school industrial espionage. The Guristas are operating a small spy station in the contested Lai Dai Refinery. If you possess some decent hacking skills you're bound to find something of value there. I might even be interested in buying some of the stuff you dig up.
messages.zh:
形象点说吧，最近在欧克勒恩海域的深色海水中游弋着很多鲨鱼。幸好他们对我们这些小鱼不屑一顾，因为他们只关心其他鲨鱼的一举一动。你肯定猜不到，他们甚至愿意高额回报那些为他们提供对手信息的人。这就轮到渺小的我登场了。我一直在从各种渠道搜集有趣的情报，并将它们卖给出价最高的人。

在很多地方都可以搜集这类信息。弗瑞吉那个争夺中的复合体就是这么一个地方，不过那里防卫相当严密，胆小的人最好别去。不过在艾尔米亚这儿就有一个地方，非常适合旧式的工业间谍。古斯塔斯在争夺中的莱戴精炼厂运作着一座小型间谍站。如果你有些像样的黑客技术，你肯定能在那儿找到些有价值的东西。说不定我会出价向你购买一些有价值的信息呢。

name.fr: Plus on est de fous, plus on rit
name.ru: В тесноте, да не в обиде (The More the Merrier)

messages.en:
The Chief Executive Panel may have charged only a couple of the mega-corporations with the task of settling Okkelen, but that doesn't mean the others have to sit idle by on the sidelines and watch Lai Dai and NOH hog all the glory. And all the riches, more importantly.

Ishukone wants to keep a watchful eye on the goings on here. I'm one of several covert and not-so covert operators roaming the constellation gathering intelligence. Personally, I'm particularly interested in the spy station operated by the Guristas pirates over in Airmia. Why spend a lot of time and resources to do something that others are already doing? If you are proficient hacker and have all the right equipment, you could do much worse than snoop around there and collect some choice tidbits to sell to information peddlers such as myself.
messages.zh:
虽然加达里CEO合作组织只指定了两家超级集团负责解决欧克勒恩星座的问题，但这并不意味着其他几家就得袖手旁观，眼睁睁看着莱戴和纳基维占尽所有光环。更重要的是，他们将夺走所有财富。

异株湖集团想要密切关注这里发生的一切。我就是集团派来的几个秘密或半秘密特工之一，我们在星座里四处搜集情报。就个人而言，我尤其对艾尔米亚的那个古斯塔斯运作的间谍站感兴趣。你想想，干嘛花大量的时间和资源去做别人已经在做的事呢？如果你是个娴熟的黑客而且拥有适当的设备，除了在那四处打探然后把一些搜集来的精选信息卖给我这样的情报贩子之外，你所能做的远不止这些。

name.ru: Стремление к вершине (Rush to the Head)

messages.en:
Something tells me that we're on the verge on discovering something really marvelous here in Okkelen that might change the way we look at the world forever. There are artifacts here that are thousands of years old and if we can discover who left them behind and what kind of society they lived in, it might put our own meager existence into a more enlightened perspective.

Yes, interesting times indeed, and I for one want to do what I can to advance humankind to the next rug in the evolution ladder. I'm collecting interesting relics and am on the lookout for independent pilots that have some rudimentary knowledge of archaeology to help me out in this great endeavor. Are you interested?
messages.zh:
直觉告诉我，我们就要在欧克勒恩发现一些不同凡响的东西了，它可能会彻底改变我们看待世界的方式。这里有历时数千年的古物，如果我们能够发现它们是谁留下来的，并了解他们的社会形态，也许我们卑微的生存状态就会获得深刻的启示。

是的，真是个非常有趣的时期，就我而言，我将尽我所能帮助人类在进化的阶梯上更上一层。我正在搜集有趣的古物，所以要找拥有基本考古知识的独立飞行员来协助我完成这项艰巨的任务。你有兴趣吗？

messages.en:

There are artifacts here that are thousands of years old and if we can discover who left them behind and what kind of society they lived in, it might put our own meager existence into a more enlightened perspective.

Yes, interesting times indeed, and I for one want to do what I can to advance humankind to the next rug in the evolution ladder. messages.zh:
我有预感我们将在欧克勒恩发现一种真正神奇的东西，它可能会永远改变我们看待世界的方式。这里有上万年前遗留下来的古物，如果我们能够发现是谁留下来的，了解他们的社会形态，或许我们就能摆脱贫弱的现状，拥有光明的未来。

是的，真是个非常有趣的年代，而我则想尽力帮助人类在进化的阶梯上更进一步。我正在收集有趣的古物，所以要找拥有基本考古知识的飞行员来帮我。你感兴趣吗？

messages.en:
From what I've heard, the Guristas pirates have amassed an impressive amount of treasure and valuable information in the contested complex here in Friggi, but that stuff is pretty well defended, so you need some heavy armaments to have any chance of tackling that. A better bet is heading out to the Airmia system and enter the spy station the Guristas are operating in the contested complex there. If you have some basic hacking knowledge, I'm certain you can dig up something of value to me.

Just be very careful ― a big gun is a man's best friend around here, so be prepared to face a few.
messages.zh:
我得到消息，古斯塔斯海盗在弗瑞吉这里争夺中的复合体中积累了令人吃惊的大量财宝和有价值的信息，但那东西守备森严，所以你需要一些重型武器才有机会解决它。比较保险的方法是，出发去艾尔米亚星系，进入争夺中的复合体内的古斯塔斯间谍站。如果你有些基本的黑客知识，我肯定你能发掘出一些对我有价值的信息。

不过千万要小心——在这一带，威力强大的枪炮是人类最好的朋友，你会在那遇到不少这样的朋友。

messages.en:
Some bright light back at headquarters got the idea that SuVee was missing out on something good here in Okkelen. So they sent poor old me out here to map the riches. Yeah, right. If I ever find out who's responsible, I'll make him dance to the tune of my AK-107. This place is a real hellhole. All I've encountered is dust and danger. I've heard plenty of stories of fabulous riches, but that's it ― just stories. My superiors are getting restless, wanting more than just hints and rumors from me, so I'm looking for prospective pilots to lend me a bit of a hand.

From what I've heard, the Guristas pirates have amassed an impressive amount of treasure and valuable information in the contested complex here in Friggi, but that stuff is pretty well defended, so you need some heavy armaments to have any chance of tackling that. A better bet is heading out to the Airmia system and enter the spy station the Guristas are operating in the contested complex there. If you have some basic hacking knowledge, I'm certain you can dig up something of value to me.

Just be very careful ― a big gun is a man's best friend around here, so be prepared to face a few.
messages.zh: 总部某个聪明的脑袋得知斯维在欧克勒恩这儿弄丢了一些好东西。所以他们就把我这个可怜的老家伙派来寻找财宝。是啊，就像真的一样。要是让我知道这是谁的主意，我就要让他伴着我的AK-107跳舞。这个地方真令人讨厌。我遇到的都是满天灰尘和无尽的险境。我听到了许多关于惊人的财富的故事，不过那也仅仅是故事而已。 我的上级坐立不安，要求我不要光是上报一些线索和流言，所以我要找个有希望的飞行员帮我个小忙。<br><br>我得到消息，古斯塔斯海盗在弗瑞吉这里争夺中的复合体中积累了令人吃惊的大量财宝和有价值的信息，但那东西守备森严，所以你需要一些重型武器才有机会解决它。比较保险的方法是，出发去艾尔米亚星系，进入争夺中的复合体内的古斯塔斯间谍站。如果你有些基本的黑客知识，我肯定你能发掘出一些对我有价值的信息。<br><br>不过千万要小心——在这一带，威力强大的枪炮是人类最好的朋友，你会在那遇到不少这样的朋友。

name.es: Quien lo encuentra se lo queda

messages.en:
The mega-corporations are trying to hog all the action here in Okkelen, but if you're careful to stay under their radar it's easy to get your hands on something good from time to time. I'm monitoring the excavation site here, looking for opportunities that might arise.

In the meantime, I hear the Kazka bandits over in Sakkikainen have hoarded a sizeable amount of artifacts in their headquarters. I'm well connected to shift these artifacts, so if you know anything about archaeology I'm interested in striking a bit of a business deal. I'll pay you good money for any {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} you manage to scavenge from the Kazka bandits.
messages.zh:
那些超级集团想尽办法掌握欧克勒恩内的一举一动，但如果你小心避开他们的雷达，就不难时时弄到些好东西。我正监视着这里的发掘现场，寻找可能出现的机会。

与此同时，我听说萨基凯伦内的卡兹卡强盗在他们的总部贮藏了大量古物。我知道很多将这些古物出手的渠道，如果你对考古学略知一二，不妨我们做个买卖。我愿高价买下你从卡兹卡强盗那里拿来的任何{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}。

messages.en:
The mega-corporations are trying to hog all the action here in Okkelen, but if you're careful to stay under their radar it's easy to get your hands on something good from time to time. I'm monitoring the excavation site here, looking for opportunities that might arise.

In the meantime, I hear the Kazka bandits over in Sakkikainen have hoarded a sizeable amount of artifacts in their headquarters. I'm well connected to shift these artifacts, so if you know anything about archaeology I'm interested in striking a bit of a business deal. I'll pay you good money for any {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} you manage to scavenge from the Kazka bandits.
messages.zh:
那些商业巨头想尽办法掌控欧克勒恩任何的风吹草动，但若我们谨慎行事，就时常会有收获。我正监控着这儿的发掘现场，寻找任何可能出现的机会。

与此同时，我听说萨基凯伦内部的卡兹卡强盗在指挥部窝藏了大量古董。我已经联系好转移这些古董，如果你也对古物略知一二，不妨我们做个买卖。我愿高价买下从卡兹卡强盗那里拿来的任何{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}。

messages.en:
Thanks in no small part to the documents you brought, we now have the location of the temporary facilities in this system where Vandano and his cohorts intend to keep the slaves while their forged documents are being submitted to the Republic. According to our reports, they will then be brought to the Joint Harvesting Plantation in Barkrik.

If you head out there now and destroy this outpost, our other team should be in a prime position to intercept the slave convoy when it comes in.
messages.zh:
多亏了你带来的文件，我们才找到了凡达诺和他的军士打算在这个星系中圈养劳工的临时设施，尽管他们已将伪造的文件上交给了共和国。根据我们接到的报告，他们稍后将被运往巴尔克里克的联合收割种植园。

如果你现在就去那里摧毁这个哨站，那么当劳工护航队抵达时，我们的其他部队就将在拦截行动中处于有利位置。

name.de: Nachschub für die Kolonie - Warentransport (1 von 3)
name.en: Supplies For The Colony - Transporting The Goods (1 of 3)
name.es: Suministros para la colonia: Transporte de las mercancías (1 de 3)
name.fr: Ravitaillement de la colonie – Transport de marchandises (1 sur 3)
name.ja: コロニー支援―物資の輸送（1/3）
name.ru: Поставки в колонию - перевозка товаров (Supplies For The Colony - Transporting The Goods) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 殖民地的供应品—运送货物(1/3)

messages.en: Just make sure you head out there prepared, {[character]player.name}.  The shipment you're supposed to fetch is located in a pretty dangerous area, I cannot guarantee that you won't be ambushed by pirates on the way.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 确保你准备好了再前往那里，{[character]player.name}。你要去取的货物在一个非常危险的区域，途中可能有海盗伏击。祝你好运。

messages.en:
The colony on Inder VIII is in desperate need of some outside help, {[character]player.name}. Since no station has yet been built orbiting the planet space travel is much more infrequent than other more prominent colonies within the Republic.

The first item that I would like you to fetch for me is soil. There's an amazing lack of fresh, quality soil in the settlements that have sprung up on the planet's surface. The farmer's union has been threatening an all-out withdrawal from Inder if this issue isn't resolved. I'll pay you well if you can get the soil which I've ordered from the Vherokior Tribe to me on time.
messages.zh:
因德尔VIII上的殖民地非常需要一些外来帮助，{[character]player.name}。由于这个行星周围没造什么空间站，比起共和国内其他更加繁华的殖民地，这里就冷清得多。

我要你为我取的第一件物品是土壤。行星表面上出现的新殖民地造成了新鲜、高质量土壤的严重短缺。农民联合会已发出威胁，如果这个问题不到解决，他们将从因德尔全面撤出。如果你能按时把我向维洛奇亚部族定购的土壤运过来，我会给你不错的报酬。

The farmer's union has been threatening an all-out withdrawal from Inder if this issue isn't resolved. I'll pay you well if you can get the soil which I've ordered from the Vherokior Tribe to me on time.
messages.zh:
因德尔 VIII的殖民地非常需要外来的帮助，{[character]player.name}。这个星球周围没什么空间站，比起在共和国境内那些繁华的殖民地，这里就冷清得多。

我要你去取的第一个物品是土壤。在这个星球表面住着的居民区面临突然出现的新鲜的，高质量的土壤严重短缺。如果不能及时解决这个问题，农民联合组织就会从因德尔完全撤出。如果你能按时把我向维洛奇亚部族定购的土壤取回的话，我会给你不错的酬劳。

name.fr: Gladiateurs – Au secours de Grace (2 sur 2)
name.ja: グラディエーター―唯一の救い（2/2）
name.ru: Гладиаторы - единственное спасение (Gladiators - Saving Grace) (2 из 2)

messages.en:
I have three fighters on hand right now, but I need more to be able to run my show. I just received word that one of my best, Grace Tarsis, is being held by a group of Cartel thugs in a deadspace location here in Nakugard, on account of some unsettled debts. If you can find her and bring her back to me in one piece, I'll be a step closer to re-opening my arena and evading the Leisure Group's wrath.

They're keeping her in a brothel in their lair, one that's not really that heavily guarded. If you kill the guards and blow up the brothel, you should be able to get her out and bring her back. If you can do that, you will have my most heartfelt thanks.
messages.zh:
现在我手头有三个斗士，但是我需要更多人才能开始演出。我刚刚收到消息，我最出色的斗士之一——格拉斯·塔尔西丝，由于未还清债务，被一伙天使企业联合体暴徒拘禁在纳库加德这里的一个死亡空间。如果你能找到她，并将她毫发无损地带到我这儿，那么我就离重开竞技场并躲避罗述集团的怒火更进一步了。

他们把她关在他们老窝里的一个娱乐站中，那里的防御并不是太好。如果你能干掉守卫并炸毁娱乐站，那么你应该就能够带出她，并把她带回来。如果你能那么做，那么我将最最衷心地感谢你。

name.ja: グラディエーター―熟考の機会（1/2）
name.ru: Гладиаторы - дыхание космоса (Gladiators - Breathing Space) (1 из 2)

messages.en:
I own and operate a portable arena of cyboerians, cybernetically augmented gladiators who fight each other for show, demonstrating a wide range of Matari martial arts. I was having problems generating revenue in my old home, so I relocated to Nakugard.

Shortly after I got here, though, a problem reared its head. Obviously I'd underestimated the extent of influence wielded by the criminal element in this area. Within weeks, most of my fighters were strung out on various illicit drugs, and I've since had to close up shop. Can't have a show if you don't have performers. And to make matters worse, my contract with the Leisure Group is still in full effect; if I'm not generating my revenue they're not going to be happy, and we most definitely do not want the Leisure Group unhappy.

There are a few things I need to be able to get my arena up and running again. Among these is oxygen; I can't very well run the place if no one can breathe, you understand. If you can go out and find me 150 units of oxygen, I'd be much obliged.
messages.zh: 我拥有并经营着一个移动竞技场，有赛博人——机械植入增强的角斗士在里面相互争斗表演，展示各式各样的玛塔利武术。我在原来的地方经营时财政出了问题，所以我搬到了纳库加德。<br><br>不过在我到达这里后不久，一个问题出现了。我显然低估了这一地区犯罪分子的影响力范围。几周内，我的多数战士都沾染上了各种违规药品，因此我不得不停业。没有表演者，我的表演没法进行。更糟糕的是，我和罗述集团的合同还没有到期；如果我的财政情况不好，那么罗述集团一定不会满意，他们一旦生气就不好办了。<br><br>我需要采取些手段才能让竞技场重新营业。其中一个就是弄到氧气；如果谁都没法呼吸，那么我就没法良好地经营这个地方，你知道的。如果你能去给我找来150单位氧气，我会非常感激的。

name.en: Furthering the Cause - Keeping Tabs (1 of 3)
name.es: Lucha por la causa: Vigilancia estrecha (1 de 3)
name.fr: Au service de la cause – Opération de surveillance (1 sur 3)
name.ja: 大義のために―監視活動（1/3）
name.ru: Содействие делу - тайное наблюдение (Furthering the Cause - Keeping Tabs) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
A few words of introduction are probably in order. I'm Mattheu Rochet, an investment banker and sometime independent trader. I made my fortune a while back, trading robotics after the great capsuleer influx two years ago. Since then, I've been constantly seeking ways to further the cause of the Matari, a proud people with a tragic history for which proper reparations have not been made.

I recently decided to make the Ani constellation my stomping grounds. The situation here is an intriguing one; the simmering conflict between the Ammatar and the old Republic is more evident here than in most other places I've been to, and there is much good work that can be done. In fact, I have a job for you if you feel like lending a hand.

Some associates of mine have set up shop in the Barkrik system's Joint Harvesting Food Packaging stations. They are going to install some equipment so they can keep tabs on some of the shadier elements in there. I need you to bring them a shipment of electronic parts, which they can then use to assemble their covert surveillance gear. Do this quickly and efficiently, and I'll have another job for you.
messages.zh:
先简单自我介绍一下，我是玛特•萝希，一位投资银行家兼自由商人。两年前，在飞行热的背景下，通过买卖机器人，我大赚了一笔。从那以后，我想方设法为进一步实现玛塔利家族的理想而奋斗。这是饱经历史沧桑，理应获得更多补偿的一族人。

最近我决定去安妮星系大干一番。这里的情况很吸引人。艾玛达和旧共和国之间的内部冲突在此地彰显无疑，这一点我到过的其他任何地方都无法比拟，遍地都是机遇。实际上，如果你愿意的话，我正有一份工作给你呢。

我的某些合伙人已在巴尔克里克星系中的联合收割空间站开了商店。他们准备安装一些设备来监督那儿的交易情况。我要你把这些电子元件带给他们，这样他们就能装配隐藏的监视器。快去快回，我还有别的工作要你做。

name.de: Die Sache vorantreiben - In Bereitschaft (2 von 3)
name.en: Furthering the Cause - State of Readiness (2 of 3)
name.es: Lucha por la causa: Estado de alerta (2 de 3)
name.fr: Au service de la cause – Prêts ! (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 大義のために―戦闘準備（2/3）
name.ru: Содействие делу - уровень готовности (Furthering the Cause - State of Readiness) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
According to my sources, there are some interesting times ahead in the Nakugard system. A group of unscrupulous individuals is planning to illegally move in Matari slaves under the guise of contract workers. Some of my contacts in Nakugard are working towards fixing this problem their own way, but I want to have my people standing by in case worst comes to worst.

I have a shipment of small arms coming into the Sisters of EVE Bureau in Lanngisi. The Sisters themselves have nothing to do with it, of course, but they trust me enough to look the other way in this case. I need the weapons delivered to the Krusual Tribe bureau at Nakugard V, where my people will pick them up and put them to good use, if need be. Will you do this for me?
messages.zh:
据可靠消息，纳库加德星系中马上要出现一些有意思的事情了。一群肆无忌惮的人试图以劳务输入的方式非法引进玛塔利劳工。我在纳库加德的一些联系人正试着以自己的方式了结此事，但我必须派自己的人介入，以免事态继续恶化。

我有一批小型军械要送往朗基斯的姐妹会办事处。当然，姐妹共济会和这事情毫无瓜葛，但是她们非常信任我，所以对此事佯作未见。现在，我要把这些武器送到纳库加德V的克鲁夏部族处，以备日后所需。你愿替我做这件事情吗？

name.es: Lucha por la causa: Retirada (3 de 3)
name.fr: Au service de la cause – Le repli (3 sur 3)
name.ru: Содействие делу - ломка (Furthering the Cause - Withdrawal) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
I've just received word from one of my Nakugard associates that the group I mentioned earlier, the ones who are bringing in the slaves, have stashed away a sizable portion of Vitoc in one of the Joint Harvesting stations in Barkrik, presumably to keep better control of their "contracted labor." Fortunately some of the station personnel in there are on my payroll, so I've managed to have the whole load of it "confiscated."

If you head over there and bring the Vitoc back to the Sisters of EVE Bureau in Lanngisi, we will be one step closer to resoundingly sending out the message. You don't try to bring Minmatar slaves into this constellation, right under everybody's nose.
messages.zh:
我的一个纳库加德合伙人给我消息说，之前我提到的那个组织，那些运送劳工的家伙们，在巴尔克里克的一个联合收割空间站藏匿了大量崴砣柯，想以此控制他们手下的“合同工”。幸运的是，在那儿的有些空间站工作人员是我的人，因此我找他们把这些东西给“没收”了。

请你去那儿，把那些崴砣柯带回朗基斯的姐妹会办事处，我们迟早会揭露这些家伙令人发指的恶行。千万别在众目睽睽之下，将那些米玛塔尔劳工也带到这个星系来。

name.en: The Time of Science - Tools of the Trade (1 of 3)
name.es: El tiempo de la ciencia: Las herramientas de trabajo (1 de 3)
name.fr: L'ère de la science – Les outils (1 sur 3)
name.ja: ときの科学―機械の修理（1/3）
name.ru: Время науки - инструменты (The Time of Science - Tools of the Trade) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
I work for the Sanctuary, one of the universe's foremost research institutions. We've recently managed to unearth what we believe could be facts paving the way towards greater understanding of the EVE Gate and how it operates; why it is the way it is. For us to put this information to practical use, however, we require more research data. You seem like the competent type. If you can do a bit of leg work for me, I'll make sure you're rewarded - and you'll be able to rest knowing you did your part in moving the scientific knowledge of today that little bit further forward.

First off, we're getting in a new batch of recently discovered material from a moon in the New Eden system, but our maintenance budget has been running low and many of our tools are in a sad state of disrepair. I have a batch of repair equipment here; if you could see fit to running this over to the SOE Bureau in Lanngisi, I would be much obliged - and so would my staff.
messages.zh:
我为宇宙中最重要的研究所——避难会工作。我们最近成功找到一些关于新伊甸之门的信息，能帮助我们更好地理解星门、星门的运作方式以及运作的原因等问题。然而，要把这些信息投入到实际应用中还需要更多的研究数据。看起来你很适合这样的工作。如果你可以为我做一些工作的话，我肯定会给你报酬。其他人也会知道，你在推动当代科技发展中作出了自己的贡献。

首先，我们从新伊甸星系的一颗卫星中得到了一批新发现的材料，但我们的费用预算已经不多了，许多工具已年久失修。我这里有一些修复设备，如果你能将它们送到朗基斯的姐妹会办事处去，我和我的同事都会不胜感激。

name.de: Zeit der Wissenschaft - Ein Ort der Fürsorge (2 von 3)
name.en: The Time of Science - A Spot of Relief (2 of 3)
name.es: El tiempo de la ciencia: Punto de socorro (2 de 3)
name.fr: L'ère de la science – Les esclaves marrons (2 sur 3)
name.ja: ときの科学―安息の地に水を（2/3）
name.ru: Время науки - небольшое облегчение (The Time of Science - A Spot of Relief) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
I've just received word that our station in Lanngisi is about to receive an influx of escaped Matari slaves who have made their way from the depths of Amarr space after their colony was attacked and destroyed. I'm already pulling all the strings I can, but there's one fairly basic thing I seem to have forgotten. There's quite a number of them, and the station will need an extra supply of water.

If you can head down to our Bureau in Traun and pick up water for the newly freed, I will reward you handsomely. I am also likely to have more work for you.
messages.zh:
我刚刚收到消息说我们在朗基斯的空间站即将涌进大批逃亡的玛塔利劳工，这些可怜的家伙从遥远的艾玛空间而来，他们原来的居所遭到攻击，被摧毁了。我已尽可能提供帮助，但还是忘了一件基本的事情。他们的人数众多，所以空间站需要额外的水资源供给。

如果你能够去我们在塔拉文的办公处，为这些刚刚重获自由的劳工带一些水的话，我会给你丰厚的报酬。我也会给你更多的工作。

name.en: The Time of Science - Shelter (3 of 3)
name.es: El tiempo de la ciencia: Refugio (3 de 3)
name.fr: L'ère de la science – En sécurité (3 sur 3)
name.ru: Время науки - убежище (The Time of Science - Shelter) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
The Matari refugees are safe and sound now, thanks in no small part to your efforts. The next step for us is to build them some decent living facilities in Lanngisi. To this end we will require building materials.

We've placed a large order for construction blocks at the Joint Harvesting plant in Barkrik. We quite like the idea of their materials helping to build housing for the free people their nation so callously and brutally mistreated. Do this for me, and I will see to it that you are handsomely rewarded.
messages.zh:
玛塔利难民现在已经平安无事了，十分感谢你的努力。下一步我们要做的就是在朗基斯为他们建造一些像样的住宅设施。在这方面，我们需要建筑材料。

我们在巴尔克里克的联合收割工厂订购了一大批建造模块。用他们的材料来建造房子，给曾经被他们残酷虐待的人们居住——这是个不错的点子。帮我这个忙吧，我一定会给你丰厚的报酬。

name.de: Nachschub für die Kolonie - Schwieriges Terrain (2 von 3)
name.en: Supplies For The Colony - Tricky Terrain (2 of 3)
name.es: Suministros para la colonia: Un terreno difícil (2 de 3)
name.fr: Ravitaillement de la colonie – En terrain difficile (2 sur 3)
name.ja: コロニー支援―厄介な土地（2/3）
name.ru: Поставки в колонию - коварная территория (Supplies For The Colony - Tricky Terrain) (2 из 3)
name.zh: 殖民地的供应品—棘手的地形(2/3)

messages.en:
The settlers on Inder VIII are becoming increasingly restless due to travel delays on the planet. Simply put, most of them can't afford vehicles which are neccessary to travel through the inhospitable terrain which covers most of the planet. So I came up with a brilliant idea, why not start a rental service where they can rent cheap but effective planetary vehicles to use when neccessary? This will not only please the inhabitants but also make me some money.

I ordered a batch of planetary vehicles from Core Complexion. They are currently waiting to be shipped from {[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}, and I'd like you to do the dirty work for me, for a nice reward of course. I hope you're up to it, I don't want to have to turn to Freedom Extension for a courier job, they're convoys are so damn expensive these days.
messages.zh:
由于在星球上出行相当不便，因德尔VIII上的居民越来越不安宁。简而言之，他们中大多数人买不起穿越恶劣地形所需的交通工具，而这星球的大部分正是被这种地形所覆盖。所以我想到了一个绝妙的主意，为什么不开展一项租车业务，让大众在需要时可以租到便宜、高效的行星车辆呢？这不仅可以使民众满意，还能让我赚些钱。

我已经向核心局面公司订购了一批行星车辆。它们正在{[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}等待出货，我希望你去帮我跑这趟苦差，当然会有不错的奖赏。希望你可以帮我这个忙，我不想为了这个运输工作向自由扩张集团请求帮助，他们的护航队最近开价很离谱呢。

name.de: Nachschub für die Kolonie -  Für die Polizei (3 von 3)
name.en: Supplies For The Colony - For The Police (3 of 3)
name.es: Suministros para la colonia: Por la policía (3 de 3)
name.fr: Ravitaillement de la colonie – Pour la police (3 sur 3)
name.ja: コロニー支援―治安維持（3/3）
name.ru: Поставки в колонию - для полиции (Supplies For The Colony - For The Police) (3 из 3)
name.zh: 殖民地的供应品—装备警察(3/3)

messages.en:
Crime has run rampant on Inder VIII since it was first settled, mainly due to the extreme lack of law enforcement officers on the planet's surface. Therefore I made a formal suggestion to the Republic Security Forces to relocate some of their personnel here. They agreed to send some of their recruits, but only under the agreement that Urban Management supply them with the necessary equipment.

Most of their equipment has already arrived, but there is one last batch of small arms that hasn't made it here yet. I'd like you to fetch it for me in a jiffy, it will save me the expenses and hassle of ordering another convoy through our bureau.
messages.zh:
自从第一批移民到达因德尔VIII，这里就成为了犯罪活动猖獗之地，其主要原因是这个星球严重缺少执法官员。因此，我向共和国安全部队提出了一项正式建议，要求他们调派一些人员过来。他们答应派一些新人过来，但条件是市政管理局要为派来的人员提供必要的装备。

大部分装备都已运达，但还有最后一批小型军械没到。我希望你马上去替我把它们取来，这样我就不用通过署里再雇佣一支护航队，可以省下不少开销和麻烦。

messages.en: Well, that was the last job I have for you this time, {[character]player.name}.  I can't thank you enough, you saved me a ton of hassle dealing with those damn bureaucrats back in Abudban, it takes forever and a day to get anything done through them.  Farewell.
messages.zh: 好吧，这是我给你的最后一个任务了，{[character]player.name}。我真不知道怎么感谢你，多亏了你我才能避免与可恶的阿布德班官僚主义者大量的唇舌之争，通过他们永远也完不成任务。保重。

name.de: Test der Kompetenz - Utrainens Berichte (1 von 2)
name.en: The Test Of Competence - Utrainen's Reports (1 of 2)
name.es: La prueba de competencia: Los informes de Utrainen (1 de 2)
name.fr: Le test de compétence – Les rapports d'Utrainen (1 sur 2)
name.ja: 適性試験―ユトレイネンのレポート（1/2）
name.ru: Проверка компетентности - отчеты Utrainen (The Test Of Competence - Utrainen's Reports) (1 из 2)
name.zh: 能力测试—尤堂恩的报告(1/2)

messages.en:
The trial consists of 2 tests. The first test is rather simple. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has set up some practice grounds in Otomainen where our combat pilots train every day. Inside one of these practice grounds you'll find a group of drones, similar to the rogue drones that keep harassing Caldari convoys in the outer constellations. If you manage to destroy all of these drones, you'll find some reports that you must bring back to me. These reports contain nothing of importance, they are just part of the test. Once I have the reports, you will have passed the test.

Just a word of warning though, I've already sent a few pilots on this test and none of them have returned. You might find the wreckage of their ships at the practice grounds, that is unless they fled before the drones managed to destroy them heh heh.
messages.zh:
这次飞行包含两步测试。 第一步很简单， {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}在欧塔迈伦星系里开设了一些训练场，供我们的战斗飞行员进行每日的训练。 你会在其中一个训练场里找到一群无人机，像自由无人机一样，他们在周边星座持续骚扰加达里护航舰队。 把他们都干掉，你会找到一份报告，把它带回来给我。 这份报告的内容并不重要，只是用于测试。 我拿到报告，你就通过了测试。

不过还是要告诫你，我曾派多位飞行员前往，很遗憾，他们都有去无回。 你可能会在训练场里发现他们舰船的残骸。他们没能及时逃脱，被无人机击毁了，呵呵。

messages.en: Well, you surprise me {[character]player.name}, I didn't think I'd ever find someone as capable as you in this crap-hole of a system.  But before I hand over the voucher, there's just one more thing you need to do for me.
messages.zh: 你真让我吃惊，{[character]player.name}。没想到在这样一个下三滥的星系里还能找到像你这样能干的人。但是你要为我再做一件事情，我才可以把凭证交给你。

name.de: Test der Kompetenz - Die umherstreunenden Briganten (2 von 2)
name.en: The Test Of Competence - The Roaving Brigands (2 of 2)
name.es: La prueba de competencia: Los bandoleros errantes (2 de 2)
name.fr: Le test de compétence – Des brigands gênants (2 sur 2)
name.ru: Тест на компетентность - бродячие бандиты (The Test Of Competence - The Roaving Brigands) (2 из 2)

messages.en:
The final test that I need you to complete is a bit more complicated. One of the major pirate organizations in Okkelen are the Kazka Bandits. They are a constant thorn in our side, and the inadequate security forces here don't seem to have the capacity to exterminate them.

To get straight to the point, I would like you to destroy 5 of their lower-grade cruisers. Bring me the spurs from their pilot's boots, that will be proof enough of your deed. Unlike your previous mission, I don't know exactly where you'll find them. I heard that one of their hideouts is located near one of Otomainen XI's moons, but that's all I know. Return to me once you have all 5 marauder spurs.

I know this might seem like a pain in the rear-end, but I can't give you that voucher unless I know that you've got the skills to track down the prey, sometimes that's required in case we don't have a bookmark to the exact location of your targets. If you can get this done then I'm sure you have what it takes to do any of our missions.
messages.zh:
我要你完成的最后一个测试要复杂一些。卡兹卡强盗是欧克勒恩最主要的海盗组织之一。他们一直是我们的眼中钉、肉中刺，但这里人数有限的安全部队根本无力全歼他们。

我就直奔主题吧，我希望你摧毁他们的5艘较低级别的巡洋舰。把他们飞行员靴子上的马刺带回来作为你行动成功的证明。与之前任务不同的是，这次我不知道他们的具体位置。我听说他们有个藏身地在欧塔迈伦XI的一个卫星附近，我就知道这么些。一旦搜齐五个马刺，马上带回来给我。

我知道这事让人不爽，但在确认你有追捕猎物的能力之前，我不能把那张凭证给你。有时候我们无法提供目标的精确位置，所以追击能力就显得必不可少。如果你把这事办成了，我就确信你有能力完成我们的任何任务。

messages.en: You've completed the trial and are now free to take a few of the vouchers next to my desk.  Some of the agents working for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} require you to hand in one of these vouchers before they'll give you a mission, so I suggest you keep them safe.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 你已经通过了考验，现在你可以从我这里取得一些担保凭证了。一些为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}工作的代理人会要求你出示某个凭证，然后才给你任务，建议你妥善保存它们。祝你好运。

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: I'll be expecting those tags soon.  With your track record, I'm sure I won't be disappointed.
messages.zh: 我想很快就能拿到这些铭牌了。以你的跟踪能力，一定能马到成功。

messages.en: Yes, that's right, I'm here to ... ah ... collect my blueprint.

messages.en:
We have a policy here within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} that our more prominent members fly a suitable ship according to their status, both to give them an edge during combat and to uphold our image, especially within our borders. We have recently decided to extend this benefit to mercenaries or freelancers employed by us that have shown admirable bravery and skill in the field, or earned the right through countless hours of dedicated service to our corporations.

As you undoubtedly already know I have been assigned the task of allocating these ships to their deserved owners. After looking at your record, we decided that you, {[character]player.name}, are worthy of such an honor. There is just one catch, since you aren't an official member we need something in exchange for this gift. Cough up {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity} and the {[item]rewardTypeID.name} is yours.

Dismissed
messages.zh:
我们在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}内部有一条政策：杰出成员需要驾驶与其地位相符的飞船，这既使他们在战斗中占有优势，又能提升我们的形象，尤其是在境内的形象。最近，我们决定将这项政策的受惠对象扩大到一些我们聘用的雇佣兵或自由飞行员，他们要么在战场上展示了令人敬佩的勇气和技术，要么就是长期为我们集团提供了难以计数的敬业服务。

你一定已经知道了，我被任命将这些飞船分配给它们当之无愧的主人。在看了你的记录后，我们认为你，{[character]player.name}，应当获此殊荣。现在只有一个小小的问题，由于你不是正式成员，这件礼物需要拿一些东西来换。拿{[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}来，然后{[item]rewardTypeID.name}就是你的了。<br><br>讲完

你一定已经知道了，我被任命将这些飞船分配给它们当之无愧的主人。在看了你的记录后，我们认为你，{[character]player.name}，应当获此殊荣。现在只有一个小小的问题，由于你不是正式成员，这件礼物需要拿一些东西来换。拿{[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}来，然后{[item]rewardTypeID.name}就是你的了。<br><br>讲完

messages.en: Enjoy your reward, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 这是你应得的，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
We have a policy here within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} that our more prominent members fly a suitable ship according to their status, both to give them an edge during combat and to uphold our image, especially within our borders. We have recently decided to extend this benefit to mercenaries or freelancers employed by us that have shown admirable bravery and skill in the field, or earned the right through countless hours of dedicated service to our corporations.

As you undoubtedly already know I have been assigned the task of allocating these ships to their deserved owners. After looking at your record, we decided that you, {[character]player.name}, are worthy of such an honor. There is just one catch, since you aren't an official member we need something in exchange for this gift. Cough up {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity} and the {[item]rewardTypeID.name} is yours.

Dismissed

messages.en: Yes, that's right, I'm here to ... ah ... collect my blueprint.
messages.zh: 没错，我来这里……呃……收集蓝图。

messages.en:
We have a policy here within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} that our more prominent members fly a suitable ship according to their status, both to give them an edge during combat and to uphold our image, especially within our borders. We have recently decided to extend this benefit to mercenaries or freelancers employed by us that have shown admirable bravery and skill in the field, or earned the right through countless hours of dedicated service to our corporations.

As you undoubtedly already know I have been assigned the task of allocating these ships to their deserved owners. After looking at your record, we decided that you, {[character]player.name}, are worthy of such an honor. There is just one catch, since you aren't an official member we need something in exchange for this gift. Cough up {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity} and the {[item]rewardTypeID.name} is yours.

Dismissed
messages.zh:
我们在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}内部有一条政策：杰出成员需要驾驶与其地位相符的飞船，这既使他们在战斗中占有优势，又能提升我们的形象，尤其是在境内的形象。最近，我们决定将这项政策的受惠对象扩大到一些我们聘用的雇佣兵或自由飞行员，他们要么在战场上展示了令人敬佩的勇气和技术，要么就是长期为我们集团提供了难以计数的敬业服务。

你一定已经知道了，我被任命将这些飞船分配给它们当之无愧的主人。在看了你的记录后，我们认为你，{[character]player.name}，应当获此殊荣。现在只有一个小小的问题，由于你不是正式成员，这件礼物需要拿一些东西来换。拿{[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}来，然后{[item]rewardTypeID.name}就是你的了。<br><br>讲完
