We have a policy here within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} that our more prominent members fly a suitable ship according to their status, both to give them an edge during combat and to uphold our image, especially within our borders. We have recently decided to extend this benefit to mercenaries or freelancers employed by us that have shown admirable bravery and skill in the field, or earned the right through countless hours of dedicated service to our corporations.

As you undoubtedly already know I have been assigned the task of allocating these ships to their deserved owners. After looking at your record, we decided that you, {[character]player.name}, are worthy of such an honor. There is just one catch, since you aren't an official member we need something in exchange for this gift. Cough up {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity} and the {[item]rewardTypeID.name} is yours.

Dismissed
messages.zh:
我们在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}内部有一条政策：杰出成员需要驾驶与其地位相符的飞船，这既使他们在战斗中占有优势，又能提升我们的形象，尤其是在境内的形象。最近，我们决定将这项政策的受惠对象扩大到一些我们聘用的雇佣兵或自由飞行员，他们要么在战场上展示了令人敬佩的勇气和技术，要么就是长期为我们集团提供了难以计数的敬业服务。

你一定已经知道了，我被任命将这些飞船分配给它们当之无愧的主人。在看了你的记录后，我们认为你，{[character]player.name}，应当获此殊荣。现在只有一个小小的问题，由于你不是正式成员，这件礼物需要拿一些东西来换。拿{[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}来，然后{[item]rewardTypeID.name}就是你的了。<br><br>讲完

messages.en: Yes, that's right, I'm here to ... ah ... collect my implant.
messages.zh: 没错，我来这里……呃……收集植入体。

messages.en:
We have a policy here within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} that our more prominent members use certain implants to boost their mental ability, since it's important that our people in key positions perform at a level above what's considered normal for a human being. It's a competitive world we live in, and sometimes one has to take risks to achieve one's goals, even if it means meddling with the brain.

You may not be a full-fledged member of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, but you've created such a name for yourself that we feel obliged to treat you as one of our own. And considering your record, we feel that our policy pertains to you as well. So I've been authorized to give you this implant in exchange for one simple task. Bring me a few insignias and the reward is yours.
messages.zh:
我们在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}内部有一项政策：杰出成员需要使用某些植入体来增强他们的智力，因为身居要位的人必须比常人拥有更高的水平，这点非常重要。我们生活在一个竞争激烈的世界里，有时候为了实现目标，必须要冒险，这甚至包括摆弄我们的大脑。

也许你并不是{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}里完全名正言顺的成员，但你现在名气如此响亮，我们觉得必须将你视为我们当中的一员。鉴于你的优秀记录，我们觉得这项政策对你也适用。所以我获准将这个植入体授予你，只要拿一件简单的任务做交换即可。给我带些徽章回来，奖励就是你的。

messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: I'll be expecting those tags soon. With your track record, I'm sure I won't be disappointed.
messages.zh: 我想很快就能拿到这些铭牌了。以你的跟踪能力，一定能马到成功。

messages.en: Yes, that's right, I'm here to ... ah ... collect my implant.
messages.zh: 没错，我来这里……呃……收集植入体。

messages.en:
We have a policy here within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} that our more prominent members use certain implants to boost their mental ability, since it's important that our people in key positions perform at a level above what's considered normal for a human being. It's a competitive world we live in, and sometimes one has to take risks to achieve one's goals, even if it means meddling with the brain.

You may not be a full-fledged member of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, but you've created such a name for yourself that we feel obliged to treat you as one of our own. And considering your record, we feel that our policy pertains to you as well. So I've been authorized to give you this implant in exchange for one simple task. Bring me a few insignias and the reward is yours.
messages.zh:
我们在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}内部有一项政策：杰出成员需要使用某些植入体来增强他们的智力，因为身居要位的人必须比常人拥有更高的水平，这点非常重要。我们生活在一个竞争激烈的世界里，有时候为了实现目标，必须要冒险，这甚至包括摆弄我们的大脑。

messages.en: Enjoy your reward, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 这是你应得的，{[character]player.name}。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Übergabe des Belegs (1 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, Hand In The Voucher (1 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: Entrega el comprobante (1 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Présentation du coupon (1 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、証明書の提出（1/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - вручение ваучера (The Audesder War Effort, Hand In The Voucher) (1 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，上交凭证 (1/8)

messages.en: I would like to help out with the war against the Minmatar alliance.
messages.zh: 我想为讨伐米玛塔尔同盟的战争出一份力。

messages.en: Bring me a voucher from one of the recruiters nearby and you're in.
messages.zh: 把凭证给我，你就是我们的一份子了。

messages.en: Here's your voucher, General.
messages.zh: 将军，这就是你要的凭证。

messages.en: Good.  Now let's get started on your assignments.
messages.zh: 好的。现在开始谈你的任务吧。

messages.en: I see.  Bring me a voucher from one of the recruiters nearby and you're in.
messages.zh: 我明白了。把凭证给我，你就是我们的一份子了。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Die Gallente-Spionagedrohnen (2 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, The Gallente Spy Drones (2 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: Drones espía gallentes (2 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Les drones espions gallente (2 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、ガレンテのスパイドローン（2/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - шпионские дроны Gallente (The Audesder War Effort, The Gallente Spy Drones) (2 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，盖伦特侦察无人机(2/8)

messages.en: I expect you back here with your ship in pristine condition.
messages.zh: 我希望你和自己的飞船都能安然无恙的回来。

messages.en: So what's my first mission, boss?
messages.zh: 头儿，那么我的第一个任务是什么？

messages.en: Your first assignment is to intercept a group of spy drones that the Gallente have deployed in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  They are guarded by a few Federation Navy cruisers and an interceptor.  They probably haven't figured out that we have them on our radar, so they won't be expecting you.  With the element of surprise on your side, this should be an easy job.
messages.zh: 你的第一个任务就是拦截盖伦特在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}部署的侦察无人机群。它们由几艘联邦海军巡洋舰和一艘截击舰守卫。他们可能还不知道自己已经在我们的雷达范围之内了，所以料不到你会去那。你可以出奇制胜，这个任务不会很难。

messages.en: The spy drones are no more, as you requested General.
messages.zh: 正如你要求的那样，这些侦察无人机已被彻底消灭了，将军。

messages.en: Good work.  Now on to you're next assignment.
messages.zh: 干得好。下面，讲讲你的下一个任务。

messages.en: Your first assignment is to intercept a group of spy drones that the Gallente have deployed in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  They are guarded by a few Federation Navy cruisers and an interceptor.  They probably haven't figured out that we have them on our radar, so they won't be expecting you.  With the element of surprise on your side, this should be an easy job.
messages.zh: 你的第一个任务就是拦截盖伦特在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}部署的侦察无人机群。几艘盖伦特标准护卫舰和截击舰在为那些侦察无人机护航。它们做梦都不会想到自己的行踪早在我们的雷达屏幕上显示得一清二楚。你去打他们个措手不及，所以这个任务不会太困难。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Der Ammatar-Verräter (3 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, The Ammatar Traitor (3 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: El traidor ammatariano (3 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre Audesder – Le traître ammatar (3 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、アマターの裏切り者（3/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - Предатель Ammatar (The Audesder War Effort, The Ammatar Traitor) (3 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，艾玛达叛徒 (3/8)

messages.en: And the next assignment is?
messages.zh: 那么下一个任务是？

messages.en: Our intelligence agency has informed us of an Ammatar traitor in our midst.  Apparently he's been collaborating with the Minmatar Republic, supplying them with information and even hiring mercenaries to sabotage our operation here.  I want you to locate him and take him out.  Our last reports indicate that he is most likely hiding near one of the moons within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.You will need a probe launcher to pinpoint his location. Once the job is done, return to me with something from his ship and I'll give you your reward.  Dismissed.
messages.zh: 我们的情报机构报告，在我们中间有一个艾玛达叛徒。  这家伙与米玛塔尔共和国相勾结，向他们提供情报，甚至招募了雇佣兵来破坏我们在这儿的行动。  我要你找到并除掉他。  最新的报告显示，他很有可能藏在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的某个卫星附近。你需要装配探针发射器使用探针找到他的藏身之所。任务完成之后，带一些他飞船上的东西给我，我会付你报酬。  快去吧。

messages.en: The traitor has been taken care of.
messages.zh: 这个叛徒已经被除掉了。

messages.en: Nice job, with him off our backs we can rest more easily here in Fort Kumar.  Now get ready for another assignment.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，除掉了这个人，我们就可以在库马尔要塞睡个好觉了。那么，准备好接受下一个任务吧。

messages.en: Find and eliminate Oggiin Kalda near one of Kenobanala's moons.
messages.zh: 在科诺巴纳拉的某个卫星附近找到并消灭奥金•卡尔达。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 目标

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Den Spion einschleusen (4 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, Planting The Spy (4 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: El espía infiltrado (4 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Infiltrer l'espion (4 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、スパイの配備（4/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - внедрение шпиона (The Audesder War Effort, Planting The Spy) (4 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，安插间谍(4/8)

messages.en: What's next?
messages.zh: 下一步呢？

messages.en:
It's time to send you into the front lines, {[character]player.name}. Yes that means flying into Audesder. It will be dangerous, there's no doubt about that. But I'm sure you're prepared for those kind of risks, considering you signed up for this job in the first place.

Your first task in Audesder is in fact to fly through Audesder, to Aedald. Our intelligence agency wants to place a spy inside their base, to gather intel on their defensive positions, plans and such. It's too risky sending him straight into the Alliance Barracks, so we're going to start with dropping him off at one of their stations in Aedald, where he'll hitch a ride on one of their ships heading to the barracks in Audesder. That's all you need to know for now, {[character]player.name}.

Drop him off at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, then hurry back here. Try not to be seen by the enemy, or you might compromise our agent's mission. Good luck.
messages.zh:
是时候派你到前线去了，{[character]player.name}。没错，这意味着你要飞入奥德斯代尔。毫无疑问，这会很危险。但你当初既然跟我们签了这份工作的协议，我肯定你对这类风险也早有准备。

实际上，你在奥德斯代尔的第一个任务是穿过奥德斯代尔到达埃伊达特。我们的情报部门想在那个基地里安插一个间谍，专门搜集关于他们防御位置、计划之类的情报。把他直接送到联盟兵营风险太大，所以我们打算先把他放到埃伊达特的某个空间站里，然后他可以在那里搭乘一艘去奥德斯代尔兵营的飞船。目前你就需要知道这么多，{[character]player.name}。

把他带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, 后尽快回来。尽量不要让敌人发现，否则我们特工的任务就难以完成了。祝好运。

messages.en: I have completed the mission, General.
messages.zh: 将军，我已经完成任务了。

messages.en: Excellent!  You're really something, {[character]player.name}.  You should consider joining the Imperial Navy sometime, as a full fledged member.  Kezti Sundara would be pleased.  But don't leave yet, I have more work for you.
messages.zh: 非常好！  真不赖，{[character]player.name}。  你可以考虑什么时候加入帝国海军了，因为你已经是一个老鸟了。  克兹迪•苏恩达拉会非常高兴的。  不过先别急着走，我还有更多任务给你。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Ihre Überwachungseinrichtungen beschädigen (5 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, Damaging Their Surveillance Capabilities (5 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: Su capacidad de vigilancia mermada (5 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Endommager le matériel de surveillance (5 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、監視施設の破壊（5/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - нарушение работы их разведки (The Audesder War Effort, Damaging Their Surveillance Capabilities) (5 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，打击敌方监控能力 (5/8)

messages.en: So now what?
messages.zh: 那么现在做什么呢？

messages.en:
This time I'd like you to do something a little more daring. The Gallente have set up a high-tech surveillance tower inside Audesder, which has allowed them to find every single one of our spy drones in the system, greatly hindering our intelligence gathering of their forces. It will take them a while to rebuild the tower after you demolish it, giving us time to gather some intel and possibly launch a sneak attack.

I'll give you the coordinates of the surveillance tower. All you have to do is fly over there and take it out. Good luck.
messages.zh:
这次我要你做些更为冒险的事。 盖伦特在奥德斯代尔内部建造了一个高科技监视塔，其精密程度足以使我们星系内任何一架谍报无人机无所遁形。我们的情报搜集工作不能因此受阻。 我希望你去摧毁这座塔，相信重建这座塔会花上他们一段时间，我们又能趁此收集情报，甚至还能发动一次偷袭。

我会给你这座监视塔的位标，你所要做的就是飞到那里，然后把它摧毁。 祝你好运。

messages.en: The surveillance tower has been destroyed, as you requested, General.
messages.zh: 将军，根据你要求的，监视塔已被摧毁。

messages.en: I'm impressed.  Again you've come through.  Our war effort will benefit greatly from your assistance, I'm sure.
messages.zh: 我被打动了。你又过关了。我确信我们的战争成就很大程度上将得益于你的协助。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Die Rettung des Spions (6 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, Recovering the Spy (6 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: El espía de vuelta (6 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Récupération de l'espion (6 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、スパイの救出（6/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - эвакуация шпиона (The Audesder War Effort, Recovering the Spy) (6 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，收回间谍 (6/8)

messages.en: I'm ready for another mission.
messages.zh: 我已经为接受另外的任务做好了准备。

messages.en:
It's time to retrieve the secret agent you delivered into Minmatar space earlier. He's currently located inside their main base in Audesder, called ‘Alliance Barracks'. It's filled with Gallente and Minmatar ships, and perhaps mercenaries like you as well. It will be extremely dangerous, {[character]player.name}. But if we don't get this done quickly, not only will the intelligence operation we put weeks of effort in be for nothing, our agent will also most assuredly be executed.

He will most likely be located inside one of the Minmatar bunkers. Get him out of there in one piece. Good luck.
messages.zh:
现在是时候把你之前送到米玛塔尔空间的特工接回来了。他目前在奥德斯代尔里一个被称为“联盟兵营”的主基地里。那里到处都是盖伦特和米玛塔尔的舰船，可能也有像你这样的雇佣兵。那地方极其危险，{[character]player.name}。若不赶快行动，不但我们花了数周时间经营的情报计划将付之东流，我们的特工也极有可能被处死。

他很可能位于其中一个米玛塔尔碉堡里。把他安全带出那里。祝你好运。

messages.en: I have the secret agent, General, safe and unharmed.
messages.zh: 我把特工带回来了，将军，他毫发无损。

messages.en: Very well done, {[character]player.name}.  But there's more to be done!
messages.zh: 干得真不错，{[character]player.name}。不过还有更多任务要去做。

messages.en: Retrieve the secret agent from one of the bunkers in the Alliance Barracks within Audesder.  Destroying it should not be neccessary.
messages.zh: 从奥德斯代尔联盟兵营的某个碉堡中救出这个特工。不一定非要摧毁碉堡。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en:
It's time to retrieve the secret agent you delivered into Minmatar space earlier. He's currently located inside their main base in Audesder, called ‘Alliance Barracks'. It's filled with Gallente and Minmatar ships, and perhaps mercenaries like you as well. It will be extremely dangerous, {[character]player.name}. But if we don't get this done quickly, not only will the intelligence operation we put weeks of effort in be for nothing, our agent will also most assuredly be executed.

He will most likely be located inside one of the Minmatar bunkers. Get him out of there in one piece. Good luck.
messages.zh:
是时候把你之前送到米玛塔尔太空的特工接回来了。他目前在奥德斯代尔里一个称为“联盟兵营”的主基地里。那里到处都是盖伦特和米玛塔尔的飞船，也有像你一样的佣兵，前途颇为艰险，{[character]player.name}。但若不赶快行动，我们数周以来为情报工作所挥洒的汗水将付之东流，而且我们的特工也极有可能被处死。

他很可能藏在其中一个米玛塔尔碉堡里。把他毫发无伤地从那里救出来。祝你好运！

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Durchbrechen der Blockade (7 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, Striking At The Blockade (7 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: Abajo el bloqueo (7 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Attaque du blocus (7 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、封鎖突破（7/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - удар по блокаде (The Audesder War Effort, Striking At The Blockade) (7 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，打破封锁 (7/8)

messages.en: What's next?
messages.zh: 下一步呢？

messages.en:
This next mission will most likely be the hardest you've done so far. As you probably know by now, the Minmatar forces have set up a blockade at the main jump gate into Audesder, which they call the 'Minmatar Alliance Defense Brigade'. It's located not far from the stargate itself, and they are equipped with a short-range surveillance tower enabling them to detect any movement of our forces through the gate at all times. Mercenaries like you can generally get past them unhindered, but any official Amarrian strike force sent through there would have to face them or be destroyed.

To get to the point, I want to weaken the Minmatar position near the gate. The best way to do that is to take out their command post, it's destruction will hopefully send them into a disarray, giving us a hefty advantage when we launch our sneak attack. Bring me the Command Post's Bluechip as proof of your deed. Good luck.
messages.zh:
这个新任务可能是你迄今为止遇到的最大挑战。或许你已经知道，米玛塔尔军队在通往奥德斯代尔的主要跃迁通道附近部署了封锁部队，他们称其为“米玛塔尔联盟防御旅”。他们就部署在离星门不远处，配备有近距离监视塔，能够随时侦察到我们部队穿越星门的行动。像你这样的雇佣兵通常能够顺利通过，但是派往那里的任何正式艾玛武装部队都不得不与他们正面交锋，甚至被摧毁。

言归正传，我想削弱星门附近米玛塔尔阵地的战略优势。达到这个目的的最好方法就是摧毁他们的指挥哨站，这么做有望使他们阵脚大乱，这样我们在发动偷袭时就能占据巨大优势。把指挥哨站的蓝色筹码带回来作为行动成功的证明。祝你好运。

messages.en: The command post has been destroyed, as you requested General.
messages.zh: 将军，如你所愿，指挥站已被摧毁。

messages.en: Great work, soldier!  Now only one assignment remains, which happens to be critical to our military operation in Audesder.  Get ready for the fight of your life!
messages.zh: 太出色了，士兵！现在只剩一个任务了，而这刚好对我们在奥德斯代尔的军事行动至关重要。准备好殊死搏斗吧！

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Die Dreadnought-Fertigungsanlage (8 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, The Dreadnought Manufacturing Facility (8 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: La fábrica de superacorazados (8 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder - L'usine de production de dreadnoughts (8 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、攻城艦製造施設（8/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - завод по строительству дредноутов (The Audesder War Effort, The Dreadnought Manufacturing Facility) (8 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，无畏战舰生产设施(8/8)

messages.en: I'm ready.
messages.zh: 我准备好了。

messages.en:
I hope you are, {[character]player.name}, I hope you are … As I mentioned before, this last mission is critical to our campaign. It will definitely test your mettle in battle, and I am certain that you will need backup to complete the assignment. Unfortunately I won't be sending any of my own guys with you, that would most likely compromise the mission anyway, so I do hope you have some merc friends along for the ride.

Your task is to commandeer a full scale assault on the Minmatar Dreadnought Manufacturing Facility in Audesder. It's a massive installation, funded by ORE, the Gallente Federation, the Minmatar Republic and various other allies of theirs. It allows them to quickly build their dreadnought ships and deploy them immediately, with devastating effect on the battle field. If we take it out, it will seriously cripple their war effort, for some at least until they manage to build another one. This should give us the edge we need to attain victory.

You have your orders, {[character]player.name}, now make us proud. May God be with you.
messages.zh:
我希望你能，{[character]player.name}，我希望你能……正象我之前提到的那样，这最后的任务对我们这个战役的成败至关重要。你将面临一场严峻考验，完成这个任务，你需要有后援，这一点我很肯定。但是我不会派自己的人与你同往，这会使我的计划功亏一篑，所以我很希望你的朋友跟你一起去接受这个挑战。

你的任务是全力攻击米玛塔尔在奥德斯代尔的无畏级战舰生产设施。这设施规模巨大，由ORE，盖伦特联邦，米玛塔尔共和国及其它盟军共同出资建造。有了这种设施，他们就能快速建造出无畏级战舰，并立刻对之进行部署，使其能在战场上大显威力。如果我们将设施摧毁，无疑会严重削弱他们的战斗力，在他们设法重建一个前，共和国的军力都会维持在一个比较低的水平，这样我们离成功也就只有一步之遥了。

{[character]player.name}，这是给你的命令，现在为了我们的自豪而战吧。愿上帝与你同在。

messages.en: The dreadnought manufacturing installation has been destroyed.
messages.zh: 无畏级战舰生产设施已被摧毁。

messages.en: Amazing!  I'm at a loss for words ... You accomplished something even the old Amarrian war heroes would be proud of!  I hope you enjoy your reward, you've most definitely earned it.  God be with you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 真不可思议！我都不知道该说什么好了……你完成的任务就连艾玛的老战斗英雄都会为之骄傲！我希望你对报酬满意，你绝对受之无愧。愿神与你同在，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: This mission is much harder than any of the previous ones. Do not attempt it without serious backup!
messages.zh: 这个任务比之前的任何任务都要难得多。如果没有重兵后援，你千万不要尝试！

messages.en: Warning
messages.zh: 警告

It will definitely test your mettle in battle, and I am certain that you will need backup to complete the assignment. {[character]player.name}，这是给你的命令，现在为了我们的自豪而战吧。愿上帝与你同在。

messages.en: This is outrageous!  I've stuck my neck out for you guys time and time again, yet I still have to prove myself!?
messages.zh: 这实在太过分了！我一次又一次为你们卖命，我却还得证明自己的实力和诚意！？

messages.en:
This assignment has been created as a mandatory test to ensure all personnel are adequately equipped and ready for the tasks ahead. Failure is unacceptable.

The assignment is simple, and should be completed within 1 hour's time. A group of rogue drones have been activated in the Imperial Navy's testing area within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. Each carries a certification result sheet which will be ejected from its interior as soon as it is destroyed. Recover 5 of these sheets and bring them back to your contact. That is all.

- Minas Iksan
messages.zh:
本次任务是一次强制性测试，目的在于确保所有人员都装备齐全并为将来的任务做好了准备。 失败是不能接受的。

任务很简单，必须在1小时内完成。 一群自由无人机活跃在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的帝国海军测试区。 每架无人机都携带了一张认证结果表，将在其被击毁时从内部弹出。 取回5张这种表格，然后带回给你的联系人。 就这些。

- 米纳斯•伊卡萨恩

messages.en: As I suspected, you're up for the job, {[character]player.name}.  Here's the voucher, bring it to General Minas Iksan, and he'll give you your next assignment.  He's located within the Central Control Tower in Fort Kumar.  Good luck out there, soldier.
messages.zh: 正如我所料，你果然胜任这份工作，{[character]player.name}。这是凭证，带给伊松•蒂亚达拉督军，她会给你下一个任务。他正在库马尔要塞的中央控制塔中。祝你好运，士兵。

messages.en: Do not speak with General Minas unless you have powerful friends at your disposal. Although Minas will begin by sending you into fairly easy encounters, once he's satisfied with your performance you will be sent straight into fleet battles, which I doubt you will be able to face alone and survive. And as my final word of advice, take care not to enter Minmatar space when criminally flagged by their security forces. It will mean certain death.
messages.zh: 除非你有强大的朋友协助，否则不要跟米纳斯将军说话。米纳斯一开始会给你一些相当简单的战斗任务，一旦他对你的表现满意，就会直接把你派到舰队战中，我怀疑你能否独自应对，甚至可能性命堪忧。最后一句忠告，要是你被米玛塔尔安全部队认定为罪犯，那么注意别进入米玛塔尔的空间。不然你必死无疑。

messages.en: {[character]agentID.name}'s Advice
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}的忠告

messages.en:
Ahem, I'm really sorry if I insulted you, {[character]player.name}, but there's nothing I can do about this. I was given the order to test EVERYONE before we send them out into the fray, and if I would ignore that order I risk being demoted. I hope you understand, Minas is very strict about us following his orders.

Now you'll find the details of your test assignment in the briefing which I'm about to load into your NeoCom. Complete the assignment, which I'm sure you'll do in no time, and I'll send you off to the general. And don't forget to read the advice I've added to the mission details in your Opportunities interface. Good luck.
messages.zh:
咳咳，{[character]player.name}，如果我冒犯了你，那我道歉，但我真的无能为力。我奉命对每个人进行测试，然后他们才能被派去战场，如果我无视命令，我很可能得降级。米纳斯非常注重手底下的人能否服从命令，希望你能谅解。

我会把检查任务详情上传到你的控制边栏，这样你就能在任务描述里看到了。你肯定能很快完成任务，等你回来我就带你去见将军。记得看看我在“机遇”界面的任务详情里提供的建议。祝你好运。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Der Beleg (1 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, The Voucher (1 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: El comprobante (1 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Le coupon (1 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、証明書（1/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - Ваучер (The Audesder War Effort, The Voucher) (1 из 8)

messages.en: Don't forget to let me know when you have the voucher.
messages.zh: 当你拿到凭证时，不要忘记告诉我。

messages.en: I would like to help out with the war against the Amarrian alliance.
messages.zh: 我想为讨伐艾玛联盟的战争出一份力。

messages.en: Bring me a voucher from one of the recruiters nearby and you're in.
messages.zh: 把凭证给我，你就是我们的一份子了。

messages.en: Here's the voucher, Warlord.
messages.zh: 督军，这是凭证。

messages.en: Good.  Now let's get started on your assignments.
messages.zh: 很好。现在开始执行你的任务吧。

messages.en: I see.  Bring me a voucher from one of the recruiters nearby and you're in.
messages.zh: 好吧。把凭证给我，你就是我们的一份子了。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Die Propaganda beenden (2 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, End The Propaganda (2 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: Fin de la propaganda (2 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – En finir avec la propagande (2 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、放送機関の破壊（2/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - прекратить пропаганду (The Audesder War Effort, End The Propaganda) (2 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，终止宣传攻势 (2/8)

messages.en: I'll do as you ask, Ison.
messages.zh: 伊松，我会按你说的去做。

messages.en: So, what's my first assignment?
messages.zh: 那么，我的第一个任务是什么？

messages.en: You're going to start with something easy, {[character]player.name}.  The Caldari Navy's propaganda machine has been spreading lies and misinformation amongst our army for some time now.  For weeks we've been trying to located the source of their broadcasting but it wasn't until today that we narrowed down the signal to a small area of deadspace in the outer regions of {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  I would like you to investigate the area and report your findings to me.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你将先做些简单的活。加达里海军的宣传机器一直在我们军队中散布谣言和错误消息，这已经持续好一段时间了。几个星期来我们一直试图找出他们的广播源，但直到今天我们才将信号范围缩小到{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}外围的一小块死亡空间区域内。我要你去这块区域调查一下，并将你的发现报告给我。

messages.en: Interesting.  So their broadcasting unit is protected by multiple Amarr and Caldari cruisers … I expected worse.  Well, we can't give them any more time to prepare themselves, it's time for us to strike.  I have a replica of the keycard required to get past the acceleration gate to the next stage of the complex, which you can have.  Get ready for some action!
messages.zh: 真是有趣。就是说，他们的广播单元设备受到几艘艾玛和加达里巡洋舰的保护……没我想的那么糟。好了，我们不能再给他们任何时间准备了，现在是我们进攻的时候了。我有一个钥匙卡的复制品，它可以打开通往复合体下一层的加速轨道，拿着吧。准备行动！

messages.en: You're going to start with something easy, {[character]player.name}.  The Caldari Navy's propaganda machine has been spreading lies and misinformation amongst our army for some time now.  For weeks we've been trying to located the source of their broadcasting but it wasn't until today that we narrowed down the signal to a small area of deadspace in the outer regions of {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  I would like you to investigate the area and report your findings to me.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你得先从简单的事做起。加达里海军最近通过他们的宣传机构向我们军队中散布谣言和错误消息。几个星期来我们一直试图找出他们的广播来源，但直到今天我们才将信号缩小到{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}外围的一个死亡空间区域内。我要你去这块区域调查一下，并将你的发现报告给我。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Schlag gegen die Caldari (3 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, Strike At The Caldari (3 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: Ataque a los caldaris (3 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Frapper les Caldari (3 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、カルダリ攻撃（3/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - удар по Caldari (The Audesder War Effort, Strike At The Caldari) (3 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，攻击加达里 (3/8)

messages.en: I'm ready to take on the Caldari.
messages.zh: 我准备好对加达里采取行动了。

messages.en: Ok.  I want you to fly straight to the broadcasting unit that you discovered in your last mission.  Destroy it, and return to me.  You will probably have to face a number of guards from the Amarrian alliance, but I'm sure you can handle it.  They've probably brought in some reinforcements since you're last attack, so be prepared.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 好的，我要你径直飞到上次任务时发现的广播单元设备那儿去。把它摧毁，然后返航回来。很可能你会与来自艾玛联盟的众多防卫队狭路相逢，但以你的能力应该没什么大碍。从你上次攻击后他们也许加派了人手，所以做好充足准备。祝你好运。

messages.en: The broadcasting unit has been destroyed, Warlord.
messages.zh: 阁下，广播单元设备已被摧毁。

messages.en: Good good.  Now with that out of the way, I'm hoping morale here will become more positive.  Now on to your next assignment …
messages.zh: 好，太好了。没有了那个东西，我希望这儿很快会士气大振。下面，讲讲你的下一个任务……

messages.en: Ok.  I want you to fly straight to the broadcasting unit that you discovered in your last mission.  Destroy it, and return to me.  You will probably have to face a number of guards from the Amarrian alliance, but I'm sure you can handle it.  They've probably brought in some reinforcements since you're last attack, so be prepared.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 好的，我要你径直飞到上次任务时发现的广播单元设备那儿去。把它摧毁，然后返航回来。很可能你会与来自艾玛联盟的众多防卫队狭路相逢，但以你的能力应该没什么大碍。从你上次攻击后他们也许加派了人手，所以做好充足准备。祝你好运。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Marines schmuggeln (4 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, Smuggling The Marines (4 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: Infiltración de marines (4 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Infiltrer les Marines (4 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、海兵隊の派遣（4/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - контрабанда космических пехотинцев (The Audesder War Effort, Smuggling The Marines) (4 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，偷运士兵(4/8)

messages.en: A suicide mission?  Sounds like they must be really loyal to the Republic.
messages.zh: 自尽式任务？看来他们对共和国非常忠诚。

messages.en: Of course they are.  Minmatar soldiers have no qualms with sacrificing their lives for our cause.  You should know that by now.
messages.zh: 他们当然是了。每个米玛塔尔的战士都愿意为我们的事业献出自己的生命。到现在，你也应该知道这一点了。

messages.en: So, what's next?
messages.zh: 接下来呢？

messages.en: Nice work.  I've already heard reports of an explosion within the factory of the station you went to, and the Ammatar governer is furious.  Great tidings indeed!  But don't leave yet, I have more work for you.
messages.zh: 干得不错。我已经听到了报告，在你去的那个空间站里，工厂发生了大爆炸，艾玛达政府对此表示愤怒。真是好消息！不过先别急着走，我还有更多任务给你。

messages.en: It's time to send you into more dangerous territory, {[character]player.name}.  I really hope you are up to it.  This time I want you to smuggle a platoon of our marines into {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, which the Ammatar have overtaken to use as a military base close to Kenobanala.  The marines we are sending are on a suicide mission to sabotage the production facilities there, which are being used by the Ammatar and Imperial Navies to assemble their ships of war.  Return to me immediately once this has been done.  I'm counting on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 现在是时候派你去更危险的领域了，{[character]player.name}。  我真的希望你能胜任这个任务。  这次我要你偷运一批我们的陆战队员到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，艾玛达占领了那里，并将其作为军事基地，和科诺巴纳拉构成犄角之势。  这些陆战队员将去执行一项敢死任务，破坏那里为艾玛达和帝国海军装配舰船的生产设备。  任务一完成立刻向我报告。  我就靠你了，{[character]player.name}。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Der Khanid-Außenposten (5 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, The Khanid Outpost (5 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: El puesto avanzado de los Khanid (5 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – L'avant-poste khanid (5 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、クーニッドアウトポスト（5/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - застава Khanid (The Audesder War Effort, The Khanid Outpost) (5 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，卡尼迪哨站 (5/8)

messages.en: You said you had more work for me.  I'm listening …
messages.zh: 你说过你有好多任务给我去做。我正等着呢……

messages.en:
Yes, and now is when it starts to get really dangerous. Again I want you to travel to Kenobanala, this time to a Khanid outpost near Fort Kumar. It was erected to accommodate a large force of Kameira soldiers, because they were not considered ‘good enough' to share living quarters with those of true Amarrian ancestry, nor even the traitorous Ammatar! As you well know, the Kameiras are Minmatar slaves of the Amarr and Khanid who are forced to serve in their military, and who's purpose is usually to be cannon fodder on the front lines in times of war.

I want these Kameiras rescued. But doing that will be tricky. The Khanid complex consists of 3 areas, not including the forward point at the entrance of the deadspace pocket. We have managed to acquire the access codes of the first two acceleration gates, but the 3rd one is unknown to us. Unfortunately the last room of the complex is where the Kameiras living quarters are.

I want you to fly to the Khanid outpost and search the rooms we have access to. Try to find something that will help us unlock the 3rd room, and bring it back here. Perhaps someone among the Khanid guards knows the code.
messages.zh:
是的，事情现在真正变得危险起来。我想让你再去一次科诺巴纳拉，这次是去库马尔要塞附近的一个卡尼迪哨站。那个岗哨的建造目的是为了容纳大批的卡莫兵，因为他们被认为“不够优秀”，所以没资格和拥有艾玛血统的人、甚至那些艾玛达叛党住在一起！正如你所熟知的那样，卡莫兵是艾玛和卡尼迪的米玛塔尔劳工，他们被迫在军中服役，而且在战争时期，他们通常都会成为前线上的炮灰。

我打算把这些卡莫兵解救出来。但要办到并不容易。卡尼迪复合体由三个区域组成，这还不包括死亡空间层入口处的前线阵地在内。我们只掌握了前两个加速轨道的进入密码，第三个加速轨道的密码仍然不明。而复合体的最后一个空间层恰恰就是那些卡莫兵所在的地方。

我要你飞到卡尼迪岗哨，对可以进入的空间层仔细搜索。找到能够帮我们开启第三个空间层的东西，然后带到这儿来，可能某个卡尼迪守卫知道这个密码。

messages.en: Ah, this Khanid commander should be able to reveal the access code to us.  We'll start interrogating him immediately.  By the way, I have another assignment ready for you.
messages.zh: 啊，这个卡尼迪指挥官应该能够告诉我们进入的密码。我们会立刻开始审讯他。顺便说一下，我已经给你准备了另一项任务。

name.en: The Audesder War Effort, Espionage (6 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: Espionaje (6 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Espionnage (6 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、諜報活動（6/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - шпионаж (The Audesder War Effort, Espionage) (6 из 8)

messages.en: I'm all ears …
messages.zh: 我洗耳恭听……

messages.en: While we wait for the interrogation of the Khanid commander to finish, I'd like you to conduct an extremely dangerous mission for me, {[character]player.name}.  The Gallente managed to smuggle a data recorder into Fort Kumar, the base of operations of our enemies in Kenobanala.  It's currently located in one of the army quarters inside their base.  All you have to do is infiltrate Fort Kumar and retrieve this data recorder.  Return to me once you have it.
messages.zh: 我们在等待对卡尼迪指挥官的审问结束，在此期间，我有一项极其危险的任务给你，{[character]player.name}。盖伦特把一部数据记录器偷运进了库马尔要塞，那儿是我们敌人在科诺巴纳拉的军事基地。这个装置目前在该基地的一个军人住区里。你要做的就是潜入库马尔要塞，取得这部数据记录器。一旦得手就立刻回到我这儿来。

messages.en: I have the data recorder as you requested, Warlord.
messages.zh: 督军，这是您要的数据记录器。

messages.en: Excellent!  Hopefully we'll be able to scrounge some useful information out of this thing.  Now on to your next assignment.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！希望我们能从中搜到有用的信息。下面，讲讲你的下一个任务。

messages.en: Retrieve the Gallente Intelligence Data Recorder from one of the army quarters in Fort Kumar.
messages.zh: 从库马尔要塞里的一个军人生活站拿回盖伦特情报数据记录器。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en: While we wait for the interrogation of the Khanid commander to finish, I'd like you to conduct an extremely dangerous mission for me, {[character]player.name}.  The Gallente managed to smuggle a data recorder into Fort Kumar, the base of operations of our enemies in Kenobanala.  It's currently located in one of the army quarters inside their base.  All you have to do is infiltrate Fort Kumar and retrieve this data recorder.  Return to me once you have it.
messages.zh: 我们在等待对卡尼迪指挥官的审问结束，在此期间，有一项极其危险的任务给你，{[character]player.name}。盖伦特集团把一个数据记录器偷运进了库马尔要塞，那儿是我们敌人在科诺巴纳拉的主要活动基地。这个装置目前在该基地的一个军人生活站里。你要做的就是潜入库马尔要塞，数据记录器拿到手，然后带回来给我。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Die Kameira befreien (7 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, Freeing The Kameiras (7 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: Liberación de los kameiras (7 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder – Libérer les Kameiras (7 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、カメイラの解放（7/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - освобождение Kameira (The Audesder War Effort, Freeing The Kameiras) (7 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，解放卡莫兵 (7/8)

messages.en: So, whats my next job?
messages.zh: 那么，我的下一个工作是什么？

messages.en:
We managed to locate a key that should work on the 3rd acceleration gate inside the Khanid outpost where the Kameiras are being held. The Khanid commander you captured revealed its location to us. It's more reliable than an access code, since they probably already changed those after your last attack. You'll find the key in a small container not far from the stargate. It is cloaked and locked but since we know it's exact location now, your ship scanner should be able to detect it. You'll have to destroy the container to acquire the key.

Assuming that the key still works, you should be able to get into the 3rd area of the complex and save the Kameiras from captivity. I'm sure the Khanid and their allies have sent in reinforcements after your last attack, so be prepared for a difficult fight. You'll have to bring some friends along if you wish to have any chance of success.

Just a word of warning though, the Kameiras are normally extremely loyal to the Empire, being more efficiently brainwashed than normal slaves. They are raised with no education of their origins, and it usually takes some time to convince them that we speak the truth. So you'll probably have to take them by force. I'll supply you with some Eforte gas which will paralyze them instantly, allowing your crew to safely transfer them into your cargo hold. Good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
现在我们得知有这么一把钥匙，它可以打开囚禁卡莫兵的卡尼迪哨站内第三个加速轨道。你抓获的卡尼迪指挥官告诉了我们钥匙的位置。这可比入口密码要可靠得多，自你上次袭击后，他们很可能已修改了密码。在距离星门不远的小集装箱内，你可以找到这把钥匙。它经过隐形处理，并上了锁， 但既然我们已掌握了确切位置，那你的船体扫描器就一定不难检测到它。你必须先破坏集装箱，然后才能拿到钥匙。

假如钥匙仍然有效，你就能进入复合体的第三区域，将卡莫兵解救出来。我敢肯定卡尼迪及其盟军自你上次袭击后已派出了援军，所以准备好打一场硬仗。记得带些朋友一起去，不然没有任何胜机可言。

我得事先向你说明，卡莫兵对帝国无比忠诚，他比一般劳工更彻底地被洗了脑。他们对自己的身世一无所知，对自己的血统毫无概念，要使他们相信我们说的话需要时间。所以很可能你得动用武力来强行把他们带回来。我会给你些艾伏特气体，这可以立即使他们瘫倒在地，使你的人可以安全将他们转移到你的货柜舱。{[character]player.name}，祝你好运！

messages.en: I have all the Kameira soldiers that I could find, here you go.
messages.zh: 我解救了所有我能找到的卡莫兵，你看一下。

messages.en: Great work!  I'll have them transferred to our slave rehabilitation center immediately.  Now for your next assignment.
messages.zh: 干得不错！我会立即把它们送到我们的劳工康复中心。下面说说你的下一个任务。

name.de: Die Audesder Kriegsbemühungen - Die Dreadnought-Fertigungsanlage (8 von 8)
name.en: The Audesder War Effort, The Dreadnought Manufacturing Facility (8 of 8)
name.es: El esfuerzo bélico en Audesder: La fábrica de superacorazados (8 de 8)
name.fr: L'effort de guerre d'Audesder - L'usine de production de dreadnoughts (8 sur 8)
name.ja: アウディスダーの戦闘、攻城艦製造施設（8/8）
name.ru: Война в Audesder - завод по строительству дредноутов (The Audesder War Effort, The Dreadnought Manufacturing Facility) (8 из 8)
name.zh: 备战奥德斯代尔，无畏战舰生产设施 (8/8)

messages.en: What's next?
messages.zh: 下一步呢？

messages.en:
It's time to send you on your last assignment, {[character]player.name}. I'm sure this will be one of the most difficult encounter you have ever faced. I'm reluctant to send you on such a suicide mission, but you're the only one qualified for the job that we have. If we sent in our fleet they would be instantly attacked by everyone in Fort Kumar. You on the other hand should be able to get by them unnoticed, if you are cautious enough.

What you need to do is destroy the assembly array of the primary Amarr dreadnought manufacturing facility in Kenobanala. It's pumping out dreadnoughts faster than we imagined, greatly boosting their military strength. If we don't take it out soon, they will be ready for a full scale assault into Audesder, and that will spell disaster for our campaign. I just don't think we're ready yet to face such a large fleet.

And I can't stress this enough, get help! You won't be able to do this alone. Good luck!
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，是时候派你去执行最后一项任务了。我确信你所面临的将会是一场极其艰苦的遭遇战，甚至是你以前都不曾经历的。虽然我很不情愿派你去执行这样一个自尽性的任务，但你是唯一合适的人选。如果我们动用自己的舰队，他们会立刻受到库马尔要塞内所有人的围攻。另外，如果你足够机警的话，就不难成功地避开他们的注意，从一旁悄悄溜过。

你所要做的就是去科诺巴纳拉，摧毁艾玛最重要的无畏级战舰生产设施的装配阵列。它生产无畏级战舰的速度之快超乎我们的想象，而这大大增进了他们的军事力量。如果我们不赶快摧毁这些设备，不久他们就会大规模全力进攻奥德斯德尔，到时我们恐怕败局已定，我们根本不能抵挡这样庞大的舰队来袭。

请注意，一定要带上帮手。一个人去是毫无疑问的送死。祝你好运！

messages.en: The assembly array has been destroyed as you requested, Warlord.
messages.zh: 阁下，根据你的要求，装配阵列已被摧毁。

messages.en: Incredible!  Not even in my wildest dreams did I expect you to return alive, and successful!  You've proven to be a huge asset to the Minmatar Republic, and I thank you from the bottom of my heart.  My the light of the Minmatar Republic be with you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 真难以置信！我做梦都没想到你会活着回来，而且还取得了成功！你已证明自己是米玛塔尔共和国的巨大财富，我从心底里感谢你。愿米玛塔尔共和国的光辉与你同在，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: This is outrageous!  I've stuck my neck out for you guys time and time again, yet I still have to prove myself!?
messages.zh: 太过分了！我为你们一次又一次卖命，难道还要考验我？

messages.en:
This assignment has been created as a mandatory test to ensure all personnel are adequately equipped and ready for the tasks ahead. This is done for your safety, we have no intention of sending you needlessly to your death.

The assignment is simple, and should be completed within 1 hour's time. A few floating containers have been placed in our training grounds in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, surrounded by sentry guns and spider drones. All you have to do is retrieve the certificates from the containers. Recover 5 of these sheets to your contact. That is all.

- Ison Tiadala
messages.zh:
本次任务是一次强制性测试，目的在于确保所有人员都装备齐全并为将来的任务做好了准备。为你的安全着想，我们可不想把你派去做无谓的牺牲。

任务很简单，必须在1小时内完成。我们在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的训练场上布置了一些飘浮的集装箱，由岗哨炮和蜘蛛无人机环绕。你所要做的就是从集装箱中取得认证。取回5张这种表格，带给你的联系人。就这些。

—伊松•蒂亚达拉

messages.en: As I suspected, you're up for the job, {[character]player.name}.  Here's the voucher, bring it to Warlord Ison Tiadala, and she'll give you your next assignment.  Good luck out there, soldier.
messages.zh: 正如我所料，你果然胜任这份工作，{[character]player.name}。这是凭证，带给伊松•蒂亚达拉督军，她会给你下一个任务。祝你好运，士兵。

messages.en: Do not speak with Warlord Ison unless you have powerful friends at your disposal. Although Ison will begin by sending you into fairly easy encounters, once she's satisfied with your performance you will be sent straight into fleet battles, which I doubt you will be able to face alone and survive. And as my final word of advice, take care not to enter Ammatar space when criminally flagged by their security forces. It will mean certain death.
messages.zh: 除非你有强大的朋友协助，否则不要跟督军伊松说话。伊松一开始会给你一些相当简单的战斗任务，一旦她对你的表现满意，就会直接把你派到舰队战中，我怀疑你能否独自应对，甚至可能性命堪忧。最后一句忠告，要是你被艾玛安全部队认定为罪犯，那么注意别进入米玛塔尔的空间。不然你必死无疑。

messages.en: {[character]agentID.name}'s Advice
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}的忠告

messages.en:
Ahem, I'm really sorry if I insulted you, {[character]player.name}, but there's nothing I can do about this. I was given the order to test EVERYONE before we send them out into the fray, and if I would ignore that order I risk being demoted. I hope you understand, Ison is very strict about us following her orders.

Now you'll find the details of your test assignment in the briefing which I'm about to load into your NeoCom. Complete the assignment, which I'm sure you'll do in no time, and I'll send you off to Tiadala. And don't forget to read the advice I've added to the mission details in your Opportunities interface. Good luck.
messages.zh:
咳咳，{[character]player.name}，如果我冒犯了你，那我道歉，但我真的无能为力。我奉命对每个人进行测试，然后他们才能被派去战场，如果我无视命令，我很可能得降级。伊松非常注重手底下的人能否服从命令，希望你能谅解。

我会把检查任务详情上传到你的控制边栏，这样你就能在任务描述里看到了。你肯定能很快完成任务，等你回来我就带你去见蒂亚达拉。记得看看我在“机遇”界面的任务详情里提供的建议。祝你好运。

messages.en: I'm interested.  Give me more details.
messages.zh: 我对此感兴趣，请详细说一下。

messages.en:
Right now I'm looking for {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}. These tags have been implanted into certain pirates which infest {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space, which they use to identify each other with. To acquire them you will most likely have to kill them, or buy them off someone who did exactly that. I don't really care either way, as long as they have been taken care of I'm satisfied.

This might not be the very best way to confirm deaths, but we've been quite successful in the past using this method. Forgeries are almost non-existent, as each tag costs more to manufacture than it's worth on the bounty market. Not only that but we can usually tell a fake apart from a genuine pirate tag. And they have remarkable survivability, usually found in the charred wreckage of the pirate ships despite everything else, including the pirate's corpse, having been completely vaporized.

You can find the pirates carrying the {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} in many places, but I'd first check the asteroid belts in the surrounding systems as attacking defenseless miners is their favorite past-time. Good luck, and have fun.
messages.zh:
我正在寻找{[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}。这些铭牌被植入了在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}空间内异常猖獗的某些海盗体内，以作身份识别之用。要获得这些铭牌，你必须干掉海盗，或者从干掉海盗的人那里购买。我不管你用什么方法获得铭牌，只要海盗已被解决，我就心满意足。

可能拿回铭牌并不是确定死亡的最好方法，不过我们一直这样做，收效不错。伪造品几乎不存在，因为铭牌造假的成本甚至超出了悬赏的金额。不仅如此，我们通常自己也能辨别海盗铭牌的真伪。铭牌的耐久性能异常强悍，就算船上的所有东西，包括海盗尸体在内，全部化为灰烬，我们依然能在舰船残骸里找到完好无损的铭牌。

携带{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}的海盗很多地方都有，但我建议你查看一下附近星系的小行星带，因为攻击毫无防备的采矿者是他们最喜欢的业余爱好。祝你好运，好好享受。

messages.en: Congratulations, you've just proven yourself as a competent mercenary fighter pilot.  Now that you've completed this task, I suggest you look for more {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} agents in {[location]agentRegionID.name} and surrounding regions.  I have no more work for you, but I'm sure you'll find some others from my corporation who do.  If all else fails, you could always work for the other {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} corporations, they have their own agents which hand out jobs as well.  Good luck in your travels, friend.
messages.zh: 恭喜你，你是一个优秀的战斗飞行员。我建议你去{[location]agentRegionID.name}及其周边地区寻找其他的{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}代理人。我已经没工作给你了，但我的同事应该有用得到你的地方。如果他们也没有，你可以为其他{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的军团工作，他们也有自己的代理人，同样也有任务。一路顺风，朋友。

name.en: The Missing Reporters - Minmatar Smugglers (1 of 3)
name.es: Los reporteros desaparecidos: Contrabandistas minmatarianos (1 de 3)
name.fr: Les journalistes kidnappés - Contrebandiers minmatar (1 sur 3)
name.ja: 行方不明の記者―ミンマターの密輸業者（1/3）
name.ru: Исчезнувшие корреспонденты - контрабандисты Minmatar (The Missing Reporters - Minmatar Smugglers) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 失踪的记者 - 米玛塔尔非法贩售者(1/3)

messages.en:
This incident comes at a very bad time. Political relations between our governments are extremely volatile at the moment, and there are rumors of war floating around everywhere. So I have explicit orders to tell you to keep this quiet. With your record I know I can trust you, don't speak of this to anyone. Just find the missing reporters, destroy their captors, return them to me and keep your mouth shut.

The first Amarrian civilian went missing in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} reporting on a story involving a group of Minmatar terrorists, who were said to have been smuggling arms and other illegal goods to some of the more notorious criminal organizations in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, to what purpose we can only guess. I'll give you the coordinates to his last known position. Find him and bring him back, whether dead or alive. His family must know what happened to him. If you find any Minmatar ships at the scene, offer them no dialogue, just destroy them.
messages.zh:
这次事件来得真不是时候。现阶段，政府之间的政治关系极其反复无常，到处都传播着战争即将爆发的谣言。所以我接到明确的命令，要你对这件事保密。鉴于你以前的记录，我知道自己可以信任你，请不要对任何人提起此事。你只要去找到那些失踪的记者，消灭绑架者，把记者带到我这里，并且把你的嘴巴管紧。

第一个艾玛公民是在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}失踪的，当时他正在报道关于一伙米玛塔尔恐怖分子的新闻，据说这群恐怖分子专门向{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的臭名昭著的黑组织非法贩售违禁物品，至于其目的我们也只能推测而已。我会把他的最近一次方位坐标给你。把他带回来，活要见人，死要见尸。如果你在现场发现了其他的米玛塔尔船只，别跟他们废话，结果了他们。

messages.en: How unfortunate, his family will be distraught.  Those damned terrorists will pay for this!  Get ready for your next assignment.
messages.zh: 太不幸了，他的家人一定会悲痛欲绝。这些该死的恐怖分子会为此付出代价的！准备下一个任务吧。

name.de: Die vermissten Reporter - Politische Feinde (2 von 3)
name.en: The Missing Reporters - Political Foes (2 of 3)
name.es: Los reporteros desaparecidos: Enemigos políticos (2 de 3)
name.fr: Les journalistes kidnappés - Ennemis politiques (2 sur 3)
name.ru: Пропавшие репортеры - Политические противники (The Missing Reporters - Political Foes) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
Two of the remaining reporters went missing in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They were investigating reports that the political movement opposed to {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} government's policy on the Audesder incident is collaborating with the Gallente Federation, and have been planning a coup. We have reason to believe that they are being kept in a prison cell located inside a settlement belonging to these misguided {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} citizens.

I want you to pay a visit to this settlement and free the reporters who are being kept there against their will. Eliminate anyone who gets in your way.
messages.zh:
其余记者之中的两名是在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}失踪的。他们当时正在调查一些报告，说的是：某个反对{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}就奥德斯代尔事件所制定政策的政治团体正与盖伦特联邦合作，秘密策划一场叛乱。据可靠情报显示，他们被关在某个殖民地的牢狱里，而这个殖民地正属于那些误入歧途的{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}公民。

我要你去那个殖民地一趟，把记者从那些强迫关押他们的人手里救出来。干掉任何挡道的人。

messages.en: I'm glad they are alive, {[character]player.name}.  Now on to your next assignment.
messages.zh: 干得不错，{[character]player.name}，你把他们活着带回来了。接下来还有个任务。

name.de: Die vermissten Reporter - Bergarbeiter seid auf der Hut (3 von 3)
name.en: The Missing Reporters - Miners Beware (3 of 3)
name.es: Los reporteros desaparecidos: Cuidado, mineros (3 de 3)
name.fr: Les journalistes kidnappés - Mineurs, attention ! (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 行方不明の記者―危険な採鉱業者（3/3）
name.ru: Пропавшие репортеры - шахтеры в опасности (The Missing Reporters - Miners Beware) (3 из 3)

messages.en: The last reporter who's missing was apparently abducted by Gallente terrorists in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  These Gallente have been masquerading as peaceful miners, having bought a lease on a small asteroid belt in this system.  But we know differently.  You'll find the abducted in one of their mining barges.  Find him and bring him back here.  Dismissed.
messages.zh: 最后一名失踪的记者显然是在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}被盖伦特恐怖分子绑架了。这些盖伦特人化装成和平的矿工，并且租用了本星系的一条小行星带。但我们知道事情并非如此。被绑架的记者就在他们的一艘采矿驳船里。去找到他，然后带回这儿来。解散。

messages.en: You didn't find the missing reporter?  How unfortunate.  But at least the terrorists have been taken care of.  I'll report our success here directly to the my contact in Amarr Certified News.  Thank you for your assistance.
messages.zh: 你没有找到失踪的记者？真可惜。不过至少你干掉了那群恐怖分子。我将把我们的成果直接报告给我在艾玛认证通信社的联系人。谢谢你的帮助。

messages.en: You notice on a local news bulletin reports of an unidentified craft destroying a peaceful Minmatar convoy carrying medical and food supplies.  The government refuses to comment, other than stating that they will do everything in their power to apprehend those responsible.
messages.zh: 留意一下本地新闻公告，其中有关于一架不明飞行物的报道，报道称该飞行物击毁了一支和平的载有药品和食物供给的米玛塔尔护航队。政府拒绝对此发表评论，只是声明他们将尽全力逮捕肇事者。

messages.zh: 额外信息

Find him and bring him back here.  Dismissed.
messages.zh: 最后一名失踪的记者显然是在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}被艾玛劳工贩子绑架了。这些艾玛人化装成一般矿工，并且租用了本星系的一条小行星带。但我们知道事情并非如此。被绑架的记者就在他们的一艘飞船里。去找到他，然后带回这儿来。完毕。

messages.en: You found him!  I'll notify his family immediately.  I'll also report our success here directly to my contact in The Scope. Thank you for your assistance.
messages.zh: 你找到他了！我会立刻通知他的家属。而且我会把这个好消息告诉我在视角传媒的联络人。感谢你的帮助。

messages.en: You notice on a local news bulletin reports of an unidentified craft destroying a peaceful Minmatar convoy carrying medical and food supplies.  The government refuses to comment, other than stating that they will do everything in their power to apprehend those responsible.
messages.zh: 留意一下本地新闻公告，其中有关于一架不明飞行物的报道，报道称该飞行物击毁了一支和平的载有药品和食物供给的米玛塔尔护航队。政府拒绝对此发表评论，只是声明他们将尽全力逮捕肇事者。

messages.en: Extra Information
messages.zh: 额外信息

messages.en:
News of your heroic deeds have spread throughout the region after the interplanetary media organization The Scope aired a detailed report on your exploits. The family of the reporter you rescued offer their utmost gratitude, and the families of those that had been killed are thankful that you at least discovered their fate.

The last reporter who's missing was apparently abducted by Amarr slave traders in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. These Amarr have been masquerading as peaceful miners, having bought a lease on a small asteroid belt in this system. But we know differently. You'll find the abducted in one of their vessels. Find him and bring him back here. Dismissed.
messages.zh:
自从星际传媒机构《视角》播出详细报道之后，你的英雄事迹传遍了整个星域。 获救的记者家属对你表示最诚挚的谢意，而那些遇害记者的家属也仍然感谢你，至少你帮助他们得知了死者的遭遇。

最后一名失踪的记者显然是被位于{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的艾玛奴隶贩子绑架了。这些艾玛人伪装成人畜无害的矿工，租下了这个星系中的一处小行星带。当然我们知道他们的底细。你会在他们的某艘船里找到被绑架的人质。找到他，把他带回来。快去吧。

The first group of Gallente civilians went missing in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} reporting on a story involving a group of Caldari Smugglers, who were said to have been smuggling armed terrorists to our stations in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, to cause mayhem no doubt. I'll give you the coordinates to their last known position. Find them and bring them back, dead or alive. Their families must be informed of their fate, or they will never be at peace. If you find any hostiles at the scene, feel free to use deadly force.
messages.zh:
很高兴听你这么说，{[character]player.name}。这次事件来得真不是时候。现阶段，政府之间的政治关系极其反复无常，到处都传播着战争即将爆发的谣言。所以我接到明确的命令，要你对这件事保密。鉴于你以前的记录，我知道自己可以信任你，请不要对任何人提起此事。你只要去找到那些失踪的记者，消灭绑架者，把记者带到我这里，并且把你的嘴巴管紧。

第一批盖伦特公民是在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}报道了一伙加达里非法贩售者之后失踪的。据说这些非法贩售者在向我们{[location]agentConstellationID.name}所在的空间站运送武装恐怖分子，同时引发了武装冲突。我会给你他们最后出现地点的位标。找到他们并把他们带回来，不论死活。必须对他们的家属有个交待，否则他们永远无法安心。如果碰到任何敌对势力，允许你使用武力。

messages.en: How unfortunate, his family will be distraught.  Those damned terrorists will pay for this!  Get ready for your next assignment.
messages.zh: 太不幸了，他的家人一定会悲痛欲绝。这些该死的恐怖分子会为此付出代价的！准备下一个任务吧。

messages.en:

Just find the missing reporters, destroy their captors, return them to me and keep your mouth shut.

name.de: Die vermissten Reporter - Schlechtes Timing (2 von 3)
name.en: The Missing Reporters - Bad Timing (2 of 3)
name.es: Los reporteros desaparecidos: Mal momento (2 de 3)
name.fr: Les journalistes kidnappés - Mauvais timing (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 行方不明の記者―よくないタイミング（2/5）
name.ru: Пропавшие репортеры - смутное время (The Missing Reporters - Bad Timing) (2 из 3)
name.zh: 失踪的记者—错误的时机（2/3）

messages.en:
One of the remaining reporters went missing in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. He was investigating reports that one of the political movements opposed to {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} government's policy on the Audesder incident has been collaborating with the Amarr Empire. We have reason to believe that this information was flawed, and in fact the politicians in question have ties to the Angel Cartel which they've been adamantly denying. They own a small settlement in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, which coincidentally is where the reporter went missing.

I would like you to pay a visit to this settlement and look for the missing reporter. If you find him you are authorized to use force, if necessary, to bring him back. Good luck.
messages.zh:
其余记者中的一人是在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}失踪的。他当时正在调查一些报告，说的是：一个反对{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}就奥德斯代尔事件所制定政策的政治团体正与艾玛帝国合作。我们有理由相信，这条情报有误，实际上，我们所说的政客与天使企业联合体相勾结，不过他们一直竭力否认这种关系。他们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一个小型殖民地，那里恰好就是记者失踪的地方。

我想让你去那个殖民地跑一趟，找找那个失踪的记者。如果你找到他，就把他带回来；如果有必要，你有权使用武力。祝你好运。

messages.en: I'm glad you found him alive, {[character]player.name}.  Now on to your next assignment.
messages.zh: 太好了，{[character]player.name}，你把他带回来了。接下来还有个任务。

name.ru: Поставки для сил сопротивления (Supplies For The Resistance)

messages.en: I'm in.
messages.zh: 好，我接受。

messages.en:
There are millions of minmatars living in the Joas constellation which are not ethnically Nefantar, and many of them are still loyal to the Republic. Even some of the Nefantar living in the area are sympathetic to our cause. Hence there is a strong resistance movement there, which in fact started long before the Rebellion. The strength of the resistance has varied greatly through the years, but the Audesder incident has refueled unrest in the region. And this may be a key factor in our campaign to hold Audesder.

What I'd like you to do is transfer a large arms cache to my contact in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. This contact of mine is an agent of the Joas resistance, he will see to it that the arms cache gets to the right hands. Try to avoid any contact with the Ammatar or their allies, if they find out what you're up to then you'll have one hell of a fight on your hands. Good luck.
messages.zh:
乔斯星系居住着数百万米玛塔尔人，他们不属于内凡达种族，而且其中很多依然效忠于共和国。甚至一些居住在该区域的内凡达人也对我们的事业表示赞同。因此，那里一直有很强的抵抗力量，早在米马塔尔大起事之前就出现了。多年来，抵抗力量时强时弱，起伏很大，但奥德斯代尔事件再次激起了这个区域内的动荡不安。这也许可以成为我们在奥德斯代尔掌权的关键要素。

我要你做的就是把一大批武器储备运送给我在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的联络人。这个联络人是乔斯抵抗组织的特工，他会确保这些武器被正确分派。尽量避免与艾玛达及其同盟接触，如果被他们发现，免不了一场恶战。祝你好运。

messages.en: Great job!  The resistance will benefit greatly from the arms cache you delivered.  It's been extremely difficult to get supplies to them with the military buildup in Kanebanala, so your success comes as a welcome surprise.  If you'd like, I have more arms that are ready to be shipped out.
messages.zh: 干得好！你运送的武器储备对抵抗组织将会很有用。科诺巴纳拉集结着大量兵力，要把补给品运抵极为困难，而你成功了，这对他们而言是个惊喜。如果你愿意，我还有更多的武器要运送。

name.fr: Encore du matériel pour la résistance
name.ja: 反乱軍へのさらなる供給
name.ru: Больше припасов для сопротивления (More Supplies For The Resistance)

messages.en: Bring the arms cache to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} in the Joas constellation.  My contact there will take care of the rest.
messages.zh: 将武器储备送到乔斯星座的{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。我在那儿的联络人会处理接下来的事。

messages.en: The arms cache has been delivered as promised, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，武器储备已如约送抵。

messages.en: Bring the arms cache to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} in the Joas constellation. My contact there will take care of the rest.
messages.zh: 将武器储备送到乔斯星座的{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。我在那儿的联络人会处理接下来的事。

name.en: Civilian Pullout - More Civilians to Evacuate
name.es: Extracción de civiles: Más civiles para evacuar
name.fr: Évacuation des civils – Encore des civils à évacuer
name.ja: 民間人の撤退―避難の続き
name.ru: Эвакуация гражданских - еще больше штатских (Civilian Pullout - More Civilians to Evacuate)
name.zh: 疏散民众—更多平民需要撤出

messages.en: As I've told you already, there are more Nefantar civilians in Aedald that need to be moved to Fort Kumar.  You'll find them in the hangar of {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 像我所告诉你的那样，在埃伊达特有越来越多的内凡达平民需要转移到库马尔要塞。你可以在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}找到他们。祝你好运！

messages.en: As I've told you already, there are more Nefantar civilians in Aedald that need to be moved to Fort Kumar.  You'll find them in the hangar of {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 正如我之前所说，在埃伊达特有更多内凡达平民需要被转移到库马尔要塞。你会在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的机库里找到他们。祝你好运。

messages.en: I'm here to help actually.  If you have a job available, that is ...
messages.zh: 其实我是来这儿帮忙的。如果你有什么工作给我，那就……

messages.en: As I've already told you we have some problems with our transportation service. We're using some of our own freighters now to transport goods from Caldari space, but we're short on manpower. If you could stop by {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and bring the 50 construction blocks I had ordered to me, then I'll give you a reward. We need them for the next habitation module we're building for the workers stationed here.
messages.zh: 就像我之前说的一样，我们的运输服务出了点问题。目前我们正在用自己的一些货船从加达里空间运送货物，但是我们人手不够。如果你能去趟{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}把我订购的50块建筑材料带回来，我会给你一份奖励。这些东西将用于为驻扎在这里的工人建造的新居住舱。

messages.en: Back with the goods, just as promised.  Here's your reward, make good use of it!  But don't go far, I've got more jobs for you.
messages.zh: 你果然信守承诺，把货物带回来了。这是你的酬劳，好好地使用它！不要走开，我还有更多的工作要你去完成。

messages.en: <font color=FF0000>You will lose Gallente Federation standing for completing missions for a Caldari corporation.</font>
messages.zh: <font color=FF0000>如果你为加达里军团执行任务，你的盖伦特声望会降低。</font>

messages.en: <font color=FF0000>Warning</font>
messages.zh: <font color=FF0000>警告</font>

messages.en:
If I have a job available! Of course I do! Do you know how hard it is to find help around here?! With FON organizing boycotts for any organization supporting us and picketing individuals we are affiliated with, I don't really blame them.

Anyway as I've already told you we have some problems with our transportation service. We're using some of our own freighters now to transport goods from Caldari space, but we're short on manpower. If you could stop by {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and bring the 50 construction blocks I had ordered to me, then I'll give you a reward. We need them for the next habitation module we're building for the workers stationed here.
messages.zh:
如果我有什么工作给你？当然有！你知不知道在这儿周围找个帮手有多难？FON组织人们联合抵制我们的所有活动，监视一切与我们交往的人，真拿他们没办法。

就像我之前说的一样，我们的运输服务出了点问题。目前我们正在用自己的一些货船从加达里空间运送货物，但是我们人手不够。如果你能去趟{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}把我订购的50块建筑材料带回来，我会给你一份奖励。这些东西将用于为驻扎在这里的工人建造的新居住舱。

messages.en:
I have something slightly more dangerous for you this time, {[character]player.name}. We have 18 surveyors stranded on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} after Prompt Delivery backed out on our deal to get them moved here a few days ago. Apparently they decided the risks of transporting them through Gallente space were too great. The Federation Navy has threatened to attack any corporations under the Caldari State other than Wiyrkomi, and even with our surveyors on board we fear they might hold true to their word.

If you can get the surveyors here today, I'll give you a hefty reward. Just watch out for those FON fanatics, they're everywhere these days.
messages.zh:
我这次给你的任务稍微危险一些，{[character]player.name}。我们有18位测量员被困在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}，我们本来和疾速快递达成协议要他们将这些测量员运到这来，可是几天前疾速快递却变卦了。很明显，他们认为将我们的人运送穿过盖伦特空间的风险实在太大了。联邦海军威胁说，他们会攻击除维克米之外的其他任何加达里合众国集团，虽然我们的船上只是些测量员，但我们担心他们还是会言出必行。

如果今天你能把测量员带到这里，我会重重奖励你。不过要当提防FON狂热者，这些天他们活动频繁。

messages.en: Good job.  But enough of these petty courier jobs, it's time to find out your true potential.  Let me know when you're ready, I have a combat mission waiting just for you!
messages.zh: 做得好。抱歉一直委屈你做这些不足挂齿的运货任务，现在是时候发挥你真正的潜力了。准备好了就告诉我，我有一个战斗任务正等着你去完成！

messages.en:
I have a matter of urgency for you this time, {[character]player.name}. Temko, the Gallentean mercenary organization that we hired, reported to us that one of its surveillance posts in Colelie has been attacked. All of their personnel are currently unavailable, so they pleaded with us to find someone else to investigate the attack. And I think you are the man for the job.

It's been a while since the attack was reported, so we have absolutely no idea what the situation is out there. Hopefully you will be able to track down whoever is responsible and punish them. Good luck.
messages.zh:
这次我有个紧急任务给你，{[character]player.name}。天科是受雇于我们的盖伦特雇佣兵组织，他们报告说，位于克勒列的一个监视岗哨遭到了袭击。此刻他们没有多余的人手，所以恳请我们找个人来调查这次袭击事件。我觉得你是这个任务的最合适人选。

距收到袭击报告已经有段时间了，所以我们现在完全不知道那边的情况如何。希望你能追查到肇事者并给予惩罚。祝你好运。

messages.en: As I guessed, it was FON which were behind the attack.  They are becoming more bold with each passing day.  I must report this to Central Command immediately.  But before you leave, there's one last task I have for you.
messages.zh: 如我所料，FON是袭击事件的幕后真凶。他们的胆子真是越来越大了。我必须立即向中央指挥部报告此事。不过你走之前，我还有最后一项任务给你。

messages.en:
I have a matter of urgency for you this time, {[character]player.name}. Temko, the Gallentean mercenary organization that we hired, reported to us that one of its surveillance posts in Colelie has been attacked. All of their personnel are currently unavailable, so they pleaded with us to find someone else to investigate the attack. And I think you are the man for the job.

It's been a while since the attack was reported, so we have absolutely no idea what the situation is out there. Hopefully you will be able to track down whoever is responsible and punish them. Good luck.
messages.zh:
这次我有一个紧急任务要你去做，{[character]player.name}。天科是受雇于我们的盖伦特雇佣兵组织，他们报告说，克勒列的一个监视岗哨遭到了袭击。此刻他们没有多余的人手，所以恳请我们找个人来调查这次的袭击事件。我想你将是最合适的人选。

距报遭袭已经有段时间了，我们此时完全不知道那边的情况如何。希望你能查到始作俑者的身份，然后给他们以制裁。祝你好运！

messages.en:
This time I'd like you to obtain a pass into the Azure Canyon in Colelie. The Azure Canyon is located in a pocket of deadspace which has unusually dense ion clouds, which makes it ideal for creating a massive power plant. The reason we are in Colelie is to start constructing the power station, but so far we've been stuck at square 1 due to our inability to clear the area of Serpentis pirates and FON terrorists.

To get to the point, we're sending in a few squadrons of Temko mercenaries to conduct a quick reconnaissance operation in the Azure Canyon area. But we haven't been able to get past the first acceleration gate since Serpentis agents reconfigured the lock, and it would take far too long to manually navigate through the deadspace pocket. Hence we need the keycard.

You'll find a group of FON ships blockading the gate against anyone affiliated with Wiyrkomi. We believe their leader has the keycard we need in her possession. Her name is Apte Donie, and she should be located at the forward point into the complex. Use whatever means necessary to acquire that keycard, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
这次我要你去拿进入克勒列的苍穹峡谷的通行证。苍穹峡谷位于某个死亡空间层，那里的离子云异常厚重，是建造大型发电站的理想之地。我们来克勒列的目的是启动能源空间站的建设，但由于无力清除该区域的天蛇海盗和FON恐怖分子，至今我们仍在原地毫无进展。

言归正传，我们准备派遣几支天科雇佣兵中队去苍穹峡谷地区，执行快速侦察任务。但由于天蛇特工重新设置了第一座加速轨道的轨道锁，我们至今仍无法通过那里，而手动航行通过死亡空间层会花去太长的时间。所以我们需要开锁的钥匙卡。

目前一群FON舰船封锁了加速轨道，不准任何与维克米有关的人通过。我们确信他们的首领手中有我们需要的钥匙卡。她叫爱佩特•多尼，应该就在通向复合体的前线阵地处。{[character]player.name}，你要使用任何必要手段来拿到那张钥匙卡。

messages.en: You've completed all the tasks I have for you, {[character]player.name}, so I'm sending you off to Veko Tallaja.  You'll find him in the Central Command site in Fluekele, he's in charge of all Wiyrkomi operations in Algintal.  Take this voucher, you won't get an appointment without it.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 你完成了我给你的全部任务，{[character]player.name}，所以我要派你去见维考·塔尔拉瑕。你可以在弗琉克勒的中央指挥部找到他，他负责维克米在阿根塔的全部事务。带着这个凭证，要是没有它，他是不会见你的。祝你好运。

messages.en:
This time I'd like you to obtain a pass into the Azure Canyon in Colelie. The Azure Canyon is located in a pocket of deadspace which has unusually dense ion clouds, which makes it ideal for creating a massive power plant. The reason we are in Colelie is to start constructing the power station, but so far we've been stuck at square 1 due to our inability to clear the area of Serpentis pirates and FON terrorists.

To get to the point, we're sending in a few squadrons of Temko mercenaries to conduct a quick reconnaissance operation in the Azure Canyon area. But we haven't been able to get past the first acceleration gate since Serpentis agents reconfigured the lock, and it would take far too long to manually navigate through the deadspace pocket. Hence we need the keycard.

You'll find a group of FON ships blockading the gate against anyone affiliated with Wiyrkomi. We believe their leader has the keycard we need in her possession. Her name is Apte Donie, and she should be located at the forward point into the complex. Use whatever means necessary to acquire that keycard, {[character]player.name}.

messages.en: I'm ready for my assignment, Veko ...
messages.zh: 维考，我准备好去完成任务了……

messages.en:
Veko?? You will address me as sir, peon! I will not have some rug-rat insult me like that in public ...

Now where were we? Ah yes, your mission. Well I have a number of nuisances for you to 'take care of', and the first in line is a Gallentean called Alarus Ekire. He's the commander of the military arm of FON, the cowardly tree-huggers who've been sabotaging our operations in Federation space ever since we made that deal with the Gallente government. With him out of the picture, FON's terrorist groups will become more disorganized and less deadly, until they find a suitable replacement anyway.

You'll probably find Alarus in the Tourist area of Azure Canyon in Colelie. They've apparently made a pact with Serpentis to defend that area of deadspace against our attempts to move our own people in there. So you might have a bit of a fight on your hands, but I'm sure you'll manage.

Bring back something to prove that Alarus is no more, and I'll give you your reward.
messages.zh:
维考？？你该称呼我为先生，打杂的！我不会允许一个乳臭未干的小子这样当众羞辱我……

我们说到哪儿了？啊，对了，你的任务。我有不少麻烦等着你去“解决”，第一个就是一个名叫埃拉瑞斯•埃及勒的盖伦特人。他是FON的军事力量指挥官，自从我们与盖伦特政府达成了那项协议之后，这群胆小的环境爱好者就一直破坏我们在联邦空间的行动。只要除掉他，FON恐怖分子集团就会涣散，变得不那么危险，除非他们找到合适的接替者。

你应该能在克勒列的苍穹峡谷观光区找到埃拉瑞斯。他们显然与天蛇有过协定，由天蛇集团负责保卫那个死亡空间区域，以防我们将自己的人运送进去。所以你可能需要大战一场，但我肯定你能应付。<br><br>带回些能证明埃拉瑞斯死亡的东西，我会给你报酬。

messages.en: Hmmph.  You got the job done, a tad later than I expected but I guess you've earned your reward.  But don't leave, I have more work in store for you.
messages.zh: 哼。你完成了任务，虽然比我预期的要晚一点，但我想可以给你报酬。不过先别走，我还有更多的任务给你。

messages.en: I'll do as you ask.
messages.zh: 我会照你说的做。

messages.en: Don't let me down.
messages.zh: 不要让我失望。

messages.en: I would like to sign up for some work, if you have any.
messages.zh: 如果你有工作的话，我愿意做。

messages.en: As a matter of fact I do have something suited for you, {[character]player.name}.  But first you're going to have to supply me with a voucher from one of the other agents around here.  I recommend stopping by the Survey Station, they need some help there as well.
messages.zh: 事实上我的确有些适合你的工作，{[character]player.name}。但首先你必须向我出具附近某个代理人的凭证。我建议停靠到那个测量空间站，他们也需要帮助。

messages.en: Here, I have the voucher.
messages.zh: 我拿到凭证了。

messages.en: Now that you've established your worth, let's get started.
messages.zh: 既然你已建立信任，那么我们开始吧。

messages.en:
As a matter of fact I do have something suited for you, {[character]player.name}. But first you're going to have to supply me with a voucher from one of the other agents around here. I recommend stopping by the Survey Station, they need some help there as well.

Do not accept this mission if you have not completed the pre-required mission sequence in the Survey Station or have acquired the neccessary voucher some other way.
messages.zh:
事实上我的确有些适合你的工作，{[character]player.name}。但首先你必须向我出具附近某个代理人的凭证。我建议停靠到那个测量空间站，他们也需要帮助。

如果你没有完成测量空间站中的前期任务，或者没有通过其他方式获得必要的凭证，那就不要接受这个任务。

messages.en: Erm, on second thought I don't think I want to work for you.
messages.zh: 呃，经过仔细考虑我不打算为你工作。

messages.en: What?  You just wasted my time for nothing?  Get out of here punk, before I send Temko mercs on your ass.
messages.zh: 什么？你只是来浪费我时间的？趁我还没叫天科雇佣兵来教训你，快滚，废物。

messages.en: You better not let me down.
messages.zh: 你最好不要让我失望。

messages.en:
Your second mission is to investigate the theft of a batch of drills we ordered recently. They were being shipped to our survey station in Colelie when their convoy was ambushed by unknown assailants. We have so far not retrieved any witnesses, and have not found any evidence at the crime scene linking FON or Serpentis to the attack. However gut feeling tells me it must have been FON. Serpentis would have taken the crew and held them for ransom, but we have found no evidence that they are still alive.

I'd like you to get to the bottom of this, {[character]player.name}. Fly to the FON recruitment center in Fluekele and see what you can find there. Return to me with anything that might implicate their involvement in the attack.

Dismissed.
messages.zh: 你的第二个任务就是调查关于我们最近定购的一批钻机遭窃的事件。这批物品在运往克勒列的测量空间站途中，遭到了身份不明的武装分子的伏击。到目前为止，我们没有救回任何目击者，在犯罪现场也没有发现任何指明该袭击与FON或者天蛇集团有关的证据。但是直觉告诉我这一定是FON干的。如果是天蛇集团所为，他们一定会把船员掳走，并以此勒索赎金，可是没有任何证据表明这些船员仍有存活的可能。<br><br>我要你查清这件事的真相，{[character]player.name}。飞去弗琉克勒的FON招募中心，看看在那里能找到些什么。把任何表明他们与此次袭击有关的东西带回来给我。<br><br>讲完。

messages.en: This data recorder may prove invaluable in our criminal investigation.  We'll see what we can find in there, but meanwhile there are some more tasks I'd like you to complete.
messages.zh: 这个数据记录器对我们的罪案调查可能有不可估量的价值。看看我们能发现些什么，不过现在我还有其他的任务需要你去完成。

They were being shipped to our survey station in Colelie when their convoy was ambushed by unknown assailants. Dismissed.

messages.en: Don't let me down.
messages.zh: 不要让我失望。

messages.en:
The next job is going to be a bit more difficult than your last two assignments. This time I want you to infiltrate the Azure Canyon complex and find a place called 'The Black Market'. We have reliable information that a regiment of Temko mercenaries are being held in a prison facility there. They were sent on a reconnaissance mission into the complex a few days ago, but never returned.

I advise you to avoid a direct confrontation with the Serpentis forces at the Black Market. Just grab the mercenaries and flee, they are your number one priority in this mission. We are running out of mercenaries already, we can't afford to lose these Temko personnel.

I also recommend that you finish this assignment in a timely manner. My time is precious.
messages.zh:
接下来的任务比之前的两个要稍微困难一些。这次我要你潜入苍穹峡谷复合体，找一个被称为“黑市”的地方。我们得到可靠消息，说有一支天科雇佣兵团被关在那的一座牢狱设施里。几天前，他们被派往该复合体执行一项侦察任务，但之后再没回来。

我建议你尽量避免与黑市的天蛇部队发生正面冲突，你只要救出雇佣兵然后逃之夭夭，他们是你这次任务的首要目标。我们的雇佣兵已经不多了，不能再失去这些天科的人马。

同时我建议你尽快完成这个任务。我的时间很宝贵。

messages.en: Well ... you did get the job done.  Fine, here's your reward.  Now stick around, I've got some more things I'd like you to take care of.
messages.zh: 呃……你确实完成了工作。好吧，这是你的酬劳。先别走，我还有一些事要你做。

messages.en: Infiltrate the Azure Canyon complex in Colelie, find the area called "The Black Market" and rescue the Temko Mercenaries from their prison.  Then return to {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 潜入克勒列的苍穹峡谷复合体，找到被称作“黑市”的地方，从牢狱里救出天科雇佣兵。然后回去找{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en:
The next job is going to be a bit more difficult than your last two assignments. This time I want you to infiltrate the Azure Canyon complex and find a place called 'The Black Market'. We have reliable information that a regiment of Temko mercenaries are being held in a prison facility there. They were sent on a reconnaissance mission into the complex a few days ago, but never returned.

I advise you to avoid a direct confrontation with the Serpentis forces at the Black Market. Just grab the mercenaries and flee, they are your number one priority in this mission. We are running out of mercenaries already, we can't afford to lose these Temko personnel.

I also recommend that you finish this assignment in a timely manner. My time is precious.

我建议你尽量避免与黑市的天蛇部队发生正面冲突，你这次任务旨在找到那些佣兵并解救他们。我们原本就缺兵少将，所以决不能失去这些天科佣兵。

我也建议你尽快完成这个任务。我的时间很宝贵。

messages.en: Cafe lounge?  I never ...
messages.zh: 咖啡馆？我从来不……

messages.en: Failure is unacceptible.
messages.zh: 失败不可饶恕。

messages.en: Something urgent just came up. The Survey Station in Colelie was attacked by FON, probably in retaliation for our recent actions against them. Many of our people have been killed, and more importantly we lost billions of ISK worth of equipment. This heinous act must not go unpunished. Our surveillance teams are currently on their tail, and I would like you to take care of them. I'll supply you with a bookmark to their approximate location, you do the rest. And do hurry this time, you can hang around the cafe lounge some other time.
messages.zh: 刚有紧急事件发生。克勒列的测量空间站遭到了FON的袭击，可能是为了报复我们最近对他们的打击。我们的许多人被干掉了，更重要的是我们损失了价值数十亿星币的装备。这种罪大恶极的行为必须受到惩罚。我们的监视小组目前正在跟踪他们，我要你把他们全部消灭。我会提供你他们大致位置的位标，接下来的任务就交给你了。这次行动一定要快，你可以改天再去咖啡馆闲逛。

messages.en: I see you're back in one piece.  Maybe you're not as useless as I first thought.  In that case, I have something more you could do for me ...
messages.zh: 你毫发无损地回来了。也许你不像我所想的那么废物。那样的话，我还有点活儿，也许你能做一下……

messages.en: Don't let me down.
messages.zh: 不要让我失望。

messages.en:
Now I want you to get us some Zemnar. The Survey Station in Colelie suffered heavy casualties, and their antibiotic supplies are stretched to the limit. On top of that there has been a viral outbreak which could cause many deaths if we don't get them the Zemnar they need fast. Now a few surveyors and engineers are expendable, but this threatens the entire outpost and could compromise our operation in Colelie!

You'll find a stock of Zemnar not far from the Pend Insurance station in Fluekele, in their storage bin. They refuse to share it with us, probably as a result of pressure from the various nature lover groups which have been protesting our presence here. So we are going to have to take it by force. Do whatever it takes to get a hold of that Zemnar, and drop it off at our factory in this system. One of my lackeys will transport it to Colelie. Just don't reveal who you're working for, to anyone! Now get moving!
messages.zh:
现在我要你帮我们弄一些泽姆纳尔。克勒列的测量空间站伤亡惨重，他们的抗生素补给已经几乎耗尽。此外，一种病毒在那里快速蔓延开来，如果我们不能及时将他们急需的泽姆纳尔送去，可能会有许多人丧生。虽然我们损失得起几个测量员或工程师，但这次病毒爆发威胁到了整个哨站，甚至可能破坏我们在克勒列的行动！

你能在弗琉克勒找到一批装在储存罐里的泽姆纳尔，那里离彭德保险空间站不远。也许是迫于反对我们进驻这里的各类自然爱好者团体的压力，储存罐的主人拒绝与我们分享那些泽姆纳尔。所以我们必须用武力夺取泽姆纳尔。用一切手段弄到泽姆纳尔，然后到我们在这个星系的工厂卸货。我的一个侍从会把它运送到克勒列。绝对<b>不要</b>向任何人透露你为谁效力！现在赶快行动吧！

messages.en: Well you managed to get that done, at least.  But there's more I have in store for you, so don't go running off yet ...
messages.zh: 你至少做完了那件事。不过我还为你准备了别的任务，所以先别急着走……

messages.zh:
现在我要你帮我们弄一些泽姆纳尔。克勒列的测量空间站伤亡惨重，他们的抗生素补给已经几乎耗尽。此外，一种病毒在那里快速蔓延开来，如果我们不能及时将他们急需的泽姆纳尔送去，可能会有许多人丧生。虽然我们损失得起几个测量员或工程师，但这次病毒爆发威胁到了整个哨站，甚至可能破坏我们在克勒列的行动！

你能在弗琉克勒找到一批装在储存罐里的泽姆纳尔，那里离彭德保险空间站不远。也许是迫于反对我们进驻这里的各类自然爱好者团体的压力，储存罐的主人拒绝与我们分享那些泽姆纳尔。所以我们必须用武力夺取泽姆纳尔。用一切手段弄到泽姆纳尔，然后到我们在这个星系的工厂卸货。我的一个侍从会把它运送到克勒列。绝对<b>不要</b>向任何人透露你为谁效力！现在赶快行动吧！

messages.en: Don't let me down.
messages.zh: 不要让我失望。

messages.en:
You've proven to be fairly reliable so far, {[character]player.name}, so I believe I can trust you for a rather sensitive assignment. We have a traitor in our ranks, or to be more precise in the ranks of the Temko mercenaries we hired. His name is Eule Vitrauze and he's apparently working for Friends of Nature on the side. We believe he's the reason the last Temko operation in the Azure Canyon complex failed.

I would ask the Temko to deal with him themselves, but Gara believes that if we make an outsider do the job and make it seem like we weren't involved in his death then our agent within FON will not be compromised. You'll probably find Eule orbiting a security outpost inside the Central Administration complex. But don't worry, the other Temko ships will not come to his aid, all you have to do is face him one-on-one, and then return to me once his ship has been turned to dust.

Dismissed.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，迄今为止你表现得相当可靠，所以我想可以托付给你一个非常机密的任务。我们的队伍里，准确地说是我们雇佣的天科雇佣兵队伍里有一个叛徒。他的名字叫尤尔•维特拉兹，显然他在背地里为FON效力。我们相信正是因为这个人的存在，天科上次在苍穹峡谷复合体内的行动才会失败。

我曾要求天科自己去处置他，但嘉哈认为，如果我们让一个外部人员来做这件事，让他的死看起来与我们无关，那我们在FON内的特工就不会有暴露的危险。你应该能在中央行政复合体内的一个安全哨站附近找到尤尔。不过别担心，其他天科舰船不会对他施以援手，你要做的就是跟他一对一地战斗，把他的飞船炸成灰烬，然后立刻回到我这儿来。

解散。

messages.en: Eule Vitrauze is no more.
messages.zh: 尤尔•维特拉兹死了。

messages.en: Although it pains me to say it, you've managed to complete all the tasks I assigned to you on time and we owe you one.  Just don't expect any medals of honor, you're a secret agent working for us and the less our enemies know of you the better.  Now before I get all mooshy with you I suggest you turn your flabby tush around and head off to the Grand Future Information Center in Jolia, General Gara Kort has a few missions for you there.  Now be off with you.
messages.zh: 尽管我不想说，但是你已经成功完成了我布置给你的所有任务，我们欠你一个人情。但不要期望得到任何荣誉奖章，你是为我们工作的秘密特工，我们的敌人知道你的事越少越好。在我对你不胜其烦之前，我建议你转过你那懦弱的嘴脸，赶快去乔利亚的盛大前景信息中心，嘉哈·考赫特将军有些任务给你。赶快走吧。
