messages.en:
Since you've been approved by Veko Tallaja, I guess you're suited for a few missions vital to our plans here in Algintal. To get straight to the point, we are currently on a campaign to rid the deadspace areas we purchased from Federate sources of pirates and violent protesters, namely the Friends of Nature organization which has been causing us much grief since we came to Algintal. To complete our objectives we have been forced to hire mercenaries which are permitted entrance into Federation space, considering that the government steadfastly refuses to allow any Caldari State military presence in their sovereign space. Which is understandable considering the current political climate.

Wiyrkomi sacrificed much to get this deal, and we definitely are not backing out with our tails behind our legs. Our CEO has publicly announced that we are firmly against any Caldari State incursions into Federation space, incurring the wrath of the State Chief Executive Panel which has fined us for rediculous reasons simply out of spite. And on top of that our lease on the deadspace pockets within Federation space could be annulled at any time if the Senate gives in to the protesters.

So now that you're briefed of the situation, it's time to get started. Your first target is an old abandoned Federation Navy ammunitions storage in Jolia. We have confirmed reports that the military arm of FON uses the facilities located there to store their weapons of mass destruction. Take it out and their terrorist operation in Jolia will be crippled. Over and out.
messages.zh:
既然你已获得了维考•塔尔拉瑕的认可，我想也该对你委以重任了，这些任务对我们在阿根塔的计划至关重要。我们目前正在武力清理那些从联邦购买的死亡空间区域，这些地区原来是属于海盗和某些反暴力分子的，即FON组织，自从我们来到阿根塔以来，他们就不断地在给我们制造麻烦。政府一如既往地拒绝任何加达里军队入境，为了我们计划的顺利实施，我们被迫雇佣一些被准许进入联邦空间的人。目前的政治氛围如此，我们也只能顺势而为。

为此，维克米付出了不小的代价，但我们绝不会夹着尾巴落荒而逃。我们的CEO公开声明，坚决反对任何加达里势力侵入联邦空间， CEO合作组织对此当然怒不可遏，他们吹毛求疵，以莫名其妙的理由向我们收取了高额罚金。最为棘手的是如果参议院向抗议者让步的话，我们对联邦空域内的死亡空间层面的租约可能随时会作废。

既然现在你已经大概了解了情况，该是行动的时候了。你的第一个目标是乔利亚里一个废弃的联邦海军旧弹药仓库。我们已经证实，FON军方在那儿存放了大量大威力武器。炸毁弹药库，那么他们在乔利亚的势力将被削弱。谈话到此结束，去行动吧。

messages.en: With your mission a success, FON will have been dealt a serious blow.  But if I know them correctly, they'll use this as an excuse to launch a counter-attack.  Meanwhile though I'd like to start concentrating on the Serpentis.  Stick around and I'll give you more details on that.
messages.zh: 由于你的任务很成功，所以FON会遭受沉重的打击。不过如果我对他们的了解没错，那么他们会以此为借口，发动一次反攻。不过现在，我想要开始集中对付天蛇了。别走远，我会给你更多的相关细节。

messages.en: <font color=FF0000>You will lose standing with the Gallente Federation for attacking Friends of Nature.  Despite Wiyrkomi's insistence that FON are a terrorist organization, the Federation thinks of them only as a minor nuissance.  And in fact only a part of FON partake in fighting Wiyrkomi, the larger part of it is non-violent.</font>
messages.zh: <font color=FF0000>如果攻击FON，你将损失在盖伦特联邦的声望。尽管维克米坚称FON是恐怖组织，不过在联邦眼中，他们只是小麻烦。事实上，只有部分FON成员参与了对维克米的斗争，该组织的大多数成员是非暴力的。</font>

messages.en: <font color=FF0000>Warning</font>
messages.zh: <font color=FF0000>警告</font>

messages.en: I have the voucher.
messages.zh: 我拿到凭证了。

messages.en: Alright, let me have it.
messages.zh: 好的，我会去做的。

messages.en: I'd like to work for you.
messages.zh: 我乐意为你工作。

messages.en: Before I let you work for me you're going to have to supply me with a voucher from Veko Tallaja, located in Central Command in Fluekele.
messages.zh: 在我给你工作前，你必须得到维考•塔尔拉瑕的凭证，他就在弗琉克勒的中心指挥部。

messages.en: Here is the voucher.
messages.zh: 这是你要的凭证。

messages.en: Now that you've established your worth, let's get started.
messages.zh: 既然你已建立信任，那么我们开始吧。

messages.en:
Before I let you work for me you're going to have to supply me with a voucher from Veko Tallaja, located in Central Command in Fluekele..

Do not accept this mission if you have not completed the pre-required mission sequence in Central Command or have acquired the neccessary voucher some other way.
messages.zh:
在我给你工作前，你必须得到维考•塔尔拉瑕的凭证，他就在弗琉克勒的中心指挥部。

如果你没有完成中央指挥部中的前期任务，或者没有通过其他方式获得必要的凭证，那就不要接受这个任务。

messages.en:
Here's the deal. I'm a senior journalist for the Scope, and I'm working on an in-depth piece about the Wiyrkomi project in this constellation and the FON's (Friends of Nature's) struggle to counteract their plans. It's a big piece, and I have several reporters working on different strands in different places, so assistance from a fast-moving capsule pilot such as yourself is always needed.

As a matter of fact, I have a job for you right now if you want it. One of my reporters just completed a few interviews with Colelie project workers who are on break from the project at the Wiyrkomi Factory in Fluekele. He says he managed to get some juicy tidbits from them about the way Wiyrkomi handles its workers; grist for the cause, to mangle a metaphor.

Bring me back the interview transcripts from Fluekele, and I'll pay you as much as the agency allows me to dole out. How about it?
messages.zh:
事情是这样的。我是《视角》的资深记者，正在深入调查这个星系中维克米的项目以及FON的反抗活动。这是一件大事，我还有几个记者在不同地方的不同战线工作，所以很需要像你这样机敏的飞行员帮忙。

事实上，我现在就有工作给你。我的一个记者刚完成对克勒列项目工作人员的访问，他说这些人正在闹罢工。从他们口中，我的同事获知了不少关于维克米如何对待劳工的情况。

从弗琉克勒带回访问手稿，我会给你我能付出的最高工资。如何？

messages.en:
As I said earlier, it's time for us turn our attention to the Serpentis. The Serpentis problem should in fact be easier to deal with than our war with the Gallente environmentalists, but at the same time they are the deadlier foe. The Serpentis are not at war with us due to some fanatical idealogy, instead they are simply here to protect their financial interests. I'm quite certain that as soon as they see this 'war' becoming unprofitable in the long run, they will retreat from their positions in our territory.

So to start off we need to make them know we mean business. And to do that I want you to take out one of their drug convoys. I had the Temko mercenaries under my command conduct a massive surveillance operation, which eventually revealed one of the Serpentis's drug convoy routes. I'll supply you with a bookmark that should lead you to one such convoy. Destroy it and report back to me. And remember, the cargo should not be brought back here, I want nothing to do with their contraband.
messages.zh: 正如我之前所说的，现在是时候把注意力放在天蛇集团上了。实际上，天蛇集团的问题应该比那些盖伦特环保主义者的更简单，不过他们却更致命。天蛇集团并不是因为某种狂热的信仰而与我们开战，他们只是为了保护自己在这里的经济利益。我相信，只要他们一认识到这场“战争”从长期来看无利可图，他们就会从设置在我们领地的据点里撤走。<br><br>所以，首先我们要让他们知道我们是动真格的。因此，我要你去干掉他们的一支违规药品护航队。我派手下的天科雇佣兵开展了一次大规模监视行动，最终发现了天蛇的一条违规药品运送路线。根据我将提供给你的位标，你能找到这样一支护航队。把它摧毁，然后回来向我报告。记住，<b>不要</b>把货物带回这来，我不想和他们的非法买卖扯上任何关系。

messages.en: The Serpentis convoy has been destroyed, as you requested General.
messages.zh: 遵照你的命令，天蛇护航队已经被消灭了。

messages.en: Good job.  I've sent a message to the Serpentis outpost in Azure Canyon, claiming responsibility for the attack on their convoy.  With enough pressure on them, I'm sure they will cave in.  But there's more to be done, one convoy won't affect the Serpentis much at all.  So stay tuned.
messages.zh: 做得好。我已经给苍穹峡谷的天蛇哨站发去消息，宣称对袭击他们的护航队事件负责。足够大的压力一定会让他们屈服。但要做的事情还很多，一支护航队根本不会影响天蛇什么的。保持联系。

messages.en:
It seems the Wiyrkomi Corporation isn't being entirely forthcoming when it comes to their labor practices. That was some very interesting material you brought back from Fluekele. So good, in fact, that I feel a sudden, almost physical urge to follow up on it.

One of my top reporters just came in from Oursulaert. I want you to take him to the Wiyrkomi factory in Jolia, where some highly classified contacts are waiting for him. Since Wiyrkomi won't give us the straight dope, we're going to have to turn to alternative sources. I'll find out the truth yet.

Take my guy to Jolia and I'll see to it that you're rewarded handsomely.
messages.zh:
看来谈到劳工待遇问题，维克米集团就变得没那么热情主动了。你从弗琉克勒带回的资料非常有意思。这些资料使我突然有一种想要继续深查下去的冲动。

我有一名最棒的通讯员刚从奥苏拉尔特回来。我要你带他去乔利亚的维克米工厂，那里有个秘密联络员在等他。既然维克米不告诉我们内情，我们就只能自己想办法，总不能吊死在一棵树上吧。这件事我一定查个水落石出。

带我的人到乔利亚，我会给你可观的报酬。

messages.en:
Something fishy's going on here. Word just came in over the feednet: apparently, a FON strike squad staged an attack on a surveillance outpost in Colelie belonging to Temko, a mercenary organization contracted by Wiyrkomi to protect their holdings and help them gain a foothold in this constellation.

This doesn't feel right at all. First, FON doesn't engage in out-and-out terrorism; their battles take place on politico-ideological fronts. Second, had it been FON, why would they advertise that fact? Their tactic is the swaying of public opinion, not the destruction of their opponents' assets. This has all the hallmarks of a frame-up.

An old friend of mine who's well-connected in this area says he's managed to obtain the data core from one of the attacking ships' computers as it was brought in by salvager vessels. If we can get it into the hands of our specialists here, they might be able to extract some clues regarding the attackers' real identities and intentions. Head out to Parchanier and get me that data core. A lot may be riding on this.
messages.zh:
这里的事儿有些可疑。我的情报网收到消息：一支FON部队袭击了克勒列维克米监视哨站，那里驻扎了一群天科佣兵，维克米雇用他们保卫自己的产业和集团在星系中的地位。

我觉得不对劲。首先，FON不是那种极端恐怖主义组织，他们喜欢玩文字游戏，在意识形态的层次舞刀弄剑。其次，如果是FON，为什么他们要对此事大肆宣扬呢？他们的策略是发动群众，而非使用武力，这里肯定有阴谋。

我在这儿有一个消息灵通的老朋友，他声称自己拿到了攻击飞船的一个电脑数据芯片，如果将它交到我们的专家手中，他们也许能发现一些关于攻击者真正身份和意图的线索。前往帕查尼尔，帮我拿回这个数据芯片。说不定能有重大发现呢。

messages.en:
Your next assignment is a pretty important one. Elere Febre is a Serpentis agent working in Fluekele, which we believe is their contact with Friends of Nature, as we've detected FON agents visiting her habitation module multiple times in the past week alone. FON are desperate to not let news of this alliance between them and Serpentis leak to the public. I'm not even sure if the majority of FON's members know of their dealings with pirates. Public opinion in favor of FON will undoubtedly plummet once people believe there is a connection between them and violent criminals.

Now killing her should be simple. The difficult part is retrieving evidence of her involvement with FON. I'm counting on her leaving some sort of evidence in her habitation module, which is located at Fluekele IV's sixth moon. Find the habitation module and destroy it, search the wreckage for anything that survived which may implicate FON's relationship with Serpentis. Return to me with your findings. Hopefully we'll be able to kill two flies in one swing with the completion of this mission.
messages.zh:
你接下来的任务相当重要。埃勒尔•费博是在弗琉克勒活动的天蛇特工，我们认为她就是天蛇与FON的联络人，因为光上周我们就多次发现FON特工前往她的居住舱。FON极不希望外界知道他们与天蛇的这种联盟关系。我甚至怀疑，大多数FON成员都不知道他们在与海盗打交道。公众一旦确信FON和暴力犯罪集团有瓜葛，他们对FON的支持度肯定会一落千丈。

言归正传，干掉她并不难。难就难在取得她与FON勾结的证据。我现在就寄希望于她会在她位于弗琉克勒IV—卫6的居住舱里留下些证据。找到那个居住舱并把它摧毁，在残骸里搜索任何尚存的可能证明FON与天蛇集团有关系的东西。带着你找到的东西返回我这儿来。这个任务的完成很可能会使我们一箭双雕。

messages.en: With Elere out of the picture, the Serpentis will hopefully have a more difficult time dealing with FON.  Friends of Nature are not the sort of organization to strike deals with pirates
messages.zh: 既然埃勒尔被干掉了，天蛇与FON的合作可能就会出现危机。FON不是那种善于与海盗打交道的组织

messages.en: Fly to Fluekele IV's sixth moon and find Elere Febre's habitation module.  Destroy it and retrieve her data log from the wreckage.
messages.zh: 去弗琉克勒IV—卫6，找到埃勒尔•费博的居住舱。摧毁它，并从残骸中取回她的数据日志。

messages.en:
Okay, it's about to hit the fan. We've stumbled on to something very very bad indeed. It's so bad, in fact, that I'm not even going to come close to covering it in my article. The people behind this cannot know, under any circumstances, that we know about their plans.

I can't tell you any more at this moment, but I'll tell you what I can do. I'm going to ask you for one more favor, and then I'm going to give you a contact within the FON. They have some work they need done, and since they're generally not the travelling types they could use a big strapping capsuleer to help them. But first I need to ask you one more favor.

I've collected the data I've accrued in the making of my article into one dossier, which I need brought to a safe place. Word's just reached us that Wiyrkomi have this place under wraps, so I've become compromised. I'll have to jack in and do the rest of this remotely.

Bring my dossier to my contact in Parchanier, and I'll hand over our analysis of the evidence you got for us. It's bad, friend. It's real bad.
messages.zh:
哎，我们无意中发现了很糟很糟的事。太糟了，事实上，我甚至不想在我的报道里对此事做任何掩饰。无论如何，事件背后的人并不知道我们了解他们的计划。

目前我并不能透露更多的细节，但会告诉你我打算怎么做。再帮我一个忙，然后我会把你介绍给一个FON的官员。他们手头有一些事情需要处理，但又不能亲自去做，所以你这样的飞行员正合他们的胃口。好吧，先说我要你做的事。

我在写文章时收集了很多资料，现在我把这些资料整理到一篇文档里，得送到安全的地方保存。有消息说维克米已经将这个地方包围，可能我的身份已经暴露。为此我必须暂时找个地方躲躲，暗中指挥剩下的事情。

将我编好的资料带到帕查尼尔我的联系人那儿，然后我会把那些证据的分析结果给你。朋友，这太糟了，真的太糟了。

messages.en:
Good work. I'm glad I found you.

Take this data chip. On it, you will find evidence that the Wiyrkomi corporation have been engaging in terrorism against themselves in order to shift the public's opinion regarding both them and FON. It's not absolutely 100 percent reliable, but what there is seems solid enough. Bring this chip to Preaux Gallot in the Natura Seminary in Audaerne. There is more to be done yet, and I have a feeling this is all just beginning.

Thank you for all your help. You've done us a great service.
messages.zh:
干得好。能找到你，我很高兴。

把这块数据芯片拿去。在这块数据芯片上，你能找到维克米集团为了改变民众对集团本身和FON的看法，而对自己进行恐怖袭击的证据。虽然不是百分百的可靠，但目前的信息已经够有说服力的了。把这个芯片送到奥德尔尼的纳图拉神学院的普尔渥•加洛那里。还有更多的事要做，我感觉这只是个开始。

谢谢你的帮助。你帮了我们一个大忙。

messages.en:
The Serpentis have so far refused to meet any of our demands. I expected as much, a few convoys and agents are expendable in their eyes. But it's time to turn up the heat. This time I would like you to gather the best pilots you can muster and launch an offensive directly into the Azure Canyon of Colelie. Head straight towards the Black Market pocket and destroy the Serpentis Stronghold. If you can, try to recover something that will allow us to blackmail them, such as computer logs, prisoners, anything.

I suspect that Salvador Sarpati will think twice about going up against Wiyrkomi after suffering the loss of such a costly installation. If all goes as planned, the Serpentis will retreat from the Azure Canyon, giving us full access to the ion clouds.
messages.zh:
到目前为止，天蛇仍然拒绝满足我们的任何要求。我就料到会这样，在他们眼里损失一些护航队和特工根本算不了什么。不过现在该是加压的时候了。这次我要你召集所能找到的最优秀飞行员，直接攻入克勒列的苍穹峡谷。径直飞往黑市所在空间层，捣毁天蛇要塞。如果可能，尽量带些能用以勒索他们的东西回来，比如计算机日志、俘虏之类的。

我想，在丢掉了如此昂贵的一个基地之后，萨瓦多尔•萨巴蒂在跟维克米作对前肯定会三思而行。如果一切按计划进行，天蛇会从苍穹峡谷撤军，我们将完全占有离子云。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. I see that you brought back a data chip containing transaction logs from within the Black Market of Azure Canyon, that will most definitely help us in our dealings with the Serpentis. I'm sure some of their customers would be less than happy to find out their involvement with a pirate organization was leaked to Federation authorities, and I'm sure the Serpentis will be desperate to keep us from uploading this data to our contacts within The Scope ...

But our work doesn't end here. We still need to deal with those fanatics in Friends of Nature ...
messages.zh:
干得太漂亮了，{[character]player.name}。我知道你带回来的数据芯片中包含了苍穹峡谷的黑市交易日志，那会在我们对付天蛇时提供极大帮助。我肯定他们的某些客户决不会希望他们与海盗组织之间的关系被泄露给联邦当局，所以天蛇也会想方设法阻止我们将数据上传给我们在《视角》里的联络人……

但是我们的工作现在还没结束。我们还需要对付那些FON的狂热分子……

在付出了承重代价之后，我想萨瓦多尔•萨巴蒂会重新考虑是否继续与维克米作对。如果一切顺利的话，天蛇会从苍穹峡谷撤军，让我们能一举通过离子云。

messages.en: Looking forward to it, general.
messages.zh: 将军，等着瞧吧。

messages.en:
As your final assignment for me, {[character]player.name}, I want you obliterate the FON headquarters, located in Deltole. As you probably know, Friends of Nature mainly consists of civilians which are protected by Federation law. They claim to be a peaceful organization fighting for 'the environment', but in fact a large portion of its members are nothing but terrorist scum who are willing to sacrifice human life to protect a heap of rocks and gas clouds. I've come to realize that no matter how hard we hit them, they will always come back for more. So the only course of action I see is to exterminate the lot of them.

Unfortunately, the Federation will not look kindly upon us killing its civilians, despite them being affiliated with Friends of Nature. They don't have the same view of FON as we do. So it is vital that you do not reveal who you are working for to anyone. If you do, I'll make certain you won't live to see another day.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，作为我给你的最终任务，我要你去毁掉FON在底托勒的总部。你大概知道，FON主要由受联邦法律保护的平民组成。他们自称是一个为“环境”而战的和平组织，但实际上，他们中大部分成员是彻头彻尾的恐怖分子，他们宁愿牺牲人命来保护一堆岩石和气云。我已经意识到，无论我们多么猛烈的打击他们，他们总是能卷土重来而且变本加厉。所以唯一有效的手段就是把他们彻底铲除。

不幸的是，联邦不会眼睁睁看着我们加害他们的平民，不管这些平民是否是FON的成员。他们对FON的看法和我们不一样。所以绝不要向任何人透露你的服务对象，否则你就肯定见不到明天的太阳了。

messages.en: The FON headquarters has been destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: FON总部已被摧毁，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en:
Awesome job, {[character]player.name}. I'm puzzled why there were no live guards at their headquarters, just drones and sentry guns, but at least their structures were destroyed. Now I just hope most of their personnel were located inside. Either way, you did what I asked you to and for that you deserve your reward.

Dismissed.
messages.zh:
任务完成得漂亮极了！{[character]player.name}。我很疑惑，为什么他们总部那里没有活人守卫，只有一些无人机和岗哨炮，但至少他们的建筑物被摧毁了。现在我只希望他们多数人员当时都在里面。不管怎样，你按我的要求做了一切，为此，这份酬劳是你应得的。

讲完了。

Good luck out there, soldier.

不幸的是，联邦不会眼睁睁看着我们加害他们的平民，不管这些平民是否是FON的成员。他们对FON的看法和我们不一样。所以绝不要向任何人透露你的服务对象，否则你就肯定见不到明天的太阳了。

祝你好运，士兵。

messages.en:
Welcome to the Nickel & Dime Store, {[character]player.name}. It is a humble little shop owned and operated by the Thukker tribe, catering to the needy souls in this beautiful constellation. Hm, something tells me you can be of some assistance to us ― perhaps you've worked for the Thukkers in the past?

Let's see if you've got what it takes to help our fledgling business grow. I have a small task for you: nothing complicated or risky, but it should let me gauge your talents. Deliver a few crates of goods to a nearby station for me. The rewards are modest, since this is such an easy task, but it's only the start.
messages.zh:
欢迎光临尼克尔折扣店，{[character]player.name}。鄙小店由图克尔部落掌管经营，为这个美丽星座中的穷困人群服务。嗯，直觉告诉我你能对我们有所帮助——也许你过去为图克尔人工作过，是吗？

让我们瞧瞧你是否有能力帮我们刚起步的生意快速发展。我有一个小任务给你：一点也不复杂，也不危险，但足以让我判断你的能力。帮我把几箱货物运到附近一座空间站去。报酬一般，毕竟任务非常简单，不过这才刚开始。

messages.en:
Good work on your previous assignment. Despite it being a tedious one, you pulled it off without any qualms. Now for something a little more interesting.

You see, things have not been easy around here lately. The Caldari mega-corp Wiyrkomi is intent on tapping into the vast natural resources found in the constellation, much to the dismay of the many environmentalists here in the Federation. The struggle between the two sides draws unwanted attention to our little enterprise here and is making our operation difficult. Down the road, I might be tempted to have you help us with this unpleasant situation. But not just yet. First, we have to take care of another small problem that just came up.

The Serpentis drug lords are out in force here in Algintal, overseeing traffic between Federation and Republic space. We Thukkers are not into the drug scene, so we generally leave them alone. The same applies for them, for the most part. Live and let live, huh? Thing is, many of the Serpentis have grown too fond of their own goods and can get a little wild at times. One such incident occurred the other night when a gang of renegade Serpentis junkies stole some goods we were receiving from our associates in the Republic. The goods aren't all that valuable, but we must send a clear sign to the Serpentis that our goods are to be left alone.

I know that the fools who stole our goods are relaxing at the Skeleton Comet complex over in Deltole. If you're willing to go over there and teach them a lesson, a hard lesson ― a permanent lesson, get me? ― then I would be much obliged. And if you could return with some of the goods they stole, I'd be even happier.
messages.zh:
上个任务干得漂亮。虽然任务比较单调乏味，而你却毫不含糊地出色完成了。我相信你就是我们要找的飞行员。

你也看到了，最近这里周围的情况也不怎么样。加达里的超级集团维克米一心想要强占这个星系丰富的自然资源，这引起了联邦众多环保论者的极大恐慌。双方你争我夺，导致我们这儿的小企业受到了觊觎，使我们的运作变得困难。我找你前来就是想打开这一局面。但还不是现在。首先，我们必须处理刚刚出现的一个小问题。

天蛇非法贩售者大规模出现在阿根塔。他们掌握着联邦和共和国空域里的违规药品交易。我们图克尔部落从不涉及违规药品，对他们的交易也不插手。大部分情况下，他们也同样对待我们。但是，天蛇集团中有不少人的胃口似乎越来越大了，时不时就会失控。不久前的一天晚上，一帮脱离天蛇的瘾君子拿走了一批我们从共和国的合伙人那里收到的货物。货物本身无足轻重，但是我们必须向天蛇集团发出明确的警告，别想在太岁头上动土。

我了解到，那些拿走我们货物的天蛇集团正在底托勒的骷髅彗星复合体那儿休息。如果你愿意去那里给他们一点教训的话，我会很高兴的。而如果你能再把他们拿走的货物带回来的话，我更会感激不尽。

messages.en:
Good work on your previous assignment. Despite it being a tedious one, you pulled it off without any qualms. Now for something a little more interesting.

You see, things have not been easy around here lately. The Caldari mega-corp Wiyrkomi is intent on tapping into the vast natural resources found in the constellation, much to the dismay of the many environmentalists here in the Federation. The struggle between the two sides draws unwanted attention to our little enterprise here and is making our operation difficult. Down the road, I might be tempted to have you help us with this unpleasant situation. But not just yet. First, we have to take care of another small problem that just came up.

The Serpentis drug lords are out in force here in Algintal, overseeing traffic between Federation and Republic space. We Thukkers are not into the drug scene, so we generally leave them alone. The same applies for them, for the most part. Live and let live, huh? Thing is, many of the Serpentis have grown too fond of their own goods and can get a little wild at times. One such incident occurred the other night when a gang of renegade Serpentis junkies stole some goods we were receiving from our associates in the Republic. The goods aren't all that valuable, but we must send a clear sign to the Serpentis that our goods are to be left alone.

I know that the fools who stole our goods are relaxing at the Skeleton Comet complex over in Deltole. If you're willing to go over there and teach them a lesson, a hard lesson ― a permanent lesson, get me? ― then I would be much obliged. And if you could return with some of the goods they stole, I'd be even happier.
messages.zh:
上个任务干得漂亮。虽然任务比较单调乏味，而你却毫不含糊地出色完成了。我相信你就是我们要找的飞行员。

你也看到了，最近这里周围的情况也不怎么样。加达里的超级集团维克米一心想要强占这个星系丰富的自然资源，这引起了联邦众多环保论者的极大恐慌。双方你争我夺，导致我们这儿的小企业受到了觊觎，使我们的运作变得困难。我找你前来就是想打开这一局面。但还不是现在。首先，我们必须处理刚刚出现的一个小问题。

天蛇非法贩售者大规模出现在阿根塔。他们掌握着联邦和共和国空域里的违规药品交易。我们图克尔部落从不涉及违规药品，对他们的交易也不插手。大部分情况下，他们也同样对待我们。但是，天蛇集团中有不少人的胃口似乎越来越大了，时不时就会失控。不久前的一天晚上，一帮脱离天蛇的瘾君子拿走了一批我们从共和国的合伙人那里收到的货物。货物本身无足轻重，但是我们必须向天蛇集团发出明确的警告，别想在太岁头上动土。

我了解到，那些拿走我们货物的天蛇集团正在底托勒的骷髅彗星复合体那儿休息。如果你愿意去那里给他们一点教训的话，我会很高兴的。而如果你能再把他们拿走的货物带回来的话，我更会感激不尽。

name.de: Besorgte Bürger - Lauf, Junge, Lauf! (3 von 3)
name.en: Concerned Citizens - Run, Boy, Run! (3 of 3)
name.fr: Des citoyens préoccupés – Une course un peu spéciale (3 sur 3)
name.ru: Обеспокоенные граждане - беги, парень, беги! (Concerned Citizens - Run, Boy, Run!) (3 из 3)

messages.en: Excellent! I'm already feeling more confident about this whole thing. I think I can count on you and Angetyn together to sort this mess out.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！我对整个事情越来越有信心了。有你和安家特一起解决这个麻烦事，我就放心了。

messages.en:
Oh, {[character]player.name}, you've come at an opportune moment. Things are progressing as I feared they would. The continuous struggle between Wiyrkomi and the activists have cast a spotlight on the constellation. While we here are the Nickel & Dime Store are running a perfectly legal business, our associates and clients like to operate in the dark. Already, I've lost several important clients, and some employees are getting restless. So much so that I'm having difficulties making my more demanding deliveries.

Unfortunately, I do not have the means or the knowledge to do much about the situation, but my business associate Iliere Angetyn is a most resourceful Gallentean, and I'm sure he's already contemplating how to put things right. But Angetyn doesn't deal with just anyone. Only those clearly in favor with the Trust Partners company get his attention. So I have a proposal for you. Run an errand for me that one of my just-departed couriers was supposed to, and I'll give you a Trust Partners Business Card. Show this to Angetyn and he's certain to offer you something lucrative.

The errand in question is a simple delivery over the border into the Republic. It has a very small chance of getting you in trouble with the customs, but I'm sure a resourceful pilot such as yourself can pick the right route to avoid any unwanted attention.
messages.zh:
嗨，{[character]player.name}，你来得正好，就像我担心的那样，维克米和激进分子之间的斗争愈演愈烈，已成了整个星座关注的焦点。尼克尔折扣店做着完全合法的生意，我们的合伙人和客户却希望在暗中私通。就这样我失去了好几个重要客户，手下部分雇员也变得焦躁不安。目前情况很严重，我无法再做更多定单。

很遗憾我对目前的局面已无能为力，而我的生意合伙人伊林尔•安家特是一个极其机智的盖伦特人，他应该知道如何摆脱困境。但安家特并不随便和人接近。只有那些受信任伙伴集团垂青的人才能引起他的注意。如果你能代替我的信使帮我送样东西，我会给你一张信任伙伴的名片卡。给安家特看一下，他一定会给你一些赚钱的活儿。

我所说的这件差事仅是让你跨越边境进入共和国的一个简单的运送而已。这些货物可能会引起米玛塔尔海关的注意，但我相信你这样机智的飞行员懂得选择适合的路线来避免不必要的麻烦。

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}. Now, take the business card I just gave you and go talk to Iliere Angetyn.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，干得不错。现在带上我刚刚给你的名片卡，去和安家特谈一谈。

name.fr: Les associés - Tueur à gages (1 sur 4)
name.ja: ビジネスアソシエイツ-殺し屋（1/4）
name.ru: Партнеры по бизнесу - наемный убийца (Business Associates - Hit Man) (1 из 4)

messages.en: I know how to keep my mouth shut. What kind of work do you have?
messages.zh: 我知道怎样管住自己的嘴。你有什么样的活？

messages.en: I want you to head over to the Wiyrkomi surveillance outpost here in Augnais and take out their shuttle. Make sure you locate the surveillance recordings; confiscate them and bring them back to me.
messages.zh: 我需要你前去奥格奈斯这里的维克米监控哨站，击毁他们的穿梭机。确保找到监控记录；查抄它们，带回给我。

messages.en: Nice. Good work. But now something else has come up...
messages.zh: 漂亮。干得好。不过，现在又出了一档子别的事……

messages.en:
Hm. Alright. You see, Algintal was such a nice place a few years back. The traffic through its systems and the many tourists meant we could operate with minimal risk. But now that has all changed with the arrival of the Wiyrkomi corporation and their lackeys, Roden Shipyards. What were once standard border-running operations now require much more time and effort to pull off.

What is worse, the Caldari think they own the place just because they exploited a loophole in the trade agreement between the State and the Federation. They're trying to muscle us out. I want to nip that bullshit in the bud and strike back at the Wiyrkomi. That's where you come in, {[character]player.name}.

The Wiyrkomi have installed a surveillance outpost here in Augnais. The problem is, I only found out about it a few days ago, after I'd just completed an important deal with a Republic contact of mine. If the Wiyrkomi listened in on the deal, they could compromise the Thukkers' position here in Algintal. I thought it was too late to do anything about it, but the security measures of the Wiyrkomi are working against them here. The surveillance outpost operates in total radio silence and only sends out its recordings in a shuttle once a week to the Wiyrkomi headquarters over in Fluekele. The shuttle will depart tomorrow, so there is still time to take care of this ... problem. I want you to head over to the surveillance outpost and take out that shuttle. Make sure you locate the surveillance recordings and confiscate them. Bring them back to me, and we're back on track.
messages.zh:
喔，知道吗，阿根塔在几年前还是一个美丽的地方。星系中有着良好的交通状况和络绎不绝的游客，这意味着我们的经营风险非常小。但现在，随着维克米集团和他们的马屁精莱登船业的到来，一切都改变了。曾经的标准边境业务现在需要耗费更多时间和精力才能完成。

更糟糕的是，加达里认为他们拥有这个地方，仅仅是因为他们利用了合众国与联邦的贸易协定中的一个漏洞。他们试图强行把我们逼走。我想在这混蛋东西的萌芽状态就终止它，并向维克米发动反击。这就是用得着你的地方了，{[character]player.name}。

维克米在奥格奈斯星系安置了一个观察站。问题是，我只是在几天前才知道这个事情，正巧是在我和我在共和国内部一个线人完成了一项重要的交易后。如果维克米在中间听到了什么信息，那么他们在阿根塔就能制约图克尔人了。我想现在要想做点什么已经太晚了，但是维克米在这儿的安全系统却对他们不是很有利。观察站的运转是在完全的无线电静默中进行的，只是在每周会有一艘穿梭机将情报运载到弗琉克勒维克米的总部进行分析。穿梭机明天就会出发，所以我们还有时间来对付这个……问题。我要你出发去观察站，把那个穿梭机干掉。然后找到监控记录并且予以没收。然后再带回来给我，这样就行了。

name.es: Socios comerciales: El hombre de la bolsa (2 de 4)
name.fr: Les associés – Homme de main (2 sur 4)
name.ja: ビジネスアソシエイツ-運び屋（2/4）
name.ru: Партнеры по бизнесу - посредник (Business Associates - Bag Man) (2 из 4)

messages.en: You got it, boss. On my way.
messages.zh: 你放心吧，头儿。我上路了。

messages.en: That's what I like to hear. Git 'er done.
messages.zh: 我就爱听这个。去完成任务吧。

messages.en: Absolutely. What do I need to know?
messages.zh: 当然。我需要了解些什么？

messages.en: Head over to the Skeletal Comet in Deltole, locate the wrecked ship, and get the drugs out.
messages.zh: 到底托勒的骷髅彗星去，找到舰船的残骸并把药品带回来。

messages.en:
It seems every time the Thukkers get themselves in trouble they come running to me to clean things up. I mean, I can't complain ― the Thukkers don't admit many foreigners into their ranks, so I'm in a privileged position, but still...

Anyway, as you might know, this constellation is full of activists fighting the Wiyrkomi and their plans to "spoil the natural beauty" to harvest resources. We've gotten into contact with some of the more belligerent activists, making them think we're here to support them, but of course we're just using them for our own benefit. We've provided them with some old ships and have even been providing full maintenance service for them. What they don't know is that we've used the opportunity when we service the ships to stuff their hidden cargo hatches full of contraband for them to ferry around for us. Heh. Pretty neat, eh? Yeah, well, it would be if these idiot FON guys would just shuttle peacefully around.

Thing is, one of them had to get into a fight with some Serpentis pirate over in Deltole and get blown to pieces. Of course the ship was full of drugs, and we need to clear that stuff up before anyone notices. Can you head over to the Skeletal Comet over in Deltole, locate the wrecked ship, and get the drugs out? I suspect they must be spoiled by now, what with the explosion and all, but we need to get them out anyway before the activists ― or worse, the authorities ― find them.
messages.zh:
看起来每次图克尔人惹上麻烦，都要我来收拾残局。我是说，我没法抱怨——图克尔部落中只有少数外族人能够进入他们的阶层，所以我已经享有很高特权了，不过还是……

无论如何，你可能知道，这个星座中有很多激进分子在与维克米作斗争，抵制他们“损坏美丽的自然”的资源采集计划。我们与其中一些最为好战的激进分子取得了联系，使他们以为我们是来支持他们的，但当然，我们只是为了我们自己的利益而利用他们。我们为他们提供了一些旧船，甚至为他们提供全套维修服务。而他们不知道的是我们利用为他们的飞船提供服务的机会，将船上隐藏的货舱中填满了违禁品，让他们为我们四处运输。呵呵，很巧妙吧？是的，要是这些白痴FON成员只是静静地四处航行，那确实很巧妙。<br><br>问题是，他们中的一个人在底托勒与某个天蛇海盗交上了火，还被炸成了碎片。 那艘船当然满载着违规药品，所以我们必须在任何人注意以前清理那些东西。你能够去底托勒的骷髅彗星找到飞船残骸并取出违规药品吗？ 我怀疑违规药品已经在飞船的爆炸中与别的东西一起被损坏了，但是无论如何我们必须赶在激进分子前把它取出来——更要赶在当局之前。

name.fr: Les associés – Du linge pas très propre (3 sur 4)
name.ja: ビジネスアソシエイツ-洗濯屋（3/4）
name.ru: Партнеры по бизнесу - грязное белье (Business Associates - Dirty Laundry) (3 из 4)

messages.en: Hey, as long as there's a decent, big job coming next, I'm willing.
messages.zh: 嗨，只要马上有像样的重大任务，我就愿意干。

messages.en: Anything else come up for me?
messages.zh: 还有其他事给我做吗？

messages.en: I want you to head over to Fluekele and drop this container off at the Pend Insurance station, where a friend of mine will place it in a safe-deposit box there. I know it's a trivial thing I'm asking, but this is very sensitive material that absolutely can't get into the wrong hands ... and, besides, I need more time to prepare for your big mission.
messages.zh: 请你到弗琉克勒，把这个货柜放在彭德保险空间站，我的一个朋友会把它放到一个保险箱里。我知道这不过是件小事，但情报内容十分敏感，绝不能落入其他人的手里……此外，我还需要一些时间来准备你的重要任务。

messages.en: Done, {[character]agentID.name}. Now what's this big job you mentioned?
messages.zh: 任务完成了，{[character]agentID.name}。现在告诉我，你提过的那个重大任务是什么？

messages.en: Patience, my friend. I just need to arrange one more thing. Talk to me again in a minute.
messages.zh: 耐心点，我的朋友。我还有件事需要安排。请在一分钟后再跟我交谈。

messages.en:
Yes, in fact. I'm feeling very confident in your abilities, so I'm setting up a big job for you. But before that, I need you to take care of a smaller matter for me. I have acquired certain items that cast Veko Tallaja, the operation supervisor for Wiyrkomi here in Algintal, in a rather negative light. I'm not going to use this stuff just now, but I need to store it somewhere safe.

I want you to head over to Fluekele and drop it off at the Pend Insurance station there. A friend of mine will then place it in a safe-deposit box there. I know it's a trivial thing I'm asking, but this is very sensitive material that absolutely can't get into the wrong hands ... and, besides, I need more time to prepare for your big mission.
messages.zh:
是的，确实如此。我对你的能力非常有信心，所以给你准备了一个重要的任务。不过在此之前，我需要你帮我个小忙。我得到一些关于维考•塔尔拉瑕的不利情报，他是维克米集团在阿根塔星座整体运营的主管。我现在还不打算使用它，但我想把它藏在一个安全的地方。

请你到弗琉克勒，把情报放在彭德保险空间站。我的一个朋友会把它放到一个保险箱里。我知道这不过是件小事，但情报内容十分敏感，绝不能落入其他人的手里……此外，我还需要一些时间来准备你的重要任务。

name.de: Geschäftspartner - Vernichten Sie die Konkurrenz (4 von 4)
name.en: Business Associates - Kill the Competition (4 of 4)
name.es: Socios comerciales: Deshacerse de la competencia (4 de 4)
name.fr: Les associés - Éliminer la concurrence (4 sur 4)
name.ja: ビジネスアソシエイツ-競合相手を消せ（4/4）
name.ru: Партнеры по бизнесу - уничтожить конкурентов (Business Associates - Kill the Competition) (4 из 4)

messages.en: You kidding? I was born ready. Watchya got?
messages.zh: 你开玩笑吗？我时刻准备着。你到底有什么任务？

messages.en:
Some smugglers have built themselves a nice little hideout near here. We're not playing any games here, so killing them is the only item on the agenda. It was hell to track them down, so make sure you take them all out in one go so I don't have to repeat the process later.

If you pull this off with style, I'm sure some associates of mine would love for you to work a bit for them. When you bring me those dead smugglers' DNA, I'll give you some ship logs that my associates need to tamper with a bit to make them seem as innocent as a virgin's butt. Those logs should be ample proof to them that you're a trusted friend.
messages.zh:
一些非法贩售者在这附近为自己建了个小巧别致的藏身之所。我们可不打算跟他们在这儿玩游戏，所以干掉他们是我们计划中的唯一项目。追踪他们费了我们九牛二虎之力，所以你一定要一次把他们全都除掉，免得我以后再重复前面的劳动。

如果你能出色完成这个任务，我相信我的一些同事会很乐意找你去工作的。当你给我带回那些被击毙的非法贩售者的DNA后，我会给你一些飞船日志，我的同事要对它们做些改动，使它们看起来像处女一样清白。这些日志应该足以向他们证明你是位可信赖的朋友。

messages.en: Mission accomplished. Those smugglers won't be bothering you again.
messages.zh: 任务完成了。那些非法贩售者不会再来烦你了。

messages.en: That's what I like to hear, {[character]player.name}. You've proven yourself to me, at least. Glad to have you onboard.
messages.zh: 那正是我想听到的，{[character]player.name}。至少对我来说，你已经证明了自己。很高兴你加入我们。

messages.en:
Algintal has always been a favored spot for smugglers. It's far enough out of the way so as not to attract too much attention from the authorities. Besides us at Trust Partners, the Serpentis are out here in force, as well as several independents. Usually we try to stay well clear of each other, but sometimes a group arrives that thinks it can muscle everyone else out. One such group has been making a nuisance of itself recently, and it's time to take them out. We've played Mr. Nice Guy until now, but no longer.

The smugglers in question have built themselves a nice little hideout near here. We're not playing any games here, so killing them is the only item on the agenda. It was hell to track them down, so make sure you take them all out in one go so I don't have to repeat the process later.

If you pull this off with style, I'm sure some associates of mine would love for you to work a bit for them. When you bring me those dead smugglers' DNA, I'll give you some ship logs that my associates need to tamper with a bit to make them seem as innocent as a virgin's butt. Those logs should be ample proof to them that you're a trusted friend.
messages.zh:
阿根塔一直是非法贩售者钟爱的地方。这是个山高皇帝远的地方，当局在这里从来都没有投入过足够的注意力。除了我们信任伙伴集团之外，天蛇和一些独立力量在这里也有部队。通常我们尽量与他们井水不犯河水，但是有时会有些团体认为自己可以强迫别人都离开。最近有个团体就为此给自己惹上了麻烦，现在是时候除掉他们了。到目前为止，我们都扮演着好好先生的角色，该停止了。

我们说的这些非法贩售者在这附近为自己建了个小巧别致的藏身之所。我们可不打算跟他们在这儿玩游戏，所以干掉他们是我们计划中的唯一项目。追踪他们费了我们九牛二虎之力，所以你一定要一次把他们全都除掉，免得我以后再重复前面的劳动。

如果你能出色完成这个任务，我相信我的一些同事会很乐意找你去工作的。当你给我带回那些被击毙的非法贩售者的DNA后，我会给你一些飞船日志，我的同事要对它们做些改动，使它们看起来像处女一样清白。这些日志应该足以向他们证明你是位可信赖的朋友。

messages.en:
We try to keep our operation here at the Forgery under the radar, with a little bribery on the side to take care of over-zealous bureaucrats. Still, even if we're not exactly advertising our services we've established a rather formidable reputation in the underworld. We like to keep things as they are and sometimes we have to engage in some aggressive weed-killing to rid ourselves of unwanted baggage that can come back and haunt us later.

Which brings me to the job I want to offer you. A few months ago we entered an agreement with some local thugs here in Deltole. At the time we were anxious as to what the Serpentis druglords at the Skeleton Comet were up to, so we hired these guys to snoop around for us. Things went well for awhile, but now we have reason to believe the thugs have been playing both sides, offering their service to the Serpentis as well. That won't do, of course. We gave the thugs a ComLink encoder/decoder for secure communications. But what we didn't tell them was that the encoder also acts as a bug device. We only put it in their as a precaution, never intending to use it, but now we need to retrieve the encoder to confirm our believe that the thugs are two-faced bastards.

Get me that encoder so I can exact my punishment on them. I've already hatched a devious plan, if I say so myself, for framing those thugs and setting them up for the Serpentis to chew on. But first I need that encoder. The thugs have entrenched themselves deep inside the Skeleton Comet complex, acting as any other small time smuggling cartel. The encoder should be located in their Relay Station, so target that.
messages.zh:
我们尽量保持行动低调，不引起当局注意，为此，有时也需要贿赂那些“过于热心”的政府官员。尽管我们没有大肆宣扬自己的功绩，在黑社会里还是赢得了相当高的声誉。我们喜欢让事物顺其自然，但有时不得不铲除一些害群之马，扔掉累赘，避免今后的麻烦。

所以有件事要拜托你。几个月前我们在底托勒和一些当地暴徒达成了协议。当时我们很想知道天蛇集团的非法贩售者在骷髅彗星会有什么行动，所以雇佣这些人为我们巡查。事情似乎进行得非常顺利，但现在我发现这些暴徒在玩弄我们，他们同时也为天蛇集团办事。我最恨脚踏两只船的人。为保证通信安全，我们曾给这伙人一个信道加密/破译器，但没有告诉他们译码器同时也是一个窃听装置，原本是为了以防万一，没真正想过去使用，但是现在我们需要找回译码器来证实那些暴徒的确是两面派。

把译码器带给我，这样他们就会得到应有的惩罚。我已经构思了一个巧妙的计划，哼，想个办法让天蛇集团来教训他们。关键道具就是译码器。那些暴徒躲在骷髅彗星复合体的深处，干着各种各样的下三滥勾当。留意中继站，译码器一定在那儿。

name.ja: 偽造所―マーケットの動向（2/5）
name.ru: Подделка - пометка для рынка (The Forgery - Mark it for Market) (2 из 5)

messages.en:
I'm glad you came along, {[character]player.name}. As you probably already know the arrival of the Wiyrkomi corporation in the constellation has stirred things up a bit. Tourism is way down and the authorities are unfairly blaming us smugglers. It's getting harder and harder to conduct any decent smuggle run and we have to be twice as careful. Not that it harms us here at the Forgery much, if anything it only makes our services even more sought after.

A Minmatar associate of mine needs to get a large quantity of high quality X-Instinct into Gallente space, but he's not willing to risk the Federation customs at times like these. That's were we come into the picture. I need a small favor from you. I ordered a large quantity of dolls, but they're sitting in a TranStellar Shipping warehouse over in Adiere. Are you willing to fetch them for me? It's a trivial assignment, I know, but I'm positively swamped at the moment, as you can well understand.
messages.zh:
我很高兴你能来，{[character]player.name}。你可能知道，维克米集团的到来已在星座内激起不小的波澜。旅游业一路下滑，当局将其归咎于我们非法贩售者，这不公平。我们已经加倍小心，但依然很难舒舒服服干上一票。不过在伪造市场上我们并没有受到打击，生意反倒更红火了。
我的一个米玛塔尔同行需要将大量优质的Ｘ—本能兴奋剂带入盖伦特空间，但他不想在这种非常时刻冒险闯入联邦海关。那就让我们来做这件事吧。帮我个小忙。我订购了大量的玩偶，存放在埃迪尔勒的泛星船运仓库里，你愿意帮我把它们取来吗？我知道这有点大材小用，但你也看到了，我正忙得不可开交呢。

name.ru: Подделка - кукольный домик (The Forgery - Dollhouse) (3 из 5)

messages.en: I'm having the dolls 'enhanced' as we speak. Your next assignment is much more tricky. Are you willing to take the drug-filled dolls deep into Gallente space? The risk is less than it sounds, as only very thorough scan of your vessel will reveal what hides inside the innocent looking dolls. But occasionally it does happen and then you'd be in deep trouble. I'd understand if you back down now, but it would be a real shame after having accomplished so much for us. But as it's your ass on the line, I won't pressure you any further. The choice is yours.
messages.zh: 我们讲话的当口，我正在派人“升级”玩偶。你接下来的任务要棘手得多。你愿意把这些违规药品填充玩偶送到盖伦特空间深处吗？这并没有听上去那么危险，因为只有对飞船进行非常彻底的扫描才会显示这些天真无邪的玩偶里所藏的东西。不过这有时的确会发生，那时你的麻烦就大了。如果你现在放弃，我完全能够理解，但在为我们做出了这么多成就后放弃实在太可惜了。但毕竟要去冒生命危险的是你，我不会再强求你什么。你自己决定吧。

name.ru: Подделка - забудьте об этом (The Forgery - Fogeddaboutid) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
You've come through for me big time in the past, {[character]player.name}. So I have an important task for you now. First, I'll let you in on a little secret. You've probably already encountered some of the activists here in Algintal, fighting to get Wiyrkomi out. Well, we Thukkers are in the same boat. We also want Wiyrkomi out. Not because we care for the environment, but because Wiyrkomi's presence here is hitting our business hard. But the problem is we can't draw attention to ourselves. If Wiyrkomi or the Federation start perceiving the Thukker tribe as a real threat in the constellation they will come down on our heads real hard. And we don't want that to happen, now do we?

So we've been trying to manipulate things as much as we can behind the scenes. By discreetly supporting the more militant elements of FON we hope the activists can be of enough nuisance to the Wiyrkomi that the Caldari will flee with their tail between their legs. We've used every method we can come up with for this, including stirring some of the Serpentis druglords into action.

A few weeks ago a powerful druglord associated with the Angel Cartel, known as Don Rico, agreed to help out. At the time we didn't think that FON would amount to much, so we invested pretty heavily in getting Don Rico involved. The results were immediate and at first his diligence thrilled us. But recently it has started to get out of hand, with Don Rico getting ever more outrageous fighting Wiyrkomi and their cronies. Our sources close to the druglord tell us that Don Rico has grown much too fond of his own product and is completely out of control.

We need to restrain Don Rico before his actions jeopardize the whole operation. I know that the Federation Navy and CONCORD are starting to take notice and the last thing we need is for him to fall into their hands. He knows too much. So we need to take him out quickly. And you're just the pilot for the job. Unfortunately, I don't know the exact whereabouts of Don Rico. He likes to cruise around in his pleasure yacht and he could be lurking anywhere in the constellation. We need to flush him out and I know just the thing to stir him into showing his face. He owns a drug factory not far from here and I want you to raid it. Kill a few of his henchmen. Don Rico's greatest weakness is his vanity and vengefulness. A direct attack on his possessions will certainly make him come screaming in revenge. And that's our chance to take him out. But first, the raid. All Don Rico's henchmen have a smuggler signet. Collect a few of these signets and bring them to me. Let's see what happens then.
messages.zh:
过去你曾在很大程度上帮过我，{[character]player.name}。因此现在有一项重要的任务给你。首先我要告诉你一些秘密。也许在阿根塔你已经碰到了一些激进分子，他们正在努力把维克米赶出去。我们图克尔部落也想把维克米赶走。 但这并非跟风造势，事实上，维克米的存在对我们在这儿的生意是个不小的冲击。但是我们不能让自己的意图被看穿。如果维克米或者联邦发现图克尔部落对他们已构成了真正意义上的威胁时，他们会不遗余力地痛击我们。这并不是我们所希望看到的，不是吗？

所以我们只能在幕后全力把握事态的发展。通过暗中支持大量FON激进分子，我们正试图给维克米制造足够多的麻烦，让这些加达里混蛋夹着尾巴滚回老家。凡是所能想到的办法，我们都已试过，甚至还请了天蛇非法贩售者来帮忙。

几周前，有个实力雄厚的非法贩售者同意帮我们，他名叫多恩•瑞克，与天使企业联合体素有瓜葛。当时FON的表现很令我们失望，因此我们不惜重金，邀请多恩•瑞克加入。一开始他的表现无可挑剔，但最近情况似乎有了变化，虽然多恩•瑞克比以往更积极强硬地打压维克米及其党羽，但据我们在多恩•瑞克身边安插的卧底报告，他似乎过度沉溺于自己的产品……变成了一个不肯听话的瘾君子。

我们必须在多恩•瑞克搅乱整个计划之前让他住手。联邦海军和统合部似乎察觉到了什么，我们必须防止多恩落入他们手里。这家伙知道的太多了，除掉他是唯一的选择。而你正是这个任务的最佳人选，不幸的是，我不知道多恩•瑞克的确切行踪。他喜欢驾船四处巡游，很可能潜伏在这个星座的某处。我们必须得干掉他，不过我有个让他露面的方法。在离这儿不远处有个他的违规药品工厂，我要你袭击那几个地方，干掉几个他的党羽。多恩•瑞克的致命弱点就是虚荣心和报复心。眼看着自己的产业被毁，他必然怒火中烧，咬牙切齿地想要报复。然后我们的机会就来了。眼下还是来谈谈这次袭击。所有多恩•瑞克的党羽都随身配有非法贩售者图章。收集一些这样的图章带给我。让我们看看接下来将会发生些什么。

我们必须在多恩•瑞克搅乱整个计划之前让他住手。联邦海军和统合部似乎察觉到了什么，我们必须防止多恩落入他们手里。这家伙知道的太多了，除掉他是唯一的选择。而你正是这个任务的最佳人选，不幸的是，我不知道多恩•瑞克的确切行踪。他喜欢驾船四处巡游，很可能潜伏在这个星座的某处。我们必须得干掉他，不过我有个让他露面的方法。在离这儿不远处有个他的违规药品工厂，我要你袭击那几个地方，干掉几个他的党羽。多恩•瑞克的致命弱点就是虚荣心和报复心。眼看着自己的产业被毁，他必然怒火中烧，咬牙切齿地想要报复。然后我们的机会就来了。眼下还是来谈谈这次袭击。所有多恩•瑞克的党羽都随身配有非法贩售者图章。收集一些这样的图章带给我。让我们看看接下来将会发生些什么。

name.de: Die Fälscherei - Die Schlinge zieht sich zu (5 von 5)
name.en: The Forgery - Tie the Knot (5 of 5)
name.ru: Подделка - завязать узел (The Forgery - Tie the Knot) (5 из 5)

messages.en:
Just as I predicted the raid on the drug factory got just the results we wanted. Don Rico is screaming fury on all the underworld channels trying to find the culprit. Don't worry, we'll keep you identity hidden long enough for you take him out for good. It's a dangerous assignment, but if you don't do it you'll have Don Rico's revenge hanging over your head for the rest of your life. Sorry to put you in this position, but look at it from my point of view, it was a win-win situation. Anyway, you're getting handsomely rewarded for all of this, so don't sulk too much.

When you accept this mission I'll give you the coordinates to the place where Don Rico is hiding out at the moment. Like all druglords he's even more paranoid than I am, so rest assured he's got artillery and plenty of it. Perhaps bringing a few friends along would be a good idea.
messages.zh:
不出所料，这次对违规药品工厂的袭击收效甚佳。多恩•瑞克显然已经发狂了，他召集所有的黑道试图找出是谁干的。别担心，我会隐藏你的身份，直到有一天你让他永远从世界上消失。你的任务很危险，但如果现在收手，多恩•瑞克为了报复，会一直悬赏要你的人头。很抱歉让你的处境变成这样，不过从我的角度看，这是个双赢的局面。不管怎样，你会为此拿到一份不错的报酬，所以别大动肝火啊！

一旦你接受了这个任务，我会把多恩•瑞克藏身之地的位标给你。像所有的非法贩售者一样，他比我还要偏执狂妄，毫无疑问肯定会准备大批的炮兵候着你。找几个朋友一起去是个不错的主意。

messages.en: Very well done, {[character]player.name}! I have an urgent message for you to deliver to Drusk Amakkit over in Parchanier. He will explain matters to you. Please hurry!
messages.zh: 干得太好了，{[character]player.name}！我有个紧急消息需要你帮我送到帕查尼尔的德鲁斯克·阿玛基特手中。他会向你解释清楚。请抓紧！

messages.en:
You probably know already that we've been subtly manipulating FON and Serpentis into working together against Wiyrkomi. While this is not without risk we feel it's the best chance of driving the Caldari megalomaniacs out of Algintal so we can get back to some serious smuggling.

But things are now rapidly progressing out of control and we have to get more directly involved to get things under control again. There's this Serpentis agent by the name of Elere Febre that we linked up with a FON contact. Febre is the main liaison between the two sides and has worked wonders in the short time she's been involved. But according to this message you brought me her cover is blown. Wiyrkomi is on to her and is probably planning to take her out as we speak. Or worse, take her into custody and interrogate her. We cannot let that happen as she could then reveal the Thukkers involvement.

Time is of the essence here, so the first thing we need to do is distract the Wiyrkomi until we come up with a real plan. I don't have time to assemble squad of my own so some improvisation is the order of the day. You're the only one here, so I guess I must rely on you. We must instigate a fake attack on the Wiyrkomi by FON. To do that we need an authentic FON banner. I know that FON has an operation station inside the Skeletal Comet complex over in Deltole. It's overlooking the huge rogue drone hive in there. What do you say about raiding the place and steal me a FON banner? Return with it here and we're half way home in throwing Wiyrkomi off the scent.
messages.zh:
你可能也发现了，我们正巧妙利用FON和天蛇集团抵御维克米集团。尽管这样做要冒风险，但我们觉得这是把那些加达里自大狂从阿根塔赶出去的最好方法，之后我们就能专心打击这里猖獗的非法贩售活动。

但事态发展很快失去了控制，现在我们必须更直接地参与此事，以期一切重回正轨。我们通过一个叫埃勒尔•费博的天蛇集团代理人联系上一个FON的成员。埃勒尔是沟通两边的主要桥梁，工作时间不长，但表现出色。但是按照你带来的信息，她的身份业已暴露，维克米集团已经盯上了她，很可能正计划把她铲除。或者将她拘留审问。我们必须阻止这样的事发生，不能把图克尔人牵连进去。

现在时间是最关键的，在我们真正的计划出台之前，要及时分散维克米集团的注意力。现在这儿只有你一个，时间又不允许我从其他地方调人过来，所以你是我唯一的希望。我们正策划一次假袭击，让维克米误以为FON攻击了他们，为此我们需要一个货真价实的FON旗帜。我知道FON在底托勒附近的骷髅彗星内有一个军事空间站，在那儿可以俯瞰到一个巨大的自由无人机母巢。去搜查一下，给我偷一个FON旗帜出来，行么？把它带回来，我们战胜维克米集团的计划就完成一半了。

messages.en:
I must congratulate you on being so quick in bringing me the banner. I wasn't feeling all that optimistic about our chances in thwarting Wiyrkomi as they were already on the move, but now things look different. I've already put in motion a fake sabotage attack on one of the Wiyrkomi stations in the system. All my agents there need is the banner to leave behind after the raid.

The Caldari are a suspicious lot, so any member of the Thukkers entering one of their stations is bound to attract attention. But you're presence there will not. To complete your recent success in getting the banner all you need to do now is getting the banner into the Wiyrkomi station and we'll take care of the rest.
messages.zh:
我真的该祝贺你那么快就带来了旗帜。我一直不太乐观，觉得我们不大可能挫败维克米，毕竟他们已经在行动中了，但是现在事情出现了转机。我已委派手下对本星系的维克米集团空间站发动一次冒牌攻击。他们唯一缺少的就是要在突袭之后留下的一面旗帜。

加达里人疑心很重，所以图克尔的人一进入他们的空间站就会引起注意。不过换成你应该没问题。你前面拿旗帜的任务完成得不错，为了使你更加功德圆满，现在赶快把这面旗帜送往维克米空间站，接下来的事我们会处理。

加达里人疑心很重，所以图克尔的人一进入他们的空间站就会引起注意。不过换成你应该没什么问题。你前面拿旗帜干得不错，现在赶快把它带到维克米集团去，其余的我们会处理。

name.ru: Власть народу - сбор урожая (Power to the People - Reap) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
The sabotage attack on the Wiyrkomi station in Jolia was only a limited success, but it was enough to divert their attention long enough for Elere Febre to cover her tracks. She's abandoned her habitation module and gone into hiding for the time being. Wiyrkomi is bound to raid her place soon, but she was careful in leaving no traces of her own DNA there, though she left a fake one that hopefully will have them running in circles.

But there is still one loose end we need to tie up. Febre's contact within the FON is making a nuisance of himself and before he does something rash we must take him out. Before Febre went into hiding she set up a meeting with the guy to discuss the future. She gave me the coordinates for that meeting and I want you to go over there and kill the guy. Just remember, even if he's a pansy activists doesn't mean he's a walkover and he may very well have some backup with him. So take care. And perhaps take some backup with you. The situation is intense and you never know what might be lying ahead.
messages.zh: 我们对乔利亚星系中维克米基地的破坏虽然只是个小胜利，但足以转移他们的注意力，使埃勒尔•费博有时间来隐藏行踪。她放弃了自己的居住舱，暂时躲了起来。维克米必定很快就会袭击她的住处，不过她非常谨慎，没在那儿留下自己的DNA，相反她留下了假的DNA，希望这能让他们绕绕圈子。<br><br> 但是还有一个漏洞我们必须去填上。费博在FON的联络人是个靠不住的家伙，我们必须在他做蠢事前除掉他。费博在藏起来之前，给这家伙设了个圈套，说是要和他会面商量一下以后的事。她给了我这次会面的坐标，而我要你到那里去把这家伙干掉。只是记住，虽然他是个娘娘腔十足的激进分子，但这并不代表他不堪一击，更何况他可能会带着帮手。一定要小心。或许你也最好带着帮手一起去。现在形势万分紧张，谁都说不准前方会有什么等着你。

messages.en: Excellent job, {[character]player.name}. You did well, especially as it seems like the guy tried to ambush you. Considering the fact I sent you there to kill him, who can blame him? But good job, nevertheless. We can now breath easier knowing that all loose ends have been tied up. Wiyrkomi will get nowhere with their enquiry.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。你做得很好，尤其是那个家伙看起来曾试图伏击你。考虑到我派你去就是要干掉他，这也就难怪了。不过不管怎样，干得不错。既然已经填补了所有漏洞，现在我们可以长出一口气了。维克米的调查不会有结果的。

messages.en: I'm up for it.
messages.zh: 我准备好了。

messages.en:
Great to hear that. Now the first task I have for you is pretty dangerous. We were expecting a large group of tourists here from Du Annes today but unfortunately their cruiser's warp-drive broke down in Deltole. On top of that they stumbled into a deadspace pocket filled with rogue drones. The last we heard of them was their distress signal indicating they were under attack. I can only hope that they managed to escape, but at this time it's impossible to tell.

I would like you to fly into the deadspace pocket where they were last seen and search for them. Destroy every rogue drone ship that you find. If they are still alive they might need some help repairing their warp-drive, if not then they at least would need help fighting off the drones.
messages.zh:
很高兴听你这样说。我要给你的第一个任务相当危险。今天本该有个杜安尼斯的大旅行团来，可是他们经过底托勒的时候，巡洋舰跃迁引擎不幸抛锚了。更糟的是他们被困在了一个满是自由无人机的死亡空间层里。我们最后收到的消息是他们发来的求救信号，这说明他们当时正受到攻击。但愿他们能逃离险境，不过现在根本说不准。

我希望你飞去他们失踪的那个死亡空间层，全力搜索他们的踪迹。击毁你看到的所有自由无人机。如果他们还活着，他们的跃迁引擎可能需要维修；如果他们的跃迁引擎是好的，他们至少需要你击退无人机。

messages.en: You've done us a great favor, {[character]player.name}.  The captain of the pleasure cruiser managed to contact us shortly after you finished your objective, and informed us that they were safe and on their way here.  Their deaths would have been terrible publicity for the Information Center ...
messages.zh: 你帮了我们大忙了，{[character]player.name}。在你完成任务后不久，那艘巡洋舰的船长就与我们取得了联系，说全船平安，正在过来的路上。要是他们遇难，那么信息中心将遭受舆论的疯狂谴责……

messages.en:
Great to hear that. Now the first task I have for you is pretty dangerous. We were expecting a large group of tourists here from Du Annes today but unfortunately their cruiser's warp-drive broke down in Deltole. On top of that they stumbled into a deadspace pocket filled with rogue drones. The last we heard of them was their distress signal indicating they were under attack. I can only hope that they managed to escape, but at this time it's impossible to tell.

I would like you to fly into the deadspace pocket where they were last seen and search for them. Destroy every rogue drone ship that you find. If they are still alive they might need some help repairing their warp-drive, if not then they at least would need help fighting off the drones. Good luck.
messages.zh:
很高兴听你这样说。我要给你的第一个任务相当危险。今天本该有个杜安尼斯的大旅行团来，可是他们经过底托勒的时候，巡洋舰跃迁引擎不幸抛锚了。更糟的是他们被困在了一个满是自由无人机的死亡空间层里。我们最后收到的消息是他们发来的求救信号，这说明他们当时正受到攻击。但愿他们能逃离险境，不过现在根本说不准。

我希望你飞去他们失踪的那个死亡空间层，全力搜索他们的踪迹。击毁你看到的所有自由无人机。如果他们还活着，他们的跃迁引擎可能需要维修；如果他们的跃迁引擎是好的，他们至少需要你击退无人机。祝你好运。

name.ja: ビジネスアソシエイツ-序章
name.ru: Партнеры по бизнесу - прелюдия (Business Associates - Prelude)

messages.en: I will return with a Trust Partners Business Card.
messages.zh: 我得到信任伙伴集团的名片卡了，我们开始吧。

messages.en: Until then. So, bye.
messages.zh: 到时候再说吧。那么，再见。

messages.en: I'm not sure what you mean. How can I prove that?
messages.zh: 我不大确定你的意思。我怎样才能证明这一点？

messages.en: Try talking to some in the vicinity and get back to me once you have a Trust Partners Business Card.
messages.zh: 在确认你是信任伙伴集团真正的朋友之前，我不会考虑跟你合作。要想证明你值得信赖，必须给我一张信任伙伴的名片卡。如果信任伙伴集团的其他代理人对你的工作满意，就会给你这张卡。去和附近的代理人谈谈，一旦你得到了名片，就回来找我。

messages.en: Very good, I can see you are to be trusted with sensitive Thukker matters. I think we can begin to do business.
messages.zh: 非常好，你值得信赖，可以处理敏感的图克尔问题。我想我们可以开始合作了。

messages.en: Yeah, I'll get right on it, loser.
messages.zh: 我还没名片，等我拿到后再回来见你。

messages.en: The door's over there.
messages.zh: 好，当你得到能证明你忠诚的名片后，我们再来交谈。

messages.en: Before I even contemplate working with you, I must be certain you are a true friend of the Trust Partners. For me to be sure, you need to give me a Trust Partners Business Card. You can get one by doing well for other agents of our firm. Try talking to some in the vicinity and get back to me once you have an appropriate business card.
messages.zh: 在我考虑是否与你合作前，我得先确定你是否真是信任伙伴集团的朋友。要让我相信，你必须给我一张信任伙伴集团的名片。为我们公司的其他代理人好好工作，你就能得到一张。去和附近的代理人谈谈，一旦你得到了名片，就回来找我。

messages.en:
The next mission in line is rather simple. A Federal Intelligence officer is scheduled to inspect our outpost this week. He was supposed to arrive later today but his ship was delayed. The Federal Intelligence Office demanded that we provide him with a quick transport so that he is able to complete his assignment on time. My take on this entire situation is that they did this on purpose just to see how far we're willing to go to please Federation authorities.

Now, considering that you completed your last assignment with flying colors I assume this will be a piece of cake for someone of your caliber. Just pick up the FIO officer at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and get him back here as quickly as possible.
messages.zh:
接下来的任务相当简单。一个联邦情报官员按计划会在本周视察我们的哨站。他本来预计今天晚些时候到达，但是他的飞船被耽搁了一下。这名联邦情报官员要求我们尽快去接他，好让他准时完成任务。我对这整件事情的理解是，他们是故意这么做的，就是想看看，为了取悦联邦当局，我们究竟能做到什么程度。

鉴于你上次的优秀表现，我觉得这次任务对你这样有能力的人来说是小菜一碟。请去{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}接那个FIO官员，并尽快把他带回来。

messages.en: Nicely done.  But don't leave yet, there's one more task I have in store for you.
messages.zh: 做得好！但先不要离开，我还有新的任务给你。

messages.en:
The next mission in line is rather simple. A Federal Intelligence officer is scheduled to inspect our outpost this week. He was supposed to arrive later today but his ship was delayed. The Federal Intelligence Office demanded that we provide him with a quick transport so that he is able to complete his assignment on time. My take on this entire situation is that they did this on purpose just to see how far we're willing to go to please Federation authorities.

Now, considering that you completed your last assignment with flying colors I assume this will be a piece of cake for someone of your caliber. Just pick up the FIO officer at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and get him back here as quickly as possible.

Dismissed.
messages.zh:
接下来的任务相当简单。一个联邦情报官员按计划会在本周视察我们的哨站。他本来预计今天晚些时候到达，但是他的飞船被耽搁了一下。这名联邦情报官员要求我们尽快去接他，好让他准时完成任务。我对这整件事情的理解是，他们是故意这么做的，就是想看看，为了取悦联邦当局，我们究竟能做到什么程度。

鉴于你上次的优秀表现，我觉得这次任务对你这样有能力的人来说是小菜一碟。请去{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}接那个FIO官员，并尽快把他带回来。

完毕。

messages.en: Don't worry, you can trust me. I have with me ship logs from another agent of the Trust Partners.
messages.zh: 不要担心，你可以相信我。我随身带了来自另外一个信任伙伴集团代理人的飞船日志。

messages.en: Ok, let's see those documents you have, then.
messages.zh: 那么，让我们看看你的那些文件。

messages.en: You have some ship logs, eh? Could you hand them over, please?
messages.zh: 你有一些飞船日志，是吧？请给我看看。

messages.en: Ah, they're from Angetyn. Excellent! Yes, I can doctor them for him. Not that I haven't done so many times in the past, mind you. But what to do with you? Angetyn only sends me pilots he thinks highly of, so let's see if you're as talented as he thinks.
messages.zh: 啊，它们是安家特的。干得漂亮！是的，我可以帮他修改一下。告诉你，我过去可做过许多次了。不过该怎么安排你呢？安家特派给我的飞行员都是他评价很高的，那么让我们看看你是否真像他认为的那么有才干。

messages.en: Sorry, I don't have any documents for you.
messages.zh: 对不起，我没有你要的文件。

messages.en: No sweat, just come and talk to me when you have the right documents for me.
messages.zh: 当你有我要的合适的文件时，你可以再过来和我谈。

messages.en: You have some ship logs, eh? Could you hand them over, please?
messages.zh: 你有一些飞船日志？请把它们拿过来。

messages.en: I have an urgent message from Krester Rupptofs to you. He told me you would tell me what the big hurry is.
messages.zh: 我替克莱斯特·拉普多夫捎了一条消息给你。他跟我说，你会告诉我什么事这么紧急。

messages.en: A message from Krester? I was expecting as much. Here, let's see what it says.
messages.zh: 来自克莱斯特的消息？如我所料地一样出色。现在让我看看上面说了什么。

messages.en: Give Drusk the message from Krester Rupptofs.
messages.zh: 把克莱斯特•拉普多夫的这个消息传给德鲁斯克。

messages.en: Ah! This is urgent indeed! It seems the Wiyrkomi bastards are more clever than I gave them credit for.
messages.zh: 啊！这的确紧急！似乎这些维克米混蛋比我想象的更聪明。

messages.en: I do not have any message for you, sorry. I will come back later when I have one.
messages.zh: 我没有消息给你，对不起。稍后等我有了消息，我会回来的。

messages.en: I hope to see you later when you have something of interest for me.
messages.zh: 希望下次见面时，你会有我感兴趣的东西。

messages.en: I have no time to deal with just anyone. Do you have some business with me? I'm waiting for an urgent message from an agent friend of mine. If you don't have the message then you can be of no help to me. So don't bother trying to talk to me any further unless you have that message with you.
messages.zh: 我没时间与随便什么人打交道。你找我有事吗？我在等候一个代理人朋友的紧急消息。如果你不是送消息的，那么你对我没用。所以除非你带来那则消息，否则别再来烦我。

messages.en: Now that you've finished the most pressing tasks I have, it's time to send my report to Miloise Roden in the Roden Shipyard headquarters.  It contains some pretty sensitive information, so I want it kept safe and secure until it's in the hangar of {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Don't mess this up!
messages.zh: 你已经完成了我这里最紧要的任务，现在该把我的报告送到莱登船业总部的米卢瓦斯·莱登手里了。里面的信息非常敏感，一定要把它安全送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的机库，别把事情搞砸了！

messages.en: You've done all I've asked you to, with style.  I suggest you take a look at the Wiyrkomi Survey Station in Colelie or the Command Center in Fluekele if you're in need of some more work.  Good luck!
messages.zh: 你已出色完成了我给你的任务。如果你需要更多工作的话，建议你去克勒列的维克米调查站或是弗琉克勒的指挥中心看看。祝你好运！

messages.en:
Now that you've finished the most pressing tasks I have, it's time to send my report to Miloise Roden in the Roden Shipyard headquarters. It contains some pretty sensitive information, so I want it kept safe and secure until it's in the hangar of {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Don't mess this up!

Dismissed.
messages.zh:
你已经完成了我这里最紧要的任务，现在该把我的报告送到莱登船业总部的米卢瓦斯·莱登手里了。里面的信息非常敏感，一定要把它安全送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的机库，别把事情搞砸了！

完毕。

messages.en: Tell me what kind of business we're talking about and I'll think about it.
messages.zh: 告诉我工作的详情，我得考虑一下。

messages.en:
Ok, I'm here on official business from {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}. I was sent here to inspect the Central Command station of Wiyrkomi in Algintal, and as a side project keep an eye out on Roden Shipyards, who've been Wiyrkomi's primary allies in Federation space.

Now my first objective is to make sure there isn't any illegal trade going on here. I haven't been able to discover any contraband during my stay here, but I'd like to test something before I fill my first report. I'd like to see how well prepared the Temko mercenaries guarding this installation are concerning illegal goods. So I want somebody inconspicuous to try to infiltrate the compound with drugs inside of his cargo hold. You look like just the person for that assignment.

You'll find the drugs on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, simply grab them and bring them to me. Federation customs officials won't touch you, they know it's my crash. Temko don't however, hence the test. If you get attacked by Temko, then flee and come back later, I'll explain everything to them once the test is complete.
messages.zh:
好吧，我是{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}派到这儿来公干的。我的任务是视察维克米在阿根塔星系里的中心指挥空间站，并顺便监视维克米在联邦空间的主要盟友——莱登船业。

目前我的首要目标就是确认这里没有任何非法交易。我在这里的这段时间还没发现任何违法交易，但是在填写第一份报告前，我还要做个测试。我要看看，当出现违禁品时，负责保卫工作的天科雇佣兵是否有充分的准备。所以，我想找一个不显眼的人在货舱里面装些违规药品，悄悄潜入这个复合体。你看起来正是这个任务的合适人选。

找到放在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的违规药品，然后带来给我。联邦海关官员不会阻拦你的，他们知道是我的东西。天科却不知道，所以就是要试一下。如果你被天科攻击，立即返航回来，事成之后我会向他们解释一切。

messages.en: So the guards didn't lift a finger to stop you?  Intriguing.  I'll have to mention this in my report!  But don't go far, I have some more work for you.
messages.zh: 那些守卫没有一点阻止你的意思？有趣。我会在报告里提到这个。不要走远，我还有一些工作要你去做。

messages.en:
Ok, I'm here on official business from {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}. I was sent here to inspect the Central Command station of Wiyrkomi in Algintal, and as a side project keep an eye out on Roden Shipyards, who've been Wiyrkomi's primary allies in Federation space.

Now my first objective is to make sure there isn't any illegal trade going on here. I haven't been able to discover any contraband during my stay here, but I'd like to test something before I fill my first report. I'd like to see how well prepared the Temko mercenaries guarding this installation are concerning illegal goods. So I want somebody inconspicuous to try to infiltrate the compound with drugs inside of his cargo hold. You look like just the person for that assignment.

You'll find the drugs on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, simply grab them and bring them to me. Federation customs officials won't touch you, they know it's my crash. Temko don't however, hence the test. If you get attacked by Temko, then flee and come back later, I'll explain everything to them once the test is complete.
messages.zh:
好吧，我是{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}派到这儿来公干的。我的任务是视察维克米在阿根塔星系里的中心指挥空间站，并顺便监视维克米在联邦空间的主要盟友——莱登船业。

目前我的首要目标就是确认这里没有任何非法交易。我在这里的这段时间还没发现任何违法交易，但是在填写第一份报告前，我还要做个测试。我要看看，当出现违禁品时，负责保卫工作的天科雇佣兵是否有充分的准备。所以，我想找一个不显眼的人在货舱里面装些违规药品，悄悄潜入这个复合体。你看起来正是这个任务的合适人选。

找到放在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的违规药品，然后带来给我。联邦海关官员不会阻拦你的，他们知道是我的东西。天科却不知道，所以就是要试一下。如果你被天科攻击，立即返航回来，事成之后我会向他们解释一切。

messages.en:
For your second assignment I'd like you to investigate a Wiyrkomi storage facility in Jolia. I stumbled upon some documents revealing it's location while inside the Central Command control tower. They were a bit startled when I informed them of what I had discovered, so I'm thinking something fishy might be afloat there.

I will add a bookmark to the mission details in your Opportunities interface which sends you to a deadspace pocket. Inside you'll find this storage facility. Take a look inside, and tell me what you find.
messages.zh:
至于你的第二个任务，我希望你能去乔利亚调查一下维克米储藏设施。我在中央指挥部的控制塔内无意发现了一些标有它位置的文件。当我说出自己的发现后，他们都有些讶异，所以我猜那里肯定有些可疑的东西。

我会在“机遇”界面的任务详情里添加位标，它会送你到死亡空间层。储藏设施就在那里。进去看看，然后将你的发现报告给我。

messages.en: So they replaced the sign on the acceleration gate leading to the storage facility with one leading to a drone hive?  This will go straight into my report.  I'll also take a look at this data chip you found in the storage facility itself, but I'm sure there's nothing of interest inside it.  If they knew you were coming and managed to replace the sign on the acceleration gates, they probably had enough time to empty the storage containers as well.  But good work anyway.
messages.zh: 这样说的话，他们把那条通向仓储设施的加速轨道上的标记符号改成了“通向无人机母巢”？我会直接把这件事写入报告的。我也会看看你在那个仓储设施内找到的数据芯片，不过我估计没什么有价值的信息。既然他们想到替换加速轨道的标记符号，那一定也清空了贮存的集装箱。不过无论如何，你做得很好。

messages.en:
For your second assignment I'd like you to investigate a Wiyrkomi storage facility in Jolia. I stumbled upon some documents revealing it's location while inside the Central Command control tower. They were a bit startled when I informed them of what I had discovered, so I'm thinking something fishy might be afloat there.

I will add a bookmark to the mission details which sends you to a deadspace pocket. Inside you'll find this storage facility. Take a look inside, and tell me what you find. Thanks.
messages.zh:
至于你的第二个任务，我希望你能去乔利亚调查一下维克米储藏设施。我在中央指挥部的控制塔内无意发现了一些标有它位置的文件。当我说出自己的发现后，他们都有些讶异，所以我猜那里肯定有些可疑的东西。

我会在任务详情里添加位标，它会送你到死亡空间层。储藏设施就在那里。进去看看，然后将你的发现报告给我。有劳了。

messages.en: Yeah, I have it here.
messages.zh: 当然，你要的东西在这。

messages.en: Very well, then, let's see it.
messages.zh: 很好，让我们来看一下。

messages.en: First of all, do you have something for me...? If you know what I'm talking about, then hand it over, please. If you don't, then I'm sorry, but I don't have anything for you.
messages.zh: 那么，你有什么要给我的吗？如果你明白我在说什么的话，就请把东西给我。如果没有，那么很抱歉我也没有什么给你。

messages.en: There you go.
messages.zh: 你可以走了。

messages.en: Excellent, thank you. I'm going to take a look at this; get back to me in a minute or two.
messages.zh: 漂亮，谢谢你。我会看一下的，一两分钟后再到我这里来一下。

messages.en: I'm sorry, I have no idea what you're talking about.  Ta.
messages.zh: 很抱歉，我不明白你在说什么。谢了。

messages.en: Bring the top-secret information into Preaux Gallot's possession.
messages.zh: 把机密信息交到普尔渥•加洛手上。

messages.en: First of all, do you have something for me...? If you know what I'm talking about, then hand it over, please. If you don't, then I'm sorry, but I don't have anything for you.
messages.zh: 那么，你有什么要给我的吗？如果你明白我在说什么的话，就请把东西给我。如果没有，那么很抱歉我也没有什么给你。

messages.en: I'm sorry, I must have misunderstood.  I don't have what you're looking for.
messages.zh: 对不起，我一定是误会了。我没有你要找的东西。

messages.en:
First, a proper introduction. I'm Preaux Gallot, one of FON's chief coordinators in this area. As you may know, the Wiyrkomi corporation is trying to move into this area, corrupting the vast tracts of natural beauty found here with their horrible industry. Moreover, the piece of evidence you just brought me seems to indicate there are things at play here far worse than we originally suspected.

It appears the Wiyrkomi corporation has been hiring mercenaries to stage attacks on their own outposts in the area, attacks which they then frame us for in order to lessen our stature in the public eye. We need to put a stop to this as soon as possible. If we lose our lobbyist support, the Federation is likely to succumb to the deals being proffered by the corrupt Caldari business machine, and this entire area will be turned into just another locale for these corporate bigwigs to ravage.

An operative of ours, Suho Tatanal, has just returned from a protest on Parchanier II. He's a canny investigator with an eye for details; I want you to bring him the aggregated evidence we've gathered on the case so far, then report back to me. I'll have another assignment for you very soon.
messages.zh:
首先来个自我介绍。我是普尔渥•加洛，FON在这个区域的主要协调人之一。你可能已经知道，维克米集团正准备进入这片美丽的土地，用他们可怕的工业来污染这片美丽的宇宙。从你带给我的证据来看，在这里悄悄上演的事情，比我们所预料的要糟得多。

维克米集团雇佣了一些佣兵攻击自家的哨站，还用这些攻击来栽赃陷害我们，以图破坏我们在群众中的形象。必须尽快制止他们的恶行。如果我们失去了议员的支持，联邦政府就会向腐败的加达里商业机器妥协，整个区域将遭到这些集团大亨的蹂躏。

我们的侦探苏霍•塔塔纳刚从帕查的抗议中回来。他是个很细致的侦探，注重细节。我要你把我们至今为止搜集到的证据统统带给他，然后回来像我报告。我还有事情要你做。

messages.en:
It's now time to turn our eyes towards Roden Shipyards. They have always been a shady corporation, and their alliance with Wiyrkomi certainly raised a few eyebrows. I was specifically told to find out exactly what part they play in all of this.

Yesterday I stumbled upon something that may be of vital importance to my investigation. My ship's sensors picked up an encoded transmission from a Roden Shipyards outpost located in Fluekele. I haven't been able to make much of it yet, but with the proper data decoder I will be able to tell what the contents of this transmission are. So my assignment to you is to find such a decoder and bring it to me. My suggestion is to scour the asteroid belts of Jolia, there is a Serpentis agent there called Pourpas Aunten who is renowned for decoding CONCORD and Federation Navy signals. If there's anyone in the galaxy which has the decoder I need, it's him.
messages.zh:
现在该把注意力转向莱登船业了。这个集团一直很可疑，而他们与维克米集团的联盟更是让人不安。我收到特别命令要求查出他们究竟在这一切中扮演什么角色。

我昨天的一次偶然发现可能对这次调查至关重要。我飞船的感应器获取了莱登船业弗琉克勒哨站发送的一条加密传输信息。我现在还没怎么弄懂这条信息，不过只要有合适的数据解码器，我就能搞明白它的内容。所以我给你的任务就是找一个这样的解码器给我。我建议你去搜索乔利亚的小行星带，那里有个名叫波尔帕斯·奥特恩的天蛇集团特工，他是出名的破译统合部和联邦海军信号的高手。这个星系里只有他才有我要的解码器。

messages.en: I have the decoder.
messages.zh: 解码器到手了。

messages.en: Nice job.  I hope you gave Pourpas Aunten my regards, heh heh.  Now just give me a moment to analyze the transmission ...
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。希望你代我向波尔帕斯·奥特恩致敬，呵呵。现在给我点时间分析传输信号……

messages.en:
It's now time to turn our eyes towards Roden Shipyards. They have always been a shady corporation, and their alliance with Wiyrkomi certainly raised a few eyebrows. I was specifically told to find out exactly what part they play in all of this.

Yesterday I stumbled upon something that may be of vital importance to my investigation. My ship's sensors picked up an encoded transmission from a Roden Shipyards outpost located in Fluekele. I haven't been able to make much of it yet, but with the proper data decoder I will be able to tell what the contents of this transmission are. So my assignment to you is to find such a decoder and bring it to me. My suggestion is to scour the asteroid belts of Jolia, there is a Serpentis agent there called Pourpas Aunten who is renowned for decoding CONCORD and Federation Navy signals. If there's anyone in the galaxy which has the decoder I need, it's him.
messages.zh:
现在该把注意力转向莱登船业了。这个集团一直很可疑，而他们与维克米集团的联盟更是让人不安。我收到特别命令要求查出他们究竟在这一切中扮演什么角色。

我昨天的一次偶然发现可能对这次调查至关重要。我飞船的感应器获取了莱登船业弗琉克勒哨站发送的一条加密传输信息。我现在还没怎么弄懂这条信息，不过只要有合适的数据解码器，我就能搞明白它的内容。所以我给你的任务就是找一个这样的解码器给我。我建议你去搜索乔利亚的小行星带，那里有个名叫波尔帕斯·奥特恩的天蛇集团特工，他是出名的破译统合部和联邦海军信号的高手。这个星系里只有他才有我要的解码器。

messages.en:
I've managed to decode the transmission but I can't make much of it. The interesting part though is that it originates from Maqeri Camcen's ship within the Contested Gallente Roden Shipyard Outpost. I checked my database and Maqeri is in fact rumored to be part of the Angel Cartel. What the Cartel would be doing in a Roden Shipyard Outpost in Fluekele is beyond me, unless there are Serpentis there. My best guess is that there are Serpentis operating inside the same deadspace are as Roden Shipyard, and this Maqeri is some sort of envoy from the Cartel.

Anyway I must get to the bottom of this. Meet with this Maqeri fellow and see if you can convince him to have a chat with me in person. If he's hostile and refuses to speak with you then you have my full authority to eliminate him. If you choose the gun rather than your wit, then at least bring evidence of his demise to me.
messages.zh:
我已经破译了传输信息，但还是不大懂它的意思。不过有意思的是这条信息是争夺中的盖伦特莱登船业哨站内的马戈利·贾森的飞船发出的。我查了下数据库，发现有谣传说，马戈利实际上是天使企业联合体的一员。我想不出天使企业联合体究竟在莱登船业的弗琉克勒哨站干什么，除非那里有天蛇集团的人。最大的可能是天蛇集团也在莱登船业所在的死亡空间内活动，而这个马戈利就是天使企业联合体委派的某种特使。

不管怎么样，我必须一查究竟。你去见见这个马戈利，看看能否说服他和我面对面聊聊。如果他怀有敌意而且拒绝与你对话，那么我准许你干掉他。记住，如果他死了，我一定要看到证据。

messages.en: Well, it's unfortunate that he had to be killed.  But these things happen ...
messages.zh: 很不幸，他必须死。不过这种事发生的次数……

messages.en:
I've managed to decode the transmission but I can't make much of it. The interesting part though is that it originates from Maqeri Camcen's ship within the Contested Gallente Roden Shipyard Outpost. I checked my database and Maqeri is in fact rumored to be part of the Angel Cartel. What the Cartel would be doing in a Roden Shipyard Outpost in Fluekele is beyond me, unless there are Serpentis there. My best guess is that there are Serpentis operating inside the same deadspace are as Roden Shipyard, and this Maqeri is some sort of envoy from the Cartel.

Anyway I must get to the bottom of this. Meet with this Maqeri fellow and see if you can convince him to have a chat with me in person. If he's hostile and refuses to speak with you then you have my full authority to eliminate him. If you choose the gun rather than your wit, then at least bring evidence of his demise to me.

Dismissed.

不管怎么样，我必须一查究竟。你去见见这个马戈利，看看能否说服他和我面对面聊聊。如果他怀有敌意而且拒绝与你对话，那么我准许你干掉他。记住，如果他死了，我一定要看到证据。

完毕。

messages.en:
Now that I've finished my report, I'd like you to transport it to my boss on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. The information inside is confidential, so please do not even think about reading the document.

Once the report is safely in the hands of my superiors, then you will have your reward. Good luck.
messages.zh:
我的报告已经写完，请你把它交给我在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的上司。这份文件高度机密，请打消阅读其内容的念头。

这份报告安全抵达我上司的手里之后，你将立即得到报酬。祝你好运。

messages.en: Congratulations on a job well done.  I have no more tasks for you, so I suggest talking to someone else if you're still in need of work.  Just stay away from those Wiyrkomi agents, I think they're up to no good ...
messages.zh: 祝贺你出色地完成了任务。我这儿已经没什么可让你做的了，如果你还需要工作的话，我建议你去和其他人谈谈。记得不要理睬维克米代理人，他们个个心怀鬼胎……

messages.en:
Now that I've finished my report, I'd like you to transport it to my boss on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. The information inside is confidential, so please do not even think about reading the document.

Once the report is safely in the hands of my superiors, then you will have your reward. Good luck.
messages.zh:
我的报告已经写完，请你把它交给我的上司，他在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。这份文件高度机密，不要设法窥探其内容，谢谢。

一旦这份报告安全的到达我的上司的手里，你就会得到报酬。祝你好运。

name.ja: イソネフロシンの救出

messages.en: Please hurry, I'm certain she's in grave danger!
messages.zh: 请快一点，我肯定她现在处境极度危险！

messages.en: {[character]player.name}!  Please help me.  My friend, Isone Flosin, has gone missing.  We were just cruising around on our shuttles within the inner areas of this complex when we were attacked by rogue drones!  I managed to escape, but in my haste I didn't notice that Isone had stopped following me.  I need to know what happened to her, and my ship is in no shape to venture back in there.  Please, you have to help me.  Find Isone and bring her back!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}！请帮帮我。我的朋友伊索尼·弗洛辛失踪了。我们驾驶着穿梭机在这个复合体的内层区域航游时，遭到了自由无人机的攻击！我设法逃出来了，可匆忙之中，我没有注意到伊索尼没能跟上我。我必须知道她究竟出了什么事，可我的飞船绝不可能再冒险飞回那里。拜托了，你一定要帮我。找到伊索尼，把她带回来！

messages.en:
How horrible! I never thought something like this could happen here. I don't know how I will be able to face her parents, they told us never to venture any further into the complex than the first area but we just couldn't resist. I'm so ashamed ...

Could you at least talk to Isone's father, in the Central Administration complex in Fluekele. Tell him I sent you, Isone's DNA will prove that. Please tell him the whole story, I'm just too traumatized at the moment to meet him myself. Thank you.
messages.zh:
多可怕啊！我从没想过这种事情会这样发生。真不知道该如何去面对她的父母，他们一再告诫我们决不能冒险越过复合体的第一个区域，但是我们还是忍不住好奇。我真羞愧难当……

你能不能去弗琉克勒的中央行政复合体内，至少跟伊索尼的父亲谈谈。告诉他是我派你来的，伊索尼的DNA可以证明。请把整个故事讲给他，我受了太大打击，现在没脸亲自去见他。谢谢。

messages.en: Find Isone Flosin inside the Contested Gallente Roden Shipyard Outpost, dead or alive, and bring her back to Nilla Elermare.
messages.zh: 在争夺中的盖伦特莱登船业哨站里找到伊索尼，不管是生是死，把她带回来给妮拉•埃尔莫。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en: {[character]player.name}!  Please help me.  My friend, Isone Flosin, has gone missing.  We were just cruising around on our shuttles within the inner areas of this complex when we were attacked by rogue drones!  I managed to escape, but in my haste I didn't notice that Isone had stopped following me.  I need to know what happened to her, and my ship is in no shape to venture back in there.  Please, you have to help me.  Find Isone and bring her back!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}！请帮帮我。我的朋友伊索尼•弗洛辛失踪了。我们驾驶着穿梭机在这个复合体内层区域巡航时，遭到了自由无人机的攻击。我逃出来了，可匆忙之中，我没有注意到伊索尼不见了。我急于想知道她究竟出了什么事，但看来我的飞船无法再回那里去了。你必须要帮助我！找到伊索尼，把她带回来。

messages.en: I'll look for her.
messages.zh: 我这就去找她。

messages.en:
Have you seen my daughter, Isone Flosin, by any chance? She went missing some time ago while inside the Roden Shipyard Outpost in Fluekele. If you find her, tell her I'm very displeased and she should come see me immediately.

I heard Nilla Elermare was asking about Isone, too. You may want to start by talking to her.
messages.zh:
你有没有碰巧见过我的女儿伊索尼·弗洛辛？前一阵子，她在弗琉克勒的莱登船业哨站里失踪了。如果你找到她，告诉她我很不高兴，并叫她立刻回来见我。

我听说妮拉·埃尔莫也在询问伊索尼的消息，你最好先和她谈谈。

messages.en: As a matter of fact, I found her.  I am sorry to give you these sad tidings but ...
messages.zh: 事实上，我找到她了。我很抱歉给你带来这条坏消息，但是……

messages.en: Arg! I can't believe those two! I told them never to venture deep into the Roden Shipyard outpost. How could they betray me like this! Please, wait a moment for me to gather my senses ...
messages.zh: 啊！这两个人！我真不敢相信！我告诉过他们绝不要冒险深入莱登船业哨站。他们怎么能这样辜负我！请等一会儿，让我平静一下……

messages.en:
Have you seen my daughter, Isone Flosin, by any chance? She went missing some time ago while inside the Roden Shipyard Outpost in Fluekele. If you find her, tell her I'm very displeased and she should come see me immediately.

I heard Nilla Elermare was asking about Isone, too. You may want to start by talking to her.
messages.zh:
你有没有碰巧见过我的女儿伊索尼·弗洛辛？前一阵子，她在弗琉克勒的莱登船业哨站里失踪了。如果你找到她，告诉她我很不高兴，并叫她立刻回来见我。

我听说妮拉·埃尔莫也在询问伊索尼的消息，你可能最好先和她谈谈。

messages.en: I'll find the person who killed your daughter, you can count on me.
messages.zh: 我会找到那个害死你女儿的凶手，你要相信我。

messages.en: So, would you like to talk or do you need more time alone?
messages.zh: 那么，你想要谈谈还是想一个人呆一会儿？

messages.en: Isone must be avenged.  The Serpentis must be responsible for her death.  We've catered to their needs for far too long.  I couldn't believe my ears when they told me we were supposed to treat the Serpentis living in the outpost as comrades!  But enough of this rambling, back to the mission at hand.  I want you to infiltrate the Corelum Drughouse again and look for clues which might lead to whoever is behind her death.  I know of one person who might know, he serves as a guard at the Serpentis storage facility inside that deadspace area.  His name is Jark something.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 伊索尼的仇一定要报。这些天蛇集团的家伙必须对她的死负责。一直以来我们都顺着他们，满足他们的要求。但我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵，岗哨里的那些天蛇集团的人竟然要求我们把他们当成伙伴！闲话到此为止，还是来谈谈手头的任务吧。我要你再去一趟克尔鲁姆烟馆，不要放过任何蛛丝马迹，找出能让我们查到凶手的线索。我知道有个人或许能对我们有所帮助，他是那个死亡空间天蛇仓房的守卫，叫贾克什么的。祝你好运。

messages.en: You brought back Jark himself?  Well, hopefully he will be able to reveal who's behind the tragedy when I interrogate him.  Stay tuned, as soon as he talks I might have another job for you.
messages.zh: 你把贾克本人带回来了？好吧，希望在我审讯后，他能够揭示出这起悲剧幕后的黑手。保持联系，只要他一开口，我可能立刻有新任务给你。

messages.en: Isone must be avenged.  The Serpentis must be responsible for her death.  We've catered to their needs for far too long.  I couldn't believe my ears when they told me we were supposed to treat the Serpentis living in the outpost as comrades!  But enough of this rambling, back to the mission at hand.  I want you to infiltrate the Corelum Drughouse again and look for clues which might lead to whoever is behind her death.  I know of one person who might know, he serves as a guard at the Serpentis storage facility inside that deadspace area.  His name is Jark something.  Good luck.
