messages.en:
While I interrogate the prisoner, I would like you to bring Isone's things to her mother on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} as well as a note from me describing the situation. I am simply too busy to make the trip myself anytime soon, and I know she will manage to find some comfort in receiving Isone's things as a memento of her short life.

Everything you need to transport is in these sealed containers. Take care not to lose any, they might not be very valuable on the market but to me and my wife they are priceless.
messages.zh:
在我审问犯人的时候，我希望你去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}跑一趟，把伊索尼的遗物以及我的一封说明情况的短信带给她母亲。我实在太忙了，一时半会儿没法亲自过去，那些遗物是伊索尼短暂人生的留念，多少能带给她母亲一些安慰。

我需要你运送的东西都在这些密封箱内。小心不要遗失任何物品，在市场上它们可能不值几个钱，但是对于我和我妻子来说它们可是无价之宝。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}.  But there is just one more thing I need you to do before I let you go ...
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]player.name}。别急着离开，我还有一件事情要你做。

messages.en:
While I interrogate the prisoner, I would like you to bring Isone's things to her mother on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} as well as a note from me describing the situation. I am simply too busy to make the trip myself anytime soon, and I know she will manage to find some comfort in receiving Isone's things as a memento of her short life.

Everything you need to transport is in these sealed containers. Take care not to lose any, they might not be very valuable on the market but to me and my wife they are priceless.
messages.zh:
在我审问犯人的时候，你到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}跑一趟，把伊索尼的一些东西以及我一封说明情况的短信带给我的妻子。我实在太忙抽不出时间过去，那些遗物多少能给她一些安慰吧。

我需要你运送的东西都在这些密封箱内。小心不要遗失任何物品，在市场上它们可能一文不值，但是对于我和我的妻子来说它们是无价之宝。

messages.en:
I've managed to extract the information I needed out of poor Jark. It seems that my Isone was accidentally killed by 'rogue' drone ships guarding the Serpentis drug storage area. Now I cannot really blame a computer for her death, but I can blame it's creators. In fact these drones are not 'rogue' at all, they are just programmed to act like them. An ingenious gallente scientist working for the Serpentis actually managed to reprogram these rogue drones to serve Salvador Sarpati and his wild schemes. The Federation Navy also tends to ignore areas infested with rogue drones, which is beneficial to the Serpentis.

Fortunately Jark knew of a Serpentis science lab in Colelie which is behind all of the drones in the Roden Shipyard complex. I want this science lab destroyed. Whoever resides in there is undoubtedly responsible for Isone's death, and must pay the ultimate price.
messages.zh:
从可怜的贾克那里，我得到了自己想要的信息。看来我的伊索尼是偶然被防卫天蛇违规药品储藏区的自由无人机消灭的。我无法将她的死归罪于一台电脑，但是制造这台电脑的人难辞其咎，我是不会放过他的。其实这些无人机本身并不行如其名，它们只是根据设定的程序在工作。某个为天蛇服务的盖伦特科学怪才设法改编了这些自由无人机的程序，使它们成为萨瓦多尔•萨巴蒂实现其疯狂计划的工具。联邦海军也对这些自由无人机的侵扰睁一只眼，闭一只眼，无疑这更助长了天蛇的嚣张气焰。

贾克知道天蛇在克勒列有一个科学实验室，所有莱登船业复合体内的无人机都出自那里。我要看到这个科学实验室被摧毁。凡是住在那里的人毫无疑问都要为伊索尼的死负责，他们必须付出沉重的代价。

messages.en: The Serpentis science lab has been destroyed.
messages.zh: 天蛇科学实验室已被摧毁。

messages.en: Excellent news.  Although I do not feel better.  Killing those Serpentis will not bring my Isone back, nothing will.  Even if I have her cloned it will not be the same ...  Now leave me, I would like to be alone for a while.
messages.zh: 大好消息。虽然我心里还是那么难受。消灭那些天蛇也换不回我的伊索尼的命，什么也换不回。即使是克隆体，那也不完全一样……现在走吧，我想单独静一静。

messages.en: Ok first of all I'll need a large batch of dense veldspar, around 14 portions should do, with each portion size being 333 units. You will probably find veldspar in one of the asteroid fields in Colelie, if not then try a neighboring system. If you're fast, I'll even get a bonus and of course I'll split it with you.
messages.zh: 好的，首先我需要一大批厚质凡晶石，大约14份就可以了，每份333单位。你很可能在克勒列的某个小行星带中找到凡晶石，如果没有，那么就去附近的其他星系试试。如果你够快，那么我甚至会得到奖励，当然我会分给你些。

messages.en: I was sent here by {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} to help gather ore for Wiyrkomi's construction workers in the Survey Station. They're hoarding up minerals and ore for the eventual construction of the power plant in Azure Canyon. The only problem is I'm not much of a combat pilot and I didn't expect there to be such an abundance of pirates festering the asteroid belts in Colelie. So I was thinking, maybe you could help me out a little? I'll split the earnings I would have received for doing the same job with you. What do you say, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}派我来帮助测量空间站的维克米建筑工人收集矿石。他们正在为苍穹峡谷电站的最后一部分建设囤积矿物和矿石。唯一的问题是，我不大擅长作战，而且没有想到克勒列的小行星带中会有那么多的海盗。所以我想，也许你能帮我点忙？我会把因此得到的收入分给你一些。你觉得怎么样，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en:
Your second job is to get me 4 portions of Omber, or 2000 units to be exact. You might find it a bit difficult to find that type or ore around these parts, but you're in luck. I know of a great spot to mine some. You see I was in Fluekele a few days ago scouting for some ore, this is before I decided the job was too dangerous for me, and I managed to stumble upon a small cluttering of asteroids in the middle of nowhere. And lo and behold, there was an asteroid brimming with minerals, which on closer inspection was Omber! Unfortunately as soon as I had discovered this magnificent find, a group of Serpentis who had been following me attacked. I believe they were being led by that scoundrel Ansedon Blat, I could be wrong though. I met him while I was at the Roden Shipyards Outpost in Fluekele, and he must have decided to follow me when I left on my expedition. That backstabber and his goons must pay.

On second thought, I'm not satisfied with just getting the omber. You'll have to kill those Serpentis bastards too, if you find them. Return to me with the omber when you're done.
messages.zh: 你的第二个工作是给我取4份奥贝尔石，或者准确地说是2000单位。在这附近找那种矿石有点困难，不过你运气不错。我知道一个可以采到奥贝尔石的好地方。几天前我在弗琉克勒搜寻矿石，那时我还没发现这工作有那么危险。我偶然来到了一块未知领域，发现了一群零乱的小行星。瞧啊，居然有一颗富含矿物的小行星，凑近一看正是奥尔贝石！不幸的是，我刚刚取得这项重大发现，一群尾随我已久的天蛇成员就发动了进攻。我相信他们应该是由安瑟顿小牛那个恶棍率领的，当然也可能不是。我在弗琉克勒的莱登船业哨站遇到过他，他肯定从我出发后就一路跟踪而来。那个暗箭伤人的小人和他的手下必须付出代价。<br><br>深思熟虑后，我认为光得到那些奥贝尔石还不能令我满意。如果你找到了那些天蛇混蛋，你一定要干掉他们。完成任务后，带着奥贝尔石回来找我。

messages.en: Well that's about it, I believe I've fulfilled my contract by turning in this last batch of ore.  There's just the trip back to my boss left.  I'd rather not make that run myself, just in case the Serpentis think I was responsible for killing their guys and decide to get some revenge.  I'm perfectly safe in the Survey Station ... so if you wouldn't mind I'd like you to make the run for me.  If you do, just wait a sec and let me grab my report.
messages.zh: 好，就这样。递交了这最后一批矿石，我的合约就完成啦。现在只剩回去向我老板报告了。我最好不要亲自去做，以防天蛇把害死他们伙计的罪都加在我身上。在空间站我非常安全……不介意的话，我希望你替我做这件事。如果你愿意，请稍候，我把报告拿过来。

messages.en:
Your second job is to get me 4 portions of Omber, or 2000 units to be exact. You might find it a bit difficult to find that type or ore around these parts, but you're in luck. I know of a great spot to mine some. You see I was in Fluekele a few days ago scouting for some ore, this is before I decided the job was too dangerous for me, and I managed to stumble upon a small cluttering of asteroids in the middle of nowhere. And lo and behold, there was an asteroid brimming with minerals, which on closer inspection was Omber! Unfortunately as soon as I had discovered this magnificent find, a group of Serpentis who had been following me attacked. I believe they were being led by that scoundrel Ansedon Blat, I could be wrong though. I met him while I was at the Roden Shipyards Outpost in Fluekele, and he must have decided to follow me when I left on my expedition. That backstabber and his goons must pay.

On second thought, I'm not satisfied with just getting the omber. You'll have to kill those Serpentis bastards too, if you find them. Return to me with the omber when you're done.

messages.en: Ok, my boss is located in our warehouse in Ane.  Just drop this report at his desk and he'll wire the payment to my account.  I'll give you something in return for your efforts as well.  Just some items that I think you might find useful, and frankly I have no need of.  Take it or leave it.
messages.zh: 好吧，我老板在安妮的仓库里。把这份报告放在他桌上，这样他就会把钱汇进我的帐户。我也会给你一些东西作为报酬。就是一些我认为对你有用的东西，反正我也用不着。要不要随你。

messages.en: Ok, my boss is located in our warehouse in Ane.  Just drop this report at his desk and he'll wire the payment to my account.  I'll give you something in return for your efforts as well.  Just some items that I think you might find useful, and frankly I have no need of.  Take it or leave it.
messages.zh: 好吧，我的老板在位于安妮的仓库里。把这份报告放到他桌上，他就会把钱汇进我的帐户。我也会给你一些东西作为报酬，一些对你有用的东西，反正闲置在我这儿也是浪费，你看怎么样？

messages.en: FON?  That some kind of fertilizer company?  Seriously, I'm just here for some work ...
messages.zh: FON？就是那个肥料公司吗？说真的，我只是来找工作的……

messages.en:
You don't know what FON stands for?! Friends of Nature of course! We ... errr they stand for everything that's good about the Federation. Originating from a group battling to save rare animal species from extinction, it has grown somewhat after space travel became more common. Now it fights for the preservation of the natural phenomena which decorate our night sky.

Now you said you were looking for some work. As a matter of fact there is something that you could do for me which would really make my day. Temko are evil corporate peons who care nothing for our heritage, the Azure Canyon. They work for a no-good money-grubbing Caldari corporation which intends to destroy our natural reserves for its own gain. It so happens that one of Temko's commanders, Maschteri Markan, had the audacity to try and blackmail us when we sabotaged one of Wiyrkomi's construction sites, where they were building a survey station. He recorded the event and threatened to release it to The Scope and the Federation authorities if we wouldn't give in to his demands.

Find these records and bring them to me, or somehow convince him to hand them over himself, and I will reward you generously.
messages.zh:
你不知道FON代表什么？！当然是“自然之友”啊！我们……呃，他们是联邦一切美好事物的象征。它原本是一个为拯救濒危珍惜动物而斗争的组织，后来随着太空旅行的普及，该组织也日益壮大。现在它为维护那些装点夜空的自然景象而战斗。

你说你是来找工作的。事实上我想请你帮我做点事，你若能做好，我会高兴一整天的。天科都是些为集团效力的邪恶走狗，丝毫不顾及我们的宝贵遗产——苍穹峡谷。他们受雇于一个一无是处、唯利是图的加达里集团，这家集团意图破坏我们的自然资源以谋取暴利。前段时间，我们破坏了一个维克米的测量空间站建筑工地，结果一个名叫马舒特里•马克恩的天科指挥官竟然厚颜无耻地试图以此要挟并勒索我们。他记录了整个事件，并威胁如果我们不满足他的要求，他就要把它交给《视角》和联邦当局。<br><br>找到这些记录，并带给我，或者说服他亲自把它交给我们，这样我就会慷慨地酬谢你。

messages.en: I didn't tell you to kill him!  I'm ready to die for my beliefs, but I won't take part in cold blooded murder!  I guess I owe you your reward, but this is the last time I'll ever do business with you, {[character]player.name}.  You're a bad, bad man.
messages.zh: 我没让你干掉他！我愿意为我的信念而死，但是我不想卷入冷血的伤害！我想我该给你酬劳，但这是我最后一次跟你合作，{[character]player.name}。你是个很坏很坏的人。

messages.en:
You don't know what FON stands for?! Friends of Nature of course! We ... errr they stand for everything that's good about the Federation. Originating from a group battling to save rare animal species from extinction, it has grown somewhat after space travel became more common. Now it also fights for the preservation of the natural phenomena which decorate our night sky.

Now you said you were looking for some work. As a matter of fact there is something that you could do for me which would really make my day. Temko are evil corporate peons who care nothing for our heritage, the Azure Canyon. They work for a no-good money-grubbing Caldari corporation which intends to destroy our natural reserves for its own gain. It so happens that one of Temko's commanders, Maschteri Markan, had the audacity to try and blackmail us when we sabotaged one of Wiyrkomi's construction sites, where they were building a survey station. He recorded the event and threatened to release it to The Scope and the Federation authorities if we wouldn't give in to his demands.

Find these records and bring them to me, or somehow convince him to hand them over himself, and I will reward you generously.

I suggest you refrain from accepting this mission if you have no idea how hard finding Maschteri is. Otherwise you might be in for a rude awakening

messages.en:
Okay, Suho's gears have started turning. The evidence you brought him helped greatly. His investigation will be a tremendous boon in our struggle against the corporate monster. We'll have to wait a while to see what he comes up with. I'm not worried about him, though; he works magic when he gets going.

While we wait, {[character]player.name}, I have another job for you. Our organization is staging a massive protest tomorrow in the Wiyrkomi Corporation Factory in Jolia, but there seems to have been a slight miscommunication between some of our activists. If you could hop over to the Pend Insurance Investment Bank in Augnais and bring a few bags of fedo blood over to the Wiyrkomi station in Jolia, the Friends of Nature would be much obliged.
messages.zh:
好了，苏霍的工作已经上了正轨。你给他带去的证据帮了他很大的忙。他的调查将大大有利于我们对抗这个残暴的集团。我们耐心地等一下，看看他会得出什么结论。我倒不担心苏霍，他总能在工作中创造奇迹。

在此期间，{[character]player.name}，我还有一份工作给你。我们的组织正筹划明天在乔利亚的维克米集团工厂举行一次大规模的抗议，但我们的人在沟通方面出了点小差错。如果可以的话，请去奥格奈斯的彭德保险投资银行，把几包费多血液带到乔利亚的维克米集团空间站，FON会非常感激你的帮忙。

messages.en:
You've proven yourself a trustworthy operative, {[character]player.name}, so I'm going to give you an assignment slightly more clandestine than the ones you've gotten from me so far. Technically speaking, we're going to be breaking the law here, but I trust you realize we're doing what we're doing for a higher cause. Okay, that said, here goes.

We just received word from our man on the inside that Wiyrkomi have just ordered 15 high-powered drills for their prospecting operations on Fluekele V, a planet home to many unique, highly endangered varieties of flora and fauna. The drills are currently sitting at the Wiyrkomi factory in Fluekele, awaiting transport to the site where they're intended to be used.

Our operatives at Fluekele have managed, through their connections with sympathetic station personnel, to pilfer these tools, but we can't keep them hidden for long. We need someone to get the drills safely out to our people in the Poteque station in Augnais. Head out there and show me how devoted to our cause you truly are.
messages.zh:
事实证明你是个值得信赖的人，{[character]player.name}。接下来的任务比较特殊，比你过去所接受的任务都要更加秘密。严格意义上说，我要你做的事情在本地区是违法的，但我相信你能理解，毕竟我们是为了崇高的理想而奋斗的。好吧，说完这点，我们可以转入正题了。

我们在维克米集团内部的线人报告说，维克米刚刚为弗琉克勒V的探矿作业订购了十五个高能钻孔机。弗琉克勒是许多濒临绝迹的动植物的家园。这些钻孔机正放置在弗琉克勒的维克米集团工厂内，等待运送到作业现场。

我们在弗琉克勒的特工好不容易说服了一些人让我们“借用”这些工具但不能用得太久。我们需要有人把钻孔机带到奥格奈斯星系的波特克制药空间站，那里有我们的人。去吧，让我看看你对我们的计划到底有多少忠诚。

messages.en:
Something urgent just landed on my desk. One of our industrial ships, carrying a load of soil intended for our reservations on Deltole, was shot down yesterday with no survivors. We need to get some soil over there soon, or a large part of our efforts in the area will be wasted.

Looks like Wiyrkomi are using our alleged aggression against them as an excuse to gun down innocent people whose aims they don't agree with. Can't say I'm surprised, frankly, although I wouldn't have thought they'd go this far.

Bring 200 units of soil to me, and you will have done us a great service.
messages.zh:
我有些紧急的事情要处理。昨天，我们的一艘工业舰被击毁，船员无一生还，船上运载着送往我们的底托勒自然保护区的土壤。我们需要尽快把土壤送去，否则我们在那里付出的一大部分辛劳就要白费了。

看起来维克米集团以我们对他们的所谓挑衅为借口，枪毙反对他们的无辜者。老实说，我不惊讶，尽管我没想到他们会做到这种程度。

为底托勒的核心局面仓库送去200单位土壤，那么你就是帮了我们个大忙了。

messages.en:
Suho has made a lot of headway in his investigation, and the results are disturbing as all hell. What I'm about to tell you is for your ears only. I want to make that absolutely clear.

It appears the attacks we've been hearing about against Wiyrkomi assets are not being staged by Wiyrkomi themselves, as we originally suspected. The most recent threads of Suho's investigation are, in fact, pointing squarely toward members of our own organization. I regret to say this, but it appears we have a vigilante rogue in our midst, someone who obviously has no conception of the harm he could be doing to our cause.

Furthermore, there's compelling evidence to the effect that this party, whoever he or she is, have been in contact with the Serpentis smugglers operating in this area, conspiring to strike against Wiyrkomi assets, murdering people in order to further our cause. Makes me feel dirty just thinking about it.

This weed in our garden needs to be rooted out, but first we need to learn its identity. The information is being held by Suho at his office in Parchanier. Needless to say, it's far too sensitive to be sent over normal channels, so I need someone I can trust to head out there and bring it back to me. That means you. We need to straighten this situation out, post-haste.

And remember, not a peep about this to anyone.
messages.zh:
苏霍的调查有进展了，结果十分令人担忧。我接下来要说的，只许你一个人知道。这点我必须事先强调清楚。

看来，外面传闻维克米设施所遭受的攻击，并非我们之前怀疑的那样，由维克米集团自导自演。实际上，苏霍最近的调查结果直接把矛头指向了我们组织内部的成员。很遗憾，这似乎是我们一个无耻的义务警员干的，他显然没有意识到他的所作所为对我们的事业造成了多大的危害。

更糟的是，不管他是什么人物，有确凿的证据证明他和天蛇集团非法贩售者联系密切，同时密谋攻击维克米集团资产，为了破坏我们的事业不惜害命。想想就觉得肮脏。

这样人的必须除掉。但首先我们得知道其身份。这消息目前为在帕查的苏霍所有。不必说，这消息肯定不能通过常规通信手段获得。因此我要你飞过去。记住了，不要对外走漏风声。

messages.en:
Hmm. Pretty much who I suspected. Damn it.

Okay, here's what I need you to do. Take this letter and give it to Ystvia Lamuette over at the Ebony Tower in Barmalie. She's one of our most respected operatives, and a great servant of the cause. When she gets the information, she'll set the right wheels in motion. And I'm sure she'll have plenty of use for a skilled pilot such as yourself.

Thank you again for what you've done for us. Good luck, and fly safe.
messages.zh:
哦，果然是他。该死。

好吧，我要你帮我做这个：把这封信给巴麦列象牙塔的伊斯塔薇•拉姆特。她忠于我们伟大的事业，是我最尊敬的同僚之一。得到这个信息后，她知道该怎么办。我敢肯定，像你这么有经验的飞行员，她一定会给予重用的。

多谢你为我们所做的一切。祝你好运，一路顺风！

name.ja: 根絶やしにせよ（プロローグ）

messages.en: Yep. Right here.
messages.zh: 对了。就在这里。

messages.en: Do you have something for me?  A letter, perhaps?
messages.zh: 你有什么要给我的吗？比如说一封信？

messages.en: Here.
messages.zh: 拿着。

messages.en: Thank you very much.
messages.zh: 非常感谢。

messages.en: Huh? Letter? Sorry lady, no idea.
messages.zh: 嗯？信？抱歉女士，我不知道。

messages.en: Give Preaux Gallot's letter to Ystvia Lamuette.
messages.zh: 把普尔渥•加洛的信交给伊斯塔薇•拉姆特。

messages.en: Do you have something for me? A letter, perhaps?
messages.zh: 你有什么要给我的吗？比如说一封信？

messages.en: I'm sorry, I must have misunderstood.  I don't have this letter you speak of.
messages.zh: 对不起，我一定是误会了。我没有你所说的信。

messages.en:
Nice to meet you. My name is Ystvia Lamuette, and I'm one of the chief coordinators of FON's activities in this constellation. Preaux tells me great things about you; apparently you can be of great help in our struggle.

I'd like to get a feel for you myself, nonetheless. Show me how fast you can be. There's a rare specimen of plant, a Colelian spider spruce, sitting in the Core Complexion Warehouse at Deltole. Bring it back to me within 15 minutes and I'll reward you handsomely. Then we can talk about what needs to be done for our organization.
messages.zh:
很高兴见到你。我叫伊斯塔薇•拉姆特，是这个星座内FON的活动的主要协调人之一。普尔渥对你的评价很高，显然你能对我们的事业提供很大的帮助。

虽然如此，我还是希望亲自领略一下。让我看看你的行事速度如何。在底托勒的核心局面公司仓库内有一种稀有植物——卡莉莲蛛形云杉。请你在15分钟内将它带回来，我会给你丰厚的报酬。然后我们可以讨论一下该为组织做些什么。

messages.en:
We need to move fast. The situation is evolving in unexpected ways. No no, don't sit down. I'll explain this as fast as I can.

While you were out on your last assignment, Ekire himself was mortally wounded in an assassination attempt by unknown assailants. We suspect Wiyrkomi, of course - they have the most to gain from his death, both politically and pragmatically speaking. Likewise, if he dies we stand to take a massive political blow.

Ekire is currently at the Egonics Inc. Development Studio at Parchanier V, bleeding severely and fading fast. Due to a rare blood condition he contracted in an Umokkan jungle while serving as a Legion marine a decade back, transfusion via normal means would kill him. For the procedure to be at all possible he needs an aortal purifier, a seldom-used piece of medical equipment which they don't have at that particular station's med bay.

I need you to head out to Auderne immediately, to the Poteque Pharmaceuticals Biotech Production plant there, and pick up what may be the only aortal purifier available in this whole damn constellation, then bring it out to the doctors in Parchanier. His life - and our success in our campaign here - may very well depend on your speed in this matter.

Go! Fly swiftly.
messages.zh:
我们需要快点行动，事情的发展出乎意料。不，不，别坐下来，我会尽快解释这一切。

上次你出去执行任务的时候，埃及勒在一次突袭行动中被不明身份的人员攻击，受了致命伤。凶手很可能是维克米。要是他死了，维克米集团无论从政治上还是实际上都获益最大，而我们将遭受政治上的重大打击。

埃及勒目前在帕查尼尔V的自尊集团发展工作室，血流不止，器官功能衰竭很快。十年前他在海军服役期间，在乌莫卡丛林中感染了一种稀有血型，因此常规输血会让他毙命。为了让他继续活下去，需要埃尔塔净化器，这种设备不怎么常用，一般的医疗站都没有。

我需要你马上去奥德尔尼的波特克制药集团空间站，将星座内唯一的埃尔塔净化器取回来，把它送到帕查尼尔的医生那里。他的生命——以及我们这次战役的成功，就完全看你办理此事的速度了。

走吧！快！

messages.en:
Alarus Ekire is safe and sound, thanks to you. We've uncovered solid evidence of what he's been up to in the sector, and we're making arrangements to have him delivered to the proper authorities safe and sound.

There's only one loose end that needs tying up, after which we can go back to business as usual, sticking it to the man. You see, I have this large shipment of wheat here that desperately needs to get dumped in the cogs of the Wiyrkomi station in Fluekele… *grins wickedly*

How about it, friend?
messages.zh:
多亏了你，埃拉瑞斯•埃及勒现在安然无恙了。我们已经找到确切的证据，能说明他在这个区域的遭遇，现在我们正安排人员将他安全送抵当局手中。

现在只有一件事要收尾了，此后我们便能重新步入正轨，继续我们的反抗。是这样的，我这有一大批小麦，迫切需要被丢进弗琉克勒里维克米空间站的齿轮箱里……*坏笑*

怎么样，朋友？

messages.en: The Friends of Nature extend their thanks to you for your help in this whole situation.  You've been a tremendous asset to our organization.  Thanks to you, we'll be able to continue our struggle to help the natural wonders of Algintal remain just that.
messages.zh: FON感谢你在整件事情中的鼎力相助。你是我们组织里不可多得的好帮手。多亏了你，我们才能继续努力，使阿根塔的自然奇迹保持原样。

messages.en:
Nice work on the spider spruce.

So here's the situation, then. There's a guy named Alarus Ekire. He's the most militant person within our ranks - a real piece of work. Most of us have disagreed with his methods in the past, but he has an authoritative air about him which rouses admiration in the weak. For this reason he's never short of followers, and has managed to maintain his position within FON.

It has now been brought to our attention, due in no small part to your diligent work, that Ekire is the weed in our garden, the one that's been causing all this trouble in the past few weeks. We have to get rid of him, but we can't kill him. If the Wiyrkomi spin doctors have the opportunity to make him into a figurehead, we're finished. So we need to try and smoke him out, lure him into revealing himself.

We need to lay the groundwork first, though, and try to undo some of the damage he's caused. First off, we need to send the clear-cut message that FON do not wish to cast their lot with known cutthroats and murderers. To this end, we need to put our own propaganda machine to work.

There is a Serpentis outpost in one of the outlying systems. According to our intel, no detachments are stationed there at present. I want you to head out there, destroy the outpost, neutralize any opposition you may find, and report back to me. One of our other operatives will shadow you to the area and record the attack, so we can spin this to our advantage and hopefully countermand any bad publicity.

Go to it. Good luck.
messages.zh:
圈套伪装的不错。

目前的情况是这样的。有个叫埃拉瑞斯•埃及勒的家伙。在指挥官里，他是最好战的——真是个大麻烦。过去我们中大多数人对他并不赞赏，但是他有一种岿然自立的姿态，在弱者中赢得了不少崇拜和追捧。出于这个原因，他身边从来不缺少跟随者，在FON里也保持他的一席之地。

多亏了你的出色表现，我们才能得以有所警觉。埃及勒就像我们花园里的杂草，在过去几短短的几周里，他给我们制造了不少麻烦。我们必须得摆脱他，但不能干掉他。如果维克米的那些家伙能替我们完成这桩事情就再好不过。所以我们得逼他浮出水面，暴露在日光之下。

首先做些铺垫工作，收拾他落下的残局。我们必须马上发出通令，宣告FON不愿和凶手有任何瓜葛。得赶快让我们的宣传机器运做起来。

在其中一个边远星系里，有一个天蛇岗哨。根据我们的情报，此刻那里没有特遣部队驻守。我要你去摧毁这个岗哨，消灭你可以找到的任何敌人，然后回来向我报告。我们会派一个特工形影不离地跟你去那儿，将这次袭击记录备案，这样我们就能制造出对自己有利的言论，从而淡化那些负面舆论。

去吧，祝你好运。

messages.en:
The photographer who recorded your strike has given his footage to the post-production people. We should see something from them soon.

We've decided there's no choice but to take the Ekire matter into our own hands. According to our intelligence, he has something like four hundred men under his command, conducting his terrorist operations. Some of them are our own FON activists, others are mercenaries - Navy rejects, working for the highest bidder.

The Deltole system is a key tactical location; many of Ekire's mercs are stationed at an outpost there, and we have solid reports that they're preparing to stage some sort of attack on the Wiyrkomi factory there. This must not be allowed to happen.

We need you to conduct a pre-emptive strike on the outpost, eliminating any personnel you find in the vicinity. As you're not flying under our flag, there should be nothing linking you to the FON, and indeed there can't be - we would never survive the political backlash. Please know that we don't undertake the killing of people lightly. It's our hope that this is the greatly lesser of two evils.

Report back to me when the deed is done. I'll be here.
messages.zh:
记录你这次袭击行动的摄影师已经把胶片交给了后期制作。估计不久就能出成果。

我们已经决定了，看来别无选择，我们得自己一手处理埃及勒事件了。根据我们手里掌握的情报，他手下有大约四百多人，其中有些是我们FON的人，其他的则是雇佣兵——从海军淘汰下来的，谁出价最高，就为谁工作。

底托勒星系具有重大的战略意义，大量埃及勒雇佣兵驻守在那儿的某个岗哨里，据可靠消息，他们准备对那儿的维克米工厂发动攻势。我们绝不能让那样的情况出现。

我要你先发制人，对那个哨站发动袭击，消灭附近的一切有生力量。你不是我们的人，所以你与FON之间没有任何牵连，我也从来没见过你——出于政治的原因我想你能理解，因为稍有不慎FON就可能落入万劫不复的深渊。我们不赞成滥用武力，但你应该明白两害相衡取其轻的道理。

任务完成之后，回来向我报告。我会在这儿等你。

name.ru: Соперничество - Пустой груз (Antagonism - Empty Cargo) (1 из 4)

messages.en: Run along, now, there's a good puppy.
messages.zh: 去吧，小家伙。

messages.en:
Well, well, what have we here? An eager puppy pilot all raring to go? Asking every stranger to be his friend. Tut, tut, did your mother never tell you not to talk to strangers, {[character]player.name}? But now that you're here, what to do with you? Ah, well, maybe you're not as green behind the ears as you seem. Might be I have something for you after all. You might not like it, but it's all I have at the moment.

What I'm talking about is a simple errand, so it shouldn't tax your skills too much. My friends at Egonics Inc. have come up with new tapes for the Latent Transmitter that I need to collect from them.

I can see you're curious about the transmitter, but what you don't know can't hurt you. Hm, I guess that's not exactly true, is it? Well, anyway, don't worry: I'll keep you all safe and tucked in. Run this errand for me and perhaps my opinion of you will rise above the level of "haughty indifference." Then I might allow you to sink your teeth into a juicier bone next time around.
messages.zh:
好吧，好吧，看看谁来了？一个年轻的飞行员？傻傻地以为身边的每个人都能成为自己的朋友。啧啧，你母亲没告诉过你不要和陌生人讲话吗，{[character]player.name}？既然到这了，总得给你什么事做吧。嗯，可能你并不像外表那么菜。我想有个任务满适合你的。你可能不怎么喜欢，可我现在只有这个任务。

这差事很简单，不是什么技术活。我在自尊集团的朋友有一些用于潜意识发送器的新数据带，帮我把它们取来。

我能看出你对发送器很好奇，但相信我，少问多做会让你活得更久。唔？你不这么认为？好吧，别害怕，我会保证你的安全，好好干，如果你能证明自己的能力，说不定下次我会派给你个肥差。

messages.en: I see you have mastered the art of fetching, little pup. Might come in handy later on, but let's do something more fun now, eh?
messages.zh: 看来你对送货颇有心得，小家伙。稍后可能还有这样的任务，但现在让我们做一些更有趣的事，嗯？

name.en: Rogue Crop - Root of the Problem (3 of 4)
name.es: Cosecha rebelde: La raíz del problema (3 de 4)
name.fr: Une récolte douteuse – La racine du problème (3 sur 4)
name.ja: ローグクロップ-問題の根っこ（3/4）
name.ru: Добыча мошенников - корень зла (Rogue Crop - Root of the Problem) (3 из 4)

messages.en:
The techies have taken a quick look at the links you brought me and they're telling me it's something they've never seen before and are totally baffled by. I'm not sure what to make of their comments, is this radical new design a threat or not? I must get a definite answer before deciding how to proceed.

My observations and the data that you and others have collected for me, as well as information on these links, needs to be looked at by more talented techies. Take this data over to the Illinfrik system, to the Trust Partners station there. They will analyze this data and give me feedback I can work from.
messages.zh:
技术人员检查了你带给我的链接，他们居然从未见过这种东西，完全摸不着头脑。我不知道该怎么解释他们的评语，这个全新设计是一个威胁吗？在决定下一步行动前，我必须得到一个明确的答案。

我需要更资深的技术人员，来研究手下搜集的观察报告以及链接上携带的信息。把这些数据带到伊林福理克星系的信任伙伴集团空间站，那里会有人分析这些数据，并给我反馈。

name.ru: Соперничество - отправка сообщения (Antagonism - Sending a Message) (2 из 4)

messages.en:
Perhaps on your long journey to Auberulle and back you spent the idle minutes wondering what a member of the Angel Cartel was doing here in Algintal? I asked that exact same question when our chief told me he was sending me here. What is there here in Algintal for the Cartel? We have no presence to speak of here and even less authority. The few Angels who frequent the area are loners and nuts, acting pretty much of their own accord.

Well, to put things bluntly, we want to usurp the stranglehold the Serpentis and Thukkers have on smuggling and other lucrative activities here on the Gallente side of the Federation/Republic borders. The Thukkers, those devious buggers, are putting the latent transmission technology of Egonics Inc. to good use, but I've managed to worm my way into the deal.

But while I'm engaged in political machinations with the Thukkers and Egonics, the Serpentis are running rampant. I need you to take them down a peck or two. One of their main areas of operation is over in the Skeleton Comet complex in Deltole. They wrenched the place from Federation hands some years ago and now consider it their own little haven. Hitting them there would send a clear message that there's a new player in the sandbox and that they'd better watch out.

To put it simply: Go over there, locate some Serpentis smugglers, and pop them. Return with the smuggler tags they drop to claim your reward ... and of course glowing praises from me.
messages.zh: 也许在往返奥贝鲁勒的漫长行程中，趁着这段无聊的时光，你一直在想一个天使企业联合体的成员到阿根塔来做什么呢？当我的上级下命让我来的时候，我也问了他同样的问题。天使企业联合体究竟想在阿根塔获得什么呢？我们在这里没有什么势力，更不用说权力了。少数频繁出没于此的天使企业联合体成员不是孤僻的家伙就是怪人，大多喜欢我行我素。<br><br>好了，我直说吧，在这个位于联邦和共和国交界地的盖伦特地区，天蛇集团和图克尔人几乎垄断了这里的非法贩售和其他的一切赚钱买卖，而我们就是来夺取他们的主导权的。图克尔那群狡猾的家伙，已经在使用自尊集团的潜意识传播技术了，不过我还是巧妙地介入了他们之间的交易。<br><br>然而正当我忙着和图克尔人以及自尊集团玩计谋、耍手腕时，天蛇集团的势力膨胀了起来。我需要你去让他们吃点苦头。他们的一个主要军事区域位于底托勒的骷髅彗星复合体。他们在几年前从联邦的手中抢走了这个地方，现在已经把它视为自己的小天堂。在那里袭击他们将是一个明显的信号——已经有新势力介入了这里的混乱局势，他们最好小心点。<br><br>简而言之：去那里，锁定几个天蛇非法贩售者，然后把他们炸了。把他们的非法贩售者铭牌带给我以换取你的酬劳……当然，还有我的热烈表扬。

messages.en: Fine work, {[character]player.name}. We'll soon have the Serpentis on the run. Talk to me again for further missions against them.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。很快我们就能让天蛇四处逃命。再来找我接受针对他们的进一步任务。

name.ru: Соперничество - никаких переговоров (Antagonism - No Contest) (4 из 4)

messages.en:
Oh, we got their attention now, {[character]player.name}! The Serpentis are seething, and it's all thanks to you. There's only problem: Now that the Serpentis know that we Angels are barging in, they're planning to retaliate. How very idiotic of them! Heh. Well, of course we must counter their counter-threats.

My most loyal and reliable source within the Serpentis tells me that an elite strike force is arriving from Fountain. I'm already quivering in my boots, as you can see. No, seriously, the fools have made one grave error. The strike force's gear arrived ahead of the team itself. It is now sitting deep inside the Skeleton Comet complex over in Deltole. "Only by exploiting the errors of others can we enlighten the world," my mother always told me, and who am I to defy my mother, eh? We must act quickly.

Go to the Skeleton Comet complex, locate the Serpentis Command Outpost, and destroy it. Then return with the strike force's gear to me. That should paralyze their whole operation.
messages.zh:
噢，现在他们注意到我们了，{[character]player.name}！天蛇正一片骚动，这可多亏了你啊。还有一个问题：既然天蛇已经知道我们天使已经闯入，他们一定在计划报复。他们实在太白痴了！呵。不过，我们当然必须化解他们的反击。

我在天蛇集团内部最忠实可靠的内线告诉我，一批精英攻击部队正从源泉之域赶来。你看，我吓得鸡皮疙瘩都起来了。开个玩笑，实际上这些蠢货犯了个超级错误。这支攻击部队的装备已经先期抵达了。这些装备现在正存放在底托勒的骷髅彗星复合体深处。母亲总是告诉我：“利用别人的错误是我们启发世界的唯一手段。

噢，现在他们注意到我们了，{[character]player.name}！天蛇正一片骚动，这可多亏了你啊。还有一个问题：既然天蛇已经知道我们天使已经闯入，他们一定在计划报复。他们实在太白痴了！呵。不过，我们当然必须化解他们的反击。

我在天蛇集团内部最忠实可靠的内线告诉我，一批精英攻击部队正从源泉之域赶来。你看，我吓得鸡皮疙瘩都起来了。开个玩笑，实际上这些蠢货犯了个超级错误。这支攻击部队的装备已经先期抵达了。这些装备现在正存放在底托勒的骷髅彗星复合体深处。母亲总是告诉我：“利用别人的错误是我们启发世界的唯一手段。

messages.en: Happy to have you aboard. Don't let a drone bug bite you.
messages.zh: 很高兴你能帮助我们。别让无人机咬到你。

messages.en:
Algintal is one of the primary smuggling routes between the Federation and Republic space and Deltole is the main hub for smugglers in the constellation. The Serpentis have taken over a local complex, a natural beauty spot called the Skeleton Comet, and made it their own. Us Thukkers do our best to keep up and fortunately we're in good enough standing with most of the Serpentis to be allowed in their haven for some R&R.

But a week or two ago the Serpentis asked us to pay them back some of their hospitality. It seems parts of the complex are crawling with rogue drones. And not just any rogue drones, but pretty lethal ones. I understand their presence there contributed greatly to the Gallenteans evacuating the Skeleton Comet in the first place. And now it seems the rogue drones are stirring once more and the Serpentis are edgy what they might do. My superiors asked me to look into the matter and I'm interested in hiring you to do some reconnaissance for me in the complex.

What I want you to do is enter the complex and locate the rogue drone hive. Kill a few of their perimeter guards and return to me with whatever they drop. Until we know more about what makes these drones such a threat we should tread carefully, so don't try to act the hero and take on the whole hive in one go. Just pick out a few outer guards and we'll take it one step at a time from there.
messages.zh:
阿根塔是联邦与共和国空域间主要的非法贩售通道之一，而底托勒是这个星系里非法贩售者们的主要集中地。天蛇集团强占了本地的一个复合体，并把它据为己有，那是一个称为骷髅彗星的天然风景区。我们图克尔部落当然也不能落后，幸好在大部分的天蛇那儿我们的口碑还不错，所以被允许在他们的港口进行一些商贸活动。

但就在一两个礼拜前，天蛇集团要求我们知恩图报，这个复合体的部分地区目前遍布着自由无人机。而且都不是普通的那种，非常致命。我知道它们在那儿大量出现主要是由于盖伦特人首先撤出了骷髅彗星。现在，这些无人机又在蠢蠢欲动，而天蛇也开始变得不知所措。我的上级要我过去调查一下情况，而我对你很感兴趣，能不能替我到复合体那里侦察一下呢？

我要你做的就是进入复合体，找到自由无人机的母巢。干掉几个周边的守卫，无论它们掉落什么都带回来给我。在我们弄清是什么原因使得这些无人机变的如此凶悍之前，我们应该谨慎行事，所以不要逞英雄，想一口气干掉整个机巢。先干掉几个外层守卫，之后我们再步步为营，切入纵深。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. I'll get our techies to take a look at those links you collected and we'll see what they come up with.
messages.zh: 干得不错！{[character]player.name}。我将派技术人员对你收集到的那些连接进行分析，看看他们能发现些什么。

messages.en:
This Aether Hive Link you returned with is a puzzle. It looks as if these drones are capable of more intimate communications than otherwise believed, but there are also hints that even more advanced hive mind links exist. I'm not a technician, so I can't go into all that much details, this information is just something relayed to me from our techies at the Thukker Mix. They say that they suspect that a truly symbiotic drone hive might be evolving. They sound exited about it, but they are safe in their labs, so what do they know? It's us that have to deal with these drones face to face that have to worry.

In any case, we must verify whether this is true or not. I need you to go back into the complex and now I need stuff from drones closer to the hive. There are some drone workers orbiting close to the hive that seem like ideal targets. Take a few of them out and, again, return with whatever they drop. I will then forward it to our techies and see what the situation is. Just be extra careful when you take the workers out, you never know what might be protecting them. Maybe nothing, maybe something heavy.
messages.zh:
你带回的这个以太机巢链简直是个谜。与普遍观点不同的是，这些无人机似乎能够进行更高等级的亲密交流，而且有迹象表明，还有更先进的母体思维链路存在。我不是技术人员，所以不可能深入了解所有细节，这则信息是我们在图克尔混合企业里的技术人员转发给我的。他们说他们怀疑有一个真正的共生无人机母巢正在逐步成形。他们听起来很兴奋，但是他们整天安全地待在实验室里，他们知道什么？需要担心的是我们这些不得不面对无人机的人。

无论怎样，我们都必须验证这是真是假。我要你回到复合体，这次我需要离母巢更近的无人机身上的物品。有些无人机工作者绕着母巢近距离航行，它们正是理想的目标。去干掉几架，还是把它们掉落的东西带回来，无论是什么。然后我会将其转交给我们的技术人员进行分析，看看究竟是什么情况。你去消灭那些无人机工作者的时候，要格外小心，因为谁都不知道它们周围是否有守卫力量。可能什么也没有，也可能是非常强大的力量。

messages.en: That's the way to do it! I think these weird links are just what our techies were hoping for.
messages.zh: 干得好！我想这些奇怪的链接正是我们技术人员想要的。

messages.zh: 你想要我去小行星带找某种二进制代码？好吧，我去看看。

messages.en: Uh, right. Hello? Do you understand me?
messages.zh: 呃，好吧。喂？你懂我的意思吗？

messages.en: Ok, I have your code.
messages.zh: 好，我有你的代码。

messages.en: I have no idea what you're saying and I'm not interested.
messages.zh: 我不知道你在说什么，对此我也不感兴趣。

messages.en: I have no patience in finding your stupid code.
messages.zh: 我没有耐心去找你的那些愚蠢的代码。

messages.en:
The Serpentis are not taking us seriously enough, it seems. My spies tell me their leadership thinks your strike was a one-time occurance that they need not concern themselves with. And more importantly, it did little to weaken their grip on the smuggling in the constellation. So we need to take more drastic steps to show them that we mean business.

With all the hype surrounding the Wiyrkomi's presence here in Algintal, smugglers have to be extra careful. The Serpentis are no idiots, and they've reacted fast. They built a huge repackaging factory in the middle of nowhere, where they ship all their illegal goods to be repacked into something looking a bit less suspicious. I understand they learnt the technique from the Thukkers, who've done the same for years. Be that as it may.

What I'm asking of you is no small feat. Take out the repackaging factory, and the Serpentis will not only become very aware of our presence here, but their operation will take a severe hit. My informant has given me the coordinates of the repackaging factory, but I have only very limited information about the defenses around the installation. No doubt they're formidable, so taking a few friends along is a good idea. But I'm pretty sure the defense systems are not yet fully operational since the factory only recently opened.
messages.zh:
似乎天蛇集团还未有所警觉。我的侦查员透露，他们认为你的袭击只是偶然，因而他们不必有太大顾虑。不仅如此，那次袭击对于他们在这个星座的非法贩售活动没有丝毫的影响。所以我们需要采取更大规模的行动，证明我们不是闹着玩的。

由于所有维克米军团在阿根塔的频繁活动，非法贩售者变得格外小心。天蛇集团也不是傻瓜，他们迅速作出了反应。在偏僻的地区，天蛇建造了一个巨大的再包装工厂，把所有的非法物品运送到那里重新包装，这样就更不容易引起怀疑。我知道这一套是他们从图克尔人那里学来的，多年以前图克尔人就是这样做的。

不管怎么样，我给你一个重要任务。毁掉那个再包装工厂，这样不光让天蛇集团意识到我们的存在，而且对他们的活动都会一次重大打击。我的内线已经给了我这个工厂的坐标，但我对于这个设施周围的防御情况知之甚少。毫无疑问，那里肯定戒备森严，所以带一些朋友一起过去是个不错的主意。希望那儿的防御系统还不够完善，因为这个工厂才刚刚开业。

messages.en:
I've received a preliminary report from Illifik. It seems a new strand of rogue drones evolved in that hive over in the Skeleton Comet complex. At first, this new strand was incorporated into the existing hive and used to augment it. These strange links you got me are a case in point. But here's the interesting thing. It seems the queen in the drone hive in the Skeleton Comet eventually turned against these new rogue drones and chased them away.

The techies in Illifik managed to extract imbedded commands in the hive links you brought them that showed that the queen has ordered her drone army to destroy all these evolved rogue drones. Obviously she fears they might pose a threat to her authority. I don't know if her drone army is already on the prowl, but I do know where one group of these evolved rogue drones is located at. I've been ordered to retrieve a functional hive mind from these new drones for further analyzes of their capabilities. Getting in a cross-fire between two opposing rogue drone factions seems kinda dangerous to me, thus I'm asking you if you're up to the job. I have no idea what you should expect in this drone hive location, be on the lookout for the drone army sent by the queen in the Skeleton Comet.
messages.zh: 我收到一份来自伊林福理克的初步报告。似乎骷髅彗星复合体的母巢内进化出了一支新类别的自由无人机。起初这些新式品种属于现有机巢，并被用于扩大机巢。你给我的这些奇怪的机巢链路就是最好的证据。但有趣的事情发生了。骷髅彗星无人机机巢的皇后似乎和这些新无人机反目成仇，并把它们赶了出去。<br><br> 伊林福理克的技术人员从你带去的机巢链里提取出了内嵌指令，这些指令显示，无人机皇后命令她的无人机大军将这些进化型自由无人机全部摧毁。显然她害怕它们会对她的权威构成威胁。我不知道她的无人机大军是不是已经开始四处巡游，但我却知道一群进化型无人机的确切位置。我接到命令，要从这些新式无人机中获得一个完好的母体芯片，以便我们进一步分析其能力。卷入两支交火的敌对自由无人机派别之间对我而言似乎有点危险，因此我想问你是否愿意做这个工作。我压根儿不知道你在机巢所在地会碰到些什么，不过你要当心骷髅彗星中无人机皇后派来的无人机部队。

messages.en: Amazing! Looks like the drones in the Skeleton Comet beat you to it. Thankfully they left enough of the new breed drones intact for you to complete your assignment and me to have something to send to my superiors. But now we can rest assured that these evolutionary drones won't pose a threat to us in the future. And we have you to thank for that, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 真不可思议！看来骷髅彗星的无人机捷足先登了。多亏他们留下了够多完好无损的新式无人机，好让你完成任务，也让我好向上级交差。但现在我们能确信无疑，这些进化的无人机在未来不会给我们构成任何威胁。我们得好好谢谢你，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en:
I've received a preliminary report from Illifik. It seems a new strand of rogue drones evolved in that hive over in the Skeleton Comet complex. At first, this new strand was incorporated into the existing hive and used to augment it. These strange links you got me are a case in point. But here's the interesting thing. It seems the queen in the drone hive in the Skeleton Comet eventually turned against these new rogue drones and chased them away.

The techies in Illifik managed to extract imbedded commands in the hive links you brought them that showed that the queen has ordered her drone army to destroy all these evolved rogue drones. Obviously she fears they might pose a threat to her authority. I don't know if her drone army is already on the prowl, but I do know where one group of these evolved rogue drones is located at. I've been ordered to retrieve a functional hive mind from these new drones for further analyzes of their capabilities. Getting in a cross-fire between two opposing rogue drone factions seems kinda dangerous to me, thus I'm asking you if you're up to the job. I have no idea what you should expect in this drone hive location, be on the lookout for the drone army sent by the queen in the Skeleton Comet.

messages.en: As a matter of fact there is.  I'm looking for some work.
messages.zh: 事实上，确实有事。我想找些活干。

messages.en: One of our supply depots in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} was recently attacked by rogue drones.  Fortunately no-one was killed, but they refuse to leave the area.  I want them destroyed, every last one.  Return to me when you've accomplished your task.
messages.zh: 我们位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个补给站最近遭到了自由无人机的袭击。幸运的是，没有人员伤亡。但是它们赖着不走了。我想让你干掉它们，一个不剩。完成任务后回来见我。

messages.en: The drones have been taken care of, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我已消灭那些无人机，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Excellent.  But unfortunately I've received reports of more attacks, my office has been virtually swamped with complaints from inhabitants of outlying settlements.  So if you're up for it, I've got another mission waiting for you.
messages.zh: 很好。但不幸的是，我收到了更多的遇袭报告，我的办公室里已经堆满了偏远殖民地居民的投诉。如果你愿意，我还有别的任务给你。

messages.en: In that case I have something that's right up your alley.  Well, as long as you can handle yourself in combat, anyway.  One of our supply depots in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} was recently attacked by rogue drones.  Fortunately no-one was killed, but they refuse to leave the area.  I want them destroyed, every last one.  Return to me when you've accomplished your task.
messages.zh: 那样的话，我就有些事情会合你的胃口。当然，不管怎样你得会打仗。我们位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个补给站最近遭到了自由无人机的袭击。幸运的是，没有人员伤亡。但是它们赖着不走了。我想让你干掉它们，一个不剩。完成任务后回来见我。

messages.en:
As I told you after your last mission, the rogue drone problem just keeps growing. Don't get me wrong, it's no threat to our major outposts here, but we just don't have the manpower to constantly patrol every corner of the Araz constellation. So we need people like you to clean up the mess sometimes.

Your last mission put to an end a small force of rogue drones which had roamed too close to one of our supply depots. This time I want you to take care of the root of the problem, a Strain Drone Matriarch which reportedly carries the mother-brain of the hive. Destroy it and the hive collapses.

The problem is finding the Matriarch. Our surveillance forces have been working 24/7 to locate some of these 'mother-drones', and there is one in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that I want you to take care of. And for that we have a plan. You must lure the Matriarch drone out of her 'nest', as attacking it head-on is risky and unnecessary. All you have to do is assault a small base near the nest which is infested with the drones, and the Matriarch will come. We have plenty of experience with situations like this and our estimates suggest that she will arrive in around 20 minutes.

So to cut the story short, warp to the bookmarked location in the mission details and make your presence known. Wait until the Matriarch shows up and destroy her. I suggest clearing the area of rogue drones before she arrives, as that would save you the hassle of having to deal with them all at the same time.
messages.zh:
就像你上次任务结束后我说的，自由无人机的问题越来越严重。别误解，它对这里的主哨站还构不成威胁，但由于缺乏人手，我们无法在埃拉茨星座持续进行全面的巡逻。有时候，我们就需要像你这样的人才来解决麻烦。

你在上次任务中成功歼灭了一小队过于靠近我们补给站的自由无人机。这次你需要解决问题的根源，击毁一艘加强型女祭司无人机。报告显示，它身上携带着母巢的母脑。只要击毁它，母巢就会坍塌。

找到女祭司，问题就能迎刃而解。我们的侦察部队全天待命，积极搜寻部分“无人机母机”，而你要解决的是位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的无人机。对此我们制定了一个计划。你要先把女祭司无人机从“老巢”里骗出来，毕竟正面攻击太危险了，没必要冒这个险。巢穴附近有一个停靠了很多无人机的小型基地，只要攻击那里，女祭司就会出动。这种情况我们已遇见多次，20分钟左右你就能看到她了。

重点就是你要跃迁到任务详情中标注了位标的位置，让它们知道你来了。女祭司一出现就干掉她。在此之前，最好先把基地里的自由无人机全部毁掉，以免在对战时同时对付许多无人机。

messages.en: Excellent work.
messages.zh: 干得很好！

messages.en: You have any more work for me?
messages.zh: 你还有其他任务给我吗？

messages.en:
You're still here? Well then, yes I have some more work. A large group of Serpentis were seen enter {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, with two industrials in tow. We are pretty sure this is a group of smugglers on their way through Araz, to where we don't know. They somehow got past our customs officials but we know their approximate coordinates now and therefore we can set up an ambush. I'll give you the coordinates of a small asteroid belt where we have set up a warp disruptor. That will force their ships to materialize from warp, and gives you the perfect chance to launch your ambush.

From what we've seen, they aren't traveling in a single group, so don't expect them all to arrive at once. Change your tactics accordingly.
messages.zh:
你还在这儿？好吧，我当然还有工作给你。据称一大群天蛇集团的成员进入了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，还带着两艘工业舰。显然这是一伙途径埃拉茨的非法贩售者，其目的地尚不清楚。虽然他们侥幸通过了海关检查，但我们依然掌握着他们目前的大致位置，因此可以发动一次伏击。伏击点是一个小行星带，我们在那里安装了跃迁扰断器阻止他们逃跑，位标会上传到你的日志中。

据我们观察，他们并不是以一整个团队行进的，所以一时间内对方并不会悉数到齐，视情况随机应变。

messages.en: Good job.
messages.zh: 做得好。

You're still here? Well then, yes I have some more work. A large group of Serpentis were seen enter {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, with two industrials in tow. name.fr: Du carburant pour les activistes (1 sur 4)

messages.en:
My name is Jannegiers Estacan, and I'm the Chief Indoctrination Officer for the Friends of Nature in this area. I bring new recruits in and teach them all about the wonders of nature and how awful the corporate behemoth is ... as the 12th Prophet put it, "trying to put an ISK sign" on everything that grows naturally in this splendid universe of ours.

I also oversee most of the supplies that come to and from our fair little seminary. As a matter of fact, I have something on my desk right now that requires the attention of someone fast and competent. Couldn't help but notice that fine-looking vessel you're flying there. One of our fertilizer shipments was ambushed yesterday, and we need someone to replace what's missing. If you can find us 100 units of fertilizer, we'd be much obliged.
messages.zh:
我叫贾内·艾斯塔坎，是FON在这个地区的首席教化官。我负责引进新成员，教授他们有关大自然的奇迹，揭露那些商业巨头是如何……按照第12位先知的说法，试图在我们美丽宇宙的所有自然生物上“印上星币标志”。

我也监管我们这所小学校的多数补给的进出。实际上，我手头有些事需要一个手脚麻利、踏实能干的人来做。我不自觉地注意到你驾驶的那艘漂亮的飞船。昨天，我们的一批肥料在运输中遭到伏击，所以我们要找人补上这批货。如果你能为我们找到100单位肥料，那么我们会非常感激的。

name.fr: Du carburant pour les activistes (2 sur 4)

messages.en:
Great job with the fertilizer. My thanks. Next up, we have a shortage of wheat on one of our outposts on Parchanier IV. There's been a bit of a mix-up, it seems: A shipment of Quafe Ultra went to the planet instead of the wheat, and now those poor people have nothing to make their bread with.

If you could pop over to the Egonics Inc. Development Studio at Parchanier V and deliver this wheat to them, you'd be greatly aiding the FON's cause in this area.
messages.zh:
干得好。非常感谢。接下来，我们在帕查尼尔IV的哨站缺少小麦。似乎出了点差错：本该运到那颗行星的小麦却变成了酷菲特强，现在那里可怜的人民连做面包的材料都没有了。

如果你可以去一下帕查尼尔V的自尊集团发展工作室，把这些小麦送给他们，你可就为FON在这个地区的事业帮了个大忙。

name.fr: Du carburant pour les activistes (3 sur 4)

messages.en:
Good news! One of our teams has just pulled off a major coup against the Wiyrkomi corporation in the Augnais system. They've managed to intercept the third shipment in a row of batteries for the workers' personal electronic entertainment systems. Things are at boiling point over there already, and I wouldn't be surprised if we saw a mutiny there sometime in the near future.

We need someone to go grab the batteries, though, so we can put them to good use and absolve our people in the area of any suspicions, should the powers that be decide to conduct a hangar search. Head over to the Pend Insurance Investment Bank in Augnais and grab the batteries for me, and we'll reward you well.
messages.zh:
好消息！我们的舰队刚在奥格奈斯星系对维克米集团发动了一次漂亮的突袭。他们成功截获了一批电池，专供工人的个人电子娱乐设备使用，算上前两次，这已经是第三回了。他们的工人怒气冲天，估计不久就会有人反叛。

我们需要一个人去把电池拿来，让它们派上好用场。另外，万一他们决定来个地毯式搜查，我们在这个地区的人又能免遭怀疑。去奥格奈斯的彭德保险投资银行，把电池带过来，我会重重有赏。

name.fr: Du carburant pour les activistes (4 sur 4)

messages.en:
This is kind of strange. I've just been handed a shipment of small arms that is supposedly bound for an outpost of ours in the Deltole system. I'm not sure what this means, but the shipping slip seems correct. I'll have to get in touch with my superiors about this - we shouldn't be ferrying weapons around. Something fishy might be going on here.

Should you decide you want to take this job, the small arms will be placed in your cargo hold and since I know you'll remain quiet about this, I'm going to throw in a little something special as a reward this time.
messages.zh:
事情有些奇怪。一批原计划运送到底托勒星系驻地的小型军械居然转到了我的手里。虽然这种小事故天天都在发生，但我总感觉不对。必须和上头联系一下——不该在这里附近运输武器。这里面有鬼。

要是你决定接受这个任务，我会叫人把小型军械运到你的舱内。如果你守口如瓶，我会给你一些特别的奖励。

name.es: El poder de la información (1 de 3)
name.ja: 巨大コーポレーション幹部のスキャンダル（1/3）
name.ru: Сила информации (The Power of Information) (1 из 3)

messages.en:
My name's Astroo Opeau, and I'm FON's propaganda honcho. I could have some hoity-toity title, sure, but I like to keep things down-to-earth and formalities just get in the way.

I have a few things I could use a big strapping capsuleer like you for, if you're interested. Tidbits of information are in constant swirl around this constellation, like electrons in an atom, and we need to cast as many nets as far and wide as possible if we want to stand a chance against the corporate behemoth of Wiyrkomi.

One of my eyes in the Audaerne system just got a recording of one of Wiyrkomi's brass indulging in some, shall we say, languorous activities in a pleasure resort not far from here. Head over to the Modern Finances Investment Bank in Audaerne and pick up the tape for me, and we'll see what we can do with it.
messages.zh:
我叫阿斯图•欧佩勒，是FON的宣传总管。当然，我可以摆出领导架子，不过我更喜欢开门见山，注重实效的作风。

如果你感兴趣，我这里有不少任务很适合你这样的飞行员。珍贵的情报总是不时地出现在我们周围，就像原子内那些飞速运动的电子，如果我们希望继续与像维克米这样庞大的军团抗衡的话，就必须尽可能多地抓住这些信息。

我在奥德尔尼的一个内线人员刚刚得到了一些资料，记录了维克米集团部分高级官员在附近一个度假胜地的一些纵容堕落行为。请你前去奥德尔尼的现代商业投资银行帮我取回那卷带子，我要考虑下该如何利用它。

name.es: El poder de la información (2 de 3)
name.ja: 巨大コーポレーション幹部のスキャンダル（2/3）
name.ru: Сила информации (The Power of Information) (2 из 3)

messages.en:
The tape you brought back of the Wiyrkomi scumbag proved ideal for our purposes. We've made a holoreel of the "incident," and we need it copied and distributed to key points in the constellation so we can mount a full-scale broadcast offensive against the bastard.

Take this holoreel over to my distributor in the Fluekele system. We'll see how big a shot the bigshot is after this.
messages.zh:
你拿回来的关于维克米集团那个蠢货的资料对我们非常有用。我们已经制作了一个关于这次“事件”的全息记录盘，需要将它大批复制，再分发到星座中关键的地点，对这个老家伙发动全面的广播攻势。

将这个全息记忆盘带给我在弗琉克勒星系中的发行人手里。看看他究竟是多大的腕儿。

name.es: El poder de la información (3 de 3)
name.ja: 巨大コーポレーション幹部のスキャンダル（3/3）
name.ru: Сила информации (The Power of Information) (3 из 3)

messages.en:
Well, our little gambit worked. The bigwig's been driven out of Wiyrkomi and a blow's been struck for the little guy. Thanks so much for your help.

One last favor, if you will. Some of our guys are founding an environmentalist education facility on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and they need some construction materials brought over. You think you could do this for me? I'll pay you well.
messages.zh:
我们的小计策成功了。那个大人物被赶出维克米集团，他还吃了不少苦头。非常感谢你的帮助！

如果你愿意的话，请你帮我最后一个忙。我们正在底托勒Ⅳ建立一个环保教育设施，需要送一些建筑材料过去。你能帮我这个忙吗？我会给你丰厚的报酬。

name.fr: De l'huile sur le feu (1 sur 3)

messages.en:
Hi there, stranger. I'm Croir Arghe, and I'm in charge of what we like to affectionately call FON's guerilla wing. Not for anyone, what I have. No sirree.

We've received some information recently that gives us reason to believe Wiyrkomi are up to some very clandestine things in this sector. In light of that, we're planning to mount a large offensive against a Wiyrkomi mercenary outpost in the Colelie system. Now, this is not something that's technically sanctioned by the top tiers of FON's command structure, but a certain portion of us feel that this must be done anyway. If you have a hauler handy and are willing to help with the logistics of this endeavor, I can pay you very well. Just keep quiet about it, OK?

First off, I need some recon speeders brought to Deltole. There's quite a large amount of them, so you'll need a good deal of cargo space. Are you up to it?
messages.zh:
刚来的，你好。我是克瓦•阿格，FON的游击翼由我掌管。换句话说，我，就是这里的老大。

最近我们收到一则消息，称维克米在这个地区正秘密地在干些什么。所以我们打算对维克米在克勒列星系的佣兵哨站发动一次大规模袭击。不管FON指挥部的高层是否批准，这次行动是势在必行。如果你手头正好有运输机，并愿意为我们的后勤保障工作出点力的话，我可以给你丰厚的报酬，但你可要守口如瓶啊。

首先，我要给底托勒送一些侦查快艇。量非常大，因此你要有足够大的货舱容量。考虑好了吗？

name.fr: De l'huile sur le feu (2 sur 3)

messages.en: Preparations for the attack are going well, but a slight problem has presented itself. The squadron we have stationed in Fluekele has run out of rocket fuel for their ground-based missile systems. This doesn't bode well for the offensive, so if you could head over to Audaerne, grab the supplies we have there and bring them over to Fluekele, we would much appreciate it.
messages.zh: 这次袭击的准备工作进展良好，不过出现了一个小问题。我们在弗琉克勒有个中队，他们的地面导弹系统的火箭燃料已经用完了。这可不是个好兆头，如果你能跑一趟奥德尔尼，把那边的补给送到弗琉克勒，我们将感激不尽。

name.fr: De l'huile sur le feu (3 sur 3)

messages.en:
We are almost ready for the offensive. Only one thing is missing.

The squadron spearheading the attack is going to be mounting custom-built guidance systems, ones which will give them an unsurpassed ability to track ground-based targets on a flyby. We've had top engineers working on these systems for a while now, and they were finally completed yesterday.

Go get the finished batch from Barmalie and bring it to Deltole, and we will be ready for our strike.
messages.zh:
基本上，我们已经做好了战斗准备。现在就差一样东西了。

这次进攻的先锋中队将配备个性化的导航系统，这将大大提升他们飞行时锁定地面目标的能力。我们的顶尖工程师花了不少时间研制这一系统，昨天刚刚做出成品。

去巴麦列取回成品，然后送去底托勒，之后我们就可以发动进攻了。

messages.en: Great work, friend.  We are now ready to strike the enemy where it will hurt him the most.  You've been a valuable asset to the FON - know that you have helped preserve one of the most beautiful and sacred spots in the entire Gallente Federation.
messages.zh: 朋友，干得漂亮。现在一切已经就位，我们会找准敌人的软肋狠狠地进行打击。你真是FON的宝贵财富——你保卫了整个盖伦特联邦最美丽、最神圣的地方。

messages.en: I seem to have one more mission for you, {[character]player.name}. Lord Manel informed me a few weeks ago that he had more important business to take care of *hint of sarcasm* than occupy the Governor's seat in the Audience Chamber. But he told me he'd be back by now, actually he was expected back a few days ago. This is not unusual behavior of Manel, but it's surprising that no one at the mansion is returning our calls. So I'd like you to investigate the matter and see what's wrong. Pay a visit to Manel and tell him to contact us ASAP. Probably just a malfunction of the communications system, but it's better to be safe than sorry.
messages.zh: 我这里似乎还有个任务得交给你，{[character]player.name}。几周前曼尼尔大人告诉我他有更重要的事要做*语气略带讽刺*，比坐统治者接见室的统治者位子还重要。但他告诉过我，他应该在这个时候回来，事实上他几天前就该到了。对曼尼尔来说，这种行为并不罕见，但是奇怪的是，官邸里没人回复我们的呼叫。所以我想让你去调查一下这件事，看看出了什么问题。去拜访一下曼尼尔，告诉他尽快与我们联系。这很可能只是通讯系统故障，不过稳妥行事总比空留遗憾好。

messages.en: So the acceleration gate was locked and Manel's servants left stranded outside?  Shocking.  We need to get to the bottom of this immediately.  Please speak with Odan Poun here in the Governor's Audience Chamber.  He's the chief of security in Chanoun.  He might need some help in solving this mystery, and I told him you were the right man for the job.  Be safe.
messages.zh: 就是说加速轨道锁上了，曼尼尔大人的仆人被锁在外面束手无策？震惊啊。我们一定立刻要查清此事。请与统治者接见室的奥达恩·帕恩谈谈。他是查浓的安全长官。他可能需要找人协助解开这个谜，我告诉他你是这个工作的合适人选。注意安全。

messages.en: I seem to have one more mission for you, {[character]player.name}. Lord Manel informed me a few weeks ago that he had more important business to take care of *hint of sarcasm* than occupy the Governor's seat in the Audience Chamber. But he told me he'd be back by now, actually he was expected back a few days ago. This is not unusual behavior of Manel, but it's surprising that no one at the mansion is returning our calls. So I'd like you to investigate the matter and see what's wrong. Pay a visit to Manel and tell him to contact us ASAP. Probably just a malfunction of the communications system, but it's better to be safe than sorry.
messages.zh: 我这里似乎还有个任务得交给你，{[character]player.name}。几周前曼尼尔大人告诉我他有更重要的事要做*语气略带讽刺*，比坐统治者接见室的统治者位子还重要。但他告诉过我，他应该在这个时候回来，事实上他几天前就该到了。对曼尼尔来说，这种行为并不罕见，但是奇怪的是，官邸里没人回复我们的呼叫。所以我想让你去调查一下这件事，看看出了什么问题。去拜访一下曼尼尔，告诉他尽快与我们联系。这很可能只是通讯系统故障，不过稳妥行事总比空留遗憾好。

messages.en: I think I have something that would interest you.
messages.zh: 我的工作你一定感兴趣。

messages.en: Well then, let's see what you got.
messages.zh: 好吧，让我们看看你有什么。

messages.en: I'm just here for some work.
messages.zh: 我来这里找一些工作。

messages.en: Who are you?  I've got important business to attend to, so unless you're somebody important get lost.
messages.zh: 你是谁？我有重要的事情要做。除非你是个大人物，否则赶快离开。

messages.en: Nossa Farad sent me.  Here's her voucher.
messages.zh: 诺萨•法拉特派我来这儿。这是她的凭证。

messages.en: Ah, so you're the guy Nossa told me about.  I'm sorry about my rudeness earlier, I'm just so used to whiney Chanoun civilians harassing me day in and day out with their petty problems ...
messages.zh: 啊，那么你就是诺莎萨跟我讲的人啦。我对之前的粗鲁表示抱歉。我已经习惯了唠叨的查浓居民整天拿一些小问题来骚扰我了……

messages.en: To obtain the voucher, talk to Nossa Farad in the Governor's Audience Chamber agent site in Chanoun and complete her missions.
messages.zh: 要获得凭证，去查浓的统治者接见室诺萨•法拉特，完成她的任务。

messages.en: Extra Info
messages.zh: 额外信息

messages.en: Who are you?  I've got important business to attend to, so unless you're somebody important get lost.
messages.zh: 你是谁？我有重要的事情要做。除非你是个大人物，否则赶快给我消失。

messages.en: Calm down, Finn. I'm here on a classified assignment as well, and I need to talk to you.
messages.zh: 冷静，芬。我到这里也是来执行一个机密任务的，而且我需要跟你谈谈。

messages.en:
Alright, in that case maybe I do have a minute or two. But hold on a second while I do a trace for bugs on you. Stand still...

Okay, you're clean. What is it? And keep your voice down.
messages.zh:
好吧，那样的话，也许我确实有一两分钟时间。不过等一下，我检查一下你身上有没有偷听器。站着别动……

好了，你身上没有东西。这是什么？还有，说话小声点。

messages.en: Hey, you're Ader Finn right?
messages.zh: 嘿，你是阿得•芬？

messages.en: Shhh!! Quiet, fool. You might compromise my mission! I can't be seen talking to someone like you...
messages.zh: 嘘！！安静，笨蛋！你可能会搅乱我的任务！不能让人看到我与像你这样的人谈话……

messages.en: I have a message from Odan Poun...
messages.zh: 我有一条来自奥达恩•帕恩的消息……

messages.en: What?! If Odan has decided to risk my entire operation, then it must be because of something important. I'll take a look at his message. Give me a moment...
messages.zh: 什么？！如果奥达恩决定拿我的整个行动冒险，那么一定是有重要原因。我要看看他的消息。稍等一下……

messages.en: Shhh!! Quiet, fool. You might compromise my mission! I can't be seen talking to someone like you...
messages.zh: 嘘！！安静，笨蛋！你可能会搅乱我的任务！不能让人看到我与像你这样的人谈话……

messages.en: I'll be back before you can say "Get going!"
messages.zh: 我马上去办。

messages.en: A courier mission...?
messages.zh: 你是说一个送信任务？

messages.en: I'd like you to transport my report to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. It has details on my latest findings about the Blood Raider operation in the Araz constellation. This stuff is way too sensitive to send over a normal transmission. It must not fall into Blood Raider hands, or my life will be forfeit! Go now, and return at once when you're done.
messages.zh: 请你把我的报告送往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。里面有我对血袭者在埃拉茨星系的行动的最新发现的详细情况。这份东西太过敏感，不能通过普通传输信号发送。它绝不能落入血袭者的手中，否则我就死定了！马上出发吧，办完事后立刻回来。

messages.en: I have completed the delivery as you requested.
messages.zh: 如你所愿，运送已完成。

messages.en: Ok. Good job. Take this message and deliver it to Odan Poun; it should explain everything. Be careful out there.
messages.zh: 好吧。做得好。好的。将这条消息带给奥达恩•帕恩，这足以解释他的疑惑。到那注意安全。

messages.en: Yes, like I said, while I evaluate this message, I'd like you to transport my report to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. It has details on my latest findings about the Blood Raider operation in the Araz constellation. This stuff is way too sensitive to send over a normal transmission. It must not fall into Blood Raider hands, or my life will be forfeit! Go now, and return at once when you're done.
messages.zh: 是的，正如我之前所说，在我研究这一信息的时候，请你把我的报告送往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。里面有我对血袭者在埃拉茨星系的行动的最新发现的详细情况。这份东西太过敏感，不能通过普通传输信号发送。它绝不能落入血袭者的手中，否则我就死定了！马上出发吧，办完事后立刻回来。

messages.en:
To start off our investigation into the disappearance of Lord Manel we need to get into his mansion. I took a look at the first acceleration gate at his mansion complex with some of my men and we noticed that it was not only locked but also booby trapped. But what was more concerning is the fact that the trap had the hallmark of a Blood Raider contraption. This, quite frankly, terrifies me. If the Blood Raiders are involved I truly fear for Manel's life.

While I do some more investigating near the mansion, I would like you to contact an agent of mine which has been working under cover as a Blood Raider operative in Munory. His name is Ader Finn, and you will find his roadhouse near the 3rd moon of Munory V. Bring him my message, it's contents are top-secret and may not fall into enemy hands. Hopefully he will be able to find some clues as to why the Blood Raiders became involved, and how to acquire a key into the complex.
messages.zh:
要调查曼尼尔大人的失踪，首先我们得进入他的官邸。我带了几个手下去看过他的官邸所在复合体的第一条加速轨道，发现这条轨道不仅上了锁，而且设置了机关。更值得关注的是，机关带有明显的血袭者装置的特征。坦白说，这吓到了我。如果这事跟血袭者有关，那么我真的替曼尼尔的性命担忧。

在我对官邸附近做详细调查时，我希望你去联系我的一个特工，他伪装成一名血袭者间谍潜伏在蒙诺瑞。他名叫阿得·芬，他在蒙诺瑞Ⅴ—卫3附近的路边旅馆居住。把我的信息带给他，信息内容高度机密，切不可落入敌人手中。希望他能查出血袭者插手此事的缘由，以及怎样得到进入复合体的钥匙。

messages.en: I have Ader's answer to your message right here, Odan.
messages.zh: 我这里有阿得给你的回应，奥达恩。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Speak with Ader Finn, who is located near his roadhouse at Munory V Moon 3.
messages.zh: 去和阿得•芬进行交谈，他在蒙诺瑞Ⅴ—卫3的路边旅馆附近。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en:
To start off our investigation into the disappearance of Lord Manel we need to get into his mansion. I took a look at the first acceleration gate at his mansion complex with some of my men and we noticed that it was not only locked but also booby trapped. But what was more concerning is the fact that the trap had the hallmark of a Blood Raider contraption. This, quite frankly, terrifies me. If the Blood Raiders are involved I truly fear for Manel's life.

While I do some more investigating near the mansion, I would like you to contact an agent of mine which has been working under cover as a Blood Raider operative in Munory. His name is Ader Finn, and you will find his roadhouse near the 3rd moon of Munory V. Bring him my message, it's contents are top-secret and may not fall into enemy hands. Hopefully he will be able to find some clues as to why the Blood Raiders became involved, and how to acquire a key into the complex.

Dismissed.
messages.zh:
要调查曼尼尔大人的失踪，首先我们得进入他的官邸。我带了几个手下去看过他的官邸所在复合体的第一条加速轨道，发现这条轨道不仅上了锁，而且设置了机关。更值得关注的是，机关带有明显的血袭者装置的特征。坦白说，这吓到了我。如果这事跟血袭者有关，那么我真的替曼尼尔的性命担忧。

在我对官邸附近做详细调查时，我希望你去联系我的一个特工，他伪装成一名血袭者间谍潜伏在蒙诺瑞。他名叫阿得·芬，他在蒙诺瑞Ⅴ—卫3附近的路边旅馆居住。把我的信息带给他，信息内容高度机密，切不可落入敌人手中。希望他能查出血袭者插手此事的

messages.en:
Ader Finn tells me in his message that the operation against Manel was not authorized by the highest ranking order of the Blood Raiders, even though members of the organization were involved. This was simply a side-job taken by one of the Blood Raider commanders in Araz, Kardour Maxten. Not only that but Ader reports that rumor in the organization has it that Kardour and the other commanders have had heated exchanges about his involvement in the Manel incident.

This is good news for us, because it means Ader can possibly acquire the help of one of the other Blood Raider commanders in our investigation, indirectly of course. He claims to be rather close to one of these commanders, who has access to a key which should temporarily disable the trap at the acceleration gate leading into Manel's Mansion. But there is a price of course, Ader was asked to assassinate Kardour in exchange for this key. The Blood Raider commander who he has been in touch with is apparently a rival of Kardour's, and is terrified that Blood Raider involvement in the killing or kidnapping of Manel will compromise their entire operation in Araz.

Obviously you are the best canditate to take out Kardour. I will supply you with a bookmark which was included in Ader's message, it should lead you to him. But I warn you, he operates a battleship and might be too tough for you to handle alone. Good luck.
messages.zh: 阿得•芬在信息里告诉我，虽然血袭者的一些成员参与了针对曼尼尔的行动，但该行动并未获得血袭者最高官员的许可。事实上，这只是埃拉茨血袭者指挥官之一——卡尔杜•马克西坦的个人单边行动。不仅如此，阿得还报告说，组织内传言卡尔杜与其他指挥官曾就他参与曼尼尔事件发生过激烈争执。<br><br>这对我们来说是个好消息，因为这意味着阿得有可能在调查中获得某位血袭者指挥官的帮助，当然是间接的。他称与某位指挥官走得很近，这位指挥官拥有一把钥匙，可以暂时关闭通向曼尼尔官邸的加速轨道处的机关。但是当然对方是有条件的，他要求阿得除掉卡尔杜来换取钥匙。阿得接触的这个血袭者指挥官显然是卡尔杜的死敌，他担心血袭者参与加害或绑架曼尼尔的事件会危及他们在埃拉茨的所有行动。<br><br>显然，你是去除掉卡尔杜的最佳人选。现在我把阿得信息中提供的位标给你，它可以引导你找到卡尔杜。不过我提醒你，他驾驶着一艘强悍的战列舰，你单枪匹马可能难以应付。祝你好运。

messages.en: Kardour has been taken care of, as you requested.
messages.zh: 按你的要求，卡尔杜已经被干掉了。

messages.en: Excellent.
messages.zh: 太好了

This was simply a side-job taken by one of the Blood Raider commanders in Araz, Kardour Maxten. Not only that but Ader reports that rumor in the organization has it that Kardour and the other commanders have had heated exchanges about his involvement in the Manel incident.

messages.en: I'll fetch the keycard in no time.
messages.zh: 我会马上取来钥匙卡片。

messages.en: So, what next?
messages.zh: 那么，接下怎么办？

messages.en: Ader should have the key available now at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Go fetch the keycard please, it's the only way we will safely get past the acceleration gate leading into Lord Manel's Mansion.
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的阿得应该有钥匙。去那儿把钥匙卡片取来，拿到这个，我们才能安全穿越通往曼尼尔大人庄园的加速轨道。

messages.en: I have the keycard in my possession.
messages.zh: 我拿到了钥匙卡片。

messages.en: Great.  Finally this investigation is getting somewhere ...
messages.zh: 很好。调查总算有所进展了……

messages.en: Ader should have the key available now at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Go fetch the keycard please, it's the only way we will safely get past the acceleration gate leading into Lord Manel's Mansion.
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的阿得应该有钥匙。去那儿把钥匙卡片取来，拿到这个，我们才能安全穿越通往曼尼尔大人庄园的加速轨道。

messages.en: I'll do my best.
messages.zh: 我尽力吧。

messages.en: What now?
messages.zh: 这次怎么了？

messages.en: Now that we have the keycard to get into Lord Manel's Mansion, it's time for you to take over.  Infiltrate the complex and try to find any trace of Manel.  Once you do, report your findings to me.  If you find him alive, then bring him back in once piece, will you?  Uriam Kador will have my head if something happens to him.
messages.zh: 既然我们得到了进入曼尼尔大人官邸的钥匙，后面的事就交给你了。潜入该复合体，尽力寻找曼尼尔行踪的蛛丝马迹。如果有任何发现，立刻向我报告。如果你发现他还活着，那就把他安全带回，好吗？要是他有什么三长两短的话，乌拉姆·卡多尔一定会要我的命。

messages.en: Now that we have the keycard to get into Lord Manel's Mansion, it's time for you to take over.  Infiltrate the complex and try to find any trace of Manel.  Once you do, report your findings to me.  If you find him alive, then bring him back in once piece, will you?  Uriam Kador will have my head if something happens to him.
messages.zh: 既然我们已得到进入曼尼尔阁下庄园的钥匙卡片，该是你行动的时候了。进入庄园并寻找曼尼尔留下的蛛丝马迹，一有消息立刻向我报告。如果你发现阁下还活着，将他安全地带回来，好吗？如果他有什么三长两短，乌拉姆•卡多尔一定会要我的命。

name.fr: Venir à bout de la menace (1 sur 3)
name.ja: 危機的状況を緩和せよ（1/3）

messages.en: I'll start clearing the Blood Raider lines.
messages.zh: 我这就开始收拾那些血袭者。

messages.en: What happened?
messages.zh: 发生了什么事情?

messages.en:
I'll explain the situation. Some time ago, I was taking one of my weekly vacations in my resort here when we were attacked by Blood Raiders. It was during the early morning, before most of my staff arrives for work. I was quite incredulous at the time, after all I have the entire Kador fleet at my disposal. But when I ordered my security personnel to send a distress call, they noticed that all of our communications systems had been tampered with, even the backup! Someone had been going through an extreme effort to cripple us. Even the warp drives of our ships had been disabled, preventing us from leaving that way as well. This sort of operation would require extensive knowledge of our security system, which is quite disturbing.

To cut the story short, our security forces have been fighting for their lives for the past few days. Only due to the exemplary bravery of my security personnel am I still alive. The Blood Raiders have cornered us here in the last pocket of my complex, and we're slowly running out of supplies. Our ships may be bigger, but the Blood Raiders just keep on coming, and for some reason not a single squadron of Kador ships has arrived to aid us.

If you could lend us a hand, I would be eternally grateful. I realize that I could leave this area with you on your ship, but I would only do such a thing as a last resort. I want control over my Mansion back, and the scoundrels who dared attack it destroyed! Every last one of them! I'll be the laughing stock of the Kador family if I flee from such low-life criminals with my tail behind my legs. Please do this for me, {[character]player.name}, I dare not risk any more of my own men.
messages.zh:
让我原原本本地从头讲起吧，这儿有我的一个度假之所，不久前，当我在那儿度周假时，血袭者袭击了我们。那是一个清晨，我的大多数员工还没来上班。起初都不敢相信他们会挑这个时候发动攻击，因为毕竟我手上掌握有整支卡多尔舰队。后来，我命令保安人员发出警报，却发现我们的所有通讯系统都受到了干扰，甚至备用系统也未能幸免。看来有人故意要让我们这儿乱作一团，并有心要将我们一举歼灭。我们飞船上的跃迁引擎也已失效，这几乎使我们走投无路。能让我们的系统几近瘫痪，这需要对我们结构复杂的安全系统了如指掌。

简而言之，过去的几天里，我们的保安部队一直在浴血奋战。如果没有他们如此英勇的表现，恐怕我现在就不会活下来了。血袭者把我们逼到了复合体的最后一个层面，而我们就快山穷水尽，弹尽粮绝了。我们的战舰的确比较大，但是血袭者的船一艘接着一艘，似乎源源不绝，而且不知道是什么原因，没有一队卡多尔舰船前来援救我们。

如果你能帮我们，我会感激不尽的。我可以乘你的飞船离开这个地方，但这只是不得已而为之。我要重新控制我的宅第，让来袭的敌人灰飞烟灭！如果我从那样卑劣的罪犯那里夹着尾巴逃跑，那我就会成为卡多尔家族的笑柄。{[character]player.name}，请帮我，我不愿再让我自己的人冒险了。

messages.en: <font color =FFCC11>Start with destroying the weaker Blood Raider ships, and bring 10 of their tags to Lord Manel.</font>
messages.zh: <font color =FFCC11>从击毁较弱的血袭者飞船开始，把他们的10个铭牌带给曼尼尔大人。</font>

messages.en: <font color =FFCC11>Objective</font>
messages.zh: <font color =FFCC11>目标</font>

name.fr: Venir à bout de la menace (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 危機的状況を緩和せよ（2/3）

messages.en: Now it's time to take care of their cruisers and higher-echelon frigates.  That should severely cripple them and pave the way for you to take out their leaders.  Get me 5 of their tags and I'll consider the job done.
messages.zh: 现在该消灭他们的巡洋舰和高级护卫舰了。这将重创他们，也会为你去收拾他们的头目铺平道路。带他们的5个铭牌回来证明你完成了任务。

messages.en: The targets have been destroyed, as you requested, Lord Manel.
messages.zh: 曼尼尔阁下，如你所愿，目标已被消灭。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.  Now there's just the leaders left to take care of.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，不错。现在只需干掉剩下的头目就行了。

messages.en: Now it's time to take care of their cruisers and higher-echelon frigates.  That should severely cripple them and pave the way for you to take out their leaders.  Get me 5 of their tags and I'll consider the job done.
messages.zh: 现在是时候去把他们的巡洋舰和更高级别的护卫舰消灭掉了。这会重创他们，你也能更容易地收拾他们的头目。带5个他们的铭牌回来给我，这样我就相信你完成任务。

name.fr: Venir à bout de la menace (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 危機的状況を緩和せよ（3/3）

messages.en: So, what's my next assignment?
messages.zh: 那么，下一个任务是什么？

messages.en: Now the only assignment left for you to complete is taking out their leaders.  Instead of just getting their insignias, I want their heads on a platter.  This will serve as a reminder to all pirates that I am not a man to be trifled with.  Once I have two of their heads, I will relieve you of your duties.  I will also give you a message which you might want to bring to Odan Poun, if he has become concerned with my well being.  In it I will recommend that he give you a reward for a job well done.  But you won't get anything until I have those heads!
messages.zh: 你剩下的唯一任务就是收拾他们的头目了。这次我不仅要得到他们的徽章，还要你奉上他们的人头。这会让所有的海盗记住，我可不是好欺负的。带回两颗人头，这样你的任务就完成了。我还想请你带一封信给奥达恩·帕恩的信，他可能正在担心我的状况吧——我想你会乐意做这个活的。信中我会建议他给你一份酬劳以回报你出色的表现。但是要是我拿不到那些人头的话，你什么也别想得到！

messages.en: You can take these severed disgusting heads now, Governor.
messages.zh: 阁下，现在你可以拿走这些面目可憎的人头了。

messages.en: You've done a good job, {[character]player.name}.  These heads will make an excellent addition to my collection.  And when you deliver my message to Odan Poun, the rest of the Blood Raiders polluting my complex will be taken care of by the Imperial Navy.
messages.zh: 你干得不错，{[character]player.name}。  这些人头会是很不错的收藏品。  在你把我的消息带给奥达恩•帕恩时，帝国海军会将剩余的侵入我的复合体的血袭者解决掉。

messages.en: Now the only assignment left for you to complete is taking out their leaders.  Instead of just getting their insignias, I want their heads on a platter.  This will serve as a reminder to all pirates that I am not a man to be trifled with.  Once I have two of their heads, I will relieve you of your duties.  I will also give you a message which you might want to bring to Odan Poun, if he has become concerned with my well being.  In it I will recommend that he give you a reward for a job well done.  But you won't get anything until I have those heads!

messages.en: Don't worry, I'm up for it.
messages.zh: 别着急，我接受这个任务。

messages.en:
Well then, to your first assignment. One of the major guilds of Maphante, Giraka, has been a thorn in my side for quite some time. I made a deal with them a few years back which entailed that I had full rights on importing a certain commodity into Garisas. But because of my political feud with Lord Methros and Arachnan, who by the way think they have some kind of authority here when in fact Lord Manel occupies the Governor's seat, I've lost a great deal of power over the local guilds. So Giraka have decided to abandon their business relationship with me and have turned to Lord Methros instead. This of course is unacceptable, Garisas is mine and I won't have that sniveling fool Methros poking his nose where it doesn't belong.

I want to teach Giraka a lesson. That will also send a message to the rest of the guilds that I'm not to be trifled with. But I'm afraid that my own forces are simply not adequate to take on Giraka, and I'd rather not get Lord Manel involved in this dispute. He has enough on his mind already, what with Methros and Arachnan fighting over Araz as if it were their own.

Your first task is to assault a supply station that Giraka owns, in Garisas. They are expecting a shipment of this commodity I told you about, and I want their transport vessels destroyed. The only problem is that the convoy carrying the goods has an escort, and the supply station has a sizable security force as well. So I would suggest that you take care of the guards at the supply station before the convoy arrives. I estimate that the convoy will arrive soon, so I suggest you hurry and take care of those guards right now. Then wait for the convoy to show up and finish your business there. Report to me when your task has been accomplish.
messages.zh:
好吧，注意听你的第一个任务。玛凡特的主要行会之一吉拉卡斯一直是我心头的一根刺。几年前我和他们达成协定，由我垄断对咖利萨斯某些“日用品”的进口权。但是梅多尔斯大人和埃拉克兰大人一直与我政见不和，他们认为自己有权在此指手画脚，而实际上曼尼尔阁下才是这儿真正的统治者。为此我在当地行会失去了很多权力，吉拉卡斯也决定与我断绝贸易关系，转投梅多尔斯。我不能容忍这种事情，咖利萨斯是我的！决不能让梅多尔斯这个蠢货涉足我的地盘。

我得教训一下吉拉卡斯，同时也要警告其他行会，我可不是那么容易对付的。问题是我怕自己的力量不足以对付吉拉卡斯，但又不想让曼尼尔阁下卷入这场风波。为了与梅多尔斯和埃拉克兰在埃拉茨抗衡，他已经够忙了。

你的第一个任务是攻击吉拉卡斯在咖利萨斯的补给站。他们正在等一批货，就是先前我垄断经营的其中一种。把他们的运输舰给我彻底摧毁。还有个小小的问题，装载物品的舰船有护卫队护航，而且能源站也有一支庞大的保安队伍。建议你在护送队到达能源站之前把那里的守卫干掉。我估计护航队会很快抵达，你必须迅速行动。完成任务后，回来向我报告。

messages.en: I'm looking for some work.
messages.zh: 我想找些活干。

messages.en: Not bad, not bad.  I didn't expect you to make it out of there alive, {[character]player.name}, much less complete the assignment.  But you proved me wrong.
messages.zh: 干得不坏，干得不坏。我没想到你能活着离开那里，{[character]player.name}，更不用说完成任务了。不过你证明了我是错的。

messages.en: Yes, I have some work.  But it's pretty risky, and involves fighting some pretty nasty mercenaries.  If you think it's over your head, then back out now.
messages.zh: 是的，我手中有些工作。但很危险，得要与恶心的雇佣兵战斗。如果你觉得自己干不了，那么立刻给我离开。

messages.en:
After your last mission, you should have realized by now what I meant by 'the commodity' which me and Giraka have been disputing over. With the convoy destroyed, this gives me an excellent opportunity to get an edge over Giraka on the black market.

The client that was expecting the shipment of drugs by Giraka has in fact come to me to get his fix. He now wants 5 units of crash, which I have managed to acquire in Chanoun. The problem is delivering the crash here, those customs officials at the gate can be quite nasty when it comes to drug transports. I would suggest that you use a fairly cheap ship to get the job done, just incase the gate officials get trigger happy.

Make it here on time and you'll even get a bonus.
messages.zh:
上个任务之后，你应该已经知道令我与吉拉卡斯发生争执的“商品”的真正含义了吧。那支护航队被摧毁后，我获得了在黑市上超越吉拉卡斯的绝佳机会。

那位苦等吉拉卡斯违规药品的客户已经转而向我发出了订单。他现在要5个单位的克拉什兴奋剂，这些我已经从查浓搞到了。问题是如何把违规药品运到这里，那些星门的海关官员只要碰到违规药品运输的勾当就会变得非常讨厌。我建议你驾驶一艘廉价飞船来完成这项任务，以防那些星门海关想过过扣扳机的瘾。

准时把东西带来，我还会给你一笔额外的奖励。

messages.en: I have the crash as you requested, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我拿到克拉什兴奋剂了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Nice work.  This will make my client very happy indeed, if it doesn't kill him heh heh.  But there's more to be done ...
messages.zh: 干得不错。呵呵，我的客户一定乐坏了，希望他别吸食过量而一命呜呼，呵呵。不过还有许多事情要去做……

messages.en: Apparently Giraka's council have become furious at the destruction of the Blood Raider convoy that they were expecting.  They know I was behind it, which leads me to believe we have a traitor in our midst.  But two can play that game, heh heh.  I have my own insiders in Giraka's compounds in Port Maphante, and they inform me that Giraka are planning a strike against my astrofarm plantation in retaliation for the drug convoy incident.  I expect their strike force to be split into waves, which is their general tactic.  But this gives you an excellent opportunity to prevent them from ganging up on you.  Destroy the first waves fast enough and you should have no problems.  But be wary of the mercenary overlord, he's no small fish to fry.
messages.zh: 显然，吉拉卡斯委员会在得知他们等待的血袭者护航队被歼之后怒不可遏。他们居然知道了我是幕后主谋，所以我想我们中间一定有叛徒。不过，他们有一手，我也有一手，呵呵。我在玛凡特港的吉拉卡斯复合体里也安插了自己的内线。他们告诉我吉拉卡斯正计划对我的宇宙农场种植园发动袭击，以报复违规药品护航队事件。我想他们的攻击部队一定会分成好几波，这是他们一贯的伎俩。不过这正是个绝好的机会，你可以利用这点防止被他们围攻。只要能快速摧毁第一波攻击，取胜就不是什么问题了。但是千万留神雇佣兵大帝，他可不是等闲之辈。

messages.en: Great work, {[character]player.name}, workers at the astro farm inform me that there were no casualties and the structures are still intact.
messages.zh: 做得好，{[character]player.name}，宇宙农场那边没有任何建筑损毁和人员伤亡。
