messages.en:
With the increasing hostilities between Garika and myself I've had to increase the number of personnel in my security forces considerably. It's costing me a fortune by the way. The problem is we are running kind of low on arms for the ground forces, because it so happens that the merchant guilds control most of the small arms trade here in Garisas and Garika has made it very hard for me to find a willing supplier.

But that got me thinking, why settle for standard small arms when I can have something much more effective? Something that will give my ground troops an edge if my enemies here decide to strike at my quarters within Maphante. It so happens that I know exactly where to find such high-tech weaponry. An agent of the Blood Raiders, which I have had extensive dealings with, informed me of a stash of elite laser-pistols which is hidden somewhere in the Mire Keep complex in Garisas, probably within the Grey Barracks. It's being guarded by powerful Blood Raider ships, and will be quite difficult to approach. Bring a few units of those pistols to me and I will reward you generously.
messages.zh:
随着我与吉拉卡斯之间的对抗日益加剧，我不得不大大扩充保安部队的编制。这可花了我一大笔钱。问题是我们的陆军缺少武器，这是因为商会控制着咖利萨斯的大部分小型军械交易，吉拉卡斯便利用这个优势，使那些供应商都不愿跟我合作。

这就让我陷入了沉思，为什么要满足于一些标准的小型武器，而不是使用一些可以获得的威力更大的东西呢？如果我有那些厉害的武器，那么当敌人袭击我在玛凡特的营地时，我的陆军将占有不小的优势。我刚好知道哪里能弄到这种高科技武器。一个与我有广泛生意合作的血袭者代理人告诉我，在咖利萨斯泥沼要塞复合体深处的某个地方藏有一批精品激光手枪，很可能就在灰色兵营内。那里有火力强大的血袭者舰船守卫，很难接近。去给我带回一些那样的手枪，我会给你丰厚的报酬。

messages.en: I have the elite laser pistols that you requested.  Here you go.
messages.zh: 我带来了你要的精英激光手枪。拿着。

messages.en:
Since you've been so helpful to me I'll let you have something that will earn you plenty of favor points with the Governor of Araz. Well, as long as he's still alive anyway. One of my agents working inside the Governor's Audience Chamber in Chanoun overheard a conversation between Nossa Farad and some other individual. He took the liberty of recording this conversation. It should offer evidence enough that Nossa Farad is planning an assassination attempt against Lord Manel.

I haven't been able to locate Manel, but if you can then give him this message. It will explain everything.
messages.zh:
既然你对我帮助这么大，那么我会给你些事情做，使你得到埃拉茨统治者的大大欣赏。无论如何，只要他还活着，他就会记得你的好。我有个特工在查浓的统治者接见室工作，他偶然听到诺莎·法拉特与某个人的对话。他冒昧地把这段对话录了下来。这可以提供充足的证据，表明诺莎·法拉特正在筹划行刺曼尼尔大人。

我还没能找到曼尼尔，但是如果你能找到他，就把这条消息告诉他。它会说明一切。

messages.en: One minute, let me find it in my cargo hold... [Do not accept this mission if you have not spoken with Bartezo Maphante in Garisas already.]
messages.zh: 给我一分钟，让我在我的货柜舱中找找……[如果你还没有跟咖利萨斯的巴特祖·玛凡特交谈过，那就不要接受这个任务。]

messages.en: I don't have all day ...
messages.zh: 我可没那么空……

messages.en: I have this message from Bartezo Maphante ...
messages.zh: 我从巴特祖•玛凡特那里得到这个消息……

messages.en: Bring Bartezo's message to Lord Manel.  Bartezo is located in Port Maphante in Garisas.
messages.zh: 把巴特祖的消息带给曼尼尔大人。巴特祖在咖利萨斯的玛凡特港。

messages.en: Here you go.
messages.zh: 拿着。

messages.en:
Incredible! I knew Nossa disliked me, but I never thought she'd go this far. The only reason I haven't sacked her is due to the political ramifications, since she is closely related to Moranour Kom. With this evidence, I will be able to take care of Nossa Farad for good. She will lose her position in the Kador family, get thrown in jail, and possibly even be made a slave. Delightful, no?!!

I'm very grateful for your help, {[character]player.name}, and I hope you can make good use of your reward. Take care.
messages.zh:
真难以置信！我知道诺莎不喜欢我，可我从没想过她会做得这么过分。我没有解雇她的唯一原因是担心政治后果，因为她与莫兰诺·克姆关系密切。有了这个证据，我就可以永远解决诺莎·法拉特了。她会失去在卡多尔家族的地位，投入牢狱，甚至可能成为劳工。可喜可贺，不是吗？！！

我很感激你的帮助，{[character]player.name}，希望你能好好利用你的酬金。保重。

messages.en: Message? I don't know what you're talking about.
messages.zh: 消息？我不知道你在说什么。

messages.en: Well, then, quit wasting my time.
messages.zh: 好吧，那么就别浪费我时间了。

messages.en:
I hear you may be offering a message from Bartezo Maphante...

[Do not accept this mission if you have not already spoken with Bartezo Maphante, in Port Maphante in Garisas.]
messages.zh:
我听说你给巴特祖·玛凡特通风报信了……

【如果你还没和位于咖利萨斯的玛凡特港的巴特祖·玛凡特交谈过，就不要接受这个任务。】

name.es: Hojas de datos para Lai Dai
name.ja: ライダイ宛てのデータシート
name.ru: Данные для Lai Dai (Data Sheets for Lai Dai)

messages.en: Lai Dai Corporation has requested a batch of data sheets for their researchers on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Deliver them on time and you'll be rewarded with a bonus.
messages.zh: 莱戴集团在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的研究员们需要一组数据单。准时送去，我会给你额外的奖金。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You can continue working for various corporations in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} as long as you like. I suggest finding an agent that has a more variety of tasks available, simply search the stations that are owned by a corporation within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} and you are bound to find an agent to your liking. You can also search for agents which will speak to you by checking the database information for the corporation of your choice. To do that simply open the People and Places menu through your NeoCom and search for the corporation name. Right click on it and choose 'show info'. There you should find a list of all of its agents that are available. Their division should give you a hint as to what type of mission they are associated with.

Take care!
messages.zh:
干得不错，{[character]player.name}。只要你愿意，你就可以继续为{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的集团工作。我建议你寻找一个可以提供更多种类任务的代理人，只需搜索{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}下任一集团的空间站，你就一定能找到一个符合你兴趣的代理人。你也可以查看你所选集团的数据库信息，从而找到愿意和你交谈的代理人。要这样做，你只需打开控制边栏上的“人物和地点”菜单并搜索集团名称。右键单击搜索结果，然后选择“显示信息”。然后你应该可以看到该集团下所有对你开放的代理人的名单。根据他们的所属部门，你应该可以了解他们所从事任务的类型。

保重！

messages.en: Zainou has requested a batch of silicon for their production facility in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  Deliver the goods there on time and you'll be eligible for a bonus reward.
messages.zh: 载诺集团在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的产品制造工厂需要一批硅。去把这些物品按时送到那里，你会得到额外的一份奖赏。

messages.en: The security forces in New Caldari are in constant need of extra planetary vehicles, and we are the main distributer of these vehicles. They have a commander coming in who demands a brand new vehicle whenever he arrives, though, so if you're free then I'd like you to take this unit and transport it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh: 新卡达利星系的保安部队不断要求得到更多的大气内穿梭机，而我们正是这类交通工具的主要供应商。如果你有空的话，我希望你能将其中的一批运送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You can continue working for various corporations in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} as long as you like. I suggest finding an agent who has a more of a variety of tasks available; simply search the stations that are owned by a corporation within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} and you are bound to find an agent to your liking.

You can also search for available agents by checking the database information for the corporation of your choice. To do that, simply open the "People and Places" menu through your NeoCom and search for the corporation name. Right-click on it and choose "show info." There, you should find a list of all of that corporation's agents who are available to you. An agent's division should give you a hint as to what type of mission he or she is likely to give you.

Take care!

你也可以查看你所选集团的数据库信息来搜索对你开放的代理人。要这样做，你只需打开控制边栏上的“人物和地点”菜单并搜索集团名称。右键单击搜索结果，然后选择“显示信息”。然后你应该可以看到该集团下所有对你开放的代理人。了解代理人所属的部门可以告诉你这个代理人会给你什么类型的任务。

保重！

messages.en: The security forces in New Caldari are in constant need of extra planetary vehicles, and we are the main distributer of these vehicles. They have a commander coming in who demands a brand new vehicle whenever he arrives, though, so if you're free then I'd like you to take this unit and transport it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh: 新卡达利星系的保安部队不断要求得到更多的大气内穿梭机，而我们正是这类交通工具的主要供应商。如果你有空的话，我希望你能将其中的一批运送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。

messages.en: Thanks for the help, {[character]player.name}.  I suggest you speak with Jeka Vantoh on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}: She needs someone for a job you might be interested in.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。我建议你与{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的吉卡•凡多谈一下。她要找人办点事情，也许你会感兴趣的。

name.ja: 海軍のロボティックス
name.ru: Роботехника для флота (Robotics For The Navy)

messages.en: We have a trade agreement with the Caldari Navy, where they request a large amount of robotics each day from our factory here in Airkio to supply their assembly plant in Maurasi.  If you would be so kind, you could make a delivery of robotics for us in exchange for {[numeric]rewardQuantity} ISK as well as a bonus if you're fast.  You'll find all the info you need in the mission details in your Opportunities interface.
messages.zh: 我们和加达里海军签订了贸易协定，他们每天从埃尔克伊欧的工厂订购大量机器人，来补给玛乌纳斯装配工厂。如果你能好心运送一下机器人，我们会支付{[numeric]rewardQuantity}星币，如果任务完成得够快，还有额外奖励。你可以在“机遇”界面的任务详情中查看所有相关信息。

messages.en: Thanks for the help, {[character]player.name}.  Before you run off though, I suggest you speak with Jeka Vantoh at the Chief Executive Panel Bureau in New Caldari.  Apparently she's looking for a hand with something.  Until next time!
messages.zh: 感谢你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。不过在你离开之前，我建议你找吉卡•凡多谈一下，她在新加达里的CEO合作组织办公署工作。很明显，她要找人帮忙做些什么事。后会有期！

name.ru: Антибиотики для флота (Antibiotics for the Navy)

messages.en: We just finished producing a batch of antibiotics that I want you to deliver to the Caldari Navy station in Maurasi.  Do this quickly enough and I'll even reward you with a bonus.
messages.zh: 我们刚完成了一批抗生素的生产，我希望你将它们运送到玛乌纳斯的加达里海军空间站。你动作够快的话，我可能还会给你一笔额外的奖金。

messages.en: Thanks for the help, {[character]player.name}. Before you run off, though, I suggest you speak with Jeka Vantoh at the Chief Executive Panel Bureau in New Caldari. Apparently she's looking for a hand with something. Until next time!
messages.zh: 感谢你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。在你离开之前，我建议你找吉卡•凡多谈一下，她在新加达里的CEO合作组织办公署工作。很明显，她要找人帮忙做些什么事。后会有期！

messages.en: We just finished producing a batch of antibiotics that I want you to deliver to the Caldari Navy station in Maurasi.  Do this quickly enough and I'll even reward you with a bonus.  Sound good?
messages.zh: 我们刚完成了一批抗生素的生产，我希望你将它们运送到玛乌纳斯的加达里海军空间站。你动作够快的话，我可能还会给你一笔额外的奖金。听起来不错吧？

messages.en: Kaalakiota Corporation has promised us some construction blocks for the extension we're building to the CEP station here in New Caldari. I've been on the lookout for people willing to make the deliveries for us, and you seem to fit the profile. If you're faster than the last guy who made the run, I'll even give you a bonus. Deal?
messages.zh: 卡拉吉塔集团已经答应为我们在新加达里建造的CEP空间站的扩展部分提供一些建筑材料。我正在寻找愿意为我们运这批货的人，看起来你符合我们的要求。如果你比上个跑腿的家伙快的话，我甚至可以给你额外的奖金。成交吗？

messages.en: Now that that's taken care of, there's something else I'd like you to do for me. Just give me a minute here, would you?
messages.zh: 既然建筑模块已经送到，那我还有一个新任务给你，先别离开。

messages.en: Kaalakiota Corporation has promised us some construction blocks for the extension we're building to the CEP station here in New Caldari. I've been on the lookout for people willing to make the deliveries for us, and you seem to fit the profile. If you're faster than the last guy who made the run, I'll even give you a bonus. Deal?
messages.zh: 卡拉吉塔集团已经答应为我们在新加达里建造的CEP空间站的扩展部分提供一些建筑材料。我正在寻找愿意为我们运这批货的人，看起来你符合我们的要求。如果你比上个跑腿的家伙快的话，我甚至可以给你额外的奖金。成交吗？

messages.en: Kaalakiota requires a progress report on our work here every now and then. I think you're the right man for this job as well. And remember, if you're fast, then you get a bonus.
messages.zh: 卡拉吉塔常常需要我们报告工作进展。我觉得你也是这份工作的合适人选。记住，如果你速度够快，可以得到额外的报酬。

messages.en: Good work. By the way, could you pay Onmi Mara a visit? I believe she's looking for a freelancer like yourself to do a quick courier job. Right, good day.
messages.zh: 干得好。顺便问一下，你能去奥米•玛哈那里看看么？我相信她正在寻找像你这样的自由工作者来完成一个快递任务。就这样，祝你愉快。

messages.en: A couple of our personnel here in Nonni require a lift.  They need to be at {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} for a meeting at the Mercantile Club.  Please, don't be late!
messages.zh: 我们在诺恩尼这儿有几个职员需要搭个便车。他们要到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}参加商业俱乐部的一个会议。可不能迟到了！

messages.en: Talk to Yrmek Penola at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} if you haven't already.  I think he's in need of a hand.
messages.zh: 如果你还没有跟{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的亚梅克•佩诺拉谈过话，就去找他聊聊吧。我想他正需要帮助。

messages.en: I'll take it.
messages.zh: 我接受任务。

messages.en: Hey, you're an Amarr aren't you?  What brings you to these parts.
messages.zh: 嗨，你是艾玛人，是吗？什么风把你吹到这儿来了？

messages.en: Bring some tobacco to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, the State And Region Bank employees will pick up the shipment from your hangar there once it has been delivered.
messages.zh: 请将一些烟草送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，国家星域银行的员工会从你的机库里接收这些货物。

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}.  Now I suggest you speak with my colleague, Irsen Alaja, at the Mercantile Club Bureau in Kaimon.  He has more work for you.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。我建议你和我的同事伊赫森•阿拉瑕谈一下，他在凯蒙的商业俱乐部办公室。他那儿有更多的工作给你干。

messages.en: Sorry, but I don't like Amarrians.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我不喜欢艾玛人。

messages.en: What!?  How dare you ...  I'll ... I'll ... I'll demand your CEO send me an apology!  Yes that's what I'll do.  You better get ready for a demotion, because he won't like what I've got to say about you ...
messages.zh: 什么！？你竟敢……我将会……我将会……我会让你们的CEO向我道歉！是的，我会这么做的。你最好做好降级的准备，他肯定不会喜欢我对你的评价……

messages.en:
So? Are you perhaps offended by the fact that I'm not Caldari? We are allies you know, no need to be rude. I'm just working here as a contractor for Mercantile Club.

Anyway, I need some tobacco transported to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}. Some State And Region Bank executives requested them, and they made a point in requesting them delivered ASAP. So hurry up with your answer, will you. Yes or no?
messages.zh:
嗯？我不是加达里人，难道会让你感到不舒服？要知道我们是同盟，没必要对我那么无礼吧。我在这里工作，是商业俱乐部的承包人。

不管怎样，我需要你将一些烟草送到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}。一些国家星域银行的管理人员需要这些东西，他们希望我们尽快将烟草送到。别磨蹭了，快回答我，好吗？接受还是不接受？

messages.en: I'd like you to move a few tourists to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  They are stopping by the entertainment facility at the Nugoeihuvi Development Studio.  It's quite popular with the locals, and we're always open to cheaper labor than the horribly expensive standard transportation services here.
messages.zh: 我希望你将一些游客送到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}。他们打算去纳基维发展工作室的娱乐设施处游玩。为节省成本，我们通常不用昂贵的标准运输服务，而雇佣低廉的当地劳动力为我们运送客户。

messages.en: Thanks for the help, {[character]player.name}.  I suggest you speak with Enanato Imeri at {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, she's been looking for someone with your enthusiasm to work for the State.
messages.zh: 多谢你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。我建议你与{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的艾娜娜托•伊梅进行交谈，她正在寻找像你这样有热情的人来为加达里合众国工作。

name.ru: От разработки к изданию (From Development To Publishing)

messages.en: I'd like you to move a stack of holoreels to our publisher in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  Take care not to lose the cargo, the holoreels contain thousands of hours' worth of video data!
messages.zh: 我要你把这堆全息记忆盘送到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}我们的出版商那里。  小心不要把货物弄丢了，这些全息记忆盘包含了数千小时的数据资料！

messages.en: I know that a colleague of mine, Hann Najus, is looking for work, so I suggest you pay him a visit in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.
messages.zh: 我知道我的一个同事韩•娜尤斯正缺少人手，因此我建议你去拜访他一下，他在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}。

name.de: Um Silicate Glass herzustellen braucht man...
name.en: To Create Silicate Glass You Need ....
name.es: Para crear vidrio de silicato hace falta...
name.fr: Pour créer du verre de silice, il faut...
name.ru: Чтобы сделать силикатное стекло, необходимо... (To Create Silicate Glass You Need ....)

messages.en: I have a job for you, {[character]player.name}.  Demand for silicon is getting out of hand, and our convoys can't keep up.  Could you help them out by transporting this batch of silicon to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}?  It would be much appreciated.
messages.zh: 我有一个任务给你，{[character]player.name}。最近我们需要大量的硅，护送队已分身乏术。你能帮他们把这批硅送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}吗？对此我将不胜感激。

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}.  I know Samora Miven, at the station you transported the silicon to, has some work to offer, you might want to pay her office a visit.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。我听说萨莫哈•米凡有一些工作提供给你，她就在目的地的空间站里，你可以去她的办公室一次。

messages.en: The Caldari Navy has requested more ammo, and we're looking for someone to make the run for us.  Take this batch of hybrid-charges to the Navy assembly station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and I'll give you a reward.
messages.zh: 加达里海军需要更多的弹药，我们正要找一个人来替我们跑一趟。把这批混合型弹药送往{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的海军集合站，我会给你报酬。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You can continue working for various corporations in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} as long as you like. I suggest finding an agent that has a more variety of tasks available, simply search the stations that are owned by a corporation within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} and you are bound to find an agent to your liking. You can also search for agents which will speak to you by checking the database information for the corporation of your choice. To do that simply open the People and Places menu through your NeoCom and search for the corporation name. Right click on it and choose 'show info'. There you should find a list of all of its agents that are available. Their division should give you a hint as to what type of mission they are associated with.

Take care!
messages.zh:
干得不错，{[character]player.name}。只要你愿意，你就可以继续为{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的集团工作。我建议你寻找一个可以提供更多种类任务的代理人，只需搜索{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}下任一集团的空间站，你就一定能找到一个符合你兴趣的代理人。你也可以查看你所选集团的数据库信息，从而找到愿意和你交谈的代理人。要这样做，你只需打开控制边栏上的“人物和地点”菜单并搜索集团名称。右键单击搜索结果，然后选择“显示信息”。然后你应该可以看到该集团下所有对你开放的代理人的名单。根据他们的所属部门，你应该可以了解他们所从事任务的类型。

保重！

name.es: Huevas de yorak de Nidupad (2 de 2)
name.ja: ニドゥパディアンヨラクの卵（2/2）
name.ru: Яйца Nidupadian Yorak (Nidupadian Yorak Eggs) (2 из 2)

messages.en: I would be honoured to carry out such a vital task for the Empire.
messages.zh: 能为帝国执行那样重要的任务我深感荣幸。

messages.en: Your assistance is greatly appreciated in serving the Emperor and his family.
messages.zh: 对于你向帝国及其皇室提供的帮助，我感激不尽。

messages.en:
Although you managed to prevent more Eggs from falling into the hands of the Blood Raiders, we currently do not have enough supplies to cope with the royal household's demands. Therefore i need you to collect me some more. 

I have already located a sufficiant supply from a neighbouring constellation. 

Be quick we do not have much time before the Emperor's Household runs out of their most valued delight.
messages.zh: 尽管你从血袭者的手中夺回了大量鱼卵，但我们仍然无法满足皇室的需求。因此我需要你再去帮我收集一些。 我已在附近的星座中找到了足够的货源。 时间不多了，快点帮我取来，否则皇室成员马上就没法享用这珍馐佳肴了。

messages.en: I have delivered the vital shipment of Eggs to ensure a constant supply for the Emperor and his family.
messages.zh: 我已送来了你要的东西，这下你就有充足的鲉鲈卵供给皇室了。

messages.en: Your services are duly noted and appreciated. Take pride in knowing that you have carried out an important duty to the Empire.
messages.zh: 我们会适时观察并评价你的服务。你为帝国完成了一项重要任务，你应该自豪。

messages.en:
Your services are duly noted and appreciated. Take pride in knowing that you have carried out an important duty to the Empire. 

Don't go anywhere i have another important mission that i need you to assist me with.
messages.zh: 我们会适时观察并评价你的服务。你为帝国完成了一项重要任务，你应该自豪。不要走开，我还有另一个重要任务需要你的协助。

messages.en: I am far to busy to haul junk food to those lazy royals.
messages.zh: 我忙得很，没有工夫给那些懒惰的皇族运送垃圾食品。

messages.en: I am ashamed to know you. You may very well have damaged the constant supply line of Yorak Eggs to the royal family. For that i can never forgive you.
messages.zh: 认识你是我的耻辱。你很可能破坏了我们一直用以为皇室供应鲉鲈卵的补给线路。我永远不会原谅你。

messages.en: I have a mission of great importance to the Empire, can you assist me?
messages.zh: 我有一个对帝国来说至关重要的任务，你能帮助我吗？

messages.en: I cannot wait anymore on you. I have lost faith in you, you are no longer as reliable as i once believed.
messages.zh: 我不能再等下去了。我对你已经失去信心，你不再像我曾经以为的那么可靠了。

messages.en: I can't be bothered anymore, these eggs are really starting to smell out my ship.
messages.zh: 烦死我了，这些尼都帕德鲉鲈卵已经开始在我船里发臭。

messages.en: I am ashamed to know you. You may very well have damaged the constant supply line of Yorak Eggs to the royal family. For that i can never forgive you.
messages.zh: 认识你太丢脸了！你完全破坏了我们一直以来对皇室尼都帕德鲉鲈卵的供给。我永远不会原谅你！

messages.en:
I am ashamed to know you. You may very well have damaged the constant supply line of Yorak Eggs to the royal family. For that I can never forgive you.

P.S Those Eggs will have already started to go bad. If you still have them on you I suggest you don't open them as you may not recover from the exposure to the toxins they produce (although that might not be a bad thing).
messages.zh:
认识你这种人是我的耻辱。你很可能破坏了我们一直用以为皇室供应鲉鲈卵的补给线路。我永远不会原谅你。

顺便说一句，那些鱼卵可能已经发臭了。如果你船舱里还有存货，建议你别打开，腐败产生的毒素会把你毒死的（虽然这也不是什么坏事）。

messages.en: You took to long to deliver the Eggs, the supply line to the royal family has been disturbed. My head may very well be on the line.
messages.zh: 递送鱼卵这件事情你耽搁得太久了，这使得我们对皇室的补给线路受到了干扰。这下，我可命悬一线了。

name.es: Huevas de yorak de Nidupad (1 de 2)
name.ja: ニドゥパディアンヨラクの卵（1/2）
name.ru: Яйца Nidupadian Yorak (Nidupadian Yorak Eggs)(1 из 2)

messages.en: I would be honoured to carry out such a vital task for the Empire.
messages.zh: 能为帝国执行那样重要的任务我深感荣幸。

messages.en: Your assistance is greatly appreciated in serving the Emperor and his family.
messages.zh: 对于你向帝国及其皇室提供的帮助，我感激不尽。

messages.en:
What an outrage!

The Emperor's House requires the finest delicacies from around the region to be delivered to its local office for the royal lineage to feast upon. As their humble servents we are tasked with the timely delivery of Nidupadian Yorak Eggs from this system.

Those blasted Blood Raiders have attacked our main processing plant in this system, we believe that there are still some Blood Raider pirates in the vacinity of the plant lead by a skilled mercenary called 'Keron Vandafelt' who is looking for left over Eggs and killing incomming vessels unaware of the recent attack.

These pirates must be eliminated once and for all. I am sending you the co-ordinates to the attack site now. I want Keron's head on my desk before the end of the day!
messages.zh:
实在欺人太甚！

照皇室的要求，整个星域的美食珍馐应定期送到当地行宫以供皇室成员享用。 作为他们粗鄙的奴仆，我们的职责就是及时将这个星系的尼都帕德鲉鲈卵运送过去。

那些遭天谴的血袭者竟然攻击了我们在这个星系的主要加工厂，而且现在仍有一些海盗留在工厂周围。他们的首领“遒隆•范德菲特”是个技术高超的雇佣兵，他在那儿四处搜寻遗留的尼都帕德鲉鲈卵，并且摧毁因尚未得知工厂遇袭消息而仍旧前往那里的舰只。

这些海盗必须被彻底铲除，一个不留。我现在就给你袭击地点的坐标。今天之内我要看到遒隆的人头放在我桌上！

messages.en: I can't be bothered anymore, these eggs are really starting to smell out my ship.
messages.zh: 烦死我了，这些尼都帕德鲉鲈卵已经开始在我船里发臭。

messages.en: Your services are duly noted and appreciated. Take pride in knowing that you have carried out an important duty to the Empire. Don't go anywhere i have another important mission that i need you to assist me with.
messages.zh: 我们会适时观察并评价你的服务。你为帝国完成了一项重要任务，你应该自豪。不要走开，我还有另一个重要任务需要你的协助。

messages.en: I am far to busy to haul junk food to those lazy royals.
messages.zh: 我忙得很，没有工夫给那些懒惰的皇族运送垃圾食品。

messages.en: I am ashamed to know you. You may very well have damaged the constant supply line of Yorak Eggs to the royal family. For that i can never forgive you.
messages.zh: 认识你太丢脸了！你完全破坏了我们一直以来对皇室尼都帕德鲉鲈卵的供给。我永远不会原谅你！

Those blasted Blood Raiders have attacked our main processing plant in this system, we believe that there are still some Blood Raider pirates in the vacinity of the plant lead by a skilled mercenary called 'Keron Vandafelt' who is looking for left over Eggs and killing incomming vessels unaware of the recent attack.

那些遭天谴的血袭者竟然攻击了我们在这个星系的主要加工厂，而且现在仍有一些海盗留在工厂周围。他们的首领“遒隆•范德菲特”是个技术高超的雇佣兵，他在那儿四处搜寻遗留的尼都帕德鲉鲈卵，并且摧毁因尚未得知工厂遇袭消息而仍旧前往那里的舰只。

这些海盗必须被彻底铲除，一个不留。我现在就给你袭击地点的坐标。今天之内我要看到遒隆的人头放在我桌上！

messages.en: I can' no longer wait for your decision. I have lost faith in you, you are no longer as reliable as i once believed.
messages.zh: 我不能再等你的决定了。我对你已经失去信心，你不再像我曾经以为的那么可靠了。

messages.en: Those royals can go without those pesky eggs, i've had enough.
messages.zh: 皇室非得吃这些鱼籽么！我受够了。

messages.en: Gah! those blasted pirates are still running rampant throughout the complex. There is no way we can re-establish supplies before the royal family runs out of Yorak Eggs.
messages.zh: 啊！那些该死的海盗还在复合体内四处活动。我们根本没法在皇室吃光尼都帕德鲉鲈卵之前，为他们重建补给线。

messages.en: You Failed Me. For that i cannot forgive.
messages.zh: 你辜负了我。我绝不会原谅你的。

name.ru: Пополнение фронтовых частей (Manning The Front Lines)

messages.en: Our generals in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} have requested an enormous amount of ground troops in preparation for a possible encounter with the Caldari Navy.  They're basically bolstering the front lines in case of an attack, and Unel seems to be one of the weak points in our defensive perimeter.  Would you be so kind as to transport some of these troops to their destination?  You'll be rewarded of course.
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的将军们要求准备大批地面部队，准备与加达里海军的进行遭遇战。一旦受到攻击，这些部队就能在前方筑起一道坚固的防线，而尤尼尔似乎是我们防线上最弱的一点。你愿意送一批部队到那儿去吗？当然，你会得到报酬。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  I suggest you speak with Ansa Vanonari, she's an agent of Chemal Tech which might have some work for you.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，干得漂亮！我建议你去和安萨•维诺娜莉谈谈，她是切玛科技公司的代理人，也许会有工作给你。

messages.en: {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} has requested another batch of silicon, to be used in the manufacturing process at their factory.  If you would deliver this shipment to them, I would be very grateful.
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}需要另一批硅来投入工厂的生产工作。如果你能送这批货给他们，我将感激不尽。

messages.en: You've certainly earned your reward, {[character]player.name}.  Now I suggest you speak with Ihanani Oksen, she might have something to offer you that's worth your time.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，那是你应得的报酬。建议你现在去和伊哈娜妮•欧科森谈谈，她也许会有些不错的工作给你。

messages.en: I'm interested.
messages.zh: 我很感兴趣。

messages.en:
With political relations between the Ammatar and the Minmatar Republic quickly deteriorating, things look dire for our citizens across the border. There are thousands of Nefantar inhabitants stuck in the Tartatven constellation, some who are working there on official business, others who simply settled there years ago. The Republic government refuses to let the majority of them leave their sovereign space and, in fact, has many under constant surveillance.

We fear that their lives may be at risk should the Ammatar declare war on the Republic and invade Audesder. There's already a huge buildup of military forces here in Kenobanala, and many fear that war is inevitable. So it's my task to ensure the safe return of as many Nefantar to Ammatar space as possible.

What I need you to do is deliver a group of Nefantar refugees from {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} to Fort Kumar. I will then relocate them to one of our settlements in Joas.

May God light your path.
messages.zh:
随着艾玛达和米玛塔尔共和国的政治关系快速恶化，穿越边界对于我们的人民而言已经变得很可怕了。在塔达文星座生活着数以千计的内凡达居民，其中一部分人在此工作，一部分人定居在这儿。共和国政府不允许这些人离开其管辖空间，很多人还受到了监视。

如果艾玛达对共和国宣战，然后侵入奥德斯代尔，恐怕这群无辜平民的生命将会危在旦夕。事实上，艾玛达在科诺巴纳拉已有大批驻军，战争阴云密布。我得尽快将内凡达人安全转移到艾玛达境内。

我需要你做的是将一群来自{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}的内凡达难民送到库马尔要塞。然后我会重新安排他们到我们在乔斯的一个居住地。

愿神与你同在。

messages.en: You have done well, {[character]player.name}. But our task is not finished. There are still thousands of Nefantars that need to be moved. If you have more time on your hands, I'd like you to make a few more runs to Aedald for me.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。但是我的任务还没有完成。仍有数以千计的内凡达人需要转移。若你正好还有时间，请你再帮我跑几趟埃伊达特吧。

messages.en:
With political relations between the Ammatar and the Minmatar Republic quickly deteriorating, things look dire for our citizens across the border. There are thousands of Nefantar inhabitants stuck in the Tartatven constellation, some who are working there on official business, others who simply settled there years ago. The Republic government refuses to let the majority of them leave their sovereign space and, in fact, has many under constant surveillance.

We fear that their lives may be at risk should the Ammatar declare war on the Republic and invade Audesder. There's already a huge buildup of military forces here in Kenobanala, and many fear that war is inevitable. So it's my task to ensure the safe return of as many Nefantar to Ammatar space as possible.

What I need you to do is deliver a group of Nefantar refugees from {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} to Fort Kumar. I will then relocate them to one of our settlements in Joas.

May God light your path.

messages.en: Duvolle Laboratories is building an extension to its research laboratory in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, and purchased a crap-load of construction blocks from our warehouse. If you would be so kind, can you transport some of these blocks to the station? You'll find all the details you need in the mission details in your Opportunities interface.
messages.zh: 度沃勒实验室正在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}扩建研究实验室，并向我们的库房采购了大量建材。你能帮忙把它们运到空间站吗？你可以在“机遇”界面的任务详情中查看所有相关信息。

messages.en: Nice work.  I suggest you speak with Ossa Blaus at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; she wants your help with something, I think.
messages.zh: 干得不错。我建议你与{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的欧萨•布拉谈一下。我想，她有事情要你帮忙。

name.ja: もっとクァフェをください...

messages.en: The Quafe Corporation Factory in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} is in constant need of more hydrogen batteries, which they use for some of their reactors.  If you're up for it, then I'd like you to transfer some of the batteries to them before our deadline runs out.  Be on time!
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的酷菲工厂时常需要大量的氢电池用于他们的反应堆。如果你感兴趣的话，我希望你尽快将这些电池送到那儿。一定要准时！

messages.en: Well done.  I heard Lorchaert Brounave in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} has something to offer you, so stop by his office will you?
messages.zh: 干得好！我听说{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的洛查尔•布纳维有任务给你，你能去一下他的办公室吗？

messages.en: Federal Administration has requested another shipment of Quafe Ultra to their Information Center in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  We're always on the lookout for cheap labor to get these transportation jobs done, so if you have time could you take care of this {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 联盟行政部门已经要求将一船酷菲特强送到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的信息中心。我们一直在寻找能够完成这次运送任务的廉价劳动力，如果你有空，能帮我这个忙吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: I believe Ley Serene was looking for you at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} ...
messages.zh: 我相信雷伊•瑟瑞恩正在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}到处找你……

name.es: Manos limpias: Reguero de sangre (1 de 5)
name.fr: Opération Mains propres – Traces de sang (1 sur 5)
name.ru: Чистые руки - кровавый след (Clean Hands - Blood Trail) (1 из 5)

messages.en: Killing cultists is my second-favorite pastime. I like it so much that I'd be willing to do it for free, if my all-time favorite pastime wasn't spending money. And lots of it.
messages.zh: 消灭异教徒是我第二喜欢的消遣方式。我很喜欢这件事，甚至愿意免费为你做这件事，只是我最喜欢的消遣方式消费太大了。实在太大了。

messages.en:
I assume the smell of battle drew you here to Araz. This constellation may be a backwater of the Empire, yet interesting things are taking place here. I will not try to deceive you, so let me come clean right from the start. I'm here as a supporter of Lord Methros. Not as an official of Imperial Armaments, but as more of a personal friend; though Lord Methros has been a cherished customer of Imperial Armaments for years.

I do not know how much you know about the situation here in Araz, or what you think you know. Things are a bit complicated here at the moment, and the rumor mill is spinning like crazy. I'd advise you to take any information you get with a grain of salt. The hottest topic is the presence of the Blood Raiders in the constellation, or more precisely, why are they here and what are they up to? Idle tongues have spewed forth the rumor that Lord Methros invited the Raiders here, but heed not the black lies of these mouths. Lord Methros is just as anxious to rid Araz of the Blood Raider plague as everyone else. He even asked me personally to aid him in the matter.

Which finally allows me to answer your question regarding whether I have a job for you. Indeed I do. The Blood Raiders have taken over the ancient imperial fortresses that litter the night sky here in Araz. One of these fortresses lies close by, in the system of Koona. Travel there and enter the forsaken ruins. A group of Blood Raider cultists resides somewhere in there, taking blood from innocent travelers. We must put a stop to this vile practice. Locate the cultists in the fortress and retrieve the blood fund they've accumulated. Return with it to me, and we'll be one step closer to purging Araz of the Raiders' foul presence.

Be warned, though: The fortress can not be entered in anything larger than a cruiser-class ship.
messages.zh:
我想你一定是嗅到了战争的气息才来到埃拉茨的。这里表面看上去平静无波，实际上暗流汹涌。我不想骗你，让我们打开天窗说亮话吧。尽管多年来梅多尔斯大人都是帝国总装部的大客户，但这次我并非以一个帝国总装部官员的身份来这儿。我是梅多尔斯阁下的拥护者，更确切地说是他一个私人朋友。

我不清楚你对埃拉茨这里的情况了解多少，现在的事情有些复杂，谣言四起，不要轻易相信你得到的任何信息。当前星座最热门的话题就是血袭者的出现，确切地说，是他们为什么来，来干什么？有恶人散布谣言说是梅多尔斯大人请他们来的，千万别在意那些阴险的谎言。梅多尔斯大人和所有人一样都急于将血袭者逐出埃拉茨，他甚至还要我亲自帮他搞定这件事。

之前你问我是不是有工作给你，现在我的回答是：有。血袭者占领了古代皇家城堡，搞得埃拉茨不得安宁。有一个城堡就在附近的库纳星系中，一群血袭者成员正居住在城堡的遗址里，加害无辜的过客。对他们的暴行，我们绝不能坐视不理！去那个城堡为民除害，带回他们抢来的财宝，这样离我们把血袭者完全驱逐出埃拉茨又近了一步。

还有，那个堡垒不允许任何比巡洋舰大的船通过。

messages.en: Well done. I will return the blood fund to the rightful authorities. Meanwhile, I have another assignment lined up for you.
messages.zh: 干得好！我会把血液储备交给适当部门。现在，我还为你准备好了另一个任务。

name.es: Manos limpias: Quiste en la muralla (2 de 5)
name.fr: Opération Mains Propres – Excroissance de rempart (2 sur 5)
name.ru: Чистые руки - Rampart Cyst (Clean Hands - Rampart Cyst) (2 из 5)

messages.en:
I'm still trying to find out what the Blood Raiders are up to here in Araz. All I can say with certainty is that they're putting in a lot of effort into causing havoc here, presumably to further their own gains. Their agenda may be as simple as taking over the constellation. Simple, if megalomaniacal. But it may be that they're searching for something. We can't be sure. Whatever it is they're after, the Blood Raiders are out in force.

Moreover, I just recently discovered that they've sent some of their top scholars here, hiding them in a long-forgotten mining station in the middle of nowhere. These scientists are up to no good, and God knows what they're brewing in that alchemist's tower of theirs. We must put a stop to this operation before their plan unfolds. You took good care of those cultists, so there's no doubt in my mind that a few alchemists shouldn't pose too much of a problem for you. Blow up their tower and bring me back whatever concoctions they were making there.
messages.zh:
我正在调查血袭者来埃拉茨的目的。唯一能肯定的是，他们在这里大搞破坏，不过是为了敛得更多的财物。说到底，他们的目的很简单——掌管整个星座。 他们可能在寻找某些东西，谁知道呢。不论如何，血袭者的确是大规模出现了。

最近的情报显示他们已经将一些最好的学者送到了这里，隐蔽在一个废弃已久的偏僻矿站中。这些科学家不怀好意，天知道他们在炼金塔中酝酿什么阴谋诡计。我们必须先发制人。你既然能轻松应付那些异教徒，几个炼金术士也不是什么大麻烦吧。炸了他们的炼金塔，把他们研制的东西带回来给我。

messages.en:
Excellent job, {[character]player.name}. You are obviously in God's favor. Those plague spores seem destined for some evil purpose; good thing we got them before the Blood Raiders could unleash them on some unsuspecting planet. I can't wait to dispose of them.

I do have another small mission for you, if you're interested.
messages.zh:
干得好，{[character]player.name}。你一定受到了神的眷顾。看来这些瘟疫孢子是个邪恶计划的产物；幸好我们赶在血袭者在某个毫无防备的行星上放出它们之前把它们抢到手里。我要马上把它们处理掉。

我还有个小任务要给你，如果你感兴趣的话。

name.es: Manos limpias: La dama de hierro (3 de 5)
name.fr: Opération Mains Propres – La Dame de fer (3 sur 5)
name.ru: Чистые руки - железная леди (Clean Hands - Iron Lady) (3 из 5)

messages.en: I know I can rely on you to deliver it quickly and efficiently.
messages.zh: 我知道你能快速送到。

messages.en:
We have to divert our attention away from the Blood Raiders for a moment, {[character]player.name}. I've been perhaps overly eager to help out my friend Lord Methros and as a result have been neglecting my duties here in Araz. The constellation is seeing a lot of black market activity, mainly in the guise of the so-called Giraka merchant guild. The Girakas have been attempting to undermine my business deals here, and my superiors are getting restless.

One of my most important clients is Lady Eroza Arachnan, sister of the despicable Lord Arachnan. Lady Eroza is an important political figure, and we must ensure that she remains a loyal client of Imperial Armaments. She's requested a rather curious item from our catalogue to be brought to her, called the Truthteller. While I won't go into details on how it works ― trade secrets and all that ― I will say that it's a torture device of the most ingenious sort, guaranteed to make anyone spill his beans, and probably his guts too. I've no idea what exactly the good lady intends to do with it, but let's just assume it's for a good cause. I need someone fast and reliable to deliver the device to the ACN station over in Aphi, where a representative of Lady Eroza is waiting for it.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我们不得不暂时从血袭者上转移一下我们的注意力了。也许我过分热衷于帮助我的朋友梅多尔斯阁下而对我在埃拉茨的使命有所怠慢，使得目前这个星座黑市活动频繁，他们通常都打着吉拉卡斯行会的旗号。吉拉卡斯正在破坏我们这儿的生意，我的上司对此非常不满。

埃罗扎•埃拉克兰女士是我最重要的客户之一，她是卑鄙的埃拉克兰大人的姐姐，也是本星座有头有脸的政治人物，我们必须确保她是帝国武器的忠实客户。她从我们的商品目录里选购了一个相当特别的物品，名叫真言机，要我们送过去。我不能透露过多细节，类似它的工作原理等等，这是商业秘密，我只能说它是用来对付最机智的那类人的刑具，保证能让他吐出所有真相。我不知她想买这东西来干嘛，但让我们往好处去想吧。现在的问题是，可恶的吉拉卡斯也想插手这笔交易，我需要一个可靠机灵的人来运送这个装置到埃费的认证通讯空间站，埃罗扎女士的代理人正在那等着呢。

messages.en: Great job as always, {[character]player.name}. Now we can get back to business dealing with those pesky Blood Raiders.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，如往常一样干得很出色。现在让我们转过头来对付那些麻烦的血袭者。

messages.en: What are you trying to do?! These Girakas will be the end of me!
messages.zh: 你究竟想怎么样！吉拉卡斯那群家伙会让我完蛋的！

name.de: Saubere Hände - Roste in Frieden (4 von 5)
name.en: Clean Hands - Rust in Peace (4 of 5)
name.es: Manos limpias: Oxídate en paz (4 de 5)
name.fr: Opération Mains propres – Repos éternel (4 sur 5)
name.ru: Чистые руки - ржавей с миром (Clean Hands - Rust in Peace) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
Now we can get back to taking care of those damned Blood Raiders. You've already visited one of their outposts here in Araz, the old imperial fortress over in Koona, the Bastion of Blood. The Blood Raiders are refurbishing the old keep and intend to make it into an impregnable stronghold. Needless to say, that won't do. We must foil their efforts now before the fortress's defenses come online. Mind you, the Blood Raiders are as hard to get rid of as cockroaches, so I don't intend for you to wipe them out for good. But if we strike them enough times, they might give up eventually.

There's a foreman overseeing the reconstruction of the old keep. If we can take him out, we'll at least delay them until a new foreman has been appointed. Bring me back that foreman's head.

name.ru: Чистые руки - котел с трупами (Clean Hands - Corpse Cauldron) (5 из 5)

messages.en: The grace of God be with you.
messages.zh: 你帮了梅多尔斯家族一个大忙，神会眷顾你的。

messages.en:
I've been in contact with Lord Methros, keeping him up to date on what I've been doing to aid his cause. He's happy with your efforts and would have you take care of an important matter for him. This a personal request from Lord Methros himself: I don't have to tell you what an honor that is.

As you know ― better than most by now, I'm sure ― the Blood Raiders are a plague here in Araz. With so many of them nearby, it's only to be expected to find some of their more gruesome forms of entertainment here. They like blood sports, and they've set up an arena to indulge themselves. It's called "The Cauldron," and many good Amarrian souls have lost their lives there. One such soul is a cousin of Lord Methros, who was kidnapped a few weeks ago. Nothing was heard from him, or his kidnappers, for a long time, but now Lord Methros has finally learned the fate of his cousin: He died as an "entertainment" for a crowd of raucous Raiders. While Lord Methros mourns his fallen family member, he must mind the honor of his family. As do other members of House Methros, the young cousin bore the coat of arms of his noble family. Lord Methros wants that back, as the thought of some hideous Blood Raider wearing his sacred coat of arms is unbearable.

Make your way over to the Cauldron and locate the Blood Raider chapel there. The coat of arms is inside the chapel. Bring it back and you will have the eternal love of House Methros.
messages.zh:
我与梅多尔斯大人有着密切的接触，这儿的工作进展会在第一时间通知他。他对你之前的工作很满意，并且想把一个重要任务托付给你。这是梅多尔斯大人的个人请求，不用我说你也知道这是何等的荣誉了。

你应该很清楚，血袭者正大批出现在埃拉茨。他们嗜好血腥的运动，还设立了一个竞技场让俘虏互相打斗取乐。这个竞技场叫做卡德隆，许多善良的艾玛人已经在此丧生。梅多尔斯的兄弟也是其中之一，他在几周前被绑架，之后就失去了消息，绑匪也没透露任何风声，但最终梅多尔斯大人还是知道了他的命运——这个可怜的孩子被强迫走上竞技场角斗，像个玩偶般死在血袭者成员的喧闹声中。梅多尔斯大人为他逝去的家族成员悲哀，但他还要强忍悲痛维护家族的荣誉。他年轻的兄弟戴有梅多尔斯贵族家庭的盾徽，大人希望找回它，他决不能容忍这个神圣的盾徽佩戴在某个血盟小丑的身上。

你需要做的就是前往卡德隆，找到血袭者的礼拜堂，盾徽就在那里。把它带回来，就能得到梅多尔斯家族永久的宠爱。

messages.en: You have done House Methros a great service, {[character]player.name}. Lord Methros wants you involved in his plans for Araz. There's an ACN reporter over in Koona who is a close confidant of Lord Methros. I'm giving you a holoreel depicting some of the worst atrocities committed by the Blood Raiders in Araz; as a reporter, this fellow will be thrilled to get his hands one something so juicy. Go talk to him, and he will let you in on the ingenious schemes Lord Methros is hatching. I believe the fellow's holed up in what is called "The Ravelin" in the contested Bastion of Blood in Koona.
messages.zh: 你帮了梅多尔斯家族一个很大的忙，{[character]player.name}。梅多尔斯大人希望你参与他在埃拉茨的计划。在库纳有一个艾玛认证通信社的记者，他是阁下的心腹。我会给你一张全息记录盘，里面记录了一些血袭者在埃拉茨所犯下的最令人发指的暴行；作为记者，这个伙计一定会为得到这块肥肉而欣喜若狂的。去跟他谈谈，他会带你进入梅多尔斯大人正精密谋划的方案。我相信这个伙计躲在库纳争夺中的血腥城堡里一个叫做“半月堡”的地方。

name.en: Clear Head - Throwing Down the Gauntlet (1 of 5)
name.fr: Les idées claires – Lancer un défi (1 sur 5)
name.ru: Ясная голова - бросить вызов (Clear Head - Throwing Down the Gauntlet) (1 из 5)

messages.en: It might take a while to find him, but have a bit of patience {[character]player.name}. I'm sure I can turn this into a good story for ACN, and you'll be at the center of it!
messages.zh: 找到他可能要费一些周折，耐心点，{[character]player.name}。我一定会把这件事写成精彩的故事交给艾玛认证通讯社，而你就是故事的主角！

messages.en:
Dakumon tells me you're a resourceful pilot. Let's see if he's right. As you perhaps know, the Arachnan family is the biggest rival of Lord Methros in the constellation. You might say the two families are duking it out to see what family is the most powerful in Araz. Lord Arachnan has a younger brother, Thyram Arachnan, who was a gifted fighter pilot. Sadly, Thyram was also what is commonly known as the black sheep of the family.

A few years back, shortly after he succeeded his father as head of the family, Lord Arachnan had had enough of Thyram's uncouth ways and disowned him, exiling the young scoundrel from the family estates. But Thyram didn't go far; he and his shady friends joined the local pirates and have been roaming the asteroid belts around Araz since then.

Lord Methros wants to send a clear message to the Arachnan family that none of them is safe, while at the same time ridding the habitants of Araz of a pesky pirate threat. And you're the person to deliver that message ― by killing Thyram Arachnan. The only problem is, Thyram discarded his identity long time ago. The only information I have on him is that he has the rank of a warrior with the local pirates. You need to track him down, move between the constellation's asteroid belts, and kill all the warriors you can find until you find the right one. How will you know you got the right one? Thyram still holds some sentiments for his old family, it seems, for it's said that he always wears his dynasty ring. Find the ring, and you know you've got the right guy. Return with the ring to me once you have it.

Oh, and in case you were wondering what a journalist is doing working under cover, let's just say that Amarrian journalism has never been plagued by impartiality and that the stories you instigate yourself are always the most interesting.
messages.zh:
达库蒙称赞你是一个足智多谋的飞行员，我想让事实来证明一切。你可能已经知道，这个星座里埃拉克兰家族是梅多尔斯大人最主要的的敌人，可以这么说，两者相斗是为了争夺埃拉茨最强大家族的位子。埃拉克兰大人有一个弟弟叫泰拉姆•埃拉克兰，是这个家族的败家子。

几年前，在埃拉克兰大人接替其父亲成为家族领袖后不久，他无法忍受泰拉姆的粗俗笨拙，将其逐出家门。但泰拉姆并没有走远，他和一群狐朋狗友们加入了当地的海盗组织，从此就在埃拉茨附近的小行星带游手好闲。

梅多尔斯大人有一条一石二鸟之计，除掉泰拉姆，一可以清楚地警告埃拉克兰家族，他们所有人都不会有好日子过；同时又能为民除害，帮助埃拉茨的居民摆脱恼人的海盗威胁。这个任务将由你执行。现在唯一的问题是泰拉姆很久以前就丢弃身份了，我仅仅知道他在当地海盗中拥有战士阶级。你要在星座的小行星带之间寻找他，干掉你遇到的所有战士，直到你找到他为止。你问如何辨别他的身份？泰拉姆似乎对他古老的家族仍念念不忘，总是戴着家族指环。找到戒指就找到了他。带着指环回来向我报告。

哦，要是你想知道记者都在暗地里搞些什么，那我告诉你，艾玛的新闻行业从来无公正可言，你亲身经历的故事总会更有趣一些。

messages.en: Yes, excellent, this is the right ring. Congratulations on finding it! Now, on to your next task.
messages.zh: 是的，太出色了，就是这个指环。祝贺你找到了它！现在，说说你的下一个任务。

name.de: Klarer Kopf - Kodex der Ritterlichkeit (2 von 5)
name.en: Clear Head - Code of Chivalry (2 of 5)
name.fr: Les idées claires – Le code de la chevalerie (2 sur 5)
name.ru: Ясная голова - кодекс рыцаря (Clear Head - Code of Chivalry) (2 из 5)

messages.en:
We Amarrians are nothing if not civilized. We were eating off of gilded plates while the other races were still using their hands to wipe their arses. We have traditions older than sin and customs more ingrained (and sometimes more disgusting) than overgrown toenails.

The feud between House Arachnan and House Methros is getting serious, and in accordance with traditions, there's protocol to be followed. But there's a bit of a twist, you see. Lord Arachnan succeeded his father not many years ago. But while he is the eldest son of his line, he does have an older sibling, a sister. I believe you've already heard her name from me: Lady Eroza Arachnan. She is disputing her brother's claim as the head of the Arachnan family.

Lord Methros, in his infinite wisdom, has decided to throw his lot in with Lady Arachnan. Lord Methros' best and brightest archivists and scholars have been poring over old documents looking for precedents, and it seems they've found one. Some thousand years ago, apparently, when the head of the Arachnan family passed away, he was succeeded not by his eldest son, who by all accounts was frail of mind and body, but by his eldest daughter. She was a most capable administrator and disciplinarian, I understand, as is her descendant, the admirable Lady Eroza Arachnan. Lord Methros passed these records into my hands, and I will make sure they're well broadcast over the ACN netword in the next few days. But protocol calls for this information also to be delivered, by hand, to the lord of the region.

That's where you come in, {[character]player.name}. I want you to deliver the ancestral records to Kador Prime, where an associate of mine will accept them from you and deliver the package to the Kador household. The package is waiting for you in the ACN station over in Aphi, so you have to pick it up there first. This is hot news: Hurry so I can send out my report of the goings on through the ACN network.
messages.zh:
我们艾玛人有着古老的文明，当我们已使用金铸的餐盘用餐时，其他种族仍在用手抓饭吃。我们的传统由古至今世代传承，我们的习俗根深蒂固恒久不变。埃拉克兰家族与梅多尔斯家族的恩怨在不断加深，而依照传统，他们必须不计前嫌和睦相处。你看这似乎有些不可思议是吧。

作为长子，埃拉克兰阁下几年前子承父业。他有一个更为年长的同胞姐姐，叫埃罗扎•埃拉克兰，我相信你曾听说过她，她极力反对弟弟自称为埃拉克兰家族的头人。深谋远虑的梅多尔斯阁下已然决定将他自己与埃拉克兰女士的命运紧紧相连。梅多尔斯大人手下最棒的档案管理员及最博学的学者不舍昼夜地埋头于旧卷宗堆里，最终找到了一个先例。在数千年前，埃拉克兰家族的头人去世后，继承人并非他的长子，据说他的长子孱弱无能，所以最终由长女继承了家族的一切。他的长女是一位出色的管理者，并且极为自律，作为她的子孙，埃罗扎•埃拉克兰同样出类拔萃。梅多尔斯大人将有关这一切的卷宗给了我，而我向他保证今后几天会通过认证通讯广播网将这些卷宗的内容广播出去。根据协议要求，这些卷宗要有人亲手送往这个地区的领主那里。

{[character]player.name}，接下来就是你的任务了。我要你将卷宗交到卡多尔家族的手上。我的一个合伙人会到卡多尔恒星和你碰面，那时他会向你要一个包裹，他好交给卡多尔家族。那个包裹现在存放在埃费的艾玛认证通讯空间站，先去那儿取一下。这事很棘手，你得赶快行动，好让我尽快通过认证通讯广播网将这些卷宗的内容广播出去。

messages.en: Good job. Now I can broadcast this sensational news to the rest of the Empire. Talk to me again soon; Lord Methros is nowhere near through with Lord Arachnan.
messages.zh: 做得好。现在我就能把这个颇具轰动性的消息传遍帝国各地了。以后再来找我谈谈吧。梅多尔斯大人决不会与埃拉克兰善罢甘休。

I want you to deliver the ancestral records to Kador Prime, where an associate of mine will accept them from you and deliver the package to the Kador household. The package is waiting for you in the ACN station over in Aphi, so you have to pick it up there first. This is hot news: Hurry so I can send out my report of the goings on through the ACN network.
messages.zh:
我们艾玛人有着古老的文明，当我们已使用金铸的餐盘用餐时，其他种族仍在用手抓饭吃。我们的传统由古至今世代传承，我们的习俗根深蒂固恒久不变。埃拉克兰家族与梅多尔斯家族的恩怨在不断加深，而依照传统，他们必须不计前嫌和睦相处。你看这似乎有些不可思议是吧。

作为长子，埃拉克兰阁下几年前子承父业。他有一个更为年长的同胞姐姐，叫埃罗扎•埃拉克兰，我相信你曾听说过她，她极力反对弟弟自称为埃拉克兰家族的头人。深谋远虑的梅多尔斯阁下已然决定将他自己与埃拉克兰女士的命运紧紧相连。梅多尔斯大人手下最棒的档案管理员及最博学的学者不舍昼夜地埋头于旧卷宗堆里，最终找到了一个先例。在数千年前，埃拉克兰家族的头人去世后，继承人并非他的长子，据说他的长子孱弱无能，所以最终由长女继承了家族的一切。他的长女是一位出色的管理者，并且极为自律，作为她的子孙，埃罗扎•埃拉克兰同样出类拔萃。梅多尔斯大人将有关这一切的卷宗给了我，而我向他保证今后几天会通过认证通讯广播网将这些卷宗的内容广播出去。根据协议要求，这些卷宗要有人亲手送往这个地区的领主那里。

{[character]player.name}，接下来就是你的任务了。我要你将卷宗交到卡多尔家族的手上。我的一个合伙人会到卡多尔恒星和你碰面，那时他会向你要一个包裹，他好交给卡多尔家族。那个包裹现在存放在埃费的艾玛认证通讯空间站，先去那儿取一下。这事很棘手，你得赶快行动，好让我尽快通过认证通讯广播网将这些卷宗的内容广播出去。

name.fr: Les idées claires - La joute (3 sur 5)
name.ru: Ясная голова - рыцарский поединок (Clear Head - The Joust) (3 из 5)

messages.en:
Predictably, Lord Arachnan is not amused by his sister's actions. I believe "treacherous" and "bitch" were the words he used when describing his feelings. And of course the fact that his arch-rival Lord Methros has intervened on Lady Arachnan's behalf aggravates him even further. But Lord Methros stands by his allies, and he has allied himself with Lady Arachnan. He has know made it his mission in life to depose Lord Arachnan and instate Eroza as the rightful head of the Arachnan family. If he succeeds, the Arachnans will undoubtedly be very grateful and, more importantly, less belligerent toward our lord and master.

With Lord Arachnan declining to step down voluntarily, more drastic measures are called for. (Incidentally, we already started down this path when we killed Lord Arachnan's younger brother. And by "we," I mean "you," of course.) Don't you sometimes just marvel at Lord Methros foresight?

Now all that stands between Lord Arachnan and his sister in the hereditary ladder is Lord Arachnan's son. With him out of the way, the path is clear for Lady Arachnan. The son goes by the name Aradim Arachnan, and he is a real hot-head. The boy fancies himself a knight of the olden days, and his foolish father indulges his fanciful dreams. Aradim and his friends like to duel in their shiny cruisers. Or joust, as they call it. They think so highly of themselves that they've declined protection from Lord Arachnan's household guards, against the better wishes of the lord's chief of security. So taking them out shouldn't be too much of a problem. Just don't fall into the same trap as they likely will and get overly confident. Overconfidence is ugly at best and lethal at worst, so keep your head screwed on straight.

Bring me the head of Aradim Arachnan, as intact as possible. Lord Methros wants it to be quite recognizable by Lord Arachnan when it's presented to him.
messages.zh:
可以预见到，埃拉克兰大人一定对他妹妹的行为感到很不愉快。我相信在描述自己的感受时，他一定用了“奸诈”和“恶棍”这样的词语。他的宿敌梅多尔斯阁下参与到此事当中只会让他更加愤怒。梅多尔斯阁下非常守信，而现在阁下已和埃罗扎小姐结成同盟，一定会竭尽全力废除埃拉克兰大人，并让埃罗扎•埃拉克兰掌管家族。如果他成功的话，埃拉克兰家族会对他十分感激，更重要的是，他们不会再与阁下交战。

如果埃拉克兰大人拒绝自动下台，那么我们就要采取更激烈的方式。顺便说一下，当我们干掉他的弟弟时，我们已经在走这条路了。啊，对了，是你干掉他的弟弟。难道你不敬佩梅多尔斯阁下的预见能力吗？

现在，埃拉克兰大人与他的妹妹之间唯一的继承问题就是埃拉克兰大人的儿子。如果将他除掉，那么埃拉克兰小姐的道路就平坦了。他儿子叫阿拉迪•埃拉克兰，是一个十分鲁莽的人，经常将自己想像成古代的骑士，他的父亲也纵容他的幻想。阿拉迪和他的朋友喜欢驾驶铮亮的巡洋舰进行决斗，并称之为马上比武。他们自视极高，拒绝了埃拉克兰家族守卫的保护，这违背了埃拉克兰大人安全第一的美好愿望。所以除掉他不会太难，只是不要像他们一样过于自信。盲目自大轻则让你残疾，重则要你小命，时刻要保持警惕。

把阿拉迪•埃拉克兰的头颅尽可能完整无缺地给我带回来。梅多尔斯阁下希望，当这颗头颅被呈送到埃拉克兰大人面前时，他能一眼认出来。

messages.en: Brilliant work, as always. Lord Arachnan must know what is coming by now. Talk to me again when you're ready to thicken the plot a bit more, ok?
messages.zh: 你一如既往地干得漂亮。埃拉克兰大人一定知道即将发生的事情。当你准备好把事态扩大的时候，来跟我谈谈，好吗？

name.fr: Les idées claires - Noire barbacane (4 sur 5)
name.ja: 知恵くらべ―ブラックバービカン（4/5）
name.ru: Ясная голова - Black Barbican (Clear Head - Black Barbican) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
Things are heating up now, {[character]player.name}. We've put things into motion that we cannot have perfect control over; I have little idea where it will all lead. Isn't it exciting?

Lord Methros is very pleased with your efforts so far; we have seized the initiative in the struggle against Lord Arachnan, and it will be interesting to see how he'll react to us slaying his son. Lord Methros himself is putting the final touches on the coup de grace for Lord Arachnan, and my editor and I are already quivering in anticipation of what he will do. But in the meantime, I have an interesting assignment for you.

I do not know how familiar you are with Amarr high society, but I can tell you that appearance and prestige are critical. For the Amarrians, you must appear powerful and strong to be prestigious, regardless of your birth. Bloodline alone is not enough. And I have the perfect mission for you to humiliate Lord Arachnan and take him down a peck or two.

The ancestral armor of House Arachnan is back in Araz, after being on display on Kador Prime for the last six months. Needless to say, the armor represents the dignity and ancestry of House Arachnan, so losing it would be a huge blow for Lord Arachnan, as the head of the house. The armor is usually stored in the Black Barbican, an ancient and impregnable fortress over in Chanoun owned by the Arachnan family. They keep many of their most valuable and prestigious items there. But the armor is not yet in the Barbican itself, it's still lying in the Outer Keep. Experts are inspecting it to see if it received any damage on the journey, and the armor won't be transferred into the Barbican for a little while. So if we hurry, we can catch the armor before it's locked away for good in the Barbican.
messages.zh:
一切都在趋于白热化，{[character]player.name}。事态已无法掌控，我也不知道它会怎么发展，很刺激吧？目前为止，梅多尔斯阁下对你的工作很满意，我们在对抗埃拉克兰大人的过程中已经掌握了主动，不知他得知儿子的死讯会有什么反应，哈。

梅多尔斯阁下正在准备对埃拉克兰大人发动致命一击，我和手下的编辑们一想到梅多尔斯阁下要做的事情就会激动得发抖。不过当下我还有个有趣的任务给你。我不清楚你对艾玛上流社会的熟悉程度，但我告诉你，外貌和声望是很重要的。作为艾玛人，你必须显露强势，以树立自己的威信，不然会被所有的人鄙视。你的任务就是羞辱埃拉克兰大人，让他威风扫地。

埃拉克兰家族祖传的盔甲在卡多尔恒星展出了六个月之后又回到了埃拉茨。不用多说，盔甲代表了他们家族的尊严和血统，遗失它对家族首领埃拉克兰大人会是一个巨大的打击。盔甲通常被储存在黑色碉堡内，这个城堡历史悠久，坚不可摧，位于埃拉克兰家族的属地：查浓。那里保管着埃拉克兰家族所有的贵重物品。目前盔甲并不在碉堡内，它在外围要塞。专家正在检查它有没有在途中受到损伤，因此盔甲暂时不会被送到黑色碉堡里去。如果行动够快，我们就能在盔甲被永久封入碉堡前得到它。

messages.en: And so the world crumbles around the great Lord Arachnan. Oh, the irony! Lord Methros is ready to close the matter now for good by killing Lord Arachnan himself! Talk to me when you're ready.
messages.zh: 这样，伟大的埃拉克兰大人的世界就要垮了。噢，多么讽刺啊！梅多尔斯大人准备干掉埃拉克兰大人，从而永远了结此事！等你准备好了，就来跟我谈谈。

name.en: Clear Head - Dragon in a Dungeon (5 of 5)
name.es: Lucidez: Dragón en la mazmorra (5 de 5)
name.fr: Les idées claires - Un dragon dans le donjon (5 sur 5)
name.ja: 知恵くらべ―ダンジョンのドラゴン（5/5）
name.ru: Ясная голова - дракон в темнице (Clear Head - Dragon in a Dungeon) (5 из 5)

messages.en: Go blow that bastard up, {[character]player.name}! Did I mention I have an exclusive on the surveillance tapes you're bringing back? This will make my career!
messages.zh: 去打爆那个混蛋，{[character]player.name}！我跟你说过吗，我拥有你带回来的监控录像的独家新闻？我的事业要腾飞了！

messages.en:
The Arachnan family owns a manor out in deep space. The grandfather of the current lord of the house built it as a reclusive summer vacation spot for the family. While its location is no secret, its tight security means it receives few visitors. Thus it's an ideal location for secret negotiations. Lord Methros has set Lord Arachnan up beautifully. Using one of his own lieutenants as a decoy, Lord Methros has manipulated Lord Arachnan into thinking he has a spy placed highly in the Methros household. And now a meeting has been arranged between Lord Arachnan and the double-agent in the aforementioned manor.

All we need do is invade the place and blast everything to pieces, including Lord Arachnan himself, allowing Lady Eroza to assume her rightful place as the head of the Arachnan family. You, a dedicated and superbly talented supporter of Lord Methros, are to be given the honor of killing Lord Methros' greatest foe.

Go and blow up the manor house. Lord Arachnan is in it and will surely die with the destruction of the manor. Now here's the only tricky part: Lord Methros wants the surveillance tapes from the internal security systems in the manor. They will serve not only as a proof of Arachnan's death, but will also allow Lord Methros to see with his own eyes the final moments of his arch-nemesis. The internal security system is called Perpetual Chamber Warden. Bring it back to me and your job is done.
messages.zh:
埃拉克兰家族在太空深处有一个庄园，埃拉克兰的祖父将其建成了一个隐蔽的家族避暑胜地。虽然现今它的存在不再是一个秘密，但由于守卫森严，游客数极少，从而使这个庄园成为秘密谈判的理想场所。梅多尔斯很好地欺骗了埃拉克兰，他利用自己的一个上尉做幌子，使得埃拉克兰相信自己在梅多尔斯家族中有内线。现在埃拉克兰正在庄园中和这个双重间谍进行会谈。

现在我们要做的就是进入庄园，将其夷为平地，其中当然包括埃拉克兰大人，这就能让埃罗扎•埃拉克兰小姐名正言顺地掌管这个家族。你是梅多尔斯阁下忠实能干的支持者，也是最适合这个任务的人。驾驶你的战舰去炸了那个庄园，埃拉克兰必死无疑。还有一个问题，梅多尔斯阁下想要庄园内部安全系统的监控录像。它们不仅能证明埃拉克兰的死亡，也让梅多尔斯阁下亲眼见证了自己的复仇计划。内部安全系统叫做永室监护。把它带回来，你的任务就算完成了。

messages.en: Fantastic results. No doubt we'll soon see Eroza Arachnan assume the leadership of House Arachnan. Oh, happy days!
messages.zh: 完美的结果。毫无疑问我们很快就能看到埃罗扎•埃拉克兰掌管埃拉克兰家族了。噢，今天真是个好日子！

现在我们要做的就是进入庄园，将其夷为平地，其中当然包括埃拉克兰大人，这就能让埃罗扎•埃拉克兰小姐名正言顺地掌管这个家族。你是梅多尔斯阁下忠实能干的支持者，也是最适合这个任务的人。驾驶你的战舰去炸了那个庄园，埃拉克兰必死无疑。还有一个问题，梅多尔斯阁下想要庄园内部安全系统的监控录像。它们不仅能证明埃拉克兰的死亡，也让梅多尔斯阁下亲眼见证了自己的复仇计划。内部安全系统叫做永室监护。把它带回来，你的任务就算完成了。

messages.en: I have a special holo reel I received from an agent in Munory. I'm sure it's of interest to you.
messages.zh: 我从蒙诺瑞一个代理人那得到了一卷特殊的全息记录盘。我相信你会有兴趣的。

messages.en: Ok, lets see this holo reel then.
messages.zh: 好，那么让我们看看全息记录盘。

messages.en: I'm a very busy person, so unless you possess something of interest for me, then don't bother talking to me.
messages.zh: 我是一个很忙的人，除非你有我感兴趣的东西，不然别来烦我。

messages.en: Here's the holo reel, full of Blood Raider atrocities.
messages.zh: 这是含有血袭者暴行的全息记录盘。

messages.en:
Oh, this is interesting. And there's a encrypted note in here too.

Ah, you have proven yourself as a worthy champion of the cause of House Methros. I have some interesting jobs lined up for someone of your calibre.
messages.zh:
噢，这个很有趣。这里还有条加密信息。

啊，你已经证明了你是梅多尔斯家族事业的可敬拥护者。我为你这样有才干的人准备了一些有趣的工作。

messages.en: I have nothing of interest for you. Let me get back to you when I have.
messages.zh: 我没有你感兴趣的事情给你。等有了，我再回来找你。

messages.en: Don't bother me again until you have a scoop of some sort. With all the goings on in the constellation us journalists are quite busy.
messages.zh: 在你拿到什么独家消息前，别来烦我了。这个星座中的情况瞬息万变，我们这些记者很忙的。

messages.en: I'm a very busy person, so unless you possess something of interest for me, then don't bother talking to me.
messages.zh: 我是一个很忙的人，除非你有我感兴趣的东西，不然别来烦我。

messages.en: It's your loss.
messages.zh: 这是你的损失。

messages.en: I'd like you to transport a few State officials to the Federation Navy station in Luminaire.  They've got important business to attend to, so don't be late.  Just drop them off at your hangar in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh: 你去把几个政府官员送到泛光之源的联邦海军空间站。他们有要务在身，所以你千万不要迟到。只须在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}让他们下船就可以了。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You can continue working for various corporations in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} as long as you like. I suggest finding an agent that has a more variety of tasks available, simply search the stations that are owned by a corporation within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} and you are bound to find an agent to your liking. You can also search for agents which will speak to you by checking the database information for the corporation of your choice. To do that simply open the People and Places menu through your NeoCom and search for the corporation name. Right click on it and choose 'show info'. There you should find a list of all of its agents that are available. Their division should give you a hint as to what type of mission they are associated with.

Take care!
messages.zh: 干得不错，{[character]player.name}。只要你愿意，你就可以继续为{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的集团工作。我建议你寻找一个可以提供更多种类任务的代理人，只需搜索{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}下任一集团的空间站，你就一定能找到一个符合你兴趣的代理人。你也可以查看你所选集团的数据库信息，从而找到愿意和你交谈的代理人。要这样做，你只需打开控制边栏上的“人物和地点”菜单并搜索集团名称。右键单击搜索结果，然后选择“显示信息”。然后你应该可以看到该集团下所有对你开放的代理人的名单。根据他们的所属部门，你应该可以了解他们所从事任务的类型。<br><br>保重！

messages.en: The Core Complexion Inc. Factory in {[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name} informed us that they have another shipment of ammo ready to be transported here.  Our transportation services cannot handle the load of these constant courier jobs so I'd be very grateful if you could take it on yourself to bring one batch of Carbonized Lead ammo here.
messages.zh: 在{[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}的核心局面公司工厂告诉我们，他们又有一批军火准备完毕等待运送。我们的运输负担已经饱和，没有人手可以调派来完成这些快递任务了。如果你能亲自为我跑一趟，把那批碳化铅炮弹送到这里的话，我将不胜感激。

messages.en: Thanks.  Don't go anywhere though, I have one more assignment I'd like you to complete.
messages.zh: 谢谢。先别走，我还有一个任务需要你完成。

messages.en: A friend of mine, Hakar Ogok, apparently is in need of some work.  He resides on the Core Complexion station in Arlek which I sent you to earlier.  Since you're probably heading there anyway to speak with Hakar, you might as well bring a batch of Enriched Uranium with you.  They need it for their factory there.
messages.zh: 我有个朋友哈卡尔•欧戈正缺乏人手。他在阿尔勒克的核心局面公司空间站，之前我派你去过那里。反正你早晚要去找哈卡尔谈谈的，所以请顺便帮我捎一批浓缩铀过去。他们的工厂正缺这个。

messages.en: Nice work.  And don't forget to speak with Hakar before you leave.
messages.zh: 干得不错。离开前别忘了和哈卡尔谈一下。

messages.en: The Urban Management station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} is getting low on medical supplies.  It's located very close to the border with the Ammatar territories, and due to the current hostilities between our nations, the sick and wounded keep the medical staff there busy.  If you could make a quick run to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} with a batch of antibiotics, I would be very grateful.
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的市政管理局空间站正缺少医疗用品。那里毗邻艾玛达边境，由于目前双方战火连连，那儿的医护人员为照顾病人和伤员而忙碌不已。若你能尽快跑一趟{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}，送一批抗生素过去，我将感激不尽。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  Keep helping the Republic like this and you'll definitely make a name for yourself.  By the way, Eslin Stein was looking for someone like you.  He's located at the Urban Management station in Odatrik.  Good luck.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，干得漂亮。继续这样为共和国服务吧，你肯定能一举成名。另外，伊斯林•斯坦恩正在找像你这样的人。他在奥达特里克的市政管理局空间站。祝你好运。

messages.en: The Vherokior Tribe Treasury station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} is in constant demand of coolants.  They're a pretty wealthy bunch out there, and they keep needin' more cooling devices to keep the engines of the shuttles and planetary vehicles, which they use on their expeditions, from overheating.  If you're up for it, you could take a batch of coolants over there and earn a reward.
messages.zh: 维洛奇亚部落在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的财政部空间站长期需求冷却剂。他们富甲一方，一直需要更多的冷却设备来防止他们探险用的穿梭机和大气内穿梭机出现引擎过热的问题。如果你愿意，你可以送一批冷却剂去那儿，然后你将得到一笔报酬。

messages.en: Good stuff.  Speak with Vilhara Vit at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} if you need more work.  Cheers.
messages.zh: 很好。要是你还想做些什么，请与{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的维拉若•薇谈谈。再见。

messages.en: The Vherokior Tribe Treasury station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} is in constant demand of coolants.  They're a pretty wealthy bunch out there, and they keep needin' more cooling devices to keep the engines of the shuttles and planetary vehicles, which they use on their expeditions, from overheating.  If you're up for it, you could take a batch of coolants over there and earn a reward.
messages.zh: 维洛奇亚部落在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的财政部空间站长期需要冷却剂。他们那些人都是有钱的主，一直需要大量冷却设备来防止探险用的穿梭机和行星车辆的引擎出现过热问题。如果你愿意，你可以送一批冷却剂去那儿，然后赚上一笔报酬。

name.de: Zutaten für das Native Freshfood Special (1 von 2)
name.en: Ingredients For The Native Freshfood Special (1 of 2)
name.es: Ingredientes para el especial de Native Freshfood (1 de 2)
name.fr: Ingrédients de la spécialité de Native Freshfood (1 sur 2)
name.ja: その土地のフレッシュフードスペシャル材料（1/2）
name.ru: Ингредиенты для Native Freshfood (Ingredients For The Native Freshfood Special) (1 из 2)

messages.en:
I have a batch of Dairy Products that need to be shipped to the Native Freshfood Warehouse in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} today, {[character]player.name}. They are used in creating the traditional Native Freshfood Special, which is a highly sought after meal. Our executives love it, and so we have this extremely lucrative deal with Native Freshfood corporation where we supply them with the ingredients almost for free and they make the product. To cut our losses we try to hire cheap labor to transfer the goods over to their factory.

So you up for it, {[character]player.name}? You could stop by my friends office, Benur Errus, for a treat if you want. He's located at the very station I'm sending you to.
messages.zh:
今天我有一批乳制品要运到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的土产公司仓库，{[character]player.name}。它们用于制造传统的特级土产，一种极受欢迎的食品。我们的长官对此喜好有佳，所以我们与土产公司集团有着良好的合作，我们几乎免费提供原料，由他们来制造成品。为了节约成本，我们雇佣廉价的劳动力，把物品送到他们厂里。

你愿意做吗，{[character]player.name}？如果你想尝尝鲜，可以去一趟我朋友的办公室，他叫贝诺尔•埃鲁斯。他就在我让你去的那个空间站里。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  Don't forget to pay Benur Errus a visit.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。不要忘了去拜访一下贝诺尔•埃鲁斯。

name.ru: Очистить торговый путь (Clear the Trade Route)

messages.en:
Hello, {[character]player.name}. I'm on the lookout for someone who can handle a combat ship, if you know what I mean. You see, there is currently a trade agreement between Native Freshfood and Vherokior Tribe: They supply us with dairy products, and in return we sell them our meals for a very low price. Usually we get many convoys each day from their station in Teonusude, but there has been a problem recently. There is apparently a rogue drone hive somewhere in that system, and the security forces haven't been able to locate it. Our convoys have been attacked occasionally when they are passing through.

Fortunately, our last convoy that was attacked managed to escape, giving us the exact coordinates of where it was ambushed. These drones don't have any common sense, so they're probably still there. Apparently they have taken control over a warp disruptor device near a research outpost and are using it to "capture" passing ships. We've already managed to disable the device remotely, but we need someone to take care of the drones. And that's where you come in. You up for it?
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}。我正在寻找一个会操作武器的人，嘿，你应该懂我的意思。你看，目前在土产公司和维洛奇亚部族之间有一个贸易协定，他们供应我们乳制品，作为回报，我们以极低的价格卖给他们粮食。通常情况下，他们提鲁苏德里的空间站每天会派许多护航队护送乳制品过来。但是现在有一个问题，他们星系中某处有一个自由无人机母巢，而安全部队一直没有找到具体位置，结果我们的护航队在经过那一区域时，不时会受到袭击。

我们的护航队在最近一次袭击中幸免于难，并给了我们受到埋伏的确切位标。这些无人机不可以常理而论，很可能还在那里。他们控制了边域研究站附近的跃迁扰断器，并利用它“捕获”来往的舰船。不过我们已经远程破坏了那个装置，现在需要有人替我们干掉那些无人机。该是你出马的时候了。你行么？

messages.en: Nice job, {[character]player.name}.  I couldn't have done it better myself.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。和我的水准相当。

name.ja: 土地のフレッシュフードスペシャル

messages.en: A friend of mine, Vilhara Vit, is expecting a shipment of our famous Native Freshfood Special.  I'd like you to make the delivery for me.  I'll pay well, of course ...
messages.zh: 维拉若•薇是我的一个朋友，他希望我送一批我们这儿有名的特级土产过去。我想请你帮我送过去。当然，我会给你不错的报酬……

name.ru: Подбросить туристов (Tourists Need A Lift) (2 из 2)

messages.en:
Your next job is a little more risky, it will send you into 0.5 security space. I doubt you'll encounter any pirates on the way, but you never know.

What I need you to do is transport a few tourists to the Krusual Tribe station in Hek. Hek is a popular tourist area these days and we always have people on the lookout for cheap flights there. If you're up for it, I'll let them know.
messages.zh:
接下来的任务有点危险，你将要进入安全系数0.5的空间。说不定你会在路上遇到海盗，可是谁也说不准。

我要你做的就是将一些游客送到赫克的克鲁夏部族空间站。赫克最近可是旅游热点，许多人都等着搭便宜的飞船。如果你对此有兴趣，我可以转告他们。

messages.en: Thank goodness you arrived there safely.  And by the way, Evika Deng was looking for you.  You'll find her at the Krusual Tribe station in Hek.
messages.zh: 谢天谢地，你安全抵达了。顺便说一声，伊薇卡•德正在找你。你能在赫克的克鲁夏部族空间站找到她。

messages.en:
The Republic Fleet keeps demanding more troops due to the current hostilities with the Amarr-Caldari alliance, and we're forced to comply. I don't know where this will end; so many youths lost in battle... I just hope this won't be like the Great Wars, when an entire generation was almost lost. Ah, tragedy.

Anyway, we cannot avoid our duty. Could you transport a few of these troops to the Republic Fleet station in Lustrevik? I would be very grateful; good, reliable independent transport is hard to find these days.
messages.zh:
由于目前与艾玛—加达里联盟的紧张关系，共和舰队一直在要求更多的部队增援，我们不得不遵从。我不知道这何时会结束，这么多的年轻士兵战死沙场……我只是希望这次不会像之前的大战一样，几乎整整一代年轻人死于战争。哎，真是一场悲剧。

可是无论如何，我们都不能逃避责任。你能帮忙运输增援部队到劳斯特威克星系的共和舰队空间站去吗？万分感谢，要知道这些日子很难找值得信赖的优秀飞行员。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You can continue working for various corporations in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} as long as you like. I suggest finding an agent who has a more of a variety of tasks available; simply search the stations that are owned by a corporation within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} and you are bound to find an agent to your liking.

You can also search for available agents by checking the database information for the corporation of your choice. To do that, simply open the "People and Places" menu through your NeoCom and search for the corporation name. Right-click on it and choose "show info." There, you should find a list of all of that corporation's agents who are available to you. An agent's division should give you a hint as to what type of mission he or she is likely to give you.

Take care!
messages.zh:
干得不错，{[character]player.name}。只要你愿意，你就可以继续为{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的军团工作。我建议你寻找一个可以提供更多种类任务的代理人，只需搜索{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}下任意一个军团的空间站，你就一定能找到一个符合你兴趣的代理人。

你也可以查看你所选军团的数据库信息来搜索对你开放的代理人。要这样做，你只需打开控制边栏上的“人物和地点”菜单并搜索军团名称。右键单击搜索结果，然后选择“显示信息”。然后你应该可以看到该军团下所有对你开放的代理人。了解代理人所属的部门可以告诉你这个代理人会给你什么类型的任务。

保重！

messages.en: I'll take it, but does this mean we're invading the Federation?
messages.zh: 我接受任务，但这是否意味着我们即将入侵盖伦特联邦？

messages.en: No, we're just strengthening our position there in case of an attack.  With the political climate as bad as it is today, we need to be prepared.
messages.zh: 不，我们只是稳固自己的阵地，以防有人对我们发起进攻。由于如今政治环境相当恶劣，我们需要有所防范。

messages.en: I need a hand with a courier job.  The Emperor Family has ordered the movement of millions of foot soldiers to Saidusairds, which is on the Federation - Empire border.  Since {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} is one of the chief suppliers of these troops, our local transportation service is currently flooded.  What I'd like you to do is take one small group of light marines to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, and drop them off at the Carthum Conglomerate station there.  I'm not authorized to send someone like you into low secure space, so unfortunately I can't pay you for making the entire run.  But it will at least save us half the journey.
messages.zh: 我需要有人帮我做个快递任务。皇室专署集团已经下令让数百万步兵前往联邦和帝国交界处的塞杜萨瑞斯。由于{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}是这些部队的主要补给供应商之一，我们当地的运输队已经忙得焦头烂额。我希望你把一小支轻装海军陆战队员送去{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的天主凝聚会空间站。我无权派你这样的人进入低安全等级空间，所以我不能雇你跑完整个行程。不过这至少使我们彼此都节省了一半的路程。

messages.en: Nice work, {[character]player.name}.  I suggest you speak with Ilia Abazen at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, she has a job or two for you.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。我建议你与{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的伊丽雅•阿贝泽谈一下，她有工作给你。祝你好运。

What I'd like you to do is take one small group of light marines to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, and drop them off at the Carthum Conglomerate station there.  I'm not authorized to send someone like you into low secure space, so unfortunately I can't pay you for making the entire run.  But it will at least save us half the journey.
messages.zh: 我需要有人帮我完成快递任务。皇室已经命令上百万步兵前往盖伦特联邦和艾玛帝国交界处的塞杜萨瑞斯。{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}是这些部队最主要的补给所，当地的运输队已经忙得焦头烂额。我希望你把这些轻装陆战队员送去{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的天主凝聚会空间站。我无权派你去如此不安全的地带，而且我还不能付给你报酬，但至少这样会节省我们很多时间和精力。

messages.en: One of our executives needs to be delivered to the Sarum station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} for a meeting.  He's running pretty late and we haven't managed to find suitable transportation for him in time.  Could you make a quick run to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and deliver him to this destination?  I would be very grateful.
messages.zh: 我们有个执行官需要被送往{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的萨拉姆空间站参加一次会议。他快要赶不及了，但我们还没给他找到合适的运输飞船。你能迅速赶去{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}，并把他送到目的地吗？我会非常感激你的。

messages.en: Good job.  I suggest that you pay a visit to Korini Nakan, at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  He has some work that you might be interested in.
messages.zh: 做得好。我建议你去看看克里尼•纳坎，他在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。或许他有你感兴趣的工作。

messages.en: One of our executives needs to be delivered to the Sarum station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} for a meeting.  He's running pretty late and we haven't managed to find suitable transportation for him in time.  Could you make a quick run to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and deliver him to this destination?  I would be very grateful.
messages.zh: 我们有个执行官需要到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的萨拉姆空间站开会。时间紧迫，我们一直没找到合适的运输飞船。你能迅速赶去{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}，把他送到目的地吗？我会很感激你的。

name.fr: Des robots pour la Sarum Family
name.ja: サルム一族のロボティックス
name.ru: Роботехника для семьи Sarum (Robotics For Sarum Family)
name.zh: 萨拉姆家族的机器人装置

messages.en: I need you to make a standard shipment of robotics to the Sarum Family station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, {[character]player.name}.  Just drop off the shipment there and Sarum personnel will pick it up.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我要你把一批标准货量的机器人装置送到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的萨拉姆家族空间站。把东西放在那就行了，萨拉姆职员会收取的。

messages.en: I suggest you speak with the Sarum agent Korini Nakan, he's always on the lookout for someone like yourself.
messages.zh: 我建议你和萨拉姆代理人克里尼•纳坎交谈一下，他一直在寻找像你这样的人。

messages.en: I need you to make a standard shipment of robotics to the Sarum Family station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, {[character]player.name}.  Just drop off the shipment there and Sarum personnel will pick it up.  You up for it?
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我要你把一批标准货量的机器人装置送到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的萨拉姆家族空间站。把东西放在那就行了，萨拉姆职员会收取的。你愿意干吗？

messages.en: I have a shipment of goods to deliver to the Ministry of War in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, and I was wondering if you could make the run for me, {[character]player.name}.  You'll be paid in full, of course.
messages.zh: 我有一船的货物需要运送到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的军务部，{[character]player.name}，我想知道你是否可以帮我跑一趟。当然你的报酬丰厚。

messages.en: I suggest you visit Kanori Agored's office while you're at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. He just might have a job for you. Good luck.
messages.zh: 我建议你在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}时，去卡诺里•阿戈尔的办公室走一趟。他也许有工作要给你。祝你好运。

messages.en: I need to get another shipment of small arms to our troops in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, {[character]player.name}.  Could you make a trip to the Imperial Navy station there and drop them off at the docking bay?  You'll be rewarded ...
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我需要给{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的军队再运送一批小型军械。  你能到那里的帝国海军空间站跑一趟，把这些东西放到船坞吗？  你会得到奖赏的……

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}.  If you're still looking for work, I know Utaka Orasa at the Navy station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} has been looking for someone like you.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。如果你正在找活干，我知道{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}里海军空间站的乌塔卡•奥拉萨正需要人手。

messages.en: We just received a shipment of arms cache, which means another group of our slave troops has been equipped and is ready to move out.  If you have spare time on your hands, {[character]player.name}, I would like you to help us move them to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  Drop them off at the Imperial Navy station there, and my colleagues will take care of the rest.
messages.zh: 我们刚收到一船武器储备，并用它武装了一个劳工兵团，正待出发。  如果你有空，{[character]player.name}，我希望你帮我们把他们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的帝国海军空间站。  余下的事我同事会处理。

messages.en: We just received a shipment of arms cache, which means another group of our slave troops has been equipped and is ready to move out.  If you have spare time on your hands, {[character]player.name}, I would like you to help us move them to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}. messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} surveillance spotted a small team of Thukker mercenaries in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, probably up to no good. They're wanted men, and need to be taken care of. I would ask you to bring them in for trial but that really isn't necessary, the exception being their captain. I want him taken alive and brought to me. We'd like to figure out exactly what they've been up to.

Your objectives in this mission are not as simple as they sound, however. We haven't been able to locate their captain's hideout yet. but we expect him to show up if you warp to some of his minions who are holed up in a small asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. So I suggest you destroy the first group of mercenaries you encounter as fast as you can, before more reinforcements arrive, or you'll have a heck of a battle on your hands.
messages.zh:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的侦察系统在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了一小队图克尔雇佣兵，八成不是在干什么好事。他们都是通缉犯，需要妥善处理。我想没必要抓他们回来审讯，但他们的队长除外。去将他生擒然后带到我这儿来，我们要查出他们究竟在那里干什么。

不过，你这次任务的目标不像听上去那么简单。我们还没能找到他们队长的藏身处，但是如果你跃迁至{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}他手下聚集的一个小行星带，他有可能会出现。我建议你在增援到达之前尽快消灭第一批出现的佣兵，要不然的话你就有的好受了。

messages.en: Good work.  But it seems that your captive is no longer of use to us.  My guess is that he injected himself with a deadly viral agent before you arrived.  But don't worry, we expected as much, and we have an antidote ready for you in the infirmary.  However, this will complicate matters a bit.  Now we have to wait for them to make the next move ...
messages.zh: 干得好。不过似乎你的俘虏已经对我们没什么用了。我猜他在你到达之前给自己注射了一种致命病毒剂。不过别担心，我们早料到了，因此我们在医院准备了一些解毒剂。但是，这会使事态稍微复杂一些。我们现在只能等他们采取下一步行动了……

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} surveillance spotted a small team of Thukker mercenaries in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, probably up to no good.
