那个数据段一定含有极其有价值的数据，这肯定是我们每次运送它时都会遭到阻碍的原因。因此，我决定将科学家和设备都带到我这儿来。但是，在此之前还有一个问题需要你解决。我们遇害的特工在潜伏时发现了血袭者要塞的坐标，并在死之前将它写了下来。它就在咖利萨斯的泥沼要塞里。找到它并不困难，泥沼要塞在大多数传统的星图中都有标记。

情报里还提到有一些克尔鲁姆指挥官驻扎在那里并指挥大局。我希望你至少干掉其中一个指挥官，并将其勋章带给我。我们会看到这对他们在埃拉茨的运作有什么影响。

name.ru: Царь горы (King of the Hill) (6 из 13)

messages.en: You told me to come back when I wanted another job, so here I am.
messages.zh: 你说过如果我想要得到工作时，可以随时回来找你，所以我来了。

messages.en: It looks like your skills have been noticed by higher echelons of my section. There is somebody expecting you, he goes by the name of Ammargal Detrone. You can find him in Nidupad. However he's very formal, and requires an official ID card before he'll deal with you. Take this note to the Emperor Family station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and you'll get your ID card. Good luck my friend.
messages.zh: 看来你的出色能力已经受到我所在部门高层的注意。现在有人想见你，他名叫埃玛格尔·迪特农。你可以在尼杜帕德找到他。但是他处世严谨，你必须具有一张正式ID卡才能和他见面。带着这张便条去{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的皇室专署集团空间站，你就会拿到你的ID卡。祝你好运，我的朋友。

messages.en: The note has been delivered. Nice receptionist at the station I might add.
messages.zh: 便条已送过去了。我得加一句，空间站接待员的服务真是太周到啦。

messages.en: I wish you good luck, here is your ID card may your experience with me serve you well with Ammargal.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，这是你的ID卡，希望你在我这的经历对你在埃玛格尔手下工作能有所帮助。

messages.en: It looks like your skills have been noticed by higher echelons of my section. There is somebody expecting you, he goes by the name of Ammargal Detrone. You can find him in Nidupad. However he's very formal, and requires an official ID card before he'll deal with you. Take this note to the Emperor Family station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and you'll get your ID card. Good luck my friend.
messages.zh: 看来你的出色表现已经受到部门高层的注意。现在有人想见你，他名叫埃玛格尔•迪特农，现在尼杜帕德。但是他处世严谨，你必须出示ID卡表明身份才能和他见面。带着这张便条去{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的皇室专署集团空间站，你就会拿到ID卡。朋友，祝你好运！

name.ru: Царь горы (King of the Hill) (7 из 13)

messages.en: I've got that ID card around here somewhere just let me get it.
messages.zh: 我在附近得到了那张ID卡，这样可以了吧？

messages.en: Please be quick, I don't have all the time in the world you know.
messages.zh: 快点，你知道我的时间有限。

messages.en: I was told to come and contact you, do you have work for me?
messages.zh: 有人让我来找你，你有任务给我吗？

messages.en: Hmm is this you? You look taller than I imagined ... do you have it?
messages.zh: 嗯，他们说的就是你？你看上去比我想像的要高……你有那个东西吗？

messages.en: Here it is, I knew I had it around here somewhere.
messages.zh: 东西在这儿，我在附近找到的。

messages.en: Very good, I believe you are the person I was waiting for. If not well he's just to damn slow. Anyway I've got a job lined up for you to get started with.
messages.zh: 非常好，我相信你就是我等待的人。就算不是，我也不等了。无论如何，我为你预备了工作，准备开始吧。

messages.en: Hmm is this you? You look taller than I imagined ... do you have it?
messages.zh: 嗯，是你吗？你比我想象的要优秀……你拿到它了吗？

name.ru: Царь горы (King of the Hill) (8 из 13)

messages.en: I'll get that device to you before you've finished your breakfast.
messages.zh: 我会在你吃完早饭前将装置送来。

messages.en: Please be quick, time is of the essence.
messages.zh: 请抓紧，时间宝贵！

messages.en: I'm here for my first assignment. What do you have?
messages.zh: 我来这里是为了接第一次任务。你有什么活可以干的？

messages.en:
I have a mission of very high importance to the empire. That data fragment you retrieved from Lord Methros' Transport Cruiser is using a very special form of encryption that our scientists cannot break without the correct machinery.

I need you to go and collect a decoding device from the Emperor Family Bureau in Gensela. From there we can start to modify it to suit our needs.
messages.zh:
我有一项对帝国至关重要的任务。你从梅多尔斯大人的运输巡洋舰上拿来的数据片段用了一种非常特殊的加密方式。没有专门的设备，我们的科学家就无法破解它。

我要你去基恩瑟拉的皇家专署集团，从那儿拿个解码器过来。然后我们就可以对此进行修改来符合我们自己的需要。

messages.en: I have the decoder, what do you want me to do with it?
messages.zh: 我拿到解码器了，下一步呢？

messages.en: Keep hold of the Decoder, I need you to use it to help us decode some of our intelligence from the front.
messages.zh: 保存好解码器，我要你用它帮我们破译一些从前线得到的情报。

messages.en:
I have a mission of very high importance to the empire. That data fragment you retrieved from Lord Methros' Transport Cruiser is using a very special form of encryption that our scientists cannot break without the correct machinery.

I need you to go and collect a decoding device from the Emperor Family Bureau in Gensela. From there we can start to modify it to suit our needs.
messages.zh:
我有一项对帝国至关重要的任务。你从梅多尔斯大人的运输巡洋舰上拿来的数据片段用了一种非常特殊的加密方式。没有专门的设备，我们的科学家就无法破解它。

我要你去基恩瑟拉的皇家专署集团，从那儿拿个解码器过来。然后我们就可以对此进行修改来符合我们自己的需要。

name.ru: Царь горы (King of the Hill) (9 из 13)

messages.en: That decoder isn't getting any younger, what do you want me to do with it?
messages.zh: 那个解码器旧的可以，你想让我拿它做什么？

messages.en:
That decoder you have does not work properly on the algorithms that Lord Methros is using, we need to get components from his machines which are fitted on almost every ship he has command over. But I have a more pressing task first for you, in order for us to program the machine correctly we need an Enigma Cipher Book, it is a set of codes that will allow us to help better decode his transmissions. Find this and collect as many Encoding Matrix components as you can find while you search for it.

Once you have proven your worth I will need you to assemble the modified encoding machine for me.

Oh and you should be able to acquire the Enigma Cipher Book from some of the pirates that infest our asteroid belts. They apparently use a very similar coding system as we found in Methros' Data Burst ...
messages.zh:
你弄到的解码器对梅多尔斯大人采用的算法不起作用，我们需要获得一些他用的加密设备的零件，这种设备几乎配备于梅多尔斯手下的每艘飞船上。但首先我有个更紧迫的任务给你。为了正确设置机器程序，我们需要一本英格玛密码手册，该手册是一套编码，有助于我们对梅多尔斯大人的传输数据进行解码。找到它，同时尽可能多地搜集编码矩阵部件。

一旦你完成任务，我将需要你组装改进后的编码机器。

噢，你应该能从遍布于我们小行星带的一些海盗手里得到英格玛密码手册。他们使用的编码系统与我们在梅多尔斯的数据中发现的显然非常相似……

messages.en: Here is that Enigma book you wanted.
messages.zh: 这就是你想要的神秘手册。

messages.en: Excellent work, our scientists have just completed work on the blueprint. Get to work and build it for us and get back to me with it as soon as you can.
messages.zh: 做得好，我们的科学家刚刚完成了蓝图的设计。按图把它建造出来，之后立刻带给我。

messages.en:
That decoder you have does not work properly on the algorithms that Lord Methros is using, we need to get components from his machines which are fitted on almost every ship he has command over. But I have a more pressing task first for you, in order for us to program the machine correctly we need an Enigma Cipher Book, it is a set of codes that will allow us to help better decode his transmissions. Find this and collect as many Encoding Matrix components as you can find while you search for it.

Once you have proven your worth I will need you to assemble the modified encoding machine for me.

Oh and you should be able to acquire the Enigma Cipher Book from some of the pirates that infest our asteroid belts. They apparently use a very similar coding system as we found in Methros' Data Burst ...
messages.zh:
你弄到的解码器对梅多尔斯大人采用的算法不起作用，我们需要获得一些他用的加密设备的零件，这种设备几乎配备于梅多尔斯手下的每艘飞船上。但首先我有个更紧迫的任务给你。为了正确设置机器程序，我们需要一本英格玛密码手册，该手册是一套编码，有助于我们对梅多尔斯大人的传输数据进行解码。找到它，同时尽可能多地搜集编码矩阵部件。

一旦你完成任务，我将需要你组装改进后的编码机器。

噢，你应该能从遍布于我们小行星带的一些海盗手里得到英格玛密码手册。他们使用的编码系统与我们在梅多尔斯的数据中发现的显然非常相似……

name.ru: Царь горы (King of the Hill) (10 из 13)

messages.en: No worries, I'll have that decoder ready for you in no time.
messages.zh: 别担心，我一会就会把解码器准备好。

messages.en: You best have it soon, my superiors are waiting on the information it can decode.
messages.zh: 抓紧去做，我的上级正在等待着解码后的信息。

messages.en: Hmm yes that decoder…
messages.zh: 嗯，那个解码器……

messages.en:
Well, if you were paying attention to me last time we spoke you should have the parts we need to assemble the machine. If you didn't manage to find them all go back to Lord Methros' compound and see what you can dig up ... Don't give away you're working for us; otherwise you will undermine our entire operation.

Take that blueprint I gave you and create a working decoder. Then bring it to me.
messages.zh:
好了，如果我们上次交谈时你仔细聆听了我所说的话，那么你应该已经拿到装配机器所需的部件了。要是你还没找到所有部件，那么你就该回到梅多尔斯大人的复合体里，看看在那儿能发现些什么……不要泄露你在为我们效力的事情，否则你会毁了整个行动。

按照我给你的那张蓝图把解码器组装好。然后把成品带给我。

messages.en: Here is the decoder, I hope you can make use of its abilities.
messages.zh: 解码器在这里，我希望你能充分利用它的性能。

messages.en: I'm sure I will. It will not be long now before we can find out what this transmission means.
messages.zh: 我相信我会的。用不了多久我们就能知道传送的消息究竟是什么了。

messages.en:
Well, if you were paying attention to me last time we spoke you should have the parts we need to assemble the machine. If you didn't manage to find them all go back to Lord Methros' compound and see what you can dig up ... Don't give away you're working for us; otherwise you will undermine our entire operation.

Take that blueprint I gave you and create a working decoder. Then bring it to me.
messages.zh:
好了，如果我们上次交谈时你仔细聆听了我所说的话，那么你应该已经拿到装配机器所需的部件了。要是你还没找到所有部件，那么你就该回到梅多尔斯大人的复合体里，看看在那儿能发现些什么……不要泄露你在为我们效力的事情，否则你会毁了整个行动。

按照我给你的那张蓝图把解码器组装好。然后把成品带给我。

name.ru: Царь горы (King of the Hill) (11 из 13)

messages.en: You've got it, I'll blow the a whole right through them.
messages.zh: 你成功了，我会好好替你吹嘘一番的。

messages.en: Make sure you make a video; it'd be nice to watch over when you've finished.
messages.zh: 别忘了录像，等你成功了再回过头看看这些，多美妙啊！

messages.en: I've got guns… Depends on the target… what do you want me to do?
messages.zh: 我有枪炮……视目标而定……你要我做什么？

messages.en:
I don't believe it! That treacherous swine. We finally managed to decode the transmission. From what we can tell it's an attack plan for Lord Arachnan and he's in league with The Blood Raider Covenant. We need to confirm this before we take it to the Emperor's House and the Imperial Navy. Go to these co-ordinates and see what you find.

Kill anything you find there and report back with any information you can find from them.
messages.zh:
那个背信弃义的混蛋，真叫我难以置信！我们破译了发射信号，从中得知埃拉克兰已经和血袭者勾结，这是他的一个进攻计划。事关重大，在把它送到皇室成员和皇家海军之前，我们必须进一步确认。去这几个坐标所指的位置，看看有什么发现。

干掉那里出现的所有人，如果得到任何情报立刻向我汇 报。

messages.en: I killed everything in sight and I managed to find this. Does it help?
messages.zh: 我把看到的一切都干掉了，还发现了这个。这个有用吗？

messages.en: Yes it does, it seems to be able to be decoded by that device you built. I'll have one of my engineers look at it right now. Get back to me in a minute and I'll see if I've got a job for you.
messages.zh: 有用，看来可以用你做的那个设备破解它。我会马上让我的一个工程师看看。赶快回来，我看看还有没有任务给你。

messages.en:
I don't believe it! That treacherous swine. We finally managed to decode the transmission. From what we can tell it's an attack plan for Lord Arachnan and he's in league with The Blood Raider Covenant. We need to confirm this before we take it to the Emperor's House and the Imperial Navy. Go to these co-ordinates and see what you find.

Kill anything you find there and report back with any information you can find from them.
messages.zh:
那个背信弃义的混蛋，真叫我难以置信！我们破译了发射信号，从中得知埃拉克兰已经和血袭者勾结，这是他的一个进攻计划。事关重大，在把它送到皇室成员和皇家海军之前，我们必须进一步确认。去这几个坐标所指的位置，看看有什么发现。

干掉那里出现的所有人，如果得到任何情报立刻向我汇 报。

name.ru: Царь горы (King of the Hill) (12 из 13)

messages.en: Spies are my favourite kind of target. He'll be dead in no time.
messages.zh: 间谍是我最喜欢的一种射击目标。他会立刻死翘翘。

messages.en: And they are my favourite kind of assignment to give out..
messages.zh: 这是我最愿意发布的一种任务……

messages.en: I've got a gun and it's still warm from helping you last time. What do you need dead?
messages.zh: 我的炮自从帮你干完上个任务后还热着呢。你这次要干掉什么？

messages.en:
We've been deceived; an undercover operative of The Blood Raider Covenant, Yamia Mida, was found working within our ranks. Once he knew his position was compromised he fled into a fleet of waiting Blood Raider troops.

That Encoded Data Chip showed attack plans against Arachnan and the Imperial Navy stationed in his area of influence, it would seem that Arachnan wasn't in league with the Blood Raiders after all.

Find the traitorous bastard and bring him to justice. We received a tip that he's located in Zimse, but that's all we know. I suggest you use a system scanner to search for him, if he's located in the middle of nowhere I assume he either has a beacon or cosmic signature nearby for navigational purposes.
messages.zh:
我们被骗了。一名血袭者同盟的秘密特工亚米埃•迈达在我们军中进行间谍活动。他一察觉自己身份暴露，就溜到了附近一支等候他的血袭者舰队中。

那块编码数据芯片显示了针对埃拉克兰及驻扎在他势力范围内的皇家海军的进攻计划。这样看来，埃拉克兰和血袭者根本不是一伙的。

找到那个叛徒并将他绳之以法。我们接到情报说他目前身在兹姆瑟，但我们只知道这么多。建议你用星系扫描仪来搜寻他，我想如果他躲在偏僻的地方，附近肯定有用于导航的信标或是空间信号。

messages.en: I have the spy, although his condition could be better ...
messages.zh: 那个间谍在我手里，尽管他的状态不是很好……

messages.en:
It seems he committed suicide rather than face justice. Probably when he saw that you were overpowering his guards.

I thank you once again for your assistance, but I've got one more task for you, if you feel up to the challenge.
messages.zh:
看来他选择了自尽而不是面对制裁。也许就在看到你的实力远远超过他的守卫之后。

再次感谢你的协助，如果你愿意接受挑战，我还有一个任务。

messages.en: Search Zimse with a system scanner for any traces of the Blood Raider agent.
messages.zh: 用星系扫描仪搜查兹姆瑟，寻找任何血袭者特工的行踪。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en:
We've been deceived; an undercover operative of The Blood Raider Covenant, Yamia Mida, was found working within our ranks. Once he knew his position was compromised he fled into a fleet of waiting Blood Raider troops.

That Encoded Data Chip showed attack plans against Arachnan and the Imperial Navy stationed in his area of influence, it would seem that Arachnan wasn't in league with the Blood Raiders after all.

Find the traitorous bastard and bring him to justice. We received a tip that he's located in Zimse, but that's all we know. I suggest you use a system scanner to search for him, if he's located in the middle of nowhere I assume he either has a beacon or cosmic signature nearby for navigational purposes.
messages.zh:
我们被骗了！有个血袭者同盟的秘密特工亚米埃•迈达在我们的军队中进行间谍活动。身份暴露的时候，他就溜到了附近一支等候他的血袭者舰队中。

编码数据芯片显示，血袭者计划对埃拉克兰及驻扎在他势力范围内的皇家海军进行攻击。这样看来，埃拉克兰和血袭者根本不是一伙的。

找到那个奸佞小人并将他绳之以法。据情报透露他躲在兹姆瑟，但我们知道的仅限于此。建议你用星系扫描器来搜寻他，就算他躲到宇宙尽头，为了航行也一定会有信标或是宇宙特征信号的。

name.ru: Царь горы(King of the Hill) (13 из 13)

messages.en: Time to offload some more firepower into these guys. I cant believe they haven't gotten the message yet.
messages.zh: 是时候给这些家伙点更可怕的打击了。难以相信，他们会没收到消息。

messages.en: Preventing their attack should send a pretty strong message to Omir Sarikusa, or whoever is responsible for their presence in Araz.
messages.zh: 对方在埃拉茨的负责人，不管是奥玛•萨利库萨还是谁，都应该从这次失败中得到警告，我们不是好惹的。

messages.en: Blood Raiders? Annihilation? Give me more info!
messages.zh: 血袭者？全歼？给我更多信息！

messages.en:
This internal quarrel is turning into a massive political mess, we've been receiving rumors of Lord Methros' involvement with the Blood Raiders, we aren't sure but if it is true then recent activities you and I have encountered would make a lot more sense. However this is to be resolved at another time. For now I have one final task for you to complete for me.

There is a large Blood Raider fleet assembling in Nidupad, which we believe is going to launch a full scale assault against Arachnan's forces. It must be quashed before it can grow any larger. If you fail I will have to deploy the Imperial Navy, but with the current situation that would cost us greatly.
messages.zh:
内部斗争已经升级为全面的政乱。我们听到传言，说梅多尔斯大人和血袭者有所勾结，目前还无法确定消息的真实性。如果此事当真，那我们最近遇到的那些事就有合理解释了。不管怎样，这不是眼下要解决的事情。现在我有最后一个任务需要你去完成。

在尼杜帕德集合了一支大型血袭者舰队，据我判断他们正准备对埃拉克兰的军队发动总攻。必须把它消灭在襁褓中。我会被迫使用皇家海军，但是从目前形势来看，这样做需要付出昂贵的代价。

messages.en: Their armada is no more.
messages.zh: 他们的舰队已被全灭。

messages.en: Amazing job.  You've certainly earned your reward, {[character]player.name}.  I will also make sure my superiors hear of your deeds, they're bound to notice.  Good luck on your future endeavours!
messages.zh: 干得太出色了。这些酬劳是你应得的，{[character]player.name}。我保证让上级也知道你的功绩，他们一定会注意的。祝你在以后的道路中一帆风顺。

messages.en:
This internal quarrel is turning into a massive political mess, we've been receiving rumors of Lord Methros' involvement with the Blood Raiders, we aren't sure but if it is true then recent activities you and I have encountered would make a lot more sense. However this is to be resolved at another time. For now I have one final task for you to complete for me.

There is a large Blood Raider fleet assembling in Nidupad, which we believe is going to launch a full scale assault against Arachnan's forces. It must be quashed before it can grow any larger. If you fail I will have to deploy the Imperial Navy, but with the current situation that would cost us greatly.

在尼杜帕德集合了一支大型血袭者舰队，据我判断他们正准备对埃拉克兰的军队发动总攻。必须把它消灭在襁褓中。我会被迫使用皇家海军，但是从目前形势来看，这样做需要付出昂贵的代价。

messages.en:
I have another assignment for you, {[character]player.name}. The military commanders on the Amarr/Gallente border have been demanding more troops, and of course systems which are quite a safe distance away from the front lines have to suffer. So I've received an order from the highest chain of command to transport hundreds of thousands of troops from our outposts here to where they are more needed.
I'd like you to take care of one of these transport missions. Fly to Khodesa, the Kador space-military training camp in Chanoun, and pick up 50 Amarrian light marines. Transport them to my location. Take care to avoid pirates around the gates which you travel through. And when you're in the military complex, don't get too close to the security outposts! It's strictly prohibited! Good luck.
messages.zh:
我有另一个任务给你，{[character]player.name}。艾玛和盖伦特边境的军事指挥官一直要求派更多的军队过去，当然位于离前线较远的安全位置的星系就要做出些牺牲了。我得到最高指示，要我们从这里的所有哨站调集数十万大军到那些更需要他们的地方去。

我把其中的一个运送任务交付给你。飞到查浓的卡多尔空间军事训练营——格德萨，装运50个艾玛轻装海军陆战队员。把他们带到我这里。穿越星门时，小心躲避周围的海盗。当你进入军事复合体后，不要过于接近安全哨站！那是严令禁止的！祝你好运。

messages.en: I hear the troops you were supposed to transport have safely arrived at their destination. Good job.
messages.zh: 听说你运送的军队已经安全到达了目的地。做得好。

messages.en:
I have another assignment for you, {[character]player.name}. The military commanders on the Amarr/Gallente border have been demanding more troops, and of course systems which are quite a safe distance away from the front lines have to suffer. So I've received an order from the highest chain of command to transport hundreds of thousands of troops from our outposts here to where they are more needed.
I'd like you to take care of one of these transport missions. Fly to Khodesa, the Kador space-military training camp in Chanoun, and pick up 50 Amarrian light marines. Transport them to my location. Take care to avoid pirates around the gates which you travel through. And when you're in the military complex, don't get too close to the security outposts! It's strictly prohibited! Good luck.
messages.zh:
我有另一个任务给你，{[character]player.name}。艾玛和盖伦特边境的指挥官需要更多军队，而国境内部的星系都得担起长途运送军队的重任。我得到最高指示，要从我们的哨站派遣大量部队到需要他们的地方去。

我把其中的一个运送任务交付给你。飞到查浓卡多尔空间内的军事训练营格德萨，搭载50个艾玛轻装陆战队员，把他们带到我这里。穿越星门时，小心躲避周围的海盗。注意一点，在军事复合体内的时候，严禁接近安全哨站！祝你好运！

name.ru: Пешки на доске (Pawns on the Board) (2 из 5)

messages.en:
You have performed admirably, {[character]player.name}. Already we have word of Methros's underlings scurrying to the cover of whatever dank, shadowy rocks they crawled out from under.

But on to other things. An urgent matter has come to our attention. Lord Arachnan has a younger brother named Thyram who has been a thorn in the family's side for decades. A few years back, he was exiled from the family and not heard from again, but rumors abound that he roams the asteroid belts here with his pirate companions. Lord Arachnan has heard these rumors but refuses to believe them, so we require someone to go out and find some evidence of the boy's being here.

Roam the asteroid belts in this constellation until you find something that belongs to him. One thing the rumors state is that, in a gesture of sardonic spite, he bestows members of his inner circle with duplicates of his family's dynasty rings, indistinguishable from the real thing by anyone who's not a specialist in Arachnan family crests and symbols. Perhaps if you found one of these rings we would have more luck in convincing the Lord his brother is out there terrorizing his own family's heartlands.

Go out and terrorize the terrorists in the belts around here. It may take a while, but see if you can't find one of these rings and bring it back to me for analysis. Perhaps the Lord can yet be convinced.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你干得很出色。我们已经收到消息说梅多尔斯的那些手下又躲回了他们阴暗潮湿的藏身之所。

但现在谈些别的吧。我们碰到了一件棘手的事儿。埃拉克兰阁下有个弟弟叫泰拉姆，几十年来他一直是家族人的眼中钉肉中刺。几年前，他被家里人赶出去后，从此杳无音信，有不少传言说他和海盗为伍，经常在这儿的行星带出没。埃拉克兰大人不愿相信这是真的，因此我们要派人去那儿找出证据。

搜索这个星系的行星带，找出一些属于这个家伙的东西。传言指出，为了嘲讽他的家族，使家族难堪，他把世代相传的家族指环复制品给了集团的核心成员，不熟悉埃拉克兰家族饰章和符纹的人根本就难辨其真假。也许你能够找到一个这样的指环复制品，这样我们就能让阁下相信他的弟弟确实是在那里，在自己家族的心脏地带进行恐怖活动了。

去给那些恐怖分子一点颜色看看。也许这会花些时间，但正好能确定一下是否能找到一个这样的指环带回来给我检查。或许我能用它说服阁下。

name.ru: Пешки на доске (Pawns on the Board) (3 из 5)

messages.en:
Hrmm. The dynasty ring plan did not work as intended. Lord Arachnan went absolutely mad. He refuses to believe that any member of his family could be involved in those kinds of activities, and he's demanded that we bring conclusive proof of his brother's involvement.

Now, I have it on good authority that Lord Methros has been hiring people to do away with Thyram. We have a double agent working in one of Methros's systems, who claims to have documents proving that Thyram is working with the pirates. Our agent is located in Munory; if you head over there, grab his dossier and bring it back to me, we will hopefully be able to convince Lord Arachnan that his brother is indeed out there, and that something needs to be done if he is to be saved.
messages.zh:
嗯。家族指环计划并没有按照预计进行。埃拉克兰大人已经失去理智了。他不相信自己的家族中有人卷入这些活动，他要求我们拿出他弟弟介入其中的确凿证据。

现在，我们有了可靠的消息，能证明梅多尔斯雇人加害泰拉姆。在梅多尔斯的某个星系内我们安插了一个双重间谍，他有文件能证明泰拉姆和海盗勾结。他现正在蒙诺瑞，如果你能够去那里把档案带给我，我们就能让埃拉克兰大人相信他弟弟的确陷入了危险，如果要救他就必须做点什么。

name.ru: Пешки на доске (Pawns on the Board) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
Good work on the dossier. We will analyze the evidence and hopefully come up with some way to convince the Lord that if he wants to see his brother alive, he will need to take drastic measures.

But other pressing matters await our attention. As you may know, Lord Arachnan and Lord Methros are both avid collectors of ancient Amarrian artifacts. Among Arachnan's personal favorites are ornamental vases from the Orozam dynasty, a family that ruled a nearby constellation hundreds of years ago and was renowned for its unique gilding techniques. Nothing quite like an Orozam vase, they used to say, and it has become doubly true since the bloodline was wiped out a little under a century ago.

We've just learned that one of the Orozam dynasty's most precious vases has landed at the Amarr Certified News Development Studio in Koona, purchased by Lord Methros and awaiting transport to his manor. Our operatives are all set to swipe it, but we need a getaway pilot to bring the thing to Arachnan's agents here in Aphi. If you accept this mission, our operatives will grab the vase and leave it in a hangar for you in Koona. Get it from there and bring it over here, and you will have done the Arachnan household a great service.
messages.zh:
档案的事做的很好。我们会仔细分析，整理出证据说服埃拉克兰阁下：必须采取强硬措施才能让他弟弟活命。

不过目前还有许多急迫的事情等着我们解决。你也许听说过，埃拉克兰阁下和梅多尔斯大人都是艾玛古董的狂热收藏者。而阁下最中意的就是欧罗扎王朝的装饰花瓶。欧罗扎家族在几百年前统治了邻近的一个星球，他们独特的镀金技术闻名遐尔。过去人们常说，欧罗扎花瓶是举世无双的，由于欧罗扎家族在一个世纪前开始逐渐绝迹，这句话更成为一句真理。

我们刚刚得知欧罗扎王朝最珍贵的一只花瓶在库纳的艾玛认证通讯社发展工作室出现了。梅多尔斯阁下已买下了它，但还没运送到自己的领地内。我已派遣间谍把它偷出来，之后则需要一个飞行员把花瓶送到埃费我们的人手里。如果你决定做这个任务，我们的间谍会在盗得花瓶后把它藏在库纳机库的隐蔽处。拿到花瓶并把它带回来，你就给埃拉克兰家族帮了一个大忙。

name.ru: Пешки на доске (Pawns on the Board) (5 из 5)

messages.en:
Your work in procuring the Orozam vase was very much appreciated by Lord Arachnan, {[character]player.name}. He has instructed me to give you further work; in fact, he has told me to hand you over to his personal assistant, Torval Kerth. Before that happens, however, I have one last job for you.

Lord Arachnan has a son by the name of Aradim. He's a good lad, though slightly pampered by his father. Him and his friends are obsessed with ancient legends of Amarrian crusaders, and they bedeck their cruisers with expensive ornaments of days past and duel each other. They call it "jousting." Heh.

Anyway, Aradim has gone missing. This, in and of itself, is not a great cause for concern, as the boy disappears all the time. He's probably out on a bender, being serviced by Gallente wenches in some nearby constellation. The problem is he seems to have left an object of some import to the family - a medal won by his father some years back, which the boy has taken to ostentatiously displaying - in the Ducia Foundry Mining Outpost in Munory. Fortunately the item was recovered by station personnel loyal to us, and there it sits currently, awaiting transport back here.

Make no mistake about the trust we are placing in you. This medal will be passed on through the Arachnan bloodline for eons to come, and few people outside the family have been allowed to touch it. Bring it back quickly so we can put the Lord's mind at ease, and you will be amply rewarded.
messages.zh:
你运送欧罗扎花瓶的工作得到了埃拉克兰大人的高度赞扬，{[character]player.name}。大人指示让我把你移交给他的私人助理托沃•克尔特，有许多重要任务等着你。而在此之前，我还有最后一个工作要你完成。

埃拉克兰大人有一个名叫阿拉迪的儿子。虽然大人可能太宠他了，可他仍是个好小伙。他和他的朋友们沉迷在艾玛十字军战士的传说里，用奢华的古代饰品装饰巡洋舰，互相决斗。他们把这种游戏叫做“马上比武”。

无论如何，阿拉迪失踪了。这是他常玩的把戏，所以我们并不在意。他也许正在哪里饮酒作乐，沉醉在附近某个星球盖伦特姑娘的温柔乡里。问题是他似乎把一件对家族有重要意义的物品留在了蒙诺瑞的杜厦铸造采矿驻地。那是一枚他父亲几年前赢得的勋章，阿拉迪拿去显摆炫耀。幸运的是，一个忠实的空间站职员发现了这个勋章，你的任务则是把它拿回来。

别辜负我们对你的期望。这个勋章将在埃拉克兰家族世代相传，家族外的人几乎不允许碰触它。尽快把它带回来，才能安抚埃拉克兰阁下紧绷的心弦，你也会受到重赏。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  Here, take this letter of recommendation and bring it over to Torval Kerth at the Carchatur Outpost in Nidupad.  He has some things that need to be taken care of for Lord Arachnan, and we think you're just the man to take care of them.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。来，拿着这封介绍信，把它带给尼杜帕德卡尔加图尔哨站的托沃•克尔特。他需要人手来处理埃拉克兰大人吩咐的事情，而你是最合适的人选。

name.ja: アーチャナンの機動作戦（1/5）

messages.en:
Why, hello there, {[character]player.name}. Agent Robikar and Lord Arachnan have both expressed their satisfaction with your work. We think you'll be ideal for some important assignments we have.

First, a bit of information on the lay of the land. We believe we've uncovered the most cunning of Lord Methros's plans yet. He is working with Arachnan's sister, Lady Eroza, who is one of this constellation's most important political figures. Our sources tell us they mean to oust Lord Arachnan and give the Lady his seat. Apparently they have gathered all sorts of archaic documents meant to legitimize the Lady's claim to power, so it looks like they intend to fight this battle on all fronts.

Our archivists have their own tricks up their sleeves, however. Working with Arachnan House lawyers, they've formed a plan of attack that should allow us to counteract these spurious legal maneuverings, which Methros and the Lady are working so hard to publicize. We need you to head over to the Noble Appliances Factory in Koona, retrieve our legal team's documents, and bring them back to the Amarr Certified News station in Aphi. Lord Arachnan is not taken down so easily.
messages.zh:
呦，你好，{[character]player.name}。代理人洛庇卡和埃拉克兰大人对你的工作都非常满意我们认为你有资格接受我这里的一些重要任务。先介绍一下大概情况。最近我们发现了梅多尔斯大人迄今为止最狡猾的计划。他居然与埃拉克兰大人的妹妹埃罗扎小姐勾结起来。这个埃罗扎小姐是这个星座里最有影响力的政治家之一。我的线人报告说，他们企图弹劾埃拉克兰大人，让埃罗扎小姐取而代之。为证明这位政坛女杰执政的合法性，他们已经收集了各种各样的古老文档。看来，他们想不惜一切代价打胜这一仗。

不过我们的档案管理员也有他们自己的绝招，同埃拉克兰家的律师一起工作，他们制定了攻击的计划让我们能够反击梅多尔斯及其夫人绞尽脑汁对外宣扬的这些不确实法律行为。我要你到库纳的高尚用具加工厂去一趟，取回我们法律团队的文件，并且带到埃费的艾玛认证通信社去。埃拉克兰大人并不是这么容易就被击垮的。

name.ja: アーチャナンの機動作戦（4/5）

messages.en:
While you were out eradicating the infestation, our agents learned of yet another plan by the nefarious Methros to undermine the glory and prestige of House Arachnan. Apparently the cur intends to steal the House's ancestral armor, one of our grandest symbols of honor and tradition.

Our House has a stronghold in Chanoun that we call the Black Barbican. It has long been one of the family's proudest monuments, and Lord Arachnan's plan for the place is to bring all of the family's precious heirlooms there for safekeeping, for the fortress is all but impregnable.

The armor has been on display in Kador Prime for a number of years now, and has just been brought back to Araz for the first time in years. Our spy in Methros's ranks tells us their plan is to snatch the armor as it is being inspected for damage in the Barbican's outer bailey. We want to show them that Lord Arachnan is always one step ahead, so we would like you to take this replica of the armor over to Chanoun, where it can be put into the bailey while the real thing stays with the family in Aphi. Imagine the ridicule they will face when this great coup of theirs is revealed as nothing more than a robbery of playthings!!
messages.zh:
就在你前去歼灭这些无人机的时候，我们的情报人员探知到那个穷凶极恶的梅多尔斯正在谋划着另一个计划，企图破坏埃拉克兰家族的荣誉与威望。看来，他准备拿走埃拉克兰家族祖传的盔甲，这是我们荣誉和传统最重要的象征之一。

我们家族在查浓有一个据点，我们称之为黑色碉堡。一直以来那儿都是家族最引以为豪的建筑之一，埃拉克兰大人打算将所有贵重的传家宝全部转移到那个坚不可摧的据点保管。

这套盔甲已在卡多尔恒星展出多年，这是它多年来第一次回埃拉茨。我们在梅多尔斯队伍中的间谍通报说，他们准备趁装甲在碉堡外墙处进行伤害检修的时候将其夺走。我们的让这些人知道埃拉克兰大人总是会比他们先想一步，所以我想让你把这个装甲的复制品带到查浓去，这样你就可以把它放到碉堡外墙的地方，然后让真家伙呆在埃费的家里。想象一下当他们发现这个尴尬的时候会是多么的白痴吧！

name.ja: アーチャナンの機動作戦（5/5）

messages.en:
Thank God for our double agents. We have a very reliable source telling us that Lord Methros is planning nothing less than an all-out strike against the Arachnan family vacation home in Aphi. The strike is meant to happen later today, so we need to move quickly.

They are aware that Lord Arachnan plans to stay in the vacation house for the next week or so. We have put the first part of our plan into motion. Lord Arachnan, in disguise, is being smuggled into the ACN Development Studio in-system. We need you to get him from there and bring him to safety, and the kind of safety we are looking for can be found only in one place: right under the enemy's nose. Take the Lord to Munory, to the Ducia Foundry Mining Outpost in that system, and do it quickly. Our people there will take good care of him.

Lord Methros wants a detailed account of his arch-nemesis's final moments to savour, so apparently he has requested that the manor's surveillance tapes be salvaged by his assault team. Naturally, we intend to pack the surveillance modules with enough explosives to scatter his molecules to the four corners of the Empire. The best part of it will be that his doom will be brought to his own doorstep, and at his own request. Ha!

Get to it now, {[character]player.name}. Move swiftly, and may God and Lord Arachnan be with you.
messages.zh:
真神保佑，多亏了我们的双重间谍的帮助。可靠情报显示，梅多尔斯正准备对埃拉克兰家族在埃费的度假庄园发动一场全面攻击。这场攻击今天晚些时候就会开始，我们得赶快行动。

他们已经知道埃拉克兰大人准备在度假庄园里度过下星期的时光。而我们已经先行一步，把我们计划的第一步付诸实施了。埃拉克兰大人经过一番乔装打扮，正被悄悄带到星系内的认证通讯发展工作室。我们需要你去找到大人，并把他带到安全地带。而在我们眼里，最安全的地方只有一个：就在敌人的眼皮底下。请将他带到那个星系里，蒙诺瑞的杜厦铸造的采矿哨站，行动要快。我们在那儿的人会给他很好的照顾。

梅多尔斯大人想要一份关于他的首要敌人最后一段时光的细致报告，所以他让他的攻击队伍将庄园的监控录像一并带走。这样的话，我们就可以在监控录像设备的箱子里放上足够多的爆炸物把它炸成粉末消散到帝国的空间里去。最有意思的是，他的末日将会由他自己搬回到家里边去，还是按照他自己的意思来的，哈哈！

这就去办吧，{[character]player.name}。利索点，愿神和埃拉克兰大人保佑你。

messages.en:
Good and bad news both, {[character]player.name}. The bad news is that the explosives we planted in the vacation house's surveillance modules went off prematurely, so Lord Methros yet lives. The good news is that the explosives went off in his family manor's great hall, wiping out a number of priceless artifacts and a good deal of the Lord's own personal guard.

Not to be overlooked, also, is the fact that Lord Arachnan lives this day, and that fact, my friend, is thanks to you. Your tireless work for this noble house has not gone unnoticed; the scribes of House Arachnan will immortalize you in our scrolls, and the annals of legend will hear your name oft whispered. From the bottom of his heart, Lord Arachnan thanks you. Go in peace, and may God bless you.
messages.zh:
我有一个好消息和一个坏消息，{[character]player.name}。坏消息是我们装在度假地监视装备中的爆炸物不知为什么提前爆炸了，梅多尔斯捡回一条小命。好消息是爆炸物在他的大厅里爆炸，无数价值连城的古董、房间里昂贵的地毯以及许多私人保镖都被炸得无影无踪。

另外一个不容忽视的事实是，多亏了你，埃拉克兰大人才活到了今天。我们会牢记你为家族所作的伟大贡献；埃拉克兰家族会将你记入史册，伟人传记中也会反复提到你的名字。埃拉克兰大人从心底里感激你。你可以放心地离开了，愿神保佑你。

name.ru: Пешки на доске (Pawns on the Board) (1 из 5)

messages.en:
Greetings, {[character]player.name}. You've come here looking for work, I see. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Stem Robikar. Nominally I am an employee of Inherent Implants, though my real function here is as Lord Arachnan's eyes and ears. Never heard of Lord Arachnan, eh? He is one of this constellation's local lords, and a brave and upstanding soul if ever there was one.

As ever happens when a shining beacon of goodness and pride exists in this cruel universe of ours, there are those out to dampen, even extinguish, the good Lord's light. Most notably there is Lord Methros, the puling wretch who believes the Araz constellation is his and his alone. It is a well-known fact that Methros's minions have been in cahoots with the Blood Raider menace currently infesting our lands - to what end, we're uncertain, but merely the fact that he allies himself with such curs should be enough to convince anyone of his utter lack of moral rectitude.

We've caught wind of one of Methros's Blood Raider patrols making inroads into Aphi. If you're interested in working for Lord Arachnan, I will task you with eliminating their current forward point, located nearby. If this mission is completed successfully, I will recommend to the Lord that we give you more work. There is much to be done.

What do you say?
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}，我知道你来此是为了找工作。允许我介绍一下自己。我叫斯坦•洛庇卡，名义上是继承芯片集团的员工，但真实身份是埃拉克兰大人在这儿的眼线。没听说过埃拉克兰大人吗？他是这个星球上的地方议员之一，拥有一颗勇敢而正直的心。

事情总是这样，世上一旦有伟大的人物出现，骄傲地伫立于高处，向众人洒下善良和希望的光芒，总会伴随着那些想要抑制，甚至扑灭耀目光芒的恶棍。梅多尔斯大人就是其中的典型，这个无耻小人坚信埃拉茨星球是他的，只属于他一人。但众所周知，梅多尔斯的走狗目前正和我们领地内出没的血袭者勾结。他们的目的尚不清楚，但和那些败类联盟的行为已经足够证明他丧尽天良。

我们从一个梅多尔斯的血袭者巡逻那里得到风声，他们会对埃费进行袭击。如果你有兴趣为埃拉克兰阁下工作，就去剿灭离这不远的前线部队。若你能成功完成，我会把你举荐给阁下，给你更多的工作。

你意下如何？

name.ja: アーチャナンの機動作戦（2/5）

messages.en:
Excellent work getting us those documents. We are confident that Methros's childish plan will be foiled. This is not his only plan, however: Almost by the hour, our operatives uncover new schemes concocted by Methros and Lady Eroza. It appears we must keep our wits about us as much as possible if we want our house to survive, for the forces arrayed against us are considerable. Guile and subversion will be our greatest assets.

We have recently learned that Methros has an observation outpost in Aphi, in the form of a Blood Raider facility, no less! We had suspicions, of course, but we were never certain his allegiance fell that way. In any case, he uses this outpost as a base for his spies, allowing them to keep an eye on Arachnan family holdings. Through this outpost, he has been able to learn all sorts of things we would rather have kept secret. This ends now.

I will upload the outpost's coordinates to your NeoCom. Bring your fury to bear on the Blood Raider scum, and let us send Methros the message that House Arachnan is not to be trifled with.
messages.zh:
给我们取文件的工作做得很好。我们肯定梅多尔斯幼稚的计划将会破产。然而，这不是他唯一的计划：几乎就在同一时间，我们的特工发现了梅多尔斯和埃罗扎女士密谋的新计划。看起来如果我们的家族想要幸存下来的话，就得时刻保持警觉，因为敌人的部队规模惊人。计谋和破坏将是我们最强大的武器。

我们最近了解到梅多尔斯在埃费有一个观察哨站，伪装成血袭者的设施，没别的了！当然，我们对他的忠心持怀疑态度，不过现在看来，我们已确定他对帝国不忠。他一直把这个基地作为监视埃拉克兰家族产业的间谍总部。通过这个哨站，他就能够知道我们想保密的各种事情。好了，就讲这些。

我会把哨站的位标上传到你的通讯系统中。把你的满腔怒火喷向血袭者的那帮渣滓们吧，顺便告诉梅多尔斯：埃拉克兰庄园不容小视。

name.ja: アーチャナンの機動作戦（序章）

messages.en: Yep. Right here.
messages.zh: 是。就在这里。

messages.en: Do you have something for me?  A letter of recommendation, perhaps?
messages.zh: 你有什么要给我的吗？比如说一封推荐信？

messages.en: Here.
messages.zh: 这里。

messages.en: Thank you very much.
messages.zh: 非常感谢。

messages.en: Letter? What the devil are you on about?
messages.zh: 信？你在搞什么鬼？

messages.en: Give Stem Robikar's letter to Torval Kerth.
messages.zh: 把斯坦•洛庇卡的信交给托沃•克尔特。

messages.en: Do you have something for me? A letter, perhaps?
messages.zh: 你有什么要给我的吗？也许是一封信？

messages.en: I'm sorry, I must have misunderstood.  I don't have this letter you speak of.
messages.zh: 很抱歉，我一定是误会了。我没有你说的这封信。

name.es: Camino a la iluminación: Decepción (1 de 3)
name.fr: Le chemin vers la lumière - Déception (1 sur 3)
name.ru: Дорога к просвещению - обман (Path to Enlightenment - Deception) (1 из 3)

messages.en: Sure, I'm skilled in Hacking, so dealing with Serpentis encrypted casks is like second nature to me.
messages.zh: 当然，我是专业黑客。处理天蛇的加密容器是我的拿手好戏。

messages.en: What are you doing in this forsaken part of space?
messages.zh: 你在这个废弃之地干什么？

messages.en:
I am a professor of archaeology at the University of Caille. Behind this ancient gate beside me you will find one of the most fascinating enigmas in existence. It is a small and seemingly insignificant object, but one that holds massive powers. The origin of this relic is still vague, though most now agree that it was built by the Yan Jung nation. Perhaps you've heard of it? The Yan Jung nation immigrated into our world through the EVE Gate eons ago. From where, we do not know, though the fragments of texts we've managed to translate talk about a mysterious middle kingdom. They settled here in Deltole, though we suspect they also colonized other systems, even in far off places. But what we've uncovered so far is here in the Deltole system, especially on Deltole V and VI, which seem to have been much more inhabitable back then.

So what happened to the Yan Jung nation, you must be wondering? Simply told, we don't know yet. Heck, I'm not even sure what the relic I just described to you was used for. I've been studying it for months and still its purpose eludes me. It has some sort of a repelling force that's almost impenetrable. It also has regeneration mechanics and perpetual power source, meaning it's as good as eternal. What the Yan Jung built it for, or used it for, is a complete mystery.

Unfortunately, the Serpentis pirates have taken an interest in Yan Jung relics too. They've sent out dozens of treasure hunters and scavengers. They don't tolerate others to interfere with their efforts, which explains why I'm hiding out here instead of being at the relic studying it. The Serpentis periodically send expeditions here and are always scouting the place. Their methods are crude, but they've got much more manpower and resources than I can ever dream of having. I've heard rumors that they've uncovered an important piece of the biggest riddle surrounding the Yan Jung nation. Over at Deltole X, close to the stargate leading to Colelie, is the entrance point to a Yan Jung site that is possibly the largest Yan Jung ruins in space still in existence. I can only imagine what riches might await there. The only problem is that a passkey is needed to activate the gate. And from what I've heard the Serpentis are now in possession of one of the key elements in constructing one.

You look like an energetic pilot. I'm interested in hiring you for a bit of work. The Serpentis relic hunters are operating from a base within the Skeleton Comet site here in Deltole. I haven't been there myself, but somewhere within it you'll find a Serpentis Survey Site, which is the right place. Therein the Serpentis store all the data and items they've found throughout the whole constellation. What I want you to search for is a map of some sort. I'm sorry for being so vague, but that's all the info I have. I'm sure you'll know what I want as soon as you see it. There's only one problem. The Serpentis are a paranoid lot, and they've encrypted all their data and storage containers. I hope you possess some hacking skills, or know someone that does, for that is what is required to get to the information I need. Get that map from the Serpentis and bring it to me and I will reward you handsomely. I feel dirty having to resort to petty theft, but when you're up against scumbags such as the Serpentis the only way to play a fair game is to follow their rules.
messages.zh:
我是凯勒大学的考古学教授。在我一旁这座古老大门的背后，是现存最不可思议的谜之一。表面看来它似乎微不足道，但却蕴含着巨大的能量。这个遗迹的由来尚不清楚，但大多数人认为殷郡民族建造了它。也许你听说过？殷郡民族几个年纪前通过新伊甸之门移居到我们这个世界。我们只译得部分关于这个神秘王国的只言片语，还不足以让我们确定他们的起源，他们定居在底托勒这儿，可我还怀疑他们曾在其他星系甚至更远的某处有过殖民。但目前为止我们只找到了底托勒星系，特别是在底托勒V 和 VI，那儿似乎更适合居住。

那么殷郡民族后来怎么样了，你一定会问？其实我们也不清楚。我甚至不能确定无疑地告诉你刚刚向你描述的遗迹到底是用来干什么的。几个月来我一直在对其进行研究，但我仍不知道它的用途。它具有某种排斥力，几乎无法穿透。而且还拥有再生装置和永久能源，这表示它永远可以使用。殷郡建造它是为了什么或利用它来做什么，这仍是一个难解之谜。

不幸的是天蛇集团似乎也对殷郡遗迹产生了兴趣，他们雇佣了许多财宝猎人和拾荒者。天蛇不能容忍他人的妨碍，这也是我躲在这儿而不在遗迹那里进行研究的原因。他们定期派遣探险队到此勘察。虽然手段非常原始，但他们拥有我做梦都不敢企及的人力和物力。有谣传说他们对于殷郡之谜的有了重要发现。在底托勒X上方，靠近通向克勒列的星门的地方，有殷郡遗迹的入口，那很可能是空间内现存的最大殷郡遗迹。可以想象有多少财富在那沉睡着。唯一的问题是需要一张通行卡来激活传送门。我听说，天蛇已经有了制作钥匙所需的一个重要零件。

你看上去精力充沛，我想让你帮些小忙。天蛇的遗迹猎人受底托勒的骷髅彗星内某个基地指挥。我没有亲自去过，但在那个基地里面你能找到一个天蛇测量点，就是在那儿天蛇储存了他们在整个星系找到的所有数据和物品。我要找的是某张地图，很抱歉我说得可能有些含糊，但这就是我所知道的全部。我敢肯定你一眼所见就会知道我要找的是什么。只不过天蛇的家伙都是一群偏执狂，他们对所有数据和舱库货柜都加了密。我希望你懂破译之道，或认识老于此道的人，因为这种能力是拿到我要的资料所必须的。从天蛇那里拿到地图，带回来给我，我会给你丰厚的报酬。用这样的方法确实有点卑劣，但当你面对像天蛇这样卑鄙的家伙时，以彼之道还施彼身是最好的选择。

messages.en: I believe this threaded waypoint map is what you were looking for?
messages.zh: 我相信这张绘满线条的航标地图正是你要找的？

messages.en: Oh, yes! This threaded waypoint map is just what I needed. Now we're getting somewhere. If you're interested in getting to the bottom of this mystery with me then don't hesitate talking to me later.
messages.zh: 噢，是的！这张航标地图正是我所要找的。现在我们正在接近真相。如果你有兴趣跟我一起揭开谜底，那么一会儿别犹豫，直接来找我谈谈。

messages.en: Hacking Serpentis encryption is not my thing.
messages.zh: 破译天蛇的加密数据或容器并不是我擅长的。

messages.zh:
我是凯勒大学的考古学教授。在我一旁这座古老大门的背后，是现存最不可思议的谜之一。表面看来它似乎微不足道，但却蕴含着巨大的能量。这个遗迹的由来尚不清楚，但大多数人认为殷郡民族建造了它。也许你听说过？殷郡民族几个年纪前通过新伊甸之门移居到我们这个世界。我们只译得部分关于这个神秘王国的只言片语，还不足以让我们确定他们的起源，他们定居在底托勒这儿，可我还怀疑他们曾在其他星系甚至更远的某处有过殖民。但目前为止我们只找到了底托勒星系，特别是在底托勒V 和 VI，那儿似乎更适合居住。

那么殷郡民族后来怎么样了，你一定会问？其实我们也不清楚。我甚至不能确定无疑地告诉你刚刚向你描述的遗迹到底是用来干什么的。几个月来我一直在对其进行研究，但我仍不知道它的用途。它具有某种排斥力，几乎无法穿透。而且还拥有再生装置和永久能源，这表示它永远可以使用。殷郡建造它是为了什么或利用它来做什么，这仍是一个难解之谜。

不幸的是天蛇集团似乎也对殷郡遗迹产生了兴趣，他们雇佣了许多财宝猎人和拾荒者。天蛇不能容忍他人的妨碍，这也是我躲在这儿而不在遗迹那里进行研究的原因。他们定期派遣探险队到此勘察。虽然手段非常原始，但他们拥有我做梦都不敢企及的人力和物力。有谣传说他们对于殷郡之谜的有了重要发现。在底托勒X上方，靠近通向克勒列的星门的地方，有殷郡遗迹的入口，那很可能是空间内现存的最大殷郡遗迹。可以想象有多少财富在那沉睡着。唯一的问题是需要一张通行卡来激活传送门。我听说，天蛇已经有了制作钥匙所需的一个重要零件。

你看上去精力充沛，我想让你帮些小忙。天蛇的遗迹猎人受底托勒的骷髅彗星内某个基地指挥。我没有亲自去过，但在那个基地里面你能找到一个天蛇测量点，就是在那儿天蛇储存了他们在整个星系找到的所有数据和物品。我要找的是某张地图，很抱歉我说得可能有些含糊，但这就是我所知道的全部。我敢肯定你一眼所见就会知道我要找的是什么。只不过天蛇的家伙都是一群偏执狂，他们对所有数据和舱库货柜都加了密。我希望你懂破译之道，或认识老于此道的人，因为这种能力是拿到我要的资料所必须的。从天蛇那里拿到地图，带回来给我，我会给你丰厚的报酬。用这样的方法确实有点卑劣，但当你面对像天蛇这样卑鄙的家伙时，以彼之道还施彼身是最好的选择。

name.es: Camino a la iluminación: Destrucción (2 de 3)
name.fr: Le chemin vers la lumière - Destruction (2 sur 3)
name.ru: Дорога к просвещению - разрушение (Path to Enlightenment - Destruction) (2 of 3)

messages.en: Sure thing, those Serpentis thiefs will never know what hit them.
messages.zh: 当然，那些天蛇窃贼永远不会知道被什么东西所袭击。

messages.en: I knew I could depend on you. Get me that micro processor and the passkey is as good as done.
messages.zh: 我就知道可以信赖你。你给我弄来了那个微处理器，那么通行钥匙也就差不多完成了。

messages.en: Well, is there something else I can do to help you?
messages.zh: 好吧，还有其他的事要我做吗？

messages.en:
The map you got me is only one piece in the puzzle of getting into the hidden relic site. You remember what I told you about that strange device that lies behind this gate beside me? It is of Yan Jung origin and I believe it can give us another vital puzzle piece. In order for me to construct a usable passkey to enter the relic site I need to understand better how the Yan Jung nation approached technology. The force repeller has a micro processor, which would give me just those insights. I am a hopeless fighter, so I don't stand a chance against the Serpentis ruffians in there. I need someone of your capabilities to get the micro processor for me.

So what you need to do is enter the Yan Jung ruins through the gate beside me. Take out the Serpentis scouts and proceed to tackle the force repeller. You can't get close to it while it's still active, so you need to shoot it from a distance. Once it blows up get the micro processor quickly before the regeneration nano-bots kick in and rebuild the repeller. Oh, and one more thing. The Serpentis periodically send expeditions to the ruins. I hope you don't run into them, but if you do make sure you have plenty of firepower on your side.
messages.zh:
拿到那张地图,只是让我们在揭开隐蔽遗迹的神秘面纱的漫漫征途上，向前迈进了一小步。你还记得我是怎样向你描述我旁边这个门后的奇怪装置的吗？它出自殷郡之手，一定能够给我们提供另一些重要线索。为了能制造出这样一张通行卡片，我必须了解殷郡民族当时的科技。力场排斥器有一个微处理器，可以让我找到答案。我一直疏于战斗，不是天蛇恶棍的对手，所以需要有像你这样骁勇善战的斗士帮我夺取微处理器。

你所要做的就是通过我旁边的这个门进入殷郡废墟。干掉天蛇的侦察机，然后去处理力场排斥器。当它在运行时，你不能靠近，所以一定要从远处射击。一旦它爆炸，得赶在再生纳米机器人前，迅速将微处理器拿到手，这些机器人会试图重建被你击毁的力场排斥器。噢，还有一点必须明确，天蛇会定期派探险队到废墟那儿。希望你不会碰到他们，但如果真遇上了，一场恶战在所难免，所以准备好充足的火力让他们尝尝厉害。

messages.en: Excellent work! Now let me take a close look at the micro processor to determine if anything more is needed to construct the passkey. It wont take long, so talk to me again soon.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！现在让我仔细查看一下微处理器，看看制作通行钥匙是否还缺点什么。时间不长，所以一会儿就来跟我谈谈吧。

messages.en: I've had enough of your wild goose chase. Do it yourself, you wimp.
messages.zh: 我受够了你那徒劳无益的行动。你自己干吧，懦夫。

messages.en: Ah, too bad. I thought you were as exited as me in getting into the relic site.
messages.zh: 啊，真不好。我原以为你会和我一样为能进入这个遗迹而兴奋不已呢。

name.es: Camino a la iluminación: Descubrimiento (3 de 3)
name.fr: Le chemin vers la lumière - Découverte (3 sur 3)
name.ru: Дорога к просвещению - открытие (Path to Enlightenment - Discovery) (3 из 3)

messages.en: I will get the binary code in no time!
messages.zh: 我会马上会拿到二进制码。

messages.en: That's the spirit. Now go get those marauders!
messages.zh: 要的就是这种精神。现在快去收拾那些搜寻者！

messages.en: So what did you find out with that micro processor I got you?
messages.zh: 那么通过我给你的那个微处理器你发现了什么？

messages.en:
The Yan Jung were more clever than I gave them credit for, it seems. The micro processor is highly advanced and my analytical methods are limited in cracking its secrets. However, what little information I've managed to glean from the processor gives me hope that we can still solve this mystery. The encryption methods employed by the Yan Jung nation are in many ways similar to those used by a new strand of rogue drones that a colleague of mine have told me exist in this very constellation. My guess is that the rogue drones happened upon some lost Yan Jung artifact here in Algintal and in assimilating it learned some new tricks.

But however it happened is beside the point. What really matters is that the local pirates that frequent the asteroid belts here in Algintal have been harassing this new breed of drones out of fear it will grow to become too powerful for them to handle. And as pirates usually do, they loot those they destroy. This colleague of mine has been doing a research on this new rogue drone breed and he tells me that the drones have developed a sophisticated binary code to interact with the Yan Jung technology they assimilated. My theory is that if we get this binary code we can use it to unravel the mysteries of the micro processor in my possession. In doing so we should have no problem in constructing a useable passkey. And the belt pirates, having hunted the new drones so excessively, are certain to possess this binary code.

In essence, I want you to go into the asteroid belts and hunt down belt pirates. From what I've heard the Serpentis are employing tough marauders to hunt the rogue drones, so your best bet is to focus on them. Return to me once you have the binary code and I will construct a passkey that you can use.
messages.zh:
殷郡比我想象的要聪明。微处理器极为先进，以我目前的分析水准恐怕难解它的奥秘。但是，我从处理器上收集到的一点资料给了我希望，相信我们仍能解开这个谜。殷郡使用的加密方法在诸多方面与一种新式自由无人机所用的非常相似，我的一个同事告诉我这个星系就有这种无人机。我猜这些自由无人机一定碰巧在阿根塔这儿发现了某些殷郡遗物，然后通过对之进行研究掌握了一些新技术。

过去的事情无关紧要。重要的是目前在阿根塔的行星带出没的本地海盗顾忌这些无人机，害怕它们进化到不可控制的地步，因此袭击了这种新型无人机。一如往常，他们在击毁对手后对残骸进行搜索。我有个同事一直在研究这种新式自由无人机，他告诉我无人机已经开发出一种复杂的二进制码来与他们掌握的殷郡技术相结合。我想如果我们得到这种二进制码，那么就能用它来解开手上这个微处理器的秘密，从而制出一把可用的通行钥匙。而行星带海盗袭击了那么多的新式无人机，他们肯定已经有了这种二进制代码。

简而言之，我要你进入行星带，消灭那里的海盗。我听说天蛇雇佣了粗暴的搜寻者来猎捕自由无人机，所以你最好把注意力集中到他们身上。一旦你拿到二进制代码后就马上回来给我，然后我会制作你能使用的通行卡片。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. I've constructed a passkey for the both of us. Head out to the stargate leading to Colelie and you should be able to enter the relic site. Good luck!
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。我为我们俩造好了通行钥匙。前往通向克勒列的星门，你应该可以进入遗迹了。祝你好运！

messages.en: Hunting belt pirates is the epitome of boredom. Get someone else to do your dirty work.
messages.zh: 去小行星带打海盗是最无聊的事。找别人去做你的脏活儿吧。

messages.en: You're giving up after all this work? You're fickle, my friend.
messages.zh: 总之，你还是要放弃这份工作咯？你太善变了，朋友。

name.ja: アーチャナンの機動作戦（3/5）

messages.en:
An emergency has come up, {[character]player.name}. An Arachnan family vacation home, set up in Aphi some years ago by Lord Arachnan's father, has been overrun by rogue drones! With most of the House's forces allocated to stemming the tide of Blood Raider activity here, we simply don't have strength at the moment to handle this.

Our spies are working hard, and we should have more information on Lady Eroza and her earnest lapdog shortly. While that happens, I want you to head over to Aphi and take care of this infestation for us. My thanks.
messages.zh:
出现紧急情况，{[character]player.name}！埃拉克兰家族的一个度假庄园，这个由埃拉克兰大人的父亲几年前在埃费建造的度假胜地，惨遭自由无人机蹂躏！由于大部分的部队被分派去阻止血袭者的行动了，我们此刻没有力量去解决这个问题。

我们的间谍正在努力工作，我们需要马上知道更多有关埃罗扎女士和她最钟爱的宠物狗的情况。与此同时，我要你前去埃费，替我们干掉那些害虫。非常感谢。

messages.en:
We've detected an illegal settlement in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. Not only do they not have a permit, they haven't paid their taxes since, well, it looks like they've never had any intention of paying their taxes. We discovered them by tracing a large shipment of ship components and planetary vehicles headed for the {[location]agentConstellationID.name} market to their outpost. I sent a small team of security personnel to evict them but they reported meeting heavy resistance, forcing them to retreat. They nearly lost a cruiser out there ...

Considering your reputation, I'd like you to take care of the dirty work. Fly over to the settlement and try to negotiate with them. If they still refuse to leave, you have full clearance to take them by force.
messages.zh:
我们在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}发现了一个非法殖民地。他们不仅没有许可证，甚至自定居以来就没交过税，而且看起来他们根本没想过要交税。我们是在跟踪一大批舰船部件和行星车辆时发现他们的，当时这批货物正在从{[location]agentConstellationID.name}市场飞向他们的哨站。我派了一小支安全部队前往收取租金，可是他们报告说遇到了激烈抵抗，被迫撤退。他们在那里差点损失一艘巡洋舰……

鉴于你的良好声誉，我想让你帮我干好这份棘手的差事。飞去那个殖民地，试着和他们谈判。如果他们拒绝离开，你有权用武力对付他们。

messages.en: Hmmph, almost none of these civilians speak our dialect.  This is quite unusual.  We will have to take a better look at this matter ...
messages.zh: 这些平民中没有人会说我们的方言。这有些反常。我们必须仔细调查。

messages.en:
Alright, I've been asked by the government agent who has been on the illegal settler case to help him retrieve some data from the information center in {[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}. He says it's important for his investigation into who these people really are, and where they come from. This data is too sensitive to send via transmission, so someone has to go retrieve the data chip for us. Considering you're already involved in this case, I think that someone should be you.

If you're up for it, then I'd be very grateful. You'll find the data chip on one of the stations in {[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}, I've uploaded the exact information to the mission details in your Opportunities interface.
messages.zh:
好吧，那位负责非法移民案的政府代理人让我去{[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}的信息中心帮他查些数据。他说查清这些人的真实身份和来历对于调查非常重要。这些数据太过敏感，不能传输，必须有人亲自取回数据芯片。鉴于你已经卷入其中，所以就成了最佳人选。

如果你愿意帮忙，我将万分感谢。这个数据芯片就在{[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}的某个空间站内。我已经把确切信息上传到你“机遇”界面的任务详情中。

messages.en: One moment while {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} investigator takes a look at this data, I'll fill you in on the results if possible.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}的调查专员正在察看这段数据，请稍候，我会尽快把结果告诉你。

If you're up for it, then I'd be very grateful. You'll find the data chip on one of the stations in {[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}, I've uploaded the exact information to the mission details in your Opportunities interface.
messages.zh:
好吧，那位负责非法移民案的政府代理人让我去{[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}的信息中心帮他查些数据。他说查清这些人的真实身份和来历对于调查非常重要。这些数据太过敏感，不能传输，必须有人亲自取回数据芯片。鉴于你已经卷入其中，所以就成了最佳人选。

如果你愿意帮忙，我将万分感谢。这个数据芯片就在{[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}的某个空间站内。我已经把确切信息上传到你“机遇”界面的任务详情中。

messages.en:
I've been informed that the settlers, which are still in our captivity, are in fact Federation citizens, or more to the point Roden Shipyard employees. That's all I've been told so far. However there was one item of significance which was retrieved from the Rolette residence by some of our personnel after you cleared the area of hostiles. It is a bookmark to a remote deadspace area in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

We haven't sent a team to investigate it yet, and I recommended you for the job. You should probably expect a trap to be waiting for you there, considering the situation in Port Rolette, so be well prepared when you make the journey. I wouldn't want you to get hurt.
messages.zh:
我了解到那些仍被我们扣留的非法移民是联邦公民，更确切地说是莱登船业的雇员。这是到目前为止我所了解到的全部。然而在你清除了罗莱特居住区的敌对势力之后，我们的人在那里有了个重大发现。那是一个位标，通往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个遥远的死亡空间区域。

我们还没派出人手去那里调查，我推荐让你去执行这个任务。鉴于罗莱特港目前的形势，你很可能会在那里陷入困境，所以在出发前好好准备一下吧。我可不希望你受伤。

messages.en: A Roden Shipyard factory!!  In {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}!?  This is completely unacceptable.  They've probably been smuggling in cheap Gallente goods to make a profit in our lucrative markets.  I must inform the government of this A.S.A.P., as this is a potential breach of national security.
messages.zh: 莱登的造船厂！在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}？这实在太过分了。他们很可能把盖伦特商品偷运到这儿来牟取暴利。事关国家安全，我必须尽快将这个消息报告政府。

name.ja: これ以上の深い愛はない（1/5）
name.ru: Самая искренняя любовь (No Sincerer Love) (1 из 5)

messages.en:
Good day, traveller. My name is Chari Shakai, and I'm one of the Nurtura corporation's chief distribution agents here in Aphi. We have one of the largest agricultural operations in the whole of New Eden, and the size of our sprawling commercial empire means that sometimes things tend to get lost in the cracks. That's where freelancers such as yourself come in.

If you've spent any amount of time in Araz at all, you have no doubt heard of Lord Methros. He is one of the local figures of power in this constellation, and his needs are often extravagant. The Lord is throwing a grand feast for his son this evening, and they are in desperate need of some Chanounian wine for the proceedings. If you can get this shipment over to Munory as soon as possible, I am likely to have more work for you.
messages.zh:
你好！我名叫查利•沙凯，是努图拉集团在埃费的主要代理人。我们的农产品贸易规模在新伊甸数一数二，但我们商业帝国的规模太大，有时不能事事兼顾。像你这样的自由战士正是我们要找的人。

如果你在埃拉茨呆过，那一定听说过梅多尔斯大人吧。他是这个星系里有权有势的大人物，过着奢侈的生活。今晚他将为儿子举办一个盛大宴会，现在需一些查浓的特产酒。如果你能尽快将其送到蒙诺瑞，我会给你更多工作。

name.ja: これ以上の深い愛はない（2/5）
name.ru: Самая искренняя любовь (No Sincerer Love) (2 из 5)

messages.en:
Good to see you again, {[character]player.name}. I was just looking for someone speedy and efficient to handle a certain matter for me that's just come up.

One of our plantations on Koona II has just suffered a small uprising. It appears the grimy shags were unable to keep their baser instincts in check, so they decided they'd try to stage a little coup. The plantation is owned by Lord Methros and sublet to us through an agency run by the area's magistrate, so it is extremely important that this little communal temper tantrum be quelled quickly and efficiently.

I need you to take a shipment of weapons to the ACN Studio at Koona IV. Get this done within 10 minutes and you will be handsomely rewarded - and the wrath of some important people averted.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，很高兴我们又见面了。我正要找一个机敏能干的人来处理一个突发事件。

我们在库纳II的一个种植园刚发生了一场小规模暴乱。看来这些愚蠢的家伙终于耐不住性子，决定发起一场小小的反抗。种植园归梅多尔斯大人所有，只是通过一个当地的代理机构转租给了我们，所以这场小闹剧必须尽快平息下来

我要你将一批武器送到库纳IV的艾玛认证通讯工作室。10分钟内完成，你就会得到丰厚的报酬，我也能免受头头们的非难。

name.ja: これ以上の深い愛はない（3/5）
name.ru: Самая искренняя любовь (No Sincerer Love) (3 из 5)

messages.en:
I have another mission of some importance for you, {[character]player.name}. It appears that a Blood Raider chapter has been staging strikes against the Amarr Constructions Production Plants in Zimse. Their requests for imperial aid have fallen on deaf ears time and time again, and since they've taken no measures to align themselves with any of this constellation's local lords they're sitting dead in the water, so to speak.

In their unwillingness to play the politics game they've opted to make a deal with us for hasty delivery of various foodstuffs, and rumor has it they're hiring independent contractors, some of them pod pilots, to protect their areas. Looks like they're preparing for a siege. Poor, silly bastards.

Anyway, one chooses one's own fate. They want a siege, they can have one as far as we're concerned. I have here a shipment of frozen plant seeds that was scheduled for delivery yesterday but was missed by the pilot assigned to it. Their cutoff point for the deal is in three hours. Get this shipment over there as soon as possible, so the poor fools stand at least some chance of surviving their self-imposed winter.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我有另外一个重要的任务给你。一个血袭者的分会正在袭击兹姆瑟的艾玛建设空间站。帝国对援助请求置若罔闻，本星系的地方首领与他们也没有同盟关系，因此他们的处境很艰难。 出于对政治手段的失望，他们决定和我们交易以求能尽快获取各种食物，传言他们雇佣一批人来保卫那里。似乎他们作好了长期被困的准备。可怜的家伙！ 无论如何，命运掌握在自己手里。他们愿意被围困，由他们去好了，只要不影响我们的生意。我这儿有一批冷藏植物种子，本来预定昨天送去，但负责这事儿的飞行员似乎忘记了。再有3小时就差不多到了这笔交易的最后期限，尽快把这批货送去，不然那些傻瓜可能连冬天都熬不过。

name.ja: これ以上の深い愛はない（4/5）
name.ru: Самая искренняя любовь (No Sincerer Love) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
The situation with our plantation on Koona II has just gotten worse, {[character]player.name}. Apparently the small arms we sent weren't enough; the slaves somehow managed to intercept the shipment as it was planetbound and kill a large contingent of our hired guards. Things down there are growing dire. The filthy animals apparently have delusions of grandeur; they've been sending coded messages intended to "illuminate" us as to the "error of our ways" and "make us see the true Spirit." We may need to take drastic measures soon.

What we have down there now is something akin to a trench warfare situation. The two camps have holed themselves up on opposite sides of the plantation and are engaging in sporadic skirmishes, but with no real losses on either side. Our people are running out of food, however, so we need to have some edibles air-dropped down to them post haste.

But therein lies the rub. Due to a recent reallocation of resources, we have nothing in that system that can be brought down to their location quickly enough to remain edible after extreme environmental changes such as the ones brought about by the hyper-suborbital crossover. We therefore need you to head over to Munory as fast as humanly possible and grab some of the dorga roes found there; they're the only thing we can think of at the moment able to withstand the journey. Bring them back to Koona as soon as possible.

Please hurry. A number of brave and upstanding soldiers are depending on you for their lives.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，种植园那里的情况越来越糟。显然我们送去的小型军械似乎并不能解决问题，那些劳工在飞船着陆时截走了货物，还害死了我们的许多护卫人员。那里的情况正变得越来越糟。那些混蛋显然是疯了，他们发信息给我们说要给我们“启迪”，奉劝我们回头是岸，还说要让我们看看什么是生命的真谛。我们得迅速采取措施，给他们点厉害瞧瞧。 我们目前在那儿的局势与堑壕战有点像，两个阵营在种植园的两端隐匿对峙，不时爆发小规模的战斗，但双方都没有实质伤亡。然而我们就快没有食物了，所以需要迅速空投些给他们。 但是问题就在这里。由于近期的资源调配，在那个星系里我们实在找不到适合投放的食品，你知道，穿越大气层时环境非常恶劣，大多数食物都会变质。现在尽快去蒙诺瑞带一些当地特产来，只有这个能够满足我们的条件，尽快把它们带回库纳。 请赶快。无数战士的生命可都掌握在你手里。

name.ja: これ以上の深い愛はない（5/5）
name.ru: Самая искренняя любовь (No Sincerer Love) (5 из 5)

messages.en:
I've just received word from Central. It's bad. It's really bad.

Apparently, the latest news from Koona II indicates that things aren't going so well down there. There's a sand storm raging down there at the moment, but through it we've been getting intermittent transmissions displaying horrible things: guards being disemboweled, their throats being slit, their eyes scooped out. I've had my reservations about blanket judgments in the past, {[character]player.name}, but I no longer care what anyone tells me. Matari just aren't human. They're driveling, putrid beasts, and they need to be kept on the tightest of leashes, lest their obscene nature ooze through the holes in their thinly woven semblance of fake humanity.

Our CEO has pulled some strings at the Trade Registry, and through them he has managed to procure what we need. Fight monsters with monsters, I say. A detachment of Kameiras awaits you at the Noble Appliances Factory at Chanoun VIII - Moon 10, freshly landed in this constellation. Let the drooling beasts choke to death on their blood as they look at the faces of their own. Only fitting, one should think.

Chanoun, then Koona. Go to it, and may the Lord be with you.
messages.zh: 我刚从总部收到消息。太糟了。真的太糟了。 椐从库纳II来的最新消息，那儿的情况很糟。肆虐的沙暴使通讯受到了干扰，频道里断断续续传来的消息描绘了这样一幅可怕的局面：我们的守卫被剖腹，割喉，挖出眼睛。{[character]player.name}，过去我的看法一直有所保留，但现在我不会再介意别人怎么说了。那些玛塔利混蛋根本不是人。他们只是淌着口水的野兽，应该被铁链紧紧绑住，那层薄薄的人皮根本无法掩饰他们凶残的本性。 我们的CEO暗中操纵着商管局，他帮我们搞到了一批卡莫特种兵。让野兽对付野兽，这再好不过了，不是吗？目前，这支卡莫兵特遣队刚抵达查浓VIII—卫10的高尚用具空间站。对这些野兽，死是最合适的下场，你认为呢？ 查浓，然后库纳。去吧，愿上帝与你同在。

messages.en:
I have strict orders from my source within the government to obliterate this Roden Shipyards Factory without further ado. He sent me this simple request as soon as I informed him of the current situation. The government will send in their own security forces later to take care of the leftovers, but the factory itself needs to be rendered inoperable immediately.

You have been assigned the task of destroying this mega-structure. I suggest you bring a couple friends with you, taking it down is not a one-man-job.
messages.zh:
我接到了政府内部人士的严格命令，要求我们尽快铲除这个莱登船业工厂以免横生枝节。当我一告知他当前的形势，他就给我下了这个简单的命令。政府随后会派自己的安全部队去收拾残局，不过首先工厂本身的运作必须立刻停止。

我们派你去摧毁这个庞然大物。我建议你带一些朋友一起去，因为这个活儿可不是单枪匹马就能完成的。

messages.en: Now that the factory has been taken care of, it's time to figure out exactly how they managed to build such a massive structure inside our territory without our surveillance forces noticing it!
messages.zh: 现在船厂的问题已经解决，是时候弄清他们怎样在我们的眼皮底下建造起这样庞大的设施了。

messages.en:
The government reconnaissance team that entered the Roden Shipyard complex shortly after you left quickly discovered something of interest, an extra hidden acceleration gate leading to another deadspace pocket. They accessed the gate, curious to see what lies on the other side, and to their astonishment there lay before them a stargate! It was apparently a smuggler gate which looks to bear the hallmarks of the Angel Cartel. However pirates were nowhere in sight, only Republic and Federation ships.

It appears as though the Federation-Republic alliance has taken over this old smuggler gate, and has been using it to smuggle in convoys of goods to {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. We discovered another stargate of Gallente design not long ago, which we destroyed, but it seems that our enemies have found more holes in our defenses.

The good part is that this smuggler gate seems to be extremely unstable. The {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} security forces almost managed to overpower the guards, but reinforcements arrived at the last minute through the gate. What they did notice was that the gate needs a few minutes to recharge before it can be used. And only a few ships are able to warp through the gate each jump cycle. This gives you a huge advantage, if you are fast.

I want you to destroy this gate. You will not need to warp through the entire deadspace area again, as we know of another way into the deadspace pocket that contains the stargate, it's located relatively close to the edge of the deadspace area surrounding the Roden Shipyard Factory Station. But be wary of the reinforcements arriving through the gate, if you are not fast enough you will eventually be overpowered. Good luck!
messages.zh:
政府的侦察队伍在你离开后不久就进入了莱登船业所在的复合体内，并且发现了个有趣的东西，是一个通往另一个死亡空间层的秘密加速轨道。出于好奇，他们激活加速轨道想看看另一边有什么。令人惊奇的是，出现在他们眼前的居然是一座星门。它带有天使企业联合体的特征，显然是个非法贩售通道。然而他们并没有在那里发现海盗，倒是有不少共和国及联邦的舰船。

似乎联邦-共和国联盟接管了这座古老的非法贩售星门，并通过它偷运货物至{[location]agentConstellationID.name}。不久前我们还发现了另一座盖伦特设计的星门，当然已经被我们干掉了。不过敌人似乎发现了我们防守上更多的漏洞。

好消息是这个非法贩售门特别不稳定。就在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}保安部队几乎要干掉门卫的时候，对方的援军来了。这个门有个特点，就是它在启用前需要几分钟的充电。而且只有很少的船可以在每个跳跃期里跃迁过这个门。如果你动作快的话，这就是一个优势。

我要你搞掉这个门。你不用再跃迁整个死亡空间。我们另辟蹊径，这条路位于莱登船业厂区空间站附近死亡空间的边缘。要小心对方的援军。如果你动作不够快那你就玩完了。好运！

messages.en: I have destroyed the stargate, as you requested {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 如你所愿，{[character]agentID.name}，我摧毁了整个星门。

messages.en: Amazing work.  You've done a great deed today, {[character]player.name}.  Enjoy your reward!
messages.zh: 太棒了。你今天干了件了不起的事，{[character]player.name}。这是你的报酬！

name.ko: 아라즈 성좌 내 제국 방위 강화 (1/5)

messages.en:
Hello there, capsuleer. My name is Amir Arshah. I work for Imperial Armaments's Distribution Department, and I'm tasked with making sure that all our clients in this constellation remain well-stocked with the wares we provide.

We've recently had a troubling case come up with one of our clients. It seems an odious merchants' guild known as the Girakas have been trying to muscle in on our turf. They've undercut certain of our deals here, some of them with very lucrative clients, and we have word they're not going to stop there.

The client I'm speaking of here, specifically, is a wealthy duke who makes his residence on Chanoun VII and who owns a controlling interest in the Noble Appliances Factory at Chanoun VIII, Moon 8. Having overheard the reports of Blood Raiders running amok in our fair constellation, he has ordered a significant increase in his troops' armaments. We have a shipment of our latest cutting-edge weaponry for his footsoldiers to play with; all we need is someone to get it over to him as soon as possible, before the Girakas manage to undercut us yet again and fill his order.

Do this for me and I will see if I can't find further employment for you.
messages.zh:
你好。我叫阿米尔•阿尔萨。在帝国总装部的销售部门工作，我的任务是就是保证我们星座内的客户武器储备充足。

我们最近和一位客户在交易上出了点麻烦。有个可恶的商会，叫做吉拉卡斯，貌似也想来插一脚。他们已经抢了我们不少赚钱的买卖，有些大客户也被他们拉去了，而且有消息称他们的目标远不止此。

我所说的那位客户是居住在查浓Ⅶ的一名富有的公爵，他在查浓Ⅷ-卫8的高尚用具加工厂拥有控制权益。他无意中听到血袭者在我们和平的星座内肆意横行后，就立刻为自己的部队订购了大量的军备。我们有一批最先进的步兵供他使用；我们现在需要一个人赶在吉拉卡斯插足之前把这些步兵运送给他。

帮我去做这件事，然后我会考虑是否让你干更多的活。

name.ko: 아라즈 성좌 내 제국 방위 강화 (2/5)

messages.en:
Hello again, {[character]player.name}. You performed the last task I assigned to you well, so my superiors have given me clearance to give you another. This one is rather more dangerous, though. I would advise you to either go in a fully combat-fitted cruiser or a covert ops frigate, if you've got one.

As you may know, the Blood Raiders have a deadspace complex in Aphi. Known as the Sanguine Vaults, this place of doom has seen the end of many an adventurous pilot cocky enough to brave its dangers. It is also the site of some of the Raiders' more gruesome rituals. One of the things they've recently taken to doing is implanting their victims' dried-out husks with all sorts of mechanized bugs and devices, not entirely dissimilar in make-up to some tiny, biomechanical rogue drone. This implantation has caused its share of unease in the constellation, let me tell you: If this kind of technology is in the hands of the Bloods, there's no telling what they intend to do with it. More disturbing still, there's no telling what else they could have up their sleeves.

In any case, one of our clients, whose name I'll keep to myself, has a particular interest in learning more about how these nasty little things work. Head out to the Sanguine Vaults in Aphi, find me some of these dried-out husks, and bring them back here. You will be rewarded in accordance with the danger of this assignment.
messages.zh:
你好啊，{[character]player.name}。你在上一个任务中表现出色，所以我的上级准许我再给你一个任务。不过这个任务更危险了些。可能的话，我建议你驾驶专职战斗的巡洋舰或者隐秘护卫舰。

也许你知道，血袭者在埃费有个死亡空间复合体。它被称为“血色穹窿”。无数狂妄自大的飞行员冒险闯入这里，都葬身于此。那也是血袭者的一些极为残忍的仪式的举行场地。他们最近爱做的一件事是在受害者被抽干的躯壳中植入各种机械仪器和设备，这就像安装某种小型的生化自由无人机。这引起了星座中的不安定，我来告诉你：如果血袭者掌握这种技术，那谁都不知道他们会干出些什么。更让人担心的是，目前谁都不知道他们还掌握了什么高级技术。

不管怎样，我的一个客户——名字我不讲——特别希望了解这些恶心得小东西怎么运作的。现在你要去埃费的血色穹窿，寻找一些此类的被抽干躯壳然后把它们带回来。你的奖励与此任务的难度成正比。

messages.en:
I'd like you to help us investigate a string of disappearances which have been occurring in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. The outer settlements and mining expeditions have been reporting people missing almost every day now for the past few weeks, and some small settlements have strangely become abandoned. It's become a bit of a political mess, considering the government has been encouraging civilians to move away from the cities and crowded areas, and now people are moving back to avoid the dangers of living on the outer rim of civilized space.

For your first reconnaissance mission I would like you to take a look at a small settlement in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that we lost contact with. The inhabitants had a hidden surveillance monitor installed a few weeks ago, which should reveal what happened there. Bring it to me, it is located inside one of the habitation modules.
messages.zh:
我要你帮我们调查最近在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}发生的一连串失踪事件。在过去的几个星期里，几乎每天都有偏远的殖民地和采矿探险队报告人员失踪事件，而且一些小型殖民地也离奇地被遗弃了。这多少引起了一些政治上的骚乱，因为政府一直鼓励居民搬离城市和人口密集地区，而现在出于安全考虑，人们又从文明空间的边远地带搬了回来。

作为你的第一个侦察任务，我希望你察看一下{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个小型殖民地，我们已与那里失去了联系。几周前那里的居民安装了一个隐秘的监视器，应该可以帮我们找到一些线索，看看那里究竟发生了什么事情。你去把那监视器给我带来，它就在某个居住舱的里面。

messages.en: Sorry about the trap you had to deal with, {[character]player.name}.  Those drones and sentry guns must have been set up by whoever was behind the disappearance of the inhabitants.  Thank goodness you made it out alive.
messages.zh: 我们对你遇到陷阱感到抱歉，{[character]player.name}。这些无人机和岗哨炮一定是由那些失踪案的幕后黑手设立的。谢天谢地，你活着回来了。

messages.en: Unfortunately the data chip you retrieved from the abandoned settlement was damaged, I can't read its contents and our computer experts here are unable to retrieve the lost data.  However I know of a specialist who deals with such things, who is currently residing in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  I'd like you to bring the chip to him, perhaps he can salvage some of the data that was lost.
messages.zh: 很不幸，你从废弃的殖民地带回来的数据芯片已经损坏，我没法读取上面的内容，我们这里的电脑专家也无法恢复丢失的数据。不过幸好我认识一个处理此类事务的专家，他目前住在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}。把芯片带给他，或许他能抢救出一部分受损的数据。

messages.en:
Interesting. The data chip was in fact damaged by an ultra-powerful EMP burst. This would also explain why we received no distress signal from the settlement when the inhabitants were abducted. I assume whoever the perpetrators are, they are trying to be extra careful to avoid detection.

The bad news is that our surveillance equipment was disabled by the EMP burst before it could detect who the attackers were. Therefore we're back to square one.*sigh*
messages.zh:
真是有趣。这块数据芯片实际上已经被强力电磁脉冲破坏了。这大概就是在绑架发生时我们没有收到任何求救信号的原因。无论罪犯是谁，显然他们都非常小心翼翼，不希望被人察觉。

不过坏消息是，电磁脉冲使我们的监控设备失效了，因此没能侦测出攻击者的身份。这样一来我们又回到原点了。*叹气*

messages.en:
It looks like fortune shines upon us, {[character]player.name}. In some of the more established settlements in the outer rim of {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} we have installed a continuous signal to {[location]agentStationID.name}. The signal from one such settlement was just recently broken, and we suspect that an EMP burst is responsible.

Please warp to the settlement A.S.A.P. If you encounter any hostiles then fight them, and if possible round up the survivors for questioning. Good luck.
messages.zh:
看起来我们的运气不坏，{[character]player.name}。我们在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}边远地区的一些有一定规模的殖民地都安装了发往{[location]agentStationID.name}的连续信号源。其中的一个信号最近中断了，我们怀疑这是电磁脉冲波造成的。

请尽快跃迁到该殖民地。如果你遇到任何敌人，与他们战斗；如果可能的话，抓几个活的回来审讯。祝你好运。

messages.en:
So the Caldari were behind this? Very surprising ... but it does explain the lack of captives you brought back with you. They don't like being taken alive.

I'll have to report this straight to the upper echelons of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}. We need to get to the bottom of this ...
messages.zh:
这么说背后主使是加达里人？出人意料……但这正好解释了为什么你没有带回来俘虏的原因。他们不愿意被活捉。

我要向{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的上级直接汇报此事。此事必须追查到底……

messages.en:
Shortly after you left the settlement we ordered you to investigate in your last mission, we noticed a group of ships warp to the area. They left in a hurry, probably after they discovered the wreckage of the hostiles you destroyed. I still have a trace on these UFOs, and I would like you to intercept them before they enter deadspace.

It so happens that one of our surveillance teams has been tracking these guys for a few days. They didn't expect them to be a part of the brigands attacking our settlements, but with this new evidence we are quite sure that there is a connection.

Using the data our surveillance team has acquired, the hostiles should arrive at a certain deadspace area in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} in a few minutes. Please warp to the acceleration gate leading into it immediately, and wait for their arrival. When they arrive, destroy them, and bring any survivors back to me.
messages.zh:
就在你离开上次让你调查的那个殖民地后不久，我们就发现一批飞船跃迁到了那里。他们很快就匆匆离开了，很可能是发现了被你击毁的敌机残骸。我还在跟踪着这些不明飞行物，我希望你在它们进入死亡空间之前拦截它们。

碰巧我们的一支侦察队跟踪了这些家伙好几天。他们未将这些家伙和袭击我们殖民地的歹徒联系在一块儿，但是有了这些新证据，我们非常确信这中间肯定有关联。

根据我们的侦察队得到的数据，这些敌机将在几分钟后到达{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。请赶快跃迁到通往它的加速轨道，等候它们的出现，消灭它们然后把幸存者带回来见我。

messages.en: You brought back captives in shackles?  Let me take a look at this ...
messages.zh: 你把俘虏带回来了？让我看看……

messages.en:
The captives you rescued in your last mission have told me their tale. Although frightened and quite traumatized, they've told me how they were captured by Amarr 'thugs' and forced to board their industrial. Right after their settlement was hit by Caldari mercenaries who disabled their communication devices.

More importantly, they were told that they would be transported to 'labor camps' where they would spend the rest of their life 'if they didn't behave'. This is a clear sign that Amarrian slave traders are somehow involved. Why we do not know yet.

I would like you to do a reconnaissance mission into the deadspace area you were sent to in your last mission. Investigate what lies inside; Where are they taking these people?

If you see an Amarr Slave Compound there, you need to enter it and see what you find there. I will not consider this mission complete until you have entered that part of their site.
messages.zh:
你上个任务中解救的俘虏已经把他们的遭遇告诉我了。尽管他们惊魂未定而且伤痕累累，不过还是向我讲述了他们是如何被艾玛“暴徒”俘虏并被迫登上了他们的工业舰的。 在那之前，加达里雇佣兵刚刚切断了他们的通信线路，袭击了他们的殖民地。

更重要的是，他们还被告知“如果表现不好的话”，就将被送往“劳动集中营”度过余生。 这明显表示，艾玛劳工贩子也与这件事有关。 我们还不知道原因。

我想让你回到你在上次任务中去过的那个死亡空间区域执行一项侦察任务， 调查一下里面有什么以及他们要把这些人带到哪里去。

如果你发现了一座艾玛劳工集中营，你要进去探个究竟。如果你没到过那里的话，我是不会算你完成任务的。

messages.en:
A slave compound, just what we expected. I didn't expect them to have such a formidable defensive barrier however. But you did good.

I'm afraid I no longer have authority to continue this investigation. Someone higher up the chain of command has been assigned to the case. Hopefully he'll be able to find someone capable of getting farther into the complex.
messages.zh:
果然不出意料，是一个劳工集中营。不过我没料到他们有这么可怕的防御力量。但你做得很不错。

我恐怕已经没有权力继续进行调查了。有个比我高级的指挥官已经被派来负责此事。因此希望他能够找到合适的人，将这件事情调查清楚。

messages.en:
I was assigned a mission from a colleague of mine in {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, who apparently hasn't been able to solve the investigation of a certain deadspace area in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They found an Amarrian slaver compound inside, as well as a few groups of Caldari State combat ships. Obviously this is a threat that must be dealt with.

There are two questions we must answer, how did our enemies manage to get all their equipment and ships there in the first place, completely avoiding our surveillance systems at the stargates. And how big exactly is their complex inside the deadspace area which they've been hiding in.

Our problem right now is that the path into the deadspace complex is blocked off by a large armada of Amarrian ships. I seriously doubt you'd be able to handle them, no offense. So your first task is to discover an alternate route into the complex, to avoid direct confrontation with their fleet.

I've located an old, abandoned acceleration gate leading into the deadspace area, which I'm pretty sure the Amarrians are not aware of. The only problem is that it leads to an area infested with rogue drones, who nearly wiped out a mining colony there many years ago. You will have to deal with them when you warp inside. After you have used two acceleration gates, you will find yourself in a room with the final gate, which leads to the drone hive itself. Do NOT go through it under any circumstances. Your task is to simply eradicate all of the rogue drones inside the first few rooms and then report back to me.
messages.zh:
我在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的同事分派给我一项任务，看来他无法完成对{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}某个死亡空间区域的调查。 他们在那里发现了一个艾玛奴隶主复合体，同时还有一些加达里合众国的战舰。 很显然，这是一个我们必须处理的威胁。

我们必须回答两个问题：第一，我们的敌人当时是怎样躲过我们在星门处的侦察系统，把他们的装备和舰船运到那里的。 第二，这个死亡空间区域内他们藏身的复合体到底有多大。

我们现在的问题是进入那死亡空间的路径被一队艾玛军舰挡住了。 说实话，我很怀疑你能不能对付他们。 因此你的第一要务是另辟蹊径，避免与那队伍正面交火。

我已经找到了一个旧门也可以通向那个死亡空间，艾玛人肯定还不知道。 唯一的问题就是那门会带你去一个无人机扎堆的地方。那群东西在好几年前吞噬过一整座采矿殖民地。 你必须把它们都解决掉。 在通过两道门之后，你会到一个有着最后一道门的空间。那最后一道门通向无人机老巢， 无论如何都不要进那门。 你只要把一开始见到的那些无机人清掉然后回来向我汇报就行。

messages.en: Good work.  I've notified our engineers which were on stand-by near the deadspace area to warp inside and start modifying the gate which leads to the Drone Hive.  After the modifications it should lead you to the Amarrian complex instead ...
messages.zh: 干得好。我已经通知待命的工程师跃迁到死亡空间区域，调整通往无人机巢穴的星门。调整完成后，它应该会转而通向艾玛复合体……
