name.ko: 아라즈 성좌 내 제국 방위 강화 (4/5)

messages.en:
These Blood Raiders are a determined bunch, I'll give them that. There has been a coordinated strike against our production facilities at various key locations throughout the constellation. I'll admit that we don't know for sure that the Raiders were behind the attacks, but given our recent activities, not to mention theirs... Anyway, due to this unforeseen occurrence, we're going to need to relocate some of our resources. This is a tremendous logistical undertaking, one that will require much manpower to execute quickly and efficiently.

One of our most important products is an infantry-borne anti-tank laser we're currently in the final stages of developing. Much of our stock was destroyed in the series of attacks, but fortunately we have a few crates of parts in Munory that were still due for the assembly line. Since you've proven yourself to be a trustworthy and effective pilot, I'm assigning you the task of relocating these parts to safer facilities, so we can continue to produce this weapon.

Head over to the Ducia Foundry Mining Outpost in Munory, grab those crates, and bring them to the Amarr Constructions Production Plant in Chanoun. Your work, and your silence in this matter will be much appreciated.
messages.zh:
我说，这些血袭者真是死性不改。最近我们在星座内各个重要地点的生产设备同时遭到攻击。我们不敢完全肯定这些攻击是血袭者发动的，但从我们最近的行动来看，这事十有八九就是他们干的，更不必说他们最近的动作了……不管怎么说，鉴于这种突发情况，我们准备对部分资源进行转移。这是一次大规模的后勤调动，需要很多人手才能快速有效地完成。

我们最重要的产品之一就是一种步兵用反坦克激光器，它正处于最后的研制阶段。我们的库存在一系列攻击中被毁，但幸运的是我们在蒙诺瑞还有几箱零部件可以用于组装。你已经证明了自己的能力，所以我把将这些部件运送至安全地点的任务委托给你来完成，这样我们就能继续生产这种武器。

到蒙诺瑞的杜厦铸造采矿站去，把那些箱子运到查浓的艾玛建筑产品工厂。关于这些事情和你的任务，如果你能保密的话我会非常感激的。

name.ko: 아라즈 성좌 내 제국 방위 강화 (3/5)

messages.en:
The Blood Raiders have come down hard on us for what happened, {[character]player.name}. They don't like people stealing their technology any more than might be expected of a bloodthirsty cabal of ruthless cultist freaks, it appears... A shipment of explosives en route to a contingent of Lord Arachnan's armed forces has been intercepted and all our personnel killed. It's beginning to look like we have to show these bloody-minded creeps a thing or two.

I want you to head down to Zimse, where rumor has it they have a small outpost. Eliminate all opposition you find there. One hopes your actions will send them the message that Imperial Armaments are not to be trifled with. Report back to me when you're done and it may be that I will have found some more work for you.
messages.zh:
血袭者已经就那件事报复我们了，{[character]player.name}。看样子，他们讨厌别人拿走他们的技术更甚于被看作一群思维怪异、手段残忍的乱党……一批运往埃拉克兰大人武装部队的一支分遣队的爆炸物在中途被拦截，我们的人无一生还。看来我们得给这些血腥的爬虫一点颜色看看。

我要你去兹姆瑟，传闻那里有他们的一座小型哨站。消灭你看到的所有抵抗力量。希望这可以警告他们帝国总装部可不是好惹的。完成任务后，回来向我报告，我可能还有些工作给你。

name.ko: 아라즈 성좌 내 제국 방위 강화 (5/5)

messages.en:
We've found out for certain who was behind the strike on our production facilities, {[character]player.name}. No surprise, really. The Blood Raiders have their tendrils everywhere, it seems.

Imperial Armaments is not known for anything less than a full-throated response. There is a Blood Raider outpost in Aphi. The thing is heavily fortified, but we will not let that deter us. Currently residing there is a Blood Raider Arch Deacon by the name of Toran Degartat. We have it on good authority that he's the one who orchestrated the attacks on our factories. Degartat makes his temporary residence in a small munitions depot, located underneath the Cathedral at the deadspace location I'm about to send you to.

Destroy the munitions depot and kill every living thing you find there. It's time we show these bastards what it means to mess with Imperial Armaments. Return to me for a substantial reward: We value good service highly here at Imperial Armaments.
messages.zh:
我们已经确定了袭击我们生产设施的幕后黑手是谁了，{[character]player.name}。不出所料，真的。看起来血袭者的触角无孔不入。

要知道，谁敢惹帝国总装部都会被还以颜色。埃费有个血袭者哨站。那东西防卫森严，不过我们不会允许它阻止我们的。目前住在那的是一个名叫托朗•德加尔塔的血袭者总执事。可靠证据证明他就是策划袭击我们工厂的那个人。德加尔塔暂时住在某个小型军需品仓库里，那个仓库在死亡空间里的大教堂下方，我马上把它的位置发给你。

摧毁军需品仓库，消灭你在那里发现的每个生物。是时候告诉这些混蛋惹毛了帝国总装部是个怎样的后果了。完成任务后你会有丰厚奖赏：帝国总装部是不会亏待有良好表现的飞行员的。

messages.en:
Our engineers have just about finished modifying the gate that used to lead to the drone hive. It's far enough into the deadspace area to be usable for our little project of connecting it to the Amarr complex. I'm a little worried that it might not send you to the correct location, modifying these gates is always risky, and there's no time to test it.

Your assignment is simple. Get as far into the Amarr complex as you can, and bring back any important info to me. Knowing their positions and strength before we launch our assault would really help.

Oh and one other thing, when you arrive there one of our agents will probably have already gone through the gate. His task was to move the navigational beacon in the Amarr complex room. This will cause the acceleration gate from the slave compound, where we believe most of the Amarr armada is located, to fail. This should give you some extra time to finish your task before reinforcements arrive. But regardless, please complete this mission as fast as possible, or you risk being overwhelmed.
messages.zh:
我们的工程师们刚刚完成对通往无人机母巢加速轨道的改建。它位于死亡空间这么深的位置，足以用于连接艾玛复合体。我有点担心它不能将你送到正确的位置，要知道改建加速轨道总是很危险的，而且我们没有时间进行测试。

你的任务很简单。尽可能地深入艾玛复合体，并且把任何重要的信息都带回来。我们发动攻击前知道他们的位置和兵力会大有益处。

噢，还有一件事。你到达以后，我方的一名特工很可能已经穿过了加速轨道。他的任务是移动艾玛复合体空间内的导航信标。这将导致劳工集中营的加速轨道失效，绝大部分艾玛舰队都驻扎在那儿。这将给你一些额外的时间在敌方增援力量赶到前完成任务。但是，我希望你能尽快的完成这项任务，不然就会变得很麻烦。

messages.en: So you retrieved a data chip, from one of the control towers.  Excellent.  I'll have it looked at immediately.
messages.zh: 这么说，你从一个控制塔中得到了数据芯片？好极了。我马上就来看一下。

Our engineers have just about finished modifying the gate that used to lead to the drone hive. It's far enough into the deadspace area to be usable for our little project of connecting it to the Amarr complex. messages.en: I'm afraid I can't decode the information inside the data chip you recovered from the Amarr complex earlier.  You'll have to deliver it to an old friend of mine in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, he has the necessary tools to crack the code.  Check the mission details in your Opportunities interface for further information.
messages.zh: 对于你之前从艾玛复合体中取回的数据芯片，我担心无法破译内部信息。不如去找找我在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的旧友，他有破解密码所需的工具。查看“机遇”界面的任务详情，进一步了解情况。

messages.en: Good work.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮。

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't decode the information inside the data chip you recovered from the Amarr complex earlier.  You'll have to deliver it to an old friend of mine in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, he has the necessary tools to crack the code.  Check the mission details in your Opportunities interface for further information.
messages.zh: 对于你之前从艾玛复合体中取回的数据芯片，我担心无法破译内部信息。不如去找找我在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的旧友，他有破解密码所需的工具。查看“机遇”界面的任务详情，进一步了解情况。

messages.en:
The data you retrieved earlier has some very important information. I don't know if the Amarr forces have guessed that the data chip you recovered had survived the explosion of the control tower, but either way we need to move fast while we still have the advantage.

This data directs us to two areas in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. One is the deadspace area that you must be familiar with by now, the other area is not in deadspace. I would like you to investigate area two. I will add a bookmark to the mission details in your Opportunities interface of course.
messages.zh:
你之前获取的数据中有一些信息非常重要。我不知道艾玛部队是否已经察觉，你取回的数据芯片没有在控制塔爆炸中销毁。无论如何，我们都要趁还有优势的时候赶紧行动。

这些数据指向了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}中的两个区域。一个就是你熟得不能再熟的死亡空间，但另一个却不在那里。我希望你能去调查一下第二个区域的位置。当然，我会在“机遇”界面的任务详情中添加位标。

messages.en: A Caldari stargate hidden inside a man-made ion field?  This is an amazing discovery, {[character]player.name}.  But we must keep this quiet.  If the general public hears about this, it may cause mass panic.
messages.zh: 一个加达里的星门藏在人造离子场内？真令人惊讶，{[character]player.name}。但我们必须保密。如果公众听到了这个消息，一定会引起恐慌。

messages.en:
The data you retrieved earlier has some very important information. I don't know if the Amarr forces have guessed that the data chip you recovered had survived the explosion of the control tower, but either way we need to move fast while we still have the advantage.

This data directs us to two areas in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. One is the deadspace area that you must be familiar with by now, the other area is not in deadspace. I would like you to investigate area two. I will include a bookmark in the mission details uploaded to your Opportunity interface of course.
messages.zh:
你之前获取的数据中有一些信息非常重要。我不知道艾玛部队是否已经察觉，你取回的数据芯片没有在控制塔爆炸中销毁。无论如何，我们都要趁还有优势的时候赶紧行动。

这些数据指向了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}中的两个区域。一个就是你熟得不能再熟的死亡空间，但另一个却不在那里。我希望你能去调查一下第二个区域的位置。当然，我会把上传到“机遇”界面的位标加入任务详情。

messages.en: I consider myself a proficient archaeologist, so this will be a trivial matter for me.
messages.zh: 我是个优秀的考古学家，这对我来说是小菜一碟。

messages.en: If you say so. Show me there's more to you than just your big mouth.
messages.zh: 如果你这么说。拿出事实来证明你不是吹牛。

messages.en: What is this place and who are you?
messages.zh: 这是哪儿，你又是谁？

messages.en:
The Museum Arcana is a private establishment were connoisseurs of all things old and arcane can pursue their interest. Within you will find many collectors from all over, but I must warn you that they are fervent followers of their chosen hobby and do not suffer fools or over eager treasure hunters.

We do not let just anyone enter the museum. You have proved that you possess at least rudimentary knowledge of archaeology, but to pass into the museum proper you must first complete a little task I will set you. My formal title is the Doorkeeper, but I seldom use it. All you have to do to pass this little test is analyse the little casket beside me. There is a runic inscription hidden there somewhere, and I want you to bring it to me. You can also find the key to the gate leading to the museum, so look closely. The key you can keep, and it grants you full access to the museum. Just to make this a little interesting I will give you a good bonus reward if you manage to complete your assessment of the casket in less than 5 minutes.
messages.zh:
阿卡纳博物馆是一个私人场所，为喜好研究古董秘宝的行家提供一个交流平台。在那儿你能找到许多来自各地的收藏者，但记得一点，他们对自己的兴趣都很热衷，不能容忍白痴或一些过分狂热的寻宝者。

不是所有人都能随意进入博物馆。你已经证明了自己拥有考古学的基本知识，但要真正进入博物馆，必须先完成我布置的一个小任务。要知道我的正式头衔是看门人，尽管我很少使用它。你的任务就是分析一下我边上的这个匣子。在它内部有一处符文铭刻，把它找出来。细心点，通往博物馆的钥匙也隐藏在匣子里。你可以留着钥匙，今后就能畅通无阻地进入博物馆了。为了增添一点小小的乐趣，如果你能在5分钟内完成对匣子的鉴定，还会有额外的奖励。

messages.en: I told you this would be easy for me. Here's your inscription.
messages.zh: 我说过这任务太简单了。这就是铭文。

messages.en: Well done. Have fun in the museum, but watch out for those collectors, they can be brutal.
messages.zh: 干得好！在博物馆里玩得开心点，但要注意那些收藏者，他们可能很野蛮。

messages.en: I'm not interested in visiting the museum at the moment.
messages.zh: 我现在不想去博物馆。

messages.en: Suit yourself. I will not test you again, but you can analyze the casket whenever you want.
messages.zh: 请随便坐。我不会再考验你，你随时可以对这个匣子进行分析。

messages.en:
In your last mission for me you discovered a Caldari stargate inside {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. This must be taken care of, before the Caldari fleet manages to bypass our entire defense system. So far they seem to be content with laying low and getting on with their business in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, but that could change when they find out they have been discovered.

So don't screw this up, {[character]player.name}. You have one shot to get this right. The Caldari Fleet could be coming through that gate any minute now, so you need to work fast. Destroy the stargate before the Caldari manage to send more ships through. Our scanners have already detected some activity around the gate, so you will probably have to fend off a few fighters to get the job done. If you can't handle it, then let me know ASAP so I can find someone more suitable. Good luck out there, soldier.
messages.zh:
在上次任务中，你在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}发现了一座加达里星门。 这事必须尽早处理，免得加达里舰队最终绕过我们整个防御系统。 目前为止，他们还满足于在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}悄悄进行地下活动，可是一旦他们察觉自己行踪败露，情况可能就会改变。

千万别搞砸了，{[character]player.name}。 你只有一次机会。 加达里舰队随时可能穿过那扇星门，所以你一定要行动迅速。 在加达里派更多飞船穿过之前，摧毁那座星门。 我们的扫描仪已经探测到了星门附近的一些活动，所以你可能需要干掉一些战舰才行。 如果你对付不了他们，那请第一时间告诉我以便我另找人选。 祝你好运，士兵。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.  Considering how fast you managed to destroy the gate, I believe it must have been damaged already.  Those Caldari gates can usually take more of a beating.  But anyhow, you did good, and saved us a heap-load of potential trouble.  But here is where our involvement in this case ends.  Dealing with the remainder of the Amarr slave complex is for someone higher up the chain of command.
messages.zh: 做得好，{[character]player.name}。你这么快就摧毁了星门，看来它原本就已经受损了。加达里的星门通常比较坚固。但不管怎样，你做得很好，为我们免去一大堆潜在的麻烦。现在该是我们这次行动该结束的时候了。处理艾玛劳工集中营是那些高级官员的事情。

name.en: In the Midst of Deadspace (1 of 5)
name.es: En medio del espacio muerto (1 de 5)
name.ja: デッドスペースの中央にて（1/5）
name.ru: В глубине дэдспейса (In the Midst of Deadspace) (1 из 5)

messages.en:
It has come to my attention that another agent within {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} revealed a sizable deadspace area inside {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} that has apparently been claimed by the Amarr - Caldari alliance. Apparently what he found in there was more than he could handle, so it has fallen to us to resolve this critical matter of national security.

Your first task is to infiltrate the Amarr slave compound and destroy the fleet guarding it. The previous agent with this assignment had discovered a secret entrance into the complex. However due to his bungling the Amarr forces now know about this 'hidden' route and therefore it's pointless to use it. Instead I want you to fly in there through the main gate and attack them head-on. You should be experienced enough to handle 'em, although I do of course recommend bringing some backup with you.
messages.zh:
我获得消息，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的另一位特工在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}发现了一块相当巨大的死亡空间区域，而且那里已被艾玛—加达里联盟占据。很显然，他的发现已经超出了他的能力范围，所以这个重大的国家安全问题就落到了我们身上。

你的第一个任务是潜入艾玛劳工集中营并消灭那里的守卫舰队。上一个执行该任务的特工发现了一个通向该复合体的秘密入口。可是由于他笨手笨脚地坏了事，艾玛军队已经知道了这条“秘密”路线，因此使用这个入口就变得没有意义了。因此我反而要你从正门进去迎头痛击他们。你的经验应该已经足够你对付它们了，尽管如此我还是建议你能带些支援同你一起前去。

messages.en: Hah, you sure showed those weaklings in the lower echelons of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} who's on top.  You succeeded where they failed.  But our job isn't over yet, I noticed that you captured some of the Amarr light marines which were on board one of their vessels.  They will need to be interrogated, just in case we missed something.
messages.zh: 哈，你比我们{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}军团那群没用的废物强多了。你完成了他们无法完成的任务。但我们的任务还没有完成。我发现你从他们的一艘飞船上俘虏了一些艾玛轻装海军陆战队员。还要好好审问他们，以防我们遗漏什么重要信息。

messages.en:
It has come to my attention that another agent within {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} revealed a sizable deadspace area inside {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} that has apparently been claimed by the Amarr - Caldari alliance. Apparently what he found in there was more than he could handle, so it has fallen to us to resolve this critical matter of national security.

Your first task is to infiltrate the Amarr slave compound and destroy the fleet guarding it. The previous agent with this assignment had discovered a secret entrance into the complex. However due to his bungling the Amarr forces now know about this 'hidden' route and therefore it's pointless to use it. Instead I want you to fly in there through the main gate and attack them head-on. You should be experienced enough to handle 'em, although I do of course recommend bringing some backup with you.
messages.zh:
我获得消息，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的另一位特工在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}发现了一块相当巨大的死亡空间区域，而且那里已被艾玛—加达里联盟占据。很显然，他的发现已经超出了他的能力范围，所以这个重大的国家安全问题就落到了我们身上。

你的第一个任务是潜入艾玛劳工集中营并消灭那里的守卫舰队。上一个执行该任务的特工发现了一个通向该复合体的秘密入口。可是由于他笨手笨脚地坏了事，艾玛军队已经知道了这条“秘密”路线，因此使用这个入口就变得没有意义了。因此我反而要你从正门进去迎头痛击他们。你的经验应该已经足够你对付它们了，尽管如此我还是建议你能带些支援同你一起前去。

name.en: In the Midst of Deadspace (2 of 5)
name.es: En medio del espacio muerto (2 de 5)
name.ja: デッドスペースの中央にて（2/5）
name.ru: Посреди дэдспейса (In the Midst of Deadspace) (2 из 5)

messages.en:
The Amarr troops you captured in your previous mission are unwilling to reveal any information. In fact we've nearly lost a few to suicide. So as a last ditch effort I want them brain scanned, we can 'fetch' images from their brain which may reveal something to us. It's a difficult and risky process, but then again these are the enemy and in war one must make decisions which would otherwise be deemed unethical.

The equipment which is needed to do the brain scan is located at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Drop off the marines there and my associates will take care of the rest. Dismissed.
messages.zh:
你在上个任务中俘虏的那群艾玛士兵拒绝透露任何讯息。事实上，有好几个差点自尽。所以作为最后手段，我要对他们进行脑部扫描，以从他们的大脑中“提取”一些可能透露有用信息的画面。这个过程很困难而且风险很大，但他们是敌人，战时我们必须做出通常被视为不道德的决定。

脑部扫描所需的设备位于{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。把那些海军陆战队俘虏送到那里，我的同事会处理接下来的事。解散。

messages.en: Get back to me when you're ready for another combat mission.
messages.zh: 当你准备好接受另一个战斗任务时，回来找我。

name.en: In the Midst of Deadspace (3 of 5)
name.es: En medio del espacio muerto (3 de 5)
name.ja: デッドスペースの中央にて（3/5）
name.ru: В глубине дэдспейса (In the Midst of Deadspace) (3 из 5)

messages.en:
A brain scan of the marines you captured revealed images of a third entrance into the Amarr slave compound deadspace area. However getting through the first acceleration gate requires a key. Fortunately one of the marines knew its location.

You must once again venture to the slave compound. There you will find an armory which was hidden by a cloaking field emitter. Since we know of its exact location now, we will modify your ship's computer to ignore the cloaking field. This should make the task of retrieving the key quite easy.

Once you have the key report back to me, and I will give you the coordinates to the third entrance.
messages.zh:
对那些你俘虏的海军陆战队员的脑部扫描显示了进入艾玛劳工集中营死亡空间区域的第三个入口的图像。然而进入第一座加速轨道需要一把钥匙。幸运的是，其中一名海军陆战队员知道它的位置。

你必须再冒险去一趟劳工集中营。那里有个通过隐形力场发射器隐藏起来的军械库。既然我们知道了它的确切位置，我们就能改装你的舰载计算机，使隐形力场失效。这应该能使取得钥匙的任务变得很容易。

一旦你得到钥匙，立刻回来向我报告，然后我会把第三个入口的坐标给你。

messages.en: I have the Imperial Navy Gate Permit and I have destroyed the targets.
messages.zh: 我有了帝国皇家海军通行许可，并已经消灭了目标。

messages.en: Great, now that we have the key it's time to use it.  Let's see what lies at the other side.
messages.zh: 好，现在钥匙到手了，该把它派上用场了。我们来看看那边到底是什么。

name.es: En medio del espacio muerto (4 de 5)
name.ja: デッドスペースの中央にて（4/5）
name.ru: В глубине дэдспейса (In the Midst of Deadspace) (4 из 5)

messages.en:
Now that we have the keycard it's time to send you to the third gate. Make sure you're well equipped and ready for anything the Amarr or Caldari might pit you against, because I have absolutely no idea what lies beyond the acceleration gate.

I will fit your ship with some high tech sensors of my own, just in case I'm able to spot something that you miss. Don't worry, it won't fill a module slot. Now get going!
messages.zh:
既然我们有了钥匙卡，是时候派你去第三个入口了。务必使你自己全副武装，而且为艾玛人或加达里人可能设置的任何陷阱做好准备，因为我根本不知道加速轨道另一边有什么在等着你。

我将给你的飞船装上我自己的高科技感应器，只是以防万一，也许我会发现你错过的东西。别担心，它不会占用装备槽。好了，现在出发吧！

messages.en:
Another stargate located inside our jurisdiction! Thank goodness you managed to destroy it. No wonder the Amarr forces had such an easy time bringing in reinforcements.

Now only the final assault on their headquarters is left. This will truly test your mettle, so get ready!
messages.zh:
在我们的辖区内有另一个星门！谢天谢地，你摧毁了它。怪不得之前艾玛的援军来得这么及时。

现在，只剩下对总部的最后袭击了。真正测试你勇气的时候到了，做好准备吧！

messages.en: Sure, I'll look for this Primer.
messages.zh: 好，我会找这本祷书的。

messages.en: Take care amongst all the collector sharks out there.
messages.zh: 在那些收藏家大鲨中要小心点。

messages.en: What is this place?
messages.zh: 这是哪里？

messages.en:
This is the Museum Arcana, where you'll find the finest collection of rare and beautiful items from all over. But what we are most famous for is our collection of Takmahl artefacts. The Takmahls were once part of the great Amarr Empire, but were exiled from the empire a long time ago, only shortly after us Amarrians took to space again. The Takmahls were heretics of the worst sort, some call them the predecessors of the Blood Raider cult.

For centuries nothing was heard from them, but not long ago relics were found here in Araz that show that the Takmahls had a thriving culture for many centuries after their departure from the glorious Amarr Empire. Yet at some point they died out, for what reasons I do not know. Archaeologists and treasure seekers from all over have since convened here in Araz, dreaming of uncovering the secrets of the Takmahls, or more precisely, their fabled treasures.

Yet my job here is not just overseeing the museum, but more importantly I am here as a member of the Theology Council. It is our job to make sure the despicable scriptures and rituals of the Takmahls are kept well under wrap. The last thing the Empire needs right now is another religious schism.

Your presence here means that you are an archaeologist of some merits. I have use of someone with your talents, rooting out those seeking false enlightenment or harbingers of discord. Help me out a bit and I will give you the key to the hidden treasures of the Takmahls. But only if you first prove yourself to be a champion of the Amarr faith.

There is a certain item to be find among the relics you see here scattered around. I want you to use your archaeological skills to unearth for me a Centrifugal Primer. It's advanced theoretical texts that I hope will give us rare insights into the rise and fall of the Takmahls. Bring me one of them, from past experience I know that your best bet of finding one is in a Digital Mezzotint. It's a rare item, so don't be too discouraged if you don't find it right away. If you haven't realised already this is a test of your mettle. If you manage to find me one I'll reward you well later down the line, but even if you fail I still have some use for you. Talk to me again when you have the Primer, or when you have given up the search.
messages.zh:
你在阿卡纳博物馆能找到来自各地的珍稀藏品，其中最有名的就是塔克玛手工品。塔克玛人曾属于伟大的艾玛帝国，但在我们艾玛人重新占据太空后不久，他们就被逐出了帝国。塔克玛人是最恶劣的异教徒，有人认为他们是血袭者的始祖。

几个世纪来他们都杳无音讯，但不久前在埃拉茨发现的遗迹表明，塔克玛人在离开显赫的艾玛帝国后曾拥有几个世纪的繁荣文明。但他们在某个时刻突然莫名其妙地灭亡了。于是，全世界的考古学家和寻宝者都齐聚于此，希望揭开塔克玛人的秘密，更确切地说是找到传说中的宝藏。

所以我的工作不仅仅是看守博物馆，更重要的是作为神学理事会的成员，将塔克玛部落卑劣的仪式和经文抄本封存。当前艾玛帝国最不想要的就是另一场宗教分裂运动。

能站在这里，说明你是个不错的考古学家。我需要你这样的人来根除那些寻求异端教化和传播分歧的异教徒。要能帮我解决这个问题，我会给你通往塔克玛隐藏宝藏的钥匙，当然这是有前提的：你必须是一个忠诚的艾玛支持者。

运用你的考古技巧在周围的废墟中找到离心祷书。希望其中的高阶理论文献能为我们解开塔克玛沉浮之谜提供一个独特的视角。给我带一本离心祷书回来，从过去的经验来看，你最有可能在数码金属板里找到它。这东西很少见，不能很快找到也别灰心，要知道这只是对你勇气的一次考验。如果你能找到，我一定会给你丰厚的报酬；但即使你失败了，我仍然需要你。就这样吧，等你拿到了祷书或是放弃搜寻后再来找我。

messages.en: Here's your Primer. This wasn't all that hard.
messages.zh: 这是你的祷书。这并没那么难。

messages.en: Ah! You have proved yourself to be an archaeoligist of exceptional talents! Talk to me again soon, I have another job for you with some juicier rewards.
messages.zh: 啊！你已经证明了自己是一个拥有特殊天分的考古学家！一会儿就来跟我谈谈吧，我还有个工作给你，很有油水的。

messages.en: I'm not interested in hunting down heretics or thieves.
messages.zh: 我对追捕异教徒或乱序者不感兴趣。

messages.en: I'm so sick looking for this rotten Primer that I could throw up. Have someone else do your dirty work.
messages.zh: 我烦透了找这个烂祷书的任务，我都要吐了。叫别人去做你的脏活儿吧。

messages.en: Yeah, I knew this was a tough one. But I'm willing to give you a second chance. Talk to me once you're ready for something different.
messages.zh: 是，我就知道这相当棘手。但是我愿意再给你个机会。一旦你准备好接受新任务，就来跟我谈话吧。

messages.en: Sure, I like digging through rubble. I'll find the statue in no time.
messages.zh: 当然，我喜欢挖掘废墟。我会立刻找到神像。

messages.en: Excellent. As before, don't let the fanatical collectors get to you.
messages.zh: 很好。跟以前一样，别让那些狂热的收藏者伤害到你。

messages.en: You said you had something of interest for me. What is it?
messages.zh: 你说有趣事要告诉我？什么趣事？

messages.en:
Yes, I want to enlist your aid in an effort of mine. I've been scourging what Takmahl ruins I've come upon for statues and idols made by the Takmahls. These statues and idols depict our deity and are a grave affront to our religion. It is my duty to find and destroy these heretical symbols before they spread to the world.

What I want you to do is simple. I know that somewhere buried among the rubble you find here you can find these holy statues if you only dig long enough. It seems that your best bet of finding one is in one of the striking curiosities around here. Search them and see if you can come up with a holy statue. If you do, bring it to me. If you manage this within the next 3 hours I will even reward you with a rare implant.
messages.zh:
是的，我需要你的帮助。我搜索了塔克玛遗址，看到很多塔克玛雕塑神像，这些东西丑化我们的神灵，严重侮辱了我们的信仰。我有责任在其广为流传前找到并摧毁这些异教徒的象征物。

你要做的很简单。在这个废墟深处隐藏着一些圣像，如果你有耐心就一定能挖到。最有可能发现圣像的地方是在附近的胜境。仔细搜索一下，看看能不能找到一具圣像。如果有，就把它带回给我。要是你在三小时内完成，我会奖你一个珍贵的植入体。

messages.en: I finally found that statue. Hope it's the right one, doesn't look much like god to me.
messages.zh: 我终于找到神像了。希望就是这个，我觉得看上去不像什么神灵。

messages.en: It's the right one alright. You are proving to be quite an asset. If you tackle one more problem for me you'll get the key to the whereabouts of Takmahl relics beyond your wildest dreams.
messages.zh: 对，就是这个。你已经证明了自己是我们的宝贵财富。如果你再为我解决一个问题，你就能得到你做梦都想不到的通向塔克玛遗址的钥匙。

messages.en: Do I look like someone that likes to get dirty? Forget about it.
messages.zh: 我看起来像是那种愿意干脏活的人么？想都别想。

messages.en: Your vanity ill suits your limited talents, young one.
messages.zh: 年轻人，你没资本那么自负。

If you manage this within the next 3 hours I will even reward you with a rare implant.
messages.zh:
是的，我有件事情需要你帮忙。我一直在大规模破坏那些塔克玛遗迹中的塔克玛人制作的神像和崇拜物。这些神像和崇拜物对我们神灵的阐释严重侮辱了我们的信仰。我有责任找到并销毁这些异端象征物，防止它们到处流传。

我要你做的很简单。在这里的建筑碎石下面的某处埋藏着这种圣像，如果你有耐心就一定能挖到。最有可能发现圣像的地方是在附近的胜境。仔细搜索一下，看看能不能找到圣像。如果找到了，就把它带回给我。要是你在三小时内完成，我还会奖励你一个珍贵的植入体。

messages.en: Sure, I like digging through rubble. I'll find the statue in no time.
messages.zh: 是的，我喜欢到处挖掘废墟，会很快找到雕像的。

messages.en: Excellent. As before, don't let the fanatical collectors get to you.
messages.zh: 好样的，和以前一样，小心那些狂热的收藏者。

messages.en: Sure, are you willing to give me another job?
messages.zh: 是的，你愿意给我一个新任务吗？

messages.en:
Yes, I want to enlist your aid in an effort of mine. I've been scourging what Takmahl ruins I've come upon for statues and idols made by the Takmahls. These statues and idols depict our deity and are a grave affront to our religion. It is my duty to find and destroy these heretical symbols before they spread to the world.

What I want you to do is simple. I know that somewhere buried among the rubble you find here you can find these holy statues if you only dig long enough. It seems that your best bet of finding one is in one of the striking curiosities around here. Search them and see if you can come up with a holy statue. If you do, bring it to me to complete your assignment.
messages.zh:
是的，我需要你的帮助。我搜索了塔克玛遗址，看到很多塔克玛雕塑神像，这些东西丑化我们的神灵，严重侮辱了我们的信仰。我有责任在其广为流传前找到并摧毁这些异教徒的象征物。

你要做的很简单。在这个废墟深处隐藏着一些圣像，如果你有耐心就一定能挖到。最有可能发现圣像的地方是在附近的胜境。仔细搜索一下，看看能不能找到一具圣像。如果有，就把它带回给我。

messages.en: I finally found that statue. Hope it's the right one, doesn't look much like god to me.
messages.zh: 我终于找到雕像了。希望就是这个，看上去似乎没什么特别。

messages.en: It's the right one alright. Looks like giving you another chance was the right thing to do. In fact, if you tackle one more problem for me you'll get the key to the whereabouts of Takmahl relics beyond your wildest dreams.
messages.zh: 对，就是这个。看来给了你第二次机会是个明智的选择。实际上，如果你再为我解决一个问题，你就能得到你做梦都想不到的通向塔克玛遗址的钥匙。

messages.en: Do I look like someone that likes to get dirty? Forget about it.
messages.zh: 我看起来像是那种干脏活的人么？忘了这些。

messages.en: Your vanity ill suits your limited talents, young one.
messages.zh: 年轻人，你没资本那么自负。

messages.en: Those Arcana Patrons don't frighten me, the texts will be in your hands before you know it.
messages.zh: 那些阿卡纳赞助人吓不倒我，我会很快把经文拿来。

messages.en: I knew you wouldn't balk at the last hurdle.
messages.zh: 我相信你不会在最后关头退缩。

messages.en: So what do I need to do to get the key to those fabled treasures of yours?
messages.zh: 怎么做才能拿到传说中宝藏的钥匙呢？

messages.en:
We're doing a good job protecting the Empire from the foul influences that the Takmahl theology might impose. But more is needed and I want you to show me one more time your dedication in rooting out these blaspehmous religious artefacts of the Takmahl. Once you've done that then you truly are an honorable pilot worthy to learn where the true treasures of the Takmahls lie.

The Arcana Patrons seek the potentially most dangerous items of the Takmahls, their holy scriptures. But we must tolerate them for they are important clients of the museum, vital for its survival. Yet you are not bound by the same restrictions I am, so you can move against them without putting the future wellbeing of the museum in jeopardy. Hunt down the Arcana Patrons and bring me back the ritual texts they are collecting. Those texts could cause severe disturbance in the Empire if revealed and the Theology Council is not about to let some uncouth art collectors hoard them.

You were not born yesterday, so I shouldn't have to urge caution, but yet I feel I must do so as the Arcana Patrons are a dangerous lot. Do not lose faith if you don't find the texts right away, in this assignment as so many others patience is a virtue worth practicing. But if you do manage to get the texts quickly, say within the next 3 hours or so, I will be a happy man and will reward you accordingly. And as promised, the moment you bring me those texts the key to the Labyrinth, wherein the hidden treasures of the Takmahls await, will be yours.
messages.zh:
我们努力保护着艾玛帝国免受塔克玛神学造成的恶劣影响。现在还需要你帮我最后一个忙，找一件渎神的宗教物品。完成这个任务，你就能充分证明自己的能力，成为少数几个有权知道塔克玛宝藏所在的人。

阿卡纳赞助人对塔克玛经文抄本兴趣十足，这些抄本一旦流传开去，造成的影响是无法预估的。对此我本人无能为力，要知道他们是博物馆重要的客户，对博物馆的生存至关重要。幸好你和我不一样，没有那么多约束，即使和他们作对也不会危及博物馆的运营。替我除掉阿卡纳赞助人，并将他们收集的经文带回来。要是这些经文被人发现，一定会在帝国内引起骚乱，这是神学理事会不能容忍的事情。

你不是个新手，我本没必要再三嘱咐你什么，但必须提醒你小心行事，阿卡纳赞助人是一群很危险的人。即使不能马上找到经文也不要灰心，这种工作需要耐心。如果你能在三小时内完成任务，我会慷慨地奖赏你。根据约定，你把经文抄本给我，通往迷宫的钥匙就是你的了，那里有塔克玛隐藏的宝藏。

messages.en: Here are those ritual texts you asked for. They sure make for a nice bedtime reading.
messages.zh: 这是你要的那些经文。他们确实适合睡前阅读。

messages.en: Those texts are going on the pyre, for your information. But thank you very much, the Empire is grateful for your efforts. The key to the Labyrinth is yours. You'll find the Labyrinth in the Aphi system. It's located pretty close to the sun, so bring your suntan lotion.
messages.zh: 告诉你吧，那些经文将被烧毁。不过非常感谢，帝国对你的贡献深表感激。通往迷宫的钥匙是你的了。你会在埃费星系找到迷宫。它距离太阳很近，所以带上防晒霜。

messages.en: I have no interest in tackling those Patrons. Keep the key yourself.
messages.zh: 我没兴趣应付那些文物庇护者。钥匙你自己留着吧。

messages.en: It's your loss, the Labyrinth will now be closed forever to you.
messages.zh: 这是你的损失，迷宫从此向你关闭了。

name.en: In the Midst of Deadspace (5 of 5)
name.es: En medio del espacio muerto (5 de 5)
name.ja: デッドスペースの中央にて（5/5）
name.ru: В глубине дэдспейса (In the Midst of Deadspace) (5 из 5)

messages.en: Great work in your last mission.  But now it is time for the final attack, to completely eliminate the Amarr presence within the troublesome deadspace area in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  The sensors I had implanted onto your ship detected a gate leading towards their headquarters, within the room where you destroyed the stargate.  It is time for you to access this gate and confront the remainder of their forces.  I will again implant the sensors onto your ship, so expect me to contact you once you warp through the acceleration gate leading to their headquarters.
messages.zh: 上次任务中你表现不错。是时候发动最后攻击了，这将彻底铲除这个麻烦的{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}死亡空间中的艾玛势力。我装在你船上的感应器检测到一条通往艾玛总部的加速轨道，就在你摧毁星门的空间内。你现在该进入这条轨道并和艾玛的残余部队正面交锋了。我还会把感应器装在你船上，一旦你跃迁穿过通向他们总部的加速轨道，我会再和你联系。

messages.en: Incredible job, {[character]player.name}.  I was afraid there for a minute that you might not be able to handle them, when you warped through the acceleration gate.  But you made it, and I'm proud of you.  Enjoy your reward!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，太不可思议了。当你通过加速轨道时，我还担心你不能对付他们。但是你做到了，我为你骄傲。好好享受你的酬劳吧！

messages.en:
Nice of you to drop by, {[character]player.name}. And what an uncanny coincidence...

{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has a slight problem on its hands. One of our agents sent a certain mercenary on a very important courier mission to deliver an item of great value to our headquarters. This was a few weeks ago, and this mercenary never showed up at his destination. At first we thought he had simply run off with the goods, but upon further investigation that proved not to be the case. His ship had been destroyed, though, we received no transmissions from him, and we found clues at the site linking the crime to a certain pirate who also happens to work as a bounty hunter. I have no doubt that some pirate organization put him up to it, but that is of little importance compared to retrieving the item that was stolen.

Now we looked up this bounty hunter and we discovered something that will interest you, no doubt. What we found was that he is currently on an assignment to kill none other than you, {[character]player.name}. Who hired him we do not know, but considering your past I'm sure you have a few suspects in mind who might pull something like this off. Now that we have a mutual target, I thought, "Why not ask {[character]player.name} to take care of the job?" And then suddenly here you are.

By doing this assignment, you'll not only rid yourself of a rat who's on your tail, but you will retrieve the item that we're after. I'm sure you're willing to get the job done, eh? I'll upload the pirate scumbag's current location into your NeoCom; he's out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} hanging around a casino. He's a pretty tough nut to crack, I hear, so you may want to bring backup with you just in case.
messages.zh:
很高兴你能来访，{[character]player.name}。我正想你什么时候会到呢。

{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}有一些小问题。几个星期前，有个代理人派发了一个非常重要的送信任务——托某个佣兵将一件极其重要的物品送达指挥部。这是n个礼拜前的事了，但这个佣兵从未出现在指挥部。起初我们认为他带着物品潜逃了，但随着调查的深入，真相并非如此。他的船已经被摧毁，根据线索判断，可能与某个海盗有联系，他的副业是赏金猎人。毋庸置疑，他背后一定有某个海盗组织的指使，但当务之急是找回被拿走的物品。

我们花了些力气追踪那个赏金猎人的身份，并发现一些你可能感兴趣的线索。我们发现他正进行一个任务，不是别的，正是除掉你，{[character]player.name}。我们还不知道是谁雇用他的，但是考虑你的过去我觉得有几个嫌疑人可能会做这样的事。现在，我们拥有了共同的目标。我还在想，“为什么不让{[character]player.name}去接受这个任务呢？”然后，你就来了。

做这个任务一举两得，既能甩掉你的尾巴，又能帮我取回货物。我想你一定乐意接受，是吗？我将在你的控制边栏内上传他的当前位置，{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}是他经常出没的游乐场。他可不好对付，所以带上帮手以防万一。

messages.en: Excellent. I have the goods, and you have rid yourself of an assassin. We're both happy, I assume, so I bid you farewell until next time.
messages.zh: 很好。我得到了货物，你为自己干掉了个清道夫。我想这回我们都高兴了，我们就此别过，下次再见吧。

messages.zh: 很好。我得到了货物，你为自己干掉了个清道夫。我想这回我们都高兴了，我们就此别过，下次再见吧。

messages.en:
Nice of you to drop by, {[character]player.name}. And what an uncanny coincidence...

{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has a slight problem on its hands. One of our agents sent a certain mercenary on a very important courier mission to deliver an item of great value to our headquarters. This was a few weeks ago, and this mercenary never showed up at his destination. At first we thought he had simply run off with the goods, but upon further investigation that proved not to be the case. His ship had been destroyed, though, we received no transmissions from him, and we found clues at the site linking the crime to a certain pirate who also happens to work as a bounty hunter. I have no doubt that some pirate organization put him up to it, but that is of little importance compared to retrieving the item that was stolen.

Now we looked up this bounty hunter and we discovered something that will interest you, no doubt. What we found was that he is currently on an assignment to kill none other than you, {[character]player.name}. Who hired him we do not know, but considering your past I'm sure you have a few suspects in mind who might pull something like this off. Now that we have a mutual target, I thought, "Why not ask {[character]player.name} to take care of the job?" And then suddenly here you are.

By doing this assignment, you'll not only rid yourself of a rat who's on your tail, but you will retrieve the item that we're after. I'm sure you're willing to get the job done, eh? I'll upload the pirate scumbag's current location into your NeoCom; he's out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} hanging around a casino. He's a pretty tough nut to crack, I hear, so you may want to bring backup with you just in case.
messages.zh:
很高兴你能来访，{[character]player.name}。我正想你什么时候会到呢。

{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}有一些小问题。几个星期前，有个代理人派发了一个非常重要的送信任务——托某个佣兵将一件极其重要的物品送达指挥部。这是n个礼拜前的事了，但这个佣兵从未出现在指挥部。起初我们认为他带着物品潜逃了，但随着调查的深入，真相并非如此。他的船已经被摧毁，根据线索判断，可能与某个海盗有联系，他的副业是赏金猎人。毋庸置疑，他背后一定有某个海盗组织的指使，但当务之急是找回被拿走的物品。

我们花了些力气追踪那个赏金猎人的身份，并发现一些你可能感兴趣的线索。我们发现他正进行一个任务，不是别的，正是除掉你，{[character]player.name}。我们还不知道是谁雇用他的，但是考虑你的过去我觉得有几个嫌疑人可能会做这样的事。现在，我们拥有了共同的目标。我还在想，“为什么不让{[character]player.name}去接受这个任务呢？”然后，你就来了。

做这个任务一举两得，既能甩掉你的尾巴，又能帮我取回货物。我想你一定乐意接受，是吗？我将在你的控制边栏内上传他的当前位置，{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}是他经常出没的游乐场。他可不好对付，所以带上帮手以防万一。

messages.en: I'll be on it immediately.
messages.zh: 我会立刻出发。

messages.en: Alright, what is my first task?
messages.zh: 好的，我第一个任务是什么？

messages.en:
Your first task will be to investigate the area where our tribute collectors went missing. It's not far from a crude militia outpost set up by the locals, but stay away from there. We just want you to find evidence of our missing ships, any debris or ship wrecks would really help us in our investigation.

We already sent a search team there, but they haven't returned. Therefore I expect there to be an ambush waiting for you, so make sure you equip your ship appropriately.
messages.zh:
你的第一个任务是去调查我们的贡品收集船失踪的地方。那里离一座当地人设立的半吊子民兵哨站不远，不过不要靠近那座哨站。我们只是要你找到失踪飞船的线索，任何碎片或飞船残骸都会对我们的调查工作有帮助。

我们已经派了搜查队去那里，但是他们一去不返。所以我估计你在那会遇到伏击，建议你好好武装你的飞船。

messages.en: There were Mordu ships awaiting you?!  This is outrageous, those slimy worms actually went so far as to hire the Mordu's Legion for assistance.  For this they will pay dearly!  And I'm counting on you to make it happen, {[character]player.name}.  Get ready for your next assignment.
messages.zh: 莫德团的飞船在那里严阵以待？！这实在太过分了，那些软弱的可怜虫居然敢雇用莫德团的人。他们要为此付出惨重代价！我就靠你帮我办这件事了，{[character]player.name}。为你的新任务做好准备。

messages.en:
With the population explosion in recent centuries within empire space many people have found themselves without homes or jobs, and have been pushed into leaving their homeworld for greener pastures. Many of these settlers have wound up in neutral space, and some even in space historically controlled by the outlawed "pirate" organizations. These settlers often have to fight a very difficult battle to survive, against both the forces of nature and those of man.

Although the empires generally consider the areas outside of their own realm being lawless and do not recognize them as sovereign states, there actually are rules to be followed even in the most bloodthirsty and barbaric nations. Each of the pirate organizations has their own culture and history, but one thing most of them do have in common is their willingness to milk the settlements in "their" solar systems for tribute. Sometimes these settlements consist entirely of slaves which have been captured elsewhere, or free people who decided to take their chances and settle on a promising planet despite its hazardous location. Either way, these settlements are a great way for the pirate factions to recruit new members, find new slaves and extract tribute in the form of credits, foodstuffs or manufactured goods.

Normally, the pirate organizations ban all settlements in their territory from having any form of high-tech weaponry in their possession, diligently enforcing this rule. This prevents the suppressed peoples from fighting back most of the time ... but with all rules, there are exceptions.
messages.zh:
近几个世纪来，由于帝国空间内人口激增，许多人失了业或者无处安身，因此不得不离开他们的家园去寻找更有开发潜力的土地。许多这些殖民者在中立空间安顿下来，有些甚至在长期被非法“海盗”组织控制的空间内定居。这些殖民者通常必须进行艰苦卓绝的抗争才能生存，对手既有自然也有人类。

虽然各帝国通常将这些自己辖区外的区域视为非法，而且不承认其为主权领土，但事实上，即便在最血腥和原始的土地上也有着需要遵守的规则。每个海盗组织有其自己的文化和历史，但有一样东西他们中的多数是共有的，就是他们喜欢在强占过来的领地上建部落。有时这些部落完全有劳工组成，有时是由自由人士组成，这些自由人士愿意冒险，愿意在一个完全陌生的环境上生活。不管怎么样，这些部落是海盗招募新鲜血液的好基地，同时也是寻找劳工然后从那里压榨各种金银钱财的好地方。

通常海盗严禁那些地区的人拥有高科技装备，为的就是防止被倒戈……不过，事情总有例外。

messages.en: Backstory
messages.zh: 背景故事

name.de: Der Aufstand - Zuschlagen wo es weh tut (2 von 4)
name.en: The Uprising - Strike Them Where It Hurts (2 of 4)
name.es: La sublevación: Donde más duele (2 de 4)
name.fr: Le soulèvement - Frapper là où ça fait mal (2 sur 4)
name.ru: Восстание - удар по больному месту (The Uprising - Strike Them Where It Hurts) (2 из 4)

messages.en:
We have discovered a fleet of Legionnaires heading towards the rebel forces in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Apparently they have split themselves into 5 groups, and we want you to eliminate all of them. They must not be allowed to reach the militia base inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, that would seriously undermine any attack we attempt on their position there. Once you have destroyed all 5 groups, then return to me.

We've discovered their gathering point, which should simplify this mission quite a bit for you. You must fly to the gathering point and destroy all 5 groups of Legionnaires when they arrive.
messages.zh:
我们发现一支莫德团舰队正朝着{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的反抗力量驶去。他们分成了5组，我们要你把他们全部歼灭。绝对不能让他们接近{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内的民兵基地，否则我们对他们据点发动攻击的计划将遭到严重破坏。一旦你把5组舰队全部摧毁，就回到我这来。

我们已经发现了这些飞船的集合点，这应该会让你的任务简单些。你必须飞到集合点，摧毁全部5组莫德团舰队。

messages.en: The Mordu reinforcements have been destroyed as you requested.
messages.zh: 如你所愿，我已消灭了莫德团的援军。

messages.en: Excellent!  This should leave their base weak enough for us to launch a direct assault on it immediately.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！他们的基地此刻力量薄弱，我们可以立刻发动直接袭击。

name.ru: Восстание - штурм (The Uprising - The Assault) (3 из 4)

messages.en:
Now comes a critical stage in our operation. We must assault the headquarters of the rebels, and destroy their pitiful forces. I want you to lead the assault, {[character]player.name}. Their base will be well guarded by filthy Mordu, but with your superior combat skill you should be able to take them out.

Also if you find any survivors, bring them back here for interrogation. We would also like to retrieve the leader of the traitors holed up at that base, for public execution. That should teach them a lesson they won't forget.
messages.zh:
现在到了我们行动的关键时刻。 我们必须袭击叛军的总部，摧毁他们可怜巴巴的军队。 我要你去率领这次袭击行动，{[character]player.name}。 他们的基地由可恶的莫德团守护，但是以你高超的战斗技能，应该可以把他们除掉。

同时，如果有幸存者，把他们带回来审问。 我们还希望抓获驻扎在那个基地的叛军首领，将他公开处决。 这应该能给他们个永生难忘的教训。

messages.en: Very good work, {[character]player.name}.  The destruction of their main base will open up a huge hole in their defenses, which we must capitalize on.  I also noticed that you brought back the leader of the settlers protecting the base, I'm sure he will give us valuable information after we torture him.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。他们主基地的毁灭等于在他们的防御系统上开了个大洞，我们要充分利用这一点。你还带回了守卫那个基地的殖民者首领，在我们严刑拷打后，我肯定他会给我们些重要信息。

name.de: Der Aufstand - Das letzte Gefecht (4 von 4)
name.ru: Восстание — последняя битва (The Uprising - Last Stand) (4 из 4)

messages.en:
Now is the time to finally quash this pathetic rebellion. The last of the rebel ships and their Mordu lackeys have been gathering at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, to make a final stand against us. We have confirmed reports of a new militia leader being among this last group of traitors. We require him to be brought to us alive for his due punishment.

Once this group of ships has been destroyed, we will have total control over the skies on {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, allowing us to bombard them at will. They will suffer dearly for their outrageous impudence.
messages.zh:
现在该给彻底捣碎这支可怜的叛军了。叛军的残余飞船及其莫德团走狗正聚集到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}试图做最后的抵抗。据可靠消息，这群叛军余孽中有一位新的民兵领袖。我们要他被活捉到我们面前，接受应得的惩罚。

一旦消灭这群飞船，我们将完全掌握{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的制空权，可以任意轰炸他们。他们要为自己的胆大妄为付出惨重代价。

messages.en: Superb job, {[character]player.name}.  You've just single handedly destroyed the ragtag rebellion.  You will go into our record-books for sure.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。你轻而易举地摧毁了贱民们的叛乱。你必将进入我们的史册。

messages.en: Pathetic wretch!  I expected more from you, {[character]player.name} ...
messages.zh: 可悲的家伙！我本对你有更高的期望，{[character]player.name}……

现在到了我们行动的关键时刻。 我们必须袭击叛军的总部，摧毁他们可怜巴巴的军队。 我要你去率领这次袭击行动，{[character]player.name}。 他们的基地由可恶的莫德团守护，但是以你高超的战斗技能，应该可以把他们除掉。

同时，如果有幸存者，把他们带回来审问。 我们还希望抓获驻扎在那个基地的叛军首领，将他公开处决。 这应该能给他们个永生难忘的教训。

messages.en: Very good work, {[character]player.name}.  The destruction of their main base will open up a huge hole in their defenses, which we must capitalize on.  I also noticed that you brought back the leader of the settlers protecting the base, I'm sure he will give us valuable information after we torture him.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。他们主基地的毁灭等于在他们的防御系统上开了个大洞，我们要充分利用这一点。你还带回了守卫那个基地的殖民者首领，在我们严刑拷打后，我肯定他会给我们些重要信息。

messages.en:
Now comes a critical stage in our operation. We must assault the headquarters of the rebels, and destroy their pitiful forces. I want you to lead the assault, {[character]player.name}. Their base will be well guarded by filthy Mordu, but with your superior combat skill you should be able to take them out.

Also if you find any survivors, bring them back here for interrogation. We would also like to retrieve the leader of the traitors holed up at that base, for public execution. That should teach them a lesson they won't forget.

messages.en: I'll be on it immediately.
messages.zh: 我会立刻出发。

messages.en: Alright, what is my first task?
messages.zh: 好的，我第一个任务是什么？

messages.en:
Your first task will be to investigate the area where our tribute collectors went missing. It's not far from a crude militia outpost set up by the locals, but stay away from there. We just want you to find evidence of our missing ships, any debris or ship wrecks would really help us in our investigation.

We already sent a search team there, but they haven't returned. Therefore I expect there to be an ambush waiting for you, so make sure you equip your ship appropriately.
messages.zh:
你的第一个任务是去调查我们的贡品收集船失踪的地方。那里离一座当地人设立的半吊子民兵哨站不远，不过不要靠近那座哨站。我们只是要你找到失踪飞船的线索，任何碎片或飞船残骸都会对我们的调查工作有帮助。

我们已经派了搜查队去那里，但是他们一去不返。所以我估计你在那会遇到伏击，建议你好好武装你的飞船。

messages.en: There were Mordu ships awaiting you?!  This is outrageous, those slimy worms actually went so far as to hire the Mordu's Legion for assistance.  For this they will pay dearly!  And I'm counting on you to make it happen, {[character]player.name}.  Get ready for your next assignment.
messages.zh: 莫德团的飞船在那里严阵以待？！这实在太过分了，那些软弱的可怜虫居然敢雇用莫德团的人。他们要为此付出惨重代价！我就靠你帮我办这件事了，{[character]player.name}。为你的新任务做好准备。

messages.en:
With the population explosion in recent centuries within empire space many people have found themselves without homes or jobs, and have been pushed into leaving their homeworld for greener pastures. Many of these settlers have wound up in neutral space, and some even in space historically controlled by the outlawed "pirate" organizations. These settlers often have to fight a very difficult battle to survive, against both the forces of nature and those of man.

Although the empires generally consider the areas outside of their own realm being lawless and do not recognize them as sovereign states, there actually are rules to be followed even in the most bloodthirsty and barbaric nations. Each of the pirate organizations has their own culture and history, but one thing most of them do have in common is their willingness to milk the settlements in "their" solar systems for tribute. Sometimes these settlements consist entirely of slaves which have been captured elsewhere, or free people who decided to take their chances and settle on a promising planet despite its hazardous location. Either way, these settlements are a great way for the pirate factions to recruit new members, find new slaves and extract tribute in the form of credits, foodstuffs or manufactured goods.

Normally, the pirate organizations ban all settlements in their territory from having any form of high-tech weaponry in their possession, diligently enforcing this rule. This prevents the suppressed peoples from fighting back most of the time ... but with all rules, there are exceptions.
messages.zh:
近几个世纪来，由于帝国空间内人口激增，许多人失了业或者无处安身，因此不得不离开他们的家园去寻找更有开发潜力的土地。许多这些殖民者在中立空间安顿下来，有些甚至在长期被非法“海盗”组织控制的空间内定居。这些殖民者通常必须进行艰苦卓绝的抗争才能生存，对手既有自然也有人类。

虽然各帝国通常将这些自己辖区外的区域视为非法，而且不承认其为主权领土，但事实上，即便在最血腥和原始的土地上也有着需要遵守的规则。每个海盗组织有其自己的文化和历史，但有一样东西他们中的多数是共有的，就是他们喜欢在强占过来的领地上建部落。有时这些部落完全有劳工组成，有时是由自由人士组成，这些自由人士愿意冒险，愿意在一个完全陌生的环境上生活。不管怎么样，这些部落是海盗招募新鲜血液的好基地，同时也是寻找劳工然后从那里压榨各种金银钱财的好地方。

通常海盗严禁那些地区的人拥有高科技装备，为的就是防止被倒戈……不过，事情总有例外。

messages.en: No problem, I'll do it.
messages.zh: 没问题，我愿意干。

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} recently sacked one of its employees after a routine inspection revealed a large amount of indecent pictures stored in his personal database.  Sadly, this ex-employee wasn't all too pleased with our 
decision, and has resorted to camping outside of our headquarters and harassing our customers.  Fortunately though, we dug up some old offenses this guy made and revealed them to the authorities, who promptly lowered his security rating quite a bit.  In effect, he's fair game.  Please warp over to the location on the bookmark I'm about to give you and squash this little pest.  I doubt he will survive for long, as some of our customers are 
heavily armed.  So hurry up and take him out if you want your reward.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}最近开除了一名雇员，原因是在例行检查中发现他的个人数据库中储存了大量违禁图片。糟糕的是，这个前雇员对我们的决定不甚满意，转而在我们的总部外面安营扎寨，不断骚扰我们的客户。幸好，我们查出了这家伙犯下的几桩罪状，并透露给了官方，他的安全等级立刻就被降低了很多。因此他实际上已经成为合法的击毁目标。马上把他的位标给你，请你飞过去挤扁这只小虫子。我想他本来就活不了多久，因为我们有些客户武装强悍。所以如果你想要你的那份酬金，就快去把他解决掉。

name.ru: За успех надо платить (Success Comes At A Price)

messages.en: I'm up to the job, and don't worry, you can trust me with keeping this under the table.
messages.zh: 我接受任务，不要担心，我会小心慎重，不辱使命。

messages.en:
I knew you were up to it. Now, the story behind this mission is actually rather complicated, but you just need to know the basics. The reason I'm telling you this at all is because I don't want you finding about this later and getting it into your head that I betrayed you, because I'd never do that *smile*. Anyway, two years ago one of the new recruits within our marketing department started to show an incredible amount of promise, making decisions that generated an enormous amount of revenue for us. Needless to say, he quickly rose up the ranks within our corporation as well as earning a place within the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} government, and we owe our recent successes largely to his 'efforts'.

However quickly some of us became suspicious, especially those within our ranks which were jealous of his success. After a lot of research and investigation, we came to the conclusion that he had a contact within the Guristas Pirates which was supplying him with sensitive information which they had acquired through illegal means. As you might know, these pirates are infamous within the Caldari territories, and have even spread to neighboring regions. For this reason we must not allow this to reach the ears of ANYONE affiliated with the authorities, or it will have dire consequences. I hope I have made myself perfectly clear on that matter. I expect your full discretion. I'll add more information to the mission details in your Opportunities interface once you get started. Good luck.
messages.zh:
我知道你能行。这个任务的背景相当复杂，但你只要掌握基础信息就够了。我跟你说这些，是希望你尽早了解情况，不然等到你自己发现这些的时候，会觉得我辜负了你，毕竟我不是那种人*微笑*。言归正传，两年前，市场部有个新人展现出了惊人才干，他的决策让我们赚得盆满钵满。自不必说，他很快就进入了军团高层，在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}政府中也赢得了一席之地。我们近期取得的成功很大程度上都是他的“功劳”。

可没多久就有人提出质疑，尤其是同级中嫉妒他的那些人。于是，我们开展了大量研究和调查，最终确定他暗中勾结古斯塔斯海盗势力，后者为他提供了以非法手段获取的敏感信息。你可能对这些海盗有所耳闻，他们在加达里境内臭名昭著，甚至还在向邻近星域扩张势力。因此，我们绝不能让与当局有关的任何人知道这个消息，否则后果将不堪设想。整件事的前因后果就是这样。希望你能谨慎行事。等你开始任务时，我会把详细信息添加到“机遇”界面的任务详情中。祝你好运。

messages.en:
I have a job for you this time which I would not have given to just anybody. I know that I can trust you, your faithful service to me in the past has proven that. Now to cut the story short, what I need is a ship destroyed. But there is a 'slight' problem, which I'll get to. You see, this ship isn't just any old pirate ship, it contains a high ranking official within {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, who also happens to be a member within the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} government. This isn't a rescue mission, this is a destroy mission. But don't worry, this mission is completely confidential. If you're interested, then I'll give you more details, otherwise this conversation never happened. Just take note of the fact your target is very powerful, do not attempt this unless you have a powerful warship at your disposal, or friends.

The ship you are supposed to destroy is actually a Guristas Emissary vessel, which is used as a secret meeting place between the person which must be killed, and his Guristas contacts. You will probably also notice his own ship nearby, which may or may not be unmanned at the time. You must also destroy this vessel, whether your target is inside it or not, to make it look like he was ambushed by pirates. And take care of anyone else nearby, none may escape. I hope I have made myself clear.

Oh and please note, you can keep whatever you find in the wreckage of these ships, it is of no concern to us. We will of course reward you as well when you have finished the task. The bookmark I gave you will show the exact location of the meeting place so getting there shouldn't be a problem.
messages.zh:
我这次的任务不能随随便便给任何人，我打算把它给你。我知道可以信任你，你过去的忠心效力已经证明了这一点。现在长话短说，我要你摧毁一艘飞船。但我还得说一个“小”问题。这艘飞船不是以前任务中的海盗船，它里面载着位{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的高层官员，而且他恰好也是{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}政府的成员。这不是项营救任务，而是次索命行动。不过别担心，这次行动是完全机密的。如果你有兴趣，我会告诉你更多细节，否则就当这次谈话从没发生过。你要注意，目标非常强大，除非你有一艘威力惊人的战舰或者有朋友的帮助，否则不要轻举妄动。

你要摧毁的飞船实际上是艘古斯塔斯使船，这艘飞船是目标及其古斯塔斯联络人的秘密会面场所。你可能会在附近发现他自己的飞船，上面有没有人不能肯定。你必须也把这艘飞船摧毁，目标是否在里面并不重要，关键是要使他看起来像是遭海盗伏击而亡。把附近的所有人都解决掉，一个漏网之鱼也不能留。我希望自己都说清楚了。

哦，请注意，你可以保留在飞船残骸里找到的任何东西，那些对我们不重要。当然在你完成任务之后，我们还会好好奖赏你。我给你的位标指出了会面地点的精确位置，所以飞去那里应该不成问题。

messages.en: Your problem has been solved.  Both the pirates and my primary target were destroyed.
messages.zh: 你的问题已经解决。海盗和主要目标都被消灭了。

messages.en: Marvelous.  You really did good out there, and I am absolutely certain I can trust you with keeping quiet about this.  However, let this be an educated warning to you:  don't mess with the system, because in the end you WILL regret it!
messages.zh: 不可思议。你干得非常好。另外，我绝对相信你能对此守口如瓶。不过还是好心提醒你一下：在星系里别干出格的事，因为那样你一定会后悔的！

messages.en: I understand.  Just don't tell anyone about what I said, you hear?
messages.zh: 我明白。不要把我说的话告诉其他人，听到没？

messages.en:
I have a job for you this time which I would not have given to just anybody. I know that I can trust you, your faithful service to me in the past has proven that. Now to cut the story short, what I need is a ship destroyed. But there is a 'slight' problem, which I'll get to. You see, this ship isn't just any old pirate ship, it contains a high ranking official within {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, who also happens to be a member within the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} government. This isn't a rescue mission, this is a destroy mission. But don't worry, this mission is completely confidential. If you're interested, then I'll give you more details, otherwise this conversation never happened. Just take note of the fact your target is very powerful, do not attempt this unless you have a powerful warship at your disposal, or friends.

The ship you are supposed to destroy is actually a Guristas Emissary vessel, which is used as a secret meeting place between the person which must be killed, and his Guristas contacts. You will probably also notice his own ship nearby, which may or may not be unmanned at the time. You must also destroy this vessel, whether your target is inside it or not, to make it look like he was ambushed by pirates. And take care of anyone else nearby, none may escape. I hope I have made myself clear.

Oh and please note, you can keep whatever you find in the wreckage of these ships, it is of no concern to us. We will of course reward you as well when you have finished the task. The bookmark I gave you will show the exact location of the meeting place so getting there shouldn't be a problem.

name.es: El que la hace la paga
name.fr: Qui sème le vent récolte la tempête
name.ru: Что посеешь, то и пожнешь (What Comes Around Goes Around)

messages.en: Good.  These bounty hunters tend to be quite tough, so be prepared.  Now get going, and remember to use the bookmark I uploaded into your NeoCom.
messages.zh: 好的。这些赏金猎人通常相当厉害，所以要准备充分。好了，出发吧，记得使用我上传到你控制边栏里的位标。

messages.en: We have a rather nasty problem on our hands.  You see due to the nature of our business, we tend to make a lot of enemies.  Usually this is not a problem, but it seems we pissed off someone with money where his mouth is.  To get straight to the point, we have a bounty hunter on our tails.  To make matters worse, this happens to be an infamous bounty hunter who is NOT to be taken lightly.  I'm not sure who he is after, but it's probably someone within our ranks who isn't expenda ... err who is important.  I want you to head out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and take care of this threat once and for all.
messages.zh: 我们手头有个相当棘手的问题。你瞧，由于我们生意的性质，我们很容易树立很多敌人。通常这不是什么问题，但似乎我们惹恼了某个财大气粗的家伙。开门见山吧，现在有个赏金猎人正盯着我们。更糟糕的是，这家伙是个恶名昭彰的赏金猎人，绝不能等闲视之。我不确定他正追捕谁，但很可能是我们队伍中某个不能随便舍弃……呃，某个重要人物。我要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，把这个威胁一劳永逸地除掉。

messages.en: I need you to do me a BIG favor this time. A few months ago one of our executives lost a wager. He was rather drunk at the time (or so he says), and refused to pay up. I won't get into any more details about that, as it's rather embarrassing. Unfortunately it seems that his 'friend' isn't satisfied with our apology on our employee's behalf. They hired a bounty hunter to settle the score. We managed to find the assassin's hideout, and I want you to go there and eliminate him before he does us any harm. Head out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and teach him a lesson.
messages.zh: 这次我要你帮我个大忙。 几个月前我们的一位执行官打赌输了。 当时他醉得不轻（至少他是这么说的），并拒绝兑现赌约。 其中的细节我就不具体说了，实在是相当丢人。 糟糕的是，似乎他的“朋友”对于我们代员工所做的道歉不甚满意。 他们雇了一名赏金猎人来算账。 我们找到了这个刺客的藏身地，我要你去干掉他，以免我们受到伤害。 到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}去，给他点教训。

name.ru: Рабов необходимо вернуть (The Slaves Must Be Returned)

messages.en: Sounds good. I like a tough fight now and then.
messages.zh: 听起来不错。我有时候喜欢鏖战。

messages.en: Good. Just don't go in alone and unprepared — he's already killed dozens of capsuleers.
messages.zh: 好的。只是别打无准备之仗，许多克隆飞行员都惨遭他的毒手。

messages.en: My pleasure. I hear you might have a job for me?
messages.zh: 这是我的荣幸。听说你有份工作给我？

messages.en:
The filthy terrorist organization TFF just struck our slave compound. They sent one of their best men, and he managed to capture a heap of our precious slaves and is making his getaway now. I need you to intercept him before he manages to escape from this system.

This guy has a very long history of criminal and terrorist activity, belonging to the international network of thugs calling themselves the Freedom Fighters. I want his head on a platter, and the slaves back here alive.
messages.zh:
可恶的恐怖组织TFF刚刚袭击了我们的劳工据点。他们派出了一名最得力的手下，掠去了很多珍贵的劳工，现在正准备逃走。我要你在他从某个星门逃离这个星系前拦截他。

小心，这家伙长期从事犯罪和恐怖活动，隶属于自称“自由战士”的国际暴徒网络。我要你呈上他的人头，并带着劳工们活着回来。

messages.en: Alright, it's done. The slaves are here in the station.
messages.zh: 好，完成了。劳工们都在这个空间站里了。

messages.en: Wow, I thought you were a goner, but you made it back in one piece! You've done {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} an invaluable favor by ridding us of that pest.
messages.zh: 哇噢，我还以为你一去不回了呢，没想到你竟然四肢健全地回来了！除掉了那个祸害，你为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}立了一件大功。

messages.en: No thanks. I think I've heard about this guy. His ship is supposed to be pretty tough. And I just got my hull refitted, so I'm not about to get it all smashed up again.
messages.zh: 不，谢谢。我想我听说过这个家伙。他的舰船估计很坚固。而我才刚刚修理过我那艘的船体，所以不打算去把它重新弄碎。

messages.en: A capsuleer, immortal and wealthy beyond measure, and you're afraid of this guy?! Very disappointing. Very, very disappointing.
messages.zh: 一个克隆飞行员，长生不老，又有无法估量的财富，可是你竟然害怕这个家伙？！真是让人失望，非常，非常失望。

messages.en:
Yes. Yes, I do. The filthy terrorist organization TFF just struck another one of our slave compounds. They sent one of their best men, and he managed to capture a heap of our precious slaves and is no doubt trying to make his getaway. I need you to intercept him before he manages to escape from this system.

Beware: This guy has a very long history of criminal and terrorist activity, belonging to the international network of thugs calling themselves the Freedom Fighters. I want his head on a platter, and the slaves brought back here alive. Do this and you will receive a healthy reward along with the bounty on his head.
messages.zh:
是的，我的确有。可恶的恐怖组织TFF刚刚袭击了我们的劳工据点。他们派出了一名最得力的手下，掠去了很多珍贵的劳工，现在正准备逃走。我要你在他从某个星门逃离这个星系前拦截他。

小心，这家伙长期从事犯罪和恐怖活动，隶属于自称“自由战士”的国际暴徒网络。我要你呈上他的人头，并带着劳工们活着回来。完成这个任务，你会获得一笔丰厚的奖赏，还有他头上的赏金。

messages.en: This guy is ridiculous! I mean, he's a total badass! I quit.
messages.zh: 这个家伙真不可思议！我的意思是，他彻底是个大麻烦！我退出。

messages.zh: 一个克隆飞行员，长生不老，又有无法估量的财富，可是你竟然害怕这个家伙？！真是让人失望，非常，非常失望。

messages.en:
Yes. Yes, I do. The filthy terrorist organization TFF just struck another one of our slave compounds. They sent one of their best men, and he managed to capture a heap of our precious slaves and is no doubt trying to make his getaway. I need you to intercept him before he manages to escape from this system.

Beware: This guy has a very long history of criminal and terrorist activity, belonging to the international network of thugs calling themselves the Freedom Fighters. I want his head on a platter, and the slaves brought back here alive. Do this and you will receive a healthy reward along with the bounty on his head.
messages.zh:
是的，我的确有。可恶的恐怖组织TFF刚刚袭击了我们的劳工据点。他们派出了一名最得力的手下，掠去了很多珍贵的劳工，现在正准备逃走。我要你在他从某个星门逃离这个星系前拦截他。

小心，这家伙长期从事犯罪和恐怖活动，隶属于自称“自由战士”的国际暴徒网络。我要你呈上他的人头，并带着劳工们活着回来。完成这个任务，你会获得一笔丰厚的奖赏，还有他头上的赏金。

messages.en: This guy is ridiculous! I mean, he's a total badass! I quit.
messages.zh: 这个家伙真不可思议！我的意思是，他彻底是个大麻烦！我退出。

messages.en: Sounds good. I like a tough fight now and then.

name.ru: Свобода не должна победить (Freedom Must Not Prevail)

messages.en: A few Minmatar terrorists, belonging to the despicable organization calling themselves 'The Freedom Fighters', managed to get by security and are approaching one of our slave compounds within this system.  Their goal is undoubtedly to capture some of our slaves and release them onto the streets!  Fortunately we spotted them before they could finish their mission.  I want you to go out there and destroy them.  I'll upload the coordinates of their current location into your NeoCom if you accept this mission.
messages.zh: 一小撮隶属于“自由战士”组织的米玛塔尔恐怖分子，竟然通过了安全防线，正在逼近我们这个星系中的一座劳工集中营。他们的目标无疑是要夺取我们的一些劳工然后释放他们，让他们满大街乱逛！所幸我们在他们得逞前发现了他们的行踪。我要你立刻前去那里，把他们彻底消灭。如果你接受任务，我会把他们当前位置的坐标上传到你的控制边栏。

messages.en: Not bad.  You've just saved a few of our disease-ridden slaves from being released from captivity, we are proud of you!
messages.zh: 干得不坏。你阻止了我们一些疾病缠身的劳工被释放出来，我为你感到骄傲！

messages.en: I just received reports of criminal activity in our sector. A certain pilot attacked and destroyed a ship belonging to an ally of ours which was flying through CONCORD-protected space. He managed to flee before CONCORD got a hold of him. I want you to fly to the coordinates where he was last spotted, find him, and put him out of business. He's an extremely elusive fellow, who has managed to evade CONCORD for quite some time, so be wary.
messages.zh: 我刚刚收到报告，说我们这个区域内有犯罪活动。某个飞行员袭击并摧毁了一艘我们盟友的飞船，当时那架飞船正飞经受统合部保护的地区。那个飞行员成功从统合部的手下逃脱。我要你飞往他最后现身的坐标，找到他，让他永远消失。他是个极其油滑的家伙，统合部花了不少时间都没能抓到他，所以你要小心。

messages.en: Excellent job, {[character]player.name}

messages.zh: 决不能让这些海盗继续在星域里放肆了，我接受这项任务。

messages.en: Ok I just uploaded the waypoint to what we believe is their destination into your NeoCom.  It's a small space-port which is infamous in these parts for harboring drug smugglers.  Please set up an ambush there and wait for them.  And a word of warning, if you do find any contraband goods which weren't destroyed along the convoy, don't pick them up, the local security forces will make sure you'll regret it if you do.  Now get out there and kick some butt, soldier!
messages.zh: 好的，我刚把航标上传到你的控制边栏，那里应该是他们的目的地。那是个小型空间港口，因藏匿违规药品非法贩售者而恶名远播。请前去那里设置埋伏，然后等那些家伙出现。给你一句忠告，如果你发现未随飞船一起摧毁的禁运物品，不要把它们装到自己船上，否则当地的安全部队将让你后悔的。现在就出发，给他们点颜色看看！

messages.en: Our surveillance team just spotted a Blood Raider convoy carrying illegal goods through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  I want you to head out there and intercept the criminals.  Make sure the contraband loot is destroyed with their ship, we don't want anything to do with it.
messages.zh: 我们的监察小组刚刚发现一支运送非法物资的血袭者护航队正在穿越{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。我要你前去拦截这些罪犯。务必把那些非法货物和他们的飞船一起摧毁，我们不想和那些东西扯上任何关系。

messages.en: No problem.

messages.en: There's a hidden stargate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that is frequented by pilots of {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}. name.es: Elimina la emboscada del portal estelar
name.fr: Éliminer le blocus au portail stellaire
name.ja: スターゲートキャンパーを壊滅せよ
name.ru: Ликвидация блокады звездных врат (Eliminate the Stargate Campers)

messages.en: No problem.
messages.zh: 没问题。

messages.en:
I have something suited for someone of your caliber. There is a hidden stargate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} which is frequented by pilots employed by allies of {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}. It so happens that a squadron of CONCORD ships have 'set up camp' near the stargate in the hopes of catching easy prey traveling via the gate. In other words they will attack any passersby which they believe to be affiliated with us or our partners. They're probably after someone specific but don't mind nabbing a few extra victims while they're at it.

We've considered sending in a strike force, but I'm afraid they might make a quick get-away should they discover who's after them. Therefore I'd like you to fly there and try to be as inconspicuous as possible, that should lure them into attacking you. Once you've succeeded in destroying them, then return to me for your reward.
messages.zh:
我有个活正适合你这样有才能的人。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一座隐藏星门，{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}同盟的飞行员经常在那里出入。然而一支统合部飞船中队在那里“设立了营地”，意图猎获穿越星门的弱小猎物。换句话说，任何他们认为与我们或我们伙伴有关的过路者都会遭到袭击。他们可能正在追击某个特定目标，不过不介意同时多捎上几个受害者。

我们考虑过派一支打击部队过去，但我怕他们发现大军压境后会迅速撤离。因此我希望你飞去，姿态要尽量低调，这样就能吸引他们来攻击你。一旦你把他们成功消灭之后就回来领赏。

messages.en: No problem.
messages.zh: 没问题。

messages.en:
I have something suited for someone of your caliber. There is a hidden stargate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} which is frequented by pilots employed by allies of {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}. It so happens that a squadron of CONCORD ships have 'set up camp' near the stargate in the hopes of catching easy prey traveling via the gate. In other words they will attack any passersby which they believe to be affiliated with us or our partners. They're probably after someone specific but don't mind nabbing a few extra victims while they're at it.

We've considered sending in a strike force, but I'm afraid they might make a quick get-away should they discover who's after them. Therefore I'd like you to fly there and try to be as inconspicuous as possible, that should lure them into attacking you. Once you've succeeded in destroying them, then return to me for your reward.
messages.zh:
我有个活正适合你这样有才能的人。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一座隐藏星门，{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}同盟的飞行员经常在那里出入。然而一支统合部飞船中队在那里“设立了营地”，意图猎获穿越星门的弱小猎物。换句话说，任何他们认为与我们或我们伙伴有关的过路者都会遭到袭击。他们可能正在追击某个特定目标，不过不介意同时多捎上几个受害者。

我们考虑过派一支打击部队过去，但我怕他们发现大军压境后会迅速撤离。因此我希望你飞去，姿态要尽量低调，这样就能吸引他们来攻击你。一旦你把他们成功消灭之后就回来领赏。

name.ru: Помешай военным приготовлениям (Foil The Military Preperations)

messages.en: I'll get this done in no time.
messages.zh: 我很快就能完成任务。

messages.en:
Recently, we started noticing an increased presence of Amarr military drones in the area. Our fears were just confirmed a few hours ago when one of our members stumbled upon a transport ship with an Amarr logo on its hull parked in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. A ship scan revealed a hoard of construction blocks in its cargo hold. This means they must be constructing something in the proximity, which is of course unacceptable. Their project must be stopped in its infancy at all costs. I want you to warp to a remote stargate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} which we believe the latest transport ship we spotted was intending to use. Wait for a few minutes until it arrives. But hurry before it's too late!

And remember, do not reveal your identity to anyone nearby, as we want to keep a lid on this operation. We do not want to ignite the spark of a full fledged war with the Empire.
messages.zh:
最近，我们发现这个地区的艾玛军用无人机活动越来越频繁。几个小时前，我们的担忧得到了证实，我们的一位成员在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}无意中发现了一艘船体印有艾玛标志的运输舰。通过对飞船进行扫描，我们发现在它的货柜舱里装有大量建筑材料。这表明他们肯定在附近建造什么东西，这绝对不能允许。必须不惜一切代价将他们的建设计划消灭在萌芽状态。我要你跃迁到一座位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的偏远星门，相信我们最近发现的运输船会通过它。在那儿等上几分钟直到它出现。但要快，赶在它之前去！

记住，不要向附近的任何人透露你的身份，我们想要秘密的完成这个行动。我们不想同帝国全面开战。

最近，我们发现这个地区的联邦军用无人机活动越来越频繁。几个小时前，我们的担忧得到了证实，我们的一位成员在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}无意中发现了一艘船体印有联邦标志的运输舰。通过对飞船进行扫描，我们发现在它的货柜舱里装有大量建筑材料。这表明他们肯定在附近建造什么东西，这绝对不能允许。必须不惜一切代价将他们的建设计划消灭在萌芽状态。我要你跃迁到一座位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的偏远星门，相信我们最近发现的运输船会通过它。在那儿等上几分钟直到它出现。但要快，赶在它之前去！

记住，不要向附近的任何人透露你的身份，我们想要秘密的完成这个行动。我们不想同盖伦特联邦全面开战。

messages.en:

Our primary objective right now is to get back the people they've taken captive. We think we've located their slave pen in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, but it's your job to make sure. Destroy the structure and rescue the slaves if you can, then report back to me. We'll deal with these slave traders later.

我们眼下的主要目标是去救回那些被他们俘虏的人。我们已经在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了他们的劳工围场，但你必须亲自去确认一下。如果可能的话，摧毁建筑并营救劳工，然后向我报告。我们回头再收拾这些劳工贩子。

messages.en:
Now that we've destroyed the slave pen and rescued the captives, it's time to turn our attention to the slavers themselves. You have the full authority of the government to shoot to kill, we do not expect any prisoners. And please do not confuse these low-lifes to the legit slave-users we sometimes do business with. These Blood Raider fanatics kidnap people indiscriminately, instead of only targeting criminals and POWs like the Amarr Empire.

We believe we know of the current whereabouts of these slavers. Warp to the bookmark that I will upload into your NeoCom, and try to find them somewhere in the asteroid belt.
messages.zh:
我们已经摧毁了劳工围场，营救了俘虏，现在该把注意力转到那些劳工贩子上了。政府授予你先斩后奏的权力，我们不要任何战俘。请不要把这些低贱生物和与我们有生意往来的合法劳工使用者混为一谈。这些血袭者狂热分子不分青红皂白地进行绑架，不像艾玛帝国那样只把罪犯和战俘当成目标。

我们已获知这些劳工贩子的下落。跃迁到我上传至你控制边栏里的位标处，在小行星带里仔细搜寻他们的踪迹。
