messages.en: I'm interested ...
messages.zh: 我有兴趣。

messages.en: The colleague that I mentioned, Aviekko Ta, requires your graduation certificate before she'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Aviekko.
messages.zh: 我提到的那位同事，艾薇伊珂•塔，需要看一下你的毕业证书，然后才能给你任务。我想你大概把它放在机库的什么地方了吧？如果找不到的话，我可以叫人在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}制作一份拷贝。去把它拿给我。只要我在上面签了字，你就可以和艾薇伊珂交谈了。

messages.en:
Ok, you're now all set to speak with Aviekko. You'll probably find her at her desk in the Echelon Entertainment Development Studio in Autama. And don't forget to bring your graduation certificate when you pay her a visit!

If you forget the location of this agent, you can always look it up by opening the 'show info' window for the graduation certificate.
messages.zh:
好的，现在你可以去跟艾薇伊珂谈话了。在奥塔马的梯队娱乐发展工作室可以找到她。去见她的时候别忘了带上毕业证书！

如果你忘了代理人的地点，你可以打开毕业证书的“显示信息”窗口来查看。

messages.en: The colleague that I mentioned, Aviekko Ta, requires your graduation certificate before she'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Aviekko.
messages.zh: 我提到的同事艾薇伊珂•塔在给你任务前需要看一下你的毕业证书。我想你大概把它忘在机库里了，也许其他地方，是吗？如果找不到的话，我可以在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}拷贝一份。拿来给我签署，之后你就能与艾薇伊珂说话了。

name.ja: パイロットの資格（導入部）

messages.en: I was sent to speak with you, Aviekko, and I have this certificate to prove it.
messages.zh: 有人叫我来这里见你，艾薇伊珂，这个证书可以证明。

messages.en: Ok, show me the certificate.  You better not be pulling my leg ...
messages.zh: 好的，给我看看证书。你最好别耍我……

messages.en: Bring Aviekko Ta a Graduation Certificate which you can acquire by speaking to one of her agents. The agents can be found in Data Centers  located in Kamokor, Ahtulaima and Saikanen.
messages.zh: 去把一本毕业证书带给艾薇伊珂•塔。你与她的一个代理人谈话之后便可获得此书。那些代理人位于卡莫科尔、阿图莱玛及塞卡伦的数据中心里。

messages.en: Here it is.
messages.zh: 给你。

messages.en: Ah, so you're a qualified pilot eh.  I have some work for you after all.  Just give me a minute to go over my files, I'll have something for you to do in a jiffy ...
messages.zh: 啊，那么你是一个合格的飞行员咯。我的确有些适合你的工作。给我一分钟时间，我要先看一下文件，马上就给你布置任务。

messages.en: Unless you've been sent here by one of my subordinates, I have nothing for you.  If you're interested, you can find them in Data Centers in Kamokor, Ahtulaima and Saikanen.
messages.zh: 除非你是我的一位下属派来的，否则我跟你无话可说。如果你感兴趣，可以在卡莫科尔、阿图莱玛及塞卡伦的数据中心里找到他们。

messages.en:
Before you begin I should get you acquainted with my current assignment. I am Aviekko Ta, agent of Atoa Issa. I am one of many agents which were dispatched by Atoa to search for leads of the missing relics, which were stolen from the 13 Achur temples. So far I've had little luck, but I believe my venture in hiring graduates from the prominent aerospace aviation schools, like yourself, will pay off in the long run.

Your first task is to retrieve a few starmaps of mine from {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. I just ordered them from our archives on our home-planet Achura in Saisio. They should lead us Kikko Roisen, who I've suspected for quite some time to have been involved with the infamous heist.

Anyway, get going. I need those starmaps asap.
messages.zh:
在你开始前，我想先向你介绍一下这次的任务。我叫艾薇伊珂•塔，是埃图安•伊萨的代理人。埃图安派了包括我在内的许多代理人去调查十三座阿赫尔神庙内遭窃的遗迹的线索。目前暂时没什么进展，但我相信，把筹码压在雇佣像你这样的航空学院杰出毕业生上，最后肯定能让我获得回报。

你的第一个任务是到{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}取回我的几份星图。我刚从位于赛西奥的母星阿赫尔的档案室订购了这些星图。这些星图能指引我们找到奇科•鲁瓦森，长久以来我一直怀疑他参与了那场肮脏的事件。 不管怎样，快点去。我急需那些星图。

messages.en: Here are the starmaps, Aviekko.
messages.zh: 给你星图，艾薇伊珂。

messages.en: Excellent.  I'll have a look at these starmaps immediately and compare them to the data I already have about Kikko.  I'll let you know when I've found something ...
messages.zh: 很好。我要马上看看这些星图，把它们与之前拿到的关于奇科的数据比较一下。如果有什么发现，我会告诉你的……

messages.en:
The sacred pieces believed to be from the Rod of the Creator were stolen from under the watchful gaze of the Achur religious order. This any true Achur would know. The State has pledged enormous resources to tracking down the thieves. But even so the Elder Visionaries of Achura are not satisfied. They do not trust the State government, and they cannot sit idly by as their religion is ridiculed for its failure to protect the icons of its faith.

And so the Celestial Imperative was devised. Atoa Issa, a proud Achur himself, took leave of his prominent position within the Caldari Navy to oversee the search for the scoundrels who dared insult the Achur religion and people of Achura. By his side stands Seer Chakai Potan, representative of the temples of Achura. Together they control the enormous wealth the Achur government and the temples have supplied to fund this investigation. And to quote Atoa, 'no stone shall remain unturned, no world shall elude our probing gaze. I vow to you, people of Achura, that I will spend every fiber of my existance from here after to track down these vile, wretched thieves and restore the honor of our people!'
messages.zh:
我们的神器，造物者之杖的碎片在阿赫尔隐修会的严密防守下被盗了。每一个虔诚的阿赫尔人都知道此事。合众国已保证会尽一切可能来追查乱序者。但即使如此，阿赫尔的内部长老会仍不满意。他们不相信合众国政府，我们不能在别人的嘲笑声中坐等联邦找回族群最珍贵的神器。

于是星芒戒律会应运而生。阿赫尔的骄傲——埃图安•伊萨，辞掉了加达里海军里令人艳羡的职位，开始追查那些胆敢侮辱阿赫尔宗教和阿赫尔人民的无赖。与他共事的还有先知查凯•波坦，他是阿赫尔寺庙的代表人物。他们手中掌握着阿赫尔政府的巨大财富，而寺庙也提供了他们调查的资金。埃图安曾经起誓：“我要翻遍每一块石头，找遍每一寸土地。阿赫尔人民，我谨此向你立誓，我将不惜耗尽毕生心血，去追查这群卑鄙无耻的窃贼，以还我族人荣誉！”

messages.en: The Celestial Imperative
messages.zh: 星芒戒律会

messages.en:
Before you begin I should get you acquainted with my current assignment. I am Aviekko Ta, agent of Atoa Issa. I am one of many agents which were dispatched by Atoa to search for leads of the missing relics, which were stolen from the 13 Achur temples. So far I've had little luck, but I believe my venture in hiring graduates from the prominent aerospace aviation schools, like yourself, will pay off in the long run.

Your first task is to retrieve a few starmaps of mine from {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. I just ordered them from our archives on our home-planet Achura in Saisio. They should lead us Kikko Roisen, who I've suspected for quite some time to have been involved with the infamous heist.

Anyway, get going. I need those starmaps asap.
messages.zh:
在你开始前，我想先向你介绍一下这次的任务。我叫艾薇伊珂•塔，是埃图安•伊萨的代理人。埃图安派了包括我在内的许多代理人去调查十三座阿赫尔神庙内遭窃的遗迹的线索。目前暂时没什么进展，但我相信，把筹码压在雇佣像你这样的航空学院杰出毕业生上，最后肯定能让我获得回报。

你的第一个任务是到{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}取回我的几份星图。我刚从位于赛西奥的母星阿赫尔的档案室订购了这些星图。这些星图能指引我们找到奇科•鲁瓦森，长久以来我一直怀疑他参与了那场肮脏的事件。 不管怎样，快点去。我急需那些星图。

messages.en: I will help you look for Kikko.  What's my first objective?
messages.zh: 我会帮你找奇科。我的第一个目标是什么？

messages.en:
Your first task is to investigate a small settlement next to the ruins of an old Caldari station. It's been rumored to be inhabited by pirates in league with the Guristas organization. You might encounter some resistance when you start poking your nose around there, but I'm sure you can take care of it.

Your goal is to find any trace of Kikko. If you find nothing, then return back to me and we'll continue the search. You will recieve a bookmark to the location in the mission details in your Opportunities interface, of course.
messages.zh:
你的第一个任务是调查位于加达里旧空间站废墟旁边的小型据点。据说，那里居住着与古斯塔斯组织勾结的海盗。打探情况时可能会遇到困难，但你肯定能应付过来。

你需要搜集关于奇科的一切下落。要是实在一无所获，那就回来，我们会继续搜寻。当然，你会在“机遇”界面的任务详情里收到位标。

messages.en:
Your first task is to investigate a small settlement next to the ruins of an old Caldari station. It's been rumored to be inhabited by pirates in league with the Guristas organization. You might encounter some resistance when you start poking your nose around there, but I'm sure you can take care of it.

Your goal is to find any trace of Kikko. If you find nothing, then return back to me and we'll continue the search.
messages.zh:
你的第一项任务是调查一座老旧加达里空间站废墟附近的小型殖民地。据传，那里是和古斯塔斯组织勾结的海盗的栖息处。你在那里四处打探的时候可能会遇到一些抵抗力量，但我肯定你能应付。

你的目标是找到奇科的蛛丝马迹。如果你毫无发现，就回到我这里，我们再继续搜查。

messages.en: So you found nothing?  Well, at least we've narrowed down the search a bit.  Let's continue on.
messages.zh: 那么说你什么也没找到？不过至少我们已缩小了搜索圈。继续吧。

messages.en:
These starmaps are indeed interesting. They point to virtually hundreds of locations in Autama where Kikko has been sighted. Visionary Atahari has had him tracked ever since his bungled burglary attempt at the temple a few years ago, so that should come as no surprise. But I've managed to narrow down these locations to 3 settlements, where he has been spotted very frequently. These are the most likely locations where we will find him.

I truly hope he hasn't left the system, but at this stage we can only cross our fingers. The mercenary tracking Kikko on Atahari's command disappeared when he tried to confront Kikko on my behalf, and that may have triggered him to think about relocating himself. Fortunately rumor still has it that he hasn't left Autama, but you never can be too sure.
messages.zh:
这些星图确实很有意思。 它们完全指出了奇科在奥塔马现身的数百个位置。 不过这也不足为奇。几年前他笨手笨脚地试图对寺庙行窃，结果失手。在那以后阿塔哈里长老就盯上了他。 但现在我已把范围缩小到他经常出没的三个殖民地。 我们很可能会在这些地方找到他。

我真希望他还没离开这个星系，但到了现在这个阶段我们也只能祈求好运了。 阿塔哈里派出跟踪奇科的雇佣兵在与奇科正面交锋时战死，这可能会激起他再次进行转移。 幸运的是，有谣言称他尚未离开奥塔马，但世事难料。

messages.en: Agent Dialogue
messages.zh: 代理人对话

messages.en:
Your second objective is to storm a habitation module in Autama where Kikko Roisen has been seen multiple times. If you find him inside, then bring him to me. Either way, report back to me immediately after the operation has finished.

Again you will receive a bookmark into your NeoCom, so this should be simple enough. There may be guards there, so be prepared for a fight.
messages.zh:
你的第二个目标是直闯奥塔马的一个居住舱，奇科•鲁瓦森多次出现在那里。如果你在那儿发现他，就把他带回来。无论如何，行动结束后，马上向我报告。

同样，你的控制边栏里会收到一个位标，所以去那里很简单。那里可能会有守卫，所以做好战斗准备。

messages.en: I have checked the habitation module and this is what I found.
messages.zh: 我已检查了居住舱，这是我的发现。

messages.en: So you found nothing, except a worthless data chip recovered from the security monitor?  How depressing ...
messages.zh: 你除了从安全监视器上取得一块毫无用处的数据芯片外，什么也没发现？郁闷啊……

messages.en:
Your second objective is to storm a habitation module in Autama where Kikko Roisen has been seen multiple times. If you find him inside, then bring him to me. Either way, report back to me immediately after the operation has finished.

Again you will receive a bookmark into your NeoCom, so this should be simple enough. There may be guards there, so be prepared for a fight.
messages.zh:
你的第二个目标是闯进奥塔马的一个居住舱，奇科•鲁瓦森多次出现在那里。如果你那儿发现他，就把他带回来。无论如何，行动结束后，马上向我报告。

在你的控制边栏上同样可以看到位标，所以去那里很简单。你也许会遭遇守卫，最好准备好战斗。

messages.en: Cross your fingers, {[character]player.name}, if this lead doesn't give us any results then I'm afraid I'll have to report to Ichoro Hinalairos empty handed.  I've been trying to earn Atoa's favor for years and blowing this chance will be devastating.  So don't let me down!
messages.zh: 祈祷吧，{[character]player.name}，如果我们从这条线索还无法得到任何结果的话，那么我只能两手空空地向伊楚洛•西纳拉罗斯报告。多年来我一直在竭力讨好埃图安，浪费这次机会对我损失很大。所以，不要让我失望！

messages.en:
Luck has not been on our side so far, {[character]player.name}. And I'm becoming less convinced we will ever find Kikko *sigh*. The third hotspot which I want you to investigate is a bit different from the last two. It's a small mining colony situated at Autama VII's moon. I won't give you a bookmark this time, as you should find it very easily on any standard map of Autama.

Search the place thoroughly. If you can't find Kikko there, then I don't know what to do.
messages.zh:
幸运之神到目前都没站在我们这边，{[character]player.name}。对于能否找到奇科我已经越来越没信心了*叹气*。我要你去调查的第三个地点与前两个略有不同。那是一个位于奥塔马VII卫星上的小型采矿殖民地。这次我不会给你位标，因为你能在任何奥塔马标准地图上轻易找到这个地方。

彻底搜查那里。如果你在那也找不到奇科，那我也不知道该怎么办了。

messages.en: Incredible!  You did it!  You found Kikko!  I'll get to analyzing the data you brought back immediately, if it's what I think it is then we finally have a lead on the missing Achur relics!
messages.zh: 真难以置信！你做到了！你找到了奇科！我会马上着手分析你带回的数据，如果我所料无误，那么我们就掌握了失踪阿赫尔遗迹的线索！

messages.en: Warp to Autama VII – Moon 1 and find the mining colony there.  See if it leads you to Kikko.
messages.zh: 跃迁到奥塔马VII—卫1，找到那里的采矿殖民地。看看能否找到奇科。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en:
Luck has not been on our side so far, {[character]player.name}. And I'm becoming less convinced we will ever find Kikko *sigh*. The third hotspot which I want you to investigate is a bit different from the last two. It's a small mining colony situated at Autama VII's moon. I won't give you a bookmark this time, as you should find it very easily on any standard map of Autama.

Search the place thoroughly. If you can't find Kikko there, then I don't know what to do.
messages.zh: 看来幸运女神并没有降临，{[character]player.name}。对于我们能否找到奇科我越来越没有信心了……唉。我要你去调查的第三个地方与前两个有点不同。这是一个小型矿业殖民站，位于奥塔马VII的卫星上。这次我不会给你位标，因为你能在奥塔马的标准地图上轻易找到这个地方。

messages.en: So, what brings you to such a dangerous place?  The Guristas are not to be trifled with ...
messages.zh: 那么，你来这么危险的地方要干什么呢？古斯塔斯可不好惹……

messages.en: Well, erm, they told me I'd be safe if I gave them access codes to some corporation hangars at the Echelon Entertainment station here in Autama.  Hey wait, you aren't recording this are you? ...
messages.zh: 好吧，呃，他们告诉我，只要我把奥塔马的梯队娱乐公司空间站中一些军团机库的访问密码给他们，那么我就安全了。嘿，等等，你没有录音吧？……

messages.en: Uh ... yeah, Aviekko sent me.
messages.zh: 呃……那个，是艾薇伊珂派我来的。

messages.en: If you're not here to kill me, then do you mind sparing my life?  Kill the Guristas guards here if you want, take the loot, just don't kill me.
messages.zh: 如果你不是到这来除掉我的，能留下我一条小命吗？如果你高兴，尽管干掉这里的古斯塔斯守卫，拿走所有东西，但就是别伤害我。

messages.en: I found this data sheet in your stash, Kikko.  It has some pretty incriminating evidence about your dealings with the Guristas organization.  Either cough up whatever you're hiding, or I'll take this straight to the authorities.
messages.zh: 我在你的贮藏处找到了这张数据单，奇科。上面有充足的证据证明你与古斯塔斯组织有交易往来。你要么老实交待，要么我直接把这个交给当局。

messages.en: Ok ok, you can have the damn data chip.  I was going to sell it to her anyway, but since it's my life I'm bargaining for then just take it!  I've had it with trying to escape that wretch, even the Guristas can't save me.  Now please leave me alone.
messages.zh: 好吧，好吧，给你这该死的数据芯片。反正我是打算卖给她的，可现在它是我活命的本钱，那么你就拿走吧！我一直企图摆脱那个混蛋，可是就连古斯塔斯都救不了我了。请让我一个人静静。

messages.en: If you're not here to kill me, then do you mind sparing my life?  Kill the Guristas guards here if you want, take the loot, just don't kill me.
messages.zh: 要是你来这里不是来除掉我的，请留下我这条小命。你可以干掉这里的古斯塔斯守卫，拿走战利品，但请不要伤害我。

messages.en: You sure you don't have any work for me?
messages.zh: 你确定没有工作给我吗？

messages.en:
Hmmm, actually there might be something you can help me with. My corporation, Echelon Entertainment, has a long standing rivalry with Nugoeihuvi Corporation. We're competitors in the entertainment industry, and it always gives you an edge if you know what your adversaries are planning.

It so happens that I know of the location of a hidden Nugoeihuvi station in Autama. It's called Station Yxtara, and I'll supply you with a bookmark to it. What I want you to do is retreive the access codes I need to break into their central computer mainframe inside Yxtara. And I believe that I know of a person who has those access codes and should in fact be orbiting around a lookout post next to the station.

His name is Havatiah Kiin and he's the captain of Yxtara's security. He normally flies a condor right outside of the station, and should be an easy target. Now considering the station is supposed to be hidden, I'm quite confident that the station manager will want to keep it that way, hence I doubt they will call in CONCORD. However Nugoeihuvi will have their own guards defending the station. So don't say I didn't warn you!
messages.zh:
嗯，事实上也许你能帮我。我所在的集团——梯队娱乐公司向来与纳基维集团水火不容。在娱乐业我们是对头，如果能知道对手在计划什么的话，那将对我们非常有利。

碰巧我知道纳基维在奥塔马的一个隐蔽空间站，叫雅塔拉空间站，我会给你那里的位标。我要你做的就是找到我需要的访问代码，好让我进入他们在雅塔拉的中央主机。我知道有一个人拥有那些访问代码，他在这个空间站附近的一个哨所出没。

这个人的名字叫哈瓦塔•金恩，是雅塔拉的警卫队队长。通常他会在空间站外驾驶着一艘秃鹫级护卫舰，应该很容易对付。空间站很隐蔽，我敢肯定他们必然不想被我们发现，可能不会向统合部求救。但空间站会有纳基维自己的守卫保护，所以别说我没警告你！

messages.en: I have Havatiah's internal database records.
messages.zh: 我拿到了哈瓦塔的内部数据库记录。

messages.en: Excellent.  You've done me a favor and certainly deserve the implant you'll receive for your efforts.  Have a nice day, and give Aviekko my regards, heh heh.
messages.zh: 很好。你帮了我大忙，这个植入体是你应得的。祝你过得愉快，代我向艾薇伊珂问好，呵呵。

messages.zh:
嗯，事实上也许你能帮我。我所在的集团——梯队娱乐公司向来与纳基维集团水火不容。在娱乐业我们是对头，如果能知道对手在计划什么的话，那将对我们非常有利。

碰巧我知道纳基维在奥塔马的一个隐蔽空间站，叫雅塔拉空间站，我会给你那里的位标。我要你做的就是找到我需要的访问代码，好让我进入他们在雅塔拉的中央主机。我知道有一个人拥有那些访问代码，他在这个空间站附近的一个哨所出没。

这个人的名字叫哈瓦塔•金恩，是雅塔拉的警卫队队长。通常他会在空间站外驾驶着一艘秃鹫级护卫舰，应该很容易对付。空间站很隐蔽，我敢肯定他们必然不想被我们发现，可能不会向统合部求救。但空间站会有纳基维自己的守卫保护，所以别说我没警告你！

messages.en: So, what's next?
messages.zh: 接下来呢？

messages.en: I've quickly run over the data you recovered and I'm certain that it's genuine.  Now I need my report delivered to Atoa.  He's currently stationed in Uemisaisen, I've arranged one of his couriers to pick up my report in the Wiyrkomi Peace Corps Assembly Plant in that system.  Please deliver them there, and my associate will take care of the rest.
messages.zh:
我快速查看了你取回的数据，我可以肯定这些是真的。现在我要你将报告送给埃图安。他现在位于乌米夏伊森，我已叫他的一个信使到该星系的维克米和平工业装配厂来取我的报告。请你把这些报告送去那里，我的同事会处理余下的工作。

作为报酬，我会将你取回的数据给你，这样你就可以在伊楚洛•西纳拉罗斯会见你时亲自交给他。他是埃图安的上尉之一，也驻扎在乌米夏伊森。

messages.en: Nice working with ya, mate.  Ta-da.
messages.zh: 合作愉快，伙计。再见。

messages.en: I've quickly run over the data you recovered and I'm certain that it's genuine.  Now I need my report delivered to Atoa.  He's currently stationed in Uemisaisen, I've arranged one of his couriers to pick up my report in the Wiyrkomi Peace Corps Assembly Plant in that system.  Please deliver them there, and my associate will take care of the rest.
messages.zh:
我很快地看了一下你拿回来的数据，我可以肯定这个是真的。现在我要将报告送到埃图安那。他现在就在乌米夏伊森，我已叫他的一个送信人到该星系的维克米和平工业装配厂来取我的报告。请你把它送到那里去，我的同事会负责接收。

作为报酬，我会把你拿回的数据给你，这样你就可以在伊楚洛•西纳拉罗斯会见你时向他出示。他是埃图安的上尉之一，也在乌米夏伊森。

messages.en: I'm interested ...
messages.zh: 我有兴趣。

messages.en: The colleague that I mentioned, Avrue Auz, requires your graduation certificate before she'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Avrue.
messages.zh: 我提到的那位同事，艾薇•奥兹，需要看一下你的毕业证书，然后才能给你任务。我想你大概把它放在机库的什么地方了吧？如果找不到的话，我可以叫人在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}制作一份拷贝。去把它拿给我。只要我在上面签了字，你就可以和艾薇交谈了。

messages.en:
Ok, you're now all set to speak with Avrue Auz. You'll probably find her at her desk in the Creodon Factory in Lirsautton. And don't forget to bring your graduation certificate when you pay her a visit!

If you forget the location of this agent, you can always look it up by opening the 'show info' window for the graduation certificate.
messages.zh:
好的，现在你可以去跟艾薇•奥兹谈话了。在勒萨乌敦的西顿工厂可以找到她。去见她的时候别忘了带上毕业证书！

如果你忘了代理人的地点，你可以打开毕业证书的“显示信息”窗口来查看。

messages.en: The colleague that I mentioned, Avrue Auz, requires your graduation certificate before she'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Avrue.
messages.zh: 我提到的同事艾薇•奥兹在给你任务前需要看一下你的毕业证书。我想你大概把它忘在机库里了，也许其他地方，是吗？如果找不到的话，我可以在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}拷贝一份。拿来给我签署，之后你就能与艾薇说话了。

name.ja: パイロットの資格（導入部）

messages.en: I was sent to speak with you, Avrue, and I have this certificate to prove it.
messages.zh: 有人叫我来这里见你，艾薇，这个证书可以证明。

messages.en: Well, let's see it.
messages.zh: 好吧，我看一下。

messages.en: Bring Avrue a Graduation Certificate which you can acquire by speaking to one of her agents. The agents are in Data Centers located in Muer, Abenync and Ekuenbiron.
messages.zh: 去把一本毕业证书带给艾薇。你与她的一个代理人谈话之后便可获得此书。那些代理人位于姆尔、爱贝宁科及俄库恩比伦的数据中心里。

messages.en: Here it is.
messages.zh: 给你。

messages.en: Ah, so you're a qualified pilot eh.  I have some work for you after all.  Just give me a minute to go over my files, I'll have something for you to do in a jiffy ...
messages.zh: 啊，那么你是一个合格的飞行员咯。我的确有些适合你的工作。给我一分钟时间，我要先看一下文件，马上就给你布置任务。

messages.en: Unless you've been sent here by one of my subordinates, I have nothing for you.  If you're interested, you can find them in Data Centers in Muer, Abenync and Ekuenbiron.
messages.zh: 除非你是我的一位下属派来的，否则我跟你无话可说。如果你感兴趣，可以在姆尔、爱贝宁科及俄库恩比伦的数据中心里找到他们。

name.ja: ビーツァン・ピコーレン（1/6）

messages.en: So what is it I need to know?
messages.zh: 我需要知道些什么？

messages.en:
Your first task is to raid a merchant operating a small trading hub in Meves. He is known to have dealings with the Auboure family; he was in fact their first contact when they started expanding their trade relations outside of Lirsautton to compete with the Picholens. It is my firm belief that the Auboures have something to do with the smuggling incident that resulted in Beizan's arrest ― yes, I believe he was framed.

The merchant's name is Kelmiler Delbone. Interrogate him for me, find a way to make him reveal what he knows about the incident. Once you have something, report back to me.
messages.zh:
你第一个任务是去袭击一个商人，他在梅温斯开着一家小型贸易中心。据说他与奥博尔家族有贸易来往；实际上，从他们开始拓展勒萨乌敦以外的贸易关系以与皮歇朗竞争时，他是他们的第一个联络人。我非常坚信奥博尔家与那起导致贝赞入狱的非法贩售事件有关——是的，我相信他被陷害了。

这个商人名叫科尔米勒•德尔本。帮我审讯他，找个办法让他说出他所掌握的那起事件的情况。一旦你获得了什么情报，马上回来向我报告。

messages.en: Your first task is to raid a merchant operating a small trading hub in Meves. The merchant, Kelmiler Delbone, is known to have dealings with the Auboure family. Interrogate him for me; find a way to make him reveal what he knows about the incident that resulted in Beizan's arrest. Once you have something, report back to me.
messages.zh: 你第一个任务是去袭击一个商人，他在梅温斯开着一家小型贸易中心。据说这个名叫科尔米勒•德尔本的商人与奥博尔家族有贸易来往。帮我审讯他；找个办法让他说出他所掌握的那起导致贝赞入狱的事件的情况。一旦你获得了什么情报，马上回来向我报告。

messages.en: These documents will have to do.  Let's see if we can find anything in here that connects Kelmiler to the crime.  One minute ...
messages.zh: 一些文件需要处理。查看一下能否在这里找到任何与科尔米勒犯罪有关的资料。稍等片刻……

messages.en:
I am Avrue Auz, agent of Beizan Picholen. I came to Chandeille (Lirsautton V) eight years ago, during the height of the Picholen-Auboure family feud. Deni Picholen hired me as Beizan's secretary and financial manager. The Picholen family is quite wealthy, having long owned a number of franchises connected with Kaalakiota and their wares.

Anyway, the feud was quite draining on the Picholens, especially their wallet. But the biggest disaster the family had ever faced came only a few years ago. It was a dreadfully cold afternoon during the height of the Chabash winter on Chandeille when I received the news that a Picholen industrial had been caught by planetary security forces, trying to smuggle a troop of slaves and illegal combat boosters into Namin City. Speculation had it that the slaves were to be used as cheap manpower in a secret military operation directed against Auboure, named after its ancient ruling family.

To me, this siezure of assets was bad enough, but to make matters far worse, my employer, Beizan, was directly implicated in the deal, for the industrial smuggling the contraband had been rented in his name. It was a debacle. Kaalakiota canceled their multi-million ISK deal with Picholen, and the Governor of Chandeille placed a huge fine on the family that has basically crippled its financial status. In other words, the Picholens lost everything other than their name and sovereignty over Namin City. Most of their lands were confiscated, as well as their overseas bank accounts. I'm a bit surprised you haven't heard this story, in fact; it was all over the Federation media at the time.

But anyway, to cut the story short, Beizan was imprisoned in Pinmouth, an infamous Federation prison facility in Lirsautton, and resides there still. It is my firm belief, however, that Beizan is really innocent, and that is why I sent for someone like you.
messages.zh:
我是艾薇·奥兹，贝赞·皮歇朗的代理人。8年前我就到了香黛尔（勒萨乌敦V），那时正值皮歇朗—奥博尔家族斗争的高潮时期。德妮·皮歇朗雇佣我当贝赞的秘书以及财务经理。皮歇朗家族相当富有，并在与卡拉吉塔的陶器生意上享有不少特权。

不管怎样，这场争斗让皮歇朗家族损失惨重，尤其是对他们的钱包。不过这个家族面临的最严重的灾难是几年前发生的。那是香黛尔一个严冬的寒冷下午，我收到消息：一艘皮歇朗工业舰被行星安全部队的人扣留了，罪名是偷运劳工和非法格斗增强植入体去纳鸣城。传言称这些劳工将被作为家族突袭奥博尔市秘密行动的廉价劳动力，正如其名，长久以来该都市的统治者都是奥博尔家族。

对我来说，这起财产扣留事件已经够糟糕了，但更严重的是，我的雇主贝赞直接涉案，原因是运送违禁品的工业舰是以他的名义出借的。这真让人崩溃。卡拉吉塔取消了与皮歇朗价值数百万的交易，香黛尔地方官员也对其家族开具了巨额罚单，完全压垮了家族经济。换句话说，皮歇朗家族失去了一切，只剩下名字和在纳鸣城的主权。多数领地都被没收，海外银行账户也被查扣。你居然没听过这个故事，这事实上令我有点惊讶；那时联邦媒体对它的报道铺天盖地。

无论如何，简而言之，贝赞一直被囚禁在“针穴”中，这是一个位于勒萨乌敦臭名昭著的联邦牢狱设施，直到现在。不过我坚信，贝赞真的是无辜的，那也是我找来你这样的人的原因。

messages.en: Avrue's Story
messages.zh: 艾薇的故事

messages.en: Since you are so eager to work for me, {[character]player.name}, I would like to start off our relationship by explaining a few critical details.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，既然你那么渴望为我工作，那么我们就合伙吧，首先我要解释一些重要的细节。

name.ja: ビーツァン・ピコーレン（2/6）

messages.en: Found anything?
messages.zh: 没有发现？

messages.en: Fly to the FedMart station in Jel and return with records of FedMart transactions at that station. Perhaps they will lead us to whoever bought those illegal boosters from Kelmiler Delbone.
messages.zh: 我要你飞到杰尔的飞马集团空间站，把飞马集团在那个空间站的交易记录带回来。也许我们可以从中查出是谁购买了科尔米勒•德尔本的增效剂。

messages.en:
Thank you. Alright, let's see... Hm. Interesting. Hmmm. Oh, my goodness! These records explicitly mention a man by the name of ... Mamo! No, surely it can't be. Mamo Guerre!? The Mamo Guerre? Amazing, even if this clue turns out to be a dead end. At the very least, we have uncovered evidence of criminal activity on one of the most powerful men in {[location]agentRegionID.name}.

Good work, {[character]player.name}. Very good work!
messages.zh:
谢谢。好，先看看吧…唔，有意思。唔。噢，天啊！这些记录明确提及了一个人……马默！不，完全不可能。马默·格尔！？赫赫有名的马默格尔？太令人吃惊了，尽管这条线索将我们引入一条死胡同。但至少我们发现了能够证明{[location]agentRegionID.name}中一个最有权势的人涉嫌犯罪的证据。

干得好，{[character]player.name}。非常好！

messages.en:
The documents you retrieved reveal nothing about the industrial. However, what interests me is that Kelmiler appears to have sold a large number of illegal boosters to a member of FedMart, located in Jel. Interestingly, these boosters are identical to the ones found inside the industrial that was caught by the planetary security forces on Chandeille. Yes, a very interesting find indeed.

I want you to fly to the FedMart station in Jel. I have an acquaintance there who will supply me with records of transactions at that station. Perhaps they will lead us to whoever bought those boosters from Kelmiler Delbone.
messages.zh:
上次任务你拿回的那些文件并没记录关于这个工业区的资料。但是有一条信息引起了我的注意，那就是科尔米勒曾出售大量的非法增效剂给飞马集团的某个成员，他就住在杰尔。有趣的是，这些增效剂与由行星安全部队在香黛尔工业区内查获的一模一样。真是个有趣的发现。

我要你飞到杰尔的飞马集团空间站。那儿有我的一个熟人，他会把空间站的交易记录交给你。也许我们可以从中查出是谁购买了科尔米勒•德尔本的增效剂。

name.ja: ビーツァン・ピコーレン（3/6）

messages.en: I'd like you to pay Mamo Guerre a visit near the moon of Lirsautton VI. See if you can scrounge up evidence linking him with the incident Beizan's rotting in jail for.
messages.zh: 我希望你去勒萨乌敦VI卫星附近拜访一下马默·格尔。看看你能否找到什么证据，能说明他与致使贝赞入狱的案件有关。

messages.en: Aha! According to this message, Eilard Ansti purchased the boosters from Mamo Guerre. Eilard is a long-time associate of the Auboure family. Now I think we're finally getting somewhere...
messages.zh: 啊哈！从这条消息看来，埃拉尔德·安斯蒂的增效剂是从马默·格尔手里购买的。埃拉尔德与奥博尔家族交往甚密。现在我想我们终于有所发现了……

messages.en: I'd like you to pay Mamo Guerre a visit. You might find him near the moon of Lirsautton VI; my sources claim that he frequents that place. See if you can scrounge up evidence linking him with the incident Beizan's rotting in jail for. If Mamo's playing any part of this ... why, I'll drag his name so far through the dirt he'll move to Fountain and live as a hermit. But let's give him something Beizan certainly could have used during his trial ― the luxury of being innocent until proven guilty.
messages.zh: 我希望你去拜访一下马默·格尔。你也许可以在勒萨乌敦VI卫星附近找到他；我的情报显示，他经常出没于那个地方。看看你能否找到什么证据，能说明他与致使贝赞入狱的案件有关。如果马默在这中间起了什么作用……我就让他名誉扫地，让他不得不搬到源泉之域去当隐士。不过，在证明他有罪之前，我们还姑且当他是清白的，尽管那对他是种奢侈——这本该是贝赞在接受审判时享有的。

name.de: Die Angelegenheit spitzt sich zu (1 von 3)
name.fr: Le complot prend de l'ampleur (1 sur 3)

messages.en: I want information ...
messages.zh: 我需要信息……

messages.en: And why should I care?
messages.zh: 为什么我要介意呢？

messages.en: I was sent to speak with you, Mamo.  Do you have a minute?
messages.zh: 我受委派来跟你谈谈，马默。你方便吗？

messages.en: Find something of interest to Mamo Guerre ... Avrue Auz might have something in mind.
messages.zh: 找些马默·格尔感兴趣的东西来……艾薇·奥兹可能知道些。

messages.en: I believe this might interest you ...
messages.zh: 我想你对这也许感兴趣……

messages.en:
Ok, you have my attention. But don't think for a moment that your little plan has any chance of success. In these parts, I am practically above the law. You can go right ahead and report your findings to the authorities, little good it will do you ...

But before you leave, you might want to consider a proposition I have. If you do a certain job for me, then I will give you what you seek. The choice is yours.
messages.zh:
好吧，你引起我的注意了。不过不要以为你那个小计划有任何成功的可能。在这一带，我凌驾于法律之上。你可以直接去向当局汇报你的发现，这对你没什么好处……

不过在你离开之前，不妨考虑一下我的建议。如果你为我做个工作，那么我就会给你你在寻找的东西。你自己决定吧。

messages.en: I don't have time for simpletons.  Either leave me be or show me a good reason why I should waste my time on you ...
messages.zh: 我没时间跟傻瓜说话。要么马上滚，要么给我一个要在你身上浪费时间的充分理由……

name.de: Die Angelegenheit spitzt sich zu (2 von 3)
name.fr: Le complot prend de l'ampleur (2 sur 3)

messages.en: Just a word of advice before you leave, the spot you're about to warp to is located in a phenomenon we call deadspace.  Since we are also currently located inside deadspace, you won't be able to warp directly back here without the use of an acceleration gate. Instead you'll have to warp outside of the deadspace bubble and then back to me.
messages.zh: 在你走之前，再给你一句忠告，你要跃迁去的地方是个我们称为死亡空间的宇宙现象。由于我们已经位于死亡空间内部，如果不使用加速轨道，你就没法直接跃迁返回这里。在这种情况下，你将不得不跃迁出这个死亡空间立场，然后再回到我这来。

messages.en:
So let me get this straight. You want me to tell you what I did with the boosters that I supposedly bought through my connections in FedMart? No problem, as long as you do something for me. You rub my back, I rub yours.

There is a certain commodity I am after, which is extremely hard to acquire. It's virtually undetectable with the current sensors used by the customs officials, and is highly illegal if you get my drift. It so happens that I know where a few units of this commodity are stashed. In fact I've configured the gateway located behind my ship to send you there. It's being guarded of course, but that's why I need you.

Bring me what I need, and I'll give you the information you've been looking for.

Just a word of advice before you leave, the spot you're about to warp to is located in a phenomenon we call deadspace. Since we are also currently located inside deadspace, you won't be able to warp directly back here without the use of an acceleration gate. Instead you'll have to warp outside of the deadspace bubble and then back to me.
messages.zh:
让我把事情理清楚。你是想知道，对于那些我靠关系从飞马集团买来的增效剂，我把它们怎么了，是吗？没问题，只要你帮我做件事。这叫互惠互利。

我正在找某样东西，它极难弄到手。海关目前使用的感应器根本没法检测到这东西，而且它是完全非法的，如果你明白我的意思的话。我碰巧知道某个地方藏了一些这种东西。事实上，我已经设置好了我飞船后面的加速轨道，好把你直接送到那里。当然那里有人守卫，不过那也就是我需要你的原因。

给我带来我需要的东西，我会给你你在找的信息。

在你走之前，再告诉你一件事：你要跃迁去的地方是一个我们称之为死亡空间的地方。不用加速轨道你是没法直接跃迁回来的。所以你得先从死亡空间里跃迁出去然后才能返回我这里。

messages.en: I have the 'commodity' you are after, now cough up the info.
messages.zh: 我有你正在找的“商品”，现在详细说出来吧。

messages.en: Good job.  Now for the information Avrue Auz was after, one moment.
messages.zh: 做得好。我会把艾薇•奥兹想知道的事情告诉你，稍等一下。

messages.en:
So let me get this straight. You want me to tell you what I did with the boosters that I supposedly bought through my connections in FedMart? No problem, as long as you do something for me. You rub my back, I rub yours.

There is a certain commodity I am after, which is extremely hard to acquire. It's virtually undetectable with the current sensors used by the customs officials, and is highly illegal if you get my drift. It so happens that I know where a few units of this commodity are stashed. In fact I've configured the gateway located behind my ship to send you there. It's being guarded of course, but that's why I need you.

Bring me what I need, and I'll give you the information you've been looking for. Deal?
messages.zh:
让我把事情理清楚。你是想知道，对于那些我靠关系从飞马集团买来的增效剂，我把它们怎么了，是吗？没问题，只要你帮我做件事。这叫互惠互利。

我正在找某样东西，它极难弄到手。海关目前使用的感应器根本没法检测到这东西，而且它是完全非法的，如果你明白我的意思的话。我碰巧知道某个地方藏了一些这种东西。事实上，我已经设置好了我飞船后面的加速轨道，好把你直接送到那里。当然那里有人守卫，不过那也就是我需要你的原因。

给我带来我需要的东西，我会给你你在找的信息。成交吗？

name.de: Die Angelegenheit spitzt sich zu (3 von 3)
name.fr: Le complot prend de l'ampleur (3 sur 3)

messages.en: I'll do what you ask, but if you try and play me like that again I'll ...
messages.zh: 我会按你的要求去做，但如果你想耍我，我会……

messages.en: Yes, don't worry.  I've no more tricks up my sleeve, you'll definitely get what you want when you're done with this simple courier job.
messages.zh: 对的，别担心。我再不会耍什么小把戏了，等你完成这个简单的快递任务后，你一定会得到你所要的。

messages.en: So, what's the deal?  You said you'd cough up the info after I got you the crash ...
messages.zh: 搞什么？你说过只要我拿到克拉什，你就会说出我要的信息……

messages.en:
Don't be so hasty, {[character]player.name}. There's always a catch you know. All you have to do is transport the commodity to the FedMart storage facility in Jel. I need it analyzed there in our lab, plus you'll make a good test dummy to see if it actually works against the customs officials at the stargates.

Once the item is in your hangar there, then I will reward you with the information you seek. And I do hope you'll never show your face in my territory again after this is over, comprende?
messages.zh:
别那么急吼吼的，{[character]player.name}。要知道，机会总是有的。你要做的就是把物品运送到位于杰尔的飞马集团存储设施。我们的实验室要对它进行仔细分析，同时你也是个不错的试验对象，正好看看这东西能否骗过星门的海关官员。

一旦物品放入你那里的机库，我会提供你需要的信息作为报酬。还有，这事了结后，我希望你从此在我领土上消失，懂了吗？

messages.en: Alright, here you go.  Bring this data chip to Avrue, it will explain everything I know about her situation.
messages.zh: 好吧，拿着。把这个数据芯片带给艾薇，这能告诉你我所知道的关于她的所有事情。

messages.en:
Don't be so hasty, {[character]player.name}. There's always a catch you know. All you have to do is transport the commodity to the FedMart storage facility in Jel. I need it analyzed there in our lab, plus you'll make a good test dummy to see if it actually works against the customs officials at the stargates.

Once the item is in your hangar there, then I will reward you with the information you seek. And I do hope you'll never show your face in my territory again after this is over, comprende?
messages.zh:
别那么急吼吼的，{[character]player.name}。要知道，机会总是有的。你要做的就是把物品运送到位于杰尔的飞马集团存储设施。我们的实验室要对它进行仔细分析，同时你也是个不错的试验对象，正好看看这东西能否骗过星门的海关官员。

一旦物品放入你那里的机库，我会提供你需要的信息作为报酬。还有，这事了结后，我希望你从此在我领土上消失，懂了吗？

name.ja: ビーツァン・ピコーレン（4/6）

messages.en: I'd like you to bring Eilard Ansti here; he must know something about the crime, and it's essential that we acquire this information. You may use any means necessary. I will supply you with a bookmark to Ansti's whereabouts within a deadspace pocket in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. You'll have to navigate through a few checkpoints due to the warp disruption, but I'm sure you can "convince" the guards to let you through...
messages.zh: 我要你把埃拉尔德•安斯蒂带来这里；他一定知道一些有关那次案件的事，这对我们至关重要。你可以采用任何必要措施。我会提供你安斯蒂在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}中死亡空间层的位标。由于路途中会有跃迁干扰，你必须飞行通过几个检查站。我确定你可以让守卫“信服”，并让你通过……

messages.en:
You found Serpentis there along with Eilard's corpse?! Oh, my. It's getting very hot in here, suddenly, don't you find...? Ahem.

Give me a few minutes while I'll have the computer in our medlab perform a quick scan of Eilard's remains.
messages.zh:
你只发现埃拉尔德的尸体，还有天蛇？噢天啊。这里突然热起来了，你不觉得吗……？呃。

给我几分钟时间，我会用医学实验室的计算机对埃拉尔德的尸体作一个快速扫描。

messages.en:
Ok, it's time to pay Eilard Ansti a visit. I'd like you to bring him here; I really need to have a ... chat with him. He must know something about the crime, and it's essential that we acquire this information. You may use any means necessary ― you'll receive a sizable reward for your efforts, of course, and I'll see to it that the authorities don't get involved.

I will supply you with a bookmark to Ansti's whereabouts. Fortunately for us, he owns a small piece of space here in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, set within a deadspace pocket. You'll have to navigate through a few checkpoints due to the warp disruption, but I'm sure you can "convince" the guards to let you through...

I won't pull any punches here, {[character]player.name}. This may be quite dangerous. Good luck.
messages.zh:
好了，现在该去拜访一下埃拉尔德·安斯蒂了。我想要你把他带来；我真的需要跟他……聊聊。他一定知道一些有关那次案件的事，这对我们至关重要。你可以采用任何必要措施——当然，你会获得大笔酬金，我会确保当局不涉及此事。

我会给你提供安斯蒂所在地的位标。幸运的是，他在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}死亡空间层中有一小片空间。由于路途中会有跃迁干扰，你必须飞行通过几个检查站。我确定你可以让守卫“信服”，并让你通过……

不是要给你增加压力，{[character]player.name}。这事儿可能比较危险，祝你好运吧。

name.ja: ビーツァン・ピコーレン（6/6）

messages.en: So, what did you find out?
messages.zh: 你发现了什么？

messages.en: I think we can assume Govarde is alive until we receive evidence to prove otherwise: The Navy database has no record of his death. I have a bookmark that should lead you to a luxury resort in Lirsautton where Govarde is known to hang out. I want you to snoop around and search for any clues that might lead us to him.
messages.zh: 在得到有力证据前，我想我们应该假设戈瓦德还活着：海军数据库里没有他死亡的记录。我有一个勒萨乌敦奢华胜地的位标，据说戈瓦德在那里。我要你去巡视一番，搜寻任何可能帮助我们发现他的线索。

messages.en: Magnificent, you have him! I'll make sure he spends the rest of his days behind bars unless he can reveal anything of importance concerning the crime Beizan was imprisoned for.
messages.zh: 好强啊，你抓住他了！除非这家伙透露导致贝赞入狱的那次案件的重要情况，否则他将在牢狱内度过余生。

messages.en:
The data you retrieved revealed that this Govarde is indeed a member of the Serpentis organization and is wanted by CONCORD for a number of offenses. He was last seen in Lirsautton, which would explain his meeting here with Eilard. Now we can only hope that he wasn't one of the Serpentis you killed during your retrieval of Eilard's corpse, but I think we can assume Govarde is alive until we receive evidence to prove otherwise: The Navy database has no record of his death.

I have a bookmark that should lead you to a luxury resort in Lirsautton that has been under investigation for quite some time as a secret drug-manufacturing op. Not yet proven, of course, but the interesting part is that Govarde has been sighted there frequently by civilians staying at the resort. I want you to snoop around and search for any clues that might lead us to him.
messages.zh:
你得到的数据显示，戈瓦德确实是天蛇集团的一员，由于一系列的犯罪行为被统合部通缉。他最后一次出现是在勒萨乌敦，这也解释了为什么他和埃拉尔德约在这儿见面。现在我只希望他不是你在取回埃拉尔德尸体的时候干掉的那些天蛇之一，在得到有力证据前，我想我们应该假设戈瓦德还活着：海军数据库里没有他死亡的记录。

我有一个勒萨乌敦奢华胜地的位标，那里因涉嫌进行秘密违规药品生产，已经被调查了不少时间。尽管还没有证明，但是有意思的是，胜地的居民曾多次见到戈瓦德。我要你去巡视一番，搜寻任何可能帮助我们发现他的线索。

name.ja: ビーツァンピコーレン（5/6）

messages.en: What's the word from the medical lab?
messages.zh: 医学实验室有什么消息吗？

messages.en: Pay a visit to {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and pick up a package for me from an acquaintance of mine who's Navy data technician there.
messages.zh: 前去{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}找我一个朋友，他是那里的海军数据技术官，从他那里收集些资料回来。

messages.en: Excellent.  One minute while I take a look at this data ...
messages.zh: 很好。稍等一下，我先看一下这些数据……

messages.en:
The results of the autopsy scan show that Eilard was killed by a blaster at close range, most likely by the Serpentis goons who were waiting for you when you arrived. However, I did find an interesting bit of data in his ComPlant. The Serpentis probably hadn't gotten to extracting it when you showed up, so I was able to recover his datajournal entries.

Most of the information was useless (if mildly entertaining...), but one very recent bit of mem-script reads, "Meet Govarde at 1800h." Now, I might be reaching a little here, but perhaps this "Govarde" was one of the Serpentis you killed earlier? Maybe he was the person Eilard was due to meet? Certainly a difficult theory to prove, but I have an idea.

I want you to pay a visit to {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and pick up a package from a Navy data technician there. The records are off limits to non-Navy personnel, for they contain extensive data on the Serpentis, but I have a contact working there who should be able to do the research for me. He owes me one, and this is as good a time as any to pay up.
messages.zh:
验尸扫描结果表明，埃拉尔德死于近距离疾速炮的攻击，极有可能是在那等你的那些天蛇暴徒的所作所为。在他的计算机里，我找到了一些有意思的信息。由于你的出现，天蛇大概没能找到这一信息。因此，我才可以把他的日志信息恢复出来。

大多数信息都没什么用（当然都挺有意思的……），不过最新的一条信息是这样的：“下午6时，会见戈瓦德”。也许我只是推测，但这个“戈瓦德”是不是你之前消灭的一名天蛇成员？可能他就是埃拉尔德要会见的人？要证明这个想法很不容易，不过我有个主意。

我要你去{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}找一个海军数据技术员取一个包裹。由于其包含大量天蛇的资料，海军成员以外的任何人都不应该知道其内容。还好我认识一个可以帮我们分析数据的人。他欠我的人情，现在是时间去讨了。

messages.en: You can count on me!
messages.zh: 交给我吧！

messages.en: I do hope so ...
messages.zh: 我真心希望如此……

messages.en: What is the 'Khanid Insurgency'?
messages.zh: 什么是“卡尼迪叛乱”？

messages.en:
The Khanid Insurgency are rebels who want to topple the Khanid government and install one that'd be more inclined to start a war with the Amarr. They are led by an old, crazed hag going by the name of Deza Yobili. She claims to have been 'wronged' by the Khanid Monarchy, because as part of an exchange deal we handed her husband to the Amarr authorities in return for a group of Khanid citizens that had been illegally held in Amarr prisons. Her husband was nothing more than a murderer, and yet some misguided souls within the Kingdom view him as a martyr. It's a rather sad ordeal, all in all.

We are doing everything we can to stop Deza and her cronies, but she keeps eluding our grasp. And their numbers refuse to drop, which is why we have started taking extra measures to quell this uprising attempt before it gets out of hand.

Now here is where you come in. One of my servants, Ziona Koon, went missing while she was posing as a student for the Royal Amarr Institute in Emrayur. The last I heard of her she was on to something. She left a report in her quarters in Emrayur, and I would like to retrieve that report to figure out what happened to her. Please retrieve this report for me.
messages.zh:
卡尼迪叛乱组织是由一群意图推翻卡尼迪政府而建立一个与艾玛为敌的新政权的叛乱者组成的。他们的首领是一个年迈而疯狂的女巫，名叫德扎·尤比莉。她宣称卡尼迪王国欺骗了她，因为我们将她的丈夫交给了艾玛当局来交换被非法拘禁在艾玛牢狱的卡尼迪公民。她的丈夫只不过是一个凶手，而目前王国里部分民众却把他当成一个烈士。唉，可悲的人哪。

我们想尽一切办法来阻止德扎及其亲信，但一直以来她都逃脱了我们的围捕。眼见他们的队伍日益庞大，我们必须采取更多措施来平息这场叛乱，在局势失控前彻底解决问题。

现在只好把你搅合进来。我的一个手下扎欧娜•蔻恩在执行任务冒充厄姆拉亚的艾玛皇家学院的学生时失踪了。在最后一次汇报中，她透露了自己似乎在跟踪什么东西。在厄姆拉亚的住处有她留下的报告，我想要拿到那份报告，仔细调查一下发生的事情。请为我取回这份报告。

messages.en: Excellent.  Please wait a minute while I run over the report ...
messages.zh: 很好。请稍等一下，我先粗略看一下这份报告……

messages.en:
The Khanid zealot, Deza Yobili, nicknamed ‘the black widow', runs a guerilla army whose aim is to enact a coup against the current regime. She has captured the hearts of many hardline Khanids due to her heart-wrenching story. Her husband, Jabil Yobili and 3 of her sons were executed by Amarr Imperial forces after they had been handed over by the Khanid Navy as a part of an exchange deal for Khanid POWs. Jabil and his sons had been accused by the Empire of slaughtering many Amarrian citizens during an insurgency in Gousoviba.

Deza's youngest son, Abarak Yobili, was imprisoned by the Khanid government for ‘causing civil unrest', when he led a demonstration against the newly rejuvenated Khanid – Amarr alliance.

Deza is the figurehead in a persistent movement to oust the current monarch of the Khanid Kingdom, and to sever their ties with the Empire once more. They are still greatly outnumbered and opposed by the majority of the Khanid nobility, but even so they are considered a threat and the Khanid monarch is eager to eradicate this thorn from his side.
messages.zh:
德扎·尤比莉，绰号“黑巫婆”，是一名卡尼迪狂热分子，现正指挥一支游击队意图颠覆当前政权。她以自己催人泪下的故事俘虏了许多卡尼迪人的心。卡尼迪海军将她的丈夫雅比•尤比莉及三个儿子交给了艾玛帝国部队来交换卡尼迪战俘，之后他们被艾玛帝国处决了。 帝国控诉雅比及其儿子在古索维巴叛乱期害死了许多艾玛公民。

德扎的小儿子阿巴拉克•尤比莉，在领导反对卡尼迪-艾玛新联盟的请愿活动时被卡尼迪政府以“挑起民众暴乱”为理由拘禁起来。

德扎的势力日益壮大，他们反对卡尼迪王国现任君主，意图破坏好不容易与帝国再次建立起来的关系。 虽然与卡尼迪的贵族相比，他们人数不多，也处处受制，但这场叛乱仍对王国构成了威胁，卡尼迪君主不惜一切要清除这根刺。

messages.en: Deza Yobili
messages.zh: 德扎·尤比莉

messages.en: So, have you finished reading the report?
messages.zh: 你读完报告了吗？

messages.en:
I've briefly skimmed over it. The report mentions that Ziona had found a suspicious fellow who claimed to offer her a job inside the Khanid Kingdom. He told her to meet her at a rendezvous point in Emrayur, where he would go over the details. She was to bring all of her credentials along with her. This certainly sounds like an undercover operation of some sort. Maybe we've hit the jackpot!

I want you to fly to Emrayur and investigate the rendezvous point. I am afraid something may have happened to Ziona, since she hasn't been in contact with me for many days. Perhaps she left some clues as to where they took her.
messages.zh:
我流览了一下报告的内容。其中提到提到，扎欧娜发现了一个可疑的家伙，这个人声称要给她在卡尼迪王国提供一份工作。他要她到厄姆拉亚某个指定地点与他会面，到时再告诉她细节。她要带上所有的证件。这听上去就像某种秘密行动。看来我们撞大运了！

我要你飞去厄姆拉亚，调查他们的会面点。恐怕扎欧娜已经出了什么意外，因为她已经好几天没有跟我联系了。也许她留下了些线索，能指向他们把她带去的地方。

messages.en: You brought back a Khanid marine I see.  The rookie fighters that attacked you must have been some of the new recruits this rogue agent has been gathering.  Well, at least we don't need to worry about them in the future.
messages.zh: 你带回一个卡尼迪海军陆战队员，我知道了。这些袭击你的新手一定是那个无赖代理人聚集的一些新兵。至少我们将来不需在乎他们了。

I've briefly skimmed over it. The report mentions that Ziona had found a suspicious fellow who claimed to offer her a job inside the Khanid Kingdom. messages.en:
Turn out that the marine has certain weaknesses, and has received very little anti-interrogation training. The clock is ticking, but there may be a way for us to extract data from him in a rather more humane way than I had originally intended.

I'd like you to look for some ... helpful products on the market, as I haven't the time to see to those matters. Think of it as some time off from the more dangerous tasks that I have in store for you.
messages.zh:
很显然海军士兵也有其弱点，那就是几乎没接受过反刑讯训练。时间不多了，不过也许我们能找到一种更人道的方法从俘虏的嘴里问出点什么来。

我想让你去市场上买点...用得着的东西，我现在可没时间管这些小事。你就当是在执行危险任务的间歇轻松一下吧。

I'd like you to look for some ... helpful products on the market, as I haven't the time to see to those matters. Think of it as some time off from the more dangerous tasks that I have in store for you.
messages.zh:
很显然海军士兵也有其弱点，那就是几乎没接受过反刑讯训练。时间不多了，不过也许我们能找到一种更人道的方法从俘虏的嘴里问出点什么来。

我想让你去市场上买点...用得着的东西，我现在可没时间管这些小事。你就当是在执行危险任务的间歇轻松一下吧。

messages.en: So, how's the interrogation going?
messages.zh: 那么审讯进行得如何？

messages.en:
I think I've found our lead. According to the prisoner, the man we're after is Mamin Choonka. He runs a diner in Ashab, somewhere near the moon of Ashab II. It offers a hefty discount to students of the academy, hence it's quite popular among their ranks.

I want you to pay him a visit. But don't go in with guns flaring, I want you to get to know him. Tell him you just graduated from the academy, and let's hope he tries to convert you to his cause. If all goes well, he will offer you a place within the Khanid insurgency. Perhaps that will lead us to one of their bases, or even better Deza Yobili.

It's hard to pin Choonka down, so I won't give you a bookmark. Instead, I want you to fly to his base at the moon of Ashab II and find him on your own. I'm sure you won't have any trouble.
messages.zh:
我想我找到线索了。根据那个俘虏的招供，我们要找的人叫马敏·切文卡。他在阿沙比经营一家餐馆，准确地说，是在阿沙比II的卫星上。他给学院的学生打很大的折扣，所以餐馆在学生群中广受欢迎。

我要你去见一下他，但不要与他起冲突，我要你与他套近乎。告诉他你刚从学院毕业，估计他会设法笼络你进入他的组织。 如果一切进行顺利，他就会在卡尼迪叛乱组织中给你安排一个位置。 也许我们能够借此找到他们的一个基地，甚至找到德扎·尤比莉本人。

切文卡这个人很难追踪，所以我不会给你准确的位标。我要你去阿沙比II的卫星上自己找到他。我知道你能搞定的。

messages.en: Amazing!  This operation has gone more smoothly than I had expected, even in my wildest dreams.  I will report back to the Royal Family immediately, but before I leave I have one more task to give you.
messages.zh: 真不可思议！做梦都没想到，这次行动竟然比我预期的还要顺利。我会马上向皇室报告，但在我离开前，我还有一个任务给你。

messages.en: Find Mamin Choonka at his diner in Ashab, near the warp-in point of Ashab II's moon.  See if you can acquire the coordinates to the Khanid insurgency from him.
messages.zh: 去阿沙比寻找马敏•切文卡，他就在自己的饭店里，那里靠近阿沙比II卫星的跃迁点。看看是否能从他那里得到卡尼迪乱党的位标。

messages.en: Mission Objective
messages.zh: 任务目标

messages.en: Then I am definitely what you're looking for. I am well prepared for combat.
messages.zh: 那样的话，我正是你在找的人。我随时可以投入战斗。

messages.en: Your first job involves taking on a group of rogue drones that have for some god-forsaken reason decided to infest my storage facility in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. Destroy all of them, and then report back to me.
messages.zh: 你第一个任务是去清除一群自由无人机，天晓得它们为什么占据我在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的存储设施不离开。全部摧毁之后，回来向我报告。

messages.en: I heard you had work available.  Was my source correct?
messages.zh: 我听说你手头有工作。我的情报准确吗？

messages.en: Your first job involves taking on a group of rogue drones that have for some god-forsaken reason decided to infest my storage facility in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. Destroy all of them, and then report back to me.
messages.zh: 你第一个任务是去清除一群自由无人机，天晓得它们为什么占据我在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的存储设施不离开。全部摧毁之后，回来向我报告。

messages.en: A job well done, {[character]player.name}.  Take your reward, but don't leave yet.  I have more tasks in store for you.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，干得漂亮。拿好你的酬金，但先不要离开。我为你准备了更多任务。

messages.en: Ah, I was hoping you had something safe and easy. I'll have to decline.
messages.zh: 啊，我本来以为你的工作安全而简单。那么我得拒绝了。

messages.en: Now that depends entirely upon the source, {[character]player.name}. But yes, I might have something available. It depends on whether you're willing to risk your neck or not. My assignments involve fighting ... lots of it. If you're looking for something more on the lines of dung-hauling, I suggest you look elsewhere.
messages.zh: 那完全取决于你消息的来源，{[character]player.name}。不过是的，我可能有些事可以给你做。这也要看你是否愿意舍生忘死。我的任务与战斗有关……很多战斗。如果你找的是运送粪便之类的工作，那么我建议你去别的地方看看。

messages.en:
You did well against artificial intelligence, I'll give you that. But can you cut it against living opponents? Your next assignment is to destroy a pirate convoy carrying illegal goods into {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. You might ask, "how did you find out about this convoy?" The answer is that I ordered the goods myself. Through a contact, of course ― I would never reveal my true identity to those bastards.

Destroy the convoy, and bring the database from one of the ships to me if you manage to find one intact. I need to present it to the authorities so that we might trace their travel route to its origin and eliminate their drug factory for good.
messages.zh:
看来你有足够能力应付人工智能。但你能消灭和你一样的飞行员么？下一个任务是去摧毁海盗护航队，他们正带着非法货物进入{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}。你可能会问：“你是怎么发现护航队的？”答案很简单，这批货的订购者就是我。当然我们签订了合同，但我使用了假身份。

消灭护航队，搜索其残骸，找到一份完整的数据库文件，带回来给我。我会将文件提交当局，之后就可以沿着他们的航行路径找到源头，彻底消灭那个违规药品工厂。

messages.en:
You did well against artificial intelligence, I'll give you that. But can you cut it against living opponents? Your next assignment is to destroy a pirate convoy carrying illegal goods into {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. You might ask, "how did you find out about this convoy?" The answer is that I ordered the goods myself. Through a contact, of course ― I would never reveal my true identity to those bastards.

messages.en: Excellent.
messages.zh: 太好了

messages.en: So, what's my next assignment?
messages.zh: 那么，下一个任务是什么？

messages.en: Your third and final mission for me is to eliminate a group of rogue Khanid pilots in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. I entrusted them with some very confidential information, and they've repaid my trust by trying to blackmail me. Once you've reduced their ships to slag, report back to me. But don't forget to search the wreckage of their ships just incase they leave something behind, such as notes or any data concerning me. I don't want the authorities to trace their deaths back to me. That would cause some, er, unfortunate complications.
messages.zh: 你的第三个也是最后一个战斗任务是去除掉一群在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的卡尼迪飞行员。我把一些非常机密的信息委托给他们传递，但是他们却反过来勒索我。一旦你让他们的飞船变为废铁，回来向我报告。但是别忘了搜寻他们飞机的残骸，把他们留下的东西装进你的箱子，例如记录或者其他关于我的数据。我不希望有关当局因此调查到我，这很麻烦。

messages.en: The Khanid pilots are no more, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，卡尼迪飞行员全被消灭了。

messages.en: Magnificent!! You passed the test, {[character]player.name}. Nice work. Not only have you shown that you can handle yourself in combat, but you've also proven yourself to be reliable under ... "difficult" circumstances. I now truly believe I can trust you.
messages.zh: 漂亮！！你通过了测试，{[character]player.name}。非常好。你不仅能在战斗中把握自己，消灭敌人，也证明了自己在……“困难”的情况下值得信赖。现在我彻底相信，我可以信任你。

messages.en: Your third and final mission for me is to eliminate a group of rogue Khanid pilots in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. I entrusted them with some very confidential information, and they've repaid my trust by trying to blackmail me. Once you've reduced their ships to slag, report back to me. But don't forget to search the wreckage of their ships just incase they leave something behind, such as notes or any data concerning me. I don't want the authorities to trace their deaths back to me. That would cause some, er, unfortunate complications.

messages.en: Anything else you need me to do, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: 还有什么你想让我帮你办的事情么，{[character]agentID.name}？

messages.en: Yes, in fact. One last errand for you, {[character]player.name}. I'd like you to pick up some potential new recruits from the academy in Chaven. Once that has been completed, I'd like you to meet a very special person in the Khanid Kingdom. You'll find her at the coordinates listed in this data disc. Once she has gotten to know you better, you might have a very promising career ahead of you within the ranks of the Khanid Traditionalist Movement.
messages.zh: 是的，确实如此。给你最后一个差事，{[character]player.name}。我要你去查文的学院接一些可能为我们所用的新人。任务完成后，我会把你引荐给卡尼迪王国的一位非常特殊的人物。你可以在这张数据光盘所列的坐标处找到她。一旦她了解你之后，你也许会在卡尼迪传统思潮会拥有一份很有前途的职业。

messages.en: You've done well, {[character]player.name}. I think you'll fit into our ranks very nicely. But I'm afraid I've nothing more to offer you, so I must bid you fare well. Good luck in the future.
messages.zh: 你做得不错，{[character]player.name}。我想你在我们的组织里一定会如鱼得水。不过我恐怕没有别的任务给你，所以只能说再见了。祝你好运。

messages.en: Yes, in fact. One last errand for you, {[character]player.name}. I'd like you to pick up some potential new recruits from the academy in Chaven. Once that has been completed, I'd like you to meet a very special person in the Khanid Kingdom. You'll find her at the coordinates listed in this data disc. Once she has gotten to know you better, you might have a very promising career ahead of you within the ranks of the Khanid Traditionalist Movement.
messages.zh: 是的，确实如此。给你最后一个差事，{[character]player.name}。我要你去查文的学院接一些可能为我们所用的新人。任务完成后，我会把你引荐给卡尼迪王国的一位非常特殊的人物。你可以在这张数据光盘所列的坐标处找到她。一旦她了解你之后，你也许会在卡尼迪传统思潮会拥有一份很有前途的职业。

messages.en: What task is that?
messages.zh: 任务是什么？

messages.en:
I've had a sinking suspicion for quite some time now that I'm being followed. I kept seeing the same mysterious man behind the corner whenever I turned my head. It was getting quite antagonizing. I work for the Khanid secret-service, so I notice these things quite well ...

Anyway I had the man's ship bugged, and we tracked him down to guess where ... Mamin Choonka's diner. Obviously Choonka has somehow gotten a hold of my identity, and probably wants me killed. I suspect they will strike after I leave the station. Which leaves me in a sort of a dilemma, as I have to meet with my superiors soon for a meeting in Khanid space.

To make things easier for me, I would like you to take care of these pests. That should clear the way for me to leave the station for a while. I will give you the exact coordinates for their ships, as we still have one of them bugged.
messages.zh: 很长时间以来，我有一种不断加深的疑虑感，总觉得有人跟踪我。每次我一扭头，都会看到同一个神秘男子躲在我身后的拐角处。这越来越让人心烦了。我在卡尼迪情报部门工作，因而对这种事情很敏感……<br><br>不管怎样，我在这个人的飞船上装上了偷听器，并且跟踪他到了……你猜是哪里？马敏•切文卡的小饭店。切文卡显然通过某种方式掌握了我的身份，很可能想要干掉我。我猜他们会在我离开空间站后袭击我。这让我进退两难，因为我很快就要去卡尼迪空间会见我的上级们。<br><br>为了减轻我的负担，我想让你料理这些麻烦。那样我就可以暂时畅通无阻地离开空间站了。我会把他们飞船的详细坐标给你，因为其中一艘上还有我们的偷听器。

messages.en: Excellent.  You've done well, {[character]player.name}.  I'll definitely recommend you to his Highness.  Take care!
messages.zh: 很好。你做得很好，{[character]player.name}。我一定会把你推荐给殿下。保重！

messages.en:
I've had a sinking suspicion for quite some time now that I'm being followed. I kept seeing the same mysterious man behind the corner whenever I turned my head. It was getting quite antagonizing. I work for the Khanid secret-service, so I notice these things quite well ...

messages.en: I'm interested ...
messages.zh: 我有兴趣。

messages.en: The colleague that I mentioned, Arizam Gimit, requires your graduation certificate before he'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Arizam.
messages.zh: 我提到的那位同事，阿里扎姆·吉米，需要看一下你的毕业证书，然后才能给你任务。我想你大概把它放在机库的什么地方了吧？如果找不到的话，我可以叫人在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}制作一份拷贝。去把它拿给我。只要我在上面签了字，你就可以和阿里扎姆交谈了。

messages.en:
Ok, you're now all set to speak with Arizam Gimit. You'll probably find her at her desk in the Amarr station in Lossa. And don't forget to bring your graduation certificate when you pay her a visit!

If you forget the location of this agent, you can always look it up by opening the 'show info' window for the graduation certificate.
messages.zh:
好的，现在你可以去跟阿里扎姆•吉米谈话了。在罗西亚的艾玛空间站可以找到他。去见他的时候别忘了带上毕业证书！

如果你忘了代理人的地点，你可以打开毕业证书的“显示信息”窗口来查看。

messages.en: The colleague that I mentioned, Arizam Gimit, requires your graduation certificate before he'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Arizam.
messages.zh: 我提到的同事阿里扎姆•吉米在给你任务前需要看一下你的毕业证书。我想你大概把它忘在机库里了，也许其他地方，是吗？如果找不到的话，我可以在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}拷贝一份。拿来给我签署，之后你就能与阿里扎姆说话了。

name.ja: パイロットの資格（導入部）

messages.en: I was sent to speak with you, Arizam, and I have this certificate to prove it.
messages.zh: 有人叫我来这里见你，艾扎姆，这个证书可以证明。

messages.en: Very well, cough it up.
messages.zh: 很好，拿过来。

messages.en: Bring Arizam a Graduation Certificate which you can acquire by speaking to one of his agents. The agents are located at Data Centers near one of the stargates in Kudi, Polfaly and Ferira.
messages.zh: 去把一本毕业证书带给艾扎姆。你与他的一个代理人谈话之后便可获得此书。那些代理人位于数据中心里。这些数据中心毗邻库迪、包法利及费尔利拉星系中的一座星门。

messages.en: Here it is ...
messages.zh: 给你……

messages.en: Ah, so you're a qualified pilot eh.  I have some work for you after all.  Just give me a minute to go over my files, I'll have something for you to do in a jiffy ...
messages.zh: 啊，那么你是一个合格的飞行员咯。我的确有些适合你的工作。给我一分钟时间，我要先看一下文件，马上就给你布置任务。

messages.en: Unless you've been sent here by one of my subordinates, I have nothing for you.  If you're interested, you can find them in the Data Centers in Kudi, Polfaly and Ferira.
messages.zh: 除非你是我的一位下属派来的，否则我跟你无话可说。如果你感兴趣，你可以在库迪、包法利及费尔利拉的数据中心里找到他们。

name.ja: パイロットの資格（導入部）

messages.en: I was sent to speak with you, Pinala, and I have this certificate to prove it.
messages.zh: 有人叫我来这里见你，宾娜拉，这个证书可以证明。

messages.en: Well, let's see it.
messages.zh: 好吧，我看一下。

messages.en: Bring Pinala a Graduation Certificate which you can acquire by speaking to one of her agents. The agents are located in Data Centers in Arlulf, Emolgranlan and Engosi.
messages.zh: 去把一本毕业证书带给宾娜拉。你与她的一个代理人谈话之后便可获得此书。那些代理人位于阿尔卢浮、伊莫戈兰伦及因戈斯的数据中心里。

messages.en: Here it is.
messages.zh: 给你。

messages.en: Ah, so you're a qualified pilot eh.  I have some work for you after all.  Just give me a minute to go over my files, I'll have something for you to do in a jiffy ...
messages.zh: 啊，那么你是一个合格的飞行员咯。我的确有些适合你的工作。给我一分钟时间，我要先看一下文件，马上就给你布置任务。

messages.en: Unless you've been sent here by one of my subordinates, I have nothing for you.  If you're interested, you can find them in the Data Centers in Arlulf, Emolgranlan and Engosi.
messages.zh: 除非你是我的一位下属派来的，否则我跟你无话可说。如果你感兴趣，可以在阿尔卢浮、伊莫戈兰伦及因戈斯的数据中心里找到他们。

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: Good, I'll see you soon.
messages.zh: 好，很快我们会再见的。

messages.en: I'm interested ...
messages.zh: 我有兴趣。

messages.en: The colleague that I mentioned, Pinala Adala, requires your graduation certificate before she'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Pinala.
messages.zh: 我提到的那位同事，宾娜拉·阿达拉，需要看一下你的毕业证书，然后才能给你任务。我想你大概把它放在机库的什么地方了吧？如果找不到的话，我可以叫人在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}制作一份拷贝。去把它拿给我。只要我在上面签了字，你就可以和宾娜拉交谈了。

messages.en:
Ok, you're now all set to speak with Pinala Adala. You'll probably find her at her desk in the Eram IX - Moon 4 - Sebiestor tribe Bureau. And don't forget to bring your graduation certificate when you pay her a visit!

If you forget the location of this agent, you can always look it up by opening the 'show info' window for the graduation certificate.
messages.zh:
好的，现在你可以去跟宾娜拉•阿达拉谈话了。在伊尔拉姆IX-卫4的赛毕斯托部族办事处可以找到她。去见她的时候别忘了带上毕业证书！

如果你忘了代理人的地点，你可以打开毕业证书的“显示信息”窗口来查看。

messages.en: The colleague that I mentioned, Pinala Adala, requires your graduation certificate before she'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Pinala.
messages.zh: 我提到的同事宾娜拉•阿达拉在给你任务前需要看一下你的毕业证书。我想你大概把它忘在机库里了，也许其他地方，是吗？如果找不到的话，我可以在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}拷贝一份。拿来给我签署，之后你就能与宾娜拉说话了。

name.ru: Доставка данных о транзакциях (Transaction Data Delivery)

messages.en: Thank you. Be careful out there, those logs must not fall into the wrong hands.
messages.zh: 谢谢。小心点，那些日志绝不能落入他人之手。

messages.en: I have an important job for you, {[character]player.name}.  Because of your good standing and the fact you have successfully completed a number of missions for {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} we have decided you are worth the trust of a very important courier job. It entails bringing a large cargo of transaction and salary logs to this station from {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} where they have been stored for the last few weeks for a routine inspection by the authorities.  This data holds information of sensitive nature on our recent business dealings, earnings and expenses and wages that we pay our staff members.  Under no circumstances may any of these reports be lost, or worse yet fall into the wrong hands.  Pirates have a tendency to want this information so they can sell it to our rivals.  They used to have easy access to this information by hacking our transmission calls, but now that we send these reports via freight this is no longer as serious of a problem.  I trust you on this, {[character]player.name}, don't let me down.
messages.zh: 我有项重要的任务给你，{[character]player.name}。鉴于你良好的声望，以及数次为{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}成功完成任务，我们认为你是值得信赖的，所以将交给你一项重要的运送任务。我们在{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}存放了一大批交易和薪金记录用以应付当局几个星期以来的例行检查，现在你要把这批东西从那里运到这个空间站。这些数据包含了我们最近的业务交易、收入、开销和支付员工的薪水等很敏感的信息。这些报告无论如何也不能弄丢，要是落入居心叵测之手就惨了。我相信你，{[character]player.name}，别让我失望。

messages.en: I am very disappointed in you.  This failure might result in catastrophic consequences, should the logs you were supposed to transfer fall into the wrong hands.  If this happens I will hold you fully responsible.
messages.zh: 我对你很失望。如果你运送的这些记录落入居心叵测之辈手中，你的这次失败就将带来灾难性的后果。如果这事发生了，我会让你负全部责任。

name.de: Eine Macht, mit der man rechnen muss
name.en: A Force to Be Reckoned With
name.es: Una fuerza a tener en cuenta
name.fr: Une force dont il faut tenir compte
name.ru: Сила, с которой надо считаться (A Force to Be Reckoned With)

messages.en:
We've spotted a few Angel Cartel ships roaming near here. We believe that they are part of a reconnaissance force sent to scout for a weakness in security. We sent men out to intercept them, but none have returned. Another surveillance team caught sight of the pirates again recently, though.

The Angels are led by an infamous captain, Jenmai Hirokan. Do not underestimate him! Many have done so in the past and have paid the ultimate price.

I won't keep you here any longer. I'm sure you'll want to get going before we lose sight of Hirokan and his allies again.
messages.zh:
我们最近发现几艘天使企业联合体飞船在这附近出没。我们认为这是一支侦察部队，想要查出我们安全系统的薄弱环节，很可能是为了一次违规药品非法贩售行动做准备。我们派出了几个最好的飞行员去拦截他们，但是他们有去无回。不过另一组侦察人员最近又发现了他们，我们决定先按兵不动，直到有能力更强的人到来后再与他们交战。我希望你能接受这个任务，除掉这些恶棍。这些天使的头目是个声名狼藉的船长，你也许听过他。詹马伊·西洛卡。千万不要低估他！过去很多人犯了这个错误，结果都付出了惨重的代价。

我不耽误你的时间了，我肯定你现在已经想要出发了，你不想我们丢掉西洛卡和他同伙的线索吧？

messages.en: The Republic bastards just launched a daring but foolhardy attack on our outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They killed every man, woman and child residing there, taking no prisoners. This was probably a retaliatory attack after we killed one of their commanders, but it matters not. We must intercept them before it's too late. I have reliable information that the leader of this attack was none other than Warlord Ixon Kruz, so you will undoubtedly have a very tough fight on your hands. Prepare yourself well, but don't tarry too long or you won't get there in time!
messages.zh: 共和国的那些恶棍刚刚对我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的哨站发动了一次大胆而愚蠢的袭击。那里居住的男女老幼全部遇难，无人被俘。这很可能是一次报复性袭击，因为我们干掉了他们的一个指挥官，不过这无关紧要。我们必须拦截他们，再迟就来不及了。我得到可靠消息，这次袭击的首领不是别人，正是军阀伊克斯隆·克鲁兹，所以毫无疑问，你将面临一场艰苦的战斗。好好准备一下，但尽快行动，不然就来不及了。

messages.en: The Republic bastards just launched a daring but foolhardy attack on our outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They killed every man, woman and child residing there, taking no prisoners. This was probably a retaliatory attack after we killed one of their commanders, but it matters not. We must intercept them before it's too late. I have reliable information that the leader of this attack was none other than Warlord Ixon Kruz, so you will undoubtedly have a very tough fight on your hands. Prepare yourself well, but don't tarry too long or you wont get there in time!
messages.zh: 共和国的那些恶棍刚刚对我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的哨站发动了一次大胆而愚蠢的袭击。那里居住的男女老幼全部遇难，无人被俘。这很可能是一次报复性袭击，因为我们干掉了他们的一个指挥官，不过这无关紧要。我们必须拦截他们，再迟就来不及了。我得到可靠消息，这次袭击的首领不是别人，正是军阀伊克斯隆·克鲁兹，所以毫无疑问，你将面临一场艰苦的战斗。好好准备一下，但尽快行动，不然就来不及了。

messages.en:
We need you for a very important assassination mission, {[character]player.name}. The Caldari State military has set up a base in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, intent on flushing out pirate activity here. We cannot afford to launch a full scale attack on it at the moment, so we have been forced to resort to scare tactics to drive them away. We planned to assassinate their commander, who is their highest-ranking official at the military outpost, but so fair all of our attempts have been foiled. You are our last hope, {[character]player.name}.

Now is the perfect time to undertake this mission. We know that the Commander is traveling through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} at this very moment, and we can supply you a bookmark to his approximate location. Should you strike immediately, then you may catch them by surprise. He is traveling with a small troop from his armada occupying the military base, so the fight may be difficult for you if you go in alone.
messages.zh:
我们需要你去完成一项非常重要的突袭任务，{[character]player.name}。加达里合众国军方在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}建立了一座基地，意图彻底消灭这里的海盗势力。我们此时还无法对其发动大规模攻击，所以我们只能退而采取恐吓措施，希望能把他们赶走。我们计划除掉他们这个军事哨站中军阶最高的官员，也就是他们的指挥官，不过迄今为止，我们所有的尝试都失败了。你是我们最后的希望，{[character]player.name}。

现在是执行这项任务的最佳时机。我们知道此刻这位指挥官现在正在穿越{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，我们可以给你他的大致位标。如果你立刻出发的话，你将有可能出奇制胜。他和占领军事基地的一小群舰队一起行动，如果你只身前往，战斗可能会有些棘手。

messages.en:
That blasted priest, Karmone Tizmer, is at it again. He has set up base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and is busily trying to convert and kill our brethen there in the name of his false religion. With him are a troop of Amarr ships, being piloted by Cult of Catechization activists. We need someone competent to take them out of business before they cause too much damage. You are the perfect man for the job, {[character]player.name}.

But do not take this mission too lightly. They are quite dangerous, and their ships are of the highest quality. You will probably need backup for this one.
messages.zh:
那个该死的牧师卡尔蒙·迪兹姆又开始忙个不停了。他在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一座基地，正在以他伪宗教的名义企图说服我们的同胞改变信仰，甚至加害他们。与他随行的是一队由自我教派激进分子驾驶的艾玛飞船。我们需要找个有能力的人去把他们彻底除掉，以免他们给我们造成巨大损失。你是这项任务的最佳人选，{[character]player.name}。

不过千万不要小看这项任务的难度。他们非常危险，而且飞船性能极为优秀。这次你很可能需要找些帮手。

但不要低估了这个任务。他们都是非常危险的罪犯，而且配备精良。也许你需要一些支援来完成这个任务。
