messages.en: Absolutely, I'm interested. This one's right up my alley.
messages.zh: 有，绝对有兴趣。我就爱干这事儿。

messages.en: Good, good. I'll trust that you know what you're doing, then. See you soon.
messages.zh: 好的好地。我相信你清楚你要做什么。等你回来。

messages.en: A few unfortunate members of our corporation were kidnapped yesterday. I have reliable information that their kidnappers are close by. If you find the kidnappers, then deal with them appropriately and return their captives to me, dead or alive.
messages.zh: 昨天我们军团里面有几个倒霉的家伙被人绑架了。我的一条可靠情报显示那些绑架者就在附近。如果你碰到他们，就立马解决他们，然后不管人质是死是活都要把他们带回。

messages.en: The kidnappers are dealt with, and I've returned with the victims.
messages.zh: 绑架者已被解决，人质我已带回。

messages.en: Excellent.  The victims' families will be pleased that their loved ones are still alive.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。那些人质的家人非常欣慰地获悉他们关爱的人还活着。

messages.en: Uh, I'm not really much of a combat pilot, actually. Maybe someone else would be a better choice.
messages.zh: 哦，我不是那种很牛的战斗飞行员。你另寻高明吧。

messages.en: Fair enough, if inconvenient. Always refreshing to meet someone who knows his or her place in the scheme of things.
messages.zh: 真麻烦，不过说的也是。人贵在有自知之明。

messages.en:
Alright, here's a job you might be ready to tackle. A few unfortunate members of our corporation were kidnapped yesterday while on duty near the edge of this very system. I have reliable information that their kidnappers are nearby. I'll upload the coordinates into your NeoCom: You should use them to find a series of gateways which should lead you to these enemies of the state.

Sound like something you'd be interested in? If you succeed I will reward you handsomely.
messages.zh:
好的，我这里有一份你能干的活。昨天我们军团里面有几个倒霉的家伙在该星系边际执行任务时被人绑架了。我的一条可靠情报显示那些绑架者就在附近。我会把他们的位标上传到你的控制边栏中：有了它你就能使用一系列加速轨道找到这些国家公敌。

听上去有没有兴趣？如果事成我会好好奖励你的。

messages.en: Absolutely, I'm on it.
messages.zh: 没问题，我这就去干。

messages.en: Good — I'm certain you know what you're doing. See you soon.
messages.zh: 很好。我相信你清楚你要做什么。等你回来。

messages.en: You don't say… something I can help you with, I'm guessing?
messages.zh: 你好像没说……我可以帮忙的事？

messages.en: A few of our senior officials were kidnapped yesterday. I have reliable information that their kidnappers are close by: I've uploaded the coordinates into your NeoCom. If you find the kidnappers, then deal with them appropriately and return our people to me, dead or alive.
messages.zh: 昨天我们几位高级官员遭人绑架了。我的一条可靠情报透露绑架者就在附近。我已经把他们的位标上传到你的控制边栏中。如果你碰到他们，就立马解决他们，然后不管人质是死是活都要把他们带回。

messages.en: The kidnappers are dealt with, and I've returned with the officials.
messages.zh: 绑架者已被解决，我把官员也带来了。

messages.en: Excellent. We are forever grateful, and their poor families will be pleased to hear the news.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。我们会永远感谢你，他们的家人获知此消息后一定会倍感欣慰。

messages.en: Uh, I'm not really much of a combat pilot, actually. Maybe someone else would be a better choice.
messages.zh: 哦，我不是那种很牛的战斗飞行员。你另寻高明吧。

messages.en: Fair enough, if inconvenient — it's always refreshing to hear someone who acknowledges his or her place in the great scheme of things.
messages.zh: 真麻烦，不过说的也是。人贵在有自知之明。

messages.en:
Correct. A few of our senior officials were kidnapped yesterday while inspecting one of our sites in this very system. I have reliable information that their kidnappers are nearby.

Can you help?
messages.zh:
对。昨天我们几位高级官员在视察我们该星系里的一个驻地时遭人绑架了。我的一条可靠情报透露绑架者就在附近。

你能帮上忙吗？

messages.en: I'm up for the job, as long as it doesn't involve breaking the law.
messages.zh: 只要不违法，我就干。

messages.en:
Oh don't worry about that, you won't be breaking any laws. Or in other words, no one will know that you are breaking any laws. We dug up some dirt on the shaman in question, and soon he will be a wanted man in the Republic. We won't reveal it to the authorities until we have him though, just to make sure we get there before the police do. We need him alive, he's of no use to us dead.

Once our allegations of him are proven, he will be executed. It will matter little to the authorities if we do the honors for them. Therefore you have nothing to fear.

Now for your task, I want you to apprehend a member of the Angel Cartel. The Cartel is the biggest criminal organization in the known universe, so finding a few of their members shouldn't be very difficult. I'll even upload a bookmark to one of their hideouts for you, you can view it in the mission details in your Opportunities interface.
messages.zh:
别担心，你不会犯法的。就算你犯了法，也没人会知道。我们掌握了那位萨满的罪证，他很快就会成为共和国的通缉犯。在将他抓捕归案前，我们不会向当局走漏风声，这也是为了保证我们能赶在警察前面。他必须活着，否则就毫无意义了。

只要我们的指控证据充分，他就逃不过处决。至于我们有没有抢功，当局并不在意。所有没什么好担心的。

现在你要去逮捕一名天使成员。天使企业联合体是全宇宙已知的最大犯罪组织，要抓获他们几个成员并不难。我还会把他们某个藏身地的位标发送到你“机遇”界面的任务详情中。

messages.en: So, what do you need me for?
messages.zh: 那你想要我做什么？

messages.en: Warp to the coordinates that Pinala gave you, recorded inside the mission details in your Opportunities interface.  Destroy the Angel Cartel ships at their hideout and capture one of their pilots from the ejected container (if one survives).  Bring this person back to your agent, as long as the captive is still alive.
messages.zh: 按照宾娜拉发送到“机遇”界面任务详情中的坐标地点进行跃迁。摧毁位于藏身处的天使舰船，并在逃生舱生擒一名逃跑的飞行员（要活的）。将活着的俘虏带到代理人面前。

messages.en: Here is the prisoner you asked for.
messages.zh: 这是你要的囚犯。

messages.en: Excellent!  He will do nicely.  But there's more to be done, so stick around.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！他会做得很好。但现在还有些事要做，所以别走远。

messages.en:
The Brutor, Hnarlir Afer, has been an outcast from his home-world, Matar, ever since his Voluval ritual. The mark it left behind was so shameful even his loving father disowned him. He moved to the Gallente Federation, where hardly anyone recognized the mark or paid it any attention. There he began a life of a mercenary, having been bred as a space pilot by his military veteran father.

He quickly made a name for himself, before becoming a freelancer. Using the wealth he garnered from that profession, he started up his own corporation, The Markoni Dragons. It has been quite successful, earning Hnarlir a small fortune.

But even with his change of fortune, Hnarlir greatly misses his homeworld. He desperately wants to return and reclaim a position within his nation of birth. But he dares not return with the mark on his cheek as visible as ever. His family has suffered enough shame on his behalf already.

Yet Hnarlir still has hope. Hope that his ‘condition' can finally be modified. Even though it goes against everything the Minmatar consider holy, Hnarlir is just desperate, and wealthy, enough to pull it off. He wants to learn the method which the Vheriokor shamans use to perform the Voluval ritual and modify the mark so that it no longer resembles the symbol of the Ammatar Mandate.
messages.zh:
纳尔利洱•阿斐，曾是一位骄傲的布鲁特人，但在一生一次的沃鲁瓦仪式中失败了，遭到了其家园玛塔尔的驱逐。仪式在其脸上留下的耻辱印记如此深刻，连他亲爱的父亲都与他断绝了父子关系。之后阿斐去了盖伦特联邦，那里没有人知道这个印记，更不会留意它。在那里，他开始自己的佣兵生涯，自小父亲就将其高超的战斗技术倾囊相授，因此阿斐对于自己的新职业非常满意。

之后他成为了一个自由战士，并很快在所处的圈子中声名鹊起。利用逐渐积累的财产，他开始着手组建自己的军团：马可尼龙盟。纳尔利洱的事业非常成功，给他带来了无数的财富。

虽然纳尔利洱已是腰缠万贯的富翁，但他对母国的思念却从未消减。他很想回到自小生活的世界，并取回他的身分。可他不敢回去，脸颊上的印记越来越明显。他的家庭也因他遭受了无数羞辱。

然而，纳尔利洱仍然怀有希望，希望其境况最终能改变。他想尽了一切办法——即使背弃米玛塔尔的神——也要抹掉这耻辱的印记。有钱能使鬼推磨。他想要知道维洛奇亚的萨满法师执行沃鲁瓦仪式的的方法，并改变自己的印记形状，使其看上去不再像艾玛达特统区的标志。

messages.en: The Disgraced Son
messages.zh: 蒙羞之子

messages.en: Now that I know you have the skills to pull through, it's time to test your loyalty.  So I'll get straight to the point.  I work for a Matar citizen, who wishes to remain anonymous, who was wronged by a certain Vherokior shaman.  My client wants revenge, and this requires the capture of this Vherokior individual.  If you don't have the guts to take part in this endeavor, then I suggest you leave now.
messages.zh: 既然你有突破重围的本事，那么现在是测试你忠诚度的时候。那么我直接说主题。我为某个不愿透露姓名的玛塔尔公民工作，维洛奇亚萨满冤枉了他。我的客户想要报仇，这就要我们抓住这个维洛奇亚人了。如果你没胆参与进来，那么我建议你现在马上离开。

messages.en: Makes sense.
messages.zh: 有道理。

messages.en: Good, now get going.
messages.zh: 好，现在去吧。

messages.en: So, what's next?
messages.zh: 接下来呢？

messages.en: Now I would like you to drop off these reports I have to the Vherokior Bureau in Gelfiven.  An associate of mine will retrieve it from the hangar there.  These reports and the Angel Cartel prisoner you brought me will be enough to convince any jury of the Vherokior shaman's guilt.  That should set us up nicely for capturing him.
messages.zh: 现在我要你将这些报告送到杰斐文的维洛奇亚办事处。我的一个同事会从那里的机库中取走报告。你带给我的这些报告和那个天使企业联合体囚犯足以使陪审团相信这个维洛奇亚萨满是有罪的。这对我们逮捕他非常有利。

messages.en: Good job.  We're almost there ...
messages.zh: 做得好。我们马上就要成功了……

messages.en: This sounds a bit too suspicious to me.  I'm out.
messages.zh: 听起来很可疑。我不做。

messages.en: Bah, I knew you didn't have it in you.  Get lost then, bud.
messages.zh: 呵，我知道你没这个天赋。滚蛋吧，伙计。

messages.en: Now I would like you to drop off these reports I have to the Vherokior Bureau in Gelfiven.  An associate of mine will retrieve it from the hangar there.  These reports and the Angel Cartel prisoner you brought me will be enough to convince any jury of the Vherokior shaman's guilt.  That should set us up nicely for capturing him.
messages.zh: 现在我要你将这些报告送到杰斐文的维洛奇亚办事处。我的一个同事会在那儿接收。你带给我的这些报告，以及天使企业联合体的囚犯足以使陪审团相信维洛奇亚的萨满有罪。这样我们就有理由逮捕他了。

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: Well, what are you waiting for then?
messages.zh: 你在等什么？

messages.en: What's my next assignment.
messages.zh: 下一个任务是什么？

messages.en:
Before we make our attempt at capturing Logut Akell, the Vherokior shaman I was referring to earlier, we need to find him. He is currently meditating somewhere in Eram, but I haven't been able to track him down. If you didn't know, this meditation process of the Vherokior shamans can take months or even years, and frankly I'd rather not wait that long.

There is one link to Logut that I haven't pursued ... yet. His name is Matique Karani, and he's an associate of Loguts. I want you to pay Matique a visit and force him to reveal the whereabouts of Logut. Use any means necessary.

Oh and you'll probably have to deal with a few guards Matique hired. If it weren't for them, I'd have done the dirty work myself a long time ago.
messages.zh:
在我们采取逮捕卢戈•阿科尔——也就是前面说的维洛奇亚萨满——的行动之前，我们得先找到他。他现在正在伊尔拉姆的某处冥想，可是我还没能找出他的踪迹。也许你不知道，维洛奇亚萨满的冥想过程可能要持续几个月甚至几年，坦白说，我可不愿意等那么久。

还有一条跟卢戈有关的线索我还没查。他叫马提克·卡拉尼，是卢戈的同事。我希望你去拜访一下马提克，逼他说出卢戈的下落。你可以使用任何必要的手段。

哦，对了，你很可能需要对付马提克雇来的一些守卫。要不是因为他们，我很早以前就自己下手了。

messages.en: So he's at one of Eram IV's moons eh?  I hope you 'took care of Matique' in your last mission, otherwise I'm afraid he may have notified Logut about our plans already.  But either way we can't waste any more time, it's time to finish what we started.
messages.zh: 那么说他在伊尔拉姆IV的某个卫星上？我希望你在上个任务中“解决了马提克”，否则恐怕他可能已经向卢戈通报了我们的计划了。不过不管怎样，我们都不能浪费时间，现在是结束这一切的时候了。

messages.en:
Before we make our attempt at capturing Logut Akell, the Vherokior shaman I was referring to earlier, we need to find him. He is currently meditating somewhere in Eram, but I haven't been able to track him down. If you didn't know, this meditation process of the Vherokior shamans can take months or even years, and frankly I'd rather not wait that long.

There is one link to Logut that I haven't pursued ... yet. His name is Matique Karani, and he's an associate of Loguts. I want you to pay Matique a visit and force him to reveal the whereabouts of Logut. Use any means necessary.

Oh and you'll probably have to deal with a few guards Matique hired. If it weren't for them, I'd have done the dirty work myself a long time ago.
messages.zh:
在我们俘获卢戈•阿科尔之前，我们要先找到维洛奇亚萨满。他正在伊尔拉姆的某处冥想，但我还未找出他的行迹。你可能不知道，维洛奇亚萨满的冥想仪式可能要花上几个月甚至几年，坦白说，我不能等很久。

还有一个与卢戈有联系的人我没有追踪。他的名字叫马提克•卡拉尼，卢戈的同事。我想让你去拜访马提克，并设法让其透露卢戈的下落，为此你可以使用任何手段。

你需要处理一些马提克雇用的守卫。如果不是因为他们，我早就亲自料理这件事了。

messages.en: Alright, alright, I'll do it.
messages.zh: 好吧好吧，我会做的。

messages.en: I'll see you soon, with Logut.
messages.zh: 我很快就回来，带着卢戈。

messages.en: My next assignment please.
messages.zh: 请给我下一个任务。

messages.en: Find Logut and bring him to your agent, alive. Your agent told you to find the objective near a moon orbiting Eram IV.
messages.zh: 找到卢戈，将他活着带到你的代理人那儿。你的代理人告诉你，目标就在伊尔拉姆IV的一个卫星附近。

messages.en: Great work!  My men are taking care of his 'accommodations' as we speak.  You'll be rewarded well for your efforts, of course.
messages.zh: 干得不错！就在我们说话的当口，我的人在照顾他的“起居”。当然，你的努力将换得丰厚的奖赏。

messages.en: I'm tired of your insults, Pinala, go find someone else to do your dirty work.
messages.zh: 我受够了你的侮辱，宾娜拉，去找其他人帮你做那肮脏的勾当吧。

messages.en: I already told you, go get Logut!  Matique said he was located near one of the moons of Eram IV, so go get him!  Now!
messages.zh: 我已经告诉你了，去抓卢戈！马提克说他就在伊尔拉姆IV的一个卫星附近，所以你赶快去抓他！马上！

name.ja: Snatching The Shaman [シャーマンの拉致]

messages.en: No, you either hand him over now or I blow this place up.
messages.zh: 不，你要么现在交出他，要么我马上毁了这个地方。

messages.en: How dare you!?  I will not 'hand him over', and I am perfectly fine with laying down my life for Logut.  We also have a very nice security system in place, so I'd think twice about attacking our home or trying to sneak in ...
messages.zh: 你敢！？我不会“交出他”，我很高兴为卢戈出生入死。我们还有个非常完善的安全系统，如果我是你，我会重新考虑一下正面攻击或潜入的可能性……

messages.en: I need to have a chat with Logut Akell.  It's personal.
messages.zh: 我要和卢戈•阿科尔谈谈。私下里。

messages.en: Obtain something of importance to Logut, to force him to come with you.  A wise choice would be to use the gateway beneath Logut's abode, perhaps it leads to somewhere interesting.  The key to the gateway must be around here somewhere ... I suspect a Data Analyzer may come in useful.
messages.zh: 拿些对卢戈重要的东西，逼他跟你来。  一个明智的做法就是利用卢戈住处下面的通道，也许它通向某个有意思的地方。  通道的钥匙一定就在这附近的某个地方…… 我觉得带上数据分析仪会很有用处。

messages.en: I have someone here with me that might 'interest' Logut ...
messages.zh: 我带了一个人来，也许卢戈会“感兴趣”……

messages.en:
No, this cannot be! Touch a strand of hair on Dari's head and we'll have the Republic Fleet so far up your ass they'll hear your screams on Amarr Prime. But I will speak to Logut, as long as Dari is unharmed.

*long pause*

Logut has agreed to your terms, he will cooperate as long as Dari remains safe with me. He would do anything for his daughter, even surrender to treasonous scoundrels like yourself. But be warned, if he is not returned safe and sound within the month, we will contact the Minmatar secret service and they will hunt you down like the dog you are. Be-gone!¨
messages.zh:
不，这不可能！你只要敢碰达莉一根头发，那么共和舰队就会马上攻击你们，你们就只能在艾玛首星上惨叫。不过，只要达莉没事，那么我会对卢戈说的。

*长时间的停顿*

卢戈同意了你的条件，只要达莉安全地待在我身边，那么他会与你合作。他愿意为女儿做任何事，哪怕是向你这无耻小人投降。但他警告你们，如果他不能在一个月内毫发无损地回来，我们就会通知米玛塔尔特工部门，而他们就会像打狗一样干掉你们。现在从我眼前消失！

messages.en: Right-e-o, I'm sorry to disturb you.  Silly me.
messages.zh: 是嘞，很抱歉打扰你。我真笨。

messages.en: Uh, ok.
messages.zh: 好吧。

messages.en: The key to the gateway is hidden inside the blasted neon sign near Logut's Abode, so bring along a Data Analyzer.
messages.zh: 通道的钥匙藏在卢戈住处附近的一个霓虹灯里，记得带上一个数据分析仪。

messages.en: Hint
messages.zh: 提示

messages.en: I'm sorry but he explicitly told me to prevent anyone from disturbing him today.  Maybe some other time?
messages.zh: 非常抱歉，但他明确表示今天不想见任何人。也许改在下次？

name.ja: The Shaman's Will［シャーマンの願い］

messages.en: I'll wait.
messages.zh: 我会等的。

messages.en:
I have spoken with Logut. He says that he will come with you under the pretense that you have 'kidnapped' him for Pinala. He will be wearing a bug attached to his garments, which will send his exact coordinates to me. I will then inform the government of his kidnapper's location, and hopefully they'll be taken care of by the Republic Fleet.

However before he can commit himself to such a dangerous task, he wants you to do him a favor. His daughter, Dari Akell, lost her husband to the Angel Cartel. He was a miner, working as a contractor in Elgoi for Core Complexion inc, when a gang of Cartel thugs struck. They had threatened to 'cause grievous harm' to the mining operation if the foreman would neglect to pay them tribute, but he had refused. So they made an example of some of his subordinates, including Dari's husband. The Cartel got what they wanted, and Logut's son-in-law is now dead.

Needless to say, Logut wants revenge. I will supply you with a bookmark to the mining operation where Dari's husband was stationed, a few Angel goons should be located nearby. Destroy them. Do not return until this task has been accomplished.
messages.zh:
我已跟卢戈谈过了。他说愿意让你假装“劫持”他去见宾娜拉。他会在外衣上装偷听器，并把确切坐标发送给我。然后我会向政府报告绑匪的位置，希望共和舰队能把它们一举歼灭。

但在他投身于如此危险的任务之前，他要你先帮他做件事。卢戈的爱女达莉•阿科尔的丈夫被天使企业联合体害死了。他是个矿工，在伊尔戈伊为核心局面公司工作，那时有一群天使暴徒袭击了他。他们威胁说如果不给他们好处的话就让采矿无法进行，但是他拒绝了。所以他们干掉了他的部分下属，也包括达莉的丈夫以儆效尤。天使得到了它们想要的一切，而卢戈的女婿却死于非命。

卢戈复仇心切理所当然。我会把那个采矿地的位标给你，那儿就是达莉丈夫曾呆过的地方，附近应该有几个天使暴徒。干掉他们。完成任务再回来！

messages.en: Actually, I was sent here by a person named Pinala Adala.  I was supposed to kidnap Logut, but I've had a change of heart.
messages.zh: 事实上，是一个叫宾娜拉•阿达拉的人派我来这里的。本来我要绑架卢戈，但我改变主意了。

messages.en: I have done what you asked, Hlebnar.
messages.zh: 我已照你说的做了，雷伯纳。

messages.en: Alright, Logut will see you now.  Take him to Pinala, we will take care of the rest.  Fare well.
messages.zh: 好了，卢戈现在要见你。带他去找宾娜拉那里，我们会处理接下来的事情。再见。

messages.en: Sorry but I don't have time to wait for you, I have business elsewhere.
messages.zh: 对不起，我没有时间等你，我还有其他事情。

messages.en:
Ah, is that so? I will relay this information to Logut immediately, one minute ...

*long pause*
messages.zh:
啊，是这样吗？我会立刻把这条消息转告给卢戈的，请稍等……

*长时间的停顿*

messages.en: Excellent.  Be on your way then.
messages.zh: 很好。那么去吧。

messages.en: Is there anything else you wish of me?
messages.zh: 还有其它事吗？

messages.en: As your final task for me, I would like you to help with delivering the reports of our success to Hnarlir Afer.  His agent in Eystur will pick them up and deliver them the rest of the way.  Hnarlir is a very secretive man, and would not want his whereabouts known to just anyone, even a trusted accomplice such as yourself.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 你的最后任务就是帮我将我们的胜利报告送给纳尔利洱·阿斐那。他在尤斯塔的代理人会将报告取走，走完余下的运送行程。纳尔利洱是个行事隐秘的人，不会随便让人知道他的行踪，甚至是他信任的同伙，比如你。祝你好运。

messages.en: I have delivered the reports, as you requested.
messages.zh: 照你说的，我已将报告送去。

messages.en: You've done well, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你干得不错，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: As your final task for me, I would like you to help with delivering the reports of our success to Hnarlir Afer.  His agent in Eystur will pick them up and deliver them the rest of the way.  Hnarlir is a very secretive man, and would not want his whereabouts known to just anyone, even a trusted accomplice such as yourself.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 你的最后任务就是帮我将我们的胜利报告送到纳尔利洱•阿斐那。他在尤斯塔的代理人会取走报告，并将它送往该去的地方。纳尔利洱是一个很神秘的人，他不想让其他人知道他的行踪，甚至是他信任的伙伴，就比如你。祝你好运。

messages.en: I'll rescue them in no time.
messages.zh: 我会马上去营救他们。

messages.en: Excellent! You've lived up to my expectations.
messages.zh: 很好，你果然没有让我失望。

messages.en: Give me something meaningful to do, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm looking for a challenge.
messages.zh: 给我些有意义的东西做，{[character]agentID.name}。我在找刺激。

messages.en:
Hmm... Yes, I do have some work for you.

Although the Cartel usually has a firm grip over the criminal strata in our system, Sansha's Nation has been poking its ugly nose in here of late-- which is perfectly fine with us. In fact, watching the two outlawed organizations duke it out is one of my favorite pastimes. If we're lucky, it will give both sides a good bruising, which will only work in our favor.

Of course, there's also bad news. An InterBus ship traveling to {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} got caught in the middle of one of the pirate warzones. The ship was damaged beyond repair and can neither warp out nor navigate away from the crossfire. Your task is to rescue the ship's crew. Please retrieve them before any more harm is done; they're already scared out of their minds. The faster you get this done, the better.

Oh, and before you leave I'd like to give you a word of advice. When you venture into this particular deadspace area, the warpgates are not locked, which gives you the chance to avoid most of the conflict, if you're not up to the fight. However, I'm told only frigate and destroyer-class ships can activate the first gate.

Good luck.
messages.zh:
嗯……是的我这儿确实有些事情给你做。

尽管天使联合企业对在我们这个系统里的基层犯罪网络都有着很强的控制能力，萨沙最近还是把他们的脏手伸到了我们这儿，这对我们来说也不算什么事儿。实际上，看着这两个犯罪组织相互争斗还真是一件消遣的好事儿。说不定我们还能趁着鹬蚌相争，渔翁得利呢。

当然，也有一些坏消息。一艘驶向{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的星际捷运所属舰船在途中被海盗的一个战区给困住了。舰船遭受到了无法修复的损伤，跃迁和导航系统都已经在海盗的交叉火力中被破坏了。你的任务就是去营救船员，请在他们的生命受到严峻威胁前把他们带到安全的地方。这些人都已经完全被吓坏了，你最好快一点过去。

哦，在你离开前我的给你一句忠告。当你进入这个特别的死亡空间后，跳跃轨道都没有锁定，所以如果你觉得自己打不赢，那就几乎可以避免任何交火就能继续前行。不过，听说只有护卫舰与驱逐舰级别的舰船才能通过那儿的第一座跳跃轨道。

祝你好运。

哦，在你离开前我的给你一句忠告。当你进入这个特别的死亡空间后，跳跃轨道都没有锁定，所以如果你觉得自己打不赢，那就几乎可以避免任何交火就能继续前行。不过，听说只有护卫舰与驱逐舰级别的舰船才能通过那儿的第一座跳跃轨道。

祝你好运。

messages.en:

Of course, there's also bad news. An InterBus ship traveling to {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} got caught in the middle of one of the pirate warzones. The ship was damaged beyond repair and can neither warp out nor navigate away from the crossfire. Your task is to rescue the ship's crew. Please retrieve them before any more harm is done; they're already scared out of their minds. The faster you get this done, the better.

Oh, and before you leave I'd like to give you a word of advice. When you venture into this particular deadspace area, the warpgates are not locked, which gives you the chance to avoid most of the conflict, if you're not up to the fight. However, I'm told only frigate and destroyer-class ships can activate the first gate.

Good luck.

messages.en:
Hmm... Yes, I do have some work for you. Although the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} have traditionally had a firm grip over this system, Sansha's Nation has been poking its ugly nose in here of late. We were about to assemble a strike force to take care of their latest infiltration when we noticed something interesting. The Sansha fleet that we had stumbled upon is fighting for their lives against a sizable Gallente armada!

We aren't sure where the Gallente came from or what they're doing here, but I suspect it's one of those blasted entrepreneurs, scouring space outside of Federation borders for possible business opportunities. Either way, we're always happy when our enemies fight each other. When they're done, it's that much easier for us to clean up the pieces.

Now, what I need you to do is fairly simple: retrieve some of our valuable drug stash that's lying in the middle of their little warzone. You'll have to navigate through the contested deadspace area to get to it, but I'm sure someone of your caliber can handle that. Just stay clear of their main fleet and you'll make it.

Good luck.
messages.zh:
恩，我确实有些活可以给你做。通常{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}对这个星系有着实际的控制能力，但最近萨沙把他们的爪子也伸了进来。当我们正准备派遣部队去攻击他们最近突入的一只渗透不对的时候，我们注意到了一些有趣的事情。萨沙舰队正在和一支盖伦特舰队拼命呢！

我们不是很清楚那支盖伦特舰队是从什么地方来的，又或者他们要做什么，但我们猜想这可能是属于盖伦特的某个大财团的舰队，徘徊在联邦的国界之外寻求可能的利润机会。不管咋样，我们的敌人和敌人之间打起来总归是件令人兴奋的事情。等他们之间解决了，我们就可以渔翁得利了。

现在，我想要你做的事情其实很简单：找回一些我们隐藏在那个战区的药物。你可能需要穿过那个发生激烈战斗的死亡空间区域才能够找到它，我想你的那些门大炮应该能够对付得了那里的状况吧。只是最好避开他们的中心战区和舰队你应该能够活着回来。

现在，我想要你执行的是一次秘密行动：摧毁我们在那个战区中间的一座军火库。我们不能让军方的秘密武器落入到错误的人手中。军火库的工作人员是可以容忍的损失，你只需要按照计划行事然后活着回来向我报告就行了。

messages.en:
Hmm... Yes, I do have some work for you.

Although the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} have traditionally had a firm grip over the {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} system, the Angel Cartel has been poking its ugly nose in here of late. We were about to assemble a strike force to take care of their latest infiltration when we noticed something interesting. The Cartel fleet that we had stumbled upon is fighting for its live against an armada of combined Imperial and Ammatar forces!

We aren't sure where the Amarr came from or what they're doing here, but I suspect it's some of those blasted slavers, scouring space outside of their borders for more slave labor. Either way, we're always happy when our enemies fight each other. When they're done, it's that much easier for us to clean up the pieces.

What I need you for is a covert ops mission: destroy one of our armories in a deadspace area near here. It's caught right in the middle of the largest battle between the Amarr slavers and the Cartel. We can't allow our military secrets to fall into the wrong hands. The armory's crew is expendable; just get the job done and get back here in one piece.
messages.zh:

name.fr: Tendre une embuscade au transport de personnel
name.ja: 人員輸送船を奇襲せよ
name.ru: Засада на транспортный корабль (Ambush the Personnel Transport)

messages.en: I'll get you the VIPs in no time, you can count on me.
messages.zh: 我会马上带回这些VIP，你可以相信我。

messages.en: Ok I just uploaded the waypoint into your NeoCom.  Get out there and kick some butt.
messages.zh: 好的，我刚把航标上传到你的控制边栏里。去给他们点颜色看看。

messages.en: A personnel transport was detected flying through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, reportedly wearing the logo of a corporation within the Minmatar Republic.  Our surveillance team scanned the transport ship and discovered a few prominent professors among the passengers, who we would very much like to get our hands on.  I want you to ambush the convoy and bring the VIPs back to me, you can do whatever you want with anything or anyone else you find on board, they aren't worth our time.  I expect the professors back here in no less than 24 hours, in good condition if possible.  We expect to receive a mighty high ransom for people as important as this.
messages.zh: 我们侦测到一艘人员运输舰正经过{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，据报告，这艘飞船上标有一个米玛塔尔共和国军团的标志。我们的侦察队扫描了这艘运输船，并发现乘客中有几位著名的教授，我们非常想得到他们。我要你去伏击这支护航队并把这几位VIP带给我。你在船上发现的其他人和任何东西都任你处置，他们不值得我们浪费时间。我期待你能够在24小时之内把这些教授带回来，尽量做到毫发无损。有这样的重要人物握在手上，我们就等着收取巨额赎金吧。

messages.en: Our surveillance cameras just spotted a group of pirates enter {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, no doubt up to no good.  These ships are all wanted and have a bounty placed on them by CONCORD, I want you to head out there immediately and destroy them.  They seem to have split up into 4 groups since they entered this system, I will supply you with bookmarks to each of the groups which we traced.  You know what to do when you get there, good luck
messages.zh: 我们的监视相机刚刚发现一伙海盗进入{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}，毫无疑问，他们不怀好意。这些飞船都受到通缉，统合部在他们身上都有悬赏。我要你立即过去消灭他们。进入这个星系后，他们似乎分成了四队，我会把我们追踪到的每一队的位标都给你。你知道到那之后该怎么做，祝你好运。

messages.en: We received a report just a couple hours ago from our secret agents that revealed plans by our enemies to make a sneak attack against us in this very system!  We believe this plan will take effect in a matter of minutes, as our surveillance teams have spotted a number of their ships mobilizing inside {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  I personally received a message from our esteemed CEO to send my most trusted contacts against these scoundrels, and so I ask you {[character]player.name}, are you up to it?  All I need you to do is infiltrate an area swarming with the pirates and destroy all of the hostile ships you encounter, my other clients will take care of the rest.  This will hopefully deter them from any further mobilization within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.
messages.zh: 几小时前，我们收到了一份来自特工的报告，报告表明，敌人正策划在这个星系偷袭我们。我们相信这个计划在几分钟后就会见效，因为我们的侦察队刚刚发现很多他们的飞船在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}内积极调动。我们尊敬的CEO亲自给我发来消息，要我派最信任的联系人去对付这些恶棍；所以我来问你，{[character]player.name}，你愿意做吗？我要你做的就是潜入一个遍布海盗的地区，消灭遇到的所有敌对飞船，我的其他客户会料理剩下的。希望这能阻止他们在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的进一步的行动。

messages.zh: 几小时前，我们收到了一份来自特工的报告，报告表明，敌人正策划在这个星系偷袭我们。我们相信这个计划在几分钟后就会见效，因为我们的侦察队刚刚发现很多他们的飞船在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}内积极调动。我们尊敬的CEO亲自给我发来消息，要我派最信任的联系人去对付这些恶棍；所以我来问你，{[character]player.name}，你愿意做吗？我要你做的就是飞过几个死亡空间层，消灭遇到的所有敌对飞船，我的其他客户会料理剩下的。希望这样能阻止他们在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的进一步活

messages.en:

Cargo scanners revealed a load of militants on board, no doubt a part of a ground force intended to strike a target near here. We don't know where they are headed or what they're up to, but we definitely want to find out. I request that you intercept the transport and capture the men on board. Bring them back to us for questioning.

We believe the escort team is split up into a few groups. If you strike fast and hard, you'll probably avoid getting swarmed by them all at once. Just keep a look out for any stray ships, we don't want them escaping back to their homebase to report the incident.
messages.zh:
我们发现一支未经授权的古斯塔斯载人运输舰正飞经{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。货柜扫描器发现船上有一批军人，毫无疑问，他们属于一支企图袭击附近某个目标的陆军。我们不知道他们要去哪里、要做什么，不过我们一定要搞清楚。我要求你拦截那艘运输船，俘虏船上所有人。把他们带回来问话。

我们相信，这支护航队已经分成了几队。如果你下手又快又狠，那么就很可能避免被他们围攻。注意周围任何游荡的飞船，我们可不想让他们溜回去向总部报告这次事件。

messages.en: Now head out there and do your job, {[character]player.name}.  Don't make me regret giving you this assignment.
messages.zh: 出发去执行任务吧，{[character]player.name}。可别让我后悔把这项任务分配给你。

messages.en: Aye I do, {[character]player.name}. We got reports of a Guristas patrol in this sector. Our surveillance patrol reports they are scouts providing intel back to their leaders for a much larger raiding party. We cannot have them discover our weak points or gather any intel on our convoy travel routes. Teach them a lesson for us, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 是的，{[character]player.name}。我们收到了关于这一地区古斯塔斯巡逻队的报告。我们的侦察巡逻队报告称，他们是一些侦察员，负责向他们的上级提供情报，以便派出一支大得多的突袭队。我们不能让他们发现我们的弱点，或者收集到关于我们护航队行进路线的任何情报。帮我们给他们点教训，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Great job {[character]player.name}! You did good out there, here's your reward.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}！你表现非常出色，这是你的酬劳。

messages.zh:
我们发现了一艘隶属于血袭者的人员穿梭机在未经许可的情况下过境{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。货柜扫描设备发现其搭载了一些武装份子，很明显这是他们的一队地面部队正在准备对附近的一个目标实施打击。我们还不知道他们的目的地和真实的计划，但是我们一定会找出来这些问题的答案。我要求你拦截这艘人员运输船，逮捕船上的武装人员，然后将他们带回到我们这里进行审讯。

我们认为他们的护航船只分为了数个小组。如果你能快准狠的进行袭击，可能根本就不会被他们的护航队伍所困扰。你要注意那些游击在周围的船只，我们不想他们任何人能活着回去报告这个事情。

messages.en:
Our spies discovered that a few convoys of Minmatar rebel ships carrying a heap load of viral agents are heading to one of the planets in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, with the intention of carrying out a biological attack on the populace! They must not be allowed to release the biohazard into the planet's atmosphere! I desperately need you to head over to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and intercept the convoys.

Be careful though, we suspect that they have an interceptor or two guarding the convoys as well as other nasties. But I'm sure that's no problem for a seasoned pilot like yourself.

messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}！你表现非常出色，这是你的酬劳。

name.ja: サボタージュ工作員を捕まえろ

messages.en: I believe in you {[character]player.name}, but I'd like some results before I celebrate thank you.  Destroy the viral agent ASAP.
messages.zh: 我相信你，{[character]player.name}。但是在我开始庆祝和感谢你之前我还是得要看到点实际的结果才行。消灭病原体。

messages.en: Our spies discovered that a few convoys of Serpentis ships carrying a viral agent are heading to one of the planets in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, with the intention of carrying out a biological attack on the populace!  They must not be allowed to release the toxin into the planet's atmosphere!  I desperately need you to find and intercept the convoys before they finish their mission.  I can supply you with bookmarks to their last sighting, I just hope you can find them in time
messages.zh:
我们的间谍发现一艘搭载有病原体的天蛇船队正在向{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}方向航行，他们的目的很可能是要发动生化攻击！我们决不能让他们把毒物释放到行星的大气层中！我急迫地需要你去找到并在他们执行任务前拦截这个船队。我可以把它们上一次出现的地点坐标发送给你，希望你能够追到他们。

你要小心，我们怀疑他们有一到两艘截击舰在保护这个船队，当然还包括其他的一些小杂碎。但是我们认为这对于像你这样经验丰富的飞行员不会是什么问题。

name.ja: サボタージュ工作員を捕まえろ

messages.en: I believe in you {[character]player.name}, but I'd like some results before I celebrate thank you.  Destroy the Viral Agents ASAP.
messages.zh: 我相信你，{[character]player.name}，但在我表示感谢之前，我得看到结果。尽快毁掉病毒剂。

messages.en:
Our spies discovered that a few convoys of Amarrian ships carrying a heap load of viral agents are heading to one of the planets in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, with the intention of carrying out a biological attack on our clones! They must not be allowed to release the biohazard into the planet's atmosphere! I desperately need you to head over to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and intercept the convoys.

Be careful though, we suspect that they have an interceptor or two guarding the convoys as well as other nasties. But I'm sure that's no problem for a seasoned pilot like yourself.
messages.zh:
我们的探员发现几艘艾玛护航船，他们携带着大量病毒剂，正前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个行星，打算对我们的克隆体发动一场生物攻击！必须阻止他们在行星大气层释放这种生物危害！我要你十万火急飞到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}去截击这支护航队。

但是要小心，我们怀疑他们的护航队由一两艘截击舰和其他妖魔鬼怪保护着。不过我相信对你这样经验老道的飞行员应该不是个问题。

messages.en: We have reports of terrorists wreaking havoc in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Our convoys have been attacked, as well as some outlying outposts; they seem to be intent on causing as much damage as possible. I'd like you to take care of them as quickly as possible. And be aware that they may not all be gathered together when you arrive... if so, you will be able to pick them off as they warp in to the rendezvous point.
messages.zh: 我们收到报告，恐怖份子正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}进行大肆破坏。我们的护航船和几个边远哨站都受到了攻击；他们似乎执意要把破坏程度最大化。我要你尽快去料理他们。要注意你到达时他们可能不是聚集在一起……若是这样的话，你就能在他们跃迁到集合点时解决他们了。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I see.  Well, perhaps you will be of some use next time.
messages.zh: 我明白了，好吧希望下次能用得到你。

messages.en: It appears that the Federation Navy has been gathering en masse inside {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  Obviously they have been trying to keep a low profile, as they have split their armada into multiple groups.  But nonetheless my superiors are extremely nervous at these tidings.  We'd like you to remove their presence from {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} for good, before they manage to gather enough ships here to launch a massive offensive against one of our strongholds.  I'll supply you with the bookmarks that you need to find them.  Just remember, do not let them know under any circumstances who you are working for, we do not want to receive a retribution attack should you fail.
messages.zh: 看起来联邦海军正在向{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}集结。显然他们一直试图低调行事，因为他们把舰队分割成无数个小队。虽然如此，我的上级对这些消息还是非常紧张。我要你让他们从{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}彻底消失，以免他们集结足够的飞船来对我们的某所要塞发动大规模进攻。我会把他们的位标给你，以便你找到他们。只是记住，万一你失败了，在任何情况下都不要让他们知道你在为谁工作，我们可不想被他们报复。

messages.en: It appears that the Caldari Navy has been gathering en masse inside {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. We'd like you to remove their presence from {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} for good, before more ships enter {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} to bolster their ranks.  I'll supply you with the bookmarks that you need to find them.  Just remember, take no prisoners and let none escape, we want them blasted to smithereens before they know what hit them.

messages.en: We are under attack!  A fleet of Gurista Pirates just came out of warp near here and started to pulverize our defense drones.  They are using some sort of scrambling device to deactivate our sentry guns as well.  We request that you gather a group of battle-hardened pilots and take them on.  If you don't then I'm afraid we'll have to negotiate our way out of this or keep our fingers crossed that backup arrives in time.
messages.zh: 我们受到了攻击！一批古斯塔斯海盗刚跃迁到附近，开始摧残我们的防御无人机。他们还用一种干扰设备使我们的岗哨炮台失去了作用。我们要你赶快集结一队强硬的战斗飞行员去对付他们。如果你不这么做，恐怕我们只有强行从这里突围或者祈求上帝保佑援军及时赶来。

messages.en: A small convoy was spotted in a nearby system, apparently en route straight through {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}.  This is a perfect chance for you to show us what you're worth.  This convoy comes with a small escort, nothing you shouldn't be able to handle.  I want you to intercept the convoy after it makes the jump into {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}; Destroy the ships if they don't surrender their goods, and bring anything you can salvage back to me.  I'll split the loot.  Sounds fair eh?
messages.zh: 我们在邻近星系发现了一支小型护航队，显然他们正在穿越{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}的途中。这是你证明自己价值的绝佳机会。这支护航队由一支很小的护卫队守护着，解决他们对你不在话下。我要你在这支护航队跳跃进入{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}后去截击他们。如果他们不愿交出物品就消灭他们，将残骸中打捞到的东西带回给我。我会和你分享战利品。听上去很公平吧？

name.ja: マネージメント部門の代表（1/2）

messages.en: I'll try my best.
messages.zh: 我会尽力。

messages.en: Somehow I doubt you'll find him, but good luck regardless ...
messages.zh: 我依然对你能否找到他心存怀疑，但无论如何，祝你好运。

messages.en: I'm looking for some work, as long as it's for the greater good of the State ...
messages.zh: 我在找工作，为了合众国，我什么都愿意做。

messages.en:
I'm in charge of security for the Minedrill expedition forces stationed here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. As you probably know this is risky space, but even so we've been harassed by the same pirate far too many times for it to be coincidence. Also upon investigating the matter further, I discovered that this pirate is in fact called 'Black Jack', a notorious felon who terrorized Molden Heath not too long ago. There was a documentary about him released by The Scope ...

Anyway, if you find him then kill him for me, please. He's been the bane of too many of my colleagues and has been making quite a fool out of my security division in fact. There are many stories floating around which tell of his greatly exaggerated victories over my men and those of the Navy guarding the civilian excavators. Now if you could bring me something to prove he's dead, his DNA would probably do, then I'll be able to vindicate the reputation of the security division here in Kois City.

Now as for finding Black Jack, I have absolutely no clue. You could try searching for him with your scanners, but that's about all I can tell you. I've tried looking for him near the habitation module they call 'Black Jack's Shack', but he's never there.
messages.zh:
我是矿钻集团在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}远征队的安全负责人。你可能也知道，这块空间很危险，我们经常会碰巧遇上海盗，不过即使如此，我们最近被同一海盗骚扰的次数之多已经远远超出了巧合的范畴。经过深入调查，我了解到这个海盗实际上是一个称作“黑杰克”的恶贯满盈的暴徒，刚来摩登赫斯开展恐怖活动不久。《视角》还发行过一个关于他的专题纪录片……

无论如何，如果你能找到他，请替我们除掉他。他害死了我太多的同事，而且让我的保安部门颜面扫地。外面流传着许多故事，说他大胜我的人和守卫平民挖掘者，全都是夸大其辞。现在如果你能给我带来他的死亡证据，比如他的DNA什么的，那么我就能够为我们克斯城的保安部门正名。<br><br>可现在对于如何找到黑杰克，我一点线索也没有。你可以试试用自己的扫描仪找他，但这也是我能给你的全部建议了。我试图在他们称为“黑杰克小屋”的居住舱附近找他，但他从没出现过。

messages.en: Great news!  With Black Jack out of the way, our expeditions should be a lot less risky.  This will most definitely boost morale, and all thanks to you.  Enjoy your reward.
messages.zh: 好消息！没有黑杰克这块绊脚石，我们的远征队就安全多了。这必将极大振奋士气，全都是你的功劳。好好享受你的奖励吧。

messages.en:
Ah then I have something for you. I'm in charge of security for the Minedrill expedition forces stationed here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. As you probably know this is risky space, but even so we've been harassed by the same pirate far too many times for it to be coincidence. Also upon investigating the matter further, I discovered that this pirate is in fact called 'Black Jack', a notorious felon who terrorized Molden Heath not too long ago. There was a documentary about him released by The Scope ...

Anyway, if you find him then kill him for me, please. He's been the bane of too many of my colleagues and has been making quite a fool out of my security division in fact. There are many stories floating around which tell of his greatly exaggerated 'victories' over my men and those of the Navy guarding the civilian excavators, which are often completely false and unjustified. Now if you could bring me something to prove he's dead, his DNA would probably do, then I'll be able to vindicate the reputation of the security division here in Kois City.

Now as for finding Black Jack, I have absolutely no clue. You could try searching for him with your scanners, but that's about all I can tell you. I've tried looking for him near the habitation module they call 'Black Jack's Shack', but he's never there.

Finding Black Jack is about as hard as finding a needle in a haystack. I suggest you refrain from accepting this mission unless you have some idea of his whereabouts.
messages.zh:
哦，那么我有事交给你做。我是矿钻集团在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}远征队的安全负责人。你可能也知道，这块空间很危险，我们经常会碰巧遇上海盗，不过即使如此，我们最近被同一海盗骚扰的次数之多已经远远超出了巧合的范畴。经过深入调查，我了解到这个海盗实际上是一个称作“黑杰克”的恶贯满盈的暴徒，刚来摩登赫斯开展恐怖活动不久。《视角》还发行过一个关于他的专题纪录片……

无论如何，如果你能找到他，请替我们除掉他。他害死了我太多的同事，而且让我的保安部门颜面扫地。本地流传着许多关于他“大胜”我的人和护卫平民挖掘者的海军的故事，相信我，那些全是谎话，不折不扣的谎话！现在如果你能给我带来他的死亡证据，比如他的DNA什么的，那么我就能够为我们克斯城的保安部门正名。<br><br>可现在对于如何找到黑杰克，我一点线索也没有。你可以试试用自己的扫描仪找他，但这也是我能给你的全部建议了。我试过在他们称为“黑杰克小屋”的居住舱附近找他，但他从没出现过。<br><br><font color=CD0000>寻找黑杰克真如石沉大海啊。 除非你知道他的下落，否则我建议你不要接受这个任务。</font>

name.ja: マネージメント部門の代表（2/2）

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: Take care.
messages.zh: 保重。

messages.en: What's next?
messages.zh: 下一步呢？

messages.en:
Now on to the big fish. As you undoubtedly know, our biggest threat in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} has been the Guristas organization. Although they seem to be quite disorganized, as you would expect for a pirate organization, their top man here is rumored to be Airkio Yanjulen, a commander residing in O-LR1H. Killing him should weaken them considerably ... at least I hope so.

Bring me proof of his death and I'll reward you generously. The last I heard he was stationed in the Guristas War Installation in one of their outposts within O-LR1H. You will have to use your system scanner in that system and search for the 'Iacta Space Plain' to find him.
messages.zh:
这次我们要对付一条大鱼。你一定清楚，我们在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的目标是古斯塔斯集团。虽然外表上他们看起来和普通的海盗组织一样松散，但传言在O-LR1H有一名古斯塔斯高官，统领着所有海盗。除掉他，就能大幅削弱古斯塔斯在本地的势力……至少暂时可以。

把他死亡的证据带给我，我会重重奖赏你。他目前在O-LR1H星系内某个哨站中驻留。建议你使用星系扫描仪，寻找一个叫“以阿塔星原”的地方。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.  A rather gruesome sight, but his corpse will do.  I will notify the admiral immediately.   You may go.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。他死相真惨，不过他的尸体确实是很好的证据。我将立刻知会上将。你可以走了。

messages.en:
Now on to the big fish. As you undoubtedly know, our biggest threat in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} has been the Guristas organization. Although they seem to be quite disorganized, as you would expect for a pirate organization, their top man here is rumored to be Airkio Yanjulen, a commander residing in O-LR1H. Killing him should weaken them considerably ... at least I hope so.

Bring me proof of his death and I'll reward you generously. The last I heard he was stationed in the Guristas War Installation in one of their outposts within O-LR1H. You will have to use your system scanner in that system and search for the 'Iacta Space Plain' to find him.
messages.zh:
现在说说那条大鱼。你一定清楚，我们在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的最大威胁是古斯塔斯集团。虽然他们看起来组织松散，就像一般的海盗组织一样，但据传言，这些海盗实际上由一位叫埃尔基欧·彦杰伦的最高指挥官统领，他就住在O-LR1H。干掉他就能大幅削弱他们的力量……至少我希望如此。

把他的死亡证据带给我，我会重重奖赏你。根据最近的消息，他在O-LR1H星系内某个哨站的古斯塔斯战斗工事中驻留。为了找到他，你得在那个星系中使用星系扫描仪来搜索一个叫“以阿塔星原”的地方。

messages.en: You got it boss.
messages.zh: 遵命，老板。

messages.en: Now head out there and do your job, {[character]player.name}. Don't make me regret giving you this assignment.
messages.zh: 出发去执行任务吧，{[character]player.name}。可别让我后悔把这项任务分配给你。

messages.en: Aye I do, {[character]player.name}. We got reports of an Ammatar patrol in this sector. Our surveillance patrol reports they are scouts providing intel back to their leaders for a much larger raiding party. We cannot have them discover our weak points or gather any intel on our convoy travel routes. Teach them a lesson for us, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 是的，当然有，{[character]player.name}。我们收到了关于这一区域艾玛达巡逻队的报告。我们的侦察巡逻队报告称，他们是一些侦察员，负责向他们的上级提供情报，以便派出一支大得多的突袭队。我们不能让他们发现我们的弱点，或者收集到关于我们护航队行进路线的任何情报。帮我们给他们点教训，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Great job {[character]player.name}! You did good out there, here's your reward.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}！你表现非常出色，这是你的酬劳。

messages.en: You got it boss.
messages.zh: 遵命，老板。

messages.en: Now head out there and do your job, {[character]player.name}. Don't make me regret giving you this assignment.
messages.zh: 出发去执行任务吧，{[character]player.name}。可别让我后悔把这项任务分配给你。

messages.en: Aye I do, {[character]player.name}. We got reports of a Federation patrol in this sector. Our surveillance patrol reports they are scouts providing intel back to their leaders for a much larger raiding party. We cannot have them discover our weak points or gather any intel on our convoy travel routes. Teach them a lesson for us, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 是的，当然有，{[character]player.name}。我们收到了关于这一区域盖伦特联邦巡逻队的报告。我们的侦察巡逻队报告称，他们是一些侦察员，负责向他们的上级提供情报，以便派出一支大得多的突袭队。我们不能让他们发现我们的弱点，或者收集到关于我们护航队行进路线的任何情报。帮我们给他们点教训，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Great job {[character]player.name}! You did good out there, here's your reward.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}！你表现非常出色，这是你的酬劳。

messages.en: Go on ...
messages.zh: 继续……

messages.en:
During my research of the Guristas movements through {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, I discovered that most of the Guristas squadrons flying through {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} originate from a certain outpost within O-LR1H. I believe that's where their command post in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} is located. Not only that but local rumor has it that many of the Guristas ships currently stationed in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} have only recently arrived to the constellation.

So my conclusion naturally is that a large portion of the Guristas forces that have been harassing us here lately are part of an assembly of fighters recently allocated here by the Guristas central command in 6NJ8-V. With this in mind I would also assume they are acting on specific orders and not randomly attacking us when the opportunity arrives, like is often the case with pirates in these parts.

Now if I could only get a hold of their plans, I would have some good news finally to present to Admiral Aurobe Kois. Knowledge of their next move would give us a huge advantage. Acquiring this knowledge is of course easier said than done.

This is where you come in. Your job, obviously, is to acquire this data. And I know of two ways to do it. Your first option is to befriend one of their leaders within the Iacta Space Plain in O-LR1H and somehow acquire the information through him. This is of course highly difficult and only possible if you are in good standing with the Guristas organization. Your second option is to rescue the last agent I sent on the very same task, Otsalen Mano. He found something, but before he could return to me his identity was discovered. He's currently being held in one of their prison facilities near the Iacta Space Plain in O-LR1H. And there's nothing I can do about it until I get more firepower ...

Anyway, don't return until you have the Guristas war plans!
messages.zh:
我在对{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的古斯塔斯活动进行研究时发现，大多数飞经{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的古斯塔斯中队都来自于O-LR1H的某个哨站。我相信那就是他们在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的指挥站。不仅如此，根据当地的传闻，许多驻扎在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的古斯塔斯舰船是最近才抵达这个星座的。

所以我的结论是，最近骚扰我们的大部分古斯塔斯部队属于一支刚调派到这不久的战舰机群，而派他们过来的正是位于6NJ8-V的古斯塔斯中央指挥站。考虑到这一点，我推测他们都是奉命行事，而不是逮着机会对我们发动随意攻击，这与该地的普通海盗有所不同。<br><br>要是我能弄到他们的作战计划就好了，这样我终于能向海军上将奥诺贝•克斯报告点好消息。了解到他们的下一步行动会让我们占据非常有利的地位。不过这事说起来容易，做起来难。<br><br>这就该你出场了。你的工作当然就是取得这些数据。做这件事我有两种方案。你的第一个选择是与O-LR1H内以阿塔星原的首领攀上交情，设法从他口中获取信息。这个难度当然非常高，要求你必须在古斯塔斯组织内有一定的声望。你的第二个选择是救出我上次派去执行同一任务的特工奥萨列•马诺。他发现了些线索，可是还没等回来，他的身份就被发现了。他现在被关在O-LR1H以阿塔星原附近的一所牢狱中。对此我无能为力，除非我有更强的火力……<br><br>无论如何，弄不到古斯塔斯作战计划就不要回来见我！

messages.en: Looks like you could use a hand out here ...
messages.zh: 似乎你需要我的帮助……

我在对{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的古斯塔斯活动进行研究时发现，大多数飞经{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的古斯塔斯中队都来自于O-LR1H的某个哨站。我相信那就是他们在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的指挥站。不仅如此，根据当地的传闻，许多驻扎在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的古斯塔斯舰船是最近才抵达这个星座的。

所以我的结论是，最近骚扰我们的大部分古斯塔斯部队属于一支刚调派到这不久的战舰机群，而派他们过来的正是位于6NJ8-V的古斯塔斯中央指挥站。考虑到这一点，我推测他们都是奉命行事，而不是逮着机会对我们发动随意攻击，这与该地的普通海盗有所不同。<br><br>要是我能弄到他们的作战计划就好了，这样我终于能向海军上将奥诺贝•克斯报告点好消息。了解到他们的下一步行动会让我们占据非常有利的地位。不过这事说起来容易，做起来难。<br><br>这就该你出场了。你的工作当然就是取得这些数据。做这件事我有两种方案。你的第一个选择是与O-LR1H内以阿塔星原的首领攀上交情，设法从他口中获取信息。这个难度当然非常高，要求你必须在古斯塔斯组织内有一定的声望。你的第二个选择是救出我上次派去执行同一任务的特工奥萨列•马诺。他发现了些线索，可是还没等回来，他的身份就被发现了。他现在被关在O-LR1H以阿塔星原附近的一所牢狱中。对此我无能为力，除非我有更强的火力……<br><br>无论如何，弄不到古斯塔斯作战计划就不要回来见我！

messages.en: I have the war plans, as you requested {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我得到了计划书，请查收，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: You have the plans?  Most excellent!!  I'll have this delivered to the Admiral immediately.  But if you have some spare time on your hands, I could use a hand with a couple other tasks ...
messages.zh: 你拿到了那份计划？太棒了！！我会立刻把它递送给上将。如果你还有空，那么我还有其他事情麻烦你……

messages.en: Search for the Iacta Space Plain in O-LR1H.  A system scanner will probably be necessary.  From there infiltrate the prison facilities and rescue the prisoner Tomi requested or find some way of acquiring the Guristas War Plans.
messages.zh: 在O-LR1H寻找以阿塔星原。星系扫描仪可能会很有用。找到星原后，潜入牢狱设施，救出托米要的囚犯，或者想其他办法，获取古斯塔斯作战计划。

messages.en: Mission Objectives
messages.zh: 任务目标

messages.en:
Is it that obvious? Well, since you had the guts to fly out here into no-mans land you might be of some use to me.

We've been holed up here for days, unable to complete our objective. I was sent here along with the rest of my division to set up a blockade around the O-LR1H gate, to prevent the Guristas from continuing to flood this system with their fighters. Unfortunately we're simply outnumbered and outgunned, there's no way for us to hold that position and the admiral was very clear when I left that he could not spare any reinforcements for quite some time.

So we've been forced to do nothing more than monitor the gate, alerting our forces of any possible threat. It's rather embarrassing to say the least, but here's where you come in ...
messages.zh:
不是很明显吗？好吧，既然你有胆飞来这个非人的地方，也许你对我们会有点用。

我们已经被困在这里好几天了，根本没法完成我们的目标。我和部门的其他人一起被派到这来，要在O-LR1H星门附近建立一道封锁线，以阻止古斯塔斯的战舰继续涌入这个星系。不幸的是，我们的人数和武器数与对方相差悬殊，根本没法守住那个位置，而上将在派我来的时候说得很清楚，他在一段时间内没法派援军过来。

所以我们目前能做的只是监视这座星门，向我们的部队发出任何可能的威胁警告。我们的处境很“尴尬”——这已经是最轻描淡写的一种说法了，不过现在可以用得上你了……

messages.en: What other tasks?
messages.zh: 什么事呢？

messages.en:
The most important task is behind us, but there are a couple more assignments that I'd like you to accomplish before you leave. The first of these assignments is to destroy a small armory near G5ED-Y II. It's being used to re-supply Guristas fighters in the system, and therefore must be destroyed. You may keep any of the supplies found inside, but do bring back some evidence of its demise.

The armory is in a deadspace pocket hidden from passive sensors. You will need to use probes to scan it down.
messages.zh:
最重要的任务已经完成了，不过在你离开之前我还想让你多做些别的任务。第一项任务是去摧毁G5ED-Y II附近的一个小型军械库。它的作用是为本星系的古斯塔斯战士提供补给，因此我们必须摧毁它。在里面找到的补给都归你，不过务必要带回些证明你成功的证据。

被动扫描器无法定位那个军械库。你需要利用探针来找出它。

messages.en: The armory has been destroyed, as you requested.
messages.zh: 军械库已经摧毁了。

messages.en: I saw the armory disintegrate from a distance.  What a sight indeed.  Nice work.
messages.zh: 我在远处看到了军械库的解体。真是太壮观了。干得不错。

messages.en:
The most important task is behind us, but there are a couple more assignments that I'd like you to accomplish before you leave. The first of these assignments is to destroy a small armory near G5ED-Y II. It's being used to re-supply Guristas fighters in the system, and therefore must be destroyed. You may keep any of the supplies found inside, but do bring back some evidence of its demise.

messages.zh:
最重要的任务已经完成了，不过在你离开之前我还想让你多做些别的任务。第一项任务是去摧毁G5ED-Y II附近的一个小型军械库。它的作用是为本星系的古斯塔斯战士提供补给，因此我们必须摧毁它。在里面找到的补给都归你，不过务必要带回些证明你成功的证据。

被动扫描器无法定位那个军械库。你需要利用探针来找出它。

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: Just remember to be patient.  I don't know exactly when they will show up, so keep your guard up.
messages.zh: 只是记住，要有耐心。我不知道他们可能出现的具体时间，所以你要保持警惕。

messages.en: Is there anything else I can do for you?
messages.zh: 还有什么我能为你做的么？

messages.en: The last thing I want you to do for me is to intercept a squadron of Guristas fighters who recently came through the stargate from O-LR1H.  They've been following a certain expedition of ours, no doubt waiting for the right time to attack.  Little beknownst to them we've been tracking their every move.  Now I expect them to show up at a certain point in G5ED-Y any moment now, and I want you to be waiting there for that to happen.  Once they appear, shoot them down immediately.
messages.zh: 我要你为我做的最后一件事是去拦截一支古斯塔斯战斗中队，他们刚从O-LR1H穿过星门而来。他们一直在追踪我们的一支远征队，无疑在等待时机发动进攻。他们还不知道我们一直在监视着他们的一举一动。我预计他们现在随时会出现在G5ED-Y的某一特定点，我要你去事先埋伏。一旦他们出现，立刻干掉他们。

messages.en: I have completed the mission.
messages.zh: 我已经完成了任务。

messages.en: Not bad, not bad.  I could really use someone like you on my team ...
messages.zh: 干得不坏，干得不坏。我的队伍真的可以用上你的人……

messages.en: The last thing I want you to do for me is to intercept a squadron of Guristas fighters who recently came through the stargate from O-LR1H.  They've been following a certain expedition of ours, no doubt waiting for the right time to attack.  Little beknownst to them we've been tracking their every move.  Now I expect them to show up at a certain point in G5ED-Y any moment now, and I want you to be waiting there for that to happen.  Once they appear, shoot them down immediately.
messages.zh: 最后我要你做的事情便是拦截一支古斯塔斯中队。他们来自O-LR1H，目的似乎是追踪某支远征队，毫无疑问，他们正在等待时机，以发动一场全面进攻。可惜他们并不知道，自己的一举一动完全落在我们眼中。预计古斯塔斯中队下次出现的地点在G5ED-Y，我要你去事先埋伏，一旦他们出现，一个不留。

messages.en: Remember to equip a system scanner, you'll need it to find Tantima.
messages.zh: 记得带上一个星系扫描仪。凭借它的帮助你才能找到旦提马。

messages.en: I heard you might have some work available ...
messages.zh: 听说你这里有活干……

messages.en:
You heard right, {[character]player.name}. We've been plagued by Caldari agents trying to infiltrate our operations here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. One such agent, Tantima Areki, managed to fool us for weeks, pretending to be a Guristas loyalist. When we finally discovered his true identity, he fled to somewhere within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. We haven't found him yet, but I'm hoping you will succeed where my lackeys failed. Bring me Tantima Areki, preferably alive, and I will reward you well.

Use a system scanner and look for deadspace signatures. He will most likely be orbiting a Caldari Tactical Outpost.
messages.zh:
没错，{[character]player.name}。加达里特工在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}已经策反了组织中部分代理人。旦提马·埃勒金就是变节者之一。身份暴露之后，他匆忙逃窜到{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的某处。我们还没找到他的具体位置，但我想你总比我手下那群饭桶强一些。把旦提马·埃勒金带到我这来，最好要活的。我会重重奖赏你。

使用星系扫描仪，搜索死亡空间信号。他很有可能在加达里战术前哨站附近出没。

messages.en: Ah, you brought him back alive.  Excellent.  I will have him interrogated immediately, and then executed.  You have done well.
messages.zh: 啊，你把他活捉回来了。漂亮。我会立刻审讯他，然后处决。你干得不错。

messages.en:
You heard right, {[character]player.name}. We've been plagued by Caldari agents trying to infiltrate our operations here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. One such agent, Tantima Areki, managed to fool us for weeks, pretending to be a Guristas loyalist. When we finally discovered his true identity, he fled to somewhere within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. We haven't found him yet, but I'm hoping you will succeed where my lackeys failed. Bring me Tantima Areki, preferably alive, and I will reward you well.

Use a system scanner and look for deadspace signatures. He will most likely be orbiting a Caldari Tactical Outpost.
messages.zh:
你的消息没错，{[character]player.name}。加达里特工试图渗入我们在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的运营，我们为此头痛不已。其中一个特工旦提马·埃勒金假扮成古斯塔斯的忠实拥趸，足足耍了我们好几个礼拜。身份最终暴露后，他溜到了{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}内的某处。我手下的那群饭桶还没找到他，不过我希望你能成功。把旦提马·埃勒金带到我这来，最好要活的。我会重重奖赏你。

使用星系扫描仪，搜索死亡空间信号。他很有可能在加达里战术哨站附近盘旋。

messages.en: I will destroy the scanner.
messages.zh: 我会照你的指示，摧毁扫描仪。

messages.en: Good, I'm counting on you.
messages.zh: 好，我对你充满信心。

messages.en: What's next?
messages.zh: 下一步呢？

messages.en: The Caldari have erected a base of operations close to the stargate we use in G5ED-Y.  Not only that but they are closely monitoring our movements from a static long range scanner.  They use this information to send in reinforcements to the Caldari Navy positions before we attack, among other things.  I'm tempted to launch a major assault against their outpost, but perhaps you can spare me the manpower by doing the job yourself.  You will be adequately rewarded of course.
messages.zh: 加达里在G5ED-Y星系内，我们使用的星门旁建立了一个基地。不仅如此，他们还利用远距扫描仪监视我们的一举一动。这样他们就能在我们行动之前先一步派遣增援。一直以来我都想找人拔掉这根眼中刺，而你是最好的人选。一旦你完成任务，我会给出让你满意的报酬。

messages.en: Good work.  Now I have another job for you, I want you to bring these documents to an agent of mine in G5ED-Y.  His name is Knaaninn Aranuri and he currently resides in a habitation module near the fifth planet in G5ED-Y.  You'll have to use a system scanner to find him.  Make haste.
messages.zh: 干得好。现在我有另外一件事交给你。我要你把这些文档交给我属下的特工，他名叫纳奈恩·埃拉努尔利，在G5ED-Y第五行星附近的居住舱内。你要使用星系扫描仪才能找到他。赶快。

messages.en: Destroy the long range scanner near the stargate to O-LR1H in G5ED-Y, and bring back its contents to your agent.
messages.zh: 摧毁G5ED-Y内通往O-LR1H星门附近的远程扫描仪，并将其掉落的物品交给代理人。

messages.en: Objectives
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en: The Caldari have erected a base of operations close to the stargate we use in G5ED-Y.  Not only that but they are closely monitoring our movements from a static long range scanner.  They use this information to send in reinforcements to the Caldari Navy positions before we attack, among other things.  I'm tempted to launch a major assault against their outpost, but perhaps you can spare me the manpower by doing the job yourself.  You will be adequately rewarded of course.
messages.zh: 加达里在G5ED-Y我们经常使用的星门附近建立了一个军事基地。不仅如此，他们还利用静态远距离扫描仪密切监视我们的行动。他们能凭这些信息坏我们不少好事，包括赶在我们进攻之前，把援军派往加达里海军的据点。我一直想全力攻下这个哨站，不过也许你能做这件事，也省得我调配自己的人手。当然，你将得到可观的回报。

messages.en: Yes, just one moment.
messages.zh: 好的，稍候。

messages.en: I don't have all day ...
messages.zh: 我可没那么空……

messages.en: I was supposed to bring this data to you, {[character]agentID.name} ...
messages.zh: 我到这来是为了递送这份数据，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Bring {[character]agentID.name} the Guristas War Plans.  You should have received these plans from agent Airkio Yanjulen in O-LR1H.  {[character]agentID.name} resides near the fifth planet of G5ED-Y.
messages.zh: 给{[character]agentID.name}带来古斯塔斯作战计划。你应该已经从O-LR1H的埃尔基欧·彦杰伦那儿得到了这些计划。{[character]agentID.name}住在G5ED-Y第五行星附近。

messages.en: Here you go.
messages.zh: 拿着。

messages.en: Ah.  My orders, finally they have arrived.  My men have been getting quite restless, ever since Airkio sent us here to spy on the State scum.  It seems that we get to launch a major offensive against the Caldari Navy positions here in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  But don't leave just yet, I have a job for you.
messages.zh: 啊。我的命令！我终于收到了！自从埃尔基欧把我们派到这里暗中监视合众国的人渣，我的手下就终日不得安宁。似乎我们要对{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的加达里海军阵地发动总攻了。不过你先别走，我还有任务给你。

messages.en: Give it to me then so I can take a look at it ...
messages.zh: 把它给我，我要好好研读。

messages.en: I hope you have what it takes, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你马到成功，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: What's next?
messages.zh: 下一步呢？

messages.en:
I've started readying the troops for battle, but there is one critical threat looming on the horizon. My sources tell me that a massive weapons convoy is en route to {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, all the way from Caldari Navy compounds in their sovereign space. It is scheduled to arrive here any minute now.

If it arrives at Kois City in one piece, it will give our enemies a huge boost. They've been low on ammunition and equipment for the past few weeks due to our relentless guerilla attacks, but that will be a thing of the past if that convoy arrives at its destination.

You probably guessed it by now, but I want you to stop it from getting to Kois City. I have a bookmark to the stargate they are using to get here. Warp to the location and eliminate every Caldari ship you see. Once they have all been reduced to floating debris, report to me.
messages.zh: 我已经开始为备战扩充军队，但眼前有一个迫在眉睫的严重威胁。情报显示，一支大规模武器护航队正在从加达里领空内的海军复合体一路赶往{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的途中。预计随时都会到达这里。<br><br>如果他们全队安然抵达克斯城，那么我们的敌人必将士气大振。由于我们几个星期以来不停地游击骚扰，他们的弹药和设备都已经吃紧，不过一旦护航队到达目的地，这个问题将不复存在。<br><br>你可能已经猜到了，我想要<b>你</b>去阻止护航队到达克斯城。我有他们到达此处所用的那个星门的位标。跃迁到那个位置，然后消灭你看到的所有加达里舰船。让他们全部沦为移动垃圾，然后回来向我报告。

messages.en: The convoy has been destroyed.
messages.zh: 护航队已经被消灭了。

messages.en: Now that the weapons convoy is out of the picture, we can continue our preparations.  All thanks to you, of course, {[character]player.name}.  Enjoy your reward.
messages.zh: 既然武器护航队已经不相干了，那么我们就可以继续准备了。当然，这全都是你的功劳，{[character]player.name}。希望你对酬劳满意。

messages.en:
I've started readying the troops for battle, but there is one critical threat looming on the horizon. My sources tell me that a massive weapons convoy is en route to {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, all the way from Caldari Navy compounds in their sovereign space. It is scheduled to arrive here any minute now.

If it arrives at Kois City in one piece, it will give our enemies a huge boost. They've been low on ammunition and equipment for the past few weeks due to our relentless guerilla attacks, but that will be a thing of the past if that convoy arrives at its destination.

You probably guessed it by now, but I want you to stop it from getting to Kois City. I have a bookmark to the stargate they are using to get here. Warp to the location and eliminate every Caldari ship you see. Once they have all been reduced to floating debris, report to me.

messages.en: I might be of some assistance, if you need help.
messages.zh: 如果你需要协助，我想我可以。

messages.en: As a matter of fact, I could use a hand in finding out what has actually become of Black Jack.  A colleague of mine in UL-4ZW, Gue Mouey, might know something.  He's one of the overseers of the Syndicate Trade Hub in that system, you'll find it near UL-4ZW IX.  He has had extensive dealings with agents of the Guristas and Caldari Navy, if anyone is qualified to scrounge up information on what happened to Black Jack, it's him.
messages.zh: 事实上，我的确需要人手帮我调查黑杰克的遭遇如何。我在UL-4ZW的一个同事凯·穆内可能知道些什么。他是该星系辛迪加贸易枢纽中心的监察官之一，你应该能在UL-4ZW IX附近找到这座中心。他与加达里海军和古斯塔斯两方的代理人都有广泛的贸易往来，要说谁最能搜集到黑杰克的信息，那是非他莫属。

messages.en: I'm looking for Black Jack ...
messages.zh: 我正在找一个叫黑杰克的人。

messages.en: As a matter of fact, I could use a hand in finding out what has actually become of Black Jack.  A colleague of mine in UL-4ZW, Gue Mouey, might know something.  He's one of the overseers of the Syndicate Trade Hub in that system, you'll find it near UL-4ZW IX.  He has had extensive dealings with agents of the Guristas and Caldari Navy, if anyone is qualified to scrounge up information on what happened to Black Jack, it's him.
messages.zh: 事实上，我的确需要人手帮我调查黑杰克的下落。我在UL-4ZW的一个同事，名叫凯·穆内，可能知道些什么。他是辛迪加贸易枢纽中心的检察官之一，你应该能在UL-4ZW IX附近找到他。他和加达里海军以及古斯塔斯海盗都有来往，如果他不知道黑杰克的下落，那就没人能知道了。

messages.en: I have this message from Gue.
messages.zh: 我从凯那儿获知了以下信息。

messages.en: This is terrible news.  Black Jack possibly dead?  This changes everything.  But before we pack our bags and head back to Syndicate space, I want to make sure our information is correct.
messages.zh: 这是条可怕的新闻。黑杰克可能死了？这会改变一切。不过在我收拾行李前往辛迪加星域之前，我需要确保情报的准确性。

messages.en: You came to the right place, but he isn't here.  Left quite some time ago on a reconnaissance mission and hasn't been heard of since.  I'm actually becoming quite worried, he and his men are a vital part of our expedition, and if something happened to them I'm afraid we might have to go empty handed back to base.
messages.zh: 你来对地方了，不过他不在。他走了一段时间了，是去做个侦察任务，一直没有音讯。我很担心，他和他的手下是远征队中非常重要的一分子，如果他们出了任何事情，恐怕我们只能两手空空回到基地了。

name.ru: Если цена хороша... (If The Price Is Right ...)

messages.en: Err, actually she needs some information on Black Jack.  You heard anything from the ranks of the Guristas lately, relating to him?
messages.zh: 呃，事实上，她需要一些关于黑杰克的信息。你从古斯塔斯军官那儿听说过关于他的什么消息吗？

messages.en: What?!  That's all she wants?  Some information?!   Well, if that's the case then it'll cost ya.  Getting my hopes up like that wasn't very nice ...
messages.zh: 什么？！她只想要这个？一些信息？！哦，如果是这样，那你就要付出点代价了。让我抱那么高的希望却又落空，这可不地道……

messages.en: Hello, {[character]agentID.name}.  Isana Dagin sent me to you, she ...
messages.zh: 早上好，{[character]agentID.name}。伊萨纳派我来见你，她……

messages.en: Get something for {[character]agentID.name} that will convince him to give you the information Isana wants.
messages.zh: 找到一样东西，交给{[character]agentID.name}，从而说服他告诉你伊萨纳想要的情报。

messages.en: I have these tags if you'd like, I heard they fetch a good price in these parts.
messages.zh: 这是你要的铭牌，我听说在本地区能卖不少钱。

messages.en: Well ... ok, that will have to do.  Now as for the information, I have something on Black Jack, yes.  This guy, Tikui Makan, a prominent member of the Guristas I might add, has been boasting lately of killing Black Jack in a duel which supposedly took place in Y5J-EU.  I don't have any more information on the matter, but I can give you Tikui's location.  I'll upload it into this data chip, take it back to Isana.  And when you do that, put in a good word for me, will ya?
messages.zh: 呃……好吧，恐怕只能如此了。那么关于黑杰克的信息呢，我确实有一些。卓越的古斯塔斯成员提库伊·玛干，最近一直在吹嘘自己在Y5J-EU的一次决斗中干掉了黑杰克。我没有更多的信息了，但我可以告诉你提库伊的位置。我会把位置上传到这块数据芯片中，你把它带给伊萨娜。你去的时候，帮我在她面前美言几句，好吗？

messages.en: Aha!  I knew that broad liked me.  Whatever kind words she has for me, tell her it's mutual.  Or better yet, I have some flowers I'd like you to give her ...
messages.zh: 啊哈！我就知道那姑娘喜欢我。无论她说了我什么好听的，告诉她，我对她也一样。或者干脆来点更好的，我这有些花，希望你能带给她……

messages.en: Oh and another thing, I think Gue has the hots for you.
messages.zh: 噢，对了。凯似乎有事情找你。

messages.en: You can tell that rascal that he has a bigger chance of winning the Legends Trials than he has with me.
messages.zh: 告诉那个混蛋，他这辈子都别想在传奇试炼中赢过我！

messages.en: What's next?
messages.zh: 下一步呢？

messages.en: As you heard from Gue, Tikui Makan recently boasted of killing Black Jack.  We need to confirm this statement before we abandon our assignment.  Gue lists the coordinates to Tikui's hideout in his message, and I want you to take a closer look.  See if you can find Tikui there, and if you do tell him to give you the exact coordinates of the encounter he had with Black Jack so that we may identify his corpse, if there is one.  Just make sure he's telling the truth.
messages.zh: 正如你从凯那里得知的，提库伊·玛干最近四处炫耀，自称干掉了黑杰克。在我们放弃任务前得先核实这个说法。凯在他的信息中列出了通往提库伊藏身处的坐标，我要你去仔细看看。看看是否能在那儿找到提库伊，而且让他把遭遇黑杰克的详细坐标告诉你，也许我们就能确认黑杰克的尸体，当然前提是得确实有这么一具尸体。一定要确保他说的是实话。

messages.en:
This information changes everything. I cannot believe we almost fell for Black Jack's ploy. This matter will be dealt with when I arrive back to Syndicate space.

The Syndicate forces under my command are not well equipped enough to take on the assignment without Black Jack and his men. So I must rely on you, {[character]player.name}, to finish the job.
messages.zh:
这条信息改变了一切。我没法相信我们几乎落入黑杰克的圈套。等我回到辛迪加之后，这件事会得到妥善解决。

我指挥下的辛迪加部队的装备不够好，在没有黑杰克和他的手下的协助下，是没有办法执行这项任务的。所以我必须靠你来完成任务了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: As you heard from Gue, Tikui Makan recently boasted of killing Black Jack.  We need to confirm this statement before we abandon our assignment.  Gue lists the coordinates to Tikui's hideout in his message, and I want you to take a closer look.  See if you can find Tikui there, and if you do tell him to give you the exact coordinates of the encounter he had with Black Jack so that we may identify his corpse, if there is one.  Just make sure he's telling the truth.
messages.zh: 正如你从凯那里得知的，提库伊·玛干最近四处炫耀，自称干掉了黑杰克。在我们放弃任务前得先核实这个说法。凯在他的信息中列出了通往提库伊藏身处的坐标，我要你去仔细看看。看看是否能在那儿找到提库伊，而且让他把遭遇黑杰克的详细坐标告诉你，也许我们就能确认黑杰克的尸体，当然前提是得确实有这么一具尸体。一定要确保他说的是实话。

messages.en: You have established yourself as a trustworthy client of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}. I have some corporate documents for you to deliver to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. You have 24 hours to get this done; that should be no problem for someone as yourself, right? I assure you the reward will be well worth the effort.
messages.zh: 你已证明你自己是{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}值得信赖的客户。我手头有些集团文件，需要你送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。你有24小时的时间来完成这个任务，这对你来说不过是小菜一碟，是吧？我保证，你会得到丰厚的酬劳。

messages.en: Great!  Your achievements for us have not gone unnoticed.
messages.zh: 太好了！你对我们的贡献是有目共睹的。

messages.en: Yes ma'am.
messages.zh: 遵命，老大。

messages.en: Good.  Now you'll find the storage facility I referred to in the civilian sector of the city.  You will probably have to destroy it to access the data chips due to the heavy security of the structure.  So just keep your fingers crossed that the data isn't destroyed with the building!
messages.zh: 好的。现在你会在城市的平民区找到我提到的存储设施。你很可能得摧毁它才能拿到数据芯片，因为这个建筑防卫森严。所以，你要祈祷那数据不会与建筑一同被毁！

messages.en: You said you still needed some help.
messages.zh: 你说你还需要帮助？

messages.en:
I think it's time for you to know the objective of my mission here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. We were to infiltrate Kois City, the central administrative complex in G5ED-Y, from where the Caldari send all of their expeditions, and answer the question that has been nagging my superiors back home, "Why are they here?".

Now getting into Kois City will be no easy task. It's heavily fortified. But on the bright side I think I know exactly what we're looking for. My sources tell me that the expeditionary forces store most of the data they have collected in a computer within the city's science labs. Backup data is also stored in data chips within their storage facility in the civilian sector of the city. Therefore your task is to somehow get into the civilian quarter and acquire at least one of those data chips. From this data we will hopefully be able to piece together their objective, and find out if it's worth our time to get involved.

This used to be Black Jack's task, but I assume he discovered something that convinced him to cut ties with us and go solo. But I will tell you this, it is in your best interest to complete this task at any cost. Should you fail, or decide to 'keep' the data for yourself, the Syndicate will hunt you down like a dog and force you to watch your own family executed in the cruelest of ways.
messages.zh:
我想现在是时候让你知道我在{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的真正目的了。我们要潜入G5ED-Y的中央行政复合体克斯城。加达里正是从这里派出他们全部的远征军，这也就解释了一直困扰总部里我的上级的问题：“他们为什么在这儿？”

现在进入克斯城不是个简单的任务。它拥有强大的防御工事。不过从好的方面讲，我想我非常清楚我们该找什么。根据我眼线的情报，远征部队将收集来的大部分数据储存在这座城市的科学实验室的一台计算机里。备份数据也储存在城市平民区存储设施内的数据芯片上。因此你的任务是设法进入平民区，获取至少一块数据芯片。从这些数据中，我们也许能拼凑出他们的目的，并搞清楚这是否值得我们花时间介入。<br><br>这本来是黑杰克该做的事，我想他一定发现了什么，使得他决定和我们断绝关系，自己单干。不过我告诉你，出于你自己的利益考虑，你最好不惜一切代价完成这个任务。如果你失败了，或者决定自己“保留”这些数据，那么辛迪加财团会像抓一只狗一样猎获你，并且当着你的面用最残酷的手段处死你的家人。

messages.en:
You have the data! Incredible, I truly thought the mission I gave you was close to impossible. Yet here you are.

Enjoy your reward, {[character]player.name}, you've certainly earned it. As for myself, I'll be heading back to Syndicate space soon enough with my findings, have a nice day.
messages.zh:
你拿到了数据！难以置信，我真的以为我给你的任务基本上是不可能完成的任务。可你做到了。

拿着你的酬金，{[character]player.name}，你理应得到它。至于我自己，我会带着我的发现迅速赶回辛迪加空间，祝你好运。

messages.en: Infiltrate Kois City, find the storage facility in the Civilian Quarter and destroy it.  Loot the Expeditionary Data from the wreckage and return to your agent.
messages.zh: 潜入克斯城，找到平民区内的存储设施，并摧毁它。从残骸中抢得远征队数据，然后回到你的代理人处。

messages.en: Mission Objective
messages.zh: 任务目标

messages.en: I'll take anything you got as long as it's worth my time.
messages.zh: 只要别浪费我时间就行了，你找的我都要。

messages.en:
Okay, what I need you to do for me is find one of the famed E-8CSQ gas clouds. Now of course I'm referring specifically to those gas clouds containing the materials I need for booster manufacturing. You must tell me where the cloud is and get me a sample from it. If you do this for me, I'll give you a booster blueprint copy, plus a little extra cash if you're fast. And you'll learn something in the process. Sounds useful, huh?

You will find information on how to find and access the clouds in the message I uploaded to the mission details in your Opportunities interface.
messages.zh:
你现在需要找到一片知名的E-8CSQ气体云。当然，我指的是那些含有增效剂制造原材料的气体云。你必须报告云团位置并取得云团样本。你要是愿意跑一趟，我就送你一份增效剂蓝图拷贝，要是速度够快，可以再加点现金奖励。在这个过程中，你也会有所收获。听起来很划算吧？

至于如何找到并进入云团，我已经把消息上传到你“机遇”界面的任务详情中。

messages.en: What brings you to this dangerous place, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，是什么风把你吹来这里啊？

messages.en: Okay, what I need you to do for me is find one of the famed E-8CSQ gas clouds. Now of course I'm referring specifically to those gas clouds containing the materials I need for booster manufacturing. You must tell me where the cloud is and get me a sample from it. If you do this for me, I'll give you a booster blueprint copy, plus a little extra cash if you're fast. And you'll learn something in the process. Sounds useful, huh?
messages.zh: 好啦，我需要你做的是寻找一块著名的E-8CSQ气云。当然我指的是那些包含我需要的增效剂制造材料的气云。你必须查出那些气云的位置并给我带回一点样品。如果你替我完成这个任务，我会给你一份增效剂蓝图拷贝；如果你够快，还有额外的现金奖励。而且你在这个过程中还会学到一些东西。听上去不错吧？

messages.en: I found one of the gas clouds you've been looking for, {[character]agentID.name}, and it's at these coordinates ...
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，我找到一些你一直要找气云。它们在以下坐标处...

messages.en: Excellent work!!  Now I just need to find a station where I can manufacture the boosters and I'm all set.  Thanks a bunch, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！！我现在只要找到一个能制造增效剂的空间站就行了，然后我将一切就绪。太谢谢你了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Boosters are made by processing chemicals extracted from special gas clouds that can be found in certain deadspace areas in many regions. Some constellations, such as E-8CSQ, 09-4XW, 9HXQ-G, OK-FEM, Pegasus, Assilot, I-3ODK, and 760-9C, however, are rumored to have massive clouds of a scale not seen anywhere else. Finding these clouds requires the ability to conduct long-range scanning, for example via scan probes. Finding them is not always an easy task, though; it sometimes requires quite a bit of exploration.

The downside of searching for these clouds is the fact that they are generally located in dangerous pirate-infested space. Few if any of these clouds exist in civilized space, having been depleted long ago by the mega-corporations. Hence, searching for them can be quite risky and is not recommended for any but the most experienced combat pilots.

To extract the chemicals from the gas clouds, you need a gas cloud harvester module. You also need to find the correct type of gas cloud. Not all clouds have chemicals that the gas cloud harvester can extract, and therefore you might have to go through some trial and error at first before you get the hang of gas cloud harvesting.

Today, most boosters are very much illegal in civilized space, due to the horrible side-effects experienced by users during the Great Booster Craze many decades ago. Manufacturing them must therefore be done in lawless space, outside the spheres of power of the major civilized factions. Similarly, anyone caught smuggling illegal boosters into civilized space can face very steep penalties.

Manufacturing boosters can broken into a few phases. Phase 1 involves extracting the material from the gas cloud. Phase 2 requires a refinery structure with the appropriate service module to process the chemicals and create reactions. Phase 3 also requires a structure or station with the equipment for booster manufacturing to process the reaction and create the booster. This simple 3-step process will result in the creation of a fairly common booster. With additional work, the right blueprint, and a combination of several low-quality boosters, one can create higher-quality versions.
messages.zh:
要生产增效剂，你必须对可以从特殊气云里获得的化学物做适当处理。特殊气云一般在许多星域的死亡空间里都能找得到。有些星座，比如E-8CSQ、09-4XW、9HXQ-G、OK-FEM、飞马、阿西洛特、I-3ODK及760-9C，据说有别处无法比拟的海量气云存在。要找出这些气云，你得有能力用类似扫描探针的东西进行远距扫描。而且真要把它们找出来也不是件容易的事情，往往需要跋山涉水。

寻找这些气云一个很不利的方面便是它们一般都出现在危险的海盗窝里。安全区域里的气云早就被大公司开采干净了，你现在几乎不可能在那些地方再发现气云。因此除非是经验老到的战斗飞行员，一般我们不建议大家去搜寻气云，太危险了。

要从气云里提取化学物，你得依靠气云采集器。除此之外，你还得找对气云的种类。不是所有气云蕴含的化学物都能被气云采集器提取出来的。可能在一开始你得反复试验好几次才能真正知道气云采集器该怎么用。

目前很多增效剂在安全区域都是违禁品，就是因为数十年前许多人都疯狂地使用这玩意儿，而它们引发的副作用实在太吓人。这样一来，要生产它们你必须要去无法律约束的区域，远离那些主要文明的势力范围。当然，如果你在那些地方被抓到偷运增效剂，那惩罚力度也是惊人的。

增效剂的生产分为几个步骤。第一步，你得从气云中提取原料。第二步，你得有一个装配了适合的服务装备的精炼厂建筑来处理化学物质和制造反应。第三步，你需要一个有合适设备的建筑或空间站来进行反应并制造增效剂。这三步下来，你就能获得最常见最普通的增效剂。如果你能再花点力气，拥有一张正确的蓝图，再加上一些低质量的增效剂，你就可以生产高质量的增效剂产品了。

messages.en: A Brief Guide to Booster Manufacturing
messages.zh: 增效剂制造指南

messages.en:
Ah, it's nice to see a friendly face around here for a change, {[character]player.name}. But to answer your question, I came here to investigate Constellation E-8CSQ, which has been reported to contain massive gas clouds full of material used in booster manufacturing. There have been a lot of rumors about it within {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and I thought I'd take a look for myself. Unfortunately, the number of rogue drones and outlaws here has me quite worried, so I dare not go looking for the clouds myself. Hence, I might have a job for you...

However, I suggest you refrain from accepting my task unless you have access to a gas cloud harvester module. Without that, you will just be wasting my time.
messages.zh:
啊，在这里见到一张友好的面孔，换换花样，真不错，{[character]player.name}。至于你的问题，我是来这里调查E-8CSQ星座的。据报道，这里有很多气云，其中蕴含着大量用于生产增效剂的矿物。在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}内有很多关于它的传言，所以我想亲自来看看。遗憾的是，那里充斥的自由无人机和非法分子让我非常担心，我可不敢自己去找那些气云。因此，我也许有个任务给你……

然而，如果你没有气云收集装置，那我建议你不要接受我的任务。如果没有那个东西，没有哪个东西你不管做什么都是在浪费时间。

name.en: All Things Come to an End (1 of 2)
name.es: Todo llega a su fin (1 de 2)
name.fr: Toutes les bonnes choses ont une fin (1 sur 2)
name.ru: Всему когда-то приходит конец (All Things Come to an End) (1 из 2)

messages.en: As a matter of fact, I am. Anything I can do for you or this fine station?
messages.zh: 事实上我正是你要找的人。有什么能帮忙的么？

messages.en:
Makeinu has a thorn in its side that I want drawn out, the sooner the better. As you might know, some of our residents have had a fairly violent history. And it so happens that DED felt the urge to send assassins all the way out here to settle the score with a couple of my people who had some run-ins with the law some time ago. Or this could be a private vendetta by an angry DED commander. Who knows? But either way, they need to be dealt with before they find us. We're ill equipped to deal with an encounter like that, and quite frankly most of us are too old and worn out to fight.

I've had the DED squadron tracked for some time now. I'll upload a bookmark for their current location to the mission details in your Opportunities interface. Find them and take out their leader ― that should be enough to send them crawling back to their homeland with their tails between their collective legs.
messages.zh:
梅吉诺人的心里都有一根刺，我想要拔掉它，越快越好。你也许听说过，这里有些居民以前都不是善茬。DED刚好很想派些杀手，跟这里前段时间犯法的人算算账。也有可能这位怒火中烧的DED指挥官是想了解私人恩怨。谁知道呢？但不管怎么说，我们都要在暴露身份前解决这件事。我们没有应对这种冲突的装备。老实说，很多人都既老迈又劳累，无法战斗。

我追踪这支DED中队有段时间了。我会把他们当前位置的位标上传到“机遇”界面的任务详情。只要找到他们并杀掉长官，就能吓得他们夹紧尾巴，滚回老家了。

messages.en: Greetings, Rakka.  I hear you call the shots here in Makeinu?
messages.zh: 你好啊，拉卡。我听说在梅吉诺你说了算？

messages.en:
Makeinu has a thorn in its side that I want drawn out, the sooner the better. As you might know, some of our residents have had a fairly violent history. And it so happens that DED felt the urge to send assassins all the way out here to settle the score with a couple of my people who had some run-ins with the law some time ago. Or this could be a private vendetta by an angry DED commander. Who knows? But either way, they need to be dealt with before they find us. We're ill equipped to deal with an encounter like that, and quite frankly most of us are too old and worn out to fight.

I've had the DED squadron tracked for some time now. I'll upload a bookmark for their current location to the mission details in your Opportunities interface. Find them and take out their leader ― that should be enough to send them crawling back to their homeland with their tails between their collective legs.
