messages.en: I have completed the task, Rakka.  Now for my reward ...
messages.zh: 我已经完成了任务，拉卡。那么至于我的报酬……

messages.en: Excellent. Yes, you will receive your reward, don't worry. But before you leave, I have one more task for you. The competence you showed in your last assignment has given me an idea ...
messages.zh: 很好。是的，你会收到你的酬金，放心好了。不过在你离开前，我还有个任务给你。你在上次任务中表现出的能力，使我想到……

messages.en: I am the mayor, yes. But you might find the inhabitants to be a bit ... independent. Anyway, I assume, from looking at the database information on you, that you're a freelancer. Looking for a job, perhaps?
messages.zh: 是的，我是镇长。但你可能发现这里的居民有点……不受约束。无论如何，从你的数据库信息上看来，我认为你是个自由飞行员。也许是来找工作吧？

name.en: All Things Come to an End (2 of 2)
name.es: Todo llega a su fin (2 de 2)
name.fr: Toutes les bonnes choses ont une fin (2 sur 2)
name.ru: Всему когда-то приходит конец (All Things Come to an End) (2 из 2)

messages.en: I will do my best.
messages.zh: 我会尽力而为。

messages.en: I can ask for nothing more.
messages.zh: 我没更多要求了。

messages.en: You said you had some more work for me?
messages.zh: 你说你还有工作要给我。

messages.en:
Yes, your next assignment is a little more personal in nature. You see, I was born and raised in the Venal system, and during my teens I joined the Guristas militia. I never knew my parents, but I assume they were loyal to the Guristas. I did have a few comrades that I could call friends, and my life was relatively stable. But then came the assignment that would change everything.

I was sent to E-8CSQ to find and apprehend a traitor, Akkeshu Karuan. My orders were specific, to bring him back dead or alive to Jirai Laitanen at the Guristas headquarters. I was not to return, not ever, until and unless this task was accomplished. I never questioned my orders, and frankly I don't give a damn what Akkeshu was accused of. For my entire life, I have known nothing other than the Guristas, the organization that fed and clothed me during my darkest of times, and I owe them my life.

But unfortunately the mission did not go as planned. I fought Akkeshu and his men inside what is now known as "Cadaver Reef." I was victorious in that battle, but Akkeshu still slipped through my grasp. He and what remained of his gang fled deeper into the deadspace pocket, and of course I followed with the fleet under my command. That action turned out to be a terrible mistake. Akkeshu knew the area like the back of his hand, and he managed to use that knowledge to his advantage. Once he warped away from our targeting systems, all we could find was an acceleration gate. When we activated it, it propelled us deeper into the rock-filled deadspace complex. But somehow Akkeshu had managed to reconfigure the gate, and instead of finding him on the other side, we were sent straight into a massive drone hive. We put up a brave fight and managed to destroy the hive, but at enormous cost. The fleet was shattered, and I was left with a force so small we could not hope to face Akkeshu again.

So here I am, all these years later, rotting in a town filled with hopelessness and depression. I so yearn to return to my roots, but I know that if I do so, I will be promptly executed for my failure.

I am now too old and out of practice to attempt to find Akkeshu again. But considering how well you dealt with your last mission, I have hope that perhaps you can succeed where I failed. All I ask for is evidence of Akkeshu's death; with that, I can return to my homeland and hopefully redeem myself, dying in peace among my own people. I do not have many years left, and you cannot imagine how much I wish to spend them in the land of my birth instead of a place like Makeinu Town.

Find Cadaver Reef. Use scan probes. Bring me proof of Akkeshu's demise, and I will give you my most prized possessions.
messages.zh:
你的下一个任务算帮我个私人的忙。我出生在维纳尔，十几岁的时候就参加了古斯塔斯军队。虽然我从来不知道自己的生身父母是谁，但我猜想他们一定忠于古斯塔斯集团。我的生活一度过得很平静，曾有过一些战友和朋友。但后来他们参与了一项任务，一切就随即改变了。

我被派去E-8CSQ逮捕一个名为阿克舒·卡鲁安的叛徒。命令上说，不管死活，要把阿克舒带到古斯塔斯总部吉拉伊·赖塔恩处。在我最困难的时候是古斯塔斯集团让我吃饱穿暖，所以我一直把他们当作自己再生父母，没有古斯塔斯就没有今天的我。不完成任务我是不会回去的。我从没对自己接到的任务产生过任何质疑，甚至不知道阿克舒受到什么指控。

但任务进行得并不如预计的顺利，我在亡者之礁和阿克舒还有他的人进行了一场战斗，虽然我们取得了胜利，但还是让阿克舒从我指缝中溜走了。他和他的党羽向死亡空间层的深处飞去，我当然也率领我的舰队追击过去。但后来事实证明这个决策是错误的。阿克舒对那个地方了如指掌，我们落入了他的圈套。当他突然从视野中消失，在我们面前只剩下一个加速门。激活加速门后，我们进入了死亡空间复合体的更深处。不知怎么的，阿克舒对加速门设置进行了改动，我们并没有在加速轨道另一端找到他，而是被带到一个大型无人机母巢。在经历了一番殊死搏斗后，虽然我方剿灭了母巢，但同时也付出了惨重的代价。我的舰队已溃不成军，无力再与阿克舒对决。

由于没能完成任务，那么多年来我都待在这个了无生机的破落小镇上。我多希望能落叶归根，但我知道回去一定会立即受到处罚，因为我任务失败了。

如今我年纪大了，没精力再去追捕阿克舒。看到你上一个任务完成得如此出色，我又理由相信你一定能顺利完成我交给你的任务。我要你带回阿克舒的死亡证明，这样我便能荣归故里。我剩下的时间已经不多了，你无法想象我多么希望在自己故乡安度晚年，我实在不想在梅吉诺镇这样的鬼地方再待下去了。

使用扫描探针找到亡者之礁，干掉阿克舒并把他的死亡证明带给我，我将用自己最值钱的财产来报答你。

messages.en: Akkeshu has been destroyed.
messages.zh: 阿克舒已被击败。

messages.en: Incredible! I simply could not bring myself to believe you would succeed, {[character]player.name}, but here you are. I owe you more than I can ever repay, but I hope this meager reward will have made it worth your time. Take care.
messages.zh: 真难以置信！我只是不敢相信你会成功，{[character]player.name}，但是你做到了。我欠你的情无以为报，不过我希望这点微薄的奖励能稍稍弥补你所花费的时间。保重。

messages.en: To finish this mission, you must first find Cadaver Reef via system scanning. It lies somewhere in this constellation. Akkeshu might be located inside; destroy his ship and return with his DNA for your reward.
messages.zh: 要完成这个任务，你必须先用星系扫描仪找到亡者之礁。它就在这个星座的某处。阿克舒可能就在里面；摧毁他的飞船，然后带回他的DNA来换取酬金。

messages.en: Objective
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en: I'll take anything you got as long as it's worth my time.
messages.zh: 只要别浪费我时间就行了，你找的我都要。

messages.en:
Okay, what I need you to do for me is find one of the famed 09-4XW gas clouds. Now of course I'm referring specifically to those gas clouds containing the materials I need for booster manufacturing. You must tell me where the cloud is and get me a sample from it. If you do this for me, I'll give you a booster blueprint copy, plus a little extra cash if you're fast. And you'll learn something in the process. Sounds useful, huh?

You will find information on how to find and access the clouds in the mission details in your Opportunities interface.
messages.zh:
你现在需要找到一片知名的09-4XW气体云。当然，我指的是那些含有增效剂制造原材料的气体云。你必须报告云团位置并取得云团样本。你要是愿意跑一趟，我就送你一份增效剂蓝图拷贝，要是速度够快，可以再加点现金奖励。在这个过程中，你也会有所收获。听起来很划算吧？

你可以查看“机遇”界面的任务详情，了解如何找到并进入云团。

messages.en: So what brought you all the way out here, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，是什么风把你吹来这里啊？

messages.en: Okay, what I need you to do for me is find one of the famed 09-4XW gas clouds. Now of course I'm referring specifically to those gas clouds containing the materials I need for booster manufacturing. You must tell me where the cloud is and get me a sample from it. If you do this for me, I'll give you a booster blueprint copy, plus a little extra cash if you're fast. And you'll learn something in the process. Sounds useful, huh?
messages.zh: 好啦，我需要你做的是寻找一块著名的09-4XW气云。当然我指的是那些包含我需要的增效剂制造材料的气云。你必须查出那些气云的位置并给我带回一点样品。如果你替我完成这个任务，我会给你一份增效剂蓝图拷贝；如果你够快，还有额外的现金奖励。而且你在这个过程中还会学到一些东西。听上去不错吧？

messages.en: I found one of the gas clouds you've been looking for, {[character]agentID.name}, and it's at these coordinates ...
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，我找到一些你一直要找气云。它们在以下坐标处...

messages.en: Excellent work!!  Now I just need to find a station where I can manufacture the boosters and I'm all set.  Thanks a bunch, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 干得好！我现在只要找到一个能制造增效剂的空间站就行了，其它一切就绪。{[character]player.name}，多谢了！

messages.en:
Boosters are made by processing chemicals extracted from special gas clouds that can be found in certain deadspace areas in many regions. Some constellations, such as E-8CSQ, 09-4XW, 9HXQ-G, OK-FEM, Pegasus, Assilot, I-3ODK, and 760-9C, however, are rumored to have massive clouds of a scale not seen anywhere else. Finding these clouds requires the ability to conduct long-range scanning, for example via scan probes. Finding them is not always an easy task, though; it sometimes requires quite a bit of exploration.

The downside of searching for these clouds is the fact that they are generally located in dangerous pirate-infested space. Few if any of these clouds exist in civilized space, having been depleted long ago by the mega-corporations. Hence, searching for them can be quite risky and is not recommended for any but the most experienced combat pilots.

To extract the chemicals from the gas clouds, you need a gas cloud harvester module. You also need to find the correct type of gas cloud. Not all clouds have chemicals that the gas cloud harvester can extract, and therefore you might have to go through some trial and error at first before you get the hang of gas cloud harvesting.

Today, most boosters are very much illegal in civilized space, due to the horrible side-effects experienced by users during the Great Booster Craze many decades ago. Manufacturing them must therefore be done in lawless space, outside the spheres of power of the major civilized factions. Similarly, anyone caught smuggling illegal boosters into civilized space can face very steep penalties.

Manufacturing boosters can broken into a few phases. Phase 1 involves extracting the material from the gas cloud. Phase 2 requires a refinery structure with the appropriate service module to process the chemicals and create reactions. Phase 3 also requires a structure or station with the equipment for booster manufacturing to process the reaction and create the booster. This simple 3-step process will result in the creation of a fairly common booster. With additional work, the right blueprint, and a combination of several low-quality boosters, one can create higher-quality versions.
messages.zh:
要生产增效剂，你必须对可以从特殊气云里获得的化学物做适当处理。特殊气云一般在许多星域的死亡空间里都能找得到。有些星座，比如E-8CSQ、09-4XW、9HXQ-G、OK-FEM、飞马、阿西洛特、I-3ODK及760-9C，据说有别处无法比拟的海量气云存在。要找出这些气云，你得有能力用类似扫描探针的东西进行远距扫描。而且真要把它们找出来也不是件容易的事情，往往需要跋山涉水。

寻找这些气云一个很不利的方面便是它们一般都出现在危险的海盗窝里。安全区域里的气云早就被大公司开采干净了，你现在几乎不可能在那些地方再发现气云。因此除非是经验老到的战斗飞行员，一般我们不建议大家去搜寻气云，太危险了。

要从气云里提取化学物，你得依靠气云采集器。除此之外，你还得找对气云的种类。不是所有气云蕴含的化学物都能被气云采集器提取出来的。可能在一开始你得反复试验好几次才能真正知道气云采集器该怎么用。

目前很多增效剂在安全区域都是违禁品，就是因为数十年前许多人都疯狂地使用这玩意儿，而它们引发的副作用实在太吓人。这样一来，要生产它们你必须要去无法律约束的区域，远离那些主要文明的势力范围。当然，如果你在那些地方被抓到偷运增效剂，那惩罚力度也是惊人的。

增效剂的生产分为几个步骤。第一步，你得从气云中提取原料。第二步，你得有一个装配了适合的服务装备的精炼厂建筑来处理化学物质和制造反应。第三步，你需要一个有合适设备的建筑或空间站来进行反应并制造增效剂。这三步下来，你就能获得最常见最普通的增效剂。如果你能再花点力气，拥有一张正确的蓝图，再加上一些低质量的增效剂，你就可以生产高质量的增效剂产品了。

messages.en: A Brief Guide to Booster Manufacturing
messages.zh: 增效剂制造指南

messages.en:
I came here to investigate Constellation 09-4XW, which has been reported to contain massive gas clouds full of material used in booster manufacturing. There have been a lot of rumors about it within {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and I thought I'd take a look for myself. Unfortunately, the number of rogue drones and outlaws here has me quite worried, so I dare not go looking for the clouds myself. Hence, I might have a job for you...

However, I suggest you refrain from accepting my task unless you have access to a gas cloud harvester module. Without that, you will just be wasting my time.
messages.zh:
我是来这里调查09-4XW星座的。据报道，这里有很多气云，其中蕴含着大量用于生产增效剂的矿物。在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}内有很多关于它的传言，所以我想亲自来看看。遗憾的是，那里充斥的自由无人机和非法分子让我非常担心，我可不敢自己去找那些气云。因此，我也许有个任务给你……

然而，如果你没有气云收集装置，那我建议你不要接受我的任务。如果没有那个东西，就只会浪费我的时间。

messages.en: I'll take anything you got as long as it's worth my time.
messages.zh: 只要别浪费我时间就行了，你找的我都要。

messages.en:
Okay, what I need you to do for me is find one of the famed I-3ODK gas clouds. Now, of course, I'm referring specifically to those gas clouds containing the materials I need for booster manufacturing. You must tell me where the cloud is and get me a sample from it. If you do this for me, I'll give you a booster blueprint copy, plus a little extra cash if you're fast. And you'll learn something in the process. Sounds useful, huh?

You will find information on how to find and access the clouds in the mission details in your Opportunities interface.
messages.zh:
你现在需要找到一片知名的I-3ODK气体云。当然，我指的是含有增效剂制造原材料的气体云。你必须报告云团位置并取得云团样本。你要是愿意跑一趟，我就送你一份增效剂蓝图拷贝，要是速度够快，可以再加点现金奖励。在这个过程中，你也会有所收获。听起来很划算吧？

你可以查看“机遇”界面的任务详情，了解如何找到并进入云团。

messages.en: What brings you here, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，是什么风把你吹来这里啊？

messages.en: Okay, what I need you to do for me is find one of the famed I-3ODK gas clouds. Now of course I'm referring specifically to those gas clouds containing the materials I need for booster manufacturing. You must tell me where the cloud is and get me a sample from it. If you do this for me, I'll give you a booster blueprint copy, plus a little extra cash if you're fast. And you'll learn something in the process. Sounds useful, huh?
messages.zh: 好啦，我需要你做的是寻找一块著名的I-3ODK气云。当然我指的是那些包含我需要的增效剂制造材料的气云。你必须查出那些气云的位置并给我带回一点样品。如果你替我完成这个任务，我会给你一份增效剂蓝图拷贝；如果你够快，还有额外的现金奖励。而且你在这个过程中还会学到一些东西。听上去不错吧？

messages.en: I found one of the gas clouds you've been looking for, {[character]agentID.name}, and it's at these coordinates ...
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，我找到一些你一直要找气云。它们在以下坐标处...

messages.en: Excellent work!!  Now I just need to find a station where I can manufacture the boosters and I'm all set.  Thanks a bunch, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 干得好！我现在只要找到一个能制造增效剂的空间站就行了，其它一切就绪。{[character]player.name}，多谢了！

messages.en:
Boosters are made by processing chemicals extracted from special gas clouds that can be found in certain deadspace areas in many regions. Some constellations, such as E-8CSQ, 09-4XW, 9HXQ-G, OK-FEM, Pegasus, Assilot, I-3ODK, and 760-9C, however, are rumored to have massive clouds of a scale not seen anywhere else. Finding these clouds requires the ability to conduct long-range scanning, for example via scan probes. Finding them is not always an easy task, though; it sometimes requires quite a bit of exploration.

The downside of searching for these clouds is the fact that they are generally located in dangerous pirate-infested space. Few if any of these clouds exist in civilized space, having been depleted long ago by the mega-corporations. Hence, searching for them can be quite risky and is not recommended for any but the most experienced combat pilots.

To extract the chemicals from the gas clouds, you need a gas cloud harvester module. You also need to find the correct type of gas cloud. Not all clouds have chemicals that the gas cloud harvester can extract, and therefore you might have to go through some trial and error at first before you get the hang of gas cloud harvesting.

Today, most boosters are very much illegal in civilized space, due to the horrible side-effects experienced by users during the Great Booster Craze many decades ago. Manufacturing them must therefore be done in lawless space, outside the spheres of power of the major civilized factions. Similarly, anyone caught smuggling illegal boosters into civilized space can face very steep penalties.

Manufacturing boosters can broken into a few phases. Phase 1 involves extracting the material from the gas cloud. Phase 2 requires a refinery structure with the appropriate service module to process the chemicals and create reactions. Phase 3 also requires a structure or station with the equipment for booster manufacturing to process the reaction and create the booster. This simple 3-step process will result in the creation of a fairly common booster. With additional work, the right blueprint, and a combination of several low-quality boosters, one can create higher-quality versions.
messages.zh:
要生产增效剂，你必须对可以从特殊气云里获得的化学物做适当处理。特殊气云一般在许多星域的死亡空间里都能找得到。有些星座，比如E-8CSQ、09-4XW、9HXQ-G、OK-FEM、飞马、阿西洛特、I-3ODK及760-9C，据说有别处无法比拟的海量气云存在。要找出这些气云，你得有能力用类似扫描探针的东西进行远距扫描。而且真要把它们找出来也不是件容易的事情，往往需要跋山涉水。

寻找这些气云一个很不利的方面便是它们一般都出现在危险的海盗窝里。安全区域里的气云早就被大公司开采干净了，你现在几乎不可能在那些地方再发现气云。因此除非是经验老到的战斗飞行员，一般我们不建议大家去搜寻气云，太危险了。

要从气云里提取化学物，你得依靠气云采集器。除此之外，你还得找对气云的种类。不是所有气云蕴含的化学物都能被气云采集器提取出来的。可能在一开始你得反复试验好几次才能真正知道气云采集器该怎么用。

目前很多增效剂在安全区域都是违禁品，就是因为数十年前许多人都疯狂地使用这玩意儿，而它们引发的副作用实在太吓人。这样一来，要生产它们你必须要去无法律约束的区域，远离那些主要文明的势力范围。当然，如果你在那些地方被抓到偷运增效剂，那惩罚力度也是惊人的。

增效剂的生产分为几个步骤。第一步，你得从气云中提取原料。第二步，你得有一个装配了适合的服务装备的精炼厂建筑来处理化学物质和制造反应。第三步，你需要一个有合适设备的建筑或空间站来进行反应并制造增效剂。这三步下来，你就能获得最常见最普通的增效剂。如果你能再花点力气，拥有一张正确的蓝图，再加上一些低质量的增效剂，你就可以生产高质量的增效剂产品了。

messages.en: A Brief Guide to Booster Manufacturing
messages.zh: 增效剂制造指南

messages.en:
I came here to investigate Constellation I-3ODK, which has been reported to contain massive gas clouds full of material used in booster manufacturing. There have been a lot of rumors about it within {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and I thought I'd take a look for myself. Unfortunately, the number of rogue drones and outlaws here has me quite worried, so I dare not go looking for the clouds myself. Hence, I might have a job for you...

However, I suggest you refrain from accepting my task unless you have access to a gas cloud harvester module. Without that, you will just be wasting my time.
messages.zh:
我是来这里调查I-3ODK星座的。据报道，这里有很多气云，其中蕴含着大量用于生产增效剂的矿物。在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}内有很多关于它的传言，所以我想亲自来看看。遗憾的是，那里充斥的自由无人机和非法分子让我非常担心，我可不敢自己去找那些气云。因此，我也许有个任务给你……

然而，如果你没有气云收集装置，那我建议你不要接受我的任务。如果没有那个东西，就只会浪费我的时间。

messages.en:
Boosters are made by processing chemicals extracted from special gas clouds that can be found in certain deadspace areas in many regions. Some constellations, such as E-8CSQ, 09-4XW, 9HXQ-G, OK-FEM, Pegasus, Assilot, I-3ODK, and 760-9C, however, are rumored to have massive clouds of a scale not seen anywhere else. Finding these clouds requires the ability to conduct long-range scanning, for example via scan probes. Finding them is not always an easy task, though; it sometimes requires quite a bit of exploration.

The downside of searching for these clouds is the fact that they are generally located in dangerous pirate-infested space. Few if any of these clouds exist in civilized space, having been depleted long ago by the mega-corporations. Hence, searching for them can be quite risky and is not recommended for any but the most experienced combat pilots.

To extract the chemicals from the gas clouds, you need a gas cloud harvester module. You also need to find the correct type of gas cloud. Not all clouds have chemicals that the gas cloud harvester can extract, and therefore you might have to go through some trial and error at first before you get the hang of gas cloud harvesting.

Today, most boosters are very much illegal in civilized space, due to the horrible side-effects experienced by users during the Great Booster Craze many decades ago. Manufacturing them must therefore be done in lawless space, outside the spheres of power of the major civilized factions. Similarly, anyone caught smuggling illegal boosters into civilized space can face very steep penalties.

Manufacturing boosters can broken into a few phases. Phase 1 involves extracting the material from the gas cloud. Phase 2 requires a refinery structure with the appropriate service module to process the chemicals and create reactions. Phase 3 also requires a structure or station with the equipment for booster manufacturing to process the reaction and create the booster. This simple 3-step process will result in the creation of a fairly common booster. With additional work, the right blueprint, and a combination of several low-quality boosters, one can create higher-quality versions.
messages.zh:
要生产增效剂，你必须对可以从特殊气云里获得的化学物做适当处理。特殊气云一般在许多星域的死亡空间里都能找得到。有些星座，比如E-8CSQ、09-4XW、9HXQ-G、OK-FEM、飞马、阿西洛特、I-3ODK及760-9C，据说有别处无法比拟的海量气云存在。要找出这些气云，你得有能力用类似扫描探针的东西进行远距扫描。而且真要把它们找出来也不是件容易的事情，往往需要跋山涉水。

寻找这些气云一个很不利的方面便是它们一般都出现在危险的海盗窝里。安全区域里的气云早就被大公司开采干净了，你现在几乎不可能在那些地方再发现气云。因此除非是经验老到的战斗飞行员，一般我们不建议大家去搜寻气云，太危险了。

要从气云里提取化学物，你得依靠气云采集器。除此之外，你还得找对气云的种类。不是所有气云蕴含的化学物都能被气云采集器提取出来的。可能在一开始你得反复试验好几次才能真正知道气云采集器该怎么用。

目前很多增效剂在安全区域都是违禁品，就是因为数十年前许多人都疯狂地使用这玩意儿，而它们引发的副作用实在太吓人。这样一来，要生产它们你必须要去无法律约束的区域，远离那些主要文明的势力范围。当然，如果你在那些地方被抓到偷运增效剂，那惩罚力度也是惊人的。

增效剂的生产分为几个步骤。第一步，你得从气云中提取原料。第二步，你得有一个装配了适合的服务装备的精炼厂建筑来处理化学物质和制造反应。第三步，你需要一个有合适设备的建筑或空间站来进行反应并制造增效剂。这三步下来，你就能获得最常见最普通的增效剂。如果你能再花点力气，拥有一张正确的蓝图，再加上一些低质量的增效剂，你就可以生产高质量的增效剂产品了。

messages.en:
Ah it's nice to see a friendly face around here for a change, {[character]player.name}. But to answer your question, I came here to investigate Constellation 760-9C, which has been reported to contain massive gas clouds full of material used in booster manufacturing. There have been a lot of rumors about it within {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and I thought I'd take a look for myself. Unfortunately, the number of pirates here has me quite worried, so I dare not go looking for the clouds myself. Hence, I might have a job for you...

However, I suggest you refrain from accepting my task unless you have access to a gas cloud harvester module. Without that, you will just be wasting my time.
messages.zh:
啊，在这里见到一张友好的面孔，换换花样，真不错，{[character]player.name}。至于你的问题，我是来这里调查760-9C星座的。据报道，这里有很多气云，其中蕴含着大量用于生产增效剂的矿物。在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}内有很多关于它的传言，所以我想亲自来看看。遗憾的是，那里充斥的海盗让我非常担心，我可不敢自己去找那些气云。因此，我也许有个任务给你……

然而，如果你没有气云采集器，那我建议你不要接受我的任务。没有那个东西，就只会是浪费我的时间。

messages.en: We've been encountering a tremendous amount of pirate activity in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} lately.  Our convoys are constantly under threat, and our CEO demanded that we do something about the situation.  We are to hire trustworthy and competent mercenaries to help us out, as the security forces in this constellation are swamped with work.  So I ask you, {[character]player.name}, will you help us out this time?  If your answer is yes, then I have a difficult assignment for you.  I need you to eliminate a heap load of pirates at a few coordinates.  You will receive bookmarks to these locations, all of them within the system {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}.  Hopefully this will put a dent into their plans, and relieve our security forces a bit of their workload.
messages.zh: 我们最近在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}遭遇了大量的海盗活动。  我们的护航队总是受到威胁，因此我们的CEO要求我们做些事情扭转局势。  我们要雇佣一些值得信赖而且有能力的佣兵来帮助我们走出困境，因为我们在这个星座中的安保力量都忙于各自的工作，无法脱身。  所以我想问你，{[character]player.name}，这次你能帮我这个忙吗？  如果答案是肯定的，那么我有个艰巨的任务给你。  我需要你清除几个坐标处的大批海盗飞船。  我会给你他们在{[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}星系的位标。  希望此举能够拖延他们的计划，减轻我们战斗人员的负担。

messages.en: I'm sorry for your loss.  Perhaps I can help.
messages.zh: 我为你的损失感到遗憾。也许我能帮忙。

messages.en:
I know some of the families of my colleagues who perished on that fateful day, and I would like their bodies returned to me so that I can bring them back to Caldari space for proper burial. If you're up for the job, I'll give you a bookmark to the deadspace area where they lost their lives. You should be able to find the wreckage of their ships there.

You'll probably have to navigate through at least two pockets though to find all of them, once the Guristas attacked we tried to flee via the acceleration gates there, some of us only made it past one gate before being mowed down.
messages.zh:
我认识死在那个灾难性日子的部分同事的家人，我想要找回他们的遗体，运回加达里空间妥善安葬。如果你愿意接受这份工作，我会给你他们遇难的死亡空间的位标。你应该可以在那里找到他们飞船的残骸。

你可能得航行穿过两个死亡空间层才能找到全部残骸。当古斯塔斯开始攻击的时候，我们试图通过那里的加速轨道逃走，可惜一些人只逃过了第一个加速轨道就被击毁了。

messages.en: Why so down, Kakala?
messages.zh: 为什么这么倒霉，卡卡拉？

messages.en:
Alright, I'll tell you a little story. My expedition had discovered an area filled with gas clouds thicker than I had ever witnessed in my life, and we were ecstatic. For days we harvested the gas fields, with no end in sight. At that time I was already starting to daydream about where I would retire when I finished this job. It was probably the greatest moment of my life. Unfortunately, followed by the worst.

Once we had filled our cargo holds, we started to align our ships for warp. It was then that they hit us. They came from nowhere and warp scrambled our industrials and jammed the two merc ships escorting us. They demanded over half of our cargo. We debated. But before we could give an answer, they attacked. Half the expedition was wiped out, including some of my closest friends. The ones who survived were told to go back to camp and relay our story to the rest of the miners and harvesters, so that the next time one of our expeditions runs into the Guristas we follow their orders immediately.

Now I just want to leave this dreadful place, I knew I took a huge risk by coming here but now that I've seen the face of death ... I just don't think I have it in me anymore.

I know some of the families of my colleagues who perished on that fateful day, and I would like their bodies returned to me so that I can bring them back to Caldari space for proper burial. If you're up for the job, I'll give you a bookmark to the deadspace area where they lost their lives. You should be able to find the wreckage of their ships there.

You'll probably have to navigate through at least two pockets though to find all of them, once the Guristas attacked we tried to flee via the acceleration gates there, some of us only made it past one gate before being mowed down.
messages.zh:
好吧，我给你讲个小故事。我的探险队发现了一处资源丰富的气云矿，比我这辈子亲眼见过的所有气云矿都要丰富得多，这让我们欣喜不已。一连好多天，我们都在开采这片看不到边际的气云。那段时间我都开始做起了白日梦，幻想着完成这次工作后找个地方退休享福了。那很可能是我这辈子最幸福的时候。可是，接下来的就是最不幸的时候了。

我们把所有的货柜舱都装满后，开始排列舰船准备跃迁。就在那时，他们袭击了我们。他们不知从什么地方跑出来，对我们的工业舰进行跃迁阻断，并且干扰了两艘护卫我们的雇佣军舰船。他们索要大半货物。我们讨论了这个问题。但是还没等我们给予答复，他们就发动了进攻。探险队半数被毁，其中包括我的几个最亲密的朋友。他们还告诉幸存者，回到营地后要把我们的遭遇讲给其他矿工和采集者听，这样下次我们有探险队遇到古斯塔斯时就会乖乖服从他们的命令。<br><br>现在我只想离开这个可怕的地方，我知道我冒了很大风险才到这里来，不过既然我已经和死神打过照面……我想我现在已经没有当初的热情了。<br><br>我认识死在那个灾难性日子的部分同事的家人，我想要找回他们的遗体，运回加达里空间妥善安葬。如果你愿意接受这份工作，我会给你他们遇难的死亡空间的位标。你应该可以在那里找到他们飞船的残骸。<br><br>你可能得航行穿过两个死亡空间层才能找到全部残骸。当古斯塔斯开始攻击的时候，我们试图通过那里的加速轨道逃走，可惜一些人只逃过了第一个加速轨道就被击毁了。

messages.en: You're some fighter, I didn't expect you to come back alive.  But I'm happy you did, here's your reward.
messages.zh: 你是个了不起的战士，我本没期望你会活着回来。不过你做到了，我很高兴。这是你的酬劳。

It was probably the greatest moment of my life. Unfortunately, followed by the worst.

messages.en: You need anything else done?
messages.zh: 你还有别的事情需要解决么。

messages.en: Your success in the last mission has given me some hope.  Perhaps my comrades can be avenged.  The captain of the Guristas gang which attacked us is still at large.  But some of my people have tracked him down, and I have the coordinates to his hideout.  I will give you these coordinates, if you promise to destroy him and anyone under his command.  You will receive a reward, of course.
messages.zh: 你在上一个任务中的成功让我看到很大的希望，也许这样能真的让我的同志们得到安息。发动对我们的攻击行动的古斯塔斯队长目前还逍遥法外，我们的一些人已经确定了他的位置，并告知了我他藏身之处的坐标。如果你答应我将他和他的全部党羽都摧毁的话，你将会得到更多的报酬。

messages.en: Although the loss of my friends can never be replaced, you have certainly gone far to ease the burden of their deaths.  For that I will be forever thankful.  Take your reward, and be safe.
messages.zh: 虽然我失去的朋友不能够再起死回生，但你却为了他们的身后事作了这么大的努力。为此我会永远感激你。拿着你的酬金，保重。

messages.en: Your success in the last mission has given me some hope.  Perhaps my comrades can be avenged.  The captain of the Guristas gang which attacked us is still at large.  But some of my people have tracked him down, and I have the coordinates to his hideout.  I will give you these coordinates, if you promise to destroy him and anyone under his command.  You will receive a reward, of course.
messages.zh: 你上次任务的成功给了我一些希望。也许真的可以为我的同志们报仇。袭击我们的古斯塔斯恶棍的队长目前仍然逍遥法外。不过我的人一直在跟踪他，并且得到了他藏身处的坐标。如果你答应干掉他和他指挥的所有人，我会把这些坐标给你。当然，你将得到一笔酬劳。

messages.en: I promise.
messages.zh: 我答应你。

messages.en:
Ok, just promise you won't laugh. You see, before I came here I was a computer programmer. I specialized in creating and maintaining artificial intelligence for Kaalakiota, probes and drones and that sort of stuff. Well after I got here, I realized I needed some heavy duty protection considering the relative lawlessness of this place, and the mercs here were just way too expensive.

So I used my expertise to set up a self-maintaining drone facility, which provided me with enough backup to safely harvest the gas fields around here. It worked like a charm to begin with ... until hardware failure wiped out the secret password I've been using to access the mother-drone computer's mainframe.

Now I can't even get into my own home! I've been sitting around here for days but none of these good-for-nothing mercs have the guts to face my drones. Maybe you've got it in you?

Anyway first I want my stash of extracted gas chemicals. You'll find a few containers full of it in my storage facility. I'll give you the coordinates, all you have to do is warp there, take out the drones guarding the stash, loot it, and bring it back here.
messages.zh: 好吧，不过你不许笑。呃，我到这儿来之前是个计算机程序员。我专门负责为卡拉吉塔集团研发创造并维护人工智能，也就是探针、无人机之类的东西。在我到这之后，我意识到我需要强有力的保护，因为这地方相对来说有些无法无天，而本地雇佣兵的佣金又太贵……<br><br>所以我利用自己的专长，建造了一个可以自我维护的无人机设施，当我在四周采集气云的时候它为我提供了足够的保护。刚开始它效果显著……直到一次硬件故障清除了用来访问母体主机的密码。<br><br>现在我连自己的家都进不去了！我已经在这里傻坐了好多天了，可是这些一无是处的雇佣兵没有一个敢去面对我的无人机。也许你有这个胆量？<br><br>无论如何，首先我要弄到我储藏的气云化学提取物。你会在我的存储设施里找到满满的好几罐。我会把坐标上传给你，你只要跃迁到那里，解决掉守卫的无人机后把东西带回来给我。

messages.en: You look frustrated.  What's up?
messages.zh: 你看上去很沮丧。出什么事了？

messages.en:

I specialized in creating and maintaining artificial intelligence for Kaalakiota, probes and drones and that sort of stuff. messages.en: I brought back the stash.  Some advice though, carry a backup of that damn password!
messages.zh: 我带回了储藏箱。不过给你个建议，带好该死的密码备份！

messages.en:
Hey! Don't tell me what to do! If I didn't have another job for you, I'd keep the reward for myself. Learn some manners!

Besides, you have no idea how much CPU a complex password like that takes. Hacker-proof passwords are no laughing matter these days.
messages.zh:
嘿！不要教我怎么做！要不是我还有别的任务给你，那么我就自己留着那份酬金。学学讲礼貌！

此外，你根本不知道破解这样一个复杂的密码要耗用多少CPU。现在的反黑客密码可不是闹着玩的。

messages.en: You're observation is correct, I AM frustrated!  And it's rather embarrassing to tell you the truth ... but if you're a merc for hire then I'll spill the beans, as long as you promise to help me.
messages.zh: 你的观察很准确，我确实很丧气！要把事实说出来很不好意思……但如果你是我要用的雇佣兵，那么我会讲给你听，只要你答应帮我。

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: Don't come back until the Drone Creation Compound has been destroyed, that's where the drone mother-computer is stored.
messages.zh: 摧毁无人机生产设施之后再回来，无人机母体计算机就在设施内部。

messages.en: You said you had another mission.
messages.zh: 你刚才提到还有个任务？

messages.en: Yes, that is correct. I need you to clean up the mess I left behind, before things spiral out of control. I don't want to have any civilian deaths on my hands. To do this, the drone mother-computer must be taken care of. It is located near the place I just sent you. I have opened the acceleration gate leading into an adjacent deadspace pocket, which is where you'll find the target. Destroy it and return to me.
messages.zh: 是，没错。我要你在事情还没有引起有关当局注意之前把它了结了。我可不想背上过失致死罪的恶名。因此，你需要摧毁母体计算机。就在我刚给你的位置附近。我打开了通往临近死亡空间层的加速轨道，你的目标就在那里。摧毁它，然后回来向我报告。

messages.en: Not bad, not bad.  You'll do quite nicely here, {[character]player.name}, I know there's a bunch of people looking for someone of your caliber.  Take care.
messages.zh: 干得不坏，干得不坏。你在这里会很有前途，{[character]player.name}。我知道有很多人在找像你这么能干的人呢。保重。

messages.en: Yes, that is correct. I need you to clean up the mess I left behind, before things spiral out of control. I don't want to have any civilian deaths on my hands. To do this, the drone mother-computer must be taken care of. It is located near the place I just sent you. I have opened the acceleration gate leading into an adjacent deadspace pocket, which is where you'll find the target. Destroy it and return to me.
messages.zh: 是的，没错。我需要你在事态发展到无法控制之前，为我收拾残局。我可不想手上有几条人命。因此，这台无人机母体计算机必须被摧毁。它就在我刚派你前去的地方的附近。我打开了通往一个临近死亡空间层的加速轨道，你的目标就在那里。摧毁它，然后回来找我。

messages.en: I'll take the job.
messages.zh: 我接受这份工作。

messages.en: Just a word of advice before you leave, they will arrive at the rendezvous point in waves, so I suggest shooting them with all you got to prevent them from overwhelming you.
messages.zh: 在你离开之前还有一句忠告。他们会分批到达集合点，建议你抓紧时间消灭他们，不然你会被铺天盖地的舰只淹没。

messages.en: I'm looking for some work, you got any?
messages.zh: 我在找工作，你有适合的么？

messages.en:
Have I got any? Are you mad? I've been sitting here all day looking for contractors with some combat experience. Now I need someone I can rely on for this job, and I have to say I'm impressed with the way you've dealt with some of your previous assignments for Caldari agents. So maybe you're cut out for this ...

Anyway, I've been informed that a few gangs of Guristas scoundrels have decided to attempt a full scale assault on our little town here. Inside sources tell me that they are not working for the core Guristas leadership in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, so they won't be as deadly and organized as I first feared. But they're still a major threat, and as such I need someone to take care of 'em. If you can do the job, in other words take 'em out before they reach Pioneer's Sanctuary, then I'll reward you generously.

It so happens that I know where one of their stopping points will be, I will give you the coordinates of course.
messages.zh: 我是不是有胆？你是不是疯了？我整天坐在这里，寻找拥有战斗经验的飞行员当合同工。现在我要找个可以信赖的人来做这个工作，而且不得不承认，你之前为加达里代理人所做任务中的办事手段令人印象深刻。所以也许你正适合这份工作……<br><br>言归正传，我得到消息说一小撮古斯塔斯暴徒计划对我们的小镇发动一场全面进攻。据内线消息，他们不是为{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的古斯塔斯核心领导层工作的，所以他们不会像我最开始想像的那样致命和组织有序。但是他们仍然是个严重的威胁，所以我需要有人料理他们。如果你能做这个活，换句话说，能在他们到达先驱者之家前除掉他们，我会给你丰厚的奖赏。<br><br>我刚好知道他们一个停靠点的位置，当然，我会把坐标给你。

messages.en: Excellent work!  You saved us from a nasty encounter, and for that I thank you.  But there's more, so stick around.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！你救了我们，我非常感激你。不过还有些事，所以别走远。

messages.en:
Have I got any? Are you mad? I've been sitting here all day looking for contractors with some combat experience. Now I need someone I can rely on for this job, and I have to say I'm impressed with the way you've dealt with some of your previous assignments for Caldari agents. So maybe you're cut out for this ...

Anyway, I've been informed that a few gangs of Guristas scoundrels have decided to attempt a full scale assault on our little town here. Inside sources tell me that they are not working for the core Guristas leadership in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, so they won't be as deadly and organized as I first feared. But they're still a major threat, and as such I need someone to take care of 'em. If you can do the job, in other words take 'em out before they reach Pioneer's Sanctuary, then I'll reward you generously.

It so happens that I know where one of their stopping points will be, I will give you the coordinates of course.
messages.zh: 我是不是有胆？你是不是疯了？我整天坐在这里，寻找拥有战斗经验的飞行员当合同工。现在我要找个可以信赖的人来做这个工作，而且不得不承认，你之前为加达里代理人所做任务中的办事手段令人印象深刻。所以也许你正适合这份工作……<br><br>言归正传，我得到消息说一小撮古斯塔斯暴徒计划对我们的小镇发动一场全面进攻。据内线消息，他们不是为{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的古斯塔斯核心领导层工作的，所以他们不会像我最开始想像的那样致命和组织有序。但是他们仍然是个严重的威胁，所以我需要有人料理他们。如果你能做这个活，换句话说，能在他们到达先驱者之家前除掉他们，我会给你丰厚的奖赏。<br><br>我刚好知道他们一个停靠点的位置，当然，我会把坐标给你。

messages.en: No problem.
messages.zh: 没问题。

messages.en: Make them suffer.
messages.zh: 让他们尝尝痛苦的滋味！

messages.en: You mentioned you had some more work for me.
messages.zh: 你说还有事情要我做？

messages.en: Now I'd like you to target a Guristas Relay Station in ZH3-BS which has been transmitting orders to dozens of pirate gangs in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}.  They're the top dogs in this system, and get their information directly from the Guristas high command.  By taking them out we will be dealing a serious blow to their plans.  I will give you the coordinates, of course.
messages.zh: 你的下一个目标是ZH3-BS的古斯塔斯中继站。这个空间站负责向{[location]agentConstellationID.name}内数十个海盗团伙传输命令。他们都是这个星系中的首领人物，直接接收古斯塔斯最高指挥部发出的信息。如果除掉他们，我们就能重创他们的计划。当然，我会给你坐标。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  You've just given us hope that we might actually win after all!
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。你给了我们胜利的希望！

messages.en: Now I'd like you to target a Guristas Relay Station in ZH3-BS which has been transmitting orders to dozens of pirate gangs in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}.  They're the top dogs in this system, and get their information directly from the Guristas high command.  By taking them out we will be dealing a serious blow to their plans.  I will give you the coordinates, of course.
messages.zh: 你的下一个目标是ZH3-BS的古斯塔斯中继站。这个空间站负责转发指令，指挥{[location]agentConstellationID.name}内的海盗行动。他们是古斯塔斯在星系里的最高权威。如果能摧毁中继站，对星系内的海盗行为将是一场沉重的打击。我会把位标传给你。

messages.en: I'm looking for work, you got any?
messages.zh: 天上地下宇宙第一神勇飞行员正在找工作，有什么要我帮忙的么？

messages.en: I'm in a bit of a dilemma at the moment.  I managed to find an area of deadspace filled with lucrative gas clouds, but as always there was a catch.  The Guristas had apparently erected an outpost next to an acceleration gate leading directly into the deadspace pocket containing the clouds.  I haven't detected any signs of them actually harvesting the gas, but I dare not try to enter the area with them nearby.  Could you please remove their presence for me?
messages.zh: 我现在感觉有点进退两难。我在一个死亡空间里找到了矿藏非常丰富的气云，但和往常一样总是有事情在中间作梗。古斯塔斯在这个复合体里建立了一个哨站，正好就建在通向有气云的空间地带的加速轨道旁。我没有发现任何他们在开采气云的迹象，但有他们在我不敢尝试进入那里。你能帮我一个忙，让他们从那里消失么？

messages.en: The pirates are gone?  I'll have to take a look myself.
messages.zh: 海盗消失了？我得亲自去看看。

messages.en: I'm in a bit of a dilemma at the moment.  I managed to find an area of deadspace filled with lucrative gas clouds, but as always there was a catch.  The Guristas had apparently erected an outpost next to an acceleration gate leading directly into the deadspace pocket containing the clouds.  I haven't detected any signs of them actually harvesting the gas, but I dare not try to enter the area with them nearby.  Could you please remove their presence for me?
messages.zh: 我现在的处境有些为难。我在一个死亡空间中找到了矿藏丰富的气云，但和往常一样总是会遇到些麻烦。古斯塔斯显然已在一条加速轨道旁建了个哨站，这条轨道直接通向那片气云所在的死亡空间层。我没有发觉任何他们正在开采气云的迹象，但是只要他们在附近，我就不敢进入那个区域。你能为我除掉他们吗？

messages.en: Anything else I can do for you?
messages.zh: 有什么事情可以为你效劳么？

messages.en: Hmmm, yes there is one more thing.  I have a long range scanner in I1-BE8 which I use to look for promising sites which may harbor harvestable gas clouds.  The problem is I'm afraid of going back there and retrieving the data, the last time I tried I noticed a couple pirates nearby who I thought might be waiting in ambush.  Anyway I don't want to take any chances, but if you're willing then I'll pay you for getting me the data.
messages.zh: 恩，是的。还有一件事情可以让你帮我。我在I1-BE8部署了远距离扫描设备用以探测可能存在可供开采的高富矿气云。现在的问题是我有点害怕回去那里回首读取的数据，上一次过去的时候看到附近有两只海盗的舰船很有可能是准备伏击我的。无论怎样我不想拿我的生命去冒险，但是你要是愿意帮我获取这些数据的话，我可以给你一笔报酬。

messages.en: Thanks for retrieving the data, {[character]player.name}.  Hopefully this data will lead me to gas clouds far away from those pesky pirates.
messages.zh: 很感谢你帮我拿到这些数据，{[character]player.name}。希望这些信息能帮助我找到那些远离海盗的高产气云。

messages.en: Hmmm, yes there is one more thing.  I have a long range scanner in I1-BE8 which I use to look for promising sites which may harbor harvestable gas clouds.  The problem is I'm afraid of going back there and retrieving the data, the last time I tried I noticed a couple pirates nearby who I thought might be waiting in ambush.  Anyway I don't want to take any chances, but if you're willing then I'll pay you for getting me the data.
messages.zh: 恩，是的。还有一件事情可以让你帮我。我在I1-BE8部署了远距离扫描设备用以探测可能存在可供开采的高富矿气云。现在的问题是我有点害怕回去那里回首读取的数据，上一次过去的时候看到附近有两只海盗的舰船很有可能是准备伏击我的。无论怎样我不想拿我的生命去冒险，但是你要是愿意帮我获取这些数据的话，我可以给你一笔报酬。

messages.en: You're the mayor of Pioneer's Sanctuary, aren't you {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: 你是先驱者之家的镇长么，{[character]agentID.name}？

messages.en:
Your observation is correct. And I've been watching you, {[character]player.name}, for a while now, and you seem to fit the criteria I've been looking for.

Now I have a task for you that may prove to be extremely dangerous. As you probably know already we've had a long standing quarrel with the Guristas forces in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. And it's really showing a toll on the settlers here. But I want to propose a truce, and I want you to be the one that brings them the offer. I will supply you a bookmark to the Guristas Headquarters in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, all you have to do is warp in there and bring it to their leaders.
messages.zh:
你的观察非常正确。我已经关注你好一段时间了，{[character]player.name}，而且你看起来符合我要找的人的标准。

我现在有一个可能极其危险的任务交给你。你可能也知道，我们和{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的古斯塔斯部队有着很深的宿怨。而且这严重损害了当地定居者的生活。但是现在我希望停战，我要你去把这个提议转达给他们。我会给你{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内的古斯塔斯总部位标，你要做的就是跃迁至那里然后把信息传达给他们的领导就行了。

messages.en: It's as I expected, they won't listen to reason.  Then I guess it's time for us to face the cold hard facts, the town must be abandoned.  Unless someone is brave enough to stand up to those scoundrels and teach them a lesson ...
messages.zh: 如我所料，他们不听解释。那么我想我们是时候面对残酷的事实了，必须废弃小镇。除非有人能勇敢地抵抗那些恶棍，给他们个教训……

messages.en:
Your observation is correct. And I've been watching you, {[character]player.name}, for a while now, and you seem to fit the criteria I've been looking for.

Now I have a task for you that may prove to be extremely dangerous. As you probably know already we've had a long standing quarrel with the Guristas forces in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. And it's really showing a toll on the settlers here. But I want to propose a truce, and I want you to be the one that brings them the offer. I will supply you a bookmark to the Guristas Headquarters in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, all you have to do is warp in there and bring it to their leaders.
messages.zh:
你的观察非常正确。我已经关注你好一段时间了，{[character]player.name}，而且你看起来符合我要找的人的标准。

我现在有一个可能极其危险的任务交给你。你可能也知道，我们和{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的古斯塔斯部队有着很深的宿怨。而且这严重损害了当地定居者的生活。但是现在我希望停战，我要你去把这个提议转达给他们。我会给你{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内的古斯塔斯总部位标，你要做的就是跃迁至那里然后把信息传达给他们的领导就行了。

messages.en: I will do it.  The Guristas will fall before me.
messages.zh: 好吧，我做。古斯塔斯根本不堪一击。

messages.en: I fear for your life, but on the other hand you are our only hope.  So I wish you good luck.
messages.zh: 我担心你的生命安全，但你也是我们唯一的希望。所以祝你好运。

messages.en: I'm willing to help you fight the Guristas
messages.zh: 我很愿意帮你解决这批古斯塔斯害虫。

messages.en:
Unfortunately there is only one way to truly stop the Guristas from enslaving us, at least temporarily. And that is to annihilate their high command in 1QH-0K. I know it sounds foolhardy and it probably is, but it's the only way ... if we don't strike them down at the root they will just keep on coming.

I'm probably getting way ahead of myself here, I really can't ask you to try something insane like assault their most powerful stronghold in the entire constellation. But if you do, I will give you a very nice reward for the insignia from their leader.
messages.zh:
不幸的是，只有一个办法可以真正阻止古斯塔斯奴役我们，至少暂时可以。那就是歼灭他们在1QH-0K的最高指挥部。我知道这听起来很鲁莽，可能确实如此，不过这是唯一的办法……如果我们不能击毁他们的老巢，那么他们只会没完没了。

我可能有些过分，我实在不该让你去做袭击他们整个星座中最强大的要塞这种疯狂的事情。不过如果你愿意做，而且取得他们首领的勋章，我会给你一笔可观的报酬。

messages.en: The Guristas high command in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} is no more.
messages.zh: {[location]agentConstellationID.name}的古斯塔斯指挥官已经死了。

messages.en: You have managed the impossible once again, {[character]player.name}.  But this time you surprised even myself.  Pioneer's Sanctuary owes you a great debt which can never be repaid in full.  But hopefully your reward will at least repay your expenses.  Good luck in whatever the future holds for you.
messages.zh: 你又一次完成了不可能的任务，{[character]player.name}。这次连我都大吃一惊。先驱者之家永远都欠你一份情。不过希望这份酬金能够至少弥补你的花销。愿你的未来永远幸运。

messages.en:
You are, huh. Unfortunately there is only one way to truly stop the Guristas from enslaving us, at least temporarily. And that is to annihilate their high command in 1QH-0K. I know it sounds foolhardy and it probably is, but it's the only way ... if we don't strike them down at the root they will just keep on coming.

I'm probably getting way ahead of myself here, I really can't ask you to try something insane like assault their most powerful stronghold in the entire constellation. But if you do, I will give you a very nice reward for the insignia from their leader.
messages.zh:
你很愿意，是吧。不幸的是，只有一个办法可以真正阻止古斯塔斯奴役我们，至少暂时可以。那就是歼灭他们在1QH-0K的最高指挥部。我知道这听起来很鲁莽，可能确实如此，不过这是唯一的办法……如果我们不能击毁他们的老巢，那么他们只会没完没了。

我可能有些过分，我实在不该让你去做袭击他们整个星座中最强大的要塞这种疯狂的事情。不过如果你愿意做，而且取得他们首领的勋章，我会给你一笔可观的报酬。

messages.en: I'm lookin' for some work. You got any?
messages.zh: 我想找个活干。你有工作吗？

messages.en: I need someone to investigate a distress signal from an industrial registered to a group of harvesters in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I'd like you to fly them back here to safety, and we'll fetch the industrial later.
messages.zh: 我需要一个人去调查从{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发出的一个遇难信号。我要你飞去把他们带回安全地点，至于那艘工业舰我们稍后再去把它弄回来。

messages.en: The job is done, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 任务已完成，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: From your report, I can only assume that the hapless harvester expedition was beset by Sansha pirates and murdered; the distress signal must have been sent by the enemy to lure us in. Clever, I suppose, but I feel bad for the harvesters' families. They were simple, hard-working men and women, and they'll be missed here in Fatimar.
messages.zh: 从你的报告中看，我只能认为那些不幸的采集者远征队遭到了萨沙海盗的包围并已经遇害；现在的这个求救信号一定是敌人用来引诱我们上当的。我看他们很聪明，不过我为那些采集者的家人感到难过。他们是勤劳质朴的大众，他们会被法提马尔的人们永远怀念的。

messages.en: Sure, {[character]player.name}. Something up your alley just hit my desk this morning, in fact. I need someone to investigate a distress signal in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It was sent from an industrial registered to a group of harvesters that recently came to Fatimar Outpost from Amarr space. It's probably just an engine failure or something, but I don't have spare mechanics to deal with that problem just now. So I'd like you to fly them back here to safety, and we'll fetch the industrial later.
messages.zh: 当然，{[character]player.name}。事实上，今天早上我刚接到一项任务，应该会合你的胃口。我需要一个人去调查从{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发出的一个求救信号。信号是从一艘工业舰上发出的，那艘舰船属于一队从艾玛空间来到法提马尔哨站的采集者。他们可能遇到了一些引擎故障或是类似问题，但目前我没有空闲的技工去解决问题。所以我想让你把他们接到我们这个安全的地方，稍后我们再取回工业舰。

messages.en: So what's next? You seem like you have something on your mind.
messages.zh: 那么接下来呢？似乎你心里已经有了想法。

messages.en: Deliver the bad news to the slain workers' colleagues. They reside in a small outpost in a nearby system; I'll upload the coordinates directly into your NeoCom. As usual, all you have to do is fly close to the outpost structure and the message should automatically be uploaded into their communications database.
messages.zh: 把坏消息传递给遇害工人的同事们。他们住在附近星系的一个小哨站内；我会把坐标直接上传到你的控制边栏里。像往常一样，你所要做的只是飞到靠近哨站的地方，消息就会自动上传到他们的通信数据库中。

messages.en: I guess my work here is done.
messages.zh: 任务已完成。

messages.en: Yes, thanks for the help, {[character]player.name}. Wish I could find more for you to do right now, but most of the jobs around here are beneath a capsuleer like you.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，感谢你的帮忙。希望我还能找到任务交给你，不过看起来这里的任务对你来说都太容易了。

messages.en: Your an observant one, {[character]player.name}. You'll go far, I imagine. Now that we know of the harvester's fate, it's time to deliver the bad news to their colleagues. They reside in a small outpost in a nearby system; I'll upload the coordinates directly into your NeoCom. As usual, all you have to do is fly close to the outpost structure and the message should automatically be uploaded into their communications database.
messages.zh: 你是个敏锐的人，{[character]player.name}。我想你会前途无量的。既然我们知道了采集者的不幸遭遇，那么现在是时候把坏消息传递给他们的同事了。他们住在附近星系的一个小哨站内；我会把坐标直接上传到你的控制边栏里。像往常一样，你所要做的只是飞到靠近哨站的地方，消息就会自动上传到他们的通信数据库中。

messages.en: You need any help?
messages.zh: 有什么能帮忙的吗？

messages.en:
Yes I do. I'm the leader of a small gang of harvesters, and I'd like to hire you to clear a rogue drone infestation near a gas field we've been working on. They have been continually harassing us, and it's come to a point where my gangmates have refused to venture back there. Armed escort would cost a fortune over a long period, so we believe the most cost effective approach is simply eradicating the threat all-together.

Your first mission is to clear the area of rogue drones. Once that is done then report back to me immediately.
messages.zh:
是的，我确实有事需要你帮忙。我是一支小型采集队的首领，我想雇你消灭在我们工作的气云矿旁大批出没的自由无人机。他们不断骚扰我们，现在已经到了我的队员拒绝冒险回去工作的紧急地步。长期雇佣武装护卫队会造成很高的成本，所以我们认为最具成本效益的方法是彻底根除全部威胁。

你的第一个任务是清除这个地区的自由无人机。任务完成后，立刻回来向我报告。

messages.en: Excellent.  But there's one more thing to be done to completely end our drone problem.
messages.zh: 很好。不过还差一件事我们才能彻底终结无人机问题。

messages.en:
Yes I do. I'm the leader of a small gang of harvesters, and I'd like to hire you to clear a rogue drone infestation near a gas field we've been working on. They have been continually harassing us, and it's come to a point where my gangmates have refused to venture back there. Armed escort would cost a fortune over a long period, so we believe the most cost effective approach is simply eradicating the threat all-together.

Your first mission is to clear the area of rogue drones. Once that is done then report back to me immediately.
messages.zh:
是的，我确实有事需要你帮忙。我是一支小型采集队的首领，我想雇你消灭在我们工作的气云矿旁大批出没的自由无人机。他们不断骚扰我们，现在已经到了我的队员拒绝冒险回去工作的紧急地步。长期雇佣武装护卫队会造成很高的成本，所以我们认为最具成本效益的方法是彻底根除全部威胁。

你的第一个任务是清除这个地区的自由无人机。任务完成后，立刻回来向我报告。

messages.en: What's next?
messages.zh: 下一步呢？

messages.en: Now it's time to strike at the root of the problem, the Drone Hive.  The drones are manufactured there, so as along as it's around they will just keep coming.  Destroy it and report to me for your reward.
messages.zh: 现在是解决问题根源的时候了，那就是无人机母巢。无人机是在那里生产出来的，所以只要它在附近，那么无人机就会不断前来。摧毁它，然后回来向我报告并领取报酬。

messages.en: You've done us a great service, {[character]player.name}.  I'll notify my crew immediately, they'll be ecstatic.  Take care.
messages.zh: 你帮了我们一个大忙，{[character]player.name}。我会立刻通知手下，他们会欣喜若狂的。保重。

messages.en: Now it's time to strike at the root of the problem, the Drone Hive.  The drones are manufactured there, so as along as it's around they will just keep coming.  Destroy it and report to me for your reward.
messages.zh: 是时候根治这群无人机了。这次你的目标是机巢，无人机自我组装生产的地方。摧毁它然后向我报告。

messages.en: Yes, sir! Whatever you command!
messages.zh: 是的，长官！一切听从吩咐！

messages.en:
That's more like it.

Your task is simple. There is a stargate in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} that I had built recently, to transport my troops secretly past the Sansha louts. Somehow, though, one of my incompetent commanders managed to reveal himself ... and the stargate ... to a Sansha patrol. Now they're all over it, probably scavenging the place for spare parts.

I want you to destroy it. Completely. Don't even leave the debris behind. There is data in the computer systems inside the stargate that might reveal the location of all our positions to the Sansha, including Fatimar Outpost. This data must not fall into the hands of the enemy.

Dismissed.
messages.zh:
那就差不多了。

你的任务很简单。我最近在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}建造了一座星门，用来秘密运送我们的军队穿过萨沙蠢货的地方。可是不知怎么搞的，我的一个无能的指挥官将自己……和星门……暴露给了一支萨沙巡逻队。现在他们已经占领了星门，很可能正在搜刮星门上的部件。

我要你摧毁这座星门。彻底摧毁。连碎片都不要留。星门电脑系统中的数据可能会把我们所有据点的位置，包括法提马尔哨站，都泄露给萨沙。这份数据绝不能落入敌人手中。

完毕。

messages.en: Who are you, if I may ask?
messages.zh: 如果可以的话请告诉我，你是谁？

Your task is simple. There is a stargate in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} that I had built recently, to transport my troops secretly past the Sansha louts. Somehow, though, one of my incompetent commanders managed to reveal himself ... and the stargate ... to a Sansha patrol. Now they're all over it, probably scavenging the place for spare parts.

I want you to destroy it. Completely. Don't even leave the debris behind. There is data in the computer systems inside the stargate that might reveal the location of all our positions to the Sansha, including Fatimar Outpost. This data must not fall into the hands of the enemy.

我要你摧毁这座星门。彻底摧毁。连碎片都不要留。星门电脑系统中的数据可能会把我们所有据点的位置，包括法提马尔哨站，都泄露给萨沙。这份数据绝不能落入敌人手中。

messages.en: I see you've done my bidding in a timely manner.  Maybe after all this is over I'll hire you as my wine steward.
messages.zh: 看来你很快就完成了我的命令。也许在这一切都结束以后，我会雇你做我的酒窖管理员。

messages.en: How dare you speak to me like that, you whey-faced monkey! Out here, you're a nobody, just like me, so sit down and mind your manners ― before I give you something to curse about... Stupid windbag.
messages.zh: 你竟敢那样跟我说话，你这乳臭未干的毛猴子！出了这里，你什么都不是，就跟我一样。所以，你给我坐下，注意你的礼仪——否则我会叫你后悔的……愚蠢的饶舌头。

messages.en: You... you, you worthless, impudent fool! If I wasn't so busy looking for servants to do my bidding, I'd strike you down right now! Get out of my sight, worm!
messages.zh: 你……你这一文不值、放肆无礼的傻瓜！如果我不是忙着要找对我惟命是从的奴才，我现在就把你打趴下！立刻从我眼前消失，臭虫！

messages.en:
Who am I? WHO AM I? I am Kushan Horeat, Baron of Dagamar. I came here with my forces when Nimpor requested my assistance. And perhaps you are curious as to why a prestigious Imperial lord would waste his time answering a peon like yourself...?

The answer is that I need a little help. I have a dangerous mission that needs doing, and I would rather not risk my own men if possible. So, on behalf of the Amarr Empire, I desire you to help me.
messages.zh:
我是谁？你问我是谁？我是达加玛男爵库沙恩·霍瑞特。奈泊尔请求我的协助，我就带着我的部队赶来了。也许你会感到困惑，为什么一个享有声望的皇家统治者会在一个你这样苦工身上浪费时间呢……？

答案是，我需要一点小小的帮助。我有个危险的任务要做，可是如果可能的话，我不愿让我的人去冒险。所以，我以艾玛帝国的名义，要求你的帮助。

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: Excellent, servant. Get to work, then, and be quick about it or I'll lower your reward.
messages.zh: 干得好，仆人。那么去干活儿吧，最好快点，否则我会扣你的酬金。

messages.en: Anything else?
messages.zh: 有别的什么事情么？

messages.en: Yes, there's one more thing I want done. Immediately, you understand? We've been preparing for a major assault against Sansha positions in 3GD6-8, but our intel of the system is very limited. I would like you to conduct a simple recon mission through a few deadspace pockets there that may contain Sansha activity. If you stumble upon a complex of theirs, then return to me immediately and give me the exact coordinates.
messages.zh: 是的，还有一件事有待完成。而且要立刻完成，你明白吗？我们一直在准备对3GD6-8的萨沙据点发动一场全面进攻，可是我们关于这个星系的情报非常有限。我要你执行一项简单的侦察任务，需要穿越几个死亡空间层，那些地方可能有萨沙的活动。如果你撞上了他们的某个复合体，那么马上回来找我，并告诉我那里的详细坐标。

messages.en: Now that wasn't so hard, was it? Perhaps you really aren't as stupid as you look. Maybe there's hope for you yet...
messages.zh: 事情没那么难，对吧？也许你并不像你看上去那么蠢。也许你还有希望……

messages.en: Sorry, but I don't have time for arrogant louts like yourself. Later, mouthpiece.
messages.zh: 对不起，我没有时间同你这样一个傲慢的蠢货打交道。再见，大嘴巴。

messages.en: How DARE you speak to me like that! I'll have your head on a platter! I'll, I'll ... why, I'll have your whole family thrown into slavery! I'll tear down your ship and build my vacation resort out of it! Just you wait and see!
messages.zh: 你竟敢那样跟我说话！我要把你的头砍下呈在水果盘里！我要，我要……我要把你全家都变成劳工！我要把你的船给拆了用来修我的游乐场！你就等着瞧吧！

messages.en: Yes, there's one more thing I want done. Immediately, you understand? We've been preparing for a major assault against Sansha positions in 3GD6-8, but our intel of the system is very limited. I would like you to conduct a simple recon mission through a few deadspace pockets there that may contain Sansha activity. If you stumble upon a complex of theirs, then return to me immediately and give me the exact coordinates.
messages.zh: 是的，还有一件事有待完成。而且要立刻完成，你明白吗？我们一直在准备对3GD6-8的萨沙据点发动一场全面进攻，可是我们关于这个星系的情报非常有限。我要你执行一项简单的侦察任务，需要穿越几个死亡空间层，那些地方可能有萨沙的活动。如果你撞上了他们的某个复合体，那么马上回来找我，并告诉我那里的详细坐标。

messages.en: I'll help you out.
messages.zh: 我愿意帮你。

messages.en: Really?  Thanks!  I'll reward you well for your effort.  What I need you to do first is warp to my asteroid field and take out the louts who stole it from me.  When that's done, we'll take care of the pesky Minmatar mining colony.
messages.zh: 真的？谢谢！你的努力将会换回我丰厚的酬劳。我首先要你做的是，跃迁到我的小行星矿除掉那些抢走它的恶棍。完成之后，我们再解决那个讨厌的米玛塔尔采矿殖民地。

messages.en: You look ... angry.  What's up?
messages.zh: 你看上去……生气了。出什么事了？

messages.en:
I'm not just angry, I'm bloody furious! I was just minding my own business in an asteroid field in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, when an extra group of miners show up. I ignore them and continue mining my roid. Then one of them jams me and threatens to blow my ship up if I don't leave. Talk about being rude! And to top it off, they're from a rival Minmatar mining colony in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}.

What I need you to do first is warp to my asteroid field and take out the louts who stole it from me. When that's done, we'll take care of the pesky Minmatar mining colony.
messages.zh:
我不止是生气，而是怒不可遏！当时我正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个小行星带忙自己的事，突然又来了一队矿工。我没理他们，继续采我的矿。接着，他们中的一个干扰了我的飞船，并威胁如果我不离开就炸掉它。太粗鲁了！最过分的是，他们都是{[location]agentConstellationID.name}与我们竞争的米玛塔尔采矿殖民地派来的。

我首先要你做的是，跃迁到我的小行星矿除掉那些抢走它的恶棍。完成之后，我们再解决那个讨厌的米玛塔尔采矿殖民地。

messages.en: I've taken care of the criminals.
messages.zh: 我已经解决了那些罪犯。

messages.en: Excellent.  Now we must strike fast against their colony, or I might have to worry about reprisal attacks when I get back to work on the asteroid field.
messages.zh: 很好。现在我们必须快速攻击他们的殖民地，否则等我回去小行星矿工作时，可能还得担心他们的报复性进攻。

messages.en: I'm not just angry, I'm bloody furious!  I was just minding my own business in an asteroid field in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, when an extra group of miners show up.  I ignore them and continue mining my roid.  Then one of them jams me and threatens to blow my ship up if I don't leave.  Talk about being rude!  And to top it off, they're from a rival Minmatar mining colony in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}.
messages.zh: 我不止是生气，而是怒不可遏！当时我正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个小行星带忙自己的事，突然又来了一队矿工。我没理他们，继续采我的矿。接着，他们中的一个干扰了我的飞船，并威胁如果我不离开就炸掉它。太粗鲁了！最过分的是，他们都是{[location]agentConstellationID.name}与我们竞争的米玛塔尔采矿殖民地派来的。

messages.en: I'm ready for the next mission.
messages.zh: 我已经准备好接受下一个任务。

messages.en:
Ok, now it's time to finish the job we started. The expedition you faced in your last mission hails from a colony in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and they'll probably not be happy when they find out what happened to their colleagues. I want you to completely obliterate their outpost and any ships nearby, that way I can safely venture back to the asteroid field without worrying about reprisal attacks. This will also rid Fatimar Outpost of a long standing competitor, so we'll effectively be killing two flies in one blow.

Good luck.
messages.zh:
好，是时候一劳永逸地解决问题。上次任务中的敌人来自{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的殖民地。我想得知同伴遇害的事情，他们一定不会高兴。索性把哨站和所有舰船统统毁灭吧，这样一来我就能安心进行我的采矿大业了。同时也为法提马尔哨站去除了一个有力的竞争对手。所谓一石二鸟，就是这个意思吧。

祝你好运！

messages.en: Awesome job.
messages.zh: 太出色了！

messages.en:
Ok, now it's time to finish the job we started. The expedition you faced in your last mission hails from a colony in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and they'll probably not be happy when they find out what happened to their colleagues. I want you to completely obliterate their outpost and any ships nearby, that way I can safely venture back to the asteroid field without worrying about reprisal attacks. This will also rid Fatimar Outpost of a long standing competitor, so we'll effectively be killing two flies in one blow.

Good luck.
messages.zh:
好，现在该给我们的工作画上一个句号了。你上次任务中面对的远征队来自于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个殖民地，那里的人在得知他们同事的遭遇后肯定会不高兴。我要你彻底摧毁他们的哨站和附近所有飞船，那样我就能安全地重返小行星带，而不用担心敌人的报复了。同时我们还为法提马尔哨站除去了一个长期竞争对手，真是一石二鸟。

祝你好运。

messages.en: I'm interested.  Keep going.
messages.zh: 我很感兴趣。继续。

messages.en:
I'll start from the beginning. I joined Frolo's crew many years ago, when I was a young lad, and served under him right up to his death. Those were some good times, and we made a fortune from harvesting gas clouds in this area and neighboring constellations. Dorim, Frolo's second son, also served under his father and we became the best of friends.

Now life here was simple, until Frolo died. He was a great man, a remarkable leader. The pioneers out here all looked up to him and followed the rules while he was around. But soon after his death that was about to change.

A few months after Frolo passed away, his firstborn, Jamur Fatimar, arrived in Fatimar Outpost. He had lived all his life with his mother in Amarr space, far away from the grueling life we have here in no-man's-land. Basically he was fed with a silver spoon his entire life, and that rubbed off on him.

As soon as he arrived he claimed ownership of the Outpost. We decided to play along with his little game, as neither I nor Dorim had any real ambition to take on the leadership role. But people quickly started to despise him. He was much harsher than Frolo ever was, and was very detached from the local miners and harvesters here who Frolo used to work along-side. He was a strict, traditional Amarrian ruler who had zero tolerance for any difference of opinion from his own. He implemented a hefty tax which was largely used to pay for his extravagant lifestyle. Needless to say, things got hairy around here. Some of pioneers split away from Fatimar Outpost and founded their own colonies elsewhere, and there were rumors of a rebellion.

When I saw everything that we had built virtually crumbling beneath us, I was forced to intervene. I claimed leadership over Fatimar Outpost. A power struggle ensued, which I eventually won. As you might expect, Jamur was not very fond of losing his title and decided to split away from us, forming his own colony elsewhere in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. But I've always had the impression that he was out for revenge, and therefore I've had his little colony under surveillance for quite some time. And that's what alerted me to an extremely worrying turn of events. Jamur had been in contact with someone from outside {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, who my sources tell me has promised to help him in 'his war with Fatimar Outpost'. I can't imagine what a bitter, power hungry man like Jamur would do to reclaim his title. I want you to find out for me. I will upload the coordinates of the meeting point into your NeoCom, all you have to do is warp there and disrupt the meeting. Bring this 'agent' to me for questioning.
messages.zh:
让我从头一一道来吧。很多年前，当我还是个小伙子时，我就加入了弗洛的船员队伍，一直在他手下工作到他去世为止。那是段美好时光，我们在这里和邻近的星座采集气云，发了笔财。弗洛的次子道瑞也为他爸爸工作，我们成了最好的朋友。

在弗洛去世之前，这里的生活一直很单纯。他是个伟大的人，一个非凡的领袖。这里的先驱采矿者都很尊敬他，并且在他在世时都很守规矩。但是他死后不久，一切就发生了变化。

弗洛过世后几个月，他的长子贾木尔•法提马尔来到了法提马尔哨站。他一直跟他的母亲生活在艾玛空间，与我们这个无人管辖区的艰苦生活相距遥远。基本上他是长在蜜罐里的，这严重影响了他的性格。

他一来就要求掌管哨站。我们决定顺着他的意思，配合他的小游戏，因为我和道瑞都没有野心去做这个首领。但是人们很快就对他不满了。他十分苛刻，跟弗洛完全不一样，而且他和当初弗洛曾经并肩工作过的矿工非常疏远。他是个严格、传统的艾玛管理者，绝不容许任何人有不同意见。他执行沉重的赋税政策，主要用以满足他奢侈的生活方式。不用说，形势变得险恶起来。一些先驱采矿者离开了法提马尔哨站并在别处建立了自己的殖民地，据说还有人密谋叛乱。

当我看到我们亲手建立的一切都在土崩瓦解时，我不得不干预进来。我要求掌管法玛提尔哨站。接着是权力竞争，最终我取得了胜利。你可以想像，贾木尔对丢了位子很不开心，并决定脱离我们，到{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的其他地方建立自己的殖民地。不过我一直觉得，他离开是为了复仇，因此我一直监视着他的小殖民地，已经好长一段时间了。正因为这样，我才觉察到了一个可能令形势发生逆转的状况。贾木尔与{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}外的某个人取得了联系，据我的内线称，那人已经承诺协助他打赢“他与法玛提尔哨站的战争”。我想象不出一个像贾木尔这样恶毒、权欲旺盛的人为了重夺他的位子会做出些什么。我希望你帮我找出答案。我会把他们见面地点的坐标上传到你的控制边栏，你要做的就是跃迁过去破坏这次会面。把这个“特工”带给我审问。

messages.en: I'm looking for work, you got any?
messages.zh: 天上地下宇宙第一神勇飞行员正在找工作，有什么要我帮忙的么？

I will upload the coordinates of the meeting point into your NeoCom, all you have to do is warp there and disrupt the meeting. Bring this 'agent' to me for questioning.
messages.zh:
让我从头一一道来吧。很多年前，当我还是个小伙子时，我就加入了弗洛的船员队伍，一直在他手下工作到他去世为止。那是段美好时光，我们在这里和邻近的星座采集气云，发了笔财。弗洛的次子道瑞也为他爸爸工作，我们成了最好的朋友。

在弗洛去世之前，这里的生活一直很单纯。他是个伟大的人，一个非凡的领袖。这里的先驱采矿者都很尊敬他，并且在他在世时都很守规矩。但是他死后不久，一切就发生了变化。

弗洛过世后几个月，他的长子贾木尔•法提马尔来到了法提马尔哨站。他一直跟他的母亲生活在艾玛空间，与我们这个无人管辖区的艰苦生活相距遥远。基本上他是长在蜜罐里的，这严重影响了他的性格。

他一来就要求掌管哨站。我们决定顺着他的意思，配合他的小游戏，因为我和道瑞都没有野心去做这个首领。但是人们很快就对他不满了。他十分苛刻，跟弗洛完全不一样，而且他和当初弗洛曾经并肩工作过的矿工非常疏远。他是个严格、传统的艾玛管理者，绝不容许任何人有不同意见。他执行沉重的赋税政策，主要用以满足他奢侈的生活方式。不用说，形势变得险恶起来。一些先驱采矿者离开了法提马尔哨站并在别处建立了自己的殖民地，据说还有人密谋叛乱。

当我看到我们亲手建立的一切都在土崩瓦解时，我不得不干预进来。我要求掌管法玛提尔哨站。接着是权力竞争，最终我取得了胜利。你可以想像，贾木尔对丢了位子很不开心，并决定脱离我们，到{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的其他地方建立自己的殖民地。不过我一直觉得，他离开是为了复仇，因此我一直监视着他的小殖民地，已经好长一段时间了。正因为这样，我才觉察到了一个可能令形势发生逆转的状况。贾木尔与{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}外的某个人取得了联系，据我的内线称，那人已经承诺协助他打赢“他与法玛提尔哨站的战争”。我想象不出一个像贾木尔这样恶毒、权欲旺盛的人为了重夺他的位子会做出些什么。我希望你帮我找出答案。我会把他们见面地点的坐标上传到你的控制边栏，你要做的就是跃迁过去破坏这次会面。把这个“特工”带给我审问。

messages.en: Jamur escaped?  Too bad, but at least you got someone.  I'll have them interrogated immediately.
messages.zh: 贾木尔跑了？太糟糕了，不过至少你抓到了一个人。我会立即让他们接收审问。

messages.en: Sounds too risky for me.  I'd rather do garbage hauling missions.  Wait ... what on earth am I doing in 0.0 space?!!
messages.zh: 这对我来说太危险了。我宁可做极端无聊的垃圾运输任务……等等……我到底在0.0空间干什么！！

messages.en:
You know who you're speaking to, right? I'll educate you regardless. I am {[character]agentID.name}, protector of Fatimar Outpost. Basically I run this place, and have ever since Frolo died.

Now I have a mission that would require you to be extremely meticulous and discreet. From looking at your accomplishments here in Fatimar Outpost you probably have what it takes to get it done. And oddly enough I trust you to keep a lid on this more than Kushan Horeat and his men.

If you're still interested, let me know.
messages.zh:
你知道在对谁说话，对吗？不管怎样，我得教育你。我是{[character]agentID.name}，是法提马尔哨站的保护者。基本上，自从弗洛死后，由我经营这个地方。

现在我有个任务，需要你极为小心谨慎才行。从你在法提马尔哨站取得的成就看来，你很可能具备完成它的能力。这简直太奇怪了，我居然相信你能守口如瓶，更胜过库沙恩•霍瑞特和他的人。

如果你还有兴趣，告诉我。

messages.en: He's as good as dead.
messages.zh: 死亡是他最好的归宿。

messages.en: You better be right.  We can't let him escape.
messages.zh: 你最好是对的。我们不能让他跑了。

messages.en: Are you done with the interrogation?
messages.zh: 审讯结束了么？

messages.en:
Yes, they coughed it up immediately. Apparently they aren't very loyal to their former master. The leader of the group has been in close contact with Jamur and claims he's gone mad. His hatred of me has clouded his judgment, and he's done the unthinkable. The secret agent in your previous mission was in fact an agent of the Sansha's Nation! Talk about striking a deal with the devil ... he's gone way too far this time.

The good news is that we can trace Jamur's exact whereabouts. The bug I had implanted into his ship is still functional, and I can see his location on our scanner. I want you to find him immediately and take him out. Every minute that passes is crucial, he must not be allowed to reveal our location to the Sansha's Nation. If that happens then all may be lost.
messages.zh:
是的，他们很快就吐出了实情。显然，他们对他们的前主子不是很忠诚。这个组织的首领与贾木尔交往甚密，他说贾木尔都疯了。他对我的仇恨混淆了他的判断力，导致他做出不可思议的事。你上次任务中的秘密特工实际上是萨沙共和国的特工！与魔鬼打交道……他这次做得太过份了。

好消息是我们可以追踪到贾木尔的确切位置。我在他飞船上安装的偷听器现在仍在运转，所以我可以在扫描仪上看到他的位置。我要你立刻找到他，把他干掉。每分钟都至关紧要，绝不能让他把我们的位置透露给萨沙共和国。如果这种情况发生了，那一切就都完了。

messages.en: Jamur is no more.
messages.zh: 贾木尔已经消失在这个宇宙中了。

messages.en: Amazing job, {[character]player.name}.  We owe you one.
messages.zh: 令人惊叹！{[character]player.name}，我欠你一份情。

messages.en:
Yes, they coughed it up immediately. Apparently they aren't very loyal to their former master. The leader of the group has been in close contact with Jamur and claims he's gone mad. His hatred of me has clouded his judgment, and he's done the unthinkable. The secret agent in your previous mission was in fact an agent of the Sansha's Nation! Talk about striking a deal with the devil ... he's gone way too far this time.

The good news is that we can trace Jamur's exact whereabouts. The bug I had implanted into his ship is still functional, and I can see his location on our scanner. I want you to find him immediately and take him out. Every minute that passes is crucial, he must not be allowed to reveal our location to the Sansha's Nation. If that happens then all may be lost.
messages.zh:
是的，他们很快就吐出了实情。显然，他们对他们的前主子不是很忠诚。这个组织的首领与贾木尔交往甚密，他说贾木尔都疯了。他对我的仇恨混淆了他的判断力，导致他做出不可思议的事。你上次任务中的秘密特工实际上是萨沙共和国的特工！与魔鬼打交道……他这次做得太过份了。

好消息是我们可以追踪到贾木尔的确切位置。我在他飞船上安装的偷听器现在仍在运转，所以我可以在扫描仪上看到他的位置。我要你立刻找到他，把他干掉。每分钟都至关紧要，绝不能让他把我们的位置透露给萨沙共和国。如果这种情况发生了，那一切就都完了。

messages.en: I want these elite troops delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for inspection. We hired them recently from an Amarrian security firm to work as guards on our transport vessels. Standard procedure requires that they be inspected for any possible diseases or mental disorders before they're allowed on board.
messages.zh: 我要把这些精英部队运送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}接受检查。我从某家艾玛保安公司雇用了这批人作为我们运输船上的守卫。根据标准程序，他们要在上船前接受检查，以防存在任何疾病或精神问题。

messages.en: I need you to help out. There is fierce fighting going on in a nearby system and we have marines here that need to be moved out there as soon as humanly possible. Are you willing to help our cause?
messages.zh: 我要你帮个忙。附近星系正在发生激烈火拼，我们需要把这儿的海军队员尽快转移出去。你愿意帮忙吗？

messages.en: I need you to help out. There is fierce fighting going on in a nearby system and we have militants here that need to be moved out there as soon as humanly possible. Are you willing to help our cause?
messages.zh: 我需要你的帮助。附近的星系正在进行一场激烈的战斗，我这儿有一批武装人员要以人力所及的最快速度运往那里。你愿意协助我们的事业吗？

messages.en: I want these elite troops delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for inspection. We hired them recently from an Amarrian security firm to work as guards on our transport vessels. Standard procedure requires that they be inspected for any possible diseases or mental disorders before they're allowed on board.
messages.zh: 我要把这些精英部队运送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}接受检查。我从某家艾玛保安公司雇用了这批人作为我们运输船上的守卫。根据标准程序，他们要在上船前接受检查，以防存在任何疾病或精神问题。

messages.en: I'm interested, I'm interested. No need to be hasty. Just give me the coordinates and the batteries, and I'm off.
messages.zh: 我有兴趣，很有兴趣。慢慢来，把位标和电池都给我，我马上动身。

messages.en: I'm uploading the coordinates to your NeoCom as we speak, and the batteries will be in your station hangar by the time you're ready to leave. Do be quick.
messages.zh: 我正在把位标上传到你的控制边栏中，电池等你准备就绪后便会放在空间站机库里。快动身吧。

messages.en: I might be, yeah. What's the deal?
messages.zh: 有点兴趣。拿你那点钱有什么条件？

messages.en: The {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} station manager has reported a lack of mono-cell batteries in their supply depot, a situation that could result in a temporary shutdown of the entire station. Deliver the batteries to them as quickly as possible.
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的空间站管理员最近向我们报告说他们的单电池严重稀缺，这事如果继续发展下去的话整个空间站就得暂时关闭了。请把电池尽快送到他们那里。

messages.en: Done. Batteries delivered, crisis averted. So, about my pay...?
messages.zh: 完成。电池送到，危机结束。那我的钱……？

messages.en: Yes, yes, already taken care of. Now, if you'll excuse me?
messages.zh: 好的，好的，我已经办好了。现在先给我点时间吧？

messages.en:
"The deal," as you so quaintly put it, my young friend, is this: The station manager of {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} recently reported to us a serious lack of mono-cell batteries in their supply depot, a situation that could result in a temporary shutdown of the entire station. We need to help them out, and I'd like you to deliver the necessary goods to them.

Simple enough, eh? Well, are you interested or not? I know of several others who would happily take this offer in your stead.
messages.zh:
小伙子，你这“条件”说得还真贴切，是这样：{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的空间站管理员最近向我们报告说他们的单电池严重稀缺，这事如果继续发展下去的话整个空间站就得暂时关闭了。我们要帮他们，我想要你把这些必需品运送给他们。

简单吧？有没有兴趣？我知道有几个和你地位差不多的人也愿意干这活。

messages.en: I'm interested, definitely. Just give me the coordinates and the batteries, and I'm off.
messages.zh: 我的确很有兴趣。把位标和电池都给我，我马上动身。

messages.en: I'm uploading the coordinates as we speak, and the batteries will be in your station hangar by the time you're ready to leave. My thanks.
messages.zh: 我正在把位标上传到你的控制边栏中，电池等你准备就绪后便会放在空间站机库里。谢谢你了。

messages.en: Always. What's the deal?
messages.zh: 当然。有什么条件？

messages.en: The {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} station manager has reported a lack of hydrogen batteries in their supply depot, a situation that could result in a temporary shutdown of the entire station. Deliver the batteries to them as quickly as possible.
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的空间站管理员最近向我们报告说他们的氢电池严重稀缺，这事如果继续发展下去的话整个空间站就得暂时关闭了。请把电池尽快送到他们那里。

messages.en: Batteries delivered, crisis averted. Thanks for the job. Easy money.
messages.zh: 完成。电池送到，危机结束。谢谢你给的这差事，这钱得来全不费功夫。

messages.en: My pleasure, {[character]player.name}, my pleasure. And my thanks.
messages.zh: 很荣幸，{[character]player.name}，我感到荣幸。谢谢。

messages.en:
Just this: The station manager of {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} has just reported to us a serious lack of hydrogen batteries in their supply depot, a situation that could result in a temporary shutdown of the entire station. We need to help them out, and I naturally thought of you to deliver the necessary goods to them — always give your friends a leg up, eh?

It's an easy job, and pays well. Just be sure you have enough space in your cargohold: This is a pretty big shipment.
messages.zh:
是这样：{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的空间站管理员最近向我们报告说他们的氢电池严重稀缺，这事如果继续发展下去的话整个空间站就得暂时关闭了。我们要帮他们，我自然就想到让你去把这些必需品送给他们——要拉朋友一把，对吧？

这事轻松，而且酬劳颇高。只要确保你货柜舱里有足够的空余空间就行：这批东西体积还蛮大的。

messages.en: An arms dealer passing through the system just sold us a cache of weapons. I need you to take it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for me. Don't worry, we've already acquired a permit for them, so you won't have any trouble at customs.
messages.zh: 一个路过此星系的军火商刚刚卖给我们一箱武器。我要你把它运往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。别担心，我们已经得到了许可，所以你在海关不会遇到任何麻烦。

messages.en: An arms dealer passing through the system just sold us a cache of weapons. I need you to take it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for me. Don't worry, we've already acquired a permit for them, so you won't have any trouble at customs.
messages.zh: 一个路过此星系的军火商刚刚卖给我们一箱武器。我要你把它运往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。别担心，我们已经得到了许可，所以你在海关不会遇到任何麻烦。

messages.en: We were ordered by high ranking officials in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} to deliver a batch of Zemnar to the inhabitants of {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Their supplies are low and they need some backup incase of a viral outbreak.
messages.zh: 在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} 的高级官员命令我们将一批泽姆纳尔送给居住在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的人们。由于当地药材供应短缺，需要一些储备以防病毒大肆传播。

messages.en: We were ordered by high ranking officials in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} to deliver a batch of Galeptos Medicine to the inhabitants of {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Viral outbreaks have been common in outlying settlements within {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and they need more drugs to combat the infections.
messages.zh: 在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} 的高级官员命令我们将一批家乐普托斯送给居住在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的人们。由于当地药材供应短缺，需要一些储备以防病毒大肆传播。

messages.en: A relative of mine in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} just requested a special order of genetically enhanced livestock. I'd like you to deliver them to him in person; he'll meet you on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. And keep a lid on this, will you? Some consumers, especially religious Amarrians, would boycott his wares if word got out he uses genetically enhanced animals.
messages.zh: 我的一个住在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的亲戚刚刚特别订购了一批基因改良家畜。我希望你亲自给他送去；他会在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}等你。这事一定要秘密进行，知道吗？一些消费者，尤其是虔诚信教的艾玛人，一旦知道他使用基因改良家畜，一定会联合抵制他的商品。

messages.en: A relative of mine in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} just requested a special order of genetically enhanced livestock. I'd like you to deliver them to him in person; he'll meet you on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. And keep a lid on this, will you? Some consumers, especially religious Amarrians, would boycott his wares if word got out he uses genetically enhanced animals.
messages.zh: 我的一个住在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的亲戚刚刚特别订购了一批基因改良家畜。我希望你亲自给他送去；他会在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}等你。这事一定要秘密进行，知道吗？一些消费者，尤其是虔诚信教的艾玛人，一旦知道他使用基因改良家畜，一定会联合抵制他的商品。

messages.en: A group of lads from {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} have been requested by {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} army to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  I've agreed to their request, and I'd like you to carry it out.  Deliver them to their destination, the faster the better.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}军队要求把{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的一批人调动到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。我已经批准了这一请求，希望由你来执行。把它们送到目的地，越快越好。

messages.en: A group of battle-hungry lads from {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} have been requested by officials within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} army to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  I've agreed to their request, and I'd like you to carry it out.  Deliver them to their destination, the faster the better.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}军队的官员要求把{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的一批渴望打仗的年轻人调动到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。我已经批准了这一请求，希望由你来执行。把它们送到目的地，越快越好。

messages.en: Our friends in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} are worried their oxygen supplies won't last until the next shipment from their supplier.  They've requested an extra batch, and we've promised to deliver.  You'll find the goods in your cargo hold if you agree to this task.
messages.zh: 我们在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的朋友担心他们的氧气储备无法维持到供应商的下一批货物到来了。他们另外定了一批，我们已经承诺送货。如果你同意接受任务，我会把那批货装进你的货柜舱。

messages.en: Our friends in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} are worried their oxygen supplies won't last until the next shipment from their supplier.  They've requested an extra batch, and we've promised to deliver.  You'll find the goods in your cargo hold if you agree to this task.
messages.zh: 我们在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的朋友担心他们的氧气储备无法维持到供应商的下一批货物到来了。他们另外定了一批，我们已经承诺送货。如果你同意接受任务，我会把那批货装进你的货柜舱。

messages.en: One of our transports flying through {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} broke down and requires immediate repairs.  We've agreed to send him the spare parts he needs to complete the operation, and I'd like you to deliver the goods.  If you're fast he might even make it on time, so don't tarry!
messages.zh: 我们的一艘运输船在飞过{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}时抛锚，需要紧急维修。我们答应给他送去维修所需的备件，希望你把东西送去。如果你够快，他甚至可能把东西准时送到，所以别在这磨蹭了！

messages.en: One of our transports flying through {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} broke down and requires immediate repairs.  We've agreed to send him the spare parts he needs to complete the operation, and I'd like you to deliver the goods.  If you're fast he might even make it on time, so don't tarry!
messages.zh: 我们的一艘运输船在飞过{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}时抛锚，需要紧急维修。我们答应给他送去维修所需的备件，希望你把东西送去。如果你够快，他甚至可能把东西准时送到，所以别在这磨蹭了！

messages.en: To eliminate the depressive mood of our hangar staff, cargo bay workers, janitors and other laborers we decided to throw them a party at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  I'd like you to do the honors of delivering the spiced wine to the gathering.  And don't forget, a quick delivery will get you a bonus!
messages.zh: 为了让机库工人、货柜舱工人、看门人和其他工人情绪好起来，我们决定为他们在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}组织一个派对。烦请你把香料汽水送过去。别忘了，速度够快就能得到额外奖励！

messages.en: To eliminate the depressive mood of our hangar staff, cargo bay workers, janitors and other laborers we decided to throw them a party at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  I'd like you to do the honors of delivering some of the personnel to the gathering.  And don't forget, a quick delivery will get you a bonus!
messages.zh: 为了让机库工人、货柜舱工人、看门人和其他工人情绪好起来，我决定在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}组织一个派对。烦请你把一些人员送过去。别忘了，速度够快就能得到额外奖励！

messages.en: A spate of engine failures and system crashes at a client firm in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} has forced them to come to us for more coolants.  We have some extras available, which I'd like you to deliver.  Get it done in time, before their manager suffers a nervous breakdown, to earn your bonus.
messages.zh: 在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的一个客户公司的引擎大面积故障导致系统崩溃，他们不得不向我们购买更多的冷却剂。我们正好有一些多余的，希望你能送过去。及时完成任务，以免他们的经理神经崩溃，然后你就能获得额外奖励。
