name.ja: 恵まれない子どもたち

messages.en: The local news recently aired a story on poor immigrants in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  Apparently some of the families have fallen on hard times and lack the funds to even buy the most basic necessities.  A few concerned citizens in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} asked me to have these clothes delivered to the needy in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, which they can make use of.  I'd like you to make the first leg of the trip, which is to drop off the goods at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Officials at the station will take care of the rest.
messages.zh: 当地新闻机构最近报道了一则关于在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的贫穷移民的故事。显然一些家庭遇到了一些困难，贫困到连最基本的生活必需品都买不起。{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的一些热心市民请求我把这些衣服送到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}里的困难人们手中。我希望你跑一趟，把这些东西送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。那里的官员会处理剩下的事。

Apparently some of the families have fallen on hard times and lack the funds to even buy the most basic necessities.  A few concerned citizens in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} asked me to have these polytextiles delivered to the needy in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, which they can make use of. messages.en: I've been ordered by the government to have these fertilizers delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, from where they'll be dispersed to nearby bio-domes.  Quite a mundane job but one that needs to be done.  Obviously I'd like you to do the honors of making the delivery, so here you go.
messages.zh: 政府命令我把这些肥料送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，之后它们会被分发到附近的生态模拟舱。一个非常平凡的任务，但也要有人完成。当然，我把运送的光荣使命交给你了，去吧。

messages.en: I've been ordered by the government to have these fertilizers delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, from where they'll be dispersed to nearby bio-domes. messages.en: Bio-engineers and farmers in nearby settlements, which have been supplying us with foodstuffs, have had good fortune recently.  Their supplies of frozen plant seeds are overflowing, and they would like to sell some of their excess products.  Obviously we took advantage of a good opportunity and bought the goods for silly prices, those people are so gullible.  I'd like you to deliver the goods to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where we've found a buyer.
messages.zh: 附近殖民地一直为我们提供食物，最近那里的生物工程师和农民交上了好运。由于冷冻植物种子的供应过剩，他们想要出售部分多余产品。我们当然利用了这个好机会，以极低的价格买到了这些东西，那些人真是好骗。我想让你把这些货送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，我们在那里有个买家。

messages.en: Miners stopping by {[location]agentStationID.name} for supplies is a common occurrence.  It so happens that a few of them left off in a hurry, and forgot a load of drill parts in the cargo bay.  Fortunately for them the containers were marked, which allowed us to trace the owners quickly enough.  When we contacted them they requested we send the parts to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, for a fee of course.  If you'll do the honors of transporting the goods, a part of that fee will be yours.
messages.zh: 矿工停在{[location]agentStationID.name}进行补给是常有的事。这次几个矿工离开太匆忙，把一堆钻机部件忘在了货柜舱。算他们运气，货柜上有他们的标记，我们这样才很快找到了失主。我们与他们取得联系后，他们请求我们把部件送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，当然他们会支付一笔费用。如果你能完成这项运送货物的光荣任务，那笔费用中的一部分就会是你的。

messages.en: Apparently some unruly locals got into trouble while visiting {[location]agentStationID.name}, and we've pressed charges.  The authorities requested we send footage from our security cameras to a specialist in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, to ascertain their authenticity.  Once he's gone through these holoreels, we'll hopefully be able to get this through court without a lengthy trial.
messages.zh: 一些不守规矩的当地居民在参观{[location]agentStationID.name}时惹了些麻烦，而我们已经提起诉讼。有关部门要求我们把监控录像送给{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的一个专家，以确认录像的真实性。一旦他检查完这些全息信息盘，我们应该就能直接获得法院的判决，而不用经过冗长的审判过程。

messages.en: A few colleagues of mine are on an assignment in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and requested a batch of transmitters which they need for a particular task.  I need them delivered there A.S.A.P.  You're up for the job, I presume?
messages.zh: 我有一些同事正在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}执行任务，需要一批传信器用于特殊作业。我需要它们被尽快送过去。我想你会做这份差事，对吧？

name.ja: 新しいハードウェアが必要
name.ru: Оборудование на замену (In Need of New Hardware)

messages.en: A friend is in need of some new hardware.  We have begun mining operations on a planet nearby, and our logistics officer thought it would be a brilliant idea to buy old Amarrian transport vehicles to save us some ISK.  Oh, well.  Looks like we bought the cat in the sack, as we used to say back home.  So now it's my responsibility to fix the situation so we can continue to get minerals for our building projects.  Take these planetary vehicles and bring them out there, so the lazy gits can get back to work.
messages.zh: 有个朋友需要一些新的硬件。我们已经在附近的一颗行星上开始采矿作业，我们的后勤官认为购买艾玛的二手运输工具可以节省一些钱。唉，得。似乎我们贪小便宜吃了大亏，就像我们老家说的。所以现在得我出来收拾局面，这样我们才能继续采集矿物用于我们的建设项目。把这些行星车辆送到那里，好让那些好吃懒做的家伙回去工作。

messages.en:
A convoy of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} ships stumbled upon a stash of viral agents in {[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name} while passing through the system. They dropped it off here so that a specialist can take a look at it and perhaps trace it to a particular individual or corporation. Now that they're done, I need you to take it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for further research.

Don't worry about getting busted by customs for transporting the viral agents: We've cleared the matter with them and they'll be expecting you.
messages.zh:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的一支护航队在穿过{[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}时，偶然发现了一批被藏匿的病原体。他们将病原体留在了这里以便让专家去研究，查出这批东西的源头。我现在要你把这批病原体带往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。

你不用担心那些病原体会被海关截下来，我们已经和他们打过了招呼，他们正等着你呢。

messages.en:
The security in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} has been getting worse and worse.  I'm telling you, those guys are in someone's pocket.  I have put in a formal request for their termination, but the powers above don't seem to be in agreement.  Which, of course, only reinforces my opinion that they are all corrupt.  Seeing as we can't throw them out of the nearest airlock, I'm going to do the next best thing

I'm sending you out there with a new security officer and some guards to back him up.  It's your responsibility to make sure they make it to the station safe.
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的安全状况越来越糟。我跟你说，那些家伙都有人罩着。我已经正式请求免除他们的职务，可是上头似乎跟我意见不一。这当然只会使我更加深信他们都是腐败分子。由于我们不能把他们从最近的空气阀门里扔出去，我只能退而求其次了。我要派你和一位新的安全官员以及协助他的守卫们一起去那里。你的职责是确保他们安全到达该空间站。

messages.en: Our cargo area and lower-tier decks are overflowing with vagabonds and tramps.  It has almost reached epidemic proportions.  These people simply refuse to leave, some are laid off workers of ours while others are simply outsiders who think they can come and live off our hospitality indefinitely.  Since there are strict regulations against sending them out the airlock for no reason, and since we can't simply frame every single one of them for a crime worthy of such a fate, we've no choice but to forcibly move them somewhere else.  Another station will do.  In fact I'd like you to move a heap-load of them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  I never liked those bastards over there anyway, let them deal with this 'human problem'.
messages.zh: 我们的货运区域和底层甲板到处都是流浪汉和游手好闲的人。几乎要到了泛滥的地步。这些人就是不走，其中一些是下岗工人，另一些则是外来人员，自以为一直可以赖在我们的屋檐下。由于法律严禁无故将他们扔出空气阀门，要给每个人安上莫须有的罪名又太麻烦，所以我们别无选择，只能强行把他们转移到别处。送到另一个空间站就行了。实际上我想让你把一大批这样的人送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。反正我向来讨厌那里的那些混蛋，就让他们去处理这个“人道问题”吧。

name.ru: Кто сгоняет за пивом? (Quelling the Temper)

messages.en: One of the local warlords is coming to this area.  We're going to be needing his assistance in the coming weeks, so to make sure we have his backing I'll need you to get me some spirits to make sure everything goes as smoothly as possible.
messages.zh: 一个当地军阀正赶往这里。在接下来的几个星期里，我们需要他的帮助，因此我希望你去弄一些幽灵饮料给我，以确保一切顺利进行。

messages.en: As you know, much of our business consists of gun running. I just made an accounting error which means that a shipment of our guns wasn't sent.  So, to keep the buyer happy, I'm gonna send you over his way with a sample of our high-quality slug throwers.  Hopefully this will buy me an extra day to get it sorted.
messages.zh: 正如你所知，我们的很多生意牵涉到军火。我的一个核算错误导致我们的一批枪械没有发出。因此，为了让买家心情愉快，我得派你送一份高质量的投弹器样本去他那里。这应该能为我多争取一天时间，能够把问题解决。

name.ja: インフルエンザの流行

messages.en: An old friend of mine runs a strip club in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Some strange flu seems to be striking his strippers pretty hard, so he's gonna be needing new girls.  I need you to take these ladies over to his station.  And if I find out any of them got pregnant along the way, you'll never work for me again.
messages.zh: 我的一个老朋友在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}开了家会所。他的很多舞女都染上了一种奇怪的流感，所以他需要找些新的小姐来顶替。我需要你把这些小姐带到他的空间站。如果我发现她们中有人在路上怀孕了，你永远都别想再为我工作了。

messages.en:
We've decided to do our agents in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} a favor. They've been complaining for quite some time of being overworked and underpaid, so we've decided to send them the perfect gift to soothe their nerves. A few packs of tobacco should do the trick, heh heh. It's at least something, until we come up with a better solution.

Deliver the batch to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and a local supplier will pick it up from there and deliver it to where they're staying.
messages.zh:
我们决定帮我们在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的代理人一个忙。他们已经因为过度工作和低廉报酬而抱怨很久了，所以我们决定送些好东西去安抚他们的情绪。几包烟草应该就能搞定他们，嘿嘿。至少在我们找到更好的办法之前，这些东西能够顶一顶。

把这一批烟草送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，当地的供应商会装运到那些代理人所在处。

messages.en: Well, once again the techies in the armament production department have screwed up and installed faulty guidance systems into the new batch of Widowmakers, so now our missiles are flying all over the place. This is not good for our reputation.  I'm sending you over there with new equipment so this can be solved, and fast.
messages.zh: 武器生产部门的技术人员又搞砸了，他们把有问题的引导系统装在一批新的“寡妇制造者”上，导致我们的导弹到处乱飞。这对我们的名声很不好。我要派你送新设备过去，这样才能最快地解决问题。

name.ru: Быть в курсе (Keeping Up to Date)

messages.en: We just got information relayed from a nearby listening post.  This info is way too valuable to be sent by local channels, so I'm making you responsible for this data.  Make sure it gets to the right location intact.
messages.zh: 我们接到附近一个监听哨站转发的信息。这些信息太宝贵了，不能通过本地频道发送，所以我要你负责这些数据。确保把信息安全送到指定地点。

messages.en: One of our station reactors is running under threat of melting down, so I'm sending you with some coolant to get the situation under hand. If the reactor goes haywire because you didn't make it in time, I will be very disappointed.
messages.zh: 我们的一个空间站反应堆正面临着融毁的危险，所以我要派你送些冷却剂过去控制局面。要是因为你没能及时送到而使反应堆失控，我会非常失望。

messages.en: I have some very important merchants here that need to be ferried to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so we can start securing a deal with them.  As you can understand, these people do not want to be known, so we are sending you to fly them around.  Make sure no passenger manifests of these persons are kept.  Thank you.
messages.zh: 我这里有些非常重要的商人，他们需要被送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这为了确保能和他们达成某项交易。你应该可以理解，这些人不想被认出来，所以我们派你去送他们。务必不要留下这些乘客的名单。谢谢。

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is in the middle of constructing an outpost in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Our engineers there claim to lack a few loads of construction blocks to finish the work, and I was asked to deliver some blocks to that station.

Could you please take the material straight to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}? Our people in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} will take care of retrieving them from your hangar there for the construction project.
messages.zh:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}正在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}建造一个哨站。我们的工程师声称缺少一些建筑材料，无法完成工作，他们叫我去给他们送材料。

你能帮我把那些材料送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}吗？我们在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的人会自己从你的机库中拿出那些东西然后用于哨站的建设。

messages.en: Once again we are out of food.  You'd think they would learn, and just eat a little less, but no.  The big bosses want me to fix this problem, so I'm delegating the task to you.  I want you to ferry these dairy products to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh: 我们又没有食物了。原本以为，他们会吸取教训，少吃一点，可他们偏不。大老板们要我去解决这个问题，而我把这个任务分派给你。我要你把这些乳制品送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。

messages.en: I need you to run over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and drop off these electronic parts. The Chief Technical Operator there contacted me regarding the discovery of a major defect in their primary reactor, and they don't have the parts on hand to repair it.
messages.zh: 我需要你把这些电子元件火速送往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。那里的技术主管联系我说主反应堆部件存在严重问题，而他们缺少修理所需的部件。

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is in the middle of constructing an outpost in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Our engineers there claim to lack a few loads of construction blocks to finish the work, and I was asked to deliver some blocks to that station.

Could you please take the material straight to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}? Our people in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} will take care of retrieving them from your hangar there for the construction project.
messages.zh:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}正在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}建造一个哨站。我们的工程师声称缺少一些建筑材料，无法完成工作，他们叫我去给他们送材料。

你能帮我把那些材料送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}吗？我们在{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的人会自己从你的机库中拿出那些东西然后用于哨站的建设。

name.ja: 新しいハードウェアが必要
name.ru: Оборудование на замену (In Need of New Hardware)

messages.en: A friend is in need of some new hardware.  We have begun mining operations on a planet nearby, and our logistics officer thought it would be a brilliant idea to buy old Amarrian transport vehicles to save us some ISK.  Oh, well.  Looks like we bought the cat in the sack, as we used to say back home.  So now it's my responsibility to fix the situation so we can continue to get minerals for our building projects.  Take these planetary vehicles and bring them out there, so the lazy gits can get back to work.
messages.zh: 有个朋友需要一些新的硬件。我们已经在附近的一颗行星上开始采矿作业，我们的后勤官认为购买艾玛的二手运输工具可以节省一些钱。唉，得。似乎我们贪小便宜吃了大亏，就像我们老家说的。所以现在得我出来收拾局面，这样我们才能继续采集矿物用于我们的建设项目。把这些行星车辆送到那里，好让那些好吃懒做的家伙回去工作。

name.ru: Смешные цены на нефть (Ridiculous Oil Prices)

messages.en: Have you seen the price of oil around here lately? It's absurd! Our clients are demanding more, but all we've got is the synthetic stuff, so take a load of it over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh: 你知道最近这里的油价吗？太荒谬了！我们客户还要更多的油，可我们这里只有合成油。你去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}送一点去。

name.es: Personas sin hogar por todas partes
name.ja: ホームレスがいたるところに

messages.en: Homeless people are everywhere, littering the streets.  I've gathered up a whole bunch of them, and I want you to go and dump them at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Make it somebody else's problem!
messages.zh: 无家可归的人到处都是，影响市容。我已经集中了一大批这样的家伙，你去把他们扔到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。让别人去处理这些麻烦吧！

messages.en: It's tough to quit smoking when you've got a warehouse full of cigarettes within arm's reach. Take every crate of that crap you can find in that warehouse over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and leave it there. Quickly, before I change my mind!
messages.zh: 一个烟草仓库就近在咫尺，这让我怎么戒烟？你快把那库里所有的香烟都送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}那儿去。快，否则我烟瘾又要上来了！

messages.en: My superiors over at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} are waiting for these reports.  I'm swamped with work so I need you to deliver them for me. Don't mess this up. Both our jobs are on the line here.
messages.zh: 我在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的上级在等着这些报告。而我手头事情太多，所以要你为我把报告送去。别搞砸了。这关系到我们两个人的工作。

messages.en: Surprisingly, people seem to enjoy visiting {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}. I personally think the place is rather boring, but command has ordered me to take care of some high-profile tourists for the next week. Ferry these tourists over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for me, would you? That should keep them busy, at least.
messages.zh: 真是令人惊讶，好像人们都喜欢来{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}游览。我自己觉得这地方无聊得很，可上头命令我下周好好照顾这些引人注目的游客。你能帮我把这批客人送到这儿吗？这样至少也不至于让他们无所事事。

messages.en: We've been having some trouble with deliveries ending up at incorrect destinations. I guess these shipping companies can't be trusted to do their job properly, so I need you to fill in for them. Take these holoreels to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; I will reward you for the effort.
messages.zh: 我们的很多东西都被送错了地址，这让我们非常困扰。我再也不相信这些货运公司的工作能力了，所以我不得不找你取代他们。把这些全息记忆盘送往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}；我会奖励你的。

messages.en: One commodity we all have a hard time living without is oxygen. One of our buyers is on a station that's close to running out of air, so I want you to fly over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and give them  a bit more.
messages.zh: 有一样东西是我们离开了就无法生存的，那就是氧气。但是我们的氧气供给正在渐渐耗尽，所以我要你飞去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}带一些回来。

messages.en: The greenhouses at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} need a delivery of fertile soil. Take these crates and deliver them, would you? Thanks. Have an excellent day!
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的温室需要递送一些肥沃的土壤。把这些箱子送给他们，好吗？谢谢。祝你愉快！

messages.en: I have assets at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} that are in need of additional protection. We've hired a group of marines to take care of the problem. Go to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and drop them off.
messages.zh: 我在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的财产急需保护。我已经雇佣了一组海军陆战队员来处理这个问题。你把他们送抵{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}吧。

messages.en:
The security in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} has been getting worse and worse.  I'm telling you, those guys are in someone's pocket.  I have put in a formal request for their termination, but the powers above don't seem to be in agreement.  Which, of course, only reinforces my opinion that they are all corrupt.  Seeing as we can't throw them out of the nearest airlock, I'm going to do the next best thing

I'm sending you out there with a new security officer and some guards to back him up.  It's your responsibility to make sure they make it to the station safe.
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的安全状况越来越糟。我跟你说，那些家伙都有人罩着。我已经正式请求免除他们的职务，可是上头似乎跟我意见不一。这当然只会使我更加深信他们都是腐败分子。由于我们不能把他们从最近的空气阀门里扔出去，我只能退而求其次了。我要派你和一位新的安全官员以及协助他的守卫们一起去那里。你的职责是确保他们安全到达该空间站。

messages.en: Who doesn't love a nice fat slice of beef? Well, vegetarians and vegans aside, I suppose, but they're a dying breed in this era, eh? Anyway, one of my clients loves his beef, and that's why I want you to fly over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and deliver a shipment of cattle to him.
messages.zh: 谁会不爱吃肥美的牛肉呢？呃，我想大概只有那些吃素的家伙吧。不过他们在这个时代已经濒临灭绝了，不是吗？无论如何，我的一个客户爱吃牛肉，所以我想让你飞往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，为他带一批牛去。

name.fr: La faim ne fait pas grève

messages.en: Looks like food supplies are dwindling fast at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. I think people are consuming a lot more than they were before. Take them a shipment of frozen food so we can feed the hungry.
messages.zh: 看来{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}那儿的食物补给快不足了。我想现在的人比以前吃得多。你去送一批冷冻食品给他们吧。

name.ja: インフルエンザの流行

messages.en: An old friend of mine runs a strip club in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Some strange flu seems to be striking his strippers pretty hard, so he's gonna be needing new girls.  I need you to take these ladies over to his station.  And if I find out any of them got pregnant along the way, you'll never work for me again.
messages.zh: 我的一个老朋友在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}开了家会所。他的很多舞女都染上了一种奇怪的流感，所以他需要找些新的小姐来顶替。我需要你把这些小姐带到他的空间站。如果我发现她们中有人在路上怀孕了，你永远都别想再为我工作了。

messages.en: Once again we are out of food.  You'd think they would learn, and just eat a little less, but no.  The big bosses want me to fix this problem, so I'm delegating the task to you.  I want you to ferry these dairy products to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh: 我们又没有食物了。原本以为，他们会吸取教训，少吃一点，可他们偏不。大老板们要我去解决这个问题，而我把这个任务分派给你。我要你把这些乳制品送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。

messages.en: As you know, much of our business consists of gun running. I just made an accounting error which means that a shipment of our guns wasn't sent.  So, to keep the buyer happy, I'm gonna send you over his way with a sample of our high-quality slug throwers.  Hopefully this will buy me an extra day to get it sorted.
messages.zh: 正如你所知，我们的很多生意牵涉到军火。我的一个核算错误导致我们的一批枪械没有发出。因此，为了让买家心情愉快，我得派你送一份高质量的投弹器样本去他那里。这应该能为我多争取一天时间，能够把问题解决。

messages.en: A friend of mine, Professor Tsulmeki, has asked me to safely transport his most recent graduating class to a seminar. Could you go over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and drop them off for me? Bring them there on time; I don't want them to be late.
messages.zh: 我的朋友祖尔梅吉教授让我去把他整个研究团队安全送到一个重要会议场所。你能帮我去把这些人送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}吗？你要保证他们按时抵达，我不希望他们迟到。

messages.en: My friend is getting married. We need entertainment for his bachelor party tomorrow, but I can't just show up with the dancers myself. Take these "performers" to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for me. Be sure to get them there on time so we can start the fun!
messages.zh: 我朋友要结婚了，我们要为他明天的告别单身晚会准备些娱乐节目。我总不能和舞女一道现身吧。你替我把她们送抵{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。别耽搁了，这样我们明天就能开心了。

name.ru: Быть в курсе (Keeping Up to Date)

messages.en: We just got information relayed from a nearby listening post.  This info is way too valuable to be sent by local channels, so I'm making you responsible for this data.  Make sure it gets to the right location intact.
messages.zh: 我们接到附近一个监听哨站转发的信息。这些信息太宝贵了，不能通过本地频道发送，所以我要你负责这些数据。确保把信息安全送到指定地点。

messages.en: Well, once again the techies in the armament production department have screwed up and installed faulty guidance systems into the new batch of Widowmakers, so now our missiles are flying all over the place. This is not good for our reputation.  I'm sending you over there with new equipment so this can be solved, and fast.
messages.zh: 武器生产部门的技术人员又搞砸了，他们把有问题的引导系统装在一批新的“寡妇制造者”上，导致我们的导弹到处乱飞。这对我们的名声很不好。我要派你送新设备过去，这样才能最快地解决问题。

messages.en: A short while ago, we had a huge problem with rodents that required us to hire an army of janitors. Now that the job's done, however, we need to reallocate these people to a place where they could be more effective. Take them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and drop them off for me.
messages.zh: 我们最近这里老鼠猖獗。我联系了公司，叫来了一帮清洁工。老鼠问题虽已解决，但现在这帮人需要去更能发挥作用的地方。你把他们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}那里去吧。

name.ru: Кто сгоняет за пивом? (Quelling the Temper)

messages.en: One of the local warlords is coming to this area.  We're going to be needing his assistance in the coming weeks, so to make sure we have his backing I'll need you to get me some spirits to make sure everything goes as smoothly as possible.
messages.zh: 一个当地军阀正赶往这里。在接下来的几个星期里，我们需要他的帮助，因此我希望你去弄一些幽灵饮料给我，以确保一切顺利进行。

messages.en: One of our station reactors is running under threat of melting down, so I'm sending you with some coolant to get the situation under hand. If the reactor goes haywire because you didn't make it in time, I will be very disappointed.
messages.zh: 我们的一个空间站反应堆正面临着融毁的危险，所以我要派你送些冷却剂过去控制局面。要是因为你没能及时送到而使反应堆失控，我会非常失望。

messages.en: Garbage is something I have an intense dislike of, and our supplies right now are unfortunately enormous.  Take these crates to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and stash them in an empty hangar there.  They will never suspect us and we'll be rid of this problem for now.
messages.zh: 垃圾是我最讨厌的东西，可是我们目前的垃圾贮藏量却非常巨大。把这些箱子送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，找个空机库藏起来。他们永远不会怀疑到我们头上，我们至少可以解决眼前的问题了。

messages.en: I have some very important merchants here that need to be ferried to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so we can start securing a deal with them.  As you can understand, these people do not want to be known, so we are sending you to fly them around.  Make sure no passenger manifests of these persons are kept.  Thank you.
messages.zh: 我这里有些非常重要的商人，他们需要被送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这为了确保能和他们达成某项交易。你应该可以理解，这些人不想被认出来，所以我们派你去送他们。务必不要留下这些乘客的名单。谢谢。

messages.en:
Several years ago on my daughter's birthday, she begged me to get the newest Andorandy doll set for her. Unfortunately, I couldn't find even one of the popular dolls, even though I ran market database searches repeatedly in this region for several weeks. Well, I'm happy to say I turned all that effort into a lucrative business; today, I sell Andorandy dolls and many other sorts here from my offices in {[location]agentStationID.name}. Maybe you've heard of us? My Little Girl, we´re called.

Anyway, right now I have a problem: I have a shipment of dolls awaiting delivery, but some inventory problems in one of my warehouses are interfering. Can you pick up the dolls for me and deliver them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}?
messages.zh:
几年前我女儿生日时，她求我给她最新的安德兰迪玩偶套装。不幸的是，虽然我一连几个礼拜里反复搜索星域的市场数据库，但居然连一件这样流行的玩偶都找不到。不过令人欣喜的是，我把自己搜寻玩偶的努力转化成了一项利润丰厚的业务；今天，我在{[location]agentStationID.name}的多个办事处销售安德兰迪和其他类型的玩偶。也许你听说过我们吧？我的小女孩，是我们的名字。

但是，现在我遇到个麻烦：我有一批玩具要发货，可是由于我的一个仓库出现了存货问题，玩具的发货受到了阻碍。你能帮我把那些玩偶装运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}吗？

messages.en: We've been having problems with some of the local miners lately, and it's time for them to be relocated. Take them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and tell them they've received a raise. They should be pretty surprised by the end of the month.
messages.zh: 最近我们与一些当地矿工有了些矛盾，现在该把他们转移到别处了。把他们带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，告诉他们，他们涨工资了。等到月底，他们会大吃一惊的。

name.de: Unsere Jungs fangen an sich zu langweilen
name.ja: 我が仲間たちは退屈している
name.ru: Когда парням скучно (Our Boys Are Getting Bored)

messages.en: We've been getting reports of unrest among a garrison of ours on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  I have a devious plan to quell this little hubbub without the use of force.  We just got a shipment of high-grade holoreels with the biggest female stars of the Federation – and no, you may not ask where.  Just head over to that station and make sure the cinema manager gets them.
messages.zh: 我们收到报告，{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的驻军发生了骚乱。我有一则妙计，不费一兵一卒就能平息这动荡的局面。我们刚刚收到了一批高级全息信息盘，是联邦几位最大牌女星演的——噢，不，你不能问是从哪儿来的。你只要去那个太空站把东西送给电影院经理就行了。

messages.en: Somebody broke into my brother's home yesterday and stole his entire gun collection. He'll get into heaps of trouble with his superiors if they find out, so I want you to help him make the problem go away. Fly over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and drop off a new set of weapons. I'll modify the ID codes on the guns, and nobody will suspect a thing.
messages.zh: 昨天有人闯进我兄弟家，拿走了他收藏的全套枪械。如果他的上级知道了，他麻烦就大了。所以请你帮他解决这件事。快飞往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}送一批新武器去。我会修改枪械的ID代码，不会有人怀疑的。

messages.en: Uhh, well… yeah, sure, I guess. I mean, ISK is ISK, right?
messages.zh: 呃，嗯……好，好吧。你想啊，谁不要钱啊？

messages.en:
Hey, don't give me that look. It might be mud, but it's important mud!

Oh, just get going.
messages.zh:
嗨，别给我使那脸色。这或许就是泥渣，但这是重要的泥渣！

好了，动起来。

messages.en: Uh, it's "pod pilot." So what's going on?
messages.zh: 哦，来了一位“逃生舱飞行员”。出什么事情了？

messages.en: Take this soil to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so our science weenies can figure out how to grow stuff for us to eat. No lollygagging.
messages.zh: 把这堆土壤运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这样我们那帮搞科研的家伙就能研究出怎样种出食物供我们享用了。别拖拖拉拉的。

messages.en: Okay, your name is mud. Or, rather, your mud is delivered. So pay up.
messages.zh: Ok，你的名字叫泥渣。噢，不，我的意思是你的泥渣已送达。给钱吧。

messages.en: Alright, alright, wiseguy. Here's your ISK. Pleasure doin' business, and all that.
messages.zh: 好了好了，聪明人，这是你的星币。我们合作得很愉快。

messages.en: Dirt transporting, huh? You do realize that I'm a capsuleer, right? Not some common industrial pilot?! Thanks, but no thanks.
messages.zh: 运泥渣啊？你知道我是飞行员，对吧？你应该不会以为我是普通的工业民工吧？

messages.en: Hey, suit yerself, pal. Heh. I'm sure there's a "common pilot" around here somewheres without that stuck-up capsuleer vibe you got in spades.
messages.zh: 你还是先自己照照镜子吧。我打赌这里还是有所谓的“普通民工”的，但他不会像你一样自命清高。

messages.en:
Some egg-heads we hired've been analyzing a nearby planet for "sustainable food resource population." Heh, yeah. Anyway, looks like our plans to terraform it are moving forward.

Now, a big part of this project is good, fertile soil. Yeah, soil. Think about it.

But before the project can move full ahead, we need someone to transport sort of a small amount of the stuff to test out the growing conditions. And that means someone with a big enough cargo hold and a desire to make a bit of ISK for the effort.

So, what do you think? Are you interested?
messages.zh:
我们聘用的一帮搞科研的家伙最近正在分析临近的一颗行星，以判定它上面是否有“可持续发展的食物资源”来供养人口。看来行星改造计划要继续下去。

现在完成此项研究计划所要求的重要物品就是好的养料土。是的，就是泥土。具体自己去想。

但在研究能全面进入下一阶段之前，我们需要有人运些少量的泥土以便测试一下那行星上的生长环境。那人得有一个够大的货柜舱，而且得愿意干那活来赚点钱。

怎样，你觉得如何？想不想干？

messages.en: Looks like there was some kind of explosion on a colony in this system, and thousands of people are without a home. I want you to take some of them over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so we can do our part in providing shelter for less fortunate people.
messages.zh: 好像这星系里某个殖民地上发生了爆炸，成千上万的人流离失所。我要你把其中一部分人送往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这样我们就能为这些不幸的人们提供住处，做些我们力所能及的事。

messages.en: We've engaged in a terraforming project on a nearby planet.  It's going as planned, but we need to make sure the greenery will flourish, so I think some fertilizer would be well in order.  I know this isn't what you had in mind when you became a pod pilot, but someone has to take care of the crap.  And I know you would be perfect for the job.
messages.zh: 我们正忙于对附近一颗行星进行适生改造。一切按计划进行，不过为了保证植物生长茂盛，有一些肥料需要好好打理一下。我知道你刚成为飞行员时没想到会做这种事，不过总得有人去做脏活累活。而且我知道你正是这个任务的最佳人选。

messages.en: I need you to run over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and drop off these electronic parts. The Chief Technical Operator there contacted me regarding the discovery of a major defect in their primary reactor, and they don't have the parts on hand to repair it.
messages.zh: 我需要你把这些电子元件火速送往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。那里的技术主管联系我说主反应堆部件存在严重问题，而他们缺少修理所需的部件。

messages.en:
As you probably know by now, not all of our operations are conducted during daylight hours. The big bosses have just given me a job that needs a reliable pilot, and seeing that you have such an excellent track record with us, I think you'd be perfect for the job. Move this package to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Don't try to open it. In fact, don't even look at it. Seriously. It's in your best interest.

And you were never here. Wait, who are you? I don't know you. Capiche? Now get going.
messages.zh:
你现在可能已经知道了，并非我们的所有工作都是在光天化日下完成的。大老板们刚刚给了我个工作，需要一个值得信赖的飞行员去做。而你有非常出色的工作记录，所以我想你是这个任务的最佳人选。把这个包裹送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，千万不要打开。确切点说，看都不要看。我是认真的。这是为了你好。

而且你从没来过这里。慢着，你是谁？我不认识你。卡皮切？现在快走。

name.ru: Смешные цены на нефть (Ridiculous Oil Prices)

messages.en: Have you seen the price of oil around here lately? It's absurd! Our clients are demanding more, but all we've got is the synthetic stuff, so take a load of it over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh: 你知道最近这里的油价吗？太荒谬了！我们客户还要更多的油，可我们这里只有合成油。你去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}送一点去。

name.es: Personas sin hogar por todas partes
name.ja: ホームレスがいたるところに

messages.en: Homeless people are everywhere, littering the streets.  I've gathered up a whole bunch of them, and I want you to go and dump them at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Make it somebody else's problem!
messages.zh: 无家可归的人到处都是，影响市容。我已经集中了一大批这样的家伙，你去把他们扔到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。让别人去处理这些麻烦吧！

messages.en: It's tough to quit smoking when you've got a warehouse full of cigarettes within arm's reach. Take every crate of that crap you can find in that warehouse over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and leave it there. Quickly, before I change my mind!
messages.zh: 一个烟草仓库就近在咫尺，这让我怎么戒烟？你快把那库里所有的香烟都送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}那儿去。快，否则我烟瘾又要上来了！

messages.en: As you know, we have a reputation for being a rowdy bunch and not the most civilized organization in the cluster, but sometimes my own men amaze even me. Yesterday the lads were responsible for showing a VIP a good time and making sure he was entertained, but just now I got a call from a local station manager who's refusing to clean up the mess they made. I'm sending you over there with an army of janitors. No, I don't want to hear about it. Just get going.
messages.zh: 正如你所知，我们因粗暴无赖而出名，绝对算不上这个星群里文明程度最高的团体，不过有时我的部下甚至会让我都大吃一惊。昨天，几个小子负责招待一位VIP，让他过一段美好时光。但我刚才接到当地空间站管理人的电话，声称拒绝收拾那帮家伙弄的烂摊子。我派你带一群卫过去。不，我不要听你的借口。先在就去。

messages.en: My superiors over at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} are waiting for these reports.  I'm swamped with work so I need you to deliver them for me. Don't mess this up. Both our jobs are on the line here.
messages.zh: 我在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的上级在等着这些报告。而我手头事情太多，所以要你为我把报告送去。别搞砸了。这关系到我们两个人的工作。

messages.en: Surprisingly, people seem to enjoy visiting {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}. I personally think the place is rather boring, but command has ordered me to take care of some high-profile tourists for the next week. Ferry these tourists over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for me, would you? That should keep them busy, at least.
messages.zh: 真是令人惊讶，好像人们都喜欢来{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}游览。我自己觉得这地方无聊得很，可上头命令我下周好好照顾这些引人注目的游客。你能帮我把这批客人送到这儿吗？这样至少也不至于让他们无所事事。

messages.en: Sounds… interesting. Well, no, actually it sounds a bit tedious. But ISK is ISK. I'm in.
messages.zh: 听起来是有意思，但其实我觉得还是有点无聊。不过毕竟能有钱拿，这活儿我接了。

messages.en: I figured I could count on you. My thanks.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住。谢了。

messages.en: What… exactly… are you… talking about?
messages.zh: 你……到底……在讲什么？

messages.en: Transport a unit of hired marines over to the {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} station so it can be brought under ... er, new management. Do not get involved personally. Just get the soldiers into the docking area and then look the other way.
messages.zh: 我要你把我雇佣的一个海军部队运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站，这样那空间站就能……呃，焕像一新了。别跟不相干的人过多纠缠，把士兵送到船坞停靠区就回来。

messages.en: I delivered your marines. Things ought to be well under way by now.
messages.zh: 我把海军陆战队员都运送过去了，事情应该进展的很顺利。

messages.en: Indeed, they are. I'm expecting further communications any minute. Again, my thanks.
messages.zh: 确实是这样。我正等着他们随时通报下一步情况呢。再次表达对你的感谢。

messages.en: Uh, sounds a bit risky. I mean, what if the station guards attack my ship? No, no thanks.
messages.zh: 哦，听上去有点危险。你想，万一空间站的守卫向我开火怎么办？算了，谢谢你的好意。

messages.en: Well, suit yourself. No risk, I assure you. But have it your way. Your loss.
messages.zh: 好吧，你还是回家种地去算了。没任何危险，我向你保证。但你会失去更多。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, a local boss who basically runs the {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} station nearby has been a thorn in my side for years, but my boss has finally given me the thumbs up for a, um, hostile takeover.

I need you to transport a unit of my hired marines over there so the station can be brought under ... er, new management. Do not get involved personally. Just get the soldiers into the docking area and then look the other way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，掌管附近{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站的头儿是我多年来的眼中钉，现在上面终于允许我……呃……用武力去抢占那空间站了。

我要你把我征募的一个海军陆战队运到那儿，这样那空间站就能……呃……焕然一新了。别跟无关的人纠缠，直接把士兵送到船坞停靠区后就回来。

messages.en: We've been having some trouble with deliveries ending up at incorrect destinations. I guess these shipping companies can't be trusted to do their job properly, so I need you to fill in for them. Take these holoreels to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; I will reward you for the effort.
messages.zh: 我们的很多东西都被送错了地址，这让我们非常困扰。我再也不相信这些货运公司的工作能力了，所以我不得不找你取代他们。把这些全息记忆盘送往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}；我会奖励你的。

name.ja: グランツの幸運を守れ
name.ru: Счастье для парней (Keeping The Grunts Happy)

messages.en: As you know, keeping the grunts happy is one of my most important jobs.  If they stop working, everything breaks down and we don't want that.  So, for the sake my head and yours, please ferry this shipment of tobacco to the {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}  station.
messages.zh: 你知道，让工作人员保持好心情是我最重要的工作之一。如果他们停止工作，一切就会瘫痪，我们可不希望那样。所以，为了保住我们俩的脑袋，请把这批烟草运往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站。

messages.en: One commodity we all have a hard time living without is oxygen. One of our buyers is on a station that's close to running out of air, so I want you to fly over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and give them  a bit more.
messages.zh: 有一样东西是我们离开了就无法生存的，那就是氧气。但是我们的氧气供给正在渐渐耗尽，所以我要你飞去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}带一些回来。

messages.en: The greenhouses at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} need a delivery of fertile soil. Take these crates and deliver them, would you? Thanks. Have an excellent day!
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的温室需要递送一些肥沃的土壤。把这些箱子送给他们，好吗？谢谢。祝你愉快！

messages.en: As you know, water is one of the most important commodities around. Without it, we would all die. More importantly, though, the station manager in a nearby station is well-connected with the powers that be. This guy has a thing for bathing in fresh water from the planet below. Yes, yes, I know, and yes, I agree, but when the big bosses ask you to jump, all you do is ask how high.  So I'm asking you to jump, and be fast about it.
messages.zh: 要知道，水是最重要的日用品之一。没有水，我们都会死。不过比水更重要的是，附近一个空间站的管理人与许多位高权重者关系密切。这个人有个爱好，喜欢用来自下方行星的淡水泡澡。是，是，我知道，对，我同意，不过当你的大老板让你跳的时候，你只能问要跳多高。所以现在我让你跳，而且要快。

messages.en: I have assets at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} that are in need of additional protection. We've hired a group of marines to take care of the problem. Go to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and drop them off.
messages.zh: 我在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的财产急需保护。我已经雇佣了一组海军陆战队员来处理这个问题。你把他们送抵{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}吧。

messages.en: We are launching one of our new listening posts nearby. Everything is ready and we have a Go signal from the authorities, but the idiots next door forgot to make sure they had the necessary supplies for the launch.  We need you to ferry some rocket fuel so these baboons don't lose their heads to the management.
messages.zh: 我们正准备在附近发射一座新的监听哨站。万事俱备，只等上面说一声“发射”了。可是隔壁的傻瓜却忘了把发射所需的补给品准备齐全。我们需要你运送一些火箭燃料，要不这些乡下佬非被上头摘了脑袋不可。

messages.en: Who doesn't love a nice fat slice of beef? Well, vegetarians and vegans aside, I suppose, but they're a dying breed in this era, eh? Anyway, one of my clients loves his beef, and that's why I want you to fly over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and deliver a shipment of cattle to him.
messages.zh: 谁会不爱吃肥美的牛肉呢？呃，我想大概只有那些吃素的家伙吧。不过他们在这个时代已经濒临灭绝了，不是吗？无论如何，我的一个客户爱吃牛肉，所以我想让你飞往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，为他带一批牛去。

messages.en: A short while ago, we had a huge problem with rodents that required us to hire an army of janitors. Now that the job's done, however, we need to reallocate these people to a place where they could be more effective. Take them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and drop them off for me.
messages.zh: 我们最近这里老鼠猖獗。我联系了公司，叫来了一帮清洁工。老鼠问题虽已解决，但现在这帮人需要去更能发挥作用的地方。你把他们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}那里去吧。

name.en: A Feast Fit for a King
name.ru: Пир горой (A Feast Fit for a King)

messages.en: I can help you out, sure. I can't do it for free, though.
messages.zh: 当然，我可以帮你。但不能白干。

messages.en: Do I look like a putz? Of course I'll pay you. Just get the stuff over there as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 我看上去像白痴吗？放心，我会付钱的。把东西尽快送到那里就行。

messages.en: I do, yeah, and I am… depending on what you need.
messages.zh: 是的，我有船也有兴趣挣钱……关键是你要什么。

messages.en: Deliver these crates of long-limb roes to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}  station.
messages.zh: 将这些长肢龙鹿卵运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站。

messages.en: Alright, delivery completed. You mentioned payment?
messages.zh: 好了，东西送到了。你答应的钱呢？

messages.en: Fantastic. Your ISK has been deposited to your account. And don't worry, my friend, I won't forget you when I rise to higher places.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。你的钱已经入你账户了。别担心，朋友，我将来升了不会忘了你。

messages.en:
Well, lemme tell you: A warlord who's been visiting my people in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} station for a while now has a thing for long-limb roes, and I need to get some over there for him. This man is very important and very dangerous, {[character]player.name}, and I want him on my good side, so let's make every effort to get his needs fulfilled.

Can you help me out?
messages.zh:
好，是这样：一名已经在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站做民事访问的军阀对长肢龙鹿卵有特殊癖好，我需要你送点这样的东西过去给他。{[character]player.name}，他是位重要人物，同时也很不好惹，我希望他能站在我这一边，因此你要尽全力满足他的需求。

能帮我这个忙吗？

name.fr: La faim ne fait pas grève

messages.en: Looks like food supplies are dwindling fast at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. I think people are consuming a lot more than they were before. Take them a shipment of frozen food so we can feed the hungry.
messages.zh: 看来{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}那儿的食物补给快不足了。我想现在的人比以前吃得多。你去送一批冷冻食品给他们吧。

messages.en: A friend of mine, Professor Tsulmeki, has asked me to safely transport his entire research team to an important seminar. Could you go over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and drop them off for me? Bring them there on time; I don't want them to be late.
messages.zh: 我的朋友祖尔梅吉教授让我去把他整个研究团队安全送到一个重要会议场所。你能帮我去把这些人送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}吗？你要保证他们按时抵达，我不希望他们迟到。

messages.en: My friend is getting married. We need entertainment for his bachelor party tomorrow, but I can't just show up with the dancers myself. Take these "performers" to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for me. Be sure to get them there on time so we can start the fun!
messages.zh: 我朋友要结婚了，我们要为他明天的告别单身晚会准备些娱乐节目。我总不能和舞女一道现身吧。你替我把她们送抵{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。别耽搁了，这样我们明天就能开心了。

messages.en: Garbage is something I have an intense dislike of, and our supplies right now are unfortunately enormous.  Take these crates to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and stash them in an empty hangar there.  They will never suspect us and we'll be rid of this problem for now.
messages.zh: 垃圾是我最讨厌的东西，可是我们目前的垃圾贮藏量却非常巨大。把这些箱子送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，找个空机库藏起来。他们永远不会怀疑到我们头上，我们至少可以解决眼前的问题了。

messages.en:
Several years ago on my daughter's birthday, she begged me to get the newest Andorandy doll set for her. Unfortunately, I couldn't find even one of the popular dolls, even though I ran market database searches repeatedly in this region for several weeks. Well, I'm happy to say I turned all that effort into a lucrative business; today, I sell Andorandy dolls and many other sorts here from my offices in {[location]agentStationID.name}. Maybe you've heard of us? My Little Girl, we´re called.

Anyway, right now I have a problem: I have a shipment of dolls awaiting delivery, but some inventory problems in one of my warehouses are interfering. Can you pick up the dolls for me and deliver them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}?
messages.zh:
几年前我女儿生日时，她求我给她最新的安德兰迪玩偶套装。不幸的是，虽然我一连几个礼拜里反复搜索星域的市场数据库，但居然连一件这样流行的玩偶都找不到。不过令人欣喜的是，我把自己搜寻玩偶的努力转化成了一项利润丰厚的业务；今天，我在{[location]agentStationID.name}的多个办事处销售安德兰迪和其他类型的玩偶。也许你听说过我们吧？我的小女孩，是我们的名字。

但是，现在我遇到个麻烦：我有一批玩具要发货，可是由于我的一个仓库出现了存货问题，玩具的发货受到了阻碍。你能帮我把那些玩偶装运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}吗？

messages.en: We've been having problems with some of the local miners lately, and it's time for them to be relocated. Take them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and tell them they've received a raise. They should be pretty surprised by the end of the month.
messages.zh: 最近我们与一些当地矿工有了些矛盾，现在该把他们转移到别处了。把他们带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，告诉他们，他们涨工资了。等到月底，他们会大吃一惊的。

messages.en: Somebody broke into my brother's home yesterday and stole his entire gun collection. He'll get into heaps of trouble with his superiors if they find out, so I want you to help him make the problem go away. Fly over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and drop off a new set of weapons. I'll modify the ID codes on the guns, and nobody will suspect a thing.
messages.zh: 昨天有人闯进我兄弟家，拿走了他收藏的全套枪械。如果他的上级知道了，他麻烦就大了。所以请你帮他解决这件事。快飞往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}送一批新武器去。我会修改枪械的ID代码，不会有人怀疑的。

messages.en: Looks like there was some kind of explosion on a colony in this system, and thousands of people are without a home. I want you to take some of them over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so we can do our part in providing shelter for less fortunate people.
messages.zh: 好像这星系里某个殖民地上发生了爆炸，成千上万的人流离失所。我要你把其中一部分人送往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这样我们就能为这些不幸的人们提供住处，做些我们力所能及的事。

messages.en: Sounds… interesting. Well, no, actually it sounds a bit tedious. But ISK is ISK. I'm in.
messages.zh: 听起来是有意思，但其实我觉得还是有点无聊。不过毕竟能有钱拿，这活儿我接了。

messages.en: I figured I could count on you. My thanks.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住。谢了。

messages.en: What… exactly… are you… talking about?
messages.zh: 你……到底……在讲什么？

messages.en: Transport a unit of hired marines over to the {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} station so it can be brought under ... er, new management. Do not get involved personally. Just get the soldiers into the docking area and then look the other way.
messages.zh: 我要你把我雇佣的一个海军部队运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站，这样那空间站就能……呃，焕像一新了。别跟不相干的人过多纠缠，把士兵送到船坞停靠区就回来。

messages.en: I delivered your marines. Things ought to be well under way by now.
messages.zh: 我把海军陆战队员都运送过去了，事情应该进展的很顺利。

messages.en: Indeed, they are. I'm expecting further communications any minute. Again, my thanks.
messages.zh: 确实是这样。我正等着他们随时通报下一步情况呢。再次表达对你的感谢。

messages.en: Uh, sounds a bit risky. I mean, what if the station guards attack my ship? No, no thanks.
messages.zh: 哦，听上去有点危险。你想，万一空间站的守卫向我开火怎么办？算了，谢谢你的好意。

messages.en: Well, suit yourself. No risk, I assure you. But have it your way. Your loss.
messages.zh: 好吧，你还是回家种地去算了。没任何危险，我向你保证。但你会失去更多。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, a local boss who basically runs the {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} station nearby has been a thorn in my side for years, but my boss has finally given me the thumbs up for a hostile takeover.

I need you to transport a unit of my hired marines over there so the station can be brought under ... er, new management. Do not get involved personally. Just get the soldiers into the docking area and then look the other way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，掌管附近{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站的头儿是我多年来的眼中钉，现在上面终于允许我……呃……用武力去抢占那空间站了。

我要你把我征募的一个海军部队运到那儿，这样那空间站就能……呃，焕然一新了。别跟人发生纠缠。把士兵送到船坞停靠区就行，然后就回来吧。

name.en: A Feast Fit for a King
name.ru: Пир горой (A Feast Fit for a King)

messages.en: I can help you out, sure. I can't do it for free, though.
messages.zh: 当然，我可以帮你。但不能白干。

messages.en: Do I look like a putz? Of course I'll pay you. Just get the stuff over there as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 我看上去像白痴吗？放心，我会付钱的。把东西尽快送到那里就行。

messages.en: I do, yeah, and I am… depending on what you need.
messages.zh: 是的，我有船也有兴趣挣钱……关键是你要什么。

messages.en: Deliver 1 crate of long-limb roes to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}  station.
messages.zh: 把一箱长肢龙鹿卵送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站。

messages.en: Alright, delivery completed. You mentioned payment?
messages.zh: 好了，东西送到了。你答应的钱呢？

messages.en: Fantastic. Your ISK has been deposited to your account. And don't worry, my friend, I won't forget you when I rise to higher places.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。你的钱已经入你账户了。别担心，朋友，我将来升了不会忘了你。

messages.en:
Well, lemme tell you: A warlord who's been visiting my people in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} station for a while now has a thing for long-limb roes, and I need to get some over there for him. This man is very important and very dangerous, {[character]player.name}, and I want him on my good side, so let's make every effort to get his needs fulfilled.

Can you help me out?
messages.zh:
好，是这样：一名已经在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站做民事访问的军阀对长肢龙鹿卵有特殊癖好，我需要你送点这样的东西过去给他。{[character]player.name}，他是位重要人物，同时也很不好惹，我希望他能站在我这一边，因此你要尽全力满足他的需求。

能帮我这个忙吗？

messages.en: As you know, we have a reputation for being a rowdy bunch and not the most civilized organization in the cluster, but sometimes my own men amaze even me. Yesterday the lads were responsible for showing a VIP a good time and making sure he was entertained, but just now I got a call from a local station manager who's refusing to clean up the mess they made. I'm sending you over there with an army of janitors. No, I don't want to hear about it. Just get going.
messages.zh: 正如你所知，我们因粗暴无赖而出名，绝对算不上这个星群里文明程度最高的团体，不过有时我的部下甚至会让我都大吃一惊。昨天，几个小子负责招待一位VIP，让他过一段美好时光。但我刚才接到当地空间站管理人的电话，声称拒绝收拾那帮家伙弄的烂摊子。我派你带一群卫过去。不，我不要听你的借口。先在就去。

messages.en: Uhh, well… yeah, sure, I guess. I mean, ISK is ISK, right?
messages.zh: 呃，嗯……好，好吧。你想啊，谁不要钱啊？

messages.en:
Hey, don't gimme that look. It might be mud, but it's important mud!

Oh, just get going.
messages.zh:
嗨，别给我使那脸色。这或许就是泥渣，但这是重要的泥渣！

好了，动起来。

messages.en: Oh? What's going on?
messages.zh: 恩？怎么了？

messages.en: Take this soil to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so our science weenies can figure out how to grow stuff for us to eat. No lollygagging.
messages.zh: 把这堆土壤运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这样我们那帮搞科研的家伙就能研究出怎样种出食物供我们享用了。别拖拖拉拉的。

messages.en: Okay, your mud is delivered. Now, pay up.
messages.zh: Ok，你的泥渣已送达。给钱吧。

messages.en: Alright, alright, wiseguy. Enough with the wit, already. Pleasure doin' business as usual.
messages.zh: 好了好了，聪明人，别再甩小聪明了。还是和以往一样，合作很愉快。

messages.en: Dirt transporting, huh? You do realize that I'm a capsuleer, right? Not some common industrial pilot?! Thanks, but no thanks.
messages.zh: 运泥渣啊？你知道我是飞行员，对吧？你应该不会以为我是普通的工业民工吧？

messages.en: Hey, suit yourself, pal. I'm sure there's a "common pilot" around here who's not quite so stuck up.
messages.zh: 你还是先自己照照镜子吧。你想干啥就干啥。我打赌这里还是有所谓的“普通民工”的，但他不会像你一样自命清高。

messages.en:
Some egg-heads we hired have been analyzing a nearby planet for "sustainable food resource population." Heh, yeah. Give a nerd an edumucation, and he thinks he gets to make up all sorts of dumb names for stuff. Anyway, looks like the plans to terraform the planet are moving forward.

Now, a big part of this project is good, fertile soil. But before the project can move full ahead, we need someone to take a small amount to their lab to test out the growing conditions. And naturally, I can't think of anyone I'd rather pay for such an easy job but you.

So, what do you think? Are you interested?
messages.zh:
我们聘用的一帮搞科研的家伙最近正在分析临近的一颗行星，以判定它上面是否有“可持续的食物资源”来供养人口。那些家伙就这样，喝了点墨水就满口术语。

不管这个了，现在看来行星改造计划要继续下去。现在完成此项研究计划所要求的重要物品就是好的养料土。是的，就是泥土。具体自己去想。

但在研究能全面进入下一阶段之前，我们需要有人运些少量的泥土以便测试一下那行星上的生长环境。那人得有一个够大的货柜舱，而且得愿意干那活来赚点钱。

怎样，你觉得如何？想不想干？

messages.en:
As you probably know by now, not all of our operations are conducted during daylight hours. The big bosses have just given me a job that needs a reliable pilot, and seeing that you have such an excellent track record with us, I think you'd be perfect for the job. Move this package to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Don't try to open it. In fact, don't even look at it. Seriously. It's in your best interest.

And you were never here. Wait, who are you? I don't know you. Capiche? Now get going.
messages.zh:
你现在可能已经知道了，并非我们的所有工作都是在光天化日下完成的。大老板们刚刚给了我个工作，需要一个值得信赖的飞行员去做。而你有非常出色的工作记录，所以我想你是这个任务的最佳人选。把这个包裹送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，千万不要打开。确切点说，看都不要看。我是认真的。这是为了你好。

而且你从没来过这里。慢着，你是谁？我不认识你。卡皮切？现在快走。

name.de: Unsere Jungs fangen an sich zu langweilen
name.ja: 我が仲間たちは退屈している
name.ru: Когда парням скучно (Our Boys Are Getting Bored)

messages.en: We've been getting reports of unrest among a garrison of ours on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  I have a devious plan to quell this little hubbub without the use of force.  We just got a shipment of high-grade holoreels with the biggest female stars of the Federation – and no, you may not ask where.  Just head over to that station and make sure the cinema manager gets them.
messages.zh: 我们收到报告，{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的驻军发生了骚乱。我有一则妙计，不费一兵一卒就能平息这动荡的局面。我们刚刚收到了一批高级全息信息盘，是联邦几位最大牌女星演的——噢，不，你不能问是从哪儿来的。你只要去那个太空站把东西送给电影院经理就行了。

messages.en: One of our transports flying through {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} broke down and requires immediate repairs.  We've agreed to send him the spare parts he needs to complete the operation, and I'd like you to deliver the goods.  If you're fast he might even make it on time, so don't tarry!
messages.zh: 我们的一艘运输船在飞过{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}时抛锚，需要紧急维修。我们答应给他送去维修所需的备件，希望你把东西送去。如果你够快，他甚至可能把东西准时送到，所以别在这磨蹭了！

messages.en: I need you to help out. There is fierce fighting going on in a nearby system and we have militants here that need to be moved out there as soon as humanly possible. Are you willing to help our cause?
messages.zh: 我需要你的帮助。附近的星系正在进行一场激烈的战斗，我这儿有一批武装人员要以人力所及的最快速度运往那里。你愿意协助我们的事业吗？

messages.en: We are launching one of our new listening posts nearby. Everything is ready and we have a Go signal from the authorities, but the idiots next door forgot to make sure they had the necessary supplies for the launch.  We need you to ferry some rocket fuel so these baboons don't lose their heads to the management.
messages.zh: 我们正准备在附近发射一座新的监听哨站。万事俱备，只等上面说一声“发射”了。可是隔壁的傻瓜却忘了把发射所需的补给品准备齐全。我们需要你运送一些火箭燃料，要不这些乡下佬非被上头摘了脑袋不可。

messages.en: One of our transports flying through {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} broke down and requires immediate repairs.  We've agreed to send him the spare parts he needs to complete the operation, and I'd like you to deliver the goods.  If you're fast he might even make it on time, so don't tarry!
messages.zh: 我们的一艘运输船在飞过{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}时抛锚，需要紧急维修。我们答应给他送去维修所需的备件，希望你把东西送去。如果你够快，他甚至可能把东西准时送到，所以别在这磨蹭了！

messages.en: We've engaged in a terraforming project on a nearby planet.  It's going as planned, but we need to make sure the greenery will flourish, so I think some fertilizer would be well in order.  I know this isn't what you had in mind when you became a pod pilot, but someone has to take care of the crap.  And I know you would be perfect for the job.
messages.zh: 我们正忙于对附近一颗行星进行适生改造。一切按计划进行，不过为了保证植物生长茂盛，有一些肥料需要好好打理一下。我知道你刚成为飞行员时没想到会做这种事，不过总得有人去做脏活累活。而且我知道你正是这个任务的最佳人选。

name.ru: Поставка для охраны (Supply the Security Personnel)

messages.en: Slaves at a nearby station are rebelling.  They've managed to break their way into an armory and are holding their ground there.  Please transport these small arms to the station to assist our security personnel in putting them in their place.
messages.zh: 附近一个空间站的劳工反叛了。他们闯入了一座军械库并在那里赖着不走。请把这些小型武器送去那个空间站，以协助我们的保安部队把这些劳工赶回各自的岗位去。

name.ja: グランツの幸運を守れ
name.ru: Счастье для парней (Keeping The Grunts Happy)

messages.en: As you know, keeping the grunts happy is one of my most important jobs.  If they stop working, everything breaks down and we don't want that.  So, for the sake my head and yours, please ferry this shipment of tobacco to the {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}  station.
messages.zh: 你知道，让工作人员保持好心情是我最重要的工作之一。如果他们停止工作，一切就会瘫痪，我们可不希望那样。所以，为了保住我们俩的脑袋，请把这批烟草运往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站。

messages.en: Manufacturing of our war ships has been halted because of faulty parts.  It is my understanding that we have some replacements at this station.  Take them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for me as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 我们的战舰生产因零件有故障而暂停。我记得我们空间站里还有一些备用零件。尽快帮我把它们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。

messages.en: As you know, water is one of the most important commodities around. Without it, we would all die. More importantly, though, the station manager in a nearby station is well-connected with the powers that be. This guy has a thing for bathing in fresh water from the planet below. Yes, yes, I know, and yes, I agree, but when the big bosses ask you to jump, all you do is ask how high.  So I'm asking you to jump, and be fast about it.
messages.zh: 要知道，水是最重要的日用品之一。没有水，我们都会死。不过比水更重要的是，附近一个空间站的管理人与许多位高权重者关系密切。这个人有个爱好，喜欢用来自下方行星的淡水泡澡。是，是，我知道，对，我同意，不过当你的大老板让你跳的时候，你只能问要跳多高。所以现在我让你跳，而且要快。

messages.en: We just discovered a colony of people we didn't know were there on a nearby planet.  Our diplomats are planning a trip to negotiate with them on working for us in the constellation. Please transport our supply of Vitoc to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. They can't go until this stuff arrives, so hurry up.
messages.zh: 我们刚刚在附近行星上发现了一个未知殖民地。我们的外交官正计划去与他们谈判，希望他们能在这个星座为我们工作。请把我们的这批崴砣柯运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。没有这些东西，他们就不能出发，所以你要快点。

name.ru: Кто-то наступил сюда (Someone Stepped In It)

messages.en: One of the mining colonies didn't receive their supplies last week, and if we don't do anything about it they're going to starve. We have some extra supplies here that I want you to transport to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh: 一处矿工殖民地上周没有收到补给，要是我们不采取措施，那里的人就会饿死。我们这里有些额外的补给，我想让你送去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。

messages.en: Take these people to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and don't tell anyone they were here.
messages.zh: 把此这些送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，别让任何人知道他们来过这里。

messages.en: There has been an accident on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, but fortunately no one was hurt.  No one that matters, anyway. Please take these slaves over there to make up for the ones that perished.
messages.zh: 在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}发生了一次事故，不过幸运的是，没人受伤。总之，重要人物都没事。请把这些劳工带到那里去替代那些丧生的劳工。

messages.en:
As you probably know by now, not all of our operations are conducted during daylight hours. The big bosses have just given me a job that needs a reliable pilot, and seeing that you have such an excellent track record with us, I think you'd be perfect for the job. Move this package to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Don't try to open it. In fact, don't even look at it. Seriously. It's in your best interest.

And you were never here. Wait, who are you? I don't know you. Capiche? Now get going.
messages.zh:
你现在可能已经知道了，并非我们的所有工作都是在光天化日下完成的。大老板们刚刚给了我个工作，需要一个值得信赖的飞行员去做。而你有非常出色的工作记录，所以我想你是这个任务的最佳人选。把这个包裹送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，千万不要打开。确切点说，看都不要看。我是认真的。这是为了你好。

而且你从没来过这里。慢着，你是谁？我不认识你。卡皮切？现在快走。

messages.en: The exotic dancers ordered for the CFO's birthday party are a little on the heavy side.  Now, they've been told they're going on a sight-seeing trip around one of the moons in a nearby system, but I want you to take them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and leave their fat asses behind.
messages.zh: 为CEO的生日晚会叫来的舞女都有点胖。我们告诉她们，她们将去附近星系的一颗卫星周围观光，不过我要你把她们带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，然后把这些肥猪扔下就走。

messages.en: Some science graduates travelling around the constellation had a short scheduled stop at this station. I've arranged things so that their own transport won't be leaving, and they've been pointed in your direction instead.  I want you to deliver them to an entirely different location from what they had in mind.
messages.zh: 一些在本星座周游的理科毕业生在这个空间站做了短暂停留。我做了些安排，让他们自己的运输舰无法离开，然后指点他们转而寻求你的帮助。我要你把他们送到完全出乎他们意料的另一个地方。

name.de: Unsere Jungs fangen an sich zu langweilen
name.ja: 我が仲間たちは退屈している

messages.zh: 附近星系的一艘矿物运载舰坏了，严重延缓了整个作业。请把这些机械部件送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这样他们才能继续工作。

messages.en: I need you to help out. There is fierce fighting going on in a nearby system and we have marines here that need to be moved out there as soon as humanly possible. Are you willing to help our cause?
messages.zh: 我要你帮个忙。附近星系正在发生激烈火拼，我们需要把这儿的海军队员尽快转移出去。你愿意帮忙吗？

messages.en: A mineral hauler has broken down in a nearby system, slowing down operations immensely. Please take these mechanical parts to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so they can get back on track
messages.zh: 附近星系的一艘矿物运载舰坏了，严重延缓了整个作业。请把这些机械部件送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这样他们才能继续工作。

messages.en: There has been an accident on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, but fortunately no one was hurt.  No one that matters, anyway. Please take these slaves over there to make up for the ones that perished.
messages.zh: 在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}发生了一次事故，不过幸运的是，没人受伤。总之，重要人物都没事。请把这些劳工带到那里去替代那些丧生的劳工。

messages.en: Take these people to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and don't tell anyone they were here.
messages.zh: 把此这些送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，别让任何人知道他们来过这里。

messages.en: Everything is overflowing with garbage.  I want you to take it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  I've done some fixing on the documents. They think they're getting luxury foodstuffs.  You might want to get out of there before they open up the crates.
messages.zh: 到处都是垃圾。我要你去把这些垃圾送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。我已经对文件做了些改动。他们还以为得到的是精美的食品呢。你也许应该在他们打开箱子之前赶快离开。

messages.en: The monthly status reports were due last week, but it took us some time to iron out some wrinkles, if you know what I mean. Hurry up and get them over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Don't be late, or my ass is grass.
messages.zh: 月报本该在上周就上交，但我们花了相当长的时间“弥补漏洞”，我想你明白我的意思。快点把月报送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。别晚了，否则我就死定了。

messages.en: I lost a bet to the station manager over at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Convince him to take this as a down payment until I manage to come up with the money I owe him.
messages.zh: 我和{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的空间站管理人打赌赌输了。这是我给他的抵押，我会尽快把欠他的钱还给他。

name.ja: トランスミッターの交換

messages.en: It is time to replace the transmitters on the region's surveillance beacons.  Please take these over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so they can get it done.
messages.zh: 是时候更换星域侦察信标上的传信器了。请把这些送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这样他们就能搞定了。

messages.en: I want you to do me a personal favor. My last operative was busted with a cargohold full of drugs, leaving me in a difficult situation.  If this shipment doesn't get through I stand to lose my client, so don't mess it up.
messages.zh: 我想请你帮我个人一个忙。我的上一个特工在运送一整船违规药品时坏了事，使我陷入难堪的境地。如果这批货再出问题，我就肯定会失去这个客户了，所以别搞砸了。

name.ru: От плохого к худшему (From Bad To Worse)

messages.en: I've got some stragglers here that claim they were raided by pirates and picked up by a transport vessel on its way here. I've decided to be charitable. Take them to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, but make sure you get there before the prisoner transport leaves for the slave camps.
messages.zh: 我这里有些流浪者，他们声称遭到海盗的袭击，幸好被一艘运输舰救起运来这里。我决定做做善事。把他们带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，不过一定要在囚犯运输舰离站开往劳工营地前送到。

messages.en: The ship builders over in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} finished ahead of schedule, so we are going to throw them a party.  Bring these spirits over to them and you'll get a nice reward.
messages.zh: {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的造船师提前完成了工作，所以我要给他们开个庆功会。把这些幽灵饮料带给他们，你就会得到一笔可观的报酬。

messages.en: I noticed this morning that I was completely out of {[item]objectiveTypeID.name}, which is just dreadful since our next experiments use this component AND I've spent all of our funds already on other things.  So I request that you bring to me {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}, that should be enough to last us quite a while.
messages.zh: 我今天早上发现，我的{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}全用完了，这实在太糟了，因为我们接下来的实验要用到这种成分，而我已经把所有的资金花在别的东西上了。所以，我请你帮我带{[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}来，那些应该足够我们支撑一阵子了。

messages.en: I have a very special delivery that needs to be transported to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  The contents of the package are confidential, so do not even think of scanning it.  The recipient will extract the package from your hangar at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} as soon as you notify him that you're ready, no questions asked.  I promise to work double-overtime should you deliver this package for me today.
messages.zh: 我有一个很特别的快递要送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。包裹的内容是机密，所以你最好连扫描一下的念头都不要有。在你一切就绪后就通知接收人员，他会从你在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的机库中取走包裹，不得向他提任何问题。如果你今天帮我把包裹送过去，我保证我要加双倍的班。

messages.en: Ok, what do you want me to do?
messages.zh: 好，你要我做什么呢？

messages.en: Your job is to intercept a squadron of ships that have split off from the main armada.  It's probably a scouting party, and they've ventured awfully close to the Pagera's resting place.  You will be supplied with a bookmark, of course.
messages.zh: 你的任务是拦截从他们主舰队脱离出来的一中队飞船。这很可能是一支侦察队，他们已经非常接近帕格拉圣地。当然，你将得到位标。

messages.en: I'd like to fight for the cause, you got any work?
messages.zh: 我愿意为大业做出自己的贡献，你有工作给我么？

messages.en:
I've been looking for someone of your talents. It has come to our attention that an armada of Amarr crusaders has arrived in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. According to our sources, their primary objective is to destroy the Pagera Manton, which they view as being a sacrilegious icon of the Blood Raider faith. They believe the Blood Raider organization is defiling the graveyard of their ancestors, and their aim is to 'give them rest'.

These sorts of incursions are nothing new, but this time they mean business. I've never seen such a huge armada threaten our beloved holy site, and to top it off it's being led by one of the Amarrian High Priests, Heftah Nekmar, which is of some concern to us. He has recently led a campaign of propaganda against the Blood Raider religion from inside the Amarrian territories, and the destruction of the Pagera Manton would certainly be viewed as a mighty victory by his people.

Your job is to intercept a squadron of ships that have split off from the main armada. It's probably a scouting party, and they've ventured awfully close to the Pagera's resting place. You will be supplied with a bookmark, of course.
messages.zh:
我一直在找一个像你这么有才干的人。我们注意到一队艾玛十字军舰队来到了{[location]agentConstellationID.name}。情报显示，他们的主要目的是摧毁帕格拉曼通，他们认为那里是血袭者宗教的渎神象征。他们认为血袭者组织亵渎了他们祖先的墓地，而他们的目标是“让他们得到安息”。

这种袭击并不新鲜，不过这次他们来真的了。我从没见过这么大一支舰队前来威胁我们的圣地，而且更有甚者，他们这次的指挥是艾玛高阶牧师黑夫塔·内科马尔，他一直是我们的一块心病。他最近在艾玛境内发动了一场针对血袭者信仰的宣传运动，消灭帕格拉曼通肯定会被其支持者认为是场大胜利。

你的任务是拦截从他们主舰队脱离出来的一中队飞船。这很可能是一支侦察队，他们已经非常接近帕格拉圣地。当然，你将得到位标。

messages.en: Their scouts have been taken care of, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 侦察队已经消灭了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Good work.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮。

messages.en:
One of the most revered holy sites of the Blood Raiders is located in the constellation OK-FEM, called the Pagera Manton. The Pagera Manton was a giant space-ship that was at the head of a massive Amarrian exploration team that had ventured into unknown lands hundreds of years ago. A malfunction in its warp-drive stranded the ship, far away from the rest of the fleet. During that time space-communication was not as sophisticated as today, and it had no way of contacting other vessels of the expedition. Years passed and the crew had finally lost all hope of survival. Food supply was running dangerously low, and it seemed that starvation was inevitable. It was then that one of the officers, an Ammatar by the name of Kalorr Makur, took matters into his own hands. He staged a successful coup against the commanding officer of the ship and had his most loyal followers bind and gag the dissidents inside a secure chamber under his control. These unfortunate souls became the crews new food supply, unbeknownst to most of the crewmembers. For over a year this plan worked, although Kalorr did have to turn to his own followers eventually to replenish his stock of human meat.

Over a century later the ship was discovered by Blood Raider pioneers scouring the distant solar-systems of OK-FEM. They found the remains of the crew, and more importantly a few dozen gigantic tanks encasing millions of liters of blood. Unbeknownst to them the blood had been collected by Kalorr who dried the human meat before consumption. The blood had been meant as a final foodsource after the meat supply had run out, but was never actually consumed as the machine responsible for recycling the air supply malfunctioned which caused the remaining crew to slowly suffocate. Fortunately the blood containers were kept in sub-freezing temperature, which despite over a centry of decay were still up and working when the Pagera was found. And not only that, Kalorr Makur's body was discovered in its very own container, along with his closest allies.

News of the find quickly spread through the Blood Raider territories, and their revered High Priest at the time declared it a 'gift from God'. The blood was stripped from the tanks and brought back to the Blood Raider headquarters for examination and ritualistic purposes. Kalorr was cloned, using genetic material retrieved from his body taken from the Pagera, and he was immediately instated as an officer of the Blood Raiders. Years later he was even made into a saint.

And to this day the Pagera is closely guarded by Kalorr and his small army of clones, extremely loyal to the Blood Raiders. Drugs, many generations of cloning and a terrible history has rendered the former Amarrian expeditioner completely insane. And despite the Pagera being a popular point of pilgrimage for the members of the Blood Raider organization, few venture there outside of large, heavily armed groups. Kalorr is known to pick off stragglers for his sinister rituals, no matter to which religion or organization they belong to.
messages.zh:
在OK-FEM中有着血袭者为数不多的圣地之一，名唤帕格拉曼通。帕格拉曼通曾经是一艘巨大的太空飞船，数百年前，它带领着一支庞大的艾玛探险队勇敢驶入了未知的宇宙空间。由于跃迁引擎故障，飞船陷入困境，被舰队远远落在后面。当时的太空通讯科技远不如今天发达，他们没有方法与远征队的其他船只取得联系。时间年复一年的过去，船员们终于放弃了求生的希望。食物即将耗尽，饥饿在所难免。就在那时，一位名叫卡尔勒·马库尔的艾玛达人决定用自己的方式寻找出路。他成功策划了针对飞船指挥官的叛变，并指使最忠诚的追随者把反对者绑起来，然后把那些反对者关押入由他自己控制的一个密室。那些反对者成了船员们的食物，大多数船员自己都不知道。这种做法持续了一年多，不过卡尔勒最终还是把自己的支持者也作为了食物。

一个世纪后，巡逻于OK-FEM偏远地区的血袭者开拓队发现了该艘船。他们发现了船员遗体，更重要的是他们还发现了装有数百万升血液的巨型集装箱。他们不知道的是这些血是卡尔勒在吃人之前先从人体内提取出来的。本来卡尔勒他们是想把血作为人肉吃光后最后一道餐的，但由于供氧系统出了问题导致船员慢慢窒息而死，那些血最终也就没被动过。所幸那些血保存在冰点温度，因此即使一个世纪过去它们还没变质。除此之外，卡尔勒·马库尔本人的尸体也被找到。

这次的发现消息很快传遍了血袭者组织。他们的高阶牧师还称其为“神赐予的礼物”。那些海量血液被血袭者带回了总部用作研究及举办宗教仪式。卡尔勒本人也被克隆，然后立马被任命为血袭者官员一职。数年之后他甚至成了圣徒。

现在，帕格拉由卡尔勒及他的一小队克隆人严密把守，他们绝对忠于血袭者。在经历了药物伤害、数代克隆以及一段可怕的历史之后，这位前艾玛探索者完全丧失了理性。尽管帕格拉是血袭者圣地，但很少有人敢在戒备森严的武装部队眼皮之外活动。很多人都知道卡尔勒六亲不认，喜欢抓获迷路人，然后用于其邪恶的祭祀台上。

messages.en: Now what?
messages.zh: 现在又怎么了？

messages.en: Apparently the group of ships you destroyed in your previous mission were just a part of a larger scouting party.  Their comrades are still in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, probably looking for any traces you left behind to track you down.  Please remove this threat before they trace your movements here, we'd rather not lose this outpost because of your blunders.
messages.zh: 显然，你上次任务中消灭的那支舰队只是一支更大的侦察队的一部分。他们的同志还在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，很可能在找寻你留下的任何踪迹以便找到你。在他们一路追踪你到这来之前解除这股威胁，我们可不想因为你的失误而失去这个哨站。

messages.en: Excellent work.
messages.zh: 干得很好！

messages.en: You look frustrated.  What's up?
messages.zh: 你看上去很沮丧，怎么了？

messages.en:
Those blasted migrants are causing trouble again. Because of the abundance of gas clouds in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, our space is just crawling with them. As a matter of fact, a large group of Khanid harvesters built an outpost right next to my hideout in M0O-JG! I spent years building that place, and now they want to keep me out of my own home. I can't even go back without being shot at. It's just not right I tell you.

What I need you to do is find their outpost and blow it to bits. That should nudge them away, but it's not going to be easy. They locked and booby-trapped the acceleration gate leading into the deadspace pocket containing their base, so we have to find the key somehow. I know where they normally work, which is near a collection of massive gas clouds which they tend to harvest. I want you to ambush them there, and bring back captives for interrogation.
messages.zh: 又是那些该死的移民。由于{[location]agentConstellationID.name}气云资源丰富，我们的后院里挤满了这些家伙。事实上，一大群卡尼迪采集人员在我M0O-JG的藏身地边上造了个哨站！我花了很多年时间建设那个地方，而他们现在竟企图把我赶出自己的家园。我甚至一回去就要挨枪子。跟你说，这绝对不公平。<br><br>我需要你做的就是找到他们的哨站，把它炸成碎片。那应该能让他们知难而退。不过这不是件容易的事。他们给通往他们基地所在死亡空间层的加速轨道上了锁，还设置了机关，所以我们无论如何必须找到钥匙。我知道他们一般在哪里工作，那里靠近一大片气云，他们企图开采那片地方。我要你去那里伏击他们，带几个俘虏回来审讯。

messages.en: I'm back, and I have some captives from their ships as you requested.
messages.zh: 我回来了，按照你的要求，还带回几个俘虏。

messages.en: Excellent.  I'll have them interrogated immediately.  Then maybe I'll have them sacrificed on the altar.  Yes that will do.
messages.zh: 很好。我会立即让他们接收审问。然后我可能会让他们当作祭品送上神坛。是的，就这么做。

messages.en:
Those blasted migrants are causing trouble again. Because of the abundance of gas clouds in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, our space is just crawling with them. As a matter of fact, a large group of Khanid harvesters built an outpost right next to my hideout in M0O-JG! I spent years building that place, and now they want to keep me out of my own home. I can't even go back without being shot at. It's just not right I tell you.

What I need you to do is find their outpost and blow it to bits. That should nudge them away, but it's not going to be easy. They locked and booby-trapped the acceleration gate leading into the deadspace pocket containing their base, so we have to find the key somehow. I know where they normally work, which is near a collection of massive gas clouds which they tend to harvest. I want you to ambush them there, and bring back captives for interrogation.

messages.en: So how's the interrogation coming?
messages.zh: 审讯有结果了么？

messages.en:
The interrogation is going well. They coughed up the access codes to the acceleration gate immediately. They look like frightened animals in fact, so entertaining. We'll have such fun together...

But now to more important matters. I will upload the access codes into your ship's mainframe, that should allow you to use the acceleration gate without problems. Once you have the bookmark, I expect you to warp out there and obliterate that base. And bring any stragglers to me, I so enjoy those sacrificial rituals.
messages.zh:
他们很快就吐露了加速轨道的通行密码。实际上，他们看上去像是受惊的动物，太搞笑了。我们肯定会度过一些有趣的时光*咯咯笑*。

好，现在说正事。我会把通行密码上传到你飞船的主机上，这样你就可以自由使用加速轨道了。获得位标后，我希望你跃迁过去，铲平那个基地。带几个来不及逃命的回来，我太喜欢活祭仪式了。

messages.en: A fine job, {[character]player.name}.  We need more people like you around here.
messages.zh: 干得不错，{[character]player.name}。真希望像你这么出色的人能多些。

messages.en:
The interrogation is going well. They coughed up the access codes to the acceleration gate immediately. They look like frightened animals in fact, so entertaining. We'll have such fun together...

But now to more important matters. I will upload the access codes into your ship's mainframe, that should allow you to use the acceleration gate without problems. Once you have the bookmark, I expect you to warp out there and obliterate that base. And bring any stragglers to me, I so enjoy those sacrificial rituals.

messages.en: I will do as you command.
messages.zh: 我会按你的要求做的。

messages.en: Be on your way then.  I've already updated your NeoCom with the coordinates.  Do not leave any survivors.
messages.zh: 那么去吧。我已经把坐标上传到你的控制边栏里了。全部消灭。

messages.en: I seek work.
messages.zh: 我想找些活干。

messages.en:
I have a very dire situation on my hands at the moment. I have been the caretaker of a few dozen slaves for 5 years now, and recently the unthinkable happened. They managed to convert a few of our pod clones to their side, and together they have made an audacious get-away from the slave pens. Fortunately, we still have them on our radar, but we fear they might try to use one of the smuggler gates in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} to escape.

Obviously, it will set a very bad precedent should they manage to successfully get away. We can't have that. There's enough rebelliousness and infighting as it is within our ranks.

Although it pains me to say this, I require that you destroy all of the vessels carrying these rebels. They will be flying our ships, but will not hesitate to fire upon you - so feel free to extend the same courtesy. I will give you the precise coordinates of their whereabouts, of course.
messages.zh:
这儿有个棘手的状况：我管理几十个劳工已经五年了， 现在发生了一件意想不到的事。他们把我们的一些克隆弄走了，而且还大胆尝试出逃。幸好目前他们还在我们雷达的控制范围下，不过我担心他们会从{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的非法贩售星门逃跑，这样子就出了我们的控制范围。

显然要是他们这次成功逃出我们的领地，那将是个十分不好的前例。我们绝不能让这样的事情发生，这里已有很多内讧和反叛情绪了。

虽然我很不情愿给你布置这样的任务，但你必须把那些叛徒的飞船都干掉。他们可能开着我们的飞船，但绝不会对血袭者的人心思手软，所以你一看到他们就要猛力开火。我会稍后把他们位置的精确坐标给你。

messages.en: Nicely done.
messages.zh: 做得很漂亮。

messages.en:
If you're looking for work then you've come to the right place. I have a very dire situation on my hands at the moment. I have been the caretaker of a few dozen slaves for 5 years now, and recently the unthinkable happened. They managed to convert a few of our pod clones to their side, and together they have made an audacious get-away from the slave pens. messages.en: Uhm, there were a little more than just a "few" clones out there, you filthy liar. I quit.
messages.zh: 哼，那儿不光只是“几个”克隆体，你这个卑劣的骗子。我退出。

messages.en: Useless!
messages.zh: 我是骗子，是吗？！你以为我会是什么，白痴？你是在给血袭者工作，不是为姐妹会服务！别再让我看到你那发牢骚的臭脸，出去的时候别让门撞到你屁股！不，最好被撞到。也许那响声会一直回荡在你脑中，好让你清醒一点。

messages.en: I'll do it.
messages.zh: 交给我吧。

messages.en: <font color = #EE3B3B>Oh, and bring me the head of their leader.  I will present that to our people as a reminder of what happens to those who double-cross the Blood Raiders.</font>
messages.zh: 噢，把他们首领的人头带给我。我会把这个出卖血袭者的人的脑袋展示给我们的人，以儆效尤。

messages.en: Anything else you need done?
messages.zh: 还有什么可以为您效劳呢？

messages.en:
Unfortunately, we discovered a few stragglers who avoided the fate of those rebels you took care of in that last assignment. Worse, we think they're about to make an attempt to reach an old abandoned stargate in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. Their getting away would be a huge embarrassment, so I want you to get to that stargate first in order to foil their plans.

There's something that will work in your favor though: This particular stargate is a very old model, and it needs to be powered up for a while before it will work. Therefore you'll have a few minutes to destroy the escapees before the stargate is completely powered up. Don't bother to attack the stargate itself ? if you destroy it they'll just warp away, and then who knows when we'll have another chance to catch them.

Oh, and bring me the head of their leader. I will present that to our people as a reminder of what happens to those who double-cross the Blood Raiders.
messages.zh:
很遗憾我们发现了一些从你上一个任务中幸存的散兵，更严重的是他们很可能在尝试通往位于{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的一个古老星门。我们不能让他们就这么去到那里，这将成为一个无比的耻辱。所以我将你调派到这个任务上，你得要赶在恰当的时间前抵达这个星门，破坏他们的这个计划。

你也可以按照你的喜好来决定他们的命运。由于这个星门已经非常的老旧，想要把它启动起来的需要花上些时间才行。那么你可以趁着星门还没有完全启动，把这些砸碎都解决掉，如果你把星门给摧毁掉了，这样他们就无路可走只能四处逃窜了，我们也可能丧失仅有的消灭他们的机会。

恩，把他们首领的头颅带来给我，我将把它展示给我们的人民，让他们记住背叛血袭者联盟的后果。

messages.en: A fine job, {[character]player.name}. And good riddance to those traitorous clones. We'll have to take extra precautions so that this doesn't happen again.
messages.zh: 干得很好，{[character]player.name}。你漂亮地铲除了那些克隆体叛徒。我们得加倍小心，以免这种事情再次发生。

messages.en: I'll bring them here in a jiffy.
messages.zh: 我会把他们完完整整载回来。

messages.en: Great.  And make sure they get here alive.
messages.zh: 很好。要确保把他们活着带来。

messages.en:
I have just the job for someone like you. My underlings have rounded up hundreds of those pesky gas harvesters who keep flooding into OK-FEM. I want them all moved here to Blood Reach, where they'll be used for various purposes *sly grin*.

I'll upload a bookmark to where my men are holding them, just retrieve them from the prison and bring them to me.
messages.zh:
我刚好有个工作适合你这样的人。我的属下围捕了数百个不断涌入OK-FEM的气云采集者。我想把他们都转移到血之死域，他们有很多用途*狡猾地笑*。

我会把他们的关押地的位标给你，把他们从牢狱里弄出来，带给我。

messages.en: You had any trouble getting them here?  I heard Nevar had assembled a gang to steal back the slaves, but since you got them all here I assume he was unsuccessful.
messages.zh: 你在带他们来时遇到什么困难了吗？我听说内瓦召集了一群人，想要偷回那些劳工，不过既然你把他们都带来了，那么我想他没能成功。
