name.ru: Рабы на заклание (Slaves To The Slaughter)  (2 из 2)

messages.en: What's next?
messages.zh: 下一步呢？

messages.en:
Nevar's gang needs to be taken care of. It's comprised of mercenaries and militia under the command of the mercenary general Nevar Took, and they've been hounding us ever since we raided one of the harvester colonies under their protection. I want as many of them dead as possible, especially the leader. They probably won't recover from a blow like that.

I want you to venture to one of their hideouts which we've discovered. Hopefully you'll find Nevar there, if not then simply dispatch as many of them as possible.
messages.zh:
胆敢跟我们抢劳工的人都得去死。内瓦·图克组建了一支佣兵和民兵的混编部队，在我们的地盘上绕来绕去，伺机捞上一把。我看他不爽很久了。去干掉他，还有他的党羽，越多越好。打他个一蹶不振！

你的目标是图瓦的秘密基地。希望你能撞到内瓦。如果他没出现，就把看到的所有人都干掉。

messages.en: You got Nevar?  Wonderful.  Not only will this get them off our backs, we'll have even more opportunities to raid their pitiful harvester and mining colonies with impunity.
messages.zh: 你抓到了内瓦？好极了。这不仅能让他们停止骚扰我们，我们甚至还能袭击他们可怜的采集站和采矿殖民地而没有后顾之忧。

messages.en:
Nevar's gang needs to be taken care of. It's comprised of mercenaries and militia under the command of the mercenary general Nevar Took, and they've been hounding us ever since we raided one of the harvester colonies under their protection. I want as many of them dead as possible, especially the leader. They probably won't recover from a blow like that.

I want you to venture to one of their hideouts which we've discovered. Hopefully you'll find Nevar there, if not then simply dispatch as many of them as possible.
messages.zh:
必须有人料理掉内瓦的帮派。这支帮派由雇佣兵和民兵组成，由雇佣兵将军内瓦·图克率领。自从我们袭击他们保护下的一个采集殖民地后，他们就一直追击我们。我要他们死，死得越多越好，尤其是他们的首领。他们将无法从这样的打击中复原。

我要你闯入已发现的他们的一个藏身处。你可能会在那里找到内瓦，如果没有，你就尽可能消灭那里的家伙。

name.es: La puerta de la muerte (1 de 2)
name.fr: Les portes de la mort (1 sur 2)

messages.en: I'll do my best.
messages.zh: 我尽力吧。

messages.en: Get going then.
messages.zh: 行，快去吧。

messages.en: I heard you had some work.
messages.zh: 我听说你有差事要人来做。

messages.en:
I need someone to help me retrieve one of my clones. He's stuck near the Pagera Manton, his ship pretty much destroyed by Kalorr's gang when it accidentally ventured too close to the Pagera. We must act quickly, before Kalorr decides to make a meal out of the guy.

I will give you a bookmark to the Pagera. But whatever you do, don't venture too close to the holy site. Kalorr will not look too kindly upon that, and I have a feeling he's not in the best of moods ... not ever.
messages.zh:
是的，我需要有人来帮我找回我的一个克隆体。他滞留在了帕格拉曼通附近，他的飞船由于意外过于接近帕格拉而被卡尔勒的人毁得差不多了。我们必须行动迅速，一定要赶在卡尔勒决定享用这个躯体之前。

我会给你去帕格拉的位标。但是不管你做什么，千万不要离那个圣地太近。卡尔勒对冒犯圣地者不会手下留情，而且我感觉他现在心情不佳……他心情从来都没好过。

messages.en: Excellent.  But don't run off just yet, as I have one more task in store for you.
messages.zh: 很好。先别走，我还有个任务给你。

messages.en:
One of the most revered holy sites of the Blood Raiders is located in the constellation OK-FEM. The original Pagera Manton was a gigantic battleship, flagship of a massive Amarrian exploration team seeking unknown systems roughly 200 years ago. However, a malfunction of the then newly built jumpgate into OK-FEM caused an explosion in the Pagera Manton's tachyonometry, resulting in the destruction of its subwarp drives. The ship was stranded in a distant and uninhabited system, and space communication not being as sophisticated as it is today, the Manton had no way of contacting other vessels of the expedition.

Years passed and the crew eventually lost all hope of survival. The food supply running dangerously low, starvation was imminent. Then, one of the senior officers, an Amarr Holder (and secretly a Sani Sabik adherent) by the name of Lieutenant-Commander Kalorr Makur, took matters into his own hands: He staged a successful coup against the ship's commanding officer and had his most loyal followers bind and gag the dissidents within a secure chamber. These unfortunate souls became the new leadership's food supply, although Makur apparently managed to keep this fact secret from most of his followers. According to the ship's logs, maintained by Makur, this plan worked for several years... although there is evidence that Makur did occasionally turn to his own followers to replenish his "stock," hiding his motives behind the guise of executions for crimes supposedly committed against the commander. Eventually, the ship's air supply malfunctioned, and the sixty or so remaining crewmembers slowly suffocated.

Over a century later, some time before the Amarr invasion of the Minmatar homeworlds, the ship was discovered by Amarr outlaws. They found the remains of the crew, and more importantly a few enormous tanks holding thousands of liters of human blood; it seems Makur had dried his human meat before consumption. The blood had been intended as a final food source after the meat supply had run out, but was never actually consumed before Makur and his crew died. Fortunately the containers were kept in cryo-vaults, which despite over a century of decay were still up and working when the Manton was found. And Kalorr Makur's body was discovered in its very own cryo-tank, along with those of his closest allies.

News of the find quickly spread throughout the pirates in the region and thence into the territories of the nascent Blood Raiders, whose revered High Priest declared the Manton a "gift from God." The blood was brought back to the Raider headquarters. Kalorr Makur was cloned using genetic material retrieved from his body, and immediately instated as an officer of the Blood Raiders. Several years later, he was beatified and sainted.

To this day, the floating wreck of the Pagera Manton is closely guarded by Makur and his small army of clones, all extremely loyal to the Blood Raiders. Drugs, many generations of cloning, and a terrible personal history have rendered the former Amarrian capsuleer completely insane. And despite the Pagera being a popular point of pilgrimage for the members of the Blood Raider organization, few even of that cult venture there outside of large, heavily armed groups, for Makur is known to pick off stragglers for his sinister rituals no matter to what religion or organization they belong.
messages.zh:
OK-FEM星座内座落着血袭者最为崇敬的圣地之一。最初的帕格拉曼通是一艘巨型战列舰。大约200年前，一支大型艾玛探险队前去探索未知的星系，它就是这支队伍的旗舰。但由于通往OK-FEM的新建跳跃门发生故障，致使帕格拉曼通的超光速粒子测量仪内部发生爆炸，导致子跃迁引擎毁坏。这艘舰船被困在了遥远的无人星系，而当时的太空通信不像现在这样精密和先进，因此曼通没有办法与探险队的其他舰船取得联系。

时间年复一年的过去，船员们终于放弃了求生的希望。食物即将耗尽，饥饿所难免。就在那时，一位名叫卡尔勒·马库尔的艾玛达人决定用自己的方式寻找出路。他成功策划了针对飞船指挥官的叛变，并指使最忠诚的追随者把反对者绑起来，然后把那些反对者关押入由他自己控制的一个密室。那些反对者成了船员们的食物，大多数船员自己都不知道。这种做法持续了一年多，不过卡尔勒最终还是把自己的支持者也作为了食物。 一个世纪后，巡逻于OK-FEM偏远地区的血袭者开拓队发现了该艘船。他们发现了船员遗体，更重要的是他们还发现了装有数百万升血液的巨型集装箱。他们不知道的是这些血是卡尔勒在吃人之前先从人体内提取出来的。本来卡尔勒他们是想把血作为餐后最后一道餐的，但由于供氧系统出了问题导致船员慢慢窒息而死，那些血最终也就没被动过。所幸那些血保存在冰点温度，因此即使一个世纪过去它们还没变质。除此之外，卡尔勒·马库尔本人的尸体也被找到。 这次的发现消息很快传遍了血袭者组织。他们的高阶牧师还称其为“神赐予的礼物”。那些海量血液被血袭者带回了总部用作研究及举办宗教仪式。卡尔勒本人也被克隆，然后立马接任血袭者官员一职。数年之后他甚至成了圣徒。 现在，帕格拉由卡尔勒及他的一小队克隆人严密把守，他们绝对忠于血袭者。在经历了药物伤害、数代克隆以及一段可怕的历史之后，这位前艾玛探索者完全丧失了理性。尽管帕格拉是血袭者圣地，但很少有人敢在戒备森严的武装部队眼皮之外活动。很多人都知道卡尔勒六亲不认，喜欢抓获迷路人，然后用于其邪恶的祭祀台上。

messages.en: The Pagera Manton
messages.zh: 帕格拉曼通

messages.en:
I need someone to help me retrieve one of my clones. He's stuck near the Pagera Manton, his ship pretty much destroyed by Kalorr's gang when it accidentally ventured too close to the Pagera. We must act quickly, before Kalorr decides to make a meal out of the guy.

I will give you a bookmark to the Pagera. But whatever you do, don't venture too close to the holy site. Kalorr will not look too kindly upon that, and I have a feeling he's not in the best of moods ... not ever.
messages.zh:
是的，我需要有人来帮我找回我的一个克隆体。他滞留在了帕格拉曼通附近，他的飞船由于意外过于接近帕格拉而被卡尔勒的人毁得差不多了。我们必须行动迅速，一定要赶在卡尔勒决定享用这个躯体之前。

我会给你去帕格拉的位标。但是不管你做什么，千万不要离那个圣地太近。卡尔勒对冒犯圣地者不会手下留情，而且我感觉他现在心情不佳……他心情从来都没好过。

name.es: La puerta de la muerte (2 de 2)
name.fr: Les portes de la mort (2 sur 2)

messages.en: I'll do it.  But how do I find Nekmar?
messages.zh: 交给我吧。可我怎样才能找到内科马尔呢？

messages.en: You won't have to look hard for Nekmar.  We know of his base of operations; I'll supply you with a bookmark to it.
messages.zh: 不要着急。我们知道他基地的位置；我会把位标传给你。

messages.en: Do you have any more tasks for me?
messages.zh: 你还有任务给我么？

messages.en: I believe it's time to turn our eyes towards the defilers, led by the vile High Priest Heftah Nekmar. He's been a problem for years, and now he has the audacity to venture into our territory to attack our beliefs! He must be punished! An example must be set! And you shall be the deliverer of our wrath.
messages.zh: 是时候惩罚那些亵渎者了，他们的首领是邪恶的高阶牧师黑夫塔·内科马尔。多年来，此人一直是我们的眼中钉肉中刺，现在居然敢来到我们的领土干预我们的宗教？！他必须受到惩罚，而你就是愤怒的传递者。

messages.en: Your destiny obviously lies with the Blood Raider Covenant. And this day is a further testament of that fact. May your reward serve you well.
messages.zh: 你显然与血袭者同盟共命运。今天又证明了这一点。愿你对酬金满意。

name.en: Kaymotin's Scout - Gas Cloud Survey (1 of 2)
name.es: Explorador de Kaymotin: Prospección de nubes de gas (1 de 2)
name.fr: Éclaireur de Kaymotin - Sondage de nuage de gaz (1 sur 2)
name.ja: ケイモティンの偵察船-ガス雲調査（1/2）
name.ru: Разведчик Kaymotin - исследование газовых облаков (Kaymotin's Scout - Gas Cloud Survey) (1из 2)
name.zh: 卡伊默丁的卫兵—气云勘探 (1/2)

messages.en: I'll get that sample for you in no time.
messages.zh: 我很快就能让你得到你想要的样本。

messages.en: Excellent.
messages.zh: 太好了

messages.en:
Welcome to Yakura Harvesting Depot, {[character]player.name}. I have use for someone like you. You see, I'm not the typical Serpentis member, in fact I never took up the stereotypical practice of piracy. Instead I've devoted my life to creating a business which specializes in harvesting gas and rock from the Pegasus constellation. I still work for the Serpentis of course, but I've more interest in finding lucrative roid and gas fields than bullying the passersby.

Anyway, I have a small job for you. Our scanners have indicated that there is a large quantity of gas clouds in a certain area in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We think the source is pretty close to a certain asteroid belt, which has been claimed by an Astral Mining Inc. expedition. I want you to warp over to this asteroid belt and take a sample from one of the asteroids there, bring it back to me for inspection. We're hoping to find gas residue on the rock which would indicate the presence of gas clouds nearby.
messages.zh:
欢迎来到雅库哈开采站，{[character]player.name}。你这样的人对我来说非常有用，你看，我并不象其它的天蛇成员那样，实际上我从来都不看好传统的海盗行为。相反，我花掉了大量的时间和精力去和采矿的专家打交道，以此来为开发飞马座的气云和矿石找到门路，创造更大的商业机会。当然我仍然是在为天蛇集团工作，只是相比威胁恐吓过路人来说我更关心怎样才能从这些矿藏中获得利润而已。

不管怎样，我这里有个小小的任务想交给你帮我办。我们的扫描器发现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的某各地方可能有大片的气云可供开采，我们分析认为这个矿源可能距离一个被星形矿业探险队占有的小型带非常近。我想你跃迁到这个小行星带为我带回一些岩石样本，我希望能够从这些样本上找到气云沉积残留物的痕迹以此来判断这个气云是否存在于它的附近。

messages.en: This sample should do nicely.
messages.zh: 这个样本应该足够我使用了。

name.es: Explorador de Kaymotin: Naves mineras fuera de combate (2 de 2)
name.fr: Éclaireur de Kaymotin – Sus aux mineurs (2 sur 2)
name.ja: ケイモティンの偵察船-鉱山労働者を排除せよ（2/2）
name.ru: Разведчик Kaymotin - выдворение шахтеров (Kaymotin's Scout - Remove The Miners) (2 из 2)
name.zh: 卡伊默丁的卫兵—铲除矿工(2/2)

messages.en: Anything else?
messages.zh: 有别的什么事情么？

messages.en:
The results of our tests indicate that vast swaths of gas clouds should be located not far from where you retrieved the sample. Since we expect the profits of harvesting these clouds to be extremely profitable, we're willing to risk a possible confrontation with Astral Mining Inc.

But first I want you to take care of their current expedition in the area. I want you to go back to where you found the sample and wait for the expedition to arrive. Destroy as many of their ships as you can, but it's imperative that you at least take out their commanding officers. That should cripple them long enough for us to move in and set up our defense perimeter before any reinforcements arrive.
messages.zh:
根据我们的实验分析结果显示在这个样本的采集点不远的地方就应该有丰富的气云矿可供开采。由于我们认为开采这些气云将带来极其丰厚的利润，所以我们愿意冒同星形矿业短兵相接的险。

但首先我想让你帮我们照顾一下那些已经在那里的星形矿业探险队。你得回到你采集这个样本地点，等待那些探险队的出现，然后尽可能的给与他们重创，至少消灭他们的指挥官是必须要做到的。这样的话我们就有足够的时间把队伍输送过去，并在他们的支援到来前建立起必要的防御设施。

messages.en: I've completed the assignment, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我已经完成了我的任务了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 干得好！{[character]player.name}。

The results of our tests indicate that vast swaths of gas clouds should be located not far from where you retrieved the sample. Since we expect the profits of harvesting these clouds to be extremely profitable, we're willing to risk a possible confrontation with Astral Mining Inc.

But first I want you to take care of their current expedition in the area. I want you to go back to where you found the sample and wait for the expedition to arrive. Destroy as many of their ships as you can, but it's imperative that you at least take out their commanding officers. That should cripple them long enough for us to move in and set up our defense perimeter before any reinforcements arrive.
messages.zh:
我们的测试结果显示在这个样本的获取地不远的地方就应该有大片的气云矿可供开采。我们估计采集这些气云将带来极其丰厚的利润，所以我们愿意冒同星形矿业短兵相接的危险。

但首先我想让你先料理一下他们已经在那里的探险队。我要你飞回样品采集点，等候探险队的到来。尽量多击毁他们的飞船，你必须至少消灭他们的指挥官，这是命令。那会使他们瘫痪很长时间，足以使我们进入该区域并在他们的援军到来前建立起自己的防御工事。

messages.en:
Hey there, {[character]player.name}. I have a task I want you to complete. If you do it right, I might have a small reward for you.

The next Legends Trial battle starts at midnight tonight, and as head of security around here, my job is to make sure it goes as smoothly as possible. However, there is a small problem. The documents detailing the fighters and their ships were scheduled to be delivered to me from {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} this morning. However, the courier assigned to the task has obviously failed us, and as such I need you to step up and fill his place. Go get the documents and bring them to me. Do it quickly and I will have a little something extra waiting for you.

Fly safe.
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}。我有一个任务交给你完成。如果你办妥当了，说不定我会给你一份小小的奖赏。

下一届传奇试练将在今天午夜进行。作为保安队长，我的职责就是确保比赛的顺利进行。但现在有个小问题。按照计划，参赛人员名单和舰船配置今天早上就该从{[location]objectiveLocationID.name}发出，送到我手里。但是，递送文件的那个信使显然辜负了我们的期望，所以我需要你挺身而出，补上这个空缺。去把文件拿回来给我。如果速度够快，我还有额外的奖励给你。

注意安全。

name.de: Wessette Gauze - Macht es so (1 von 2)
name.en: Wessette Gauze - Making It So (1 of 2)
name.fr: Wessette Gauze - L'issue du combat (1 sur 2)
name.ja: ウェッセッテガーゼ―密談（1/2）
name.ru: Wessette Gauze - достижение цели (Wessette Gauze - Making It So) (1 из 2)

messages.en: Done deal, i forsee no problems in dealing with this.
messages.zh: 成交。交给我吧。

messages.en:
Precisely one week from today, the Gallente Gaming Commission will have another Legends Trial tournament. The famed contestant, Kuroki Tselmi, will be going up against his long-time rival, Hadni Riiuto. Now, everybody loves to see two fighters face each other when they also have a personal dislike for each other. It makes the entire fight that much more intense. Of course, given the nature of mankind, everybody and their pet has placed some money on the outcome of this fight. 
Acquaintances of mine also placed money on this fight and we are all hoping that Kuroki Tselmi will win. He usually does, but it probably won't hurt if we try to give fate a little nudge, here. This is where you come in. 

I need you to go to Riiuto's agent. When you meet him, have a word with him about this whole business. He'll know what to do next, and we'll all be able to sleep a little easier at night knowing important people won't lose a lot of money on the match. 

Now, I have spoken to Riiuto's agent and he sounds fine with it, but keep your wits about you; don't go thinking this is going to be a walk in the bio-dome. This needs to go precisely as planned with no screw-ups, otherwise the Betting Commission will be on top of this like a Gallente escort, and they'll ride this thing for all it's worth if they find out.. I suggest you bring some friends to make sure the agent doesn't feel like telling anyone about this. What do you say, do we have a deal?
messages.zh: 从今天起，整整一个星期之后，盖伦特竞技委员会将举办另一场传奇试炼锦标赛。著名的竞技者库洛基·茨尔米将与他的宿敌，海迪·利乌托将同场竞技，决一胜负。带有私人恩怨的角斗会非常非常刺激，大家都爱看。这使得比赛的紧张程度大大上升。依照惯例，几乎所有观众都在比赛上下了注。我和兄弟们当然也不例外，我们看好库洛基·茨尔米。库洛基是个勇猛的战士，胜利的天平一直偏向于他，但我想你不介意再加个砝码吧。我想让你去找利乌托的代理人，和他商量一下，他知道该怎么做。而确保头头脑脑们听我建议投下的赌注一定能赚，我也能睡个安稳觉了。我刚知会过利乌托的代理人，他对此表现出了浓厚的兴趣。但我要提醒你，这绝不是一次简单的跑腿任务。必须严格按照计划执行，不然被博弈委员会得知此事，你我都不会有好下场。我建议你带几个朋友同行，确保代理人不要多嘴。事情就是这样，你愿意么？

messages.en: So you were ambushed. Hrmm. We might want to take more drastic measures to ensure the fight ends the way we want it to.
messages.zh: 你被伏击了？嗯，看来我必须采取更“极端”一些的措施来确保事情按照我们的意思进行。

messages.en: Of course, a genuine fan, and I'd hate to see our favourite          lose. You can count on me to make sure Riiuto chances upon “unforeseen circumstances.”
messages.zh: 当然啊，我是个真正的体育迷，我绝不愿看见我们喜爱的选手……失败。你放心交给我好了，我会让利乌托遭遇“不可预测的情况”的。

messages.en:
As it turns out, you did your job a little too well. We seem to have scared Riiuto into seeking protection from the Gaming Commission. Perhaps we should have stuck to bribery. Oh well, we'll remember that for next time. We still need Tselmi to win this match against Riiuto and one way of accomplishing that is having Riiuto pull out of the match prematurely due to “unforeseen circumstances,” or whatever the Commission will choose to call it when you blow him out of the sky.

Because of our previous attempt of nudging fate into the right and profitable direction for my friends, our boy Riiuto is a little more concerned about his safety. He is flying with a heavy escort, but luckily for you I have a plan that cannot fail if you follow the instructions to the letter. It's not that complicated; just go to the location and hide behind an asteroid. After some time you'll see Riiuto and his escort meet up with a fuel tanker to refuel their ships. This will be the time to come out of hiding and attack them. If you attack before this moment, Riiuto and his escort will know something is up.

I trust you will perform as well as you did before. Don't let me down now, because I took the liberty of placing a little more money on this, using another friend of mine. If you're good to me, I might add you to the payroll during the next Legends Trial, or get you better seats if you want to play it safe. You do want to Tselmi to win, right? I mean, you're a sports fan, right?
messages.zh:
上个任务做得不错，从利乌托的角度而言，做得太出色了，吓得他直接去竞赛委员会寻求帮助。这样一来就只有贿赂那些恶心的官员……等等，不，这次用不着贿赂。我们的目的是让库洛基赢得比赛，有很多方法能做到这一点。比如制造一点“纯属意外”的情况，比如利乌托横死太空。

要除掉利乌托并不容易，经过上次的意外，他已经大幅加强了保安，去哪里都有一大群护卫伴随。但你用不着担心，只需按照我的指示去做便可。飞去指定位置，耐心等待。目标会很快出现，补充燃料。抓住机会，打它个措手不及。

我相信你有足够能力完成任务，别让我失望！事成之后，或许我可以考虑让你加入我的信息网，在下次传奇试炼里赚它个盆满钵满。你是个体育迷吧，哈哈？

messages.en: ISK in the bank. Excellent job, my dear lad. I foresee a great future for you with us.
messages.zh: 星币已存入你的帐户。干得漂亮极了，我亲爱的伙计。我预见到你与我们合作，前途无量。

messages.en:
As it turns out, you did your job a little too well. We seem to have scared Riiuto into seeking protection from the Gaming Commission. Perhaps we should have stuck to bribery. Oh well, we'll remember that for next time. We still need Tselmi to win this match against Riiuto and one way of accomplishing that is having Riiuto pull out of the match prematurely due to “unforeseen circumstances,” or whatever the Commission will choose to call it when you blow him out of the sky.

Because of our previous attempt of nudging fate into the right and profitable direction for my friends, our boy Riiuto is a little more concerned about his safety. He is flying with a heavy escort, but luckily for you I have a plan that cannot fail if you follow the instructions to the letter. It's not that complicated; just go to the location and hide behind an asteroid. After some time you'll see Riiuto and his escort meet up with a fuel tanker to refuel their ships. This will be the time to come out of hiding and attack them. If you attack before this moment, Riiuto and his escort will know something is up.

I trust you will perform as well as you did before. Don't let me down now, because I took the liberty of placing a little more money on this, using another friend of mine. If you're good to me, I might add you to the payroll during the next Legends Trial, or get you better seats if you want to play it safe. You do want to Tselmi to win, right? I mean, you're a sports fan, right?

messages.en:
We had a team of people doing mining work for us in one of our harvester outposts. It's a thankless and hazardous job, eons away from the safe mining you ship pilots get to engage in. The harvesting equipment they have to use is incredibly dangerous in untrained hands and requires both physical strength and endurance, particularly for the length of time these people have to work. I daren't even think of the accidents that might have occurred had the Minecore harvesters not taken it on themselves to ease their working days a bit with some innocent entertainment. It breaks up the monotony somewhat, so that one's focus on the mining laser won't accidentally slip, leaving some poor soul plastered all over the nearby asteroids.

The Minecore harvesters aren't allowed to have any signals in their suits apart from the ones required to run their equipment. All they have is closed communication channels. So a few began telling jokes, and some of them shared stories from past work, and eventually it turned out that one or two of them, embarrassed though they were at first, could even carry a tune. There is now a core troupe of harvesters who have dedicated themselves to keeping up their coworkers' spirits, maintaining a steady stream of radio talk all through the day. These are men whose only thoughts were how long it was until the end of their shift and how much they were going to drink when they got back to their quarters, and now for the first time they all have something to look forward to.

Except that their workplace is now under siege by rogue drones, and the company apparently refuses to waste manpower rescuing 'expendable resources'. If these people die, the tradition dies with them, and the entire workforce slides back into old, ugly habits. I cannot let that happen, no matter what the company thinks. I want you to go in there and get them.
messages.zh: 我们有一支团队在采集哨站进行采矿工作。这是一份危险而又没有成就感的工作，和你们这些飞行员曾经参与的安全采矿有天壤之别。他们要使用的采集设备必须经过专业培训才能使用，否则极其危险，而且使用该设备需要体力和耐力，以他们的工作时间长度而言，这点尤其重要。我甚至不敢想象，要是那些矿源采集者不自己用一些简单的娱乐方法来缓解工作的劳累，真不知道会发生什么样的事故。这样的娱乐至少能稍微打破一下单调的生活，采集者就不会在操作采矿激光时开小差，否则附近的这片小行星就会有很多被误伤的倒霉鬼。<br><br>矿源集团采集者的工作服中不允许有任何信号，除了运行设备所需的之外。他们所拥有的只是封闭式通信频道。 所以有几个人就开始讲笑话，还有一些人分享过去的工作经历，最后他们发现，他们中竟然有一两个人唱歌还不错，尽管他们刚开口唱时还很害羞。现在有一支由采集者组成的核心巡回演出队，他们致力于保持工人们的情绪，每天不间断地进行广播。本来这些人满脑子想的只是什么时候换班，回到居住舱该喝多少酒，而现在，他们平生第一次有了期盼。<br><br>只是他们的工作地点现在处在自由无人机的包围之下，而公司显然拒绝浪费人力来拯救他们这些“可牺牲资源”。如果这些人死了，那么这个惯例也就跟着消亡了，而且全体职工都要退回丑陋的旧习中。我不能让这种事发生，不管公司怎么想。我要你去那里救出他们。

messages.en:
Thank you for your task. I know not everyone cares about company morale, but with these poor people, distraction and boredom can kill. I'm sure the whole mess will give them plenty to talk about when they feel up to returning to work.

Unfortunately, we have a new problem. Not everyone feels so philanthropical toward their fellow man, even under circumstances where you'd think that people would stick together and help one another out. Now that you've cleared the last of the Minecore harvesters out of the area, the scavengers arrive. I have reason to believe that these rogue harvesters, unaffiliated with Minecore, have moved in and are proceeding to rob us of our equipment. These people undoubtedly intend to set up a business of their own, and plan to use our property as a starting point. The next step will certainly be attempts to headhunt our own employees, with extravagant offers of better working conditions, higher pay, more benefits and time off. Total and utter lies, all of it. Rogue operators pay even less, and if you desert the company to go work for them, you might as well have placed yourself in indentured servitude. I am not letting that happen to my people, especially now that they've built so much camaraderie and trust. I want you to return to the outpost, find these cowardly harvesters and destroy them, and retrieve our mining equipment.
messages.zh:
多谢你的帮助。我知道，许多人对工人的士气不屑一顾，那是因为他们不理解，倦怠和无趣会腐蚀一个矿工。我确定，这次历险给了那几个喜剧家更多的谈资。

不幸的是，我们遇到了新问题。不是每个人都对手下那么仁慈，即使是在如此恶劣、需要团结才能求得生存的环境下，有些人依然不明白理解与宽容的意义。既然你已经救回了区域内所有的矿源人员，那现在正在进行采集作业的，就一定是流浪的拾荒者。我怀疑他们会拿走矿源宝贵的设备器材，然后以此为基础自立门户。接下来的事情用手指也想得到，以高薪、优良的工作环境、终身福利等种种理由挖我们的墙角。谎话！全是谎话！小公司报酬更少，待遇更差，要想离职公司还会扣着你的档案不放！我从来不会这样对我的手下，何况他们已经建立了兄弟般的情感。我要你回到采集点，找到流浪的采矿者，除掉他们，把我们的采矿设备带回来。

name.fr: Bley Oreriel – Descente de la force CONCORD (1 sur 2)
name.ja: ブレイオーレリアル-CTF一斉検挙（1/2)
name.ru: Bley Oreriel - разгром CTF (Bley Oreriel - CTF Crackdown) (1 of 2)

messages.en: No worries. I´ll be back with him as soon as possible. And no boy bands. Got it.
messages.zh: 不用担心。我会尽快带他回来的。而且不放男孩团体的音乐。明白了。

messages.en: One of our labs a few systems out is under a DED blockade, and all our "material" there is being confiscated. Our guards are being hit with serious firepower even as we speak. Now, most of our mobile research facilities are expendable, but this one is a bit special. Get in there and retrieve the imprisoned chemist, Achove Oullen.
messages.zh: 我们在几个星系外的一个实验室受到DED的查封，而且所有“物资”都被没收。就在我们说话的当口，我们的守卫正遭到猛烈的炮火攻击。我们大多数移动研究设施都是可有可无的，但这个实验室却有些特殊。去那里救回被囚禁的化学家艾克夫·欧伦。

messages.en: Excellent. Now we just have to hope our dear friend recovers from his trauma and can get back to work A.S.A.P. But we still have to deal with thouse CTF Forces before the inflict more damage to our operation, so talk to me again in a minute, after I take this Com-call.
messages.zh: 很好。现在只希望我们亲爱的朋友从伤痛中恢复过来，尽快投入他的工作。目前我们需要先对付CTF部队，以免他们对我们的业务再造成任何损害。过一会儿再来找我，我要先接一个计算机。

messages.en:
One of our labs a few systems out is under a DED blockade, and all our "material" there is being confiscated. Our guards are being hit with serious firepower even as we speak. Now, most of our mobile research facilities are expendable, but this one is a bit special. Our lead chemist there, Achove Oullen, was recruited after his rather embarrassing fall from grace at Poteque Pharmaceuticals. The man was an incredibly hard worker, often spending entire nights in his laboratory, and had been doing sterling work for the company.

Unbeknownst to his superiors, though, he had a tendency to use the lab for certain pet projects outside office hours. Most of these were completely illegal, of course, and poor Achove was found out when he attempted to synthesize a new drug that would allow the user to experience synesthetic highs, in which you see smells, taste sounds, and so on. His first test of the drug held him in rapt fascination all night.

All seemed to be going well until his radio alarm rang. Bit of a funny story, actually. Due to his frequent overnight stays at the lab, he had set the alarm to wake him at a preset hour in the morning so that he could take a quick shower and shave before his associates poured in, and had unwisely tuned it to a station that played almost nothing except the top 20 hits in the region. The songs apparently smelled and tasted so vile that he vomited, splattering equipment and furniture with chunky bile. He was still retching when his coworkers arrived on the scene, and to this day he still screams at the very mention of pop music.

All that aside, we felt he showed promise, so after he had been dismissed from Poteque, we snapped him up and set him back to work in earnest on his synesthetic drug, a booster called Sikes-8. The drug will be a key factor in our operation for the next year, but all this work will be for naught if poor Achove is taken into custody. Heh. No doubt they'll play an endless sequence of boy bands until he just cracks and tells them everything! Ha! But seriously, it would only be a matter of time before the Cartel got their hands on the information and used it to strengthen their hold on the drug market.

You have to intervene; retrieve the imprisoned Achove for us. Just be careful what you play on your ship's loudspeakers when you're on your way back....
messages.zh:
我们在几个星系外的一个实验室受到DED的查封，而且所有“物资”都被没收。就在我们说话的当口，我们的守卫正遭到猛烈的炮火攻击。我们大多数移动研究设施都是可有可无的，但这个实验室却有些特殊。我们的首席化学师艾克夫·欧伦在那里工作，在我们聘用他前，他曾任职于波特克制药工作，后来却因名誉扫地而尴尬离开。这个可怜的人曾是个不可思议的工作狂，经常整晚整晚待在实验室里工作，为波特克公司做出了杰出贡献。

但他瞒着自己的上级在工作之余利用实验室搞一些自己爱好的项目。当然大多数项目都是完全违法的。当可怜的艾克夫尝试合成一种新违规药品时被人发现了；这种违规药品可以使人体验到联觉的高潮，这些高潮能通过嗅觉、味觉、听觉以及其他感官感知。他第一次尝试这种违规药品的时候，整晚都神魂颠倒。<br><br>一切似乎都进展顺利，直到他的收音机闹钟响起才破坏了这一切。事实上，是个可笑的小故事。由于他经常通宵待在实验室，他设定了闹钟在早上把自己叫醒，这样他就可以在助手成批赶到前洗澡剃须；可惜他很不明智地把收音机设在了一个专放该地区TOP20歌曲的频道。那些歌曲的气味和口感显然恶劣之极，艾克夫呕吐起来，溅得设备和家具上都是大片的胆汁。同事们抵达实验室时，他的呕吐仍未停止，直到现在，艾克夫一听到有人提起流行音乐就要尖叫。<br><br>除了这些之外，我们觉得此人大有前途，所以在他被波特克解雇后，我们立刻把他抢了过来，让他继续研究这种联觉违规药品——一种名叫Sikes-8的增效剂。这种违规药品是我们明年业务的一项关键，要是艾克夫被捕，这一切就付诸东流了！哈！不过严肃地说，天使企业联合体得到这条信息，并把它用于强化他们对违规药品市场的掌控只是时间问题。<br><br>因此你必须出手；把被囚禁的艾克夫从牢狱中救出来。只是在你回来的时候，务必要小心使用你的舰载扩音器……

name.fr: Bley Oreriel – Descente de la force CONCORD (2 sur 2)
name.ja: ブレイオーレリアル-CTF一斉検挙（2/2)
name.ru: Bley Oreriel - разгром CTF (Bley Oreriel - CTF Crackdown) (2 of 2)

messages.en: Good on you, {[character]player.name}! Destroy every one of those shipyards and make sure all the defending forces are destroyed. No prisoners, and no survivors.
messages.zh: 你真太好了，{[character]player.name}！把所有船坞都击毁，并确保消灭所有防御部队。我们不需要俘虏。

messages.en:
While on a routine courier job, one of my pilots recently ran into CTF forces that nearly destroyed his ship. Fortunately, his systems were intact enough that he could track their heading. Our covert ops ships later scanned the area and eventually discovered what is likely a DED communications and supply station.

I want you to scope out the location, and if you find any hint of a CTF depot there, I want you to conduct a surgical strike on them before they know what's happening. If you come across any shipyards or supply facilities, I want them blown to pieces so they can't fuel and repair their ships, and if anyone stands in your way, hull their ships. Show no mercy.
messages.zh:
最近我的一个飞行员在做例行快递任务时遇到了CTF部队，差点被干掉。幸运的是，他的系统完好无损，因此他能够跟踪他们行进。我们的情报人员后来去那个地区仔细侦察了一番，发觉一个地方很像DED的通信供给空间站。

我要你彻底侦察那里，如果发现任何CTF站点的迹象，就给他们来个措手不及的打击。如果你看见任何船坞或补给设施，把它们炸成碎片，这样他们就没法补充燃料和修复舰船了。如果有人挡道，轰了他们。不要手下留情。

messages.en: Excellent work! Hopefully CTF will finally give up their efforts in our region ― or at least they won't be able to re-supply their ships in our space anymore ― and we can finally start mass-production of our new drugs. Oh, and by the way, Achove Oullen is doing well and extends his thanks. For what it's worth, he's taken up listening to Amarrian choral chanting, of all things...
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！希望CTF可以最终放弃在我们星域捣乱——或者至少，他们在我们的空间无法对他们船只进行补给了——我们终于可以开始批量生产新的药物了。噢，艾克夫·欧伦也很好，他要我代他表示感谢。对了，他竟然喜欢上了听艾玛唱诗班的颂唱，不知道是不是真的……

messages.en:
Ah, {[character]player.name}! Thanks again for saving Achove. I hope you remembered to place him a sound-proofed cabin on your way here.

The DED activities have begun to trouble us. There have been far too many sightings of their ships, including ones that would not be here unless they had a safe-house of some kind nearby. While on a routine courier job, one of my pilots recently ran into CTF forces that seemed entirely blasé about their ammo supplies ... at least judging by the prodigious amount they fired into his shield, armor, and structure. He barely escaped the onslaught; his ship was taking direct hits to its hull, and the barrage of munitions was such that it nearly roasted him in his pod. Despite being wounded and needing medical attention, he reported to me directly after he'd docked. Stout fellow.

He told me that after the CTF forces had fragged his ship for a while, they'd casually and inexplicably taken off, and fortunately his systems were intact enough that he could track their heading. He gave me as much information as he could, then headed off to the med labs to have new eyebrows tattooed on.

The information he gave me wasn't much to go on, but it was enough. Our covert ops ships scanned the area and eventually discovered a location that is extremely likely to hold a DED communications and supply station. As much as I'd like to avenge my brave pilot and his scorched eyebrows, we don't dare risk a full-scale attack on the depot for fear that they will pick up the fleet's signal on their scanner post. Instead, we need to send in a single ship, or maybe a small squad of pilots if you have some willing allies, hoping that they can sneak in without triggering a full-scale reaction.

I'm putting you in command of this operation. I want you to scope out the location, and if you find any hint of a CTF depot there, I want you to conduct a surgical strike on them before they know what's happening. If you come across any shipyards or supply facilities, I want them blown to pieces so they can't fuel and repair their ships, and if anyone stands in your way, hull their ships. Show no mercy.
messages.zh:
啊，{[character]player.name}！再次感谢你救了艾克夫。希望你在来的路上，没忘记把他放在隔音舱里。

现在DED的活动已让我们感到棘手了。他们的飞船实在太多了，而且等他们在附近有了安全据点后还会增派一些飞船过来。最近我的一个飞行员在做例行快递任务时遇到了CTF部队，他们一点也不吝啬弹药……至少从他们对他的飞船的护盾、装甲和结构造成的巨大破坏就可见一斑。他险些丧命；他的飞船船体硬度只剩最后几个百分点，敌人火力之猛差点把他在逃生舱里烤焦。尽管受伤严重并极其需要治疗，但他还是在进站后第一时间来向我报告此事。坚强的家伙啊。<br><br>他告诉我，CTF部队在把他击伤后不久，不知为何就漫不经心地离开了，幸运的是，他的系统尚有能力使他追踪到了那支部队的航向。他向我提供了他所知道的全部信息，然后去医学实验室植了一对新眉毛。<br><br>他给我的信息不是太多，不过这就足够了。 我们的情报人员后来去那个地区侦察了一番，最终发觉有个地方似乎座落着DED的一座通信补给空间站。虽然我十分想为那个勇敢的飞行员还有他烧焦的眉毛报仇，但是我们不敢冒然对那个站点发动全面进攻，因为我怕他们的扫描哨站会捕获到舰队的信号。所以我们需要派去一艘飞船或者一小队飞行员——如果你有愿意协助的盟友的话，希望他们能够偷偷潜入，避免引发敌人的全面反应。<br><br>我现在派你负责这项任务。我要你彻底侦察该区域，如果发现任何CTF站点的迹象，就给他们来个措手不及的打击。如果你看见任何船坞或补给设施，把它们炸成碎片，这样他们就没法补充燃料和修复舰船了。如果有人挡道，轰了他们。不要手下留情。

messages.en: No worries, I'll do this for you.
messages.zh: 不用担心，我会帮你找到这个混蛋的。

messages.en:
For quite some time now, we have been aware of a security leak within our organization. Federal operatives have always been willing to pay a lot of money for inside information, and it has become abundantly clear to us in recent days that one of our commanders has fallen prey to the temptation of working for both sides.

We have no proof as to who the leak might be, but recently some of our people retrieved an encoded computer chip from the wreckage of a scout outpost. The chip contained documents which we think provide clues to the mole's identity. The chip is slightly damaged, so some parts are unencrypted and other parts missing entirely.

I want you to take the chip and bring it to our best code decryptor. He currently resides deep within the A8-XBW system, and you might have to go through some rogue drones to reach him there. Don't annoy him too much: He values his privacy and doesn't like being disturbed. There is a data terminal at his docking bay, so dock there and then bring me back the news.

然而我们没有证据查明这人究竟是谁。但是我们的人最近从一个侦查哨站的残骸中得到了一块解码的电脑芯片，它很可能为我们查明卧底的身份提供线索。不过它轻微损坏了，所以部分内容没有加密，部分内容完全丢失了。

我要你把这块芯片带给我们最好的解码专家。他现在居住在A8-XBW星系，你可能会遇到些自由无人机才能到达他那儿。千万别令他生气：他非常注重隐私，不喜欢被打扰。他所在的停泊港有一个数据终端机，你在那儿停靠，有任何消息回来向我报告。

messages.en: Excellent, now we just wait until the data comes back and then we will deal with this informant and his contact.
messages.zh: 很好，现在我们要做的就是等待数据被传回来，然后再对付这个线人和他的联络人。

messages.en:

Federal operatives have always been willing to pay a lot of money for inside information, and it has become abundantly clear to us in recent days that one of our commanders has fallen prey to the temptation of working for both sides.

We have no proof as to who the leak might be, but recently some of our people retrieved an encoded computer chip from the wreckage of a scout outpost. The chip contained documents which we think provide clues to the mole's identity. The chip is slightly damaged, so some parts are unencrypted and other parts missing entirely.

name.en: Cliene Veine - Fixing the Problem (2 of 2)
name.es: Cliene Veine: La solución del problema (2 de 2)
name.fr: Cliene Veine – La solution au problème (2 sur 2)
name.ja: クレインベイノ―問題解決（2/2）
name.ru: Cliene Veine - Решение проблемы (Cliene Veine - Fixing the Problem) (2 of 2)

messages.en: No worries. This informant and his contact will be dead before the day has passed.
messages.zh: 不用担心。这个线人和他的联络人不会看见明天的太阳的。

messages.en:
Our decryption expert just got back to us with the results. Fortunately, the chip was not too damaged. We have some very trustworthy indications that the snitch is a well known commander within the organization. It came as quite a surprise to me personally that he would start playing for the other team, though in retrospect it does make sense that only someone in his position would have been able to feed the enemy the information they've apparently been receiving.

The commander is on vacation right now at his residence and doesn't go on active duty for three days, so now is the time to strike. His residence is in the A8-XBW system. Gear up and fly there as fast as you can. Make the bastard suffer for betraying us ― let's hope it will be sufficient warning for others not to do the same.

Return to me when you have completed your task.
messages.zh:
我们的解密专家刚刚与我们重新联系，并告诉了我们结果。幸好芯片的损坏程度还不算太糟糕。我们已经获得了非常可靠的信息，指出内奸是组织中一位非常有名望的指挥官。我听到这个消息时非常震惊，他竟然会为敌人效命，不过回头一想，正是处于他那样职位上的人才能提供敌人获得的那些情报——这完全合乎情理。

这名指挥官目前正在他的居所度假，三天后才会重返职位，所以现在正是我们攻击的最佳时机。他的居所就在A8-XBW星系。尽快全副武装并飞往该地。让这个混蛋知道背叛我们的下场——希望能够敲山震虎。

完成任务后回来向我报告。

messages.en: Lets hope our dealings with the Gallente Fleet is over and we can get back to making ISK.
messages.zh: 希望我们和盖伦特舰队的问题已经解决了，我们可以回去赚星币了。

name.ja: ジャーバスラディヤー-包囲（1/2）
name.ru: Jarvas Ladier - в осаде (Jarvas Ladier - Besieged) (1 из 2)

messages.en: Consider them in yulai.
messages.zh: 送敌人回尤拉

messages.en:
We have a big problem, and very little time to deal with it, {[character]player.name}. Four days ago, two of our squadrons conducted a strike on a small outpost not far from here, not realizing the place was a key tactical and scientific asset belonging to the Federation. In retaliation, Fed Navy HICOM has issued three platoons of combat ships to attack the Fountain region. According to our intel, they will be striking several vital targets of ours in the next twenty-four-hour period. Rumor has it the order came from President Roden himself, so we can expect them to bring big guns and larger numbers.

Losing these outposts is something we cannot afford, so we have to move swiftly and meet them head-on before they do their damage. Two teams have already been sent to intercept the first two squads. I want you to handle the third. We believe that they are currently residing at 4-EP12. Get over there and send them back to Yulai.
messages.zh: 我们有一个严重的问题，而我没有太多的时间来对付它，{[character]player.name}。四天前，我们的两个中队攻击了这里附近的一个空间站，但并不知道那里是联邦的关键战术和科技中心。作为报复，联邦海军最高指挥部派遣了三个舰队的兵力攻打源泉之域。根据我们获得的情报显示，在接下来的24小时里，他们将袭击我们的多个重要目标。有传闻说这个命令直接来自于莱登总统本人，由此我们可以想象得到他们将会带来的巨炮和无数的士兵。失去这些哨站是我们不能接受的，所以我们必须要在他们抵达前就予以截击。已经有两只队伍被调派到该地区去拦截敌方的两只先头部队。我要你去处理第三队敌人。我们相信现在正在4-EP12的某处整顿。赶快过去把他们都送回到尤拉去。

messages.en:
Great work. 
But somthing tells me they aren't done yet. So be ready if i need you in short notice.
messages.zh: 干得好。但我觉得好像还没有全部完成。所以准备好吧，我会随时需要你的。

name.ru: Jarvas Ladier - в осаде (Jarvas Ladier - Besieged) (2 из 2)

messages.en: Im on the case.
messages.zh: 我将接受这个工作

messages.en:
Something even bigger has come up, and I'm putting my best pilot, you, on the job. We've just learned that the group of Fed ships you took out wasn't just there for retaliation. It appears that through an informant within our ranks, the Federation have caught wind of our next-gen booster project. The platoons in question were reportedly dispatched for one purpose: to locate and terminate our star scientist, the one who masterminded the project and who currently holds the prototype formulas. The Federate officers you took care of were getting awfully close to him and managed to relay their information back to Fed Central before you took them out, so now we have an even larger Fed group attacking our primary research facilities in 4-EP12. 

The facility itself is not as important as the scientist himself, and the plans he holds. Should these designs fall into the wrong hands, years of research will be lost and those responsible, myself included, would probably find ourselves swiftly exiled from existence. Load up your guns and put an end to this siege. Save our scientist, and return to me when your task is complete.
messages.zh: 一些更严重的问题又出现了，我只有把我最好的飞行员，你，调派来执行这个任务。我们刚刚得知你所干掉的那只联邦战舰并不是来参与复仇行动的，这是我们的一个线人报告的情况。联邦海军获得了我们正在研究下一代推进器的信息,那只脱离大部队的小队肯定是在搜索和加害我们的首席科学家，他是整个研究的核心人物，并且拥有原型机的模型。你干掉的联邦海军军官当时已经非常接近目标，并且同联邦情报中心进行了汇报。现在有一支更大的联邦舰队将要攻击我们建立在4-EP12的主要科研设施。这个科研设施本身并不重要，重要的是我们的首席科学家和他所持有的蓝图。如果这些东西落到敌人的手里，如果多年的研究毁于一旦，包括我在内的所有人将会很快的从世界上消失。准备好你的火炮给这场争夺画上一个句号吧！营救我们的科学家，完成任务后回来向我报告。

messages.en: The Serpentis family thanks you for your contribution. Here is your reward. Enjoy
messages.zh: 天蛇家族非常感谢你的贡献。这是你的酬金。希望你会喜欢

name.es: Marvernois Ruemin: Industria de Serpentis (1 de 2)
name.ja: マーヴェノイスルエミン-サーペンティスインダストリー（1/2）
name.ru: Marvernois Ruemin - индустрия Serpentis (Marvernois Ruemin -Serpentis Industry) (1 из 2)
name.zh: 马维诺瓦·罗敏—天蛇工业(1/2)

messages.en:
You seem eager and willing to work for me. I have this little problem you could help me out with. Yesterday I was tricked into telling my supervisors I would take care of a situation in the area, not fully knowing all the details. Next time I´ll be more careful and not be baited. Anyway, I looked into it and scout reports indicated a large Serpentis operation in the ppg-xc system. It appears they're setting up their own tournament to compete with the Legends Trial. Some of our advertisers have a real problem with this, so they need the operation brought to a halt.

Naturally, I'd do it myself, but I figure since you are such an eager puppy you would just love to do it for me, wouldn't you?
messages.zh: 你似乎迫切愿意为我工作，那么你也许可以帮我解决这个小小的问题。昨天我被哄着答应了上司解决本地的一个“小问题”，而当时我还不了解所有细节。哼，下次我会更小心，不会上钩的。查看了详细资料之后，我发现天蛇在ppg-xc星系设立了一个大型工事。似乎他们也在训练自己的队伍参加传奇试炼。某些广告商对此表示非常担忧，他们希望这个工事停止运作。通常情况下，我会亲自解决这种事，但我觉得像你这么上进的飞行员一定很愿意替我完成任务，对吧？

name.es: Marvernois Ruemin: Industria de Serpentis (2 de 2)
name.ja: マーヴェノイスルエミン-サーペンティスインダストリー（2/2）
name.ru: Marvernois Ruemin - индустрия Serpentis (Marvernois Ruemin -Serpentis Industry) (2 из 2)
name.zh: 马维诺瓦·罗敏—天蛇工业(2/2)

messages.en:
Those blasted Serps just keep bouncing back. They seem determined to profit from the proceedings in some way. After we took out their tournament site, they appear to have immediately put their backup plan into action, namely to put up a brothel for tournament visitors in need of some after-hours entertainment. 

Their hiring practices leave a lot to be desired. They've abducted some of the finest exotic dancers this system has to offer. My immediate superior, bless his heart, has a particular affinity for one of these dancers, a girl who goes by the name of Layla. I need you to head out to the brothel, blow the living you-know-what out of it and bring the girl back. The Scope will be in your debt, friend.
messages.zh: 那些讨厌的天蛇还不善罢甘休。看来他们是铁了心要通过某种方式从这些活动中捞一笔了。就在我们摧毁天蛇的锦标赛站点后，他们似乎立刻搬出了备用方案，也就是开设了一家娱乐站，专为需要晚间娱乐的锦标赛观众提供服务。他们的录用手段实在太不高明。他们绑架了当地一些最出色的脱衣舞表演者。我的直属上司一直对其中一位名叫蕾拉的姑娘情有独钟——希望他的心脏承受得了。因此，我要你飞往娱乐站，干掉在场的全部天蛇，然后把蕾拉安全带回来。《视角》会记得你的好处，朋友。

name.ru: Dars Amene - отрицание (Dars Amene- Denial) (1 из 2)

messages.en:
Ah, {[character]player.name}! It is good to see there are freelancers who still maintain some loyalty to the Federation. It pleases me greatly that capsuleers like yourself still prove willing to help us out at need. Anyway, if you are looking for something to do, I know a little job that might just mix profit with pleasure.

The Serpentis are setting up a little shop in this area where they are training their fighters, intending to bring them into the tournament. Now, we aren't afraid of a little competition, but these fighters aren't all-natural, if you know what I mean. We're going to need them kidnapped and brought back here. Chances are you're going to find the substance the Serps have been feeding their fighters as well, and I know some people who are very interested to see it recovered. Purely for research, of course. I wouldn't dream of touching the stuff myself....

OK, OK, so maybe years ago when I was younger I might have tried some, but everyone experiments a little. No harm in that. Right? Just don't let me find out that you've kept a little for yourself. I need ... I mean, I want it all. To give to our researchers, of course. Ahem. Yes.

So, well, before you go ... listen, I would appreciate it if you could keep this matter to yourself. I'm sure you'll agree that not everybody needs to know about this, hm?
messages.zh:
啊，{[character]player.name}！能看到还对联邦保有衷心的自由战士真是太好了。你这样的飞行员总是在我们困难时伸出援助之手，真让我倍感欣慰。至少，如果你在找工作，那么我知道一件既有趣又有利可图的事情。

天蛇集团在本地设立了一个小工作室，在那里训练准备参加锦标赛的斗士。我并不反对正常的竞争，但这些战士并不是非常检点，如果你明白我的意思的话。我们要把他们绑过来。你也有可能找到天蛇给这些斗士服用的物质，我知道有人会对这些东西感兴趣。当然它们只将作为研究用途。我本人是想都不会去想那些东西……

好吧，好吧，我承认要是几年前我还年轻的时候可能还会去尝试一下，是人总有好奇心。这并没有什么害处。对吧？只是别让我发现你自己还私藏了一些。我需要……不，我的意思是，我想要全部。拿去给我们的研究人员用。嗯，就是这样。

那好，在你走之前……听好了，我希望这件事情对任何人都保密。我想你也明白不是所有人都需要知道这事儿的，对吧？

messages.en:
Ah, {[character]player.name}! It is good to see there are freelancers who still maintain some loyalty to the Federation. It pleases me greatly that capsuleers like yourself still prove willing to help us out at need. Anyway, if you are looking for something to do, I know a little job that might just mix profit with pleasure.

The Serpentis are setting up a little shop in this area where they are training their fighters, intending to bring them into the tournament. Now, we aren't afraid of a little competition, but these fighters aren't all-natural, if you know what I mean. We're going to need them kidnapped and brought back here. Chances are you're going to find the substance the Serps have been feeding their fighters as well, and I know some people who are very interested to see it recovered. Purely for research, of course. I wouldn't dream of touching the stuff myself....

OK, OK, so maybe years ago when I was younger I might have tried some, but you know how it is — everyone experiments a little. No harm in that. Right? Just don't let me find out that you've kept a little for yourself. I need ... I mean, I want it all. To give to our researchers, of course. Ahem. Yes.

So, well, before you go ... listen, I would appreciate it if you could keep this matter to yourself. I´m sure you´ll agree that not everybody needs to know about this, hm?
messages.zh:
啊，{[character]player.name}！能看到还对联邦保有衷心的自由战士真是太好了。你这样的飞行员总是在我们困难时伸出援助之手，真让我倍感欣慰。至少，如果你在找工作，那么我知道一件既有趣又有利可图的事情。

天蛇集团在本地设立了一个小工作室，在那里训练准备参加锦标赛的斗士。我并不反对正常的竞争，但这些战士并不是非常检点，如果你明白我的意思的话。我们要把他们绑过来。你也有可能找到天蛇给这些斗士服用的物质，我知道有人会对这些东西感兴趣。当然它们只将作为研究用途。我本人是想都不会去想那些东西……

好了，好了，我承认要是几年前我还年轻的时候可能还会去尝试一下，但你知道这是什么世界——人人都会做点小实验，这并没有什么害处。对么？只是别让我发现你自己还私藏了一些。我需要……我是说，我要全部。拿来给我们的研究人员用的，当然。恩，是的。

那好，在你走之前……听好了，我希望这件事情对任何人都保密，我想你也明白不是所有人都需要知道这事儿的，恩？

name.ru: Dars Amene - отрицание (Dars Amene- Denial) (2 из 2)

messages.en:
Thanks for meeting me in person, {[character]player.name}. We have a problem: My superiors have transcripts of our earlier communication and know about the drugs you brought back. It's okay, though, they've given me a chance to get rid of the stuff.

I need you to head out to Q-UA3C. The Serps have had a small shipping checkpoint there for a while, one which our investigative reporters have been monitoring for a big exposé on the way Serpentis supply chains work. Since my bosses want this little "mistake" of mine rectified quietly in order to prevent a scandal, they want the drugs taken there and the outpost destroyed. And that's what will happen.

Between you and me, though, I can't stand the idea of letting such a valuable commodity go to waste. So what I want you to do is head out there and kill everything you see, but leave the drug disposal to me. I'll convince my superiors and anyone else who asks that the drugs were destroyed at the outpost, and everyone will be happy ? at least, assuming that you can keep this a secret. And that is what you will do, I trust.
messages.zh:
很高兴你能来，{[character]player.name}。又有新问题了。上级查阅了最近的交易日志，发现了你带回的那些药品。但还好，他们给了我一个机会让我尽快想一个合理的方式解决这件事情。

所以这次你得跑一趟Q-UA3C。天蛇在那儿有一个发货中转站，联邦早就安排了秘密监控，并布下眼线，等时机成熟就能大举进攻了。我的上头要我用体面的方式“纠正”自己的错误，因为这件事情传出去，对代理所的声誉会产生不小的冲击。所以我承诺他们，会找人把违规药品送过去，然后连同哨站炸得一干二净。就这样。

以下内容就只有你知我知，我不允许这么值钱的东西被糟蹋。你要做的就是飞去中转站，干掉所有活人，但别把违规药品摧毁，交给我。剩下的事情交给我就行，我会让上司信服所有违规药品都已经消失，这样皆大欢喜。前提是你得保密。我相信你一定做得到。

name.ja: ヴァレッドミダール―敵対（1/2）
name.ru: Valedt Midalle - оппозиция (Valedt Midalle - Opposition) (1 из 2)

messages.en:
Good day. Looking for a job, are you? I have just the thing for a strapping capsuleer such as yourself. 

We're helping with putting on the Legends Trial, that great and massive confrontation. We've hit a snag, though; we had a shipment of supplies that were supposed to get here this morning, but the convoy ran into some technical difficulties and it appears they won't get here in time.

We've had wind of a Serpentis outpost in the vicinity, though, so we're thinking we might just outsource and play them at their own game. How about it? You up for a little hit-snatch-and-run?
messages.zh: 祝你愉快。你是在找工作吗？我手头有个案子，非常适合像你这样强壮的飞行员。 我们正忙着为传奇试炼的举行做准备，那是一场盛大的对抗赛。不过，我们遇到了一点儿小麻烦，一支本应今晨抵达的补给运输队由于技术故障，无法准时到达。我们听说这附近有一个天蛇的哨站，我们不如就完全外包，跟天蛇在他们最擅长的比赛里玩上一把。你觉得如何？你准备好玩“打抢跑”了吗？

name.ja: ヴァレッドミダール―敵対（2/2）
name.ru: Valedt Midalle - оппозиция (Valedt Midalle - Opposition) (2 из 2)

messages.en:
Great job on the supplies. We seem to be good to go, now that most of the logistical details are taken care of. This will be greatest tournament ever. And I'm sure the Serpentis don't mind us borrowing some of their things.

I have another mission for you. Just another small supply run, one for which I'll reward you handsomely, to show our appreciation for... hold on.  Give me a second, here. I have something coming in over the wire.

...

Oh, lord. Oh, sweet sister of mercy. Looks like we made the Serpentis mighty mad. In retaliation for our little loan of goods, they've gone all-out and attacked a Gallente station in XG-D1L

Navy squadrons are already on the way, but it's going to take them some time to get there. What we need now is someone to repel the first wave of attack, buy some time for the reinforcements to get there. What do you say, pilot? In the mood to be a hero today?
messages.zh:
补给的事情做得漂亮！截止目前一切顺利，后勤方面的问题都解决了。这将是史上最伟大的一届锦标赛。天蛇一定不会介意借给我们这么多资源，呵呵。



接下来还有一个任务要你完成。别担心，只是一个简单的运输任务，我会给你丰厚的奖赏，来表示我们的感激之……  等等，我有电话



……



哦，老大，嗯……好吧。看来我们有麻烦了。天蛇发起了反击，他们倾巢而出，目标直指XG-D1L的盖伦特空间站。



海军已经出动，但赶到现场还需一段时间。我们需要一名勇敢的飞行员抵挡住敌人的第一波进攻，为增援部队赢得足够的时间。怎么样，飞行员？你有成为英雄的自信么？

messages.en: One can never have too much loot- ... glory, I mean.
messages.zh: 人对成就的追求是没有止境的。

messages.en:
Welcome back, and congratulations on your task. Not that I had anything to do with it in any way whatsoever, but I'm very happy with your efforts. Which I know nothing about. But good job nonetheless. Whatever you did.

While you were away, we received orders that I've been praying for. We've located the booster manufacturing facility itself, and it's time to strike at the source. There are some that claim this recent attack by an unnamed pilot on a smuggling convoy was badly timed, and that we now have only a few days before the Cartel decides to move its operation to a new secret location. But then, I don't recall those same people giving any good reason why we should allow even one parcel of drugs to pass into the hands of our citizens.

Nevertheless, fingers have been pointed, and people are quite annoyed at having to rush in. While I don't have the slightest doubts that I made the right decision in sending you to destroy that convoy - NOT sending you to destroy that convoy, I should say, because of course I had nothing to do with it - it may nonetheless be a wise decision on our part to get there first and destroy that manufacturing facility all by ourselves. It will give us a little added glory, just in case someone decides to get clever about that convoy business.
messages.zh: 欢迎归来。再一次对你的努力表示敬意！虽然我对你的所作所为“一无所知”。就在你离开的时候，我终于接期盼已久的任务指令。上头已经确定了天使增效剂制造基地的位置，斩草除根的时刻终于到来了！我们的情报部门认为，那个不知名飞行员对天使护航队的攻击来得非常不巧，天使正在着手搬迁行动，我们只有几天的时间来策划一次大规模进攻。哼，我可不记得这群人曾给出任何有说服力的理由，证明这些违规药品应该落入我们人民的手里。无论如何，事情搞得如此急迫，负责攻击行动的弟兄很是恼火。但我丝毫没有后悔派你去袭击护航队——我的意思是，没有派你去袭击护航队。当然，此事与我无关。但如果我是那个指派你去袭击护航队的人，我现在就会派你抢先一步把制造基地给炸飞。这并不会增加大多成就感，只是顺手之劳而已。

messages.en: I've had my fill of glory for the time being. Thanks, but no thanks.
messages.zh: 我目前已经很有成就感了。谢谢。我不干，不过还是谢了。

messages.en: We certainly do. I'll be back after I've not destroyed the convoy that's not flying through space nearby.
messages.zh: 我当然彼此了解。我不会去摧毁那支不会穿过附近空间的护航队，然后我就回来。

messages.en: Excellent! I'll see you back here after you've done whatever it is you were going to do that I had nothing to do with in any way whatsoever.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！在你完成了该做的事情之后回来见我，这些事都是你要做的，跟我一点关系都没有。

messages.en:
You've heard, I hope, of the Angel Cartel drug smuggling into Minmatar space. No one will ever know how many lives have been destroyed by this ugly scourge, but while we cannot help those poor souls who have already fallen prey to booster abuse, I'm not going to sit by and let the drugs continue spreading to new victims. 

I am aware that not everyone around here shares my sentiments. My superiors feel that it's useless to strike at the dealers and the couriers, that the only way to uproot this problem is to stop it at its source. They say that to do otherwise is a waste of time and money.

And they're right, I'm sure. Of course they're right. So what I am absolutely not going to do is send out a single rogue pilot and tell him to cut off a supply convoy carrying drugs to Minmatar children. Let's be crystal clear on that. I am certainly not asking you to help me out on a secret task to rid us of one clandestine shipment, just one, even if nobody would notice its disappearance anyway. We understand one another, I trust.
messages.zh: 我希望你听闻过天使企业联合体将违规药品偷偷运入米玛塔尔境内的事情。不计其数的无辜大众深受其害，但既然不能帮助那些沉沦的人，我们就应该做点什么来阻止违规药品向新的群体扩散。可惜并不是所有的人都像我一样悲天悯人。我的上司对于打击违规药品运输和贩卖渠道一点兴趣都没有，他们认为这是纯粹的浪费时间，只一心一意想着斩草除根。他们说得对，他们说得很对。我绝对不会派一个自由雇佣战士去切断天使重要的违规药品运输线，即使违规药品都是通过这条线路流散到米玛塔尔孩子的手里。我们得说清楚，我从来都没有要求你炸毁一艘满载违规药品的运载舰。就一艘，没人会注意到它的消失。我想我们已经达成共识了，不是么？

messages.en: The thing you asked me not to do has been ... not done.
messages.zh: 你要求我不做的事情……我也没做。

messages.en: Splendid! You've saved lives, you know.
messages.zh: 太好了！你拯救了无数生命。

messages.en: I'm not doing this. And when I say "not", I mean "not". At all. You understand that, I trust.
messages.zh: 这件事我不干。我说“不”就是“不”。就这样。我相信你明白。

messages.en: I'm sorry to hear that. I had hoped you would see things my way.
messages.zh: 很遗憾听你那么说。我还以为你能像我一样看待问题呢。

messages.en: I'll help out. It's for the girl's own good.
messages.zh: 我会帮忙的。这都是为了女孩好。

messages.en: Thank you. I'm sure the young woman will learn her lesson from this.
messages.zh: 谢谢。我想这个年轻女人应该会吸取教训。

你能把女孩安全带回来真是太好了。在通常情况下，这便是故事的结局了，从此以后矿工和女孩幸福地生活在一起。但事实并非如此，这甚至不能被称作绑架，因为女孩是心甘情愿与鲁宾私奔！鲁宾承诺，只要等他完成手头最后一件事，便与女孩开始新生活，把她当作公主一样伺候。当然，有点智商的人都会看出，这是不折不扣的谎言。这群丧心病狂的海盗和野兽的唯一区别就是他们会驾驶飞船！你的任务就是铲除这个禽兽，免得他再花言巧语诱骗其他善良女孩。她叔叔告诉我，女孩在海盗手里吃尽苦头，而且依然执迷不悟，他只好把她索在居住舱内的隔间里，不让她与外人接触。等到她恢复了正常心智，再把她放出来。

messages.en: Rubin is dead.
messages.zh: 鲁宾已经死了。

messages.en: Excellent. The girl's uncle assures me that he will take good care of her from now on. Very good care indeed.
messages.zh: 很好。女孩的叔叔告诉我，今后他会好好对待她。真正地好好待她。

messages.en: I can't take part in this. Something stinks.
messages.zh: 我不能插手此事。这事没意思。

messages.en: That's a shame. Her uncle will have to make an extra effort to teach her the error of her ways, then.
messages.zh: 真是遗憾。那么她叔叔还得另找方法告诉她：她错在哪里。

messages.en:
I've been contacted by one of the mining harvesters working in the vicinity. It's a private matter, and the poor man is desperate for assistance. His niece, a good-looking but rather quiet woman, lives with him and takes care of their living quarters, but when he got home a few days back, she was gone. After much searching, he discovered that she had been kidnapped by the Angel Cartel, in an operation led by the pirate captain Rubin Sozar.

We need you to go find the girl. Her uncle is beside himself with worry and is willing to give up all his savings for her safe retrieval, along with the destruction of the man who put him through all this grief. It is imperative that you get his niece back to us before going after Rubin Sozar, because if anything goes wrong with the rescue we will need him alive to barter for her return. Needless to say, her uncle's savings will not go to you unless the young woman is back where she belongs, safe and sound.
messages.zh: 就在刚才，附近一个矿工联系我，说需要战士的帮助。虽说是私事，但看他一把年纪，伤心欲绝的样子，我也就应允下来了。事情是这样的，他有一个侄女，样貌不错，且性情温和，和老人住在一起，平时负责打扫清理居住舱。但就在老人上次出门采集矿石的当口，以鲁宾·索扎为首的一群天使海盗绑架了她。我要你去拯救那个女孩。矿工愿意以自己的所有家产回报那个能救回女孩，并手刃绑架者的人。记着，以救人为第一优先。稍后再去找鲁宾算账。万一营救失败，我们还能拿他当筹码和对方谈判。当然，只有等你把女孩安全带到矿工面前，他才会兑现自己的承诺。

messages.en:
Okelle Alash has not yet broken under questioning. However, now that his fleet failed to save him, we have reason to believe that his brother Martokar is going to try it. This is the big break we were hoping for. Martokar is the very man we've been after, a brutal criminal who arrived here on the run, having been implicated in kidnappings, slave trade and the murder of CONCORD officers. He hasn't been here long and has already established himself a big player in the booster smuggling business. We need this man taken down.

Martokar is amassing an attack fleet at the moment, and one of the people he tried to recruit has been spotted by our agents in a nearby establishment, ranting about the lousy offer he got. This man is the only chance we'll get at discovering Martokar's precise location, so we need you to retrieve him right away. If we screw this up, Martokar may strike at any time while we're completely unprepared, and good people will die. Obviously, Martokar is going to want to silence this poor fellow before he can reveal anything, so we need to get there first.

However, we mustn't let Martokar think that we've got sensitive information on him, since that'll only make him change his plans and will ruin any advantage we had. We therefore need you to lay waste to the entire location, making it look like our informant perished in the process. Once you've destroyed the place and anyone snooping around, bring the guy back to us.
messages.zh:
奥克勒·阿哈什在拷打逼问之下仍未屈服。既然他自己的舰队没能保住他，可以预料，阿哈什的哥哥马图卡会纠集一群同伙来营救他。这是可是等待已久的契机啊！马图卡是我们极力追捕的要犯，罪行牵涉到绑架、劳工贩卖以及伤害。他到这儿不久，便站稳了脚跟，并俨然成了增效剂贩卖商中的大亨。他是个危险人物，必须被铲除。

此刻，马图卡正在组建自己的舰队，他新近招募的一名手下在附近沙龙大声抱怨自己薪水过低的时候引起了我们探员的注意。这个喽罗是获知马图卡藏身之地的重要线索，因此我要你亲自去找到他。如果这件事搞砸了，我们得不到马图卡的详细进攻时间，局势将变得十分被动。马图卡得知此事后，很可能下令将此人封口，我们一定要迅速行动，赶在他们下手之前找到他。

然而，我们不能让马图卡起疑心。万一他知道风声走漏，就会全盘改变计划。因此你要把那里整个夷为平地，造成无人生还的假象。在你清理了一切有生命的东西之后，把线人带回到我这来。

messages.en: Once I'm done, there will be nothing left but dust.
messages.zh: 结果一定让你满意。

messages.en: Excellent. I'll let Duliner Nerhoger know we've got our best pilot on the case.
messages.zh: 很好。我会让杜里纳尔·内罗杰知道，我们派出了最好的飞行员去对付他。

messages.en:
It's time to end the reign of Martokar Alash. The informant you brought in gave us all the information we needed, and we now know where the warlord is.

I cannot emphasize enough how important it is that you wipe out not only this man but the entire force you see there and anything else in the vicinity. Before Martokar came here, he was on the verge of being a target for a Republic invasion fleet. Duliner Nerhoger, the chief of intelligence in the Republic Justice Department, has personally contacted my superiors to notify them that if we fail, we can expect repercussions.

That's not to mention the scourge of organized crime, which we know is always trying to get a toehold. Unless we show Martokar and everyone else that we mean business, someone else will simply move in to fill the gap he left. We have to ensure that the only thing remaining in that place are the burnt and wrecked remains of the last criminal who dared oppose us. But at the same time we don't dare bring in a massive fleet, for fear that Martokar get wind of it and take off. We've trusted you this far, and I have complete faith in your abilities to take care of the matter.
messages.zh:
是时候和马图卡作个了断了。你带回来的线人说出了我们想知道的一切，包括那个恶棍的藏身之处。

我不想再陈述那些陈词滥调，你要做的很简单，飞过去，干掉马图卡和他所有手下。在马图卡来到本地之前，他差一点就成为整支共和国舰队的追捕目标。共和国司法部的情报处处长杜里纳尔·内罗杰亲自下令，要我们除掉马图卡。要是行动一旦失败，后果可想而知。

像马图卡这样的恶棍首领，就算消灭一个，也会有更多的马图卡站起来填补他的位置。因此我们要做得干净利落，把整个组织连根拔起。敲山震虎，才能真正遏制恶势力的扩张。我们不能派一整支舰队去执行任务，这样做反而会打草惊蛇。因此唯一的希望就是你，而我也充分相信，以你的能力，一定能成功归来。

messages.en: Martokar is dead, dead, dead.
messages.zh: 马图卡已经死了，死了！

messages.en: Great, great, great. Thank you for your services.
messages.zh: 太好了，太好了，太好了。感谢你的帮助。

messages.en: I'm scared! I don't wanna do it!
messages.zh: 我很害怕！我不想做这件事！

messages.en: ... did you fall into the cloning vat or something?
messages.zh: ……你跌到克隆舱里还是怎么着？

name.ru: Из страха перед Akrada (For Fear of Akrada) (1 из 2)

messages.en: Sure, I'll give it a look.
messages.zh: 没问题，我去看看。

messages.en: Thanks very much. Don't mention this to Akrada, though.
messages.zh: 非常感谢。不过不要把这件事告诉阿克拉德。

messages.en:
As you may know, Minecore has been launching expeditions into BLC-X0 in order to find more gas cloud sites. We've been pretty successful so far, if I do say so myself. But success breeds the need for more success, and also breeds a certain type of man who expects that success. My superior, Akrada Ubje, is that type of man.

Akrada is one of the few people in Minecore who can deal with the pirates on their own terms. The Angel Cartel have us in a stranglehold, but Akrada is so defiant of everything and everyone that the Angels respect him, and even if it's the grudging respect a predator may show its prey, it's one of the things that has kept them from completely devouring our operations here. Problem is, Akrada expects everyone else to be defiant, showing constant bravery and strength so that the pirates won't think us weak. This means he occasionally demands too much, and the rest of us have to ensure he doesn't push us into something dangerous.

We've recently received word of quite a promising gas cloud. However, we have also heard that Sansha's Nation plans to establish a base there, intending to beat us to the punch. They have put up a scanning sentry there which will call for backup the instant an enemy force approaches. I want you to destroy this sentry, and do it quickly. No matter what Akrada says, we cannot deal with this on our own.
messages.zh: 如你所知，矿源集团派出了不少勘探队到BLC-X0来发掘气云资源。可以说，到目前为止我们的进展不错，可以用成功来形容吧。你应该知道，小小的成功会导致对更大成功的渴望，小小的成功也会培养出具有这种渴望的人。我的上司，阿克拉德·乌卜耶就是这样的人。他是矿源集团中少数几个能依靠一己之力抵御海盗侵袭的战士之一。事实上，天使企业联合体牢牢掌控着本星系，但阿克拉德的自傲着实唬住了这群海盗，至今为止我们没有遇到任何袭击，但我感觉这种平静只是暂时的，仿佛捕食者正在观察猎物，一旦找到一丝空隙，就会扑上来咬断我们的脖子。问题是，阿克拉德要我们也像他一样表现出无所畏惧的模样，说什么别让海盗小瞧我们。这种想法经常把我们推向危险的境地。最近我们发现了一片资源丰富的气云，不幸的是萨沙共和国的疯子也想在那儿建立一个根据地，和我们抢夺宝贵的资源。他们建造了一个扫描岗哨，一旦有人入侵便会呼叫援兵。 阿克拉德叫我们去摧毁这个扫描岗哨，但我们觉得，你更适合这个任务。我们不愿也不能拿自己的性命冒险。去吧，手脚利索点。

messages.en: The sentry is dust.
messages.zh: 岗哨已经不复存在。

messages.en: Splendid. Hopefully the area will now be safe for us to enter.
messages.zh: 太好了。希望我们现在能够安全进入这片区域了。

messages.en: I've got better things to do than shoot out a sentry.
messages.zh: 比起摧毁扫描岗哨，我有更好的事情做。

messages.en: I'm saddened to hear how unconcerned you are about our safety.
messages.zh: 你的冷漠让我心寒。

messages.en: Uh, there's no one there. Probably. I couldn't be bothered to check.
messages.zh: 噢，那里可能没有。我可不想去查看。

messages.en: I'm saddened to hear how unconcerned you are about our safety.
messages.zh: 你的冷漠让我心寒。

name.ru: Из страха перед Akrada (For Fear of Akrada) (2 из 2)

messages.en: Don't worry, I'll take care of it.
messages.zh: 放心，交给我吧。

messages.en: Thanks very much. I'll go back to ordering my pens according to color, then.
messages.zh: 非常感谢。那么我要接着工作了——根据颜色订购我的钢笔。

messages.en:
Unfortunately, the Sansha's Nation isn't so easily deterred. They received backup right after you left, and have now set up a full base in the area. The place is crawling with Sansha's pirates and we desperately need your services again. I can't let this get to Akrada, since he'll go berserk and demand we all fly in there, guns blazing. Anyone who refuses will find themselves out of a job at the very least, which in this part of space is tantamount to death by starvation.

So we need this done on the quiet, like. No major forces, no big deal made, and no bragging afterwards. You simply head back out there, kill everything you see, then silently head back to me for debriefing. I should warn you that if you find yourself in trouble, no one will be able to help you, and I will not admit to knowing anything about your mishaps.

All I wanted was to do my nice desk job in this company, pay my dues to Minecore and the Angel Cartel, and head back home at the end of the harvesting season. Flying out on suicide missions wasn't part of the job description, and neither was having to hire freelance pilots to sneak around behind my boss's back.
messages.zh: 非常不幸，萨沙共和国并不是那么好对付的。就在你离开后不久，他们的增援便赶到现场，现在已经建立了一个大型基地。海盗横行，我们需要你的帮助。我不敢把这件事上报给阿克拉德，他一定会命令我们开着战舰过去和萨沙交战，而我们没有丝毫胜机。如果我胆敢拒绝上头的命令，就会被立刻革职。在这个不毛之地没有军团的支持，就相当于踏进了鬼门关！所以我们要悄悄地把这件事情了结。不要大举出动，事后也不要四处夸耀。你只需飞到现场，干掉所有的活人，然后回来向我报告。丑话说在前头，如果你遇到危险，没人会来帮你，我也不会承认自己和此事有任何关联。我是个小职员，所有的愿望便是安安静静坐在办公室里，签署一些矿源集团和天使企业联合体有关的文件，然后在采矿季结束之后安全回家。军团无权要求我驾驶飞船去做这种自尽性的任务，当初合同上并没有这么写，不是么？当然，合同上也没写我不能雇用强悍的太空游侠来做这些事情，哈哈！

messages.en: The area is clear.
messages.zh: 我已经把那儿清场了。

messages.en: Wonderful! And you'll be happy to hear that I've finished ordering my pens. Would you care for a red one?
messages.zh: 好极了！你也会开心的，我完成了订购钢笔的事情。你想要支红的吗？

messages.en: Find someone else to do your grunt work.
messages.zh: 另请高明吧。

messages.en: I'm very disappointed. This means Akrada will want me to go there instead.
messages.zh: 我很失望。这意味着阿克拉德会要我去那里的。

messages.en: I don't like the look of those Sansha's. I'm leaving.
messages.zh: 我对萨沙没有一点兴趣。告辞。

messages.en: I'm very disappointed. This means Akrada will want me to go there instead
messages.zh: 我很失望。这意味着阿克拉德会要我去那里的。

name.es: Las banderas de la sangre (1 de 2)
name.ru: Знамена крови (The Flags of Blood) (1 из 2)

messages.en: My justice will be swift and merciless.
messages.zh: 我会迅速，坚决地执行正义。

messages.en: Thanks for your services. Our specialists will now interrogate them.
messages.zh: 感谢你的帮助。我们的专家将立刻审讯他们。

messages.en: Here are the harvesters.
messages.zh: 矿工在这儿！

messages.en: Well done. For their sake, I hope they were acting alone.
messages.zh: 干得好！为了他们好，我希望他们是独自行动的。

messages.en: I don't deal with corporate henchmen, sorry.
messages.zh: 我不跟军团的人打交道，抱歉。

messages.en: Your funeral.
messages.zh: 你的葬礼。

messages.en:
The concept of 'miner's justice' is new to some freelancers here. Have you heard of it? No? It's rather simple, really. Space can be dangerous, and we at the Angel Cartel are charged with keeping the peace, ensuring that people don't step out of line. We don't have the luxury of courts and lawyers, nor the option to hold long and protracted trials, so justice tends to be meted out in swift, decisive doses. It's quite a convenient arrangement for the most part, and the mining harvesters only need to defray the slight cost involved.

Sadly, though, not everyone sees it this way. There are some who feel themselves to be beyond the reach of justice, and who apparently believe they won't have to face the consequences of their rebellious actions. I've received word of a group of harvesters who have been misreporting their earnings and paying only a fraction of what they should, thus swindling the Cartel out of our rightly-earned tribute. Needless to say, this kind of behavior is absolutely unacceptable.

You are to head out, destroy their equipment and ships along with anything else you find, but return the harvesting personnel to us intact. While normally I wouldn't hesitate in demanding their bodies be splattered all over deep space, we need them alive to extract information about any other rogue operations.
messages.zh: “矿工的正义”对于某些初入此地的太空游侠是个新概念。你有没有听说过？没有？哦，其实这是个简单的概念。太空很危险，我们天使企业联合体就是为了保证大家的安全而存在，让每件事都在自己的框架内运行。因此我们不需要法庭和律师，也不需要旷日持久的审判过程，正义的判定只在火石之间。这真是一个便利的安排，矿工只需支付一小些费用即可享受我们正义的庇护。可惜啊可惜，有些人就是不领情。认为自己能凌驾于正义之上，作出种种忤逆我们的行为。我最近收到一份报告，一群采集者谎报自己的收入，少缴了许多钱。不用说，这种欺骗天使的行径，将遭到严厉的惩罚！ 你去摧毁他们的舰船，他们的设备，但把这群人给我活着带回来。通常情况下，我会毫不犹豫下令干掉他们，但我还想通过审讯，获得更多欺上瞒下者的名字。

messages.en: I'm not going after the miners. Do your own dirty work.
messages.zh: 我才不去追击矿工。你自己干这种垃圾事情吧。

messages.en: So you've joined the ranks of the insurrection. I hope you've prepared your last will and testament.
messages.zh: 那么说，你加入了叛乱军队了。我希望你已经写好了遗嘱。

name.es: Las banderas de la sangre (2 de 2)
name.ru: Знамена крови (The Flags of Blood) (2 из 2)

messages.en: It'll be a walk in the park, I'm sure.
messages.zh: 听上去很轻松。

messages.en: Off you go, then.
messages.zh: 那就去吧。

messages.en:
We've finished with the harvesters you brought in, and it turns out they weren't just skimming the profits. There is a gas cloud there, a very valuable gas cloud, which they had discovered and were hoping to keep all for themselves.

This isn't some minor act of subterfuge, it's outright betrayal! I cannot express how angry I am at this. Here we are, working day and night to ensure the safety of these people, and for very little pay, I might add, and this is how they treat us. Rest assured, we will make a memorable example of these traitors. Their bodies will be flayed open and their skin will flap in the wind like the bloodied flags of a failed uprising.

As for the gas cloud, since you were the one who brought these miscreants to justice, you're the only one I trust to inspect the cloud and verify whether it's as valuable as they claimed. Head out there, give it a look, and tell me what you saw. I suppose it's possible that the Minmatars will get a little cranky at the fact that you were responsible for the mutilation and death of their kind, but I'm sure they won't do anything drastic about it. Still, I'd appreciate if you also made sure that the area was clear of enemies.
messages.zh: 审讯结束，很可惜，他们犯下了大错误。你知道么，最近这批矿工发现了一片气云，非常丰富的气云资源，于是他们打算将其占为己有。这不是简单的遁词，这是不折不扣的背叛！你知道我有多生气么？我们在这成天忙忙碌碌，保护弱小矿工的安全，只收取微薄的报酬，居然还有人胆敢这样对待我们！好吧，我就让这群叛徒好好尝尝背叛的滋味！我要剥下他们的皮，挂在旗杆上，让这血腥的旗帜作为抗争失败的最好见证吧！至于气云，由于你帮忙带回这些叛徒，我才能得知它的存在，所以我信赖你，把侦查的任务交给你。去那儿仔细勘察一番，看看是否真有传说的那么丰富。我想米玛塔尔共和国一定对此事很好奇，但由于这只是你的个人行为，他们不能也无法深究。对了，如果你能顺便清除那里的敌人，我将感激不尽。

messages.en: The cloud looks fine. So did the Minmatar forces that ambushed me.
messages.zh: 这片气云看起来不错。伏击我的米玛塔尔部队也不错。

messages.en: I'm sure you had no problems handling them.
messages.zh: 我相信你的能力，收拾他们完全没问题。

messages.en: I can't be a part of this any longer. You need serious therapy.
messages.zh: 我做不下去了。你需要认真的治疗。

messages.en: I'm disappointed. Let's hope you won't end up like those traitors you brought in earlier.
messages.zh: 我很失望，我可不希望你和那群叛徒一个下场！

messages.en:
We've finished with the harvesters you brought in, and it turns out they weren't just skimming the profits. There is a gas cloud there, a very valuable gas cloud, which they had discovered and were hoping to keep all for themselves.

This isn't some minor act of subterfuge, it's outright betrayal! I cannot express how angry I am at this. Here we are, working day and night to ensure the safety of these people, and for very little pay, I might add, and this is how they treat us. Rest assured, we will make a memorable example of these traitors. Their bodies will be flayed open and their skin will flap in the wind like the bloodied flags of a failed uprising.

As for the gas cloud, since you were the one who brought these miscreants to justice, you're the only one I trust to inspect the cloud and verify whether it's as valuable as they claimed. Head out there, give it a look, and tell me what you saw. I suppose it's possible that the Minmatars will get a little cranky at the fact that you were responsible for the mutilation and death of their kind, but I'm sure they won't do anything drastic about it. Still, I'd appreciate if you also made sure that the area was clear of enemies.
messages.zh: 审讯结束，很可惜，他们犯下了大错误。你知道么，最近这批矿工发现了一片气云，非常丰富的气云资源，于是他们打算将其占为己有。这不是简单的遁词，这是不折不扣的背叛！你知道我有多生气么？我们在这成天忙忙碌碌，保护弱小矿工的安全，只收取微薄的报酬，居然还有人胆敢这样对待我们！好吧，我就让这群叛徒好好尝尝背叛的滋味！我要剥下他们的皮，挂在旗杆上，让这血腥的旗帜作为抗争失败的最好见证吧！至于气云，由于你帮忙带回这些叛徒，我才能得知它的存在，所以我信赖你，把侦查的任务交给你。去那儿仔细勘察一番，看看是否真有传说的那么丰富。我想米玛塔尔共和国一定对此事很好奇，但由于这只是你的个人行为，他们不能也无法深究。对了，如果你能顺便清除那里的敌人，我将感激不尽。

messages.en: I've got better things to do than look at clouds and wait to be attacked.
messages.zh: 我对守卫气云和等待伏击没有任何兴趣。

messages.en: I'm disappointed. Let's hope you won't end up like those traitors you brought in earlier.
messages.zh: 我很失望。但愿你不会和上次带来的那群叛徒一样下场。

messages.en: I will carve out a fitting memorial to your gangmates, written in Sansha's blood.
messages.zh: 我会用萨沙的血为你的伙伴打造最合适的纪念品。

messages.en: I'm glad you feel the same about it as I do.
messages.zh: 我十分感谢你的同情。

messages.en:
You are talking to the last survivor of a vicious, dishonorable assault. I used to soar through this area with the rest of my gang, taking care of business, talking to people who needed a good talking to, maybe knocking them around a bit, keeping things tight and running. I loved my job, and I was good at it.

But then we ran into a bunch of Sansha's, and things went very wrong. They snuck up on us while we were minding our own business, and they murdered every single one of my gangmates. I still have nightmares about those last few seconds, when each one of my communication channels to them was filled with screams, then static. Then nothing at all. The Sansha's left me alive only so that I could crawl back to home and tell the tale, a message that they were coming to push us out of the territory.

We're going to send them a message in return. We don't dare risk total war, though, so we need a freelancer. You are going to head out, find a bunch of Sansha's puppets, and kill them. Bring me back their tags so that I can hang them over my bed like a set of wind chimes; that ought to stop then nightmares for good.
messages.zh: 和你说话的人是一场卑鄙袭击的最后幸存者。我曾经是本地的一名雇佣兵，和伙伴一起帮人解决问题，惩恶扬善。我热爱这份工作，事实上，我也干得很出色。可是后来，一群萨沙疯子改变了一切！我和同伴一起执行任务的时候，萨沙的人突然冲进来，不分青红皂白，害死了我所有的同伴！那最后的几秒时常出现在我的梦魇中……通讯器一个接一个地传来惨叫声，而后陷入死寂。萨沙只留下我一个人，为了让我回来把这个恐怖的讯息传递给大家，萨沙已经宣布对此地的占有权。好吧，我也有自己的信息要传递给他们。我们并不想挑起全面战争，因此只能托付你这样的太空游侠。去找一群萨沙的傀儡，干掉他们，把铭牌带回来。我会把它们挂在床头，当风吹过，清脆的响声将寄托我对战友的思念。希望噩梦能因此终结。

messages.en: Your gang has been avenged. Here are the tags of the dead.
messages.zh: 我已经为你的伙计们报仇了。这是那些死者的铭牌。

messages.en: Thank you. I look forward to the night now.
messages.zh: 谢谢。现在我期待着今晚的美梦。

messages.en: You want me to retaliate with a vicious, dishonorable assault of your own. Sorry, but no.
messages.zh: 你想让我通过一场同样卑鄙的袭击来为你复仇？抱歉，我不干。

messages.en: You have no understanding of honor.
messages.zh: 你对荣誉没有任何概念。

messages.en: I'm not going to help you kill innocent victims. I quit.
messages.zh: 我不想帮你加害无辜。我退出。

messages.en: They don't belong among the innocent, you fool, and not among the living, either.
messages.zh: 他们并不是无辜的！你个蠢货！他们早就死了，现在只是一群傀儡而已！

messages.en: Abufyr's as good as dead.
messages.zh: 阿布菲尔死定哩！

messages.en: Excellent.
messages.zh: 太好了

messages.en:
After you left, I got to thinking. Killing some random gang of Sansha's is good, but it's not enough. All we did was send the message that someone had wanted to kill their grunts. We need more.

As luck would have it, the person reputed to be Sansha's provincial leader in this area, a man named Abufyr Joek, is situated not far from us. If we take him out, along with all his staff and guards, we will be sending a clear message to those brainless drones. They won't dare declare war on us, since they'll have nothing to officially tie the attack to our forces, but they'll know exactly who was responsible. Abufyr probably gave permission for his troops to roam around and viciously murder anyone they met, and even if he didn't he's still the nominal figurehead for them, so his death will be a statement. 

Kill everyone you see at that place, then bring me back Abufyr's head, and we'll show Sansha's Nation what happens when you get the stupid, stupid idea to attack the Angel Cartel. Don't worry about special storage, either, just put it in your cargo hold like everything else. We want it to be good and ripe before we vacuum-seal it to send off to the Sansha.
messages.zh: 你走后，我一直在思考。随便干掉几个萨沙暴徒倒是不错，不过还不够。我们这样传递的信息只是有人要动他们的小兵。我们还要更进一步。刚巧，萨沙在这个区域的地方领导阿布菲尔•约克现在就在离我们不远的地方。如果我们除掉他，还有他的所有员工和守卫，那么就会向那些无脑的寄生虫传达一个明确的信号。他们不敢向我们宣战，因为他们无法正式将这次袭击与我们联系起来，但是他们一定知道谁该为此事负责。阿布菲尔可能下令允许他的军队四处漫游，恶意加害他们遇到的任何人，即使他没下过命令，他仍然是他们名义上的傀儡领袖，所以他的死就是我们的宣言。干掉那里所有的人，然后把阿布菲尔的头带给我，这样我们就可以让萨沙共和国看看做出袭击天使企业联合体这种非常非常愚蠢的举动后，会有什么样的后果。你也不用操心采用什么特殊的存放方式，只要把它像其他任何东西一样装进你的货柜舱就行了。在我们把它用真空包装送还给萨沙之前，我们要让它色香味俱全。

messages.en: Abufyr and all his cohorts are dead. Here's what's left of him.
messages.zh: 阿布菲尔和他所有部下都死了。这是他的残骸。

messages.en: Marvelous. And he looks so surprised, too.
messages.zh: 不可思议。他看上去还那么惊讶。

messages.en: Clearly, no number of deaths will be enough for you. Get someone else to be your butcher.
messages.zh: 显然，加害多少生灵都满足不了你的欲望。找别人做你的屠夫吧。

messages.en: You have no understanding of honor.
messages.zh: 你对荣誉没有任何概念。

messages.en: I've had enough. Go behead Abufyr yourself.
messages.zh: 我受够了。你自己去砍阿布菲尔的人头吧。

messages.en: Suit yourself. Abufyr's head won't be the only one on my desk, then.
messages.zh: 请随便坐。就是说，我桌上不只有阿布菲尔一颗人头。

messages.en: I'll save her from the clutches of evil, no problem.
messages.zh: 我会从邪恶手中把她救出来，没问题。

messages.en: I have full confidence in you. Remember, this is family.
messages.zh: 我对你信心十足。记住，这关系到我的家庭。

messages.en:
This one is personal. I haven't usually bothered too much about Sansha's Nation; they're here, and we're going to kick them out eventually, but until now they haven't been worth the effort. That's all changed. They have taken my sister.

Understand, this is one of very few people in the world who means anything to me. We grew up together, and since I was older by a few years, I was the protector. She isn't too clever, dear Nokana, but she always meant well, and all the times I had to pull her out of trouble were paid for a thousand times over by the times she stood by me when no one else would. When I got this job as an Angel Cartel agent, she demanded that she be employed here as well so that she could keep an eye on me. It's risky business sometimes, being an agent for the pirates, and Nokana wouldn't let me do it alone.

But now it's all gone wrong. Nokana apparently heard of a group of Sansha's who had it in for me, and went to try and negotiate with them. She's wonderful, my sister, but she's no diplomat, and they ended up kidnapping her. If my bosses find out about her meddling they'll fire both of us, so I need you to go in, get her, and return her to me before anyone else finds out. I hear they're keeping her in a slave pen, the barbarians!
messages.zh: 这次是私人事件。萨沙共和国在本地驻留已久，我很清楚迟早有一天会把他们踢出星域，事实上他们也一直没给我们造成大麻烦，因此我并不是很在意这群疯子。但现在一切都变了。他们抓走了我的妹妹！她是我在这尘世打拼的原因之一！我们从小一起长大，作为哥哥我保护着她。诺卡娜并不聪颖，但她是个好人。我数次将她从困境中救出，作为回报，小妹始终是我最坚定的支持者，即使全世界都背叛了我，她也会站在我身边。当我接受天使代理人的工作时，她也要求在此获得一个职位，以便待在我的身边。你也知道，做海盗代理人是件危险的事情，妹妹决不会让我一个人承担压力。就是因为这种性格才出了岔子！妹妹听说一群萨沙成员冲着我来，就自告奋勇驾船和他们谈判。她是个勇敢的女孩，诺卡娜，但她并不是谈判高手。结果萨沙疯子就把我妹妹绑走了！如果上头知道她把事情搞砸了，我们俩的性命都会不保！这都怪我！现在唯一的弥补方法就是请你神不知鬼不觉地把她带回来。我听说她被关押在劳工围场里，那群疯子！

messages.en: Nokana's back, unharmed.
messages.zh: 诺卡娜回来了。毫发无伤。

messages.en: Thank you so much.
messages.zh: 太感激你了！

messages.en: I've got better things to do than hunt down wayward siblings.
messages.zh: 比起猎捕萨沙疯子，有更重要的事情等着我。

messages.en: I hope you don't have brothers or sisters of your own.
messages.zh: 我想你一定没有兄弟姐妹。
