messages.en: I really can't be bothered to find her.
messages.zh: 我可不想花这么大的功夫去找她。

messages.en: I hope you don't have brothers or sisters of your own.
messages.zh: 我想你一定没有兄弟姐妹。

messages.en: Don't worry. I'll take good care of her.
messages.zh: 别着急。我会好好照顾她的。

messages.en: Excellent. I trust you completely.
messages.zh: 很好。我完全信任你。

messages.en:
Now that Nokana is safe, I've decided it's too much of a risk to let her stay here. Wanting to protect me is good and fine, and exactly what I'd expect from her, but she's going to end up getting both of us into serious trouble, and if anything happened to her I would never forgive myself. Not to mention that I'd have to tell our parents, and they'd have my hide.

I would like you to take her back to my parents' place in Cartel space. I know this is a little outside the realm of your usual work, to be escorting someone home like a chaperon, but I'd really appreciate it. You did a good job in bringing Nokana back, and I'm sure you're as eager as I am to ensure that she doesn't cost us any more time and effort.

I'll arrange matters here, talk to her superiors and give them some reasonable explanation. A friend of mine will meet Nokana at the landing point, so once you've docked safe and sound, let me know and we'll take care of the rest.

Just don't let her convince you to turn around or do anything silly. Head straight home with her. And for heaven's sake, don't tell her anything about this conversation. I'll take care of that as well.
messages.zh: 既然诺卡娜平安归来，我不想她在这个是非之地多呆一分钟。她想保护我的心意我很明白，但盲目行事只会把我俩推入万劫不复的境地。如果她出了任何意外，我绝对不会原谅自己。要是父母得知此事，一定会把我的皮剥了！因此我想让你代劳，把她带回天使领域内，父母的住所。我知道，陪护不是你的工作范围，但如果你能接受，我将感激不尽。我会打理好本地的一切，替她找个合适的离职理由。我的朋友会在终点空间站内接应你们，因此你只需进站后和我取得联系便可。别被她的恳求说服了，直接回家！此外，别告诉她这是我授意的，一个字都别提！我也会守口如瓶的。

messages.en: Nokana is back where she belongs.
messages.zh: 诺卡娜已经回到她该去的地方了。

messages.en: I'm very glad to hear that. Now I can get back to business with a clear conscience.
messages.zh: 听你这样说，我很高兴。现在我可以安心地工作了。

messages.en: I'm not a babysitter. Find someone else.
messages.zh: 我可不是一个保姆。你找别人吧。

messages.en: I'm disappointed. I had hoped you would put this sensitive matter above your usual routine of murder and carnage.
messages.zh: 我很失望。我还以为你能把这件敏感的事情放在那些没完没了的强盗勾当之上呢。

messages.zh: 既然诺卡娜平安归来，我不想她在这个是非之地多呆一分钟。她想保护我的心意我很明白，但盲目行事只会把我俩推入万劫不复的境地。如果她出了任何意外，我绝对不会原谅自己。要是父母得知此事，一定会把我的皮剥了！因此我想让你代劳，把她带回天使领域内，父母的住所。我知道，陪护不是你的工作范围，但如果你能接受，我将感激不尽。我会打理好本地的一切，替她找个合适的离职理由。我的朋友会在终点空间站内接应你们，因此你只需进站后和我取得联系便可。别被她的恳求说服了，直接回家！此外，别告诉她这是我授意的，一个字都别提！我也会守口如瓶的。

messages.en: Nokana and I are eloping. We're in love, and wanted you to be the first to know. I'm taking her to my quarters instead.
messages.zh: 诺卡娜和我私奔了。我们正在热恋，我想让你成为第一个得知此事的人。我正把她带去我的居住舱。

messages.en: That is my little sister you're talking about, you ogre!
messages.zh: 这是我的小妹！你个禽兽！

messages.en:
We've run into a little trouble. Word has spread that Okelle Alash is being held captive, and his legion is going absolutely insane. Apparently it's all right for them to terrorize innocent citizens, but not for us to start hitting back. They're tearing through the constellation, firing at everything in sight and demanding that Okelle be returned to them in one piece.

This, unfortunately, is no longer an option, not unless they have a surgeon on their team who specializes in reattaching fingers. We will have to fight them. Their fleet is disorganized as you'd expect pirates to be, but nonetheless they have a small scouting party that flies ahead and coordinates the primary fleet. You have to take out the scouting party first, so that the primary fleet will be left blinded and confused. Once you're done with that, report to me and we'll see if we can use you in taking care of the remnants of Okelle's fleet.
messages.zh: 我们遇到了些麻烦。奥克勒·阿哈什被捕的风声走漏，他手下已经陷入了抓狂状态。他们对无辜市民施行恐怖袭击当然不会使我们发动反击。他们在星座中闹翻了天，看到什么打什么，还要求把奥克勒毫发无损地返还给他们。很不幸，这根本不可能，除非他们队伍中有个专于手指续接的外科医生。与他们开战势在难免了。如同所有海盗一样，这支舰队组织松散，然而却有一支侦察先头部队，协调主舰队的行动。你必须先消灭这支侦察部队，这样主舰队就会变得盲目而混乱。一旦你完成任务，立刻向我报告，然后我们会看看能否让你料理奥克勒舰队的余孽。

messages.en: I'm interested.  Give me more details.
messages.zh: 我对此感兴趣，请详细说一下。

messages.en:
Right now I'm looking for {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}. These tags have been implanted into certain pirates which infest {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space, which they use to identify each other with. To acquire them you will most likely have to kill them, or buy them off someone who did exactly that. I don't really care either way, as long as they have been taken care of I'm satisfied.

This might not be the very best way to confirm deaths, but we've been quite successful in the past using this method. Forgeries are almost non-existent, as each tag costs more to manufacture than it's worth on the bounty market. Not only that but we can usually tell a fake apart from a genuine pirate tag. And they have remarkable survivability, usually found in the charred wreckage of the pirate ships despite everything else, including the pirate's corpse, having been completely vaporized.

You can find the pirates carrying the {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} in many places, but I'd first check the asteroid belts in the surrounding systems as attacking defenseless miners is their favorite past-time. Good luck, and have fun.
messages.zh:
我正在寻找{[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}。这些铭牌被植入了在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}空间内异常猖獗的某些海盗体内，以作身份识别之用。要获得这些铭牌，你必须干掉海盗，或者从干掉海盗的人那里购买。我不管你用什么方法获得铭牌，只要海盗已被解决，我就心满意足。

可能拿回铭牌并不是确定死亡的最好方法，不过我们一直这样做，收效不错。伪造品几乎不存在，因为铭牌造假的成本甚至超出了悬赏的金额。不仅如此，我们通常自己也能辨别海盗铭牌的真伪。铭牌的耐久性能异常强悍，就算船上的所有东西，包括海盗尸体在内，全部化为灰烬，我们依然能在舰船残骸里找到完好无损的铭牌。

携带{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}的海盗很多地方都有，但我建议你查看一下附近星系的小行星带，因为攻击毫无防备的采矿者是他们最喜欢的业余爱好。祝你好运，好好享受。

messages.en: Congratulations, you've just proven yourself as a competent mercenary fighter pilot.  Now that you've completed this task, I suggest you look for more {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} agents in {[location]agentRegionID.name} and surrounding regions.  I have no more work for you, but I'm sure you'll find some others from my corporation who do.  If all else fails, you could always work for the other {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} corporations, they have their own agents which hand out jobs as well.  Good luck in your travels, friend.
messages.zh: 恭喜你，你是一个优秀的战斗飞行员。我建议你去{[location]agentRegionID.name}及其周边地区寻找其他的{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}代理人。我已经没工作给你了，但我的同事应该有用得到你的地方。如果他们也没有，你可以为其他{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的军团工作，他们也有自己的代理人，同样也有任务。一路顺风，朋友。

携带{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}的海盗很多地方都有，但我建议你查看一下附近星系的小行星带，因为攻击毫无防备的采矿者是他们最喜欢的业余爱好。祝你好运，好好享受。

messages.en:

可能拿回铭牌并不是确定死亡的最好方法，不过我们一直这样做，收效不错。伪造品几乎不存在，因为铭牌造假的成本甚至超出了悬赏的金额。不仅如此，我们通常自己也能辨别海盗铭牌的真伪。铭牌的耐久性能异常强悍，就算船上的所有东西，包括海盗尸体在内，全部化为灰烬，我们依然能在舰船残骸里找到完好无损的铭牌。

携带{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}的海盗很多地方都有，但我建议你查看一下附近星系的小行星带，因为攻击毫无防备的采矿者是他们最喜欢的业余爱好。祝你好运，好好享受。

messages.en: Congratulations, you've just proven yourself as a competent mercenary fighter pilot.  Now that you've completed this task, I suggest you look for more {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} agents in {[location]agentRegionID.name} and surrounding regions.  I have no more work for you, but I'm sure you'll find some others from my corporation who do.  If all else fails, you could always work for the other {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} corporations, they have their own agents which hand out jobs as well.  Good luck in your travels, friend.
messages.zh: 恭喜你，你是一个优秀的战斗飞行员。我建议你去{[location]agentRegionID.name}及其周边地区寻找其他的{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}代理人。我已经没工作给你了，但我的同事应该有用得到你的地方。如果他们也没有，你可以为其他{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的军团工作，他们也有自己的代理人，同样也有任务。一路顺风，朋友。

messages.en:
Right now I'm looking for {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}. These tags have been implanted into certain pirates which infest {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space, which they use to identify each other with. To acquire them you will most likely have to kill them, or buy them off someone who did exactly that. I don't really care either way, as long as they have been taken care of I'm satisfied.

This might not be the very best way to confirm deaths, but we've been quite successful in the past using this method. Forgeries are almost non-existent, as each tag costs more to manufacture than it's worth on the bounty market. Not only that but we can usually tell a fake apart from a genuine pirate tag. And they have remarkable survivability, usually found in the charred wreckage of the pirate ships despite everything else, including the pirate's corpse, having been completely vaporized.

You can find the pirates carrying the {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} in many places, but I'd first check the asteroid belts in the surrounding systems as attacking defenseless miners is their favorite past-time. Good luck, and have fun.

Right now I'm looking for {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}. These tags have been implanted into certain pirates which infest {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space, which they use to identify each other with. To acquire them you will most likely have to kill them, or buy them off someone who did exactly that. I don't really care either way, as long as they have been taken care of I'm satisfied.

This might not be the very best way to confirm deaths, but we've been quite successful in the past using this method. Forgeries are almost non-existent, as each tag costs more to manufacture than it's worth on the bounty market. Not only that but we can usually tell a fake apart from a genuine pirate tag. And they have remarkable survivability, usually found in the charred wreckage of the pirate ships despite everything else, including the pirate's corpse, having been completely vaporized.

You can find the pirates carrying the {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} in many places, but I'd first check the asteroid belts in the surrounding systems as attacking defenseless miners is their favorite past-time. Good luck, and have fun.
messages.zh:
我正在寻找{[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}。这些铭牌被植入了在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}空间内异常猖獗的某些海盗体内，以作身份识别之用。要获得这些铭牌，你必须干掉海盗，或者从干掉海盗的人那里购买。我不管你用什么方法获得铭牌，只要海盗已被解决，我就心满意足。

可能拿回铭牌并不是确定死亡的最好方法，不过我们一直这样做，收效不错。伪造品几乎不存在，因为铭牌造假的成本甚至超出了悬赏的金额。不仅如此，我们通常自己也能辨别海盗铭牌的真伪。铭牌的耐久性能异常强悍，就算船上的所有东西，包括海盗尸体在内，全部化为灰烬，我们依然能在舰船残骸里找到完好无损的铭牌。

携带{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}的海盗很多地方都有，但我建议你查看一下附近星系的小行星带，因为攻击毫无防备的采矿者是他们最喜欢的业余爱好。祝你好运，好好享受。

messages.en: Congratulations, you've just proven yourself as a competent mercenary fighter pilot.  Now that you've completed this task, I suggest you look for more {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} agents in {[location]agentRegionID.name} and surrounding regions.  I have no more work for you, but I'm sure you'll find some others from my corporation who do.  If all else fails, you could always work for the other {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} corporations, they have their own agents which hand out jobs as well.  Good luck in your travels, friend.
messages.zh: 恭喜你，你是一个优秀的战斗飞行员。我建议你去{[location]agentRegionID.name}及其周边地区寻找其他的{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}代理人。我已经没工作给你了，但我的同事应该有用得到你的地方。如果他们也没有，你可以为其他{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的军团工作，他们也有自己的代理人，同样也有任务。一路顺风，朋友。

可能拿回铭牌并不是确定死亡的最好方法，不过我们一直这样做，收效不错。伪造品几乎不存在，因为铭牌造假的成本甚至超出了悬赏的金额。不仅如此，我们通常自己也能辨别海盗铭牌的真伪。铭牌的耐久性能异常强悍，就算船上的所有东西，包括海盗尸体在内，全部化为灰烬，我们依然能在舰船残骸里找到完好无损的铭牌。

携带{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}的海盗很多地方都有，但我建议你查看一下附近星系的小行星带，因为攻击毫无防备的采矿者是他们最喜欢的业余爱好。祝你好运，好好享受。

messages.en: Congratulations, you've just proven yourself as a competent mercenary fighter pilot.  Now that you've completed this task, I suggest you look for more {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} agents in {[location]agentRegionID.name} and surrounding regions.  I have no more work for you, but I'm sure you'll find some others from my corporation who do.  If all else fails, you could always work for the other {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} corporations, they have their own agents which hand out jobs as well.  Good luck in your travels, friend.
messages.zh: 恭喜你，你是一个优秀的战斗飞行员。我建议你去{[location]agentRegionID.name}及其周边地区寻找其他的{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}代理人。我已经没工作给你了，但我的同事应该有用得到你的地方。如果他们也没有，你可以为其他{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的军团工作，他们也有自己的代理人，同样也有任务。一路顺风，朋友。

messages.en:
Right now I'm looking for {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}. These tags have been implanted into certain pirates which infest {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space, which they use to identify each other with. To acquire them you will most likely have to kill them, or buy them off someone who did exactly that. I don't really care either way, as long as they have been taken care of I'm satisfied.

This might not be the very best way to confirm deaths, but we've been quite successful in the past using this method. Forgeries are almost non-existent, as each tag costs more to manufacture than it's worth on the bounty market. Not only that but we can usually tell a fake apart from a genuine pirate tag. And they have remarkable survivability, usually found in the charred wreckage of the pirate ships despite everything else, including the pirate's corpse, having been completely vaporized.

You can find the pirates carrying the {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} in many places, but I'd first check the asteroid belts in the surrounding systems as attacking defenseless miners is their favorite past-time. Good luck, and have fun.

messages.en:
We ran Okelle's hard drive through disinfection and decryption, and we got lucky! Sometimes these things are set to self-destruct after unauthorized access, or they've been planted and are full of things that attempt to infect our reader programs the instant we start picking them apart. I'd have thought that our data extraction people would be professional enough not to hook the darn things right up to our systems, but sometimes they get a little overzealous. It took us a month to clear out the last infection we got.

At any rate, we now know Okelle's whereabouts. Remember that he's undoubtedly aware that we're after him, and that we intend to use him as a bartering chip to lure his brother out of hiding, so he's not going to come quietly. Try not to hang around, either, or he'll just escape. Go in there, kill any backup forces you see, and bring Okelle back to us alive.
messages.zh: 我们对奥克勒的硬盘进行了清理和破解，而且我们很幸运！有时这些东西会设置为一被非法访问就立刻自毁，或者会被植入各种东西，企图在我们破解它时，立即感染我们的程序。我一直认为我们的数据提取人员会很专业，不会直接把这些该死的东西弄到我们的系统中，不过有时他们有点过分积极。清除我们上次被感染的病毒花了我们一个月时间。至少，现在我们知道了奥克勒的下落。你要知道，毫无疑问他已经意识到我们在找他，他知道我们想要把他作为引出他兄弟的筹码，所以他不会坐以待毙的。你尽量别浪费时间闲逛，否则他就会逃掉的。去那里，消灭你见到的所有援军，活捉奥克勒，把他带给我们。

messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
I have a problem. It's about my son, Torin. He recently graduated from the academy, and I was giving him a tour of {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} in his brand-new Kestrel. We were going to have such a wonderful time celebrating his achievement when we were set upon by rogue drones. A battle ensued, which eventually I won, but when I looked for Torin his ship was a smoking hulk. He has very little practical experience with combat, despite graduating in the top 5 percentile of his class. However, his capsule was nowhere to be found: I think some of the drones must have captured his pod and fled before I noticed them. If he had died, my sensors would have registered the destruction of his pod, but they found nothing.

I want my son back, or at least vengeance on whoever is responsible for his death. I'll be out searching myself, but for each moment that passes...

I just want to find him and destroy those drones before they attack anyone else. I have a key that you'll need to access all areas of the site. I'll have it sent to a station in the system where you can find the rogue drones.

Note: Do not forget to pick up the acceleration gate key from the station first.
messages.zh: 我可以帮你找他。{[character]player.name} 愿为你服务！

messages.en: I am...truly grateful for your assistance. I've detected a number of anomalies in this system that may indicate the presence of rogue drones. I've passed by a number of them and destroyed numerous drones, but have found no hive yet; perhaps you will have better luck. I will upload the coordinates of one of the reconnaissance points to the mission details in your Opportunity interface. Please take a look and see if you can find a drone hive. If you do, destroy it; we must ensure the safety of the people in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} above all else.
messages.zh: 我…真的很感谢你的帮助。探测结果显示，这片星系内出现大量异象，可能存在自由无人机。我见过大量无人机，也击毁了不少，但始终没能找到母巢；也许你更走运，能够找到它。我会把其中一个侦察点坐标上传到你“机遇”界面的任务详情中。你看看能不能找到无人机母巢。如果能，那就捣毁它；{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}人民安全高于一切，必须得到保障。

messages.en:
I am...truly grateful for your assistance. I've detected a number of anomalies in this system that may indicate the presence of rogue drones. I've passed by a number of them and destroyed numerous drones, but have found no hive yet; perhaps you will have better luck. I've uploaded the coordinates of one of the reconnaissance points into your Opportunities interface, and I've had an acceleration gate key set aside for you in a station at the same location. You'll need the key to access all areas.

Please take a look and see if you can find a drone hive. If you do, destroy it; we must ensure the safety of the people in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} above all else.

Note: Do not forget to pick up the acceleration gate key from the station first.

你看看能不能找到无人机母巢。如果能，那就捣毁它；{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}人民安全高于一切，必须得到保障。

注意：记得先去空间站拿加速轨道钥匙。

messages.en: You won't believe this but ...
messages.zh: 我无法相信，但……

messages.en: You have found Torin! And alive! I cannot begin to express my thanks. You have done me an immeasurable favor, and I am forever in your debt. Perhaps some day you will join us in a voyage between the stars, {[character]player.name}. I have so many places to show you. But I am certain you have other obligations at the moment, so I will leave you now to your own business. Enjoy your reward ― you have definitely earned it!
messages.zh: 你找到了图灵！他还活着！我真不知道如何表达我的谢意。你对我的帮助是无价的，我永远欠你一份恩情。也许某天你会加入我们的恒星间航行，{[character]player.name}。我有很多地方要带你去看。但我知道，目前你还有很多事要做，我就不打扰了。拿好你的奖励——毫无疑问，这是你应得的！

messages.en:
I have a problem. It's about my son, Torin. He recently graduated from the academy, and I was giving him a tour of {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} in his brand-new Kestrel. We were going to have such a wonderful time celebrating his achievement when we were set upon by rogue drones. A battle ensued, which eventually I won, but when I looked for Torin his ship was a smoking hulk. He has very little practical experience with combat, despite graduating in the top 5 percentile of his class. However, his capsule was nowhere to be found: I think some of the drones must have captured his pod and fled before I noticed them. If he had died, my sensors would have registered the destruction of his pod, but they found nothing.

I want my son back, or at least vengeance on whoever is responsible for his death. I'll be out searching myself, but for each moment that passes...

I just want to find him and destroy those drones before they attack anyone else.
messages.zh:
是我儿子图灵的事。他最近刚从学院毕业，我打算带他乘坐他崭新的“茶隼”去{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}旅行。正当我们打算愉快地庆祝他的成就的时候，一群自由无人机突然袭击了我们。战斗随之发生，最终我赢了，但是当我转向图灵，却发现他的飞船只剩下了冒烟的船壳。尽管他是以班里前几名的成绩毕业的，但他没有什么实际作战经验。不过，他的逃生舱不见踪影：我想一定是有些无人机俘虏了他的太空舱，并趁我没注意溜走了。要是他死了，我的感应器会提示他的太空舱毁了，但是它们什么也没发现。

我要救回我的儿子，或者起码也要对加害我儿子的人血债血偿。我自己也会去找，但时间真的不多了……

我只想找到儿子然后干掉那些无人机，不让它们再害别人。

name.fr: Le chercheur fou spécialisé en création de drones
name.ja: 狂ったドローン科学者
name.ru: Сумасшедший исследователь дронов (The Crazed Drone Scientist)

messages.en: I'll find him. Read mission details in Opportunities first.
messages.zh: 我会找到他的。先看看“机遇”界面中的任务详情。

messages.en: Look buddy, I have no idea where he is.  I've looked everywhere ... so just give it up ok?  You won't find him.
messages.zh: 嘿，伙计，我不知道他跑哪儿去了。我到处都找遍了……所以放弃吧，好吗？你找不到他的。

messages.en: If you have managed to find Lazron Kamon, then return him to {[character]agentID.name}.  Do not bother looking unless you have some idea of his whereabouts, he could be anywhere.
messages.zh: 如果你找到拉扎·卡蒙，就把他带回{[character]agentID.name}所在之处。在你毫无头绪之前绝对不要轻易承诺，他可能出现在任何地方！

messages.en: Actually, you were wrong.  I DID find him.
messages.zh: 事实上，你错了。我已经找到他了。

messages.en: Well I'll be ... you found the SOB!  My boss will be pleased, maybe I'll even get a promotion ... Anyway, here's your dough as I promised.  Take care.
messages.zh: 哦，我会……你找到了那个恶棍养的！我的老板会高兴的，也许我会得到晋升……无论如何，这是我承诺给你的钱。保重。

messages.en:
I was assigned the task of finding a missing scientist. His name is Lazron Kamon. I think the crazy old coot got bored with life and took a trip out the airlock, but who knows. I'm getting fed up with these find-a-needle-in-a-haystack jobs to be honest.

Anyway, if you ever stumble across this guy, let me know, k?
messages.zh:
我受命找寻一个失踪的科学家。他叫拉扎·卡蒙。我认为这个疯狂的老笨蛋一定是厌倦了人世的生活，跑到空气阀门外面转悠去了，唉，谁知道呢。说实话，我受够了这些大海捞针的任务。

无论如何，如果你刚好碰到过他，那么告诉我，行吗？

messages.en: I will do as you ask, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我会按照你说的做，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Please make this delivery your first priority, {[character]player.name}. It must go smoothly and quickly.
messages.zh: 把其他事都搁下，用最快速度把快递送到，{[character]player.name}，重申一遍，货物必须准时送抵。

messages.en:
I have a very special mission for you today, {[character]player.name}. A high-ranked Overseer of a secret {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} compound in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} has requested items of ours that must be delivered to him A.S.A.P. This job must be done in complete secrecy; we do not want the contents of this delivery to fall into the wrong hands. As a precautionary measure, we have set up an explosive mechanism inside the cargo containers that will trigger should anyone attempt to tamper with them.

I trust you on this, {[character]player.name}. Be very discreet and, at any cost, avoid confrontation with hostiles en route to your destination. Make haste!
messages.zh:
今天我有一个特殊的任务给你，{[character]player.name}。{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}下属一个位于{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的高官要求我们将一批特殊的物品尽快运送到他手里。这个任务必须保持高度机密，运送包裹绝对不能落入他人手中。为此，我们在货柜中安置了爆炸设施，一旦有人试图用暴力打开货柜，就会马上爆炸。

我把这个重要的任务托付给你了，{[character]player.name}，不要节外生枝，尽快把货送到！去吧！

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 干得好！{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:

messages.en: I'll take care of these pests {[character]agentID.name}, just give me the coordinates and I'm good to go.
messages.zh: 我会处理这些害虫的，{[character]agentID.name}。把位标给我，我立刻出发。

messages.en: Take care out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 到那以后要小心，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Pirates have set up a blockade near a hidden stargate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and are swarming over any passersby, which are mostly merchants and civilians.  Pirates tend to create these temporary blockades at ill-defended stargates, usually ones which have been set up by civilians and are not guarded by our forces.  But we still have an obligation to protect the citizens of {[location]agentConstellationID.name}.  Therefore I want you, {[character]player.name}, to fly to the stargate and eliminate the illegal blockade.
messages.zh: 海盗在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内一座隐蔽星门附近设立了一道封锁线，成群结对骚扰路人，主要是商人和平民。海盗通常把此类临时封锁线设立在防御薄弱的星门边，这些星门一般是由平民建立的，没有我们的军队守卫。但我们仍然有责任保护{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的公民。因此，{[character]player.name}，我要你飞去星门，粉碎那道非法封锁线。

messages.en: I have cleared the blockade as you requested, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我已经按你的要求，清除了封锁线，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: The merchants which own the gate you defended are very grateful for your assistance.  They told us to send you their best regards for a job well done.
messages.zh: 由于你保卫了那座星门，拥有星门的那些商人非常感激你的帮助。为了你出色的表现，他们通过我们向你致以最高的敬意。

messages.en: You're afraid of a few pirates?  Maybe I was wrong about you after all ...
messages.zh: 你会害怕几个海盗？看来我还是看错你了。

Pirates tend to create these temporary blockades at ill-defended stargates, usually ones which have been set up by civilians and are not guarded by our forces. messages.zh: 哦，得了吧，其实没那么难。啊，好吧，那我去找别人来完成这个任务。

messages.en: I'll take care of these pests {[character]agentID.name}, just give me the coordinates and I'm good to go.
messages.zh: 我会处理这些害虫的，{[character]agentID.name}。把位标给我，我立刻出发。

messages.en: Take care out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 到那以后要小心，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Pirates have set up a blockade near a hidden stargate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and are swarming over any passersby, which are mostly merchants and civilians.  Pirates tend to create these temporary blockades at ill-defended stargates, usually ones which have been set up by civilians and are not guarded by our forces.  But we still have an obligation to protect the citizens of {[location]agentConstellationID.name}.  Therefore I want you, {[character]player.name}, to fly to the stargate and eliminate the illegal blockade.
messages.zh: 海盗在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内一座隐蔽星门附近设立了一道封锁线，成群结对骚扰路人，主要是商人和平民。海盗通常把此类临时封锁线设立在防御薄弱的星门边，这些星门一般是由平民建立的，没有我们的军队守卫。但我们仍然有责任保护{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的公民。因此，{[character]player.name}，我要你飞去星门，粉碎那道非法封锁线。

messages.en: I have cleared the blockade as you requested, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我已经按你的要求，清除了封锁线，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: The merchants which own the gate you defended are very grateful for your assistance.  They told us to send you their best regards for a job well done.
messages.zh: 由于你保卫了那座星门，拥有星门的那些商人非常感激你的帮助。为了你出色的表现，他们通过我们向你致以最高的敬意。

messages.en: You're afraid of a few pirates?  Maybe I was wrong about you after all ...
messages.zh: 你会害怕几个海盗？看来我还是看错你了。

messages.en: Take care out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 到那以后要小心，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Pirates have set up a blockade near a hidden stargate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and are swarming over any passersby, which are mostly merchants and civilians.  Pirates tend to create these temporary blockades at ill-defended stargates, usually ones which have been set up by civilians and are not guarded by our forces.  But we still have an obligation to protect the citizens of {[location]agentConstellationID.name}.  Therefore I want you, {[character]player.name}, to fly to the stargate and eliminate the illegal blockade.
messages.zh: 海盗在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内一座隐蔽星门附近设立了一道封锁线，成群结对骚扰路人，主要是商人和平民。海盗通常把此类临时封锁线设立在防御薄弱的星门边，这些星门一般是由平民建立的，没有我们的军队守卫。但我们仍然有责任保护{[location]agentConstellationID.name}的公民。因此，{[character]player.name}，我要你飞去星门，粉碎那道非法封锁线。

messages.en: I have cleared the blockade as you requested, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我已经按你的要求，清除了封锁线，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: The merchants which own the gate you defended are very grateful for your assistance.  They told us to send you their best regards for a job well done.
messages.zh: 由于你保卫了那座星门，拥有星门的那些商人非常感激你的帮助。为了你出色的表现，他们通过我们向你致以最高的敬意。

messages.en: You're afraid of a few pirates?  Maybe I was wrong about you after all ...
messages.zh: 你会害怕几个海盗？看来我还是看错你了。

Therefore I want you, {[character]player.name}, to fly to the stargate and eliminate the illegal blockade.

messages.en: Oh comon now, it isn't that hard.  Ah well, I'll find someone else to finish the job then.
messages.zh: 哦，得了吧，其实没那么难。啊，好吧，那我去找别人来完成这个任务。

messages.en: I'll take care of these pests {[character]agentID.name}, just give me the coordinates and I'm good to go.
messages.zh: 我会处理这些害虫的，{[character]agentID.name}。把位标给我，我立刻出发。

messages.en: Take care out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 到那以后要小心，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
A DED strike-force has set up a blockade near a hidden stargate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and are swarming over any passersby, which are mostly smugglers loyal to {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}. DED tend to create these temporary blockades at ill-defended stargates, to catch some of our employees which have broken the law within 'Empire' space. And we tend to send in hired guns to disperse the pigs.

Yes you guessed it, I want you, {[character]player.name}, to take care of this business.
messages.zh:
一支DED攻击部队在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}附近的一个隐蔽星门设立了一道封锁线，成群结对骚扰行人，主要针对忠于{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name}的非法贩售者。DED通常把此类临时封锁线设立在防御薄弱的星门边，以捕捉我们一些在“帝国”境内触犯了法律的员工。而我们想要雇佣一些武装人员，派去清除这些蠢猪。

是的，你猜对了，{[character]player.name}，我要你去对付他们。

messages.en: I have cleared the blockade as you requested, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我已经按你的要求，清除了封锁线，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: The smugglers which own the gate you defended are very grateful for your assistance.  They told us to send you their best regards for a job well done.
messages.zh: 由于你保卫了那座星门，拥有星门的那些非法贩售者非常感激你的帮助。为了你出色的表现，他们通过我们向你致以最高的敬意。

messages.en: You're afraid of a few space pigs?  Maybe I was wrong about you after all ...
messages.zh: 你会害怕一些太空蠢猪？看来我还是看错你了。

messages.en: So long as it doesn't have to be organic, I'm your man.
messages.zh: 好吧，我听你的。

messages.en: Very good. Don't dally there, mind.
messages.zh: 非常好。别在那发呆了，思考者。

messages.en: I'm glad to see you. Things are heating up. You may be aware that we've been hunting the infamous Thukker warlord named Martokar Alash. He's proved quite difficult to provoke out of hiding, but we've finally been given a good lead. Unfortunately it's not to him, but to his brother, Okelle Alash. I don't know if our capturing Okelle will drive Martokar out of hiding, but at the very least it will give him one more thing to worry about. Okelle is a bit of a wild one. He's reportedly done just about every drug in existence, goes through a girlfriend a month and ends up leaving them at that harem of his, has built up a reputation for being near-suicidal in battle, and all in all lives the definite pirate lifestyle. You should be aware that once you start hunting him, though, he may be a little more cautious. He's only foolhardy when he's the one who chooses the battlefield, and this time we're aiming to catch him with his pants down. He'll probably manage to escape before you reach his harem, so if you don't find him there, I want you to bring back something he left that'll allow us to determine his whereabouts. It's a fairly well hidden place, so you'll have to search hard.
messages.zh: 很高兴见到你。形势正在升级。你可能知道我们正在追捕臭名昭著的图克尔军阀马图卡·阿哈什。他出了名的谨慎，很难把他激出巢穴，不过我们终于得到了一个很好的诱饵。不过这个诱饵不是直接引他出动，而是指向他的兄弟奥克勒·阿哈什。我不知道我们抓住奥克勒是否会把马图卡激出巢穴，但这最少也会给他添一件伤脑筋的事情。奥克勒是个有点疯狂的家伙。据说他服用过现今每个种类的违规药品，一个月换一个女朋友，最后把她们都扔在后宫之中，而且他因自尽式的战斗方式而闻名，总之，他过着彻底的海盗生活。你应该知道，一旦你开始追捕他，他就会变得更谨慎些。只有当他确信自己能掌控局势的时候才会释放内心的狂野。因此这次我们要打他个猝不及防。他很可能会在你到达他的后宫之前，就逃之夭夭，所以如果你在那里找不到他，你就给我带回一些他落下的东西，那可能会帮助我们找到他的下落。那是个很隐蔽的地方，所以你必须仔细寻找。

messages.en: Here's the data you need.
messages.zh: 这是你需要的数据。

messages.en: Thanks. I hope you didn't pick up anything else at that place.
messages.zh: 谢谢。我希望你没把那里的其他东西带回来。

messages.en: I'd much rather pay the place an unofficial visit. Thanks, but no thanks.
messages.zh: 我比较倾向于以非正式的形式去那里游览。谢谢。我不干，不过还是谢了。

messages.en: I do wish you people wouldn't put your own needs first all the time.
messages.zh: 我真希望人可以不那么自私。

messages.en:
The container you delivered to me was completely empty! Those damned Serpentis must have snatched the documents as you were loading the container aboard your ship.

I'm putting the blame for this mess squarely on your back. You need to solve this, {[character]player.name}! If my superiors find out the documents have been lost, we can expect some heads to roll ... your head, to be precise. Find the documents and bring them to me straight away. They cannot have gotten very far; I'm actually pretty sure they're in this very system.
messages.zh:
你递送给我的集装箱里面什么也没有！这些该死的天蛇垃圾肯定在你装船的时候把这些文件拿走了。

我只有把这糟糕的事情怪在你身上你必须解决它，{[character]player.name}！如果我的上级发现文件丢了，那么我们肯定有人要人头落地……准确地说，你的头是一定的了。找到文件，直接把它带给我。他们跑不远；实际上，我很确定，他们一定还在这个星系里。

name.ru: Царь горы (King of the Hill) (1 из 13)

messages.en: I'll get that data chip back here in no time.
messages.zh: 我会立刻将数据芯片带到这里。

messages.en: Do this for me and you will go far within the Amarr Empire.
messages.zh: 为我完成这个任务，你就会在艾玛帝国内名声大震。

messages.en: Do you have any work for a servant of the Empire?
messages.zh: 我想为艾玛帝国服务，你有工作么？

messages.en:
While the royal family does not officially condone the fighting between Methros and Arachnan, they do not see it as any major threat to their claim to power in this region. To that end they are willing to let it continue as the infighting is bringing a much needed economic boost to the region.

With this in mind, it is our duty to monitor the conflict and inform the Emperor and his council should either of the parties engage in business detrimental to the empire.

We have a mission suited to your talents my friend. Lord Methros and Arachnan have secret outposts inside their sphere of influence in Araz, from where they conduct various operations. We are of course aware of these outposts, as the Emperor Family has ears and eyes in all corners of the Empire, figuratively speaking of course. I want you to make an unannounced visit to these outposts and retrieve an encrypted data burst located inside them.

I want you to start with Lord Methros' outpost. I'll give you a bookmark to it's exact location, of course. I will inform his guards of your visit as soon as you arrive, since doing it any earlier would compromise your mission.
messages.zh:
虽然皇室并没有正式赦免梅多尔斯和埃拉克兰的争斗之罪，但也没有将其看作是对这个地区统治的主要威胁。结果就是，皇室愿意让争斗继续，因为内讧反而刺激了当地经济的发展。

了解这一点后，我们的职责就是密切关注这场斗争，一旦其中一方做了任何不利于帝国的事，我们要马上通知皇帝和他的智囊团。

我们有一个能发挥你才能的任务，我的朋友。梅多尔斯大人和埃拉克兰大人在埃拉茨的个人势力范围内都有秘密的哨站，他们在那里执行各种行动。我们当然清楚这些哨站的存在，皇室的耳目遍及整个帝国。当然，这只是一个比喻。我希望你对这些哨站进行一次不加通报的访问，将那里的一段加密数据给我带回来。

我要你先从梅多尔斯大人的哨站开始。当然，我会给你精确的位标。你一到那里，我就会通知他的守卫你已到访，如果过早透露消息会搞砸你的任务。

messages.en: I have the Encrypted Data Burst, but I have some disturbing news as well ...
messages.zh: 我得到了加密数据，同时也有一些恼人的消息……

messages.en: The presence of the Blood Raiders is disturbing news, I have another assignment for you already if you feel up to the job?
messages.zh: 血袭者的出现就够让人头痛的了，我已经为你布置了新的任务，你能胜任吗？

name.ru: Девица в беде (The Damsel In Distress)

messages.en: I'll get her back, I promise.
messages.zh: 我保证会把她带回来的。

messages.en: Good to hear.  Just keep a lookout for this Kruul character, he's known for being quite the scoundrel.
messages.zh: 很高兴听你这样说。不过要留意这个叫克鲁乌尔的人，他是个十足的流氓恶棍。

messages.en: It has come to my attention that one of our employee's daughters has gone missing.  She was last spotted in a disreputable nightclub in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and we're afraid she's been forced into slave labor, or even prostitution.  We request that you find her immediately and bring her safe and sound back to her family.  I will give you the coordinates of this nightclub, I believe it is called 'Kruul's Pleasure Hub', and I expect you to take care of the rest.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 我听说我们一个员工的女儿失踪了。最后有人看到她是在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一家低级会所，我们担心她已被迫为奴，甚至是舞女。请你立即找到她，然后把她安全送回家。我会给你这家会所的坐标，我想它叫作“克鲁乌尔的娱乐站”，剩下的事就交给你了。祝你好运。

messages.en: I have the damsel, now where's my money?
messages.zh: 我找到少女了，我的钱呢？

messages.en: I'll just have to find someone else then.
messages.zh: 看来我得找其他人了。

messages.en: I give up.
messages.zh: 我放弃。

messages.en: You would leave the poor damsel to her fate?  How cruel.  You've failed me today, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你想任这个可怜的少女遭遇不幸而无动于衷？太残忍了。你今天真让我失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.zh: 我保证会把她带回来的。

messages.en: Good to hear.  Just keep a lookout for the owner of the pleasure complex, I believe his name is Kruul.  He's known for being quite the scoundrel, and I wouldn't mind you getting rid of him for us if you get the chance.
messages.zh: 很高兴听你这样说。你要当心这个娱乐站的主人，他的名字好像叫做克鲁乌尔。他是个十足的恶棍，如果你有机会的话，我不介意你把他干掉。

messages.en: It has come to my attention that one of our employee's daughters has gone missing.  She was last spotted in a disreputable nightclub in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and we're afraid she's been forced into slave labor, or even prostitution.  We request that you find her immediately and bring her safe and sound back to her family.  I will give you the coordinates of this nightclub, I believe it is inside a pleasure complex, and I expect you to take care of the rest.  Good luck.
messages.zh: 我听说我们一个员工的女儿失踪了。最后有人看到她是在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一家低级会所，我们担心她已被迫为奴，甚至是舞女。请你立即找到她，然后把她安全送回家。我会给你这个会所的坐标，我记得那儿是在一个娱乐大楼里面，剩下的就交给你啦。祝你好运。

messages.en: I have the damsel, now where's my money?
messages.zh: 我找到少女了，我的钱呢？

messages.en: I'll just have to find someone else then.
messages.zh: 看来我得找其他人了。

messages.en: I give up.
messages.zh: 我放弃。

messages.en: You would leave the poor damsel to her fate?  How cruel.  You've failed me today, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你想任这个可怜的少女遭遇不幸而无动于衷？太残忍了。你今天真让我失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
I need a shipment of Synthetic Oil delivered to this station as soon as possible. It's currently stored in one of our warehouses in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; I'll give you the coordinates, of course. Just warp to our outpost, navigate to the warehouse, and pick up the shipment, and then return it to {[location]agentStationID.name}. Simple, ain't it?

Just make sure you keep a lookout for any suspicious activity. You can't be too careful these days.
messages.zh:
我有一批合成油需要被运到这个空间站来，越快越好。油现在存放在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个仓库内；当然，我会给你它的坐标。你只要跃迁到我们的哨站，驶向仓库，装上货物然后把它带回{[location]agentStationID.name}就行了。很简单，是吧？

只是务必要观察周围是否有可疑情况。这年头，万事都要小心翼翼。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
I'd like you to do some reconnaissance for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, my friend. Our operatives in an outpost within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have requested a convoy of goods, through some pretty hostile territory. There are a few routes we could take to reach the destination, and you're going to help us find the safest route.

All I need you to do is scout ahead and see if there are any pirates, rogue drones or dangerous terrain. Report your findings to me. I'll upload a bookmark to the first area into your NeoCom.
messages.zh:
我希望你为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}做一些侦察工作，我的朋友。我们位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}某哨站内的特工人员请求护送一些货物，将穿越一些相当危险的区域。有几条路线可供选择以达到目的地，你需要帮助我们找出最安全的路线。

我要你做的就是担当侦察先锋，察看前方是否有海盗、自由无人机或危险的地势。将你发现的情况汇报给我。我会将第一区域的位标上传到你的控制边栏中。

messages.en: So the first area was filled with pirates?  I expected as much.  Looks like we'll be looking some more, get ready for your next mission.
messages.zh: 就是说，第一区域全是海盗？我也是这么预料的。看来我们还要多看几个地方，为你的下个任务做好准备。

name.ja: エンジェルタグハンター

messages.en: I heard you are a headhunter, {[character]agentID.name}.  I have these tags you might be interested in.
messages.zh: 我听说你是一名猎头，{[character]agentID.name}。你可能会对我的这些铭牌感兴趣。

messages.en:
Why, yes, you heard correctly. I've been contracted by {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} to hunt down their enemies, and I am currently on the lookout for certain tags that would prove their demise. These tags can be acquired only by removing them from their dead bodies, of course. By the way, I'm an expert on appraising tags, so don't bother to try to trick me with forgeries. If you have the genuine stuff, then I'll pay for it. And you'll earn some good will with {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} at the same time. A win-win situation if you ask me.

I'm currently on the lookout for {[item]objectiveTypeID.name}.
messages.zh:
没错，你所闻不假。我跟{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}签订了合约，专门追捕他们的敌人，我正密切关注那些能证明敌人死亡的铭牌的动向。当然，获得这些铭牌的方式只能是在敌人死后，从他们的尸体上取下。顺便说一句，我是鉴定铭牌的专家，想用赝品来骗我是白费心思。如果你有真品，我会出钱购买。而且你还可以赢得在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的好名声。要我说，这就是双赢。

我现在正在寻找{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}。

messages.en: These would be genuine tags you have there.  You've got a deal.  Hope you enjoy your reward, mercenary.
messages.zh: 你有的这些铭牌是真的。买卖成交了。希望你对报酬满意，雇佣兵。

I've been contracted by {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} to hunt down their enemies, and I am currently on the lookout for certain tags that would prove their demise. These tags can be acquired only by removing them from their dead bodies, of course. By the way, I'm an expert on appraising tags, so don't bother to try to trick me with forgeries. If you have the genuine stuff, then I'll pay for it. And you'll earn some good will with {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} at the same time. A win-win situation if you ask me.

I'm currently on the lookout for {[item]objectiveTypeID.name}.
messages.zh:
没错，你所闻不假。我跟{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}签订了合约，专门追捕他们的敌人，我正密切关注那些能证明敌人死亡的铭牌的动向。当然，获得这些铭牌的方式只能是在敌人死后，从他们的尸体上取下。顺便说一句，我是鉴定铭牌的专家，想用赝品来骗我是白费心思。如果你有真品，我会出钱购买。而且你还可以赢得在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的好名声。要我说，这就是双赢。

我现在正在寻找{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
I'd like you to do some reconnaissance for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, my friend. Our operatives in an outpost within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have requested a convoy of goods, through some pretty hostile territory. There are a few routes we could take to reach the destination, and you're going to help us find the safest route.

All I need you to do is scout ahead and see if there are any pirates, rogue drones or dangerous terrain. Report your findings to me. I'll upload a bookmark to the first area into your NeoCom.
messages.zh:
我希望你为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}做一些侦察工作，我的朋友。我们位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}某哨站内的特工人员请求护送一些货物，将穿越一些相当危险的区域。有几条路线可供选择以达到目的地，你需要帮助我们找出最安全的路线。

我要你做的就是担当侦察先锋，察看前方是否有海盗、自由无人机或危险的地势。将你发现的情况汇报给我。我会将第一区域的位标上传到你的控制边栏中。

messages.en: So the first area was filled with pirates?  I expected as much.  Looks like we'll be looking some more, get ready for your next mission.
messages.zh: 就是说，第一区域全是海盗？我也是这么预料的。看来我们还要多看几个地方，为你的下个任务做好准备。

messages.en: So where's my next assignment?
messages.zh: 那么，我的下一个任务在哪里？

messages.en:
I have the second location for you to scout for us, I will upload it into your NeoCom shortly. We've had reports that the area has been claimed by some obscure mining corporation, who've hired mercenaries to defend their assets. It's in a pretty remote area in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, so don't expect the local security forces to back you up if you get confronted by the mercs.

Your job is to go in there, fly to the rendezvous point and report what you find back to us. If the mercs leave you alone, and you don't find any pirates roaming around there, then we've found our safe route.
messages.zh:
我获得了你需要为我们进行侦察的第二个地点，我很快就会将它上传到你的控制边栏里。据报告，某家身份不明的矿业公司声称该地区归其所有，并且招募了雇佣兵来保护其资产。那是位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个相当遥远的地区，所以如果你跟那些雇佣兵正面相遇，不要指望当地安全部队为你提供支援。

你的任务就是进入该地区，飞到指定地点并将你发现的情况报告给我们。如果那些雇佣兵不来找你麻烦，而且你没发现任何在那附近出没的海盗，那么我们的安全路线就找到了。

messages.en: They attacked you?  Blasted!  It seems those miners are more paranoid than I had hoped, maybe they found some incredibly rare minerals in the area.  These damn rogue corporations which aren't even registered with {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}, you never know what to expect from them.  Well it's not in our best interests to piss them off, so let's move on to the next location.
messages.zh: 他们向你发动攻击了？该死的！似乎那些矿工比我预计的要疯狂，也许他们在该地区找到了十分珍稀的矿石。这些该死的流氓集团，他们甚至没在{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}注册过。你永远料不到他们会干些什么。算了，激怒他们对我们没有任何好处，我们还是前进到下一个地点吧。

messages.en: So where do I go next?
messages.zh: 那么我接下来该去哪？

messages.en:
The next area you'll be scouting is known to be filled with hazardous, radioactive materials. It used to be a waste dump for {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}, but it also contains no mineral wealth at all so it's not a popular attraction for gold diggers fortunately.

I know there is still an acceleration gate inside the area and I want you to make sure it's still functioning and doesn't send you straight into something deadly. It's a dangerous job, but I'm not paying you for garbage hauling now am I. Get to it and report back to me with your findings!
messages.zh:
我们已知，你将侦察的下一个区域充满了危险的放射性物质。 它曾经是{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}的废料堆积处。庆幸的是，该地区没有任何矿藏，所以它不是淘金者爱来的地方。

我知道该区域内仍有一个加速轨道，我要你确认该轨道是否仍可以正常运转，并且不会把人直接送到致命的环境中去。这是一个危险的任务，但别忘了，我不是花钱雇你来运垃圾的。 出发吧，把你发现的情况汇报给我！

messages.en: Hmm.  So the acceleration gate is in working order, but there's nasty radiation covering the entire area.  Well, I'll submit your report to my superior and he'll decide which route we take.  They all seem to have their cons.  But you've certainly earned your reward, take care.
messages.zh: 哦，  就是说加速轨道运转正常，但有一片讨厌的放射性物质覆盖了整个区域。  好吧，我会把你的报告交给我的上级，他将决定我们选择哪条路线。  这些路线都有不尽如人意的地方。  当然，你赢得了自己的奖励，保重。

messages.zh:
我希望你为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}做一些侦察工作，我的朋友。我们位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}某哨站内的特工人员请求护送一些货物，将穿越一些相当危险的区域。有几条路线可供选择以达到目的地，你需要帮助我们找出最安全的路线。

我要你做的就是担当侦察先锋，察看前方是否有海盗、自由无人机或危险的地势。将你发现的情况汇报给我。我会将第一区域的位标上传到你的控制边栏中。

messages.en: So where's my next assignment?
messages.zh: 那么，我的下一个任务在哪里？

messages.en:
I have the second location for you to scout for us, I will upload it into your NeoCom shortly. We've had reports that the area has been claimed by some obscure mining corporation, who've hired mercenaries to defend their assets. Your job is to go in there, fly to the rendezvous point and report what you find back to us. If the mercs leave you alone, and you don't find any pirates roaming around there, then we've found our safe route.
messages.zh:
我获得了你需要为我们进行侦察的第二个地点，我很快就会将它上传到你的控制边栏里。据报告，某家身份不明的矿业公司声称该地区归其所有，并且招募了雇佣兵来保护其资产。那是位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个相当遥远的地区，所以如果你跟那些雇佣兵正面相遇，不要指望当地安全部队为你提供支援。

你的任务就是进入该地区，飞到指定地点并将你发现的情况报告给我们。如果那些雇佣兵不来找你麻烦，而且你没发现任何在那附近出没的海盗，那么我们的安全路线就找到了。

messages.en: They attacked you?  Blasted!  It seems those miners are more paranoid than I had hoped, maybe they found some incredibly rare minerals in the area.  These damn rogue corporations which aren't even registered with {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}, you never know what to expect from them. 我们已知，你将侦察的下一个区域充满了危险的放射性物质。 它曾经是{[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}的废料堆积处。庆幸的是，该地区没有任何矿藏，所以它不是淘金者爱来的地方。

我要你做的就是担当侦察先锋，察看前方是否有危险分子或危险的地势。将你发现的情况汇报给我。我会将第一区域的位标上传到你的控制边栏中。

messages.en: Blood Raiders?  I should have known.  There have been reports of those bastards roaming that territory.  But that's not our concern right now, so get ready for your next mission.
messages.zh: 血袭者？我早该料到了。之前就有人报告说他们在那里出没。但那不是我们现在要关心的，准备接受下一个任务吧。

messages.en:
I'd like you to do some reconnaissance for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, my friend. Our operatives in an outpost within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have requested a convoy of goods, through some pretty hostile territory. There are a few routes we could take to reach the destination, and you're going to help us find the safest route.

All I need you to do is scout ahead and see if there are any rogue elements or dangerous terrain. Report your findings to me. I'll upload a bookmark to the first area into your NeoCom.

messages.en: I want you to escort a convoy of trade goods heading out to our headquarters. It's just a formality, but a necessary one nonetheless. You'll find a bookmark to their current location in your NeoCom.
messages.zh: 我需要你护送一支运送贸易货物的舰队，目的地是我们的总部。这只是必要的例行公事。你会在控制边栏里找到他们当前位置的位标。

messages.en: Rogue drones looting trade convoys? Might be that there's a new hive nearby, I suppose, or maybe it's someone sinister pulling their strings. Who knows? Regardless, you did good ― can't blame you for the convoy's destruction. It was probably destroyed before you set out from the station. Take your reward, you've earned it.
messages.zh: 自由无人机袭击了贸易舰队？我猜想附近可能有一个新的机巢，要么就是某些奸险之徒在背后耍了阴谋诡计。谁知道呢。无论怎样，你干得不错，不能让你对舰队的覆灭负责。可能在你从空间站出发之前，舰队就已经被摧毁了。拿好你的奖励，这是你应得的。

messages.en: Oh, and also be on the lookout for the mercenary gang that owns the repair station. I doubt they'll look too kindly upon your attacking their precious structure.
messages.zh: 哦，还要小心拥有该维修站的雇佣兵团。我想他们不会就这么仁慈地坐视你攻击他们心爱的维修站。

messages.en:
We've discovered a small repair station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. By itself, this station is no issue, but when our patrols scanned the site they detected pirates in the area. This particular repair station is owned by a local mercenary gang that allows felonious individuals to dock there, and they are therefore aiding and abetting known criminals.

I would like you to do us all a favor and remove this repair station from existence. It's not registered in the government's official database and it's being used to break the law ― that is all the information I need to authorize decisive action against it. It may be guarded, so be careful.
messages.zh:
我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内发现了一座小型维修站。维修站本身不是什么大事，但我们的巡逻队在侦测该地点时发现该区域有海盗出没。这座维修站由一家当地雇佣兵团所有，他们允许凶恶之徒在那里停留，因此他们是在支持并助长臭名昭著的犯罪分子。

我希望你帮我们个忙，让那所维修站彻底消失。它没有在政府的官方数据库中注册，而且正被用于违法勾当——只要有这些信息，我就可以批准对它采取果断的行动。维修站可能有防守力量，要小心行事。

messages.en: Excellent! That repair station will aid pirates and outlaws no more.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！那所维修站不能再为海盗和不法分子提供帮助了。

messages.en: Hm. Guess I was wrong about you.
messages.zh: 嗯。看来我对你估计有误。

messages.en: In this mission you must find and destroy a structure in space, the repair station.  It will not appear in your overview unless you have 'Large Collidable Structure' selected in your overview settings.  Make sure that your settings are correctly configured, finding structures without using the overview is not always easy.
messages.zh: 在这次的任务中，你必须找到并摧毁一所太空建筑，就是维修站。你需要在总览设置中选中“大型可撞击的建筑”，维修站才会在你的总览中出现。请确保你的设置配置正确，不借助总览来找寻建筑是件比较麻烦的事。

messages.en: Hint
messages.zh: 提示

name.de: Zwei Fliegen mit einer Klappe schlagen
name.en: Striking Down Two Flies In One Swing
name.es: Matar dos pájaros de un tiro
name.ru: Двух зайцев одним выстрелом (Striking Down Two Flies In One Swing)

messages.en: Oh and be on the lookout for the mercenary gang that owns the repair outpost, I doubt they will look kindly upon you attacking their precious structure.
messages.zh: 哦，小心拥有该维修站的雇佣兵团。我想他们不会慈祥地坐视你攻击他们心爱的建筑。

messages.en:
We've discovered a small repair station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} which by itself is no issue, but when our patrols scanned the site they detected a gang of our rivals in the area. This particular repair station is owned by a local mercenary corporation, which obviously allows our enemies to operate it and are therefore just asking for retribution.

I would like you to do us all a favor and remove this repair station from existence. It's not registered in our database and this mercenary corporation is late on their tribute, which gives us a perfectly valid reason to obliterate them.

Be on your way now.
messages.zh:
我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内发现了一座小型维修站。维修站本身不是什么大问题，但我们的巡逻队在扫描该站点时探测到该区域存在着一伙我们的敌人。该维修站由一家当地雇佣兵军团所有，显然，他们允许我们的敌人运作该维修站并索取分成。

我希望你帮我们个忙，让那所维修站彻底消失。它没有在我们的数据库中注册，而且这家雇佣兵军团一直拖欠保护费，这给了我们充分的理由将他们一举除掉。

现在出发吧。

messages.en: Excellent, that repair station should no longer be of any use to our enemies.
messages.zh: 干得好，那所维修站不会再为我们的敌人效力了。

我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内发现了一座小型维修站。维修站本身不是什么大问题，但我们的巡逻队在扫描该站点时探测到该区域存在着一伙我们的敌人。该维修站由一家当地雇佣兵军团所有，显然，他们允许我们的敌人运作该维修站并索取分成。

我希望你帮我们个忙，让那所维修站彻底消失。它没有在我们的数据库中注册，而且这家雇佣兵军团一直拖欠保护费，这给了我们充分的理由将他们一举除掉。

现在出发吧。

messages.en: Excellent, that repair station should no longer be of any use to our enemies.
messages.zh: 干得好，那所维修站不会再为我们的敌人效力了。

name.de: Zwei Fliegen mit einer Klappe schlagen
name.en: Striking Down Two Flies In One Swing
name.es: Matar dos pájaros de un tiro
name.ru: Двух зайцев одним выстрелом (Striking Down Two Flies In One Swing)

messages.en: Oh and be on the lookout for the mercenary gang that owns the repair outpost, I doubt they will look kindly upon you attacking their precious structure.
messages.zh: 哦，小心拥有该维修站的雇佣兵团。我想他们不会慈祥地坐视你攻击他们心爱的建筑。

messages.en:
We've discovered a small repair station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} which by itself is no issue, but when our patrols scanned the site they detected a gang of our rivals in the area. This particular repair station is owned by a local mercenary corporation, which obviously allows our enemies to operate it and are therefore just asking for retribution.

I would like you to do us all a favor and remove this repair station from existence. It's not registered in our database and this mercenary corporation is late on their tribute, which gives us a perfectly valid reason to obliterate them.

Be on your way now.

messages.en: We have reports of terrorists wreaking havoc in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Our convoys have been attacked, as well as some outlying outposts; they seem to be intent on causing as much damage as possible. I'd like you to take care of them as quickly as possible. And be aware that they may not all be gathered together when you arrive... if so, you will be able to pick them off as they warp in to the rendezvous point.
messages.zh: 我们收到报告，恐怖份子正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}进行大肆破坏。我们的护航船和几个边远哨站都受到了攻击；他们似乎执意要把破坏程度最大化。我要你尽快去料理他们。要注意你到达时他们可能不是聚集在一起……若是这样的话，你就能在他们跃迁到集合点时解决他们了。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I see.  Well, perhaps you will be of some use next time.
messages.zh: 我明白了，好吧希望下次能用得到你。

messages.en:
One of our patrol teams noticed a suspicious looking craft on its system scanner. I'd like you to investigate the matter. If the craft is hostile, destroy it. Report back to me with your findings.

I'll supply you with a bookmark to its approximate location, just be wary of any other hostile activity in the area. I expect a swift return {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
我们的巡逻队在星系扫描仪上发现了一个形迹可疑的飞行物。我要你去调查此事。如果这个飞行物怀有敌意，那么消灭它。将你的发现报告给我。

我会提供你那里的粗略位标，千万小心该区域的其他地方活动。希望你快去快回，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I'm truly sorry, {[character]player.name}.  We'll launch an inquiry into why the surveillance team failed to notice any sign of a set up.  The responsible parties will be punished.  I just hope the mission reward soothes your anger.
messages.zh: 真的很抱歉，{[character]player.name}。我们会调查为什么侦察队没发现这个陷阱的任何征兆。责任方会受到应有的惩罚。我只希望任务的报酬能够平复你愤怒的心情。

messages.en: Our surveillance teams have discovered a disturbance near some old ruins in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  I'd like you to take a look, it's awfully close to one of our outposts.  Report your findings to me.
messages.zh: 我们的侦察队在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内发现了一些旧废墟。那离我们的一个哨站实在太近了，我希望你能去看看。向我汇报你发现的情况。

messages.en: I'm sorry that you got ambushed, {[character]player.name}.  You have my regrets.  I'll have someone take care of any ships or sentries that you left behind.
messages.zh: 很抱歉你遇到了埋伏，{[character]player.name}。我为你感到难过。我会派人去收拾被你甩掉的飞船或岗哨。

messages.en:
I need someone to safely transport these Data Sheets. They contain various files that relate to matters of national security — not something we can entrust to anyone less than a capsuleer.

Once you have delivered them, contact me and let me know you've completed the mission. I'll have something else ready for you by the time you get back.

Don't forget to put the Data Sheets in your cargohold before you set off!
messages.zh:
我需要有人安全运送这批数据单。这些都是事关国家安全的文档，我只能把它托付给克隆飞行员。

完成运送后请联系我，让我知道你完成了任务。你回来时我有其它东西要给你。

千万别忘记，在你出发前把数据单放在舰船的货柜舱内。

messages.en: Well done, {[character]player.name}. Let me know when you're ready to begin your next assignment. I've found a job you could profit and learn from at the same time.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。如果你准备好接受下一个任务了，那就知会我一声。我这里已经有份工作可以让你在赚到钱的同时还能学到点东西。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (10 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (10 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (10 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (10 из 10)

messages.en:
You've done a great job so far, mastering the intricacies of industry - mining, reprocessing, manufacturing, and hauling. All while murdering everyone who stands in your way. You're now ready for your final assignment.

You're going to bring me a full-fledged frigate. I'll give you a blueprint copy with more than enough runs for this task. If you choose to use it, finding the resources is up to you. But time is money, and however you choose to acquire the ship is fine by me.

Good luck!
messages.zh:
到目前为止你做得很好！你掌握了工业生产中采矿、提炼、制造和运输的繁琐流程，也干掉了所有碍事的家伙。你现在可以完成最终任务了。

你要造一艘完备的护卫舰，我会给你一份蓝图拷贝，能让你轻松完成本次任务。如果你要用它，就要自己寻找资源。时间就是金钱，我不会干预你造舰的方式。

祝你好运！

messages.en:
Congratulations, {[character]player.name}! With the successful production of that Burst you've proven that you have what it takes. I hate to see you go, but you have mastered all the challenges I have for you.

There are plenty of mining agents out there who would be happy to employ someone like you who can get the job done. You can find them in the Agency Mining Agents. Or, if you are interested in broadening your skills into other areas you can start a conversation with any of the other career agents here in station.

Best of luck in the future, my friend. Stick with the Republic and you'll do well.
messages.zh:
祝贺你，{[character]player.name}！你成功制造出了一个爆发级，实力不俗。我不愿你离去，但你已经完成了我为你准备的所有挑战。

有很多采矿代理人愿意雇佣像你这样能胜任工作的人。你可以在星际代理处的采矿代理人中找到他们。或者，如果你想将自己的技能拓展到其他领域，你可以与空间站中的其他职业代理人交谈。

祝你未来一切都好，我的朋友。与共和国并肩作战，你一定会干得很出色。

messages.en: You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You should enroll in other training courses and learn as much as you can before making any long-term plans.
messages.zh: 你做的很好，{[character]player.name}。但在你为自己做出任何长远规划之前，我希望你能先去把其他的课程都学一下，多多益善。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。这样我只好把这个任务交给别人去打理了。

messages.en: Since you seem to have forgotten, I asked you to bring me a frigate, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你可能是忘记了，我曾让你带一艘护卫舰给我的。我给了你一星期时间，到现在什么结果都没收到。看样子我非得找别人不可了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (9 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (9 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (9 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (9 из 10)

messages.en:
Turns out one of my production assistants was a spy for the enemy. He's gone into hiding, so I need you to draw him out.

You'll act as a decoy, mining until enemy forces turn up. Destroy them and bring the spy back to me. You may keep whatever ore you find out there.

Make sure you use a mining laser, so they'll notice you out there.
messages.zh:
没想到我的生产助理中还有敌方派来的间谍。他已经躲藏起来了，所以我要你把他引出来。

你要做诱饵，假装在那里采矿，直到敌人出现。干掉他们，然后把那个间谍押运回来。那里的矿石随你拿。

务必使用采矿激光器，这样他们才会注意到你在那儿。

messages.en: Praise the Republic! Well done! And now, I'm sad to say, I have just one more task for you.
messages.zh: 共和国赞扬你！干得好！现在，我只剩一项任务给你了。

messages.en:
The Black Box you retrieved indicates that the Angel Cartel has built a surveillance facility nearby, using it to launch attacks on convoys from the {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.

You need to take out the outpost and any vessels defending it. Once the area is clear, use the Civilian Data Analyzer I'm giving you to hack the data storage device in the area. Bring back whatever it contains.
messages.zh:
你带回的黑匣子有信息显示天使集团在附近建立了一座侦察设施，正利用它攻击{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的运输船队。

你得去摧毁那座哨站和周围守卫的船只。清理了战场之后，使用我给你的民用数据分析仪破解该区域的所有数据存储装置，带回任何有用的东西。

messages.en: Amazing work, {[character]player.name}. With the destruction of that outpost we now have time to go over the evidence and prepare for any upcoming attacks.
messages.zh: 太好了，{[character]player.name}。那哨站没了，我们就有时间仔细研究这些证据，并对即将到来的攻击做好准备。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. I needed that Cartel listening post dealt with.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。那我只好把这个任务交给别人去打理了。总之天使的那个哨站我是一定要弄掉的。

messages.en: I needed you to deal with that Cartel listening post quickly, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我已经要求你尽快把那天使哨站给端了。我给了你一星期时间，迄今什么回信都没收到。看样子我必须把这活儿交别人干了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

messages.en:
The Black Box you retrieved indicates that the Blood Raiders have built a surveillance facility nearby, using it to launch attacks on convoys from the {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.

You need to take out the outpost and any vessels defending it. Once the area is clear, use the Civilian Data Analyzer I'm giving you to hack the data storage device in the area. Bring back whatever it contains.
messages.zh:
你带回的黑匣子有信息显示血袭者在附近建立了一座侦察设施，正利用它攻击{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的运输船队。

你得去摧毁那座哨站和周围守卫的船只。清理了战场之后，使用我给你的民用数据分析仪破解该区域的所有数据存储装置，带回任何有用的东西。

messages.en: God bless you, {[character]player.name}. With the destruction of that outpost we now have time to go over the evidence and prepare for any upcoming attacks.
messages.zh: 上帝保佑，{[character]player.name}。那哨站没了，我们就有时间仔细研究这些证据，并对即将到来的攻击做好准备。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. I needed that Blood Raider listening post dealt with.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你这么不主动那肯定是没有兴趣了。那我只有把这个任务交给别人了，血袭者的那座哨站是一定要弄掉的。

messages.en: I needed you to deal with that Blood Raider listening post quickly, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我已经要求你尽快把那血袭者哨站给端了。我给了你一星期时间，迄今什么回信都没收到。看样子我必须把这活儿交别人干了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

messages.en: And one other thing before you leave. Whatever you do, don't shoot at the particle accelerator itself. If you do, I'll have your coffin ready for you in a jiffy. Understand?
messages.zh: 在你离开之前，还有件事要说明一下。无论你采取什么行动，绝对不要朝粒子加速器开火。如果你这么干了，我会立刻为你准备好棺材的。明白了吗？

messages.en: I'm interested.  What type of job are we talking about?
messages.zh: 我很感兴趣。我们讨论的是什么样的任务？

messages.en:
I'll get right down to it then. I am {[character]agentID.name}, an operative of C.E.R.N., a corporation with strong ties with CONCORD. We oversee a part of their technological research and development, that's all I can tell you. My role within the corporation is confidential, but I am here on official business.

The problem we currently face is in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We set up a number of particle accelerators there, for various testing and research purposes, which we abandoned a few years ago. We stripped them of everything we needed, but apparently one of them was still in a condition to continue functioning.

A few weeks ago we were informed that someone, or rather something, had managed to override the system lock we placed on one of the particle accelerators and turn it back on. The problem is whoever did this doesn't seem to have a clue of the dangers involved in running these things, the type of particle accelerator involved has instruments inside which can in theory create energy in enormous quantities. The catch is that once the energy level reaches a certain point, the operation becomes extremely unstable and liable to cause a chain reaction resulting in an explosion of catastrophic proportion, and cause conditions to arise which may result in the formation of a miniature black hole. The latest reports indicate that the particle accelerator has become so unstable it could blow at any minute.

We've already sent a team to shut down the accelerator, but we lost contact with them days ago. The last transmissions we heard from their leader indicated that they had found a strange object which was draining energy from the accelerator. It appears that this object is causing the dangerous energy bursts which we are afraid may cause the conditions necessary for the formation of the black hole. If you were to remove this object, then we expect the particle accelerator to quickly defuse as its capacitor has already drained and relies on external energy output managed by this object.

Now I won't say this isn't dangerous, we've already lost one team on this job. But if you have the guts then the mission is yours. I would however advise you to bring along some friends, the gate leading to the site in question is only configured to work with small frigates which may be poorly equipped to deal with the situation by themselves. A squadron of them however ...
messages.zh:
那我就直入主题吧。我叫{[character]agentID.name}，是C.E.R.N.的特工，C.E.R.N.是一家与统合部关系紧密的军团。我们负责监督他们的部分技术研发方案，我只能告诉你这么多。我在军团中的职务是机密的，但我在这里执行公务。

我们现在遇到的问题出在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。我们在那里设立了不少粒子加速器，用于各种测试和研究目的，我们在几年前放弃了这些设施。我们从加速器上卸除了所有需要的东西，但其中一台的状态显然还适合再次运转。

几星期前，我们接到消息，有人，或者更确切地说，有样东西设法穿过了我们设在某台粒子加速器的系统锁并再次启动了机器。问题是，无论这事是谁干的，那个人似乎对运行这些机器的相关危险一无所知。这种粒子加速器内含有的仪器理论上可以产生极其巨大的能量。一旦能量等级达到一定界限，机器的运行将变得极不稳定，而且很可能会产生连锁反应，导致灾难性的大爆炸，最终的状况可能会导致小型黑洞的形成。根据最新的报告，粒子加速器已极不稳定，随时可能爆炸。

我们已经派出一支队伍去关闭加速器，但几天前我们与他们失去了联系。我们从同该队队长的最后一次通话中了解到，他们发现了一个奇怪物体，正在从加速器中吸取能量。似乎正是这个物体造成了危险的能量爆发，我们担心这些爆发可能最终形成适合黑洞生成的必要条件。如果你去消灭这个物体，我们估计粒子加速器会很快停息下来，因为它的电容器已经被吸干了，现在的运转完全依赖由物体控制的外部能源输出。

我不否认这个任务的危险性，我们已经为此失去了一个队伍。但你要是有这个胆量的话，这个任务就是你的了。不过，我建议你带上一些朋友，通往事故地点的加速轨道被设置为仅允许小型护卫舰使用，而护卫舰的蹩脚装备可能无法独自应付局面。要是一个护卫舰中队的话，情况可能就不一样了……

messages.en: The task has been completed, Christer.
messages.zh: 任务完成了，克里斯特。

messages.en:
Amazing job, {[character]player.name}! I hope you put that implant to good use, you've most definitely earned it!

Now that this situation has been taken care I must get back to my work. Perhaps when I make my next discovery I'll name the product that comes of it after you, my friend. Who knows! Take care.
messages.zh:
干得太出色了，{[character]player.name}！我希望你好好使用这块植入体，你受之无愧！

既然局势已经得到控制，我就必须回去工作了。当我进行下一次发明时，我可能会用你的名字给产品命名，我的朋友。谁知道呢！保重。

messages.en:
The Cartel has heavily encoded all of their tactical information. Our best hope at decryption is a friend of mine over in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, so I want you to safely ferry it to her.

I'd be happy to offer you some Inertial Stabilizers for the journey. This module improves your ship's handling and maneuverability, helping you align to warp faster.
messages.zh:
天使对他们的战术情报做了牢不可破的加密处理，想要破译它，只能寄希望于我在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的一个朋友，所以我要你把它带过去给她。

为了应对这趟旅途，我会给你几个惯性稳定器。这种装备可以提高舰船的操控性，帮你更快地转向和跃迁。

messages.en: Thank you for handling that delivery, {[character]player.name}. I'm sure my colleague will have something for us shortly.
messages.zh: 谢谢你帮忙，{[character]player.name}。我想她一定有办法的。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. I needed those Cartel documents delivered days ago.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你这么不主动那肯定是不想做这个任务了吧。那我就去找别人了。这些天使文档我本来打算几天前就送出去了。

messages.en: I needed you to deliver those Cartel documents quickly, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.

name.ru: Наличные для капсулеров (Cash Flow for Capsuleers)  (1 из 10)

messages.en:
Angel Cartel thugs are harassing miners in a nearby asteroid belt. Let's clean up the area.

Make sure to keep your target within your weapon's range, and try not to give them a stationary target.
messages.zh:
一些天使企业联合体暴徒正在骚扰附近一条小行星带中的矿工，让我们把那个地方清理干净吧。

你要确保目标在武器的射程内，并且要保持移动，不要当一个静止的活靶子。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. I'll have the miners return to work. See me when you're ready for your next assignment.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。我立刻就让矿工回去工作。你准备好做下一个任务了就来找我。

messages.en:
We've discovered an ancient site that the pirates are using as some kind of staging outpost. We cannot let them continue to gain any kind of foothold in this area. You need to kill them.

Since we're businessmen, mind you, I suggest you also fit a Civilian Relic Analyzer to your ship. Once you have cleared the mission area of hostiles, you can use the Analyzer to inspect any ancient ships or ruins in the area.
messages.zh:
我们发现了一处被那些海盗用作岗哨的古迹。我们不能让他们在此处扎根，你得去干掉他们。

既然我们是商人，我建议你在船上再装配一件民用遗迹分析仪，一旦你清除了任务区域的敌人，就可以用民用遗迹分析仪去侦查该区域的古舰船或残骸。

messages.en: Impressive work, {[character]player.name}! I'll pass the analyses on to my superiors immediately. Thank you once again.
messages.zh: 是吗，太好了，{[character]player.name}！我马上就会将分析结果报告给我的上级。谢谢你。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. I needed that Cartel archaeology site dealt with.
messages.zh: 我给了你整整一个星期的时间去思考我给你的工作机会，{[character]player.name}。你的沉默让我觉得你对这活儿毫无兴趣。这样的话，我想我必须要把这个任务转交给别的什么人了，我需要有人帮我处理那个考古发掘场的事务。

messages.en: I needed you to deal with that Cartel archaeology site quickly, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: 我希望你能去调查那个天使考古现场，{[character]player.name}。我都给了你整整一个星期的时间，但你居然一点反馈都没？这样的话，我想我必须要把这个任务转交给别的什么人了，我需要有人帮我处理那个考古发掘场的事务。

messages.en:
I suspect we'll get a chance before long to hunt down this pirate who escaped.

Meanwhile, I've located an illegal stargate hidden by the interference from a large deadspace field, and I want you to scout the area.
messages.zh:
我觉得我们恐怕无法很快找到那个逃跑的海盗并干掉他。

与此同时，我发现了一个被大型死亡空间力场保护着的非法星门，我要你去那里侦察一下。

messages.en: Sorry about the cloud damage to your ship. You might try fitting that afterburner I gave you. They're very useful when you need to get out of a dangerous area quickly.
messages.zh: 啊，不好意思让你的舰船受损了。要不试试装上我给你的加力燃烧器吧，当你想要快速离开危险地带的时候它可能非常有用。

messages.en:
After you left the area, our cleanup crew found a message from that pirate, "The Devout". He wants to meet you in person, with no backup, at a small repair outpost in this system. Be careful - you don't have to kill the man, but he's assassinated people I've known, so his death wouldn't be any great loss.

I'll provide you with a Civilian EM Shield Hardener. It will improve your shield resistance against Electromagnetic Damage, which is what Blood Raider lasers primarily dish out. Amarr starship tech usually revolves around armor repair, not shield resistance, but this should see you through for now.
messages.zh:
你离开该区域后，我们的清扫人员发现了来自德伍特的消息。他想和你本人见面，双方都不带人，地点是本星系的一座小维修站。要小心——你不必杀了他，但他杀害过我认识的人，所以他死掉了也没什么大不了的。

我会给你一个民用电磁护盾增强器。它能助你抵挡血袭者的激光器放出的电磁伤害。艾玛人其实比较常用装甲类的防御装备，但现在你拿这应付一下应该就够了。

messages.en: I cannot believe the nerve of that criminal! Alright, this has gone on too long.
messages.zh: 我简直不敢相信那个恶棍的勇气！算了，一切都过去了。

messages.en:

Moreover, I can provide you with a Small Armor Repairer I if you're willing to take this on. It should help you against any damage thrown your way by Steon and his allies' ships.

messages.zh: 又让他逃跑了？没关系，只要多多少少打击了他的同伴就很不错了。

messages.en:
We've got him this time. Follow these coordinates to catch Steon once and for all. Note that he'll be heavily guarded by his cohorts.

If your shields and armor are depleted and you're close to taking hull damage, warp out immediately. You can either dock at a nearby station and pay its repair shop to fix your ship, or you can use an armor repairer module while in space.
messages.zh:
这次我们不会放走他了。循着这些坐标去抓住史坦。注意拥护者们会严防死守保护他。

如果你舰船的护盾和装甲都所剩无几接近结构了，要立即跃迁离开。你可以就近停靠空间站修理舰船，也可以在太空中使用装甲维修器。

messages.en:
The Republic is grateful for your service, {[character]player.name}. Thanks to your combat expertise we've got one less scumbag pirate boss to worry about.

If you would like to further your career in enforcement, there are Agents hiring across the cluster. I've heard the Sisters of EVE are looking for capable pilots, check out The Blood-Stained Stars for more information. If you'd rather broaden your skill set instead, you could start a conversation with any of the other Career Agents in this station.

Thanks again for everything, and good luck out there!
messages.zh:
共和国不会忘记你的贡献，{[character]player.name}。多亏了你教的战斗技巧，我们又干掉了一个臭海盗头子。

如果你想打入执法领域的内部，那就去找正在招聘的代理人吧。听说EVE姐妹会正在招聘能力出众的飞行员，去血染之星了解更多信息吧。反之，如果你更想拓展自己的技能，可与站内的其他职业代理人聊一聊。

再次感谢你的贡献，祝你好运！

If your shields and armor are depleted and you're close to taking hull damage, warp out immediately. You can either dock at a nearby station and pay its repair shop to fix your ship, or you can use an armor repairer module while in space.
messages.zh:
这次我们不会放走他了。循着这些坐标去抓住沃夫。注意拥护者们会严防死守保护他。

messages.en: Good work. The miner's family will be pleased. I'll notify them immediately.

messages.en: The miners are happy, but now the station owners are not. An Angel Cartel pirate has stolen some sensitive documents from them, and I'm tasked with quietly resolving the matter. I'm entrusting you with this. Get those documents back for me.
messages.zh: 矿工们很高兴，但现在轮到我们的空间站主人不高兴了。一名天使海盗拿走了一些敏感文件，他们叫我悄悄地解决这个问题。我相信你可以搞定这件事的，去把那些文件拿回来给我吧。

messages.en: I read your ship's encounter analysis as you were docking - not your fault someone escaped, soldier. I'll fill you in shortly.
messages.zh: 在你停靠的时候我读了你的舰船遭遇分析数据，有人逃掉了不是你的错。我一会儿再和你说。

name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (1 из 10)

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, war never stops, and we need to stoke it with raw materials. I want you to go mine some Veldspar ore for me.

Remember to fit a mining module to your ship before you go, and keep in mind that you might have to make more than one trip before you report back to me.

To make it clear, I want you to mine at least some ore from the location I've uploaded for you.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，战争永不会停歇，而原材料更是能给它推波助澜。我要你去采些凡晶石来。

记得在出发前把采矿器装到船上，你可能得多跑一两趟才能完成任务回来向我报告。

重申一下，你要在我给的地点采些矿石回来。

messages.en: Well done, my friend. I may have another task for you.
messages.zh: 干得好，我的朋友。我也许还有新任务给你。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (1 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (1 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (1 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (1 из 10)

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, war never stops, and we need to stoke it with raw materials. I want you to go mine some Veldspar ore for me.

Remember to fit a mining module to your ship before you go, and keep in mind that you might have to make more than one trip before you report back to me.
