messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，战争永不会停歇，而原材料更是能给它推波助澜。我要你去采些凡晶石来。

记得在出发前把采矿器装到船上，你可能得多跑一两趟才能完成任务回来向我报告。

重申一下，你要在我给的地点采些矿石回来。

messages.en: Well done, my friend. I may have another task for you.
messages.zh: 干得好，我的朋友。我也许还有新任务给你。

messages.en:
There is one other thing our security forces need before they are fully prepared for the coming battle with these insufferable pirates.

Our forces are suffering a shortage of afterburners for their frigate contingents, and the resulting lack of speed is costing them dearly. I need two 1MN Afterburner I modules from you - buy them, build them, or loot them from the cooling wreckage of other ships. I won't ask questions.
messages.zh:
在我们的安全部队准备好与这些可恶的海盗战斗之前，他们还需要一样东西。

由于缺少足够的加力燃烧器，我们的护卫舰分遣队缺乏速度，损失惨重。我需要你提供两件1MN加力燃烧器 I装备给我。

-你可以通过查看1MN加力燃烧器 I的市场详情，根据物品的价格，物品售卖的位置等因素自行选择购买。
（卖家所在的位置，若不在当前空间站，需要自行前往取货)

-你也可以通过其他途径获得1MN加力燃烧器 I，如果你装配了它，你必须在物品机库中右键点击这个装备，进行拆卸装箱后再给我。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}! There was already mounting pressure on our financiers to delegate us more resources, but this will surely guarantee that we get what we need.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}！我们的财务人员最近采购压力很大，你这下就帮了我们一个大忙。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. The window of opportunity to fix our funding problems is passing us by.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。这样我只好把这个任务交给别人去打理。经费这问题不能再拖了。

messages.en: Hmph. I do wish you had told me earlier, {[character]player.name}. Very well, I suppose it can't be helped. Thank you for all the other times you were more reliable.
messages.zh: 你干嘛不早点告诉我，{[character]player.name}。算了，不行就不行了。还是得感谢你在其他的任务上所表现出的可靠性。

messages.en: I needed you to acquire those afterburners quickly, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我已经要求你尽快的弄几台加力燃烧器来。我给了你一星期时间，迄今什么回信都没收到。看样子我必须把这活儿交别人干了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (4 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (4 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (4 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (4 из 10)

messages.en:
Any industrial mogul worth their salt knows how to fight for their bounty.

I'm sending you to mine in an area infested with Rogue Drones. Let's see if you can survive the trip and bring me the processed goods.
messages.zh:
任何一个名副其实的工业大亨都明白如何为赏金而战。

我要你前往自由无人机出没的地区与之一战，让我们看看你是否能够为我带回加工物品凯旋归来。

messages.en:
Your final test as a business mogul is also your opportunity to feed the war machine. You've provided us with utility modules; now it's the basic building blocks of violence: Weapons.

I'm giving you a blueprint copy with which you can fulfil my quota. Any remaining production runs are yours, as is this Industrial-class ship I'm going to reward you with.

Are you ready to pass your final test, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh:
你能否成为商业大亨的最终考验，也是你获得弹药、装填战争武器的好机会。你已经向我们提供了装备，现在该轮到武器了，它才是暴力之源。

我现在给你一张蓝图拷贝，你可以用它来制造我需要的数额，制造的剩余流程数归你了，和这艘工业舰船一起算是给你的奖励。

准备好进行这次终考了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en:
Well done, {[character]player.name}. Here is your Wreathe, as promised; use it well. You've completed all my tasks and shown yourself to be a savvy entrepreneur. There is an entire cluster filled with opportunities for someone like you.

To find other agents you can just check the Agency, Distribution Agents might be of interest to you. Or if you want to broaden your skill set you can reach out to the other Career Agents here in this station.

Whichever future business endeavors you decide to pursue, good luck!
messages.zh:
做得好，{[character]player.name}。现在这艘环绕级归你了，好好利用它。你已经完成了我安排的所有任务，足以证明你是个有头脑的企业家。在你们这类人眼中，宇宙中充满了无限机遇。

如需寻找其他代理人，星际代理处中的物流代理人部分可能会符合你的要求。或者，如果你想拓展自己的技能，可与站内的其他职业代理人聊一聊。

无论你今后决定从事什么领域，都祝你好运！

messages.en: You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You should enroll in other training courses and learn as much as you can before making any long-term plans.
messages.zh: 你做的很好，{[character]player.name}。但在你为自己做出任何长远规划之前，我希望你能先去把其他的课程都学一下，多多益善。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about that final production test, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I won't be able to pass you for the course though, I'm afraid.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑那最后一项生产任务。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。恐怕我是没法给你评合格了。

messages.en: I wanted you to provide me with the weapon quickly, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I have to record your failure in our database. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: 我想要你快点把武器带给我，{[character]player.name}。我给了你一星期时间，到现在什么结果都没收到。看样子我得把你的无能记录在数据库里了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (4 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (4 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (4 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (4 из 10)

messages.en:
Any industrial mogul worth their salt knows how to fight for their bounty.

I'm sending you to mine in an area infested with Rogue Drones. Let's see if you can survive the trip and bring me the processed goods.
messages.zh:
任何一个名副其实的工业大亨都明白如何为赏金而战。

我要你前往自由无人机出没的地区与之一战，让我们看看你是否能够为我带回加工物品凯旋归来。

messages.en:
I've compiled all the information you have gathered so far from the various pirate facilities. It's my belief that with everything going on, we might be able to get more military funding out in these areas. This Central Data Core will provide all the evidence we need to argue for it.

Please take it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for me. I have a friend there who can pass it on to the right people. Can we count on you to make this delivery?
messages.zh:
你在众多海盗基地中找到了不少资料，我把所有这些信息都整理了一番。我相信按目前形势，我们完全可以要求上面再给那些地区多拨一些军费。这中央数据核心里面保存了所有能支持这一要求的证据，

请把它送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，那里有我一个朋友，他知道该把这东西交给谁。
怎么样，我们能把这事交给你做吗？

-首先，将物品机库里的中央数据核心放入舰船货仓。

-跟着任务指引飞到目标地点。
（如果目标地点不在本星系，您需要“设置终点”后，在总览中右击黄色星门“跳跃”前往）

-与收货人交谈后，即可完成任务。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. I've been informed that the evidence is already making its way up the chain of command. Good news indeed.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。有人告诉我，上面已经有人拿到那些信息了。好事啊。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. I needed those documents delivered days ago.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。这样我就得去找别人了。这些文档我本来打算几天前就送出去的。

messages.en: I needed you to deliver those data files quickly, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我已经要求你尽快把这些数据文档送出去。我给了你一星期时间，迄今为止什么回信都没收到。看样子我必须把这活儿交别人干了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

messages.en:
A transport ship carrying sensitive cargo has been destroyed by pirates in the area. I'm giving you a Civilian Salvager module so you can go in, use it on the ship's wreckage, and extract anything of use from their databanks. Once you have that Black Box, return it to me.

Also, there may be some hostiles still lingering around too, so be ready for combat, {[character]player.name}. If you're successful, I may reward you with a brand new mining frigate.
messages.zh:
一艘携带着敏感货物的运输舰在这片区域被海盗击毁了。我现在给你一件民用打捞装备，你可以把它用在这艘舰船的残骸上，看看能不能从他们的数据库中提取什么有用的东西。一旦你发现了那个黑匣子，就来向我汇报。

敌人可能还没有完全散去，所以你要做好迎战准备，{[character]player.name}。如果你完成任务，我会奖励你一艘崭新的采矿护卫舰。

messages.en: Fantastic work, {[character]player.name}. With this in our possession, we can build a clearer picture of the Angel Cartel attack. Here is your Venture, as promised.

I don't care how you do it; you can build one using the blueprint I gave you or just buy it off someone else. But however you get your hands on one, please make sure it is packaged before you give it to me.
messages.zh:

我不管你怎么弄到它，用我给你的蓝图自己造也行，从别人手里买也行。无论用什么方法，你要记得先把它拆卸装箱后再给我。

messages.en: Excellent – looks good. Nice work.

messages.en:
You've mined, processed, built and fought. Now let's see if you can transport my goods safely.

Take these electronic parts out to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} as fast as possible.
messages.zh:
你已经训练过采矿、提炼、制造和战斗了，现在我们来看看你安全运送货物的能力如何。

把这些电子元件尽快送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去。

- 首先，将装箱的电子元件放入舰船货仓。

- 跟着任务指引飞到目标地点。
（如果目标地点不在本星系，您需要“设置终点”后，在总览中右击黄色星门“跳跃”前往）

- 与收货人交谈后，即可完成任务。

messages.en: Superb. Just give me a moment, would you? Then I'll have something else for you.
messages.zh: 好极了。给我一些时间，好吗？待会儿我还有别的活给你。

messages.en:
I need someone to safely transport these Data Sheets. They contain various files that relate to matters of national security — not something we can entrust to anyone less than a capsuleer.

Once you have delivered them, contact me and let me know you've completed the mission. I'll have something else ready for you by the time you get back.

Don't forget to put the Data Sheets in your cargohold before you set off!
messages.zh:
我需要有人安全运送这批数据单。这些都是事关国家安全的文档，我只能把它托付给克隆飞行员。

完成运送后请联系我，让我知道你完成了任务。你回来时我有其它东西要给你。

千万别忘记，在你出发前把数据单放在舰船的货柜舱内。

messages.en: Well done, {[character]player.name}. Let me know when you're ready to begin your next assignment. I have found a job you could profit and learn from at the same time.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。如果你准备好了接受下一个任务，那就知会我一声。我这里已经有份工作可以让你在赚到钱的同时还能学到点东西。

messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。如果你准备好接受下一个任务了，那就知会我一声。我这里已经有份工作可以让你在赚到钱的同时还能学到点东西。

messages.en:
I've compiled all the information you have gathered so far from the various pirate facilities. It's my belief that with everything going on, we might be able to get more military funding out in these areas. This Central Data Core will provide all the evidence we need to argue for it.

Please take it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for me. I have a friend there who can pass it on to the right people. Can we count on you to make this delivery?
messages.zh:
你在众多海盗基地中找到了不少资料，我把所有这些信息都整理了一番。我相信按目前形势，我们完全可以要求上面再给那些地区多拨一些军费。这中央数据核心里面保存了所有能支持这一要求的证据，

请把它送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，那里有我一个朋友，他知道该把这东西交给谁。
怎么样，我们能把这事交给你做吗？

-首先，将物品机库里的中央数据核心放入舰船货仓。

-跟着任务指引飞到目标地点。
（如果目标地点不在本星系，您需要“设置终点”后，在总览中右击黄色星门“跳跃”前往）

-与收货人交谈后，即可完成任务。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. I've been informed that the evidence is already making its way up the chain of command. Good news indeed.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。有人告诉我，上面已经有人拿到那些信息了。好事啊。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. I needed those documents delivered days ago.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。这样我就得去找别人了。这些文档我本来打算几天前就送出去的。

messages.en: I needed you to deliver those data files quickly, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我已经要求你尽快把这些数据文档送出去。我给了你一星期时间，迄今为止什么回信都没收到。看样子我必须把这活儿交别人干了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

messages.en:
Turns out one of my production assistants was a spy for the enemy. He's gone into hiding, so I need you to draw him out.

You'll act as a decoy, mining until enemy forces turn up. Destroy them and bring the spy back to me. You may keep whatever ore you find out there.

Make sure you use a mining laser, so they'll notice you out there.
messages.zh:
没想到我的生产助理中还有敌方派来的间谍。他已经躲藏起来了，所以我要你把他引出来。

你要做诱饵，假装在那里采矿，直到敌人出现。干掉他们，然后把那个间谍押运回来。那里的矿石随你拿。

务必使用采矿激光器，这样他们才会注意到你在那儿。

messages.en: Ha! Good! He will pay dearly… Hey, I've got one last job for you.
messages.zh: 哈！不错！他会付出昂贵的代价……嗨，我还有最后一个任务给你。

messages.en:
There is one other thing our security forces need before they are fully prepared for the coming battle with these insufferable pirates.

Our forces are suffering a shortage of afterburners for their frigate contingents, and the resulting lack of speed is costing them dearly. I need two 1MN Afterburner I modules from you - buy them, build them, or loot them from the cooling wreckage of other ships. I won't ask questions.
messages.zh:
在我们的安全部队准备好与这些可恶的海盗战斗之前，他们还需要一样东西。

由于缺少足够的加力燃烧器，我们的护卫舰分遣队缺乏速度，损失惨重。我需要你提供两件1MN加力燃烧器 I装备给我。

-你可以通过查看1MN加力燃烧器 I的市场详情，根据物品的价格，物品售卖的位置等因素自行选择购买。
（卖家所在的位置，若不在当前空间站，需要自行前往取货)

-你也可以通过其他途径获得1MN加力燃烧器 I，如果你装配了它，你必须在物品机库中右键点击这个装备，进行拆卸装箱后再给我。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}! There was already mounting pressure on our financiers to delegate us more resources, but this will surely guarantee that we get what we need.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}！我们的财务人员最近采购压力很大，你这下就帮了我们一个大忙。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. The window of opportunity to fix our funding problems is passing us by.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。这样我只好把这个任务交给别人去打理。经费这问题不能再拖了。

messages.en: I needed you to acquire those afterburners quickly, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我已经要求你尽快的弄几台加力燃烧器来。我给了你一星期时间，迄今什么回信都没收到。看样子我必须把这活儿交别人干了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我已经要求你尽快的弄几台加力燃烧器来。我给了你一星期时间，迄今什么回信都没收到。看样子我必须把这活儿交别人干了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

messages.en:
There is one other thing our security forces need before they are fully prepared for the coming battle with these insufferable pirates.

Our forces are suffering a shortage of afterburners for their frigate contingents, and the resulting lack of speed is costing them dearly. I need two 1MN Afterburner I modules from you - buy them, build them, or loot them from the cooling wreckage of other ships. I won't ask questions.
messages.zh:
在我们的安全部队准备好与这些可恶的海盗战斗之前，他们还需要一样东西。

由于缺少足够的加力燃烧器，我们的护卫舰分遣队缺乏速度，损失惨重。我需要你提供两件1MN加力燃烧器 I装备给我。

-你可以通过查看1MN加力燃烧器 I的市场详情，根据物品的价格，物品售卖的位置等因素自行选择购买。
（卖家所在的位置，若不在当前空间站，需要自行前往取货)

-你也可以通过其他途径获得1MN加力燃烧器 I，如果你装配了它，你必须在物品机库中右键点击这个装备，进行拆卸装箱后再给我。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}! There was already mounting pressure on our financiers to delegate us more resources, but this will surely guarantee that we get what we need.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}！我们的财务人员最近采购压力很大，你这下就帮了我们一个大忙。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. The window of opportunity to fix our funding problems is passing us by.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。这样我只好把这个任务交给别人去打理。经费这问题不能再拖了。

messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我已经要求你尽快的弄几台加力燃烧器来。我给了你一星期时间，迄今什么回信都没收到。看样子我必须把这活儿交别人干了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

messages.en:
Your final test as a business mogul is also your opportunity to feed the war machine. You've provided us with utility modules; now it's the basic building blocks of violence: Weapons.

I'm giving you a blueprint copy with which you can fulfil my quota. Any remaining production runs are yours, as is this Industrial-class ship I'm going to reward you with.

Are you ready to pass your final test, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh:
你能否成为商业大亨的最终考验，也是你获得弹药、装填战争武器的好机会。你已经向我们提供了装备，现在该轮到武器了，它才是暴力之源。

我现在给你一张蓝图拷贝，你可以用它来制造我需要的数额，制造的剩余流程数归你了，和这艘工业舰船一起算是给你的奖励。

准备好进行这次终考了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en:
Well done, {[character]player.name}. Here is your Sigil, as promised; use it well. You've completed all my tasks and shown yourself to be a savvy entrepreneur. There is an entire cluster filled with opportunities for someone like you.

To find other agents you can just check the Agency, Distribution Agents might be of interest to you. Or if you want to broaden your skill set you can reach out to the other Career Agents here in this station.

Whichever future business endeavors you decide to pursue, good luck!
messages.zh:
做得好，{[character]player.name}。现在这艘魔符级归你了，好好利用它。你已经完成了我安排的所有任务，足以证明你是个有头脑的企业家。在你们这类人眼中，宇宙中充满了无限机遇。

如需寻找其他代理人，星际代理处中的物流代理人部分可能会符合你的要求。或者，如果你想拓展自己的技能，可与站内的其他职业代理人聊一聊。

无论你今后决定从事什么领域，都祝你好运！

messages.en: You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You should enroll in other training courses and learn as much as you can before making any long-term plans.
messages.zh: 你做的很好，{[character]player.name}。但在你为自己做出任何长远规划之前，我希望你能先去把其他的课程都学一下，多多益善。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about that final production test, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I won't be able to pass you for the course though, I'm afraid.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑那最后一项生产任务。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。恐怕我是没法给你评合格了。

messages.en: I wanted you to provide me with the weapon quickly, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I have to record your failure in our database. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.

name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (8 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (8 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills)  (8 из 10)

messages.en:
Let's try building something more complicated.

A friend of mine needs a fast vessel, so I want you to take this blueprint copy and construct a shuttle for him.

Oh, and don’t bother buying it from the market. This needs to be manufactured by you!
messages.zh:
让我们试试更加复杂的制造项目。

我的一个朋友需要一艘快船，所以我要你拿着这张蓝图拷贝为他制造一艘穿梭机。

- 首先，打开物品机库里的穿梭机蓝图，查看所需材料。

- 通过采矿或其他途径获得所需材料后，制造穿梭机。
(哦对了，别妄想着去市场买一艘交差了，你必须自己造一艘！）

- 制造完成后，即可回来完成任务。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. My friend was very pleased with me, I owe you one. Get back to me when you're ready for another assignment.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。我的朋友对此感到很满意，多亏了你。等你准备好了接受下一任务就来找我。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。这样我只好把这个任务交给别人去打理了。

messages.en: I'm tired of waiting.
messages.zh: 我没耐心再等下去了。

messages.en: Since you seem to have forgotten, I asked you to build that shuttle for me, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你也许忘记了，我之前让你尽快帮我造一架穿梭机。都给了你一星期时间，我迄今什么回信都没收到。看样子我非得找别人不可了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

messages.en: I'm tired of waiting.
messages.zh: 我没耐心再等下去了。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen  (5 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (5 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (5 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (5 из 10)

messages.en:
You've mined, processed, built and fought. Now let's see if you can transport my goods safely.

Take these electronic parts out to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} as fast as possible.
messages.zh:
你已经训练过采矿、提炼、制造和战斗了，现在我们来看看你安全运送货物的能力如何。

把这些电子元件尽快送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去。

- 首先，将装箱的电子元件放入舰船货仓。

- 跟着任务指引飞到目标地点。
（如果目标地点不在本星系，您需要“设置终点”后，在总览中右击黄色星门“跳跃”前往）

- 与收货人交谈后，即可完成任务。

messages.en: Good work. Just give me a moment, would you?
messages.zh: 干得好。给我一些时间，好吗？

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (10 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (10 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (10 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (10 из 10)

messages.en:
You've done a great job so far, mastering the intricacies of industry - mining, reprocessing, manufacturing, and hauling. All while murdering everyone who stands in your way. You're now ready for your final assignment.

You're going to bring me a full-fledged frigate. I'll give you a blueprint copy with more than enough runs for this task. If you choose to use it, finding the resources is up to you. But time is money, and however you choose to acquire the ship is fine by me.

Good luck!
messages.zh:
到目前为止你做得很好！你掌握了工业生产中采矿、提炼、制造和运输的繁琐流程，也干掉了所有碍事的家伙。你现在可以完成最终任务了。

你要造一艘完备的护卫舰，我会给你一份蓝图拷贝，能让你轻松完成本次任务。如果你要用它，就要自己寻找资源。时间就是金钱，我不会干预你造舰的方式。

祝你好运！

messages.en:
Congratulations, {[character]player.name}! With the successful production of that Tormentor you've proven that you have what it takes. I hate to see you go, but you have mastered all the challenges I have for you.

There are plenty of mining agents out there who would be happy to employ someone like you who can get the job done. You can find them in the Agency Mining Agents. Or, if you are interested in broadening your skills into other areas you can start a conversation with any of the other career agents here in station.

Best of luck in the future, my friend. Stick with the Republic and you'll do well.
messages.zh:
祝贺你，{[character]player.name}！你成功制造出了一个巨神兵级，实力不俗。我不愿你离去，但你已经完成了我为你准备的所有挑战。

有很多采矿代理人愿意雇佣像你这样能胜任工作的人。你可以在星际代理处的采矿代理人中找到他们。或者，如果你想将自己的技能拓展到其他领域，你可以与空间站中的其他职业代理人交谈。

祝你未来一切都好，我的朋友。与共和国并肩作战，你一定会干得很出色。

messages.en: You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You should enroll in other training courses and learn as much as you can before making any long-term plans.
messages.zh: 你做的很好，{[character]player.name}。但在你为自己做出任何长远规划之前，我希望你能先去把其他的课程都学一下，多多益善。

messages.en: Since you seem to have forgotten, I asked you to bring me a frigate, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你可能是忘记了，我曾让你带一艘护卫舰给我的。我给了你一星期时间，到现在什么结果都没收到。看样子我非得找别人不可了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

messages.en:
The next stage in the industrial process is building something. I want you to give me a Civilian Afterburner.

I don't care how you do it; you can build one using the blueprint I gave you or just buy it off someone else. But however you get your hands on one, please make sure it is packaged before you give it to me.
messages.zh:
工业流程的下一步是制造。我要你给我一个民用加力燃烧器。

我不管你怎么弄到它，用我给你的蓝图自己造也行，从别人手里买也行。无论用什么方法，你要记得先把它拆卸装箱后再给我。

messages.en: Excellent – they look good. Nice work.
messages.zh: 真棒——它们看起来很好。干得不错。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (1 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (1 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (1 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (1 из 10)

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, war never stops, and we need to stoke it with raw materials. I want you to go mine some Veldspar ore for me.

Remember to fit a mining module to your ship before you go, and keep in mind that you might have to make more than one trip before you report back to me.

To make it clear, I want you to mine at least some ore from the location I've uploaded for you.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，战争永不会停歇，而原材料更是能给它推波助澜。我要你去采些凡晶石来。

记得在出发前把采矿器装到船上，你可能得多跑一两趟才能完成任务回来向我报告。

重申一下，你要在我给的地点采些矿石回来。

messages.en: Well done, my friend. I may have another task for you.
messages.zh: 干得好，我的朋友。我也许还有新任务给你。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (4 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (4 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (4 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (4 из 10)

messages.en:
Any industrial mogul worth their salt knows how to fight for their bounty.

I'm sending you to mine in an area infested with Rogue Drones. Let's see if you can survive the trip and bring me the processed goods.
messages.zh:
任何一个名副其实的工业大亨都明白如何为赏金而战。

我要你前往自由无人机出没的地区与之一战，让我们看看你是否能够为我带回加工物品凯旋归来。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (3 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (3 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (3 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills)  (3 из 10)

messages.en:
The next stage in the industrial process is building something. I want you to give me a Civilian Afterburner.

I don't care how you do it; you can build one using the blueprint I gave you or just buy it off someone else. But however you get your hands on one, please make sure it is packaged before you give it to me.
messages.zh:
工业流程的下一步是制造。我要你给我一个民用加力燃烧器。

我不管你怎么弄到它，用我给你的蓝图自己造也行，从别人手里买也行。无论用什么方法，你要记得先把它拆卸装箱后再给我。

messages.en: Excellent – looks good. Nice work.
messages.zh: 很好——听起来不错。干得好。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen  (5 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (5 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (5 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (5 из 10)

messages.en:
You've mined, processed, built and fought. Now let's see if you can transport my goods safely.

Take these electronic parts out to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} as fast as possible.
messages.zh:
你已经训练过采矿、提炼、制造和战斗了，现在我们来看看你安全运送货物的能力如何。

把这些电子元件尽快送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去。

- 首先，将装箱的电子元件放入舰船货仓。

- 跟着任务指引飞到目标地点。
（如果目标地点不在本星系，您需要“设置终点”后，在总览中右击黄色星门“跳跃”前往）

- 与收货人交谈后，即可完成任务。

messages.en: Good work. Just give me a moment, would you?
messages.zh: 干得好。请稍等下好吗？

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (8 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (8 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (8 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills)  (8 из 10)

messages.en:
Let's try building something more complicated.

A friend of mine needs a fast vessel, so I want you to take this blueprint copy and construct a shuttle for him.

Oh, and don’t bother buying it from the market. This needs to be manufactured by you!
messages.zh:
让我们试试更加复杂的制造项目。

我的一个朋友需要一艘快船，所以我要你拿着这张蓝图拷贝为他制造一艘穿梭机。

- 首先，打开物品机库里的穿梭机蓝图，查看所需材料。

- 通过采矿或其他途径获得所需材料后，制造穿梭机。
(哦对了，别妄想着去市场买一艘交差了，你必须自己造一艘！）

- 制造完成后，即可回来完成任务。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. You're learning quickly. Get back to me when you're ready for another assignment.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。你进步很快。准备好接受下一任务后就再来找我。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。这样我只好把这个任务交给别人去打理了。

messages.en: I'm tired of waiting.
messages.zh: 我没耐心再等下去了。

messages.en: Since you seem to have forgotten, I asked you to build that shuttle for me, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你也许忘记了，我之前让你尽快帮我造一架穿梭机。都给了你一星期时间，我迄今什么回信都没收到。看样子我非得找别人不可了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

messages.en: I'm tired of waiting.
messages.zh: 我没耐心再等下去了。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (9 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (9 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (9 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (9 из 10)

messages.en:
Turns out one of my production assistants was a spy for the enemy. He's gone into hiding, so I need you to draw him out.

You'll act as a decoy, mining until enemy forces turn up. Destroy them and bring the spy back to me. You may keep whatever ore you find out there.

Make sure you use a mining laser, so they'll notice you out there.
messages.zh:
没想到我的生产助理中还有敌方派来的间谍。他已经躲藏起来了，所以我要你把他引出来。

你要做诱饵，假装在那里采矿，直到敌人出现。干掉他们，然后把那个间谍押运回来。那里的矿石随你拿。

务必使用采矿激光器，这样他们才会注意到你在那儿。

messages.en: Ha! Good job! Listen, I've got one last job for you.
messages.zh: 哈！做得好！听着，我还有最后一个工作要给你。

name.de: Aus einer Mücke einen Elefanten machen (10 von 10)
name.es: Una montaña de un grano de arena (10 de 10)
name.fr: Faire d'une mouche un éléphant (10 sur 10)
name.ru: Делаем из мухи слона (Making Mountains of Molehills) (10 из 10)

messages.en:
You've done a great job so far, mastering the intricacies of industry - mining, reprocessing, manufacturing, and hauling. All while murdering everyone who stands in your way. You're now ready for your final assignment.

You're going to bring me a full-fledged frigate. I'll give you a blueprint copy with more than enough runs for this task. If you choose to use it, finding the resources is up to you. But time is money, and however you choose to acquire the ship is fine by me.

Good luck!
messages.zh:
到目前为止你做得很好！你掌握了工业生产中采矿、提炼、制造和运输的繁琐流程，也干掉了所有碍事的家伙。你现在可以完成最终任务了。

你要造一艘完备的护卫舰，我会给你一份蓝图拷贝，能让你轻松完成本次任务。如果你要用它，就要自己寻找资源。时间就是金钱，我不会干预你造舰的方式。

祝你好运！

messages.en:
Congratulations, {[character]player.name}! With the successful production of that Bantam you've proven that you have what it takes. I hate to see you go, but you have mastered all the challenges I have for you.

There are plenty of mining agents out there who would be happy to employ someone like you who can get the job done. You can find them in the Agency Mining Agents. Or, if you are interested in broadening your skills into other areas you can start a conversation with any of the other career agents here in station.

Best of luck in the future, my friend. Stick with the Republic and you'll do well.
messages.zh:
祝贺你，{[character]player.name}！你成功制造出了一个矮脚鸡级，实力不俗。我不愿你离去，但你已经完成了我为你准备的所有挑战。

有很多采矿代理人愿意雇佣像你这样能胜任工作的人。你可以在星际代理处的采矿代理人中找到他们。或者，如果你想将自己的技能拓展到其他领域，你可以与空间站中的其他职业代理人交谈。

祝你未来一切都好，我的朋友。与共和国并肩作战，你一定会干得很出色。

messages.en: You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You should enroll in other training courses and learn as much as you can before making any long-term plans.
messages.zh: 你做的很好，{[character]player.name}。但在你为自己做出任何长远规划之前，我希望你能先去把其他的课程都学一下，多多益善。

messages.en: Since you seem to have forgotten, I asked you to bring me a frigate, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你可能是忘记了，我曾让你带一艘护卫舰给我的。我给了你一星期时间，到现在什么结果都没收到。看样子我非得找别人不可了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

name.en: A Feast Fit for a King
name.ru: Пир горой (A Feast Fit for a King)

messages.en: I can help you out, sure. I can't do it for free, though.
messages.zh: 当然，我可以帮你。但不能白干。

messages.en: Do I look like a putz? Of course I'll pay you. Just get the stuff over there as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 我看上去像白痴吗？放心，我会付钱的。把东西尽快送到那里就行。

messages.en: I do, yeah, and I am… depending on what you need.
messages.zh: 是的，我有船也有兴趣挣钱……关键是你要什么。

messages.en: Deliver 5 cases of long-limb roes to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}  station.
messages.zh: 将5箱长肢龙鹿卵运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站。

messages.en: Alright, delivery completed. You mentioned payment?
messages.zh: 好了，东西送到了。你答应的钱呢？

messages.en: Fantastic. Your ISK has been deposited to your account. And don't worry, my friend, I won't forget you when I rise to higher places.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。你的钱已经入你账户了。别担心，朋友，我将来升了不会忘了你。

messages.en:
Well, lemme tell you: A warlord who's been visiting my people in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} station for a while now has a thing for long-limb roes, and I need to get some over there for him. This man is very important and very dangerous, {[character]player.name}, and I want him on my good side, so let's make every effort to get his needs fulfilled.

Can you help me out?
messages.zh:
好，是这样：一名已经在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站做民事访问的军阀对长肢龙鹿卵有特殊癖好，我需要你送点这样的东西过去给他。{[character]player.name}，他是位重要人物，同时也很不好惹，我希望他能站在我这一边，因此你要尽全力满足他的需求。

能帮我这个忙吗？

name.en: A Feast Fit for a King
name.ru: Пир горой (A Feast Fit for a King)

messages.en: I can help you out, sure. I can't do it for free, though.
messages.zh: 当然，我可以帮你。但不能白干。

messages.en: Do I look like a putz? Of course I'll pay you. Just get the stuff over there as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 我看上去像白痴吗？放心，我会付钱的。把东西尽快送到那里就行。

messages.en: I do, yeah, and I am… depending on what you need.
messages.zh: 是的，我有船也有兴趣挣钱……关键是你要什么。

messages.en: Deliver 1 crate of long-limb roes to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}  station.
messages.zh: 把一箱长肢龙鹿卵送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}空间站。

messages.en: Alright, delivery completed. You mentioned payment?
messages.zh: 好了，东西送到了。你答应的钱呢？

messages.en: Fantastic. Your ISK has been deposited to your account. And don't worry, my friend, I won't forget you when I rise to higher places.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。你的钱已经入你账户了。别担心，朋友，我将来升了不会忘了你。

messages.en: I will see every one of those slaver swine die a fiery death.
messages.zh: 我会看着那些劳工贩子一个个葬身火海。

messages.en: I see we're of the same mind. Excellent. Be careful out there.
messages.zh: 看来我们想法一致。太好了。注意小心。

messages.en: Well, well ... seems like I've arrived right on time.
messages.zh: 啧，啧，看来我来得正是时候。

messages.en:
To complete this mission, you will require a ship with a hacking module online, as well as an available cargo capacity of at least 2,000 m3 volume (and preferably 6,000 m3).

I recently learned that a manufacturer for the Imperial Navy has taken over a complex in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, where they build components for their slave transports. I want you to defeat whatever guards or defenses they've put in place and bring back the freight containers they've got stored there. This isn't as simple as it sounds, of course.

I understand that the Amarr, fearing an action just such as the one I'm proposing, have booby-trapping these cargo containers: You'll need to hack the floating containers to get the secure containers inside, and the outer containers will no doubt detonate if you fail to hack them properly. There may be other decoy containers in the compound, too ― you'll need to find the ones with the secure containers inside.
messages.zh:
要完成这个任务，你需要一艘装配了破译装备的飞船，以及可用容量至少为2000m3的货舱（最好是6000m3）。

我最近获悉，一个为帝国海军服务的制造商接管了一个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的复合体，他们在那里制造劳工运输船的部件。我要你击垮他们设在那的任何守卫或防御，并带回他们储藏在那的货物集装箱。当然这任务不像听起来那么简单。

我听说，为了防范类似的行动，艾玛已经在这些货物集装箱上做了手脚。你需要破译漂浮的集装箱以获得其内部的安全集装箱，而如果你破译失败，外部的集装箱将会爆炸。可能还有其他假冒集装箱混迹其中，你需要找到含有安全集装箱的那些箱子。

messages.en: The Amarr manufacturer's complex is destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}. Victory is ours.
messages.zh: 艾玛制造商的复合体已被摧毁，{[character]agentID.name}。胜利属于我们。

messages.en: Excellent news, {[character]player.name}. Thank goodness you arrived when you did.
messages.zh: 真是好消息，{[character]player.name}。谢天谢地你来了。

messages.en: Sounds awfully dangerous. Hm. No, this sounds like a job for the navy, backed by their demolitions experts.
messages.zh: 听上去太危险了。嗯。不，这听上去应该是海军和他们的爆炸物专家后援的活。

messages.en: Do you think I'd have asked you if I had the whole navy fleet at my beck and call...!!
messages.zh: 如果整个海军舰队都对我惟命是从，我用得着请你吗……！！

messages.en:
Yes, my friend, you have. I have a proposal that could make us both a great deal of ISK, as well as inconvenience the Imperial Navy. How does that sound?

I recently learned that a manufacturer for the Imperial Navy has taken over a complex in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} ― yes, the sheer audacity, I know! ― where they build components for Bestowers, which as you know are their favored slave transports. By going in there and destroying the outpost, we can set their production well back and reduce the efficacy of their entire imperial slave transport apparatus; further, by taking their finished ship's components and modifying them for our own use, we can gain valuable help in advancing our own interests.

I want you to go into that complex, defeat whatever guards or defenses they've put in place, and bring back the freight containers they've got stored there. This isn't as simple as it sounds, of course, and that's why I need someone with your skills and resources: The whole deadspace complex will be heavily guarded, without a doubt … and it gets more complicated than that.

I understand that the Amarr, fearing an action just such as the one I'm proposing, have booby-trapping these cargo containers: You'll need to hack the floating containers to get the secure containers inside, and the outer containers will no doubt detonate if you fail to hack them properly. There may be other decoy containers in the compound, too ― you'll need to find the ones with the secure containers inside.

To complete this mission, you will require a ship with a hacking module online, as well as a cargo capacity of at least 2,000 m3 volume (and preferably one with a capacity of 6,000 m3).
messages.zh:
是的，我的朋友，来得正是时候。我有一个计划，能让我们俩赚上一大笔星币，还能给帝国海军添乱。这听上去怎么样？

我最近获悉，一个为帝国海军服务的制造商接管了一个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的复合体——没错，真是厚颜无耻！——他们在那里制造恩赐者级的部件，正如你所知，那是他们最钟爱的劳工运输船。如果我们进入那里并摧毁哨站，就能阻碍他们生产的步伐，并降低他们整个帝国劳工运输机器的效率；另外，如果我们把他们生产好的飞船部件带回来并根据自己的用途加以改造，这等于是帮了我们自己一个大忙。

我要你进入那个复合体，击垮他们设在那的任何守卫或防御，并带回他们储藏在那的货物集装箱。当然这任务不像听起来那么简单，这也是为什么我需要你这样有勇有谋的人。毫无疑问，整个死亡空间复合体有重兵把守……但情况比这更复杂。

我听说，为了防范类似的行动，艾玛已经在这些货物集装箱上做了手脚。你需要破译漂浮的集装箱以获得其内部的安全集装箱，而如果你破译失败，外部的集装箱将会爆炸。可能还有其他假冒集装箱混迹其中，你需要找到含有安全集装箱的那些箱子。

要完成这个任务，你需要一艘装配了破译装备的飞船，以及可用容量至少为2000m3的货舱（最好是6000m3）。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Whatever your reasons, you did not clear out the Bestower manufacturing outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The Amarrians have moved elsewhere now, it seems, and taken our resources with them.

Well done, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

无论出于什么原因，你并未把位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的“恩赐者级”制造哨站清除干净。艾玛人似乎已经转移到别的地方了，还带走了我们的资源。

干得不错，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Manufacturing outpost moved
messages.zh: 制造哨站已转移

messages.en: Sorry, I can't finish this job for you.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我不能为你完成这个任务。

messages.en: Good thinking. I mean, the whole Amarr slavery problem will surely take care of itself, right!?
messages.zh: 想的好。我的意思是，艾玛的整个劳工制问题自然会找到自己的解决办法，对吧！？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Whatever your reasons, you did not clear out the Bestower manufacturing outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The Amarrians have moved elsewhere now, it seems, and taken our resources with them.

Well done, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

无论出于什么原因，你并未把位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的“恩赐者级”制造哨站清除干净。艾玛人似乎已经转移到别的地方了，还带走了我们的资源。

干得不错，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Manufacturing outpost moved
messages.zh: 制造哨站已转移

messages.en: Those capitalist pigs! Selling weapons illegally to the Guristas? They must be stopped!
messages.zh: 那些蠢猪资本家！向古斯塔斯非法销售武器？必须阻止它们！

messages.en: I see we're of the same mind. I'm glad of that. Hey, be careful out there.
messages.zh: 看来我们想法一致。这真令我高兴。嘿，到那注意安全。

messages.en: Fortunate...? What do you mean, exactly?
messages.zh: 幸运……？你到底指的是什么？

messages.en:
To complete this mission, you will require a ship with a hacking module online, as well as an available cargo capacity of at least 2,000 m3 volume (and preferably 6,000 m3).

I recently learned that Caldari Steel, one of the biggest producers of munitions and hybrid weaponry out there, has taken over a complex in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. From there, they've been supplying certain radical Caldari military pseudo-corporations, and maybe even the Guristas themselves.

I want you to go defeat whatever guards or defenses they've put in place and bring back the freight containers they've got stored there. This isn't as simple as it sounds, of course, and that's why I need someone with your skills and resources: For sure the whole deadspace complex will be heavily guarded, but it's more complicated than that.

These Caldari are known for booby-trapping their cargo containers: You'll need to hack the floating containers to get the secure containers inside, and the outer containers will no doubt detonate if you fail to hack them properly. There may be other decoy containers in the compound, too ― you'll need to find the ones with the secure containers inside.
messages.zh:
要完成这个任务，你需要一艘装配了破译装备的飞船，以及可用容量至少为2000m3的货舱（最好是6000m3）。

我最近了解到，全球最大的弹药和混合武器生产商之一卡尔达里钢铁公司已经接管了一处位于……的工厂。{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。从那里，他们一直在向某些激进的卡尔达里军事伪公司，甚至可能是古斯塔斯本人提供物资。

我要你击垮他们设在那的任何守卫或防御，并带回他们储藏在那的货物集装箱。当然，这并不像听起来那么简单，所以我需要像你这样拥有技能和资源的人：可以肯定的是，整个死亡空间综合体都会受到严密的守卫，但实际情况比这复杂得多。

这些卡尔达里人以在货运集装箱中设置陷阱而闻名：我听说，为了防范类似的行动，艾玛已经在这些货物集装箱上做了手脚。你需要破译漂浮的集装箱以获得其内部的安全集装箱，而如果你破译失败，外部的集装箱将会爆炸。可能还有其他假冒集装箱混迹其中，你需要找到含有安全集装箱的那些箱子。

messages.en: The Caldari Steel storage complex is destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}. And not a moment too soon.
messages.zh: 加达里钢铁集团的存储复合体被摧毁了，{[character]agentID.name}。真是千钧一发。

messages.en: Excellent news, my friend. One more blow struck for democracy!
messages.zh: 真是好消息，我的朋友。这是为民主而战的又一次重拳出击！

messages.en: Sounds pretty damned risky. No, I don't think you can pay me enough for this one.
messages.zh: 听上去危险极了。不了，你付我多少我也不干。

messages.en: Where there's a will, there's a way. Surely someone who shares my views will come along. Good day.
messages.zh: 有志者事竟成。我总有一天会遇到与我志同道合的人。祝你愉快。

messages.en:
I have a proposal that could make us both a great deal of ISK, as well as throw a wrench into the gears of the Caldari military-economic infrastructure. How does that sound? Very good, I'd say.

I recently learned that Caldari Steel, one of the biggest producers of munitions and hybrid weaponry out there, has taken over a complex in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Like most Caldari corporations, they mistreat their workers and destroy moons and planets at an astonishing rate in order to maximize their profit ― and, in this case, contribute directly to the steady increase of Caldari military power. Obviously, it is the duty of people like us to stop them however we can, as I'm sure you'll agree. But in this case we have even more impetus to act: I have it on good authority that this outpost of theirs has been supplying certain radical Caldari military pseudo-corporations, and maybe even the Guristas themselves.

{[character]player.name}, I want you to go into that complex, defeat whatever guards or defenses they've put in place, and bring back the freight containers they've got stored there. This isn't as simple as it sounds, of course, and that's why I need someone with your skills and resources: For sure the whole deadspace complex will be heavily guarded, but it's more complicated than that.

I guess the guards these Caldari Steel people have hired are known for booby-trapping their cargo containers: You'll need to hack the floating containers to get the secure containers inside, and the outer containers will no doubt detonate if you fail to hack them properly. There may be other decoy containers in the compound, too ― you'll need to find the ones with the secure containers inside.

To complete this mission, you will require a ship with a hacking module online, as well as a cargo capacity of at least 2,000 m3 volume (and preferably one with a capacity of 6,000 m3).
messages.zh:
我有一个计划，能让我们俩赚上一大笔星币，还能破坏加达里的军事经济基础。这听上去怎么样？要我说，这实在太棒了。

我最近获悉，加达里钢铁集团，也就是当今最大的军需品和混合武器制造商之一，夺取了一个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的复合体。与大部分加达里集团一样，他们虐带自己的工人，为了实现利益最大化，他们以骇人的速度摧毁着卫星和行星——而且在眼下这个事件里，他们直接为加达里军事力量的扩张贡献力量。很明显，采取任何方式阻止他们是我们这类人的职责，我相信你会同意我的看法。但对于这个事件，我们更应采取行动：据可靠消息称，他们的那个哨站一直为某些激进的加达里伪军事集团提供装备，这些军团可能根本就是古斯塔斯。

{[character]player.name}，我要你进入那个复合体，击垮他们设在那的任何守卫或防御，并带回他们储藏在那的货物集装箱。当然这任务不像听起来那么简单，这也是为什么我需要你这样有勇有谋的人。毫无疑问，整个死亡空间复合体有重兵把守，但情况比这更复杂。

这些加达里人雇的守卫是出了名地爱在货物集装箱上做手脚：你需要破解漂浮的集装箱以获得其内部的安全集装箱，当然，如果你破解失败，外部的集装箱将无疑会爆炸。可能还有其他假冒集装箱混迹其中，你需要找到内含安全集装箱的目标。

要完成这个任务，你需要一艘装配并启用了破译装备的飞船，以及可用容量至少为2,000 m3的货舱(最好是6,000 m3)。"

{[character]player.name}，

你动作太慢了，我不得不找别人解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的盖伦特异教徒。我现在发财了，你呢？管他的，谁在乎？我现在有的是钱。

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Cultists destroyed
messages.zh: 异教徒被消灭

messages.en: I've changed my mind. Sorry, I can't do this job.
messages.zh: 我改主意了。抱歉，我不能做这份工作。

messages.en: I see. Take the job, then quit. You don't feel the same way about these blackhearted fiends as I do, I guess.
messages.zh: 我明白了。接下这个活，却又不干了。看来对于那些黑心的魔鬼，我们的看法不一致。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

I guess you couldn‘t be bothered to clean out those cultists in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} after all. They‘ve disappeared, and all that beautiful loot with them.

Nice work.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

我想你还是没有尽全力把那些在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的异教徒彻底解决干净。他们带着那些漂亮的战利品消失了。

干得不错。

messages.en: Cultists escaped
messages.zh: 异教徒逃脱

name.es: Quien lo encuentra se lo queda

messages.en: Hey, ISK equals double un-bad. Count me in.
messages.zh: 嗨，星币等于好事成双。我参加。

messages.en: That's what I like to hear, {[character]player.name}. That's what I like to hear.
messages.zh: 那正是我想听到的，{[character]player.name}。那正是我想听到的。
