messages.zh: 幸运……？你到底指的是什么？

messages.en:
To complete this mission, you will require a ship with a hacking module online, as well as an available cargo capacity of at least 2,000 m3 volume (and preferably 6,000 m3).

One of these bizarre Intaki cults that have been cropping up so much among the Gallente lately has inhabited a complex in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. These “cultists” are really just a bunch of freebooters who've been storing all of their loot in this outpost, presumably until they can haul the stuff away to sell.

Head on out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and recover the freight containers, and I'll give you a hefty reward. This isn't as simple as it sounds, of course: You'll need to hack the floating containers to get the secure containers inside, and the outer containers will no doubt detonate if you fail to hack them properly. There may be other decoy containers in the compound, too ― you'll need to find the ones with the secure containers inside.
messages.zh:
要完成这个任务，你需要一艘装配并启用了破译装备的飞船，以及可用容量至少为2,000 m3的货舱(最好是6,000 m3)。

一些怪异的印塔基团体最近在盖伦特大批出现，其中一支占据了位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个复合体。这些所谓的异教徒实际上只是一群自由海盗，他们把所有抢来的物资储存在该哨站，估计在他们能把东西运走并出售之前将一直驻扎在那里。

我要你前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，取回货物集装箱，我会重重奖赏你。当然这任务不像听起来那么简单：你需要破解漂浮的集装箱以获得其内部的安全集装箱，当然，如果你破解失败，外部的集装箱将无疑会爆炸。可能还有其他假冒集装箱混迹其中，你需要找到内含安全集装箱的目标。

messages.en: The Intaki “cult” is no more, and I have what you asked for.
messages.zh: 印塔基“异教团”已经不存在了，而且我带来了你要的东西。

messages.en: Haha! Excellent. Ha. And I have what I offered in return. Don't spend it all at once.
messages.zh: 哈哈！好极了。哈，我的付出终于得到回报了。别一次都花完了。

messages.en: Sounds pretty risky. Nah, I don't think you can pay me enough from the looks of you.
messages.zh: 听上去很危险。不了，看你那样就知道付不起我的报酬。

messages.en: Hey, suit yourself. I'm sure I can find someone else with a little more enterprise ― and maybe a little more courage.
messages.zh: 好吧，请自便。我肯定会找到更有上进心的人，也许有更多一点勇气。

messages.en:
Like the Caldari, the Intaki were once subjugated by the Gallenteans; some remain part of the Federation, but others long ago departed en masse to form the Intaki Syndicate, an independent state on the borders of the Gallente Federation. This “Syndicate” is not overtly political in any real sense ― each member station enjoys complete autonomy ― but the Intaki share economic information and generally help each other, for instance banding together when necessary in their common defense.

In reality, the Syndicate is a haven for various undesirable elements of society, yet without being too rough and tough. It has long fostered the role of mediator between merchants from the empires and the outer regions, which makes trading with Syndicate space quite brisk, and the Intaki are generally known as a highly individualistic, spiritual people.
messages.zh:
与加达里一样，印塔基曾被盖伦特人征服；一些印塔基人仍留在联邦之中，但其余大部分很久以前集体脱离了联邦，组成了印塔基联合财团——一个与盖伦特联邦接壤的独立国度。这种“联合财团”不具备任何明显的政治意义，每个成员空间站都享有完全的自治权，但印塔基人之间会共享经济信息而且通常互相帮助，比如在进行必要的共同防御时团结起来。

事实上，这种联合财团成了许多社会不良分子的避风港，虽然他们还没那么强悍和粗野。它很长时间一直扮演着帝国商人和外空地带商人之间的调停者角色，因此在联合财团的空间做贸易相当刺激，而且印塔基人通常被视作非常个人主义、注重精神性的一群人。

messages.en: The Intaki
messages.zh: 印塔基人

messages.en:
I have a proposal that could make us both a great deal of ISK. How does that sound? Now, what I am about to say should remain between you and me, {[character]player.name}. I trust you can agree to that? Good.

According to some intelligence I've just received, one of these bizarre Intaki cults that have been cropping up so much among the Gallente lately has just inhabited a complex in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. These cultists are more than they appear, though: They're really just a bunch of freebooters, apparently, who've been using their cult as a cover while raiding and looting all sorts of low-sec settlements. They're storing all of this loot in their outpost, presumably until they can fill a freighter and haul the stuff away to sell.

Well, I think you must know where I'm headed with this… I want you to head on out to that system and recover the freight containers for me; do that and I'll give you a hefty reward. This isn't as simple as it sounds, of course, and that's why I need someone with your skills and resources: For sure the whole deadspace complex will be heavily guarded, but it's more complicated than that.

I guess these “cultists” are known for booby-trapping things like asteroids and cargo containers, then picking up the scraps after some unsuspecting sap blows one up: You'll need to hack the floating containers to get the secure containers inside, and the outer containers will no doubt detonate if you fail to hack them properly. There may be other decoy containers in the compound, too ― you'll need to find the ones with the secure containers inside.

To complete this mission, you will require a ship with a hacking module online, as well as a cargo capacity of at least 2,000 m3 volume (and preferably one with a capacity of 6,000 m3).
messages.zh:
我有一个计划，能让我们俩赚上一大笔星币。这听上去怎么样？听着，我接下来要说的只能让你我知道，{[character]player.name}。我相信你不会反对吧？好的。

根据我最近获悉的情报，一些怪异的印塔基团体最近在盖伦特大批出现，其中一支占据了位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个复合体。然而，这些异教徒不是表面看上去这么简单：很显然，他们实际上只是一群自由海盗，一直以宗教的幌子作掩护，背地里在各个低安全等级地带进行打劫。他们现在把所有的物品储存在空间站，可能要一直等到装满一艘货船才把东西运走出售。

我想你肯定猜到我打算怎么干了吧。我要你前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，取回货物集装箱，然后我会重重奖赏你。当然这任务不像听起来那么简单，这也是为什么我需要你这样有勇有谋的人。毫无疑问，整个死亡空间复合体有重兵把守，但情况比这更复杂。

这些“异教徒”是出了名地爱在小行星、货物集装箱等东西上做手脚，就等着粗心大意的傻瓜引爆机关，然后他们好收拾残骸。你需要破解漂浮的集装箱以获得其内部的安全集装箱，当然，如果你破解失败，外部的集装箱将无疑会爆炸。可能还有其他假冒集装箱混迹其中，你需要找到内含安全集装箱的目标。

要完成这个任务，你需要一艘装配并启用了破译装备的飞船，以及可用容量至少为2,000 m3的货舱(最好是6,000 m3)。

{[character]player.name}，

你动作太慢了，我不得不找别人解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的盖伦特异教徒。我现在发财了，你呢？一无所有。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Cultists destroyed
messages.zh: 异教徒被消灭

messages.en: I've changed my mind ― sorry, but I'm not much interested in finishing this job.
messages.zh: 我改主意了。抱歉，但我对完成这个任务兴趣不大。

messages.en: I see. Take a job, then quit. Your work ethic needs some polishing, I fear.
messages.zh: 我明白了。接下这个活，却又不干了。你的职业道德恐怕有待提高。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

I guess you couldn‘t be bothered to clean out those cultists in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} after all. They‘ve disappeared, and all that beautiful loot with them.

Nice work.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

我想你还是没有尽全力把那些在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的异教徒彻底解决干净。他们带着那些漂亮的战利品消失了。

干得不错。

messages.en: Cultists escaped
messages.zh: 异教徒逃脱

messages.en: I've about had enough of these bloody-minded Minmatar. Forget enslaving them ― I say we just eradicate the whole lot. I'm in.
messages.zh: 我受够这些残忍的米玛塔尔人了。别想着把他们变成劳工了——我说干脆把他们连根除掉。我会参加这个任务。

messages.en: Well, I think these raiders certainly deserve your wrath, at least. Be careful out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 这些侵袭者起码也要让你火冒三丈。到那以后要小心，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A fine greeting! How can I be of service, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: 你好！我能为你效劳吗，{[character]agentID.name}？

messages.en:
To complete this mission, you will require a ship with a hacking module online, as well as an available cargo capacity of at least 2,000 m3 volume (and preferably 6,000 m3).

The Minmatar have been stockpiling raw materials and manufacturing equipment that they've acquired in surface raids on Kameira-guarded bases out in the border constellations. I'm told these raiders have a supply outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; I want you to head out there and recover the freight containers. This isn't a simple job, though, and that's why I need someone with your skills and resources to do it.

First off, I'm sure the compound, built in a deadspace complex, will be heavily guarded. Also, the Minmatar are known for booby-trapping their structures and containers; you'll need to hack the floating containers to get the secure containers inside, and the outer containers will no doubt detonate if you fail to hack them properly. There may be other decoy containers in the compound, too ― you'll need to find the ones with the secure containers inside.
messages.zh:
要完成这个任务，你需要一艘装配并启用了破译装备的飞船，以及可用容量至少为2,000 m3的货舱(最好是6,000 m3)。

米玛塔尔人一直在对相邻星座区域的由卡莫兵守卫的基地进行侵袭，从而囤积了大量抢来的原材料和制造设备。有消息称，这些侵袭者在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一个供给哨站。我要你前往那里，取回货物集装箱。不过这任务不像听起来那么简单，这也是为什么我需要你这样有勇有谋的人。

首先，我确定这个设施建于一个死亡空间复合体中，而且守卫严密。还有，米玛塔尔人是出了名地爱在他们的建筑和集装箱上做手脚；你需要破解漂浮的集装箱以获得其内部的安全集装箱，当然，如果你破解失败，外部的集装箱无疑会爆炸。可能还有其他假冒集装箱混迹其中，你需要找到内含安全集装箱的目标。

messages.en: The complex is cleared of resistance, and I have your cargo here.
messages.zh: 复合体的反抗力量已被清除，你要的货柜箱我带来了。

messages.en: Fantastic! And here is your reward for a difficult job well done.
messages.zh: 太棒了！这是对你出色完成如此艰巨任务的奖励。

messages.en: Sounds a little too much like common labor for my liking. Freight hauling? Nope, not my thing.
messages.zh: 这任务听上去平常得紧。运送货物？算了吧，不合我胃口。

messages.en: Not all of a capsuleer's work need involve violence, {[character]player.name}. You ought to broaden your horizons, perhaps.
messages.zh: 飞行员的工作不一定都要涉及暴力，{[character]player.name}。你可能需要开阔你的视野。

messages.en: Kameiras are elite foot soldiers originally drawn from among the Minmatar slaves by the Amarr Empire. Raised from birth to become hardened, highly disciplined and emotionless soldiers, they are savage and ruthless in personal combat. They serve the Empire, the Khanid Kingdom, and the Ammatar lordlings well, although always on a tight leash, often used as personal bodyguards for Holders and other people in positions of power.
messages.zh: 卡莫兵是步兵精英，最初由艾玛帝国从米玛塔尔劳工中挑选出来。他们从出生起就被培养为坚毅、无情、训练有素的士兵，在与敌人的近身战中，他们表现得残忍而冷酷。虽然受到严格管束，但他们衷心侍奉帝国、卡尼第王国和艾玛达的权贵，经常被劳工主和其他位高权重者当作贴身保镖。

messages.en: Kameiras
messages.zh: 卡莫兵

messages.en:
I won't waste time, for there is none to waste: {[character]player.name}, according to our scouts, the Minmatar have been ferrying a lot of raw materials and ship-manufacturing equipment around, stockpiling it in various secure outposts until they can ship it back to their “Republic”; a lot of this stuff they've been acquiring in surface raids on Kameira-guarded bases out in the border constellations. (Of course, the Kameiras who failed to guard these assets have been properly dealt with.) Now, I don't like the implications of this activity any more than you do, so I want it dealt with, and dealt with yesterday. You get me?

Alright, I'm told these Minmatar raiders have a supply outpost in and around the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system; I want you to head out there and recover the freight containers ― we can use that stuff just as well as they can. This isn't a simple job, though, and that's why I need someone with your skills and resources to do it.

First off, I'm sure the compound, built in a deadspace complex, will be heavily guarded. Also, the Minmatar are known for booby-trapping their structures and containers; you'll need to hack the floating containers to get the secure containers inside, and the outer containers will no doubt detonate if you fail to hack them properly. There may be other decoy containers in the compound, too ― you'll need to find the ones with the secure containers inside.

To complete this mission, you will require a ship with a hacking module online, as well as a cargo capacity of at least 2,000 m3 volume (and preferably one with a capacity of 6,000 m3).
messages.zh:
我就不浪费时间了，因为根本没有时间浪费：{[character]player.name}，根据我们的侦察，米玛塔尔人正四处运送大量原材料和舰船制造设备，将它们储存在不同的安全哨站，最后将把它们运回他们所谓的共和国；这些物品中的大部分来自他们对相邻星座区域里基地的侵袭，那些基地由卡莫兵把守。(当然，那些失职未能保护好资产的卡莫兵已经被妥当处理了。)我跟你一样讨厌这件事可能造成的最终后果，所以我希望把它解决掉，让它成为昨天的历史。你懂我意思吗？

言归正传，有消息称，这些侵袭者在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系有一个供给哨站。我要你前往那里，取回货物集装箱——我们用起这东西来跟他们一样顺手。不过这任务不像听起来那么简单，这也是为什么我需要你这样有勇有谋的人。

首先，我确定这个设施建于一个死亡空间复合体中，而且守卫严密。还有，米玛塔尔人是出了名地爱在他们的建筑和集装箱上做手脚；你需要破解漂浮的集装箱以获得其内部的安全集装箱，当然，如果你破解失败，外部的集装箱无疑会爆炸。可能还有其他假冒集装箱混迹其中，你需要找到内含安全集装箱的目标。

要完成这个任务，你需要一艘装配并启用了破译装备的飞船，以及可用容量至少为2,000 m3的货舱(最好是6,000 m3)。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找了一支雇佣军中队来解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的米玛塔尔复合体，而且损失不小。幸好你不是为我国办事的唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar destroyed
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人被消灭

messages.en: I've changed my mind ― sorry, but I'm not much interested in finishing this job.
messages.zh: 我改主意了。抱歉，但我对完成这个任务兴趣不大。

messages.en: I see. Take a job, then quit. Your work ethic needs some polishing, I fear.
messages.zh: 我明白了。接下这个活，却又不干了。你的职业道德恐怕有待提高。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你未能妥善处理{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的仓库，米玛塔尔人已经带着偷来的物资逃回了共和国。飞行员不止你一个，{[character]player.name}，而且我还要提醒你，不要忘了替你付账单的是谁。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar escape
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人逃脱

name.ja: アマター基地を破壊せよ
name.ru: Уничтожить базу Ammatar (Destroy the Ammatar Base)

messages.en: I'm on it. Those slavers won't know what hit them.
messages.zh: 我这就向那出发。那些劳工贩子到时候连被谁打都不知道。

messages.en: Excellent. If you're quick, you can crush them before they know what's happening. Still, you're going to need a few tough allied ships; I'm sure they'll have reasonably strong stationary defenses.
messages.zh: 很好。如果你动作够快，你能在他们还没弄明白怎么回事前就把他们碾碎。不过，你还需要几艘强大的友军飞船；我肯定他们的空间站防御不是吃素的。

messages.en: Thanks, Commander. I heard you could use me. Whaddya need?
messages.zh: 谢谢，指挥官。我听说你可能用得着我。你要我干啥？

messages.en:
Recently, an Ammatar captain was given command of an Amarr station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} not too long ago, and he‘s been sending ships out into nearby low-security systems to harass our supply ships ever since. My scouts reported just a few hours ago that a large force of Amarr ships has left the base, so I´ve sent every ship I can spare to intercept them. I want you to head out there and destroy the station along with every damned Amarr or Ammatar you find.

Still, you're going to need a few tough allied ships; I'm sure they'll have reasonably strong stationary defenses.
messages.zh:
不久前，一个艾玛达上尉接管了位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个艾玛空间站，自那以后，他不断派舰船到附近低安全等级的星系来骚扰我们的补给船。据我的侦察机报告，几小时前，一大队艾玛飞船离开了基地，所以我派出了手头剩余的所有舰船去截击他们。我要你前往那里，摧毁空间站，并消灭你发现的每个艾玛或艾玛达人。

不过，你还需要几艘强大的友军飞船；我肯定他们的空间站防御不是吃素的。

messages.en: The station is so much scrap, Commander. Might wanna send some salvagers in there ― I left a few scraps behind.
messages.zh: 这空间站已经支离破碎了，指挥官。可能你们得派些打捞人员过来——我扔了好些垃圾碎片在后面。

messages.en: Hooo, yes!! Haha! I knew you were the right pilot for the job, {[character]player.name}. Take this ― you've earned it, my friend.
messages.zh: 哦，太好了！哈哈！我就知道你是能胜任这个任务的飞行员，{[character]player.name}。拿着，这是你应得的，我的朋友。

messages.en: Commander, I‘ve got places to be, people to see. Why not roll your fat ass out from behind that desk and fire up your own engines for a change?
messages.zh: 指挥官，我还有好多地方要跑，很多人要拜访。你干嘛不挪动你的大屁股，从桌子后面走出来，这次换你亲自开动引擎出发如何？

messages.en: And here I thought we were all fighting on the same side. Whose side you on, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 我还以为我们是并肩作战呢。你是哪边的，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en:
The Nefantar go by many names, but Ammatar is the most common ― though their former Minmatar brethren sometimes refer to them as “the Lost Tribe” in pity, but more often “the Fawning” or “the Yoked” in scorn. The Nefantar have left behind their tribal heritage and taken up many (but not all) aspects of the Amarrian religion, a movement that has resulted in a unique blend of cultures.

The Ammatar Mandate and the Minmatar Republic have been locked in a state of cold war for a few years now; since the Vindication Wars, there hasn't been a large-scale battle between them, mainly due to former Prime Minister Karin Midular's diplomatic efforts. However, after Midular's passing, the animosity between the two peoples cannot be denied. The Ammatar aristocracy see themselves as the rightful rulers of all the Matar tribes; for their part, most Minmatar hold little more than bitter animosity toward the tribe that long ago betrayed its cousins, and a widespread hatred of the Ammatar is still common among them.
messages.zh:
内凡达人有许多称呼，但艾玛达是最常用的——不过他们之前的同胞米玛塔尔人有时怜悯地称他们为“失落的部族”，但更多时候蔑称他们为“谄媚族”或“披枷者”。内凡达人遗弃了自己的部族传统，接受了艾玛宗教的许多(但非全部)方面，这一运动导致了一种独特的文化融合。

艾玛达特统区和米玛塔尔共和国数年来处于冷战的胶着状态；自从辩护战争以来，双方并未发生过大规模的战役，这主要归功于前首相卡琳·米杜拉在外交层面的努力。不过，自米杜拉卸任后，双方人民之间的敌意是毋庸置疑的了。艾玛达贵族视自己为所有玛塔尔部族的合法统治者；但米玛塔尔人对这群在早年背叛了其伙伴的人除了憎恶以外几乎找不到一丁点其他感情，此外在其他玛塔利部落中也广泛存在着对艾玛达人的仇视。

messages.en: The Nefantar
messages.zh: 内凡达人

messages.en:
The Amarr, as you must know, have been raiding our outlying planets, enslaving our people with the help of their Ammatar slaves. Recently, a Fawning lapdog captain took command of a station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} not too long ago, and he‘s been sending ships out into nearby low-security systems to harass our supply ships ever since. CONCORD does nothing, of course, and I don't have the resources to guard every transport flying near the border systems.

These raids must stop, {[character]player.name}. We know where the enemy base is, but my calls for reinforcement have fallen on deaf ears ― those squabbling slaves in the Republic Parliament can't walk five meters without tripping in their own shit. Now matters have gotten worse, and that's why I need you: My scouts reported just a few hours ago that a large force of Amarr ships, by all accounts their entire fleet, has left the base, so I´ve sent every ship I can spare to intercept them. That's why you're here: With all of their ships away from the station, we can make a sudden strike at them while their defenses are down.

{[character]player.name}, I want you to head out there and destroy that station along with every cursed Amarr or Ammatar in it.
messages.zh:
你肯定得知了，艾玛人一直在侵略我们边远地区的行星，在奴才艾玛达人的帮助下奴役我们的人民。不久前，一只谄媚族哈巴狗上尉接管了位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个空间站，自那以后，他不断派舰船到附近低安全等级的星系来骚扰我们的补给船。当然，统合部什么行动也没采取，而我又没有力量去保护每只飞近相邻星系的运输船。

必须阻止这些侵略，{[character]player.name}。我们知道敌人的基地在哪，但人们对我要求支援的呼吁充耳不闻——那些在共和议会人只会吹牛。现在情况已经恶化，这也是我为什么要你来的原因：我的探员数小时前回来向我报道说一个艾玛大部队已经离开了基地，因此我已全力让我的舰船奋力截击。我现在要你乘他们后方空虚去打他们一个措手不及。

{[character]player.name}，去把那个空间站摧毁，包括其中的每一个中了邪的艾玛及艾玛达人。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Due to your lack of response, I was forced to find another pilot to deal with the Amarr station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Fortunately, you are not the only capable capsuleer working in the Republic.

Commander {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛空间站。幸好你不是为共和国办事的唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}指挥官。

messages.en: Amarr station destroyed
messages.zh: 艾玛空间站被摧毁

messages.en: You nuts?! That was a fully armed battlestation! Gimme a couple dozen heavy assault cruisers and maybe I‘d stand a chance.
messages.zh: 你是不是疯了？！那可是个全副武装的战役空间站。给我几十艘重型突击巡洋舰，我可能还有机会。

messages.en: Damn you! This was our first real opportunity to strike back at those slave-takers. You're no better than those fools in parliament.
messages.zh: 你这该死的！那是我们第一次真正有机会向那些劳工贩子反击。你比那些议会的蠢才好不到哪去。

messages.en:
Because of your failure to deal with the station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, many Minmatar lost their lives fighting an overwhelming number of Amarr and Ammatar ships. You are not the only capsuleer working in the Republic, {[character]player.name}, and I‘d remind you to remember whose side you‘re on ― there may well come a day when you'll rue this occasion.

Captain {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh:
因为你的失利，位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的空间站未能得到妥善解决，许多优秀的艾玛人在与米玛塔尔巡洋舰的战斗中因为寡不敌众献出了生命。为共和国办事的飞行员不只你一个，{[character]player.name}，而且我还要提醒你，不要忘了自己是哪一边的，有一天你肯定会为今天后悔。

{[character]agentID.name}上尉。

messages.en: Amarr victory
messages.zh: 艾玛获胜

name.ja: カルダリアウトポストを破壊せよ
name.ru: Уничтожить станцию Caldari (Destroy the Caldari Outpost)

messages.en:
I'm happy to help, {[character]agentID.name}. Anything to show those Caldari automatons that the Federation is not to be trifled with. Just give me the coordinates and I'll be on my way.

…Once I finish my drink, of course.
messages.zh:
我很乐意帮忙，{[character]agentID.name}。有什么任务能让那帮加达里机器人看看，联邦不是好惹的吗？只要告诉我坐标，我就上路。

……当然，得等我先干完这杯。

messages.en:
Haha. Naturellement. Enjoy.

Now, I hope I have not misrepresented this matter: This won't be an easy task. You're going to need a few good ships along with you, for, as I mentioned, the owners of the station have paid a great deal for ... how do you say? "state-of-the-arts"? ― c'est ca? ― for strong stationary defenses.
messages.zh:
哈哈，当然了，请享用。

话说回来，我希望我没有让你产生误解：这不是个轻松的任务。你需要几艘好船与你同行；那个空间站的主人们可是花了大价钱，用在……那个词怎么说来着？“最先进的”？——是吗？——用于强大的空间站防御。

messages.en: You are too kind. The journey was nothing I couldn't handle. And make it Lusean rum, white, and Quafe Ultra, if you please. A double.
messages.zh: 你人真好。这次旅行对我来说是小菜一碟。哦，请给我卢香酒，加奶和酷菲特强。特大杯的。

messages.en:
Recently, the Caldari seized a shipment of extremely valuable blueprints from us and rerouted them to a station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Intelligence assures me that they haven't moved the blueprints yet; our spies have determined that the Caldari are holding the materials for inspection before they move them elsewhere. Those blueprints must be destroyed before that happens. I want you to head out there and destroy that storage outpost.

This won't be an easy task. You're going to need a few good ships along with you; the owners of the station have paid a great deal for strong stationary defenses.
messages.zh:
不久前，加达里人从我们这里抢走了一批极其宝贵的蓝图，并把它们转运到了位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一家空间站。据可靠情报，他们还没把蓝图转移到别处；我们的间谍已确认，加达里人要对蓝图进行检查，然后再将其转移。必须在转移前销毁那些蓝图。我要你立刻出发，摧毁那个存储哨站。

这不是个轻松的任务。你需要几艘好船与你同行；那个空间站的主人们为了加强防御可是花了大价钱。

messages.en: The station and its contents are no more. Those Caldari pigs will not benefit from our Gallente ingenuity.
messages.zh: 那个空间站及里面的东西已经不存在了。那些加达里蠢猪在我们盖伦特人的才智前讨不到便宜。

messages.en: C'excellent!! I knew you wouldn't let me down, {[character]player.name}. Here, now, take this reward ― you have earned it, my friend.
messages.zh: 太好了！！我知道你不会让我失望，{[character]player.name}。拿着，这是你应得的，我的朋友。

messages.en: {[character]agentID.name}, I'm afraid I can't do this for you right now: I have an appointment at my favorite spa, and … oh, look at the time ― better be going!
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，恐怕我现在不能替你干这个：我预约了我最爱的温泉美容，哦，看看几点了！我得走了！

messages.en: Merde alors!! What about the sanctity of the Federation, huhn!? F'agh! You, you, you capsuliers … you're all the same ― some day you'll need to choose a side.
messages.zh: 真是混蛋！！联邦的尊严怎么办呢，啊！？呸！你，你，你们这些飞行员——你们都一样——总有一天你需要明确立场。

messages.en:
The oligarchic Caldari State stands for corporate capitalism in its purest form. There are eight great "mega-corporations" that together own more than 90 percentage of all property within the State. Each corporation is made up of thousands of companies of various sizes, each with any number of specific market interests, ranging from simple mining companies to powerful security companies. There is no single, unified government as such; each megacorp rules its territories like a kingdom with little or no interference from the others.

In State matters such as foreign policy, the all-powerful Board of Directors, which consists of the CEOs of the eight megacorps, determines the behavior of the State (the tiebreaker vote in deadlock situations belongs to the CEO of Modern Finances). The Board also makes sure that the social infrastructure of the State remains intact and settles all major quarrels between the corporations.

The eight major corporations are Kaalakiota, Sukuuvestaa, Nugoeihuvi, Ishukone, Wiyrkomi, Hyasyoda, CBD, and Lai Dai.
messages.zh:
主张寡头政治的加达里合众国完全代表集团资本主义。八家“超级集团”总共占据了加达里合众国内百分之九十以上的财产。每家集团由数以千计的公司组成，这些公司规模不一，每个公司专营的业务领域数量也不尽相同，从简单的采矿公司到强大的安全公司均有包括。加达里合众国没有单独统一的政府；每个超级集团就像一个独立王国一样统治自己的领地，很少或几乎不干涉其他集团。

处理国家事务(比如外交政策)时，万能的董事会(由八家超级集团的CEO组成)将决定国家的行为(投票陷入僵局时，现代金融的CEO将投出打破平衡的一票)。董事会保全着加达里的基础社会秩序，并化解各集团间的争端。

八家超级集团包括卡拉吉塔，斯库维塔，纳基维，异株湖，维克米，三岛，CBD，和莱戴。

messages.en: The Corporate State
messages.zh: 集团国家

messages.en:
Of course. I‘ll have it brought in at once...

Now, in the meantime, {[character]player.name}, can we talk business? As you know, the Caldari megacorps have imposed a unilateral, if entirely “unofficial” trade embargo on all Gallentean transports. Recently, they seized a shipment of extremely valuable blueprints, which they rerouted to a station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I don't see that there's any way we can recover the shipment, so I want to do the next best thing.

Intelligence assures me that they haven't moved the blueprints yet; our spies have determined that the Caldari are holding the materials for inspection before they move them elsewhere. Those blueprints must be destroyed before that happens. You see where I'm headed with this?

{[character]player.name}, I want you to head out there and destroy that storage outpost. Right down to the foundations, non!? As a private holding subcontractor, the corporation that owns the station doesn't have any combat-worthy starships, but the structure is well protected nonetheless. What do you say?
messages.zh:
当然。我马上叫人送上来……

趁这个时候，{[character]player.name}，我们来谈谈工作吧？如你所知，加达里超级集团对所有盖伦特运输船强加了单边的、完全“非法”的贸易禁令。不久前，加达里人从我们这里抢走了一批极其宝贵的蓝图，并把它们转运到了位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一家空间站。我想我们没有办法把货物取回来，所以我打算退而求其次。

据可靠情报，他们还没把蓝图转移到别处；我们的间谍已确认，加达里人要对蓝图进行检查，然后再将其将其转移。必须在转移前销毁那些蓝图。你明白我的意思了吧？

{[character]player.name}，我要你立刻出发，摧毁那个存储哨站。作为一个私营转包商，那个空间站的所有者军团没什么厉害的战船，但是建筑物本身还是戒备森严的。你看怎么样？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Due to your lack of response, I was forced to find another pilot to deal with the Caldari station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Fortunately, you are not the only capable capsulier working in the Empire.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的加达里空间站。幸好你不是帝国里唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Station destroyed
messages.zh: 空间站被摧毁

messages.en: Are you completely, incurably mad?! What were you thinking!?? You‘d need a squadron of dreadnoughts to take down a fully armed outpost!
messages.zh: 你是不是彻底疯了，无可救药了？！你脑子里怎么想的！？？要干掉一个全副武装的哨站，你需要一个中队的无畏舰！

messages.en: Sacre…!! Well, what am I supposed to do now, hmm? Leave those blueprints to the capitalist pigs?!
messages.zh: 可恶……！！那我现在该怎么办，啊？把蓝图拱手让给那些资本主义蠢猪吗？！

messages.en:
Because of your failure to deal with the station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, the capitalist regime of the Caldari State has won another small victory over the democratic union of our noble Federation.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
由于你的失利，{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的空间站未能得到妥善处理，加达里合众国的资本主义政权又一次小胜我们高贵的联邦的民主联盟。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Capitalist victory
messages.zh: 资本家获胜

name.fr: Détruire le lieu de stockage gallente
name.ja: ガレンテの武器庫を粉砕せよ
name.ru: Уничтожить склад Gallente (Smash the Gallente Stockyard)

messages.en: Sounds good, Commander. You've called on the right capsuleer for this job.
messages.zh: 听上去不错，指挥官。你找到了最适合这项任务的飞行员。

messages.en: Excellent. I should warn you, however, that you're going to need a few tough ships along with you; the Gallente navy may be laughable, but I'm told the company that owns the station has paid top kredits for some pretty sturdy stationary defenses out there.
messages.zh: 很好。但我要告诫你，你还需要几艘强大的友军飞船；盖伦特人虽然可笑，但这个空间站所属的公司还是花了大价钱配备了相当坚固的空间站防御系统。

messages.en: Thank you, Commander, I am flattered. But let us not waste any time discussing my small successes: I understand you would have me perform some task for the benefit of the State?
messages.zh: 谢谢，指挥官，我受宠若惊。但我们不必浪费时间讨论我那些小小的成绩：我想你是想要我为合众国的利益执行某些任务吧？

messages.en:
Some Gallente warehousing firm has a station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} where they‘ve been stockpiling all sorts of old, unused armaments and ammunition. Thing is, some pirates have heard about the stockpile, and they keep trying to get their hands on it. Of course, we can't let that happen. The Gallente, being as soft as they are stupid, don't post guard ships around the place at all, so the longer it sits there, the more likely it is that some criminals will figure out a way past the stationary defenses.

Head out there and just destroy the whole bloody station. We'll call it a terrorist attack or something, don't worry. Your back is covered. Still, you're going to need a few tough ships along with you; the Gallente navy may be laughable, but I'm told the company that owns the station has paid top kredits for some pretty sturdy stationary defenses out there.
messages.zh:
某盖伦特仓储公司在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一所空间站，他们在那里囤积各种老式但从未用过的武器和弹药。事情是这样的：一些海盗听说了这些武器储备，一直试图将其据为己有。当然，我们不能让这事发生。盖伦特人，既软弱又愚蠢，根本没有在那地方布置防卫舰，所以这个空间站多存在一天，犯罪分子就越有机会想法子通过空间站的防御系统。

我要你飞去那里，把那个该死的空间站整个摧毁。别担心，我们会把它说成是恐怖分子的袭击或别的什么。你没有后顾之忧。不过，你还需要几艘强大的友军飞船；盖伦特人虽然可笑，但这家空间站所属的公司还是花了大价钱配备了相当坚固的空间站防御系统。

messages.en: The Gallente warehouse station is no more, Commander. Those weapons will never see pirate hands, or any others for that matter.
messages.zh: 那个盖伦特仓储空间站已经不存在了，指挥官。那些武器永远不会落到海盗或其他人手里。

messages.en:
That is good news, my friend. Though I could not speak of it (and it remains a matter of highest security), there was more at stake here than a simple pirate threat. Yes, good news indeed.

Take this reward ― you've certainly earned it.
messages.zh:
真是好消息，我的朋友。虽然我不能细谈（而且它还属于最高安全事件），但我们遭受的威胁不仅仅是海盗那么简单。确实是好消息。

拿好你的奖励，这是你应得的。

messages.en: Commander {[character]agentID.name}, I think you ought to find someone else to do your dirty work. Let me ask you: Somebody giving you a kickback to take care of this “stockpile“?
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}指挥官，我想你要找别人来替你做这下流活了。我问你：别人给了你多少好处让你来解决这个“仓库”？

messages.en: Well. I see. I had heard you were Caldari through and through ― but I see now that the State holds little place in your mercenary heart.
messages.zh: 好吧。我明白了。我听说你是彻彻底底的加达里人——但我看合众国在你这个雇佣兵的心里没什么地位。

messages.en: Gallentean society is currently enjoying the fruits of unprecedented economic prosperity and growth, undergoing a cultural and spiritual revitalization. President Foiritan, still popular despite being ousted by President Roden, takes credit for ushering in this age, expanding trade with other nations and pouring money into massive projects. In all of New Eden, no other nation has as many concurrent terraforming initiatives underway as the Federation; the demand for labor has grown so great that it now draws immigrants from many other nations, especially from the Minmatar Republic.
messages.zh: 盖伦特社会现在正享受着前所未有的经济繁荣和增长所带来的成果，文化和精神方面都在进行复兴。总统佛里坦虽然被莱登总统取代，但仍广受欢迎，他的功绩在于引导这个时代、扩大同其他国家的贸易并斥巨资于大型项目。在新伊甸星系中，联邦所进行的适生改造计划比其它任何国家都多；对于劳动力的需要急剧增长，吸引了来自许多其他国家——尤其是米玛塔尔共和国——的移民。

messages.en: The Gallentean Renaissance
messages.zh: 盖伦特的复兴

messages.en:
Heh. Humble and selfless, just like they said you‘d be. Listen, {[character]player.name}: Some Gallente warehousing firm has a station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and they‘ve been stockpiling all sorts of old, unused armaments and ammunition there for months now. Thing is, some pirates have heard about the stockpile, and they keep trying to get their hands on it. We can't let that happen; the Guristas and other pirate scum keep us busy enough as it is, and we don't need them causing any more trouble than they already do.

Of course, the Gallente, being as soft as they are stupid, don't post guard ships around the station at all, so the longer it sits there, the more likely it is that some jackass will figure out a way past the stationary defenses and hit the jackpot. We've got little use for the stuff ourselves, considering how outdated it is, so here's what I need you to do: Head out there and just destroy the whole bloody station, stockpile and all. I'm serious ― just take it down, no questions asked. We'll call it a terrorist attack or something, don't worry. Your back is covered.
messages.zh:
呵。你真是跟别人说的一样，谦虚又无私。听着，{[character]player.name}：某盖伦特仓储公司在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一所空间站，他们在那里囤积各种老式但从未用过的武器和弹药。事情是这样的：一些海盗听说了这些武器储备，一直试图将其据为己有。我们不能让这种事发生；古斯塔斯和其他海盗渣滓已经让我们够忙了，我们不能再让他们火上浇油。

盖伦特人既软弱又愚蠢，根本没有在那地方布置防卫舰，所以这个空间站多存在一天，一些混蛋就越有机会想法子通过空间

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Due to your lack of a suitably timely response, I was forced to find another capsuleer to deal with the Gallente situation in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Fortunately, you are not the only capable capsuleer working in the Empire.

Commander {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的盖伦特空间站。幸好你不是帝国里唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}指挥官。

messages.en: Gallente station destroyed
messages.zh: 盖伦特空间站被摧毁

messages.en: I'm afraid you're going to need to call in the Navy capital fleet on this one, Commander. That station is remarkably well protected for a simple arms storage facility…
messages.zh: 恐怕你要叫海军旗舰级舰队来解决这事了，指挥官。如果只用于简单的武器存储，这个空间站也实在是防御得太好了……

messages.en: Damn! Who knows when someone will retrieve that evi― ehh, those weapons. This was a matter of national security, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 可恶！谁知道有人会在什么时候取回那邪恶的……呃，那些武器。这事关乎国家安全，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en:
Pirates in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have just seized the contents of that warehouse, {[character]player.name}. There is more at stake in this matter than you know ― this is now a matter of national security.

Good day,
Commander {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh:
{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的海盗已经夺走了那座仓库里的东西，{[character]player.name}。这造成的威胁比你知道的更多——这事现在已经关乎国家安全。

祝你愉快，
{[character]agentID.name}指挥官。

messages.en: Pirate seizure
messages.zh: 海盗夺取成功

name.es: Destruir la estación de los sebiestors
name.ja: セビエスターステーションを破壊せよ
name.ru: Уничтожить станцию Sebiestor (Crush the Sebiestor Station)

messages.en: I'll ready my ship and summon my allies to strike at once, while the iron is still hot. Those pathetic barbarian fools won't know what hit them.
messages.zh: 我会趁热打铁，马上准备飞船，召集我的同伙立刻出击。那些可怜的野蛮傻瓜不会弄明白被什么打中了。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}. If you're quick and decisive, you can take these worthless dogs down. Still, you're going to need a few tough allied ships along with you; I'm sure the Minmatar will have reasonably strong stationary defenses.
messages.zh: 我就知道可以指望你，{[character]player.name}。如果你行动迅速果敢，肯定能结果那些贱狗。不过，你还需要几艘强大的友军飞船与你同行；我肯定米玛塔尔人的空间站防御不是吃素的。

messages.en: The pleasure is mine, Commander. I came as soon as I heard you had need. What seems to be the problem?
messages.zh: 我很荣幸，指挥官。一听说你用得着我，我就立刻赶来了。问题出在哪里？

messages.en:
Recently, a Sebiestor chieftain took command of a Minmatar station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and he‘s been sending raiding parties out into nearby systems to harass our transport caravans. I want you to head out there and destroy the raiders' base along with every damned Minmatar you find. If you're quick and decisive, you can take these worthless dogs down.

Still, you're going to need a few tough allied ships along with you; I'm sure the Minmatar will have reasonably strong stationary defenses.
messages.zh:
不久前，一个赛比斯托酋长接掌了位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个米玛塔尔空间站，自那以后，他不断派侵袭者到附近星系骚扰我们的运输船队。我要你前往那里摧毁侵袭者的基地，并消灭你发现的每个米玛塔尔人。如果你行动迅速果敢，肯定能结果那些贱狗。

不过，你还需要几艘强大的友军飞船与你同行；我肯定米玛塔尔人空间站的防御不是吃素的。

messages.en: The station is no more, Commander. Those Minmatar scum all died fiery deaths, every last one of them. And I laughed the whole time.
messages.zh: 那个空间站已经不存在了，指挥官。那些米玛塔尔渣滓都葬身火海了，一个也不剩。整个过程让我笑得不行。

messages.en: Ha! Victory!! I knew you wouldn't let me down, {[character]player.name}. Take this reward ― you've more than earned it, my friend.
messages.zh: 哈！胜利了！！我知道你不会让我失望，{[character]player.name}。拿着，这是你应得的，我的朋友。

messages.en: Commander {[character]agentID.name}, {[character]player.name} isn‘t a pawn in anyone‘s little war. Find someone else to do your dirty work.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}指挥官，{[character]player.name}不会为任何人的卑微战争充当爪牙。找别人完成你的肮脏任务吧。

messages.en: Dammit, {[character]player.name}, I thought you were on our side! You capsuleers are all the same ― some day, pilot, you'll need to choose a side.
messages.zh: 该死，{[character]player.name}，我以为你是我们这边的！你们这些飞行员都一样——总有一天你需要明确立场。

messages.en: The Sebiestor tribe hails from the inhospitable steppes of the Mikramurka continent in the northern arctic region on the Minmatar homeworld of Matar. The Sebiestors are the most technically inclined of the Minmatar tribes; they were at the forefront in the tentative space exploration program the Minmatars were undertaking just before the Amarrians arrived to subjugate them. Today, most Minmatar ships, and especially stations, tend to be engineered by Sebiestors.
messages.zh: 赛毕斯托部族发源于米克拉姆卡大陆上贫瘠的大草原，这块大陆位于米玛塔尔的玛塔尔家园的北极区域。赛比斯托人是米玛塔尔所有部族中最偏爱技术的；在艾玛人征服米玛塔尔人之前，赛比斯托人在米玛塔尔进行的太空探索计划中处于最前沿。今天，大多数米玛塔尔飞船，尤其是空间站，通常都是由赛比斯托人设计的。

messages.en: The Sebiestor
messages.zh: 赛比斯托人

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, these Minmatar rebels, as you know, have been getting more and more daring in their raids on outlying planets. Recently, one of their chieftains ― a Sebiestor, I think, for all it matters ― took command of a station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and he‘s been sending out raiding parties into nearby low-security systems to keep our transport caravans from getting to their destination. CONCORD intervention is minimal, of course, in low-sec, and I simply don't have the ships or the men to spare to guard every convoy within five jumps.

These raids must be stopped. We've known for some time where the enemy base is located, but my requests for reinforcements haven't been answered. Now matters have escalated, and that's why I need you: My scouts reported just a few hours ago that a large force of Minmatar ships, virtually their entire fleet, has left the base, so I´ve sent every ship I can spare to intercept them. The good thing is that, with all of their ships away from the station, we can make a sudden strike at them while their defenses are down.

{[character]player.name}, I want you to head out there and destroy the raiders' base along with every damned Minmatar you find.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，如你所知，这些米玛塔尔叛军在对我们边远地区行星的侵袭中已经越来越大胆了。不久前，他们的一个酋长——也就是个赛比斯托人而已——接掌了位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个米玛塔尔空间站，自那以后，他不断派侵袭者到附近低安全等级的星系来阻碍我们的运输船队到达目的地。当然，在低安全等级地带，统合部的介入是微乎其微的，而且我根本腾不出足够的舰船和人力来保护五个跳跃以内的所有运输船。

必须阻止这些侵袭。我们掌握了敌人基地的位置，但我的增援要求至今尚未得到回复。现在事情搞大了，所以我需要你。我的侦查队数小时前刚刚告诉我一个米玛塔尔大部队已经离开了那基地，我已经派出了每一架可用的舰船去拦截他们。这里有一件好事：敌人带大部队离开基地，我们就可以乘机搞偷袭。

{[character]player.name}，我要你去那里摧毁入侵者的基地，以及每一个你能发现的该死的米玛塔尔人。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Due to your lack of response, I was forced to find another pilot to deal with the Minmatar menace in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Fortunately, you are not the only capable capsuleer working in the Empire.

Commander {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的米玛塔尔威胁。幸好你不是在帝国里办事的唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}指挥官。

messages.en: Minmatar station destroyed
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔空间站被摧毁

messages.en: Are you insane?! You‘d need a squadron of dreadnoughts to take down a fully armed battlestation! I‘m getting the hell away from here before those Minmatar come looking for me.
messages.zh: 你是不是疯了？！要干掉一个全副武装的战役空间站，你需要一个中队的无畏舰！在那些米玛塔尔人来抓我之前，我要先离开这个鬼地方。

messages.en: Bloody hell! This was our first real opportunity to strike back at those Minmatar pirates. I guess I'd better call for more reinforcements ... won't hold my breath, though.
messages.zh: 该死！那是我们第一次真正有机会向那些米玛塔尔海盗反击。我想我最好还是请求更多的增援部队……我不会屏息以待的。

messages.en:
Because of your failure to deal with the station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, many good Amarrians lost their lives fighting an overwhelming number of Minmatar cruisers. You are not the only capsuleer working in the Empire, {[character]player.name}, and I‘d remind you to remember whose side you‘re on ― there may well come a day when you'll rue this occasion.

Commander {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh:
因为你的失利，位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的空间站未能得到妥善解决，许多优秀的艾玛人在与米玛塔尔巡洋舰的战斗中因为寡不敌众献出了生命。为共和国办事的飞行员不只你一个，{[character]player.name}，而且我还要提醒你，不要忘了自己是哪一边的，有一天你肯定会为今天后悔。

{[character]agentID.name}指挥官。

messages.en: Minmatar victory
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔获胜

messages.en: Sounds like a tough fight. That settles it: I'm in.
messages.zh: 听上去会是一场硬仗。这就够了：我会参加这个任务。

messages.en: Ha! That's the spirit! But I imagine it will be a tough fight, yes. You ought to call on some of your old friends to tackle this one.
messages.zh: 哈！要的就是这种精神！但我想这会是艰苦的一仗。你在啃这块硬骨头前应叫上一些老朋友。

messages.en:
Don't mind if I do ... Ah, the good stuff. Thanks.

So, {[character]agentID.name}, I hear there's been some Imperial Navy activity around here lately. Anything I can help with?
messages.zh:
喝点也行…… 啊，好酒。谢谢了。

那么，{[character]agentID.name}，我听说最近这附近有帝国海军在活动。我能帮上什么忙吗？

messages.en:
Nine days ago, my spies found out about a capital ship repair facility, owned secretly by the Amarr, residing in our sovereign space. I must warn you that what I propose is not authorized by Command, and if you get caught I will be forced to deny all knowledge of you and your actions.

An Amarr carrier was heavily damaged yesterday by a few Blood Raider battleships, badly enough that it was apparently forced to head to the repair facility of which I've spoken. Whether its repairs are complete by now or not I don't know, but regardless, I want you to head out to that facility and destroy the carrier. That should make them think twice about using our space for troop movements.

But I imagine it will be a tough fight. You ought to call on some of your friends before you tackle this one.
messages.zh:
九天前，我的间谍发现一座艾玛人秘密拥有的旗舰级战舰维修工厂，就位于我们的领空之内。我必须警告你，我的计划未经过指挥部批准，因此如果你被抓，我将不得不否认与你和你的行动有关。

一艘艾玛航空母舰昨天被几只血袭者战列舰严重损坏，损坏程度使它不得不前往我提到的那个维修工厂。我不知道它的修理是否已经完毕，但无论如何，我要你飞往该工厂，摧毁这艘航母。这样他们以后打算用我们的领空运输军队前要三思而行了。

但我想这会是艰苦的一仗。你在啃这块硬骨头前应叫上一些朋友。

messages.en: Ah, that was a good fight. The mothership is no more, {[character]agentID.name}. Next time you have trouble with those stinking fedo-lovers ... well, you know who to call, right?
messages.zh: 真是一场恶战啊。那艘母舰已经不存在了，{[character]agentID.name}。下次要是那些臭哄哄的费多爱好者再找你麻烦……你知道该给谁打电话了，对吧？

messages.en: Indeed I do. I expected no less, {[character]player.name}. Put the right person on the job, and it always gets done well.
messages.zh: 我确实知道。这跟我的期望一样，{[character]player.name}。只要找到合适的人选，就能将工作圆满完成。

messages.en: {[character]agentID.name}, I appreciate your confidence in me, but I‘m afraid I can‘t afford to entangle myself in your political maneuverings. Hope you understand.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，感谢你对我的信任，但我恐怕无力卷入你的政治把戏之中。希望你理解。

messages.en: I see how it is, {[character]player.name}. We are men of action: Lies do not become us. You needn‘t hide your cowardice behind your politics.
messages.zh: 我知道这是怎么回事了，{[character]player.name}。我们是靠行动说话的：谎话成就不了我们。你用不着拿那些外交辞令来掩饰你的胆小。

messages.en:
Religion is of great importance to every Amarrian ― at least in public, if not in private. This fervor has at various times been the cause of both great good and great evil, as has religion in every age of humankind.

Shortly after recovering from the closure of EVE, millennia ago, the Amarrians began to expand their realm and colonize other planets and, eventually, constellations. The worlds they conquered were enslaved, a practice justified by the Amarr Scriptures. Ever since, the Amarrians have attempted to enslave every nation and race they have encountered, and slavery remains an essential part of Amarr society. This practice has, of course, tainted their relations with other races.

And the Lord spake, and said, Lo, my people,
Witness, for I have made the worlds of Heaven;
And these worlds I give to you, My Chosen,
So Amarr shall rule the worlds of the Heavens.

None shall stand higher than you save the Sefrim,
Who serve Me as others shall serve you,
For all things under Me serve one higher;
So Amarr shall rule the worlds of the Heavens.

As Garrulor rules the skies; as Frisceas rules the sea;
As Emperor rules Holder; as Holder rules Serf;
Yet all under Heaven serve Me;
So shall Amarr rule the worlds of the Heavens.

―Book of Reclaiming 3.19–21
messages.zh:
宗教对每个艾玛人都具有重大意义，至少在公众层面如此，私下就难说了。这种热情在不同时期既导致了大善，也造成了大恶——就像宗教在人类每个历史时期所发挥的作用一样。

数千年前，在从新伊甸的封闭中恢复后不久，艾玛人开始了他们的领土扩张，在其他行星设立殖民地，最终他们的殖民范围扩大到成群的星座区域。他们使被征服的世界的人们沦为劳工，这是艾玛圣典中允许的。从此以后，艾玛人试图奴役他们遇见的每一个国家和民族，劳工制成为艾玛社会的一项关键组成部分。毫无疑问，这种做法破坏了他们同其他种族的关系。

上帝曾说，瞧吧，我的人民，
亲眼看吧，我创造了天堂的世界；
我把这些世界赐给你们，被我选中的人们，
艾玛将主宰天堂的世界。

没有人比你们地位更高，除了瑟夫林人，
他们服侍我，就像其他人应服侍你们，
因为所有于我之下者服侍地位高于其者；
所以艾玛应统治天堂的世界。

就像盖儒勒统治天空；弗里西斯统治海洋；
就像皇帝统治劳工主；劳工主统治劳工；
但普天万物均为我服务；
所以艾玛应统治天堂的世界。

―归御书 3.19–21

messages.en: Slavery and the Amarr Mindset
messages.zh: 劳工制和艾玛心理

messages.en:
I was hoping you'd ask, of course ― that's why you're here. I won't lie to you: We need someone with your talents, {[character]player.name}.

Amarrian ships have been passing through our space. Low-sec space, mind you, so not heavily patrolled, but our space nonetheless. And large numbers of them are capital ships, carriers that we're pretty certain are ferrying drop ships for their damnable slave-hunting surface raids in outlying constellations. I've sent several requests to every admiral in High Command, but the replies are always the same: Our ships are needed elsewhere, and there are no ships to spare unless these Amarr actually open hostilities.

Nine days ago, my spies found out about a capital ship repair facility, owned secretly by the Amarr, residing in our sovereign space. Of course, the very existence of this station is a breach of multiple treaties and is actually reason enough to declare open war. I get the sense, though, that that isn't something we're ready to do ― not just yet, at least. But that doesn't mean my hands are tied completely. I must warn you that what I propose is not authorized by Command, and if you get caught I will be forced to deny all knowledge of you and your actions.

Understood? Very well.

My spies inform me that an Amarr carrier was heavily damaged yesterday in a firefight with a few Blood Raider battleships; it was hurt badly enough that it was apparently forced to head to the repair facility of which I've spoken. Whether its repairs are complete by now or not I don't know, but regardless, I want you to head out to that facility and destroy that carrier; if the attack isn't undertaken by ships bearing our signatures, we can simply declare it an act of piracy and be done with it. Heh. That should make those bastards think twice about using our space for troop movements.

But just to be safe, let's keep this conversation between the two of us.
messages.zh:
当然，我就希望你会问——这就是要你来的原因。我不打算对你撒谎：我需要像你这样有才干的人，{[character]player.name}。

艾玛的船舰最近一直穿行于我们的空间。因为都是些低安全等级的空间，所以巡逻力量不强，但毕竟还是我们的空间。船舰中的大部分是旗舰级战舰和航空母舰，我们相当肯定，它们运输的是该死的空投飞船，用来在边远的星座区域发动抓捕劳工的地面侵袭。我给高级指挥部的每位将军都发了好几次请求，但答复总是相同的：我们的船舰需要用于别处，无法腾出多余的飞船，只有艾玛开战才能另当别论。

九天前，我的间谍发现一座艾玛人秘密拥有的旗舰级战舰维修工厂，就位于我们的领空之内。这个维修站的存在是对多边条约的破坏，而且基本上构成宣战的理由。不过我们还没准备那样做——至少现在还不行。但是这不等于我就只能束手无策。我必须警告你，我的计划未经过指挥部批准，因此如果你被抓，我将不得不否认与你和你的行动有关。

明白吗？很好。

我的间谍报告说一艘艾玛航空母舰昨天被几只血袭者战列舰严重损坏，损坏程度使它不得不前往我提到的那个维修工厂。我不知道它的修理是否已经完毕，但无论如何，我要你飞往该工厂，摧毁这艘航母。只要袭击者不带我们的军队标记，事后我们就可以宣称这是一起海盗行为，哈。这样他们以后打算用我们的领空运输军队前要三思而行了。

这事天知地知，你知我知。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Due to your lack of response, I was forced to find another capsuleer to deal with the Amarr menace we discussed. Sadly, having little time to prepare for the task I required, the pilot of that expedition lost his ship and barely escaped in his pod. The Amarr ship remains at large.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去处理那次艾玛威胁。不幸的是，由于没有充足的时间准备，执行任务的飞行员丢掉了飞船，勉强靠逃生舱逃生。那艘艾玛飞船仍逍遥法外。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: I just got my ass handed to me out there. How in all the hells did you expect me to do this!? Give me a fleet of battleships, and then maybe....
messages.zh: 我刚刚在那被打得差点丢了屁股。你该死的怎么会指望我来干这个活！？给我一个战列舰舰队，也许还行……

messages.en: Well, {[character]player.name}, I understand that this was not an easy task, but, given your reputation, I really didn‘t expect you to give up so easily. Just goes to show, you can‘t trust everything you hear...
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我知道这不是个简单的任务，但以你的名声，我万万没想到你会这么轻易放弃。正是应了那句话，耳听未必为实……

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Unfortunately, given the amount of time that has passed since we last met, the Amarr carrier we discussed has now left {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and rejoined its fleet. At this time, I must ask you to stand down.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

很不幸，在我们上次会面之后的这段时间里，那艘艾玛航空母舰已经离开了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}并重新加入了舰队。此时此刻，我必须请你退出任务。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Abort mission
messages.zh: 任务中止

messages.en: Very well. You find a tough problem, you've got to send out a tougher solution.
messages.zh: 很好。你遇到了一个棘手的问题，你就得拿出一个更强硬的解决方案。

messages.en: That's what I hoped you would say. What a relief! Take care out there.
messages.zh: 我就希望你这么说。总算松了口气！多加小心。

messages.en: That´s precisely why I'm here, {[character]agentID.name}. How can I help?
messages.zh: 我就是为这个来的，{[character]agentID.name}。我能帮什么忙？

messages.en:
Caldari ships, some of them capital, have been traveling through nearby low-security systems in our sovereign space. Now, a few days ago, my scout discovered a capital ship repair facility, secretly controlled by the Caldari State, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}! One of their carriers was heavily damaged yesterday by some Guristas battleships and forced to head to this secret base; I want you to destroy that carrier before it has a chance to rejoin its fleet.

I imagine this will be a tough fight. You ought to gather some allies before you head out.
messages.zh:
最近，加达里舰船，包括一些旗舰级战舰在内，一直穿行于靠近我国领土的低安全等级星系。几天以前，我的侦察队发现了一座由加达里合众国秘密掌管的旗舰维修工厂，就位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}！昨天，他们的一艘航空母舰被一些古斯塔斯战列舰严重损坏，因而不得不前往该秘密基地；我要你在这艘航空母舰有机会重返舰队前摧毁它。

我想这会是艰苦的一仗。出发前，你应该先去找点帮手来。

messages.en: The Caldari mothership is destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}. My pleasure.
messages.zh: 那艘加达里母舰被摧毁了，{[character]agentID.name}。很高兴为你效劳。

messages.en: Wonderful news, {[character]player.name}. Please accept this reward as a small token of my gratitude.
messages.zh: 这消息太棒了，{[character]player.name}。为了略表谢意，请接受这个奖励。

messages.en: Oh, I just realized that I had forgotten I´m supposed to go visit my mom today. Boy, what a memory I have! Haha. Ha. Ha. (Ha.) Well, see you later…
messages.zh: 哦，我刚想起来我忘了今天该去看我妈妈。哦，我的记性太差了！哈哈。哈。哈。（哈。）好吧，回头见……

messages.en: Your mother, eh? Good one. Never heard that before, not in all my years.
messages.zh: 你妈妈？真是个不错的理由。还从没听说过，这辈子也没有。

messages.en:
The Caldari Navy is smaller in terms of personnel and total ships than both the Federation Navy and the Imperial Navy, yet it has more battleships than any other fleet, and the average age of the Caldari ships is considerably less. (The Caldari regularly replace their oldest ships with newer ones and constantly add better hi-tech equipment.) The strategic doctrine of the Caldari Navy, as reported by Kutatala Ikao, Chief Coordinator of Navy Public Relations, is simple: to be able to defeat any other navy in the world.

Most experts believe it is.
messages.zh:
加达里海军在人员和飞船数量上均不如联邦海军和帝国海军，但他们的战列舰却是最多的，飞船服役年限也相对较短。（加达里人经常用新船替换最老的战舰，而且不断添加更好的高科技装备。）据海军公共关系首席协调官库塔塔拉·伊考报告，加达里海军的战略信条很简单：具有战胜世界上其他任何海军的能力。

很多专家对此深信不疑。

messages.en: Caldari Navy
messages.zh: 加达里海军

messages.en:
Well, I've been hearing reports of Caldari ships ― many, and some of them capital ships ― traveling in nearby low-security systems, {[character]player.name}. Apparently they think they can reduce the amount of jump fuel they use by taking short cuts through our sovereign space. Of course, this is a clear breach of our treaties; the very appearance of capital ships in such numbers is cause to declare open war! I have issued formal complaints to Fleet Command, but it's always the same: “You need to bring in ‘concrete evidence' of these ships' movements.” And implicit in that is the fact that I'm not supposed to ruffle any political feathers... Well, frankly, I've had it. These ships undermine my authority and make me look bad.

Now, a few days ago, my scout discovered a capital ship repair facility, secretly controlled by the bloody Caldari State, located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}! Yes, within our jurisdiction! There's good news, too, though: One of their carriers was heavily damaged yesterday by some Guristas battleships, and it was apparently forced to head to this secret base. I want you to destroy that carrier before it has a chance to rejoin its fleet. As long as it's a mercenary like yourself who does the deed, we can just call the whole thing an unfortunate random act of piracy and leave it at that. Heh.

I should warn you that this mission is not authorized by the Federation or the Fleet, and if you get caught I'll be forced to deny all knowledge of you and your actions. Fair enough?
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，据报告，很多加达里舰船，包括一些旗舰在内，一直在附近的低安全等级星系穿行。显然，他们认为从我们的领土上走走捷径，可以节省跳跃用的燃料。当然，这明显触犯了我们的条约，这么多旗舰的出现已经构成公开宣战的理由。我已经多次向舰队指挥部正式提出报告，但回复总是一样的：“你需要提供这些舰船活动的‘确凿证据’”。言外之意就是要我别再激起政治风波了…… 老实说，我受够了。这些船侵犯了我的权威还让我面子扫地。

几天以前，我的侦察队发现了一座由加达里合众国秘密掌管的旗舰维修工厂，就位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}！没错，正是我们的辖区！ 不过也有好消息：他们的一艘航母昨天被古斯塔斯的战列舰围攻，破损严重。这艘航母好像朝这个秘密基地来了。我要你干掉这艘航母，别让它重回舰队。只要干这件事的人是像你这样的雇佣兵，我们在事成之后就可以称这只是一个海盗事件，就没事了。嘿嘿。

我必须警告你，这个任务未经过联邦或共和舰队批准，因此如果你被抓，我将不得不否认与你和你的行动有关。这要求不过分吧？

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去处理那艘加达里飞船。由于没有充足的时间准备，那个飞行员丢掉了飞船，勉强靠逃生舱逃生。感谢你的(不)努力。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: I might as well have attacked a Fleet armada in a Velator. Are you mad?! I'm done with this “mission” of yours.
messages.zh: 我还不如坐着“维拉托尔”号去攻击一支舰队呢。你是不是疯了？！我受够你的这个“任务”了。

messages.en:
You're giving up?! Zut alors!

Alright, fine. Fine. Good effort, and all that. I guess this was a pretty tough job.
messages.zh:
你放弃了？！真是该死！

好吧，行。行。你已经努力了。我想这是个相当棘手的任务。

{[character]player.name}，

很不幸，在我们上次会面之后的这段时间里，那艘加达里母舰已经离开了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}并重新加入了舰队。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Abort mission
messages.zh: 任务中止

messages.en: Well, now, this sounds like it might be a challenge worthy of … me. I accept.
messages.zh: 嗯，这听上去似乎是个值得我出马的挑战。我接受了。

messages.en: Oh, well, that's what I'd hoped you'd say. With you on our side, we can't fail. Good luck out there. Even though you don't need it.
messages.zh: 哦，我就希望你这么说。有你在我们这边，我们战无不胜。祝你好运！尽管你也不需要。

messages.en: Are you mocking me, {[character]agentID.name}? I came to see if you needed my help, but I can leave…
messages.zh: 你在嘲笑我吗，{[character]agentID.name}？我来看看你是否需要我的帮助，但我可以离开……

messages.en:
Lately, we've been getting reports of large numbers of Gallente ships in nearby low-sec border systems. Not just any ships, either, but capital ships. These ships in my jurisdiction undermine my authority and make me look bad. However, a Gallente carrier was heavily damaged yesterday by some Serpentis battleships, enough that it was apparently forced to head to a capital ship repair facility, secretly run by the Federation, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy that carrier before it has a chance to rejoin with its fleet.

I imagine this will be a tough fight. You ought to gather a squad of allies before you head out there.
messages.zh:
最近我们收到报告，有大量盖伦特船舰出没于附近的低安全等级的相邻星系。而且它们不是普通的船，而是旗舰级船舰。这些出现在我辖区内的飞船侵犯了我的权威还让我面子扫地。不过，一艘盖伦特航空母舰昨天被几艘天蛇集团战列舰严重损坏，损坏程度使它不得不前往位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一所旗舰级船舰维修工厂，这所工厂是由盖伦特联邦秘密拥有的。我要你在这艘航空母舰有机会重返舰队前摧毁它。

我想这会是艰苦的一仗。出发前，你应召集一小队友军。

messages.en: Damn, that was a good fight. The carrier is dispatched, {[character]agentID.name}. Happy to be of help. And my reward?
messages.zh: 真是一场恶战啊。那艘航母被解决了，{[character]agentID.name}。很高兴帮上忙。我的奖赏呢？

messages.en: Yes, yes, of course. Thank you. I'm only sorry I can't give you more...
messages.zh: 是，是，当然。谢谢。很抱歉我不能多给你一些……

messages.en: {[character]agentID.name}, a carrier. A carrier. CAR-ri-er. You realize what that means? I'm out of here.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，一艘航空母舰。一艘航空母舰。航-空-母-舰。你知道那意味着什么吗？我闪了。

messages.en: But you're this great thing! This famous capsuleer! I … I don't know what to say…
messages.zh: 但你是那个大人物！那个著名飞行员！我……我不知道该说什么……

messages.en: Impetus is the biggest and most widely known producer of holoreels in the entire known EVE universe, making everything from epic feature films and indie art films to cheap porn flicks. Production Manager Baemedier Andenget, herself once the most trusted newscaster in the Federation, has in recent years led the development of much-anticipated instant news arrays, a technology that, once complete, will no doubt revolutionize the news industry.
messages.zh: 促进工业是整个宇宙中最大、最著名的全息记忆盘生产商，生产的产品从史诗长片、独立艺术电影到廉价的动作片应有尽有。生产部经理巴梅蒂·安德金本人曾是盖伦特联邦内最受信赖的新闻广播员，近年来她一直领导着备受期待的即时新闻阵列的开发，这种技术一旦成功，无疑会给整个新闻产业带来变革。

messages.en: Impetus and Instant News
messages.zh: 促进工业和即时新闻

messages.en:
No, no, honest. We're just huge fans of yours here at {[location]agentStationID.name}. Especially after seeing that Impetus docureel of you destroying those pirates not far from here a couple of months back? Remember that, just a few constellations over? Man, that was a good one.

Anyway, we really do need your help. Lately, we've been getting reports of large numbers of Gallente ships in nearby low-sec border systems, apparently cutting jumps out of their travels by using our sovereign space as a “shortcut.” Not just any ships, either, but capital ships. I'm talking dreadnoughts, motherships.

Of course, they're breaching multiple treaties in this; their appearance in our space is enough reason to declare open war. I have sent several reports about it, but the replies are always the same: that I need to bring in “concrete evidence” of these ships' movements. And I have also been given tacit instructions about not “rocking the boat.” Yeah. Well, I've had enough. These ships in my jurisdiction undermine my authority and make me ― and our government ― look bad.

And it gets worse. A few days ago, my spies found out about a capital ship repair facility, secretly run by the Federation, again in our territory! But apparently a Gallente carrier was heavily damaged yesterday by some Serpentis battleships, enough that it was forced to head to this secret facility. I want you to head out there and destroy that carrier before it has a chance to rejoin with its fleet. As long as it's a privateer like yourself who does the deed, we can just claim the whole thing is a “random act of piracy” and leave it at that. Right?

Alright, then ― now, to be fair, I should warn you that what we're doing here is not authorized by the Board or the Navy, and if you get caught I'll be forced to deny all knowledge of you and your actions.
messages.zh:
不，不，我是认真的。我们在{[location]agentStationID.name}的人都是你的狂热粉丝。尤其是看了一部促进工业的纪录片后，片子讲的是你几个月前干掉一帮海盗的事迹，那地方离这不远吧？记得吗，就是几个星座区域以外的地方？老兄，真是部好片子。

言归正传，我们真的需要你的帮助。最近我们收到报告，有大量盖伦特船舰出没于附近的低安全等级的相邻星系，显然他们把我们的领空当作“捷径”以节省跳跃数量。而且它们不是普通的船，而是旗舰级船舰。我说的可是无畏舰、母舰之类的。

当然，他们此举触犯了多项条约；这些船舰出现我们的空间已经构成公开宣战的理由。我已经上交了好几份报告，但回复总是一样的：说我需要提供这些船舰活动的“具体证据”。而且，我还受到暗示指令，叫我不要“惹乱子”。唉。好吧，我受够了。这些出现在我辖区内的飞船侵犯了我的权威还让我——和我的政府——面子扫地。

而且情况还在变得更糟。几天前，我的间谍发现了一座盖伦特联邦秘密运营的旗舰级船舰维修工厂，也在我们的领地里！不过一艘盖伦特航空母舰昨天被一些天蛇集团战列舰重创，因此不得不前往这个秘密工厂。我要你飞去那里，在这艘航空母舰有机会重返舰队前摧毁它。只要这事是由你这样的私掠船干的，我们就能把整个事件称为是海盗造成的不幸事件然后就此罢手。对吗？

好吧，不过，为了公平起见，我需要警告你，我们要干的事未经过董事会或海军批准，因此如果你被抓，我将不得不否认与你和你的行动有关。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去处理那艘盖伦特飞船。由于没有充足的时间准备，那个飞行员丢掉了飞船，勉强靠逃生舱逃生。要是你动作再快些，除掉那个威胁就好了……

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: Well, I'm done. A carrier?! I might as well attack the nearest moon.
messages.zh: 好吧，我不干了。一艘航空母舰？！我还不如去攻打最近的卫星呢。

messages.en: You're giving up?! But, but … you're {[character]player.name}!!
messages.zh: 你放弃了？！但，但是……你是{[character]player.name}！！

{[character]player.name}，

很不幸，在我们上次会面之后的这段时间里，那艘盖伦特母舰已经离开了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}并重新加入了舰队。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Abort mission
messages.zh: 任务中止

messages.en: I've been looking to test my latest ship fittings against a worthy opponent. Now's as good a time as any.
messages.zh: 我一直都期待找一个劲敌来测试我最新的飞船装备。现在正是最佳时机。

messages.en: Wonderful. I knew I could count on you. Your reputation is not unwarranted.
messages.zh: 好极了。我就知道你值得信赖。你不是浪得虚名。

messages.en: No, {[character]agentID.name}, nothing I couldn't deal with. I understand you need some help?
messages.zh: 不，{[character]agentID.name}，没什么是我解决不了的。我想你需要一些帮助？

messages.en:
Recently, Minmatar ships have been spotted in unprecedented numbers in various low-sec border systems. My spies recently found out about a secret Matar capital ship repair facility in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and yesterday a Minmatar carrier was heavily enough damaged in a firefight with a some Ammatar ships that it was forced to head to this facility. I want you to destroy that carrier.

I imagine it will be a tough fight. You ought to call on some of your friends before you tackle this one.
messages.zh:
最近，我们在各个低安全等级的相邻星系发现了空前数量的米玛塔尔船舰。我的间谍最近发现了位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个秘密玛塔尔旗舰级船舰维修工厂。昨天一艘米玛塔尔航空母舰被一些艾玛达飞船在交货中重创，不得不前往该修复工厂。我要你去摧毁那艘航空母舰。

我想这会是艰苦的一仗。你在啃这块硬骨头前应叫上一些朋友。

messages.en: Now that was a good fight. The mothership is no more, {[character]agentID.name}. Next time you have trouble with a capital ship infestation ... well, you know who to call, right?
messages.zh: 真是一场恶战啊。那艘母舰已经不存在了，{[character]agentID.name}。下次要是那些如老鼠般出动的旗舰级战舰再找你麻烦……你知道该给谁打电话了，对吧？

messages.en: Damned straight I do! But to be honest, I expected no less, {[character]player.name}. Fine work. Fine work indeed.
messages.zh: 我当然知道啦！而且说实话，{[character]player.name}，这跟我期望的一样。干得漂亮。干得真是漂亮。

messages.en: {[character]agentID.name}, I hope you‘ll understand when I say I‘d rather lick fedo slime out of my grandmother‘s ear than do this mission for you.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，我希望你能理解，我宁愿给我奶奶舔她耳朵里的费多粘液，也不愿给你干这个活。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}. {[character]player.name}. {[character]player.name}. You truly, deeply, profoundly disappoint me.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}。{[character]player.name}。{[character]player.name}。你真的是彻底让我失望透顶了。

messages.en:
Religion defines the Amarr Empire, where slavery and colonization are defended with direct reference to the Holy Scriptures. Philosophers of other races have tried, with little effect, to argue these matters with theologians of Amarr, but the practice of slavery is so deeply ingrained in the Amarrian mindset that the Empire would no doubt collapse under its own ponderous weight if slavery were ever abolished ― which is not something any Amarrian, Holder or otherwise, could ever imagine happening.

And the Lord spake, and said, Lo, my people,
Witness, for I have made the worlds of Heaven;
And these worlds I give to you, My Chosen,
So Amarr shall rule the worlds of the Heavens.

None shall stand higher than you save the Sefrim,
Who serve Me as others shall serve you,
For all things under Me serve one higher;
So Amarr shall rule the worlds of the Heavens.

As Garrulor rules the skies; as Frisceas rules the sea;
As Emperor rules Holder; as Holder rules Serf;
Yet all under Heaven serve Me;
So shall Amarr rule the worlds of the Heavens.

―Book of Reclaiming 3.19–21

I give to you the destiny of Faith,
And you will bring its message to every planet and every star in the heavens:
Go forth, conquer in My Name, and reclaim that which I have given.

―Book of Reclaiming 22.13
messages.zh:
宗教界定了艾玛帝国，圣典中的语句直接为那里的劳工制和殖民主义提供了支持。其他种族的哲学家多次试图与艾玛的神学家进行争辩，但收效甚微，而且劳工制已经牢牢生根于艾玛人的思维模式中，如果劳工制有天被废除，艾玛帝国无疑将因无法承担自身的重量而土崩瓦解——这不是任何艾玛人、劳工主或其他人所愿意看到的。

上帝曾说，瞧吧，我的人民，
亲眼看吧，我创造了天堂的世界；
我把这些世界赐给你们，被我选中的人们，
艾玛将主宰天堂的世界。

没有人比你们地位更高，除了瑟夫林人，
他们服侍我，就像其他人应服侍你们，
因为所有于我之下者服侍地位高于其者；
所以艾玛应统治天堂的世界。

就像盖儒勒统治天空；弗里西斯统治海洋；
就像皇帝统治劳工主；劳工主统治劳工；
但普天万物均为我服务；
所以艾玛应统治天堂的世界。

―归御书 3.19–21

我赐予你们传播信仰的命运，
你们将把其内涵带到天堂内的每个行星和每颗恒星：
前进吧，以我的名义征服，收复我给予之物。

―归御书 22.13

messages.en: Slavery and the Scriptures
messages.zh: 劳工制和圣典

messages.en:
Heh. Don't waste any time, eh? I like that. And I won't lie to you: We do need your help.

Recently, Minmatar ships have appeared in unprecedented numbers in various low-sec border systems. And that's not all: Many of them are capital ships, carriers that we're pretty certain are ferrying swarms of assault frigates. Now, I've sent several requests to every admiral I know, but the replies are always the same: Our forces are needed elsewhere, and there are no ships to spare unless the heathens actually initiate open hostilities.

But it gets worse. A few days ago, my spies found out about a capital ship repair facility, owned secretly by the Republic, residing in our sovereign space. Of course, the very existence of this station is reason enough to declare open war. I get the sense, though, that that isn't something we're ready to do ― not just yet, at least. But that doesn't mean I have to sit here fingering my nasal implants. I must warn you that what I propose is not authorized by Command, and if you get caught I will be forced to deny all knowledge of you and your actions. Got that?

Alright, well then: My spies inform me that a Minmatar carrier was heavily damaged yesterday in a firefight with some Ammatar outriggers; it was hurt badly enough that it was apparently forced to head to this illegal repair facility of theirs. I have no idea if they've had the time or resources to repair it yet, and I don't care. I want you to head out to that facility and destroy that carrier, I don´t care how, before it has a chance to rejoin with its fleet.

Now, as long as the attack isn't undertaken by our ships, we can declare the whole thing a “random act of piracy” or something and leave it at that. Right? That'll teach these upstart dogs to use our space for troop movements. But just to avoid any political repercussions, let's keep this all between the two of us.
messages.zh:
唔，不浪费任何时间，是吗？我喜欢那样。我也不打算对你撒谎：我们确实需要你的帮助。

最近，数量空前的米玛塔尔舰船出现在各个低安全等级的相邻星系。而且事情还不只这样：舰船中的大部分是旗舰级战舰和航空母舰，我们相当肯定，它们运输的是大批突击护卫舰。我给认识的每位将军都发了好几次请求，但答复总是相同的：我们的部队需要用于别处，无法腾出多余的飞船，只有那些异教徒首先开战才能另当别论。

情况还在变得更糟。几天前，我的间谍发现一座米玛塔尔共和国秘密运行的旗舰级战舰维修工厂，就位于我们的领空之内。当然，这所空间站的存在本身已经构成公开宣战的理由。不过，我有预感，我们什么也不会做——至少现在不会。但这并不意味着我只有傻坐着拨弄我的鼻腔植入体。我必须警告你，我的计划未经过指挥部批准，因此如果你被抓，我将不得不否认与你和你的行动有关。懂了吗？

好吧，接下来：我的间谍通知我，一艘米玛塔尔航空母舰昨天在同几艘艾玛达飞船的交战中受到重创，损坏程度使它不得不前往他们那个非法的维修工厂。我不知道他们是否已经有足够的时间或资源把母舰修好了，而且我也不在乎。我要你飞去那个工厂，不管你用什么方式，在这艘航空母舰有机会重返舰队前摧毁它。

只要这事不是我们的船干的，我们就能把整个事件称为是海盗造成的不幸事件之类的然后就此罢手。对吧？这会教会那些暴发狗，在我们的空间运输军队就是这个下场。不过，为了避免任何政治后果，这次谈话只有你我知道。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去处理那艘米玛塔尔飞船。由于没有充足的时间准备，那个执行任务的飞行员丢掉了飞船，勉强靠逃生舱逃生。那艘母舰仍逍遥法外。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: Are you crazy?! All the holy relics of Amash-Akura couldn't take out that mothership!
messages.zh: 你疯了吗？！所有阿玛什-阿库拉的圣迹也不能干掉那艘母舰！

messages.en:
You're giving up...? I mean, you‘re just giving up!?

Inconceivable.
messages.zh:
你放弃了？！我说，你就这么放弃了！？

真是难以置信。

{[character]player.name}，

很不幸，在我们上次会面之后的这段时间里，那艘米玛塔尔母舰已经离开了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}并重新加入了舰队。感谢你的……无所作为。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Abort mission
messages.zh: 任务中止

messages.en: Not my usual style, {[character]agentID.name}, but the money sounds good. Count me in.
messages.zh: 这并不符合我一贯的风格，{[character]agentID.name}，但价钱听上去不错。我参加。

messages.en: Glad to hear it. Glad to hear it. Go, silence them … with prejudice.
messages.zh: 很高兴听你这样说。很高兴听你这样说。去吧，让他们保持沉默……没有条件可讲。

messages.en: Oh? What is it? And what's it gonna be worth?
messages.zh: 噢？这是什么？它值多少？

messages.en:
Intelligence has discovered a number of unsolicited broadcasts washing over this constellation recently. We believe the Gallente to be the source of the signals; they've been overriding our local broadcasts and filling the airwaves with their crazy libertine, anti-establishment dogma. It may sound trivial to you, but if we don't stop these broadcasts, they're going to cause serious problems for us. Workers have started believing the trash they're hearing, and if this doesn't stop soon, we may face full-scale revolt.

I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and take these Gallente-controlled towers offline by destroying the broadcast station that controls them. Rest assured, the State will be most grateful.
messages.zh:
最近，情报部门发现了许多自发播放的广播，辐射到这块星座区域。我们相信盖伦特人是这些信号的来源；他们覆盖我们的本地广播，让电波中充斥他们疯狂的不羁主义、反权威信仰。你可能觉得这听上去是小事，但如果我们不中止这些广播，它们会给我们造成严重的问题。工人们已经开始相信他们听到的这些垃圾了，如果这事不快点解决，我们可能会面临全面的叛变。

我需要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，摧毁那座广播空间站，这样由它控制的那些盖伦特塔楼就会停止运转。放心，加达里合众国将万分感激。

messages.en: Well, they meant business ― had some pretty serious defense towers in place. Nothing I couldn't handle, though.
messages.zh: 他们是来真格的——架起了好些相当坚固的防御塔。不过，没什么是我解决不了的。

messages.en:
Excellent news, {[character]player.name}. Excellent news indeed.

Here. Don't spend it all in one place, eh?
messages.zh:
好消息，{[character]player.name}。真是好消息。

拿着。别一次都花了啊。

messages.en: Hm. Not really my style, {[character]agentID.name}, blowing up com-stations. I think I'll go see if someone else has some capital ships they need owned.
messages.zh: 嗯。{[character]agentID.name}，炸通讯空间站真不是我的风格。我想我还是去看看有没有占领旗舰级舰船的活儿吧。

messages.en: Yes, well, I suppose the security of this great State doesn't mean anything to you...? Hmm? Bloody mercenaries.
messages.zh: 好吧，我想伟大的合众国的安全对你来说毫无意义吧……？嗯？该死的雇佣兵。

messages.en:
Despite the use of jump gates for travel purposes, communication across the vast distances of space must be transmitted at the speed of light. The Amarrians were the first to master jump gate technology and thus the first to face the problem. In the end, they suspended all research, accepting the fact that FTL communications were unattainable.

Hundreds of years later, a young Gallentean woman, Li Azbel, came up with a solution that was so simple yet deeply rooted in arcane physics that it was at first rejected as a hoax. The root of the solution lay in the “EPR paradox,” a name shrouded in mystery. The EPR paradox is famous for contradicting quantum physics in some very important ways; specifically, it shows another old theory, the Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle, to be untrue.
messages.zh:
尽管跳跃门可以用于航行用途，但在广袤无垠的空间中进行的通讯必须以光速传送。艾玛人最先掌握跳跃门技术，也因此第一个面对这个问题。最终，他们停止了所有研究，接受了FTL通讯确实无法实现这一现实。

数百年后，一位年轻的盖伦特女性李·阿兹贝尔提出了一种解决方案，它是如此简单却又植根于深奥的物理学，以致于它起初被当作一种骗人的玩笑而遭到否定。这种解决方案的根本来自“EPR悖论”，一个笼罩在神秘中的名字。EPR悖论的名气在于它在许多重要方面与量子物理学相抵触；更特别的是，它指出另一个古老的定律——海森博格不确定原理是不正确的。

messages.en: Azbel Communications
messages.zh: 阿兹贝尔通讯

messages.en:
Don´t worry, my friend, you'll be suitably compensated. Here's the deal: The {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system has been somewhat unstable lately ― workers in the colonies here have been acting up and black market trading has been steadily on the rise, and as a result several lucrative contracts have been lost to the Gallente. We recently moved to quell the situation, but now we've hit upon another problem.

Intelligence has discovered a number of unsolicited broadcasts washing over this constellation recently. We believe the Gallente to be the source of the signals, trying to turn the situation to their advantage. They've been overriding our local broadcasts and filling the airwaves with their crazy libertine, anti-establishment dogma.

It may sound trivial to you, but believe me ― if we don't stop these broadcasts, they're going to cause serious problems for us. Workers have started believing the trash they're hearing, and they now believe our efforts to stabilize the region is an attempt to “keep them down,” whatever that means. We're already hearing stories of people who've been kidnapped, tortured, spied on. All totally unfounded, of course. And to add to the problems, local companies have begun grumbling about moving out of the system, and we have even had reports of small corporations accepting Gallente contracts in favor of the State's! All in all, if this doesn't stop soon, we may face full-scale revolt.

Luckily, our latest recon patrols encountered what seemed a lost convoy, which we of course intercepted; after holding the pilots for questioning, we found that they were Gallente agents involved in this whole conspiracy, and a little … gentle persuasion soon convinced them to reveal the location of the tower. However, the ships I sent to the location soon broke contact and have not yet returned. That, coupled with the fact that the broadcast array must be quite extensive given the strength of the signal, convinces me that the array must be heavily guarded.

{[character]player.name}, I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and take these towers offline by destroying the broadcast station that controls them. Rest assured, the State will be most grateful.
messages.zh:
别担心，我的朋友，你会得到相应的补偿。事情是这样的：这{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}最近，这个体系有些不稳定——这里的殖民地工人行为不端，黑市交易也日益猖獗，结果导致几份利润丰厚的合同落入了盖伦特人手中。我们最近采取措施平息了事态，但现在又遇到了另一个问题。

情报部门发现，近期有大量未经请求的广播信号涌入该星系。我们认为盖伦特人是这些信号的来源，他们试图扭转局势，使之对自己有利。他们一直在干扰我们当地的广播，用他们疯狂的、自由放任的、反建制的教条充斥着我们的广播。

这听起来可能微不足道，但相信我——如果我们不阻止这些广播，它们会给我们带来严重的问题。工人们开始相信他们听到的那些无稽之谈，他们现在认为我们为稳定该地区所做的努力是为了“打压他们”，不管这意味着什么。我们已经听到了一些人被绑架、遭受酷刑、被监视的故事。当然，这一切都毫无根据。雪上加霜的是，当地企业已经开始抱怨要退出该系统，我们甚至有报道称，一些小公司宁愿接受 Gallente 的合同，也不愿接受国家的合同！总而言之，如果这种情况再不停止，我们可能会面临全面叛乱。

幸运的是，我们最近的侦察巡逻队遇到了一支看似迷路的运输队，我们当然将其拦截；在扣押飞行员进行审问后，我们发现他们是参与整个阴谋的盖伦特特工，稍加……温和的劝说就让他们透露了塔的位置。然而，我派往该地点的船只很快就失去了联系，至今仍未返回。考虑到信号的强度，广播阵列必然非常庞大，这一点再加上其他因素，使我确信该阵列必须受到严密保护。

{[character]player.name}我需要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}通过摧毁控制这些信号塔的广播站，使这些信号塔失去工作能力。请放心，国家将对此感激不尽。

{[character]player.name}，

很不幸，雇佣兵舰船已经加强了我们刚谈到的那座位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的广播空间站的防御。在这种情况下，我认为请海军来处理此事是最慎重的决定。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: Wow, I must be in the wrong line of work. I just got my ass handed to me by a broadcast station!! Pathetic! I need to go have a shower...
messages.zh: 哇噢，我肯定是入错了行。我刚刚差点被一座广播空间站搞得丟盔卸甲！！可悲！我需要去洗个淋浴……

messages.en: Hm. Yes, pathetic. But hey, I hear they're looking for a new line cook down at J.C.'s Grill House...
messages.zh: 嗯。是的，真可悲。不过，我听说J.C.烧烤屋正在招一名新产品厨师……

{[character]player.name}，

很不幸，雇佣兵舰船已经加强了我们刚谈到的那座位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的广播空间站的防御。在这种情况下，我认为请海军来处理此事是最慎重的决定。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

name.ru: Проповедуя среди толп (Preaching to the Masses)

messages.en: Not my usual fare, but the money's good. Count me in.
messages.zh: 这不是我一贯的营生，但价钱不错。我参加。

messages.en: Very well, then. Silence them with prejudice. Glad to have you on board, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 这样很好。让他们无条件保持沉默。很高兴你跟我们一伙，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I'm {[character]player.name}. I see you've heard of me. I understand I might be of some service?
messages.zh: 我是{[character]player.name}。看来你听说过我。也许我能为你效劳？

messages.en:
I've had a lot of reports come across my desk the past few weeks about unrest in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. It turns out that there have been unsolicited broadcasts washing over this region recently, very cleverly insinuating themselves into the local media. They're having a noticeable effect in the region already, and it's only a matter of time before we get something more serious than a few weird cults popping up.

Luckily, our latest recon patrols intercepted an apparently lost convoy, and after holding the pilots for questioning, we have discovered the location of the tower. Patrols I have sent to the location have not returned, and coupled with the fact that the broadcast array must be quite extensive given the strength and reach of the signal, we can only assume that it's heavily guarded.

I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and take these towers offline by destroying the broadcast station that controls them. Rest assured, the Republic will be grateful.
messages.zh:
过去几个礼拜我桌子上堆满了报告，都是关于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的动荡。事情的真相是，最近出现了许多自发播放的广播，辐射着本区域，非常狡猾地潜入本地媒体之中。它们在本区域内已经造成了相当明显的影响，除了冒出来一些古怪的邪教组织，产生比这更严重的后果也只是时间问题。

幸运的是，我们在最近的侦察巡逻中截获了一只似乎迷航的护卫舰，在对飞行员进行拘留审问后，我们发现了广播塔的地点。但是我派去该地的巡逻队无一返回；另外，从广播信号的强度和深度看来，广播阵列的面积应该相当广大，这两点只能让我们认为，广播阵列肯定有重兵把守。

我需要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，摧毁那座广播空间站，这样由它控制的那些塔楼就会停止运转。放心，共和国将万分感激。

messages.en: It's done, {[character]agentID.name}. But somebody had set up some pretty serious hardware to protect that station. This whole thing stinks. Stinks like an Amarr privy.
messages.zh: 搞定了，{[character]agentID.name}。不过有人设置了一些相当厉害的硬件来保护那所空间站。这整件事真臭。臭得就像艾玛的茅房。

messages.en: Hm. Yes, very alarming. I'll notify Fleet Command and the Justice Department at once.
messages.zh: 嗯。是的，令人非常震惊。我会立刻通报舰队指挥部和司法部的。

messages.en: I'm in the business of crushing battleships, and you send me to deal with some measly broadcast station? No thanks, my friend.
messages.zh: 我正在做歼灭战舰的大买卖，而你却想让我去处理那不起眼的广播空间站一类的小事？不必了，谢谢，我的朋友。

messages.en: Hmph! You mercs are all the same. Ever consider that the integrity of our Republic might be at stake?! Ah, why bother...
messages.zh: 哼！你们这些雇佣兵都一样。你们考虑过我们共和国的安全可能在遭受严重威胁吗？啊……算了！
