messages.en:
{[character]player.name}! Right. I thought you looked familiar. And yes, you‘ve come to the right place.

I've had a lot of reports come across my desk the past few weeks about unrest in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. It wasn't anything too much to worry about at first, it seemed, but then several cults sprouted up, virtually overnight, that bear a discomforting similarity to the revolting religion of the Amarr. Naturally, Republic Security Services sent some people out to investigate.

It turns out that there have been unsolicited broadcasts washing over this region recently, very cleverly insinuating themselves into the local media. The subversiveness of the broadcasts is astounding: an advert changed slightly here, there a holoreel modified with very subtle textual changes.

It may sound trivial, but believe me, if we don't stop these broadcasts, they are going to cause serious problems. They're having a noticeable effect in the region already, and it's only a matter of time before we get something more serious than a few cults popping up. At the moment, it's just a few hundred susceptible minds, but the broadcast techniques are improving and we can't seem to override the signal ― they must have a relay or broadcast tower in the system that's jamming our efforts at the same time it's spamming its own signals.

Luckily, our latest recon patrols intercepted an apparently lost convoy, and after holding the pilots for questioning, we have discovered the location of the tower. Patrols I have sent to the location have not returned, and coupled with the fact that the broadcast array must be quite extensive given the strength and reach of the signal, we can only assume that it's heavily guarded.

I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and take these towers offline by destroying the broadcast station that controls them. Rest assured, the Republic will be grateful.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}！就是你。我就觉得你看起来面熟。是的，你来对地方了。

过去几个礼拜我桌子上堆满了报告，都是关于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的动荡。这事起初看上去没什么好担心的，但后来好几个邪教组织几乎一夜之间冒了出来，与恶心的艾玛宗教有着令人不快的相似点。当然，共和安全局派了人前去调查。

事情的真相是，最近出现了许多自发播放的广播，辐射着本区域，非常狡猾地潜入本地媒体之中。这些广播的颠覆性令人震惊：一会是稍加篡改的广告，一会是文本微妙变更的全息信息盘。

你可能觉得这听上去是小事，但如果我们不关掉这些广播，它们将造成严重的问题,相信我。它们在本区域内已经造成了相当明显的影响，除了冒出来一些邪教组织，产生比这更严重的后果也只是时间问题。现在，只有几百个思想易动摇的人受影响，但广播技术还在改进，我们似乎无法覆盖掉信号——他们肯定在星系里使用了一个转播或广播塔，一边破坏我们的努力，一边扩大自己的垃圾信号。

幸运的是，我们在最近的侦察巡逻中截获了一只似乎迷航的护卫舰，在对飞行员进行拘留审问后，我们发现了广播塔的地点。但是我派去该地的巡逻队无一返回；另外，从广播信号的强度和深度看来，广播阵列的面积应该相当广大，这两点只能让我们认为，广播阵列肯定有重兵把守。

我需要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，摧毁那座广播空间站，这样由它控制的那些塔楼就会停止运转。放心，共和国将万分感激。

{[character]player.name}，

很不幸，雇佣兵舰船已经加强了我们刚谈到的那座位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的广播空间站的防御。在这种情况下，我认为请共和舰队来处理此事是最慎重的决定。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: There's some heavy damned hardware out there around that station! Call in the Republic Fleet on this one; no way am I going back there.
messages.zh: 那个空间站的周围有一些该死的重型硬件保护！叫共和舰队来吧；我绝不会回去了。

messages.en: What!? You're quitting? Alright, fine, fine. I'll notify Fleet Command.
messages.zh: 什么！？你要退出？好吧，行。我会通报舰队指挥的。

{[character]player.name}，

很不幸，雇佣兵舰船已经加强了我们刚谈到的那座位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的广播空间站的防御。在这种情况下，我认为请共和舰队来处理此事是最慎重的决定。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: I'll signal my first officer to fire up my ship right now. On my way.
messages.zh: 我现在就通知大副给我的飞船点火。我上路了。

messages.en: Be careful out there, {[character]player.name}. Who knows what you're going to find.
messages.zh: 到那以后要小心，{[character]player.name}。谁知道你会发现什么呢。

messages.en: Good day, {[character]agentID.name}. I trust you've been well?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}。我想你最近过得不错吧？

messages.en:
A former slave, a member of my tribe, recently managed to escape from Amarr and make her way here to {[location]agentStationID.name}. That in itself is good news, of course, but there's bad as well. She told me she recently overheard some Amarrian officials talking about a military project at a hidden station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} ― yes, in our dominion! She doesn't know what goes on there, but its top secret.

The thing is, our scans can't find anything out of the ordinary except a couple of unlicensed jumpgates that appear to lead nowhere. Because of the lack of evidence, Republic Security won't authorize an official investigation beyond what we've already found, but I think there's more going on here than meets the eye. I need you to head out there and see what's going on. It could be that the Amarr are hiding behind some kind of cloaking array or something.

If you do happen to discover any cloaking arrays, destroy them. It may be that they're concealing the actual gate to this Amarr base we heard about, as well as the base itself. Regardless, destroy every enemy ship you see, if there's anything at all, and blow up the station if you can find it.
messages.zh:
一个曾经的劳工，我们部族的一员，最近设法逃离了艾玛，并跑到了{[location]agentStationID.name}这里。这事本身当然是个好消息，但还有坏消息。她告诉我说，她无意中听到一些艾玛的官员谈起位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个隐藏空间站内的一项军事计划——是的，就在我们的辖区里！她不知道那里正发生什么，只知道那是最高机密。

可是情况是，我们的扫描结果显示，除了一些不知通向何处的未经许可的跳跃门以外，一切正常。由于缺少证据，共和安全局不会批准正式调查我们已知的情况之外的东西，但是我认为事情绝不是表面上这么简单。我需要你前去那里查明事情真相。艾玛很可能正躲藏在隐形阵列之类的东西后面。

如果你真的发现任何隐形阵列，摧毁它们！也可能是他们隐藏了通往我们听说的那个艾玛基地的真正大门，还有那个基地本身。无论如何，如果那里真的有敌人的话，干掉你看到的每一艘敌舰；如果你能找到空间站的话，把它炸了！

messages.en: Your hunch was right, {[character]agentID.name}. They'd hidden themselves with cloaking arrays ― but I found them anyway.
messages.zh: 你猜对了，{[character]agentID.name}。他们是躲在隐形阵列后面——不过我还是找到了他们。

messages.en: Good work! Here, take this. I only wish it was more.
messages.zh: 干得好！给，拿着。我真希望多给你些。

messages.en: Uh, sounds pretty complicated, {[character]agentID.name}. I'll pass.
messages.zh: 呃，听起来很复杂，{[character]agentID.name}。我放弃。

messages.en: Yes, and vitally important. But apparently our national security doesn't mean much to you.
messages.zh: 是的，而且至关重要。但是显然，我们的国家安全对你来说无所谓。

messages.en:
Yes, fine, thanks. But I'm glad you're here: I need your help.

A former slave, a member of my tribe, recently managed to escape from Amarr and make her way here to {[location]agentStationID.name}. That in itself is good news, of course, but there's bad as well. She told me she recently overheard some Amarrian officials talking about a military project at a hidden station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} ― yes, in our dominion! She doesn't know what goes on there, but its top secret.

Because of the lack of evidence, Republic Security won't authorize an official investigation beyond what we've already found, but I think there's more going on here than meets the eye. I need you to head out there and see what's going on. It could be that the Amarr are hiding behind some kind of cloaking array or something.

If you do happen to discover any cloaking arrays, destroy them. It may be that they're concealing the actual gate to this Amarr base we heard about, as well as the base itself. Regardless, destroy every enemy ship you see, if there's anything at all, and blow up the station if you can find it.
messages.zh:
是的，很好，谢谢。但是我很高兴你来了：我需要你的帮助。

一个曾经的劳工，我们部族的一员，最近设法逃离了艾玛，并跑到了{[location]agentStationID.name}这里。这事本身当然是个好消息，但还有坏消息。她告诉我说，她无意中听到一些艾玛的官员谈起位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个隐藏空间站内的一项军事计划——是的，就在我们的辖区里！她不知道那里正发生什么，只知道那是最高机密。

可是情况是，我们的扫描结果显示，除了一些不知通向何处的未经许可的跳跃门以外，一切正常。由于缺少证据，共和安全局不会批准正式调查我们已知的情况之外的东西，但是我认为事情绝不是表面上这么简单。我需要你前去那里查明事情真相。艾玛很可能正躲藏在隐形阵列之类的东西后面。

如果你真的发现任何隐形阵列，摧毁它们！也可能是他们隐藏了通往我们听说的那个艾玛基地的真正大门，还有那个基地本身。无论如何，如果那里真的有敌人的话，干掉你看到的每一艘敌舰；如果你能找到空间站的话，把它炸了！

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员来解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛威胁。我们赢得了胜利，但是代价是惨重的人员伤亡。幸好你不是共和国唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarr station destroyed
messages.zh: 艾玛空间站被摧毁

messages.en: I've had enough of this, {[character]agentID.name}. You're going to have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我受够了，{[character]agentID.name}。你另请他人吧。

messages.en: That's ... unfortunate.
messages.zh: 那可真是……太不幸了。

由于你未能及时处理隐藏的艾玛空间站，{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的许多善良的米玛塔尔人民在艾玛军队发动的一系列行星表面突袭中被抓获。然后艾玛人立刻拆除了隐蔽基地，放弃了这个地点，但我们迟早要报仇。

至于你，我要提醒的是，不要忘了自己是哪边的，{[character]player.name}。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarr slave raid
messages.zh: 艾玛发动劳工搜捕

messages.en: Hm. Hardly seems like the Minmatar to behave this way ― they're usually a lot more straightforward ― and I don't like it. Count me in.
messages.zh: 嗯。似乎很难想象米玛塔尔会做这种事——他们一向都是非常直接的——我可不喜欢这样。我参加。

messages.en: Perfect. Reduce those defenses to scrap, along with every Minmatar scum in them. You'll be rewarded handsomely.
messages.zh: 太妙了。把这些防御设施打成碎片，连同里面的米玛塔尔渣滓一个也不要放过。你将得到优厚的奖赏。

messages.en: I'm {[character]player.name}. I  was told I should speak with you about some work? Something discreet?
messages.zh: 我是{[character]player.name}。我听说我应该就某件工作跟你谈谈，是吗？是一些需要谨慎对待的事？

messages.en:
You've heard of NMA, right? The Nefantar Mining Association? Well, an associate of mine who has some sizeable contracts with them has run into some problems. He has a small but lucrative mining concern in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that was recently taken over by some claimjumpers.

Turns out the guys who moved in are actually working for Core Complexion Inc. ― some Minmatar mining conglomerate that's in bed with the Sebiestor tribe ― and that they apparently got access to mining rights there through some loophole in some treaty. I don't know the details, and it's obviously not legit, but you've got to be careful when lawyers get involved, eh? Anyway, one of these ruffians got drunk one night and let it slip that they were sent in to get their hands on whatever valuable ore they could … I guess for building new ships. I don't know what that means, but it can't be good.

Anyway, here's the thing: Until the legal crap gets dealt with, these guys are untouchable by the authorities. Not to mention the fact that they've been working away to put up some pretty hefty defense towers around the place. But you ... you could roll on in there and just waste them, and we could pretend some pirates or freebooters had taken it on themselves to deal with the Minmatar scum.
messages.zh:
你听说过NMA，对吧？内凡达矿业协会呢？事情是这样，我的一个朋友跟NMA签有相当可观的合同，但他最近遇到了一些麻烦。他在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}拥有一个盈利颇丰的小矿场，那里最近被一些强盗接管了。

原来这些强行接管的家伙实际上是为核心局面公司工作的——那是一家米玛塔尔采矿联合企业，与赛毕斯托部族关系非常密切——显然，他们通过某个条约上的漏洞获得了那里的采矿权。我不清楚详情，但这显然是违法的，不过，一旦有律师介入，万事都要小心，不是吗？话说回来，这些流氓中的一个一天晚上喝多了，说漏了嘴，原来他们被派来尽力寻找所有珍贵的矿石……我猜大概是为了建造新舰船。我不知道那意味着什么，不过肯定不是好事。

好吧，言归正传：除非这些法律方面的破事得到处理，否则当局没法碰这些家伙。更不要提他们在那周围建了好些重型防御塔了。但是你……你可以潜入那里，把它们变成垃圾；而我们可以假称，是某些海盗或自由搜寻者主动去解决了那些米玛塔尔渣滓。

messages.en: Well, they put up a tough fight ... but not tough enough. Now, you'd mentioned a substantial reward?
messages.zh: 唔，他们顽强抵抗了一阵……不过还不够顽强。现在，你曾提到过的那笔丰厚的报酬是不是该……？

messages.en: Ah, excellent. My friend will be most pleased to hear he can move his men back into the site. And here's the reward I promised. Nice working with you.
messages.zh: 啊，太棒了。如果我的朋友得知他可以把人重新转移到矿区，他会万分欣喜的。这是我答应给你的报酬。与你合作很愉快。

messages.en: Hm. Too many political complications here for my liking. Don't you have something where I just go nuke some dumb pirates or outlaws or something??
messages.zh: 嗯。这事有太多不合我胃口的复杂政治因素。你难道没有些任务，只要让我去用核芯武器去轰炸那些笨蛋海盗或者不法分子就可以了吗？

messages.en: We live in dangerous times, {[character]player.name}, when we must take calculated risks from time to time. But suit yourself. Now if you'll excuse me...
messages.zh: 我们生活在危险的时期，{[character]player.name}，我们必须不时地做出一些计划好的冒险举动。不过，随你的便吧。请原谅，我失陪了……

messages.en: The Nefantar Miner Association is primarily a mining company, but one with a strong militaristic overtone. This is because it operates mostly in the areas between Ammatar and Minmatar space. The area has deeds and mining rights for many well-hidden, rich mineral zones, making it coveted by more or less everyone.
messages.zh: 内凡达矿业协会主要是家矿业公司，但有着强烈的军事主义色彩。这是因为它的业务活动主要在艾玛达与米玛塔尔之间的区域内进行。该地区确实拥有许多鲜为人知、蕴藏丰富的矿区，这里的采矿权成为几乎所有人觊觎的目标。

messages.en: The Nefantar Mining Association
messages.zh: 内凡达矿业协会

messages.en:
Ah, {[character]player.name}, right. Yes, I do have a matter here that requires someone of your caliber. You've heard of NMA, right? The Nefantar Mining Association? Well, an associate of mine who has some sizeable contracts with them has run into some problems.

My friend, whose name I'm afraid I'm not at liberty to reveal, has a small but lucrative mining concern in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Until now, he‘s been subcontracting NMA to do the work there for him, but recently some claimjumpers came in and started throwing their weight around, waving datacards around saying they had just bought the rights to mine there. They came in a couple of transports, sporting some pretty advanced small arms and carrying themselves like they knew how to use them, so the NMA guys played it safe and pulled out; they weren‘t armed to resist a hostile takeover of that magnitude.

Since then, a few well-spent kredits from a couple of his agents uncovered the fact that the guys who moved in are actually working for Core Complexion Inc. ― some Minmatar mining conglomerate that's in bed with the Sebiestor tribe ― and that they apparently got access to mining rights there through some loophole in some treaty. I don't know the details, and it's obviously not legit, but you've got to be careful when lawyers get involved, eh? Anyway, one of these ruffians got drunk one night and let it slip that they were sent in to get their hands on whatever valuable ore they could … I guess for building new ships. I don't know what that means, but it can't be good.

Anyway, here's the thing: Until the legal crap gets dealt with, these guys are untouchable by the authorities. Not to mention the fact that they've been working away to put up some pretty hefty defense towers around the place. But you ... you could roll on in there and just waste them, and we could pretend some pirates or freebooters had taken it on themselves to deal with the Minmatar scum. Nobody'd be the wiser. Whaddya think? The ISK is good.
messages.zh:
啊，{[character]player.name}，对了。是的，我这里确实有件事需要个像你这样有才干的人。你听说过NMA，对吧？内凡达矿业协会呢？事情是这样，我的一个朋友跟NMA签有相当可观的合同，但他最近遇到了一些麻烦。

我的朋友在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}拥有一个小型但盈利颇丰的矿场。他的名字我不便透露。一直以来，他将那里的工作转包给NMA来替他完成；但是最近，一伙强盗闯了进来，盛气凌人，挥舞着他们的数据卡，四处宣称已经购买了那里的开采权。他们乘坐着很多运输机，炫耀着一些相当先进的小武器，看他们的架势好像确实知道怎么用这些东西，所以NMA的人为了安全起见，撤出了该地区——他们的武装不足以抵挡那么强大的武力接管。

那之后，他的几个代理人好好花钱打点后发现，这些强行接管的家伙实际上是为核心局面公司工作的——那是一家米玛塔尔采矿联合企业，与赛毕斯托部族关系非常密切——显然，他们通过某个条约上的漏洞获得了那里的采矿权。我不清楚详情，但这显然是违法的，不过，一旦有律师介入，万事都要小心，不是吗？话说回来，这些流氓中的一个一天晚上喝多了，说漏了嘴，原来他们被派来尽力寻找所有珍贵的矿石……我猜大概是为了建造新舰船。我不知道那意味着什么，不过肯定不是好事。

好吧，言归正传：除非这些法律方面的破事得到处理，否则当局没法碰这些家伙。更不要提他们在那周围建了好些重型防御塔了。但是你……你可以潜入那里，把它们变成垃圾；而我们可以假称，是某些海盗或自由搜寻者主动去解决了那些米玛塔尔渣滓。谁也猜不出来。你怎么想？星币是很可观的哟。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的米玛塔尔强占特权者。幸好你不是在我们统治区域里唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Agreement expired
messages.zh: 协议过期

messages.en: Uh, you said “some defense towers.” Now, I may be wrong, but that in no way suggests a fully armed battle array, including warships!! I'm outta here.
messages.zh: 呃，你说过是“一些防御塔”。好吧，我可能理解有误，但那绝不会让人想到一个全副武装的战斗阵列，甚至还包括军舰！！ 我闪了。

messages.en: Oh, I see: When the going gets tough, the tough ... run away like a ... a ... person who's running away!? Really ... fast?? <ahem> Ooh, and screaming? Yeah, and waving your hands in the air? Like this…?
messages.zh: 哦，我明白了：当情况变得棘手的时候，那些恶棍……逃跑了？就像一个……一个普通人一样逃跑了？速度真的……很快？<啊咳> 哦，并且尖叫着？而且，双手还在空中挥舞？就像这样……？

messages.en:
Because of your failure to deal with the Minmatar claimjumpers in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, as you had agreed to do, the asteroid field there has been depleted entirely. Who knows what the thieves stole from NMA, and to what end?

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
由于你有失承诺，未妥善处理{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的米玛塔尔强占特权者，那里的小行星矿藏已经完全枯竭了。谁知道那些乱序者从NMA拿走了什么，用于什么目的呢？

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Thieves escaped
messages.zh: 乱序者逃脱

messages.en: Hm. Hardly seems like those Gallente pansies to push like this ― and I don't like it. Somebody needs to put them back in their place. Somebody like me.
messages.zh: 嗯。似乎很难想象盖伦特会做这种事——我可不喜欢这样。看来需要有人来让他们安分些。像我这样的人正合所需。

messages.en: Perfect. Take those Gallente defenses apart and you'll be rewarded handsomely.
messages.zh: 太妙了。把这些盖伦特的防御设施打成碎片，你将得到优厚的奖赏。

messages.en: I'm {[character]player.name}. I  heard I should talk to you about some ... er, work?
messages.zh: 我是{[character]player.name}，有人让我来和你谈一下有关工作的事情。是这样的吗？

messages.en:
You've heard of Minedrill, right? Big mining corporation, tied to the Caldari Navy? Well, an associate of mine has a lucrative mining concern subcontracted out to Minedrill in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. But recently some claimjumpers came in, waving datacards around saying they had the real rights to mine there. They came in a couple of transports, guarded by a bunch of assault frigates, so the Minedrill guys played it safe and pulled out; they weren‘t armed to resist a hostile takeover like that.

We managed to question one of the claimjumpers, and we found out that they are actually working for Astral Mining Inc. ― you know, that Gallente mining conglomerate that's in bed with CreoDron? They apparently got access to mining rights there through some legal sleight of hand. I don't know the details, and I don't care. It's not legit, far as I'm concerned, and the megacorps won't care one way or another as long as this problem just goes away.

Anyway, here's the thing: These Gallente crooks have been working away putting up some pretty hefty defense towers around the place, and since the Navy can't really get involved, we need a privateer like yourself who really knows starship combat. You can just warp on in there and waste them, and all we say is that some pirates took it on themselves to destroy the operation out there. Whaddya think?
messages.zh:
你听说过矿钻集团，对吧？这是个加达里海军旗下的大型矿业公司。事情是这样，我的一个朋友在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}将一份利润丰厚的合同转包给了矿钻集团。但是最近，一伙强盗闯了进来，盛气凌人，挥舞着他们的数据卡，四处宣称已经购买了那里的开采权。他们乘坐着很多运输机，有突击护卫舰护航，所以矿钻集团的人为了安全起见，撤出了该地区——他们的武装不足以抵挡那么强大的暴力侵袭。

后来我们想尽办法，从其中一位强盗口中得知这些强行接管的家伙实际上是为星形矿业工作的——那是一家盖伦特采矿联合企业，与西顿工业关系非常密切。显然，他们通过某个条约上的漏洞获得了那里的采矿权。我不清楚详情，也不想去弄清楚。反正我认为他们这样做是不合法的，而且那些大财团也不会追究其中细节，只要这问题能被搞定就行。

好吧，言归正传：盖伦特人那周围建了好些重型防御塔了。但由于我们不能让海军参与此事，我们需要像你这样知道如何驾驶飞船战斗的人。你只要跃迁到那儿，把他们都消灭就行。而我们可以假称，是某些海盗或自由搜寻者干的。怎么样，愿意干吗？

messages.en: All in an hour's work. Heh. Now, you'd mentioned a reward?
messages.zh: 一小时内都完成了！你现在一定在等奖励了吧？

messages.en: Wonderful! My friend will be most pleased to hear he can move his men back into the site. Here's the reward I promised.
messages.zh: 好极了！如果我的朋友得知他可以把人重新转移到矿区，他会万分欣喜的。这是我答应给你的报酬。

messages.en: Hm. Sounds risky. Don't you have something where I just shuttle some freight around for a huge profit or something??
messages.zh: 嗯。听上去挺危险的。难道你没什么让我运送点东西，而且能赚不少钱的活儿吗？

messages.en: You're snuffling up the wrong vlutar, {[character]player.name}. I have more important things to do, if you don't mind.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你找错对象哭诉了。我有更重要的事要干。

messages.en: Minedrill traces its history back to the Great Caldari-Gallente War. Founded as a special forces unit within the Caldari Navy that rigged asteroids with explosives and used them as booby traps, it became a civilian corporation several years after the war ended ― though it maintains to this day a close affiliation with the Navy. The company's personnel, even today remaining largely ex-military, have used their special knowledge to gain prominence within the mining industry.
messages.zh: 矿钻集团的历史可以追溯到加达里－盖伦特大战的时候。起初，矿钻集团是加达里海军下属的一个特种部队，在小行星带进行爆破，并以此作为陷阱。战争结束几年后，矿业集团成了民营公司，不过至今为止该集团仍和加达里海军保持着良好的关系。这个公司里的大多数雇员以前都曾在军队服役，他们利用自己的专长在采矿工业中取得了优势地位。

messages.en: The Minedrill Corporation
messages.zh: 矿钻集团

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的盖伦特强强盗。幸好你不是我们统治区域里唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Agreement expired
messages.zh: 协议过期

messages.en: There's no way the reward you offered will cover my expenses for a single week! This mission stinks.
messages.zh: 你给的这点奖励根本抵不上我一周的开支。这个任务太烂了。

messages.en: Ah. And you're quitting doesn't have anything to do with the fact that you're a coward, I suppose?
messages.zh: 啊。你不愿意接受这个任务，大概不会是因为你是个懦夫吧？

messages.en:
Because of your failure to deal with the Gallente claimjumpers in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, as you had agreed to do, the asteroid field there has been depleted entirely. Who knows what technology the thieves stole from Minedrill, and to what end?

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
由于你有失承诺，没有把{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的盖伦特强盗消灭掉，那里的小行星矿藏已经完全枯竭了。谁知道那些乱序者从矿钻集团拿走了什么技术，用于什么目的呢？

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Thieves escaped
messages.zh: 乱序者逃脱

name.ja: 鉱山労働者を解放せよ

messages.en: Those damned capitalist Caldari pigs! I'm in. And while I appreciate the reward, this one's personal.
messages.zh: 该死的资本家！该死的加达里猪！我干了。虽然奖励很诱人，但这次是出于个人原因。

messages.en: That's the spirit. I'm glad you came by ― I don't know what we'd have done.
messages.zh: 要的就是这种精神！很高兴你来了——否则我真不知道我们要做什么傻事了。

messages.en: I'm told {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} might have some work for me?
messages.zh: 我听说{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}可能有些活儿给我干？

messages.en:
You've heard of Kaalakiota, right? Well, an associate of mine who has some rather sizeable mining contracts around here has run into some problems with them. Kaalakiota owns a mining concern in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} ― a relic of some conciliatory treaty made following the Great War ― and my friend‘s company was contracted by KK to do the work there for them.

Well, now things there have gotten entirely out of hand. A number of workers went missing in the past few weeks, supposedly sent off to “work elsewhere,” and the Caldari have set up a bunch of powerful sentry towers. We've lost contact with the operation altogether now, and industrial ships have been seen flying in and out of the compound constantly. Rumors have even indicated that those convoys have been heading into Amarr space, making the fate of those missing workers a matter of profound concern.

Anyway, Kaalakiota refuses to comment, and since the Federation Navy can't really get involved because of the treaty, we need a free agent like yourself, someone who really knows starship combat. We need you to go in there and destroy the Caldari defenses so we can send in some personnel transports to get those workers out!
messages.zh:
你听说过卡拉吉塔，对吧？事情是这样：我的一个朋友在附近握有相当可观的采矿合同，他最近和卡拉吉塔的家伙们起了麻烦。卡拉吉塔在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}拥有一个矿场——大战后某个调停合约的产物——而我朋友的公司就是与KK签约，在那里为他们工作的。

唔，可现在那里的情况已经完全失去控制。在过去的几个星期里，大量工人失踪了，据说是被送往“其它地方工作”了。而加达里方面则设置了大批强力哨塔。我们现在已经与那里的业务完全失去了联系，只看到工业舰船不断飞进飞出那个矿场。传言说那些护卫舰是飞往艾玛空间的，这使得那些失踪工人的命运极其令人担忧。

事到如今，卡拉吉塔拒绝发表任何评论。而由于条约，联邦海军无法真正介入。所以我们需要一个像你这样的自由特工，一个真正懂得星际舰船战斗的人。我们需要你前往那里，摧毁加达里的防御设施，这样我们就可以派几艘人员运输船去把那些工人带回来。"

messages.en: All taken care of, {[character]agentID.name}. And while I'd like to say “keep the reward,” it does take a lot of ISK to keep a ship spaceworthy…
messages.zh: 全都搞定了，{[character]agentID.name}。尽管我想说“收起你的奖励吧”，可是要让我的飞船经得起太空作业也确实需要大笔的星币……

messages.en: Understood, {[character]player.name}. Of course you do. You've done democracy a great service this day.
messages.zh: 明白，{[character]player.name}。你当然需要。你今天为民主办了一件大事。

messages.en: Are you sure this is a good idea? No, sorry, I can't afford the headaches this kind of political action would cause. Sorry.
messages.zh: 你确定这是个好主意？不了，抱歉，我可受不了这种政治行动可能造成的麻烦。抱歉。

messages.en: I'm sorry to hear that, {[character]player.name}.  And here I thought the plight of those poor workers would be incentive enough in itself...
messages.zh: 很遗憾听你这么说，{[character]player.name}。我本来认为那些可怜的工人的困境本身已经足够成为你的动力了……

messages.en: Kaalakiota is the largest of the Caldari mega-corporations, most often referred to as the KK, with its fingers in most everything ― manufacturing, distribution, retail, and research, as well as politics. Its greatest rival within the Caldari State, in both business and politics, is the Sukuuvestaa Corporation (which in turn is closely allied with the Nugoeihuvi Corporation). Like all of the Caldari megacorps, save perhaps Ishukone, Kaalakiota is infamous for treating its working-class employees as little better than slaves.
messages.zh: 卡拉吉塔是加达里最大的超级集团，通常被称为KK。它几乎涉足所有领域——生产、分销、零售、科研，还有政治。在商业和政治方面，它在加达里合众国内最大的竞争对手是斯库维塔集团(为了与卡拉吉塔抗衡，与纳基维集团结成同盟)。像所有的加达里超级集团一样(可能异株湖除外)，卡拉吉塔对待工人阶层的雇员就比劳工好一点点，这使它声名狼藉。

messages.en: Kaalakiota
messages.zh: 卡拉吉塔

messages.en:
Well, I suspect we do, yes. But you're {[character]player.name}, aren't you? How fortuitous. Actually, at the moment, I have a private matter here that requires someone of your caliber.

You've heard of Kaalakiota, right? Of course you have. Who hasn't? Well, an associate of mine who has some rather sizeable mining contracts around here has run into some problems with them. Kaalakiota owns a mining concern in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} ― a relic of some conciliatory treaty made following the Great War ― and my friend‘s company was contracted by KK to do the work there for them. However, the workers there, mostly locals and all good people, started issuing formal complaints almost at once about their treatment at the hands of the KK foremen.

Well, now things there have gotten entirely out of hand. A number of workers went missing entirely in the past few weeks, supposedly sent off to “work elsewhere,” and the Caldari have set up a bunch of powerful sentry towers, turning the place into something more like a military base than a mining operation. We've lost contact with the operation altogether now, and industrial ships have been seen flying in and out of the compound at a much higher rate than the amount of mining there would suggest being necessary. Rumors have even indicated that those convoys have been heading into Amarr space, making the fate of those missing workers a matter of profound concern.

Anyway, Kaalakiota refuses to comment, and since the Federation Navy can't really get involved because of the treaty, we need a free agent like yourself, someone who really knows starship combat. We need you to go in there and destroy the Caldari defenses so we can send in some personnel transports to get those workers out! You'll be rewarded generously, of course.
messages.zh:
嗯，我想我们有，没错。你不是{[character]player.name}吗？多巧啊。事实上，我手头正有件私活需要你这样有才干的人。

你听说过卡拉吉塔，对吧？你当然听说过。谁会没听说过呢？事情是这样：我的一个朋友在附近握有相当可观的采矿合同，他最近和卡拉吉塔的家伙们起了麻烦。卡拉吉塔在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}拥有一个矿场——大战后某个调停合约的产物——而我朋友的公司就是与KK签约，在那里为他们工作的。然而，那里的工人大多是本地人而且都是好人，几乎同时正式控诉在KK工头手下他们所遭受的待遇。

唔，可现在那里的情况已经完全失去控制。在过去的几个星期里，大量工人完全失踪了，据说是被送往“其它地方工作”了。而加达里方面则设置了大批强力哨塔，把那地方变得更像是一个军事基地，而非采矿工厂。我们现在已经与那里的业务完全失去了联系，只看到工业舰船不断飞进飞出那个矿场，它们进出的频率远远高出采矿业务所需。传言说那些护卫舰是飞往艾玛空间的，这使得那些失踪工人的命运极其令人担忧。

事到如今，卡拉吉塔拒绝发表任何评论。而由于条约，联邦海军无法真正介入。所以我们需要一个像你这样的自由特工，一个真正懂得星际舰船战斗的人。我们需要你前往那里，摧毁加达里的防御设施，这样我们就可以派几艘人员运输船去把那些工人带回来。当然，你将得到可观的回报。"

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的状况。幸好你不是在我们统治区域唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Agreement expired
messages.zh: 协议过期

messages.en: I'm afraid you're going to have to come up with another plan. Those defenses are too tough.
messages.zh: 恐怕你得另做打算。那些防御设施太强大了。

messages.en: Dammit! And what happens to those poor workers now!?
messages.zh: 该死！那些可怜的工人现在怎么样了！？

messages.en:
Because of your failure to deal with the Caldari slavemasters in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, as you had agreed to do, the asteroid field there has been depleted entirely and the entire complement of workers has vanished. Who knows what has really happened there, and to what end?

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
由于你有失承诺，未妥善处理{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的加达里劳工主，那里的小行星矿藏已经完全枯竭了，所有的工人也都消失了。谁知道那里真正发生了什么，造成了什么结果呢？

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Caldari escaped
messages.zh: 加达里逃脱

name.ja: 鉱山労働者を解放せよ

messages.en: I'll be there before you can pour yourself a cup of Quafe, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我会尽快到那里的，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Good. I'm glad you came in just now ― I don't know what we'd have done otherwise.
messages.zh: 好的。你能来太好了，不然我们都不知道要做什么了。

messages.en: I'm told you might have some work for me?
messages.zh: 你有任务要交给我？

messages.en:
An associate of mine owns a mining concern in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and a few months ago he contracted a small, private mining sompany to do the work there. However, we have just discovered that the company he hired is secretly run by the Amarrians. Unbelievable, I know, but those Scripture-spouting lunatics are cunning.

Well, things there in the past 24 hours have very quickly gone downhill. Knowing the jig is up, the Amarrians behind the whole thing sent in a task force of ships and supplies, and they've set up a bunch of powerful sentry towers, turning the place into a labor camp so they can strip the place and flee before the military can be called in to deal with them. No doubt taking all the laborers with them at gunpoint to be made into slaves when they return. Cunning bastards.

Since the navy likely won't be able to rally a response soon enough, we desperately need someone like you, who knows starship combat. We need you to go in there and destroy the Amarrian forces so we can send in some personnel transports to get those workers out!
messages.zh:
事情是这样：我的一个朋友在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}拥有一个矿场，几个月前他签约了一家小型的私人矿产公司，在那里为他们工作。然而，我们发现他雇用的这家公司其实是由艾玛人暗箱操控着。真不可思议，那群口吐经文的疯子太狡猾了。

好了，消息在前24小时里已经传到了山下。获得情报的幕后主使艾玛人派出了一大批军事力量和供给，他们还建造了一连串的超强岗哨塔，将阵营变成了一个劳工营地，这样他们就能在军队前来攻击他们时迅速撤离。无疑还会带上所有的劳工，万不得已在敌人返回的时候，还可以装扮成劳工。他们真是诡计多端。

由于海军无法及时给出回应，所以我们非常需要一个像你这样的人，一个真正懂得星际舰船战斗的人。我们需要你前往那里，摧毁艾玛部队，这样我们就可以派几艘人员运输船去把那些工人带回来。

messages.en: Those Amarr swine are dead, every last one. Gods, I love the smell of thermoplasm in the morning!
messages.zh: 那些艾玛猪都死了，一个都没留下。好喜欢在清晨闻着留有余温的血腥味！

messages.en: I knew we could count on you; thanks to Hela that you're on our side. I can only hope this reward is sufficient.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，感谢赫拉，让你和我们并肩作战。希望报酬能令你满意。

messages.en: This force of theirs is intended to withstand a Fleet counterattack for long enough that they can escape? And you want me to go in there? Uh ... no.
messages.zh: 他们准备不停抵抗舰队的反击，来争取时间逃跑？而且你要我去那里？呃……不行。

messages.en: Black-hearted coward!!
messages.zh: 黑心的胆小鬼！

messages.en:
Religion is of great importance to every Amarrian ― at least in public, if not in private. This fervor has at various times been the cause of both great good and great evil, as has religion in every age of humankind.

Shortly after recovering from the closure of EVE, millennia ago, the Amarrians began to expand their realm and colonize other planets and, eventually, constellations. The worlds they conquered were enslaved, a practice justified by the Amarr Scriptures. Ever since, the Amarrians have attempted to enslave every nation and race they have encountered, and slavery remains an essential part of Amarr society. This practice has, of course, tainted their relations with other races.
messages.zh:
宗教对每个艾玛人都具有重大意义，至少在公众层面如此，私下就难说了。这种热情在不同时期既导致了大善，也造成了大恶——就像宗教在人类每个历史时期所发挥的作用一样。

数千年前，在从新伊甸的封闭中恢复后不久，艾玛人开始了他们的领土扩张，在其他行星设立殖民地，最终他们的殖民范围扩大到许多星座的范围。他们使被征服的世界的人们沦为劳工，这是艾玛圣典中允许的。从此以后，艾玛人试图奴役他们遇见的每一个国家和民族，劳工制成为艾玛社会的一项关键组成部分。毫无疑问，这种做法破坏了他们同其他种族的关系。

messages.en: Slavery and the Amarr Mindset
messages.zh: 劳工制和艾玛心理

messages.en:
Ah, straight to the point. Good. Wait ... you're {[character]player.name}, aren't you? Perfect. At the moment, I have a matter here that requires someone of your ability.

An associate of mine owns a mining concern in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and a few months ago he contracted a small, private mining sompany to do the work there. However, we have just discovered that the company he hired is secretly run by the Amarrians. Unbelievable, I know, but those Scripture-spouting lunatics are cunning.

Well, things there in the past 24 hours have very quickly gone downhill. Knowing the jig is up, the Amarrians behind the whole thing sent in a big task force of ships and supplies, and they've set up a bunch of powerful sentry towers, turning the place into a labor camp so they can strip the place and flee before the military can be called in to deal with them. No doubt taking all the laborers with them, at z-stick-point, to be made into slaves when they return. Cunning bastards.

Since the navy likely won't be able to rally a response soon enough, we desperately need someone like you, who knows starship combat. We need you to go in there and destroy the Amarrian forces so we can send in some personnel transports to get those workers out!
messages.zh:
好，那直接切入主题。等等，你是 {[character]player.name}，是吗？很好。我现在有个任务，就需要像你这样有能力的人。

事情是这样：我的一个朋友在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}拥有一个矿场，几个月前他签约了一家小型的私人矿产公司，在那里为他们工作。然而，我们发现他雇用的这家公司其实是由艾玛人暗箱操控着。真不可思议，那群口吐经文的疯子太狡猾了。

好了，消息在前24小时里已经传到了山下。获得情报的幕后主使艾玛人派出了一大批军事力量和供给，他们还建造了一连串的超强岗哨塔，将阵营变成了一个劳工营地，这样他们就能在军队前来攻击他们时迅速撤离。无疑还会带上所有的劳工，万不得已在敌人返回的时候，还可以装扮成劳工。他们真是诡计多端。

由于海军无法及时给出回应，所以我们非常需要一个像你这样的人，一个真正懂得星际舰船战斗的人。我们需要你前往那里，摧毁艾玛部队，这样我们就可以派几艘人员运输船去把那些工人带回来。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的状况，已经有不少人因为延误而丧生了。 幸运的是，你不是我们主权空间里唯一能干的飞行员。不幸的是，竟然有你这个人在我们主权空间工作。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Agreement expired
messages.zh: 协议过期

messages.en: I'm afraid you're going to have to hope a Fleet response can be mounted in time. I couldn't stand against them.
messages.zh: 我恐怕你只能期盼舰队能够准时给与回应了。我可挡不住他们。

messages.en: Dammit, {[character]player.name}! What happens to those poor workers now!? Argh!!
messages.zh: 该死，{[character]player.name}！那些可怜的工人现在怎么样了！？啊！！

由于你的失误，没有干掉{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛人，那里的小行星矿藏已经完全枯竭了，所有的工人也都消失了。你要我怎么向他们的家人交代！！？希望你明天对着镜子好好看看自己，反省一下，{[character]player.name}。

不，你还是别去看你那张脸了。

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: The Amarr have escaped
messages.zh: 艾玛人逃脱了

messages.en: Is there no end to the audacity of these slaves?! If there is any truth to this secret base, I will find it and crush it.
messages.zh: 这些劳工们真是越来越得寸进尺了？！如果让我查到这个隐秘基地的任何可靠消息，我一定把它彻底摧毁。

messages.en: Be careful out there, {[character]player.name}. God be with you.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，一切小心行事。上帝与你同在！

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]agentID.name}. I understand there's a sensitive matter you need help with?
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]agentID.name}。我想你这里有个棘手任务需要帮忙吧？

messages.en:
Intelligence recently intercepted a message sent by a known Minmatar spy mentioning a “military project” of theirs at a hidden station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} ― yes, well within our sovereign space! We have no other information, but naturally the location of this place must be top secret.

The thing is, our scans and recon ships can't find anything out of the ordinary except a couple of unlicensed jump gates that appear to lead nowhere. Internal Security won't authorize any further official investigation, calling the whole affair a wild goose chase, but I think there's more to it. I need you to head out there and see what's going on. It could be that the Minmatar are hiding behind some kind of cloaking array or something.

If you do happen to discover any such arrays, destroy them. It may be that they're concealing the actual gate to this secret base we heard about, as well as the base itself. Regardless, destroy every enemy ship you see, assuming there's anything at all there, and destroy the station if you do find it.
messages.zh:
最近得到一个米玛塔尔间谍的情报，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}可能有个米玛塔尔的军事项目—是的，在我们的领空内。我们目前还没有其它相关信息，但是我不想冒险。

我们的扫描仪和侦察舰在那个地区除了几个不正规的跳跃星门什么都没有找到。内部安全局已不会再派遣官方人员对此事作进一步调查，但直觉告诉我，我们应该深入查下去。所以，我希望派你去那里查一下。我想那里的米玛塔尔人可能使用了隐形阵列之类的东西。

如果你正好发现了这些，就将他们摧毁掉。很可能这些人有意隐藏了通往这个隐秘基地的星门。反正你见到多少敌人就把他们都干掉，当然，如果你发现了空间站，也一并将它摧毁。

messages.en: It is finished, {[character]agentID.name}, station destroyed. These Minmatar are getting very cagey, though. Cloaking arrays? Sounds more like a Gallente tactic to me.
messages.zh: 搞定了，{[character]agentID.name}，空间站已被摧毁。不过这些米玛塔尔人真是越来越狡猾了。隐形阵列？这听上去更像是盖伦特人擅用的伎俩。

messages.en: Bless you! Yes, good point. By God, when will these slave races learn their place?!
messages.zh: 祝你好运！对，说得好。真不知道这些劳工什么时候才能有些自知之明？！

messages.en: Sounds a bit dull, actually. I'm more of a straightforward “pewpew” kind of captain. So, um, no thanks.
messages.zh: 说实话，听上去很无聊。我是喜欢直来直往的人。所以，嗯，不了，谢谢。

messages.en: I truly wonder... I wonder, “How would being cloned as often as a capsuleer affect one's IQ?” That's what I wonder.
messages.zh: 我真的搞不懂……我想知道，“多次自我克隆怎么会影响智商呢？”我真搞不懂。

messages.en:
Yes, there is. Forgive my abruptness, but this is an urgent matter. Let's get straight to it.

Intelligence recently intercepted a message sent by a known Minmatar spy mentioning a “military project” of theirs at a hidden station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} ― yes, well within our sovereign space! We have no other information, but naturally the location of this place must be top secret.

The thing is, our scans and recon ships can't find anything out of the ordinary in the system except a couple of unlicensed jump gates that appear to lead nowhere. Internal Security won't authorize any further official investigation, calling the whole affair a wild goose chase, but I think there's more to it. I need you to head out there and see what's going on. It could be that the Minmatar are hiding behind some kind of cloaking array or something.

If you do happen to discover any such arrays, destroy them. It may be that they're concealing the actual gate to this secret base we heard about, as well as the base itself. Regardless, destroy every enemy ship you see, assuming there's anything at all there, and destroy the station if you do find it.
messages.zh:
是的，请原谅我的唐突，但真有个紧急的事情。让我们开门见山地说吧。

我们的扫描仪和侦察舰在那个地区除了几个不正规的跳跃星门什么都没有找到。内部安全局已不会再派遣官方人员对此事作进一步调查，但直觉告诉我，我们应该深入查下去。所以，我希望派你去那里查一下。我想那里的米玛塔尔人可能使用了隐形阵列之类的东西。

如果你正好发现了这些，就将他们摧毁掉。很可能这些人有意隐藏了通往这个隐秘基地的星门。反正你见到多少敌人就把他们都干掉，当然，如果你发现了空间站，也一并将它摧毁。

{[character]player.name}，

然后由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员来解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}玛塔尔的威胁。我们赢得了胜利，但是代价是惨重的人员伤亡。幸好你不是帝国唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar station destroyed
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔空间站被摧毁

messages.en: This assignment smells worse than a week-dead fedo, {[character]agentID.name}. I quit.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，这个任务听上去很差劲。我退出。

messages.en: And the possibility of Minmatar resistance means nothing to you?? Be on your way, pilot.
messages.zh: 我想米玛塔尔人的反抗对你来说应该是小菜一碟吧？上路吧！

由于你未能及时处理隐藏的米玛塔尔空间站，许多重要的军事文件被他们突袭时拿走了。此后，米玛塔尔人立刻拆除了隐蔽基地，放弃了这个地点。

至于你，我要提醒的是，不要忘了自己是哪边的，{[character]player.name}。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar surprise attack
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔突袭

messages.en: Secret Gallente base, eh? Alright, I'll have a look around.
messages.zh: 隐秘的盖伦特基地？好吧，我去看一看。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. Be careful out there ― if there really is a base, it's bound to be well guarded.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，谢谢！小心行事，如果那儿真有个基地，那肯定是守卫森严的。

messages.en:
Oh, whoa, sorry. I'll give you a sec... ahem. All set?

Right, okay, so, yeah, I understand there's a sensitive matter you need some help with? I mean, another sensitive matter? You seemed to have that one well in hand.
messages.zh:
噢，不好意思。我先给你一点时间……准备好了？

行，好吧，嗯，是这样的，我想你这里有些敏感的事情需要帮忙吧？我是说，别的敏感的事情？你手头好像已经有那桩事情了。

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} recently uncovered some intelligence about a supposed secret Gallente “military installment” in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We have no other information, but I don't want to take any chances.

The thing is, our scans and recon patrols can't find anything out of the ordinary there except a couple of unlicensed jump gates that appear to lead nowhere. I can't authorize the expense of any further official investigation without more to go on, but my gut tells me we need to look into this further. I want you to head out there and check things out. It could be that these Gallente, if they exist, are using some kind of cloaking array or something.

If you do happen to discover any such arrays, destroy them. It may be that they're concealing the actual gate to this secret base we heard about, as well as the base itself. Regardless, destroy every enemy ship you see, assuming there's anything at all there, and destroy the station too if you do find it.

messages.en: There was a base out there, {[character]agentID.name}, but I've destroyed it. Pretty daring of them to try something like this.
messages.zh: 那儿曾经有一个基地，{[character]agentID.name}，但我已经把它给毁了。他们敢这样做，胆子也太大了。

messages.en: It certainly is. We shall have to be much more careful with our system scanning in the future.
messages.zh: 肯定是。我们以后进行星系扫描时应该更加仔细。

messages.en: Mmm ... no. No thanks.
messages.zh: 不，谢谢！

messages.en: Okay. Listen, I hope this doesn't have anything to do with ... you know, when you came in?
messages.zh: 好的。听着，我希望这事和你当初……呃，就是你刚来的时候，应该没有什么关系吧？

messages.en:
Yes, errr ...yes, there is. Forgive me, but this really is an urgent matter. So let's get to it. Er... to business, I mean.

Right. Okay, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} recently uncovered some intelligence about a supposed secret Gallente “military installment” in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We have no other information, but I don't want to take any chances.

是的。请原谅我的唐突，但我真的是有紧急事情。我说的是公事。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Due to your lack of response, I was forced to find another capsuleer to search for the secret base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Unfortunately, her ship was ambushed by several cloaked Gallente assault cruisers and she was podded in the ensuing firefight. Their base has since been dismantled and the location is now abandoned.

War is brewing, {[character]player.name}. Which side are you on?

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另找一名飞行员来搜寻{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}里隐藏的一个军事基地。然而，她很不幸被几艘盖伦特隐形突击舰伏击。之后他们就拆除了基地，放弃了该地点。

战争一触即发，{[character]player.name}。你会选择站在哪一边？

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Caldari agent pod-killed
messages.zh: 加达里代理人被爆蛋了

messages.en: This job is a waste of my time. I'm leaving.
messages.zh: 这事完全是浪费我的时间。我走了。

messages.en: But, I thought we had a deal?!
messages.zh: 但我想我们还有事要做吧？

messages.en:
We‘ve found that there was indeed a hidden Gallente base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, but apparently it was dismantled very recently and the location is now abandoned.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
我们发现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的确有个盖伦特的隐秘基地，但很明显它最近被拆除了。

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Gallente station abandoned
messages.zh: 盖伦特空间站被遗弃

messages.en: A secret base, eh? Damned Caldari! Alright, I'll go have a look around.
messages.zh: 一个秘密基地？该死的加达里！好吧，我去看一看。

messages.en: Good. Be careful out there ― if there really is a base, it's sure to be well protected.
messages.zh: 好的。小心行事，如果那儿真有个基地，一定守卫森严。

messages.en: I'm told there's an unusual matter you need some help with, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，我听说你有个棘手的事情需要帮忙，是吗？

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} recently received some intelligence about a supposed secret Caldari “military installment” in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We have no other information, I'm afraid, but I don't want to take any chances. I can't authorize of any further official investigation without more evidence, but I have a hunch that we need to be careful here.

I want you check the place out. It could be that this Caldari base, if it really exists, is using some kind of cloaking device or something to stay hidden. If you do happen to discover any cloaking arrays, destroy them. They might be concealing the gate to this secret base, as well as the base itself. You are authorized to destroy any enemy ship you see, assuming there's anything at all there, and to destroy the station if you find it.

messages.en: Your hunch was right, {[character]agentID.name}. Good call. There was a base out there. So what the hell does this mean, I wonder?
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，你的直觉是正确的。说的对。那儿曾经有一个基地。我想知道这是什么意思呢？

messages.en: Yes, it's all very troubling. We shall have to be much more careful, I fear, we Gallente.
messages.zh: 是的，真是非常烦人。恐怕我们盖伦特人要多加小心了。

messages.en: I can't risk my ship when I don't know what might be out there. Hope you understand.
messages.zh: 如果我不清楚那里的状况，我是不会贸然行事的。希望你理解。

messages.en: I understand completely, {[character]player.name}. But I think the time is near when we shall all have to fight if we value democracy, despite the risks.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我完全理解你的想法。但我想我们已经不能再等了，如果我们还珍惜民主，就应该立即采取行动。

messages.en:
Yes, there is, in fact. Forgive me, but this really is quite urgent, I think. So let's get right to business.

{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} recently received some intelligence about a supposed secret Caldari “military installment” in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We have no other information, I'm afraid, but I don't want to take any chances. {[character]player.name},

{[character]agentID.name}

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Gallente agent podded
messages.zh: 盖伦特代理人被爆蛋了。

messages.en: This is a fool's errand. I'm done.
messages.zh: 这任务根本没法完成。我不干了。

messages.en: But I thought we had a deal!!
messages.zh: 但我想我们还有事要做。

messages.en:
A determined young capsuleer has reported that there was indeed a hidden Caldari base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, but apparently it was dismantled very recently and the location is now abandoned. You are discharged of your duty in this matter.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
一名年轻有毅力的飞行员报告，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的确有个加达里隐秘基地，但很明显那里不久前被拆除，现在已经被遗弃了。你不再需要负责此事。

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: I'm on it, {[character]agentID.name}. I'll be back before you know it.
messages.zh: 我这就去干，{[character]agentID.name}。我会在你没缓过神来前就回来。

messages.en: Excellent. My thanks. Do be careful out there ― we have no idea what we're dealing with, really.
messages.zh: 很好。非常感谢。到那里千万要小心——我们压根不知道我们要对付的是什么，真的。

messages.en: Good day, {[character]agentID.name}. You have anything for me?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}。你有什么事让我做吗？

messages.en:
We've been picking up strange distress signals coming from the site of an old starship battle in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It's possible, though unlikely, that there were some survivors aboard one of those wrecked ships and that they've just recently been able to repair their communications systems enough to send out distress signals.

What's more likely, though, is that some explorers or salvage workers got trapped out there, or maybe even that some pirates have set up this phony distress call to lure unsuspecting rescuers out there to their doom. In any case, I want it checked out, just in case there are actually some of our people still out there. Because of the potential danger, though, I'm only willing to send one of our best, most capable pilots out there. And that means you.

Go on out there and see what's causing this signal. You'll be handsomely rewarded for your efforts.
messages.zh:
我们最近一直收到来自{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的某个星际飞船战斗旧址的奇怪求救信号。虽然不确定，但可能一艘飞船残骸上还有幸存者，他们最近勉强修复了通讯系统，使之能够发出求救信号。

不过更可能的情况是一些探险者或者打捞人员被困在那里，甚至可能是一些海盗发出假信号来引诱毫无防备的救助人员去那里，以把他们一网打尽。无论是哪种情况，我都要确认清楚，以防那里真的还有我们的人。然而由于存在潜在的危险，我只想派一名我们最出色、最能干的飞行员去那里。而这个人就是你。

去那里吧，看看信号到底是谁发出来的。你的努力将得到丰厚的奖赏。

messages.en: It was a trap, {[character]agentID.name}. The ships were Minmatar, and they seemed to know I'd be there.
messages.zh: 那是个圈套，{[character]agentID.name}。那些船是米玛塔尔的，他们好像知道我要去。

messages.en: Remarkable! Something strange is going on here. Let me see what I can dig up, and then maybe we can take the fight to them.
messages.zh: 了不起！这事肯定有古怪。让我看看能挖出什么线索，然后也许我们可以跟他们干一仗。

messages.en: Sounds like work for a rookie, as far as I'm concerned. A distress signal? No thanks. Give me some pirates to fight, maybe, or some Minmatar or Gallente!
messages.zh: 就我而言，这工作听上去像是给新手的。一个求救信号？不了，谢谢。还是给我些海盗打打吧，或者打些米玛塔尔人或者盖伦特人也好。

messages.en: Yes, well, maybe you are a little more suited to tackling dreadnoughts in that ship of yours, but hey, the ISK was good...
messages.zh: 哦，是的，也许你比较适合开着你的飞船去跟一些无畏舰较劲，但是，嗨，这次的星币可不少哦……

messages.en:
Funny you should ask: I was just about to contact you. Since you're about our best independent capsuleer, I think we need you on this one.

We've been picking up strange distress signals coming from the site of an old starship battle in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, dating back about 8 years or so, where several of our ships were lost. Now, it's possible, though unlikely, that there were some survivors aboard one of those wrecked ships and that they've just recently been able to repair their communications systems enough to send out distress signals. I say it's possible.

What's more likely, though, is that some explorers or salvage workers got trapped out there, or maybe even that some pirates have set up this phony distress call to lure unsuspecting rescuers out to their doom. In any case, I want it checked out, just in case there are actually some of our people still out there. Because of the potential danger, though, I'm only willing to send one of our best, most capable pilots out there. And that means you.

Go on out there and see what's causing this signal. You'll be well rewarded, as always.
messages.zh:
有意思，你竟然主动问起：我正打算联系你。由于你算是我们最好的独立飞行员，我想我们在这件事上需要你。

我们最近一直收到来自{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的某个星际飞船战斗旧址的奇怪求救信号。那次战斗可以追溯到大约8年前，我们损失了一些舰船。现在看来，虽然不确定，但可能一艘飞船残骸上还有幸存者，他们最近勉强修复了通讯系统，使之能够发出求救信号。我觉得这是可能的。

不过更可能的情况是一些探险者或者打捞人员被困在那里，甚至可能是一些海盗发出假信号来引诱毫无防备的救助人员去那里，以把他们一网打尽。无论是哪种情况，我都要确认清楚，以防那里真的还有我们的人。然而由于存在潜在的危险，我只想派一名我们最出色、最能干的飞行员去那里。而这个人就是你。

去那里吧，看看信号到底是谁发出来的。与往常一样，你会得到很好的报酬。

{[character]player.name}，

{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的信号已经停止发送，我们已经派出侦察舰去查清原委。你没有必要再前往那里了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Signal vanished
messages.zh: 信号消失

messages.en: Something's come up, I'm afraid, {[character]agentID.name}. Not going to be able to finish this one on time. Sorry.
messages.zh: 很抱歉，{[character]agentID.name}，出现了某些突发事件。我不能按时完成这个任务了。抱歉。

messages.en: I see. Well, that's unfortunate. I don't have many pilots of your caliber to send out on these special assignments.
messages.zh: 我明白了。唔，真是不幸。像你一样可以派去执行这些特殊任务的有才干的飞行员实在是不多。

{[character]player.name}，

{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的信号已经停止发送，我们已经派出侦察舰去查清原委。你没有必要再前往那里了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Signal vanished
messages.zh: 信号消失

messages.en: I'm on it, {[character]agentID.name}. I'll be back before you know it.

messages.en: Excellent. My thanks. Do be careful out there ― we have no idea what we're dealing with, really.
messages.zh: 很好。非常感谢。到那里千万要小心——我们压根不知道我们要对付的是什么，真的。

messages.en: Good day, {[character]agentID.name}. You have anything for me?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}。你有什么事让我做吗？

messages.zh: 噢？我正赶上什么了？

messages.en:
I've just received word that the Amarr have actually had the gall to build one of their temple complexes in our space! Well, they're claiming it's their space. And since it's in low-security, we'd be declaring an open act of war by sending in the Republic Navy to remove them. Some day, I think, we'll be ready to do that, but not today.

So what I need you for is this: You know the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system? We cannot allow this humiliating action of theirs to go unpunished. The beauty of sending you in there, as a privateer, is that we can claim complete ignorance. Go there and kill every Amarr you find. Once you've dealt with the defenses, I can send in our people to take care of the rest of the cleanup.
messages.zh:
我刚收到消息，艾玛人居然厚颜无耻地在我们的空间里建造了他们的一个圣殿复合体！他们还声称这是他们的空间。然而那里位于低安全等级区域，如果我们派共和海军去铲除他们的话，就等于公开宣战。我想，我们有一天会那样干的，但不是今天。

所以，我需要你做的就是：你知道{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系吗？我们绝不能放任他们这种让我们蒙羞的行为。我们将把你以私掠船的名义派往那里，这种做法的高明之处就是我们可以声称对此事一无所知。前往那里，干掉你发现的每一个艾玛人。一旦你收拾掉了那些防御系统，我就可以派我们的人去收拾残局。

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另雇一小队私掠船去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛圣坛。幸好你不是共和国空间里唯一能干的星际飞船船长。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarr destroyed
messages.zh: 艾玛人被消灭

messages.en: You'll need to call in someone else on this one, {[character]agentID.name}. The task is beyond me.
messages.zh: 你要找别人来干这事了，{[character]agentID.name}。这个任务在我能力之外。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, we do not always have the luxury of choosing our battles. Think on that. Dangerous times lie ahead. Close ahead.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，战斗选择权对我们来说是少有的奢侈。考虑一下吧。前方危机四伏。就在前方不远处。

{[character]player.name}，

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarr destroyed
messages.zh: 艾玛人被消灭

messages.en: Dammit, {[character]agentID.name}, these Minmatar are starting to make me angry. They won't like me when I'm angry.
messages.zh: 该死的，{[character]agentID.name}，这些米玛塔尔人开始让我生气了。他们可不会喜欢我生气时的样子。

messages.en: That's good to hear. But remember, your assignment is just to get those civilians to safety. Then we'll think about vengeance.
messages.zh: 很高兴听你这么说。但是记住，你的任务只是把那些平民安全救出。然后我们再谋报复。

messages.en: What does that mean? What have you found out?
messages.zh: 那是什么意思？你发现了什么？

messages.en:
To complete this mission, you will require a ship with an available cargo capacity of at least 1,000 m3 volume (and preferably 6,000 m3).

So here's what I've been able to find out: The Minmatar have moved, within the past few days, against a number of our free agents such as yourself; unfortunately, not all of the capsuleers they targeted proved as resilient as you. Four of them were podded, may God rest their souls. I don't like this kind of concerted effort on the part of the Minmatar, {[character]player.name}. God knows what it all means.

Now, my spies report, it seems they are growing even more daring, moving against a number of our civilian colonies. With four of our top pilots gone, and even with the Navy pulling its weight, we're going to be hard pressed to protect all of those people. We all need to do our part. I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to the civilian outpost there and evacuate those people. Destroy any preliminary Minmatar forces you encounter, get those civilians out of the citizen quarters, and bring them all safely back to me here at {[location]agentStationID.name}.
messages.zh:
要完成这个任务，你需要一艘可用货舱容量至少为1000 m3的飞船（最好是6000 m3）。

以下是我所掌握到的情况：米玛塔尔人在过去几天内向不少你这样的自由特工采取了行动；很不幸，他们锁定的飞行员并非都像你一样有韧性。他们中的四个被击爆了逃生舱，愿上帝让他们安息。我不喜欢米玛塔尔采取的这种一致行动，{[character]player.name}。上帝知道这都意味着什么。

如今，我的间谍报告说，似乎他们正变得愈发嚣张，要对我们很多平民殖民地采取行动了。我们损失了四个顶尖飞行员，即便我们的海军恪尽职守，保护所有那些人民仍将给我们带来很大压力。我们都需要发挥自己的作用。我需要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的平民哨站并疏散那里的居民。消灭你遭遇的所有米玛塔尔前哨军队，将那些平民从市民区带出来，安全送回{[location]agentStationID.name}我这里。

messages.en: Alright, the people are safe. Now tell me where to find that Minmatar fleet!
messages.zh: 好了，人都安全了。现在告诉我那支米玛塔尔舰队在哪！

messages.en: That's the spirit, {[character]player.name}. But don't rush in unprepared: This is going to be a tough fight.
messages.zh: 要的就是这种精神，{[character]player.name}。但别打无准备之仗：这一仗会很艰难。

messages.en: First an ambush, now a concerted attack against our civilians!? No, I don't think I want any more to do with this Minmatar problem.
messages.zh: 他们先是打埋伏，现在又联合攻击我们的平民！？不了，我不想再跟这个米玛塔尔难题扯上任何关系了。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, whose side are you on, for God‘s sake!?
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，看在上帝的份上，你是哪一边的？

messages.en:
Well, that distress signal most certainly was a trap ― one intended to catch you. It seems as though the Minmatar have taken notice of a handful of capsuleers who've interfered a great deal with their resistance movement. You're on that list. In fact you show quite highly, if that makes you feel any better.

So here's what I've been able to find out: The Minmatar have moved, within the past few days, against a number of our free agents such as yourself; unfortunately, not all of the capsuleers they targeted proved as resilient as you. Four of them were podded, may God rest their souls. I don't like this kind of concerted effort on the part of the Minmatar, {[character]player.name}. God knows what it all means.

Now, my spies report, it seems they are growing even more daring, moving against a number of our civilian colonies. With four of our top pilots gone, and even with the Navy pulling its weight, we're going to be hard pressed to protect all of those people. We all need to do our part. I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to the civilian outpost there and evacuate those people. {[character]player.name}，

米玛塔尔舰队攻下了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的平民居住区，数千平民失去了生命。你在本军团效力的日子可能不多了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.zh: 平民遭不幸

messages.en: Sorry about those civilians, but I can't get there on time. Send in the Navy or something.

messages.zh: 那里都是些无辜的人，{[character]player.name}！我们也没有其他人了！

{[character]player.name}，

加达里好战分子攻下了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的平民居住区，数千平民失去了生命。你在本军团效力的日子可能不多了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Civilians slaughtered
messages.zh: 平民遭不幸

messages.en: I'll get those people out of there. And when I get back, I'm going to make these Amarr zealots pay.
messages.zh: 我会把那些人带出来。等我回来的时候，我要好好跟这些艾玛疯子算算账。

messages.en: That's good to hear. But remember, your assignment is just to get those civilians to safety. Then we'll think about vengeance.
messages.zh: 很高兴听你这么说。但是记住，你的任务只是把那些平民安全救出。然后我们再谋报复。

messages.en: What does that mean? What have you found out?
messages.zh: 那是什么意思？你发现了什么？

messages.en:
To complete this mission, you will require a ship with an available cargo capacity of at least 1,000 m3 volume (and preferably 6,000 m3).

So here's what I've been able to find out: These Amarr have moved, within the past few days, against a number of our free agents such as yourself; unfortunately, not all of the capsuleers they targeted proved as resilient as you. Several of them were pod-killed, may they rest in peace. I don't really know what to make of these action, {[character]player.name}. Is it some group of militant Amarr fanatics? I can‘t figure it out. But if it‘s the Imperial Navy behind all of this, then it might mean the worst. Yes, war.

But now it gets more frightening: Scouts report that a number of Amarr capital ships are moving, even as we speak, against a number of our civilian colonies. With a number of our top pilots gone, and even with our own navy pulling its weight, we're going to be hard pressed to protect all of those people. We all need to do our part. I need you to go to the civilian outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and evacuate those people. Destroy any Amarr forces you encounter, get those civilians out of the citizen quarters, and bring them all safely back to me here at {[location]agentStationID.name}.
messages.zh:
要完成这个任务，你需要一艘货舱可用容量至少为1000m3（最好是6000m3）的飞船。

以下是我所掌握到的情况：艾玛人在过去几天内对不少你这样的自由特工采取了行动；很不幸，他们锁定的飞行员并非都像你一样有韧性。他们中的几个被击爆了逃生舱，愿上帝让他们安息。我不知道这些行动意味着什么， {[character]player.name}。是一些好战的艾玛信仰者干的吗？我不确定。但如果帝国海军是背后的指使者，就是最坏的情况。没错，这意味着战争。

而现在形势变得更糟糕了：情报称一些艾玛旗舰现在正前往我们的殖民领地。我们损失了一些顶尖的飞行员，即使海军拼尽全力，恐怕也不能保护所有的平民。我们都必须贡献自己的力量。我需要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的平民哨站并疏散那里的居民。消灭你遭遇的所有艾玛军队，将那些平民从居住区带出来，安全送回{[location]agentStationID.name}。

messages.en: Alright, the people are safe. Now tell me where to find that Amarr fleet!
messages.zh: 好了，人都安全了。现在告诉我那支艾玛舰队在哪！

messages.en: That's the spirit, {[character]player.name}. But don't rush in unprepared: This is going to be a tough fight.
messages.zh: 要的就是这种精神，{[character]player.name}。但别打无准备之仗：这一仗会很艰难。

messages.en: No, I don't think I want anything more to do with this problem. I need to keep my own hide intact.
messages.zh: 不了，我不想再跟这个难题扯上任何关系了。我要保住自己的小命。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, whose side are you on, I wonder!?
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你到底是哪一边的！？

messages.en:
Well, that distress signal most certainly was a trap ― one intended to catch you. It seems as though some of the Amarr have taken notice of a handful of capsuleers who've caused a great deal of problems for them in the past. You're on that list. In fact you show quite highly, if that makes you feel any better.

So here's what I've been able to find out: These Amarr have moved, within the past few days, against a number of our free agents such as yourself; unfortunately, not all of the capsuleers they targeted proved as resilient as you. Several of them were pod-killed, may they rest in peace. I don't really know what to make of these action, {[character]player.name}. Is it some group of militant Amarr fanatics? I can‘t figure it out. But if it‘s the Imperial Navy behind all of this, then it might mean the worst. Yes, war.

But now it gets more frightening: Scouts report that a number of Amarr capital ships are moving, even as we speak, against a number of our civilian colonies. With a number of our top pilots gone, and even with our own navy pulling its weight, we're going to be hard pressed to protect all of those people. We all need to do our part. I need you to go to the civilian outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and evacuate those people. Destroy any Amarr forces you encounter, get those civilians out of the citizen quarters, and bring them all safely back to me here at {[location]agentStationID.name}.

To complete this mission, you will require a ship with an available cargo capacity of at least 1,000 m3 volume (and preferably one with a capacity of 6,000 m3).
messages.zh:
唔，那个求救信号几乎肯定就是个陷阱——在引诱你上钩。艾玛似乎已经注意到了一些在过去几年给他们造成了不少麻烦的飞行员，其中就包括你。事实上你的排名相当靠前——如果这样说你会感觉好点的话。

以下是我所掌握到的情况：艾玛人在过去几天内对不少你这样的自由特工采取了行动；很不幸，他们锁定的飞行员并非都像你一样有韧性。他们中的几个被击爆了逃生舱，愿上帝让他们安息。我不知道这些行动意味着什么， {[character]player.name}。是一些好战的艾玛信仰者干的吗？我不确定。但如果帝国海军是背后的指使者，就是最坏的情况。没错，这意味着战争。

而现在形势变得更糟糕了：情报称一些艾玛旗舰现在正前往我们的殖民领地。我们损失了一些顶尖的飞行员，即使海军拼尽全力，恐怕也不能保护所有的平民。我们都必须贡献自己的力量。我需要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的平民哨站并疏散那里的居民。消灭你遭遇的所有艾玛军队，将那些平民从居住区带出来，安全送回{[location]agentStationID.name}。

要完成这个任务，你需要一艘货舱可用容量至少为1000m3（最好是6000m3）的飞船。

{[character]player.name}，

艾玛军队攻下了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的平民居住区，数千平民失去了生命。你在本军团效力的日子可能不多了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Civilians slaughtered
messages.zh: 平民遭不幸

messages.en: Sorry about those civilians, but I can't get there on time. Send in the Navy or something.
messages.zh: 我很同情那些平民，但我没法准时到那。派海军或者其他人去吧。

messages.en: Those are innocent people out there, {[character]player.name}! And we have no one else!
messages.zh: 那里都是些无辜的人，{[character]player.name}！我们也没有其他人了！

{[character]player.name}，

艾玛军队攻下了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的平民居住区，数千平民失去了生命。你在本军团效力的日子可能不多了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Civilians slaughtered
messages.zh: 平民遭不幸

messages.en: I will stop those ships or clone-jump trying.
messages.zh: 我会阻止那些飞船，直到我需要使用远距克隆传送。

messages.en: Your name shall be sung among the stars, {[character]player.name}. And your earthly rewards shall be great.
messages.zh: 你的名字将在星球间传颂，{[character]player.name}。你的尘世酬劳将异常丰厚。

messages.en: Yes, I know ― there's a capital fleet out there. Now where is it?
messages.zh: 是的，我知道——有一支旗舰级舰队。那支舰队现在在哪？

messages.en:
This mission is extremely dangerous. You should not undertake it without at least a handful of gang-mates all in powerful, combat-ready ships.

While you were out saving those civilians, the Minmatar, as we suspected they were going to, hit several other habitations; in total, the loss of life is staggering. Casualty reports are still coming in, but already it's numbering in the thousands, and likely it will be tens of thousands by the time we have confirmed intelligence. Thank God you were able to rescue some of our people, at least.

But now it is time to meet these Minmatar in battle. Our scouts report a squad of enemy ships, including carriers, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Desperate times call for … ah, you know how it goes: I want you to get out there and stop those ships. I'll be honest, {[character]player.name}. I think the likelihood of your returning to me in a new clone is high, but we have no choice ― we must stop them from slaughtering our people. This, like it or not, is war.
messages.zh:
这项任务极其危险。要接下这个任务，你至少需要几个装备精良、训练有素的友军协同配合。

就在你去拯救那些平民的时候，米玛塔尔人，就像我们猜想的那样，攻击了其他几个居民区；平民的死伤总人数令人触目惊心。伤亡报告还在不断送达，但现在的结果已经数以千计，等我们确认了情报之后，这个数字很可能达到数万。感谢上帝，你至少救出了一些我们的人。

现在是我们在战场上迎击那些米玛塔尔人的时候了。我们的侦察机在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了一小队敌舰，其中包括航母。非常时期要求我们……啊，你知道这句话接下来是什么吧：我要你去那里阻止那些飞船。实话说，{[character]player.name}，我觉得你很有可能将以一个新的克隆的形式回到我这里，但我们别无选择——我们必须阻止他们伤害我们的人。不管你喜不喜欢，这就是战争。

messages.en: It was probably the toughest fight of my career, {[character]agentID.name}, but the Minmatar ships are no more. What news?
messages.zh: 这很可能是我职业生涯中最艰苦的一战，{[character]agentID.name}，不过那些米玛塔尔的飞船已经不复存在了。什么消息？

messages.en: Well, we've managed to drive the Minmatar back. The Republic denies all knowledge of the attacks, of course, claiming that the Thukker nomads are responsible. But do not be fooled, {[character]player.name} ― I think war will soon be upon us.
messages.zh: 我们成功地将米玛塔尔人赶了回去。当然，共和国称对这些进攻毫不知情，并要求图克尔游牧民族对此事负责。但是你可别被迷惑，{[character]player.name}——我认为战争很快就会降临。

messages.en: A squadron of capital ships. Are you mad?! How can I do anything but have my ship destroyed? No, a few thousand civilians are not worth that.
messages.zh: 一个中队的旗舰级战舰。你是不是疯了？！我做什么也不会让我的飞船去送死！不了，为了几千个平民的性命不值得。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, this is war! Do you not understand what that means!? I think you capsuleers tend to forget what it is to be human, to have families, children threatened, killed. Phagh! Get out of my sight!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，这是战争！你难道不知道那意味着什么吗！？我看你们这些飞行员忘记了做人的本质，忘记了家人、孩子被威胁和加害时的痛苦。该死的！立刻从我眼前消失！

messages.en:
I admire your courage, {[character]player.name}, but remember that discretion is the better part of valor. This fleet must be met, yes, but not by a lone ship.

While you were out saving those civilians, the Minmatar, as we suspected they were going to, hit several other habitations; in total, the loss of life is staggering. Casualty reports are still coming in, but already it's numbering in the thousands, and likely it will be tens of thousands by the time we have confirmed intelligence. Thank God you were able to rescue some of our people, at least.

But now it is time to meet these Minmatar in battle. Our scouts report a squad of enemy ships, including carriers, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; currently, some of them have stopped at a refueling facility they've secured there. Desperate times call for … ah, you know how it goes: I want you to get out to that fuel depot and destroy those ships. I'll be honest, {[character]player.name}. I think the likelihood of your returning to me in a new clone is high, but we have no choice ― we must stop them from slaughtering our people. This, like it or not, is war.

This mission is extremely dangerous. You should not undertake it without at least a handful of gang-mates all in powerful, combat-ready ships.
messages.zh:
我佩服你的勇气，{[character]player.name}，但是记住，谨慎即大勇。是的，那支舰队必须被迎头痛击，但不能单由一只飞船来干。

就在你去拯救那些平民的时候，米玛塔尔人，就像我们猜想的那样，攻击了其他几个居民区；平民的死伤总人数令人触目惊心。伤亡报告还在不断送达，但现在的结果已经数以千计，等我们确认了情报之后，这个数字很可能达到数万。感谢上帝，你至少救出了一些我们的人。

现在是我们在战场上迎击那些米玛塔尔人的时候了。我们的侦察机在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了一小队敌舰，其中包括航母；现在，其中一些飞船停靠在他们保护的一座燃料补给工厂。非常时期要求我们……啊，你知道这句话接下来是什么吧：我要你去那个燃料补给站，摧毁那些飞船。实话说，{[character]player.name}，我觉得你很有可能将以一个新的克隆的形式回到我这里，但我们别无选择——我们必须阻止他们伤害我们的人。不管你喜不喜欢，这就是战争。

这项任务极其危险。要接下这个任务，你至少需要几个装备精良、训练有素的友军协同配合。

{[character]player.name}，尽管你无所作为，米玛塔尔人还是被我们的海军赶回去了，但代价是惨重的伤亡。当然，共和国称对这些进攻毫不知情，并要求图克尔游牧民族对此事负责。但是你可别被迷惑，{[character]player.name}——我认为战争很快就会降临。

你会站在哪一边？

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar forces driven back
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔军队被赶回

messages.en: This task is beyond me.
messages.zh: 这项任务非我能力所及。

messages.en: I see. Very well; I knew this was a difficult task when I sent you. But note this, {[character]player.name}: In war, all must make sacrifices, and no action is too small. And these are not peaceful times.
messages.zh: 我明白了。好吧，当我派你出发的时候我就知道这是个艰巨的任务。但请注意，{[character]player.name}：在战争中，所有人都要做出牺牲，任何行动都不是小事。现在不是和平时期。

{[character]player.name}，尽管你无所作为，米玛塔尔人还是被我们的海军赶回去了，但代价是惨重的伤亡。当然，共和国称对这些进攻毫不知情，并要求图克尔游牧民族对此事负责。但是你可别被迷惑，{[character]player.name}——我认为战争很快就会降临。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.zh: 你的名字将在星球间传颂，{[character]player.name}。你的尘世酬劳将异常丰厚。

{[character]player.name}，尽管你无所作为，盖伦特人还是被我们的海军赶回去了，但代价是惨重的伤亡。当然，联邦称对这些进攻毫不知情，并宣称冒充成盖伦特民族主义者的天蛇恐怖分子应对此事负责。但是你可别被迷惑，{[character]player.name}——我认为战争很快就会降临。

你会站在哪一边？

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Gallente forces driven back
messages.zh: 盖伦特军队被赶回

messages.en: This task is beyond me.
messages.zh: 这项任务非我能力所及。

messages.en: I see. Very well; I knew this was a difficult task when I sent you. But note this, {[character]player.name}: In war, all must make sacrifices, and no action is too small. And these are not peaceful times.
messages.zh: 我明白了。好吧，当我派你出发的时候我就知道这是个艰巨的任务。但请注意，{[character]player.name}：在战争中，所有人都要做出牺牲，任何行动都不是小事。现在不是和平时期。

{[character]player.name}，尽管你无所作为，盖伦特人还是被我们的海军赶回去了，但代价是惨重的伤亡。当然，联邦称对这些进攻毫不知情，并宣称冒充成盖伦特民族主义者的天蛇恐怖分子应对此事负责。但是你可别被迷惑，{[character]player.name}——我认为战争很快就会降临。

你会站在哪一边？

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Gallente forces driven back
messages.zh: 盖伦特军队被赶回

messages.en: I will stop those ships or clone-jump trying.
messages.zh: 我会阻止那些飞船，直到我需要使用远距克隆传送。

messages.en: You will be recognized as a champion of democracy everywhere, {[character]player.name}. And your reward will be substantial.
messages.zh: 你的名字将在星球间传颂，{[character]player.name}。你的尘世酬劳将异常丰厚。

messages.en: Yes, I know ― there's a capital fleet out there. Now where is it?
messages.zh: 是的，我知道——有一支旗舰级舰队。那支舰队现在在哪？

messages.en:
This mission is extremely dangerous. You should not undertake it without at least a handful of gang-mates all in powerful, combat-ready ships.

While you were out saving those civilians, the Caldari, as we suspected they were going to, hit several other habitations; in total, the loss of life is staggering. Casualty reports are still coming in, but already it's numbering in the thousands, and likely it will be tens of thousands by the time we have confirmed intelligence. Thank God you were able to rescue some of our people, at least.

But now it is time to meet these Caldari in battle. Our scouts report a squad of enemy ships, including carriers, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Desperate times call for … ah, you know how it goes: I want you to get out there and stop those ships. I'll be honest, {[character]player.name}. I think the likelihood of your returning to me in a new clone is high, but we have no choice ― we must stop them from slaughtering our people. This, like it or not, is war.
messages.zh:
这项任务极其危险。要接下这个任务，你至少需要几个装备精良、训练有素的友军协同配合。

就在你去拯救那些平民的时候，加达里人，就像我们猜想的那样，攻击了其他几个居民区；平民的死伤总人数令人触目惊心。伤亡报告还在不断送达，但现在的结果已经数以千计，等我们确认了情报之后，这个数字很可能达到数万。感谢上帝，你至少救出了一些我们的人。

现在是我们在战场上迎击那些加达里人的时候了。我们的侦察机在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了一小队敌舰，其中包括航母。非常时期要求我们……啊，你知道这句话接下来是什么吧：我要你去那里阻止那些飞船。实话说，{[character]player.name}，我觉得你很有可能将以一个新的克隆的形式回到我这里，但我们别无选择——我们必须阻止他们伤害我们的人。不管你喜不喜欢，这就是战争。

messages.en: It was probably the toughest fight of my career, {[character]agentID.name}, but the Caldari ships are no more. What news?
messages.zh: 这很可能是我职业生涯中最艰苦的一战，{[character]agentID.name}，不过那些加达里的战舰已经不复存在了。什么消息？

messages.en: Well, we've managed to drive the Caldari back. The Caldari State denies all knowledge of the attacks, of course, claiming that Guristas terrorists posing as Caldari nationalists are responsible. But do not be fooled, {[character]player.name} ― I think war will soon be upon us.
messages.zh: 我们成功地将加达里人赶了回去。当然，加达里称对这些进攻毫不知情，并宣称冒充成加达里民族主义者的古斯塔斯恐怖分子应对此事负责。但是你可别被迷惑，{[character]player.name}——我认为战争很快就会降临。

messages.en: A squadron of capital ships. Are you mad?! How can I do anything but have my ship destroyed? No, a few thousand civilians are not worth that.
messages.zh: 一个中队的旗舰级战舰。你是不是疯了？！我做什么也不会让我的飞船去送死！不了，为了几千个平民的性命不值得。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, this is war! Do you not understand what that means!? I think you capsuleers tend to forget what it is to be human, to have families, children threatened, killed. Phagh! Get out of my sight!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，这是战争！你难道不知道那意味着什么吗！？我看你们这些飞行员忘记了做人的本质，忘记了家人、孩子被威胁和加害时的痛苦。该死的！立刻从我眼前消失！

messages.en:
I admire your courage, {[character]player.name}, but remember that discretion is the better part of valor. This fleet must be met, yes, but not by a lone ship.

While you were out saving those civilians, the Caldari, as we suspected they were going to, hit several other habitations; in total, the loss of life is staggering. Casualty reports are still coming in, but already it's numbering in the thousands, and likely it will be tens of thousands by the time we have confirmed intelligence. Thank God you were able to rescue some of our people, at least.

But now it is time to meet these Caldari in battle. Our scouts report a squad of enemy ships, including carriers, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; currently, some of them have stopped at a refueling facility they've secured there. Desperate times call for … ah, you know how it goes: I want you to get out to that fuel depot and destroy those ships. I'll be honest, {[character]player.name}. I think the likelihood of your returning to me in a new clone is high, but we have no choice ― we must stop them from slaughtering our people. This, like it or not, is war.

This mission is extremely dangerous. You should not undertake it without at least a handful of gang-mates all in powerful, combat-ready ships.
