{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarr forces driven back
messages.zh: 艾玛军队被赶回

messages.en: Those Minmatar will rue their interference. Consider it done.
messages.zh: 那群米玛塔尔人会为他们所干的蠢事后悔的。你就当这事已经办妥了。

messages.en: Excellent. Be warned, though: You're likely going to need a few allies. Our sanctum has strong defenses in place.
messages.zh: 很好。但是，给你一些忠告：你可能需要一些友军。我们的圣坛有很强大的防御力量。

messages.en: Oh? What is it that I can do for you?
messages.zh: 噢？有什么可以为您效劳的吗？

messages.en:
You know the temple complex that was built a few years ago out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}? Well, a bunch of Minmatar slaves, apparently working with outside help from god knows where, have somehow managed to capture this heavily fortified holy place! Yes, unbelievable, I tell you. And now several Minmatar ships from Republic space have joined them there ― yes, in Amarr space! Damn them!

Now they are using our sanctum as a base of operations for their evil business in our space. We cannot allow this humiliating act to go unpunished. Go there and kill them all. Once you've dealt with this matter, I will send in our soldiers to take care of the rest.
messages.zh:
你知道几年前在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造的一座圣殿复合体吗？ 一群米玛塔尔劳工不知获得了哪来的外力的帮助，竟然占领了这个防御森严的神圣场所！是的，我跟你说，太难以置信了。而且现在一些米玛塔尔舰船又进入到那个区域内——是的，在我们艾玛人的地盘上。他们该死！

他们现在利用我们的圣地作为行动基地，干他们的邪恶勾当。我们绝不能放任这种让我们蒙羞的行为。你去把他们全都干掉。一旦你解决了问题，我就会派我们的士兵去收拾残局。

messages.en: The Minmatar dogs are no more, {[character]agentID.name}. I‘m afraid I also had to destroy the stationary defenses, though.
messages.zh: 这群米玛塔尔混蛋都被干掉了，{[character]agentID.name}。接下来，我还要去摧毁空间站防御系统。

messages.en: Excellent. One more lesson taught to the Minmatar. When, I wonder, will they finally learn their place?!
messages.zh: 很好。米玛塔尔人又受了次教训。真不知道他们要什么时候才会有自知之明？！

messages.en: I'm sorry, but this doesn't sound like any kind of work I'm interested in.
messages.zh: 对不起，这听起来这不是我感兴趣的工作。

messages.en: Oh, to be a capsuleer. “Hm, not interested, thanks.” Life is so easy for you people.
messages.zh: 噢，成为一名飞行员。“嗯，不感兴趣，谢谢。”你们这些人的日子也太好过了吧。

messages.en:
It's those damned Minmatar, as usual. As if pirate scum aren't bad enough, but we also have deal with these ungrateful slave folk. I tell you, they've about got me ready to... oh, my ulcer!

You see what happens? Don't ever take a desk job, {[character]player.name}, trust me. Stick to your starships.

Alright, so you know the temple complex that was built a few years ago out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}? Well, a bunch of Minmatar slaves, apparently working with outside help from god knows where, have somehow managed to capture this heavily fortified holy place! Yes, unbelievable, I tell you. And now several Minmatar ships from the Minmatar homeworlds have joined them there ― yes, in Amarr space! Damn them!

Now they are using our star sanctum as a base of operations for their evil business in our space. We cannot allow this humiliating act to go unpunished … and I certainly cannot allow my superiors to learn of this matter before it has been dealt with properly. Go there and kill every Minmatar you find. Once you've dealt with this matter, I will send in our soldiers to take care of the rest.
messages.zh:
又是那些恶心的米玛塔尔人！海盗的事已经够让我头疼的了，但我们还是得来应付这些劳工们，他们真要把我给逼急了……哦，天哪！

看看他们干了什么，{[character]player.name}，别理他们，干好你自己的事。

对了，你知道我们几年前在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造的一个圣殿复合体吗？米玛塔尔人在外力的帮助下竟然占领了那块地方。简直难以置信！而且现在一些米玛塔尔舰船又进入到那个区域内，是的，在我们艾玛人的地盘上。该死的！

他们现在利用我们的地盘作为基地干他们的邪恶勾当，我们绝不能放任他们这种让我们蒙羞的行为， 而且也不能让我的上级知道这件事情。你去那里，把找到的米玛塔尔人都干掉，然后我就可以派我们的人去收拾残局。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不找了另外一名飞行员去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的米玛塔尔人。幸好你不是帝国空间里唯一能干的星舰舰长。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar destroyed
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人被消灭

messages.en: You'll need to call in the Navy on this one, {[character]agentID.name}. It's beyond me.
messages.zh: 你得召集海军来解决这件事，{[character]agentID.name}。它超过了我的能力范围。

messages.en: A capsuleer with the sense to admit defeat?? Incredible. I commend you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 一个愿意承认失败的飞行员？？难以置信。我赞扬你，{[character]player.name}。

由于你没能对付{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的那些米玛塔尔人，我们的圣坛受到了亵渎，那些闹事的米玛塔尔劳工也逃回他们的“共和国”空间了。

为帝国办事的飞行员不只你一个，{[character]player.name}，我还要提醒你，不要忘了自己是站在哪一边的，总有一天你会为今天的事情感到后悔。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar escape
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人逃脱

messages.en: Oh, yes, very good. Those Amarrian slave-takers will pay for their arrogance.
messages.zh: 非常好。那些艾玛人将为他们的傲慢付出代价的。

messages.en: Excellent. But you're likely going to need a few allies. These Amarr “star sanctums” always have strong defenses in place.
messages.zh: 很好。不过你可能需要一些友军。他们的“明星圣坛”一直部署着强大的防御力量。

messages.en: Oh? What am I in time for?
messages.zh: 噢？我正赶上什么了？

messages.en:
You know the hyperspace complex out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system that the Amarr have been renting from us under treaty? Well, I've just received word that they've actually had the gall to build one of their profane temple complexes in there! In clear breach of the treaty under which they're using the place! And since it's in low-security, we'd be declaring an open act of war by sending in the Federation Navy to remove them.

So what I need you for is this: We cannot allow this disgusting atrocity of theirs to go unpunished. Keeping Minmatar slaves under our very noses! The sheer, unmitigated gall of it!! The beauty of sending you in there, as a privateer, is that we can claim complete ignorance. Go there and destroy every Amarr vessel you find. Once you've dealt with the defenses, I can send in our people to take care of the rest of the cleanup.
messages.zh:
你知道在艾玛人通过合约问我们租用的在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的复合体吗？我刚收到消息，艾玛人居然厚颜无耻地在我们的空间里建造了他们的一个圣殿复合体！他们还声称这是他们的空间。然而那里位于低安全等级区域，如果我们派共和海军去铲除他们的话，就等于公开宣战。我想，我们有一天会那样干的，但不是今天。

所以，我需要你做的就是：你知道{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系吗？我们绝不能放任他们这种让我们蒙羞的行为。我们将把你以私掠船的名义派往那里，这种做法的高明之处就是我们可以声称对此事一无所知。前往那里，干掉你发现的每一个艾玛人。一旦你收拾掉了那些防御系统，我就可以派我们的人去收拾残局。

messages.en: The Amarr liars are no more, {[character]agentID.name}. No more slavery in pour space!
messages.zh: 那些爱说大话的艾玛人都被干掉了，{[character]agentID.name}。这地方再也没有劳工了。

messages.en: Well done. Good work out there.
messages.zh: 干得好！做得不错。

messages.en: A fully operational Amarr sanctum in our space? I hate the idea of it too, but I think this task is beyond me.
messages.zh: 在我们的空间有个全面运作的艾玛圣坛？我也讨厌这种做法，但对此我实在无能为力。

messages.en: “Discretion is the better part of valor,” yes … but where does discretion end and cowardice begin.
messages.zh: “谨慎即大勇”，没错……可是谨慎和胆怯只有一线之隔。

messages.en:
It's the damned Amarr for a change, actually. I mean, as if we didn't have enough problems with their Caldari confederates and the rampant piracy going on all the time…

You know the hyperspace complex out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system that the Amarr have been renting from us under treaty? Well, I've just received word that they've actually had the gall to build one of their profane temple complexes in there! In clear breach of the treaty under which they're using the place! And since it's in low-security, we'd be declaring an open act of war by sending in the Federation Navy to remove them.

So what I need you for is this: We cannot allow this disgusting atrocity of theirs to go unpunished. Keeping Minmatar slaves under our very noses! The sheer, unmitigated gall of it!! The beauty of sending you in there, as a privateer, is that we can claim complete ignorance. Go there and destroy every Amarr vessel you find. Once you've dealt with the defenses, I can send in our people to take care of the rest of the cleanup.

Sound good?
messages.zh:
当然是那些恶心的艾玛人。谁还能让我这么头痛呢？也许，除了他们该死的加达里海盗盟友……

你知道在艾玛人通过合约问我们租用的在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的复合体吗？我刚收到消息，艾玛人居然厚颜无耻地在我们的空间里建造了他们的一个圣殿复合体！他们还声称这是他们的空间。然而那里位于低安全等级区域，如果我们派共和海军去铲除他们的话，就等于公开宣战。我想，我们有一天会那样干的，但不是今天。

所以，我需要你做的就是：你知道{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系吗？我们绝不能放任他们这种让我们蒙羞的行为。我们将把你以私掠船的名义派往那里，这种做法的高明之处就是我们可以声称对此事一无所知。前往那里，干掉你发现的每一个艾玛人。一旦你收拾掉了那些防御系统，我就可以派我们的人去收拾残局。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另雇一小队私掠船去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛圣坛。幸好你不是联邦空间里唯一能干的星际飞船船长。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarr destroyed
messages.zh: 艾玛人被消灭

messages.en: You'll need to call in someone else on this one, {[character]agentID.name}. The task is beyond me.
messages.zh: 你要找别人来干这事了，{[character]agentID.name}。这个任务在我能力之外。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, we do not always have the luxury of choosing our battles. Think on that. Dangerous times lie ahead. Close ahead.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，战斗选择权对我们来说是少有的奢侈。考虑一下吧。前方危机四伏。就在前方不远处。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不另雇一小队私掠船去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛圣坛。幸好你不是联邦空间里唯一能干的星际飞船船长。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarr destroyed
messages.zh: 艾玛人被消灭

messages.en: Those Minmatar will rue their interference in Caldari space. Consider it done.
messages.zh: 那群米玛塔尔人会为他们在加达里空间所干的蠢事后悔的。你就当这事已经办妥了。

messages.en: Excellent. You're likely going to need a few allies, I think. These Amarr sanctums generally have strong defenses in place.
messages.zh: 很好。我认为你可能需要一些友军。这些艾玛人的“明星圣坛”往往部署着强大的防御力量。

messages.en: Oh? What seems to be the problem?
messages.zh: 噢？问题出在哪里？

messages.en:
You know the Amarr temple complex that was built by contract a few years ago out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}? Well, a bunch of Minmatar slaves, apparently working with outside help from god knows where have somehow managed to capture this heavily fortified holy place! Yes, unbelievable, I tell you. And now several Minmatar ships from the Minmatar homeworlds have joined them there ― yes, in our space! Damn them!

Now they are using this Amarr star sanctum as a base of operations for their barbaric business in our space. We cannot allow this brazen act to go unpunished … and I certainly cannot allow my superiors to learn of this matter before it has been dealt with properly. Go there and destroy every hostile vessel you find. Once you've dealt with this matter, I will send in our people to take care of the rest.
messages.zh:
你知道我们几年前在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造的一个圣殿复合体吗？米玛塔尔人在外力的帮助下竟然占领了那块地方。简直难以置信！而且现在一些米玛塔尔舰船又进入到那个区域内，是的，在我们艾玛人的地盘上。该死的！

他们现在利用我们的地盘作为基地干他们的邪恶勾当，我们绝不能放任他们这种让我们蒙羞的行为， 而且也不能让我的上级知道这件事情。你去那里，把找到的米玛塔尔人都干掉，然后我就可以派我们的人去收拾残局。

messages.en: The Minmatar are no more, {[character]agentID.name}. I‘m afraid I also had to destroy the Amarr stationary defenses, though.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，米玛塔尔人已经干掉了。恐怕我还需要去摧毁艾玛的固定防御设施。

messages.en: Excellent. I hope you'll find the reward helpful.
messages.zh: 很好。我希望这些奖励对你有用。

messages.en: I'm sorry, but this doesn't sound like any kind of work I'm interested in. Too political for my taste.
messages.zh: 这事听上去不太合我的口味，政治意味太浓了。

messages.en: I see. Well, luckily I do know a couple of other capsuleers who might be more interested.
messages.zh: 我明白了。幸好我知道一些飞行员会对此比较感兴趣。

messages.en:
It's the Minmatar, actually. As if pirate scum aren't bad enough, but we also have deal with the fallout of the Minmatar rebellion against the Amarr. I tell you, I wish they'd keep their differences to themselves ― or at least keep them out of our space!

You know the Amarr temple complex that was built by contract a few years ago out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}? Well, a bunch of Minmatar slaves, apparently working with outside help from god knows where have somehow managed to capture this heavily fortified holy place! Yes, unbelievable, I tell you. And now several Minmatar ships from the Minmatar homeworlds have joined them there ― yes, in our space! Damn them!

Now they are using this Amarr star sanctum as a base of operations for their barbaric business in our space. We cannot allow this brazen act to go unpunished … and I certainly cannot allow my superiors to learn of this matter before it has been dealt with properly. Go there and destroy every hostile vessel you find. Once you've dealt with this matter, I will send in our people to take care of the rest.
messages.zh:
又是那些恶心的米玛塔尔人！海盗的事已经够让我头疼的了，但我们还是得来应付这些劳工们的反抗。他们最好别待在我们的领地内。

对了，你知道我们几年前在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造的一个圣殿复合体吗？米玛塔尔人在外力的帮助下竟然占领了那块地方。简直难以置信！而且现在一些米玛塔尔舰船又进入到那个区域内，是的，在我们艾玛人的地盘上。该死的！

他们现在利用我们的地盘作为基地干他们的邪恶勾当，我们绝不能放任他们这种让我们蒙羞的行为， 而且也不能让我的上级知道这件事情。你去那里，把找到的米玛塔尔人都干掉，然后我就可以派我们的人去收拾残局。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有及时回复，我不得不找了另外一名飞行员去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的米玛塔尔人。幸好你不是合众国里唯一能干的星舰舰长。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar destroyed
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人被消灭

messages.en: You'll need to call in the Navy on this one, {[character]agentID.name}. It's beyond me.
messages.zh: 你得召集海军来解决这件事，{[character]agentID.name}。它超过了我的能力范围。

messages.en: I commend you for knowing when you are outclassed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我因你的优越表现感到高兴。

由于你没能对付{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的那些米玛塔尔人，那些袭击了圣坛的米玛塔尔人也逃回他们自己的地方了。

{[character]player.name}，由于我们对此事无所作为，我们的艾玛盟军可能会感到不悦，而且他们与米玛塔尔之间的关系日益恶化。我们今后可能会为今天的事件而懊悔。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar escape
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人逃脱

messages.en: Given freedom, Minmatar will always show their true colors. Yes, I'll happily help to reclaim these infidels for you.
messages.zh: 有了自由，米玛塔尔人就会露出他们的本来面目。是的，我会很乐意去帮你驯服这些异教徒。

messages.en: Good, then. Be careful out there: The Minmatar ships in the area are reportedly numerous and powerful.
messages.zh: 那样就好。到那注意安全。据报告，该区域的米玛塔尔飞船数目惊人，威力强大。

messages.en: Very kind of you, {[character]agentID.name}. I understand you have some work for me?
messages.zh: 过奖了，{[character]agentID.name}。我想你有一些任务给我吧？

messages.en:
Some years ago, the great Emperor Doriam, in the spirit of co-operation and generosity, allowed some Minmatar refugees to set up home in a former Ammatar station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They were not enslaved, but have been allowed to live free folk, as long as they maintained an excise quota on all of their trade. We have allowed them to continue thus in order to honor the reforms undertaken by Emperor Doriam, but recently one of their number took it upon himself to resist an Imperial customs inspection of their homes, killing the officer in question.

The Minmatar attempted to cover it all up, of course, but we soon got to the bottom of the matter. As they have thrown aside our goodwill and struck down one of the Chosen, the Navy has been ordered to dispense God's judgment upon the heathens. The Admiralty, however, feels that this job is best undertaken by a loyal but independent pilot, rather than official Navy forces, and we have chosen you to dispense with our punishment.

Fly to the coordinates provided and destroy any resistance, so that I can send transports in there to bring back the entire population of the habitats, women, children, and all. After that, destroy all the colony structures, and we will then, in our divine mercy, place any survivors into slavery ― if any are innocent ― and begin them on their path to glorious enlightenment through proper service to the Empire.

Now, we have had reports of Minmatar Republic ships in the area, likely attempting to evacuate the inhabitants: If you are fired upon, you have all authority to defend yourself by any means necessary … and by that, I mean kill them all. God's will be done.
messages.zh:
几年前，多利安姆大帝本着合作和宽容的精神，批准了一些米玛塔尔难民在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个前艾玛达空间站建立家园。他们没有被奴役，只要他们为所有交易上缴一定额度的税金，就可以像自由人一样生活。我们允许他们继续这样，是为了对多利安姆大帝的改革精神表示敬意。但是最近，他们这伙人中，有一个竟然胆敢抗拒帝国海关官员检查他们的住所，并害死了该官员。

当然，这些米玛塔尔人企图掩盖事实，不过我们很快就查出了事情的真相。因为他们不理会我们的好意，害死了上帝的子民，海军被授命对这些异教徒执行上帝的判决。 但是，海军部觉得这事最好交由一位忠心的独立飞行员来办，而不是正式的海军军队，所以我们选择你来代为执行我们的惩罚。

飞往提供给你的坐标，消灭一切抵抗力量，然后我就可以派遣运输船去带回那个居留地的所有人员、女人、儿童和所有一切。在那之后，摧毁所有殖民建筑。然后我们就会出于神圣的慈悲，让所有幸存者成为劳工——如果他们是无辜的的话——通过为帝国做出适当的服务，开始他们光荣的教化之路。

不过，我们已经接到报告，该地区出现了米玛塔尔共和国的舰队，好像企图撤走那些居民：如果他们向你射击，你有权使用任何手段防卫……我的意思就是，把他们全部干掉。上帝的旨意必将履行。

messages.en: The Minmatar defenders are no more, {[character]agentID.name}. You can send in your ship to gather the new slaves there.
messages.zh: 那些米玛塔尔保卫者不复存在了，{[character]agentID.name}。你可以派飞船去那里搜集新劳工了。

messages.en: Well done. Let us hope they can serve the Empire better now, as do we all.
messages.zh: 干得好！让我们希望他们现在能更好地为帝国服务，就像我们所有人一样。

messages.en: Surely this task is beneath me. Spend my time against some piddling Minmatar fleet? I, who destroy battle stations as a matter of course?
messages.zh: 很显然这份工作不值得我去做。让我花时间去对付一些微不足道的米玛塔尔舰队？让我这样一个把摧毁战役空间站当作家常便饭的人去干这种活儿？

messages.en: Hm. And here I was under the impression that we all served the Empire. You may be a capsuleer, but you are no emperor.
messages.zh: 嗯。我还以为我们都是为帝国服务的。你也许是个飞行员，但不是皇帝。

messages.en:
I do indeed. It's the damned Minmatar, of course, as usual. If it isn't the Blood Raiders, it seems, it's the Minmatar.

Some years ago, our late Emperor Doriam, in the spirit of co-operation and generosity, allowed some Minmatar refugees to set up home in a former Ammatar station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They were not enslaved, but have been allowed to live free folk, as long as they maintained an excise quota on all of their trade. We have allowed them to continue thus under the late Emperor's directive, but recently one of their number took it upon himself to resist an Imperial customs inspection of their homes, killing the officer in question.

The Minmatar attempted to cover it all up, of course, but we soon got to the bottom of the matter. As they have thrown aside our goodwill and struck down one of the Chosen, the Navy has been ordered to dispense God's judgment upon the heathens. The Admiralty, however, feels that this job is best undertaken by a loyal but independent pilot, rather than official Navy forces, and we have chosen you to dispense with our punishment.

Fly to the coordinates provided and destroy any resistance, so that I can send transports in there to bring back the entire population of the habitats, women, children, and all. After that, destroy all the colony structures, and we will then, in our divine mercy, place any survivors into slavery ― if any are innocent ― and begin them on their path to glorious enlightenment through proper service to the Empire.

Now, we have had reports of Minmatar Republic ships in the area, likely attempting to evacuate the inhabitants: If you are fired upon, you have all authority to defend yourself by any means necessary … and by that, I mean kill them all. God's will be done.
messages.zh:
我确实有。当然，跟往常一样，又是那些该死的米玛塔尔人。似乎给我们添乱的不是血袭者，就是米玛塔尔人。

几年前，先皇多利安姆大帝本着合作和宽容的精神，批准了一些米玛塔尔难民在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个前艾玛达空间站建立家园。他们没有被奴役，只要他们对所有交易上缴一定额度的税收，他们就可以像自由人一样生活。遵照先帝的指示，我们允许他们继续这样生活。但是最近，他们这伙人中的一个竟然胆敢抗拒帝国海关官员检查他们的住所，并害死了该官员。

当然，这些米玛塔尔人企图掩盖事实，不过我们很快就查出了事情的真相。因为他们不理会我们的好意，害死了上帝的子民，海军被授命对这些异教徒执行上帝的判决。 然而，海军部觉得这事最好交由一位忠心的独立飞行员来办，而不是正式的海军军队，所以我们选择了你来代为执行我们的惩罚。

飞往提供给你的坐标，消灭一切抵抗力量，然后我就可以派遣运输船去带回那个居留地的所有人员、女人、儿童和所有一切。在那之后，摧毁所有殖民建筑。然后我们就会出于神圣的慈悲，让所有幸存者成为劳工——如果他们是无辜的的话——通过为帝国做出适当的服务，开始他们光荣的教化之路。

不过，我们已经接到报告，该地区出现了米玛塔尔共和国的舰队，好像企图撤走那些居民：如果他们向你射击，你有权使用任何手段防卫……我的意思就是，把他们全部干掉。上帝的旨意必将履行。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有回复，我不得不另雇一小队私掠船去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的米玛塔尔叛军。幸好你不是为帝国服务的唯一能干的星际飞船船长。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: Perhaps you'd best send in the Navy after all, {[character]agentID.name}. The task is beyond me.
messages.zh: 可能你最终还是得派出海军，{[character]agentID.name}。这项任务非我能力所及。

messages.en: We do not always have the luxury of choosing our battles. When war comes calling, will you simply bow out?
messages.zh: 战斗选择权对我们来说是少有的奢侈。当战争来临时，你难道只会全身而退吗？

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有回复，我不得不另雇一小队私掠船去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的米玛塔尔叛军。幸好你不是为帝国服务的唯一能干的星际飞船船长。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: Of course, {[character]agentID.name}. I'll happily clear out the Amarr scum for you.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，当然，我很高兴为你清除了艾玛败类。

messages.en: Good, then. Be careful out there: The Amarr ships in the area are reportedly numerous and powerful.
messages.zh: 那样就好。到那注意安全。据报告，该区域的艾玛舰船数目惊人，威力强大。

messages.en: Very kind of you, {[character]agentID.name}. I hear you might have some work for me?
messages.zh: 过奖了，{[character]agentID.name}。我想你有一些任务给我吧？

messages.en:
Some years ago, the late Amarr Emperor Doriam ―probably the only enlightened Amarrian to ever have lived ― built an Amarr habitation station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} as a gesture of goodwill. Minmatar were welcomed there and were not enslaved, but have been allowed to live free folk. However, recent governors in that station started to levy outrageous excises on all Minmatar tradesfolk and goods there. Things quickly turned ugly, and recently one of our people got in a fight with an Imperial customs agent; things escalated, and our man ended up killing the officer in question. Knowing what was coming, we managed to evacuate the rest of our people, but the situation is far from resolved.

As you might have guessed, the Amarr have taken this event as cause for military action. They've sent in a number of heavily armed ships, and we fear they're going to try to use the colony as a base of operations for surface raids on nearby planets, taking whatever Minmatar they can as slaves when they leave. We can't let that happen. The Republic Fleet has its hands tied, since any action on their part would result in open war, and we're just not ready for that yet. I need you to get in there!

Fly to the coordinates provided and destroy any resistance, and then destroy the colony structures so the Amarr can't use them. We have had reports of many Amarr ships in the area: If you are fired upon, as is likely, you have all authority to defend yourself by any means necessary … and by that, I mean kill them all.
messages.zh:
几年前，艾玛先皇多利安姆大帝——可能是现今知识最渊博的艾玛人——在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一处艾玛居所，表示友好。米玛塔尔人在那里并没有被奴役还受到欢迎，他们可以像自由人一样生活。然而最近，空间站的统治者开始对米玛塔尔人的贸易货物进行强制征税。事情很快就变得一发不可收拾，他们这伙人中的一个与帝国海关官员发生了正面冲突，之后还把他害死了。知道了这一切后，我们立刻设法撤离了其他人，但是情形并没有得到缓解。

正如你想到的，艾玛人为此发起了军团行动。他们出动了大批全副武装的舰船，我们害怕他们会使用殖民地来作为表面上的行动基地，然后离开的时候拿走所有米玛塔尔人的东西。我们不能让这种事发生。共和舰队的心是紧紧相连的，因为对方随时都有可能发起战争。但是我们还没有做到万全准备，我需要你前往那里！

飞往提供给你的坐标，消灭一切抵抗力量，摧毁殖民地的建筑，使得艾玛无法再使用。我们已经得到该区域艾玛舰船发出的报告：如果他们向你射击，你有权使用任何手段防卫……我的意思就是，把他们全部干掉。

messages.en: The Amarr ships are no more, {[character]agentID.name}, and their colonies are floating scrap.
messages.zh: 艾玛舰船以及殖民者都被干掉了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Well done. Let's see the Amarrians try to cover up their political machinations now that their ships were destroyed by “unidentified pirates,” eh? Ha!
messages.zh: 干得好！艾玛的舰船都被“无名海盗”干掉了，看看他们还怎么掩盖政治阴谋。哈！

messages.en: Amarr may not declare open war against the Republic, but they'll certainly send their assassins after a lone captain. No thanks ― no targets on my head!
messages.zh: 艾玛也许不会对合众国公开宣战，但他们肯定会派清道夫追捕形单影只的星舰船长。不了，谢谢——我不想别人要我的脑袋！

messages.en: Hm. And here I'd been given the impression you feared nothing. Hm, indeed.
messages.zh: 嗯。你给我留下了一个无所畏惧的印象。嗯，的确是。

messages.en:

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有回复，我不得不另雇一小队图克尔雇佣兵去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛人。幸好你不是为共和国服务的唯一能干的星际飞船船长。

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: Perhaps you'd best send in the Navy after all, {[character]agentID.name}. The task is beyond me.
messages.zh: 可能你最终还是得派出海军，{[character]agentID.name}。这项任务非我能力所及。

messages.en: We can't always choose our battles, {[character]player.name}. When war comes, will you flee, tail between your legs?
messages.zh: 我们不能总是去选择战争，{[character]player.name}。当战争来临时，你会夹着尾巴逃跑？

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有回复，我不得不另雇一小队图克尔雇佣兵去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛人。幸好你不是为共和国服务的唯一能干的星际飞船船长。

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: Sure, sounds easy enough. Blow some stuff up. I can do that real well. I'm in.
messages.zh: 当然，听起来够简单的了。就是炸掉一些东西。我可以干得很漂亮。我会参加这个任务。

messages.en: Good. But I must repeat: The Gallente ships in the area are reportedly numerous and powerful. Be careful.
messages.zh: 好的。不过我必须再说一遍：据报告，该区域的盖伦特舰船数目惊人，威力强大。当心点。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]agentID.name}. What can I do for you?
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]agentID.name}。我可以为你做些什么吗？

messages.en:
Some weird disease has spread through a civilian colony out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We quarantined it and sent some scientists in there to study the disease, and they've determined that it's a virus that mutates too quickly to be safely controlled.

The trouble is, some Gallente businessman caught wind of this and has figured out that he can make a profit by getting samples and selling the virus to their military as a weapon. Now, our scientists assure us that the risk is too high without a great deal more research and testing, which is already underway. But we sure as hell don't want the Gallente getting their hands on this stuff.

Trouble is, this Gallente person, or corporation, or whatever, has already moved on it, paying off some government official and thus getting permission to send in mercenary ships to secure the area. We can't send in our military for fear of political repercussions, so I need someone like you to deal with this matter for me.

Fly to the coordinates provided and destroy any Gallente ships there, and then destroy all the colony structures so no one else gets any ideas about collecting samples of this biological weapon. Now, we've had reports of some tough ships in their fleet: Be careful out there, but be sure to kill them all. We don't want any of them escaping with this virus.
messages.zh:
一些怪异的疾病在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的平民殖民地传播蔓延开来。我们对其进行检疫，并派了一批去那里研究该疾病的缘由。经过研究发现这是一种病毒，变异速度非常快难以控制。

一些盖伦特商人已经得到了关于此事的风声，准备获得这种病毒并卖给他们的军事机构制成生化武器，然后从中牟利。现在，我们的科学家向我们确认说这个病毒非常可怕，危险性极高，必须进行充分大量的研究和测试才能了解它的原理，并且研究工作已经在进行中了。不管怎么样，是决不能让盖伦特人插手进来。

但问题是，不知道是哪个盖伦特人或者军团已经开始行动了，他们付给了政府官员一笔钱，然后获得许可派遣一批雇佣军保卫这个地区，因而我们就无法派遣我们的部队进入。我需要像你这样的人帮我去处理这件事情。

飞去提供的坐标位置，消灭在那里所有的盖伦特舰船，并摧毁殖民地建筑，这样就没有人能够采集到生化武器的试样。现在我们已经获得了他们舰队中的一些强大舰船的报告：小心前往，全部干掉，一个不留。我们不希望看到任何病毒携带者逃离现场。

messages.en: All done, {[character]agentID.name}. The enemy ships are destroyed, along with the colony itself.
messages.zh: 任务完成，{[character]agentID.name}。敌军舰船和殖民地都被干掉了。

messages.en: I knew I could trust you to get the job done. Good work. Now let's keep this whole matter between you and me, okay?
messages.zh: 我就知道可以信赖你的工作能力。干得好。不过整件事情只有你知我知，好吗？

messages.en: Biological warfare? Incurable diseases? Uhhm, I think maybe I'll pass on this one. Thanks anyway.
messages.zh: 细菌战？无法治愈的疾病？唔，我想这个任务我不干。不过还是谢谢。

messages.en: Well, you'd have been at no personal risk, I assure you. But fine, suit yourself.
messages.zh: 我向你保证，你不会有人身危险。不过，好吧，随你的便吧。

messages.en:
Well, we seem to have a bit of a situation here, and I'm hoping you can help me out. You see, some civilian living in a colony complex out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} brought some creature home from a nearby planet ― I guess he was part of a work detail there or something ― and apparently it was a carrier for some weird disease that quickly spread through the colony. We quarantined the colony and sent some scientists in there to contain and study the disease, and they've determined that it's a virus that mutates too quickly to be safely controlled.

The trouble is, some Gallente businessman ― we haven't found out who yet ― caught wind of this and has figured out that he can make a profit by getting samples and selling the virus to their military as a weapon. Now, the idea had crossed our minds too, of course, but our scientists assure us that the risk is too high without a great deal more research and testing, which is already underway. But we sure as hell don't want the Gallente getting their hands on this stuff.

Trouble is, this Gallente person, or corporation, or whatever, has already moved on it, paying off some government official and thus getting permission to send in mercenary ships to secure the area. We can't send in our military for fear of political repercussions, so I need someone like you to deal with this matter for me.

Fly to the coordinates provided and destroy any Gallente ships there, and then destroy all the colony structures so no one else gets any ideas about collecting samples of this biological weapon. We'll cove the whole thing up as an act of piracy, and it'll soon be forgotten. Besides, we already have samples of the virus for ourselves.

Now, we've had reports of some tough ships in their fleet: Be careful out there, but be sure to kill them all. We don't want any of them escaping with this virus.

messages.en: Are you saying you can't do it? Alright, alright, fine. I'll get someone else.
messages.zh: 你的意思是你做不了？好吧，好吧，行。我会另觅人选。

messages.zh:
我们这里看起来有些不太平，我希望你可以帮我们解决。你已经看到了，一些住在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的殖民地复合体的平民从附近星球带回了一些生物体——我猜这应该就是我们要面对的问题——表面上看，殖民地正蔓延着一种怪异的疾病。我们对其进行检疫，并派了一批去那里研究该疾病的缘由。经过研究发现这是一种病毒，变异速度非常快难以控制。

一些加达里商人已经得到了关于此事的风声，准备获得这种病毒并卖给他们的军事机构制成生化武器，然后从中牟利。现在，我们的科学家向我们确认说这个病毒非常可怕，危险性极高，必须进行充分大量的研究和测试才能了解它的原理，并且研究工作已经在进行中了。不管怎么样，是决不能让加达里人插手进来。

但问题是，加达里军团已经开始行动了，毫无疑问是付给了政府官员一笔钱，获得许可派遣一批雇佣军保卫这个地区，因而我们就无法派遣我们的部队进入。我需要像你这样的人帮我去处理这件事情。

飞去提供的坐标位置，消灭在那里所有的加达里舰船，并摧毁殖民地建筑，这样就没有人能够采集到生化武器的试样。现在我们已经获得了他们舰队中的一些强大舰船的报告：小心前往，全部干掉，一个不留。我们不希望看到任何病毒携带者逃离现场

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有回复，我不得不另雇一小队雇佣军去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的平民殖民者。幸好你不是为联邦服务的唯一能干的星际飞船船长。

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Abort mission
messages.zh: 任务中止

messages.en: I think you'd better hire one of the big mercenary companies for this one. I might just be out of my league here.
messages.zh: 我想你这次最好去找一家大的雇佣兵公司。这事可不是我这种级别的人能应付的。

messages.en: Are you saying you can't do it? Alright, alright, fine. I'll get someone else.
messages.zh: 你的意思是你做不了？好吧，好吧，行。我会另觅人选。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有回复，我不得不另雇一小队雇佣军去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的平民殖民者。幸好你不是为联邦服务的唯一能干的星际飞船船长。

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Abort mission
messages.zh: 任务中止

messages.en: Don't worry, I'll make every one of them pay in blood.
messages.zh: 别担心，我会让他们每个人血债血偿的。

messages.en: See to it. Get those poor people out of that hellhole!
messages.zh: 交给你了。把那些可怜的人从地狱中拯救出来吧！

messages.en: Oh, yeah? What's the problem?
messages.zh: 噢，什么事？出什么事了？

messages.en:
I recently sent a capsuleer out to investigate disturbing reports from the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system: The number of missing persons cases on some outlying planets there has risen sharply and there have even been reports of lost ships. My capsuleer returned, unfortunately in his pod, but my suspicions were confirmed. What he reported is very disturbing, and we need someone with resources such as you possess to deal with it.

It appears an unprincipled Amarrian Holder has set up a heavily guarded slave breeding facility there. {[character]player.name}, go to this facility, rescue as many of my people as you can, and then reduce the place to cinders! Kill every Amarrian there ― make them pay for what they have done. Leave nothing intact, nothing ― the facilities least of all, lest some other Amarrian come in and occupy them!
messages.zh:
最近我派了一名飞行员去调查来自{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的令人担忧的报告：一些边远行星上的人口失踪案急速上升，甚至有了一些飞船失踪的报道。我的飞行员回来了。不幸的是，他是乘坐逃生舱回来的。不过，我的怀疑已经得到了证实。他的报告令人非常担忧，我们需要一个像你这样有才干的人来处理这件事。

一个毫无人道的艾玛劳工主似乎在那里建立了一个守卫森严的劳工繁殖工厂。{[character]player.name}，去那里尽你所能救出我的人，然后把那里化为灰烬！干掉那里所有的艾玛人——让他们为自己的行为付出代价。不要留下任何完整的东西，一个也别留下——尤其是那些工厂本身，以免其他艾玛人进来并占有它们。

messages.en: I've rescued the slaves and destroyed the facility.
messages.zh: 我已经救出劳工，并摧毁了那座设施。

messages.en: Ah, wonderful. I knew you wouldn't fail. Justice has been done.
messages.zh: 啊，干得漂亮。我就知道你不会失败的。正义总算得到了伸张。

messages.en: I sympathize with the plight of those people, of course, but take on an entire slaver complex by myself? That's suicide. Clones are too expensive for that.
messages.zh: 当然，我很同情那些人的困境；但是就靠我一个人去拿下一整个劳工主集中营？那简直是自尽。为这事购买克隆实在太昂贵了。

messages.en: Well, I see where your priorities lie…. Good day.
messages.zh: 好吧，我明白你的首要利益所在了……。祝你愉快。

messages.en:
This type of breeding facility produces Minmatar children ready to assume their place as servants to the Amarr; rumors abound that the slaves in these places hail from other races as well, including even fallen Amarr who are sent here rather than to penal colonies. 
Brood slaves are held within breeder colonies for years for the sole purpose of increasing a slaver's stock. Discarded when they have outlived their usefulness, these poor people have a terribly short life expectancy, although that fact might be a blessing when one considers the misery of their existence. Slavers who use such methods tend to be secretive about it, anchoring their breeding centers in low-security space; these facilities, however profitable, are looked down upon even in Amarrian society (especially since the Doriam reforms).
messages.zh: 这种繁殖设施培养出的是米玛塔尔儿童，他们生来就为成为艾玛人的仆人准备着；而且据风传，这些地方的劳工也有来自其他种族的人，甚至包括一些没落的艾玛人，他们没有被送往监禁地，而是被送到这里了。劳工们多年来被圈养在饲养殖民地，唯一的目的是为了增加其劳工主拥有的劳工总数。这些可怜的人一旦活过了最具使用价值的时期，就将被抛弃，因此他们的生命极其短暂，不过想想他们悲惨的一生，这也算是一种解脱。使用这种手段的劳工主通常都是偷偷摸摸进行，将他们的繁殖中心设在低安全等级的空间；无论这些设施多么有利可图，但即使在艾玛社会中，它们也是受人鄙视的(尤其是多利安姆改革后)。

messages.en: Amarr Breeding Facilities
messages.zh: 艾玛繁殖设施

messages.en:
I recently sent a capsuleer out to investigate disturbing reports from the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system: The number of missing persons cases on some outlying planets there has risen sharply and there have even been reports of lost ships. The locals are a superstitious lot, so they blame it on angering some spirit or other, but I have no such beliefs ― I suspect foul play. My capsuleer returned, unfortunately in his pod, but my suspicions were confirmed. What he reported is very disturbing, and we need someone with resources such as you possess to deal with it.

It appears an unprincipled Amarrian Holder has set up a heavily guarded slave breeding facility there. You cannot know the sheer horror of these places, our people penned and bred like cattle; the men sold or sent to work camps, the women used mercilessly. The owner no doubt felt that the place would remain undetected in unregulated space, so close here to a ready supply of … well, what I'm sure they would refer to as “livestock.”

{[character]player.name}, go to this facility, rescue as many of my people as you can, and then reduce the place to cinders! Kill every Amarrian there ― make them pay for what they have done. Leave nothing intact, nothing ― the facilities least of all, lest some other Amarrian come in and occupy them!
messages.zh:
最近我派了一名飞行员去调查来自{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的令人担忧的报告：一些边远行星上的人口失踪案急速上升，甚至有了一些飞船失踪的报道。当地民众是很迷信的一群人，因此他们将这归咎于惹恼了某位神灵什么的，但是我不这么认为——我怀疑这里有一些罪恶的勾当。我的飞行员回来了。不幸的是，他是乘坐逃生舱回来的。不过，我的怀疑已经得到了证实。他的报告令人非常担忧，我们需要一个像你这样有才干的人来处理这件事。

一个毫无人道的艾玛劳工主似乎在那里建立了一个守卫森严的劳工繁殖工厂。你无法想像这些地方是多么的恐怖——我们的人民像牛一样被圈养、繁殖；男人被贩卖或者发送到劳动营，女人则被残忍地奴役。那个劳工主无疑认为，那个地方在治安很差的空间可以不被察觉，而且那里离现成的……“牲口”(我肯定他们会用这个词)供应源很近。

{[character]player.name}，去那里尽你所能救出我的人，然后把那里化为灰烬！干掉那里所有的艾玛人——让他们为自己的行为付出代价。不要留下任何完整的东西，一个也别留下——尤其是那些工厂本身，以免其他艾玛人进来并占有它们。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有回复，我不得不另找一支雇佣兵小队去解决{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛劳工围场。幸好你不是为帝国办事的唯一能干的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Slave compound destroyed
messages.zh: 劳工集中营被摧毁

messages.en: I feel bad about those poor people, but the defenses at that compound are beyond me. I give up.
messages.zh: 我同情那些可怜的人，可是解决那个集中营的防御设施实在超出我的能力范围。我放弃。

messages.en: That's truly unfortunate. Now what am I supposed to do?!
messages.zh: 那真是太不幸了。现在我该怎么办？！

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Scouts inform me that the station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has been evacuated and disassembled. No doubt the Holder who owned the place caught wind of our efforts, and your tardiness has allowed him time to remove his operation to another system.

May the fates of those slaves weigh on your soul.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

据侦察机消息，{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}空间站的人员已经撤离，空间站也被拆解。毫无疑问，那地方的劳工主听到了我们行动的风声，你的行动缓慢给了他充足的时间把他的勾当转移到另一个星系。

希望那些劳工的命运成为你灵魂的重压。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Slave compound abandoned
messages.zh: 劳工集中营遭遗弃

name.ja: ウィルムスレイヤー作戦

messages.en: Oh, yeah, take out some Serpentis? For sure! I hate those guys!
messages.zh: 噢，干掉几个天蛇集团的人？当然愿意！我讨厌那些家伙！

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}. Do be careful, though. It won't be an easy job.
messages.zh: 我就知道你值得信赖，{[character]player.name}。不过，千万要小心。这不是个轻松的任务。

messages.en: Many thanks. I came as soon as I got your message. Is there something I can help you with?
messages.zh: 十分感谢。一收到你的信息，我马上就来了。有什么事需要我帮忙吗？

messages.en:
A couple of years ago, the Serpentis Corporation built a station out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and everyone in the constellation has been worried about it since. At first, as always with the Serpentis, things were fine ― they kept up a clean front and acted like a legitimate corporation. More recently, though, they've been pirating nearby gates and causing all kinds of problems for the local police forces. CONCORD intervention is minimal, of course, in low-sec, and they're always careful to make things seem like some other pirate group is responsible.

These raids must be stopped. And here's an interesting thing: Interstellar law states that an unoccupied station can be freely commandeered. And that Serpentis station apparently has some state-of-the-art tech that we'd like to get our hands on. So that's why I need you: {[character]player.name}, I want you to head out there and destroy every damned Serpentis you find there so we can go in and claim the station for our own.
messages.zh:
几年前，天蛇集团在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一个空间站，引起了星座区域内每个人的担忧，直到现在。就像天蛇集团的一贯做法一样，在刚开始时情况总是不错的——他们表面上举止正派，就像个合法的公司一样。可是就在最近，他们开始劫掠附近的星门，给当地警方制造了各种麻烦。当然，在低安全星系，统合部的介入是微乎其微的，而且天蛇集团的家伙们一直小心仔细地使事情看上去像是其他海盗团体所为。

必须制止他们的劫掠。还有件有趣的事是：星际法规定，无人所有的空间站可以被自由占用。那座天蛇空间站显然拥有一些我们很想弄到手的最先进技术。所以，这就是我需要你的原因：{[character]player.name}，我要你前往那里，消灭你发现的每个该死的天蛇集团成员，那样我们就可以进入并占领空间站了。

messages.en: The Serpentis station is defenseless. Good fight, that was.
messages.zh: 那个天蛇集团空间站毫无防备。真是漂亮的一仗。

messages.en: Ha! Well done! I knew you wouldn't let me down, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 哈！干得好！我就知道你不会让我失望的，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A Serpentis battle station, and you want me to go in there? Are you mad?! Uh... no! As if...!!
messages.zh: 一个天蛇集团的战役空间站，你想让我去那儿？你是不是疯了？！呃……不行！好像……！！

messages.en: Wow, take it easy. I just asked. No harm in asking, is there?
messages.zh: 哇噢，别紧张。我只是问问。问问没有害处，对吧？

messages.en:
The Serpentis Corporation was founded a few decades ago by V. Salvador Sarpati. At first a legitimate corporation, it was engaged in hi-tech research, but with time its ties to organized crime grew and the Serpentis research stations, scattered around in remote areas, became infamous pirate havens. Sarpati made a deal with the Angel Cartel early on to gain protection for his stations, and the duty was taken on by the Guardian Angels. Both sides have prospered enormously from this deal ― Serpentis can operate in peace, and the Angel Cartel gets access to the illegal research efforts of the Serpentis.

It is strongly believed that Serpentis is the largest developer and manufacturer of illegal neural boosters, especially since Sarpati's father was a renowned specialist in that field. The home of the Serpentis criminal organization is the Phoenix constellation in the Fountain region.
messages.zh:
天蛇集团数十年前由V.·萨尔瓦多·萨巴蒂创立。最初，它是个合法的公司，专门进行高科技研究。但是随着时间的推移，它与犯罪集团的联系愈发紧密，而那些散布在遥远区域中的天蛇科研空间站也成了声名狼藉的海盗庇护所。早年，萨巴蒂曾与天使企业联合体达成协议，后者将保护前者的空间站，该任务由守护天使执行。双方都从此项协议中获益匪浅——天蛇集团的运作可以不受干扰，而天使企业联合体有权使用天蛇集团的非法科研成果。

据信，天蛇集团是非法神经增效剂的最大开发商和生产商，而萨巴蒂的父亲曾是这一领域享有盛誉的专家，这更巩固了人们的想法。天蛇犯罪组织的老巢位于源泉之域的凤凰星座。

messages.en: The Serpentis Corporation
messages.zh: 天蛇军团

messages.en:
Yes, indeed. I think the job I have here requires someone of your unique talents.

A couple of years ago, the Serpentis Corporation built a station out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and everyone in the constellation has been worried about it since. At first, as always with the Serpentis, things were fine ― they kept up a clean front and acted like a legitimate corporation. More recently, though, they've been pirating nearby gates and causing all kinds of problems for the local police forces. CONCORD intervention is minimal, of course, in low-sec, and they're always careful to make things seem like some other pirate group is responsible.

These raids must be stopped. And here's an interesting thing: Interstellar law states that an unoccupied station can be freely commandeered. And that Serpentis station apparently has some state-of-the-art tech that we'd like to get our hands on. So that's why I need you: {[character]player.name}, I want you to head out there and destroy every damned Serpentis you find there so we can go in and claim the station for our own.

What do you think?
messages.zh:
是的，我想我手头的活需要你这样拥有独特才干的人。

几年前，天蛇集团在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一个空间站，引起了星座区域内每个人的担忧，直到现在。就像天蛇集团的一贯做法一样，在刚开始时情况总是不错的——他们表面上举止正派，就像个合法的公司一样。可是就在最近，他们开始劫掠附近的星门，给当地警方制造了各种麻烦。当然，在低安全等级地带，统合部的介入是微乎其微的，而且天蛇集团的家伙们一直仔细小心地使事情看上去像是其他海盗团体所为。

必须制止他们的劫掠。还有件有趣的事是：星际法规定，无人所有的空间站可以被自由占用。那座天蛇空间站显然拥有一些我们很想弄到手的最先进技术。所以，这就是我需要你的原因：{[character]player.name}，我要你前往那里，消灭你发现的每个该死的天蛇集团成员，那样我们就可以进入并占领空间站了。

你怎么想？

据侦察机消息，一支天蛇集团舰队已经抵达{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，来增援他们的空间站。他们一定是听到了风声。我现在取消这次任务——现在去的话无异于自尽。

我相信你没有立即赶去一定有充分的理由，但我们确实是失去了一个绝佳的机会。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: I've reconsidered your offer, and I've found it wanting. Sorry, I‘m out.
messages.zh: 我重新考虑了你的出价，我觉得它数目不够。抱歉，我不想干。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, this was our first real opportunity to strike back at those bloody pirates. I can't believe this!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，这是我们第一次真正有机会向那些该死的海盗反击。我真无法相信！

据侦察机消息，一支天蛇集团舰队已经抵达{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，来增援他们的空间站。他们一定是听到了风声。我现在取消这次任务——现在去的话无异于自尽。

我相信你没有立即赶去一定有充分的理由，但我们确实是失去了一个绝佳的机会。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

name.ja: ウィルムズベイン作戦

messages.en: Oh, yeah, take out some Serpentis? For sure! I hate those guys!
messages.zh: 噢，干掉几个天蛇集团的人？当然愿意！我讨厌那些家伙！

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}. Do be careful, though. It won't be an easy job.
messages.zh: 我就知道你值得信赖，{[character]player.name}。不过，千万要小心。这不是个轻松的任务。

messages.en: Many thanks. I came as soon as I got your message. Is there something I can help you with?
messages.zh: 十分感谢。一收到你的信息，我马上就来了。有什么事需要我帮忙吗？

messages.en:
A couple of years ago, the Serpentis Corporation built a station out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and everyone in the constellation has been worried about it since. At first, as always with the Serpentis, things were fine ― they kept up a clean front and acted like a legitimate corporation. More recently, though, they've been pirating nearby gates and causing all kinds of problems for the local police forces. CONCORD intervention is minimal, of course, in low-sec, and they're always careful to make things seem like some other pirate group is responsible.

These raids must be stopped. Like all pests, though, the only way to be sure you're rid of them is to exterminate them entirely, right at the source; if you just kill the ones you see crawling about, you're not accomplishing much. And that's why I need you: My scouts reported just yesterday that a large force of their ships left the base, off to raid nearby systems, so we can make a sudden strike at their home station while their defenses are down, and then clean up the rest later.

{[character]player.name}, I want you to head out there and destroy the Serpentis station, along with every damned Serpentis you find there. I imagine you're going to want a few good allies ships along with you, though; I'm sure their base will have reasonably strong defenses.
messages.zh:
几年前，天蛇集团在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一个空间站，引起了星座区域内每个人的担忧，直到现在。就像天蛇集团的一贯做法一样，在刚开始时情况总是不错的——他们表面上举止正派，就像个合法的公司一样。可是就在最近，他们开始劫掠附近的星门，给当地警方制造了各种麻烦。当然，在低安全等级地带，统合部的介入是微乎其微的，而且天蛇集团的家伙们一直仔细小心地使事情看上去像是其他海盗团体所为。

必须制止他们的劫掠。可是，就像对付所有害虫一样，唯一能确保将他们消灭干净的方法就是把他们在发源地彻底根绝；如果只干掉一些四处爬行的家伙，那么成果实在有限。而这正是我需要你的原因：我的侦察机昨天刚刚报告说，一支舰队离开了他们的基地，前去袭击附近的星系，因此我们可以趁他们老巢的防御减弱时发动突袭，然后再消灭余孽。

{[character]player.name}，我要你前往那里，摧毁天蛇集团空间站，并消灭你发现的每个该死的天蛇集团成员。不过，我想你还需要一些强大的友军飞船与你同行；我肯定他们基地的防御不是吃素的。

messages.en: The Serpentis station is toast. And I loved every second of it.
messages.zh: 那个天蛇集团空间站被烤焦了。我很享受干这活的每一秒钟。

messages.en: Ha! Well done! I knew you wouldn't let me down, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 哈！干得好！我就知道你不会让我失望的，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A Serpentis battle station, and you want me to go in there? Are you mad?! Uh... no! As if...!!
messages.zh: 一个天蛇集团的战役空间站，你想让我去那儿？你是不是疯了？！呃……不行！好像……！！

messages.en: Wow, take it easy. I just asked. No harm in asking, is there?
messages.zh: 哇噢，别紧张。我只是问问。问问没有害处，对吧？

messages.en:
The Serpentis Corporation was founded a few decades ago by V. Salvador Sarpati. At first a legitimate corporation, it was engaged in hi-tech research, but with time its ties to organized crime grew and the Serpentis research stations, scattered around in remote areas, became infamous pirate havens. Sarpati made a deal with the Angel Cartel early on to gain protection for his stations, and the duty was taken on by the Guardian Angels. Both sides have prospered enormously from this deal ― Serpentis can operate in peace, and the Angel Cartel gets access to the illegal research efforts of the Serpentis.

It is strongly believed that Serpentis is the largest developer and manufacturer of illegal neural boosters, especially since Sarpati's father was a renowned specialist in that field. The home of the Serpentis criminal organization is the Phoenix constellation in the Fountain region.
messages.zh:
天蛇集团数十年前由V.·萨尔瓦多·萨巴蒂创立。最初，它是个合法的公司，专门进行高科技研究。但是随着时间的推移，它与犯罪集团的联系愈发紧密，而那些散布在遥远区域中的天蛇科研空间站也成了声名狼藉的海盗庇护所。早年，萨巴蒂曾与天使企业联合体达成协议，后者将保护前者的空间站，该任务由守护天使执行。双方都从此项协议中获益匪浅——天蛇集团的运作可以不受干扰，而天使企业联合体有权使用天蛇集团的非法科研成果。

据信，天蛇集团是非法神经增效剂的最大开发商和生产商，而萨巴蒂的父亲曾是这一领域享有盛誉的专家，这更巩固了人们的想法。天蛇犯罪组织的老巢位于源泉之域的凤凰星座。

messages.en: The Serpentis Corporation
messages.zh: 天蛇军团

messages.en:
Yes, indeed. I think the job I have here requires someone of your unique talents.

A couple of years ago, the Serpentis Corporation built a station out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and everyone in the constellation has been worried about it since. At first, as always with the Serpentis, things were fine ― they kept up a clean front and acted like a legitimate corporation. More recently, though, they've been pirating nearby gates and causing all kinds of problems for the local police forces. CONCORD intervention is minimal, of course, in low-sec, and they're always careful to make things seem like some other pirate group is responsible.

These raids must be stopped. Like all pests, though, the only way to be sure you're rid of them is to exterminate them entirely, right at the source; if you just kill the ones you see crawling about, you're not accomplishing much. And that's why I need you: My scouts reported just yesterday that a large force of their ships left the base, off to raid nearby systems, so we can make a sudden strike at their home station while their defenses are down, and then clean up the rest later.

{[character]player.name}, I want you to head out there and destroy the Serpentis station, along with every damned Serpentis you find there.
messages.zh:
是的，的确。我这里有个活儿就需要像你这样有才干的人才能做。

{[character]player.name}，我要你前往那里，摧毁天蛇集团空间站，并消灭你发现的每个该死的天蛇集团成员。

据侦察机消息，天蛇舰队已经返回他们位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的空间站。我现在取消行动——现在过去无异于自尽。

我相信你没有立即赶去一定有充分的理由，但我们确实是失去了一个绝佳的机会。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: On second thought, you‘d need a squad of dreadnoughts and assault frigates to take down a battlestation! I quit.
messages.zh: 细想了一下，要干掉一个全副武装的战役空间站，你最好需要一个小队的无畏舰和突击护卫舰！我退出。我不干了。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, this was our first real opportunity to strike back at those bloody pirates. Well, so be it. Their time will come.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，这是我们第一次真正有机会向那些该死的海盗反击。好吧，这事只能作罢。他们的死期迟早会到。

据侦察机消息，天蛇舰队已经返回他们位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的空间站。我现在取消行动——现在过去无异于自尽。

我相信你没有立即赶去一定有充分的理由，但我们确实是失去了一个绝佳的机会。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

name.ja: ウィルムスレイヤー作戦

messages.en: Oh, yeah, take out some Serpentis? For sure! I hate those guys!
messages.zh: 噢，干掉几个天蛇集团的人？当然愿意！我讨厌那些家伙！

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}. Do be careful, though. It won't be an easy job.
messages.zh: 我就知道你值得信赖，{[character]player.name}。不过，千万要小心。这不是个轻松的任务。

messages.en: Many thanks. I came as soon as I got your message. Is there something I can help you with?
messages.zh: 十分感谢。一收到你的信息，我马上就来了。有什么事需要我帮忙吗？

Like all pests, though, the only way to be sure you're rid of them is to exterminate them entirely, right at the source; if you just kill the ones you see crawling about, you're not accomplishing much. And that's why I need you: My scouts reported just yesterday that a large force of their ships left the base, off to raid nearby systems, so we can make a sudden strike at their home station while their defenses are down, and then clean up the rest later.

{[character]player.name}, I want you to head out there and destroy the Serpentis station, along with every damned Serpentis you find there.
messages.zh:
是的，的确。我这里有个活儿就需要像你这样有才干的人才能做。

几年前，天蛇集团在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一个空间站，引起了星座区域内每个人的担忧，直到现在。就像天蛇集团的一贯做法一样，在刚开始时情况总是不错的——他们表面上举止正派，就像个合法的公司一样。可是就在最近，他们开始劫掠附近的星门，给当地警方制造了各种麻烦。当然，在低安全等级地带，统合部的介入是微乎其微的，而且天蛇集团的家伙们一直仔细小心地使事情看上去像是其他海盗团体所为。

必须制止他们的劫掠。可是，就像对付所有害虫一样，唯一能确保将他们消灭干净的方法就是把他们在发源地彻底根绝；如果只干掉一些四处爬行的家伙，那么成果实在有限。而这正是我需要你的原因：我的侦察机昨天刚刚报告说，一支舰队离开了他们的基地，前去袭击附近的星系，因此我们可以趁他们老巢的防御减弱时发动突袭，然后再消灭余孽。

{[character]player.name}，我要你前往那里，摧毁天蛇集团空间站，并消灭你发现的每个该死的天蛇集团成员。

据侦察机消息，天蛇舰队已经返回他们位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的空间站。我现在取消行动——现在过去无异于自尽。

我相信你没有立即赶去一定有充分的理由，但我们确实是失去了一个绝佳的机会。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: On second thought, you‘d need a squad of dreadnoughts and assault frigates to take down a battlestation! I quit.
messages.zh: 细想了一下，要干掉一个全副武装的战役空间站，你最好需要一个小队的无畏舰和突击护卫舰！我退出。我不干了。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, this was our first real opportunity to strike back at those bloody pirates. Well, so be it. Their time will come.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，这是我们第一次真正有机会向那些该死的海盗反击。好吧，这事只能作罢。他们的死期迟早会到。

据侦察机消息，天蛇舰队已经返回他们位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的空间站。我现在取消行动——现在过去无异于自尽。

我相信你没有立即赶去一定有充分的理由，但我们确实是失去了一个绝佳的机会。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stand down
messages.zh: 退出任务

messages.en: Sansha prisoners, eh? Well, I can set my cargo bay to keep them in cryo-containment, I suppose. Sure, I'm in.
messages.zh: 萨沙俘虏，哦？好吧，我想我可以整理一下货柜舱然后把他们放在冬眠舱里。当然，我接受。

messages.en: Excellent. I'll await your return with bated breath … and a heap of ISK.
messages.zh: 非常好。我会耐心等待你的归来……等待你的还有一大堆星币。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]agentID.name}. I trust you are well. You have some work for me?
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]agentID.name}。别来无恙啊。你有什么工作给我吗？

messages.en:
Some of the top cybernetics experts in the region were recently here at {[location]agentStationID.name} for a conference, and they made me a proposal that I found quite intriguing. These scientists theorize that the Sansha mindslave technology is leaps ahead of anything we currently have in the realm of cerebro-emission communications. You might call what they've got a sort of limited telepathy, I suppose. Anyway, these scientists were having heated arguments about the risks and benefits of toying with Sansha tech. And that's where it gets interesting.

A handful of them approached me after the conference and spoke of a Sansha base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that they had learned of. They asked if I knew any ships' captains who might be interested in “acquiring” a few Sansha mindslaves for them to experiment on. Now, a friend in the Admiralty tells me the Navy is apparently planning to move against this station very soon, so our window of opportunity is narrow. We'd be doing the authorities a favor, and getting a little something on the side.

Destroy a Sansha tower and pick up some prisoners. What could be easier?
messages.zh:
本星域一些顶尖的控制论专家最近在{[location]agentStationID.name}开会，他们向我提出了一项相当有趣的计划。这些科学家推测，萨沙的心奴技术在脑波通讯领域远远领先于我们掌握的任何技术。你不妨称他们拥有某种有限的心灵感应。这些科学家就使用萨沙技术的风险和利益展开了激烈讨论。而那就是事情变得有趣的地方。

他们中的几个人在会后找到我，并提起了他们所知的一个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的萨沙基地。他们问我是否认识任何舰船船长，可能会有兴趣为他们“获得”一些萨沙心奴以供他们实验研究。但是，海军部的一个朋友告诉我，海军计划不久对这个空间站发起行动，所以我们的机会有限。我们可以帮当局一个忙，顺带自己也弄些东西。

摧毁一个萨沙塔楼，并带几个俘虏回来。还有比这更简单的吗？

messages.en: The Sansha Battletower is no more, {[character]agentID.name}, and the prisoners are here in station.
messages.zh: 萨沙战斗塔已经不复存在了，{[character]agentID.name}，俘虏就在空间站。

messages.en: Well done. I'll send the reward directly to your Interstellar account.
messages.zh: 干得好！我会把酬劳直接打入你的星际帐户。

messages.en: I don't think I care to bring Sansha aboard my ship, thanks very much. No, find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不愿意将萨沙人带上我的飞船，谢谢你的提议。不了，还是找别人吧。

messages.en: I understand your reticence, but think of the ISK! Ah, well, your loss.
messages.zh: 我理解你为什么不愿意，但是想想那笔星币！啊，好吧，这是你的损失。

messages.en:
I do, yes. It's quite sensitive, actually, so I'd appreciate it if this matter remained between us. Some of the top cybernetics experts in the region were recently here at {[location]agentStationID.name} for a conference, and they made me a proposal that I found quite intriguing.

These scientists theorize that the Sansha mindslave technology is leaps ahead of anything we currently have in the realm of cerebro-emission communications. You might call what they've got a sort of limited telepathy, I suppose. Anyway, these scientists were having heated arguments about the risks and benefits of toying with Sansha tech. And that's where it gets interesting.

A handful of them approached me after the conference and spoke of a Sansha base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that they had learned of. They asked if I knew any ships' captains who might be interested in “acquiring” a few Sansha mindslaves for them to experiment on. Now, a friend in the Admiralty tells me the Navy is apparently planning to move against this station very soon, so our window of opportunity is narrow. We'd be doing the authorities a favor, and getting a little something on the side.

So what do you think? Sound like something you're interested in? Destroy a Sansha tower and pick up some prisoners. What could be easier?
messages.zh:
是的，我确实有。实际上，这件事很敏感，所以如果你能保密的话，我会非常感激的。本星域一些顶尖的控制论专家最近在{[location]agentStationID.name}开会，他们向我提出了一项相当有趣的计划。

这些科学家推测，萨沙的心奴技术在脑波通讯领域远远领先于我们掌握的任何技术。你不妨称他们拥有某种有限的心灵感应。这些科学家就使用萨沙技术的风险和利益展开了激烈讨论。而那就是事情变得有趣的地方。

他们中的几个人在会后找到我，并提起了他们所知的一个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的萨沙基地。他们问我是否认识任何舰船船长，可能会有兴趣为他们“获得”一些萨沙心奴以供他们实验研究。但是，海军部的一个朋友告诉我，海军计划不久对这个空间站发起行动，所以我们的机会有限。我们可以帮当局一个忙，顺带自己也弄些东西。

那么，你觉得呢？听起来是你感兴趣的事吗？摧毁一个萨沙塔楼，并带几个俘虏回来。还有比这更简单的吗？

{[character]player.name}，

由于你的行动缓慢，我不得不另雇一小队私掠船去获取{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的萨沙俘虏。幸好你不是附近唯一能干的星际飞船船长。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Opportunity lost ― for you
messages.zh: 机会丢失——对你而言

messages.en: I think I'd rather not finish this mission. Sorry, second thoughts: Sansha are too creepy.
messages.zh: 我想我宁愿不完成这项任务。抱歉，这是经过深思熟虑的：萨沙人太恐怖了。

messages.en: Blast it! Oh, fine. I'm sure I can find someone else to share the reward with me.
messages.zh: 真该死！噢，好吧。我相信我能找到别人与我分享这笔赏金。

{[character]player.name}，

很不幸，海军介入了，他们摧毁了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的萨沙战斗塔。又一个黄金机会溜走了，飘入寒冷的宇宙真空。我想，这就是生活吧。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Opportunity lost
messages.zh: 机会丢失

messages.en: Sure, seems easy enough. I assume the ISK's good, as usual?
messages.zh: 当然，看起来够简单的了。我猜星币也跟以往一样不错吧？

messages.en: Yes, of course. You might run into some trouble out there, so be careful.
messages.zh: 是的，当然。你在那里可能会遇到点麻烦，所以小心点。

messages.en: Good day, {[character]agentID.name}. A pleasure to be back here at the {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} offices. Anything new?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}。回到{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}办公室真的很愉快。有什么新任务吗？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, an employee of ours, Solen Sagul, has been acting a little odd lately; he comes and goes at strange hours and doesn't say where he is going or where he's been, but he often takes company ships and disappears for days at a time. We are lucky if he shows up for meetings, and when he does appear he utters the strangest things, completely inappropriate and ... well, just unsettling. We could deal with it if we thought he was just insane, but we are afraid it's more than that.

You've heard those stories about people taken alive into rogue drone hives? Well, one of Sagul's co-workers claims he heard the man muttering something about “the hive mother” and “the song of the drones.” We need to be sure that Sagul has not been ... taken by the drones. We had security look around in his logs and they found this location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that he's visited several times in the past months. It's a dark, nasty part of space, though, and I can't send just anyone: Maybe you can take a look and tell us what you find.

Oh, and if you do find anything remarkable there, I need you to get in close and have a good look before you report back to me.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我们的一个雇员索伦·萨古尔最近行为很古怪；他总是在不正常的时间到来或离开，从不透露他要去哪里或者去过那里，而且经常乘坐公司的飞船一下子失踪好几天。要是他开会的时候能出现，那么就已经很了不得了。而每次他真的出席会议的时候，又总是讲些古怪透顶的话，完全不合时宜……呃，让人有点儿不安。如果他只是精神错乱了，我们倒可以处理这件事，不过恐怕事情不止那么简单。

你听说过活人被吸入无人机母巢的事情吧？呃，萨古尔的一个同事说曾听到他嘀咕一些有关“母巢”和“无人机之歌”的事情。我们需要确定萨古尔是否被……无人机控制。我们让保安人员查看了他的航行日志，他们发现他在过去几个月去了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}好几次。那是空间中的一个阴暗、肮脏的部分，所以，我不能随便派人前往：也许你可以去看看，然后告诉我们你发现了什么。

噢，如果你真的在那里发现了任何不一般的东西，我要你靠近并仔细观察，然后再向我报告。

messages.en: Well, you were certainly right about the drones: There were a ton of them out there, along with some kind of huge structure. I cleaned the place out, though, so no worries.
messages.zh: 嗯，你对无人机的看法完全正确：那里有成群的无人机，还有一种巨型建筑。不过，我还是把那里铲平了，所以不用担心了。

messages.en: Well, that's good news. But I have bad news too. Just give me a moment to finish up here and I'll explain...
messages.zh: 唔，真是好消息。但我还有一个坏消息。先让我把手上的事情忙完，然后我会解释的……

messages.en: People taken by drones? Yeah, right. No, I think I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 人类被无人机控制？是啊，就像真的一样。不了，这项任务我不干。

messages.en: Fine, be that way. But I assure you, there's more to these stories than most would care to admit.
messages.zh: 好吧，就那样吧。但我向你保证，这些故事远不止人们愿意相信的那么简单。

messages.en:
Oh, not much, really... er, well, now, wait! Actually, that's not entirely true. In fact, maybe this is something you could help me out with ― I don't know why I didn't think of you sooner.

{[character]player.name}, an employee of ours, Solen Sagul, has been acting a little odd lately; he comes and goes at strange hours and doesn't say where he is going or where he's been, but he often takes company ships and disappears for days at a time. We are lucky if he shows up for meetings, and when he does appear he utters the strangest things, completely inappropriate and ... well, just unsettling. We could deal with it if we thought he was just insane, but we are afraid it's more than that.

You've heard those stories about people taken alive into rogue drone hives? Well, one of Sagul's co-workers claims he heard the man muttering something about “the hive mother” and “the song of the drones.” We need to be sure that Sagul has not been ... taken by the drones. We had security look around in his logs and they found this location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that he's visited several times in the past months. It's a dark, nasty part of space, though, and I can't send just anyone: Maybe you can take a look and tell us what you find.

Oh, and if you do find anything remarkable there, I need you to get in close and have a good look before you report back to me.
messages.zh:
哦，没什么活，真的……呃，好吧，喂，等等！事实上，情况并不完全是这样。实际上，可能这里有些你也许能帮我解决的事情——我不知道我怎么没有早点想到你。

{[character]player.name}，我们的一个雇员索伦·萨古尔最近行为很古怪；他总是在不正常的时间到来或离开，从不透露他要去哪里或者去过那里，而且经常乘坐公司的飞船一下子失踪好几天。要是他开会的时候能出现，那么就已经很了不得了。而每次他真的出席会议的时候，又总是讲些古怪透顶的话，完全不合时宜……呃，让人有点儿不安。如果他只是精神错乱了，我们倒可以处理这件事，不过恐怕事情不止那么简单。

你听说过活人被吸入无人机母巢的事情吧？呃，萨古尔的一个同事说曾听到他嘀咕一些有关“母巢”和“无人机之歌”的事情。我们需要确定萨古尔是否被……无人机控制。我们让保安人员查看了他的航行日志，他们发现他在过去几个月去了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}好几次。那是空间中的一个阴暗、肮脏的部分，所以，我不能随便派人前往：也许你可以去看看，然后告诉我们你发现了什么。

噢，如果你真的在那里发现了任何不一般的东西，我要你靠近并仔细观察，然后再向我报告。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Unfortunately, Solen Sagul has disappeared entirely. Because I hadn‘t heard anything from you, I hired a recon ship to go check the location I told you about in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; there were signs of drone activity there, but little else. I guess, if there was something more there, it‘s gone now.

I‘m sure you have good reason for not getting this job done on time, but in the future ... do try to be a little more prompt.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

不幸的是，索伦·萨古尔彻底失踪了。由于我没有得到你的任何回复，我雇了一艘侦察舰去调查我所说的位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的地点；那里有些无人机活动的迹象，不过没有别的什么了。我想，即使那里曾经有更多的东西，现在也已经不存在了。

我相信你没能按时完成任务一定有充分的理由，不过以后……请务必动作迅速点。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Abort mission
messages.zh: 任务中止

messages.en: This is crazy, {[character]agentID.name}. I can't finish this job for you.
messages.zh: 这事太疯狂了，{[character]agentID.name}。我不能替你完成这个工作。

messages.en: You know, a quitter is just another kind of loser.
messages.zh: 你知道吗，退出者只是另一种失败者。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Unfortunately, Solen Sagul has disappeared entirely. Because I hadn‘t heard anything from you, I hired a recon ship to go check the location I told you about in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; there were signs of drone activity there, but little else. I guess, if there was something more there, it‘s gone now.

I‘m sure you have good reason for not getting this job done on time, but in the future ... do try to be a little more prompt.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

不幸的是，索伦·萨古尔彻底失踪了。由于我没有得到你的任何回复，我雇了一艘侦察舰去调查我所说的位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的地点；那里有些无人机活动的迹象，不过没有别的什么了。我想，即使那里曾经有更多的东西，现在也已经不存在了。

我相信你没能按时完成任务一定有充分的理由，不过以后……请务必动作迅速点。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Abort mission
messages.zh: 任务中止

messages.en: Sansha prisoners, eh? Well, I can set my cargo bay to keep them in cryo-containment, I suppose. Sure, I'm in.
messages.zh: 萨沙俘虏，哦？好吧，我想我可以整理一下货柜舱然后把他们放在冬眠舱里。当然，我接受。

messages.en: Excellent. I'll look forward to your victorious return.
messages.zh: 很好。我等待你胜利归来。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]agentID.name}. I trust you are well. You have some work for me?
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]agentID.name}。别来无恙啊。你有什么工作给我吗？

messages.en:
It seems some cybernetics experts among the Caldari and the god-fearing Amarr have recently made efforts to acquire Sansha mindslave technology. Now, we don't know what they're after, specifically, but we can't afford to let them jump ahead of us. We have a couple of sympathizers among them who we think we can convince to defect, so maybe they can keep us up to date on what has transpired with this Sansha research.

Anyway, we know of a Sansha base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and a friend of mine in the Admiralty tells me the Navy is apparently planning to move against this base very soon, so I've devised a plan. Our window of opportunity is narrow, so you'd need to be ready to move fast. We'd be doing the authorities a favor, and allowing our people to remain abreast of the most current scientific theory.

You seem a little confused. Oh, I guess I haven't really filled you in on my little brainstorm… Heh. Ok, here it is: Go out there, destroy the Sansha tower, and pick up some prisoners to bring back here. Easy enough, right?
messages.zh:
加达里和艾玛的一些顶尖控制论专家正努力获取萨沙的心奴技术。我不知道他们为了什么，但是很明确的是，不能让他们超越我们。在他们之中有些人的思想与我们是有共鸣的，我相信是可以说服他们站在我们这边，他们可以让我们及时了解萨沙的研究进展。

而且，我了解在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的萨沙基地，海军部的一个朋友告诉我，海军计划不久对这个基地发起行动，所以我已经在设计方案了。我们的机会有限，所以你要尽快准备出发。我们可以帮当局一个忙，顺便也让我们的人了解一些当下的科学理论。

看来，你似乎有些迷茫了。噢，我猜你可能没有彻底领悟我的意思……好吧，我的意思是：离开这里，摧毁萨沙塔楼，并带几个俘虏回来。很简单，对吧？

messages.en: The Sansha Battletower is no more, {[character]agentID.name}, and the prisoners are here in station.
messages.zh: 萨沙战斗塔已经不复存在了，{[character]agentID.name}，俘虏就在空间站。

messages.en: Fine work. I've managed to scrape together a suitable reward for your work. Thanks, my friend.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。我会帮你争取一笔合适的报酬。谢谢你，朋友。

messages.en: I don't think I care to bring Sansha aboard my ship, thanks very much. No, find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不愿意将萨沙人带上我的飞船，谢谢你的提议。不了，还是找别人吧。

messages.en: I understand your reticence, but think of the benefit to science! Ah, well, forget it, then. I'll find someone…
messages.zh: 我理解你为什么不愿意，但是想想这对科学的贡献！啊，好吧，那就算了。我再找别人……

messages.en:
I do, yes. It's quite sensitive, actually, so I'd appreciate it if this matter remained between us. It seems some cybernetics experts among the Caldari and the god-fearing Amarr have recently made efforts to acquire Sansha mindslave technology. Now, we don't know what they're after, specifically, but we can't afford to let them jump ahead of us. We have a couple of sympathizers among them who we think we can convince to defect, so maybe they can keep us up to date on what has transpired with this Sansha research.

Anyway, we know of a Sansha base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and a friend of mine in the Admiralty tells me the Navy is apparently planning to move against this base very soon, so I've devised a plan. Our window of opportunity is narrow, so you'd need to be ready to move fast. We'd be doing the authorities a favor, and allowing our people to remain abreast of the most current scientific theory.

You seem a little confused. Oh, I guess I haven't really filled you in on my little brainstorm… Heh. Ok, here it is: Go out there, destroy the Sansha tower, and pick up some prisoners to bring back here. Easy enough, right?
messages.zh:
是的，我确实有。实际上，这件事很敏感，所以如果你能保密的话，我会非常感激的。加达里和艾玛的一些顶尖控制论专家正努力获取萨沙的心奴技术。我不知道他们为了什么，但是很明确的是，不能让他们超越我们。在他们之中有些人的思想与我们是有共鸣的，我相信是可以说服他们站在我们这边，他们可以让我们及时了解萨沙的研究进展。

而且，我了解在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的萨沙基地，海军部的一个朋友告诉我，海军计划不久对这个基地发起行动，所以我已经在设计方案了。我们的机会有限，所以你要尽快准备出发。我们可以帮当局一个忙，顺便也让我们的人了解一些当下的科学理论。

看来，你似乎有些迷茫了。噢，我猜你可能没有彻底领悟我的意思……好吧，我的意思是：离开这里，摧毁萨沙塔楼，并带几个俘虏回来。很简单，对吧？

messages.en:
Sorry, {[character]player.name}, but I had to hire some mercenaries to get the Sansha prisoners from {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} before the Navy got in there. My apologies, but you were simply taking too long.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，对不起，但是在海军抵达那里之前，我不得不雇佣些雇佣军去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，把萨沙俘虏带出来。我很抱歉，但是你占用的时间太长了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Job completed
messages.zh: 任务完成

messages.en: I think I'd rather not finish this mission. Sorry, second thoughts: Sansha are too creepy.
messages.zh: 我想我宁愿不完成这项任务。抱歉，这是经过深思熟虑的：萨沙人太恐怖了。

messages.en: Blast it! Oh, fine. I'm sure I can find someone else to assist me in this.
messages.zh: 真该死！噢，好吧。我相信我能找到别人来帮我一把。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Unfortunately, the Navy moved in and obliterated the Sansha Battletower in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I guess there are always more Sansha, though.

Oh, that's an awful thought…

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

很不幸，海军介入了，他们摧毁了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的萨沙战斗塔。不过我猜肯定还有不少萨沙人。

噢，这个想法太可怕了……

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Opportunity lost
messages.zh: 机会丢失

messages.en: I don't want to think about what might happen if the rogue drones get their hands on those design sketches. I'll take care of this, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 如果这些无人机掌握了那些设计草图，我不敢设想将会发生什么。我会搞定这事的，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Excellent. I won't say I'm relieved, at least not yet, but I am glad you're on this job. Be careful: Those drones are sure to put up a hell of a fight.
messages.zh: 很好。我不能说已经放心了，至少现在还不能，但是我很高兴你能做这个工作。当心点：那些无人机肯定会拼死一战的。

messages.en: Thanks. You seem worried. What's the problem?
messages.zh: 谢谢。你看起来很担心。出什么事了？

messages.en:
Solen Sagul found a way to sneak back into the research facility here in {[location]agentStationID.name}; he got the help of some old friends in the corporation who had no idea he is ... changed. The problem is that he managed to slip out with copies of some preliminary design documents for a prototype battleship that's going to be built here in the station next year. I take it I don't have to tell you how valuable these documents are, nor what would happen if they fall into the wrong hands.

Now, we managed to get a tracking beacon painted onto Sagul's ship as he blasted out of here, and one of our scanning engineers was then able to track him to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We sent a recon pilot out there, and she was able to pick up some heavy drone activity. We need those copies of the design documents destroyed, {[character]player.name}, along with Sagul and all of his “friends.” If you get out there and he isn't around, don't worry: He's bound to show his face out there eventually.
messages.zh:
索伦·萨古尔设法重新潜回了{[location]agentStationID.name}这里的研究设施；他得到了军团中一些老朋友的帮助，他们压根不知道他已经……变了。问题是，他带着一架原型战列舰的相关初步设计文档的拷贝溜了，这架战列舰将于明年在本空间站建造。不用我说你也知道这些文档的价值，而且你也知道如果它们落入居心叵测之人手中会发生些什么。

在萨古尔从这里炸开一条出路时，我们趁机在他的船上涂上了一种追踪信标，我们的一位扫描工程师成功地追踪到他逃往了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。然后，我们派去了一位侦察员，她发现那里有大量无人机的活动。我们需要销毁所有那些设计文档拷贝，{[character]player.name}，同时把萨古尔和他所有的“朋友”也都干掉。如果你到那里发现他不在附近，别担心：他迟早会在那里露面。

messages.en: Yeah, you weren't kidding when you said you'd give me coordinates to the “locus of drone activity.” They were all over me. Or maybe they knew I was coming...?
messages.zh: 是啊，你说要给我“无人机活动地点”的坐标时，你不是开玩笑。它们到处都是，一起向我进攻。可能它们知道我要来……？

messages.en: Now that’s one hell of a thought. No, how could they know?! No, we'll just call it good reconnaissance. The alternative is too frightening. Anyway, don't go far; this isn't over yet.
messages.zh: 那真是个可怕的想法。不，他们怎么会知道的？！不，我们只能称其为出色的侦察。如果他们采取别的行动就太可怕了。无论如何，别走远；事情还没有结束。

messages.en: I'm sick to hell of these drones. No, I'm going to go take a vacation with some good old-fashioned holoreels.
messages.zh: 这些无人机让我恶心透了。不了，我正打算带一些经典老式的全息记忆盘去度假。

messages.en: Do you not care about the danger these drones pose if they can control people and steal our most advanced starship plans?! This isn't day-camp, pilot!
messages.zh: 如果这些无人机能够控制人类并获得我们最先进的星际飞船计划，那么他们将带来多大的危险啊！你一点儿也不在乎吗？！这不是夏令营，飞行员！

Solen Sagul found a way to sneak back into the research facility here in {[location]agentStationID.name}; he got the help of some old friends in the corporation who had no idea he is ... changed. Now, we've dealt with the employees who helped him, but we can't find Sagul himself. The problem is that he managed to slip out with copies of some preliminary design documents for a prototype battleship that's going to be built here in the station next year. I take it I don't have to tell you how valuable these documents are, nor what would happen if they fall into the wrong hands.

Now, we managed to get a tracking beacon painted onto Sagul's ship as he blasted out of here, and one of our scanning engineers was then able to track him to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We sent a recon pilot out there, and she was able to pick up some heavy drone activity; I'll upload the exact coordinates of the locus of that activity to your NeoCom for you in just a sec.

We need those copies of the design documents destroyed, {[character]player.name}, along with Sagul and all of his “friends.” If you get out there and he isn't around, don't worry: He's bound to show his face out there eventually.

我们需要销毁所有那些设计文档拷贝，{[character]player.name}，同时把萨古尔和他所有的“朋友”也都干掉。如果你到那里发现他不在附近，别担心：他迟早会在那里露面。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Unfortunately, Solen Sagul has disappeared entirely, and with him the battleship plans. Because I hadn‘t heard anything from you, I hired a recon ship to go check the location I told you about in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; there were signs of drone activity there, but little else. I guess, if there was something more there, it‘s gone now.

Let us pray that we‘ve seen the end of these drones... but I fear the worst.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

不幸的是，索伦·萨古尔彻底失踪了，还带着战列舰的计划。由于我没有得到你的任何回复，我雇了一艘侦察舰去调查我所说的位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的地点；那里有些无人机活动的迹象，不过没有别的什么了。我想，即使那里曾经有更多的东西，现在也已经不存在了。

让我们祈祷再也不要看到这些无人机了……但是我担心可能会发生最糟的事情。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Solen Sagul escaped
messages.zh: 索伦·萨古尔逃脱

messages.en: I'm done with this crappy job and I'm leaving, {[character]agentID.name}, and I don't think you'll want to try to stop me.
messages.zh: 我受够了这个垃圾任务，我要走了，{[character]agentID.name}，你最好别拦我。

messages.en: Wha― Whe― Why? What? Is that a threat?! You may be a capsuleer, {[character]player.name}, but you're not a god! Remember that!

在阿迪偌从这里炸开一条出路时，我们趁机在他的船上涂上了一种追踪信标，我们的一位扫描工程师成功地追踪到他逃往了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。然后，我们派去了一位侦察员，她发现那里有大量无人机的活动；我很快会把无人机活动位置的具体坐标上传到你的控制边栏。

我们需要销毁所有那些设计文档拷贝，{[character]player.name}，同时把阿迪偌和他所有的“朋友”也都干掉。如果你到那里发现他不在附近，别担心：他迟早会在那里露面。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Unfortunately, Milena Adiras has disappeared entirely, and with her the battleship plans. Because I hadn‘t heard anything from you, I hired a recon ship to go check the location I told you about in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; there were signs of drone activity there, but little else. I guess, if there was something more there, it‘s gone now.

Let us pray that we‘ve seen the end of these drones... but I fear the worst.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

不幸的是，米蕾娜·阿迪拉斯彻底失踪了，还带着战列舰的计划。由于我没有得到你的任何回复，我雇了一艘侦察舰去调查我所说的位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的地点；那里有些无人机活动的迹象，不过没有别的什么了。我想，即使那里曾经有更多的东西，现在也已经不存在了。

让我们祈祷再也不要看到这些无人机了……但是我担心可能会发生最糟的事情。

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Milena Adiras escaped
messages.zh: 米雷纳·阿迪偌逃脱

messages.en: I'm done with this crappy job and I'm leaving, {[character]agentID.name}, and I don't think you'll want to try to stop me.
messages.zh: 我受够了这个垃圾任务，我要走了，{[character]agentID.name}，你最好别拦我。

messages.en: Wha― Whe― Why? What? Is that a threat?! You may be a capsuleer, {[character]player.name}, but you're not a god! Remember that!
messages.zh: 什——哪——为什么？什么？这算是威胁吗？！{[character]player.name}，你也许是个飞行员，但不是神！给我记住！

messages.en: I don't want to think about what might happen if the rogue drones get their hands on those design sketches. I'll take care of this, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 如果这些无人机掌握了那些设计草图，我不敢设想将会发生什么。我会搞定这事的，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Excellent. I won't say I'm relieved, at least not yet, but I am glad you're on this job. Be careful: Those drones are sure to put up a hell of a fight.
messages.zh: 很好。我不能说已经放心了，至少现在还不能，但是我很高兴你能做这个工作。当心点：那些无人机肯定会拼死一战的。

messages.en: Thanks. You seem worried. What's the problem?
messages.zh: 谢谢。你看起来很担心。出什么事了？

messages.en:
Inettria Volur found a way to sneak back into the research facility here in {[location]agentStationID.name}; she got the help of some old friends in the corporation who had no idea she's ... changed. The problem is that she managed to slip out with copies of some preliminary design documents for a prototype battleship that's going to be built here in the station next year. I take it I don't have to tell you how valuable these documents are, nor what would happen if they fall into the wrong hands.

Now, we managed to get a tracking beacon painted onto Volur's ship as she blasted out of here, and one of our scanning engineers was then able to track her to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We sent a recon pilot out there, and he was able to pick up some heavy drone activity. We need those copies of the design documents destroyed, {[character]player.name}, along with Volur and all of her “friends.” If you get out there and she isn't around, don't worry: She's bound to show her face out there eventually.
messages.zh:
印塔·沃鲁设法重新潜回了{[location]agentStationID.name}这里的研究设施；他得到了军团中一些老朋友的帮助，他们压根不知道他已经……变了。问题是，他带着一架原型战列舰的相关初步设计文档的拷贝溜了，这架战列舰将于明年在本空间站建造。不用我说你也知道这些文档的价值，而且你也知道如果它们落入居心叵测之人手中会发生些什么。

在沃鲁从这里炸开一条出路时，我们趁机在他的船上涂上了一种追踪信标，我们的一位扫描工程师成功地追踪到他逃往了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。然后，我们派去了一位侦察员，她发现那里有大量无人机的活动。我们需要销毁所有那些设计文档拷贝，{[character]player.name}，同时把沃鲁和他所有的“朋友”也都干掉。如果你到那里发现他不在附近，别担心：他迟早会在那里露面。

messages.en: Yeah, you weren't kidding when you said you'd give me coordinates to the “locus of drone activity.” They were all over me. Or maybe they knew I was coming...?
messages.zh: 是啊，你说要给我“无人机活动地点”的坐标时，你不是开玩笑。它们到处都是，一起向我进攻。可能它们知道我要来……？

messages.en: Now that’s one hell of a thought. No, how could they know?! No, we'll just call it good reconnaissance. The alternative is too frightening. Anyway, don't go far; this isn't over yet.
messages.zh: 那真是个可怕的想法。不，他们怎么会知道的？！不，我们只能称其为出色的侦察。如果他们采取别的行动就太可怕了。无论如何，别走远；事情还没有结束。

messages.en: I'm sick to hell of these drones. No, I'm going to go take a vacation with some good old-fashioned holoreels.
messages.zh: 这些无人机让我恶心透了。不了，我正打算带一些经典老式的全息记忆盘去度假。

messages.en: Do you not care about the danger these drones pose if they can control people and steal our most advanced starship plans?! This isn't day-camp, pilot!
messages.zh: 如果这些无人机能够控制人类并获得我们最先进的星际飞船计划，那么他们将带来多大的危险啊！你一点儿也不在乎吗？！这不是夏令营，飞行员！

messages.en:
We have a quickly escalating situation here, and I need your help to control the damage. Inettria Volur found a way to sneak back into the research facility here in {[location]agentStationID.name}; she got the help of some old friends in the corporation who had no idea she's ... changed. Now, we've dealt with the employees who helped her, but we can't find Volur herself. The problem is that she managed to slip out with copies of some preliminary design documents for a prototype battleship that's going to be built here in the station next year. I take it I don't have to tell you how valuable these documents are, nor what would happen if they fall into the wrong hands.

Now, we managed to get a tracking beacon painted onto Volur's ship as she blasted out of here, and one of our scanning engineers was then able to track her to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We sent a recon pilot out there, and he was able to pick up some heavy drone activity; I'll upload the exact coordinates of the locus of that activity to your NeoCom for you in just a sec.

We need those copies of the design documents destroyed, {[character]player.name}, along with Volur and all of her “friends.” If you get out there and she isn't around, don't worry: She's bound to show her face out there eventually.
