messages.en: Sure, seems easy enough. I assume the ISK's good, as usual?
messages.zh: 当然，看起来够简单的了。我猜星币也跟以往一样不错吧？

messages.en: Yes, of course. You might run into some trouble out there, so be careful.
messages.zh: 是的，当然。你在那里可能会遇到点麻烦，所以小心点。

messages.en: Good day, {[character]agentID.name}. A pleasure to be back here at the {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} offices. Anything new?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}。回到{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}办公室真的很愉快。有什么新任务吗？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, an employee of ours, Dimitri Ulanus, has been acting a little odd lately; he comes and goes at strange hours and doesn't say where he is going or where he's been, but he often takes company ships and disappears for days at a time. We are lucky if he shows up for meetings, and when he does appear he utters the strangest things, completely inappropriate and ... well, just unsettling. We could deal with it if we thought he was just insane, but we are afraid it's more than that.

You've heard those stories about people taken alive into rogue drone hives? Well, one of Ulanus's co-workers claims he heard the man muttering something about “the hive mother” and “the song of the drones.” We need to be sure that Ulanus has not been ... taken by the drones. We had security look around in his logs and they found this location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that he's visited several times in the past months. It's a dark, nasty part of space, though, and I can't send just anyone: Maybe you can take a look and tell us what you find.

Oh, and if you do find anything remarkable there, I need you to get in close and have a good look before you report back to me.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我们的一个雇员迪米·厄尼最近行为很古怪；他总是在不正常的时间到来或离开，从不透露他要去哪里或者去过那里，而且经常乘坐公司的飞船一下子失踪好几天。要是他开会的时候能出现，那么就已经很了不得了。而每次他真的出席会议的时候，又总是讲些古怪透顶的话，完全不合时宜……呃，让人有点儿不安。如果他只是精神错乱了，我们倒可以处理这件事，不过恐怕事情不止那么简单。

你听说过活人被吸入无人机母巢的事情吧？呃，萨古尔的一个同事说曾听到他嘀咕一些有关“母巢”和“无人机之歌”的事情。我们需要确定萨古尔是否被……无人机控制。我们让保安人员查看了他的航行日志，他们发现他在过去几个月去了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}好几次。那是空间中的一个阴暗、肮脏的部分，所以，我不能随便派人前往：也许你可以去看看，然后告诉我们你发现了什么。

噢，如果你真的在那里发现了任何不一般的东西，我要你靠近并仔细观察，然后再向我报告。

messages.en: Well, you were certainly right about the drones: There were a ton of them out there, along with some kind of huge structure. I cleaned the place out, though, so no worries.
messages.zh: 嗯，你对无人机的看法完全正确：那里有成群的无人机，还有一种巨型建筑。不过，我还是把那里铲平了，所以不用担心了。

messages.en: Well, that's good news. But I have bad news too. Just give me a moment to finish up here and I'll explain...
messages.zh: 唔，真是好消息。但我还有一个坏消息。先让我把手上的事情忙完，然后我会解释的……

messages.en: People taken by drones? Yeah, right. No, I think I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 人类被无人机控制？是啊，就像真的一样。不了，这项任务我不干。

messages.en: Fine, be that way. But I assure you, there's more to these stories than most would care to admit.
messages.zh: 好吧，就那样吧。但我向你保证，这些故事远不止人们愿意相信的那么简单。

messages.en:
Oh, not much, really... er, well, now, wait! Actually, that's not entirely true. In fact, maybe this is something you could help me out with ― I don't know why I didn't think of you sooner.

{[character]player.name}, an employee of ours, Dimitri Ulanus, has been acting a little odd lately; he comes and goes at strange hours and doesn't say where he is going or where he's been, but he often takes company ships and disappears for days at a time. We are lucky if he shows up for meetings, and when he does appear he utters the strangest things, completely inappropriate and ... well, just unsettling. We could deal with it if we thought he was just insane, but we are afraid it's more than that.

You've heard those stories about people taken alive into rogue drone hives? Well, one of Ulanus's co-workers claims he heard the man muttering something about “the hive mother” and “the song of the drones.” We need to be sure that Ulanus has not been ... taken by the drones. It's a dark, nasty part of space, though, and I can't send just anyone: Maybe you can take a look and tell us what you find.

Oh, and if you do find anything remarkable there, I need you to get in close and have a good look before you report back to me.
messages.zh:
哦，没什么活，真的……呃，好吧，喂，等等！事实上，情况并不完全是这样。实际上，可能这里有些你也许能帮我解决的事情——我不知道我怎么没有早点想到你。

{[character]player.name}，我们的一个雇员迪米·厄尼最近行为很古怪；他总是在不正常的时间到来或离开，从不透露他要去哪里或者去过那里，而且经常乘坐公司的飞船一下子失踪好几天。要是他开会的时候能出现，那么就已经很了不得了。而每次他真的出席会议的时候，又总是讲些古怪透顶的话，完全不合时宜……呃，让人有点儿不安。如果他只是精神错乱了，我们倒可以处理这件事，不过恐怕事情不止那么简单。

I guess, if there was something more there, it‘s gone now.

I‘m sure you have good reason for not getting this job done on time, but in the future ... do try to be a little more prompt.

{[character]agentID.name}

我相信你没能按时完成任务一定有充分的理由，不过以后……请务必动作迅速点。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: This is crazy, {[character]agentID.name}. I can't finish this job for you.
messages.zh: 这事太疯狂了，{[character]agentID.name}。我不能替你完成这个工作。

messages.en: You know, a quitter is just another kind of loser.
messages.zh: 你知道吗，退出者只是另一种失败者。

messages.en: Good day, {[character]agentID.name}. A pleasure to be back here at the {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} offices. Anything new?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}。回到{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}办公室真的很愉快。有什么新任务吗？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, an employee of ours, Ashur Ylavun, has been acting a little odd lately; he comes and goes at strange hours and doesn't say where he is going or where he's been, but he often takes company ships and disappears for days at a time. We are lucky if he shows up for meetings, and when he does appear he utters the strangest things, completely inappropriate and ... well, just unsettling. We could deal with it if we thought he was just insane, but we are afraid it's more than that.

You've heard those stories about people taken alive into rogue drone hives? Well, one of Ylavun's co-workers claims he heard the man muttering something about “the hive mother” and “the song of the drones.” We need to be sure that Ylavun has not been ... taken by the drones. We had security look around in his logs and they found this location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that he's visited several times in the past months. It's a dark, nasty part of space, though, and I can't send just anyone: Maybe you can take a look and tell us what you find.

Oh, and if you do find anything remarkable there, I need you to get in close and have a good look before you report back to me.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我们的一个雇员阿什·拉维最近行为很古怪；他总是在不正常的时间到来或离开，从不透露他要去哪里或者去过那里，而且经常乘坐公司的飞船一下子失踪好几天。要是他开会的时候能出现，那么就已经很了不得了。而每次他真的出席会议的时候，又总是讲些古怪透顶的话，完全不合时宜……呃，让人有点儿不安。如果他只是精神错乱了，我们倒可以处理这件事，不过恐怕事情不止那么简单。

你听说过活人被吸入无人机母巢的事情吧？呃，萨古尔的一个同事说曾听到他嘀咕一些有关“母巢”和“无人机之歌”的事情。我们需要确定萨古尔是否被……无人机控制。我们让保安人员查看了他的航行日志，他们发现他在过去几个月去了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}好几次。那是空间中的一个阴暗、肮脏的部分，所以，我不能随便派人前往：也许你可以去看看，然后告诉我们你发现了什么。

噢，如果你真的在那里发现了任何不一般的东西，我要你靠近并仔细观察，然后再向我报告。

messages.en: Well, you were certainly right about the drones: There were a ton of them out there, along with some kind of huge structure. I cleaned the place out, though, so no worries.
messages.zh: 嗯，你对无人机的看法完全正确：那里有成群的无人机，还有一种巨型建筑。不过，我还是把那里铲平了，所以不用担心了。

messages.en: Well, that's good news. But I have bad news too. Just give me a moment to finish up here and I'll explain...
messages.zh: 唔，真是好消息。但我还有一个坏消息。先让我把手上的事情忙完，然后我会解释的……

messages.en: People taken by drones? Yeah, right. No, I think I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 人类被无人机控制？是啊，就像真的一样。不了，这项任务我不干。

messages.en: Fine, be that way. But I assure you, there's more to these stories than most would care to admit.
messages.zh: 好吧，就那样吧。但我向你保证，这些故事远不止人们愿意相信的那么简单。

messages.en:

Oh, and if you do find anything remarkable there, I need you to get in close and have a good look before you report back to me.

哦，没什么活，真的……呃，好吧，喂，等等！事实上，情况并不完全是这样。实际上，可能这里有些你也许能帮我解决的事情——我不知道我怎么没有早点想到你。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Unfortunately, Ashur Ylavun has disappeared entirely. Because I hadn‘t heard anything from you, I hired a recon ship to go check the location I told you about in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; there were signs of drone activity there, but little else. I guess, if there was something more there, it‘s gone now.

I‘m sure you have good reason for not getting this job done on time, but in the future ... do try to be a little more prompt.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

不幸的是，阿什·拉维彻底失踪了。由于我没有得到你的任何回复，我雇了一艘侦察舰去调查我所说的位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的地点；那里有些无人机活动的迹象，不过没有别的什么了。我想，即使那里曾经有更多的东西，现在也已经不存在了。

我相信你没能按时完成任务一定有充分的理由，不过以后……请务必动作迅速点。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Abort mission
messages.zh: 任务中止

messages.en: This is crazy, {[character]agentID.name}. I can't finish this job for you.
messages.zh: 这事太疯狂了，{[character]agentID.name}。我不能替你完成这个工作。

messages.en: You know, a quitter is just another kind of loser.
messages.zh: 你知道吗，退出者只是另一种失败者。

{[character]player.name}，我们的一个雇员米雷纳·阿迪偌最近行为很古怪；他总是在不正常的时间到来或离开，从不透露他要去哪里或者去过那里，而且经常乘坐公司的飞船一下子失踪好几天。要是他开会的时候能出现，那么就已经很了不得了。而每次他真的出席会议的时候，又总是讲些古怪透顶的话，完全不合时宜……呃，让人有点儿不安。如果他只是精神错乱了，我们倒可以处理这件事，不过恐怕事情不止那么简单。

你听说过活人被吸入无人机母巢的事情吧？呃，萨古尔的一个同事说曾听到他嘀咕一些有关“母巢”和“无人机之歌”的事情。我们需要确定萨古尔是否被……无人机控制。我们让保安人员查看了他的航行日志，他们发现他在过去几个月去了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}好几次。那是空间中的一个阴暗、肮脏的部分，所以，我不能随便派人前往：也许你可以去看看，然后告诉我们你发现了什么。

噢，如果你真的在那里发现了任何不一般的东西，我要你靠近并仔细观察，然后再向我报告。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Unfortunately, Milena Adiras has disappeared entirely. Because I hadn‘t heard anything from you, I hired a recon ship to go check the location I told you about in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; there were signs of drone activity there, but little else. I guess, if there was something more there, it‘s gone now.

I‘m sure you have good reason for not getting this job done on time, but in the future ... do try to be a little more prompt.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

不幸的是，米蕾娜·阿迪拉斯彻底失踪了。由于我没有得到你的任何回复，我雇了一艘侦察舰去调查我所说的位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的地点；那里有些无人机活动的迹象，不过没有别的什么了。我想，即使那里曾经有更多的东西，现在也已经不存在了。

我相信你没能按时完成任务一定有充分的理由，不过以后……请务必动作迅速点。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Abort mission
messages.zh: 任务中止

messages.en: This is crazy, {[character]agentID.name}. I can't finish this job for you.
messages.zh: 这事太疯狂了，{[character]agentID.name}。我不能替你完成这个工作。

messages.en: You know, a quitter is just another kind of loser.
messages.zh: 你知道吗，退出者只是另一种失败者。

messages.en: Sure, seems easy enough. I assume the ISK's good, as usual?
messages.zh: 当然，看起来够简单的了。我猜星币也跟以往一样不错吧？

messages.en: Yes, of course. You might run into some trouble out there, so be careful.
messages.zh: 是的，当然。你在那里可能会遇到点麻烦，所以小心点。

messages.en: Good day, {[character]agentID.name}. A pleasure to be back here at the {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} offices. Anything new?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}。回到{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}办公室真的很愉快。有什么新任务吗？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, an employee of ours, Inettria Volur, has been acting a little odd lately; she comes and goes at strange hours and doesn't say where she is going or where she's been, but she often takes company ships and disappears for days at a time. We are lucky if she shows up for meetings, and when she does appear she utters the strangest things, completely inappropriate and ... well, just unsettling. We could deal with it if we thought she was just insane, but we are afraid it's more than that.

You've heard those stories about people taken alive into rogue drone hives? Well, one of Volur's co-workers claims he heard her muttering something about “the hive mother” and “the song of the drones.” We need to be sure that Volur has not been ... taken by the drones. We had security look around in her logs and they found this location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that she's visited several times in the past months. It's a dark, nasty part of space, though, and I can't send just anyone: Maybe you can take a look and tell us what you find.

Oh, and if you do find anything remarkable there, I need you to get in close and have a good look before you report back to me.

messages.en: Well, you were certainly right about the drones: There were a ton of them out there, along with some kind of huge structure. I cleaned the place out, though, so no worries.
messages.zh: 嗯，你对无人机的看法完全正确：那里有成群的无人机，还有一种巨型建筑。不过，我还是把那里铲平了，所以不用担心了。

messages.en: Well, that's good news. But I have bad news too. Just give me a moment to finish up here and I'll explain...
messages.zh: 唔，真是好消息。但我还有一个坏消息。先让我把手上的事情忙完，然后我会解释的……

messages.en: People taken by drones? Yeah, right. No, I think I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 人类被无人机控制？是啊，就像真的一样。不了，这项任务我不干。

messages.en: Fine, be that way. But I assure you, there's more to these stories than most would care to admit.
messages.zh: 好吧，就那样吧。但我向你保证，这些故事远不止人们愿意相信的那么简单。

messages.en:

messages.en: I hope there is indeed a station there.  If so, I shall summon my allies and strike at once.
messages.zh: 我真希望那里确实有个空间站。那样的话，我会立刻召集我的友军并发动攻击。

messages.en: How lucky that you arrived here when you did, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你的到来真是幸运之至，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Actually, I'm not here for pleasure, but thanks.  I was wondering if you have some work for me. I'd heard you might?
messages.zh: 事实上，我不是到这来享乐的，不过还是谢谢你。我想知道你是否有工作给我。我听说你可能有？

messages.en:
Recent advances in station design among the Minmatar, particularly the Sebiestor tribe, have resulted in frighteningly powerful battle stations capable of withstanding tremendous punishment. They are not to be underestimated.

{[character]player.name}, these Minmatar rebels, as you know, are always causing problems, so their raids in outlying systems don't normally draw too much notice. Not normally. Recently, though, we've been hearing rumors about some kind of “super” battle station they're building in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, supposedly with a full capital ship maintenance array. I don‘t really have the resources at hand to investigate these rumors, but just to be safe, maybe I could pay you to check things out for me?

So, could you fly out there and investigate these rumors for me? I'll pay you handsomely. And if you do encounter any Minmatar, or any kind of enemy station, just take care of it for me, won't you? We can't afford that kind of trouble around here. As is standard these days, do it quickly and I'll throw in a substantial bonus. What do you think?
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔人，尤其是赛毕斯托部族，在空间站设计上取得了最新的进展，结果诞生了拥有恐怖力量的战役空间站，它们能够承受极大程度的打击。绝不可低估它们。

{[character]player.name}，就像你知道的那样，这些米玛塔尔叛军总爱惹麻烦，所以他们对边远星系的侵袭往往不大会引起重视。一般不会。然而最近，我们听到谣传，说他们正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造一种“超级”战役空间站，据信拥有一个完整的旗舰级战舰维护阵列。我手头现在确实没有人能去调查这些传闻的真实性，不过为了保险起见，也许我可以雇你为我去确认一下情况？

那么，你可以飞往那里去为我调查一下这些传闻的真实性吗？我会付你丰厚的报酬。你如果真的遭遇米玛塔尔人或者发现任何敌人空间站，帮我解决掉它们，好吗？我们受不了附近有这种麻烦。就像如今的惯例一样，如果快速完成任务，我将送上丰富的额外奖励。你觉得怎么样？

messages.en: There was truth in those rumors. Now, what business do the Minmatar have building a battle station so close to our territory...?
messages.zh: 看来有些传闻不假。那么，米玛塔尔人在离我们领空这么近的地方建战役空间站的目的是什么呢……？

messages.en: Good question, {[character]player.name}. And I fear we won't like the answer.
messages.zh: 问得好，{[character]player.name}。但恐怕我们不会喜欢那个答案的。

messages.en: A simple recon mission? No, thank you. I had expected something a little more ... meaningful.
messages.zh: 一个简单的侦察任务？不了，谢谢你。我本来期待会得到一些更……有意义的工作。

messages.en: Life can't always be blasts and battleships. Who knows what you might have found out there?
messages.zh: 生活不会总是充满爆炸和战舰的。谁知道你可能在那里发现什么呢？

messages.en: The Sebiestor tribe hails from the inhospitable steppes of the Mikramurka continent in the northern arctic region on the Minmatar homeworld of Matar. The Sebiestors are the most technically inclined of the Minmatar tribes; they were at the forefront in the tentative space exploration program the Minmatars were undertaking just before the Amarrians arrived to subjugate them. Today, most Minmatar ships, and especially stations, tend to be engineered by Sebiestors.
messages.zh: 赛毕斯托部族发源于米克拉姆卡大陆上贫瘠的大草原，这块大陆位于米玛塔尔的玛塔尔家园的北极区域。赛比斯托人是米玛塔尔所有部族中最偏爱技术的；在艾玛人征服米玛塔尔人之前，赛比斯托人在米玛塔尔进行的太空探索计划中处于最前沿。今天，大多数米玛塔尔飞船，尤其是空间站，通常都是由赛比斯托人设计的。

messages.en: The Sebiestor
messages.zh: 赛比斯托人

messages.en:
“All work and no play,” you know. But I can see that you're determined. Yes, well, there is something I had planned to hand over to the authorities, but maybe you can handle this one without us having to get them involved. In fact, that might be best, now that I think about it.

{[character]player.name}, these Minmatar rebels, as you know, are always causing problems, so their raids in outlying systems don't normally draw too much notice. Not normally. Recently, though, we've been hearing rumors about some kind of “super” battle station they're building in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, supposedly with a full capital ship maintenance array. I don‘t really have the resources at hand to investigate these rumors, but just to be safe, maybe I could pay you to check things out for me?

So, could you fly out there and investigate these rumors for me? I'll pay you handsomely. And if you do encounter any Minmatar, or any kind of enemy station, just take care of it for me, won't you? We can't afford that kind of trouble around here. As is standard these days, do it quickly and I'll throw in a substantial bonus. What do you think?
messages.zh:
真是“有劳无逸”。不过看来你已经下定决心了。嗯，好吧，我本来打算把有件事情交给当局，不过也许你能解决这件事，这样就不用麻烦他们插手。实际上，现在想想，这可能是最好的办法。

{[character]player.name}，就像你知道的那样，这些米玛塔尔叛军总爱惹麻烦，所以他们对边远星系的侵袭往往不大会引起重视。一般不会。然而最近，我们听到谣传，说他们正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造一种“超级”战役空间站，据信拥有一个完整的旗舰级战舰维护阵列。我手头现在确实没有人能去调查这些传闻的真实性，不过为了保险起见，也许我可以雇你为我去确认一下情况？

那么，你可以飞往那里去为我调查一下这些传闻的真实性吗？我会付你丰厚的报酬。你如果真的遭遇米玛塔尔人或者发现任何敌人空间站，帮我解决掉它们，好吗？我们受不了附近有这种麻烦。就像如今的惯例一样，如果快速完成任务，我将送上丰富的额外奖励。你觉得怎么样？

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有回复，我不得不调用海军去解决了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的米玛塔尔战役空间站。就当你没被雇佣过。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar station destroyed
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔空间站被摧毁

messages.en: I've changed my mind. You'll have to find someone else; I'm vacationing after all.
messages.zh: 我改主意了。你得去找别人了；我毕竟还在渡假。

messages.en: Well, convenient, that is. And me just having heard that the rumors are true. Guess this is a job for the Navy after all.
messages.zh: 嗯，我就在附近。我刚听说传闻是真的。我想这回终于该派海军出动了。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你没有回复，我不得不调用海军去解决了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的米玛塔尔战役空间站。就当你没被雇佣过。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Minmatar station destroyed
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔空间站被摧毁

messages.en: I'll head out there at once. This just might get interesting.
messages.zh: 我会立刻出发前往那里。这可能会很有趣。

messages.en: How fortuitous that you arrived here just now, {[character]player.name}. Good luck!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你来这里真是我的福气。祝你好运！

messages.en: Thanks. I hear you might have some work for me. That true?
messages.zh: 谢谢。听说你可能有些活让我做，是这样的吗？

messages.en:
Recent advances in station design among the Minmatar, who have shared their designs through treaty with their Gallentean allies, have resulted in frighteningly powerful battle stations capable of withstanding tremendous punishment. They are not to be underestimated.

We've been hearing rumors about some kind of ultra-powerful battle station the Gallenteans are building, using Minmatar designs, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Supposedly, it's fitted with a full capital ship maintenance array. Now, I don‘t really have the resources at hand to investigate these rumors, but just to be safe, maybe I could pay you to check things out for me? I'll pay you well, of course.

And if you do encounter any hostile Gallente out there, or any kind of enemy station ― how shall I put this...? Eh, take care of it, will you? We can't afford any Gallentean capital ships being built or serviced so close to our territory. Of course, as is common these days, do it quickly and I'll throw in a substantial bonus.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔人分享了他们盟军盖伦特的研究成果，在空间站设计上取得了最新的进展，结果诞生了拥有恐怖力量的战役空间站，它们能够承受极大程度的打击。绝不可低估它们。

最近，我们听到谣传，说盖伦特正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造一种“超级”战役空间站，据信拥有一个完整的旗舰级战舰维护阵列。我手头现在确实没有人能去调查这些传闻的真实性，不过为了保险起见，也许我可以雇你为我去确认一下情况？那么，你可以飞往那里去为我调查一下这些传闻的真实性吗？我会付你丰厚的报酬。

你如果真的遭遇盖伦特人或者发现任何敌人空间站，帮我解决掉它们，好吗？我们受不了附近有这种麻烦。就像如今的惯例一样，如果快速完成任务，我将送上丰富的额外奖励。

messages.en: There was truth to those rumors of a station, that's for sure. What's, or rather who's behind it, I wonder?
messages.zh: 关于那个空间站的传闻肯定并非空穴来风。我想知道幕后主使是谁？

messages.en: I don't like to think about it, {[character]player.name}. But it bears thinking about.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我真不想去考虑这个问题，但它确实值得思考。

messages.en: A simple recon mission? No, thank you. I had expected something a little more ... meaningful.
messages.zh: 一个简单的侦察任务？不了，谢谢你。我本来期待会得到一些更……有意义的工作。

messages.en: I'm sorry you find things too dull for your liking here, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 真遗憾这些事让你觉得无聊，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Gallentean society is currently enjoying the fruits of unprecedented economic prosperity and growth, undergoing a cultural and spiritual revitalization. President Foiritan, still popular despite being ousted by President Roden, takes credit for ushering in this age, expanding trade with other nations and pouring money into massive projects. In all of New Eden, no other nation has as many concurrent terraforming initiatives underway as the Federation; the demand for labor has grown so great that it now draws immigrants from many other nations, especially from the Minmatar Republic.
messages.zh: 盖伦特社会现在正享受着前所未有的经济繁荣和增长所带来的成果，文化和精神方面都在进行复兴。总统佛里坦虽然被莱登总统取代，但仍广受欢迎，他的功绩在于引导这个时代、扩大同其他国家的贸易并斥巨资于大型项目。在新伊甸星系中，联邦所进行的适生改造计划比其它任何国家都多；对于劳动力的需要急剧增长，吸引了来自许多其他国家——尤其是米玛塔尔共和国——的移民。

messages.en: The Gallentean Renaissance
messages.zh: 盖伦特的复兴

messages.en:
Yes, I do. Good timing. {[character]player.name}, we've been hearing rumors about some kind of ultra-powerful battle station the Gallenteans are building, using Minmatar designs, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Supposedly, it's fitted with a full capital ship maintenance array. Now, I don‘t really have the resources at hand to investigate these rumors, but just to be safe, maybe I could pay you to check things out for me? I'll pay you well, of course.

And if you do encounter any hostile Gallente out there, or any kind of enemy station ― how shall I put this...? Eh, take care of it, will you? We can't afford any Gallentean capital ships being built or serviced so close to our territory. Of course, as is common these days, do it quickly and I'll throw in a substantial bonus.
messages.zh:
是的。{[character]player.name}，你来得正好！最近，我们听到谣传，说盖伦特正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造一种“超级”战役空间站，据信拥有一个完整的旗舰级战舰维护阵列。我手头现在确实没有人能去调查这些传闻的真实性，不过为了保险起见，也许我可以雇你为我去确认一下情况？那么，你可以飞往那里去为我调查一下这些传闻的真实性吗？我会付你丰厚的报酬。

你如果真的遭遇盖伦特人或者发现任何敌人空间站，帮我解决掉它们，好吗？我们受不了附近有这种麻烦。就像如今的惯例一样，如果快速完成任务，我将送上丰富的额外奖励。

{[character]player.name}，

传闻已经被证实，盖伦特确实在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内建设战役空间站，我不得不调用海军去解决了它。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Gallentean station destroyed
messages.zh: 盖伦特空间站被毁

messages.en: I've changed my mind. You'll have to find someone else. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我改主意了。你得另寻他人了。抱歉。

messages.en: Sorry? Sorry?! Hmph. I knew I shouldn't have offered this to a freelancer.
messages.zh: 抱歉？抱歉？！哼。我就知道不该找个自由职业者干这活。

{[character]player.name}，

传闻已经被证实，盖伦特确实在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内建设战役空间站，我不得不调用海军去解决了它。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Gallentean station destroyed
messages.zh: 盖伦特空间站被毁

messages.en: I'll head out there at once. This just might get interesting.
messages.zh: 我会立刻出发前往那里。这可能会很有趣。

messages.en: How fortuitous that you arrived here just now, {[character]player.name}. Good luck!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你来这里真是我的福气。祝你好运！

messages.en: Thanks. I hear you might have some work for me. That true?
messages.zh: 谢谢。听说你可能有些活让我做，是这样的吗？

messages.en:
Recent advances in space station design among the military industrial complex of the Caldari have resulted in frighteningly powerful battle stations capable of withstanding tremendous punishment. They are not to be underestimated.

We've been hearing rumors about some kind of “super” battle station the Caldari are building in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, supposedly with a full capital ship maintenance array. Now, I don‘t really have the resources at hand to investigate these rumors, but just to be safe, maybe I could pay you to check things out for me? I'll pay you well, of course.

And if you do encounter any hostile Caldari out there, or any kind of enemy station ― take care of it, will you? We can't afford to have any Caldari capital ships being built or serviced so close to our territory.
messages.zh:
加达里人在空间站设计上取得了最新的进展，结果诞生了拥有恐怖力量的战役空间站，它们能够承受极大程度的打击。绝不可低估它们。

最近，我们听到谣传，说加达里正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造一种“超级”战役空间站，据信拥有一个完整的旗舰级战舰维护阵列。我手头现在确实没有人能去调查这些传闻的真实性，不过为了保险起见，也许我可以雇你为我去确认一下情况？那么，你可以飞往那里去为我调查一下这些传闻的真实性吗？我会付你丰厚的报酬。

你如果真的遭遇加达里人或者发现任何敌人空间站，帮我解决掉它们，好吗？我们受不了附近有这种麻烦。就像如今的惯例一样，如果快速完成任务，我将送上丰富的额外奖励。

messages.en: There was truth to those rumors of a station, that's for sure. And I don't like the implications.
messages.zh: 关于那个空间站的传闻肯定并非空穴来风。我不想卷入这事情。

messages.en: Nor do I, {[character]player.name}. Nor do I. Good work out there, nonetheless.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我也不想。不过还是去那里干吧。

messages.en: A simple recon mission? No, thank you. I had expected something a little more ... meaningful.
messages.zh: 一个简单的侦察任务？不了，谢谢你。我本来期待会得到一些更……有意义的工作。

messages.en: I'm sorry you find things too dull for your liking here, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 真遗憾这些事让你觉得无聊，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
The oligarchic Caldari State stands for corporate capitalism in its purest form. There are eight great “mega-corporations” that together own more than 90 percentage of all property within the State. Each corporation is made up of thousands of companies of various sizes, each with any number of specific market interests, ranging from simple mining companies to powerful security companies. There is no single, unified government as such; each megacorp rules its territories like a kingdom with little or no interference from the others. 
The eight major corporations are Kaalakiota, Sukuuvestaa, Nugoeihuvi, Ishukone, Wiyrkomi, Hyasyoda, CBD, and Lai Dai.
messages.zh: 主张寡头政治的加达里合众国完全代表集团资本主义。八家巨型“超级集团”总共占据了加达里合众国内百分之九十以上的财产。每家集团由数以千计的公司组成，这些公司规模不一，每个公司专营的业务领域数量也不尽相同，从简单的采矿公司到强大的安全公司均有包括。加达里合众国没有单独统一的政府；每个超级集团就像一个独立王国一样统治自己的领地，很少或几乎不干涉其他集团。八家超级集团分别为卡拉吉塔集团、斯库维塔集团、纳基维集团、异株湖集团、维克米集团、三岛集团、CBD集团和莱戴集团。

messages.en: The Caldari State
messages.zh: 加达里共和国

messages.en:
Let us not mix business and pleasure, eh? Heh. Very well: Yes, I do have something you could help me with. In keeping with the spirit of this meeting so far, let's get straight to it.

{[character]player.name}, we've been hearing rumors about some kind of “super” battle station the Caldari are building in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, supposedly with a full capital ship maintenance array. Now, I don‘t really have the resources at hand to investigate these rumors, but just to be safe, maybe I could pay you to check things out for me? I'll pay you well, of course.

And if you do encounter any hostile Caldari out there, or any kind of enemy station ― how shall I put this...? Eh, take care of it, will you? We can't afford any Caldari capital ships being built or serviced so close to our territory. Of course, as is common these days, do it quickly and I'll throw in a substantial bonus.
messages.zh:
让我们别把正事和消遣搞混了。是的，我有点事要你帮忙。让我们开门见山地说吧。

{[character]player.name}，最近我们听到谣传，说加达里正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造一种“超级”战役空间站，据信拥有一个完整的旗舰级战舰维护阵列。我手头现在确实没有人能去调查这些传闻的真实性，不过为了保险起见，也许我可以雇你为我去确认一下情况？那么，你可以飞往那里去为我调查一下这些传闻的真实性吗？我会付你丰厚的报酬。

你如果真的遭遇加达里人或者发现任何敌人空间站，帮我解决掉它们，好吗？我们受不了附近有这种麻烦。就像如今的惯例一样，如果快速完成任务，我将送上丰富的额外奖励。

{[character]player.name}，

传闻已经得到证实，我不得不调用海军去解决了在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内的加达里战役空间站。就像人们常说的，早起的鸟儿有虫吃。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Caldari station destroyed
messages.zh: 加达里空间站被毁

messages.en: I've changed my mind. You'll have to find someone else. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我改主意了。你得另寻他人了。抱歉。

messages.en: Sorry? Sorry?! Hmph. I knew I shouldn't have offered this to a freelancer.
messages.zh: 抱歉？抱歉？！哼。我就知道不该找个自由职业者干这活。

{[character]player.name}，

传闻已经得到证实，我不得不调用海军去解决了在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内的加达里战役空间站。就像人们常说的，早起的鸟儿有虫吃。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Caldari station destroyed
messages.zh: 加达里空间站被毁

messages.en: Damn. This is serious. Okay, I'm on it.
messages.zh: 该死。问题很严重。好，我接受任务。

messages.en: That's why I called you in on this one, {[character]player.name}. I knew you'd jump on it.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，这就是为什么我找你来。我知道你能对付得了这事。

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]agentID.name}. Been a while... I think. I get to so many stations, see, that it's hard to remember where all I've been sometimes.
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]agentID.name}。有好一段时间没见面了……我觉得。我去过太多空间站了，一下子想不起来我去过哪个。

messages.en:
Recent advances in station design among the Caldari, who have shared their designs through treaty with their Amarrian allies, have resulted in frighteningly powerful battle stations capable of withstanding tremendous punishment. They are not to be underestimated.

{[character]player.name}, our scouts have just discovered an extremely powerful battle station the Amarrians are building, combining their efforts with top Caldari military designers, out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The truly frightening part, though, is that the damned thing is apparently pretty much fully operational ― who the hell knows how they've managed to keep the entire project hidden for the months it must have taken to build! ― and worse yet, it's tricked out with a massive capital ship maintenance array.

Now, I don‘t really have the resources at hand to investigate these rumors, and I‘m afraid that it‘s going to take the Navy too long to get out here to deal with the thing. So I imagine you can see where this is all going by now: I need someone to head in there and take that station apart, and it has to happen right now. You think you can handle this one? Needless to say, we can't afford any Amarr capital ships being built or serviced so close to our territory.
messages.zh:
加达里人分享了他们盟军艾玛的研究成果，在空间站设计上取得了最新的进展，结果诞生了拥有恐怖力量的太空堡垒，它们能够承受极大程度的打击。绝不可低估它们。

{[character]player.name}，我们的侦察兵发现艾玛人最近在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造一种“超级”太空堡垒，据信拥有一个完整的旗舰级战舰维护阵列。

现在我手头现在确实没有人能去调查这些传闻的真实性，而且我想派海军去解决这个事情花费太长时间了。我想你该明白我找你来的意图了吧：我需要有个人去那里，把那个空间站解决了。你能干吗？勿庸置疑，我们受不了在领土周围艾玛人建造旗舰舰船。

messages.en: By all the hells, that was a tough fight. If the Amarr are putting these things together elsewhere, we should be concerned. Very concerned.
messages.zh: 真是见鬼了，这是一场硬仗。如果艾玛人把这些东西都转移到其他地方，我们就有麻烦了。很大的麻烦。

messages.en: I don't like to think about it, {[character]player.name}. But it bears thinking about.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我真不想去考虑这个问题，但它确实值得思考。

messages.en: A simple recon mission? No, thank you. I had expected something a little more ... meaningful.
messages.zh: 一个简单的侦察任务？不了，谢谢你。我本来期待会得到一些更……有意义的工作。

messages.en: I'm sorry you find things too dull for your liking here, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 真遗憾这些事让你觉得无聊，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Well, either way, thanks for coming. I have urgent need of a captain of your skill. And I mean it. This is a serious matter.

{[character]player.name}, our scouts have just discovered an extremely powerful battle station the Amarrians are building, combining their efforts with top Caldari military designers, out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The truly frightening part, though, is that the damned thing is apparently pretty much fully operational ― who the hell knows how they've managed to keep the entire project hidden for the months it must have taken to build! ― and worse yet, it's tricked out with a massive capital ship maintenance array.

Now, I don‘t really have the resources at hand to investigate these rumors, and I‘m afraid that it‘s going to take the Navy too long to get out here to deal with the thing. So I imagine you can see where this is all going by now: I need someone to head in there and take that station apart, and it has to happen right now. You think you can handle this one? Needless to say, we can't afford any Amarr capital ships being built or serviced so close to our territory.
messages.zh:
不管怎样，感谢你的到来。我现在急需有你这样经验的舰长。你将面对一个严重的事件。

{[character]player.name}，我们的侦察员发现艾玛族正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造一个太空堡垒，并且加达里军事设计师也参与到这个事件中。恐怖的事情是：他们的太空堡垒已经基本可以运行了，不知道这几个月以来他们是如何这么隐蔽的运作这个项目。更严重的事情是：他们已经建立好了旗舰维护阵列。

现在我的手上没有足够的资源去调查这个传闻，而海军将会需要很长的时间才能处理这个事件。所以我想你可以去看看哪里到底发生了什么事，我需要有人去那里立刻把太空堡垒摧毁。你觉得你能做到吗？不管怎么说是不能让艾玛旗舰在我们领地附近建造和服务。

{[character]player.name}，

幸运的是，海军赶在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛战役空间站得以全副武装前把它摧毁了。幸运女神这次站在了我们这边……尽管你没有。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarr station destroyed
messages.zh: 艾玛空间站被摧毁

messages.en: I can't finish the job, {[character]agentID.name}. I‘m sorry.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，很抱歉我不能完成这工作。

messages.en: Not as sorry as I am! What the hell's going to happen now??
messages.zh: 我才感到遗憾呢！现在会发生什么呢？？

{[character]player.name}，

幸运的是，海军赶在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的艾玛战役空间站得以全副武装前把它摧毁了。幸运女神这次站在了我们这边……尽管你没有。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarr station destroyed
messages.zh: 艾玛空间站被摧毁

name.ja: ローグドローンの根絶(3/3)

messages.en: I'll do it, {[character]agentID.name}. But I've gotta tell you, I'm getting tired of these drones…
messages.zh: 我做，{[character]agentID.name}。不过我得告诉你，我对这些无人机很厌倦了。

messages.en: I sympathize, {[character]player.name}, but we don't have the luxury of leaving them alone. Be careful out there.
messages.zh: 我赞同，{[character]player.name}，但是我们不能放任它们不管。到那注意安全。

messages.en: I don't like the sound of that. Now what?
messages.zh: 我不喜欢你的弦外之音。现在又怎么了？

messages.en:
Well, we nearly succeeded in wiping out all rogue drones who knew about the research Solen Sagul had stolen, but it seems two drones escaped and thus were able to share the data with the local “hive mind” in two other locations in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We have enough ships to cordon off the area, and we've set up temporary jump gates between the locations for you, but we need you to actually go in there and clean the drones out. We must be sure to destroy them all before they can send their data to yet another hive.

Don´t take any chances; these locations will be well defended.
messages.zh:
我们几乎成功地消灭了所有了解索伦·萨古尔拿走的研究材料的无人机，但是好像有两架逃脱了，并且与{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的两个不同地点的“机巢母体”共享了我们的数据。我们派遣了足够的飞船封锁了那个区域，并且为你在这些地点间设立了临时跳跃门，但我们真正要你做的是前往那里并且将无人机清除干净。我们必须确保在它们将数据发往别的母巢之前毁灭它们。

别抱侥幸心理；这些地点一定守卫森严。

messages.en: Alright, the drones are destroyed. Please don't tell me any of them got away this time...!
messages.zh: 好吧，无人机都被消灭了。不要告诉我这次又有漏网之鱼……！

messages.en: No, I think we got them all this time. My thanks, {[character]player.name} ― we couldn't have done it without you.
messages.zh: 不，我想我们这次把它们一网打尽了。非常感谢，{[character]player.name}——如果没有你，我们不可能做到。

messages.en: I'm sick to hell of these drones. No, I'm going to go take a vacation with some good old-fashioned holoreels.
messages.zh: 这些无人机让我恶心透了。不了，我正打算带一些经典老式的全息记忆盘去度假。

messages.en: Don't you care about the danger these drones pose? They can control people and steal our most advanced starship plans!! They must be stopped!
messages.zh: 你不在乎这些无人机所造成的危险吗？它们能够控制人类，并且拿走我们最先进的星际飞船计划！！必须阻止它们！

messages.en:
Well, we nearly succeeded in wiping out all rogue drones who knew about the research Solen Sagul had stolen, but it seems two drones escaped and thus were able to share the data with the local “hive mind” in two other locations in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We have enough ships to cordon off the area, and we've set up temporary jump gates between the locations for you, but we need you to actually go in there and clean the drones out. We must be sure to destroy them all before they can send their data to yet another hive.

Don´t take any chances; these locations will be well defended.
messages.zh:
我们几乎成功地消灭了所有了解索伦·萨古尔拿走的研究材料的无人机，但是好像有两架逃脱了，并且与{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的两个不同地点的“机巢母体”共享了我们的数据。我们派遣了足够的飞船封锁了那个区域，并且为你在这些地点间设立了临时跳跃门，但我们真正要你做的是前往那里并且将无人机清除干净。我们必须确保在它们将数据发往别的母巢之前毁灭它们。

别抱侥幸心理；这些地点一定守卫森严。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Unfortunately, several drones have escaped with the battleship plans past our barricade. Because I hadn‘t heard anything from you, I hired a recon ship to go check the location I told you about in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; there were signs of recent drone activity there, but little else. I guess, if there was something more there, it‘s gone now.

Let us pray that we‘ve seen the end of these drones... but I fear the worst.

messages.en: No, I think we got them all this time. My thanks, {[character]player.name} ― we couldn't have done it without you.
messages.zh: 不，我想我们这次把它们一网打尽了。非常感谢，{[character]player.name}——如果没有你，我们不可能做到。

messages.en: I'm sick to hell of these drones. No, I'm going to go take a vacation with some good old-fashioned holoreels.

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Unfortunately, several drones have escaped with the battleship plans past our barricade. Because I hadn‘t heard anything from you, I hired a recon ship to go check the location I told you about in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}; there were signs of recent drone activity there, but little else. I guess, if there was something more there, it‘s gone now.

Let us pray that we‘ve seen the end of these drones... but I fear the worst.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

不幸的是，几架无人机带着战列舰计划通过了我们的路障。由于我没有得到你的任何回复，我雇了一艘侦察舰去调查我所说的位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的地点；那里有无人机近期活动的迹象，不过没有别的什么了。我想，即使那里曾经有更多的东西，现在也已经不存在了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: This mission sucks. I am so leaving that I might never have been here!

messages.en: Heh. You bet. The Blood Raiders are pigs, so let's take this one to the slaughterhouse.
messages.zh: 呵。这还用说。血袭者都是猪，让我们把这只送到屠宰场去吧。

messages.en: Ha! I like your style, {[character]player.name}. I look forward to your report on this.
messages.zh: 哈！我喜欢你的风格，{[character]player.name}。期待你对此事的报告。

messages.en: Glad to be here. So I assume there's something I can help you out with?
messages.zh: 很高兴来到这里。我想也许有什么事需要我帮忙？

messages.en:
A few months ago, a relative of one of the executive officers of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} disappeared for a while. I won't name any names, because we want to avoid tarnishing any valuable reputations. You get me? Okay. We now know that she was involved with some shady fellows, one guy in particular who's known for his close ties to people in the Blood Raiders. I understand he's a pilot who's trying to get accepted into the Raiders' organization, actually.

Now, the girl doesn't want to talk about what happened, but she was pretty messed up and she's now with child. I think she had a crush on this guy for some time, or at least that's what her friends told me. Poor kid. This guy needs to be brought to justice. Terminal justice, if you take my meaning. The beauty of it is, we know he's currently hiding out at a Raider recruitment station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, so if we take out that whole station, then we make points with the authorities and we clear up this personal issue at the same time.

So here it is: I want you to go out there and take out that recruitment station ― I mean reduce it to scrap ― along with any Blood Raiders you might find guarding it. Sound good? The reward, as always, will be commensurate with the risk.
messages.zh:
几个月前，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的一位执行长官的亲戚消失了一段时间。为了避免影响任何要人的声誉，我不会指名道姓。明白吗？好的。我们现在知道的情况是，她与一些可疑分子有瓜葛，尤其是一个众所周知与血袭者的人有着密切关系的家伙。我了解到，他实际上是个试图加入血袭者组织的飞行员。

那名少女不想说出发生了什么，不过她现在处境很糟——她怀孕了。我想她对那家伙着了一段时间的迷，至少她的朋友是这么跟我说的。可怜的孩子。这个家伙应该被绳之以法。终极审判，如果你懂我的意思的话。这件事的高明之处就是，我们知道他现在藏在位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个血袭者招募空间站中，所以如果我们端掉整个空间站，那么我们既能让当局另眼相看，也能同时解决这件私事。

所以你的任务是：去那里端掉整个招募空间站——我是说把它炸成碎片——包括你发现的任何进行守卫的血袭者。听起来不错吧？赏金嘛，像往常一样，与风险是成正比的。

messages.en: It is done. The Raider station is destroyed, and the creep who assaulted that young girl is no more.
messages.zh: 搞定了。血袭者空间站已经被摧毁，侵犯了那名少女的混蛋也不存在了。

messages.en: That is good news. Very good news. Well done.
messages.zh: 真是好消息。非常好的消息。干得好！

messages.en: Man, I've tangled with the Blood Raiders before. But take out a fully guarded station?! No, I don't think I'm interested.
messages.zh: 老兄，我以前是跟血袭者纠缠过。不过，你居然让我去端掉一个全副守卫的空间站？！不了，我想我不感兴趣。

messages.en: Too bad, {[character]player.name}. You could have made some serious points with the powers-that-be on this one.
messages.zh: 太糟了，{[character]player.name}。你本可以在这件事上让当权者们好好记住你的功劳。

messages.en:
The Amarr Empire has had its share of religious cults and fanatics in the past, but few have been as successful, or as much feared, as the Blood Raiders. The Raiders are a corrupted sect of an ancient cult called Sani Sabik, which historically used human blood in its rituals. The Blood Raiders believe that cloned bodies have “purer” blood than other bodies, and this explains their penchant for operating mainly in space, attacking unwary spacefarers and draining their bodies of blood.

The Blood Raiders are led by the fearsome Omir Sarikusa, who has remained on top of the DED most wanted list for many years now. Under his leadership, the Raiders have become more organized, and they have firmly established several bases in the Bleak Lands region.
messages.zh:
过去艾玛帝国也有宗教派系和狂热分子，但没哪个像血袭者那么成功，或者说那么令人畏惧。血袭者是古老的萨萨比克异教的一个堕落教派，他们有着宗教仪式上使用人类鲜血的历史。血袭者相信克隆体的血液比其他肉体“更加纯净”，这说明了他们为什么爱在太空中活动，袭击粗心的宇航员并吸干他们肉体的血液。

血袭者由令人闻风丧胆的奥玛·萨利库萨领导，多年来他一直名列DED最高通缉名单之首。在他的领导下，血袭者变得更有组织性，他们稳稳地在幽暗之域星域建立了数个基地。 "

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, The cretin who assaulted my boss‘s relative is now a member of the Raiders, and he‘s long gone from the recruitment station. The military has been called in to deal with the station itself, so our opportunity is lost. Damn shame, too. I had high hopes for a promotion once this was dealt with.

Guess maybe I should look for someone else next time, maybe, eh?

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}， 那个侵犯了我老板亲戚的笨蛋现在已经是血袭者的一员了，他早就离开了招募空间站。当局已召集了军队来解决那座空间站，所以我们的机会落空了。真是遗憾。我本来满怀希望，以为办妥了这件事就能晋升了。

也许下次我该找别人了，也许吧？

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Miscreant escaped
messages.zh: 异教徒逃脱

messages.en: I'm gonna have to call it quits on this mission, {[character]agentID.name}. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我不得不退出这个任务，{[character]agentID.name}。抱歉。

messages.en: Are you serious?! I mean, I'd heard you were unstoppable.
messages.zh: 你是认真的吗？！我是说，我听说你是无人能挡的。

messages.zh: 太糟了，{[character]player.name}。你本可以在这件事上让当权者们好好记住你的功劳。

messages.en:
Formed by two former members of the Caldari Navy who go by the names “Fatal” and “The Rabbit,” the Guristas are a constant thorn in the side of the Caldari State. The Guristas are traditional pirates in the sense that their operation is not based around some creed or ideology, but rather a plain and simple motivation: greed.

The Guristas have starbases close to Caldari space, and from them they embark on daring raids, often into the State itself. Though Guristas pirates are considered more honorable than many of their counterparts, they are still extremely dangerous and not to be tampered with.
messages.zh:
古斯塔斯集团由两个前加达里海军成员“命运”和“野兔”所建立，一直以来是加达里合众国的眼中钉。古斯塔斯是传统意义上的海盗，他们的行动不受教义或意识形态的束缚，仅由简单的动机支配：贪婪。

古斯塔斯基地距加达里很近，海盗们从那里发动大胆袭击，有时还进入加达里境内。虽然古斯塔斯与他们的同类相比更值得尊敬，但是他们依然是极度危险的人物，需要小心应付。

messages.en: The Guristas
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯

messages.en:
The Serpentis Corporation was founded a few decades ago by V. Salvador Sarpati. At first a legitimate corporation, it was engaged in hi-tech research, but with time its ties to organized crime grew and the Serpentis research stations, scattered around in remote areas, became infamous pirate havens. Sarpati made a deal with the Angel Cartel early on to gain protection for his stations, and the duty was taken on by the Guardian Angels. Both sides have prospered enormously from this deal ― Serpentis can operate in peace, and the Angel Cartel gets access to the illegal research efforts of the Serpentis.

It is strongly believed that Serpentis is the largest developer and manufacturer of illegal neural boosters, especially since Sarpati's father was a renowned specialist in that field. The home of the Serpentis criminal organization is the Phoenix constellation in the Fountain region.

据信，天蛇集团是非法神经增效剂的最大开发商和生产商，而萨巴蒂的父亲曾是这一领域享有盛誉的专家，这更巩固了人们的想法。天蛇犯罪组织的老巢位于源泉之域的凤凰星座。

messages.zh: 老兄，我以前是跟天使的人纠缠过。不过，你居然让我去端掉一个全副守卫的空间站？！不了，我想我不感兴趣。

messages.en: Too bad, {[character]player.name}. You could have made some serious points with the powers-that-be on this one.
messages.zh: 太糟了，{[character]player.name}。你本可以在这件事上让当权者们好好记住你的功劳。

messages.en:
Operating from the heart of the Curse region, the Angel Cartel is today the largest and best organized of the space-based criminal factions. The Angels are divided into several groups, each with a very special function; the organization as a whole is commanded by the “Dominations.” In the century they've been lurking in deep space, they have stolen, plundered, or sabotaged countless ships and kidnapped, harassed, or murdered thousands of people.

The Angels recruit members from all races, and are thus not bound to any one area of operation; their touch reaches almost the entire known EVE universe. Many believe that the Angels got their power by uncovering Jovian technologies hidden in their ancient homes, now infested by the Angel Cartel.
messages.zh:
天使企业联合体的运作位于柯尔斯星域的心脏地带，是当今基于太空的规模最大、组织最完善的犯罪团体。天使联合分为数个团体，每个都有极其特殊的职能。该组织整体上由主天使集团支配。

守护天使集团是天使企业联合体的一个部门，专门守卫天使和天蛇集团的空间站。天蛇集团支付天使企业联合体相当可观的酬劳以获得保护，这种保护力量甚至使DED也不敢靠近。

messages.en: The Angel Cartel
messages.zh: 天使集团

messages.en:
You guessed it. I have a personal matter that needs fixing, and I'm hoping you're up for it: I need you to be discreet about this, though, so please don't discuss it over dinner with your friends.

A few months ago, a relative of one of the executive officers of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} disappeared for a while. I won't name any names, because we want to avoid tarnishing any valuable reputations. You get me? Okay. We now know that she was involved with some shady fellows, one guy in particular who's known for his close ties to people in the Angel Cartel. I understand he's a pilot who's trying to get into the Angels, actually.

Now, the girl doesn't want to talk about what happened, but she was pretty messed up and she's now with child. I think she had a crush on this guy for some time, or at least that's what her friends told me. Poor kid. This guy needs to be brought to justice. Terminal justice, if you take my meaning. The beauty of it is, we know he's currently hiding out at an Angel recruitment station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, so if we take out that whole station, then we make points with the authorities and we clear up this personal issue at the same time.

So here it is: I want you to go out there and take out that recruitment station ― I mean reduce it to scrap ― along with any Angels you might find guarding it. Sound good? The reward, as always, will be commensurate with the risk.
messages.zh:
你猜对了。我有件私事要处理，希望你能够帮我办妥。我需要你慎重对待它，所以请不要在饭桌上跟你的朋友提及此事。

几个月前，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的一位执行长官的亲戚消失了一段时间。为了避免影响任何要人的声誉，我不会指名道姓。你懂我意思吗？好的。我们现在知道的情况是，她与一些可疑分子有瓜葛，尤其是一个众所周知与天使的人有着密切关系的家伙。我了解到，他实际上是个试图加入天使集团的飞行员。

那名少女不想说出发生了什么，不过她现在处境很糟——她怀孕了。我想她对那家伙着了一段时间的迷，至少她的朋友是这么跟我说的。可怜的孩子。这个家伙应该被绳之以法，终极审判，如果你懂我的意思的话。这件事的高明之处就是，我们知道他现在藏在位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个天使招募空间站中，所以如果我们端掉整个空间站，那么我们既能让当局另眼相看，也能同时解决这件私事。

所以你的任务是：去那里端掉整个招募空间站——我是说把它炸成碎片——包括你发现的任何进行守卫的天使海盗。听起来不错吧？赏金嘛，像往常一样，与风险是成正比的。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, The cretin who assaulted my boss‘s relative is now a member of the Angels, and he‘s long gone from the recruitment station. The military has been called in to deal with the station itself, so our opportunity is lost. Damn shame, too. I had high hopes for a promotion once this was dealt with.

Guess maybe I should look for someone else next time, maybe, eh?

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}， 那个侵犯了我老板亲戚的笨蛋现在已经是天使企业联合体的一员了，他早就离开了招募空间站。当局已召集了军队来解决那座空间站，所以我们的机会落空了。真是遗憾。我本来满怀希望，以为办妥了这件事就能晋升了。

也许下次我该找别人了，也许吧？

{[character]agentID.name}"

messages.en: Miscreant escaped
messages.zh: 异教徒逃脱

messages.en: I'm gonna have to call it quits on this mission, {[character]agentID.name}. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我不得不退出这个任务，{[character]agentID.name}。抱歉。

messages.en: Are you serious?! I mean, I'd heard you were unstoppable.
messages.zh: 你是认真的吗？！我是说，我听说你是无人能挡的。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, The cretin who assaulted my boss‘s relative is now a member of the Angels, and he‘s long gone from the recruitment station. Guess maybe I should look for someone else next time, maybe, eh?

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.zh: 异教徒逃脱

name.fr: Chasseurs de têtes de la légion Mordu
name.ja: モードゥのヘッドハンター

messages.en: Don't worry; I'll take care of it.
messages.zh: 放心；交给我吧。

messages.en: Wonderful. Of course, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will pay well for this job ― the Mordus are no easy fare.
messages.zh: 好极了。当然，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}会为这份工作付一大笔钱的——莫德团可不是那么容易对付的。

messages.en: Well, I had heard that you might have some work for me.
messages.zh: 听说你可能有些工作给我做。

messages.en:
One of our patrols spotted a Mordu's Legion strike force not far from here. We have since received intelligence confirming that the Legion has been hired to assassinate one of our high-ranking officials. We can't let this happen, of course, so we need someone of your caliber to destroy them all. Make sure no one survives.

Of course, we ourselves have used the Legion in the past for … well, for various things. So we don't want to make a big political scene out of this if we ever have to hire them in the future. That's why we mustn't send one of our own ships out to confront them. No, you're the right one for this job. Leave no trace behind; I don't want this biting us in the ass later on.

Oh, and one other thing: Our spies inform us that Taisu Magdesh might actually be part of the Mordu strike force, so be extra careful if he appears ― his reputation is hard won.
messages.zh:
我们的一艘巡逻舰在离这里不远处发现了一支莫德团攻击部队。我们之后收到的情报证实，这支莫德军团是被雇来加害我们的一位高级官员的。我们当然不能容许这种事情发生，所以我们需要一个像你这样有才干的人去消灭他们。一定要全部消灭。

当然，我们自己以前也雇佣过莫德团去做……呃，做各种事情。我们不想让它演变成一个重大的政治事件，因为我们将来可能还要雇佣他们。这就是为什么我们不得派自己的飞船去正面迎击他们。但是，你很适合这个任务。不要留下任何线索；我不想留下后患日后反咬我们一口。

噢，还有一件事：间谍通知我们，泰斯·马德什可能是这支莫德攻击部队的一分子，所以如果他现身的话，你要格外小心——他可不是浪得虚名。

messages.en: Done. Missile-spamming monkeys are easy. It's all the same to me.
messages.zh: 搞定。乱放导弹的猴子很好对付。对我来说都一样。

messages.en: Thank you very much, {[character]player.name}. You have saved us from the assassination attempt and guaranteed that this didn't turn into a political blunder.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。你粉碎了一个阴谋，并确保这事没有转变成政治障碍。

messages.en: Mordu's Legion? An assassination force? Uh, this sounds like some serious shit, so … no. No thanks.
messages.zh: 莫德团？一支行刺部队？呃，这听起来像非常严重，所以……不了，我不干，谢谢。

messages.en: One wonders why certain capsuleers ever bother to get impressive ships when they don't seem to want to fly them…
messages.zh: 有人会想，某些飞行员干嘛费力去弄些惹眼的飞船，尽管他们似乎并不想开它们……

messages.en:
The origin of Mordu's Legion is an indirect result of the Gallente-Caldari War, during which a group of Intaki military personnel sided with the Caldari. The Intakis were placed into a separate unit commanded by a Caldari officer named Mordu. After the war, the Intakis settled in Caldari space, but unwillingly became embroiled in a battle against Caldari locals in what is now known as the Waschi Uprising. Mordu's Legion formed at that time as a mercenary fighting force, and after the uprising it stayed active, working for the highest bidder ― but, it is said, acting always with integrity and honor.

Mordu's Legion is loosely associated with the Caldari Navy, but remains independent. The Legion is commonly hired by companies to protect valuable assets in low-security space, most often near the Caldari State; for instance, Outer Ring Excavations pays the Legion handsomely to patrol the Outer Ring region.
messages.zh:
莫德团是盖伦特-加达里战争的间接产物，战争期间有一批印塔基军人与加达里同一阵营。这些印塔基人被编入一个独立部队，由一位名叫莫德的加达里军官指挥。战争结束后，这些印塔基人在加达里定居下来，但无奈卷入了与当地加达里人的战争，现称瓦斯奇抗争。莫德团就是在那时候作为一支雇佣兵打击力量被组建起来的，并在抗争结束后仍保持活跃。他们为出价最高者工作——但是，据说他们的行动一直秉持诚实和荣誉。

莫德团与加达里海军有些关系，但保持完全独立。莫德团常被一些公司雇佣以保护他们在帝国境外的贵重财产，例如外空联合矿业集团就高薪聘请他们在外环星域巡逻。

messages.en: Mordu's Legion
messages.zh: 莫德团

messages.en:
Hm. Yes. As a matter of fact, I do have a relatively serious matter that could use someone of your ability … not to mention someone with your considerable resources. One of our patrols spotted a Mordu's Legion strike force not far from here. We have since received intelligence confirming that the Legion has been hired to assassinate one of our high-ranking officials. We can't let this happen, of course, so we need someone of your caliber to destroy them all. Make sure no one survives.

Of course, we ourselves have used the Legion in the past for … well, for various things. So we don't want to make a big political scene out of this if we ever have to hire them in the future. Oh, and one other thing: Our spies inform us that Taisu Magdesh might actually be part of the Mordu strike force, so be extra careful if he appears ― his reputation is hard won.
messages.zh:
嗯，是的。实际上，我的确有个比较严重的问题需要一个像你这样有才干的人……更不要说你还有相当的资源。我们的一艘巡逻舰在离这里不远处发现了一支莫德团攻击部队。我们之后收到的情报证实，这支莫德军团是被雇来加害我们的一位高级官员的。我们当然不能容许这种事发生，所以我们需要一个像你这样有才干的人去消灭他们。一定要全部消灭。

当然，我们自己以前也雇佣过莫德团去做……呃，做各种事情。我们不想让它演变成一个重大的政治事件，因为我们将来可能还要雇佣他们。这就是为什么我们不得派自己的飞船去正面迎击他们。但是，你很适合这个任务。不要留下任何线索；我不想留下后患日后反咬我们一口。

噢，还有一件事：间谍通知我们，泰斯·马德什可能是这支莫德攻击部队的一分子，所以如果他现身的话，你要格外小心——他可不是浪得虚名。

messages.en: I've decided not to do this job for you after all ― no hard feelings, I hope?
messages.zh: 我最终还是决定不为你干这个工作——我希望你不会感到不痛快吧？

messages.en: Hard feelings? No. Some concern? Yeah, I'm definitely what you might call concerned.
messages.zh: 感到不痛快？不会。有点担忧？是啊，我现在绝对称得上万分焦虑。

messages.en: Hard feelings? No. Some concern? Yeah, I'm definitely what you might call concerned.
messages.zh: 感到不痛快？不会。有点担忧？是啊，我现在绝对称得上万分焦虑。

messages.en: Angels? For sure! I hate those guys!
messages.zh: 天使联合体？当然愿意！我讨厌那些家伙！

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}. Be careful out there. It won't be easy.
messages.zh: 我就知道你值得信赖，{[character]player.name}。千万要小心。这不是个轻松的任务。

messages.en: You seem upset, {[character]agentID.name}. What's the problem?
messages.zh: 你看起来很心烦，{[character]agentID.name}。有什么问题吗？

messages.en:
The Angels have a “research station” out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. That‘s bad enough. Now, last week, a friend told me that a couple of scientists who work for his pharmaceutical corporation were kidnapped by the Angels and taken to their glorified floating drug lab. Their ruffians have been showing up in stations all through the system, and in nearby systems too, pushing some new, experimental drug they're making by the shipload in this station of theirs. “Wrath,” they're calling it. Well, that's the last straw.

I want something done about this, and the Navy doesn't seem to care about what's going on. So I've arranged for a nice little reward for the first captain who's willing to go out there and take out that station. I'm serious. Destroy the whole place, and take out all the pirates you see flying around there. And if you can, bring those scientists back here, too; they have families to feed, for god's sake!
messages.zh:

messages.en: The Angel station is destroyed. And I earned every bit of that reward!

messages.en: Oh, excellent! I knew you could do it, {[character]player.name}.

messages.zh: 一座天使战役空间站？你疯了吗？！呃，不了……

天使企业联合体的运作位于柯尔斯星域的心脏地带，是当今基于太空的规模最大、组织最完善的犯罪团体。天使联合分为数个团体，每个都有极其特殊的职能。该组织整体上由主天使集团支配。

messages.en: The Salvation Angels
messages.zh: 打捞天使集团

messages.en:
Ha! Upset!? That‘s an understatement. How would you feel if you had just learned that the Angel Cartel had just taken possession of a battle station in the same constellation you live in with your family?! Bad news, I tell you. And it gets worse. Angel ruffians have been showing up in stations all through the system, and in nearby systems too, I hear, pushing some new, experimental drug they're making by the shipload in this station of theirs. “Wrath,” they're calling it. It's too much, I tell you. I need a drink.

Okay, that's a little better. Now, let me fill you in: A couple of years ago, the Serpentis Corporation built a research station out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and that was bad enough. Things were alright at first, despite the Serpentis‘ reputation, but then rumors started spreading that they were making drugs there, not doing any kind of real research.

And then some local freight-runners reported seeing cargo ships pouring in and out of the place, and the station started expanding, adding sentries and missile batteries, and, inevitably, Angel and Serpentis ships started frequenting the place. Piracy ramped up in local shipping lanes. And now this: We find out that the Serpentis have moved on and pretty much left the place in the hands of the Angels.

Now, last week, a friend told me that a couple of scientists who work for his pharmaceutical corporation were kidnapped by the Angels and taken to their glorified floating drug lab. That's the last straw. I want something done about this, and the Navy doesn't seem to care about what's going on. So I've arranged for a nice little reward for the first captain who's willing to go out there and take out that station. I'm serious. Destroy the whole place, and take out all the pirates you see flying around there. And if you can, bring those scientists back here, too; they have families to feed, for god's sake!

{[character]player.name}, are you the capsuleer for this job?
messages.zh:
哈！心烦！？那实在太轻描淡写了。如果你刚得知天使企业联合体在你和家人居住的星座区域里夺取了一座战役空间站，你会有什么感受？！我告诉你，那会是个坏消息。而且情况还在变得更糟。这些恶棍近来出现在本星系的所有空间站里，强行推销某种新型实验性药物，恐怕他们在附近其他星系里也在这么干——他们在那所空间站里一船接一船生产这种药物。“愤怒”，这是他们给它起的名字。我跟你说，这太过分了。我得喝一杯。

好吧，这样好点了。现在，让我把情况告诉你：几年前，天蛇集团在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一所研究空间站，这已经够糟的了。尽管天蛇名声不好，不过起初那里情况还正常，但是后来传闻四起，说他们在那里制造违规药品，而不是做任何真正的研究。

上个星期，一个朋友告诉我，在他公司任职的几位科学家被天使联合体绑架了，并被带到了那个被他们美其名曰为浮游药物实验室的空间站。这让人再也无法忍受了。我需要对这事采取行动，但海军好像根本不关心事态的发展。因此，我准备了一笔诱人的小奖金，专给愿意带头前去端掉那个空间站的船长。我是认真的。摧毁整个地方，干掉附近你看到的所有海盗。如果可以的话，把那些科学家也带回来；上帝啊，他们还要养家糊口！

{[character]player.name}，你是适合这个任务的飞行员吗？

messages.en: I've changed my mind. I‘m sure you can find someone else crazy enough to tackle an Angel battle station.
messages.zh: 我改主意了。我肯定你能另找一个足够疯狂的家伙去跟一座天使战役空间站较劲。

messages.en: We can only hope, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我们只能怀抱希望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Angels? For sure! I hate those guys!

messages.zh: 我就知道你值得信赖，{[character]player.name}。千万要小心。这不是个轻松的任务。

messages.en: You seem upset, {[character]agentID.name}. What's the problem?
messages.zh: 你看起来很心烦，{[character]agentID.name}。有什么问题吗？

A couple of years ago, the Serpentis Corporation built a station out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and that was bad enough. Things were alright at first, despite the Serpentis‘ reputation, but then the criminal activities started. Piracy, drug-running, the usual.

And then known Angel and Serpentis pirate ships started frequenting the place. Piracy ramped up in local shipping lanes. And now this: We find out that the Serpentis have moved on and pretty much left the place in the hands of the Angels. I want something done about this, and the Navy doesn't seem to care about what's going on. So I've arranged for a nice little reward for the first captain who's willing to go out there and take out that station. I'm serious. Destroy the whole place, and take out all the pirates you see flying around there.
messages.zh:
几年前，天蛇集团在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一座空间站，这已经够糟的了。尽管天蛇名声不好，但起初情况还正常。不过后来，犯罪活动就开始了。海盗、犯罪，都是他们常干的勾当。

后来，许多臭名昭著的天使和天蛇海盗船开始频繁光顾这个地方。海盗事件在当地的安全航道上疯狂出现。现在事情是这样：我们发现天蛇集团已经另觅他处，差不多把这个地方全交到了天使联合体手上。我需要对这事采取行动，但海军好像根本不关心事态的发展。因此，我准备了一笔诱人的小奖金，专给愿意带头前去端掉那个空间站的船长。我是认真的。摧毁整个地方，干掉附近你看到的所有海盗。

messages.en: The Angel station is destroyed. And I earned every bit of that reward!
messages.zh: 天使空间站已被摧毁。而我挣到了那笔奖金的每一个子。

messages.en: Oh, excellent! I knew you could do it, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 噢，太棒了！我就知道你会办到，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: An Angel battle station? Are you nuts?! Uh, ah no...
messages.zh: 一座天使战役空间站？你疯了吗？！呃，不了……

messages.en: Well, it was a long shot. I just hope some other semi-suicidal starship captain is up for the reward...
messages.zh: 嗯，这个赌注风险不小。我只希望有别的具有半自尽倾向的星际飞船船长愿意为奖励一搏……

messages.en:
Operating from the heart of the Curse region, the Angel Cartel is today the largest and best organized of the space-based criminal factions. The Angels are divided into several groups, each with a very special function; the organization as a whole is commanded by the Domination Angels.

The Guardian Angels is a division of the Angel Cartel exclusively occupied with guarding their and the Serpentis' space stations. The Serpentis Corporation pays the Angel Cartel handsomely for this protection, which is strong enough to keep even the DED at bay.
messages.zh:
天使企业联合体的运作位于柯尔斯星域的心脏地带，是当今基于太空的规模最大、组织最完善的犯罪团体。天使联合分为数个团体，每个都有极其特殊的职能。该组织整体上由主天使集团支配。

守护天使集团是天使企业联合体的一个部门，专门守卫天使和天蛇集团的空间站。天蛇集团支付天使企业联合体相当可观的酬劳以获得保护，这种保护力量甚至使DED也不敢靠近。

messages.en: The Guardian Angels
messages.zh: 守护天使集团

messages.en:
Ha! Upset!? That‘s an understatement. How would you feel if you had just learned that the Angel Cartel had moved in to reinforce an Angel battle station in your home constellation?! Bad news, I tell you.

A couple of years ago, the Serpentis Corporation built a station out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and that was bad enough. Things were alright at first, despite the Serpentis‘ reputation, but then the criminal activities started. Piracy, drug-running, the usual.

And then known Angel and Serpentis pirate ships started frequenting the place. Piracy ramped up in local shipping lanes. And now this: We find out that the Serpentis have moved on and pretty much left the place in the hands of the Angels. I want something done about this, and the Navy doesn't seem to care about what's going on. So I've arranged for a nice little reward for the first captain who's willing to go out there and take out that station. I'm serious. Destroy the whole place, and take out all the pirates you see flying around there.

You the right person for the job, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh:
哈！心烦！？那实在太轻描淡写了。如果得知天使企业联合体着手加强你所居住星座区域的一座天使战役空间站，你会作何感想？！我告诉你，那会是个坏消息。

几年前，天蛇集团在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一座空间站，这已经够糟的了。尽管天蛇名声不好，但起初情况还正常。不过后来，犯罪活动就开始了。海盗、犯罪，都是他们常干的勾当。

后来，许多臭名昭著的天使和天蛇海盗船开始频繁光顾这个地方。海盗事件在当地的安全航道上疯狂出现。现在事情是这样：我们发现天蛇集团已经另觅他处，差不多把这个地方全交到了天使联合体手上。我需要对这事采取行动，但海军好像根本不关心事态的发展。因此，我准备了一笔诱人的小奖金，专给愿意带头前去端掉那个空间站的船长。我是认真的。摧毁整个地方，干掉附近你看到的所有海盗。

你是适合这份工作的人吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: I've changed my mind. I‘m sure you can find someone else crazy enough to tackle an Angel battle station.
messages.zh: 我改主意了。我肯定你能另找一个足够疯狂的家伙去跟一座天使战役空间站较劲。

messages.en: We can only hope, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我们只能怀抱希望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Fair enough. Sounds like a good fight. Consider it done.
messages.zh: 说得不错。听起来会是一场恶战。你就当这事已经办妥了。

messages.en: Excellent. Remember, captain, no survivors.
messages.zh: 很好。记住，船长，消灭所有人。

messages.en: Glad to be here. Any insurmountable obstacles that need removing?
messages.zh: 很高兴来到这里。有什么障碍需要扫平吗？

messages.en:
I've just learned that an Amarr military convoy has somehow “strayed” into our space. Preliminary scans reveal multiple freighter-class vessels with a large escort. Intelligence has informed us that this is a munitions convoy they've been hearing about for some time, but which until now has somehow managed to avoid direct monitoring until sometime yesterday. Intel's theory is made pretty concrete by virtue of the large guard force attached to the Amarr fleet.

This is an opportunity we cannot pass up. The bulk of the convoy is currently sitting in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system waiting for supply ships to catch up for refueling. I want you to intercept the convoy and destroy it before it can leave our territory; the way our interstellar relations stand right now, those weapons they're carrying could easily be turned on us within the year. If this attack is undertaken by independents that is, you and whatever allies you can pull in for this mission … and I'd advise you to bring some friends in for this one, we can easily claim no knowledge of the matter.

Now, we've had a couple of cloaked recon pilots set up jamming beacons in the vicinity to disrupt the Amarrians' communications, so they shouldn't be able to get a distress call out or hail one another when you attack. The rest is up to you. Destroy every last one of the Amarrian ships: I want no survivors. Leave no trace.
messages.zh:
我刚刚得知，一支艾玛军事运送队不知何故“误闯”入我们的空间。初步扫描结果显示，他们是些货运级飞船和一大支护卫舰队。情报部告诉我们，他们一段时间前就得知有这样一支军需品运送队了，不过在昨天某个时间以前，该运送队都设法避开了我们的直接监视。鉴于这支艾玛舰队的强大防卫力量，情报部的理论得以充分印证。

这个机会我们决不能放过。运输队的大部分目前正停留在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，等候补给舰船的到来以重新补充燃料。我要你去截获这支运输队，并在他们离开我们领空前消灭他们；就我们现在的星际关系来看，他们运载的这些武器很可能一年内就会瞄向我们。如果这场袭击是由自由人士进行的——也就是你和那些你能拉来做这个任务的友军……我建议你还是带些朋友一起来做这个任务——我们可以轻易声称对此事一无所知。

我们已派一些隐形侦察员在附近设置了干扰信标以破坏艾玛人的通信系统，这样当你进攻的时候他们就无法发出求救信号或者相互呼唤。剩下的就看你的了。消灭每一艘艾玛飞船，也不要留下痕迹。

messages.en: It was a tough one, alright, but the Amarr weapons convoy is destroyed.
messages.zh: 那是艰苦的一仗，不过，艾玛武器运送队已被消灭。

messages.en: Excellent. Most excellent. Good work out there, captain.
messages.zh: 很好。非常出色。干得漂亮，船长。

messages.en: I think destroying an entire military convoy under heavy escort is a little beyond me. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我想消灭由一整支由重兵护卫的军事运送队有点超出我的能力范围。抱歉。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, I‘d heard you were unstoppable. Well, I guess I should know better than to believe everything I hear.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我听说你是无人能挡的。我早该知道耳听未必为实。

messages.en:
The convoy in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has managed to slip away from Intelligence once again, no thanks to you. You could at least have let me know you weren‘t prepared to finish the job ― I might have found someone else to go in there.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}中的运送队再次从情报部的视线中逃脱了，你一点忙也没帮上。你至少应该告诉我你没做好完成这个任务的准备——我也许就能找别人去了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarr convoy escaped
messages.zh: 艾玛运送队逃脱

messages.en: On second thought, I'm going to pass on this mission. A heavily escorted military convoy is a little over the top.
messages.zh: 仔细一想，我打算放弃这个任务。一支重兵护送的军事运送队实在有些不可抵挡。

messages.en: What!? This was a grand opportunity to knock the Amarr down a peg. And now I have you to thank for letting it slip by.
messages.zh: 什么！？这本是个绝好的机会，可以煞煞艾玛的锐气。可现在我必须把这次机会的丧失归罪于你。

messages.zh: 米玛塔尔运送队逃脱

messages.en: Sansha, huh?  Yeah, I think I know some people who might want to space a few.
messages.zh: 是萨沙？行。我知道有些人正想解决他们呢。

messages.en: Glad to hear it.  Happy hunting.
messages.zh: 很好。祝你顺利。

messages.en: What's this about Sansha?
messages.zh: 他们怎么了？

messages.en:
We've been having problems with a Sansha outpost for a while now. I've finally received clearance to sponsor a raid on the facility. I guess someone got tired of paying for new haulers.

So how about it? Get some of your capsuleer buddies together and destroy every Sansha you find. You'll be a hero; and since the Sansha are all unholy mockeries of all that is human, you don't even have to feel bad about killing them!
messages.zh:
我们对一个萨沙哨站已经有一段时间不爽了。现在我终于获得许可，可以对那里发动一场袭击了。我看是有人心疼那些被爆掉的货船了。

怎么样？去叫上一帮朋友把萨沙一网打尽吧。你会成为一名英雄；萨沙他们是群人渣，干掉他们根本不会有负罪感！

messages.en: It's done.  We wiped every one of the Sansha out.
messages.zh: 任务完成。萨沙被打得片甲不留。

messages.en: I wish I was there to see it.  There's nothing quite as satisfying as watching the explosive decompression of an enemy ship.  Hope you had fun.  Oh, and thanks for saving all the civvies in system from the Sansha threat, or whatever.
messages.zh: 真希望我刚才能在现场。看到敌人的舰船随着爆炸声化作一团烟火是最让人满意的事了。但愿你从中获得了满足。哦，还要谢谢你把一帮平民从萨沙手中解救出来哦噢。

messages.en: Moral high ground or not, I'm not diving into a nest of Sansha.
messages.zh: 不管有没有负罪感，我都不会自投罗网的。

messages.en: Not diving in?  What, are you afraid of a few explosions?
messages.zh: 不会自投罗网？靠，难道你害怕看到爆炸吗？

messages.en: Sansha's Nation is just this side of rogue drones-- in some ways the Nation is worse. At least drones are machines acting like they're alive. Sansha were people; now they act like machines. Best thing about both is that you can blow the hell out of them and still maintain a clear moral high ground.
messages.zh: 萨沙共和国和自由无人机差不多——在某些方面还更糟。无人机至少还是机器，只是看起来像生物。萨沙是人类；现在却表现得像个机器。但他们有一个共同点：解决掉它们不会让你产生负罪感。

messages.en: Moral implications?
messages.zh: 道德后果？

So how about it? Get some of your capsuleer buddies together and destroy every Sansha you find. You'll be a hero; and since the Sansha are all unholy mockeries of all that is human, you don't even have to feel bad about killing them!
messages.zh:
我们对一个萨沙哨站已经有一段时间不爽了。现在我终于获得许可，可以对那里发动一场袭击了。我看是有人心疼那些被爆掉的货船了。

怎么样？去叫上一帮朋友把萨沙一网打尽吧。你会成为一名英雄；萨沙他们是群人渣，干掉他们根本不会有负罪感！

messages.en: You can't make up your mind in a timely fashion; I can't just sit on this offer.  The job's moved on to a merc corp.  Now you'll have to watch someone else have all the fun.
messages.zh: 你没法及时作出决定；我不能干等。我已经把这工作交给了雇佣军。你就站在一旁看着吧。

messages.en: Too slow.
messages.zh: 拖太久。

messages.en: I was all for clearing out the Sansha, but there were just too many of them.  I have to quit.
messages.zh: 我举双手支持这一计划，但敌人实在是太多了。我闪了。

messages.en: Do you have any idea how much these Sansha are costing us on a weekly basis? Never mind. I guess I'll have to contract one of the mercenary companies to take care of it.
messages.zh: 你知道这帮萨沙人让我们每周损失多少钱吗？算了，看来我得去雇一支雇佣军来接手此事。

messages.en: I can't wait for you to finish off those Sansha.  Too much pressure from above, you understand.  I have to pass the contract along to a professional mercenary corp.  You just weren't fast enough.
messages.zh: 我等不起了。上面压力太大催着我。我把这事转交给一家专业雇佣军团了。你的动作实在太慢。

messages.en: Too long.
messages.zh: 太费时。

messages.en: Glad to hear it. Don't be afraid to hurt their feelings. They have none.
messages.zh: 很高兴听你这样说。别怕伤到它们的感情。它们根本就没有这玩意儿。

messages.en:
Lately, our scouts and agents have been reporting increasing numbers of rogue drones, not just here, but throughout civilized space. We think they are building up for a massive attack in all the empires. Who knows what their goal is, really. Honestly I don't care about what the drones do elsewhere, but I want our sovereign space cleared of these machines.

Some recon scans I received yesterday indicate there's a sizeable drone colony being built in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Go out there, {[character]player.name}, and clean that hive out. I hate vermin, maybe even more than I hate the idea of those damned Jovians ― at least they are somewhat human.
messages.zh:
最近，我们的情报人员报告说自由无人机的出现数量越来越多，不只是在这里，整个文明地区都有它们的踪影。我们觉得它们是想在帝国区发动一场大规模袭击。谁都不知道它们背后的动机。说实话，如果那些无人机不来我们的主权区域活动，我才不会去管它们呢。问题是它们来了，所以我们就必须把它们赶走。

从我昨天收到的一份侦察报告来看，{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那儿正在搭起一座规模不小的无人机殖民地。快去吧，{[character]player.name}，把那无人机老巢给端了。我讨厌害虫，比起我对朱庇特人的厌恶，真是有过之而无不及——朱庇特人起码还算是人。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. That's one less thing I have to worry about.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。至少又少了一件让我烦心的事。

messages.en: Very well. But I think you gravely underestimate the threat these drones represent.
messages.zh: 好吧。你明显没有完全意识到这群无人机的潜在威胁。

messages.en:
Just in time for a job that requires a capsuleer of your skill.

You've been working for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} long enough that I think I can trust you with this ... situation. You know we try to keep our eyes on pretty much everything and everyone. Lately, our scouts and agents have been reporting increasing numbers of rogue drones, not just here, but throughout civilized space. We think they are building up for a massive attack in all the empires. Who knows what their goal is, really.

Now, honestly I don't care about what the drones do elsewhere, but I want our sovereign space cleared of these machines. You know how it is with vermin ― once they get a foothold, there is no stopping them. Well, some recon scans I received yesterday indicate there's a sizeable drone colony being built in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Hopefully you can deal with them in time before we are overrun by those infernal things and no ships are safe.

Go out there, {[character]player.name}, and clean that hive out. I hate vermin, maybe even more than I hate the idea of those damned Jovians ― at least they are somewhat human.
messages.zh:
我这里正好有件需要有你这样技能的克隆飞行员才能完成的事情。

鉴于你与{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}合作已久，我觉得我可以把这……事情放心地交给你去处理。你知道基本上任何人任何事都处于我们的监视之下。最近，我们的情报人员报告说自由无人机的出现数量越来越多，不只是在这里，整个文明地区都有它们的踪影。我们觉得它们是想在帝国区发动一场大规模袭击。谁都不知道它们背后的动机。

说实话，如果那些无人机不来我们的主权区域活动，我才不会去管它们呢。问题是它们来了，所以我们就必须把它们赶走。你应该知道那些让人讨厌的害虫的习性——一旦你让它们站稳脚跟，你就再也别想压制它们。从我昨天收到的一份侦察报告来看，{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那儿正在搭起一座规模不小的无人机殖民地。但愿你能及时解决它们，不要让它们反过来把我们和我们的船都给吞噬了。

快去吧，{[character]player.name}，把那无人机老巢给端了。我讨厌害虫，比起我对朱庇特人的厌恶，真是有过之而无不及——朱庇特人起码还算是人。

messages.en: Drone expansion ― stand down
messages.zh: 无人机扩张——撤退

messages.en: What?! You're quitting? Oh, fine. I'll just hope I can find someone else to deal with it.
messages.zh: 什么？！你退出？好吧，好吧。但愿我能找到其他人来接手此事。

messages.en: Drone expansion ― stand down
messages.zh: 无人机扩张——撤退

messages.en: I'll catch him.
messages.zh: 我会抓到他的。

messages.en: Don't waste any time. Galin Famis is already getting away.
messages.zh: 一分钟也别浪费。加林·法米斯已经在逃跑途中了。

messages.en: My ears are open and my lips are sealed.
messages.zh: 我耳听八方，嘴不漏风。

messages.en:
Quafe has been secretly developing a new soft drink called Quafe Unleashed that they say will revolutionize the entire soft drink industry. But only hours ago, the formula was stolen. Security records show that a Quafe employee, an Amarrian named Galin Famis, has just left the station with the top-secret formula in his possession. Quafe representatives believe that he might be on his way to try to sell or deliver the formula to one of Quafe's competitors, and have offered a reward for the recovery of the formula.

Now, the Amarr government has spoken out against this act of corporate terrorism, but so far they haven't taken any overt actions to deal with it. We could make big points if we could find Famis. We were able to track him for a while, and we've just heard that he's now in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. I'll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom. Stop him before he meets his contact, and bring back the formula.

We're not expecting you to go to war for this, but you should be prepared to meet some rough customers.
messages.zh:
回到主题， 酷菲一直在秘密研制一种叫做“酷菲劲量”的新软饮料，传说这种饮料将会给整个饮料业带来巨变。但就在几小时前，饮料的配方失窃了。安全记录表明，一个酷菲的雇员-名叫加林.法米斯的艾玛人刚带着绝密配方离开空间站。酷菲方面代表认为，他可能会设法出售配方或将其交给酷菲的竞争对手，酷菲方面已经提供悬赏追回失窃的配方。

现在， 艾玛政府已表示反对这种企业恐怖主义行为，但到目前为止，他们没有采取任何相应的公开行动。如果我们能找到法米斯我们就可以弄出点大动静儿了。我们追踪了他一个段时间，刚收到消息，他在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name} 恒星系。我已经把任务的详细情况上传到你控制边栏中的日志上了。在他和别人取得联络之前阻止他，并带回配方。

我们不希望你因此卷入战争，但是你要做好准备，可能会遇到很棘手的对手。

messages.en: I have the formula right here.
messages.zh: 配方就在我这里。

messages.en:
Nice work. But I wonder why the formula has this psychotropic drug in it...?

Hm. Well, never mind. Sometimes it's best not to know.
messages.zh:
干得不错。但我不明白，为什么配方里含有这种神经药物……？

嗯。唉，算了。有时候还是什么都不知道为上策。

messages.en: Damn! I hope I can find someone else to handle this on such short notice.
messages.zh: 可恶！时间这么紧促，我真希望能找到别人来处理这事。

messages.zh: 到达某个任务所在星系之后，要跃迁到这个任务的位置，只需在开放空间的任意位置右击鼠标。在出现的下拉窗口中，你会发现一个可以跃迁到任务地点的选项。

messages.zh: 友情提示

messages.en:

Thanks to Quafe's assistance in resolving the Girani-Fa incident, their presence and political clout within the Empire has grown tremendously.

Anyway, Quafe has been secretly developing a new soft drink called Quafe Unleashed that they say will revolutionize the entire soft drink industry. But only hours ago, the formula was stolen. Security records show that a Quafe employee, an Amarrian named Galin Famis, has just left the station with the top-secret formula in his possession. Quafe representatives believe that he might be on his way to try to sell or deliver the formula to one of Quafe's competitors, and have offered a reward for the recovery of the formula.

Now, the Amarr government has spoken out against this act of corporate terrorism, but so far they haven't taken any overt actions to deal with it. We could make big points if we could find Famis. We were able to track him for a while, and we've just heard that he's now in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. I'll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom. Stop him before he meets his contact, and bring back the formula.

Oh, and make sure you keep this to yourself. Quafe doesn't want it to get out that this formula even exists.

回到主题， 酷菲一直在秘密研制一种叫做“酷菲劲量”的新软饮料，传说这种饮料将会给整个饮料业带来巨变。但就在几小时前，饮料的配方失窃了。安全记录表明，一个酷菲的雇员-名叫加林.法米斯的艾玛人刚带着绝密配方离开空间站。酷菲方面代表认为，他可能会设法出售配方或将其交给酷菲的竞争对手，酷菲方面已经提供悬赏追回失窃的配方。

哦，对了，你还要保证对此守口如瓶。 酷菲不希望外界知道配方的存在。

messages.en: Maybe next time. Are you sure you're ready to be a ship commander? Perhaps you'd be best among the slaves.
messages.zh: 也许下次吧。你确定做好担当舰船指挥官的准备了？也许你最好还是和劳工呆在一起。

messages.en: I'll catch him.
messages.zh: 我会抓到他的。

messages.en: Don't waste any time.  Quince Nemirda is already getting away.
messages.zh: 一分钟也别浪费。昆斯·内密尔达已经在逃跑途中了。

messages.en: I know when to keep my mouth shut, yeah.
messages.zh: 我知道什么时候该管住自己的嘴。

messages.zh: 我猜昆斯·内密尔达已经逃跑了。你竟然连一个手无缚鸡之力的技术员都抓不到，我们就不指望你能派上什么用场了。

messages.en: I'll catch him.

messages.en: I know what's what, yeah.

We could make big points if we could find Blackish. We were able to track him for a while, and we've just heard that he's now in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. I‘ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom. Stop him before he meets his contact, and bring back the formula.

Oh, and make sure you keep this to yourself. Quafe doesn't want it to get out that this formula even exists.
messages.zh:
我刚收到了一个来自酷菲公司的紧急幕后消息。这个公司是银河系中最大的软饮料制造商，你也听说过吧？他们是最令我们骄傲、最成功的军团之一……而且，由于他们在盖拉尼法事件中的积极参与，他们的政治影响力达到了空前绝后的水平，他们与政府政要有很好的私交。

回到主题，酷菲一直在秘密研制一种叫做“酷菲劲量”的新软饮料，传说这种饮料将会给整个饮料业带来巨变。他们在这里研制是因为这里不是他们的军团总部，消息不容易泄露。

但就在几小时前，饮料的配方失窃了。安全记录表明，一个名叫斯旺斯·布莱克什的酷菲雇员刚带着绝密配方离开空间站。酷菲方面代表认为，他可能会设法出售配方或将其交给酷菲的竞争对手，酷菲方面已经提供悬赏追回失窃的配方。

如果我们能找到布莱克什我们就能弄出点大动静儿来了。我们追踪了他一个段时间，刚收到消息，他在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}恒星系。我已经把任务的详细情况上传到你控制边栏中的日志上了。在他和别人取得联络之前阻止他，并带回配方。

哦，对了，你还要保证对此守口如瓶。 酷菲不希望外界知道配方的存在。

messages.en: I guess Sivance Blackish must have escaped. Perhaps I'll have to look for a different ship commander next time. I thought you were ready.
messages.zh: 我猜斯旺斯·布莱克什已经逃跑了。看来下回我得找别的舰船指挥官了。我还以为你已经够资格了呢。

messages.en: I'll catch him.
messages.zh: 我会抓到他的。

messages.en: Don't waste any time. Choon Mirith is already getting away.
messages.zh: 一分钟也别浪费。求恩·米瑞斯已经在逃跑途中了。

messages.en: I'm all ears.
messages.zh: 我洗耳恭听。

messages.en:
Quafe has been secretly developing a new soft drink called Quafe Unleashed that they say will revolutionize the entire soft drink industry. But only hours ago, the formula was stolen. Security records show that a Quafe employee, a guy called Choon Mirith, has just left the station with the top-secret formula in his possession. Quafe representatives believe that he might be on his way to try to sell or deliver the formula to one of Quafe's competitors, and have offered a reward for the recovery of the formula.

We could make big points with our Gallente friends if we could find Choon Mirith first. We were able to track him for a while, and we've just heard that he's now in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. I‘ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom. Stop him before he meets his contact, and bring back the formula.

We're not expecting you to go to war for this, but you should be prepared to meet some rough customers.
