酷菲一直在秘密研制一种叫做“酷菲劲量”的新软饮料，传说这种饮料将会给整个饮料业带来巨变。他们在这里研制是因为这里不是他们的军团总部，消息不容易泄露。

但就在几小时前，饮料的配方失窃了。安全记录表明，一个名叫求恩·米瑞斯的酷菲雇员刚带着绝密配方离开空间站。酷菲方面代表认为，他可能会设法出售配方或将其交给酷菲的竞争对手，酷菲方面已经提供悬赏追回失窃的配方。

如果我们能找到求恩·米瑞斯我们就能弄出点大动静儿来了。我们追踪了他一个段时间，刚收到消息，他在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}恒星系。我已经把任务的详细情况上传到你控制边栏中的日志上了。在他和别人取得联络之前阻止他，并带回配方。

我们不希望你因此卷入战争，但是你要做好准备，可能会遇到很棘手的对手。

messages.en: I have the formula right here.
messages.zh: 配方就在我这里。

messages.en:
Nice work. But I wonder why the formula has this psychotropic drug in it...?

Hm. Well, never mind. Sometimes it's best not to know.
messages.zh:
干得不错。但我不明白，为什么配方里含有这种神经药物……？

嗯。唉，算了。有时候还是什么都不知道为上策。

messages.en: Damn! I hope I can find someone else to handle this on such short notice.
messages.zh: 可恶！时间这么紧促，我真希望能找到别人来处理这事。

messages.en: To warp to a mission's location once you've arrived in its star system, simply right-click anywhere in open space. In the drop-down menu that appears, you will find an option to warp to the mission.
messages.zh: 要跃迁到某个任务的位置，一旦你到达任务所在星系，就在开放空间的任意位置点击。在出现的下拉窗口中，你会发现一个可以跃迁到任务地点的选项。

messages.en: Helpful Hint
messages.zh: 友情提示

messages.en:
I just received an emergency communication from an insider in the Quafe Corporation. Perhaps you've heard of them, the single biggest soft drink manufacturer in the galaxy? Thanks to their involvement in the Girani-Fa incident, they have a lot of power in every corner of space these days. Even in remote, primitive areas, one can still always find a Quafe dispenser.

Anyway, Quafe has been secretly developing a new soft drink called Quafe Unleashed that they say will revolutionize the entire soft drink industry. But only hours ago, the formula was stolen. Security records show that a Quafe employee, one Choon Mirith, has just left the station with the top-secret formula in his possession. Quafe representatives believe that he might be on his way to try to sell or deliver the formula to one of Quafe's competitors, and have offered a reward for the recovery of the formula.

We could make big points if we could find Mirith. We were able to track him for a while, and we've just heard that he's now in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. I‘ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom. Stop him before he meets his contact, and bring back the formula.

Oh, and make sure you keep this to yourself. Quafe doesn't want it to get out that this formula even exists.

回到主题， 酷菲一直在秘密研制一种叫做“酷菲劲量”的新软饮料，传说这种饮料将会给整个饮料业带来巨变。他们在这里研制是因为这里不是他们的军团总部，消息不容易泄露。

但就在几小时前，饮料的配方失窃了。安全记录表明，一个名叫求恩·米瑞斯的酷菲雇员刚带着绝密配方离开空间站。酷菲方面代表认为，他可能会设法出售配方或将其交给酷菲的竞争对手，酷菲方面已经提供悬赏追回失窃的配方。

如果我们能找到米瑞斯我们就能弄出点大动静儿来了。我们追踪了他一个段时间，刚收到消息，他在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系。我已经把任务的详细情况上传到你控制边栏中的日志上了。在他和别人取得联络之前阻止他，并带回配方。

哦，对了，你还要保证对此守口如瓶。酷菲不希望外界知道配方的存在。

messages.en: I guess Choon Mirith must have escaped. Too bad.
messages.zh: 我猜求恩·米瑞斯已经逃掉了。太糟糕了。

name.de: Flamme des Friedens - Die Auserwählte  (4 von 4)
name.es: La llama de la paz: La elegida (4 de 4)
name.fr: La flamme de la paix - L'élue (4 sur 4)
name.ja: 平和の炎―選ばれしもの（4/4）
name.ru: Пламя мира – Избранная (Flame of Peace - Chosen) (4 из 4)

messages.en: I'll wipe them out.
messages.zh: 我会去一举歼灭他们。

messages.en: Excellent. God be with you!
messages.zh: 很好。愿神与你同在！

messages.en: I stand ready.
messages.zh: 我随时待命。

messages.en:
The prisoners you procured for us on your last assignment provided ample information on the Flame of Peace organization. Their leader is a woman calling herself simply "Chosen." Let me make it clear: I want you to go in there and wipe them out. You knocked them off balance with your previous attack. Now you must finish them off.

I've uploaded the location of their hideout in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} into your databank. Now, get going, and don't come back until you've destroyed them.

Do not go into this mission unless you are fully prepared for combat!
messages.zh:
你上次带回来的俘虏为我们提供了许多关于“和平火焰”组织的信息。他们的首领是一名女性，自称“天择”。我把话说明了：我要你立刻前去那里，把他们彻底铲除。你之前的进攻把他们打得失了阵脚。现在你必须结果他们。

我已经把他们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}藏匿处的位标上传到你的数据库。好了，现在去吧，不把他们消灭别回来。

执行任务前，务必做好战斗准备！

messages.en: The Flame of Peace has been extinguished.
messages.zh: “和平火焰”已经被我扑灭。

messages.en: Outstanding work, {[character]player.name}! You are a true and loyal citizen, and you have done the Empire a great service.
messages.zh: 非常出色，{[character]player.name}！你真是一名忠诚的公民，为帝国做了一大贡献！

messages.en: Leave them alone. They're not harming anyone but themselves.
messages.zh: 让他们自生自灭好了。他们除了自己，没有伤害别人。

messages.en: Perhaps you sympathize with these vermin!? Get out of my sight!
messages.zh: 你大概是同情那些恶棍吧！立刻从我眼前消失！

messages.en:
Good, my friend. Good. The prisoners you procured for us on your last assignment provided ample information on the Flame of Peace organization. Some of them succumbed admirably to our interrogation techniques, and they have since become newly reformed, docile slaves. But before we wiped their minds, they gave us clues to the location of their leader.

The leader is a woman calling herself simply "Chosen." Apparently she had some sort of delusional religious vision and in a fit of inspiration and creativity, wrote their "sacred text" over the course of a pleasure cruise through the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. And what emerged was the Fellowship of the Flame of Peace.

Let me make it clear: I want you to go in there and wipe them out. You knocked them off balance with your previous attack. Now you must finish them off. I've uploaded the location of their hideout into your databank. Now, get going, and don't come back until you've destroyed them.
messages.zh:
好，我的朋友。真好，你最近一次任务里面抓回来的俘虏给我们提供了关于和平火焰组织的足够信息。他们当中的一些对我们的审讯方法毫无招架之力，现在已经成为了顺服的改过自新的劳工了。在我们给他们洗脑之前，他们给了我们些关于他们头目的方位的线索。

他们头目是一个自称为“天择”的女人。很明显，她有一些多少有点妄想的宗教理念，加上一些灵感的创造力，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系快乐航行的途中写了他们的“圣文”。由此产生了和平火焰团体。

让我说得清楚点吧：我要你过去，把他们全部摆平。在之前的攻击中，你已经把他们打得遍地找牙，现在你要终结他们。我已经把他们的藏身之地上传到你的数据库里面去了。现在，出发吧，全部消灭，凯旋而归。

messages.en: You waited too long. The cannibalistic heretics caught wind of our coming and fled. You have failed the Empire, failed miserably.
messages.zh: 你耽搁的时间太久了。那些吃人不眨眼的异教徒听到了我们要来的风声，已经逃跑了。你太让帝国失望了，失望得一塌糊涂。

messages.en: You let them get away!
messages.zh: 你让他们跑了！

messages.en: You abandon your task now? You are no better than these filthy vermin!
messages.zh: 你要现在放弃你的任务？你比这些肮脏的害虫好不到哪儿去！

messages.en: You waited too long. The cannibalistic heretics caught wind of our coming and fled. You have failed the Empire, failed miserably.
messages.zh: 你耽搁的时间太久了。那些吃人不眨眼的异教徒听到了我们要来的风声，已经逃跑了。你太让帝国失望了，失望得一塌糊涂。

messages.en: You let them get away!
messages.zh: 你让他们跑了！

name.es: La llama de la paz: Canibalismo (3 de 4)
name.fr: La flamme de la paix - Cannibalisme (3 sur 4)
name.ja: 平和の炎―カニバリズム（3/4）
name.ru: Пламя мира – каннибализм (Flame of Peace - Cannibalism) (3 из 4)
name.zh: 和平火焰 – 食人主义(3/4)

messages.en: I will not fail.
messages.zh: 我不会失败的。

messages.en: Excellent. Don't forget to bring back prisoners.
messages.zh: 很好。别忘了带些俘虏回来。

messages.en: Maybe not, but I have a feeling you're going to tell me…
messages.zh: 也许不会吧，但我觉得你会告诉我的……

messages.en:
This new "religion" is one of the most twisted travesties of faith we have ever encountered. They talk much of peace and love, and all such nonsense, but according to their text, they kill and eat one of their members during their most sacred rituals. After the ritual slaughter, they roast their victim's flesh in the so-called Flame of Peace and share it among the congregation. Now you see how dangerous these deranged fanatics are!

This is highest priority. The data crystals gave us a clue to the location of one of their major enclaves. It lies deep in some rugged deadspace area, and they are likely guarding the entrance. Go there, destroy their habitat, and crush all resistance. Capture some of them alive and bring them back for interrogation.

We know that the cultist have members from all walks of life, civilians and otherwise. Some of them are likely to be experienced combat pilots, though. Don't go out there without fitting your ship for a fight.
messages.zh:
这种所谓的"新信仰"是我们遇到的对信仰的最扭曲的解释了。他们大谈和平，关爱以及一些空洞的话，但是根据他们的记载。他们在他们最神圣的仪式上处决一个成员。然后他们还把受害者的尸体在所谓的"和平火焰"上烧，还分着吃。现在你知道这些疯狂的狂热者是多么危险了吧！

这是任务的首要目标。数据晶体给我们提供了条线索，让我们找到了他们的主要窝点之一。它位于一些崎岖的死亡空间深处，进口很有可能被他们看守着。飞过去，毁掉他们的窝点，摆平所有防卫。活捉一些，好带回来审讯。

我们知道他们他们的成员鱼龙混杂，有些很有可能是战斗行家。出发之前在配船的时候，一定要做好大战一场的准备。

messages.en: Mission accomplished. Prisoners on board.
messages.zh: 任务完成了。俘虏已经押上舰船。

messages.en: You have done well. These prisoners may hold the key to destroying this heinous cult once and for all. Don't stray too far.
messages.zh: 你干得不错。这些俘虏也许是让这个可恶的教派永远消失的关键。别跑太远了。

messages.en: Leave them alone. They're not harming anyone but themselves.
messages.zh: 让他们自生自灭好了。他们除了自己，没有伤害别人。

messages.en: Perhaps you sympathize with these vermin!? Get out of my sight!
messages.zh: 你大概是同情那些恶棍吧！立刻从我眼前消失！

messages.en:
Indeed I am. This new "religion" is one of the most twisted travesties of faith we have ever encountered. They talk much of peace and love, and all such nonsense, but according to their text, they kill and eat one of their members during their most sacred rituals. After the ritual slaughter, they roast their victim's flesh in the so-called Flame of Peace and share it among the congregation. Now you see how dangerous these deranged fanatics are!

This is highest priority. The data crystals gave us a clue to the location of one of their major enclaves. It lies deep in some rugged deadspace area, and they are likely guarding the entrance. Go there, destroy their habitat, and crush all resistance. Capture some of them alive and bring them back for interrogation.

We must find the leaders of this despicable cult and wipe them out.
messages.zh:
的确是这样.这种所谓的"新信仰"是我们遇到的对信仰的最扭曲的解释了. 他们大谈和平,关爱以及一些空洞的话,但是根据他们的记载,他们在他们最神圣的仪式上处决一个成员.然后,他们还把受害者的尸体在所谓的"和平火焰"上烧,还分着吃.现在你知道这些疯狂的狂热者是多么危险了吧!

这是任务的首要目标.数据晶体给我们提供了条线索,让我们找到了他们的主要窝点之一.它位于一些崎岖的死亡空间深处,进口很有可能被他们看守着.飞过去,毁掉他们的窝点,摆平所有防卫.活捉一些,好带回来审讯.

我们一定要找到这个卑鄙信仰者组织的头头们,并且把他们消灭.

messages.en: Your lack of initiative disturbs me.
messages.zh: 你的惰性让我很不爽。

messages.en: You abandon your task now? Perhaps you sympathize with these vermin!
messages.zh: 你要现在放弃你的任务？你大概是同情那些恶棍吧！

messages.en: Failure is not acceptable!
messages.zh: 只许成功，不许失败！

name.de: Flamme des Friedens - Heilige Schriften (2 von 4)
name.es: La llama de la paz: Escrituras (2 de 4)
name.fr: La flamme de la paix - Écritures (2 sur 4)
name.ru: Пламя мира — Скрижали (Flame of Peace — Scriptures) (2 из 4)

messages.en: I'm on my way.
messages.zh: 我马上出发。

messages.en: Splendid. Don't waste a second.
messages.zh: 好极了，别浪费时间。

messages.en: I am. What do you need?
messages.zh: 是的。你需要什么？

messages.en:
We cannot crack the encryption on these odd data crystals you discovered, but the contents appear to be some kind of heretical religious text. Of course, there is only one true religion, so this upstart cult must be stamped out wherever they can be found. However, now that you've destroyed that nest, we need to look for more until these vermin are eradicated.

Deliver the data crystals to the Theology Council's chief cryptographer at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. He has an incredible talent for this sort of thing, and we hope that he can crack the encryption. Perhaps the data inside will offer some clues about this cult's plans and locations.
messages.zh:
我们无法破译你发现的这些奇异的数据晶体，其内容似乎是某类异教文本。当然了，只有一种正统的宗教，所以只要这个新兴的邪教组织被发现就一定要被消灭。虽然你已经摧毁了他们的巢穴，但是我们必须找出其余党直至这些害虫被根除。

把这些数据晶体送到神学理事会的首席破译者，他在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。他对破译有着难以置信的才华，所以我们希望他能够破译这些文本。也许这些晶体里的数据会为我们提供一些关于这个邪教组织的据点和他们想要采取的计划。

messages.en: Data crystal delivered, O Great One.
messages.zh: 数据晶体已经递送，大人。

messages.en: You have done well. You won't believe the things that we discovered after we broke the encryption! Come back when you have time, will you?
messages.zh: 你干得不错。我们把密码破解之后发现了一些东西，说出来肯定吓你一跳！有空回来，好吗？

messages.en: Why not just leave these people alone? I don't have time for this.
messages.zh: 为什么就不能让这些人自生自灭呢？我可没时间做这种事。

messages.en: Your loyalty stands in question, {[character]player.name}. Leave me.
messages.zh: 你的忠心令人怀疑，{[character]player.name}。请你离开这儿。

messages.en:
We cannot crack the encryption on these odd data crystals you discovered, but the contents appear to be some kind of heretical religious text. Of course, there is only one true religion, so this upstart cult must be stamped out wherever they can be found. However, now that you've destroyed that nest, we need to look for more until these vermin are eradicated.

Deliver the data crystals to the Theology Council's chief cryptographer at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. He has an incredible talent for this sort of thing, and we hope that he can crack the encryption. Perhaps the data inside will offer some clues about this cult's plans and locations.
messages.zh:
我们无法破译你发现的这些奇异的数据晶体，其内容似乎是某类异教文本。当然了，只有一种正统的宗教，所以只要这个新兴的邪教组织被发现就一定要被消灭。虽然你已经摧毁了他们的巢穴，但是我们必须找出其余党直至这些害虫被根除。

把这些数据晶体送到神学理事会的首席破译者，他在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。他对破译有着难以置信的才华，所以我们希望他能够破译这些文本。也许这些晶体里的数据会为我们提供一些关于这个邪教组织的据点和他们想要采取的计划。

messages.en: The encrypted data crystals you discovered had some sort of timed self-destruct mechanism. Now the thing is useless.
messages.zh: 你发现的加密数据晶体采用了一种定时自毁装置。现在这个东西已经毫无用处了。

messages.en: Why not just leave these people alone? I don't have time for this.
messages.zh: 为什么就不能让这些人自生自灭呢？我可没时间做这种事。

messages.en: You cannot make a simple courier run on something this important? I have slaves with more initiative than you!
messages.zh: 对于这么重要的东西，你连跑一趟简单的快递都不行吗？我的一些劳工都比你更有积极性！

messages.en: The encrypted data crystals you discovered had some sort of timed self-destruct mechanism. Now the whole thing is useless.
messages.zh: 你发现的加密数据晶体采用了一种定时自毁装置。现在这个东西已经毫无用处了。

name.es: La llama de la paz: Herejía (1 de 4)
name.fr: La flamme de la paix - Hérésie (1 sur 4)
name.ru: Пламя мира – ересь (Flame of Peace - Heresy) (1 из 4)

messages.en: I'll check it out.
messages.zh: 我会去看个究竟。

messages.en: Excellent. Don't forget to bring back any evidence you might find.
messages.zh: 很好。如果找到什么证据，别忘了带回来。

messages.en: Oh? Sounds interesting. What is it?
messages.zh: 噢？听上去很有趣。这是什么？

messages.en:
The Theology Council has caught wind of a religious colony, whose leaders are gathering followers on a remote station in this system. They apparently call themselves the Flame of Peace. Their outpost is in the heart of a deadspace pocket, which is more than a little suspicious. The Council wants to know what these people are up to out there. Of course, we cannot allow the slightest deviation from the practices and beliefs of Holy Scripture, so you must determine if they are gathering a following for some strange new heresy.

If you determine that they are indeed heretics, destroy them without mercy and bring back any evidence you can.
messages.zh:
神学理事会听到风声，有那么一个宗教群体，他们的领袖正在本星系一个边远空间站聚集教众。他们自称为“和平火焰”。他们的哨站位于一个死亡空间层的中心，这点非常可疑。神学理事会想知道这些人到底在那里干什么。当然，我们不容许有任何对《圣典》惯例和信仰稍有背离的行为出现，所以，你必须判断他们是否正在为某个古怪的新异教召集教众。

如果你确定他们真的是异教徒，那么就毫不留情地消灭他们，然后把能够证明你行动的证据带回来。

messages.en: I have dispatched the heretics and found this strange encrypted data storage unit.
messages.zh: 我把那些异教徒消灭了，还找到了这块奇怪的加密数据存储器。

messages.en: Great work. I'm sure the Council will want to take a look at this data immediately. However, the crystals are encrypted, so I have another job for you.
messages.zh: 干得好。理事会肯定想立即看看这些数据。不过，这些晶体已经加密，所以我有另外一件事情要你做。

messages.en: These religious politics don't interest me. I have better things to do.
messages.zh: 我对这些宗教政治不感兴趣。我有更意义的事要做。

messages.en: Your loyalty stands in question, {[character]player.name}. Leave me.
messages.zh: 你的忠心令人怀疑，{[character]player.name}。请你离开这儿。

messages.en: Amarrian theocracy is millennia old and traces its roots back into ancient times, perhaps even before humans ever set foot among the stars. Religion is the backbone of Amarrian society. Countless wars have been fought and lives lost over the proper interpretation of the Amarrian Scriptures.
messages.zh: 艾玛的神权统治已有数千年的历史，其根源更可以追溯到远古时期，也许甚至早在人类探索太空之前。宗教是艾玛社会的支柱。就艾玛《圣典》如何合理解读，已经引发了无数的战争，无数人丧失了生命。

messages.en: Amarrian Society and the Religious Mind
messages.zh: 艾玛社会和宗教心理

messages.en: You waited too long. The heretics caught wind of us and have moved elsewhere.
messages.zh: 你耽搁的时间太久了。那些异教徒听到了我们要来的风声，已经转移到别处了。

messages.en: Your lack of initiative disturbs me.
messages.zh: 你的惰性让我很不爽。

messages.en: I didn't think you were capable of this, and now neither does the Theology Council. I think you will find them much less friendly in the future.
messages.zh: 我就知道你没能力干这事，现在神学理事会也知道了。我想你以后会发现他们对你的友好度已经大大降低。

messages.en: You waited too long. The heretics caught wind of us and have moved elsewhere.
messages.zh: 你耽搁的时间太久了。那些异教徒听到了我们要来的风声，已经转移到别处了。

messages.en: Failure is not acceptable!
messages.zh: 只许成功，不许失败！

name.fr: Un très vieux tableau de service

messages.en: Don't worry! I'll get the roster back!
messages.zh: 别着急！我去把名册拿回来！

messages.en: Thanks and good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢，祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I'm no rookie. I'm a capsuleer. What do you have for me?
messages.zh: 我可不是菜鸟。我是一名飞行员。你有什么任务给我？

messages.en:
The frigate Sunhammer was recently attacked by Angel Cartel pirates; the captain called for reinforcements and managed to warp away, but the Angels scanned him down and pursued him, and the ship was lost... yet not before the fast-thinking captain jettisoned his cargo to avoid the risk of its being destroyed in the firefight. The captain's pod made it back in one piece, and the cargo's mostly expendible, but for one thing: Among the junk they had to ditch was a Brutor Tribe roster with all the history and lineage of tribal members in this sector from over a century ago.

The roster is absolutely unique; it can't be replaced. We need someone to get out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and find the roster. There's a reward in it for you if you succeed. What do you say, {[character]player.name}?

Oh, of course there's a good chance the Angels will still be lingering in the vicinity of the cargo, so be prepared for a fight.
messages.zh:
护卫舰太阳锤号最近被天使集团的海盗袭击了。船长叫来了援军而且成功的跃迁走了，但还是被天使的人扫描了出来，追到并且害死了。还好，反应迅速的船长为了避免货柜被毁坏，在他要被害之前把它丢了出来。船长的太空舱幸免遇难，货柜里也大多没什么值钱的东西，但是有一个东西，布鲁特部族名册，里面有这个地区一百多年前部族成员的历史和家谱。

名册是百分之百独一无二的，无法替代的。我们需要有人去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}找到那本名册。事成后会重赏你的，怎么样，{[character]player.name}?

当然，天使的人很有可能还待在那个货柜的附近，所以做好作战准备。

messages.en: I've returned with the roster.
messages.zh: 我把名册带回来了。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. I'll know who to turn to next time I have a job that needs doing.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。下次我有事情需要办的时候，知道该找谁了。

messages.en:
Your agent has placed a bookmark in your NeoCom to help you get to the correct location. Open People and Places and go to the Bookmarks tab. Then right-click on the objective item (the roster) and choose "Set Destination." On your ship's control panel, click the Autopilot icon. Your ship will now travel to the appropriate star system. Once you've arrived, your Autopilot will deactivate.

Now go back to your Bookmarks, right-click on the roster and select "Warp to within 0." Once you've arrived at the location, look at your Overview and find the cargo container; right-click on it and select "Approach." Once you've approached to within 1500 meters, right-click the cargo container and open it. A window will now pop up, displaying the container's contents. Click and drag the item(s) into your cargo hold: Once you've done that, you will have obtained the Brutor Tribe roster. All that will remain is to return with it to your agent for your reward.
messages.zh:
代理人已经在你的控制边栏里面加了个地点标签，这样可以帮你到达正确的地方。打开人物和地点，找到地点标签。然后右击目标物品（名册），选择设定为终点。在你船的控制面板上，单击自动导航图标。你的船会飞到正确的星系。你到那以后，自动导航会结束。

现在你回到地点标签，右击名册，选择“跃迁到0”。你到了以后，看你的总览，找到那个集装箱货柜。右击它，选择“接近”。当你接近到1500米的时候，右击集装箱货柜选择“打开”。你会看到有个窗口弹出显示柜内物品。把里面的物品拖到你的货柜舱里面：你便拿到了布鲁特部族名册。现在带它回到你代理人那领赏吧。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.zh: 别着急。我会把古物取回来。

messages.en: Thanks and good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢，祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I'm no rookie. I'm a capsuleer. What do you have for me?
messages.zh: 我可不是菜鸟。我是一名飞行员。你有什么任务给我？

messages.en:
The transport Santaros had a bulkhead failure in a nearby system and was forced to jettison its cargo. Its crew barely made it back in one piece, and the cargo's mostly a dead loss, but among the junk they had to ditch was a relic from Old Amarr, an item of little value to you or me, but vital to Lord Kendron Horowan, a noble who is friendly with House Tash-Murkon. We need someone to get out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and find the relic. There's a reward in it for you if you succeed, as well as the gratitude of an important nobleman.

I've uploaded the location of the Santaros's cargo dump into your onboard computer. It should appear in your bookmarks. Once you've located the relic, get it back to me here.
messages.zh:
运输船桑塔罗斯在附近星系里遭遇不幸，被迫扔掉货柜。船员艰难得以逃生，货柜几乎全部被毁，但是在剩余物品中，有个来自古艾玛的宝物，一个对你我都没什么用，但是却对塔什蒙贡家族 的朋友肯爵翁·豪罗宛大人来说相当重要。我们需要有人去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}找到那个古物。事成后有重赏，当然还有爵士的感谢。

我已经把桑塔罗斯货舱的方位导入到你飞船的机载电脑里面了。那也会出现在你的地点标签里面的。如果你找到那个古物，把它带回来给我。

messages.en: I've returned with the relic.
messages.zh: 我把古物带回来了。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

name.en: In the Shadow of War (1 of 5)
name.es: En la sombra de la guerra (1 de 5)
name.fr: Dans l'ombre de la guerre (1 sur 5)
name.ru: В тени войны (In the Shadow of War) (1 из 5)

messages.en: I'll do my best.
messages.zh: 我会尽力的。

messages.en: Thanks! You don't know what a service you're doing for us!
messages.zh: 谢谢！知道吗，你将为我们做出巨大贡献！

messages.en: How can I help, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，有什么我可以效劳？

messages.en: About an hour ago, we received a distress call from one of our scouts in a damaged escape pod; there's a lot of subspace interference, but we were able to make out his location and ID. It sounds as if he was ambushed by Caldari ships. We need someone to head out here and pick him up before the enemy finds him. I've bookmarked the pilot's last known location for you.
messages.zh: 大约一小时前，我们收到了一名侦察员从他损坏的逃生舱里发来的求救信号；虽然信号受到了很多子空间干扰，我们还是确定了他的位置和ID。听上去他似乎被加达里舰队伏击了。我们需要有人过去赶在敌人找到他之前把他带回来。我已将该飞行员最后的确知位置上传给你。

messages.en: He's in bad shape, but he's still alive, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 他情况危急，不过还活着，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Thank god! We're sending him in to intensive care even as I speak; come back in a little while and I'll let you know if there's anything else we need.
messages.zh: 谢天谢地！我们立即把他送到重病监护室。过一会儿再回来，我会告诉你我们还有什么需要。

messages.en: Relations between the Federation and the Caldari have never been good in the best of times, and now, with the region arming for war, there is every possibility that the old hatreds between Gallente and Caldari will be reignited. If the Caldari are indeed massing a fleet nearby, it's the job of every patriotic Gallente fighter to stop it.
messages.zh: 联邦和加达里之间的关系几乎从未好过。现在，本星域正在进行战备，在这种情况下，盖伦特和加达里之间古老的怨仇之火极有可能重新点燃。如果加达里的确在附近集结舰队，那么每一位爱国的盖伦特战士都应当挺身而出，阻止他们。

messages.en: The Caldari Conflict
messages.zh: 加达里冲突

messages.en:
You may have been hearing some scuttlebutt about Caldari fleet movements in the area. We suspect that they're up to something big, something that might presage a general conflict. Needless to say, this constellation's been a powder keg for years, and a single spark will set the whole region alight. We're shorthanded here at {[location]agentStationID.name}, but we've got a number of scouts out combing the region looking for signs of enemy activity.

About an hour ago, we received a distress call from one of our scouts in a damaged escape pod; there's a lot of subspace interference, but we were able to make out his location and ID. It sounds as if he was ambushed by Caldari ships. We need someone to head out here and pick him up before the enemy finds him.

Now, I know it's a big task for a newbie like you, but if you're up to it we're ready to offer generous compensation for your time. I've bookmarked the pilot's last known location for you. So, what do you say?
messages.zh:
你应当听过关于加达里舰队在这个区域活动的传言。我们怀疑他们正在筹划一场大事件，可能会引起一次全面冲突。毋庸讳言，多年来这个星座就如一个火药桶，只需一粒火花，整个区域就将燃起战火。我们在{[location]agentStationID.name}缺乏人手，但有不少侦察机在整个区域各地寻找敌军活动的蛛丝马迹。

大约一小时前，我们收到了一名侦察员从他损坏的逃生舱里发来的求救信号；虽然信号受到了很多子空间干扰，我们还是确定了他的位置和ID。听上去他似乎被加达里舰队伏击了。我们需要有人前去那里，在敌人发现他前把他接走。

我知道，对你这样的新手而言，这是一个艰巨的任务。不过如果你愿意效力，我们将给你提供丰厚的报酬。我已将该飞行员最后的确知位置上传给你。怎么样，干不干？

name.en: In the Shadow of War (2 of 5)
name.es: En la sombra de la guerra (2 de 5)
name.fr: Dans l'ombre de la guerre (2 sur 5)
name.ru: В тени войны (In the Shadow of War) (2 из 5)

messages.en: I'm ready to do my duty!
messages.zh: 我准备好履行义务了！

messages.en: You asked me to come back for an update on the situation...?
messages.zh: 你说过，要我回来了解事态的最新进展……？

messages.en:
Seems the pilot you rescued in your last mission had jumped a couple of Caldari couriers and hacked a data chip containing information on enemy fleet movements from one of their ships. On his way back here, he ran into an enemy destroyer, but was able to warp away and jettison the data chip before the Caldari captain tracked him down and destroyed his ship. Our man gave us the location of the chip he jetted, but now we need someone to go retrieve it.

I've uploaded a bookmark to your ship's database; the data chip is at that location. But I'm afraid there may be enemy fighters about looking for the chip as well. Be careful!
messages.zh:
你在上个任务中救出的飞行员似乎袭击了几艘加达里运输舰，还在一艘舰船中得到一块数据芯片，里面含有敌军舰队活动的信息。他返回我这里时，遇到敌军的一艘驱逐舰。幸好他跃迁脱身，在加达里军官追上他并把他的舰船摧毁之前，将数据芯片抛进了太空中。我的手下把芯片的抛弃地点给了我们，现在我们需要找人去把它取回来。

我已经把位标上传到你舰船的数据库中，数据芯片就在那个位置。敌军战舰恐怕也在寻找那块芯片。当心点。

messages.en: Here's the data chip.
messages.zh: 这是资料芯片。

messages.en: Good work! I've handed the chip over to the lab boys for decoding. If it contains what I think it does, I'll have more work for you shortly.
messages.zh: 干得好！我已经把芯片交给实验室的人去破解了。如果芯片的内容正如我所料的话，我将很快会有新的事情要你做。

messages.en:
I certainly did. Good timing on your part. That poor devil you brought in didn't make it - his injuries were too severe. But he was able to provide us with some information before he died.

Seems he had jumped a couple of Caldari couriers and hacked a data chip containing information on enemy fleet movements from one of their ships. On his way back here, he ran into an enemy destroyer, but he was able to warp away and jettison the data chip before the Caldari captain tracked him down and destroyed his ship. Our man gave us the location, but now we need someone to go retrieve it. You did well in finding and bringing our guy back, may he rest in peace, and I want you for this job too.

I've uploaded a bookmark to your ship's database; the data chip is at that location, but I'm afraid that there may be enemy fighters about as well looking for the same item. Be careful!
messages.zh:
我是说过。你来得正巧。你带回来的那个可怜的家伙没能撑下去——他的伤势太严重了。不过他死之前向我们提供了一些信息。

看来他袭击了几艘加达里运输舰，还在一艘舰船中得到一块数据芯片，里面含有敌军舰队活动的信息。他返回这里时，遇到敌军的一艘驱逐舰。幸好他跃迁脱身，在加达里军官追上他并把他的舰船摧毁之前，将数据芯片抛进了太空中。我的手下把地点给了我们，现在我们需要找人去把它取回来。你找到了我的人，并把他带了回来，干得好。希望他安息。我希望你能接受这个任务。

我已经把位标上传到你舰船的数据库中，数据芯片就在那个位置。恐怕敌军战舰也在寻找那件物品。当心点。

name.en: In the Shadow of War (3 of 5)
name.es: En la sombra de la guerra (3 de 5)
name.fr: Dans l'ombre de la guerre (3 sur 5)
name.ru: В тени войны (In the Shadow of War) (3 из 5)

messages.en: I'm on it.
messages.zh: 我准备好了。

messages.en: Thanks!
messages.zh: 谢谢！

messages.en: Oh? Have you retrieved the information on that chip?
messages.zh: 噢？你恢复芯片上的信息了吗？

messages.en:
The data on the chip you recovered for us earlier is heavily encrypted, and we think it contains some telemetry data regarding enemy ship movements. We just don't have the right personnel here to get at it, though, and some recent subspace interference is preventing us from communicating with our friends over at the {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} facilities. Deliver the chip for us for decryption.

Make sure the data chip is in your cargohold before you undock.
messages.zh:
你之前帮我们取回的数据芯片经过高度加密，我们认为芯片里含有一些关于敌军舰船行动的遥测数据。我们手头根本没有适合的破解人员，而且由于最近子空间的干扰，我们与位于{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}设施的朋友的通讯受到了阻碍。帮我们把这块芯片送去解密。

务必在出发前确认数据芯片已放入货柜舱中。

messages.en: I dropped off the data chip, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我已经把数据芯片卸载到指定地点了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Good job. We should be receiving the tracking data shortly -- be sure to check back in soon.
messages.zh: 做得好。我们应该很快就能收到跟踪数据。请你务必尽快回来查看。对了，保管好我刚刚给你的那个分析仪装备。如果我的预感没错的话，你很快就会用到它。

messages.en:
Yes, and thanks to you, our pilot didn't die in vain. The data on that chip is heavily encrypted, and we think it contains some telemetry data regarding enemy ship movements. We just don't have the right personnel here to get at it, though, and some recent subspace interference is preventing us from communicating with our friends over at the {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} facilities.

Time is of the essence; we need to have this chip delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for decryption. Are you fueled up and ready to go, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh:
是的，多亏了你，我们的飞行员才没有白白牺牲。那块芯片的数据经过高度加密，我们认为芯片里含有一些关于敌军舰船行动的遥测数据。我们手头根本没有适合的破解人员，而且由于最近子空间的干扰，我们与位于{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}设施的朋友的通讯受到了阻碍。

时间宝贵；我们需要把这块芯片送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去解密。{[character]player.name}，你有没有养足精神，做好出发的准备？

name.en: In the Shadow of War (4 of 5)
name.es: En la sombra de la guerra (4 de 5)
name.fr: Dans l'ombre de la guerre (4 sur 5)
name.ru: В тени войны (In the Shadow of War) (4 из 5)

messages.en: This report is as good as delivered.
messages.zh: 你就当那份报告已经送到了。

messages.en: I thank you, {[character]player.name}. You're a real patriot.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。你是一名真正的爱国者。

messages.en: I take it we had some progress in analyzing that telemetry data?
messages.zh: 我猜遥测数据的分析有进展了？

messages.en:
We've decrypted the data and analyzed the telemetry, and the Caldari are definitely amassing near this sector for some reason. Worse still, we suspect that our communication problems aren't the result of excessive ionization after all: We think the Caldari are jamming our transmissions. We sent out some scouts to track down the source of the interference, and they've traced the jamming signals to a location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I've added it to your bookmarks.

It's vital that we figure out just exactly what the Caldari are up to as soon as possible. Enemy scouts may be interdicting any traffic in that system as well, so be on the lookout for enemy vessels. Avoid or destroy them, as you see fit.

There's bound to be a structure of some kind out there that's causing the signal interference, and I need you to see what exactly it's doing; access the structure and bring me whatever Communications Logs you find inside.
messages.zh:
我们破解了数据并分析了遥测记录，可以断言，加达里人肯定在本区域附近大规模集结，但原因不明。更糟糕的是，我们怀疑我们的通讯问题根本不是超量电离作用造成的。我们认为，是加达里人在干扰我们的通讯。我们派出一些侦察机去寻找干扰源，他们一直追踪到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的某个位置。我已经把它添加到你的位标里了。

我们必须尽快弄清楚加达里人在玩什么花样。敌人侦察机可能也正在那个星系里拦截过往船只，所以要小心遭遇敌舰。要么避开它们，要么摧毁它们，你视情况而定。

这些信号干扰肯定是那里的一座建筑产生的，我要你去看看它到底是怎么回事。进入该建筑，把所有能找到的通信日志都给我带回来。

messages.en: Here's my report, {[character]agentID.name}. There's definitely something fishy going on out there.
messages.zh: 这是我的报告，{[character]agentID.name}。那里绝对有可疑。

messages.en: Excellent! With your help we'll see to it that those Caldari have a hell of a surprise coming.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！有了你的帮助，我们肯定能把那些加达里人弄个惊慌失措。

messages.en:
We did, yes. This is big, really big. We've decrypted the data and analyzed the telemetry, and the Caldari are definitely amassing near this sector for some reason. Worse still, we suspect that our communication problems aren't the result of excessive ionization after all: We think the Caldari are jamming our transmissions. We sent out some scouts to track down the source of the interference, and they've traced the jamming signals to a location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

Here's the report with all pertinent information; I've added it to your bookmarks. It's vital that we figure out just exactly what they're up to as soon as possible. Enemy scouts may be interdicting any traffic in that system as well, so be on the lookout for enemy vessels. Avoid or destroy them, as you see fit.

There's bound to be a structure of some kind out there that's causing the signal interference, and I need you to see what exactly it's doing. Get a report on whatever you find out there back to me as soon as possible.
messages.zh:
是的，我们确实取得了进展。这件事大了，非常大。我们破解了数据并分析了遥测记录，可以断言，加达里人肯定在本区域附近大规模集结，但原因不明。更糟糕的是，我们怀疑我们的通讯问题根本不是超量电离作用造成的。我们认为，是加达里人在干扰我们的通讯。我们派出一些侦察机去寻找干扰源，他们一直追踪到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的某个位置。

这是包含所有相关信息的一份报告。我已经把它添加到你的位标里了。我们必须尽快弄清楚他们在玩什么花样。敌人侦察机可能也正在那个星系里拦截过往船只，所以要小心遭遇敌舰。要么避开它们，要么摧毁它们，你视情况而定。

这些信号干扰肯定是那里的一座建筑产生的，我要你去看看它到底是怎么回事。弄一份关于你发现结果的报告，然后立刻带回给我。

name.en: In the Shadow of War (5 of 5)
name.es: En la sombra de la guerra (5 de 5)
name.fr: Dans l'ombre de la guerre (5 sur 5)
name.ru: В тени войны (In the Shadow of War) (5 из 5)

messages.en: Those Caldari are an arrogant bunch of bastards. It'll give me pleasure to pay them back in kind.
messages.zh: 那些加达里人是一群狂妄自大的混蛋。能以其人之道还治其人之身，我非常乐意。

messages.en: That's the spirit, {[character]player.name}! Good luck!
messages.zh: 要的就是这种精神，{[character]player.name}！祝你好运！

messages.en: What do you need me to do, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: 你需要我做什么，{[character]agentID.name}？

messages.en:
We've got those Caldari bastards right where we want them. We're organizing a pre-emptive strike to take out their fleet, but the thing is, we can only get so many Navy ships in here to do the job in the short time we have available. More importantly, we need someone we can trust to take out one of their communications tower arrays in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} so the Navy ships can get into position for the attack.

We need you to take the array out for us. Are you up to this job?
messages.zh:
那些加达里混蛋已经落入了我们的圈套。我们正在策划抢先发动进攻以铲除他们的舰队，但问题是，在短期内，我们能在这召集齐的海军舰船数量有限。更重要的是，我们需要一个值得信赖的人去摧毁敌人位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一座通信塔阵列，然后海军舰船就能进入战斗位置。

我们需要你去把那座阵列除掉。你愿意接受这个任务吗？

messages.en: The com array is down, {[character]agentID.name}. They had some serious defenses out there, but the deed is done.
messages.zh: 通信阵列已被摧毁，{[character]agentID.name}。他们的防守非常严密，但我还是完成了任务。

messages.en: Your service is an example to all capsuleers, {[character]player.name}. Here's your reward; you've earned it!
messages.zh: 你是所有飞行员的榜样，{[character]player.name}。拿好你的奖励，这是你应得的！

messages.en:
We're organizing a pre-emptive strike to take out their fleet, but the thing is, we can only get so many Navy ships in here to do the job in the short time we have available. More importantly, we need someone we can trust to take out one of their communications tower arrays in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} so the Navy ships can get into position for the attack. We need you to take the array out for us.

This will be a tough fight, so make sure your ship is fitted for a full-scale assault! A shield booster or armor repairer is essential, and you should be prepared to warp out for repairs if you're anywhere near taking hull damage.
messages.zh:
我们正在策划抢先发动进攻以铲除他们的舰队，但问题是，在短期内，我们能在这召集齐的海军舰船数量有限。更重要的是，我们需要一个值得信赖的人去摧毁敌人位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一座通信塔阵列，然后海军舰船就能进入战斗位置。我们需要你去把那座阵列除掉。

这将是一场恶战，务必好好装备你的飞船以应付一场全规模的战斗！护盾回充增量器或者装甲维修器非常必要，而且如果你的船体快要遭到损伤，请立即跃迁离开，对舰船进行修复。

messages.en: Don't worry, I'll get those records back for you.
messages.zh: 别担心，我会把那些记录带回来给你。

messages.en: Thanks and good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢，祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Why, sure. What do you have for me?
messages.zh: 哦，当然。你有什么任务给我？

messages.en:
The freighter Bright Prospect struck an asteroid when emerging from warp in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The jump drive was badly damaged and they thought it might blow, but they managed to make it back in one piece. However, among the cargo, which was mostly expendable, was a set of important Ishukone corporate records; they were forced to jettison the records lest they be lost if the ship's warp core blew. We don't have backups, so the records are irreplaceable.

We need someone to get out there and recover those records. There's a reward in it for you if you succeed, as well as my gratitude.

I've uploaded the location of the Bright Prospect's cargo dump into your onboard computer. It should appear in your bookmarks. Once you've located the records, place them in your cargo hold and bring them back to me here.
messages.zh:
我们的货船光明前景在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}跃迁过程中卡在了一块行星里。跃迁核心受损严重，他们本以为它会爆掉，但船还是幸免逃出来了，货柜里面的也大多没什么值钱的东西。但是，一套异株湖集团记录也被扔在了空间里。我们没有记录的备份，所以他们是不可替代的。

我们需要有人去那，取回那些记录。事成后一定重赏，当然还有重谢。

我已经把光明前景货舱的方位上传到你飞船里了。那也会出现在你的地点标签里面的。如果你找到那些记录，请把它们放在你的货柜舱里面，带回来给我。

messages.en: I've returned with the records.
messages.zh: 我带着记录回来了。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Your agent has placed a bookmark in your NeoCom to help you get to the correct location. Open People and Places and go to "Bookmarks." Then right-click on the objective item (the corporate records) and choose "Set Destination." Then go to your ship's control panel and click the Autopilot icon. Your ship will now travel to the appropriate star system. Once you've arrived, your Autopilot will deactivate.

Now go back to your Bookmarks, right-click on the corporate records, and select "Warp to within 0." Once you've arrived at the location, look at your Overview and find the cargo container; right-click on it and select "Approach." Once you've approached to within 1500 meters, right-click the cargo container and select "Open." A window will now open, displaying the container's contents. Click and drag the corporate records into your cargo hold. Now return with them to your agent in {[location]agentStationID.name} for your reward.
messages.zh:
代理人已经在你的控制边栏里面加了个地点标签，这样可以帮你到达正确的地方。打开人物和地点，找到地点标签。然后右击目标物品(名册)，选择设定为终点。在你船的控制面板上，单击自动导航图标。你的船会飞到正确的星系系统。你到那以后，自动导航会结束。

现在你回到地点标签，右击名册，选择“跃迁到0”。你到了以后，看你的总览，找到那个集装箱货柜。右击它，选择“接近”。当你接近到1500米的时候，右击集装箱货柜，把里面的物品拖到你的货柜舱里面。

恭喜，你已经拿到布鲁特部族名册了！现在回到你在{[location]agentStationID.name}的代理人那领赏吧。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
You look pretty green to me, youngster. Still, we've got a situation here and maybe you can help us out.

Our freighter Bright Prospect struck an asteroid when emerging from warp in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The jump drive was badly damaged and they thought it might blow, but they managed to make it back in one piece. However, among the cargo, which was mostly expendable, was a set of important Ishukone corporate records; they were forced to jettison the records lest they be lost if the ship's warp core blew. At present we don't have backups due to a database malfunction, so those records might be irreplaceable.

We need someone to get out there and recover those records. I've uploaded the location of the Bright Prospect's cargo dump into your onboard computer. It should appear in your bookmarks. Once you've located the records, place them in your cargo hold and bring them back to me here. There's a reward in it for you if you succeed, of course, as well as my gratitude.
messages.zh:
小子，是个新脸嘛，但是我们现在有个情况或许你可以帮我们。我们的货船光明前景在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}跃迁过程中卡在了一块行星里。跃迁核心受损严重，他们本以为它会爆掉，但船还是幸免逃出来了，货柜里面的也大多没什么值钱的东西。但是，一套异株湖集团记录也被扔在了空间里。我们没有记录的备份，所以他们是不可替代的。

我们需要有人去那，取回那些记录。事成后一定重赏，当然还有重谢。

我已经把光明前景货舱的方位上传到你飞船里了。那也会出现在你的地点标签里面的。如果你找到那些记录，请把它们放在你的货柜舱里面，带回来给我。

messages.en: Don't worry. I'll get those records back.
messages.zh: 别着急。我去把那些记录拿回来。

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: That's why I'm here. Guess I timed that one well...
messages.zh: 我正是为此而来。看来我来得正巧……

messages.en:
The courier ship Swiftsure had a warp drive mishap in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and was forced to jettison its cargo lest it be damaged or lost if the core blew. Eventually they managed to make it back in one piece; however, the cargo they had to ditch was a set of important Federation court records. We don't have backups available, so those records are irreplaceable.

{[character]player.name}, we need someone to head out there and find those records. There's a healthy reward in it for you if you succeed. I've uploaded the location of the Swiftsure's cargo dump into your onboard computer. It should appear in your bookmarks. Once you've located the records, place them in your cargo hold and get it back to me here.
messages.zh:
运送船Swiftsure在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}跃迁飞行时出了点儿不好的状况，为防止货柜内物品的损坏或由于核心爆炸而造成的物品丢失，船上的货柜被迫地被遗弃了。虽然这艘船最终死里逃生，但他们被迫丢掉的货柜里却有一整套非常重要的联邦法庭记录。我们现在也没有可以备用的记录，所以这些丢失的记录是无法被替代的。

{[character]player.name}，现在我们非常迫切地需要一个人到出事地点去把那些记录找回来。如果你成功的话，会有丰厚的奖赏给你。我已经把这艘Swiftsure的货柜所处的地点上传到了你船上的电脑里，它应该会在你的地点标签里出现。当你找到那些记录以后，就把它们放到你的货柜里然后带回来给我。

messages.en: I've returned with the records.
messages.zh: 我带着记录回来了。

messages.en: Good work, my friend.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，我的朋友。

messages.en: Your agent has given you the task of locating some lost records. Once you have accepted the mission and undocked, view your mission details by selecting the 'Agent Missions' icon at the top left of your HUD. Then select the 'Lost Records' entry and then 'Warp to Location'. Once you've arrived at the location, proceed onwards until you locate the cargo container; then right-click on it and select "Approach." Once you've approached to within 2000 meters, right-click the cargo container and select "Open." A window will now open, displaying the container's contents. Select the 'Loot All' button to place the records into your cargo hold. Now return with them to your agent in {[location]agentStationID.name} for your reward.
messages.zh: 你的代理人刚刚给了你一个任务，让你去寻找一些丢失的记录。接受任务并出站后，请点击屏幕左上方的“代理人任务”图标来查看任务细节。接下来选择“丢失的记录”条目并点击“跃迁至该处”。到达后，你会在总览中看到那个货柜，请右键点击它并选择“接近”。当距离货柜2000m之内时，右键点击它并选择“打开货柜”。这时会弹出一个窗口显示货柜中的物品，选择“全部拾取”就可以将记录移到你的货舱中。然后就回到位于{[location]agentStationID.name}的代理人那里拿奖赏吧。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
So it would seem.

Listen, the courier ship Swiftsure has just had a warp drive mishap in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and was forced to jettison its cargo lest it be damaged or lost if the core blew. They're crawling back to their home station as we speak; however, the cargo they had to ditch was a set of important Federation court records. We don't have backups available, so those records are irreplaceable, and they can't get another courier out there until tomorrow sometime. Bloody couriers. Can't get good help these days.

{[character]player.name}, we need someone to head out there and find those records right away. There's a healthy reward in it for you if you succeed. I've uploaded the location of the Swiftsure's cargo dump into your onboard computer. It should appear in your bookmarks. Once you've located the records, place them in your cargo hold and get it back to me here.
messages.zh:
是这样的。

听着，就在不久之前有艘叫Swiftsure的运送船在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}跃迁飞行时出了一点不好的事故。为了防止货柜内物品的损坏，或由于核心爆炸而造成的物品丢失，他们不得不把货柜丢弃了。我们可以想象到现在他们正挣扎着要把船开回他们的空间站去，但是，他们被迫丢掉的货柜里却是一整套非常重要的联邦法庭记录。而我们现在也没有任何备用的记录，所以说那些丢失的东西是没法被替代、绝无仅有的，可是如果让他们再出动一艘运送船到那边去的话，就要等到明天的某个时候了。运送船这玩意儿啊，这段日子根本帮不了你什么忙。

{[character]player.name}，现在我们非常迫切地需要一个人到出事地点去把那些记录找回来。如果你成功的话，会有丰厚的奖赏给你。我已经把这艘Swiftsure的货柜所处的地点上传到了你船上的电脑里，它应该会在你的地点标签里出现。当你找到那些记录以后，就把它们放到你的货柜里然后带回来给我。

name.ja: 新たなフロンティア-原料（1/7）
name.ru: Новые горизонты – сырье (New Frontiers - Raw Materials) (1 из 7)

messages.en: Sure thing, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm on it.
messages.zh: 当然了，{[character]agentID.name}。我这就出发。

messages.en: Excellent. I've downloaded the coordinates to your NeoCom. Come back soon.
messages.zh: 很好。我已将坐标传到你的控制边栏里。快去快回。

messages.en: Hm. Okay. Mining doesn't get me in my happy place, but if it's just this one mission and such a small amount...
messages.zh: 嗯，好吧，我并不太愿意采矿，不过如果仅此一次，而且是这么少量的话……

messages.en:
The famed Dr. Lamia Calus is one of our top nanite research specialists. She has entered a requisition for 47 units of Green Arisite for her research. If you can procure this mineral, I'm sure you'll be adequately rewarded. I have coordinates here to a mining site of ours where a bit of this rare substance can be found.

Green Arisite is related to Gneiss, which is itself rare and is typically found only in low-sec space; pirates and mercenaries of all stripes are often found in its vicinity. Don't go out there in a defenseless mining scow.
messages.zh:
著名的拉米亚·卡鲁司博士是我们顶尖的纳米研究专家之一。她提出申请，要求获得47个单位的绿色阿里斯特石供其研究使用。如果你能弄到这种矿物，我保证你将得到丰厚的报酬。我这有个采矿点的坐标，在那儿可以找到些许这种稀有物质。

绿色阿里斯特石和片麻岩类似，极其罕见，一般只在安全系数较低的空间出现。各种海盗和雇佣兵常常在其附近出没。不要驾驶一艘没有防御装备的采矿船去那里。

messages.en: Here's your ore. Some mercenaries had set up a mining op there, but I dealt with it. Now, you mentioned some other work after this?
messages.zh: 矿石在这儿。有些雇佣兵在那儿建立采矿设施，不过我把这事解决了。你刚才好象说过，今后还有别的工作？

messages.en:
How on earth did they find our secret mining site, I wonder? And who are they working for? Hm.

Well, that's why I needed someone as capable as you to go out there. Listen, I just need a few minutes while I finish entering this data: Come back and see me in a bit.
messages.zh:
我想知道，他们到底是怎样发现我们的秘密采矿点的？他们的幕后主使是什么人？嗯。

这就是为什么我需要找一个像你这么能干的飞行员到那儿去。听着，我先录入这些数据，过几分钟就好了。待会再回来找我吧。"

messages.en: That is unfortunate. Ah, well, I'm sure I can find someone else for this lucrative opportunity.
messages.zh: 真是太遗憾了。好吧，我肯定能找到其他人来完成这桩赚钱的买卖。

messages.en: Excellent. The famed Dr. Lamia Calus is one of our top nanite research specialists.  She has entered a requisition for 47 units of Green Arisite for her research. If you can procure this substantial quantity of mineral, I'm sure you'll be adequately rewarded. The sooner, the better.
messages.zh: 很好。著名的拉米亚·卡鲁司博士是我们顶尖的纳米研究专家之一。她提出申请，要求获得47个单位的绿色阿里斯特石供其研究使用。如果你能弄到这个数量的矿物，我保证你将得到丰厚的报酬。越快越好。

messages.en: No need to bother with the ore any longer.  You took too long, and our scientist found other resources.  I hope you know that you have missed a golden opportunity.
messages.zh: 你省点力气吧，不用你再去费心采矿了。你花的时间太长了，我们的科学家已经找到了其他资源。你要知道，你错过了一个黄金机会。

messages.en: Green Arisite procurement
messages.zh: 获取绿色阿里斯特石

messages.en: Scientific progress grinds to halt, thanks to your lack of initiative.
messages.zh: 有了你的惰性，科研进展就停滞不前了。

messages.en: No need to bother with the ore any longer.  You took too long, and our scientist found other resources.  I hope you know that you have missed a golden opportunity.
messages.zh: 你省点力气吧，不用你再去费心采矿了。你花的时间太长了，我们的科学家已经找到了其他资源。你要知道，你错过了一个黄金机会。

messages.en: Green Arisite procurement
messages.zh: 获取绿色阿里斯特石

name.ja: 新たなフロンティア-狂気の科学者（2/7）
name.ru: Новые горизонты – сумасшедший ученый (New Frontiers - Mad Scientist) (2 из 7)
name.zh: 新前线 – 疯狂的科学家(2/7)

messages.en: Bring back some helpless old man? Piece of cake. Be right back.
messages.zh: 带一个衰弱不堪的老头带回来？小意思。我很快就回来。

messages.en: Excellent. Do be prompt about this one... and don't hurt him! We need that man unharmed!
messages.zh: 很好。这次的动作要快……而且不要伤害他！我们需要这个人毫发无伤！

messages.en: As long as it's not retrieving more ore, I'm good with that.
messages.zh: 只要不是再去采矿，我就没什么意见。

messages.en:
Dr. Lamia Calus' former mentor was the famous particle physicist and AI specialist, Professor Kajurei Delainen. A number of years of ago, though, Delainen disappeared. He was supposed to report to his laboratory at the appointed time, but he simply never appeared. His living quarters were cleared out and his bank accounts emptied and closed. Yet no evidence of criminal wrongdoing was ever found.

In any case, evidence has just surfaced that he in fact still lives ... and in this very system! Now Dr. Calus has reached a critical stage in her research, and Delainen was once the galaxy's foremost expert on both quantum particle physics and artificial intelligence. He claimed that the two fields were more closely related than anyone realized. His expertise would be invaluable to our current research.

Your mission is to bring him back here. One hitch, though: It is very possible that he will not come willingly. Don't take no for an answer.
messages.zh:
拉米亚·卡鲁司博士以前的导师是著名的粒子物理学家及人工智能专家卡居雷·德莱宁教授。但许多年以前，德莱宁不见了。他本来应该在约好的时间向他的实验室报告的，但他就是再也没出现过。他的住处被清扫整理过，银行帐户也被提空并注销了。但从未有任何证据显示他做了犯法的事情。

无论如何，目前有证据显示他实际上还活着…而且就在这个星系里！现在卡鲁司博士的研究已经到了一个决定性的阶段，而德莱宁教授曾经是整个银河系内量粒子物理学和人工智能学方面最为重要的专家。他宣称这两个领域比任何人所能够意识到的都联系得紧密。他的意见的价值对我们目前的研究来说是不可估量的。

你的任务就是要去把他带回到这儿来。但是有一点：他很有可能不愿意跟你回来。不要让他说不行。

messages.en: I have Delainen with me. Uh, just a word of warning, though: He's completely insane!
messages.zh: 我把德莱宁带来了。呃，不过我提醒一句：他彻底疯了！

messages.en: Oh? Well, nonetheless, splendid! Dr. Calus will be pleased.  Stick around, {[character]player.name}; I'll have some more work for you shortly, I imagine.
messages.zh: 噢？虽然这样，但还是非常不错！卡鲁斯博士会很高兴的。别走远了，{[character]player.name}。我很快会有更多的工作给你。

messages.en: It seems that apprehending a helpless old man is too much for you.
messages.zh: 看来捉拿一位孤弱无助的老人太难为你了。

messages.en:
You might remember the preeminent scientist, Dr. Lamia Calus, from your previous mission. Her mentor was the famous particle physicist and AI specialist, Professor Kajurei Delainen. Perhaps you've heard of Delainen's "Seven Pillars of Artificial Intelligence"? No? Well, no matter.

A number of years of ago, Delainen disappeared. He was supposed to report to his laboratory at the appointed time, but he simply never appeared. His living quarters were cleared out and his bank accounts emptied and closed. Yet no evidence of criminal wrongdoing was ever found. In such a vast universe, it can be easy for a person to disappear.

In any case, evidence has just surfaced that he in fact still lives ... and in this very system! Now Dr. Calus has reached a critical stage in her research, and Delainen was once the galaxy's foremost expert on both quantum particle physics and artificial intelligence. He claimed that the two fields were more closely related than anyone realized. His expertise would be invaluable to our current research.

Your mission is to bring him back here. One hitch, though: It is very possible that he will not come willingly. Don't take no for an answer.
messages.zh:
你应该还能从你以前的任务里想起那个卓越的科学家拉米亚·卡鲁司博士。她的导师是著名的粒子物理学家及人工智能专家卡居雷·德莱宁教授。也许你曾经听过德莱宁的“人工智能的七大支柱”，当然如果没听过也没关系。

很多年前，德莱宁消失了。他本来应该在约好的时间向他的实验室报告的，但他却像人间蒸发了一样，再也没出现过。他的住处被清扫整理过，银行帐户也被提空并注销了。但从未有任何证据显示他做了犯法的事情。不过在这么大的宇宙里，一个人想要消失也是件蛮容易的事情。

无论如何，目前有证据显示他实际上还活着…而且就在这个星系里！现在卡鲁司博士的研究已经到了一个决定性的阶段，而德莱宁教授曾经是整个银河系内量粒子物理学和人工智能学方面最为重要的专家。他宣称这两个领域比任何人所能够意识到的都联系得紧密。他的意见的价值对我们目前的研究来说是不可估量的。

你的任务就是要去把他带回到这儿来。但是有一点：他很有可能不愿意跟你回来。别让他说不。

messages.en: You failed. You won't find Delainen at that location any longer. He sent us a note saying he'd caught wind of your coming and relocated. He has disappeared once again.
messages.zh: 你真令人失望。你再也不会在那个地方找到德莱宁了。他发给我们一条信息，说他听到了你要去找他的风声，所以转移了。他又一次消失了。

messages.en: Your lack of initiative has cost us
messages.zh: 你的惰性让我们损失惨重。

messages.en: It seems that apprehending a helpless old man is too much for you.
messages.zh: 看来捉拿一位孤弱无助的老人太难为你了。

messages.en: You failed. You won't find Delainen at that location anymore. He sent us a note saying he'd caught wind of your coming and relocated. He has disappeared once again.
messages.zh: 你真令人失望。你再也不会在那个地方找到德莱宁了。他发给我们一条信息，说他听到了你要去找他的风声，所以转移了。他又一次消失了。

messages.en: Your lack of initiative has cost us
messages.zh: 你的惰性让我们损失惨重。

name.ja: ダラメイドからの手紙

messages.en: I'll give those Minmatar terrorists exactly the sort of attention they deserve.
messages.zh: 我会让那些米玛塔尔恐怖分子得到他们应得的“注意”！

messages.en: Godspeed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Just in time for...?
messages.zh: 正巧赶上……？

messages.en:
The letters of Bishop Dalamaid, currently on tour through the Empire, have been stolen by Minmatar terrorists. There's a media lockdown; attention is the only thing the Minmatar could reasonably expect to gain from such a heist. Still, the letters are of extreme importance to the Empire, even if they aren't grounds to mobilize a large force. That's where you come in: I want you to recover the letters for us.

The terrorists were recently spotted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They're likely using a series of acceleration gates to disguise the true location of their base, a not uncommon tactic. You will have to approach and activate each acceleration gate you find to progress further to the terrorists' base. Follow the terrorists, destroy any resistance, and return the letters to me.
messages.zh:
当下在帝国中流传的达拉迈德主教的信件被米玛塔尔的恐怖分子拿走了。他们策划这次事件就是为了吸引公众注意力，所以这件事已经对媒体进行了封锁。但即使这些信件不是用来动员人们的，它们对帝国来说依然很重要。这就是为什么要你过来的原因：我想请你去把这些信件找回来。

最近在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了恐怖分子的踪迹。他们很可能会使用一系列的加速轨道来掩盖他们基地真正所在的地方，这亦是个常见的策略。你需要接近并激活每个你找到的加速轨道来深入接近恐怖分子的基地。然后跟着他们，如果他们敢反抗，全部干掉，然后把信件带回来给我。

messages.en: I've returned with Bishop Dalamaid's letters.
messages.zh: 我把达拉迈德主教的信件带回来了。

messages.en: Excellent. More Minmatar terrorists have been sent to their Judgment, and the letters have been returned to Imperial hands. Good work, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 很好。又有一些米玛塔尔恐怖分子被送去接受上帝审判了，而那些信件也回到了帝国的手中。干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I'm not going to risk my ship against Minmatar fighters just for some stupid old papers.
messages.zh: 我可不愿意为了几张发黄的老信纸，去和那些米玛塔尔战舰拼命。

messages.en: Oh, sure. Maybe rescuing doctrinal works isn't as sexy as rescuing exotic dancers, but I expected better.
messages.zh: 噢，当然。虽然拯救教义著作并不像拯救舞女那么带劲儿，但我觉得会更有意义。

messages.en: Acceleration gates are not an uncommon sight for most pilots. Like warp gates, each acceleration gate can only be configured for one point in space; unlike warp gates, they can only be used for travel to other points within the same solar system. Acceleration gates can also be locked, preventing pilot from using them. Such locking mechanisms can be based on ship type, on the presence of active guard units in the area, or on appropriate codes/keys.
messages.zh: 对大多数飞行员来说，加速轨道是宇宙中的常见风景。与跃迁门一样，每座加速轨道都仅位于太空中的一固定位置；与跃迁门不同的是，加速轨道仅能用于到同一恒星系的其他位置点的传输。加速门也可以被锁定，从而防止飞行员使用它们。这类锁定机制可以是专门针对飞船类型，也可以因该区域存在的某些活跃守卫力量而激活，或者是需要特定的密码/钥匙来开启。

messages.en: Acceleration Gates
messages.zh: 加速轨道

messages.en:
As you may have heard, the letters of Bishop Dalamaid are currently on tour through the Empire. Not only are they of doctrinal significance, but sections dealing with the various scandals of the flesh among the clergy of Dalamaid's time have always been popular. It's a little embarrassing to admit, but these tawdry details are usually the bigger draw, a fact that the Empire has rarely been too ashamed to take advantage of. This tour was one such attempt to use the controversial nature of the letters to get more citizens interested in the Scriptures.

However, the plan has misfired. Minmatar terrorists recently broke into the station where the letters were being kept and have stolen them. There's a media lockdown on the whole thing, for attention is the only thing the Minmatar could reasonably expect to gain from such a heist. Still, the letters are of extreme importance to the Empire, even if they aren't grounds to mobilize a large force. That's where you come in: I want you to recover the letters for us.

The terrorists were recently spotted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They're likely using a series of acceleration gates to disguise the true location of their base, a not uncommon tactic. You will have to approach and activate each acceleration gate you find to progress further to the terrorists' base. Follow the terrorists, destroy any resistance, and return the letters to me.
messages.zh:
你可能已经知道达拉迈德主教的信件目前正在帝国区中传送着。这些信件不单单有着教诲人们的重要性，其抨击达拉迈德时期在圣贤者中发生的各种丑闻的片段也深得人心。其实这么说是有一点尴尬的，但通常情况下，低俗的细节确实更加吸引人们的眼球，这是一个帝国地区基本上不觉得耻辱而不会去改善的事实。这次信件的传送就是这样一个在信中使用具有争议性的字眼，以此使得更多的人对圣经和神圣道德重感敬畏的计划。

但是，计划失败了。米玛塔尔的恐怖分子最近闯进了存放那些信件的空间站并拿走了它们。他们策划这次事件就是为了吸引公众注意力，所以这件事已经对媒体进行了封锁。但即使这些信件不是用来动员人们的，它们对帝国来说依然很重要。这就是为什么要你过来的原因：我想请你去把这些信件找回来。

最近在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了恐怖分子的踪迹。他们很可能会使用一系列的加速轨道来掩盖他们基地真正所在的地方，这亦是个常见的策略。你需要接近并激活每个你找到的加速轨道来深入接近恐怖分子的基地。然后跟着他们，如果他们敢反抗，全部干掉，然后把信件带回来给我。

messages.en: I can't hold off on the search anymore. I was hoping you could retrieve the letters of Bishop Dalamaid discreetly, but now I have to mobilize an entire force, attracting exactly the sort of attention the terrorists wanted.
messages.zh: 搜寻不能再拖延了。我本来希望你能悄悄地找回达拉迈德主教的信件，但现在我不得不发动整个部队。这样会引起人们的注意，正合那些恐怖分子的心意。

messages.en: Media circus
messages.zh: 媒体焦点

messages.en: The Minmatar can have the stupid letters. I quit.
messages.zh: 让米玛塔尔人拿走那些无聊的信件吧。我退出。

messages.en: This will not do, not at all. Now I'll have to find someone else to take care of this.
messages.zh: 这可不行，根本不行。我得找别人来处理这件事了。

messages.en: You have taken too long in recovering the letters of Bishop Dalamaid. The Minmatar terrorists have escaped; it will take weeks to track them down. I only hope we will be able to recover the letters safely.
messages.zh: 你在取回达拉迈德的信件这件事上耗费了太多时间。米玛塔尔恐怖分子已经逃跑了。我们得花好几星期的时间才能追踪到他们。我只希望我们去取这些信件时不必冒太大危险。

messages.en: Letters and terrorists have vanished
messages.zh: 信件和恐怖分子已消失

messages.en: I understand my duty. These terrorists will pay. Dearly.
messages.zh: 我明白我的责任。这些恐怖分子将付出代价。惨重的代价。

messages.en: Get this done, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 把这事办好，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I am ready for whatever you need.
messages.zh: 无论你要我做什么，我都在所不辞。

messages.en:
The Achuran White Song bird has been sacred to the Achura throughout their recorded history. The creature mates only in the mountains of Saisio III, and naturally is exceedingly rare. Recently, the remnants of the old Achuran government made a gift of two such birds to the State, a male and a female. These particular birds are quite special, in that they have been genetically modified to mate off-planet. This is a matter of tremendous importance for us, from both a diplomatic and an ecological standpoint.

Twelve hours ago, the birds were stolen. Gallentean eco-terrorists hijacked the diplomatic courier mid-transit. Now, I don't think anyone ever needs an excuse to gun for the Gallente, but these guys are more worthless than the Federation Navy. The terrorists were last spotted at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It's likely they are using a series of acceleration gates to hide the true location of their base. You'll have to approach and activate each acceleration gate you find to progress further to the terrorists' base. Track down the terrorists, and recover the White Song birds.
messages.zh:
对于阿赫尔家族来说，自有历史记录以来，白歌鸟一直是他们的神圣之鸟。他们只在赛西奥III的山上交配，而且自然意义上讲，它们是极其稀少的。最近，古阿赫尔政府的后代将两只白歌鸟作为礼物送给合众国。那两只鸟比较特殊，因为他们通过基因改变，已经可以离开行星交配。无论从外交上还是从生态上讲，这件事情对于我们来说都是相当的重要。

12小时之前，那两只鸟被盖伦特的生态恐怖分子给半路拦截了。我想现在不需要任何理由去和盖伦特交火了，但是那些人没有联邦海军厉害。恐怖分子最后一次出现是在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。他们看起来是用一系列的加速门隐藏他们基地的真正方位。你得必须接近，激活你找到的每一个加速门，这样才能继续前进，到达他们的老巢。找到恐怖分子，拿回白歌鸟。

messages.en: The Gallenteans are no more. Sadly, only one of the White Songs survived.
messages.zh: 那些盖伦特人被干掉了。可惜的是，只有一只白色燕雀活了下来。

messages.en: Only one survived? Damn it. Well, I'm sure there was nothing you could do. It was those damned Gallente. We won't be able to populate another world with just one bird, but I suppose we can always engineer more.
messages.zh: 只有一只活了下来？该死。好吧，你肯定已经尽力了。都是那帮可恶的盖伦特人的错。只有一只鸟不可能繁衍后代，不过我想我们还能通过基因工程培育成更多。

messages.en: Gallente or no, I have more important things to do than rescue a couple of birds.
messages.zh: 管他是不是盖伦特，我有很多比救鸟更重要的事情要做。

messages.en: I'm not going to waste time explaining to you what a mistake this is.
messages.zh: 我不会浪费时间来向你说明这是一个多么严重的错误。

messages.en: Acceleration gates are not an uncommon sight for most pilots. Like warp gates, each acceleration gate can only be configured for one point in space; unlike warp gates, they can only be used for travel to other points within the same solar system. Acceleration gates can also be locked, preventing pilot from using them. Such locking mechanisms can be based on ship type, on the presence of active guard units in the area, or on appropriate codes/keys.
messages.zh: 对大多数飞行员来说，加速轨道是宇宙中的常见风景。与跃迁门一样，每座加速轨道都仅位于太空中的一固定位置；与跃迁门不同的是，加速轨道仅能用于到同一恒星系的其他位置点的传输。加速门也可以被锁定，从而防止飞行员使用它们。这类锁定机制可以是专门针对飞船类型，也可以因该区域存在的某些活跃守卫力量而激活，或者是需要特定的密码/钥匙来开启。

messages.en: Acceleration Gates
messages.zh: 加速轨道

messages.en:
The Achuran White Song bird has been sacred to the Achura throughout their recorded history. The creature mates only in the mountains of Saisio III, and naturally is exceedingly rare. Recently, the remnants of the old Achuran government made a gift of two such birds to the State, a male and a female. These particular birds are quite special, in that they have been genetically modified to mate off-planet. This is a matter of tremendous importance for us, from both a diplomatic and an ecological standpoint.

Twelve hours ago, the birds were stolen. Gallentean eco-terrorists hijacked the diplomatic courier mid-transit. They released a statement claiming that the Caldari State is-- hang on, let me get this right... ah, here it is: "incapable of doing what is best for the longevity of this beautiful species, as demonstrated by their abhorrent destruction of the natural qualities of these rare and fragile..." blah, blah, blah, you get the point.

Now, I don't think anyone ever needs an excuse to gun for the Gallente, but these guys are more worthless than the Federation Navy. The terrorists were last spotted at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It's likely they are using a series of acceleration gates to hide the true location of their base. You'll have to approach and activate each acceleration gate you find to progress further to the terrorists' base. Track down the terrorists, and recover the White Song birds.
messages.zh:
对于阿赫尔家族来说，自有历史记录以来，白歌鸟一直是他们的神圣之鸟。他们只在赛西奥III的山上交配，而且自然意义上讲，它们是极其稀少的。最近，古阿赫尔政府的后代将两只白歌鸟作为礼物送给合众国。那两只鸟比较特殊，因为他们通过基因改变，已经可以离开行星交配。无论从外交上还是从生态上讲，这件事情对于我们来说都是相当的重要。

12小时之前，那两只鸟被盖伦特的生态恐怖分子给半路拦截了。他们发表了一项声明，宣称加达里联邦是，等下，让我再看下，嗯，是“没有能力给这么美丽的种族传宗接代的，他们对这些稀少的脆弱的鸟进行的可恶的毁灭就可以证明。。。”

我想现在不需要任何理由去和盖伦特交火了，但是那些人没有联邦海军厉害。恐怖分子最后一次出现是在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。他们看起来是用一系列的加速门隐藏他们基地的真正方位。你得必须接近，激活你找到的每一个加速门，这样才能继续前进，到达他们的老巢。找到恐怖分子，拿回白歌鸟。

messages.en: We lost track of the terrorists. If you'd given me an answer, a more timely response could have been put together to prevent this.
messages.zh: 我们失去了那些恐怖分子的线索。如果你给我答复的话，我们就能做出更及时的反应，来阻止这一切的发生。

messages.en: Gallente and birds fly coop
messages.zh: 盖伦特人和鸟儿逃亡成功

messages.en: I've had it. This mission is for the-- well, you know.
messages.zh: 我受够了。这个任务是给那些——咳，你知道的。

messages.en: You have no idea what a PR nightmare this will be for the State.
messages.zh: 你根本不知道这对合众国将是一场多么恐怖的公关梦魇。

messages.en: The Gallentean terrorists escaped from the system and disappeared. Best intel suggests there was a complication, and that both birds will have died while in their "care." If you had acted faster, all this could have been avoided.
messages.zh: 盖伦特恐怖分子逃出了星系，消失在宇宙中。据我们了解，这事还会有一个并发后果，在他们的“照料”下，两只鸟都将可能死去。如果你行动迅速些，这些都可以避免。

messages.en: A diplomatic nightmare
messages.zh: 外交梦魇

name.ja: ルーヴェノーの名誉のために
name.ru: За честь Rouvenor (For the Honor of Rouvenor)

messages.en: I will do this thing, for the glory of what Gallente was and will be again.
messages.zh: 为了盖伦特过去和未来的荣耀，我接受任务。

messages.en: It is good the Federation can still count on pilots like you.
messages.zh: 太好了，联邦还有你这样的飞行员可以依靠。

messages.en: A chance? What's going on?
messages.zh: 一个机会？发生什么事了？

messages.en:
You've heard the legends of King Rouvenor, yes? Founded the kingdom of Garoun, reigned for a hundred years of peace, killed the fabled Giant Long-Limb of Lyace? Everyone knows these tales. Well, most believe them only to be tales. However, a recent archaeological dig has found what could be the old city of Amatore itself! Nothing is certain yet, but this could be the biggest find in the history of the Federation. Already artifacts from the dig are being sent around to scholars across the universe.

Enter the Caldari. An artifact we believe to be the armor of Rouvenor himself was on its way to the University of Caille when it was hijacked by Caldari terrorists! They've issued no demands, but it is clear they wish to do harm to this piece of our cultural heritage.

We've tracked the terrorists to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It is likely they are using a series of acceleration gates to conceal the location of their base, as so many pirates are wont to do. You will have to approach and activate each acceleration gate you find to progress further to the terrorists' base. Track down these despicable terrorists, and restore the Armor of Rouvenor to its people.
messages.zh:
你听说过洛维诺国王的传说吧？当然你听说过，每一个上过小学的盖伦特人都知道。建立了盖荣帝国，统治了近百年的和平时代，消灭了传说中巨大的长翼莱尔斯。每个人都知道这些故事。但是，一个最近的挖掘行动找到了可能是爱马托尔的古老城市，洛维诺国王的首都！虽然还没什么被确定，但是这可能是联邦有史以来最大的发现。在挖掘中出土的人造物品已经被送往附近大学的学者。

进入加达里。一个我们确信是洛维诺之甲的人造物品在前往加里大学的途中被加达里恐怖分子劫持了！他们并没有提出任何要求，但可以肯定的是他们会试图毁坏我们的文化遗产。

我们跟踪这些恐怖分子到了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。他们很可能利用一系列的加速门来伪装他真正的隐藏地点，虽然大多数的海盗并不会那么做。你必须接近并启动每一个加速门直到你找到他们的据点。追捕这些卑劣的恐怖分子并夺回属于人民的洛维诺之甲。

messages.en: I have done it. I give you the Armor of Rouvenor.
messages.zh: 我成功了。我赐给你洛维诺之甲。

messages.en: You have the thanks of the entire Federation. With heroes like you, we shall soon bring the peace and glory of Old Gallente to every corner of the universe.
messages.zh: 整个联邦向你致谢。有了你这样的英雄，我们将会把盖伦特昔日的和平与荣耀洒遍宇宙的每一个角落。

messages.en: I will risk neither my ship nor my life against these children's stories.
messages.zh: 我不会为了这些骗小孩的故事去拿我的舰船或生命冒险。

messages.en: I had hoped for better from a citizen of the Federation. Get out of my sight.
messages.zh: 我还以为联邦的公民会有出息一些。立刻从我眼前消失。

messages.en: Acceleration gates are not an uncommon sight for most pilots. Like warp gates, each acceleration gate can only be configured for one point in space; unlike warp gates, they can only be used for travel to other points within the same solar system. Acceleration gates can also be locked, preventing pilot from using them. Such locking mechanisms can be based on ship type, on the presence of active guard units in the area, or on appropriate codes/keys.

messages.zh: 加速轨道

messages.en:
Those damned Caldari aren't content to raze our borders and sabotage our economic concerns abroad. Oh, no! Now the bastards are attempting to defile our cultural history!

You've heard the legends of King Rouvenor, yes? Of course you have -- every Gallentean who went to primary school has. Founded the kingdom of Garoun, reigned for a hundred years of peace, killed the fabled Giant Long-Limb of Lyace? Everyone knows these tales. Well, most believe them only to be tales. However, a recent archaeological dig has found what could be the old city of Amatore itself, the wondrous capitol of King Rouvenor! Nothing is certain yet, but this could be the biggest find in the history of the Federation. Already artifacts from the dig are being sent around to scholars across the universe.

Enter the Caldari. An artifact we believe may be the armor of Rouvenor himself was on its way to the University of Caille when it was hijacked by Caldari terrorists! They've issued no demands, but it is clear they wish to do harm to this piece of our cultural heritage.

We've tracked the terrorists to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It is likely they are using a series of acceleration gates to conceal the location of their base, as so many pirates are wont to do. You will have to approach and activate each acceleration gate you find to progress further to the terrorists' base. Track down these despicable terrorists, and restore the Armor of Rouvenor to its people.
messages.zh:
那些令人憎恶的加达里人并不满足于把我们的边界夷为平地和破坏我们在国外的经济利益。哦，不！现在那些杂碎还试图把我们的文明历史抹黑。

你听说过洛维诺国王的传说吧？当然你听说过，每一个上过小学的盖伦特人都知道。建立了盖荣帝国，统治了近百年的和平时代，消灭了传说中巨大的长翼莱尔斯。每个人都知道这些故事。但是，一个最近的挖掘行动找到了可能是爱马托尔的古老城市，洛维诺国王的首都！虽然还没什么被确定，但是这可能是联邦有史以来最大的发现。在挖掘中出土的人造物品已经被送往附近大学的学者。

进入加达里。一个我们确信是洛维诺之甲的人造物品在前往加里大学的途中被加达里恐怖分子劫持了！他们并没有提出任何要求，但可以肯定的是他们会试图毁坏我们的文化遗产。

我们跟踪这些恐怖分子到了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。他们很可能利用一系列的加速门来伪装他真正的隐藏地点，虽然大多数的海盗并不会那么做。你必须接近并启动每一个加速门直到你找到他们的据点。追捕这些卑劣的恐怖分子并夺回属于人民的洛维诺之甲。

messages.en: Not only did the Caldari terrorists escape with the Armor of Rouvenor, but now they are publicly decrying it as a fake. The lows they will stoop to in the pursuit of discrediting the Federation are limitless, but the damage is done. Had you decided sooner, this could have all been avoided.
messages.zh: 加达里恐怖分子不仅带着洛维诺之甲逃跑了，而且他们还公然诽谤那是一件赝品。为了诋毁联邦，他们可以无限堕落下去，但对联邦的伤害已经造成了。如果你能早点决定，这一切都可以避免。

messages.en: Caldari declare Rouvenor a fraud
messages.zh: 加达里称洛维诺之甲为赝品

messages.en: The Caldari can have that hunk of rusted metal. I quit.
messages.zh: 让加达里人把那块生锈的废铁拿走吧。我退出。

messages.en: You are spitting on our heritage. All you unpatriotic swine will get yours someday.
messages.zh: 你这是在向我们的宝贵遗产吐唾沫。你们这些毫无爱国之心的猪们，有朝一日一定会得到报应。

messages.en: The Caldari terrorists have absconded with the Armor of Rouvenor, and we do not know where they have gone. The Gallentean people have lost an important part of their history because you did not succeed in your mission.
messages.zh: 加达里恐怖分子带着洛维诺之甲逃跑了，我们不知道他们的去向。因为你没有成功完成任务，盖伦特人民失去了历史中的一个重要部分。

messages.en: Caldari terrorists vanish
messages.zh: 加达里恐怖分子消失

messages.en: I will bring the traitor back to face justice.
messages.zh: 我会将叛徒带回来，接受正义的制裁。

messages.en: Go with the blessings of the tribes.
messages.zh: 带着部落的祝福，出发吧！

messages.en: I am always ready to serve the Republic.
messages.zh: 我随时准备为共和国效力。

messages.en:
The Republic needs your help. Twelve hours ago, an Amarrian spy attacked and destroyed a prison convoy in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Most of the guards and prisoners are dead, but one prisoner was rescued: a suspected Amarr sympathizer.

Fortunately, they haven't left the system yet; we've learned that the spy has some sort of forward base established here. He's likely using a series of acceleration gates to disguise the true location of the base, a not uncommon tactic. You will have to approach and activate each acceleration gate you find to progress further to the base. Follow the Amarr agent, destroy any resistance, and bring back the sympathizer.
messages.zh:
共和国需要你的帮助。12个小时之前，一个艾玛间谍攻击并摧毁了一艘监犯护卫舰，地点在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系。大部分的护卫和犯人都死了，但有一个犯人被救走了：一个艾玛支持者嫌犯。

庆幸的是，那个艾玛特工还没有离开这个星系，我们探查到一些他们事先建立的据点。他可能利用一系列的加速门来伪装他真正的隐藏地点，一个不那么罕见的战术。你必须接近并启动每一个加速门直到你找到他们的据点。尾随这个艾玛特工，摧毁任何抵抗力量，并把那个艾玛支持者带回来。

messages.en: I have sent the Amarr spy back to his God, and I've brought the traitor back to you.
messages.zh: 我送那个艾玛间谍去见他的上帝了，叛徒已经带了回来。

messages.en:
Good work, {[character]player.name}, I'll just transfer him to— oh, look, I seem to have accidentally opened the airlock he was being kept in! What a tragedy. And the Republic is safer for it.

Remember this lesson well. The true justice of the Minmatar is swift and uncompromising.
messages.zh:
干得好，{[character]player.name}，我可以把他转移到——噢，看啊，我似乎不小心把关着他的空气阀门给打开了！真是太悲惨了。不过共和国却因此更安全了。

好好记住这一课。真正的米玛塔尔正义是迅速而强硬的。

messages.en: Chasing down a single traitor is not the best use of my time.
messages.zh: 追踪一名叛徒不是占用我时间的最佳方式。

messages.en: On the contrary, there is no better use of a Minmatar's time than chasing down a traitor. Be gone.
messages.zh: 恰恰相反，追捕叛国者是米玛塔尔人消耗时间的最佳方式。现在从我眼前消失。

Like warp gates, each acceleration gate can only be configured for one point in space; unlike warp gates, they can only be used for travel to other points within the same solar system. Acceleration gates can also be locked, preventing pilot from using them. Such locking mechanisms can be based on ship type, on the presence of active guard units in the area, or on appropriate codes/keys.

messages.en:
Excellent. Because the Republic needs your help. Twelve hours ago, an Amarrian spy attacked and destroyed a prison convoy in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Most of the guards and prisoners are dead, but one prisoner was rescued: a suspected Amarr sympathizer.

I wish I could say Amarr sympathizers were uncommon. We like to tell ourselves that we cleaned house when we expelled the Nefantar tribe – the Ammatar – from the Republic. But of course life is not so simple. For every ten Minmatar we have fighting to free our brethren from Amarrian captivity or to restore some bit of our displaced old ways, there is one who will sell out his brother for a few ISK. And it only takes one dissenter, one cowardly traitor, to undermine the efforts of hundreds. This is why it is always a top priority for the Republic to ferret out the weak or the corrupt from positions of power. And why the corrupt must be instantly and decisively exterminated.

The prisoner who was rescued is one such figure, formerly a local politician of some influence. He had everyone fooled with his historical conservation initiatives, until an anonymous tip led to his arrest. He was on his way to the Tribunal when the Amarr spy took him ― bastard probably had a deal worked out with the Amarr the whole time.

Fortunately, the Amarr agent hasn't left the system yet; we've learned that he has some sort of forward base established here. He's likely using a series of acceleration gates to disguise the true location of the base, a not uncommon tactic. You will have to approach and activate each acceleration gate you find to progress further to the base. Follow the Amarr agent, destroy any resistance, and bring back the sympathizer.
messages.zh:
太好了。由于共和国需要你的帮助。12个小时之前，一个艾玛间谍攻击并摧毁了一艘监犯护卫舰，地点在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系。大部分的护卫和犯人都死了，但有一个犯人被救走了：一个艾玛支持者嫌犯。

我希望我可以说艾玛支持者是稀有的。我们常常在击退邪恶部落-艾玛达-来自共和国的同时告诉自己我们已经把自家的后院打扫得很干净了。但事实并不是那么简单的。在每十个为了从艾玛解放被捕获的同胞或者为了夺回一块被夺取得土地的米尔玛塔战士中，就有一个会为了一点点的星币而出卖自己的同胞兄弟。而只需要一个反对者，一个懦弱的背叛者，就可以破坏一百个人的心血。这就是为什么赶跑那些弱者或者那些在位的腐败者成为共和国的首要任务。也就是为什么那些腐败的人需要被立即和果断的消灭。

那个被营救的犯人就是其中一个，一个从前有影响力的政治家。他利用自己原有的主动欺骗了所有人，直到一个匿名的举报导致了他的被捕。在被艾玛间谍营救之前他正在前往审判他的路上，那个混蛋可能与艾玛一直有着丝丝缕缕的联系。

庆幸的是，那个艾玛特工还没有离开这个星系，我们探查到一些他们事先建立的据点。他可能利用一系列的加速门来伪装他真正的隐藏地点，一个不那么罕见的战术。你必须接近并启动每一个加速门直到你找到他们的据点。尾随这个艾玛特工，摧毁任何抵抗力量，并把那个艾玛支持者带回来。

messages.en: Justice cannot wait for your decision to act. In lieu of direct action on the traitor, the Republic has performed his sentence on his immediate family, both back and forward one generation. You left the Republic with no other choice.
messages.zh: 正义等不到你决心采取行动的时刻。由于无法对叛国者采取直接行动，共和国转而将对该叛徒的宣判施于其直系家属——前后共三代人。你使共和国别无选择。

messages.en: Justice cannot wait
messages.zh: 公正不容等待

messages.en: Chasing down a single traitor is not the best use of my time. I quit.
messages.zh: 追踪一名叛徒不是占用我时间的最佳方式。我退出。

messages.en: On the contrary, there is no better use of a Minmatar's time than chasing down a traitor. Be gone.
messages.zh: 恰恰相反，追捕叛国者是米玛塔尔人消耗时间的最佳方式。现在从我眼前消失。

messages.en: We've lost track of the Amarr agent. Had you acted more quickly, proper justice might have been served. In lieu of direct action on the traitor, the Republic has performed his sentence on his immediate family, both back and forward one generation. Whatever further Minmatar lives are lost as a result of this are on your head.
messages.zh: 我们失去了艾玛特工的线索。如果你动作快些，真正的正义已得到伸张。由于无法对叛国者采取直接行动，共和国转而将对该叛徒的宣判施于其直系家属——前后共三代人。如果再有任何米玛塔人因此而丧命，都应归咎于你。

messages.en: Justice cannot wait
messages.zh: 公正不容等待
