name.ru: Новые рубежи - навстречу решению (New Frontiers - Toward a Solution) (3 из 7)

messages.en: I'd be happy to help. Money's money, eh?
messages.zh: 我很乐意帮忙。谁会跟钱过意不去，对吧？

messages.en: Yes, it will. Never fear.
messages.zh: 会的。不用怕。

messages.en: Interesting. But how can I help?
messages.zh: 真是有趣。可我该怎么帮忙呢？

messages.en: We need you to go pick up a unique Mechanical Engineering datacore put together for the project by one of Dr. Calus's colleagues not far from here and bring it back as soon as possible. You will be rewarded, of course, as usual.
messages.zh: 我们需要你去取一个独特的机械工程数据核心，它是专为卡鲁斯博士的一位同事所进行的项目而创造的，请尽快去把它带回来。当然，跟往常一样，你将得到回报。

messages.en: I have the datacore. You owe me.
messages.zh: 我拿到数据核心了。你欠我一个人情。

messages.en: Now, now: I always pay my debts. And now the project can move into the final stage. I hope you're still willing to help out?
messages.zh: 好了，好了：我这人向来有债必还。现在，这个项目可以进入最终阶段了。你还是愿意帮忙的吧？

messages.en: Scientific progress grinds to halt, thanks to your lack of initiative.
messages.zh: 有了你的惰性，科研进展就停滞不前了。

messages.en:
Well, Dr. Calus is not ready to reveal the nature of her project, but rest assured that it will be huge. However, the good doctors require some critical datacores to help them put their ideas into physical form. Sometimes scientific ideas race ahead of one's ability to fabricate the results effectively.

We need you to go pick up a unique Mechanical Engineering datacore put together for the project by one of Dr. Calus's colleagues not far from here and bring it back as soon as possible. You will be rewarded, of course, as usual.
messages.zh:
呃，卡鲁斯博士还不准备透露其项目的具体情况，但请放心这一定是项大工程。现在那群优秀的博士们需要一些重要的数据核心，他们需要用这些东西将他们头脑里的理论变成现实。科学灵感有时候真是太高深，高得你没法弄虚作假。

我们需要你去取一个独特的机械工程数据核心，它是专为卡鲁斯博士的一位同事所进行的项目而创造的，请尽快去把它带回来。当然，跟往常一样，你将得到回报。

messages.en: Dr. Calus has informed me that your delay in procuring the datacore has put her research irrevocably behind schedule. As such, your involvement is no longer welcome.
messages.zh: 卡鲁斯博士通知我说，由于你在获取数据核心时的延误，致使她的研究彻底落在进度表后面，完全没有挽救余地。鉴于此，我们的研究不再欢迎你的参与。

messages.en: You're fired!
messages.zh: 你被炒鱿鱼了！

messages.en: Scientific progress grinds to a halt, thanks to you.
messages.zh: 多亏了你，科研进展停滞不前了。

messages.en: Dr. Calus has informed me that your delay in procuring the datacore has put her research irrevocably behind schedule. As such, your involvement is no longer welcome.
messages.zh: 卡鲁斯博士通知我说，由于你在获取数据核心时的延误，致使她的研究彻底落在进度表后面，完全没有挽救余地。鉴于此，我们的研究不再欢迎你的参与。

messages.en: You're fired!
messages.zh: 你被炒鱿鱼了！

name.ja: 新たなフロンティア-正体判明（4/7）
name.ru: Новые горизонты – разоблачение (New Frontiers - The Unveiling) (4 из 7)

messages.en: I'll find it.
messages.zh: 我去找它。

messages.en: Good, but move quickly, before it jumps elsewhere. It's hiding in an asteroid field in this system.
messages.zh: 好的，不过快点行动，否则它要跳到别的地方去了。它正藏在这个星系的一个小行星带里。

messages.en: I must've missed it, sorry. What happened?!
messages.zh: 抱歉，我肯定错过那一幕了。发生了什么？！

messages.en:
Somehow Delainen subverted Calus's research. They inserted the nanites, programmed by Prof. Delainen, into a battlecruiser's systems, but the things immediately began to malfunction. In less than ten minutes, they had changed the structure of the ship to ... something else. It blew a hole through the wall of the station into open space and blasted out of there. Everyone in the lab was killed, including Calus.

We believe that the nanites somehow merged Delainen into the ship they had created, making it some sort of bizarre biomechanical symbiote. But we need to know what happened for certain, and this ― well, this Delainen-ROM symbiote, I guess, for lack of a better name ― is the only thing that can give us the answers.

We want you to go out there and confront it; we've tracked its location, and it's still in this system. I've sent the coordinates to your NeoCom. Destroy it if you must, and then sift through the wreckage to find its central AI core. Bring that back for further study.
messages.zh:
德莱宁不知怎么搞的把卡鲁司的研究弄砸了。他们在一艘战列巡洋舰的系统里加入了德莱宁教授编程的纳米体，但那些东西很快就失灵了。他们在十分钟以内就把那艘船的结构变成了……不知道什么东西。那船在空间站的墙上穿了一个洞到太空中然后就在外面爆炸了。实验室里没有人生还，其中包括卡鲁司。

我们因此相信那些纳米体以某种方式把德莱宁同化到了他们造的那艘船里，使得他变成了异化的生化机械怪物。但我们需要知道的是具体发生了什么事，以及那个——那个德莱宁-ROM共生体，在没有想到好名字之前，就暂且这样叫它吧——它是唯一能够告诉我们答案的东西了。

我们已经追踪到了它的地点，而且它还在这个星系里，所以我们想让你到那边去看看。我已将坐标上传到了你的控制边栏里。如果必须干掉它的话，就干掉它，然后在它留下的残骸里找到它的中央AI核心，带回来我们再研究。

messages.en: I have the AI core right here. And it's dripping green goo all over my cargo hold! And the goo is moving!
messages.zh: AI核心我带来了。我的货柜舱里到处是它滴出的绿色黏液！而且那些液体还在动！

messages.en: That is a tremendous relief. You have done well; now we must study this thing for clues about what went wrong. Stick around.
messages.zh: 我终于长出了一口气。你干得不错。现在我们要好好研究这个东西，看看哪里出了问题。别走远了。

messages.en: You're backing out now? Cowardice does not look good in such an experienced ship commander.
messages.zh: 你现在要退出？对你这样有经验的舰船指挥官来说，胆小如鼠的性格与你不相称啊。

messages.en:
Well, that thing is gone, so the station is safe for now. The breached districts have been sealed off until repair crews can get in there. But I suppose you're wondering what happened. Let me back up for a moment.

Dr. Calus's original goal was to create a ship energy system that used advanced nanites to harvest the energy that binds subatomic particles together. The amount of energy that could be produced would be staggering. Think of it. The offensive potential of our ships and weapons systems could be increased a hundred-fold at least, maybe a thousand-fold.

But somehow Delainen subverted Calus's research. He spent years living in close proximity to a nest of rogue drones; he even claimed to have struck up a beneficial relationship with them. Who knows what that does to a person?

They inserted the nanites, programmed by Prof. Delainen, into the battlecruiser's systems, but the things immediately began to malfunction. In less than ten minutes, they had changed the structure of the ship to ... something else. The security 'reels show a flash of light, almost like a jump gate activation, and then Delainen just disappears. Then, immediately, the metallic beast begins to move. We have heard of massive rogue drones, but this is different.

The ship actually spoke to Calus, who was injured during the ship's violent transformation. It said its name was "ROM." Then it blew a hole through the wall of the station into open space and blasted out of there. Everyone in the lab was killed, including Calus.

We believe that the nanites somehow merged Delainen into the ship they had created, making it some sort of bizarre biomechanical symbiote. But we need to know what happened for certain, and this ― well, this Delainen-ROM symbiote, I guess, for lack of a better name ― is the only thing that can give us the answers.

We want you to go out there and confront it; we've tracked its location, and it's still in this system. I'll send the coordinates to your NeoCom. Destroy it if you must, and then sift through the wreckage to find its central AI core. Bring that back for further study.
messages.zh:
算了，那东西没了，所以就目前来说那空间站是安全的。那个地区会一直封锁，直到维修人员到达。不过我觉得你肯定很想知道发生了什么事。让我来告诉你吧。

卡鲁司博士最开始的目标是要建造一个船舶能源系统，运用先进的纳米技术来获取结合原子和粒子颗粒的能源。从中获得的能源可能会多得惊人。想想看，我们船只的攻击潜力和武器系统可以因此而提升至少一百多倍，说不定一千多倍都有可能。

但不知怎么地，德莱宁把卡鲁司的研究搞砸了。他曾经有好多年的时间住在离一群自由无人机很近的地方，他甚至还宣称他跟他们形成了一种利益关系。谁知道这些事情会让一个人变成什么样呢？

他们在一艘战列巡洋舰的系统里加入了德莱宁编制的纳米体，但那些东西很快就失灵了。才不到十分钟，他们就把那艘船的结构变成了……不知道什么的东西。当时监控录像上显示的是一道光闪过，有点像跳过星门发出的光，然后德莱宁就不见了。紧接着那艘船就开始移动。我们以前听说过庞大的自由无人机，但这次却不一样。

当时那艘船跟在船体剧烈变化中受伤的卡鲁司说，它的名字叫“ROM”。然后它就在那个空间站的墙上穿出一个洞延伸到太空中，在外面爆炸了。包括卡鲁司在内的实验室里的所有人，无一幸免。

我们因此相信那些纳米体以某种方式把德莱宁同化到了他们造的那艘船里，使得他变成了异化的生化机械怪物。但我们需要知道的是具体发生了什么事，那个——那个德莱宁-ROM共生体，在没有想到好名字之前，就暂且这样叫它吧——是唯一能够告诉我们答案的东西了。

我们已经追踪到了它的地点，而且它还在这个星系里，所以我们想让你到那边去看看。我会将任务坐标上传到你的控制边栏里。如果必须干掉就干掉它，然后在它留下的残骸里找到它的中央AI核心，把它带回来我们再研究。

messages.en: You waited too long. The symbiote has somehow slipped away and eluded us. This is on your head. Who knows the havoc that thing will create, who knows how it will evolve!
messages.zh: 你耽搁的时间太久了。那个共生体想办法溜走了，已经逃出了我们的视线。这要记在你头上。天知道那个东西会造成怎样的破坏，天知道它会进化到什么形态！

messages.en: The symbiote has escaped
messages.zh: 共生体逃跑了

messages.en: You're just letting that thing loose upon the galaxy! Imagine the havoc it will cause!
messages.zh: 你就这么让那个东西在宇宙里自由自在！想想它会造成什么灾难吧！

messages.en: You waited too long. The symbiote has somehow slipped away and eluded us. This is on your head. Who knows the havoc that thing will create, who knows how it will evolve!
messages.zh: 你耽搁的时间太久了。那个共生体想办法溜走了，已经逃出了我们的视线。这要记在你头上。天知道那个东西会造成怎样的破坏，天知道它会进化到什么形态！

messages.en: The symbiote has escaped
messages.zh: 共生体逃跑了

name.ja: 新たなフロンティア-予期せぬ展開（5/7）
name.ru: Новые горизонты – неожиданный поворот (New Frontiers - An Unexpected Twist) (5 из 7)

messages.en: More weird drones? Yeah … okay, fine. But this had better be worth it!
messages.zh: 又是奇怪的无人机？噢……行，好吧。不过这次最好值得我花这么大力气！

messages.en: Of course, my friend, yes. Of course. Just be careful out there!
messages.zh: 当然，我的朋友。当然。到那注意安全！

messages.en: Yeah, it's all cleaned up. But thanks for the concern. You mentioned that I should stick around, though?
messages.zh: 是的，都清理干净了。谢谢你关心。你之前说过，让我别走远，对吗？

messages.en:
Delainen apparently formed some sort of bond or relationship with the rogue drone colony near his previous home. But it's worse than that. Even now there are ongoing subspace transmissions taking place between these drones and the AI unit you recovered ― the thing's intelligence core is most certainly not dead.

The drones have moved around several times, but they're remaining near, for whatever reason. Go to the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and destroy that rogue drone colony once and for all. The hive mind CPU and construction center is in the central hive structure. That is your target.

These drones are very, very advanced, and they've had time to build. You might even wish to take some help with you. Once they are all destroyed, salvage the hive mind CPU and return it to us.
messages.zh:
很明显，卡居雷·德莱宁早就与在他以前家附近的自由无人机殖民地有某种联系。但是现在情况更糟。即使现在， 这里有子空间的传输活动正在那些无人机和你修复的人工智能芯片之间进行-智能核心不可能死亡。

这些无人机已经在周围飞行很多次，但是他们依然离得很近，无论因为什么样的理由。去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系并且一次性摧毁无人机殖民地。母巢思维CPU和建筑中心在母巢结构中心处。那就是你的目标。

这些无人机非常先进，而且他们有时间去制造。你可能甚至会希望得到一些帮助。一旦他们都被摧毁，打捞母巢思维CPU并且把它带给我们。

messages.en: The drone colony is destroyed. I have the hive mind CPU on board. But do you think it is wise to have it so near the AI core? Weren't they communicating somehow?
messages.zh: 无人机殖民地已被摧毁。机巢母体CPU就在我船上。不过，你觉得把它带到离AI核心这么近的地方，是个好主意吗？它们之前不是在以某种方式相互通信吗？

messages.en: We have little choice, {[character]player.name}; we must understand what has gone on. But we have made progress here as well. Come back when you have time and I'll explain.
messages.zh: 我们别无选择，{[character]player.name}，我们必须了解到底那里发生了什么事。不过我们这边也有进展。等你有时间的时候再回来，我会解释清楚的。

messages.en: Look, I don't need any weird nanites taking over my ship. I'm done with this.
messages.zh: 听着，我可不想让什么古怪的纳米体占领我的飞船。我不干了。

messages.en: You're backing out now? Cowardice does not look good in such an experienced ship commander.
messages.zh: 你现在要退出？对你这样有经验的舰船指挥官来说，胆小如鼠的性格与你不相称啊。

messages.en:
Yes, I did. The good Dr. Calus ― whose value to us necessitates our keeping a clone in place for her ― is studying the Delainen-ROM's AI "brain" as we speak. But there's something else we'd like you to do.

Delainen apparently formed some sort of bond or relationship with the rogue drone colony near his previous home. But it's worse than that. Even now there are ongoing subspace transmissions taking place between these drones and the AI unit you recovered ― the thing's intelligence core is most certainly not dead.

The drones have moved around several times, but they're remaining near, for whatever reason. Go to the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and destroy that rogue drone colony once and for all. The hive mind CPU and construction center is in the central hive structure. That is your target. Once the drones there are all destroyed, salvage the hive mind CPU and return it to us.
messages.zh:
是的，我是说过。当我们发言时， 人不错的卡鲁司博士正在研究德莱宁-只读存储器人工智能“大脑”。但这里还有一些事我们希望你可以去做。

很明显，卡居雷·德莱宁早就与在他以前家附近的自由无人机殖民地有某种联系。但是现在情况更糟。即使现在， 这里有子空间的传输活动正在那些无人机和你修复的人工智能芯片之间进行-智能核心不可能死亡。

这些无人机已经在周围飞行很多次，但是他们依然离得很近，无论因为什么样的理由。去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系并且一次性摧毁无人机殖民地。母巢思维CPU和建筑中心在母巢结构中心处。那就是你的目标。这些无人机非常先进，而且他们有时间去制造。你可能甚至会希望得到一些帮助。一旦他们都被摧毁，打捞母巢思维CPU并且把它带给我们。

messages.en: You waited too long. Apparently, the Delainen-ROM AI core warned them that we were coming: The drones have disappeared and moved. Now, it is unlikely we will ever have the opportunity to fully understand what happened.
messages.zh: 你耽搁的时间太久了。显然，德莱宁-ROM AI核心已经向那些无人机发出警告，告诉它们我们要来了。那些无人机已经消失，转移到别处了。现在我们几乎不可能有机会去完全了解到底发生了什么。

messages.en: Disappearing drones
messages.zh: 消失的无人机

messages.en: Look, I don't need any weird nanites taking over my ship. I'm done with this.
messages.zh: 听着，我可不想让什么古怪的纳米体占领我的飞船。我不干了。

messages.en: If we had thought you a quitter, we would never have hired you in the first place.
messages.zh: 要是早知道你是个半途而废的家伙，我们一开始就不雇你了。

messages.en: You waited too long. Apparently, the Delainen-ROM AI core warned them that we were coming: The drones have disappeared and moved. Now, it is unlikely we will ever have the opportunity to fully understand what happened.
messages.zh: 你耽搁的时间太久了。显然，德莱宁-ROM AI核心已经向那些无人机发出警告，告诉它们我们要来了。那些无人机已经消失，转移到别处了。现在我们几乎不可能有机会去完全了解到底发生了什么。

messages.en: Disappearing drones
messages.zh: 消失的无人机

name.es: Nuevas fronteras: Nanobots a la carta (6 de 7)
name.ja: 新たなフロンティア-ナノマシン至急便（6/7）
name.ru: Новые рубежи - нанитный экспресс (New Frontiers - Nanite Express) (6 из 7)

messages.en: Yeah, sure. At least I won't have to worry about any green goo this time if it's all frozen.
messages.zh: 是的，当然。既然它已经被冰冻起来，至少这次我就不用担心那些绿色黏液了。

messages.en: Excellent. Come back when you're finished.
messages.zh: 很好。完成任务之后再回来吧。

messages.en: Sure. Makes sense. How can I help?
messages.zh: 好。有道理。我该怎么做？

messages.en:
We've completed Dr. Calus's study of the Delainen-ROM symbiote's AI core and the CPU you got for us. They're like nothing we've ever seen before. A strange combination of human thought patterns, atomic-scale nanites, and constantly evolving neural networks. And the thing wouldn't stop telling bad jokes! But if those nanites were ever loosed, they could easily latch onto the nearest ship and reconstitute themselves. We just can't risk that happening … again.

But it's also too valuable to destroy. We have placed the items in a special cryogenic container for temporary cold storage. The closest station with an adequate facility for long-term cryogenic storage is in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, though. Please take the container over there for safekeeping.
messages.zh:
我们对你带回来的卡鲁司博士的德莱宁-ROM共生体AI核心和CPU进行了研究，它和我们之前见过的截然不同。它是一种奇异的组合，包含了人类的思维模式、原子级别的纳米体以及不断进化的神经网络。这个东西还会没完没了地讲蹩脚笑话！如果这些纳米体获得自由，它们会轻易地搭上最近的舰船然后进行自我重组。我们绝不能让这种事情再次发生了。

但是，这东西太珍贵了，摧毁掉实在可惜。我们把这些东西放在了一个特殊的低温容器中暂时冷冻起来。离这儿最近的适合长期冷冻储存的空间站在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，请把这个容器带到那里好好保存起来。

messages.en: Okay, I'm done.
messages.zh: 好我搞定了。

messages.en: Another job well done, {[character]player.name}. But I need to talk to you again right away ― this isn't over!
messages.zh: 你又一次出色地完成了任务，{[character]player.name}。不过我马上还要和你说另一件事——事情还没结束呢！

messages.en: No, thanks. I'm about done with this stupid drone business.
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。这一串愚蠢的无人机差事已经让我受够了。

messages.en: You're quitting now, {[character]player.name}?! After everything you've been through? But this is just a courier mission!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你要现在退出？！在你干了这么多事之后？这只是个快递任务而已！

messages.en:
We've completed Dr. Calus's study of the Delainen-ROM symbiote's AI core and the CPU you got for us. They're like nothing we've ever seen before. A strange combination of human thought patterns, atomic-scale nanites, and constantly evolving neural networks. And the thing wouldn't stop telling bad jokes! But if those nanites were ever loosed, they could easily latch onto the nearest ship and reconstitute themselves. Er, itself. Well, whatever. We just can't risk that happening … again. Which is why it's too dangerous to study further ― the chance of a breakout is just too high.

But it's also too valuable to destroy. We have placed the items in a special cryogenic container for temporary cold storage. The closest station with an adequate facility for long-term cryogenic storage is in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, though. Please take the container over there for safekeeping.
messages.zh:
我们对你带回来的卡鲁司博士的德莱宁-ROM共生体AI核心和CPU进行了研究，它和我们之前见过的截然不同。它是一种奇异的组合，包含了人类的思维模式、原子级别的纳米体以及不断进化的神经网络。这个东西还会没完没了地讲蹩脚笑话！如果这些纳米体获得自由，它们会轻易地搭上最近的舰船然后进行自我重组。 我们绝不能让这种事情再次发生了。这也是为什么对它继续研究下去过于危险的原因——发生意外的几率实在太高了。

但是，这东西太珍贵了，摧毁掉实在可惜。我们把这些东西放在了一个特殊的低温容器中暂时冷冻起来。离这儿最近的适合长期冷冻储存的空间站在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，请把这个容器带到那里好好保存起来。

messages.en: You waited too long, so we found someone else to do this. Such a lack of initiative looks poorly on such an experienced ship commander.
messages.zh: 你耽搁了太多时间，我们已经另找他人去办了。这种惰性与你这样有经验的舰船指挥官实在是不相称。

messages.en: Cryogenic Safety Precaution
messages.zh: 低温安全预防措施

messages.en: On second thought, I'm about done with this stupid drone business. Count me out.
messages.zh: 经过仔细考虑，我觉得这一串愚蠢的无人机差事已经让我受够了。我不参加。

messages.en: You're quitting now, {[character]player.name}?! After everything you've been through? But this is just a courier mission!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你要现在退出？！在你干了这么多事之后？这只是个快递任务而已！

messages.en: Forget it. We'll find someone else to carry this. We can't just leave it lying around. Such a lack of initiative looks poorly on such an experienced ship commander.
messages.zh: 算了吧。我们找别人来运送好了。我们不能把它放在这里不管。这种惰性与你这样有经验的舰船指挥官实在是不相称。

messages.en: Cryogenic Safety Precaution
messages.zh: 低温安全预防措施

name.ja: 新たなフロンティア-優勢（7/7）
name.ru: Новые горизонты – восхождение (New Frontiers - Ascendance) (7 из 7)

messages.en: Solar Cinder, huh? How apt: That thing's as good as cinders, now.
messages.zh: 日烬号，嗯？真贴切：那玩意儿现在就跟灰烬差不多了。

messages.en: Good. But move quickly. It's hiding in a deadspace location not far from here.
messages.zh: 好的。不过行动要快。它正藏在离这不远的一个死亡空间里。

messages.en: Don't tell me. You mean there's more rogue nanites out there?
messages.zh: 别跟我说，你的意思是还有更多的自由纳米体？

messages.en:
That green goo in your cargohold was far more dangerous than we first realized. Some nanites – perhaps even the very ones from your cargohold – somehow made their way onto a battleship called Solar Cinder, which blasted out of its hangar just a few minutes ago. We don't know what to call this thing now, but it is sentient, and shows many similarities to the Delainen-ROM symbiote. But this is a battleship. An uncontrolled battleship with human-patterned AI ... and capable of self-replication!

We need you to get out there and destroy it! The military is on the way, but they will not be here in force before it has time to escape, if that's what it intends.

This won't be easy. That ship was heavily armed, and the symbiote's drone technology is very advanced. Furthermore, we believe that it can actually "heal" itself. You just might want to get some assistance on this one.
messages.zh:
你货柜里的那绿色黏液比我们一开始意识到的要危险多了。一些纳米体——甚至有可能就是你货柜里的那些纳米体，不知通过什么方法登上了一艘叫作日烬的战列巡洋舰，就是几分钟前从它的机库里爆炸的那艘。现在我们并不知道怎么来解释这件事情，但这事儿跟德莱宁-ROM共生体之间有很多相似之处，不同的是这是一艘战列巡洋舰。一艘失去控制的类似人类AI的…而且还能自我复制的战列巡洋舰！!

我们需要你到那儿去把它消灭掉！虽然说我们的军队已经在路上了，但照计划来说，他们在它有时间逃掉之前，是赶不到那儿的。self-replication!

这事儿可不容易，那艘船武装得很好，而且那个共生体的无人机技术也非常高超。还有，我们觉得那船可以“自愈”。要做这个任务的话，我觉得你需要点儿帮助。

messages.en:
Mission accomplished at last. The entity is destroyed. The galaxy is safe.

But I have some repair bills to cover, so... about that reward?
messages.zh:
任务终于完成了。目标已被摧毁。宇宙现在安全了。

不过我有些维修账单要付……那个，报酬的事情怎样了？

messages.en: Your assistance has been invaluable, {[character]player.name}. You are a courageous commander. Enjoy your rewards and my personal gratitude. You've more than earned them.
messages.zh: 你为我们立了个大功，{[character]player.name}。你真是一名勇敢的指挥官。请接受奖励，以及我个人的谢意。这完全是你应得的。

messages.en: This could go on forever. Nah, I'm gonna let the military deal with this one. It's out of my league now.
messages.zh: 这可能会没完没了。不啦，我还是让军方来解决这件事吧。这事现在不属于我的职责范畴了。

messages.en: You're backing out now? Imagine the havoc that thing will cause!
messages.zh: 你现在要退缩？想想这东西会造成什么灾难吧！

messages.en:
Yes. Very astute, {[character]player.name}. Do you recall that green goo in your cargohold a while back, when you returned with the drone AI core? That material was far more dangerous – and far more cunning – than we first realized. The nanites in the symbiote's AI core were the size of molecules, with atomic-scale manipulator arms. And because they are so small, they are practically undetectable. A billion of them could hide in the crevices of a speck of dust.

Are you frightened yet? You should be. Because they are loose.

Those nanites – perhaps even the self-same ones from your cargohold – somehow made their way onto a battleship called Solar Cinder, which blasted out of its hangar, with no crew, just a few minutes ago. We don't know what to call this thing now, but it is sentient, and shows many similarities to the Delainen-ROM symbiote. But this is a battleship. An uncontrolled battleship with human-patterned AI ... and capable of self-replication! Given time, it could lay waste to an entire planet!

We need you to get out there and destroy it! The military is on the way, but they will not be here in force before it has time to escape, if that's what it intends.
messages.zh:
是的，你能够见机行事，{[character]player.name}。你还能想起不久前当你带回那个无人机AI核心的时候，你货柜里的那绿色黏液吗？那玩意儿比起我们一开始意识到的更危险也更奇妙。在那共生体的AI核心里的纳米体只有分子大小，长着原子大小般的机械臂。正因为它们那么小，它们实际上是无法被检测出来的。成千上亿的这些东西可以躲藏在灰尘中的缝隙里。

你害怕了吗？应该害怕了。因为他们无孔不入。

那些纳米体——甚至有可能就是你货柜里的那些，不知通过什么方法登上了一艘叫作日烬的战列巡洋舰，就是几分钟前从它的机库里爆炸的那艘。我们还不知道怎么来解释这件事情，但这事儿跟德莱宁-ROM共生体之间有很多相似之处，不同的是这是一艘战列巡洋舰。一艘失去控制的类似人类AI的…而且还能自我复制!的战列巡洋舰！如果给它足够的时间，它甚至可以把一整个行星都毁掉！

我们需要你到那儿去把它消灭掉！虽然说我们的军队已经在路上了，但照计划来说，他们在它有时间逃掉之前，是赶不到那儿的。

messages.en: The Solar Cinder drone entity escaped, thanks to you. I must say, I've never been associated with such a shiftless coward.
messages.zh: 都是因为你，日烬无人机逃跑了。我必须说，我从没跟你这么无能的胆小鬼打过交道。

messages.en: It has escaped!
messages.zh: 它逃了！

messages.en: This is crazy. I'm just gonna let the military deal with this one. It's out of my league now.
messages.zh: 这太疯狂了。我还是让军方来解决这件事吧。这事现在不属于我的职责范畴了。

messages.en: You just let that thing loose upon the galaxy! Imagine the havoc it will cause!
messages.zh: 你就这么让那个东西在宇宙里自由自在！想想它会造成什么灾难吧！

messages.en: The Solar Cinder drone entity escaped, thanks to you. I must say, I've never been associated with such a shiftless coward.
messages.zh: 都是因为你，日烬无人机逃跑了。我必须说，我从没跟你这么无能的胆小鬼打过交道。

messages.en: It has escaped!
messages.zh: 它逃了！

name.es: Atención indebida: Tantear el terreno (1 de 3)
name.ru: Незаслуженное внимание – осмотр на месте (Undue Attention - Poking Around) (1 из 3)

messages.en: Sure thing. Consider the area poked.
messages.zh: 当然。一定完成这个区域的侦察任务。

messages.en: Ah, nice. Thanks. My favorite holovid show's about to come on, and I really don't want to miss it.
messages.zh: 啊，漂亮。谢谢。我最喜欢的全息视频秀就要开始了，我真的不想错过这期节目。

messages.en: Just, "hey"? No salute or anything?
messages.zh: 就一个“嗨”？不敬个礼什么的？

messages.en:
We've been getting a few reports of strange activity in this system. Now, I bet it's just smugglers. And honestly, I'd rather not create too much of a fuss over it ― but it's making the civvies nervous, and they could raise just as much hell for us as any smuggler. So, just go out to these coordinates, poke around a bit, and come back. If anything pokes back, just run.

Or don't do it at all. I mean, what the hell do I care, really? It may be I can find some other work for you if you'd rather not play scout…
messages.zh:
我们不断收到关于本星系中怪异活动的报告。我打赌这肯定是非法贩售者所为。而且说实话，我不想为这事小题大做——但它引起了平民的紧张情绪，他们一添起乱来，比起任何非法贩售者是有过之而无不及。所以，你就飞去该坐标位置，四处打探一下，然后就回来。如果有东西反击你，立刻就跑。

要不你干脆就别去干。我是说，这关我什么事？如果你不想扮演侦察员，也许我能给你找个别的什么工作……

messages.en: Yeah, about this whole scouting thing? Seems you've got Gallente out there. And I don't mean a few.
messages.zh: 呃，关于这个侦察任务？那里似乎有盖伦特人。数量可不少。

messages.en: Gallente? Here? You've got to be kidding. Okay, let me set this show to record… gimme just minute and come back, will you?
messages.zh: 盖伦特？在这里？你是在开玩笑吧。好吧，那我把这期节目录下来……给我一分钟，到时再回来，行吗？

messages.en: I think I'll pass. You suggested you might have something else?
messages.zh: 我想我还是免了。你刚才说过，可能还有别的事情？

messages.en: Something else? Yeah, I've got something for you. Come back in a bit.
messages.zh: 别的事情？是啊，我是还有事要你办。你过一会再来。

messages.en:
Quitting missions (or ignoring them until they "time out," which amounts to the same thing) invariably results in a loss of faction standing; it is almost always in a character's best interest to complete all missions he or she accepts.

However, a character may freely decline a mission when it is first offered, as long as it isn't one of those rare "storyline" missions; after that, declining another mission within four hours of the first does result in a loss of standing. Still, in general, a pilot's career is usually long and eventful enough that a few such minor hits to standing may not be too large a price.
messages.zh:
退出任务（或者忽略任务，直到它们“过期”，等同于退出任务）会损失一定的势力声望；所以，为了角色利益的着想，最好完成他或她接受的所有任务。

不过，当最初拿到任务时，只要这个任务不是罕见的“故事线”任务，角色可以自由拒绝该任务；然而，在拒绝首个任务后的4小时内，如果再拒绝一个任务，也会导致声望的损失。不过，总的说来，一个飞行员的职业生涯会很漫长且坎坷，一点这样小小的声望损失一般不会造成太大的影响。

messages.en: Missions and Standing
messages.zh: 任务和声望

messages.en:
We don't stand much on formality here: This isn't a post people seek out to advance their careers. Most of us are content to not be noticed. People start making noise, the hard-asses start remembering we're here, and that means more work for everyone.

But speaking of work, I've got some for you. We've been getting a few reports of strange activity in this system. Now, I bet it's just smugglers. And honestly, I'd rather not create too much of a fuss over it ― but it's making the civvies nervous, and they could raise just as much hell for us as any smuggler. So, just go out to these coordinates, poke around a bit, and come back. If anything pokes back, just run.

Or don't do it. I mean, what the hell do I care, really? It may be I can find some other work for you if you'd rather not play scout…
messages.zh:
我们不讲客套话：没人把这职位当作事业发展的阶梯。我们大多数人不愿抛头露面。但有些人心痒痒了，狗崽子们也想起了我们在这里，这些都意味着每个人都有更多的工作可干了。

提到工作，我这里倒有一些适合你做的。有报告说该星系里有异常活动。我现在相信他们只是一些非法贩售团伙。说真的，我不想小题大做——但它引起了平民的紧张情绪，他们一添起乱来，比起任何非法贩售者是有过之而无不及。所以，你就飞去该坐标位置，四处打探一下，然后就回来。如果有东西反击你，立刻就跑。

要不你干脆就别去干。我是说，这关我什么事？如果你不想扮演侦察员，也许我能给你找个别的什么工作……

messages.en: Things are quieting down, so I'm calling off the recon. Any activity now and people will get suspicious.
messages.zh: 事情正在平息下来，所以我取消了侦察。现在采取任何行动的话，人们肯定会起疑。

messages.en: Recon over
messages.zh: 侦察结束

messages.en: I'm just having so much fun with this mission that I think I should let someone else do it instead. What else have you got?
messages.zh: 这个任务太有意思了，我想应该让别人来享受这种乐趣。你还有什么别的任务？

messages.en: Yeah, I don't blame you. Still, my superiors aren't going to like it. But that doesn't mean I might not have something else for you…
messages.zh: 是啊，我不责怪你。但我的上级还是不会高兴的。不过，这并不是说我没有别的事情要你做了……

messages.en: Things are quieting down, so I'm calling off the recon. Any activity now and people will get suspicious.
messages.zh: 事情正在平息下来，所以我取消了侦察。现在采取任何行动的话，人们肯定会起疑。

messages.en: Recon over
messages.zh: 侦察结束

name.de: Übermäßige Aufmerksamkeit - Den Hilfreichen helfen (2 von 3)
name.en: Undue Attention - Helping the Helpful (2 of 3)
name.es: Atención indebida: Ayudar a quien ayuda (2 de 3)
name.fr: Une attention excessive - Au secours des alliés (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 過度の注目―支援者への支援（2/3）
name.ru: Незаслуженное внимание – помощь (Undue Attention - Helping the Helpful) (2 из 3)

messages.en: The Intaki Syndicate, huh? Okay, I'll do my best.
messages.zh: 印塔基联合财团，嗯？好吧，我尽力。

messages.en: Good. Oh, and if their leader mentions anything about anything like… oh, say, a few outstanding debts? Just tell him he's thinking of the wrong {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 好的。对了，如果他们的头提到关于……嗯，关于一些未偿债务的事情……你就告诉他，他说的是另一个{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Calm down. Take it slowly. We can deal with this.
messages.zh: 冷静。慢慢来。我们能搞定的。

messages.en: Okay, here's what I need you to do. I have a few friends in the Intaki Syndicate who owe me for looking the other way during a few local business deals. I need you to hop over to their base and get their support. Do whatever you can. But be sure you're armed. You can never tell what's going on with the Syndicate.
messages.zh: 好吧，我要你做的事情是这样的。我在印塔基联合财团有几个朋友，因为我在几桩本地业务买卖中睁一只眼、闭一只眼，所以他们欠我人情。我要你跃迁到他们的基地并获得他们的支持。尽你一切所能。不过，务必要全副武装。没有人摸得清联合财团的状况。

messages.en: I found the Intaki. The Gallente were giving them some trouble, but I gave the Gallente more. The Syndicate said they'd help us out.
messages.zh: 我找到印塔基人了。盖伦特人给他们了些苦头吃，不过我让盖伦特人吃了更多苦头。联合财团答应帮助我们。

messages.en: The Federation is moving faster than I thought. Still, with the Syndicate's help, this should be a lot easier.
messages.zh: 联邦的行进速度比我料想的要快。不过，有了联合财团的帮助，事情会好办得多。

messages.en: I'm not getting mixed up in criminal affairs. Give me some other option.
messages.zh: 我可想不扯进犯罪事件中。给我些其他选择吧。

messages.en: Damn it! You and your stupid ethics. Alright, fine. Give me a minute to think of something else and then come back, okay?
messages.zh: 该死！你和你那愚蠢的职业道德。好吧，行。给我点时间，让我找件别的任务，待会再回来，行吗？

messages.en: Sometimes a mission might not turn out the way you anticipated. You might have incomplete information from your agent, and conditions can change during the mission. Such changes are generally communicated to you directly, either through a direct pop-up window when using an acceleration gate or by means of a text message appearing in your local chat channel.
messages.zh: 有时候一个任务并不会像你预期的那样发展。你可能从你的代理人那里得到了不完整的信息，并且环境也会随着任务的进行而发生变化。这些变化通常直接影响到你，不是通过当你使用加速轨道的时候弹出的一个窗口，便是通过出现在你本地聊天频道的一条文本信息。

messages.en: Things Change
messages.zh: 事态变化

messages.en:
Yeah, slow, right. It's only the Gallente. No big deal. They're just going to turn this whole place into a libertine drone-lover festival, that's all!!

Okay, think, think.

Alright, we know they're building a jump gate in this system, right? And we can't take on both the guards at that gate and the forces they presumably have building up elsewhere in this system. I'll call in the Navy ― they should be here in a matter of hours, I hope ― but we need to occupy these free-loving jerks in the meantime. We need some sort of a distraction....

Okay, here's what I need you to do. I have a few friends in the Intaki Syndicate who owe me for looking the other way during a few local business deals. I need you to hop over to their base and get their support. Do whatever you can. But be sure you're armed. You can never tell what's going on with the Syndicate.
messages.zh:
对，慢慢的，就这样。不就是盖伦特吗，没有什么大不了的。他们只是想把整个地方变成一个目无法纪的无人机爱好者的狂欢节，仅此而已！！

好了，想想，再想想。

好吧，我们知道他们正在这个星系建星门，是吧？我们不能同时对付守卫星门的守卫和他们预先建立在其他地区的部队。我会联络海军-他们几小时后就能赶到，我想-但是，这段时间里我们也不能让这些爱好自由的疯子们闲着。我们要分散他们的注意力……

好了，我需要你做几件事。我有几个朋友在印塔基联合财团，有几次在做本地生意时他们拒绝了我，因此欠我人情。我需要你跃至他们的基地请求支援。你要想尽一切办法，而且要保证你全副武装。与联合财团打交道，你永远不知道会发生什么。

messages.en:
Listen, the Intaki Syndicate is moving out, and so are we. The Navy has arrived to deal with this, finally, and called for a wholesale civilian evacuation, so it's all out of our hands now.

Thanks for nothing.
messages.zh:
听着，印塔基联合财团已经开始撤离了，我们也一样。海军终于前来处理此事了，他们要求全部平民撤离，所以现在情况完全在我们掌控之外。

感谢你的……无所作为。

messages.en: Withdrawal
messages.zh: 撤退

messages.en: This is getting too hairy for me. I'm out.
messages.zh: 这对我来说太棘手了，我不干。

messages.en: I don't think you know quite how hairy things are going to get around here. Fine, alright. Get lost, then.
messages.zh: 你可能不知道这里的情况会变得多棘手。行，好了。那就滚蛋吧。

messages.en: Took your sweet time, huh? Okay, whatever, I know how it is. Anyway, chatter's coming through that the Intaki Syndicate is moving out. In fact, it sounds like someone pushed them out. If it was the Gallente, our job just got harder. Come and see me right away.
messages.zh: 一点儿也不着急嘛，嗯？好了，管他呢，我知道是怎么回事。言归正传，我接到消息，说印塔基联合财团开始撤离了。实际上，似乎是有人逼他们撤离的。如果是盖伦特人干的，我们的任务就更艰难了。马上来见我。

messages.en: Syndicate help now impossible
messages.zh: 联合财团协助成泡影

name.de: Übermäßige Aufmerksamkeit - Das Tor schließen (3 von 3)
name.en: Undue Attention - Closing the Gate (3 of 3)
name.es: Atención indebida: Cerrar el portal (3 de 3)
name.fr: Une attention excessive - Fermeture de la porte (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 過度の注目―ゲートの閉鎖（3/3）
name.ru: Незаслуженное внимание – закрытие врат (Undue Attention - Closing the Gate) (3 из 3)

messages.en: The Gallente are in for a nasty surprise. I am going to destroy their precious gate, and their ships along with it.
messages.zh: 我会给盖伦特人一个可怕的惊喜。我要摧毁他们宝贵的跳跃门，还有他们的飞船。

messages.en: That's the spirit. Show those self-righteous Gallente the price of trying to occupy Caldari space.
messages.zh: 要的就是这种精神。让这些自大的盖伦特人看看，试图侵占加达里空间会是什么下场。

messages.en: End this? It would take a small fleet to handle these Gallente!
messages.zh: 做个了结？得要一支小舰队才能对付这些盖伦特人！

messages.en:
Fly to the Gallente jump gate and destroy it. I won't lie to you: The gate is almost certainly more heavily fortified than it was before. The gate itself will probably take a crapload of damage before it's disabled. However, there should be fewer enemy pilots to deal with this time, since they'll all be tied up in the larger battle. Once the jump gate is down, not only will the main Gallente force be without reinforcements, but they won't have a clean exit, and they should flee or surrender.

We've picked up some local chatter from the Gallente saying that only frigate-class ships can get to that jump gate.
messages.zh:
飞去盖伦特的跳跃门并摧毁它。我不想骗你：几乎可以肯定，这座门比之前更加坚固了，很可能要对它大肆狂轰滥炸一番才能使它失灵。不过，由于大部分敌人飞行员都被牵制在主战场，所以那附近要对付的敌人比较少。一旦跳跃门瘫痪，盖伦特主力部队不仅无法得到增援，而且也不能全身而退，他们只能要么逃窜，要么投降。

我们截获了一些盖伦特人的本地通讯信息，据说，只有护卫舰级的飞船能够到达那座跳跃门。

messages.en: Jump gate destroyed. The Gallente are cut off ― and still stupid to boot.
messages.zh: 跳跃门被摧毁了。盖伦特人被切断了后路，他们还在愚蠢地试图启动跳跃门呢。

messages.en:
Terrific news, {[character]player.name}, terrific news. Reports are coming in from the battle. The Gallente are being routed. Their entire formation is broken. And even better, we've captured their command ship. That's going to be one hell of a bargaining chip for us here at {[location]agentStationID.name}.

I have to admit, I was not sure we were going to make it through that alive. Of course, the politicians are probably going to cover all of this up; this sort of event could trigger all out war. But we know what happened, and we know we kept the State safe. And you were instrumental in this victory: You have our deepest thanks, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
好消息，{[character]player.name}，好消息。有消息从战场上传来，盖伦特快被消灭了。他们的整个组织已经瓦解。还有，我们已经捕获他们的指挥舰。这将是一个极好的跟 {[location]agentStationID.name}讨价还价的筹码。

我不得不承认，我不能肯定我们能那么顺利的走到那一步。当然，政客们可能会掩盖所有行动;因为这类活动可能引发战争。但是我们知道发生了什么事，而且我们知道，我们保正了国家的安全。而且你在这场胜利中很重要：我们非常感谢你，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: This is too big for me. I can't do this. Sorry, but I'm out.
messages.zh: 这任务对我来说太重大了。我无法完成。抱歉，我退出。

messages.en:
You know, the universe is big. It can be dangerous. But sometimes things need to get done, even if you'd rather just be lying back with a nice cold rum and Quafe.

I only hope we can pull this off. And you― you can leave. Coward.
messages.zh:
要知道，宇宙很大。宇宙可以很危险。不过有时候，即使你只是很想靠在椅子上，喝一杯爽口的冰镇朗姆酒和酷菲，但有些事情必须完成。

我只是希望，我们能实现这个目标。你——你可以走了。懦夫。

messages.en: Sometimes agent missions will require you to destroy large structures such as space stations, wrecks, bunkers, or even jump gates. In general, structures can take a serious beating. In fact, some are altogether impervious ― but luckily, this jump gate isn't one of them. Get to it.
messages.zh: 有时候，代理人任务会要求你摧毁一些大型建筑，比如空间站、残骸、碉堡，甚至是跳跃门。一般说来，建筑可以承受巨大的打击。事实上，有些建筑是丝毫不会受损的——不过幸运的是，这座跳跃门不属于此类。飞去那座跳跃门吧。

messages.en: Damaging Structures
messages.zh: 损坏建筑

messages.en:
Yeah, it would. That's what we're using. Between my few ships and my friends in the Intaki Syndicate, we have enough to occupy what's over here now until the Navy gets here. The problem is that damned jump gate you found.

I can see you sweating already. Calm down. I know you aren't ready for a major fleet op, not yet. And I want to use that to our advantage. We're staging our battle on the other side of the system ― close enough for the Gallente to take the bait, but far enough that that gate will be beyond their sensor range, especially against a frigate-class ship the size of the one you'll need to be flying.

Fly to the Gallente jump gate and destroy it. I won't lie to you: The gate is almost certainly more heavily fortified than it was before. The gate itself will probably take a crapload of damage before it's disabled. However, there should be fewer enemy pilots to deal with this time, since they'll all be tied up in the larger battle. Once the jump gate is down, not only will the main Gallente force be without reinforcements, but they won't have a clean exit, and they should flee or surrender.
messages.zh:
是啊，它会的。这也是我们正在使用的。有我在印塔基联合财团的数艘舰艇和我的朋友们，我们有足够的火力对付他们直到海军赶到这里。问题是你发现的那个该死的跳跃门。

我可看到你出汗了。冷静点。我知道你还没做好准备指挥一个舰队。我想这对我们有利。我们正在星系的另一边发动战争-近的足以让盖伦特上钩，远的也足以让他们的无法探测跳跃门，这对象你这样需要开护卫舰级战船的飞行员是很有利的。

飞去盖伦特跳跃门，然后摧毁它。我不打算对你撒谎：几乎可以肯定，这座门比之前更加坚固了。很可能要对这座门大肆狂轰滥炸一番才能使它失灵。不过，由于大部分敌人飞行员都被牵制在大战区，所以这次跳跃门处的对敌机会较少。一旦跳跃门瘫痪，盖伦特主力部队不仅无法得到增援，而且也不能全身而退，他们只能要么逃窜，要么投降。

messages.en: The battle's over. The Gallente are pulling out. They know that we know where their gate is, and they seem content with having destroyed a good chunk of our forces in this system. They left their gate on a self destruct. It's going to be almost impossible to prove the Gallente were even here. All we have as proof is our dead.
messages.zh: 战争结束了。盖伦特人正在撤离。他们知道我们掌握了其跳跃门的位置，但由于摧毁了我们在本星系的大批军队，他们感到心满意足。他们将跳跃门设为自毁模式。我们甚至将无法证明盖伦特人来过这。我们唯一的证据就是我们的死亡。

messages.en: It's all over – you can come out of hiding now
messages.zh: 都结束了，你可以从桌子底下爬上来了。

messages.en: Hope for a miracle, because I can't take that gate out.
messages.zh: 祈祷奇迹发生吧，因为我无法摧毁那座跳跃门。

messages.en: Damn you! We've risked so much on this operation. The Gallente are pulling out, yeah, but they're mostly escaping with no losses… using the gate you didn't take out. I don't think anyone is going to be calling this a sound victory by any means.
messages.zh: 你这该死的！我们对这次行动下了这么大的赌注。是啊，盖伦特人在撤退，但他们是几乎毫无损失地全身而退……使用的就是你未能破坏的跳跃门。我想，无论从哪个方面讲，谁都不会把这称为一次彻底胜利。

messages.en: The battle's over. The Gallente are pulling out. They know that we know where their gate is, and they seem content with having destroyed a good chunk of our forces in this system. They left their gate on a self destruct. It's going to be almost impossible to prove the Gallente were even here. All we have as proof is our dead.
messages.zh: 战争结束了。盖伦特人正在撤离。他们知道我们掌握了其跳跃门的位置，但由于摧毁了我们在本星系的大批军队，他们感到心满意足。他们将跳跃门设为自毁模式。我们甚至将无法证明盖伦特人来过这。我们唯一的证据就是我们的死亡。

messages.en: It's all over – you can come out of hiding now
messages.zh: 都结束了，你可以从桌子底下爬上来了。

name.de: Übermäßige Aufmerksamkeit - Was Spacelane Patrol weiß (2 von 3)
name.en: Undue Attention - What Spacelane Patrol Knows (2 of 3)
name.es: Atención indebida: Lo que sabe la Patrulla Espacial (2 de 3)
name.fr: Une attention excessive - Ce que sait la Spacelane Patrol (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 過度の注目―スペースレーンパトロールの知恵（2/3）
name.ru: Ненадлежащее внимание - что известно Spacelane Patrol (Undue Attention - What Spacelane Patrol Knows) (2 из 3)
name.zh: 过分关注—空间航线巡管局的发现（2/3）

messages.en: This sounds more to my liking. Sure, I'll do it.
messages.zh: 这听起来更合我的口味。当然，交给我吧。

messages.en: Try to be quick about it. The faster we get things settled around here, the better.
messages.zh: 动作快些。我们越快把这里的事情平定越好。

messages.en: Well, what do you suggest?
messages.zh: 唔，你有什么提议？

messages.en: Our good friends over at CBD have been picking up some strange chatter for the past few days. According to them it has some bearing on what's going on in our system. Go get the intelligence report from the Spacelane Patrol station I've added to your bookmarks, and bring it back here.
messages.zh: 最近几天来，我们在CBD的好朋友不断收到一些奇怪的信息。据他们说，这和我们星系目前的状况有一定关系。去空间航线巡管局空间站，取得情报报告并带回这里。我已经把空间站的位标提供给你了。

messages.en: Got your intel here.
messages.zh: 我把你的情报带来了。

messages.en:
Good work. Let's take a look, here…

Wha―?! Damn! Damn… damn, damn… This isn't good, {[character]player.name}. I'm gonna need your help again.
messages.zh:
干得好。让我来看一看……

什么？！可恶！该死……该死……情况不妙，{[character]player.name}。我又得借助你的帮助了。

messages.en: No, I think I'll pass on this one too.
messages.zh: 不了，这项任务我也不干。

messages.en: Just so we're clear, you probably shouldn't pass on every mission. Oh, well, your loss.
messages.zh: 不过有一点要说明，你最好别每个任务都放弃。唉，算了，这是你的损失。

messages.en: At first glance, courier missions may seem a waste of a capsuleer's valuable time. After all, a standard crewed (i.e., non-capsule-controlled) ship could ferry material just as well. The difference is in the security capsuleers bring to a shipment versus standard ship crews. As well, a capsule ship requires a far smaller crew, meaning fewer potential leaks regarding shipping schedules, routes, and cargoes. Further, the capsuleers themselves are more reliable and easier to work with than most other ship command structures, making them a favorite for agents throughout the EVE universe.
messages.zh: 乍一看，快递任务似乎会浪费飞行员的宝贵时间。毕竟，配备标准船员的飞船（也就是不由太空舱控制的飞船）也能运输货物。而两者的不同之处在于，飞行员比标准船员更能确保货物的安全。另外，太空舱飞船需要的船员数量要少得多，这就意味着运输计划、路线和货物这些信息不容易泄露。还有，比起大多数其他飞船指挥机构，飞行员更可靠而且更容易共事，所以他们是遍布新伊甸的代理人的最爱。

messages.en: Capsuleers and Courier Missions
messages.zh: 飞行员和快递任务

messages.en:
Our good friends over at CBD have been picking up some strange local chatter for the past few days. According to them, this chatter has some bearing on what's going on in our system. But I still had to buy the intel from their Spacelane Patrol... I didn't have quite enough favors built up get them to deliver it, and it apparently isn't the sort of thing you just transmit across open space.

Anyway, go get the intelligence report from Spacelane Patrol and bring it back here, would you?
messages.zh:
最近几天来，我们在CBD的好朋友不断收到一些奇怪的本地信息。据他们说，这些信息和我们星系目前的状况有一定关系。但我得从空间航线巡管局那里把这些情报买下来……我跟他们的交情还没好到可以让他们自己把东西送来，而且这显然不是那种可以随便在开放空间运送的东西。

好了，言归正传，请你去空间航线巡管局，取得情报报告并带回这里，可以吗？

messages.en: CBD has taken down their intel offer. Somehow they got the impression we weren't that serious about it. If you had acted a bit faster, we'd have it by now.
messages.zh: CBD取消了他们的情报提案。他们隐约感到，我们对这些情报不是那么热心。要是你动作快一点，这些情报现在已经在我们手上了。

messages.en: Intel gone
messages.zh: 失去情报

messages.en: I've decided I don't want to play space taxi. Thanks, but no thanks.
messages.zh: 我决定不再当太空出租车了。谢谢。我不干，不过还是谢了。

messages.en: Listen, I know I said some stuff before about quitting missions, but it still makes folks uneasy. I mean, it's not a huge deal, but don't make a habit of it.
messages.zh: 听着，我知道我以前因为你放弃任务而说了些难听的话，不过这种行为确实让人感到不安。我的意思是，虽然这并不是什么天大的事情，不过千万别养成习惯。

messages.en: CBD has taken down their intel offer. Somehow they got the impression we weren't that serious about it. If you had acted a bit faster, we'd have it by now.
messages.zh: CBD取消了他们的情报提案。他们隐约感到，我们对这些情报不是那么热心。要是你动作快一点，这些情报现在已经在我们手上了。

messages.en: Intel gone
messages.zh: 失去情报

messages.en: The battle's over. The Gallente are pulling out. They know that we know where their gate is, and they seem content with having destroyed a good chunk of our forces in this system. They left their gate on a self destruct. It's going to be almost impossible to prove the Gallente were even here. All we have as proof is our dead.
messages.zh: 战争结束了。盖伦特人正在撤离。他们知道我们掌握了其跳跃门的位置，但由于摧毁了我们在本星系的大批军队，他们感到心满意足。他们将跳跃门设为自毁模式。我们甚至将无法证明盖伦特人来过这。我们唯一的证据就是我们的死亡。

messages.en: It's all over – you can come out of hiding now
messages.zh: 都结束了，你可以从桌子底下爬上来了。

messages.en: Hope for a miracle, because I can't take that gate out.
messages.zh: 祈祷奇迹发生吧，因为我无法摧毁那座跳跃门。

messages.en: Damn you! We've risked so much on this operation. The Gallente are pulling out, yeah, but they're mostly escaping with no losses… using the gate you didn't take out. I don't think anyone is going to be calling this a sound victory by any means.
messages.zh: 你这该死的！我们对这次行动下了这么大的赌注。是啊，盖伦特人在撤退，但他们是几乎毫无损失地全身而退……使用的就是你未能破坏的跳跃门。我想，无论从哪个方面讲，谁都不会把这称为一次彻底胜利。

messages.en: The battle's over. The Gallente are pulling out. They know that we know where their gate is, and they seem content with having destroyed a good chunk of our forces in this system. They left their gate on a self destruct. It's going to be almost impossible to prove the Gallente were even here. All we have as proof is our dead.
messages.zh: 战争结束了。盖伦特人正在撤离。他们知道我们掌握了其跳跃门的位置，但由于摧毁了我们在本星系的大批军队，他们感到心满意足。他们将跳跃门设为自毁模式。我们甚至将无法证明盖伦特人来过这。我们唯一的证据就是我们的死亡。

messages.en: It's all over – you can come out of hiding now
messages.zh: 都结束了，你可以从桌子底下爬上来了。

messages.en: I will do all I can.
messages.zh: 我会竭尽全力。

messages.en: That is the most any of us can do, no? It's always good to find someone else with a well-developed moral sense. Do be careful.
messages.zh: 我们中最杰出者所能做到的也不过如此，不是吗？还能找到具有这样强烈道德感的人，真是件美事。一定要当心。

messages.en: Got any work for a capsuleer, Your Eminence?
messages.zh: 有什么工作可以给我这个飞行员吗，大人？

messages.en: I've been hearing about a rogue drone hive nearby. The Theology Council has been searching for more information on the issue of these… "awakened" drones. Such a matter has a certain interest to those who are given to the study of doctrinal matters. Will you do me the courtesy of investigating the situation and, if possible, bringing one of these strange creatures' AI cores back for study?
messages.zh: 我不断听说有关这附近一座自由无人机机巢的传闻。神学理事会一直在搜寻有关这些……“觉醒的”无人机的更多信息。这类事件对那些负责研究教义问题的人来说有一定兴趣。你能否帮我个忙，去调查一下情况，如果可能的话，再带回一个这种古怪生物的AI核心以供研究？

messages.en: I found an AI core, but I'm not sure if it will do you any good.
messages.zh: 我找到一个AI核心，但不知道这对你有没有用。

messages.en: That is for the Council to decide, of course. Go with God, child, and know that your assistance is appreciated.
messages.zh: 当然，那得由理事会来决定。神与你同在，孩子。感谢你的帮忙。

messages.en: I don't think I'm up to that right now.
messages.zh: 我觉得现在还没能力接受这个任务。

messages.en: I will keep you in my prayers.
messages.zh: 你会出现在我的祈祷词中。

messages.en: I've been hearing about a rogue drone hive nearby. The Theology Council has been searching for more information on the issue of these… "awakened" drones. Such a matter has a certain interest to those who are given to the study of doctrinal matters. Will you do me the courtesy of investigating the situation and, if possible, bringing one of these strange creatures' AI cores back for study?
messages.zh: 我不断听说有关这附近一座自由无人机机巢的传闻。神学理事会一直在搜寻有关这些……“觉醒的”无人机的更多信息。这类事件对那些负责研究教义问题的人来说有一定兴趣。你能否帮我个忙，去调查一下情况，如果可能的话，再带回一个这种古怪生物的AI核心以供研究？

messages.en: Next time you are called upon, assuming you are called upon, perhaps you will act with appropriate haste.
messages.zh: 下次你再接到号令的时候，假设你真的接到号令的话，也许你会懂得快速采取行动。

messages.en: Rogue drones are too weird for me. I'm done.
messages.zh: 自由无人机对我来说太怪异了。我受够了。

messages.en: I will pray for you.
messages.zh: 我会为你祈祷的。

messages.en: Next time you are called upon, assuming you are called upon, perhaps you will act with appropriate haste.
messages.zh: 下次你再接到号令的时候，假设你真的接到号令的话，也许你会懂得快速采取行动。

messages.en: I can do that.
messages.zh: 我能够胜任。

messages.en: Glad to hear it.
messages.zh: 很高兴听你这样说。

messages.en: Got any work?
messages.zh: 有什么工作吗？

messages.en: I've been hearing about an abandoned drone hive nearby. We have yet to find any viable explanation for its presence. I need someone to go investigate and make sure there aren't any rogue drones still hanging around: We need to be certain this is not a threat.
messages.zh: 我不断听说有关这附近一座废弃的无人机机巢的传闻。对于它的存在，我们尚未找到一个合理的解释。我需要有人去调查一下，并确认那附近是否还有自由无人机在活动。我们要确定，该机巢不会造成威胁。

messages.en: I destroyed all the drones in the area. Should be no further threats from that quarter, at least.
messages.zh: 我把那个区域里的无人机都摧毁了。至少不会再有来自那边的威胁了。

messages.en: That's the Caldari spirit, all right. Well done.
messages.zh: 毫无疑问，这才是加达里精神。干得好！

messages.en: You'd better send someone else.
messages.zh: 你最好另请高明。

messages.en: I've been hearing about an abandoned drone hive nearby. We have yet to find any viable explanation for its presence. I need someone to go investigate and make sure there aren't any rogue drones still hanging around: We need to be certain this is not a threat.
messages.zh: 我不断听说有关这附近一座废弃的无人机机巢的传闻。对于它的存在，我们尚未找到一个合理的解释。我需要有人去调查一下，并确认那附近是否还有自由无人机在活动。我们要确定，该机巢不会造成威胁。

messages.en: Or maybe something. That structure's been dismantled, picked clean. Try to act a little faster next time, huh?
messages.zh: 或者有可能是某些东西干的。那座建筑已经被拆除分解，清除得干干净净。下一次动作快一点，知道吗？

messages.en: Someone beat us to it
messages.zh: 有人抢在我们前面了。

messages.en: Sorry, I'm just not up for this.
messages.zh: 对不起，我没有能力完成这个任务。

messages.en: That's a damn shame. I'll have to send out someone who can handle it.
messages.zh: 太遗憾了。我得另派一个有能力的人去处理此事。

messages.en: Or maybe something. That structure's been dismantled, picked clean. Try to act a little faster next time, huh?
messages.zh: 或者有可能是某些东西干的。那座建筑已经被拆除分解，清除得干干净净。下一次动作快一点，知道吗？

messages.en: Someone beat us to it
messages.zh: 有人抢在我们前面了。

messages.en: Yeah, I'm up for it.
messages.zh: 好，我愿意效劳。

messages.en: "Up for it." How quaint. You do seem quite the pedestrian. Still, not all covers belie the contents. And it's always good to find someone else with a healthy sense of intellectual curiosity, whatever their manners.
messages.zh: “愿意效劳。”真是古怪的说法。你看起来的确有些呆板。不过，不能以貌取人。而且能找到一个具有学术好奇心的人，总是件好事，不论他的行为举止如何。

messages.en: Yeah, there is. You got any work?
messages.zh: 是的，确实有要你帮忙的事。你有活给我吗？

messages.en:
I've been hearing about an abandoned drone hive nearby. These creatures are undeniably strange, and at this point, any information we can get about them is a boon. Trust me, the university will be happy to have the chance to examine anything you can find, once they know there's no threat of active drones out there.

I need someone to go peruse the area, if you take my meaning? Confirm that it is the "real deal," as it were, and make sure there are no rogue drones still in the vicinity. Does this task seem agreeable to you?
messages.zh:
我不断听说有关这附近一座废弃的无人机机巢的传闻。不可否认，这些生物非常古怪；在现阶段，能获得关于它们的任何信息对我们都有帮助。相信我，全宇宙的人会对你在那里发现的任何东西都会产生研究兴趣，前提是他们要确认那里没有活动无人机的威胁。

我需要有人去仔细调查一下那个区域，你懂我意思吗？去核实那里是否还保持原来的“真实面貌”，而且确认周围是否还有无人机。这个任务合你的胃口吗？

messages.en: I found drones out there, but it's all clear now. Send those egg-heads on in there!
messages.zh: 我在那发现了无人机，现在已经全被干掉了。派那些书呆子过去吧！

messages.en: Well, that is good news. I'll put the grad students to work on it; maybe we'll be able to come up with a way to use this location for further study.
messages.zh: 哦，这是好消息啊。我会派研究生去进行接下来的工作。说不定我们能想办法将这个地点用于今后的研究。

messages.en: Nah, I don't think I'm up to that right now.
messages.zh: 不啦，我觉得现在还没能力接受这个任务。

messages.en: I see. Well, I cannot say I'm surprised. One look ought to have told me to send you packing.
messages.zh: 我明白了。好吧，我说不上有多惊讶。 我只看一眼，就知道早该让你收拾东西走人了。

messages.en:
Well, perhaps… Yes. Yes, I've been hearing about an abandoned drone hive nearby. These creatures are undeniably strange, and at this point, any information we can get about them is a boon. Trust me, the university will be happy to have the chance to examine anything you can find, once they know there's no threat of active drones out there.

I need someone to go peruse the area, if you take my meaning? Confirm that it is the "real deal," as it were, and make sure there are no rogue drones still in the vicinity. Does this task seem agreeable to you?
messages.zh:
嗯，大概……有的。是的，我不断听说有关这附近一座废弃的无人机机巢的传闻。不可否认，这些生物非常古怪；在现阶段，能获得关于它们的任何信息对我们都有帮助。相信我，全宇宙的人会对你在那里发现的任何东西都会产生研究兴趣，前提是他们要确认那里没有活动无人机的威胁。

我需要有人去仔细调查一下那个区域，你懂我意思吗？去核实那里是否还保持原来的“真实面貌”，而且确认周围是否还有无人机。这个任务合你的胃口吗？

messages.en: Or perhaps something. That structure has been dismantled in its entirety. Do try to act a little more quickly next time, won't you?
messages.zh: 或者有可能是某些东西干的。那座建筑已经被彻底拆除分解。下次动作一定要快一点，知道吗？

messages.en: Someone beat us to it
messages.zh: 有人抢在我们前面了。

messages.en: This shit's too weird for me. I'm out.
messages.zh: 这个烂任务对我来说太怪了。我退出。

messages.en: That's truly a shame. I knew I needed a first-rate capsuleer for this one, not just some riff-raff pilot.
messages.zh: 真是太遗憾了。我就知道该找个一流的飞行员来办这事，而不是那些半桶水的家伙。

messages.en: Or perhaps something. That structure has been dismantled in its entirety. Do try to act a little more quickly next time, won't you?
messages.zh: 或者有可能是某些东西干的。那座建筑已经被彻底拆除分解。下次动作一定要快一点，知道吗？

messages.en: Someone beat us to it
messages.zh: 有人抢在我们前面了。

messages.en: Sure.
messages.zh: 好。

messages.en: It's always nice to find a like-minded indy-vidual. Careful out there, huh?
messages.zh: 能找到一个志趣相投的人，真不错。到那要当心，好吗？

messages.en: Got any work?
messages.zh: 有什么工作吗？

messages.en: I' been hearin' 'bout this abandoned drone hive nearby. These things are weird, right, but they're also huge ― and really advanced, techonologicalically, you know ― and I'm always on the lookout fer spare parts. I need someone to go check it out, see, confirm it's abandoned; make sure there aren't any rogue drones still hangin' around. See if there's anything useful there ya can bring back fer me.
messages.zh: 我不断听说有关这附近一座废弃的无人机机巢的传闻。这些东西很怪，对吧，不过它们也很大——而且非常先进，你知道，从技术角度上是这样——我正好还在一直搜集备件。我需要有人去查看一下，也就是说核实那里是否废弃了；还有确认那附近是否还有自由无人机在活动。去看看那里是否有什么你可以带回来给我的有用东西。

messages.en: I found some stuff, but I don't know if it will do you any good.
messages.zh: 我找到一些东西，但不知道这对你有没有用。

messages.en: I'll get this sent down to the shop right away, see what my boys can put together.
messages.zh: 我马上派人把它送到车间，看看我的人能拼出什么东西来。

messages.en: Not interested.
messages.zh: 不感兴趣。

messages.en: Oooh. Hoity-toity, eh? Well, fine, suit yerself then.
messages.zh: 哇。很自命不凡嘛，嗯？好吧，随你的便吧。

messages.en: I' been hearin' 'bout this abandoned drone hive nearby. These things are weird, right, but they're also huge ― and really advanced, techonologicalically, you know ― and I'm always on the lookout fer spare parts. I need someone to go check it out, see, confirm it's abandoned; make sure there aren't any rogue drones still hangin' around. See if there's anything useful there ya can bring back fer me.
messages.zh: 我不断听说有关这附近一座废弃的无人机机巢的传闻。这些东西很怪，对吧，不过它们也很大——而且非常先进，你知道，从技术角度上是这样——我正好还在一直搜集备件。我需要有人去查看一下，也就是说核实那里是否废弃了；还有确认那附近是否还有自由无人机在活动。去看看那里是否有什么你可以带回来给我的有用东西。

messages.en: I'm not in the mood to go junk-hunting. See you later.
messages.zh: 我现在没心情去捡破烂。回头见。

messages.en: That's a damn shame. I really coulda used those parts.
messages.zh: 太遗憾了。我本来可以把那些部件派上大用场的。

messages.en: I say… I'm on my way.
messages.zh: 我说……我这就出发。

messages.en: Ha. Good. Contact me as soon as you get there, alright?
messages.zh: 哈，很好。到达目的地之后立即联系我，好吗？

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]agentID.name}. What sort of work did you have in mind?
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]agentID.name}。你觉得会是什么样的工作？

messages.en:
I've got some confidential mining survey reports here I need hand-delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. I suspect that there are some fairly valuable mineral deposits nearby and they may need help mining them. Deliver this and I'll see to it that you're suitably rewarded... and put in a good word for you with the station manager. I've entered the station location into your Neocom.

The reports have been placed in your station hangar. Remember to put them in your cargohold before you set out!
messages.zh:
我手头有些机密的采矿调查报告，我需要一个人亲自把它们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。我认为这附近有些价值不菲的矿藏，是该有人把它们开采出来的时候了。把东西送过去，我保证你能得到应有的奖赏……还会在空间站管理人面前说你几句好话。我已经把空间站的位置输入你的控制边栏了。

报告已经放入你的空间站机库中。记得在出发前将它们放入货柜舱！

messages.en: The report has been delivered, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 报告已经送过去了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Thanks for the assist. Come back soon and we'll have more work for you.
messages.zh: 感谢你的帮助。记得快点回来，我们还有更多的工作给你。

messages.en:
I've got some confidential mining survey reports here. There has been a lot of Angel Cartel activity in this area recently, though, and I'm not going to take the risk of sending this over an open channel or even via common courier. I need it hand-delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Deliver this and I'll see to it that you're suitably rewarded... and put in a good word for you with the station manager.

What do you say?
messages.zh:
我手头有些机密的采矿调查报告。不过最近，天使企业联合体在这个区域活动频繁。我不想冒险通过公开渠道或者普通运输舰来发送这些文件。我需要一个人亲自把它们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。把东西送过去，我保证你能得到应有的奖赏……还会在空间站管理人面前说你几句好话。

你觉得怎么样？

name.ja: 後継者の寵愛する奴隷
name.ru: Любимая рабыня наследника (The Heir's Favorite Slave)

messages.en: Excellent. You had better move. We cannot afford to lose her.
messages.zh: 很好。你还是快动身吧。我们不能失去她。

messages.en: What would you have me do?
messages.zh: 你想让我做什么？

messages.en:
A slave named Jaliti has escaped from the house of the one of the five Heirs to the Imperial Throne. We don't know why or how, but she has commandeered a luxury transport and is still on the run. The Heir in question, who will of course remain anonymous, demands her return, for he greatly enjoys her beauty and company. She is also privy to a great number of personal secrets that could cause great embarrassment to the Heir, and perhaps even to the Imperial Council.

We intercepted a transmission indicating that she intends to meet a contact in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We don't know whom she will meet, but you must stop her and bring her back, any way you can. Alive if possible, but dead if necessary. I'm sure if you're successful, the rewards will be substantial. We are dealing with an Heir, after all.

The ship Jaliti commandeered is known to be well-armed. You might need a battle-ready frigate to bring her back.
messages.zh:
帝国五位太子中的一位丢了个劳工，那个劳工名叫珈妮蒂，刚从这位太子府上逃走。我们不知道原因，也不知道她是怎么办到的，但她抢占了一架豪华运输舰，目前还在逃亡中。刚刚所说的太子，当然，他的名号不便相告，要求她回到他身边，因为他非常喜欢她的美貌及她的陪伴。她知道这位太子的许多私人秘密，这可能会让他非常难堪，甚至会让帝国议会受窘。

我们截获了一条通讯，表明她打算在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系与一个联络人会面。我们不知道她要去见谁，但你必须采取一切手段阻止她并把她带回来。最好是活的，不过如果必要，死尸也无妨。我保证，只要你成功，报酬将非常可观。我们可是在给一位太子办事啊。

珈妮蒂霸占的那艘飞船的武装相当好。你可能需要一艘适合作战的护卫舰去把她带回来。

messages.en: I have the slave in custody and her Minmatar lover is floating ash.
messages.zh: 那个劳工就关在我手里，她的米玛塔尔爱人已经成了漂浮的灰尘。

messages.en: Splendid! In custody. Splendid! The Heir will be pleased.
messages.zh: 干得好！监禁起来了？太好了！太子会高兴的。

messages.en: I didn't think you were up to this challenge. Perhaps you should go do something less meaningful.
messages.zh: 我不认为你可以胜任这个挑战。也许你应该去干些不那么有意义的事。

messages.en: Most of the difficult labor in the Empire is performed by legions of uneducated slaves, who serve at the beck and call of those who are both clearly and naturally above their station. From conquered races to hereditary servants, Amarrian slaves are diverse and numerous, and they spend their entire lives working toward enlightenment under the guidance of their rightful masters.
messages.zh: 帝国中的大部分体力劳动都是由成群未受过教育的劳工完成的，他们受到那些地位明显高于他们的人的呼喝差遣。艾玛劳工种类多样、数量众多，从被征服的种族到世袭奴仆都有包括，他们尽其一生辛苦劳作，希望在他们合法主人的指引下，达到文明开化。

messages.en: Amarrian Society
messages.zh: 艾玛社会

messages.en:
I'm not entirely sure you're ready for an important task like this, but time is of the essence. This may well be the most important mission you have ever undertaken.

A slave named Jaliti has escaped from the house of the one of the five Heirs to the Imperial Throne. We don't know why or how, but she has commandeered a luxury transport and is still on the run. The Heir in question, who will of course remain anonymous, demands her return, for he greatly enjoys her beauty and company. She is also privy to a great number of personal secrets that could cause great embarrassment to the Heir, and perhaps even to the Imperial Council.

We intercepted a transmission indicating that she intends to meet a contact in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We don't know whom she will meet, but you must stop her and bring her back, any way you can. Alive if possible, but dead if necessary. I'm sure if you're successful, the rewards will be substantial. We are dealing with an Heir, after all.
messages.zh:
我还不确定你是否能够执行一项这么重要的任务，但现在时间宝贵。这可能是你迄今执行过的最重要任务。

帝国五位太子中的一位丢了个劳工，那个劳工名叫珈妮蒂，刚从这位太子府上逃走。我们不知道原因，也不知道她是怎么办到的，但她抢占了一架豪华运输舰，目前还在逃亡中。刚刚所说的太子，当然，他的名号不便相告，要求她回到他身边，因为他非常喜欢她的美貌及她的陪伴。她知道这位太子的许多私人秘密，这可能会让他非常难堪，甚至会让帝国议会受窘。

我们截获了一条通讯，表明她打算在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系与一个联络人会面。我们不知道她要去见谁，但你必须采取一切手段阻止她并把她带回来。最好是活的，不过如果必要，死尸也无妨。我保证，只要你成功，报酬将非常可观。我们可是在给一位太子办事啊。

messages.en: Alas, the window of opportunity through which you might have proven yourself has passed. Fortunately for the Empire, someone else stepped up to challenge instead of you. Your failure will not sit well with those in power, and certainly does not bode well for your future.
messages.zh: 唉，这个可以让你证明自己价值的机会流失了。不过帝国还是幸运的，有人挺身而出化解了这个危机。你的失利不会给当权者留下好印象，这对你的前途不是什么好兆头。

messages.en: Your lack of initiative
messages.zh: 你的惰性使然

messages.en: I think the slave is better off where she's going.
messages.zh: 我想这个劳工在她要去的地方会过得更好。

messages.en: You were not paid to think, fool! Your rashness will not sit well with those in power, and certainly does not bode well for your future.
messages.zh: 我们花钱雇你不是让你来思考的，傻瓜！你的轻率不会给当权者留下好印象，这对你的前途不是什么好兆头。

messages.en: Alas, Jalita has surely escaped by now and is lost to us forever. Your failure will not sit well with those in power, and certainly does not bode well for your future.
messages.zh: 唉，珈妮蒂现在肯定已经跑了，我们永远失去了她。你的失利不会给当权者留下好印象，这对你的前途不是什么好兆头。

messages.en: Your failure
messages.zh: 你失败了

name.es: Vector de Vitoc: La recogida (1 de 4)
name.ja: ビトックベクトル―回収（1/4）
name.ru: Вектор Vitoc - получение (Vitoc Vector - The Pickup) (1 из 4)

messages.en: I can handle it.
messages.zh: 我能搞定。

messages.en: Work fast. We're counting on you.
messages.zh: 动作快些。我们就指望你了。

messages.en: Oh, yeah? All good, I hope. So what's going on?
messages.zh: 噢，什么事？我希望一切太平。到底怎么了？

messages.en: Go pick up the Vitoc shipment in its warded container and bring it back to {[location]agentStationID.name}.
messages.zh: 去将保险集装箱中的崴砣柯货物取出来，再把它带回到{[location]agentStationID.name}。

messages.en: I've got the Vitoc.
messages.zh: 我拿到崴砣柯了。

messages.en: So my source was right about you. Nice. Listen, I should have more work for you soon. I've arranged for a Civilian Relic Analyzer to be placed in your hangar in station; come and see me once you have it fitted on your ship.
messages.zh: 看来我的情报人员没看错你。很好。听着，我很快会有更多的活儿要你干。我已派人把一台民用遗迹分析仪放到你的空间站机库里了，你把它装配到你的船上后就来见我。

messages.en: I'm gonna have to pass.
messages.zh: 我还是免了吧。

messages.en: I understand. Please excuse me; I've no time to waste.
messages.zh: 我明白。请原谅，我可没时间浪费。

messages.en: The Vitoc Method is fundamental to the Amarr slave market. The Method has two key components: a deadly, highly toxic drug with a seemingly viral ability to mutate, and its carefully-guarded antidote: Vitoc. The subject infected with the chemically engineered virus will suffer an agonizing death without regular doses of Vitoc; his daily dose, however, will react with the toxin to bring him several hours of euphoria in addition to keeping the virus inert for a short time.
messages.zh: 崴砣柯方法对于艾玛劳工市场至关重要。该方法由两样关键部分组成：一种具有类似病毒的变异能力的致命剧毒药物，和受到严密保护的解毒剂：崴砣柯。一旦感染这些经过化学加工的病毒，患者如果不定期使用崴砣柯，就会被剧烈的疼痛折磨至死。然而，如果患者每天服用崴砣柯，该药物会与毒素发生反应，除了能短时间抑制病毒活性之外，还能使患者连续几小时处于欣快状态。

messages.en: The Vitoc Method
messages.zh: 崴砣柯方法

messages.en:
Well, some good, some… Heh. Just kidding. No, folks are saying good things about you.

Anyway, listen, I have a lead on a Vitoc shipment not far from here. I've arranged a buy, but I need someone to make the pick-up under the radar. We've arranged for special packaging that will keep the authorities from being able to scan the stuff in your hold, since the stuff is normally highly illegal around here, so you don't need to worry about that.

{[character]player.name}, this could provide the breakthrough our researchers need. Can I trust you to handle it?
messages.zh:
嗯，有好的，也有……呃。我是开玩笑的。实际上，大家都说你的好话呢。

言归正传，听着，我收到线索，说附近有一批崴砣柯货物。我已经安排了一次购买交易，但我需要一个人去悄悄把货物取回来。我让他们使用了一种特殊的包装，好让当局没办法扫描到你的东西，因为那东西在这里可是非法的，这样你就不必担心了。

{[character]player.name}，这东西能为我们的研究人员提供一个重大突破口。我能把这个任务委托给你吗？

messages.en: I have to find someone who can get this done before our contact sells that Vitoc to someone else. Don't contact me again unless you have the time to do the job.
messages.zh: 我要找个能将这件事情办妥的人，一定要赶在我们的联系人把那批崴砣柯转手之前。除非你有时间把这件事办好，否则不要再联系我了。

messages.en: Time's up
messages.zh: 时间到了

messages.en: I'm not dealing with drug-runners. I quit.
messages.zh: 我不和非法贩售者打交道。我退出。

messages.en: I'm sorry I entrusted you with something so sensitive.
messages.zh: 我委托你去办这么敏感的事，真抱歉。

messages.en: Someone bought the Vitoc out from under us. When you're working with smugglers, you work fast, and you don't take anything for granted.
messages.zh: 有人抢在我们之前把崴砣柯买光了。和非法贩售者打交道，动作一定要快，任何事情都不能想当然。

messages.en: Back to square one
messages.zh: 重回原点

name.en: Vitoc Vector - Earning Their Trust (2 of 4)
name.es: Vector de Vitoc: Ganar su confianza (2 de 4)
name.fr: Vecteur de Vitoc - Gagner leur confiance (2 sur 4)
name.ja: ビトックベクトル―信頼の獲得（2/4）
name.ru: Вектор Vitoc – завоевание доверия (Vitoc Vector - Earning Their Trust) (2 из 4)
name.zh: 崴砣柯带菌者—赢取信任（2/4）

messages.en: I'm willing to help.
messages.zh: 我愿意帮忙。

messages.en: Your loyalty is in the right place.
messages.zh: 你的忠诚确实名副其实。

messages.en: I can. And I'm glad you feel that way.
messages.zh: 我当然可以。很高兴你能这样想。

messages.en:
Hack the wrecked Amarrian science vessel's computers and bring whatever you find back to your agent. Be sure to have some weaponry fitted as well: There's a good chance some pirates have already caught wind of this wrecked vessel as well.

Make sure you fit out the Civilian Relic Analyzer that your agent gave you before you leave the station. You may have to run it for a few cycles before you find anything on the wrecked ship.
messages.zh:
破译艾玛科学舰船残骸中的计算机，把你获得的任何结果带回给代理人。另外，务必装配一些武器：有些海盗很可能已经听到关于这艘舰只残骸的风声。

记得在离开空间站前装上代理人给你的民用遗迹分析仪。你可能需要让它运行几个周期，才能从舰船残骸中发现一些东西。

messages.en: I have the information you asked for.
messages.zh: 我拿到你需要的信息了。

messages.en: So my source was right about you. I'll pass your name along. Come back and talk to me again in a while, will you?
messages.zh: 看来我的情报人员没看错你。我也会多在别人面前夸奖你的。不久再来找我谈谈，好吗？

messages.en: This is all a little too dull for me. I'm more of a straightforward, shoot-em-up kind of capsuleer. Good luck finding someone else.
messages.zh: 我觉得这有点太无聊了。我喜欢直来直往的任务。去找别人吧，祝你好运。

messages.en: I see. Don't come back until you're ready to prove yourself worthy of my trust.
messages.zh: 我明白了。等你能够证明自己值得我信任时，再来找我。

messages.en:
Well, I've got a job you can do to prove it. We're always looking for information. After the last job you ran, I think I can trust you with something a little more sensitive.

I just got a tip that there's a wrecked Amarrian science vessel nearby that is likely to contain something useful; apparently it was here on some kind of "goodwill incentive program" devised by some clown in CONCORD, but the ship was jumped by Brutor Tribe radicals before it landed in station. Heh. Stupid CONCORD, and pathetic Amarrians ― no doubt they were using this program to scout for slave-ship raids anyway.

Point is, though, that I need you to get in there and hack it; take whatever data you can from it before the pirates rip the whole thing to pieces for salvage. This is more important to us than you can understand right now. Matari lives may well be at stake here.
messages.zh:
我这里正好有个可以让你证明自己的工作。我们一直在搜寻相关信息，鉴于你取得的最新进展，我认为我们的合作可以进一步深入。

我们接到线报，附近一艘损坏的艾玛科研船只上可能存在一些有用的信息，统合部的某些人策划了所谓的“友好互助活动”并把这艘船派遣到这里，不幸半路遭到了布鲁特部落种族分子的袭击。哎，愚蠢的统合部，可怜的艾玛人，毫无疑问他们把这个活动当作幌子意图袭击劳工运输船。

言归正传，我需要你潜入那里破解他的计算机，在海盗彻底摧毁船只并打捞完毕前带出任何你得到的数据。这关系到玛塔利部落的存亡，对我们来说相当重要。

messages.en: The pirates beat you to it. There's nothing left of that science vessel.
messages.zh: 海盗抢在你之前得手了。那座科学舰船里什么也没剩下。

messages.en: Guess I can't be trusted after all. I quit.
messages.zh: 也许到头来我还是不值得信任。我退出。

messages.en: My source was wrong about you.
messages.zh: 看来我的情报人员对你的评价有误。

messages.en: The pirates beat you to it. There's nothing left of that science vessel.
messages.zh: 海盗抢在你之前得手了。那座科学舰船里什么也没剩下。

name.en: Vitoc Vector - Mounting a Defense (3 of 4)
name.es: Vector de Vitoc: Defensa a ultranza (3 de 4)
name.fr: Vecteur de Vitoc - Organiser une défense (3 sur 4)
name.ja: ビトックベクトル―防衛の開始（3/4）
name.ru: Вектор Vitoc – укрепление обороны (Vitoc Vector - Mounting a Defense) (3 из 4)
name.zh: 崴砣柯带菌者—设置防御（3/4）

messages.en: I'm on my way.
messages.zh: 我马上出发。

messages.en: You will do what you must.
messages.zh: 你就去做该做之事吧。

messages.en: What is it?
messages.zh: 帮什么忙？

messages.en:
One of our research stations has been compromised, and we believe that the Amarr and their allies, the traitorous, mongrel Nefantar, will attempt to destroy it. We need you to get in there and defend the station, for I can't be sure I can mobilize local military forces in time.

The Amarrians will go to any lengths to prevent us from reverse-engineering a treatment that could invalidate the Vitoc Method. If we can make it costly enough for them, though, they may just be forced to give up on this station, with it being so deep in our sovereignty.
messages.zh:
我们一座研究空间站受到了威胁，我们认为艾玛人和他们的同盟——叛变的内凡达混蛋，企图摧毁这座空间站。我们需要你前去那里并保卫该空间站，因为我不能确定是否能及时调动本地军队。

艾玛人会采取一切手段阻止我们通过逆向工程，研究出一种可以使崴砣柯方法失效的治疗手法。如果我们能使他们为此付出一定代价，也许他们就会被迫放弃这座位于我们领空腹地的空间站。

messages.en: The station is safe, and the Ammatar have learned a painful lesson.
messages.zh: 空间站安全了，艾玛达人得到了惨痛的教训。

messages.en: Though this battle was small, it is still a great victory. And already it bears unexpected fruit. Return to me when you are ready to take on a great labor.
messages.zh: 虽然这场战役规模不大，但仍然是一次伟大的胜利。而且这已经带来了意外收获。如果你准备好接受一项艰巨任务了，就再回来找我。

messages.en: I don't think I can do that.
messages.zh: 我觉得我不能胜任。

messages.en: I hope, for your sake, that you do not come to regret this choice.
messages.zh: 为了你的利益着想，我希望你不会为这一选择而后悔。

messages.en:
The Nefantar go by many names, but Ammatar is the most common ― though their former Minmatar brethren sometimes refer to them as “the Lost Tribe” in pity, but more often “the Fawning” or “the Yoked” in scorn. The Nefantar have left behind their tribal heritage and taken up many (but not all) aspects of the Amarrian religion, a movement that has resulted in a unique blend of cultures.

The Ammatar Mandate and the Minmatar Republic have been locked in a state of cold war for years now; since the Vindication Wars, there hasn't been a large-scale battle between them, mainly due to former Prime Minister Karin Midular's diplomatic efforts. However, after Midular's passing, the animosity between the two peoples cannot be denied.

The old, traditionally aristocratic bloodlines of the Nefantar see themselves as the rightful rulers of all the Matar tribes; for their part, most Minmatar hold little more than bitter animosity toward the tribe that long ago betrayed its cousins, and a widespread hatred of the Ammatar is still common among all other Matari.
messages.zh:
内凡达人有许多称呼，但艾玛达是最常用的——不过他们之前的同胞米玛塔尔人有时怜悯地称他们为“失落的部族”，但更多时候蔑称他们为“谄媚族”或“披枷者”。内凡达人遗弃了自己的部族传统，接受了艾玛宗教的许多(但非全部)方面，这一运动导致了一种独特的文化融合。

艾玛达特统区和米玛塔尔共和国数年来处于冷战的胶着状态；自从辩护战争以来，双方并未发生过大规模的战役，这主要归功于前首相卡琳·米杜拉在外交层面的努力。不过，自米杜拉卸任后，双方人民之间的敌意是毋庸置疑的了。

拥有古老贵族血统的内凡达人视自己为所有玛塔尔部族的合法统治者；但米玛塔尔人对这群在早年背叛了其伙伴的人除了憎恶以外几乎找不到一丁点其他感情，此外在其他玛塔利部落中也广泛存在着对艾玛达人的仇视。

messages.en: The Nefantar
messages.zh: 内凡达人

messages.en:
One of our research stations ― the very one where I sent the information from that science vessel you hacked for us ― has been compromised, and we believe that the Amarr and their allies, the traitorous, mongrel Nefantar, will attempt to destroy it. As you know, we Minmatar have many small research stations scattered throughout space to better avoid Amarr detection, but as a result, our resources are necessarily splintered.

The loss of this research station would be a tremendous setback to us. We need you to get in there and defend the station, for I can't be sure I can mobilize local military forces in time. The Amarrians will go to any lengths to prevent us from reverse-engineering a treatment that could invalidate the Vitoc Method. If we can make it costly enough for them, though, they may just be forced to give up on this station, with it being so deep in our sovereignty.
messages.zh:
我们将你上次得到的信息发送去了我们的一个研究站，很不幸现在它被盯上了。有证据表明艾玛人和他们的同盟——叛变的内凡达混蛋，企图摧毁这座空间站。正如你所知我们为了更好地摆脱来自艾玛的侦查，在宇宙各地建造了这种小型研究站。也正因为这样，我们手头的资源很分散。

如果研究站被摧毁了，这对于我们的工作来说是一个巨大的倒退。我们需要你前去那里并保卫该空间站，因为我不能确定是否能及时调动本地军队。艾玛人会采取一切手段阻止我们通过逆向工程，研究出一种可以使崴砣柯方法失效的治疗手法。如果我们能使他们为此付出一定代价，也许他们就会被迫放弃这座位于我们领空腹地的空间站。

messages.en: We are sending someone who understands the importance of speed. Stand down.
messages.zh: 我们已另派一个重视速度的人去办这件事。你可以下岗了。

messages.en: Don't bother…
messages.zh: 别费心了……

messages.en: I can't fight a war by myself! I'm outta here.
messages.zh: 我一个人不可能打赢一场战争！我闪了。

messages.en: We will not take this betrayal lightly.
messages.zh: 对于这种背叛行为，我们不会轻易原谅。

messages.en: The station has been destroyed by Nafantar raiders. The Matari lives lost are on your head.
messages.zh: 空间站被内凡达侵袭者摧毁了。你要为那些玛塔利人的死亡负责。

messages.en: Your shame will be legendary
messages.zh: 你的耻辱将成为传奇

name.en: Vitoc Vector - A Terrible Thing (4 of 4)
name.es: Vector de Vitoc: Algo terrible (4 de 4)
name.ja: ビトックベクトル―恐ろしいこと（4/4）
name.ru: Вектор Vitoc – ужасная вещь (Vitoc Vector - A Terrible Thing) (4 из 4)
name.zh: 崴砣柯带菌者—可怕的事件（4/4）

messages.en: I understand. I'll do what you ask of me.
messages.zh: 我明白。我会按你说的做。

messages.en: Steel yourself, and do what must be done.
messages.zh: 坚定你的决心，完成该做之事吧。

messages.en: What's happened?
messages.zh: 发生了什么？

messages.en: Destroy the Amarr Breeding Facility, kill any enemy ships there, and return any enslaved Matari you find to {[location]agentStationID.name}.
messages.zh: 摧毁艾玛繁殖设施，干掉所有敌军舰船，将所有被奴役的玛塔利人带到{[location]agentStationID.name}。

messages.en: I've brought back as many as I could.
messages.zh: 我已经尽可能多地把他们带回来了。

messages.en: You have done our people a great service. No reward can be enough, though our means are limited ― still, go with our gratitude.
messages.zh: 你为我们的人民做了一件大好事。没有任何东西足以报答你的恩德，虽然我们钱不多，但这是我们的一片心意。

messages.en: I can't condemn innocent victims to death, even in the face of such an atrocity.
messages.zh: 我不能用死亡来惩罚这些无辜的受害者，即使他们遭受着如此大的暴行。

messages.en: Well, not everyone is capable of such a thing. But a capsuleer is supposed to be made of sterner stuff.
messages.zh: 好吧，不是谁都有能力做这件事。但是飞行员的心态应该更坚强。

messages.en:
This type of breeding facility produces Minmatar children ready to assume their place as servants to the Amarr; rumors abound that the slaves in these places hail from other races as well, including even fallen Amarr who are sent here rather than to penal colonies.

Brood slaves are held within breeder colonies for the sole purpose of increasing a slaver's stock. Discarded when they have outlived their usefulness, these poor souls have a terribly short life expectancy, although that fact might be a blessing when one considers the misery of their existence.

Slavers who use such methods tend to be secretive about it, often anchoring their breeding centers in low-sec or unclaimed space; however profitable, these facilities are generally looked down upon even in polite Amarrian society (especially since the Doriam reforms).
messages.zh:
通过这种繁殖设施培养的米玛塔尔儿童，他们生来就以成为艾玛人的奴仆为目标；而且据风传，这些地方的劳工也有来自其他种族的人，甚至包括一些没落的艾玛人，他们没有被送往监禁地，而是被送到这里。

劳工们多年来被圈养在此，唯一的目的是增加其劳工主拥有的劳工总数。这些可怜的人一旦不再拥有使用价值就将被抛弃，因此他们的生命极其短暂，不过想想他们悲惨的一生，这也算是一种解脱。

拥有这种设施的劳工主通常对此三缄其口，将他们的繁殖中心设在低安全等级甚至无主的废弃之所；无论这些设施多么有利可图，但即使在艾玛文明社会中，它们也是受人鄙视的（尤其是多利安姆改革后）。

messages.en: Amarr Breeding Facilities – Even Death Is Better
messages.zh: 艾玛繁殖设施—生不如死

messages.en:
We have tracked down an Amarr "breeding facility." {[character]player.name}, I was held in one of these places once, when I was young, and it is only thanks to the efforts of one such as yourself that I find myself a free person today. They're hellholes.

You will find only women and children there; the boys are shipped elsewhere before they turn nine. Most of these facilities don't even bother with Vitoc; they prefer cheaper, more primitive methods of control. After all, the work is hardly complicated: Where humane restraints don't work, brute force and fear often will.

Destroy this place. Rescue as many Matari as you can, but be certain that even those who die are better off.
messages.zh:
我们搜索到了一处艾玛的繁殖设施，{[character]player.name}，我小时候一度被带去那里，但在众多与你类似的英雄之士的不懈努力下我又恢复了自由之身。那里简直就是地狱。

你在那里只能找到女人和幼儿，男孩们在九岁以前就被人用船偷运到其他地方了。这种繁殖设施大部分都几乎不使用崴砣柯，他们偏爱更廉价，更直接的途径来取得控制。一言以蔽之，这里没有人性化的约束，暴力与恐惧大行其道。br>
去摧毁这个地方，尽可能多地解救里面的玛塔利人。

messages.en: I pray there is still time to rescue those unfortunates. Clearly, that rescue will fall to someone else.
messages.zh: 我希望还有时间来拯救那些不幸的人。显然，这次拯救行动将由别的人完成。

messages.en: You are released from your obligation
messages.zh: 你的义务已经解除

messages.en: I'm not doing this. I'm done here.
messages.zh: 这件事我不干。我受够了。

messages.en: I hope that you are haunted for the rest of your days by the angry spirits of those you refuse to save.
messages.zh: 你拒绝拯救那些人，我希望他们那愤怒的鬼魂永远萦绕在你的身边，让你终日不得安宁。

messages.en: The Amarr have swift counter-intelligence. They have moved their operations, and we don't know where.
messages.zh: 艾玛人的反情报工作非常迅速。他们已经转移了行动地点，至于转到哪里，我们不知道。

messages.en: They're gone
messages.zh: 他们都不在了

messages.en: Doesn't sound too exciting, but I'll do it.
messages.zh: 听起来不够刺激，但我愿意干。

messages.en: Well, get to work then! We'll see you on your return.
messages.zh: 好，那就开工吧！等你完成任务后再见！

messages.en: You bet. What is it?
messages.zh: 这还用说。这是什么？

messages.en: Scouts we hired from Minmatar Mining found that there are some significant amounts of Augumene nearby. That's not normally a very valuable substance, but we're using a fabrication process here that utilizes Augumene as a catalyst, so we'll take all we can get. We need 400 units.
messages.zh: 我们从米玛塔尔矿业联合体雇佣的侦察机在附近发现了大量奥古米内石。那通常不是什么值钱的物质，不过我们这里的制造流程需要奥古米内石作为催化剂，所以我们要尽量获取这种物质。我们需要400个单位。

messages.en: Here's the Augumene you requested, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 这是你要的奥古米内石，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: That's a great help to us, friend. Come back and see me, okay?
messages.zh: 你帮了我们一个大忙，朋友。以后再来找我，好吗？

messages.en:
When mining for specific minerals, use the Overview to help. Click the small white arrow beside the word “Overview”; from there, select “Load default,” and then “Mining.” Then, you can right-click any type of asteroid in your overview and select “Remove from Overview”; keep doing this until only the type you want is left in your overview.

Now, if you plan to mine this type of ore regularly, you can click the Overview arrow again and select “Save current type selection as…” and put in whatever name seems appropriate. Now you can return to this setting anytime you want to simply by using the Overview arrow to select “Load [type].”
messages.zh:
当开采特殊种类的矿物时，“总览”可以为你提供帮助。点击“总览”旁边的白色小箭头；选择“装载默认设置”，然后选择“采矿”。然后，你可以在总览中右键点击任何种类的小行星并选择“从总览中去除”；不断重复此操作，直到总览中只剩下你希望保留的小行星种类。

如果你打算经常开采这种矿石，你可以再次点击“总览”旁的箭头，选择“当前类型选择另存为…”，然后再输入一个合适的名称。现在，只要你使用“总览”箭头并选择“加载 [类型]”就可以随时返回该设置。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en: Well, as we had projected in that report you delivered for me, scouts we hired from the Minmatar Mining Corp found that there are some significant amounts of Augumene nearby. That's not normally a very valuable substance, but we're using a fabrication process here that utilizes Augumene as a catalyst, so we'll take all we can get. We need 400 units. You good for it?
messages.zh: 我们在你给我带来的那份报告中发现，我们从米玛塔尔矿业联合体雇佣的侦察机在附近发现了大量奥古米内石。那通常不是什么值钱的物质，不过我们这里的制造流程需要奥古米内石作为催化剂，所以我们要尽量获取这种物质。我们需要400个单位。你没问题吧？

messages.en: I'll do it!
messages.zh: 交给我吧！

messages.en: See you when you get back!
messages.zh: 我在这里静候佳音！

messages.en: Sounds good to me. What do you need?
messages.zh: 听上去不错。你需要什么？

messages.en: Our production here is going into high gear and we're experiencing shortages of just about everything. We expect everyone to pitch in. I need you to obtain 750 units of Tritanium and deliver them here. You've been reliable so far: care to help out again? You'll get fair compensation for your efforts, plus our gratitude… which isn't worthless, I assure you.
messages.zh: 我们这里正在高速生产，几乎所有东西都短缺了。我们希望每个人都尽一份力。我需要你去弄750单位三钛合金并送到这来。到目前为止，你一直很可靠：愿意再帮次忙吗？你的努力会换来合理的回报，还有我们奖励……我保证，这绝不是毫无价值的。

messages.en: The Tritanium is here.
messages.zh: 三钛合金来了。

messages.en: Thanks a million, {[character]player.name}. We'll be needing some help on another matter, so come back soon.
messages.zh: 太感谢了，{[character]player.name}。我们还需要你在另一件事情上提供帮助，所以记得不久再过来。
