messages.en: First, you'll need to locate Veldspar, Scordite, or other ores that produce Tritanium. Next, mine the ore and transport your cargo back to the station. Open your cargo hold and right-click on the ore, then select "To Hangar and Reprocess." In the next window, you'll see how much Tritanium you'll receive. Once you've reprocessed enough, return with it to your agent to complete the mission.
messages.zh: 首先，你需要找到凡晶石、灼烧岩或其他能够产出三钛合金的矿石。接下来，采集这些矿石并将其运回空间站。打开货柜舱并右击矿石，然后选择“到机库并提炼”。在接下来的窗口中，你会看到你提炼出了多少三钛合金。等你提炼了足够的三钛合金后，带着它们返回至代理人处，完成任务。

messages.en: Helpful Hint
messages.zh: 友情提示

messages.en: Our production here is going into high gear and we're experiencing shortages of just about everything. We expect everyone to pitch in. I need you to obtain 750 units of Tritanium and deliver them here. You've been reliable so far: care to help out again? You'll get fair compensation for your efforts, plus our gratitude… which isn't worthless, I assure you.
messages.zh: 我们这里正在高速生产，几乎所有东西都短缺了。我们希望每个人都尽一份力。我需要你去弄750单位三钛合金并送到这来。到目前为止，你一直很可靠：愿意再帮次忙吗？你的努力会换来合理的回报，还有我们奖励……我保证，这绝不是毫无价值的。

messages.en: I won't leave one pirate vessel intact.
messages.zh: 我不会落下一艘海盗船。

messages.en: Good hunting, my friend.
messages.zh: 祝你成功，朋友。

messages.en: What do you need?
messages.zh: 你需要什么？

messages.en:
It seems that our activity in this system has attracted unwanted attention. Mercenaries and pirates of a variety of allegiances have been preying on our unarmed miners and transports. This can't go on! The industrial production of this sector is vital to our military effort.

Hunt these bastards down. I've uploaded their current location to your NeoCom.
messages.zh:
似乎我们在这个星系的活动引起了不怀好意者的兴趣。各种势力的雇佣兵和海盗不断袭击我们毫无武装的矿工和运输舰。事情不能再这样下去了！这个区域里的工业生产对我们的军事计划至关重要。

去追击这些混蛋。我已将他们的当前位置上传到你的控制边栏里。

messages.en: The raiders have been defeated.
messages.zh: 侵袭者已被打败。

messages.en: I knew we could count on you, {[character]player.name}. We're planning to finish those raiders off once and for all, so stick around, huh?
messages.zh: 我就知道可以指望你，{[character]player.name}。我们打算把那些侵袭者一举歼灭。所以别走远了。

messages.en: If you take too much damage in battle, be sure to warp out to a nearby station for repairs; also be sure to replenish your ammunition if you're running low. Pirates can be pretty tough, so you'll need to be on your toes to deal with them.
messages.zh: 如果你的飞船在战斗中严重受损，一定要跃迁到附近的空间站去维修。同时，如果弹药数量不足，就立即补充弹药。有些海盗很难对付，所以一定要保持警觉。

messages.en: Battle Tips
messages.zh: 战术秘诀

messages.en:
It seems that our activity in this system has attracted unwanted attention. Mercenaries and pirates of a variety of allegiances have been preying on our unarmed miners and transports. This can't go on! The industrial production of this sector is vital to our military effort.

Are you willing to hunt these bastards down? We have lots of pilots who are good mining operators, but only the rare few are also capsuleers capable of taking on pirates and raiders like you can. There's a generous reward in it if you're in, not to mention the bounties and loot on the enemies themselves.
messages.zh:
似乎我们在这个星系的活动引起了不怀好意者的兴趣。各种势力的雇佣兵和海盗不断袭击我们毫无武装的矿工和运输舰。事情不能再这样下去了！这个区域里的工业生产对我们的军事计划至关重要。

你愿意去追击那些混蛋吗？我们有很多熟悉采矿操作的飞行员，但能像你这样对付海盗和侵袭者的飞行员少之又少。如果你接受任务，我会给你丰厚的报酬，更不必说敌人留下的战利品和他们抢来的东西了。

messages.en: I'll head out there right away. They don't stand a chance.
messages.zh: 我会立刻出发前往那里。他们不可能成功。

messages.en: Good bye and good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 再见，祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Hey, {[character]agentID.name}. Alright, tell me about this idea of yours.
messages.zh: 嗨，{[character]agentID.name}。好吧，现在告诉我你的主意吧。

messages.en:
It looks as if there was some organization behind all the recent pirate activity. We've just learned that they maintain communications in adjacent systems via a communications tower network in this very system! We need someone to take out the pirates' tower array. That someone is you.

I'll enter the locations into your bookmarks. If you leave now, there's every chance you'll catch 'em napping. We'll offer a decent reward plus a bonus if you hit them fast.
messages.zh:
最近这些海盗活动似乎是某个组织在背后搞的鬼。我们刚得知，他们通过一张通信塔网络来维持在邻近星系内的通讯，而那个通信塔网络就在这个星系里！我们需要有人去铲除那座海盗通信塔阵列。那个人就是你。

我会将位置输入到你的位标里。如果你现在就去的话，很可能会在他们睡午觉的时候打他们个措手不及。我们会提供丰厚的报酬，而且如果你速战速决，还有额外奖励。

messages.en: Those tower arrays are history. Now, about that reward?
messages.zh: 那些塔楼阵列已经成为历史了。现在，我的报酬呢？

messages.en: Happily, I I consider it well spent. You've proven yourself admirably. This system is a safer place because of you.
messages.zh: 乐意奉上，我这笔钱花得值。你以令人惊叹的方式证明了自己的价值。因为你的功劳，这个星系的安全得到了提高。

messages.en:
It looks as if there was some organization behind all the recent pirate activity. You hurt them in that last mission, but they're still out there. We've just learned that they maintain communications in adjacent systems via a communications tower network in this very system! If one of their scouts is forced to flee, the others maintain contact with him via FTL communications made possible by this com network.

We need someone to take out the pirates' tower array. There's been a lot of subspace chatter over the past few days, and we have a pretty good idea that they're planning something big. We need to hit them hard before that happens, throw a wrench in their plans.

So, would you like to be the one who goes in there and finishes them off? I'll enter the locations into your bookmarks. If you leave now, there's every chance you'll catch 'em napping. We'll offer a decent reward plus a bonus if you hit them fast.
messages.zh:
最近这些海盗活动似乎是某个组织在背后搞的鬼。你在上一个任务中重创了他们，但是他们并没有被消灭。我们刚得知，他们通过一张通信塔网络来维持在邻近星系内的通讯，而那个通信塔网络就在这个星系里！如果他们中任何一个间谍强行逃出，其他通过这个系统的联系将变得可能。

我们需要有人去铲除那座海盗通信塔阵列。过去的几天之内一直有喋喋不休的通讯传播在附近的子空间内，我们知道他们正在计划一个大的行动。我们需要在他们行动之前铲除他们，破坏他们的计划。

所以，你愿意接受这个任务吗？我会将位置输入到你的位标里。如果你现在就去的话，很可能会在他们睡午觉的时候打他们个措手不及。我们会提供丰厚的报酬，而且如果你速战速决，还有额外奖励。

name.ja: 新たなる奴隷たち-洗脳（1/5）
name.ru: Новые рабы - индоктринация (New Slaves - Indoctrination) (1 из 5)

messages.en: I shall leave at once.
messages.zh: 我马上就出发。

messages.en: That is precisely what I wanted to hear.
messages.zh: 这正合我意。

messages.en: Thank you. The Empire deserves no less of us.
messages.zh: 谢谢。帝国的利益永远高于我们。

messages.en: I have a fresh shipment of slaves here that need to be vaccinated, prepped, and properly indoctrinated. Please take them to our facility at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh: 我这里有一批新来的劳工，他们需要接种疫苗，进行体检，还要接受适当的教化。请把他们带到我们位于{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的设施。

messages.en: Slaves delivered. Anything else?
messages.zh: 劳工已经送过去了。有别的什么事情么？

messages.en: Well done, {[character]player.name}! But there is indeed something else: You won't believe what has happened! Give me just a moment to finish reading this report and then come speak to me again.
messages.zh: 干得不错，{[character]player.name}！实际上，还有一件事：说出来绝对让你大吃一惊！给我一点时间，等我把报告看完，你再来找我谈吧。

messages.en: That is unfortunate. I'm sure I can find someone else for this lucrative opportunity.
messages.zh: 真是太遗憾了。我肯定能找到其他人来完成这桩赚钱的买卖。

messages.en: When you reach your destination system, right-click in open space, and you will find a submenu for this mission. One of the options there is to dock at the desired station: This menu makes it easy for you to go straight there without having to search through the overview list for the destination station.
messages.zh: 到达目标星系后，在开放空间中点击右键，你会看到该任务的子菜单。其中一个选项是在目标空间站停靠：通过这个菜单，你可以直接到达目的地，而不必在总览列表中寻找目标空间站。

messages.en: Helpful Hint
messages.zh: 友情提示

messages.en:
Well said, well said.

{[character]player.name}, I have a fresh shipment of slaves here that need to be vaccinated, prepped, and properly indoctrinated. Please take them to our facility at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Let us not make their keepers wait.
messages.zh:
说得好，说得好。

{[character]player.name}，我这里有一批新来的劳工，他们需要接种疫苗，进行体检，还要接受适当的教化。请把他们带到我们在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的设施。我们可不能让他们的主人等久了。

messages.en: I found someone else to take care of this. No need to bother. I should add that your lack of spirit disturbs me…
messages.zh: 我已经找别人来处理这件事了。不用你费心了。我还要说一句，你的惰性让我不安……

messages.en: Slave transport
messages.zh: 劳工运输舰

messages.en: You cannot complete a simple mission like this? Hm. That does not bode well for your future in the Empire.
messages.zh: 你连这么个简单任务都没法完成？嗯。这对你在帝国的前途不是什么好兆头。

messages.en: I found someone else to take care of this. No need to bother. I should add that your lack of spirit disturbs me…
messages.zh: 我已经找别人来处理这件事了。不用你费心了。我还要说一句，你的惰性让我不安……

messages.en: Slave transport
messages.zh: 劳工运输舰

name.ru: Новые рабы – мятеж (New Slaves - Insurgency) (2 из 5)

messages.en: I'll bring them back.
messages.zh: 我会把他们带回来的。

messages.en: Good hunting.
messages.zh: 去好好享受追击吧。

messages.en: More trouble than they're worth, slaves. Alright, what can I do?
messages.zh: 劳工带来的麻烦大于他们的价值。好吧，我能做什么？

messages.en: A woman named Zira started an uprising among those new slaves almost the moment they arrived at the indoctrination facility. It was a bloody affair, and several guards and innocent citizens were killed or wounded. You are to hunt down Zira, terminate her with extreme prejudice as a lesson to them all, and recapture the other escaped slaves.
messages.zh: 那批新劳工几乎刚一到达教化设施，一个名叫紫拉的女人就在他们中间发动了一场叛乱。那真是一次血腥事件，好几个守卫和无辜平民被害死或打伤。你要去追击紫拉，毫不留情地结果她，让其他所有人都记住这个教训，还要把其他逃跑的劳工都抓回来。

messages.en: Slaves in custody. Zira is dead.
messages.zh: 劳工已经被监禁。紫拉已死。

messages.en: Nice work. These escapees will be severely punished. Now, don't go far; I'm sure I can find something else for you.
messages.zh: 干得不错。这些逃跑者将受到严厉惩罚。好吧，别走远了；我肯定还能给你找些事做。

messages.en: Let them go. They're not worth the trouble.
messages.zh: 让他们走。不值得为他们费那么大劲。

messages.en:
Who's paid you to think?! Your job is to do!! Ach!

I hope I can find someone else to handle this on such short notice.
messages.zh:
谁花钱雇你来思考了？！你的工作是做事！！哦!

时间这么紧促，我真希望能找到别人来处理这事。"

messages.en: You can usually find the items your agent requires by sifting through the wreckage of destroyed ships or structures, or by looking inside floating cargo containers.
messages.zh: 通过遍查被毁舰船或建筑的残骸，或查看漂浮货柜集装箱的内部，你通常能找到代理人所要求的物品。

messages.en: Helpful Hint
messages.zh: 友情提示

messages.en:
Oh, they have their uses, I assure you. Just rule them with an iron hand, my friend.

Anyway, it seems a woman named Zira started an uprising among those new slaves almost the moment they arrived at the indoctrination facility. It was a bloody affair, and several guards and innocent citizens were killed or wounded. This insubordination cannot be tolerated. You are to hunt down Zira, terminate her with extreme prejudice as a lesson to them all, and recapture the other escaped slaves.

Don't waste any time. We've tracked them to a deadspace location, but they may be planning to jump out of the system even as we speak. I've uploaded their location to your NeoCom.
messages.zh:
哦，我向你保证，他们自有用处。我的朋友，只需要用铁腕政策统治他们。

总之，看起来像有一个叫紫拉的女人，她在那些新劳工刚到达教化所时就发起这项抗争。这是一起血腥事件， 一些警卫和无辜的市民在这起事件中丧生或受伤。 这样的反抗是不能容忍的。你们要去穷追直至抓获紫拉，把她干掉以示众人，并且把其他逃跑的劳工抓回来。

别浪费时间，我们已经跟踪他们到一个死亡空间地带，但是，正巧在我们说话的时候，他们可能正在策划跳出这个系统。我已经把他们的位置上传到你们的控制边栏上。

messages.en: You allowed those filthy, disease-ridden slaves to escape. Now they will carry their pestilence to the rest of the galaxy!
messages.zh: 你竟然让那些肮脏、浑身是病的劳工跑了。现在他们要把身上的瘟疫传播到宇宙的其他地方了！

messages.en: Escaped slaves
messages.zh: 劳工逃跑

messages.en: On second thought, I think we should just let these slaves go. They're just not worth the trouble.
messages.zh: 我仔细思考了一下，我认为我们该让这些劳工走。不值得为他们费那么大劲。

messages.en: What, scared away by the thought of facing a few miserable sub-humans? This does not look good on you. Not good at all.
messages.zh: 什么，要面对几个卑劣的低等人种把你吓怕了吗？这让你的形象很不好看。非常不好看。

messages.en: You allowed those filthy, disease-ridden slaves to escape. Now they will carry their pestilence to the rest of the galaxy!
messages.zh: 你竟然让那些肮脏、浑身是病的劳工跑了。现在他们要把身上的瘟疫传播到宇宙的其他地方了！

messages.en: Escaped slaves
messages.zh: 劳工逃跑

name.de: Neue Sklaven - Eine neue Rebellion (3 von 5)
name.en: New Slaves - A New Rebellion (3 of 5)
name.es: Nuevos esclavos: Una nueva rebelión (3 de 5)
name.fr: Nouveaux esclaves - Une nouvelle rébellion (3 sur 5)
name.ja: 新たなる奴隷たち-新たなる反乱勢力（3/5）
name.ru: Новые рабы – новое восстание (New Slaves - A New Rebellion) (3 из 5)

messages.en: I'll get this over there right away.
messages.zh: 我马上把它送过去。

messages.en: Oh? What might that be?
messages.zh: 噢？那会是什么呢？

messages.en:
Zira Cobalus, the slave leader you dispatched for us, might have been a Minmatar agent sent into our slave population to foment rebellion among the masses. This is intolerable. However, we must verify that she was indeed a spy, and our databanks here are inadequate to this task.

Take this data chip for examination at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Intelligence personnel there will compare our data with theirs, and hopefully we will get a match.
messages.zh:
紫拉·可巴拉斯，就是你除掉的那个劳工首领，可能是被安插到我们劳工群体中的米玛塔尔特工，她打算在劳工中煽动叛乱。这是不能容忍的。不过，我们必须核实她是否真的是一名间谍，但我们这里的数据库对这一任务无能为力。

将这枚数据芯片送去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}以供检查。情报人员会将我们的数据与他们的进行比较，但愿他们会得到一个匹配的结果。

messages.en: Package delivered.
messages.zh: 包裹已递送。

messages.en: It didn't take them long. We were right about this Zira Cobalus. Return immediately so we can discuss the next step.
messages.zh: 他们很快就找到了结果。我们对这个紫拉·可巴拉斯的怀疑是正确的。马上回来，我们好商量下一步的对策。

messages.en: Oh, I've had enough of this business, I think. Not interested. Sorry.
messages.zh: 噢，我想我已经受够了这些勾当了。很抱歉，不感兴趣。

messages.en: That is unfortunate. I'm sure I can find someone else whose loyalty is not so plainly in question. Keep one eye over your shoulder, my friend.
messages.zh: 真是太遗憾了。你的忠心令人怀疑，我肯定能找到一个更忠心耿耿的人。以后当心点，朋友。

messages.en:
You can make multiple consecutive jumps through stargates much more quickly manually than you can relying on Autopilot (because the Autopilot brings your ship out of warp 15 km from the stargate each time you warp, forcing you to then fly at sub-warp speed to within 2,500 m of the gate before jumping).

First, set your destination by right-clicking on the location in the mission details or in your bookmarks. The correct stargate icon will now be highlighted in yellow, both in your overview and in space.

Now, right-click on the stargate (either in space or in the overview) and use the "Warp to within 0 km" option… and then turn on Autopilot; you will drop out of warp directly beside the stargate and, because Autopilot is on, jump immediately. As soon as you begin to jump, turn your Autopilot back off; once you've jumped, simply repeat the whole "Warp to 0 km" process with each stargate along the route until you arrive at your destination system.
messages.zh:
使用手动方式在星门之间连续多次跳跃，比使用自动导航要快得多（因为每次跃迁时，自动导航会将舰船跃迁到距离星门15公里外的地方，这样就不得不在跳跃前以非跃迁速度飞到距离星门2500米的地方）。

首先，右击任务详情或位标中的位置，设定目的地。此时无论从太空看还是从总览看，星门图标都应该以黄色突出显示。

现在，右击星门（无论在太空中还是在总览中）并选择“跃迁至0公里内”选项，然后开启自动导航；你将直接在星门旁停止跃迁，同时由于自动导航开启，你会立刻跳跃。开始跳跃后就关闭自动导航；沿途遇到每座星门，都要在跳跃后重复操作“跃迁至0公里内”的整个流程，直至抵达目标星系。

messages.en: Helpful Hint
messages.zh: 友情提示

messages.en:
Zira, the slave leader you dispatched for us, might have been a Minmatar agent sent into our slave population to foment rebellion among the masses. This is intolerable. However, we must verify that she was indeed a spy, and our databanks here are inadequate to this task.

Take this data chip for examination at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Intelligence personnel there will compare our data with theirs, and hopefully we will get a match.
messages.zh:
紫拉，就是你除掉的那个劳工首领，可能是被安插到我们劳工群体中的米玛塔尔特工，她打算在劳工中煽动叛乱。这是不能容忍的。不过，我们必须核实她是否真的是一名间谍，但我们这里的数据库对这一任务无能为力。

将这枚数据芯片送去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}以供检查。情报人员会将我们的数据与他们的进行比较，但愿他们会得到一个匹配的结果。

messages.en: I think I'm going to pack it in after all. I'm tired of being your errand-runner.
messages.zh: 我想我最终还是要放弃了。我已经厌烦替你跑腿了。

messages.en: You cannot complete a simple mission like this? Oh, dear. Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear. This does not bode well for your future in the Empire.
messages.zh: 你连这么个简单任务都没法完成？噢，天啊。天啊，天啊，我的天啊。这对你在帝国的前途不是什么好兆头。

messages.en: You waited too long. Someone erased all the data we had on this "Zira." Now we will never know the truth.
messages.zh: 你耽搁得太久了。有人把我们所有关于“紫拉”的数据都删除了。我们将永远无法知道真相。

messages.en: Loyalty in question
messages.zh: 忠心遭到怀疑

name.fr: Nouveaux esclaves - Deux fois plus de problèmes (4 sur 5)
name.ja: 新たな奴隷-二重のトラブル（4/5）
name.ru: Новые рабы – двойные хлопоты (New Slaves - Double Trouble) (4 из 5)

messages.en: Sounds more like my kind of work. Sure, I'm in.
messages.zh: 听起来这个任务更对我胃口。当然，我接受。

messages.en: Good luck, and good hunting.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，好好享受追击吧。

messages.en: That's frustrating. Is there some way I can help?
messages.zh: 这真令人郁闷。我可以帮上什么忙吗？

messages.en:
We did intercept an encrypted transmission from Zira's contact. (We sent a recovery team to pick up Zira's remains, and we discovered that she had a cybernetic transceiver implanted in her brain.) Her contact identified himself only as "Helter."

We don't know who he is, but we think, from examinations of his speech patterns, that he is Amarrian. The coordinates of the rendezvous were included in the transmission, and I've uploaded them into your data bank. Go out there and see who we're dealing with. But be careful.
messages.zh:
我们截获了一条紫拉的联络人发出的加密通讯。（我们派了一支回收小组去拾取紫拉的残骸，我们发现她的大脑中植入了一枚脑控调制器。）她的联络人自称为“赫尔特”。

我们不知道他是谁，但通过对他遣词造句的分析，我们认为他是个艾玛人。他们汇合点的坐标就包含在那条传输讯息里，我已经把它上传至你的数据库。出发吧，去看看我们的对手是谁。不过要小心。

messages.en: The contact is an Amarrian, and his name is Garmasi Jowai. He is definitely working with the Minmatar.
messages.zh: 那名联络人是个艾玛人，名字叫佳玛斯•侨韦。他绝对是在给米玛塔尔人干活。

messages.en: Excellent! So, a double agent working with the Minmatar... No surprise, really. Those mindless sub-humans will do anything to stick a thorn in the side of the Empire, and true loyalty is at a premium these days. Now, we do have a chance to finish this before it goes any further: Come see me as soon as you can.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！这么说，他是一名为米玛塔尔效力的双重间谍……我一点也不惊奇，真的。为了让帝国不得安宁，那些愚蠢的低等人种什么事都干得出来，而且这年头，只要出大价钱就能买到忠心。好吧，在情况进一步恶化前，我们还有机会结束这一切：如果可能，尽快再来见我。

messages.en: This sounds too dangerous to me. I don't want to be a spy; just give me some pirates to fight or something.
messages.zh: 这听起来太危险了。我不想当间谍；就给我些海盗打打，或者别的什么工作。

messages.en: I was afraid this was too much for you. From now on, we'll have to keep you busy hauling garbage or something.
messages.zh: 我本来就担心这任务对你来说太难了。从现在起，我们会让你去忙拖运垃圾之类的工作。

messages.en: If your ship is badly damaged and in danger of destruction, you should consider warping away from an encounter. You can repair your ship at most stations, for a cost dependent upon the amount of damage, or you can use Hull Repairers and Armor Repairers to fix the damage yourself while you are in space. But before you try to fit those items to your ship, you should make sure you have the correct skills.
messages.zh: 如果你的舰船严重受损并且有被毁的危险，你应该考虑从遭遇战中跃迁出来。在大多数空间站中，你都可以维修自己的舰船，维修费用取决于损坏程度，或者，你可以在太空中使用船体维修器及装甲维修器来修复损伤。但在将这些装备安装上你的舰船之前，你要确认你拥有适当的技能。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
I think you can, yes. Are you ready for another mission, a truly important one? Good.

We did intercept an encrypted transmission from Zira's contact. How could a naked slave with no possessions receive a transmission, you ask? We sent a recovery team to pick up Zira's remains, and we discovered that she had a cybernetic transceiver implanted in her brain. Not a simple cybernetic implant, but something bio-electrical, beyond our current technology, deep in her cerebral cortex.

Her contact identified himself only as "Helter." We don't know who he is, but we think, from examinations of his speech patterns, that he is Amarrian. The coordinates of the rendezvous were included in the transmission, and I've uploaded them into your data bank.

Go out there and see who we're dealing with. But be careful.
messages.zh:
我认为你行的，没错。你为另一个真得特别重要的任务做好准备了吗？好的。

我们确实曾经拦截过一个从紫拉联系人那里发出的加密传送信息。你会问，一个一无所有的劳工怎么可能接收加密信息?我们派遣了一个防御小组去捡拾紫拉的遗体，然后我们发现有一个无线电收发机插件在她的大脑里。这并不是一个简单的控制插件，而是一个生物电的插件。这种技术在我们的技术之上，并且深入她的大脑皮层。

她的联系人只确认自己是“赫尔特”。我们不知道他是谁，但是我们认为，从他的言谈上看，他是艾玛人。他们聚集处的信息也包含在这个传送之中，我已经把他们上传到你们的数据银行里。

去那里看看到底谁在处理这个事情，但是要小心一些。

messages.en: You waited too long. We have missed an opportunity to thwart the rendezvous and discover the identity of the Amarrian double agent. Your lack of initiative puts your loyalty in question, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你耽搁得太久了。我们错过了机会，没有破坏他们的汇合并发现那名艾玛双重间谍的身份。你的惰性令人对你的忠心起疑，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Missed opportunity
messages.zh: 错失机会

messages.en: This is too dangerous. Bring in the Navy or something, okay?
messages.zh: 这太危险了。还是派海军或者其他人去吧，好吗？

messages.en: I was afraid this was too much for you. From now on, we'll have to keep you busy elsewhere... maybe hauling trash or something.
messages.zh: 我本来就担心这任务对你来说太难了。从现在起，我们会让你去忙别的……可能是拖运垃圾之类的工作。

messages.en: You waited too long. We have missed an opportunity to thwart the rendezvous and discover the identity of the Amarrian double agent. Your lack of initiative puts your loyalty in question, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你耽搁得太久了。我们错过了机会，没有破坏他们的汇合并发现那名艾玛双重间谍的身份。你的惰性令人对你的忠心起疑，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Missed opportunity
messages.zh: 错失机会

name.de: Neue Sklaven - Einen Spion fangen (5 von 5)
name.en: New Slaves - To Catch a Spy (5 of 5)
name.es: Nuevos esclavos: Cómo atrapar a un espía (5 de 5)
name.ja: 新たな奴隷たち-スパイの捕獲（5/5）
name.ru: Новые рабы – охота на шпиона (New Slaves - To Catch a Spy) (5 из 5)

messages.en: You bet. And I'll enjoy every nano-second.
messages.zh: 这还用说。我会充分享受每一纳秒的。

messages.en: Excellent. Glad to have you working on this one.
messages.zh: 很好。很高兴你能来办这件事。

messages.en: Yes, I can. And I will.
messages.zh: 是的，我能。而且我会着手去做。

messages.en:
Now is our chance to apprehend Garmasi Jowai. Intel has determined that he is meeting his Minmatar handlers in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Get out there and catch him, and bring him in to face the Emperor's justice.

The strength of the Minmatar force is unknown, but you can bet they'll be heavily armed. You should not attempt this mission without a well-armed ship, and you should be prepared to warp out for repairs if necessary.
messages.zh:
现在，我们抓捕佳玛斯•侨韦的机会到了。情报部门断定，他正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系与他的米玛塔尔副手碰头。去那里抓住他，带他回来接受皇帝的制裁。

那支米玛塔尔部队的实力上不清楚，但不难想象，他们肯定武装强悍。要尝试完成这个任务，你必须有一艘武装精良的飞船，而且在必要的情况下，你要做好跃迁出战区以进行维修的准备。

messages.en: Garmasi Jowai is in custody, and his Minmatar flunkies are destroyed.
messages.zh: 佳玛斯•侨韦已被监禁，那些米玛塔尔奴才都被干掉了。

messages.en: You have done the Empire a great service, {[character]player.name}. You will be handsomely rewarded.
messages.zh: 你为帝国立了大功，{[character]player.name}。你将得到丰厚的回报。

messages.en: This is too dangerous for me. I think I'll go find something else to do.
messages.zh: 这对我太危险了。我想我还是找点别的事做吧。

messages.en: It seems the Minmatar frightened you off after all. From now on, we'll have to keep you busy hauling garbage or something.
messages.zh: 看来米玛塔尔人还是把你吓跑了。从现在起，我们会让你去忙拖运垃圾之类的工作。

messages.en:
Some deadspace acceleration gates are locked so that you cannot use them until all the enemy ships in the area have been destroyed. If you warp into a deadspace area and you become surrounded by enemies, consider warping out again to repair or to try a different tactic rather than running for the next acceleration gate.

When you warp to an encounter area that you expect might be swarming with enemies, do not use the "Warp to 0 km" option if you can avoid it. Instead, warp to 50 km or so, and force your enemies to come to you. This is a useful option particularly if you are outgunned or seriously outnumbered, especially if you use long-range weapons. (Unfortunately, this tactic isn't available in many deadspace locations, but it should be used whenever possible.)
messages.zh:
一些死亡空间的加速门是锁起来的，所以你要把在那一区域所有的敌船都消灭之后才能使用她们。如果你跃迁到一个死亡空间并且被敌船包围， 考虑一下飞出去进行一下修理或者换一套方案， 而不是赶快飞到下一个加速门。

当你跃迁到一个遭遇战区域，在那里你可能想在那里会充满敌人，如果你能避开它，不要使用“跃迁到0千米”这个选项。相反，你要选择大约跃迁到50千米，迫使你的敌人接近你。 这是一条非常有用的选项，特别是在你在火力非常强大的时候以及你使用的是远距离武器的条件下。(不幸的事，这个战略在许多死亡空间地带都不适用，但当条件允许时，还是可以使用的。)

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
Excellent. This is our chance to apprehend Jowai and make him pay — as well as getting some useful intelligence from him. Intel has determined that he is meeting his Minmatar handlers in a remote pocket of deadspace in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Our ships are too far away, and you've shown great courage and resourcefulness up till now.

Get out there and catch him, {[character]player.name}, and bring him in to face Imperial Justice. Our interrogators are quite... skilled. And you will be well rewarded, of course.
messages.zh:
很好。这是我们的机会，要抓住侨韦并让他付出代价——当然还要从他身上弄点有用的情报。情报部门断定，他正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系一个边远的死亡空间层与他的米玛塔尔副手碰头。我们的舰船距那太远，而且迄今为止，你都展现了巨大的勇气和智慧。

去那里抓住他，{[character]player.name}，带他回来接受帝国的制裁。我们的审讯人员是相当……有技巧的。当然，你将得到优厚的回报。

messages.en: You waited too long. Garmasi Jowai escaped from the rendezvous point with his Minmatar handlers. Your lack of initiative puts your loyalty in question, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你耽搁得太久了。佳玛斯·侨韦和他的米玛塔尔副手从汇合点逃跑了。你的惰性令人对你的忠心起疑，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Your failure
messages.zh: 你失败了

messages.en: This is too dangerous. I quit.
messages.zh: 这太危险了。我退出。

messages.en: It seems the Minmatar frightened you off after all. From now on, we'll have to keep you busy hauling garbage or something.
messages.zh: 看来米玛塔尔人还是把你吓跑了。从现在起，我们会让你去忙拖运垃圾之类的工作。

messages.en: You waited too long. Garmasi Jowai escaped from the rendezvous point with his Minmatar handlers. Your lack of initiative puts your loyalty in question, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你耽搁得太久了。佳玛斯·侨韦和他的米玛塔尔副手从汇合点逃跑了。你的惰性令人对你的忠心起疑，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Your failure
messages.zh: 你失败了

messages.en: I will make these Thukkers regret ever coming to this system.
messages.zh: 我会让这些图克尔人后悔来到这个星系。

messages.en: Spoken like a true crusader. Godspeed.
messages.zh: 你说得就像一名真正的信仰战士。祝你好运。

messages.en: What's the problem? Specifically, I mean.
messages.zh: 出什么事了？请说具体一点。

messages.en:
A group of Thukker raiders has taken residence in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. So far they've only hit soft targets, passing industrials and the like. They haven't gotten brave enough to try for a station. And, thanks to you, we won't let them live that long.

Head out to their hiding spot. Wipe the savages out. All of Creation will be a safer place for their deaths. And remain wary. I smell the Minmatar "government" behind all this.
messages.zh:
一群图克尔侵袭者进驻了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。目前为止，他们还只是攻击些脆弱目标，比如过往的工业舰之类的。他们还没胆大到去攻击一座空间站。而且，多亏了你，我们不会让他们活到那个时候。

出发前往他们的藏身点。把这些野蛮人彻底清除。在上帝创造的宇宙中消灭他们应该更有成功把握。不过要保持警惕。我嗅出这一切背后有米玛塔尔“政府”的味道。

messages.en: Those Thukkers will no longer bother the living.
messages.zh: 那些图克尔人再也不能骚扰生灵了。

messages.en: Take joy in the knowledge that you have preserved the Empire's peace, and that more damned have been sent to the eternal purgatorial furnace.
messages.zh: 欢喜吧，你维护了帝国的和平，那些该死的家伙已被打入永恒的炼狱。

messages.en: I have no desire to engage these violent beasts. Do you have any idea what it costs to replace a ship like mine these days?
messages.zh: 我不想与这些粗暴的野兽交手。你知道这年头更换一艘我这样的飞船要花多少钱吗？

messages.en: The Empire was not forged by the timid, my friend, nor can the timid preserve it.
messages.zh: 帝国不是由胆小鬼造就的，我的朋友，胆小鬼也别想得势。

messages.en:
The Empire has been studying the ships flown by the Minmatar for some time. Though they mostly fly variants of standard Minmatar ships, the Thukkers usually have specific load outs: They favor Explosive and Thermal weapons, and their ships have a low heat tolerance, making Thermal weapons the best to use against them. If you are using laser weapons, X-Ray or Gamma lenses could be good to equip. If you feel like bringing the fight in closer, Multifrequency lenses do even more Thermal damage, but at the cost of range.

Remember, whatever weapon you use to destroy their ships, Thukkers decompress explosively, just like any other Minmatar...
messages.zh:
帝国已经研究米玛塔尔人驾驶的舰船好一段时间了。尽管他们大多驾驶各种标准米玛塔尔舰船的衍生型，但图克尔人采用了特殊的武器配置：他们偏爱能造成爆炸和热能伤害的武器，他们飞船的耐热性较差，因此热能武器是对付他们的最好选择。如果你使用激光武器的话，X射线或伽玛晶体将是不错的弹药装备。如果你愿意近距离作战的话，多频晶体能造成更大的热能伤害，但要以射程为代价。

记住，无论你使用什么武器摧毁他们的飞船，图克尔人被击毁的时候都是爆炸式的，就跟其他米玛塔尔人一样……

messages.en: Thukker Armaments
messages.zh: 图克尔武器装备

messages.en:
Yes. Minmatar heathens, and pirates as well. As if we don't have enough to worry about with Blood Raider pirates, Gallente political maneuvering, and our own houses trying to screw each other over. We don't need a bunch of bloodthirsty savages coming in here and causing more trouble.

The Thukker raiders have taken residence in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. So far they've only hit soft targets, passing industrials and the like. They haven't gotten brave enough to try for a station. And, thanks to you, we won't let them live that long.

Head out to their hiding spot. Wipe the savages out. All of Creation will be a safer place for their deaths. And remain wary. I smell the Minmatar "government" behind all this.
messages.zh:
是的，又是米玛塔尔那群野蛮的强盗。我们操心的事情还不够多么？血袭者海盗的袭击，和盖伦特方面的政治协调，还有我们自己内部的相互争斗，这些难道还不够么！我们不需要那群残忍的野蛮人来这里，造成更多的麻烦。

这些图克尔侵袭者已经占据了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。到目前为止，他们还只是攻击些脆弱目标，比如过往的工业舰之类的。他们还没胆大到去攻击一座空间站。而且，多亏了你，我们不会让他们活到那个时候。

出发前往他们的藏身点。把这些野蛮人彻底清除。在上帝创造的宇宙中消灭他们应该更有成功把握。不过要保持警惕。我嗅出这一切背后有米玛塔尔“政府”的味道。

messages.en: The Thukkers attacked a local outpost. Though the savages themselves died in the ensuing battle, the civilian losses were great. Had you acted more quickly, perhaps fewer souls would be awaiting their judgment now.
messages.zh: 图克尔人攻打了一座本地哨站。虽然这些野蛮人自己也在其后的战斗中丧命，但平民死亡惨重。如果你行动快一些，也许现在等待上帝审判的灵魂数量会大大减少。

messages.en: Many dead
messages.zh: 许多人死亡

messages.en: I cannot wipe out the Thukkers.
messages.zh: 我无法肃清图克尔人。

messages.en: Disappointing. But not entirely unexpected.
messages.zh: 真是遗憾。不过也并非完全出乎意料。

messages.en: The Thukkers attacked a local outpost. Though the savages themselves died in the ensuing battle, the civilian losses were great. Had you acted more quickly, perhaps fewer souls would be awaiting their judgment now.
messages.zh: 图克尔人攻打了一座本地哨站。虽然这些野蛮人自己也在其后的战斗中丧命，但平民死亡惨重。如果你行动快一些，也许现在等待上帝审判的灵魂数量会大大减少。

messages.en: Many dead
messages.zh: 许多人死亡

messages.en: Dead Serpentis, coming up.
messages.zh: 干掉天蛇，马上就去办。

messages.en: Good to hear.
messages.zh: 很高兴听你这样说。

messages.en: That's me, always willing to help.
messages.zh: 当然，我永远乐意帮忙。

messages.en: A small group of Serpentis pirates has taken up residence in a deadspace pocket here in our system. I want you to fly out there and take these clowns out. Use whatever means you need to. And be careful: I have a feeling that they wouldn't be here this deep into our space unless Gallente agents were behind it.
messages.zh: 一小群天蛇海盗占据了我们星系里的一个死亡空间层。我要你去那里干掉这些小丑。采取一切你认为必要的手段。不过要小心：我有感觉，如果不是盖伦特特工在背后支持，他们不会深入到我们空间的这个位置。

messages.en: Those Serpentis are not coming back… ever.
messages.zh: 那些天蛇不会再回来了……永远都不会。

messages.en: Great. Maybe my boss will ease up on me for a while now.
messages.zh: 很好。也许我的老板现在能让我好过点了。

messages.en: I'm not about to tangle with the Serpentis just because some haulers got spooked.
messages.zh: 我不会因为一些拖运工受到了惊吓而去与天蛇交手。

messages.en: You are going to tangle with the Serpentis at some point. Better to tangle with them when they're small and stupid.
messages.zh: 你迟早会要与天蛇交手。还不如在他们既弱小又蠢笨的时候去对付他们。

messages.en:
We have data sheets miles long on the Gallenteans. While a lot of it is complete crap, it does give us good information on their typical ship load outs, including the ships flown by pirate groups working in Gallente space, such as the Serpentis.

Serpentis ships favor Kinetic and Thermal weapons, so be prepared for that. Their armor is tough, but cannot turn a point: Using an ammo type that does Kinetic damage should do the trick. Scourge light missiles or rockets work well.
messages.zh:
我们有长达数英里的关于盖伦特人的数据单。虽然其中大部分都是纯粹的垃圾，不过我们确实从中了解了他们典型飞船的武器配置，包括在盖伦特空间内活动的海盗组织的飞船，比如天蛇。

天蛇舰船偏爱动能和热能武器，所以要做好准备。他们的装甲很强悍，但有一个弱点：只要使用能造成动能伤害的弹药类型就能取胜。鞭挞轻型导弹或者火箭的效果就很好。

messages.en: Serpentis Armaments
messages.zh: 天蛇武器装备

messages.en:
Great, 'cause we have a slight problem: A small group of Serpentis pirates has taken up residence in a deadspace pocket here in our system. They've been mostly harmless until recently, when the dumbasses actually tried to hold up a Rorqual. As you can imagine, they didn't hurt anybody, but they raised enough ire from high up in the corporation that now we have to do something about them.

I want you to fly out there and take these Serpentis clowns out. Use whatever means you need to. And be careful: I have a feeling that they wouldn't be here this deep into our space unless Gallente agents were behind it.
messages.zh:
很好，我们正好有个小问题：一小群天蛇海盗占据了我们星系里的一个死亡空间层。他们本来一直没什么危害，不过最近情况发生了变化，这些蠢货竟然试图拦截一艘“长须鲸”级。不难想象，他们没伤害任何人，但这已足以引起集团高层的强烈愤怒，所以现在我们必须对他们采取些行动。

我要你去那里干掉这些天蛇小丑。采取一切你认为必要的手段。不过要小心：我有感觉，如果不是盖伦特特工在背后支持，他们不会深入到我们空间的这个位置。

messages.en: The Serpentis pulled off a heist on a freighter full of rare ores. That pissed the Navy off something awful. Subsequently the Serpentis thieves had a little run-in with a Navy Raven. The idiots are dead, but we have no idea what they've done with the minerals. If you had acted faster, the State would not have lost these resources.
messages.zh: 天蛇成功抢走了一艘满载稀有矿石的货船。这让海军大为光火。随后，天蛇窃贼与一艘海军“乌鸦”级展开了一场小规模战争。那些白痴都死了，我们不知道他们是如何处置那批矿物的。如果你行动快一些，合众国就不会损失这些资源了。

messages.en: Serpentis situation
messages.zh: 天蛇难题

messages.en: These Serpentis aren't worth the effort.
messages.zh: 不值得为了这些天蛇费力气。

messages.en:
You know that and I know that, but my boss will not get off my back about it.

Alright, alright, fine. I'll get someone else.
messages.zh:
你和我都清楚这一点，但我的老板不会让我好过的。

好吧，好吧，行。我会另觅人选。

messages.en: The Serpentis pulled off a heist on a freighter full of rare ores. That pissed the Navy off something awful. Subsequently the Serpentis thieves had a little run-in with a Navy Raven. The idiots are dead, but we have no idea what they've done with the minerals. If you had acted faster, the State would not have lost these resources.
messages.zh: 天蛇成功抢走了一艘满载稀有矿石的货船。这让海军大为光火。随后，天蛇窃贼与一艘海军“乌鸦”级展开了一场小规模战争。那些白痴都死了，我们不知道他们是如何处置那批矿物的。如果你行动快一些，合众国就不会损失这些资源了。

messages.en: Serpentis situation
messages.zh: 天蛇难题

messages.en: Dead Guristas, coming up.
messages.zh: 干掉古斯塔斯，马上就去办。

messages.en: Get to it.
messages.zh: 快行动起来。

messages.en: What's the matter?
messages.zh: 有什么问题吗？

messages.en:
What's the matter is the Guristas, of all things; there's a group of them in this system harassing industrials and civilian vessels alike. They don't seem particularly effective as pirates go, but they're brazen enough.

The big concern is that filming for the holo Tears of the Sky is taking place in the same area. Smart money would bet that the Caldari mega-corps are funding these guys; the State is desperate to keep this holo from coming out.

Anyway, the best solution is to just take these Guristas out.
messages.zh:
这次的问题竟然是古斯塔斯；这个星系里有一群古斯塔斯，正在骚扰工业舰和民用船只等飞船。作为海盗，他们似乎效率不高，但足够厚颜无耻。

主要令人担心的是，全息电影天空之泪正在同一区域拍摄。消息灵通的投资家们确信，一定是加达里超级集团在资助那些古斯塔斯海盗，因为合众国不惜一切手段要阻止这部全息电影拍摄成功。

不管怎么说，最好的解决方式还是铲除这些古斯塔斯海盗。

messages.en: The Guristas are… dealt with. Tears of the Sky is still on track to be the best holoreel of the year.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯已被……解决。天空之类注定将成为年度最佳全息记忆盘。

messages.en: No, not of the year. Of the century.
messages.zh: 不，不是年度。是整个世纪。

messages.en: I think I have more important things to do than safeguard the filming of a holoreel.
messages.zh: 我想，比起保护全息记忆盘的拍摄来，我还有更重要的事要做。

messages.en: I know you're young, so you may not fully understand it yet, but believe me when I tell you that nothing is more important than holoreels.
messages.zh: 我知道你还年轻，所以你也许不能完全理解，不过我跟你说，没有什么比全息记忆盘更重要，你要相信我。

messages.en: The Federation Navy and FIO have been investigating the Guristas for years, seeing as they're primarily a Caldari organization. Most of the information is classified, but what is public knowledge is their usual load out: Guristas prefer weapons that do Explosive and Kinetic damage, so watch out for that. Luckily, their ships tend to have poor Kinetic resistance; using pretty much any hybrid charges should work fine, or use Hornets if you're into drones.
messages.zh: 联邦海军和FIO已经调查古斯塔斯好多年了，因为他们差不多就是一个加达里组织。大部分信息都是机密，唯一的公开信息就是他们通常的武器配置：古斯塔斯喜欢能产生爆炸和动能伤害的武器，所以注意这一点。幸运的是，他们舰船的动能抗性比较差；使用任何混合弹药都能取得不错的效果，或者，如果你喜欢用无人机的话，可以使用“大黄蜂”无人机。

messages.en: Gurista Armament
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯武器装备

messages.en:
What's the matter is the Guristas, of all things. Yeah, I know, when have Guristas ever caused trouble in these parts, right? It's weird. But nonetheless, there's a group of them in this very system harassing industrials and civilian vessels alike.

Now, they don't seem particularly effective as pirates go, but they're brazen enough. The big concern is that filming for the holo Tears of the Sky is taking place in the same area. It's set to be the best selling version of the Caldari Uprising yet, with a quarter of the Federation's biggest companies all sponsoring it. If the Guristas mess it up, there is going to be a storm of bad press.

Smart money would bet that the Caldari mega-corps are funding these guys; the State is desperate to keep this holo from coming out. They claim it "misrepresents history." Heh, well, whatever else you want to say about 'em, it's a fact that they have no respect for artistic license...

Anyway, the best solution is to just take these Guristas out. You interested?
messages.zh:
古斯塔斯怎么了？是的，我知道古斯塔斯从没有在这里制造过麻烦，这太奇怪了。但不管怎么说，现在这个星系里有一群古斯塔斯，正在骚扰工业舰和民用船只等飞船。

他们的效率现在还比不上海盗，但足够厚颜无耻。主要令人担心的是，全息电影天空之泪正在同一区域拍摄。如果让这些海盗影响了电影的拍摄，那我们将遭受舆论的批判风暴。

消息灵通的投资家们确信，一定是加达里超级集团在资助那些古斯塔斯海盗，因为合众国不惜一切手段要阻止这部全息电影拍摄成功。他们认为这部电影“错误地叙述了历史。”无论你这么看，这伙人一点也不尊重艺术……

不管怎么说，最好的解决方式还是铲除这些古斯塔斯海盗。你有兴趣吗？

messages.en: The Guristas made a move on the set of Tears of the Sky. Security ships took them out, but this is going to push back the shooting for at least another quarter. Not only is this going to hurt the Gallente economy, but you've disappointed holoreel fans everywhere.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯对天空之泪拍摄现场采取了行动。安全船只将他们全部消灭了，但影片的拍摄至少会因此再延后一个季度。这不仅将损害盖伦特的经济发展，你还令各地的影迷失望。

messages.en: Reelmaking delayed
messages.zh: 全息影片拍摄推迟

messages.en: To hell with the Guristas, and to hell with this holo.
messages.zh: 让古斯塔斯去见鬼，让这部全息记忆盘也去见鬼。

messages.en: I can understand if you don't want to mess with the Guristas, but I never want to hear you besmirch the holoreel industry again.
messages.zh: 如果你不想去惹古斯塔斯，我理解，但别让我再听到你侮辱全息记忆盘产业。

messages.en: The Guristas made a move on the set of Tears of the Sky. Security ships took them out, but this is going to push back the shooting for at least another quarter. Not only is this going to hurt the Gallente economy, but you've disappointed holoreel fans everywhere.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯对天空之泪拍摄现场采取了行动。安全船只将他们全部消灭了，但影片的拍摄至少会因此再延后一个季度。这不仅将损害盖伦特的经济发展，你还令各地的影迷失望。

messages.en: Reelmaking delayed
messages.zh: 全息影片拍摄推迟

messages.en: I will exterminate these Blood Raiders in as bloody a manner as I can.
messages.zh: 我会用最血腥的方式结果这些血袭者。

messages.en: That's the spirit.
messages.zh: 要的就是这种精神。

messages.en: Blood Raiders?
messages.zh: 血袭者？

messages.en: A group of Blood Raiders has been seen in this system. This deep in Minmatar space, you can bet the Amarr government is behind it. I need you to go out there and wipe them out, and make it as violent as you can. We want to make sure this hit is noticed. But be careful on this one.
messages.zh: 有人在本星系里看到了血袭者。他们竟然如此深入米玛塔尔空间，不难想象，一定是艾玛政府在背后搞鬼。我要你去那里把他们彻底消灭，闹得越激烈越好。我们要确保这次袭击会得到关注。不过这次行动要小心。

messages.en: The explosions of the Blood Raider ships could be seen from Athra, I imagine. Boy, did I make a mess of them!
messages.zh: 我猜，这些血袭者舰船的爆炸大概在阿提拉也看得到。老兄，我可把它们炸开了花！

messages.en: That's exactly what I wanted to hear. Good work.
messages.zh: 我就想听这个。干得好。

messages.en: I'm busy enough as it is, thanks. But no thanks.
messages.zh: 谢谢，但我已经够忙了。不了，谢谢。

messages.en: Fine. I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 好吧。我会另觅人选。

messages.en: Between our records and CONCORD's, we have a ton of data on the Blood Raiders. They're about what you'd expect from one of the only religious pirate organizations in existence. But what we're most interested in, of course, is how to destroy them, should we need to: They seem to favor Electromagnetic and Thermal weapons; their ships are tough, but vulnerable to EM-based attacks… so EMP ammo would be a good choice for guns, Mjolnir if you are using missiles.
messages.zh: 在我们和统合部的记录中存储了海量的关于血袭者的数据。这些数据涵盖了这个当今唯一的宗教性海盗组织的方方面面。当然，我们最感兴趣的还是如何在必要的情况下摧毁他们：他们似乎偏爱电磁和热能武器；虽然他们的舰船很强悍，但在电磁攻击面前却相当脆弱……所以如果使用大炮的话，电磁脉冲弹是很好的选择；如果使用导弹，就选择“雷神”。

messages.en: Blood Raider Armaments
messages.zh: 血袭者武器装备

messages.en:
Yeah, Blood Raiders. Never heard of them? The Raiders are a corrupted sect of an ancient cult — I forget the proper name — that historically used human blood in its rituals. Today, they believe that cloned bodies have "purer" blood than others… which is why they operate mainly in space, attacking unwary capsuleers and other rich folks who can afford clones and draining their bodies of blood.

Anyway, a group of Blood Raiders has been seen in this system. Yeah, weird, huh? This deep in Minmatar space?! You can bet the Amarr government is behind this. I need you to go out there and wipe them out. Make it as violent as you can. We want to make sure this hit is noticed. But be careful on this one.
messages.zh:
是的，正是血袭者。从没有听说过他们？他们是某古老文明中走向堕落的一个派系—我忘记了这个文明的具体名字—这个派系有在仪式中使用人血的传统。他们迷信地认为“克隆体比其他人类有更纯正的血统”，并因此在宇宙中袭击那些未加防范的飞行员和富有的民众，将他们的血从人体中抽尽，让他们的灵魂从克隆里复生。

总之一队血袭者舰队出现在了这个星系里，很奇怪是吧？在米玛塔尔控制的腹地？！毫无疑问一定有艾玛政府在后面支持他们，我需要你赶去那里消灭他们。闹得越激烈越好，我们要确保这次袭击会得到关注。不过这次行动要小心。

messages.en: The Blood Raiders took out one of our patrols. The Raiders themselves were destroyed, but at considerable loss of life. Had you exterminated them when you were asked to, our dead pilots would still be around.
messages.zh: 血袭者摧毁了我们一艘巡逻舰。血袭者已被消灭，但代价是我方惨重的人员死亡。如果你遵照命令，早点消灭他们，我们死去的飞行员如今还会健在。

messages.en: Many killed in attack
messages.zh: 许多人在袭击中死亡

messages.en: I'm not too keen on facing down these Blood Raiders. I quit.
messages.zh: 我不是那么热衷于制服这些血袭者。我退出。

messages.en: It may seem like just a few whacked out pirates, but if we let them escape without punishment, what message are we sending our enemies?
messages.zh: 他们也许看上去只是一些疯狂的海盗，但如果我们让他们跑了，我们向敌人传达的是怎样的信息呢？

messages.en: The Blood Raiders took out one of our patrols. The Raiders themselves were destroyed, but at considerable loss of life. Had you exterminated them when you were asked to, our dead pilots would still be around.
messages.zh: 血袭者摧毁了我们一艘巡逻舰。血袭者已被消灭，但代价是我方惨重的人员死亡。如果你遵照命令，早点消灭他们，我们死去的飞行员如今还会健在。

messages.en: Many killed in attack
messages.zh: 许多人在袭击中死亡

messages.en: Yeah, I'll give it a shot.
messages.zh: 行，我去试一下。

messages.en: Good for you. The morons barely deserve the help, but it's my ass if someone goes and dies.
messages.zh: 很好。那些呆瓜其实不值得我们伸出援手，但你可千万别死啊，不然我就惨了。

messages.en: Well, that's fortunate! I came to see if you had any work for me.
messages.zh: 哈，正好撞上了。我就是来找工作的。

messages.en: Pick up the shipment of AIMEDs and deliver them to {[location]agentStationID.name}. Keep in mind that pirates and other unsavory elements are always looking for AIMEDs since medical staff among them are virtually non-existent, so you should be prepared for interference of some kind.
messages.zh: 将一批机器人医生运到{[location]agentStationID.name}。要当心路上虎视眈眈的海盗。他们几乎没有自备的医疗设备，因此你要准备随时应战。

messages.en: Got the AIDs here. Turned out to be a bit trickier than expected, I might add.
messages.zh: 我把医疗机器人带来了。但过程好像比我想象地要艰险。

messages.en: Well done. Not a single unnecessary death. And the reward's pretty generous, so it should cover any additional hassle, I think. Sorry for the trouble, though.
messages.zh: 干得好。你没有造成任务不必要的伤亡。你的报酬很丰厚，我想应该能抵消你路上遇到的不顺。但我还是向你说声抱歉。

messages.en: I think I'll pass.
messages.zh: 我想我还是算了。

messages.en: I can hardly blame you. I'll have to find someone else to fix those morons' mistake.
messages.zh: 也不能怪你。看样子我得去找其他人帮那些呆瓜擦屁股。

messages.en: Medical doctors being in such short supply, and thus in high demand, few of them are willing to risk their lives for a less lucrative practice than the one they can run comfortably planet-side. On stations, robotic AI Medical Doctors (AIMEDs, more commonly known as "AI Docs" or just "AIDs") are much more common than human medical practitioners, and much more affordable.
messages.zh: 医生的供给状况是供小于给，加上在行星上行医收入要大于天上，因此几乎没医生愿意冒更大的风险在太空中从业。在空间站里，机器人工智能医生更常见，要价也更便宜。

messages.en: AIMEDs
messages.zh: 机器人医生

messages.en:
Good. Listen, some idiot just hacked into the AID system and fried all the doctors. Then a bigger idiot burned out all the replacement hardware by trying to replace single units instead of rebooting the whole damn system. So the whole station is fracked, completely without medical staff.

I need you to go pick up the nearest batch of replacement parts from the Sisters of EVE Medical Center in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and bring them back here before everyone manages to die of the Debylian flu or something.
messages.zh:
很好。听着，有个呆瓜破解了救助系统，把机器医生都烧成灰了。然后还有个更呆的家伙不去重启系统，反而想换上新的机器医生以解决问题，这下可好，全部的替换机器人都烧成灰报废了。这样整个空间站就被搞砸了，没有一个医疗救助设备。

我要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的姐妹会医疗中心去把离我们最近的一批部件带来。动作要快，不然会死人的。

messages.en:
Those fools went and let ships dock with no medics to give the okay. Turns out one of 'em was carrying some kind of plague, and the whole station ended up sick before they figured out what was going on.

Anyway, you don't need to take the AID parts over anymore. They'll take care of that when they refurbish the place after the hazmat team finishes sterilizing it and incinerating the bodies.
messages.zh:
那些傻瓜在无医疗救助设备的情况下继续让一些舰船停靠。其中有艘船上有人带瘟疫，整个空间站里的人在还没弄清楚发生什么之前已经全部病倒了。

反正你已经不用去取医疗部件了。等有人把那面消毒打扫干净之后他们会自己料理的。

messages.en: Would you believe it?
messages.zh: 你相信吗？

messages.en: I can hardly blame you. I'll have to find someone else to fix those morons' mistake.
messages.zh: 也不能怪你。看样子我得去找其他人帮那些呆瓜擦屁股。

messages.en:
Those fools went and let ships dock with no medics to give the okay. Turns out one of 'em was carrying some kind of plague, and the whole station ended up sick before they figured out what was going on.

Anyway, you don't need to take the AID parts over anymore. They'll take care of that when they refurbish the place after the hazmat team finishes sterilizing it and incinerating the bodies.
messages.zh:
那些傻瓜在无医疗救助设备的情况下继续让一些舰船停靠。其中有艘船上有人带瘟疫，整个空间站里的人在还没弄清楚发生什么之前已经全部病倒了。

反正你已经不用去取医疗部件了。等有人把那面消毒打扫干净之后他们会自己料理的。

messages.en: Would you believe it?
messages.zh: 你相信吗？

name.de: Topf und Deckel - Verwundeter Jäger (1 von 5)
name.en: Pot and Kettle - Wounded Hunter (1 of 5)
name.es: La sartén al cazo: Cazador herido (1 de 5)
name.fr: L'hôpital et la charité - Chasseur blessé (1 sur 5)
name.ja: 痛み分け-傷ついたハンター（1/5）
name.ru: Котелок и чайник – раненый охотник (Pot and Kettle - Wounded Hunter) (1 из 5)

messages.en: That battlecruiser's dead, mark my words!
messages.zh: 那艘战列巡洋舰死定了，我说话算话！

messages.en: Excellent. Good hunting, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 很好。打猎愉快，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: What's up?
messages.zh: 怎么了？

messages.en: One of our covert ops pilots managed to scan a badly damaged Amarrian Prophecy down in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system, but of course he couldn't take her on, even if she was badly damaged; he figured her captain was hiding out until we eased off on stargate security so he could sneak through and get back to Amarr space. Go out there and blow that damaged battlecruiser to hell.
messages.zh: 我们的一位特勤舰飞行员在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系里扫描到了一艘严重受损的艾玛先知级，当然尽管它损坏严重，那名飞行员仍然不是它的对手；他估计，那艘先知级的船长躲了起来，打算等我们放松对星门的安全检查后再偷偷穿过并逃回艾玛空间。出发去那里，让那艘受损的战列巡洋舰下地狱。

messages.en: The battlecruiser's destroyed. It wasn't alone, and it must've had both hull and armor repairers fitted, 'cause there wasn't a scratch on it when I got there.
messages.zh: 那艘战列巡洋舰已被摧毁。它并不是单枪匹马，而且它肯定装配了结构与装甲维修器，因为我到那里的时候，它根本毫发无损。

messages.en: Those Amarrians will rue the day they messed with us! We're analyzing the enemy fleet's communications — come back if you're interested in more action.
messages.zh: 那些艾玛人会后悔那天招惹了我们！我们正在分析敌舰的通讯——如果你还有兴趣参加更多的战斗，记得再回来。

messages.en: Hm. No. Not worth my time, one lone battlecruiser. Thanks, but no thanks.
messages.zh: 呃。不了。不值得我浪费时间，只是一艘孤零零的战列巡洋舰而已。谢谢。我不干，不过还是谢了。

messages.en: I guess I misjudged you, {[character]player.name}. I'll have to seek help elsewhere.
messages.zh: 我想我看错你了，{[character]player.name}。我会另找帮手。

messages.en: The Prophecy is built on an ancient Amarrian warship design dating back to the earliest days of starship combat. It was originally intended as a full-fledged battleship, but Imperial Navy engineers determined after mixed fleet engagements with early prototypes that the Prophecy would be more effective as a slightly smaller, more mobile Battlecruiser-class.
messages.zh: 先知级的设计基于一种古代艾玛战船，可以追溯到星际飞船大战的最早期。最初的设想是把它建造成一艘完备的战列舰，但在早期原型与各类飞船进行战斗后，帝国海军工程师认为，把先知级缩减到巡洋舰大小后能够更大地发挥它的效能。

messages.en: The Prophecy
messages.zh: 先知级

messages.en:
It looks as if the Amarr are getting a little too ballsy. We encountered a small Amarrian skirmish fleet a couple of jumps away and chewed 'em up pretty bad. Their leader was in a Prophecy, which was damaged in the fight, but he managed to warp her away when we demolished his squad. She was nearly hulled, and we want someone to make sure she doesn't make it back to Amarr territory.

One of our covert ops pilots managed to scan the ship down in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system, but of course he couldn't take her on, even if she was badly damaged; he figured her captain was hiding out until we eased off on stargate security so he could sneak through and get back to Amarr space. I want you to get out there and take out that damaged battlecruiser, blow her to hell.

Now, I know you'd be willing to do this just to take down some of those arrogant Amarr bastards, but I've arranged for a decent reward anyway. You in?
messages.zh:
似乎艾玛人有些过于放肆了。我们在几个跳跃之外的地方遭遇了一小支艾玛舰队，把他们打得狼狈不堪。他们的首领驾驶的是一艘先知级，这艘船在战斗中受到了损坏，不过在我们消灭其他小队成员的时候，先知级跃迁逃跑了。它的船体已近乎完全损坏，我们要派个人去确保它不会重返艾玛领土。

我们的一位特勤舰飞行员在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系里扫描到了这艘飞船，当然尽管它损坏严重，那名飞行员仍然不是它的对手；他估计，那艘先知级的船长躲了起来，打算等我们放松对星门的安全检查后再偷偷穿过并逃回艾玛空间。我要你去那里除掉那艘损坏的战列巡洋舰，让它去见上帝。

我知道，就冲着能收拾一些傲慢的艾玛混蛋，你就肯定会接这个活，不过我还是安排了一份优厚的报酬。你干吗？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Your delay in responding to my request for assistance with the enemy battlecruiser in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has forced me to revoke my offer of employment. I will be seeking assistance from more reliable pilots in future.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

对于我提出的协助处理{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的战列巡洋舰的请求，你未能及时回应，因此我不得不撤回我的任务提议。以后我会找更可靠的飞行员来提供帮助。

messages.en: Re: Your lack of response
messages.zh: 回复：你未回复

messages.en: That battlecruiser isn't as badly hurt as you claimed, and it sure as hell isn't alone out there. Take your mission and shove it!
messages.zh: 那艘战列巡洋舰根本不像你说的那样损坏严重，而且我发誓那里不止它一艘飞船。拿着你的烂任务自己享受去吧！

messages.en: Well, I'll just have to find someone else with the guts to finish the job!
messages.zh: 好吧，我会找个更有胆量的人来做这件事！

messages.en: The Amarrian battlecruiser has escaped, possibly with valuable information regarding our force dispositions and capabilities. Your failure to complete this mission is a stain upon both your honor and mine, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 那艘艾玛战列巡洋舰逃跑了，很可能还带着关于我们军力部署和战斗力的宝贵信息。由于你未能完成该任务，致使你我的荣誉都蒙受了污点，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Prophecy escaped
messages.zh: 先知级逃掉了

name.es: La sartén al cazo: Buscaminas (2 de 5)
name.fr: L'hôpital et la charité – Dragueur de mines (2 sur 5)
name.ru: Котелок и чайник – тральщик (Pot and Kettle - Minesweeper) (2 из 5)

messages.en: I'll do it, sure — sounds a little more interesting than your typical shoot-em-up.
messages.zh: 我当然会做——这听起来比你通常的歼敌任务要有趣些。

messages.en: Well, what are you waiting for? Get out there and get those mines!
messages.zh: 好吧，你在等什么呢？出发去清除那些地雷！

messages.en: I'm back. What do you need? Those Amarr ships were up to no good, I'm sure.
messages.zh: 我回来了。你需要什么？我肯定那些艾玛飞船没干好事。

messages.en:
The Amarrians were busy out here. It seems they were up to a lot more than just scouting. One of their missions was apparently to place mines along some of our major shipping routes. {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, in particular, is full of the blasted things, and we've got a convoy coming through within four standard hours. We need to get someone to both systems and clear out those mines!

These "mines" are quite something, though. They are highly explosive proximity charges built into structures, but when they blow, they also launch a bunch of drones into space to finish off anything not torn entirely apart by the explosion. It's a tough job, but if they're not cleared by the time the convoy gets there, our people are in serious trouble.
messages.zh:
艾玛人在这的空间里非常忙碌。似乎他们的工作远不止侦察这么简单。显然，他们的任务之一是在我们的主要航运路线上铺设地雷。{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那里布满了这种该死的东西，而再过4个标准工时，我们就有一支护航队要经过那里。我们需要有人前往相关星系，清除那些地雷！

不过，这些“地雷”可不简单。它们的结构里含有近炸高爆装药，但是它们炸开之后，会向太空中释放大量无人机，去消灭未被爆炸完全粉碎的任何物体。这个任务很艰巨，但如果在护航队到达之前不清除它们，我们的人会遇到很大的麻烦。

messages.en: The convoys are safe. I've dealt with the mines — cunning idea, those. Too bad we didn't think of it first!
messages.zh: 护航队安全了。我已经处理了地雷——布雷真是个巧妙的主义。可惜我们没先想到！

messages.en: Good work, kid! Those convoys will get through now. Come on back soon and I'll have some more work for you.
messages.zh: 干得好，孩子！那些护航队现在可以通过了。记得不久要回来，我还有更多工作给你。

messages.en: Surely you must have some cheap ships you can throw away on these mines, right? I mean, why risk my ship?!
messages.zh: 你肯定有些廉价的飞船可以用来撞地雷，不是吗？我是说，干嘛让我的飞船冒险？！

messages.en: Don't ask if you're not serious about wanting work. You've wasted my valuable time.
messages.zh: 既然你对要求工作丝毫不严肃，那么就干脆别向我要。你浪费了我宝贵的时间。

messages.en:
The Amarrians were busy out here, I guess — they were up to a lot more than just scouting, it seems. One of their missions was apparently to place mines along some of our major shipping routes. {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, in particular, is full of the blasted things, and we've got a convoy coming through within four standard hours. We need to get someone to both systems and clear out those mines!

These "mines" are quite something, though. They are highly explosive proximity charges built into structures, but when they blow, they also launch a bunch of drones into space to finish off anything not torn entirely apart by the explosion. It's a tough job, but if they're not cleared by the time the convoy gets there, our people are in serious trouble.

You up for it?
messages.zh:
艾玛人在这的空间里非常忙碌——似乎他们的工作远不止侦察这么简单。显然，他们的任务之一是在我们的主要航运路线上铺设地雷。特别是{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，那里布满了这种该死的东西，而再过4个标准工时，我们就有一支护航队要经过那里。我们需要有人前去这两个星系，清除那些地雷！

不过，这些“地雷”可不简单。它们是容纳于结构之中的高爆炸近感弹药，但是它们炸开之后，会向太空中释放大量无人机，去消灭未被爆炸完全粉碎的任何物体。这个任务很艰巨，但如果在护航队到达之前不清除它们，我们的人会遇到很大的麻烦。

你愿意干吗？

messages.en: I don't like being kept waiting. We've had to abort two convoy missions now and I've had to hire a team of minesweepers to go in there and clear it out. If you're going to treat all my offers this way, don't bother coming back.
messages.zh: 我不喜欢别人叫我等。我们已经被迫中止两项护航队任务了，我不得不雇了一组扫雷人员去那里进行清理。如果你打算一直这样对待我的任务提议，不要再来找我。

messages.en: Minesweeping offer revoked
messages.zh: 扫雷任务提议被撤回

messages.en: Sorry, I decided I don't want to risk my ship to clear those mines.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我决定不要让我的飞船冒险去清除那些地雷。

messages.en: You think this is a joke, don't you? Good men and women may die because you don't have what it takes to finish a simple job!
messages.zh: 你以为这只是个玩笑，是吗？你没有能力完成一个简单的任务，许多善良的男男女女却会因此而死！

messages.en: You've delayed too long; our convoy struck a mine and had to turn back. Lives have been lost and our forces in the region have been dealt a serious setback. Well done.
messages.zh: 你耽搁太久了；我们的护航队触到了一颗地雷，不得不返航。有人失去了生命，我们在这个星域的部队也遭到了严重挫折。干得好！

messages.en: Convoy damaged
messages.zh: 护航队受损

name.es: La sartén al cazo: Entrega (3 de 5)
name.fr: L'hôpital et la charité – Livraison (3 sur 5)
name.ru: Котелок и чайник - доставка (Pot and Kettle - Delivery) (3 из 5)

messages.en: I'll leave right away!
messages.zh: 我马上出发！

messages.en: Fly safe, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 一路顺风，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: What's up? Any more minefields need clearing?
messages.zh: 出什么事了？还有什么障碍要清除吗？

messages.en: We need a fast, competent courier to get these documents for a modified EMP Smart Bomb over to the research wing at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; they need them as a model for the new prototype. I imagine I'll have more work for you as soon as you get back, since they're going to want to start producing these right away. You up for the job?
messages.zh: 我们需要一名腿脚快又能干的信使去把这些关于改良型EMP立体炸弹的文件送给{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name};的研究部门，他们需要这个来造新的实验原型。我想，只要你一回来，我就会有更多的工作给你，因为他们打算立刻就生产这些东西。你愿意接这个任务吗？

messages.en: I delivered those smart bomb design documents as requested.
messages.zh: 我已经按要求把立体炸弹设计文件送过去了。

messages.en: Excellent work. See me again as soon as you get a chance.
messages.zh: 干得很好！一有机会就再来找我。

messages.en: I'm not your errand boy. I'm a capsuleer. Find someone else!
messages.zh: 我可不是专门替你跑腿的。我是一名飞行员。你找别人吧！

messages.en: Well, it's not the most glamorous job around, fine, but it was vital. Guess I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 好吧，虽然这不是最吸引人的活儿，但却极其重要。我想我得另找他人了。

messages.en:
That convoy you helped get through was more important than you know. In addition to their normal cargo, they were transporting a sealed diplomatic container containing research blueprints for a new EMP Smartbomb II. The next time those Amarr decide to swing through this sector and leave drones for us to find, our boys'll be waiting for them with a few racks of these babies. Those fanatical SOBs won't know what hit 'em.

Anyway, we need a fast, competent courier to get these documents for a modified EMP Smart Bomb over to the research wing at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; they need them as a model for the new prototype. I imagine I'll have more work for you as soon as you get back, since they're going to want to start producing these right away. You up for the job?
messages.zh:
你协助的那支护航队的重要性比你知道的要大得多。除了普通货物之外，他们还运送了一个密封的外交货柜，里面放的是新型EMP立体炸弹II的研究蓝图。要是那些艾玛人再敢闯进我们的地盘，派无人机来和我们玩捉迷藏，那我们的兄弟们就不客气了，让他们尝尝这些新炸弹的厉害。那些头脑发狂的白痴到时候连被谁打都不知道。

好了，话说回来，我们需要一名腿脚快又能干的信使去把这些关于改良型EMP立体炸弹的文件送给{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name};的研究部门，他们需要这个来造新的实验原型。我想，只要你一回来，我就会有更多的工作给你，因为他们打算立刻就生产这些东西。你愿意接这个任务吗？

messages.en: Research needed the docs for that smart bomb yesterday, {[character]player.name}! While you were busy screwing around, I hired someone else for the job.
messages.zh: 研究部门昨天就在等着立体炸弹的文件了，{[character]player.name}！在你整天忙着瞎混的时候，我已经雇了另外一个人去干了。

messages.en: Non-delivery
messages.zh: 没有运送

messages.en: Those techies over in research are still waiting to create the new smart bomb, {[character]player.name}. I've given the job to someone else.
messages.zh: 研究部门的那些技术人员们还在等着造新的立体炸弹呢，{[character]player.name}。我已经把这活儿给别人了。

messages.en: Non-delivery
messages.zh: 没有运送

name.de: Topf und Deckel - Suchen und zerstören (4 von 5)
name.en: Pot and Kettle - Seek and Destroy (4 of 5)
name.es: La sartén al cazo: Buscar y destruir (4 de 5)
name.fr: L'hôpital et la charité - Trouver et détruire (4 sur 5)
name.ru: Котелок и чайник – найти и уничтожить (Pot and Kettle - Seek and Destroy) (4 из 5)
name.zh: 瓶瓶罐罐 – 搜寻和消灭(4/5)

messages.en: Definitely! This sounds like something I can sink my teeth into!
messages.zh: 当然！这听起来是件我能认真解决的事情！

messages.en: Good! Now for all that's holy, be careful out there!
messages.zh: 不错！老天保佑，你到那里要小心！

messages.en: Absolutely. Uh, something a little more challenging, though? I mean, any rookie can mine Kernite…
messages.zh: 当然。呃，不过是稍微更有挑战性的活吗？要知道，任何菜鸟都会挖水硼砂……

messages.en:
Thanks to your help, we've built a number of the advanced EMP smart bombs. We've scheduled testing in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, but it looks as if Amarrian intel has realized that something is up: Amarr is dispatching recon ships to all our surrounding systems.

{[character]player.name}, we can't let them observe this weapons test! We need to hit any Amarrian recon ships in the system and destroy them before they can get word back to the enemy. And I have a plan.

We've tracked down a small gang of Amarrian ships nearby. Go in there and attack them so they call for backup, luring their recon ships in to assist; then you can pick them off once they arrive.
messages.zh:
多亏了你的帮助，我们建造了许多高级EMP立体炸弹。我们计划在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}进行测试，但好像艾玛情报部门有所觉察：艾玛正向我们所有的周围星系分派侦察舰。

{[character]player.name}，我们不能让他们观测到这次武器测试！我们需要袭击星系中的所有艾玛侦察舰，在他们跑回去传话之前消灭他们。我有个计划。

我们跟踪确定了附近一小群艾玛舰船的位置。去那里攻击他们，这样他们会召唤支援，把侦察舰都引来进行协助；一旦他们到达，你就可以把他们逐一干掉了。

messages.en: Not a single enemy ship escaped. The secret testing operation is secure.
messages.zh: 敌舰无一逃脱。秘密测试行动现在安全了。

messages.en:
The test went without a hitch, thanks to you and our other recon pilots! Now we're ready to take the fight to the enemy.

Come back and see me as soon as you can.
messages.zh:
测试进行得很顺利，这都得归功于我们其他的侦察飞行员啊！现在我们可以主动打击敌人了。

回来后尽快来见我。

messages.en: Sorry, no can do. Sounds like maybe you have something else for me, though?
messages.zh: 抱歉，我不想干。不过听起来你还有别的任务给我？

messages.en: Alright, that's fine — not every capsuleer develops recon skills, I know. Let me peruse these files and I'll see what else I can offer.
messages.zh: 好吧，没问题——不是每个飞行员都训练了侦察技能，我了解。我会仔细查看一下这些文件，看看还能提供什么别的任务。

messages.en:
Quitting a mission invariably results in a loss of faction standing; it is almost always in a character's best interest to complete all missions he or she accepts.

However, a character may freely decline a mission when it is first offered, as long as it isn't one of those rare "storyline" missions; after that, declining another mission within four hours of the first does result in a loss of standing. Still, in general, a capsuleer's career is usually long and eventful enough that a few such minor hits to standing may not be too large a price.
messages.zh:
退出任务会造成一定的势力声望损失；所以，为了对角色的利益着想，最好完成他或她接受的所有任务。

不过，当任务最初被提出时，角色可以自由拒绝该任务——只要这个任务不是罕见的“故事线”任务就行；不过，在拒绝首个任务后的4小时内，如果再拒绝一个任务，还是会导致声望的损失。不过，总的说来，一个飞行员的职业生涯会很长而且事件不断，一点这样小小的声望损失一般不会造成太大的影响。

messages.en: Missions and Standing
messages.zh: 任务和声望

messages.en:
Yes, of course. We waste your talents in such banalities, I realize. Still, thanks to your help, we've managed to build a number of the advanced EMP smart bombs. We've scheduled a live test in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, but it looks as if Amarrian intel has realized that something is up: Our spies tell us Amarr is dispatching recon ships to all our surrounding systems.

We can't let them observe this weapons test! We need someone to keep the gate closed. We need to hit any Amarrian recon ships in the system and destroy them before they can get word back to the enemy. And I have a plan.

We've tracked down a small gang of Amarrian ships nearby. If you were to go in there and attack them, they would call for backup, luring their recon ships in to assist; then you can pick them off once they arrive.

What do you say? This a little more up your alley? If not, well, I might have something else you can do to help.
messages.zh:
是的，当然。我已经意识到，我们把你的才能都浪费在这类平庸琐事上了。不过，多亏了你的帮助，我们建造了许多高级EMP立体炸弹。我们计划在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}进行一次实况测试，但好像艾玛情报部门有所觉察：据我们的间谍报告，艾玛正向我们所有的周围星系分派侦察舰。

我们不能让他们观测到这次武器测试！我们需要有人去帮我们守住这个秘密。我们需要袭击星系中的所有艾玛侦察舰，在他们跑回去传话之前消灭他们。我有个计划。

我们跟踪确定了附近一小群艾玛舰船的位置。如果你去那里攻击他们，他们就会召唤支援，把侦察舰都引来进行协助；一旦他们到达，你就可以把他们逐一干掉了。

你觉得怎么样？这是不是稍微合你胃口一点了呢？如果不行的话，我可能还有些别的你能帮忙的活。

messages.en: We needed help sooner than this, {[character]player.name}. I've gotten help elsewhere.
messages.zh: 我们需要你在更早的时候提供帮助，{[character]player.name}。我已经请他人帮忙了。

messages.en: Mission offer withdrawn
messages.zh: 任务收回

messages.en: Sorry, this was more than I could handle.
messages.zh: 抱歉，这超过了我的能力范围。

messages.en: Since you dawdled for too long, the enemy has observed our smart bomb test. They'll be coming here in force any time now, I'm sure. If you want to make up for this failure, come see me.
messages.zh: 由于你浪费了太多时间，敌人已经观测到了我们的立体炸弹测试。我肯定，他们的大军会随时开到。如果你想弥补这次失利，过来见我。

messages.en: Recon mission failed
messages.zh: 侦察任务未完成

name.de: Topf und Deckel - Auf in den Kampf (5 von 5)
name.en: Pot and Kettle - To Battle (5 of 5)
name.es: La sartén al cazo: A la batalla (5 de 5)
name.fr: L'hôpital et la charité - Au combat (5 sur 5)
name.ru: Котелок и чайник – в бой (Pot and Kettle - To Battle) (5 из 5)

messages.en: I'll blow those bastards back to hell!
messages.zh: 我会把那些混蛋重新炸回地狱里去！

messages.en: Prepare for launch then, captain. Good luck!
messages.zh: 那就准备出发吧，船长。祝你好运！

messages.en: Reporting back for more work — you said you might have something big this time?
messages.zh: 我回来领取更多任务了——你说过这次可能有个大买卖？

messages.en:
You've been with this assignment since the beginning, so you know we're involved in producing new high-tech EMP smart bombs. Our intel tells us that the enemy fleet is fielding a good number of electronic warfare frigates that like to orbit at close range. Fitting a smartbomb or two would counter this tactic of theirs quite effectively.

{[character]player.name}, it's up to you now.
messages.zh:
你自一开始便参与了这个任务，因此你知道我们在生产新的高科技EMP立体炸弹。据我们的情报部门报告，敌人舰队将动用许多善于进行近距离环绕的电子战护卫舰。装配一两个这样的立体炸弹将有效挫败他们的这一战术。

{[character]player.name}，现在就看你的了。

messages.en: Enemies destroyed. Smart bombs or otherwise, they didn't stand a chance.
messages.zh: 敌人已被摧毁。无论是否使用立体炸弹，他们根本没有赢得机会。

messages.en: You've done us an invaluable service! Let us hope this reward for a job well done, along with our eternal gratitude, will suffice.
messages.zh: 你为我们做出了宝贵的贡献！对于你的出色表现，我们希望这个奖励以及我们无尽的感激能够让你满意。

messages.en: That sounds suicidal. No offense, but I'm not the pilot for this one.
messages.zh: 那听起来像自尽。恕我冒昧，但我不是适合这个任务的飞行员。

messages.en: You've come this far and now you're backing out?!
messages.zh: 你已经走到这一步了，现在你却要退却？

messages.en:
You've been with this assignment since the beginning, so it's only fitting that you be the one to take the fight to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, where our scouts have detected part of an Amarrian fleet. The Navy will engage the main Amarrian force elsewhere, but we are confident that a capsuleer such as yourself, having proven your skills time and time again, can be trusted to deal with this smaller force.

Be careful out there, {[character]player.name}. I mean it: This one is not going to be easy.
messages.zh:
我们的侦察机在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了某艾玛舰队的部分舰只，由于你自一开始便参与了这个任务，因此由你将战线扩大到那里是再合适不过的。我们的海军将在别处与艾玛的主力部队作战，不过我们相信，一位像你这样一次又一次证明了自己实力的飞行员，一定能够胜任与这支小部队的战斗。

到那以后要小心，{[character]player.name}。我是说真的：这个任务可不容易。

messages.en: Sorry. There's no way I'm going to be able to complete this mission.
messages.zh: 抱歉。我不可能完成这个任务。

messages.en: You've come this far only to quit? I expected better of you.
messages.zh: 你已经走到这一步了，结果却要退出？看来我高估你了。

name.en: Pot and Kettle - Making Amends (5 of 5)
name.es: La sartén al cazo: Hacer las paces (5 de 5)
name.fr: L'hôpital et la charité - Amende honorable (5 sur 5)
name.ru: Котелок и чайник – исправление ошибок (Pot and Kettle - Making Amends) (5 из 5)

messages.en: Spare me the sarcasm, {[character]agentID.name}. Let's see you go out there and face down an Amarrian fleet! Just give me the stuff and I'll get it there, okay?
messages.zh: 别挖苦我了，{[character]agentID.name}。要不你出去和一整支艾玛舰队较量一下！直接把东西给我，然后我送过去，可以了吧？

messages.en: Ha! Some spirit after all. Good! We might make a decent pilot out of you yet!
messages.zh: 哈！终于有些士气了！不错！说不定我们可以把你培养成一个不错的飞行员呢！

messages.en: Uh, "failure" is such a strong word…. Anyway, what can I do?
messages.zh: 呃，“失利”这个字眼太重了……好吧，我能做什么？

messages.en: The Amarrians now know that we're manufacturing high-tech EMP smart bombs in this vicinity. They can't attack this station -- it's too well defended -- but they also know we need Mexallon to produce the bombs, and they are trying to cut off our supply. We need you to deliver some Mexallon to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh: 艾玛人已经知道我们在附近生产高科技EMP立体炸弹了。他们不可能攻击这座空间站，这里的防御实在太强了，但他们也知道，我们需要类银超金属来生产这些炸弹，所以他们打算切断我们的矿物供给。我们要你送一些类银超金属到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。

messages.en: Okay, your precious minerals are safe. Are we even now?
messages.zh: 好了，你那些珍贵的矿物都安全了。现在我们扯平了吧？

messages.en: Yes, you've erased that black mark on your record, {[character]player.name}, at least as far as I'm concerned. But do keep the insolence to a minimum from now on, hmm?
messages.zh: 是的，你已经抹掉了你记录中的污点，{[character]player.name}，至少我是这样想的。不过以后要克制你的傲慢无礼，嗯？

messages.en: Er, no thanks. I may not have been able to defeat the Amarrian fleet single-handedly, but I'm not some stupid courier.
messages.zh: 呃，不了，谢谢。我虽然单枪匹马没法打败艾玛舰队，但我也不至于给你当跑腿的。

messages.en: Coward! I knew you weren't up to it!
messages.zh: 胆小鬼！我就知道你干不了！

messages.en: As a result of your failure, the Amarrians now know that we're manufacturing high-tech EMP smart bombs in this vicinity. They can't attack this station — it's too well defended — but they also know we need Mexallon to produce the bombs, and they are trying to cut off our supply. We need someone to deliver some more Mexallon to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. You good for this job, at least?
messages.zh: 由于你的失利，艾玛人现在知道了我们正在附近生产高科技EMP立体炸弹。他们不可能攻击这座空间站，这里的防御实在太强了，但他们也知道，我们需要类银超金属来生产这些炸弹，所以他们打算切断我们的矿物供给。我们要找人送一些类银超金属到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。这个活儿你总能办好吧？

messages.en: The enemy has successfully shut down our advanced EMP smart bomb production. Your repeated failure to act has caused considerable damage to this sector.
messages.zh: 敌人已成功地让我们的高级EMP立体炸弹停产。你几次三番不履行任务，对本部门造成了严重损害。

messages.en: Your continuing failure
messages.zh: 你接二连三失职

messages.en: On second thought, I don't think I will deliver the Mexallon. Your insolence is just a bit too… insolent.
messages.zh: 在仔细考虑之后，我决定不去运送这些类银超金属。你的傲慢实在有些……无以复加。

messages.en: I knew you couldn't hack it, {[character]player.name}. You've just proven it… again.
messages.zh: 我就知道你搞不定，{[character]player.name}。你再次证明了这点。

messages.en: The enemy has successfully shut down our advanced EMP smart bomb production. Your repeated failure to act has caused considerable damage to this sector.
messages.zh: 敌人已成功地让我们的高级EMP立体炸弹停产。你几次三番不履行任务，对本部门造成了严重损害。

messages.en: Your continuing failure
messages.zh: 你接二连三失职

messages.en: I'm on it.
messages.zh: 我准备好了。

messages.en: Thanks, youngster! We'll make a real miner of you yet!
messages.zh: 谢谢你，年轻人！我们要让你成为一名真正的矿工！

messages.en: Just say the word.
messages.zh: 只要你一句话。

messages.en:
We recently found a number of new mining fields in adjacent systems, and the usual assortment of pirate trash has come out of the woodwork to exploit it. We'll need them mined soon because even those thieving bastards have friends in places high enough to put the legal status of these sites in doubt. For some reason they've taken an interest even in Banidine, too, and we'll need to find out why; all my workers are busy with the more profitable fields, but I'm not taking any chances.

I'm uploading a bookmark to your People & Places databank; it shows the location of a Banidine mining operation. I need you to head out there and mine all the Banidine. Should be 18,000 units, my foreman tells me. Once we've made an undisputed claim, we're free to mine there again without interference, and I'll provide you with a little something for your trouble.
messages.zh:
我们最近在毗邻的星系中发现了一些新的矿场，同时有些垃圾海盗也不甘寂寞，想要从中渔利。我们要赶紧开采这些矿场，不然的话，那些混蛋强盗在高层的朋友也许会跳出来，质疑我们拥有那些矿场的合法性。出于某种原因，他们居然对班尼德勒石也很感兴趣，我们要查明背后的玄机。我所有的工人现在都在开采其他更值钱的矿石，但我不愿意抱有侥幸心理。

我把一个位标上传到你的“人物与地点”表单中了，它显示的正是班尼德勒石的开采地点。我需要你现在就赶往那里，开采所有的班尼德勒石。哦，具体地说应该是18000个单位，这是我的矿头告诉我的。一旦我们拿到了无可争议的所有权，我们就可以在那里进行自由开采了，然后我会对你付出的努力给予适当奖励。

messages.en: Here's the Banidine ore, {[character]agentID.name}. Seems like a waste of time to me, but hey, you're paying.
messages.zh: 这是班尼德勒石，{[character]agentID.name}。在我看来有些浪费时间，不过反正你会付钱的。

messages.en: Listen, just leave the logistics of it all to me, okay? You mine, I plan, you mine some more. That's all you need to know.
messages.zh: 听着，把全部后勤工作都交给我就行了，知道吗？你采矿，我规划，然后你再采矿。你知道这些就够了。

messages.en: Most people don't go looking for Banidine: It's virtually worthless, so you simply won't find it on the market.
messages.zh: 大多数人不会去找班尼德勒石：它几乎没有价值，所以在市场上根本看不到。

messages.en: Banidine and Scanners
messages.zh: 班尼德勒石和扫描器

messages.en:
We recently found a number of new mining fields in adjacent systems, and the usual assortment of pirate trash has come out of the woodwork to exploit it. We'll need them mined soon because even those thieving bastards have friends in places high enough to put the legal status of these sites in doubt. For some reason they've taken an interest even in Banidine, too, and we'll need to find out why; all my workers are busy with the more profitable fields, but I'm not taking any chances.

I'm uploading a bookmark to your People & Places databank; it shows the location of a Banidine mining operation. I need you to head out there and mine all the Banidine — should be 18,000 units, my foreman tells me. Once we've made an undisputed claim, we're free to mine there again without interference, and I'll provide you with a little something for your trouble.
messages.zh:
我们最近在附近的星系中发现了一些新的矿场，同时那些垃圾海盗也出现了，也想要从中渔利。我们想要尽快的开采这些矿场，尽管那些混蛋乱序者在上面有人可能可以帮他们把这些矿场合法化。处于某种原因，他们居然对班尼德勒石也很感兴趣，我们得要知道为什么。我所有的工人现在都在开采那些更值钱的矿石，但我不愿意抱有侥幸心理。

我把一个位标上传到你的“地点与人物”表单中了，它显示的正是班尼德勒石的开采地点。我需要你现在就赶往那里，开采所有的班尼德勒石——应该是18,000个单位，这是我的采矿精英告诉我的。等我一旦拿到了非争议的所有权，我们就可以在那里进行自由的开采了，并且我会对你的麻烦给予一些帮助。

messages.en: I'm young, but I'm no rookie – I'll get your ore for you.
messages.zh: 我很年轻，不过我不是新手——我会帮你弄到矿石的。

messages.en: Thanks, youngster. You may prove yourself yet.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，年轻人。你现在可以证明你自己了。

messages.en: Yeah, I'm looking for work. Whatever you've got.
messages.zh: 是的，我想找活干。不管你有什么活都行。

messages.en:
Banidine is normally all but worthless, so real miners don't usually bother with the stuff. Still, I've found a buyer who's willing to take whatever we can mine. So, get me 20,000 units of Banidine and I'll make it worth your while.

There's an asteroid field near here that's lousy with the stuff – I've bookmarked it for you. Get back as soon as you can and I'll arrange a little bonus.

Remember to fit a decent miner to your ship before you go. If you're having trouble finding the Banidine at the mission location, loading the "Mining" default overview will show all ores. If you're familiar with creating custom overview settings, Banidine is shown by enabling "Veldspar".
messages.zh:
班尼德勒石基本没什么价值，所以真正的矿工通常并不在意它们。尽管如此，我还是找到了一个买主，他愿意买下所有的矿石。所以，给我20000单位的班尼德勒石，我会给你回报的。

有一个小行星带离这里很近，而且产量也很高。我为你标注好了位置。做完后马上回来，我会给你一些额外的奖励。

记住在去之前你的飞船上装配一个好用的采矿器。如果你无法在那地方找到那矿石，那你应该使用总览的“采矿”默认设置。如果你知道如何自定义总览的设置，那你只要选择“凡晶石”就行。

messages.en: Here's your ore, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 这是你要的矿石，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Not bad, youngster. Not bad.
messages.zh: 不错，年轻人。干得不坏。

messages.en:
The easiest way to travel to a destination system quickly is to use the Overview. Stargates are marked in the Overview settings panel under the "Celestial" group; once you have selected "Stargate" there, right-click on the hyperlinked destination system in the mission details and choose "Set destination." You will notice that the next stargate along your route, both in space and in your Overview, is now yellow.

Next, right-click on the yellow stargate (in space or in the Overview) and select "Warp to within 0m"; turn on your Autopilot, then sit back and relax until you are in the destination system.

After you have completed the mission, if you have problems finding your way back to the agent, simply open the "People and Places" window from your NeoCom and check the Agents tab; the agent you are working for should be displayed there. Right-click on the appropriate agent and select "Set destination," then turn on your Autopilot to make your way back to the agent's system.
messages.zh:
快速前往目标星系的最简单方法就是利用“总览”。你可以在“总览”设置面板的“天体”类目下找到“星门”；选好“星门”后，右击任务详情中附有超链接的目标星系，并选择“设置为终点”。你会注意到，无论从太空看还是从总览看，都会发现沿途的下一座星门呈黄色。

然后右击黄色星门（无论在太空中还是在总览中）并选择“跃迁至0公里内”；开启自动导航，然后安心坐等抵达目标星系即可。

完成任务后如果找不到与代理人碰面的路，只需打开控制边栏上的“人物和地点”窗口，并选择“代理人”标签，就会出现你目前效力的代理人。右击对应代理人并选择“设置为目标”，然后开启自动导航，指引你返回代理人所在的星系。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
Damnation, they're sending them out younger and younger. Are you sure you're old enough to fly a starship? Oh, well, we have to play the hand we're dealt, and if you're the best I can get, I suppose you'll do.

We'll start simple, youngster. Banidine is normally all but worthless, so real miners don't usually bother with the stuff. Still, I've found a buyer who's willing to take whatever we can mine. So, get me 20,000 units of Banidine and I'll make it worth your while. It should be easy, even for a pup like you, but it will show me that you're serious.

There's an asteroid field near here that's lousy with the stuff – I've bookmarked it for you. Get back as soon as you can and I'll arrange a little bonus.
messages.zh:
天啊，他们派出来的人越来越年轻了。你确信你已经老得不能驾飞船了吗？好吧，我们必须用我们的实力向他们证明一切，你是我能找到的最佳人选，我相信你不会让我失望的。

很简单，班尼德勒石很常见价值也不大，所以真正的矿工通常并不在意它们。然而，我还是找到了一个买主，他愿意买下所有的矿石。所以，给我20000单位的班尼德勒石，我会给你回报的。

有一个小行星带离这里很近，而且产量也很高。我为你标注好了位置。做完后马上回来，我会给你一些额外的奖励。

messages.en: Twenty thousand Banidine? That doesn't sound too tough. Sure, I'm good for it.
messages.zh: 两万单位班尼德勒石？这听起来倒不难。当然，我愿意做。

messages.en: Great, great. Maybe now I can get some work done.
messages.zh: 太好了，太好了。也许现在我的工作能取得些进展了。

messages.en: You look preoccupied. Something I can help you with?
messages.zh: 你看上去很心烦。我能帮上什么忙吗？

messages.en:
My boss wants Banidine; something to do with manufacturing cheaper parts for refrigeration units or something. I don't know. Point is, he's made it my job to get the ore. And now I'm makin' it your job.

There's a few Banidine rocks out at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, enough for 20,000 units, the scouts tell me. Go out there, mine it, bring it back. Should be easy enough, right?
messages.zh:
我的老板想要班尼德勒石；它好像是用于生产比较廉价的制冷部件或者别的什么东西。天晓得。关键是，弄矿石这件事是他分配给我的任务。而现在我要让你替我完成这个任务。

据侦察员说，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有些班尼德勒石，足够开采20000个单位。赶快去给我开采回来。这事不难吧？

messages.en: Here're your rocks.
messages.zh: 这是你要的石头。

messages.en:
Excellent! Maybe I'll finally get that raise.

Oh, uh, good job. Here's your payment.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮！也许我终于能得到那份盼望已久的加薪了。

哦，呃，干得好。这是你的报酬。

messages.en: Uhh... nah. Sorry. That's a little too pedestrian for me.
messages.zh: 呃……不了。抱歉，那对我来说有点太平淡无奇了。

messages.en: Dammit, don't make me mine this crap myself. I hate mining.
messages.zh: 该死，别让我去采这种垃圾。我讨厌采矿。

messages.en: Most people don't go looking for Banidine: It's virtually worthless, so you won't find it on the market. In fact, most sensor manufacturers don't even bother putting it into their mining packages when they produce ship scanners. If you're having trouble finding the Banidine at the mission location, you can right-click the "Banidine" icon in the mission details and select "Add to Overview."
messages.zh: 大多数人不会去找班尼德勒石：它几乎没有价值，所以在市场上根本看不到。实际上，大多数感应器生产商在生产舰船扫描器时，甚至不屑把这种矿石列入采矿扫描选项。如果在任务地点找不到班尼德勒石，那就右击任务详情中的“班尼德勒石”图标，然后选择“添加至总览”。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
Well, maybe, yeah. Have you ever heard of Banidine? Doesn't matter, you have now. Anyway, my boss wants the stuff. Why? I have no idea — something to do with manufacturing cheaper parts, refrigeration units or something. I don't know. Point is, he's made it my job to get the ore. And now, if you're interested, I'm makin' it your job.

There's a few Banidine rocks out at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, enough for 20,000 units, the scouts tell me. Go out there, mine it, bring it back. Should be easy enough, right?
messages.zh:
呃，可能吧，嗯。你听说过班尼德勒石吗？没关系，反正你现在知道了。不管怎样，我老板要这东西。为什么？我不知道——用于生产比较廉价的零件、制冷部件或者别的什么东西。天晓得。关键是，他让我给他搞矿石。现在，如果你有兴趣，我可以让它成为你的任务。

据侦察员说，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有些班尼德勒石，足够采集20000个单位。赶快去给我采回来。应该够简单的了，对吧？

messages.en: I can't wait around here forever. I'm getting someone else to mine the Banidine.
messages.zh: 我不能永远这样等。我会叫别人去采班尼德勒石。

messages.en: Your crippling indecisiveness
messages.zh: 你的犹豫不决真差劲

messages.en: The mining isn't done... but I'm done with it.
messages.zh: 采矿任务没完成……可是我受够了。

messages.en: Oh, for the love of... fine. Whatever. I'll get someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 噢，看在……好吧。随你的便。我会叫别人去做。
