name.en: Regional Stability - Moving the Consul (1 of 4)
name.es: Estabilidad regional: Trasladar al cónsul (1 de 4)
name.fr: Stabilité régionale - Déplacer le consul (1 sur 4)
name.ja: リージョン情勢の安定-コンサルの護送（1/4）
name.ru: Региональная стабильность – Перемещение консула (Regional Stability - Moving the Consul) (1 из 4)

messages.en: I will ensure the emissary arrives safely.
messages.zh: 我保证能将使节安全送达。

messages.en: And remember, that Minmatar consul must come to no harm.
messages.zh: 记住，不能让米玛塔尔领事受到伤害。

messages.en: You can trust me. What do you need done?
messages.zh: 你能信得住我。你需要我做些什么？

messages.en:
Last week a branch of the Achur monks calling itself the "Sagacious Path" began protesting some Caldari legislation. Their Minmatar allies, especially, are giving us a hard time. We aren't in a position to end these protests yet, so the next best thing is to end the Minmatar involvement.

The State wants you to go pick up the Minmatar emissary at the station he's residing in. Bring him back here, where he is to remain until this whole situation blows over.
messages.zh:
上个星期，一群自称为“明智之路”的阿赫尔僧侣开始对一些加达里法律采取抗议行动。尤其是他们的米玛塔尔同盟，给了我们不少压力。我们尚无法平息这些抗议，所以只能退而求其次，以终止米玛塔尔对此事的介入。

合众国要你去米玛塔尔使节居住的空间站，接他上你的飞船。然后把他带到这来，他将在这里一直待到整个局势平息下来。

messages.en: The Minmatar emissary has been safely relocated.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔使节已经安全转移。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. The consul is clearly unhappy with the whole affair, but he remains silent. Don't go far – I expect to have more work for you very soon.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。虽然领事明显对整个事件非常不满，但他保持了缄默。别跑太远了，我很快就有更多的活儿要你干。

messages.en: You have my sympathies, but I'm not about to ferry some Minmatar about just because a few Achura are upset.
messages.zh: 我很同情你，但我可不会因为几个闹腾的阿赫尔人而去运送什么米玛塔尔使节。

messages.en: Some day, you will learn just how important politics are; this job is vital. If you will not do it, I will find someone else.
messages.zh: 总有一天，你会了解政治的重要性。这个任务非常重要。如果你不愿意做，我会另请高明。

messages.en: Politics are an integral part of life in the EVE universe. The empires engage in a complex ballet of posturing, promises, and deception. Although empire politics rarely reach the all-out hostility common in lawless space or even along the empires' border zones, they are no less deadly.
messages.zh: 在新伊甸里，政治是人们生活中不可分割的一部分。帝国与帝国之间交织着各种错综复杂的政治立场、承诺和欺骗。尽管帝国政治几乎无法触及非法空间内的邪恶势力，甚至也不能影响帝国边界区域的犯罪分子，但帝国政治的致命性却丝毫不亚于这两者。

messages.en: The Game of Politics
messages.zh: 政治游戏

messages.en:
Last week a branch of the Achur monks calling itself the "Sagacious Path" began protesting some Caldari legislation. They claim the State has been abusing the Achura, steering them into supporting war with the Gallente Federation and its Minmatar allies. Now, groups like this crop up from time to time, and usually everything works itself out and goes back to the status quo.

Unfortunately, this group seems smarter and more determined than usual, staging rallies outside of foreign embassies, that sort of thing. They're getting some real attention now. The Minmatar especially are giving us a hard time. We aren't in a position to end these protests yet, so the next best thing is to end the Minmatar involvement.

The State wants you to go pick up the Minmatar emissary at the station he's residing in. Bring him back here, where he is to remain until this whole situation blows over.
messages.zh:
上个星期，一群自称为“明智之路”的阿赫尔僧侣开始对一些加达里法律采取抗议行动。他们声称合众国已开始虐待阿赫尔一族，并将其驱使到自身与盖伦特及其米玛塔同盟展开的战役中去。目前，诸如此类的事情此起彼伏，通常都是自然平息，而后又回来当前状态。

不幸的是，这个群体比那些纠集在外国大使馆外的力量看来更为机智，意志也更为坚定。他们目前正引起大家的关注。尤其是米玛塔方面，给了我们不少压力。我们尚无法平息这些抗议，所以只能退而求其次，以终止米玛塔尔对此事的介入。

合众国要你去米玛塔尔使节居住的空间站，接他上你的飞船。然后把他带到这来，他将在这里一直待到整个局势平息下来。

messages.en: The protests are heating up. The Minmatar are now using their Gallentean allies to pressure the State into recognizing the Sagacious Path as a political movement: For all intents and purposes, the dissenters have won legitimacy. The State will not soon forget this embarrassment.
messages.zh: 抗议正在不断升级。米玛塔尔人现在正通过其盖伦特盟友对合众国施压，要求合众国承认“明智之路”为政治运动。事实上，那些持不同政见者赢得了合法地位。合众国不会很快淡忘这次遭受的难堪。

messages.en: Sagacious Path recognized
messages.zh: “明智之路”得到承认

messages.en: To hell with politics. I will waste no more time on this.
messages.zh: 让政治滚蛋。我不会再为这个浪费时间。

messages.en: You do not understand what you have done. Through your failure to act, these dissenters have gained legitimacy. The State will not soon forget this embarrassment.
messages.zh: 你根本不明白你自己干了什么。由于你没有采取行动，那些持不同政见者取得了合法地位。合众国不会很快淡忘这次遭受的难堪。

messages.en: The protests are heating up. The Minmatar are now using their Gallentean allies to pressure the State into recognizing the Sagacious Path as a political movement: For all intents and purposes, the dissenters have won legitimacy. The State will not soon forget this embarrassment.
messages.zh: 抗议正在不断升级。米玛塔尔人现在正通过其盖伦特盟友对合众国施压，要求合众国承认“明智之路”为政治运动。事实上，那些持不同政见者赢得了合法地位。合众国不会很快淡忘这次遭受的难堪。

messages.en: Sagacious Path recognized
messages.zh: “明智之路”得到承认

name.ru: Региональная стабильность – цензура (Regional Stability - Censorship) (2 из 4)
name.zh: 区域稳定 – 审查制度(2/4)

messages.en: I got it. Consider the Scope silenced.
messages.zh: 我懂了。一定会让《视角》闭嘴。

messages.en: Excellent. Just remember: Destroy Scope array, good; kill reporters, BAD!
messages.zh: 很好。只是记住：摧毁《视角》的阵列，大功一件；加害记者，大错特错！

messages.en: The media? What are you getting at?
messages.zh: 媒体？你在指什么？

messages.en:
There's a group of Scope reporters sitting out at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They're feeding the Gallentean and Minmatar viewers exactly what they want to see: dissent in the State. We need you to... persuade these gentlemen to leave.

Of particular interest is their broadcast array: As soon as you warp in, target and destroy that array.

Do not concern yourself with the Scope reporters. They aren't fighters, and are likely to flee as soon as you start firing: Under no circumstances are you to kill any of them. That will only make the entire situation even more explosive.
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一群来自视角的播音员，他们让盖伦特和米玛塔尔的人民看到了他们想要看到的东西：合众国内部的争议。我们需要你去。。。说服这些绅士离开。

特别留心他们昂贵的的广播塔， 他们正是利用这个不间断地向宇宙的各个角落传递信息。当你接触他们时务必在第一时间摧毁他们的广播塔。

不用在意那些视角的播音员， 他们不是战士，很有可能在你开火的时候就逃之夭夭了。在任何情况下不要加害那些播音员，否则只会让这个事件更加棘手。

messages.en: The array has been taken care of.
messages.zh: 那座阵列已经得到处理了。

messages.en: Good work. And now it seems the Achur government has requested your help in another matter.
messages.zh: 干得好。似乎阿赫尔政府已经要求你就另一件事予以协助了。

messages.en: I will not threaten innocent civilians, no matter what your rationale.
messages.zh: 无论你有什么根本原因，我都不会去威胁无辜的平民。

messages.en: You are fooling yourself if you think the press is innocent in all this.
messages.zh: 如果你认为媒体在这件事中是完全无辜的话，你就是自欺欺人。

messages.en: Not all entities in deadspace pockets will immediately attack on sight. Some operate under orders to have limited engagement zones, while others are simply cowardly. Note, however, that nearly all starships or space station defenses will return fire if attacked first.
messages.zh: 不是死亡空间层中的所有单位都会一看到目标便发动攻击。有些单位接受了指令，要在一定的交战区域内采取行动，而另外一些则完全是胆小怕事。不过注意，如果首先遭到攻击，几乎所有的星舰或空间站防御设施都会反击。

messages.en: Rules of Engagement
messages.zh: 交战规则

messages.en:
The media can be as dangerous as an army. The masses are swayed by it, and the masses sway the politicians. There's a group of Scope reporters sitting out at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They're feeding the Gallentean and Minmatar viewers exactly what they want to see: dissent in the State. We need you to... persuade these gentlemen to leave.

Of particular interest is their broadcast array: It's an expensive piece of hardware that allows them to broadcast to the rest of the universe in real time. As soon as you warp in, target and destroy that array. Do not concern yourself with the Scope reporters. They aren't fighters, and are likely to flee as soon as you start firing. Under no circumstances are you to kill any of the reporters. That will only make the entire situation even more explosive.

Got it?
messages.zh:
媒体和军队一样危险。人民群众受媒体舆论的支配，随后又去影响政治家们的行为。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一群来自视角的播音员，他们让盖伦特和米玛塔尔的人民看到了他们想要看到的东西：合众国内部的争议。我们需要你去。。。说服这些绅士离开。

特别留心他们昂贵的的广播塔， 他们正是利用这个不间断地向宇宙的各个角落传递信息。当你接触他们时务必在第一时间摧毁他们的广播塔。不用在意那些视角的播音员， 他们不是战士，很有可能在你开火的时候就逃之夭夭了。在任何情况下不要加害那些播音员，否则只会让这个事件更加棘手。

你懂了吗？

messages.en: Scope just broadcast a special feature called Caldari: State of Fear. It is every bit the sort of drivel it sounds like, but the universe is buying it. Most of the footage came from the reporters you didn't scare off. We won't ask for your help again soon.
messages.zh: 《视角》刚刚播放了一部题为《加达里：恐怖国家》的专题片。这部片子就跟它的名字一样，非常牵强附会，但全宇宙都相信了它的内容。其中的大多数新闻镜头都是那些你没有吓跑的记者拍摄的。我们很长一段时间不会再要你帮忙了。

messages.en: State of Fear
messages.zh: 恐怖国家

messages.en: I thought I had it in me to scare some journalists, but I guess I don't.
messages.zh: 我本以为我有吓唬记者的本领，但我没有。

messages.en: The only thing worse than intimidating the press is failing at it. The Scope are now pressing even harder. The State is not going to come out of this looking good at all.
messages.zh: 比恐吓媒体更遭的事情就是恐吓未遂。《视角》现在比以前更咄咄逼人了。他们绝对会让合众国颜面无存。

messages.en: Scope just broadcast a special feature called Caldari: State of Fear. It is every bit the sort of drivel it sounds like, but the universe is buying it. Most of the footage came from the reporters you didn't scare off. We won't ask for your help again soon.
messages.zh: 《视角》刚刚播放了一部题为《加达里：恐怖国家》的专题片。这部片子就跟它的名字一样，非常牵强附会，但全宇宙都相信了它的内容。其中的大多数新闻镜头都是那些你没有吓跑的记者拍摄的。我们很长一段时间不会再要你帮忙了。

messages.en: State of Fear
messages.zh: 恐怖国家

name.fr: Stabilité régionale - Le maître des clés (3 sur 4)
name.ja: リージョン情勢の安定-キーの達人（3/4）
name.ru: Региональная стабильность – мастер ключей (Regional Stability - Key Master) (3 из 4)

messages.en: No worries. CONCORD won't even know I was there.
messages.zh: 不用担心。统合部根本就不会知道我去过那里。

messages.en: You were born for this kind of work, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你天生就是干这种活的料，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I think I have proven myself after the last mission. What is it?
messages.zh: 我想我在上次任务中证明了自己的能力。这是什么？

messages.en:
Despite your good work, reports are still coming from the protests. Individual citizens are spreading the news over the open channels, doing nearly as much damage as Scope. If stability is to return, we must prevent these amateur reports from getting out.

There is a fluid router nearby that is the primary hub for the areas where the Sagacious Path is protesting. One of our best contractors at a nearby station has managed to break the encryption key on the router. If you retrieve this key and bring it back to me here at {[location]agentStationID.name}, the State will be able to control what information enters and leaves the area.
messages.zh:
你干得不错，但来自抗议的报道仍在不断涌出。许多公民个体在公开频道散播消息，其造成的伤害几乎与《视角》一样大。如果要恢复稳定的秩序，我们必须阻止这些业余报道的流传。

在这附近有一部高效路由器，它是“明智之路”抗议所在地区的主要网络集线器。在附近一座空间站上有一位我们最出色的合同工，他已经破解了那部路由器上的加密钥匙。如果你能取回那把钥匙，并给我带到{[location]agentStationID.name}这来，合众国就能控制出入该区域的信息。

messages.en: I've returned with the encryption key. Hope it works out for you.
messages.zh: 我把加密钥匙带回来了。希望它对你有用。

messages.en: Fantastic. With this we can control what information enters — and leaves — the area. Now, come back as soon as possible: I have one more job for you.
messages.zh: 太棒了。有了这个，我们就可以随心所欲地控制这个区域里信息的进出了。好吧，如果可能，请尽快回来：我还有一份工作要给你。

messages.en: I will not do something this blatantly immoral. I'll do something else, but not this.
messages.zh: 我不会做这种赤裸裸地缺乏道德的事情。别的事情我可以做，但这个不行。

messages.en: Playing the good guy, eh? That's alright. I think we have something else for you.
messages.zh: 想当好好先生，呃？没关系。我们应该还有别的活给你。

messages.en: Fluid Routers are the backbone of interstellar communication. These devices make faster-than-light (FTL) communication possible. Though many are owned by private companies, they all fall under the purview of CONCORD, and tampering with them is considered a serious crime. Thanks to some complex legal loopholes, in this case you will not be doing anything illegal by transporting the encryption key.
messages.zh: 高效路由器是星际通信的支柱。这些设备使超光速通信成为了可能。虽然许多路由器都由私人集团拥有，但这些设备都由统合部看管，乱碰这些设备可是严重的罪行。不过庞杂的法律体系总有漏洞，正是多亏了这一点，你去运输加密钥匙根本算不上犯法。

messages.en: Fluid Routers and You
messages.zh: 你和高效路由器

messages.en:
You did well in kicking out Scope; aside from some minor whining, we have not heard anything from the Minmatar consulate. The Achura are viewing you as something of a good luck charm, it seems. In fact, they have asked for you to handle another task that some may view as dubious.

Despite your good work, reports are still coming from the protests. Individual citizens are spreading the news over the open channels, doing nearly as much damage as Scope. If stability is to return, we must prevent these amateur reports from getting out.

There is a fluid router nearby that is the primary hub for the areas where the Sagacious Path is protesting. One of our best contractors at a nearby station has managed to break the encryption key on the router. If you retrieve this key and bring it back to me here at {[location]agentStationID.name}, the State will be able to control what information enters and leaves the area.

And don't worry, I know what I'm asking you to do would be illegal under most any circumstances, we've been given dispensation by the State in this affair. Still, if you feel uneasy, I can come up with something less.... distasteful for you. Your choice.
messages.zh:
你做的不错，把《视角》清除出了我们的眼线；除一些零星的抱怨声外，我们尚未从米玛塔领事馆听说任何事情。看来阿赫尔已把你视为了幸运符。事实上，他们已向你指派了另外一项其他人可能犹豫不决的工作。

你干得不错，但来自抗议的报道仍在不断涌出。许多公民个体在公开频道散播消息，其造成的伤害几乎与《视角》一样大。如果要恢复稳定的秩序，我们必须阻止这些业余报道的流传。

在这附近有一部高效路由器，它是“明智之路”抗议所在地区的主要网络集线器。在附近一座空间站上有一位我们最出色的合同工，他已经破解了那部路由器上的加密钥匙。如果你能取回那把钥匙，并给我带到{[location]agentStationID.name}这来，合众国就能控制出入该区域的信息。

不用担心，我知道大多数情况下我指定给你的工作都是非法的，但是合众国在此事上已给予我们特许。你如果还感觉不适的话，我能给你一些其他活儿……但不合你胃口。你自己决定吧。

messages.en: Reports are flooding out from the protests. The amateur nature of the reports is actually making them more damaging than the Scope story was. The other empires are viewing the protesters as oppressed underdogs, which plays directly into the protesters' hands.
messages.zh: 来自抗议的报道如潮水般涌出。由于这些报道的非专业性质，它们比《视角》报道造成的伤害更大。其他帝国将这些抗议者视为受压迫者，而抗议者也恰恰利用了这一点。

messages.en: Sagacious Path Protests
messages.zh: “明智之路”抗议

messages.en: I can't continue in this immoral mission any longer. You mentioned that you could give me something else to do?
messages.zh: 我不能继续这个不道德的任务了。你说过，还有别的事情可以让我做？

messages.en: I didn't expect you to give up so soon. Yeah, okay. I have something else, I think.
messages.zh: 我想不到你这么快就要放弃。那么，好吧。我想我还有些别的活。

messages.en: Reports are flooding out from the protests. The amateur nature of the reports is actually making them more damaging than the Scope story was. The other empires are viewing the protesters as oppressed underdogs, which plays directly into the protesters' hands.
messages.zh: 来自抗议的报道如潮水般涌出。由于这些报道的非专业性质，它们比《视角》报道造成的伤害更大。其他帝国将这些抗议者视为受压迫者，而抗议者也恰恰利用了这一点。

messages.en: Sagacious Path Protests
messages.zh: “明智之路”抗议

name.de: Regionale Stabilität - Den Frieden wieder herstellen (4 von 4)
name.es: Estabilidad regional: Restaurar la paz (4 de 4)
name.fr: Stabilité régionale - Le retour de la paix (4 sur 4)
name.ja: 地域の安定-平和の回復（4/4）
name.ru: Региональная стабильность – восстановление мира (Regional Stability - Restoring Peace) (4 из 4)
name.zh: 区域稳定 – 恢复安宁(4/4)

messages.en: For the good of the State, it will be done.
messages.zh: 为了合众国的利益，我必将完成该任务。

messages.en: Go, citizen. Restore peace to our people.
messages.zh: 去吧，公民。将和平重新还给我们的人民。

messages.en: How do you suggest we do that?
messages.zh: 你建议我们该怎么做呢？

messages.en:
The Sagacious Path has been immune from action for too long. They've hidden behind the media. They've hidden behind civilians. Now they have nothing to hide behind. Our security forces have forced the Sagacious Path out of all State stations. Now they are concentrated in a few ships, rallying in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to plan their next disruption.

Warp in and compel the Sagacious Path to leave Caldari space. Use any means necessary. If any Sagacious Path remain in this area, or if anyone sees you and escapes, harmony will not return. Ensure that order prevails.
messages.zh:
很长时间以来我们对没办法对“明智之路”采取行动。他们躲藏在媒体后面。他们躲藏在民众后面。现在，他们无处可躲了。我们的安全部队将“明智之路”赶出了所有合众国的空间站。现在他们集中在一小批舰船上，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内重整旗鼓，酝酿着下一次分裂行动。

跃迁过去，迫使“明智之路”离开加达里空间。使用任何必要的手段。如果“明智之路”继续存在于这个地区，或者有任何人从你手里逃跑，和谐就永远无法归来。一定要保证秩序能够永存。

messages.en: The protests are officially over. None escaped the consequences of their dissention.
messages.zh: 抗议已然结束了。那些提出异议者都尝到了他们行为的后果。

messages.en:
Stability is returning to the area. Those who would change our ways have been silenced. And it is all thanks to you.

You have done the State and Achura a great service. But you must remain vigilant. In the war to come, the State will have need of elite agents like you.
messages.zh:
该区域正在重新恢复稳定。那些可以改变我们秩序的人都已经被封口了。这都多亏了你。

你为合众国和阿赫尔做出了巨大的贡献。但你必须保持警醒。在即将到来的战争中，合众国会需要你这样的精英特工。

messages.en: I cannot do this. There has to be a better way to resolve this.
messages.zh: 我不能这么做。肯定有更好的解决办法。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, there is no other way. I had thought you and I were of a mind in this. Clearly I was wrong.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，没有其他办法。我本以为在这事上我们是一条心。显然我错了。

messages.en: Capsuleer ships contain impressive amounts of monitoring equipment. This equipment is what allows CONCORD to respond so quickly when capsuleers attack each other in empire space. Regular ships usually lack such sophisticated equipment, making them particularly vulnerable. If these ships are destroyed in deadspace, it is likely no one would learn of it for some time.
messages.zh: 太空舱飞行员的舰船内含有数量惊人的监控设备。正是有了这种设备，当飞行员在帝国空间内相互攻击时，统合部才能极迅速地做出响应。普通飞船通常缺少如此精密的设备，使得它们极容易受攻击。如果这类飞船在死亡空间中被毁，可能在相当一段时间内都不会有人知道。

messages.en: CONCORD Monitoring
messages.zh: 统合部的监控

messages.en:
How else do you restore order? You remove the chaotic elements.

The Sagacious Path has been immune from action for too long. They've hidden behind the media. They've hidden behind civilians. Now they have nothing to hide behind. Our security forces have forced the Sagacious Path out of all State stations. Now they are concentrated in a few ships, rallying in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to plan their next disruption.

We will take advantage of this opportunity. You will warp in and compel the Sagacious Path to leave Caldari space. You are cleared to use any means necessary. If any Sagacious Path remain in this area, or if anyone sees you and escapes, harmony will not return. Ensure that it does.
messages.zh:
你还能怎么样恢复秩序？我们需要你去排除这些不安定因素。

很长时间以来我们对没办法对“明智之路”采取行动。他们躲藏在媒体后面。他们躲藏在民众后面。现在，他们无处可躲了。我们的安全部队将“明智之路”赶出了所有合众国的空间站。现在他们集中在一小批舰船上，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内重整旗鼓，酝酿着下一次分裂行动。

我们要利用这次机会，跃迁过去，迫使“明智之路”离开加达里空间。使用任何必要的手段。如果“明智之路”继续存在于这个地区，或者有任何人从你手里逃跑，和谐就永远无法归来。一定要保证秩序能够永存。

messages.en: The Sagacious Path have resumed protests, and we have failed to reach our goals in this matter. I believed you to be a person of action. Clearly I was mistaken.
messages.zh: “明智之路”又恢复了抗议行动，我们未能达成目标。我原来以为你是个用行动说话的人。显然我错了。

messages.en: Sagacious Path return
messages.zh: “明智之路”东山再起

messages.en: I cannot do this. There has to be a better way to resolve this.
messages.zh: 我不能这么做。肯定有更好的解决办法。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, there is no other way. I had thought you and I were of a mind in this. Clearly I was wrong.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，没有其他办法。我本以为在这事上我们是一条心。显然我错了。

messages.en: The Sagacious Path have resumed protests, and we have failed to reach our goals in this matter. I believed you to be a person of action. Clearly I was mistaken.
messages.zh: “明智之路”又恢复了抗议行动，我们未能达成目标。我原来以为你是个用行动说话的人。显然我错了。

messages.en: Sagacious Path return
messages.zh: “明智之路”东山再起

name.de: Regionale Stabilität - Den Helden spielen (4 von 4)
name.es: Estabilidad regional: Hacerse el héroe (4 de 4)
name.fr: Stabilité régionale - Jouer les héros (4 sur 4)
name.ja: 地域の安定-英雄気取り（4/4）
name.ru: Региональная стабильность – игра в героя (Regional Stability - Playing Hero) (4 из 4)
name.zh: 区域稳定 – 扮演英雄(4/4)

messages.en: If I accomplish nothing else, I will have done some good in this.
messages.zh: 如果我在别的方面没有什么成就的话，至少我能通过这件事行些善。

messages.en: You're our best hope, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你是我们最大的希望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I've already told you, I will not do anything immoral.
messages.zh: 我已经告诉过你了，我不会做任何不道德的事。

messages.en:
There is a terrorist cell comprised of Matari and Gallentean extremists out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They plan to use the recent unrest to bomb several key Achur sites. For security reasons I cannot reveal their targets, but it is truth when I tell you that countless civilians will die unless we act.

Fly to their hideout. Destroy their cell before they succeed in their terrible goals.
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一个居住着玛塔利和盖伦特极端分子的恐怖分子居住舱。他们打算趁最近的动乱来炸毁几处重要的阿赫尔基地。出于安全原因，我不能透露他们的目标，但有件事是肯定的，如果我们不行动，无数平民将死亡。

飞到他们的藏身处。摧毁他们的居住舱，让他们的恐怖阴谋无法得逞。

messages.en: I stopped the terrorists. The Caldari State is safe from foreign aggression once again.
messages.zh: 我阻止了那些恐怖分子。加达里合众国又一次在外来侵略中安然无恙。

messages.en:
You're alive!? Ah... excellent! Well done, {[character]player.name}. The State is indeed in your debt.

While you were defending our people from foreign extremists, our peacekeeping forces have dealt with the Sigacious Path. They will not be seen here again. Now peace and stability can return to the area.

Did I mention how glad I am to see you've returned safely?
messages.zh:
你还活着！？啊……太棒了！干得好，{[character]player.name}。合众国欠你情。

当你在保护我们的人民免受外来极端分子伤害的时候，我们的维和部队正在对付“明智之路”。他们再也不会在这里出现了。现在，安宁和稳定终于能重返该区域了。

哦，我跟你提了吗，见到你安全回来我真高兴啊？

messages.en: I don't trust you. Not anymore.
messages.zh: 我不信任你。再也不信任了。

messages.en: You don't trust us? I shall shed a single tear.
messages.zh: 你不信任我们？我会落泪的，不过就一滴。

messages.en:
I know. The truth is we've been waiting for someone of your moral caliber. Now listen closely: This is an urgent matter.

There is a terrorist cell comprised of Matari and Gallentean extremists out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They plan to use the recent unrest to bomb several key Achur sites. For security reasons I cannot reveal their targets, but it is truth when I tell you that countless civilians will die unless we act.

Fly to their hideout. Destroy their cell before they succeed in their terrible goals.
messages.zh:
我知道。事实上，我们一直在等待像你这样有道德觉悟的人。好了，仔细听着：这是个紧急事件。

在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一个居住着玛塔利和盖伦特极端分子的恐怖分子居住舱。他们打算趁最近的动乱来炸毁几处重要的阿赫尔基地。出于安全原因，我不能透露他们的目标，但有件事是肯定的，如果我们不行动，无数平民将死亡。

飞到他们的藏身处。摧毁他们的居住舱，让他们的恐怖阴谋无法得逞。

messages.en: You have wasted enough of my time. I consider our business through.
messages.zh: 你浪费了我够多时间了。我们的业务关系到此为止。

messages.en: Business concluded
messages.zh: 业务终止

messages.en: I am not up to this task. May the State forgive me.
messages.zh: 我没能力执行这件任务。希望合众国原谅我。

messages.en: The State forgives you, {[character]player.name}. But will you forgive yourself?
messages.zh: 合众国原谅你，{[character]player.name}。但你能原谅你自己吗？

messages.en: You have wasted enough of my time. I consider our business through.
messages.zh: 你浪费了我够多时间了。我们的业务关系到此为止。

messages.en: Business concluded
messages.zh: 业务终止

name.de: Allgemeinwohl - Falsche Positionierung von Vorräten (1 von 5)
name.es: Por el bien común: Suministros extraviados (1 de 5)
name.ja: 崇高なる善―援助物資の誤配（1/5）
name.ru: Общее благо – доставка не по адресу (Greater Good - Misplacing Supplies) (1 из 5)
name.zh: 人类大义 – 错放物资（1/5）

messages.en: I am. Just tell me where to go.
messages.zh: 当然。告诉我该去哪儿吧。

messages.en: Um, it's bad? Is this a trick?
messages.zh: 嗯，这是坏事？你是在逗我吗？

messages.en: Pick up the supplies and bring them back to your agent at {[location]agentStationID.name}.
messages.zh: 去把物资装上飞船，把它们带回到{[location]agentStationID.name}的代理人那里。

messages.en: I've got the supplies you asked for.
messages.zh: 我已经拿到你要的物资了。

messages.en: I can see that you have principles, {[character]player.name}. Come back when you're ready to act on them again.
messages.zh: 我能看出你是一个有原则的人，{[character]player.name}。等你准备好对他们采取行动后再回来吧。

messages.en: I don't like the sound of this. I'll pass.
messages.zh: 我不喜欢你的弦外之音。我不干。

messages.en: Some people just aren't ready to serve the greater good.
messages.zh: 有些人就是没有为全人类大义服务的觉悟。

messages.en: While the Gallente Federation officially condemns Amarr for practicing slavery, they fear to take any action that might lead to outright war. Some individuals feel that it is well past the time for mere words, and that action is long overdue.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦虽然公开谴责艾玛的劳工制度，但他们害怕采取任何可能引发全面战争的行动。有个别人认为，现在光说几句话已经远远不够了，早该采取行动了。

messages.en: As Things Stand
messages.zh: 现状

messages.en:
I — and a number of other members of the Federation — believe that the official position we have taken regarding the Amarrian enslavement of the Matari people is far too lenient. We feel that something must be done to eliminate this dehumanizing practice within our lifetimes, and if we are to see action, we must take it ourselves.

Amarr slavers commit atrocities on a regular basis, and while they do not hide this fact, they can hardly be expected to advertise it. We must bring the attention of the masses to focus upon the sheer cruelty of the slavers… even if it is necessary for us to manipulate the facts of the situation to do so.

Are you willing to stand with us, to do what is necessary?
messages.zh:
我，还有不少联邦里的其他人，都认为对于艾玛人奴役玛塔利人民一事，当局的立场过于仁慈。我们认为必须要做点什么，在我们的有生之年里铲除这种灭绝人性的行为，如果我们希望行动出现，我们就必须亲自动手。

艾玛劳工贩子的凶残恶行时有发生，虽然他们不隐瞒这一事实，但也不至于会自己去宣传。我们必须令群众关注这些劳工贩子的残酷本性……为了达到这个目的，即使有必要篡改事实真相，我们也在所不惜。

你愿不愿意和我们一道，做一些该做的事情？

messages.en: The shipment is already on its way. We'll have to wait for another chance, and while we do, more will die in durance vile.
messages.zh: 运输船现在已经上路了。我们只能等下一个机会了，与此同时，又有许多人会在恶劣的监禁环境中死去。

messages.en: Carpe… nothing
messages.zh: 一无所获

messages.en: I figured out what you're doing here, and I don't want to be part of it.
messages.zh: 我猜到你的目的了，我不想加入。

messages.en: Some people just aren't ready to serve the greater good.
messages.zh: 有些人就是没有为全人类大义服务的觉悟。

messages.en: The shipment is already on its way. We'll have to wait for another chance, and while we do, more will die in durance vile.
messages.zh: 运输船现在已经上路了。我们只能等下一个机会了，与此同时，又有许多人会在恶劣的监禁环境中死去。

messages.en: Carpe… nothing
messages.zh: 一无所获

name.es: Por el bien común: Asuntos desagradables (2 de 5)
name.fr: Intérêt général - Des affaires désagréables (2 sur 5)
name.ja: 崇高なる善–不愉快な問題（2/5）
name.ru: Общественное благо – неприятная работа (Greater Good – Distasteful Matters) (2 из 5)
name.zh: 人类大义 – 勉为其难(2/5)

messages.en: You're making sense to me. I'm in.
messages.zh: 你说的有道理。我干。

messages.en: Don't worry, we will make sure that the blame for this action falls where it truly belongs — on the Amarr.
messages.zh: 别担心，我们会确保这次行为将被归咎于真正罪有应得的人——艾玛人。

messages.en: I think so. Depends, I guess.
messages.zh: 我想可以。不过要视情况而定。

messages.en:
We have the location of a small, unmanned Minmatar convoy that's carrying relief supplies to an Amarr slave camp. It's the kind of effort that's likely to do more harm than good in the long run. Slavery doesn't look as bad if the slaves are well-cared for.

I need you to destroy that convoy; once you're done, I'll have my people arrange something at the scene that points back to the Amarr. After all, they're the ones responsible for this whole mess.
messages.zh:
我们获得了一支无人驾驶的小型米玛塔尔护航队的位置，它们正在运输救济补给前往一座艾玛劳工营。从长远角度看，这种行为带来的坏处比好处更多。如果劳工得到精心照顾，劳工制的恶劣就没法充分体现了。

我要你前去摧毁那支护航队，在你任务完成后，我将派我的人在现场留下些东西，将矛头指向艾玛人。说到底，他们才是要对这所有一切负责的人。

messages.en: I've done what you asked. None the wiser.
messages.zh: 我已经照你说的做了。 不过还是不明白为什么。

messages.en: Excellent. Come back to me when you're ready to do some more work for the cause.
messages.zh: 很好。等你准备好为这个事业尽更多力量的时候再来找我吧。

messages.en: That's entirely too heavy for me. I'm not going to go destroy relief ships. You're crazy!
messages.zh: 那对我来说实在太艰巨了。我不会去袭击救济舰的。你太疯狂了！

messages.en: Crazy or no, this work needs doing. But I'll find someone else, fine. Talk to me in a bit and I'll have something else for you instead, something that won't ruffle your moral feathers.
messages.zh: 不管是否疯狂，这项工作都必须做。好吧，我会另觅人选。过一会再来找我，我会找些别的事给你，一些不会刺激你的道德良知的事。

messages.en: Though Scope (the corporation taking its name from its famed primetime holocast, The Scope) was originally based inside the Gallente Federation, it has expanded to the point where it is now considered the leading news agency throughout the empires.
messages.zh: 虽然视角传媒(名称取自该集团著名的黄金时段全息节目，《视角》)最初立足于盖伦特联邦境内，现在已经发展为遍布各大帝国的主要新闻机构。

messages.en: The Scope
messages.zh: 视角传媒

messages.en:
You did well with the last task I gave you. A careful leak to my contact at the Scope got us into the news: a minor story about slaves being allowed to starve under Amarrian "care." A minor story! We're going to need a lot more than that to achieve our goals.

So, this time, we're getting a little more high-profile.

We have the location of a small, unmanned Minmatar convoy that's carrying relief supplies to an Amarr slave camp. It's the kind of effort that's likely to do more harm than good in the long run. Slavery doesn't look as bad if the slaves are well-cared for.

I need you to destroy that convoy; once you're done, I'll have my people arrange something at the scene that points back to the Amarr. After all, they're the ones responsible for this whole mess.

I can see you blanching at this: Trust me, it's for the best. But if you really can't bring yourself to do it, well, then let me know and I'll give you something less... distasteful.
messages.zh:
上次交给你的任务你完成的非常好。通过一些安排，我们在视角传媒的内线给我们上了条新闻：“关于劳工被饿死在艾玛劳工营事件的一个小插曲。”小插曲！我们需要更大的影响力来完成我们的目标。

所以，这次我们要再高调一些。

我们获得了一支无人驾驶的小型米玛塔尔护航队的位置，它们正在运输救济补给前往一座艾玛劳工营。从长远角度看，这种行为带来的坏处比好处更多。如果劳工得到精心照顾，劳工制的恶劣就没法充分体现了。

我要你前去摧毁那支护航队，在你任务完成后，我将派我的人在现场留下些东西，将矛头指向艾玛人。说到底，他们才是要对这所有一切负责的人。

我知道你有些害怕，相信我这是最好的办法。不过如果你觉得无法接受的话，请告诉我，我会给你另找些下得了手的活儿。

messages.en: The convoy reached its destination, and people have the nerve to praise the Amarr for allowing the aid through! Work this important has to be done fast.
messages.zh: 护航队到达了目的地，居然还有人对艾玛人允许补给物资通过表示赞扬！这么重要的工作应该快些完成。

messages.en: The damage is done
messages.zh: 造成损失

messages.en: I can't do this. The people we're hurting are the Minmatar who need these supplies!
messages.zh: 我不能这么做。我们所伤害的人正是那些需要补给的米玛塔尔人。

messages.en: I understand. Some people don't have the breadth of view necessary to serve the greater good.
messages.zh: 我明白。有些人就是没有为全人类大义服务的胸怀。

messages.en: The convoy reached its destination, and people have the nerve to praise the Amarr for allowing the aid through! Work this important has to be done fast.
messages.zh: 护航队到达了目的地，居然还有人对艾玛人允许补给物资通过表示赞扬！这么重要的工作应该快些完成。

messages.en: The damage is done
messages.zh: 造成损失

name.en: Greater Good – Poisoning the Well (3 of 5)
name.es: Por el bien común: Veneno en el pozo (3 de 5)
name.fr: L'intérêt général - Empoisonner le puits (3 sur 5)
name.ru: Общее благо – отравление колодца (Greater Good – Poisoning the Well) (3 из 5)
name.zh: 人类大义 – 井中计谋（3/5）

messages.en: Okay, I can do that.
messages.zh: 好的，这事我能办。

messages.en: This may not seem difficult, but it is very important. Act quickly.
messages.zh: 这也许看上去不难，但非常重要。行动要快。

messages.en: Maybe. What do you want me to do this time?
messages.zh: 也许吧。这回你想要我干什么？

messages.en: Take the Food-Borne Toxin to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and report back to your agent.
messages.zh: 把食源性毒素带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，然后回去向你的代理人汇报。

messages.en: I left the item where you told me to.
messages.zh: 我把那件东西放到你说的地方了。

messages.en: So I heard. You're doing a difficult job, and doing it well, {[character]player.name}. Come see me when you're ready to take the next step.
messages.zh: 我听到了。你完成了一件困难的任务，而且干得很漂亮，{[character]player.name}。等你准备好下一步行动的时候就来找我吧。

messages.en: I'm not sure what you're planning, but I'm through with it.
messages.zh: 我不大清楚你的计划，但我受够这一切了。

messages.en: I'm not sure why you're quitting now.
messages.zh: 我不知道你为什么要现在退出。

messages.en:
The Scope picked up on the destruction of a certain Minmatar relief convoy, alright, but the story suggested that the whole thing was a military accident. An accident! How dangerous did that convoy look to you?!

Well, anyway, now the public has the idea that the Amarr are just a bit incompetent, that their destruction of a relief convoy was merely overzealous rather than malicious. So now we need to show people how dangerous Amarrian incompetence can be.

I need you to take this… er, well, the item I'm about to give you... to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Leave it in your hangar there, and my contact will see that it makes its way into... well, where it needs to go. The less you know, maybe, the better?
messages.zh:
视角报道了关于米玛塔尔救济船队摧毁的事件，不错，但报道暗示整个事件是一个军事意外。一个意外！在你看来这个船队有多危险？！

好吧，但无论如何，现在公众眼中艾玛有点没用,他们摧毁一个救援车队，只不过是过份，而不是恶意的。因此，我们现在必须让人们看看艾玛人有多么危险。

我需要你利用这个…呃，好了,我马上要给你的东西…到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去.把它留在那的机库里，在那里，我的亲信会看到它去了……嗯，它该去的地方。也许,你知道的越少越好？

messages.en: This is messed up. I'm out of here.
messages.zh: 这实在太混乱了。我闪了。

messages.en: I'm not sure why you're quitting now.
messages.zh: 我不知道你为什么要现在退出。

name.es: Por el bien común: Medidas drásticas (4 de 5)
name.ja: 崇高なる善―抜本的対策（4/5）
name.ru: Общественное благо – крайние меры (Greater Good - Drastic Measures) (4 из 5)
name.zh: 人类大义 – 极端措施(4/5)

messages.en: I'll blow up the ship, just like before. 'Nuff said.
messages.zh: 我会炸了那艘船的，就跟以往一样。完毕。

messages.en: I realize this is difficult, but believe me, it must be done.
messages.zh: 我知道这很困难，不过相信我，这件事非做不可。

messages.en: What's happened?
messages.zh: 发生了什么？

messages.en: Destroy the CONCORD Committee Vessel so that the Amarr Empire can be blamed for the act.
messages.zh: 摧毁统合部委员会船只，然后艾玛帝国将为这次行动受到谴责。

messages.en: I did what you asked of me.
messages.zh: 我已照你说的做了。

messages.en: Come see me again soon. This isn't over yet.
messages.zh: 一会儿来见我。这事还没完呢。

messages.en: I'm not interested in messing with CONCORD. You nuts?!
messages.zh: 我没兴趣招惹统合部。你是不是疯了？！

messages.en: I'm sorry you don't have the nerve to do what must be done.
messages.zh: 很遗憾，你没有胆量去做该做之事。

messages.en: The Gallentean super-corporation Egonics Inc. uses a special intracranial technology for broadcasting sound that has been outlawed in the Amarr Empire.
messages.zh: 盖伦特超级集团自尊集团使用一种特殊的颅内技术来播放在艾玛帝国内被禁的声音材料。

messages.en: Egonics Inc.
messages.zh: 自尊集团

messages.en:
Finally, we're getting noticed. Egonics picked up the last story — how Amarr standards are so lax that they fed contaminated rations to their slaves. Egonics isn't keen on the Amarr anyway, so they really let them have it.

Here's the thing, though: The food poisoning outbreak affected so many people that it showed up on CONCORD's radar. They've sanctioned a small independent committee to inspect the conditions in one of the slave colonies. Ridiculous as it sounds, they're checking the conditions in which people are being kept as livestock.

The ship is due to arrive in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} soon. Our cause will be better served if it never gets there. Obviously, that will look bad for the Amarr; it might even make people reconsider what happened to the last non-Amarr ship that tried to reach one of their slave colonies.

Do you understand what I need you to do?
messages.zh:
终于，我们引起了人们的注意。看一下自尊集团的最后一篇报道:艾玛帝国是如此差劲，他们竟给劳工们喂食受污染的粮食。总之，自尊集团与艾玛可不怎么投缘，他们巴不得能有这样的“好”消息。

是这样：这次食物中毒事件影响甚大，引起了统合部的注意。他们派遣了一支独立调查委员会来调查其中一个劳工殖民地的情况。很可笑吧，他们竟然去调查那种把劳工当牲口的地方。

他们的船很快就会到达{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。如果它到不了的话会对我们非常有利。显然，这会对艾玛的非常不利，甚至让人们再次反思上一次去劳工营的非艾玛船只究竟发生了什么。

你明白我要你做什么了吧？

messages.en: The ship was still destroyed, but the Empire managed to dodge the blame again. I've been hearing stories ranging from pirates to equipment failure. If you had done as I asked, at least some good would have come of this destruction.
messages.zh: 那艘飞船还是被摧毁了，不过帝国再一次逃脱了指责。关于这个事件，我听到了各种各样的版本，从海盗袭击到设备故障都有。如果你照我要求的去做，那么飞船的破坏至少会带来一些有益的结果。

messages.en: You're too late.
messages.zh: 你太迟了。

messages.en: No way am I going up against CONCORD. You nuts?!
messages.zh: 我决不会跟统合部对着干。你是不是疯了？！

messages.en: I'm sorry you've lost the nerve to do what must be done.
messages.zh: 很遗憾，你没有胆量去做该做之事。

messages.en: The ship was still destroyed, but the Empire managed to dodge the blame again. I've been hearing stories ranging from pirates to equipment failure. If you had done as I asked, at least some good would have come of this destruction.
messages.zh: 那艘飞船还是被摧毁了，不过帝国再一次逃脱了指责。关于这个事件，我听到了各种各样的版本，从海盗袭击到设备故障都有。如果你照我要求的去做，那么飞船的破坏至少会带来一些有益的结果。

messages.en: You're too late.
messages.zh: 你太迟了。

name.es: Por el bien común: Estómago fuerte (5 de 5)
name.fr: Intérêt général - Estomac bien accroché (5 sur 5)
name.ja: 崇高なる善―強靭な胃袋（5/5）
name.ru: Общественное благо – крепкий желудок (Greater Good - Strong Stomach) (5 из 5)
name.zh: 人类大义 – 忍辱负重(5/5)

messages.en: You're right, a quick death is better. I'll destroy the colony and bring back what survivors I can.
messages.zh: 你是对的，痛快一死好过活受罪。我会摧毁殖民地，然后尽量带回幸存者。

messages.en: You are sparing those people from Amarr aggression. Surely death is better than servitude.
messages.zh: 你使那些人免遭了艾玛人的侵犯。死亡当然要好过被奴役。

messages.en: What's going on now? You've got more work, you said, right?
messages.zh: 现在情况怎么样了？你说过你还有更多任务，是吧？

messages.en:
Since we've drawn so much attention to the plight of the Matari, there's been a news leak: one of the slave colonies has staged a rebellion. Now, the Amarr always respond to rebellion with brute force, so those people are pretty much doomed. But we can save them, and still make it look like they all perished once again at the hands of the Amarrians.

Destroy the mining colony before the Amarrians do, and bring the survivors back here for safekeeping.
messages.zh:
我们已经把大量的注意力引向玛塔利劳工的境遇，有消息称：其中一个劳工殖民地正在策划一次叛乱。现在艾玛对叛乱总是施以残酷的控制，所以那些劳工算是玩完了。不过我们可以拯救他们，并且做得让人以为他们死了，就像是被艾玛人害死的。

赶在艾玛人之前摧毁采矿殖民地，然后把幸存者带回这里保护起来。

messages.en: I've done what you asked. I'm not sure how to feel about it, though.
messages.zh: 我已经照你说的做了。 不过我无法确定我对这件事的感受。

messages.en: You display exemplary moral fiber. Not many have the sheer grit to do so many unpleasant things in the service of their fellow man.
messages.zh: 你是道德品质的典范。不是很多人都有勇气为了人类同胞而做这么多令人为难的事。

messages.en: This is going too far. No, I'm done.
messages.zh: 这实在太离谱了。不，我不干了。

messages.en: I'm sorry you're not willing to make the necessary sacrifice.
messages.zh: 你不愿意做出必要的牺牲，这让我很遗憾。

messages.en: Impetus is the main producer of holoreels in the universe today. In recent years, they have led the development of instant news arrays. Impetus predicts that when these arrays are completed, they will revolutionize the news business.
messages.zh: 促进工业是当今宇宙中主要的全息记忆盘生产商。近年来，他们领导着即时新闻阵列的开发。促进工业预言，一旦这些阵列开发完成，将给新闻产业带来巨大变革。

messages.en: Impetus
messages.zh: 促进工业

messages.en:
Impetus is considering putting out a new holoreel about the enslaved Matari. Now that people think the Amarr would rather blow up CONCORD ships than allow the public to see how slaves are treated, there's talk of a major project, not just a documentary. This is exactly what we need!

News and documentaries are useful, but this would really reach the public. The average person needs things black and white, and that's what holos are for.

This is the last thing I'm going to ask of you, and it won't be easy. Since we've drawn so much attention to the plight of the Matari, there's been a news leak: one of the slave colonies has staged a rebellion. Now, the Amarr always respond to rebellion with brute force, so those people are pretty much doomed.

But we can save them--at least a good number of them--and still make it look like they all perished, once again at the hands of the Amarrians. And it's unlikely Amarr will even bother to deny responsibility since everyone knows they'd destroy the whole colony anyway. Remember, if you leave it to the Amarr to destroy the colony themselves, those Matari will only suffer further torture and degradation, and then be killed anyway.

Can you do this final task for the cause?
messages.zh:
促进工业正考虑放出一段新的关于玛塔利劳工的全息记录盘。大家都认为，艾玛宁愿毁了统合部的船，也不希望公众看见那些劳工是如何被对待的，有传言说其中包含一个重要的项目，而不仅仅是一段记录片。这正是我们所要的！

普通的新闻和记录片当然有用，但难以真正憾动公众。老百姓要的是清晰而残酷的事实，那正是全息记录盘所能做到的。

这是我对你的最后一个要求，它不会那么轻松。我们已经把大量的注意力引向玛塔利劳工的境遇，有消息称：其中一个劳工殖民地正在策划一次叛乱。现在艾玛对叛乱总是施以残酷的控制，所以那些劳工算是玩完了。

不过我们可以拯救他们——至少他们中的大部分——并且做得让人以为他们死了，就像是被艾玛人害死的。而且艾玛人应该不会在意被人栽赃，反正大家都知道他们要控制劳工殖民地。记住，如果你让艾玛来摧毁劳工殖民地的话，那些玛塔利劳工会受到更残酷的折磨和更深重的摧残，还会死无全尸。

你能为我们的事业再努力一次，完成这最后的任务吗？

messages.en:
Amarr retook the colony. They captured the leaders for transportation and torture, followed by public execution. Well, the men, at least. The women were lobotomized and transferred to breeding colonies. Everyone else involved was merely spaced.

So as you can see, you did them no favors.
messages.zh:
艾玛重新夺回殖民地。他们抓获了抗争首领，将他们转移，施以酷刑，再公开处决。至少对所有男性是这样的。女性被切除了脑白质，然后被转移到繁殖殖民地。其余所有参与者都只是被隔离了。

所以你看，你根本没帮上他们什么忙。

messages.en: This is just too creepy. I'm done with you.
messages.zh: 这实在太令人生厌了。我不给你干了。

messages.en: I'm sorry you're not willing to make the necessary sacrifice.
messages.zh: 你不愿意做出必要的牺牲，这让我很遗憾。

messages.en:
Amarr retook the colony. They captured the leaders for transportation and torture, followed by public execution. Well, the men, at least. The women were lobotomized and transferred to breeding colonies. Everyone else involved was merely spaced.

So as you can see, you did them no favors.

所以你看，你根本没帮上他们什么忙。

messages.en: I'm on my way. Don't worry.
messages.zh: 我这就出发。别着急。

messages.en: Splendid. Don't waste a second.
messages.zh: 好极了，别浪费时间。

messages.en: Procure 20 holoreels from any source and transport them to the station whose coordinates I've uploaded to your Oppertunities interface.
messages.zh: 你需要从任意渠道获得20张全息记忆盘并运送至空间站，具体坐标我已经上传到你的“机遇”界面了。

messages.en: Holoreels delivered. Hope they got there in time.
messages.zh: 全息记忆盘已递送。希望它们及时到达了。

messages.en: They did; well done. You're a shrewd customer.
messages.zh: 它们都及时送到了；干得不错。你是个精明的顾客。

messages.en:
To find a particular item for trade, open the market window and select the Search tab on the left-hand side. Type in the name of the item you are searching for. If there are any available in your region, they will appear under Sellers, in the top half of the window. You can then right-click on the seller you want for more options.

Note that you might have to fly some distance to pick up the 'reels, especially if you want to pay bottom ISK for them.
messages.zh:
要想找到可交易的某特定物品，请打开市场窗口，然后选择左侧的“搜索”选项卡。输入你要搜索的物品名称。如果在你的星域内有这样的可交易物品，它们会显示在窗口上半部的“出售人”下方。然后你可以右击想要查看的出售人，以获取更多选项。

注意，你可能要飞行一些距离去提取那些全息记录盘，尤其是你想以最便宜的价格购买它们的话。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
People act like infants sometimes: Some locals have complained of not receiving any new entertainment holoreels for several weeks. Apparently there is a large contingent of fans in that system clamoring to experience the new Marek Garulous comedy, and the distribution company that normally supplies them has gone out of business. No one has stepped up to bring in more holoreels. The people are so frustrated that they're threatening violence unless the governor takes action. Some people and their entertainment, huh?

Anyway, I need you to procure 20 holoreels from a supplier and transport them for me; I'll upload the station's coordinates to your Opportunity interface. And don't worry, I'll pay you far more than it will cost you to buy the 'reels — I just don't have time to buy and deliver them myself.
messages.zh:
人总有些幼稚行为：当地人因为好几周没买到新的娱乐全息记忆盘，已经怨声载道了。显然，这些马雷克·加洛斯的迷弟迷妹们急于欣赏偶像的喜剧新作，可之前负责这块业务的发行公司却倒闭了。没人采取行动，去弄些全息记忆盘回来。于是他们群情激愤，扬言道要是统治者不采取行动，就要动用暴力手段了。这就是所谓的粉丝和娱乐吗？

总之，你要帮我从供应商那里买回20张全息记忆盘；我会把空间站坐标发到你的“机遇”界面上。放心，我会给你更高价，你绝对不会亏本，我只是没时间亲自去买罢了。

messages.en: You cannot deliver 20 measly holos for me!? I have slaves with more initiative than you!
messages.zh: 你连微不足道的20张全息记忆盘都不能给我送来！？我的一些劳工都比你更有积极性！

messages.en: I'm on my way. Don't worry.
messages.zh: 我这就出发。别着急。

messages.en: Splendid. Don't waste a second.
messages.zh: 好极了，别浪费时间。

messages.en: Procure 20 holoreels from any source and transport them to the station whose coordinates I've uploaded to the mission details in your Opportunities.
messages.zh: 你需要从任意渠道采购20张全息记忆盘并送往空间站，具体坐标我已经发送到“机遇”界面的任务详情中了。

messages.en: Holoreels delivered. Hope they got there in time.
messages.zh: 全息记忆盘已递送。希望它们及时到达了。

messages.en: They did; well done. You're a shrewd customer.
messages.zh: 它们都及时送到了；干得不错。你是个精明的顾客。

No one has stepped up to bring in more holoreels. The people are so frustrated that they're threatening violence unless the governor takes action. Some people and their entertainment, huh?

Anyway, I need you to procure 20 holoreels from a supplier and transport them for me; I'll upload the station's coordinates to the mission details in your Opportunities. 总之，你要帮我从供应商那里买回20张全息记忆盘；我会把空间站坐标发送到“机遇”界面的任务详情中。放心，我会给你更高价，你绝对不会亏本，我只是没时间亲自去买罢了。

messages.en: You cannot deliver 20 measly holos for me!? I have slaves with more initiative than you!
messages.zh: 你连微不足道的20张全息记忆盘都不能给我送来！？我的一些劳工都比你更有积极性！

messages.en: I am a loyal citizen. I will deliver the cargo.
messages.zh: 我是一名忠心耿耿的公民。我会运送这批货物的。

messages.en: Well said, citizen. Good luck.
messages.zh: 说得好，公民。祝你好运。

messages.en: Good day, {[character]agentID.name}. I am seeking employment.
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}。我想找份活儿。

messages.en:
It is important to the Empire that we get a shipment of elite slaves to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so that the workers there do not fall any further behind schedule.

Remember to move the slaves to your cargo hold before departure.
messages.zh:
我们要把一批精英劳工送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，好让那边的工人能把进度赶上来，这对帝国非常重要。

记得在出发之前把劳工转移到你的货柜舱里。

messages.en: The slaves have been successfully delivered, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 劳工已经成功送达，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: You have done well, citizen.
messages.zh: 你干得不错，公民。

messages.en: The Empire is disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 帝国对你很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
The easiest way to travel to a destination station quickly is to use the Overview. Stargates are marked in the Overview settings panel under the "Celestial" group. Once you have selected "stargate" in the Overview settings, right-click on the hyperlinked destination system in your mission details and choose "set destination." You will notice that the applicable stargate in your Overview is now yellow, as well as the one in space that leads to the next system along your route.

Next, simply right-click on the yellow stargate in the Overview (or in space) and hit "warp to within 0m"; turn on your Autopilot and simply sit back and relax until you are in the destination system.

Once you have arrived in the correct star system, simply right-click anywhere in space. In the drop-down window that appears, your current mission information appears at the bottom. From there, select the "dock" option and your Autopilot will bring you into the station momentarily.

Once the slaves are delivered, return to your agent's home station (also available via the drop-down simply by right-clicking anywhere in space) to collect your reward.
messages.zh:
快速前往目标空间站的最简单方法就是利用“总览”。你可以在“总览”设置面板的“天体”类目下中找到“星门”。在总览设置中选好“星门”后，右击任务详情中附有超链接的目标星系，并选择“设置为终点”。你会注意到，从“总览”看到的黄色星门，就是你在途中从太空看到的星门，它会指引你前往下一星系。

然后只需右击“总览”（或太空）中的黄色星门并单击“跃迁至0公里内”；开启自动导航，然后安心坐等抵达目标星系即可。

抵达正确恒星系后，右击太空中任意位置即可。弹出下拉菜单后，你会在底部找到当前任务信息。在任务信息里，选择“停靠”。自动导航系统将很快让你进站。

交接完奴隶后，你就可以回到代理人所在的空间站（也可以右击太空中任意位置，然后通过下拉菜单返回）并领取奖励。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
Excellent. As you know, it is the duty of every citizen to demonstrate his or her loyalty to the state from time to time. Though you are, at present, a small cog in the great machine of the Empire, you will find that even you have your place. We have a task for you that will help show your fitness to advance in our society and become a more significant part of that great machine.

It seems that the construction works at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} are experiencing an unfortunate labor shortage, possibly brought on by their overly harsh personnel management methods. It is important to the Empire that we get them a shipment of elite slaves so that they do not fall any further behind schedule. Are you a loyal enough citizen to do this task and do it quickly?

I will upload a bookmark to your People & Places databank; use it to locate and reach your destination.
messages.zh:
棒极了。你应该明白，时不时的证明他们对帝国的忠心是每个公民的义务。尽管你现在只是帝国这台巨大机器上的一个小齿轮，你仍然能找到适合你的位置。现在我们有一项工作给你，这是你向我们证明你是否能胜任一个小齿轮的位置，并且是否有能力成为这台机器上一个更重要的部件的机会。

似乎这项工程所在的地方{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}存在着严重的劳力不足，这很可能是由于他们过于苛刻的人事管理方法造成的。这项工程对帝国很重要，我们得为他们运送一船精英劳工以免他们进度落后。你是帝国忠诚的公民，我相信你能很快完成这项工作的，是吧？

我会把那里的位标上传到你船上的机载电脑中，这样你就能找到你该去的地方。

messages.en: Okay, I guess I'll do it.
messages.zh: 好的，我想我能做。

messages.en: Good going. Now deliver those dancers, tiger! And try not to make too many stops along the way to… enjoy the merchandise, m'okay? Heh.
messages.zh: 祝你一路顺风。现在就带着舞女们上路吧，马夫！路上别为了享受这批货而停太多次，好吗？呵。

messages.en: Hello, {[character]agentID.name}. Any work for a poor but honest young capsuleer?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}。有没有适合我这样年轻飞行员的活？虽说我很穷，但我这人很老实。

messages.en:
It just so happens that we're opening some new clubs over in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. The problem is that the talent has gotten stranded here, and has to be over to the station for the grand opening. You probably know the rest. It's important that this be taken care of soon, so we're offering a substantial reward to anyone who wants to take the job.

Remember to move the dancers to your cargo hold before departure.
messages.zh:
我们在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}有几家会所正要开张。可问题是有些艺人被困在这了，她们必须到那座空间站去参加盛大的开幕晚会。接下来该怎么做你大概都知道。这事很重要，需要尽快妥善处理，所以我们将向任何愿意接下这个活的人提供丰厚的报酬。

记得在出发之前把舞女转移到你的货柜舱里。

messages.en: The dancers are dancing in your club as we speak, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 就在我们讲话的这会儿，舞女们已经开始在会所里跳舞了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Thanks! We're counting the money already.
messages.zh: 谢谢！我们已经在数钱了。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
Hey, I'm glad you asked!

Here at Nugoeihuvi Corporation, we're all about pleasure. I'm sure you've seen our adverts — "If it's fun, it must be from Nugoeihuvi." And it just so happens that we're opening some new clubs over in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. The problem is that the talent has gotten stranded here, and has to be over to the station for the grand opening. What talent you ask? Well, I mean the dancers, {[character]player.name}... Exotic dancing is an art form, you know, appreciated on the highest intellectual level. And we've got a bunch of dancers just standing around waiting for a ship to take 'em to their new home.

You probably know the rest. We need a fast, reliable pilot and a ship without any major mechanical problems. That brave and resourceful pilot needs to take these dancers to their destination so that they can get bringing in the high-rollers and thus earning their wages. It's important that this be taken care of soon, so we're offering a substantial reward to anyone who wants to take the job. You up to it, kid?
messages.zh:
嗨，很高兴你这样问我。

在纳基维集团中总是充满着乐趣。相信你已经看到了我们的广告—“乐趣，尽在纳基维”。我们在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}有几家会所正要开张。可问题是有些艺人被困在这了，她们必须到那座空间站去参加盛大的开幕晚会。什么艺人？当然是舞者，{[character]player.name}...异族舞者是艺术的化身，你知道，高级知识分子们尤其欣赏。现在我们有一票舞者正等着被送到她们的新家去。

接下来该怎么做你大概都知道。我们需要一个迅速的，可靠的飞行员及一架没有任何机械问题的飞船。这名足智多谋的勇敢飞行员需要带着这些舞者去到她们的目的地，以便她们可以结识那些有钱人并且赚到薪水。这事很重要，需要尽快妥善处理，所以我们将向任何愿意接下这个活的人提供丰厚的报酬。你要做吗？

messages.en: I'll help you any way I can.
messages.zh: 我会竭尽所能为你效劳。

messages.en: Thanks — the Federation won't soon forget this.
messages.zh: 谢谢——联邦不会忘记你的功劳的。

messages.en: Hello. I hear you might have some work for a capsuleer like me?
messages.zh: 你好。听说你可能有活给我这样的飞行员做？

messages.en:
You may have noticed all those marines hanging out in the loading bay. We've grabbed every available transport we can find, but there's still a few left behind who need to be transported to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Suffice to say, their presence is of vital importance to Federation efforts; if you're a loyal citizen, you'll take them to their destination.

Remember to move the marines to your cargo hold before departure.
messages.zh:
你可能已经注意到了那些在装运码头到处闲逛的海军陆战队员。我们已经发动了所有能找到的运输舰了，但还有一些人落在后面，他们需要被送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。可以说，他们到场与否对于联邦的行动至关重要；如果你是个忠诚的公民，就把他们送到目的地去吧。

记得在出发之前把海军陆战队员转移到你的货柜舱里。

messages.en: I've successfully transported the marines to their destination.
messages.zh: 我已将海军陆战队员顺利送达目的地。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: You've let down our glorious Federation, pilot.
messages.zh: 你让我们辉煌的联邦失望了，飞行员。

messages.en:
The easiest way to travel to a destination station quickly is to use the Overview. Stargates are marked in the Overview settings panel under the "Celestial" group. Once you have selected "stargate" in the Overview settings, right-click on the hyperlinked destination system in the mission details and choose "set destination." You will notice that the applicable stargate in your Overview is now yellow, as well as the one in space that leads to the next system along your route.

Next, simply right-click on the yellow stargate in the Overview (or in space) and hit "warp to within 0m"; turn on your Autopilot and simply sit back and relax until you are in the destination system.

Once you have arrived in the correct star system, simply right-click anywhere in space. In the drop-down window that appears, your current mission information appears at the bottom. From there, select the "dock" option and your Autopilot will bring you into the station momentarily.

Once the marines are delivered, return to your agent's home station (also available via the drop-down simply by right-clicking anywhere in space) to collect your reward.
messages.zh:
快速前往目标空间站的最简单方法就是利用“总览”。你可以在“总览”设置面板的“天体”类目下中找到“星门”。在总览设置中选好“星门”后，右击任务详情中附有超链接的目标星系，并选择“设置为终点”。你会注意到，从“总览”看到的黄色星门，就是你在途中从太空看到的星门，它会指引你前往下一星系。

然后只需右击“总览”（或太空）中的黄色星门并单击“跃迁至0公里内”；开启自动导航，然后安心坐等抵达目标星系即可。

抵达正确恒星系后，右击太空中任意位置即可。弹出下拉菜单后，你会在底部找到当前任务信息。在任务信息里，选择“停靠”。自动导航系统将很快让你进站。

交接完海军陆战队员后，你就可以回到代理人所在的空间站（也可以右击太空中任意位置，然后通过下拉菜单返回）并领取奖励。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en: Well, yes. Now, I can't say too much, but something's come up, and there's a great need for ground troops in a nearby system. You may have noticed all those marines hanging out in the loading bay. We've grabbed every available transport we can find, but there's still a few left behind who need to be transported to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Suffice to say, their presence is of vital importance to Federation efforts, and if you're a loyal citizen, you'll take them to their destination. And of course there's some extra pay in it for you. Will you help?
messages.zh: 嗯，是的。不过我还不能告诉你太多信息。但的确出乱子了，附近的一个星系急需一批陆军。你可能已经注意到了那些在装运码头到处闲逛的海军陆战队员。我们已经发动了所有能找到的运输舰了，但还有一些人落在后面，他们需要被送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。可以说，他们到场与否对于联邦的行动至关重要；如果你是个忠诚的公民，就把他们送到目的地去吧。当然，我们会给你奖励。你愿意帮忙吗？

name.ru: Воины и их оружие (Warriors and Their Weapons)

messages.en: I will serve the Republic, as always.
messages.zh: 我将一如既往地为共和国效劳。

messages.en: You are a true warrior, captain.
messages.zh: 你是一名真正的战士，船长。

messages.en: I see a great deal of activity on the docks, {[character]agentID.name}. Is there anything I can help with?
messages.zh: 我看见船坞那边忙得不可开交，{[character]agentID.name}。我能帮上什么忙吗？

messages.en:
On the loading dock is a shipment of weapons for our 412th Regiment, currently garrisoned at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Can you get it there for them?

Remember to move the High-Tech Small Arms to your cargo hold before departure.
messages.zh:
在装运码头上有一批武器，是供我们驻扎在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的第412团使用的。你能帮我把这些武器送过去吗？

记得在出发之前把高科技小型枪械放到你的货柜舱里。

messages.en: The delivery is complete, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 递送已完成，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: With the help of those weapons, our fighters will triumph. You have the Republic's gratitude, as well as my own, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 借助那些武器，我们的战士一定会大获全胜。共和国和我都向你致以谢意，{[character]player.name}.

messages.en:
The easiest way to travel to a destination station quickly is to use the Overview. Stargates are marked in the Overview settings panel under the "Celestial" group. Once you have selected "stargate" in the Overview settings, right-click on the hyperlinked destination system in the mission details in your Opportunities interface and choose "set destination." You will notice that the applicable stargate in your Overview is now yellow, as well as the one in space that leads to the next system along your route.

Next, simply right-click on the yellow stargate in the Overview (or in space) and hit "warp to within 0m"; turn on your Autopilot and simply sit back and relax until you are in the destination system.

Once you have arrived in the correct star system, simply right-click anywhere in space. In the drop-down window that appears, your current mission information appears at the bottom. From there, select the "dock" option and your Autopilot will bring you into the station momentarily.

Once the weapons are delivered, return to your agent's home station (also available via the drop-down simply by right-clicking anywhere in space) to collect your reward.

快速前往目标空间站的最简单方法就是利用“总览”。你可以在“总览”设置面板的“天体”类目下中找到“星门”。在总览设置中选好“星门”后，右击“机遇”界面的任务详情中附有超链接的目标星系，并选择“设置为终点”。你会注意到，从“总览”看到的黄色星门，就是你在途中从太空看到的星门，它会指引你前往下一星系。

然后只需右击“总览”（或太空）中的黄色星门并单击“跃迁至0公里内”；开启自动导航，然后安心坐等抵达目标星系即可。

抵达正确恒星系后，右击太空中任意位置即可。弹出下拉菜单后，你会在底部找到当前任务信息。在任务信息里，选择“停靠”。自动导航系统将很快让你进站。

交接完武器后，你就可以回到代理人所在的空间站（也可以右击太空中任意位置，然后通过下拉菜单返回）并领取奖励。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
These are dark days for our Republic, as you know. Our enemies threaten us on all sides, and our ancient traditions are in danger of dying out. We are a race of warriors, {[character]player.name}, and only through strength do we survive in a hostile universe. Our strength is in our warriors and in their weapons.

We believe that the cursed Amarrians are planning a major invasion, and we need to equip our warriors to repel their attacks on planetary environs. On the loading dock is a shipment of weapons for our 412th Regiment, currently garrisoned at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Can you get it there for them?
messages.zh:
正如你所知的，这是对共和国来说是最黑暗的日子。我们的敌人对我们构成了全面威胁，并且我们古老的传统正在慢慢消逝。我们是一个尚武的民族，{[character]player.name}，只有通过力量我们才能在险恶的宇宙中生存。我们的力量在我们的战士心中，也融在他们的武器里面。

我们相信那些被诅咒的艾玛人正在制定全面侵略计划，我们需要武装我们的士兵来击退他们在外围行星的攻击。在装卸处我们有一船为412团准备的武器，他们正在驻守{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。你能把这船装备运送给他们吗？

messages.en: You got it. Be back in a jiffy.
messages.zh: 遵命。马上回来。

messages.en: Oh, a jiffy! Hooray! I'm aquiver with anticipation.
messages.zh: 噢，马上！万岁！我实在太期待了。

messages.en: Uh, maybe. What sort of test?
messages.zh: 呃，也许吧。什么样的测试？

messages.en: We're going to have a little test for the delivery staff. Acquire for me a mere 15 units of Tritanium. Keep them in your cargo hold and then talk to me again. I will send the new staff to pick up the mineral.
messages.zh: 我们要对递送人员进行个小测试。只要给我取得15单位的三钛合金就行了。把它们放到你的货柜舱中，然后再跟我交谈。我会派个新快递人员去取那些矿物。

messages.en: Here is your Tritanium, ready to go.
messages.zh: 这是你要的三钛合金，快递人员随时可以运送。

messages.en: Very good. It seems my Tritanium is already on the way.
messages.zh: 非常好。似乎我的三钛合金已经在路上了。

messages.en: Yeah, I'm not even going to bother with this.
messages.zh: 是啊，我才懒得做这种事。

messages.en: Harumph.
messages.zh: 咳咳。

messages.en:
To purchase Tritanium from the market, open the Market button from your NeoCom on the left. When the Market window is open, click on the Search tab and search for "Tritanium." Doing so will open a list containing the buyers and sellers in the region.

To purchase 15 units of Tritanium from a particular seller, right-click an item from the listing and select "Buy this"; in the "Quantity" field on the window that pops up, change the value to "15." Be sure to note the location of the order, as you will have to pick up the Tritanium from that station. (If you're not sure what station you've bought something from, you can always find all of your possessions, in any station, using the "Assets" window in your NeoCom.) Click "Buy."

Do NOT click "Place a Buy Order" unless there is a seller at your station that can fill the order immediately or you are willing to depend upon someone filling your order before this mission times out.
messages.zh:
在左边的控制边栏中点开市场，在搜索栏中输入“三钛合金”，点击“搜索”后将显示在星域内所有收购和出售三钛合金的人员列表。

要从特定的售出人那里购买15单位的三钛合金，在列表中右键点击该商品并选择“购买此物品”，在弹出的对话框中数量一栏输入“15”。务必留心挂单的地点，因为你必须亲自飞到挂单空间站去提取购买的三钛合金。（如果你不确定自己从哪个站购买了商品，你可以从控制边栏中点开“资产”窗口来确认你当前在游戏中拥有的所有资产。）然后点击“购买”。

请不要点击“添加购买订单”，除非你确认你所在的空间站里有立刻愿意出售三钛给你的玩家，或者你乐意在等待接单中让你的任务时限流逝。

messages.en: Purchasing from the Market
messages.zh: 从市场购买

messages.en:
A number of weeks ago I ordered a case of long-limb roe from a respectable supplier who was docked at this very station. The delivery staff was atrocious. Many of the packages were damaged, and most of the roes were half rancid. I made sure everyone on that staff was fired, but I am not so quickly inclined to trust these new hires. We're going to have a little test. And I need someone of your caliber, a graduate and a capsuleer, to help.

Acquire for me just 15 units of Tritanium. You can purchase them from the market or mine ore to reprocess it yourself — how you get it is up to you. Keep the Tritanium in your cargo hold and then talk to me again. I will send someone from among the new staff to pick up the mineral.

If you need further instructions on purchasing items, I shall provide them in the mission briefing I'll upload to your Opportunities interface.
messages.zh:
几周前我从一个有名的供货商那里订购了一箱长肢龙鹿的卵，当时他正好停靠在这个空间站。但是快递员干得糟糕透顶，到手时很多包装都已经破损，里面的卵也大多开始变质腐败。我把负责那批货的人全开了，但又没法很快信任新雇的员工。所以得做个小测试。我就需要像你这样刚毕业的优秀克隆飞行员。

给我去弄些三钛合金来，15个单位就好，你自己决定怎么去获得，直接去市场上买或者从采来的矿石中提炼都行。把那些三钛合金放到货柜舱里然后再来找我，我会从新雇的人里挑选一个来取货。

你要是不熟悉采购流程，我会把含有相关信息的任务描述上传到你的“机遇”界面里。

messages.en: You move even more slowly than that incompetent delivery staff. Were you delivering my long-limb roe, I'm sure it would have grown a mold of such maturity that it would be well on its way to developing a written language.
messages.zh: 你的动作甚至比那些无能的快递人员还要慢。要是等你送来我的长肢龙鹿卵的话，我敢肯定，它都已经发育成熟，都快发明出一种书面语言了。

messages.en: Too slow
messages.zh: 太慢了

messages.en: I'm quitting this whole thing. It's completely laughable, with your "markets" and your "orders." Jeesh.
messages.zh: 这整件事我不干了。这实在太可笑了，去你的“市场”和“订单”。混蛋。

messages.en: How will I know if I can trust the delivery staff with my perishables again?
messages.zh: 我怎么才能知道是否可以再次把易坏物品托付给这些快递人员呢？

messages.en: You move even more slowly than that incompetent delivery staff. Were you delivering my long-limb roe, I'm sure it would have grown a mold of such maturity that it would be well on its way to developing a written language.
messages.zh: 你的动作甚至比那些无能的快递人员还要慢。要是等你送来我的长肢龙鹿卵的话，我敢肯定，它都已经发育成熟，都快发明出一种书面语言了。

messages.en: Too slow
messages.zh: 太慢了

messages.en: Well, since you asked so nicely… yeah, sure. I'll help.
messages.zh: 嗯，既然你态度这么好……是啊，当然。我愿意帮忙。

messages.en: I'll let them know you're coming. The perfume should be in a secure coded package in your hangar — with what I paid for it, I'm not taking any chances. I may be forgetful, but I'm not stupid.
messages.zh: 我会通知他们说你要过去。香水应该放在你机库里的一个密码安全包装里——我是花了大价钱买下香水的，不能冒任何险。虽然我可能有些健忘，但我不蠢。

messages.en: Maybe. What did you have in mind?
messages.zh: 也许吧。你打算给我什么任务？

messages.en: Deliver the secure coded package for your agent.
messages.zh: 把密码安全包交给你的代理人。

messages.en: I've got your… well, whatever's in this box.
messages.zh: 我已经拿到你的……呃，这个盒子里的东西了。

messages.en: Oh, thank you! Things were already getting tense. If she thought I'd forgotten again, I think she might've stopped speaking to me!
messages.zh: 噢，谢谢你！这里的气氛已经开始紧张起来了。她要是以为我又忘记了，我想她再也不会理我了！

messages.en: I don't want to contribute to spoiling your sister. Take a stance, will you?!
messages.zh: 我不想帮你惯坏你的妹妹。做人要有立场，好吗？！

messages.en: She's never gonna talk to me again.
messages.zh: 她再也不会理我了。

messages.en: Trade is a booming industry. Humanity is spread out over such a vast area of space that everything is rare somewhere, and there's always someone willing to make that journey for a profit, however small.
messages.zh: 贸易是一项欣欣向荣的产业。人类所遍布的宇宙如此之广，以致于任何一样东西在某些地方都会变得无比珍贵，而且总有人愿意为了赚取利润而长途跋涉，无论这利润有多么微薄。

messages.en: Rare Equals Expensive
messages.zh: 物以稀为贵

messages.en:
Well, it's my sister. I mean, I remembered her birthday this time, I swear. I planned out the gift, got it ordered in advance — and it was not cheap, let me tell you. I found a specialty perfume maker, and it turns out my sister likes the smells of really damn expensive things. And of course the fancy-pants perfumer has a ridiculous waiting list. But I got everything done in time!

I just need you to deliver it. I'll pay you, okay?
messages.zh:
呃，这事儿和我妹妹有关。我是说，我这回终于记住她的生日了，我发誓。我把礼物想好了，还提前下了订单——我告诉你，这份礼物可不便宜。我找到一个特别香水生产商，因为我妹妹喜欢闻这些贵得要死的东西的气味。而且，这个穿得花里胡哨的香水商有一串长得吓人的客户预定名单。不过我还是把一切都及时办妥了！

我只要你把东西交给她。我会付你钱的，如何？

messages.en:
She realized I didn't have her present yet, and she wouldn't believe me when I told her it was on the way! She said she should've known I'd forget again, and she's never gonna speak to me again!
This is gonna be a shitty week. Thanks a bunch, jerk.
messages.zh: 她发现了我没有给她准备礼物，而且说什么也不相信我给她的礼物正在路上！她说自己早该知道我又会忘记的，她再也不会理我了！这将是一个糟糕的礼拜。真是多亏了你，混蛋。

messages.en: What the hell happened??
messages.zh: 见鬼，到底发生了什么？？

messages.en: I've been thinking about it, and your sister sounds kinda mean. I don't wanna get her present. Let her fume.
messages.zh: 我一直在想这事，你妹妹似乎有些苛刻。我不想去拿她的礼物。让她火冒三丈吧。

messages.en: Well, now she's never gonna talk to me again. Although maybe that's for the best…
messages.zh: 得，她再也不会理我了。不过也许这样最好……

messages.en:
She realized I didn't have her present yet, and she wouldn't believe me when I told her it was on the way! She said she should've known I'd forget again, and she's never gonna speak to me again!
This is gonna be a shitty week. Thanks a bunch, jerk.
messages.zh: 她发现了我没有给她准备礼物，而且说什么也不相信我给她的礼物正在路上！她说自己早该知道我又会忘记的，她再也不会理我了！这将是一个糟糕的礼拜。真是多亏了你，混蛋。

messages.en: What the hell happened??
messages.zh: 见鬼，到底发生了什么？？

name.de: Rettet die Bäume - Die Zukunft pflanzen (1 von 3)
name.en: Save the Trees - Seeding a Future (1 of 3)
name.es: Salvar los árboles: Sembrando el futuro (1 de 3)
name.fr: Sauver les arbres - Semer pour l'avenir (1 sur 3)
name.ja: 森林を守れ–未来の種を蒔く（1/3）
name.ru: Спасите деревья – посадка будущего (Save the Trees - Seeding a Future) (1 из 3)

messages.en: I'm on my way.
messages.zh: 我马上出发。

messages.en: Splendid! But be careful: They're quite fragile.
messages.zh: 太好了！不过要小心：它们很脆弱。

messages.en: I think so. Courier runs are always such easy money.
messages.zh: 我想可以。跑快递是件容易赚钱的差事。

messages.en:
Some of our scientists have discovered a strange species of tree previously unknown to us. We need to transport the seeds for further study. But the tree has the most peculiar means of procreation: The seeds must be germinated inside a living animal host. Our scientists on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} have prepared some suitable livestock to serve as host for the germination. Take the seeds to this station so the tests can begin.

Remember to move the seeds to your cargo hold before you undock.
messages.zh:
我们的科学家发现了一种我们从未见过的奇特树木。我们需要运输一些树种以供进一步研究。但是这种树木的繁殖方式非常奇特：这些树种必须在活体动物宿主内发芽。我们在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的科学家准备了一些合适的牲畜用作树种发芽所需的宿主。将树种送到该空间站，这样测试就能开始了。

记得在出发之前把种子放到你的货柜舱里。

messages.en: Plant seeds delivered. They were certainly strange-looking things.
messages.zh: 植物种子已经送达。它们真是些怪模怪样的东西。

messages.en: You have done well. Contact me again and I'll tell you how the research is progressing.
messages.zh: 你干得不错。以后再联系我，我会告诉你研究的进展。

messages.en:
Some of our scientists have discovered a strange species of tree previously unknown to us. We need to transport the seeds for further study. The nearby planet has vast, ancient forests, and this new species lies deep within one of its densest rain forests; no human has ever seen its like before. We have obtained a sample of one of its seeds and we will attempt to grow it in the laboratory.

The tree has the most peculiar means of procreation. The seeds must be germinated inside a living animal host. Our scientists on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} have prepared some suitable livestock to serve as host for the germination. Take the seeds to this station so the tests can begin.
messages.zh:
我们的科学家发现了一种未知的奇特树木。我们需要运输一些树种以供进一步研究。这种植物是在近邻的星球上广袤而古老的森林最深处的雨林里发现的，在这之前从没有人见过它们。我们已经获得了一颗它的种子的样品，正准备在实验室里培育。

这种树木的繁殖方式十分奇特，必须以活的动物为寄主才能发芽。我们的科学家在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}星系准备了一些实验牲口来作为该树木的寄主。把这些种子带去那里进行实验。

messages.en: You disappoint me. I thought you could handle a simple courier mission, but apparently I was wrong. I suppose I'll have to limit your work to garbage runs. I've found someone else to take care of this.
messages.zh: 你真令我失望。我以为你能搞定一个简单的快递任务，但显然我想错了。看来我只能把你的工作范围限制为运送垃圾了。我已经找别人来处理这件事了。

messages.en: Courier mission failed
messages.zh: 快递任务未完成

messages.en: You disappoint me. I thought you could handle a simple courier mission, but apparently I was wrong. I suppose I'll have to limit your work to garbage runs. I've found someone else to take care of this.
messages.zh: 你真令我失望。我以为你能搞定一个简单的快递任务，但显然我想错了。看来我只能把你的工作范围限制为运送垃圾了。我已经找别人来处理这件事了。
