messages.zh: 快递任务未完成

name.de: Rettet die Bäume - Die Rache des Waldes (2 von 3)
name.en: Save the Trees – Forest's Revenge (2 of 3)
name.es: Salvar los árboles: La venganza del bosque (2 de 3)
name.fr: Sauver les arbres - La revanche de la forêt (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 森林を守れ–森林の復讐（2/3）
name.ru: Спасите деревья – месть леса (Save the Trees – Forest's Revenge) (2 из 3)

messages.en: I'm on my way.
messages.zh: 我马上出发。

messages.en: I'm sure Horei Falcosis would thank you to hurry, were he able.
messages.zh: 我肯定荷瑞·法尔科希斯会恳请你动作快些的——如果他办得到的话。

messages.en: Uh, not sure, but I'm guessing it might be interesting…
messages.zh: 呃，不清楚，不过我想应该会很有意思……

messages.en:
Unbeknownst to us, a botanist here named Horei Falcosis took one of the seeds for examination before you shipped the package; a short time ago, as he worked with it, it shot out a tendril and sank it into his flesh. It was several minutes before he was discovered, and by that time, the seed's tendrils had penetrated his body in several locations. Falcosis was unconscious by this time, and the seed had pulled itself close to his body and started to secrete a protective resin.

Sadly, this station does not have the proper facilities to care for him. And since this tree has now been designated noxious and dangerous--the other seeds were all incinerated safely, I understand--Falcosis has been placed in cryogenic stasis for transport.

Deliver him to the station I've included in the mission details, would you?
messages.zh:
让我们搞不明白的是，有一位名叫荷瑞·法尔科希斯的植物学家，在你运送包裹之前已经拿走了一颗种子样本；不久前，在他潜心研究的时候，种子伸出卷须，插入了他的身体里。过了好几分钟他才被发现，但那时，他身上已有多处扎入了这种卷须。现在法尔科希斯处于昏迷状态，而种子已经和他的身体高度融合，正在分泌保护性树脂。

可惜，这座空间站上没有能够抢救他的设备。自从确定这颗树有毒并有危险之后，其他种子已经以安全的方式烧光了。据我所知，已将法尔科希斯的身体置于低温冷藏状态，以便运输。

你愿意把他送到任务详情中标注的空间站吗？

messages.en: I've delivered the cryogenic stasis capsule, as you requested. How's the patient? Any word?
messages.zh: 我已经照你说的，把低温停滞舱送去了。病人现在怎么样？有消息吗？

messages.en: You have done well. No word, no. Time will tell if Falcosis survives this ordeal. Come and see me again when you have time.
messages.zh: 你干得不错。还没有消息。法尔科希斯能否度过难关，只有时间才能给出答案。等你有空的时候再来找我吧。

messages.en:
Interesting, yes. Also disgusting.

One of the seeds had thoughts of its own on whom or what might be its host. Unbeknownst to us, a botanist here named Horei Falcosis took one of the seeds for examination before you shipped the package; a short time ago, as he worked with it, it shot out a tendril and sank it into his flesh. It was several minutes before he was discovered, and by that time, the seed's tendrils had penetrated his body in several locations. Falcosis was unconscious by this time, and the seed had pulled itself close to his body and started to secrete a protective resin.

Brings new meaning to giving one's body to science, don't you think?

In any case, this station does not have the proper facilities to care for him. And since this tree has now been designated noxious and dangerous — the other seeds were all incinerated safely, I understand — Falcosis has been placed in cryogenic stasis for transport. Deliver his cryo-tank for me, would you?
messages.zh:
很有趣，是的，也很恶心。

有一颗种子具备自己的意志选择中意的寄主。让我们不得而知的是有一位名叫荷瑞·法尔科希斯的科学家在你卸下所有包裹前已经拿走那颗种子样本；不久之前，在他潜心研究的时候，种子伸出卷须，插入了他的身体里。他在几分钟前被发现的时候，卷须已经穿透他身体好几处了。现在荷瑞·法尔科希斯处于昏迷状态，而种子已经和他的身体高度融合，正在分泌保护性树脂。

让科学家有了新的途经献身科学，你说呢？

当务之急是那个空间站没有合适的设备抢救他，而植物在不断产生危险的有毒物质——其他的种子已被安全火化，我知道——法尔科希斯被送进低温停滞舱，等待运送。你能把停滞舱为我带来吗？

messages.en: You disappoint me, and Horei Falcosis has since died thanks to your lack of initiative. I suppose I'll have to limit your work to garbage runs from now on.
messages.zh: 你令我失望，由于你的惰性，荷瑞·法尔科希斯死了。看来以后我只能把你的工作范围限制为运送垃圾了。

messages.en: Scientist dies
messages.zh: 科学家死亡

messages.en: You cannot make a simple courier run on something this important? A man's life is at stake!
messages.zh: 对于这么重要的东西，你连跑一趟简单的快递都不行吗？一个生命正危在旦夕啊！

messages.en: You disappoint me, and Horei Falcosis has since died thanks to your lack of initiative. I suppose I'll have to limit your work to garbage runs from now on.
messages.zh: 你令我失望，由于你的惰性，荷瑞·法尔科希斯死了。看来以后我只能把你的工作范围限制为运送垃圾了。

messages.en: Scientist dies
messages.zh: 科学家死亡

name.de: Rettet die Bäume - Rettet die Menschen (3 von 3)
name.en: Save the Trees – Save the People (3 of 3)
name.es: Salvar los árboles: Salvar a la gente (3 de 3)
name.fr: Sauver les arbres - Sauver les gens (3 sur 3)
name.ru: Спасите деревья – спасите людей (Save the Trees – Save the People) (3 из 3)

messages.en: I'm on my way, don't worry!
messages.zh: 我这就出发，别担心！

messages.en: There's no time to waste.
messages.zh: 必须分秒必争了。

messages.en: You bet. What can I do?
messages.zh: 这还用说。我能做些什么？

messages.en:
As soon as Horei Falcosis was taken out of cryo-stasis, the tree started using his body for food. Fortunately for him, he didn't survive long. But the tree exploded with immediate growth. And it is semi-mobile! It can move slowly on its roots as if they were tentacles! And it's predatory! Its vines killed several lab technicians. We need to stop it before it takes over the whole station.

Since we don't yet know much about its biology, we need more information. I'll upload a destination to your Bookmarks: Go there and pick up the copy of Dem's Galactical Botanical I've ordered, and bring it back to me here. Perhaps in that book there will be some clues about how to contain or destroy this thing.
messages.zh:
荷瑞·法尔科希斯刚被解除冬眠状态，那棵树便以他的肉体为食物。他还算幸运，不久就咽了气，没有忍受太多折磨。但那棵树却快速生长并急剧膨胀。它居然还是半移动式的！它的根能够缓慢移动，就好象是触角一样！而且它还是肉食性的！它的藤蔓害死了好几个实验室技术员。我们必须在它占领整个空间站前制止它。

由于我们没有太多关于它的生物知识，我们需要更多信息。我会把目的地上传到你的位标里：去那里取我订购的德姆星系植物学，然后送我这来。也许那本书里有关于如何抑制或摧毁那玩意的线索。

messages.en: I've delivered the book. Crisis averted, I hope.
messages.zh: 我把书送去了。希望危机就此化解。

messages.en: You have proven your resourcefulness. Enjoy your reward.
messages.zh: 你向我们证明了你的机智。好好享受你的奖励吧。

messages.en:
Dozens have been killed so far. That tree is vicious! It almost took over the entire station. And it's still growing!

As soon as Horei Falcosis was taken out of cryo-stasis, the tree started using his body for food. Fortunately for him, he didn't survive long. But the tree exploded with immediate growth. It reached a height of 4 meters in less than hour. And it is semi-mobile! It can move slowly on its roots as if they were tentacles! And it's predatory! Its vines killed several lab technicians. Apparently human body fluids kick the tree's metabolism into high gear. Its growth became rampant, and it's now trying to propagate itself some enormous, striated greenish-red fruit. We need to stop it before it takes over the whole station.

Since we don't yet know much about its biology, we need more information. I've uploaded the destination station in the mission details in your Opportunity interface: Go there and pick up the copy of Dem's Galactical Botanical I've ordered, and bring it back to me here. Perhaps in that book there will be some clues about how to contain or destroy this thing.
messages.zh:
至今已有数十人丧生。这颗树太邪恶了！都快长满整个空间站。它还在继续生长！

荷瑞·法尔科希斯刚一解除冬眠，那株植物就开始以他的身体为食。他没能撑太久，也算一件幸事。但这株植物却马上爆炸性增长。不到一小时就长到了4米高。甚至还能移动！它的根须就像触须一样，托着它缓慢移动！甚至还会夺人性命！好几位实验室技术员都丧生在它的藤条下。显然，人体内的体液会加快这株植物的新陈代谢。它的生长十分迅猛，现在正尝试繁殖，快要结出青红色的巨型条纹状果实了。我们必须在它长满整个空间站之前消灭它。

可我们对其生物特性知之甚少，还需要掌握更多信息才行。我已经在“机遇”界面的任务详情里上传了目标空间站：你去把我订购的德姆星系植物学副本带回来。那本书也许能给我们一些关于如何遏制或消灭它的线索。

messages.en: We couldn't wait for you any longer. We sent someone else after the book. Because of your delay, it will now be months before we can reclaim that part of the station, if not the whole thing. Who knows?
messages.zh: 我们实在没时间再等你了。我们派了别人去取那本书。由于你的延误，我们现在要花上几个月的时间才能把空间站——至少是那部分空间站——夺回来。谁知道呢？

messages.en: Dem's Galactical Botanical
messages.zh: 德姆星系植物学

messages.en: We couldn't wait for you any longer. We sent someone else after the book. Because of your delay, it will now be months before we can reclaim that part of the station, if not the whole thing. Who knows?
messages.zh: 我们实在没时间再等你了。我们派了别人去取那本书。由于你的延误，我们现在要花上几个月的时间才能把空间站——至少是那部分空间站——夺回来。谁知道呢？

messages.en: Dem's Galactical Botanical
messages.zh: 德姆星系植物学

messages.en: Okay, I'll take the damned furrier.
messages.zh: 好吧，我来把这个可恶的毛绒怪带走。

messages.en: You'll do it? Hey guys — he says he'll do it!
messages.zh: 你愿意做？嗨，伙计们——他说他愿意做！

messages.en: Hi. I'm looking for some gainful employment.
messages.zh: 嗨。我想找些有赚头的活儿。

messages.en:
No doubt you've see that little furrier that's been bouncing around the station for the last few days, {[character]player.name}? You haven't? Well, I certainly have — nasty little creature. It bites, you know.

In any event, it was part of a shipment of exotic pets intended for delivery to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, but it got left behind because I spilled a drink all over the cargo manifest. We need someone to take this furrier, special delivery, over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and get it the hell out of our hair.

Remember to move the "special delivery" container into your cargo hold before you go.
messages.zh:
毫无疑问你已经看见那个在空间站里蹦达了好几天的毛绒怪了，{[character]player.name}？你没有？好吧，我有！那小东西真讨厌。它还咬人，你知道吧。

无论如何，它是一船运往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的异国宠物之一，可是它被落下了，因为我把一杯饮料都洒在了货物单上。我们需要人把这毛绒怪快递到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}这样我们就能彻底摆脱它了。

记得在你走之前把快递包裹放进你的货柜仓里。

messages.en: The furrier's delivered. Man those things stink.
messages.zh: 毛绒怪已经送过去了。伙计，那东西真是太臭了。

messages.en: So the little monster didn't ruin your upholstery? Good job, my friend. You may have a future in the animal transport business! Check back to me in a while.
messages.zh: 就是说那个小怪物没有把你的机舱弄得一团糟？干得漂亮，我的朋友。你也许会在动物运输行业里大有作为！过会儿再来找我吧。

messages.en:
The easiest way to travel to a destination station quickly is to use the Overview. Stargates are marked in the Overview settings panel under the "Celestial" group. Once you have selected "stargate" in the Overview settings, right-click on the hyperlinked destination system in the mission details in your Opportunities and choose "set destination." You will notice that the applicable stargate in your Overview is now yellow, as well as the one in space that leads to the next system along your route.

Next, simply right-click on the yellow stargate in the Overview (or in space) and hit "warp to within 0m"; turn on your Autopilot and simply sit back and relax until you are in the destination system.

Once you have arrived in the correct star system, simply right-click anywhere in space. In the drop-down window that appears, your current mission information appears at the bottom. From there, select the "dock" option and your Autopilot will bring you into the station momentarily.

Once the courier item is delivered, return to your agent's home station (also available via the drop-down simply by right-clicking anywhere in space) to collect your reward.
messages.zh:
快速前往目标空间站的最简单方法就是利用“总览”。你可以在“总览”设置面板的“天体”类目下中找到“星门”。在总览设置中选好“星门”后，右击“机遇”界面的任务详情中附有超链接的目标星系，并选择“设置为终点”。你会注意到，从“总览”看到的黄色星门，就是你在途中从太空看到的星门，它会指引你前往下一星系。

然后只需右击“总览”（或太空）中的黄色星门并单击“跃迁至0公里内”；开启自动导航，然后安心坐等抵达目标星系即可。

抵达正确恒星系后，右击太空中任意位置即可。弹出下拉菜单后，你会在底部找到当前任务信息。在任务信息里，选择“停靠”。自动导航系统将很快让你进站。

交接完快递舰艇后，你就可以回到代理人所在的空间站（也可以右击太空中任意位置，然后通过下拉菜单返回）并领取奖励。

messages.en: Helpful Hints
messages.zh: 有益提示

messages.en:
No doubt you've see that little furrier that's been bouncing around the station for the last few days, {[character]player.name}? You haven't? Well, I certainly have. Nasty little creature. It bites, you know.

In any event, it was part of a shipment of exotic pets intended for delivery to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, but it got left behind because I spilled a drink all over the cargo manifest. We need someone to take this furrier, special delivery, over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and get it the hell out of our hair. We need a special pilot, a pilot with skill and daring, a pilot who doesn't know the meaning of the word "fear"… and who isn't allergic to furriers. You interested?
messages.zh:
毫无疑问，你已经看见那个在空间站里蹦跶了好几天的毛绒怪了，{[character]player.name}？有没有？好吧，我已经看见了。那小东西真讨厌。它还咬人，你懂的。

无论如何，它是一船运往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的异国宠物之一，可是它被落下了，因为我把一杯饮料洒在了货物单上。我们需要人把这毛绒怪快递到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，这样我们就能彻底摆脱它了。我们需要一个特别的飞行员，这个人必须具备技巧与胆量，必须无所畏惧，而且…不能对毛绒怪过敏。你有兴趣么？

messages.en: I'll deliver the vaccine, but only if you stop calling me a furrier-hauler.
messages.zh: 我愿意运送疫苗，但你以后别再叫我“毛绒怪搬运工”了。

messages.en: I knew you'd want to help. Please make it snappy.
messages.zh: 我就知道你会乐意帮忙。抓紧时间吧。

messages.en: Who are you calling a furrier-hauler, drink-spiller?
messages.zh: 你说谁是毛绒怪搬运工呢？你这个乱撒饮料的家伙。

messages.en: That furrier you delivered was carrying some kind of disease, and it's running rampant since the thing bit a few folks here. We haven't got the right vaccine here. Since you were the one who brought the damned furrier that started it all, I think it's only fitting that you get the vaccine and bring it back here for us.
messages.zh: 你运送的那只毛绒怪携带了某种疾病，它在这里咬了几个人，然后这种疾病就迅速传开了。我们这里没有合适的疫苗。既然是你把那个该死的毛绒怪送来的，我想只有你替我们把疫苗取来才是最合适的。

messages.en: Vaccine delivered, boss.
messages.zh: 疫苗已经送到了，老大。

messages.en: Great job, {[character]player.name}. Come back later and I'll see if I can scrounge up another job for you.
messages.zh: 好样的，{[character]player.name}！之后再过来，我看看能不能给你找点别的活。

messages.en:
Ha. Good one…

Listen, about that furrier? Things have gotten a little complicated, {[character]player.name}. That thing was carrying some kind of disease, and it's running rampant since the thing bit a few folks here. We haven't got the right vaccine here, and god the place is in bad shape — people turning green and swelling up like balloons everywhere. Since you were the one who brought the damned furrier that started it all, I think it's only fitting that you get the vaccine and bring it back here for us.

Oh, yeah — we'll vaccinate you before you leave, too. What do you say, champ?
messages.zh:
哈。说得好……

听着，关于那只毛绒怪？事情变得有些复杂，{[character]player.name}。那东西携带着某种疾病，它在这里咬了几个人，然后这种疾病就迅速传开了。我们这里没有合适的疫苗。天啊，这地方现在太不雅观了——人们全身发绿，向气球一样涨得鼓鼓的。既然是你把那个该死的毛绒怪送来的，我想只有你替我们把疫苗取来才是最合适的。

哦，对了——在你离开之前，我们也会给你注射疫苗。你觉得怎么样，伙计？

messages.en: Okay, but just this one more time.
messages.zh: 好的，但这可是最后一次了。

messages.en: Here's the manifest. Now get going.
messages.zh: 这就是货物清单。现在快走。

messages.en: You are? Why? Spill another drink and you need me to get some wipes for you?
messages.zh: 真的？为什么？又洒了一杯饮料，要我帮你擦干净？

messages.en:
It seems that the folks at one of our other offices can't find the proper paperwork about this last pet shipment, and they need this manifest. Or at least what's left of it after I spilled my drink on it. They're begging us to send it over. So, can you run this manifest over there so we can put this entire sordid affair behind us?

Remember to put the manifest in your cargo hold or you'll have to come back and relive the whole, sad incident all over again.
messages.zh:
我们另一座办公室的家伙们似乎找不到这批宠物的相关书面文件了，所以他们需要这份货物清单。不过由于我把饮料洒在了上面，现在只能说是这份清单的残余部分了。他们央求我们把东西送过去。那么，你能把这份清单送过去吗？之后我们就可以把这整件烂事丢在脑后了。

别忘了把货物清单放进你的货柜舱里，否则你又要让这出悲剧重新上演了。

messages.en: Done, {[character]agentID.name}. Hope that helped.
messages.zh: 任务完成，{[character]agentID.name}。希望这有用。

messages.en: Thank goodness. That's the last furrier we'll be transporting out of thisstation, let me tell you.
messages.zh: 谢天谢地。我跟你说，这肯定是从这座空间站里送出的最后一只毛绒怪了。

messages.en:
Ha! Smartass! No, nothing like that {[character]player.name}. Er, well, sort of…

It seems that the folks at one of our other offices can't find the proper paperwork about this last pet shipment, and they need this manifest. Or at least what's left of it after I spilled my drink on it. They're begging us to send it over. So, can you run this manifest over there so we can put this entire sordid affair behind us?
messages.zh:
哈！鬼机灵！不，不是那样的，{[character]player.name}。呃，其实，也差不多……

我们另一座办公室的家伙们似乎找不到这批宠物的相关书面文件了，所以他们需要这份货物清单。不过由于我把饮料洒在了上面，现在只能说是这份清单的残余部分了。他们央求我们把东西送过去。那么，你能把这份清单送过去吗？之后我们就可以把这整件烂事丢在脑后了。

name.de: Jagd auf einen Ketzer - Einen Spinner aufspüren (1 von 3)
name.en: Hunting a Heretic  - Tracking a Crackpot (1 of 3)
name.es: A la caza del hereje: Tras un chiflado (1 de 3)
name.fr: Chasse à l'hérétique - À la poursuite du Tordu (1 sur 3)
name.ja: ヘレティック狩り-気違いの追跡（1/3）
name.ru: Охота на еретика – выслеживание Дурного (Hunting a Heretic  - Tracking a Crackpot) (1 из 3)
name.zh: 追捕异教徒—追踪狂想者（1/3）

messages.en: That sounds simple enough. I'll get the data for you.
messages.zh: 这听起来够简单的了。我去帮你拿数据。

messages.en: Go quickly. I can't afford to lose this lead.
messages.zh: 赶快去。我决不能丢失这条线索。

messages.en: Of course I am.
messages.zh: 我当然忠诚。

messages.en:
One of the functions of my job is to ensure things operate smoothly in this region. I have a number of informants that keep me in the loop of the less visible happenings. They tend to be skittish by nature, but recently one of my informants was noticeably shaken. He won't send the information, and he won't meet me in person. He's insisted that I send a third party to pick up the data.

Normally I'd just find another informant, but this one was on the trail of a particularly virulent heretic. The man can't be anything but mad--he calls himself The Crackpot, for one thing--but it's damned hard to track a madman. He's been attracting attention, even followers from among the weak-minded, and it's long past time to put a stop to his nonsense.

If you'll go and pick up that data, it could help us track this menace down.
messages.zh:
我的职责之一是维护本地区的秩序。我的众多线人让最隐秘的事情也不能逃脱我的眼睛。他们天性怯懦，但是最近其中一个线人却举止异常。他不愿意向我报告情报，也不愿与我私下见面。他坚持要第三方去取情报。

我本应该再找一个线人来代替他，可是他正在跟踪一伙凶恶的异教徒。他一定是疯了——最起码他管自己叫狂想者——但要追踪一个疯子实在太困难了。他现在正在吸引注意力，甚至连胆小鬼都在追随他。我早就该阻止他的胡作非为了。

如果你能去取得情报资料，一定会对我们追踪这个危险分子有帮助。

messages.en: I've got the data.
messages.zh: 数据到手了。

messages.en: Well done. Once I get this decrypted, I may have more work for you.
messages.zh: 干得好！等我把它解密之后，也许有更多的活儿要你干。

messages.en: I'm not interested.
messages.zh: 我没兴趣。

messages.en: Not so loyal after all.
messages.zh: 说到底，你的忠心不过如此。

我本应该再找一个线人来代替他，可是他正在跟踪一伙凶恶的异教徒。他一定是疯了——他管自己叫狂想者。另一方面——要追踪一个疯子实在太困难了。他现在正在吸引注意力，甚至连胆小鬼都在追随他。我早就该阻止他的胡作非为了。

messages.en: Something spooked the snitch and he ran off. Now we'll have to find a new source for intel on this heretic, and who knows where he'll be by then.
messages.zh: 线人受到了惊吓，逃跑了。现在我们得找一个新的线人来获取关于那个异教徒的情报，到时候谁知道他已经跑到哪去了。

messages.en: You blew it.
messages.zh: 你搞砸了。

messages.en: I don't like the sound of this. I quit.
messages.zh: 我不喜欢你的弦外之音。我退出。

messages.en: Not so loyal after all.
messages.zh: 说到底，你的忠心不过如此。

messages.en: Something spooked the snitch and he ran off. Now we'll have to find a new source for intel on this heretic, and who knows where he'll be by then.
messages.zh: 线人受到了惊吓，逃跑了。现在我们得找一个新的线人来获取关于那个异教徒的情报，到时候谁知道他已经跑到哪去了。

messages.en: You blew it.
messages.zh: 你搞砸了。

name.de: Jagd auf einen Ketzer - Bücherverbrennung (2 von 3)
name.en: Hunting a Heretic - Book Burning (2 of 3)
name.es: A la caza del hereje: La quema de libros (2 de 3)
name.ja: ヘレティック狩り-禁書（2/3）
name.ru: Охота на еретика – сожжение книг (Hunting a Heretic - Book Burning) (2 из 3)

messages.en: I'll go and get the books immediately.
messages.zh: 我立即去取书。

messages.en: Remember, we can't get rid of this trash fast enough.
messages.zh: 记住，这些垃圾越快处理掉越好。

messages.en: What else can I do?
messages.zh: 我还能帮上什么忙吗？

messages.en:
The Crackpot has been hiding his heretical nonsense in copies of the Pax Amarria! This is absolutely intolerable! Needless to say, we've been seizing copies as they're found, and of course those in possession of such an insulting piece of work have been detained for questioning. Still, that leaves us with a pile of gilded filth on our hands.

I want you to go pick up the copies that are being held and bring them back here. We're having the Pax Amarria covers stripped off before we send them along for the ceremonial burning.
messages.zh:
“狂想者”竟然把他那些荒唐的异端邪说藏在《和平艾玛》的副本里！这绝对不能容忍！毫无疑问，这些副本一经发现就会被我们没收，当然，那些持有这种大不敬作品的人都已被拘留盘问。我们手上已经有了一堆这种镀金的垃圾。

我要你去取一下由我们保管的那些副本并带到这来。我们要先把《和平艾玛》的封面剥下来，然后再对这些书举行焚烧典礼。

messages.en: I have the heretical nonsense you requested.
messages.zh: 我已经拿到你说的那些异端歪理邪说了。

messages.en:
We'll get these stripped down and shipped out as quickly as possible. They'll be burned at a more appropriate location.

By the way, some of our detainees have proved… most informative. I should have more work for you soon.
messages.zh:
我们会撕掉这些封面，然后尽快运出去。它们将在一个更加合适的地点被烧毁。

顺便说一下，被拘留的人中有一些……非常“消息灵通”。我应该很快就会有更多的活儿给你。

messages.en: I'm not helping with any book-burning.
messages.zh: 我可不帮你干烧书的活儿。

messages.en: I thought you were better than that.
messages.zh: 看来我高估你了。

messages.en: From the publisher's description: "This is the most remarkable book published in the last century. Here, the great Emperor Heideran VII records his dreams for peace throughout the galaxy; it is this vision that propelled him into becoming a champion of interstellar relations. His relentless struggle toward this goal has brought unparalleled harmony among the empires; his constant search for peaceful solutions to any problem having many times quelled the storms of hostilities on the horizon. His determination and his powers of persuasion have compelled his own people and others to sacrifice many things they thought sacred to ensure that tranquility will prevail, now and forever."
messages.zh: 出版商的描述：“这是上个世纪最杰出的一本书。书中，希德伦七世记录了他希望全宇宙和平的梦想，这种远见推动他成为星际关系的积极倡导者。他对此目标的不懈努力为各帝国间关系带来了空前的和谐；他通过和平手段处理一切问题的态度，平息了不少可能酿成大祸的风暴。他的决心和强大的说服力使他的许多民众以及其他种族放弃了许多对他们具有神圣意义的事物，从而确保了和平能永远成为主旋律。”

messages.en: The Pax Amarria
messages.zh: 和平艾玛

messages.en:
That Crackpot has been hiding his heretical nonsense in copies of the Pax Amarria! This is absolutely intolerable! Needless to say, we've been seizing copies as they're found, and of course those in possession of such an insulting piece of work have been detained for questioning. Still, that leaves us with a pile of gilded filth on our hands.

I want you to go pick up the copies that are being held and bring them back here. We're having the Pax Amarria covers stripped off before we send them along for the ceremonial burning.
messages.zh:
“狂想者”竟然把他那些荒唐的异端邪说藏在《和平艾玛》的副本里！这绝对不能容忍！毫无疑问，这些副本一经发现就会被我们没收，当然，那些持有这种大不敬作品的人都已被拘留盘问。我们手上已经有了一堆这种镀金的垃圾。

messages.en: I'll find someone who understands that, and can help us dispose of this garbage in a more timely fashion.
messages.zh: 我会另请高明，他能理解我们的行动，而且能帮我们更快处理掉这些垃圾。

messages.en: This is a sensitive matter.
messages.zh: 这是个敏感事件。

messages.en: I don't like the sound of this. I quit.
messages.zh: 我不喜欢你的弦外之音。我退出。

messages.en: I thought you were better than that.
messages.zh: 看来我高估你了。

messages.en: I'll find someone who understands that, and can help us dispose of this garbage in a more timely fashion.
messages.zh: 我会另请高明，他能理解我们的行动，而且能帮我们更快处理掉这些垃圾。

messages.zh: 这是个敏感事件。

name.de: Jagd auf einen Ketzer - Spinner geschnappt! (3 von 3)
name.en: Hunting a Heretic - Crackpot Captured! (3 of 3)
name.es: A la caza del hereje: ¡Chiflado capturado! (3 de 3)
name.fr: Chasse à l'hérétique - Tordu capturé ! (3 sur 3)
name.ja: ヘレティック狩り-気違いの捕獲（3/3）（3/3）
name.ru: Охота на еретика – Дурной схвачен! (Hunting a Heretic - Crackpot Captured!) (3 из 3)
name.zh: 追捕异教徒—“狂想者”落网！（3/3）

messages.en: I'm honored to be of service the Empire.
messages.zh: 能够为帝国效力，是我的荣幸。

messages.en: I thought you would be. Remember, this must be done quickly, before word gets out.
messages.zh: 我料到你会答应。记住，一定要行动迅速，以免走漏风声。

messages.en: You do?
messages.zh: 你是说真的？

messages.en: We've finally got The Crackpot. I need you to go pick him up and bring him here. We've made sure to keep him anonymous. Go and get him before some other loon tries to break him out.
messages.zh: 我们终于抓到了“狂想者”。我需要你去把他接到这里来。我们设法隐去了他的姓名。赶在其他疯子把他救出来之前，去那里把他带来。

messages.en: I have the Crackpot.
messages.zh: 我把“狂想者”带来了。

messages.en: The Empire thanks you for your assistance in disposing of this trash.
messages.zh: 帝国感谢你为处理这些垃圾所给予的协助。

messages.en: I don't like the sound of this. I think I'll pass.
messages.zh: 我不喜欢你的弦外之音。我想我还是免了。

messages.en: I thought you'd be pleased at the chance to finally bring this menace in.
messages.zh: 我原以为你会为终于有机会制裁这个危险分子而感到高兴。

messages.en:
We've finally got The Crackpot. It turns out his real name was Russell. I need you to go pick him up and bring him here for transport. We want him there when his books burn—he'll need to recant publicly, throw the books on the fire, that sort of thing. After all, we wouldn't want him martyred.

He's in confinement a few jumps away. We've made sure to keep him anonymous. There are still some crazed sympathizers on the loose, and we don't want them endangering themselves any further. Go and get him before some other loon tries to break him out.
messages.zh:
我们终于抓到了“狂想者”。原来他的真名叫罗塞尔。我需要你去把他接到这里来以便再次转移。当他的书被烧毁时，我们需要他在场——我们要让他当众宣布放弃他的异教信仰，亲手把书扔进火里。说到底，我们可不想让他成为殉教的圣人。

他就被关在几个跳跃之外。我们设法隐去了他的姓名。他还有一些未受到监控的疯狂支持者，我们不希望他们再继续自我伤害了。赶在其他疯子把他救出来之前，去那里把他带来。

messages.en: Someone broke that madman out. Now we'll have to start the hunt all over again.
messages.zh: 有人突破牢狱，放出了那个疯子。我们现在不得不从头开始整个搜捕过程。

messages.en: The Crackpot is gone.
messages.zh: “狂想者”逃了。

messages.en: I don't like the direction this is going. I quit.
messages.zh: 我不喜欢这件事的处理方式。我退出。

messages.en: Well, I'm sure I can find someone who will properly appreciate the honor of this assignment.
messages.zh: 好吧，我肯定能够找到一个能够理解这项任务所赋予的荣誉的人。

messages.en: Someone broke that madman out. Now we'll have to start the hunt all over again.
messages.zh: 有人突破牢狱，放出了那个疯子。我们现在不得不从头开始整个搜捕过程。

messages.en: The Crackpot is gone.
messages.zh: “狂想者”逃了。

name.de: Für die Truppen - Essen fürs Vergnügen (1 von 3)
name.en: For the Troops - Food for Fun (1 of 3)
name.es: Por las tropas: Comida y entretenimiento (1 de 3)
name.fr: Pour les troupes - De la bouffe pour le moral (1 sur 3)
name.ja: 部隊のために―楽しい食事（1/3）
name.ru: Для солдат – еда для удовольствия (For the Troops - Food for Fun) (1 из 3)

messages.en: Food?  You got it.
messages.zh: 食物？遵命。

messages.en: And do hurry.  Our chefs are grumpy and impatient.
messages.zh: 动作要快。厨师们已经脾气焦躁，等得不耐烦了。

messages.en: How can I aid the mighty State?
messages.zh: 我该怎样为伟大的合众国效力？

messages.en:
A number of the mega-corporations have joined together to produce SPLET: the State Personnel Life Enrichment Tour.

The first thing we need is food, and there are crates of frozen food waiting not too far from here. Bring the food here so our chefs can start to figure out how to stretch it into an appropriately festive-- but still economical-- dish.
messages.zh:
几家超级集团联合创办了SPLET——合众国工作人员生活改善巡游。

我们首先需要的是食物。在不太远的地方就有几箱冷冻食物等着我们去取回来。把那些食物带过来，这样我们的厨师就能开始构思：怎样把它们做成一道既有欢宴气氛又经济节约的大餐。

messages.en: Food has arrived.
messages.zh: 食物已经送到。

messages.en: Not very appetizing, is it?  I have faith our chefs will be able to make ...something... out of it.  But come, there is still more to do.
messages.zh: 看上去不是很好吃，对吗？我相信，厨师们应该能够从中做出……一些东西……来的。不过马上回来，还有很多事情要做。

messages.en: To hell with food delivery.  The soldiers should be happy simply serving the State.
messages.zh: 让食物运送滚蛋。士兵的满足应该只体现在为合众国效命。

messages.en: The State should support its soldiers not out of concern for the soldier, but for the services he renders.  Remember this in your future travels.
messages.zh: 合众国对士兵的支持，不应出于对士兵的关心，而是为了士兵所提供的服务。在你今后的旅行中，记住这一点。

messages.en: The problem is information networks. Our soldiers are well cared for and would normally be content, but they find that pictures and holoreels all tend to be from Gallente producers. They see the decadence and excess of our enemies. Our men are revolted by the excess of the Gallente, yes, but there is jealousy among them as well. And this jealousy is eating away at the core of our efforts.
messages.zh: 问题出在信息网络上。我们的士兵都受到了很好的照料，而且通常都很知足，但是他们发现网络上的图片和全息电影似乎都来自盖伦特生产商。他们看到了敌人的堕落和无度。我们的军人的确对盖伦特人的堕落感到厌恶，但其中也不乏妒嫉。这种妒嫉正在慢慢蚕食着我们事业的核心价值。

messages.en: Why is morale faltering?
messages.zh: 为什么士气不振？

messages.en:
Even with the best of equipment and space superiority, any long-term military engagement has to rely on ground and station personnel. And personnel are only as reliable as their morale. I won't lie to you, the morale of our soldiers could be better.

To fix this, a number of the mega-corporations have joined together to produce SPLET—the State Personnel Life Enrichment Tour. This program will tour to various parts of the State, providing entertainment and other morale services for our soldiers.

The first thing we need is food, and there are crates of frozen food waiting not too far from here. Bring the food here so our chefs can start to figure out how to stretch it into an appropriately festive-- but still economical-- dish.
messages.zh:
即使拥有最精良的装备和非凡的宇宙优越感，打持久战还是离不开基本的空间站人员管理。而人员管理和士气密不可分。我和你老实说，我们士兵的士气可以更高。

要提高士气，几家超级集团联合创办了SPLET——国家工作人员生活改善巡游。

我们首先需要的是食物。在不太远的地方就有几箱冷冻食物等着我们去取回来。把那些食物带到这来，这样我们的厨师就能开始构思怎样把它们做成一道既有欢宴气氛又经济节约的大餐。

messages.en: You have taken too long.  Our chefs have quit in disgust.  This will delay SPLET for weeks.
messages.zh: 你花的时间太长了……我们的厨师已经生气地辞职了。这会让SPLET耽误几个星期。

messages.en: SPLET Delayed
messages.zh: SPLET被耽搁

messages.en: I tire of trafficking food.  The soldiers should be happy simply serving the State.
messages.zh: 我讨厌运送食物。士兵的满足应该只体现在为合众国效命。

messages.en: The State should support its soldiers not out of concern for the soldier, but for the services he renders.  Remember this in your future travels.
messages.zh: 合众国对士兵的支持，不应出于对士兵的关心，而是为了士兵所提供的服务。在你今后的旅行中，记住这一点。

messages.en: You have taken too long.  Our chefs have quit in disgust.  This will delay SPLET for weeks.
messages.zh: 你花的时间太长了……我们的厨师已经生气地辞职了。这会让SPLET耽误几个星期。

messages.en: SPLET Delayed
messages.zh: SPLET被耽搁

messages.en: Sure, no problem. I'm on it.
messages.zh: 当然，没问题。我这就去干。

messages.en: Good luck, my friend!
messages.zh: 祝你好运，我的朋友！

messages.en: Yep. As usual, I'm the right one for the job, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 对了。我一如既往是这个工作的最佳人选，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en:
Our miners have just reported a bunch of rogue drones in the system. Between them and the damned ore thieves, I'm almost ready to give up. They're worse than Gallentean greenroaches – if we don't show them that they're not welcome here, we'll be up to our eyeballs. And I can't send my guys out there if I know they might be in danger. No, we need a capsuleer on this job, someone capable of defending a ship and mining at the same time.

I've bookmarked a mining site for you. Go on out there and, if you see any drones, take 'em out. You know the risks. Then mine whatever Banidine you find out there so I can find out what the damn things are so interested in.
messages.zh:
我们的矿工刚刚向我回报称，在星系内有一群失控的无人机。由于它们和那些该死的偷矿者，我们几乎要放弃了。他们甚至比那些盖伦特垃圾们更糟，我们需要给他们一点颜色看看。而我不能将我的同伴送去冒险。我们需要一个有能力的人来胜任这项工作，一个既能够保护自己同时又能够采矿的人。

我为你已经标注了一个矿点。去吧，如果你看到任何无人机，请摧毁它们。你知道的，这活有风险。那么就去挖班尼德勒石吧，看看你是否对这项危险的工作感兴趣。

messages.en: Here's the ore you asked for. Seems like a waste of time, but hey — anything the drones want, it's a safe bet we shouldn't let them have it, right?
messages.zh: 这是你要的矿石。好像是浪费时间，不过——不管无人机想要什么，我们让它们没法得到就是保险了，对吧？

messages.en: Agreed, {[character]player.name}... can't be a good thing. Thanks for the assist!
messages.zh: 同意，{[character]player.name}……它们不会干好事。谢谢协助！

messages.en: Most people don't go looking for Banidine: It's virtually worthless, so you won't find it on the market.
messages.zh: 大多数人不会去找班尼德勒石：它几乎没有价值，所以在市场上根本看不到。

messages.en: Banidine and Scanners
messages.zh: 班尼德勒石和扫描器

messages.en:
Yes, I think you are. Listen, our miners have just reported a bunch of rogue drones in the system. Between them and the damned ore thieves, I'm almost ready to give up. They're worse than Gallentean greenroaches – if we don't show them that they're not welcome here, we'll be up to our eyeballs. And I can't send my guys out there if I know they might be in danger. No, we need a capsuleer on this job, someone capable of defending a ship and mining at the same time.

I've bookmarked a mining site for you. Go on out there and, if you see any drones, take 'em out. Be caref— well, I don't need to tell an experienced starship captain like you. You know the risks. Then mine whatever Banidine you find out there so I can find out what the damn things are so interested in.
messages.zh:
是的，我知道你在。听着，我们的矿工刚刚向我回报称，在星系内有一群失控的无人机。由于它们和那些该死的偷矿者，我们几乎要放弃了。他们甚至比那些盖伦特垃圾们更糟，我们需要给他们一点颜色看看。而我不能将我的同伴送去冒险。我们需要一个有能力的人来胜任这项工作，一个既能够保护自己同时又能够采矿的人。

我为你已经标注了一个矿点。去吧，如果你看到任何无人机，请摧毁它们。你知道的，这活有风险。那么就去挖班尼德勒石吧，看看你是否对这项危险的工作感兴趣。

name.en: For the Troops - Error of Comedy (2 of 3)
name.fr: Pour les troupes - Erreur de comédie (2 sur 3)
name.ja: 部隊のために―喜劇の間違い（2/3）
name.ru: Для солдат – ошибка комедии (For the Troops - Error of Comedy) (2 из 3)

messages.en: This is getting slightly weird, but okay.
messages.zh: 这事有点奇怪，不过好吧，我接受。

messages.en: Trust me, this isn't any less weird on my side.
messages.zh: 相信我，在我看来，这也很奇怪。

messages.en: What are we talking about?  Musical acts?  Stunts?
messages.zh: 我们都在说些什么呀？音乐剧？特技表演？

messages.en: There is a man awaiting pick-up at a nearby station-- I'll upload the coordinates to your Neocom. The man is a comedian of a specialized sort.  You‘ll know him when you see him.  Bring him back here for me.
messages.zh: 在附近一座空间里有个人正等待接送；我会把坐标直接上传到你的控制边栏里。这个人是一个特型喜剧演员。你一看到他，就会知道是他。替我把他带到这来。

messages.en: Though it may constitute some form of war-crime, here is your prop comedian.
messages.zh: 尽管这可能会触犯军法，但我还是把你要的头号台柱喜剧演员带来了。

messages.en: I share your misgivings, but if this is the worst thing we do to our men, then we will be well on our way to perfection.
messages.zh: 我和你有同样的顾虑，但如果这样一个喜剧演员就算是我们给士兵的最大灾难的话，那只能说明我们在其他方面已经做得很好了。

messages.en: I will not bother with this.  The comedian can take a transport like everyone else.
messages.zh: 我不想自找麻烦。那个喜剧演员可以跟别人一样乘坐运输舰。

messages.en: Indeed he could, but the State wants him here now, and if you will not get him, I will have someone else do it.
messages.zh: 他确实可以，但合众国需要他立即到这里来。如果你不愿你去接他，那我就另请高明了。

messages.en: According to recent studies, the typical foot soldier's sense of humor tends towards the ironic, with a particular fondness for satire and gallows humor. Yet to hear Command tell it, these types of humor are the most dangerous to morale.  As a result, most government-sponsored entertainment is consciously light-hearted, even if nobody really enjoys it.
messages.zh: 最近的研究表明，普通步兵的幽默感偏向于讽刺型，特别喜欢讽刺和沉痛型的幽默。不过据指挥部称，这类幽默是军心和士气最危险的敌人。因此，政府支助的许多娱乐项目都刻意办得轻松愉快，尽管没有人真心喜欢。

messages.en: Why this guy?
messages.zh: 为什么是这个家伙？

messages.en:
No, the State cannot afford the lofty prices of professional entertainers of such caliber. We have booked far worse, I'm afraid.

There is a man awaiting pick-up at a nearby station-- I'll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom. The man is a comedian of a specialized sort. You‘ll know him when you see him. Bring him back here for me.
messages.zh:
不，那种档次的职业表演者要价太高，合众国请不起。恐怕我们预订的演员要差多了。

在附近一座空间里有个人正等待接送；我会把坐标直接上传到你的控制边栏里。这个人是一个特型喜剧演员。你一看到他，就会知道是他。替我把他带到这来。

messages.en: Our prop comedian is dead.  He was reportedly beaten and stabbed to death by citizens who were simply "annoyed into a murderous rage."  Had you acted faster, we might have acquired his services before he was brutally killed at the hands of a vengeful mob.
messages.zh: 我们的头号台柱喜剧演员死了。据报告，他被一群公民殴打并穿刺致死，那些公民被“过度骚扰，以致陷入了狂暴的愤怒”。如果你行动快些，我们可能已经赶在他被一群暴徒残忍加害之前看到他的表演了。

messages.en: "Comedian's Act Ends Early"
messages.zh: “喜剧演员的表演提前谢幕”

messages.en: I have delivered many inane objects in my time, but I will never deliver a comedian.
messages.zh: 我这人送过许多荒唐的东西，但我永远也不会去接送喜剧演员。

messages.en: Inane or not, this job posed no threat to your safety.
messages.zh: 不管是否荒唐，这个任务肯定不会威胁你的安全。

messages.en: Our prop comedian is dead.  He was reportedly beaten and stabbed to death by citizens who were simply "annoyed into a murderous rage."  Had you acted faster, we might have acquired his services before he was brutally killed at the hands of a vengeful mob.
messages.zh: 我们的头号台柱喜剧演员死了。据报告，他被一群公民殴打并穿刺致死，那些公民被“过度骚扰，以致陷入了狂暴的愤怒”。如果你行动快些，我们可能已经赶在他被一群暴徒残忍加害之前看到他的表演了。

messages.en: "Comedian's Act Ends Early"
messages.zh: “喜剧演员的表演提前谢幕”

messages.en: A race against the drones, huh? Sure, I'll do it.
messages.zh: 与无人机的竞赛，对吧？当然，交给我吧。

messages.en: Get this done, {[character]player.name}. We don't really need that Banidine, but better we get it than those drones.
messages.zh: 完成这个任务，{[character]player.name}。我们不是真需要那些班尼德勒石，但是我们得到它总好过那些无人机得到它。

messages.en: What's this about drones?
messages.zh: 这些无人机是怎么回事？

messages.en:
A recent survey scan of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} reveals a big deposit of Banidine ore. We were content to leave it alone at first, but then we saw swarms of drones in the area. They seem to be making their way through the asteroid fields there in a hurry. They haven't stumbled on the Banidine yet, but it's only a matter of time.

We want you to get to the ore before they do. I won't lie to you; it's going to be close. You may even have to fight a few of them off, so be careful.
messages.zh:
最近一次对{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的测量扫描结果显示，那里有一个大型班尼德勒石矿藏。起初，我们没有理会它，可是后来我们发现大群无人机进入了那一区域。它们似乎正在小行星带中快速穿行。它们尚未发现那些班尼德勒石，不过那只是时间问题。

我们要你赶在它们前面找到矿石。实话告诉你，它们离那里不远。你甚至可能得击退它们中的一些，所以，要小心。

messages.en: Got your Banidine here. No drones were going to stop me.
messages.zh: 我把你要的班尼德勒石带来了。没有无人机能挡得住我。

messages.en: Good work. Those drones are making life difficult for everyone hereabouts.
messages.zh: 干得好。那些无人机让这一带人们生活得很苦。

messages.en: No. I'm not scared, I'm just sick of mining and popping drones.
messages.zh: 不，我不是怕。我就是讨厌采矿和突然冒出来的无人机。

messages.en: If we don't get that Banidine, those drones will. I hope someone else can do it.
messages.zh: 如果我们不得到那些班尼德勒石，那些无人机就会得手。希望别的什么人能完成这件任务。

messages.en:
It's not a well-kept secret that as rogue drones get more advanced, they're becoming more unpredictable. Talk to any seasoned pod pilot and they'll tell you about the dozens of rogue drones they've had to fight off just in the course of their regular business. Even more disturbing are reports of drone hives, massive constructs of debris that no one can quite figure out, but which are always full of haywire drones.

So what's their interest in Banidine? Who knows?! Most humans don't go looking for the stuff: It's virtually worthless, so you won't find it on the market. In fact, most sensor manufacturers don't even bother giving it its own entry in their mining packages when they produce ship scanners. (If you're having trouble finding the Banidine at the mission location, you can right-click the "Banidine" icon in the mission details in your Opportunity interface entry and select "Add to Overview.")

So, again, why the interest from the drones? Well, none but the drones can say, and they're not talking. Suffice to say that their interest can't mean anything good for the humans that share their space.
messages.zh:
自由无人机越来越先进，这已经是一个公开的秘密了，它们变得更加难以预测。随便找那些太空舱飞行员老手聊聊，他们就会告诉你，在他们的生意航线上要和数量众多的自由无人机战斗简直是家常便饭。无人机母巢的报道加剧了人们的担忧，巨大残骸里到底是什么构造，没人知道，但里面装满了失控的无人机。

它们为什么会盯上班尼德勒石？谁知道呢？！大多数人不会去找这些东西：它几乎没有价值，所以在市场上根本看不到。实际上，大多数感应器生产商在生产舰船扫描器时，甚至不屑在采矿扫描选项中为这种矿石单独设立条目。（如果在任务地点找不到班尼德勒石，那就右击“机遇”界面任务详情中的“班尼德勒石”图标，然后选择“添加至总览”。）

话说回来，为什么这些无人机想要这种石头？这只有无人机自己知道，可惜它们开不了口。我只能说，不管它们有何企图，对我们这些生活在同一片太空中的人而言都不是什么好事。

messages.en: Rogue Drones and Asteroid Fields
messages.zh: 自由无人机和小行星带

messages.en:
A recent survey scan of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} reveals a big deposit of Banidine ore. We were content to leave it alone at first, but then we saw swarms of drones in the area. They seem to be making their way through the asteroid fields there in a hurry. They haven't stumbled on the Banidine yet, but it's only a matter of time.

We want you to get to the ore before they do. I won't lie to you; it's going to be close. You may even have to fight a few of them off, so be careful.
messages.zh:
最近一次对{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的测量扫描结果显示，那里有一个大型班尼德勒石矿藏。起初，我们没有理会它，可是后来我们发现大群无人机进入了那一区域。它们似乎正在小行星带中快速穿行。它们尚未发现那些班尼德勒石，不过那只是时间问题。

我们要你赶在它们前面找到矿石。实话告诉你，它们离那里不远。你甚至可能得击退它们中的一些，所以，要小心。

messages.en: I'm giving the job to someone else. The universe isn't going to stop and wait for you to make up your mind.
messages.zh: 我要把这任务交给别人了。宇宙不会停下来等你做决定。

messages.en: Mission revoked
messages.zh: 任务废除

messages.en: I decided I'm not really into this job.
messages.zh: 我决定了，我对这项工作不感兴趣。

messages.en: What? A few drones too much for you to handle?
messages.zh: 什么？几架无人机你都应付不来？

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, because of your inaction, the drone swarm found the Banidine. This rare mineral is now even rarer because you let those automatons get to it first, and that can't be good for any of us.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，由于你的无所作为，无人机群找到了班尼德勒石。这种稀有的矿物现在更加稀有了，就是因为你让那些机器生物抢先得到了它。这对我们所有人都不会是好事。

messages.en: Drone troubles unanswered
messages.zh: 无人机问题未解决

messages.en: Sure. I'll see what I can do.
messages.zh: 好。我会看看我能做什么的。

messages.en: Don't waste any time. Our people are waiting.
messages.zh: 一分钟也别浪费。我们的人民在等着呢。

messages.en: I'm ready. What's up?
messages.zh: 我准备好了。出什么事了？

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} wants a massive shipment of Augumene right away, so we need you to get out there and bring some back. I've been looking for a miner who's experienced enough, with the right kind of ship, and maybe you fit the bill. Time is critical on this one. There's a big bonus for you if you can bring it in fast enough.

Pirates and claimjumpers abound in these parts, so you should also be prepared to defend your ship from such scavengers.

Finally, this amount of raw Augumene ore may require multiple trips unless you have a Hulk or a similarly large hauler for the job.
messages.zh:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}需要立刻得到一大船奥古米内石，所以我们需要你出去采些这种矿石带回来。我在寻找一个经验足够丰富，而且拥有合适飞船的采矿者，也许你能满足我的要求。这次任务时间很紧迫。如果你能尽快把矿石带来，你还会得到一大笔额外奖励。

这一带海盗和强盗横行，你也要做好准备，保护你的舰船免受这些拾荒者的袭击。

最后，这批奥古米内石矿藏数量巨大，除非你拥有霍克号或同等规模的运载舰，否则可能需要多次往返。

messages.en: I have your mountain of Augumene right here.
messages.zh: 你要的堆积如山的奥古米内石就在这里。

messages.en: Nice work. I'll keep you in mind when something else comes up.
messages.zh: 干得不错。如果还有别的任务，我会想到你的。

messages.en: I hope I can find someone else to handle this.
messages.zh: 我希望能够找到其他人来处理这个问题。

messages.en: Augumene is an extremely toxic ore; fortunately, it is also extremely rare. It can be mined safely from a starship, but proves very deadly when handled directly unless one takes extremely expensive safety precautions that more than negate any profit to be made from refining the stuff. For this reason, even black market operators generally won't deal in it, and it is never found for sale on the open market.
messages.zh: 奥古米内石是一种剧毒的矿石；幸运的是，它也极为稀有。从星舰上采集它是很安全的，但是如果直接加以处理，它会非常致命，除非采用极为昂贵的安全预防措施，可是这种方法的成本远远抵消了精炼后的全部利润。正因如此，就连黑市经营者都不会做它的买卖，而在正规市场上，它更是不见踪影。

messages.en: Augumene
messages.zh: 奥古米内石

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} wants a massive shipment of Augumene right away, so we need you to get out there and bring some back. They seem to think they might be able to find some use for the stuff for chemical warfare, I guess? But that's just between you and me, right?

Anyway, I've been looking for a miner who's experienced enough, with the right kind of ship, and maybe you fit the bill. Time is critical on this one. There's a big bonus for you if you can bring it in fast enough.

Seriously, we need a mountain of this stuff, so get on it. I've uploaded the location to your People & Places databank.
messages.zh:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}急需一大批奥古米内石，所以我们需要你出去采些这种矿石带回来。我猜他们大概认为可以将这东西用于化学战吧？但这话也就你我之间说说，好吧？

总之，我在寻找一个经验足够丰富，而且拥有合适飞船的采矿者，也许你能满足我的要求。这次任务时间很紧迫。如果你能尽快把矿石带来，你还会得到一大笔额外奖励。

说真的，我们需要很多这种东西，像一座山那么多，所以快去吧。我已经把地点上传到你的“人物和地点”数据库。

messages.en: Maybe next time, huh? In any case, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will manage. It's your loss.
messages.zh: 也许下次？不管怎么样，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}都会搞定的。这是你的损失。

messages.en: If it will help us defeat those bastards, I'll do it.
messages.zh: 如果这对我们打败那些混蛋有用，我就做。

messages.en: Make me proud.
messages.zh: 让我为你骄傲吧。

messages.en: Sure. Uh, how do I do that?
messages.zh: 好。呃，我该怎么做呢？

messages.en: Acquire the 20,000 units of Augumene at the location I've given you. Now, there may be other folks looking to get this stuff too, so don't go out there unprepared to defend yourself, okay?
messages.zh: 前往我给你的地点，把那20,000单位的奥古米内石带回来。不过，可能还有其他家伙也在打这东西的主意，所以务必有所防备，记得保护好自己，明白吗？

messages.en: Here is the Augumene.
messages.zh: 这是你要的奥古米内石。

messages.en: Good. You've helped make the universe a safer place.
messages.zh: 好的。你为宇宙的安全做出了贡献。

messages.en: I don't want to be a part of this. It's just not right.
messages.zh: 我不想参与这个任务。这事根本就不正义。

messages.en: "Conscientious objectors" like you are going to destroy this government.
messages.zh: 像你这样“有良心的异议者”会毁掉这个政府的。

messages.en: Augumene is an extremely toxic ore; fortunately, it is also extremely rare. It can be mined safely from a starship, but proves very deadly when handled directly unless one takes extremely expensive safety precautions — which more than negates any profit to be made from reprocessing the stuff. For this reason, even black market operators generally won't deal in it, and it is never found for sale on the open market.
messages.zh: 奥古米内石是一种剧毒的矿石；幸运的是，它也极为稀有。从星舰上采集它是很安全的，但是如果直接加以处理，它会非常致命，除非采用极为昂贵的安全预防措施，可是这种方法的成本远远抵消了提炼后的全部利润。正因如此，就连黑市经营者都不会做它的买卖，而在正规市场上，它更是不见踪影。

messages.en: About Augumene
messages.zh: 关于奥古米内石

messages.en:
Chemical warfare may not be as flashy as space lasers or doomsday weapons, but it just might decide the outcome of this war we're in. After all, what's the value of taking over territory if all your planets are uninhabitable? Of course, our foes have found counters to most of the known chemical agents. So the key to victory will be new compounds.

That's why I want you to acquire a big bunch of Augumene for us. The stuff is insanely toxic, hence its absence on the market. But in this case, its very toxicity is what we want to harness.
messages.zh:
化学武器也许没有太空激光或末日武器那样炫目，但它可能使任何战争一锤定音。说到底，如果所有的行星都破坏得不宜居住了，那么占领那些土地又有什么意义呢？当然，各个帝国都已掌握了克制多数已知化学剂的方法。取胜的关键是使用新的化合物。

所以我们要求你为我们获取一大批奥古米内石。这东西的毒性非常猛烈，因此市场上买不到它。但现在，我们正是需要它的这种剧毒特性。

messages.en: I'm starting to think this is a bad idea. I quit.
messages.zh: 我开始觉得这是个馊主意了。我退出。

messages.en: Morals don't win wars.
messages.zh: 依靠高尚的道德无法打赢战争。

name.de: Für die Truppen - Letzte Verhandlungen (2 von 3)
name.en: For the Troops - Final Negotiations (3 of 3)
name.es: Por las tropas: Negociaciones finales (3 de 3)
name.fr: Pour les troupes - Négociations finales (3 sur 3)
name.ja: 部隊のために―最終交渉（3/3）
name.ru: Для солдат – окончательные переговоры (For the Troops - Final Negotiations) (3 из 3)

messages.en: I will do this last thing.
messages.zh: 我就再做这最后一件事。

messages.en: Good.  Although SPLET has not become what was originally envisioned, I doubt the soldiers will complain too loudly...
messages.zh: 好的。虽然SPLET变得和一开始的设想有所不同，但我觉得士兵们应该不会发什么牢骚吧……

messages.en: What's been cut?
messages.zh: 削减了什么？

messages.en:
We are working closely with several bathhouses through Nugoeihuvi to acquire the large number of companions required for SPLET. We are close to completing the contracts. All that is required to finalize is a final inspection, to be performed by the SPLET organizer.

Pick up the NOH prostitute-- I'll upload the station address to your NeoCom-- and return her here. After this last mission, I believe the program will be ready to launch.
messages.zh:
为了找到SPLET所需的一大批舞女，我们正在通过纳基维集团与几个浴场中心紧密合作。我们就快签订合同了。现在要做的就是进行最后的验收了，这将由SPLET组织者完成。

去接那个NOH混蛋，然后把她带到这来，我会把空间站位置上传到你的控制边栏。在这个最终任务之后，我相信我们的项目就能启动了。

messages.en: I have brought the— uh— negotiator.
messages.zh: 我把这名，呃，谈判者，带来了。

messages.en: Excellent.  Thanks to your help, SPLET will soon be making its way through the Caldari ranks.
messages.zh: 很好。多亏你的帮助，SPLET马上就要在加达里各部队巡游了。

messages.en: This task seems to favor the chairman more than the Caldari soldiers.  I will not do it.
messages.zh: 和加达里士兵比起来，主席似乎能从这个任务得到更多的好处。我不干。

messages.en: But we were so close to finally being done with this!
messages.zh: 我们差一点就把一切搞定了！

messages.en: The Nugoeihuvi Corporation, or NOH, is the only Caldari mega-corporation that has focused on the entertainment industry. They have always been suspected of strong ties to the Caldari underworld, mainly because many of their products cater to that social element or are on the borderline of legality.
messages.zh: 纳基维集团，也就是NOH，是唯一一家专注于娱乐业的加达里超级集团。人们怀疑该集团与加达里黑社会有紧密联系，主要是因为他们许多产品都迎合黑社会需求，或和法律打擦边球。

messages.en: NOH
messages.zh: NOH

messages.en:
Originally, we were going to be hiring the best dancers in Caldari space. It was to be a dazzling performance, with custom arranged music and specially choreographed numbers. It would have been a show both tantalizing and tasteful. But such things are expensive.

We found the best cost-effective solution by working with NOH's bathhouses. Traveling with SPLET will be a "companion army." We are close to completing the contracts. All that is left is a final round of...negotiation by the SPLET chairman.

Pick up the NOH prostitute-- I'll upload the station address to your NeoCom-- and return her here. After this last mission, I believe the program will be ready to launch.
messages.zh:
一开始，我们准备雇用加达里最优秀的舞女。精心编排的音乐加上特别的舞蹈设计，这本会是场炫目的演出。这场演出本该既具挑逗性而又不乏品位。不过这样做费用太高。

通过与NOH的浴场合作，我们找到了最具性价比的解决方案。到时将有一个“歌舞团”随SPLET出发。我们就快签订合同了。现在已经万事俱备，只差SPLET主席进行最后一轮……谈判了。

去接那个NOH混蛋，然后把她带到这来，我会把空间站位置上传到你的控制边栏。在这个最终任务之后，我相信我们的项目就能启动了。

messages.en: The chairman has grown impatient with the negotiator's delayed arrival.  He has cancelled SPLET, citing a “personal insult” on the part of NOH.
messages.zh: 由于谈判代表的迟到，主席失去了耐性。他取消了SPLET，说这是NOH方面对他“个人的侮辱”。

messages.en: SPLET Insulted
messages.zh: SPLET遭到侮辱

messages.en: I will not continue this mission.
messages.zh: 我不会继续这个任务了。

messages.en: Damn it, the chairman will have my head for this.
messages.zh: 该死，主席非要了我的脑袋不可。

messages.en: The chairman has grown impatient with the negotiator's delayed arrival.  He has cancelled SPLET, citing a “personal insult” on the part of NOH.
messages.zh: 由于谈判代表的迟到，主席失去了耐性。他取消了SPLET，说这是NOH方面对他“个人的侮辱”。

messages.en: SPLET Insulted
messages.zh: SPLET遭到侮辱

name.ja: 注意せよ、奴らは生きている

messages.en: Take out drones, mine Mercium. Got it, chief.
messages.zh: 消灭无人机，采回莫西石。明白了，长官。

messages.en: Glad to hear it. I'll leave you to it, then.
messages.zh: 很高兴听你这样说。那就交给你了。

messages.en: You know me. I'm always interested in work.
messages.zh: 你了解我的，我总是乐于工作。

messages.en:
Turns out someone got the bright idea that if mining drones mine more ore, bigger drones would mine even more ore. This guy's team slapped some mining drone's AI into non-regulation heavy combat units and threw some mining lasers on. He even hacked the firmware so that the mining brains could control the weaponry, making some sort of self-sufficient mining machines.

Now there's a bunch of haywire drones zipping about this rare mineral that we want. Our guys in the lab need it for research, I guess. The drones aren't even mining the rock, last I heard, but they have tried to bore through any ship we send out there....

It's getting ridiculous. If you can, get out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, neutralize the drones, and bring back all the Mercium; we'll pay you well for your efforts.
messages.zh:
有人想出了一个好主意，如果采矿无人机能采集更多的矿石，越大的无人机采集的矿石越多的话那该多好。这个家伙把某些采矿无人机的人工智能嵌入了非常规的重型战斗无人机，还为它们加上了采矿激光器。他甚至还破译了无人机固件，使得采矿控制单元能控制武器的使用，就像某种自给自足的采矿机器。

目前有这么一批无人机，它们发了疯似地采集我们需要的这种稀有矿石。我认为我们的实验室人员要用它来作研究。我上回听说，这些无人机不仅没有在采集矿石，它们还试图在我们派去那里的所有飞船上凿孔…

这太扯淡了。如果你行的话，前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}去消灭这些无人机，然后带回莫西石。我们会给你丰厚的报酬。

messages.en: I've returned with your Mercium.
messages.zh: 我带回你要的莫西石了。

messages.en: I knew those drones wouldn't be that big a deal for you.
messages.zh: 我就知道那些无人机对你来说不成问题。

messages.en: I don't want to mess with someone else's failed experiments.
messages.zh: 我不想卷入某些人失败的实验中。

messages.en: They're still just drones. What's the big deal?
messages.zh: 它们仍旧只是无人机而已。有什么了不起呢？

messages.en: Since their invention sometime around the Gallente-Caldari War, drones have become commonplace in nearly all facets of life. Drones vary in size from that of a human eye up to those that rival the largest frigates, and they have been built to fill the roles of fighters, miners, and repair vehicles, as well as household cleaning units and tiny children's toys — not to mention their various military uses in space stations and on planetary surfaces alike. New uses for drone technology are being developed constantly.
messages.zh: 自从无人机于盖伦特—加达里战争时期发明之后，这东西几乎涉足了人类生活的各方各面。无人机尺寸各异，最小的只相当于人类眼球大小，最大的可以与最大型的护卫舰比肩。这类无人机用途不一，可作为战舰、矿工、维修器，以及家具清洁工和儿童玩具——更不用说它们在空间站和行星表面等地方的多种军事用途了。人们还在不停地开发无人机科技的新用途。

messages.en: Drones for a Better Future
messages.zh: 为了无人机更好的明天

messages.en:
You ever try mining with drones? Useful little guys, huh? Yeah, well, to a point…

Turns out someone got the bright idea that if mining drones mine more ore, bigger drones would mine even more ore. This guy's team slapped some mining drone's AI into non-regulation heavy combat units and threw some mining lasers on. He even hacked the firmware so that the mining brains could control the weaponry, making some sort of self-sufficient mining machines. But of course the genius didn't test the things properly before sending them out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to mine Mercium. And of course now he's made himself scarce.

You can probably guess what happened. Now there's a bunch of haywire drones zipping about this rare mineral that we want — our guys in the lab need it for research, I guess. The drones aren't even mining the rock, last I heard, but they have tried to bore through any ship we send out there....

It's getting ridiculous. If you can, get out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, neutralize the drones, and bring back all the Mercium; we'll pay you well for your efforts.
messages.zh:
你以前用无人机开矿吗，老弟？随便问问。

有人想出了一个好主意，如果采矿无人机能采集更多的矿石，越大的无人机采集的矿石越多的话那该多好。这个家伙把某些采矿无人机的人工智能嵌入了非常规的重型战斗无人机，还为它们加上了采矿激光器。他甚至还破译了无人机固件，使得采矿控制单元能控制武器的使用，就像某种自己自足型的采矿机器。当然这个天才在将它们送往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}采集莫西石之前没有合理地进行测试。这把他自己都吓坏了。目前有这么一批无人机，它们发了疯似地采集我们需要的这种稀有矿石——我认为我们的实验室人员要它来用作研究。我上回听说，这些无人机不仅不在采集矿石，它们还试图在我们送往该地的任意一艘飞船上凿孔……

这太荒诞了。如果你愿意的话，你可以前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}去消灭这些无人机，并带回莫西石：我们会给你丰厚的报酬。

messages.en: I can't just sit on this contract. I'm sending this off to someone with more initiative.
messages.zh: 我可不能等人来接这份合约。我要把它委派给其他更有主动性的人。

messages.en: Contract revoked
messages.zh: 合同取消

messages.en: I don't have time to mess with this crazy drone business.
messages.zh: 我可没时间管这些神经无人机。

messages.en: Really, {[character]player.name}, I expected more from you.
messages.zh: 真的，{[character]player.name}，我本对你有更高的期望。

messages.en: Someone else got to the Mercium before we did; most likely those drones, which have also disappeared. You better start getting on the ball.
messages.zh: 有人在我们之前得到了莫西石，很可能就是那些无人机，因为它们也消失了。你最好学会行动迅速。

messages.en: Mercium gone
messages.zh: 莫西石没了

messages.en: Yeah, okay. I'll do it.
messages.zh: 那么，好吧。交给我吧。

messages.en: Good stuff. Get to it.
messages.zh: 很好。飞去那座跳跃门吧。

messages.en: Sure. What kind of rocks?
messages.zh: 好。什么样的石头？

messages.en:
I've just discovered a sizable deposit of Pithix out by an old mining station. The station's been abandoned for a while now, but there are still working sensors in the area; that's how we picked up on the Pithix. Problem is, the transmission's hardly secure. I need you to get out there and bring me back that rock before someone else cleans the place out.

Oh, there might also be some rogue drone activity in the area. Fair warning.
messages.zh:
我刚刚在一座老旧的采矿空间站附近发现了储量巨大的皮丝杰斯贝矿。那座空间站已经废弃了一段时间，但是那个区域还有一些感应器在运作；那就是我们发现皮丝杰斯贝矿的原因。问题是，那个信号传输很不可靠。我需要你前去那里，把矿石带回来，别让别人先下手了。

噢，那个地区还可能有些自由无人机活动。保持适当警惕。

messages.en: I've got your rocks here. Seems like a waste of time, but it's your ISK…
messages.zh: 我把你要的石头带来了。似乎是浪费时间，不过花的是你的星币……

messages.en: Alright. Now I just have to find a buyer…
messages.zh: 好吧。现在我只要找个买家就行了……

messages.en: No thanks. Not interested.
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。不感兴趣。

messages.en: Stop wasting my time, then.
messages.zh: 那么别再浪费我的时间了。

messages.en:
Pithix is virtually worthless, due to the terrible inefficiency of reprocessing it; one is far better off to mine for Jaspet instead. As a result, you won't find the former ore on the market. In fact, most sensor manufacturers don't even bother giving it a unique listing in their mining packages when they produce standard ship scanners.

If you're having trouble finding the Pithix at the mission location, simply right-click the "Pithix" icon in the mission details and select "Add to Overview."
messages.zh:
皮丝杰斯贝矿几乎没有价值，因为它的提炼效率低得可怕，远不如直接去开采杰斯贝矿。所以上述矿石在市面上找不到。实际上，大多数感应器生产商在生产标准舰船扫描器时，甚至不屑在采矿扫描选项中单独列出这种矿石。

如果在任务地点找不到皮丝杰斯贝矿，那就右击任务详情中的“皮丝杰斯贝矿”图标，然后选择“添加至总览”。

messages.en: Finding Pithix
messages.zh: 寻找皮丝杰斯贝矿

messages.en:
I've just discovered a sizable deposit of Pithix out by an old mining station. The station's been abandoned for a while now, but there are still working sensors in the area; that's how we picked up on the Pithix. Problem is, the transmission's hardly secure. I need you to get out there and bring me back that rock before someone else cleans the place out.

So, are you game?
messages.zh:
我刚刚在一座老旧的采矿空间站附近发现了储量巨大的皮丝杰斯贝矿。那座空间站已经废弃了一段时间，但是那个区域还有一些感应器在运作；那就是我们发现皮丝杰斯贝矿的原因。问题是，那个信号传输很不可靠。我需要你前去那里，把矿石带回来，别让别人先下手了。

那么，你愿意吗？

messages.en: I don't want to do this anymore. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我不想再干这活了，抱歉。

messages.en: Great, now there's no way I'll get someone there in time. Thanks a bunch.
messages.zh: 真不错，现在我绝对没办法派人及时赶到那里了。真“谢谢”你啊。

messages.en: This sounds easy enough. I'm in.
messages.zh: 这听起来够简单了。好，我接受。

messages.en: Alrighty, then, get to it.
messages.zh: 好的，那么，去吧。

messages.en: Sure. What kind and where?
messages.zh: 好。是哪种？在哪里？

messages.en:
There's an abandoned mining station not far from here that still has a bunch of Pithix 'roids floating around. There's about 4,500 units of it out there, and we want all of it. Don't worry, we'll pay you.

Oh, and keep an eye out for rogue drones. There might be a few roaming around.
messages.zh:
离这儿不远有个废弃的采矿空间站，那附近还飘着不少皮丝杰斯贝矿小行星。那里有大约4500单位的矿石，我们要全部弄到手。放心，我们会给你报酬的。

噢，多留意自由无人机。那附近可能有一些。

messages.en: I'm back… with your Pithix.
messages.zh: 我回来了……还有你的皮丝杰斯贝矿。

messages.en: I'll take that, and here's your pay. Pleasure doing business.
messages.zh: 我会全部收下，这是你的酬劳。与你合作很愉快。

messages.en: No deal. Sorry. I'm a lover and a fighter, but I'm no miner.
messages.zh: 我不干，抱歉，我是个有爱心的人，也是名战士，但我不是矿工。

messages.en:
Most people don't go looking for Pithix. It doesn't do so well out on the open market. That's why a lot of sensor manufacturers don't even bother to give it its own unique entry in the mining packages they produce for standard ship scanners.

If you are having trouble finding the Pithix 'roids in this mission, you can right-click the "Pithix" icon in your mission log and add it to your overview.
messages.zh:
大多数人都不会去找皮丝杰斯贝矿。它在正规市场上的销售很不理想。所以，很多感应器厂商在他们为标准飞船扫描器生产的采矿套件中，甚至没有为这种矿石专门设置一个类别。

如果你在任务中找不到皮丝杰斯贝矿“小行星”，那么你可以右键点击任务日志中的“皮丝杰斯贝矿”图标，然后将它添加至总览。

messages.en: Finding Pithix
messages.zh: 寻找皮丝杰斯贝矿

messages.en:
There's an old mining station not far from here that hasn't been used in months. The mining company gave up their claim when they thought they wiped the area of all valuable materials. About all they left was a bunch of Pithix.

But it just so happens that a couple of scientists who do some work for us want Pithix for some of their research projects. There's about 4,500 units of it out there, and we want all of it. Don't worry, we'll pay you.
messages.zh:
离这儿不远有座旧采矿空间站，已经几个月没用过了。那家采矿公司觉得已采光了所有值钱矿物，所以放弃了该空间站。他们留下的就只有一堆皮丝杰斯贝矿。

不过一些为我们工作的科学家正好需要皮丝杰斯贝矿做些研究项目。那里有大约4500单位的矿石，我们要全部弄到手。放心，我们会给你报酬的。

messages.en: I'm pretty bored of this already. See ya.
messages.zh: 我已经觉得这种任务够无聊了。再见。

messages.en: Not motivated enough? This was almost free money!
messages.zh: 动力不足？这可等于是免费捡钱啊！

messages.en: This sounds easy enough.
messages.zh: 这听起来够简单了。

messages.en: Get to it.
messages.zh: 快行动起来。

messages.en: Sure. What kind and where?
messages.zh: 好。是哪种？在哪里？

messages.en:
There's an old mining station not far from here. When they pulled out, they took everything they could with them; about all they left was a bunch of Pithix.

Now, it just so happens that I know a couple of scientists who want Pithix for some of their research projects. There's about 4,500 units of it out there, and they're willing to pay a good price for all of it. Go get it for me. I'll give you your fair share.

Oh, hey, make sure you fit some guns or something - we spotted some rogue drones around here recently.
messages.zh:
离这儿不远有座老旧的采矿空间站。他们撤出时，带走了能带走的一切，只留下一堆皮丝杰斯贝矿。

现在，我碰巧认识一些需要皮丝杰斯贝矿以开展研究项目的科学家。那里有大约4,500单位的矿石，他们愿意以不错的价格全部买下。去给我弄来，我会给你应得的那份。

噢，嘿，一定给船上装些枪炮或别的武器——我们发现最近那里有些自由无人机活动。

messages.en: Got your Pithix here.
messages.zh: 这是你要的皮丝杰斯贝矿。

messages.en: I'll take that, and here's your pay. Pleasure doing business.
messages.zh: 我会全部收下，这是你的酬劳。与你合作很愉快。

messages.en: No deal. Sorry. I'm a lover and a fighter, but I'm no miner.
messages.zh: 我不干，抱歉，我是个有爱心的人，也是名战士，但我不是矿工。

messages.en:
Most people don't go looking for Pithix. It doesn't do so well out on the open market. That's why a lot of sensor manufacturers don't even bother to give it its own unique entry in the mining packages they produce for standard ship scanners.

If you are having trouble finding the Pithix 'roids in this mission, you can right-click the "Pithix" icon in your mission log and add it to your overview.
messages.zh:
大多数人都不会去找皮丝杰斯贝矿。它在正规市场上的销售很不理想。所以，很多感应器厂商在他们为标准飞船扫描器生产的采矿套件中，甚至没有为这种矿石专门设置一个类别。

如果你在任务中找不到皮丝杰斯贝矿“小行星”，那么你可以右键点击任务日志中的“皮丝杰斯贝矿”图标，然后将它添加至总览。

messages.en: Finding Pithix
messages.zh: 寻找皮丝杰斯贝矿

messages.en:
There's an old mining station not far from here. The mining company that owned it hasn't been around for months. Something about repeated attacks by "blood thirsty raiders." Heh. When they pulled out, they took everything they could with them. About all they left was a bunch of Pithix.

Now, it just so happens that I know a couple of scientists who want Pithix for some of their research projects. There's about 4,500 units of it out there, and they're willing to pay a good price for all of it. Go get it for me. Don't worry. I'll give you your fair share.
messages.zh:
离这儿不远有座老旧的采矿空间站。拥有它的那家矿业公司已经几个月没来了。可能是因为屡次遭遇“残忍的袭击者”攻击的缘故。呵。他们撤出时，带走了能带走的一切。他们留下的就只有一堆皮丝杰斯贝矿。

现在，我碰巧认识一些需要皮丝杰斯贝矿以开展研究项目的科学家。那里有大约4,500单位的矿石，他们愿意以不错的价格全部买下。去给我弄来。别担心。我会给你不错的分成。

messages.en: I'm pretty bored of this already. See ya.
messages.zh: 我已经觉得这种任务够无聊了。再见。

messages.en: Not motivated enough? This was almost free money!
messages.zh: 动力不足？这可等于是免费捡钱啊！

messages.en: Yeah, I'll help you out.
messages.zh: 是，我会帮你的。

messages.en: Please hurry back with the space ice.
messages.zh: 请赶快去把太空冰弄些回来。

messages.en: You do? Great, when can I start?
messages.zh: 你是说真的？太好了，我什么时候可以开始？

messages.en:
Mine 20 units of Crystalline Icicles. Oh, and watch out for pirates or rogue drones. Lots of them around these parts.

You will need an Ice Harvester module to complete this mission. Also, be aware that this amount of raw Crystalline Icicles ore may require multiple trips unless you have a large amount of cargo space.
messages.zh:
去开采20单位的晶冰。噢，要当心海盗或自由无人机。他们在这里人多势众。

你需要一部冰矿采集器才能完成该任务。另外请注意，运载如此数量的天然晶冰可能要跑好几趟，除非你的货柜舱容量足够大。

messages.en: Here're your shiny icicles.
messages.zh: 这是你要的亮闪闪的晶冰。

messages.en: Oh, thank you. I was about ready to strangle that guy.
messages.zh: 噢，谢谢你。我正打算去掐死那家伙呢。

messages.en: I'm not much of an "art" person. So no.
messages.zh: 我算不上是个懂“艺术”的人。所以，我不做。

messages.en: You're gonna leave me to deal with a disappointed artist? Oh, that's real nice. Thanks so much.
messages.zh: 你要让我一个人去跟一名失望的艺术家打交道？哦,你品德真好。非常“感谢”。

messages.en:
Right away. But look, this one's a little weird. Just a heads up.

There's this guy who's making these really, truly gigantic ice sculptures — some kinda artsy shit, I don't know. I said, buddy, that much ice, it's gonna melt before you can finish carving it, or it's gonna break under its own weight. He says he knows that, says that's why he's gonna build it in space! Crazy…

Anyway, he's got the money, so what am I gonna say but "how much and how fast?" So, can you get 20 units of Crystalline Icicles over here ASAP? I got a location for you.

You will need an Ice Harvester module to complete this mission. Also, be aware that this amount of raw Crystalline Icicles ore may require multiple trips unless you have a large amount of cargo space.
messages.zh:
立刻就出发。等一下，这次的有点诡异。

这家伙在搞一个巨大的冰雕——华而不实的鬼东西，谁知道。我说，哥们，你要的冰矿太多了，在你完成冰雕前就要化掉的，或者它们自己就要裂开毁坏的。他说他明白，还说这就是为什么他要在宇宙空间里雕！疯了……

无论怎样，他愿付钱，所以我也只能问他：“你要多少？什么时候要？”你能开采20单位晶冰吗？越快越好。这个是开采地点。

你需要一部冰矿采集器才能完成该任务。还有请注意，运载如此数量的天然晶冰可能要跑好几趟，除非你的货柜舱容量足够大。

messages.en: Now he doesn't want that ice! He wants a different kind of ice because now it's a different phase of the moon and the colors don't match anymore! And he won't stop talking about this stuff! Next time, move a little quicker, huh?
messages.zh: 现在他不要些冰矿了！他要另一种冰，因为现在卫星的月相变了，颜色已经不匹配了！他就一直这样说个不停！下次动作快点，知道吗？

messages.en: I don't like art anymore. Not when it takes effort. I quit.
messages.zh: 我再也不喜欢艺术了。艺术竟然还要花那么多力气。我退出。

messages.en: You're gonna leave me to deal with a disappointed artist? Oh, that's real nice. Thanks so much.
messages.zh: 你要让我一个人去跟一名失望的艺术家打交道？哦,你品德真好。非常“感谢”。

messages.en: Now he doesn't want that ice! He wants a different kind of ice because now it's a different phase of the moon and the colors don't match anymore! And he won't stop talking about this stuff! Next time, move a little quicker, huh?
messages.zh: 现在他不要些冰矿了！他要另一种冰，因为现在卫星的月相变了，颜色已经不匹配了！他就一直这样说个不停！下次动作快点，知道吗？

messages.en: One order of Azure Ice, coming up.
messages.zh: 一份天蓝冰的订单，马上就到。

messages.en: You and me, we're gonna go far.
messages.zh: 你和我，我们要大干一番。

messages.en: Could be. Let me hear more, my friend.
messages.zh: 也许吧。说得详细点，我的朋友。

messages.en:
There's a field of Azure Ice at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want to sell it to some less-than-brilliant colonists. It's not as good as Blue Ice, but the they won't know the difference. Bring me back, oh, 20 blocks of it. I'll split the profit with you.

You will need an Ice Harvester module to complete this mission. Also, be aware that this amount of raw Azure Ice may require multiple trips unless you have a large amount of cargo space.
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一片天蓝冰矿。我打算把它卖给一些不太聪明的殖民者。这种矿没有蓝冰好，不过他们绝对分不清区别。给我带些回来，哦，要20块。我会跟你分享利润的。

你需要一部冰矿采集器才能完成该任务。还有请注意，运载如此数量的天蓝冰可能要跑好几趟，除非你的货柜舱容量足够大。

messages.en: Your "high-quality" Azure Ice is ready.
messages.zh: 你的“高品质”天蓝冰已经到了。

messages.en: Excellent. I've already got your share of the money ready. This should keep their colony running just well enough so that they can make more orders.
messages.zh: 很好。我早就把你的那份钱准备好了。这应该可以勉强维持他们殖民地的运转，这样他们就会下更多的订单。

messages.en: Maybe I'll ruin the lives of unsuspecting colonists some other time, but not today.
messages.zh: 我也许改天会去破坏那些毫无戒心的殖民者的生活，不过不是今天。

messages.en: Those colonists already ruined their lives. What's the harm in making some ISK off of that?
messages.zh: 那些殖民者已经破坏了自己的生活了。从这中间赚一笔星币又有什么坏处呢？

messages.en: The open market doesn't bother with Azure Ice. Everyone and their grandmothers know it's not nearly as useful as Blue Ice. Planetary water ice has more demand. Any deal that gets you ISK for Azure Ice is a good sell. And if you ever get stuck with Azure Ice and no mission to turn it in... well, just be glad your docking bay has no volume limit.
messages.zh: 正规市场不屑于经营天蓝冰。所有人，就连老太太也知道这种矿远没有蓝冰实用。行星水冰的需求量更大。任何能把天蓝冰换成星币的交易都是不错的买卖。如果你有一堆没法脱手的天蓝冰，而且没有什么任务需要这种矿的话……那么你只能看开点，毕竟你的船坞没有什么容量限制。

messages.en: Buyer Beware
messages.zh: 买家注意

messages.en:
Alright! You ever been out to some of those backwater colonies? You know the ones I mean. Barren wastelands of rocks and dust where some nut got the bright idea to try to build the agricultural community of tomorrow? Kind of place where the main export is despair? That kind of place?

Well, so happens I know of one that's just starting up. Poor bastards need some fuel. They're willing to pay good money, too. Now, I could sell them the good stuff, but seriously, these jokers wouldn't know good ice if it fell out of the sky and crushed their pet furrier.

There's a field of Azure Ice at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It's not as good as Blue Ice, but the colonists won't know the difference. Bring me back about, oh, 20 blocks of it. I'll sell it to the colony goobers and cut you in. Sound good?

You will need an Ice Harvester module to complete this mission. Also, be aware that this amount of raw Azure Ice may require multiple trips unless you have a large amount of cargo space.
messages.zh:
好的！你去过那些又穷又偏僻的殖民地吗？你知道我在说哪里。岩石和尘埃组成的贫瘠荒地，却有些疯子要去那儿建造什么“明日农业社”？那种主流出口贸易永远不会光顾的地方？那种地方？

嗯，碰巧我认识一个这样的疯子。可怜的笨蛋，急需燃料，愿意出高价购买。我当然可以卖给他们真正的好料，但是，说真的，如果天上凭白掉下冰矿砸在他们的毛皮大衣上，这些小丑又怎么会分辨是不是好矿呢？

在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一片天蓝冰矿。我打算把它卖给一些不太聪明的殖民者。这种矿没有蓝冰好，不过他们绝对分不清区别。给我带些回来，哦，要20块。我会跟你分享利润的。听起来不错吧？

你需要一部冰矿采集器才能完成该任务。还有请注意，运载如此数量的天蓝冰可能要跑好几趟，除非你的货柜舱容量足够大。

messages.en: You moved too slow. Someone else got the sell. Not only that, but they got the right stuff for the job. How is anyone supposed to get repeat business if customers keep getting what they need?
messages.zh: 你的动作太慢了。别人做成了那笔买卖。不仅如此，他们还弄到了合适的开采工具。如果客户的要求一直得到满足，那么还怎么弄到回头生意呢？

messages.en: Maybe ripping off colonists isn't the best use of my abilities.
messages.zh: 欺骗殖民者也许不是对我能力的最好运用。

messages.en: As far as I'm concerned, there is never a better use of one's skills than exploiting the ignorant. Go figure.
messages.zh: 对我而言，占无知者的便宜是对一个人能力的最好运用。自己去想。

messages.en: You moved too slow. Someone else got the sell. Not only that, but they got the right stuff for the job. How is anyone supposed to get repeat business if customers keep getting what they need?
messages.zh: 你的动作太慢了。别人做成了那笔买卖。不仅如此，他们还弄到了合适的开采工具。如果客户的要求一直得到满足，那么还怎么弄到回头生意呢？

name.fr: Comme des drones dans un nuage
name.ja: 雲へ向かうドローンのごとく
name.ru: Как дроны к облаку (Like Drones to a Cloud)

messages.en: I can harvest the cloud for you.
messages.zh: 我可以为你采集那片气云。

messages.en: Thank you. You wouldn't believe how difficult it is to find a good pilot capable of using a gas harvester.
messages.zh: 谢谢。你不知道要找一个会使用气云采集器的好飞行员有多难！

messages.en: Not at all. Why?
messages.zh: 一点也不。为什么？

messages.en:
There's a Chartreuse Cytoserocin cloud over in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that seems to be attracting these wild drones. We keep clearing them out, but new drones just end up replacing them. We've figured out that, for whatever reason, they're attracted to the gas. So the best solution is to just remove the cloud: no cloud, no drones. If you can harvest that cloud out, it'd be a big help.

You must fit a Gas Cloud Harvester to complete this mission. Of course, you'll also need to deal with whatever drones are there.
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一片黄绿色的硫酸云正吸引着这些荒野无人机。我们一直尝试把它们清除出去，但新的无人机还是不停的出现。不管什么理由，我们研究出他们是被这些气体给吸引来的。所以最好的解决办法是把这些云除去：没有云，就没有无人机。如果你可以把这些云消去，那就帮了大忙了。

你必须装备一个气云采集器来完成这个任务。当然，你需要对付在那里的无人机。

messages.en: I've harvested the gas cloud. Hopefully the drones won't be so interested in the area now.
messages.zh: 我已经采光了那片气云。那些无人机现在应该不会再对那片地方如此感兴趣了。

messages.en: Great. We'll keep an eye on the area, but I think you've fixed our drone problem.
messages.zh: 很好。我们会监视那个地方的，不过我觉得你已经解决了我们的无人机问题。

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't do this.
messages.zh: 恐怕我做不了。

messages.en: Damn. I'll have to find someone else. Thanks for being honest, though.
messages.zh: 该死。我得另找他人了。不过，还是谢谢你的坦诚。

messages.en:
Rogue drones and "wild drones" are the terms used for advanced drones that have mutated out of control. A few years ago, a respected Gallentean inventor had the idea of creating super-advanced drones that could think and act on their own in every sense like a regular space ship, except for being computer controlled, and hence unmanned.

Unfortunately, the drones became unruly, then unmanageable, and soon developed the ability to "infect" other drones, and eventually even ships, with their capricious artificial intelligence. Needless to say, Gallente soon abandoned this line of research.
messages.zh:
自由无人机和野生无人机是指那些因发生变异而不再受控的高级无人机。几年前，一位受人尊敬的盖伦特发明家产生了创造一种超级无人机的想法，这种无人机能够独立思考和行动，其行为在各方面都相当于一艘普通飞船，唯一不同之处在于，它由计算机控制，因此是无人驾驶的。

不幸的是，这些无人机后来变得不守规矩，再后来根本无法管理，而且凭借它们难以琢磨的人工智能，它们很快具有了“感染”其他无人机、最终甚至是飞船的能力。接下来谁都猜得到：盖伦特不久就放弃了这条研究路线。

messages.en: Rogue Drones
messages.zh: 自由无人机

messages.en:
Drones scare the daylights out of some people. To be completely honest, the big hives even scare me a little. The smaller drone groups are annoying, but more manageable. Usually.

Anyway, there's a Chartreuse Cytoserocin cloud over in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that seems to be attracting these wild drones. We keep clearing them out, but new drones just end up replacing them. We've figured out that, for whatever reason, they're attracted to the gas. So the best solution is to just remove the cloud: no cloud, no drones. If you can harvest that cloud out, it'd be a big help.

You must own and be able to use a Gas Cloud Harvester to complete this mission. If you do not or cannot, please just decline; note that you can decline one mission every 4 hours without standing loss.
messages.zh:
无人机能把某些人吓破胆。说实话，我也有点害怕它们。小型的无人机非常的烦人，但还是容易对付。当然这只是一般而言。

不管怎么样，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一片黄绿丝胶溶质气云正吸引着这些疯狂的无人机。我们一直尝试把它们清除出去，但新的无人机还是不停的出现。我们经过研究发现，不管出于什么原因，它们是被这些气云给吸引来的。所以最好的解决办法是，把这些气云除去：没有云团，就没有无人机。如果你能把这些气云采集掉，那就帮了大忙了。

为了完成这个任务，你必须拥有并能使用气云采集器。如果你没有或者不能，请拒绝这个任务；请注意，你可以每四个小时拒绝一次任务而不至于掉声望。

name.fr: Comme des drones dans un nuage
name.ja: 雲へ向かうドローンのごとく
name.ru: Как дроны к облаку (Like Drones to a Cloud)

messages.en: Consider the cloud harvested.
messages.zh: 放心，你就当那些气云已经采集好了。

messages.en: Thank you. You wouldn't believe how difficult it is to find a good gas harvester around here.
messages.zh: 谢谢。你想不到在这一带找一部气云采集器有多难。

messages.en: You know me, ready for anything.
messages.zh: 你知道我的，我随时准备做任何事。

messages.en:
There's a Chartreuse Cytoserocin cloud over in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It's attracting all sorts of drones to it. We keep clearing them out, but new drones just take their place. I figure the best solution is to just remove the cloud. No cloud, no drones. Simple. If you can harvest that cloud out, I'll pay you well.

You gotta fit a Gas Cloud Harvester to do this mission. And you also gotta deal with any drones there. Fair enough?
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一片黄绿丝胶溶质气云正吸引着这些疯狂的无人机。我们不断地消灭它们，但是新的无人机很快又出现了。我觉得最好的办法就是除去那些云。没有气云，就没有无人机。就这么简单。如果你可以把那些云采集完，我会付一大笔钱给你。

你必须使用气云采集器来完成这个任务。而且你还得解决在场的无人机。这要求不过分吧？

messages.en: I've harvested the gas cloud. Hopefully the drones won't be so interested in the area now.
messages.zh: 我已经采光了那片气云。那些无人机现在应该不会再对那片地方如此感兴趣了。

messages.en: Great. We'll keep an eye on the area, but I think you've fixed our drone problem.
messages.zh: 很好。我们会监视那个地方的，不过我觉得你已经解决了我们的无人机问题。

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't do this. So... "no thanks."
messages.zh: 恐怕我做不了。所以……“不，谢谢”。

messages.en: Damn. I'll have to find someone else. Hey, thanks for being honest, though.
messages.zh: 该死的。我不得不找其他人了。不过，还是谢谢你的坦诚。

messages.en: Rogue drones and "wild drones" are the terms used for advanced drones that have mutated out of control. A few years ago, some ingenious Gallentean inventor had the idea of creating super-advanced drones that could think and act on their own in every sense like a regular space ship, except for being computer controlled, hence unmanned. The drones became unruly, then unmanageable. Needless to say, this research was soon abandoned by the Gallenteans.
messages.zh: 自由无人机和野生无人机是指那些因发生变异而不再受控的高级无人机。几年前，一位受人尊敬的盖伦特发明家产生了创造一种超级无人机的想法，这种无人机能够独立思考和行动——其行为在各方面都相当于一艘普通飞船，唯一不同之处在于，它由计算机控制，因此是无人驾驶的。这些无人机后来变得不守规矩，再后来根本就不听指挥。接下来谁都猜得到：盖伦特不久就放弃了这项研究。

messages.en: Rogue Drones
messages.zh: 自由无人机

messages.en:
There's a Chartreuse Cytoserocin cloud over in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It's attracting all sorts of drones to it. I don't know why. It's like insects to a flame or somethin'. We keep clearing them out, but new drones just take their place. It's annoying as hell.

I figure the best solution is to just remove the cloud. No cloud, no drones. Simple. If you can harvest that cloud out, I'll pay you well.

You gotta own and be able to use a Gas Cloud Harvester to do this mission. If you don't or ya can't, just say "no thanks." You can decline one mission about every 4 hours without pissing me off, so no worries.
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一片黄绿丝胶溶质气云正吸引着这些疯狂的无人机。我不知道为什么。就像火焰吸引昆虫一样。我们不断地消灭它们，但是新的无人机很快又出现了。真是烦得要死。

我觉得最好的办法就是除去那些云。没有气云，就没有无人机。就这么简单。如果你可以把那些云采集完，我会付一大笔钱给你。

你需要有并且可以使用气云采集器来完成这个任务。如果你没有或者不能使用气云采集器，只要说“不，谢谢”。你可以每四个小时拒绝一个任务而不惹我生气，所以不用担心。

messages.en: I'm on it. Back in a bit.
messages.zh: 我这就去干。很快回来。

messages.en: Excellent, {[character]player.name}. Thanks.
messages.zh: 太棒了，{[character]player.name}。谢谢你。

messages.en: You know I do. What have you got?
messages.zh: 你知道我当然愿意。你有什么好事？

messages.en:
We've located some asteroids that contain substantial amounts of Polygypsum — that's a comparatively rare mineral, and almost completely unknown in this system. Our guys want to have a look at the stuff and see if they can figure out some way to make use of it; however, we don't have anyone who wants to deal with it. So guess who I thought of first?

You'll need to grab all 2,800 units of the stuff and get it back here. See you then.
messages.zh:
我们找到了一些含有大量聚合石膏的小行星——这种矿物比较稀有，几乎没人在这个星系见过它们。我们的人想研究一下这东西，看看能否对它加以利用；但是，没人愿意去弄这种矿石。所以，你猜我第一个想到了谁？

你需要把那2800单位的东西全部搞到，然后带回这来。到时再见。

messages.en: It was awfully dull, but the reward should make some amends. Here's your ore.
messages.zh: 采矿非常无聊，不过我的酬劳应该能起些慰劳作用。这是你要的矿石。

messages.en: You've earned your reward as far as I'm concerned, {[character]player.name}, that's for sure.
messages.zh: 在我看来，可以肯定的是，你接受这些酬劳是当之无愧的，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Hm. No, I think I'm going to go, oh… watch some paint dry, actually. Thanks for the offer, though.
messages.zh: 嗯。不了，实际上我想我要去，喔……看一些油漆慢慢变干。不过，谢谢你的提议。

messages.en: I see. Well, I guess I can find someone else willing to make an easy few ISK.
messages.zh: 我明白了。我想会有别人愿意来赚这笔不费劲的星币的。

messages.en:
Polygypsum is widely considered worthless because of the dangers associated with storing and reprocessing it. As a result, you won't find this ore on the market. In fact, for this reason, most sensor manufacturers don't even bother putting it as a unique entry in the computers when they install standard ship scanners.

If you're having trouble finding the correct ore at the mission location, you can right-click the "Polygypsum" icon in the mission details in your Opportunities interface and select "Add to Overview."
messages.zh:
人们普遍认为聚合石膏没有价值，因为它的存储和提炼都具有危险性。所以这种矿石在市面上找不到。实际上，出于这个原因，大多数感应器生产商在安装标准舰船扫描器时，甚至不屑把这种矿石作为单独条目输入计算机中。

如果在任务地点找不到聚合石膏，那就右击“机遇”界面任务详情中的“聚合石膏”图标，然后选择“添加至总览”。

messages.en: Mining Polygypsum
messages.zh: 开采聚合石膏

messages.en:
Well, we've located some asteroids that contain substantial amounts of Polygypsum. It's a comparatively rare mineral, and almost completely unknown in this system. Our guys want to have a look at the stuff and see if they can figure out some way to make use of it; however, we don't have anyone who wants to deal with the stuff. So guess who I thought of first?

You'll need to grab all 2,800 units of the stuff and get it back here. So what do you think? Are you in?
messages.zh:
呃，我们找到了一些含有大量聚合石膏的小行星。这种矿物比较稀有，几乎没人在这个星系见过它们。我们的人想研究一下这东西，看看能否对它加以利用；但是，没人愿意去弄这种矿石。所以，你猜我第一个想到了谁？

你需要把2800单位的那种东西全部挖到，然后带回这里。怎么样？干吗？

messages.en: Sure, I'll see what I can do.
messages.zh: 当然，我会尽我所能。

messages.en: Don't waste any time. These guys are waiting for their ore.
messages.zh: 一分钟也别浪费。这些家伙在等着他们的矿石呢。

messages.en: We do? Or I do? Either way, I'm ready. What's up?
messages.zh: 我们做？还是我做？不管怎样，我准备好了。出什么事了？

messages.en:
We need a big shipment of Geodite crystals for a client of ours, some gemology lab. These gemologists figure they might be able to get some decent stones out of it and make a bit of profit that way. Whatever. They want to pay for it, so it's all good by me. And you'll get your cut, don't worry.

Geodite takes up a lot of room: You're going to need a big cargo hold, or you'll have to make several trips.
messages.zh:
我们要给一个客户——某个地质实验室——运一大批几欧石晶体。那些宝石学家认为他们也许能从这些矿石中提取出一些宝石，然后赚点钱。管它呢。反正，他们愿意付钱，所以我没有异议。当然，你也会得到你那一份，放心吧。

几欧石占地很多：你需要一个大货柜舱，要么你就多跑几趟。
