messages.en: Here's your load of Geodite.
messages.zh: 这是你要的几欧石。

messages.en: Nice work. I'll keep you in mind when something else comes up.
messages.zh: 干得不错。如果还有别的任务，我会想到你的。

messages.en: That's one boring scenario you've worked out there, my friend. I think I'm gonna pass.
messages.zh: 你编的那套情节真无聊，我的朋友。我想我还是免了。

messages.en: Man, I hope I can find someone else to handle this.
messages.zh: 天啊，真希望能找到别人来做这件事。

messages.en:
Geodite ore is pretty much worthless because of the poor-quality Nocxium it produces; one is far better off to look for Crokite instead... although that's no easy job. In any case, you won't find Geodite on the market anywhere.

If you're having trouble finding the Geodite at the mission location, you can right-click the "Geodite" icon in the mission's details and select "Add to Overview."
messages.zh:
几欧石没什么价值，它产出的超新星诺克石质量很差，远不如去找克洛基石，虽然很难找到。你是不可能在市面上见到几欧石的。

如果在任务地点找不到几欧石，那就右击任务详情中的“几欧石”图标，然后选择“添加至总览”。

messages.en: Geodite Ore
messages.zh: 几欧石

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has an unusual request for the right miner. We need a big shipment of Geodite crystals for a client of ours, some gemology lab. Maybe you've heard of Geodite, but if not, it'd be no surprise — the stuff's pretty much worthless. But these gemologists figure they might be able to get some decent stones out of it and make a bit of profit that way. Whatever. They want to pay for it, so it's all good by me. And you'll get your cut, don't worry.

Anyway, if you're interested, I'll send the coordinates over to your ship's NeoCom — the field's in this system.
messages.zh:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}在找合适的矿工，这次的要求不同寻常。我们要给一个客户——某个地质实验室——运一大批几欧石晶体。也许你听说过几欧石，不过即便没有，也不奇怪——这东西基本上毫无价值。可是那些宝石学家认为他们也许能从这些矿石中提取出一些宝石，然后赚点钱。管它呢。反正，他们愿意付钱，所以我没有异议。当然，你也会得到你那一份，放心吧。

总之，如果你感兴趣，我可以把坐标发到你的控制边栏上——那个矿带就在这个星系里。

messages.en: Hm. This is a pretty boring scenario you've worked out here, my friend. I think I'm gonna cut out.
messages.zh: 嗯。你编的那套情节挺无聊的，我的朋友。我想我还是走吧。

messages.en: Maybe next time. Once again progress grinds to a halt.
messages.zh: 也许下次吧。进度又一次遭遇刹车。

messages.en: You know I'm never one to shy away from my patriotic duty.
messages.zh: 你知道，我从不是个逃避爱国责任的人。

messages.en: Be quick about it. We don't want to let anyone else beat us to that Oeryl.
messages.zh: 快点行动。我们可不能让别人抢先拿到欧黑赭石。

messages.en: Hear what, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: 听到什么，{[character]agentID.name}？

messages.en:
War is one of the biggest boons to business you could hope for. It's a hungry giant that will eat anything you can throw at it. And the thing is, if you don't feed it, it will just eat you…. But if you feed it well? Oh, the rewards. Public recognition, sure, but the contracts, the contracts, {[character]player.name}! That's where the real ISK is. And we're going to get those contracts. Oh, yes. But first we need minerals.

Right now, it seems the giant on our doorstep wants Oeryl, and we're going to give it to him. There's a deposit out at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Bring back all 5,600 units of the stuff and I'll make sure you get your share of the reward.
messages.zh:
战争是你长久奢求的谋财契机，是一个你无论怎么喂也永远喂不饱的巨人。问题是，如果你不喂它，它就会吃了你……，但是如果你喂的好？哦，你得到奖赏：公众赏识，当然，还有合同，合同 ，{[character]player.name}！这才是真正的生财之道。而且我们要拿到那些合同。哦，是的。但是首先我们需要矿物。

现在看来，站在门口嗷嗷待哺的巨人需要欧黑赭石，那我们就给他欧黑赭石。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一个采矿点，带回5600个单位的矿物，你将得到你的报酬。

messages.en: Here's the Oeryl. Uh, for the war effort.
messages.zh: 这是你要的欧黑赭石。当然，是喂给战争的。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. Just remember, you're not a profiteer — you're securing the financial stability of the homefront.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。只是记住，你可不是投机商——你是在维护大后方的金融稳定。

messages.en: I'm not comfortable with the moral implications of this job.
messages.zh: 这个任务涉及的道德问题让我很不舒服。

messages.en: I knew you were one of those spineless sympathizers.
messages.zh: 我就知道你是一个胆小的反战者。

messages.en: It has been nearly a century since the Caldari-Gallente War, the last major war between any of the Great Empires, came to a close. Though skirmishes have broken out here and there, the distractions of the ever-expanding "lawless" space and the efforts of organizations such as CONCORD have helped maintain an uneasy peace. But no peace lasts forever.
messages.zh: 加达里—盖伦特战争已经过去快一个世纪了，那是各大帝国间所进行的最后一场大型战争。尽管小型冲突此起彼伏，不过不断扩大的“无法律”空间分散了人们的注意，而且诸如统合部等组织进行着不懈努力，这一切终于使来之不易的和平得以维系。但是，没有永远的和平。

messages.en: Of Peace and Preparation
messages.zh: 和平与备战

messages.en:
It's the sound of war! It's been too long since the blaring of military marches has been heard, the stockpiling of weapons undertaken, the murderous idealism of a young generation inveigled. And to me it all seems like the clinking of ISK.

War is one of the biggest boons to business you could hope for. It's a hungry giant that will eat anything you can throw at it. And the thing is, if you don't feed it, it will just eat you…. But if you feed it well? Oh, the rewards. Public recognition, sure, but the contracts, the contracts, {[character]player.name}! That's where the real ISK is. And we're going to get those contracts. Oh, yes. But first we need minerals.

Right now, it seems the giant on our doorstep wants Oeryl, and we're going to give it to him. There's a deposit out at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Bring back all 5,600 units of the stuff and I'll make sure you get your share of the reward.
messages.zh:
这是战争之声！好久没有听见军事阅兵的号声了，还有成堆的武器存储以及被万恶的理想主义诱骗的年轻一代。对我来说，战争就意味着叮叮当当的星币。

战争是你长久奢求的谋财契机，是一个你无论怎么喂也永远喂不饱的巨人。问题是，如果你不喂它，它就会吃了你……，但是如果你喂的好？哦，你得到奖赏：公众赏识，当然，还有合同，合同 ，{[character]player.name}！这才是真正的生财之道。而且我们要拿到那些合同。哦，是的。但是首先我们需要矿物。

现在看来，站在门口嗷嗷待哺的巨人需要欧黑赭石，那我们就给他欧黑赭石。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一个采矿点，带回5600个单位的矿物，你将得到你的报酬。

messages.en: While you were puttering around, deciding whether you were going to do the Oeryl job, the government went and got its ore from another seller. Nice effort. Or rather, lack thereof.
messages.zh: 就在你一边闲逛，一边在想要不要做这个欧黑赭石任务的时候，政府已经从另一个卖家那里购得了这种矿石。干得不错。或者说，什么都没干才更正确。

messages.en: Oeryl contract lost
messages.zh: 失去欧黑赭石合同

messages.en: I can't continue doing this. Sorry, but I quit.
messages.zh: 我没法继续做这件事了。抱歉，我退出。

messages.en: Do you want the enemy to win? Do you?
messages.zh: 你想让敌人获胜吗？你想吗？

messages.en: In the time it took you to fail this mission, nearly 250 brave pilots lost their lives. You also failed to make a load of money. You need to do better.
messages.zh: 你耽搁了那么长时间以致于未完成任务，在这期间，有将近250名勇敢的飞行员丧失了生命。你也失去了赚一大笔钱的机会。你要好好改进才行。

messages.en: Time is money. Blood money.
messages.zh: 时间就是金钱。沾血的金钱。

name.zh: 阿里斯特石引发的妒意

messages.en: Yeah, okay, I'll get your rock…
messages.zh: 是，好的，我会给你弄来那石头……

messages.en: Well, get going then! I need that rock!
messages.zh: 那么出发吧！我需要那石头！

messages.en: Hm. Depends on the job…
messages.zh: 嗯。那要看是什么任务了……

messages.en: I hear there's some Green Arisite that a bunch of people are looking to get their hands on. Now, I don't know why they want it, but if they want it, I want it. You may have to hunt for it a bit; I hear the belt's got a lot of big broken-up old asteroids floating around. Might be a little creepy, but it shouldn't do you any harm, and I want that damn rock!
messages.zh: 我听说有很多人想要弄到一些绿色阿里斯特石。虽然我不知道他们为什么要得到它，不过只要他们想要，我就想要。你可能稍微仔细搜索一下；我听说那里散布着很多巨大古老的小行星。它们看上去有些吓人，不过伤不到你。我要那些该死的矿石！

messages.en: I got there first! Here's your stupid green rock.
messages.zh: 我第一个到那！这是你要的傻兮兮的绿石头。

messages.en: Hah! Who's the stupid one?! Now I can sell it for a fortune to those other jerks!
messages.zh: 哈！谁傻呀？！现在我可以把它高价卖给别的蠢货了！

messages.en: I think I'll pass. Also, you might want to cool off a bit.
messages.zh: 我想我还是免了。还有，也许你要冷静一下。

messages.en: If I cooled off, I wouldn't have a business. Now move along.
messages.zh: 如果我冷静下来，我就不会有买卖了。现在滚吧。

messages.en: Green Arisite is relatively worthless because of the high costs of reprocessing; one is far better off mining Gneiss instead. As a result, you won't find the former ore on the market. If you're having trouble finding the Arisite at the mission location, loading the "Mining" default overview will show all ores. If you're familiar with creating custom overview settings, Green Arisite is shown by enabling "Gneiss".
messages.zh: 绿色阿里斯特石几乎没有价值，因为提炼成本很高；去开采片麻岩要赚得多多了。因此，你在市场上找不到前面一种矿石。如果你在任务地点找不到阿里斯特石，那么你只要右键点击任务日志中的“绿色阿里斯特石”图标，然后选择“添加至总览”就行了。如果你对自定义总览设置较为熟悉，那就请选中“片麻岩”以便看到绿色阿里斯特石。

messages.en: Green Arisite
messages.zh: 绿色阿里斯特石

messages.en:
Look, I hear there's some Green Arisite that a bunch of people are looking to get their hands on. Now, I don't know why they want it, but if they want it, I want it.

You may have to hunt for it a bit; I hear the belt's got a lot of big broken-up old asteroids floating around. Might be a little creepy, but it shouldn't do you any harm, and I want that damn rock!

Go get it before those other bastards get their grubby hands on it!
messages.zh:
是这样，我听说有很多人想要弄到一些绿色阿里斯特石。虽然我不知道他们为什么要得到它，不过只要他们想要，我就想要。

你可能稍微仔细搜索一下；我听说那里散布着很多巨大古老的小行星。它们看上去有些吓人，不过伤不到你。我要那些该死的矿石！

在它们落到其他混蛋的脏手里之前，把它们给我弄来！

messages.en: On second thought? I'm out of here. And I think you're a little crazy.
messages.zh: 让我再想想？我闪了。我觉得你有点疯了。

messages.en: Yeah — like a fox! Suit yourself, it's your loss.
messages.zh: 是啊——就像只狐狸！你自便吧，这是你的损失。

name.ru: Совсем не Gneiss (Not Gneiss at All)

messages.en: If the pay is good, I'm there.
messages.zh: 如果报酬不错的话，我立刻动身。

messages.en: Indeed. And paid you will be.
messages.zh: 没错。你会得到报酬的。

messages.en: Why is that? You got something for me?
messages.zh: 怎么了？你有什么任务给我吗？

messages.en:
Demand for minerals is skyrocketing. Which is good for us. More demand means more profit.

To fill that demand, though, we're having to turn to some unorthodox ores: Green Arisite, for instance. I know of a large field that's full of the stuff. If you can get it for me, I'll make sure you're reimbursed. We just may be able to make some use of it, with the right tech. Who knows?
messages.zh:
对矿物的需求正如火箭般暴涨。这对我们是好事。需求越大，利润越高。

不过，为了填补那些需求，我们得转向一些非正统的矿石：比如绿色阿里斯特石。我知道一大片满是这种东西的行星带。如果你能为我搞来，我不会让你白干的。只要使用正确的技术，我们也许能发挥这种矿石的作用。谁知道呢。

messages.en: Your Green Arisite. But I think you're gonna lose your shirt on this one…
messages.zh: 你要的绿色阿里斯特石。不过我觉得你会在这东西上赔光所有家当……

messages.en: Good job. Nice working with you
messages.zh: 做得好。与你合作很愉快

messages.en: Not today, sorry. Uh, my cousin just asked for help moving some furniture…
messages.zh: 今天不行，抱歉。呃，我表妹刚刚求我去帮她搬家具……

messages.en: I guess I'll find someone who likes ISK, then.
messages.zh: 看来我得去找个喜欢星币的人。

messages.en: Green Arisite is relatively worthless because of the high costs of reprocessing; one is far better off mining Gneiss instead. As a result, you won't find the former ore on the market. If you're having trouble finding the Arisite at the mission location, just right-click the "Green Arisite" icon in  this mission's details in your Opportunities interface and select "Add to Overview."
messages.zh: 绿色阿里斯特石没什么价值，提炼成本很高，远不如去开采片麻岩。所以上述矿石在市面上找不到。如果在任务地点找不到阿里斯特石，那就右击“机遇”界面任务详情中的“绿色阿里斯特石”图标，然后选择“添加至总览”。

messages.en: Green Arisite
messages.zh: 绿色阿里斯特石

messages.en:
I do. And it's going to be a big haul.

Demand for minerals is skyrocketing. All the big empires are stockpiling for the coming fight. Oh, come on, you've seen the signs! Ships, rockets, drones, fortifications — all these things take material. The skirmishes out in 0.0 aren't lessening the demand any, either. Which is good for us. More demand means more profit.

To fill that demand, we're having to turn to some unorthodox ores. Green Arisite, for instance. I know of a large field that's full of the stuff. If you can get it for me, I'll make sure you're reimbursed. We just may be able to make some use of it, with the right tech. Who knows?
messages.zh:
我知道。这将是一次大规模的运载。

对矿物的需求正在急速飙升。各大帝国都在囤积矿石以备战争。哦，来吧，你也看到了种种迹象！舰船，火箭，无人机，防御工事——这些东西都需要材料。在0.0的游击战也会增加对材料的需求，这些对我们来说都是好消息。需求越大，利润越高。

不过，为了填补那些需求，我们得转向一些非正统的矿石：比如绿色阿里斯特石。我知道一大片满是这种东西的行星带。如果你能为我搞来，我不会让你白干的。只要使用正确的技术，我们也许能发挥这种矿石的作用。谁知道呢。

messages.en:
Too. Many. Rocks. Uhhhh…

I quit.
messages.zh:
石头—太—多—了！呃……

我退出。

messages.en: What kind of miner are you?
messages.zh: 你算是什么矿工？

name.fr: Comme des drones dans un nuage
name.ja: 雲へ向かうドローンのごとく
name.ru: Как дроны к облаку (Like Drones to a Cloud)

messages.en: I can harvest the cloud for you.
messages.zh: 我可以为你采集那片气云。

messages.en: Thank you. You wouldn't believe how difficult it is to find a good gas harvester around here.
messages.zh: 谢谢。你想不到在这一带找一部气云采集器有多难。

messages.en: Gallente? I'll take care of them.
messages.zh: 盖伦特？我会解决他们的。

messages.en:
There's a Chartreuse Cytoserocin cloud over in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that seems to be attracting drones. We keep clearing them out, but new drones just end up replacing them. We've figured out that, for whatever reason, they're attracted to the gas. The best solution is to just remove the cloud. No cloud, no drones. If you can harvest that cloud out, it'd be a big help.

You must fit a Gas Cloud Harvester to complete this mission. Of course, you'll also need to deal with whatever drones are there.
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一片黄绿色的硫酸云正吸引着这些荒野无人机。我们一直尝试把它们清除出去，但新的无人机还是不停的出现。不管什么理由，我们研究出他们是被这些气体给吸引来的。所以最好的解决办法是把这些云除去：没有云，就没有无人机。如果你可以把这些云消去，那就帮了大忙了。

你得配备一部气云采集器才能完成该任务。当然，你还得解决那里的无人机。

messages.en: I've harvested the gas cloud. Hopefully the drones won't be so interested in the area now.
messages.zh: 我已经采光了那片气云。那些无人机现在应该不会再对那片地方如此感兴趣了。

messages.en: Great. We'll keep an eye on the area, but I think you've fixed our drone problem.
messages.zh: 很好。我们会监视那个地方的，不过我觉得你已经解决了我们的无人机问题。

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't do this.
messages.zh: 恐怕我做不了。

messages.en: Damn. I'll have to find someone else. Thanks for being honest, though.
messages.zh: 该死。我得另找他人了。不过，还是谢谢你的坦诚。

messages.en: Rogue drones and "wild drones" are the terms used for advanced drones that have mutated out of control. A few years ago, some ingenious Gallentean inventor had the idea of creating super-advanced drones that could think and act on their own in every sense like a regular space ship, except for being computer controlled, hence unmanned. The drones became unruly, then unmanageable. Needless to say, this research was soon abandoned by the Gallenteans.
messages.zh: 自由无人机和野生无人机是指那些因发生变异而不再受控的高级无人机。几年前，一位受人尊敬的盖伦特发明家产生了创造一种超级无人机的想法，这种无人机能够独立思考和行动——其行为在各方面都相当于一艘普通飞船，唯一不同之处在于，它由计算机控制，因此是无人驾驶的。这些无人机后来变得不守规矩，再后来根本就不听指挥。接下来谁都猜得到：盖伦特不久就放弃了这项研究。

messages.en: Rogue Drones
messages.zh: 自由无人机

messages.en:
No, no. There are no Gallente. It's those cursed rogue drones. If the Gallente hadn't made those things way back during the Caldari-Gallente War, I wouldn't have this headache to deal with.

Here's the odd thing: There's a Chartreuse Cytoserocin cloud over in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that seems to be attracting drones. We keep clearing them out, but new drones just end up replacing them. We've figured out that, for whatever reason, they're attracted to the gas. The best solution is to just remove the cloud. No cloud, no drones. If you can harvest that cloud out, it'd be a big help.

You must own and be able to use a Gas Cloud Harvester to complete this mission. If you do not or cannot, please just decline; note that you can decline one mission every 4 hours without standing loss.
messages.zh:
不，不。那些不是盖伦特人。那些是该死的无人机。如果盖伦特没有在加达里-盖伦特战争中制造那些东西，我就不需要头疼地处理这些东西了。

有件事比较奇怪：在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一片黄绿丝胶溶质气云正吸引着这些疯狂的无人机。我们一直尝试把它们清除出去，但新的无人机还是不停的出现。我们经过研究发现，不管出于什么原因，它们是被这些气云给吸引来的。所以最好的解决办法是，把这些气云除去。没有气云，就没有无人机。如果你能把这些气云采集掉，那就帮了大忙了。

为了完成这个任务，你必须拥有并能使用气云采集器。如果你没有或者不能，请拒绝这个任务；请注意，你可以每四个小时拒绝一次任务而不至于掉声望。

name.en: Greater Good – Less Distasteful Matters (2 of 5)
name.es: Por el bien común: Asuntos menos desagradables (2 de 5)
name.fr: L'intérêt général - Des sujets moins déplaisants (2 sur 5)
name.ja: 崇高なる善―不愉快な問題（2/5）
name.ru: Общее благо – менее неприятные вещи (Greater Good – Less Distasteful Matters) (2 из 5)
name.zh: 人类大义 – 不大合口味的事情（2/5）

messages.en: I think I can manage that.
messages.zh: 我认为我能办到。

messages.en: Don't forget, we are making sure that the blame for this action falls where it truly belongs: on the Amarr.
messages.zh: 别忘了，我们一定要把此行为归咎于真正罪有应得的人：艾玛人。

messages.en: Something a little less morally objectionable, yes.
messages.zh: 是的，让我不那么良心不安的。

messages.en: Take the reporter from {[location]agentStationID.name} to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, then report back.
messages.zh: 把那名记者从{[location]agentStationID.name}带到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，然后回来向我汇报。

messages.en: I've done what you asked.
messages.zh: 我已经照你说的做了。

messages.en:
Good enough. Since someone else took care of that job you couldn't handle, things should still work out alright.

Come back to me when you're ready to do some more work for the cause... assuming you can handle it.
messages.zh:
干得不错。因为有人把你应付不来的事情完成了，所以一切总算顺利。

等你准备好为这个事业尽更多力量的时候再来找我吧……假设你有能力应付的话。

messages.en: I don't want to be involved with anyone who thinks that your methods are acceptable.
messages.zh: 我可不想与任何认可你方法的人扯上关系。

messages.en: Some people just aren't ready to serve the greater good.
messages.zh: 有些人就是没有为全人类大义服务的觉悟。

messages.en: Though Scope (the corporation taking its name from its famed primetime holocast, The Scope), was originally based inside the Gallente Federation, it has expanded to the point where it is now considered the leading news agency throughout the empires.
messages.zh: 虽然视角传媒（名称取自该集团著名的黄金时段全息节目《视角》）最初设立于盖伦特联邦境内，现在已经发展为遍布各大帝国的主要新闻机构。

messages.en: The Scope
messages.zh: 视角传媒

messages.en: Well, not everyone has the stomach to do what must be done. Do you think you could manage to carry a reporter from point A to point B, or will that strain your moral sensibilities?
messages.zh: 好吧，不是人人都有胆量去做该做之事。那么，你觉得你能把一名记者从A地点带到B地点吗？这会不会伤害你脆弱的良心？

messages.en: I don't want to be involved with anyone who thinks that your methods are acceptable.
messages.zh: 我可不想与任何认可你方法的人扯上关系。

messages.en: I've had just about enough of you anyway.
messages.zh: 反正我已经受够你了。

name.de: Allgemeinwohl - Nicht im Entferntesten so drastische Maßnahmen (4 von 5)
name.en: Greater Good - Not Even Remotely Drastic Measures (4 of 5)
name.es: Por el bien común: Medidas nada drásticas (4 de 5)
name.fr: L'intérêt général - Des mesures pas draconiennes pour un rond (4 sur 5)
name.ja: 崇高なる善―かすりもしない抜本的対策（4/5）
name.ru: Общее благо – меры, далёкие от жёстких (Greater Good - Not Even Remotely Drastic Measures) (4 из 5)
name.zh: 人类大义 – 一点都不出格的措施（4/5）

messages.en: Um, okay. You could be a little less of a jerk about it, though.
messages.zh: 嗯，好吧。不过你不必那么尖刻。

messages.en:
Sure, chief. Whatever.

Oh, I suppose: At least you're doing something halfways useful.
messages.zh:
当然，长官。你说什么就是什么。

哦，我猜：你做的事情的价值只及我的一半。

messages.en: That sounds potentially less crazy, yeah.
messages.zh: 好吧，这事的后果似乎没那么疯狂。

messages.en: Go pick up the reporter at the location I've given you and bring him back to me.
messages.zh: 去接那个记者，再把他带到我这里来。地点我已经给你了。

messages.en: I brought back your reporter.
messages.zh: 我把你说的记者带回来了。

messages.en:
While you were ferrying that reporter over here, someone else took out that CONCORD committee, so there's still some real progress being made.

Come see me again when you're ready for real action.
messages.zh:
在你运送记者的时候，有人把那个统合部委员会给除掉了，所以我们还是取得了一些真正的进展。

等你准备好执行真正的任务时再来找我。

messages.en: I'm not interested in this busy-work.
messages.zh: 我对这种没什么成效的事情不感兴趣。

messages.en: I gave you every opportunity to help our cause.
messages.zh: 我可是给了你一切机会，让你来协助我们的事业。

messages.en:
Weak moral constitution, I suppose. Very well, then.

Go pick up a reporter waiting at a nearby station -- I'll give you the location -- and bring him back to me. Will that be supportable?
messages.zh:
看来你的道德感很脆弱。这样很好。

有个记者在附近的空间站等着，你去接他——我会把地址给你——再把他带到我这里来。你的道德感可以承受这个吗？

messages.en:
The ship was still destroyed, but the Empire managed to dodge the blame again. I've been hearing stories ranging from pirates to equipment failure. If you had done as I originally asked, at least some good would have come of this destruction.

Instead, you couldn't even move a reporter within a reasonable timeframe. Hold your head up high, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
那艘飞船还是被摧毁了，不过帝国再一次逃脱了指责。关于这个事件，我听到了各种各样的版本，从海盗袭击到设备故障都有。如果你照我最初的要求去做，那么飞船的破坏至少会带来一些有益的结果。

但事实是，你居然不能在适当时间内运送一名记者。你还真有脸，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: You could have prevented this…
messages.zh: 你本可以阻止这一切的……

messages.en: You know what? I'm tired of being insulted by a crazy person. I quit.
messages.zh: 你知道吗？我受够了你这个疯子的侮辱了。我退出。

messages.en: I gave you every opportunity to help our cause.
messages.zh: 我可是给了你一切机会，让你来协助我们的事业。

messages.en:
The ship was still destroyed, but the Empire managed to dodge the blame again. I've been hearing stories ranging from pirates to equipment failure. If you had done as I originally asked, at least some good would have come of this destruction.

Instead, you couldn't even move a reporter within a reasonable timeframe. Hold your head up high, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
那艘飞船还是被摧毁了，不过帝国再一次逃脱了指责。关于这个事件，我听到了各种各样的版本，从海盗袭击到设备故障都有。如果你照我最初的要求去做，那么飞船的破坏至少会带来一些有益的结果。

但事实是，你居然不能在适当时间内运送一名记者。你还真有脸，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: You could have prevented this…
messages.zh: 你本可以阻止这一切的……

messages.en: It just so happens I am trained in Gas Harvesters. I'll do it.
messages.zh: 碰巧我受过操作气云采集器的训练。交给我吧。

messages.en: Thank you. Get back as quickly as you can.
messages.zh: 谢谢。尽快完成任务回来。

messages.en: What's up? Happy to help.
messages.zh: 出什么事了？我乐于帮忙。

messages.en:
I need pain medications badly. I can't just wait for the next delivery. I need to produce my own drugs. For that I'm going to need Gamboge Cytoserocin. I heard a smuggler say there was a pocket at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Go there, and bring back everything you can. I'll try to make it worth your while.

You need to fit a Gas Cloud Harvester to complete this mission.
messages.zh:
我非常需要止痛药。我已经等不及下一批货的到来了。我要自己制造些药物。因此，我需要藤黄丝胶溶质。我听一名非法贩售者说，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一团这样的气云。去吧，有多少就带多少回来。我会让你的劳动得到应有的回报。

你需要配备一部气云采集器，才能完成这个任务。

messages.en: Here's your gas. Do some good with it.
messages.zh: 这是你要的气云。用它做些好事吧。

messages.en: More good will come from this than you know.
messages.zh: 它的好处比你知道的还要多。

messages.en: I'm afraid I cannot do this.
messages.zh: 恐怕我不能做。

messages.en: Okay, that's fine. It's better that you're upfront with these things than not.
messages.zh: 好吧，没关系。你坦白告诉我，总好过隐瞒。

messages.en: Although the compounds that are popularly called "boosters" are illegal in empire space, other legal derivatives of gas cloud materials are used in the medical community. These medicinal drugs are highly controlled, but are often the difference between life and death for many citizens.
messages.zh: 虽然通常被称作“增效剂”的化合物在帝国空间内是非法物品，但气云物质的其他合法衍生物可以用于医学界。这些药物的使用受到严格控制，但是对许多公民来说，药物使用与否的差别就如同天堂与地狱一般。

messages.en: Medicinal Drugs
messages.zh: 药物

messages.en:
The government says we're prepared for war. You wouldn't know it by looking at our wounded. Space makes everything worse. Just look through the medical bay. Second-degree burns and frostbite are both alarmingly common, and are usually in conjunction with other serious injuries.

I need pain medications badly. I can't just wait for the next delivery. I need to produce my own drugs. For that I'm going to need Gamboge Cytoserocin. I heard a smuggler say there was a pocket at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Go there, and bring back everything you can. I'll try to make it worth your while.

You must own and be able to use a Gas Cloud Harvester to complete this mission. If you do not or cannot, please just decline; note that you can decline one mission every 4 hours without standing loss.
messages.zh:
政府宣称：我们已做好全面的战争准备。你不会了解到这对我们造成的伤害。它使一切都变得很糟，你只要看看医疗部门就会有所了解。二度烧伤和冻伤，同样的都是惊人的严重伤害。

我非常需要止痛药。我已经等不及下一批货运的到来了。我要自己制造些药品。因此，我需要藤黄丝胶溶质。我听一名非法贩售者说，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一团这样的气云。去吧，有多少就带多少回来。我会让你的劳动得到应有的回报。

你需要配备一部气云采集器，才能完成这个任务。 如果你不想去或者无法完成，请拒绝；需要注意的是你只能够每4个小时拒绝一个任务才不会造成声望的损失。

messages.en: Yes, just get some rest {[character]agentID.name}. Don't you worry, I'll take good care of your friend's problem for you.
messages.zh: 是的，得要休息休息，{[character]agentID.name}。 别担心，我会帮你的朋友解决这点问题的。

messages.en: Oh, you will? That's so very kind of you, {[character]player.name}. Perhaps we can talk again later, after I've had a little nap.
messages.zh: 噢，你会？你真是太好了{[character]player.name}。也许过些时候我们能再谈谈，等我睡一觉。

messages.en: I'm ready to serve in any way I can.
messages.zh: 我已经准备好为你效劳了。

messages.en:
I have a friend in a very difficult situation. He's due for a promotion, you see. More accurately, he would be if there weren't a few other promising individuals ahead of him in line. Such promising individuals, indeed, that I am sure their superiors would miss them dearly if anything were to happen to them.

However, you see, they are all Gallente officers, and for any agent of the State to interfere in Federation matters would be quite wrong, now, wouldn't it? Of course, it's not terribly uncommon for valiant officers, Gallente or otherwise, to meet quite unfortunate ends in any number of... well, mishaps. Yes, {[character]player.name}, it's not uncommon at all, is it? So I'm sure things will work themselves out somehow.

Anyhow, your mission. Well, this is quite embarrassing... I've completely forgotten any mission I might have had for you. Come to think of it, I've forgotten everything I was just talking about. Goodness, I think I'd better go lie down for a while.

But... I don't suppose you could look after my datapad here while I rest? It's quite important, you see, for it has the current coordinates of one of those promising Federation individuals, one of the ones we just discussed. And I wouldn't want that to fall into the wrong hands, now, would I?

And you... you look like you could use a break, too. Maybe a leisurely cruise out into space somewhere nearby, a chance to relax and, oh, I don't know, enjoy some scenery? Maybe pay someone a visit? And by the time I wake up, maybe my worries will have taken care of themselves, hmm?

Your agent's datapad has given you the coordinates to one of the competitors of your agent's "friend" in the Gallente Navy. Your "mission" once you arrive there should be abundantly clear.
messages.zh:
我有个朋友遇到了非常麻烦的情况。本来他应当被升职的，你知道。更确切的说是他将会被提升，如果在他之前没有别的更适合人选的话。所谓更适合的人选，说实在的，我想要是他们出了什么事情的话，他们的上司肯定会非常想念他们的。

无论怎样，你看，他们都是盖伦特官员，任何共和国代理人插手盖伦特的事物都是非常错误的行为，是吗。当然，这样的事情在那些勇敢的军官里面是常有的，不管是不是盖伦特，遇上这样的意外事件都是非常不幸的。是啊，{[character]player.name}，这完全不寻常，是吗？我肯定车到山前必有路。

无论怎样，让我来告诉你的任务吧。恩，这是件很尴尬的事情……我完全忘记了我曾给过你的任何任务，想想看，我几乎忘了刚刚我说的所有东西。天啊，我想我得去躺躺。

但……我想你不会趁我睡着的时候偷看我的数据版吧？上面记得有那些联邦的优秀人才，就是刚才我们所谈到的。我不想要那些泄漏到错误的人手里，对么？

还有你……你看起来也应该休息休息，找一艘娱乐游轮，到附近的星系去转转，放松放松，看看风景？也可以去拜访一下某些人？等我醒来的时候，或许我的担心已经完全不解自灭了，是么？

你的代理人的数据版给你了一个坐标，他是盖伦特海军里面你的代理人的那个朋友的竞争对手。当你到了那个地方自然会明白你的“任务”具体是要做什么。

messages.en: It's good to see you so well rested, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm afraid I have some bad news: I've lost your datapad, the one with the coordinates on it? Oh, and I fear that a certain Gallente lieutenant may have run into some trouble as well.
messages.zh: 你看上去很精神，{[character]agentID.name}。我想我有些坏消息，我把你的数据板弄丢了，就是那个有坐标的数据板。恩，当然还有某个盖伦特的中尉也遇到了些麻烦。

messages.en: Is that so? Dear me... that's quite unfortunate. I am terribly sorry to hear it, {[character]player.name}. Here, take this compensation for the concern you must also be feeling; hopefully it will ease your mind somewhat.
messages.zh: 是那样么？天啊……那真是太不幸了。我真是非常的抱歉，{[character]player.name}。 来，这里是些对你的关心的回报；希望能够让你好受一点。

messages.en: What the hell are you yammering on about?! I 'm going to go wash down a few Starsi and leave you to your rest. You apparently need it.
messages.zh: 你到底在叫个什么？我不管你了。

messages.en: Yes, of course, please forgive me. I'll just get some rest now. Do close the door on your way out. <sigh>
messages.zh: 是啊，当然。请原谅我，我得要休息休息。走的时候请关上门（谈起）

messages.en:
The corporations of the State have many friends, as you know... many friends in many interesting and useful places. Why is this relevant, you ask? Well, it's not at all… it was merely an idle thought I had today that I wanted to impart upon you.

But actually, now I come to think about the topic of friends… I am reminded of a particular friend of mine in a very difficult situation. He's due for a promotion, you see. More accurately, he would be if there weren't a few other promising individuals ahead of him in line. Such promising individuals, indeed, that I am sure their superiors would miss them dearly if anything were to happen to them. But it would be very, er, helpful... for me--for us--if this friend of ours were to get what he wants.

However, you see, they are all Gallente officers, and for any agent of the State to interfere in Federation matters would be quite wrong, now, wouldn't it? Of course, with all the random third party violence these days, it's not terribly uncommon for valiant officers, Gallente or otherwise, to meet quite unfortunate ends in any number of... well, mishaps. Yes, {[character]player.name}, it's not uncommon at all, is it? So I'm sure things will work themselves out somehow.

Anyhow, your mission. Right. Well, this is quite embarrassing... I've completely forgotten any mission I might have had for you. Come to think of it, I've forgotten everything I was just talking about. Goodness, I think I better go and lie down for a while.

But... I don't suppose you could look after my datapad here while I rest? It's quite important, you see, for it has the current coordinates of one of those promising Federation individuals, one of the ones we just discussed. And I wouldn't want that to fall into the wrong hands, now, would I?

And you... you look like you could use a break, too. Maybe a leisurely cruise out into space somewhere nearby, a chance to relax and, oh, I don't know, enjoy some scenery? Maybe pay someone a visit? And by the time I wake up, maybe my worries will have taken care of themselves, hmm?
messages.zh:
合众国的很多军团里面都有我的朋友，这一点你是知道的…各种各样、不同行业的朋友。你要问这有什么关系？其实没有什么关系…这只是今天突然想起来要传授给你的一个道理。

但实际上，我现在开始考虑朋友这个问题，特别是我想起来，有一位朋友正处于窘境之中。本来他应当被提拔的。更准确的说，是他将被提拔，如果在他之前没有别的更适合人选的话。所谓这些更适合的人选，说实在的，我想要是他们出了什么事情的话，他们的上司肯定会非常想念他们的。但如果我们这位朋友能心想事成的话，那对我，对我们，都是件好事。

无论怎样，你看，他们都是盖伦特官员，任何合众国代理人插手盖伦特的事物都是非常错误的行为，对吧？不过，鉴于 最近经常发生随机第三方暴力事件，因此不管是不是盖伦特人，一旦遇上这样的倒霉事，应该都不能算一个太大的意外。嗯嗯，压根儿不算是意外，对吧，{[character]player.name}？所以我想这种事应该不用我们操心，自己会解决的。

无论怎样，你的任务。好吧。真是很尴尬呀……我完全忘记了我曾给过你任何任务。我几乎忘了刚刚我说的所有东西。神哪，我想我得去躺一会儿。

但…我感觉你是不会在我睡觉的时候替我照看我的数据板的吧？上面记录着一位联邦的优秀人才，就是刚才我们所谈到的那个人，目前所在的位置。我怎么会让那东西落入不该落入的人手里呢？

还有你…你看起来也应该休息一下。找一艘娱乐游轮，到附近的星系去转转，放松放松，看看风景？顺便去拜访某人？等我醒来的时候，或许我的担心已经完全自行消失了，嗯？

messages.en: You seem to have forgotten what I was talking about too, {[character]player.name}! Ah well, perhaps it was a conversation best left forgotten.
messages.zh: 看来你也忘记了我所说的事情。{[character]player.name}！很好，也许我们的这段对话应该永远被遗忘。

messages.en: Our conversation
messages.zh: 我们的对话

messages.en: I just wanted to let you know that I too forgot everything you were talking about. Seems that now we both forgot, hmm? Guess I'll come back for a real mission later.
messages.zh: 我只是想告诉你，我也忘记你所说的所有事情了。看起来我们两都忘记了？我想我会回来找你要真正的任务的。

messages.en: Strange, isn't it.... how someone can just completely forget about a conversation? Though some conversations are best left forgotten, right, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 奇怪，这不是……人怎么可能就这么随意的把说过的话给忘了呢？尽管有些对话我们还是忘掉的好，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: I'm afraid that my datapad went missing on your watch, {[character]player.name}. It is an unfortunate thing, very unfortunate indeed. I'm afraid, also, that I'll have to hold you responsible for its contents and any action--or in this case, inaction--they might have inspired.
messages.zh: 恐怕我的数据板就在你的眼皮底下消失掉了，{[character]player.name}。真是不幸，太不幸了。我觉得你必须对此事造成的后果负责。

messages.en: My datapad?
messages.zh: 我的数据板？

messages.en: I can't believe this is allowed to happen! Give me the coordinates. I'll show them the fast route back to Gallente space: via clone replacement.
messages.zh: 我真没法相信有人会允许这样的事情发生！快把位标给我。我会给他们指引一条回到盖伦特领域最快的路：利用克隆重生。

messages.en: Excellent, I'm sure you will, {[character]player.name}. I'm sending the location now.
messages.zh: 很好，我相信你行的，{[character]player.name}。我现在把地址传送给你。

messages.en: How can I help?
messages.zh: 你要我怎么做？

messages.en:
There has been an ongoing situation in the entertainment industry, the gambling sector in particular. We've started to see Gallente companies buying out the smaller ones here and reaping profits from our own citizens. Worse, they've offered Navy vessels as security for these companies' spacebound offices, many of which are located here in our own regions.

Make no mistake, {[character]player.name}: This is in all likelihood just their first step. Their intentions are nothing short of an economic war with us over one of our key industries, followed by a direct assault in our own backyard once we're sufficiently weakened.

So, we're getting loyal pod pilots like you together and sending them off to as many of these "company sites" as we can find. A local recon force recently found such a Gallente Navy headquarters nearby in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Get out there and deal with them. This is a standard office complex; an outer layer of security with the offices behind them. Take out all of the guards, then go for their headquarters.
messages.zh:
娱乐业最近出了点状况，尤其是博弈行业。盖伦特公司一天到晚收购我们这里的小公司，从我们人民身上榨取利润。而且盖伦特那些公司的高层有很多都住在我们境内，现在联邦政府都开始用他们的海军舰船为那帮商人保驾护航。。

{[character]player.name}，你要清楚认识到这点：这极有可能只是他们的第一步。他们的目的正是先在关键行业与我们来一场经济战，然后乘我们弱得不行的时候再发动一场直捣黄龙的军事打击。

鉴于此，我们正在组织起像你这样的忠心飞行员，将他们派往我们能找到的所有那些盖伦特公司。我们的一支侦察队在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了盖伦特海军的一个总部。请飞往那里将他们解决掉。这是座标准的办公室设施，周围会驻守一些防卫力量。先把卫兵都解决掉，然后直捣他们的老巢。

messages.en: My work is done. You won't be seeing any new acquisition bids from that company.
messages.zh: 我完成任务了。你不会再看到那家公司有任何收购行动了。

messages.en: You did? Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. On behalf of the countless Caldari whose jobs you have saved, I thank you.
messages.zh: 是吗？干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。你为无数加达里人保住了他们的工作，我代表他们谢谢你。

messages.en: I don't think I care enough about your economic concerns to risk my ship over it.
messages.zh: 我还不至于为了你的经济担忧去牺牲我的船。

messages.en: The State does not ask much of its people. Your lack of loyalty will not be tolerated for very long around these parts, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 国家对人民所求不多。你这缺乏忠诚的表现不会被长期容忍的，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Gallente Navy ships are not often allowed inside State borders – at least not officially. Conditions determined in the Iyen-Oursta Treaty at the end of the war place strict conditions on the manner in which each nation's fleets enter the other's sovereign space.

One of the current laws allows such deployments, though, if they are hired by a third party as part of usual trade business. Additionally, they must meet stringent size and composition requirements that greatly limit any damage they could potentially cause. Since official search and rescue missions are, by treaty, conducted exclusively by the nation that owns the space, further "hostile" forces cannot legally be sent to recover hired navy forces that go missing.
messages.zh:
法律上讲，盖伦特海军的舰船是不允许入加达里国境的。在大战结束后双方签订的《伊恩-奥斯塔条约》中，明确对双方军舰进出对方主权领域进行了限制。

不过现在有一条法律约定，如果一方军舰受雇于第三方以协助进行常规贸易活动的话，那该方军舰便可以进出对方领域。另外，军舰的尺寸和组成都受严格限制，以便降低可能涌现的破坏力。由于根据条约，官方的搜救活动只能由事故发生地所在的国家那一方来担当，因此失事一方无法派出自己军队前往对方领域搜救。

messages.en: Iyen-Oursta Loopholes
messages.zh: 伊恩-奥斯塔漏洞

messages.en:
There has been an ongoing situation in the entertainment industry, the gambling sector in particular. We've started to see Gallente companies buying out the smaller ones here and reaping profits from our own citizens. This isn't entirely new, of course — they've been trying to do it for decades — but it's actually seeing widespread success now.

What concerns us is that the Federation is officially starting to play an active role in all of this. They've offered Navy vessels as security for the companies' spacebound offices, many of which are located here in our own regions. Since these security forces come at a greatly subsidized cost, we're starting to see a few troubling things. First off, the companies obviously have more ISK to fund further acquisitions. More important, however, is this slow build-up inside our space of Gallente military units. They may be relatively inexperienced and poorly equipped, for the most part, but it's the quantity that concerns us, not the quality.

Make no mistake, {[character]player.name}: This is in all likelihood just their first step. Soon the Federation will forge these various companies into a more unified and organized conglomerate, and then we'll see them pushing to allow larger military escorts with better equipment. Their intentions are nothing short of an economic war with us over one of our key industries, followed by a direct assault in our own backyard once we're sufficiently weakened.

So, we're getting loyal pod pilots like you together and sending them off to as many of these "company sites" as we can find. They were supposed to have registered their offices with our officials, but a combination of lazy State bureaucrats and Gallente scheming means there are currently numerous sites out there that we don't have exact coordinates for. Our mistake in part, yes, but we're fixing it now. It's easy enough to disclaim any official involvement in this little removal operation too, since we have your kind doing the work for us.

Anyway, a local recon force recently found such a Gallente Navy headquarters nearby in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Are you ready to act?
messages.zh:
娱乐业最近出了点状况，尤其是博弈行业。盖伦特公司一天到晚收购我们这里的小公司，从我们人民身上榨取利润。当然这不是什么新鲜事——他们数十年来都这样做——但最近他们涉及的范围越来越广。

让我们担心的是，盖伦特联邦政府逐渐在这一系列商业活动中扮演了积极角色。盖伦特那些公司的高层有很多都住在我们境内，现在联邦政府都开始用他们的海军舰船为那帮商人保驾护航。由于这些商人采用这些护航服务都是享有补贴的，我们从中看出了些不好的端倪。首先，那些公司可以省下更多的钱去继续大肆收购。但更重要的是，盖伦特在我们境内开始逐渐聚集起军事部队。虽然其中的大多数都没啥经验，装备落后，我们担心的是他们的数量，而不是质量。

{[character]player.name}，你要清楚认识到这点：这极有可能只是他们的第一步。很快盖伦特联邦就会让那些小企业合并起来组成一个垄断集团，然后他们就可以顺理成章地派出装备更精良的部队进行护航了。他们的目的正是先在关键行业与我们来一场经济战，然后乘我们弱得不行的时候再发动一场直捣黄龙的军事打击。

鉴于此，我们正在组织起像你这样的忠心飞行员，将他们派往我们能找到的所有那些盖伦特公司。其实那些公司当初是应该找我们官员注册的，但由于我们官员的官僚作风以及盖伦特施行的诡计，弄得有大量公司的位置我们根本就不清楚。这当中确有我们的责任，我们已经开始弥补这点了。由于这些军事清除行动将交给你这样的人来完成，因为我们政府是比较容易在表面上与此事脱离干系的。

好了，我们的一支侦察队在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了盖伦特海军的一个总部。你准备好出击了吗？

messages.en: Too slow
messages.zh: 太慢了

messages.en: You know, upon reflection, I'm less sure about this mission now. They're not breaking any laws, so if you want them gone you'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我又前思后想了一下，觉得自己不适合干这类任务。他们又没犯法，你要赶他们走就去找别人吧。

messages.en: You disappoint me, {[character]player.name}. Next time you take up a mission, understand that we will expect you to see it through — no matter the cost.
messages.zh: 你真让我失望，{[character]player.name}。下次你接活儿时，我希望你明白我们要求你有始有终——不管付出什么代价。

messages.en: You promised to deal with that company I needed removed, remember? Well, now too much time has passed and they've relocated their headquarters after noticing our scouts. You have let me down, {[character]player.name}, and countless other Caldari as well.
messages.zh: 你向我保证过你会处理我希望除去的那个公司，对吗？哼，现在的情况是这事拖得太久，他们在注意到我们的侦察兵后把总部挪走了。你不仅让我失望，{[character]player.name}，你也让无数加达里人跟着一起失望。

messages.en: What happened?
messages.zh: 发生了什么事情?

name.es: El precio de una hierba más verde
name.fr: Le prix d'une herbe plus verte
name.ru: Цена зеленой травы (The Cost of Greener Grass)

messages.en: Yes, it's a distressing trend, I agree. I'll see to it he never makes it to Federation space.
messages.zh: 是啊，这是个有趣的现象。我会去确保他永远不能活着抵达联邦的边境的。

messages.en: Good to hear. One less leech, we can do without.
messages.zh: 很高兴听到。

messages.en: I might be. What did you have in mind?
messages.zh: 我可能是，你在想什么？

messages.en:
One of our people has betrayed us and is planning to defect to the Gallente. This particular traitor is fairly high-profile, you see, which makes it difficult for us to act more openly. I need this situation sorted. We have to send a message that any treacherous behavior against the State will have truly dire consequences.

We have been able to locate the traitor's temporary living quarters, which are still in State space and therefore under our jurisdiction. Can you head over there and deal with this, {[character]player.name}? I don't want this fool making it to Gallente space alive. Oh, and bring what's left of him back to me, just for certainty's sake.
messages.zh:
我们的一个人背叛了我们的国家，准备叛逃到盖伦特。这个叛徒的行为相当的高调，你知道，这让我们很难公开的去了结这事儿。我需要把这个事情结束掉，要让所有的那些心怀叵测的人知道，背叛是会受到严厉惩罚的。

我们已经找到了这个叛徒的藏身处，目前他还躲藏在我们的领地之内。{[character]player.name}，你能前去帮我给这事儿做一个了解么？我不想让他活着逃到盖伦特的领地里。哦，最好再把他的尸体带回来，只是为了确保万无一失。

messages.en: It's done: Add one more traitor to the body count... and some ISK to my account, please.
messages.zh: 完成了：还多干掉了一个叛徒……请你把钱打到我的户头上吧。

messages.en: Ha! Impressive work, {[character]player.name}. I heard you made a real mess of those traitors. Here is your reward — take it with my thanks.
messages.zh: 哈！干的漂亮，{[character]player.name}。我听说你把那些叛徒都搞得很惨。这是你的报酬，拿去吧，很感谢你。

messages.en: What a pointless job! I want to make a difference, maybe get rich along the way... not chase down people who just happen to like Intaki wine. Get back to me with some real work, ok?
messages.zh: 简直是个毫无意义的任务！我想要有些改变，或许应该找点发财的事儿做……这种去追捕一个只是因为爱喝印塔基的酒就叛逃的人不是我想做的事情。等你有什么真正的活儿的时候再找我，Ok？

messages.en: Excuse me? You want to encourage this behavior?! Your lack of loyalty is disconcerting, {[character]player.name}. Not to mention the lack of foresight....
messages.zh: 你再说一次？你想我纵容这种行为？！你的不忠已经造成破坏了，{[character]player.name}。更别说，你目光的短浅。

messages.en:
Over the years, the Caldari have seen various citizens desert their posts in search of better futures elsewhere. The Guristas have always recruited disgruntled ex-State pilots into their ranks, while Mordu's Legion has taken in those who were unhappy with their place in the State, but who remained patriotic or were otherwise obligated to maintain good relations.

Recently, however, there has been an increase in defections to various Gallente corporations, usually in the research and security sectors, and even to the Federation Navy. While such a thing was virtually unheard of in the past, the Federation is increasingly becoming the home to a certain class of Caldari: those skilled pilots and technicians who have come to disagree violently with the State, but who, for various reasons, do not want to enter the seedy underworld of galactic piracy. Such people have found the Federation most sympathetic and welcoming.
messages.zh:
这些年，很多加达里人废弃了他们的家园迁移到别处寻求更好的发展。古斯塔斯和莫德团都在招收那些不满和事业受挫的前加达里飞行员，但依然，那些忠心和爱国人的还是留在加达里继续努力。

最近，在几个盖伦特所属的企业和军团里面出现了上升的叛逃势头，特别是在研究和安全部门尤为凸显，甚至已经发展到了联邦海军内部。这些事情在以前都是前所未闻的，现在联邦已经变成了一群特殊加达里人的家园：经验丰富的飞行员和技术人员极端的反对合众国，但也是这些人，因为各种原因，不愿意涉足到恶心的星际海盗地下世界。这些人受到了联邦的同情和欢迎。

messages.en: State Defection
messages.zh: 叛国

messages.en:
We have a serious matter to deal with, {[character]player.name}. Very serious. One of our people has betrayed us and is planning to defect to the Gallente.

It's not as if he knows anything particularly important. Nor does he pose much of a threat. It's the principle of the thing. And the example this sets for others. This particular traitor is fairly high-profile, you see, which makes it difficult for us to act more openly. We've already lost enough people to the Guristas and the Legion, and if we start losing people to the Federation, who knows where it will end.

I need this situation sorted. We have to send a message that any treacherous behavior against the State has consequences. We have been able to locate the traitor's temporary living quarters, which are still in State space and therefore under our jurisdiction. We have a small window of opportunity to act before he leaves for the Federation. Can you head over there and deal with this, {[character]player.name}? I don't want this fool making it to Gallente space alive.
messages.zh:
我们有一个严重的问题要处理，{[character]player.name}。非常严重。我们的一个人背叛了我们，而且准备要叛逃到盖伦特。

并不是因为他知道什么重要的秘密，也不是因为他对我们有什么特别的危害。这是原则性的问题，这会起一个坏头。我这个叛徒的行为相当的高调，你知道，这让我们很难公开的去了结这事儿。我们已经被古斯塔斯和莫德团拉去了不少人了，如果我们再这么放任自由，谁知道会发生什么样的结果。

我需要把这个事情结束掉，要让所有的那些心怀叵测的人知道，背叛是会受到严厉惩罚的。我们已经找到了这个叛徒的藏身处，目前他还躲藏在我们的领地之内。你能前去帮我给这事儿做一个了解么？ {[character]player.name}。我不想让他活着逃到盖伦特的领地里。

messages.en: Too long
messages.zh: 太长

messages.en: You know what? I've changed my mind. If this guy wants to run to Gallente so bad, let him.
messages.zh: 你知道么？我改变主意了，如果这家伙那么想要跑到盖伦特那边去，就让他去吧。

messages.en: Let him?! And let the Federation propaganda machine turn him against us entirely? A very foolish stance, {[character]player.name}. Your failure to act will only encourage more problems of this kind.
messages.zh: 不管他？！就这么让联邦把他变成宣传机器来诋毁我们自己？真是愚蠢的想法，{[character]player.name}。你的失败行为只会鼓励这些无赖。

messages.en: You have failed us
messages.zh: 你让我们失望了。

name.es: Tan en serio como la muerte

messages.en: Okay, relax. I've got this one in the bag. That's why you asked me, remember? I'll get my people together and we'll have a barbecue, Caldari-style.
messages.zh: OK，放松，放松。这事我能搞定。不然你找我干嘛，对吧？我会拉拢一帮兄弟，给敌人来一次加达里式的像烤肉一样的攻击。

messages.en: Ha! Yes… yes indeed. You're a source of inspiration for us all, I assure you. I'll have the transport fleet on standby; report back to me immediately after the area is secure.
messages.zh: 哈哈！是，是。你的确给了我们很大的精神鼓舞。我会叫运输队一旁待命；把那地区搞定之后回来向我报告。

messages.en: Born ready, {[character]agentID.name}. But, uh, what the hell is going on? You look about ready to slit someone's throat.
messages.zh: 我天生就准备好了，{[character]agentID.name}。不过到底出什么事了？你看上去好像要割人喉咙似的。

messages.en:
The Gallente have somehow discovered one of our secret cloning facilities, and I'm told their orders to attack it have come from the most senior of Federation military officials.

I can't stress enough the importance of this mission. If those clone bays go down, we'll have a huge problem on our hands. I don't have the clearance to know exactly whose clones are being stored where, nor if they are the only copies. All I know is that they are holding important people, very important.

Fly over there immediately, and destroy any and all hostiles you see. Once the facility is secure, we can send in the relocation fleet and move it all safely away. You must move quickly, though! This initial force is undoubtedly just the scouting party since they're not attacking the facility yet. We need them cleared out before we have a fleet of Navy Moros besieging the facility.
messages.zh:
盖伦特人不知用什么手段发现了我们的一处秘密克隆设施，听说联邦的最高军官已经下达了要攻打那里的指令。

这次任务的重要性不必我多说，你应该懂。如果那些克隆舱都没了，那我们就要倒大楣。我认为这只是盖伦特对付我方关键人物的第一步，他们要先把救生用的克隆给毁了。由于级别限制，我无法知道那些克隆到底是谁的，也不清楚那些克隆是否唯一。我唯一能确定的就是那些克隆都是重要大人物的。

你要迅速飞往那里，御敌人个片甲不留。你把那设施保全之后，我们就会派出一个搬家部队，把设施转运到一个安全地点。但前提是你动作要快！敌人的先头部队还没有袭击克隆设施，因此他们应该只是侦察队。你要把那里清空，然后我们才可以派出一支海军莫洛级无畏舰舰队。

messages.en: I told you I had it covered. You can send your fleet in now.
messages.zh: 没事了。你可以把你的舰队派过去了。

messages.en: You truly are an asset to the State, {[character]player.name}. I honestly don't know what we would have done without your help. Be proud of the work you have done today.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你果真是合众国的一位重要功臣。说真的没你帮忙我真不知道我们会怎么办。你应该对自己今天的作为感到骄傲。

messages.en: Wait… you're actually serious about asking me to do all this? I'm not standing between a Gallente fleet and a target like that! Find someone else for your suicide missions!
messages.zh: 等等……你还真打算让我干这事？我可不会冒着抵挡一支盖伦特舰队的风险去保护那样一个设施！找别人当炮灰去吧！

messages.en: Suicide missions!? You have a clone, do you not, {[character]player.name}?! Unlike the many important Caldari whose clones are in peril…! A true Caldari would give anything to serve the State in such an important matter. Clearly you are no such thing.
messages.zh: 当炮灰！？你不是还有克隆吗，难道你没有吗，{[character]player.name}？！你又不是像加达里许多高级人物一样，克隆处于危险之中……！在这样一个重要场合，真正的加达里人是甘愿付出一切保卫合众国的。很明显你不是这样的人。

messages.en:
Following the widespread release of cloning technology, as it became both financially viable and CONCORD-sanctioned, Zainou Biotech enjoyed a period of unprecedented profits. Securing almost one third of the market share in clone sales, the corporation was set to become one of the most important Caldari corporations in the cluster, which would only have added further influence to its parent company, Ishukone.

In those days, Zainou handled all cloning, though, then as today, only the fabulously wealthy could afford the technology. However, since the event known as the "Insorum Imbroglio," when Zainou lost the trust of the other State corporations, the CEP has mandated that the highest levels of office and those of great value to the State would have their clones stored in other facilities.

Little is known about these cloning centers. Details such as their number, location, staff, administrative structure, and resources all remain closely guarded secrets.
messages.zh:
随着克隆技术的成本大幅降低，加上统合部的法律批准，该技术迎来了大规模运用的时代，载诺科技也因此收获了前所未有的利润。在抢占了克隆销售市场近三分之一的份额之后，该公司将势必成为加达里最重要的集团之一，而这也必将进一步提升其母公司——异株湖集团——的影响力。

在过去，载诺曾接手过所有的克隆服务，不像今天只有少部分富人才能享用这种服务。然而，在“荧索莱姆事件”爆发后，载诺就失去了合众国其他集团的信任，CEO合作组织后来强制规定，所有高级官员以及对国家有重要价值的人物的克隆体必须安放在其他设施里。

人们对那些克隆中心知之甚少。像设施数量、地点、人员、组织结构及资源这类信息都是秘密中的秘密。

messages.en: The Advent of the Clone
messages.zh: 克隆的出现

messages.en:
It's those damn Gallente, what else!? They're not even trying to maintain the appearance of peace between us anymore! I'm deadly serious, {[character]player.name}. If this isn't a direct act to provoke all-out war, then I don't know what is. We are dealing with a blatant assault on one of our most important facilities, right within our own borders!

Alright, here's the deal: They've somehow discovered one of our secret cloning facilities, and I'm told their orders to attack it have come from the most senior of Federation military officials.

I can't stress enough the importance of this mission. If those clone bays go down, we'll have a huge problem on our hands. Hell, for all we know this could be only the first step before key individuals are targeted, without clones to save them. I don't have the clearance to know exactly whose clones are being stored where, nor if they are the only copies. All I know is that they are holding important people, very important.

You need to fly over there immediately, and destroy any and all hostiles you see. Once the facility is secure, we can send in the relocation fleet and move it all safely away. You must move quickly, though! This initial force is undoubtedly just the scouting party since they're not attacking the facility yet. We need them cleared out before we have a fleet of Navy Moros besieging the facility.

If we can't trust you with this, {[character]player.name}, then I don't know who we can trust anymore.
messages.zh:
这都要怪那帮该死的盖伦特人，除了他们之外还有谁！？他们连表面上的和平都不想要了！我很严肃，{[character]player.name}。如果这都不算直接开战的一次挑衅，那我真不知道什么还算是了。我们正在面对敌人对我们最重要设施的一次侵袭，而且就位于我们境内！

好了，情况现在是这样：敌人不知用什么手段发现了我们的一处秘密克隆设施，听说联邦的最高军官已经下达了要攻打那里的指令。

这次任务的重要性不必我多说。如果那些克隆舱都没了，那我们就要倒大霉。我认为这只是盖伦特对付我方关键人物的第一步，他们要先把救生用的克隆给毁了。由于级别限制，我无法知道那些克隆到底是谁的，也不清楚那些克隆是否唯一。我唯一能确定的就是那些克隆都是重要大人物的。

你要迅速飞往那里，把敌人打个片甲不留。你把那座设施保全之后，我们就会派出一支转移部队，把设施转运到一个安全地点。但前提是你动作要快！敌人的先头部队还没有袭击克隆设施，因此他们应该只是侦察队。你要把他们清除干净，然后我们才可以派出一支海军无畏舰队。

你是我们唯一能信任的人了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
It should not take anywhere near this long to decide on a mission of such importance. I cannot wait for you any longer; I've arranged for a more reliable party to secure the facility.

I suggest you fix your attitude.
messages.zh:
这样一项重要的任务不应该花这么久的时间来考虑；我没法再陪你耗下去了；我已经联系他家去保卫那设施了。

我建议你以后端正一下你的态度。

messages.en: Your appalling indecision
messages.zh: 你那令人鄙夷的优柔寡断

messages.en: It's a hopeless situation, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm afraid you're going to have to find another solution. I can't involve myself any further in this; I just don't have the resources to deliver the results.
messages.zh: 这事没救了，{[character]agentID.name}。恐怕你得另寻他法。我没法再干了；凭我所能我没法完成任务。

messages.en: Well… then why did you accept it in the first place?! Damned podders. Where is your loyalty, your commitment!? Get out of here.
messages.zh: 我靠……那你当初还接受这任务？！没用的飞行员。你的忠诚体现在哪里！？滚出去。

messages.en: Because of your inaction, thousands of Caldari lives were lost retaking the cloning facility. I can barely describe the level of profound disappointment I have in you, {[character]player.name}. Do not offer your services in the future unless you truly intend to provide them.
messages.zh: 由于你原地不动，数千加达里人在收复克隆设置时付出了生命。{[character]player.name}，我对你的失望已经到了无以言对的地步。除非你确实有心，不然将来就不要假惺惺地伸手支援了。

messages.en: You have failed us
messages.zh: 你让我们失望了。

messages.en: Of course. If the Caldari are going to exploit such sacred places for profit, then I'll be the first one to get in their way.
messages.zh: 敬请放心。如果加达里人妄想亵渎圣地发横财，那我便是第一个上前阻止他们的人。

messages.en: I thought you would agree with me on this. I'm uploading you the location of the memorial site now. Just be prepared for a fight: They won't take kindly to being forcibly removed.
messages.zh: 我就知道你我立场一致。我现在把纪念地的位标上传到你控制边栏里。要做好战斗准备：他们可不喜欢被强迁。

messages.en: You do? Alright, then, let's hear it.
messages.zh: 是嘛？那说出来听听。

messages.en:
There's any number of memorial sites from the Great War littered around Gallente space. We've always honored the wishes of honest Caldari pilgrims wanting to visit these memorials; we even let them keep a small number of maintenance staff around on the bigger sites.

It seems our trust was misplaced, however. I've recently received reports of their using their memorials as staging grounds for production facilities inside our own space. Those profit-minded slime are seeking to benefit financially from these facilities, without paying taxes… in fact, with nooversight whatsoever.

We've asked them to withdraw and to take down their marketing facilities, but they're acting outraged that we'd even suggest it. Obviously it's a sensitive issue, but even the President has been vocal about the Caldari exploiting such sensitivity over the past war for commercial profit.

Problem is, our requests are nothing but posturing without an independent like you to back them up: We can't send in any official forces to remove them. A capsuleer like yourself, though… that gives us some plausible deniability.
messages.zh:
在我们与加达里的那场大战之后，他们在我们领域里布下了许多纪念场所。对于那些真心实意前来拜访纪念场所的加达里人，我们尊重他们的意愿；在一些较大场所里，我们甚至还允许少量加达里护工驻留。

不过现在看来我们不应该对他们这么信任。我收到报告说他们用那些纪念场地做掩护，背后却在大搞生产基地。那些拜金主义者妄图借此大发横财，却不缴一分税金……其实就是无人监管了。

我们已经要求他们召回所有员工，关闭生产设施。他们却大发雷霆，说我们怎么敢提这种要求。明显这是起敏感事件，但总统本人已经在此问题上清楚表明了自己的立场，反对借战争题材捞钱。

不过我们的问题就是到目前为止我们还没任何实际行动：我们不能调动部队把他们赶走。但有你这样的飞行员帮忙……就容易让我们与此事脱干系。

messages.en: The area has been cleared of foreign personnel and structures. They defended it surprisingly well, so I think it's safe to say we haven't seen the end of this matter.
messages.zh: 我已经把那里的外国人与外国设施清除掉了。他们的抵抗出乎意料地顽强，因此这事极有可能还没完。

messages.en: Disgusting, isn't it? I can only wonder about a nation that cares only for material gain. No doubt it won't be the last time you have to do this sort of thing for us… but at least we have reliable people like you to count on.
messages.zh: 很恶心是吧？我真想不通怎么会有一切向钱看的国家的。这事肯定还没完……不过好在我们还有像你这样靠得住的人。

messages.en: That's pretty sickening, I agree, but I don't think we should remove them. Just expose what they're up to and the situation will resolve itself, I'm sure.
messages.zh: 说实话他们行为确实够恶心，但还不至于把他们赶走吧。把这事曝光媒体后这事自然会解决。

messages.en: I admire your humanity. This is, however, exactly what they're expecting us to do. They'll just withdraw before the media storm hits and we'll still look like brutal imperialists.
messages.zh: 我欣赏你的怜悯之心。但这样做正好落入他们圈套，他们可以在媒体口述笔伐之前撤离，然后别人照样会指责我们是冷血的帝国主义者。

messages.en:
There's any number of memorial sites from the Great War between us and the Caldari littered around our space. We've always honored the wishes of honest Caldari pilgrims wanting to visit these memorials; we even let them keep a small number of maintenance staff around on the bigger sites.

It seems our trust in them was misplaced, however. I've recently received reports of their using their memorials, of all places, as staging grounds for production facilities inside our own space. Those profit-minded slime are seeking to benefit financially from these facilities, all without paying taxes… in fact, without any oversight whatsoever.

We've asked them to withdraw all staff and take down their marketing facilities, but they're acting outraged that we'd even suggest it. Obviously it's a sensitive issue, but even the President has been vocal about the Caldari exploiting such sensitivity over the past war for commercial profit.

Problem is, our requests are nothing but posturing without an independent like you to back them up: We can't send in any official forces to remove them. A capsuleer like yourself, though… that gives us some plausible deniability.

Can we trust you with this matter, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh:
在我们与加达里的那场大战之后，他们在我们领域里布下了许多纪念场所。对于那些真心实意前来拜访纪念场所的加达里人，我们尊重他们的意愿；在一些较大场所里，我们甚至还允许少量加达里护工驻留。

不过现在看来我们不应该对他们这么信任。我收到报告说他们用那些纪念场地做掩护，背后却在大搞生产基地。那些拜金主义者妄图借此大发横财，却不缴一分税金……其实就是无人监管了。

我们已经要求他们召回所有员工，关闭生产设施。他们却大发雷霆，说我们怎么敢提这种要求。明显这是起敏感事件，但总统本人已经在此问题上清楚表明了自己的立场，反对借战争题材捞钱。

不过我们的问题就是到目前为止我们还没任何实际行动：我们不能调动部队把他们赶走。但有你这样的飞行员帮忙……就容易让我们与此事脱干系。

我们能把这事放心地交给你吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en:
I'm fed up with your indecision, {[character]player.name}. If you weren't interested in clearing the Caldari from the memorial site, you might have just said so. You could have saved me a great deal of time, but instead you've decided to waste it instead.

I suggest you mend your ways — that attitude won't get you far in the Federation.
messages.zh:
我受不了你的优柔寡断了，{[character]player.name}。如果你没兴趣将加达里人从纪念设施中赶走，那你就说一声。你本来可以省下我很多时间，但你却让我浪费。

我建议你反省一下自己——就凭你那态度，你在联邦里混不出名堂。

messages.en: Mission offer expired
messages.zh: 任务提案过期

messages.en: I've changed my mind about this one, sorry. If they want to make a profit out of their own memorials, then they can answer to their own conscience, not to our guns.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我改变想法了。如果他们想利用自己的纪念设施赚钱，那就让他们自己反省去吧，我们没必要用枪指着他们。

messages.en: They should do both, {[character]player.name}! We first have to remove them; then and only then will we have proof of what they were up to. I now regret my faith in you; you are capable, no doubt, but short-sighted.
messages.zh: 这两件事情都要做，{[character]player.name}！我们要先把他们赶走；然后，一等要等要然后，我们才能抓获他们做脏的证据。我现在后悔相信你了；你的能力不容置疑，但你的目光却很短浅。

messages.en: Did you forget what you promised me, {[character]player.name}? I asked you to clear that memorial site of Caldari presence, and still no word back from you. I'm tired of waiting; I'm going to hand the job over to someone more reliable and deserving.
messages.zh: 你忘了对我做出的保证了吗，{[character]player.name}？我要求你把纪念地的加达里人清理干净，但你什么反应也没有。我不想再耗下去了；我打算把这事转交给一位更可靠、更值得的人去做。

messages.en: Mission expired
messages.zh: 任务过期

messages.en: Yes, just get some rest {[character]agentID.name}. Don't you worry, I'll take good care of your friend's problem for you.
messages.zh: 是的，得要休息休息，{[character]agentID.name}。 别担心，我会帮你的朋友解决这点问题的。

messages.en: Oh, you will? That's so very kind of you, {[character]player.name}. Perhaps we can talk again later, after I've had a little nap.
messages.zh: 噢，你会？你真是太好了{[character]player.name}。也许过些时候我们能再谈谈，等我睡一觉。

messages.en: I'm ready to serve in any way I can.
messages.zh: 我已经准备好为你效劳了。

messages.en:
I have a friend in a very difficult situation. He's due for a promotion, you see. More accurately, he would be if there weren't a few other promising individuals ahead of him in line. Such promising individuals, indeed, that I am sure their superiors would miss them dearly if anything were to happen to them.

However, you see, they are all Gallente officers, and for any agent of the State to interfere in Federation matters would be quite wrong, now, wouldn't it? Of course, it's not terribly uncommon for valiant officers, Gallente or otherwise, to meet quite unfortunate ends in any number of... well, mishaps. Yes, {[character]player.name}, it's not uncommon at all, is it? So I'm sure things will work themselves out somehow.

Anyhow, your mission. Well, this is quite embarrassing... I've completely forgotten any mission I might have had for you. Come to think of it, I've forgotten everything I was just talking about. Goodness, I think I'd better go lie down for a while.

But... I don't suppose you could look after my datapad here while I rest? It's quite important, you see, for it has the current coordinates of one of those promising Federation individuals, one of the ones we just discussed. And I wouldn't want that to fall into the wrong hands, now, would I?

And you... you look like you could use a break, too. Maybe a leisurely cruise out into space somewhere nearby, a chance to relax and, oh, I don't know, enjoy some scenery? Maybe pay someone a visit? And by the time I wake up, maybe my worries will have taken care of themselves, hmm?

Your agent's datapad has given you the coordinates to one of the competitors of your agent's "friend" in the Gallente Navy. Your "mission" once you arrive there should be abundantly clear.
messages.zh:
我有个朋友遇到了非常麻烦的情况。本来他应当被升职的，你知道。更确切的说是他将会被提升，如果在他之前没有别的更适合人选的话。所谓更适合的人选，说实在的，我想要是他们出了什么事情的话，他们的上司肯定会非常想念他们的。

无论怎样，你看，他们都是盖伦特官员，任何共和国代理人插手盖伦特的事物都是非常错误的行为，是吗。当然，这样的事情在那些勇敢的军官里面是常有的，不管是不是盖伦特，遇上这样的意外事件都是非常不幸的。是啊，{[character]player.name}，这完全不寻常，是吗？我肯定车到山前必有路。

无论怎样，让我来告诉你的任务吧。恩，这是件很尴尬的事情……我完全忘记了我曾给过你的任何任务，想想看，我几乎忘了刚刚我说的所有东西。天啊，我想我得去躺躺。

但……我想你不会趁我睡着的时候偷看我的数据版吧？上面记得有那些联邦的优秀人才，就是刚才我们所谈到的。我不想要那些泄漏到错误的人手里，对么？

还有你……你看起来也应该休息休息，找一艘娱乐游轮，到附近的星系去转转，放松放松，看看风景？也可以去拜访一下某些人？等我醒来的时候，或许我的担心已经完全不解自灭了，是么？

你的代理人的数据版给你了一个坐标，他是盖伦特海军里面你的代理人的那个朋友的竞争对手。当你到了那个地方自然会明白你的“任务”具体是要做什么。

messages.en: It's good to see you so well rested, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm afraid I have some bad news: I've lost your datapad, the one with the coordinates on it? Oh, and I fear that a certain Gallente captain may have run into some trouble as well.
messages.zh: 你看上去很精神，{[character]agentID.name}。我想我有些坏消息，我把你的数据板弄丢了，就是那个有坐标的数据板。恩，当然还有某个盖伦特的上尉也遇到了些麻烦。

messages.en: Is that so? Dear me... that's quite unfortunate. I am terribly sorry to hear it, {[character]player.name}. Here, take this compensation for the concern you must also be feeling; hopefully it will ease your mind somewhat.
messages.zh: 是那样么？天啊……那真是太不幸了。我真是非常的抱歉，{[character]player.name}。 来，这里是些对你的关心的回报；希望能够让你好受一点。

messages.en: What the hell are you yammering on about?! I 'm going to go wash down a few Starsi and leave you to your rest. You apparently need it.
messages.zh: 你到底在叫个什么？我不管你了。

messages.en: Yes, of course, please forgive me. I'll just get some rest now. Do close the door on your way out. <sigh>
messages.zh: 是啊，当然。请原谅我，我得要休息休息。走的时候请关上门（谈起）

messages.en:
The corporations of the State have many friends, as you know... many friends in many interesting and useful places. Why is this relevant, you ask? Well, it's not at all… it was merely an idle thought I had today that I wanted to impart upon you.

But actually, now I come to think about the topic of friends… I am reminded of a particular friend of mine in a very difficult situation. He's due for a promotion, you see. More accurately, he would be if there weren't a few other promising individuals ahead of him in line. Such promising individuals, indeed, that I am sure their superiors would miss them dearly if anything were to happen to them. But it would be very, er, helpful... for me — for us — if this friend of ours were to get what he wants.

However, you see, they are all Gallente officers, and for any agent of the State to interfere in Federation matters would be quite wrong, now, wouldn't it? Of course, with all the random third party violence these days, it's not terribly uncommon for valiant officers, Gallente or otherwise, to meet quite unfortunate ends in any number of... well, mishaps. Yes, {[character]player.name}, it's not uncommon at all, is it? So I'm sure things will work themselves out somehow.

Anyhow, your mission. Right. Well, this is quite embarrassing... I've completely forgotten any mission I might have had for you. Come to think of it, I've forgotten everything I was just talking about. Goodness, I think I better go and lie down for a while.

But... I don't suppose you could look after my datapad here while I rest? It's quite important, you see, for it has the current coordinates of one of those promising Federation individuals, one of the ones we just discussed. And I wouldn't want that to fall into the wrong hands, now, would I?

And you... you look like you could use a break, too. Maybe a leisurely cruise out into space somewhere nearby, a chance to relax and, oh, I don't know, enjoy some scenery? Maybe pay someone a visit? And by the time I wake up, maybe my worries will have taken care of themselves, hmm?
messages.zh:
共和国的很多军团和企业里面都有我的朋友，这一点你是知道的……各种各样不同用途和目的的朋友。如果你要问这有什么关系，其实没有什么关系。这只是今天突然想起来要传授给你的一个道理。

但实际上，我现在开始考虑朋友这个问题，我所提到的那个正处于窘境之中的朋友。我有个朋友遇到了非常麻烦的情况。本来他应当被升职的，你知道。更确切的说是他将会被提升，如果在他之前没有别的更适合人选的话。所谓更适合的人选，说实在的，我想要是他们出了什么事情的话，他们的上司肯定会非常想念他们的。

无论怎样，你看，他们都是盖伦特官员，任何共和国代理人插手盖伦特的事物都是非常错误的行为，是吗。当然，这样的事情在那些勇敢的军官里面是常有的，不管是不是盖伦特，遇上这样的意外事件都是非常不幸的。是啊，{[character]player.name}，这完全不寻常，是吗？我肯定车到山前必有路。

无论怎样，让我来告诉你的任务吧。恩，这是件很尴尬的事情……我完全忘记了我曾给过你的任何任务，想想看，我几乎忘了刚刚我说的所有东西。天啊，我想我得去躺躺。

但……我想你不会趁我睡着的时候偷看我的数据版吧？上面记得有那些联邦的优秀人才，就是刚才我们所谈到的。我不想要那些泄漏到错误的人手里，对么？

还有你……你看起来也应该休息休息，找一艘娱乐游轮，到附近的星系去转转，放松放松，看看风景？也可以去拜访一下某些人？等我醒来的时候，或许我的担心已经完全不解自灭了，是么？

messages.en: You seem to have forgotten what I was talking about too, {[character]player.name}! Ah well, perhaps it was a conversation best left forgotten.
messages.zh: 看来你也忘记了我所说的事情。{[character]player.name}！很好，也许我们的这段对话应该永远被遗忘。

messages.en: Our conversation
messages.zh: 我们的对话

messages.en: I just wanted to let you know that I too forgot everything you were talking about. Seems that now we both forgot, hmm? Guess I'll come back for a real mission later.
messages.zh: 我只是想告诉你，我也忘记你所说的所有事情了。看起来我们两都忘记了？我想我会回来找你要真正的任务的。

messages.en: Strange, isn't it.... how someone can just completely forget about a conversation? Though some conversations are best left forgotten, right, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 奇怪，这不是……人怎么可能就这么随意的把说过的话给忘了呢？尽管有些对话我们还是忘掉的好，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: I'm afraid that my datapad went missing on your watch, {[character]player.name}. It is an unfortunate thing, very unfortunate indeed. I'm afraid, also, that I'll have to hold you responsible for its contents and any action--or in this case, inaction--they might have inspired.
messages.zh: 恐怕我的数据板就在你的眼皮底下消失掉了，{[character]player.name}。真是不幸，太不幸了。我觉得你必须对此事造成的后果负责。

messages.en: My datapad?
messages.zh: 我的数据板？

messages.en: Yes, just get some rest {[character]agentID.name}. Don't you worry, I'll take good care of your friend's problem for you.
messages.zh: 是的，得要休息休息，{[character]agentID.name}。 别担心，我会帮你的朋友解决这点问题的。

messages.en: Oh, you will? That's so very kind of you, {[character]player.name}. Perhaps we can talk again later, after I've had a little nap.
messages.zh: 噢，你会？你真是太好了{[character]player.name}。也许过些时候我们能再谈谈，等我睡一觉。

messages.en: I'm ready to serve in any way I can.
messages.zh: 我已经准备好为你效劳了。

messages.en:
I have a friend in a very difficult situation. He's due for a promotion, you see. More accurately, he would be if there weren't a few other promising individuals ahead of him in line. Such promising individuals, indeed, that I am sure their superiors would miss them dearly if anything were to happen to them.

However, you see, they are all Gallente officers, and for any agent of the State to interfere in Federation matters would be quite wrong, now, wouldn't it? Of course, it's not terribly uncommon for valiant officers, Gallente or otherwise, to meet quite unfortunate ends in any number of... well, mishaps. Yes, {[character]player.name}, it's not uncommon at all, is it? So I'm sure things will work themselves out somehow.

Anyhow, your mission. Well, this is quite embarrassing... I've completely forgotten any mission I might have had for you. Come to think of it, I've forgotten everything I was just talking about. Goodness, I think I'd better go lie down for a while.

But... I don't suppose you could look after my datapad here while I rest? It's quite important, you see, for it has the current coordinates of one of those promising Federation individuals, one of the ones we just discussed. And I wouldn't want that to fall into the wrong hands, now, would I?

And you... you look like you could use a break, too. Maybe a leisurely cruise out into space somewhere nearby, a chance to relax and, oh, I don't know, enjoy some scenery? Maybe pay someone a visit? And by the time I wake up, maybe my worries will have taken care of themselves, hmm?

Your agent's datapad has given you the coordinates to one of the competitors of your agent's "friend" in the Gallente Navy. Your "mission" once you arrive there should be abundantly clear.
messages.zh:
我有个朋友遇到了非常麻烦的情况。本来他应当被升职的，你知道。更确切的说是他将会被提升，如果在他之前没有别的更适合人选的话。所谓更适合的人选，说实在的，我想要是他们出了什么事情的话，他们的上司肯定会非常想念他们的。

无论怎样，你看，他们都是盖伦特官员，任何共和国代理人插手盖伦特的事物都是非常错误的行为，是吗。当然，这样的事情在那些勇敢的军官里面是常有的，不管是不是盖伦特，遇上这样的意外事件都是非常不幸的。是啊，{[character]player.name}，这完全不寻常，是吗？我肯定车到山前必有路。

无论怎样，让我来告诉你的任务吧。恩，这是件很尴尬的事情……我完全忘记了我曾给过你的任何任务，想想看，我几乎忘了刚刚我说的所有东西。天啊，我想我得去躺躺。

但……我想你不会趁我睡着的时候偷看我的数据版吧？上面记得有那些联邦的优秀人才，就是刚才我们所谈到的。我不想要那些泄漏到错误的人手里，对么？

还有你……你看起来也应该休息休息，找一艘娱乐游轮，到附近的星系去转转，放松放松，看看风景？也可以去拜访一下某些人？等我醒来的时候，或许我的担心已经完全不解自灭了，是么？

你的代理人的数据版给你了一个坐标，他是盖伦特海军里面你的代理人的那个朋友的竞争对手。当你到了那个地方自然会明白你的“任务”具体是要做什么。

messages.en: It's good to see you so well rested, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm afraid I have some bad news: I've lost your datapad, the one with the coordinates on it? Oh, and I fear that a certain Gallente Vice Admiral may have run into some trouble as well.
messages.zh: 你看上去很精神，{[character]agentID.name}。我想我有些坏消息，我把你的数据板弄丢了，就是那个有坐标的数据板。恩，当然还有某个盖伦特的中将也遇到了些麻烦。

messages.en: Is that so? Dear me... that's quite unfortunate. I am terribly sorry to hear it, {[character]player.name}. Here, take this compensation for the concern you must also be feeling; hopefully it will ease your mind somewhat.
messages.zh: 是那样么？天啊……那真是太不幸了。我真是非常的抱歉，{[character]player.name}。 来，这里是些对你的关心的回报；希望能够让你好受一点。

messages.en: What the hell are you yammering on about?! I 'm going to go wash down a few Starsi and leave you to your rest. You apparently need it.
messages.zh: 你到底在叫个什么？我不管你了。

messages.en: Yes, of course, please forgive me. I'll just get some rest now. Do close the door on your way out. <sigh>
messages.zh: 是啊，当然。请原谅我，我得要休息休息。走的时候请关上门（谈起）

messages.en:
The corporations of the State have many friends, as you know... many friends in many interesting and useful places. Why is this relevant, you ask? Well, it's not at all... it was merely an idle thought I had today that I wanted to impart upon you.

But actually, now I come to think about the topic of friends... I am reminded of a particular friend of mine in a very difficult situation. He's due for a promotion, you see. More accurately, he would be if there weren't a few other promising individuals ahead of him in line. Such promising individuals, indeed, that I am sure their superiors would miss them dearly if anything were to happen to them. But it would be very, er, helpful... for me--for us--if this friend of ours were to get what he wants.

However, you see, they are all Gallente officers, and for any agent of the State to interfere in Federation matters would be quite wrong, now, wouldn't it? Of course, with all the random third party violence these days, it's not terribly uncommon for valiant officers, Gallente or otherwise, to meet quite unfortunate ends in any number of... well, mishaps. Yes, {[character]player.name}, it's not uncommon at all, is it? So I'm sure things will work themselves out somehow.

Anyhow, your mission. Right. Well, this is quite embarrassing... I've completely forgotten any mission I might have had for you. Come to think of it, I've forgotten everything I was just talking about. Goodness, I think I better go and lie down for a while.

But... I don't suppose you could look after my datapad here while I rest? It's quite important, you see, for it has the current coordinates of one of those promising Federation individuals, one of the ones we just discussed. And I wouldn't want that to fall into the wrong hands, now, would I?

And you... you look like you could use a break, too. Maybe a leisurely cruise out into space somewhere nearby, a chance to relax and, oh, I don't know, enjoy some scenery? Maybe pay someone a visit? And by the time I wake up, maybe my worries will have taken care of themselves, hmm?
messages.zh:
合众国的很多军团里面都有我的朋友，这一点你是知道的…各种各样、不同行业的朋友。你要问这有什么关系？其实没有什么关系…这只是今天突然想起来要传授给你的一个道理。

但实际上，我现在开始考虑朋友这个问题，特别是我想起来，有一位朋友正处于窘境之中。本来他应当被提拔的。更准确的说，是他将被提拔，如果在他之前没有别的更适合人选的话。所谓这些更适合的人选，说实在的，我想要是他们出了什么事情的话，他们的上司肯定会非常想念他们的。但如果我们这位朋友能心想事成的话，那对我，对我们，都是件好事。

无论怎样，你看，他们都是盖伦特官员，任何合众国代理人插手盖伦特的事物都是非常错误的行为，对吧？不过，鉴于 最近经常发生随机第三方暴力事件，因此不管是不是盖伦特人，一旦遇上这样的倒霉事，应该都不能算一个太大的意外。嗯嗯，压根儿不算是意外，对吧，{[character]player.name}？所以我想这种事应该不用我们操心，自己会解决的。

无论怎样，你的任务。好吧。真是很尴尬呀……我完全忘记了我曾给过你任何任务。我几乎忘了刚刚我说的所有东西。神哪，我想我得去躺一会儿。

但…我感觉你是不会在我睡觉的时候替我照看我的数据板的吧？上面记录着一位联邦的优秀人才，就是刚才我们所谈到的那个人，目前所在的位置。我怎么会让那东西落入不该落入的人手里呢？

还有你…你看起来也应该休息一下。找一艘娱乐游轮，到附近的星系去转转，放松放松，看看风景？顺便去拜访某人？等我醒来的时候，或许我的担心已经完全自行消失了，嗯？

messages.en: You seem to have forgotten what I was talking about too, {[character]player.name}! Ah well, perhaps it was a conversation best left forgotten.
messages.zh: 看来你也忘记了我所说的事情。{[character]player.name}！很好，也许我们的这段对话应该永远被遗忘。

messages.en: Our conversation
messages.zh: 我们的对话

messages.en: I just wanted to let you know that I too forgot everything you were talking about. Seems that now we both forgot, hmm? Guess I'll come back for a real mission later.
messages.zh: 我只是想告诉你，我也忘记你所说的所有事情了。看起来我们两都忘记了？我想我会回来找你要真正的任务的。

messages.en: Strange, isn't it.... how someone can just completely forget about a conversation? Though some conversations are best left forgotten, right, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 奇怪，这不是……人怎么可能就这么随意的把说过的话给忘了呢？尽管有些对话我们还是忘掉的好，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: I'm afraid that my datapad went missing on your watch, {[character]player.name}. It is an unfortunate thing, very unfortunate indeed. I'm afraid, also, that I'll have to hold you responsible for its contents and any action--or in this case, inaction--they might have inspired.
messages.zh: 恐怕我的数据板就在你的眼皮底下消失掉了，{[character]player.name}。真是不幸，太不幸了。我觉得你必须对此事造成的后果负责。

messages.en: My datapad?
messages.zh: 我的数据板？

messages.en: I'll bring back those citizens, don't you worry.
messages.zh: 别担心，我会我们同胞带回来的。

messages.en: Good, good. I like your spirit. That's why I asked you to do this job.
messages.zh: 很好很好，我欣赏你这样的态度。这也解释了我为什么要让你来做这件事的原因。

messages.en: You better believe I would!
messages.zh: 绝对想！

messages.en:
An Amarrian Holder we've suspected for some time of black market slave trading has overstepped his bounds and nabbed a few Gallente citizens for his slave pens. You must stop him. He thinks he's getting away unnoticed, but I want you to prove him wrong.

Destroy this scumbag's ship and bring those slaves back to me, {[character]player.name}. We'll make sure they are returned to their homes. After they pay back their transport fees, that is.

You will need a well-armed frigate to accomplish this mission. The slave ship is probably armed, and might have escorts as well.
messages.zh:
我们长期以来一直怀疑一位艾玛官员身陷黑市劳工交易活动。最近他吃了豹子胆，竟敢抓起我们盖伦特人来了。你必须掐掉他。他觉得他可以逃之夭夭，但我要你证明他是错的。

{[character]player.name}，去把这人渣灭了，然后把被绑劳工带回来。我们会让他们各自重返家园的，但前提是他们得把回家车费给付了。

你需要一支全副武装的护卫舰来完成此项任务。那劳工船可能带火炮，而且还可能有护卫。

messages.en: Alright, I'm back. One less slaver to worry about, assuming he didn't have a clone, and a bunch of Gallenteans happy to be home.
messages.zh: 好了我回来了。但愿那官员没有克隆，这样世界上就又少了个劳工贩子。那帮盖伦特人很高兴重回故里。

messages.en: Excellent. I'm sure those poor, unwashed people would shower you with gratitude. But first, let's see that they have showers of their own, eh?
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。我相信那些未洗澡的穷人会暴风骤雨般地向你表示感谢的。不过我看还是先让他们洗个澡吧。

messages.en:
Amarrian society, a religious oligarchy, relies on slaves to do nearly all of its manual labor and servant work. Of course, Gallenteans despise this practice. Honest workers should be given an honest wage, not kept in bondage.

Amarr's slaves are often taken wherever they can be found. Citizens of the Gallente Federation, as any other nation, sometimes find themselves locked in Amarrian slave collars. Most of the time, there is little to be done about it, especially if the slaves were kidnapped in low-security or otherwise lightly policed areas of space.
messages.zh:
艾玛社会是个宗教集权组织，她依靠大量的劳工来干几乎所有的体力活以及让这些劳工作伺佣。盖伦特对此自然十分鄙弃。他们认为真正的工人应该享有正常工资，不受任何强制绑定。

艾玛雇佣劳工的方法通常是见一批抓一批。像其他国家的公民一样，盖伦特联邦的公民有时也被艾玛抓去充奴。多数情况下人们对此都无能为力，尤其是当劳工都被关押在低安全区或其他警力薄弱的区域时。

messages.en: Amarrian Slavery
messages.zh: 艾玛的劳工制

messages.en:
Alright, then. An Amarrian Holder we've suspected for some time of black market slave trading has overstepped his bounds and nabbed a few loyal Gallente citizens for his slave pens. You must stop him. He thinks he's getting away unnoticed, but I want you to prove him wrong.

Destroy this scumbag's ship and bring those slaves back to me, {[character]player.name}. We'll make sure they are returned to their homes. After they pay back their transport fees, that is.
messages.zh:
那很好。我们长期以来一直怀疑一位艾玛官员身陷黑市劳工交易活动。最近他吃了豹子胆，竟敢抓起我们盖伦特人来了。你必须掐掉他。他觉得他可以逃之夭夭，但我要你证明他是错的。

{[character]player.name}，去把这人渣灭了，然后把被绑劳工带回来。我们会让他们各自重返家园的，但前提是他们得把回家车费给付了。

{[character]player.name}， 由于你懒，那恶心的艾玛人已经成功地带着一帮盖伦特公民逃脱了！你本应可以阻止他的！你作为飞行员还能混到现在真是项奇迹。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Gallente prisoners
messages.zh: 盖伦特被关押人

{[character]player.name}， 由于你懒，那恶心的艾玛人已经成功地带着一帮盖伦特公民逃脱了！你本应可以阻止他的！你作为飞行员还能混到现在真是项奇迹。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Gallente prisoners
messages.zh: 盖伦特被关押人

name.de: Eine Railgun-Salve sagt mehr als tausend Worte
name.en: A Railgun Charge Is Worth a Thousand Words
name.es: Una carga de cañón electromagnético vale más que mil palabras
name.fr: Une charge de canon vaut mieux qu'un long discours
name.ja: 百聞はレールガン攻撃にしかず
name.ko: 수천 단어의 가치를 가진 레일건 한 발
name.ru: Заряд рейлгана стоит тысячи слов (A Railgun Charge Is Worth a Thousand Words)
name.zh: 一颗磁轨炮的弹丸就能取代千言万语

messages.en: Very well. It ain't over till... well, er, till the fat man is dead.
messages.zh: 很好。这事得等那肥猪死了才算了。

messages.en: Indeed. Good luck out there.
messages.zh: 是啊。祝你顺利。

messages.en: Uh, okay. Fair enough. Care to explain what's on your mind, though?
messages.zh: 哦，行啊。蛮有道理的。但你能透露一下那更重要的事吗？

messages.en:
Pisharpar Corilian is one of the most renowned Amarrian poets of all time. He is also a spy. He has been on a "book tour" of Gallente space for several months now, and our suspicions were confirmed when we tracked a coded transmission coming from his pleasure yacht. We believe he has had secret data chips implanted within his massive rolls of flesh, where he can hide all sorts of sensitive information.

We cannot tolerate this blatant abuse of the arts! We want him terminated immediately… but it must look like piracy. That's where you come in. He is currently traveling to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Warp in, blast him and his entourage to smithereens, and warp out. Simple.

Now, it's likely that a man this respected in Amarrian society has a clone, but at least we'll have destroyed whatever information he's gathered into his data-ridden body. Take care of him, and you'll be doing us all a great favor.
messages.zh:
佩斯哈佩·科乐林是艾玛最著名的诗人之一。他很有才，却有着诗人的通病：放纵、傲慢，还神经质——以为自己是飞天的神仙。这家伙特别肥，路都走不动，只能坐在一个飞行椅上转悠。

他同时还是个间谍。他在盖伦特领域里已经开展了为时数月的“书展”。我们有一次从他邮轮上探测到了加密信号传输，从此确定他的间谍身份。我们相信他把隐秘的数据芯片藏在了他那堆厚脂肪下面，那里适合他藏机密信息。

我们不能容忍这种对艺术的亵渎！我们要立即结果他……但这一切得弄得看上去像是海盗所为才行。这也正是我要你来的原因。他目前正飞往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。你要跃迁过去，把他及他的手下碎尸万段，然后再跃迁回来。很简单。

当然，像他这样一个在艾玛帝国中地位崇高的人很可能有个克隆，但至少我们能把他那暗藏数据的肥肉身给炸碎。把他解决掉，你就帮了我们一个大忙。

messages.en: Chalk up one large, whiny poet. Clone or no, that was a surprising pleasure, I must admit.
messages.zh: 干掉了一个肥大，大嘴巴的诗人。不管他有没有克隆，这事都令人愉快。

messages.en: Nice work. When news gets out, of course, it will be a "terrible act of piracy"… but in the meantime I think we can drink a toast to that whining bastard's bloated, frozen corpse.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。新闻里肯定会说这是一起“令人厌恶的海盗行为”……与此同时，我将喝上一杯，为那渣子的尸首干杯。

messages.en: But I myself am a great patron of the arts! I love his work!! I can't kill him!
messages.zh: 我是艺术迷！我爱他的作品！！我不能对他下手！
