messages.en: Wow, I would never have thought…. Well, I hope I can find someone else to handle this on such short notice.
messages.zh: 哇，真想不到……好吧，但愿我能在这么短的时间内找到另一个人来处理这事。

messages.en:
This, {[character]player.name}: All the great nations in the galaxy have long allowed each other to travel freely in pursuit of commerce, but I've just heard a story that makes me think this time of freedom is near its end.

Pisharpar Corilian is one of Amarr's most renowned poets of all time. He is gifted, but a typical example of a poet. He's effete, arrogant, and overly sensitive — always with his head in the clouds and his feet floating half a meter off the floor. In Corilian's case, this is literal: So obese that his legs can no longer support his weight, he uses a hoverchair to get around.

He is also a spy. He has been on a "book tour" of Gallente space for several months now, and our suspicions were confirmed when we tracked a coded transmission coming from his pleasure yacht. We believe he has had secret data chips implanted within his massive rolls of flesh, where he can hide all sorts of sensitive information.

We cannot tolerate this blatant abuse of the arts! We want him terminated immediately… but it must look like piracy. That's where you come in. He is currently traveling to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Warp in, blast him and his entourage to smithereens, and warp out. Simple.

Now, it's likely that a man this respected in Amarrian society has a clone, but at least we'll have destroyed whatever information he's gathered into his data-ridden body. Take care of him, and you'll be doing us all a great favor — both politically and artistically... (If you've never read his work, you'll have to take my word for it.)
messages.zh:
事情是这样，{[character]player.name}：出于商业考虑，宇宙中所有伟大的国家都允许对方公民自由出入，但我刚听到一则故事，让我觉得这样的自由就快到头了。

佩斯哈佩·科乐林是艾玛最著名的诗人之一。他很有才，却有着诗人的通病：放纵、傲慢，还神经质——以为自己是飞天的神仙。这家伙特别肥，路都走不动，只能坐在一个飞行椅上转悠。

他同时还是个间谍。他在盖伦特领域里已经开展了为时数月的“书展”。我们有一次从他邮轮上探测到了加密信号传输，从此确定他的间谍身份。我们相信他把隐秘的数据芯片藏在了他那堆厚脂肪下面，那里适合他藏机密信息。

我们不能容忍这种对艺术的亵渎！我们要立即结果他……但这一切得弄得看上去像是海盗所为才行。这也正是我要你来的原因。他目前正飞往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。你要跃迁过去，把他及他的手下碎尸万段，然后再跃迁回来。很简单。

当然，像他这样一个在艾玛帝国中地位崇高的人很可能有个克隆，但至少我们能把他那暗藏数据的肥肉身给炸碎。把他解决掉，你就帮了我们一个大忙——不管是从政治意义上讲还是艺术角度上看……（如果你从没阅读过他的作品，那你就相信我的话好了。）

{[character]player.name}，

由于你的慵懒，我不得不找了一个更有才更具良知的人来接手这项重要任务。或许你不是个能在危险时刻为联邦出力的人。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: The spy
messages.zh: 间谍

messages.en: Find somebody else to do this. I have better things to do than hunt down some stupid poet, even if he is a spy.
messages.zh: 让别人去干。即使他是个间谍，我也有比追捕他更重要的事要看。

messages.en: You can't handle one pitiful, overweight poet? What kind of capsuleer are you?
messages.zh: 你连一个可怜的肥胖诗人也对付不了？你算什么飞行员？

{[character]player.name}，

由于你的慵懒，我不得不找了一个更有才更具良知的人来接手这项重要任务。或许你不是个能在危险时刻为联邦出力的人。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: The spy
messages.zh: 间谍

messages.en: I'm the capsuleer for this job. Just tell me where to find that ship.
messages.zh: 除了我之外还能有谁？快把那船的位置告诉我。

messages.en: I'm uploading you the coordinates as we speak. Your target will not be in this area for long, though, so don't dally.
messages.zh: 我正在上传位标。你的目标不会在此地久留，因此动作要快。

messages.en: Wow, great news! How can I help?
messages.zh: 哇，好消息啊！你要我怎么做？

messages.en:
An informant within the Amarrian Empire has given us a break in our long quest to find the cure for the slave drug, Vitoc. A sample of their most recent version of the drug has been ... diverted to be transported on an industrial ship passing near Gallente space. If we move quickly, we can intercept the industrial ship, steal its top secret cargo, and it will all be blamed on pirates.

Destroy the industrial ship and bring the Vitoc to me.

Amarrian convoys are well guarded when they pass near Gallente space. Be prepared for a fight.
messages.zh:
长久以来我们一直想找到对付奴役药品——崴砣柯——的解药，现在我们安插在艾玛内部的线人向我们提供了一条重要情报。有一艘艾玛工业舰正在穿越盖伦特领域，它上面运载着崴砣柯的最新品。如果我们动作够快，那就可以把那艘船截下来，带走里面的货物，然后我们可以把这一切都归咎于海盗行为。

你的任务就是摧毁那艘工业舰，然后把崴砣柯带给我。

穿越盖伦特领域的艾玛运输队一般都配有很强的护驾。要做好面对一场硬仗的准备。

messages.en: Alright – those Amarr creeps never knew what hit them, and I've got the Vitoc samples right here.
messages.zh: 干完了。那帮艾玛人连怎么死的都不知道，我已经把崴砣柯样品带来了。

messages.en: Excellent work. I'm glad we can depend on you. Our scientists will want to see this stuff as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。我就知道你靠得住。我们的科学家正迫切着想看一下这东西呢。

messages.en: I don't care all that much about any Amarrian slaves. I mean, sure, slavery's bad… but risk my ship over it? No, thanks.
messages.zh: 我对艾玛的劳工不关心。虽然劳工制不好，但想让我冒险用船去摧毁它？还是免了吧。

messages.en: I see. Showing your true colors, eh? Well, I just hope I can find a pilot with a sense of moral propriety for this job.
messages.zh: 我懂了，露出本性了是吧？好吧，我去找一个道德标准合乎此事的人。

messages.en:
The toxic chemical known as Vitoc is the preferred method Amarrians use to control their slaves. The drug is injected into the slaves, and the slaves must work to retrieve a periodic dose of antidote to the poison. Gallente scientists, among others, have been chasing the formula for Vitoc for years, but without success. The drug behaves in many ways like a virus.

If one could find the cure, the entire Amarrian economy might be crippled… assuming that cure could somehow be supplied to a sufficient number of their slaves.
messages.zh:
众人知晓的崴砣柯化学违规药品是艾玛人最喜欢用来控制劳工的药物。该药物注入一个劳工体内之后，他必须为艾玛工作以换取短效解毒剂。多年来盖伦特科学家和其他人一样，都千方百计地想把崴砣柯的化学方程式弄到手，但至今未果。该药物和病毒有许多相像之处。

如果有人可以找到解药的话，那艾玛整个经济估计就要垮了……当然前提是有大量劳工可以获得这样的解药。

messages.en: Vitoc
messages.zh: 崴砣柯

messages.en:
An informant within the Empire has given us a break in our long quest to find a counter for the slavers' drug, Vitoc. A sample of their most recent version of the drug has been… diverted, to be transported on an industrial ship passing through Gallente space. If we move quickly, we can intercept the ship and steal its cargo, and — the best part? — it will all be blamed on pirates.

Destroy the industrial ship and bring the Vitoc to me. Can you do it?
messages.zh:
长久以来我们一直想找到对付奴役药品——崴砣柯——的解药，现在我们安插在艾玛内部的线人向我们提供了一条重要情报。有一艘艾玛工业舰正在穿越盖伦特领域，它上面运载着崴砣柯的最新品。如果我们动作够快，那就可以把那艘船截下来，带走里面的货物，而且更好的是，我们可以把这一切都归咎于海盗行为。

你的任务就是摧毁那艘工业舰，然后把崴砣柯带给我。你行吗？

messages.en: That Vitoc shipment
messages.zh: 那批崴砣柯货物

messages.en: I just don't have time for this Vitoc mission. You'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我没时间干这事。你去找别人吧。

messages.en: This was a golden opportunity to strike a serious blow against Amarr slavery! Have you no guts at all?
messages.zh: 这可是我们对艾玛劳工制度给予一次重大打击的黄金机会啊！你是不是个胆小鬼？

messages.en: That Vitoc shipment
messages.zh: 那批崴砣柯货物

messages.en: I'm on my way.
messages.zh: 我马上出发。

messages.en: Splendid. Don't waste a second.
messages.zh: 好极了，别浪费时间。

messages.en: Okay, sounds good. What is it?
messages.zh: 好的，听起来不错，那是什么？

messages.en:
We have a research scientist currently in a small, secret outpost near here; he's originally Caldari, but he recognized the error of his upbringing and came over to our side after the war. More importantly, though, he's on the verge of a breakthrough in a high-priority weapons technology project. And likely as a direct result of that research, we think someone's trying to kill him. He has requested secure transport out of there, and we can't risk losing him.

Head over to the location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and bring him back here to me, will you? This mission requires the utmost secrecy, so don't tell anyone where you're going or say anything about your passenger. Got it? He's an important man, and there will be a decent bonus if you get him here discreetly and quickly.
messages.zh:
我们在附近的一个小型秘密哨站里有一位科学家；他原本是加达里人，但是后来意识到了他所受的错误的教育，并在战后投奔了我们这边。更重要的是，他正处于一项研发高优先级的武器的技术突破边缘。并且，我们相信正有人尝试行刺他，从而破坏我们的研究工作。他已经要求安全地转移出那个地区，同时，我们也不能冒失去他的风险。

前去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}并把他带回来见我，你能做到吗？这个任务要求保证最高机密，所以别告诉任何人你将去哪里，以及任何有关你的乘客的信息，理解吗？他是个重要的人，因此如果你能把他小心且快捷地带回来，将会得到丰厚的奖励。

messages.en: Looks like your scientist has had, er, a… bit of a setback. Too bad about that.  Hope he had a good clone ready.
messages.zh: 看起来你的科学家已经...呃...对于研究是有点延误。那真是太糟糕了。真希望他已经有个完整的克隆体。

messages.en: Well done. You're a resourceful capsuleer. And yes, never fear — we take care of our own.
messages.zh: 做得好。你是个足智多谋的飞行员。嗯是的，永远别担心——我们各管各的。

messages.en: Let him find his own ride. My time is too valuable to spend it ferrying around some egghead.
messages.zh: 让他自己搭车吧。我那宝贵的时间可不能浪费在这些理论派的身上。

messages.en: Oh, I see. Matters of national importance are too dreary for you, eh? I see it all too clearly…
messages.zh: 哦我知道。国家大事对你来说实在是太沉闷了，不是吗？我实在太清楚这一点了...

messages.en: Sometimes a mission might not turn out the way you anticipated. You might have incomplete information from your agent, and conditions can change during the mission. Such changes are generally communicated to you directly, either through a direct pop-up window when using an acceleration gate or by means of a text message appearing in your local chat channel.
messages.zh: 有时候一个任务并不会像你预期的那样发展。你可能从你的代理人那里得到了不完整的信息，并且环境也会随着任务的进行而发生变化。这些变化通常直接影响到你，不是通过当你使用加速轨道的时候弹出的一个窗口，便是通过出现在你本地聊天频道的一条文本信息。

messages.en: Things Change
messages.zh: 事态变化

messages.en:
We have a research scientist currently in a small, secret outpost near here; he's originally Caldari, but he recognized the error of his upbringing and came over to our side after the war. More importantly, though, he's on the verge of a breakthrough in a high-priority weapons technology project. And likely as a direct result of that research, we think someone's trying to kill him. He has requested secure transport out of there, and we can't risk losing him.

Head over to the location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and bring him back here to me, will you? This mission requires the utmost secrecy, so don't tell anyone where you're going or say anything about your passenger. Got it? He's an important man, and there will be a decent bonus if you get him here discreetly and quickly.
messages.zh:
我们在附近的一个小型秘密哨站里有一位科学家；他原本是加达里人，但是后来意识到了他所受的错误的教育，并在战后投奔了我们这边。更重要的是，他正处于一项研发高优先级的武器的技术突破边缘。并且，我们相信正有人尝试行刺他，从而破坏我们的研究工作。他已经要求安全地转移出那个地区，同时，我们也不能冒失去他的风险。

前去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}并把他带回来见我，你能做到吗？这个任务要求保证最高机密，所以别告诉任何人你将去哪里，以及任何有关你的乘客的信息，理解吗？他是个重要的人，因此如果你能把他小心且快捷地带回来，将会得到丰厚的奖励。

{[character]player.name},

因为你的失职，似乎有一群加达里特工已经成功潜入我们内部。不仅如此，他们还摧毁了整个哨站，以及其中一切正在进行的研究工作。这是个巨大的延误，这一切都不怪你，做得好，做得好。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Terrible news
messages.zh: 可怕的消息

messages.en: You know, on second thought, let this lapdog scientist of yours find his own ride.
messages.zh: 你知道，再三思考之后，还是让你的这个小狗般的科学家自己搭车回去吧。

messages.en: You can't be serious…!? Such a lack of initiative looks quite bad, my friend. Quite bad indeed.
messages.zh: 你不是当真的吧……？！如此缺乏主动性真是糟糕透了。我的朋友，你太糟了。

{[character]player.name},

我找了另一个愿意做这件事的人。你所失去的变成了别人所得到的。你的帐户本该塞满星币的。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Missed our chance
messages.zh: 良机已逝

name.ja: 破壊された夢のクリスタル

messages.en: This madman will never plant his bomb. Or see another sunrise, for that matter.
messages.zh: 这疯子没法安放他的炸弹。我不会让他见到第二天的太阳的。

messages.en: That's precisely what I wanted to hear. I'm glad we understand one another. Don't waste any time.
messages.zh: 这正是我要听的回答。我很高兴我们都能明白对方的心思。行动要快。

messages.en: Okay, I'm officially intrigued. What's up?
messages.zh: OK，你把我胃口吊起来了。到底是什么事？

messages.en:
We have received word from an informant that an Amarrian terrorist, some religious zealot, is planning to plant a nuclear bomb somewhere on the Crystal Boulevard. Even though the structures of the crystal buildings are hardened against attack, a blast like that would kill thousands, not to mention shutting down the Boulevard — which, I needn't stress, would cause untold losses in profits.

Fortunately, we've just gotten intelligence regarding the lunatic's current whereabouts. Head out to these coordinates in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and stop this madman from executing his scheme.

Keep in mind though, {[character]player.name}, you must exercise a little stealth in approach. You will need to fly something smaller than a Battleship. Beyond that one restriction, I don't really care what you use. I just don't want you broadcasting your intentions before you even arrive on scene.
messages.zh:
我们从线人那里得到一条情报说，一个艾玛的宗教狂热恐怖份子准备在水晶大道上安放一个核装置。虽然大道上的建筑都已经针对可能受到的袭击进行了加固，但像这样的爆炸还是会造成数千人的伤亡，然后还会迫使整条大道关闭——也就是说，这会造成收入损失。

幸运的是我们已经从情报中了解到这疯子目前的行踪。请前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}阻止他，不要让这疯子的计划得逞。

有些事情你需要记在心里，{[character]player.name}，在接近目标的时候你需要保持自己处于尽量隐蔽的状态。这意味着你需要用一艘比战列舰体积更小的舰船，至于具体是什么，我就不管你了。这么做的原因，我只是不想在你抵达目的地之前就引起他们的注意。

messages.en: The terrorist is now a grease smear on his battlecruiser's smoking wreck.
messages.zh: 那恐怖分子现在成了躺在他那冒烟的战列巡洋舰残骸里的一堆烂肉。

messages.en: Ha! Nice work, {[character]player.name}. Enjoy your reward — you've earned it.
messages.zh: 哈哈！干得好，{[character]player.name}。好好享用酬金吧——你用之无愧。

messages.en: What do I care about the Crystal Boulevard? I never shop there.
messages.zh: 那水晶大道关我鸟事？我从来不去那里的。

messages.en: You would allow a madman to harm our beloved monument? What kind of patriot are you? Gods, I hope I can find someone else to handle this on such short notice.
messages.zh: 你竟然会让一个疯子去对我们珍视的地标搞破坏？你这也算爱国？天哪，但愿我能在短时间内找到其他人来处理这事。

messages.en:
The Crystal Boulevard is indeed one of the great monuments of the Gallente Federation. It is perhaps the most stunning sight in the galaxy, a sea of gleaming crystal spires and sparkling lights, teeming with inhabitants and tourists. As such, it is a symbol of pride for the Gallente, a symbol of wealth, a symbol of freedom.

That makes it a wonderful target for enemies of the Federation as well.
messages.zh:
水晶大道确实是盖伦特联邦最伟大的地标之一。无数闪耀水晶塔及眩目灯光与游人居民共绘一副灿烂画面，水晶大道可能是宇宙中最令人叹为观止的景点。对盖伦特而言，它代表了荣耀、财富和自由。

这也使该大道成了联邦敌人首要的攻击目标。

messages.en: The Crystal Boulevard
messages.zh: 水晶大道

messages.en:
We have received word from an informant that an Amarrian terrorist, some religious zealot, is planning to plant a nuclear bomb somewhere on the Crystal Boulevard. Even though the structures of the crystal buildings are hardened against attack, a blast like that would kill thousands, not to mention shutting down the Boulevard — which, I needn't stress, would cause untold losses in profits.

Fortunately, we've just gotten intelligence regarding the lunatic's current whereabouts. Head out there, will you? Stop this madman from executing his fanatic scheme.

Keep in mind though, {[character]player.name}, you must exercise a little stealth in approach. You will need to fly something smaller than a Battleship. Beyond that one restriction, I don't really care what you use. I just don't want you broadcasting your intentions before you even arrive on scene.
messages.zh:
我们从线人那里得到一条情报说，一个艾玛的宗教狂热恐怖份子准备在水晶大道上安放一个核装置。虽然大道上的建筑都已经针对可能受到的袭击进行了加固，但像这样的爆炸还是会造成数千人的伤亡，然后还会迫使整条大道关闭——也就是说，这会造成收入损失。

幸运的是我们已经从情报中了解到这疯子目前的行踪。请速出发，不要让这疯子的计划得逞。

有些事情你需要记在心里，{[character]player.name}，在接近目标的时候你需要保持自己处于尽量隐蔽的状态。这意味着你需要用一艘比战列舰体积更小的舰船，至于具体是什么，我就不管你了。这么做的原因，我只是不想在你抵达目的地之前就引起他们的注意。

{[character]player.name}，

所幸我已找了他人来处理这事。你的慵懒完全有可能让那疯狂的恐怖分子在水晶大道上引爆一颗炸弹！也许你不该跟着联邦混。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

Your lack of initiative has allowed that insane Amarrian terrorist to detonate a bomb on the Crystal Boulevard! Where the hell were you?! Thousands are dead, and the repair costs will be astronomical. But you capsuleers never seem to think in such terms. Sickening, really.

I pray, for all our sakes, that you will learn to let your conscience guide you in the future.

{[character]agentID.name}
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

由于你的慵懒，那疯狂的恐怖分子已经在水晶大道上引爆了一颗炸弹！你死哪儿去了？！现在已有数千人死亡，而修复花费更将是天文数字。你们飞行员从来想不到这一点。真让人恶心。

但愿你今后能长点良知。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: I'll leave right away.
messages.zh: 我现在就出发。

messages.en: I knew you were good for it, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我就知道你能处理好这事儿，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Yeah, I'm interested in helping out.
messages.zh: 是的，我很有兴趣在这件事情上帮你。

messages.en:
There's been an increase in Caldari activity in surrounding systems. We think those self-righteous bastards might be up to something. Of course, that's nothing new.

We've placed passive reconnaissance units in several nearby locations, but we don't want any direct transmissions from them for fear of attracting Caldari attention. So we've decided to dispatch "unofficial" vessels like yours to pick up the data chips from their base and bring them back here. The Caldari are less likely to suspect — or at least less likely to interfere with — a capsuleer, so they should leave you alone.

If you do get jumped, however, remember that the recon unit is the top priority. Get it out of there if you can. Do it fast and there'll be a substantial bonus.
messages.zh:
加达里在附近星系的活动越来越频繁。我们认为这些自负的家伙正在密谋什么事情。当然，这也不算什么新闻了。

我们在附近的一些个地点安放了被动侦察部队，但我们不想要它们主动的向我们传送信息，避免引起加达里的注意。所以我们需要雇佣“非官方”的第三方的舰船帮助我们获取这些情报，帮我们从他们的基地取回数据芯片并带回到这里。加达里人对此好像并不会有太大的疑心——至少说是不愿意和一些克隆飞行员有过多的关系，所以他们应该不会管你。

一旦你跳过去了，记住，侦察部队才是首要的目标，尽量将它从那儿带出来。尽快完成这样还能得到额外的奖励。

messages.en: Here are the data chips from your recon base, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 这是从你的侦查基地取回的数据芯片，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Good job, capsuleer. You show some promise, I must admit.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。我的承认，果然是名不虚传。

messages.en: Sorry. I don't want to get involved.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我不想交货这事儿。

messages.en: I can't say I'm too surprised, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我只能说太惊讶了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
There's been an increase in Caldari activity in surrounding systems. We think those self-righteous bastards might be up to something. Of course, that's nothing new.

We've placed passive reconnaissance units in several nearby locations, but we don't want any direct transmissions from them for fear of attracting Caldari attention. So we've decided to dispatch "unofficial" vessels like yours to pick up the data chips from their base and bring them back here. The Caldari are less likely to suspect--or at least less likely to interfere with--a capsuleer, so they should leave you alone.

If you do get jumped, however, remember that the recon unit is the top priority. Get it out of there if you can. Do it fast and there'll be a substantial bonus.

我们在附近的一些地点安放了被动侦察单元，但我们不想让它们直接向我们传送信息，避免引起加达里的注意。所以我们需要雇佣“非官方”的第三方舰船帮助我们获取这些情报，从他们的基地取回数据芯片并带回到这里。加达里人对此好像并不会有太大的疑心——至少是不愿意和克隆飞行员有过多的关系——所以他们应该不会管你。

一旦你遭人怀疑了，记住，那侦察单元才是首要的目标。尽量把它从那里带出来。最好再快点，这样你还能得到额外的奖励。

messages.en: The Minmatar will be driven from the system.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人将会被从这个星系驱逐出去。

messages.en: Remember, only destroy the enemy ships. The gates are not to be harmed.
messages.zh: 记住只要摧毁敌方的舰船，但是不要损坏加速轨道。

messages.en: What is it?
messages.zh: 帮什么忙？

messages.en:
We've found what appears to be a large collection of acceleration gates surrounded by Minmatar ships. These gates have apparently been modified to act as "simple" mass drivers. Theoretically, they could propel asteroids or similar celestial bodies at Amarrian targets. The combination of mass and velocity produced by such a gate could easily destroy a station; I don't even want to think what the results would be for a planetary impact.

We need you to stop the Minmatar before they get a chance to use these devices. Destroy any enemy ships you find. But do not destroy the gates: We do not know how dangerous that would be… and in any case, our scientists want to take a closer look.
messages.zh:

messages.en: We've detected several large explosions coming from the enemy mass driver cluster. Apparently their experiment failed. We simply lucked out on this. Had you responded faster, though, we might have secured the technology and developed it properly for ourselves.
messages.zh: 我们探测到在敌人的巨型驱动器集群的位置出现了几次大的爆炸。很显然，他们的实验失败了。我们很走运，有你快速的反应，我们找回了一些有用的情报，帮助我们自己研发这种技术。

messages.en: Mass drivers destroyed.
messages.zh: 巨型驱动器已被摧毁

messages.en: I'm sorry, but I can't clear the Ammarr from the acceleration gates. Don't ask me why. I just can't.
messages.zh: 我很抱歉，我无法将加速轨道附近的艾玛人驱赶开。别问为什么，我就是不能。

messages.en: Disappointing, to say the least.
messages.zh: 非常失望，至少可以这么说。

messages.en: We've detected several large explosions coming from the enemy mass driver cluster. Apparently their experiment failed. We simply lucked out on this. Had you responded faster, though, we might have secured the technology and developed it properly for ourselves.
messages.zh: 我们探测到在敌人的巨型驱动器集群的位置出现了几次大的爆炸。很显然，他们的实验失败了。我们很走运，有你快速的反应，我们找回了一些有用的情报，帮助我们自己研发这种技术。

messages.en: Mass drivers destroyed.
messages.zh: 巨型驱动器已被摧毁

messages.en: I'll find him!
messages.zh: 我会找到他的。

messages.en: Excellent. Now get to it, before that bastard gets away.
messages.zh: 很好，现在你就出发，趁着那些混蛋还没有跑掉。

messages.en: How can I assist you?
messages.zh: 我要怎样帮助你。

messages.en:
One of our intelligence technicians has gone rogue. He isn't a very high-level operator, but he has access to some sensitive passwords, code keys, and patrol routes. We think he was bought off by the Caldari and is headed out of system.

We've located him in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and we need someone to stop him and grab his ship's log if possible. It may contain information about his destination and, more importantly, about who recruited him. It's an important mission.
messages.zh:
我们的一个情报技术人员最近叛逃了。他并不是一个职位很高的操作员，但他知道一些敏感的密码、编码密匙以及巡逻路线。我们认为他是被加达里收买了，现在正准备逃离这个星系。

我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了他，需要有人去阻止他，并且最好把他的舰船日志也带回来。日志里面可能藏有重要的信息，有关谁是上家，目的地在哪里，等等。这是项重要任务。

messages.en: I've eliminated the traitor and obtained his log book.
messages.zh: 我消灭了叛徒，拿到了他的日志。

messages.en: Good job! We'll analyze the data right away. Come back in a few hours and we may have some more work for you.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，我们现在就对数据进行分析。过几分钟再回来，然后我们会有新的任务给你。

messages.en:
One of our intelligence technicians has gone rogue. He isn't a very high-level operator, but he has access to some sensitive passwords, code keys, and patrol routes. We think he was bought off by the Caldari and is headed out of system.

We've located him in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and we need someone to stop him and grab his ship's log if possible. It may contain information about his destination and, more importantly, about who recruited him. It's an important mission. Are you game?
messages.zh:
我们的一个情报技术人员最近叛逃了。他并不是一个职位很高的操作员，但他知道一些敏感的密码、编码密匙以及巡逻路线。我们认为他是被加达里收买了，现在正准备逃离这个星系。

我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了他，需要有人去阻止他，并且最好把他的舰船日志也带回来。日志里面可能藏有重要的信息，有关谁是上家，目的地在哪里，等等。这是项重要任务。干不干？

messages.en: I'll get him and bring him back.
messages.zh: 我会去找到他然后带回来。

messages.en: Move quickly, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 快点行动，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I'm always ready to help. What's going on?
messages.zh: 我随时都准备好帮忙的。有什么情况么？

messages.en:
Turns out the traitor was on his way to meet up with his contact, a Caldari spy, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. With luck, the contact is still out there waiting for the traitor's arrival.

Head out there and take him down.
messages.zh:
看来叛徒是正在去和他的上线接头的路上，一个加达里的间谍，位置在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。走运的话，这个接头人应该还是在那个地方等待叛徒去和他接触。

你过去把这个间谍干掉。

messages.en: The contact has been dealt with, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 接头人已经解决了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Excellent job! You've helped deal a major blow to the Caldari spy network.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！你在破坏加达里间谍网的行动中起到了关键的作用。

messages.en: Not really interested. Seems like this should be something for the Navy, anyway, no?
messages.zh: 没什么兴趣。这看起来象是海军该干的事情，不是么？

messages.en:
We've analyzed the data you brought back from the traitor's ship. He was on his way to meet up with his contact, some Caldari spy, in the asteroid fields of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. With luck, the contact is still out there waiting for the traitor's arrival.

Can you head on out to that system and take him down? His ship is likely to be pretty powerful, but if you can capture him alive we'll provide you with a substantial bounty.
messages.zh:
我们分析了你从叛逃者所驾驶的舰船上带回来的日志。看来叛徒是正在去和他的上线接头的路上，一个加达里的间谍，位置在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。走运的话，这个接头人应该还是在那个地方等待叛徒去和他接触。

你过去把这个间谍干掉。

messages.en: I'll do it. Send me the coordinates.
messages.zh: 交给我好了，把坐标发送给我。

messages.en: See you when you return, my friend.
messages.zh: 回头见啦，我的朋友。

messages.en: Sounds good, {[character]agentID.name}. What do you need?
messages.zh: 听起来不错，{[character]agentID.name}。你想要我干什么？

messages.en:
There has been an outbreak of commerce raiding in this sector. We strongly suspect the Caldari are behind it, either directly or through proxies such as Mordu's Legion. They've hit a convoy in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, but there was too much cargo for them to loot immediately. We suspect that they'll be returning in a few hours with a transport and some escorts.

We want to strike back, but also to learn something about who these raiders are and whether the Caldari are really behind the attacks. Take out the transport and escorts when they arrive in-system, and return to us with any logs or transponders you're able to recover. The lost cargo is yours if you want it. Insurance has already covered those losses, so consider that a little extra bonus for yourself.
messages.zh:
在这个区域最近发生了大量针对商船的袭击。我们严重怀疑加达里是背后的主使，无论是直接参与还是通过其爪牙例如莫德团来实施，他们都脱不了关系。他们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}袭击了一支运输队，但由于货物数量太多，他们不能马上就把战利品转移出去。我们估计，在几小时之内他们会带着运输舰以及护航舰船返回事发地点。

我们要反击他们，同时也要查明这些袭击者的身份，看看加达里是不是真的在幕后操控这次袭击。消灭运输舰及其护航船只，然后从被击毁的舰船残骸中取回一份他们的舰船日志，或者无线应答机。至于那些散落的货物，如果你想要的话就拿去吧。这些损失已经由保险公司赔付过，所以就把那些货当作是你的奖金好了。

messages.en: I've defeated the raiders and found the information you requested.
messages.zh: 我打败了那些血袭者然后拿到了你所要的信息。

messages.en: You're a hell of a pilot, {[character]player.name}. Come back in a bit and I'll let you know if there's more work for you.
messages.zh: 你真是太厉害了，{[character]player.name}。一会儿你再来我这儿，如果我有新的工作的话我会告诉你的。

messages.en:
There's been an outbreak of commerce raiding in this sector. We strongly suspect the Caldari are behind it, either directly or through something like Mordu's Legion. Whoever it is, they've hit a convoy in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, but it seems there was too much cargo for them to loot immediately. We suspect that they'll be returning in a few hours with a transport and some escorts.

We want to strike back, of course, but also to learn something about who these raiders are and whether the Caldari are really behind the attacks. Take out the transport and escorts when they arrive in-system, and return to us with any logs or transponders you're able to recover.

Take these guys down and we'll make it worth your time. You might even get a piece of the action if we find out who's behind the raids. The lost cargo is also yours if you want it. Insurance has already covered those losses, so consider that a little extra bonus for yourself.
messages.zh:
在这个区域最近发生了大量针对商船的袭击。我们严重怀疑加达里是背后的主使，无论是直接参与还是通过其爪牙例如莫德团来实施，他们都脱不了关系。总之，他们已经在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}袭击了一支运输队，但是貌似由于货物数量太多，他们不能马上就把战利品转移出去。我们估计，在几小时之内他们会带着运输舰以及护航舰船返回事发地点。

我们当然要反击他们，但同时也要查明这些袭击者的身份，看看加达里是不是真的在幕后操控这次袭击。消灭运输舰及其护航船只，然后从被击毁的舰船残骸中取回一份他们的舰船日志，或者无线应答机。

干掉他们的运输舰以及护航船只，我们会好好答谢你。最好是你能从被击毁的舰船残骸中取回一份他们的舰船日志或者无线应答机，这样我们就可以判断是谁在背后操控。至于那些散落的货物，如果你想要的话就拿去吧。这些损失已经由保险公司赔付过，所以就把那些货当作是你的奖金好了。

messages.en: Let me at 'em!
messages.zh: 让我吃了他们！

messages.en: Alright, then, capsuleer, go take some Caldari names.
messages.zh: 好吧，克隆飞行员，快去取几个加达里人头吧。

messages.en: Nothing I'd enjoy more…
messages.zh: 没有什么比这个更有趣的了……

messages.en:
There's a Caldari supply depot located at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that we want destroyed. We can't offer you much support, but we know you don't really need it. That's why we're sending you in, and not some Navy rookie. We want the Caldari to know that we can cause them grief with only a single ship. It doesn't take us a whole fleet.

I won't lie, it's risky.The depot is likely to be guarded, and they may send reinforcements once the action begins.
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一座加达里补给站，我们想把它端掉。我们恐怕没法为你提供太多帮助，但是我看你也并不需要。这也是为什么他们把你派过来，而不是什么海军里的菜鸟。我们要让加达里人明白，我们可以只用一艘战舰就把他们打个落花流水。根本不需要动用一整支舰队。

实话对你说，这差事还是挺危险的。这座补给站肯定受到了一定的保护，也许他们还会在遭受攻击的时候调遣增援部队。

messages.en: That was fun.
messages.zh: 很有意思。

messages.en: Great work! I suspect we won't be seeing anymore Caldari raiders in this sector for a while.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮！我想很长时间内我们不会再在这个区域见到加达里海盗的身影了。

messages.en:
We've got some more information from the data you brought back. It seems that these enemies are indeed Mordu's Legion, with their squadron insignia obscured. That means the Caldari are likely behind the raids and we need to send them a message that we know about it.

There's a Caldari supply depot located at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that we want destroyed. We can't offer you much support, but we know you don't really need it. That's why we're sending you in, and not some Navy rookie. We want the Caldari to know that we can cause them grief with only a single ship. It doesn't take us a whole fleet.

So, you want to go in? I won't lie, it's risky--the depot is likely to be guarded, and they may send reinforcements once the action begins.
messages.zh:
从你带回的数据中，我们获取了更多信息。看来这些敌人真是莫德团的人，我们找到了他们中队的徽章。这意味着加达里人确实很有可能在幕后指挥袭击。我们要让他们知道，我们对此了如指掌。

在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一座加达里补给站，我们想把它端掉。我们恐怕没法为你提供太多帮助，但是我看你也并不需要。这也是为什么他们把你派过来，而不是什么海军里的菜鸟。我们要让加达里人明白，我们可以只用一艘战舰就把他们打个落花流水。根本不需要动用一整支舰队。

怎么样，你愿意接这个活儿么？实话对你说，这差事还是挺危险的。这座补给站肯定受到了一定的保护，也许他们还会在遭受攻击的时候调遣增援部队。

name.ru: Ид и Egonics, Inc. (Id and Egonics, Inc.)

messages.en: I can't believe this! And here I was just going to pick up an Egonics headset for each of my cousin's kids… Okay, don't worry, just get me that ship's coordinates.
messages.zh: 难以置信！我刚才还想为我姐的每个孩子都带一个耳机回去呢……好，别担心，把那船的位标给我就行。

messages.en: You seem upset. What's wrong?
messages.zh: 你看去不大高兴啊。怎么了？

messages.en:
An Amarrian slaver has found a way to hack the Egonics signal, at least at short range. Security cameras in a nearby station show hundreds of people--all of them wearing Egonics devices--simply walking into the cargohold of an Amarrian Bestower. It wasn't until after the ship had departed the station and the missing persons reports starting coming in that we realized anything was amiss. Security found that this Amarrian "citizen" had inserted subliminal commands into the Egonics signals at the station.

If you can get all of those citizens back, there's a big reward for you.

There are over 1,000 people missing. You will need a large cargo capacity to carry them all at once, unless you intend to make multiple runs to the deadspace location where the Amarrain ship is located.
messages.zh:
有个艾玛奴役者已经找到了一个至少在短距离上可以破解自尊集团信号的方法。附近一个空间站里的保安摄像头显示数百个头戴自尊集团耳机的人径直走入了一艘艾玛恩赐者级的货柜舱。直到飞船离站，我们收到人员失踪报告后，我们才意识到事情不对。保安发现这个艾玛“公民”在空间站向自尊集团信号里掺插了潜意识指令。

如果你能把那些失踪的人都带回来，那你就能拿重赏。

失踪人数总共超过一千。你需要用一艘货柜舱较大的船才能一次性地把他们都运回来。当然你也可以跑多趟去那死亡空间，那艾玛飞船就在那儿。

messages.en: All of the kidnapped citizens are safe at home now. They seem a bit groggy, but otherwise none the worse for wear.
messages.zh: 所有遭绑架的人现在都安全回到家里了。他们好像还有点反应迟钝，但除此之外一切都好。

messages.en: Magnificent, {[character]player.name}. Their families will be so happy to have them back. You've done a great deed today, my friend.
messages.zh: 太棒了，{[character]player.name}。他们的家人会很高兴他们的孩子终于回来了。朋友，你今天干了件大好事。

messages.en: What do I care about a few numbskull music freaks? Not worth my time.
messages.zh: 那些长愚木脑袋的音乐发烧友关我什么事？浪费我时间。

messages.en: Not worth…?! Wha—? I can't believe you can say that! Get out of here, will you? I have to find someone else to save those kids.
messages.zh: 浪费……？！什—？我真料不到你会那样说！滚出去。我另寻他人来救那些孩子。

messages.en:
Egonics, Inc. is unique in the Gallente music industry. Extremely popular among young citizens of virtually every star nation, Egonics produces the only entertainment headset that transmits music directly into the user's brain. The company's contracted musical artists tailor the music to the individual tastes of every listener.

The technology's growing popularity has caused it spread across the galaxy, except in the Amarr Empire, where possession of Egonics tech is outlawed.
messages.zh:
自尊集团在盖伦特音乐界中是独一无二的。该集团在各国都受到了狂热追捧，它生产的一种耳机可以将音乐直接送入人的头脑。该集团下面的许多艺人都能根据听众个人喜好对音乐做调整。

越来越多的人开始喜欢这种先进的音乐播放技术，目前这玩意儿已经流行于全宇宙。当然例外的地方只有一个，那就是艾玛领域，艾玛认为自尊集团的这种技术是非法的。

messages.en: Egonics, Inc.
messages.zh: 自尊集团

messages.en:
What's wrong? Listen to this. Egonics headsets: They're the fashion, right? All the kids have to have them. But some people, including me, have always been afraid that something like this could happen.

Apparently some Amarrian slaver has found a way to hack the Egonics signal, at least at short range. Security cameras in a nearby station show hundreds of people — all of them wearing Egonics devices — simply walking into the cargohold of an Amarrian Bestower. This strange exodus went unnoticed because, other than their destination, the people seemed to be behaving normally. It wasn't until after the ship had departed the station and the missing persons reports starting coming in that we realized anything was amiss.

Security found that this Amarrian "citizen" had inserted subliminal commands into the Egonics signals at the station. Of course, they thought their network security was iron-clad, but now I can assure you they're rethinking their assumptions. This is a catastrophe of the highest order, {[character]player.name}!

Just imagine what a tragedy this would be if it wasn't Federation policy to put a tracking beacon on every Bestower that docks in our sovereignty!

If you can get all of those Gallente citizens back, there's a big reward for you. And if you can keep the Egonics corporate name out of it, so much the better… If you see any Scope reporters nosing around as you leave, pray, ignore them.

There are over 1,000 people missing. You will need a large cargo capacity to carry them all at once, unless you intend to make multiple runs to the deadspace location where the Amarrain ship is located.

The slaver ship likely has escorts, as well.
messages.zh:
怎么了？让我告诉你怎么了。自尊集团生产的耳机：你知道它们很流行，对吧？只要是孩子都想要一个。但有些人，包括我，就担心下面这样的事情会发生。

很明显有个艾玛奴役者已经找到了一个至少是短距离的耳机信号破解方法。附近一个空间站里的保安摄像头显示数百个头戴耳机的人径直走入了一艘艾玛恩赐者级的货柜舱。由于就他们的目的地有问题，而他们的行为看上去却很正常，因此没人注意到这一奇怪的集体离站现象。直到飞船离站，我们收到人员失踪报告后，我们才意识到事情不对。

保安发现这个艾玛“公民”在空间站向耳机信号里掺插了潜意识指令。当然，自尊集团一开始还以为他们的网络是坚不可摧的，现在他们肯定要重新反思一下了。这是次最严重的事故，{[character]player.name}！

如果不是联邦规定每艘停靠于我们领域的恩赐者级都要安上一个跟踪器的话，这场悲剧将发展到难以想象的程度。

如果你能把那些失踪的人都带回来，那你就能拿重赏。如果你还能让自尊集团不在这个事件中曝光的话，那便是好上加好……如果你看到任何视角报道员在你身边转悠，当他们是空气就行。

失踪人数总共超过一千。你需要用一艘货柜舱较大的船才能一次性地把他们都运回来。当然你也可以跑多趟去那死亡空间。那艘艾玛恩赐者级的周围可能有人保驾护航。

messages.en: Amarrian slaver captured
messages.zh: 艾玛奴役者被抓

messages.en: Forget it. I've changed my mind. Let the Navy deal with this.
messages.zh: 算了。我改变想法了。让海军去处理这事吧。

messages.en: You're just going to let that slaver get away with a thousand kids? What kind of person are you? Perhaps you should work out of Amarr space from now on!
messages.zh: 你打算让那奴役者带着一千个孩子跑掉吗？你到底是个怎样的人？也许从今以后你不应该再在艾玛地盘里干活儿！

{[character]player.name}，

由于你懒，那恶心的艾玛人已经成功地带着一帮盖伦特公民逃脱了！你难道还有脸继续在盖伦特领域里转悠吗！？

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Amarrian slaver escaped
messages.zh: 艾玛奴役者逃脱

messages.en: This Gallente pirate is a dead man.
messages.zh: 这个盖伦特海盗已经是个死人了。

messages.en: Good. But move quickly. These "pirates" could disappear at any time.
messages.zh: 很好，但你得快点。这些"海盗"随时都可能出现。

messages.en: Hey, I'm all about dealing with pirates. What's the problem?
messages.zh: 嘿！我专门对付各种海盗，有什么问题么？

messages.en:
These pirates in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} are well funded, well equipped, and commanded by some canny ship commanders. In fact, we believe the Gallente government has sanctioned these "pirates" as privateers.

Go out there and wipe them out. Yes, this is a “terminate with extreme prejudice” matter. The bounty on the pirate commander is sizeable, but you'll need proof of his death to collect it: Bring back his head and you'll be well-rewarded for your efforts.

You're going to face a sizable force of pirates. You'll likely need at least a battlecruiser, and maybe even a few allies.
messages.zh:
这些在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}活动的海盗受到了很强的财政支持，装备先进，而且有精明的指挥官。实际上，我们相信盖伦特政府确实招安了这些海盗作为私掠船。他们已经给艾玛人带来了无法估量的财产损失，我们需要你去把他们都铲除掉。是的，这完全可以算是“先枪毙再审判”的做法。海盗头目的击毁赏金是非常可观的，但你需要证据证明你已经把他干掉才能够领取这笔赏金。把他的人头带回来，你会得到应有的奖赏的。

你将会遭遇到相当的海盗力量，你可能需要至少是一艘战列巡洋舰才能够对付他们，甚至可能还用得到一些团队合作。

messages.en: Mission accomplished. The pirates are dead, and I have the commander's filthy gob in a jar in my cargo.
messages.zh: 任务完成了，海盗都死翘翘了，那个指挥官的尸首就在我的货柜舱里面。

messages.en: Thank you for your assistance. You are a courageous pilot, {[character]player.name}. Enjoy your rewards. You've earned them.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的协助，你是一位勇敢的飞行员，{[character]player.name}。好好享受你的报酬吧，这是你应得的。

messages.en: You know, this sounds pretty risky. And I just had my ship cleaned and repainted. Nah, I'm gonna pass, thanks.
messages.zh: 你要知道，这听上去非常的冒险。我刚刚把我的船擦干净重新上了漆。算了，我不去，谢谢。

messages.en: Don't have the stones, huh? Well, I'm sure there are plenty of ship captains courageous enough to grab this bounty.
messages.zh: 没这脾气是吧，恩？好啦，我想肯定还有一大堆舰长们有这胆识为了赏金去完成这个任务的。

messages.en:
A gang of pirates has been terrorizing the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system for some time. And they've been using their base in that system as a launching point to strike out into neighboring systems as well. Of course, pirates are to be expected these days, but these pirates are different. They are well funded, well equipped, and commanded by some canny ship commanders.

A survivor of the pirate raids told us that at least two of the ship captains — including the pirates' leader himself — were once high-ranking officers in the Gallente Navy. In fact, we believe the Gallente government has sanctioned these pirates as privateers. The damage they have already caused to Amarrian interests is incalculable. Go out there and wipe them out. Yes, this one's a “terminate with extreme prejudice.”

The bounty on the pirate commander is sizeable, but you'll need proof of his death to collect it. Bring back his head and you'll be well-rewarded for your efforts.

You're going to face a sizable force of pirates. You'll likely need at least a battlecruiser, and maybe even a few allies.
messages.zh:
有一队海盗在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name} 猖狂了好些时候了。他们利用其在那个星系的空间站作为基地，将攻击行动辐射到了周围的好几个临近星系。当然，这年头海盗并不算什么稀奇的事物，但他们去不一样。这些人有非常不一般的后台支撑，装备先进，而且有精明的指挥官。

一个在海盗袭击中幸存的船员告诉我们，至少有两个海盗船的指挥官，其中包括一个是海盗头子本人——都是盖伦特海军中的高级军官。实际上，我们相信盖伦特政府确实招安了这些海盗作为私掠船。他们已经给艾玛人带来了无法估量的财产损失，我们需要你去把他们都铲除掉。是的，这完全可以算是“先枪毙再审判”的做法。

海盗头目的击毁赏金是非常可观的，但你需要证据证明你已经把他干掉才能够领取这笔赏金。把他的人头带回来，你会得到应有的奖赏的。

你将会遭遇到相当的海盗力量，你可能需要至少是一艘战列巡洋舰才能够对付他们，甚至可能还用得到一些团队合作。

messages.en: Don't have the stones? Good thing there are plenty of ship captains courageous enough to grab this bounty. Consider yourself un-hired.
messages.zh: 没这脾气是吧？幸好冲着这样丰厚的赏金，肯定还有一大堆舰长愿意有足够的胆识去完成这个任务的。你失业了。

messages.en: So that's how it is...
messages.zh: 就是这样的……

messages.en: Don't have the stones? I'm sure there are plenty of ship captains courageous enough to grab this bounty.
messages.zh: 没这脾气是吧？好啦，我想肯定还有一大堆舰长们有这胆识为了赏金去完成这个任务的。

messages.en: Sounds like quite a challenge. Sure, I'll help.
messages.zh: 听上去挺有挑战性的。行，我干。

messages.en: Good hunting, my friend.
messages.zh: 祝你成功，朋友。

messages.en: Good day, {[character]agentID.name}. What can you offer me?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}。你有什么任务？

messages.en:
There's a flotilla of Amarrian ships operating illegally out of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We need you to go take them out. Leave as much wreckage as you can so the Empire can't deny its actions in our space.

Now, we're not sure how many fleet resources they have in the region, so it might be a tough fight. A real tough fight.
messages.zh:
一队艾玛舰船在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}非法活动。我们要你去把他们解决掉。尽量多留点残骸，这样帝国就无法抵赖他们在我们境内活动的事实了。

我们现在还不清楚他们在此区域到底有多少支舰队，因此要做好准备。做好打硬仗的准备。

messages.en: I took out the enemy vessels. Good fight, just like you said.
messages.zh: 我把敌舰都干掉了。确实如你所言那样，这仗打得真刺激。

messages.en: Excellent work! That'll put the fear of their bloodthirsty god right into them.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！这下轮到他们发抖了。

messages.en: Sorry, but I can't do it, {[character]agentID.name}. Pressing business elsewhere.
messages.zh: 不好意思，{[character]agentID.name}，我没法干这事。我还有其他事情呢。

messages.en: I'm sorry to hear that, {[character]player.name}. I'll find someone else, I suppose.
messages.zh: 听你这样说真是很遗憾，{[character]player.name}。看来我得找其他人了。

messages.en:
There's been a lot of Amarrian activity along the frontier lately. We think they're preparing for war with the Minmatar, but there's no love lost between them and us, as you know. Or perhaps they want to start a conflict that will involve all four major powers. We can't say.

What we do know is that there is a flotilla of Amarrian ships operating out of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. To avoid the political confrontation, we'd been leaving them alone until now, but they've been snooping where they aren't welcome, and we think they may even be raiding some of our supply convoys. We need you to go take them out--leave as much wreckage as you can so the Empire can't deny it had an illegal military outpost in our space.

Now, we're not sure how many fleet resources they have in the region, so it might be a tough fight. A real tough fight. Are you up for it?
messages.zh:
最近艾玛人在前线活动很频繁。我们认为，他们在准备与米玛塔尔人开战，不过我们与艾玛的关系还没有搞僵。当然他们也可能想发动一场席卷四大帝国的战争。具体怎样我们也不知道。

而我们确信的是，有一队艾玛舰船在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}活动。为了避免政治冲突，我们一直没去管他们。但现在情况变了，他们闯入了不该去的地方，我们甚至怀疑他们袭击了我们的补给线。我们要你去把他们解决掉——尽量多留点残骸，这样帝国就无法抵赖他们在我们境内拥有非法军事哨站这一事实了。

我们现在还不清楚他们在此区域到底有多少支舰队，因此要做好准备。做好打硬仗的准备。你有兴趣吗？

messages.en: I've changed my mind — these odds are too uncertain. I quit.
messages.zh: 我改变想法了——风险太大。我闪了。

messages.en: I guess you can't take the heat. There are others who will.
messages.zh: 我猜你是顶不住了。我去找能顶住的人。

messages.en: I will destroy the beacons, never fear.
messages.zh: 别担心，我会把那些信标都清理干净的。

messages.en: Your loyalty and bravery continue to astonish us all.
messages.zh: 你真是出人意料地忠勇。

messages.en: I think so, yes. Sounds like you need the help.
messages.zh: 应该行的。看样子你有求于我。

messages.en:
The Caldari are helping the Amarrians plan an offensive in this sector by deploying subspace beacons deep in obscure star systems. We need to destroy the beacons and strand some of the Caldari in this sector.

The most powerful of these beacons are located in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system; go there and destroy them quickly. There will be ships guarding the beacons, and they'll no doubt put up a very strong resistance.
messages.zh:
加达里人在该地区正在帮助艾玛人策划一次袭击。加达里人在人烟罕至的星系里部属了子空间信标。我们正在酝酿摧毁这些信标并且阻止加达里的一些舰队离开这里。

信号最强的信标都在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系。你是我们现在能叫到的最好的飞行员，你要飞过去动作快点把它们都毁掉。信标周围会有舰船把守，它们肯定会拼命抵抗。

messages.en: The beacons are all destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}. Along with the Caldari bastards who put them there.
messages.zh: 那些信标都被拔掉了，{[character]agentID.name}。还有那帮把它们竖起来的加达里人也全被解决掉了。

messages.en: That's got them! Well done, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 太好了，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: This sounds pretty dangerous, going up against the Caldari. No, I think I'll pass.
messages.zh: 同加达里对抗，听上去太危险了。不，我还是算了吧。

messages.en: I see. Well, I suppose this is a difficult job I've offered you. Still— Oh, well, I'll find someone…
messages.zh: 我明白。我想这任务对你来说是难了点。但——嗯，算了，我还是找别人吧。

messages.en:
So glad to hear it. Good, good.

Okay, we believe that the Caldari are helping the Amarrians plan an offensive in this sector; the Caldari are deploying subspace beacons deep in obscure star systems to support it. We're developing a plan to destroy the beacons and strand some of the Caldari flotillas in this sector.

The most powerful of these beacons are located in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system, and since you're the best commander we've got involved, we want you to go there and destroy them quickly. There will be ships guarding the beacons, and they'll no doubt put up a strong resistance.

What do you say? Do you want the mission?
messages.zh:
很好，很好。

OK，我们发现加达里人在该地区正在帮助艾玛人策划一次袭击。加达里人在人烟罕至的星系里部属了子空间信标。我们正在酝酿摧毁这些信标并且阻止加达里的一些舰队离开这里。

信号最强的信标都在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系。你是我们现在能叫到的最好的飞行员，你要飞过去动作快点把它们都毁掉。信标周围会有舰船把守，它们肯定会拼命抵抗。

怎么样，接受该任务吗？

messages.en: It sounds like a very difficult job. Of course I'll do it!
messages.zh: 听起来真是件十分棘手的活儿。当然我会尽力的！

messages.en: I knew we could count on you, {[character]player.name}. Please hurry.
messages.zh: 我知道我们能够指望你的，{[character]player.name}。快点吧。

messages.en: An emergency? Sure, how can I help?
messages.zh: 有紧急状况？当然，我能帮上什么忙吗？

messages.en:
A group of Ammatar "nationals" in a small outpost out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} claim that they were beaten up by our security guards and then arrested on trumped-up charges. The Amarr Empire has dispatched a fleet to blockade the outpost; they are demanding that the prisoners be turned over to them.

We're in a no-win situation: If we hold the Nefantar, the Amarr fleet will bombard the station and force a confrontation, but if we turn them over it will be seen as a sign of weakness. We need to raise the blockade, while at the same time avoiding direct official intervention in the situation.

Fly to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, take out the fleet that is amassing there.
messages.zh:
一群居住在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name} 外一个小哨站里的艾玛达“侨民”声称他们被我们的保安痛打了一顿并且因为莫须有的罪名而被捕。艾玛帝国已经派出了一支舰队把这个哨站封锁了起来，同时要求我们将犯人移交给他们。

我们陷入了必败的境地：如果我们扣押内凡达，艾玛的舰队会对我们的空间站进行轰击从而使我们不得不与他们交锋，但是如果我们把犯人交还，那又将会被视为软弱。我们要提高封锁力度，同时又要避免官方直接介入。

快飞往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，把在那儿聚集的舰队消灭。

messages.en: The prisoners should be safe to pick up now, {[character]agentID.name}. Oh, by the way, the Imperial Navy is also down a few warships.
messages.zh: 现在去接回犯人应该不会有危险，{[character]agentID.name}。哦，对了，帝国海军也折损了几艘战船。

messages.en: Good job! We've scored a major victory here, thanks to you!
messages.zh: 干得好！我们已经取得了巨大的成功，多亏你了！

messages.en: I like to stay out of political squabbles. Find yourself another capsuleer.
messages.zh: 我可不想卷入政治论战。还是为你自己找另一个克隆飞行员吧。

messages.en: Damnation, {[character]player.name}! You were our best hope. I just pray I can find someone else.
messages.zh: 完了，{[character]player.name}！我们把希望都寄托在你的身上。上帝保佑我能找到其他人。

messages.en:
All hell's broken loose out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The Amarrians have chosen to create an incident that they're hoping will escalate into war.

A group of Ammatar "nationals" in a small outpost out there claim that they were beaten up by our security guards and then arrested on trumped-up charges. The Empire has dispatched a fleet to blockade the outpost "in protest," they say, "on behalf of our friends and allies"; they are demanding that the prisoners be turned over to them.

We're in a no-win situation: If we hold the Nefantar, the Amarr fleet will bombard the station and force a confrontation, but if we turn them over it will be seen as a sign of weakness. We need to raise the blockade, while at the same time avoiding direct official intervention in the situation. That's why we need a capsuleer. We need you.

{[character]player.name}, please — fly to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and take out the fleet that is amassing there. It's a tough job, but from what we've heard you're up to it. What do you say?
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的恶魔都逃了出来. 艾玛人制造了一个事件希望它能逐步升级为战争。

一群居住在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name} 外一个小哨站里的艾玛达的“侨民”声称他们被我们的保安痛打了一顿并且因为莫须有的罪名而被捕。艾玛帝国已经派出了一支舰队把这个哨站封锁了起来“以示抗议”，他们声称道，“代表我们的朋友及盟友”，要求我们把犯人移交给他们。

我们陷入了必败的境地：如果我们扣押内凡达，艾玛的舰队会对我们的空间站进行轰击从而使得我们不得不与他们交锋，但是如果我们把犯人交还，那又会被视作软弱。我们要提高封锁力度，同时又要避免官方直接介入。这就是为什么我们需要克隆飞行员。我们需要你。

{[character]player.name}，求你了--飞去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，把留在那的舰队带过来。这是个棘手的活儿，但据我们所知，你一定能够胜任。你看如何？

messages.en: This mission isn't worth the risk. I'm sorry, but I have to withdraw.
messages.zh: 这个任务不值得冒险。很遗憾，我不得不撤退。

messages.en: You've really let the Republic down, {[character]player.name}. Don't expect to keep up this sort of behavior without some lasting effect.
messages.zh: 你真是让共和失望，{[character]player.name}。没有持久影响的话可别指望还会有这样的行为发生。

name.ru: Sansha на горизонте (Sansha on the Horizon)

messages.en: That station is as good as dust.
messages.zh: 这个空间站像垃圾一样。

messages.en: Have at them.
messages.zh: 试着攻击他们。

messages.en: I am a dedicated problem solver.
messages.zh: 我是个专注的解题者。

messages.en: The Sansha recently began a campaign of expansion. Our forces have contained them so far, but every day it gets harder. A new Sansha base has recently been discovered on our side of the line. We don't have the men to spare to handle it right now. I need you to take care of it. Destroy the station and any Sansha craft that may be defending it.
messages.zh: 萨沙最近在开展一项扩张运动。我们的部队已经容忍他们很久了，但是每天情况都在变得更严峻。最近我们在我们侧翼发现一个新萨沙基地。现在我们没有多余人手来解决他们。我需要你去，摧毁那个空间站，以及任何可能保卫空间站的萨沙部队。

messages.en: The station has been destroyed.
messages.zh: 空间站已经被摧毁。

messages.en: Thanks to your efforts, we've been able to focus on pushing the Sansha back. We've driven them back to where they started, but the fighting is still hard. You've done well, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 感谢你的努力，我们能够专注于将萨沙赶回去。我们已经把他们赶回他们最初的地方，但是战斗依然很艰苦。你做得很好，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I'm not ready for an operation on this scale.  Not against the Nation.
messages.zh: 我没有准备应付那么大的任务——对付一个国家。

messages.en: Fair enough. I can't order you.
messages.zh: 相当公平。我不能命令你。

messages.en: Sansha's Nation was founded more than a century ago. Sansha was a Caldari tycoon who set out to create a utopian state. He started experiments, combining capsule technology with the human mind, creating zombie-like creatures that had the cold, calculating minds of computers, but the ingenuity of humans. When this became public knowledge, Sansha was condemned and his forces were decimated, but remnants still remain.
messages.zh: 萨沙国在一个多世纪前成立。萨沙是一个加达里大亨，决心建立一个乌托邦国度。他开始试验，把克隆技术和人类思维结合起来，创造了类似于僵尸的，拥有计算机般冷酷、精于算计的思维，同时拥有人类的创造力的生物。当这成为众所周知的事之后，萨沙被指控有罪，他的军队也被削减到十分之一，但是残余的仍旧留下来了。

messages.en: A Nation's Beginnings
messages.zh: 民族的开端

messages.en:
Understand that what I'm about to tell you is classified. If word of this got out, there would be a system-wide panic.

The Sansha recently began a campaign of expansion. Our forces have contained them so far, but every day it gets harder. The Sansha do not sleep. They do not flinch. They do not run. They have our guys running triple shifts just to keep up. The cracks in our line are already starting to show.

A new Sansha base has recently been discovered on our side of the line. We don't have the men to spare to handle it right now. I need you to take care of it. Destroy the station and any Sansha craft that may be defending it.
messages.zh:
请理解我将要告诉你的事情是机密。如果外泄，将会导致整个星系范围的恐慌。

萨沙最近在开展一项扩张运动。我们的部队已经容忍他们很久了，但是每天情况都在变得更严峻。萨沙不睡觉，不退缩，也不逃跑。我们的人必须得进行三重转移才能勉强跟上他们。我们战线上的裂缝已经逐渐显现了。

最近我们在我们侧翼发现一个新萨沙基地。现在我们没有多余人手来解决他们。我需要你去，摧毁那个空间站，以及任何可能保卫空间站的萨沙部队。

messages.en: The situation with the Sansha station cannot wait any longer. I need someone who can decide and commit, not lollygag.
messages.zh: 与萨沙空间站对峙的情况不能等下去了。我需要有人能够决定并去做，而非浪费时间。

messages.en: Lollygagger
messages.zh: 浪费时间的人

messages.en: There were Sansha everywhere.  I'm not going back out there, man.  You can't make me.
messages.zh: 那里到处都是萨沙。我不打算回去，伙计。你不能逼我。

messages.en: I'm not about to force you to go back, but I am disappointed.  We trusted you to do this.  You've made life a lot harder for my boys.
messages.zh: 我并不打算逼你回去，但是我很失望。我们信任你会做好，但你却使我的孩子们的生活更加艰苦了。

messages.en: Things are going badly. Because you were slow to act, the Sansha station we found launched a raid against one of our facilities. Now I have to pull people off the line to handle the mess.  Next time, make sure you can do what needs to be done.
messages.zh: 事情越来越糟。因为你行动过慢，我们发现的那个萨沙空间站对我们某个设施发动了突袭。现在我必须把人们拖离生产线来处理残局。下一次，请确定你能够做到需要你去做的事。

messages.en: Sansha station launches raid.
messages.zh: 萨沙空间站发动突袭。

messages.en: Always happy to help, but especially when there's ISK involved.
messages.zh: 我一向乐于助人，尤其当有钱拿的时候。

messages.en: Excellent. Alright, get moving, then — that bastard's getting away!
messages.zh: 很好。那就立刻出发吧——那兔崽子就快逃走了！

messages.en: Thanks for your consideration, {[character]agentID.name}. And yes, I believe I am.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的考虑，{[character]agentID.name}。是的，我觉得我是这样的人。

messages.en:
It looks as if one of our public confidence operatives has turned. What's a public confidence operative? A person whose job it is to spread good news and make sure the general public doesn't lose faith in the government. Yes, I guess you could call it "propaganda management"… but hell, what's a government without propaganda?

Anyway, it seems those fascists in the Caldari State have managed to turn the guy, and he's heading for enemy space with a computer full of our public confidence procedures. He's met up with some Caldari warships, and they're escorting him to the frontier.

Stop them, destroy their ships, and bring back the data chip containing the public confidence procedures.
messages.zh:
现在看起来我们有一位公众信心特工叛逃了。你问公众信心特工是什么？他们的职责是散布正面消息，确保普通大众保持对政府的信心。对，我觉得你可以把这称作“舆论掌控”……但你想，哪个政府不靠舆论支撑？

不管如何，加达里的那帮恶棍已经买通了那家伙，他现在正带着一个存有我们大众信心掌控流程的计算机，飞往敌方领域。他已经和一些加达里战舰会了面，那些战舰现正将他护航送到前线。

我们要阻止他们，击毁那飞船，把那存有大众信心掌控流程的计算机带回来。

messages.en: Here's that data chip you wanted. And don't worry, there's no one left to talk about this matter.
messages.zh: 这是你要的数据芯片。别担心，知道这事儿的人已经被我干掉了。

messages.en: Thanks to you, our people will remain happy now!
messages.zh: 谢谢你，我们的人民能继续开心了！

messages.en: You want me to help you lie to the people of our fair and just Federation?! You're crazy.
messages.zh: 我们联邦倡导公平与公正，你现在要我帮你欺骗它的人民？！你脑袋坏了。

messages.en: Your loss, {[character]player.name}. Remember: Keep your mouth shut about this.
messages.zh: 损失的是你，{[character]player.name}。记住：对此事一个屁都不要放。

messages.en:
Excellent. Now, first off, I must stress that this is all strictly confidential. If any word of this matter were to get out, it could tarnish our appearance in the public eye, not to mention damage Federation morale.

It looks as if one of our public confidence operatives has turned. What's a public confidence operative? A person whose job it is to spread good news and make sure the general public doesn't lose faith in the government. Yes, I guess you could call it "propaganda management"… but hell, what's a government without propaganda?

Anyway, it seems those fascists in the Caldari State have managed to turn the guy, and he's heading for enemy space with a computer full of our public confidence procedures. He's met up with some Caldari warships, and they're escorting him to the frontier. We need to stop them, destroy that ship, and get back the computer with the... public confidence procedures.

Keep it on the sly, {[character]player.name}, and you'll be well rewarded. What do you think?
messages.zh:
很好。首先，我必须强调以下所说内容属机密信息。如果走漏半点风声，那不仅会毁了我们的公众形象，更会对联邦的整个士气产生负面影响。

现在看起来我们有一位公众信心特工叛逃了。你问公众信心特工是什么？他们的职责是散布正面消息，确保普通大众保持对政府的信心。对，我觉得你可以把这称作“舆论掌控”……但你想，哪个政府不靠舆论支撑？

不管如何，加达里的那帮恶棍已经纳降了那家伙，他现在正带着一个存有我们大众信心掌控流程的计算机，飞往敌方领域。他已经和一些加达里战舰会了面，那些战舰现正将他护航送到前线。我们要阻止他们，击毁那飞船，把那存有……大众信心掌控流程的计算机带回来。

要低调行事，{[character]player.name}，我们会重赏你的。你觉得如何？

name.ru: Sansha на горизонте (Sansha on the Horizon)

messages.en: That station is as good as dust.
messages.zh: 这个空间站像垃圾一样。

messages.en: Have at them.
messages.zh: 试着攻击他们。

messages.en: I am a dedicated problem solver.
messages.zh: 我是个专注的解题者。

messages.en: The Sansha recently began a campaign of expansion. Our forces have contained them so far, but every day it gets harder. A new Sansha base has recently been discovered on our side of the line. We don't have the men to spare to handle it right now. I need you to take care of it. Destroy the station and any Sansha craft that may be defending it.
messages.zh: 萨沙最近在开展一项扩张运动。我们的部队已经容忍他们很久了，但是每天情况都在变得更严峻。最近我们在我们侧翼发现一个新萨沙基地。现在我们没有多余人手来解决他们。我需要你去，摧毁那个空间站，以及任何可能保卫空间站的萨沙部队。

messages.en: The station has been destroyed.
messages.zh: 空间站已经被摧毁。

messages.en: Thanks to your efforts, we've been able to focus on pushing the Sansha back. We've driven them back to where they started, but the fighting is still hard. You've done well, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 感谢你的努力，我们能够专注于将萨沙赶回去。我们已经把他们赶回他们最初的地方，但是战斗依然很艰苦。你做得很好，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I'm not ready for an operation on this scale.  Not against the Nation.
messages.zh: 我没有准备应付那么大的任务——对付一个国家。

messages.en: Fair enough. I can't order you.
messages.zh: 相当公平。我不能命令你。

messages.en: Sansha's Nation was founded more than a century ago. Sansha was a Caldari tycoon who set out to create a utopian state. He started experiments, combining capsule technology with the human mind, creating zombie-like creatures that had the cold, calculating minds of computers, but the ingenuity of humans. When this became public knowledge, Sansha was condemned and his forces were decimated, but remnants still remain.
messages.zh: 萨沙国在一个多世纪前成立。萨沙是一个加达里大亨，决心建立一个乌托邦国度。他开始试验，把克隆技术和人类思维结合起来，创造了类似于僵尸的，拥有计算机般冷酷、精于算计的思维，同时拥有人类的创造力的生物。当这成为众所周知的事之后，萨沙被指控有罪，他的军队也被削减到十分之一，但是残余的仍旧留下来了。

messages.en: A Nation's Beginnings
messages.zh: 民族的开端

messages.en:
Understand that what I'm about to tell you is classified. If word of this got out, there would be a system-wide panic.

The Sansha recently began a campaign of expansion. Our forces have contained them so far, but every day it gets harder. The Sansha do not sleep. They do not flinch. They do not run. They have our guys running triple shifts just to keep up. The cracks in our line are already starting to show.

A new Sansha base has recently been discovered on our side of the line. We don't have the men to spare to handle it right now. I need you to take care of it. Destroy the station and any Sansha craft that may be defending it.
messages.zh:
你必须要明白我现在对你说的都是属于机密的内容。这些对话内容一旦透露出去将会引起整个星系的恐慌。

萨沙最近发动一次扩张战役。我们的军队一直将他们的行动限制在一定的范围，但战事日益紧张，难度也在加大。萨沙人不会在这时候打瞌睡，他们从来不退缩，也不会投降，他们迫使我们的人必须要三班倒，已经是疲于应付。我们得战线已经出现了裂痕。

在我们的战线之内最近发现了一座萨沙的基地。因为目前还没有人手能够抽调出来对付它，所以我们需要你去摧毁这座空间站以及任何试图抵抗的萨沙军队。

messages.en: The situation with the Sansha station cannot wait any longer. I need someone who can decide and commit, not lollygag.
messages.zh: 与萨沙空间站对峙的情况不能等下去了。我需要有人能够决定并去做，而非浪费时间。

messages.en: Lollygagger.
messages.zh: 又费马达又费电。

messages.en: There were Sansha everywhere.  I'm not going back out there, man.  You can't make me.
messages.zh: 那里到处都是萨沙。我不打算回去，伙计。你不能逼我。

messages.en: I'm not about to force you to go back, but I am disappointed.  We trusted you to do this.  You've made life a lot harder for my boys.
messages.zh: 我并不打算逼你回去，但是我很失望。我们信任你会做好，但你却使我的孩子们的生活更加艰苦了。

messages.en: Things are going badly. Because you were slow to act, the Sansha station we found launched a raid against one of our facilities. Now I have to pull people off the line to handle the mess.  Next time, make sure you can do what needs to be done.
messages.zh: 事情越来越糟。因为你行动过慢，我们发现的那个萨沙空间站对我们某个设施发动了突袭。现在我必须把人们拖离生产线来处理残局。下一次，请确定你能够做到需要你去做的事。

messages.en: Sansha station launches raid.
messages.zh: 萨沙空间站发动突袭。

messages.en: I will help you to the best of my ability. The Republic!
messages.zh: 我会尽全力帮你。为了共和国！

messages.en: On your way, captain. Death to Amarr!
messages.zh: 快去吧。艾玛必败！

messages.en: I'll serve the Republic any way I can, {[character]agentID.name}. What is needed of me?
messages.zh: 我会竭尽所能地为共和国卖命，{[character]agentID.name}。需要我做什么？

messages.en:
A few hours ago, an Amarrian strike force hit a refugee convoy in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The Amarrians have gone now, but we've picked up a distress transmission that claims there are survivors. It could be a trap, or the Amarrians may be planning to return and capture the survivors for sale as slaves in the Empire.

Warp over to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and investigate. If there really are any survivors, get them before the Amarrians do; you'll need to move quickly. And if it proves an ambush, then take out any Amarrian bastards who show themselves.
messages.zh:
数小时前艾玛攻击队在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}袭击了一支难民运送伍。那里现在看起来已经没有艾玛人，我们目前收到那里传来的一个求救信号表示可能还有幸存者。这可能是个陷阱，也可能艾玛人打算过一会儿就返回那里，把抓到的幸存者当劳工卖掉。

请跃迁往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}进行调查。如果那里确有幸存者，那你就要抢在艾玛人之前把他们带回来。动作要快。如果这是个陷阱，那就把出现的艾玛混蛋们统统干掉。

messages.en: The refugees are safe and the Amarrian ships are destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，难民已安全抵达，艾玛舰船也已被消灭。

messages.en: Thank god! We'll see to the refugees' comfort. Take your reward and my personal gratitude.
messages.zh: 谢天谢地！我们会照顾好难民的。这是你的报酬，我个人对你表示由衷感谢。

messages.en: I know it's important, but the danger sounds too great. I can't risk my ship over a few civilians.
messages.zh: 我知道这事重要，但其风险也太大了。我不会为自个平民去牺牲我的舰船的。

messages.en: I'm… shocked. My reports have you a fearless, dedicated veteran. I am supremely disappointed, both in you and in my intelligence.
messages.zh: 我……被雷了。报告上还说你是个勇敢忠心的经验老到的战士呢。我彻底失望了，不光是对你，也对我的情报人员。

messages.en:
You may already know that Amarr is preparing for war. It seems that they want to take back what they feel was once rightfully theirs and make us all slaves in the process. It will be the Day of Darkness all over again, if they have their way.

But they will not. We Minmatar will not kneel to that sociopathic, god-mongering cult run by feeble cybernetic monstrosities. The Amarrians will either perish or slay us to the last — either way, they will never again make us their slaves.

We've not come to open warfare yet, but the Imperials have been raiding along the frontier, trying to provoke us into a fight. A few hours ago they hit a refugee convoy in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The Amarrians have gone, but we've picked up a distress transmission that claims there are survivors. It could be a trap, or the Amarrians may be planning to return and capture the survivors for sale as slaves in the Empire.

So, we need a good, capable captain who's willing to warp over to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and investigate. If there really are any survivors, get them before the Amarrians do; survivors may not last long out there, so you'll need to move quickly.

If it proves an ambush, then take out any Amarrian bastards who show themselves. Will you do it?
messages.zh:
你可能已经知道艾玛正在做打仗的准备。他们好像想夺回自以为是他们的东西，同时还想再奴役我们一次。如果让他们得逞，那我们等于又要经历一段黑暗的日子。

他们这次绝不会再得逞。艾玛人是一群被纸老虎控制的反人类、唱鬼神的邪教，我们米玛塔尔人不会再向他们屈服。艾玛人只有两个选择，要么死，要么就把我们都干掉——反正我们是不会再从奴的。

我们还没正式开战，但那帮帝国主义鬼子已经开始骚扰我们的边境，试图挑衅我们。数小时前他们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}袭击了一支难民运送伍。那里现在看起来已经没有艾玛人，我们目前收到那里传来的一个求救信号声称还有幸存者。这可能是个陷阱。也可能艾玛人打算过一会儿就返回那里，把抓到的幸存者当劳工卖掉。

因此我们需要一位有能力、有意愿，敢跃迁往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}进行调查的船长。如果那里确有幸存者，那你就要抢在艾玛人之前把他们带回来。幸存者在那里可能活不长，你动作要快。

如果这是个陷阱，那就把出现的艾玛混蛋们统统干掉。你接收这任务吗？

messages.en: I'll take care of the problem, {[character]agentID.name}. This intrusion must be stopped.
messages.zh: 我会处理这个问题，{[character]agentID.name}。这次骚扰一定会被制止的。

messages.en: Here's the coordinates for where the deal is going down. Good hunting, kirjuun.
messages.zh: 这是交易发生地点的坐标。好好收拾你的猎物，伙计。

messages.en: How can I be of service to {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} and the State, kirjuun?
messages.zh: 我该如何服务 {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}以及加达里州，伙计？

messages.en: A gang of Serpentis cartel thugs is being used by Federation intelligence to slip assets into the State during drugs runs. You are to intercept one of these runs in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system, destroy the Serpentis vessels there, and recover any prisoners you can find. Bring them back to your agent so that they can be remanded to Tribunal custody.
messages.zh: 一伙天蛇集团的暴徒被联邦情报局借着违规药品交易的机会，安插进了加达里州内部。你要前去截获其中一起位于 {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的交易，摧毁那里的天蛇舰队，并找回所有你能找到的囚犯。把他们带回来交给你的代理人，还押于法院囚禁所。

messages.en: The drug runners' ships have been destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}, and I managed to bring back a few of them alive for interrogation.
messages.zh: 违规药品贩子的舰船已经被摧毁了，{[character]agentID.name}，并且我抓了几个活的回来审问。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. You've done a great job for the State and this corporation.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。你为加达里州和这个企业干了件大好事。

messages.en: I don't think I feel like dealing with this mess right now.
messages.zh: 我不认为现在我有情绪处理这个乱局。

messages.en: Most disappointing, pilot. How can you sit idly by while the Federation poisons our bodies and our minds? Hopefully someone else will have the courage to stand up to them.
messages.zh: 太令人失望了，飞行员。在联邦毒害我们的思想和身体的时候，你怎么竟然能够呆坐着不动？真希望有人能有勇气，站起来反抗他们阿。

messages.en:
Some critics might argue that the State has a complicated relationship with organized crime. While the various criminal enterprises in the State (including the Guristas) do cut into the bottom line of the megacorporations, these enterprises are also used by said corporations as a means of arm's-length corporate espionage. Or so the pundits say.

Therefore, these cynical observers aver, while corporate security generally tries to keep a firm hand against the criminal syndicates, their upper management simultaneously ensures that the symbiotic relationship between the corporations and the syndicates is preserved, often to the frustration of the security forces and the Navy.
messages.zh:
一些评论也许会论述加达里州与这次组织犯罪背后有一些复杂的关系。大约如一些学者所说，在各个州内的犯罪集团们（包括古利斯塔）渐渐成为特大公司的同时，他们也被一些公司用作间谍。

因此，这些愤世嫉俗的观察者们断言，当公司安保部门都在努力对付联合犯罪组织的时候，他们的上层管理也同时在努力确保公司和这些犯罪组织的共生关系能够长久发展，总是使安保力量和海军感到挫败。

messages.en: Organized Crime in the State
messages.zh: 加达里州内有组织的犯罪

messages.en:
We've recently received intelligence that a deal is going down in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system between a Caldari buyer and a minor, local branch of the Serpentis drug cartel. While this is a bit of a concern in and of itself, the bigger problem is that we believe the cartel is being paid by elements within the Federation intelligence community; their goal, apparently, is to use this particular drug route as a way to insert intelligence assets into the State. That is of considerably greater concern to us.

We would like you to fly to the coordinates of this rendezvous, eliminate the Serpentis vessels there, and recover any prisoners that you can find. We'll turn them over to the Tribunal for further questioning.
messages.zh:
最近我们收到情报，加达里买家与天蛇违规药品集团的一个本地分部将会在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系进行交易。尽管问题本身已经令人烦恼，但是更严重的是，我们相信那个违规药品集团的资金来源于联邦情报局中的某些部门；他们的目的，很显然，就是利用这条违规药品交易的路线，把他们的间谍安插进加达里州。那使我们相当担心。

我们希望你前去他们会面的坐标地点，消灭那里的天蛇舰队，并找回所有你能发现的囚犯。我们将把他们移交法院进行进一步审讯。

messages.en: Due to your lack of action, {[character]player.name}, I was forced to find another pilot to carry out this mission. Hopefully, in the future, you will be more punctual, pilot.
messages.zh: 因为你的不作为，{[character]player.name}，我不得不另找一个飞行员来解决这个任务。希望以后你会变得更加守时，飞行员。

messages.en: Drug runners captured
messages.zh: 抓获非法贩售者

messages.en: I... I've decided that I don't want to go after these Serpentis guys. You did hear what they did to the last guy who tried, right?
messages.zh: 我...我决定不去追赶这群天蛇的家伙。你听说过他们是怎么对付上一个这么尝试的人的，不是吗？

messages.en: I thought you had a bit more fortitude. It's people like you that allow the Federation to get away with committing this kind of treachery.
messages.zh: 我本以为你会更加坚强。是人们喜爱你，才让联邦背着背叛的罪名离开的。

messages.en: You failed to stop the drug deal, and likely Federation penetration of our borders as well. There is little doubt that this will put us at an even greater disadvantage against our enemies than we were already dealing with. While I hope for your sake that I am wrong, I fear that you have cost us more than you can possibly imagine.
messages.zh: 你没能阻止违规药品交易，也许也没能阻止联邦渗透我们的边境。毫无疑问这使我们在面对敌人的时候处于一个相当不利的境遇。尽管我希望我错了，但是恐怕你造成的损失远远超过你的想象。

messages.en: Drug runners escape
messages.zh: 非法贩售者逃跑了

messages.en: You take it out back, have one last look at it, then put a bullet in its furry little head.
messages.zh: 你把它放回去，最后看它一眼，然后给它的脑袋来一枪。

messages.en: Huh. That's right. Guess you might be useful after all. Alright, then, my young protégé: Stage two – here's the coordinates. I'm not giving you a damn thing. Go show me you're more than just talk!
messages.zh: 嗯，这是对的。我猜你还是有用的。那好吧，我年轻的跟班：第二步——这是坐标。我不会给你任何报酬。去向我展示一下你除了说废话以外还会干点别的！

messages.en: Uh… wha-?! Like, vermin in your apartment or something? You know I'm a capsuleer, right?
messages.zh: 啊……什么？！就像你房间里的虫子？你知道我是个克隆飞行员对吧？

messages.en:
This is a pre-recorded message: Why are you lookin' here? You forget somethin'? Are you stupid, 's that it? We're barely done talkin' and it all already slipped outta your head? GO KILL THE DAMN TRAITOR.

Damn rookies.
messages.zh:
这是一条事先录制的信息：你为什么在这里东张西望？你忘了什么东西？你很蠢是不是？你就光在这里聊天，把要做的事情抛在脑后了？去给我干掉那叛徒。

你这该死的新手。

messages.en: Hop, hop, bang. "Crap, I'm dead." I think it's payday.
messages.zh: 跳着跳着，砰的一声。“该死，我挂了。”今天还是发薪日呢。

messages.en: Good work, Rookie! Now go and have yourself a party on me. Oh, and remember: this is what happens to bad bunnies. Don't get any funny ideas under those long, furry ears of yours.
messages.zh: 干得好，新手！现在去好好庆祝一下吧。哦对了，还要记住：这就是坏兔子的下场。听清楚，不要打什么鬼主意。

messages.en: Uhm… what I do is… or what someone needs to do, at least, is stop gobbling the ol' Blue Pill. I think you need to get some rest… and maybe some rehab. Sheesh.
messages.zh: 嗯……我该做的是……或者只不过是需要有个人去做，是停止吃ol'蓝药片。我想你该休息一下……恢复一下。

messages.en: Wrong answer, Rookie. Howsabout you take that tub of yours and paddle back to State space before you figure out you can't swim with the big fish.
messages.zh: 答错了，新手。你还不如在你认识到你不能抱着大鱼去游泳之前带上你的浴盆回老家去。

messages.en:
A traditional Caldari privateer's song

Oh, poor old man, your bunny will die.
And we say so, and we know so.
Oh, poor old man, your bunny gonna die
Oh, poor old man!

We'll drag it down to the State line,
We'll drop it down inside the border,
We'll drop it off into the void, hey.

We'll drop it off into the void, now,
Sing it down with a long, long roll.
The peggies can have its body,
And the devil can have its soul.
messages.zh:
一首传统的加达里海盗歌曲

哦，可怜的老家伙，你的兔子要死了。
既然我们这么说，当然是知道。
哦，可怜的老家伙，你的兔子要死了
哦，可怜的老家伙！

我们会把它拽过国界，
我们会把它扔在边疆，
我们会把它扔进虚空，嘿。

我们现在就把它扔进虚空，
就这样反复唱着。
假腿能得到它的躯体，
恶魔能得到它的灵魂。

messages.en: "Ol' Blue Pill"
messages.zh: “Ol'蓝药片”

messages.en:
You heard me, {[character]player.name}. Animal problems. And stop lookin' at me like I'm crazy or I'll be tempted to do somthin' we'll both regret. Just shut up and listen.

This is what happens: You scour the land, lookin' hard and far and wide and all that. After much of that business, you find yourself a good bunny. Real proper, no poser crap – the real deal. Least that's what you think. You give this bunny everything of yourself. All your knowledge, all your expertise, all your damn money. Hell… all your love, even. I said stop lookin' at me like that!

What was I–? Oh… right.

So, for a while that works well – with a real big emphasis on the "for a while" bit. This little bunny looks after itself proper, looks after you real good in turn too. As it damn well should, little bugger. Then one day, outta the blue, it seems to think it's had enough. Thinks it will just hop on over to the Mordus Legion and work for them instead. After everything you've done for it. "Better money," it says. "Doing what's right," it says. Dumb bunny. Real damn stupid.

You know what you do next, right? Go on, tell me what you do and prove you're not as green as you look.
messages.zh:
你听到我说的话了，{[character]player.name}。关于动物的问题。别这样看着我，好像我疯了或者我要做一件让我们俩都后悔的事情似的。闭上嘴听我说。

现在的情况是：你要在这里上上下下仔细地找，就这些。一番忙碌之后，你要找到一只兔子。很简单，没有任何麻烦——实际上就是这样。至少你就是这样想的。你得把你的一切都给这只兔子。你的知识、你的技术，和你所有的钱。还有……你所有的爱。我说过了不要像这样看着我！

我……？哦……对。

那么，暂时还顺利——要强调的是“暂时”。这只小兔子把自己照顾得很好，反过来也把你照顾得不错。就像预想的那么好，小家伙。直到有一天，要作好最坏打算。打算要好好责骂一通莫德团，然后为他们工作。在你做完这些之后。“更多的钱”，它说。“做正确的事。”它说。这哑兔子，真是愚蠢至极。

你知道接下来要怎么做对吧？继续做下去，告诉我你都做了些什么，向我证明一下你不像表面上那么嫩。

messages.en: I forgot what I was supposed to do, so I figure I'll just do nothing instead. Seeya.
messages.zh: 我忘了我要做什么，所以我觉得还是什么都不做吧。再见。

messages.en: Eh… useless after all. I knew it. I could smell the fear on you, ya damn rookie! Howsabout you forget about that next time, eh? You got a damn pod, what more could ya want?
messages.zh: 呃……根本没有用。我知道这首歌。我能感觉到你在害怕，你这该死的新手！你下次能不能别老想着它，嗯？你已经爆舱了，你还想怎么样？

messages.en: I'll hit ‘em hard for you, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我会为你狠狠的揍他们的，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Good. Here are the coordinates for the transmitter; remember, you must destroy it and any vessels that would defend it, but it isn't necessary to engage the Republic Navy ships. Get out if you have to.
messages.zh: 好。这些是发射机的坐标；记住，你必须摧毁它和一切保卫发射机的船只，不过没有必要把共和国海军的船只牵扯进来。必要的时候可要逃出来。

messages.en: Oh? What sort of mission is that?
messages.zh: 哦？那是什么样的任务？

messages.en: The "Brothers of Freedom" have set up an FTL transmitter in the area of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and are broadcasting anti-corporate propaganda into the State, with the help of some Minmatar sympathizers. This situation is completely unacceptable; the transmitter must be destroyed, and we want you take care of it. Eliminate the transmitter and any hostile ships nearby. If the Minmatar Navy interferes, you can take out their vessels as well, but it's not strictly necessary.
messages.zh: “自由兄弟会”在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造了超光速发射机并且在国内散播反集团的宣传, 在米玛塔尔的拥护者的帮助下。真是让人无法接受这种局面；发射机一定要被摧毁，我们希望你能看好它。消灭发射机及在周围的敌船。如果米玛塔尔的海军介入，也一样干了它，不过并不是一定要那样做。

messages.en: The transmitter has been destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm just disappointed I didn't catch Torvil there himself.
messages.zh: 传信器已经摧毁了，{[character]agentID.name}。我就是后悔我怎么没有活捉托维尔。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. Perhaps Torvil will restrict himself to overpaid speaking engagements for bleeding-heart, over-privileged Gallente from now on, instead of trying to spit in our faces.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。也许托维尔今后就没功夫对着我们唾沫横飞了，他得要和那些有着巨额薪水，感情脆弱且过分民主的盖伦特人好好的费费口舌了。

messages.en: I don't think I want to mess with it if it's inside the Republic. I hear they eat their prisoners.
messages.zh: 如果那是在共和国的内部的话，我想我还是不要去乱搞。我听说他们会把囚犯煮来吃掉。

messages.en: Don't tell me you actually sympathize with these morons? For your sake, I hope you don't.
messages.zh: 别告诉我你真的“同情”这些傻子？为了你好，我希望你别这样。

messages.en:
Formerly an extremist labor movement in the State, the Brothers of Freedom led a widespread revolt against corporate security forces on a number of Caldari planets a number of years ago -- some time before Tibus Heth's vastly more successful revolt of a similar nature -- after 65,000 protesters were killed by Caldari paramilitary forces while trying to force their way onto a CEP station in the New Caldari system. After months of dogged pursuit by Caldari authorities, the riots were put down and most of the leaders were killed or arrested.

Some of the leadership, including the ringleader Melarius Torvil, did manage to escape the final Caldari Navy operation that crushed the Brothers' movement. Torvil and a small group of associates fled to the Minmatar Republic and applied for asylum from Caldari persecution, which was granted by then-President Midular's Gallente-friendly government.

Today, though they have been largely eliminated as a major force in the State, the Brothers of Freedom continue to spread anti-corporate propaganda and speak out against the CEP's government in the Gallente Federation and the Minmatar Nation, as well as outlying State settlements and facilities.
messages.zh:
自由兄弟会的前身是一场极端主义劳工运动。几年前，在广大抗议者试图闯进新加达里星系中的一座CEO合作组织空间站的时候，有六万五千人被加达里准军事部队加害。因此自由兄弟会在许多加达里的星球上开展广泛的对抗集团安全部队的运动，之后，提波斯·赫特领导了一次更成功的类似性质的反抗。在加达里当局长达几个月的执拗的追击后，暴动终于平息，而且大多数领导人都死亡或被捕。

不过有一些领导人，包括会长米拉瑞斯·托维尔，成功地逃脱了最后加达里海军对兄弟会运动的控制。托维尔和一小部分同伴都逃去了米玛塔尔共和国，并且申请免受加达里迫害的庇护。亲盖伦特的时任米杜拉政府准予了他们的请求。

今天，虽然这支重要的力量在加达里境内已基本被清除，自由兄弟会仍然在其他地区宣传反对CEO合作组织及其政府。他们的活动遍及盖伦特联邦，米玛塔尔共和国，和加达里偏远地区的定居点与设施。

messages.en: The Brothers of Freedom
messages.zh: 自由兄弟会

messages.en:
In the last few weeks, we've become aware of an FTL transmitter in the area which has been broadcasting anti-corporate propaganda into the State. Usually, the Federation isn't quite this bold in its slander of our state, so a number of corporate intelligence offices looked into the matter and found to our surprise that this transmitter is actually being run by someone we are all too familiar with: Melarius Torvil and his so-called “Brothers of Freedom.”

Obviously, we cannot allow this situation to continue. Torvil's persistent ability to elude capture by Caldari authorities is frustrating enough, but we cannot simply stand by while he rubs it in our faces. Frankly, the fact that the Republic is allowing this kind of dangerous nonsense makes me thankful our militia capsuleers are giving them a hard time.

Anyway, we would like you to fly to the transmitter in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}: Destroy it and any Minmatar vessels in the area. If the Republic Navy sends any ships to assist, feel free to eliminate them as well, but it isn't necessary; I don't think they'll be willing to stick their necks out over what is a rather diplomatically shady activity anyway.

What do you say? Can you handle this for me?
messages.zh:
在最后几周内，我们渐渐意识到了在国内散播反集团的宣传的超光速发射机。通常，联盟不会如此无耻地中伤我们的国家，所以一些企业情报办公室调查此事并且让我们惊讶的是控制这个发射机的人是我们都熟悉不过的：Melarius Torvil和他所谓的“自由兄弟会”。

显然，我们不能让这种局面延续。长久以来Torvil都逃脱了加达里当局的抓捕已经够令人沮丧了，然而我们不能冷眼旁观否则他们就要到我们头上动土。老实说，共和国对于这种危险的毫无意义的事情默许让我对感谢国民军飞行员没给他们好日子。

总之，我们想要你飞去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的发射器：把它和那个区域里米玛塔尔的船只一起摧毁。如果共和国派船只来援助，毫无顾忌地把它们也都消灭掉吧，不过并没有那个必要；我想他们不会乐意在这样一件相当黑暗的外交行动中冒险。

你说呢？你能帮我解决一下吗？

messages.en: I never heard back from you, {[character]player.name}, so I'm going to assume you don't have the stomach to take care of this Brothers of Freedom tyuui. That's unfortunate, but thankfully there are plenty of other loyal Caldari pilots out there looking for work.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你从未给过我答复，所以我以为你不想管自由兄弟会的事了。真不走运，不过谢天谢地外面仍有很多忠诚的加达里飞行员需要工作。

messages.en: Mission offer withdrawn
messages.zh: 任务收回

messages.en: I've decided it's not worth risking my hide just to shut up someone who's making fun of you. Do your own dirty work.
messages.zh: 我决定了那不值得我冒着危险只是为了让取笑你的人闭上他的嘴。自己去干那些破事吧。

messages.en: I'm not sure you're thinking this through: the Brothers of Freedom are more of a threat than you realize. Perhaps you'll learn before it's too late.
messages.zh: 我不知道你是否想清楚了：自由兄弟会比你想的更危险。或许在事态还不是很严重之前你会了解的。

messages.en: Because you couldn't take out the Brothers of Freedom transmitter, some soft-headed fools at one of our border mining colonies seem to have taken their “sermons” to heart and, in the wake of Heth's recent successes, have begun a wildcat strike, setting back production and causing a number of injuries and even a few deaths. I hope you realize what your failure here cost us, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 由于你不能拿走自由兄弟会的发射机 ,赫人最近的成功致使我们边境采矿殖民地里一些愚蠢的傻瓜似乎听信了他们的“说教”，并且擅自罢工，导致生产延误，很多人受伤甚至有些人死亡。我希望你能意识到你的失败所为此付出的代价，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Labor riots on Caldari colony
messages.zh: 加达里殖民地上的劳工暴动

messages.en: Seems straightforward enough. Are these Athrans hostile?
messages.zh: 好像很简单啊。这帮阿什兰人凶残吗？

messages.en: It's possible, but not generally, no. If they do engage, don't feel obliged to mess with them, unless you feel you're in no danger.
messages.zh: 有些是的，但大多数不是。如果他们来袭击你，不要和他们纠缠，除非你很有自信。

messages.en: Well, thanks. I'm just wondering if you might have some work for a recent graduate. I'm a decent combat pilot.
messages.zh: 谢谢。我在想你手上有没有适合新毕业生干的活。我可是个不错的飞行员。

messages.en:
You've heard of the "Athran Brotherhood"? No? Well, that's no surprise, really. They're little more than a nuisance, and few in number. But they can be a pain at times. That's what I want you to find out for me, actually.

There's a small station built into an old asteroid near here: It used to be a mining outpost till they hollowed the thing out. It's been abandoned for a few years now, but some rumors of activity in that area have been surfacing. And I suspect it may have become the hideout for a chapter of the Athran Brotherhood. I need you to go check those rumors out and let me know what you find.

All you need to do is fly close to the structure and see if you pick up any short-range radio transmissions or see any other signs of activity. Then get back here and let me know what you found.
messages.zh:
你听说过“阿什兰兄弟会”吗？没有？也难怪。他们也就是帮乌合之众而已。但有时他们也会让人头疼。我们确信他们在这附近有个基地，但具体藏身之地还未知。你的任务就是把它找出来。

附近的小行星上有个小空间站，在那里的矿石被采尽之前，那空间站曾一直是个采矿基地。现在那里已被废弃多年，但最近有传言称那里有点状况。我怀疑那里已经成了阿什兰兄弟会的一个藏身地。我要你去那里看看传言是否准确，然后回来向我报告。

你要做的就是飞到一个建筑那里，看看能否收到短距无线电信号或是有任何人员活动迹象。然后回来向我报告结果就行。
