messages.en: Alright, I went out there, and I definitely picked up some Athran radio transmissions. I also picked up some carbon scoring when they opened fire on me...
messages.zh: 我飞到那里，确实收到了一些阿什兰人的无线电信号，另外我还和他们干上了一架……

messages.en: Yeah, I got your ship's logs once you docked. Stick around and talk to me again in a bit, would you? We need to get to the bottom of this.
messages.zh: 是啊，你停靠后我就收到了你舰船上的记录。请不要离开这里，过会儿就来找我。我们要把这事弄个水落石出。

messages.en: Sounds pretty dull, actually. I think I'll pass.
messages.zh: 听上去很无聊啊。我还是不干了。

messages.en:
Sometimes calling itself "The Scions of Athra," the Athran Brotherhood is a group of Khanid secessionists with headquarters located on the Khanid homeworld of Amarr Prime (called Athra in the Old Khanid tongue). This group tends to rise perhaps every other generation or so, seemingly from its own ashes, making trouble for local government and interstellar trade alike.

Given the many large pirate organizations and other independent "freebooters" of New Eden, not to mention the constant weight of intergalactic politics and the ongoing "Minmatar Problem," Amarr rulers cannot generally spare a large-scale military effort to deal with these relatively minor troublemakers. Perhaps this is the reason the Brotherhood seems never to die, but always reappears just when authorities start to think they've rid themselves of the nuisance.
messages.zh:
阿什兰兄弟会，有时自称为“阿什兰之后”，是一个卡尼迪分离论者组织。总部设在艾玛首星的卡尼迪家园（古卡尼迪语中叫做阿什兰）。这个组织随着一代又一代人浮浮沉沉，似乎就是不甘寂寞，总在扰乱星际贸易，给当地政府找麻烦。

因为新伊甸有许多大型海盗组织和其他独立的“自由海盗”，更不用说持续的星际政治斗争及“米玛塔尔问题”，艾玛统治者根本腾不出手来对付这些无足轻重的滋事者。也许这就是为什么阿什兰兄弟会能够生存至今的原因吧，他们总是在权贵们觉得已经摆脱他们的骚扰之后又死灰复燃地出现。

messages.en: The Athran Brotherhood
messages.zh: 阿什兰兄弟会

messages.en:
You don't say! Well, yes, in fact, I do have something I could use you for.

You've heard of the "Athran Brotherhood"? No? Well, that's no surprise, really. They're little more than a nuisance, and few in number. But they can be a pain at times. And we're pretty sure there's a chapter of them hereabouts. But we don't know where they're hiding out. That's what I want you to find out for me, actually.

There's a small station built into an old asteroid near here. Used to be a mining outpost till they hollowed the thing out. It's been abandoned for a few years now, but some rumors of activity in that area have been surfacing. I need you to go check those rumors out and let me know what you find.

Seem like something you'd be interested in?
messages.zh:
别说大话！不过我这里确实还有适合你干的事。

你听说过“阿什兰兄弟会”吗？没有？也难怪。他们也就是帮乌合之众而已。但有时他们也会让人头疼。我们确信他们在这附近有个基地，但具体藏身之地还未知。你的任务就是把它找出来。

附近的小行星上有个小空间站，在那里的矿石被采尽之前，那空间站曾一直是个采矿基地。现在那里已被废弃多年，但最近有传言称那里有点状况。我要你去那里看看传言是否准确，然后回来向我报告。

这事你有兴趣干吗？

messages.en: I've given it some more thought, and actually I'm not sure I'm up to tracking down these Athrans for you. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我仔细考虑了一下，发现自己能力有限。不好意思。

messages.en: You bet. I'll be back before you can say, "Hey, where'd you go?"
messages.zh: 行，本人速去速回。

messages.en: That's what I like to hear. Be careful out there, eh? These Athrans seem more... volatile than most.
messages.zh: 这正是我要的回答。当心点。那帮阿什兰人似乎比其他人更……脾气暴躁。

messages.en: Excellent. More Athran harassment?
messages.zh: 好啊。是不是要再去骚扰一下阿什兰人？

messages.en:
We've learned that the remaining Athrans pulled out as soon as you left your last mission. Fortunately, one of our recon pilots was able to trail them to another location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

{[character]player.name}, head out there and find out what's going on. See what these Athrans are up to, and report any suspicious activity back to me. And if they open fire on you again, you're fully authorized to shoot back. Don't take any chances.
messages.zh:
我们已经了解到你一离开那里，那帮剩下的阿什兰人也跟着撤了。我们的一位特勤飞行员一直跟着他们到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的另一个地方。

{[character]player.name}，我要你飞往那里看看情况。看看那帮阿什兰人到底在搞什么名堂，然后向我报告任何可疑情况。如果他们这次向你开火，那你就有权还击。这次要直面他们。

messages.en: I found those Athrans, alright. And they're in league with the Minmatar, it would seem. They made pretty short work of a chapel structure out there.
messages.zh: 我发现那些阿什兰人了。看上去他们与米玛塔尔人是一伙儿的。他们用很短的时间就在那里建起了一座教堂。

messages.en: I wonder what was so important about that chapel… Hm. Give me a while to look into this, then come back and see me, will you? Thanks.
messages.zh: 让我想想那教堂对他们到底有什么重要之处……嗯。给我点时间让我考虑一下，然后你再来见我好吗？谢谢。

messages.en: What if it's a trap? I mean, they seemed to know I was coming last time, right? Sorry, but I just can't risk my ship....
messages.zh: 万一这是个陷阱怎么办？他们好像知道上次就是我去的。不好意思，我不想拿我的船冒险……

messages.en: Suit yourself. I was giving you a chance to be of service to your nation, but if you want to hide behind your degree, well… I can't stop you.
messages.zh: 你还是回家种地去吧。我给你为国效力的机会，但你表现得却像个缩头乌龟……算了，我不能强迫你。

messages.en:
Always be ready to warp out if you start taking heavy damage, whether in a mission or in lawless space. Sometimes it's a good idea to have a jump route selected before going into a mission so you can simply click your autopilot to get out quickly; this is a valid approach only with relatively small ships, though. Eventually, once you get into something like a Battleship, aligning to warp can take so long — especially if you begin once you're already taking heavy damage — that your ship might be destroyed by the time you actually start your warp.

Remember too that if you take damage in battle, you can always return to a nearby station for repairs; also be sure to replenish your ammunition while you're there if you're running low. Combat in EVE can be deadly and costly, so do what you can to cut your losses.

"It's better to warp away and fight again another day."
messages.zh:
不管是做任务还是在0.0区域打架，如果你已严重受损，那就要做好随时跃迁出去的准备。有时在出去做任务时不妨先选好一条跳跃路线，这样便于你到时候用自动导航就能撤退；但这方法只适用于小船。等你哪一天驾驶战列舰的时候，尤其当你已经严重受损的时候，到那会儿你再启动跃迁就已经太晚了。

还要记住如果你已经受损，那你可以返回邻近的空间站进行修理；如果你弹药不够还可以乘机补充一下。新伊甸中的战斗死亡率高花费大，因此要想尽一切方法降低损失。

“跃迁撤离来日再战是个明智的做法。”

messages.en: Battle Tips
messages.zh: 战术秘诀

messages.en:
Yes. We put a covert ops ship out there around the same time you left for your last mission, and the pilot corroborated your story. He also reports that the remaining Athrans pulled out as soon as you left. Fortunately, he was able to trail them to another location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

{[character]player.name}, I want you to head out there and find out what's going on. See what these Athrans are up to, and report any suspicious activity back to me. And if they open fire on you again, you're fully authorized to shoot back. Don't take any chances.
messages.zh:
是的。就在你上次任务结束时，我们派了一艘特勤舰也去了那里，那飞行员的报告与你的正吻合。他的报告还称，你一离开那里，那帮剩下的阿什兰人也就跟着撤。后来那飞行员一直跟到他们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的另一个地方。

{[character]player.name}，我要你飞往那里看看情况。看看那帮阿什兰人到底在搞什么名堂，然后向我报告任何可疑情况。如果他们这次向你开火，那你就有权还击。这次要直面他们。

messages.en: The Athrans seem pretty dangerous. I think I'm throwing in the towel. Sorry.
messages.zh: 阿什兰人很凶险。我想我还是免了吧。不好意思。

messages.en: I had doubts about you all along, to be honest. Just goes to show I'm still a good judge of character.
messages.zh: 说实话我一开始就对你的能力产生怀疑。我看人是很准的。

messages.en: Finally, we're taking the fight to them. I'll be there in moments.
messages.zh: 我们终于可以拿起枪对付他们了。我马上出发。

messages.en: Good show. But be careful out there: They may know you're coming.
messages.zh: 很好，但要小心：他们可能对你已经有所准备了。

messages.en: I certainly am. Have you been able to discover what the Athrans were after?
messages.zh: 当然了。你知道那帮阿什兰人在搞什么鬼了吗？

messages.en: The Athran Brotherhood has an ammunitions depot located in this very system. If we can take it out, we'll seriously disrupt their plans, whatever they might be. In fact, they have a Bestower full of explosives docking there shortly: Get over there and take out that ship, then deal with the depot itself. They're sure to have some guards, but you've proven yourself capable of dealing with them.
messages.zh: 阿什兰兄弟会在此星系有个弹药库。不管他们的计划到底是什么，只要我们能把这个弹药库端掉，他们的计划便会流产。事实上他们已经有一艘装满爆炸物的恩赐者级即将停靠：你要赶往那里先把那船毁掉，然后再把弹药库端掉。那里当然会有人值守，但我想你已经证明你行的。

messages.en: Woo! That was one big explosion. That's my kind of mission.
messages.zh: 哇，我制造了次大爆炸。这任务合我胃口。

messages.en: Glad you enjoyed it. Listen, this all may not be over yet, so don't wander too far off, okay?
messages.zh: 你能喜欢这任务我很高兴。听着，事情还没完，所以不要走太远好吗？

messages.en: Hm, I don't know. Their munitions depot is bound to be heavily guarded. Maybe you should get someone more experienced to handle this one. Too risky.
messages.zh: 呃……他们那弹药库肯定有重兵把守。也许你应该找个更有经验的人来处理这事儿。这事风险太大。

messages.en: You can't always take the safe way out, you know. Sometimes a warrior has to bleed a little to serve his nation... or hers. Point is, danger is part of the job.
messages.zh: 不可能一直有软柿子让你捏，懂吗？为了国家，士兵有时必须流点血。没有不危险的任务。

messages.en:
Well, it seems they're simply trying to disrupt the local infrastructure. What they seek to gain by doing so, I don't know... but that's the terrorist mentality for you.

But what's more interesting is that I've discovered they have an ammunitions depot not far from here. If we can take it out, we'll seriously disrupt their plans, whatever they might be. In fact, they have a Bestower full of explosives docking shortly: Get over there and take out that ship, then deal with the depot itself. They're sure to have some guards, but you've proven yourself capable of dealing with them. God speed.
messages.zh:
他们好像想破坏当地的基础设施。他们这么做的目的究竟是什么，我现在还不得而知……但这可能就是恐怖分子的思路吧。

有意思的是我发现他们在离这不远的地方有个弹药库。不管他们的计划到底是什么，只要我们能把这个弹药库端掉，他们的计划便会流产。事实上他们已经有一艘装满爆炸物的恩赐者级即将停靠：你要赶往那里先把那船毁掉，然后再把弹药库端掉。那里当然会有人值守，但我想你已经证明你行的。祝你成功。

messages.en: Uh, I've decided this mission isn't for me. Sorry, but you'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 啊，我觉得这任务不适合我。不好意思，你去找别人吧。

name.de: Ein neues Unternehmen - Gesunder Wettbewerb (3 von 5)
name.en: A New Venture – Healthy Competition (3 of 5)
name.es: Una nueva empresa: Sana competencia (3 de 5)
name.fr: Nouvelle entreprise - Une saine concurrence (3 sur 5)
name.ja: 新たな冒険-健全な競争（3/5）
name.ru: Новое предприятие – здоровая конкуренция (A New Venture – Healthy Competition) (3 из 5)

messages.en: A chance to take out one of those spineless couriers without risking CONCORD? Consider it done!
messages.zh: 让我有机会在无统合部干扰的情况下去炸毁那些嬴弱的运输船？没问题！

messages.en: That's what I like to hear!
messages.zh: 我就是要得到这样的回答！

messages.en: Nothing like a little healthy competition, right?
messages.zh: 有点竞争总是好事吧？

messages.en:
There's a small family-run corporation operating in the neighboring system. They keep getting exclusive contracts because they keep their shipments secret and secure. But I've figured out where they go.

Intercept the ship, blow it up, and bring the supplies--construction tools, I think-- back to me.
messages.zh:
旁边的星系里有个小型家族企业。他们能拿到排他合同的原因是他们把货物统统存放在一个隐秘的地方。现在我已经知道他们的一批货物将在何时何地出现。

拦下飞船，把它摧毁掉，然后把货物——我猜是建造工具——带来给我。

messages.en: It's done. Here are the construction tools.
messages.zh: 搞定了，建造工具带来了。

messages.en: Hah! Let's see how they do without their exclusive stock! Don't go anywhere. There's more to be done.
messages.zh: 哈哈！没了专属货物看他们怎么办！先别走，还有事儿呢。

messages.en: I'm not going to take out a lowly courier, risk or no risk.
messages.zh: 不管有没有风险，我都不会去攻击一艘手无寸铁的运输船。

messages.en: Come on, this is a professional hauler. He almost doesn't even count as a person.
messages.zh: 算了吧，这只是艘专业货船。他几乎都不算上个人物。

messages.en: Truth be told, nowhere in the universe is safe for the humble courier. Even though CONCORD patrols the so-called "hi-sec" areas of space (security rating 0.5-1.0), that doesn't ensure your protection one hundred percent. It is possible for a capsuleer of sufficient skill or equipment to take out another capsuleer before CONCORD fully retaliates. Usually the certainty of losing a ship to CONCORD is enough to dissuade hi-sec attacks, but if the payout or cargo is worth enough, an attacker might think it worth the trouble.
messages.zh: 说实话，对运输船来说，宇宙中到处都是危险。即使在统合部值勤巡逻的所谓“高安全”区域（安全等级0.5-1.0），你的安全也没法得到百分百的保证。一位有本事、装备精良的飞行员是有可能赶在统合部到场之前将另一位飞行员干掉的。一般来说在高安全区，人们是不会顶着舰船必被统合部击爆的结果去攻击其他舰船的，但如果报酬巨大或者货物价值连城，那还是会有人誓死一博的。

messages.en: Attacking Couriers or Haulers in Hi-sec
messages.zh: 在高安全区袭击运输船

messages.en:
There's a small family-run corporation operating in the neighboring system. A real pain, you know? They've got a corner on just about every small commodity in the region. I can't even get any of their suppliers to sell to me, and it's pissing me off.

I've got a plan, though. They keep getting exclusive contracts because they keep their shipments secret and secure. But I've figured out where they go. I know when and where one of their supply shipments are going to be. And even better, it's in a dead space pocket that CONCORD doesn't monitor.

Intercept the ship, blow it up, and bring the supplies--construction tools, I think-- back to me.
messages.zh:
旁边的星系里有个小型家族企业。你知道吗，他们让人很头痛。他们在该星域里的经销范围几乎涵盖了每一种日常小用品，牢牢抓住了市场份额。我想从他们供货商那里进货是不可能的，而这也让我非常光火。

不过我有办法。他们能拿到排他合同的原因是他们把货物统统存放在一个隐秘的地方。现在我已了解到一些线索了。我已经知道他们的一批货物将在何时何地出现。更好的是那个死亡空间处于统合部的管辖之外。

拦下飞船，把它摧毁掉，然后把货物——我猜是建造工具——带来给我。

messages.en: I see that my competitors have just put up a new selection of construction tools on the market. You missed the window of opportunity. I need timely and punctual help, not indecisive help.
messages.zh: 我注意到我的竞争者刚在市场上挂售了一批新的建造工具。你已经错失了时机。我要的是及时准确的帮助，而不是优柔寡断的那种。

messages.en: Supplies delivered?
messages.zh: 货物送到了吗？

messages.en: I'm not going to take out a lowly courier, risk or no risk.
messages.zh: 不管有没有风险，我都不会去攻击一艘手无寸铁的运输船。

messages.en: Not going to-but it's just a courier! They were made to be popped!
messages.zh: 不大像——但它就只是一艘运输船而已啊！他们就是该被爆的！

messages.en: I see that my competitors have just put up a new selection of construction tools on the market. I assume then that you did not intercept the shipment, else I would have a shiny new set of tools.
messages.zh: 我注意到我的竞争者刚在市场上挂售了一批新的建造工具。这样推断你肯定没有把那批货截下来，不然的话我就能拥有那批闪亮的玩意儿了。

messages.en: Supplies delivered?
messages.zh: 货物送到了吗？

messages.en: Sure, I can take it over there for you. I mean, you're paying me, right?
messages.zh: 怎么会介意呢，我当然会帮你处理这事。你会付我钱的是吧？

messages.en: Of course, yes. One does not ask a favor of a capsuleer otherwise, you know...
messages.zh: 这当然。不然我是不会让你帮忙的……

messages.en: Of course, {[character]agentID.name}. What do you need?
messages.zh: 行，{[character]agentID.name}。你要我帮什么忙？

messages.en: Prepare an oral report regarding your actions in the Athran Uprising for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}'s Assistant Chief Security Officer. He's currently at a meeting at our office in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.
messages.zh: 准备向{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的首席安全官助理做一个关于阿什兰人暴动的口头汇报。他目前正在我们的{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}办公室开会。

messages.en: Well, looks like the Minmatar were trying pretty hard to cover their tracks. Sorry I couldn't deliver the report — and, er... it looks like {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has some cleanup to do over in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Not much left of your offices there.
messages.zh: 看起来米玛塔尔人正在想尽一切办法遮掩他们的行踪啊。不好意思，我没法将那报告送达了——而且看起来{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}还有扫尾工作要干。你那办公室基本上都快空了。

messages.en:
You're not alone in being attacked. Our security personnel barely stopped an attempt on my life just a few minutes after you left for that last mission. My life flashed before my eyes, I swear!

Listen, we need to end this. Let me look into this a bit further; come back and talk to me soon, though, okay? I'm not going to be able to sleep until we finish this thing.
messages.zh:
遭到攻击的不只你一个人。就在你上次出去执行任务后没几分钟，有人便想谋害我，幸好有安保人员及时阻止。那一刻我有命悬一线的感觉，真的！

我们要了结这一切。让我再研究一下这情况，然后回来找我好吗？这事情不完我就睡不着觉。

messages.en: Not really interested in playing delivery-stooge, no. Thanks anyway.
messages.zh: 我对当传话的不感兴趣。算了，谢谢。

messages.en: I guess my ISK and my friendship aren't incentive enough, huh? I see where we stand. Hmph. Thanks. For nothing.
messages.zh: 看样子我出的价以及我俩的交情都还不够啊？我明白了。各管各吧。

messages.en:
The Athrans seem to have vanished, so either we dealt with the last of them, or the remaining few have gone deep into hiding. Either way, it looks like we've seen the end of their plotting.

All that remains is for you to give a report to the Assistant Chief Security Officer for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}. He's currently at a meeting at our office in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. So how about it? Do you mind flying over there and letting him know what's been happening? You'll be generously reimbursed for your time, of course.
messages.zh:
那帮阿什兰人似乎已经人间蒸发了，我看要么是因为他们已经被我们全部解决，要么就是剩下的一小部分人已经躲藏起来了。不管怎么样，看来我们都是已经挫败了他们的阴谋。

你剩下要做的就是把一份报告送给{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的首席安全官助理。他目前正在我们的{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}办公室开会。如何？你介意飞过去让他了解情况吗？我们会好好奖励你的。

messages.en: I've had enough of this. Sorry, but I can't finish this mission. Keep your reward.
messages.zh: 我受够了。不好意思我没法完成此任务。奖励你还是自己拿着吧。

messages.en: You know, our security personnel just barely stopped an attempt on my life. We are still in danger, and you just walk away? This isn't over yet. I'll never understand you capsuleers, I swear.
messages.zh: 你知道吗，我们的保安刚阻止了一次别人对我的谋害。在形势还危及的情况下你却想拍屁股走人？这事儿还没完呢。我真是永远也无法理解你们这帮飞行员。

messages.en: My pleasure. I'm going to enjoy this mission.
messages.zh: 没事。我会好好完成此任务的。

messages.en: I thought you might, {[character]player.name}. I thought you might.
messages.zh: 我以为你会的，{[character]player.name}。我原以为你会的。

messages.en: How so? What did you find?
messages.zh: 怎么样？调查有什么结果？

messages.en: Head out to the deadspace location they Athrans are using as a hideout. Deal with those creeps and take out their leader, Cosensin Thrand.
messages.zh: 飞往那帮阿什兰人的藏身之地。连带他们的头儿柯赛新·斯兰德一并解决掉。

messages.en: Cosensin Thrand and her henchmen are no longer… well, they're just no longer. If you take my meaning.
messages.zh: 柯赛新·斯兰德和她的爪牙不再……，恩，我还是别把这个词说出来，你应该会明白我要说什么。

messages.en: Excellent news! I knew you would conclude this matter admirably. I shall speak on your behalf to my associates. God speed. And thank you.
messages.zh: 太好了！我就知道你能为这事儿划上圆满句号。我会在同事面前替你美言几句的。祝你一切顺利。谢谢。

messages.en:
Hm. These guys are pretty dangerous. And you want me to take out their leader? I don't know…

Nah, sounds too risky.
messages.zh:
唔，那帮家伙很危险啊。你还要我去把他们的头儿干掉？我不知道……

算了，这事太危险。

messages.en: There is no room for cowardice in a capsuleer. I mean, you're virtually immortal! It's shameful.
messages.zh: 飞行员容不得胆小。你可是有不死之身的啊！你怎么还有脸做人？

messages.en:
We know who their leader is, {[character]player.name}: some woman called Cosensin Thrand. And it seems she's hiding out in this very star system. Now we can take these nut-jobs out once and for all.

I'll upload the coordinates of the deadspace location they're using as a hideout. Get on out there and deal with these creeps, and you'll be well rewarded. Good luck!
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我们知道他们的头儿是谁了：是个叫柯赛新·斯兰德的女人。而且她好像目前就躲藏在本星系里。现在是我们将他们一举歼灭的机会。

我会把他们用来藏身的死亡空间的位标上传给你。去对付他们吧，你不会白干的。祝你成功！

messages.en: This might be a problem for you, but I can't finish this mission. Sorry. I just can't.
messages.zh: 这对你来说可能不是个好消息，但我没法完成此任务。不好意思。我不行。

messages.en:
I see. Well, I must assume you have good reason.

Until next time.
messages.zh:
我明白。我想你一定是有苦衷的。

后会有期。

name.ja: オーグメンのアレルギー誘発物質（1/5）

messages.en: Yeah, I'm a decent 'roid miner. I'll have this Augumene back to you in a jiffy.
messages.zh: 有。我是个高效的采矿者。我一会儿就能把你搞定这些矿石。

messages.en: Excellent. We'll make it worth your while.
messages.zh: 好极了。我们不会亏了你的。

messages.en: Capsuleer, in fact. You need a starship pilot? I might be available….
messages.zh: 其实我是驾驶逃生舱的。你要一名星舰飞行员？这我也能凑合……

messages.en: Go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and mine 333 units of Augumene ore.
messages.zh: 去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}采集333单位的奥古米内石。

messages.en: I've got your Augumene here. Good luck making any use of it.
messages.zh: 我把奥古米内石运来了。随便你拿它作什么用，祝你顺利。

messages.en: Well, that's up to our scientists, not me. But you did good work. In fact, I may have another job for you shortly, so come back in a bit, will you?
messages.zh: 这得看我们的科研人士，这不是我能决定的。但你确实干得不错。其实说不定我很快就能有下一份工作安排给你了，别跑太远了，好伐？

messages.en: Not really interested in mining for someone else's profit, no. I can hit the belts on my own if I want to mine, and that way I cut out the middle man.
messages.zh: 我真的没兴趣给别人当矿工。如果我想采矿我自己会去小行星带，那样的话也就少了个要收钱的中间人了。

messages.en: But you won't be building any cred with {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} while you mine that way. Ah, well — your choice, not mine.
messages.zh: 但你那样挖矿的话就和{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}拉不上关系了。算了，这是你的选择，与我无关。

messages.en: Augumene is an extremely toxic ore; fortunately, it is also extremely rare. It can be mined safely from a starship, but proves very deadly when handled directly unless one takes extremely expensive safety precautions — which more than negates any profit to be made from reprocessing the stuff. For this reason, even black market operators generally won't deal in it, and it is never found for sale on the open market.
messages.zh: 奥古米内石是一种剧毒的矿石；幸运的是，它也极为稀有。从星舰上采集它是很安全的，但是如果直接加以处理，它会非常致命，除非采用极为昂贵的安全预防措施，可是这种方法的成本远远抵消了提炼后的全部利润。正因如此，就连黑市经营者都不会做它的买卖，而在正规市场上，它更是不见踪影。

messages.en: About Augumene
messages.zh: 关于奥古米内石

messages.en:
Well, I need someone who can handle a ship, but who also knows how to rip ore. If you can do that, then we might be able to come to an agreement.

You've heard of Augumene ore before? It's not too common because it's too costly to refine safely. Thing is, though, a team of scientists working for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} think they've figured out a way to do it cheaply. We need someone to procure some of the ore, though, so they can run some tests.

Interested?
messages.zh:
嗯，我需要一个既知道如何开船又知道如何采矿的人。如果你是这样的人，那我们就有希望合作。

你听说过奥古米内矿吗？这东西不常见，因为要安全地对其进行精炼所花费用太高。但现在有一队科学家声称他们已经找到了一个便宜的方法。我们需要有个人去弄一些这样的矿石，这样他们就能先试验一下了。

有兴趣吗？

messages.en: I've changed my mind. Sorry. I can't be bothered mining for someone else, though. Just doesn't make sense.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我改变主意了。我没兴趣给别人当矿工。没意思。

name.de: Ein neues Unternehmen - Wissen ist Macht (1 von 5)
name.en: A New Venture  – Education is Key (1 of 5)
name.es: Una nueva empresa: La educación es clave (1 de 5)
name.fr: Nouvelle entreprise - L'importance de l'éducation (1 sur 5)
name.ja: 新たな冒険-教育こそが鍵（1/5）
name.ru: Новое предприятие – важность образования (A New Venture  – Education is Key) (1 из 5)

messages.en: I ain't afraid of no book. I'll get it.
messages.zh: 我对什么书都无所畏惧。我会去把它拿来的。

messages.en: Show no fear! Show no mercy! Get the book!
messages.zh: 别害怕！腿别软！去拿书！

messages.en: Oh yeah? What do you want?
messages.zh: 哦，是嘛？你要什么？

messages.en:
I have this crazy idea about owning my own outpost. I just need to put my plans into action.

First thing I need is an instructional book on running a corporation. I've found the perfect book for me. I'll pay you to go and pick it up for me.
messages.zh:
我发狂似地想拥有一座自己的哨站。现在我只要把我的计划付诸行动就行。

首先，我需要一本教人怎样带领军团的书。我已找到一本适合我的。你去把那本书拿来，我会付你钱。

messages.en: Here's your book.
messages.zh: 你的书来了。

messages.en: Thanks! I'll start reading this immediately. While I'm studying this, I have something else you can do for me.
messages.zh: 谢谢！我马上就会读这本书的。乘我读书的时候，我会安排你其他事干。

messages.en: Nope. Not a delivery service.
messages.zh: 不。我不干快递活。

messages.en: You're going to have a tough time of this universe if you can't be bothered to get a book.
messages.zh: 如果你连一本书都不想拿，那你今后会活得很艰难。

messages.en: While academies and universities can provide a good foundation, successful capsuleers know that education continues forever. Skill books are the quickest and most reliable way for a capsuleer to learn to use new equipment or systems.
messages.zh: 虽然大学与研究院能给你打下一个扎实的知识基础，但真正有所成就的飞行员都知道学无止境的道理。对一个飞行员来说，学习技能书是掌握新设备或新系统的最快、同时也是最可靠的方法。

messages.en: Skill Books
messages.zh: 技能书

messages.en:
I have this crazy idea about owning my own outpost. I've heard it's just like printing ISK. I'm in strong enough favor with the local powers, and I've secured a number of interested investors. Now I just need to put my plans into action.

First thing I need is an instructional book on running a corporation. The books you capsuleers use are a bit over my head. Luckily, I've found the perfect book for me. I'll pay you to go and pick it up for me.
messages.zh:
我发狂似地想拥有一座自己的哨站。我听人说它就像一个印钞机一样。我和这里当地的权威人仕关系很好，而且已拉来了几位兴意盎然的投资者。现在我只要把我的计划付诸行动就行。

首先，我需要一本教人怎样带领军团的书。你们飞行员看的那些书有点超我能力所及。所幸我已找到一本适合我的。你去把那本书拿来，我会付你钱。

messages.en: Why are you so indecisive about books? Do they frighten you? Are you afraid you might catch "the literacy"?
messages.zh: 你怎么对本书这么婆婆妈妈的？它吓着你了吗？还是你怕你会一头扎进书本？

messages.en: Where's my book?
messages.zh: 我的书呢？

messages.en: I'm not going to finish this book delivery. Just bootleg it or something.
messages.zh: 我不想去跑腿拿那本书。你自己去盗版一本或随便你怎么样。

messages.en: Bootleg? Are you kidding? The skill book makers track that stuff more than CONCORD. Their lawyers are more vicious, too.
messages.zh: 盗版？你在开玩笑吗？出版商在这方面管得比统合部还要严。而且他们的律师都是不好惹的。

messages.en: I could have spacewalked to the damn station, picked up my book, read it, and spacewalked back by now. Get with the program, huh?
messages.zh: 我原本可以已经走到了那该死的空间站，拿到那本书，看起来，说不定现在已经走回来了。

messages.en: Where's my book?
messages.zh: 我的书呢？

name.ja: オーグメンのアレルギー誘発物質（2/5）

messages.en: Sure. As long as I'm paid according to my station, then I'm all for it.
messages.zh: 没问题。只要报酬合理，我就百分百帮你干。

messages.en: Of course, of course. Payment on delivery, as usual.
messages.zh: 当然，按规矩嘛，一手交钱一手交货。

messages.en: Sure. What do you need?
messages.zh: 当然。你想要我怎么做？

messages.en:
Pick up the encrypted data crystals -- I've uploaded the destination into your NeoCom -- and bring it back to your agent.

Once you collect it, remember to put the data crystals in your cargohold before you leave the station.
messages.zh:
去拿加密数据晶体——我已经把目的地位置上传到你的控制边栏上了——然后把它交给我。

拿到后不要忘了在离站前把它放入你的货柜舱里。

messages.en: Formula delivered, safe and sound. Glad to do business with you.
messages.zh: 方程式完好送达。很高兴与你合作。

messages.en: Good job. And thanks again. Talk to me whenever you have time and we'll see if I can't dig up some more work for you.
messages.zh: 干得好，再次表示感谢。有空就来找我，我会看看还有什么活适合你干。

messages.en: You know, I didn't graduate from the best university in the universe just so I could pick up packages for people. So, no. Thanks, but no.
messages.zh: 跟你说虽然我不是名牌大学毕业但我也不至于帮人送快递。所以我只能说不了，抱歉。

messages.en: Well, if that's how you see it, then fine. But you do realize I would have paid you…?
messages.zh: 好吧，如果你偏要这样想，那我也没办法。但你知不知道我原来打算付你……？

messages.en:
Oh, it's nothing complicated or difficult, frankly. But it's not something I'd trust to a common courier service or even an encrypted FTL transmission.

Can you go pick up the formula our scientists have been working on and bring it back to me here? They've stored a copy in some encrypted data crystals. I need to have my personal team review the process before I can let the experiment go ahead.
messages.zh:
哦，这事既不复杂也不难，真的。但我不放心叫一个普通的快递公司帮我干这件事，即使用超光速传输也不让人放心。

你能把我们科学家在研究的一个方程式带给我吗？他们把写入了一个加密的数据晶体里。我要让我自己的团队先审视一下整个流程，然后才能继续试验。

messages.en: I changed my mind. Sorry. I've got better things to do than fetch your formula for you.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我改变想法了。我还有比帮你拿方程式更重要的事情要做。

name.de: Ein neues Unternehmen - Geeignete Leute  (2 von 5)
name.en: A New Venture  – Right People (2 of 5)
name.es: Una nueva empresa: La gente adecuada (2 de 5)
name.fr: Nouvelle entreprise - Les bonnes personnes (2 sur 5)
name.ja: 新たな冒険-適切な人材（2/5）
name.ru: Новое предприятие – подходящие люди (A New Venture  – Right People) (2 из 5)

messages.en: One desperate workforce, coming up!
messages.zh: 很快就能有急需工作的人了！

messages.en: Desperate is the best kind of work force.
messages.zh: 走投无路的人是最好的劳动力。

messages.en: People? I--
messages.zh: 人？我……

messages.en:
I've recently hired a number of highly trained... I can't say that with a straight face.

Bums. I hired bums.

Go pick up my bums.
messages.zh:
我最近雇了一批受过良好训练的……呃……我都不好意思说。

讨饭的。我雇了一群讨饭的。

去把那帮讨饭的人接过来吧。

messages.en: Homeless people have arrived!
messages.zh: 讨饭的来了！

messages.en: Good job. I'll have them broken and dehumanized within a week. You're turning into quite the helper.
messages.zh: 干得好。我会在一星期里就去掉他们做人的尊严，让他们屈从于我。你就快成为我的得力助手了。

messages.en: I don't want to support your exploitation of the homeless, I hate the homeless and wish them to remain in abject poverty, or I am simply lazy. Take your pick.
messages.zh: 我不想帮你剥削讨饭的。我不喜欢他们，但愿他们就这样一直赤贫下去，当然也有可能我就是懒。自己去干。

messages.en: I pick hating the homeless. It upsets me less.
messages.zh: 我讨厌接人。接人很恶心。

messages.en: You capsuleers are lucky. A couple of you get together, any of you can start a corporation. There are a bunch of you out in 0.0 controlling territory that rivals the empires. But even you guys have to work together to do it.
messages.zh: 你们飞行员是幸运的。你们可以几个聚在一起然后组建一个军团。在0.0地区有一大批像你们这样的人控制着可与帝国比肩的区域。但你们必须要合作才行。

messages.en: Working with Others
messages.zh: 与人协作

messages.en:
I hate people, personally. But it's damn hard to get anything done in this universe by yourself. With that in mind, I've recently hired a number of highly trained...I can't say that with a straight face.

Bums. I hired bums.

Go pick up my bums.
messages.zh:
就我个人而言，我对人比较讨厌。但在这世界中光靠自己完成一件事真是难得要命。鉴于此，我最近雇了一批受过良好训练的……呃……我都不好意思说。

讨饭的。我雇了一群讨饭的。

去把那帮讨饭的人接过来吧。

messages.en: I just received word that the homeless have been moved to another station. Apparently some bureaucratic know-nothing decided to have another capsuleer ship them off to improve appearances.
messages.zh: 我刚得到消息说那帮讨饭的已经被转移到另一座空间站了。肯定是某个无知官僚觉得他们有碍颜面，派人把他们运走了。

messages.en: Human Resources
messages.zh: 人力资源

messages.en: I don't want to support your exploitation of the homeless, I hate the homeless and wish them to remain in abject poverty, or I am simply lazy. Take your pick.
messages.zh: 我不想帮你剥削讨饭的。我不喜欢他们，但愿他们就这样一直赤贫下去，当然也有可能我就是懒。自己去干。

messages.en: I pick hating the homeless. It upsets me less.
messages.zh: 我讨厌接人。接人很恶心。

messages.en: Never mind about the bums. I just filled all my positions with some of the local children. If you got the bums already, you can just go ahead and space them or something.
messages.zh: 算了，不去管那帮讨饭的了。我已经找了此地的一些小孩为我干活。如果你已经把那些讨饭的带来了，你可以给他们吃点洗脑药，任你处置。

messages.en: Human Resources
messages.zh: 人力资源

name.ja: オーグメンのアレルギー誘発物質（3/5）

messages.en: Alright, calm down. It's a tragedy, but we'll manage. I'll go get the survivors, okay?
messages.zh: 好吧，别慌。这是个悲剧，但相信我们能处理好。我去接那些幸存者回来吧。

messages.en: Oh, thank you. This is horrible. Horrible.
messages.zh: 谢谢你了。这事真可怕，可怕啊。

messages.en: We do? We? Really? What in the world is it?
messages.zh: 我们 ？是我们？真的吗？到底出什么事了？

messages.en: The Augumene ore reprocessed using the new formula, for some reason, produces a deadly allergic reaction in most people of the Matari racial type. There are only a handful of survivors at that reprocessing station. Evacuate the surviving scientists from the quarantine station next to their outpost/lab.
messages.zh: 大多数玛塔利血统的人都对用新化学流程提炼的奥古米内石产生了一种严重的致命性过敏反应，原因尚不明了。活下来的人极少。请将幸存科学家从实验室旁边的隔离空间站里转移出来。

messages.en: Alright, I've picked up the survivors and brought them back. What's next?
messages.zh: 好了，我把幸存者接过来了。下一步怎么做？

messages.en: So many things to do. Listen, thanks for getting them. Just give me a minute to figure out the next step and then come back, will you?
messages.zh: 下一步要做的事情有很多。先谢谢你把他们带回来。现在给我一点时间让我做下一步计划。过一会儿你再来找我好吗？

messages.en: Uh, I'm not sure I want any people who might be infected with some weird disease on my ship. Er, no thanks.
messages.zh: 哦，我不想让染上怪病的人上我的船。算了。

messages.en: It's not a disease, it's an allergic reaction. And these are the survivors, and they're in quarantine. But, hey, suit yourself. I've got enough problems already; I don't need you adding to them.
messages.zh: 那不是病，那是过敏反应，而且他们还是幸存者，他们已经被隔离起来了。算了，你还是拿块豆腐撞头去吧。我已经焦头烂额了，我不想你再给我添乱。

messages.en:
Listen, things were going fine. Just fine. My team had approved the procedure and tested the results. But here's the thing. None of the science team was of Matari heritage. They were all Caldari or mixed-blood. So what we didn't realize until way too late is that the Augumene ore reprocessed using this new formula, for god knows what reason, produces a severe and deadly allergic reaction in most people of the Matari racial type.

{[character]player.name}, almost the entire population of that reprocessing lab was Matari. There are only a handful of survivors. It's a disaster, a huge disaster. First thing, we need to evacuate the surviving scientists from the quarantine station next to their lab. That's your first job. Come back when that's done, and we'll have more to do, I imagine.
messages.zh:
听好，事情总得来说还算顺利 。 我的团队已经认可了流程并对结果进行了测试。但问题出在这里：队伍里没有一人是玛塔利血统的。他们都是加达里血统或混血。我们是直到出了事才知道，原来大多数玛塔利血统的人都对用新化学流程提炼的奥古米内石产生了一种严重的致命性过敏反应，原因尚不明了。

{[character]player.name}，那提炼厂里几乎所有人都是玛塔利人。活下来的人极少。这是个灾难，大灾难。首先，我们需要将幸存科学家从实验室旁边的隔离空间站里转移出来，这是你的首要任务。完成任务后就回来，我预料我们还有其他事儿要干。

name.ja: オーグメンのアレルギー誘発物質（4/5）

messages.en: You got it. I've been looking forward to testing my new ship's fittings against Amarr scum. Perfect timing.
messages.zh: 明白。我正等着用那帮艾玛人渣作靶子来试试我最新的舰船装备呢。他们正好撞到枪口上了。

messages.en: Good, good. Be careful out there. Who knows what kind of force they'll have waiting.
messages.zh: 很好，但要小心。天知道他们在那里部署了什么力量正严阵以待呢。

messages.en: What do you mean? What's happened now?
messages.zh: 什么意思？出什么事了？

messages.en: The Amarrians somehow caught wind of our difficulties here, and they're eager to get their hands on the Augumene reprocessing formula. They may already have a team in that lab. Get out there and destroy that lab before they get their hands on the formula. And if they offer up any resistance, don't hesitate to take them out.
messages.zh: 艾玛看起来得到了一点风声，他们知道我们在这里遇到了困难，因此现在拼命想得到奥古米内石的提炼化学方程式。他们可能已经派出一支队伍潜入了那个实验里。我要你即刻返回那里，在他们获得化学式之前，把那实验室给摧毁掉。如果你遭遇任何抵抗，就把他们统统歼灭。

messages.en:
The lab is no more, and neither are the Amarr agents they sent in. Any more, that is. Uh, neither are they any more. "Anymore"? Ehh… either way, that doesn't make much sense, does it? I mean, they're all dead. And so is the lab. Or, well, it's not so much dead as…

Mission complete. All done. Thanks — sorry! Thanks.
messages.zh: 实验室没了，艾玛人也都被解决掉了。任务完成。

messages.en: Oh, thank you. I think. This may not be over yet, so don't go too far. Oh, and hold onto that blueprint I just gave you; we're going to need to produce an antidote for this allergen.
messages.zh: 哦，谢谢。这事可能还没完，因此不要走太远。哦，不要把我刚给你的那张蓝图给扔了；我们要用它来做对付该过敏症的特效药。

messages.en: Um, I'm really not a combat pilot, if you take my meaning. Maybe this is more of a job for the navy? Sorry.
messages.zh: 唔，我不是真正意义上的战斗飞行员，懂我意思吗？这事更适合让海军来干。不好意思。

messages.en: Alright, fair enough. But good god, I hope they can get there in time. Imagine the death toll…
messages.zh: 好吧，确有道理。但愿海军能及时赶到那里。那里的伤亡数字难以预计……

messages.en:
The damned Amarr, that's what! What else?! God, I need a break.

Alright, it seems the Amarrians somehow caught wind of our, er, difficulties here, and they're eager as all hell to get their hands on the Augumene reprocessing formula. I mean, what better than a biological weapon for use against the Minmatar that was developed by the Minmatar and their allies, right?

Anyway, they may already have a team in that lab. I need you to head right back out there and destroy that lab before they get their hands on the formula. If you manage to blow up some Amarrian marines while you're at it, so much the better. And if they offer up any resistance, don't hesitate to take them out. We can cover up the destruction of a few ships, but we simply cannot afford to let them get the formula. Understand?
messages.zh:
当然是该死的艾玛人！除了他们还会有谁？！天哪，我需要冷静一下。

好了，艾玛看起来得到了一点风声，他们知道我们在这里遇到了困难，因此现在拼命想得到奥古米内石的提炼化学方程式。他们巴不得用米玛塔尔制造的生化武器来对付米玛塔尔人。

他们可能已经派出一支队伍潜入了那个实验里。我要你即刻返回那里，在他们获得化学式之前，把那实验室给摧毁掉。如果你能在此过程中顺便干掉几个艾玛兵，那是再好不过了。如果你遭遇任何抵抗，就把他们统统歼灭。敌人战船损坏几艘我们还能进行掩盖，但化学式落入他们之手所带来的损失我们可承担不起。明白了吗？

messages.en: I've decided to back out of this mission, actually. I'm just not up to it. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我已经决定退出此任务了。我不是这任务的合适人选。不好意思。

name.ja: オーグメンのアレルギー誘発物質（5/5）

messages.en: Sounds pretty simple. Get DNA, make antidote. Sure, I can do that.
messages.zh: 听上去很容易啊。拿DNA，做特效药。行，我能干。

messages.en: Excellent. You're doing us a great service, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 太好了。你帮了我们一个大忙，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Sounds good. What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 听上去不错。你要我怎么做？

messages.en:
To make the antidote, we need a DNA sample from a Matari subject who was affected by the reprocessed Augumene — which means I need you to head back out to the lab site and sift through the debris out there. Once you have the DNA sample, find a station where you can manufacture the antidote, then bring the finished product back to me.

Use the blueprint copy I gave you at the end of your last mission; if you're unsure what to do, review Aura's "Industry" tutorial, which you can access from your NeoCom.
messages.zh:
不过，为了制作特效药，我们需要从遭过敏反应的玛塔利人个体上提取出DNA——也就是说我要你返回那实验室地点，在一堆废墟中去搜寻。一旦你拿到了DNA，就去找一个能生产特效药的空间站，然后把制好的成品带给我。

使用我上次任务结束的时候给你的蓝图；如果你不知道要做什么，重新看一次奥拉的“工业”教程，你可以在控制边栏的教程面板里面找到。

messages.en: Here's your antidote, {[character]agentID.name}. I pray we won't need to use it.
messages.zh: 这是你要的特效药，{[character]agentID.name}。但愿我们不会用到它。

messages.en: I share your sentiment, my friend. Let us hope this whole incident is now far behind us.
messages.zh: 朋友，我也这样想。但愿这事儿就这样了了。

messages.en: Sorry, I'm not flying out to that place again. Twice is more than enough, thanks.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我不想再去那地方了。两次就已经够了。

messages.en: Very well. I see how it is. Well, I'm sure I can find someone willing to do this job for me.
messages.zh: 行，我懂你什么意思。我肯定能找到其他人来接手该任务。

messages.en: To finish this mission, you first need to acquire the Minmatar DNA from the laboratory site (where you destroyed the lab in your last mission). Once you have the DNA, use it and the blueprint you received at the end of your last mission to manufacture the Modified Augumene Antidote. With the antidote in your hangar, talk to your agent again to complete the mission.
messages.zh: 要完成该任务，你需要先在实验室那地方（即你上次任务里炸毁实验室的地方）拿到米玛塔尔人的DNA。有了DNA之后，将它与你拿到的蓝图结合起来使用，制作奥古米内石改良特效药。在机库里放上特效药之后，便告诉代理人来完成此任务。

messages.en: Mission Completion
messages.zh: 任务完成

messages.en:
Well, I gave you the blueprint we'd been working on for the antidote after your last mission. In theory, we don't need to worry about the reprocessed Augumene being produced anymore, but just in case, we want to have the antidote on hand in case the Amarr somehow did get a copy, despite your efforts. Or, for that matter, if their scientists were to rediscover the process on their own.

However, to make the antidote, we need a DNA sample from a Matari subject who was affected by the reprocessed Augumene — which means I need you to head back out to the lab site and sift through the debris out there. Once you have the DNA sample, find a station where you can manufacture the antidote, then bring the finished product back to me.
messages.zh:
上次任务结束时，我给了你一张用来制作特效药的蓝图。理论上说，我们已经没必要担心再有人提炼奥古米内石了，但我们还是要防范万一，万一艾玛人还是拿到了化学式拷贝就惨了。当然也要防范艾玛科学家万一自己捉摸出了那套程式。

不过，为了制作特效药，我们需要从遭过敏反应的玛塔利人个体上提取出DNA——也就是说我要你返回那实验室地点，在一堆废墟中去搜寻。一旦你拿到了DNA，就去找一个能生产特效药的空间站，然后把制好的成品带给我。

messages.en: I just can't be bothered to finish making the antidote. Sorry. Maybe someone can do it.
messages.zh: 我觉得制作特效药太烦了。不好意思，请另寻高明吧。

messages.en: You come this far and then quit?! Acts speak far more loudly than words, you know. And your inaction here has spoken to your character more clearly than you know.
messages.zh: 你已经走到这一步现在却要退出？！行动上表现出来的永远要比嘴上吹得好，懂吗？你现在的不作为让人更清楚地看清了你的本质。

name.de: Ein neues Unternehmen - Harter Markt (4 von 5)
name.en: A New Venture – Rough Market (4 of 5)
name.es: Una nueva empresa: Mercado hostil (4 de 5)
name.fr: Nouvelle entreprise - Un marché impitoyable (4 sur 5)
name.ja: 新たな冒険-手荒なマーケット（4/5）
name.ru: Новое предприятие – жестокий рынок (A New Venture – Rough Market) (4 из 5)

messages.en: Those mercenaries are as good as dead.
messages.zh: 那些雇佣军死了最好。

messages.en: You handle that. I need to... I need to figure out my next move.
messages.zh: 你自己去处理。我要……我要计划下步打算。

messages.en: What? Don't believe what?
messages.zh: 什么？不相信什么？

messages.en:
That blasted family corp sent mercenaries after my new outpost. Can you believe that? Who do they think they are?!

Get to my outpost. Kill every mercenary you can. Maybe it's not too late to save it.
messages.zh:
那该死的家族企业派雇佣军来袭击我的哨站了。你相信吗？他们以为自己是谁？！

快赶往我哨站那里。全部消灭，那哨站或许还有救。

messages.en: So here's the thing: I killed all the mercenaries that were left. But, well... your station kind of, well, blew up.
messages.zh: 情况是这样：我把所有剩下的雇佣兵都清理掉了。但……你的那个站……那个……爆了已经。

messages.en:
Blew up? How the-- Oh, I'm going to get them. They will suffer.

...And I just paid that thing off!
messages.zh:
炸了？怎么——噢，我要去抓住他们。他们会不得好死。

……那东西的钱我可是刚付了才不久啊！

messages.en: Yeah, um, no. Not going to defend your outpost from mercenaries that were sent in response to your mistake.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过……不。这是你的失误，我不会顶着雇佣军去保卫你的哨站的。

messages.en: Fine. You don't want to share the blame? I don't want to share my money.
messages.zh: 行啊。你不想有人怪到你头上？我也不想把钱分到你手里。

messages.en: Capsuleers can have their own structures (POS). These can be used for tasks such as mining, storage, or research. One of the ways capsuleers in 0.0 wage war is by attacking POSes. Though such an attack can be difficult to mount, the loss of a structure is a huge one.
messages.zh: 飞行员可以拥有自己的结构（POS）。它们可用来储藏，也可用于进行采矿、研究等活动。袭击POS是在0.0的飞行员发起战争的一种方式。

messages.en: Structures and You
messages.zh: 你和结构

messages.en:
It's that blasted family corp! They've sent mercenaries after my new outpost. Can you believe that? I mean, yeah, I may have messed with their supply route a bit, but-- Who do they think they are?!

Get to my outpost. Kill every mercenary you can. Maybe it's not too late to save it.
messages.zh:
那该死的家族企业！他们派雇佣军来袭击我的哨站了。你相信吗？我虽然搞砸了他们的供给线，但——他们以为自己是谁？！

快赶往我哨站那里。全部消灭，那哨站或许还有救。

messages.en:
So, apparently my outpost EXPLODED. In a FIREBALL. I lost everything. The research, the equipment, the bums, EVERYTHING.

I'm mildly UPSET.
messages.zh:
这么说来我的哨站还是化作了一团火球，爆了。我什么都没了。研究资料、设备、工人，什么都没有了。

我心情不是很好现在。

messages.en: WHAT
messages.zh: 什么

messages.en: You know, I've decided I don't want to be shot to hell by mercenaries. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我决定我不想被雇佣军打了。不好意思。

messages.en: Wah, wah, wah. I don't want to get shot. Wah, wah, wah.
messages.zh: 哇，我不想被打。

messages.en:
So, apparently my outpost EXPLODED. In a FIREBALL. I lost everything. The research, the equipment, the bums, EVERYTHING.

I'm mildly UPSET.
messages.zh:
这么说来我的哨站还是化作了一团火球，爆了。我什么都没了。研究资料、设备、工人，什么都没有了。

我心情不是很好现在。

messages.en: WHAT
messages.zh: 什么

name.ja: サンテンディのリコール（1/5）

messages.en: Oh, sure. Nice, easy work, with good pay? I'm all for that.
messages.zh: 哦，当然了。活儿既轻松，钱也不少？我定全力以赴。

messages.en: Excellent. I've just uploaded the coordinates of the pickup station to your NeoCom. Do be quick, okay?
messages.zh: 太好了。我已经把取货地点的地址上传到了你的控制边栏中。动作要快，OK？

messages.en: Actually, the question is, can I help you? {[character]player.name}, capsuleer, at your service.
messages.zh: 其实这问题应该是：我能帮上你什么忙？我叫{[character]player.name}，是名克隆飞行员，随时听候你调遣。

messages.en: Pick up the electronics from the station I've noted in the mission details and bring them back to {[location]agentStationID.name}.
messages.zh: 取得任务详情中标注的空间站电子元件，并将其带回{[location]agentStationID.name}。

messages.en: Got your electronic parts here. Anything else I can do for you?
messages.zh: 我把你要的电子零件拿来了。还有什么事要我帮忙？

messages.en: I expect so, yeah. And thanks. Just give me a few minutes to pull up my files, will you?
messages.zh: 我就知道你行的。谢了。给我几分钟让我整理一下我的文件好吗？

messages.en: Hm… not really into playing courier, no. Sorry. I'll look for something else.
messages.zh: 嗯……我对运货不是特别感兴趣。算了，不好意思。我另寻他活。

messages.en: I see. Easy money's not good enough, eh? Huh.
messages.zh: 我明白。但让你轻松拿钱还不好，嗯？

messages.en:
Egonics, Inc., is unique in the Gallente music industry. Extremely popular among young citizens of virtually every star nation, Egonics produces the only entertainment headset that transmits music directly into the user's brain. The company's contracted musical artists tailor the music to the individual tastes of every listener.

The technology's growing popularity has caused it spread across the galaxy, except in the higher-security regions of the Amarr Empire, where possession of Egonics tech is outlawed.
messages.zh:
自尊集团在盖伦特音乐界中是独一无二的。该集团在各国都受到了狂热追捧，它生产的一种耳机可以将音乐直接送入人的头脑。该集团下面的许多艺人都能根据听众个人喜好对音乐做调整。

越来越多的人开始喜欢这种先进的音乐播放技术，目前这玩意儿已经流行于全宇宙。当然例外的地方只有一个，那就是艾玛的高安全区域，艾玛认为自尊集团的这种技术是非法的。

messages.en: Egonics, Inc.
messages.zh: 自尊集团

messages.en:
Ah, a capsuleer? Perfect. Then yes, you most certainly can help me. A local company called Suntendi, competing directly against Egonics, Inc., has produced a new virtual reality implant that stands to make literally billions of ISK. We have a large stake in the company, so we're doing what we can to help get things off the ground.

The first wave of these new Suntendi Virtu-Real Implants has already hit market, but there's been a bit of a snag in production. Has to do with expected sales figures from the previous generation of implants or something… I don't know, corporate jargon, you know. Not my thing.

Anyway, the upshot is, we desperately need a shipment of electronics parts here, and the courier we normally work with is too busy shipping the finished product to get them here in time. So, do you think you could go pick up these parts for us and bring them back here? You'll be well paid, of course.
messages.zh:
噢，克隆飞行员？很好。恩，是的，你可以帮我。有一个本地的公司叫桑特恩迪，它与自尊集团是竞争对手。最近该公司已经生产出一种新的虚拟现实植入体，估计可以为它赚上数十亿星币。我们在这公司里投了大笔钞票，所以我们要竭尽所能让这笔生意火起来。

这批新的植入体已有部分进入了市场，但现在生产方面似乎稍微慢了下来。可能和上一代植入体或什么东西的预计销售量有关吧……我也说不清楚，反正你知道说起来都是企业用的那套行话，我对那不擅长。

算了，说重点：我们这里急需一批电子零件，我们平时雇佣的快递公司正忙着运送成品，没时间照顾这里。你觉得你能帮我们去把那些零件拿来吗？当然肯定会有好处给你的。

name.de: Ein neues Unternehmen - Letzte Verhandlungen (5 von 5)
name.en: A New Venture – Final Negotiations (5 of 5)
name.es: Una nueva empresa: Negociaciones finales (5 de 5)
name.ja: 新たな冒険-最後の交渉（5/5）
name.ru: Новое предприятие – окончательные переговоры (A New Venture – Final Negotiations) (5 из 5)

messages.en: A single sunk ship of civvies? Sure.
messages.zh: 就一艘民用船？行。

messages.en: Sibilance. Sssibilance.
messages.zh: 唉……唉。

messages.en: What are we going to do?
messages.zh: <i>我们<i>该怎么办？

messages.en: I have it on good authority that the mother and son owners of that corp are taking a scenic cruise aboard a tour ship, the Dainty Rose. I need you to destroy it. I'll make sure the battle is recorded as a pirate raid. Don't worry about taking out any other ships that might show up. The Dainty Rose is your only concern.
messages.zh: 我有确凿情报显示，那公司干部的家眷正搭乘着一艘叫“靓玫瑰”的游船饱览风光呢。我要你去把那靓玫瑰给炸了。我会把它搞成是个海盗袭击事件。不用管其他出现的舰船，靓玫瑰是你唯一的目标。

messages.en: The Dainty Rose had a most unfortunate encounter with a gang of nefarious pirates.
messages.zh: 靓玫瑰运气不好，遇到了一帮臭名昭著的海盗。

messages.en:
Nefarious pirates? What are you talking-- Oh, right. I mean great! Great! Now I don't have to worry about their competition.

You've done good work for me, {[character]player.name}. I won't forget this.

Probably.
messages.zh:
臭名昭著的海盗？你在说什么……噢，对，对。太好了，好极了！现在我不用担心与他们的竞争问题了。

你帮我干了件大好事，{[character]player.name}。我不会忘记这点的。

也许吧。

messages.en: I will not destroy a cruise ship full of innocent people.
messages.zh: 我不会击毁一艘满载无辜平民的舰船的。

messages.en: I'll tell you right now "innocent people" is an oxymoron.
messages.zh: 那我跟你明说，“无辜平民”只是个相对概念而已。

messages.en: This universe can be an unforgiving one. Sometimes you will have to do terrible things to remain on top. Your fellow capsuleers can be the worst offenders, scamming and ganking their way to victory. It pays to have friends to scam and gank others with first.
messages.zh: 这世界不相信眼泪。有时为了成功你必须做一些违背良心的事。和你差不多的人可能正在靠着欺骗的手段迈向成功呢。我打算付钱让你也来干这样的事。

messages.en: Dark Spaces
messages.zh: 黑暗空间

messages.en:
I will stay here to maintain appearances. You will be the instrument of my justice.

I have it on good authority that the mother and son owners of that corp are taking a scenic cruise aboard the tour ship, the Dainty Rose. Off seeing the sights of the universe or something. They think they're safe out in public. It's too bad pirates don't care about their public image.

I need you to destroy the Dainty Rose. I'll make sure it is recorded as a pirate raid. Don't worry about taking out any other ships that might show up. The Dainty Rose is your only concern.
messages.zh:
我要待在这里做形象大使。我需要你来为我伸张正义。

我有确凿情报显示，那公司干部的家眷正搭乘着一艘叫“靓玫瑰”的游船饱览风光呢。他们觉得他们在大庭广众之下就安全了，但海盗是不要脸的，他们可以到处袭击。

我要你去把那靓玫瑰给炸了。我会把它搞成是个海盗袭击事件。不用管其他出现的舰船，靓玫瑰是你唯一的目标。

messages.en: I just wanted you to blow up a defenseless ship full of wealthy tourists. How soft of a target do you need? You could have shot pillows at them and they would explode. I need a drink.
messages.zh: 我只是要你去炸一艘载满富翁但毫无抵抗力的舰船而已。难道还有比这更容易的目标吗？你去扔个枕头也行呀。我要喝酒去了，受不了你。

messages.en: Dainty Rose Returns from a Lovely Trip
messages.zh: “靓玫瑰”顺利返航

messages.en: I will not destroy a cruise ship full of innocent people.
messages.zh: 我不会击毁一艘满载无辜平民的舰船的。

messages.en: I'll tell you right now "innocent people" is an oxymoron.
messages.zh: 那我跟你明说，“无辜平民”只是个相对概念而已。

messages.en: I just wanted you to blow up a defenseless ship full of wealthy tourists. How soft of a target do you need? You could have shot pillows at them and they would explode. I need a drink.
messages.zh: 我只是要你去炸一艘载满富翁但毫无抵抗力的舰船而已。难道还有比这更容易的目标吗？你去扔个枕头也行呀。我要喝酒去了，受不了你。

messages.en: Dainty Rose Returns from a Lovely Trip
messages.zh: “靓玫瑰”顺利返航

name.ja: サンテンディのリコール（2/5）

messages.en: Sure thing. I'm on it.
messages.zh: 没问题，交给我好了。

messages.en: I'll see you soon, then.
messages.zh: 我很快就会再找你，再见。

messages.en: Great. More courier work, or something else?
messages.zh: 很好，又是快递任务？还是别的什么东西？

messages.en:
We need a moderate quantity of Pyerite: We've traced the location of a Augumene asteroid — a source of Pyerite — of just about the right size. Dig the whole 'roid up and bring it back to {[location]agentStationID.name}. I've uploaded its coordinates to your NeoCom.

Be sure to fit a mining laser to your ship before you set out.
messages.zh:
我们需要一些类晶体胶矿：我们搜索到了一些斜长岩小行星带——类晶体胶矿的最佳开采地点——而且储藏量也正好是我们想要的。你去把这些矿石挖出来带给{[location]agentStationID.name}。我会把它的坐标上传到你的控制边栏。

记住出发之前别忘记给你的船装配采矿激光器。

messages.en: Okay, here's your ore. Glad to help out.
messages.zh: 很好，这是你的矿石。很高兴你能帮忙。

messages.en: Happy to have you. Listen, I'm likely to have some more work for you if you want to come back in just a little while.
messages.zh: 有你在真是太好了。挺好，我希望你过会儿再回来，我这儿还有别的工作可以给你。

messages.en: Sorry, if there's one thing I hate, it's mining. I'll pass.
messages.zh: 不好意思，只要是其中有一点点我不喜欢的因素我都不会去做，就像是采矿这种事情。我不干。

messages.en: Hm. I see. Well, it's a free world — if you're a capsuleer. Not all of us are so lucky.
messages.zh: 嗯……我明白了。好吧，这是个自由的世界，特别对于你这样的克隆飞行员。不是我们每个人都是这么走运的。

messages.en:
Pirates and ore thieves abound in the world of EVE. Even in high-security space, scoundrels may pop in from time to time, so having at least one weapon on your ship (or an ally to guard you while you're mining) is a good idea. The lower the security level of the system, the higher the likelihood of your encountering pirates — whether NPC ships or other players, either of whom are most likely more than willing to blow you to smithereens.

Always, in EVE, being aware of the chatter in the local chat channel can mean the difference between life and death… or at least between surviving in your current clone and having to buy a new one.
messages.zh:
这个世界里面就盛产海盗和盗矿者这两样东西。就算是在高安全等级的地方，坏蛋和恶棍可能随时都会出现，所以你至少也要带上一杆枪防身才是（或者也可以是一块铁皮在你挖矿的时候保护好你自己）。安全等级越是低，你遇到海盗的可能性就越大——无论是NPC舰船还是其他玩家，都会非常急切地想要把你轰上天。

在新伊甸中，随时随地都要注意本地的聊天频道，它可能就是你掌握自己生死的关键。或者至少说你是不是还要花钱重新购买新的克隆体。

messages.en: Dangers of Asteroid Mining
messages.zh: 小行星开矿的危险

messages.en: Something different this time. We need a moderate quantity of Pyerite for production: We've traced the location of a Augumene asteroid — a source of Pyerite — of just about the right size. Dig the whole 'roid up and bring it back for me here. I'll upload its coordinates to your NeoCom.
messages.zh: 这次的情况有所不同。我们需要一些类晶体胶矿：我们搜索到了一些斜长岩小行星带——类晶体胶矿的最佳开采地点——而且储藏量也正好是我们想要的。你过去帮我们挖回来吧。我会把它的坐标上传到你的控制边栏。

messages.en: I give up. Now I remember why I hate mining so much.
messages.zh: 我放弃了。现在我知道自己是多么讨厌挖矿了。

messages.en: But we had a deal…! Okay, okay, fine. I'll just have to find someone else. With a better work ethic.
messages.zh: 但我们我都说好……！嗯，嗯，好。那我找别人趋做就好了，找个更有职业道德人。

name.ja: サンテンディのリコール（3/5）

messages.en: Okay, sure, I can do that. Be right back.
messages.zh: 好，没问题，我可以帮忙。很快就回来。

messages.en: Excellent. Again, speed is of the essence.
messages.zh: 很好，再说一次， 速度才是关键。

messages.en: Yeah, sure. That's why I'm here. But what's the matter?
messages.zh: 好啊，没问题，这正是我来这儿的原因。有什么情况么？

messages.en:
The new Suntendi implants are causing all kinds of electronic devices to short-circuit, even explode. Initial tests say it's due to some kind of bio-EM pulse. We need to get Suntendi's senior researcher over here to figure out what the heck is happening.

Go to our research outpost and pick up the lead scientist; bring him back here. We don't have much time, so I need you to hurry.
messages.zh:
那些新型的桑特恩迪植入体由于某种原因造成了各种电子设备的短路，甚至是爆炸。最初的测试显示是因为某种生物电磁脉冲造成的。我们需要找到一些桑特恩迪的资深研究员到这里来解决这个问题，在我们丢掉饭碗前弄清楚到底是什么鬼原因导致这些事件。

到我们的研究站找到首席科学家，时间不多了，你得要快点去办这个事儿。

messages.en: Here's your scientist. And you guy's had better figure this out soon — even my ship took damage because of those stupid implants.
messages.zh: 这是你的科学家。你们最好能快点得个结论——因为这些愚蠢的植入体，我的船都被打坏了。

messages.en:
Oh, this is getting out of hand. I don't know…

Okay, please don't go far. I expect I'll need your help again before this is over.
messages.zh:
啊，这事儿已经超出我们的控制了。我不知道……

好吧，请不要走远了，这事儿结束前我还有任务要给你。

messages.en: I'm getting tired of shuttling things around, people or otherwise. Sorry, I'm done.
messages.zh: 我已经厌倦这些跑腿的任务了。不好意思，我不干了。

messages.en:
Damn! Why—

Alright, alright, fine. I can find someone else, I expect.
messages.zh:
该死！为什么？

好吧好吧，我另外找人好了，早就知道。

messages.en:
It's these new Suntendi implants. For some reason, they're causing all kinds of electronic devices to short-circuit, even explode. Initial tests say it's due to some kind of bio-EM pulse. Even CONCORD billboards are being destroyed when people wearing these implants fly too close.

We need to get Suntendi's senior researcher over here to figure out what the heck is happening before we lose our shirts. The public outcry is already immense, and growing fast.

Go to our research outpost and pick up the lead scientist; bring him back here. We don't have much time, so I need you to hurry.
messages.zh:
是关于那些新型的桑特恩迪植入体。由于某种原因，它们造成了各种电子设备的短路，甚至是爆炸。最初的测试显示是因为某种生物电磁脉冲造成的。甚至有时候当安装了这些植入体的人太靠近，连统合部的星门公告板都被烧毁了。

我们需要找到一些桑特恩迪的资深研究员到这里来解决这个问题，在我们丢掉饭碗前弄清楚到底是什么鬼原因导致这些事件。公众的反对呼声已经出现，而且开始快速蔓延。

到我们的研究站找到首席科学家，带到我这里来，你得要快点去办这个事儿。

name.ja: サンテンディのリコール（4/5）

messages.en: Sure, I can do that. Easy enough.
messages.zh: 没问题，我能做，小菜一碟。

messages.en: Good. Listen, you've been a great help in this matter. Keep up the good work. See you shortly.
messages.zh: 很好，听着。你在这事儿中间帮了大忙，再接再厉，很快我们就会再见面的。

messages.en: Yep. You said you might have more for me to do, so…
messages.zh: 是的，你说还有更多的任务，我就……

messages.en: Go pick up a load of faulty Suntendi Virtu-Real Implants and bring them back here so that we can look them over. They're out at a CONCORD building and repair station where they produce their stargate billboards; they've had each employee who used one unhook their implant and are holding them there for us.
messages.zh: 去取回一些有问题的虚拟现实植入体，带回到这里我们好进行研究。它们在统合部的一座建筑和维修站里面，就是他们建造星门公告板的地方。他们已经把每个员工所安装的这个植入体摘了下来，放好就等待我们去取回了。

messages.en: Got your faulty implants here. Hope they help you figure out the problem. And fast.
messages.zh: 你的问题植入体都在这儿了。希望能帮你尽快找出毛病来。

messages.en: You and me both, I assure you. I haven't slept for… well, for far too long. Listen, give us a bit to see what we come up with, then come on back in, will you?
messages.zh: 恩。你得给我点时间，我已经有相当长的时间没有睡觉了。让我看看我们能从这儿得出什么结论，过会儿再来找我，好么?

messages.en: Not a fan of CONCORD's policies, actually. Sorry, but this is where I draw the line.
messages.zh: 我不是统合部警察的热爱者，说实在的。不好意思，这我帮不上忙。

messages.en: Hm. Okay, didn't realize where you stood on the CONCORD issue. That's alright, I guess. Sorry to see you go, though.
messages.zh: 嗯。好吧，我不知道你和统合部之间的那档子事儿。好吧，我想。很遗憾你不能在这儿。

messages.en: Yes, indeed. Listen, we've got the researchers working away here, but can you do me a favor? Go pick up a load of faulty Suntendi Virtu-Real Implants and bring them back here so that we can look them over. They're out at a CONCORD building and repair station where they produce their stargate billboards; they've had each employee who used one unhook their implant and are holding them there for us.
messages.zh: 是的，确实是。听好了，我们有一个研究人员离开了，但是你能帮我一个忙么？去取回一些有问题的虚拟现实植入体，带回到这里我们好进行研究。它们在统合部的一座建筑和维修站里面，就是他们建造星门公告板的地方。他们已经把每个员工所安装的这个植入体摘了下来，放好就等待我们去取回了。

name.ja: サンテンディのリコール（5/5）

messages.en: Hot damn! I'm on it. About time you paid me to do something more than flying components and researchers around!
messages.zh: 太棒了！我接了。是时候该让我做点除了运送零件和客人之外的事情了！

messages.en: Good. Now get going. No mercy, my friend. Not a shred.
messages.zh: 很好，现在就去吧，不要手下留情，我的朋友。

messages.en: Just like who? What is it? What did you find?
messages.zh: 就像谁？这是什么？你找到了什么？

messages.en:
We found out that the Caldari State has been sabotaging this whole project. While we were building the implants, they had spies putting in receptors that would allow a transmission station — which they were building nearby at the same time — to mess with the implants. That's what caused all the shorts and explosions.

Well, now we know where the station is. Go out there and blow that scrambling beacon to bits. And take any bloody Caldari you see out with it. You have full authority. Make them pay.
messages.zh:
我们发现是加达里人在背后破坏这个项目。当我们制造这些植入体的时候，他们的间谍在接收器当中放置了秘密的装置，使得这些接收器能够接受到他们安放在附近的一座发射台所发射的破坏性信息。正是这些信息导致了短路和爆炸的情况出现。

好吧，我们现在已经知道这座发射站的位置。正好你是个克隆飞行员，是完成这项任务的最佳人员。你去把那个干扰信号发射装置炸成碎片。如果你有发现任何一个可恶的加达里人，一道送他们上路。你已经被授权做任何事情，让他们付出代价吧。

messages.en: Mission complete. Transmitter destroyed, and Caldari put to the torch. And a pleasure it was.
messages.zh: 任务完成了。发射站已经被摧毁了，加达里人被付之一炬。

messages.en: That's fantastic! Thank you, my friend. We've taken a big financial hit, but the government will help, now that the problem is shown to have been the result of espionage. Anyway, listen — thanks again for all your help.
messages.zh: 这太棒了，谢谢你，我的朋友！我们遭到了很大的经济打击，但是政府会给我们补偿的，现在问题只是间谍渗透这回事儿了。非常谢谢你的帮助。

messages.en: Whoa, hold up! I'm no soldier. I'm a business-person. You've got the wrong capsuleer.
messages.zh: 哇，等等！我可不是当兵的。我只是个商人，你找错人了。

messages.en: Well, that's… disappointing. I thought you people could all fight! Ah well, I guess I needs to find someone else. Or take this to the military.
messages.zh: 好吧，这有点让人失望，我以为你们这些人能够赴汤蹈火呢！我想我在找其他人吧，或者让军队去干。

messages.en:
Destroying structures can be a difficult undertaking. Most structures have very high hit points, at least relative to small ships like frigates, and they take a lot of punishment before being destroyed. And like ships, the bigger they are, the more shields and structure they generally have.

In a mission such as this, where you're asked to destroy a structure, it's generally a good idea to fit as much firepower on your ship as you're able: Otherwise, you simply might never be able to overcome your target's shield recharge rate, let alone rip apart its structure.
messages.zh:
摧毁一座建筑物可能是一件辛苦的事情。大部分建筑物的结构有非常高的伤害承受能力，至少是对于像护卫舰这种小型舰船，需要大量的时间才能推到一座建筑物。就像是舰船一样，他们的体积越大，护盾就越强，结构就越坚固。

在这样的任务里，当你被要求去摧毁一座建筑物，最好能够带上尽可能多的火力装备。不然，你可能永远都没法打掉回复速度较快的建筑物护盾，更别说摧毁结构了。

messages.en: Destroying Structures
messages.zh: 摧毁建筑物

messages.en:
The damned Caldari, that's who! Messing around with our technology, scrambling the implant signals so they emit harmful EM pulses.

This is all-out, goddamned war! I mean it! I want to tear those bastards a new—

Forgive me. I get a little worked up sometimes. But this is… it's just so wrong! So many innocent people have been hurt by this!

Listen, long and short: We found out that some covert operations from the Caldari State have been sabotaging this whole project. While we were building the implants, they had spies putting in receptors that would allow a transmission station — which they were building nearby at the same time — to mess with the implants. That's what caused all the shorts and explosions.

Well, now we know where the station is. And, since you're a capsuleer, we've got the right person for the job right here among us. Go out there and blow that scrambling beacon to bits. And take any bloody Caldari you see out with it. You have full authority. Make them pay.
messages.zh:
可恶的加达里人，就是他们！他们在后面捣鬼，让植入体的信号释放有害的电磁脉冲。

这简直是一场该死的全面战争，是这样的！我要把这些混蛋都撕成碎片。

请原谅我，有时候我会非常的激动。但这也是……这也太……可憎了！很多无辜的人在这件事情中受到了伤害！

听着，长话短说：我们发现一些加达里的秘密行动正是在这件事后面捣乱的，故意的破坏了这些植入体。他们在接收器当中放置了间谍装置，使得这些接收器能够接受到他们安放在附近的一座发射台所发射的破坏性信息。正是这些信息导致了短路和爆炸的情况出现。

好吧，我们现在已经知道这座发射站的位置。正好你是个克隆飞行员，是完成这项任务的最佳人员。你去把那个干扰信号发射装置炸成碎片。如果你有发现任何一个可恶的加达里人，一道送他们上路。你已经被授权做任何事情，让他们付出代价吧。

messages.en: This is just too hard. Sorry, but you need to find someone else. I can't do it.
messages.zh: 这太难了，不好意思，你另找人吧。我做不了。

messages.en: You're right: Seems pretty interesting. I'll get out there right away.
messages.zh: 你说的对：听起来很有意思，我马上就去看看。

messages.en: Excellent. Let me know if you find anything out of the ordinary. Anything.
messages.zh: 很好，如果你找到了任何不寻常的东西就赶快让我知道。

messages.en: You are indeed. You have any work suitable for an egg jockey?
messages.zh: 你说的是。有什么工作可以给一个新手么？

messages.en:
We've been getting a number of reports from in and around this system regarding "unidentified alien spacecraft." Theories abound, and people are saying it's the Jovians, or even one of the Ancients: Takhmal, Yan Jung, any number of things.

Supposedly there was a sighting very recently out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} — I've uploaded the precise coordinates to your NeoCom. Head on out there and see what you can find.
messages.zh:
我们收到了好些个在这个星系或者附近什么地方的”不明空间飞行物“的目击报告，说有奇怪的外星人甚至已经登陆了星球。各种说法都有，有人说他们是朱庇特人，甚至还有人说他们是古人——塔克玛人、殷郡或者别的什么。甚至还有人认为这是新的外星种族正尝试同我们接触。

最近的目击传言多半来自{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。如果你准备好了，就过去看看你能找到什么线索。我已经把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中了。

messages.en: There's definitely something weird going on. I saw a strange ship out there, and it destroyed two Gallente Navy frigates. Warped away before I could get any kind of lock, though.
messages.zh: 肯定是有些不寻常的事情发生了。我见到一艘奇怪的舰船，而且它摧毁了两艘盖伦特海军护卫舰。在我被它砸到之前我就跃迁走了。

messages.en: Alright, that's enough for me. We need to investigate further. I'm going to add your findings into my initial report, and then I'd like you to drop it off for me; come right back, will you?
messages.zh: 好吧，这些就够了。我们需要调查一下。我会把你的发现加入到我的前期报告中，我需要你帮我递送这份报告，所以尽快回来我这儿，好么？

messages.en: Sounds pretty dull, actually. Don't you have some pirates for me to fight or something?
messages.zh: 听起来很无聊，真的。你还有别的什么事儿么？像打打海盗这些的？

messages.en: Uh. Yeah, maybe. Well, actually, I don't know. I mean, I guess you can come back later and see if I have anything else…
messages.zh: 呃，是的，可能。实际上，我也不是很肯定。我是说，我想你可以过会儿再过来看看我是不是有别的什么事情……

messages.en:
There are a number of ancient races who have left traces of their civilizations scattered throughout the EVE universe: The Takmahl, masters of cybernetics and bioengineering; the Talocan, with their hyper-advanced spatial manipulation technology; and Yan Jung, who excelled in gravitronics and force field theories. Others include the mysterious Sleepers, who some say are the ancestors of the enigmatic Jovians.

Those who wish to learn more of these ancient peoples are well-advised to develop their Science and Archaeology skills.
messages.zh:
有一些古老的种族在宇宙中留下了他们文明存在的线索：塔克玛人，生物科技和神经机械学的大师；塔洛迦人，拥有无比先进的空间操控技术；殷郡，发达的引力能和力场研究。其他的还有神秘的冬眠者，有人说是隐秘的朱庇特人的祖先。

想要知道更多关于古人的知识，你就应该多多提升你在考古学和对应的古科技技能。

messages.en: Ancient Peoples
messages.zh: 古人

messages.en:
In fact I do. And it's pretty interesting, I think.

We've been getting a number of reports from in and around this system regarding "unidentified alien spacecraft." Sightings of weird-looking people have even come in from planetary surfaces. Theories abound, and people are saying it's the Jovians, or even one of the Ancients: Takhmal, Yan Jung, any number of things. A few folks even think it's some new alien race making an appearance.

Anyway, we could use someone to go and check these rumors out. Supposedly there was a sighting very recently out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. If you're ready, head on out there and see what you can find. And don't worry — you'll be well paid for your time.
messages.zh:
实际上我确实是的，而且这似乎很有意思，我想。

我们收到了好些个在这个星系或者附近什么地方的”不明空间飞行物“的目击报告，说有奇怪的外星人甚至已经登陆了星球。各种说法都有，有人说他们是朱庇特人，甚至还有人说他们是古人——塔克玛人、殷郡或者别的什么。甚至还有人认为这是新的外星种族正尝试同我们接触。

不管怎样，我们需要有人过去查证一下这些流言。最近的目击传言多半来自{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。如果你准备好了，就过去看看你能找到什么线索。别担心，我们会为你花费的时间支付报酬的。

messages.en: Sure thing. You'll upload me the coordinates?
messages.zh: 小事一桩。你把地址上传给我了吗？

messages.en: Yes, of course. They should be visible in the mission details in your Opportunity interface. See you soon.
messages.zh: 是的，当然。你可以在“机遇”界面的任务详情里找到。再见。

messages.en: Sounds good. Where do you need me to take it?
messages.zh: 听起来不错。你想让我把它送到哪里？

messages.en: Deliver your agent's report to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. <font color = #EE3B3B>Remember to put the report in your cargohold before you leave the station.</font>
messages.zh: 将代理人的报告送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。<font color = #EE3B3B>记得在离站前把报告放入你的货柜。</font>

messages.en: Okay, report delivered. Any more word about these supposed aliens?
messages.zh: 好了，报告送达。怎么样，对这些所谓的外星人的调查有什么进展了吗？

messages.en: Yes, in fact. Come on back to my office and speak to me there. I have another job for you.
messages.zh: 是的。请来我办公室见我。我有另一件事情要你做。

messages.en: I'm more into doing reconnaissance or combat missions, frankly. Courier jobs just aren't my thing. Sorry.
messages.zh: 说实话，我更喜欢干侦察或打斗活。运货我不喜欢。不好意思。

messages.en: Oh, I see. I guess my ISK doesn't change your mind? Fair enough. Who knows, something along those lines might come up.
messages.zh: 哦，我明白了。看起来我提供的钱没法动摇你？行啊。随你便吧。

messages.en:
Given the FTL (faster-than-light) communications capabilities of contemporary starships, it would seem that transporting data or communications physically, by means data crystals or datapad, would be a thing of the distant past. However, for every data transfer via subspace or interstellar transmission, there is a risk of interception. Idea theft and espionage are par for the course in the competitive universe of EVE.

When governments and powerful corporations need to transfer information without risk of interference, they often rely on capsuleers. Common courier ships may be used for less sensitive yet vital data, but only capsuleers offer the combination of piloting ability and inherent security desired by the rich and powerful; of course, one must always take the risk that a capsuleer is trustworthy, but such employers can generally afford to pay their "couriers" well enough to buy their loyalty.
messages.zh:
现代舰船上都配备了超光速通讯能力，再用实体方式——采用数据晶体或数据板——去传输数据看上去似乎早已是件老掉牙的事情。不过每一次利用次空间进行的数据传输或星际通讯实际上都有被窃听的危险。在这个复杂纷争的宇宙中，身份窃贼与间谍是悉数家常之事。

因此一旦当政府和一些大组织需要避开该风险进行数据传输时，他们通常会依靠飞行员。虽然普通货舰可以用来传递重要但敏感度较低的数据，但只有飞行员才能做到既会驾驶又能保驾，而这点正是被那些有钱有势的人所看重的；当然，飞行员本身的可信度是个不确定因素，但那些主儿通常有足够的钱可买到飞行员的忠诚度。

messages.en: FTL Transmissions and Data Couriering
messages.zh: 超光速通讯与数据递送

messages.en: I need to get this to a colleague over in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Just contact me once you're there and I'll have one of his people pick it up from your hangar.
messages.zh: 我要这东西运到位于{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的同事那里。你到了之后通知我，我会让他手下的一个人到你的机库里将它拿走。

messages.en: I've changed my mind, actually. I must have better things to do with my time than deliver reports for people.
messages.zh: 我已经改变想法了。我肯定能找到比为人送报告更好方式来打发时间。

messages.en: Sure. No problem. I can handle this.
messages.zh: 没问题，我可以应付得了。

messages.en: Excellent. Just don't get too cocky — we don't know what we're up against here.
messages.zh: 很好。只是别太莽撞了，我们不知道我们的对手是些什么，它们有何目的。

messages.en: Yep, that's why I'm here. What've you got?
messages.zh: 是的，这就是为什么我来这儿的原因。你有什么任务给我？

messages.en:
We need to get some actual evidence about these supposed aliens. We've got another set of coordinates here for a complex in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, where sightings have been fairly common. Head out there and see if you can't approach one of these ships, assuming you find one, and then come back and tell me whatever you can about it.

Now, we have no idea if these things are hostile. But if what you told me is true, that you saw one take out a couple of Gallente ships, then we need to be careful. You need to be careful, that is. If you're under attack, get the hell out of there. And if not, well, just find out what you can. Don't take any unnecessary risks.
messages.zh:
我们需要取得一些确凿的证据来证明这些异星人的存在。我这儿又有了另外一组目击地点的坐标，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，听说那儿的目击频率很高。你去那儿看看，假如你确实找到一艘这样的船，试试看能不能接近它，然后回来告诉我你都能对这船做些什么。

现在，我们并不知道这些东西是不是具有敌意，但如果你说的关于它们击毁盖伦特舰船的事情是真的，那么我们就得小心。你需要很小心，就这样。如果你受到攻击，立刻脱离战斗。如果没有，就看看你都能做些什么，千万不要冒不必要的风险。

messages.en: Alright, I found one of them. But I haven't got much to report. You can read my ship logs for yourself, though, in case I missed something.
messages.zh: 恩，我找到了一个。但我又很多信息需要向你报告。如果我漏掉了什么，你可以看我的舰船日志。

messages.en: Okay, will do. Downloading them now. Come back in a bit and we'll discuss it further.
messages.zh: 好吧，我来就是了。正在下载这些记录。待会儿回来我们可以继续谈谈这个。

messages.en: This is starting to sound a little risky. Maybe you should call in the Navy, or better yet, a more experienced capsuleer. I don't think I'm up to it.
messages.zh: 这听起来开始让人觉得有点危险了。或许你应该让海军插手这事儿，不然你也应该找个有经验的飞行员。我不太认为我能应付得了。

messages.en: You need to have more faith in yourself. I wouldn't send you out if I didn't think you could handle it. But suit yourself. I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 你要有信念。如果我不认为你能够应付的了的话，我就不会要你去了。但随你的便，我找别人就是了。

messages.en:
Well, we need to get some actual evidence about these things, these supposed aliens. Now, I don't doubt that people are seeing something unusual, but whether we're really dealing with another race of people, or with some Jovians, or what… well, who knows? But that's what I need you to find out.

We've got another set of coordinates here for a deadspace complex where sightings have been fairly common. Head out there and see if you can't approach one of these ships, assuming you find one, and then come back and tell me whatever you can about it.

Now, we have no idea if these things are hostile, if they really exist. But if what you told me is true, that you saw one take out a couple of Gallente ships, then we need to be careful. You need to be careful, that is. If you're under attack, get the hell out of there. And if not, well, just find out what you can. Don't take any unnecessary risks.
messages.zh:
我们需要取得一些确凿的证据来证明这些异星人的存在。现在我已经不怀疑人们看到的东西是不寻常的了，但无论我们是否在和另外一个种族打交道，或者说是朱庇特人或者别的什么，我都需要知道到底对方是什么。我这儿又有了另外一组目击地点的坐标，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，听说那儿的目击频率很高。你去那儿看看，假如你确实找到一艘这样的船，试试看能不能接近它，然后回来告诉我你都能对这船做些什么。

现在，我们并不知道这些东西是不是具有敌意，但如果你说的关于它们击毁盖伦特舰船的事情是真的，那么我们就得小心。你需要很小心，就这样。如果你受到攻击，立刻脱离战斗。如果没有，就看看你都能做些什么，千万不要冒不必要的风险。

messages.en: I've changed my mind. I don't really feel up to finishing this mission. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我改变主意了。我不是很想做这个任务，不好意思。

messages.en: I'll get out there right away. Don't worry: I'll take care of it.
messages.zh: 我马上就会走掉的，别担心，我能对付。

messages.en: I hope so. I really do. Just be careful.
messages.zh: 我希望是这样，真的。小心点。

messages.en: What's so urgent? Anything wrong?
messages.zh: 什么事情这么急？有什么乱子么？

messages.en:
We've just received a distress call from an industrial that got stranded out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They claim they dropped out of warp prematurely, and that there were several "alien ships" waiting for them when they dropped. They claim these aliens somehow actually forced them out of warp.

Anyway, they're still sitting out there, apparently, and haven't attacked or responded to attempts to hail them. Can you get out there as fast as possible and see what's going on? You're the only one who's seen one of these ships up close — it may be that they'll let you approach again.

But again, I warn you – be careful. I'd go out there ready to defend myself if I were you.
messages.zh:
我们刚刚收到了一艘被困在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的工业舰发出的求救信号。他们声称在跃迁过程中过早的意外退出了跃迁，并且就在这个时候几艘”异星“飞船出现了，就在他们被拉出跃迁通道的地方等着他们。

不管怎样，他们还在那儿，却又还没有攻击或者尝试攻击他们。你能够尽快赶过去看看到底是怎么回事儿么？你是唯一一个曾经近距离目击过这些舰船的人，很有可能他们会让你再次接近。

但依然是老规矩，你需要非常小心。如果我是你的话我会好好的准备一下自己的防御。

messages.en: Well, there weren't any aliens out there, just some Serpentis. I dealt with them, but I'm afraid there's not much left of that transport out there. Sorry.
messages.zh: 恩，看来那儿并不是什么不明飞行物，只是一些天蛇的舰船。我把他们解决掉了，但是那艘运输舰里的东西恐怕已经所剩无几了，抱歉。

messages.en:
Thing is, though, the last communication we got from the industrial's captain said the aliens warped out just before the Serpentis arrived… so who knows what really happened. Anyway, Navy Intelligence has stepped in and told us to halt any further investigation, so I guess we'll just have to wonder. For now, at least. But we'll get some answers eventually, I'm sure.

Anyway, thanks for all your help. Glad to have had you onboard.
messages.zh:
这是我们从工业舰收到的最后的联络，舰长说那些异族的飞船正巧在天蛇的舰船到达的时候跃迁出来……所以，中间肯定有些什么蹊跷。无论如何，海军情报部门已经插手进来，并且告诉我们停止所有的调查行动。这让我们很不解，至少是现在看来。但我们终究将会解开这个谜团，我敢肯定。

不管怎样，谢谢你的帮助，很高兴你能加入。

messages.en: Look, these ships, whatever they are, are clearly beyond my means to deal with. You need to get someone else for this job. You can see that, right?
messages.zh: 看吧，这些船，无论他们是什么，都是我们无法明白的。你应该找别人来做这份工作。我懂么？

messages.en: I'm sorry you feel that way — I had high hopes that you were the right podder for the job. I'll find someone else, then… but in the future, don't sell yourself so short, okay?
messages.zh: 你这么想我很抱歉。在这个任务上我对你的期望很高。但我会找其他人的，那么……以后你不能在这么挑剔了，好么？

messages.en:
Yes. We've just received a distress call from an industrial that got stranded out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They claim they dropped out of warp prematurely, and that there were several "alien ships" waiting for them when they dropped. They claim these aliens somehow actually forced them out of warp. I mean, can you imagine the ramifications…?!

Anyway, they're still sitting out there, apparently, and haven't attacked or responded to attempts to hail them. Can you get out there as fast as possible and see what's going on? You're the only one who's seen one of these ships up close — it may be that they'll let you approach again.

But again, I warn you – be careful. I'd go out there ready to defend myself if I were you.
messages.zh:
是的，我们刚刚收到了一艘被困在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的工业舰发出的求救信号。他们声称在跃迁过程中过早的意外退出了跃迁，并且就在这个时候几艘”异星“飞船出现了，就在他们被拉出跃迁通道的地方等着他们。

不管怎样，他们还在那儿，却又还没有攻击或者尝试攻击他们。你能够尽快赶过去看看到底是怎么回事儿么？你是唯一一个曾经近距离目击过这些舰船的人，很有可能他们会让你再次接近。

但依然是老规矩，你需要非常小心。如果我是你的话我会好好的准备一下自己的防御。

name.fr: Un chemin de fer interstellaire (1 sur 4)

messages.en: Sure. Seems like a pretty easy job.
messages.zh: 没问题，看来是个很简单的任务。

messages.en: Yes. You should know, though, that there have been threats against his life — not unusual for an Amarrian diplomat in this day and age. But do keep an eye out for any kind of trouble.
messages.zh: 是的，你应该知道，外面已经有人给他发了恐吓信，这对于一个艾玛的政治人物来说实在是不多见的。但一定要对可能发生的事情多一个心眼。

messages.en:
…

Uh—

Okay.
messages.zh:
……

嗯……

好吧.

messages.en: Pick up the Amarr diplomat from the Amarr-Caldari Mediation Center. The coordinates have been uploaded to your NeoCom.
messages.zh: 到艾玛-加达里仲裁中心接送艾玛政客。地点的坐标已经发送到你的控制边栏。

messages.en: I've got your emissary here. And you were right about the death threats. The Minmatar seem hot to get this guy.
messages.zh: 我找到你的使节了。看来你说的死亡威胁的事是对的。米玛塔尔看来很想要得到这个人。

messages.en: No surprise, given his current efforts. You do know about the Amarrian slave negotiations going on? In any case, I have some other work for you; just give me a short while to put a few things in order here, if you don't mind.
messages.zh: 依他现在的能力来说，不算让人吃惊。你知道现在正在进行的艾玛劳工贸易谈判么？无论怎样，我还有别的工作要给你；如果你不介意的话请给我点时间整理一下这里。

messages.en: Not really too interested in forwarding any Amarrian political agenda. Thanks anyway.
messages.zh: 没兴趣参与任何艾玛人的政治事务。谢谢了。

messages.en:
I'm very sorry you see it that way.

A word of caution? Or advice, if you will: One in your position might do well to swallow one's political distaste in the future.
messages.zh:
我很抱歉你是这么理解的。

的要给你些忠告或者说建议，如果你愿意的话：在未来想你这样位置上的人很容易消除别人的政治疑惑。

messages.en:
The government has implemented a program designed to locate and shut down a number of Minmatar smuggling operations in this region. Our corporation has won a contract to supply a number of resources to the task. And as part of that contract, we have funding to hire capsuleers for a number of jobs. I'm honored to be the first to welcome you as part of this initiative.

First off, if you're willing, I'd like you to pick up an Amarr dignitary from a nearby diplomatic outpost. We can't trust his security to common transport, and I'm afraid a military escort is out of the question in these turbulent times. I'll load the coordinates to your NeoCom momentarily.
messages.zh:
政府拟定了一套政策旨在结束米玛塔尔在这个区域的一系列非法贩售行为。我们赢得了在这个政策执行中的一些服务性的合同。作为合同的一部分我们要招募一些克隆飞行员来完成任务。我很荣幸能找到你作为第一个加入这个计划的克隆飞行员。

第一个任务，如果你愿意加入的话，我们想让你到附近的一个政务空间站接送一位重要的艾玛官员。我们不能相信他的保镖，但是军队护送在这个动荡的时期看来也似乎是不可行的。我会把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中。

name.fr: Un chemin de fer interstellaire (2 sur 4)

messages.en:
Okay, sure, I can get them for you.

A cult, eh? Sounds like I might have some more interesting work coming up, I guess.
messages.zh:
好的，行，我可以帮你把它们拿来。

听说是个邪教组织？恩，看样子后面还有更有意思的事情。

messages.en: That's very possible, yes. But for now, just worry about those reports.
messages.zh: 是的，很有可能是那样。但现在请把心思放在那些报告上。

messages.en: No problem at all. So what else have you got for me?
messages.zh: 小菜一碟。你还有什么事情要我做？

messages.en: Fetch the reports your agent requested and bring them back to {[location]agentStationID.name}.
messages.zh: 去拿代理人要的报告，然后带着它们返回{[location]agentStationID.name}。

messages.en: I've got your reports here.
messages.zh: 我把你要的报告带来了。

messages.en: Good work. Alright, give me a little while to have my staff go over these and then we'll have a better idea how to proceed. Come back in a bit.
messages.zh: 干得好。好了，给我点时间，等我下属来了我就会知道我们接下来该怎么做了。过会儿你再来吧。

messages.en: I'm looking for something a little more exciting than just running courier missions. Sorry, not interested.
messages.zh: 我希望干些比送快递更刺激的时事情。不好意思，我对此不感兴趣。

messages.en: I see. Well, one can't expect to go far with that kind of attitude.
messages.zh: 我理解。不过，有那样态度的人一般是成不了大事的。

messages.en:
It is easy to think of the Amarr Empire as a cold, cruel, hegemonic state endorsing terrible repression and subjugation. Anyone making such an argument would have a strong case. But of course life is never so simple: For every Amarrian "true believer" in the Empire, there is another who doubts not only his or her faith, but also the government that reifies religious doctrine.

That isn't to say that half of the Amarrians in the Empire are traitors and rebels — far from it. But to assume that every free Amarrian citizen condones slavery and colonization is to make a grievous error. There are many sympathizers to the Minmatar cause in Amarr.

One such group is the coalition of the "Secret Starway" (called by some the "Secret Stairway"), a loose network of liberal idealists who work actively, but always covertly, to assist escaped slaves slip out of the Empire's sovereignty. One of the chief ironies of this group is that most of its members are fervent believers in the State religion; they simply have alternate, "heretical" views of those passages from the Scriptures that tend to be used in support of slavery.
messages.zh:
一提及艾玛，人们就很容易把它想成一个实施高压政策，实行劳工制的冷酷、残忍及专权国家。持这种观点的人总是理由十足。但事情总有两面性：对于艾玛帝国中每一个“真正信奉者”来讲，都有一个不仅对其自身信仰持怀疑态度、而且对政府提出的宗教不容置疑说也心存狐疑的人。

但这并不是说有一半艾玛人都是叛徒和逆贼——远远不是。当然你要说每个艾玛人都举双手赞成劳工及殖民的做法也是远远不对的。事实上在艾玛有很多米玛塔尔的同情者。

其中有一个这样的组织叫“秘密星路”（有人戏称“秘密楼道”），这是个松散的持有左路思潮的理想主义者群体。他们积极帮助那些流亡劳工逃出艾玛帝国，当然这些都是在幕后进行的。具有讽刺意味的是，这个组织中的大多数人都是艾玛宗教的狂热信仰者；而对于那常被用来支持劳工制的“经典”，他们只是有着不同的解读而已。

messages.en: The Secret Starway
messages.zh: 秘密星路

messages.en:
Well, first of all, have you heard of this group that calls itself the "Secret Starway"? It's a cult of some kind, comprised of traitors and murderers who are working to bring about the downfall of all we hold dear. And my sources tell me there may be a sect of the group located near here. It's our job to see that they are dealt with.
