To do that, I need a number of reports that have been collected at another station not far from here. So, your first job is to collect those reports and bring them back here so I and my staff can figure out the best next step.
messages.zh:
恩，首先，你听说过一个自称“秘密星路”的组织吗？从某种角度来说它是个邪教组织，里面的人都是卖国贼和伤害犯，他们妄图瓦解我们的信仰。据我情报称，附近可能有一伙该组织的人。我们的任务就是清理他们。

在这之前我需要看一些报告，这些报告在一个离这不远的空间站里。因此你第一件要做的事就是去把那些报告拿过来，这样我和我的下属便可根据它们制定下一步计划了。

name.fr: Un chemin de fer interstellaire (3 sur 4)

messages.en: As long as they're all well-caged, then yeah — sure. I have a cousin who was mauled by those things, so I won't take any chances.
messages.zh: 只要他们被牢牢地圈住，那就没问题。我有一个表兄就被这东西给抓伤了，所以我不愿意做任何尝试。

messages.en: Of course. They're entirely secure. No worries. Feel free to inspect them before they're loaded to your ship, if that'll make you feel better.
messages.zh: 当然，他们都很安全。不用担心，你可以在装船之前检查一下，如果这样能让你放心的话。

messages.en: That's what I was hoping to hear, {[character]agentID.name}. What is it?
messages.zh: 这正是我想要听到的，{[character]agentID.name}，是什么任务？

messages.en: Go pick up a shipment of slaver hounds from a private deadspace compound in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They're inside the base, stored in secured containers in case those Starway freaks try anything.
messages.zh: 到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的私人死亡空间运送猎奴犬。它们在基地里面的一个安全货柜舱中，这只是为了防止那些太空怪物做出什么出格的事情来。

messages.en: I got your slavers. But I don't think you'll be getting any more from that supplier-— someone bombed the place but good, just as I got there. And I'm thinking it was no coincidence.
messages.zh: 我拿到你的猎奴犬了。不过我想你可能不会再从那个供货商那儿得到什么了。有人在我到达后把那儿炸了个底朝天。我想这可不是什么巧合。

messages.en: Damn it! These "Starway" murderers must be stopped. Let me do a bit of digging and see what our intelligence has rooted out. Come back in a bit.
messages.zh: 靠！这些车匪路霸罪犯必须要阻止他们。让我看看我们的情报部门能不能找出什么线索。你等等就过来。

messages.en: God, I'm tired of doing courier runs for you. No, I've had enough, thanks.
messages.zh: 天啊，我已经厌倦了你这些运送任务了。不，我不做了，谢谢你。

messages.en: It's not as if you aren't being well paid for your efforts, {[character]player.name}. But have it your way.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，如果给你的钱不是这么高的话可能就不会了。但我理解你。

messages.en:
The sinuous slaver hound, mammalian yet rather serpentine in form, is commonly referred to as a "slaver." A native of Syrikos V, it has been bred by the Amarrians from the time they first settled that planet more than a millennium ago. The favorable use of the slaver as guard animal and hunting beast alike has led to its being exported from Syrikos V to virtually every other Amarrian agricultural planet, and to many industrial and mining colonies as well.

Over the centuries, the slaver has become fashionable among wealthy Amarrians as a pet for those willing to risk its often murderous nature; these hounds can become extremely loyal and devoted to their owners if disciplined well and handled with great care. As well, breeders and handlers have produced several subspecies of "toy slavers," smaller breeds more suitable for keeping as pets.
messages.zh:
是些细长的猎奴犬，长得像蛇一样的哺乳动物，他们通常被称作是“奴兽”，原产于希尔库索V，从上一个千年艾玛人刚刚殖民这个星球的时候它们就还是驯养这种野兽了。由于大量需求这种动物作为保卫和猎捕的用途，他们开始从希尔库索V出口这些猎奴犬到几乎所有的艾玛农业星球，也出口到很多的工业和矿业殖民地。

在那一百年，猎奴犬盛行于有钱的艾玛人之中，那些愿意在它们的兽性前冒险的人也把它当作是宠物来饲养。如果是经过严格的训练和饲养，这些动物对他们的主人将会是非常非常忠心的。也有人培育出了新的品种，成为“玩具奴兽”，较小的体型更加适合作为宠物饲养。

messages.en: Slavers
messages.zh: 奴兽

messages.en: One of the tactics we've come up with in terms of dealing with this "Secret Starway" group is to use slaver hounds to sniff them out. So I've arranged for a large shipment of the beasts. Could you go and pick them up for me? It's a private deadspace compound, but I'll upload the coordinates for you and arrange for you to be allowed in with no hassles.
messages.zh: 我们想到的一个对付“秘密星路”组织的办法就是使用猎奴犬把他们都找出来。所以我订购了一大批这样的野兽。你能帮我把她们运送回来么？货物在一个私人的死亡空间里面，我会把坐标上传给你，然后安排一下让你过去的时候不会受到任何骚扰。

messages.en: I've tired of this mission. Sorry, but I quit.
messages.zh: 我已经受够了这个任务了，不好意思，我退出。

messages.en: Why take the mission in the first place only to quit now?! Fine, fine, have it your way.
messages.zh: 既然你要推出，为什么当初要接这个人物呢？好吧，好吧，你走吧。

name.fr: Un chemin de fer interstellaire (4 sur 4)

messages.en: I'm on it. She will suffer the fate of all traitors — long live the Empire!
messages.zh: 我接受了。她会知道背叛的下场的。帝国万岁！

messages.en: Excellent. Do this quickly, and I'll arrange a bonus.
messages.zh: 很好，尽快的搞定，我会安排你的奖励的。

messages.en: How do you mean? What kind of progress?
messages.zh: 什么意思，什么进展？

messages.en:
It seems these "Starway" people have been avoiding detection only because they've had help — from a pathetic traitor in our own midst. Now that we've found her out, she's fled the station and is currently piloting a ship on her way out of the system. Presumably, out of the Empire. We cannot allow her to escape.

Apparently, she's made the mistake of wanting to stop off to pick up some things at her family's private habitat here in this star system. Get over there and make sure she doesn't escape.

In fact, make sure she never has the opportunity to escape again, if you take my meaning. You've just been given free license.
messages.zh:
看来“秘密星路”能够躲过我们的侦查的原因是他们在我们中间找到了一个可悲的叛徒。现在，我们已经把她找出来了。她逃离了空间站，现正在驾驶一艘飞船企图逃离这个星系。我们推测他是要逃离帝国，我们不能让她就这么逃走了。

她犯了一个致命的错误，停留在她的私人居住舱外面想要取回一些自己的家庭物品。别让她逃了，实际上，我想让你永远的消除她逃离的可能性，能明白我的意思么？你已经被授权可以这么做了。

messages.en: The traitor is dead.
messages.zh: 叛徒已经死了

messages.en: Well done. You have served the Empire admirably. I foresee a grand future for you, my young friend.
messages.zh: 干得好。你很好的完成了帝国交付给你的重任。我能看见你的前途是光明的，我年轻的朋友。

messages.en: I may not be a fan of your courier missions, but I'm not an assassin either. This woman is a citizen of the Empire. At worst, she deserves a fair trial.
messages.zh: 我不是这些运送任务的狂热分子，但我也不是个清道夫。这个女人是帝国的子民。无论怎样，她都应该得到公平的审判。

messages.en: I had no idea you were in a position to judge the decrees of the Heirs themselves. Forgive me: I was not informed that you had been coronated the next emperor….
messages.zh: 我不知道你还能对继承人的命令做出决定。原谅我，我不知道你被加冕成了下一界皇帝了。

messages.en:
It seems these "Starway" people have been avoiding detection only because they've had help — from a pathetic traitor in our own midst. Now that we've found her out, she's fled the station and is currently piloting a ship on her way out of the system. Presumably, out of the Empire. We cannot allow her to escape.

Apparently, she's made the mistake of wanting to stop off to pick up some things at her family's private habitat here in the system. I'll give you the coordinates: Get over there and make sure she doesn't escape. In fact, make sure she never has the opportunity to escape again, if you take my meaning. You've just been given free license.
messages.zh:
看来“秘密星路”能够躲过我们的侦查的原因是他们在我们中间找到了一个可悲的叛徒。现在，我们已经把她找出来了。她逃离了空间站，现正在驾驶一艘飞船企图逃离这个星系。我们推测他是要逃离帝国，我们不能让她就这么逃走了。

她犯了一个致命的错误，停留在她的私人居住舱外面想要取回一些自己的家庭物品。我会把坐标交给你，别让她逃了。实际上，我想让你永远的消除她逃离的可能性，能明白我的意思么？你已经被授权可以这么做了。

name.en: Fair Play - To the Rescue (1 of 5)
name.ru: Честная игра — на помощь (Fair Play - To the Rescue) (1 из 5)

messages.en: Don't worry. If there's anyone in trouble out there, I'll bring them back safely.
messages.zh: 别担心。如果那里有人遇到困难，那我一定会把他们安全护送回来的。

messages.en: You're going to win medals one day.
messages.zh: 有一天你会获勋章的。

messages.en: What is it?
messages.zh: 帮什么忙？

messages.en:
We're receiving a rather garbled transmission. We can't tell who it's from, but it is damnably close to a Navy distress call. It's not certain, but I'm not going to be the one sacked for not responding quickly to a call from our boys.

Fly out to these coordinates and see what's going on. Take out any hostiles.
messages.zh:
我们收到一条非常不清楚的信号。我们还没查出信号发射方，但它极有可能是海军的呼救信号。当然这一切还未确认，但我可不想被别人指责失职，说我没在第一时间做出反应，然后丢掉饭碗。

请飞往那些位标去查个究竟。清掉所有敌人。

messages.en: It was a setup. There was a rather inept and annoying pirate that demanded ISK. I spaced him, but still.
messages.zh: 那是个圈套。那里有个讨厌的要星币的海盗。我把他解决掉了。

messages.en: A pirate? Damn. Sorry about that. At least you were able to handle yourself.
messages.zh: 海盗？可恶。不好意思。不过所幸你还有能力自己处理。

messages.en: Close or not, I'm not heading into the unknown just to protect your ass.
messages.zh: 不管是不是求救信号，我都不会为你冒险的。

messages.en: Fine. See if I give you a good mission next time you ask.
messages.zh: 好啊。看我下次还会不会给你留好差事。

messages.en: It always pays to keep an eye on the Local chat window. Not only is it a great place to send and receive warnings on incoming pirates and the like, but it is also a handy way to see just which capsuleers are in-system.
messages.zh: 时刻关注本地频道非常重要。这不仅是一个通知海盗进出的好地方，同时也非常方便你查看在本星系的飞行员。

messages.en: Check Local
messages.zh: 查看本地频道

messages.en:
We're receiving a rather garbled transmission. We can't tell who it's from, but it is damnably close to a Navy distress call. It's not certain, but I'm not going to be the one sacked for not responding quickly to a call from our boys.

Fly out to these coordinates and see what's going on. Take out any hostiles.
messages.zh:
我们收到一条非常不清楚的信号。我们还没查出信号发射方，但它极有可能是海军的呼救信号。当然这一切还未确认，但我可不想被别人指责失职，说我没在第一时间做出反应，然后丢掉饭碗。

请飞往那些位标去查个究竟。清掉所有敌人。

messages.en: I'm afraid I'm not up to finishing this investigation.
messages.zh: 恐怕我没法完成此侦查了。

messages.en: That's too bad.
messages.zh: 太糟了。

name.ja: フェアプレイ‐ 仕返し（5/5）
name.ru: Честная игра — разворот (Fair Play - Turnabout) (5 из 5)

messages.en: I've been waiting for a chance to really do some damage!
messages.zh: 我早就想大干一场了！

messages.en: Well, looks like your waiting has paid off. Now get out there and do this!
messages.zh: 看来你的等待已经有了结果，现在马上离开去做这事儿。

messages.en: Whatever it is, I'm up for it.
messages.zh: 不管你要我帮什么样的忙，我都能胜任。

messages.en: Our fleet is doing well, but there are more frigates than we were anticipating. We want you to provide anti-frigate support. Most of the fighting will be far away. We just need you to eliminate a few of the pirate's frigates. The rest of the fleet will take care of itself.
messages.zh: 我们的舰队进攻进行得不错，但敌人的护卫舰比我们料想的要多。我们要你去进行参加护卫舰歼灭行动。大多数时候你不用进入主力战场。你只要歼灭掉敌方几艘护卫舰就行。剩下的我们舰队自己会对付。

messages.en: Mission complete.
messages.zh: 任务完成。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you. With your help, the pirate fleet crumbled. Even if there were any capsuleers that could come back from that, I doubt any of them will be so cavalier with pirating again.
messages.zh: 我就知道你能靠得住。在你的帮助下，海盗舰队彻底垮了。就算有人侥幸逃脱，我看他们也不敢再操海盗这一行了。

messages.en: I can't do it. It's just too big.
messages.zh: 我不行。他们太强了。

messages.en: In this universe, there is no such thing as too big.
messages.zh: 这世上没有所谓太强的事物。

messages.en: Ships are generally designed to counter ships near their own size. The larger a ship is, the more trouble it has targeting smaller prey. Often frigate pilots exploit this, ganging up in groups called "wolf packs" to take down larger ships. The long targeting time and slower tracking of the larger ships makes taking down these wolf packs difficult. Often the best counter to wolf packs are other frigates, resulting in battles-within-battles.
messages.zh: 通常舰船都是设计用来抗衡与它们尺寸相仿的舰船。船越大，瞄准小船就越困难。很多护卫舰驾驶员就利用这一点，组队去对付大船。由于大船的瞄准时间长，炮塔跟踪速度又慢，因此真要对付这些小船也绝不是件简单的事情。对付小船最好的办法还是用小船，而这也经常造成大战里面有小战的局面。

messages.en: Targeting Resolution
messages.zh: 目标锁定分辨率

messages.en:
It's time for you to get your knuckles bruised.

Our fleet is doing well, but there are more frigates than we were anticipating. I realize you probably haven't been in a larger ship yet, but it's actually hard for big ships to target frigates. The difference in size is too great. We want you to provide anti-frigate support.

It's safer than you think. Most of the fighting will be far off. We just need you to eliminate a few of the pirates' frigates. The rest of the fleet will take care of itself.
messages.zh:
现在是轮到你重拳出击的时候了。

我们的舰队进攻进行得不错，但敌人的护卫舰比我们料想的要多。我知道你可能还没驾驶过大船，但真的要利用一艘大船去攻打护卫舰却是件很费力的事情。因尺寸不同引发的差异是巨大的。我们要你去进行参加护卫舰歼灭行动。

这事比你想象的要安全。大多数时候你不用进入主力战场。你只要歼灭掉敌方几艘护卫舰就行。剩下的我们舰队自己会对付。

messages.en: There were just too many ships. I couldn't complete the mission.
messages.zh: 那里船太多了。我没法完成此任务。

messages.en: More ships are just more opportunities to succeed.
messages.zh: 船越多胜算越大。

name.de: Fair Play - Ein leichter Vorteil (4 von 5)
name.ja: フェアプレイ‐ わずかに優勢（4/5）
name.ru: Честная игра — небольшое преимущество (Fair Play - Slight Advantage) (4 из 5)

messages.en: Heh. This will be fun.
messages.zh: 我想这会很有意思的。

messages.en: You have no idea.
messages.zh: 你什么都不知道。

messages.en: Don't I always?
messages.zh: 难道我有不仔细过吗？

messages.en:
Reports are that the pirates are amassing a small fleet for action against us. They have a scout scoping the place ahead of them. Only he's not going to get to the final area.

The scout will be jumping through an old, decommissioned jump gate. Take a position by the gate, and wait for him to come through. Once he does, take him out.
messages.zh:
有报告说那帮海盗正在组织一支小舰队打算对付我们。他们派出了一个先遣哨兵。我们不能让他顺利完成任务。

那哨兵会跳过一座已经没人管的旧星门。你到那星门附近去抢个位置，等他送上门来。一来就把他干掉。

messages.en: Scout neutralized. The pirates won't know what's coming.
messages.zh: 哨兵已解决。海盗还被蒙在鼓里。

messages.en: That's exactly what I want to hear. Any minute now the ambush will begin.
messages.zh: 这正是我想听到的结果。伏击可以随时进行了。

messages.en: Sorry, boss, but this sounds too dangerous for me.
messages.zh: 老板不好意思，但这听上去太危险了。

messages.en: But you stole ore! Danger is your middle name!
messages.zh: 可你已经偷过矿石了！麻烦你是躲不掉的。

messages.en: Gate camps are groups of ships who wait outside jump gates for other ships to pass through. Once a ship comes through the gate camp bombards it, putting their target at a great disadvantage. The use of warp bubbles and scramblers can further ruin an unsuspecting target's day, preventing it from warping away from the fight. For this reason, warp stabilizers are common fitting for any ships passing through low- or null- security space.
messages.zh: 堵星门就是一群舰船围堵在星门周围，等着其他舰船来穿越该星门。一旦有船通过星门，他们就会对该船进行轰炸，可以说该船是处于一个非常不利的位置。如果一个无辜的受害者遇到了跃迁干扰装置，那他更是倒霉，因为这些反跃迁设备会阻止他跃迁逃离。鉴于此，许多穿越低安全区或0.0区域的舰船都经常带上跃迁核心稳定器。

messages.en: Gate Camps
messages.zh: 堵星门

messages.en:
We've stirred up the hive on this one. Reports are that the pirates are amassing a small fleet for action against us. Lucky for us an informant has told us exactly where they're heading. We're going to be waiting for the bastards.

They have a scout scoping the place ahead of them. Only he's not going to get to the final area. He's going to be jumped by some other pirate. You will be that pirate.

The scout will be jumping through an old, decommissioned jump gate. Take a position by the gate, and wait for him to come through. Once he does, take him out.
messages.zh:
我们捅出篓子了。有报告说那帮海盗正在组织一支小舰队打算对付我们。所幸我们已经从线人那里获悉了他们打算来哪里。我们要去伏击那帮兔崽子。

他们派出了一个先遣哨兵。我们不能让他顺利完成任务，得让他撞上一个海盗。你就去作那海盗。

那哨兵会跳过一座已经没人管的旧星门。你到那星门附近去抢个位置，等他送上门来。一来就把他干掉。

messages.en: Scouts are surprisingly resilient. I can't do it.
messages.zh: 哨兵好顽强啊。我无能为力。

messages.en: The pirates are going to find the trap, and we lose the best shot at taking this group out.
messages.zh: 这样一来海盗就能发现我们布下的陷阱，我们将失去把他们清理掉的最佳机会。

name.es: Juego limpio: Parece que muerde (3 de 5)
name.ru: Честная игра — Фас! (Fair Play - Now Bite) (3 из 5)

messages.en: Fly in, get the ore, fly out. Got it.
messages.zh: 飞入，偷矿，飞出。明白了。

messages.en: Let's see how they like this.
messages.zh: 让我们看看他们会有什么反应吧。

messages.en: Sounds like fun. Have anything in mind?
messages.zh: 听上去你有很有意思的事情？

messages.en: We found a mining op being run by the pirates. I want you to fly out to one of their mining ops and steal their ore. I know it sounds dangerous, but if you're quick about it you should be fine. Just fly in, find their jet-can, and take the ore from it.
messages.zh: 我们发现了一个由海盗组织的采矿行动。我要你飞往其中一处去偷他们的矿石。我知道这听上去蛮危险的，但只要你动作够快那就没事。你飞过去，找到他们的置于太空中的货柜，然后拿走其中的班尼德勒石就行了。

messages.en: Behold, Banidine burgled from boisterous brigands!
messages.zh: 我已经从那群流氓那里顺手牵羊出班尼德勒石了！

messages.en: Hah! I wish I could have seen their faces!
messages.zh: 哈哈！真想到场看看他们的表情啊！

messages.en: Pirates or no, I will not stoop to petty theft.
messages.zh: 不管对象是不是海盗，我都不会去当扒手的。

messages.en: Petty theft? This would have been at least larceny.
messages.zh: 扒手？真要做成了你可是大盗啊。

messages.en: Jet-can mining has become a common practice among capsuleers. One ship mines, ejects the ore, and continues on its way. Another ship will then pick up the ore and deliver it to the nearest station. This can save time for larger mining ops, but it also carries a risk that the jettisoned ore might be swiped by a quick--if unscrupulous--thief.
messages.zh: 扔箱挖矿已经很常见。一个船在挖，然后扔出货柜，把挖来的矿扔进里面，接着继续挖。另一个船跟在后面捡这些箱子中的矿，然后把它们运往最近的空间站。对于大规模的采矿作业，这能省时不少，但也要冒矿石被乱序者一卷而空的风险。

messages.en: Jet-cans
messages.zh: 扔箱挖矿

messages.en:
Yeah, I do.

Turns out these pirates knew each other. They're both in some upstart pirate gang. The name isn't important or creative enough to remember. They do, however, have a surprisingly robust roster. The ones we've been seeing are the less skilled of the bunch.

But I've got a plan. It starts with you flying out to one of their mining ops and stealing their ore. There's a group of them out there mining Banidine. Just fly in, find their jet-can, and take the ore from it. I know it sounds dangerous, but if you're quick about it you should be fine.
messages.zh:
是的。

那两个海盗看起来是一伙的。他们同属于一个新起的海盗团，团名已经忘了，反正没什么创意，也不是重点。不过他们有令人吃惊的超强编制。我们碰到的那两个还算差的。

好在我已有对策。第一步就是你要飞到他们的一个采矿点去偷他们的矿石。他们有一帮家伙在那里开采班尼德勒石。你飞过去，找到他们的置于太空中的货柜，然后拿走其中的班尼德勒石。我知道这听上去蛮危险的，但只要你动作够快那就没事。

messages.en: There were rocks and ships and bullets and beeping and...I quit.
messages.zh: 我看到那里有岩石、船还有炮弹……我闪了。

messages.en: Bah. Can't even get you to steal ore.
messages.zh: 靠。叫你去偷矿都不行。

name.ru: Честная игра — боевая готовность (Fair Play - More Bark) (2 из 5)

messages.en: After that last one, I'm ready to kill every pirate in sight.
messages.zh: 把上次那海盗解决后，我已经养成了见海盗就打的习惯。

messages.en: You will do well here.
messages.zh: 我相信你会成功。

messages.en: How do we know this one is legit?
messages.zh: 你怎么确信这条是真的？

messages.en:
We routinely make mining operations (or ops) to make some easy ISK. In hi-sec areas it's fairly reliable, with the only real risk being rats from the bigger pirate factions. Most capsuleer pirates immediately get the boot by CONCORD. This one pirate seems to be affiliated with neither, and is being an enormous pain for one of our miners.

We can't let this kind of behavior continue. Take that pirate out.
messages.zh:
因为发报人所抱怨的海盗与你描述的一模一样。

我们经常搞些常规的采矿活动来轻松赚钱。在高安全区里干这活很可靠，唯一的风险也就是遇到那些较大海盗势力里的人。而飞行员海盗几乎是被统合部立即击毙的。这飞行员不属于两者中任何一个，令人万分头痛。

我们不能容忍这样的行为继续下去。去把那海盗干掉。

messages.en: Bad news is the miner didn't survive. Good news is neither did the pirate.
messages.zh: 我这里好消息坏消息各一条。坏消息是矿工没能死里逃生，好消息是那海盗也一样下场。

messages.en: Drat. Ah well. Miners are an ISK a dozen. At least you took the pirate out.
messages.zh: 靠。啊算了，矿工用星币一抓一大把。反正你把海盗解决了就好。

messages.en: No more pirates, thank you. I've had my fill.
messages.zh: 我不会再去碰海盗了。我受够了。

messages.en: There will always be more pirates.
messages.zh: 海盗会源源不断向你扑来。

messages.en: Pirating is a common, if illegal, career path for capsuleers. Some turn to piracy for money, some for glory. Other do it just to be jerks. Fellow capsuleers have the least tolerance for the latter group, though CONCORD is eager to swat any of them.
messages.zh: 做海盗是飞行员的常见职业途径，当然也有人认为这是一种非法途径。做海盗的有的是为钱，有的是为荣誉，有的只是就想做恶人而已。虽然统合部对这三类海盗都是全部消灭，但飞行员最痛恨的是最后一类。

messages.en: A Life of Crime
messages.zh: 罪恶生涯

messages.en:
Because he's complaining about pirates that match the description you provided me.

We routinely make mining operations (or ops) to make some easy ISK. In hi-sec areas it's fairly reliable, with the only real risk being rats from the bigger pirate factions. Most capsuleer pirates immediately get the boot by CONCORD. This one pirate seems to be affiliated with neither, and is being an enormous pain for one of our miners.

We can't let this kind of behavior continue. Take that pirate out.
messages.zh:
因为发报人所抱怨的海盗与你描述的一模一样。

我们经常搞些常规的采矿活动来轻松赚钱。在高安全区里干这活很可靠，唯一的风险也就是遇到那些较大海盗势力里的人。而飞行员海盗几乎是被统合部立即击毙的。这飞行员不属于两者中任何一个，令人万分头痛。

我们不能容忍这样的行为继续下去。去把那海盗干掉。

messages.en: I'm sorry. These guys are just too annoying to continue.
messages.zh: 不好意思，这些家伙太烦了，我没法再继续下去了。

messages.en: If you quit, the pirates win.
messages.zh: 如果你退出，那你就把胜利拱手相让了。

messages.en: Okay, sounds good. I'll be back shortly.
messages.zh: 好，听上去不错。我很快便回。

messages.en: Excellent. Thank you.
messages.zh: 很好。谢谢。

messages.en: I hope so: {[character]player.name}, capsuleer, looking for work.
messages.zh: 但愿如此：我叫{[character]player.name}，是名飞行员，正在找活儿干。

messages.en: Go pick up the shipment of robotics from the station listed in the mission's details and bring them back to {[location]agentStationID.name}.
messages.zh: 取得任务详情中列出的机器人货物，并将其带回{[location]agentStationID.name}。

messages.en: Yo! Robotics in the hangar.
messages.zh: 嗨！机器人已经放在机库里了。

messages.en: Excellent. Listen, I've just received a somewhat addled report, so if you could give me just a few minutes to go over it? Thanks. I'll have something more for you soon.
messages.zh: 很好。跟你说，我刚得到一份比较模糊的报告，你能给我几分钟让我仔细看一下吗？谢谢。我想很快我又能有其他事情让你做了。

messages.en: Hm. Must admit, I was looking for something a little more interesting than yet another stupid courier run…
messages.zh: 说实话，我其实是想找其他更有意思的活，不是这种无聊的快递任务。

messages.en: Oh, I see. Obviously you're not looking that hard for work….
messages.zh: 哦，我明白了。看起来你找工作的积极性还不是那么够……

messages.en:
Hm. Oh, right, {[character]player.name}! Yes, I remember now.

Well, sure I have some work for you. It's nothing fancy, but maybe I can find something else for you while you handle this simple task. I have a shipment of robotics waiting in a nearby station, but I don't have anyone to pick them up at the moment. Think you could go get them for me?
messages.zh:
哦，对，是{[character]player.name}！我想起来了。

嗯，好，我确实有事情让你做。这事没什么大不了，但或许在你做这件事情的时候我还能去帮你找找还有什么其他活可让你干。我有一批机器人在附近的一个空间站里。目前我找不到其他人去帮我取这批东西。你觉得你能帮我去把他们拿来吗？

messages.en: Uh, sure, I guess. "Anything hostile"? Just what is it you're thinking might be wrong?
messages.zh: 呃，我想是的。“任何敌对”？你可能想错了呢？

messages.en: Well, I can't say for certain at this juncture: A bad guess might be worse than not knowing what to expect at all. But make sure you have some weapons fitted to your ship.
messages.zh: 是吧，在这个节骨眼儿上我还不能说的很肯定：一个最坏的猜测总是比什么都不知道好。你最好确定你在你的船上装了些武器。

messages.en: Oh? Sounds good. What is it?
messages.zh: 哦？听起来不错，是什么事情？

messages.en:
One of our production outposts has been out of contact for a couple of days now. All I know for certain is that they reported something about strange occurrences in the production line. Several injuries, a couple of deaths.

I'm not sure what the problem might be, exactly, but I do have a hunch. Would you please go over to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and check it out for us? And if you encounter anything out of the ordinary — anything hostile, that is — deal with it for us?
messages.zh:
我们的一个生产空间站已经失去联系多日了。我所知道只是他们曾经报告过说那儿的生产线有些异样，一些人受伤了，也有死掉的。

我不是很清楚具体是什么问题，但我已经有了些头绪。你能去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}帮我们调查一下么？如果你遇到了任何异常的事情，任何敌对势力的存在，你就直接对付他们。可以么？

messages.en: Well, I suspect your hunch was right. Looks like maybe some rogue drones somehow got their messed up wiring mixed into the production line over there.
messages.zh: 好吧，我猜想你的头绪是正确的。应该是一些自由无人机在那儿乱搞，把生产线的设备给搞砸了。

messages.en:
Damn. Not often that you wish you'd been wrong, but this is one of those times. Alright, I have a quick vid-meeting I need to attend, but then I should have some more work for you.

Oh, and hold onto that robotics blueprint I just gave you: You'll need it shortly.
messages.zh:
靠，你总不能老是期待你自己是错的吧，恰好这次就是这样。好吧，我还有个视频会议要参加，完了可能会有些工作给你。

噢，看好我刚刚给你的那份机器人蓝图，一会儿你还用得上。

messages.en: It sounds like you're expecting something dangerous out there. And I gotta say, danger isn't my thing. Sorry, wrong capsuleer.
messages.zh: 看来你是想要写更刺激的工作。我得说，刺激并不是我的专业。对不起，我找错人了。

messages.en: I see. Alright, well, fair enough. Good to know that now, rather than to find out the hard way.
messages.zh: 我懂了。好吧，也行。趁早知道也好，免得到时候出了问题再来后悔。

messages.en:
It seems that one of our production outposts has been out of contact for a couple of days now — and it happens to be the same outpost that sent me that garbled report I was reading last time you were here. Something about strange occurrences in the production line.

I'm not sure what the problem might be, exactly, but I do have a hunch. Would you please go check it out for us? And if you encounter anything out of the ordinary — anything hostile, that is — deal with it for us?
messages.zh:
我们的一座生产空间站已经失去联系好多天了，而这座空间站就是上次发给我那份奇怪的报告的那座，当时正巧你也在这儿。报告是关于生产线中间的某种奇怪的现象。

我还不是很清楚那到底是个什么问题，但至少我已经有了点头绪。你能过去帮我们看看情况么？如果你遇到了任何异常的事情，任何敌对势力的存在，你就直接对付他们。可以么？

messages.en: Sure. This is right up my alley — mining, reprocessing, manufacturing. I'll have the new robots for you in no time.
messages.zh: 没问题，这些正是我的强项——挖矿、提炼、制造。我很快就会把你要的机器人做好的。

messages.en: That's what I expected to hear. Good stuff.
messages.zh: 这正是我想要听到的，好东西。

messages.en: Sure am. More rogue drones to deal with?
messages.zh: 我确实是。还有更多的自由无人机要解决么？

messages.en:
I'm not too keen on powering up those robots you picked up for me earlier. In fact, I'd much rather have you build me some new ones. That's why I gave you that Basic Robotics blueprint copy.

So, how about it? I have the location of some Scordite 'roids; feel like doing a bit of mining? Go get the Scordite for the materials for the robotics, then construct some new, safe robots for me.

Use the blueprint copy I gave you at the end of your last mission; if you're unsure what to do, review Aura's "Industry" tutorial, which you can access from your NeoCom.
messages.zh:
我不太想要把你早前交给我的那些机器人激活。实际上，我想要你帮我造一些新的。这也是为什么我之前把那个基础机器人蓝图拷贝交给你的原因。

那么，你觉得怎样？我有一些地方可以用来开采灼烧岩，怎么样，去挖点？去找点制造机器人所需的灼烧岩然后生产一批新的，安全的机器人给我。

使用我上次任务结束的时候给你的蓝图；如果你不知道要做什么，重新看一次奥拉的“工业”教程，你可以在控制边栏的教程面板里面找到。

messages.en: One batch of new robotics, as requested. Hope they work out for you.
messages.zh: 一批崭新的机器人，按照你的要求制作的。希望能帮到你。

messages.en: Fantastic! Alright, I'll get them up and running right away. In the meantime, we're going to need more, so stick around – next job coming up momentarily.
messages.zh: 太棒了！很好，我会马上让他们重新运转起来。在这期间，我们还需要做很多事情，你就带在附近，很快就有新的任务给你。

messages.en: I'm not much of an industry guy, actually. Sorry, but I don't think I can do this job for you.
messages.zh: 我只是个不怎样的工业人士，实话说。不好意思，我觉得我做不了这个任务。

messages.en: Oh. Okay. I guess I misunderstood: I thought industry was your schtick.
messages.zh: 哦，好吧。那是我想错了，我还以为工业方面的事情是你的强项。

messages.en:
To finish this mission, you first need to acquire the Scordite from the deadspace site (listed in the mission details). Once you have the Scordite, reprocess it at a station; use the Pyerite and Tritanium you get from reprocessing it, along with the blueprint copy you received at the end of your last mission, to manufacture the Basic Robotics.

Finally, with the newly built Basic Robotics in your hangar (at the agent's station), talk to your agent again to complete the mission.
messages.zh:
要完成这项任务，你首先要去死亡空间（参见任务详情）采集灼烧岩作为原料。然后将这些灼烧岩送到空间站进行提炼，从中获得类晶体胶矿和三钛合金，并根据我在上次任务结束时给你的蓝图，制造初级机器人。

最后把所有做好的初级机器人都放入机库（位于代理人所在的空间站），再次告知代理人即可完成任务。

messages.en: Mission Completion
messages.zh: 任务完成

messages.en:
Not directly, but I'll admit that I'm not too keen on powering up those robots you picked up for me earlier. In fact, I'd much rather have you build me some new ones. That's why I gave you that Basic Robotics blueprint.

So, how about it? I have the location of some Scordite 'roids; feel like doing a bit of mining? Go get the Scordite for the materials for the robotics, then construct some new, safe robots for me.
messages.zh:
不直接，我不太想要把你早前交给我的那些机器人激活。实际上，我想要你帮我造一些新的，这也是为什么我之前把那个基础机器人蓝图交拷贝给你的原因。

那么，你觉得怎样？我有一些地方可以用来开采灼烧岩，怎么样，去挖点？去找点制造机器人所需的灼烧岩然后生产一批新的，安全的机器人给我。

messages.en: I can't finish this job for you. Sorry, but I just can't.
messages.zh: 我没法完成这个任务，不好意思，我做不了。

messages.en: I can mine like a bloody fiend! Sure, I'm on it.
messages.zh: 我能像一个采矿瘾君子一样去挖！行，这事儿我包了。

messages.en: Excellent. See you when you return, then.
messages.zh: 太好了。你回来时我会接你。

messages.en: Glad to help. Anything else I can do?
messages.zh: 很高兴我能帮上忙。还有其他事要我干吗？

messages.en: Mine the Augumene from the location your agent has given you.  <font color = #EE3B3B>Remember to fit a miner to your ship before you go. Keep in mind that pirates and ore thieves tend to collect around mining sites, though — it'd be wise to fit a weapon as well.</font>
messages.zh: 去代理人指定的地方开采奥古米内石。  <font color = #EE3B3B>记得在出发前将采矿器装在船上。海盗和偷矿贼经常出没于采矿地附近，你最好带上些武器。</font>

messages.en: Here's the ore you needed. Oh, and I thought you might be interested to know a Gallente ship showed up briefly, followed by a bunch of rogue drones…
messages.zh: 这是你要的矿石。噢，我想我应该告诉你我看到一艘盖伦特的舰船从我眼前晃过，然后还有一些自由无人机……

messages.en:
Well, that makes sense. You may be interested to know we've discovered a Gallente saboteur among the surviving workers from that production outpost.

Come back soon; I may need your help again shortly.
messages.zh:
恩，这不奇怪。我或许也应该告诉你我们发现在那个生产基地上活下来的员工里，有一个盖伦特的颠覆者。

快点回来；我可能很快又要你帮忙了。

messages.en: No thanks. Mining is for suckers. I'd rather stick a white-hot spanner in my ear.
messages.zh: 不，谢了。采矿是无聊人才会干的活。我宁愿在我耳朵里塞上一个板头。

messages.en: Why don't you tell me how you really feel…?
messages.zh: 你怎么不问问你自己什么感觉？

messages.en: Yes, in fact. Now that we know the 'bots you produced were safe, we need more Tritanium and Pyerite for extended production. How do you feel about going to mine a bunch more Augumene for me?
messages.zh: 有啊。既然我们现在知道你造的那些机器人是安全可靠的，那我们就有必要获取更多的三钛合金和类晶体胶矿以扩大生产。你觉得让你去开采一批奥古米内石如何？

messages.en: I am so tired of this mission. So... tired.... Must... quit... (pretend to fall asleep)
messages.zh: 我对这任务提不起精神。太……累……不得不……闪……（装睡）

messages.en: Sure. Is the thing guarded?
messages.zh: 没问题，这东西有防御么？

messages.en: I imagine they have some kind of security measures in place, yes, whether stationary batteries or mercenaries or whatnot.
messages.zh: 我猜想他们安放了某种安全措施，是的，可能是固定的炮台或者雇佣军之类的。

messages.en: Puzzled out the whole Gallente involvement question, you mean?
messages.zh: 你是说推测出盖伦特在中间捣的鬼？

messages.en:
The Gallente set up a drone control tower not far from here that, combined with the chip their saboteur was putting into our robots, made them behave erratically. In fact, they started self-modifying as a result, effectively making themselves into rogue drones with limited AI.

But now we know where the control transmitter array is; all we need is for you to gear up and go take out the transmitter, and we'll be back in business.
messages.zh:
盖伦特在这儿附近设立了一座无人机控制塔，配合他们的奸细在我们的机器人里面放置的秘密芯片，使得它们的行为不受我们控制。实际上，是它们的自我改造机能把它们变成了一低智商的自由无人机。

现在我们知道了这座控制信号发射发射塔的具体位置，我们要做的只是带些枪炮过去把它炸掉，这样我们的工作就能回复正轨了。

messages.en: The transmitter array's destroyed, along with a few drones and a couple of ships. Everything should be back to normal, I guess.
messages.zh: 发射阵列已经被摧毁了，还有些无人机和舰船也一同呜呼了。现在一切该回复正常了吧，我想。

messages.en: Wonderful news, {[character]player.name}. Well done, and thanks. You've done {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} a great service.
messages.zh: 很有意思的新闻，{[character]player.name}。干得好，谢谢。你帮了{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}一个大忙。

messages.en: Ehhh… sounds a bit dangerous, methinks. No, sorry, not my strong suit, combat.
messages.zh: 呃……听起来有些危险，我以为。算了，战斗可不是我在行的。

messages.en: Fine, but… you're a capsuleer, for crying out loud! You have nothing to fear. You're immortal!
messages.zh: 好吧，但……你是个克隆飞行员，真是没有天理！你怕什么呢？你是不死的啊！

messages.en:
Yes, precisely. As I mentioned, we discovered evidence of a Gallente saboteur. And once we figured out who it was, it was only a matter of time till we caught up to him. And let me just say that our internal security people can be very… persuasive. He gave up the whole story before he died.

The short version is this: The Gallente have set up a drone control tower not far from here that, combined with the chip our saboteur was putting into the robots, made them behave erratically. In fact, they started self-modifying as a result, effectively making themselves into rogue drones with limited AI.

But now we know where the control transmitter array is, and I've already sent in ships to destroy the "contaminated" outpost. Now all we need is for you to gear up and go take out the transmitter, and we'll be back in business. So how about it?
messages.zh:
是的，正如我所说的，我们发现了一个盖伦特奸细存在的迹象。一旦我们查出来这个内鬼是谁过后，我们只花了一点点时间就把他捉拿归案了，让他知道我们的内部安全特工是非常的……“有说服力的”。最后他招了，在他被正义的处死之前。

长话短说：盖伦特在附近设立了一个无人机控制塔，配合他们的奸细在我们的机器人里面放置的秘密芯片，使得这些无人机的行为不受我们控制。实际上，是它们的自我改造机能把它们变成了一低智商的自由无人机。

现在我们知道了这座控制信号发射发射塔的具体位置，我们要做的只是带些枪炮过去把它炸掉，这样我们的工作就能回复正轨了。你能去完成么？

messages.en: Sure, I can do that. Be back in a flash.
messages.zh: 没问题，我来做好了。很快就好。

messages.en: Good. Be careful out there, though. We have no idea what you might find.
messages.zh: 很好，但要小心。我们也不知道你会遇到什么。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, recent graduate and capsuleer. And looking for work.
messages.zh: 本人名叫{[character]player.name}，刚毕业，准备找个活儿干。

messages.en:
A couple of our scouts have reported possible Caldari activity over in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Fly over there, to the coordinates I've provided, and have a look around. If you find any structures, fly in and have a close look so your scanners can do a readout, and then come back to me here.

If you encounter any resistance, I leave it to your judgement how to proceed... but for now, at least, information is more important to us than hulling a few Caldari.
messages.zh:
我们的侦查部队报告最近在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了一些加达里的活动迹象。你去我给你的坐标点看看。如果你找到任何建筑物就靠近，用你的扫描仪做一个扫描然后回我这儿报告。

如果你遭到了抵抗，你有权自己做出决定，但是现在，相对于爆掉几艘加达里的船来说，情报显得更加重要。

messages.en: I found a structure out there alright — some kind of Caldari research outpost. Check my ship logs for the full specs.
messages.zh: 我在那儿找到了一个建筑物，某种加达里的研究站。看看我的舰船日志里面有详细情况。

messages.en: I will do that. Good work, {[character]player.name}. Stick around, will you? There will likely be more work for you once I'm done reading this over.
messages.zh: 我会看得，很好，{[character]player.name}。别走远了，我们可能还有更多的工作要给你做。

messages.en: Sounds kinda dangerous, like a job for a Navy scout or something. Don't you think?
messages.zh: 听起来有点危险啊，这应该是海军去做的事情。你觉得呢？

messages.en: What I think is that you're perfect for the job, not some Navy pilot who can't be replaced if his ship gets blown away. Not everyone flying a ship has the luxury of a capsule clone, you know.
messages.zh: 我认为你是这个任务的最佳人选。海军的人死了就死了一去不复返。不是所有开飞船的人都有这样豪华的克隆体的。

messages.en:
Oh, {[character]player.name}, yes, I remember the name. Right. Quite competent, from what I recall.

Well, it just so happens that I do have something appropriate for an egg-sailor like yourself. A couple of our scouts have reported possible Caldari activity over in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. How do you feel about going to have a look for me, see what you can find?
messages.zh:
哦，{[character]player.name}。是的，我记得这个名字。恩，在我的记忆中是个很有能力的人。

好吧，正好我现在有点工作可以给你这样的飞行员去做。我们的侦查部队报告最近在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}发现了一些加达里的活动迹象。你去看看能找到什么。

messages.en: Well, that's easy enough. Sure, I can do that.
messages.zh: 恩，小菜一碟啊。行，我干。

messages.en: Thanks. I'll see you when you get back.
messages.zh: 谢谢。你回来时我会接你的。

messages.en: Sure. Or… well, that depends on the favor, I guess.
messages.zh: 当然。不过还得看你要我做什么。

messages.en: Take the data chip to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for your agent.
messages.zh: 帮代理人把这数据芯片送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。

messages.en: Data delivered. Anything else you need?
messages.zh: 数据送达。还有什么事情？

messages.en: Yes, there is. Come on back to my office and we'll discuss it there in private, though, okay?
messages.zh: 我确实还有事情要你做。来我办公室私下谈怎么样？

messages.en:
Given the FTL (faster-than-light) communications capabilities of contemporary starships, it would seem that transporting data or communications physically, by means data crystals or datapad, would be a thing of the distant past. However, for every data transfer via subspace or interstellar transmission, there is a risk of interception. Idea theft and espionage are par for the course in the competitive universe of EVE.

When governments and powerful corporations need to transfer information without risk of interference, they often rely on capsuleers. Common courier ships may be used for less sensitive yet vital data, but only capsuleers offer the combination of piloting ability and inherent security desired by the rich and powerful; of course, one must always take the risk that a capsuleer is trustworthy, but such employers can generally afford to pay their "couriers" well enough to buy their loyalty.
messages.zh:
现代舰船上都配备了超光速通讯能力，再用实体方式——采用数据晶体或数据板——去传输数据看上去似乎早已是件老掉牙的事情。不过每一次利用次空间进行的数据传输或星际通讯实际上都有被窃听的危险。在这个复杂纷争的宇宙中，身份窃贼与间谍是悉数家常之事。

因此一旦当政府和一些大组织需要避开该风险进行数据传输时，他们通常会依靠飞行员。虽然普通货舰可以用来传递重要但敏感度较低的数据，但只有飞行员才能做到既会驾驶又能保驾，而这点正是被那些有钱有势的人所看重的；当然，飞行员本身的可信度是个不确定因素，但那些主儿通常有足够的钱可买到飞行员的忠诚度。

messages.en: FTL Transmissions and Data Couriering
messages.zh: 超光速通讯与数据递送

messages.en: Oh, it's nothing too difficult. Or illegal or immoral or anything. I just need some very sensitive data taken to my colleagues, and I can't entrust it to FTL uplink. It's not too far away. And we would pay you, of course.
messages.zh: 哦，这事一点都不难，也没有什么违法或不道德的地方。我只是需要把这十分敏感的数据发送给我的同事，但我不放心用超光速信道。其实运送地离这不远，而且我们肯定会付报酬给你的。

messages.en: Perfect. That's my kind of job.
messages.zh: 很不错，正是我想要的工作。

messages.en: Keep your eyes open. This won't be a cakewalk.
messages.zh: 把眼睛睁大点。这不是件简单的事情。

messages.en: That's what I like to hear. So what's the target?
messages.zh: 我就希望听到这个，目标是什么？

messages.en: Go on back out there and take out that Caldari research outpost. We have full license to destroy any Caldari we see in the vicinity, as well.
messages.zh: 回去那儿把加达里的研究站端掉。我们已经获权对任何临近的加达里目标进行毁灭性打击。

messages.en: Well, I didn't quite blow it up myself, but the outpost is gone. I have a feeling the Caldari aren't done here, though.
messages.zh: 恩，我并不是一个人把它爆掉的，但空间站已经没了。我感觉加达里这事儿还没完。

messages.en: Agreed. Listen, one of our recon pilots spotted a couple of ships leaving the outpost just before you warped in; they must have had warning of your arrival. But we're tracking them now, so come back in a minute and I may have another target for you.
messages.zh: 我同意。听着，我们的一个侦查员发现在你跃迁进去的时候有几艘飞船从那个空间站飞了出去；他们肯定知道你要去那儿，我们正在跟踪他们。快回来，我有另外一个任务给你。

messages.en: Uh, take out an entire outpost? All by myself? Nope, too risky.
messages.zh: 呃……端掉整个空间站？我一个人？算了，我命没那么多。

messages.en: You're a capsuleer, for goodness' sake. If you can't do it, who can?!
messages.zh: 你是克隆飞行员，天啊。如果你都不能做，那谁还能做？！

messages.en: The Caldari research outpost. Go on out there and take it out. We have full license to destroy any Caldari we see in the vicinity, as well.
messages.zh: 一座加达里的研究站。你过去把它给端掉。我们已经获权对任何临近的加达里目标进行毁灭性打击。

messages.en: I can do that. Easiest thing in the world.
messages.zh: 我能做，小菜一碟。

messages.en: Perhaps for a capsuleer. That's why people like you are so important.
messages.zh: 也许是专门给一个克隆飞行员。这也是为什么像你这样的人非常的重要。

messages.en: Good. Hook me up with the coords and I'm all over them.
messages.zh: 不错，把坐标给我，我这就去搞掉他们。

messages.en: A shuttle with an escort escaped from the Caldari outpost. We've tracked them to a deadspace location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Head on over there to the coordinates I've provided and take them out. Pick up whoever makes it into the escape pod from the shuttle and bring them back to {[location]agentStationID.name}.
messages.zh: 有一艘穿梭机被保护着从那座加达里空间站逃出去了。我们追踪到他们的位置在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个死亡复合体内。你去我给你的那个坐标位置，把他们干掉。把穿梭机里面的乘客带回到{[location]agentStationID.name}，不管是谁。

messages.en: Got 'em. Looks like we bagged us a scientist.
messages.zh: 抓到了，看来我们套了个科学家回来。

messages.en:
That's terrific news! If anyone can tell us what the hell they were doing out there, surely one of their scientists can. What luck!

Listen, make yourself available for just a bit longer, will you? we may need you again once we've had a chance to, er, talk to this fellow.
messages.zh:
真是个可怕的消息。谁能告诉我这些人到底在那儿都干些什么鬼事情，他们的这个科学家肯定会说的！

听好，你的多在这儿干一段时间，好么？我们需要你为我们完成更多的任务。

messages.en: No, thanks. I'm getting tired of dealing with these Caldari. I'm sure you can find someone else.
messages.zh: 不要了，谢谢。我已受够这些加达里人了。你应该能找到别人帮你。

messages.en:
The escaped ships are a shuttle and an escort. Our covert ops pilot tracked them to a deadspace location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I guess they thought they could lay low there and escape once they figured they'd evaded pursuit.

Head on over there to the coordinates I provide and take them out. Pick up whoever makes it into the escape pod from the shuttle and bring them back here.
messages.zh:
逃跑的船是一艘穿梭机和一艘护航船。我们的隐形侦查员把他们的位置锁定在了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个死亡复合体里面。他们以为可以躲在那儿等到事完了再跑出去。

你去我给你的那个坐标，把他们揪出来。把他们爆掉再把穿梭机里面的人带回来给我。

messages.en: Sounds like my idea of a good time. Count me in.
messages.zh: 听起来有点意思，算我一个。

messages.en: Excellent. But this may well be one of the hardest missions you've ever attempted, so don't be too hasty.
messages.zh: 很好，这件事一个非常艰巨的任务，你不要太草率地对待。

messages.en: Really? Tell me all about it!
messages.zh: 真的？快告诉我！

messages.en:
It turns out the Caldari were researching some kind of advanced planetary shields, basing much of their work on what little ancient Yan Jung technology they'd been able to acquire. We got the specs of the "macroshield" they were working on. It's powered by a huge generator located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Yeah, that close!

The generator itself is protected by a smaller, but still very powerful shield system controlled by three power links somewhere else in the same deadspace location. In order to take out the macroshield generator, you first need to destroy the three shield power links. Then you should be able to warp back to the first room and take out the main generator.

Oh, and of course, I expect the whole place will be fairly heavily guarded. So be wary.
messages.zh:
原来加达里在那儿研究某种先进的行星护盾，在殷郡的古老技术上进行了更深一步的研究。我们获得了他们正在研究的这个广域护盾发生器。它有一个巨大的能源发生器，位置在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，是的，非常近！

能源发生器由一个较小但是依然很强劲的护盾系统保护，这个护盾的能源来自于同一个死亡复合体的某个地方。为了能把广域护盾发生器的能源发生装置摧毁掉，你需要将所有三个护盾的能源供给线路先切断。然后你在跃迁回第一层死亡空间将主要的能源发生器摧毁。

哦，当然，我估计这个地方的防守非常强，你要小心。

messages.en: The Caldari shield system is offline… for good. Let's just hope they don't come up with a better version and slip it under our noses somehow, eh?
messages.zh: 加达里护盾系统已经失效，很好。希望他们别再在我们鼻子下面搞一个更大的就好。

messages.en: Yes indeed. But at least for now we've managed to deal with them. And as long as we have competent capsuleers like yourself around, I believe our chances are good.
messages.zh: 是这样的。但至少在现在我们还能够对付他们，如果一直能够有像你一样的克隆飞行员在我们周围的话。

messages.en: This sounds like it's crazy dangerous. No, sorry, but I'm out.
messages.zh: 这听起来太危险了。算了，我不干了。

messages.en: You have a pod, for Zane's sake! You can't die! What's your worry?!
messages.zh: 你有克隆，天啊，你都死不了，还担心什么呢？！

messages.en:
It turns out the Caldari were researching some kind of advanced planetary shields, basing much of their work on what little ancient Yan Jung technology they'd been able to acquire. We got the specs of the "macroshield" they were working on. It's powered by a huge generator located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Yeah, that close!

Now, the generator itself is protected by a smaller, but still very powerful shield system controlled by three smaller power links somewhere else in the same deadspace location. In order to take out the macroshield generator, you first need to destroy the three shield power links. Then you should be able to warp back to the first room and take out the main generator.

Got all that? It's a bit complex, but that's the only way it'll work. Oh, and of course, I expect the whole place will be fairly heavily guarded. So be wary.
messages.zh:
原来加达里在那儿研究某种先进的行星护盾，在殷郡的古老技术上进行了更深一步的研究。我们获得了他们正在研究的这个广域护盾发生器。它有一个巨大的能源发生器，位置在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，是的，非常近！

能源发生器由一个较小但是依然很强劲的护盾系统保护，这个护盾的能源来自于同一个死亡复合体的某个地方。为了能把广域护盾发生器的能源发生装置摧毁掉，你需要将所有三个护盾的能源供给线路先切断。然后你在跃迁回第一层死亡空间将主要的能源发生器摧毁。

明白了吗？虽然有点麻烦，但这是我们唯一的办法。哦，当然，我估计这个地方的防守非常强，你要小心。

messages.en: This mission is just way too hard. I quit.
messages.zh: 这个任务太难了

messages.en: I can't believe you're quitting now, with victory so close. Ach, well, I guess I'll have to find someone else to go out there.
messages.zh: 我真不敢相信你现在就这么退出了，眼看就要成功。唉，好吧，看来我只有找别人来做了。

messages.en: Yeah, okay.
messages.zh: 好。

messages.en: Please hurry back.
messages.zh: 请快去快回。

messages.en: Okay...
messages.zh: 好吧……

messages.en:
I can't give you her name-- though you probably know it. She's the heir to an obscene amount of money, and she has enough demands that I can certainly use all the extra help I can get.

Her new pet-- a miniature slaver-- has just arrived at a nearby station. Of course, she wants it here, and here now. The sooner you can get it back here, the sooner we can both get on with our lives.
messages.zh:
我不能告诉你她的名字—虽然你有可能已经或多或少知道一点。她是个富家小姐，继承了一大笔令人垂涎的财产，而且她要求还特别多，我得绞尽脑汁去满足她。

她的一个新宠——小型猎奴犬——已经运达了附近的一个空间站。当然喽，她要那玩具出现在这里，而且要马上。你动作越快越好，这样我们俩后面的日子就好过点。

messages.en: Here's your tiny dog.
messages.zh: 我把你要的小狗拿来了。

messages.en: Oh, thank you. I'm just receiving a new message-- I should have another job for you when you come back.
messages.zh: 哦，谢谢你。我刚得到一条消息——你回来后我另有活儿让你干。

messages.en: No thanks. I hate rats.
messages.zh: 不，谢了。我讨厌这活儿。

messages.en: I can't say that I blame you.
messages.zh: 我没法怪你。

messages.en:
I can't give you her name-- though you probably know it. She's the heir to an obscene amount of money, and she has enough demands that I can certainly use all the extra help I can get.

Her new pet-- a miniature slaver-- has just arrived at a nearby station. Of course, she wants it here, and here now. The sooner you can get it back here, the sooner we can both get on with our lives.
messages.zh:
我不能告诉你她的名字—虽然你有可能已经或多或少知道一点。她是个富家小姐，继承了一大笔令人垂涎的财产，而且她要求还特别多，我得绞尽脑汁去满足她。

她的一个新宠——小型猎奴犬——已经运达了附近的一个空间站。当然喽，她要那玩具出现在这里，而且要马上。你动作越快越好，这样我们俩后面的日子就好过点。

messages.en: She threw another tantrum. Not that it really matters.
messages.zh: 她又发火了。这已经没什么了不起的了。

messages.en: The critter died.
messages.zh: 那狗死了。

messages.en: Let the princess know she'll have to wait on her new toy. I'm not running your errands anymore.
messages.zh: 你让那公主自己去等吧。我不帮你跑腿了。

messages.en: I can't say that I blame you.
messages.zh: 我没法怪你。

messages.en: She threw another tantrum. Not that it really matters.
messages.zh: 她又发火了。这已经没什么了不起的了。

messages.en: The critter died.
messages.zh: 那狗死了。

messages.en: I'll do it to help you out.
messages.zh: 我来帮你吧。

messages.en: Uh… why?
messages.zh: 噢……为什么？

messages.en:
While you were gone, she managed to crash a vehicle she wasn't supposed to have been driving on some backwater planet in a nearby system. And then security found boosters on her. She's being held at the nearest space station.

I need you to post her bail, preferably before the media gets wind of this. Drop off the currency in your hangar at the station. She won't ride in your ship, so just check in with me when you're done. I'm sure I'll have something else for you by then.
messages.zh:
就在你离开的那段时间，她又在附近星系一个偏远的行星上驾一辆她不应该驾的车，然后把它给撞坏了。警察到场后发现她身上有兴奋剂。她目前被关在就近的一个空间站里。

我要你去保释她，这事儿最好在媒体还没察觉到之前给办了。到了那里把钱扔在机库里就行。她不会随你船一起回来，你干完后只要向我支一声就行。我想等你都搞定后，我还会有事情让你干。

messages.en: I dropped off the cash.
messages.zh: 我把钱送到了。

messages.en: Thanks. I'm trying to talk her out of her latest demand. Check in again in a sec; I'm sure it won't work.
messages.zh: 谢谢。我现在打算去劝她放弃她的新一轮要求。你可要马上回来哦，我不认为她会听我的。

messages.en: I think I'll pass. The detention might do her some good.
messages.zh: 我想还是算了吧。蹲牢对她有好处。

messages.en: I can't say that I blame you.
messages.zh: 我没法怪你。

messages.en:
While you were gone, she managed to crash a vehicle she wasn't supposed to have been driving on some backwater planet in a nearby system. And then security found boosters on her. She's being held at the nearest space station.

I need you to post her bail, preferably before the media gets wind of this. Drop off the currency in your hangar at the station. She won't ride in your ship, so just check in with me when you're done. I'm sure I'll have something else for you by then.

我要你去保释她，这事儿最好在媒体还没察觉到之前给办了。到了那里把钱扔在机库里就行。她不会随你船一起回来，你干完后只要向我支一声就行。我想等你都搞定后，我还会有事情让你干。

messages.en: Nah. Let her rot.
messages.zh: 不。让她继续堕落吧。

messages.en: I can't say that I blame you.
messages.zh: 我没法怪你。

messages.en: This is getting ridiculous, but I'll help you out again.
messages.zh: 这事越来越荒谬，但我会再帮你一次。

messages.en: Your willingness to help is astounding.
messages.zh: 你的帮忙意愿真是超乎想象。

messages.en: I'm not?
messages.zh: 我不会？

messages.en:
I need you to go mine some polygypsum, as the Heiress has decided she wants a complete bedroom set made out of it. Yes, I know it sometimes spontaneously combusts. She still wants it. Obviously, reason has nothing to do with it.

So, bring me 20 units of polygypsum, and we'll see what she wants next.
messages.zh:
我要你去采集一些聚合石膏，那富家小姐想让她的卧室套房就用这石头打造。是的，我知道这石头没准会自燃。但她就是要。她不跟你讲道理。

好了，去带20个单位的聚合石膏回来，然后我们再看她还能玩出什么花样。

messages.en: I've got your hideously unstable rocks here.
messages.zh: 我这里有你说的那些极其不稳定的石头。

messages.en:
Oh, good. Maybe she'll blow herself up.

Ahem. I mean, I'll let her know the polygypsum is available. Check back in soon.
messages.zh:
哦，很好。也许她会把自己给炸了吧。

噢嗥，我的意思是我会为她准备好聚合石膏。快点回来。

messages.en: Sorry, this is nuts. You'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 对不起，这会把人逼疯的。你另寻高明吧。

messages.en: I can't say I blame you.
messages.zh: 我没法怪你。

messages.en: Some ores have no value on the open market, usually as a result of their unstable properties, but they can still be useful in completing missions.
messages.zh: 有些矿石由于性质不稳定，在公开市场上没有价值，但它们在完成任务中仍然有用。

messages.en: Someone Still Wants Them
messages.zh: 有人还是想要它们

messages.en:
I need you to go mine some polygypsum, as the Heiress has decided she wants a complete bedroom set made out of it. Yes, I know it sometimes spontaneously combusts. She still wants it. Obviously, reason has nothing to do with it.

So, bring me 20 units of polygypsum, and we'll see what she wants next.
messages.zh:
我要你去采集一些聚合石膏，那富家小姐想让她的卧室套房就用这石头打造。是的，我知道这石头没准会自燃。但她就是要。她不跟你讲道理。

好了，去带20个单位的聚合石膏回来，然后我们再看她还能玩出什么花样。

messages.en: This is nuts. I'm out.
messages.zh: 这太疯狂了。我闪了。

messages.en: I can't say I blame you.
messages.zh: 我没法怪你。

messages.en: I have to say, I'm curious. I'll do it.
messages.zh: 我承认我很好奇，我干。

messages.en: Excellent. Hurry back, there's wonderful news waiting in the will.
messages.zh: 很好。要快去快回，有喜讯等着你呢。

messages.en: How's that again?
messages.zh: 怎么又那样？

messages.en: The bad news is that the Heiress's inheritance is nearly hers: her grandfather has just died. The good news... well, I can't tell you that until after you've delivered her to the funeral. We're not sure if she'd actually get there if we let her go alone.
messages.zh: 坏消息是这位富家小姐几乎快要拿到遗产了：她祖父刚去世。好消息是……嗯，等你把她送到葬礼现场后我再告诉你。如果让她单独去，我们还真不能肯定她是否会去呢。

messages.en: Right, one heiress delivered.
messages.zh: 是的，小姐安全送达。

messages.en: Thanks for getting her there intact. I have to speak with her grandfather's executor, but it shouldn't take long, and then I can let you in on the secret.
messages.zh: 谢谢你把她安然无恙地送达那里。我要去和她祖父的律师谈一会儿话，时间不会长。然后我便告诉你那好消息。

messages.en: I've had enough of these games. I'll pass.
messages.zh: 我玩够了。不干了。

messages.en: It's a shame. Things were starting to look up.
messages.zh: 很遗憾啊。事情正向好的方向发展呢。

messages.en: The bad news is that the Heiress's inheritance is nearly hers: her grandfather has just died. The good news… well, I can't tell you that until after you've delivered her to the funeral. We're not sure if she'd actually get there if we let her go alone.
messages.zh: 坏消息是这位富家小姐几乎快要拿到遗产了：她祖父刚去世。好消息是……嗯，等你把她送到葬礼现场后我再告诉你。如果让她单独去，我们还真不能肯定她是否会去呢。

messages.en: I don't care what she runs herself into; I'm done with this mess.
messages.zh: 她遇到什么事与我无关；我不要再卷入这堆烂事中了。

messages.en: Tsk, tsk. Just when things were starting to look brighter.
messages.zh: 可惜啊，可惜。事情刚刚开始变得对我们有利起来呢。

messages.en: Are you kidding? Wait, don't answer that. I accept!
messages.zh: 你在开玩笑么？别说了，我接受！

messages.en: I thought you'd like it. Go get ‘er!
messages.zh: 我以为你会喜欢这个。去找他吧。

messages.en: Okay, what's the big secret?
messages.zh: 好吧，说说看是什么样的秘密？

messages.en:
In order to stop her unceasing exploitation of her unearned fame and fortune, the Heiress's grandfather requested that she be killed outright in his will. I'm relieved to discover that he died with his wits intact, after all.

She's off celebrating, of course-- went straight from the funeral. I'll give you the approximate coordinates; you shouldn't have any trouble finding her private transport. It may take you awhile to destroy it, though, so be patient. If we're lucky, she may have some explosive substances on board that could trigger a chain reaction and speed things up considerably.

So, do you think you can kill the Heiress?
messages.zh:
为了阻止她不停地滥用不劳而获的名声和财富，她的祖父甚至在遗嘱中要求把她置于死地。我很庆幸他在最后的时刻也没有失去他的智慧。

她自己已经去庆祝去了，从葬礼上一离开就直接去庆祝了。我会把他们的派对地点发送给你；你应该很容易就能找到她们的私人穿梭机。要把它摧毁可能得要废点时间，你需要点耐心。如果我们走运的，她应该会在船上放了些烟花爆竹之类的爆炸物，一旦击中就能引发连锁爆炸，让整个过程快些结束。

你认为你能干掉这个女继承人么？

messages.en: I hope you heard about the explosion?
messages.zh: 希望你听说了那个爆炸？

messages.en: Thanks for all your help. I'm just glad this whole thing is over with.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，我很高兴这事儿终于给了结了。

messages.en: I can't say I like her, but I don't want to get involved in this. It seems kinda risky.
messages.zh: 我不能说我喜欢她，但我不想卷入这事儿。看起来有些危险。

messages.en: Huh. I thought you'd be pleased about this one.
messages.zh: 恩，我以为你会高兴听到这个。

messages.en:
It turns out that the former Heiress's grandfather felt that she wasn't doing his family name any favors. The will he left behind disinherits her, but there's more.

In order to stop her unceasing exploitation of her unearned fame and fortune, he wants her dead.

That's right. The request that she be killed outright is in the old man's will. I'm relieved to discover that he died with his wits intact, after all.

She's off celebrating, of course-- went straight from the funeral. I'll give you the approximate coordinates; you shouldn't have any trouble finding her private transport. It may take you awhile to destroy it, though, so be patient. If we're lucky, she may have some explosive substances on board that could trigger a chain reaction and speed things up considerably.

So, do you think you can kill the Heiress?
messages.zh:
事情是这样的，前任女继承人去世的祖父在弥留之际认为她的行为给他的家族名声带来很坏的影响。他的遗嘱中将她完全地从继承人中除名了，但上面所要求的还远不止这么简单。

为了阻止她不停地滥用不劳而获的名声和财富，她的祖父甚至要她从这个世界消失

没错，他已经把这一个要求写进了遗嘱里面，我很庆幸他在最后的时刻也没有失去他的智慧。

她自己已经去庆祝去了，从葬礼上一离开就直接去庆祝了。我会把他们的派对地点发送给你；你应该很容易就能找到她们的私人穿梭机。要把它摧毁可能得要废点时间，你需要点耐心。如果我们走运的，她应该会在船上放了些烟花爆竹之类的爆炸物，一旦击中就能引发连锁爆炸，让整个过程快些结束。

你认为你能干掉这个女继承人么？

messages.en: Now it's just creepy. I'm out.
messages.zh: 这事儿太诡异了，我不做。

messages.en: Weird. I thought you'd be thrilled.
messages.zh: 奇怪，我以为你会颤抖。

messages.en: I guess... it's not gonna blow up or anything, right?
messages.zh: 我猜猜……它不会爆炸或怎样吧？

messages.en: Oh, don't worry, the one thing I do know is that it's legal.
messages.zh: 哦，别担心。我确定它是合法的。

messages.en: Oh? What's that?
messages.zh: 噢？那是什么？

messages.en:
The thing is, I don't know. Look... I lost a bet with this guy I know, and I was dumb enough to agree to do five forfeits-- “to be named later”-- when I thought I was going to win. Now I've got no idea what he's holding over me.

On top of that, part of the deal is that I've got to stay put, so I have to find someone who'll follow these freaking bizarre directions.

If you're willing to help me out, I'll upload the station info to the mission details in your Opportunities interface; all you have to do is go pick up the item that doesn't belong there and bring it back to me.
messages.zh:
问题是我并不知情。听着...我打赌输给了这个我认识的家伙，本以为能赢，但却傻乎乎地同意弃权五次，这个“稍后再谈”。现在我有点摸不清他的意图。

而且按约定我不能离开原地，所以必须找到人帮我执行这些奇怪的指示。

如果你愿意帮忙，我会把空间站信息上传到你“机遇”界面的任务详情内，只要找出不属于空间站的物品并把它带回来就可以了。

messages.en: Yeah... it's a doll. Here.
messages.zh: 是的……是个洋娃娃。给你。

messages.en:
Oh, I should have known he'd pull something like this. That bastard knows--

Never mind. There're directions on the damn doll. Give me a minute to figure them out, and then I'll need your help again.
messages.zh:
哦，我应该早猜到他会搞这花样。那家伙知道——

算了。那洋娃娃上有指示，先给我点时间让我看一下，然后我会再找你帮忙。

messages.en: Sorry, but I'm not signing up to carry something unless I know what it is.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我不会在不知情的情况下去运一样东西的。

messages.en: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.
messages.zh: 小心点，我们不能把自己不想失去的东西作为赌注。

messages.en:
The thing is, I don't know. Look... I lost a bet with this guy I know, and I was dumb enough to agree to do five forfeits-- “to be named later”-- when I thought I was going to win. Now I've got no idea what he's holding over me.

On top of that, part of the deal is that I've got to stay put, so I have to find someone who'll follow these freaking bizarre directions.

If you're willing to help me out, the station info is in the mission details I've uploaded to your Opportunities interface; all you have to do is go pick up the item that doesn't belong there and bring it back to me.
messages.zh:
问题是我并不知情。听着...我打赌输给了这个我认识的家伙，本以为能赢，但却傻乎乎地同意弃权五次，这个“稍后再谈”。现在我有点摸不清他的意图。

而且按约定我不能离开原地，所以必须找到人帮我执行这些奇怪的指示。

如果你愿意帮忙，就看看我上传到你“机遇”界面的任务详情内的空间站信息，只要找出不属于空间站的物品并把它带回来就可以了。

messages.en: I think you should really do your own dirty work.
messages.zh: 我觉得这脏活累活你应该自己去干。

messages.en: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.
messages.zh: 小心点，我们不能把自己不想失去的东西作为赌注。

messages.en: You're right; I don't like it. But I'll do it.
messages.zh: 你是对的；我不喜欢这样，但是我得这么做。

messages.en: Remember not to fire on anybody! I don't know what'll happen if I screw up any of these.
messages.zh: 记住不要向任何人开火！要是把别人惹毛了我可不知道会发生什么事情。

messages.en: Yeah, what is it?
messages.zh: 恩，什么东西？

messages.en: Well, you're not going to like it. He's set a location-- I'll upload it for you-- and you're supposed to fly out there and wait around for a drop. I don't know how long he's gonna make you wait, so be patient. <font="#FF0000"> And don't fire on anybody!</font>
messages.zh: 好吧，你不会喜欢的。他正在建立一个坐标——我会上传给你——你要飞过去等在那儿接收一个物资投放。我不知道他会让你等多久，所以你得有点耐心。<font="#FF0000"> 别向任何人射击！</font>

messages.en: It's another doll. I think there's something you're not telling me.
messages.zh: 这是另外一个娃娃。我想有些事情你没有告诉我。

messages.en:
It's about something that happened when I was a kid, all right? I don't want to talk about it.

There's another set of directions. I'll see you in a few.
messages.zh:
当我还是个孩子的时候遇到了些事情，但我不想谈论它。

我还有另外一套方案，待会儿再详谈。

messages.en: I think I'll pass. It sounds kinda suspicious.
messages.zh: 我不跟了，这听来有点可疑。

messages.en: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.
messages.zh: 小心点，我们不能把自己不想失去的东西作为赌注。

messages.en: Well, you're not going to like it. He's set a location-- I'll upload it for you-- and you're supposed to fly out there and wait around for a drop. I don't know how long he's gonna make you wait, so be patient. <font="#FF0000"> And don't fire on anybody!</font>
messages.zh: 好吧，你不会喜欢的。他正在建立一个坐标——我会上传给你——你要飞过去等在那儿接收一个物资投放。我不知道他会让你等多久，所以你得有点耐心。<font="#FF0000"> 别向任何人射击！</font>

messages.en: I'm out. Find someone else.
messages.zh: 我退出。另外找人吧。

messages.en: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.
messages.zh: 小心点，我们不能把自己不想失去的东西作为赌注。

messages.en: No harm will come to the diplomats.
messages.zh: 这对搞政治的人是没有什么坏处的。

messages.en: Good to know.
messages.zh: 很高兴知道

messages.en: What've they done now?
messages.zh: 他们都做了些什么？

messages.en: So get this: This one Gallente dignitary is completely hammered and calls our side, "a bunch of humorless egg-jockeys." The higher ups are protesting by pulling out of the embassy. They need you to provide security while they pull out. Rumor has it some jingoist factions of the Gallente will try to make a move on the ambassadors to spark more conflict. Patrol the area outside the embassy until the dignitaries have completed their withdraw.
messages.zh: 那听听这个：一个盖伦特的权贵最近向我们发起了挑衅，说我们是“一帮没有幽默感的鸡蛋小丑。”高层已经把大使馆的人都撤了出来，以示抗议。有传闻说盖伦特内部一些沙文主义团体会在我们的人撤离的时候搞些事件来扩大对抗的强度。你到大使馆外面去巡逻，直到所有的大人物都完全撤离了。

messages.en: It's a good thing I was there. A Gallente and his drones began attacking during the withdraw. I don't know if he was Gallente Navy, though.
messages.zh: 幸好我在那儿。在撤退的时候一个盖伦特人和他的无人机发动了攻击。不知道他是不是盖伦特海军的人。

messages.en: That is troubling. I'm glad you were there to handle it.
messages.zh: 这很麻烦，我很高兴有你在这儿帮我们解决问题。

messages.en: Screw the diplomats. Let them hash this out themselves.
messages.zh: 让政客见鬼去吧。等他们自己去把这事儿谈清楚。

messages.en: You better hope this doesn't get as big as it could.
messages.zh: 你最好希望这事儿不要过分的激化了。

messages.en: The empires are itching for a war. All they need is a good excuse. It's coming. It's more a question of when than if.
messages.zh: 各个国家的人现在都浑身发痒的想要打仗。他们所需要的就是一个恰当的借口了。现在机会来了，剩下的只是时间问题。

messages.en: Powder Keg
messages.zh: 火药桶

messages.en:
So get this: There's some big high society party going on. All the best and brightest are there. So this one Gallente dignitary is completely hammered and starts mouthing off to everyone. He even goes right up to an admiral and calls our side, "a bunch of humorless egg-jockeys." Right to his face!

So now it's this whole thing. The higher-ups are protesting by pulling out of the embassy. I think it's a stronger statement than they really should be making, but they're going ahead with it. They need you to provide security while they pull out. Rumor has it some jingoist factions of the Gallente will try to make a move on the ambassadors to spark more conflict. Patrol the area outside the embassy until the dignitaries have completed their withdraw.
messages.zh:
听着：最近有一个上流社会的派对正在举办。所有的社会名流都在那儿。然后有一个盖伦特权贵喝醉了酒，开始到处乱说话。他甚至对我们的一位上将说，我们海军是“一帮没情趣的卵人”。就冲着他的脸说的！

现在的情况是这样：高层们要把大使馆撤走，以示抗议。我原以为他们会采取更温和的态度，但他们已经这么安排了。他们需要你在他们撤离的时候提供安保。有传闻说，盖伦特内部一些军国主义势力会在我们的人撤离的时候搞些事件来扩大事态。我要你到大使馆外面去巡逻，直到所有的大人物都完成撤离。

messages.en: Screw the diplomats. Let them hash this out themselves.
messages.zh: 让政客见鬼去吧。等他们自己去把这事儿谈清楚。

messages.en: You better hope this doesn't get as big as it could.
messages.zh: 你最好希望这事儿不要过分的激化了。

name.en: What's in a Name  - Smile When You Call Me That (2 of 5)
name.es: Lo que encierra un nombre: Sonríe cuando me llames así (2 de 5)
name.fr: Le pouvoir des mots - Ça mérite au moins un sourire (2 sur 5)
name.ja: 大切なもの―貶すときにも愛想良く（2/5）

messages.en: They should really put defenseless media towers somewhere safer.
messages.zh: 他们真的因该把这种没有防御能力的塔台放在个安全的地方。

messages.en: I know, right?
messages.zh: 我知道，对么？

messages.en: I like that I can almost hear the quotes in that sentence.
messages.zh: 我喜欢那句话。

messages.en:
The Gallente media is painting both the Caldari and Amarr as overly sensitive ninnies because of the pullout. So there's going to be a little accident with one of the Gallente communication arrays.

Go make sure that accident happens.
messages.zh:
盖伦特的媒体把加达里和艾玛在这次撤出中的角色都说得像个傻子一样。这样的话我们就只好让盖伦特的一座通讯阵列发生点小意外了。

你过去给他们一点小小的意外。

messages.en: The tower is down.
messages.zh: 塔已经倒掉了。

messages.en: Hah! Let's see how whiney they get when their precious "free press" can't broadcast their filth.
messages.zh: 哈哈！让我们看看当他们的“自由言论”政策再也不能广播这些淫秽的猥亵信息后他们的表情回事怎样的痛苦。

messages.en: No. This is pushing things too far.
messages.zh: 不行，这只能让事情更糟糕。

messages.en: So you want them to think us weak? They're only more likely to attack.
messages.zh: 让他们觉得我们好欺负？这会让他们更加得寸进尺。

messages.en: Some structures are notoriously difficult to destroy with small weapons fire. If you're in a bit of a hurry, keep an eye out for more vulnerable targets attached to the structure. A good shot at a fuel or weapons depot might be what you need to bring a speedy end to the assault.
messages.zh: 如果要用小型武器来摧毁一些建筑物的话几乎是不可能的。如果你赶时间的话，注意看看是不是有易燃易爆的物体链接在你的目标建筑物上。比如一个燃料储藏舱或者军火库都是非常理想的。

messages.en: Structures and the Destruction Thereof
messages.zh: 建筑和破坏

messages.en:
The nature of the business, friend.

The Gallente media is painting both the Caldari and Amarr as overly sensitive ninnies because of the pullout. So there's going to be a little accident with one of the Gallente communication arrays.

Go make sure that accident happens.
messages.zh:
这就是事物的本质，朋友。

盖伦特的媒体把加达里和艾玛在这次撤出中的角色都说得像个傻子一样。这样的话我们就只好让盖伦特的一座通讯阵列发生点小意外了。

你过去给他们一点小小的意外。

messages.en: I decided I have better things to do than pop broadcast towers.
messages.zh: 我想除了去轰控制塔，我还有其他更有意义的事情要做。

messages.en: Liar.
messages.zh: 骗子。

name.de: Was bedeuted schon ein Name - Schubs (3 von 5)
name.en: What's in a Name  - Poke (3 of 5)
name.es: Lo que encierra un nombre: Toque (3 de 5)

messages.en: Time to give the Gallente a little scare.
messages.zh: 是时候要吓唬吓唬他们了。

messages.en: Make the captain crap himself.
messages.zh: 让那个上尉屁滚尿流。

messages.en: Stupid Gallente.
messages.zh: 愚昧的盖伦特人。

messages.en:
There's a Gallente battleship "practicing maneuvers" in the region. You're going to practice maneuvers too--right across their bow. Pass by their ship as close as you can. It will scare the hell out of them.

But please, whatever you do, do not fire on the battleship. It will win that fight.
messages.zh:
有一艘盖伦特的战列舰在这个区域进行“战术机动”。你也过去在他们的船头前面搞搞战术机动。从你能够做到的最近距离上掠过他们的战列舰。我想应该把他们吓得屁滚尿流吧。

但请注意，无论你做什么，都不要向那艘船开火，按我说的做就行了。

messages.en: That was excessively fun. I bet they're shaking.
messages.zh: 这简直是爽翻了。我打赌他们现在都还在发抖。

messages.en: You should hear the reports. The Gallente are now paranoid that we're going to roll right over them! Of course our line is just that you were taking photographs for your family or something, but they're scared senseless.
messages.zh: 你应该已经听到报道了。盖伦特现在已经开始神经衰弱了，我们要趁势压上去！当然我们的说法是你是为你的孩子们拍两张照片，却不知道把他们吓得昏过去了。

messages.en: Battleship? I'm thinking, "No."
messages.zh: 战列舰？我在想是不是不要去了。

messages.en: Chickening out? Come on, don't let the Gallente be right.
messages.zh: 怕了？没事儿，别让盖伦特把你吓着了。

messages.en: Seriously, don't fire at the battleship.
messages.zh: 我是说真的，不要朝那条船开火。

messages.en: Battleships and You
messages.zh: 战列舰与你

messages.en:
New plan. It's a bit riskier, but it should get the message across.

There's a Gallente battleship "practicing maneuvers" in the region. You're going to practice maneuvers too--right across their bow. Pass by their ship as close as you can. It will scare the hell out of them.

But please, whatever you do, do not fire on the battleship. It will win that fight.
messages.zh:
新的计划，这个比较冒险一点，但是应该能够准确地传达我们的信息。

有一艘盖伦特的战列舰在这个区域进行“战术机动”。你也过去在他们的船头前面搞搞战术机动。从你能够做到的最近距离上掠过他们的战列舰。我想应该把他们吓得屁滚尿流吧。

但请注意，无论你做什么，都不要向那艘船开火，按我说的做就行了。

messages.en: It was a battleship. I thought better of it.
messages.zh: 那是一个战列舰，我以为是什么更厉害的。

messages.en: You would have been fine if you just didn't fire first.
messages.zh: 你要是不首先开火的话就没事儿了。

messages.en: I'll return shortly.
messages.zh: 我很快就回来。

messages.en: Be quick.
messages.zh: 快点。

messages.en: What is it?
messages.zh: 帮什么忙？

messages.en: Starting to get mixed reports of Gallente buildup. Ships are moving out of stations. Reserves are being called up. We don't know what's going on, but it needs to be investigated. I'm giving you the most likely location for a convergence, if there is one. Report back when you know what is going on.
messages.zh: 最近开始收到了很多关于盖伦特集结的情报。舰船都被从空间站里调集出来，战备物资也开始进行储蓄。我们还不知道到底会发生什么事情，但我们需要去进行调查。我把一个非常可能的集结地点告诉你，你去看看，一有情况就回来向我报告。

messages.en: There were ships. Lots of ships.
messages.zh: 那有些船，有很多很多。

messages.en: I was afraid of that. Similar reports are popping up all over.
messages.zh: 我很担心，有很多类似的报告出现了。

messages.en: I'm not involving myself in this anymore.
messages.zh: 我不想把我自己卷到这样的事件中去。

messages.en: What? But--What?
messages.zh: 什么？你说什么？

messages.en: Not every mission you get requires you to kill every enemy in sight. It's often easier to warp out once your objective is done, enemy ships be damned.
messages.zh: 不是每个你拿到的任务都会让你把所有的敌人都干掉的。通常你最好在把首选目标处理掉过后就从现场跃迁出去。

messages.en: Mind the Mission
messages.zh: 关注任务

messages.en: Starting to get mixed reports of Gallente buildup. Ships are moving out of stations. Reserves are being called up. We don't know what's going on, but it needs to be investigated. I'm giving you the most likely location for a convergence, if there is one. Report back when you know what is going on.
messages.zh: 最近开始收到了很多关于盖伦特集结的情报。舰船都被从空间站里调集出来，战备物资也开始进行储蓄。我们还不知道到底会发生什么事情，但我们需要去进行调查。我把一个非常可能的集结地点告诉你，你去看看，一有情况就回来向我报告。

messages.en: I'm not involving myself in this anymore.
messages.zh: 我不想把我自己卷到这样的事件中去。

messages.en: What? But--What?
messages.zh: 什么？你说什么？

messages.en: I'll make sure he gets there safely.
messages.zh: 我保证他会安全到达那里。

messages.en: For everyone's sake, he better.
messages.zh: 为了所有人的利益，请务必保证兑现你的承诺。

messages.en: I thought this is what you wanted? The Gallente are taking us seriously.
messages.zh: 我觉得这正是你所希望的呀。盖伦特人开始正视我们了。

messages.en: This situation snowballed. Diplomacy must resume, even if to only keep things just below war being declared. Take our envoy over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. From there he will meet with the Gallente envoy to begin non-public negotiations. If all goes well, the situation will simply vanish from the public's consciousness and life will continue as normal.
messages.zh: 事情越闹越大。外交努力必须继续下去，即便只是将形势控制在离战争只有一步之遥的样子。请把我们的外交官员送往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。他会在那里和盖伦特的外交人员会面，然后进行一场闭门谈判。如果进展顺利，那目前的形势便会烟消云散，一切便会回归正常。

messages.en: The envoy's been delivered. I hope everything goes well.
messages.zh: 外交官送到。但愿一切顺利。

messages.en: We'll know if everything is going well by if there is a tomorrow.
messages.zh: 如果我们还能见到明天，那就算顺利了。

messages.en: Envoy? Like hell. They want peace, they'll apologize.
messages.zh: 外交官？去他的。他们要和平，他们会道歉的。

messages.en: I think a few hurt feelings and wounded egos are worth it if it avoids war.
messages.zh: 如果能避免战争，那我们低调做人完全值得。

messages.en: Lots of stuff.
messages.zh: 好处很多。

messages.en: What is war good for?
messages.zh: 战争有什么好的？

messages.en:
There's a difference between being taken seriously and letting the inmates run the asylum. Diplomacy must resume, even if to only keep things just below war being declared.

It's a strange game, friend. I don't think even the diplomats fully understand it. Still, this is one of those times diplomats are useful again.

Take our envoy over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. From there he will meet with the Gallente envoy to begin non-public negotiations. If all goes well, the situation will simply vanish from the public's consciousness and life will continue as normal.
messages.zh:
被敌人正视和被他们控制是两回事。外交努力必须继续下去，即便只是将形势控制在离战争只有一步之遥的样子。

朋友，这是场让人看不懂的游戏。我觉得即使是那帮外交官也不一定完全懂得其中的奥秘。但现在还是要让外交官显身手的时候。

请把我们的外交官员送往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。他会在那里和盖伦特的外交人员会面，然后进行一场闭门谈判。如果进展顺利，那目前的形势便会烟消云散，一切便会回归正常。

messages.en: You know, I decided I like war. Screw peace.
messages.zh: 我决定了，我要打仗。和平去死吧。

messages.en: I don't know that my mind is even capable of forming a response to that.
messages.zh: 我对你这样的问题无语了。

name.es: Espectáculo aéreo: Se abre la inscripción (1 de 5)
name.ja: 航空ショー！-登録受付中（1/5）
name.ru: Воздушное шоу! — Открытие регистрации (Air Show! - Sign-up Begins) (1 из 5)

messages.en: Pick up the entrance badge, bring it back here. Got it.
messages.zh: 把出入徽章拿来。懂了。

messages.en: Good. Meanwhile I'll make sure your name is added to the program.
messages.zh: 好。我保证会把你名字报进这个项目。

messages.en: Good? I'm gr--
messages.zh: 就只是好？我可是伟……

messages.en:
Perfect. You've just been invited to the Gallente-Minmatar Joint Air Show. I'm sure you're very excited.

Oh, what am I thinking? You need your entrance badge! Pick up your badge, then I'll be able to provide you with your show shuttle.
messages.zh:
很好。你已经应邀加入了盖伦特—米玛塔尔联合空演。我想你现在一定是跃跃跃欲试。

哦，我想我怎么忘了什么东西呢？原来是你要用的进场徽章啊！自己去取那徽章吧，然后我会把表演专用的穿梭机提供给你。

messages.en: Here's my entrance badge.
messages.zh: 我把出入徽章拿来了。

messages.en: I'll take that. Here's your shuttle.
messages.zh: 那东西放在我这里。这是你的穿梭机。

messages.en: Whoa, hang on there. I have no interest in being in your air show.
messages.zh: 嗨，行了。我没兴趣参加你那表演。

messages.en: Fine, move on. Next!
messages.zh: 行啊，随你便。下一位！

messages.en: Even when on the brink of war, sometimes the people need a reminder just what all of their taxes are paying for. Air shows have long been a reliable PR program that gets the people excited about military tech in a slightly friendlier venue than a state-funded parade. There are accidents every so often, and the introduction of the vacuum of space has certainly not made them any safer, but damn if they are not still popular.
messages.zh: 即使战争逼近，人民有时还是想知道他们的税款到底都花到什么地方去了。比起国家举行的阅兵仪式，航空表演是一个更亲近大众，能激起他们对军事科技兴趣的靠得住的形象工程。当然表演时事故时有发生，而且在真空举行这样的表演也没有降低事故发生率，但如果这种表演到现在为止还不受大家欢迎的话，那我真要吐了。

messages.en: Air Shows
messages.zh: 航空表演

messages.en:
Perfect. You've just been invited to the Gallente-Minmatar Joint Air Show. I'm sure you're very excited.

As a representative of state-sponsored capsuleer programs, you'll be expected to perform a variety of piloting tricks. All very basic for you, I'm sure.

Oh, what am I thinking? You need your entrance badge! Pick up your badge, then I'll be able to provide you with your show shuttle.
messages.zh:
很好。你已经应邀加入了盖伦特—米玛塔尔联合空演。我想你现在一定是跃跃跃欲试。

既然代表出演国家出资的项目，你就得表演多种飞行特技。我觉得这对你来说都是基本功。

哦，我想我怎么忘了什么东西呢？原来是你要用的进场徽章啊！自己去取那徽章吧，然后我会把表演专用的穿梭机提供给你。

messages.en: On second thought, I have no interest in being in your air show.
messages.zh: 我又想了一下，我觉得我对你那表演没兴趣。

messages.en: Fine, move on. Next!
messages.zh: 行啊，随你便。下一位！

name.de: Flugshow! - Schalte die Lichter aus...? (2 von 5)
name.en: Air Show!  - Kick the Fires...? (2 of 5)
name.ja: 航空ショー！-さあ行くぞ（2/5）
name.ru: Авиашоу! — Полный вперед…? (Air Show!  - Kick the Fires...?) (2 из 5)

messages.en: No problem.
messages.zh: 没问题。

messages.en: What are you still doing here? Get flying!
messages.zh: 你还在这儿干什么？快去表演！

messages.en: Hey, that rhyme--
messages.zh: 嗨，那节奏……

messages.en:
Your first event is just to fly around the audience. You have to fly out to a beacon. Once you reach the beacon, that one will go quiet and the next one will appear. Make the whole circuit, and your first act is done. Simple, yeah?

Oh, and make sure you're flying a shuttle. You received one for signing up, but really any shuttle will do.
messages.zh:
你的第一项表演就是在观众面前飞行。别激动，一切都按纸上安排的来。你必须一直往外飞到一个信标那里；一旦你飞过那信标后，它就会暗下来，从而亮起另一个。只要转一圈你的表演就完成了。简单吧？

哦，你一定要驾驶穿梭机。你报名时已经获得一架了。其实随便什么样的穿梭机都行。

messages.en: Audience completely wowed.
messages.zh: 观众完全被震撼了。

messages.en: Never say "wow" again. I hate that word.
messages.zh: 不许再说震撼。我讨厌那词。

messages.en: Gee, as fun as that sounds, I think I quit.
messages.zh: 啊，虽然听上去有趣，但我想我还是闪吧。

messages.en: Air shows are not about fun.
messages.zh: 航空表演和找乐子是两码事。

messages.en:
These beacons were specifically designed for use in air shows. There are similar devices already used in construction, but that wouldn't have been nearly as fun as another inflated government contract.

Note: You will have to add Large Collidable Objects to your Overview to see these mission specific beacons. The first one will be called Beacon 1.
messages.zh:
这些信标是专用于航空表演的。虽然类似的东西早已有建造，但政府就喜欢烧钱。

注意：你需要在总览中显示大型空间实体才能看到这些特殊的任务信标。第一个叫做信标1。

messages.en: Proximity Beacons
messages.zh: 近距范围信标

messages.en:
Your first event is just to fly around the audience. Don't get too excited, everything is carefully choreographed. You have to fly out to a beacon. Once you reach the beacon, that one will go quiet and the next one will appear. Make the whole circuit, and your first act is done. Simple, yeah?

Oh, and make sure you're flying a shuttle. You received one for signing up, but really any shuttle will do.
messages.zh:
你的第一项表演就是在观众面前飞行。别激动，一切都按纸上安排的来。你必须一直往外飞到一个信标那里；一旦你飞过那信标后，它就会暗下来，从而亮起另一个。只要转一圈你的表演就完成了。简单吧？

哦，你一定要驾驶穿梭机。你报名时已经获得一架了。其实随便什么样的穿梭机都行。

messages.en: Gee, as fun as that sounds, I think I quit.
messages.zh: 啊，虽然听上去有趣，但我想我还是闪吧。

messages.en: Air shows are not about fun.
messages.zh: 航空表演和找乐子是两码事。

name.fr: Salon aéronautique !  - Crash et incendie (3 sur 5)
name.ja: 航空ショー！-パイロットの救出（3/5）
name.ru: Авиашоу! — свободное падение (Air Show! - Crash & Burn ) (3 из 5)
name.zh: 航空表演！— 冲击和燃烧（3/5）

messages.en: Don't worry. I'll get that pilot out.
messages.zh: 别担心。我会把那飞行员救出来的。

messages.en: Hurry, but not too much. The audience likes some excitement, after all.
messages.zh: 那就快去吧，但也别太急了。观众毕竟喜欢看热闹。

messages.en: Whatever it is, I'm re--
messages.zh: 无所谓，反正我也要……

messages.en:
I'm getting word that one of our stunt craft just burst into flames. The pilot ejected successfully, but his pod is damaged. He can't make his way back under his own power.

{[character]player.name}, get out there and bring that pilot back. I'm not losing a pilot.
messages.zh:
我得到消息说我们的一艘特技船着火了。庆幸的是那飞行员还活着，但他的逃生舱还是严重遭毁。他靠自己没法回来。

{[character]player.name}，去把那飞行员带回来。我不想牺牲他。

messages.en: Pilot safely returned.
messages.zh: 飞行员安全送回。

messages.en: Is he still alive? Yes? Good. Just dump him over here somewhere. I'm sure someone will get to him eventually.
messages.zh: 他还活着吗？活着？很好。就让他待在这里。我相信会有人来接他的。

messages.en: That pilot knew the risks. Let the audience see the reality we face.
messages.zh: 那飞行员应该知道这风险。还是让观众明白我们面临的实际危险吧。

messages.en: You are out of the show. Get out of here.
messages.zh: 你不用再表演了。滚吧。

messages.en: Proper capsuleer pods are completely reliable and do not break on their own. They are, however, slow as all hell and liable to pop if looked at wrong. Traveling in one for any period of time is not recommended.
messages.zh: 正规的逃生舱可靠性极佳，基本不会自己开裂。但它们的飞行速度极慢，而且很容易被爆，因此一般不建议用它们来进行旅行。

messages.en: Pod Reliability
messages.zh: 逃生舱的可靠性

messages.en:
Hang on to that thought. I'm getting word that one of our stunt craft just burst into flames. I told them we were overloading the systems too much! Now we're…

Wait…yes, the pilot ejected successfully, but his pod is damaged. He can't make his way back under his own power.

{[character]player.name}, get out there and bring that pilot back. I'm not losing a pilot.
messages.zh:
先别慌。我得到消息说我们的一艘特技船着火了。我早就提醒过他们系统会超载的！现在我们……

等等……好，那飞行员所幸还活着，但他的逃生舱还是严重遭毁。他靠自己没法回来。

{[character]player.name}，去把那飞行员带回来。我不想失去他。

messages.en: That pilot knew the risks. Let the audience see the reality we face.
messages.zh: 那飞行员应该知道这风险。还是让观众明白我们面临的实际危险吧。

messages.en: You are out of the show. Get out of here.
messages.zh: 你不用再表演了。滚吧。

name.en: Air Show! - Target Rich Environment (4 of 5)
name.fr: Salon aéronautique ! - Un environnement riche en cibles (4 sur 5)
name.ru: Авиашоу! — цели со всех сторон (Air Show! - Target Rich Environment) (4 из 5)
name.zh: 航空表演！—满是目标的环境（4/5）

messages.en: I can pop a few drones, no problem.
messages.zh: 我行的，没问题。

messages.en: Then go out there and give everyone a good show.
messages.zh: 那就快去给大家献上一场精彩表现吧。

messages.en: Just tell me since you'll interrupt me any--
messages.zh: 那就快说。

messages.en:
This is the big combat section. We've got some drones flying around that you're going to pop. This is live fire, but it shouldn't be too dangerous. Just take out any drone you see. The people will love it.

Oh, and do note that you must fly something with weapons this time. Your shuttle will not cut it.
messages.zh:
现在表演进行到了战斗部分。我们准备了一些无人机，你要把他们都给爆掉。这可是来真格的，但还不至于太危险。见一个打一个就行。观众肯定喜欢看。

哦，这次你记着要驾驶一艘带武器的船。你的穿梭机不会顶用。

messages.en: The drones have been dispatched in a series of satisfying explosions.
messages.zh: 伴随着令人满意的爆炸声，那些无人机都化作了烟花。

messages.en: Perfect!
messages.zh: 太好了！

messages.en: Combat? I think not.
messages.zh: 战斗？算了。

messages.en: Come on. What's more entertaining than explosions?
messages.zh: 我靠。难道爆炸还不够刺激吗？

messages.en: Contrary to Caldari propaganda, not all drones gain sentience and turn on their masters. The Gallente have made great strides in drone technology. Modern drones are highly reliable. The one you will fight today have been made to simulate rogue drones, but it is only simulation.
messages.zh: 与加达里的宣扬的恰恰相反，不是所有的无人机都会有突然意识，然后对制造者倒戈一击。盖伦特在无人机科技方面已取得了长足进步。现代无人机都是非常可靠的。你今天要去对付的无人机只是自由无人机的模拟品而已。

messages.en: Drone Simulations
messages.zh: 无人机模拟

messages.en:
This is the big combat section. We've got some drones flying around that you're going to pop. This is live fire, but it shouldn't be too dangerous. Just take out any drone you see. The people will love it.

Oh, and do note that you must fly something with weapons this time. Your shuttle will not cut it.
messages.zh:
现在表演进行到了战斗部分。我们准备了一些无人机，你要把他们都给爆掉。这可是来真格的，但还不至于太危险。见一个打一个就行。观众肯定喜欢看。

哦，这次你记着要驾驶一艘带武器的船。你的穿梭机不会顶用。

messages.en: Combat? I think not.
messages.zh: 战斗？算了。

messages.en: Come on. What's more entertaining than explosions?
messages.zh: 我靠。难道爆炸还不够刺激吗？

name.en: Air Show! - Requesting a Flyby (5 of 5)
name.es: Espectáculo aéreo: Vuelo de reconocimiento (5 de 5)
name.fr: Salon aéronautique ! - Vol en rase-mottes demandé (5 sur 5)
name.ja: 航空ショー！-接近飛行のリクエスト（5/5）
