name.ru: Авиашоу! — Запрос на пролет мимо (Air Show! - Requesting a Flyby) (5 из 5)
name.zh: 航空表演！— 要求低空通场（5/5）

messages.en: Just one fly-by? Easy.
messages.zh: 就来一次通场飞行？小菜一碟。

messages.en: Easy, but they do so love loud noises.
messages.zh: 是啊，观众确实很喜欢巨大的噪音。

messages.en: ...Oh, can I talk this ti--
messages.zh: ……哦，那这次我能发……

messages.en:
So what you're going to be doing is an old fashioned tower-buzz. It's rather simple. I'll give you a series of nine start and end points. Fly between these points. This will take you past the onlookers, giving them a good buzz.

If you have the skills and equipment, you can use a Micro-Warp Drive (MWD) for this. It's not required, but you'll go crazy fast.

Note: You will have to add Large Collidable Objects to your Overview to see these mission specific beacons. The first one will be called Beacon 1.
messages.zh:
你这次要做的就是来一次老掉牙的轰鸣表演。过程很简单，我会给你九个起点与终点，你的任务就是在它们之间转悠。在此过程中你会从观众面前飞过，让他们感受一下巨大的轰鸣声。

如果你已经具备相应技能，那你就可以搭载上微型跃迁推进器。这玩意儿虽然不必要，但可以让你变得飞快。

注意：你需要在总览中显示大型空间实体才能看到这些特殊的任务信标。第一个叫做信标1。

messages.en: And I'm done.
messages.zh: 干好了。

messages.en: Great work! Everyone loved the whole show. Why, at this rate we may even have another air show before too long.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！所有的人都对表演大加赞赏。凭这样的实力，用不了多久我们就可以再搞一次这样的演出。

messages.en: How droll. I pass.
messages.zh: 太小儿科了吧。我不干。

messages.en: : Massive. Subwoofers.
messages.zh: 巨型低音炮。

messages.en: Because soundless space is not cool.
messages.zh: 因为没声音的太空不够酷。

messages.en: Sound in Space
messages.zh: 太空中的声音

messages.en:
So what you're going to be doing is an old fashioned tower-buzz. It's rather simple. I'll give you a series of nine start and end points. Fly between these points. This will take you past the onlookers, giving them a good buzz.

Of course there is no air in space, so the buzz will be simulated with massive subwoofers we've hidden around their seating, but they'll love it.

If you have the skills and equipment, you can use a Micro-Warp Drive (MWD) for this. It's not required, but you'll go crazy fast.

Note: You will have to add Large Collidable Objects to your Overview to see these mission specific beacons. The first one will be called Beacon 1.
messages.zh:
你这次要做的就是来一次老掉牙的轰鸣表演。过程很简单，我会给你九个起点与终点，你的任务就是在它们之间转悠。在此过程中你会从观众面前飞过，让他们感受一下巨大的轰鸣声。

当然了，由于太空中没有空气，因此我们会利用安装在观众座位上的巨型低音炮来模拟轰鸣声，我想观众们会喜欢的。

如果你已经具备相应技能，那你就可以搭载上微型跃迁推进器。这玩意儿虽然不必要，但可以让你变得飞快。

注意：你需要在总览中显示大型空间实体才能看到这些特殊的任务信标。第一个叫做信标1。

messages.en: This is droll. I pass.
messages.zh: 这是太小儿科表演。我不干。

messages.en: Massive. Subwoofers.
messages.zh: 巨型低音炮。

messages.en: Sure, I don't mind teaching scum like that a lesson or two. Count me in.
messages.zh: 当然，我不介意为那混蛋上一两节课。算上我吧。

messages.en: This pleases me more than you know, {[character]player.name}. We'll show this crooked wretch how we do things downstation.
messages.zh: 这要比你想象的更令我欣喜，{[character]player.name}。我们会让这个邪恶的家伙知道，接下去我们会怎么做。

messages.en: Is that so? Well, as long as it makes me rich, color me interested. What is it?
messages.zh: 是那样吗？好吧，既然我能借此赚钱，就当我是有兴趣的吧。究竟是怎么回事呢？

messages.en:
It's simple, really: I supplied this ungrateful Gallente leech with items he requested, and then he warps away before paying me. I'd like you teach him some manners — by blasting his ship to stardust, then returning my stolen cargo to me.

My sources tell me he can be found at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.
messages.zh:
这很简单，真的：我给了这个不懂得感恩的盖伦特吸血鬼他所要的东西，然后他还没付钱就跃迁走了。我希望你去教教他如何礼貌做人——把他的舰船轰成渣吧，然后把我失窃的货柜带回给我。

我的情报告诉说你能在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}找到他。

messages.en:
Your thief is dead, here's your cargo. I taught your friend a lesson, all right — don't mess with me. Too bad he's dead, because I'd like to teach him that one again.

Now pay up.
messages.zh:
偷你东西的贼已经死了，这是你的货物。我给他上了一课，好吧——别管我。很不幸他死了，我本想再给他上一次课的。

付钱吧。

messages.en: Superbly done, {[character]player.name} ! If only I could have been there, to see him mewl as his ship crumbled around him — oh, the hilarity! Enjoy your reward, friend. You've earned it.
messages.zh: 干得太棒了，{[character]player.name}！要是我也能在场，亲眼看他为他分崩离析的舰船哭泣的话，就再好不过了——哦，真高兴啊！这是你的报酬，朋友，你挣到的。

messages.en: Boo-hoo, someone stole something from you. Deal with it yourself: I've got places to be.
messages.zh: 呜呼，有人拿走了你的东西。你自己去解决吧：我要去其他地方了。

messages.en: Oh, that's all I needed to hear today. No one gives a toss for a poor, honest businessman these days, it seems.
messages.zh: 哦，到此为止吧。这些天似乎没人愿意为一位可怜的，诚实的商人伸出援手。

messages.en:
Remember to keep an eye on your shields and armor during battle. But if you do forget and you happen to lose a ship, well… hey, that's the life of a capsuleer. Just get a new one, even if you've got to beg, borrow, or steal, and just get right back to work.

Get used to the idea: Ships — not to mention your current clone — won't last forever.
messages.zh:
记得在战斗中要留心你自己的护盾和装甲。但如果你确实忘记了，并因此不巧失去了一艘战舰，好吧……嘿，那就是克隆飞行员的生活。弄一艘新的吧，即使你需要为此行乞，借钱，然后回来工作。

尝试习惯这个想法：舰船——不是说你现在这艘——总是会损坏的。

messages.en: Danger and You
messages.zh: 危险和你

messages.en:
I wish everyone was as straightforward as you, {[character]player.name}. Then I wouldn't be in this situation.

I supplied this Gallente leech with certain items he requested, and then he warps away before paying me. Some people, I tell you. So, I need to teach him some manners. Well, okay… I need you to teach him some manners.

My sources tell me he can be found at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. {[character]player.name}, I'd like you to do that — teach him his manners — by flying out there, blasting his ship to so much dust, then returning my stolen cargo to me. If that doesn't teach him, nothing will.
messages.zh:
我希望每个人都像你这么直接，{[character]player.name}。那么我就不会处在这样的局势中了。

我按照那个盖伦特吸血鬼的要求给了他所要的东西，可是他还没付钱就跃迁走了。有些人，如我所说的。因此，我想教教他如何礼貌做人。好把……我需要你来给他上这堂课。

我的情报告诉说你能在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}找到他。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, I really could have used you on this job. It's unfortunate things didn't work out… but I'm sure the fault is all yours.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我那时的确是想让你来做这个任务。很不幸事情没有什么进展……但是我确信都是你的错。

messages.en: Lost honor
messages.zh: 失去的诚信

messages.en: I really don't have time for this. Find someone else to fight your battles for you. Or better yet, learn to fight them yourself.
messages.zh: 我真的没时间做这件事。找其他人来帮你战斗吧。或者，你更应该学习自己去和他们战斗。

messages.en: You disappoint me, {[character]player.name}. If I can't count on you, then who can I count on? This universe grows darker every day...
messages.zh: 你使我失望，{[character]player.name}。如果我连你都不能指望，我还能指望谁呢？这个宇宙正日渐黑暗……

messages.en: Because of your failure to deal with the small matter of bringing justice to the Gallente thief at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, my business is now facing bankruptcy. Sooner or later, {[character]player.name}, you're going to have realize we're all in this together, and start acting accordingly.
messages.zh: 因为你连将位于(missiondetails.dungeon.1.location.name)s的盖伦特乱序者们绳之以法这样的小事都做不好，我的公司正面临破产。或早或晚，{[character]player.name}，你会意识到我们是绑在一条船上的，因此快去行动吧。

messages.en: Facing bankruptcy
messages.zh: 面临破产

name.fr: Des rayons laser qui manquent de puissance
name.ja: レーザーの優しい輝き

messages.en: He won't know what hit him.
messages.zh: 他不会知道是什么击中了他。

messages.en: Don't waste any time! And don't worry: House Tash-Murkon has formally disowned Geeral already, so you'll face no repercussions from them.
messages.zh: 别浪费时间！也别担心：塔什蒙贡家族已经正式否认了葛瑞尔的家族身份，所以你不会遭受他们的报复。

messages.en: Sure, but... how about something with a little action?
messages.zh: 当然，但是……就一件小事，怎么样？

messages.en:
As you may know, the Tash-Murkon family is one of the richest in the galaxy. The kind of wealth they can bring to bear is mind-boggling. One of their scions, an otherwise respectable man named Geeral — he is, in fact, one-hundred and seventy-eighth in line for the throne — has turned traitor. He has stolen the access codes for some of the family's secret bank accounts and fled toward Gallente space.

We have tracked Geeral Tash-Murkon to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We suspect he is going to meet his Gallentean allies, who will escort him back to Gallente space. Go out there and capture Geeral. Bring him back to me; destroy his allies.

You will need some firepower for this mission. A stoutly armed cruiser is recommended.
messages.zh:
你知道，塔什蒙贡家族是当今世界最富有的家族之一，这个大家族所拥有的巨额财富多得令人难以想象。家族后代中有个孙子叫葛瑞尔·塔什蒙贡备受尊敬，可事实上他在孙子辈中只排行178位，结果与王位无缘的他选择了叛变。他拿走了家族的一些机密银行帐号和存取密码，然后逃往盖伦特。

我们跟踪葛瑞尔来到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，我们估计他想要在此与盖伦特的同伙汇合，前往盖伦特。我要你去抓住葛瑞尔，干掉他的同伙，然后把他带回来见我。

要完成这个任务，你需要点重火力，推荐你去弄一艘防御坚固的巡洋舰。

messages.en: The Tash-Murkon traitor is in the hold — a little the worse for wear, but he's alive.
messages.zh: 塔什蒙贡叛徒在这里——有点狼狈，不过他还活着。

messages.en: You have done well; the Tash-Murkon family will certainly appreciate your efforts. I shudder to think of the horrors that await Geeral when he is returned to his family.
messages.zh: 你做得很好；塔什蒙贡家族当然会感激你的努力。我都不敢想象塔什蒙贡家族准备了多么恐怖的惩罚来迎接葛瑞尔回家。

messages.en: I don't want any part of royal family machinations. I hate politics.
messages.zh: 我不想参与任何皇室家族的阴谋。我恨政治。

messages.en: I hope I can find someone else to handle this.
messages.zh: 我希望能够找到其他人来处理这个问题。

messages.en: The Tash-Murkon family is one of the royal families of Amarr, but their blood is not truly Amarrian blood. They were originally Udorian, but their immense wealth allowed them to buy their way to power.
messages.zh: 塔什蒙贡家族是艾玛皇室的一支，但是他们并没有真正的艾玛血统。他们原本是尤朵人，但是他们无尽的财富能够打通权势之路。

messages.en: House Tash-Murkon
messages.zh: 塔什蒙贡家族

messages.en:
I have just the thing, never fear.

As you may know, members of the royal families can be... er, marginally eccentric. However, rarely do they prove disloyal to the Empire. The Tash-Murkon family is one of the richest in the galaxy. The kind of wealth they can bring to bear is mind-boggling. One of their scions, an otherwise respectable man named Geeral — he is, in fact, one-hundred and seventy-eighth in line for the throne — has turned traitor.

He has stolen the access codes for some of the family's secret bank accounts and fled toward Gallente space. If he reaches it, the Gallente would be only too willing to drain those funds dry in an effort to throw the entire Amarrian government into chaos. Naturally, we cannot allow this to happen.

We have tracked Geeral Tash-Murkon to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We suspect he is going to meet his Gallentean allies, who will escort him back to Gallente space. Go out there and capture Geeral. Bring him back to me; destroy his allies.
messages.zh:
要干大事我从不畏惧。

你可能了解，身处深宫的皇室成员有时举止怪癖，但是背弃帝国的这样的事情还是鲜有发生。塔什蒙贡家族是当今世界最富有的家族之一，这个大家族所拥有的巨额财富多得令人难以想象。家族后代中有个孙子叫葛瑞尔·塔什蒙贡备受尊敬，可事实上他在孙子辈中只排行第178位，结果与王位无缘的他选择了叛变。

他拿走了家族的一些机密银行帐号和存取密码，然后逃往盖伦特。如果他得以逃脱，对于抽干艾玛金库，令艾玛朝野陷入一片混乱，盖伦特只会感到求之不得。显然，我们绝不能让这种事情发生。

我们跟踪葛瑞尔来到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，我们估计他想要在此与盖伦特的同伙汇合，前往盖伦特。我要你去抓住葛瑞尔，干掉他的同伙，然后把他带回来见我。

{[character]player.name}，

你没能抓回逃犯葛瑞尔，塔什蒙贡家族曾经的一员。因为你的怯弱，他逃到了盖伦特空间。如果艾玛帝国的经济福利在接下去的几天里变得低迷的话，你会知道为什么的。

{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Tash-Murkon fugitive
messages.zh: 塔什蒙贡逃犯

messages.en: Sorry, but Geeral escaped. There was nothing I could do.
messages.zh: 对不起，但是葛瑞尔逃跑了。我对此无能为力。

messages.en: I must question your loyalty to the Emperor, or else your bravery. You are not the ship captain I thought you were.
messages.zh: 我必须质疑你对皇帝的忠诚，要不就是质疑你的勇气。你不是我以前认识的那个船长了。

{[character]player.name}，

你没能抓回逃犯葛瑞尔，塔什蒙贡家族曾经的一员。因为你的怯弱，他逃到了盖伦特空间。如果艾玛帝国的经济福利在接下去的几天里变得低迷的话，你会知道为什么的。

{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Tash-Murkon fugitive
messages.zh: 塔什蒙贡逃犯

messages.en: Four rooms, four dolls. Got it.
messages.zh: 四个房间，四个玩偶。知道了。

messages.en: Do hurry. I'm not sure I can take these dolls much longer.
messages.zh: 快点，我不知道还能保住这些玩偶多长时间。

messages.en: What is the story with the dolls, anyway?
messages.zh: 那些玩偶背后有什么故事？

messages.en: There are four dolls hidden in a series of deadspace pockets. How he found an unused chain of acceleration gates, I have no idea. But they're out there. Go to each canister, take a doll, then use the acceleration gate to get to the next room. There should be four rooms and four dolls.
messages.zh: 在那个死亡空间里面隐藏了四个玩偶。他找到了在各个加速轨道之间的秘密关联，但我不是很清楚。但它们就在那儿，去看看每个罐子，找到那些玩偶，通过加速轨道到达下一层，应该有四个空间层，每层一个玩偶。

messages.en: Four more dolls for you.
messages.zh: 你还要再多四个玩偶。

messages.en: Just...just put them over there. With the others.
messages.zh: 就把他们放在那儿。

messages.en: To hell with this. I quit.
messages.zh: 去死吧，我退出。

messages.en: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.
messages.zh: 小心点，我们不能把自己不想失去的东西作为赌注。

messages.en: Yes, dolls. All kids love dolls.
messages.zh: 是啊，玩偶，可爱的玩偶。

messages.en: Dolls
messages.zh: 玩偶

messages.en:
I don't want to talk about it. Whenever I close my eyes I can still hear the screams...

So, yes, more dolls. There are four dolls hidden in a series of deadspace pockets. How he found an unused chain of acceleration gates, I have no idea. But they're out there. Go to each canister, take a doll, and then use the acceleration gate to get to the next room. There should be four rooms and four dolls.
messages.zh:
我不想谈论这个。无论什么时候，当我闭上眼，依然能够听到惨叫声……

好吧，还需要更多的玩偶。在那个死亡空间里面隐藏了四个玩偶。他找到了在各个加速轨道之间的秘密关联，但我不是很清楚。但它们就在那儿，去看看每个罐子，找到那些玩偶，通过加速轨道到达下一层，应该有四个空间层，每层一个玩偶。

messages.en: To hell with this. I quit.
messages.zh: 去死吧，我退出。

messages.en: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.
messages.zh: 小心点，我们不能把自己不想失去的东西作为赌注。

messages.en: Easy, there. I'll get the doll.
messages.zh: 简单，我会把玩偶弄到手的。

messages.en: Another doll, and that'll be all. Another doll....
messages.zh: 又拿到一个，应该已经齐了。又一个玩偶……

messages.en: What is it this time?
messages.zh: 这次又是什么？

messages.en: He's hidden another one of those blasted dolls at another location. But it's not just anywhere, oh no, he's hidden it this time. It's in the middle of an asteroid field. You'll have to mine through those rocks until you find it.
messages.zh: 他还隐藏了另一个受诅咒的玩偶在另一个地点。只是不知道在哪儿，噢，不，他把它给藏起来了。在一个小行星带的中心。你得要挖这些石头，直到找到它。

messages.en: That was thoroughly unpleasant, but I have retrieved the doll.
messages.zh: 这真是不愉快，不过我会找回这些玩偶的。

messages.en: Another doll! Almost done here! Yes....
messages.zh: 又一个玩偶！快集齐了！很好……

messages.en: You're starting to scare me a little. I think I better go.
messages.zh: 你开始吓到我了。我想我还是走吧。

messages.en: Have you ever looked at their faces? They look back.
messages.zh: 你有看见他们的脸么？他们看了看后面

messages.en: They're all laughing at me.
messages.zh: 他们都在朝我笑呢。

messages.en: Don't you hear them? The dolls?
messages.zh: 你没有听到我说的么？关于玩偶？

messages.en:
He's hidden another one of those blasted dolls at another location. But it's not just anywhere, oh no, he's hidden it this time. It's in the middle of an asteroid field. You'll have to mine through those rocks until you find it.

Yes, I'm serious. So go! Fetch the dolls! The more the merrier!
messages.zh:
他还隐藏了另一个受诅咒的玩偶在另一个地点。只是不知道在哪儿，噢，不，他把它给藏起来了。在一个小行星带的中心。你得要挖这些石头，直到找到它。

我是认真的。去吧！找到那个玩偶！多多益善！

messages.en: This isn't even funny anymore. Quitting.
messages.zh: 这已经变得十分没趣儿了，我退出了。

messages.en: You can't quit! There are still more dolls. Always more dolls.
messages.zh: 你不能退出，还有更多的玩偶。总是有更多的玩偶。

messages.en: Enlil is as good as dead.
messages.zh: 厄利尔已经死翘翘了。

messages.en: As good as dead! I love it! I'll have the curtain ready for our guests.
messages.zh: 太好啦！我太喜欢这个了！我要去为我们的客人准备一下。

messages.en: The show? Are you alright?
messages.zh: 那个演出？你还好么？

messages.en: Find Enlil Bel. End his role in this story. Bring me his meat costume. I want to wear it.
messages.zh: 找到厄利尔·贝儿。结束他在这场游戏中的角色。把他的道具服装给我带回来，我要穿在我身上。

messages.en: Enlil Bel is dead. His part in this is done.
messages.zh: 厄利尔·贝儿已经死了。他的作用已经完成了。

messages.en:
Enlil Bel? What are you--

You didn't talk to me when I was... Oh god, what did you do?

Oh dear, oh dear. I have to think of what to do now. Uh, here. Here's your payment. You don't know anything about what happened here, right? Neither of us know anything.

It's happening all over again.
messages.zh:
厄利尔·贝儿？你再说……

你不是……噢，我的神啊。你做了什么？

天啊，天啊。我得想想现在该怎么办了。呃，这样。这儿是你的报酬。你对这儿发生的任何事情都不知道，明白？我们俩谁都不知道。

这又得从头开始。

messages.en: I will not kill for you. Get help.
messages.zh: 我不会帮你害人的，另请高明吧。

messages.en: Maybe...rraarrgh...maybe you're right.
messages.zh: 也许……呃啊～～～或许你是对的。

messages.en:
It's five acts, don't you see? The purity of it! The establishment, the turn, all wonderful. But the end!

...At last there will be a resolution.
messages.zh:
这戏有五场，你没看出来么？ 开场，序章，转折，都十分有趣。但是这结局！

……最终是会有解决的方案的。

messages.en: Story's End
messages.zh: 故事的结局

messages.en:
Yes, the show. It's the real reason for all of this, you see. At first I thought he was being vindictive by constantly reminding me of that terrible night, but now I see. He is the only one that understood the significance of that night. He was trying to show me.

It's all been an act, you see? And it wasn't the dolls. They're just an audience. We! We are the performers. And this story, like all good comedies, ends with a death.

Find Enlil Bel. He is the one who began this tale.

End his role. Bring me his meat costume. I want to wear it.
messages.zh:
是的，那个演出。这才是所有这些事情的真正原因，就像你看到的。起初我以为他一直是想报复，一直提醒我那个恐怖的夜晚，但是现在我明白了。他是唯一一个懂得那个晚上发生的事情的重要性的人。他试图让我也明白。

这都是演习，你懂么？这实际上和那个玩偶一点关系都没有，他们都是听众。我们！我们才是演员。而这个故事，和所有的喜剧一样都以悲剧收场。

找到厄利尔·贝儿。他是那个导演这场戏的人。

结束他角色的生命。把他的道具服装给我带回来，我要穿在我身上。

messages.en: I will not kill for you. Get help.
messages.zh: 我不会帮你害人的，另请高明吧。

messages.en: Maybe...rraarrgh...maybe you're right.
messages.zh: 也许……呃啊～～～或许你是对的。

messages.en: I'll make sure he arrives safely.
messages.zh: 我保证他能安全到达。

messages.en: Good. After this, the real work begins.
messages.zh: 很好。这事情搞定之后就有真正的活儿要干了。

messages.en: What's up?
messages.zh: 怎么了？

messages.en: Command has been hearing strange things about a certain Major. Unsettling things. It is felt that investigating the Major must be handled with more tact than a traditional inquiry would provide. The first step is implanting a spy into his staff. Deliver this man to the location provided; he will do the rest.
messages.zh: 指挥部已经发现某个少校有点异常。这事让人担。我觉得我们在调查该少校时应该更加细微谨慎。我们要做的第一步就是在他下属当中安插一个间谍。把这人送到指定地点；接下的事他自己会处理。

messages.en: The spy has been delivered.
messages.zh: 间谍已送达。

messages.en: That's great. In fact, our spy is already providing us with interesting data.
messages.zh: 太好了。我们的间谍已经向我们通报了一些很有意思的情报。

messages.en: No, this sounds like something I want to stay away from.
messages.zh: 不，这事让我觉得我应该离这事远点。

messages.en: Disappointing.
messages.zh: 真让人失望。

messages.en: Holoreels would have you believe that spies occupy romantic positions, such as enticing femme fatales or ceiling-crawling ninjas. The reality is that often the most effective spies are the ones posing as simple functionaries. Nobody expects the dull guy.
messages.zh: 影片里描绘的间谍形象能使你相信间谍不是外表光鲜就是身怀绝技，比如能迷倒人的致命女谍或是能攀岩走壁的忍者。但现实是大多数间谍干的活都很平常，没有什么惊天动地的地方，这样别人也不容易起疑心。

messages.en: Spies in Ties
messages.zh: 关系错综的间谍

messages.en: Command has been hearing strange things about a certain Major. Unsettling things. Given our situation with the other empires, it is felt that investigating the Major must be handled with more tact than a traditional inquiry would provide. The first step is implanting a spy into his staff. Deliver this man to the location provided; he will do the rest.
messages.zh: 指挥部已经发现某个少校有点异常。这事让人担忧。在目前形势下，我觉得我们在调查该少校时应该更加细微谨慎。我们要做的第一步就是在他下属当中安插一个间谍。把这人送到指定地点；接下的事他自己会处理。

messages.en: I decided that I don't want to get involved in this.
messages.zh: 我决定不卷入其中。

messages.en: Sooner or later, you will have to involve yourself in the affairs of the world around you.
messages.zh: 你迟早要被牵扯入在你身边发生的事情。

messages.en: Stolen property, coming up.
messages.zh: 被盗的财产，来了。

messages.en: I hope this will be as big as I feel it is.
messages.zh: 希望这些东西和我想象的一样有价值。

messages.en: Oh?
messages.zh: 哦？

messages.en:
There was a theft in the Major's office just before our spy arrived. The thief made off with a number of the Major's personal effects. The timing of this could be coincidental, but it's unlikely.

I want you to go out there and take out the thieves. Bring back whatever they stole.
messages.zh:
在我们的情报人员到达少校的办公室之前有一个窃贼已经光顾了那里，带走了几件少校的私人物品。这事儿可能只是巧合，但看起来实在不像。

我要你去干掉乱序者，把它拿走的东西都带回来给我。

messages.en: Here are the Major's personal effects.
messages.zh: 这儿是少校的个人物品。

messages.en:
Good work. Let's see what we have here....

I don't get it. There's nothing but actual personal items here. Some medals, family photos; nothing valuable nor incriminating. Weird.
messages.zh:
干得很好，让我们看看都有些什么……

我不明白，这儿什么都没有，的确只是一些私人物品。一些奖章，家庭照片；没有任何有价值的东西。奇怪。

messages.en: I can't bring that thief down. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我没法打败那个乱序者。对不起。

messages.en: Do you have any idea how hard it will be to get another free agent to do this without attracting attention?
messages.zh: 你知道要在极度保密的条件下再找另外一个特工来干这事儿是多么困难么？

messages.en: You have to hire someone better.
messages.zh: 你应该另外请个高手。

messages.en: If you want something done right...
messages.zh: 如果你想要做些有意义的事情的话。

messages.en:
Apparently there was a theft in the Major's office just before our spy arrived. The thief made off with a number of the Major's personal effects. The timing of this could be coincidental, but it's unlikely. What's even stranger is that the Major has expressed no interest in chasing down the thieves. He claims it would, "be a waste of resources." We've been tracking the thieves, and we know just where they are.

I want you to go out there and take them out. Bring back whatever they stole. If my suspicions are right, what we find will greatly aid the investigation.
messages.zh:
很明显在我们的情报人员到达少校的办公室之前有一个窃贼已经光顾了那里，带走了几件少校的私人物品。这事儿可能只是巧合，但看起来实在不像。更蹊跷的事情是，少校居然没有兴趣去追回失去的物品。他说这是“浪费宝贵的时间”，不过我们一直在追踪这个乱序者，现在已经知道这贼到底在哪儿了。

我要你去干掉乱序者，把它拿走的东西都带回来给我。如果我的怀疑没有错，他所带走的东西对我们的调查非常有价值。

messages.en: I can't bring that thief down. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我没法打败那个乱序者。对不起。

messages.en: Do you have any idea how hard it will be to get another free agent to do this without attracting attention?
messages.zh: 你知道要在极度保密的条件下再找另外一个特工来干这事儿是多么困难么？

messages.en: It's not as glamorous as I'd hoped, but okay.
messages.zh: 这事没有我想的那么激愤人心。不过我还是干吧。

messages.en: Real investigative work is never glamorous.
messages.zh: 真正的调查工作都不会是多么激愤人心的。

messages.en: Any ideas?
messages.zh: 知道是怎么回事吗？

messages.en: Our spy has not been able to check what the Major has thrown away. Luckily we do know that the recent garbage has not been properly disposed of yet. Get out there and bring me that garbage.
messages.zh: 我们的间谍还无法知道这少校到底把什么给扔掉了。所幸我们知道最近的一批垃圾还没被处理掉。去那儿把垃圾拿来。

messages.en: Here's the Major's garbage.
messages.zh: 我把少校的垃圾运来了。

messages.en:
Let's have another look.

This is interesting. It's some sort of letter from a Serpentis! Give me a minute to read this.
messages.zh:
让我再看看。

有意思。这是天蛇的人发出的信！让我读一下。

messages.en: Nope. I'm not wasting my time picking up garbage.
messages.zh: 不。我不会浪费时间去取什么垃圾。

messages.en: As a capsuleer, you never have to take out your own trash.
messages.zh: 作为一个克隆飞行员，我从来不去处理自己的垃圾。

messages.en: Chores
messages.zh: 勤杂家务

messages.en:
We know nothing else has left the Major's office yet. Everything's just been business as usual. Our spy has not been able to check what the Major has thrown away. Rummaging around the garbage would be a bit suspicious. Luckily we do know that the recent garbage has not been properly disposed of yet. You know what I'm thinking, of course.

Get out there and bring me that garbage. There has to be something in there.
messages.zh:
据我们了解，少校的办公室里并没有少一样东西。一切照旧。我们的间谍还无法知道这少校到底把什么给扔掉了。你让你去垃圾堆里翻来翻去会引起别人怀疑。所幸我们知道最近的一批垃圾还没被处理掉。知道我在想什么了吧。

去那儿把垃圾拿来，面肯定有东西。

messages.en: I just can't do it. I quit.
messages.zh: 我不做。闪了。

messages.en: Too high and mighty for garbage duty? Blasted capsuleers.
messages.zh: 你觉得自己很伟大很光荣，不削于运垃圾对吧？糜烂的克隆飞行员啊。

messages.en: One Serpentis contact, coming up.
messages.zh: 一个天蛇接头人，来了。

messages.en: This better be the lead we need, or so help me....
messages.zh: 这最好就是我们要找的线索……

messages.en: The proverbial bloody knife?
messages.zh: 人人皆知的血腥之刃？

messages.en:
The Major has some sort of clandestine meeting with a member of the Serpentis. The meeting is out in the middle of an asteroid field, no less.

Go out to the meeting place and bring this Serpentis contact in.
messages.zh:
这个少校同天蛇集团安排了一个秘密的会议。这个会议在一个小行星带里举行,这很重要。

到密会地点把天蛇的接头人给我带来。

messages.en: Here's the contact. He's still breathing, too.
messages.zh: 这是你要找的接头人，还是活着的。

messages.en: Excellent. Now if you'll excuse us, our new friend and I need to have a little chat.
messages.zh: 很好。现在希望你能给我们点时间，我们的新朋友和我有些事情要谈。

messages.en: No can do. I'm not angering the Serpentis
messages.zh: 不行。我不想惹上天蛇的人。

messages.en: It's been my experience that the Serpentis are always angry.
messages.zh: 根据我的经验，天蛇从来就没有不恼怒过。

messages.en: The Serpentis Corporation was founded a few decades ago by V.Salvador Sarpati. At first it was engaged in hi-tech research, but with time its ties with the underworld grew and the Serpentis research stations, scattered around in remote areas, became infamous pirate havens. It is strongly believed that Serpentis is the main developer and manufacturer of illegal neural boosters, especially since Sarpati's father was a renown specialist in that field. The home of Serpentis is in the Phoenix constellation in the Fountain region.
messages.zh: 天蛇集团是V.萨瓦多尔·萨巴蒂在几十年前建立的。最初只从事高科技研究，但随着他们与黑社会的关系日益密切，天蛇集团分散在边远区域的空间研究站成为臭名昭著的海盗避难所。萨巴蒂在早期就与天使企业联合体达成协议，由守护天使对他的空间站提供保护。这次交易使双方都收获颇丰——天蛇集团可以专注于研究，而天使企业联合体有权享受天蛇集团的非法研究成果。人们坚信天蛇集团是非法神经增效剂的主要开发和制造者，而萨巴蒂的父亲正是业内的著名专家。天蛇集团的基地在源泉星域的凤凰星座。

messages.en: Serpentis
messages.zh: 天蛇

messages.en:
Not quite, but it's close. According to this the Major has some sort of clandestine meeting with a member of the Serpentis. The meeting is out in the middle of an asteroid field, no less. If something illegal isn't going on, I'll kiss a slaver hound.

Go out to the meeting place and bring this Serpentis contact in. Let's blow this thing wide open.
messages.zh:
不完全是，但差不多。根据这上面说的，这个少校同天蛇集团安排了一个秘密的会议。这个会议在一个小行星带里举行,这很重要。如果这会议不是关于任何非法的事情，我就去亲我的猎奴犬的屁股。

到密会地点把天蛇的接头人给我带来。让我们好好看看中间到底是什么鬼。

messages.en: I quit. I'm not angering the Serpentis.
messages.zh: 我退出。我不想把天蛇给惹恼了。

messages.en: It's been my experience that the Serpentis are always angry.
messages.zh: 根据我的经验，天蛇从来就没有不恼怒过。

messages.en: I would be honored to bring this to do this.
messages.zh: 我很荣幸做这事。

messages.en: Good luck.
messages.zh: 祝你好运。

messages.en: What happened? What'd that Serpentis scum say?
messages.zh: 怎么样？那个天蛇人渣说什么？

messages.en:
That Serpentis is the Major's son. He joined the Serpentis as part of some grey op about a year ago. A few months in he stopped reporting in. The Serpentis figured out who he was and put the boy through extreme conditioning. The Major has been trying to recover his son while keeping the operation that started this a secret. With the son now recovered, the Serpentis have nothing.

The boy needs to be sent for proper psychiatric care. It's going to take a while to scrub what the Serpentis did to him. The Major is waiting for him at the delivery point.
messages.zh:
那个天蛇的人其实是少校的儿子。大约一年前他作为间谍行动的成员加入了天蛇集团。然后没几个月他就不再汇报情况了。原来天蛇当时已经调查到他的真实身份，并开始对他进行刑讯。少校之后一直在努力救他儿子，同时还不让那次行动走漏一点风声。如今儿子已获救，天蛇什么都没了。

这孩子需要被送到一个合适的心理诊疗所。要在精神上把他从天蛇的阴影中彻底解救出来还需要一段时间。少校现在正在移交地点等待他的儿子。

messages.en: The Major has been reunited with his son, if briefly.
messages.zh: 少校已经和他儿子团聚了，即使只是暂时的。

messages.en:
You did good work, {[character]player.name}.

You know, it wasn't quite the big bust I was hoping, but I feel like we really did something good, you know? You don't get to feel like that every day in this universe. Savor it while you can.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

你知道吗，这事并没有我一开始想的那样隆重，但我觉得这确实是件好事。有这种感觉真不容易啊，好好体会一下吧。

messages.en: After all this I am not just going to hand the boy over and pretend nothing happened.
messages.zh: 在发生了这一切之后，我不会把这孩子就这么交出去，然后装做什么都没发生过一样。

messages.en: There's nothing to be gained by being bitter. It's over.
messages.zh: 恶言相对并不能让你得到什么。这事已了结了。

messages.en: There are many forms of brainwashing. None of them are very pleasant, particularly in the time frame that the Major's son was brainwashed in. He can get better, but it will be a long and strenuous process.
messages.zh: 洗脑方式有多种。没有一种是让人愉快的，尤其是少校儿子在接受洗脑的那段日子。他会好起来，但过程漫长且费力。

messages.en: Brainwashing
messages.zh: 洗脑

messages.en:
That Serpentis scum is the Major's son. I've just confirmed it with intelligence.

What happened is that the Major's son joined the Serpentis as part of some grey op about a year ago. A few months in the kid stopped reporting in. He was presumed dead. We now know that the Serpentis figured out who he was, and put the boy through extreme conditioning.

The Major has been trying to recover his son while keeping the operation that started this a secret. The Serpentis meanwhile have been trying to blackmail the Major. We're lucky they thought small by threatening the Major's career with exposing his son as a traitor. With the son now recovered, the Serpentis have nothing.

The boy needs to be sent for proper psychiatric care. It's going to take a while to scrub what the Serpentis did to him. The Major is waiting for him at the delivery point. I can't think of a better person than you to give closure to all this.
messages.zh:
我从情报人员那里得到确凿信息，那天蛇渣子其实是少校的儿子。

事情的来龙去脉是这样：大约一年前少校儿子作为间谍行动的一份子加入了天蛇集团。然后没几个月他就不再汇报情况了。人们以为他死了。我们现在知道原来天蛇当时已经察觉到他的真实身份，他们开始变着法子整他。少校之后一直在努力救他儿子，同时还不让那次行动走漏一点风声。天蛇还不断试着敲诈少校。所幸那帮家伙思路短浅，只是试图将少校儿子作为叛徒曝光来威胁少校的职业生涯。如今儿子已获救，天蛇就抓不住我们任何把柄了。

孩子需要被送到一个合适的心理诊疗所。要在精神上把他从天蛇的阴影中彻底解救出来还需要一段时间。少校现在正在移交地点等待他的儿子。我觉得你是了结这事儿的最佳人选。

messages.en: After all this I am not just going to hand the boy over and pretend nothing happened.
messages.zh: 在发生了这一切之后，我不会把这孩子就这么交出去，然后装做什么都没发生过一样。

messages.en: There's nothing to be gained by being bitter. It's over.
messages.zh: 恶言相对并不能让你得到什么。这事已了结了。

name.ru: Быка за рога (A Wolf by the Ears)

messages.en: We're counting on you, {[character]player.name}. Good luck.
messages.zh: 我们就靠你了，{[character]player.name}。祝你成功。

messages.en:
We've got a wolf by the ears — a number of enemy ships escorting the Amarrian carrier Lupus Nivius. We simply don't have the resources in this sector to stop them. We're looking for resourceful pilots to fly to the Lupus's last known location and hit it hard before the crew can effect repairs and start raiding. There's a squadron guarding her, so you'll have to take them down too. The enemy's location has been programmed into your Neocom, and time is of the essence.

I suggest you find some help for this mission — these Amarrians are going to be pretty tough to take down on your own.
messages.zh:
狼真的来了——敌方一艘由大量小船护卫的白狼航母正向我们径直奔来。目前在此地区我们已经没有能档住他们的武装力量了。

我们现在需要足智多谋的飞行员飞往那白狼的最近一次报告位置，赶在敌方援军到来之前给予那航母致命一击。那航母周围有护驾，你要把它们也解决掉。我会把敌人位置上传到你的控制边栏中。

我建议你找些帮手——你单枪匹马怕是扛不住他们。

messages.en: The sector is safe from the Amarrians for now, but I fear for the future, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 现在在这地区我们是可以不用担心艾玛人了，但我对未来还是感到忧心忡忡，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: That's a fine way to defend our Republic. I'm disappointed.
messages.zh: 这也叫保卫共和国？太让人失望了。

messages.en:
One of the most infamous of Amarrian vessels, the Lupus Nivius is nearly 80 years old, and has participated in many different engagements during its long and varied career. The Lupus has been extensively refitted with advanced technology and high-end weaponry. It has served as a raider par exellence, often leading flotillas of battleships and cruisers on missions deep inside Minmatar and Gallente territory.

The Lupus participated in the bombardment of several planets during the Empire's attempts to reconquer the Khanid Kingdom, and its name is spoken of with hatred and fear in Minmatar space — it is widely believed that the Lupus was responsible for the massacre of several refugee convoys as they attempted to escape from Ammatar space three decades ago.
messages.zh:
服役近80载的白狼是艾玛最劣迹斑斑的舰船之一，可谓身经百战。依托高科技，白狼现在可以说是集尖端武器于一身。它经常带领一大队战列舰与巡洋舰深入米玛塔尔和盖伦特腹地，它的突击作用真是无与伦比。

在艾玛对卡尼迪进行征服的过程中，白狼参与了数次行星轰炸行动。一提到这名字，仇恨和恐惧就从米玛塔尔人心中油然而生——大多数人都相信正是由这艘白狼领衔，在三十年前，艾玛人对正要从艾玛达领域逃脱的米玛塔尔难民施行了残忍消灭。

messages.en: The Lupus Nivius
messages.zh: 白狼

messages.en:
Our naval units managed to ambush an Amarrian strike force and forced them to jump into Republic space. Now, just between you and me, our action was a ploy to pin the incident on the Empire and gain support for our war efforts... but I never told you that, right?

Well, I was against the plan from the beginning, since those blasted religious fanatics always have some kind of trick up their sleeves. In this case, it turns out that their force was simply stronger than our intelligence led us to believe, and we took some serious damage. And now they're loose inside Republic territory.

Personally, I think they were expecting it all along and just used our attack as an excuse to get a raiding force inside our borders. Now we've got a wolf by the ears — a number of enemy ships escorting the carrier Lupus Nivius. They took some losses in the initial battle, but our ships are even worse off and we simply don't have the resources in this sector to stop them.

We're looking for resourceful pilots to fly to the Lupus's last known location and hit it hard before the crew can effect repairs and start raiding. There's a squadron guarding her, so you'll have to take them down too. I'll upload the enemy's location to your Neocom.

I suggest you find some help for this one — they're going to be pretty tough to take down on your own. Can you do it?
messages.zh:
我们的海军部队成功地伏击了一支艾玛突击队，已经将他们逼入共和国领域里了。现在，你不要和别人说这件事：其实我们原来的打算是想将整个事件推卸到帝国头上的，这样我们就能得到别人的支持……我从来没跟你说这件事，对吧？

其实呢，我一开始就反对这计划，因为我知道那帮宗教狂热分子兜里儿总会藏者什么诡计。果然不出我所料，这次他们部队的实力比我们情报预测的要强，我们因此受损严重。艾玛人现正在共和国领域里晃荡呢。

我个人以为艾玛人对此一切早有所预料，他们巴不得将我们这次突袭作为他们来犯的借口。现在狼真的来了——敌方一艘由大量小船护卫的白狼航母正向我们径直奔来。他们虽然在一开始的交火中遭到部分损伤，但问题是我们受损更严重。目前在此地区我们已经没有能档住他们的武装力量了。

我们现在需要足智多谋的飞行员飞往那白狼的最近一次报告位置，赶在敌方援军到来之前给予那航母致命一击。那航母周围有护驾，你要把它们也解决掉。我会把敌人位置上传到你的控制边栏中。

我建议你找些帮手——你单枪匹马怕是扛不住他们。你能执行这个任务么？

messages.en: The Amarrians will be loose in our systems in a matter of hours, then, thanks to you.
messages.zh: 这样的话艾玛人用不了几个小时就能在我们星系里到处撒野了。这还真得谢谢你啊！

messages.en: We've received reports that the enemy has completed repairs on Lupus Nivius. They've moved out and begun raiding. Your mission is a failure, and now the Republic will suffer for it. Let us hope the Navy can send reinforcements here in a hurry — but it's not as if they don't have their hands full already.
messages.zh: 据称敌人已经把他们的白狼给修好了。他们又开始袭击我们了。你任务没完成，共和国也跟着倒霉。但愿海军能迅速派出增援——但他们身上可能还有其他事。

messages.en: The Lupus has escaped
messages.zh: 白狼已逃脱

messages.en: Um, okay. I'm gonna back away slowly and go blow up the nasty old prize committee.
messages.zh: 哦，好的。我会慢慢晃悠过去把那个肮脏的奖励委员会给爆破掉。

messages.en: Yes, they'll pay for their temerity. Off you go!
messages.zh: 是的，他们会为他们的愚昧付出代价的。去吧！

messages.en: Well, that's great, right? Congratulations!
messages.zh: 好吧，不错，对吗？恭喜了！

messages.en:
Those short-sighted fools at the Center for Scientific Advancement have no idea what they've done! To dismiss my contributions to the furtherance of human knowledge with a mere honorable mention is an insult! An insult!

Well, we'll show them, won't we? Go blow up the old farts' convention! You'll find a large container of explosives right next to the facility. I'd intended to make a gift of them-- my own new design, very strong-- when I accepted my rightful prize. It seems fitting to use them as the agent of destruction for those too blind to see the brilliance right before their eyes.
messages.zh:
中心里面这些目光短浅的人根本不知道他们都做了些什么！用鼓励奖这样的词来敷衍我对人类的进步所作出的贡献简直就是侮辱！是污辱！

好吧，我们会让他们看看，对么？去把这些放屁的家伙都炸死！你可以在建筑物的旁边找到一个装满爆炸物的巨大容器。我要送个礼物给他们，握最新的研究成果，爆炸威力相当强大。看来这是一个非常好的方法来把这些有眼无珠的家伙给铲除掉。

messages.en: I blew up the Center for Scientific Advancement. The prize committee is now in very small pieces.
messages.zh: 我炸掉了科学发展中心。奖励委员会现在已经是尘埃了。

messages.en: That'll teach 'em.
messages.zh: 这将给他们点教训。

messages.en: What? No! I'm not blowing up a civic center just because they didn't give you first prize!
messages.zh: 什么？不！我才不会去爆破一个民用设施，单单是因为他们没有给你头等奖？

messages.en: Hmph. I should have known that someone like you couldn't comprehend the magnitude of this offense any more than you could grasp the true significance of my work.
messages.zh: 恩……我早就应该知道像你这样的人根本就没有办法理解我的工作的重要性，更是无法看清我的发现对你自己的将来将会带来什么样的重要影响。

messages.en: Sometimes, explosions cause chain reactions.
messages.zh: 有时候爆炸可以引起连锁反应。

messages.en: Explosions
messages.zh: 爆炸物

messages.en:
Congratulations? Congratulations? Those short-sighted fools at the Center for Scientific Advancement have no idea what they've done! To dismiss my contributions to the furtherance of human knowledge with a mere honorable mention is an insult! An insult!

Well, we'll show them, won't we? Go blow up the old farts' convention! You'll find a large container of explosives right next to the facility. I'd intended to make a gift of them-- my own new design, very strong-- when I accepted my rightful prize. It seems fitting to use them as the agent of destruction for those too blind to see the brilliance right before their eyes.
messages.zh:
祝贺？祝贺?中心里面这些目光短浅的人根本不知道他们都做了些什么！用鼓励奖这样的词来敷衍我对人类的进步所作出的贡献简直就是侮辱！是污辱！

好吧，我们会让他们看看，对么？去把这些放屁的家伙都炸死！你可以在建筑物的旁边找到一个装满爆炸物的巨大容器。我要送个礼物给他们，握最新的研究成果，爆炸威力相当强大。看来这是一个非常好的方法来把这些有眼无珠的家伙给铲除掉。

messages.en: On second thought, this is ridiculous. Do your own dirty work for a change.
messages.zh: 再想想，这简直是太可笑，你自己做这种肮脏的事情吧。

messages.en: I should have known better than to trust someone of such obviously sub-par intelligence with any aspect of my work.
messages.zh: 我早就知道不能把我的任何一项任务交给一个智商低下的人去做。

messages.en: Yeah, sure, fine.
messages.zh: 好的，没问题，没问题。

messages.en: Speed is of the essence, so hurry up.
messages.zh: 速度是关键，所以赶快出动吧。

messages.en: That's not getting old at all. You told me to come back, you jerk.
messages.zh: 这根本就不会变老，你让我回来的，你这个垃圾。

messages.en: The data you brought me proved very interesting. Now I need you to go collect the physical samples. Again, they're in the same location. I've left them in a container with very little shielding to observe the effects of exposure to the peculiar conditions of the area over time. Pick them up and bring them back to me; the faster, the better.
messages.zh: 你带给我的数据非常的有意思。现在我需要你去收集一些实物的证据。一样的，他们也是在同样的地点。我把他们放在一个有很小护盾保护的容器里，用来观察它长时间暴露在特殊环境里的效果。你尽快把它带回来给我。

messages.en: Here's your... whatever these are.
messages.zh: 这是你的……不知道这是什么东西。

messages.en: Give me a few minutes for analysis, then come back. Go away now.
messages.zh: 给我几分钟时间做分析，然后你再回来。你先出去把。

messages.en: Run your own errands.
messages.zh: 你自己搞定吧。

messages.en: Ah, yes, well. The data you brought me proved very interesting. Now I need you to go collect the physical samples. Again, they're in the same location. I've left them in a container with very little shielding to observe the effects of exposure to the peculiar conditions of the area over time. Pick them up and bring them back to me; the faster, the better.
messages.zh: 啊，是的很好。你带给我的数据非常的有意思。现在我需要你去收集一些实物的证据。一样的，他们也是在同样的地点。我把他们放在一个有很小护盾保护的容器里，用来观察它长时间暴露在特殊环境里的效果。你尽快把它带回来给我。

messages.en: I'm bored with all this science crap. I quit.
messages.zh: 我现在已经相当厌倦这些科学的东西了。我不干了。

messages.en: I should have known better than to trust someone of such obviously sub-par intelligence with any aspect of my work.
messages.zh: 我早就知道不能把我的任何一项任务交给一个智商低下的人去做。

messages.en: Get close to the beacons, bring back the data. Got it.
messages.zh: 找到信标，将数据带回来，明白了。

messages.en: Go on then, enough time's been wasted already.
messages.zh: 去吧，已经浪费了不少时间了。

messages.en: You said I should come back, remember?
messages.zh: 你说要我回来的，记得么？

messages.en:
Well, I've reset the password, but the fact remains: I don't trust whatshisname anymore. I'd like you to go collect my data from the area where you found my former assistant. You're on the system's allowed list, so you should be fine.

There are a series of cloaked beacons in the area, which contain devices for collecting and recording data. They are also capable of transmitting the data, but only over a very short range. You'll need to get in close to each beacon. Once you've gotten close enough, my device will collect the transmission and the next beacon will decloak.
messages.zh:
啊，很好，我重置了密码，但还有一个问题没有解决：我不能再相信这些年轻人了。我想你去到上次你找到我的助理的那个地方帮我收集数据，你现在已经在系统的许可名单上了，所以应该没有什么问题的。

在那个区域有一系列的隐形信标，这些信标上装载有收集和记录数据的装置。当然，它们也有传输数据的作用，但只是在一个很短的距离之内。你需要离得很近才能够进行传输。当你靠近后，我的设备能够读取数据，同时下一个信标将会显现出来。

messages.en: Data retrieved.
messages.zh: 数据下载完成。

messages.en: I need silence to assess these data. Come back when I'm done.
messages.zh: 在我读取数据的时候需要安静的环境，等我完成了再回来找我。

messages.en: No thanks; sounds boring.
messages.zh: 算了，听起来真无聊。

messages.en: I should have known better than to trust someone of such obviously sub-par intelligence with any aspect of my work.
messages.zh: 我早就知道不能把我的任何一项任务交给一个智商低下的人去做。

messages.en:
Ah, yes. Well, I've reset the password, but the fact remains: I don't trust whatshisname anymore. I'd like you to go collect my data from the area where you found my former assistant. You're on the system's allowed list, so you should be fine.

There are a series of cloaked beacons in the area, which contain devices for collecting and recording data. They are also capable of transmitting the data, but only over a very short range. You'll need to get in close to each beacon. Once you've gotten close enough, my device will collect the transmission and the next beacon will decloak.
messages.zh:
啊，很好，我重置了密码，但还有一个问题没有解决：我不能再相信这些年轻人了。我想你去到上次你找到我的助理的那个地方帮我收集数据，你现在已经在系统的许可名单上了，所以应该没有什么问题的。

在那个区域有一系列的隐形信标，这些信标上装载有收集和记录数据的装置。当然，它们也有传输数据的作用，但只是在一个很短的距离之内。你需要离得很近才能够进行传输。当你靠近后，我的设备能够读取数据，同时下一个信标将会显现出来。

messages.en: Get your own damn data. I quit.
messages.zh: 你自己去找你的垃圾数据吧，我不干了。

messages.en: I should have known better than to trust someone of such obviously sub-par intelligence with any aspect of my work.
messages.zh: 我早就知道不能把我的任何一项任务交给一个智商低下的人去做。

messages.en: Sure, I can help you out.
messages.zh: 没问题，我可以帮忙。

messages.en: Hurry up.
messages.zh: 快点。

messages.en: Uh... you have another job for me, right?
messages.zh: 你还有活儿交给我做是吧？

messages.en:
You still have that device I gave you, right? Make sure it's in your cargohold before you head out after my lab assistant. I've loaded a program that will initiate my security's stand-down sequence as soon as you get close enough. All you have to do is approach the trapped ship-- my device will take care of the rest.

Don't go shooting anything! I've got sensitive equipment in there.
messages.zh:
我给你那个仪器你还留着的吧？记住你去找我的实验室助理的时候一定要带着。我会加载一个程序，当你足够接近的时候能够把我的防御系统设定为暂停状态。你要做的只是接近被停滞的船只，剩下的交给我的仪器就行了。

别向任何东西射击，那些都是非常敏感的仪器。

messages.en: Done. Your guy ran away.
messages.zh: 完成了，你的人都跑了。

messages.en: Typical. Take this device and come back in a few minutes. I'll need you to do some work for me.
messages.zh: 很典型。拿着这个仪器，几分钟后回来。我还有其他的工作要交给你。

messages.en: Nah, you can find someone else.
messages.zh: 不，你可以另外找人。

messages.en: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.
messages.zh: 我其实很想另找一个助手。

messages.en: Find someone else; I'm done.
messages.zh: 找找别人，我没戏。

messages.en: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.
messages.zh: 我其实很想另找一个助手。

messages.en: I can do that.
messages.zh: 我能够胜任。

messages.en: That remains to be seen. Get on with it!
messages.zh: 你还需要证明这点。动身吧！

messages.en: What?
messages.zh: 什么？

messages.en:
My stupid lab assistant has managed to trigger the security protocols in one of my research areas, and now he's stuck in there. He's just lucky he managed to get off a brief call for help, because as it happens, the lockdown procedure includes jamming all long-distance communications.

I need you to go pick up one of my data chips. I'm storing them at another station; I'll let them know to leave one in your hangar. I can explain more after you bring it to me.
messages.zh:
我的一个愚蠢的实验室助理在我一个实验基地里触发了安全警报，现在他人被困在那里了。这家伙真够幸运的，警报拉响后所有的长途通信都会被切断，他却在最后一刻发出了求救信号。

我现在要你去拿我的一个数据芯片。我把它放在另一个空间站里了；我会叫那里的人把它放到你机库里的。你把东西拿来后我会告诉你详情。

messages.en: Here's your data chip. That was hardly a challenge.
messages.zh: 你的数据芯片拿来了。这活也太轻松了。

messages.en: I'll have this ready in a few moments if you stop bothering me.
messages.zh: 如果你别再烦我，我就可以将这马上搞定。

messages.en: Since you're such a charmer... get your own damn chip.
messages.zh: 既然你这么吸引人……那你自己去拿那芯片好了。

messages.en: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.
messages.zh: 我其实很想另找一个助手。

messages.en:
My stupid lab assistant has managed to trigger the security protocols in one of my research areas, and now he's stuck in there. He's just lucky he managed to get off a brief call for help, because as it happens, the lockdown procedure includes jamming all long-distance communications.

I need you to go pick up one of my data chips. I'm storing them at another station; I'll let them know to leave one in your hangar. I can explain more after you bring it to me.
messages.zh:
我的一个愚蠢的实验室助理在我一个实验基地里触发了安全警报，现在他人被困在那里了。这家伙真够幸运的，警报拉响后所有的长途通信都会被切断，他却在最后一刻发出了求救信号。

我现在要你去拿我的一个数据芯片。我把它放在另一个空间站里了；我会叫那里的人把它放到你机库里的。你把东西拿来后我会告诉你详情。

messages.en: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.
messages.zh: 我其实很想另找一个助手。

messages.en: Time's up.
messages.zh: 时间到。

messages.en: I quit. You can run your own errands.
messages.zh: 我闪了。自己的事情自己解决。

messages.en: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.
messages.zh: 我其实很想另找一个助手。

messages.en: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.
messages.zh: 我其实很想另找一个助手。

messages.en: Time's up.
messages.zh: 时间到。

messages.en: I can handle it. "Danger" is my middle name.
messages.zh: 我可以应付，我从小就是被吓大的。

messages.en: Good luck! Be careful!
messages.zh: 祝你好运，万事要小心。

messages.en: So you have need of my particular brand of, er, justice?
messages.zh: 你现在需要我特有的“判决”能力了？

messages.en:
Go to the Ducia Foundry mining colony in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and take out any hostiles you encounter. Then look for survivors; if you find any, pick them up and bring them back to {[location]agentStationID.name}.

We're not expecting you to have to go to war, but whoever took down that mining station was able to defeat a heavily armed escort. Just be prepared for a tough fight.
messages.zh:
前往位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的杜厦制造采矿殖民站。消灭遭遇的任何敌对势力。然后搜寻生还者；如果你有发现他们，就把他们带回到{[location]agentStationID.name}。

我们不希望你遇到的是一场血战，但是能打掉这样一个采矿殖民站的人肯定也能轻松对付一整支武装舰队，无论怎样你还是要有一场恶战的思想准备。

messages.en: Mission accomplished. The surviving miners are safe, and the Gallente privateers are space dust.
messages.zh: 任务完成了，生还的矿工现在已经安全了。另外那些盖伦特的私稤船都被我碾成了尘埃。

messages.en: Excellent. Ducia Foundry is most pleased that you were able to save their miners. And taking down those Gallente privateers was an added bonus.
messages.zh: 非常好。杜厦铸造对你能够营救他们的矿工感到非常高兴。你又干掉那些盖伦特私稤船，真是好上加好。

messages.en: Miners?! I don't have time to help a bunch of miserable rock-zappers.
messages.zh: 矿工？我没时间去帮助那些嚼石头的人。

messages.en: Ducia Foundry is one of the most ambitious mining corporations in the Amarr Empire. They routinely send heavily armed mining expeditions into low-sec space to mine the most profitable ore deposits.
messages.zh: 杜厦铸造是艾玛帝国里最有野心的一个矿业集团。他们定期地派遣全副武装的远征采矿舰队到低安全等级地区大肆开采那些非常有价值的小行星矿带。

messages.en: Ducia Foundry
messages.zh: 杜厦铸造

messages.en:
Yes. Well, not me personally — but Ducia Foundry needs your help. As you probably know, Ducia often sends mining ops into dangerous areas. Most of the time, they are able to handle whatever belt-rats come along, but it sounds like something terrible has happened this time. They lost contact with their mining colony in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

The only information we have is a garbled message. Listen...

...*SQUAWK crackle crackle* ... unknown intruders ... picking apart ... communications ... *hisssss* ... help us! ... escorts are ..."

We fear its already too late, but we have to do something. We‘ve made several attempts to contact them, but their com network appears to be down.

We want you to enter the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and look for survivors. If you find any, pick them up and bring them to me. And be careful. We don't know what might be out there.
messages.zh:
好吧，其实，并不是我要找你——事杜夏制造想请你帮个忙。你也许知道，杜夏制造经常派遣采矿船深入到危险的低安全等级地区进行勘探开采任务。大多数时候，他们都能够对付那些独来独往的小行星带土匪，但这次情况可能严重得多。在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个采矿殖民站同总部失去了联络。

我们能截获到的信息都是一些杂音，你可以听听……

”……＊嘈杂的电噪音＊……不明身份的袭击者…………撕成碎片……通讯…………＊嘶嘶嘶＊……救救我们！…………护航队已经…………“

恐怕这其实都太晚了，但我们还是要做些什么才行。已经尝试过几次要和他们取得联系，但可能他们的通讯网络已经被摧毁了。

我们要你前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}搜索生还者。如果你有发现幸存者就带回来。你要小心，我们不知道还有谁在那儿等你。

{[character]player.name}，

得要感谢你的优柔寡断，我才能找到一个更能够胜任我的任务的人。带着你的懦弱回去干你的劳工买卖吧。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stranded miners
messages.zh: 束手无策的矿工

messages.en: I can't handle this. I give up.
messages.zh: 我对付不了，不做了。

messages.en: I guess those Gallente privateers were too much for you. Don't worry, I doubt I'll overestimate you again.
messages.zh: 我想要你去对付那些盖伦特私稤船可能是太难为你了。别担心，我以后不会这么高估你了。

{[character]player.name}，

得要感谢你的优柔寡断，我才能找到一个更能够胜任我的任务的人。带着你的懦弱回去干你的劳工买卖吧。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Stranded miners
messages.zh: 束手无策的矿工

messages.en: I'll see what I can do.
messages.zh: 我会尽我所能。

messages.en: Don't waste any time.
messages.zh: 那就快去吧。

messages.en: Oh? What's happened? And does it mean work for me?
messages.zh: 噢？那到底发生了什么呢？是不是意味着我有事干了呢？

messages.en:
A secret Gallente outpost nearby just suffered a catastrophic overload in its main power core. The resulting explosion obliterated the outpost, which had been a communications hub routing vast amounts of data back into Gallente space. There's no telling what secrets we could uncover if we were to recover its central information core.

We want you to go the remnants of the outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and sift through the debris until you find that data core. Just pick it up and bring it back.

This might sound easy, except that the Gallente Navy is already en route to the location. They likely won't be looking for the core themselves; they'll be picking up survivors. However, intelligence reports say that the rescue fleet is large, and they might not react favorably to Amarr vessels nosing around in the face of their tragedy.
messages.zh:
附近的一座盖伦特秘密哨站最近遭遇了灾难性的能源核心超载。由此引发的爆炸彻底毁灭了整个哨站，大量的信息曾经通过这个通讯基站传输到盖伦特境内。如果我们能想办法恢复它的数据核心的话，说不定可以发现一些有趣的东西。

我们需要你前往位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的哨站残骸那，从废墟里把数据核心扒出来。把它带回来给我。

这事儿应该不难，但注意盖伦特海军已经在赶往那边的路上了。不过他们更像是去搜救幸存者，而不是找那个核心的。然而情报显示这支救援舰队数量庞大，并且在悲催的节骨眼上他们应该不喜欢看到有任何艾玛舰船在一旁幸灾乐祸。

messages.en: I have the central data core on board.
messages.zh: 我把数据核心带来了。

messages.en: Nicely done. This information core might just be priceless.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。这东西的价值无法估量。

messages.en: Sorry, but I don't like the political ramifications. You'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 不好意思，但我不想见到可能出现的政治后果。你去找别人吧。

messages.en: I hope I can find someone else to handle this.
messages.zh: 我希望能够找到其他人来处理这个问题。

messages.en:
A secret Gallente outpost nearby just suffered a catastrophic overload in its main power core. The resulting explosion obliterated the outpost. The Gallente navy is on its way there to look for survivors.

We don't care about the Gallente civilians, but we do care about the massive amount of sensitive information that might be stored in the remnants of the outpost's central information core. That outpost was a communications hub routing vast amounts of data back into Gallente space. There's no telling what secrets we could uncover with that information core.

We want you to go to the remnants of the outpost and sift through the debris until you find that central data core. Just pick it up and bring it back.

This might sound easy, except that the Gallente Navy is already en route to the location. They likely won't be looking for the core themselves; they'll be picking up survivors. However, intelligence reports say that the rescue fleet is large, and they might not react favorably to Amarr vessels nosing around in the face of their tragedy.
messages.zh:
附近的一座盖伦特秘密哨站最近遭遇了灾难性的能源核心超载。由此引发的爆炸彻底破坏了整座设施。盖伦特海军已经出发去搜救其中的幸存者。

我们对那些平民没兴趣，但你要知道哨站废墟里的数据核心可能储藏了大量的敏感信息。大量讯息每天通过那个通信基站发送至盖伦特境内。我们说不定可以从中发现一些有趣的东西。

我们需要你前往哨站残骸那里，从废墟里把数据核心扒出来。把它带回来给我。

这事儿应该不难，但注意盖伦特海军已经在赶往那边的路上了。他们更像是去搜救幸存者而不是找那个核心的。不过情报显示这支救援舰队数量庞大，并且在悲催的节骨眼上他们应该不喜欢看到有任何艾玛舰船在一旁幸灾乐祸。

messages.en: You just helped us miss a golden opportunity. This doesn't bode well for your future.
messages.zh: 你让我们错失了良机。你的未来不会光明的。

messages.en: I will deal with him, kirjuun.
messages.zh: 我会解决他的，伙计。

messages.en: Excellent. Here are the coordinates of the transfer station; you should proceed there post-haste. I'll be waiting to hear from you upon your return.
messages.zh: 很好。这是那个中转空间站的坐标；你应当立刻赶到那里。我会等着你的好消息。

messages.en: How can I serve {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}? Eager to help, as always.
messages.zh: 我该怎样为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}服务呢？我总是急切地想要提供帮助。

messages.en: An incompetent executive will be passing through a transfer station in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. In order to eliminate this problem for the company and keep it from hurting our stock price, you will need to intercept the executive and his security detail at the transfer station and eliminate the executive's ship. You may engage the security detail if you wish, but it is not strictly necessary.
messages.zh: 一个无能的主管将通过一个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的中转空间站。为了替公司解决这个问题，以免危及我们的股价，你需要在那个中转空间站截住这位主管和他的保镖，并把他的舰船击毁。如果你愿意，你也可以挑战他的保镖们，但是这并没有严格要求。

messages.en: The problem has been eliminated.
messages.zh: 这个问题已经被解决了。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear that, {[character]player.name}. Perhaps with him out of the way, that division will begin to show the profit we have been expecting for the last year.
messages.zh: 很高兴听到这些，{[character]player.name}。也许把他“移除”之后，那个部门将会展示去年我们所期望的盈利。

messages.en: I'm not going to kill this man just to solve a few headaches.
messages.zh: 我不打算仅仅为了解决一些头痛问题就干掉这个人。

messages.en: If you do not have the fortitude to do what must be done, I suppose I can find someone else with the courage to see it through. I cannot hide my disappointment in you, however.
messages.zh: 如果你没有毅力完成你必须做到的事情，我觉得我能够找到其他有勇气的人来完成。无论如何，我无法隐藏我对你的不满。

messages.en:
Because of the importance placed on "saving face" in Caldari culture, mid- and high-level executives often remain employed despite failures in leadership or performance, simply because firing them publicly would damage the corporation's reputation. In extreme cases, it is not altogether unknown for superiors within the corporation to arrange "accidents" for executives who fail to meet objectives and threaten their employer's bottom line. This eliminates the drain on corporate resources and allows them to save face.

While such methods of dealing with "problem employees" are simply not discussed openly (doing so would be in horribly poor taste, after all), it is something that lurks in the back of every corporate executive's mind.
messages.zh:
由于“面子”这玩意在加达里文化中的重要地位，中高层领导们即使领导无方或者表现拙劣，仍然会被保留职务——仅仅因为公开解雇他们会伤害公司的名誉。某些极端事例中，公司的高层有时会为那些任务失败，乃至于超出雇主忍耐底线的主管们制造一些“意外”，而这对公众来说也不是一个秘密。这种做法消除了公司资源的损耗，同时也保全了“面子”。

由于这些对付“问题雇员”的方法并不会公开讨论（这样做会显得十分粗鲁），所以通常只会深埋在每个公司总裁的心底。

messages.en: Termination
messages.zh: 终结

messages.en:
Well, we have a bit of a problem we need to deal with, {[character]player.name}. A low-level executive here has consistently failed to live up to our standards, but because of his position in a sensitive area of the corporation, simply terminating his contract would have an unfortunate effect on our stock prices. As a result, it has become necessary to— shall we say, "eliminate his salary line"? Yes, that works. Eliminate his salary line, through alternate means.

This executive and his entourage, consisting of a number of security vessels, will be stopping by a transfer station in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system shortly. We would like you to fly to the transfer station and eliminate his vessel; you can do as you like with the security detail, but their elimination is not strictly necessary.

Once you've completed the job, return to me and I'll make sure you are amply rewarded.
messages.zh:
好吧，我们有一个需要解决的小问题，{[character]player.name}。一个低层主管连续好几次没能完成我们的要求，但是由于他在公司敏感部门的职位，直接终止他的合同会对我们的股价造成不利影响。因此，很有必要——这样说吧，“剔除他的工资线？”对，就这样说。通过其他途径， 剔除他的工资线，。

这个主管和他的随行人员，包括一支护卫舰队，将会在一个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name} 星系的中转休息站稍作停留。我们希望你飞去那里并把他的舰船击毁；你也可以按你意愿挑战他的卫队，但是我们并不严格要求你消灭那些卫队。

一旦你完成任务，回来找我，我保证你会得到满意的报酬。

messages.en: I'm afraid I couldn't wait any longer for a response from you on this mission, pilot. Thankfully, I was able to contact another pilot to take care of the matter while the window of opportunity was still open, and she managed to deal with the problem. Next time, please be a bit more punctual in your response.
messages.zh: 恐怕我没有更多时间等你完成这个任务了，飞行员。幸好，我还能趁着机会之门还未关闭的时候签约另一个飞行员来解决这个任务，而且她也设法完成了这个任务。下一次，请务必准时给我回复。

messages.en: Corporate executive killed by pirates
messages.zh: 公司主管被海盗加害

messages.en: I am afraid I will not be able to carry out your orders, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 恐怕我不能完成你的任务，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: That is unfortunate. We may not have another chance to dispose of this fool quietly for some time. Your failure here has cost us a considerable amount of money, pilot.
messages.zh: 那很不幸。我们在短期内找不到另一个能够安静地消灭那个蠢货的机会了。你这次的失败使我们损失了不少钱，飞行员。

messages.en: Don't worry, {[character]agentID.name}. I'll handle this right away.
messages.zh: 别着急，{[character]agentID.name}。我马上就去处理。

messages.en: Good luck, {[character]player.name}. We're all counting on you.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，祝你好运。我们都指望你了。

messages.en: How can I serve the State and {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, kirjuun?
messages.zh: 我能为国家和{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}做些什么？

messages.en: A number of important shareholders were aboard a transport vessel in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system when their ship was attacked and incapacitated by Gurista raiders. Fly out there, secure the area, recover the VIPs, and bring them safely back to your agent in {[location]agentStationID.name}.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯的突袭者袭击了一些重要的股东的船，那时他们正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}系统的一艘运输船上。快飞去那里把那个地方保卫起来找到股东并把他们都安全地带回{[location]agentStationID.name}的代理人那里。

messages.en: I have recovered the VIPs, {[character]agentID.name}. Unfortunately, the ship was a total loss.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，我已经把贵宾救出来了。但不幸的是，船都毁了。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. Well done. We could use more pilots like you.
messages.zh: 干的好，{[character]player.name}。太棒了。我们应该多用些像你一样的飞行员。

messages.en: I don't think I am really the person for this job.
messages.zh: 我觉得我并不适合这份工作。

messages.en: Most unfortunate. Well, I'm sure someone else will accept the honor of such an important mission for the State.
messages.zh: 真不幸。我相信一定会有人觉得为国家处理如此重要的事情是十分荣幸。

messages.en: While Caldari society is not what most people would call democratic, the shareholder meeting is one of the few places in the State where a certain type of democracy still exists. Anyone who is a corporate shareholder is welcome to attend a shareholder meeting either in person or virtually and voice their concerns to the corporation's board of directors, whether they own one share or millions. While most small shareholders do not bother to attend and simply proxy their shares to one of the large voting blocs within the corporation (the largest of which is usually the board of directors itself), this has been used on occasion to embarrass corporate officers; those who do so, however, do not generally have long to revel in their triumph.
messages.zh: 加达里并不是一个民主的国家，股东会议是那个国家仅有的几个仍然存在民主的地方。股东会议欢迎一切合法的股东，无论是亲自出席还是向公司董事会表达关注，也不在意他们是否拥有一百万的股份。然而大多数小股东没有去参加会议只是把他们的股份转交给公司里大的投票点（其中最大的通常都是董事会自己），这样有时会让公司的高级人员为难；然而，这样做的人，并没有长久地沉醉在他们的成功之中。

messages.en: Shareholder Meetings
messages.zh: 股东大会。

messages.en:
We have a bit of a problem, {[character]player.name}. A number of important shareholders were aboard a transport vessel in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system when their ship was attacked and incapacitated by Gurista raiders. We need you to fly out there, secure the area, recover the VIPs, and bring them safely back here.

Can you handle that, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我们遇到了一些问题。古斯塔斯的突袭者袭击了一些重要的股东的船，那时他们正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的一艘运输船上。我们需要你飞去那里，隔离该地区，找到股东并把他们都安全地带回来。

你愿意接受这次任务吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Due to your indecisiveness, I was forced to contact another pilot about handling this mission. He was able to assist the stranded vessel in time. Perhaps next time you will be more prompt.
messages.zh: 因为你的犹豫不决，我不得不派出另一名飞行员来处理这件事情。他能及时帮助搁浅的船。下次你要再迅速一点。

messages.en: Shareholders rescued
messages.zh: 股东获救

messages.en: The Gurista force there is too strong for me; I can't even get close to the ship! Find someone else for this suicide run.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯的军队太强了；我都不能靠近那船！找其他人为你干这种自尽式任务吧。

messages.en: You've failed not only me, but the State itself. I have no doubt you will come to regret this.
messages.zh: 国家和我都对你感到失望。你一定会懊悔的。

messages.en: The shareholders have been captured by the Guristas, along with the valuable information they carried. This is a dark day for the State, {[character]player.name}; this failure rests upon your shoulders.
messages.zh: 股东们，带着他们拥有的重要信息，被古斯塔斯俘获了。对国家来说这真是黑暗的一天，{[character]player.name}；你要为这次失败负责。

messages.en: I'll deal with the strike.  You can count on me.
messages.zh: 我能对付，交给我好了。

messages.en: Good.  Here are the coordinates for the entrance to the mining facility.  Return to me as soon as the job is done.
messages.zh: 很好，这是那个采矿设施的入口坐标。完成任务后尽快回来向我报告。

messages.en: What sort of trouble?
messages.zh: 什么样的麻烦？

messages.en:
The workers in a corporate mining facility are striking, taking control of the facility's defense grid and arming their mining vessels. They have shut the mining operation down completely and locked corporate personnel out of the area until their demands are met.

This situation is not acceptable. You are to enter the facility and neutralize any armed resistance: bring the strike to an end before there is any more damage to corporate property or loss of production. Do what you can to minimize collateral damage, but ending this as soon as possible is your top priority.
messages.zh:
联合采矿设施的工人们发起了罢工行动，他们控制了厂区的防御设施，武装了他们的采矿船。现在矿站的生产已经处于完全的停滞状态，工人们还把集团的高层工作人员拒之门外，声称在要求得到满足前绝不做出让步。

这种局面是不能被接受的。现在要求你进入矿区，制服所有你遇到的抵抗：在企业的财产受到更大损失，生产遭受更严重滞后之前结束这次罢工。尽量减少附带伤害，但是尽快结束这次罢工是你的首要目标。

messages.en: The strike has been brought to an end.
messages.zh: 罢工已经收场了

messages.en: Excellent.  Hopefully the new manager of that facility will be able to get production up and running in short order.
messages.zh: 很好，希望新到任的主管能够让那儿尽快的恢复生产工作。

messages.en: I'm not sure this is really a job for me.
messages.zh: 我想可能这个工作不大适合我。

messages.en: I certainly hope you're not turning this down because you sympathize with them.  I suppose I'll have to find someone else with a more realistic idea of the situation to handle this.
messages.zh: 我当然希望你别因为你的怜悯把这事儿给搞砸了。我想我的另外找个现实点的人去做这样的事情。

messages.en:
We have a bit of a problem, {[character]player.name}. A corporate executive seems to have used some rather unorthodox methods to try to speed up production in his mining fields, and the strain this placed on the labor force there has led to a wildcat strike which has shut down production in that field entirely, causing materials shortages all the way up our supply chain. Of course, this is entirely unacceptable; it is imperative that this strike be brought to a close immediately and production resume as soon as possible.

Corporate security is stretched rather thin in this sector, so we would like you to go to the mining facility in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and eliminate any threats to corporate assets. You should be aware that the striking miners have taken control of the facility's defense grid and armed many of their mining vessels with makeshift weapons, so you should expect heavy resistance.

Avoid any collateral damage to corporate assets if possible; we don't want this strike to cost us any more than it already has.
messages.zh:
我们有了一个大麻烦，{[character]player.name}。一个企业的执行层似乎采用了一种不那么正规的做法试图能够大大增加他们一座采矿场的生产能力。这种压在那里的工人身上的压力很明显过分的紧张了，工人们发起了罢工，停滞了整个矿区的生产作业，这使得我们的整个供给线都受到原料短缺的影响。当然，这种情况是不能容忍的，罢工必须要尽快的解决。

企业的安全防御措施在这个区域十分的薄弱，所以我们决定让你从{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}进入矿区，消灭你遇到的所有威胁企业财产的坏分子。你要注意的是，这些罢工的矿工夺取了矿站的防御系统，并且武装了他们的采矿船。你要对可能遇到的强烈抵抗做好准备。

尽量避免对企业的财产造成不必要的附带损伤；我们不想让这次罢工给我们带来更多的损失了。

messages.en: I couldn't wait any longer for you to decide if you could handle this for me. I was forced to call in another pilot to take care of the matter.  While I am not exactly a fan of her methods, she has been able to bring the strike to a quick end.  Perhaps next time you will make sure you get back to me in a timely manner.
messages.zh: 如果你能帮我解决这事儿的我希望你马上就作出决定。我不得都不找来另外一个飞行员去解决这个事情。尽管我不是那么相信她，但至少她能把这事儿尽快的解决掉。或许下次你的动作能快点。

messages.en: Wildcat strike brought to bloody end
messages.zh: 工人自发的突然罢工最终在鲜血中得以解决

messages.en: I've decided I don't have time to clean up this particular mess.
messages.zh: 我决定了，我现在没时间处理这种烦人的事情。

messages.en: I certainly hope you're not a sympathizer, pilot.  You won't go far if you keep up this attitude.
messages.zh: 我当然希望你不是个多愁善感的人，飞行员。如果你总是抱着这样的态度的话，你活不长的。

messages.en: You've taken too long: the strike has gotten far too out of control and corporate assets are in serious danger.  We've called in the military to deal with the situation. Your services are no longer needed, pilot.
messages.zh: 你用的时间太长了，罢工早已超出我们的控制，企业的财产遭受了严重的威胁。我们已经向军事部门求助进行干预。我们已经不再需要你的帮助了，飞行员。

messages.en: Strike out of control
messages.zh: 失控的罢工

name.ja: インソルムのハイジャック

messages.en: I won't let something so dangerous fall into enemy hands, I swear.
messages.zh: 我保证我绝不会让这么危险的东西落入敌人之手的。

messages.en: Good hunting, pilot. For the sake of the State and its citizens, I hope you do not fail.
messages.zh: 说得好，飞行员。为了国家及其民众，我希望你能成功。

messages.en: I'll certainly try, kirjuun. What can I do to serve the State today?
messages.zh: 我会尽我所能来帮你。国家今天遇到什么问题了？

messages.en:
A convoy belonging to the Zainou Biotech corporation has broadcast a distress call to all nearby stations, saying they are under attack by unknown hostiles and going down fast. Because the convoy's cargo, chemical components of an insorum prototype, is such a valuable and dangerous one, the CEP itself has given orders for all nearby agents to find ships capable of rescuing the cargo, even if the ships in the convoy are otherwise unsalvageable.

You will need to fly to the last reported location of the convoy, eliminate the attacking vessels, and either escort the convoy to safety or recover the insorum components from the wreckage if it is already too late. It is imperative that this be taken care of as soon as possible; we cannot allow this cargo to fall into the wrong hands.

You will need a Salvager to complete this task.
messages.zh:
一艘载诺生化科技的舰船已经向所有的比邻空间站发出了求救信号，说它正在遭到不明敌对势力的袭击，已经快不行了。由于那船上装载着价值庞大风险度巨大的生产荧索莱姆试验产品的化学原料，因此上面下命令要求邻近范围内的每个代理人去找能进行援救行动的飞行员，即使那船现在已经毁得七零八落了。

我们需要你飞往该运输队最近的所在地，干掉侵犯者，然后再把运输队护送回来。如果一切已经晚了，那把能拿回的荧索莱姆原料都拿回来。这事情一定要迅速解决。我们绝不能让那货柜里的东西落入敌人手里。

要完成此任务你需要用上打捞回收设备。

messages.en: The convoy was destroyed by Minmatar terrorists, {[character]agentID.name}, but I was able to recover the insorum components.
messages.zh: 那运输队已被米玛塔尔恐怖分子击毁了，{[character]agentID.name}，但我把荧索莱姆化学原料带回来了。

messages.en: Minmatar terrorists, eh? We should have known. You have performed a great service for the Caldari State. You've earned your reward ten times over today. Enjoy it while you can.
messages.zh: 原来是米玛塔尔恐怖分子？我们应该早就料到是这样。你为加达里合众国立下了汗马功劳。你会获得重赏。尽情享用吧。

messages.en: I don't have time to take on this sort of responsibility right now, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我现在没时间承担这类任务，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Perhaps it's for the best. After all, it would be better to place something of such import in the hands of someone more responsible.
messages.zh: 也许这是只有精英才能干的事。毕竟，这么重要的事情应该交给一个更有责任心的人才行。

messages.en: Despite the death of Dr. Ullia Hnolku at the hands of Caldari paramilitary forces and the capture of all remaining insorum samples by enemies of the State, Zainou Biotech continues to research the process for creating the material at various locations in the Caldari State. Speculation continues as to what their intentions are if they ever manage to replicate the process; some within the Amarr Empire fear the Caldari will use it as a weapon should they have reason to fight the Empire, while the Federation's halls echo with concerns that the Caldari will use it as a counterweight to break the Republic from the grasp of the Gallente. The only sure bet is that the Republic would pay almost any price, in money or blood, to have the secret of insorum creation in its hands.
messages.zh: 虽然乌拉尔·娄库已死在了加达里民兵的手里，那些剩下的荧索莱姆样本也已经被加达里对手拿去，载诺生化科技继续在加达里的各个地方对该物质的生产过程进行研究。大家都在不停地猜测一旦他们成功掌握了生产流程，接下来他们会干什么。艾玛中的有些人担心一旦加达里找茬与他们动手，加达里人会把这用作针对他们的武器。而盖伦特政府中的人认为他们会利用这玩意儿帮助米玛塔尔脱离盖伦特的掌控。现在唯一可以确定的是，不管是花钱还是流血，米玛塔尔人都会力保荧索莱姆的生产工艺不泄露出去。

messages.en: The Insorum Legacy
messages.zh: 荧索莱姆遗产

messages.en:
We've just received a distress call from a Zainou Biotech transport ship nearby, saying that she was under attack by unknown hostiles and her escort force was failing fast. Unfortunately, most of the nearby vessels are unable to assist and as a result the CEP has ordered everyone in the general vicinity to try and find pod pilots willing to assist the transport before it is too late.

It is critical that they receive that assistance, because that convoy is carrying a large quantity of chemical components for a new synthesis of insorum. No doubt you're aware of how valuable such a thing would be, and how dangerous it would be if it were to fall into the wrong hands. Zainou, and the State, cannot allow such a compound to fall into the hands of terrorists or foreign powers. We need you to fly to the last reported location of this convoy and destroy any attackers; if the convoy is still in serviceable shape, escort it to the nearest safe station, otherwise, recover whatever you can of the insorum synthesis components and bring them back to me immediately. Are you up to it?

You will need a Salvager to complete this task.
messages.zh:
我们刚收到一艘载诺生化科技舰发来的求救信号，说它正在遭到不明敌对势力的袭击，它的护航队已经快撑不下去了。糟糕的是大多数比邻舰船都无法去支援，因此上面下命令要求大范围周围内的每个人都在一切晚矣之前找到愿意去支援的飞行员。

他们急切需要支援，因为那船上装载着大量制造新荧索莱姆合成物所需的化学原料。你肯定知道这东西蕴含的价值，也肯定明白一旦它落入敌人之手会有多危险。载诺公司及整个国家都不允许这样重要的东西旁落恐怖分子或他国敌人之手。我们需要你飞往该运输队最近的所在地，干掉侵犯者。如果那船看上去还能用的话，请把它带到最近的一个安全的空间站里。否则就把能拿回的荧索莱姆原料都拿回来。你能担当此任吗？

要完成此任务你需要用上打捞回收设备。

messages.en: I'm afraid this mission was far too important to let sit any longer. Thankfully, you're not the only pod pilot in the service of the State, and one of them was able to take care of the problem, keeping this valuable cargo from falling into the hands of Minmatar extremists. Next time, I hope you will heed the call and come to the aid of the State promptly, instead of neglecting your obligations.
messages.zh: 只怕这任务事关重大，我们等不起。还好我们国家里不是就你一个飞行员。有个飞行员已经把这事解决了，没有让那重要的货柜落入敌人之手。下次我希望你能随叫随到，不要再逃离你的职责。

messages.en: Insorum convoy rescued by loyalist pilot
messages.zh: 一位忠心的飞行员已经解救了荧索莱姆运输队

messages.en: I can't take care of this right now; you'll have to find someone else. Or not; I don't really care.
messages.zh: 我现在没法儿处理这事；你得另寻他人。反正不关我事。

messages.en: Do you understand what you're doing? You're handing over a doomsday weapon to people who have no compunctions against its use! I sincerely hope that you never have cause to look back at this day and realize what a mistake you made, but I fear that time will come all too soon.
messages.zh: 你知道你在做什么吗？你等于在把一个末日武器交给一个无道德约束的敌人！我真的希望你不要有一天回过头来看这件事情然后觉得懊悔，但我担心这天可能已经离我们不远了。

messages.en: You've failed both me and the Caldari State. Your failure to recover the insorum prototype components has as good as handed them over to Minmatar extremists, and who knows what those primitives will do? I hope you can sleep at night with that resting on your conscience, pilot.
messages.zh: 你不仅让我失望，也让整个加达里国失望。由于你未能拿到残余的荧索莱姆化学原料，它们现在已经落入了米玛塔尔极端分子的手里。天晓得那些人接下来会怎么做！飞行员，但愿你还能睡得安稳。

messages.en: Minmatar extremists capture insorum components
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔极端分子抢到了荧索莱姆化学原料

name.ru: Соринка в глазу (A Mote in the Eye)

messages.en: A chance to collect interest on a debt they've owed us for a century? I'll gladly help any way I can, kirjuun.
messages.zh: 能有机会能从他们那收取长达一个世纪之久的欠款的利息？我很高兴能尽我所能帮你这个忙，同志。

messages.en: Excellent. I'll send word that you're on the case; let me know as soon as you've finished taking care of the listening post.
messages.zh: 很好，我会转告说你来负责这个行动；你一处理完情报站的事就马上通知我。

messages.en: I am ready to do my duty, kirjuun. How can I serve the State today?
messages.zh: 我时刻准备着尽我应尽的责任，同志。今天我能为国家做些什么？

messages.en: In order to prevent a number of Gallente corporations from appropriately countering a move by Sukuuvesta, we need to eliminate a Gallente listening post which is providing intelligence to those corporations. You and any pilots accompanying you are to fly to the listening post in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and destroy it. There will very likely be a strong Federation defense fleet stationed there, but the destruction of that fleet is not required. The listening post is your top priority.
messages.zh: 为了预防一批盖伦特公司妨碍斯库维塔的行动，我们要摧毁一个给这些公司提供情报的盖伦特情报站。你和你身边的飞行员都要飞去位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的情报站并且把它摧毁。很可能有一支非常厉害的联邦防卫舰队驻扎在那，但并不需要把那舰队也歼灭掉。情报站才是第一位的目标。

messages.en: The Gallente listening post has been destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 盖伦特情报站已经被摧毁了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Perfect; I'll inform Sukuuvesta at once. They'll be indebted to us – and you – for a long time to come.
messages.zh: 很好；我会马上通知斯库维塔。他们会很感谢我们的-还有你-将来很长一段时间都会这样。

messages.en: I don't particularly feel like wading into the middle of an international incident right now.
messages.zh: 现在我并没有特别觉得我正陷入一场国际纠纷。

messages.en: Very well, I suppose this sort of job isn't for everyone. I'll have to find something more suited to your talents.
messages.zh: 那好吧，我想这种工作并不是对每个人都合适。看来我要为你找些更适合你的才能的工作。

messages.en:
There are a number of treaties that regulate the way in which the various nations of the cluster are supposed to relate to each other and what behaviors are and are not acceptable for them to take against one another. In reality, every nation subverts these same treaties by engaging in a number of questionable practices, perpetuating a state of cold war where men and women on both sides fight and die while the two sides pretend to make nice with one another.

Perhaps nowhere is this more apparent than between the Caldari State and the Gallente Federation. While Caldari megacorporations have made a science of public relations and marketing, and the Federation has carefully cultivated a sympathetic image since the end of the Yulai Convention, beneath the polite veneer of both nations, knives flash in the dark. For the State, this shadow war is not about dominance or revenge, but fear. For all their seeming arrogance, the Caldari are deathly afraid that the Federation is only waiting for a moment of vulnerability before they can begin the process of re-assimilating the State into their nation, something which many Caldari already see them doing to the Republic. Often, this war gets the most bloody when the Gallente make what look like altruistic gestures, as the Caldari tend to interpret this as an attempt to get them to drop their guard in preparation for some sort of attack.
messages.zh:
很多协定都是用来规定说，很多国家他们理应关系良好及规定他们之间可接受及不可接受的行为。实际上，每个国家都用一种值得怀疑的做法来颠覆这种协定，他们要让冷战的局面延续下去，在双方假意和好的同时，实际上却在斗争、倾轧。

在加达里及盖伦特联盟之间这种情形尤为明显。在加达里超级集团做出了公共关系及营销的科学定义、联邦在尤拉会议后，小心地戴上同情的面具的时候，隐藏在这虚伪的礼貌的表皮下的，却是一片刀光剑影。但对加达里来说，这场暗战与称霸及报复无关，而是因为恐惧。加达里看起来很高傲，然而他们却十分害怕联邦只是在寻找容易攻破的机会把加达里再次收复，就像他们对共和国做过的那样。当盖伦特摆出一副无私的姿态，而加达里却倾向于理解成那是企图使自己放松警惕，以便于实施某种攻击的时候，那会是一场最最血腥的战斗。

messages.en: A Convenient Lie
messages.zh: 合宜的谎言

messages.en:
Recently, the Sukuuvesta corporation has been planning a major operation in a number of systems along the Gallente border, an operation which would be, shall we say, detrimental to the market share of a number of Gallente corporations. Unfortunately, these corporations are also politically well-connected, and we know that they have extensive connections within the Federation intelligence community. They've used these connections to get a Federation listening post to focus its attention on the very systems Sukuuvesta is planning their operation in, and as a result if Sukuuvesta makes a move, they will have enough forewarning to counter it, costing the megacorporation and the State billions.

The listening post attached to this particular region of space is in a rather precarious position; technically, according to the Gallente government, it is actually a civilian data archive and not at all related to the Federation intelligence apparatus. Furthermore, acting on behalf of the Gallente corporations, unlike in the State, is actually a violation of Gallente law. This means that were it to suffer an “accident” at the hands of someone not specifically affiliated with the State, there would be little the Federation could do in response. Hopefully, you can be that someone for us.
messages.zh:
最近，斯库维塔的公司正计划对盖伦特边境上的数个星系进行一场大行动，怎么说呢，这次行动决定了一大批盖伦特公司的市场份额的分配。不幸的是，这些公司在政治上关系紧密，而且我们知道他们在联邦情报界有广泛的接触。他们依赖于这种关系来让联邦情报站密切关注斯库维塔准备施加行动的星系，这样做也可以让他们在斯库维塔采取行动的时候做好充分的准备，用超级集团和国家金库来对付。

这个空间星域的情报站实在是处于危险的境地；严格的说，依据盖伦特政府所说的，它实际上是个民用的数据库，并且和联盟情报机构毫无关系。而且，为盖伦特公司牟利，不像在合众国内的，实际上是对盖伦特法律的违抗行为。这就意味着如果你遭遇了一些由不属于合众国的人引起的“意外”，那么联盟几乎不会做任何回应。但愿，你是帮我们的人。

messages.en: I never heard back from you, so I was forced to find someone else to take care of this problem. Time, tide, and megacorps wait for no man. Next time, do us both a favor and give me an answer so that we don't waste this time again.
messages.zh: 你从未给过我答复，所以我不得不去找来其他人接手这个问题。超级集团就像时间和潮水一样不会等人。下次请帮帮忙，给我个答复，免得我们再像这次一样浪费时间。

messages.en: Contract serviced by alternate vendor
messages.zh: 后部供应商的合同

messages.en: This is crazy-- what were you thinking? I can't possibly fight all those ships!
messages.zh: 真是疯了——你到底在想什么呢？我怎么可能对抗所有的船！

messages.en: I hope you know what you're doing. It isn't wise to anger one of the megacorps, and you've just endangered billions of Sukuuvesta investment dollars. I'd watch my back if I were you.
messages.zh: 我希望你能明白你在干什么。惹火任何一家超级集团都不是件聪明事，况且你才搞砸了几十亿的斯库维塔投资货币。如果我是你，我会时时警惕背后有没有清道夫。

messages.en: You waited far too long to get this done, and Sukuuvesta was forced to go ahead with their plans. Unfortunately, exactly what we expected happened, and their acquisition was blocked-- thanks to some rather “prescient” financial maneuvering. You've cost them a great deal. I'd watch my back if I were you.
messages.zh: 你等了太久了，而且斯库维塔不得不继续他们的计划。不幸的是，事情如我们所预料的进行，而且他们的所得都被封锁了——多亏那些“有先见之明的”金融策略。你已经花了他们不少钱了。如果我是你，我会时时警惕我的背后有没有清道夫。

messages.en: Sukuuvesta acquistion blocked by Gallente coalition
messages.zh: 斯库维塔的所得被盖伦特联盟都封锁起来了

name.ru: Нож в горле (Knife in the Throat)

messages.en: That relay is as good as gone.
messages.zh: 那座中继塔已经完蛋了。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, get out of there as quickly as you can. Reinforcements will probably be sent to the area as soon as the thing goes down.
messages.zh: 很好。一旦你摧毁了那座中继塔就迅速的从那儿离开，敌人的增援部队可能随时抵达。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
The Amarr have deployed a series of tactical FTL relays along the front lines in order to coordinate their operations. Naval Intelligence has located one nearby-- it's being used to stage raids against our convoys. Unfortunately, no regular naval forces are available for a fast strike, so we're looking to you to take care of this for us.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Amarr Tactical Relay, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
艾玛帝国在战区的前沿部署了一系列的超光速通讯中继塔用于组织对我们的进攻。海军情报部门已经定位了一座用来协调攻击我方补给船队的战术中继塔。但目前我们的人员紧张，没法抽调常规部队来完成这次攻击，所以我们正在找像你这样的飞行员帮助我们完成这个任务。

飞到指定的地点，寻找并摧毁艾玛战术中继塔，然后回来向你的代理人报告。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. This should take a bit of pressure off our supply convoys. I'll make sure command realizes your contribution.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮，飞行员。这能让我们的补给船队承受的压力得到一些减轻。我会让指挥部的人知道你的功劳的。

messages.en: Sounds a bit small-time to me.  I think I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 听起来不像是我的风格。我想我还是不要做这个了。
