messages.en: Not every mission is glory and fame, pilot.  Total victory is but an amalgam of many small, seemingly insignificant victories; that's something you will need to learn eventually.
messages.zh: 并不是每个任务都会是那么风光的，飞行员。最终的胜利是来自于很多像这样不那么重大的胜利共同组成的。这些你最后都会明白。

messages.en:
As you're probably aware, in order to coordinate military operations at the front lines, the Amarr have deployed a series of FTL communications relays at the edge of the forward line of battle. Eliminating these communications relays and throwing a wrench into enemy operations has been made a top priority by the general staff.

Naval Intelligence has been able to locate one of these tactical relays being used to coordinate raids on our shipping. Right now, it is only lightly defended, but we don't have any forces available to take it out. I've been asked to look for capsuleers like yourself to eliminate the relay. Think you're up for it?
messages.zh:
你可能已经知道了，为了配合前线的军事行动，艾玛帝国在战区的前沿部署了一系列的超光速通讯中继塔。为使敌人的通讯指挥系统陷入瘫痪，破坏这些中继站成为了我们总参部目前的首要目标。

海军情报部门已经定位了一座用来协调攻击我方部队的战术中继塔。目前，它的防御尚还较为薄弱，但即便这样我们也没有足够的人手调配出来组织这次攻击。我正在寻找能够完成这个任务的克隆飞行员，就像你这样的，去摧毁这座中继塔。你认为你能行么？

messages.en: He's as good as dead.
messages.zh: 死亡是他最好的归宿。

messages.en: Excellent. I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Remember, this commander is an expert at surprise attacks, so don't let him sneak up on you.
messages.zh: 很好。我期待你回音。注意，这司令是偷袭战的老手，你可要时刻提防着。

messages.en:
Minmatar forces in this sector have been taking heavy losses from enemy hit and run attacks on our fleets, damaging morale and stalling our offensives. Naval Intelligence believes that these attacks are being masterminded by the local Amarr sector commander, and has determined that our best option for ending these attacks is to eliminate him.

We have located a staging point that the sector commander is using for his attacks. You need to fly to these coordinates and wait for the commander and his escort to arrive, then eliminate him. Be aware that you may need to engage multiple groups of enemy forces while waiting, so be prepared for a protracted battle. Return to your agent when the sector commander has been destroyed.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔部队在此地区遭到了敌人重创，士气受损，进攻也停滞不前。海军情报部门相信，这些袭击的幕后指使是本地的艾玛地区司令，而结束袭击的最好方法就是把他除掉。

我们已经找到了该司令的部队纠集地。你要做的就是飞往那里，守株待兔，他一出现就把他干掉。注意在他来到之前，你可能要先被迫与多批敌人部队交火，因此要作好打持久战的准备。那司令死了后就速回代理人那里汇报。

messages.en: I've eliminated the sector commander.
messages.zh: 我已经把那地区司令干掉了。

messages.en: Great work, pilot. We'll make sure that word of your victory is spread to the rest of our forces; that should help morale more than you can realize.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。我会把这条好消息通报全军的；这真是一条令人振奋的消息啊。

messages.en:
We've been taking some heavy losses in the last few weeks along this area of the front. An enemy frigate squadron has been hitting our ships hard, taking out stragglers and scouts and then fading into space before we can counterattack, and it's starting to take its toll not only on our physical resources but an even heavier one on our morale. Our captains are getting too cautious, too unwilling to push for gains, and our general staff is getting concerned that the front will be stalled because of this. This is unacceptable.

Naval Intelligence believes that the person behind these attacks is the local Amarr sector commander. Eliminating him will hopefully end these attacks, give our forces a morale boost, and shift the momentum in this sector back to our side. Because of our problems with morale, we aren't sure that regular naval forces can handle this job; we'd like you to deal with this problem for us.

We've located a rendezvous point that this commander is going to be using for staging his next series of raids. You will need to fly there, eliminate his ship, and then report in. There will likely be a significant enemy presence there aside from the sector commander and his direct escort, so be prepared for a protracted battle.
messages.zh:
过去几周我们在此前线地区遭到了重创。敌方的一支护卫舰队伍对我们施行了猛烈打击，抓走我们侦察队的人，然后在我们实施反击前又退缩了回去。他们不仅在身体上让我们受打击，在精神上也极大地压制了我们。我们的舰长也变得胆小慎微起来，不敢大举进攻，大家都开始担心前线的推进将会就此打住。这是无法令人接受的。

海军情报部门相信，这些袭击的幕后指使是本地的艾玛地区司令。把他灭掉就可以停止这些袭击，还可以提升我军士气，另外也能让该地区的形势朝对我们有利的方向发展。但由于现在军队士气低落，因此我们对让常规海军部队完成此项任务并没把握；我想让你来帮我们这个忙。

我们已经找到了该司令将要发动下一次袭击的集合点。你就是要飞过去把他干掉，然后回来报告。那里除了司令员本身及他的随从之外，还可能会有其他大量敌舰，因此要作好打持久战的准备。

messages.en: I'll leave immediately.
messages.zh: 我马上就出发。

messages.en: Good. Return here as soon as you get the data.
messages.zh: 很好，拿到数据后尽快返回这里。

messages.en:
The Navy is planning a new offensive against Empire positions, but Naval Intelligence has been unable to make headway getting the information necessary to plan a coordinated strike. In order to get the intelligence we need, we're going to need you to make a raid on a secure enemy datastore.

You'll need to jump into the deadspace area, eliminate the defenders, and recover the Tactical Information Sheet from the datastore. Once you've got it, bring it back to your agent so that Naval Intelligence can analyze it in preparation for the offensive.
messages.zh:
海军正在策划对帝国的目标进行一次攻击，但是海军情报部门还没有能够得到这次攻击计划制定之中所需的关键情报。为了能够得到这份情报，我们需要你去袭击一座敌人的数据储藏中心。

你需要跃迁进入到一个死亡空间复合体里面，消灭所有的反抗者，然后再从数据中心找到战术情报文件。一旦得手，马上带回来给你的代理人，这样海军情报部门就能立即对情报进行分析制定作战计划。

messages.en: I think I've found what you were looking for. Is this it?
messages.zh: 我想我已经拿到你要找的东西，是这个么？

messages.en: Nice work, pilot. I'll pass this up the chain to Naval Intelligence. Drinks are on us tonight.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮，飞行员，我会把这个发布到海军情报系统里面去。今晚的酒钱我们买单了。

messages.en: Sounds pretty dicey. I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 听起来很冒险。

messages.en: This war isn't going to get any easier, pilot.  You'd better start thinking whether or not you're really cut out for this line of work.
messages.zh: 这场仗不会好过的，飞行员。你应该好好想想你到底要不要参与进来。

messages.en:
The Navy's general staff is planning an offensive against Amarr positions in this sector, but Naval Intelligence is having difficulty piercing the veil of enemy counterintelligence. Optimally, we'd like to get a better idea of Amarr positions, communications codes, fleet readiness and their own intelligence estimates of our disposition, but they've been working hard to keep us from getting our hands on anything more than a vague picture.

We've decided to try a bit of an end-run around their counterintelligence screen. We know where they have a secure datastore in an area of deadspace. We're going to send you in to recover the information from the datastore, but we'll only have a short window for this, so you'll need to move quickly. Can you handle that?
messages.zh:
海军总参谋部正在策划对这个区域的一个艾玛据点发动攻击，但是海军情报部门在对敌人的反情报系统进行渗透的时候遇到了一些麻烦。我们希望能够得到一些关于这个艾玛目标更为准确的信息，包括联络代码，舰队部署以及他们对我们的战力预测。但是他们的反情报部门将这些文件管理得非常严密，我们的人根本没法插入。

我们决定采用一些更加直接的办法绕道他们后面进行夺取。我们知道他们放置了重兵力守卫这个死亡复合体中的数据库，我们将把你派过去夺取这份情报。机会难得，你需要尽快动身。有什么问题么？

messages.en: Blowing up some supply industrials? Sounds easy enough.
messages.zh: 击毁几艘运送补给物资的工业舰？听起来够简单的。

messages.en: I knew you would be up for it, pilot. The convoy is lightly guarded and the only important targets are their industrials. Once you destroy them, you can get out of there or mop up as needed. Just remember, because the system is contested, pod pilots working for the Amarr may try to stop you. Be sure that your ship is set up to counter them as well.
messages.zh: 我知道你会帮忙的，飞行员。船队的防御力量很弱，首要目标是他们的工业舰。一旦摧毁了他们，你就可以回来报告了，你也可以全部消灭如果你觉得有必要的话。只是你要记住，那个星系是争夺区域，这样在那儿游荡的艾玛飞行员会尝试组织你，你得要准备好对付这些人。

messages.en: Yes.
messages.zh: 是的。

messages.en:
The Amarr are resupplying one of their relay stations in a nearby contested system-- it's due to run out soon and the convoy dispatched to resupply it hasn't arrived yet. Your job is to intercept the convoy and destroy the industrials before they have a chance to complete their mission.

The mission shouldn't be too difficult, as long as you don't encounter any pod pilots fighting for the Amarr. You should fit your ship to defend itself from other pod pilots just in case.
messages.zh:
艾玛正在对他们在附近争夺区域的一座中继站进行补给——他们的燃料就要烧完了而运送补给物资的船队尚还没有抵达。你的任务就是去拦截补给护航船队并将在他们抵达目的地之前将其工业舰摧毁。

这个人物应该没有什么难度，关键的威胁来自于游荡于争夺区域的帝国飞行员。你需要好好的装配你的舰船来对抗可能出现的遭遇战。

messages.en: That station won't be seeing new supplies any time soon.
messages.zh: 那座中继站很长一段时间是看不到他们的补给船对了。

messages.en: Good work. I knew I could count on you. With that relay station out of commission, our local transmissions will be harder for the Amarr to intercept, at least until they manage to sneak another convoy in there.
messages.zh: 干的不错，我就知道你是靠得住的。那座中继站失效过后，我们在本地的通信将会难以被艾玛所截获，至少说在他们重新溜进来之前我们可以安心好些日子了。

messages.en: I can't do that.
messages.zh: 我做不了那个。

messages.en: Is destroying a few industrials really that difficult? I suppose I'll have to find someone else to complete this mission for me.
messages.zh: 打几艘工业舰真的就这么难么？我找别人来做这个任务好了。

messages.en:
I'm glad you're here, pilot. It's come to my attention that the Amarr have a relay station in a nearby contested system. The station is being used to send monitor classified Republic transmissions and then transmit them back to Amarr space, where their code-breakers can get to work figuring out what we mean. So far, we haven't had an opportunity to strike at it, and it's unlikely we'll get one soon.

However, we've received intelligence that the Amarr have dispatched a convoy to refuel the station. If we can destroy that convoy, we'll hamper their spying operations for at least a little while.
messages.zh:
很高兴你在这儿，飞行员。艾玛在附近争夺区域的一座中继站最近引起了我的注意。这座中继站专门用来监听共和国的机密频道，并将信息传送回艾玛境内的接收站进行破译。到目前我们都还没有找到机会攻击它，这样下去也不是办法。

不管怎样，我们得到情报说有一队艾玛船队从本土出发准备对这座中继站进行燃料补给。如果我们能摧毁这个船队的话，那我们就能给他们的情报工作带来一定程度上的打击。

messages.en: I have to abandon your mission.
messages.zh: 我的要放弃你的任务。

messages.en: That relay station is causing serious problems for us. I'll have to get someone else to stop them.
messages.zh: 这个中继站给我们造成了严重的危害。我得要找人去阻止他们。

messages.en: It doesn't matter what those thieves do as their day jobs, they won't get away from me!
messages.zh: 我不关心这些强盗白天都在干些啥，但绝对不会逃过我的掌心。

messages.en: Remember, the belt is in a contested system, so pod pilots working for the Empire may try to stop you. Make sure you prepare for them above all else.
messages.zh: 记住，这个矿带是位于一个争夺中的星系，所以帝国的克隆飞行员们可能会要试图攻击你。你的准备好对付这些人。

messages.en: I am always ready to earn an honest buck. Sometimes a not-so-honest one too.
messages.zh: 我总是希望赚点老实钱。虽然有时候也搞点不那么老实的。

messages.en: Some pesky miners working for the Amarr Empire have managed to discover one of our hidden asteroid belts. This is unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. Head out there and destroy those miners, then report back to me. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the Empire.
messages.zh: 一些为艾玛人工作的矿工发现了我们的一个秘密的小行星带。这是不能接受的。我把坐标传送给你，你去把他们都歼灭了，然后回来向我报告。你要当心那些为帝国卖力的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: I've destroyed those miners. Our asteroids are safe for now!
messages.zh: 我消灭了那些矿工。我们的小行星带从此又恢复了宁静。

messages.en: Great. That should teach them to try to take what belongs to the Republic! Hopefully, we won't have any more problems with those pesky miners, but knowing the Amarr, I doubt this'll be the end of it. Oh well, we'll just send you in again if need be!
messages.zh: 很好。那应该能教会他们去偷共和国的东西！希望这些烦人的矿工不会再来制造麻烦了。不过你要知道艾玛人，我很怀疑他们会就这么罢休。好吧，如果他们又来了我们再找你。

messages.en: I can't do that to those poor miners!
messages.zh: 我不能对那些可怜的矿工下毒手。

messages.en: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这样看来我得找别人来做了。

messages.en:
The Minmatar Republic has located numerous hidden asteroid belts that our miners use to provide resources for the war effort. Usually, they don't get touched by anyone except us and the people we send out there... even if they're not technically in Republic space. However, it seems the Amarr Empire has sent some miners into one of our fields in an area of space they consider theirs; while we've been busy with other things, they've been sneaking in and mining our ore!

This is unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. I want you to go out there and destroy those miners and show them that we're always watching. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the Amarr. They're sure to be in the area.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔找到了我们的矿工用来为战争提供后请资源的小行星带。通常他们不会受到除了我们派去的人之外的干扰，就算他们现在并不是在共和国的空域。但是现在的情况是，艾玛帝国派遣了一些矿工到我们的一个小行星带，他们还认为这个小行星带是他们所有的；我们现在很忙，趁这个空子他们肆无忌惮的开采我们的资源！

这是不能接受的。我把坐标传送给你，你去把他们都歼灭了，然后回来向我报告。你要当心那些为帝国卖力的克隆飞行员，他们肯定会在那些区域出现。

messages.en: I'm afraid I cannot complete your mission.
messages.zh: 恐怕我不能完成你的任务。

messages.en: I'm disappointed in you. I didn't think you would have trouble.
messages.zh: 你让我失望了。我以为你不会有问题的。

messages.en: Don't worry. I'll make sure that gate stays deactivated!
messages.zh: 能。我保证能让那门永远封存起来。

messages.en:
I knew I could count on you for this. I've uploaded the location of the deadspace pocket to your NeoCom. All you need to do is head there and destroy the repair ships. The gate itself is probably too tough for you to destroy on your own. After all, that's why we left it there before.

Just remember, this gate is in a contested system. That means pod pilots flying for the Amarr might try to stop you. Be careful.
messages.zh:
我就知道我能把这事托付给你。我已经把死亡空间的位置上传到了你的控制边栏里。你要做的就是赶往那里把维修船炸掉。那门靠你自己去轰可能难了点。不然我们也不会一开始就把那门留了下来。

记住，由于这门位于一个争夺星系里，因此为艾玛效力的飞行员可以随时向你开火。要当心。

messages.en: Sure thing. What needs destroyed today?
messages.zh: 准备好了。今天要去哪里搞破坏？

messages.en: The Amarr Empire has a gate hidden in a deadspace pocket. The gate has been offline for a while, and has fallen into some disrepair. Now it seems that the Empire is trying to get it back on. Head over to the gate and destroy the repair ships before they can get it back online. Oh, and be careful. We've received word that capsuleers working for the Amarr have been spotted in the area.
messages.zh: 艾玛在一个死亡空间里有个隐蔽门。那门已经长久不用，很多地方都需要修理了。现在看起来帝国打算对它进行修复。快赶往那里，乘他们施行修复之前，把那些修理船都干掉。哦，我们获悉那里会有为艾玛效力的飞行员，因此你行事要小心。

messages.en: Those repair ships were no problem. Mission accomplished.
messages.zh: 那些维修船已经不是问题了。任务完成。

messages.en: Good work. I am impressed. The Amarr will probably think twice before trying to reactivate that gate again. I'm sure that will put a serious crimp in their plans for the area.
messages.zh: 干得好，我欣赏。艾玛可能不再敢轻举妄动去重启那门了。我敢肯定，他们针对该地区的计划已经严重受挫。

messages.en: That sounds a bit tougher than I can handle.
messages.zh: 我处理这事可能有点吃力。

messages.en: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这样看来我得找别人来做了。

messages.en:
We recently discovered a hidden gate belonging to the Amarr Empire in a nearby deadspace pocket. A capsuleer working for us managed to take the guards out some time ago, after which we then sent in forces to deactivate it. For a while, it seemed like the Amarr would simply abandon the gate.

Unfortunately, that's not the case. We've detected a squad of ships heading to the gate to initiate repairs on the gate and reactivate it, probably so they can more easily move forces into the area. Luckily, it will take them quite some time to get it operational. We want you to head out there and stop them before they can. Can you handle this?
messages.zh:
我们最近在附近的一个死亡空间里发现了属于艾玛的一个隐蔽门。上次我们的一位飞行员成功地把守门的卫兵都干掉了，之后我们派出一支部队把那门封停了。当初看起来艾玛已经有了弃门的意思。

不过实际情况并非如此。我们已经探到敌方有一支部队正前往那星门，准备修复它，然后打算重新启用该门。估计他们这样做的目的是想让自己进出更方便。所幸他们真要搞成还需要一点时间。我们要你飞往那里及时制止他们。你能接手这事吗？

messages.en: Things were tough over there! I'm going to have to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这仗太难打了！我不干了。

messages.en: Now I'll have to find someone else to stop them! I hope we still have time.
messages.zh: 那我现在必须得另寻他人来阻止他们了！但愿还来得及。

name.ru: Изменение в плане (A Change of Plan)

messages.en: Don't worry, I won't let you down.
messages.zh: 不用担心，我不会让你失望。

messages.en: See that you do not.
messages.zh: 看起来你不要做。

messages.en: That's why I'm here. What's the problem?
messages.zh: 这正是我在这儿的原因。有什么问题么。

messages.en: We've got an Imperial Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there; kill that commander and any of his guards present. This should scatter their forces long enough for our own reinforcements to arrive.
messages.zh: 我们发现有一个帝国海军前线指挥官最近又到了我们的边界线以内。我们截获的对方通讯显示他们计划要巩固他们的工事，而且还有更多的船要开过来。你要确保这样的事情不会发生。你去把那个前线指挥官干掉，还有他的守卫。这样我们将有足够的时间把增援部队调集过去。

messages.en: Mission complete. The Field Commander and his guards have been dealt with.
messages.zh: 任务完成。前线指挥官和他的守卫都被我收拾了。

messages.en: Not bad, rookie. Not bad at all. You've a long way left to go to prove your worth, however.
messages.zh: 不错啊，菜鸟，很好。但你还要继续长期努力才能证明你的价值。

messages.en: Sorry, this doesn't interest me one bit.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我完全没兴趣。

messages.en: I had a suspicion you would balk at the thought of live combat. You'd best sort your act out, rookie.
messages.zh: 我就猜到你可能会在真正的战斗中退缩。你最好反省一下，菜鸟。

messages.en: Imperial Navy combat units have become increasingly bold with their incursions into Minmatar Republic sovereign space. At times, the Field Commanders in charge of their small units are not even on authorized missions, dangerous as such a thing is inside the Empire. Grabs for glory and personal vendettas make for a very disturbing trend when inside one of the largest navies in existence.
messages.zh: 帝国海军战斗单位已开始越来越大胆地在米玛塔尔共和国的领空肆意进行侵略活动。小型作战单位的前线指挥官已经很多次越权进行军事行动，给帝国内部的安全带来了威胁。追求个人的荣誉和公报私仇有愈演愈烈的趋势。

messages.en: A troubling individualism
messages.zh: 危险的个人主义

messages.en:
Nothing major, which is why you're getting the job. Prove to us you can handle this and we'll have plenty more to throw you later on. Screw up, however, and it's going on your record.

We've got an Imperial Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. If we allow them room to breathe, they'll have Navy Battleships and perhaps even more entrenched in the system within a week. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen.

Fly over there and kill that commander and any of his guards present. Without him calling the shots, his people will fall back to regroup, and that buys us enough time to reinforce the area properly with skilled pilots.

Briefing's over, rookie: move your ass.
messages.zh:
没什么大不了的，正因为这样你才能拿到这个任务。如果你能证明给我们看，你完全能够处理这样的小问题的话，我们还有大把的任务可以交给你来完成。如果你给搞砸了，这也得记在你的账上。

我们发现有一个帝国海军前线指挥官最近又到了我们的边界线以内。我们截获的对方通讯显示他们计划要巩固他们的工事，而且还有更多的船要开过来。如果我们给他们喘息的机会，他们的海军战列舰就会在一周内占去这个星系的大部分地盘。你要确保这样的事情不会发生。

你去把那个前线指挥官干掉，还有他的守卫。没有了指挥官，他的人只能回去重新整队，这将给我们足够的时间来加强防御，增加人手。

情况就是这样，菜鸟，动起来！

messages.en: I can't finish this mission, there's too many hostiles getting in my way.
messages.zh: 我不能完成这个任务，那有太多的敌人了。

messages.en: Fine, I'll get someone more capable. A word of advice: don't repeat this display of cowardice and uselessness. We don't tolerate such things in the Republic.
messages.zh: 好吧，我会找个更有实力的人。给你一点建议，别再表现的像个没用的懦夫一样。我们共和国不能容忍这样的人。

messages.en: On my way!
messages.zh: 我立马出发！

messages.en: Good. Keep your comms line open, I'll be relaying further information when you give me a clear picture of the situation.
messages.zh: 很好。保持信道通畅，在你向我汇报清情况之后，我会给你下一步指令。

messages.en: I've come for work, yes.
messages.zh: 我就是来找工作的。

messages.en:
We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. Get your ass out there. I want them supported in any way possible.
messages.zh:
我们刚从在敌方领域行动的侦察队那里收到一条重要消息。他们的任务是侦察敌军，现在他们已经发现了敌人。由于他们自己无法解决敌人，他们向我们发出了增援请求。

我回复他们我们一招到合适人员就会派去增援他们，但自此以后我就一直没收到他们的回音。你尽快赶往那里，要尽一切方式帮助他们。

messages.en: I just made it back, is everything ok now?
messages.zh: 我回来了，现在一切都顺利了是不是？

messages.en: Yes, they succeeded in clearing the area of hostiles just moments ago. Good work out there rookie, keep it up.
messages.zh: 是的，他们就在刚才成功地清理了该敌区。干得不错，新人。要再接再厉。

messages.en: Oh…sorry, I won't be able to leave immediately. You better find someone else.
messages.zh: 哦……不好意思，我没法立刻动身。你最好找别人。

messages.en: Useless. Don't offer your services unless you intend to provide them wherever and whenever you are asked to!
messages.zh: 没用的家伙。除非你准备好随时随地做贡献，不然就别问别人需不需帮助！

messages.en: The life of a reconnaissance pilot is fraught with real and present danger at all times. Since even the slightest mistake can cost an entire squadron their lives, operations behind enemy lines are a task carried out by some of the most disciplined and battle-hardened pilots each empire has.
messages.zh: 特勤人员的生涯充满了危险。由于最小的错误也可能让整支队伍送命，因此深入敌后的行动一般都是由每个帝国中纪律性最强，久经沙场考验的飞行员执行的。

messages.en: A covert life.
messages.zh: 特勤生涯。

messages.en:
Alright then, I suppose I've got something for you.

We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. They've either had to maintain comms silence to avoid being detected or they've been forced to engage prematurely.

In any case, get your ass out there. Those are good men and women putting their lives on the line. I want them supported in any way possible.
messages.zh:
那好，我想我这里有适合你干的活。

我们刚从在敌方领域行动的侦察队那里收到一条重要消息。他们的任务是侦察敌军，现在他们已经发现了敌人。由于他们自己无法解决敌人，他们向我们发出了增援请求。

我回复他们我们一招到合适人员就会派去增援他们，但自此以后我就一直没收到他们的回音。他们要么就是为了不被发现而中断联系，要么就是被迫提前和敌人们干上了。

不管怎么样你都要尽快赶往那里。他们都是拿命做赌注的好同志。你尽一切方式帮助他们。

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't make it out to them after all. Sorry for the let down.
messages.zh: 我怕我没法完成该任务了。不好意思让你失望了。

messages.en: Sorry for the let down? Is that all you have to say? They're probably dead or cornered and that's all you offer me? Keep that callous attitude up and you'll find yourself barred from any further work inside our borders.
messages.zh: 不好意思让我失望？你最多就只能说这句话？他们可能已经牺牲了，而你跟我说这话？你就继续保持那冷血态度吧，然后你就再也无法在我们境内找到工作。

messages.en: They are assisting the Amarrians, as you said. I see no reason to decline. Give me the coordinates.
messages.zh: 他们在帮助艾玛人，就像你说的一样。这是不可否认的事实。把坐标给我。

messages.en: I am glad to see you understand the situation fully. Report back to me when you have finished the assignment.
messages.zh: 我很高兴你能够明白现在的状况。完成任务后回来向我报告。

messages.en: I am. Tell me how I can serve.
messages.zh: 是的。请告诉我该怎样做。

messages.en: We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Amarrian vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Empire forces. They must be dealt with.
messages.zh: 我们在附近的区域发现了一座民用设施，里面驻扎了一些工程师和技术人员，这些人都是帮助维修艾玛军队的舰船的。虽然技术上来说他们只是工人，是非战斗人员，但不可否认的是他们在直接地帮助我们的敌人。他们必须要有觉悟承受这样做的后果。

messages.en: I have done as you asked, the facility has been destroyed.
messages.zh: 我已经完成你的要求了，那座设施被摧毁了。

messages.en: Excellent work, rookie. There is hope for you yet. You have proven today that you understand the realities of the conflict ahead. Your loyalty will not go unnoticed.
messages.zh: 干得很棒，菜鸟。看来你还有希望。所今天所做的证明了你对眼前争夺的实质还是明白的。你的忠心不会被忽略的。

messages.en: I don't care what the circumstances are; I will not be a party in the murder of civilians.
messages.zh: 我不关心现在的环境；我不会参与对平民的伤害的。

messages.en: Your very refusal has assured that you will be. If you think those ships they repair do not target civilian structures of our own then you are a fool. I will get someone else for the job, your short-sighted and confused morality changes nothing except our perceptions of your worth to our cause.
messages.zh: 你的拒绝是很愚蠢的。你真的以为这些被修好的舰船不会拿我们自己的平民当靶子吗？你这个笨蛋。我会找别的人来完成这个任务，你短浅的眼光和模糊的道德标准除了让你的忠诚受到伤害之外没有什么用处了。

messages.en: In a time of war, there are very few people who will not find themselves caught in the crossfire. Civilians and non-combatants who directly assist armed forces are invariably seen as valid targets – no empire will risk letting their efforts go unhindered. In such dark times, necessity always takes precedent over morality.
messages.zh: 在战争的年代，只有很少人是处在没有战火的地方。那些帮助武装力量的平民和非战斗人员永远都是合法的目标，没有任何一个国家会忽视这种力量。在这样一个黑暗的时代，利益驱使的必要性总是会战胜纠结于灵魂之中的道德。

messages.en: Dark times.
messages.zh: 黑暗的年代。

messages.en:
The task I have for you today is an important one. It is significant not only in strategic terms, but also a test of your loyalty.

We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Amarrian vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Empire forces. They must be dealt with.

Fortunately for us, there is a small window of opportunity where we can strike at them. Repaired ships that are awaiting further deployment usually stand on guard at the facility. However, the large majority of them have been recalled to another higher priority assignment. We have a chance to strike here, rookie. Will you help the Republic?
messages.zh:
今天我要给你的任务是非常重要的。不光光是战术上的重要性，而也是对你的忠诚的考验。

我们在附近的区域发现了一座民用设施，里面驻扎了一些工程师和技术人员，这些人都是帮助维修艾玛军队的舰船的。虽然技术上来说他们只是工人，是非战斗人员，但不可否认的是他们在直接地帮助我们的敌人。他们必须要有觉悟承受这样做的后果。

幸运的是，我有一个机会可以直接的袭击他们。被维修好的舰船在重新被分配任务之前会充当这个维修站的防御力量。但是，他们大部分被派遣出去执行另外一项更高优先级的任务了。这给我们带来了一个机会，新人，你愿意帮助共和国完成这项任务么？

messages.en: I've changed my mind. I cannot do what you've asked of me.
messages.zh: 我改变主意了。我不能做这事儿。

messages.en: Then you are of no use to us. Save me your confused ramblings on morality, we have a war to win here and I will do what it takes to serve that end.
messages.zh: 这样的话你对我们就没用了。把你的道德言论收起来吧，我们有一场战争要去赢，这终将是一场不择手段的争夺。

messages.en: Blowing up a reactor is what I've been dreaming of! Count me in.
messages.zh: 我做梦都想要把哪个反应堆给炸掉玩玩！算我一个。

messages.en: Good deal. I've uploaded the location to your NeoCom. There will be some defenses there, but they shouldn't be too difficult for you. However, pod pilots working for the Empire may be flying in the area. Prepare yourself to face them.
messages.zh: 不错。我正在把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中。你可能会在那儿遭到一些抵抗，但对你来说这应该不会太难。只是你要注意的是帝国的飞行员可能也在附近徘徊，你要对此有所准备。

messages.en: Whatever you've got, I can take it on.
messages.zh: 不管是什么，我都能解决。

messages.en:
The Amarr Empire is trying to set up a starbase inside one of the contested systems. If they manage to get it up and running, they'll have a staging point from which to launch further attacks against us. Luckily, it is not yet fully operational and has a highly explosive reactor that is just waiting to be destroyed.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Head over there and destroy the reactor. Just watch out for the pod pilots working for the Empire. They will try to stop you if they can.
messages.zh:
艾玛帝国试图在一个争夺区域中设立一个空间站。如果他们能够成功的话，他们就有了一个把战线朝我们进一步推进的跳板。幸运的事，这个母星还没有完全的进入运转，并且有一个高爆炸危险的反应堆在那儿等着我们去把他轰掉。

我已经把坐标地点上传到你的控制边栏中了。你前去把反应堆炸掉然后回来向我报告。你要注意可能再附近出现的敌方克隆飞行员，他们一定会尝试阻止你。

messages.en: I've destroyed the reactor and the starbase went up like a Day of Freedom celebration!
messages.zh: 我已经炸毁了那个反应堆，整个空间站就像解放纪念日的烟火一样炫丽！

messages.en: Excellent work. I wish I could have been there to see that thing go. I bet it was quite a display! Hopefully, this will set the Amarr back and make them hesitate before trying to set up a starbase here again!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。真希望我也能在场观看，这肯定是一场精彩的表演！希望这能够给艾玛人带来点教训让他们想要再在这儿搞一个空间站的时候能够三思而后行。

messages.en: Whoa, maybe I can't take that on.
messages.zh: 行了，我可能做不了这个。

messages.en: Don't you think you can handle this?
messages.zh: 你不认为你能对付得了么？

messages.en:
Those damn Amarr. Always up to something sneaky. Thankfully we've enough spies in their midst to keep them from pulling off anything too big. One of those spies just reported that the Empire is trying to construct a starbase inside a nearby contested system.

A fully functioning starbase can cause us a huge headache. They're tough and require a lot of manpower to destroy. Because of our spies we have a first strike advantage. The starbase hasn't been completed yet, and the idiot Amarr have filled their main reactor full of fuel.

If you head over there and destroy the reactor, the entire starbase will blow. Do you think you can do this for me?
messages.zh:
这些可恶的艾玛人。总是喜欢干这种偷鸡摸狗的事情。庆幸我们有足够的间谍渗透在他们之中把所有的信息都能够传送回来。我们的一个间谍报告说帝国正试图在附近的一个争夺区域建设一个母星。

一个全面运转的母星将给我们带来严重的威胁，而这些建筑又非常坚固而且需要非常多的人力去摧毁。这座母星还没有完成，而那些愚昧的艾玛人却已经把足够多的燃料运送过去，活生生的把他们的反应堆塞成了一个爆炸物筒。

如果你过去把这个反应堆摧毁的话，剧烈的爆炸会把整个母星变成尘埃。你认为你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: That starbase reactor was tougher than I expected.
messages.zh: 那个母星反应堆比我想象的要坚固的多。

messages.en: I suppose I can send someone else to finish the job.
messages.zh: 我看来只好找别人来完成这个任务了。

name.ru: Нож в горле (Knife in the Throat)

messages.en: That relay is as good as gone.
messages.zh: 那座中继塔已经完蛋了。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, get out of there as quickly as you can. Reinforcements will probably be sent to the area as soon as the thing goes down.
messages.zh: 很好。一旦你摧毁了那座中继塔就迅速的从那儿离开，敌人的增援部队可能随时抵达。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
The Minmatar have deployed a series of tactical FTL relays along the front lines in order to coordinate their operations. Naval Intelligence has located one nearby-- it's being used to stage raids against our convoys. Unfortunately, no regular naval forces are available for a fast strike, so we're looking to you to take care of this for us.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Minmatar Tactical Relay, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔在战区的前沿部署了一系列的超光速通讯中继塔用于组织对我们的进攻。海军情报部门已经定位了一座用来协调攻击我方补给船队的战术中继塔。但目前我们的人员紧张，没法抽调常规部队来完成这次攻击，所以我们正在找像你这样的飞行员帮助我们完成这个任务。

飞到指定的地点，寻找并摧毁艾玛战术中继塔，然后回来向你的代理人报告。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. This should take a bit of pressure off our supply convoys. I'll make sure command realizes your contribution.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮，飞行员。这能让我们的补给船队承受的压力得到一些减轻。我会让指挥部的人知道你的功劳的。

messages.en: Sounds a bit small-time to me.  I think I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 听起来不像是我的风格。我想我还是不要做这个了。

messages.en: Not every mission is glory and fame, pilot.  Total victory is but an amalgam of many small, seemingly insignificant victories; that's something you will need to learn eventually.
messages.zh: 并不是每个任务都会是那么风光的，飞行员。最终的胜利是来自于很多像这样不那么重大的胜利共同组成的。这些你最后都会明白。

messages.en:
As you're probably aware, in order to coordinate military operations at the front lines, the Minmatar have deployed a series of FTL communications relays at the edge of the forward line of battle. Eliminating these communications relays and throwing a wrench into enemy operations has been made a top priority by the general staff.

Naval Intelligence has been able to locate one of these tactical relays being used to coordinate raids on our shipping. Right now, it is only lightly defended, but we don't have any forces available to take it out. I've been asked to look for capsuleers like yourself to eliminate the relay. Think you're up for it?
messages.zh:
你可能已经知道了，为了配合前线的军事行动，米玛塔尔在战区的前沿部署了一系列的超光速通讯中继塔。为使敌人的通讯指挥系统陷入瘫痪，破坏这些中继站成为了我们总参部目前的首要目标。

海军情报部门已经定位了一座用来协调攻击我方补给船队的战术中继塔。目前，它的防御尚还较为薄弱，但即便这样我们也没有足够的人手调配出来组织这次攻击。我正在寻找能够完成这个任务的克隆飞行员，就像你这样的，去摧毁这座中继塔。你认为你能行么？

messages.en: He's as good as dead.
messages.zh: 死亡是他最好的归宿。

messages.en: Excellent. I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Remember, this commander is an expert at surprise attacks, so don't let him sneak up on you.
messages.zh: 很好。我期待你回音。注意，这司令是偷袭战的老手，你可要时刻提防着。

messages.en:
Amarr forces in this sector have been taking heavy losses from enemy hit and run attacks on our fleets, damaging morale and stalling our offensives. Naval Intelligence believes that these attacks are being masterminded by the local Minmatar sector commander, and has determined that our best option for ending these attacks is to eliminate him.

We have located a staging point that the sector commander is using for his attacks. You need to fly to these coordinates and wait for the commander and his escort to arrive, then eliminate him. Be aware that you may need to engage multiple groups of enemy forces while waiting, so be prepared for a protracted battle. Return to your agent when the sector commander has been destroyed.
messages.zh:
艾玛部队在此地区遭到了敌人重创，士气受损，进攻也停滞不前。海军情报部门相信，这些袭击的幕后指使是本地的米玛塔尔地区司令，而结束袭击的最好方法就是把他除掉。

我们已经找到了该司令的部队纠集地。你要做的就是飞往那里，守株待兔，他一出现就把他干掉。注意在他来到之前，你可能要先被迫与多批敌人部队交火，因此要作好打持久战的准备。那司令死了后就速回代理人那里汇报。

messages.en: I've eliminated the sector commander.
messages.zh: 我已经把那地区司令干掉了。

messages.en: Great work, pilot. We'll make sure that word of your victory is spread to the rest of our forces; that will help morale more than you can realize.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。我会把这条好消息通报全军的；这真是一条令人振奋的消息啊。

messages.en:
We've been taking some heavy losses in the last few weeks along this area of the front. An enemy frigate squadron has been hitting our ships hard, taking out stragglers and scouts and then fading into space before we can counterattack, and it's starting to take its toll not only on our physical resources but an even heavier one on our morale. Our captains are getting too cautious, too unwilling to push for gains, and our general staff is getting concerned that the front will be stalled because of this. This is unacceptable.

Naval Intelligence believes that the person behind these attacks is the local Minmatar sector commander. Eliminating him will hopefully end these attacks, give our forces a morale boost, and shift the momentum in this sector back to our side. Because of our problems with morale, we aren't sure that regular naval forces can handle this job; we'd like you to deal with this problem for us.

We've located a rendezvous point that this commander is going to be using for staging his next series of raids. You will need to fly there, eliminate his ship, and then report in. There will likely be a significant enemy presence there aside from the sector commander and his direct escort, so be prepared for a protracted battle.
messages.zh:
过去几周我们在此前线地区遭到了重创。敌方的一支护卫舰队伍对我们施行了猛烈打击，抓走我们侦察队的人，然后在我们实施反击前又退缩了回去。他们不仅在身体上让我们受打击，在精神上也极大地压制了我们。我们的舰长也变得胆小慎微起来，不敢大举进攻，大家都开始担心前线的推进将会就此打住。这是无法令人接受的。

海军情报部门相信，这些袭击的幕后指使是本地的米玛塔尔地区司令。把他灭掉就可以停止这些袭击，还可以提升我军士气，另外也能让该地区的形势朝对我们有利的方向发展。但由于现在军队士气低落，因此我们对让常规海军部队完成此项任务并没把握；我想让你来帮我们这个忙。

我们已经找到了该司令将要发动下一次袭击的集合点。你就是要飞过去把他干掉，然后回来报告。那里除了司令员本身及他的随从之外，还可能会有其他大量敌舰，因此要作好打持久战的准备。

messages.en: I'll leave immediately.
messages.zh: 我马上就出发。

messages.en: Good. Return here as soon as you get the data.
messages.zh: 很好，拿到数据后尽快返回这里。

messages.en:
The Navy is planning a new offensive against Republic positions, but Naval Intelligence has been unable to make headway getting the information necessary to plan a coordinated strike. In order to get the intelligence we need, we're going to need you to make a raid on a secure enemy datastore.

You'll need to jump into the deadspace area, eliminate the defenders, and recover the Tactical Information Sheet from the datastore. Once you've got it, bring it back to your agent so that Naval Intelligence can analyze it in preparation for the offensive.
messages.zh:
海军正在策划对共和国的目标进行一次攻击，但是海军情报部门还没有能够得到这次攻击计划制定之中所需的关键情报。为了能够得到这份情报，我们需要你去袭击一座敌人的数据储藏中心。

你需要跃迁进入到一个死亡空间复合体里面，消灭所有的反抗者，然后再从数据中心找到战术情报文件。一旦得手，马上带回来给你的代理人，这样海军情报部门就能立即对情报进行分析制定作战计划。

messages.en: I think I've found what you were looking for. Is this it?
messages.zh: 我想我已经拿到你要找的东西，是这个么？

messages.en: Nice work, pilot. I'll pass this up the chain to Naval Intelligence. Drinks are on us tonight.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮，飞行员，我会把这个发布到海军情报系统里面去。今晚的酒钱我们买单了。

messages.en: Sounds pretty dicey. I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 听起来很冒险。

messages.en: This war isn't going to get any easier, pilot.  You'd better start thinking whether or not you're really cut out for this line of work.
messages.zh: 这场仗不会好过的，飞行员。你应该好好想想你到底要不要参与进来。

messages.en:
The Navy's general staff is planning an offensive against Minmatar positions in this sector, but Naval Intelligence is having difficulty piercing the veil of enemy counterintelligence. Optimally, we'd like to get a better idea of Minmatar positions, communications codes, fleet readiness and their own intelligence estimates of our disposition, but they've been working hard to keep us from getting our hands on anything more than a vague picture.

We've decided to try a bit of an end-run around their counterintelligence screen. We know where they have a secure datastore in an area of deadspace. We're going to send you in to recover the information from the datastore, but we'll only have a short window for this, so you'll need to move quickly. Can you handle that?
messages.zh:
海军总参谋部正在策划对这个区域的一个米玛塔尔据点发动攻击，但是海军情报部门在对敌人的反情报系统进行渗透的时候遇到了一些麻烦。我们希望能够得到一些关于这个米玛塔尔目标更为准确的信息，包括联络代码，舰队部署以及他们对我们的战力预测。但是他们的反情报部门将这些文件管理得非常严密，我们的人根本没法插入。

我们决定采用一些更加直接的办法绕道他们后面进行夺取。我们知道他们放置了重兵力守卫这个死亡复合体中的数据库，我们将把你派过去夺取这份情报。机会难得，你需要尽快动身。有什么问题么？

messages.en: Blowing up some supply industrials? Sounds easy enough.
messages.zh: 击毁几艘运送补给物资的工业舰？听起来够简单的。

messages.en: I knew you would be up for it, pilot. The convoy is lightly guarded and the only important targets are their industrials. Once you destroy them, you can get out of there or mop up as needed. Just remember, because the system is contested, pod pilots working for the Minmatar may try to stop you. Be sure that your ship is set up to counter them as well.
messages.zh: 我知道你会帮忙的，飞行员。船队的防御力量很弱，首要目标是他们的工业舰。一旦摧毁了他们，你就可以回来报告了，你也可以全部消灭如果你觉得有必要的话。只是你要记住，那个星系是争夺区域，这样在那儿游荡的米玛塔尔飞行员会尝试组织你，你得要准备好对付这些人。

messages.en: Yes.
messages.zh: 是的。

messages.en:
The Minmatar are resupplying one of their relay stations in a nearby contested system-- it's due to run out soon and the convoy dispatched to resupply it hasn't arrived yet. Your job is to intercept the convoy and destroy the industrials before they have a chance to complete their mission.

The mission shouldn't be too difficult, as long as you don't encounter any pod pilots fighting for the Minmatar. You should fit your ship to defend itself from other pod pilots just in case.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔正在对他们在附近争夺区域的一座中继站进行补给——他们的燃料就要烧完了而运送补给物资的船队尚还没有抵达。你的任务就是去拦截补给护航船队并将在他们抵达目的地之前将其工业舰摧毁。

这个人物应该没有什么难度，关键的威胁来自于游荡于争夺区域的帝国飞行员。你需要好好的装配你的舰船来对抗可能出现的遭遇战。

messages.en: That station won't be seeing new supplies any time soon.
messages.zh: 那座中继站很长一段时间是看不到他们的补给船对了。

messages.en: Good work. I knew I could count on you. With that relay station out of commission, our local transmissions will be harder for the Minmatar to intercept, at least until they manage to sneak another convoy in there.
messages.zh: 干的不错，我就知道你是靠得住的。那座中继站失效过后，我们在本地的通信将会难以被米玛塔尔所截获，至少说在他们重新溜进来之前我们可以安心好些日子了。

messages.en: I can't do that for you.
messages.zh: 我不能为你干这事儿。

messages.en: Is destroying a few industrials really that difficult? I suppose I'll have to find someone else to complete this mission for me.
messages.zh: 打几艘工业舰真的就这么难么？我找别人来做这个任务好了。

messages.en:
I'm glad you're here, pilot. It's come to my attention that the Minmatar have a relay station in a nearby contested system. The station is being used to send monitor classified Empire transmissions and then transmit them back to Minmatar space, where their code-breakers can get to work figuring out what we mean. So far, we haven't had an opportunity to strike at it directly, and it's unlikely we'll get one soon.

However, we've received intelligence that the Minmatar have dispatched a convoy to resupply the station. If we can destroy that convoy, we'll hamper their spying operations for at least a short period of time.
messages.zh:
很高兴你在这儿，飞行员。米玛塔尔在附近争夺区域的一座中继站最近引起了我的注意。这座中继站专门用来监听共和国的机密频道，并将信息传送回米玛塔尔境内的接收站进行破译。到目前我们都还没有找到机会攻击它，这样下去也不是办法。

不管怎样，我们得到情报说有一队米玛塔尔船队从本土出发准备对这座中继站进行燃料补给。如果我们能摧毁这个船队的话，那我们就能给他们的情报工作带来一定程度上的打击。

messages.en: I'm afraid I have to abandon your mission.
messages.zh: 很遗憾我要放弃你的任务。

messages.en: That relay station is causing serious problems for us. I'll have to get someone else to stop them.
messages.zh: 这个中继站给我们造成了严重的危害。我得要找人去阻止他们。

messages.en: It doesn't matter what those thieves do as their day jobs, they won't get away from me!
messages.zh: 我不关心这些强盗白天都在干些啥，但绝对不会逃过我的掌心。

messages.en: Remember, the belt is in a contested system, so pod pilots working for the Republic may try to stop you. Make sure you prepare for them above all else.
messages.zh: 记住，这个矿带是位于一个争夺中的星系，所以共和国的克隆飞行员们可能会要试图攻击你。你的准备好对付这些人。

messages.en: I am always ready to earn an honest buck. Sometimes a not-so-honest one too.
messages.zh: 我总是希望赚点老实钱。虽然有时候也搞点不那么老实的。

messages.en: Some pesky miners working for the Minmatar Republic have managed to discover one of our hidden asteroid belts. This is unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. Head out there and destroy those miners, then report back to me. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the Republic.
messages.zh: 一些为米玛塔尔工作的矿工发现了我们的一个秘密的小行星带。这是不能接受的。我把坐标传送给你，你去把他们都歼灭了，然后回来向我报告。你要当心那些为共和国卖力的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: I've destroyed those miners. Our asteroids are safe for now!
messages.zh: 我消灭了那些矿工。我们的小行星带从此又恢复了宁静。

messages.en: Great. That should teach them to try to take what belongs to the Empire! Hopefully, we won't have any more problems with those miners, but knowing the Minmatar, I doubt this'll be the end of it. Oh well, we'll just send you in again if need be!
messages.zh: 很好。那应该能教会他们去拿属于帝国的东西！希望这些烦人的矿工不会再来制造麻烦了。不过你要知道米玛塔尔人，我很怀疑他们会就这么罢休。好吧，如果他们又来了我们再找你。

messages.en: I can't do that to those poor miners!
messages.zh: 我不能对那些可怜的矿工下毒手。

messages.en: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这样看来我得找别人来做了。

messages.en:
Amarr has located numerous hidden asteroid belts that we mine for the betterment of the Empire. Usually, these locations are known only to us... even if they're not technically in our sovereign space. However, it seems the Minmatar have sent some miners into one of our fields in an area of space they consider "theirs"; while we've been busy with other things, they've been sneaking in and mining our ore!

This situation is unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. I want you to go out there and destroy those miners and show them that the Empire is always watching. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the Matari scum: They're sure to be in the area.
messages.zh:
艾玛找到了我们的矿工用来为战争提供后请资源的小行星带。通常他们不会受到除了我们派去的人之外的干扰，就算他们现在并不是在共和国的空域。但是现在的情况是，米玛塔尔派遣了一些矿工到我们的一个小行星带，他们还认为这个小行星带是他们所有的；我们现在很忙，趁这个空子他们肆无忌惮的开采我们的资源！

这是不能接受的。我把坐标传送给你，你去把他们都歼灭了，然后回来向我报告。你要当心那些为帝国卖力的克隆飞行员，他们肯定会在那些区域出现。

messages.en: I'm afraid I cannot complete your mission.
messages.zh: 恐怕我不能完成你的任务。

messages.en: I'm disappointed in you. I didn't think you would have trouble.
messages.zh: 你让我失望了。我以为你不会有问题的。

messages.en: Don't worry. I'll make sure that gate stays deactivated!
messages.zh: 能。我保证能让那门永远封存起来。

messages.en:
I knew I could count on you for this. I've uploaded the location of the deadspace pocket to your NeoCom. All you need to do is head there and destroy the repair ships. The gate itself is probably too tough for you to destroy on your own. After all, that's why we left it there before.

Just remember, this gate is in a contested system. That means pod pilots flying for the Republic might try to stop you. Be careful.
messages.zh:
我就知道我能把这事托付给你。我已经把死亡空间的位置上传到了你的控制边栏里。你要做的就是赶往那里把维修船炸掉。那门靠你自己去轰可能难了点。不然我们也不会一开始就把那门留了下来。

记住，由于这门位于一个争夺星系里，因此为共和国效力的飞行员可以随时向你开火。要当心。

messages.en: Sure thing. What needs destroyed today?
messages.zh: 准备好了。今天要去哪里搞破坏？

messages.en: The Minmatar Republic has a gate hidden in a deadspace pocket. The gate has been offline for a while, and has fallen into some disrepair. Now it seems that the Republic is trying to get it back on. Head over to the gate and destroy the repair ships before they can get it back online. Oh, and be careful. We've received word that capsuleers working for the Republic have been spotted in the area.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔在一个死亡空间里有个隐蔽门。那门已经长久不用，很多地方都需要修理了。现在看起来共和国打算对它进行修复。快赶往那里，乘他们施行修复之前，把那些修理船都干掉。哦，我们获悉那里会有为共和国效力的飞行员，因此你行事要小心。

messages.en: Those repair ships were no problem. Mission accomplished.
messages.zh: 那些维修船已经不是问题了。任务完成。

messages.en: Good work. I am impressed. The Minmatar will probably think twice before trying to reactivate that gate again. I'm sure that will put a serious crimp in their plans for the area.
messages.zh: 干得好，我欣赏。米玛塔尔可能不再敢轻举妄动去重启那门了。我敢肯定，他们针对该地区的计划已经严重受挫。

messages.en: That sounds a bit tougher than I can handle.
messages.zh: 我处理这事可能有点吃力。

messages.en: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这样看来我得找别人来做了。

messages.en:
We recently discovered a hidden gate belonging to the Minmatar Republic in a nearby deadspace pocket. A capsuleer working for us managed to take the guards out some time ago, after which we then sent in forces to deactivate it. For a while, it seemed like the Republic would simply abandon the gate.

Unfortunately, that's not the case. We've detected a squad of ships heading to the gate to initiate repairs on the gate and reactivate it, probably so they can more easily move forces into the area. Luckily, it will take them quite some time to get it operational. We want you to head out there and stop them before they can. Can you handle this?
messages.zh:
我们最近在附近的一个死亡空间里发现了属于米玛塔尔共和国的一个隐蔽门。上次我们的一位飞行员成功地把守门的卫兵都干掉了，之后我们派出一支部队把那门封停了。当初看起来米玛塔尔已经有了弃门的意思。

不过实际情况并非如此。我们已经探到敌方有一支部队正前往那星门，准备修复它，然后打算重新启用该门。估计他们这样做的目的是想让自己进出更方便。所幸他们真要搞成还需要一点时间。我们要你飞往那里及时制止他们。你能接手这事吗？

messages.en: Things were tough over there! I'm going to have to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这仗太难打了！我不干了。

messages.en: Now I'll have to find someone else to stop them! I hope we still have time.
messages.zh: 那我现在必须得另寻他人来阻止他们了！但愿还来得及。

name.ru: Изменение в плане (A Change of Plan)

messages.en: Don't worry, I won't let you down.
messages.zh: 不用担心，我不会让你失望。

messages.en: See that you do not.
messages.zh: 看起来你不要做。

messages.en: That's why I'm here. What's the problem?
messages.zh: 这正是我在这儿的原因。有什么问题么。

messages.en: We've got Minmatar Republic Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there; kill that commander and any of his guards present. This should scatter their forces long enough for our own reinforcements to arrive.
messages.zh: 我们发现有一个米玛塔尔前线指挥官最近又到了我们的领地界限以内。很明显的是这样的事情通常会慢慢升级到失去控制。我们截获的对方通讯显示他们计划要巩固他们的工事，而且还有更多的船要开过来。你要过去确保这件事情不会发生。你去那儿，把那个前线指挥官干掉，还有他的守卫。这样我们将有足够的时间把增援部队调集过去。

messages.en: Mission Complete. The Field Commander and his guards have been dealt with.
messages.zh: 任务完成。前线指挥官和他的守卫都被我收拾了。

messages.en: Not bad, rookie. Not bad at all. You've a long way left to go to prove your worth however.
messages.zh: 不错啊，菜鸟，很好。但你还要继续长期努力才能证明你的价值。

messages.en: Sorry, this doesn't interest me one bit.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我完全没兴趣。

messages.en: I had a suspicion you would balk at the thought of live combat. You best sort your act out, rookie.
messages.zh: 我就猜到你可能会在真正的战斗中退缩。你最好好好思考一下，菜鸟。

messages.en: Minmatar combat units have become increasingly bold with their incursions into Amarr Empire sovereign space, even after the Elder Fleet's recent defeat at Jamyl Sarum's hands. At times, Amarr field commanders in charge of small units are not even on authorized missions; tribal vendettas and raids to recover Matari slaves are usually at the root of these sorties.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔战斗单位已开始越来越大胆的在帝国的领空肆意进行侵略活动。小型作战单位的前线指挥官已经很多次越权进行军事行动，给共和国内部的安全带来了威胁。追求个人的荣誉和私仇公报都成为这些人私自调用宇宙中最强大的海军舰队之行为的理由。即便这些问题不会成为他们内部的什么大危机，但那部落化的玛塔利却通常以为达成目的不择手段而成名。

messages.en: Tribal Priorities
messages.zh: 部落的要事

messages.en:
Nothing major, which is why you're getting the job. Prove to us you can handle this and we'll have plenty more to throw you later on. Screw up, however, and it's going on your record.

We've got a Republic Fleet Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. If we allow them room to breathe, they'll have Fleet battleships and perhaps even more entrenched in the system within a week.

You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there and kill that commander and any of his guards present. Without him calling the shots, his people will fall back to regroup, and that buys us enough time to reinforce the area properly.

Briefing's over, rookie: move your ass.
messages.zh:
没什么大不了的，正因为没什么大不了你才能拿到这个任务。如果你能证明给我们看，你完全能够处理这样的小问题的话，我们还有大把的任务可以交给你来完成。如果你给搞砸了，这也得记在你的账上。

我们发现有一个米玛塔尔前线指挥官最近又到了我们的领地界限以内。很明显的是这样的事情通常会慢慢升级到失去控制。我们截获的对方通讯显示他们计划要巩固他们的工事，而且还有更多的船要开过来。如果我们给他们喘息的机会，他们的海军战列舰就会开到甚至是在一周内占去这个系统的大部分地盘。

你去那儿，把那个前线指挥官干掉，还有他的守卫。没有他在那儿组织，他的人只能回去重新整理，这将给我们足够的时间来加强那个地区的防御，增添更多比你都有经验的飞行员。简报就到这里。

菜鸟，动起来！

messages.en: I can't finish this mission, there's too many hostiles getting in my way.
messages.zh: 我不能完成这个任务，那有太多的敌人了。

messages.en: Fine, I'll get someone more capable. A word of advice: don't repeat this display of cowardice and uselessness. We don't tolerate such a gross lack of faith in our glorious Empire.
messages.zh: 好吧，我会找个更有实力的人。给你一点建议，别再表现的像个没用的懦夫一样。我们帝国不能容忍这样的人。

messages.en: On my way!
messages.zh: 我立马出发！

messages.en: Good. Keep your comms line open, I'll be relaying further information when you give me a clear picture of the situation.
messages.zh: 很好。保持信道通畅，在你向我汇报清情况之后，我会给你下一步指令。

messages.en: I've come for work, yes.
messages.zh: 我就是来找工作的。

messages.en:
We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. Get your ass out there. I want them supported in any way possible.
messages.zh:
我们刚从在敌方领域行动的侦察队那里收到一条重要消息。他们的任务是侦察敌军，现在他们已经发现了敌人。由于他们自己无法解决敌人，他们向我们发出了增援请求。

我回复他们我们一招到合适人员就会派去增援他们，但自此以后我就一直没收到他们的回音。你尽快赶往那里，要尽一切方式帮助他们。

messages.en: I just made it back, is everything ok now?
messages.zh: 我回来了，现在一切都顺利了是不是？

messages.en: Yes, they succeeded in clearing the area of hostiles just moments ago. Good work out there rookie, keep it up.
messages.zh: 是的，他们就在刚才成功地清理了该敌区。干得不错，新人。要再接再厉。

messages.en: Oh…sorry, I won't be able to leave immediately. You better find someone else.
messages.zh: 哦……不好意思，我没法立刻动身。你最好找别人。

messages.en: Useless. Don't offer your services unless you intend to provide them wherever and whenever you are asked to!
messages.zh: 没用的家伙。除非你准备好随时随地做贡献，不然就别问别人需不需帮助！

messages.en: The life of a reconnaissance pilot is fraught with real and present danger at all times. Since even the slightest mistake can cost an entire squadron their lives, operations behind enemy lines are a task carried out by some of the most disciplined and battle-hardened pilots each empire has.
messages.zh: 特勤人员的生涯充满了危险。由于最小的错误也可能让整支队伍送命，因此深入敌后的行动一般都是由每个帝国中纪律性最强，久经沙场考验的飞行员执行的。

messages.en: A covert life.
messages.zh: 特勤生涯。

messages.en:
Alright then, I suppose I've got something for you.

We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. They've either had to maintain comms silence to avoid being detected or they've been forced to engage prematurely.

In any case, get your ass out there. Those are good men and women putting their lives on the line. I want them supported in any way possible.
messages.zh:
那好，我想我这里有适合你干的活。

我们刚从在敌方领域行动的侦察队那里收到一条重要消息。他们的任务是侦察敌军，现在他们已经发现了敌人。由于他们自己无法解决敌人，他们向我们发出了增援请求。

我回复他们我们一招到合适人员就会派去增援他们，但自此以后我就一直没收到他们的回音。他们要么就是为了不被发现而中断联系，要么就是被迫提前和敌人们干上了。

不管怎么样你都要尽快赶往那里。他们都是拿命做赌注的好同志。你尽一切方式帮助他们。

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't make it out to them after all. Sorry for the let down.
messages.zh: 我怕我没法完成该任务了。不好意思让你失望了。

messages.en: Sorry for the let down? Is that all you have to say? They're probably dead or cornered and that's all you offer me? Keep that callous attitude up and you'll find yourself barred from any further work inside our borders.
messages.zh: 不好意思让我失望？你最多就只能说这句话？他们可能已经牺牲了，而你跟我说这话？你就继续保持那冷血态度吧，然后你就再也无法在我们境内找到工作。

messages.en: They are assisting the Republic, as you said. I see no reason to decline. Give me the coordinates.
messages.zh: 他们在帮助米玛塔尔，就像你说的一样。这是不可否认的事实。把坐标给我。

messages.en: I am glad to see you understand the situation fully. Report back to me when you have finished the assignment.
messages.zh: 我很高兴你能够明白现在的状况。完成任务后回来向我报告。

messages.en: I am. Tell me how I can serve.
messages.zh: 是的。请告诉我该怎样做。

messages.en: We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Minmatar vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Republic forces. They must be dealt with.
messages.zh: 我们在附近的区域发现了一座民用设施，里面驻扎了一些工程师和技术人员，这些人都是帮助维修米玛塔尔军队的舰船的。虽然技术上来说他们只是工人，是非战斗人员，但不可否认的是他们在直接地帮助我们的敌人。他们必须要有觉悟承受这样做的后果。

messages.en: I have done as you asked, the facility has been destroyed.
messages.zh: 我已经完成你的要求了，那座设施被摧毁了。

messages.en: Excellent work, rookie. There is hope for you yet. You have proven today that you understand the realities of the conflict ahead. Your loyalty and faith will not go unnoticed.
messages.zh: 干得很棒，菜鸟。看来你还有希望。所今天所做的证明了你对眼前争夺的实质还是明白的。你的忠心不会被忽略的。

messages.en: I don't care what the circumstances are; I will not be a party in the murder of civilians.
messages.zh: 我不关心现在的环境；我不会参与对平民的伤害的。

messages.en: Your very refusal has assured that you will be. If you think those ships they repair do not target civilian structures of our own then you are a fool. I will get someone else for the job, your short-sighted and confused morality changes nothing except our perceptions of your worth to our cause.
messages.zh: 你的拒绝是很愚蠢的。你真的以为这些被修好的舰船不会拿我们自己的平民当靶子吗？你这个笨蛋。我会找别的人来完成这个任务，你短浅的眼光和模糊的道德标准除了让你的忠诚受到伤害之外没有什么用处了。

messages.en: In a time of war, there are very few people who will not find themselves caught in the crossfire. Civilians and non-combatants who directly assist armed forces are invariably seen as valid targets – no empire will risk letting their efforts go unhindered. In such dark times, necessity always takes precedent over morality.
messages.zh: 在战争的年代，只有很少人是处在没有战火的地方。那些帮助武装力量的平民和非战斗人员永远都是合法的目标，没有任何一个国家会忽视这种力量。在这样一个黑暗的时代，利益驱使的必要性总是会战胜纠结于灵魂之中的道德。

messages.en: Dark times.
messages.zh: 黑暗的年代。

messages.en:
The task I have for you today is an important one. It is significant not only in strategic terms, but also a test of your loyalty.

We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Minmatar vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Republic forces. They must be dealt with.

Fortunately for us, there is a small window of opportunity where we can strike at them. Repaired ships that are awaiting further deployment usually stand on guard at the facility. However, the large majority of them have been recalled to another higher priority assignment. We have a chance to strike here, rookie. Will you help the Empire?
messages.zh:
今天我要给你的任务是非常重要的。不光光是战术上的重要性，而也是对你的忠诚的考验。

我们在附近的区域发现了一座民用设施，里面驻扎了一些工程师和技术人员，这些人都是帮助维修米玛塔尔军队的舰船的。虽然技术上来说他们只是工人，是非战斗人员，但不可否认的是他们在直接地帮助我们的敌人。他们必须要有觉悟承受这样做的后果。

幸运的是，我有一个机会可以直接的袭击他们。被维修好的舰船在重新被分配任务之前会充当这个维修站的防御力量。但是，他们大部分被派遣出去执行另外一项更高优先级的任务了。这给我们带来了一个机会，新人，你愿意帮助帝国完成这项任务么？

messages.en: I've changed my mind. I cannot do what you've asked of me.
messages.zh: 我改变主意了。我不能做这事儿。

messages.en: Then you are of no use to us. Save me your confused ramblings on morality, we have a war to win here and I will do what it takes to serve that end.
messages.zh: 这样的话你对我们就没用了。把你的道德言论收起来吧，我们有一场战争要去赢，这终将是一场不择手段的争夺。

messages.en: Blowing up a reactor is what I've been dreaming of! Count me in.
messages.zh: 我做梦都想要把哪个反应堆给炸掉玩玩！算我一个。

messages.en: Good deal. I've uploaded the location to your NeoCom. There will be some defenses there, but they shouldn't be too difficult for you. However, pod pilots working for the Republic may be flying in the area. Prepare yourself to face them.
messages.zh: 不错。我正在把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中。你可能会在那儿遭到一些抵抗，但对你来说这应该不会太难。只是你要注意的是共和国的飞行员可能也在附近徘徊，你要对此有所准备。

messages.en: Whatever you've got, I can take it on.
messages.zh: 不管是什么，我都能解决。

messages.en:
The Minmatar Republic is trying to set up a starbase inside one of the contested systems. If they manage to get it up and running, they'll have a staging point from which to launch further attacks against us. Luckily, it is not yet fully operational and has a highly explosive reactor that is just waiting to be destroyed.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Head over there and destroy the reactor. Just watch out for the pod pilots working for the Republic. They will try to stop you if they can.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔共和国试图在一个争夺区域中设立一个空间站。如果他们能够成功的话，他们就有了一个把战线朝我们进一步推进的跳板。幸运的事，这个母星还没有完全的进入运转，并且有一个高爆炸危险的反应堆在那儿等着我们去把他轰掉。

我已经把坐标地点上传到你的控制边栏中了。你前去把反应堆炸掉然后回来向我报告。你要注意可能再附近出现的敌方克隆飞行员，他们一定会尝试阻止你。

messages.en: I've destroyed the reactor and the starbase went up like an Emperor's Birthday celebration!
messages.zh: 我已经炸毁了那个反应堆，整个空间站就像皇帝陛下生日的烟火一样炫丽！

messages.en: Excellent work. I wish I could have been there to see that thing go. I bet it was quite a display! Hopefully, this will set the Minmatar back and make them hesitate before trying to set up a starbase here again!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。真希望我也能在场观看，这肯定是一场精彩的表演！希望这能够给米玛塔尔人带来点教训让他们想要再在这儿搞一个空间站的时候能够三思而后行。

messages.en: Whoa, maybe I can't take that on.
messages.zh: 行了，我可能做不了这个。

messages.en: Don't you think you can handle this?
messages.zh: 你不认为你能对付得了么？

messages.en:
Those damn Minmatar. Always up to something sneaky. Thankfully we've enough spies in their midst to keep them from pulling off anything too big. One of those spies just reported that the Republic is trying to construct a starbase inside a nearby contested system.

A fully functioning starbase can cause us a huge headache. They're tough and require a lot of manpower to destroy. Because of our spies we have a first strike advantage. The starbase hasn't been completed yet, and the idiot Minmatar have filled their main reactor full of fuel.

If you head over there and destroy the reactor, the entire starbase will blow. Do you think you can do this for me?
messages.zh:
这些可恶的米玛塔尔人。总是喜欢干这种偷鸡摸狗的事情。庆幸我们有足够的间谍渗透在他们之中把所有的信息都能够传送回来。我们的一个间谍报告说共和国正试图在附近的一个争夺区域建设一个母星。

一个全面运转的母星将给我们带来严重的威胁，而这些建筑又非常坚固而且需要非常多的人力去摧毁。这座母星还没有完成，而那些愚昧的米玛塔尔人却已经把足够多的燃料运送过去，活生生的把他们的反应堆塞成了一个爆炸物筒。

如果你过去把这个反应堆摧毁的话，剧烈的爆炸会把整个母星变成尘埃。你认为你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: That starbase reactor was tougher than I expected.
messages.zh: 那个母星反应堆比我想象的要坚固的多。

messages.en: I suppose I can send someone else to finish the job.
messages.zh: 我看来只好找别人来完成这个任务了。

messages.en: Just leave it to me, {[character]agentID.name}. I'll catch those smugglers.
messages.zh: 交给我好了，{[character]agentID.name}。我会逮住那帮非法贩售者的。

messages.en: Excellent. Good hunting out there, {[character]player.name}. Keep an eye out for anyone that might come to their aid; you don't want to be caught in an ambush.
messages.zh: 太好了。祝你顺利，{[character]player.name}。当心任何可能对他们提供援助的人；你不想遭埋伏吧？

messages.en: I might be. What's the job?
messages.zh: 也许。是什么样的事情？

messages.en: We need you to intercept a possible group of smugglers trying to get out of the State with some military-grade sensor components in secure storage containers. You'll need to fly to the intercept point and wait for our signal. If it's the right ship, we want you to disable the vessel and take possession of the cargo and crew. Bring them back to your agent, and he'll turn them over to the proper authorities.
messages.zh: 有一群非法贩售者在安全货柜里窝藏了些军用级别的感应器组件，他们打算把它们带出加达里领域。我们要你去把他们截下来。你要飞往拦截点，等我信号。如果确实来了艘非法贩售船，那你就把它打废，把货柜中的东西放到你自己船里。然后把它们交给代理人，他会把它们递交给相关部门。

messages.en: I managed to catch the smugglers and capture their cargo. Had to deal with a few miscreants along the way, though.
messages.zh: 我抓住了那些非法贩售者，把他们的货物也抢来了。顺便还处理掉了一些小喽罗。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. You handled that admirably; I've got another mission for you, if you're interested. Just let me know when you're ready.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。你处理地很得体。你有兴趣的话我还有事情让你做。准备好后跟我说一声。

messages.en: I don't really feel like playing the State's meter maid today.
messages.zh: 我今天不想当国家值勤人员。

messages.en: Well, sorry it's not your cup of tea, but someone's got to do it, after all. I'll see if I can't find something more your speed for next time.
messages.zh: 好吧，也许这活儿不合你胃口，但这事总得有人来做。我下次给你找点更刺激的活干。

messages.en: The CCA is a division of the Caldari Business Tribunal, which is the only nationwide law enforcement agency in the Caldari State. The CCA is in charge of policing trade at the borders of Caldari space and enforcing any customs duties or tariffs, though the State generally has few of those with both the Liberal and Practical factions both being free trade advocates. However, the CCA tends to be short-staffed, despite being adequately funded, and as a result they often outsource customs duties to the Navy or corporate security forces, who will in turn sometimes subcontract to individual pod-pilots. In general, customs duties are a low priority (and sometimes an obstruction) for many of the Caldari megacorporations' operations, so they tend to be pushed upon pilots and officers towards the low end of the totem pole.
messages.zh: 加达里商业法庭是加达里合众国里唯一的全国性法律执行机构，而加达里海关局便是其中的一个部门。虽然在加达里中，很少有自由派和务实派联手鼓吹自由贸易，但该局主要还是负责管理边境贸易及施行关税。尽管资金来源充足，海关局却一直有人员短缺的现象。由此他们经常将海关任务外包给海军或者军团的保安力量，这些机构有时又会将这些任务承包给个体飞行员。一般来说，在加达里许多超级军团眼里，海关任务重要性不高（有时还是绊脚石），因此承接那些活儿的一般都是些地位不高的飞行员。

messages.en: Caldari Customs Authority
messages.zh: 加达里海关局

messages.en: I've been asked to help the Customs Authority apprehend a group of smugglers trying to get some military-grade sensor components out of the State where they can sell them to the highest bidder. They've sent us a list of possible targets and we've been tracking them; one of the suspect vessels has just entered our jurisdiction. I'd like you to intercept this ship; once you're there, we'll let you know if that's the one we're looking for. If it is, you'll need to disable the vessel, apprehend the crew, and confiscate the sensor components, which are being carried in small secure containers. Can you handle that for me?
messages.zh: 最近有一群非法贩售者试图将军用级别的感应器组件偷运出合众国境内，然后卖给高价购买者。海关局要求我出面解决他们。他们已经给我列出了目标对象，我最近也一直在跟踪他们；其中有艘嫌疑船只已经进入了我们的管辖范围。我要你去把它拦下来。一旦你到达那里，我们就会告诉你那艘船是否是我们要袭击的目标。如果它是，你就去把它给打废，清洗掉里面的船员，然后没收装箱在小型安全货柜里的感应器组件。你能帮我处理这事吗？

messages.en: I couldn't hold this mission for you any longer, {[character]player.name}; those smugglers were going to get away if we didn't do something and fast. Next time, please let me know if you're going to be able to help or not; we managed to catch them this time, but it won't always work out that way.
messages.zh: 我没法再让这任务等你了，{[character]player.name}；如果我们再不行动，那帮非法贩售者就要全溜走了。下次你最好提前向我坦白你到底能不能帮忙；虽然这次我们把他们抓住了，但事情不会永远这么顺利。

messages.en: Smugglers apprehended
messages.zh: 被清剿的非法贩售者

messages.en: I'm not going to have time to take care of this penny-ante business, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我没空处理这些鸡毛蒜皮的事，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Unfortunate. Those smugglers will be selling those sensor components on the black market soon enough, I'm sure. We'll have to find some other way to deal with this.
messages.zh: 真倒霉。我相信那帮非法贩售者很快就会在黑市上倒卖那些感应器组件了。我们必须找到对付此事的其他办法。

messages.en: I'll take care of it, no problem.
messages.zh: 交给我吧，没问题。

messages.en: Glad to hear it. I'll see you when you return.
messages.zh: 听你这样的回答让人觉得爽快。等你回来。

messages.en: What's the job?
messages.zh: 什么事？

messages.en: We've been asked by the Customs Authority to intercept a transport ship that has been tracked coming from the Amarr Empire that they believe is carrying a cargo of slaves, which is of course illegal here in the State. They have intelligence that this ship may be linked to a splinter sect of the Blood Raider cults, so you'll need to keep a lookout for trouble when you're trying to apprehend them.
messages.zh: 我们注意到有一艘艾玛帝国的满载劳工的运输船过境，这在合众国里当然是违法的，因此海关局要求我们去把它拦下来。有情报称这船可能和血袭者的一个分支有勾结，因此你在袭击它的时候要当心。

messages.en: I've recovered the slave cargo, {[character]agentID.name}, and it looks like the ship did belong to the Blood Raiders. They've been dealt with.
messages.zh: 我把劳工装箱带回来了，{[character]agentID.name}，那船看上去确实是属于血袭者的。我已经把他们解决了。

messages.en: Excellent work. You've helped us smash a dangerous cult of Blood Raiders; against such a dangerous menace, every small victory helps.
messages.zh: 干得真棒。你帮我们粉碎了血袭者的一个危险分支；面对这样一个危险的敌人，每一次小胜都是重要的奠基。

messages.en: Blood Raiders? I don't think this is really my line of work. I'll pass.
messages.zh: 血袭者？这活儿不适合我干。我闪了。

messages.en: Someone has to do it, and not every mission is an easy one. In the future, I hope you'll realize the obligation that we all have to do our small part for the State.
messages.zh: 事情总得有人干，不是每项任务都能轻松完成。我希望你将来能意识到我们每个人对合众国的义务。

messages.en: The Cult of the Lash is a splinter sect of the Blood Raiders. The center of their belief is that the amount of pain and suffering in the universe is a constant, and that therefore they must inflict as much pain on others to reduce the amount of suffering visited upon the rest of humanity, especially themselves. Their most frequent victims are captured crews and slaves from their raids upon Amarr colonies, due to their special contempt for the Amarr faith, but they have been expanding their raids into other areas of the cluster. Like the main Blood Raider cult, the Cult of Lash actually has small groups of adherents secreted away in almost every region of the cluster, practicing in secret on kidnapped members of dispossessed classes.
messages.zh: 拉什分支是血袭者的一个分支机构。他们的核心信念是，宇宙中的痛苦是一个恒定量，因此他们必须尽量将痛苦强加在别人身上，以减轻其他人，尤其是他们自己，身上所遭受的痛苦。由于他们对艾玛信仰的特殊鄙视，他们最喜欢去艾玛殖民地上搞破坏。但最近他们已经将触角伸向了其他地方。像血袭者主机构一样，拉什分支在每个星域里几乎都散落了一小群地下教徒，暗自行教。

messages.en: The Cult of the Lash
messages.zh: 拉什分支

messages.en: We've been asked by the Customs Authority to intercept a transport ship that has been tracked coming from the Amarr Empire that they believe is carrying a cargo of slaves, which is of course illegal here in the State. They have intelligence that this ship may be linked to a splinter sect of the Blood Raider cults, so you'll need to keep a lookout for trouble when you're trying to apprehend them. Think you can handle this for me?
messages.zh: 我们注意到有一艘艾玛帝国的满载劳工的运输船过境，这在合众国里当然是违法的，因此海关局要求我们去把它拦下来。有情报称这船可能和血袭者的一个分支有勾结，因此你在袭击它的时候要当心。你觉得你能对付吗？

messages.en: If you aren't going to get back to me, pilot, you give me no choice but to turn to other pilots to take care of my jobs. Thankfully, the pilot I selected for this mission managed to take care of the job with aplomb-- she broke up the Blood Raider cult behind this smuggling operation. Next time, please let me know if you won't be able to take care of the job promptly, instead of letting me hang.
messages.zh: 飞行员，如果你就这样调头走的话，那我就非得找他人来打理这事了。谢天谢地，我找来的飞行员成功地解决了这事——她对非法贩售行动的幕后指使血袭者给了一记重拳。下次如果你无法迅速完成任务就提前通知我，不要再让我傻等。

messages.en: Blood Raider cult broken up
messages.zh: 血袭者分支被粉碎

messages.en: On second thought, I've decided I'm not interested in being the Customs Authority's errand boy.
messages.zh: 我又想了一下，我发觉我没兴趣为海关局当跑腿的。

messages.en: Great things come from many small deeds. Hopefully someday you'll realize that.
messages.zh: 千里之行，积于跬步。希望有天你能明白这点。

name.ru: Нож в горле (Knife in the Throat)

messages.en: That relay is as good as gone.
messages.zh: 那座中继塔已经完蛋了。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, get out of there as quickly as you can. Reinforcements will probably be sent to the area as soon as the thing goes down.
messages.zh: 很好。一旦你摧毁了那座中继塔就迅速的从那儿离开，敌人的增援部队可能随时抵达。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
The Gallente have deployed a series of tactical FTL relays along the front lines in order to coordinate their operations. Naval Intelligence has located one nearby-- it's being used to stage raids against our convoys. Unfortunately, no regular naval forces are available for a fast strike, so we're looking to you to take care of this for us.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Gallente Tactical Relay, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
盖伦特在战区的前沿部署了一系列的超光速通讯中继塔用于组织对我们的进攻。海军情报部门已经定位了一座用来协调攻击我方补给船队的战术中继塔。但目前我们的人员紧张，没法抽调常规部队来完成这次攻击，所以我们正在找像你这样的飞行员帮助我们完成这个任务。

飞到指定的地点，寻找并摧毁艾玛战术中继塔，然后回来向你的代理人报告。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. This should take a bit of pressure off our supply convoys. I'll make sure command realizes your contribution.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮，飞行员。这能让我们的补给船队承受的压力得到一些减轻。我会让指挥部的人知道你的功劳的。

messages.en: Sounds a bit small-time to me.  I think I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 听起来不像是我的风格。我想我还是不要做这个了。

messages.en: Not every mission is glory and fame, pilot.  Total victory is but an amalgam of many small, seemingly insignificant victories; that's something you will need to learn eventually.
messages.zh: 并不是每个任务都会是那么风光的，飞行员。最终的胜利是来自于很多像这样不那么重大的胜利共同组成的。这些你最后都会明白。

messages.en:
As you're probably aware, in order to coordinate military operations at the front lines, the Gallente have deployed a series of FTL communications relays at the edge of the forward line of battle. Eliminating these communications relays and throwing a wrench into enemy operations has been made a top priority by the general staff.

Naval Intelligence has been able to locate one of these tactical relays being used to coordinate raids on our shipping. Right now, it is only lightly defended, but we don't have any forces available to take it out. I've been asked to look for capsuleers like yourself to eliminate the relay. Think you're up for it?
messages.zh:
你可能已经知道了，为了配合前线的军事行动，盖伦特在战区的前沿部署了一系列的超光速通讯中继塔。为使敌人的通讯指挥系统陷入瘫痪，破坏这些中继站成为了我们总参部目前的首要目标。

海军情报部门已经定位了一座用来协调攻击我方补给船队的战术中继塔。目前，它的防御尚还较为薄弱，但即便这样我们也没有足够的人手调配出来组织这次攻击。我正在寻找能够完成这个任务的克隆飞行员，就像你这样的，去摧毁这座中继塔。你认为你能行么？

messages.en: He's as good as dead.
messages.zh: 死亡是他最好的归宿。

messages.en: Excellent. I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Remember, this commander is an expert at surprise attacks, so don't let him sneak up on you.
messages.zh: 很好。我期待你回音。注意，这司令是偷袭战的老手，你可要时刻提防着。

messages.en:
Caldari forces in this sector have been taking heavy losses from enemy hit and run attacks on our fleets, damaging morale and stalling our offensives. Naval Intelligence believes that these attacks are being masterminded by the local Gallente sector commander, and has determined that our best option for ending these attacks is to eliminate him.

We have located a staging point that the sector commander is using for these attacks. You need to fly to these coordinates and wait for the commander and his escort to arrive, then eliminate him. Be aware that you may need to engage multiple groups of enemy forces while waiting, so be prepared for a protracted battle. Return to your agent when the sector commander has been destroyed.
messages.zh:
加达里部队在此地区遭到了敌人重创，士气受损，进攻也停滞不前。海军情报部门相信，这些袭击的幕后指使是本地的盖伦特地区司令，而结束袭击的最好方法就是把他除掉。

我们已经找到了该司令的部队纠集地。你要做的就是飞往那里，守株待兔，他一出现就把他干掉。注意在他来到之前，你可能要先被迫与多批敌人部队交火，因此要作好打持久战的准备。那司令死了后就速回代理人那里汇报。

messages.en: I've eliminated the sector commander.
messages.zh: 我已经把那地区司令干掉了。

messages.en: Great work, pilot. We'll make sure that word of your victory is spread to the rest of our forces; that should help morale more than you can realize.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。我会把这条好消息通报全军的；这真是一条令人振奋的消息啊。

messages.en:
We've been taking some heavy losses in the last few weeks along this area of the front. An enemy frigate squadron has been hitting our ships hard, taking out stragglers and scouts and then fading into space before we can counterattack, and it's starting to take its toll not only on our physical resources but an even heavier one on our morale. Our captains are getting too cautious, too unwilling to push for gains, and our general staff is getting concerned that the front will be stalled because of this. This is unacceptable.

Naval Intelligence believes that the person behind these attacks is the local Gallente sector commander. Eliminating him will hopefully end these attacks, give our forces a morale boost, and shift the momentum in this sector back to our side. Because of our problems with morale, we aren't sure that regular naval forces can handle this job; we'd like you to deal with this problem for us.

We've located a rendezvous point that this commander is going to be using for staging his next series of raids. You will need to fly there, eliminate his ship, and then report in. There will likely be a significant enemy presence there aside from the sector commander and his direct escort, so be prepared for a protracted battle.
messages.zh:
过去几周我们在此前线地区遭到了重创。敌方的一支护卫舰队伍对我们施行了猛烈打击，抓走我们侦察队的人，然后在我们实施反击前又退缩了回去。他们不仅在身体上让我们受打击，在精神上也极大地压制了我们。我们的舰长也变得胆小慎微起来，不敢大举进攻，大家都开始担心前线的推进将会就此打住。这是无法令人接受的。

海军情报部门相信，这些袭击的幕后指使是本地的盖伦特地区司令。把他灭掉就可以停止这些袭击，还可以提升我军士气，另外也能让该地区的形势朝对我们有利的方向发展。但由于现在军队士气低落，因此我们对让常规海军部队完成此项任务并没把握；我想让你来帮我们这个忙。

我们已经找到了该司令将要发动下一次袭击的集合点。你就是要飞过去把他干掉，然后回来报告。那里除了司令员本身及他的随从之外，还可能会有其他大量敌舰，因此要作好打持久战的准备。

messages.en: I'll leave immediately.
messages.zh: 我马上就出发。

messages.en: Good. Return here as soon as you get the data.
messages.zh: 很好，拿到数据后尽快返回这里。

messages.en:
The Navy is planning a new offensive against Federation positions, but State Intelligence has been unable to make headway getting the information necessary to plan a coordinated strike. In order to get the intelligence we need, we're going to need you to make a raid on a secure enemy datastore.

You'll need to jump into the deadspace area, eliminate the defenders, and recover the Tactical Information Sheet from the datastore. Once you've got it, bring it back to your agent so that State Intelligence can analyze it in preparation for the offensive.
messages.zh:
海军正在策划对联邦的目标进行一次攻击，但是海军情报部门还没有能够得到这次攻击计划制定之中所需的关键情报。为了能够得到这份情报，我们需要你去袭击一座敌人的数据储藏中心。

你需要跃迁进入到一个死亡空间复合体里面，消灭所有的反抗者，然后再从数据中心找到战术情报文件。一旦得手，马上带回来给你的代理人，这样海军情报部门就能立即对情报进行分析制定作战计划。

messages.en: I think I've found what you were looking for. Is this it?
messages.zh: 我想我已经拿到你要找的东西，是这个么？

messages.en: Nice work, pilot. I'll pass this up the chain to Naval Intelligence. Drinks are on us tonight.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮，飞行员，我会把这个发布到海军情报系统里面去。今晚的酒钱我们买单了。

messages.en: Sounds pretty dicey. I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 听起来很冒险。

messages.en: This war isn't going to get any easier, pilot.  You'd better start thinking whether or not you're really cut out for this line of work.
messages.zh: 这场仗不会好过的，飞行员。你应该好好想想你到底要不要参与进来。

messages.en:
The Navy's general staff is planning an offensive against Gallente positions in this sector, but Naval Intelligence is having difficulty piercing the veil of enemy counterintelligence. Optimally, we'd like to get a better idea of Gallente positions, communications codes, fleet readiness and their own intelligence estimates of our disposition, but they've been working hard to keep us from getting our hands on anything more than a vague picture.

We've decided to try a bit of an end-run around their counterintelligence screen. We know where they have a secure datastore in an area of deadspace. We're going to send you in to recover the information from the datastore, but we'll only have a short window for this, so you'll need to move quickly. Can you handle that?
messages.zh:
海军总参谋部正在策划对这个区域的一个盖伦特据点发动攻击，但是海军情报部门在对敌人的反情报系统进行渗透的时候遇到了一些麻烦。我们希望能够得到一些关于这个盖伦特目标更为准确的信息，包括联络代码，舰队部署以及他们对我们的战力预测。但是他们的反情报部门将这些文件管理得非常严密，我们的人根本没法插入。

我们决定采用一些更加直接的办法绕道他们后面进行夺取。我们知道他们放置了重兵力守卫这个死亡复合体中的数据库，我们将把你派过去夺取这份情报。机会难得，你需要尽快动身。有什么问题么？

messages.en: Blowing up some supply industrials? Sounds easy enough.
messages.zh: 击毁几艘运送补给物资的工业舰？听起来够简单的。

messages.en: I knew you would be up for it, pilot. The convoy is lightly guarded and the only important targets are their industrials. Once you destroy them, you can get out of there or mop up as needed. Just remember, because the system is contested, pod pilots working for the Gallente may try to stop you. Be sure that your ship is set up to counter them as well.
messages.zh: 我知道你会帮忙的，飞行员。船队的防御力量很弱，首要目标是他们的工业舰。一旦摧毁了他们，你就可以回来报告了，你也可以全部消灭如果你觉得有必要的话。只是你要记住，那个星系是争夺区域，这样在那儿游荡的盖伦特飞行员会尝试组织你，你得要准备好对付这些人。

messages.en: How may I serve?
messages.zh: 我能怎样为您效力呢？

messages.en:
The Gallente are resupplying one of their relay stations in a nearby contested system-- it's due to run out soon and the convoy dispatched to resupply it hasn't arrived yet. Your job is to intercept the convoy and destroy the industrials before they have a chance to complete their mission.

The mission shouldn't be too difficult, as long as you don't encounter any pod pilots fighting for the Gallente. You should fit your ship to defend itself from other pod pilots just in case.
messages.zh:
盖伦特正在对他们在附近争夺区域的一座中继站进行补给——他们的燃料就要烧完了而运送补给物资的船队尚还没有抵达。你的任务就是去拦截补给护航船队并将在他们抵达目的地之前将其工业舰摧毁。

这个人物应该没有什么难度，关键的威胁来自于游荡于争夺区域的帝国飞行员。你需要好好的装配你的舰船来对抗可能出现的遭遇战。

messages.en: That station won't be seeing new supplies any time soon.
messages.zh: 那座中继站很长一段时间是看不到他们的补给船对了。

messages.en: Good work. I knew I could count on you. With that relay station out of commission, our local transmissions will be harder for the Gallente to intercept, at least until they manage to sneak another convoy in there.
messages.zh: 干的不错，我就知道你是靠得住的。那座中继站失效过后，我们在本地的通信将会难以被盖伦特所截获，至少说在他们重新溜进来之前我们可以安心好些日子了。

messages.en: I can't do that for you.
messages.zh: 我不能为你干这事儿。

messages.en: Is destroying a few industrials really that difficult? I suppose I'll have to find someone else to complete this mission for me.
messages.zh: 打几艘工业舰真的就这么难么？我找别人来做这个任务好了。

messages.en:
I'm glad you're here, pilot. It's come to my attention that the Gallente have a relay station in a nearby contested system. The station is being used to monitor classified State transmissions and then transmit them back to Gallente space, where their code-breakers can get to work figuring out what we mean. So far, we haven't had an opportunity to strike at it directly, and it's unlikely we'll get one soon.

However, we've received intelligence that the Gallente have dispatched a convoy to resupply the station. If we can destroy that convoy, we'll hamper their spying operations for at least a short period of time.
messages.zh:
很高兴你在这儿，飞行员。盖伦特在附近争夺区域的一座中继站最近引起了我的注意。这座中继站专门用来监听共和国的机密频道，并将信息传送回盖伦特境内的接收站进行破译。到目前我们都还没有找到机会攻击它，这样下去也不是办法。

不管怎样，我们得到情报说有一队盖伦特船队从本土出发准备对这座中继站进行燃料补给。如果我们能摧毁这个船队的话，那我们就能给他们的情报工作带来一定程度上的打击。

messages.en: I'm afraid I have to abandon your mission.
messages.zh: 很遗憾我要放弃你的任务。

messages.en: That relay station is causing serious problems for us. I'll have to get someone else to stop them.
messages.zh: 这个中继站给我们造成了严重的危害。我得要找人去阻止他们。

messages.en: It doesn't matter what those thieves do as their day jobs, they won't get away from me!
messages.zh: 我不关心这些强盗白天都在干些啥，但绝对不会逃过我的掌心。

messages.en: Remember, the belt is in a contested system, so pod pilots working for the Federation may try to stop you. Make sure you prepare for them above all else.
messages.zh: 记住，这个矿带是位于一个争夺中的星系，所以联邦的克隆飞行员们可能会要试图攻击你。你的准备好对付这些人。

messages.en: I am always ready to earn an honest buck. Sometimes a not-so-honest one too.
messages.zh: 我总是希望赚点老实钱。虽然有时候也搞点不那么老实的。

messages.en: Some pesky miners working for the Gallente Federation have managed to discover one of our hidden asteroid belts. This is unacceptable.
