I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. Head out there and destroy those miners, then report back to me. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the Federation.
messages.zh: 一些为盖伦特工作的矿工发现了我们的一个秘密的小行星带。这是不能接受的。我把坐标传送给你，你去把他们都歼灭了，然后回来向我报告。你要当心那些为联邦卖力的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: I've destroyed those miners. Our asteroids are safe for now!
messages.zh: 我消灭了那些矿工。我们的小行星带从此又恢复了宁静。

messages.en: Great. That should teach them to try to take what belongs to the State! Hopefully, we won't have any more problems with those pesky miners, but knowing the Gallente, I doubt this'll be the end of it. Oh well, we'll just send you in again if need be!
messages.zh: 很好。那应该能教会他们去偷加达里的东西！希望这些烦人的矿工不会再来制造麻烦了。不过你要知道盖伦特人，我很怀疑他们会就这么罢休。好吧，如果他们又来了我们再找你。

messages.en: I can't do that to those poor miners!
messages.zh: 我不能对那些可怜的矿工下毒手。

messages.en: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这样看来我得找别人来做了。

messages.en:
The State has numerous asteroid belts secreted away, from which our miners provide resources for the war effort. Usually, these sites don't get touched by anyone except us and the companies we contract out to mine them. However, it seems the Gallente have recently sent some miners in to steal our asteroids. This is unacceptable.

I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. I want you to go out there and destroy those miners; show them that we're always vigilant. Just be ready for any Federation-sponsored pod pilots: They've been reported in the area.
messages.zh:
加达里找到了我们的矿工用来为战争提供后请资源的小行星带。通常他们不会受到除了我们派去的人之外的干扰，就算他们现在并不是在共和国的空域。但是现在的情况是，盖伦特派遣了一些矿工到我们的一个小行星带，他们还认为这个小行星带是他们所有的；我们现在很忙，趁这个空子他们肆无忌惮的开采我们的资源！

这是不能接受的。我把坐标传送给你，你去把他们都歼灭了，告诉他们我们时刻都是准备好的，然后回来向我报告。你要当心那些为联邦卖力的克隆飞行员，他们肯定会在那些区域出现。

messages.en: I'm afraid I cannot complete your mission.
messages.zh: 恐怕我不能完成你的任务。

messages.en: I'm disappointed in you. I didn't think you would have trouble.
messages.zh: 你让我失望了。我以为你不会有问题的。

messages.en: Don't worry. I'll make sure that gate stays deactivated!
messages.zh: 能。我保证能让那门永远封存起来。

messages.en:
I knew I could count on you for this. I've uploaded the location of the deadspace pocket to your NeoCom. All you need to do is head there and destroy the repair ships. The gate itself is probably too tough for you to destroy on your own. After all, that's why we left it there before.

Just remember, this gate is in a contested system. That means pod pilots flying for the Federation might try to stop you. Be careful.
messages.zh:
我就知道我能把这事托付给你。我已经把死亡空间的位置上传到了你的控制边栏里。你要做的就是赶往那里把维修船炸掉。那门靠你自己去轰可能难了点。不然我们也不会一开始就把那门留了下来。

记住，由于这门位于一个争夺星系里，因此为联邦效力的飞行员可以随时向你开火。要当心。

messages.en: Sure thing. What needs destroyed today?
messages.zh: 准备好了。今天要去哪里搞破坏？

messages.en: The Gallente Federation has a gate hidden in a deadspace pocket. The gate has been offline for a while, and has fallen into some disrepair. Now it seems that the Federation is trying to get it back on. Head over to the gate and destroy the repair ships before they can get it back online. Oh, and be careful. We've received word that capsuleers working for the Federation have been spotted in the area.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦在一个死亡空间里有个隐蔽门。那门已经长久不用，很多地方都需要修理了。现在看起来联邦打算对它进行修复。快赶往那里，乘他们施行修复之前，把那些修理船都干掉。哦，我们获悉那里会有为联邦效力的飞行员，因此你行事要小心。

messages.en: Those repair ships were no problem. Mission accomplished.
messages.zh: 那些维修船已经不是问题了。任务完成。

messages.en: Good work. I am impressed. The Gallente will probably think twice before trying to reactivate that gate again. I'm sure that will put a serious crimp in their plans for the area.
messages.zh: 干得好，我欣赏。盖伦特可能不再敢轻举妄动去重启那门了。我敢肯定，他们针对该地区的计划已经严重受挫。

messages.en: That sounds a bit tougher than I can handle.
messages.zh: 我处理这事可能有点吃力。

messages.en: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这样看来我得找别人来做了。

messages.en:
We recently discovered a hidden gate belonging to the Gallente Federation in a nearby deadspace pocket. A capsuleer working for us managed to take the guards out some time ago, after which we then sent in forces to deactivate it. For a while, it seemed like the Federation would simply abandon the gate.

Unfortunately, that's not the case. We've detected a squad of ships heading to the gate to initiate repairs on the gate and reactivate it, probably so they can more easily move forces into the area. Luckily, it will take them quite some time to get it operational. We want you to head out there and stop them before they can. Can you handle this?
messages.zh:
我们最近在附近的一个死亡空间里发现了属于盖伦特联邦的一个隐蔽门。上次我们的一位飞行员成功地把守门的卫兵都干掉了，之后我们派出一支部队把那门封停了。当初看起来联邦已经有了弃门的意思。

不过实际情况并非如此。我们已经探到敌方有一支部队正前往那星门，准备修复它，然后打算重新启用该门。估计他们这样做的目的是想让自己进出更方便。所幸他们真要搞成还需要一点时间。我们要你飞往那里及时制止他们。你能接手这事吗？

messages.en: Things were tough over there! I'm going to have to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这仗太难打了！我不干了。

messages.en: Now I'll have to find someone else to stop them! I hope we still have time.
messages.zh: 那我现在必须得另寻他人来阻止他们了！但愿还来得及。

name.ru: Изменение в плане (A Change of Plan)

messages.en: Don't worry, I won't let you down.
messages.zh: 不用担心，我不会让你失望。

messages.en: See that you do not.
messages.zh: 看起来你不要做。

messages.en: That's why I'm here. What's the problem?
messages.zh: 这正是我在这儿的原因。有什么问题么。

messages.en: We've got a Federation Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there; kill that commander and any of his guards present. This should scatter their forces long enough for our own reinforcements to arrive.
messages.zh: 我们发现有一个联邦海军前线指挥官最近又到了我们的领地界限以内。很明显的是这样的事情通常会慢慢升级到失去控制。我们截获的对方通讯显示他们计划要巩固他们的工事，而且还有更多的船要开过来。你要过去确保这件事情不会发生。你去那儿，把那个前线指挥官干掉，还有他的守卫。这样我们将有足够的时间把增援部队调集过去。

messages.en: Mission Complete. The Field Commander and his guards have been dealt with.
messages.zh: 任务完成。前线指挥官和他的守卫都被我收拾了。

messages.en: Not bad, rookie. Not bad at all. You've a long way left to go to prove your worth, however.
messages.zh: 不错啊，菜鸟，很好。但你还要继续长期努力才能证明你的价值。

messages.en: Sorry, this doesn't interest me one bit.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我完全没兴趣。

messages.en: I had a suspicion you would balk at the thought of live combat. You best sort your act out, rookie.
messages.zh: 我就猜到你可能会在真正的战斗中退缩。你最好好好思考一下，菜鸟。

messages.en: Gallente Federation combat units have become increasingly bold flying into Caldari sovereign space. At times, the commanders in charge of their small units are not even on authorized missions: Glory and revenge are strong motivators. Though the problem is by no means significant or crippling, the individualism for which Gallenteans are known has found its way even into the Federation Navy.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦战斗单位已开始越来越大胆的在加达里的领空肆意进行侵略活动。小型作战单位前线指挥官已经很多次越权进行军事行动。追求个人的荣誉和私仇公报都成为这些人私自调用宇宙中最强大的海军舰队之行为的理由。尽管这样的问题不会对海军造成任何影响，但是盖伦特的个人主义者总会找到调遣他们的海军的地方。

messages.en: A troubling individualism
messages.zh: 危险的个人主义

messages.en:
Nothing major, which is why you're getting the job. Prove to us you can handle this and we'll have plenty more to throw you later on. Screw up, however, and it's going on your record.

We've got a Federation Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. If we allow them room to breathe, they'll have Navy battleships, and perhaps even more, entrenched in the system within a week.

You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there and kill that commander and any of his guards present. Without him calling the shots, his people will fall back to regroup, and that buys us enough time to reinforce the area.
messages.zh:
没什么大不了的，正因为没什么大不了你才能拿到这个任务。如果你能证明给我们看，你完全能够处理这样的小问题的话，我们还有大把的任务可以交给你来完成。如果你给搞砸了，这也得记在你的账上。

我们发现有一个联邦海军前线指挥官最近又到了我们的领地界限以内。很明显的是这样的事情通常会慢慢升级到失去控制。我们截获的对方通讯显示他们计划要巩固他们的工事，而且还有更多的船要开过来。如果我们给他们喘息的机会，他们的海军战列舰就会开到甚至是在一周内占去这个系统的大部分地盘。

你去那儿，把那个前线指挥官干掉，还有他的守卫。没有他在那儿组织，他的人只能回去重新整理，这将给我们足够的时间来加强那个地区的防御，增添更多比你都有经验的飞行员。简报就到这里。菜鸟，动起来！

messages.en: I can't finish this mission; there're too many hostiles getting in my way.
messages.zh: 我不能完成这个任务，那儿有太多的敌人了。

messages.en: Fine, I'll get someone more capable. A word of advice: don't repeat this display of cowardice and uselessness. We don't tolerate that crap in the State.
messages.zh: 好吧，我会找个更有实力的人。给你一点建议，别再表现的像个没用的懦夫一样。我们共和国不能容忍这样的人。

messages.en: On my way!
messages.zh: 我立马出发！

messages.en: Good. Keep your comms line open, I'll be relaying further information when you give me a clear picture of the situation.
messages.zh: 很好。保持信道通畅，在你向我汇报清情况之后，我会给你下一步指令。

messages.en: I've come for work, yes.
messages.zh: 我就是来找工作的。

messages.en:
We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. Get your ass out there. I want them supported in any way possible.
messages.zh:
我们刚从在敌方领域行动的侦察队那里收到一条重要消息。他们的任务是侦察敌军，现在他们已经发现了敌人。由于他们自己无法解决敌人，他们向我们发出了增援请求。

我回复他们我们一招到合适人员就会派去增援他们，但自此以后我就一直没收到他们的回音。你尽快赶往那里，要尽一切方式帮助他们。

messages.en: I just made it back, is everything ok now?
messages.zh: 我回来了，现在一切都顺利了是不是？

messages.en: Yes, they succeeded in clearing the area of hostiles just moments ago. Good work out there rookie, keep it up.
messages.zh: 是的，他们就在刚才成功地清理了该敌区。干得不错，新人。要再接再厉。

messages.en: Oh…sorry, I won't be able to leave immediately. You better find someone else.
messages.zh: 哦……不好意思，我没法立刻动身。你最好找别人。

messages.en: Useless. Don't offer your services unless you intend to provide them wherever and whenever you are asked to!
messages.zh: 没用的家伙。除非你准备好随时随地做贡献，不然就别问别人需不需帮助！

messages.en: The life of a reconnaissance pilot is fraught with real and present danger at all times. Since even the slightest mistake can cost an entire squadron their lives, operations behind enemy lines are a task carried out by some of the most disciplined and battle-hardened pilots each empire has.
messages.zh: 特勤人员的生涯充满了危险。由于最小的错误也可能让整支队伍送命，因此深入敌后的行动一般都是由每个帝国中纪律性最强，久经沙场考验的飞行员执行的。

messages.en: A covert life.
messages.zh: 特勤生涯。

messages.en:
Alright then, I suppose I've got something for you.

We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. They've either had to maintain comms silence to avoid being detected or they've been forced to engage prematurely.

In any case, get your ass out there. Those are good men and women putting their lives on the line. I want them supported in any way possible.
messages.zh:
那好，我想我这里有适合你干的活。

我们刚从在敌方领域行动的侦察队那里收到一条重要消息。他们的任务是侦察敌军，现在他们已经发现了敌人。由于他们自己无法解决敌人，他们向我们发出了增援请求。

我回复他们我们一招到合适人员就会派去增援他们，但自此以后我就一直没收到他们的回音。他们要么就是为了不被发现而中断联系，要么就是被迫提前和敌人们干上了。

不管怎么样你都要尽快赶往那里。他们都是拿命做赌注的好同志。你尽一切方式帮助他们。

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't make it out to them after all. Sorry for the let down.
messages.zh: 我怕我没法完成该任务了。不好意思让你失望了。

messages.en: Sorry for the let down? Is that all you have to say? They're probably dead or cornered and that's all you offer me? Keep that callous attitude up and you'll find yourself barred from any further work inside our borders.
messages.zh: 不好意思让我失望？你最多就只能说这句话？他们可能已经牺牲了，而你跟我说这话？你就继续保持那冷血态度吧，然后你就再也无法在我们境内找到工作。

messages.en: They are assisting the Federation, as you said. I see no reason to decline. Give me the coordinates.
messages.zh: 他们在帮助盖伦特，就像你说的一样。这是不可否认的事实。把坐标给我。

messages.en: I am glad to see you understand the situation fully. Report back to me when you have finished the assignment.
messages.zh: 我很高兴你能够明白现在的状况。完成任务后回来向我报告。

messages.en: I am. Tell me how I can serve.
messages.zh: 是的。请告诉我该怎样做。

messages.en: We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Federation vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Federation forces. They must be dealt with.
messages.zh: 我们在附近的区域发现了一座民用设施，里面驻扎了一些工程师和技术人员，这些人都是帮助维修盖伦特联邦军队的舰船的。虽然技术上来说他们只是工人，是非战斗人员，但不可否认的是他们在直接地帮助我们的敌人。他们必须要有觉悟承受这样做的后果。

messages.en: I have done as you asked, the facility has been destroyed.
messages.zh: 我已经完成你的要求了，那座设施被摧毁了。

messages.en: Excellent work, rookie. There is hope for you yet. You have proven today that you understand the realities of the conflict ahead. Your loyalty will not go unnoticed.
messages.zh: 干得很棒，菜鸟。看来你还有希望。所今天所做的证明了你对眼前争夺的实质还是明白的。你的忠心不会被忽略的。

messages.en: I don't care what the circumstances are; I will not be a party in the murder of civilians.
messages.zh: 我不关心现在的环境；我不会参与对平民的伤害的。

messages.en: Your very refusal has assured that you will be. If you think those ships they repair do not target civilian structures of our own then you are a fool. I will get someone else for the job, your short-sighted and confused morality changes nothing except our perceptions of your worth to our cause.
messages.zh: 你的拒绝是很愚蠢的。你真的以为这些被修好的舰船不会拿我们自己的平民当靶子吗？你这个笨蛋。我会找别的人来完成这个任务，你短浅的眼光和模糊的道德标准除了让你的忠诚受到伤害之外没有什么用处了。

messages.en: In a time of war, there are very few people who will not find themselves caught in the crossfire. Civilians and non-combatants who directly assist armed forces are invariably seen as valid targets – no empire will risk letting their efforts go unhindered. In such dark times, necessity always takes precedent over morality.
messages.zh: 在战争的年代，只有很少人是处在没有战火的地方。那些帮助武装力量的平民和非战斗人员永远都是合法的目标，没有任何一个国家会忽视这种力量。在这样一个黑暗的时代，利益驱使的必要性总是会战胜纠结于灵魂之中的道德。

messages.en: Dark times.
messages.zh: 黑暗的年代。

messages.en:
The task I have for you today is an important one. It is significant not only in strategic terms, but also a test of your loyalty.

We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Federation vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Federation forces. They must be dealt with.

Fortunately for us, there is a small window of opportunity where we can strike at them. Repaired ships that are awaiting further deployment usually stand on guard at the facility. However, the large majority of them have been recalled to another higher priority assignment. We have a chance to strike here, rookie. Will you help the Caldari?
messages.zh:
今天我要给你的任务是非常重要的。不光光是战术上的重要性，而也是对你的忠诚的考验。

我们在附近的区域发现了一座民用设施，里面驻扎了一些工程师和技术人员，这些人都是帮助维修盖伦特联邦军队的舰船的。虽然技术上来说他们只是工人，是非战斗人员，但不可否认的是他们在直接地帮助我们的敌人。他们必须要有觉悟承受这样做的后果。

幸运的是，我有一个机会可以直接的袭击他们。被维修好的舰船在重新被分配任务之前会充当这个维修站的防御力量。但是，他们大部分被派遣出去执行另外一项更高优先级的任务了。这给我们带来了一个机会，新人，你愿意帮助加达里完成这项任务么？

messages.en: I've changed my mind. I cannot do what you've asked of me.
messages.zh: 我改变主意了。我不能做这事儿。

messages.en: Then you are of no use to us. Save me your confused ramblings on morality, we have a war to win here and I will do what it takes to serve that end.
messages.zh: 这样的话你对我们就没用了。把你的道德言论收起来吧，我们有一场战争要去赢，这终将是一场不择手段的争夺。

messages.en: Blowing up a reactor is what I've been dreaming of! Count me in.
messages.zh: 我做梦都想要把哪个反应堆给炸掉玩玩！算我一个。

messages.en: Good deal. I've uploaded the location to your NeoCom. There will be some defenses there, but they shouldn't be too difficult for you. However, pod pilots working for the Federation may be flying in the area. Prepare yourself to face them.
messages.zh: 不错。我正在把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中。你可能会在那儿遭到一些抵抗，但对你来说这应该不会太难。只是你要注意的是联邦的飞行员可能也在附近徘徊，你要对此有所准备。

messages.en: Whatever you've got, I can take it on.
messages.zh: 不管是什么，我都能解决。

messages.en:
The Gallente Federation is trying to set up a starbase inside one of the contested systems. If they manage to get it up and running, they'll have a staging point from which to launch further attacks against us. Luckily, it is not yet fully operational and has a highly explosive reactor that is just waiting to be destroyed.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Head over there and destroy the reactor. Just watch out for the pod pilots working for the Federation. They will try to stop you if they can.
messages.zh:
盖伦特联邦试图在一个争夺区域中设立一个空间站。如果他们能够成功的话，他们就有了一个把战线朝我们进一步推进的跳板。幸运的事，这个母星还没有完全的进入运转，并且有一个高爆炸危险的反应堆在那儿等着我们去把他轰掉。

我已经把坐标地点上传到你的控制边栏中了。你前去把反应堆炸掉然后回来向我报告。你要注意可能再附近出现的敌方克隆飞行员，他们一定会尝试阻止你。

messages.en: I've destroyed the reactor and the starbase went up like a State Independence celebration!
messages.zh: 我已经炸毁了那个反应堆，整个空间站就像独立日的烟火一样炫丽！

messages.en: Excellent work. I wish I could have been there to see that thing go. I bet it was quite a display! Hopefully, this will set the Gallente back and make them hesitate before trying to set up a starbase here again!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。真希望我也能在场观看，这肯定是一场精彩的表演！希望这能够给盖伦特人带来点教训让他们想要再在这儿搞一个空间站的时候能够三思而后行。

messages.en: Whoa, maybe I can't take that on.
messages.zh: 行了，我可能做不了这个。

messages.en: Don't you think you can handle this?
messages.zh: 你不认为你能对付得了么？

messages.en:
Those damn Gallente. Always up to something sneaky. Thankfully we've enough spies in their midst to keep them from pulling off anything too big. One of those spies just reported that the Federation is trying to construct a starbase inside a nearby contested system.

A fully functioning starbase can cause us a huge headache. They're tough and require a lot of manpower to destroy. Because of our spies we have a first strike advantage. The starbase hasn't been completed yet, and the idiot Gallente have filled their main reactor full of fuel.

If you head over there and destroy the reactor, the entire starbase will blow. Do you think you can do this for me?
messages.zh:
这些可恶的盖伦特人。总是喜欢干这种偷鸡摸狗的事情。庆幸我们有足够的间谍渗透在他们之中把所有的信息都能够传送回来。我们的一个间谍报告说联邦正试图在附近的一个争夺区域建设一个母星。

一个全面运转的母星将给我们带来严重的威胁，而这些建筑又非常坚固而且需要非常多的人力去摧毁。这座母星还没有完成，而那些愚昧的盖伦特却已经把足够多的燃料运送过去，活生生的把他们的反应堆塞成了一个爆炸物筒。

如果你过去把这个反应堆摧毁的话，剧烈的爆炸会把整个母星变成尘埃。你认为你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: That starbase reactor was tougher than I expected.
messages.zh: 那个母星反应堆比我想象的要坚固的多。

messages.en: I suppose I can send someone else to finish the job.
messages.zh: 我看来只好找别人来完成这个任务了。

name.ru: Нож в горле (Knife in the Throat)

messages.en: That relay is as good as gone.
messages.zh: 那座中继塔已经完蛋了。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, get out of there as quickly as you can. Reinforcements will probably be sent to the area as soon as the thing goes down.
messages.zh: 很好。一旦你摧毁了那座中继塔就迅速的从那儿离开，敌人的增援部队可能随时抵达。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
The Caldari have deployed a series of tactical FTL relays along the front lines in order to coordinate their operations. Naval Intelligence has located one nearby-- it's being used to stage raids against our convoys. Unfortunately, no regular naval forces are available for a fast strike, so we're looking to you to take care of this for us.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Caldari Tactical Relay, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
加达里在战区的前沿部署了一系列的超光速通讯中继塔用于组织对我们的进攻。海军情报部门已经定位了一座用来协调攻击我方补给船队的战术中继塔。但目前我们的人员紧张，没法抽调常规部队来完成这次攻击，所以我们正在找像你这样的飞行员帮助我们完成这个任务。

飞到指定的地点，寻找并摧毁艾玛战术中继塔，然后回来向你的代理人报告。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. This should take a bit of pressure off our supply convoys. I'll make sure command realizes your contribution.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮，飞行员。这能让我们的补给船队承受的压力得到一些减轻。我会让指挥部的人知道你的功劳的。

messages.en: Sounds a bit small-time to me.  I think I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 听起来不像是我的风格。我想我还是不要做这个了。

messages.en: Not every mission is glory and fame, pilot.  Total victory is but an amalgam of many small, seemingly insignificant victories; that's something you will need to learn eventually.
messages.zh: 并不是每个任务都会是那么风光的，飞行员。最终的胜利是来自于很多像这样不那么重大的胜利共同组成的。这些你最后都会明白。

messages.en:
As you're probably aware, in order to coordinate military operations at the front lines, the Caldari have deployed a series of FTL communications relays at the edge of the forward line of battle. Eliminating these communications relays and throwing a wrench into enemy operations has been made a top priority by the general staff.

Naval Intelligence has been able to locate one of these tactical relays being used to coordinate raids on our shipping. Right now, it is only lightly defended, but we don't have any forces available to take it out. I've been asked to look for capsuleers like yourself to eliminate the relay. Think you're up for it?
messages.zh:
你可能已经知道了，为了配合前线的军事行动，加达里在战区的前沿部署了一系列的超光速通讯中继塔。为使敌人的通讯指挥系统陷入瘫痪，破坏这些中继站成为了我们总参部目前的首要目标。

海军情报部门已经定位了一座用来协调攻击我方补给船队的战术中继塔。目前，它的防御尚还较为薄弱，但即便这样我们也没有足够的人手调配出来组织这次攻击。我正在寻找能够完成这个任务的克隆飞行员，就像你这样的，去摧毁这座中继塔。你认为你能行么？

messages.en: He's as good as dead.
messages.zh: 死亡是他最好的归宿。

messages.en: Excellent. I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Remember, this commander is an expert at surprise attacks, so don't let him sneak up on you.
messages.zh: 很好。我期待你回音。注意，这司令是偷袭战的老手，你可要时刻提防着。

messages.en:
Gallente forces in this sector have been taking heavy losses from enemy hit and run attacks on our fleets, damaging morale and stalling our offensives. Naval Intelligence believes that these attacks are being masterminded by the local Caldari sector commander, and has determined that our best option for ending these attacks is to eliminate him.

We have located a staging point that the sector commander is using for his attacks. You need to fly to these coordinates and wait for the commander and his escort to arrive, then eliminate him. Be aware that you may need to engage multiple groups of enemy forces while waiting, so be prepared for a protracted battle. Return to your agent when the sector commander has been destroyed.
messages.zh:
盖伦特部队在此地区遭到了敌人重创，士气受损，进攻也停滞不前。海军情报部门相信，这些袭击的幕后指使是本地的加达里地区司令，而结束袭击的最好方法就是把他除掉。

我们已经找到了该司令的部队纠集地。你要做的就是飞往那里，守株待兔，他一出现就把他干掉。注意在他来到之前，你可能要先被迫与多批敌人部队交火，因此要作好打持久战的准备。那司令死了后就速回代理人那里汇报。

messages.en: I've eliminated the sector commander.
messages.zh: 我已经把那地区司令干掉了。

messages.en: Great work, pilot. We'll make sure that word of your victory is spread to the rest of our forces; that should help morale more than you can realize.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。我会把这条好消息通报全军的；这真是一条令人振奋的消息啊。

messages.en:
We've been taking some heavy losses in the last few weeks along this area of the front. An enemy frigate squadron has been hitting our ships hard, taking out stragglers and scouts and then fading into space before we can counterattack, and it's starting to take its toll not only on our physical resources but an even heavier one on our morale. Our captains are getting too cautious, too unwilling to push for gains, and our general staff is getting concerned that the front will be stalled because of this. This is unacceptable.

Naval Intelligence believes that the person behind these attacks is the local Caldari sector commander. Eliminating him will hopefully end these attacks, give our forces a morale boost, and shift the momentum in this sector back to our side. Because of our problems with morale, we aren't sure that regular naval forces can handle this job; we'd like you to deal with this problem for us.

We've located a rendezvous point that this commander is going to be using for staging his next series of raids. You will need to fly there, eliminate his ship, and then report in. There will likely be a significant enemy presence there aside from the sector commander and his direct escort, so be prepared for a protracted battle.
messages.zh:
过去几周我们在此前线地区遭到了重创。敌方的一支护卫舰队伍对我们施行了猛烈打击，抓走我们侦察队的人，然后在我们实施反击前又退缩了回去。他们不仅在身体上让我们受打击，在精神上也极大地压制了我们。我们的舰长也变得胆小慎微起来，不敢大举进攻，大家都开始担心前线的推进将会就此打住。这是无法令人接受的。

海军情报部门相信，这些袭击的幕后指使是本地的加达里地区司令。把他灭掉就可以停止这些袭击，还可以提升我军士气，另外也能让该地区的形势朝对我们有利的方向发展。但由于现在军队士气低落，因此我们对让常规海军部队完成此项任务并没把握；我想让你来帮我们这个忙。

我们已经找到了该司令将要发动下一次袭击的集合点。你就是要飞过去把他干掉，然后回来报告。那里除了司令员本身及他的随从之外，还可能会有其他大量敌舰，因此要作好打持久战的准备。

messages.en: I'll leave immediately.
messages.zh: 我马上就出发。

messages.en: Good. Return here as soon as you get the data.
messages.zh: 很好，拿到数据后尽快返回这里。

messages.en:
The Navy is planning a new offensive against State positions, but Naval Intelligence has been unable to make headway getting the information necessary to plan a coordinated strike. In order to get the intelligence we need, we're going to need you to make a raid on a secure enemy datastore.

You'll need to jump into the deadspace area, eliminate the defenders, and recover the Tactical Information Sheet from the datastore. Once you've got it, bring it back to your agent so that Naval Intelligence can analyze it in preparation for the offensive.
messages.zh:
海军正在策划对共和国的目标进行一次攻击，但是海军情报部门还没有能够得到这次攻击计划制定之中所需的关键情报。为了能够得到这份情报，我们需要你去袭击一座敌人的数据储藏中心。

你需要跃迁进入到一个死亡空间复合体里面，消灭所有的反抗者，然后再从数据中心找到战术情报文件。一旦得手，马上带回来给你的代理人，这样海军情报部门就能立即对情报进行分析制定作战计划。

messages.en: I think I've found what you were looking for. Is this it?
messages.zh: 我想我已经拿到你要找的东西，是这个么？

messages.en: Nice work, pilot. I'll pass this up the chain to Naval Intelligence. Drinks are on us tonight.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮，飞行员，我会把这个发布到海军情报系统里面去。今晚的酒钱我们买单了。

messages.en: Sounds pretty dicey. I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 听起来很冒险。

messages.en: This war isn't going to get any easier, pilot.  You'd better start thinking whether or not you're really cut out for this line of work.
messages.zh: 这场仗不会好过的，飞行员。你应该好好想想你到底要不要参与进来。

messages.en: Blowing up some supply industrials? Sounds easy enough.
messages.zh: 击毁几艘运送补给物资的工业舰？听起来够简单的。

messages.en: I knew you would be up for it, pilot. The convoy is lightly guarded and the only important targets are their industrials. Once you destroy them, you can get out of there or mop up as needed. Just remember, because the system is contested, pod pilots working for the Caldari may try to stop you. Be sure that your ship is set up to counter them as well.
messages.zh: 我知道你会帮忙的，飞行员。船队的防御力量很弱，首要目标是他们的工业舰。一旦摧毁了他们，你就可以回来报告了，你也可以全部消灭如果你觉得有必要的话。只是你要记住，那个星系是争夺区域，这样在那儿游荡的加达里飞行员会尝试组织你，你得要准备好对付这些人。

messages.en: What can I do to help?
messages.zh: 我能怎样帮忙呢？

messages.en:
The Caldari are resupplying one of their relay stations in a nearby contested system-- it's due to run out soon and the convoy dispatched to resupply it hasn't arrived yet. Your job is to get to the convoy and destroy the industrials before they have a chance to complete their mission.

The mission shouldn't be too difficult, as long as you don't encounter any pod pilots fighting for the Caldari. You should fit your ship to defend itself from other pod pilots just in case.
messages.zh:
加达里正在对他们在附近争夺区域的一座中继站进行补给——他们的燃料就要烧完了而运送补给物资的船队尚还没有抵达。你的任务就是去拦截补给护航船队并将在他们抵达目的地之前将其工业舰摧毁。

这个人物应该没有什么难度，关键的威胁来自于游荡于争夺区域的帝国飞行员。你需要好好的装配你的舰船来对抗可能出现的遭遇战。

messages.en: That station won't be seeing new supplies any time soon.
messages.zh: 那座中继站很长一段时间是看不到他们的补给船对了。

messages.en: Good work. I knew I could count on you. With that relay station out of commission, our local transmissions will be harder for the Caldari to intercept, at least until they manage to sneak another convoy in there.
messages.zh: 干的不错，我就知道你是靠得住的。那座中继站失效过后，我们在本地的通信将会难以被加达里所截获，至少说在他们重新溜进来之前我们可以安心好些日子了。

messages.en: I can't do that for you.
messages.zh: 我不能为你干这事儿。

messages.en: Is destroying a few industrials really that difficult? I suppose I'll have to find someone else to complete this mission for me.
messages.zh: 打几艘工业舰真的就这么难么？我找别人来做这个任务好了。

messages.en:
I'm glad you're here, pilot. It's come to my attention that the Caldari have a relay station in a nearby contested system. The station is being used to send monitor classified Federation transmissions and then transmit them back to Caldari space, where their code-breakers can get to work figuring out what we mean. So far, we haven't had an opportunity to strike at it directly, and it's unlikely we'll get one soon.

However, we've received intelligence that the Caldari have dispatched a convoy to resupply the station. If we can destroy that convoy, we'll hamper their spying operations for at least a short period of time.
messages.zh:
很高兴你在这儿，飞行员。加达里在附近争夺区域的一座中继站最近引起了我的注意。这座中继站专门用来监听共和国的机密频道，并将信息传送回加达里境内的接收站进行破译。到目前我们都还没有找到机会攻击它，这样下去也不是办法。

不管怎样，我们得到情报说有一队加达里船队从本土出发准备对这座中继站进行燃料补给。如果我们能摧毁这个船队的话，那我们就能给他们的情报工作带来一定程度上的打击。

messages.en: I'm afraid I have to abandon your mission.
messages.zh: 很遗憾我要放弃你的任务。

messages.en: That relay station is causing serious problems for us. I'll have to get someone else to stop them.
messages.zh: 这个中继站给我们造成了严重的危害。我得要找人去阻止他们。

messages.en: It doesn't matter what those thieves do as their day jobs, they won't get away from me!
messages.zh: 我不关心这些强盗白天都在干些啥，但绝对不会逃过我的掌心。

messages.en: Remember, the belt is in a contested system, so pod pilots working for the State may try to stop you. Make sure you prepare for them above all else.
messages.zh: 记住，这个矿带是位于一个争夺中的星系，所以合众国的克隆飞行员们可能会要试图攻击你。你的准备好对付这些人。

messages.en: I am always ready to earn an honest buck. Sometimes a not-so-honest one too.
messages.zh: 我总是希望赚点老实钱。虽然有时候也搞点不那么老实的。

messages.en: Some pesky miners working for the Caldari State have managed to discover one of our hidden asteroid belts. This is unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. Head out there and destroy those miners, then report back to me. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the State.
messages.zh: 一些为加达里工作的矿工发现了我们的一个秘密的小行星带。这是不能接受的。我把坐标传送给你，你去把他们都歼灭了，然后回来向我报告。你要当心那些为合众国卖力的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: I've destroyed those miners. Our asteroids are safe for now!
messages.zh: 我消灭了那些矿工。我们的小行星带从此又恢复了宁静。

messages.en: Great. That should teach them to try to take what belongs to the Federation! Hopefully, we won't have any more problems with those pesky miners, but knowing the Caldari, I doubt this'll be the end of it. Oh well, we'll just send you in again if need be!
messages.zh: 很好。那应该能教会他们去偷盖伦特的东西！希望这些烦人的矿工不会再来制造麻烦了。不过你要知道加达里人，我很怀疑他们会就这么罢休。好吧，如果他们又来了我们再找你。

messages.en: I can't do that to those poor miners!
messages.zh: 我不能对那些可怜的矿工下毒手。

messages.en: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这样看来我得找别人来做了。

messages.en:
The Federation has located numerous asteroid belts hidden away all over charted space. Usually, these sites are so out of the way that they're rarely found, let alone touched by anyone except us. But it seems the Caldari State has found one of them and sent some miners in to steal those asteroids: Those capitalist pigs have been sneaking in and mining our ore!

As you can see, this situation is entirely unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom -- I want you to go out there and destroy those miners. Show them that the Federation will not tolerate such acts. Just be wary of any pod pilots working for the State. They'll almost certainly attack you on sight.
messages.zh:
盖伦特找到了我们的矿工用来为战争提供后请资源的小行星带。通常他们不会受到除了我们派去的人之外的干扰，就算他们现在并不是在共和国的空域。但是现在的情况是，加达里派遣了一些矿工到我们的一个小行星带，他们还认为这个小行星带是他们所有的；我们现在很忙，趁这个空子他们肆无忌惮的开采我们的资源！

这是不能接受的。我把坐标传送给你，你去把他们都歼灭了，然后回来向我报告。你要当心那些为合众国卖力的克隆飞行员，他们肯定会在那些区域出现。

messages.en: I'm afraid I cannot complete your mission.
messages.zh: 恐怕我不能完成你的任务。

messages.en: I'm disappointed in you. I didn't think you would have trouble.
messages.zh: 你让我失望了。我以为你不会有问题的。

messages.en: Don't worry. I'll make sure that gate stays deactivated!
messages.zh: 能。我保证能让那门永远封存起来。

messages.en:
I knew I could count on you for this. I've uploaded the location of the deadspace pocket to your NeoCom. All you need to do is head there and destroy the repair ships. The gate itself is probably too tough for you to destroy on your own. After all, that's why we left it there before.

Just remember, this gate is in a contested system. That means pod pilots flying for the State might try to stop you. Be careful.
messages.zh:
我就知道我能把这事托付给你。我已经把死亡空间的位置上传到了你的控制边栏里。你要做的就是赶往那里把维修船炸掉。那门靠你自己去轰可能难了点。不然我们也不会一开始就把那门留了下来。

记住，由于这门位于一个争夺星系里，因此为合众国效力的飞行员可以随时向你开火。要当心。

messages.en: Sure thing. What needs destroyed today?
messages.zh: 准备好了。今天要去哪里搞破坏？

messages.en: The Caldari State has a gate hidden in a deadspace pocket. The gate has been offline for a while, and has fallen into some disrepair. Now it seems that the State is trying to get it back on. Head over to the gate and destroy the repair ships before they can get it back online. Oh, and be careful. We've received word that capsuleers working for the State have been spotted in the area.
messages.zh: 加达里在一个死亡空间里有个隐蔽门。那门已经长久不用，很多地方都需要修理了。现在看起来合众国打算对它进行修复。快赶往那里，乘他们施行修复之前，把那些修理船都干掉。哦，我们获悉那里会有为合众国效力的飞行员，因此你行事要小心。

messages.en: Those repair ships were no problem. Mission accomplished.
messages.zh: 那些维修船已经不是问题了。任务完成。

messages.en: Good work. I am impressed. The Caldari will probably think twice before trying to reactivate that gate again. I'm sure that will put a serious crimp in their plans for the area.
messages.zh: 干得好，我欣赏。加达里可能不再敢轻举妄动去重启那门了。我敢肯定，他们针对该地区的计划已经严重受挫。

messages.en: That sounds a bit tougher than I can handle.
messages.zh: 我处理这事可能有点吃力。

messages.en: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这样看来我得找别人来做了。

messages.en:
We recently discovered a hidden gate belonging to the Caldari State in a nearby deadspace pocket. A capsuleer working for us managed to take the guards out some time ago, after which we then sent in forces to deactivate it. For a while, it seemed like the State would simply abandon the gate.

Unfortunately, that's not the case. We've detected a squad of ships heading to the gate to initiate repairs on the gate and reactivate it, probably so they can more easily move forces into the area. Luckily, it will take them quite some time to get it operational. We want you to head out there and stop them before they can. Can you handle this?
messages.zh:
我们最近在附近的一个死亡空间里发现了属于加达里合众国的一个隐蔽门。上次我们的一位飞行员成功地把守门的卫兵都干掉了，之后我们派出一支部队把那门封停了。当初看起来合众国已经有了弃门的意思。

不过实际情况并非如此。我们已经探到敌方有一支部队正前往那星门，准备修复它，然后打算重新启用该门。估计他们这样做的目的是想让自己进出更方便。所幸他们真要搞成还需要一点时间。我们要你飞往那里及时制止他们。你能接手这事吗？

messages.en: Things were tough over there! I'm going to have to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这仗太难打了！我不干了。

messages.en: Now I'll have to find someone else to stop them! I hope we still have time.
messages.zh: 那我现在必须得另寻他人来阻止他们了！但愿还来得及。

name.ru: Изменение в плане (A Change of Plan)

messages.en: See that you do not.
messages.zh: 看起来你不要做。

messages.en: That's why I'm here. What's the problem?
messages.zh: 这正是我在这儿的原因。有什么问题么。

messages.en: We've got a Caldari Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there; kill that commander and any of his guards present. This should scatter their forces long enough for our own reinforcements to arrive.
messages.zh: 我们发现有一个加达里海军前线指挥官最近又到了我们的领地界限以内。很明显的是这样的事情通常会慢慢升级到失去控制。我们截获的对方通讯显示他们计划要巩固他们的工事，而且还有更多的船要开过来。你要过去确保这件事情不会发生。你去那儿，把那个前线指挥官干掉，还有他的守卫。这样我们将有足够的时间把增援部队调集过去。

messages.en: Mission complete: The Field Commander and his guards have been dealt with.
messages.zh: 任务完成，前线指挥官和他的守卫都被我收拾了。

messages.en: Not bad, rookie. Not bad at all. You've a long way to go to prove your worth, however.
messages.zh: 不错啊，菜鸟。尽管你完成得很出色，但在获得荣耀的路上你还有很长的路要走、

messages.en: Sorry, this doesn't interest me one bit.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我完全没兴趣。

messages.en: I had a suspicion you would balk at the thought of live combat. You'd best sort your act out, rookie.
messages.zh: 我就猜到你可能会在真正的战斗中退缩。你最好反省一下，菜鸟。

messages.en: Caldari State combat units have little compunction about raiding into Gallente sovereign space; the State navy is perhaps the most disciplined in the universe, but anti-Gallentean sentiment currently runs very high, and even disciplined soldier occasionally let emotion overrule duty.
messages.zh: 加达里战斗单位对在盖伦特境内的目标实施攻击的错误显得认识不足。合众国海军可能是宇宙中最训练有素的军队，但是其反盖伦特声音最近十分猖獗，这样就算是训练最有素纪律最严明的军人有时候也会让情绪战胜军纪。

messages.en: Caldari Xenophobia
messages.zh: 加达里的仇外情绪

messages.en:
Nothing major, which is why you're getting the job. Prove to us you can handle this and we'll have plenty more to throw you later on. Screw up, however, and it's going on your record.

We've got a Caldari Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. If we allow them room to breathe, they might have Navy battleships and even worse entrenched in our system within a week. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen.

Fly over there and kill that commander and his guards. Without him calling the shots, his people will most likely fall back to regroup, and that buys us enough time to reinforce the area.

So, briefing's over rookie - move your ass!
messages.zh:
没什么大不了的，正因为没什么大不了你才能拿到这个任务。如果你能证明给我们看，你完全能够处理这样的小问题的话，我们还有大把的任务可以交给你来完成。如果你给搞砸了，这也得记在你的账上。

我们发现有一个加达里海军前线指挥官最近又到了我们的领地界限以内。很明显的是这样的事情通常会慢慢升级到失去控制。我们截获的对方通讯显示他们计划要巩固他们的工事，而且还有更多的船要开过来。如果我们给他们喘息的机会，他们的海军战列舰就会开到甚至是在一周内占去这个系统的大部分地盘。你去那儿，把那个前线指挥官干掉，还有他的守卫。没有他在那儿组织，他的人只能回去重新整理，这将给我们足够的时间来加强那个地区的防御，增添更多比你都有经验的飞行员。

简报就到这里。菜鸟，动起来！

messages.en: I can't finish this mission - too many hostiles in my way.
messages.zh: 我不能完成这个任务，有太多的敌人了。

messages.en: On my way!
messages.zh: 我立马出发！

messages.en: Good. Keep your comms line open, I'll be relaying further information when you give me a clear picture of the situation.
messages.zh: 很好。保持信道通畅，在你向我汇报清情况之后，我会给你下一步指令。

messages.en: I've come for work, yes.
messages.zh: 我就是来找工作的。

messages.en:
We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. Get your ass out there. I want them supported in any way possible.
messages.zh:
我们刚从在敌方领域行动的侦察队那里收到一条重要消息。他们的任务是侦察敌军，现在他们已经发现了敌人。由于他们自己无法解决敌人，他们向我们发出了增援请求。

我回复他们我们一招到合适人员就会派去增援他们，但自此以后我就一直没收到他们的回音。你尽快赶往那里，要尽一切方式帮助他们。

messages.en: I just made it back, is everything ok now?
messages.zh: 我回来了，现在一切都顺利了是不是？

messages.en: Yes, they succeeded in clearing the area of hostiles just moments ago. Good work out there rookie, keep it up.
messages.zh: 是的，他们就在刚才成功地清理了该敌区。干得不错，新人。要再接再厉。

messages.en: Oh…sorry, I won't be able to leave immediately. You better find someone else.
messages.zh: 哦……不好意思，我没法立刻动身。你最好找别人。

messages.en: Useless. Don't offer your services unless you intend to provide them wherever and whenever you are asked to!
messages.zh: 没用的家伙。除非你准备好随时随地做贡献，不然就别问别人需不需帮助！

messages.en: The life of a reconnaissance pilot is fraught with real and present danger at all times. Since even the slightest mistake can cost an entire squadron their lives, operations behind enemy lines are a task carried out by some of the most disciplined and battle-hardened pilots each empire has.
messages.zh: 特勤人员的生涯充满了危险。由于最小的错误也可能让整支队伍送命，因此深入敌后的行动一般都是由每个帝国中纪律性最强，久经沙场考验的飞行员执行的。

messages.en: A covert life.
messages.zh: 特勤生涯。

messages.en:
Alright then, I suppose I've got something for you.

We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. They've either had to maintain comms silence to avoid being detected or they've been forced to engage prematurely.

In any case, get your ass out there. Those are good men and women putting their lives on the line. I want them supported in any way possible.
messages.zh:
那好，我想我这里有适合你干的活。

我们刚从在敌方领域行动的侦察队那里收到一条重要消息。他们的任务是侦察敌军，现在他们已经发现了敌人。由于他们自己无法解决敌人，他们向我们发出了增援请求。

我回复他们我们一招到合适人员就会派去增援他们，但自此以后我就一直没收到他们的回音。他们要么就是为了不被发现而中断联系，要么就是被迫提前和敌人们干上了。

不管怎么样你都要尽快赶往那里。他们都是拿命做赌注的好同志。你尽一切方式帮助他们。

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't make it out to them after all. Sorry for the let down.
messages.zh: 我怕我没法完成该任务了。不好意思让你失望了。

messages.en: Sorry for the let down? Is that all you have to say? They're probably dead or cornered and that's all you offer me? Keep that callous attitude up and you'll find yourself barred from any further work inside our borders.
messages.zh: 不好意思让我失望？你最多就只能说这句话？他们可能已经牺牲了，而你跟我说这话？你就继续保持那冷血态度吧，然后你就再也无法在我们境内找到工作。

messages.en: They are assisting the Caldari, as you said. I see no reason to decline. Give me the coordinates.
messages.zh: 他们在帮助加达里，就像你说的一样。这是不可否认的事实。把坐标给我。

messages.en: I am glad to see you understand the situation fully. Report back to me when you have finished the assignment.
messages.zh: 我很高兴你能够明白现在的状况。完成任务后回来向我报告。

messages.en: I am. Tell me how I can serve.
messages.zh: 是的。请告诉我该怎样做。

messages.en: We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Caldari vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting State forces. They must be dealt with.
messages.zh: 我们在附近的区域发现了一座民用设施，里面驻扎了一些工程师和技术人员，这些人都是帮助维修加达里军队的舰船的。虽然技术上来说他们只是工人，是非战斗人员，但不可否认的是他们在直接地帮助我们的敌人。他们必须要有觉悟承受这样做的后果。

messages.en: I have done as you asked, the facility has been destroyed.
messages.zh: 我已经完成你的要求了，那座设施被摧毁了。

messages.en: I don't care what the circumstances are; I will not be a party in the murder of civilians.
messages.zh: 我不关心现在的环境；我不会参与对平民的伤害的。

messages.en: In a time of war, there are very few people who will not find themselves caught in the crossfire. Civilians and non-combatants who directly assist armed forces are invariably seen as valid targets – no empire will risk letting their efforts go unhindered. In such dark times, necessity always takes precedent over morality.
messages.zh: 在战争的年代，只有很少人是处在没有战火的地方。那些帮助武装力量的平民和非战斗人员永远都是合法的目标，没有任何一个国家会忽视这种力量。在这样一个黑暗的时代，利益驱使的必要性总是会战胜纠结于灵魂之中的道德。

messages.en: Dark times.
messages.zh: 黑暗的年代。

messages.en:
The task I have for you today is an important one. It is significant not only in strategic terms, but also a test of your loyalty.

We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Caldari vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting State forces. They must be dealt with.

Fortunately for us, there is a small window of opportunity where we can strike at them. Repaired ships that are awaiting further deployment usually stand on guard at the facility. However, the large majority of them have been recalled to another higher priority assignment. We have a chance to strike here, rookie. Will you help the Federation?
messages.zh:
今天我要给你的任务是非常重要的。不光光是战术上的重要性，而也是对你的忠诚的考验。

我们在附近的区域发现了一座民用设施，里面驻扎了一些工程师和技术人员，这些人都是帮助维修加达里军队的舰船的。虽然技术上来说他们只是工人，是非战斗人员，但不可否认的是他们在直接地帮助我们的敌人。他们必须要有觉悟承受这样做的后果。

幸运的是，我有一个机会可以直接的袭击他们。被维修好的舰船在重新被分配任务之前会充当这个维修站的防御力量。但是，他们大部分被派遣出去执行另外一项更高优先级的任务了。这给我们带来了一个机会，新人，你愿意帮助联邦完成这项任务么？

messages.en: I've changed my mind. I cannot do what you've asked of me.
messages.zh: 我改变主意了。我不能做这事儿。

messages.en: Then you are of no use to us. Save me your confused ramblings on morality, we have a war to win here and I will do what it takes to serve that end.
messages.zh: 这样的话你对我们就没用了。把你的道德言论收起来吧，我们有一场战争要去赢，这终将是一场不择手段的争夺。

messages.en: Blowing up a reactor is what I've been dreaming of! Count me in.
messages.zh: 我做梦都想要把哪个反应堆给炸掉玩玩！算我一个。

messages.en: Good deal. I've uploaded the location to your NeoCom. There will be some defenses there, but they shouldn't be too difficult for you. However, pod pilots working for the State may be flying in the area. Prepare yourself to face them.
messages.zh: 不错。我正在把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中。你可能会在那儿遭到一些抵抗，但对你来说这应该不会太难。只是你要注意的是合众国的飞行员可能也在附近徘徊，你要对此有所准备。

messages.en: Whatever you've got, I can take it on.
messages.zh: 不管是什么，我都能解决。

messages.en:
The Caldari State is trying to set up a starbase inside one of the contested systems. If they manage to get it up and running, they'll have a staging point from which to launch further attacks against us. Luckily, it is not yet fully operational and has a highly explosive reactor that is just waiting to be destroyed.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Head over there and destroy the reactor. Just watch out for the pod pilots working for the State. They will try to stop you if they can.
messages.zh:
加达里合众国试图在一个争夺区域中设立一个空间站。如果他们能够成功的话，他们就有了一个把战线朝我们进一步推进的跳板。幸运的事，这个母星还没有完全的进入运转，并且有一个高爆炸危险的反应堆在那儿等着我们去把他轰掉。

我已经把坐标地点上传到你的控制边栏中了。你前去把反应堆炸掉然后回来向我报告。你要注意可能再附近出现的敌方克隆飞行员，他们一定会尝试阻止你。

messages.en: I've destroyed the reactor and the starbase went up like a Federation Day celebration!
messages.zh: 我已经炸毁了那个反应堆，整个空间站就像联邦纪念日的烟火一样炫丽！

messages.en: Whoa, maybe I can't take that on.
messages.zh: 行了，我可能做不了这个。

messages.en: Don't you think you can handle this?
messages.zh: 你不认为你能对付得了么？

messages.en:
Those damn Caldari. Always up to something sneaky. Thankfully we've enough spies in their midst to keep them from pulling off anything too big. One of those spies just reported that the State is trying to construct a starbase inside a nearby contested system.

A fully functioning starbase can cause us a huge headache. They're tough and require a lot of manpower to destroy. Because of our spies we have a first strike advantage. The starbase hasn't been completed yet, and the idiot Caldari have filled their main reactor full of fuel.

If you head over there and destroy the reactor, the entire starbase will blow. Do you think you can do this for me?
messages.zh:
这些可恶的加达里人。总是喜欢干这种偷鸡摸狗的事情。庆幸我们有足够的间谍渗透在他们之中把所有的信息都能够传送回来。我们的一个间谍报告说合众国正试图在附近的一个争夺区域建设一个母星。

一个全面运转的母星将给我们带来严重的威胁，而这些建筑又非常坚固而且需要非常多的人力去摧毁。这座母星还没有完成，而那些愚昧的家达里却已经把足够多的燃料运送过去，活生生的把他们的反应堆塞成了一个爆炸物筒。

如果你过去把这个反应堆摧毁的话，剧烈的爆炸会把整个母星变成尘埃。你认为你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: That starbase reactor was tougher than I expected.
messages.zh: 那个母星反应堆比我想象的要坚固的多。

messages.en: I suppose I can send someone else to finish the job.
messages.zh: 我看来只好找别人来完成这个任务了。

name.ru: Нож в горле (Knife in the Throat)

messages.en: That relay is as good as gone.
messages.zh: 那座中继塔已经完蛋了。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 太好了。摧毁中继塔后便尽快回来。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
An enemy cruiser squadron has been causing some serious trouble for our forces in this area. Unfortunately, we're also trying to deal with a Minmatar offensive in this sector, and that means that regular naval forces are stretched thin. In order to take some pressure off, we need you to take out the tactical relay that they are using to coordinate their activities. Hopefully, that will buy our fleet some time to deal with the offensive.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the tactical relay, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
一只敌人的巡洋舰中队在这个地区给我们造成了一些严重的麻烦。不幸的是，我们现在的主要兵力都忙于对抗米玛塔尔对这个区域的进攻，同时常规海军部队的战线又已经被拉的很长。为了能减轻一些负担，我们需要你去把敌方用来组织攻击行动的战术中继塔摧毁。希望这样能够为我们的舰队争取一些时间来对付正面攻击。

飞去指定的地点，找到并摧毁战术中继塔，然后返回你的代理人那里报告。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. You've bought our fleet some time to hold the line here. I'll make sure the sector commander knows you were responsible.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。你为舰队争取了组后的时间来抵抗正面进攻。我会让战区指挥官知道你的功绩的。

messages.en: Sounds a bit small-time to me. I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 听起来不像是我的风格。我想我还是不要做这个了。

messages.en: Even small actions are important, pilot. Just because you're not in the middle of a fleet battle doesn't mean you're not making an important contribution.
messages.zh: 就算是小小的一次行动也有它的重要性所在，飞行员。不在交战最激烈的前沿阵地不代表你就不能做出重大的贡献。

messages.en:
We've identified the location of a Minmatar tactical relay being used by an enemy cruiser squadron operating in the area. This squadron has been making deep penetration raids over the last week, and our sector commander has decided that elimination of this relay is the first step towards containing these incursions.

Unfortunately, our regular naval forces have their hands full dealing with an enemy offensive several systems away and protecting our supply lines holding the line in that area. As a result, I've been tasked with finding a loyal capsuleer who can take care of the problem for us. We'd like for you to give it a shot.
messages.zh:
我们确定了一座米玛塔尔用来指挥他们在这个区域的一只巡洋舰中队所用的战术中继塔。这个巡洋舰中队最近渗透到我们战线后方实施了一系列的破坏活动。我们的战区指挥官决定要消灭这支部队，作为防止地方更进一步侵犯的第一步。

不巧的是，我们的常规海军部队最近正忙于应付敌人对我们多个星系的侵犯，保卫我们的补给线能够正常的运转。这样一来，我们就要找一个忠诚的克隆飞行员来为我们处理这个麻烦。你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: There's too many of them; I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. You'll have to find some other sucker for this one.
messages.zh: 他们人太多了，我根本就没法靠近那个中继塔。你还是找别人吧。

messages.en: I thought you were supposed to be some hotshot pilot. All talk, huh?
messages.zh: 我还以为你是个

name.fr: Les meilleurs partent toujours en premier
name.ru: Только хорошие умирают молодыми (Only the Good Die Young)

messages.en: I'll put an end to their winning streak, don't worry.
messages.zh: 我会结束他们的运气的，别担心。

messages.en: Good. Make sure you're ready for a protracted battle. You may have to wade through a number of enemy capsuleers.
messages.zh: 很好，准备好打一场持久战吧。你可能得要和不少敌人的克隆飞行员苦战一番。

messages.en:
An enemy force has been launching increasingly bold attacks against us. They've been taking advantage of the fact that we have bigger troubles to deal with, and coming away victorious more often than not.

The general staff has decided to put an end to this campaign by striking a crippling blow to their morale. We want you to eliminate the enemy sector commander at these coordinates; all other targets are secondary.
messages.zh:
敌人的军队对我们的进攻越来越密集疯狂。在我们处理别的危机的空档，他们趁人之危越来越嚣张。

总参谋部决定要结束这种状况，给他们的士气予以狠狠一击。我们希望你去把敌人的区域指挥官给干掉。坐标已经给你，除了区域指挥官之外的都是次要目标。

messages.en: The enemy commander has been eliminated, sir.
messages.zh: 敌人的指挥官已经被消灭了，长官。

messages.en: Well, that should put ‘em in their place. Nice work, pilot. I'll make sure the general staff knows you were responsible.
messages.zh: 你做的很好，飞行员。我一定会在总参谋部那儿好好的表扬你一番。

messages.en: I'm really not comfortable with this.
messages.zh: 我对这个不太有心情。

messages.en: This is war, pilot. It's not about your comfort.
messages.zh: 这就是战争，飞行员。我们不是在谈论你的心情。

messages.en:
As I'm sure you're already aware, pilot, one of the most precious resources a military force has is morale. Battles can be won or lost by it, and wars can be turned by it. That is why one of our top priorities has been the disruption of the enemy's morale.

Lately, the Minmatar have enjoyed a string of small but dramatic victories over our forces in this sector. Though the damage inflicted to our forces has been negligible, the enemy forces responsible for these actions, especially their commander, have been emboldened and now they are pushing their luck more and more.

The general staff has determined that striking a crippling blow to their morale will likely put an end to this nonsense once and for all. We want you to eliminate their commander. With any luck, this will scatter them to the winds and put an end to these raids.
messages.zh:
我想你已经知道了，飞行员。军队最重要的一项资源就是士气，它可以左右战场的成败，可以转变战争的局势。这也是为什么挫伤敌人的士气是我们的首要任务之一。

最近，米玛塔尔在这个区域对我们的作战中取得了一些小胜利。尽管这些伤害对我们的部队来说是不值一提的，但这却让敌人的指挥官越来得寸进尺，越来越胆大，妄图把他们的”运气“跟进一步的推到我们的门口。

总参谋部决定要结束这种状况，给他们的士气予以狠狠一击。我们希望你去把敌人的区域指挥官给干掉。希望这样能够打散他们的攻击计划。

messages.en: I'll get that intelligence for you.
messages.zh: 我会帮你搞到那个情报。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it, pilot. Here's the coordinates; remember, that tactical information sheet is the primary objective. Any other damage is secondary.
messages.zh: 很高兴听到这个。这是坐标，记住，那份战术情报文件是你的首要目标，其他的都不是很重要。

messages.en:
The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from a Minmatar detention camp. In order to pave the way for the raid, we need to get information on the disposition of the enemy forces so that our strike force and the vulnerable transports coming with them can make it to the detention camp unmolested.

In order to get that intelligence, we need you to raid the base of an enemy force in this sector. We need you to get the tactical information sheet from the outpost and bring it back here in preparation for the prisoner raid.
messages.zh:
总参部正在计划一次营救行动，目标是解救在米玛塔尔集中营里面的一些战俘。为了能够为营救行动作铺垫，我们需要了解敌人集中营的兵力布置，这样我们的打击部队和人员运输舰才能够方便的打入集中营。

为了得到这些情报，我们希望你能够去突袭在这个区域一座敌人的基地。找到在那个哨站里的战术情报文件并带回来给我用来准备营救行动。

messages.en: I've got the information sheet. Does it have the data you're looking for?
messages.zh: 我拿到文件了，有你要找的数据么？

messages.en: Nice work, pilot; I'll send this off to the boys at intel. With any luck, you've just given us what we need to bring some of our brave warriors home.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员；我会把这个传给情报部门的小伙子们。运气好的话，你所带来的情报就能把我们的战士们带回家来。

messages.en: I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 这事儿我懒得管。

messages.en: I hope you can live with the lives of those prisoners on your conscience.
messages.zh: 我希望你的良心能够承受这些囚犯的生命。

messages.en:
You've got a real chance to be a hero here, pilot. The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from a Minmatar detention camp. The only problem is that we need to get intelligence on the distribution of enemy forces prior to the raid in order to pave the way for our strike force and the vulnerable transports that will need to be sent in with it. That's where you come in.

We know that one of the enemy fleets in this area has copies of the data that we need. You will need to penetrate their base of operations and retrieve the tactical information sheet from the outpost there. Bring that back to me and we can get the planning for this raid underway.
messages.zh:
现在你有一次做英雄的真正机会。总参部正在计划一次营救行动，目标是解救在米玛塔尔集中营里面的一些战俘。为了能够为营救行动作铺垫，我们需要了解敌人集中营的兵力布置，这样我们的打击部队和人员运输舰才能够方便的打入集中营。

我们知道在这个区域的一支敌方舰队手里有这份情报，为了得到它，我们希望你能够去突袭在这个区域一座敌人的基地。找到在那个哨站里的战术情报文件并带回来给我用来准备营救行动。

messages.en: This doesn't sound like a problem. I can take care of it for sure.
messages.zh: 这不是个问题，我当然能够处理的了。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it! Once you make sure every industrial is destroyed, return to me to report. Just watch out for capsuleers flying on their side and equip yourself to defend against them first and foremost.
messages.zh: 很高兴听到这些！一旦你确定已经把所有的工业舰都摧毁了，就回来向我报告。你要当心那些在那儿附近游荡的敌方克隆飞行员，武装好你的舰船来应付可能的遭遇。

messages.en: I will gladly hear what duty you have for me.
messages.zh: 很高兴知道你有任务交给我做。

messages.en:
A convoy is heading to supply a station in a contested system. That station provides food, water, clothing, and other basic equipment for the Minmatar forces in the area. We've managed to pinpoint the convoy's location, so we can send you out to take care of them for us.

Destroy the convoy before they can unload their cargo.
messages.zh:
一只护航补给舰对正在前往一座位于争夺区域的空间站执行补给任务。这座空间站为那个区域的米玛塔尔军队提供食物、水、服装以及各种基础装备。我们想办法确定了补给舰队的位置，现在我们要把你派过去对付这支补给船队。

在他们能抵达目的地卸货之前消灭补给船队。

messages.en: I hope those Minmatar lowlifes can make do without their tattoo ink because I just blew them all up!
messages.zh: 希望这些悲剧的米玛塔尔人能在没有纹身墨水儿的这段时间熬过去。

messages.en: Excellent. Without supplies, the Minmatar forces in the area will lose morale! It'll allow us to make inroads into the system.
messages.zh: 很好。没有了补给，那个区域的米玛塔尔军队很快就会失去士气！让我们有机会可以打入他们的星系。

messages.en: Blowing up industrials? Sounds boring! Give me something difficult, will you?
messages.zh: 打几艘工业舰？听起来太无聊了，拿点有些难度的事情给我做好不好。

messages.en: Tch. I didn't think you would turn this down.
messages.zh: 啊！我没想到你会让人这么失望。

messages.en:
I've been waiting for you to show up! We have a small problem. The Minmatar have a hidden supply depot inside a contested system. Normally, we would just go and destroy it, but we can't spare the manpower at the moment.

However, we've discovered that they're running low on supplies and are receiving a shipment of new equipment any time now. If we can stop them from restocking, we'll force the enemy to begin heavy rationing, which will harm their morale. Imagine the looks on their faces when they hear they can't have their snack-time. Are you up to the task?
messages.zh:
我一直在等待你的出现！我们这儿有点小麻烦。米玛塔尔在附近的争夺区域有一个隐藏的补给站。通常情况下，我们会直接把它给端掉，但是现在人力有限。

不管怎样，我们已经发现他们现在的补给出现了问题，正在等待新的装备抵达。如果我能够阻碍他们的补给进行，那么就能使他们的后勤出现大麻烦从而引发士气受到巨大打击。想象一下当连吃的都成问题的时候他们脸上会是什么样的表情。你愿意接受这个任务么？

messages.en: It turned out to be more difficult than I expected. I'm going to have to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这比我想象的要难得多。我放弃了。

messages.en: Thanks to those supplies getting through, we'll have to face fresh enemies in the area.
messages.zh: 的要感谢这些补给物资，现在我们要面对一大帮精神焕发的敌人了。

messages.en: I'll smash those miners like they smash those asteroids!
messages.zh: 我会把这些矿工都碾成饼。

messages.en:
Our scanners haven't revealed any combat ships escorting the miners. That could be simple hubris on the part of the Minmatar, or it could mean they've reinforcements a short way away. The miners are the only important targets, so focus on them.

Just be careful, as I've heard Capsuleers loyal to the Republic are in the area. You might have to deal with them and they'll provide a much greater threat.
messages.zh:
我们的扫描器没有发现任何战斗船只在保护这些采矿船。要么是这些米玛塔尔人过于傲慢，要么就是他们的增援还在路上。采矿船是你的首要目标，集中火力对付他们。

但是要小心，我听说共和国的一些克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动，你可能要对付他们，而且这些人的威胁可能来得更高。

messages.en: Oh how glorious it is! What do you have for me?
messages.zh: 哦，这真是太好了，你有什么活儿给我做。

messages.en:
Those damn Minmatar have managed to discover an asteroid belt in one of the contested systems nearby! Head over there and destroy them as soon as possible. Once you do, we can exploit the resources ourselves.

Just make sure you're ready to fight. Capsuleers loyal to the Republic might be out in force.
messages.zh:
这些可恶的米玛塔尔人在附近的争夺区域找到了一个小行星矿带！你尽快赶过去消灭它们。一旦成功，我们就可以自己去开采这些资源了。

做好准备战斗。为共和国卖力的克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动。

messages.en: I've taken out the miners, no sweat.
messages.zh: 我已经把矿工铲除了，不费吹灰之力。

messages.en: Excellent job. With those rats gone, we'll be able to exploit the resources and further fund our efforts. Even better, it seems like you got there in time to stop them from mining the choicest asteroids. This will not be forgotten.
messages.zh: 干的很漂亮。这些渣滓被铲除后我们就能够专心的开采这些资源为我们的国家服务。关键在于，是你赶在损失扩大之前赶到那儿制止了他们的这种行为，这将是不会被忘记的。

messages.en: They found it, they deserve it. I can't take your mission.
messages.zh: 是他们找到了这些矿石，是他们应得的。我不要做你的这个任务。

messages.en: I'm surprised you don't have the stomach for it.
messages.zh: 我很吃惊你居然没胆子干这事儿。

messages.en:
Uncountable numbers of hidden asteroid belts dot all of known space; some of them are quite valuable -- so much that both we and our enemies would risk going into contested space to find and exploit them. The Minmatar have recently sent miners into a rich field we discovered some time ago -- in a region of "contested space" -- and we certainly can't have them taking our ore.

If you can drive them out of there, we'll have those precious mineral resources all to ourselves. Can you do it?
messages.zh:
在已知的空余中布满了大大小小隐藏着的小行星矿带；其中有些还非常的值价——无论是我们的敌人还是我们自己都愿意冒险到处于战争状态的争夺区域去开采这些矿石。米玛塔尔最近派遣了一些矿工到一个我们早前发现的高产量小行星矿带——它也是出于一个争夺状态的空域。我们肯定不能让他们就这样拿走我们的资源。

如果你能把它们都从那儿赶出去，我们就能自己去开采这些价值连城的矿石资源了。你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: It turns out this was more than I could handle. I'm sorry!
messages.zh: 我发现这已经超出了我能够控制的范围。不好意思。

messages.en: Was the mission really that difficult?
messages.zh: 这个任务真有这么难？

messages.en: That repair crew won't have a chance. Don't worry about it.
messages.zh: 那些修门的人没机会完成自己的工作。放心好了。

messages.en: I figured as much! I've already uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. You shouldn't have too much trouble taking out the repair ships. It is in a contested system, so you may find Republic-aligned capsuleers patrolling the place.
messages.zh: 我有了很多发现！我已经把那座星门的坐标上传到你的控制边栏中了。打掉那几艘维修船对你来说应该是很简单的。但它位于一个争夺状态的区域里，你应该要做好准备迎击那些巡弋在附近的共和国克隆飞行员。

messages.en: An old smuggler's gate connects a system deep inside Republic territory with one of the contested systems nearby. It's been offline for years, but the Republic is trying to get it running again. Destroy the repair ships trying to repair the gate.
messages.zh: 这是个陈旧的非法贩售者修筑的星门，它通往共和国领土深处一个争夺区域附近。它已经停止使用多年了，但是敌人正在尝试让它重新运转。消灭那些正在维修这个星门的舰船。

messages.en: I've taken out that repair crew! The gate remains offline for now.
messages.zh: 我已经消灭了那些维修船！星门目前依然处于不可用状态。

messages.en: I hope it wasn't too much trouble for you. With that repair crew out of the way, we can take our time and send a demolition crew to destroy it when we get the chance. You have done the Empire proud.
messages.zh: 我希望之对你来说不算是个太大的麻烦。等到把那些维修船都打掉了，我们就有时间派出拆除作业团队去将星门完全拆除。你的勇敢让帝国十分骄傲。

messages.en: I'm not sure I can take them out in time.
messages.zh: 我不是很确定我能不能把它们及时地消灭掉。

messages.en: Well someone needs to take care of that repair crew. I guess I can find someone else.
messages.zh: 总得有人去把那些维修船干掉。我猜我还能找到别人去做。

messages.en:
Our contested territory is riddled with old, inoperable gates. Some of them were put up by our enemies, others by common smugglers hoping to get past customs. Well, it turns out that the Republic has discovered one of these derelict gates. Normally, this wouldn't be an issue, but the gate connects to a system deep in Republic space.

I don't need to tell you what could happen if those Minmatar slave dogs get that gate online. We can't spare the manpower to destroy the gate itself, but the ships working to repair it aren't nearly so sturdy.

I want you to fly over there and take them out. Are you up for it?
messages.zh:
我们的争夺中领土到处都可以看到年久失修的星门。有一些是我们的敌人安放的，有一些则是希望通过这种方法逃脱关税的非法贩售者安置的。结果，我们发现共和国发现了一座废弃的星门。通常这并不能算是什么事情，但是他们这次发现的这个星门链接到了共和国深处的一个星系。

我想我不说你也应该知道这意味着什么，如果那些米玛塔尔的混蛋把那座星门重新修复激活的话。我们暂时没法分散更多的人力去搞定那座星门，但是那些负责维修它的舰船则不是那么难对付的。

我要你飞过去把他们都干掉，你能接这个任务么？

messages.en: It turns out I wasn't prepared to tackle this mission. I'm going to have to abandon it.
messages.zh: 我发现原来我根本就没有准备好完成这个任务。我还是只有退出了。

messages.en: Grr. I wish I'd known you couldn't handle it from the start!
messages.zh: 呃～。我真希望一开始就知道你没法干这事儿。

messages.en: Understood, I'll arrange a meeting with her and consequence.
messages.zh: 明白了，我会去会会她。

messages.en: Spare me the tough talk, pilot. Action is the only language I respect. Move it.
messages.zh: 我也不想说太多了，飞行员。行动才是最有说服力的。快去吧。

messages.en: We've been watching Republic Fleet units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Amarrians; most of them non-combatants I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.
messages.zh: 我们正在监视快速堆积到附近争夺区域的共和舰队作战单位，在我们就要开始对他们实施攻击的时候，我们发现他们的一个高级前线指挥官刚刚抵达了那里。这个女人，他们的前线指挥官害死了无数的艾玛人民，这些受害者大部分还是平民。除了她和她的卫兵其他的我都不管了。干掉她们，你会得到应有的报酬的，甚至是人民的尊敬。

messages.en: She's dead.
messages.zh: 她已经挂掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. Not bad…not bad at all. Keep it up and we might just trust you with more important work down the line.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。不错，非常不错。再接再厉，我们会把接下来的更多的任务交给你的。

messages.en: Cheap Assassin? She is the cheap assassin. Non-combatants are her primary targets! I don't give a damn how highly you think of yourself so long as our people stop dying. Forget it; I'll get someone else who actually has a shred of patriotism and empathy.
messages.zh: 无耻的刺客？她是个卑劣无耻下流的清道夫，专门以平民为目标！只有我们的人民一天不停止死亡我就永远不会觉得你算得上是个什么东西。算了，我另外去找一个有爱国心和怜悯的人来做这个任务

messages.en: The breakdown in relations between the empires has seen huge losses in civilian life as they all target “weak points” and set missions specifically to “maximize morale loss.” In a war, there are few who will not see the atrocities of conflict and defenseless non-combatants are no exception. Those who lead such missions however, sit at the very top of their enemy's target lists.
messages.zh: 国家之间的深仇大恨造成了大量平民的生命在利益的冲突中牺牲，他们互相都把平民作为是对方的“软肋”和对士气最大打击的着手点。在战争中很少有人会受到怜悯，平民也不例外。这些执行残酷命令的人，总是会处在敌人击毁名单的最前端。

messages.en: Collateral Damage
messages.zh: 附带伤害

messages.en:
Good. I need you for an assassination, and this is something you best not screw up.

We've been watching Republic Fleet units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Amarrians; most of them non-combatants. She has a penchant for hitting weakened and unsupported civilian structures. She is scum, and I want her dead.

This is surgical stuff, pilot. She'll slip away if we go in there with full force. I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.

Simple as that, now get going.
messages.zh:
很好。我需要你执行一个行刺任务，你最好别搞砸了。

我们正在监视快速堆积到附近争夺区域的共和舰队作战单位，在我们就要开始对他们实施攻击的时候，我们发现他们的一个高级前线指挥官刚刚抵达了那里。这个女人，他们的前线指挥官害死了无数的艾玛人民，这些受害者大部分还是平民。她有一个嗜好就是攻击毫无防备和反抗之力的平民建筑。他是一个垃圾，我要她死。

这是个精细活，如果我们大举进攻的话她可能会毫无踪迹的溜掉。除了她和她的卫兵其他的我都不管了。干掉她们，你会得到应有的报酬的，甚至是人民的尊敬。

就这么简单，现在就赶快去办吧。

messages.en: What an utter disappointment you are. Next time, do not offer services beyond your ability. Eggers and their pride…just get out of here.
messages.zh: 你简直让人失望透顶了。下一次不要再冲汉子说大话了。你们这些生活在鸡蛋里的人……快从这儿滚出去。

messages.en: I'll set out immediately.
messages.zh: 我这就出发。

messages.en: You'll hear from me shortly. Pay close attention to my orders and obey them exactly.
messages.zh: 我很快就会再联系你。注意听我指挥，严格按照命令行动。

messages.en: That's why I'm here, how can I help?
messages.zh: 这正是我来这里的原因，我能帮上什么忙？

messages.en: Moments ago we launched an offensive against a Minmatar compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in. I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field.
messages.zh: 之前我们深入了米玛塔尔一个重兵把守的基地，对那里发动了一次袭击。我们不想冒险遭围剿，因此我们需要你帮忙。我要你飞过去确保这次行动的成功。你到战场后我会向你发出战术指示。

messages.en: Good call on the Commander, it seems to have worked.
messages.zh: 你指挥地不错，效果很好。

messages.en: Orders are only as good as the people who carry them out. That was some good work out there, pilot; calm, precise and efficient. You fly like a real Amarrian. Keep it up.
messages.zh: 命令还是要靠人去执行的。你干得不错，飞行员——冷静、精准、高效。这才像真正的艾玛人。希望能再接再厉。

messages.en: I won't be able to help with something like this I'm afraid, that sector is too far out of my way.
messages.zh: 恐怕我对此无能为力，那对我来说太强了。

messages.en: Why should I care? You asked how you could help so I'm telling you. Clearly I'm wasting my damn time in the process. A piece of advice rookie, don't ask if you can help when you have no concept of the expectations likely to be put upon you.
messages.zh: 你跟我说这干什么？是你自己问是否可以帮忙我才告诉你这一切的。看来我是在浪费时间。但菜鸟，我还是要给你一条忠告：如果你没做好不负重托的准备，就不要问别人你能否帮忙。

messages.en: Changes in technology and in particular, the advent of the jump drive, has made the battlefields of space a dynamic and unpredictable arena. Where previously reinforcements could take many hours or even days to arrive on-field, now they can be dropped immediately into the fray with a single cynosaural field. When the technology first appeared, all four empires had to drastically revise their outdated battle tactics and this is a process still happening even today. Mistakes are still made, and the cost of hubris and underestimation is usually high.
messages.zh: 由于科技的更新，尤其是跳跃飞行的出现，战场形势一下子变得瞬息万变起来。以前增援部队抵达战场可能要耗费数小时甚至数天时间，现在利用一个诱导力场便能立刻冲上战斗前线。该技术刚出现的时候，四大帝国被迫脱胎换骨似地修改他们那些老掉牙的战术，直到今天这修改还是一直不断。错误依旧有人犯，而傲慢与低估更是让人付出惨痛代价。

messages.en: A necessary adaptation
messages.zh: 必需的调整

messages.en:
Moments ago we launched an offensive against a Minmatar compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support.

Initial reconnaissance has suggested they may have the capability to field more vessels than we had originally anticipated. Naturally, we're not turning around in the face of this news, we've come too far and a retreat will only encourage them. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in.

I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field. Don't worry about any orders or cohesion with our own forces there, you'll be answering directly to me and following only my orders.

Briefing over. Get going.
messages.zh:
之前我们深入了米玛塔尔一个重兵把守的基地，对那里发动了一次袭击。

现在情报显示他们当时派出的舰船可能比我们预料的还要多。当然我们不可能在获悉这一消息后就进行撤退，那样话只会助长他们的士气。不过我们也不想冒险遭围剿，因此我们需要你帮忙。

我要你飞过去确保这次行动的成功。你到战场后我会向你发出战术指示。不用担心与我们自己的部队会有冲突，你直接听我指挥就行。

讲完了，出发吧。

messages.en: I can't commit myself to this after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.
messages.zh: 我没法保证我能完成这任务。但愿你能及时找到其他人。

messages.en: What?! I already told my superiors the matter was being handled. I'm really glad you hope I can find someone else, rookie. That means so much to me whilst our own people are out there risking their lives. Don't let me catch you repeating this performance.
messages.zh: 什么？！我已经告诉上级这事正在被处理了。还好你能希望我另找他人，菜鸟。我自己人正在那面冒着搭上命的风险呢。别让我看到你再有这样的表现。

messages.en: Without question. Give me the coordinates.
messages.zh: 没什么要问的，直接把坐标给我。

messages.en: I am relieved to see you have such good judgement. I'm sending you the location now; move quickly, before their compound is reinforced once again.
messages.zh: 你能有这样的觉悟我很高兴。我马上将地址发送给你，赶快过去在他们的增援来到之前做出行动。

messages.en: That's why I've come. Is there any work you can give me?
messages.zh: 这正是我来这儿的原因，有什么事儿可以让我做么？

messages.en: During a routine recon operation in a contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Minmatar citizens. In all likelihood they are assisting Republic forces in some way, either directly or indirectly. We have an opportunity for to remove that threat, whatever it may be. Kill them. Kill them all.
messages.zh:
最近一次在附近争夺区域的例行巡逻任务中，我们发现了一个大型设施，里面居住了数千米玛塔尔公民。种种迹象表明，他们正在以某种方式支援共和国军队，无论直接或者是间接的。我们有机会消除这个威胁。

尽管这听上去是一个糟糕的事情，但是总有人要去执行这样的任务。为了我们的国家，摧毁那个设施。

messages.en: I have done as you asked - the facility is destroyed.
messages.zh: 我按照你要求的做了，那个设施已经被摧毁。

messages.en: You have done well, pilot: That seems to be the only way we can rest reassured those Minmatar scum pose no further threat. Good work.
messages.zh: 做的很好，飞行员。米玛塔尔在这个地区将不再有任何威胁了。祝你好运。

messages.en: No, I won't do this. We should investigate before we start shooting. Get back to me when you've done so, and then I might be interested.
messages.zh: 我不会这么做。我们应当在开火前仔细的调查他们为什么这么做。等你调查好了再找我，可能我会有兴趣的。

messages.en: The arrogance of you eggers! I do not report to you, but to true servants of the divine Empire. I will find someone else to carry out this task - your refusal has achieved nothing but my disdain.
messages.zh: 你们这帮傲慢的蠢人！我不靠你吃饭，我是神圣帝国的忠实子民。我去找别人来帮我完成这个任务好了，你的拒绝只能让我藐视你。

messages.en: "Those who would seek peace in times of war must stay unmistakably clear of it. Withdraw yourselves from the view of your enemy and remain unseen, for even the most innocent action is a threat in the eyes of your enemy. This you must understand, for to tempt fate too often is invariably to meet it."
messages.zh: “那些想要在战火四起的时代寻找和平的人必须要认清一个事实。把你自己从你的敌人眼前隐藏起来，任何一个在你看来无辜的行为，在你的敌人眼里都会是可疑的。只有隐居的人才能有安全。这一点你必须明白，越是躲避命运，也就越容易和命运相遇。”

messages.en: The Pacifist Manifesto: Chapter I, Verso xxiv.
messages.zh: 和平主义宣言，第一章——左页xxiv

messages.en:
There is, and I hope you will understand the importance of what I am about to ask you.

During a routine recon operation in a contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Minmatar citizens. We are unsure why they are there. In all likelihood they are assisting Republic forces in some way, either directly or indirectly. It matters little - they are savage scum who are obviously up to something.

That defensive force they had installed just recently moved elsewhere, and scouts tell us that the compound is now sitting largely defenseless. This represents an opportunity for us to remove the threat, whatever it may be. Kill them. Kill them all.
messages.zh:
关于这个，我希望你能理解我要你所做的事情的重要性。

在对附近争夺区域一次例行的侦察任务中，我们发现了一座大型的设施，里面居住了成千的米玛塔尔公民。我们没能够渗透到这座据点里面去，所以他们那儿干什么，我们无法得知。种种迹象表明，他们在以某种方式，直接或者间接的支援共和国海军行动。这些都不重要，他们这些野蛮的垃圾贩子肯定是有了什么阴谋。

他们最近安装的防御系统被移动到了其他地方，这使得这座据点基本处于无防守状态，这是我们的机会——铲除这个威胁的机会，不管到底会是什么样的威胁。干掉他们！

messages.en: I will not do this. I cannot kill people who may well be innocent bystanders, savages though they are.
messages.zh: 我决定不这么做。我不能加害这些平民，很可能他们只是无辜的旁观者，即便他们是一群野蛮人。

messages.en: Save me your confused morality, pilot. They are clearly more than innocent bystanders: Look at where they are and how heavily they were guarded! You've fallen into precisely the trap they wished to set. What a dismal display of clouded judgment. You have failed this test of faith!
messages.zh: 把你愚蠢的道德收起来吧，飞行员。他们明显不光光是无辜的野蛮人，看看他们在谁的地盘上，再看看他们有多少兵力在那儿守卫。你就是刚好掉进了他们设下的陷进，最初这么优柔寡断的决定。在忠诚的考验面前，你就这么失败了！

name.ru: Нож в горле (Knife in the Throat)

messages.en: That relay is as good as gone.
messages.zh: 那座中继塔已经完蛋了。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 太好了。摧毁中继塔后便尽快回来。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
An enemy cruiser squadron has been causing some serious trouble for our forces in this area. Unfortunately, we're also trying to deal with a Gallente offensive in this sector, and that means that regular naval forces are stretched thin. In order to take some pressure off, we need you to take out the tactical relay that they are using to coordinate their activities. Hopefully, that will buy our fleet some time to deal with the offensive.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the tactical relay, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
一只敌人的巡洋舰中队在这个地区给我们造成了一些严重的麻烦。不幸的是，我们现在的主要兵力都忙于对抗盖伦特对这个区域的进攻，同时常规海军部队的战线又已经被拉的很长。为了能减轻一些负担，我们需要你去把敌方用来组织攻击行动的战术中继塔摧毁。希望这样能够为我们的舰队争取一些时间来对付正面攻击。

飞去指定的地点，找到并摧毁战术中继塔，然后返回你的代理人那里报告。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. You've bought our fleet some time to hold the line here. I'll make sure the sector commander knows you were responsible.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。你为舰队争取了组后的时间来抵抗正面进攻。我会让战区指挥官知道你的功绩的。

messages.en: Sounds a bit small-time to me. I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 听起来不像是我的风格。我想我还是不要做这个了。

messages.en: Even small actions are important, pilot. Just because you're not in the middle of a fleet battle doesn't mean you're not making an important contribution.
messages.zh: 就算是小小的一次行动也有它的重要性所在，飞行员。不在交战最激烈的前沿阵地不代表你就不能做出重大的贡献。

messages.en:
We've identified the location of a Gallente tactical relay being used by an enemy cruiser squadron operating in the area. This squadron has been making deep penetration raids over the last week, and our sector commander has decided that elimination of this relay is the first step towards containing these incursions.

Unfortunately, our regular naval forces have their hands full dealing with an enemy offensive several systems away and protecting our supply lines holding the line in that area. As a result, I've been tasked with finding a loyal capsuleer who can take care of the problem for us. We'd like for you to give it a shot.
messages.zh:
我们确定了一座盖伦特用来指挥他们在这个区域的一只巡洋舰中队所用的战术中继塔。这个巡洋舰中队最近渗透到我们战线后方实施了一系列的破坏活动。我们的战区指挥官决定要消灭这支部队，作为防止地方更进一步侵犯的第一步。

不巧的是，我们的常规海军部队最近正忙于应付敌人对我们多个星系的侵犯，保卫我们的补给线能够正常的运转。这样一来，我们就要找一个忠诚的克隆飞行员来为我们处理这个麻烦。你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: There's too many of them; I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. You'll have to find some other sucker for this one.
messages.zh: 他们人太多了，我根本就没法靠近那个中继塔。你还是找别人吧。

messages.en: I thought you were supposed to be some hotshot pilot. All talk, huh?
messages.zh: 我还以为你是个

name.fr: Les meilleurs partent toujours en premier
name.ru: Только хорошие умирают молодыми (Only the Good Die Young)

messages.en: I'll put an end to their winning streak, don't worry.
messages.zh: 我会结束他们的运气的，别担心。

messages.en: Good. Make sure you're ready for a protracted battle. You may have to wade through a number of enemy capsuleers.
messages.zh: 很好，准备好打一场持久战吧。你可能得要和不少敌人的克隆飞行员苦战一番。

messages.en:
An enemy force has been launching increasingly bold attacks against us. They've been taking advantage of the fact that we have bigger troubles to deal with, and coming away victorious more often than not.

The general staff has decided to put an end to this campaign by striking a crippling blow to their morale. We want you to eliminate the enemy sector commander at these coordinates; all other targets are secondary.
messages.zh:
敌人的军队对我们的进攻越来越密集疯狂。在我们处理别的危机的空档，他们趁人之危越来越嚣张。

总参谋部决定要结束这种状况，给他们的士气予以狠狠一击。我们希望你去把敌人的区域指挥官给干掉。坐标已经给你，除了区域指挥官之外的都是次要目标。

messages.en: The enemy commander has been eliminated, sir.
messages.zh: 敌人的指挥官已经被消灭了，长官。

messages.en: Well, that should put ‘em in their place. Nice work, pilot. I'll make sure the general staff knows you were responsible.
messages.zh: 你做的很好，飞行员。我一定会在总参谋部那儿好好的表扬你一番。

messages.en: I'm really not comfortable with this.
messages.zh: 我对这个不太有心情。

messages.en: This is war, pilot. It's not about your comfort.
messages.zh: 这就是战争，飞行员。我们不是在谈论你的心情。

messages.en:
As I'm sure you're already aware, pilot, one of the most precious resources a military force has is morale. Battles can be won or lost by it, and wars can be turned by it. That is why one of our top priorities has been the disruption of the enemy's morale.

Lately, the Gallente have enjoyed a string of small but dramatic victories over our forces in this sector. Though the damage inflicted to our forces has been negligible, the enemy forces responsible for these actions, especially their commander, have been emboldened and now they are pushing their luck more and more.

The general staff has determined that striking a crippling blow to their morale will likely put an end to this nonsense once and for all. We want you to eliminate their commander. With any luck, this will scatter them to the winds and put an end to these raids.
messages.zh:
我想你已经知道了，飞行员。军队最重要的一项资源就是士气，它可以左右战场的成败，可以转变战争的局势。这也是为什么挫伤敌人的士气是我们的首要任务之一。

最近，盖伦特在这个区域对我们的作战中取得了一些小胜利。尽管这些伤害对我们的部队来说是不值一提的，但这却让敌人的指挥官越来得寸进尺，越来越胆大，妄图把他们的”运气“跟进一步的推到我们的门口。

总参谋部决定要结束这种状况，给他们的士气予以狠狠一击。我们希望你去把敌人的区域指挥官给干掉。希望这样能够打散他们的攻击计划。

messages.en: I'll get that intelligence for you.
messages.zh: 我会帮你搞到那个情报。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it, pilot. Here's the coordinates; remember, that tactical information sheet is the primary objective. Any other damage is secondary.
messages.zh: 很高兴听到这个。这是坐标，记住，那份战术情报文件是你的首要目标，其他的都不是很重要。

messages.en:
The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from a Gallente detention camp. In order to pave the way for the raid, we need to get information on the disposition of the enemy forces so that our strike force and the vulnerable transports coming with them can make it to the detention camp unmolested.

In order to get that intelligence, we need you to raid the base of an enemy force in this sector. We need you to get the tactical information sheet from the outpost and bring it back here in preparation for the prisoner raid.
messages.zh:
总参部正在计划一次营救行动，目标是解救在盖伦特集中营里面的一些战俘。为了能够为营救行动作铺垫，我们需要了解敌人集中营的兵力布置，这样我们的打击部队和人员运输舰才能够方便的打入集中营。

为了得到这些情报，我们希望你能够去突袭在这个区域一座敌人的基地。找到在那个哨站里的战术情报文件并带回来给我用来准备营救行动。

messages.en: I've got the information sheet. Does it have the data you're looking for?
messages.zh: 我拿到文件了，有你要找的数据么？

messages.en: Nice work, pilot; I'll send this off to the boys at intel. With any luck, you've just given us what we need to bring some of our brave warriors home.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员；我会把这个传给情报部门的小伙子们。运气好的话，你所带来的情报就能把我们的战士们带回家来。

messages.en: I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 这事儿我懒得管。

messages.en: I hope you can live with the lives of those prisoners on your conscience.
messages.zh: 我希望你的良心能够承受这些囚犯的生命。
