messages.en:
You've got a real chance to be a hero here, pilot. The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from a Gallente detention camp. The only problem is that we need to get intelligence on the distribution of enemy forces prior to the raid in order to pave the way for our strike force and the vulnerable transports that will need to be sent in with it. That's where you come in.

We know that one of the enemy fleets in this area has copies of the data that we need. You will need to penetrate their base of operations and retrieve the tactical information sheet from the outpost there. Bring that back to me and we can get the planning for this raid underway.
messages.zh:
现在你有一次做英雄的真正机会。总参部正在计划一次营救行动，目标是解救在盖伦特集中营里面的一些战俘。为了能够为营救行动作铺垫，我们需要了解敌人集中营的兵力布置，这样我们的打击部队和人员运输舰才能够方便的打入集中营。

我们知道在这个区域的一支敌方舰队手里有这份情报，为了得到它，我们希望你能够去突袭在这个区域一座敌人的基地。找到在那个哨站里的战术情报文件并带回来给我用来准备营救行动。

messages.en: This doesn't sound like a problem. I can take care of it for sure.
messages.zh: 这不是个问题，我当然能够处理的了。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it! Once you make sure every industrial is destroyed, return to me to report. Just watch out for capsuleers flying on their side and equip yourself to defend against them first and foremost.
messages.zh: 很高兴听到这些！一旦你确定已经把所有的工业舰都摧毁了，就回来向我报告。你要当心那些在那儿附近游荡的敌方克隆飞行员，武装好你的舰船来应付可能的遭遇。

messages.en: I don't have voice mail, so I guess I'd better pick up!
messages.zh: 我没有语音信箱，我想还是最好接起来！

messages.en:
A convoy is heading to supply a station in a contested system. That station provides food, water, clothing, and other basic equipment for the Gallente forces in the area. We've managed to pinpoint the convoy's location, so we can send you out to take care of them for us.

Destroy the convoy before they can unload their cargo.
messages.zh:
一只护航补给舰对正在前往一座位于争夺区域的空间站执行补给任务。这座空间站为那个区域的盖伦特军队提供食物、水、服装以及各种基础装备。我们想办法确定了补给舰队的位置，现在我们要把你派过去对付这支补给船队。

在他们能抵达目的地卸货之前消灭补给船队。

messages.en: I hope those Gallente cowards can make due without their cheeses and heavy sauces! Because I just blew them all up!
messages.zh: 希望这些悲剧的盖伦特人能在没有奶酪和火腿的这段时间熬过去。

messages.en: Excellent. Without supplies, the Gallente forces in the area will lose morale! It'll allow us to make inroads into the system.
messages.zh: 很好。没有了补给，那个区域的盖伦特军队很快就会失去士气！让我们有机会可以打入他们的星系。

messages.en: Blowing up industrials? Sounds boring! Give me something difficult, will you?
messages.zh: 打几艘工业舰？听起来太无聊了，拿点有些难度的事情给我做好不好。

messages.en: Tch. I didn't think you would turn this down.
messages.zh: 啊！我没想到你会让人这么失望。

messages.en:
I've been waiting for you to show up! We have a small problem. The Gallente have a hidden supply depot inside a contested system. Normally, we would just go and destroy it, but we can't spare the manpower at the moment.

However, we've discovered that they're running low on supplies and are receiving a shipment of new equipment any time now. If we can stop them from restocking, we'll force the enemy to begin heavy rationing, which will harm their morale. Imagine the looks on their faces when they hear they can't have their snack-time. Are you up to the task?
messages.zh:
我一直在等待你的出现！我们这儿有点小麻烦。盖伦特在附近的争夺区域有一个隐藏的补给站。通常情况下，我们会直接把它给端掉，但是现在人力有限。

不管怎样，我们已经发现他们现在的补给出现了问题，正在等待新的装备抵达。如果我能够阻碍他们的补给进行，那么就能使他们的后勤出现大麻烦从而引发士气受到巨大打击。想象一下当连吃的都成问题的时候他们脸上会是什么样的表情。你愿意接受这个任务么？

messages.en: It turned out to be more difficult than I expected. I'm going to have to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这比我想象的要难得多。我放弃了。

messages.en: Thanks to those supplies getting through, we'll have to face fresh enemies in the area.
messages.zh: 的要感谢这些补给物资，现在我们要面对一大帮精神焕发的敌人了。

messages.en: I'll smash those miners like they smash those asteroids!
messages.zh: 我会把这些矿工都碾成饼。

messages.en:
Our scanners haven't revealed any combat ships escorting the miners. That could be simple hubris on the part of the Gallente, or it could mean they've reinforcements a short way away. The miners are the only important targets, so focus on them.

Just be careful, as I said earlier -- capsuleers loyal to the Federation are in the area.
messages.zh:
我们的扫描器没有发现任何战斗船只在保护这些采矿船。要么是这些盖伦特人过于傲慢，要么就是他们的增援还在路上。采矿船是你的首要目标，集中火力对付他们。

但是要小心，我听说联邦的一些克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动，你可能要对付他们，而且这些人的威胁可能来得更高。

messages.en: Oh how glorious it is! What do you have for me?
messages.zh: 哦，这真是太好了，你有什么活儿给我做。

messages.en:
Those damn Gallente have managed to discover an asteroid belt in one of the contested systems nearby! Head over there and destroy them as soon as possible. Once you do, we can exploit the resources ourselves.

Just make sure you're ready to fight. Capsuleers loyal to the Federation might be out in force.
messages.zh:
这些可恶的盖伦特人在附近的争夺区域找到了一个小行星矿带！你尽快赶过去消灭它们。一旦成功，我们就可以自己去开采这些资源了。

做好准备战斗。为联邦卖力的克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动。

messages.en: I've taken out the miners, no sweat.
messages.zh: 我已经把矿工铲除了，不费吹灰之力。

messages.en: Excellent job. With those rats gone, we'll be able to exploit the resources and further fund our efforts. Even better, it seems like you got there in time to stop them from mining the choicest asteroids. This will not be forgotten.
messages.zh: 干的很漂亮。这些渣滓被铲除后我们就能够专心的开采这些资源为我们的国家服务。关键在于，是你赶在损失扩大之前赶到那儿制止了他们的这种行为，这将是不会被忘记的。

messages.en: They found it, they deserve it. I can't take your mission.
messages.zh: 是他们找到了这些矿石，是他们应得的。我不要做你的这个任务。

messages.en: I'm surprised you don't have the stomach for it.
messages.zh: 我很吃惊你居然没胆子干这事儿。

messages.en:
It's no secret that many hidden asteroid belts dot all of known space. Some of them are so valuable that our people would risk going into contested space to find and exploit them. Well, we've recently done just that -- we discovered a fairly sizable asteroid belt. In Gallente-contested space...

Trouble is, the Gallente seem to have noticed. But we simply can't let them take it: If you can drive them out of there, we'll send in a special ops mining force and have those precious mineral resources all to ourselves. Can you do it?
messages.zh:
在已知的空余中布满了大大小小隐藏着的小行星矿带的事实已经不是什么秘密了；其中有些还非常的值价——无论是我们的敌人还是我们自己都愿意冒险到处于战争状态的争夺区域去开采这些矿石。我们发现了一个高产量小行星矿带——它正是处在一个盖伦特所属的争夺空域。我们肯定不能让他们就这样拿走我们的资源。

如果你能把它们都从那儿赶出去，我们就能自己去开采这些价值连城的矿石资源了。你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: It turns out this was more than I could handle. I'm sorry!
messages.zh: 我发现这已经超出了我能够控制的范围。不好意思。

messages.en: Was the mission really that difficult?
messages.zh: 这个任务真有这么难？

messages.en: That repair crew won't have a chance. Don't worry about it.
messages.zh: 那些修门的人没机会完成自己的工作。放心好了。

messages.en: I figured as much! I've already uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. You shouldn't have too much trouble taking out the repair ships. It is in a contested system, so you may find Federation-aligned capsuleers patrolling the place.
messages.zh: 我有了很多发现！我已经把那座星门的坐标上传到你的控制边栏中了。打掉那几艘维修船对你来说应该是很简单的。但它位于一个争夺状态的区域里，你应该要做好准备迎击那些巡弋在附近的联邦克隆飞行员。

messages.en: I'm a capsuleer! I don't need to put my life on the line to get the job done.
messages.zh: 我是个克隆飞行员，我更本不需要把我的生命压上去来完成这种任务。

messages.en: An old smuggler's gate connects a system deep inside Federation territory with one of the contested systems nearby. It's been offline for years, but the Federation is trying to get it running again. Destroy the repair ships trying to repair the gate.
messages.zh: 这是个陈旧的非法贩售者修筑的星门，它通往联邦领土深处一个争夺区域附近。它已经停止使用多年了，但是敌人正在尝试让它重新运转。消灭那些正在维修这个星门的舰船。

messages.en: I've taken out that repair crew! The gate remains offline for now.
messages.zh: 我已经消灭了那些维修船！星门目前依然处于不可用状态。

messages.en: I hope it wasn't too much trouble for you. With that repair crew out of the way, we can take our time and send a demolition crew to destroy it when we get the chance. You have done the State proud.
messages.zh: 我希望之对你来说不算是个太大的麻烦。等到把那些维修船都打掉了，我们就有时间派出拆除作业团队去将星门完全拆除。你的勇敢让合众国十分骄傲。

messages.en: I'm not sure I can take them out in time.
messages.zh: 我不是很确定我能不能把它们及时地消灭掉。

messages.en: Well someone needs to take care of that repair crew. I guess I can find someone else.
messages.zh: 总得有人去把那些维修船干掉。我猜我还能找到别人去做。

messages.en:
Our contested territory is riddled with old, inoperable gates. Some of them were put up by our enemies, others by common smugglers hoping to get past customs. Well, it turns out that the Federation has discovered one of these derelict gates. Normally, this wouldn't be an issue, but the gate connects to a system deep in Federation space.

I don't need to tell you what could happen if the Gallente get that gate online. We can't spare the manpower to destroy the gate itself, but the ships working to repair it aren't nearly so sturdy.

I want you to fly over there and take them out. Are you up for it?
messages.zh:
我们的争夺中领土到处都可以看到年久失修的星门。有一些是我们的敌人安放的，有一些则是希望通过这种方法逃脱关税的非法贩售者安置的。结果，我们发现联邦找到了一座废弃的星门。通常这并不能算是什么事情，但是他们这次发现的这个星门链接到了联邦深处的一个星系。

我想我不说你也应该知道这意味着什么，如果那些盖伦特人把那座星门重新修复激活的话。我们暂时没法分散更多的人力去搞定那座星门，但是那些负责维修它的舰船则不是那么难对付的。

我要你飞过去把他们都干掉，你能接这个任务么？

messages.en: It turns out I wasn't prepared to tackle this mission. I'm going to have to abandon it.
messages.zh: 我发现原来我根本就没有准备好完成这个任务。我还是只有退出了。

messages.en: Grr. I wish I'd known you couldn't handle it from the start!
messages.zh: 呃～。我真希望一开始就知道你没法干这事儿。

messages.en: Understood, I'll arrange a meeting with her and consequence.
messages.zh: 明白了，我会去会会她。

messages.en: Spare me the tough talk, pilot. Action is the only language I respect. Move it.
messages.zh: 我也不想说太多了，飞行员。行动才是最有说服力的。快去吧。

messages.en: Ready and willing. How can I help?
messages.zh: 随时都准备好的，你要我怎么做？

messages.en: We've been watching Federation Navy units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Caldari; most of them non-combatants I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.
messages.zh: 我们正在监视快速堆积到附近争夺区域的联邦舰队作战单位，在我们就要开始对他们实施攻击的时候，我们发现他们的一个高级前线指挥官刚刚抵达了那里。这个女人，他们的前线指挥官害死了无数的加达里人民，这些受害者大部分还是平民。除了她和她的卫兵其他的我都不管了。干掉她们，你会得到应有的报酬的，甚至是人民的尊敬。

messages.en: She's dead.
messages.zh: 她已经挂掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. Not bad…not bad at all. Keep it up and we might just trust you with more important work down the line.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。不错，非常不错。再接再厉，我们会把接下来的更多的任务交给你的。

messages.en: Get someone else for the job; I'm not some cheap assassin.
messages.zh: 另外找人吧，我可不是个无耻的刺客。

messages.en: Cheap Assassin? She is the cheap assassin. Non-combatants are her primary targets! I don't give a damn how highly you think of yourself so long as our people stop dying. Forget it; I'll get someone else who actually has a shred of patriotism and empathy.
messages.zh: 无耻的刺客？她是个卑劣无耻下流的清道夫，专门以平民为目标！只有我们的人民一天不停止死亡我就永远不会觉得你算得上是个什么东西。算了，我另外去找一个有爱国心和怜悯的人来做这个任务

messages.en: The breakdown in relations between the empires has seen huge losses in civilian life as they all target “weak points” and set missions specifically to “maximize morale loss.” In a war, there are few who will not see the atrocities of conflict and defenseless non-combatants are no exception. Those who lead such missions however, sit at the very top of their enemy's target lists.
messages.zh: 国家之间的深仇大恨造成了大量平民的生命在利益的冲突中牺牲，他们互相都把平民作为是对方的“软肋”和对士气最大打击的着手点。在战争中很少有人会受到怜悯，平民也不例外。这些执行残酷命令的人，总是会处在敌人击毁名单的最前端。

messages.en: Collateral Damage
messages.zh: 附带伤害

messages.en:
Good. I need you for an assassination, and this is something you best not screw up.

We've been watching Federation Navy units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Caldari; most of them non-combatants. She has a penchant for hitting weakened and unsupported civilian structures. She is scum, and I want her dead.

This is surgical stuff, pilot. She'll slip away if we go in there with full force. I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.

Simple as that, now get going.
messages.zh:
很好。我需要你执行一个行刺任务，你最好别搞砸了。

我们正在监视快速堆积到附近争夺区域的联邦舰队作战单位，在我们就要开始对他们实施攻击的时候，我们发现他们的一个高级前线指挥官刚刚抵达了那里。这个女人，他们的前线指挥官害死了无数的加达里人民，这些受害者大部分还是平民。她有一个嗜好就是攻击毫无防备和反抗之力的平民建筑。他是一个垃圾，我要她死。

这是个精细活，如果我们大举进攻的话她可能会毫无踪迹的溜掉。除了她和她的卫兵其他的我都不管了。干掉她们，你会得到应有的报酬的，甚至是人民的尊敬。

就这么简单，现在就赶快去办吧。

messages.en: I can't get to her; you're going to have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不能靠近她；你另外找人去吧。

messages.en: What an utter disappointment you are. Next time, do not offer services beyond your ability. Eggers and their pride…just get out of here.
messages.zh: 你简直让人失望透顶了。下一次不要再冲汉子说大话了。你们这些生活在鸡蛋里的人……快从这儿滚出去。

messages.en: I'll set out immediately.
messages.zh: 我这就出发。

messages.en: You'll hear from me shortly. Pay close attention to my orders and obey them exactly.
messages.zh: 我很快就会再联系你。注意听我指挥，严格按照命令行动。

messages.en: That's why I'm here, how can I help?
messages.zh: 这正是我来这里的原因，我能帮上什么忙？

messages.en: Moments ago we launched an offensive against a Federation compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in. I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field.
messages.zh: 之前我们深入了联邦一个重兵把守的基地，对那里发动了一次袭击。我们不想冒险遭围剿，因此我们需要你帮忙。我要你飞过去确保这次行动的成功。你到战场后我会向你发出战术指示。

messages.en: Good call on the Commander, it seems to have worked.
messages.zh: 你指挥地不错，效果很好。

messages.en: Orders are only as good as the people who carry them out. That was some good work out there, pilot; calm, precise and efficient. You fly like a real Caldari. Keep it up.
messages.zh: 命令还是要靠人去执行的。你干得不错，飞行员——冷静、精准、高效。这才像真正的加达里人。希望能再接再厉。

messages.en: I won't be able to help with something like this I'm afraid, that sector is too far out of my way.
messages.zh: 恐怕我对此无能为力，那对我来说太强了。

messages.en: Why should I care? You asked how you could help so I'm telling you. Clearly I'm wasting my damn time in the process. A piece of advice rookie, don't ask if you can help when you have no concept of the expectations likely to be put upon you.
messages.zh: 你跟我说这干什么？是你自己问是否可以帮忙我才告诉你这一切的。看来我是在浪费时间。但菜鸟，我还是要给你一条忠告：如果你没做好不负重托的准备，就不要问别人你能否帮忙。

messages.en: Changes in technology and in particular, the advent of the jump drive, has made the battlefields of space a dynamic and unpredictable arena. Where previously reinforcements could take many hours or even days to arrive on-field, now they can be dropped immediately into the fray with a single cynosaural field. When the technology first appeared, all four empires had to drastically revise their outdated battle tactics and this is a process still happening even today. Mistakes are still made, and the cost of hubris and underestimation is usually high.
messages.zh: 由于科技的更新，尤其是跳跃飞行的出现，战场形势一下子变得瞬息万变起来。以前增援部队抵达战场可能要耗费数小时甚至数天时间，现在利用一个诱导力场便能立刻冲上战斗前线。该技术刚出现的时候，四大帝国被迫脱胎换骨似地修改他们那些老掉牙的战术，直到今天这修改还是一直不断。错误依旧有人犯，而傲慢与低估更是让人付出惨痛代价。

messages.en: A necessary adaptation
messages.zh: 必需的调整

messages.en:
Moments ago we launched an offensive against a Federation compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support.

Initial reconnaissance has suggested they may have the capability to field more vessels than we had originally anticipated. Naturally, we're not turning around in the face of this news, we've come too far and a retreat will only encourage them. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in.

I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field. Don't worry about any orders or cohesion with our own forces there, you'll be answering directly to me and following only my orders.

Briefing over. Get going.
messages.zh:
之前我们深入了联邦一个重兵把守的基地，对那里发动了一次袭击。

现在情报显示他们当时派出的舰船可能比我们预料的还要多。当然我们不可能在获悉这一消息后就进行撤退，那样话只会助长他们的士气。不过我们也不想冒险遭围剿，因此我们需要你帮忙。

我要你飞过去确保这次行动的成功。你到战场后我会向你发出战术指示。不用担心与我们自己的部队会有冲突，你直接听我指挥就行。

讲完了，出发吧。

messages.en: I can't commit myself to this after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.
messages.zh: 我没法保证我能完成这任务。但愿你能及时找到其他人。

messages.en: What?! I already told my superiors the matter was being handled. I'm really glad you hope I can find someone else, rookie. That means so much to me whilst our own people are out there risking their lives. Don't let me catch you repeating this performance.
messages.zh: 什么？！我已经告诉上级这事正在被处理了。还好你能希望我另找他人，菜鸟。我自己人正在那面冒着搭上命的风险呢。别让我看到你再有这样的表现。

messages.en: Without question. Give me the coordinates.
messages.zh: 没什么要问的，直接把坐标给我。

messages.en: I am relieved to see you have such good judgement. I'm sending you the location now; move quickly before their compound is reinforced once again.
messages.zh: 你能有这样的判断能力我很高兴。我马上将地址发送给你，赶快过去在他们的增援来到之前做出行动。

messages.en: That's why I've come. Is there any work you can give me?
messages.zh: 这正是我来这儿的原因，有什么事儿可以让我做么？

messages.en:
During a routine recon operation inside a nearby contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Gallente; in all likelihood they are mercenaries assisting Federation Navy forces in some way. We have an opportunity to remove the threat, though, whatever it may be.

Though it is a grim task I ask of you, it is one that must be done. Destroy the facility, for the security of our great State.
messages.zh:
最近一次在附近争夺区域的例行巡逻任务中，我们发现了一个大型设施，里面居住了数千盖伦特公民。种种迹象表明，他们正在以某种方式支援联邦军队，无论直接或者是间接的。我们有机会消除这个威胁。

尽管这听上去是一个糟糕的事情，但是总有人要去执行这样的任务。为了我们的国家，摧毁那个设施。

messages.en: I have done as you asked: the facility is destroyed.
messages.zh: 我按照你要求的做了，那个设施已经被摧毁。

messages.en: You have done well, pilot. Those Federation guerrillas can pose no further threat.
messages.zh: 你做得很好，飞行员。盖伦特在这个地区将不再有任何威胁了。祝你好运。

messages.en: No, I can't do this. We should investigate why they're here before we start shooting. Get back to me when you've done so and then I might be interested.
messages.zh: 不，我不能这么做。我们应当在开火前仔细的调查他们为什么这么做。等你调查好了再找我，可能我会有兴趣的。

messages.en: The arrogance of you eggers! I do not report to you! I will simply find someone else to carry out this task. Your refusal has achieved nothing but my disdain!
messages.zh: 你们这帮傲慢的蠢人！我才是你的上司！我去找别人来帮我完成这个任务好了，你的拒绝没有任何意义，只是赢得了我的藐视！

messages.en: "Those who would seek peace in times of war must stay unmistakably clear of it. Withdraw yourselves from the view of your enemy and remain unseen, for even the most innocent action is a threat in the eyes of your enemy. This you must understand, for to tempt fate too often is invariably to meet it."
messages.zh: “那些想要在战火四起的时代寻找和平的人必须要认清一个事实。把你自己从你的敌人眼前隐藏起来，任何一个在你看来无辜的行为，在你的敌人眼里都会是可疑的。只有隐居的人才能有安全。这一点你必须明白，越是躲避命运，也就越容易和命运相遇。”

messages.en: The Pacifist Manifesto: Chapter I, Verso xxiv
messages.zh: 和平主义宣言，第一章——左页xxiv

messages.en:
There is, and I hope you will understand the importance of what I am about to ask you.

During a recon operation in a nearby contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Gallente. We've had no luck infiltrating the compound, so we are unsure why they are here. In all likelihood they are assisting Federation forces in some way, though: When we first discovered the facility, it was heavily guarded. They are obviously up to something.

That defensive force they had installed just recently moved elsewhere, however, and the compound is now sitting largely defenseless. This represents an opportunity for us to remove the potential threat. Though it is a grim task I ask of you, it is one that must be done. Can I rely on you to carry it out?
messages.zh:
关于这个，我希望你能理解我要你所做的事情的重要性。

在对附近争夺区域一次例行的侦察任务中，我们发现了一座大型设施，里面居住了成千的盖伦特公民。我们没能够渗透到这座据点里面去，所以他们那儿干什么，我们无法得知。种种迹象表明，他们在以某种方式，直接或者间接地支援联邦海军行动。这些都不重要，他们肯定是有了什么阴谋。

他们最近安装的防御系统被移动到了其他地方，这使得这座据点基本处于无防守状态，这是我们的机会——铲除这个威胁的机会，不管到底会是什么样的威胁。我能够把这个重任托付于你吧？

messages.en: I cannot kill thousands of people unless I am assured of their guilt, {[character]agentID.name}, Gallente or otherwise.
messages.zh: 我反对这么做。{[character]agentID.name}，我不能加害这些平民，他们很可能只是无辜的旁观者。

messages.en: Spare me your philosophizing - we are at war! They are clearly more than innocent bystanders; just look at where they are and how heavily they were guarded. Obviously you are not the right person for this job. I will find another.
messages.zh: 把你愚蠢的道德收起来吧，我们这是在打仗。他们明显不光光是无辜的野蛮人，看看他们在谁的地盘上，再看看他们有多少兵力在那儿放着。你就是刚好掉进了他们设下的陷进。很明显你不是干这事儿的人，我去找别人执行这个任务好了。

name.ru: Волк среди овец (A Wolf in the Fold)

messages.en: It'll be my pleasure.
messages.zh: 我很高兴做这事。

messages.en: Excellent.  Remember, take out the reactor; anything else is just a bonus. Good hunting, pilot.
messages.zh: 太好了。记住，摧毁反应堆；其他都是次要目标。祝你顺利，飞行员。

messages.en: I'm game. What's the job?
messages.zh: 我早有准备。要干什么？

messages.en: A reconnaissance patrol has located the base of a group of Gallente raiders operating near this system. In order to secure our supply lines, you will need to fly to the base and destroy its main reactor, knocking it out of action. Any additional damage you can do to static defenses or the enemy raiding fleets would certainly be appreciated.
messages.zh: 一支盖伦特突袭队正在该星系附近转悠，我们的侦察巡逻队已经找到了他们的基地。为了保住我们的补给线，你得飞往那基地，炸毁其主反应堆让它发挥不了作用。如果你能把那些防御工事或是敌方舰队也解决的话，那是再好不过的了。

messages.en: The reactor's been destroyed.
messages.zh: 反应堆摧毁了。

messages.en: Great work, pilot. We're already putting together a counterstrike in case they come to repair it. You've helped us bait the trap perfectly, and saved a load of war materiel and lives in the process.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。他们一旦回来修那东西我们就能组织一次反击了。你帮我们设下了一个完美陷阱，同时还节省了不少战争物资，避免了不必要的牺牲。

messages.en: I'll pass. I feel like there's something you're not telling me.
messages.zh: 我不干。我觉得你对我隐瞒了什么东西。

messages.en: I don't know what you're talking about, but if that's the way you're going to be, then I'll find someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 我不知道你在说什么。如果你偏要那么想，那我就去另寻他人。

messages.en:
Our supply lines have been taking heavy damage from Gallente raids near this system. Until recently, we were baffled as to where the enemy force was resupplying. Luckily, a reconnaissance patrol just returned with sensor data that seems to correspond with the reactor emissions of a Gallente base, and it's in exactly the right place to be supporting these raids.

We want you to fly to the location of these reactor emissions, locate the base, and destroy its main reactor; that should be enough to put it out of action for a while. The thing to remember is that the base is likely to be well-protected, with static defenses if nothing else. I'd advise being careful on your approach. Keep an eye out for any raiding groups returning to resupply. Are you ready?
messages.zh:
我们的补给线在这星系附近遭到了盖伦特部队的严重袭击。前几天我们一直搞不清他们的后勤保障从何而来。还好我们的侦察巡逻队刚上报了一个信号数据，据此推断可能是盖伦特基地上的一个反应堆，而这应该就是盖伦特突袭队的后勤基地。

我们要你飞到那个反应堆那里，找到基地，摧毁其主反应堆；这样的话它就能消停好一会儿了。要记住那基地很可能戒备森严，即使没有什么其他防御，至少也有站桩式的防御工事。我建议你谨慎行事。要随时提防回来补给的突袭队。准备好了吗？

messages.en: There's too many of them! I can't deal with firepower of that magnitude.
messages.zh: 他们人太多了！我吃不消那样的火力。

messages.en: I'm extremely disappointed. Hopefully, I can find someone else to take this mission before they hit us again; if I can't, I hope you realize that those losses will be on your head, pilot.
messages.zh: 你让我极度失望。但愿我能在他们再次对我们施行打击之前找到其他人来接手该任务；如果不能，那一切损失都将算到你头上，飞行员。

name.ru: Нож в горле (Knife in the Throat)

messages.en: That relay is as good as gone.
messages.zh: 那座中继塔已经完蛋了。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 太好了。摧毁中继塔后便尽快回来。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
An enemy cruiser squadron has been causing some serious trouble for our forces in this area. Unfortunately, we're also trying to deal with a Caldari offensive in this sector, and that means that regular naval forces are stretched thin. In order to take some pressure off, we need you to take out the tactical relay that they are using to coordinate their activities. Hopefully, that will buy our fleet some time to deal with the offensive.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the tactical relay, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
一只敌人的巡洋舰中队在这个地区给我们造成了一些严重的麻烦。不幸的是，我们现在的主要兵力都忙于对抗加达里对这个区域的进攻，同时常规海军部队的战线又已经被拉的很长。为了能减轻一些负担，我们需要你去把敌方用来组织攻击行动的战术中继塔摧毁。希望这样能够为我们的舰队争取一些时间来对付正面攻击。

飞去指定的地点，找到并摧毁战术中继塔，然后返回你的代理人那里报告。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Sounds a bit small-time to me. I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 听起来不像是我的风格。我想我还是不要做这个了。

messages.en:
We've identified the location of a Caldari tactical relay being used by an enemy cruiser squadron operating in the area. This squadron has been making deep penetration raids over the last week, and our sector commander has decided that elimination of this relay is the first step towards containing these incursions.

Unfortunately, our regular naval forces have their hands full dealing with an enemy offensive several systems away and protecting our supply lines holding the line in that area. As a result, I've been tasked with finding a loyal capsuleer who can take care of the problem for us. We'd like for you to give it a shot.
messages.zh:
我们确定了一座加达里用来指挥他们在这个区域的一只巡洋舰中队所用的战术中继塔。这个巡洋舰中队最近渗透到我们战线后方实施了一系列的破坏活动。我们的战区指挥官决定要消灭这支部队，作为防止地方更进一步侵犯的第一步。

不巧的是，我们的常规海军部队最近正忙于应付敌人对我们多个星系的侵犯，保卫我们的补给线能够正常的运转。这样一来，我们就要找一个忠诚的克隆飞行员来为我们处理这个麻烦。你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: There's too many of them; I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. You'll have to find some other sucker for this one.
messages.zh: 他们人太多了，我根本就没法靠近那个中继塔。你还是找别人吧。

messages.en: I thought you were supposed to be some hotshot pilot. All talk, huh?
messages.zh: 我还以为你是个

name.fr: Les meilleurs partent toujours en premier
name.ru: Только хорошие умирают молодыми (Only the Good Die Young)

messages.en: I'll put an end to their winning streak, don't worry.
messages.zh: 我会结束他们的运气的，别担心。

messages.en: Good. Make sure you're ready for a protracted battle. You may have to wade through a number of enemy capsuleers.
messages.zh: 很好，准备好打一场持久战吧。你可能得要和不少敌人的克隆飞行员苦战一番。

messages.en:
An enemy force has been launching increasingly bold attacks against us. They've been taking advantage of the fact that we have bigger troubles to deal with, and coming away victorious more often than not.

The general staff has decided to put an end to this campaign by striking a crippling blow to their morale. We want you to eliminate the enemy sector commander at these coordinates; all other targets are secondary.
messages.zh:
敌人的军队对我们的进攻越来越密集疯狂。在我们处理别的危机的空档，他们趁人之危越来越嚣张。

总参谋部决定要结束这种状况，给他们的士气予以狠狠一击。我们希望你去把敌人的区域指挥官给干掉。坐标已经给你，除了区域指挥官之外的都是次要目标。

messages.en: The enemy commander has been eliminated, sir.
messages.zh: 敌人的指挥官已经被消灭了，长官。

messages.en: Well, that should put ‘em in their place. Nice work, pilot. I'll make sure the general staff knows you were responsible.
messages.zh: 你做的很好，飞行员。我一定会在总参谋部那儿好好的表扬你一番。

messages.en: I'm really not comfortable with this.
messages.zh: 我对这个不太有心情。

messages.en: This is war, pilot. It's not about your comfort.
messages.zh: 这就是战争，飞行员。我们不是在谈论你的心情。

messages.en:
As I'm sure you're already aware, pilot, one of the most precious resources a military force has is morale. Battles can be won or lost by it, and wars can be turned by it. That is why one of our top priorities has been the disruption of the enemy's morale.

Lately, the Caldari have enjoyed a string of small but dramatic victories over our forces in this sector. Though the damage inflicted to our forces has been negligible, the enemy forces responsible for these actions, especially their commander, have been emboldened and now they are pushing their luck more and more.

The general staff has determined that striking a crippling blow to their morale will likely put an end to this nonsense once and for all. We want you to eliminate their commander. With any luck, this will scatter them to the winds and put an end to these raids.
messages.zh:
我想你已经知道了，飞行员。军队最重要的一项资源就是士气，它可以左右战场的成败，可以转变战争的局势。这也是为什么挫伤敌人的士气是我们的首要任务之一。

最近，加达里在这个区域对我们的作战中取得了一些小胜利。尽管这些伤害对我们的部队来说是不值一提的，但这却让敌人的指挥官越来得寸进尺，越来越胆大，妄图把他们的”运气“跟进一步的推到我们的门口。

总参谋部决定要结束这种状况，给他们的士气予以狠狠一击。我们希望你去把敌人的区域指挥官给干掉。希望这样能够打散他们的攻击计划。

messages.en: I'll get that intelligence for you.
messages.zh: 我会帮你搞到那个情报。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it, pilot. Here's the coordinates; remember, that tactical information sheet is the primary objective. Any other damage is secondary.
messages.zh: 很高兴听到这个。这是坐标，记住，那份战术情报文件是你的首要目标，其他的都不是很重要。

messages.en:
The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from a Caldari detention camp. In order to pave the way for the raid, we need to get information on the disposition of the enemy forces so that our strike force and the vulnerable transports coming with them can make it to the detention camp unmolested.

In order to get that intelligence, we need you to raid the base of an enemy force in this sector. We need you to get the tactical information sheet from the outpost and bring it back here in preparation for the prisoner raid.
messages.zh:
总参部正在计划一次营救行动，目标是解救在加达里集中营里面的一些战俘。为了能够为营救行动作铺垫，我们需要了解敌人集中营的兵力布置，这样我们的打击部队和人员运输舰才能够方便的打入集中营。

为了得到这些情报，我们希望你能够去突袭在这个区域一座敌人的基地。找到在那个哨站里的战术情报文件并带回来给我用来准备营救行动。

messages.en: I've got the information sheet. Does it have the data you're looking for?
messages.zh: 我拿到文件了，有你要找的数据么？

messages.en: Nice work, pilot; I'll send this off to the boys at intel. With any luck, you've just given us what we need to bring some of our brave warriors home.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员；我会把这个传给情报部门的小伙子们。运气好的话，你所带来的情报就能把我们的战士们带回家来。

messages.en: I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 这事儿我懒得管。

messages.en: I hope you can live with the lives of those prisoners on your conscience.
messages.zh: 我希望你的良心能够承受这些囚犯的生命。

messages.en:
You've got a real chance to be a hero here, pilot. The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from a Caldari detention camp. The only problem is that we need to get intelligence on the distribution of enemy forces prior to the raid in order to pave the way for our strike force and the vulnerable transports that will need to be sent in with it. That's where you come in.

We know that one of the enemy fleets in this area has copies of the data that we need. You will need to penetrate their base of operations and retrieve the tactical information sheet from the outpost there. Bring that back to me and we can get the planning for this raid underway.
messages.zh:
现在你有一次做英雄的真正机会。总参部正在计划一次营救行动，目标是解救在加达里集中营里面的一些战俘。为了能够为营救行动作铺垫，我们需要了解敌人集中营的兵力布置，这样我们的打击部队和人员运输舰才能够方便的打入集中营。

我们知道在这个区域的一支敌方舰队手里有这份情报，为了得到它，我们希望你能够去突袭在这个区域一座敌人的基地。找到在那个哨站里的战术情报文件并带回来给我用来准备营救行动。

messages.en: This doesn't sound like a problem. I can take care of it for sure.
messages.zh: 这不是个问题，我当然能够处理的了。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it! Once you make sure every industrial is destroyed, return to me to report. Just watch out for capsuleers flying on their side and equip yourself to defend against them first and foremost.
messages.zh: 很高兴听到这些！一旦你确定已经把所有的工业舰都摧毁了，就回来向我报告。你要当心那些在那儿附近游荡的敌方克隆飞行员，武装好你的舰船来应付可能的遭遇。

messages.en: I do sleep, but I'm awake and ready now.
messages.zh: 我确实睡着了，但是现在我已经打起精神准备好了。

messages.en:
A convoy is heading to supply a station in a contested system. That station provides food, water, clothing, and other basic equipment for the Caldari forces in the area. We've managed to pinpoint the convoy's location, so we can send you out to take care of them for us.

Destroy the convoy before they can unload their cargo.
messages.zh:
一只护航补给舰对正在前往一座位于争夺区域的空间站执行补给任务。这座空间站为那个区域的加达里军队提供食物、水、服装以及各种基础装备。我们想办法确定了补给舰队的位置，现在我们要把你派过去对付这支补给船队。

在他们能抵达目的地卸货之前消灭补给船队。

messages.en: I hope those Caldari fools can make due without their tea and home electronics! Because I just blew them all up!
messages.zh: 希望这些悲剧的加达里人能在没有茶叶和音响的这段时间熬过去。

messages.en: Excellent. Without supplies, the Caldari forces in the area will lose morale and fight at less than 100 percent! It'll allow us to make inroads into the system.
messages.zh: 很好。没有了补给，那个区域的加达里军队很快就会失去士气！让我们有机会可以打入他们的星系。

messages.en: Blowing up industrials? Sounds boring! Give me something difficult, will you?
messages.zh: 打几艘工业舰？听起来太无聊了，拿点有些难度的事情给我做好不好。

messages.en: Tch. I didn't think you would turn this down.
messages.zh: 啊！我没想到你会让人这么失望。

messages.en:
I've been waiting for you to show up! We have a small problem. The Caldari have a hidden supply depot inside a contested system. Normally, we would just go and destroy it, but we can't spare the manpower at the moment.

However, we've discovered that they're running low on supplies and are receiving a shipment of new equipment any time now. If we can stop them from restocking, we'll force the enemy to begin heavy rationing, which will harm their morale. Imagine the looks on their faces when they hear they can't have their snack-time. Are you up to the task?
messages.zh:
我一直在等待你的出现！我们这儿有点小麻烦。加达里在附近的争夺区域有一个隐藏的补给站。通常情况下，我们会直接把它给端掉，但是现在人力有限。

不管怎样，我们已经发现他们现在的补给出现了问题，正在等待新的装备抵达。如果我能够阻碍他们的补给进行，那么就能使他们的后勤出现大麻烦从而引发士气受到巨大打击。想象一下当连吃的都成问题的时候他们脸上会是什么样的表情。你愿意接受这个任务么？

messages.en: It turned out to be more difficult than I expected. I'm going to have to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这比我想象的要难得多。我放弃了。

messages.en: Thanks to those supplies getting through, we'll have to face fresh enemies in the area.
messages.zh: 的要感谢这些补给物资，现在我们要面对一大帮精神焕发的敌人了。

messages.en: I'll smash those miners like they smash those asteroids!
messages.zh: 我会把这些矿工都碾成饼。

messages.en:
Our scanners haven't revealed any combat ships escorting the miners. That could be simple hubris on the part of the Caldari, or it could mean they've reinforcements a short way away. The miners are the only important targets, so focus on them.

Again, be careful -- capsuleers loyal to the State are in the area.
messages.zh:
我们的扫描器没有发现任何战斗船只在保护这些采矿船。要么是这些加达里人过于傲慢，要么就是他们的增援还在路上。采矿船是你的首要目标，集中火力对付他们。

但是要小心，我听说合众国的一些克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动，你可能要对付他们，而且这些人的威胁可能来得更高。

messages.en:
Those damn Caldari have managed to discover an asteroid belt we had claimed in one of the contested systems nearby! Head over there and destroy them as soon as possible. Once you do, we can exploit the resources ourselves.

Just make sure you're ready to fight. Capsuleers loyal to the State might be out in force.
messages.zh:
这些可恶的加达里人在附近的争夺区域找到了一个小行星矿带！你尽快赶过去消灭它们。一旦成功，我们就可以自己去开采这些资源了。

做好准备战斗。为合众国卖力的克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动。

messages.en: I've taken out the miners, no sweat.
messages.zh: 我已经把矿工铲除了，不费吹灰之力。

messages.en: Excellent job. With those rats gone, we'll be able to exploit the resources and further fund our efforts. Even better, it seems like you got there in time to stop them from mining the choicest asteroids. This will not be forgotten.
messages.zh: 干的很漂亮。这些渣滓被铲除后我们就能够专心的开采这些资源为我们的国家服务。关键在于，是你赶在损失扩大之前赶到那儿制止了他们的这种行为，这将是不会被忘记的。

messages.en: They found it, they deserve it. I can't take your mission.
messages.zh: 是他们找到了这些矿石，是他们应得的。我不要做你的这个任务。

messages.en: I'm surprised you don't have the stomach for it.
messages.zh: 我很吃惊你居然没胆子干这事儿。

messages.en:
As you know, there are a large number of hidden asteroid belts all throughout space. Some of them are quite valuable, so much that both we and our enemies would risk going into contested space to find them. Well, we've recently done just that... but the Caldari have apparently spotted our ships in the vicinity.

We discovered a fairly sizable asteroid belt that had managed to elude our scanners for some time. Now that the Caldari have also pinpointed it, though, we need to get in there fast. We simply can't let them strip it of all value. We want to be the ones to do that. If you can drive them out of there, we'll have those precious mineral resources all to ourselves -- and keep their war-mongering fingers away from it. Can you do it?
messages.zh:
你知道在已知的空余中布满了大大小小隐藏着的小行星矿带；其中有些还非常的值价——无论是我们的敌人还是我们自己都愿意冒险到处于战争状态的争夺区域去开采这些矿石。我们最近正式在做这样的事情，但是加达里明显发现了我们的船只在附近活动。

我们发现了一个产量不小的小行星矿带，现在加达里人也发现了这个矿带。我们的要快点赶过去，不能让他们占了便宜。 如果你能把它们都从那儿赶出去，我们就能自己去开采这些价值连城的矿石资源了。你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: It turns out this was more than I could handle. I'm sorry!
messages.zh: 我发现这已经超出了我能够控制的范围。不好意思。

messages.en: Was the mission really that difficult?
messages.zh: 这个任务真有这么难？

name.ru: Нож в горле (Knife in the Throat)

messages.en: That relay is as good as gone.
messages.zh: 那座中继塔已经完蛋了。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 太好了。摧毁中继塔后便尽快回来。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
An enemy cruiser squadron has been causing some serious trouble for our forces in this area. Unfortunately, we're also trying to deal with an Amarr offensive in this sector, and that means that regular naval forces are stretched thin. In order to take some pressure off, we need you to take out the tactical relay that they are using to coordinate their activities. Hopefully, that will buy our fleet some time to deal with the offensive.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the tactical relay, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
一只敌人的巡洋舰中队在这个地区给我们造成了一些严重的麻烦。不幸的是，我们现在的主要兵力都忙于对抗艾玛对这个区域的进攻，同时常规海军部队的战线又已经被拉的很长。为了能减轻一些负担，我们需要你去把敌方用来组织攻击行动的战术中继塔摧毁。希望这样能够为我们的舰队争取一些时间来对付正面攻击。

飞去指定的地点，找到并摧毁战术中继塔，然后返回你的代理人那里报告。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. You've bought our fleet some time to hold the line here. I'll make sure the sector commander knows you were responsible.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。你为舰队争取了组后的时间来抵抗正面进攻。我会让战区指挥官知道你的功绩的。

messages.en: Sounds a bit small-time to me. I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 听起来不像是我的风格。我想我还是不要做这个了。

messages.en: Even small actions are important, pilot. Just because you're not in the middle of a fleet battle doesn't mean you're not making an important contribution.
messages.zh: 就算是小小的一次行动也有它的重要性所在，飞行员。不在交战最激烈的前沿阵地不代表你就不能做出重大的贡献。

messages.en:
We've identified the location of an Amarr tactical relay being used by an enemy cruiser squadron operating in the area. This squadron has been making deep penetration raids over the last week, and our sector commander has decided that elimination of this relay is the first step towards containing these incursions.

Unfortunately, our regular naval forces have their hands full dealing with an enemy offensive several systems away and protecting our supply lines holding the line in that area. As a result, I've been tasked with finding a loyal capsuleer who can take care of the problem for us. We'd like for you to give it a shot.
messages.zh:
我们确定了一座艾玛用来指挥他们在这个区域的一只巡洋舰中队所用的战术中继塔。这个巡洋舰中队最近渗透到我们战线后方实施了一系列的破坏活动。我们的战区指挥官决定要消灭这支部队，作为防止地方更进一步侵犯的第一步。

不巧的是，我们的常规海军部队最近正忙于应付敌人对我们多个星系的侵犯，保卫我们的补给线能够正常的运转。这样一来，我们就要找一个忠诚的克隆飞行员来为我们处理这个麻烦。你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: There's too many of them; I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. You'll have to find some other sucker for this one.
messages.zh: 他们人太多了，我根本就没法靠近那个中继塔。你还是找别人吧。

messages.en: I thought you were supposed to be some hotshot pilot. All talk, huh?
messages.zh: 我还以为你是个

messages.en: That repair crew won't have a chance. Don't worry about it.
messages.zh: 那些修门的人没机会完成自己的工作。放心好了。

messages.en: I figured as much! I've already uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. You shouldn't have too much trouble taking out the repair ships. It is in a contested system, so you may find Federation-aligned capsuleers patrolling the place.
messages.zh: 我有了很多发现！我已经把那座星门的坐标上传到你的控制边栏中了。打掉那几艘维修船对你来说应该是很简单的。但它位于一个争夺状态的区域里，你应该要做好准备迎击那些巡弋在附近的联邦克隆飞行员。

messages.en: I'm a capsuleer! I don't need to put my life on the line to get the job done.
messages.zh: 我是个克隆飞行员，我更本不需要把我的生命压上去来完成这种任务。

messages.en: An old smuggler's gate connects a system deep inside Federation territory with one of the contested systems nearby. It's been offline for years, but the Federation is trying to get it running again. Destroy the repair ships trying to repair the gate.
messages.zh: 这是个陈旧的非法贩售者修筑的星门，它通往联邦领土深处一个争夺区域附近。它已经停止使用多年了，但是敌人正在尝试让它重新运转。消灭那些正在维修这个星门的舰船。

messages.en: I've taken out that repair crew! The gate remains offline for now.
messages.zh: 我已经消灭了那些维修船！星门目前依然处于不可用状态。

messages.en: I hope it wasn't too much trouble for you. With that repair crew out of the way, we can take our time and send a demolition crew to destroy it when we get the chance. You have done the Federation proud.
messages.zh: 我希望之对你来说不算是个太大的麻烦。等到把那些维修船都打掉了，我们就有时间派出拆除作业团队去将星门完全拆除。你的勇敢让联邦十分骄傲。

messages.en: I'm not sure I can take them out in time.
messages.zh: 我不是很确定我能不能把它们及时地消灭掉。

messages.en: Well someone needs to take care of that repair crew. I guess I can find someone else.
messages.zh: 总得有人去把那些维修船干掉。我猜我还能找到别人去做。

messages.en:
Our contested territory is riddled with old, inoperable gates. Some of them were put up by our enemies, others by common smugglers hoping to get past customs. Well, it turns out that the Federation has discovered one of these derelict gates. Normally, this wouldn't be an issue, but the gate connects to a system deep in Federation space.

I don't need to tell you what could happen if those Caldari fascists get that gate online. We can't spare the manpower to destroy the gate itself, but the ships working to repair it aren't nearly so sturdy.

I want you to fly over there and take them out. Are you up for it?
messages.zh:
我们的争夺中领土到处都可以看到年久失修的星门。有一些是我们的敌人安放的，有一些则是希望通过这种方法逃脱关税的非法贩售者安置的。结果，我们发现联邦找到了一座废弃的星门。通常这并不能算是什么事情，但是他们这次发现的这个星门链接到了联邦深处的一个星系。

我想我不说你也应该知道这意味着什么，如果那些加达里人把那座星门重新修复激活的话。我们暂时没法分散更多的人力去搞定那座星门，但是那些负责维修它的舰船则不是那么难对付的。

我要你飞过去把他们都干掉，你能接这个任务么？

messages.en: It turns out I wasn't prepared to tackle this mission. I'm going to have to abandon it.
messages.zh: 我发现原来我根本就没有准备好完成这个任务。我还是只有退出了。

messages.en: Grr. I wish I'd known you couldn't handle it from the start!
messages.zh: 呃～。我真希望一开始就知道你没法干这事儿。

messages.en: Understood, I'll arrange a meeting with her and consequence.
messages.zh: 明白了，我会去会会她。

messages.en: Spare me the tough talk, pilot. Action is the only language I respect. Move it.
messages.zh: 我也不想说太多了，飞行员。行动才是最有说服力的。快去吧。

messages.en: Ready and willing. How can I help?
messages.zh: 随时都准备好的，你要我怎么做？

messages.en: We've been watching Caldari Navy units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Gallente; most of them non-combatants I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.
messages.zh: 我们正在监视快速堆积到附近争夺区域的加达里舰队作战单位，在我们就要开始对他们实施攻击的时候，我们发现他们的一个高级前线指挥官刚刚抵达了那里。这个女人，他们的前线指挥官害死了无数的盖伦特人民，这些受害者大部分还是平民。除了她和她的卫兵其他的我都不管了。干掉她们，你会得到应有的报酬的，甚至是人民的尊敬。

messages.en: She's dead.
messages.zh: 她已经挂掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. Not bad…not bad at all. Keep it up and we might just trust you with more important work down the line.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。不错，非常不错。再接再厉，我们会把接下来的更多的任务交给你的。

messages.en: Get someone else for the job; I'm not some cheap assassin.
messages.zh: 另外找人吧，我可不是个无耻的刺客。

messages.en: Cheap Assassin? She is the cheap assassin. Non-combatants are her primary targets! I don't give a damn how highly you think of yourself so long as our people stop dying. Forget it; I'll get someone else who actually has a shred of patriotism and empathy.
messages.zh: 无耻的刺客？她是个卑劣无耻下流的清道夫，专门以平民为目标！只有我们的人民一天不停止死亡我就永远不会觉得你算得上是个什么东西。算了，我另外去找一个有爱国心和怜悯的人来做这个任务

messages.en: The breakdown in relations between the empires has seen huge losses in civilian life as they all target “weak points” and set missions specifically to “maximize morale loss.” In a war, there are few who will not see the atrocities of conflict and defenseless non-combatants are no exception. Those who lead such missions however, sit at the very top of their enemy's target lists.
messages.zh: 国家之间的深仇大恨造成了大量平民的生命在利益的冲突中牺牲，他们互相都把平民作为是对方的“软肋”和对士气最大打击的着手点。在战争中很少有人会受到怜悯，平民也不例外。这些执行残酷命令的人，总是会处在敌人击毁名单的最前端。

messages.en: Collateral Damage.
messages.zh: 附带伤害

messages.en:
Good. I need you for an assassination, and this is something you best not screw up.

We've been watching Caldari Navy units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Gallente; most of them non-combatants. She has a penchant for hitting weakened and unsupported civilian structures. She is scum, and I want her dead.

This is surgical stuff, pilot. She'll slip away if we go in there with full force. I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.

Simple as that, now get going.
messages.zh:
很好。我需要你执行一个行刺任务，你最好别搞砸了。

我们正在监视快速堆积到附近争夺区域的加达里舰队作战单位，在我们就要开始对他们实施攻击的时候，我们发现他们的一个高级前线指挥官刚刚抵达了那里。这个女人，他们的前线指挥官害死了无数的盖伦特人民，这些受害者大部分还是平民。她有一个嗜好就是攻击毫无防备和反抗之力的平民建筑。他是一个垃圾，我要她死。

这是个精细活，如果我们大举进攻的话她可能会毫无踪迹的溜掉。除了她和她的卫兵其他的我都不管了。干掉她们，你会得到应有的报酬的，甚至是人民的尊敬。

就这么简单，现在就赶快去办吧。

messages.en: I can't get to her; you're going to have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不能靠近她；你另外找人去吧。

messages.en: What an utter disappointment you are. Next time, do not offer services beyond your ability. Eggers and their pride…just get out of here.
messages.zh: 你简直让人失望透顶了。下一次不要再冲汉子说大话了。你们这些生活在鸡蛋里的人……快从这儿滚出去。

name.fr: Les meilleurs partent toujours en premier
name.ru: Только хорошие умирают молодыми (Only the Good Die Young)

messages.en: I'll put an end to their winning streak, don't worry.
messages.zh: 我会结束他们的运气的，别担心。

messages.en: Good. Make sure you're ready for a protracted battle. You may have to wade through a number of enemy capsuleers.
messages.zh: 很好，准备好打一场持久战吧。你可能得要和不少敌人的克隆飞行员苦战一番。

messages.en:
An enemy force has been launching increasingly bold attacks against us. They've been taking advantage of the fact that we have bigger troubles to deal with, and coming away victorious more often than not.

The general staff has decided to put an end to this campaign by striking a crippling blow to their morale. We want you to eliminate the enemy sector commander at these coordinates; all other targets are secondary.
messages.zh:
敌人的军队对我们的进攻越来越密集疯狂。在我们处理别的危机的空档，他们趁人之危越来越嚣张。

总参谋部决定要结束这种状况，给他们的士气予以狠狠一击。我们希望你去把敌人的区域指挥官给干掉。坐标已经给你，除了区域指挥官之外的都是次要目标。

messages.en: The enemy commander has been eliminated, sir.
messages.zh: 敌人的指挥官已经被消灭了，长官。

messages.en: Well, that should put ‘em in their place. Nice work, pilot. I'll make sure the general staff knows you were responsible.
messages.zh: 你做的很好，飞行员。我一定会在总参谋部那儿好好的表扬你一番。

messages.en: I'm really not comfortable with this.
messages.zh: 我对这个不太有心情。

messages.en: This is war, pilot. It's not about your comfort.
messages.zh: 这就是战争，飞行员。我们不是在谈论你的心情。

messages.en:
As I'm sure you're already aware, pilot, one of the most precious resources a military force has is morale. Battles can be won or lost by it, and wars can be turned by it. That is why one of our top priorities has been the disruption of the enemy's morale.

Lately, the Amarr have enjoyed a string of small but dramatic victories over our forces in this sector. Though the damage inflicted to our forces has been negligible, the enemy forces responsible for these actions, especially their commander, have been emboldened and now they are pushing their luck more and more.

The general staff has determined that striking a crippling blow to their morale will likely put an end to this nonsense once and for all. We want you to eliminate their commander. With any luck, this will scatter them to the winds and put an end to these raids.
messages.zh:
我想你已经知道了，飞行员。军队最重要的一项资源就是士气，它可以左右战场的成败，可以转变战争的局势。这也是为什么挫伤敌人的士气是我们的首要任务之一。

最近，艾玛在这个区域对我们的作战中取得了一些小胜利。尽管这些伤害对我们的部队来说是不值一提的，但这却让敌人的指挥官越来得寸进尺，越来越胆大，妄图把他们的”运气“跟进一步的推到我们的门口。

总参谋部决定要结束这种状况，给他们的士气予以狠狠一击。我们希望你去把敌人的区域指挥官给干掉。希望这样能够打散他们的攻击计划。

messages.en: I'll set out immediately.
messages.zh: 我这就出发。

messages.en: You'll hear from me shortly. Pay close attention to my orders and obey them exactly.
messages.zh: 我很快就会再联系你。注意听我指挥，严格按照命令行动。

messages.en: That's why I'm here, how can I help?
messages.zh: 这正是我来这里的原因，我能帮上什么忙？

messages.en: Moments ago we launched an offensive against a Caldari compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in. I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field.
messages.zh: 之前我们深入了加达里一个重兵把守的基地，对那里发动了一次袭击。我们不想冒险遭围剿，因此我们需要你帮忙。我要你飞过去确保这次行动的成功。你到战场后我会向你发出战术指示。

messages.en: Good call on the Commander, it seems to have worked.
messages.zh: 你指挥地不错，效果很好。

messages.en: Orders are only as good as the people who carry them out. That was some good work out there, pilot; calm, precise and efficient. You fly like a real Gallente. Keep it up.
messages.zh: 命令还是要靠人去执行的。你干得不错，飞行员——冷静、精准、高效。这才像真正的盖伦特人。希望能再接再厉。

messages.en: I won't be able to help with something like this I'm afraid, that sector is too far out of my way.
messages.zh: 恐怕我对此无能为力，那对我来说太强了。

messages.en: Why should I care? You asked how you could help so I'm telling you. Clearly I'm wasting my damn time in the process. A piece of advice rookie, don't ask if you can help when you have no concept of the expectations likely to be put upon you.
messages.zh: 你跟我说这干什么？是你自己问是否可以帮忙我才告诉你这一切的。看来我是在浪费时间。但菜鸟，我还是要给你一条忠告：如果你没做好不负重托的准备，就不要问别人你能否帮忙。

messages.en: Changes in technology and in particular, the advent of the jump drive, has made the battlefields of space a dynamic and unpredictable arena. Where previously reinforcements could take many hours or even days to arrive on-field, now they can be dropped immediately into the fray with a single cynosaural field. When the technology first appeared, all four empires had to drastically revise their outdated battle tactics and this is a process still happening even today. Mistakes are still made, and the cost of hubris and underestimation is usually high.
messages.zh: 由于科技的更新，尤其是跳跃飞行的出现，战场形势一下子变得瞬息万变起来。以前增援部队抵达战场可能要耗费数小时甚至数天时间，现在利用一个诱导力场便能立刻冲上战斗前线。该技术刚出现的时候，四大帝国被迫脱胎换骨似地修改他们那些老掉牙的战术，直到今天这修改还是一直不断。错误依旧有人犯，而傲慢与低估更是让人付出惨痛代价。

messages.en: A necessary adaptation.
messages.zh: 必需的调整

messages.en:
Moments ago we launched an offensive against a Caldari compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support.

Initial reconnaissance has suggested they may have the capability to field more vessels than we had originally anticipated. Naturally, we're not turning around in the face of this news, we've come too far and a retreat will only encourage them. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in.

I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field. Don't worry about any orders or cohesion with our own forces there, you'll be answering directly to me and following only my orders.

Briefing over. Get going.
messages.zh:
之前我们深入了加达里一个重兵把守的基地，对那里发动了一次袭击。

现在情报显示他们当时派出的舰船可能比我们预料的还要多。当然我们不可能在获悉这一消息后就进行撤退，那样话只会助长他们的士气。不过我们也不想冒险遭围剿，因此我们需要你帮忙。

我要你飞过去确保这次行动的成功。你到战场后我会向你发出战术指示。不用担心与我们自己的部队会有冲突，你直接听我指挥就行。

讲完了，出发吧。

messages.en: I can't commit myself to this after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.
messages.zh: 我没法保证我能完成这任务。但愿你能及时找到其他人。

messages.en: What?! I already told my superiors the matter was being handled. I'm really glad you hope I can find someone else, rookie. That means so much to me whilst our own people are out there risking their lives. Don't let me catch you repeating this performance.
messages.zh: 什么？！我已经告诉上级这事正在被处理了。还好你能希望我另找他人，菜鸟。我自己人正在那面冒着搭上命的风险呢。别让我看到你再有这样的表现。

messages.en: I'll get that intelligence for you.
messages.zh: 我会帮你搞到那个情报。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it, pilot. Here's the coordinates; remember, that tactical information sheet is the primary objective. Any other damage is secondary.
messages.zh: 很高兴听到这个。这是坐标，记住，那份战术情报文件是你的首要目标，其他的都不是很重要。

messages.en:
The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from an Amarr detention camp. In order to pave the way for the raid, we need to get information on the disposition of the enemy forces so that our strike force and the vulnerable transports coming with them can make it to the detention camp unmolested.

In order to get that intelligence, we need you to raid the base of an enemy force in this sector. We need you to get the tactical information sheet from the outpost and bring it back here in preparation for the prisoner raid.
messages.zh:
总参部正在计划一次营救行动，目标是解救在艾玛集中营里面的一些战俘。为了能够为营救行动作铺垫，我们需要了解敌人集中营的兵力布置，这样我们的打击部队和人员运输舰才能够方便的打入集中营。

为了得到这些情报，我们希望你能够去突袭在这个区域一座敌人的基地。找到在那个哨站里的战术情报文件并带回来给我用来准备营救行动。

messages.en: I've got the information sheet. Does it have the data you're looking for?
messages.zh: 我拿到文件了，有你要找的数据么？

messages.en: Nice work, pilot; I'll send this off to the boys at intel. With any luck, you've just given us what we need to bring some of our brave warriors home.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员；我会把这个传给情报部门的小伙子们。运气好的话，你所带来的情报就能把我们的战士们带回家来。

messages.en: I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 这事儿我懒得管。

messages.en: I hope you can live with the lives of those prisoners on your conscience.
messages.zh: 我希望你的良心能够承受这些囚犯的生命。

messages.en:
You've got a real chance to be a hero here, pilot. The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from an Amarr detention camp. The only problem is that we need to get intelligence on the distribution of enemy forces prior to the raid in order to pave the way for our strike force and the vulnerable transports that will need to be sent in with it. That's where you come in.

We know that one of the enemy fleets in this area has copies of the data that we need. You will need to penetrate their base of operations and retrieve the tactical information sheet from the outpost there. Bring that back to me and we can get the planning for this raid underway.
messages.zh:
现在你有一次做英雄的真正机会。总参部正在计划一次营救行动，目标是解救在艾玛集中营里面的一些战俘。为了能够为营救行动作铺垫，我们需要了解敌人集中营的兵力布置，这样我们的打击部队和人员运输舰才能够方便的打入集中营。

我们知道在这个区域的一支敌方舰队手里有这份情报，为了得到它，我们希望你能够去突袭在这个区域一座敌人的基地。找到在那个哨站里的战术情报文件并带回来给我用来准备营救行动。

name.ru: Волк среди овец (A Wolf in the Fold)

messages.en: It'll be my pleasure.
messages.zh: 我很高兴做这事。

messages.en: Excellent.  Remember, take out the reactor; anything else is just a bonus. Good hunting, pilot.
messages.zh: 太好了。记住，摧毁反应堆；其他都是次要目标。祝你顺利，飞行员。

messages.en: I'm game. What's the job?
messages.zh: 我早有准备。要干什么？

messages.en: A reconnaissance patrol has located the base of a group of Caldari raiders operating near this system. In order to secure our supply lines, you will need to fly to the base and destroy its main reactor, knocking it out of action. Any additional damage you can do to static defenses or the enemy raiding fleets would certainly be appreciated.
messages.zh: 一支加达里突袭队正在该星系附近转悠，我们的侦察巡逻队已经找到了他们的基地。为了保住我们的补给线，你得飞往那基地，炸毁其主反应堆让它发挥不了作用。如果你能把那些防御工事或是敌方舰队也解决的话，那是再好不过的了。

messages.en: The reactor's been destroyed.
messages.zh: 反应堆摧毁了。

messages.en: Great work, pilot. We're already putting together a counterstrike in case they come to repair it. You've helped us bait the trap perfectly, and saved a load of war materiel and lives in the process.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。他们一旦回来修那东西我们就能组织一次反击了。你帮我们设下了一个完美陷阱，同时还节省了不少战争物资，避免了不必要的牺牲。

messages.en: I'll pass. I feel like there's something you're not telling me.
messages.zh: 我不干。我觉得你对我隐瞒了什么东西。

messages.en: I don't know what you're talking about, but if that's the way you're going to be, then I'll find someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 我不知道你在说什么。如果你偏要那么想，那我就去另寻他人。

messages.en:
Our supply lines have been taking heavy damage from Caldari raids near this system. Until recently, we were baffled as to where the enemy force was resupplying. Luckily, a reconnaissance patrol just returned with sensor data that seems to correspond with the reactor emissions of a Caldari base, and it's in exactly the right place to be supporting these raids.

We want you to fly to the location of these reactor emissions, locate the base, and destroy its main reactor; that should be enough to put it out of action for a while. The thing to remember is that the base is likely to be well-protected, with static defenses if nothing else. I'd advise being careful on your approach. Keep an eye out for any raiding groups returning to resupply. Are you ready?
messages.zh:
我们的补给线在这星系附近遭到了加达里部队的严重袭击。前几天我们一直搞不清他们的后勤保障从何而来。还好我们的侦察巡逻队刚上报一个信号数据，据此推断可能是加达里基地上的一个反应堆，而这应该就是加达里突袭队的后勤基地。

我们要你飞到那个反应堆那里，找到基地，摧毁其主反应堆；这样的话它就能消停好一会儿了。要记住那基地很可能戒备森严，即使没有什么其他防御，至少也有站桩式的防御工事。我建议你谨慎行事。要随时提防回来补给的突袭队。准备好了吗？

messages.en: There's too many of them! I can't deal with firepower of that magnitude.
messages.zh: 他们人太多了！我吃不消那样的火力。

messages.en: I'm extremely disappointed. Hopefully, I can find someone else to take this mission before they hit us again; if I can't, I hope you realize that those losses will be on your head, pilot.
messages.zh: 你让我极度失望。但愿我能在他们再次对我们施行打击之前找到其他人来接手该任务；如果不能，那一切损失都将算到你头上，飞行员。

messages.en: This doesn't sound like a problem. I can take care of it for sure.
messages.zh: 这不是个问题，我当然能够处理的了。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it! Once you make sure every industrial is destroyed, return to me to report. Just watch out for capsuleers flying on their side and equip yourself to defend against them first and foremost.
messages.zh: 很高兴听到这些！一旦你确定已经把所有的工业舰都摧毁了，就回来向我报告。你要当心那些在那儿附近游荡的敌方克隆飞行员，武装好你的舰船来应付可能的遭遇。

messages.en: I don't hear anything, but I'm ready for anything.
messages.zh: 我什么也没听见，但是我已经做好准备应对任何事情。

messages.en:
A convoy is heading to supply a station in a contested system. That station provides food, water, clothing, and other basic equipment for the Amarr forces in the area. We've managed to pinpoint the convoy's location, so we can send you out to take care of them for us.

Destroy the convoy before they can unload their cargo.
messages.zh:
一只护航补给舰对正在前往一座位于争夺区域的空间站执行补给任务。这座空间站为那个区域的艾玛军队提供食物、水、服装以及各种基础装备。我们想办法确定了补给舰队的位置，现在我们要把你派过去对付这支补给船队。

在他们能抵达目的地卸货之前消灭补给船队。

messages.en: I hope those Amarr scumbags can make due without their Pax Amarria and copies of the Scriptures! Because I just blew them all up!
messages.zh: 希望这些悲剧的艾玛人能在没有经文和圣象的这段时间熬过去。

messages.en: Excellent. Without supplies, the Amarr forces in the area will lose morale! It'll allow us to make inroads into the system.
messages.zh: 很好。没有了补给，那个区域的艾玛军队很快就会失去士气！让我们有机会可以打入他们的星系。

messages.en: Blowing up industrials? Sounds boring! Give me something difficult, will you?
messages.zh: 打几艘工业舰？听起来太无聊了，拿点有些难度的事情给我做好不好。

messages.en: Tch. I didn't think you would turn this down.
messages.zh: 啊！我没想到你会让人这么失望。

messages.en:
I've been waiting for you to show up! We have a small problem. The Amarr have a hidden supply depot inside a contested system. Normally, we would just go and destroy it, but we can't spare the manpower at the moment.

However, we've discovered that they're running low on supplies and are receiving a shipment of new equipment any time now. If we can stop them from restocking, we'll force the enemy to begin heavy rationing, which will harm their morale. Imagine the looks on their faces when they hear they can't have their snack-time. Are you up to the task?
messages.zh:
我一直在等待你的出现！我们这儿有点小麻烦。艾玛在附近的争夺区域有一个隐藏的补给站。通常情况下，我们会直接把它给端掉，但是现在人力有限。

不管怎样，我们已经发现他们现在的补给出现了问题，正在等待新的装备抵达。如果我能够阻碍他们的补给进行，那么就能使他们的后勤出现大麻烦从而引发士气受到巨大打击。想象一下当连吃的都成问题的时候他们脸上会是什么样的表情。你愿意接受这个任务么？

messages.en: It turned out to be more difficult than I expected. I'm going to have to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这比我想象的要难得多。我放弃了。

messages.en: Thanks to those supplies getting through, we'll have to face fresh enemies in the area.
messages.zh: 的要感谢这些补给物资，现在我们要面对一大帮精神焕发的敌人了。

messages.en: That repair crew won't have a chance. Don't worry about it.
messages.zh: 那些修门的人没机会完成自己的工作。放心好了。

messages.en: I figured as much! I've already uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. You shouldn't have too much trouble taking out the repair ships. It is in a contested system, so you may find Empire-aligned capsuleers patrolling the place.
messages.zh: 我有了很多发现！我已经把那座星门的坐标上传到你的控制边栏中了。打掉那几艘维修船对你来说应该是很简单的。但它位于一个争夺状态的区域里，你应该要做好准备迎击那些巡弋在附近的帝国克隆飞行员。

messages.en: I'm a capsuleer! I don't need to put my life on the line to get the job done.
messages.zh: 我是个克隆飞行员，我更本不需要把我的生命压上去来完成这种任务。

messages.en: An old smuggler's gate connects a system deep inside Empire territory with one of the contested systems nearby. It's been offline for years, but the Empire is trying to get it running again. Destroy the repair ships trying to repair the gate.
messages.zh: 这是个陈旧的非法贩售者修筑的星门，它通往帝国领土深处一个争夺区域附近。它已经停止使用多年了，但是帝国正在尝试让它重新运转。消灭那些正在维修这个星门的舰船。

messages.en: I've taken out that repair crew! The gate remains offline for now.
messages.zh: 我已经消灭了那些维修船！星门目前依然处于不可用状态。

messages.en: I hope it wasn't too much trouble for you. With that repair crew out of the way, we can take our time and send a demolition crew to destroy it when we get the chance. You have done the Republic proud.
messages.zh: 我希望之对你来说不算是个太大的麻烦。等到把那些维修船都打掉了，我们就有时间派出拆除作业团队去将星门完全拆除。你的勇敢让共和国十分骄傲。

messages.en: I'm not sure I can take them out in time.
messages.zh: 我不是很确定我能不能把它们及时地消灭掉。

messages.en: Well someone needs to take care of that repair crew. I guess I can find someone else.
messages.zh: 总得有人去把那些维修船干掉。我猜我还能找到别人去做。

messages.en:
Our contested territory is riddled with old, inoperable gates. Some of them were put up by our enemies, others by common smugglers hoping to get past customs. Well, it turns out that the Empire has discovered one of these derelict gates. Normally, this wouldn't be an issue, but the gate connects to a system deep in Empire space.

I don't need to tell you what could happen if those Amarr zealots get that gate online. We can't spare the manpower to destroy the gate itself, but the ships working to repair it aren't nearly so sturdy.

I want you to fly over there and take them out. Are you up for it?
messages.zh:
我们的争夺中领土到处都可以看到年久失修的星门。有一些是我们的敌人安放的，有一些则是希望通过这种方法逃脱关税的非法贩售者安置的。结果，我们发现帝国发现了一座废弃的星门。通常这并不能算是什么事情，但是他们这次发现的这个星门链接到了帝国深处的一个星系。

我想我不说你也应该知道这意味着什么，如果那些艾玛的狂热份子把那座星门重新修复激活的话。我们暂时没法分散更多的人力去搞定那座星门，但是那些负责维修它的舰船则不是那么难对付的。

我要你飞过去把他们都干掉，你能接这个任务么？

messages.en: It turns out I wasn't prepared to tackle this mission. I'm going to have to abandon it.
messages.zh: 我发现原来我根本就没有准备好完成这个任务。我还是只有退出了。

messages.en: Grr. I wish I'd known you couldn't handle it from the start!
messages.zh: 呃～。我真希望一开始就知道你没法干这事儿。

messages.en: I'll smash those miners like they smash those asteroids!
messages.zh: 我会把这些矿工都碾成饼。

messages.en:
Our scanners haven't revealed any combat ships escorting the miners. That could be simple hubris on the part of the Amarr, or it could mean they've reinforcements a short way away. The miners are the only important targets, so focus on them.

Just be careful out there, like I said.
messages.zh:
我们的扫描器没有发现任何战斗船只在保护这些采矿船。要么是这些艾玛人过于傲慢，要么就是他们的增援还在路上。采矿船是你的首要目标，集中火力对付他们。

但是要小心。

messages.en: Oh how glorious it is! What do you have for me?
messages.zh: 哦，这真是太好了，你有什么活儿给我做。

messages.en:
Those damn Amarr have managed to discover an asteroid belt in one of the contested systems nearby! Head over there and destroy them as soon as possible. Once you do, we can exploit the resources ourselves.

Just make sure you're ready to fight. Capsuleers loyal to the Empire might be out in force.
messages.zh:
这些可恶的艾玛人在附近的争夺区域找到了一个小行星矿带！你尽快赶过去消灭它们。一旦成功，我们就可以自己去开采这些资源了。

做好准备战斗。为帝国卖力的克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动。

messages.en: I've taken out the miners, no sweat.
messages.zh: 我已经把矿工铲除了，不费吹灰之力。

messages.en: Excellent job. With those rats gone, we'll be able to exploit the resources and further fund our efforts. Even better, it seems like you got there in time to stop them from mining the choicest asteroids. This will not be forgotten.
messages.zh: 干的很漂亮。这些渣滓被铲除后我们就能够专心的开采这些资源为我们的国家服务。关键在于，是你赶在损失扩大之前赶到那儿制止了他们的这种行为，这将是不会被忘记的。

messages.en: They found it, they deserve it. I can't take your mission.
messages.zh: 是他们找到了这些矿石，是他们应得的。我不要做你的这个任务。

messages.en: I'm surprised you don't have the stomach for it.
messages.zh: 我很吃惊你居然没胆子干这事儿。

messages.en:
It's no secret that a large number of hidden asteroid belts dot all parts of space, including the Republic -- and Amarr. Some of them are quite valuable, so much that we would most certainly risk going into Amarr space to procure them. Well, our scouts recently found just such a field in Amarr-contested space.

They've discovered a fairly sizable asteroid belt. Now that we've pinpointed it, though, the Amarr seem to have noticed our activities there... and we simply can't let them strip the site of all those resources. If you can drive them out of there, we'll have those precious minerals all to ourselves. Can you do it?
messages.zh:
在已知的空余中布满了大大小小隐藏着的小行星矿带的事实已经不是什么秘密了；其中有些还非常的值价——无论是我们的敌人还是我们自己都愿意冒险到处于战争状态的争夺区域去开采这些矿石，就算是在艾玛帝国的空域也在所不惜。我们的侦察部队发现了一个高产量小行星矿带——它正是处在一个艾玛所属的争夺空域。我们肯定不能让他们就这样拿走我们的资源。

如果你能把它们都从那儿赶出去，我们就能自己去开采这些价值连城的矿石资源了。你能完成这个任务么？

messages.en: It turns out this was more than I could handle. I'm sorry!
messages.zh: 我发现这已经超出了我能够控制的范围。不好意思。

messages.en: Was the mission really that difficult?
messages.zh: 这个任务真有这么难？

messages.en: Understood, I'll arrange a meeting with her and consequence.
messages.zh: 明白了，我会去会会她。

messages.en: Spare me the tough talk, pilot. Action is the only language I respect. Move it.
messages.zh: 我也不想说太多了，飞行员。行动才是最有说服力的。快去吧。

messages.en: Ready and willing. How can I help?
messages.zh: 随时都准备好的，你要我怎么做？

messages.en: We've been watching Imperial Navy units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Matari; most of them non-combatants I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.
messages.zh: 我们正在密切监视在附近一处争夺区域迅速集结的帝国海军舰队。在我们就要开始对他们实施攻击的时候，我们发现他们的一个高级前线指挥官刚刚抵达了那里。这个女人的手上沾满了无数玛塔利人民的鲜血，其中大部分都是平民。现在我的仇恨里只有这个女人和她的守卫，别的什么都顾不上了。干掉她们，你会得到应有的报酬，甚至可能获得人民的尊敬。

messages.en: She's dead.
messages.zh: 她已经挂掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. Not bad…not bad at all. Keep it up and we might just trust you with more important work down the line.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。不错，非常不错。再接再厉，我们会把接下来的更多的任务交给你的。

messages.en: Get someone else for the job; I'm not some cheap assassin.
messages.zh: 另外找人吧，我可不是个无耻的刺客。

messages.en: Cheap Assassin? She is the cheap assassin. Non-combatants are her primary targets! I don't give a damn how highly you think of yourself so long as our people stop dying. Forget it; I'll get someone else who actually has a shred of patriotism and empathy.
messages.zh: 无耻的刺客？她是个卑劣无耻下流的清道夫，专门以平民为目标！只有我们的人民一天不停止死亡我就永远不会觉得你算得上是个什么东西。算了，我另外去找一个有爱国心和怜悯的人来做这个任务

messages.en: The breakdown in relations between the empires has seen huge losses in civilian life as they all target “weak points” and set missions specifically to “maximize morale loss.” In a war, there are few who will not see the atrocities of conflict and defenseless non-combatants are no exception. Those who lead such missions however, sit at the very top of their enemy's target lists.
messages.zh: 国家之间的深仇大恨造成了大量平民的生命在利益的冲突中牺牲，他们互相都把平民作为是对方的“软肋”和对士气最大打击的着手点。在战争中很少有人会受到怜悯，平民也不例外。这些执行残酷命令的人，总是会处在敌人击毁名单的最前端。

messages.en: Collateral Damage
messages.zh: 附带伤害

messages.en:
Good. I need you for an assassination, and this is something you best not screw up.

We've been watching Imperial Navy units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Matari; most of them non-combatants. She has a penchant for hitting weakened and unsupported civilian structures. She is scum, and I want her dead.

This is surgical stuff, pilot. She'll slip away if we go in there with full force. I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.

Simple as that, now get going.
messages.zh:
很好。我需要你执行一个突袭任务，你最好别搞砸了。

我们正在密切监视在附近一处争夺区域迅速集结的帝国海军舰队。在我们就要开始对他们实施攻击的时候，我们发现他们的一个高级前线指挥官刚刚抵达了那里。这个女人的手上沾满了无数玛塔利人民的鲜血，其中大部分都是平民。她的一个嗜好就是攻击毫无防备和反抗之力的平民建筑。她是个人渣，我要她死。

这可是个精细活，飞行员。如果我们大举进攻的话她可能会毫无踪迹的溜掉。除了她和她的卫兵其他的我都不管了。干掉她们，你会得到应有的报酬，甚至可能获得人民的尊敬。

就这么简单，现在就赶快去办吧。

messages.en: I can't get to her; you're going to have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不能靠近她；你另外找人去吧。

messages.en: What an utter disappointment you are. Next time, do not offer services beyond your ability. Eggers and their pride…just get out of here.
messages.zh: 你简直让人失望透顶了。下一次不要再冲汉子说大话了。你们这些生活在鸡蛋里的人……快从这儿滚出去。

messages.en: I'll set out immediately.
messages.zh: 我这就出发。

messages.en: You'll hear from me shortly. Pay close attention to my orders and obey them exactly.
messages.zh: 我很快就会再联系你。注意听我指挥，严格按照命令行动。

messages.en: That's why I'm here, how can I help?
messages.zh: 这正是我来这里的原因，我能帮上什么忙？

messages.en: Moments ago we launched an offensive against an Amarrian compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in. I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field.
messages.zh: 之前我们深入了艾玛一个重兵把守的基地，对那里发动了一次袭击。我们不想冒险遭围剿，因此我们需要你帮忙。我要你飞过去确保这次行动的成功。你到战场后我会向你发出战术指示。

messages.en: Good call on the Commander, it seems to have worked.
messages.zh: 你指挥地不错，效果很好。

messages.en: Orders are only as good as the people who carry them out. That was some good work out there, pilot; calm, precise and efficient. You fly like a real Matari. Keep it up.
messages.zh: 命令还是要靠人去执行的。你干得不错，飞行员——冷静、精准、高效。这才像真正的玛塔利人。希望能再接再厉。

messages.en: I won't be able to help with something like this I'm afraid, that sector is too far out of my way.
messages.zh: 恐怕我对此无能为力，那对我来说太强了。

messages.en: Why should I care? You asked how you could help so I'm telling you. Clearly I'm wasting my damn time in the process. A piece of advice rookie, don't ask if you can help when you have no concept of the expectations likely to be put upon you.
messages.zh: 你跟我说这干什么？是你自己问是否可以帮忙我才告诉你这一切的。看来我是在浪费时间。但菜鸟，我还是要给你一条忠告：如果你没做好不负重托的准备，就不要问别人你能否帮忙。

messages.en: Changes in technology and in particular, the advent of the jump drive, has made the battlefields of space a dynamic and unpredictable arena. Where previously reinforcements could take many hours or even days to arrive on-field, now they can be dropped immediately into the fray with a single cynosaural field. When the technology first appeared, all four empires had to drastically revise their outdated battle tactics and this is a process still happening even today. Mistakes are still made, and the cost of hubris and underestimation is usually high.
messages.zh: 由于科技的更新，尤其是跳跃飞行的出现，战场形势一下子变得瞬息万变起来。以前增援部队抵达战场可能要耗费数小时甚至数天时间，现在利用一个诱导力场便能立刻冲上战斗前线。该技术刚出现的时候，四大帝国被迫脱胎换骨似地修改他们那些老掉牙的战术，直到今天这修改还是一直不断。错误依旧有人犯，而傲慢与低估更是让人付出惨痛代价。

messages.en: A necessary adaptation
messages.zh: 必需的调整

messages.en:
Moments ago we launched an offensive against an Amarrian compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support.

Initial reconnaissance has suggested they may have the capability to field more vessels than we had originally anticipated. Naturally, we're not turning around in the face of this news, we've come too far and a retreat will only encourage them. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in.

I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field. Don't worry about any orders or cohesion with our own forces there, you'll be answering directly to me and following only my orders.

Briefing over. Get going.
messages.zh:
之前我们深入了艾玛一个重兵把守的基地，对那里发动了一次袭击。

现在情报显示他们当时派出的舰船可能比我们预料的还要多。当然我们不可能在获悉这一消息后就进行撤退，那样话只会助长他们的士气。不过我们也不想冒险遭围剿，因此我们需要你帮忙。

我要你飞过去确保这次行动的成功。你到战场后我会向你发出战术指示。不用担心与我们自己的部队会有冲突，你直接听我指挥就行。

讲完了，出发吧。

messages.en: I can't commit myself to this after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.
messages.zh: 我没法保证我能完成这任务。但愿你能及时找到其他人。

messages.en: What?! I already told my superiors the matter was being handled. I'm really glad you hope I can find someone else, rookie. That means so much to me whilst our own people are out there risking their lives. Don't let me catch you repeating this performance.
messages.zh: 什么？！我已经告诉上级这事正在被处理了。还好你能希望我另找他人，菜鸟。我自己人正在那面冒着搭上命的风险呢。别让我看到你再有这样的表现。

messages.en: Just give me the coordinates.
messages.zh: 直接把坐标给我吧。

messages.en: Good. I like your spirit. I'm sending you the location now: Move quickly, before their compound is reinforced once again.
messages.zh: 我很喜欢你这样的精神。我马上将地址发送给你，赶快过去在他们的增援来到之前做出行动。

messages.en: That's why I've come. You have work you can give me?
messages.zh: 这正是我来这儿的原因，你有什么事儿可以让我做么？

messages.en: During a recon operation in a contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Amarrians. In all likelihood they are assisting Empire Navy forces in some way: When we first discovered the facility it was heavily guarded, so they are obviously up to something. But their ships recently pulled out, no doubt on the way to a dirtside raid or something - and the compound is now sitting largely defenseless. This is our chance to remove their threat.
messages.zh: 最近一次在附近争夺区域的例行巡逻任务中，我们发现了一个大型设施，里面居住了数千艾玛公民。种种迹象表明，他们正在以某种方式支援帝国军队，无论直接或者是间接的。我们最初发现这个设施的时候，它被以重兵把守，这肯定是有某种原因的。最近他们的舰船被调离了那个设施，显然是去执行某些见不得人的任务了。这样这个设施的防御就被削弱到几乎没有，这是我们的一举端掉这个窝点的机会。

messages.en: I have done as you asked, the facility is destroyed.
messages.zh: 我按照你要求的做了。那个设施已经被摧毁了。

messages.en: You have done well, pilot. We can be reassured that the Amarrians pose no further threat in that sector, good work.
messages.zh: 你做的很好，飞行员。艾玛在这个地区将不再有任何威胁了。祝你好运。

messages.en: No, I can't do this. We should investigate why they're here before we start shooting. Get back to me when you've done so and then I might be interested.
messages.zh: 不，我不能这么做。我们应当在开火前仔细的调查他们为什么这么做。等你调查好了再找我，可能我会有兴趣的。

messages.en: The arrogance of you eggers! I do not report to you! I will simply find someone else to carry out this task. Your refusal has achieved nothing but my disdain!
messages.zh: 你们这帮傲慢的蠢人！我才是你的上司！我去找别人来帮我完成这个任务好了，你的拒绝没有任何意义，只是赢得了我的藐视！

messages.en: "Those who would seek peace in times of war must stay unmistakably clear of it. Withdraw yourselves from the view of your enemy and remain unseen, for even the most innocent action is a threat in the eyes of your enemy. This you must understand, for to tempt fate too often is invariably to meet it."
messages.zh: “那些想要在战火四起的时代寻找和平的人必须要认清一个事实。把你自己从你的敌人眼前隐藏起来，任何一个在你看来无辜的行为，在你的敌人眼里都会是可疑的。只有隐居的人才能有安全。这一点你必须明白，越是躲避命运，也就越容易和命运相遇。”

messages.en: The Pacifist Manifesto: Chapter I, Verso xxiv.
messages.zh: 和平主义宣言，第一章——左页xxiv

messages.en:
I do, and I hope you'll understand the importance of what I am about to ask you.

During a recon operation in a contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Amarrians. In all likelihood they are assisting Empire Navy forces in some way. When we first discovered the facility it was heavily guarded, so they are obviously up to something.

But that defensive force recently pulled out, no doubt on the way to a dirtside raid or something - and the compound is now sitting largely defenseless. This is our chance to remove their threat. Can I rely on you?
messages.zh:
是的，我希望你能理解我要你所做的事情的重要性。

在对附近争夺区域一次例行的侦察任务中，我们发现了一座大型的设施，里面居住了成千的艾玛公民。我们没能够渗透到这座据点里面去，所以他们那儿干什么，我们无法得知。种种迹象表明，他们在以某种方式，直接或者间接的支援帝国海军行动。这些都不重要，他们肯定是有了什么阴谋。

他们最近安装的防御系统被移动到了其他地方，这使得这座据点基本处于无防守状态，这是我们的机会，产出这个威胁的机会，不管到底会是什么样的威胁。干掉他们。

messages.en: What if these people are nothing but innocent bystanders? Even if they are Amarrian, do we not become what we hate if we simply kill them outright?!
messages.zh: 我反对这么做。我不能加害这些平民，很可能他们只是无辜的旁观者，即便他们是艾玛人！！

messages.en: This is war, pilot! Do you think the Heirs and their high-minded Paladins would offer our people the same courtesy?! You fool. They are clearly more than innocent bystanders: Why else were they so heavily guarded? You've disappointed me once. Do not let it happen again.
messages.zh: 这是一场战争，飞行员！你觉得太子们和他们傲慢的帕拉丁会对我们的人民有一样的谦恭么？他们明显不是无辜的过路人，看看他们在谁的地盘上，再看看他们有多少兵力在那儿守卫。你太让我失望了，别再这样。

name.ru: Волк среди овец (A Wolf in the Fold)

messages.en: It'll be my pleasure.
messages.zh: 我很高兴做这事。

messages.en: Excellent.  Remember, take out the reactor; anything else is just a bonus. Good hunting, pilot.
messages.zh: 太好了。记住，摧毁反应堆；其他都是次要目标。祝你顺利，飞行员。

messages.en: I'm game. What's the job?
messages.zh: 我早有准备。要干什么？

messages.en: A reconnaissance patrol has located the base of a group of Amarr raiders operating near this system. In order to secure our supply lines, you will need to fly to the base and destroy its main reactor, knocking it out of action. Any additional damage you can do to static defenses or the enemy raiding fleets would certainly be appreciated.
messages.zh: 一支艾玛突袭队正在该星系附近转悠，我们的侦察巡逻队已经找到了他们的基地。为了保住我们的补给线，你得飞往那基地，炸毁其主反应堆让它发挥不了作用。如果你能把那些防御工事或是敌方舰队也解决的话，那是再好不过的了。

messages.en: The reactor's been destroyed.
messages.zh: 反应堆摧毁了。

messages.en: Great work, pilot. We're already putting together a counterstrike in case they come to repair it. You've helped us bait the trap perfectly, and saved a load of war materiel and lives in the process.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。他们一旦回来修那东西我们就能组织一次反击了。你帮我们设下了一个完美陷阱，同时还节省了不少战争物资，避免了不必要的牺牲。

messages.en: I'll pass. I feel like there's something you're not telling me.
messages.zh: 我不干。我觉得你对我隐瞒了什么东西。

messages.en: I don't know what you're talking about, but if that's the way you're going to be, then I'll find someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 我不知道你在说什么。如果你偏要那么想，那我就去另寻他人。

messages.en:
Our supply lines have been taking heavy damage from Amarr raids near this system. Until recently, we were baffled as to where the enemy force was resupplying. Luckily, a reconnaissance patrol just returned with sensor data that seems to correspond with the reactor emissions of a Amarr base, and it's in exactly the right place to be supporting these raids.

We want you to fly to the location of these reactor emissions, locate the base, and destroy its main reactor; that should be enough to put it out of action for a while. The thing to remember is that the base is likely to be well-protected, with static defenses if nothing else. I'd advise being careful on your approach. Keep an eye out for any raiding groups returning to resupply. Are you ready?
messages.zh:
我们的补给线在这星系附近遭到了艾玛部队的严重袭击。前几天我们一直搞不清他们的后勤保障从何而来。还好我们的侦察巡逻队刚上报了一个信号数据，据此推断可能是艾玛基地上的一个反应堆，而这应该就是艾玛突袭队的后勤基地。

我们要你飞到那个反应堆那里，找到基地，摧毁其主反应堆；这样的话它就能消停好一会儿了。要记住那基地很可能戒备森严，即使没有什么其他防御，至少也有站桩式的防御工事。我建议你谨慎行事。要随时提防回来补给的突袭队。准备好了吗？

messages.en: There's too many of them! I can't deal with firepower of that magnitude.
messages.zh: 他们人太多了！我吃不消那样的火力。

messages.en: I'm extremely disappointed. Hopefully, I can find someone else to take this mission before they hit us again; if I can't, I hope you realize that those losses will be on your head, pilot.
messages.zh: 你让我极度失望。但愿我能在他们再次对我们施行打击之前找到其他人来接手该任务；如果不能，那一切损失都将算到你头上，飞行员。

name.ru: Волк среди овец (A Wolf in the Fold)

messages.en: It'll be my pleasure.
messages.zh: 我很高兴做这事。

messages.en: Excellent.  Remember, take out the reactor; anything else is just a bonus. Good hunting, pilot.
messages.zh: 太好了。记住，摧毁反应堆；其他都是次要目标。祝你顺利，飞行员。

messages.en: I'm game. What's the job?
messages.zh: 我早有准备。要干什么？

messages.en: A reconnaissance patrol has located the base of a group of Minmatar raiders operating near this system. In order to secure our supply lines, you will need to fly to the base and destroy its main reactor, knocking it out of action. Any additional damage you can do to static defenses or the enemy raiding fleets would certainly be appreciated.
messages.zh: 一支米玛塔尔突袭队正在该星系附近转悠，我们的侦察巡逻队已经找到了他们的基地。为了保住我们的补给线，你得飞往那基地，炸毁其主反应堆让它发挥不了作用。如果你能把那些防御工事或是敌方舰队也解决的话，那是再好不过的了。

messages.en: The reactor's been destroyed.
messages.zh: 反应堆摧毁了。

messages.en: Great work, pilot. We're already putting together a counterstrike in case they come to repair it. You've helped us bait the trap perfectly, and saved a load of war materiel and lives in the process.
