messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。他们一旦回来修那东西我们就能组织一次反击了。你帮我们设下了一个完美陷阱，同时还节省了不少战争物资，避免了不必要的牺牲。

messages.en: I'll pass. I feel like there's something you're not telling me.
messages.zh: 我不干。我觉得你对我隐瞒了什么东西。

messages.en: I don't know what you're talking about, but if that's the way you're going to be, then I'll find someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 我不知道你在说什么。如果你偏要那么想，那我就去另寻他人。

messages.en:
Our supply lines have been taking heavy damage from Minmatar raids near this system. Until recently, we were baffled as to where the enemy force was resupplying. Luckily, a reconnaissance patrol just returned with sensor data that seems to correspond with the reactor emissions of a Minmatar base, and it's in exactly the right place to be supporting these raids.

We want you to fly to the location of these reactor emissions, locate the base, and destroy its main reactor; that should be enough to put it out of action for a while. The thing to remember is that the base is likely to be well-protected, with static defenses if nothing else. I'd advise being careful on your approach. Keep an eye out for any raiding groups returning to resupply. Are you ready?
messages.zh:
我们的补给线在这星系附近遭到了米玛塔尔部队的严重袭击。前几天我们一直搞不清他们的后勤保障从何而来。还好我们的侦察巡逻队刚上报了一个信号数据，据此推断可能是米玛塔尔基地上的一个反应堆，而这应该就是米玛塔尔突袭队的后勤基地。

我们要你飞到那个反应堆那里，找到基地，摧毁其主反应堆；这样的话它就能消停好一会儿了。要记住那基地很可能戒备森严，即使没有什么其他防御，至少也有站桩式的防御工事。我建议你谨慎行事。要随时提防回来补给的突袭队。准备好了吗？

messages.en: There's too many of them! I can't deal with firepower of that magnitude.
messages.zh: 他们人太多了！我吃不消那样的火力。

messages.en: I'm extremely disappointed. Hopefully, I can find someone else to take this mission before they hit us again; if I can't, I hope you realize that those losses will be on your head, pilot.
messages.zh: 你让我极度失望。但愿我能在他们再次对我们施行打击之前找到其他人来接手该任务；如果不能，那一切损失都将算到你头上，飞行员。

messages.en: Don't worry. I can handle this.
messages.zh: 别担心，我来处理吧。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you. Just be sure you make the fight look real. If not, Serpentis will suspect something. And his associates will be trying to kill you for real anyway.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住。别忘了让这场打斗看起来真实一些。否则的话天蛇会起疑心的，而且他的同党会真的把你干掉。

messages.en: I hear you might have some work for me...
messages.zh: 我听说你有工作要给我……

messages.en: A Serpentis captain wants to surrender to us and help right his wrongs. He's currently hiding out in a small deadspace pocket with some other Serpentis watching him. Get over there, make a show of wiping him and his followers out, and then bring him back to us unharmed.
messages.zh: 一位天蛇舰长想要投靠我们，纠正他所犯下的错误。他现在隐藏在一处小死亡空间里，身边有几个天蛇人看护着他。你到那里去，演一出除掉他和他的追随者的戏，然后把他毫发无损地带回来。

messages.en: I've brought in your snitch. The Serpentis shouldn't suspect a thing.
messages.zh: 我把你要的告密者带来了。天蛇不会起疑心的。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}! Without your help, we may never have been able to extract the informant from the Serpentis. They do not like traitors and, if they found out, he'd have met an ugly death.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}！如果没有你，我们就不能把告密者从天蛇手里解救出来。他们不喜欢叛徒，而且如果他们发现的话，他早就死得很难看了。

messages.en: I don't know if I'll be able to take this mission. Find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不确定我有这个实力来接受这个任务。你还是另找别人吧。

messages.en: You should not refuse missions so lightly.
messages.zh: 你不该这么轻易地拒绝任务。

messages.en:
As you well know, the Serpentis are notorious pirates across the galaxy. They are particularly troublesome here, pushing their drugs and committing all sorts of crimes against the Federation. Every so often, though, one of them finds a conscience and decides to change his criminal ways.

It just so happens that a Serpentis captain is ready to turn himself in. Of course, he can't just dock in one of our stations and surrender: He'd be dead before he exited warp. Now, that wouldn't be a big deal, normally, but this one has information that can help bring down several higher ranking Serpentis members.

We've agreed to send someone over there for a show for this captain's friends, someone to fight with him and destroy his ship. He'll have already ejected of course and made his way to your cargo hold. Are you up to it?
messages.zh:
正如你所了解的，天蛇人是整个银河中臭名昭著的海盗。他们尤其爱在这里惹麻烦，售卖药品并犯下诸多对抗联邦的罪行。然而，他们中偶尔也会有人良心发现，决定痛改前非。

现在就有一位这样的天蛇舰长想要自首。当然，他不能大摇大摆地停靠在我们的空间站并投降：他会在脱离跃迁之前就被干掉。一般来说投降的人没有多大价值，但是这个舰长知道一些信息，能帮助我们干掉多个天蛇高级成员。

我们已经同意派遣一个人过去，给这位舰长的盟友们演一出戏，跟他打斗一番并摧毁他的舰船。在爆炸前他当然已经弹射出去了，并会躲到你的货柜舱里。你愿意去吗？

messages.en: Waiting is not an option. Because of this, I've had to assign the job to another pilot. Come back when you're ready to actually work.
messages.zh: 干等不是办法。这样的话我必须把这工作交给另一个飞行员去做。等你真正准备好要工作的时候再来找我吧。

messages.en: What were you waiting for?
messages.zh: 你在等什么？

messages.en:
I don't know how to tell you this. Here goes: I quit your mission.

Heh, I guess I do know how to tell you.
messages.zh:
我不知道该怎么说。是这样的：我要退出你给的任务。

呵呵，我猜我其实知道该怎么说。

messages.en: You can't even beat someone who wants to lose? Hmph, what are we going to do with you?
messages.zh: 你连一个想输的人都打不过？真不知道你还有什么用？

messages.en: The informant grew nervous waiting around for you to come extract him. Because of that, it looks like we've lost an opportunity to gain valuable information about our enemies. I am disappointed in your failure.
messages.zh: 告密者等你救援等得越来越紧张。因为这个原因，我们似乎损失了一次获取敌人有用信息的机会。我对你的失败很失望。

messages.en: The informant has fled
messages.zh: 告密者已逃离

name.ja: マンナー採掘コロニー

messages.en: That sounds simple enough. Sure, I can do it.
messages.zh: 那听起来太简单了。当然，我能搞定。

messages.en: I knew you'd be up for it. Careful out there.
messages.zh: 我知道会去的。在那里要小心。

messages.en: As long as you're paying!
messages.zh: 只要你付钱！

messages.en:
A Mannar mining colony has recently been attacked by rogue drones. Unfortunately, this mining colony supplies us with a good deal of cheap minerals we use for our defense initiatives. We can't wait for them to repair the damage done by the drones, so we've decided to fix their equipment for them, free of charge. The sooner we can get them back to work, the better.

All you need to do is pick up the parts from their mining colony and bring them back here. Good luck!
messages.zh:
马纳尔矿业殖民地最近遭受了流寇无人机的攻击。不幸的是，这个殖民地为我们的防御设施提供了大量廉价矿石。我们不能等着他们自己修复无人机造成的破坏力，因此我们决定帮他们免费修理装备。我们越早帮他们恢复生产越好。

你所需做的就是前去把该殖民地的所有部件捡回来给我。祝你好运！

messages.en: I've picked up the parts, as you asked.
messages.zh: 如你所要求的那样，我捡回来了那些部件。

messages.en: I hope those rogue drones weren't too much trouble? I doubted they'd be much of a match for you.
messages.zh: 我希望那些流寇无人机没有带来太多麻烦吧？我不信他们会是你的对手。

messages.en: Come back to me when you've got something interesting.
messages.zh: 当你找到有趣的东西的时候回来见我。

messages.en: Your lack of willingness is disheartening.
messages.zh: 你如此不愿意真是令人沮丧。

messages.en:
This one should be pretty simple. Near here is a mining colony owned and run by some Mannar workers. Usually, they keep things pretty solid. We even have a deal with them where we protect them and supply them with parts in exchange for a cheap supply of minerals. It all works out fine.

Recently, though, they've had some problems with rogue drones, and some of their equipment was damaged. Trouble is, we're in the middle of arming to protect against the Caldari threat, so we can't wait for them to fix their machines. Instead, I've been authorized to have their tools repaired.

You'll have to fly out to their base and pick up the tools. It shouldn't be much of a problem, though you might encounter some rogue drones or a few pirates, maybe. So you'd better go in armed.
messages.zh:
这件事应该非常简单。这附近有一个由玛纳尔工人经营的矿业殖民地。通常，他们做事总是很可靠。我们甚至和他们有一笔交易——我们提供他们安全保障以及零部件，来换得廉价矿石。这样一直合作得很愉快。

最近，有一群流寇无人机在找他们麻烦，并且损坏了他们一部分设备。麻烦的是，我们正处于武装以抵御加达里的威胁的关键时刻，因此我们不能等着他们自己修复他们的机器。相反的，我被授权修理他们的机器。

你得飞去他们的基地并把工具带回来。这不该有什么麻烦的，尽管你可能会遇到一些流寇无人机或是一些海盗。所以你最好装备齐全再去。

messages.en: Yes or no, that's all we needed. Instead, you made us wait. I can't stand indecision.
messages.zh: 不管行或不行，都是我们需要的回答。但是你使我们干等着。我不能犹豫下去了。

messages.en: Indecision killed the cat
messages.zh: 犹豫害死猫

messages.en: I've decided I had enough of this. I quit.
messages.zh: 我觉得我受够了。我退出。

messages.en: I was hoping I wouldn't have to waste our resources to deliver new parts, but I guess I will now.
messages.zh: 我本希望我们不用浪费资源来提供新的部件，但是估计现在我们不得不这样做了。

messages.en: The Mannar are nothing if not patient! But they can't wait for those parts to be repaired any longer. I've had to send someone else in with new equipment.
messages.zh: 如果不急的话，妈那儿什么都不是！但是他们不能继续等着部件慢慢修好了。我已经派其他人去递交新设施了。

messages.en: Parts delivered
messages.zh: 部件已送达

name.es: Un silencio tan profundo como la muerte

messages.en: I do love the ominous, dangerous-sounding jobs. I'll do it, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我真的喜欢这些不祥的，听起来很危险的任务。我会接受的，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Oh, thank you. You know, if you can bring back those miners in a hurry, I could maybe slap a bonus on your fee. So get moving!
messages.zh: 噢，谢谢。你知道，如果你能够尽快带回那些矿工，我可能会给你一笔额外奖金。那还不快点出发！

messages.en: Oh, sorry 'bout that. Listen – I'm just here for some work. I hear you might have something?
messages.zh: 噢，这件事很对不起了。听着—我只是来着找一些工作的。我听说你也许有一些任务可以提供？

messages.en: Investigate the distress beacon at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and rescue the lost miners.
messages.zh: 调查位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的呼救信标，并解救失踪的矿工。

messages.en: Your mining crew ran into a slave-raiding party. Those scum won't be slave raiding anymore, though — or breathing, for that matter. Here's your crew; now hand over the ISK!
messages.zh: 你的矿工陷入了一个劫掠劳工的盛宴。不过，那些杂碎不会继续劫持劳工，或者是呼吸了。这里是你的员工；现在给我星币吧！

messages.en: Oh, wonderfully done, {[character]player.name}! Those miner implants are safe and sound! You've done {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} a great service, one we probably won't forget.
messages.zh: 噢，做得太完美了，{[character]player.name}！那些植入芯片的矿工现在既安全又健康！你为{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}做了一件重要的事，一件我们难以忘怀的事！

messages.en: So you've already lost two teams of your employees to some mysterious fate… and you want me to join them?! Do I have "IDIOT" written on my forehead? No thanks, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 那么，你已经把你的两队雇员推进了神秘的命运里了……然后你希望我也加入他们？！难道我把“白痴”两个字写在额头上了吗？谢谢，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Well, I'm sorry the job sounds too dangerous for you, {[character]player.name}. If I get any jobs that involve ice cream and lollipops, should I give you a call?
messages.zh: 好吧，我很抱歉这份任务对你来说太危险了，{[character]player.name}。如果我有一些关于冰激凌和棒棒糖的任务，我是不是该联系你？

messages.en:
It never fails to amuse the more cynical in New Eden that the Amarr — with all their holier than thou piety — see nothing wrong with their use of slaves. Still, this darker side of the Amarrian faith, while upsetting to many, never fails to generate the gleam of potential profits for those willing to provide such slaves.

The Angel Cartel — arguably the strongest criminal organization plaguing the star lanes today — has not let this business opportunity go amiss. Yet it is a matter even the Cartel handles delicately, since it has no wish to openly provoke the Minmatar Empire or its Gallente allies. Still, if a few Minmatar ships go missing, who would notice? The blackness of space promises many dangers to the unwary, and much ISK to those who happen to be in the right place at the right time (with the right weapons...).
messages.zh:
每每提到那些比你们这些虔诚的人更加神圣的艾玛人，竟然从来不知道使用劳工有什么不对的，这总是令新伊甸里那些更为愤世嫉俗的人们发笑。直到现在，艾玛人信念中这黑暗的一面，在惹恼很多人的同时，也一直为那些愿意提供劳工的人们创造发财的机会。

天使集团，也许是当今出没于各条星际航线到处惹麻烦的犯罪组织中最强大的一个，没有放过这个赚钱的机会。然而，天使集团为了免于公开激怒米玛塔尔帝国及其盖伦特同盟而一直小心翼翼地运营这笔生意。不过，如果一些米玛塔尔舰船失踪了，谁会发现呢？在黑暗的宇宙中，一不小心就会遇到危险，给那些正巧在正确的时间出现在正确的地方的人（也要带着正确的武器……）送去大量星币。

messages.en: The Slave Trade
messages.zh: 劳工交易

messages.en:
Yes, that's true. You're {[character]player.name}, right? So many new capsuleers these days – hard to keep them all straight. My apologies.

Anyway, listen: We recently lost contact with a small group of miners at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Outside of the miners' distress beacon being activated, we've heard nothing from them for two days. Just... silence.

Normally, we'd just hire new crews. But we spent a fortune on implants for those miners, and we're not ready to write those off. So would you please go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and see what's what?

Whatever the case, you'll need to bring those miners back here for examination and questioning.
messages.zh:
是的，的确如此。你是{[character]player.name}，对吗？这些天有太多新的克隆飞行员——很难直接关照他们。抱歉。

无论如何，听着:近期我们与一小群位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的矿工失去了联系。除了这些矿工的求救信标被激活之外，我们已有两天没收到任何来自他们的消息了。只有……一片寂静。

通常，我们只需招募新的员工。但是我们花了一大笔钱给这些矿工植入芯片，而且我们还没打算把这一笔勾销。所以你愿意去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}看看发生了什么吗？

无论发生了什么，你必须把那些矿工带回来检查并审问。

messages.en: {[character]player.name} — since replying to potential employers is so low on your priority list, I've gone and hired someone else for the job we discussed. I hope you find the time in your busy schedule to read this message.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}——既然回复潜在雇主的消息并非你所重视的事情，我已经雇用了另一个人来完成我们曾经商量过的任务。我希望你在百忙之中抽出时间来看看这条信息。

messages.en: Miners lost
messages.zh: 矿工失踪了

messages.en: Sorry to disappoint, {[character]player.name}, but I don't see this job working out for me the way I'd prefer — you know, like me surviving it. Find yourself another hero. One with less foresight.
messages.zh: 很抱歉是你失望了，{[character]player.name}，但是我没有看到这个任务在往我期待的方向发展——你知道，就像我能忍受的那样。把你自己当成另外一个英雄吧，一个没有那么多远见的英雄。

messages.en: I'm not disappointed, {[character]player.name}. I actually had a bet going that you would quit. Thanks for letting me win!
messages.zh: 我没有失望，{[character]player.name}。事实上我曾经打赌你会放弃这个任务。谢谢你让我赢了这个赌约！

messages.en: Not that you probably care, {[character]player.name}, but thanks to your inability to do the job, those miners are probably dead now. Or worse. Have a nice night!
messages.zh: 你可能并不太在意，{[character]player.name}，但是由于你无力完成任务，那些矿工们现在可能已经丧生了，甚至更糟。祝你渡过一个愉快的夜晚！

messages.en: Miners' families mourn
messages.zh: 矿工家庭的哀伤

messages.en: Good luck out there!
messages.zh: 祝你顺利！

messages.en:
The Gallente have constructed a communications relay station very near the borders of our space. This relay is a problem because the Gallente have grown increasingly belligerent and intractable lately, and this communications relay would be able to operate outside of normal channels, enhancing the espionage capabilities of any Gallente spies that make their way into Amarr space.

We want you to enter the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and destroy the communications platform, along with the Federation pilots guarding it. We are expecting it to be guarded, but not heavily, because they think we know nothing of this location. And since you are not an official agent of the Amarrian government, we have plausible deniability.

We're not expecting you to have to go to war, but a cruiser would probably have a better chance of making it out of there than a frigate would.
messages.zh:
盖伦特在离我们边境不远处搭建了一座通讯中继站。这中继站对我们来说是个威胁。盖伦特最近胆子越来越大，越来越难对付。这个中继站是可以避开常规信道进行通信的，因此对在艾玛领域内活动的盖伦特间谍来说，这绝对是如虎添翼。

我们要你前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，摧毁那通信平台及其联邦守卫。那里应该会有些守卫，但不会太多，因为他们还以为我们对此一无所知。而且由于你不是艾玛政府派出的官方特工，因此我们能对一切进行矢口否认。

虽然你去的不是什么大战役，但用巡洋舰还是要比用护卫舰胜算更大。

messages.en: Mission accomplished. The communications platform is so much space dust.
messages.zh: 任务完成。那通信平台已化作一团灰了。

messages.en: Excellent. The Emperor will be pleased. Fear not, only the Amarrian government will know of your involvement in this enterprise.
messages.zh: 很好。皇帝会很满意的。别担心，只有艾玛政府知道你与此事有关。

messages.en: I hope I can find someone else to handle this on such short notice.
messages.zh: 但愿我能在这么短的时间内找到一个能接手此事的人。

messages.en:
The Gallente have constructed a communications relay station very near the borders of our space. This relay is a problem because the Gallente have grown increasingly belligerent and intractable lately, and this communications relay would be able to operate outside of normal channels, enhancing the espionage capabilities of any Gallente spies that make their way into Amarr space.

We want you to enter the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and destroy the communications platform, along with the Federation pilots guarding it. We are expecting it to be guarded, but not heavily, because they think we know nothing of this location. And since you are not an official agent of the Amarrian government, we have plausible deniability.
messages.zh:
盖伦特在离我们边境不远处搭建了一座通讯中继站。这中继站对我们来说是个威胁。盖伦特最近胆子越来越大，越来越难对付。这个中继站是可以避开常规信道进行通信的，因此对在艾玛领域内活动的盖伦特间谍来说，这绝对是如虎添翼。

我们要你前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，摧毁那通信平台及其联邦守卫。那里应该会有些守卫，但不会太多，因为他们还以为我们对此一无所知。而且由于你不是艾玛政府派出的官方特工，因此我们能对一切进行矢口否认。

messages.en: I guess I'll have to find someone with a little stronger loyalty to the Empire.
messages.zh: 我想我得去找一个对艾玛向心力更强一点的人。

messages.en: They won't know what hit them.
messages.zh: 我会打他们个措手不及的。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 太好了。摧毁中继塔后便尽快回来。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
Enemy forces are building up for a major offensive in the sector, and coordination will be key for their attack. Reinforcements for our positions are already on their way, but it will still be some time before they arrive. We need you to slip past their front lines and hit the communications relay they are using to coordinate their attack. That should keep them off balance and buy our fleet enough time for reinforcements to arrive.
Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Gallente Tactical Support Center, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
敌人部队正在该地区集结，准备对我们发动一次大规模袭击，而协调指挥对他们来说是关键。我们的增援部队正在往这里赶，但要到达还要点时间。我们要你潜入他们的前线，攻打他们用来协调指挥进攻的通讯中继塔。这能暂缓他们的军事集结，从而为我们的增援部队争取到宝贵的时间。
飞往位标指定地点，找出并摧毁盖伦特的战术支持中心，然后返回向代理人汇报。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. You've bought some time for our reinforcements to arrive.  I'll make sure the sector commander knows that you were responsible.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，飞行员。你为我们的增援部队赢得了宝贵的时间。我肯定会向该地区司令报告你的英雄事迹的。

messages.en: This sounds pretty risky. You can count me out of this one.
messages.zh: 这听上去太危险了，不用考虑我了。

messages.en: Yeah, I guess we can just count you out of the whole war then, huh? You need to suck it up and get your head together, pilot. This war isn't going to win itself.
messages.zh: 是啊，看来我们应该索性把你踢出这场战争算了，如何？飞行员，你要学会正视困难。战场上没有不劳而获。

messages.en:
According to the latest intelligence reports, enemy forces in this sector have been building up for a major offensive. Over the last 48 hours, we've detected a number of enemy support squadrons moving into positions that will let them hit a variety of targets with little notice. It's likely that they're planning a carefully coordinated strike against us, hoping for a breakthrough. Reinforcements are en route to this sector, but we need to buy some time.

We've located an enemy communications relay that is most likely serving as the coordination center for a large part of the enemy support fleet. While they're keeping a sharp eye on our forces, a capsuleer like yourself could sneak past their lines and hit them where they aren't looking. With the relay down, they won't be able to coordinate their attacks, and we should be able to hold them off long enough for reinforcements to arrive.
messages.zh:
最新情报显示，敌人正在该地区集结，准备对我们发动一次大规模的袭击。在过去的48小时里，我们已经注意到敌方开始部署大量支援部队，以期对我们众多要地进行偷袭。看来他们打算对我们进行一次精心设计的打击，希望打开一个突破口。我们的增援部队正在往这里赶，但我们需要争取时间。

我们已经发现了敌人的一座通讯中继塔，它的作用很可能就是用来协调指挥敌人增援大部队。虽然他们时刻关注着我们部队的一举一动，但像你这样的飞行员应该可以潜入他们的防线，打他们个措手不及。只要那中继塔一倒，他们就无法再有效组织进攻，我们也就可以在援军到达之前把他们拖住了。

messages.en: I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. Find someone else.
messages.zh: 我没法能进入到对那座中继塔有效的攻击范围内。你找别人吧。

messages.en: I thought you were supposed to be a hotshot pilot.
messages.zh: 我原本还以为你真像传说的一样厉害。

messages.en: I'll make sure they don't find a trace of him.
messages.zh: 我保证让敌人再也找不到他。

messages.en: Good. Make sure you're ready for the worst, and try not to leave witnesses.
messages.zh: 很好。要做好最坏准备，千万不要留下后患。

messages.en:
Naval Intelligence has discovered that one of the local sector commanders has a close personal relationship with a high-ranking senator, and believes that we can exploit the senator's overprotective nature by destroying the sector commander's vessel. The senator should force the Gallente into an expensive, time-consuming and ultimately futile search.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the sector commander before he knows what hit him.
messages.zh:
海军情报部门发现一位本地司令与一位高级议员有非常密切的私交，我们可以通过干掉这位司令来促使该议员意气用事。他会逼迫盖伦特部队进行一场耗时耗财，无功而返的搜寻。

我们现在要你出发，去把那司令打个措手不及。

messages.en: The enemy commander has been eliminated.
messages.zh: 我已经把那司令干掉了。

messages.en: That should keep them running in circles for a while.  Good work, pilot.
messages.zh: 这样一来敌人就要当几天无头苍蝇了。干得好，飞行员。

messages.en: I'm really not comfortable with this.
messages.zh: 我对这个不太有心情。

messages.en: You're going to need to learn a certain moral flexibility in this line of work, pilot.
messages.zh: 飞行员，干这行的需要有灵活的道德标准。

messages.en:
Recently, Naval Intelligence has been profiling the local commanders in this sector, looking for weaknesses in the enemy's defensive lines. While doing so, they've come to find out that one of the local sector commanders is a bit of a protégé to a high-ranking senator. The two of them are very close, and the senator is well known to be a bit protective of the commander.

Naval Intelligence believes they can use this to their advantage. While the sector commander is not a particularly important or successful one, we believe that if he goes missing, the senator will demand that his Navy drop everything to look for his adopted son. This will force them to scour space for the missing commander, which should buy us a few days.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the sector commander before he knows what hit him.
messages.zh:
最近，海军情报部门对此地块的地区司令们进行了详细分析，希望能借此找出敌人防守上的漏洞。在此过程中，他们发现有位司令与一位高级议员有点裙带关系。这两人关系十分密切，该议员对此司令也是关爱有加。

海军情报部门认为他们可以好生利用这一点。虽然那司令不是什么十分重要人物，但我们相信如果他消失了，那那位议员一定会要求他的海军尽一切力量去寻找他的心腹的。这样他们就会派兵出去搜寻，正好给了我们几天喘息时间。

我们现在要你出发，去把那司令打个措手不及。

messages.en: I'll get that intelligence for you.
messages.zh: 我会帮你搞到那个情报。

messages.en: I just need you to get that intelligence. Everything else is secondary to that goal. Good luck, pilot.
messages.zh: 我要的就只是那份情报，其他的东西我都无所谓。祝你好运，飞行员。

messages.en: What can I do?
messages.zh: 我能为你做什么?

messages.en:
The Gallente forces in this sector have begun an offensive, and it's keeping chunks of our fleet busy just holding the line. The enemy can't maintain a major push like this for long, though, not without serious organization. That's where we'll have to hit them to put an end to this mess.

The first step will be to locate where those supply routes are so that we can launch a counterstrike. In order to do that, we need to get access to Gallente logistical command data, which is where you come in. We need you to attack one of their supply bases and get access to the tactical information sheet in the base's main outpost. Bring it back here so we can plan our counterattack.
messages.zh:
这个区域的盖伦特军队发动了攻击，他们拖住了我们一整支正忙于顶住战线的舰队的一大部分。敌人不可能长期的支持这样一次进攻，至少，在没有严密的组织计划的情况下是不可能的。我们就在这个节骨眼上给他们狠狠一击，结束现在的混乱局面。

行动的第一步是要找到他们的供给线路这样我们可以对其实施反击。为了达成这个目的，我们需要获取盖伦特的后勤指挥数据，这就是我们要你去做的事情了。你要去攻击他们的一座补给站并且在主哨站夺取战术情报文件。把文件带回来我们就可以进行反击计划的部署了。

messages.en: I managed to get the tactical information sheet, but it wasn't easy.
messages.zh: 我拿到了战术情报文件，可不容易啊。

messages.en: You did a good job, pilot. I'll get that data into the right hands immediately.
messages.zh: 你干得很好，飞行员。我马上就会把这份情报交到需要的人手里。

messages.en: I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 这事儿我懒得管。

messages.en: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will. We can't afford to let this offensive continue unchecked.
messages.zh: 如果你不做的话，我可就得找别人了。我们不能让这种攻击性的行为就这么放任不管。

messages.en:
The Gallente forces in this sector have begun an offensive, and it's keeping chunks of our fleet busy just holding the line. The enemy can't maintain a major push like this for long, though, not without serious organization. That's where we'll have to hit them to put an end to this mess.

The first step will be to locate where those supply routes are so that we can launch a counterstrike. In order to do that, we need to get access to Gallente logistical command data, which is where you come in. We need you to attack one of their supply bases and get access to the tactical information sheet in the base's main outpost. Bring it back here so we can plan our counterattack.
messages.zh:
这个区域的盖伦特军队发动了攻击，他们拖住了我们一整支正忙于顶住战线的舰队的一大部分。敌人不可能长期的支持这样一次进攻，至少，在没有严密的组织计划的情况下是不可能的。我们就在这个节骨眼上给他们狠狠一击，结束现在的混乱局面。

行动的第一步是要找到他们的供给线路这样我们可以对其实施反击。为了达成这个目的，我们需要获取盖伦特的后勤指挥数据，这就是我们要你去做的事情了。你要去攻击他们的一座补给站并且在主哨站夺取战术情报文件。把文件带回来我们就可以进行反击计划的部署了。

messages.en: This is way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这完全超出了我的理解能力，你另找高手吧。

messages.en: You're setting our entire war effort back by weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out the missions we need, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder next time.
messages.zh: 你把我们的整个作战计划的进度又推回到了几周之前。如果你不能执行我们的命令，那你对我们已经没有用处了。你下次最好更努力点工作。

messages.en: I'll take out those industrials immediately!
messages.zh: 我马上就去干掉那些工业舰。

messages.en:
Great! Things shouldn't be too difficult for someone of your skills. Fly over to the depot and head off the industrials.

Your biggest worry will be capsuleers loyal to the Federation. You should prepare yourself to battle or avoid them.
messages.zh:
很好！这些事对于你这样有能力的人应该算不了什么。飞过去补给站那儿把敌人的工业舰干掉。

你最大的对手可能是对方的克隆飞行员。你要做好准备，要么和他们战斗要么就避开他们。

messages.en: I am alive and so I serve the State.
messages.zh: 我既然或这就要为合众国干点事情。

messages.en: The Gallente are transporting a load of weapons and ammo to their depot in a nearby system. While we can't attack the weapons depot directly at this time, interdicting their transports serves the purpose just as well. Destroy the industrials before they can drop off the ammo. Just be warned, capsuleers working for the Federation may try to stop you.
messages.zh: 盖伦特运送了大量的武器和弹药到他们位于附近一个星系的补给站。我们现在还没法直接攻击这个补给站，但是截断他们的补给线路一样能够达成预想的效果。在他们把弹药送抵目的地之前击毁他们的工业舰。你要当心的是在当地活动的联邦克隆飞行员，他们会试图阻止你。

messages.en: I've successfully destroyed the industrials!
messages.zh: 我成功的击毁了工业舰！

messages.en: Good work.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮。

messages.en: Yawn, that doesn't sound like it's worth my time at all.
messages.zh: 啊哈，这听来好像不值得我花时间去做。

messages.en: I never thought you'd turn this down. Oh well, I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 我从来没想过你会让大家失望。好吧，我在另外找人。

messages.en:
I'm glad to see that you're here, pilot. I've got some work that's right up your alley. You see, a nearby system has long been contested. Just recently, things have reached a head.

The Federation forces in the area are rearmed by a weapons depot in the system. We cannot strike directly at the depot itself, but we can stem the flow of supplies into the depot. We've received word that a convoy of supplies is heading there now. It's lightly guarded and destroying it will surely set the Gallente forces in this area back. Do you think you can handle it?
messages.zh:
很高兴你在这儿，飞行员。我这儿有些任务非常的适合你。你看，附近的一个星系已经成为争夺状态很久了。就在不久前，情况发生了一些变化。

那个区域的联邦军队受到星系里面的一个补给站持续的补给和重新武装。我们不能直接的打击这个补给站，但是我们可以截掉它的运输线路。我们得到情报说一支补给船队正在向那儿进发。船队的防御很弱，摧毁掉它能够重重的挫伤这个区域的盖伦特军事活动。你觉得你可以应付得了么？

messages.en: I'm afraid I must abandon this mission. I hope you understand.
messages.zh: 恐怕我得要放弃这个任务了。我希望你能明白。

messages.en: You're quitting on me? Truly a sad day.
messages.zh: 你不干了？真是难过的一天。

name.ja: 激しさを増すロイドレイジ

messages.en: Those miners won't know what hit them.
messages.zh: 那些矿工都不知道是什么打到他们的。

messages.en: I knew you'd be up for it! You shouldn't have too much trouble with the Gallente, however, we've had reports that capsuleers loyal to the Federation are roaming the area. Because the system is contested, they'll be able to attack you if they catch you. Be prepare to face them.
messages.zh: 我知道你会帮忙的！盖伦特应该难不倒你，但是我们的情报显示很多为联邦做事儿的克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动。因为这个区域是争夺状态的，所以一旦他们发现你就会对你进行攻击。你要有所准备。

messages.en: How can I be of use?
messages.zh: 我该怎么帮忙？

messages.en: Our scanners just uncovered a hidden asteroid belt in a contested system. The Gallente apparently got to it before us and have already begun mining it. It still has plenty of ore, however, so we want to ensure that ore gets to us instead. All you have to do is fly out there and blow those miners to smithereens.
messages.zh: 我们的扫描器在争夺区域发现了一个隐藏的小行星带。盖伦特人显然赶在我们之前已经发现并开始进行开采了。目前看来还剩余有大量的矿石藏量，所以我们得要把这些矿石夺过来。你要做的只是飞过去把那些采矿船都干掉就行了。

messages.en: The asteroid belt has been cleared of hostile miners. Hostile miners? That sounds like an oxymoron.
messages.zh: 小行星带的敌方采矿船已经被请出了。

messages.en: Now that those Gallente fools have been taken care of, our own miners can go in and strip the belt. Unless the Gallente send someone to counterattack... But nah, that's not likely to happen. Good job, come back to me when you're ready for some more work.
messages.zh: 那些盖伦特的蠢货们已经被解决了，我们自己的采矿船可以进场作业了。除非那些盖伦特人又回来反击……但不像，应该不会发生了。干得不错，等你准备好了接下个任务的时候回来找我吧。

messages.en: I'm not sure I'm up for taking this mission. Maybe something else?
messages.zh: 我不是很肯定我是不是想谈论这个任务，有其他的事情么？

messages.en: That's a shame. This is important work.
messages.zh: 很遗憾啊，这可是个重要的任务。

messages.en:
It seems I am in luck. You see, we have recently discovered a rather large hidden asteroid belt. This belt has many resources that we could exploit. Unfortunately, it seems the Gallente Federation found it before us. They've miners over there right now stripping the belt of its precious mineral resources. We certainly can't let them do that!

I want you to fly over there and chase those miners off. By which I mean, of course, blowing them up. The bigger the explosions, the better. Can you do this for me?
messages.zh:
看起来我很走运。你看，最近我们发现了一个相当大规模的隐藏小行星矿带。这个矿带中蕴藏了很多我们可以加以利用的资源。不幸的是，盖伦特联邦政府在我们之前先发现了这个矿带，他们的矿工和采矿船已经在那里对这个小行星矿带中的贵重资源进行开采了。我们当然不能让他们这样做！

我要你飞过去那个矿带，把那些采矿船都赶走。我说的是，当然，你得把它们都消灭掉。爆炸的焰火越剧烈越好，让他们都看看。你能帮我做这事儿么？

messages.en: I'm afraid I bit off more than I can chew.
messages.zh: 恐怕我干不了这个。

messages.en: I didn't think some miners would be able to scare you off!
messages.zh: 我并不觉得一些矿工就能吓到你！

messages.en: Don't worry about it. I'll take them out and make sure the Federation gains nothing!
messages.zh: 别担心这个。我会确保他们能挺过来而且联邦从中得不到任何好处。

messages.en: Excellent. I've uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. If you move fast, you'll be able to take out those repair ships with no problem. Your main competition will be pod pilots flying under the banner of the Federation. Prepare yourself to fight them if they try to intervene.
messages.zh: 很好。我已经把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中了。如果你行动迅速，应该可以毫不费劲地摧毁那些维修船。你的首要威胁来自于那些联邦的克隆飞行员。准备好和那些阻止你的人大干一场吧。

messages.en: I'll give everything I've got. What do you need of me?
messages.zh: 我会把我的所有都奉献出来。你需要做什么？

messages.en: The Gallente Federation is trying to reopen a gate in one of the nearby contested systems. Things are especially urgent, because our spies have learned they have a large strike force ready to come through the gate as soon as it's back online. We do not have the manpower to fight off the strike force at this time. Get there and destroy their repair ships.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦尝试将附近争夺区域中的一座废弃的星门重新开启。这件事非常的紧急，因为我们的间谍发现在星门的另一端集结了一直庞大的攻击部队，准备穿过星门直接攻击我们的后方。现在我们没有足够的人力再来处理这事儿。你去把那些负责维修星门的舰船都清除掉。

messages.en: The repair crew has been destroyed and the gate remains offline. You have nothing more to worry about.
messages.zh: 维修船已经被消灭了，星门目前依然处于离线状态。你没什么好担心的了。

messages.en: This is great news! It truly shows that the honorable State is the strongest. With that repair crew taken out, we can request reinforcements and either demolish that gate or repair it ourselves and ambush the strike force as it comes through. You truly earned your reward today.
messages.zh: 这真是个大好消息！这表现了威力大的合众国是最强大的。现在这支维修队被消灭了，我们就有时间排出增援部队和爆破小组去把这个星门个完全消灭掉，或者我们自己把它修好然后等待他们的部队过来给予迎头痛击。你今天表现得非常好！

messages.en: That sounds like too much pressure for me.
messages.zh: 这听来对我的压力太大了。

messages.en: If our ancestors had that attitude, we'd never have achieved greatness.
messages.zh: 如果我们的祖先都是这种态度的话，我们根本不可能达到今天的辉煌。

messages.en:
Something urgent has just come across my desk. The Gallente Federation at one time managed to set up a gate in a nearby contested system. We eventually drove them off, but we never got around to tearing the gate down. It seems that was a mistake, as now the Gallente are trying to get the gate operational again. They have a huge strike force on the other side, waiting to come through.

We do not have the manpower to fight off that strike force. However, we still have time to act. While our forces are keeping the escorts busy, you need to go in and take out those repair ships. Can you do that?
messages.zh:
有些紧急的事情刚刚被送到我的办公桌上。盖伦特联邦曾经有一次在附近的争夺区域安放了一座星门。我们最终还是把他们给驱赶跑了，但当时并没有把那座星门给拆掉。现在看来那是当时的一个失误，现在这些盖伦特人正尝试把这座星门重新运转起来。他们在门的另一头集结了大量的攻击部队，准备在星门回复运转过后穿越过来。

我们没有足够的人力去抵抗这股攻击部队。不过，我们还有时间。我们的部队现在忙于防御巡逻，你现在就可以去把那些负责维修星门的舰船全都清楚掉。有问题么？

messages.en: Things got too hot for me! I've got to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这对我来说太烫手了！我要放弃这个任务。

messages.en: You can't? Don't you realize what this could mean? Get out of my sight; I need to find someone else to take your place.
messages.zh: 你没办法？你知道这意味着什么吗？滚出我的视线；我另外找人去完成这个任务。

messages.en: Understood. I'll deal with this immediately.
messages.zh: 明白。我马上动身处理这事。

messages.en: Good. There is no room for error here, so don't make me regret trusting you with this.
messages.zh: 好。这事情容不得半点闪失，别让我后悔相信你。

messages.en: I'm listening…
messages.zh: 愿洗耳恭听……

messages.en: We've learned that a Federation Intelligence Office agent has infiltrated our ranks and has been actively working against us ever since. Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops to undoubtedly strike at our weakest points. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat, understood?
messages.zh: 据称多年前有一位联邦特工渗入了我们组织内部，一直在背后行使对我们不利的事情。许是他察觉到了，也许只是时机上的巧合，反正最近有人看到他在附近区域正召集一小支队伍。毫无疑问，他们打算袭击我们的要害点。他知不知道我们已经盯上了他已经不重要了；把他弄死就万事大吉。明白吗？

messages.en: I've dispatched the spy and his bodyguards.
messages.zh: 我把那间谍和他的守卫都干掉了。

messages.en: Excellent work, thank you. I hoped I could rely on your expertise and discretion. Once again you prove yourself a valuable ally of the Caldari people.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，真要谢谢你啊。我认为我能相信你的水平和判断力，事实果然证明你是加达里人民值得信赖的朋友。

messages.en: Why aren't we trying to capture and interrogate him? I want no part in any assassination of such a valuable source.
messages.zh: 为什么我们不去把他抓起来审问呢？这家伙可以提供重要情报，我想留他一条命。

messages.en: The arrogance and presumption of you eggers amazes me. I don't need to explain myself to you; I'll just get someone else who knows their place.
messages.zh: 你的傲慢与自以为是真是出乎我意料。我没必要向你解释什么；我自去找一个知道天高地厚的人。

messages.en: The gradual breakdown in relations between the empires over recent years has seen a drastic increase in their focus on espionage as a tool to both prevent, and more regularly, enhance warfare. As a result, spying is rife inside all of the empires and the common assumption that many organizations operate under is that they have already been compromised. Very few are trusted with crucial information, and those that have been are very closely watched. Despite their vast differences, the brutal treatment of those caught in the act is one thing shared by each nation.
messages.zh: 随着近年来关系逐渐恶化，帝国之间的间谍活动越发频繁。虽然这其中有部分行动是为了防止战争，但更多情况下，这些活动的进行是为了加强一方的战争优势。因此各帝国中的间谍活动都可以说是到达了猖獗程度，许多组织已被渗透更是一个共同假设。现在已经有很少组织可以被托付机密信息了，而那些为数不多可以被托付的也处于严密监视之下。国家虽各异，但在对被抓间谍的处理上，它们倒是如出一辙的残忍。

messages.en: A brutal commonality
messages.zh: 残忍共性

messages.en:
We've got a mess on our hands and I need you to clean it up.

We recently came across some startling intelligence, given to us by certain sources I won't name. We learned that a Federation Intelligence Office agent had infiltrated our ranks many years ago and has been actively working against us ever since. After this discovery we began watching this individual closely, it seems a little too closely.

Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops. Undoubtedly, they plan to strike at our weakest points. There is any number of nightmare scenarios they could bring to bear. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat.

Understood?
messages.zh:
我们搞砸了件事情，我需要你去帮我们擦屁股。

我们最近获悉了条让人唏嘘不已的情报，情报来源我这里不便透露。据称多年前有一位联邦特工渗入了我们组织内部，一直在背后行使对我们不利的事情。了解这情况后，我们开始对他进行近距离监视，但监视地可能太近了。

也许是他察觉到了，也许只是时机上的巧合，反正最近有人看到他在附近区域正召集一小支队伍。毫无疑问，他们打算袭击我们的要害点。他有可能为我们带来无尽麻烦。他知不知道我们已经盯上了他已经不重要了；把他弄死就万事大吉。

明白了吗？

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't get to him, there's too much at risk.
messages.zh: 恐怕我抓不住他了，风险太大。

messages.en: Risk? Risk?! You have a clone, what risk is there? I'll tell you what risk is: it's when you have a long-time spy in your organization leading fleets against you, that's risk! Whatever, I'll find someone else who can spare me of such pathetic excuses for their own cowardice.
messages.zh: 风险？你说风险？！你有克隆还谈什么风险？我告诉你什么是风险：一个间谍在你内部长期作威作福，然后他带领一支舰队对你实行倒戈，这才叫风险！算了，我去找一个不会用借口来掩饰自己懦弱的人。

messages.en: Of course. Give me the coordinates and I'll head out immediately.
messages.zh: 当然。快把位标给我，我立刻动身。

messages.en: Excellent, I'll tell them to proceed. Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.
messages.zh: 太好了，我将告诉他们按计划行事。尽快飞往那里听候调遣。我将根据战场形势直接向你发出进攻或是撤退的命令。

messages.en: Oh? Let's hear it then.
messages.zh: 噢？说出来听听。

messages.en:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance. We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Federation logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and we're expecting Federation forces to be more prepared than usual.

Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.
messages.zh:
我们打算即将深入敌后发动一场高风险的行动。我要你也参与以提供特定协助。盖伦特有一对一整个争夺区域提供后勤支援的弹药库，那里有重兵把守，我要你去对它进行打击。战斗会很激烈，而且我们估计他们较以往会有更充足的准备。

快飞往那里听候调遣。我将根据战场形势直接向你发出进攻或是撤退的命令。

messages.en: Was that all you needed done? How is the fight going?
messages.zh: 你要求的事都完成了吗？战斗怎么样了？

messages.en: I just received word that the cache has been secured and will be detonated once we've cleared the area. Excellent work out there, they've lost a strategic foothold as well as a prominent commander today, we couldn't be happier with the result.
messages.zh: 我得到消息说那弹药库已在我们控制之下，我们把那地区清空之后就会用炸弹点爆它。你干得漂亮，他们今天不仅失去了一个战略工事，还损失了一名重要司令，对于这样的结果我们是再满意不过了。

messages.en: This high-pressure stuff isn't really for me, I'm afraid. You'd be better off finding someone else.
messages.zh: 我觉得这种压力超大的事不是我能干的。你最好找别人。

messages.en: Am I supposed to be admiring your honesty here? If you're not cut out for this kind of work then you're not worth my time, period.
messages.zh: 我是不是应该钦佩你有自知之明啊？如果你不是天生干这活儿的，那就别再浪费我时间了，就这样。

messages.en: As relations began to slide further towards outright war, each of the empires increased their focus on long-term strategic interests. Exhaustively detailed battle plans of everything from invasion scenarios to the best locations for ammunitions caches were deliberated over endlessly by countless organizations dedicated to the singular task of winning, or perhaps simply surviving, a seemingly inevitable war.
messages.zh: 随着关系变糟得已经有了爆发全面战争的可能，各帝国都开始将他们的注意力越来越多地投向了他们的长期战略利益。他们制定了各种详尽计划，从应对侵略到选择弹药库存放地，所有的计划都被各级组织反复讨论。面对一场似乎无法避免的战争，这些组织身上都背负了赢取它——或者只是在其中存活下来——的重任。

messages.en: Prepare for the worst.
messages.zh: 做好最坏打算。

messages.en:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance.

We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Federation logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and a great deal at stake for us should we fail to impede the recent progress they've been making.

We've reason to believe that our plans have already been partly compromised. We're expecting Federation forces to be more prepared than usual, possibly even reinforced, and we're aiming to prepare ourselves accordingly. I've been tasked with organising a capsuleer-based contingency plan and deploying it with specific orders in mind. Once I given the clear that we've got someone, they'll be launching the offensive immediately, so time is of the essence.

Having someone as capable as you at our backs would allow us a great deal of tactical flexibility on-field and all but ensure that victory is swift and casualties low. If it turns out you're not needed, then we'll still pay you for your time, but certain orders I've been receiving suggest we may yet have a use for you out there, time will tell.

Are you up for the mission?
messages.zh:
我们打算即将深入敌后发动一场高风险的行动。我要你也参与以提供特定协助。

盖伦特有一对一整个争夺区域提供后勤支援的弹药库，那里有重兵把守，我要你去对它进行打击。如果我们不能阻止他们最近的攻势，那后面的仗将越发难打，风险巨大。

其实我认为我们的计划已经部分失败了。联邦的准备较之前更加充分，他们可能已经调集了援军，我们也要做好相应准备。我的任务是筹划一个由飞行员执行的应急计划，号施令由我来发。一旦我这里清理掉了一个关键人物，那他们就可以马上发动大规模袭击了，因此时间是关键。

有你这样一位有能力的飞行员助阵将允许我们施行更灵活的战术，最重要的是我们可以获取一场耗时少，伤亡低的胜利。如果实际情况没你也行，那我们还是会付你钱的，毕竟我们占用了你的时间；但从我目前收到的命令来看，你还是会被派上用场的，等着瞧吧。

你准备好了吗？

messages.en: I'm sorry, but I have to decline this mission after all, I won't be able to provide the level of assistance you're after.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我必须拒绝该任务，我不能提供你想要的协助。

messages.en: What?! I already told them we had someone inbound and they launched the operation! This is a gross display of negligence on your behalf, pilot. I'll be making a note of it in your records, just as soon as I've found someone who is actually reliable.
messages.zh: 什么？！我已经告诉他们有人加入，他们已经开始行动了！飞行员，你让人看到了你的庸碌无为。我会在找到其他可靠的人后在你简历上记上这一笔。

name.ru: Боевой дух и высокая мораль (Morale and Morality)

messages.en: If you think I have a problem with this, I don't. I understand completely. Give me the location of the residence.
messages.zh: 如果你认为我会有所顾虑，那你就错了。我完全明白这种道理。给我那个居住地的坐标吧。

messages.en: You're right; I should have known you could be relied upon in these matters. I'm uploading the coordinates now, good luck.
messages.zh: 你说的对， 我早就知道你是完全可以被信任的。我正把座标上传给你。

messages.en: How can I serve?
messages.zh: 我能帮你什么

messages.en:
We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the Federation's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Caldari people. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

They have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these industrials, we can starve the enemy out.
messages.zh:
我们在附近联邦具有主要控制权的地区发现了一个民用设施。这个据点里面居住了数千他们的居民，大部分都是在附近舰艇和设施中服役的士兵和官员的家属。这些人是来这里为他们的军队提高士气的，而我们正是不能容忍这样的事情发生。

他们有一个很大的弱点：就是供给线。殖民地的日常生活和军事需求都是完全依靠一条工业运输线路来完成。如果我们能够拦截摧毁那些工业舰，那么我们的敌人就得挨饿了。

messages.en: The Industrials have been destroyed. I only hope this serves our purposes and doesn't backfire.
messages.zh: 工业舰已经被干掉了，我只是希望我们能达到目的且不要节外生枝。

messages.en: Though I understand and even share those same concerns, it was a risk that had to be taken. Good work today pilot, here's your pay.
messages.zh: 其实我理解这些问题，但这个风险时必须要承担的。你做的很好，飞行员，这是你的报酬。

messages.en: Briefings like this make me question what side I should be fighting for. I want nothing to do with this.
messages.zh: 想这样的任务简报让我开始怀疑我到底该为谁工作。我不想参与这事儿。

messages.en: What would you have us do then, huh? Shall we just leave them there, let them continue to offer a kind of assistance no amount of military and logistics support can? You disappoint me, deeply. Oh, and if I find out you've leaked this information, there will be consequences.
messages.zh: 你要我们怎么办，恩？我们就这么放着他们不管？就这么让他们为我们的敌人提供任何军事和后勤支援都不能提供的支持？你让我失望了，深深的失望了。哦，要是我知道你泄露了机密的话，绝不会给你好果子吃的。

messages.en: Civilian deaths in a war are a reality, one which is accepted as inevitable by all of the empires. The effects of such things are often hard to predict, however, and those targeting their attacks must do so carefully. There are times when the mass death of civilians can indeed crush a nation's will to fight any further, or cause such anxiety amongst their citizenry that popular support for conflict is replaced by angry cries to back down. At other times however, it will only harden their resolve, serving as a valuable and yet grim propaganda victory, that allows them to paint their enemy as a heartless monster.
messages.zh: 战争中平民的死亡是现实的问题，无论是什么样的国家都必须接受它的不可逃避性。这种事情的结果通常是难以预料的，但是，那些发动攻击的人必须要小心的选择目标。有的时候，大量的平民伤亡可能在最大限度上消磨一个国家的战斗意志，甚至在其国民之中造成大恐慌，使得要求妥协结束战争的人取代那些好战份子。但是在更多时候，却只会坚定他们的意志，成为一个宣传的好案例，更加的使其敌人妖魔化。

messages.en: A risky target
messages.zh: 危险的目标

messages.en:
What I am about to ask you is strictly confidential, understood?

We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the Federation's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Caldari people.

Their arrogance is astounding, no? They seem to think we will allow them to exist in peace simply because they bear no weapons. Their weak security presence suggests as much. Understand pilot; these people are as significant a threat as any other. What they provide may not be firepower or logistics but it is crucial to their war effort nonetheless. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

They have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these industrials, we can starve the enemy out.
messages.zh:
我要你干的事情是十分保密的，你能明白么？

我们在附近联邦具有主要控制权的地区发现了一个民用设施。这个据点里面居住了数千他们的居民，大部分都是在附近舰艇和设施中服役的士兵和官员的家属。这些人是来这里为他们的军队提高士气的，而这些军人正式那些伤害我们加达里自己兄弟和国民的凶手。

这帮人傲慢到了极点，不是么？他们以为我们会放任他们不管，看看他们那不堪一击的安防系统就知道了。明智的飞行员，这些人的威胁是不容置疑的，他们所来的可能不是枪炮和补给，但是却大大的增强了敌人的士气，我们决不能让他们这么做。

他们有一个很大的弱点：就是供给线。殖民地的日常生活和军事需求都是完全依靠一条工业运输线路来完成。如果我们能够拦截摧毁那些工业舰，那么我们的敌人就得挨饿了。

messages.en: I've had second thoughts. I simply cannot do something as monstrous as this. We risk too much with actions of this nature.
messages.zh: 我还有另外一个想法，我不能干这种禽兽不如的事情。做这样的事情所造成的风险实在太大了。

messages.en: Spare me the ethics lecture. I will find someone else who understands the importance of this mission.
messages.zh: 省省你的道德课吧。我会另外找个明白其中重要性高手来办这事儿。

messages.en: I can't let them succeed. I'll make sure both the Republic and Federation pay for their audacity!
messages.zh: 我不会让他们得逞的。我保证会让共和国和联邦为他们的胆大包天付出代价。

messages.en: Great. Now, the forces building the starbase probably aren't too tough. After all, most will be prepared for construction, not combat. However, I'm sure there will be capsuleers working for our enemies in the area. You'll have to set yourself up to combat them.
messages.zh: 很好。建造哨站的那帮人容易对付，毕竟他们是建筑工，不是战士。不过我相信那里应该会有为敌人卖命的飞行员。你最好还是带枪上阵。

messages.en: I'll make the world regret their antagonism.
messages.zh: 他们和我们斗，我会让他们后悔的。

messages.en:
A joint taskforce between the Minmatar and Gallente are trying to establish a starbase inside one of our contested systems. We cannot allow them to succeed. Luckily the starbase's main reactor is vulnerable to attack.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Just remember, capsuleers loyal to our enemies will be able to fire on you in that system.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔盖伦特联军打算在我们的一个争夺星系中搭建一个哨站。我们不能让他们得逞。还好那哨站的主反应堆还很脆弱。

我已经把哨站的位置上传到你的控制边栏里了。记住，为敌方效力的飞行员可以在那星系里自由攻击你。

messages.en: I expected more of the Republic-Federation alliance! I've trashed their reactor.
messages.zh: 我看共和国和联邦的联盟会更加牢固，因为我们把他们的反应堆已经毁了。

messages.en: Excellent! If that's the best the Minmatar and Gallente can throw against us together, our future is certainly bright indeed. You definitely earned your reward here.
messages.zh: 太好了！如果米玛塔尔和盖伦特就真这点能耐，那我们就可以高枕无忧了。你这钱该拿。

messages.en: The Republic and Federation are working together? I could handle one, but not both!
messages.zh: 共和国和联邦强强联手？一个我还能对付，两个就不行了！

messages.en: Hmph. I thought you'd jump to take this mission.
messages.zh: 靠。我还以为你会兴奋地跳起来呢。

messages.en:
It looks like our enemies have banded together to attack us. The Minmatar and Gallente have always been close, but they haven't been cooperating to a great extent in the war. That seems to have changed.

You see, the Gallente have been trying for months to get a starbase set up inside one of the nearby contested systems. We've been stopping them, but now it seems like they've got the Minmatar to assist them.

Thankfully we've found out before they could get everything online. Their main reactor is still vulnerable to attack. If you destroy it, it will take the starbase with it. Can you head over there and take it out for us?
messages.zh:
看样子我们的敌人已经联合起来攻击我们了。虽然米玛塔尔和盖伦特关系很近，但以前他们还从来没有在战争中有过大规模的合作。但现在情况有所改变。

盖伦特数月来一直试图在邻近争夺星系里竖立一个哨站。我们也试图一直反制他们，但现在看起来他们背后还有米玛塔尔撑腰。

所幸我们及早察觉到了这点。他们现在那主反应堆还很脆弱。你把主反应堆端掉，那哨站也就搭不起来了。你能前往那里帮我们把它解决掉吗？

messages.en: The combined forces of the Republic and Federation were too much for me to handle.
messages.zh: 这两家联手我没法对付。

messages.en: Unfortunate. Having you fail shows our enemies weakness.
messages.zh: 不幸啊，你这是在向敌人示弱。

messages.en: They won't know what hit them.
messages.zh: 我会打他们个措手不及的。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 太好了。摧毁中继塔后便尽快回来。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
Enemy forces are building up for a major offensive in the sector, and coordination will be key for their attack. Reinforcements for our positions are already on their way, but it will still be some time before they arrive. We need you to slip past their front lines and hit the communications relay they are using to coordinate their attack. That should keep them off balance and buy our fleet enough time for reinforcements to arrive.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Caldari Tactical Support Center, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
敌人部队正在该地区集结，准备对我们发动一次大规模袭击，而协调指挥对他们来说是关键。我们的增援部队正在往这里赶，但要到达还要点时间。我们要你潜入他们的前线，攻打他们用来协调指挥进攻的通讯中继塔。这能暂缓他们的军事集结，从而为我们的增援部队争取到宝贵的时间。

飞往位标指定地点，找出并摧毁加达里的战术支持中心，然后返回向代理人汇报。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. You've bought some time for our reinforcements to arrive.  I'll make sure the sector commander knows that you were responsible.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，飞行员。你为我们的增援部队赢得了宝贵的时间。我肯定会向该地区司令报告你的英雄事迹的。

messages.en: This sounds pretty risky. You can count me out of this one.
messages.zh: 这听上去太危险了，不用考虑我了。

messages.en: Yeah, I guess we can just count you out of the whole war then, huh? You need to suck it up and get your head together, pilot. This war isn't going to win itself.
messages.zh: 是啊，看来我们应该索性把你踢出这场战争算了，如何？飞行员，你要学会正视困难。战场上没有不劳而获。

messages.en:
According to the latest intelligence reports, enemy forces in this sector have been building up for a major offensive. Over the last 48 hours, we've detected a number of enemy support squadrons moving into positions that will let them hit a variety of targets with little notice. It's likely that they're planning a carefully coordinated strike against us, hoping for a breakthrough. Reinforcements are en route to this sector, but we need to buy some time.

We've located an enemy communications relay that is most likely serving as the coordination center for a large part of the enemy support fleet. While they're keeping a sharp eye on our forces, a capsuleer like yourself could sneak past their lines and hit them where they aren't looking. With the relay down, they won't be able to coordinate their attacks, and we should be able to hold them off long enough for reinforcements to arrive.
messages.zh:
最新情报显示，敌人正在该地区集结，准备对我们发动一次大规模的袭击。在过去的48小时里，我们已经注意到敌方开始部署大量支援部队，以期对我们众多要地进行偷袭。看来他们打算对我们进行一次有组织的袭击，妄图来一场大胜。我们的增援部队正在往这里赶，但我们需要争取时间。

我们已经发现了敌人的一座通讯中继塔，它的作用很可能就是用来协调指挥敌人增援大部队。虽然他们时刻关注着我们部队的一举一动，但像你这样的飞行员应该可以潜入他们的防线，打他们个措手不及。只要那中继塔一倒，他们就无法再有效组织进攻，我们也就可以在援军到达之前把他们拖住了。

messages.en: I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. Find someone else.
messages.zh: 我没法能进入到对那座中继塔有效的攻击范围内。你找别人吧。

messages.en: I thought you were supposed to be a hotshot pilot.
messages.zh: 我原本还以为你真像传说的一样厉害。

messages.en: They won't know what hit them.
messages.zh: 我会打他们个措手不及的。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 太好了。摧毁中继塔后便尽快回来。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

That should keep them off balance and buy our fleet enough time for reinforcements to arrive.
Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Minmatar Tactical Support Center, and return to your agent.

飞往位标指定地点，找出并摧毁米玛塔尔的战术支持中心，然后返回向代理人汇报。

messages.en: I've eliminated the communications relay.
messages.zh: 我已把通讯中继塔端掉了。

messages.zh: 我没法能进入到对那座中继塔有效的攻击范围内。你找别人吧。

messages.en: I thought you were supposed to be a hotshot pilot.
messages.zh: 我原本还以为你真像传说的一样厉害。

messages.en: I'll make sure they don't find a trace of him.
messages.zh: 我保证让敌人再也找不到他。

messages.en: Good. Make sure you're ready for the worst, and try not to leave witnesses.
messages.zh: 很好。要做好最坏准备，千万不要留下后患。

messages.en:
Naval Intelligence has discovered that one of the local sector commanders has a close personal relationship with a high-ranking elder, and believes that we can exploit the elder's overprotective nature by destroying the sector commander's vessel. The elder should force the Minmatar into an expensive, time-consuming and ultimately futile search.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the sector commander before he knows what hit him.
messages.zh:
海军情报部门发现一位本地司令与一位高级长老有非常密切的私交，我们可以通过干掉这位司令来促使该长老意气用事。他会逼迫米玛塔尔部队进行一场耗时耗财，无功而返的搜寻。

我们现在要你出发，去把那司令打个措手不及。

messages.en: The enemy commander has been eliminated.
messages.zh: 我已经把那司令干掉了。

messages.en: That should keep them running in circles for a while.  Good work, pilot.
messages.zh: 这样一来敌人就要当几天无头苍蝇了。干得好，飞行员。

messages.en: I'm really not comfortable with this.
messages.zh: 我对这个不太有心情。

messages.en: You're going to need to learn a certain moral flexibility in this line of work, pilot.
messages.zh: 飞行员，干这行的需要有灵活的道德标准。

messages.en:
Recently, Naval Intelligence has been profiling the local commanders in this sector, looking for weaknesses in the enemy's defensive lines. While doing so, they've come to find out that one of the local sector commanders is a bit of a protégé to a high-ranking tribal elder. The two of them are very close, and the elder is well known to be a bit protective of the commander.

Naval Intelligence believes they can use this to their advantage. While the sector commander is not a particularly important or successful one, we believe that if he goes missing, the elder will demand that his Navy drop everything to look for his adopted son. This will force them to scour space for the missing commander, which should buy us a few days.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the sector commander before he knows what hit him.
messages.zh:
最近，海军情报部门对此地块的地区司令们进行了详细分析，希望能借此找出敌人防守上的漏洞。在此过程中，他们发现有位司令与一位高级长老有点裙带关系。这两人关系十分密切，该长老对此司令也是关爱有加。

海军情报部门认为他们可以好生利用这一点。虽然那司令不是什么十分重要人物，但我们相信如果他消失了，那那位长老一定会要求他的海军尽一切力量去寻找他的心腹的。这样他们就会派兵出去搜寻，正好给了我们几天喘息时间。

我们现在要你出发，去把那司令打个措手不及。

messages.en: I'll make sure they don't find a trace of him.
messages.zh: 我保证让敌人再也找不到他。

messages.en: Good. Make sure you're ready for the worst, and try not to leave witnesses.
messages.zh: 很好。要做好最坏准备，千万不要留下后患。

messages.en:
Naval Intelligence has discovered that one of the local sector commanders has a close personal relationship with a high-ranking corporate executive, and believes that we can exploit the corporate executive's overprotective nature by destroying the sector commander's vessel. The corporate executive should force the Caldari into an expensive, time-consuming and ultimately futile search.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the sector commander before he knows what hit him.
messages.zh:
海军情报部门发现一位本地司令与一位公司高层有非常密切的私交，我们可以通过干掉这位司令来促使该高层意气用事。他会逼迫加达里部队进行一场耗时耗财，无功而返的搜寻。

我们现在要你出发，去把那司令打个措手不及。

messages.en: The enemy commander has been eliminated.
messages.zh: 我已经把那司令干掉了。

messages.en: That should keep them running in circles for a while.  Good work, pilot.
messages.zh: 这样一来敌人就要当几天无头苍蝇了。干得好，飞行员。

messages.en: I'm really not comfortable with this.
messages.zh: 我对这个不太有心情。

messages.en: You're going to need to learn a certain moral flexibility in this line of work, pilot.
messages.zh: 飞行员，干这行的需要有灵活的道德标准。

messages.en:
Recently, Naval Intelligence has been profiling the local commanders in this sector, looking for weaknesses in the enemy's defensive lines. While doing so, they've come to find out that one of the local sector commanders is a bit of a protégé to a high-ranking corporate executive. The two of them are very close, and the corporate executive is well known to be a bit protective of the commander.

Naval Intelligence believes they can use this to their advantage. While the sector commander is not a particularly important or successful one, we believe that if he goes missing, the corporate executive will demand that his Navy drop everything to look for his adopted son. This will force them to scour space for the missing commander, which should buy us a few days.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the sector commander before he knows what hit him.
messages.zh:
最近，海军情报部门对此地块的地区司令们进行了详细分析，希望能借此找出敌人防守上的漏洞。在此过程中，他们发现有位司令与一位公司高层有点裙带关系。这两人关系十分密切，该高层对此司令也是关爱有加。

海军情报部门认为他们可以好生利用这一点。虽然那司令不是什么十分重要人物，但我们相信如果他消失了，那那位公司高层一定会要求他的海军尽一切力量去寻找他的心腹的。这样他们就会派兵出去搜寻，正好给了我们几天喘息时间。

我们现在要你出发，去把那司令打个措手不及。

messages.en: I'll get that intelligence for you.
messages.zh: 我会帮你搞到那个情报。

messages.en: I just need you to get that intelligence. Everything else is secondary to that goal. Good luck, pilot.
messages.zh: 我要的就只是那份情报，其他的东西我都无所谓。祝你好运，飞行员。

messages.en: What can I do?
messages.zh: 我能为你做什么?

messages.en:
The Minmatar forces in this sector have begun an offensive, and it's keeping chunks of our fleet busy just holding the line. The enemy can't maintain a major push like this for long, though, not without serious organization. That's where we'll have to hit them to put an end to this mess.

The first step will be to locate where those supply routes are so that we can launch a counterstrike. In order to do that, we need to get access to Minmatar logistical command data, which is where you come in. We need you to attack one of their supply bases and get access to the tactical information sheet in the base's main outpost. Bring it back here so we can plan our counterattack.
messages.zh:
这个区域的米玛塔尔军队发动了攻击，他们拖住了我们一整支正忙于顶住战线的舰队的一大部分。敌人不可能长期的支持这样一次进攻，至少，在没有严密的组织计划的情况下是不可能的。我们就在这个节骨眼上给他们狠狠一击，结束现在的混乱局面。

行动的第一步是要找到他们的供给线路这样我们可以对其实施反击。为了达成这个目的，我们需要获取米玛塔尔的后勤指挥数据，这就是我们要你去做的事情了。你要去攻击他们的一座补给站并且在主哨站夺取战术情报文件。把文件带回来我们就可以进行反击计划的部署了。

messages.en: I managed to get the tactical information sheet, but it wasn't easy.
messages.zh: 我拿到了战术情报文件，可不容易啊。

messages.en: You did a good job, pilot. I'll get that data into the right hands immediately.
messages.zh: 你干得很好，飞行员。我马上就会把这份情报交到需要的人手里。

messages.en: I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 这事儿我懒得管。

messages.en: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will. We can't afford to let this offensive continue unchecked.
messages.zh: 如果你不做的话，我可就得找别人了。我们不能让这种攻击性的行为就这么放任不管。

messages.en: This is way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这完全超出了我的理解能力，你另找高手吧。

messages.en: You're setting our entire war effort back by weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out the missions we need, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder next time.
messages.zh: 你把我们的整个作战计划的进度又推回到了几周之前。如果你不能执行我们的命令，那你对我们已经没有用处了。你下次最好更努力点工作。

messages.en: They won't know what hit them.
messages.zh: 我会打他们个措手不及的。

messages.en: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.
messages.zh: 太好了。摧毁中继塔后便尽快回来。

messages.en: What do you need me to do?
messages.zh: 什么战斗任务？

messages.en:
Enemy forces are building up for a major offensive in the sector, and coordination will be key for their attack. Reinforcements for our positions are already on their way, but it will still be some time before they arrive. We need you to slip past their front lines and hit the communications relay they are using to coordinate their attack. That should keep them off balance and buy our fleet enough time for reinforcements to arrive.
Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Amarr Tactical Support Center, and return to your agent.
messages.zh:
敌人部队正在该地区集结，准备对我们发动一次大规模袭击，而协调指挥对他们来说是关键。我们的增援部队正在往这里赶，但要到达还要点时间。我们要你潜入他们的前线，攻打他们用来协调指挥进攻的通讯中继塔。这能暂缓他们的军事集结，从而为我们的增援部队争取到宝贵的时间。
飞往位标指定地点，找出并摧毁艾玛的战术支持中心，然后返回向代理人汇报。

messages.en: I've eliminated the tactical relay.
messages.zh: 我已把那中继塔端掉了。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. You've bought some time for our reinforcements to arrive.  I'll make sure the sector commander knows that you were responsible.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，飞行员。你为我们的增援部队赢得了宝贵的时间。我肯定会向该地区司令报告你的英雄事迹的。

messages.en: This sounds pretty risky. You can count me out of this one.
messages.zh: 这听上去太危险了，不用考虑我了。

messages.en: Yeah, I guess we can just count you out of the whole war then, huh? You need to suck it up and get your head together, pilot. This war isn't going to win itself.
messages.zh: 是啊，看来我们应该索性把你踢出这场战争算了，如何？飞行员，你要学会正视困难。战场上没有不劳而获。

messages.en:
According to the latest intelligence reports, enemy forces in this sector have been building up for a major offensive. Over the last 48 hours, we've detected a number of enemy support squadrons moving into positions that will let them hit a variety of targets with little notice. It's likely that they're planning a carefully coordinated strike against us, hoping for a breakthrough. Reinforcements are en route to this sector, but we need to buy some time.

We've located an enemy communications relay that is most likely serving as the coordination center for a large part of the enemy support fleet. While they're keeping a sharp eye on our forces, a capsuleer like yourself could sneak past their lines and hit them where they aren't looking. With the relay down, they won't be able to coordinate their attacks, and we should be able to hold them off long enough for reinforcements to arrive.
messages.zh:
最新情报显示，敌人正在该地区集结，准备对我们发动一次大规模的袭击。在过去的48小时里，我们已经注意到敌方开始部署大量支援部队，以期对我们众多要地进行偷袭。看来他们打算对我们进行一次有组织的袭击，妄图来一场大胜。我们的增援部队正在往这里赶，但我们需要争取时间。

我们已经发现了敌人的一座通讯中继塔，它的作用很可能就是用来协调指挥敌人增援大部队。虽然他们时刻关注着我们部队的一举一动，但像你这样的飞行员应该可以潜入他们的防线，打他们个措手不及。只要那中继塔一倒，他们就无法再有效组织进攻，我们也就可以在援军到达之前把他们拖住了。

messages.en: I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. Find someone else.
messages.zh: 我没法能进入到对那座中继塔有效的攻击范围内。你找别人吧。

messages.en: I thought you were supposed to be a hotshot pilot.
messages.zh: 我原本还以为你真像传说的一样厉害。

messages.en: I'll take out those industrials immediately!
messages.zh: 我马上就去干掉那些工业舰。

messages.en:
Great! Things shouldn't be too difficult for someone of your skills. Fly over to the depot and head off the industrials.

Your biggest worry will be capsuleers loyal to the Republic. You should prepare yourself to battle or avoid them.
messages.zh:
很好！这些事对于你这样有能力的人应该算不了什么。飞过去补给站那儿把敌人的工业舰干掉。

你最大的对手可能是对方的克隆飞行员。你要做好准备，要么和他们战斗要么就避开他们。

messages.en: I'll do whatever it takes!
messages.zh: 我会不惜一切代价地完成任务的。

messages.en: The Minmatar are transporting a load of weapons and ammo to their depot in a nearby system. While we can't attack the weapons depot directly at this time, interdicting their transports serves the purpose just as well. Destroy the industrials before they can drop off the ammo. Just be warned, capsuleers working for the Republic may try to stop you.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔运送了大量的武器和弹药到他们位于附近一个星系的补给站。我们现在还没法直接攻击这个补给站，但是截断他们的补给线路一样能够达成预想的效果。在他们把弹药送抵目的地之前击毁他们的工业舰。你要当心的是在当地活动的共和国克隆飞行员，他们会试图阻止你。

messages.en: I've successfully destroyed the industrials!
messages.zh: 我成功的击毁了工业舰！

messages.en: Good work.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮。

messages.en: Yawn, that doesn't sound like it's worth my time at all.
messages.zh: 啊哈，这听来好像不值得我花时间去做。

messages.en: I never thought you'd turn this down. Oh well, I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 我从来没想过你会让大家失望。好吧，我在另外找人。

messages.en:
I'm glad to see that you're here, pilot. I've got some work that's right up your alley. You see, a nearby system has long been contested. Just recently, things have reached a head.

The Republic forces in the area are rearmed by a weapons depot in the system. We cannot strike directly at the depot itself, but we can stem the flow of supplies into the depot. We've received word that a convoy of supplies is heading there now. It's lightly guarded and destroying it will surely set the Minmatar forces in this area back. Do you think you can handle it?
messages.zh:
很高兴你在这儿，飞行员。我这儿有些任务非常的适合你。你看，附近的一个星系已经成为争夺状态很久了。就在不久前，情况发生了一些变化。

那个区域的共和国军队受到星系里面的一个补给站持续的补给和重新武装。我们不能直接的打击这个补给站，但是我们可以截掉它的运输线路。我们得到情报说一支补给船队正在向那儿进发。船队的防御很弱，摧毁掉它能够重重的挫伤这个区域的米玛塔尔军事活动。你觉得你可以应付得了么？

messages.en: I'm afraid I must abandon this mission. I hope you understand.
messages.zh: 恐怕我得要放弃这个任务了。我希望你能明白。

messages.en: You're quitting on me? Truly a sad day.
messages.zh: 你不干了？真是难过的一天。

messages.en: I'll get that intelligence for you.
messages.zh: 我会帮你搞到那个情报。

messages.en: I just need you to get that intelligence. Everything else is secondary to that goal. Good luck, pilot.
messages.zh: 我要的就只是那份情报，其他的东西我都无所谓。祝你好运，飞行员。

messages.en: What can I do?
messages.zh: 我能为你做什么?

我们现在要你出发，去把那司令打个措手不及。

name.ja: 激しさを増すロイドレイジ

messages.en: Those miners won't know what hit them.
messages.zh: 那些矿工都不知道是什么打到他们的。

messages.en: I knew you'd be up for it! You shouldn't have too much trouble with the Minmatar, however, we've had reports that capsuleers loyal to the Republic are roaming the area. Because the system is contested, they'll be able to attack you if they catch you. Be prepare to face them.
messages.zh: 我知道你会帮忙的！米玛塔尔应该难不倒你，但是我们的情报显示很多为共和国做事儿的克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动。因为这个区域是争夺状态的，所以一旦他们发现你就会对你进行攻击。你要有所准备。

messages.en: How can I be of use?
messages.zh: 我该怎么帮忙？

messages.en: Our scanners just uncovered a hidden asteroid belt in a contested system. The Minmatar apparently got to it before us and have already begun mining it. It still has plenty of ore, however, so we want to ensure that ore gets to us instead. All you have to do is fly out there and blow those miners to smithereens.
messages.zh: 我们的扫描器在争夺区域发现了一个隐藏的小行星带。米玛塔尔人显然赶在我们之前已经发现并开始进行开采了。目前看来还剩余有大量的矿石藏量，所以我们得要把这些矿石夺过来。你要做的只是飞过去把那些采矿船都干掉就行了。

messages.en: The asteroid belt has been cleared of hostile miners. Hostile miners? That sounds like an oxymoron.
messages.zh: 小行星带的敌方采矿船已经被请出了。

messages.en: Now that those Minmatar fools have been taken care of, our own miners can go in and strip the belt. Unless the Minmatar send someone to counterattack... But nah, that's not likely to happen. Good job, come back to me when you're ready for some more work.
messages.zh: 那些米玛塔尔的蠢货们已经被解决了，我们自己的采矿船可以进场作业了。除非那些米玛塔尔人又回来反击……但不像，应该不会发生了。干得不错，等你准备好了接下个任务的时候回来找我吧。

messages.en: I'm not sure I'm up for taking this mission. Maybe something else?
messages.zh: 我不是很肯定我是不是想谈论这个任务，有其他的事情么？

messages.en: That's a shame. This is important work.
messages.zh: 很遗憾啊，这可是个重要的任务。

messages.en:
It seems I am in luck. You see, we have recently discovered a rather large hidden asteroid belt. This belt has many resources that we could exploit. Unfortunately, it seems the Minmatar Republic found it before us. They've miners over there right now stripping the belt of its precious mineral resources. We certainly can't let them do that!

I want you to fly over there and chase those miners off. By which I mean, of course, blowing them up. The bigger the explosions, the better. Can you do this for me?
messages.zh:
看起来我很走运。你看，最近我们发现了一个相当大规模的隐藏小行星矿带。这个矿带中蕴藏了很多我们可以加以利用的资源。不幸的是，米玛塔尔政府在我们之前先发现了这个矿带，他们的矿工和采矿船已经在那里对这个小行星矿带中的贵重资源进行开采了。我们当然不能让他们这样做！

我要你飞过去那个矿带，把那些采矿船都赶走。我说的是，当然，你得把它们都消灭掉。爆炸的焰火越剧烈越好，让他们都看看。你能帮我做这事儿么？

messages.en: I'm afraid I bit off more than I can chew.
messages.zh: 恐怕我干不了这个。

messages.en: I didn't think some miners would be able to scare you off!
messages.zh: 我并不觉得一些矿工就能吓到你！

messages.en: Don't worry about it. I'll take them out and make sure the Republic gains nothing!
messages.zh: 别担心这个。我会确保他们能挺过来而且共和国从中得不到任何好处。

messages.en: Excellent. I've uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. If you move fast, you'll be able to take out those repair ships with no problem. Your main competition will be pod pilots flying under the banner of the Republic. Prepare yourself to fight them if they try to intervene.
messages.zh: 很好。我已经把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中了。如果你行动迅速，应该可以毫不费劲地摧毁那些维修船。你的首要威胁来自于那些共和国的克隆飞行员。准备好和那些阻止你的人大干一场吧。

messages.en: I'll give everything I've got. What do you need of me?
messages.zh: 我会把我的所有都奉献出来。你需要做什么？

messages.en: The Minmatar Republic is trying to reopen a gate in one of the nearby contested systems. Things are especially urgent, because our spies have learned they have a large strike force ready to come through the gate as soon as it's back online. We do not have the manpower to fight off the strike force at this time. Get there and destroy their repair ships.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔共和国尝试将附近争夺区域中的一座废弃的星门重新开启。这件事非常的紧急，因为我们的间谍发现在星门的另一端集结了一直庞大的攻击部队，准备穿过星门直接攻击我们的后方。现在我们没有足够的人力再来处理这事儿。你去把那些负责维修星门的舰船都清除掉。

messages.en: The repair crew has been destroyed and the gate remains offline. You have nothing more to worry about.
messages.zh: 维修船已经被消灭了，星门目前依然处于离线状态。你没什么好担心的了。

messages.en: This is glorious news! God truly shines on the Empire today. With that repair crew taken out, we can request reinforcements and either demolish that gate or repair it ourselves and ambush the strike force as it comes through. You truly earned your reward today.
messages.zh: 这真是个大好消息！看来神的光芒依旧照耀着今天的帝国。现在这支维修队被消灭了，我们就有时间排出增援部队和爆破小组去把这个星门个完全消灭掉，或者我们自己把它修好然后等待他们的部队过来给予迎头痛击。你今天表现得非常好！

messages.en: That sounds like too much pressure for me.
messages.zh: 这听来对我的压力太大了。

messages.en: Don't you know that God looks down on the meek?
messages.zh: 你知道神看不起懦夫么？

messages.en:
Something urgent has just come across my desk. The Minmatar Republic at one time managed to set up a gate in a nearby contested system. We eventually drove them off, but we never got around to tearing the gate down. It seems that was a mistake, as now the Minmatar are trying to get the gate operational again. They have a huge strike force on the other side, waiting to come through.

We do not have the manpower to fight off that strike force. However, we still have time to act. While our forces are keeping the escorts busy, you need to go in and take out those repair ships. Can you do that?
messages.zh:
有些紧急的事情刚刚被送到我的办公桌上。米玛塔尔共和国曾经有一次在附近的争夺区域安放了一座星门。我们最终还是把他们给驱赶跑了，但当时并没有把那座星门给拆掉。现在看来那是当时的一个失误，现在这些米玛塔尔人正尝试把这座星门重新运转起来。他们在门的另一头集结了大量的攻击部队，准备在星门回复运转过后穿越过来。

我们没有足够的人力去抵抗这股攻击部队。不过，我们还有时间。我们的部队现在忙于防御巡逻，你现在就可以去把那些负责维修星门的舰船全都清楚掉。有问题么？

messages.en: Things got too hot for me! I've got to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这对我来说太烫手了！我要放弃这个任务。

messages.en: You can't? Don't you realize what this could mean? Get out of my sight; I need to find someone else to take your place.
messages.zh: 你没办法？你知道这意味着什么吗？滚出我的视线；我另外找人去完成这个任务。

messages.en: I'll make sure those troops never reach their destinations!
messages.zh: 我会让他们永远到达不了目的地！

messages.en:
I knew you would be up for it. The convoy guards should not pose a significant challenge to you. And besides, the only real targets are the industrials carrying the ground troops. Destroy them and you can avoid fighting the other ships, unless you want to.

The main threat to your mission will be capsuleers supporting the Federation.
messages.zh:
我知道你会答应的。船队的护航舰对你来说都不是什么大问题。我们的首要目标还是那些运送地面部队的工业舰。消灭他们，至于其他的船你可以放着不管如果你愿意的话。

主要的威胁还是来自于那些联邦的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: I shall do my best to serve the Federation's ideals.
messages.zh: 我会全身心的把自己投入到联邦的理想当中去。

messages.en:
The Caldari State is building up its ground troops in a nearby contested system with plans to launch an attack on our fortified positions.

We've discovered a troop transport moving toward their command outpost. You need merely destroy the industrials and don't need to bother with the convoy guards.
messages.zh:
加达里正在附近一个争夺区域集合他们的地面部队，准备对我们的一个加强工事进行袭击。

我们发现了一个运兵船队正在向他们的指挥哨站前进。你只需要将船队中的工业舰都消灭掉就行了，别的船和那些护航船只你自己看着办。

messages.en: The troop transports have been destroyed. The Federation need not fear any longer!
messages.zh: 运兵船队已经被消灭，联邦政府不需要再担心了。

messages.en: With their troops eliminated, we'll be able to reinforce our own positions. And maybe soon, we'll be able to push forward and overwhelm the Caldari positions as well! Just another step towards victory! Excellent work.
messages.zh: 一旦他们的部队被歼灭，我们就有空档加强自己的工事。或许很快，我们就能够向前推进对加达里的战线形成压倒性的优势！你干的很好，我们又向胜利迈进了一步！

messages.en: Anyone can take out a few transports! Why can't you give me something more substantial?
messages.zh: 任何人都可以搞掉几艘运输舰，你就不能给我点有意义的东西么？

messages.en: You would really turn down my offer? I'm not sure you know the severity of this mission.
messages.zh: 你真的要这么让我失望么？我不知道你是否知道这项任务的重要性。

messages.en:
In a nearby contested system, the Caldari State has long held illusions of claiming it entirely for themselves. Now, we've always been able to stop them, but lately they've started moving ground troops into their command outpost there.

We cannot attack the command outpost directly. It's too well guarded and our forces are kept occupied in other areas. However, if they manage to get enough ground troops there, they can launch an attack on our planetary holdings.

Our scanners have picked up a lightly guarded convoy filled with troops heading toward the command outpost. You can take them out, no sweat, right?
messages.zh:
在附近一个争夺中的星系，加达里长期自欺欺人地宣布其在当地主权。实际上我们一直都有能力阻止他们的行为只是假装视而不见，但是最近他们开始将地面部队运送到他们在那个区域的指挥哨站。

我们不能直接地攻击指挥哨站，那里的防守力量非常强大，况且我们的大部分兵力都已经派往了别的作战区域。无论如何，如果他们设法聚集了足够多得地面部队在那里，他们就可以对我们的星球进行登陆作战了。

我们的扫描器发现了一个护卫力量较少的船队，搭载了大量的士兵正在朝这个指挥哨站进发。你可以将它们毫不费力的摧毁掉，有问题么？

messages.en: Yipes! That didn't turn out as easy as I hoped. I'm going to have to quit.
messages.zh: 唉！事情不是像我设想的一样简单，我要退出。

messages.en: If our ground forces are forced into a confrontation, thousands of lives will be lost.
messages.zh: 如果我们的地面部队和他们发生正面冲突，成千上万的生命将会消失。

messages.en: I'll get that intelligence for you.
messages.zh: 我会帮你搞到那个情报。

messages.en: I just need you to get that intelligence. Everything else is secondary to that goal. Good luck, pilot.
messages.zh: 我要的就只是那份情报，其他的东西我都无所谓。祝你好运，飞行员。

messages.en: What can I do?
messages.zh: 我能为你做什么?

messages.en:
The Amarr forces in this sector have begun an offensive, and it's keeping chunks of our fleet busy just holding the line. The enemy can't maintain a major push like this for long, though, not without serious organization. That's where we'll have to hit them to put an end to this mess.

The first step will be to locate where those supply routes are so that we can launch a counterstrike. In order to do that, we need to get access to Amarr logistical command data, which is where you come in. We need you to attack one of their supply bases and get access to the tactical information sheet in the base's main outpost. Bring it back here so we can plan our counterattack.
messages.zh:
这个区域的艾玛军队发动了攻击，他们拖住了我们一整支正忙于顶住战线的舰队的一大部分。敌人不可能长期的支持这样一次进攻，至少，在没有严密的组织计划的情况下是不可能的。我们就在这个节骨眼上给他们狠狠一击，结束现在的混乱局面。

行动的第一步是要找到他们的供给线路这样我们可以对其实施反击。为了达成这个目的，我们需要获取艾玛的后勤指挥数据，这就是我们要你去做的事情了。你要去攻击他们的一座补给站并且在主哨站夺取战术情报文件。把文件带回来我们就可以进行反击计划的部署了。

messages.en: I managed to get the tactical information sheet, but it wasn't easy.
messages.zh: 我拿到了战术情报文件，可不容易啊。

messages.en: You did a good job, pilot. I'll get that data into the right hands immediately.
messages.zh: 你干得很好，飞行员。我马上就会把这份情报交到需要的人手里。

messages.en: I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 这事儿我懒得管。

messages.en: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will. We can't afford to let this offensive continue unchecked.
messages.zh: 如果你不做的话，我可就得找别人了。我们不能让这种攻击性的行为就这么放任不管。

messages.en:
The Amarr forces in this sector have begun an offensive, and it's keeping chunks of our fleet busy just holding the line. The enemy can't maintain a major push like this for long, though, not without serious organization. That's where we'll have to hit them to put an end to this mess.

The first step will be to locate where those supply routes are so that we can launch a counterstrike. In order to do that, we need to get access to Amarr logistical command data, which is where you come in. We need you to attack one of their supply bases and get access to the tactical information sheet in the base's main outpost. Bring it back here so we can plan our counterattack.
messages.zh:
这个区域的艾玛军队发动了攻击，他们拖住了我们一整支正忙于顶住战线的舰队的一大部分。敌人不可能长期的支持这样一次进攻，至少，在没有严密的组织计划的情况下是不可能的。我们就在这个节骨眼上给他们狠狠一击，结束现在的混乱局面。

行动的第一步是要找到他们的供给线路这样我们可以对其实施反击。为了达成这个目的，我们需要获取艾玛的后勤指挥数据，这就是我们要你去做的事情了。你要去攻击他们的一座补给站并且在主哨站夺取战术情报文件。把文件带回来我们就可以进行反击计划的部署了。

messages.en: This is way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 这完全超出了我的理解能力，你另找高手吧。

messages.en: You're setting our entire war effort back by weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out the missions we need, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder next time.
messages.zh: 你把我们的整个作战计划的进度又推回到了几周之前。如果你不能执行我们的命令，那你对我们已经没有用处了。你下次最好更努力点工作。

messages.en: Understood. I'll deal with this immediately.
messages.zh: 明白。我马上动身处理这事。

messages.en: Good. There is no room for error here, so don't make me regret trusting you with this.
messages.zh: 好。这事情容不得半点闪失，别让我后悔相信你。

messages.en: I'm listening…
messages.zh: 愿洗耳恭听……

messages.en: We've learned that a Republic Security Services agent has infiltrated our ranks and has been actively working against us ever since. Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops to undoubtedly strike at our weakest points. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat, understood?
messages.zh: 据称多年前有一位共和国特工渗入了我们组织内部，一直在背后行使对我们不利的事情。许是他察觉到了，也许只是时机上的巧合，反正最近有人看到他在附近区域正召集一小支队伍。毫无疑问，他们打算袭击我们的要害点。他知不知道我们已经盯上了他已经不重要了；把他弄死就万事大吉。明白吗？

messages.en: I've dispatched the spy and his bodyguards.
messages.zh: 我把那间谍和他的守卫都干掉了。

messages.en: Excellent work, thank you. I hoped I could rely on your expertise and discretion. Once again you prove yourself a valuable ally of the Amarrian people.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，真要谢谢你啊。我认为我能相信你的水平和判断力，事实果然证明你是艾玛人民值得信赖的朋友。

messages.en: Why aren't we trying to capture and interrogate him? I want no part in any assassination of such a valuable source.
messages.zh: 为什么我们不去把他抓起来审问呢？这家伙可以提供重要情报，我想留他一条命。

messages.en: The arrogance and presumption of you eggers amazes me. I don't need to explain myself to you; I'll just get someone else who knows their place.
messages.zh: 你的傲慢与自以为是真是出乎我意料。我没必要向你解释什么；我自去找一个知道天高地厚的人。

messages.en: The gradual breakdown in relations between the empires over recent years has seen a drastic increase in their focus on espionage as a tool to both prevent, and more regularly, enhance warfare. As a result, spying is rife inside all of the empires and the common assumption that many organizations operate under is that they have already been compromised. Very few are trusted with crucial information, and those that have been are very closely watched. Despite their vast differences, the brutal treatment of those caught in the act is one thing shared by each nation.
messages.zh: 随着近年来关系逐渐恶化，帝国之间的间谍活动越发频繁。虽然这其中有部分行动是为了防止战争，但更多情况下，这些活动的进行是为了加强一方的战争优势。因此各帝国中的间谍活动都可以说是到达了猖獗程度，许多组织已被渗透更是一个共同假设。现在已经有很少组织可以被托付机密信息了，而那些为数不多可以被托付的也处于严密监视之下。国家虽各异，但在对被抓间谍的处理上，它们倒是如出一辙的残忍。

messages.en: A brutal commonality
messages.zh: 残忍共性

messages.en:
We've got a mess on our hands and I need you to clean it up.

We recently came across some startling intelligence, given to us by certain sources I won't name. We learned that a Republic Security Services agent had infiltrated our ranks many years ago and has been actively working against us ever since.
