After this discovery we began watching this individual closely, it seems a little too closely.

Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops. Undoubtedly, they plan to strike at our weakest points. There is any number of nightmare scenarios they could bring to bear. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat.

Understood?
messages.zh:
我们搞砸了件事情，我需要你去帮我们擦屁股。

我们最近获悉了条让人唏嘘不已的情报，情报来源我这里不便透露。据称多年前有一位共和国特工渗入了我们组织内部，一直在背后行使对我们不利的事情。了解这情况后，我们开始对他进行近距离监视，但监视地可能太近了。

也许是他察觉到了，也许只是时机上的巧合，反正最近有人看到他在附近区域正召集一小支队伍。毫无疑问，他们打算袭击我们的要害点。他有可能为我们带来无尽麻烦。他知不知道我们已经盯上了他已经不重要了；把他弄死就万事大吉。

明白了吗？

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't get to him, there's too much at risk.
messages.zh: 恐怕我抓不住他了，风险太大。

messages.en: Risk? Risk?! You have a clone, what risk is there? I'll tell you what risk is: it's when you have a long-time spy in your organization leading fleets against you, that's risk! Whatever, I'll find someone else who can spare me of such pathetic excuses for their own cowardice.
messages.zh: 风险？你说风险？！你有克隆还谈什么风险？我告诉你什么是风险：一个间谍在你内部长期作威作福，然后他带领一支舰队对你实行倒戈，这才叫风险！算了，我去找一个不会用借口来掩饰自己懦弱的人。

messages.en: Of course. Give me the coordinates and I'll head out immediately.
messages.zh: 当然。快把位标给我，我立刻动身。

messages.en: Excellent, I'll tell them to proceed. Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.
messages.zh: 太好了，我将告诉他们按计划行事。尽快飞往那里听候调遣。我将根据战场形势直接向你发出进攻或是撤退的命令。

messages.en: Oh? Let's hear it then.
messages.zh: 噢？说出来听听。

messages.en:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance. We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Minmatar logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and we're expecting Republic forces to be more prepared than usual.

Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.
messages.zh:
我们打算即将深入敌后发动一场高风险的行动。我要你也参与以提供特定协助。米玛塔尔有一对一整个争夺区域提供后勤支援的弹药库，那里有重兵把守，我要你去对它进行打击。战斗会很激烈，而且我们估计他们较以往会有更充足的准备。

快飞往那里听候调遣。我将根据战场形势直接向你发出进攻或是撤退的命令。

messages.en: Was that all you needed done? How is the fight going?
messages.zh: 你要求的事都完成了吗？战斗怎么样了？

messages.en: I just received word that the cache has been secured and will be detonated once we've cleared the area. Excellent work out there, they've lost a strategic foothold as well as a prominent commander today, we couldn't be happier with the result.
messages.zh: 我得到消息说那弹药库已在我们控制之下，我们把那地区清空之后就会用炸弹点爆它。你干得漂亮，他们今天不仅失去了一个战略工事，还损失了一名重要司令，对于这样的结果我们是再满意不过了。

messages.en: This high-pressure stuff isn't really for me, I'm afraid. You'd be better off finding someone else.
messages.zh: 我觉得这种压力超大的事不是我能干的。你最好找别人。

messages.en: Am I supposed to be admiring your honesty here? If you're not cut out for this kind of work then you're not worth my time, period.
messages.zh: 我是不是应该钦佩你有自知之明啊？如果你不是天生干这活儿的，那就别再浪费我时间了，就这样。

messages.en: As relations began to slide further towards outright war, each of the empires increased their focus on long-term strategic interests. Exhaustively detailed battle plans of everything from invasion scenarios to the best locations for ammunitions caches were deliberated over endlessly by countless organizations dedicated to the singular task of winning, or perhaps simply surviving, a seemingly inevitable war.
messages.zh: 随着关系变糟得已经有了爆发全面战争的可能，各帝国都开始将他们的注意力越来越多地投向了他们的长期战略利益。他们制定了各种详尽计划，从应对侵略到选择弹药库存放地，所有的计划都被各级组织反复讨论。面对一场似乎无法避免的战争，这些组织身上都背负了赢取它——或者只是在其中存活下来——的重任。

messages.en: Prepare for the worst.
messages.zh: 做好最坏打算。

messages.en:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance.

We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Minmatar logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and a great deal at stake for us should we fail to impede the recent progress they've been making.

We've reason to believe that our plans have already been partly compromised. We're expecting Republic forces to be more prepared than usual, possibly even reinforced, and we're aiming to prepare ourselves accordingly. I've been tasked with organising a capsuleer-based contingency plan and deploying it with specific orders in mind. Once I given the clear that we've got someone, they'll be launching the offensive immediately, so time is of the essence.

Having someone as capable as you at our backs would allow us a great deal of tactical flexibility on-field and all but ensure that victory is swift and casualties low. If it turns out you're not needed, then we'll still pay you for your time, but certain orders I've been receiving suggest we may yet have a use for you out there, time will tell.

Are you up for the mission?
messages.zh:
我们打算即将深入敌后发动一场高风险的行动。我要你也参与以提供特定协助。

米玛塔尔有一对一整个争夺区域提供后勤支援的弹药库，那里有重兵把守，我要你去对它进行打击。如果我们不能阻止他们最近的攻势，那后面的仗将越发难打，风险巨大。

其实我认为我们的计划已经部分失败了。共和国的准备较之前更加充分，他们可能已经调集了援军，我们也要做好相应准备。我的任务是筹划一个由飞行员执行的应急计划，号施令由我来发。一旦我这里清理掉了一个关键人物，那他们就可以马上发动大规模袭击了，因此时间是关键。

有你这样一位有能力的飞行员助阵将允许我们施行更灵活的战术，最重要的是我们可以获取一场耗时少，伤亡低的胜利。如果实际情况没你也行，那我们还是会付你钱的，毕竟我们占用了你的时间；但从我目前收到的命令来看，你还是会被派上用场的，等着瞧吧。

你准备好了吗？

messages.en: I'm sorry, but I have to decline this mission after all, I won't be able to provide the level of assistance you're after.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我必须拒绝该任务，我不能提供你想要的协助。

messages.en: What?! I already told them we had someone inbound and they launched the operation! This is a gross display of negligence on your behalf, pilot. I'll be making a note of it in your records, just as soon as I've found someone who is actually reliable.
messages.zh: 什么？！我已经告诉他们有人加入，他们已经开始行动了！飞行员，你让人看到了你的庸碌无为。我会在找到其他可靠的人后在你简历上记上这一笔。

name.ja: 激しさを増すロイドレイジ

messages.en: Those miners won't know what hit them.
messages.zh: 那些矿工都不知道是什么打到他们的。

messages.en: I knew you'd be up for it! You shouldn't have too much trouble with the Caldari, however, we've had reports that capsuleers loyal to the State are roaming the area. Because the system is contested, they'll be able to attack you if they catch you. Be prepare to face them.
messages.zh: 我知道你会帮忙的！加达里应该难不倒你，但是我们的情报显示很多为共和国做事儿的克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动。因为这个区域是争夺状态的，所以一旦他们发现你就会对你进行攻击。你要有所准备。

messages.en: How can I be of use?
messages.zh: 我该怎么帮忙？

messages.en:
It seems I am in luck. You see, we have recently discovered a rather large hidden asteroid belt. This belt has many resources that we could exploit. Unfortunately, it seems the Caldari State found it before us. They've miners over there right now stripping the belt of its precious mineral resources. We certainly can't let them do that!

I want you to fly over there and chase those miners off. By which I mean, of course, blowing them up. The bigger the explosions, the better. Can you do this for me?
messages.zh:
看起来我很走运。你看，最近我们发现了一个相当大规模的隐藏小行星矿带。这个矿带中蕴藏了很多我们可以加以利用的资源。不幸的是，加达里政府在我们之前先发现了这个矿带，他们的矿工和采矿船已经在那里对这个小行星矿带中的贵重资源进行开采了。我们当然不能让他们这样做！

我要你飞过去那个矿带，把那些采矿船都赶走。我说的是，当然，你得把它们都消灭掉。爆炸的焰火越剧烈越好，让他们都看看。你能帮我做这事儿么？

messages.en: The asteroid belt has been cleared of hostile miners. Hostile miners? That sounds like an oxymoron.
messages.zh: 小行星带的敌方采矿船已经被请出了。

messages.en: Now that those Caldari fools have been taken care of, our own miners can go in and strip the belt. Unless the Caldari send someone to counterattack... But nah, that's not likely to happen. Good job, come back to me when you're ready for some more work.
messages.zh: 那些加达里的蠢货们已经被解决了，我们自己的采矿船可以进场作业了。除非那些加达里人又回来反击……但不像，应该不会发生了。干得不错，等你准备好了接下个任务的时候回来找我吧。

messages.en: I'm not sure I'm up for taking this mission. Maybe something else?
messages.zh: 我不是很肯定我是不是想谈论这个任务，有其他的事情么？

messages.en: That's a shame. This is important work.
messages.zh: 很遗憾啊，这可是个重要的任务。

messages.en: I'm afraid I bit off more than I can chew.
messages.zh: 恐怕我干不了这个。

messages.en: I didn't think some miners would be able to scare you off!
messages.zh: 我并不觉得一些矿工就能吓到你！

name.ru: Боевой дух и высокая мораль (Morale and Morality)

messages.en: If you think I have a problem with this, I don't. I understand completely. Give me the location of the residence.
messages.zh: 如果你认为我会有所顾虑，那你就错了。我完全明白这种道理。给我那个居住地的坐标吧。

messages.en: You're right; I should have known you could be relied upon in these matters. I'm uploading the coordinates now, good luck.
messages.zh: 你说的对， 我早就知道你是完全可以被信任的。我正把座标上传给你。

messages.en: How can I serve?
messages.zh: 我能帮你什么

messages.en:
We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the Republic's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Amarrian people. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

They have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these industrials, we can starve the enemy out.
messages.zh:
我们在附近米玛塔尔具有很强势力的地区发现了一个民用设施。这个据点里面居住了数千他们的居民，大部分都是在附近舰艇和设施中服役的士兵和官员的家属。这些人是来这里为他们的军队提高士气的，而这些军人正式那些伤害我们艾玛自己弟兄姐妹和公民的凶手。我们不能容忍这样的事情发生。

他们有一个很大的弱点：就是供给线。殖民地的日常生活和军事需求都是完全依靠一条工业运输线路来完成。如果我们能够拦截摧毁那些工业舰，那么我们的敌人就得挨饿了。

messages.en: The Industrials have been destroyed. I only hope this serves our purposes and doesn't backfire.
messages.zh: 工业舰已经被干掉了，我只是希望我们能达到目的且不要节外生枝。

messages.en: Though I understand and even share those same concerns, it was a risk that had to be taken. Good work today pilot, here's your pay.
messages.zh: 其实我理解这些问题，但这个风险时必须要承担的。你做的很好，飞行员，这是你的报酬。

messages.en: Briefings like this make me question what side I should be fighting for. I want nothing to do with this.
messages.zh: 想这样的任务简报让我开始怀疑我到底该为谁工作。我不想参与这事儿。

messages.en: What would you have us do then, huh? Shall we just leave them there, let them continue to offer a kind of assistance no amount of military and logistics support can? You disappoint me, deeply. Oh, and if I find out you've leaked this information, there will be consequences.
messages.zh: 你要我们怎么办，恩？我们就这么放着他们不管？就这么让他们为我们的敌人提供任何军事和后勤支援都不能提供的支持？你让我失望了，深深的失望了。哦，要是我知道你泄露了机密的话，绝不会给你好果子吃的。

messages.en: Civilian deaths in a war are a reality, one which is accepted as inevitable by all of the empires. The effects of such things are often hard to predict, however, and those targeting their attacks must do so carefully. There are times when the mass death of civilians can indeed crush a nation's will to fight any further, or cause such anxiety amongst their citizenry that popular support for conflict is replaced by angry cries to back down. At other times however, it will only harden their resolve, serving as a valuable and yet grim propaganda victory, that allows them to paint their enemy as a heartless monster.
messages.zh: 战争中平民的死亡是现实的问题，无论是什么样的国家都必须接受它的不可逃避性。这种事情的结果通常是难以预料的，但是，那些发动攻击的人必须要小心的选择目标。有的时候，大量的平民伤亡可能在最大限度上消磨一个国家的战斗意志，甚至在其国民之中造成大恐慌，使得要求妥协结束战争的人取代那些好战份子。但是在更多时候，却只会坚定他们的意志，成为一个宣传的好案例，更加的使其敌人妖魔化。

messages.en: A risky target
messages.zh: 危险的目标

messages.en:
What I am about to ask you is strictly confidential, understood?

We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the Republic's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Amarrian people.

Their arrogance is astounding, no? They seem to think we will allow them to exist in peace simply because they bear no weapons. Their weak security presence suggests as much. Understand pilot; these people are as significant a threat as any other. What they provide may not be firepower or logistics but it is crucial to their war effort nonetheless. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

They have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these industrials, we can starve the enemy out.
messages.zh:
我要你干的事情是十分保密的，你能明白么？

我们在附近米玛塔尔具有很强势力的地区发现了一个民用设施。这个据点里面居住了数千他们的居民，大部分都是在附近舰艇和设施中服役的士兵和官员的家属。这些人是来这里为他们的军队提高士气的，而这些军人正式那些伤害我们艾玛自己弟兄姐妹和公民的凶手。

这帮人傲慢到了极点，不是么？他们以为我们会放任他们不管，看看他们那不堪一击的安防系统就知道了。明智的飞行员，这些人的威胁是不容置疑的，他们所来的可能不是枪炮和补给，但是却大大的增强了敌人的士气，我们决不能让他们这么做。

他们有一个很大的弱点：就是供给线。殖民地的日常生活和军事需求都是完全依靠一条工业运输线路来完成。如果我们能够拦截摧毁那些工业舰，那么我们的敌人就得挨饿了。

messages.en: I've had second thoughts. I simply cannot do something as monstrous as this. We risk too much with actions of this nature.
messages.zh: 我还有另外一个想法，我不能干这种禽兽不如的事情。做这样的事情所造成的风险实在太大了。

messages.en: Spare me the ethics lecture. I will find someone else who understands the importance of this mission.
messages.zh: 省省你的道德课吧。我会另外找个明白其中重要性高手来办这事儿。

messages.en: I'll take out those industrials immediately!
messages.zh: 我马上就去干掉那些工业舰。

messages.en:
Great! Things shouldn't be too difficult for someone of your skills. Fly over to the depot and head off the industrials.

Your biggest worry will be capsuleers loyal to the Empire. You should prepare yourself to battle or avoid them.
messages.zh:
很好！这些事对于你这样有能力的人应该算不了什么。飞过去补给站那儿把敌人的工业舰干掉。

你最大的对手可能是帝国的克隆飞行员。你要做好准备，要么和他们战斗要么就避开他们。

messages.en: My howl will cause the enemy dead to turn over in fear.
messages.zh: 我的咆哮会让敌人完全的陷入恐惧。

messages.en: The Amarr are transporting a load of weapons and ammo to their depot in a nearby system. While we can't attack the weapons depot directly at this time, interdicting their transports serves the purpose just as well. Destroy the industrials before they can drop off the ammo. Just be warned, capsuleers working for the Empire may try to stop you.
messages.zh: 艾玛运送了大量的武器和弹药到他们位于附近一个星系的补给站。我们现在还没法直接攻击这个补给站，但是截断他们的补给线路一样能够达成预想的效果。在他们把弹药送抵目的地之前击毁他们的工业舰。你要当心的是在当地活动的帝国克隆飞行员，他们会试图阻止你。

messages.en: I've successfully destroyed the industrials!
messages.zh: 我成功的击毁了工业舰！

messages.en: Good work.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮。

messages.en: Yawn, that doesn't sound like it's worth my time at all.
messages.zh: 啊哈，这听来好像不值得我花时间去做。

messages.en: I never thought you'd turn this down. Oh well, I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 我从来没想过你会让大家失望。好吧，我在另外找人。

messages.en:
I'm glad to see that you're here, pilot. I've got some work that's right up your alley. You see, a nearby system has long been contested. Just recently, things have reached a head.

The Imperial forces in the area are rearmed by a weapons depot in the system. We cannot strike directly at the depot itself, but we can stem the flow of supplies into the depot. We've received word that a convoy of supplies is heading there now. It's lightly guarded and destroying it will surely set the Amarr forces in this area back. Do you think you can handle it?
messages.zh:
很高兴你在这儿，飞行员。我这儿有些任务非常的适合你。你看，附近的一个星系已经成为争夺状态很久了。就在不久前，情况发生了一些变化。

那个区域的帝国军队受到星系里面的一个补给站持续的补给和重新武装。我们不能直接的打击这个补给站，但是我们可以截掉它的运输线路。我们得到情报说一支补给船队正在向那儿进发。船队的防御很弱，摧毁掉它能够重重的挫伤这个区域的艾玛军事活动。你觉得你可以应付得了么？

messages.en: I'm afraid I must abandon this mission. I hope you understand.
messages.zh: 恐怕我得要放弃这个任务了。我希望你能明白。

messages.en: You're quitting on me? Truly a sad day.
messages.zh: 你不干了？真是难过的一天。

messages.en: Don't worry about it. I'll take them out and make sure the Empire gains nothing!
messages.zh: 别担心这个。我会确保他们能挺过来而且帝国从中得不到任何好处。

messages.en: Excellent. I've uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. If you move fast, you'll be able to take out those repair ships with no problem. Your main competition will be pod pilots flying under the banner of the Empire. Prepare yourself to fight them if they try to intervene.
messages.zh: 很好。我已经把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中了。如果你行动迅速，应该可以毫不费劲地摧毁那些维修船。你的首要威胁来自于那些帝国的克隆飞行员。准备好和那些阻止你的人大干一场吧。

messages.en: I'll give everything I've got. What do you need of me?
messages.zh: 我会把我的所有都奉献出来。你需要做什么？

messages.en: The Caldari State is trying to reopen a gate in one of the nearby contested systems. Things are especially urgent, because our spies have learned they have a large strike force ready to come through the gate as soon as it's back online. We do not have the manpower to fight off the strike force at this time. Get there and destroy their repair ships.
messages.zh: 加达里合众国尝试将附近争夺区域中的一座废弃的星门重新开启。这件事非常的紧急，因为我们的间谍发现在星门的另一端集结了一直庞大的攻击部队，准备穿过星门直接攻击我们的后方。现在我们没有足够的人力再来处理这事儿。你去把那些负责维修星门的舰船都清除掉。

messages.en: The repair crew has been destroyed and the gate remains offline. You have nothing more to worry about.
messages.zh: 维修船已经被消灭了，星门目前依然处于离线状态。你没什么好担心的了。

messages.en: This is great news! The morals of the Federation prove stronger again. With that repair crew taken out, we can request reinforcements and either demolish that gate or repair it ourselves and ambush the strike force as it comes through. You truly earned your reward today.
messages.zh: 这真是个大好消息！联邦的士气再次被证明是最高昂的。现在这支维修队被消灭了，我们就有时间排出增援部队和爆破小组去把这个星门个完全消灭掉，或者我们自己把它修好然后等待他们的部队过来给予迎头痛击。你今天表现得非常好！

messages.en: That sounds like too much pressure for me.
messages.zh: 这听来对我的压力太大了。

messages.en: If we don't fight for our way of life, will we ever know true justice?
messages.zh: 如果我们不全力的斗争，怎么能知道什么是真正的公正呢？

messages.en:
Something urgent has just come across my desk. The Caldari State at one time managed to set up a gate in a nearby contested system. We eventually drove them off, but we never got around to tearing the gate down. It seems that was a mistake, as now the Caldari are trying to get the gate operational again. They have a huge strike force on the other side, waiting to come through.

We do not have the manpower to fight off that strike force. However, we still have time to act. While our forces are keeping the escorts busy, you need to go in and take out those repair ships. Can you do that?
messages.zh:
有些紧急的事情刚刚被送到我的办公桌上。加达里合众国曾经有一次在附近的争夺区域安放了一座星门。我们最终还是把他们给驱赶跑了，但当时并没有把那座星门给拆掉。现在看来那是当时的一个失误，现在这些加达里人正尝试把这座星门重新运转起来。他们在门的另一头集结了大量的攻击部队，准备在星门回复运转过后穿越过来。

我们没有足够的人力去抵抗这股攻击部队。不过，我们还有时间。我们的部队现在忙于防御巡逻，你现在就可以去把那些负责维修星门的舰船全都清楚掉。有问题么？

messages.en: Things got too hot for me! I've got to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这对我来说太烫手了！我要放弃这个任务。

messages.en: You can't? Don't you realize what this could mean? Get out of my sight; I need to find someone else to take your place.
messages.zh: 你没办法？你知道这意味着什么吗？滚出我的视线；我另外找人去完成这个任务。

messages.en: I can't let them succeed. I'll make sure both the Federation and Republic pay for their audacity!
messages.zh: 我不会让他们得逞的。我保证会让联邦和共和国为他们的胆大包天付出代价。

messages.en: Great. Now, the forces building the starbase probably aren't too tough. After all, most will be prepared for construction, not combat. However, I'm sure there will be capsuleers working for our enemies in the area. You'll have to set yourself up to combat them.
messages.zh: 很好。建造哨站的那帮人容易对付，毕竟他们是建筑工，不是战士。不过我相信那里应该会有为敌人卖命的飞行员。你最好还是带枪上阵。

messages.en: I'll make them regret their antagonism.
messages.zh: 他们和我们斗，我会让他们后悔的。

messages.en:
A joint taskforce between the Minmatar and Gallente are trying to establish a starbase inside one of our contested systems. We cannot allow them to succeed. Luckily the starbase's main reactor is vulnerable to attack.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Just remember, capsuleers loyal to our enemies will be able to fire on you in that system.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔盖伦特联军打算在我们的一个争夺星系中搭建一个哨站。我们不能让他们得逞。还好那哨站的主反应堆还很脆弱。

我已经把哨站的位置上传到你的控制边栏里了。记住，为敌方效力的飞行员可以在那星系里自由攻击你。

messages.en: I expected more of the Federation-Republic alliance! I've trashed their reactor.
messages.zh: 我看联邦和共和国的联盟会更加牢固，因为我们把他们的反应堆已经毁了。

messages.en: Excellent! If that's the best the Gallente and Minmatar can throw against us together, our future is certainly bright indeed. You definitely earned your reward here.
messages.zh: 太好了！如果盖伦特和米玛塔尔就真这点能耐，那我们就可以高枕无忧了。你这钱该拿。

messages.en: The Federation and Republic are working together? I could handle one, but not both!
messages.zh: 联邦和共和国强强联手？一个我还能对付，两个就不行了！

messages.en: Hmph. I thought you'd jump to take this mission.
messages.zh: 靠。我还以为你会兴奋地跳起来呢。

messages.en:
It looks like our enemies have banded together to attack us. The Minmatar and Gallente have always been close, but they haven't been cooperating to a great extent in the war. That seems to have changed.

You see, the Minmatar have been trying for months to get a starbase set up inside one of the nearby contested systems. We've been stopping them, but now it seems like they've got the Gallente to assist them.

Thankfully we've found out before they could get everything online. Their main reactor is still vulnerable to attack. If you destroy it, it will take the starbase with it. Can you head over there and take it out for us?
messages.zh:
看样子我们的敌人已经联合起来攻击我们了。虽然米玛塔尔和盖伦特关系很近，但以前他们还从来没有在战争中有过大规模的合作。但现在情况有所改变。

米玛塔尔数月来一直试图在邻近争夺星系里竖立一个哨站。我们也试图一直反制他们，但现在看起来他们背后还有盖伦特撑腰。

所幸我们及早察觉到了这点。他们现在那主反应堆还很脆弱。你把主反应堆端掉，那哨站也就搭不起来了。你能前往那里帮我们把它解决掉吗？

messages.en: The combined forces of the Federation and Republic were too much for me to handle.
messages.zh: 这两家联手我没法对付。

messages.en: Unfortunate. Your failure shows our enemies weakness.
messages.zh: 不幸啊，你这是在向敌人示弱。

name.ja: 激しさを増すロイドレイジ

messages.en: I knew you'd be up for it! You shouldn't have too much trouble with the Amarr, however, we've had reports that capsuleers loyal to the Empire are roaming the area. Because the system is contested, they'll be able to attack you if they catch you. Be prepare to face them.
messages.zh: 我知道你会帮忙的！艾玛人应该难不倒你，但是我们的情报显示很多为共和国做事儿的克隆飞行员也在这个区域活动。因为这个区域是争夺状态的，所以一旦他们发现你就会对你进行攻击。你要有所准备。

messages.en: How can I be of use?
messages.zh: 我该怎么帮忙？

messages.en: Our scanners just uncovered a hidden asteroid belt in a contested system. The Amarr apparently got to it before us and have already begun mining it. It still has plenty of ore, however, so we want to ensure that ore gets to us instead. All you have to do is fly out there and blow those miners to smithereens.
messages.zh: 我们的扫描器在争夺区域发现了一个隐藏的小行星带。艾玛人显然赶在我们之前已经发现并开始进行开采了。目前看来还剩余有大量的矿石藏量，所以我们得要把这些矿石夺过来。你要做的只是飞过去把那些采矿船都干掉就行了。

messages.en: The asteroid belt has been cleared of hostile miners. Hostile miners? That sounds like an oxymoron.
messages.zh: 小行星带的敌方采矿船已经被请出了。

messages.en: Now that those Amarrian fools have been taken care of, our own miners can go in and strip the belt. Unless the Amarr send someone to counterattack... But nah, that's not likely to happen. Good job, come back to me when you're ready for some more work.
messages.zh: 那些艾玛的蠢货们已经被解决了，我们自己的采矿船可以进场作业了。除非那些艾玛人又回来反击……但不像，应该不会发生了。干得不错，等你准备好了接下个任务的时候回来找我吧。

messages.en: I'm not sure I'm up for taking this mission. Maybe something else?
messages.zh: 我不是很肯定我是不是想谈论这个任务，有其他的事情么？

messages.en: That's a shame. This is important work.
messages.zh: 很遗憾啊，这可是个重要的任务。

messages.en:
It seems I am in luck. You see, we have recently discovered a rather large hidden asteroid belt. This belt has many resources that we could exploit. Unfortunately, it seems the Amarr Empire found it before us. They've miners over there right now stripping the belt of its precious mineral resources. We certainly can't let them do that!

I want you to fly over there and chase those miners off. By which I mean, of course, blowing them up. The bigger the explosions, the better. Can you do this for me?
messages.zh:
看起来我很走运。你看，最近我们发现了一个相当大规模的隐藏小行星矿带。这个矿带中蕴藏了很多我们可以加以利用的资源。不幸的是，艾玛帝国在我们之前先发现了这个矿带，他们的矿工和采矿船已经在那里对这个小行星矿带中的贵重资源进行开采了。我们当然不能让他们这样做！

我要你飞过去那个矿带，把那些采矿船都赶走。我说的是，当然，你得把它们都消灭掉。爆炸的焰火越剧烈越好，让他们都看看。你能帮我做这事儿么？

messages.en: I'm afraid I bit off more than I can chew.
messages.zh: 恐怕我干不了这个。

messages.en: I didn't think some miners would be able to scare you off!
messages.zh: 我并不觉得一些矿工就能吓到你！

messages.en: Understood. I'll deal with this immediately.
messages.zh: 明白。我马上动身处理这事。

messages.en: Good. There is no room for error here, so don't make me regret trusting you with this.
messages.zh: 好。这事情容不得半点闪失，别让我后悔相信你。

messages.en: I'm listening…
messages.zh: 愿洗耳恭听……

messages.en: We've learned that a Caldari State agent has infiltrated our ranks and has been actively working against us ever since. Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops to undoubtedly strike at our weakest points. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat, understood?
messages.zh: 据称多年前有一位合众国特工渗入了我们组织内部，一直在背后行使对我们不利的事情。许是他察觉到了，也许只是时机上的巧合，反正最近有人看到他在附近区域正召集一小支队伍。毫无疑问，他们打算袭击我们的要害点。他知不知道我们已经盯上了他已经不重要了；把他弄死就万事大吉。明白吗？

messages.en: I've dispatched the spy and his bodyguards.
messages.zh: 我把那间谍和他的守卫都干掉了。

messages.en: Excellent work, thank you. I hoped I could rely on your expertise and discretion. Once again you prove yourself a valuable ally of the Gallente people.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，真要谢谢你啊。我认为我能相信你的水平和判断力，事实果然证明你是盖伦特人民值得信赖的朋友。

messages.en: Why aren't we trying to capture and interrogate him? I want no part in any assassination of such a valuable source.
messages.zh: 为什么我们不去把他抓起来审问呢？这家伙可以提供重要情报，我想留他一条命。

messages.en: The arrogance and presumption of you eggers amazes me. I don't need to explain myself to you; I'll just get someone else who knows their place.
messages.zh: 你的傲慢与自以为是真是出乎我意料。我没必要向你解释什么；我自去找一个知道天高地厚的人。

messages.en: The gradual breakdown in relations between the empires over recent years has seen a drastic increase in their focus on espionage as a tool to both prevent, and more regularly, enhance warfare. As a result, spying is rife inside all of the empires and the common assumption that many organizations operate under is that they have already been compromised. Very few are trusted with crucial information, and those that have been are very closely watched. Despite their vast differences, the brutal treatment of those caught in the act is one thing shared by each nation.
messages.zh: 随着近年来关系逐渐恶化，帝国之间的间谍活动越发频繁。虽然这其中有部分行动是为了防止战争，但更多情况下，这些活动的进行是为了加强一方的战争优势。因此各帝国中的间谍活动都可以说是到达了猖獗程度，许多组织已被渗透更是一个共同假设。现在已经有很少组织可以被托付机密信息了，而那些为数不多可以被托付的也处于严密监视之下。国家虽各异，但在对被抓间谍的处理上，它们倒是如出一辙的残忍。

messages.en: A brutal commonality.
messages.zh: 残忍共性

messages.en:
We've got a mess on our hands and I need you to clean it up.

We recently came across some startling intelligence, given to us by certain sources I won't name. We learned that a Caldari State agent had infiltrated our ranks many years ago and has been actively working against us ever since. After this discovery we began watching this individual closely, it seems a little too closely.

Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops. Undoubtedly, they plan to strike at our weakest points. There is any number of nightmare scenarios they could bring to bear. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat.

Understood?
messages.zh:
我们搞砸了件事情，我需要你去帮我们擦屁股。

我们最近获悉了条让人唏嘘不已的情报，情报来源我这里不便透露。据称多年前有一位加达里特工渗入了我们组织内部，一直在背后行使对我们不利的事情。了解这情况后，我们开始对他进行近距离监视，但监视地可能太近了。

也许是他察觉到了，也许只是时机上的巧合，反正最近有人看到他在附近区域正召集一小支队伍。毫无疑问，他们打算袭击我们的要害点。他有可能为我们带来无尽麻烦。他知不知道我们已经盯上了他已经不重要了；把他弄死就万事大吉。

明白了吗？

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't get to him, there's too much at risk.
messages.zh: 恐怕我抓不住他了，风险太大。

messages.en: Risk? Risk?! You have a clone, what risk is there? I'll tell you what risk is: it's when you have a long-time spy in your organization leading fleets against you, that's risk! Whatever, I'll find someone else who can spare me of such pathetic excuses for their own cowardice.
messages.zh: 风险？你说风险？！你有克隆还谈什么风险？我告诉你什么是风险：一个间谍在你内部长期作威作福，然后他带领一支舰队对你实行倒戈，这才叫风险！算了，我去找一个不会用借口来掩饰自己懦弱的人。

messages.en: Don't worry about it. I'll take them out and make sure the State gains nothing!
messages.zh: 别担心这个。我会确保他们能挺过来而且合众国从中得不到任何好处。

messages.en: Excellent. I've uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. If you move fast, you'll be able to take out those repair ships with no problem. Your main competition will be pod pilots flying under the banner of the Empire. Prepare yourself to fight them if they try to intervene.
messages.zh: 很好。我已经把坐标上传到你的控制边栏中了。如果你行动迅速，应该可以毫不费劲地摧毁那些维修船。你的首要威胁来自于那些帝国的克隆飞行员。准备好和那些阻止你的人大干一场吧。

messages.en: I'll give everything I've got. What do you need of me?
messages.zh: 我会把我的所有都奉献出来。你需要做什么？

messages.en: The Amarr Empire is trying to reopen a gate in one of the nearby contested systems. Things are especially urgent, because our spies have learned they have a large strike force ready to come through the gate as soon as it's back online. We do not have the manpower to fight off the strike force at this time. Get there and destroy their repair ships.
messages.zh: 艾玛帝国尝试将附近争夺区域中的一座废弃的星门重新开启。这件事非常的紧急，因为我们的间谍发现在星门的另一端集结了一直庞大的攻击部队，准备穿过星门直接攻击我们的后方。现在我们没有足够的人力再来处理这事儿。你去把那些负责维修星门的舰船都清除掉。

messages.en: The repair crew has been destroyed and the gate remains offline. You have nothing more to worry about.
messages.zh: 维修船已经被消灭了，星门目前依然处于离线状态。你没什么好担心的了。

messages.en: This is great news! The cause of freedom has been advanced today. With that repair crew taken out, we can request reinforcements and either demolish that gate or repair it ourselves and ambush the strike force as it comes through. You truly earned your reward today.
messages.zh: 这真是个大好消息！自由的事业在今天又一次取得了胜利。现在这支维修队被消灭了，我们就有时间排出增援部队和爆破小组去把这个星门个完全消灭掉，或者我们自己把它修好然后等待他们的部队过来给予迎头痛击。你今天表现得非常好！

messages.en: That sounds like too much pressure for me.
messages.zh: 这听来对我的压力太大了。

messages.en: Submission is not the way of the Minmatar! Submission is the way of defeat.
messages.zh: 臣服永远不是米玛塔尔人的行为！那意味着奴役。

messages.en:
Something urgent has just come across my desk. The Amarr Empire at one time managed to set up a gate in a nearby contested system. We eventually drove them off, but we never got around to tearing the gate down. It seems that was a mistake, as now the Amarr are trying to get the gate operational again. They have a huge strike force on the other side, waiting to come through.

We do not have the manpower to fight off that strike force. However, we still have time to act. While our forces are keeping the escorts busy, you need to go in and take out those repair ships. Can you do that?
messages.zh:
有些紧急的事情刚刚被送到我的办公桌上。米玛塔尔共和国曾经有一次在附近的争夺区域安放了一座星门。我们最终还是把他们给驱赶跑了，但当时并没有把那座星门给拆掉。现在看来那是当时的一个失误，现在这些艾玛人正尝试把这座星门重新运转起来。他们在门的另一头集结了大量的攻击部队，准备在星门回复运转过后穿越过来。

我们没有足够的人力去抵抗这股攻击部队。不过，我们还有时间。我们的部队现在忙于防御巡逻，你现在就可以去把那些负责维修星门的舰船全都清楚掉。有问题么？

messages.en: Things got too hot for me! I've got to abandon this mission.
messages.zh: 这对我来说太烫手了！我要放弃这个任务。

messages.en: You can't? Don't you realize what this could mean? Get out of my sight; I need to find someone else to take your place.
messages.zh: 你没办法？你知道这意味着什么吗？滚出我的视线；我另外找人去完成这个任务。

messages.en: Of course. Give me the coordinates and I'll head out immediately.
messages.zh: 当然。快把位标给我，我立刻动身。

messages.en: Excellent, I'll tell them to proceed. Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.
messages.zh: 太好了，我将告诉他们按计划行事。尽快飞往那里听候调遣。我将根据战场形势直接向你发出进攻或是撤退的命令。

messages.en: Oh? Let's hear it then.
messages.zh: 噢？说出来听听。

messages.en:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance. We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Caldari State logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and we're expecting State forces to be more prepared than usual.

Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.
messages.zh:
我们打算即将深入敌后发动一场高风险的行动。我要你也参与以提供特定协助。加达里有一对一整个争夺区域提供后勤支援的弹药库，那里有重兵把守，我要你去对它进行打击。战斗会很激烈，而且我们估计他们较以往会有更充足的准备。

快飞往那里听候调遣。我将根据战场形势直接向你发出进攻或是撤退的命令。

messages.en: Was that all you needed done? How is the fight going?
messages.zh: 你要求的事都完成了吗？战斗怎么样了？

messages.en: : I just received word that the cache has been secured and will be detonated once we've cleared the area. Excellent work out there, they've lost a strategic foothold as well as a prominent commander today, we couldn't be happier with the result.
messages.zh: 我得到消息说那弹药库已在我们控制之下，我们把那地区清空之后就会用炸弹点爆它。你干得漂亮，他们今天不仅失去了一个战略工事，还损失了一名重要司令，对于这样的结果我们是再满意不过了。

messages.en: This high-pressure stuff isn't really for me, I'm afraid. You'd be better off finding someone else.
messages.zh: 我觉得这种压力超大的事不是我能干的。你最好找别人。

messages.en: Am I supposed to be admiring your honesty here? If you're not cut out for this kind of work then you're not worth my time, period.
messages.zh: 我是不是应该钦佩你有自知之明啊？如果你不是天生干这活儿的，那就别再浪费我时间了，就这样。

messages.en: As relations began to slide further towards outright war, each of the empires increased their focus on long-term strategic interests. Exhaustively detailed battle plans of everything from invasion scenarios to the best locations for ammunitions caches were deliberated over endlessly by countless organizations dedicated to the singular task of winning, or perhaps simply surviving, a seemingly inevitable war.
messages.zh: 随着关系变糟得已经有了爆发全面战争的可能，各帝国都开始将他们的注意力越来越多地投向了他们的长期战略利益。他们制定了各种详尽计划，从应对侵略到选择弹药库存放地，所有的计划都被各级组织反复讨论。面对一场似乎无法避免的战争，这些组织身上都背负了赢取它——或者只是在其中存活下来——的重任。

messages.en: Prepare for the worst.
messages.zh: 做好最坏打算。

messages.en:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance.

We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Caldari State logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and a great deal at stake for us should we fail to impede the recent progress they've been making.

We've reason to believe that our plans have already been partly compromised. We're expecting State forces to be more prepared than usual, possibly even reinforced, and we're aiming to prepare ourselves accordingly. I've been tasked with organising a capsuleer-based contingency plan and deploying it with specific orders in mind. Once I given the clear that we've got someone, they'll be launching the offensive immediately, so time is of the essence.

Having someone as capable as you at our backs would allow us a great deal of tactical flexibility on-field and all but ensure that victory is swift and casualties low. If it turns out you're not needed, then we'll still pay you for your time, but certain orders I've been receiving suggest we may yet have a use for you out there, time will tell.

Are you up for the mission?
messages.zh:
我们打算即将深入敌后发动一场高风险的行动。我要你也参与以提供特定协助。

加达里有一对一整个争夺区域提供后勤支援的弹药库，那里有重兵把守，我要你去对它进行打击。如果我们不能阻止他们最近的攻势，那后面的仗将越发难打，风险巨大。

其实我认为我们的计划已经部分失败了。合众国的准备较之前更加充分，他们可能已经调集了援军，我们也要做好相应准备。我的任务是筹划一个由飞行员执行的应急计划，号施令由我来发。一旦我这里清理掉了一个关键人物，那他们就可以马上发动大规模袭击了，因此时间是关键。

有你这样一位有能力的飞行员助阵将允许我们施行更灵活的战术，最重要的是我们可以获取一场耗时少，伤亡低的胜利。如果实际情况没你也行，那我们还是会付你钱的，毕竟我们占用了你的时间；但从我目前收到的命令来看，你还是会被派上用场的，等着瞧吧。

你准备好了吗？

messages.en: I'm sorry, but I have to decline this mission after all, I won't be able to provide the level of assistance you're after.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我必须拒绝该任务，我不能提供你想要的协助。

messages.en: What?! I already told them we had someone inbound and they launched the operation! This is a gross display of negligence on your behalf, pilot. I'll be making a note of it in your records, just as soon as I've found someone who is actually reliable.
messages.zh: 什么？！我已经告诉他们有人加入，他们已经开始行动了！飞行员，你让人看到了你的庸碌无为。我会在找到其他可靠的人后在你简历上记上这一笔。

name.ru: Боевой дух и высокая мораль (Morale and Morality)

messages.en: If you think I have a problem with this, I don't. I understand completely. Give me the location of the residence.
messages.zh: 如果你认为我会有所顾虑，那你就错了。我完全明白这种道理。给我那个居住地的坐标吧。

messages.en: You're right; I should have known you could be relied upon in these matters. I'm uploading the coordinates now, good luck.
messages.zh: 你说的对， 我早就知道你是完全可以被信任的。我正把座标上传给你。

messages.en: How can I serve?
messages.zh: 我能帮你什么

messages.en:
We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the State's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Gallente people. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

They have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these Industrials, we can starve the enemy out.
messages.zh:
我们在附近合众国具有主要控制权的地区发现了一个民用设施。这个据点里面居住了数千他们的居民，大部分都是在附近舰艇和设施中服役的士兵和官员的家属。这些人是来这里为他们的军队提高士气的，而我们正是不能容忍这样的事情发生。

他们有一个很大的弱点：就是供给线。殖民地的日常生活和军事需求都是完全依靠一条工业运输线路来完成。如果我们能够拦截摧毁那些工业舰，那么我们的敌人就得挨饿了。

messages.en: The Industrials have been destroyed. I only hope this serves our purposes and doesn't backfire.
messages.zh: 工业舰已经被干掉了，我只是希望我们能达到目的且不要节外生枝。

messages.en: Though I understand and even share those same concerns, it was a risk that had to be taken. Good work today pilot, here's your pay.
messages.zh: 其实我理解这些问题，但这个风险时必须要承担的。你做的很好，飞行员，这是你的报酬。

messages.en: Briefings like this make me question what side I should be fighting for. I want nothing to do with this.
messages.zh: 想这样的任务简报让我开始怀疑我到底该为谁工作。我不想参与这事儿。

messages.en: What would you have us do then, huh? Shall we just leave them there, let them continue to offer a kind of assistance no amount of military and logistics support can? You disappoint me, deeply. Oh, and if I find out you've leaked this information, there will be consequences.
messages.zh: 你要我们怎么办，恩？我们就这么放着他们不管？就这么让他们为我们的敌人提供任何军事和后勤支援都不能提供的支持？你让我失望了，深深的失望了。哦，要是我知道你泄露了机密的话，绝不会给你好果子吃的。

messages.en: Civilian deaths in a war are a reality, one which is accepted as inevitable by all of the empires. The effects of such things are often hard to predict, however, and those targeting their attacks must do so carefully. There are times when the mass death of civilians can indeed crush a nation's will to fight any further, or cause such anxiety amongst their citizenry that popular support for conflict is replaced by angry cries to back down. At other times however, it will only harden their resolve, serving as a valuable and yet grim propaganda victory, that allows them to paint their enemy as a heartless monster.
messages.zh: 战争中平民的死亡是现实的问题，无论是什么样的国家都必须接受它的不可逃避性。这种事情的结果通常是难以预料的，但是，那些发动攻击的人必须要小心的选择目标。有的时候，大量的平民伤亡可能在最大限度上消磨一个国家的战斗意志，甚至在其国民之中造成大恐慌，使得要求妥协结束战争的人取代那些好战份子。但是在更多时候，却只会坚定他们的意志，成为一个宣传的好案例，更加的使其敌人妖魔化。

messages.en: A risky target.
messages.zh: 一个冒险的目标

messages.en:
What I am about to ask you is strictly confidential, understood?

We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the State's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Gallente people.

Their arrogance is astounding, no? They seem to think we will allow them to exist in peace simply because they bear no weapons. Their weak security presence suggests as much. Understand pilot; these people are as significant a threat as any other. What they provide may not be firepower or logistics but it is crucial to their war effort nonetheless. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

We've found they have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these Industrials, we can starve the enemy out.
messages.zh:
我要你干的事情是十分保密的，你能明白么？

我们在附近合众国具有主要控制权的地区发现了一个民用设施。这个据点里面居住了数千他们的居民，大部分都是在附近舰艇和设施中服役的士兵和官员的家属。这些人是来这里为他们的军队提高士气的，而这些军人正式那些伤害我们盖伦特自己兄弟和国民的凶手。

这帮人傲慢到了极点，不是么？他们以为我们会放任他们不管，看看他们那不堪一击的安防系统就知道了。明智的飞行员，这些人的威胁是不容置疑的，他们所来的可能不是枪炮和补给，但是却大大的增强了敌人的士气，我们决不能让他们这么做。

他们有一个很大的弱点：就是供给线。殖民地的日常生活和军事需求都是完全依靠一条工业运输线路来完成。如果我们能够拦截摧毁那些工业舰，那么我们的敌人就得挨饿了。

messages.en: I've had second thoughts. I simply cannot do something as monstrous as this. We risk too much with actions of this nature.
messages.zh: 我还有另外一个想法，我不能干这种禽兽不如的事情。做这样的事情所造成的风险实在太大了。

messages.en: Spare me the ethics lecture. I will find someone else who understands the importance of this mission.
messages.zh: 省省你的道德课吧。我会另外找个明白其中重要性高手来办这事儿。

messages.en: Understood. I'll deal with this immediately.
messages.zh: 明白。我马上动身处理这事。

messages.en: Good. There is no room for error here, so don't make me regret trusting you with this.
messages.zh: 好。这事情容不得半点闪失，别让我后悔相信你。

messages.en: I'm listening…
messages.zh: 愿洗耳恭听……

messages.en: We've learned that an Amarrian agent has infiltrated our ranks and has been actively working against us ever since. Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops to undoubtedly strike at our weakest points. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat, understood?
messages.zh: 据称多年前有一位艾玛特工渗入了我们组织内部，一直在背后行使对我们不利的事情。许是他察觉到了，也许只是时机上的巧合，反正最近有人看到他在附近区域正召集一小支队伍。毫无疑问，他们打算袭击我们的要害点。他知不知道我们已经盯上了他已经不重要了；把他弄死就万事大吉。明白吗？

messages.en: I've dispatched the spy and his bodyguards.
messages.zh: 我把那间谍和他的守卫都干掉了。

messages.en: Excellent work, thank you. I hoped I could rely on your expertise and discretion. Once again you prove yourself a valuable ally of the Matari people.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，真要谢谢你啊。我认为我能相信你的水平和判断力，事实果然证明你是玛塔利人民值得信赖的朋友。

messages.en: Why aren't we trying to capture and interrogate him? I want no part in any assassination of such a valuable source.
messages.zh: 为什么我们不去把他抓起来审问呢？这家伙可以提供重要情报，我想留他一条命。

messages.en: The arrogance and presumption of you eggers amazes me. I don't need to explain myself to you; I'll just get someone else who knows their place.
messages.zh: 你的傲慢与自以为是真是出乎我意料。我没必要向你解释什么；我自去找一个知道天高地厚的人。

messages.en: The gradual breakdown in relations between the empires over recent years has seen a drastic increase in their focus on espionage as a tool to both prevent, and more regularly, enhance warfare. As a result, spying is rife inside all of the empires and the common assumption that many organizations operate under is that they have already been compromised. Very few are trusted with crucial information, and those that have been are very closely watched. Despite their vast differences, the brutal treatment of those caught in the act is one thing shared by each nation.
messages.zh: 随着近年来关系逐渐恶化，帝国之间的间谍活动越发频繁。虽然这其中有部分行动是为了防止战争，但更多情况下，这些活动的进行是为了加强一方的战争优势。因此各帝国中的间谍活动都可以说是到达了猖獗程度，许多组织已被渗透更是一个共同假设。现在已经有很少组织可以被托付机密信息了，而那些为数不多可以被托付的也处于严密监视之下。国家虽各异，但在对被抓间谍的处理上，它们倒是如出一辙的残忍。

messages.en: A brutal commonality
messages.zh: 残忍共性

messages.en:
We've got a mess on our hands and I need you to clean it up.

We recently came across some startling intelligence, given to us by certain sources I won't name. We learned that an Amarrian agent had infiltrated our ranks many years ago and has been actively working against us ever since. After this discovery we began watching this individual closely, it seems a little too closely.

Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops. Undoubtedly, they plan to strike at our weakest points. There is any number of nightmare scenarios they could bring to bear. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat.

Understood?
messages.zh:
我们搞砸了件事情，我需要你去帮我们擦屁股。

我们最近获悉了条让人唏嘘不已的情报，情报来源我这里不便透露。据称多年前有一位艾玛特工渗入了我们组织内部，一直在背后行使对我们不利的事情。了解这情况后，我们开始对他进行近距离监视，但监视地可能太近了。

也许是他察觉到了，也许只是时机上的巧合，反正最近有人看到他在附近区域正召集一小支队伍。毫无疑问，他们打算袭击我们的要害点。他有可能为我们带来无尽麻烦。他知不知道我们已经盯上了他已经不重要了；把他弄死就万事大吉。

明白了吗？

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't get to him, there's too much at risk.
messages.zh: 恐怕我抓不住他了，风险太大。

messages.en: Risk? Risk?! You have a clone, what risk is there? I'll tell you what risk is: it's when you have a long-time spy in your organization leading fleets against you, that's risk! Whatever, I'll find someone else who can spare me of such pathetic excuses for their own cowardice.
messages.zh: 风险？你说风险？！你有克隆还谈什么风险？我告诉你什么是风险：一个间谍在你内部长期作威作福，然后他带领一支舰队对你实行倒戈，这才叫风险！算了，我去找一个不会用借口来掩饰自己懦弱的人。

messages.en: I can't let them succeed. I'll make sure both the Empire and State pay for their audacity!
messages.zh: 我不会让他们得逞的。我保证会让帝国和合众国为他们的胆大包天付出代价。

messages.en: Great. Now, the forces building the starbase probably aren't too tough. After all, most will be prepared for construction, not combat. However, I'm sure there will be capsuleers working for our enemies in the area. You'll have to set yourself up to combat them.
messages.zh: 很好。建造哨站的那帮人容易对付，毕竟他们是建筑工，不是战士。不过我相信那里应该会有为敌人卖命的飞行员。你最好还是带枪上阵。

messages.en: I'll make the world regret their antagonism.
messages.zh: 他们和我们斗，我会让他们后悔的。

messages.en:
It looks like our enemies have banded together to attack us. The Caldari and Amarr have always been close, but they haven't been cooperating to a great extent in the war. That seems to have changed.

You see, the Caldari have been trying for months to get a starbase set up inside one of the nearby contested systems. We've been stopping them, but now it seems like they've got the Amarr to assist them.

Thankfully we've found out before they could get everything online. Their main reactor is still vulnerable to attack. If you destroy it, it will take the starbase with it. Can you head over there and take it out for us?
messages.zh:
看样子我们的敌人已经联合起来攻击我们了。虽然加达里和艾玛关系很近，但以前他们还从来没有在战争中有过大规模的合作。但现在情况有所改变。

加达里数月来一直试图在邻近争夺星系里竖立一个哨站。我们也试图一直反制他们，但现在看起来他们背后还有艾玛撑腰。

所幸我们及早察觉到了这点。他们现在那主反应堆还很脆弱。你把主反应堆端掉，那哨站也就搭不起来了。你能前往那里帮我们把它解决掉吗？

messages.en: I expected more of the Empire-State alliance! I've trashed their reactor.
messages.zh: 我看帝国和合众国的联盟会更加牢固，因为我们把他们的反应堆已经毁了。

messages.en: Excellent! If that's the best the Amarr and Caldari can throw against us together, our future is certainly bright indeed. You definitely earned your reward here.
messages.zh: 太好了！如果艾玛和加达里就真这点能耐，那我们就可以高枕无忧了。你这钱该拿。

messages.en: The Empire and State are working together? I could handle one, but not both!
messages.zh: 帝国和合众国强强联手？一个我还能对付，两个就不行了！

messages.en: Hmph. I thought you'd jump to take this mission.
messages.zh: 靠。我还以为你会兴奋地跳起来呢。

messages.en:
A joint taskforce between the Caldari and Amarr are trying to establish a starbase inside one of our contested systems. We cannot allow them to succeed. Luckily the starbase's main reactor is vulnerable to attack.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Just remember, capsuleers loyal to our enemies will be able to fire on you in that system.
messages.zh:
加达里艾玛联军打算在我们的一个争夺星系中搭建一个哨站。我们不能让他们得逞。还好那哨站的主反应堆还很脆弱。

我已经把哨站的位置上传到你的控制边栏里了。记住，为敌方效力的飞行员可以在那星系里自由攻击你。

messages.en: The combined forces of the Empire and State were too much for me to handle.
messages.zh: 这两家联手我没法对付。

messages.en: Unfortunate. Having you fail shows our enemies weakness.
messages.zh: 不幸啊，你这是在向敌人示弱。

messages.en: Of course. Give me the coordinates and I'll head out immediately.
messages.zh: 当然。快把位标给我，我立刻动身。

messages.en: Excellent, I'll tell them to proceed. Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.
messages.zh: 太好了，我将告诉他们按计划行事。尽快飞往那里听候调遣。我将根据战场形势直接向你发出进攻或是撤退的命令。

messages.en: Oh? Let's hear it then.
messages.zh: 噢？说出来听听。

messages.en:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance. We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Amarrian logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and we're expecting Empire forces to be more prepared than usual.

Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.
messages.zh:
我们打算即将深入敌后发动一场高风险的行动。我要你也参与以提供特定协助。艾玛有一对一整个争夺区域提供后勤支援的弹药库，那里有重兵把守，我要你去对它进行打击。战斗会很激烈，而且我们估计他们较以往会有更充足的准备。

快飞往那里听候调遣。我将根据战场形势直接向你发出进攻或是撤退的命令。

messages.en: Was that all you needed done? How is the fight going?
messages.zh: 你要求的事都完成了吗？战斗怎么样了？

messages.en: I just received word that the cache has been secured and will be detonated once we've cleared the area. Excellent work out there, they've lost a strategic foothold as well as a prominent commander today, we couldn't be happier with the result.
messages.zh: 我得到消息说那弹药库已在我们控制之下，我们把那地区清空之后就会用炸弹点爆它。你干得漂亮，他们今天不仅失去了一个战略工事，还损失了一名重要司令，对于这样的结果我们是再满意不过了。

messages.en: This high-pressure stuff isn't really for me, I'm afraid. You'd be better off finding someone else.
messages.zh: 我觉得这种压力超大的事不是我能干的。你最好找别人。

messages.en: Am I supposed to be admiring your honesty here? If you're not cut out for this kind of work then you're not worth my time, period.
messages.zh: 我是不是应该钦佩你有自知之明啊？如果你不是天生干这活儿的，那就别再浪费我时间了，就这样。

messages.en: As relations began to slide further towards outright war, each of the empires increased their focus on long-term strategic interests. Exhaustively detailed battle plans of everything from invasion scenarios to the best locations for ammunitions caches were deliberated over endlessly by countless organizations dedicated to the singular task of winning, or perhaps simply surviving, a seemingly inevitable war.
messages.zh: 随着关系变糟得已经有了爆发全面战争的可能，各帝国都开始将他们的注意力越来越多地投向了他们的长期战略利益。他们制定了各种详尽计划，从应对侵略到选择弹药库存放地，所有的计划都被各级组织反复讨论。面对一场似乎无法避免的战争，这些组织身上都背负了赢取它——或者只是在其中存活下来——的重任。

messages.en: Prepare for the worst.
messages.zh: 做好最坏打算。

messages.en:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance.

We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Amarrian logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and a great deal at stake for us should we fail to impede the recent progress they've been making.

We've reason to believe that our plans have already been partly compromised. We're expecting Empire forces to be more prepared than usual, possibly even reinforced, and we're aiming to prepare ourselves accordingly. I've been tasked with organising a capsuleer-based contingency plan and deploying it with specific orders in mind. Once I given the clear that we've got someone, they'll be launching the offensive immediately, so time is of the essence.

Having someone as capable as you at our backs would allow us a great deal of tactical flexibility on-field and all but ensure that victory is swift and casualties low. If it turns out you're not needed, then we'll still pay you for your time, but certain orders I've been receiving suggest we may yet have a use for you out there, time will tell.

Are you up for the mission?
messages.zh:
我们打算即将深入敌后发动一场高风险的行动。我要你也参与以提供特定协助。

艾玛有一对一整个争夺区域提供后勤支援的弹药库，那里有重兵把守，我要你去对它进行打击。如果我们不能阻止他们最近的攻势，那后面的仗将越发难打，风险巨大。

其实我认为我们的计划已经部分失败了。帝国的准备较之前更加充分，他们可能已经调集了援军，我们也要做好相应准备。我的任务是筹划一个由飞行员执行的应急计划，号施令由我来发。一旦我这里清理掉了一个关键人物，那他们就可以马上发动大规模袭击了，因此时间是关键。

有你这样一位有能力的飞行员助阵将允许我们施行更灵活的战术，最重要的是我们可以获取一场耗时少，伤亡低的胜利。如果实际情况没你也行，那我们还是会付你钱的，毕竟我们占用了你的时间；但从我目前收到的命令来看，你还是会被派上用场的，等着瞧吧。

你准备好了吗？

messages.en: I'm sorry, but I have to decline this mission after all, I won't be able to provide the level of assistance you're after.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我必须拒绝该任务，我不能提供你想要的协助。

messages.en: What?! I already told them we had someone inbound and they launched the operation! This is a gross display of negligence on your behalf, pilot. I'll be making a note of it in your records, just as soon as I've found someone who is actually reliable.
messages.zh: 什么？！我已经告诉他们有人加入，他们已经开始行动了！飞行员，你让人看到了你的庸碌无为。我会在找到其他可靠的人后在你简历上记上这一笔。

name.ru: Боевой дух и высокая мораль (Morale and Morality)

messages.en: If you think I have a problem with this, I don't. I understand completely. Give me the location of the residence.
messages.zh: 如果你认为我会有所顾虑，那你就错了。我完全明白这种道理。给我那个居住地的坐标吧。

messages.en: You're right; I should have known you could be relied upon in these matters. I'm uploading the coordinates now, good luck.
messages.zh: 你说的对， 我早就知道你是完全可以被信任的。我正把座标上传给你。

messages.en: How can I serve?
messages.zh: 我能帮你什么

messages.en:
We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the Empire's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Matari people. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

They have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these industrials, we can starve the enemy out.
messages.zh:
我们在附近帝国具有很强势力的地区发现了一个民用设施。这个据点里面居住了数千他们的居民，大部分都是在附近舰艇和设施中服役的士兵和官员的家属。这些人是来这里为他们的军队提高士气的，而这些军人正式那些伤害我们玛塔利弟兄姐妹和公民的凶手。我们不能容忍这样的事情发生。

他们有一个很大的弱点：就是供给线。殖民地的日常生活和军事需求都是完全依靠一条工业运输线路来完成。如果我们能够拦截摧毁那些工业舰，那么我们的敌人就得挨饿了。

messages.en: The Industrials have been destroyed. I only hope this serves our purposes and doesn't backfire.
messages.zh: 工业舰已经被干掉了，我只是希望我们能达到目的且不要节外生枝。

messages.en: Though I understand and even share those same concerns, it was a risk that had to be taken. Good work today pilot, here's your pay.
messages.zh: 其实我理解这些问题，但这个风险时必须要承担的。你做的很好，飞行员，这是你的报酬。

messages.en: Briefings like this make me question what side I should be fighting for. I want nothing to do with this.
messages.zh: 想这样的任务简报让我开始怀疑我到底该为谁工作。我不想参与这事儿。

messages.en: What would you have us do then, huh? Shall we just leave them there, let them continue to offer a kind of assistance no amount of military and logistics support can? You disappoint me, deeply. Oh, and if I find out you've leaked this information, there will be consequences.
messages.zh: 你要我们怎么办，恩？我们就这么放着他们不管？就这么让他们为我们的敌人提供任何军事和后勤支援都不能提供的支持？你让我失望了，深深的失望了。哦，要是我知道你泄露了机密的话，绝不会给你好果子吃的。

messages.en: Civilian deaths in a war are a reality, one which is accepted as inevitable by all of the empires. The effects of such things are often hard to predict, however, and those targeting their attacks must do so carefully. There are times when the mass death of civilians can indeed crush a nation's will to fight any further, or cause such anxiety amongst their citizenry that popular support for conflict is replaced by angry cries to back down. At other times however, it will only harden their resolve, serving as a valuable and yet grim propaganda victory, that allows them to paint their enemy as a heartless monster.
messages.zh: 战争中平民的死亡是现实的问题，无论是什么样的国家都必须接受它的不可逃避性。这种事情的结果通常是难以预料的，但是，那些发动攻击的人必须要小心的选择目标。有的时候，大量的平民伤亡可能在最大限度上消磨一个国家的战斗意志，甚至在其国民之中造成大恐慌，使得要求妥协结束战争的人取代那些好战份子。但是在更多时候，却只会坚定他们的意志，成为一个宣传的好案例，更加的使其敌人妖魔化。

messages.en: A risky target
messages.zh: 危险的目标

messages.en:
What I am about to ask you is strictly confidential, understood?

We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the Empire's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Matari people.

Their arrogance is astounding, no? They seem to think we will allow them to exist in peace simply because they bear no weapons. Their weak security presence suggests as much. Understand pilot; these people are as significant a threat as any other. What they provide may not be firepower or logistics but it is crucial to their war effort nonetheless. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

They have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these industrials, we can starve the enemy out.
messages.zh:
我要你干的事情是十分保密的，你能明白么？

我们在附近帝国具有很强势力的地区发现了一个民用设施。这个据点里面居住了数千他们的居民，大部分都是在附近舰艇和设施中服役的士兵和官员的家属。这些人是来这里为他们的军队提高士气的，而这些军人正式那些伤害我们玛塔利自己弟兄姐妹和公民的凶手。

这帮人傲慢到了极点，不是么？他们以为我们会放任他们不管，看看他们那不堪一击的安防系统就知道了。明智的飞行员，这些人的威胁是不容置疑的，他们所来的可能不是枪炮和补给，但是却大大的增强了敌人的士气，我们决不能让他们这么做。

他们有一个很大的弱点：就是供给线。殖民地的日常生活和军事需求都是完全依靠一条工业运输线路来完成。如果我们能够拦截摧毁那些工业舰，那么我们的敌人就得挨饿了。

messages.en: I've had second thoughts. I simply cannot do something as monstrous as this. We risk too much with actions of this nature.
messages.zh: 我还有另外一个想法，我不能干这种禽兽不如的事情。做这样的事情所造成的风险实在太大了。

messages.en: Spare me the ethics lecture. I will find someone else who understands the importance of this mission.
messages.zh: 省省你的道德课吧。我会另外找个明白其中重要性高手来办这事儿。

messages.en: I can't let them succeed. I'll make sure both the State and Empire pay for their audacity!
messages.zh: 我不会让他们得逞的。我保证会让合众国和帝国为他们的胆大包天付出代价。

messages.en: Great. Now, the forces building the starbase probably aren't too tough. After all, most will be prepared for construction, not combat. However, I'm sure there will be capsuleers working for our enemies in the area. You'll have to set yourself up to combat them.
messages.zh: 很好。建造哨站的那帮人容易对付，毕竟他们是建筑工，不是战士。不过我相信那里应该会有为敌人卖命的飞行员。你最好还是带枪上阵。

messages.en: I'll make the world regret their antagonism.
messages.zh: 他们和我们斗，我会让他们后悔的。

messages.en:
A joint taskforce between the Amarr and Caldari are trying to establish a starbase inside one of our contested systems. We cannot allow them to succeed. Luckily the starbase's main reactor is vulnerable to attack.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Just remember, capsuleers loyal to our enemies will be able to fire on you in that system.
messages.zh:
艾玛加达里联军打算在我们的一个争夺星系中搭建一个哨站。我们不能让他们得逞。还好那哨站的主反应堆还很脆弱。

我已经把哨站的位置上传到你的控制边栏里了。记住，为敌方效力的飞行员可以在那星系里自由攻击你。

messages.en: I expected more of the State-Empire alliance! I've trashed their reactor.
messages.zh: 我看合众国和帝国的联盟会更加牢固，因为我们把他们的反应堆已经毁了。

messages.en: Excellent! If that's the best the Caldari and Amarr can throw against us together, our future is certainly bright indeed. You definitely earned your reward here.
messages.zh: 太好了！如果加达里和艾玛就真这点能耐，那我们就可以高枕无忧了。你这钱该拿。

messages.en: The State and Empire are working together? I could handle one, but not both!
messages.zh: 合众国和帝国强强联手？一个我还能对付，两个就不行了！

messages.en: Hmph. I thought you'd jump to take this mission.
messages.zh: 靠。我还以为你会兴奋地跳起来呢。

messages.en:
It looks like our enemies have banded together to attack us. The Amarr and Caldari have always been close, but they haven't been cooperating to a great extent in the war. That seems to have changed.

You see, the Amarr have been trying for months to get a starbase set up inside one of the nearby contested systems. We've been stopping them, but now it seems like they've got the Caldari to assist them.

Thankfully we've found out before they could get everything online. Their main reactor is still vulnerable to attack. If you destroy it, it will take the starbase with it. Can you head over there and take it out for us?
messages.zh:
看样子我们的敌人已经联合起来攻击我们了。虽然艾玛和加达里关系很近，但以前他们还从来没有在战争中有过大规模的合作。但现在情况有所改变。

艾玛数月来一直试图在邻近争夺星系里竖立一个哨站。我们也试图一直反制他们，但现在看起来他们背后还有加达里撑腰。

所幸我们及早察觉到了这点。他们现在那主反应堆还很脆弱。你把主反应堆端掉，那哨站也就搭不起来了。你能前往那里帮我们把它解决掉吗？

messages.en: Unfortunate. Your failure shows our enemies weakness.
messages.zh: 不幸啊，你这是在向敌人示弱。

name.ru: Мертвые не болтают (Dead Men Tell No Tales)

messages.en: Executing that traitor will be my honor. Don't worry, I'll make sure he's taken care of.
messages.zh: 把那叛贼处决掉将是我的荣幸。别担心，我保证他会得到应有处置的。

messages.en: Good. Don't take any chances; that relay is our top priority. Everything else is a secondary target.
messages.zh: 很好。别鲁莽冒险；那中继站是我们的首要目标，其他都是次要目标。

messages.en: Disturbing news?
messages.zh: 令人忧心的消息？

messages.en: Your mission will be to slip past enemy lines and destroy the Caldari tactical relay and the spy on board. With him out of the way, our intelligence network in this sector should remain secure and the war effort will not be seriously threatened by his capture. Haste is of utmost importance, so don't waste any time.
messages.zh: 你的任务就是潜入敌人后防线，摧毁那加达里战术中继站及里面的那位间谍。把他解决之后，我们在地区的情报网就能安然无恙，我们的战争形势也不会受到太多负面影响。现在最需要的就是速度，切莫再迟疑。

messages.en: The tactical relay has been eliminated.
messages.zh: 我已经把中继站连根拔起了。

messages.en: Superb work, pilot. I'll make sure your name gets mentioned up the chain.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，飞行员。我会在上级面前美言你几句的。

messages.en: Look, I don't feel like cleaning up someone else's mess here. Find someone else to do your dirty work.
messages.zh: 听好，我不喜欢替别人擦屁股。找别人去干这些低档活儿吧。

messages.en: We're all in this war together, pilot, or we're all in deep trouble. You need to realize that sooner rather than later.
messages.zh: 我们是在同一条船上的，飞行员，要不大家都没好日子过。你最好尽快明白这点。

messages.en:
Intelligence has been using an agent on a Caldari tactical relay to eavesdrop on their communications in this sector. A few days ago we lost contact with him and all reports ceased, leaving us with a giant blind spot. We assumed that our agent had been discovered and eliminated.

It seems that the problem is even worse than we feared. Intelligence intercepted a communiqué indicating that our agent was not just caught, but turned-- he's ready to tell the enemy everything he knows about our operations in this area. This must not happen.

Fortunately, at the moment he's still being held on the tactical relay, putting him within our striking distance. We need you to slip past enemy lines and destroy that relay before it's too late.
messages.zh:
情报部门在一个加达里战术中继站里安插了一位特工，他的任务是窃听加达里人在这个地区的通信。几天前我们与他失去了联系，再也没有收到任何报告，我们现在面临一个巨大的消息真空。我们一开始以为这家伙被敌人发现然后被除掉了。

但问题好像比我们想象的还要严重。根据情报部门截取的一条信息，我们的特工不仅被抓，还发生了变节——他打算向敌人吐露一切他所了解的我们在此地区的行动情况。我们决不允许有这样的事情发生。

所幸他目前还被关押在战术中继站内，尚处于我们的打击范围。我们要你潜入敌人后防线，赶在一切都变得来不及之前摧毁那中继站。

messages.en: I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. Find someone else.
messages.zh: 我没法能进入到对那座中继塔有效的攻击范围内。你找别人吧。

messages.en: You have hurt us deeply here, pilot; I hope you realize that.
messages.zh: 你让我们遭受了惨痛损失，飞行员；我希望你能明白这点。

messages.en: I'll make sure those troops never reach their destinations!
messages.zh: 我会让他们永远到达不了目的地！

messages.en:
I knew you would be up for it. The convoy guards should not pose a significant challenge to you. And besides, the only real targets are the industrials carrying the ground troops. Destroy them and you can avoid fighting the other ships, unless you want to.

The main threat to your mission will be capsuleers supporting the Federation.
messages.zh:
我知道你会答应的。船队的护航舰对你来说都不是什么大问题。我们的首要目标还是那些运送地面部队的工业舰。消灭他们，至于其他的船你可以放着不管如果你愿意的话。

主要的威胁还是来自于那些联邦的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: The State is life. I cannot turn away when it needs me!
messages.zh: 合众国就是我的生命，我不会在他需要我的时候转身离去。

messages.en:
The Gallente Federation is building up its ground troops in a nearby contested system with plans to launch an attack on our fortified positions.

We've discovered a troop transport moving toward their command outpost. You need merely destroy the industrials and don't need to bother with the convoy guards.
messages.zh:
盖伦特正在附近一个争夺区域集合他们的地面部队，准备对我们的一个加强工事进行袭击。

我们发现了一个运兵船队正在向他们的指挥哨站前进。你只需要将船队中的工业舰都消灭掉就行了，别的船和那些护航船只你自己看着办。

messages.en: The troop transports have been destroyed. The State need not fear any longer!
messages.zh: 运兵船队已经被消灭了，合众国不需要再担心了。

messages.en: With their troops eliminated, we'll be able to reinforce our own positions. And maybe soon, we'll be able to push forward and overwhelm the Gallente positions as well! Just another step towards victory! Excellent work.
messages.zh: 一旦他们的部队被歼灭，我们就有空档加强自己的工事。或许很快，我们就能够向前推进对盖伦特的战线形成压倒性的优势！你干的很好，我们又向胜利迈进了一步！

messages.en: Anyone can take out a few transports! Why can't you give me something more substantial?
messages.zh: 任何人都可以搞掉几艘运输舰，你就不能给我点有意义的东西么？

messages.en: You would really turn down my offer? I'm not sure you know the severity of this mission.
messages.zh: 你真的要这么让我失望么？我不知道你是否知道这项任务的重要性。

messages.en:
In a nearby contested system, the Gallente Federation has long held illusions of claiming it entirely for themselves. Now, we've always been able to stop them, but lately they've started moving ground troops into their command outpost there.

We cannot attack the command outpost directly. It's too well guarded and our forces are kept occupied in other areas. However, if they manage to get enough ground troops there, they can launch an attack on our planetary holdings.

Our scanners have picked up a lightly guarded convoy filled with troops heading toward the command outpost. You can take them out, no sweat, right?
messages.zh:
在附近一个争夺中的星系，盖伦特长期自欺欺人地宣布其在当地主权。实际上我们一直都有能力阻止他们的行为只是假装视而不见，但是最近他们开始将地面部队运送到他们在那个区域的指挥哨站。

我们不能直接地攻击指挥哨站，那里的防守力量非常强大，况且我们的大部分兵力都已经派往了别的作战区域。无论如何，如果他们设法聚集了足够多得地面部队在那里，他们就可以对我们的星球进行登陆作战了。

我们的扫描器发现了一个护卫力量较少的船队，搭载了大量的士兵正在朝这个指挥哨站进发。你可以将它们毫不费力的摧毁掉，有问题么？

messages.en: Yipes! That didn't turn out as easy as I hoped. I'm going to have to quit.
messages.zh: 唉！事情不是像我设想的一样简单，我要退出。

messages.en: If our ground forces are forced into a confrontation, thousands of lives will be lost.
messages.zh: 如果我们的地面部队和他们发生正面冲突，成千上万的生命将会消失。

messages.en: It will be an honor to eliminate him.
messages.zh: 消灭他是我的荣誉。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it, pilot, and I'm sure the families of those lost will be, too. I'll be awaiting news of your victory.
messages.zh: 我很高兴听到这个，飞行员。我想那些失去亲人的家庭也会这样认为。我会在这里等待你的胜利凯旋。

messages.en: What happened?
messages.zh: 发生了什么事情?

messages.en:
A Caldari task force destroyed a civilian convoy fleeing the front lines. Included in the missing and presumed dead are the daughter of a prominent senator and her family, and the general staff is outraged by the attack. We must have revenge for this brutal massacre.

The sector commander responsible for ordering the attack is currently resupplying, leaving him temporarily vulnerable. We don't intend to let him get away. Fly to the base at the coordinates you've been given and make sure the sector commander does not survive. Any other targets are secondary, but don't hold back. Show these bastards the wrath of the righteous.
messages.zh:
加达里的部队摧毁了一支逃离前线的平民船队。一位有威望的参议员的女儿及其家人也在袭击中失踪，大家都认为她已经遭遇不幸。总参部对这次袭击非常的愤怒，我们必须要对这种残忍的兽行进行报复。

下令执行那次攻击的敌人区域指挥官所在舰队正在进行补给，这使得他们的防御暂时性的被削弱了。我们不能让他就这么逃脱责任。你到我给你的坐标点去，将这个区域指挥官干掉。其他的目标都是次要的，不要被他们拖住了。让这些混蛋得到正义的惩罚吧。

messages.en: That murderer won't be committing any more acts of butchery.
messages.zh: 那个凶手再也不能制造任何危害了。

messages.en: Excellent work, pilot. The families of the dead owe you a great debt.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。那些失去亲人的家庭都欠你一份人情。

messages.en: I don't know if I can handle this, sir. You better find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不确定我是否能够干得了。长官，你最好找找别人。

messages.en: I see. I'm disappointed, pilot, but I'm glad you told me now rather than later. I'll have to see if I can find someone more capable for a mission of this import.
messages.zh: 我明白了，我很失望，飞行员。但是我很高兴你能现在告诉我而不是等到太晚的时候。我会看看我能不能找到另外的能干这任务的飞行员。

messages.en:
I've just received word that a fleeing civilian convoy was destroyed by the Caldari, pilot. There were over two thousand fatalities before a Navy search-and-rescue force was able to reach the scene and recover the survivors.

In addition to the utter disregard for human life that this act displayed, evidently the daughter of a prominent senator and her family were on board one of the industrial ships with the convoy. They are still missing, but the Navy isn't hopeful that they will be found. We are outraged, and they want to show those terrorists that they can't get away with this kind of butchery.

I've been asked to find a pod pilot capable of taking out the sector commander who ordered this massacre. His battleship group is currently resupplying, and is temporarily vulnerable. It won't be easy; despite his cowardly choice of targets, he's quite capable and has a significant force at his disposal.
messages.zh:
我收到消息，一支逃离前线战火的平民船队被加达里人给摧毁了。在那儿有超过两千人在海军的搜救队抵达现场之前就死去了。

不说这件事情表现出敌人对人类生命的极端藐视，而且在这次事件中，一位有威望的参议员的女儿及其家人也在其中的一艘工业舰上，目前还没有能找到她生还的任何迹象，海军搜救队认为她生还的可能性已经非常渺茫。我们愤怒了，我们要让那些恐怖分子知道，他们不可能就这么从这件灭绝人性的事件中轻松走开。

我接到命令找一位有能力干掉敌人区域指挥官的克隆飞行员，这个指挥官就是下达那次对我平民进行袭击命令的人。他的战列舰舰队当前正在进行补给，造成了暂时的防御松懈。这不会是一件简单的事情，尽管他懦弱的选择了平民作为目标，但是他的舰队依然具有强大的实力。

name.ja: ネットワークを遮断せよ

messages.en: I'll get that intelligence. You can count on me.
messages.zh: 我去把那情报拿来。交给我了。

messages.en: I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Don't let me down.
messages.zh: 我期待你来向我汇报。别让我失望。

messages.en: Of course. I'm always ready to do my part for the war effort.
messages.zh: 当然。我时刻准备着。

messages.en:
Caldari forces have begun to deploy a cynosural field network in this sector.

In order to find the beacons comprising this network and destroy them, we need to get the records on where those beacons have been deployed. To find that, we need to get the tactical information sheet from the Caldari outpost not far from here. You'll need to fight your way to the outpost and grab the sheet. Bring it back to me as quickly as possible.
messages.zh:
加达里已经开始在此区域部署诱导力场网络了。

为了揪出组成这网络的信标并将它们摧毁，我们需要获取记录这些信标位置的信息。要找到这信息，我们需要从离这不远的一做加达里哨站里获取战术信息文档。你必须冲出一条血路去取那文档。然后尽快将它带回。

messages.en: I've managed to get the tactical information sheet you needed. I hope it helps.
messages.zh: 我成功获取了你要的战术信息。希望能派上用场。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. I'll get that to Naval Intelligence right away.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。我马上就把它转交给海军情报部门。

messages.en: I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 这事儿我懒得管。

messages.en: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will.
messages.zh: 如果你不干，那我就去找能干的他人。

messages.en:
One of the key advantages we've had so far in this sector is our extensive cynosural field network, which allows us to drop our capital ships in on the enemy almost at will. The enemy, meanwhile, is forced to leave their ships vulnerable during cynosural field generation.

Unfortunately, our advantage may be crumbling. Yesterday, a task force engaging a Caldari blockade suffered serious losses when three enemy carriers dropped on them. The disturbing part is that the cynosural field was activated by a beacon, not by a Caldari ship. That means the Caldari have put up a limited cynosural field network to compete with ours. No doubt they're expanding it as fast as they can.

The network needs to be destroyed, but we need to know where those beacons have been deployed so that we can get all of them when we do a sweep. In order to do this, we want you to penetrate the security at the Caldari outpost nearby and get the tactical information sheet there. Bring it back here, and we'll have Naval Intelligence find those beacons. Understood?
messages.zh:
我们在此地区的一项关键优势是我们拥有分布广泛的诱导力场网络，利用该网络我们可以随意向敌人派出旗舰。与此同时，在诱导力场生成期间，敌方的舰船会被迫处于脆弱状态。

不幸的是，我们的优势可能正在消失。昨天，与加达里封锁队交火的一支队伍在敌方派出三艘航母后遭到了严重打击。令人担心的是，他们的诱导力场是由信标产生的，而非加达里舰船。这意味着加达里人为了对抗我们，已经搭建了一个有限的诱导力场网络。他们现在肯定正在全力拓展这一网络。

我们一定要摧毁这网络，但我们必须先知道这些信标部署在哪些位置以便来次大扫荡。为了完成这点，我们要你潜入附近的一座加达里哨站，从里面偷运出他们的战术信息文档。把它带回来，我们会让海军情报部门去搜寻那些信标。明白了吗？

messages.en: I can't do this; it's way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我没法干；这事超我能力所及。你得去找别人。

messages.en: You're setting our entire war effort back weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out missions, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder in the future.
messages.zh: 飞行员，你让我们的战争努力倒退了数周。如果你不能执行任务，那你对我们来说就是个废物。我劝你将来要更卖力点。

messages.en: I'll make sure those troops never reach their destinations!
messages.zh: 我会让他们永远到达不了目的地！

messages.en:
I knew you would be up for it. The convoy guards should not pose a significant challenge to you. And besides, the only real targets are the industrials carrying the ground troops. Destroy them and you can avoid fighting the other ships, unless you want to.

The main threat to your mission will be capsuleers supporting the Federation.
messages.zh:
我知道你会答应的。船队的护航舰对你来说都不是什么大问题。我们的首要目标还是那些运送地面部队的工业舰。消灭他们，至于其他的船你可以放着不管如果你愿意的话。

主要的威胁还是来自于那些联邦的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: I shall do my best to serve the Federation's ideals.
messages.zh: 我会全身心的把自己投入到联邦的理想当中去。

messages.en:
The Caldari Federation is building up its ground troops in a nearby contested system with plans to launch an attack on our fortified positions.

We've discovered a troop transport moving toward their command outpost. You need merely destroy the industrials and don't need to bother with the convoy guards.
messages.zh:
加达里正在附近一个争夺区域集合他们的地面部队，准备对我们的一个加强工事进行袭击。

我们发现了一个运兵船队正在向他们的指挥哨站前进。你只需要将船队中的工业舰都消灭掉就行了，别的船和那些护航船只你自己看着办。

messages.en: The troop transports have been destroyed. The Federation need not fear any longer!
messages.zh: 运兵船队已经被消灭，联邦政府不需要再担心了。

messages.en: With their troops eliminated, we'll be able to reinforce our own positions. And maybe soon, we'll be able to push forward and overwhelm the Caldari positions as well! Just another step towards victory! Excellent work.
messages.zh: 一旦他们的部队被歼灭，我们就有空档加强自己的工事。或许很快，我们就能够向前推进对加达里的战线形成压倒性的优势！你干的很好，我们又向胜利迈进了一步！

messages.en: Anyone can take out a few transports! Why can't you give me something more substantial?
messages.zh: 任何人都可以搞掉几艘运输舰，你就不能给我点有意义的东西么？

messages.en: You would really turn down my offer? I'm not sure you know the severity of this mission.
messages.zh: 你真的要这么让我失望么？我不知道你是否知道这项任务的重要性。

messages.en:
In a nearby contested system, the Caldari Federation has long held illusions of claiming it entirely for themselves. Now, we've always been able to stop them, but lately they've started moving ground troops into their command outpost there.

We cannot attack the command outpost directly. It's too well guarded and our forces are kept occupied in other areas. However, if they manage to get enough ground troops there, they can launch an attack on our planetary holdings.

Our scanners have picked up a lightly guarded convoy filled with troops heading toward the command outpost. You can take them out, no sweat, right?
messages.zh:
在附近一个争夺中的星系，加达里长期自欺欺人地宣布其在当地主权。实际上我们一直都有能力阻止他们的行为只是假装视而不见，但是最近他们开始将地面部队运送到他们在那个区域的指挥哨站。

我们不能直接地攻击指挥哨站，那里的防守力量非常强大，况且我们的大部分兵力都已经派往了别的作战区域。无论如何，如果他们设法聚集了足够多得地面部队在那里，他们就可以对我们的星球进行登陆作战了。

我们的扫描器发现了一个护卫力量较少的船队，搭载了大量的士兵正在朝这个指挥哨站进发。你可以将它们毫不费力的摧毁掉，有问题么？

messages.en: Yipes! That didn't turn out as easy as I hoped. I'm going to have to quit.
messages.zh: 唉！事情不是像我设想的一样简单，我要退出。

messages.en: our ground forces are forced into a confrontation, thousands of lives will be lost.
messages.zh: 我们的地面部队不得已要和敌人交战，数以千计的生命将消失。

name.ja: 最も激しいロイドレイジ

messages.en: Miners in a combat zone? Don't they know what could happen to them? They should see it coming!
messages.zh: 战场里的矿工？他们不知道会遇到什么危险么？

messages.en: Perfect. The miners should be coming in and out of the belt. We doubt they'll be heavily defended, so you shouldn't have any problem destroying them. Capsuleers who foolishly cast their lot in with the State may be patrolling the area.
messages.zh: 真是完美。这些矿工在这个矿带进进出出，可能并没有太强大的防守力量，对于你来说应该不是个问题。你要当心合众国的克隆飞行员可能在附近出没。

messages.en: Ready as I'll ever be.
messages.zh: 我时刻都准备着的。

messages.en: It looks like the State likes to send its citizens into dangerous territory to mine. Well, their stupidity is to our benefit. All you have to do is head over there and blow up the mining vessels, then report back to us. The miners and any escort they have should pose no problem to you. However, capsuleers loyal to the State are in the area; they might prove difficult.
messages.zh: 合众国好像很热衷于把自己的国民送到危险的地方去开矿。好吧，他们的这种愚蠢行为对于我们来说是件好事。你要做的只是前去这个地点把他们的采矿船都摧毁掉，然后回来向我报告。这些采矿船和那些可能的护卫队可能都不是问题，但是你要当心在这个空域活动的合众国克隆飞行员；他们可能相当难对付。

messages.en: Those mining vessels made a very pleasing explosion.
messages.zh: 这些采矿船爆炸的景象真是太精彩了。

messages.en: I can just imagine those miners cursing the commander who sent them into hostile territory for some ore. Just before you sent them to a fiery demise, of course.
messages.zh: 我可以想象在你把他们送上黄泉路之前，这些矿工肯定在诅咒那个把他们送到敌对区域采矿的指挥官。

messages.en: Don't you have anything different for me to do?
messages.zh: 你还没有其他的什么是情能给我做的。

messages.en: Are you worried it will be too difficult?
messages.zh: 你担心这会很难么？

messages.en:
Good news, follower! We've just discovered the State doing something incredibly foolish! It turns out they've been sending miners into a contested system for ore. The impudence! Did they think they could do this with impunity!? I hope they're ready to pay for their folly.

I want you to be the one to make them pay. Our normal forces are occupied with other objectives. I'd like you to head over there and take out those miners. It will deny the Caldari a large amount of precious mineral resources. What do you say?
messages.zh:
好消息，我们发现加达里现在正在做一些非常愚蠢的事情！他们现在正在往一个处于争夺状态区域的小行星带派遣采矿船。真是厚颜无耻的人啊！他们以为自己就能够这么平平安安的混过去？！希望他们准备好了为自己的愚蠢行为付出代价。

你现在就过去让他们痛苦一下。我们的正规军最近正忙于对付其他很多事情，我想要你过去把那些采矿船都干掉。这将让加达里损失大量的贵重矿物资源。你说怎样？

messages.en: I can't complete your mission.
messages.zh: 我不能完成你的任务。

messages.en: You really couldn't handle it? I guess you aren't as capable as they say.
messages.zh: 你真的不能对付这事儿？我想你并不是像别人说的那样有能耐。

name.ja: 最も激しいロイドレイジ

messages.zh: 战场里的矿工？人怎么能愚蠢到这个程度？

All you have to do is head over there and blow up the mining vessels, then report back to us. The miners and any escort they have should pose no problem to you. messages.zh: 你还没有其他的什么是情能给我做的。
