不幸的是，我们的优势可能正在消失。昨天，与艾玛封锁队交火的一支队伍在敌方派出三艘航母后遭到了严重打击。令人担心的是，他们的诱导力场是由信标产生的，而非艾玛舰船。这意味着艾玛人为了对抗我们，已经搭建了一个有限的诱导力场网络。他们现在肯定正在全力拓展这一网络。

我们一定要摧毁这网络，但我们必须先知道这些信标部署在哪些位置以便来次大扫荡。为了完成这点，我们要你潜入附近的一座艾玛哨站，从里面偷运出他们的战术信息文档。把它带回来，我们会让共和国情报部门去搜寻那些信标。明白了吗？

messages.en: I can't do this; it's way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我没法干；这事超我能力所及。你得去找别人。

messages.en: You're setting our entire war effort back weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out missions, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder in the future.
messages.zh: 飞行员，你让我们的战争努力倒退了数周。如果你不能执行任务，那你对我们来说就是个废物。我劝你将来要更卖力点。

name.ru: Мертвые не болтают (Dead Men Tell No Tales)

messages.en: Executing that traitor will be my honor. Don't worry, I'll make sure he's taken care of.
messages.zh: 把那叛贼处决掉将是我的荣幸。别担心，我保证他会得到应有处置的。

messages.en: Good. Don't take any chances; that relay is our top priority. Everything else is a secondary target.
messages.zh: 很好。别鲁莽冒险；那中继站是我们的首要目标，其他都是次要目标。

messages.en: Disturbing news?
messages.zh: 令人忧心的消息？

messages.en: Your mission will be to slip past enemy lines and destroy the Gallente tactical relay and the spy on board. With him out of the way, our intelligence network in this sector should remain secure and the war effort will not be seriously threatened by his capture. Haste is of utmost importance, so don't waste any time.
messages.zh: 你的任务就是潜入敌人后防线，摧毁那盖伦特战术中继站及里面的那位间谍。把他解决之后，我们在地区的情报网就能安然无恙，我们的战争形势也不会受到太多负面影响。现在最需要的就是速度，切莫再迟疑。

messages.en: The tactical relay has been eliminated.
messages.zh: 我已经把中继站连根拔起了。

messages.en: Superb work, pilot. I'll make sure your name gets mentioned up the chain.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，飞行员。我会在上级面前美言你几句的。

messages.en: Look, I don't feel like cleaning up someone else's mess here. Find someone else to do your dirty work.
messages.zh: 听好，我不喜欢替别人擦屁股。找别人去干这些低档活儿吧。

messages.en: We're all in this war together, pilot, or we're all in deep trouble. You need to realize that sooner rather than later.
messages.zh: 我们是在同一条船上的，飞行员，要不大家都没好日子过。你最好尽快明白这点。

messages.en:
Intelligence has been using an agent on a Gallente tactical relay to eavesdrop on their communications in this sector. A few days ago we lost contact with him and all reports ceased, leaving us with a giant blind spot. We assumed that our agent had been discovered and eliminated.

It seems that the problem is even worse than we feared. Intelligence intercepted a communiqué indicating that our agent was not just caught, but turned-- he's ready to tell the enemy everything he knows about our operations in this area. This must not happen.

Fortunately, at the moment he's still being held on the tactical relay, putting him within our striking distance. We need you to slip past enemy lines and destroy that relay before it's too late.
messages.zh:
情报部门在一个盖伦特战术中继站里安插了一位特工，他的任务是窃听盖伦特人在这个地区的通信。几天前我们与他失去了联系，再也没有收到任何报告，我们现在面临一个巨大的消息真空。我们一开始以为这家伙被敌人发现然后被除掉了。

但问题好像比我们想象的还要严重。根据情报部门截取的一条信息，我们的特工不仅被抓，还发生了变节——他打算向敌人吐露一切他所了解的我们在此地区的行动情况。我们决不允许有这样的事情发生。

所幸他目前还被关押在战术中继站内，尚处于我们的打击范围。我们要你潜入敌人后防线，赶在一切都变得来不及之前摧毁那中继站。

messages.en: I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. Find someone else.
messages.zh: 我没法能进入到对那座中继塔有效的攻击范围内。你找别人吧。

messages.en: You have hurt us deeply here, pilot; I hope you realize that.
messages.zh: 你让我们遭受了惨痛损失，飞行员；我希望你能明白这点。

messages.en: It will be an honor to eliminate him.
messages.zh: 消灭他是我的荣誉。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it, pilot, and I'm sure the families of those lost will be, too. I'll be awaiting news of your victory.
messages.zh: 我很高兴听到这个，飞行员。我想那些失去亲人的家庭也会这样认为。我会在这里等待你的胜利凯旋。

messages.en: What happened?
messages.zh: 发生了什么事情?

messages.en:
A Gallente task force destroyed a civilian convoy fleeing the front lines. Included in the missing and presumed dead are the daughter of a prominent Corporate executive and her family, and the general staff is outraged by the attack. We must have revenge for this brutal massacre.

The sector commander responsible for ordering the attack is currently resupplying, leaving him temporarily vulnerable. We don't intend to let him get away. Fly to the base at the coordinates you've been given and make sure the sector commander does not survive. Any other targets are secondary, but don't hold back. Show these bastards the wrath of the righteous.
messages.zh:
盖伦特的部队摧毁了一支逃离前线的平民船队。一位有威望的军团执行官的女儿及其家人也在袭击中失踪，大家都认为她已经遭遇不幸。总参部对这次袭击非常的愤怒，我们必须要对这种残忍的兽行进行报复。

下令执行那次攻击的敌人区域指挥官所在舰队正在进行补给，这使得他们的防御暂时性的被削弱了。我们不能让他就这么逃脱责任。你到我给你的坐标点去，将这个区域指挥官干掉。其他的目标都是次要的，不要被他们拖住了。让这些混蛋得到正义的惩罚吧。

messages.en: That murderer won't be committing any more acts of butchery.
messages.zh: 那个凶手再也不能制造任何危害了。

messages.en: Excellent work, pilot. The families of the dead owe you a great debt.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。那些失去亲人的家庭都欠你一份人情。

messages.en: I don't know if I can handle this, sir. You better find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不确定我是否能够干得了。长官，你最好找找别人。

messages.en: I see. I'm disappointed, pilot, but I'm glad you told me now rather than later. I'll have to see if I can find someone more capable for a mission of this import.
messages.zh: 我明白了，我很失望，飞行员。但是我很高兴你能现在告诉我而不是等到太晚的时候。我会看看我能不能找到另外的能干这任务的飞行员。

messages.en:
I've just received word that a fleeing civilian convoy was destroyed by the Gallente, pilot. There were over two thousand fatalities before a Navy search-and-rescue force was able to reach the scene and recover the survivors.

In addition to the utter disregard for human life that this act displayed, evidently the daughter of a prominent Corporate executive and her family were on board one of the industrial ships with the convoy. They are still missing, but the Navy isn't hopeful that they will be found. We are outraged, and they want to show those terrorists that they can't get away with this kind of butchery.

I've been asked to find a pod pilot capable of taking out the sector commander who ordered this massacre. His battleship group is currently resupplying, and is temporarily vulnerable. It won't be easy; despite his cowardly choice of targets, he's quite capable and has a significant force at his disposal.
messages.zh:
我收到消息，一支逃离前线战火的平民船队被盖伦特人给摧毁了。在那儿有超过两千人在海军的搜救队抵达现场之前就死去了。

不说这件事情表现出敌人对人类生命的极端藐视，而且在这次事件中，一位有威望的军团执行官的女儿及其家人也在其中的一艘工业舰上，目前还没有能找到她生还的任何迹象，海军搜救队认为她生还的可能性已经非常渺茫。我们愤怒了，我们要让那些恐怖分子知道，他们不可能就这么从这件灭绝人性的事件中轻松走开。

我接到命令找一位有能力干掉敌人区域指挥官的克隆飞行员，这个指挥官就是下达那次对我平民进行袭击命令的人。他的战列舰舰队当前正在进行补给，造成了暂时的防御松懈。这不会是一件简单的事情，尽管他懦弱的选择了平民作为目标，但是他的舰队依然具有强大的实力。

messages.en: I'll make sure those troops never reach their destinations!
messages.zh: 我会让他们永远到达不了目的地！

messages.en:
I knew you would be up for it. The convoy guards should not pose a significant challenge to you. And besides, the only real targets are the industrials carrying the ground troops. Destroy them and you can avoid fighting the other ships, unless you want to.

The main threat to your mission will be capsuleers supporting the Empire.
messages.zh:
我知道你会答应的。船队的护航舰对你来说都不是什么大问题。我们的首要目标还是那些运送地面部队的工业舰。消灭他们，至于其他的船你可以放着不管如果你愿意的话。

主要的威胁还是来自于那些帝国的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: I shall do my best to live up to their expectations. What do you have for me?
messages.zh: 我会尽力让达到他们的要求的。你有什么任务交给我么？

messages.en:
The Amarr Empire is building up its ground troops in a nearby contested system with plans to launch an attack on our fortified positions.

We've discovered a troop transport moving toward their command outpost. You need merely destroy the industrials and don't need to bother with the convoy guards.
messages.zh:
艾玛帝国正在附近一个争夺区域集合他们的地面部队，准备对我们的一个加强工事进行袭击。

我们发现了一个运兵船队正在向他们的指挥哨站前进。你只需要将船队中的工业舰都消灭掉就行了，别的船和那些护航船只你自己看着办。

messages.en: The troop transports have been destroyed. The Republic need not fear any longer!
messages.zh: 运兵船队已经被消灭了。共和国不需要再为此担忧！

messages.en: With their troops eliminated, we'll be able to reinforce our own positions. And maybe soon, we'll be able to push forward and overwhelm the Amarr positions as well! Just another step towards victory! Excellent work.
messages.zh: 一旦他们的部队被歼灭，我们就有空档加强自己的工事。或许很快，我们就能够向前推进对艾玛的战线形成压倒性的优势！你干的很好，我们又向胜利迈进了一步！

messages.en: Anyone can take out a few transports! Why can't you give me something more substantial?
messages.zh: 任何人都可以搞掉几艘运输舰，你就不能给我点有意义的东西么？

messages.en: You would really turn down my offer? I'm not sure you know the severity of this mission.
messages.zh: 你真的要这么让我失望么？我不知道你是否知道这项任务的重要性。

messages.en:
In a nearby contested system, the Amarr Empire has long held illusions of claiming it entirely for themselves. Now, we've always been able to stop them, but lately they've started moving ground troops into their command outpost there.

We cannot attack the command outpost directly. It's too well guarded and our forces are kept occupied in other areas. However, if they manage to get enough ground troops there, they can launch an attack on our planetary holdings.

Our scanners have picked up a lightly guarded convoy filled with troops heading toward the command outpost. You can take them out, no sweat, right?
messages.zh:
在附近一个争夺中的星系，艾玛帝国长期自欺欺人地宣布其在当地主权。实际上我们一直都有能力阻止他们的行为只是假装视而不见，但是最近他们开始将地面部队运送到他们在那个区域的指挥哨站。

我们不能直接地攻击指挥哨站，那里的防守力量非常强大，况且我们的大部分兵力都已经派往了别的作战区域。无论如何，如果他们设法聚集了足够多得地面部队在那里，他们就可以对我们的星球进行登陆作战了。

我们的扫描器发现了一个护卫力量较少的船队，搭载了大量的士兵正在朝这个指挥哨站进发。你可以将它们毫不费力的摧毁掉，有问题么？

messages.en: Yipes! That didn't turn out as easy as I hoped. I'm going to have to quit.
messages.zh: 唉！事情不是像我设想的一样简单，我要退出。

messages.en: If our ground forces are forced into a confrontation, thousands of lives will be lost.
messages.zh: 如果我们的地面部队和他们发生正面冲突，成千上万的生命将会消失。

messages.en: I'll get out there right away!
messages.zh: 我会立即离开那儿。

messages.en: I'm expecting good things of you. The repair ships are only lightly guarded, with most of the enemy forces waiting to invade. However, capsuleers aligned with the Federation may be waiting to attack. You should watch out!
messages.zh: 我很看好你。那些维修船的防卫力量很薄弱，敌人的大部分兵力都去准备侵入作战了。但是，联邦的克隆飞行员可能在附近徘徊等待上门的猎物。

messages.en: I'll do what I can.
messages.zh: 我会尽力而为的。

messages.en: The Gallente Federation is trying to open up an old smuggler's gate belonging to the Angel Cartel. If they can get it open, they will be able to bring in overwhelming forces before we can respond. Head out there and destroy the repair ships. Just make sure you're ready for a real fight. Capsuleers loyal to the Federation are out and about and may try to stop you.
messages.zh: 盖伦特正尝试开启一座老旧的天使集团非法贩售星门通道。如果他们能成功激活这个星门，他们就能在我们无法反应的时间内把大量的兵力投放到我们的眼皮子底下。你得要做好准备迎接一场恶斗。联邦的克隆飞行员可能在附近徘徊等待上门的猎物。

messages.en: I've wiped the repair crew out to a man. The invasion has been stopped, for now.
messages.zh: 我把维修队已经铲除了。入侵行为已经被组织，至少是目前来说。

messages.en: You've really saved our butts today. If the Federation got that gate working, we'd be faced with a large invasion force behind our front lines. That could have been catastrophic. I suppose we'll have to be more diligent in the future with those sort of things.
messages.zh: 今天你真是救了我们一命。如果盖伦特能让那座星门恢复运转，我们就要在自己的战线后方面对一次大规模的进攻。我想我们以后还是要多多注意这样的事情。

messages.en: You're putting a lot on my shoulders here...
messages.zh: 你已经给我了很多重担了。

messages.en: Your hesitation is disheartening. I shall find someone made of sterner stuff.
messages.zh: 你的犹豫不决让人沮丧。我应该找个更加有毅力的人。

messages.en:
I've just received some very disturbing intelligence from my operatives inside the Gallente Federation. It seems that the Minmatar Republic has turned over an old Angel gate that leads into a nearby contested system of ours. We never tore it down, since the Cartel doesn't bother us too often.

Unfortunately, it looks like that has come back to bite us. The Gallente are planning on using the gate to launch an attack into our space. Luckily, the gate is set to only accept ships broadcasting a specific Cartel transponder code. The Gallente have to reset both ends before they can utilize the gate.

Their repair team is at the gate now, doing the maintenance required to switch the codes. We need you to get over there and stop them immediately!
messages.zh:
我刚刚收到一份紧急的情报，来自于我们的一个在盖伦特联邦内部的人员。情报显示，米玛塔尔最近移交了一座通往附近争夺区域的老旧天使集团星门。

看来这个古董又会给我们带来麻烦了。盖伦特正准备用这个星门向我们的领空发动攻击。幸运的是，这座星门似乎需要发送一系列的天使通行代码才能够被激活。加达里只好把心门的两端都进行了重置以为自用。

他们的维修团队现在正在那个星门那儿，准备把星门的预设通行代码强行取消。我们需要你过去阻止他们的维修行动。

messages.en: I don't know how to say this, but I've been beaten. You'll need to find someone else to complete things.
messages.zh: 我不知道该怎么说，但是我被揍惨了。你找其他人去做这事儿吧。

messages.en: Don't you realize how important this mission is? Now what will we do?
messages.zh: 你没有意识到这是多么重要的一个任务么？先在我们该怎么办？

name.ja: 最も激しいロイドレイジ

messages.en: Miners in a combat zone? They should see what I'm going to do to them coming!
messages.zh: 战场里的矿工？他们应该知道我迟早会找上门的！

messages.en: Perfect. The miners should be coming in and out of the belt. We doubt they'll be heavily defended, so you shouldn't have any problem destroying them. Capsuleers who foolishly cast their lot in with the Empire may be patrolling the area.
messages.zh: 真是完美。这些矿工在这个矿带进进出出，可能并没有太强大的防守力量，对于你来说应该不是个问题。你要当心帝国的那些愚蠢克隆飞行员可能在附近出没。

messages.en: The Empire has made a mistake. A really dumb one: They've sent miners out into hostile territory for ore. What's their stupidity is to our benefit. Just head over there and blow up the mining vessels, then report back to us. The miners and any escort they have should pose no problem to you. However, some Amarrian capsuleers have been spotted in the area, so be ready for a firefight.
messages.zh: 帝国犯了个错误，一个愚蠢的错误：他们把矿船派到敌对区域去采集矿石。你直接过去把他们的矿船都给打个稀巴烂，然后回来向我报告。这些矿工和那些可能存在的护航船对你来说并不算是什么威胁。但是，有些艾玛帝国所属的克隆飞行员可能也在这个区域活动，你得要小心他们。

messages.en: Those mining vessels made a very pleasing explosion.
messages.zh: 这些采矿船爆炸的景象真是太精彩了。

messages.en: I can just imagine those miners cursing the commander who sent them into hostile territory for some ore. Well, before you sent them to a fiery demise, of course.
messages.zh: 我可以想象在你把他们送上黄泉路之前，这些矿工肯定在诅咒那个把他们送到敌对区域采矿的指挥官。

messages.en: Don't you have anything different for me to do?
messages.zh: 你还没有其他的什么是情能给我做的。

messages.en: Are you worried it will be too difficult?
messages.zh: 你担心这会很难么？

messages.en:
Good news, follower! We've just discovered the Empire doing something incredibly foolish! It turns out they've been sending in miners to a contested system near their sovereign space. I hope they're ready to pay for their folly.

I want you to be the one to make them pay. Our normal forces are occupied with other objectives: I'd like you to head over there and take out those miners. Not only will it deny Amarr a large amount of precious mineral resources, it will also sting their sickening pride. What do you say?
messages.zh:
好消息，我们发现艾玛帝国现在正在做一些非常愚蠢的事情！他们现在正在往一个处于争夺状态区域的小行星带派遣采矿船。真是厚颜无耻的人啊！他们以为自己就能够这么平平安安的混过去？！希望他们准备好了为自己的愚蠢行为付出代价。

你现在就过去让他们痛苦一下。我们的正规军最近正忙于对付其他很多事情，我想要你过去把那些采矿船都干掉。这将让艾玛损失大量的贵重矿物资源。你说怎样？

messages.en: I can't complete your mission.
messages.zh: 我不能完成你的任务。

messages.en: You really couldn't handle it? I guess you aren't as capable as they say.
messages.zh: 你真的不能对付这事儿？我想你并不是像别人说的那样有能耐。

messages.en: Sounds like my kind of work. Send me the location and I'll head out there.
messages.zh: 听起来就像是给我准备的。把坐标传送给我，我马上就出发。

messages.en: Excellent, I will be awaiting news of your success.
messages.zh: 很好，我就等着你成功的消息了。

messages.en: That's what I'm here for, throw me one.
messages.zh: 这是我来这儿的目的，只管说就行了。

messages.en: We've recently had to deal with some rather resilient Federation forces in a nearby contested sector. It seemed like every hard-earned victory counted for nothing; they would simply retreat, regroup and repair. We knew they had to have a Starbase somewhere to do this as effectively as they were. That Starbase has now been found. You simply need to destroy the Main Reactor powering the shields. From there we can send in a team to clear the rest out.
messages.zh: 我们最同一只行动低调的盖伦特部队在附近的争夺区域进行了交锋。看起来我们每次费劲力气才取得胜利都完全没有对敌人造成任何效果，他们每次都直接的撤退，重新整编，补给维修后再次进犯我们的战线。我们知道他们在附近有一个空间站在有效地为他们提供这些关键的后勤支援。你所要做的就是把他们的主反应堆击毁，这将是他们的护盾失效，这样我们就可以派遣打击部队进去清剿残敌。

messages.en: I've destroyed the reactor; you can send our people in now.
messages.zh: 我消灭了那座反应堆；你的人可以进去了。

messages.en: I knew I could rely on you. Excellent work, I'll give the order to mobilize immediately. Here is your pay, take it with my gratitude.
messages.zh: 我知道你是靠得住的。干的漂亮，我马上就给机动部队下达攻击命令。这是你的报酬，我很感激你。

messages.en: I'm not going up against a Starbase, even with a plan like this. You best find someone else more willing to lose their ship and crew.
messages.zh: 我不想去攻击一座空间站，即便你已经这样精心策划了。你最好找那些愿意船毁人亡的疯子去做。

messages.en: Unusual for you to behave like such a coward, I hope you're not starting to lose your nerve? Very well, I'll find someone else but…sort yourself out, please.
messages.zh: 你像这样的懦弱我还是头一次见着，我想你不要失去你的自我了。好吧，我会找其他人来完成这个任务，但请你一定要恢复好自己。

messages.en: The advent of the Starbase has seen vast changes in the nature of entrenched, long-term warfare. The tactics of battlefield logistics had to be almost entirely reinvented when forces suddenly had the capability to restock and reship inside hostile space. This process is ongoing even today, as empires discover new ways to utilize the potent abilities afforded by these structures.
messages.zh: 空间站和星站的出现大大改变了改变了持久战和大型战场中前线的布防策略。战地后勤的策略因为舰船可以及时在前方的到完全的补给协助而发生了巨大的转变。这种变化每天都在发生，各个国家随时都在研究新的方式来使这些空间建筑发挥最大的效用。

messages.en: The rise of the Starbase
messages.zh: 星站的崛起

messages.en:
Excellent. I'll give you our top priority assignment since I know how reliable you are.

We've recently had to deal with some rather resilient Federation forces in a nearby contested sector. It seemed like every hard-earned victory counted for nothing; they would simply retreat, regroup and repair. We knew they had to have a Starbase somewhere to do this as effectively as they were. That Starbase has now been found.

I can see the look in your eyes, don't worry, we have a plan to take it down that won't involve fielding Capital vessels. You simply need to destroy the Main Reactor powering the shields. From there we can send in a team to clear the rest out.

This mission isn't without risk; you are assaulting a Starbase after all. Expect some resistance and prepare yourself accordingly. Are you up to the task?
messages.zh:
很好，我会把我们最高优先等级的任务交给你去做，因为我知道你是靠得住的人。

我们最同一只行动低调的盖伦特部队在附近的争夺区域进行了交锋。看起来我们每次费劲力气才取得胜利都完全没有对敌人造成任何效果，他们每次都直接的撤退，重新整编，补给维修后再次进犯我们的战线。我们知道他们在附近有一个空间站在有效地为他们提供这些关键的后勤支援，现在我们终于找到了这座空间站的所在地。

我可以从你的眼神中看到些担心，其实不用，我们已经计划好了，不用旗舰的帮助就能够将其摧毁。你所要做的就是把他们的主反应堆击毁，这将是他们的护盾失效，这样我们就可以派遣打击部队进去清剿残敌。

这不会是一场轻松的战斗，毕竟你是在攻击一座空间站。准备好对付敌人的顽抗。你愿意接受这个任务么？

messages.en: I apologize, but I won't be able to complete this mission after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.
messages.zh: 我很抱歉，但是我终究还是没法完成这个任务。希望你能即时的找到替补我的人。

messages.en: You have a reputation for reliability, pilot. Don't let me see you undo all the hard work that earned it. I will find someone else, but I'm not impressed. This better be the last time you fail me.
messages.zh: 可靠是你的本钱，飞行员。不要让我看见你就这么把你之前所积累起来的名声就这么毁了。我会找其他人来完成任务，但是我不会太相信他们。这最好是你最后一次让我失望。

messages.en: This sounds important! I'll get out there right away!
messages.zh: 这听起来很重要！我现在就出发！

messages.en: I'm expecting good things of you. The repair ships are only lightly guarded, with most of the enemy forces waiting to invade. However, capsuleers aligned with the Empire may be waiting to attack. You should watch out!
messages.zh: 我很看好你。那些维修船的防卫力量很薄弱，敌人的大部分兵力都去准备侵入作战了。但是，帝国的克隆飞行员可能在附近徘徊等待上门的猎物。

messages.en: I'll do what I can.
messages.zh: 我会尽力而为的。

messages.en: The Amarr Empire is trying to open up an old Guristas gate. If they can get it open, they will have free access to our space and be able to bring in overwhelming forces before we can respond. Head out there and destroy the repair ships. Just make sure you're ready for a real fight. Capsuleers loyal to the Empire are out and about and may try to stop you.
messages.zh: 艾玛正尝试开启一座老旧的古斯塔斯星门。如果他们能成功激活这个星门，他们就能在我们无法反应的时间内把大量的兵力投放到我们的眼皮子底下。你得要做好准备迎接一场恶斗。帝国的克隆飞行员可能在附近徘徊等待上门的猎物。

messages.en: I've wiped the repair crew out to a man. The invasion has been stopped, for now.
messages.zh: 我把维修队已经铲除了。入侵行为已经被组织，至少是目前来说。

messages.en: You've really saved our butts today. If the Empire got that gate working, we'd be faced with a large invasion force behind our front lines. I suppose we'll have to be more diligent in the future with those sort of things.
messages.zh: 今天你真是救了我们一命。如果帝国能让那座星门恢复运转，我们就要在自己的战线后方面对一次大规模的进攻。我想我们以后还是要多多注意这样的事情。

messages.en: You're putting a lot on my shoulders here...
messages.zh: 你已经给我了很多重担了。

messages.en: Your hesitation is disheartening. I shall find someone made of sterner stuff.
messages.zh: 你的犹豫不决让人沮丧。我应该找个更加有毅力的人。

messages.en:
I've just received some very disturbing intelligence from my operatives inside the Amarr Empire. It seems that the Caldari State has turned over an old Guristas gate that leads into a nearby contested system. We never tore it down since the Guristas don't bother us too often.

Unfortunately, it looks like that has come back to bite us. The Amarr are planning on using the gate to launch an attack into our space. The gate is set to only accept ships broadcasting a specific Guristas transponder code. The Amarr have to reset both ends before they can utilize the gate.

Their repair team is at the gate now, doing the maintenance required to switch the codes. We need you to get over there and stop them immediately!
messages.zh:
我刚刚收到一份紧急的情报，来自于我们的一个在艾玛帝国内部的人员。情报显示，加达里最近移交了一座通往附近争夺区域的老旧古斯塔斯星门。

看来这个古董又会给我们带来麻烦了。艾玛正准备用这个星门向我们的领空发动攻击。幸运的是，这座星门似乎需要发送一系列的古斯塔斯通行代码才能够被激活。艾玛只好把心门的两端都进行了重置以为自用。

他们的维修团队现在正在那个星门那儿，准备把星门的预设通行代码强行取消。我们需要你过去阻止他们的维修行动。

messages.en: I don't know how to say this, but I've been beaten. You'll need to find someone else to complete things.
messages.zh: 我不知道该怎么说，但是我被揍惨了。你找其他人去做这事儿吧。

messages.en: Don't you realize how important this mission is? Now what will we do?
messages.zh: 你没有意识到这是多么重要的一个任务么？先在我们该怎么办？

messages.en: Understood. I'll make sure she's made an example of.
messages.zh: 明白了。我会让她成为这样的一个典型得。

messages.en: I knew I could rely on you. I'll be eagerly awaiting news of your success.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住。我就等着你的好消息啦！

messages.en: Of course. How can I serve?
messages.zh: 当然，我能为你做什么。

messages.en:
A few weeks ago we dispatched a small squadron of Amarrian vessels that had made it inside our borders to a contested sector. We thought the job was finished and the area secure but it seems we've been duped. The entire regiment we cleared was just a decoy, and they've been massing hostiles in a nearby location.

Various sources of ours have pointed towards one of their Field Commanders being the key strategist behind these latest maneuvers. We need her assassinated.
messages.zh:
在几周前，我们驱逐了一支艾玛飞行中队,他们闯入了我们的领地中的一块争夺区域。本以为事情就这么了结了，但看起来我们好像被忽悠了。我们消灭的那整个编队似乎只是诱饵，他们正在附近的一个地方集结部队。

多方面的信息表示，他们的一个前线指挥官是这件事情背后的黑手，我们得要把她干掉。

messages.en: The Field Commander and her guards are dead.
messages.zh: 前线指挥官和她的守卫们都死了。

messages.en: Excellent work, pilot. That should leave it clear to aspiring commanders just what exactly their promotion brings.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。这样我们也为那些有抱负的指挥官们扫清了前进的道路，正如他们的升职系统所提供的那样。

messages.en: I'm not here to clean up the mistakes of others, find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不是来这儿为别人的丑事儿擦屁股的，你去找别人吧。

messages.en: A disappointing remark, especially coming from one such as you. A million brave deeds in good times cannot compare to a single act made when everything has begun to fall apart.
messages.zh: 真是让人失望，特别是想你这样的人。平时做一万件好事也比不上在关键时候做一件。

messages.en:
The added responsibility and higher profile that comes with promotion is never without a great amount of personal risk. This is true across all the navies of the empires. Enemy Field Commanders are one of the most common targets of assassinations, and though the high honor of attaining such a rank is something countless people work towards, many do not hold the position for very long.

This is particularly true of the most brilliant commanders, who are often the first to be targeted for removal. With loyal capsuleers at their disposal, the empires are only too happy to pay large sums to have the most promising enemy commanders ruthlessly culled.
messages.zh:
晋升所带的责任的增加会使得个人的风险更大。这是在所有的帝国的海军中都能适用的一个原则。敌人的前线指挥官一直都是突袭行动中最常见的目标，尽管有成千上万的人都在为着这样一个目标努力，但是很少有人能在这个位置上坐得长久。

这条规则特别适用于那些出色的指挥官，他们常常都会最先成为突袭的目标。有了忠诚的克隆飞行员的帮助，这些帝国更加愿意花大笔大笔的钱来将这些敌方指挥官置于死地。

messages.en: The risk of brilliance.
messages.zh: 智慧的危险

messages.en:
We have a serious situation on our hands, pilot.

A few weeks ago we dispatched a small squadron of Amarrian vessels that had made it inside our borders to a contested sector. We thought the job was finished and the area secure but it seems we've been duped. The entire regiment we cleared was just a decoy, and they've been massing hostiles in a nearby location with the use of covert technology.

The situation is not only embarrassing; it's undoubtedly boosted their own morale to have deceived us so effectively. We relocated all of our forces from there only days ago and re-establishing a presence will be admitting to our own people that those Imperial scum outsmarted us…or one of them in particular, actually.

Various sources of ours have pointed towards one of their Field Commanders being the key strategist behind these latest maneuvers. We need her assassinated, pilot. Not only will her death impede their progress, but it should send a message to other commanders inside the Empire. Fly out there and make it clear to them: we have capsuleers ready and able to strike down their best and brightest. Let that be the first thought in their mind before they step up to lead fleets against our people.
messages.zh:
我们有些棘手的情况。

在几周前，我们驱逐了一支艾玛飞行中队,他们闯入了我们的领地中的一块争夺区域。本以为事情就这么了结了，但看起来我们好像被忽悠了。我们消灭的那整个编队似乎只是诱饵，他们正在隐形装置的掩护下于附近的一个地方集结部队。

目前的情况不光光是尴尬的问题，成功愚弄我们将使得他们的士气大大的增加。几天前我们重新布置了在那儿的部队，重新建立我们在那儿的控制能力将会是在我们自己人面前承认这些帝国的垃圾比我们聪明……至少是其中有人比我们聪明。

多方面的信息表示，他们的一个前线指挥官是这件事情背后的黑手，我们得要把她暗中消灭掉。她的死不光会阻碍他们的进程，也能够给他们内部送去一个警告。你飞过去，把事情搞得干净利索，告诉他们：我们有足够的飞行员时刻的准备着把他们从天上搞下来。让他们以后出来和我们作对的时候随时把这点击在脑子里。

messages.en: She's too well defended I'm afraid. I can't get to her.
messages.zh: 她的防守相当严密，我无法靠近她。

messages.en: I trusted you and only you with this, what am I supposed to do now? Now they know we sent some of our best and failed, you've only emboldened them further! It seems I'll have to seriously reassess your worth to us.
messages.zh: 在这件事儿上，我相信你，而且只相信你一个人，我现在该怎么做？他们知道我们已经把最好的战士派去了，而且也输掉了，你让他们变得更加大胆！看来，我的重新对你的价值进行评估。

messages.en: Sure, sounds easy enough. I'll head out immediately.
messages.zh: 很好，应该很简单，我这就去办。

messages.en: Good, I'm relaying the coordinates now. Be on standby once you get there, I may still have some targets of opportunity for you.
messages.zh: 很好，我正在上传坐标。一旦你到达那儿就应该准备好，我应该还有一些目标要交给你。

messages.en: That's why I'm talking to you. Did you have some work for me?
messages.zh: 我就是跟你谈这事儿。你有事情给我做么？

messages.en: We're about to launch an operation in a heavily contested sector where we've seen mixed success recently. We'll be targeting one of the Amarrian Empire's largest ship logistics depots in an effort to halt their progress. You'll fly over there, hang at the back of the fighting and show them we even brought capsuleers to deal with their puny forces. I may have orders for you but I doubt it, though I still want you on standby just in case.
messages.zh: 我们准备在一个非常激烈的争夺区域进行一次行动，在这个区域双方都取得了一些胜利。为了能让他们的战略进度受阻，我们的目标是艾玛帝国最大型的舰船后勤站。你需要飞去到指定地点，持续的在目的地进行破坏和攻击，让他们知道我们连克隆飞行员都已经找来了，为了对付他们那些没用的军队。我应该给你明确的命令，但我怀疑这有什么作用，不过我还是希望在任何可能的事情就要发生的时候你能勇敢的坚持。

messages.en: I could have stayed around to help further, you know. Was that really all you needed done?
messages.zh: 我能够继续帮忙，你知道。这些就是你需要完成的事情？

messages.en: Yes, it helped more than I think you realize, we couldn't get to their Commander as quickly and effectively as you. Your actions freed us up to identify and remove the rest of their chain of command. We'll come away with the victory we needed, despite some heavy losses. Let our mistake be a lesson for you, pilot. Good work today though, here's your pay.
messages.zh: 是的，这对我们的好处我想肯定不止你所想象的那么多，如果没有你的帮助，我们没法这么迅速的夺取他们的指挥部。你的勇猛让我们连对他们的指挥系统斩草除根的行动都省了。我们得到了我们想要的胜利，即使我们也遭受到了一定的损失，这也算是给你的一些经验吧。干得好，飞行员，这是你的报酬。

messages.en: No offense, but I'd rather serve the Republic in other, more important ways. I'm not some trophy you wave around.
messages.zh: 原谅我的冒犯，我情愿在更加重要的事件中为共和国效力。我可不是你随便使唤的跑龙套的。

messages.en: Then you do not understand your own importance, pilot. The mere presence of a capsuleer on the field can fill an entire fleet with terror. I'm disappointed that you cannot see the value in a mission such as this. Oh well, I'll make other arrangements.
messages.zh: 你不明白你的重要性，飞行员。克隆飞行员的出现能够让一整支舰队处于恐慌之中。你不能明白这个任务的重要性，我感到非常失望。好吧，等我有别的事情了再找你。

messages.en: Even the smallest of battlefields can become a focal point of a larger war when both sides refuse to back down. The localized strategic objectives of the battle can slowly fall out of view, as the fight in a particular area comes to represent the conflict at large; with both sides stubbornly fighting for a victory they believe will set the precedent for further ones.
messages.zh: 当对抗的双方都不愿意放手的时候，即便是最小的战场也会变成一整场战争中的焦点。如果在某一特定地点的战斗已经变成了整个对抗的重点，原本的局部战略目标都会渐渐淡出视线，双方都顽强地着重在一场战斗的胜利，他们相信这一场胜利能够为以后的更多胜利打下基础。

messages.en: The need for victory.
messages.zh: 对胜利的渴望。

messages.en:
I did, I need you to support some forces of ours in the way only a capsuleer can.

We're about to launch an operation in a heavily contested sector where we've seen mixed success recently. We'll be targeting one of the Amarrian Empire's largest ship logistics depots in an effort to halt their progress. If we can remove their ability to repair and re-supply then we can push the advantage and hopefully clear them out of there altogether.

Admittedly, they've been a tough opponent so far and we've suffered some heavy losses. We're not taking any chances this time however, we need to come away with a victory today. That's why we've called in additional numbers…lots of them. Victory is all but assured this time but I want more than just success today, I want those slaver scum utterly crushed and left without hope. I want them reeling from this defeat. That's where you come in.

You'll fly over there, hang at the back of the fighting and show them we even brought capsuleers to deal with their puny forces. I may have orders for you but I doubt it, though I still want you on standby just in case. You're there simply to crush their morale, to show them that no matter what they brought, their defeat was inevitable. It's an easy assignment, pilot; you should have no problem with it.
messages.zh:
是的，我需要你去支援我们的一些部队，用一种只有克隆飞行员能做到的方式。

我们准备在一个非常激烈的争夺区域进行一次行动，在这个区域双方都取得了一些胜利。为了能让他们的战略进度受阻，我们的目标是艾玛帝国最大型的舰船后勤站。如果我们能让他们的舰船无法尽快得到维修和补给，那我么能就能获得更多的优势，甚至或许还能把他们一举清除出这个区域。

不可否认的是，他们一直是我们最棘手的对手，也确实给我们带来了不小的损失。这一次我们不再寄托于任何机会了，要靠今天的胜利一次性地扭转局势，这也是为什么我们现在大量的召集外部力量。胜利是我们的使命，今天的胜利是注定的，但我需要的不仅是一次胜利，我还要让加达里被打入地狱永不翻身，要让他们永远无法从这次战斗之后再站起来。这就是你在这儿的目的。

你需要飞去到指定地点，持续的在目的地进行破坏和攻击，让他们知道我们连克隆飞行员都已经找来了，为了对付他们那些没用的军队。我应该给你明确的命令，但我怀疑这有什么作用，不过我还是希望在任何可能的事情就要发生的时候你能勇敢的坚持。你去那儿的目的非常简单，就是要消磨他们的士气，让他们知道无论他们派来什么部队都没法改变失败的命运。这是个简单的任务，飞行员，你应该没有问题。

messages.en: I won't be able to help with this after all, something more important than a chest-beating mission came up and I'm giving it priority.
messages.zh: 我到底还是没法帮上忙，有些比这个惊心动魄的任务更加重要的事情出现了，我得要先去处理。

messages.en: Your lack of commitment does a great disservice to your reputation, pilot. I suggest you not repeat this mistake.  You are known for your loyalty and reliability, do not unravel all that hard work.
messages.zh: 你的名誉因你的推脱和逃避而受到了巨大的打击，飞行员。我希望你别再犯同样的错误。你的名声是来自于你的忠诚和可靠的能力，不要自己把它给毁了。

messages.en: Give me the coordinates.
messages.zh: 把坐标给我。

messages.en: I knew you could be trusted. Here is your payment, take it with my thanks.
messages.zh: 我知道你是指的信任的。这是你的报酬，希望你能满意。

messages.en: I'm ready for anything, you can count on my discretion.
messages.zh: 我准备好干任何事情了，我是完全靠的住的。

messages.en: Very recently, we spotted a huge transport fleet carrying thousands upon thousands of Amarrians towards our borders. We let them enter, pretending as always that we had not noticed. This time however, we reinforced all of the likely exit points with additional patrols. As a result they have not yet been able to leave. They are sitting largely defenseless as they wait for an opportunity to pass back out into Empire borders. Do what must be done.
messages.zh: 就在不多久前，我们观测到他们的一支庞大运输舰队，搭载了成千上万的艾玛国民正在朝我们的边境方向移动。我们让他们近来，假装和平时一样完全不在意他们的行为。但是这一次，我们将会加强所有出口的巡逻力量。这样他们进来了就出不去了。在他们等待机会从我们的边境线溜出去的时候，大部分时间都是疏于防守的。你去做你该做的事情。

messages.en: The work has been completed.
messages.zh: 任务完成了。

messages.en: I'm just going to pretend I never had this conversation.
messages.zh: 我回假装我从来没有听说过这回事儿。

messages.en: Very well. See that you do a good job of pretending. I would hate to see someone like yourself in the sort of trouble that leaking this information would land you in.
messages.zh: 你真可以，把自己伪装得这么到家。我早就应该对看见你这样的漏风嘴而感到恶心了。

messages.en:
Despite the frequent death of civilians in a war, it is nonetheless exceptionally rare for large-scale casualties to happen without even a shred of reason. Engineers, mechanics, scientists, these and other professions – when used directly to aid combatant forces – can be said to have justifiably draw the wrath of their enemies. There just enough shades of grey to allow it.

No empire, however, is foolish enough to outright murder citizens without any involvement in a conflict. Or as some might argue, they are not so foolish as to get caught in the act. The rise of the capsuleer has spawned a dark new age where culpability is little more than an elusive dream.
messages.zh:
尽管在战争中平民的死亡是时有发生的事情，但是在没有任何原因的情况下这样大规模地发生伤亡却是十分罕见的。工程师，机械工人，科学家，各种各样的技术专业人员——当他们直接帮助战斗部队的时候——这给他们的敌人制造了报复所需要的一切正当理由，所需要的只是一个灰色的阴影加以掩盖。

任何一个国家都不至于蠢到对没有卷入和任何冲突的平民进行伤害。或许有人会反驳，这些平民根本不会这么傻到会让人轻易逮到他们的反抗行为，战争中或许根本就没有平民。克隆飞行员的出现制造了一个黑暗的年代，使得一些罪责变成了一场小小的可以忘却的噩梦。

messages.en: Shades of grey
messages.zh: 灰色地带

messages.en:
Good, listen carefully. The Amarrians have been moving their own citizens through our space, shuttling them back home from distant and lawless frontiers. We've been watching this for some time now and for the most part, simply ignoring it. Predictable as they are, we knew the appearance of lax border security would embolden them and this is precisely what has happened.

Very recently, we spotted a huge transport fleet carrying thousands upon thousands of their people towards our borders. We let them enter, pretending as always that we had not noticed. This time however, we reinforced all of the likely exit points with additional patrols. As a result they have not yet been able to leave.

They are currently holed up in a nearby contested sector, where Amarrian forces will offer them some protection, but only a little. They are sitting largely defenseless as they wait for an opportunity to pass back out into Empire borders. I will give you those coordinates if you can promise me you will do something useful with them.

Am I being understood here, pilot?
messages.zh:
嗯，好好听着。艾玛帝国正在转移他们处在宇宙各个角落的国民，用穿梭机从各个危险的区域把他们都接回到本土。我们已经观察他们的这些行动有些时候了，但一直都没有采取行动。和他们自己所预料的一样，我们知道边境上松懈的防务力量会鼓励他们的大胆行为，果然我们所担心的事情已经开始发生了。

就在不多久前，我们观测到他们的一支庞大运输舰队，搭载了成千上万他们的国民正在朝我们的边境方向移动。我们让他们近来，假装和平时一样完全不在意他们的行为。但是这一次，我们将会加强所有出口的巡逻力量。这样他们进来了就出不去了。

他们现在被困在了附近的一个争夺区域，在那儿帝国的军队还能够给他们一些保护，但只是一点点保护。更大程度上他们还是完全处于一种不设防的状态，一直在等待一个机会穿越我们的边境回到艾玛的国土内。如果你能向我保证你能给他们点惊喜的话，我会给你他们的坐标。

你明白我的意思了么，飞行员？

messages.en: I've had a change of heart. I cannot do what I think it is you want me to.
messages.zh: 我最近良心发现，不能去做你说说的那种事情，至少是我理解成的那种。

messages.en: Your loyalty has been tested and found lacking, along with your resolve. I can only hope that your discretion does not follow the same path, it would be a shame to lose such a capable pilot.
messages.zh: 你的忠诚已经得到了检验，很遗憾没能过关。我只希望你不要让你的能力走上同样的道路。失去你这样的飞行员是一件非常遗憾的事情。

name.ru: Мертвые не болтают (Dead Men Tell No Tales)

messages.en: Executing that traitor will be my honor. Don't worry, I'll make sure he's taken care of.
messages.zh: 把那叛贼处决掉将是我的荣幸。别担心，我保证他会得到应有处置的。

messages.en: Good. Don't take any chances; that relay is our top priority. Everything else is a secondary target.
messages.zh: 很好。别鲁莽冒险；那中继站是我们的首要目标，其他都是次要目标。

messages.en: Disturbing news?
messages.zh: 令人忧心的消息？

messages.en: Your mission will be to slip past enemy lines and destroy the Minmatar tactical relay and the spy on board. With him out of the way, our intelligence network in this sector should remain secure and the war effort will not be seriously threatened by his capture. Haste is of utmost importance, so don't waste any time.
messages.zh: 你的任务就是潜入敌人后防线，摧毁那米玛塔尔战术中继站及里面的那位间谍。把他解决之后，我们在地区的情报网就能安然无恙，我们的战争形势也不会受到太多负面影响。现在最需要的就是速度，切莫再迟疑。

messages.en: The tactical relay has been eliminated.
messages.zh: 我已经把中继站连根拔起了。

messages.en: Superb work, pilot. I'll make sure your name gets mentioned up the chain.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，飞行员。我会在上级面前美言你几句的。

messages.en: Look, I don't feel like cleaning up someone else's mess here. Find someone else to do your dirty work.
messages.zh: 听好，我不喜欢替别人擦屁股。找别人去干这些低档活儿吧。

messages.en: We're all in this war together, pilot, or we're all in deep trouble. You need to realize that sooner rather than later.
messages.zh: 我们是在同一条船上的，飞行员，要不大家都没好日子过。你最好尽快明白这点。

messages.en:
Intelligence has been using an agent on a Minmatar tactical relay to eavesdrop on their communications in this sector. A few days ago we lost contact with him and all reports ceased, leaving us with a giant blind spot. We assumed that our agent had been discovered and eliminated.

It seems that the problem is even worse than we feared. Intelligence intercepted a communiqué indicating that our agent was not just caught, but turned-- he's ready to tell the enemy everything he knows about our operations in this area. This must not happen.

Fortunately, at the moment he's still being held on the tactical relay, putting him within our striking distance. We need you to slip past enemy lines and destroy that relay before it's too late.
messages.zh:
情报部门在一个米玛塔尔战术中继站里安插了一位特工，他的任务是窃听米玛塔尔人在这个地区的通信。几天前我们与他失去了联系，再也没有收到任何报告，我们现在面临一个巨大的消息真空。我们一开始以为这家伙被敌人发现然后被除掉了。

但问题好像比我们想象的还要严重。根据情报部门截取的一条信息，我们的特工不仅被抓，还发生了变节——他打算向敌人吐露一切他所了解的我们在此地区的行动情况。我们决不允许有这样的事情发生。

所幸他目前还被关押在战术中继站内，尚处于我们的打击范围。我们要你潜入敌人后防线，赶在一切都变得来不及之前摧毁那中继站。

messages.en: You have hurt us deeply here, pilot; I hope you realize that.
messages.zh: 你让我们遭受了惨痛损失，飞行员；我希望你能明白这点。

messages.en: It will be an honor to eliminate him.
messages.zh: 消灭他是我的荣誉。

messages.en: I'm glad to hear it, pilot, and I'm sure the families of those lost will be, too. I'll be awaiting news of your victory.
messages.zh: 我很高兴听到这个，飞行员。我想那些失去亲人的家庭也会这样认为。我会在这里等待你的胜利凯旋。

messages.en: What happened?
messages.zh: 发生了什么事情?

messages.en:
A Minmatar task force destroyed a civilian convoy fleeing the front lines. Included in the missing and presumed dead are the daughter of a prominent Holder and her family, and the general staff is outraged by the attack. We must have revenge for this brutal massacre.

The sector commander responsible for ordering the attack is currently resupplying, leaving him temporarily vulnerable. We don't intend to let him get away. Fly to the base at the coordinates you've been given and make sure the sector commander does not survive. Any other targets are secondary, but don't hold back. Show these bastards the wrath of the righteous.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔的部队摧毁了一支逃离前线的平民船队。一位有威望的贵族的女儿及其家人也在袭击中失踪，大家都认为她已经遭遇不幸。总参部对这次袭击非常的愤怒，我们必须要对这种残忍的兽行进行报复。

下令执行那次攻击的敌人区域指挥官所在舰队正在进行补给，这使得他们的防御暂时性的被削弱了。我们不能让他就这么逃脱责任。你到我给你的坐标点去，将这个区域指挥官干掉。其他的目标都是次要的，不要被他们拖住了。让这些混蛋得到正义的惩罚吧。

messages.en: That murderer won't be committing any more acts of butchery.
messages.zh: 那个凶手再也不能制造任何危害了。

messages.en: Excellent work, pilot. The families of the dead owe you a great debt.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。那些失去亲人的家庭都欠你一份人情。

messages.en: I don't know if I can handle this, sir. You better find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不确定我是否能够干得了。长官，你最好找找别人。

messages.en: I see. I'm disappointed, pilot, but I'm glad you told me now rather than later. I'll have to see if I can find someone more capable for a mission of this import.
messages.zh: 我明白了，我很失望，飞行员。但是我很高兴你能现在告诉我而不是等到太晚的时候。我会看看我能不能找到另外的能干这任务的飞行员。

messages.en:
I've just received word that a fleeing civilian convoy was destroyed by the Minmatar, pilot. There were over two thousand fatalities before a Navy search-and-rescue force was able to reach the scene and recover the survivors.

In addition to the utter disregard for human life that this act displayed, evidently the daughter of a prominent Holder and her family were on board one of the industrial ships with the convoy. They are still missing, but the Navy isn't hopeful that they will be found. We are outraged, and they want to show those terrorists that they can't get away with this kind of butchery.

I've been asked to find a pod pilot capable of taking out the sector commander who ordered this massacre. His battleship group is currently resupplying, and is temporarily vulnerable. It won't be easy; despite his cowardly choice of targets, he's quite capable and has a significant force at his disposal.
messages.zh:
我收到消息，一支逃离前线战火的平民船队被米玛塔尔人给摧毁了。在那儿有超过两千人在海军的搜救队抵达现场之前就死去了。

不说这件事情表现出敌人对人类生命的极端藐视，而且在这次事件中，一位有威望的贵族的女儿及其家人也在其中的一艘工业舰上，目前还没有能找到她生还的任何迹象，海军搜救队认为她生还的可能性已经非常渺茫。我们愤怒了，我们要让那些恐怖分子知道，他们不可能就这么从这件灭绝人性的事件中轻松走开。

我接到命令找一位有能力干掉敌人区域指挥官的克隆飞行员，这个指挥官就是下达那次对我平民进行袭击命令的人。他的战列舰舰队当前正在进行补给，造成了暂时的防御松懈。这不会是一件简单的事情，尽管他懦弱的选择了平民作为目标，但是他的舰队依然具有强大的实力。

name.ja: ネットワークを遮断せよ

messages.en: I'll get that intelligence. You can count on me.
messages.zh: 我去把那情报拿来。交给我了。

messages.en: : I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Don't let me down.
messages.zh: 我期待你来向我汇报。别让我失望。

messages.en: Of course. I'm always ready to do my part for the war effort.
messages.zh: 当然。我时刻准备着。

messages.en:
Minmatar forces have begun to deploy a cynosural field network in this sector.

In order to find the beacons comprising this network and destroy them, we need to get the records on where those beacons have been deployed. To find that, we need to get the tactical information sheet from the Minmatar outpost not far from here. You'll need to fight your way to the outpost and grab the sheet. Bring it back to me as quickly as possible.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔已经开始在此区域部署诱导力场网络了。

为了揪出组成这网络的信标并将它们摧毁，我们需要获取记录这些信标位置的信息。要找到这信息，我们需要从离这不远的一做米玛塔尔哨站里获取战术信息文档。你必须冲出一条血路去取那文档。然后尽快将它带回。

messages.en: I've managed to get the tactical information sheet you needed. I hope it helps.
messages.zh: 我成功获取了你要的战术信息。希望能派上用场。

messages.en: Good work, pilot. I'll get that to Naval Intelligence right away.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。我马上就把它转交给海军情报部门。

messages.en: I'm going to sit this one out.
messages.zh: 这事儿我懒得管。

messages.en: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will.
messages.zh: 如果你不干，那我就去找能干的他人。

messages.en:
One of the key advantages we've had so far in this sector is our extensive cynosural field network, which allows us to drop our capital ships in on the enemy almost at will. The enemy, meanwhile, is forced to leave their ships vulnerable during cynosural field generation.

Unfortunately, our advantage may be crumbling. Yesterday, a task force engaging a Minmatar blockade suffered serious losses when three enemy carriers dropped on them. The disturbing part is that the cynosural field was activated by a beacon, not by a Minmatar ship. That means the Minmatar have put up a limited cynosural field network to compete with ours. No doubt they're expanding it as fast as they can.

The network needs to be destroyed, but we need to know where those beacons have been deployed so that we can get all of them when we do a sweep. In order to do this, we want you to penetrate the security at the Minmatar outpost nearby and get the tactical information sheet there. Bring it back here, and we'll have Naval Intelligence find those beacons. Understood?
messages.zh:
我们在此地区的一项关键优势是我们拥有分布广泛的诱导力场网络，利用该网络我们可以随意向敌人派出旗舰。与此同时，在诱导力场生成期间，敌方的舰船会被迫处于脆弱状态。

不幸的是，我们的优势可能正在消失。昨天，与米玛塔尔封锁队交火的一支队伍在敌方派出三艘航母后遭到了严重打击。令人担心的是，他们的诱导力场是由信标产生的，而非米玛塔尔舰船。这意味着米玛塔尔人为了对抗我们，已经搭建了一个有限的诱导力场网络。他们现在肯定正在全力拓展这一网络。

我们一定要摧毁这网络，但我们必须先知道这些信标部署在哪些位置以便来次大扫荡。为了完成这点，我们要你潜入附近的一座米玛塔尔哨站，从里面偷运出他们的战术信息文档。把它带回来，我们会让海军情报部门去搜寻那些信标。明白了吗？

messages.en: I can't do this; it's way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我没法干；这事超我能力所及。你得去找别人。

messages.en: You're setting our entire war effort back weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out missions, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder in the future.
messages.zh: 飞行员，你让我们的战争努力倒退了数周。如果你不能执行任务，那你对我们来说就是个废物。我劝你将来要更卖力点。

messages.en: I'll make sure those troops never reach their destinations!
messages.zh: 我会让他们永远到达不了目的地！

messages.en:
I knew you would be up for it. The convoy guards should not pose a significant challenge to you. And besides, the only real targets are the industrials carrying the ground troops. Destroy them and you can avoid fighting the other ships, unless you want to.

The main threat to your mission will be capsuleers supporting the Republic.
messages.zh:
我知道你会答应的。船队的护航舰对你来说都不是什么大问题。我们的首要目标还是那些运送地面部队的工业舰。消灭他们，至于其他的船你可以放着不管如果你愿意的话。

主要的威胁还是来自于那些共和国的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: Serving the Empire is serving the side of right!
messages.zh: 为帝国效力就是为正义效力！

messages.en:
The Minmatar Republic is building up its ground troops in a nearby contested system with plans to launch an attack on our fortified positions.

We've discovered a troop transport moving toward their command outpost. You need merely destroy the industrials and don't need to bother with the convoy guards.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔共和国正在附近一个争夺区域集合他们的地面部队，准备对我们的一个加强工事进行袭击。

我们发现了一个运兵船队正在向他们的指挥哨站前进。你只需要将船队中的工业舰都消灭掉就行了，别的船和那些护航船只你自己看着办。

messages.en: The troop transports have been destroyed. The Empire need not fear any longer!
messages.zh: 运兵船队已经被消灭了。帝国需要再为此担忧！

messages.en: With their troops eliminated, we'll be able to reinforce our own positions. And maybe soon, we'll be able to push forward and overwhelm the Minmatar positions as well! Just another step towards victory! Excellent work.
messages.zh: 一旦他们的部队被歼灭，我们就有空档加强自己的工事。或许很快，我们就能够向前推进对米玛塔尔的战线形成压倒性的优势！你干的很好，我们又向胜利迈进了一步！

messages.en: Anyone can take out a few transports! Why can't you give me something more substantial?
messages.zh: 任何人都可以搞掉几艘运输舰，你就不能给我点有意义的东西么？

messages.en: You would really turn down my offer? I'm not sure you know the severity of this mission.
messages.zh: 你真的要这么让我失望么？我不知道你是否知道这项任务的重要性。

messages.en:
In a nearby contested system, the Minmatar Republic has long held illusions of claiming it entirely for themselves. Now, we've always been able to stop them, but lately they've started moving ground troops into their command outpost there.

We cannot attack the command outpost directly. It's too well guarded and our forces are kept occupied in other areas. However, if they manage to get enough ground troops there, they can launch an attack on our planetary holdings.

Our scanners have picked up a lightly guarded convoy filled with troops heading toward the command outpost. You can take them out, no sweat, right?
messages.zh:
在附近一个争夺中的星系，米玛塔尔长期自欺欺人地宣布其在当地主权。实际上我们一直都有能力阻止他们的行为只是假装视而不见，但是最近他们开始将地面部队运送到他们在那个区域的指挥哨站。

我们不能直接地攻击指挥哨站，那里的防守力量非常强大，况且我们的大部分兵力都已经派往了别的作战区域。无论如何，如果他们设法聚集了足够多得地面部队在那里，他们就可以对我们的星球进行登陆作战了。

我们的扫描器发现了一个护卫力量较少的船队，搭载了大量的士兵正在朝这个指挥哨站进发。你可以将它们毫不费力的摧毁掉，有问题么？

messages.en: Yipes! That didn't turn out as easy as I hoped. I'm going to have to quit.
messages.zh: 唉！事情不是像我设想的一样简单，我要退出。

messages.en: If our ground forces are forced into a confrontation, thousands of lives will be lost.
messages.zh: 如果我们的地面部队和他们发生正面冲突，成千上万的生命将会消失。

name.ja: 最も激しいロイドレイジ

messages.en: Miners in a combat zone? They should see what I'm going to do to them coming!
messages.zh: 战场里的矿工？他们应该知道我迟早会找上门的！

messages.en: Perfect. The miners should be coming in and out of the belt. We doubt they'll be heavily defended, so you shouldn't have any problem destroying them. Capsuleers who foolishly cast their lot in with the Republic may be patrolling the area.
messages.zh: 真是完美。这些矿工在这个矿带进进出出，可能并没有太强大的防守力量，对于你来说应该不是个问题。你要当心共和国的那些愚蠢克隆飞行员可能在附近出没。

messages.en: Ready as I'll ever be.
messages.zh: 我时刻都准备着的。

messages.en: The Republic has sent workers into hostile territory to mine asteroids. Well, their foolish overconfidence is to our benefit. All you have to do is head over there and blow up the mining vessels, then report back to us. The miners and any escort they have should pose no problem to you; however, the Republic capsuleers in the area might prove difficult. Be ready.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔共和国把自己的国民送到危险的地方去开矿。好吧，他们的这种愚蠢行为对于我们来说是件好事。你要做的只是前去这个地点把他们的采矿船都摧毁掉，然后回来向我报告。这些采矿船和那些可能的护卫队可能都不是问题，但是你要当心在这个空域活动的米玛塔尔克隆飞行员；他们可能相当难对付。

messages.en: Those mining vessels made a very pleasing explosion.
messages.zh: 这些采矿船爆炸的景象真是太精彩了。

messages.en: I can just imagine those miners cursing the commander who sent them into hostile territory for some ore. Well, before you sent them to a fiery demise, of course.
messages.zh: 我可以想象在你把他们送上黄泉路之前，这些矿工肯定在诅咒那个把他们送到敌对区域采矿的指挥官。

messages.en: Don't you have anything different for me to do?
messages.zh: 你还没有其他的什么是情能给我做的。

messages.en: Are you worried it will be too difficult?
messages.zh: 你担心这会很难么？

messages.en:
Good news, follower! We've just discovered the Republic doing something incredibly foolish! It turns out they've been sending in miners to a nearby contested system. The impudence! Did they think they could do this right under our noses and we wouldn't notice? I hope they're ready to pay for their folly.

I want you to be the one to make them pay. Our normal forces are occupied with other objectives. I'd like you to head over there and take out those miners. It will deny the Minmatar a large amount of precious mineral resources. What do you say?
messages.zh:
好消息，我们发现米玛塔尔现在正在做一些非常愚蠢的事情！他们现在正在往一个处于争夺状态区域的小行星带派遣采矿船。真是厚颜无耻的人啊！他们以为自己就能够这么平平安安的混过去？！希望他们准备好了为自己的愚蠢行为付出代价。

你现在就过去让他们痛苦一下。我们的正规军最近正忙于对付其他很多事情，我想要你过去把那些采矿船都干掉。这将让米玛塔尔损失大量的贵重矿物资源。你说怎样？

messages.en: I can't complete your mission.
messages.zh: 我不能完成你的任务。

messages.en: You really couldn't handle it? I guess you aren't as capable as they say.
messages.zh: 你真的不能对付这事儿？我想你并不是像别人说的那样有能耐。

messages.en: I'll get out there right away!
messages.zh: 我会立即离开那儿。

messages.en: I'm expecting good things of you. The repair ships are only lightly guarded, with most of the enemy forces waiting to invade. However, capsuleers aligned with the Republic may be waiting to attack. You should watch out!
messages.zh: 我很看好你。那些维修船的防卫力量很薄弱，敌人的大部分兵力都去准备侵入作战了。但是，共和国的克隆飞行员可能在附近徘徊等待上门的猎物。

messages.en: The Minmatar Republic is trying to open up an old smuggler's gate belonging to the Serpentis. If they can get it open, they will be able to bring in overwhelming forces before we can respond. Head out there and destroy the repair ships. Just make sure you're ready for a real fight. Capsuleers loyal to the Republic are out and about and may try to stop you.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔正尝试开启一座老旧的天蛇星门。如果他们能成功激活这个星门，他们就能在我们无法反应的时间内把大量的兵力投放到我们的眼皮子底下。你得要做好准备迎接一场恶斗。共和国的克隆飞行员可能在附近徘徊等待上门的猎物。

messages.en: I've wiped the repair crew out to a man. The invasion has been stopped, for now.
messages.zh: 我把维修队已经铲除了。入侵行为已经被组织，至少是目前来说。

messages.en: You've really saved our butts today. If the Republic got that gate working, we'd be faced with a large invasion force behind our front lines. That could have been catastrophic. I suppose we'll have to be more diligent in the future with those sort of things.
messages.zh: 今天你真是救了我们一命。如果共和国能让那座星门恢复运转，我们就要在自己的战线后方面对一次大规模的进攻。我想我们以后还是要多多注意这样的事情。

messages.en: You're putting a lot on my shoulders here...
messages.zh: 你已经给我了很多重担了。

messages.en: Your hesitation is disheartening. I shall find someone made of sterner stuff.
messages.zh: 你的犹豫不决让人沮丧。我应该找个更加有毅力的人。

messages.en:
I've just received some very disturbing intelligence from my operatives inside the Minmatar Republic. It seems that the Gallente Federation has turned over an old Serpentis gate that leads into a nearby contested system. We never tore it down since the Serpentis don't bother us too often.

It looks like that has come back to bite us. The Minmatar are planning on using the gate to launch an attack into our space. Luckily, the gate is set to only accept ships broadcasting a specific Serpentis transponder code. The Minmatar have to reset both ends before they can utilize the gate.

Their repair team is at the gate now, doing the maintenance required to switch the codes. We need you to get over there and stop them immediately!
messages.zh:
我刚刚收到一份紧急的情报，来自于我们的一个在米玛塔尔共和国内部的人员。情报显示，盖伦特最近移交了一座通往附近争夺区域的老旧天蛇星门。

看来这个古董又会给我们带来麻烦了。米玛塔尔正准备用这个星门向我们的领空发动攻击。幸运的是，这座星门似乎需要发送一系列的天蛇通行代码才能够被激活。米玛塔尔只好把心门的两端都进行了重置以为自用。

他们的维修团队现在正在那个星门那儿，准备把星门的预设通行代码强行取消。我们需要你过去阻止他们的维修行动。

messages.en: I don't know how to say this, but I've been beaten. You'll need to find someone else to complete things.
messages.zh: 我不知道该怎么说，但是我被揍惨了。你找其他人去做这事儿吧。

messages.en: Don't you realize how important this mission is? Now what will we do?
messages.zh: 你没有意识到这是多么重要的一个任务么？先在我们该怎么办？

messages.en: Understood. I'll make sure she's made an example of.
messages.zh: 明白了。我会让她成为这样的一个典型得。

messages.en: I knew I could rely on you. I'll be eagerly awaiting news of your success.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住。我就等着你的好消息啦！

messages.en: Of course. How can I serve?
messages.zh: 当然，我能为你做什么。

messages.en:
A few weeks ago we dispatched a small squadron of Minmatar vessels that had made it inside our borders to a contested sector. We thought the job was finished and the area secure but it seems we've been duped. The entire regiment we cleared was just a decoy, and they've been massing hostiles in a nearby location.

Various sources of ours have pointed towards one of their Field Commanders being the key strategist behind these latest maneuvers. We need her assassinated.
messages.zh:
在几周前，我们驱逐了一支米玛塔尔飞行中队,他们闯入了我们的领地中的一块争夺区域。本以为事情就这么了结了，但看起来我们好像被忽悠了。我们消灭的那整个编队似乎只是诱饵，他们正在附近的一个地方集结部队。

多方面的信息表示，他们的一个前线指挥官是这件事情背后的黑手，我们得要把她干掉。

messages.en: The Field Commander and her guards are dead.
messages.zh: 前线指挥官和她的守卫们都死了。

messages.en: Excellent work, pilot. That should leave it clear to aspiring commanders just what exactly their promotion brings.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。这样我们也为那些有抱负的指挥官们扫清了前进的道路，正如他们的升职系统所提供的那样。

messages.en: I'm not here to clean up the mistakes of others, find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不是来这儿为别人的丑事儿擦屁股的，你去找别人吧。

messages.en: A disappointing remark, especially coming from one such as you. A million brave deeds in good times cannot compare to a single act made when everything has begun to fall apart.
messages.zh: 真是让人失望，特别是想你这样的人。平时做一万件好事也比不上在关键时候做一件。

messages.en:
The added responsibility and higher profile that comes with promotion is never without a great amount of personal risk. This is true across all the navies of the empires. Enemy Field Commanders are one of the most common targets of assassinations, and though the high honor of attaining such a rank is something countless people work towards, many do not hold the position for very long.

This is particularly true of the most brilliant commanders, who are often the first to be targeted for removal. With loyal capsuleers at their disposal, the empires are only too happy to pay large sums to have the most promising enemy commanders ruthlessly culled.
messages.zh:
晋升所带的责任的增加会使得个人的风险更大。这是在所有帝国的海军中都能适用的一个原则。敌人的前线指挥官一直都是突袭行动中最常见的目标，尽管有成千上万的人都在为着这样一个目标努力，但是很少有人能在这个位置上坐得长久。

这条规则特别适用于那些出色的指挥官，他们常常都会最先成为突袭的目标。有了忠诚的克隆飞行员的帮助，这些帝国更加愿意花大笔大笔的钱来将这些敌方指挥官置于死地。

messages.en: The risk of brilliance.
messages.zh: 智慧的危险

messages.en:
We have a serious situation on our hands, pilot.

A few weeks ago we dispatched a small squadron of Minmatar vessels that had made it inside our borders to a contested sector. We thought the job was finished and the area secure but it seems we've been duped. The entire regiment we cleared was just a decoy, and they've been massing hostiles in a nearby location with the use of covert technology.

The situation is not only embarrassing; it's undoubtedly boosted their own morale to have deceived us so effectively. We relocated all of our forces from there only days ago and re-establishing a presence will be admitting to our own people that those Federation scum outsmarted us…or one of them in particular, actually.

Various sources of ours have pointed towards one of their Field Commanders being the key strategist behind these latest maneuvers. We need her assassinated, pilot. Not only will her death impede their progress, but it should send a message to other commanders inside the Republic. Fly out there and make it clear to them: we have capsuleers ready and able to strike down their best and brightest. Let that be the first thought in their mind before they step up to lead fleets against our people.
messages.zh:
我们有些棘手的情况。

在几周前，我们驱逐了一支米玛塔尔飞行中队,他们闯入了我们的领地中的一块争夺区域。本以为事情就这么了结了，但看起来我们好像被忽悠了。我们消灭的那整个编队似乎只是诱饵，他们正在隐形装置的掩护下于附近的一个地方集结部队。

目前的情况不光光是尴尬的问题，成功愚弄我们将使得他们的士气大大的增加。几天前我们重新布置了在那儿的部队，重新建立我们在那儿的控制能力将会是在我们自己人面前承认这些联邦的垃圾比我们聪明……至少是其中有人比我们聪明。

多方面的信息表示，他们的一个前线指挥官是这件事情背后的黑手，我们得要把她暗中消灭掉。她的死不光会阻碍他们的进程，也能够给他们内部送去一个警告。你飞过去，把事情搞得干净利索，告诉他们：我们有足够的飞行员时刻的准备着把他们从天上搞下来。让他们以后出来和我们作对的时候随时把这点击在脑子里。

messages.en: She's too well defended I'm afraid. I can't get to her.
messages.zh: 她的防守相当严密，我无法靠近她。

messages.en: I trusted you and only you with this, what am I supposed to do now? Now they know we sent some of our best and failed, you've only emboldened them further! It seems I'll have to seriously reassess your worth to us.
messages.zh: 在这件事儿上，我相信你，而且只相信你一个人，我现在该怎么做？他们知道我们已经把最好的战士派去了，而且也输掉了，你让他们变得更加大胆！看来，我的重新对你的价值进行评估。

messages.en: Sure, sounds easy enough. I'll head out immediately.
messages.zh: 很好，应该很简单，我这就去办。

messages.en: Good, I'm relaying the coordinates now. Be on standby once you get there, I may still have some targets of opportunity for you.
messages.zh: 很好，我正在上传坐标。一旦你到达那儿就应该准备好，我应该还有一些目标要交给你。

messages.en: That's why I'm talking to you. Did you have some work for me?
messages.zh: 我就是跟你谈这事儿。你有事情给我做么？

messages.en: We're about to launch an operation in a heavily contested sector where we've seen mixed success recently. We'll be targeting one of the Minmatar Republic's largest ship logistics depots in an effort to halt their progress. You'll fly over there, hang at the back of the fighting and show them we even brought capsuleers to deal with their puny forces. I may have orders for you but I doubt it, though I still want you on standby just in case.
messages.zh: 我们准备在一个非常激烈的争夺区域进行一次行动，在这个区域双方都取得了一些胜利。为了能让他们的战略进度受阻，我们的目标是米玛塔尔共和国最大型的舰船后勤站。你需要飞去到指定地点，持续的在目的地进行破坏和攻击，让他们知道我们连克隆飞行员都已经找来了，为了对付他们那些没用的军队。我应该给你明确的命令，但我怀疑这有什么作用，不过我还是希望在任何可能的事情就要发生的时候你能勇敢的坚持。

messages.en: Yes, it helped more than I think you realize, we couldn't get to their Commander as quickly and effectively as you. Your actions freed us up to identify and remove the rest of their chain of command. We'll come away with the victory we needed, despite some heavy losses. Let our mistake be a lesson for you, pilot. Good work today though, here's your pay.
messages.zh: 是的，这对我们的好处我想肯定不止你所想象的那么多，如果没有你的帮助，我们没法这么迅速的夺取他们的指挥部。你的勇猛让我们连对他们的指挥系统斩草除根的行动都省了。我们得到了我们想要的胜利，即使我们也遭受到了一定的损失，这也算是给你的一些经验吧。干得好，飞行员，这是你的报酬。

messages.en: I could have stayed around to help further, you know. Was that really all you needed done?
messages.zh: 我就在附近等着能帮你做更多事情，你知道。这就是你所需要帮助的全部么？

messages.en: No offense, but I'd rather serve the Empire in other, more important ways. I'm not some trophy you wave around.
messages.zh: 原谅我的冒犯，我情愿在更加重要的事件中为帝国效力。我可不是你随便使唤的跑龙套的。

messages.en: Then you do not understand your own importance, pilot. The mere presence of a capsuleer on the field can fill an entire fleet with terror. I'm disappointed that you cannot see the value in a mission such as this. Oh well, I'll make other arrangements.
messages.zh: 你不明白你的重要性，飞行员。克隆飞行员的出现能够让一整支舰队处于恐慌之中。你不能明白这个任务的重要性，我感到非常失望。好吧，等我有别的事情了再找你。

messages.en: Even the smallest of battlefields can become a focal point of a larger war when both sides refuse to back down. The localized strategic objectives of the battle can slowly fall out of view, as the fight in a particular area comes to represent the conflict at large; with both sides stubbornly fighting for a victory they believe will set the precedent for further ones.
messages.zh: 当对抗的双方都不愿意放手的时候，即便是最小的战场也会变成一整场战争中的焦点。如果在某一特定地点的战斗已经变成了整个对抗的重点，原本的局部战略目标都会渐渐淡出视线，双方都顽强地着重在一场战斗的胜利，他们相信这一场胜利能够为以后的更多胜利打下基础。

messages.en: The need for victory.
messages.zh: 对胜利的渴望。

messages.en:
I did, I need you to support some forces of ours in the way only a capsuleer can.

We're about to launch an operation in a heavily contested sector where we've seen mixed success recently. We'll be targeting one of the Minmatar Republic's largest ship logistics depots in an effort to halt their progress. If we can remove their ability to repair and re-supply then we can push the advantage and hopefully clear them out of there altogether.

Admittedly, they've been a tough opponent so far and we've suffered some heavy losses. We're not taking any chances this time however, we need to come away with a victory today. That's why we've called in additional numbers…lots of them. Victory is all but assured this time but I want more than just success today, I want those savages utterly crushed and left without hope. I want them reeling from this defeat. That's where you come in.

You'll fly over there, hang at the back of the fighting and show them we even brought capsuleers to deal with their puny forces. I may have orders for you but I doubt it, though I still want you on standby just in case. You're there simply to crush their morale, to show them that no matter what they brought, their defeat was inevitable. It's an easy assignment, pilot; you should have no problem with it.
messages.zh:
是的，我需要你去支援我们的一些部队，用一种只有克隆飞行员能做到的方式。

我们准备在一个非常激烈的争夺区域进行一次行动，在这个区域双方都取得了一些胜利。为了能让他们的战略进度受阻，我们的目标是米玛塔尔共和国最大型的舰船后勤站。如果我们能让他们的舰船无法尽快得到维修和补给，那我么能就能获得更多的优势，甚至或许还能把他们一举清除出这个区域。

不可否认的是，他们一直是我们最棘手的对手，也确实给我们带来了不小的损失。这一次我们不再寄托于任何机会了，要靠今天的胜利一次性地扭转局势，这也是为什么我们现在大量的召集外部力量。胜利是我们的使命，今天的胜利是注定的，但我需要的不仅是一次胜利，我还要让加达里被打入地狱永不翻身，要让他们永远无法从这次战斗之后再站起来。这就是你在这儿的目的。

你需要飞去到指定地点，持续的在目的地进行破坏和攻击，让他们知道我们连克隆飞行员都已经找来了，为了对付他们那些没用的军队。我应该给你明确的命令，但我怀疑这有什么作用，不过我还是希望在任何可能的事情就要发生的时候你能勇敢的坚持。你去那儿的目的非常简单，就是要消磨他们的士气，让他们知道无论他们派来什么部队都没法改变失败的命运。这是个简单的任务，飞行员，你应该没有问题。

messages.en: I won't be able to help with this after all, something more important than a chest-beating mission came up and I'm giving it priority.
messages.zh: 我到底还是没法帮上忙，有些比这个惊心动魄的任务更加重要的事情出现了，我得要先去处理。

messages.en: Your lack of commitment does a great disservice to your reputation, pilot. I suggest you not repeat this mistake.  You are known for your loyalty and reliability, do not unravel all that hard work.
messages.zh: 你的名誉因你的推脱和逃避而受到了巨大的打击，飞行员。我希望你别再犯同样的错误。你的名声是来自于你的忠诚和可靠的能力，不要自己把它给毁了。

messages.en: Give me the coordinates.
messages.zh: 把坐标给我。

messages.en: Uploading them now. Do what must be done. Go with God's blessing, pilot.
messages.zh: 我正在上传。使命终究事要完成的。神会保佑你，飞行员。

messages.en: I'm ready for anything, you can count on my discretion.
messages.zh: 我准备好干任何事情了，我是完全靠的住的。

messages.en: The work has been completed.
messages.zh: 任务完成了。

messages.en: I knew you could be trusted. Here is your payment, take it with my thanks.
messages.zh: 我知道你是指的信任的。这是你的报酬，希望你能满意。

messages.en: I'm just going to pretend I never had this conversation.
messages.zh: 我回假装我从来没有听说过这回事儿。

messages.en: Very well. See that you do a good job of pretending. I would hate to see someone like yourself in the sort of trouble that leaking this information would land you in.
messages.zh: 你真可以，把自己伪装得这么到家。我早就应该对看见你这样的漏风嘴而感到恶心了。

messages.en:
Despite the frequent death of civilians in a war, it is nonetheless exceptionally rare for large-scale casualties to happen without even a shred of reason. Engineers, mechanics, scientists, these and other professions – when used directly to aid combatant forces – can be said to have justifiably draw the wrath of their enemies. There just enough shades of grey to allow it.

No empire, however, is foolish enough to outright murder citizens without any involvement in a conflict. Or as some might argue, they are not so foolish as to get caught in the act. The rise of the capsuleer has spawned a dark new age where culpability is little more than an elusive dream.
messages.zh:
尽管在战争中平民的死亡是时有发生的事情，但是在没有任何原因的情况下这样大规模地发生伤亡却是十分罕见的。工程师，机械工人，科学家，各种各样的技术专业人员——当他们直接帮助战斗部队的时候——这给他们的敌人制造了报复所需要的一切正当理由，所需要的只是一个灰色的阴影加以掩盖。

任何一个国家都不至于蠢到对没有卷入和任何冲突的平民进行伤害。或许有人会反驳，这些平民根本不会这么傻到会让人轻易逮到他们的反抗行为，战争中或许根本就没有平民。克隆飞行员的出现制造了一个黑暗的年代，使得一些罪责变成了一场小小的可以忘却的噩梦。

messages.en: Shades of grey
messages.zh: 灰色地带

messages.en:
Good, listen carefully.

The Minmatar have been moving their own citizens through our space, shuttling them back home from distant and lawless frontiers. We've been watching this for some time now and for the most part, simply ignoring it. Predictable as they are, we knew the appearance of lax border security would embolden them and this is precisely what has happened.

Very recently, we spotted a huge transport fleet carrying thousands upon thousands of their people towards our borders. We let them enter, pretending as always that we had not noticed. This time however, we reinforced all of the likely exit points with additional patrols. As a result they have not yet been able to leave.

They are currently holed up in a nearby contested sector, where Minmatar forces will offer them some protection, but only a little. They are sitting largely defenseless as they wait for an opportunity to pass back out into Republic borders. I will give you those coordinates if you can promise me you will do something useful with them.

Am I being understood here, pilot?
messages.zh:
嗯，好好听着。米玛塔尔正在转移他们处在宇宙各个角落的国民，用穿梭机从各个危险的区域把他们都接回到本土。我们已经观察他们的这些行动有些时候了，但一直都没有采取行动。和他们自己所预料的一样，我们知道边境上松懈的防务力量会鼓励他们的大胆行为，果然我们所担心的事情已经开始发生了。

就在不多久前，我们观测到他们的一支庞大运输舰队，搭载了成千上万他们的国民正在朝我们的边境方向移动。我们让他们近来，假装和平时一样完全不在意他们的行为。但是这一次，我们将会加强所有出口的巡逻力量。这样他们进来了就出不去了。

他们现在被困在了附近的一个争夺区域，在那儿共和国的军队还能够给他们一些保护，但只是一点点保护。更大程度上他们还是完全处于一种不设防的状态，一直在等待一个机会穿越我们的边境回到米玛塔尔的国土内。如果你能向我保证你能给他们点惊喜的话，我会给你他们的坐标。

你明白我的意思了么，飞行员？

messages.en: I've had a change of heart. I cannot do what I think it is you want me to.
messages.zh: 我最近改变了我的内心。我不能去做你说说的那种事情，至少是我理解成的那种。

messages.en: Your loyalty and faith has been tested and found lacking, along with your resolve. I can only hope that your discretion does not follow the same path, it would be a shame to lose such a capable pilot.
messages.zh: 你的忠诚已经得到了检验，很遗憾没能过关。我只希望你不要让你的能力走上同样的道路。失去你这样的飞行员是一件非常遗憾的事情。

messages.en: Sounds like my kind of work. Send me the location and I'll head out there.
messages.zh: 听起来就像是给我准备的。把坐标传送给我，我马上就出发。

messages.en: Excellent, I will be awaiting news of your success.
messages.zh: 很好，我就等着你成功的消息了。

messages.en: That's what I'm here for, throw me one.
messages.zh: 这是我来这儿的目的，只管说就行了。

messages.en: We've recently had to deal with some rather resilient Minmatar forces in a nearby contested sector. It seemed like every hard-earned victory counted for nothing; they would simply retreat, regroup and repair. We knew they had to have a Starbase somewhere to do this as effectively as they were. That Starbase has now been found. You simply need to destroy the Main Reactor powering the shields. From there we can send in a team to clear the rest out.
messages.zh: 我们最同一只行动低调的米玛塔尔部队在附近的争夺区域进行了交锋。看起来我们每次费劲力气才取得胜利都完全没有对敌人造成任何效果，他们每次都直接的撤退，重新整编，补给维修后再次进犯我们的战线。我们知道他们在附近有一个空间站在有效地为他们提供这些关键的后勤支援。你所要做的就是把他们的主反应堆击毁，这将是他们的护盾失效，这样我们就可以派遣打击部队进去清剿残敌。

messages.en: I've destroyed the reactor; you can send our people in now.
messages.zh: 我消灭了那座反应堆；你的人可以进去了。

messages.en: I knew I could rely on you. Excellent work, I'll give the order to mobilize immediately. Here is your pay, take it with my gratitude.
messages.zh: 我知道你是靠得住的。干的漂亮，我马上就给机动部队下达攻击命令。这是你的报酬，我很感激你。

messages.en: I'm not going up against a Starbase, even with a plan like this. You best find someone else more willing to lose their ship and crew.
messages.zh: 我不想去攻击一座空间站，即便你已经这样精心策划了。你最好找那些愿意船毁人亡的疯子去做。

messages.en: Unusual for you to behave like such a coward, I hope you're not starting to lose your nerve? Very well, I'll find someone else but…sort yourself out, please.
messages.zh: 你像这样的懦弱我还是头一次见着，我想你不要失去你的自我了。好吧，我会找其他人来完成这个任务，但请你一定要恢复好自己。

messages.en: The advent of the Starbase has seen vast changes in the nature of entrenched, long-term warfare. The tactics of battlefield logistics had to be almost entirely reinvented when forces suddenly had the capability to restock and reship inside hostile space. This process is ongoing even today, as empires discover new ways to utilize the potent abilities afforded by these structures.
messages.zh: 空间站和星站的出现大大改变了改变了持久战和大型战场中前线的布防策略。战地后勤的策略因为舰船可以及时在前方的到完全的补给协助而发生了巨大的转变。这种变化每天都在发生，各个国家随时都在研究新的方式来使这些空间建筑发挥最大的效用。

messages.en: The rise of the Starbase
messages.zh: 星站的崛起

messages.en:
Excellent. I'll give you our top priority assignment since I know how reliable you are.

We've recently had to deal with some rather resilient Minmatar forces in a nearby contested sector. It seemed like every hard-earned victory counted for nothing; they would simply retreat, regroup and repair. We knew they had to have a Starbase somewhere to do this as effectively as they were. That Starbase has now been found.

I can see the look in your eyes, don't worry, we have a plan to take it down that won't involve fielding Capital vessels. You simply need to destroy the Main Reactor powering the shields. From there we can send in a team to clear the rest out.

This mission isn't without risk; you are assaulting a Starbase after all. Expect some resistance and prepare yourself accordingly. Are you up to the task?
messages.zh:
很好，我会把我们最高优先等级的任务交给你去做，因为我知道你是靠得住的人。

我们最同一只行动低调的米玛塔尔部队在附近的争夺区域进行了交锋。看起来我们每次费劲力气才取得胜利都完全没有对敌人造成任何效果，他们每次都直接的撤退，重新整编，补给维修后再次进犯我们的战线。我们知道他们在附近有一个空间站在有效地为他们提供这些关键的后勤支援，现在我们终于找到了这座空间站的所在地。

我可以从你的眼神中看到些担心，其实不用，我们已经计划好了，不用旗舰的帮助就能够将其摧毁。你所要做的就是把他们的主反应堆击毁，这将是他们的护盾失效，这样我们就可以派遣打击部队进去清剿残敌。

这不会是一场轻松的战斗，毕竟你是在攻击一座空间站。准备好对付敌人的顽抗。你愿意接受这个任务么？

messages.en: I apologize, but I won't be able to complete this mission after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.
messages.zh: 我很抱歉，但是我终究还是没法完成这个任务。希望你能即时的找到替补我的人。

messages.en: You have a reputation for reliability, pilot. Don't let me see you undo all the hard work that earned it. I will find someone else, but I'm not impressed. This better be the last time you fail me.
messages.zh: 可靠是你的本钱，飞行员。不要让我看见你就这么把你之前所积累起来的名声就这么毁了。我会找其他人来完成任务，但是我不会太相信他们。这最好是你最后一次让我失望。

messages.en: Sounds like my kind of work. Send me the location and I'll head out there.
messages.zh: 听起来就像是给我准备的。把坐标传送给我，我马上就出发。

messages.en: Excellent, I will be awaiting news of your success.
messages.zh: 很好，我就等着你成功的消息了。

messages.en: That's what I'm here for, throw me one.
messages.zh: 这是我来这儿的目的，只管说就行了。

It seemed like every hard-earned victory counted for nothing; they would simply retreat, regroup and repair. We knew they had to have a Starbase somewhere to do this as effectively as they were. That Starbase has now been found. You simply need to destroy the Main Reactor powering the shields. From there we can send in a team to clear the rest out.
messages.zh: 我们最同一只行动低调的艾玛帝国部队在附近的争夺区域进行了交锋。看起来我们每次费劲力气才取得胜利都完全没有对敌人造成任何效果，他们每次都直接的撤退，重新整编，补给维修后再次进犯我们的战线。我们知道他们在附近有一个空间站在有效地为他们提供这些关键的后勤支援。你所要做的就是把他们的主反应堆击毁，这将是他们的护盾失效，这样我们就可以派遣打击部队进去清剿残敌。

messages.zh: 我消灭了那座反应堆；你的人可以进去了。

messages.zh: 可靠是你的本钱，飞行员。不要让我看见你就这么把你之前所积累起来的名声就这么毁了。我会找其他人来完成任务，但是我不会太相信他们。这最好是你最后一次让我失望。

messages.en: You can count on me.
messages.zh: 交给我好了。

messages.en: Excellent. Remember, we have no idea who might be there waiting for you. So be ready for anything.
messages.zh: 很好。记住，我们不知道谁会在那里等着你。所以你要作好一切准备。

messages.en: I know, I'm awesome. Anyway, you got anything to do?
messages.zh: 我知道我很可怕。不管它，你有事情做吗？

messages.en: Some of our explorers have just located a hidden asteroid belt that is apparently full of rare ore — here in local space. That's more than a little suspicious. The signature the belt is giving off is obvious enough that it seems nearly impossible it hasn't been found and mined out before now. We're afraid it might be a trap of some sort. We want you to warp over there and check it out, then report back.
messages.zh: 我们的一些探险者刚发现了一个富含稀有矿石的隐秘小行星带——就在这里。这很让人怀疑。从这个行星带上发出的信号表明它在此前几乎不可能已被发现并开采。我们觉得这可能是某种陷阱。我们想要你跃迁过去查看一下，然后交回报告。

messages.en: Looks like rogue drones staged this ambush.
messages.zh: 看起来是自由无人机设下了这个埋伏。

messages.en: I've never heard of them setting ambushes before. That is disturbing news.
messages.zh: 我以前从没听说他们设过埋伏。这是个无聊的消息。

messages.en: You want me to walk into a trap on purpose? No, thanks-- find some other patsy.
messages.zh: 你要我故意去踩陷阱？不了，谢谢——另找个替死鬼吧。

messages.en: I can understand your nervousness, I suppose. I'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我能理解你的紧张不安，我另找别人吧。

messages.en:
Yes, I certainly do have something for you. Recently, some explorers employed by {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} discovered an extremely strong gravimetric signature. Their scanners indicated the hidden belt was full of rare ore. Now, while this news would normally be cause for joy, I'm suspicious.

I'd like you to fly over to the belt and check it out. If it really is full of ore-- wonderful. If not, get back to me with the news as quickly as possible.
messages.zh:
是的，我的确是有东西要给你。最近，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}所雇佣的一批探险者发现了一处非常强的引力信号。他们的扫描仪显示那个隐秘的行星带富含稀有矿石。现在我很怀疑这个消息只是一个玩笑。

我想让你飞到那个行星带去查看一下。如果它真的富含矿石，那么棒极了。如果不是，那么尽快回来告诉我。

messages.en: You still haven't answered me about the mission. I'm assuming that means "no", so I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 关于这个任务你还没给我答复。我猜你想说“不”，那么我另找别人吧。

messages.en: Just tell me no.
messages.zh: 只要回答我“不”就行了。

messages.en: The prospect of walking into a trap doesn't appeal to me. I'm quitting your mission.
messages.zh: 我对踩陷阱不感兴趣。我要退出你的任务。

messages.en: I should have known better than to trust you.
messages.zh: 我早该自己去了解清楚，而不该相信你。

messages.en: Is the prospect of springing a trap really that unnerving? I'm afraid I can't wait for your courage to show up.
messages.zh: 触动这个陷阱的可能性真的这么小吗？恐怕我等不到你展现勇气的时候了。

messages.en: Are you afraid?
messages.zh: 你怕了？

name.ru: Миллион маленьких кусочков (A Million Little Pieces)

messages.en: I'll raze the outpost until nothing is left but fiery debris.
messages.zh: 我会把那空间站炸得就剩一点火芯。

messages.en: Excellent. Don't waste any time. <font color=#FF0000>And remember, you won't make it in in a battleship, so take something smaller.</font>
messages.zh: 太好了，快去吧，别浪费时间。<font color=#FF0000>记住，你没法开一艘战列舰进去，找一艘小点的船。</font>

messages.en: Good stuff. That's why I'm here.
messages.zh: 好。这也正是我为什么在此的原因。

messages.en:
We recently received word that the Gallente have discovered a massive hidden deposit of Prime Arkonor in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and are setting up an industrial mining operation there. Prime Arkonor, as you probably know, is one of the most valuable minerals in the galaxy. And while we can't seem to pin down the location of the field itself, we do know where their processing base is.

Enter the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and wipe out the mining infrastructure they have constructed there. Your objective is the ore processor station itself, but you may want to take out their communications relay first so they can't call for backup. And don't go barging in there in a battleship, either. Try to be a little more subtle.
messages.zh:
我们最近收到情报显示，盖伦特人在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系蕴藏了大量的艾克诺精华岩，而且已经在那里大肆兴建工业基地了。你知道艾克诺精华岩是宇宙中最具价值的矿物之一。尽管我们似乎无法知道该矿产地的精确位置，但我们已经掌握了他们加工地的位置。

请飞往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系将他们建起来的矿业设施端掉。你的目标是矿石处理空间站，但你可以先把他们的通讯中继塔炸掉，这样他们就无法求助增援了。还有，你没法开一艘战列舰进去，尽量找一艘小点的船。

messages.en: I destroyed it all. Those Gallente won't be getting any more of that Arkonor anytime soon.
messages.zh: 我把它彻底炸了。那帮盖伦特人在短期内是不会有任何艾克诺精华岩可用了。

messages.en: Nice work.  I'll keep you in mind when something else comes up.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。以后有事时我还会找你。

messages.en: Listen, I've got enough to worry about without getting the Gallente pissed at me. And there's already plenty of Caldari to mess with out there.
messages.zh: 听着，即使盖伦特人不找我麻烦，我也已经够烦了。再说还有大量加达里人等着我去对付呢。

messages.en: I hope I can find someone else to handle this.
messages.zh: 我希望能够找到其他人来处理这个问题。

messages.en:
I thought as much. Okay. Good.

Try to be a little more subtle.
messages.zh:
我也这么想。好吧，行。
