messages.en: There's a lot of Gallente out there: You might need to call in some big guns on this one. Sorry, I'm done.
messages.zh: 那里的盖伦特人太多了：你最好去找个比较牛的人去干这儿事。不好意思，我走了。

messages.en: Well, I must say — you are not the fearless captain I had thought you were.
messages.zh: 哼，我不得不说，你不是我想象中的那种大无畏飞行员。

messages.en: I'll bring him in safe and sound.
messages.zh: 我会把他安全接来的。

messages.en: Fantastic. Alright, you might as well move out: A chance like this won't come again anytime soon.
messages.zh: 太好了。你最好立刻出发：这样的好机会再来一次就难了。

messages.en: Yes, of course. What is it, {[character]agentID.name}?
messages.zh: 能。要我帮什么忙，{[character]agentID.name}？

messages.en: A high-ranking Gallente officer has experienced a religious conversion and wants to defect to Amarr. This man, Admiral Meledier, has apparently arranged to lead a reconnaissance foray into our space and is holed up in an old outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Get out there and extract him from the rendezvous point.
messages.zh: 一位盖伦特高级将领已经转变了信仰，希望来投靠艾玛。这位将领，梅勒迪尔上将，似乎打算带一种侦察攻击队来我们这里。他现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个旧哨站里。请飞往那里将他接来。

messages.en: Mission accomplished. Admiral Meledier is on board.
messages.zh: 任务完成。梅勒迪尔上将来了。

messages.en: Excellent work. You have done well. Glory to Amarr!
messages.zh: 太棒了。干得漂亮。艾玛万岁！

messages.en: Are you kidding? I'm not going up against an entire squadron of the Gallente Navy!
messages.zh: 你开什么玩笑？我可不会一个人去面对盖伦特海军整个一支队伍。

messages.en: How very disappointing, {[character]player.name}. The Empire will not look with pleasure upon your lack of courage.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}你真让人失望。你的懦弱只会令帝国不满。

messages.en:
A Gallente admiral has seen the light of true faith and experienced a religious conversion. A hand-written, hand-delivered letter — on actual paper! — arrived in the office this morning, expressing Admiral Meledier's desire to defect. Having a high-ranking Gallente officer suddenly join our side could cause tremendous damage to the ability of their capsuleers to wage war against us: His knowledge of their systems and tactics would be staggering.

We want you to go collect him from the rendezvous point in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. You game?
messages.zh:
一名盖伦特海军上将看到了真理的曙光，终于转变了信仰。办公室今早收到一封由专人递送的手写书信，里面表达了梅勒迪尔上将有意愿投靠我们。让一位盖伦特高级将领加入我们可以极大地打击对方的作战能力：他对该星系的了解程度及对战术能力的掌握都是惊人的。

我们要你去约见点{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}接他。去吗？

{[character]player.name}，

由于你一直未能注意到我们发出的消息，梅勒迪尔上将已经被他自己人抓起来投进了大牢。也许你应该回家开垃圾船去，我觉得那蛮适合你的。你的这次失误将被通报整个帝国。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Admiral Meledier
messages.zh: 梅勒迪尔上将

{[character]player.name}，

由于你一直未能注意到我们发出的消息，梅勒迪尔上将已经被他自己人抓起来投进了大牢。也许你应该回家开垃圾船去，我觉得那蛮适合你的。你的这次失误将被通报整个帝国。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Admiral Meledier
messages.zh: 梅勒迪尔上将

messages.en: Their blood will be ours.
messages.zh: 我会为你献上那些矿工的血的。

messages.en: Excellent. Now go and do your work. Never merciful.
messages.zh: 很好。快去行动吧。不要手软。

messages.en: Of course, Sanguine One. Let me prove my loyalty. Who needs bleeding?
messages.zh: 当然。让我以实际行动来表明我的忠诚吧。这次要让谁流血？

messages.en: Several of our brethren were slain by a group of infidel miners encroaching on our territory in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. These outsiders are stealing our precious resources. Go out there and kill them all; bring their cargo back to me.
messages.zh: 最近在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，我们的几位同胞惨遭一群来犯的教外矿工的加害。前往那里把他们都除掉，然后把他们的货物也带回来。

messages.en: The miners have been destroyed, O Sanguine One. Their cargo is in my hold.
messages.zh: 那帮矿工已被清除。他们的货物现在在我的货柜里。

messages.en: You have done well — you've sent a message to those who would encroach on what is ours.
messages.zh: 干得好——你向打算侵犯我们的人发出了一个强烈信号：我们的东西不容侵犯。

messages.en: I will not slay some helpless miners. Can we not just drive them away?
messages.zh: 我不会伤害手无缚鸡之力的矿工。难道我们把他们赶走不行吗？

messages.en: Have you no courage, {[character]player.name}? Do you not follow the sacred creed? Never merciful.
messages.zh: 你胆怯了吗，{[character]player.name}？你打算不遵照圣教条的精神了吗？不要有任何慈悲心肠。

messages.en:
Very good, young capsuleer. Accept the purity of Blood and all will be well with you.

Recently, several of our brethren were slain by a group of infidel miners encroaching on our territory in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. These outsiders are stealing our precious resources. Go out there and kill them all, and then bring their cargo back to me. The Collectors will move in once you've finished the job.
messages.zh:
很好，年轻的飞行员。来接受圣洁血（袭者）的洗礼吧，保你万事顺心。

最近在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，我们的几位同胞惨遭一群来犯的教外矿工的加害。现在这些教外的人正在拿走我们宝贵的资源。快前往那里把他们都除掉，然后把他们的货物也带回来。事成之后收集者便会赶往那里。

messages.en: It sounds like a good deal to me. Sure, I'll help you.
messages.zh: 听上去是件美差，行，我就帮你一把。

messages.en: We've entered the coordinates into your NeoCom, and the recon unit has been installed in your ship. Remember, you won't even know it's there.
messages.zh: 我们已经把位标上传到了你的控制边栏里，那个侦察装置也已经安装到了你船上。提醒你，那玩意儿你是感觉不到的。

messages.en: I'm well, thanks. Do you have any work available?
messages.zh: 很好，谢谢。你有什么活儿让我干吗？

messages.en:
I'd like you to fly to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} posing as a freelance miner; while you're out there, we'll have a reconnaissance module installed in your ship. Go to the asteroid field that we've entered into your NeoCom and mine 2,000 units of Scordite. Of course we'll reimburse you generously for your time and for the ore – the mining mission is just a cover for the recon mission.

While you're mining, the recon module will be scanning the region and monitoring Amarrian activity around the system. You'll never even notice it's there. Once you've finished, head back here and we'll recover the recon unit, take the ore, and reward you for your efforts. I'd advise caution in the area as well: There are lots of miners around, but the Amarr will be suspicious of any vessel that originates from Republic space.
messages.zh:
我要你飞往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}假扮成一位自由矿工；你到了那里后我们会在你船上装一个侦察装置。我们已经把那小行星带的位置上传到了你的控制边栏里，你去那挖2000个单位的灼烧岩来。当然对你付出的时间以及采得的矿石，我们都会慷慨付钱的——这事表面上是个采矿任务，实际上是项侦察任务。

你采矿的时候那侦察装置会自动扫描整个星域，监视艾玛在此星系的一举一动，在此过程中根本就不会察觉到它的存在。一切搞定后你就回来，我们会取下侦察装置，拿走矿石，向你行赏。我建议你谨慎行事：周围虽然有大量矿工，但艾玛对于任何来自共和国的舰船都会起疑心。

messages.en: You can get your recon module back now. I ran into a few Amarrian gnats, but I swatted them away.
messages.zh: 你可以把那侦察装置取下来了。我碰到了几只艾玛苍蝇，但都被我打死了。

messages.en: Fine work, my friend. Here's your reward.
messages.zh: 干得好，朋友。这是你的奖励。

messages.en: Doesn't sound like my kind of job. I'm sure you can find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不喜欢这种活。你另找别人吧。

messages.en: Your loss, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 这是你的损失，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Well, it just so happens that we're in the middle of some operations that might require a capsuleer's assistance.

The Amarrians have been busy lately, building bases and moving fleet resources back and forth along the frontier. We've done recon in several of the systems where the Amarrians have been active, but we recently observed unusual comings and goings in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We think they might be building a base in one of the system's asteroid fields, but we can't be sure as all of our ships are tied down in other locations.

I'd like to install a reconnaissance module in your ship, then have you fly to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} posing as a freelance miner. Go to the asteroid field that we've entered into your NeoCom and mine 2000 units of Scordite. We'll take the ore off your hands when you get back to make sure everything looks aboveboard.

While you're mining, the recon module will be scanning the region and monitoring Amarrian activity around the system. You'll never even notice it's there. Once you've finished, head back here and we'll recover the recon unit, take the ore, and reward you for your efforts.

Note, I'd advise caution. Will you do it, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh:
啊，我们正巧在执行一项任务，或许你能帮忙。

艾玛人最近活动频繁，在前线建造基地及运输军舰物资。我们已经在艾玛人活动的几个星系里展开了侦察行动，但最近在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，我们察觉到了异常情况。我们怀疑他们正在该星系的一个小行星带上建造基地，但由于我们所有的舰船都被派到了其他地方，因此我们还没法确定。

我会在你船上装一个侦察装置，然后要你飞往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}假扮成一位自由矿工。我们已经把那小行星带的位置上传到了你的控制边栏里，你去那挖2000个单位的灼烧岩来。你回来后我们会照样拿掉矿石，这样别人就不会起疑心。

你采矿的时候那侦察装置会自动扫描整个星域，监视艾玛在此星系的一举一动，在此过程中根本就不会察觉到它的存在。一切搞定后你就回来，我们会取下侦察装置，拿走矿石，向你行赏。

我建议你谨慎行事。干不干，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: I'm not the right pilot for this job. I resign.
messages.zh: 我不适合干这活儿。我闪了。

messages.en: I'm sorry to hear that, sorry indeed. You've wasted a valuable opportunity.
messages.zh: 听你这样说真是太遗憾了。你浪费了个绝佳机会。

messages.en: It sounds like a good deal to me. Sure, I'll help you.
messages.zh: 听上去是件美差，行，我就帮你一把。

messages.zh: 我不适合干这活儿。我闪了。

messages.en: I'm sorry to hear that, sorry indeed. You've wasted a valuable opportunity.
messages.zh: 听你这样说真是太遗憾了。你浪费了个绝佳机会。

messages.en: I'll secure the gate for you, piece of cake.
messages.zh: 我会帮你保住那门的，这对我来说是小菜一碟。

messages.en: Make sure you take plenty of ammo-- this gate is the sort of thing our competition will sacrifice almost anything to secure.
messages.zh: 你要尽量多带点弹药——我们的竞争对手会同样拼命力保该门的。

messages.en: It usually is. Please, go on.
messages.zh: 我一般都有先知先觉。请讲。

messages.en:
Our spies have intercepted a leaked transmission from a mining survey crew who reported the discovery of an abandoned jump gate. Now, that may not sound exciting, but based on what the mining crew's description of the gate's position and general design, we think it could be a lost Jovian jump gate, able to access their space.

I want you to travel to the gate coordinates and secure that location until the elite forces arrive. Sounds easy, but it's going to be anything but.
messages.zh:
我们的情报人员截取了一条来自一支采矿探测队的信息，该队伍据称已经发现了一座废弃的星门。这事乍一听可能没啥大不了，但从对该门的位置及总体设计的描述来看，这可能是一座能带我们进入朱庇特领域的朱庇特星门。

我要你前往那里，在精英部队到达之前把那里清理干净。这事听上去很容易，但做起来并非如此。

messages.en: That space is a graveyard now. But it's a secure, Cartel-owned graveyard.
messages.zh: 那地方现在是一座坟场了。不过那里已经被清空了，成了天使掌控的坟场。

messages.en: You've given us the opportunity to study the gate, which could lead to some considerable technological advances. Good work.
messages.zh: 你让我们有机会研究那星门，说不定能导致重大科技突破。干得好。

messages.en: Is this a “take it or leave it” option?  If so, I'll leave it.
messages.zh: 你的意思是“要么接受不然就走”？那我走了。

messages.en: You must've come to the wrong office. Missions for those lacking guts are down the hall, to the right.
messages.zh: 你一定是跑错地方了。适合胆小鬼的任务都在楼下右手边。

messages.en:
Many bars have their fair share of tall tales, but one recurring favorite is that of the fabled “lost Jovian gate.” This tale always follows a similar narrative: the friend-of-a-friend was traveling in one of the outer regions, when, suddenly, his ship dropped out of warp. The crew found themselves in the middle of nowhere, with an inactive jump gate of strange design just in front of them.

As they approached the gate, it suddenly activated, propelling the crew into Jovian space, which was either some sort of utopia or a place of blackest horror. Before the crew could gather any evidence, some sort of danger-- usually a Jovian warship of marvelous design-- immediately appeared to force the pilot back through the gate, undertaking an emergency warp as back on the other side. Invariably, the ship's log was somehow erased. The gate, of course, cannot be rediscovered, and is once more lost to time.
messages.zh:
许多沙龙里都流传着各式各样的奇闻轶事，不过有一则关于“失落的朱庇特之门”故事广为流传。故事大概是这样：话说一位朋友的朋友正在偏远星域旅行，突然之间他的船停止了跃迁飞行。船上船员不知道他们身处何地，面前却横着一堵造型奇特、已经停用的星门。

正当他们向那门靠近的时候，它突然打开了，把船员们统统带入了朱庇特领域，那里不是天堂就是地狱。就在船员想用双眼观察四周情况时，突然一艘设计华丽的朱庇特战舰蹦出，迫使船员们退回星门。之后船上的记录也销声匿迹。这样一来那门就没法再被人发现，逐渐消失在岁月之中。

messages.en: Tales of the Lost Jovian Gate
messages.zh: 失落的朱庇特之门传说

messages.en:
Our spies have intercepted a leaked transmission from a mining survey crew who reported the discovery of an abandoned jump gate. Now, that may not sound exciting, but based on what the mining crew's description of the gate's position and general design, we think it could be a lost Jovian jump gate, able to access their space.

I want you to travel to the gate coordinates and secure that location until the elite forces arrive. Sounds easy, but it's going to be anything but.
messages.zh:
我们的情报人员截取了一条来自一支采矿探测队的信息，该队伍据称已经发现了一座废弃的星门。这事乍一听可能没啥大不了，但从对该门的位置及总体设计的描述来看，这可能是一座能带我们进入朱庇特领域的朱庇特星门。

我要你前往那里，在精英部队到达之前把那里清理干净。这事听上去很容易，但做起来并非如此。

messages.en: What are you doing? Securing the asset before any of the other factions arrived was a matter of timing as well as firepower! I'll find someone else, as you're obviously not up to the task.
messages.zh: 你在搞什么？抢在对手之前保住那星门，时机确实重要，但火力同样重要！看来你明显力不从心，我得另找他人了。

messages.en: We'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 我们另寻他人。

messages.en: It's hell out there! I'm not losing my stuff over some antique jump gate – I quit!
messages.zh: 那里是人间地狱！我不会为了一个老古董大门去牺牲我的东西——我闪了！

messages.en: Get out of my sight.
messages.zh: 滚吧。

messages.en: Do you understand how important this mission was to the Cartel? We're now forced into a major military action to take the gate from the forces established there. Don't think we'll forget your incompetence any time soon.
messages.zh: 你明白这任务对天使的重要性吗？我们现在不得不发动一场大规模进攻将星门从敌人手里夺回。我们会好好记下你这次无能表现的。

messages.en: You've stepped over the line.
messages.zh: 你过分了。

messages.en: I have no problem handling weapons-- have you seen my ship lately? I'll happily broker the deal.
messages.zh: 我知道怎么使用武器——你最近看到我的舰船了吗？我很乐意做这笔买卖的中间人。

messages.en: Get going, champ; they'll be waiting.
messages.zh: 去吧，英雄；他们在等你。

messages.en: When you say "negotiation", I'm assuming you mean "shooting." What's happening?
messages.zh: 当你说“谈判”的时候，我以为你要说的是“开火”。发生什么了？

messages.en:
Certain unofficial militia groups in several Caldari systems are very interested in acquiring themselves some serious firepower. They must also have some well-connected financial backers, as they want to pay top ISK to get their hands on these weapons, and in large quantities, ASAP.

You've got a solid reputation with us, so I want you to broker the deal on my behalf. Meet my man at the rendezvous point provided. He'll have the weapons cache. Everything goes well; the Caldari will show up, you'll trade the stuff, the end. But if the deal goes south, I want you to take out every last one of them and bring the weapons back here.
messages.zh:
加达里星系中的某个非官方军事集团想要挑起战争。他们背后一定有人提供资助，因为他们出很高的价钱想要尽快购买大量武器。

你在我们当中声望很高，所以我想让你代表我去做这笔买卖。去约好的地点跟我的人碰头吧。他知道武器的藏匿地点。事情进展顺利的话，加达里会出现，你把东西交易给他，就结束了。但是如果他们耍诈，我要你把他们全干掉，然后把武器带回来。

messages.en: Well, the "deal" proved to be a straight setup, but I showed them what it means to mess with the Cartel.
messages.zh: 这笔“买卖”肯定是直接的，但我已经让他们清楚了与天使集团作对会是什么下场。

messages.en: Really? I never thought such shady, anonymous characters would even consider betrayal. How about that?
messages.zh: 真的？我可不想这样不明不白，匿名的人会被当作是叛徒的。要是这样怎么办？

messages.en: So, the odds of something going wrong are high enough that you want me to go instead of you? I'll pass, thanks.
messages.zh: 那么，出现状况的几率大到你要让我来代替你去？谢了，我可不去。

messages.en: Easy there, I'm not gonna make you do it. I'll just find another pilot to represent me at the deal.
messages.zh: 放轻松，我没让你去干这事。我会另找一个飞行员代表我去做这笔买卖。

messages.en:
Have you been following the news? All that unrest over in Caldari space? Certain unofficial militia groups in several Caldari systems are very interested in acquiring themselves some serious firepower. They must also have some well-connected financial backers, as they want to pay top ISK to get their hands on these weapons, and in large quantities, ASAP.

You've got a solid reputation with us, so I want you to broker the deal on my behalf. Meet my man at the rendezvous point provided. He'll have the weapons cache. Everything goes well; the Caldari will show up, you'll trade the stuff, the end. But if the deal goes south, I want you to take out every last one of them and bring the weapons back here.
messages.zh:
你看新闻了吗？加达里领域已经十分动荡了。在几个加达里星系中的某个非官方军事集团想要挑起战争。他们背后一定有人提供资助，因为他们出很高的价钱想要尽快购买大量武器。

你在我们当中声望很高，所以我想让你代表我去做这笔买卖。去约好的地点跟我的人碰头吧。他知道武器的藏匿地点。事情进展顺利的话，加达里会出现，你把东西交易给他，就结束了。但是如果他们耍诈，我要你把他们全干掉，然后把武器带回来。

messages.en: If you didn't want the gig, you should've said so to begin with. I'll go find someone who's actually interested and reliable.
messages.zh: 如果你不想去做，当初你就不该那样说。我另找一个对此真正感兴趣和靠得住的人吧。

messages.en: I withdraw our offer.
messages.zh: 我撤销我们的提案。

messages.en: I had a bad feeling about this when I took the mission, and now things are just bad all around. I quit.
messages.zh: 我接受任务的时候就有种不好的感觉，现在到处都是糟糕的事情。我不干了。

messages.en: Let's forgo the exit interview-- just remember that you can't keep messing us around like this and retain all of your body parts.
messages.zh: 别再说下去了——你只要记住，如果你再这样玩我们，你会死无全尸。

messages.en: Because of you, the deal has fallen through. If you weren't one of those “elite” pilots, you'd be out of an airlock by now. Sleep lightly, friend.
messages.zh: 因为你的原因，这笔买卖泡汤了。幸亏你是个“精英”飞行员，否则你早就被丢出船舱了。睡个好觉吧，朋友。

messages.en: A warning.
messages.zh: 一个警告。

messages.en: Hell yeah, let me at ‘em!
messages.zh: 有。我去解决它们！

messages.en: Stellar. Get to it.
messages.zh: 很好。快去吧。

messages.en: That depends. You got something interesting for me?
messages.zh: 这要看帮你什么忙了。有什么有意思的活儿吗？

messages.en: Engage the hostile fleet.  Watch out for reinforcements.  Kill as many as you can and then get out.
messages.zh: 与敌方舰队交火。当心他们的援军。尽量多干掉几个。

messages.en: Man, that was a lot of little ships.  What the heck was that all about?
messages.zh: 伙计，那里有很多小船啊。到底在搞什么名堂啊？

messages.en: Excellent!  Nice shooting out there.
messages.zh: 很好！祝你顺利。

messages.en: Sounds risky. I think I'll pass.
messages.zh: 听上去蛮有风险的。还是算了吧。

messages.en: Oh, so I suppose you want to do something a little less dangerous?
messages.zh: 你大概是想要找些不那么危险的事情来做吧？

messages.en: There are rumors of Angels attempting to outmaneuver their enemies with squads of small ships, sacrificing firepower for mobility. While these are just rumors, there may be some merit to their tactics. Be wary.
messages.zh: 据说天使不惜以牺牲火力为代价，打算用小船与敌人拼速度。虽说是谣言，但该战术本身还是值得推究的。当心点。

messages.en: Look out for the swarm.
messages.zh: 当心敌人扎堆。

messages.en: We have reports of a strange Angel fleet massing in a nearby system.  The reports say they're all small ships, but I'm not sure if I'd trust that.  I need a pilot to round up some mates and go take them out.  You game?
messages.zh: 我们有报告说附加星系有大量天使集结。虽然报告上说都是小船，但我有点不大相信。我需要一位飞行员叫上一帮同伴去把他们解决。你有兴趣吗？

messages.en: Had to send someone else. Sorry, chump.
messages.zh: 找其他人吧。不好意思。

messages.en: Hey.
messages.zh: 嗨。

messages.en: This is too much work. Find some other chump.
messages.zh: 任务太繁重。找其他傻瓜来干吧。

messages.en: Funny, I thought you were a combat pilot.
messages.zh: 真可笑，我竟然还当你是为战斗飞行员。

messages.en: Or were you just too busy watching vids?
messages.zh: 或者你只是忙着看影片？

messages.en: No guts, huh?
messages.zh: 没脾气？

messages.en: I'll take care of the Amarrians for you, happily.
messages.zh: 我帮你治治那些艾玛人，高兴点。

messages.en: I... we appreciate your assistance.
messages.zh: 我……应该是我们感激你的帮助。

messages.en: I just might be, yes. What have you got?
messages.zh: 我只是也许，能行。你有什么事儿。

messages.en:
We think Imperial forces are rebuilding an abandoned CONCORD station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and will be using it to service their vessels, so they may be planning a more long-term presence in the region. These are just the opening moves in the great war, I assure you, but we can't let ourselves be outmaneuvered.

We're short-handed right now, so we're not above hiring independents; we'd like you to take out this station. There may be some Amarrian ships in the area, but we don't anticipate anything like a full-scale defense. Get in, destroy the base, and get out.
messages.zh:
我们发现，帝国的军队正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}重建一座统合部的废弃空间站，很可能用于支援他们的舰只活动，这意味着他们可能在准备一次长期的兵力投放。这些只是一场史诗的开场而已，我可以保证。我们不能在战略上输给别人。

现在我们正缺少人手，所以需要雇用很多个体的战士；我们需要你去把这座空间站铲除掉。那儿可能有一些艾玛舰船防守，但并不是什么坚固的防御。去把那空间站拔掉，你将会获得一笔不错的报酬。

messages.en: Base and enemy vessels destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}. It looks as if the Angel Cartel took some interest in things as well.
messages.zh: 基地和地方舰船已经摧毁，{[character]agentID.name}。看起来好像天使的人再从中牟利。

messages.en: Good work. I guess the Angels really are interested in this sector.
messages.zh: 干得好。我想那些天使的人确实对这块区域很感兴趣。

messages.en: Doesn't interest me. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我不感兴趣，不好意思。

messages.en: Too bad. Soon we're all going to have to help out whether we want to or not.
messages.zh: 真遗憾，过不了多久我们就会身不由己了。

messages.en:
Oh, we have a number of possibilities, but only a few really choice assignments for especially trustworthy capsuleers like yourself.

These are definitely dangerous times, {[character]player.name}. The corsairs are getting bolder, crime is rampant, and the empires are pretty much at war, which will plunge us all into chaos and cost millions of lives. Unfortunately for people like me, there's not much we can do to change the inevitable; all we can do is try to make sure that what comes costs us as little as possible — in lives, worlds, and materials. To that end, I'm overseeing a lot of war prep in this region, and I'm in need of good pilots who know their stuff and aren't afraid to take some risks now and again.

This has been a hot sector lately. The Angel Cartel is especially active, but fortunately for us they're equal opportunity raiders, and have been as hard on the Caldari and the Amarr as they have on us. Amarr, for their part, have been sending in reconnaissance craft, which suggests either that they have designs on this region or they think we'll be using it as a staging area.

In fact, we think Imperial forces are rebuilding an abandoned CONCORD station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and will be using it to service their vessels, so they may be planning a more long-term presence in the region. These are just the opening moves in the great game, I assure you, but we can't let ourselves be outmaneuvered.

We're short-handed right now, so we're not above hiring independents; we'd like you to take out this station. There may be some Amarrian ships in the area, but we don't anticipate anything like a full-scale defense. Get in, destroy the base, and get out, and you'll have earned yourself a nice reward... and helped to keep the Empire out of this sector.
messages.zh:
有多种可能性，但是只有少数像你这样的精英飞行员才能被选中来执行这些重要的任务。

这绝对不是一件简单的任务，{[character]player.name}。这些海贼越来越猖獗了，肆无忌惮的犯罪，而各大国之间又几乎进入全面战争状态，这将把我们都拖下水，成千上万的生命将会因此消失。不幸的是，像我这样的人，面对这种不可避免的灾难却只能束手旁观；我们所能做的只是尽量把损失降到最低，拯救更多的生命，家园，和财产。现在，我正在监管这个星域的战争准备工作，我需要很多很棒的飞行员帮我，他们必须要精通技术而且不怕牺牲。

最近这里成为了一个热点区域。天使企业联合体的人在这儿特别活跃，但不幸的是对于我们来说他们只是一群投机主义者，和艾玛还有加达里一样难对付。至于艾玛，一直都有派遣侦查部队前来，这表示他们要不是对这个星域有什么歹心就是觉得我们将会以此作为跳板向前推进。

实际上，我们发现，帝国的军队正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}重建一座统合部的废弃空间站，很可能用于支援他们的舰只活动，这意味着他们可能在准备一次长期的兵力投放。这些只是一场史诗的开场而已，我可以保证。我们不能在战略上输给别人。

现在我们正缺少人手，所以需要雇用很多个体的战士；我们需要你去把这座空间站铲除掉。那儿可能有一些艾玛舰船防守，但并不是什么坚固的防御。去把那空间站拔掉，你将会获得一笔不错的报酬，更将能让艾玛人远离这块区域。

messages.en: I'm taking more damage than I expected. I need to bail out of this mission, {[character]agentID.name}. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我受到的伤害比我预想的要多，这事儿我不干了，{[character]agentID.name}。不好意思。

messages.en: This isn't going to look good to my superiors, {[character]player.name}, but I accept your decision.
messages.zh: 我的上司肯定将会对此不满意，{[character]player.name}，但是我理解你的决定。

messages.en: I'll need to round up my wingmen, but consider that shipyard dust.
messages.zh: 我得要去集合我的队友了，不过你完全可以想象那个船坞已经变成了宇宙尘埃。

messages.en: Excellent. Fight well.
messages.zh: 很好，你打的很优秀。

messages.en: You need something handled?
messages.zh: 你有情况需要帮助么？

messages.en: Destroy the three enemy shipyards and the control tower at the specified location.  Defend yourself and destroy any resistance.  You may need backup for this one.
messages.zh: 摧毁指定地点的三个敌人船坞以及那个控制塔。保护好自己，消灭一切抵抗力量，你可能需要援助。

messages.en: The shipyard is down.
messages.zh: 船坞已经被摧毁了。

messages.en: Unbelievable. You destroyed the shipyard and their fleet. And you came back, which is a bonus.
messages.zh: 无法相信。你把他们的船坞和舰队都消灭了，而且还完好的回来了，令人惊讶！

messages.en: Sounds risky. I'll pass.
messages.zh: 这听起来很危险。我不干。

messages.en: Oh, so I suppose you want to do something a little less dangerous?
messages.zh: 你大概是想要找些不那么危险的事情来做吧？

messages.en:
The Republic needs your help with this one. We've discovered one of the facilities of a corporation that's a major supplier for the Amarrian Navy. By destroying it, we'll deliver a serious blow to their military buildup, which can only help the Republic.

Expect major resistance on this-- you'll need some backup of your own. Think you can handle this?
messages.zh:
共和国需要你的帮助。我们发现一个敌人的造船设施，它专门为艾玛海军提供支持。如果能够将它摧毁，我们就能够给他们的军工供给线造成很严重的破坏，这将对共和国带来很大的优势。

你要最好准备对付强大的抵抗——可能需要队友的帮助。你能应付得了么？

messages.en: I'll just get someone who has some balls, then.
messages.zh: 那我还是去找个有胆量的人来做好了。

messages.en: Time's up.
messages.zh: 时间到。

messages.en: Okay, this is a bit much. I'm gonna have to quit.
messages.zh: 唉，这是有点过头了，我决定退出。

messages.en: I thought you were a warrior of the Republic. I must've been thinking of somebody else.
messages.zh: 我以为你是共和国的战士。大概是我看走眼了。

messages.en: People were counting on you!
messages.zh: 大家都看着你呢！

messages.en: No guts, huh?
messages.zh: 没脾气？

messages.en: I will do anything necessary to ensure that the Federation remains a bastion of freedom!
messages.zh: 我会尽力确保联邦依旧是个自由天堂！

messages.en: Excellent. Now, get out there and catch this scumbag. And vaporize the smugglers as well. They're not our main targets, but eliminating a few of them should help you let off some steam.
messages.zh: 很好。现在就请出发逮住这人渣。把那帮非法贩售者也解决掉。他们虽然不是我们的主要目标，但把他们弄掉一些有助于你沉稳作战。

messages.en: If you're paying well, then you're right — I am perfect for it.
messages.zh: 如果你给的报酬够丰厚，那你说得对——我是该任务的合适人选。

messages.en:
A customs officer has long been suspected of taking bribes from the Amarr. There is an old smuggler's gate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that is supposed to have been deactivated, but lately ships have been registered coming through it. We believe it is the customs officer, allowing illegal slavers to bypass our normal checkpoints and bring slaves through the Federation.

We want you to fly out to the stargate and catch him in the act. Once you do, you're free to eliminate him with extreme prejudice.
messages.zh:
我们一直怀疑有个海关官员接受艾玛的行贿。{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那里有一个按理说应该是已经停用的旧的非法贩售者星门，但最近记录显示有船通过了该星门。我们相信这一切是那官员所为，他让那些非法奴役者绕过了常规检查站，在联邦境内偷运劳工。

我们要你飞往那里把他逮个正着。抓住他之后你就随意处置他。

messages.en: You were right: the customs official was letting slaves into the Federation. But he won't be doing so any longer.
messages.zh: 你是对的：那海关官员确实把劳工放进来了。不过他也就到此为止了。

messages.en: Good work. The Federation does its utmost to make sure our enemies cannot undermine our way of life, and you've struck a great blow today in that pursuit.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。联邦总是尽全力确保我们的敌人不会破坏我们的生活方式，你今天做出了漂亮一击。

messages.en: Shouldn't this really be something the police could take care of?
messages.zh: 这事难道不应有警察来管吗？

messages.en: I am surprised. I wouldn't have taken you for someone who'd allow such an injustice to continue.
messages.zh: 我无语了。我不应该把你当成是一个路见不平拔刀相助的人。

messages.en:
It is a sad day when you cannot trust your own citizens, don't you agree? Well, today is a sad day. You see, one of our customs agents may be accepting bribes. What's worse, he may actually be helping those Amarr slaver scum smuggle slaves through the Federation.

We have long suspected the officer, but never had any concrete proof. He has been incredibly careful in covering his tracks. But finally, we think we've got him. There's an old smuggler's stargate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that's supposed to be inactive. It seems the transmission logger isn't inactive, though, and it recently sent us a traffic report… and several industrial ships belonging to "Imperial Human Resources," a well-known Amarrian slave company, were recorded passing through the gate.

We believe the customs official is the one opening the gate for the smugglers, and he just left the station a short time ago. We planted a bug on his ship, so we have his current location. I want you to fly out there, catch the customs official in the act of opening the gate, and destroy him.
messages.zh:
当你无法相信你自己国家同胞的时候，这注定是一个悲伤时刻。今天便是这样一种时刻。我们的一个海关官员可能有受贿行为。更糟的是，他可能还协助艾玛人在联邦境内偷运劳工。

其实我们怀疑他已经很久了，但一直没有具体证据。他非常注意掩盖自己的踪迹。不过现在，我想我们终于找到他了。{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那里有一个按理说应该是已经停用的旧的非法贩售者星门。但星门上的记录器似乎还在运转，最近它向我们发来了一些交通报告……记录上显示有几艘隶属于艾玛一家著名劳工公司“帝国人力资源”的工业舰通过了该星门。

我们相信为非法贩售者打开星门的就是那腐败官员，他现在刚刚离开一座空间站。我们在他船上安放了一个偷听器，因此我们知道他目前的位置。我要你赶往那里，在他打开星门的时候抓住他，然后把他干掉。

{[character]player.name}，

你没意识到这事的严重性对吧？由于你等了这么长时间才来回复我的要求，我早就派出其他人去干这活儿了。在你证明你值得相信之前别来找我了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Justice cannot wait
messages.zh: 公正不容等待

messages.en: Great. Unless something is done, this problem will just continue to grow. I never thought you would be so selfish.
messages.zh: 很好。除非有人站出来，不然这问题只会继续搞大。我真没料到你做人这么自私。

{[character]player.name}，

由于你动作太慢，那腐败官员又放入一批劳工船进入联邦领域。更糟的是他听到了我们要采取行动的风声，已经逃了。你把这一切干得真不错。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: The official has escaped
messages.zh: 官员已逃

messages.en: Sure, I'll give it a shot, {[character]agentID.name}. When do I leave?
messages.zh: 好，我去干，{[character]agentID.name}。什么时候出发？

messages.en: ASAP, {[character]player.name}. See you when you get back.
messages.zh: 你要尽快，{[character]player.name}。回头见。

messages.en: I've been busy. What've you got cooking?
messages.zh: 我很忙。你做了什么好吃的？

messages.en:
There's a badly damaged Gallente convoy nearby. One or two of the vessels may be capable of defending themselves, but we don't think they're up to much of a fight. We want you to head out there; finish them off and get as much of that salvage as you can. Somewhere in all that cargo and salvage there's a sealed container of great value to the Cartel, so we'll provide you with a generous bonus if you get it back to us intact.

Oh, yes, one more thing... The Gallente convoy got off a distress signal, so you might have to contend with a Gallente rescue mission. And we've heard some chatter from the Serpentis saying that they might be sending ships soon, so best be on your guard. Our intelligence says that neither of those factions has very much in the way of resources in the area, so you shouldn't have too much to do.

Things might get dicey, but I'm sure it's nothing you can't handle.
messages.zh:
附近有一支损失惨重的盖伦特护卫队。其中一两艘舰船或许还能自我保护一下，但我觉得他们无法再进行战斗了。我们想要你到那儿去；把他们解决掉，并尽可能多地带些物资回来。船上的货柜中有一个密封的集装箱，里面装着对天使集团来说价值巨大的东西，如果你能把它原封不动地带回来，我们会给你一笔丰厚的奖金。

哦对了，还有一件事…… 盖伦特护卫队发出了一条求救信号，所以你可能会遭遇盖伦特救援队。我们还从天蛇那里听到一些传闻，说他们很快就会派遣舰船，所以你最好提高警惕。我们的情报说他们在本地区并没有很多人手，所以你不会遇到过多的麻烦。

可能会有危险，但我相信没有你搞不定的事情。

messages.en: You were definitely low-balling the risk, {[character]agentID.name}. Here's your precious container.
messages.zh: 你显然隐瞒了风险，{[character]agentID.name}。这是你那宝贵的集装箱。

messages.en: I can't imagine why you're complaining. You got the job done, after all.
messages.zh: 我不知道你在抱怨些什么。你毕竟完成了这份工作。

messages.en: I think you're low-balling the risk here. I'll look for opportunities elsewhere.
messages.zh: 我觉得你隐瞒了风险。我还是去别处找工作吧。

messages.en: Your loss, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 这是你的损失，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
There's a badly damaged Gallente convoy nearby. One or two of the vessels may be capable of defending themselves, but we don't think they're up to much of a fight. We want you to head out there; finish them off and get as much of that salvage as you can. Somewhere in all that cargo and salvage, there's a sealed container of great value to the Cartel, so we'll provide you with a generous bonus if you get it back to us intact.

Oh, yes, one more thing... The Gallente convoy got off a distress signal, so you might have to contend with a Gallente rescue mission. And we've heard some chatter from the Serpentis saying that they might be sending ships soon, so best be on your guard. Our intelligence says that neither of those factions has very much in the way of resources in the area, so you shouldn't have too much to do.

Things might get dicey, but I'm sure it's nothing you can't handle.
messages.zh:
附近有一支损失惨重的盖伦特护卫队。其中一两艘舰船或许还能自我保护一下，但我觉得他们无法再进行战斗了。我们想要你到那儿去；把他们解决掉，并尽可能多地带些物资回来。船上的货柜中有一个密封的集装箱，里面装着对天使集团来说价值巨大的东西，如果你能把它原封不动地带回来，我们会给你一笔丰厚的奖金。

哦对了，还有一件事…… 盖伦特护卫队发出了一条求救信号，所以你可能会遭遇盖伦特救援队。我们还从天蛇那里听到一些传闻，说他们很快就会派遣舰船，所以你最好提高警惕。我们的情报说他们在本地区并没有很多人手，所以你不会遇到过多的麻烦。

可能会有危险，但我相信没有你搞不定的事情。

messages.en: Holy crap, where are all those ships coming from? I'm taking too much damage. I quit!
messages.zh: 尽是些废话，那些舰船都是哪来的？我的损失太大了。我不干了！

messages.en: I never said you wouldn't get your hair a little mussed. I'm sorry that the mean ol' bad guys scratched up your precious paint job.
messages.zh: 我可没说你会毫发无损。我很抱歉卑鄙的坏蛋们弄坏了你宝贵的画作。

messages.en: You really must not like people who grew up planetside. Anyway, I'll take care of it.
messages.zh: 你肯定不喜欢那些星球上成长起来的人。算了，我来处理这些吧。

messages.en: The sooner you deal with this, the better. I hate having to interact with those petty land-lice.
messages.zh: 这事儿解决得越快越好，我很讨厌和这些地头蛇打交道。

messages.en:
You know what they say about assumptions, right? …something about, uh, sums and options… I think.

Why am I here again?
messages.zh:
你知道他们怎么看待假设么？……关于，呃，加法和选择……我想。

我来这儿是干嘛的？

messages.en:
Someone has illegally hijacked a broadcast satellite and is using it to play a message denigrating a local politician running for office. I could care less, but those sand-sifters won't stop nagging me about it. We've found the offending satellite, we just need it destroyed — the sooner, the better. That way I'll stop having to hear complaints about it.

Oh, there might be some automated defenses, but they probably won't be that hard to handle.
messages.zh:
有人非法地劫持了我们的一个广播人造卫星，用来广播一些诋毁我们一个地方选举人的信息。我本不想管的，但是这些烦人的政客不停的在半夜吵醒我。我们已经找到了这颗出问题的卫星，只是需要把它给炸掉——越快越好。这样我就可以不再听那些烦人的抱怨声了。

哦， 你要小心那儿可能有的一些自动防御系统，但我想应该不是这么难对付。

messages.en: I've destroyed the satellite, but I think there's something more going on here than meets the eye.
messages.zh: 我摧毁了人造卫星，但是我想在那儿肯定还有更多的这东西。

messages.en: What? Caldari forces protecting that satellite? Great. Just great. Now we'll have to launch a whole investigation into the matter. I might even get sent planetside. I do hate this job sometimes.
messages.zh: 什么？加达里的军队在保护那个人造卫星？很好，太好了，我们要对这事儿进行一次全面调查。我甚至应该派人到星球上去看看。我讨厌这些事情。

messages.en: Wow, you know, I have something more important to do. Like... uh... yeah — no thanks.
messages.zh: 哇噢，我还有些更重要的事情要做。呃……就是……，算了，谢谢。

messages.en: You're really turning me down? If I have to deal directly with those dust-snufflers, I'll scream.
messages.zh: 你就这么让我失望？如果我要亲自去对付这些吃泥巴的人，我会尖叫的。

messages.en:
The Gallente Federation is a massive democracy. It is divided up into several regions, which are subdivided into districts, which are further divided into sub-districts… which make up several individual systems, each of which has one or more planetary governments, each of which further has additional subdivisions. Though every planet follows some basic rules, such as having regular elections with universal suffrage, the systems on each planet are as varied as the Gallente people.

For most observers, planetary politics in the Federation are incredibly tedious. Some, however, count the politics of the planets as the most fascinating and vital part of the democracy. There is a huge amount of bureaucracy involved, which makes it too dense for most to penetrate. But the amount of energy put forth by many individuals (who are unlikely to be remembered once their terms are finished) exemplifies the true spirit of the Federation.
messages.zh:
盖伦特联邦是一个大型的民主国家。它分成了很多个地区，这些地区又分成了很多的行政区，这些行政区有分成了很多分区……他们通常有几个星系的范围，这些分区通常都有一个或者多个行星政府，每一个又有多个下级分区。每个行星都遵循着一定的规则，比如定期的普选，其规则根据不同的地区又有不一样的具体法则。

对于很多旁观者来说，联邦行星政治系统里面的那些事情都是十分单调乏味的。有一些人则把这些行星上的政治活动看成是民主的最为重要的组成部分。这中间有很大的官僚成份，使得任何人想要渗透到这个系统里面都是非常困难的。但是这些使出浑身解数想要把自己的理念注入到这个系统里面的人（通常都会在任期结束后被人们忘得一干二净）将联邦的民主的灵魂放大了。

messages.en: Federation Politics
messages.zh: 联邦政务

messages.en:
Ehh, politics, I believe. Oh, I never get tired of them. Dear, sweet politics. Oh, wait. No. I hate politics.

But without politics, our great democratic and free society would collapse. It's the nature of the beast, I'm afraid. And, well, the Federation has numerous laws to prevent politicians from being abusive with their politicking. Now, some dirtside political office is up for grabs after the incumbent died of a heart attack after a night at a pleasure hub. "Vice Commissioner of Waste Management for the Civic Council" or something unimportant like that.

Normally, we wouldn't even bother with something this trivial. Those silly dirtside hillhuggers and their governments aren't much to look at. But one of them had to go and break some laws, and now it's our job to clean it up. You see, someone has hijacked some broadcast waves and is sending out a constant message denouncing one of the candidates. And because it's a space-based satellite doing the broadcasting, we're the ones that have to deal with it.

Now, we don't know who it is that's making the broadcasts, and frankly, I don't care. As long as they're stopped, I'm happy with it. We've pinned down the offending satellite, so I want you to fly over there and blow it up. There might be some automated defenses, but it's just some mudsucker's place, so they can't be that great.
messages.zh:
唉，我相信是政治在捣鬼。啊，我从来都不会为这些事情感到疲倦。亲爱的政治运动啊。哦，等等。不，我讨厌政治。

但是没有政治，我们伟大的民主和自由社会将会完全的崩溃。这是野兽的本性，我很担心。并且，联邦有多项法律来防止政客滥用他们的权利。现在一些三流政党在当权者死后正在准备公开投标。“民建委员会废物管理办公室副主任” 通常都是这样不是很重要的职位。

一般来说，我们根本就不会去管这些不痛不痒的事情。这些傻傻的三流土财主和他们当权阶级都不值得一看。你知道，有些这种政客劫持了我们的广播人造卫星不停的传送对我们某位政客的诋毁性广播。因为这些卫星都是在太空中的，这就变成了我的事情。

现在，我们不知道是谁在进行广播，老实说，我们也不关心是谁。只要他们能停止这些行为，我就很高兴了。我们已经找到了这颗被劫持信号的人造卫星，我们需要你去把它摧毁掉。那儿可能有一些自动防御系统，但只是一些破烂玩意儿，不能给你构成任何威胁。

{[character]player.name}，

你有没有过某样特别烦人的事情这么缠着你就是不会离开？恩，我的问题就是这个人造卫星。那些舔墙灰的人不停地让这件事情恶化。我的要找人帮我永远的消除这个烦恼。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: I despise land-baggers
messages.zh: 我鄙视那些土财主

messages.en: Hey, I didn't sign up for this when I accepted your mission!
messages.zh: 嘿！当初我们谈的时候可不是这么说的！

messages.en: Great. You can't get the job done, so now I'll have to deal with it even more.
messages.zh: 很好，你成功完成了任务，现在我还要继续完成剩下的事情。

{[character]player.name}，

你一定很讨厌我，是么？那些嗅泥巴的人总是烦恼着我，问我什么时候才会把那个广播人造卫星消除掉。我实在不能忍受他们再向我打电话了。我需要有人帮我解决这个问题。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: I hate sprouts
messages.zh: 我讨厌新生事物

messages.en: I've carried worse around. One politician shouldn't be too bad.
messages.zh: 比这更糟的事我也干过。去接一个政客也就这样了。

messages.en: Hurry over there and get him. The sooner he's back, the sooner I can get rid of him.
messages.zh: 快去把他带来。他回来得越早，我就能越快摆脱他。

messages.en:
Technically, I had nothing to do with getting you into this in the first place. I was just...

Ah, never mind. What do you need?
messages.zh:
技术上来说，并不是我最先把你拉入这事件的。我只是……

哎算了。你想怎么办？

messages.en:
So, it turns out that the Caldari Navy is the one behind those transmissions. The question is, why? Why do the Caldari care who wins some meaningless election on some planetary hovel? That's what we have to find out now. The first step in taking care of this will be to question the candidate they were broadcasting about.

Now, I've received word that the man is vacationing with his family a few systems away. We've already sent word over to have him recalled as a matter of official Federation business. By the time you get there, he should be ready for pick up.
messages.zh:
嗯，结果看起来好像是加达里海军在幕后指使。问题是为什么……为什么加达里会关心谁会赢呢？这只是在一个不起眼的行星上进行的一场无关痛痒的选举而已。我们必须现在去找到这个问题的答案。首先就是把广播里被贬的那个候选人带来进行审问。

我得到消息说目前那家伙正和他家人在离这儿数个星系之远的地方度假。我们已经告诉他事关重大，他必须过来。等你到达那里，他就应该准备好了。

messages.en: I brought the politician back, as asked.
messages.zh: 我按照要求把那政客带来了。

messages.en: Alright, now I've got to go have a little chat with our politician. Come back to me later to see what I've discovered.
messages.zh: 好了，现在我要去和我们的政治家聊一会儿。你过会儿回来看看我能不能了解到一些什么东西。

messages.en: Zzzz... What? Huh? Oh, you should find someone else, I guess, since your proposal's making me fall asleep.
messages.zh: Zzzz……啥？嗯？哦，我想你应该找其他人才对，一听到你这个计划我就想打瞌睡。

messages.en: I suppose I'll have to send someone else to do it for me.
messages.zh: 看起来我得找其他人帮我这个忙了。

messages.en:
Well, it turns out that the Caldari Navy is behind those transmissions. The question is why… Why do the Caldari care who wins some meaningless election on some planetary hovel? That's what we have to find out now. The first step in taking care of this will be to question the candidate they were broadcasting about.

Now, I've received word that the man is vacationing with his family a few systems away. We've already sent word over to have him recalled as a matter of official Federation business. By the time you get there, he should be ready for pick up.

What, I didn't mention that? Yes, you get the great pleasure of taxiing that earthbounder back to us. I know you'll accept, won't you?
messages.zh:
嗯，结果看起来好像是加达里海军在幕后指使。问题是为什么……为什么加达里会关心谁会赢呢？这只是在一个不起眼的行星上进行的一场无关痛痒的选举而已。我们必须现在去找到这个问题的答案。首先就是把广播里被贬的那个候选人带来进行审问。

我得到消息说目前那家伙正和他家人在离这儿数个星系之远的地方度假。我们已经告诉他事关重大，他必须过来。等你到达那里，他就应该准备好了。

什么，我没那样说过吗？恩，你这次很幸运要为那个星球人做司机了。我知道你会接受的，对吧？

{[character]player.name}，

我知道我们心里对那家伙其实一点儿都不关心，但这事儿还是必须得有人去做的。既然你不想做，那我已经派别人去了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: I despise landloafers
messages.zh: 我鄙视陆地上的闲人。

messages.en: I'm too lazy to finish your mission. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我很懒，没法去完成你的任务。不好意思。

messages.en: I don't want to deal with this any more than you do. You're really quitting on me?
messages.zh: 我和你一样最好也不参与这一切。但你说不想干了，是认真的么？

{[character]player.name}，

OK，那家伙第一次发信来问我你在哪儿的时候，我大笑。第二次发信来问的时候，我就笑了一下。第三次，我火了。现在我要爆发了。行动之前，我要派其他人去把那大嘴巴的家伙带来。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: I hate dirtminers
messages.zh: 我讨厌陆地上的闲人。

messages.en: At last, something interesting! I'll do it!
messages.zh: 至少应该是什么有趣的事情！我接了！

messages.en: I've uploaded the location to your NeoCom.
messages.zh: 我已经把坐标上传到你的控制边栏里了。

messages.en: Really? You can't? I would never have guessed.
messages.zh: 真的？你不行？我还真不知道。

messages.en:
Our politician friend managed to annoy a Caldari Navy officer back in the day and now that officer is out for revenge. He's the one behind all these broadcasts. I guess he figured since it was such a meaningless, tiny local election, the Federation wouldn't stop his revenge.

I guess he doesn't know that we'll take any opportunity there is to blow up a few Caldari Navy vessels.

We've tracked his base down and want you to go over there and take him out. The sooner this headache is over, the better.
messages.zh:
我们的政客以前惹恼了一个加达里的海军官员，现在这个官员出来寻找机会报仇了。他就是在背后操控广播的那个人。我猜他自从这还是一个没有意义的小型选举的时候就已经开始干了，联邦不会去阻止他的复仇。

我想这个海军官员已经发现，因为这事儿只是一个小小的没有什么特别意义的选举活动，联邦政府也不会专门来管他复仇的闲事儿。

我们已经找到了他的基地所在，你过去把他消灭掉。这头疼的事情能够越快解决越好。

messages.en: The Caldari have learned not to mess with our local district elections.
messages.zh: 加达里人已经学会了不要在我们的地区选举里面捣鬼了。

messages.en: Good. Of course, now everyone thinks our politician's some great hero, important enough for the Caldari Navy to try and get rid of him. The fool will probably become President some day. Makes my skin crawl just thinking about it.
messages.zh: 很好。当然，现在每个人都把我们的这位政客当成是英雄，这对于加达里来说已经足够算是个把他铲除的理由了。什么时候这个蠢蛋很有可能成为我们的总统。我一想起这事儿就浑身不舒服。

messages.en: I'm sorry, but I'm not going to handle someone else's bully.
messages.zh: 很抱歉，我没兴趣管这样的闲事儿。

messages.en: Nnnggg.... You're just trying to give me an aneurysm, aren't you?
messages.zh: 呀呀呀……你简直都要让我气死了，不是么？

messages.en:
No, it's true. I know I always speak glowingly of them, but really, they get under my skin.

Anyway, my questioning finally got some answers out of that damn fool politician. It turns out that there is no vast conspiracy after all. Not really. It turns out the idiot is just a little too loud-mouthed for his own good. He used to be in the Navy… before he was discharged because he kept fainting every time he went onto the battlefield. But before he demonstrated that bit of heroism, he managed to piss off a Caldari Navy officer by throwing up on him during a diplomatic summit.

Apparently, the officer in question never lived it down and still gets heckled about the event to this day. And now he's out for revenge by trying to disrupt our man, the stupid politician. It's… it's so tedious and… stupid.

Anyway, I guess this officer figured that, since it was such a meaningless little election, the Federation wouldn't bother to interfere with his revenge. Heh. I guess he doesn't know that we'll take any opportunity there is to blow up a few Caldari Navy vessels. We've tracked his base down and want you to go over there and take him out.

The sooner this headache is over, the better.
messages.zh:
不，这是真的。我知道我总是谈他们谈到热血沸腾，但真的，他们确实已经让我烦得不得了。

不管怎么说，那个该死的傻子政客终于对我的质询有了回应。看起来这中间并没有什么巨大的阴谋，一点也没有。事实上只是这个傻瓜嘴巴太漏风。他以前在海军里呆过……后来被从前线调走了，因为每次到战场上他都会晕过去。在他展现那可怜的英雄主义之前，他惹恼了一个加达里海军官员，他再一次外交峰会的时候说了那个海军官员很多坏话。

很显然故事中的这位海军官员并没有能够从这事儿中熬过去，甚至是到今日还耿耿于怀。他现在着手开始复仇，想要扰乱我们的这位愚蠢的政客。这真的是……非常乏味和……愚昧的一件事儿。

不管怎样，我想这个海军官员已经发现，因为这事儿只是一个小小的没有什么特别意义的选举活动，联邦政府也不会专门来管他复仇的闲事儿。呃，我想他也不知道我们会在那儿冒险爆掉几艘加达里的海军舰船的意义。

这头疼的事情能够越快解决越好。

{[character]player.name},

看来冷漠的心态在这样的英雄主义中还算是起到了作用。我们的加达里海军官员并没有被打入到泥土里面而是逃之夭夭了。或许把他废掉是个更好的选择，但，好吧。

{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Inaction carries the day
messages.zh: 为碌碌无为而雀跃

messages.en: It turns out those Caldari Navy guys are pretty tough. I quit.
messages.zh: 那些加达里海军的人太牛了，我不干了。

messages.en: You couldn't even take care of one lone Caldari officer? What kind of pod pilot are you?
messages.zh: 你连一个独身一人的加达里官员都不能解决？你是个什么破烂飞行员啊。

{[character]player.name}，

恩，看起来这个加达里的官员对他的复仇计划并不是真正很关心，他已经打包行李搬走了。我们没能惩罚到他真是个遗憾，但至少他不再烦到我了。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: Problem solved
messages.zh: 问题解决了

messages.en: Of course I'll do it.
messages.zh: 当然，我会做的。

messages.en: I knew you were the right person for the job. Take care, as this holo star does have bodyguards.
messages.zh: 我知道你一定是最合适完成这项任务的人。小心，这些明星都有贴身保镖。

messages.en: I heard you had a job for me.
messages.zh: 我听说你有任务要派给我。

messages.en: The daughter of a prominent Holder has eloped with a famous Gallente holo star, despite having a proper marriage with an Amarr man awaiting her at home. Retrieve her from this seducer and kill him.
messages.zh: 一位知名的主席的女儿不顾自己已经和一名艾玛男子订婚的事实，与一名盖伦特的明星私奔了。把她找回来，把那花花公子干掉。

messages.en: I, uh, found the girl. You take her.
messages.zh: 我，呃，找到了这个女孩。你带着她。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you. You are indeed a faithful Amarr; your reputation will only benefit from the work you have done.
messages.zh: 我知道我可以依赖你。你是个十分可靠的艾玛人;但是只有干得好才会有良好的声誉。

messages.en: I don't have time to chase down some runaway. I have more important things to do.
messages.zh: 我可没时间去追踪那些逃跑的人。我有更重要的事要做。

messages.en: And I thought you were a good Amarr. You cannot expect to keep a good reputation if you won't put in any effort.
messages.zh: 我想你应该是个不错的艾玛人。如果你不付出，那你可别妄想你的好名声还会继续下去。

messages.en: The Gallente are great lovers of wealth and luxury, and especially of beauty. They produce countless holos, from the cheapest porn flicks to high-priced stage shows and beyond. The stars of these productions are greatly esteemed for the entertainment they provide, and therefore hold influence and power in some circles.
messages.zh: 盖伦特人是金钱和奢侈品的狂热者，还有他们特别爱美。他们打造了无数的明星，从低级的违禁片到高价的舞台剧等等。因为这些明星给人们带来的快乐，他们非常受尊重，并且因此在有些圈子里有影响有权利。

messages.en: Holo Stars
messages.zh: 明星

messages.en:
Yes, I have work for you. The daughter of a prominent Holder has been seduced by a famous Gallente holo star. She's run away with him, likely planning to get married as soon as she is out of her family's reach.

She was already betrothed to a perfectly suitable Amarrian man, a match approved by her family and her faith. Obviously, she must be brought back into the fold.

You will be well rewarded if you can deliver her back to her family before she can shame herself any further. If you destroy this seducer in the process-- well, that's all the better.
messages.zh:
是的，我已经听从你的指挥了。一位知名主席的女儿被一名盖伦特明星勾引，跟着他跑了。他们似乎计划着一旦她的家人找不到她，她就马上和那个明星结婚。

她之前已经和一名门当户对的艾玛男子订婚了，那个人无论是家庭还是信仰都与她十分般配。显然，她一定得回来。

如果你在她进一步干出傻事以前把她带回来，那你就会得到丰厚的赏金。如果你同时把那花花公子也干掉--那再好不过了。

messages.en: Thanks to you, {[character]player.name}, the Holder's daughter has married the Gallente holo star and brought shame to her family and to the Amarr. Do not think that you can let things like this happen and without suffering any consequences.
messages.zh: 多谢了，{[character]player.name}。主席的女儿与盖伦特的一位明星结了婚，这件事让她的家庭和所有艾玛人蒙羞。不要妄想你可以让这种事情发生下去，而不付出任何代价。

messages.en: Shameful marriage
messages.zh: 可耻的婚姻

messages.en: I don't have time to chase down some runaway. I have more important things to do.
messages.zh: 我可没时间去追踪那些逃跑的人。我有更重要的事要做。

messages.en: And I thought you were a true Amarr. You cannot expect to keep a good reputation if you fail to do these jobs.
messages.zh: 我想你应该是个真正的艾玛人。如果你这件事干不好，那你可别妄想你的好名声还会继续下去。

messages.en: Thanks to you, {[character]player.name}, the Holder's daughter has married the Gallente holo star and brought shame to her family and to the Amarr. Do not think that you can let things like this happen without suffering any consequences.
messages.zh: 多谢了，{[character]player.name}。主席的女儿与盖伦特的一位明星结了婚，这件事让她的家庭和所有艾玛人蒙羞。不要妄想你可以让这种事情发生下去，而不付出任何代价。

messages.en: Shameful marriage
messages.zh: 可耻的婚姻

messages.en: Nothing would please me more than to put a stop to this plot.
messages.zh: 没有事情能比阻止这一阴谋更让我高兴了

messages.en: Wonderful! Remember to take care – Minmatar are always hard to break.
messages.zh: 干得好！要小心啊——米玛塔尔可是很难对付的。

messages.en: I heard that you needed someone willing to do a combat mission.
messages.zh: 我听说你要找人去完成一项战斗的任务。

messages.en: The Minmatar are attempting to form an alliance with the Khanid Kingdom in order to gain an ally against the Amarr Empire. This could be dangerous to the Empire, as the Khanid may know much that could help Amarr's enemies. Find, intercept and destroy the Minmatar ambassador's vessel and its escorts and bring the ambassador back for interrogation.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔计划要与卡尼迪王国组成同盟来对付艾玛帝国。这非常危险，因为卡尼迪知道太多有关艾玛的事情，那对艾玛的敌人十分有帮助。找到米玛塔尔大使的船以后拦截下来连同护卫一起摧毁掉并把大使带回来审问。

messages.en: I found and destroyed the Minmatar ambassador's ship. I've brought you the "envoy" for questioning.
messages.zh: 我已经找到并摧毁了米玛塔尔大使的船。我把“大使”带来了，你可以审问他。

messages.en: Excellent. Thank you for your efforts.  Here is your reward.
messages.zh: 干得好。谢谢你的帮忙。这是你的报酬。

messages.en: I don't see this as a threat to us. Khanid might not conform as he should, but he is still Amarr.
messages.zh: 我没把这当成对我们的威胁。卡尼迪可能不会做他应该做的事情，但他仍然是艾玛人。

messages.en: I am disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}. I thought you would see the importance of this mission.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我对你非常失望。我本以为你能够意识这次任务的重要性。

messages.en:
The Amarr Empire is ruled by the Emperor and the five Heirs. When the Emperor dies, these Heirs go through a set of ritual competitions to become the next Emperor.

In 22762 AD, Khanid was the Heir of one of the other five families, but he refused to acknowledge the election of the new Emperor. He also refused to commit ritual suicide, which is done by the remaining Heirs in order to keep resentments and past problems from interfering with the new ruler's regime.

Instead of being obedient and faithful, Khanid fled Amarr and set out to create his own empire. He formed the Khanid Kingdom, which is also known as the “Dark Amarr.”
messages.zh:
艾玛帝国是由国王和五名后嗣统治的。国王一死，这些后嗣就要进行一系列竞赛仪式来选出下一任的国王。

公元22762年，卡尼迪是五个后嗣家庭的成员，但是他拒绝承认新一任国王的选举。他也拒绝自尽，一种断绝其他后嗣的仇恨以及历史问题，以免干扰新国王的统治的仪式。

卡尼迪本该顺从又忠心，然而他却逃离了艾玛建立了自己的帝国。他创建了卡尼迪王国，也称作“黑暗艾玛”。

messages.en: Dark Amarr
messages.zh: 黑暗艾玛

messages.en:
That is correct.

The Minmatar, deceitful devils that they are, are attempting to form an alliance with the Khanid Kingdom. Khanid is a traitor to our beliefs, and he knows much about us that the Minmatar could exploit if they manage to forge an alliance.

We cannot risk the chance that the Minmatar might succeed. Go find the Minmatar vessel and destroy it before it reaches Khanid. Take care to bring the ambassador back for questioning. Be cautious, however – the Minmatar have the distasteful habit of thinking they can fight back against us.
messages.zh:
对。

米玛塔尔，这群到处骗人的恶魔，正计划和卡尼迪帝国组成联盟。卡尼迪背叛了我们的信念，他对我们了解甚多，如果他们组成了联盟，那米玛塔尔就会获得很多情报。

我们不能让米玛塔尔成功。在他们到达卡尼迪帝国之前消灭掉米玛塔尔的船。要把大使带回来审问。但是要小心--米玛塔尔的思维习惯真是叫人作呕，他们可能会对我们发起反击。

messages.en: You should make decisions more quickly, capsuleer. As a result of your failure to destroy the ship, the Minmatar ambassador met with someone within the Khanid Kingdom; whether or not an alliance will be forged is still unknown.
messages.zh: 你本该快点做决定的，飞行员。就是因为你未能摧毁米玛塔尔大使的船，他在卡尼迪王国内和一个人见了面。他们究竟是否会结成联盟，我们还不知道。

messages.en: For shame
messages.zh: 真丢脸

messages.en: I don't have time to hunt down these Minmatar vessels. You'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我可没时间去追捕这些米玛塔尔的船。你还是找其他人吧。

messages.en: I thought you were a better pod pilot than that. A true Amarr would understand how much this refusal could damage a reputation.
messages.zh: 我本以为你是个比现在更好的飞行员。真正的艾玛人应该明白如果推却这次任务将会对他的声誉造成严重的危害。

messages.en: I cannot believe that you could not find and destroy the Minmatar vessels. You are not the pod pilot I thought you were. As a result of this failure, the Khanid Kingdom may have leaked dangerous secrets to the Minmatar.
messages.zh: 真是让人难以置信，你竟然无法找到并摧毁米玛塔尔的舰队。你不是我认识的那个飞行员了。这次失败直接导致了卡尼迪王国把一些危险的机密泄露给了米玛塔尔。

messages.en: For shame
messages.zh: 真丢脸

messages.en: I'll find them and bring them back.
messages.zh: 我会找到他们并把他们带回来的。

messages.en: God's will be with you. You will be greatly rewarded when you bring them back.
messages.zh: 上帝与你同在。当你把他们带回来后，会得到丰厚的奖励。

messages.en: I've heard rumors about a slave uprising.
messages.zh: 我听说了劳工抗争的传言。

messages.en: Some Minmatar slaves have rebelled, killing several Amarr and stealing a ship. Track them down so that they can be returned to their owner.
messages.zh: 一些米玛塔尔劳工反叛了，打死了几个艾玛人，并拿走了一艘舰船。追踪他们并把他们抓住，还给他们的主人。

messages.en: I've brought the slaves back.
messages.zh: 我把劳工带回来了。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you to retrieve those upstarts. Stay close: I suspect I'll have another mission for you shortly.
messages.zh: 我知道我能指望你来补偿那些暴发户。别走远：我猜想我马上就有其他任务给你做。

messages.en: They aren't worth the trouble.
messages.zh: 他们不值得我如此大费周章。

messages.en: Be careful or people will begin to think you support the barbarians.
messages.zh: 要小心人们会开始怀疑你支助野蛮人。

messages.en:
When the Amarr Empire first came across the Minmatar, they began raiding this new people for slaves as they had with every other race they'd come across, a practice that is sanctified and even encouraged by the Amarr religion.

Though the Minmatar have since rebelled and managed to expel the Amarr and their allies from Minmatar space, approximately a third of all Minmatar are still enslaved under the Amarr.
messages.zh:
当艾玛帝国第一次邂逅米玛塔尔的时候，他们开始劫掠这些新的种族作为劳工，正如他们对其他任何种族所做的一样，这是一种被神圣化的行为，甚至受到艾玛宗教的支持。

尽管米玛塔尔因此而反抗，并尝试把艾玛帝国及其盟友赶出米玛塔尔空间，仍有三分之一的米玛塔尔人被艾玛人奴役着。

messages.en: Amarr/ Minmatar Relations
messages.zh: 艾玛/米玛塔尔关系

messages.en:
So the news is out.

It's true, some slaves have rebelled, and their actions have caused the deaths of several people. They have stolen a ship, and thus far they've managed to evade capture as well. This is insult on top of injury and cannot be tolerated.

I want you to track them down so that they can be returned to their owner.
messages.zh:
看来这条消息已经传开了。

这是真的，有些劳工反叛了，并且，他们的行动导致了数人死亡。他们拿走了一艘舰船，并企图借此逃避追捕。这无异于在我们的伤口上撒盐，绝对不可容忍。

我希望你追踪他们，并把他们抓住，还给他们的主人。

messages.en: Slaves escaped
messages.zh: 劳工逃跑了

messages.en: These slaves aren't worth the trouble I've gone to; get someone else to hunt them down.
messages.zh: 这些劳工不值得我如此大费周章；找其他人来抓他们吧。

messages.en: Be careful or people will begin to think you support the barbarians.
messages.zh: 要小心人们会开始怀疑你支助野蛮人。

messages.en: Inaction speaks, pilot. Be careful or people will begin to think you support the barbarians.
messages.zh: 你的不作为是会传递某些信息的，飞行员。要小心人们会开始怀疑你支助野蛮人。

messages.en: Slaves escaped
messages.zh: 劳工逃跑了

messages.en: I'm up for anything that will embarrass the Caldari. I'll do it.
messages.zh: 只要是跟加达里对着干，我都愿意。我去办。

messages.en: Well done. The system coordinates have been sent to your NeoCom.
messages.zh: 干得好。星系坐标已经上传到你的数控系统。

messages.en: What's up, {[character]agentID.name}? I take it you have some work for me.
messages.zh: 怎么了，{[character]agentID.name}？我猜你有活要给我干吧。

messages.en:
We think that Mordu's Legion may be planning on hitting one of our bases in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. What we'd like you to do is get over there and take up position near the station. When the Legion ships arrive, destroy them or drive them off. We'll be monitoring things by video drone, so we'll have clear evidence of the attack.

Oh, and the Legion may be coming in strength, so you might want to bring some friends along.
messages.zh:
我们认为莫德军团可能在计划进攻我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一处基地。我们希望你过去，到空间站附近就位。当莫德军团的舰船到达时，干掉他们或者把他们引开。我们会通过无人录像机来进行监控，并将取得这次袭击的确凿证据。

哦对了，莫德军团可能会派遣大量兵力，所以你最好带上几个朋友。

messages.en: The Mordu's Legion fleet is defeated. And the Caldari have egg all over their faces.
messages.zh: 莫德军团的舰队已经被打败了。加达里被打得体无完肤。

messages.en: Excellent. Your reward has been entered into your interstellar account. Many thanks, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 很好。你的奖励已经打入你的星际帐户了。非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: That sounds awfully fishy to me. I prefer to let other people get dirty with the propaganda machine.
messages.zh: 听起来很不可靠。我宁可让别人去做。

messages.en: That isn't what we're doing at all! But it's obvious to me you don't want the job, so forget it anyway.
messages.zh: 这不是我们要做的事情！但是很显然你不想做这份工作，那就别去管它了。

messages.en:
Mordu's Legion is descended from a group of Intaki military personnel who sided with the Caldari State when it chose to secede from the Gallente Federation. It was led by a brilliant Caldari officer named Muryia Mordu, who fought the Gallente with great distinction.

After the war, the Intaki were given land around Waschi City on the planet Kamokor IV, but soon racial tensions flared between them and Caldari nationalists, who called for the expulsion of all foreigners. The Intaki called upon their hero Mordu for assistance, and the aging commander emerged from retirement to lead an independent mercenary group dedicated to preserving Intaki rights and property. Mordu's Legion helped defeat the nationalists and made peace with the Caldari authorities.

Today, the Legion remains a well-known mercenary band that often works closely with the Caldari State. Many Intaki continue to suffer discrimination at the hands of the xenophobic Caldari and have grown disillusioned with life in the corporate state. Nevertheless, Mordu remains a revered character among the Intaki, many of whom see him as a savior who will one day return to deliver his adopted people from the repression and poverty that they suffer from today.
messages.zh:
莫德军团原先是一个印塔基军事集团，当加达里合众国从盖伦特联邦中脱离出来时，他们站在合众国这边。莫德军团由一位名叫穆瑞亚·莫德的杰出加达里官员所率领，他以出众的表现与盖伦特作着斗争。

战争结束后，印塔基得到了卡莫克IV星球上瓦斯奇市周围的土地，但是很快他们就和加达里民族主义者产生了冲突，于是他们请求将所有外国人都逐出该地。印塔基向他们的英雄人物莫德求助，这位上了年纪的指挥官从退休中重回战场，率领一支独立佣兵团维护着印塔基的权益并保护着他们的财产。莫德军团打败了那些民族主义者，给加达里当局带来了安宁。

如今，莫德团仍然是一支著名的佣兵团，与加达里合众国保持着密切合作。许多印塔基人在排外的加达里人面前始终遭受着歧视，对于在两国共居局面下的生活已经有所觉悟。但是，莫德在印塔基人眼里仍然是一个令人敬畏的人物，许多印塔基人把他视为救世主，认为总有一天他会回来把饱受压迫和贫穷之苦的人民拯救出来。

messages.en: The Intaki and Mordu's Legion
messages.zh: 印塔基和莫德的军团

messages.en:
If you're willing. Given the current state of interstellar affairs, Mordu's Legion is in the thick of things. They've been engaging in raids and reconnaissance, harassing merchant traffic, and generally making trouble for us. In this sector, at least, they're doing just what the Caldari want them to — keeping our fleet tied down so those greedy bastards can martial their own forces in relative peace.

We might have an ace in the hole, however. We have good intelligence that many Intaki inside the Caldari State are growing impatient and restless, suffering discrimination and unemployment. Many blame the Caldari for their woes, and with the right incentive they might even be persuaded to secede back to the Federation. An incident involving the State-sanctioned Mordu's Legion may be just enough to tip the scales.

We've been monitoring subspace chatter, and we think that the Legion may be planning on hitting one of our bases in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We're planning on making it known that the base is full of Intaki refugees, but just to clinch the deal, it would be best if some heroic pilot caught the Mordus in the act and drove them off before the base was completely destroyed.

What we'd like you to do is get over to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and take up position near the station. When the Legion ships arrive, destroy them or drive them off. We'll be monitoring things by video drone, so we'll have clear evidence of the attack.

Oh, and the Legion may be coming in strength, so you might want to bring some friends along. So, what do you say?
messages.zh:
如果你愿意的话可以。从目前所发生的这些事来看，莫德军团就在幕后。他们参加过突袭和侦察、阻碍商业交通，给我们惹了很多麻烦。在这个地区，他们至少也在做着加达里希望他们做的事——牵制住我们的舰队，让那些贪婪的混蛋们能在比较安宁的情况下耀武扬威。

但是我们也有我们的王牌。我们收到情报说许多加达里合众国内的印塔基人正因为受歧视和失业而变得焦躁不安。许多人将自己的不幸归罪于加达里，只要游说得当，他们甚至可能重新回到联邦来。一场涉及众人爱戴的莫德军团的事变，或许就足以起到决定性作用。

我们正在监视莫德军团在子空间的行动，而且，我们认为他们正在策划一场袭击，目标是四个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的基地中的一个。我们正在散布消息说那个基地里满是印塔基难民，但如果有一个英雄驾驶员当场抓到莫德，并在基地被摧毁前把他的舰队赶跑，那就再好不过了。

我们希望你到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}去，到空间站附近就位。当莫德军团的舰船到达时，干掉他们或者把他们引开。我们会通过无人录像机来进行监控，并将取得这次袭击的确凿证据。

哦对了，莫德军团可能会派遣大量兵力，所以你最好带上几个朋友。你看如何？

messages.en: I'm encountering more difficulty than I'd anticipated. I have to to withdraw from the mission, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 我遇到了比预期更多的困难。我得退出任务了，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: I'm disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Sounds like a decent job. I'll do it.
messages.zh: 听上去不错啊。我干。

messages.en: Thanks for your help. The coordinates are in your NeoCom, along with my instructions.
messages.zh: 谢谢你帮忙。我把位标和指示都已经上传到你的控制边栏里了。

messages.en: Might be, {[character]agentID.name}. What have you got?
messages.zh: 有一点，{[character]agentID.name}。你这里有什么活可干？

messages.en:
We need someone to fly to the possible locations of the secret gate and see what's there. I'll enter the location of the first acceleration gate into your NeoCom; you should be able to reach the others using whatever internal gate array they've put in place. Fly through each one in turn and check the area for any gates that look suspicious. If you find one, you need to blast it before the enemy can jump any more ships around in this system.

Mind you, if there are enemy ships, you might have to fight them too, and no one can say for sure what might come through the gate. There might even be static defense turrets or drones as well.
messages.zh:
我们需要一个人飞往那星门有可能搭建的几个地点，对那些地方实行侦察。我会把第一个加速轨道的位置上传到你的控制边栏里；利用每一个位置里的中继轨道，你应该可以把所有地点都跑全。你的任务就是搜寻那可疑的星门，找到后就要赶到敌人到来之前把它炸掉。

注意，如果你遇到敌舰，那就可能免不了一番争斗，敌人实力目前也难以预料。可能你还会碰到炮台或无人机。

messages.en: The enemy gate is destroyed, along with some of their hardware, {[character]agentID.name}. Thanks for the mission.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，敌人的星门已被摧毁。谢谢你委派我这任务。

messages.en: Your assistance is appreciated, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的协助，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: That doesn't sound very interesting. Have you got anything else?
messages.zh: 听上去没什么意思啊。你这里还有其他活可干吗？

messages.en: That's too bad, {[character]player.name}. Nothing else available right now, I'm afraid.
messages.zh: 算你倒霉，{[character]player.name}。目前我这里无其他活可干。

messages.en:
Well, we've had some suspicious activity in this system lately. We suspect that someone — Angel Cartel, or possibly Serpentis, maybe even the Amarrians — might be sneaking in and prepping the system for attack with hidden bases, supplies, and the like. There may even be a hidden jumpgate somewhere in the vicinity; we've certainly detected some suspicious warp signatures and have been able to triangulate them down to several potential locations, all quite close to each other.

If we make a move with a large fleet, though, we might spook the enemy, so we're looking for a freelancer who's willing to take a risk on behalf of the Federation. We need someone to fly to the possible locations of the acceleration gate and see what's there. I'll enter the location of the first acceleration gate into your NeoCom; you should be able to reach the others using whatever internal gate array they've put in place. Fly through each one in turn and check the area for any gates that look suspicious. If you find one, you need to blast it before the enemy can jump any more ships around in this system.

Mind you, if there are enemy ships, you might have to fight them too, and no one can say for sure what might come through the gate. There might even be static defense turrets or drones as well. Who knows?

Once the gate is destroyed, return here and report; do it quickly and you'll earn yourself a nice bonus. Are you in?
messages.zh:
是这样，最近我们在此星系中察觉到一些可疑活动。我们怀疑有人——天使、天蛇或者艾玛——已潜入了该星系，正在秘密部署后勤基地之类的东西。他们甚至有可能已经在周围搭建了一座星门；我们已经根据侦测到的可疑跃迁信号定位了几个有可能是他们搞活动的地方，这些位置距彼此都很近。

如果我们出动一支大型舰队，那很有可能出现打草惊蛇的现象，为此我们需要一位愿意为联邦冒生命危险的独立飞行员。我们需要他飞往那星门有可能搭建的几个地点，对那些地方实行侦察。我会把第一个加速轨道的位置上传到你控制边栏里；利用每一个位置里的中继轨道，你应该可以把所有地点都跑全。你的任务就是搜寻那可疑的星门，找到后就要赶到敌人到来之前把它炸掉。

注意，如果你遇到敌舰，那就可能免不了一番争斗，敌人实力目前也难以预料。可能你还会碰到炮台或无人机。谁知道呢？

一旦你摧毁星门后就回来向我报告。动作要快，我会好好答谢你的。干不干？

messages.en: I'm taking too much damage, and this is taking too long. I quit.
messages.zh: 我受损严重，而且这事太费时。我闪了。

messages.en: I expected better from you, to be honest. You are a capsuleer, right? You're not just impersonating one?
messages.zh: 说实话我对你原本期望还蛮高的。你不是飞行员吗？不会是冒牌的吧？

messages.en: Sounds important. I'll take care of it.
messages.zh: 听起来很重要。我会处理的。

messages.en: I look forward to seeing what you find.
messages.zh: 我很期待你究竟发现了什么。

messages.en: You said you might have more work for me?
messages.zh: 你说你也许有更多工作给我？

messages.en: The slaves provided us with a location. There was supposed to be a data chip in a dead drop at this rendezvous. In the interest of preventing further mayhem, I need you to bring me that chip.
messages.zh: 劳工提供我们了一个地点。据推测，在那场约会地点有一枚资料芯片。为了避免更多的伤害，我要你去带回那块芯片。

messages.en: Here's the data chip.
messages.zh: 这是资料芯片。

messages.en: Good work. Let me see what this says; I may have another mission for you shortly.
messages.zh: 干得好。让我看看这说明什么；也许我现在就有其他的任务需要你来完成。

messages.en: I don't want to risk angering the Gallente. I'll pass.
messages.zh: 我不想担负惹火盖伦特的危险。我退出。

messages.en: And here I thought you were a brave one.
messages.zh: 并且，我觉得你是个勇敢的人。

messages.en: A significant percentage of the Minmatar population resides within the Gallente Federation, forming a rather powerful political bloc. This bloc is one reason that the relations between Amarr and Gallente remain constantly tense.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人口中的一大部分都是生活在盖伦特联邦中的，并形成了一个相当有力的政治集团。这个集团也是导致艾玛与盖伦特的关系时常紧张的原因之一。

messages.en: Minmatar Influence on the Gallente
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔对盖伦特的影响力

messages.en:
Yes. We interrogated several of the Minmatar slaves you brought back after they escaped.

It seems that the errant Minmatar were headed to a group of their own kind within the Gallente Federation. In fact, they might not have managed to escape at all without the help of a Gallente contact.

When we applied more pressure, the slaves could only provide us with a location. There was supposed to be a data chip in a dead drop at this rendezvous. In the interest of preventing further mayhem, I need you to bring me that chip.
messages.zh:
是的。我们审问了几个你抓回来的米玛塔尔劳工。

似乎那个流浪的米玛塔尔正逃向他位于盖伦特联邦中的同族们。事实上，没有盖伦特方面的帮助，他们都不可能策划这场逃亡。

当我们施加更大压力之后，这些劳工也只提供了一个地点。据推测，在那场约会地点有一枚资料芯片。为了避免更多的伤害，我要你去带回那块芯片。

messages.en: I've waited too long for your reply. You've taught me not to mistake you for dependable.
messages.zh: 我等你的回复已经太久了。你已经使我我明白别把你当成个可靠的人了。

messages.en: Too late
messages.zh: 太晚了

messages.en: Something else has come up. I quit.
messages.zh: 发生了些其他事，我退出。

messages.en: I'll have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我不得不找其他人了。

messages.en: You've waited too long to do what I asked. You've taught me not to mistake you for dependable.
messages.zh: 你太磨蹭了，我要求你做的事情都没动手。你已经使我我明白别把你当成个可靠的人了。

messages.en: Waited too long
messages.zh: 等了太久

messages.en: I'll make certain that he doesn't cause any more trouble.
messages.zh: 我会确保那个家伙不会再惹麻烦了。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you. Remember that we're setting an example here.
messages.zh: 我就知道我能指望你。记住，我们可是在树立榜样。

messages.en: Did that data chip have anything interesting on it?
messages.zh: 那块资料芯片上有什么有趣的东西吗？

messages.en: The data cube yielded the name of a single member of the powerful Minmatar political bloc in the Federation. This man was the contact that helped the slaves escape. Kill him and any who protect him.
messages.zh: 资料盒暴露了位于联邦里米玛塔尔政治集团中的某位成员的名字。这个人正是帮助劳工逃亡的联络人。干掉他，还有任何保护他的人。

messages.en: You won't have any more problems with that Minmatar collaborator.
messages.zh: 你不会再为那个米玛塔尔同伙而头疼了。

messages.en: Nicely done.
messages.zh: 做得很漂亮。

messages.en: It isn't wise to go after someone with such high connections. I won't do it.
messages.zh: 去追逐那种关系重大的人可不是个明智的选择。我不会做这种事的。

messages.en: I thought you were brave, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我本以为你是个勇敢的人，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A significant percentage of the Minmatar population resides within the Gallente Federation, forming a rather powerful political bloc. This bloc is one reason that the relations between Amarr and Gallente remain constantly tense.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人口中的一大部分都是生活在盖伦特联邦中的，并形成了一个相当有力的政治集团。这个集团也是导致艾玛与盖伦特的关系时常紧张的原因之一。

messages.en: Minmatar Influence on the Gallente
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔对盖伦特的影响力

messages.en:
Yes, we found some very useful information on it.

It seems that the Minmatar faction within the Federation has garnered the secret support of some influential members of the Gallente government.

Those officials were not named, but the slaves' contact within the Minmatar faction was. I want you to go to the location that the data chip indicated, and kill that contact and any who defend him.
messages.zh:
是的，在这上面我找到了一些非常有用的信息。

看起来，在联邦内部似乎有一个米玛塔尔帮派得到了来自一些盖伦特政府要员的秘密资助。

那些官员没有被提名，但是劳工们与米玛塔尔帮派的联络人的名字被提到了。我希望你前去资料芯片指出的地方，并把那个联络人以及任何保护他的人干掉。

messages.en: I hope I can find someone capable who'll be able to kill the Gallente contact before he finds out that he's a target. I am disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我希望能找到合适的人，能够在引起警觉之前，消灭那个盖伦特联系人。我对你很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: You have failed
messages.zh: 你失败了

messages.en: I don't want to go after someone with such high connections. I'm done with this.
messages.zh: 我可不想去追赶那些关系重大的人。我放弃这件事。

messages.en: And here I thought you were brave, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 而且，我本以为你是个勇敢的人，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I hope I can find someone capable who'll be able to kill the Gallente contact before he finds out that he's a target. I am disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我希望能找到合适的人，能够在引起警觉之前，消灭那个盖伦特联系人。我对你很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: You have failed
messages.zh: 你失败了

name.ja: アーティファクトを取り戻せ

messages.en: I would be honored to undertake such a mission.
messages.zh: 我很乐意接受这个任务。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I thought you might have some work for me today.
messages.zh: 我想你今天可能有活要给我干。

messages.en: While mining ore in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, a small group of mining pirates uncovered a religious artifact of uncertain origin. Find these rogues and retrieve the artifact from them.
messages.zh: 在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}采集矿石时，一个小型矿盗团发掘出了一个来源不明的宗教古董。你去找到这些游手好闲的人并从他们手里拿到这件古董。

messages.en: I hope you find this as valuable as you thought it would be. The miners have already paid with their lives.
messages.zh: 我希望这个东西如你所期待的那样无价。矿工们已经为此付出了他们的生命了。

messages.en: Here is your reward. You have truly earned it.
messages.zh: 这是给你的奖励。你应得的。

messages.en: I'm not going to go haring off over some unidentified piece of ancient junk. My time's worth more than that.
messages.zh: 我可不想穿过那不知名的垃圾堆。我的时间可不该浪费在这上面。

messages.en: I am disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Due in large part to the values and teachings of the Amarr faith, the Amarr have the most extensive libraries, archives, and collections of artifacts pertaining to post-Eden life and, possibly, the EVE gate.

One of the heirs of the Ardishapur family, hailed as a paragon of the faith, has amassed what may be the largest array of religious artifacts in a private collection. Some of his pieces are even suspected to pre-date the closure of the EVE gate.
messages.zh:
艾玛有着为数最多的图书馆、档案和大量有关伊甸园生活和新伊甸之门的古董，这些是艾玛信仰中价值和教义的一个重要部分。

被推崇为信仰典范的阿狄莎波家族继承人之一，私下里收集了数量或许最为庞大的宗教古董。其中一些藏品甚至被认为比新伊甸之门的关闭更为久远。

messages.en: Amarr and Religious Artifacts
messages.zh: 艾玛和宗教古董

messages.en:
I always have work for a good pod pilot.

It has recently come to my attention that a small group of nearby pirates stumbled across something rather unusual. While mining for ore, they made a lucky discovery-- they uncovered what appears to be a religious artifact.

As you know, such an object is of great importance to all Amarr. There are many Holders who would pay large sums to get their hands on such a find; even better, there are collectors among the royal family who would give large rewards to add such a thing to their private collections.

I want you to find these rogue miners and retrieve this artifact from them. Bring it here, and you will be well rewarded.
messages.zh:
我手头总是有工作给优秀的新人飞行员做。

最近我的意识中总是出现一个小海盗团费劲地穿过某个很不寻常的东西。采集矿石时，他们有了幸运的发现——他们挖出的东西看起来是宗教古董。

如你所知，这样的东西对艾玛来说可是非常重要的。许多皇室成员会愿意不惜巨资来插手其中；甚至于，皇室家族中的收藏家也愿意出巨资把这件东西收入囊中。

我要你找到这些游手好闲的矿工，从他们手里拿到这件古董。把它带回来，我会给你丰厚的奖励。

messages.en: Due to your sloth, the miners who discovered the artifact found another buyer, one from outside the faith. Thanks to your neglect, we may never discover the true religious significance of this piece of living history.
messages.zh: 由于你不积极，那些发现古董的矿工们另找了一个买主——一个介于信仰之外的人。也要感谢你的疏忽，否则我们或许永远都无法发现这活生生的历史当中蕴含的宗教意义。

messages.en: Found another buyer
messages.zh: 找到另一个买主

messages.en: I'm done haring off over some unidentified piece of ancient junk. My time's worth more than this.
messages.zh: 我终于从一些不知名的垃圾堆里跑出来了。我的时间可不该浪费在这上面。

messages.en: I am disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Due to your sloth, the miners who discovered the artifact found another buyer, one from outside the faith. Thanks to your neglect, we may never discover the true religious significance of this piece of living history.
messages.zh: 由于你不积极，那些发现古董的矿工们另找了一个买主——一个介于信仰之外的人。也要感谢你的疏忽，否则我们或许永远都无法发现这活生生的历史当中蕴含的宗教意义。

messages.en: Found another buyer
messages.zh: 找到另一个买主

messages.en: You can count on me.
messages.zh: 交给我好了。

messages.en: Excellent. Do take care. Our intelligence on these ships is sketchy at best, so they may be more powerful than we know.
messages.zh: 很好。小心。我们得到的关于船的信息都是粗略的，所以他们可能比我们想的要强得多。

messages.en: You have work for me, then?
messages.zh: 那么你有工作要派给我？

messages.en: A new race track is being built in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. During the final stages of building, we received reports of some ships bearing Gallente markings, and several suspicious "accidents" have occurred. Sabotage is suspected. Go find these ships and destroy them so that no harm will come to participants or viewers during the big race.
messages.zh: 在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}正建造一条新赛道。就在建造的最后阶段，我们得到一些报道说有一些印有盖伦特标记的船出现，并且随之发生了几桩可疑的“意外”。我们怀疑是蓄意破坏。找到那些船并把他们消灭掉，确保在大赛期间观众和参赛者不会受到任何伤害。

messages.en: I've disposed of the Gallente miscreants.
messages.zh: 我已经把这群盖伦特恶棍处理掉了。

messages.en: I knew you were the right pilot for the job.
messages.zh: 我认为你是最适合这份工作的飞行员。

messages.en: I don't have time to play hide-and-seek with some phantom troublemakers. Find someone else who has nothing better to do.
messages.zh: 我可没时间和神出鬼没的捣蛋鬼玩捉迷藏。还是去找些无所事事的人来干吧。

messages.en: You are not the pilot I thought you were. I'll be sure to spread the word of your laziness and ingratitude.
messages.zh: 你离我的期望相差十万八千里。我一定会到处宣扬你的懒惰和忘恩负义。

messages.en:
Ship racing has become very popular in the past few years. Pilots race their ships to see who can complete a circuit the fastest and thus show off proper ship handling, attention to quick course corrections, and how much power can be coaxed out of a ship.

The Amarr have some of the best racers in the sector and to commemorate their successes, they are building a new racing area in one of our poorer systems to help stimulate the economy, while at the same time showcasing Amarr skill in flying the best ships in pod pilot hands today.
messages.zh:
赛船是过去几年中一直十分流行的赛事。飞行员驾驶他们的飞船，比赛谁能最快完成一圈的飞行并且卖弄他们驾驭飞船和快速调整的本领，并且显示他们的飞船有多大的能量。

艾玛有最好的赛船，并且为了纪念他们的成功，他们在我们较贫困的星系内建立一个新的赛场来促进他们的经济，同时炫耀他们艾玛最好的飞船。

messages.en: Racing
messages.zh: 比赛

messages.en:
I have a task that must be done quickly, and it requires punitive force.

A new race track is being designed and built in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and it is supposed to be the grandest and most beautiful and complicated tracks yet ever to exist in all of the known sectors! A substantial quantity of money and work have gone into this track, and there are plans to hold one of the largest races ever as soon as the track is finished.

However, some suspicious ships have been seen in the vicinity. They evade patrols, but we've received reports that they bear Gallente markings. A couple of "accidents" have already occurred while testing the track, and investigations have led to suspicion of sabotage.

We think that these Gallente ships have been sabotaging this new track, probably in hopes of killing many Holders and their families when the time comes for the great inaugural race.

I want you to put a stop to this nonsense before it has any further impact. Destroy those ships; it's time we sent a message.
messages.zh:
我有一个急需完成的任务，而这需要惩罚性力量。

一条新赛道已经设计完成并准备建造在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，并且将成为世上最壮最美最复杂的赛道。我们已经投入了大量的金钱和人力，并且计划在赛道完工后举办一场盛大的赛事。

然而附近出现了一些可疑的船。他们躲开了巡逻队，但是我们已经接到情报说他们印有盖伦特的标记。在我们试验跑道的时候已经发生了一系列“意外”，调查显示可能是蓄意破坏。

我认为这些盖伦特的船蓄意破坏新的跑道，并且希望在赛事开始的时候伤害股东和他们的家庭。

我希望你能在这是没有越来越糟之前停止这种胡闹。把他们都干掉；是时候给他们点颜色了。

messages.en: The Gallente ships were finally found, but not before they caused further serious damage to the track. You are lucky that they were discovered before the great race, or else you would have many more Amarr lives on your conscience. You may rest assured that I will spread the word of your laziness and ingratitude.
messages.zh: 盖伦特的船被找到了，但已经晚了，他们造成了进一步的毁坏。你很幸运在赛事开始前找到了那些船，要不然你要在良心的谴责下看着许多人死去。你放心，我一定会到处宣扬你的懒惰和忘恩负义。

messages.en: Finally found
messages.zh: 最后还是找到了

messages.en: Your intelligence must be wrong because I can't find these mysterious ships. Find someone else who has nothing better to do than playing hide-and-seek with phantom troublemakers.
messages.zh: 你给的情报一定是错的，我根本就找不到那些神秘的船。找些无所事事的人来和神出鬼没的捣蛋鬼玩捉迷藏吧。

messages.en: You are not the pilot I thought you were. I'll be sure to spread the word of your laziness and ingratitude.
messages.zh: 你离我的期望相差十万八千里。我一定会到处宣扬你的懒惰和忘恩负义。

messages.en: The Gallente ships were finally found, but not before they caused further serious damage to the track. You are lucky that they were discovered before the great race, or else you would have many more Amarr lives on your conscience. You may rest assured that I will spread the word of your laziness and ingratitude.
messages.zh: 盖伦特的船被找到了，但已经晚了，他们造成了进一步的毁坏。你很幸运在赛事开始前找到了那些船，要不然你要在良心的谴责下看着许多人死去。你放心，我一定会到处宣扬你的懒惰和忘恩负义。

messages.en: Finally found
messages.zh: 最后还是找到了

messages.en: Sounds simple enough, {[character]agentID.name}.  I'll get on it right away.
messages.zh: 听起来很简单，{[character]agentID.name}。我马上就去。

messages.en: {[character]player.name} — you are the absolute best! I knew today was my lucky day!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}—你绝对是最棒的！我就知道今天是我的幸运日！

messages.en: Then I take it you've got a high-paying job for me, right?
messages.zh: 我打赌你为我准备了一份报酬丰厚的工作，对吗？

messages.en: Destroy the Caldari cruiser at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} along with any other hostile ships you may encounter. No witnesses!
messages.zh: 摧毁位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name} 的加达里巡洋舰以及任何你遇到的敌对舰船。别被人发现！

messages.en: The Caldari cruiser is now dust. Would have been nice of you to let me know about the Guristas, though.
