messages.zh: 这艘加达里巡洋舰已经成为灰烬了。尽管如此，如果你早点告诉我关于古利塔斯的事情就更好了。

messages.en: I'm so happy to hear the ship is no longer an issue for us — and especially that you're okay, {[character]player.name}. And so sorry about those Guristas. You're right, I should have said something...
messages.zh: 听说那艘舰船再也不会成为我们的麻烦实在太令我高兴了——尤其是看到你没事，{[character]player.name}。关于那群古利塔斯，我很抱歉。你是对的，我本该说起的...

messages.en: If you want a clean-up job, hire a janitor.  Not interested.
messages.zh: 如果你想要我做大扫除，不如去雇一个门卫。我不感兴趣。

messages.en: I'm sorry, {[character]player.name}, but the way you dress, I thought you were a janitor. My mistake!
messages.zh: 很抱歉，{[character]player.name}，但是你的穿着使我把你误认为门卫了，这是我的错！

messages.en:
The worst enemy is the one who was once an ally. This is a lesson not lost on the Caldari Navy, for it was from within their own ranks that the seeds of the Guristas pirates were born.

The Guristas were founded by two ex-Caldari Navy members now known only as "Fatal" and "The Rabbit." Utilizing their knowledge of the Navy's procedures — and thus its weaknesses — these two renegades have confounded their previous employers for many years with their persistence and ingenuity.

The Guristas cannot totally disown their militaristic origins: among pirates, they remain arguably the most honorable among a dishonorable bunch. Yet spacefarers shouldn't take too much comfort from that fact, or from their amusing bunny-skull logo. The Guristas will still slit your throat if there's profit involved.

Honor, as many have learned, goes only so far when ISK is concerned.
messages.zh:
最糟糕的敌人就是曾经的盟友。但加达里海军从来不明白这个道理，因为古利塔斯海盗最早便是从加达里自己的阶级中衍生出来的。

古利塔斯最早是由两个前加达里海军成员——现在仅仅知道他们叫“致命”与“兔子”——所发现的。利用他们对海军规程以及其弱点的了解，这两个叛徒，凭借他们的坚持与谋略，很多年来一直把他们从前的雇主搞得很狼狈。

古利塔斯无法彻底否认他们军国主义的传统：在海盗中，他们仍然是一群不名誉的家伙中名声最好的。然而，宇宙游客不应该因为这个事实，或是他们可笑的兔头骷髅的标志而感到放松。古利塔斯仍然会为了利益割断你的脖子。

名誉，就像很多人知道的那样，在星币面前什么都不是。

messages.en: The Guristas
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯

messages.en:
I do, in fact, have a little matter that needs your attention. It's rather... delicate.

My corporation recently had a small misunderstanding with a Caldari business rival. Fortunately, after some of our folks met with the Caldari to have a… discussion, our people managed to limp back here; unfortunately, they left the wreckage of the Caldari ship intact, including the ship's log.

Now, it would impact any future dealings we might have with the Caldari if this dispute became known to their authorities. I'm sure they'd insist on petty things like vengeance. So we'd rather that didn't happen. We'd like you to go destroy all evidence of the Caldari cruiser. It can be found at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

So, will you be a pal and do this for me?
messages.zh:
我的确，事实上，有一个小麻烦需要你关心一下。这实在很...微妙。

我的企业最近和一家加达里竞争对手之间发生了一些小误会。我的人与加达里方见面...讨论了一番，幸运的是，他们瘸了腿，但好歹回来了；但不幸的是，他们把加达里舰船的残骸原封不动地留在了那里，包括航行日志。

现在，这可能影响我们未来与加达里的所有生意——如果他们的当局知道了这场争执。我确信他们会执著于一些小事，比如复仇。所以我宁可什么都没发生过。我希望你去摧毁所有关于那艘加达里巡洋舰的证据。你能在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}找到它。

那么，你会站在我这一边，来帮我这个忙吗？

{[character]player.name}，

我相信你是个体面人，是个不会让一位可怜的代理人干等的好飞行员。我已经被迫雇用了另一个明白怎样正确对待我的飞行员。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: That small problem we discussed
messages.zh: 那个我们讨论过的小问题

messages.en: I'm getting a really bad feeling about this job, and I've learned to trust my gut. I'm out. And go easy on batting those eyelashes, {[character]agentID.name} — you'll pull a muscle.
messages.zh: 我对这件工作有很不好的预感，而且我早就知道要相信我的胆量。我退出。打击那群杂毛的时候请放轻松点{[character]agentID.name}——不然你会拉伤肌肉的。

messages.en: That's so funny, {[character]player.name}, because I just got this funny sensation behind my eyes when I saw you walk in — sort of like an ulcer, but in my brain.
messages.zh: 那太有趣了，{[character]player.name}，当我看到你走进来的时候，我突然有了这种有趣的感觉——有点像溃疡，不过在我脑子里。

{[character]player.name}，

当我听说你没能击毁那艘加达里巡洋舰的时候，我彻底懵了，彻底。我希望你去死，免得再让我继续失望下去。我真的，真的是这个意思。

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: The Caldari problem
messages.zh: 加达里的问题

messages.en: This job just keeps getting better and better. And yes, that's sarcasm. But yes, I'll do it — for the ISK. I can't spend your gratitude.
messages.zh: 这个任务正变得越来越容易。是的，那很讽刺。但是，我会做下去——为了星币。我可受不起你的感激。

messages.en: It speaks very well of you that you aren't running away when things get hot, {[character]player.name}. I like that in a capsuleer.
messages.zh: 据称你在遇到麻烦的时候不会逃跑，{[character]player.name}，我很欣赏有这种品质的飞行员。

messages.en: Funny you should mention the Guristas, because I kind of wanted an explanation about that. You knew they'd be there?
messages.zh: 有趣的是你应该早点提到古利塔斯，现在我有点想要你为此解释。你早知道他们会出现在那里？

messages.en: Go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}  and destroy the Guristas pirates there. Don't forget to recover the ship log that they stole from the Caldari cruiser. They won't be there long, so please hurry!
messages.zh: 前去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}并摧毁那里的古利塔斯海盗。别忘记把他们从加达里巡洋舰上拿走的航行日志带回来。他们在那里不会待太久，所以请快点！

messages.en: I destroyed those Guristas, {[character]agentID.name}, and I got the ship log. But, uh, I checked it to make sure it's the right log, and it… well, it has some interesting information. Is there something you want to tell me?
messages.zh: 我摧毁了那群古利塔斯，{[character]agentID.name}，并且找到了航行日志。但是，呃，我对这份日志进行检查以确保这是你要的东西，然后……好吧，里面有一些有趣的信息。你有什么想告诉我的吗？

messages.en:
Oh, yeah, {[character]player.name}, about that....

Listen, give me a minute to wrap this up, and then come back and I'll explain everything, okay?
messages.zh:
哦，是的，{[character]player.name}，关于那个……

听着，给我一分钟整理思路，然后回来听我解释一切，好吗？

messages.en: Sorry, {[character]agentID.name}, but no thanks. You seem about as trustworthy as a Thukker ship salesman. Go play some other sucker, 'cause I'm gone.
messages.zh: 抱歉，{[character]agentID.name}，不过不用了。你就像一个索克族销售员一般可信，我可要走了。

messages.en: I did say I was sorry about forgetting to mention the pirates… but it seems obvious you're just afraid to fight. Run along then, little egger, run along.
messages.zh: 我已经说了我很抱歉忘记提醒你有海盗……但是很显然你只是害怕战斗。走吧，小家伙，走吧。

messages.en:
I'm so sorry about those Guristas! You're right. I should have said something... but I knew you'd be able to handle it.

Anyway, it seems they boarded that Caldari cruiser before you arrived and took the ship's log. Now they're threatening to turn it over to the Caldari Navy if we don't pay up. We've got enough on our plate at the moment without fomenting open war with Caldari. Amarr'd just love that, huh?

So, we've tracked them to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. If you could go and take care of them, I'd be really, really grateful.
messages.zh:
对于那帮古利塔斯我感到很抱歉！你是对的，我应该早点说的……但是我早知道你有能力解决。

无论如何，他们似乎先你一步登上了加达里巡洋舰，并拿走了日志。现在他们说要把这东西交给加达里海军，以此威胁我们付钱。哪怕不与加达里公开宣战，我们目前手头的事情也足够多了。艾玛正希望我们那么做，不是吗？

因此，我们追踪他们至{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。如果你能去解决他们，我会非常非常感激！

messages.en:
Hey {[character]player.name},

Just a quick note to let you know your laxity in retrieving that ship log has led to several Caldari vigilante attacks on my corporation. At last count, 200 people are dead. Have a nice day!
messages.zh:
嘿{[character]player.name}，

简单地告诉你，你在带回航行日志这件事上的懈怠导致一些加达里警员攻击我的公司。至少200人丧生。祝你来日愉快！

messages.en: Logs out of reach
messages.zh: 遥不可及的日志

messages.en: I've just done the math, {[character]agentID.name}. Bunch of Guristas + me not trusting you = I quit.
messages.zh: 我刚做完这道数学题，{[character]agentID.name}。一群古利塔斯+我不信任你=我退出。

messages.en:
You surprise me, to be honest. I would have thought that kind of complex addition quite beyond you.

Bye now.
messages.zh:
老实说你使我感到惊奇。我本来会在你之前考虑这种复杂的加法的。

现在，再见吧。

{[character]player.name}，

我本以为你在尝试从古利塔斯那里弄回这本日志的时候英勇就义了。可是最后我得知你嫌费事而不干。为此，我把你的失败通知给我上层了，乖乖地待在安全的地方吧，祝你过得愉快！

{[character]agentID.name}

messages.en: You've lied to me, you've manipulated me, and you've almost gotten me killed. I've got to admit, {[character]agentID.name} — I'm starting to like your style. I'm in!
messages.zh: 你骗了我，耍了我，还差点让我送命。但我必须承认，{[character]agentID.name}——这风格我欣赏。我干！

messages.en: I knew you'd never let me down, {[character]player.name}.  Just hurry before this buyer comes to his senses (or you do…). Oh — did I say that out loud?
messages.zh: 我知道你不会让我失望的，{[character]player.name}。乘着那买家还没回过神来快把这事了结吧（你这傻瓜……）。哦——我刚才说什么了吗？

messages.en: Well, maybe. Kinda depends on what it is you tell me now and what you want next, really.
messages.zh: 恩，好像是的。关键看你现在怎么说了，还有你接下来想要什么。

messages.en:
Your agent wants you to meet with the buyer at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

And you might want to keep an eye out for the Guristas. They might be a little peeved with you.
messages.zh:
你的代理人要你在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}与那个买家碰面。

你要警惕古斯塔斯的存在。他们可能对你有些不满意。

messages.en: Well, it's done. Maybe not the way you wanted, but it's done. The buyer is dead, the pirates are dead, you've got your secret package back, and I need a drink. Now pay up!
messages.zh: 好了，事情搞定了。也许不是你喜欢的那种方式，但搞定了就是行。买家死了，海盗也死了，我把你的秘密物品也带给你了。现在我要喝一杯享受享受。快付钱吧！

messages.en: Congratulations, {[character]player.name}! Not only have you done the impossible, but you've made me 100,000 ISK in a side bet! My partners thought you'd die long before this! Thanks a bunch! Here's your reward, and a little extra besides! Don't spend it all in one place, champ.
messages.zh: 恭喜你啊，{[character]player.name}！你不但完成了件不可能的任务，还让我赢了一笔——我下了10万注星币赌你会帮我！我的朋友还以为你肯定活不到今天！太感谢了！这是答应给你的赏金，还有一点额外奖励！别一下就花光了。

messages.en: Newsflash, {[character]agentID.name}! You're obviously out of your mind. I'm putting as much distance between you and me as humanly possible. See ya, crackpot!
messages.zh: 听好，{[character]agentID.name}！你脑子肯定不正常。我要离你尽量远点。拜拜，疯子！

messages.en: But I'm really in deep with Covert Ops! I have an honorary badge and everything! And a set of spy glasses, too. I'm the real deal!
messages.zh: 我真是特勤人员！我有勋章的，什么都有！我还有间谍专用眼镜呢。我说的都是真的！

messages.en:
Few have the skills to enter the world of Covert Ops, and fewer still survive long once they enter it. And of those who do survive, rare are those who can claim to be totally sane afterwards.

One of the first lessons in Covert Ops is "plausible deniability"; this, along with the selective use of misinformation, allows a government and or a military entity to distance itself from its spies and operatives should their activities become known. Paradoxically, though, while every government and military organization requires Covert Ops to survive, it can be extremely harmful to admit such groups' existence, at least without a feasible back-up story — a story usually provided by the covert agents themselves.

At times, the distance between a Covert Ops agency and its parent organization can become so byzantine that funding can present a dangerous optic. When that occurs, operatives may have to raise funds themselves, in ways only they can...
messages.zh:
有本事当间谍的本来就不多，其中能长久干下去的更是少之又少。而在那些真能干下去的人当中，几乎没有一个事后敢说自己脑子还是正常的。

间谍人员首先要学会的就是制造出“似是而非的事实”；这样，一旦间谍行动暴露，那背后指使的政府或军队还能与特工脱离干系。具有讽刺意味的是，虽然政府军队希望特工能活下来，但要承认这类人员的存在，尤其是在没有事实（通常得要特工自己嘴里吐出的事实）铺垫的情况下，对政府机构的危害是很大的。

有时，一个间谍机构可以与它的管理组织疏远得非常之远，导致资金来源都成了个大问题。一旦有这样的事情发生，那特工们往往只能按他们自己的行事方式来筹措资金了……

messages.en: The Murky World of Covert Ops
messages.zh: 特勤人员的灰色世界

messages.en:
Okay, I haven't been totally honest with you. I'm currently working on behalf of a Covert Ops agent for the Republic Navy.

That Caldari ship? Belonged to a disgruntled military scientist who was going to sell us a bio-weapon prototype. Unfortunately, we had a small misunderstanding over price, and now he's dead. Things happen, you know? I hired you to retrieve the ship logs so we could have a little thing called "plausible deniability" if things went badly. Like they kinda did.

{[character]player.name}, here's the new plan. First of all, the weapon is useless — the scientist was as terrible a researcher as he was a negotiator. But rumors we whispered into the right ears have got people believing otherwise. This whole operation was about raising funds for Navy Covert Ops, after all. Spy stuff isn't cheap!

Anyway, we need you to meet with the buyer at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Will you do this for me?

Sorry about all the fibs. Please? Pretty please?
messages.zh:
好吧，我并没有把 所有的真相告诉你。其实我是共和国海军的一个特工人员。

想知道那艘加达里舰船是怎么回事么？那艘船属于一个对加达里不满的军事科学家，他打算卖给我们一种生化武器原型。可惜我们在价格上面还有些小误会，现在他却死了。有些事情是无法避免的， 你知道。我花钱雇佣你是希望你能去取回那艘船的航行日志，这样一旦有什么意外，我们还可以让它变成“似是而非的事实”，就像往常所做的那样。

{[character]player.name}，听听我的新计划吧。首先，这种武器是更本就是一个废物——那个科学家不仅不会谈判，而且研究也做得很糟糕。但我们散布出去的谣言已经让别人相信这武器是有用的。实际上，这整个行动的目的都只是为了提高海军特勤行动的金费。要知道，组织间谍活动是很耗钱的！

不管怎么样，我们都需要你到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}与买家碰面。你愿意为我办这件事情么？

很抱歉之前不能跟你讲实话。帮帮忙，行吗？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

It seems unfortunate that you would go so far in this operation only to wander off right at the end. And since you had the prototype, we couldn't get paid, either. Not a good idea to upset Covert Ops that way, you know? Really Bad Idea.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

你在这个行动中坚持了这么就却要在最后一刻放弃，这真是太遗憾了。原型机现在还在你的手上，这样我们一分钱报酬也拿不到。要是把那些间谍惹火了可就不太好了，这真是个糟糕的注意。

messages.en: The prototype scam
messages.zh: 原型武器的骗局

messages.en: I've just had a sudden attack of common sense, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm out of here before I end up in either a casket or a rubber room.
messages.zh: 我脑子突然清醒了，{[character]agentID.name}。我可不想进棺材，拜拜。

messages.en: Wow. What a build-up to the letdown you turned out to be, {[character]player.name}. Oh, well — there must remain some expendable suckers out there I can use, I'm sure.
messages.zh: 哇噢，原来你这么让人失望啊，{[character]player.name}。唉，算了——你不干还有别人干呢。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name},

How difficult was it to just deliver the prototype? What, the thought of a few Guristas out for revenge stopped you? Maybe you just didn't want it enough. Ever think of that? Very, very disappointed, me.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，

仅仅运送一个原型机对你来说有多难?什么?就因为害怕古斯塔斯会对你实施报复就阻止了你？也许你并不想干这份工作。你想过吗？你非常，非常让我失望。

messages.en: You've really done it now
messages.zh: 你真的做了

name.de: Unfrieden stiften - Schnappen Sie sich die Gallente (1 von 2)
name.en: Driving a Wedge - Get the Gallente (1 of 2)
name.es: Sembrar la discordia: A por el gallente (1 de 2)
name.fr: Creuser un fossé - Attraper le Gallente (1 sur 2)
name.ja: 分裂作戦―ガレンテ大使を殺害せよ（1/2）
name.ru: Как поссорить союзников — взять Gallente (Driving a Wedge - Get the Gallente) (1 из 2)
name.zh: 挑拨离间—灭了那盖伦特人（1/2）

messages.en: I'll take out that Gallente.
messages.zh: 我能够把那盖伦特外交官解决。

messages.en: Good. Come back when you can tell me that the Gallente is done for.
messages.zh: 好的。回来报告我盖伦特都在干什么。

messages.en: Um, I need a job...
messages.zh: 嗯，我需要工作……

messages.en: As if fighting the Gallente on our front doorstep wasn't bad enough, the Minmatar are becoming more active of late. The biggest risk is that our two enemies will start closely coordinating their attacks. The State cannot allow this to happen. To that end, there is a summit meeting in need of disrupting. Killing the Gallente diplomat should do the trick.
messages.zh: 如果说与盖伦特在家门口作战还不够糟的话，米玛塔尔最近可是越来越活跃了。最危险的是我们两方面的敌人越走越近准备一起攻击我们。我们国家不能允许这样的事情发生。为此，我们要破坏他们的峰会。干掉盖伦特的外交官我们就能如愿。

messages.en: The Gallente exploded, and the Minmatar ran off.
messages.zh: 盖伦特的外交官被炸飞了，米玛塔尔的外交官逃跑了。

messages.en: Give me just a moment to check something.
messages.zh: 让我检查一下。

messages.en: I could take out that Minmatar instead.
messages.zh: 我觉得解决那米玛塔尔外交官倒是没问题。

messages.en:
Ah, my apologies for being cross with you, but it's been a busy day. As if fighting the Gallente on our front doorstep isn't bad enough, the Minmatar are becoming more active of late.

The biggest risk is that our two enemies will start closely coordinating their attacks. The State cannot allow this to happen. To that end, there is a summit meeting in need of disrupting. If I give you the coordinates for the meeting site, can you go over there and blow up a diplomat?
messages.zh:
哦，很抱歉对你发火，但今天真是很忙。如果说与盖伦特在家门口作战还不够糟的话，米玛塔尔最近可是越来越活跃了。

最危险的是我们两方面的敌人越走越近准备一起攻击我们。我们国家不能允许这样的事情发生。为此，我们要破坏他们的峰会。如果我给你峰会地点的坐标，你能跑去炸死一名外交官吗？

messages.en: As I did not receive word from you about the summit we discussed, I have handled the problem by assigning another pilot.
messages.zh: 你对于我们所讨论的关于的峰会的事没有给我答复，我已经指派了另一个飞行员去处理了。

messages.en: Enemy summit disrupted.
messages.zh: 敌峰会已瓦解。

messages.en: I'm not going to be able to finish this job after all.
messages.zh: 我根本没办法完成这个任务。

messages.en: Then stop wasting my time!
messages.zh: 那就别再浪费我的时间了！

messages.en: I thought you were taking care of that matter in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that we discussed. And now I find out from my source that the summit went on unimpeded. What have you been up to all this time? I'm beginning to think you're not as trustworthy as I'd been led to believe. Rest assured, you're going to have to work hard to get back into my good graces.
messages.zh: 我以为你像我们讨论的那样在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}处理事情。现在我发现峰会没有受到影响。你这段时间都在干什么？我现在觉得你不像别人说得那么可靠了。放心，只要你往后努力工作，我还会对你重拾信心。

messages.en: Summit unimpeded
messages.zh: 峰会未受影响

messages.en: Good. Come back when you can tell me that that Minmatar is done for.
messages.zh: 很好。等你把那个米玛塔尔人解决了就回来。

messages.en: Sorry, it didn't seem like a smart move.
messages.zh: 抱歉，这行动看起来可不怎么样。

name.en: Driving a Wedge - Delegation Destruction (2 of 2)
name.es: Sembrar la discordia: Destrucción delegacional (2 de 2)
name.fr: Creuser un fossé - Destruction de délégation (2 sur 2)
name.ja: 分裂作戦―代理人の殺害（2/2）
name.ru: Как поссорить союзников — уничтожение делегации (Driving a Wedge - Delegation Destruction) (2 из 2)

messages.en: Only one battleship? No problem.
messages.zh: 只有一艘战列舰？没问题。

messages.en: For your sake, I hope not. Good luck.
messages.zh: 为了你自己，我希望不是。好运。

messages.en: You mentioned an opportunity?
messages.zh: 你说有个机会？

messages.en:
The attack on the meeting between the Gallente and Minmatar emissaries went perfectly. Now we need to finish the job. After escaping the scene of the attack, the Minmatar ambassador was whisked away to a nearby staging area.

A raid on the Minmatar delegation now will look like a reprisal raid from the Gallente delegation, and since the Minmatar know they weren't responsible for the initial attack, they'll be even angrier. We have reason to believe that the enemy diplomats have been transferred aboard the Minmatar flagship to ensure their safety. It's the only battleship in the delegation, and it must be destroyed.
messages.zh:
在盖伦特和米玛塔尔的特使会面时发动袭击进展非常顺利。现在我们要完成它。从袭击中逃生的米玛塔尔大使被降职发配到了附近的一个集合区。

米玛尔塔代表团遭受的突袭现在看来像是盖伦特代表团发起的报复性突袭，并且要是米玛尔塔知道先前的袭击与他们无关的话，他们就会更加生气了。我有理由相信为了确保敌方外交官的安全，他们已经被转移到米玛尔塔的旗舰上了。那是代表团里唯一的战列舰，一定要摧毁掉。

messages.en: The enemy flagship is no more.
messages.zh: 敌人的旗舰不复存在了。

messages.en: I knew you were up to it. Good work, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 我知道你能够胜任的。好好干，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: Attack a battleship and its entire convoy? No thanks.
messages.zh: 攻击一艘战列舰和它所有的护航队？算了吧。

messages.en: You're letting a great opportunity slip away, but it's your call.
messages.zh: 你让一个绝佳的机会白白溜走了。不过这也正是你的风格。

messages.en:
The attack on the meeting between the Gallente and Minmatar emissaries went perfectly. Now we need to finish the job. After escaping the scene of the attack, the Minmatar ambassador was whisked away to a nearby staging area.

A raid on the Minmatar delegation now will look like a reprisal raid from the Gallente delegation, and since the Minmatar know they weren't responsible for the initial attack, they'll be even angrier. We have reason to believe that the enemy diplomats have been transferred aboard the Minmatar flagship to ensure their safety. It's the only battleship in the delegation, and it must be destroyed. Are you game?
messages.zh:
在盖伦特和米玛塔尔的特使会面时发动袭击进展非常顺利。现在我们要完成它。从袭击中逃生的米玛塔尔大使被降职发配到了附近的一个集合区。

米玛尔塔代表团遭受的突袭现在看来像是盖伦特代表团发起的报复性突袭，并且要是米玛尔塔知道先前的袭击与他们无关的话，他们就会更加生气了。我有理由相信为了确保敌方外交官的安全，他们已经被转移到米玛尔塔的旗舰上了。那是代表团里唯一的战列舰，一定要摧毁掉。你愿意吗？

messages.en: Apparently we did not strike while the iron was hot. In the time since I've talked to you, my source has indicated that the Minmatar emissaries have safely made it back to their own space. Worse still, they appear to have sorted things out with the Gallente, or at least allayed some of their suspicions.
messages.zh: 很显然我们没有能够乘热打铁。在我上次和你谈话后不久，我得到情报说玛塔尔的间谍安全的回到了他们自己的空间。更糟的是，他们与盖伦特之间的事情已经解决了，或者至少已经消除了疑虑。

messages.en: Minmatar delegation escapes
messages.zh: 米玛尔塔代表团逃离

messages.en: Find someone else to take this on. I'm busy.
messages.zh: 找其他人干这个吧。我忙着呢。

messages.en: What happened to “no problem?” You capsuleers are all alike – as soon as the going gets tough you cut and run.
messages.zh: 不是说“没有问题”吗？你们飞行员都一样——事情一糟你们就溜之大吉。

messages.en: Apparently we did not strike while the iron was hot. In the time since I've talked to you, my source has indicated that the Minmatar emissaries have safely made it back to their own space. messages.en: The enemy diplomats have been dealt with.
messages.zh: 敌人的外交官已经被解决了。

messages.en: I knew you were up to it. Good work, {[character]player.name}!

messages.en: Sorry, I have better things to do.

messages.en: You're letting a great opportunity slip away, but it's your call.

After escaping the scene of the attack, the Gallente ambassador was whisked away to a small consulate facility. messages.zh: 显然我们没能趁热打铁。在我们谈话的时间里，我的线人说盖伦特外交官安全返回他们自己的星系了。更糟的是，他们似乎和米玛塔尔一起解决了事情，至少也缓和了他们的猜疑。

messages.en: As if fighting the Gallente on our front doorstep wasn't bad enough, the Minmatar are becoming more active of late. The biggest risk is that our two enemies will start closely coordinating their attacks. The Empire cannot allow this to happen. To that end, there is a summit meeting in need of disrupting. Killing the Gallente diplomat should do the trick.
messages.zh:
如果是和盖伦特在家门口开战还不够糟的话，米玛塔尔最近可是越来越活跃了。

最危险的就是我们两方面的敌人越走越近会联合起来攻打我们。帝国可不允许这种事情发生。要把盖伦特的外交官炸的粉身碎骨才算成功。

messages.en: The Gallente exploded, and the Minmatar ran off.
messages.zh: 盖伦特的外交官被炸飞了，米玛塔尔的外交官逃跑了。

messages.en: Give me just a moment to check something.
messages.zh: 让我检查一下。

messages.en: I could take out that Minmatar instead.
messages.zh: 我觉得解决那米玛塔尔外交官倒是没问题。

messages.en:
Ah, my apologies for being cross with you, but it's been a busy day. As if fighting the Gallente on our front doorstep isn't bad enough, the Minmatar are becoming more active of late.

The biggest risk is that our two enemies will start closely coordinating their attacks. The Empire cannot allow this to happen. To that end, there is a summit meeting in need of disrupting. If I give you the coordinates for the meeting site, can you go over there and blow up a diplomat?
messages.zh:
哦，我很抱歉对你发火，但今天真是忙得不可开交。如果是和盖伦特在家门口开战还不够糟的话，米玛塔尔最近可是越来越活跃了。

最危险的就是我们两方面的敌人越走越近会联合起来攻打我们。帝国可不允许这种事情发生。为此，我们不能让他们的峰会顺利进行。如果我把会议地址的坐标给你，你能帮我去把外交官炸个稀巴烂吗？

messages.en: As I did not receive word from you about the summit we discussed, I have handled the problem by assigning another pilot.
messages.zh: 你对于我们所讨论的关于的峰会的事没有给我答复，我已经指派了另一个飞行员去处理了。

messages.en: Enemy summit disrupted.
messages.zh: 敌峰会已瓦解。

messages.en: I'm not going to be able to finish this job after all.
messages.zh: 我根本没办法完成这个任务。

messages.en: Then stop wasting my time!
messages.zh: 那就别再浪费我的时间了！

messages.en: I thought you were taking care of that matter in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that we discussed. And now I find out from my source that the summit went on unimpeded. What have you been up to all this time? I'm beginning to think you're not as trustworthy as I'd been led to believe. Rest assured, you're going to have to work hard to get back into my good graces.
messages.zh: 我以为你像我们讨论的那样在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}处理事情。现在我发现峰会没有受到影响。你这段时间都在干什么？我现在觉得你不像别人说得那么可靠了。放心，只要你往后努力工作，我还会对你重拾信心。

messages.en: Summit unimpeded
messages.zh: 峰会未受影响

name.de: Unfrieden stiften - Zerstörung der Delegation (2 von 2)
name.en: Driving a Wedge - Delegation Destruction (2 of 2)
name.es: Sembrar la discordia: Destrucción delegacional (2 de 2)
name.fr: Creuser un fossé - Destruction de délégation (2 sur 2)
name.ja: 分裂作戦―代理人の殺害（2/2）
name.ru: Как поссорить союзников — уничтожение делегации (Driving a Wedge - Delegation Destruction) (2 из 2)

messages.en: Only one battleship? No problem.
messages.zh: 只有一艘战列舰？没问题。

messages.en: For your sake, I hope not. Good luck.
messages.zh: 为了你自己，我希望不是。好运。

messages.en: You mentioned an opportunity?
messages.zh: 你说有个机会？

messages.en:
The attack on the meeting between the Gallente and Minmatar emissaries went perfectly. Now we need to finish the job. After escaping the scene of the attack, the Minmatar ambassador was whisked away to a nearby staging area.

A raid on the Minmatar delegation now will look like a reprisal raid from the Gallente delegation, and since the Minmatar know they weren't responsible for the initial attack, they'll be even angrier. We have reason to believe that the enemy diplomats have been transferred aboard the Minmatar flagship to ensure their safety. It's the only battleship in the delegation, and it must be destroyed.
messages.zh:
在盖伦特和米玛塔尔的特使会面时发动袭击进展非常顺利。现在我们要完成它。从袭击中逃生的米玛塔尔大使被降职发配到了附近的一个集合区。

米玛尔塔代表团遭受的突袭现在看来像是盖伦特代表团发起的报复性突袭，并且要是米玛尔塔知道先前的袭击与他们无关的话，他们就会更加生气了。我有理由相信为了确保敌方外交官的安全，他们已经被转移到米玛尔塔的旗舰上了。那是代表团里唯一的战列舰，一定要摧毁掉。

messages.en: The enemy flagship is no more.
messages.zh: 敌人的旗舰不复存在了。

messages.en: I knew you were up to it. Good work, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 我知道你能够胜任的。好好干，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: Attack a battleship and its entire convoy? No thanks.
messages.zh: 攻击一艘战列舰和它所有的护航队？算了吧。

messages.en: You're letting a great opportunity slip away, but it's your call.
messages.zh: 你让一个绝佳的机会白白溜走了。不过这也正是你的风格。

messages.en:
The attack on the meeting between the Gallente and Minmatar emissaries went perfectly. Now we need to finish the job. After escaping the scene of the attack, the Minmatar ambassador was whisked away to a nearby staging area.

A raid on the Minmatar delegation now will look like a reprisal raid from the Gallente delegation, and since the Minmatar know they weren't responsible for the initial attack, they'll be even angrier. We have reason to believe that the enemy diplomats have been transferred aboard the Minmatar flagship to ensure their safety. It's the only battleship in the delegation, and it must be destroyed. Are you game?
messages.zh:
在盖伦特和米玛塔尔的特使会面时发动袭击进展非常顺利。现在我们要完成它。从袭击中逃生的米玛塔尔大使被降职发配到了附近的一个集合区。

米玛尔塔代表团遭受的突袭现在看来像是盖伦特代表团发起的报复性突袭，并且要是米玛尔塔知道先前的袭击与他们无关的话，他们就会更加生气了。我有理由相信为了确保敌方外交官的安全，他们已经被转移到米玛尔塔的旗舰上了。那是代表团里唯一的战列舰，一定要摧毁掉。你愿意吗？

messages.en: Apparently we did not strike while the iron was hot. In the time since I've talked to you, my source has indicated that the Minmatar emissaries have safely made it back to their own space. Worse still, they appear to have sorted things out with the Gallente, or at least allayed some of their suspicions.
messages.zh: 很显然我们没有能够乘热打铁。在我上次和你谈话后不久，我得到情报说玛塔尔的间谍安全的回到了他们自己的空间。更糟的是，他们与盖伦特之间的事情已经解决了，或者至少已经消除了疑虑。

messages.en: Minmatar delegation escapes
messages.zh: 米玛尔塔代表团逃离

messages.en: Find someone else to take this on. I'm busy.
messages.zh: 找其他人干这个吧。我忙着呢。

messages.en: What happened to “no problem?” You capsuleers are all alike – as soon as the going gets tough you cut and run.
messages.zh: 不是说“没有问题”吗？你们飞行员都一样——事情一糟你们就溜之大吉。

messages.en: Apparently we did not strike while the iron was hot. In the time since I've talked to you, my source has indicated that the Minmatar emissaries have safely made it back to their own space. Worse still, they appear to have sorted things out with the Gallente, or at least allayed some of their suspicions.
messages.zh: 很显然我们没有能够乘热打铁。在我上次和你谈话后不久，我得到情报说玛塔尔的间谍安全的回到了他们自己的空间。更糟的是，他们与盖伦特之间的事情已经解决了，或者至少已经消除了疑虑。

messages.en: Minmatar delegation escapes
messages.zh: 米玛尔塔代表团逃离
