messages.en: A diplomatic facility? No problem.
messages.zh: 一处外交设施？没问题。

messages.en: For your sake, I hope not. Good luck.
messages.zh: 为了你自己，我希望不是。好运。

messages.en: You mentioned an opportunity?
messages.zh: 你说有个机会？

messages.en: The attack on the meeting between the Gallente and Minmatar emissaries went perfectly. Now we need to finish the job.  After escaping the scene of the attack, the Gallente ambassador was whisked away to a small consulate facility. A raid on the Gallente diplomatic station now will look like a reprisal raid, which should drive the wedge between our enemies further.
messages.zh: 在盖伦特和米玛塔尔的特使会面时发动袭击进展非常顺利。现在我们要完成它。从袭击中逃生的盖伦特大使被降职发配到了一个小领事馆。如果现在对盖伦特外交空间站发动突袭，看起来会像一场报复性袭击，会更进一步地离间我们的敌人。

messages.en: The enemy diplomats have been dealt with.
messages.zh: 敌人的外交官已经被解决了。

messages.en: I knew you were up to it. Good work, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 我知道你能够胜任的。好好干，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: Sorry, I have better things to do.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我有更重要的事情要做。

messages.en: You're letting a great opportunity slip away, but it's your call.
messages.zh: 你让一个绝佳的机会白白溜走了。不过这也正是你的风格。

messages.en:
The attack on the meeting between the Gallente and Minmatar emissaries went perfectly. Now we need to finish the job. After escaping the scene of the attack, the Gallente ambassador was whisked away to a small consulate facility. A raid on the Gallente diplomatic station now will look like a reprisal raid, which should drive the wedge between our enemies further.

Do you think you're up to the task?
messages.zh: 在盖伦特和米玛塔尔的特使会面时发动袭击进展非常顺利。现在我们要完成它。从袭击中逃生的盖伦特大使被降职发配到了一个小领事馆。如果现在对盖伦特外交空间站发动突袭，看起来会像一场报复性袭击，会更进一步地离间我们的敌人。

messages.en: Apparently we did not strike while the iron was hot. In the time since I've talked to you, my source has indicated that the Gallente diplomats have safely made it back to their home systems. Worse still, they appear to have sorted things out with the Minmatar, or at least allayed some of their suspicions.
messages.zh: 显然我们没能趁热打铁。在我们谈话的时间里，我的线人说盖伦特外交官安全返回他们自己的星系了。更糟的是，他们似乎和米玛塔尔一起解决了事情，至少也缓和了他们的猜疑。

messages.en: Gallente delegation escapes
messages.zh: 盖伦特代表团逃逸

messages.en: Find someone else to take this on. I'm busy.
messages.zh: 找其他人干这个吧。我忙着呢。

messages.en: What happened to “no problem?” You capsuleers are all alike – as soon as the going gets tough you cut and run.
messages.zh: 不是说“没有问题”吗？你们飞行员都一样——事情一糟你们就溜之大吉。

messages.en: Apparently we did not strike while the iron was hot. In the time since I've talked to you, my source has indicated that the Gallente diplomats have safely made it back to their home systems. Worse still, they appear to have sorted things out with the Minmatar, or at least allayed some of their suspicions.
messages.zh: 显然我们没能趁热打铁。在我们谈话的时间里，我的线人说盖伦特外交官安全返回他们自己的星系了。更糟的是，他们似乎和米玛塔尔一起解决了事情，至少也缓和了他们的猜疑。

messages.en: Gallente delegation escapes
messages.zh: 盖伦特代表团逃逸

messages.en: I'm willing to help any way I can. Just say where the cargo is.
messages.zh: 我会尽我所能帮助你的。告诉我你的货在哪就行了。

messages.en: Good decision. The meds are being moved into your hangar as we speak — ready for loading in just a sec.
messages.zh: 真是个明智的决定。如我们所说的那样正在把药搬进你的机库—马上就开始装运。

messages.en: I am in need of, uh, gainful employment, yes.
messages.zh: 我需要的是，嗯，一份能赚大钱的工作，对。

messages.en:
We've got a shipment of vaccines that need to be delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} in a hurry. I'm willing to provide a substantial bonus if they're delivered right away. Regardless, the meds need to be delivered soon, though.

Be sure to move the medicine into your cargo hold before you set out. And note the hasty delivery required — you don't have much time!
messages.zh:
我们有一批需要加急运送至{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的抗生素。如果你能马上把这批货送达，我很乐意支付一笔十分可观的奖金。无论如何，这些药需要马上送达。

但一定要确保把药物装进货舱后才能起飞。而且动作要快——时间并不充裕！

messages.en: The medications have been delivered, {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 药物已送达，{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. Come by again sometime; I can generally find work for a dependable operator.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。有时间再过来一次；我总能给一个值得信赖的特工找到工作的。

messages.en: Sorry, not the right kind of job for me. Find another errand boy.
messages.zh: 不好意思，这不是我想要的工作。还是找其他人为您跑腿吧。

messages.en: Well, that doesn't help at all, {[character]player.name}! These supplies really need to be delivered.  Thanks for nothing.
messages.zh: 真是一点忙都帮不上，{[character]player.name}！这些货可急需被运出去。真是感谢你的无所作为。

messages.en:
Well, you're pretty green, by the look of you, but I've got no choice. You may have heard all the rumors. The entire frontier is buzzing with reports that we're pretty much at war with the Amarrians. I can't say either way, for sure, but I do know that all this war talk has led to some big headaches when it comes to commercial traffic and trade-route management. Passenger liners are all booked, haulers have been pre-empted by the military or by wealthy clients... god, it's just a mess out there.

Anyway, as you may have seen, the docks here at {[location]agentStationID.name} are filled to overflowing with tons of goods, and we can't seem to find enough transport to get them to their destinations. I need to get some of this stuff out of here.

Ah, here: we've got a shipment of vaccines that need to be delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} in a hurry. I'm willing to provide a substantial bonus if they're delivered right away. Regardless, the meds need to be delivered soon, though.

Say the word and you can move the stuff into your cargo hold. Can you do it?
messages.zh:
从表面上来看，你的确是名新手，不过我们别无选择。我想你已经听说外面的传闻了吧。 整条前线都在叽叽喳喳的议论着我们与艾玛之间的战争，我什么都不想说，然而我知道对于商业交通及贸易路线管理来说，这些关于战争的言论都会导致令人头痛的大问题。定期客轮都被预定光了，搬运工也早就被军队及富有的客人预定了。天啊，这儿真是一团糟。

不管怎么样，就如你所看到的，{[location]agentStationID.name}的码头堆满了货物，而且我们找不到足够的运输船只把他们运到目的地。我必须把一些货物运出去。

啊，这儿：我们有一批需要紧急运送至{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的抗生素。如果你能马上把这批货送达，我很乐意支付一笔十分可观的奖金。无论如何，这批药需要马上送达。

同意的话就把货物搬进你的货舱吧。行吗？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}:

You've taken too long, I'm afraid — those medications are no longer required at that station. They managed to find some from somewhere else since you took so long. You've lost your bonus and your payment altogether.

I hope that this will be a valuable lesson for you.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}:

你已经磨蹭的太久了，恐怕空间站已经不再需要那些药物了。因为你的拖沓，他们只得自己在其他地方找到了一些药物。你不但没有奖金而且一分报酬都别想拿。

我希望你能从中吸取宝贵的教训。

messages.en: Payment canceled; medications expired
messages.zh: 报酬没了；药品又过期了

messages.en: I've decided that I don't want this job after all. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我想我还是不适合这份工作。不好意思。

messages.en: That's pretty poor behavior, {[character]player.name}. I and my corporation are disappointed in you.
messages.zh: 干的太差劲了，{[character]player.name}。你真让我和我的公司失望。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}:

You've taken too long, I'm afraid — those medications are no longer required at that station. They managed to find some from somewhere else since you took so long. You've lost your bonus and your payment altogether.

I hope that this will be a valuable lesson for you.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}:

你已经磨蹭的太久了，恐怕空间站已经不再需要那些药物了。因为你的拖沓，他们只得自己在其他地方找到了一些药物。你不但没有奖金而且一分报酬都别想拿。

我希望你能从中吸取宝贵的教训。

messages.en: Payment canceled; medications expired
messages.zh: 报酬没了；药品又过期了

messages.en: I'll defend the gate. You know I'm up to it.
messages.zh: 我这就去守门。你知道我没问题的。

messages.en: That's the spirit.
messages.zh: 就要你这股劲。

messages.en: I need some work.
messages.zh: 我需要一些工作。

messages.en:
The Amarr are conducting an unprecedented number of probing missions in this and the surrounding systems.

I need you to defend a military gate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. You must utterly destroy any Amarr forces that approach the gate. We need to send a message of strength in our position.
messages.zh:
艾玛人在这里以及周围星系对我们进行了规模空前的侦察行动。

我要去你防守{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一座军用跃迁轨道。你必须消灭所有接近轨道的艾玛部队，让他们知道我们不是好惹的。

messages.en: The Amarr did attack the gate, but I destroyed them all.
messages.zh: 艾玛人果然袭击了我们的跃迁轨道，但我已经把他们都解决掉了。

messages.en: Your work here represents real progress in our campaign against the Amarr.
messages.zh: 你又为我们在与艾玛的战斗中取得了一场胜利。

messages.en: This situation sounds like it could very easily get out of hand. I don't want any part of it.
messages.zh: 这事情弄不好就会失控。我不想参与。

messages.en: Don't you realize how important this is to the Federation?
messages.zh: 你难道不明白这事对联邦的重要性吗？

messages.en: Space battles generally occur around targets of strategic and tactical significance: gates, stations, corporate structures, asteroids or mining colonies, research facilities, outposts, etc.
messages.zh: 太空战斗一般都发生在战略要地：星门、空间站、军团建筑、陨石、开采基地、研究所及哨站等。

messages.en: Targets
messages.zh: 目标

messages.en:
Good, I have some work for you. We're facing a serious issue in this area. The Amarr are conducting an unprecedented number of probing missions in this and the surrounding systems.

I need you to defend a military gate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. You must utterly destroy any Amarr forces that approach the gate. We need to send a message of strength in our position.
messages.zh:
好啊，我正好有事让你干。我们在此地区遇到了一个严重问题。艾玛人在这里以及周围星系对我们进行了规模空前的侦察行动。

我要去你防守{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一座军用跃迁轨道。你必须消灭所有接近轨道的艾玛部队，让他们知道我们不是好惹的。

messages.en: You have let down the Federation and you have let me down.
messages.zh: 你不光是让联邦政府失望了，我也对你失望了。

messages.en: Amarr surveillance goes unopposed
messages.zh: 艾玛侦察队顺利完成任务

messages.en: I quit.
messages.zh: 我不干了。

messages.en: You've let us all down.
messages.zh: 你让大家都失望了。

messages.en: You have let down the Federation and you have let me down.
messages.zh: 你不光是让联邦政府失望了，我也对你失望了。

messages.en: Amarr surveillance goes unopposed
messages.zh: 艾玛侦察队顺利完成任务

messages.en: I'll go get you your roach poison, sure.
messages.zh: 当然，我去帮你拿来蟑螂药。

messages.en: Don't waste any time. These bugs grow more aggressive during sleep cycles.
messages.zh: 别浪费时间了。这些虫子会在它们的睡眠周期内变的更凶猛。

messages.en: Mess? What mess? It looks spotless in here.
messages.zh: 一团糟？什么一团糟？这儿看起来无可挑剔。

messages.en:
An infestation of nasty, biting roaches has taken hold on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and it is growing out of control. In fact, it's gotten so bad that they've considered venting the emergency airlocks briefly and allowing the station atmosphere to empty into space, but scientists tell us the little bastards can survive even in space for hours.

The only answer is to gas the entire station. The substance they want to use is a special concoction designed specifically to grant this particular species of roach a quick death. I have a shipment of the stuff; I just need you to get it there. This stuff is more dangerous than the cockroaches.

Note the hasty delivery required — you don't have much time to complete this mission.
messages.zh:
一大群讨厌的会咬人的蟑螂占领了{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name},，并且愈发不可控制。

实际上，情况是如此的糟糕，我们只能让紧急舱通通气，让空间站里的空气流入太空中，但是我们的科学家告诉我们那些小畜生即使在太空中也能活上几小时。

唯一解决方法就是把空间站烧个遍。我们想用一种让这种特殊的蟑螂死的特别快的特制品。我已经订了一批那玩意。我只需要你去把他们拿回来。一拿回来就通知我这样我们就可以赶紧开始我们空间站的大扫除。这玩意可比蟑螂更危险。

注意你可只有一点时间来完成这次使命。

messages.en: Here's your bug spray. Come and get it.
messages.zh: 这是你的除虫喷雾，快过来拿。

messages.en: They'll offload the chemicals immediately. You should be fine on your ship. They'll be gassing every corner of the structure, though.
messages.zh: 他们马上就要把化学品都卸下来。你应该好好的呆在你的船上。他们要把每个角落都发满毒气。

messages.en: I don't have time for this. Clean up your own mess.
messages.zh: 我没时间帮你干这些。不好意思，你得自己解决问题。

messages.en: I hope I can find someone else to handle this. These bugs mostly come out during sleep cycle. Mostly.
messages.zh: 我希望能找人来处理这个问题。这些虫子通常都在睡眠周期内生长出来。通常都这样。

messages.en:
An infestation of nasty, biting roaches has taken hold on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and it is growing out of control. In fact, it's gotten so bad that they've considered venting the emergency airlocks briefly and allowing the station atmosphere to empty into space, but scientists tell us the little bastards can survive even in space for hours.

The only answer is to gas the entire station. The substance they want to use is a special concoction designed specifically to grant this particular species of roach a quick death. I have a shipment of the stuff; I just need you to get it there. This stuff is more dangerous than the cockroaches.

Note the hasty delivery required — you don't have much time to complete this mission.
messages.zh:
一大群讨厌的会咬人的蟑螂占领了{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name},，并且愈发不可控制。

实际上，情况是如此的糟糕，我们只能让紧急舱通通气，让空间站里的空气流入太空中，但是我们的科学家告诉我们那些小畜生即使在太空中也能活上几小时。

唯一解决方法就是把空间站烧个遍。我们想用一种让这种特殊的蟑螂死的特别快的特制品。我已经订了一批那玩意。我只需要你去把他们拿回来。一拿回来就通知我这样我们就可以赶紧开始我们空间站的大扫除。这玩意可比蟑螂更危险。

注意你可只有一点时间来完成这次使命。

messages.en: I don't have time for this after all. Sorry, but you'll have to clean up your own mess.
messages.zh: 我没时间帮你干这些。不好意思，你得自己把这一团糟的事解决。

messages.en: Blasted roaches!
messages.zh: 该死的蟑螂！

name.ru: Конец перехвату информации (An End to Eavesdropping)

messages.en: Of course you can count on me.
messages.zh: 你当然可以指望我。

messages.en: Glad to hear it.  But be careful out there; you're not dealing with amateurs.
messages.zh: 听到这个消息我真高兴。在那要小心；你可不是在对付外行啊。

messages.en: I'm always ready to do my part. How can I help?
messages.zh: 我时刻准备着干我该干的事。我能怎么帮助你呢？

messages.en: Our counter-intelligence service has indicated that the Gallente Federal Intelligence Office has erected a covert listening post in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. While our communications are encrypted, the presence of Gallente intelligence operations in our space poses both an insult to Caldari sovereignty and an unacceptable risk to communications security.
messages.zh: 我们的反情报部门指出盖伦特联邦情报局已经在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一个地下情报站。但是我可以向你保证我们的通信都是加了密的，盖伦特在我们空间的行动不仅是对加达里主权的侮辱，也是通信安全不可接受的风险。

messages.en: The Gallente spies have been destroyed.
messages.zh: 盖伦特的间谍都被歼灭了。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}! The agent who recommended you to me may not have praised you highly enough!
messages.zh: 干的好，{[character]player.name}！把你推荐给我的人夸你还夸得不够！

messages.en: This doesn't really sound like my kind of thing, sorry.
messages.zh: 听起来这不像我一贯干的事，不好意思。

messages.en: So, what, we're just supposed to let the Gallente spy on us? I'll have to inform the agent who recommended you that you're less reliable than advertized. Get out of my sight.
messages.zh: 什么，我们应该让盖伦特暗中监视我们？看来我要和推荐你来的中介说一下你实在是不如他们说推荐的那样值得信赖。别让我再见到你。

messages.en: The Gallente FIO answers directly to the Gallente President. Its works are shrouded in secrecy and covert operations. Among their spying operations are the construction and operation of numerous small, covert listening posts designed to glean information from enemy signals and communications.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦情报局直接回答盖伦特总统。他们的工作是秘密进行的。他们的间谍行动是由无数个小型的秘密情报站建设和运行的，而这些小型的秘密情报站是从敌人的信号和通信中收集信息的。

messages.en: The Federal Intelligence Office
messages.zh: 联邦情报局

messages.en:
Our counter-intelligence service has indicated that the Gallente Federal Intelligence Office has erected a covert listening post in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. While I assure you our communications are encrypted, the presence of Gallente intelligence operations in our space poses both an insult to Caldari sovereignty and an unacceptable risk to communications security.

Your task is simple: go there, overwhelm whatever forces are defending the post, and destroy it. Can I count on you to see this through?
messages.zh:
我们的反情报部门指出盖伦特联邦情报局已经在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建立了一个地下情报站。但是我可以向你保证我们的通信都是加了密的，盖伦特在我们空间的行动不仅是对加达里主权的侮辱，也是通信安全不可接受的风险。

你的任务很简单：过去把所有保卫情报站的部队都消灭掉。我能把这个重任交给你吗？

messages.en: Perhaps I did not impress upon you the importance of the matter we discussed, but your delay in replying to my offer is unacceptable. I have taken the liberty of giving the job to someone who understands the importance of rooting out spies.
messages.zh: 或许是我未能让你意识到这件任务的重要性，但是我们不能接受你迟来的回复。我已经把工作派给能够理解铲除间谍的重要性的人了。

messages.en: Gallente Listening Post Destroyed
messages.zh: 盖伦特的情报站已经被摧毁了

messages.en: I'm afraid I'm not going to be able to complete this job for you.
messages.zh: 恐怕我不能帮你完成这个任务

messages.en: Well, at least you tried. Good luck in your travels, {[character]player.name}
messages.zh: 好吧，最起码你尽力了。祝你一路顺风，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Perhaps I did not impress upon you the importance of the matter we discussed, but your delay in performing this simple task is unacceptable. I have taken the liberty of giving the job to someone who understands the importance of rooting out spies.
messages.zh: 或许是我未能让你意识到这件任务的重要性，但是你连这么一件简单的任务都不能及时完成实在是让人无法接受。我已经把工作派给能够理解铲除间谍的重要性的人了。

messages.en: Gallente Listening Post Destroyed
messages.zh: 盖伦特的情报站已经被摧毁了

messages.en: Absolutely. Just let me at ‘em.
messages.zh: 当然。让我去解决吧。

messages.en: Excellent. Get out there and make it happen. The sooner those enemy patrols are out of the way, the sooner we can launch the raid.
messages.zh: 好极了。快去执行。一旦敌军的巡逻队撤退，我们就能发起突袭。

messages.en: I hear you've got some important work to be done. How can I help?
messages.zh: 我听说你有些十分重要的活要找人干。我能帮你吗？

messages.en: In order to maximize the element of surprise for our raid, all enemy pickets and patrol ships must be destroyed. Go to the assigned location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy all the ships you find there. Beware of enemy reinforcements!
messages.zh: 为了能加大突袭行动的力度，所有敌人的哨兵和巡逻船都要摧毁。快去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的指定地点并把所有敌船都消灭掉。小心敌人的增援部队。

messages.en: All opposition has been swept away. Where's my reward?
messages.zh: 敌人都被赶走了。赏金在哪里？

messages.en: Well done, {[character]player.name}. You'll no doubt be happy to hear that early reports indicate our raid has been a stunning success!
messages.zh: 干的好，{[character]player.name}。告诉你一个喜讯，之前有报告已经表明我们的这次突袭是个巨大成功！

messages.en: Hmm, this isn't really what I had in mind. Maybe next time.
messages.zh: 这和我想的有些差距。下次吧。

messages.en: Suit yourself, though I'd like to remind you that the details of our discussion are to be kept in the strictest of confidence. Operational security, you understand. If it gets back to me that you've been blabbing about this raid, there will be hell to pay. You are dismissed.
messages.zh: 随你的便，但我还是要提醒你我们所谈的一切都要高度保密。要十分安全，你明白的。一旦我听说你走漏风声，后果不堪设想。那你就别想再干下去了。

messages.en:
The time has come to strike a blow against the arrogant Gallente. We're going to stage a raid deep into Gallente territory. In order to mask the movements of our forces, however, we first need to wipe out their pickets and patrols. We could do this with our own ships, of course, but that might alert the enemy to our plans. A lone, talented capsuleer, on the other hand, would make short work of them and raise less suspicion.

I've uploaded the coordinates of the stepping-off point of our raid into your nav-computer. I want you to go there and destroy all of the enemy ships you find. Be advised that they may try to bring in reinforcements, but that should be no problem for someone of your caliber. Are you up to the task?
messages.zh:
这次对于傲慢的盖伦特来说无疑是次打击。我们准备对盖伦特的领空进行一次偷袭。为了使我们这次行动不暴露，我们先要干掉他们的护卫和巡逻队。我们 可以用我们自己的船，当然这样会激起敌人对我们计划的警惕。另一方面，一位无组织的，有能力的飞行员可以迅速解决掉他们并且不会引起太多的怀疑。

我已经把一步步前进的坐标上传到你的导航计算机了。我要你去那把所有的敌船都消灭掉。他们可能会有增援部队，但是对你来说应该没有问题。你准备接受这个任务吗？

messages.en: Based on your lack of response, I take it that this assignment did not interest you. Had you been considerate enough to simply tell us that up front, we could have gotten someone else. As it is, we've had to scrub the entire raid.
messages.zh: 你没有给我答复，所以我以为你对此不感兴趣。如果你能体谅我们一下的话就该早点告诉我们，我们还可以找其他人。现在，我们不得不取消整个突袭行动。

messages.en: Raid canceled
messages.zh: 突袭行动取消

messages.en: I'm afraid you're going to have to find someone else to deal with your problem. I have more important things to do.
messages.zh: 我恐怕你得找其他人帮你了。我有更重要的事情。

messages.en: This is terrible! Our operations time-table is totally disrupted. I hold you personally responsible, {[character]player.name}
messages.zh: 太糟啦！我们的行动计划表都被你搞乱了。你应该为此负责，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Due to your inability to deal with this assignment in a timely fashion, the entire raid has been scrubbed. It may be quite some time before another opportunity this good arises. Whatever you were doing, I hope it was important.
messages.zh: 因为你未能及时处理好这次任务，突袭不得不取消。可能不会再有如此良好的机会了。不管你做了什么，我都希望是有价值的。

messages.en: Raid canceled
messages.zh: 突袭行动取消

messages.en: No problem. I'll do this job and sleep with a clear conscience.
messages.zh: 没问题。我会去做这份工作，然后睡个安稳觉。

messages.en: Good. Now get out there and wreck something.
messages.zh: 很好。现在离开这儿，去干点坏事吧。

messages.en: Yes. Do you have an assignment for me?
messages.zh: 是的。你有任务交给我吗？

messages.en:
Even in times of conflict with an external enemy we still find ourselves in competition with other “friendly” corporations. One such corporation is providing security for a repair outpost. They got that security contract by underbidding us. Go to the site, destroy their entire security force, then destroy the repair outpost. With such an abysmal failure on their record, they'll never get another security contract in this sector again.

And who knows, maybe we'll get the reconstruction contract for the replacement outpost as well.
messages.zh:
即使是在抵御外敌的时候，我们仍然发现自己与其它一些看似“友好”的公司竞争着。其中一家公司给一个修理哨站提供保安服务。他们以低于我们的价格签下了那份合同。你到现场去，摧毁他们的整个防卫力量，然后摧毁掉修理哨站。有了这么一次失败记录，他们就再也别想在这个地区混下去了。

说不定我们还能赢得新哨站的重建合同。

messages.en: I've taken care of your little problem. Now pay up.
messages.zh: 我已经处理好了你的小问题。现在付钱给我吧。

messages.en: You really are a ruthless one, {[character]player.name}. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is always looking for pilots like you. Look me up again if you ever need work.
messages.zh: 你真是个无情的人，{[character]player.name}。{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}始终在寻找像你这样的飞行员。你需要工作的时候就来找我吧。

messages.en: I don't think I'm cut out for that kind of work, sorry.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我可不觉得这是该由我来干的活。

messages.en: Too bad. I guess I'll have to find someone with a stronger stomach or looser morals. You are dismissed.
messages.zh: 糟透了。看样子我得另找一个气量更大的或者不那么较真的人。你被开除了。

messages.en:
As a matter of fact, I do. As I'm sure you're aware, even in times of conflict with an external enemy we still find ourselves in competition with other “friendly” corporations. One such corporation is providing security for a repair outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They got that security contract by underbidding us. I want you to head out there, destroy their entire security force, then destroy the repair outpost. With such an abysmal failure on their record, they'll never get another security contract in this sector again.

And who knows, maybe we'll get the reconstruction contract for the replacement outpost as well.

So what do you say? Do you think you can handle this job? I can make it worth your while.
messages.zh:
事实上，是的。我想你肯定已经知道了，即使是在抵御外敌的时候，我们仍然发现自己与其它一些看似“友好”的公司竞争着。其中一家公司给{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个修理哨站提供保安服务。他们以低于我们的价格签下了那份合同。我想让你到那里去，摧毁他们的整个防卫力量，然后摧毁掉修理哨站。有了这么一次失败记录，他们就再也别想在这个地区混下去了。

说不定我们还能赢得新哨站的重建合同。

你觉得怎么样？你能胜任吗？我不会让你吃亏的。

messages.en: When you didn't respond to my offer, I found someone willing to undertake the job. He did what we asked of him, but got caught in the process, implicating us in the attack. Amateur. I wish you'd been able to help us, because I know you'd have done the job right. Oh well, maybe next time.
messages.zh: 你没有对我的提案给出答复，我已经找了愿做的人接手这份工作了。他做到了我们的要求，但是他也在过程中被捕了，把我们牵扯进了袭击中。真业余。我希望你能帮助我们，因为我知道这份工作如果交给你做，你一定能出色完成。下次就找你吧。

messages.en: Repair Outpost destroyed
messages.zh: 修理哨站已摧毁

messages.en: I've had second thoughts. I'm not going to do this job after all.
messages.zh: 我有别的主意。我不打算做这份工作。

messages.en: I knew you couldn't hack it. Maybe you should look for a different line of work.
messages.zh: 我早知道你不行。或许你该找其它水准的工作。

messages.en: I take it from your inability to complete the job we discussed that you had second thoughts about it. I'm not paying you to grapple with your morals. Next time, just decline the job so that I can find someone with the guts to actually pull the trigger.
messages.zh: 既然你有别的打算而不能完成这份工作，那么我认了。我不会付钱给你让你去想通道德问题。下次不如直接拒绝我，我好另找个勇敢的人来扣动扳机。

messages.en: Repair Outpost still operational
messages.zh: 修理哨站仍在运作

messages.en: Well, it may not be glamorous, but for the good of the State I'll do it.
messages.zh: 这可能不太诱人，但是为了合众国，我会去办的。

messages.en: Excellent! This will take some of the pressure off our forces and allow them to get down to the important work of striking at the enemy.
messages.zh: 很好！这会减轻我们军队的压力，让他们能腾出手来向敌人发起进攻。

messages.en: I've heard you have ample work for skilled pilots. Is that true, or are you wasting my time and money as well?
messages.zh: 听说你有许多工作给专业飞行员做。到底是真的还是你在浪费我的时间和钱？

messages.en: Head for your assigned patrol sector coordinates. Wait there and destroy any enemy ships that show up. Make sure none of them escape!
messages.zh: 你到给你指定的巡逻坐标去。等在那里，摧毁一切出现的敌舰。不要放走任何一艘！

messages.en: The sector assigned to me is clear.  No enemy vessels escaped.
messages.zh: 指派给我的区域已经清理完了，没有敌舰逃走。

messages.en: I knew you could be counted upon, {[character]player.name}. Your sense of patriotism has been duly noted. Please accept this reward, and do not hesitate to contact me again in the future should you need work. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} always has opportunities for enterprising pilots.
messages.zh: 我就知道你靠得住，{[character]player.name}。你的爱国精神一定会被记录下来。收下这笔奖励吧，以后你再需要工作的话尽管来找我。{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}一定会有机会留给有上进心的飞行员。

messages.en: Patrol work? Talk about wasting time.  I have no interest in your mission.
messages.zh: 巡逻？浪费时间。我对这任务没兴趣。

messages.en: As I suspected, talking to you was a waste of time. Be gone from my sight.
messages.zh: 如我所料，跟你谈话是在浪费时间。不想再看到你。

messages.en: As you may be aware, the Gallente Navy has been making increasingly bold reconnaissance patrols into Caldari space. This is unacceptable and must be stopped immediately. Unfortunately, given our own Navy's operational tempo, we don't have the forces to spare to cover every avenue of hostile approach. That's where you come in, {[character]player.name}. I want you to patrol an area where we've had reports of hostile recon patrols recently. Think you can handle that?
messages.zh: 或许你已经知道了，盖伦特海军正派遣大量的侦察队进入加达里领域。这是令我们无法接受的，我们必须立即加以阻止。很不幸，以我们自己海军的行动效率，我们现在没有足够的兵力覆盖整个敌区。这就是目前的情况，{[character]player.name}。我要你到一个地区去巡逻，最近接到报告说那边出现了敌人的侦察队。你能处理好吗？

messages.en: While the ability to strike out offensively at the enemy may not matter to you, rest assured it is of the utmost importance to us. Due to your lack of response, main-line Naval forces have been tasked with patrolling. While nothing catastrophic has come from you leaving us hanging this time, it has caused an inevitable delay in offensive operations.
messages.zh: 你觉得对敌人频繁地发动攻击不关你的事，可是对我们来说这非常重要。由于你缺乏责任感，海军主力接受了巡逻任务。虽然你耽误我们这段时间没有造成重大灾难，但是对攻击行动还是造成了不可避免的延误。

messages.en: Navy forces stretched to limit
messages.zh: 海军兵力延伸已到极限

messages.en: I'm afraid something more pressing has come up.
messages.zh: 恐怕会发生更麻烦的事情。

messages.en: Very disappointing, {[character]player.name}. A true patriot would have finished the task for the good of the State. Your unwillingness to perform when called upon will be noted in your permanent record, I assure you.
messages.zh: 很令人失望，{[character]player.name}。一个真正的爱国者应该完成对国家有益的任务。你的消极态度会写进你的永久记录，我保证。

messages.en: Your laxness has cost the State dearly. While you were off haring about, a small enemy raiding force seems to have slipped through your assigned sector and destroyed three commerce vessels. I hope in the future you won't be so cavalier with the safety of sovereign Caldari territory.
messages.zh: 你的松懈让合众国付出了沉重的代价。在你逃跑的时候，敌人的一支小型突击队似乎很轻松地穿过了你的辖区并击毁了三艘商用舰船。我希望将来加达里领土安全受到威胁的时候你可别那么畏缩。

messages.en: Gallente raid successful
messages.zh: 袭击盖伦特成功

messages.en: No problem. I'll get on it right away.
messages.zh: 没问题，我马上就出发。

messages.en: Good.  Just be careful out there. You might not be the only scavenger picking through the wreckage.
messages.zh: 很好。不过要小心。你也许不是唯一对这堆残骸有兴趣的清道夫。

messages.en: I'm looking for work. Have you got anything for me?
messages.zh: 我在找工作。你有什么能让我干的活吗？

messages.en:
Recently a long-range reconnaissance patrol was sent out deep behind enemy lines. While trying to exfiltrate to friendly lines, our recon ship inadvertently jumped into the middle of a pitched battle. The ship and its cargo were lost. Go to the site of the battle, find the wreck of our reconnaissance ship, and salvage the data chips from the remains. This task will require the use of a Salvager module.

Beware that there may be other scavengers or interested parties in the area. Take whatever steps you feel are necessary to bring the data back safely.
messages.zh:
最近，一支远程勘查巡逻队被派去深入敌后。直到返航前，一切都很顺利。当他们试着渗透到友方阵线的时候，我们的勘查舰不小心跳跃进了一场乱战中。舰船和它的货物都损毁了。你前去那个战场，找到勘查舰的残骸，并回收资料芯片。这个任务将会需要使用回收装备。

小心那里可能会有其他清道夫和对此感兴趣的组织。为了把资料安全地带回来，你必须不择手段。

messages.en: I have recovered your data.
messages.zh: 我带回了你的资料。

messages.en: My thanks, {[character]player.name}. I'll get this to our intelligence analysts immediately.
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]player.name}。我会马上把它带给情报分析师。

messages.en: Sorry, that's not really something I can help you with right now.
messages.zh: 抱歉，这件事我现在没法帮你。

messages.en: That's a shame. Ah, well, maybe next time.
messages.zh: 真遗憾。啊，好吧，也许下次吧。

messages.en:
For someone of your caliber? Always.

Recently a long-range reconnaissance patrol was sent out deep behind enemy lines. Everything went fine until the return trip. While trying to exfiltrate to friendly lines, our recon ship inadvertently jumped into the middle of a pitched battle in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. In the resulting confusion, the recon ship was destroyed and the vital intelligence it was carrying was lost. I want you to go out to the site of the battle, find the wreck of our reconnaissance ship, and salvage the data chips from the remains. This task will require the use of a Salvager module.

Beware that there may be other scavengers or interested parties in the area. Take whatever steps you feel are necessary to bring the data back safely. Do you think this is something you can handle?
messages.zh:
找一个有你这般能力的人？我一直都是这样做的。

最近，一支远程勘查巡逻队被派去深入敌后。直到返航前，一切都很顺利。当他们试着渗透到友方阵线的时候，我们的勘查舰不小心跳跃进了一场位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的乱战中。在此后的一片混乱中，勘查舰被摧毁，而且其收集的主要情报也都遗失了。我希望你前去那个战场，找到勘查舰的残骸，并回收资料芯片。这个任务将会需要使用回收模块。

小心那里可能会有其他清道夫和对此感兴趣的组织。为了把资料安全地带回来，你必须不择手段。你觉得你能处理好吗？

messages.en: When you did not respond to my employment offer, I was forced to go with someone else. That pilot responded promptly and performed admirably. You would do well to follow her example in the future.
messages.zh: 由于你没有回应我的雇佣合同，我只能另求高明了。那个飞行员很快地回应，而且表现无可指摘。以后你要好好以她为榜样。

messages.en: Intelligence recovered
messages.zh: 情报失而复得

messages.en: I've got bad news. I won't be able to recover your data.
messages.zh: 我带来了坏消息。我没能带回你的数据。

messages.en: That is unfortunate, {[character]player.name}. I just hope that the data didn't fall into the wrong hands.
messages.zh: 那真不幸，{[character]player.name}。我只希望这些资料不要落入敌人手中。

messages.en: I can only assume from your lack of response that you were unable to recover the intelligence we discussed. No matter, I'm sure you made a valiant effort. I only hope that the data was destroyed and some battlefield scavenger friendly to the Gallente doesn't run across it.
messages.zh: 我只能假设是你缺少责任心，才没能带回我要的情报。不要紧，我相信你勇敢地努力了。我只希望那些资料被摧毁了，也希望那些亲盖伦特的战场清道夫们不要发现这块数据芯片。

messages.en: Intelligence lost
messages.zh: 情报遗失

messages.en: No problem. Those terrorist scum won't get through on my watch.
messages.zh: 没问题。那些恐怖分子杂碎不可能瞒得过我的眼睛。

messages.en: Good. And be careful, these people will stop at nothing to accomplish their goals.
messages.zh: 很好，但是要小心，这些人不达目的是不会罢休的。

messages.en: Maybe. What's in it for me?
messages.zh: 也许。那为我准备的是什么呢？

messages.en:
In recent days, we believe one of our repair and resupply depots has been under surveillance by suspected members of one of a terrorist group, and we think they're going to attempt some kind of sabotage. We could quadruple our security, but that might tip them off. Instead, I want you to go there and keep an eye out for them. If you see anything suspicious, you are authorized to destroy the vessel in question immediately. We don't want to take any chances.

Once you've destroyed the suspicious transport, recover any cargo and bring it to me. We might be able to use it as evidence of Gallente involvement.
messages.zh:
这些天来，我们相信我们的某一个维修补给库正被某一支叛徒组织暗中调查，并且，我们相信他们意欲进行破坏。我们能够倍增保安力量，但这样做可能把他们吓跑。因此，我希望你去那里留心他们的举动，如果发现任何可疑的事，你被授权立即摧毁可疑舰船。我们不打算冒任何风险。

一旦你摧毁了可疑的运输队，把所有货柜整理出来带给我。我们也许能把它用作指控盖伦特涉入此事的证据。

messages.en: The terrorists have been dealt with. Here's the viral agent they were trying to spread.
messages.zh: 恐怖分子已经被解决了。这是他们正准备散布的病毒剂

messages.en: You've done well, {[character]player.name}. Check back later for another assignment.
messages.zh: 你做得很好，{[character]player.name}。过阵子回来看看新的任务吧。

messages.en: Patrol duty? I can't think of a worse way to spend my time. Find someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 巡逻任务？我想不到比这更浪费时间的事情了。找别人去做吧。

messages.en: Suit yourself. Maybe I'll find a pilot with a shred of patriotism to do it instead. Good day, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你自个儿乐去吧。也许我能找到一个有爱国主义情怀的飞行员来做这个任务。祝你愉快，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
A hefty reward, if you're successful.

For some time now there have been rumors of Caldari citizens who are unhappy with the way the State is run. Some of them are no doubt Gallente sympathizers, and we're certain the Gallente are giving them aid through third-parties. Either way, they're traitors to the State, and we must be vigilant to keep them from disrupting our operations.

In recent days, we believe one of our repair and resupply depots has been under surveillance by suspected members of one of these traitor groups, and we think they're going to attempt some kind of sabotage. We could quadruple our security, but that might tip them off. Instead, I want you to go there and keep an eye out for them. If you see anything suspicious, you are authorized to destroy the vessel in question immediately. We don't want to take any chances.

Once you've destroyed the suspicious transport, recover any cargo and bring it to me. We might be able to use it as evidence of Gallente involvement.
messages.zh:
如果你成功了，将有重赏。

近来流言传说对国家治理不满的加达里市民开始动乱了。其中一些毫无疑问是盖伦特的支持者，并且，我们确信盖伦特正通过第三方为他们提供补助。总之，他们是国家的叛徒，我们一定要警惕，以免他们影响到我们的行动。

这些天来，我们相信我们的某一个维修补给库正在被某一支叛徒组织中暗中调查，并且，我们认为他们意欲进行破坏。我们能够倍增的保安力量，但是这样做可能会把他们吓跑。因此，我希望你去那里留心他们的举动。如果你发现任何可疑的事，你被授权立刻摧毁可疑舰船。我们不打算冒任何风险。

一旦你摧毁了可疑的运输队，把所有货柜整理出来并带给我。我们也许能把它用作指控盖伦特涉入此事的证据。

messages.en: You won't be needed for that job after all. Several hours ago, we started receiving reports of people dying from a bizarre sickness, and already the death toll has risen sharply. Apparently the terrorists were successful in their plot. In addition to the human cost, we've had to scramble to set up quarantine and shift our resupply operations elsewhere. Dozens of vessels have come and gone from that depot, and any of them could have been exposed to the virus. This has truly been a disaster.
messages.zh: 到头来这件任务根本不需要你的参与。几小时前，我们开始收到报告，说人们正死于一种怪病，而且死亡人数已经锐升。显然恐怖分子们的阴谋得逞了。除了人员伤亡，我们还必须忙着建立隔离区，并把我们的补给工作转移到其他地方去做。几十艘舰船到过这个机库，每一艘都有可能感染病毒。这真是一场灾难啊。

messages.en: Hundreds killed in viral outbreak
messages.zh: 数百人死于病毒爆发

messages.en: On second thought, this job sounds awful. Find someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 重新考虑之后，这个任务听起来太可怕了。找其他人做吧。

messages.en: Suit yourself. Maybe I'll find a pilot with a shred of patriotism to do it instead. Good day, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你自个儿乐去吧。也许我能找到一个有爱国主义情怀的飞行员来做这个任务。祝你愉快，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: You won't be needed for that job after all. Several hours ago, we started receiving reports of people dying from a bizarre sickness, and already the death toll has risen sharply. Apparently the terrorists were successful in their plot. In addition to the human cost, we've had to scramble to set up quarantine and shift our resupply operations elsewhere. Dozens of vessels have come and gone from that depot, and any of them could have been exposed to the virus. This has truly been a disaster.
messages.zh: 到头来这件任务根本不需要你的参与。几小时前，我们开始收到报告，说人们正死于一种怪病，而且死亡人数已经锐升。显然恐怖分子们的阴谋得逞了。除了人员伤亡，我们还必须忙着建立隔离区，并把我们的补给工作转移到其他地方去做。几十艘舰船到过这个机库，每一艘都有可能感染病毒。这真是一场灾难啊。

messages.en: Hundreds killed in viral outbreak
messages.zh: 数百人死于病毒爆发

name.ja: ステーション464でのハッキング

messages.en: I'll get the data!
messages.zh: 我会拿到数据的!

messages.en: Good!  I can't begin to tell you how important this mission is. Fly safe.
messages.zh: 好！我真是不知道该如何告诉你这件任务有多么重要。小心。

messages.en: I heard you have been looking for me?
messages.zh: 我听说你在找我？

messages.en: Go to Caldari station 464, hack the relay center so that the data in its computers can be collected, and return to {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 去加达里464空间站，侵入中转中心，然后把中心内部电脑里的数据收集并带回给 {[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: I have the data from station 464.
messages.zh: 我得到了464空间站的数据。

messages.en: We received the data.  You did well out there. We'll examine it, but in the mean time, here is your reward.
messages.zh: 你拿到了数据，干的真不错。我们会检验的，与此同时，这里是你的奖赏。

messages.en: It sounds like station 464 is too heavily fortified for me to handle.
messages.zh: 听起来464空间站对我来说太难了。

messages.en: I can't begin to tell you how important this mission was. Your refusal to carry it out disappoints me, and it doesn't help your reputation with {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.
messages.zh: 我真是不知道如何告诉你这件任务有多么重要。你拒绝了这项任务让我很失望，而且对你的{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}声誉也很不利。

messages.en:
Open conflict now exists between the Gallente and Caldari empires. Both empires are fighting for the systems between them, often sending forces into the other's territory to probe for weakness, to secure forward bases and to exploit resources.

Forward bases built by one empire in the space of another are usually represented as private business concerns to avoid any conflict with Concord.
messages.zh:
盖伦特与加达里帝国之间存在着公开的冲突。这两个帝国为了他们之间的星系战斗，常常派军队去他国的领空勘测看看有什么漏洞，看看前方基地的安全情况以及开发资源。

为了避免打破公约，通常是由一些私有企业代表一个帝国去其他帝国里建立前哨基地的。

messages.en: The Situation between the Caldari and the Gallente
messages.zh: 加达里和盖伦特之间的现状

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, the Caldari have built an observation base in Gallente space. It has been designated “Station 464.” One of the structures is a relay station, and it is being used to store all the information the Caldari have collected in the system. I need you to hack the relay station so we can see what kind of information they have collected and thus the purpose of the base.

The data center is heavily protected so be ready for a real fight. I will upload the location to your Neocom.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，加达里在盖伦特空间建造了一座观察基地。被命名为“464空间站”。它的作用就是一座中转站，用来储存加达里在星系里收集到的所有信息。我想派你侵入那里搞清楚他们在搜集什么情报和那个基地的用途。

数据中心戒备森严，好像随时应对一场硬仗。我会对你的控制边栏更新他的位置。

messages.en: I can't begin to tell you how important this mission was.  I'm sorry you didn't accept it, but I am more concerned about the fact your delay in responding has caused us to miss the opportunity to gather the data.
messages.zh: 我真是不知道如何告诉你这件任务有多么重要。我很遗憾你不能接手这次任务，但是我更关心的是由于你未能及时回复我们而使我们失去了得到数据的绝佳机会。

messages.en: I didn't hear back from you!
messages.zh: 我没有从你那得到回复。

messages.en: Station 464 is too heavily fortified for me to complete the mission. I'm sorry but you will have to give this to someone else.
messages.zh: 464空间站这个任务对我来说太难了。我很抱歉，但是你可以找其他人来完成。

messages.en: How am I supposed to get that data now? I was depending on you! Failures like this will not help your reputation with {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.
messages.zh: 你知道我有多想得到那个数据吗？我是多么信任你啊！这种错误对你的声誉with {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}可没什么好处。

messages.en: The opportunity to secure the data from Caldari base 464 has passed and I haven't heard from you. You disappoint me greatly.
messages.zh: 你没有给我们任何答复，就这样我们已经错过了从加达里464基地安全获得数据的机会。你让我很失望。

messages.en: Station 464
messages.zh: 464空间站

messages.en: Terrorists huh? I don't like terrorists; especially Caldari terrorist. It will be a pleasure to take care of this for you.
messages.zh: 恐怖分子，嗯？我不喜欢恐怖分子；尤其是加达里恐怖分子。为你解决这群家伙将是件愉快的事。

messages.en: I need some cash. Do you have a job for me?
messages.zh: 我需要一些钱。你有工作给我吗？

messages.en: Caldari terrorists have been attacking miners in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They must be destroyed, along with the bunker they are using as their base.
messages.zh: 加达里恐怖分子一直在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}袭击矿工。他们必须被摧毁，还有他们用作基地的堡垒。

messages.en: I've killed all the terrorists and destroyed their bunker. They will not bother the miners again.
messages.zh: 我把所有恐怖分子都干掉了，并摧毁了那个堡垒。他们不会再打扰矿工们了。

messages.en: I'll get the word out to the miners. I'm sure they will be happy to know those terrorist have met a proper end. Here's your reward; just don't spend it all in one place, ok?
messages.zh: 我会把消息告诉那些矿工的。我确信他们在得知这群恐怖分子受到了应有的惩罚之后会感到开心的。这里是你的报酬；别一口气花完，好吗？

messages.en: Terrorists? Pirates I can handle, but I don't want any part of a mission against terrorists. Find someone else to handle this.
messages.zh: 恐怖分子？我能解决海盗，但是我不想碰任何与恐怖分子作对的任务。找其他人来吧。

messages.en: I'm disappointed in you. I really thought you were the person for this job. I depend on you, but when you turn down missions it makes me think that you don't value the work I give you.
messages.zh: 我对你很失望。我真的人为你是解决这个任务的不二人选。我依靠你，可是当你拒绝这个任务的时候，你使我觉得你根本不重视我给你的工作。

messages.en:
Some Caldari terrorists are in sympathy with the Ammarian faith. Flying out of Caldari space they attack Gallente civilian outpost and miners in an effort to terrorize those who reject the faith. They believe they are engaged in a holy war to rid New Eden of unbelievers.

This, however, is not the only brand of terrorism coming out of Caldari space. Increasingly terrorism from the state is based on intense nationalism born of hatred towards the Gallente. Some of these are thought to be followers of Tibus Heth and the national ideals he purportedly espouses.
messages.zh:
一些加达里恐怖分子赞同艾玛人的信念。飞出了加达里空间，他们攻击盖伦特平民哨站和矿工，并以此来胁迫那些反对他们信念的人。他们相信自己在进行一场信仰之战，要把新伊甸里所有不信教的人全部消灭。

然而这并不是加达里州出来的唯一一种恐怖主义。日趋增多的恐怖主义大多是产生于对盖伦特的憎恨所导致的狭隘民族主义。其中一些被认为是提波斯·赫特及其支持的民族主义理想的追随者。

messages.en: Caldari Terrorist
messages.zh: 加达里恐怖分子

messages.en:
{[character]player.name} we have located a Caldari terrorist cell. They have been harassing nearby miners for some time using hit and run tactics. Now that we know where their base is it's time to take care of this problem. I want you to fly out and destroy them and the bunker they are using as their base.

I will upload the coordinates to your Neocom. Be careful out there, but teach these terrorists a lesson they will not forget!
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}我们已经定位了一个加达里恐怖分子营地。他们这段时间一直在用游击战术，反复袭击附近矿工。既然我们得知了他们的基地所在，是时候处理这个问题了。我希望你飞去那里并摧毁他们和被他们用作基地的堡垒。

我会把坐标上传到你的通讯设施里。小心行事，但是要给那些恐怖分子们上一堂终生难忘的课！

messages.en: I've been expecting you to accept the mission I offered you. Now the terrorist have moved their base and we're back to hunting them. I'm disappointed in you. More importantly my boss is mad at me for choosing you for this mission. If I suffer, you suffer.
messages.zh: 我一直在期待你接受我给你的任务。现在恐怖分子已经转移了基地，我们也不得不继续追踪他们。我对你很失望。更重要的是，因为我选择你来完成这个任务，老板对我大发雷霆。如果我受罪，你也得受罪。

messages.en: A Missed Opportunity
messages.zh: 一个错失了的机会

messages.en: I'm sick so I can't complete this mission. Perhaps it's the flu or maybe just allergies.
messages.zh: 我病了因此我无法完成这个任务。也许是流感，或者仅仅是过敏。

messages.en: Sick, huh? Don't make a habit of it; I can't use pod pilots who are “sick” all the time.
messages.zh: 病？嗯？别习惯于此；我可不能用一个病秧子飞行员。

messages.en: I've been expecting to hear from you about dealing with these Caldari terrorist. According to intelligence, they have moved their base and we're back to hunting them. I'm disappointed in you. More importantly my boss is mad at me for choosing you for this mission. If I suffer, you suffer.
messages.zh: 我一直在等待你解决这群加达里恐怖分子的好消息。依照情报，他们已经转移了基地，我们也不得不继续追踪他们。我对你很失望。更重要的是，因为我选择你来完成这个任务，老板对我大发雷霆。如果我受罪，你也得受罪。

messages.en: A Missed Opportunity
messages.zh: 一个错失了的机会

name.ru: Копание в прошлом (Delving Into the Past) (1 из 3)

messages.en: This sounds interesting. I'll take care of it for you.
messages.zh: 这听起来很有意思。我来帮你办。

messages.en: Good! Just remember to be careful out there.
messages.zh: 很好！记住到了那边要小心。

messages.en: I got your message. What can I do for you?
messages.zh: 我收到你的信息了。我能为你做点什么？

messages.en: An old mining site has just been rediscovered. Soon archeologists will arrive to properly explore the site, but I want you to go in and do a preliminary survey. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom. Bring back anything of interest that you find.
messages.zh: 有人刚发现了一个旧的采矿现场。很快就会有考古学家来勘查这个现场，但我希望你先过去作个初步调查。我已经把地点上传到了你的数控系统。把你找到的一切好东西都带回来。

messages.en: I arrived at the site. All I found was this old map.
messages.zh: 我到现场了。我只找到这份旧地图。

messages.en: Ok, give me a chance to look over this map and then get back to me for another mission.
messages.zh: 好，让我好好看看这张地图，你回来吧，我再给你新的任务。

messages.en: I'm sorry, but I'm not an archeologist. I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我可不是考古学家。这个我不干。

messages.en: Ok, I'll get someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 好吧，我另找别人去做。

messages.en:
A mining site that may date back millennia has been found. Soon Archeologists will arrive to properly explore the site, but I want you to go in and do a preliminary survey. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom. Bring back anything of interest that you may find.

The Amarrians are exploring the area and may have found the site as well, so go in ready for combat just in case they are there already.

This mission is of upmost importance to the Federation.
messages.zh:
这个矿场有几千年的历史了。很快就会有考古学家来勘查这个现场，但我希望你先过去作个初步调查。我已经把地点上传到了你的数控系统。把你找到的一切好东西都带回来。

艾玛人也在开发这片区域，他们或许也发现了这个矿场，所以你要作好战斗准备，以防他们率先到达了。

这个任务对联邦来说非常重要。

messages.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I offered you. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 我不明白为什么你对我给你的任务不作任何回应。现在你要加入已经太迟了，我会另找别人去做。

messages.en: I've waited long enough.
messages.zh: 我已经等了很久了。

messages.en: I've lost interest in your mission. You will have to find someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 我对你给的任务没兴趣。你另找别人干吧。

messages.en: This will not look good on your record, but I'll do as you request and find someone else to do this for me.
messages.zh: 这要是写进你的记录可不光彩，但我还是顺你的意思另找别人去做吧。

messages.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I sent you on. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 我不明白为什么你对我给你的任务不作任何回应。现在你要加入已经太迟了，我会另找别人去做。

messages.en: It's Too Late
messages.zh: 太迟了

name.ru: Копание в прошлом (Delving Into the Past) (2 из 3)

messages.en: This is getting more and more interesting; I'll take care of it for you.
messages.zh: 事情变得越来越有意思了；我会帮你办的。

messages.en: Good! Just remember to be careful out there.
messages.zh: 很好！记住到了那边要小心。

messages.en: Did you find anything interesting on that old map?
messages.zh: 你在那张旧地图上发现什么有趣的东西了吗？

messages.en: The map you found led us to an old observation post. I want you to do a preliminary survey before the Amarr get there, and bring back anything of interest that you find.
messages.zh: 你找到的那份地图把我们带到了一个旧的观察哨。我要你赶在艾玛人之前去那里作个初步调查，并把你找到的一切好东西都带回来。

messages.en: I arrived at the site, but all I found was this old map. It seems to be a second half to the other map we found.
messages.zh: 我到现场了，但我只找到了这份旧地图。看起来这是我们上次找到的那份地图的另一半。

messages.en: Ok, give me a chance to look over this map in conjunction with the first one and then get back to me for another mission.
messages.zh: 好，让我把这张地图和上一张拼起来好好看看，你回来吧，我再给你新的任务。

messages.en: I'm sorry, but I'm not an archeologist. I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我可不是考古学家。这个我不干。

messages.en: Ok, I'll get someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 好吧，我另找别人去做。

messages.en:
The map you found has the location of several ancient sites on it. One in particular is circled; an old observation post. Again, archeologists will soon arrive to properly explore the site, but once again I want you to go in and do a preliminary survey. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom. Bring back anything of interest that you may find.

The Amarr are still exploring the area and may have found the site as well so go in ready for combat just in case they are there already.

I want to remind you that this mission is of utmost importance to the Federation.
messages.zh:
你找到地图上标注了好几个古代遗迹的位置。其中一个还画了圈；这是一个旧的观察哨。和以前一样，很快会有考古学家去勘查现场，同样的，我希望你先过去作个初步调查。我已经把地点上传到你的数控系统。把你找到的一切好东西都带回来。

艾玛仍然在开发这片区域，可能也发现了这个现场，所以你要作好战斗准备，以防他们率先到达。

我要提醒你一下，这个任务对于联邦来说非常重要。

messages.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I offered you. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. This will not look good on your permanent record.
messages.zh: 我不明白为什么你对我给你的任务不作任何回应。现在你要加入已经太迟了，我会另找别人去做。这要是写进你的永久记录可不光彩。

messages.en: I've waited long enough.
messages.zh: 我已经等了很久了。

messages.en: I've lost interest in your mission. You will have to find someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 我对你给的任务没兴趣。你另找别人干吧。

messages.en: This will not look good on your record, but I'll do as you request and find someone else to do this for me.
messages.zh: 这要是写进你的记录可不光彩，但我还是顺你的意思另找别人去做吧。

messages.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I sent you on. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. This will not look good on your permanent record.
messages.zh: 我不明白为什么你对我给你的任务不作任何回应。现在你要加入已经太迟了，我会另找别人去做。这要是写进你的永久记录可不光彩。

messages.en: It's Too Late
messages.zh: 太迟了

name.ru: Копание в прошлом (Delving Into the Past) (3 из 3)

messages.en: I'll take care of it for you.
messages.zh: 我会帮你办的。

messages.en: Good! Just remember to be careful out there.
messages.zh: 很好！记住到了那边要小心。

messages.en: What did the maps reveal?
messages.zh: 两张地图透露出了什么？

messages.en: Go out to the asteroid field, confirm that the vault is there and see if it has been opened or not. If the Amarr show up, destroy them all.
messages.zh: 到小行星带去，确认一下地窖在不在那，看看有没有被人动过。如果艾玛出现，干掉他们。

messages.en: I arrived at the site and the Amarr were already there. I dealt with them; and yes, the vault is there and is intact.
messages.zh: 我到现场了，艾玛已经率先到了。我把他们都解决了；还有，是的，地窖还原封未动。

messages.en: Good work! Your part in this is done. We will have to let the archeologist take over now. Here is your reward.
messages.zh: 干得好！你的工作完成了。后面的事情就交给考古学家了。这是给你的奖励。

messages.en: I'm sorry, but I'm not an archeologist. I'll pass on this one.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我可不是考古学家。这个我不干。

messages.en: Ok, I'll get someone else to do it, but this will not look good on your permanent record.
messages.zh: 好吧，我另找别人去做，但这要是写进你的永久记录可不光彩。

messages.en:
When the two maps are put together they point to a mined out asteroid field. According to the map the field contains an ancient vault. We need to find out whether or not it has been located and opened.

I want you to go out to the asteroid field, confirm that the vault is there and see if it has been opened or not. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom.

The Amarrians are exploring the area and may have found the site as well so go in ready for combat. If they are there then destroy them all lest the Amarrians should get to the vault before we do.

I want to remind you that this mission is of upmost importance to the Federation.
messages.zh:
两张地图拼在一起时，指向了一处已被开发的小行星带。从地图上看，这个行星带上有一处地窖。我们要查出这个地窖是否存在，以及是否已经被人动过。

我想让你到那儿去，确认一下这两点。我已经把地点上传到了你的数控系统。

艾玛人也在开发这片区域，他们或许也发现了这个地点，所以你要作好战斗准备。如果他们也在那里，就干掉他们，不要让艾玛人在比我们先碰那个地窖。

我要提醒你一下，这个任务对联邦非常重要。

messages.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I offered you. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. You disappoint me greatly.
messages.zh: 我不明白为什么你对我给你的任务不作任何回应。现在你要加入已经太迟了，我会另找别人去做。你让我非常失望。

messages.en: I've waited long enough.
messages.zh: 我已经等了很久了。

messages.en: I've lost interest in your mission. You will have to find someone else to do it.
messages.zh: 我对你给的任务没兴趣。你另找别人干吧。

messages.en: This will not look good on your record, but I'll do as you request and find someone else to do this for me.
messages.zh: 这要是写进你的记录可不光彩，但我还是顺你的意思另找别人去做吧。

messages.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I sent you on. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. This will not look good on your permanent record.
messages.zh: 我不明白为什么你对我给你的任务不作任何回应。现在你要加入已经太迟了，我会另找别人去做。这要是写进你的永久记录可不光彩。

messages.en: It's Too Late
messages.zh: 太迟了

messages.en: Calm the hell down, I'll sort it.
messages.zh: 见鬼，镇定点，我会处理的。

messages.en: Time is of the essence, get over their now.
messages.zh: 时间十分宝贵，快去吧。

messages.en: Something need doing?
messages.zh: 有什么需要做的？

messages.en:
I recently lost contact with one of our deep cover operatives embedded in enemy space. A delay of this length can only mean one thing: that he has been discovered and killed, or worse for us, captured.

We need to find out which, and fast before he talks. We have a contact within the administrative department who we tasked with retrieving the information and have arranged a meeting with him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

Go to the co-ordinates provided, meet the contact and retrieve the information.
messages.zh:
我最近同一个我们安插在敌人内部的卧底失去了联系。联络中断了这么长的时间，只能有一个解释：他已经被发现并且遇害了；或者被活捉，那样的话对我们来说更加不利。

如果是那样的话，我们必须要在他招供之前找到他的下落。我们在敌人的行政部门内部有一个联络人，他奉命调查这次事件的相关情报，并将在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}向我们报告。

去提供于你的地点，同联络人接头并带回信息。

messages.en: The bad news is it was an ambush. The good news is they didn't know who they were messing with.
messages.zh: 坏消息是，那是一次伏击。好消息是，他们不知道到底是谁在给他们捣乱。

messages.en: That's great! I mean, it's too bad about our operative and all, but I bet they'll think twice before they try to pull that stunt again.
messages.zh: 太棒了！我的意思是，对我们的卧底来说，实在太糟了，但是我敢打赌那些家伙在故技重施之前会好好考虑一下了。

messages.en: Can yous say "trap?" Not doing it.
messages.zh: 你说是“陷阱”吗？我不做。

messages.en: Pessimist.
messages.zh: 悲观主义者。

messages.en: I've had enough of this, I quit. Oh, and your guy is probably dead.
messages.zh: 我受够了，我要退出。噢，你的手下可能已经死了。

messages.en: Never let an inconvenience like death prevent you from finishing a mission.
messages.zh: 别让类似于死亡这类的“困难”阻碍你完成任务。

messages.en: Never let an inconvenience like death prevent you from finishing a mission.
messages.zh: 别让类似于死亡这类的“困难”阻碍你完成任务。

messages.en: I'll take it, assuming that your intelligence is correct this time. It didn't pan out very well last time, did it?
messages.zh: 我会接受的，这次你的情报最好都是正确的。上一次就不是很准确，不是吗？

messages.en: Rest assured, this information is good. Let's stop wasting time. You will be well compensated, just get that decoder.
messages.zh: 放心，这次的信息准确可靠。别浪费时间了，只要你能得到那个解码器的话，我们就会好好地报偿你。

messages.en:
Right, well, that didn't go quite to plan. Looks like we're going to have to do this the hard way.

There is a relay station that our enemies think is well hidden in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We found out about it recently and have been intercepting communication traffic from it. However, we have trouble decoding most of the traffic and we need the decoder which is held inside the communications hub, each decoder is unique and lasts for a limited time.

So the only way to get a hold of this device is to manually hack into the communications hub using a Data Analyzer. I want you to go to the co-ordinates provided, retrieve the decoder and destroy the installation.

We're still up against the clock here. Get this done.
messages.zh:
对，是这样的，事情没有像计划的一样发展。看来我们不得不用激烈的方式来搞定这件事了。

在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一个我们敌人认为隐蔽得很好的中继站。最近才被我们发现并截取了它的通讯。然而，在破译该通讯信息的时候，我们遇到了麻烦。我们需要找到隐藏在通讯中心里的解码器，每个解码器都是独一无二的，并只持续有限的一段时间。

获取这个设备唯一的方法就是利用数据分析仪闯入该通讯中心的网络。我希望你去坐标所指示的地点，把解码器带回来并将通讯中心摧毁。

我们是在与时间赛跑，快去完成这个任务吧。

messages.en: Station, explosions, decoder.
messages.zh: 空间站，爆炸，解码器。

messages.en: Great story.
messages.zh: 伟大的故事。

messages.en: Hacking isn't my style. Gonna have to pass.
messages.zh: 黑别人的电脑不是我的作风，我还是放弃吧。

messages.en: You're going to leave me hanging because something isn't "your style?" Thanks a lot.
messages.zh: 你就因为这不是“你的作风”，而要我干等着？多谢！

messages.en: You will need a Data Analyzer module to finish this mission.
messages.zh: 你需要一个数据分析仪来完成这个任务。

messages.en: Remember
messages.zh: 记住

messages.en: Calm the hell down, I'll sort it.
messages.zh: 见鬼，镇定点，我会处理的。

messages.en: Time is of the essence, get over their now.
messages.zh: 时间十分宝贵，快去吧。

messages.en: Something need doing?
messages.zh: 有什么需要做的？

messages.en:
I recently lost contact with one of our deep cover operatives embedded in enemy space. A delay of this length can only mean one thing: that he has been discovered and killed, or worse for us, captured.

We need to find out which, and fast before he talks. We have a contact within the administrative department who we tasked with retrieving the information and have arranged a meeting with him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

Go to the co-ordinates provided, meet the contact and retrieve the information.
messages.zh:
我最近同一个我们安插在敌人内部的卧底失去了联系。联络中断了这么长的时间，只能有一个解释：他已经被发现并且遇害了；或者被活捉，那样的话对我们来说更加不利。

如果是那样的话，我们必须要在他招供之前找到他的下落。我们在敌人的行政部门内部有一个联络人，他奉命调查这次事件的相关情报，并将在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}向我们报告。

去提供于你的地点，同联络人接头并带回信息。

messages.en: The bad news is it was an ambush. The good news is they didn't know who they were messing with.
messages.zh: 坏消息是，那是一次伏击。好消息是，他们不知道到底是谁在给他们捣乱。

messages.en: That's great! I mean, it's too bad about our operative and all, but I bet they'll think twice before they try to pull that stunt again.
messages.zh: 太棒了！我的意思是，对我们的卧底来说，实在太糟了，但是我敢打赌那些家伙在故技重施之前会好好考虑一下了。

messages.en: Can yous say "trap?" Not doing it.
messages.zh: 你说是“陷阱”吗？我不做。

messages.en: Pessimist.
messages.zh: 悲观主义者。

We need to find out which, and fast before he talks. We have a contact within the administrative department who we tasked with retrieving the information and have arranged a meeting with him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

Go to the co-ordinates provided, meet the contact and retrieve the information.

我最近同一个我们安插在敌人内部的卧底失去了联系。联络中断了这么长的时间，只能有一个解释：他已经被发现并且遇害了；或者被活捉，那样的话对我们来说更加不利。

messages.en: I've had enough of this, I quit. Oh, and your guy is probably dead.
messages.zh: 我受够了，我要退出。噢，你的手下可能已经死了。

messages.en: Never let an inconvenience like death prevent you from finishing a mission.
messages.zh: 别让类似于死亡这类的“困难”阻碍你完成任务。

messages.en: I'll take it, assuming that your intelligence is correct this time. It didn't pan out very well last time, did it?
messages.zh: 我会接受的，这次你的情报最好都是正确的。上一次就不是很准确，不是吗？

messages.en: Rest assured, this information is good. Let's stop wasting time. You will be well compensated, just get that decoder.
messages.zh: 放心，这次的信息准确可靠。别浪费时间了，只要你能得到那个解码器的话，我们就会好好地报偿你。

messages.en:
Right, well, that didn't go quite to plan. Looks like we're going to have to do this the hard way.

There is a relay station that our enemies think is well hidden in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We found out about it recently and have been intercepting communication traffic from it. However, we have trouble decoding most of the traffic and we need the decoder which is held inside the communications hub, each decoder is unique and lasts for a limited time.

So the only way to get a hold of this device is to manually hack into the communications hub using a Data Analyzer. I want you to go to the co-ordinates provided, retrieve the decoder and destroy the installation.

We're still up against the clock here. Get this done.
messages.zh:
对，是这样的，事情没有像计划的一样发展。看来我们不得不用激烈的方式来搞定这件事了。

在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一个我们敌人认为隐蔽得很好的中继站。最近才被我们发现并截取了它的通讯。然而，在破译该通讯信息的时候，我们遇到了麻烦。我们需要找到隐藏在通讯中心里的解码器，每个解码器都是独一无二的，并只持续有限的一段时间。

获取这个设备唯一的方法就是利用数据分析仪闯入该通讯中心的网络。我希望你去坐标所指示的地点，把解码器带回来并将通讯中心摧毁。

我们是在与时间赛跑，快去完成这个任务吧。

messages.en: Base, explosions, decoder.
messages.zh: 基地，爆炸，解码器。

messages.en: Great story.
messages.zh: 伟大的故事。

messages.en: Hacking isn't my style. Gonna have to pass.
messages.zh: 黑别人的电脑不是我的作风，我还是放弃吧。

messages.en: You're going to leave me hanging because something isn't "your style?" Thanks a lot.
messages.zh: 你就因为这不是“你的作风”，而要我干等着？多谢！

messages.en: You will need a Data Analyzer module to finish this mission.
messages.zh: 你需要一个数据分析仪来完成这个任务。

messages.en: Remember
messages.zh: 记住

messages.en: What? But... What?
messages.zh: 什么？但是……什么？

messages.en: I've destroyed more ships than you've had hot dinners; I'll get your man back.
messages.zh: 我击毁的战舰要比你吃过的饭还多；我会把你的人带回来的。

messages.en: Don't underestimate the forces arrayed against you. Good luck.
messages.zh: 别低估被部署来对付你的部队。祝你好运。

messages.en: What next?
messages.zh: 还有什么？

messages.en:
Our team has cracked the enemy communications and found the information we need. It turns out our spy is alive and under heavy guard in a detention facility in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We had no idea they even had a facility here; I'm not sure how they managed to sneak one there without us knowing, but that's not important. The spy's last reports hinted at him getting close to something very disturbing. The information he has could prove invaluable to us.

Our limited intel on the area has revealed it to be a high security facility. They obviously consider our man a high priority. I want you to break into the detention facility, fight your way to the prison and retrieve our man. Expect some serious resistance here.
messages.zh:
我们的队伍破译了敌人的通讯并找到了我们需要的信息。结果原来我们的间谍还活着，并被重兵把守在一个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的拘留所里。我们从不知道他们在那里竟然都有一个拘留所；我不确定他们究竟是如何在我们的眼皮底下偷偷建立起那个东西的，但是这不重要。我们的间谍发回来的最后一份报告暗示他发现了非常烦人的东西。他拥有的信息对我们来说也许是无价的。

我们在该地区有限的情报告诉我们，那个拘留所是个高度警备的设施。他们显然把我们的间谍当成了重要人物。我希望你闯入那个拘留所，冲出一条血路，找到牢狱并把我们的间谍救回来。在那儿可能会遇到一些猛烈的反抗。

messages.en: Here's your guy, mostly alive.
messages.zh: 这是你要的人，基本还活着。

messages.en: Mostly alive is good enough for us!
messages.zh: 活着就好！

messages.en: Prison break, huh? That's my cue to call it quits.
messages.zh: 越狱，嗯？对我来说这意味着我退出。

messages.en: But we were so close! I'm sure our info was good this time.
messages.zh: 但是我们已经那么接近了！我确信这次我们的信息是正确的。

messages.zh: 我正准备去救他，但是我又想了想，“去你的，我还不如去看一场电影。”

messages.en: Damn fickle eggers.
messages.zh: 该死的反复无常的家伙。

name.ja: 情報提供を受けた攻撃（4/5）
name.ru: Кто предупрежден, тот вооружен (Informed Attack) (4 из 5)

messages.en: It's already done.
messages.zh: 已经办妥了。

messages.en: I expect no less.
messages.zh: 我希望不会比这少。

messages.en: What can this hero do for you?
messages.zh: 本英雄乐意为你效劳。

messages.en:
Thanks to your efforts we've got our man back, and more importantly the information he had inside that skull of his.

It seems our enemies have been busy. They have secretly been building up a Bio-Weapon Facility in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Such facilities are in direct violation of the Yulai convention between the empires. However, we're not going to inform CONCORD of this. No doubt they would just claim it to be a chemical storage facility or some such.

No, what we're going to do is remove the facility by force. I want the facility razed, the main processing center destroyed and, if you get the chance, acquire a sample of the bioweapon.
messages.zh:
感谢你的努力，我们救回了我们的人。更重要的是救回了他所知道的信息。

看起来我们的敌人一直被牵制着。他们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系秘密建造一处生化武器设施。这样的设施直接违反了帝国之间签定的尤拉协议。但是，我们不会向统合部举报这事。毫无疑问，他们只会声称那只是一个化学品储存设施。

我们要做的是动用武力铲除这个设施。我要你去把那个设施破坏掉，把主处理中心摧毁，如果有机会的话，最好能取得一份化学武器的样品。

messages.en: I blew that facility up good. Oh, and here: Don't lick this.
messages.zh: 我把那个设施炸掉了。哦还有：别舔这个。

messages.en: Don't- Oh! The bioweapon! Excellent! My superiors are going to be ecstatic. Speaking of....
messages.zh: 别——哦！生化武器！太棒了！我的上司会非常高兴的。至于……

messages.en: I'm not messing with chemical weapons. Sorry.
messages.zh: 我不参与有关化学武器的任务。抱歉。

messages.en: But you live in a hermetically sealed capsule!
messages.zh: 但你身处一个不透气的密封太空舱！

No, what we're going to do is remove the facility by force. I want the facility razed, the main processing center destroyed and, if you get the chance, acquire a sample of the bioweapon.
messages.zh:
感谢你的努力，我们救回了我们的人。更重要的是救回了他所知道的信息。

看起来我们的敌人一直被牵制着。他们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系秘密建造一处生化武器设施。这样的设施直接违反了帝国之间签定的鱼莱协议。但是，我们不会向统合部举报这事。毫无疑问，他们只会声称那只是一个化学品储存设施。

我们要做的是动用武力铲除这个设施。我要你去把那个设施破坏掉，把主处理中心摧毁，如果有机会的话，最好能取得一份化学武器的样品。

messages.en: Quitting.
messages.zh: 我要退出。

messages.en: Wait, what?
messages.zh: 等等，什么？

messages.en: Very well.
messages.zh: 很好。

messages.en: I don't take any pleasure in this.
messages.zh: 干这个一点乐趣都没。

messages.en: What's next?
messages.zh: 下一步呢？

messages.en:
There is one more task before we can bring this to a close. We have a leak. Four of our convoys have been intercepted and destroyed in the past hour. These convoys had special contents which I won't go into now, but suffice to say their route was not well publicized and only known to a few people. One of those people was our man you went to all the trouble of rescuing.

He doubtless broke under interrogation. Now the trust we invest in agents of such level has been broken. He knows too much, which makes him too dangerous to be kept alive. We have arranged for him to meet you, his rescuer, at these co-ordinates under the pretense that you have the information for his next assignment.

I want you to kill this man. This is national security.
messages.zh:
把这事情结束之前，还有一个任务。我们有个漏洞，在过去的一小时里我们的护航队中有四艘舰船被拦截并击毁了。这些护航队的舰船有一些特殊的机密，我现在还不能说，但是有一点可以告诉你，它们的航线并没有对外公布，只有一小部分人知道，其中之一是你尽了全力营救回来的人。

他在审问之下肯定已经招供了。现在我们对于这个等级的特工所寄予的信任已经荡然无存了。他知道得太多，对我们来说太危险了。我们骗他说你有一些关于他下一个任务的信息要告诉他，安排了他和你——他的救命恩人在这个坐标见面。

我要你干掉他。这事关国家安全。

messages.en: That victim of fate won't be returning for the sequel.
messages.zh: 那个命中注定的受害者以后不会回来了。

messages.en: Man, you're one scary egger, you know that?
messages.zh: 老兄，你是个胆小鬼，知不知道？

messages.en: So this guy was tortured, broken physically and psychologically, and now you just want me to off him? How about you go to hell?
messages.zh: 这个家伙已经被拷问过了，身体上和精神上都崩溃了，现在你要我放他走？你怎么不去死？

messages.en: Oh, sure, now you have a conscience.
messages.zh: 哦，行啊，现在你有良心了。
