messages.zh: 道德上受到质疑的暗算者是多么令人厌恶？

messages.en: Consider it done.
messages.zh: 考虑到这完成了。

messages.en: Good. Be careful out there and be sure to keep this thing a secret. Give those Caldari a good spanking.
messages.zh: 很好。在那里要小心，并确保这件事是秘密。好好地打那群加达里人的屁股吧。

messages.en: Hello {[character]agentID.name}; that is good because I'm looking for some work.
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]agentID.name}；那很好，正巧我要找一些工作呢。

messages.en: There is a monument where a battle in the Gallente-Caldari war occurred within Gallente space. We once tolerated Caldari pilgrims, but with this war we cannot allow the Caldari any excuse to proceed this deep within our space. Such leniency would only invite terrorism. I need you to destroy the monument, and any witnesses to the event. This may include some of our own people, but you needn't worry about any kind of standings complications, I will handle the political fallout.
messages.zh: 在盖伦特空间内发生的盖伦特-加达里战争的遗址上，有一个纪念碑。我们曾经容忍了前来朝圣的加达里人，但是自从这次战争之后，我们不能再允许加达里人用任何借口深入我们的空间了。否则，我们的宽大只会引来恐怖主义。我需要你前去摧毁这个纪念碑，以及任何在场目击者。这其中可能会包含我们自己人，但你别担心声望的事，我会帮你进行妥当处理的。

messages.en: It's done. Due to the sensitivity and secrecy of what I know, I expect a large reward.
messages.zh: 完成了。考虑到我所知道的事情的敏感性与隐秘性，我要求更多的报酬。

messages.en: You'll get what I promised you and not one isk more; but I do appreciate your work.
messages.zh: 你会得到我答应给你的数，一星币也不会多；但是我感谢你的努力。

messages.en: I'm not keen on destroying any monument. Give this to someone else.
messages.zh: 我并不热衷于摧毁任何纪念碑。把这个任务给其他人做吧。

messages.en: I thought I could depend on you. I guess you don't care if Caldari roam about our space.
messages.zh: 我以为我能依靠你的。我猜你并不介意加达里人在我们的空间到处闲逛。

messages.en:
There is a monument where a battle in the Gallente-Caldari war occurred within Gallente space. We once tolerated Caldari pilgrims, but with this war we cannot allow the Caldari any excuse to proceed this deep within our space. Such leniency would only invite terrorism.

I need you to destroy the monument, and any witnesses to the event. This may include some of our own people, but you needn't worry about any kind of standings complications, I will handle the political fallout. We will then release a statement that the site was attacked by pirates and, although the Caldari won't believe this, it will provide us with enough plausible deniability.

Undoubtedly there will be an uproar about this. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will disavow any involvement. You will be best served by remaining silent yourself.
messages.zh:
在盖伦特空间内发生的盖伦特-加达里战争的遗址上，有一个纪念碑。我们曾经容忍了前来朝圣的加达里人，但是自从这次战争之后，我们不能再允许加达里人用任何借口深入我们的空间了。否则，我们的宽大只会引来恐怖主义。

我需要你前去摧毁这个纪念碑，以及任何目击者。随后我们会发表声明，说这是海盗所为。加达里人当然不会相信，但是这会提供我们一个说得过去的拒绝越境的借口。

毫无疑问的，这样做会导致骚动。{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}会否认任何关联。你最好对此也保持缄默。

messages.en: What gives? I expected that monument to be destroyed by now, and you haven't even decided if you are going to do it or not. Forget about it. I will get someone else to do the job.
messages.zh: 你做到了什么？我期望那个纪念碑现在已经被摧毁，可是你甚至还没有决定是不是要去做。忘了它吧，我会找其他人去做的。

messages.en: Where have you been?
messages.zh: 你去哪了？

messages.en: I've thought about it and I'm not keen on destroying any sacred site.
messages.zh: 我考虑过了，但我并不热衷于摧毁任何神圣的地方。

messages.en: I thought I could depend on you. I guess you do not care if Caldari roam around Gallente space.
messages.zh: 我以为我能依靠你的。我猜你并不介意加达里人在盖伦特空间到处闲逛。

messages.en:
What gives? I expected that monument to be destroyed by now? I guess you don't care about Caldari roaming around our space.

Forget about it; I will get someone else to do the job.
messages.zh:
你做到了什么？我期望那个纪念碑现在已经被摧毁，我猜你根本不在乎加达里人在我们的空间里闲逛。

忘了它吧，我会找其他人去做的。

messages.en: Where have you been?
messages.zh: 你去哪了？

name.ru: Еще одно спасение рабов (Another Slave Rescue) (1 из 3)

messages.en: Destroy the Amarr; right, I'll take care of it for you.
messages.zh: 摧毁艾玛；对，我会替你办好的。

messages.en: That's the spirit! Remember this mission is an important one to the Federation.
messages.zh: 就是要这种干劲！记住这次任务对联邦来说可是很重要的。

messages.en: You are welcome. Why did you send for me?
messages.zh: 别客气。为什么派我去呢？

messages.en: Our supporters in Amarr space have managed to smuggle out some slaves. I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy the Amarr pursuit team.
messages.zh: 我们在艾玛空间的救援人员已经成功地把一些劳工偷运出去了。我要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}把艾玛的追踪小队干掉。

messages.en: The Amarr are dead. Did the slaves make it okay?
messages.zh: 艾玛人都死了。劳工还好吗？

messages.en: The slaves made it to one of our outposts, but they are not safe yet. I need you to get back with me immediately for another mission.
messages.zh: 劳工都在我们的一个哨站内，但是他们仍不安全。我要你和我一起回去处理另一件任务。

messages.en: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.
messages.zh: 我不赞成劳工制，但我也不想在联邦内见到更多的米玛塔尔人。找其他人帮你吧。

messages.en: That sounds a lot like prejudice to me.
messages.zh: 听起来似乎对我有成见啊。

messages.en: I have some work for you. Our supporters in Amarr space have managed to smuggle out some slaves. The Amarr are in close pursuit, and the slaves are in grave danger of being caught and returned. I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy the Amarr pursuit team. Be quick about it lest they catch the slaves. Show no mercy!
messages.zh: 我这儿有个活要你做。我们在艾玛空间的救援人员已经成功地把一些劳工偷运出去了。艾玛那边追得很紧，劳工都惶惶不安害怕又被捉回去。我要你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}把艾玛的追踪小队干掉。快去，免得他们抓住劳工。绝不要心慈手软！

messages.en: Your delay in getting back to me about protecting the escaped slaves has led to them being recaptured by the Amarr.
messages.zh: 你那么晚才回复我关于保护劳工的事情，致使他们又被艾玛人捉了回去。

messages.en: The slaves have been recaptured.
messages.zh: 劳工们又被抓回去了。

messages.en: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.
messages.zh: 我不赞成劳工制，但我也不想在联邦内见到更多的米玛塔尔人。找其他人帮你吧。

messages.en: That sounds a lot like prejudice to me.
messages.zh: 听起来似乎对我有成见啊。

messages.en: Your inaction has led to the slaves being recaptured by the Amarr. We were depending on you, and you let us down.
messages.zh: 你的无所作为导致我们的劳工又被艾玛人捉了回去。我们是那么得信任你，而你却让我们大失所望。

messages.en: The slaves have been recaptured.
messages.zh: 劳工们又被抓回去了。

name.ru: Еще одно спасение рабов (Another Slave Rescue) (2 из 3)

messages.en: That's the spirit!
messages.zh: 就是要那种干劲！

messages.en: Ok, I'm back. What can I do for you now?
messages.zh: 好啦，我回来了。有什么可以帮您的吗？

messages.en: The Amarr are threatening to attack the station in an effort to reclaim their slaves. I need you to transport them to another station where they will be safe should the Amarrians attack.
messages.zh: 艾玛扬言要攻击我们的空间站以夺回他们的劳工。我需要你把他们运送到另一个安全的空间站，这样他们就可以免受艾玛人的攻击了。

messages.en: The slaves are safe. I'm looking forward to dealing with those Amarr.
messages.zh: 劳工们都很安全。我正盼着好好的教训那些艾玛人一下。

messages.en: That's good, because we are going to have to deal them with as they still threaten the safety of the slaves.
messages.zh: 很好，我们正打算教训一下他们，他们仍旧威胁着劳工们的安全。

messages.en: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.
messages.zh: 我不赞成劳工制，但我也不想在联邦内见到更多的米玛塔尔人。找其他人帮你吧。

messages.en:
The slaves are here on the station with us. The Amarr are threatening to raid us for them. I need you to transport the slaves to another station for everyone's safety.

Some of the escaped slaves are highly skilled. The Federation is very interested in having them on our side. Take every precaution.
messages.zh:
劳工们和我们一起在空间站内。艾玛扬言要来抓走他们。考虑到大家的安全，我需要你把他们都运送到另一个安全的空间站。

一些逃走的劳工可是技术相当高超啊，联邦很想把他们留在我们这边。保持高度警惕。

messages.en: Your inaction has led to the slaves being recaptured by the Amarrians.
messages.zh: 你的无为使得劳工们都被艾玛人抓回去了。

messages.en: The slaves have been recaptured.
messages.zh: 劳工们又被抓回去了。

messages.en: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.
messages.zh: 我不赞成劳工制，但我也不想在联邦内见到更多的米玛塔尔人。找其他人帮你吧。

messages.en: That sounds a lot like prejudice to me.
messages.zh: 听起来似乎对我有成见啊。

messages.en: Your inaction has led to the slaves being recaptured by the Amarr.
messages.zh: 你的无为使得劳工们都被艾玛抓回去了。

messages.en: The slaves have been recaptured.
messages.zh: 劳工们又被抓回去了。

name.ru: Еще одно спасение рабов (Another Slave Rescue) (3 из 3)

messages.en: It will be my pleasure to take care of that strike force.
messages.zh: 我很乐意来对付突击部队。

messages.en: Get to it. We're all counting on you.
messages.zh: 去吧。我们可都指望你啦。

messages.en: Ok, I'm back.
messages.zh: 我回来了。

messages.en:
The Amarr are still threatening to attack the station. Destroy their strike force.

We read one dreadnought with them, though she seems to be playing support. Pay her no mind. We've got a little surprise in store for her. Watch for instructions after you clean up the rest.
messages.zh:
艾玛仍扬言要攻击我们的空间站。把他们的突击部队干掉。

我们观察到他们其中一个无畏的人，虽然她看起来是支持我们的。别对她在意。我们给她准备了点小惊喜。干掉他们之后等待指示。

messages.en: The Amarr strike force has been decimated. Where is my reward?
messages.zh: 艾玛的突击部队全被歼灭了。我有什么奖励？

messages.en: Nukes are always fun, huh? You handled yourself well. See if those Amarr bastards try anything like that again.
messages.zh: 核芯武器很有趣，哈哈，是吗？你可要照顾好自己。我们来看看艾玛那个畜生会不会再用那一招。

messages.en: Hey, the slaves are safe. The Amarr are your problem.
messages.zh: 嘿，劳工都安全了。艾玛人靠你了。

messages.en: Damn you. Get out of here.
messages.zh: 该死的。滚出去。

messages.en:
The Amarr either do not know or do not care that the slaves have been transported to another station. They are still threatening to attack. I need you to destroy the Amarr strike force.

We read one dreadnought with them, though she seems to be playing support. Pay her no mind. We've got a little surprise in store for her. Watch for instructions after you clean up the rest.
messages.zh:
艾玛既不知道也不关心劳工被运到其他空间站的事。他们仍扬言要攻击我们的空间站。我要你去把他们的突击部队干掉。

我们观察到他们其中一个无畏的人，虽然她看起来是支持我们的。别对她在意。我们给她准备了点小惊喜。干掉他们之后等待指示。

messages.en: Your delay has led to a bloody battle that we barely won. Thanks for leaving us to die.
messages.zh: 都是因为你的耽搁致使我们经历了一场血战，勉强胜利。真是多谢你让我们伤亡惨重啊。

messages.en: You missed the battle.
messages.zh: 你错过了一场战斗。

messages.en: Hey, the slaves are safe. The Amarr are your problem.
messages.zh: 嘿，劳工都安全了。艾玛人靠你了。

messages.en: Damn you. Get out of here.
messages.zh: 该死的。滚出去。

messages.en: Your inaction has led to a bloody battle that we barely won. Thanks for leaving us to die.
messages.zh: 你的无为致使我们经历了一场血战，勉强胜利。真是多谢你让我们伤亡惨重啊。

messages.en: You missed the battle.
messages.zh: 你错过了一场战斗。

messages.en: I'll take care of this for you.
messages.zh: 我会帮你办好的。

messages.en: Good! Be careful out there; and remember, avoid combat with the Gallente if at all possible.
messages.zh: 很好！到那要小心；还要记住，尽可能避免与盖伦特开战。

messages.en: Got any work for me?
messages.zh: 有工作要给我做？

messages.en: The Gallente are using a radio telescope to spy on us. Destroy the Gallente telescope.  Try to avoid engaging any Gallente ships unless you are attacked.
messages.zh: 盖伦特人正在用无线电望远镜窥探我们。毁掉盖伦特的望远镜。尽量避免接触盖伦特舰船，除非他们攻击你。

messages.en: I've destroyed the telescope. Unfortunately, I also had to destroy some Gallente.
messages.zh: 我把望远镜摧毁了。很不幸，我也必须干掉一些盖伦特人。

messages.en: Perhaps they'll be a little less nosy in the future.
messages.zh: 以后他们应该不那么爱管闲事了。

messages.en: No thanks. They may be willing to violate the trust of their allies, but I have higher standards.
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。他们说不定想要糟蹋盟友的信任呢，我还有更长的路要走呢。

messages.en: I suppose I can understand your reluctance to engage our allies, even in spite of this intrusion.
messages.zh: 我觉得我能理解你为什么不愿意答应我们的盟友，即使没有这次侵扰也一样。

messages.en:
As a matter of fact, I do.

We've located a nest of Gallente spies. They're using a radio telescope to keep track of our activities in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

I want you to go out there and destroy that radio telescope. Try to avoid hostile contact with the Gallente spies, but if they attack-- well, you do what you have to do. It'll serve them right for spying on their allies.
messages.zh:
事实上，是的。

我们已经发现了一个盖伦特间谍窝点。他们正在使用一架无线电望远镜监视我们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的行动。

我要你到那里去，摧毁那架无线电望远镜。尽量避免与盖伦特间谍正面接触，但是如果他们发起攻击的话——那就做你必须做的。这就是他们窥探盟友的下场。

messages.en: This radio telescope has to be taken care of. I can't wait any longer for you to make up your mind. Your delay has allowed the Gallente another week of spying on us.
messages.zh: 我们必须小心应对这个无线电望远镜。我不能再等你打定主意了。你的延误让盖伦特人又窥探了我们一星期。

messages.en: Time's up.
messages.zh: 时间到。

messages.en: I've reconsidered striking out against our allies. Maybe you can pull in a diplomat on this one.
messages.zh: 我已经重新考虑过了关于袭击我们盟友的事情。我觉得这件事情上你可以当一个外交官。

messages.en: Very funny. Dismissed.
messages.zh: 很有意思。解散。

messages.en: You've allowed the Gallente another week of spying on us. I can't wait any longer. I'll get someone else to take care of this, but in future, please to not take on missions unless you intend to complete them in a timely manner.
messages.zh: 你让盖伦特人又窥探了我们一个星期。我不能再等了。我会另找别人来处理这事，但是以后，除非你能及时完成任务，否则就不要接受。

messages.en: Time's up.
messages.zh: 时间到。

name.ja: 禁じられたクローン作成

messages.en: I will take on this responsibility.
messages.zh: 我会对此负责的。

messages.en: You will be greatly rewarded for your faith and hard work.
messages.zh: 你办事牢靠，工作也努力，你将得到一笔丰厚的奖励。

messages.en: Do you have work for me?
messages.zh: 你有工作给我做吗？

messages.en: A mad scientist is attempting to clone a member of a noble family. Find and destroy him, his facility, and any who protect him. He cannot be allowed to go through with his heretical experiments.
messages.zh: 一位疯狂的科学家正在试图克隆一位贵族家庭成员。找到并且干掉他，摧毁他的设施，干掉所有保护他的人。我们不能允许他进行这样的异教实验。

messages.en: The heretic's destruction will serve as a lesson to other blasphemers. I have done as God willed.
messages.zh: 这个异教徒的灭亡将会警示其它的亵渎者。我完成了神的旨意。

messages.en: I had faith that you would.
messages.zh: 我相信你会的。

messages.en: I don't have time to chase after madmen. Find someone else.
messages.zh: 我可没时间去盯着一个疯子。另找别人吧。

messages.en: You cannot interfere with God's will.
messages.zh: 你无法违背天意。

messages.en:
The Holders (the higher born class) are rarely cloned. The Amarr are a very religious people, and they consider the flesh to be sacred. This is particularly true of the Holders, since any of them could potentially become Heir and eventually Emperor.

In addition, the few instances of such blasphemy that have been carried out have resulted in madness or other deformities, clearly manifesting God's will in these matters.
messages.zh:
贵族（天生的高级阶层）几乎从来不被当作克隆对象。艾玛人具有很强的宗教观念，他们的血肉被认为是神圣的。对于贵族来说尤为如此，因为其中任何一人都可能成为继承人，进而成为帝王。

不过，也发生过少数这样亵渎神灵的例子，但是最终产物都是一些疯子或其它畸形，这就清楚地传达了神灵的意志。

messages.en: Amarr and Cloning
messages.zh: 艾玛与克隆

messages.en:
I do, though it is of a most distressing nature. Recently, rumors have come to my attention that some... scientist has taken it upon himself to attempt to clone a member of a noble Amarr family.

This heretic must not be allowed to go through with his blasphemous experiments. I need you to be the instrument of God's will in this matter.

Destroy his facility completely. Let him answer to God for his actions.
messages.zh:
是的，虽然这事很麻烦。最近我听到一些传闻，说某个……科学家擅自尝试克隆一个艾玛贵族家庭中的一位成员。

我们决不能允许这个异教徒进行如此亵渎神灵的实验。我希望你能代表神的意志除掉他。

彻底摧毁他的设施。让他去神的面前接受拷问吧。

messages.en: You have waited too long to give me an answer. I will find someone else who is willing to do God's work before it is too late.
messages.zh: 你等了那么久都没有给我答复。我会在一切还来得及的时候另找一个愿意为神工作的人。

messages.en: You have failed.
messages.zh: 你失败了。

messages.en: I don't have time to chase after madmen. Find someone else.
messages.zh: 我可没时间去盯着一个疯子。另找别人吧。

messages.en: You cannot interfere with God's will.
messages.zh: 你无法违背天意。

messages.en: You have failed to destroy this blaspheming madman and his sick experiments. I will find someone else who is willing to do God's work.
messages.zh: 你没能毁掉这个亵渎神灵的疯子，没能终止他那恶心的实验。我会另找一个愿意遵从神的旨意的人。

messages.en: You have failed.
messages.zh: 你失败了。

messages.en: I will gladly do this task.
messages.zh: 我会愉快地接受这个任务的。

messages.en: Wonderful! You will be greatly rewarded for this service.
messages.zh: 完美！你会因此获得丰富的奖励！

messages.en: Do you have work for me?
messages.zh: 你有工作给我做吗？

messages.en: The mining operations in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have been being systematically poached. Find and destroy these intruders.
messages.zh: 这个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的采矿行动是有组织的侵占行为。找到并摧毁那些入侵者。

messages.en: I've obliterated the poachers.
messages.zh: 我已经把那些入侵者抹掉了。

messages.en: Praises to God! I knew I could count on you to deal with those scurrilous interlopers. Here is your reward. You have truly earned it!
messages.zh: 赞美上帝！我就知道我可以指望你来解决那些卑鄙的入侵者。这是你的奖励，你应得的！

messages.en: No thanks.
messages.zh: 不用了。

messages.en: I am shocked that you will let this insult stand.
messages.zh: 我很震惊你竟然会忍受这种侮辱。

messages.en:
I do. The mining operations in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} are being systematically poached. Miners are driven from the area, or attacked if they will not leave.

These poachers must be completely and utterly destroyed. Make them an example, so that no one will dare think they can take what is rightfully ours.
messages.zh:
的确。这个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的采矿行动是有组织的侵占行为。该地区的矿工被驱逐，如果不离开甚至会遭受攻击。

这些侵入者必须被彻底地完全地消灭，这样以后就没人敢动属于我们的东西了。

messages.en: I thought I could count on you to do this task, but apparently I was wrong.
messages.zh: 我本以为我能指望你来做这个任务，但是显然我错了。

messages.en: Waited too long
messages.zh: 等了太久

messages.en: If it's so important to you, do it yourself.
messages.zh: 如果这对你而言那么重要，那你就自己做吧。

messages.en: I am shocked that you will let this insult stand.
messages.zh: 我很震惊你竟然会忍受这种侮辱。

messages.en: I thought I could count on you to do this task, but apparently I was wrong.
messages.zh: 我本以为我能指望你来做这个任务，但是显然我错了。

messages.en: Waited too long
messages.zh: 等了太久

messages.en: Will do!
messages.zh: 我会的！

messages.en: Get it done, okay?
messages.zh: 办好它，好吗？

messages.en: What can I do for you?
messages.zh: 我能为你做什么?

messages.en: Confirm or deny the rumor of a secret Amarr base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} , and see if your agent has further instructions.
messages.zh: 证实或推翻关于那个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name} 的艾玛秘密基地的留言，然后看看你的代理人是否有进一步指示。

messages.en: I took care of that base.
messages.zh: 我已经解决了那个基地。

messages.en: Well done.
messages.zh: 做得好。

messages.en: This is not the kind of thing I want to be doing right now.
messages.zh: 这不是我现在想做的事情。

messages.en: Well, I can find scouts anywhere.
messages.zh: 好的，我到处都能找到侦查员。

messages.en:
I need you to do some reconnaissance work for me. There is a rumor that the Amarr have set up a secret base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

I want you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and see if you can find a base there. If you do, I'll have additional instructions.
messages.zh:
我需要你来为我做一些勘察工作。留言传说艾玛人在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name} 建立了一个秘密基地。

我希望你前去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name} 并看看是否能够找到这样一个基地。如果找到了，我会有进一步的指示。

messages.en: I can't sit around waiting for you to accept this mission.
messages.zh: 我可不能坐着等你接受这个任务。

messages.en: It's been too long.
messages.zh: 已经太久了。

messages.en: I don't have the time right now to complete this mission. I quit!
messages.zh: 我没有时间来完成这个任务。我退出！

messages.en:
I didn't think you were a quitter, but I see I'll have to reevaluate my view of you. Because you are a quitter.

Because you quit.

Quitter.
messages.zh:
我本以为你不是个没有志气的人，但是我发现我必须重新评价你这个人。因为你是个轻易停止的人。

因为你放弃了。

没有志气的人。

messages.en: I'm giving this to someone else.
messages.zh: 我准备把这件事给别人做。

messages.en: It's been too long.
messages.zh: 已经太久了。

messages.en: With pleasure.
messages.zh: 不客气。

messages.en: Take care not to underestimate the Gallente.
messages.zh: 可别低估了盖伦特人。

messages.en: I heard you had a job for me?
messages.zh: 听说有工作要指派给我？

messages.en: A Caldari pilot who has been helpful to the Empire in the past was ambushed by Gallente ships and managed to limp away to the safe haven of a station run by the Sisters of EVE. Go make sure that the lingering Gallente ship that is waiting for her to leave will not be a problem.
messages.zh: 一位曾经对帝国提供过帮助的加达里飞行员被盖伦特的舰船伏击了并且蹒跚的逃到了姐妹会的避难所。你去处理一下，要确保那艘船不会再带来任何麻烦。

messages.en: That vulturous Gallente ship is no longer a threat to anyone.
messages.zh: 贪婪的盖伦特舰船不会再对任何人构成威胁。

messages.en: Well done. Aid given to our allies is aid that will be returned to us twofold in the times to come.
messages.zh: 干得好。我们这样帮助我们的盟友，将来他们会双倍奉还的。

messages.en: The Caldari can take care of their own. I'm sure she'll be fine.
messages.zh: 那个加达里人她会自己照顾好自己的。我保证她会没事的。

messages.en: Remember: in helping our allies, we help ourselves. It's yourself you're leaving in the lurch here, friend.
messages.zh: 记住：救助盟友的时候也要自救。别把自己的安危置身事外，朋友。

messages.en:
The Sisters of EVE are a religious humanitarian aid organization. They believe that heaven resides on the other side of the EVE gate, and if they can get back through the gate, they will be able to talk to God. Allying their religion with science, they frequently experiment on the EVE gate, with the goal of one day unlocking its secrets.

The Sisters are politically neutral, with members from every faction. They have been providing aid to those in need since the Gallente-Caldari War. They have a number of stations set up outside of empire borders.
messages.zh:
姐妹会是一个宗教性质的人道主义援救组织。他们相信天堂在新伊甸之门的另一头，而且如果他们能成功的从星门那头回来，他们就可以和上帝交流。为了把他们的宗教理念和科学结合起来，他们总是在星门上做实验，希望终有一日能够解开那个谜团。

姐妹会在政治上处于中立，他的成员也是来自各个宗派的。加达里与盖伦特的战争开始后，他们就向那些需要帮助的人提供援助。他们在帝国的边境外建站了一大批空间站。

messages.en: The Sisters of EVE
messages.zh: 姐妹会

messages.en:
The Gallente have ambushed a Caldari pilot who has been very helpful to us in the past. Her vessel suffered serious damage, and she barely escaped.

She managed to reach a station operated by the Sisters of EVE, who provided her with help. However, her ship is still damaged, and there is a Gallente ship that is waiting to finish her off as soon as she leaves the station's shelter.

I would like you to assist her by making certain that the Gallente ship will no longer be a problem.
messages.zh:
盖伦特伏击了一名曾经对我们有恩的加达里飞行员。她的船毁坏得很厉害，她也险遭不测。

她成功逃到了愿意提供帮助的姐妹会的空间站。但是她的船损坏得很厉害，而且盖伦特的舰船在外面守着，她一走出避难所，就会死于盖伦特之手。

我希望你能去帮助她，确保盖伦特舰船不会再带来任何麻烦。

messages.en: Due to your laziness and disregard, the Gallente ship managed to destroy our Caldari friend. You have cost us a valuable and proven ally; your reputation will suffer for this.
messages.zh: 因为你的懒惰和漠视，盖伦特的舰船害死了我们的加达里朋友。致使我们失去了一位宝贵的可靠的盟友；你将会名誉扫地。

messages.en: Caldari ally destroyed.
messages.zh: 加达里同盟已经被摧毁了。

messages.en: I don't have time for this anymore. The Caldari can take care of their own. I'm sure she'll be fine.
messages.zh: 我可没时间再管这事。那个加达里人她会自己照顾好自己的。我保证她会没事的。

messages.en: Remember: in helping our allies, we help ourselves. It's yourself you're leaving in the lurch here, friend.
messages.zh: 记住：救助盟友的时候也要自救。别把自己的安危置身事外，朋友。

messages.en: Due to your laziness and disregard, the Gallente ship managed to destroy our Caldari friend. You have cost us a valuable and proven ally; your reputation will suffer for this.
messages.zh: 因为你的懒惰和漠视，盖伦特的舰船害死了我们的加达里朋友。致使我们失去了一位宝贵的可靠的盟友；你将会名誉扫地。

messages.en: Caldari ally destroyed.
messages.zh: 加达里同盟已经被摧毁了。

messages.en: Of course.
messages.zh: 当然。

messages.en: Keep him safe and you will be well rewarded.
messages.zh: 保卫他的安全，干得好就有报酬。

messages.en: I heard you have work.
messages.zh: 我听说你有任务。

messages.en: A Caldari envoy is soliciting our assistance for his particular area of space. However, his transport ship is poorly guarded. Meet him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and escort him the rest of the way here.
messages.zh: 一位加达里的使节请求我们去他的一个地盘帮忙。不过他运输舰的防卫很弱。你现在去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}和他会面，然后对他进行全程护送。

messages.en: Here he is, safe and sound.
messages.zh: 他来了，毫发无伤。

messages.en: Excellent job. Here is your reward.
messages.zh: 干的好。这是你的报酬。

messages.en: I don't have time to ferry around pampered envoys. Find someone else for your babysitting job.
messages.zh: 我可没时间去护送那些娇贵的特使。找其他人吧。

messages.en: Your reputation will suffer for this.
messages.zh: 你会为此声誉扫地。

messages.en: The Caldari-Gallente war began based upon differences of thought and opinion of the Federation they were both a part of. It ripped the Federation completely down the middle and became particularly vicious.
messages.zh: 加达里-盖伦特之间的战争是由于对于他们同在的联邦的想法与理念不同所造成的。他们把联邦分裂成两半，并且十分邪恶。

messages.en: Caldari-Gallente Conflict
messages.zh: 加达里与盖伦特之间发生冲突

messages.en: A Caldari envoy is soliciting our assistance for his particular area of space. However, his transport ship is poorly guarded. Meet him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and escort him the rest of the way here.
messages.zh: 一位加达里的使节请求我们去他的一个地盘帮忙。不过他运输舰的防卫很弱。你现在去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}和他会面，然后对他进行全程护送。

messages.en:
Thanks to you, the Caldari envoy had to wait for another transport, and in that time, a Gallente ship managed to sneak into the area and attack the vessel he was on. Unfortunately for all involved, the assassination succeeded.

The loss of our ally is your fault.
messages.zh:
真是多亏你，在加达里的特使等另一艘运输船的时候，盖伦特的船悄悄潜入那里并且袭击了特使的船。很不幸，一切都毁了。

失去这样一位盟友都是你的责任。

messages.en: Caldari envoy dead.
messages.zh: 加达里的使节死了

messages.en: I don't have time to ferry around pampered envoys. Find someone else for your babysitting job.
messages.zh: 我可没时间去护送那些娇贵的特使。找其他人吧。

messages.en: Your reputation will suffer for this.
messages.zh: 你会为此声誉扫地。

The loss of our ally is your fault.

失去这样一位盟友都是你的责任。

messages.zh: 加达里的使节死了

name.fr: Le labeur de la guerre (1 sur 3)
name.ru: Все для победы (Labors of War) (1 из 3)

messages.en: Bounty's the magic word. Count me in.
messages.zh: 赏金是魔咒。算上我一个。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you.
messages.zh: 我就知道我能指望你的。

messages.en: I'm looking for work. Do you have anything for me?
messages.zh: 我在找工作。你有什么事给我做吗？

messages.en:
Supply and munitions interdiction raids are a critical part of ongoing operations against the Gallente Federation. Depriving the enemy of the materiel necessary to sustain the fight can only make it easier for our own forces to prevail.

After recent fighting in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, the enemy is no doubt attempting to undertake just such re-supply operations. There are State interdiction patrols active in the area and I'd like you to lend them a hand. If you see any enemy transports, destroy them immediately.
messages.zh:
封锁军火补给线的袭击行动是对付盖伦特联邦的行动中的重要部分。把敌人用来战斗的物资夺走会让我军更加容易地取得胜利。

在近期发生在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的战斗中，敌人无疑在尝试确保补给工作的顺利进行。在该区域有我们的封锁巡逻队在行动，我希望你去帮他们一把。如果你看到任何敌人的运输队，立即摧毁他们。

你能做好吗？如果成功你将会得到丰富的奖励。

messages.en: I destroyed an enemy convoy. Now where's that bounty you mentioned?
messages.zh: 我摧毁了一个敌军卫队。你说过的赏金在哪里？

messages.en: I have deposited the funds in your account. Check back with me as soon as you're able – I have another task for you.
messages.zh: 我把钱存在你的账户里了。尽快回来找我——我有其他任务给你。

messages.en: No thanks; I'm not interested in patrolling.
messages.zh: 不用了；我对巡逻不感兴趣。

messages.en: Very well. I'll find a real patriot to do it instead. You are dismissed, pilot.
messages.zh: 很好。我会找一个<i>真正<i/>爱国的人来做这件事。你被解雇了，飞行员。

messages.en:
Of course.

Supply and munitions interdiction raids are a critical part of ongoing operations against the Gallente Federation. Depriving the enemy of the materiel necessary to sustain the fight can only make it easier for our own forces to prevail.

After recent fighting in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, the enemy is no doubt attempting to undertake just such re-supply operations. There are State interdiction patrols active in the area and I'd like you to lend them a hand. If you see any enemy transports, destroy them immediately.

Will you do this? There's a sizable bounty in it for you if you're successful.
messages.zh:
当然。

封锁军火补给线的袭击行动是对付盖伦特联邦的行动中的重要部分。把敌人用来战斗的物资夺走会让我军更加容易地取得胜利。

在近期发生在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的战斗中，敌人无疑在尝试确保补给工作的顺利进行。在该区域有我们的封锁巡逻队在行动，我希望你去帮他们一把。如果你看到任何敌人的运输队，立即摧毁他们。

你能做好吗？如果成功你将会得到丰富的奖励。

messages.en: Even as we speak another Gallente task force is re-supplying in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It appears that our attempts to stop them from rearming have been unsuccessful. No matter, we will try again when the opportunity presents itself. At that time, be ready {[character]player.name}. I don't want to let another chance to hit a soft target pass us by.
messages.zh: 正当我们聊天的时候，另一支盖伦特特遣部队正在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name} 进行补给。这说明我们试图阻止他们重新装备的尝试失败了。不要紧，当机会出现的时候我们会再进行尝试。那时候，准备好，{[character]player.name}。我不希望让另一个容易打击的目标在我们眼皮底下溜走。

messages.en: Gallente supply operations continue unchecked.
messages.zh: 盖伦特补给行动毫无节制地进行着。

messages.en: Sorry, I'm not going to be able to complete this task.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我没能完成这个任务。

messages.en: Was I unclear in my explanation of the work I expected of you? You have accomplished nothing since taking on the task we discussed. This is unacceptable. I have made note of this dereliction of duty in your permanent record. Perhaps in the future you'll see fit to follow through on your obligations.
messages.zh: 是我没解释清楚我要你完成的任务吗？自从你接手这个任务，到现在什么都没做成。这不可接受。我把你的不负责任记在你的永久性档案里了。也许以后你会发现履行你的职责是多么必要。

messages.en: Gallente supply operations continue unchecked.
messages.zh: 盖伦特补给行动毫无节制地进行着。

name.fr: Le labeur de la guerre (2 sur 3)
name.ru: Все для победы (Labors of War) (2 из 3)

messages.en: No problem. I'll get right on it.
messages.zh: 没问题，我会踏实地去做的。

messages.en: Remember, those “workers” are of no value to us dead.
messages.zh: 记住，那些“工人”如果死了的话，对我们来说就没有任何价值了。

messages.en: Tell me more.
messages.zh: 再告诉我一点。

messages.en: The Federation is relying on the cheap labor provided by Minmatar immigrants to provide munitions. Even now, the Federation is building new factories to take advantage of these “human assets.” These assets must be captured or destroyed, just like any other enemy war materiel. One of our spies has managed to obtain information about a group of these workers being transported through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Capture them and bring them here.
messages.zh:
联邦正在依靠米玛塔尔提供的廉价劳动力来补充军火。

即便是现在，联邦仍然在建设新的工厂，并利用这些“人力资源”。我们的某个间谍设法获得了一些信息，据称一组工人将通过{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}被运输过来。抓住他们，并把他们带回来。

messages.en: Mission accomplished.
messages.zh: 任务完成。

messages.en: Stop by again when you're available. We're going to interrogate some of these Minmatar vagrants before shipping them off. Maybe we'll be able to find out where they were headed.
messages.zh: 下次当你有空的时候请再来一次。我们准备在放走他们之前，审问一些米玛塔尔流浪汉。也许会知道他们本来要被送去哪里。

messages.en: That sounds an awful lot like a slave raid to me. Count me out.
messages.zh: 那听起来像是个可怕的劫掠劳工行动。别把我扯进去。

messages.en: Good to know that you don't have the stomach to do what's necessary.
messages.zh: 很高兴得知你不害怕去做那些必须要做的事。

messages.en: For years, the booming Gallente economy has lured millions of Minmatar immigrants from their homes in the Republic, where poverty and unemployment are chronic. Often freed slaves come to the Federation, where they take menial jobs for little pay. These immigrant workers have further fueled Gallente business ventures by allowing them to reduce labor-related production costs.
messages.zh: 好多年了，盖伦特蓬勃发展的经济吸引了的数以百万计的米玛塔尔移民，他们都来自于共和国，一个贫穷和失业成为长期问题的地方。通常被释放的劳工会前去联邦，做一些卑微的工作，换取零星报酬。这些移民工人进一步推动了盖伦特的商业投机行为，因为他们可以借此减低劳力成本。

messages.en: Minmatar Emigration
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔移民

messages.en:
As you may have noticed on your last interdiction raid, the transports you destroyed were of Minmatar origin. It seems that the Federation is relying on the cheap labor provided by Minmatar immigrants to provide munitions.

Even now the Federation is building new factories and taking advantage of these “human assets.” One of our spies has managed to obtain information about a group of these workers being transported through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They must be captured, just like any other enemy war materiel.

Still interested?
messages.zh:
如你在上次封锁袭击中留意到的，你摧毁的运输队其实是来自米玛塔尔的。看起来似乎联邦正在依靠米玛塔尔提供的廉价劳动力来补充军火。

即便是现在，联邦仍然在建设新的工厂，并利用这些“人力资源”。我们的某个间谍设法获得了一些信息，据称一组工人将通过{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}被运输过来。我们必须抓住他们，就像任何其他敌军物资一样。

你还有兴趣吗？

messages.en: Business opportunity lost.
messages.zh: 错失了一笔生意。

messages.en: On second thought, I'm not going to take this job after all.
messages.zh: 重新考虑之后，我决定不接受这个任务。

messages.en: Dammit, you could have told me earlier.
messages.zh: 该死，你该早点告诉我的。

messages.en: Business opportunity lost.
messages.zh: 错失了一笔生意。

name.fr: Le labeur de la guerre (3 sur 3)
name.ru: Все для победы (Labors of War) (3 из 3)

messages.en: I'm on it.
messages.zh: 我准备好了。

messages.en: I knew I could count on you.
messages.zh: 我就知道我能指望你的。

messages.en: You've got my attention.
messages.zh: 你引起了我的注意。

messages.en: We've had a chance to interrogate some of the prisoners you brought back. Fortune smiles upon us – we've learned the location of the munitions plant in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to which they were headed. That factory must be destroyed as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 我们有机会审问一些你带回来的囚犯。幸运女神在对我们微笑——我们得知他本来要被送去的位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的军火工厂的地点。那个工厂一定尽快摧毁。

messages.en: That arms factory is no longer a current event.
messages.zh: 那个军火工厂已经成为历史了。

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}. You've struck a major blow to the Gallente war effort.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。你成功地给了盖伦特重重一击。

messages.en: No, thanks. I'm busy.
messages.zh: 不用了。我很忙。

messages.en: Suit yourself.
messages.zh: 随你便。

messages.en: I thought so. We've had a chance to interrogate some of the prisoners you brought back. Fortune smiles upon us – we've learned the location of the munitions plant in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to which they were headed. That factory must be destroyed as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 我也这样想。我们有机会审问一些你带回来的囚犯。幸运女神在对我们微笑——我们得知他本来要被送去的位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的军火工厂的地点。那个工厂一定得尽快摧毁。

messages.en:
When I did not hear back from you after assigning you the task of destroying that munitions plant, I feared the worst. I took the liberty of assigning another pilot to the task, and I am happy to report that the factory has been destroyed.

If you find yourself in need of work in the future, please do not hesitate to look me up. I'm sure I can find something for you to do.

Something less important.
messages.zh:
当我任免你来摧毁那个军火工厂之后，你就没有再回复过我。我害怕最糟糕的事情发生。我行使了签署另一个飞行员来完成任务的自由，并且，很高兴得知那个工厂已经被摧毁了。

如果你以后还想要找工作，请直接来找我，不要犹豫。我确信我会找到一些给你做的事，

一些不那么重要的事。

messages.en: Arms factory destroyed.
messages.zh: 武器工厂已摧毁。

messages.en: Sorry, I'm not going to be able to destroy that munitions plant after all.
messages.zh: 对不起。我毕竟还不能摧毁那个军火工厂。

messages.en: Suit yourself, but just be aware that every hour that factory is operating, it's cranking out ammunition that might be used to speed up your next clone activation.
messages.zh: 你自便吧，但是要意识到每个小时那个工厂都在运作，生产出可能会用来加速激活你下一个克隆体的军火。

messages.en:
When I did not hear back from you after assigning you the task of destroying that munitions plant, I feared the worst. I took the liberty of assigning another pilot to the task, and I am happy to report that the factory has been destroyed.

If you find yourself in need of work in the future, please do not hesitate to look me up. I'm sure I can find something for you to do.

Something less important.
messages.zh:
当我任免你来摧毁那个军火工厂之后，你就没有再回复过我。我害怕最糟糕的事情发生。我行使了签署另一个飞行员来完成任务的自由，并且，很高兴得知那个工厂已经被摧毁了。

如果你以后还想要找工作，请直接来找我，不要犹豫。我确信我会找到一些给你做的事，

一些不那么重要的事。

messages.en: Arms factory destroyed.
messages.zh: 武器工厂已摧毁。

messages.en: Ice mining in low sec– I can't think of a better way to spend the day, {[character]agentID.name}. I'd even do it for free, but not today!
messages.zh: 在低安全区域采冰—我似乎没有更好的办法来消磨一整天，{[character]agentID.name}。我甚至可以免费帮你做这件事，但不是今天！

messages.en: You're good with the bravado, {[character]player.name}, I'll give you that– now just get me my ice!
messages.zh: 你可真会虚张声势，{[character]player.name}，我会给你你要的东西——现在快去给我搞来我要的冰！

messages.en: If I don't live up to my reputation, I'll open the airlock for you, {[character]agentID.name}.  So what do you have for me?
messages.zh: 如果我辜负了自己的名声，我会自觉地跳出去，不需烦劳你为我打开气闸，{[character]agentID.name}。那你为我准备了什么？

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, I need you to go and procure 10 units of a very particular ice-- Azure Ice, I believe, is what you're looking for on your scanner. I also need it within the next 24 hours, so get to that ice field!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我要你去搞来一种非常特别的冰——蔚蓝色的冰，要10个单位，我相信你能在扫描器上找到。在24小时内我就要，快去那片冰域。

messages.en: What did I tell you, {[character]agentID.name}? Here's the ice you need, with time to spare.
messages.zh: {[character]agentID.name}，我不是告诉过你么？这是你要的冰，时间还很充裕。

messages.en: Finally, someone with a degree of competence! Thanks for your work, {[character]player.name}. Just mind that airlock door on your way out...
messages.zh: 真是一个能干的人啊！谢谢你的付出，{[character]player.name}。小心门口的气闸啊……

messages.en: Sorry, {[character]agentID.name}-- I like to stay frosty with my weapons turrets, not some boring mining laser. I'm off to find work a little more glorious than this– goodbye!
messages.zh: 不好意思，{[character]agentID.name}—我想我宁可在寒风中和我的武装炮塔抱在一块，也不想使用这些无聊的采矿激光。我要去找些更光辉的工作——再见！

messages.en: Well, you do live up to your reputation-- as a selfish churl. Good riddance, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 恩，你真是不负盛名啊——自私的吝啬鬼。谢天谢地，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en:
There are few who can deny the majestic beauty of an ice field: the slowly rotating towers of glistening blue-green ice set against the colder backdrop of the stars can give even the most jaded pilot pause. Yet such beauty hides a darker truth: if you are not prepared, an ice field can quickly become your very own sparkling graveyard.

While some ice fields can be found in Empire space, the rarer– and more profitable– ice ores are found in 0.0 space. As always, low sec can promise more ISK– or it can promise the dubious thrill of seeing your ship pounded into dust by eager pirates. Far too many inexperienced pilots have seen their mining barges blown apart-- with the hours and ISK needed to outfit them-- now so much vapor floating around their blinking pod.

Yet for most, the lure of the ice fields is too much to resist. With the sure promise of such treasures as Strontium Clathrates and Liquid Ozone, to name a few, the dangers of low sec will be dared. And even if it all ends in a fiery explosion, pilots can still enjoy the way their ship's destruction makes the ice sparkle all that more beautifully, if only for a few, rare seconds.
messages.zh:
几乎无人能够否认冰原壮丽的美：闪闪发光的蓝绿色的冰塔慢慢旋转着，在星星背景的衬托下甚至能够让最疲倦的飞行员得到停止打呵欠。然而这种美丽却暗含黑暗的真相：如果你毫无准备，那冰原就会成为你闪亮的墓地。

虽然在帝国空间也能找到冰原，然而更稀有——也更有价值的的冰矿只能在0.0空间找到。通常来说，低安全地带意味着更多的星币——或者意味着你可能要看着你的船被那些残忍的海盗撕得粉碎。太多没有经验的飞行员眼睁睁的看着他们的开采船被撞得粉碎—连同花在上面的时间和星币—而现在大量的气泡漂浮在闪烁的吊舱周围。

然而冰原的引诱几乎无法抵挡。由于在这儿会找到如锶包合物和液态臭氧一类的财宝, 这只是几个例子,飞行员便会无视低安全区域的危险。即使最终发生大爆炸，飞行员仍能欣赏由于自己船只的毁灭而带来的更美的冰火交融，即使只有短短的几秒。

messages.en: Cold Beauty: The Irresistible Danger of Ice Mining
messages.zh: 冷冷的美：无法抵抗的采冰危险。

messages.en:
I've been having a spot of bother filling an order, {[character]player.name}. It's starting to affect my usually sunny disposition. I'm hoping you can clear this off my docket, and bring the smile back to my face.

My client requires hydrogen isotopes to run her control tower, and she's getting a little snippy about the time it's taking me to provide it. She's even sent along a few assassins to vent her displeasure. No patience, that woman.

{[character]player.name}, I need you to procure 10 units of a very particular ice-- Azure Ice, I believe, is what you're looking for on your scanner; I can extract the hydrogen myself. I've lost a few good ships and a few incompetent pilots in the ice fields trying to fill this order, and I really need you to live up to your reputation, {[character]player.name}-- within the next 24 hours. Can I count on you, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh:
我在完成一个订单时遇到了点麻烦，{[character]player.name}。那甚至开始影响我一贯的开朗性格。我真希望你能帮我把这件事从我的事项表上清除，让我能重展笑容。

我的客户需要氢同位素来运行她的控制塔，而且她对于我所能提供的时间感到些许急躁。她甚至派出了一些刺客来发泄她的不爽情绪。那个女人真是毫无耐心。

{[character]player.name}，我要你去搞来一种非常特别的冰——蔚蓝色的冰，要10个单位，我相信你能在扫描器上能找到；我自己能够提取氢。为了完成这个订单我已经在那片冰原上失去了几条好船和几名无能的飞行员，千万别辜负你的盛名，{[character]player.name}——在24小时内我就要。我能指望你吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Perhaps my instructions were too complex for you, {[character]player.name}, but I needed that ice mining job done in 24 hours– not you making up your mind in 24 hours. Since the chronometer's ticking, I've gone and found someone who understands the concepts of ‘time pressure' and ‘manners'. If you want to apologize, please go fly into a black hole.
messages.zh: 或许我的指示对你来说太复杂了，{[character]player.name}，但是我需要有人能在24小时能完成采冰的工作—而不是在24小时内让你做决定。时钟滴滴答答地走，我要找能够理解“时间压力”和“规矩”的人。如果你想说抱歉的话，那就滚到黑洞里去吧。

messages.en: Ice won't mine itself.
messages.zh: 冰可不会自己开采自己。

messages.en: I'm not really feeling this job, {[character]agentID.name}. It could be the constant pirate attacks, or the sheer boredom of mining frozen water rocks.  Hard to say, but either way, I'm gone.
messages.zh: 我不能真正理解这份工作，{[character]agentID.name}。可能是长期的海盗式的攻击，或是百般无聊的开采冰岩。怎么说呢，反正，我不去。

messages.en: Or it could be that you need a Courage Implant along with an upgrade of Job Dedication? Just tossing it out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 或许你该需要植入一块升级过职业奉献的勇气芯片？把那些抛在脑后吧，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}– just a quick note to let you know your incompetence has had some rather spectacular consequences. Since you failed to provide the hydrogen isotopes I requested, I've had to deal with assassination attempts courtesy of both my client and my CEO. If you wish to make amends, please take a stroll through the nearest airlock. Thanks, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}¬—稍稍的提醒你一下，你的无能真是导致了十分壮观的后果。因为你无法提供我要求的氢同位素，我只好自己去对付那些由我的客户和总裁派来的突袭行动了。如果你想弥补什么的话，那请你滚到最近的气闸去吧。多谢，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: Hydrogen bombs
messages.zh: 氢弹

name.es: Al auxilio de los amarrianos oscuros
name.ja: ダークアマーへの協力
name.ru: Помощь темным Amarr (Aiding the Dark Amarr)

messages.en: Sure, I'll do it. Minmatar, Amarr - who cares, as long as I get to shoot them in the face, right?
messages.zh: 当然，我愿意。米玛塔尔，艾玛——管他呢，我只要朝着他们开火就行了，对吧？

messages.en: Good decision, {[character]player.name}. Now get flying!
messages.zh: 很好的决定，{[character]player.name}。现在出发吧！

messages.en: Might be.... What have you got for me?
messages.zh: 或许吧……你要给我什么？

messages.en:
The Minmatar Republic has been building up forces in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. In exchange for some generous financial compensation, we've agreed to help the Khanids push the Minmatar out. But we need a capsuleer to fly to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to keep the light Minmatar escorts busy while we help the Khanids destroy the larger vessels.

We've loaded the location into your NeoCom. Destroy any Republic vessels you encounter there.
messages.zh:
米玛塔尔共和国在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}组建了大军。卡尼迪给了我们一大笔财政补偿，作为交换，我们同意帮助他们把米玛塔尔人赶走。但我们需要一名克隆飞行员飞到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}去，在我们帮助卡尼迪人摧毁米玛塔尔大型舰队的时候，牵制他们的轻型护卫队

我们把地点上传到了你的数控系统中。我们希望你去那儿，摧毁任何出现在你视野中的共和国舰船。

messages.en: Well, I did my part. Have we got the Minmatar on the run?
messages.zh: 我完成了我的部分。我们让米玛塔尔忙起来了吗？

messages.en: Yes, we do - tails between their legs. Good work, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 是的，我们做到了——打得他们夹着尾巴十分可怜。干得好，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I don't really care too much for the Khanid Kingdom, or for any Amarrians, actually. No way I'm going to help them.
messages.zh: 我并不太在乎卡尼迪王国，也不怎么在乎艾玛人。我决不会去帮助他们。

messages.en: Sorry to hear that, {[character]player.name}. Your loss.
messages.zh: 真遗憾，{[character]player.name}。这是你的损失。

messages.en:
The Khanid Kingdom is a small empire of a dozen or so systems that was founded by the renegade Amarr Heir Khanid II. Rather than commit ritual suicide when he failed to attain the imperial throne, Khanid declared independence from the Empire. The next few years were spent fighting a rebellion by Khanid's brother and fellow heir Dakos, and turning back an invasion by the Empire.

Since then, Khanid's rule has continued, his small empire has prospered, and trade relations with his former imperial enemies have expanded considerably. The Kingdom acts as a small point of contact between the secretive people of Amarr and the rest of civilized space. Today, the kingdom's primary enemies are the Minmatar, who, despite Khanid II's secession, still see it as an ally of the hated Amarr Empire.
messages.zh:
卡尼迪王国是由艾玛背叛者黑尔卡尼迪二世所发现的几个星系所组成的小帝国。当卡尼迪没能登上帝国的王位时，他没有选择自尽，而是宣布从帝国独立出来。之后的几年都在与背叛者卡尼迪的兄弟及其继承人达寇斯作斗争，并击退了帝国的一次入侵。

从那时候起，卡尼迪延续了他的统治，他的小帝国开始昌盛起来，与前帝国的敌人之间的贸易关系也迅速地扩张起来。王国充当着艾玛神秘人群和文明太空其它区域之间的枢纽。现在，王国主要的敌人是米玛塔尔，他们无视卡尼迪二世的分裂，仍然把它视为令他们深恶痛绝的艾玛帝国的同盟。

messages.en: The Khanid Kingdom
messages.zh: 卡尼迪王国

messages.en:
Well, as you know, the Cartel has a pretty good thing going here in Curse – we're able to strike into the heart of all the other empires and remain relatively safe from retaliation. Now that the conflict between the Amarr Empire and the Minmatar Republic has heated up, though, we're getting pressure from both sides. The Minmatar have been pushing hard in some places, and now we've decided that it's time to push back.

We've been working with representatives of the Khanid Kingdom to give the Minmatar a surprise. The Republic has been building up forces in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. In exchange for some generous financial compensation, we've agreed to help the Khanids push the Minmatar out. But we need a good capsuleer to keep the light Minmatar escorts busy while we help the Khanids destroy the larger vessels.

Will you do it?
messages.zh:
如你所知，天使集团做了一件对我们来说相当不错的傻事——现在我们能够直击每个帝国的心腹地区，并在遭受反击时保证安全。由于艾玛帝国和米玛塔尔共和国之间的冲突已经升温，我们受到了来自双方的压力。米玛塔尔在一些地区逼得很紧，现在我们决定，是时候打回去了。

我们已经和卡尼迪王国的代表达成一致，要给米玛塔尔一个惊喜。共和国已经在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}组建了大军。卡尼迪给了我们一大笔财政补偿，作为交换，我们同意帮助他们把米玛塔尔人赶走。我们需要一个优秀的克隆飞行员去那里，在我们帮助卡尼迪人摧毁米玛塔尔大型舰队的时候，牵制他们的轻型护卫队。

你愿意去吗？

messages.en: Sorry, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm not going to be able to finish this assignment.
messages.zh: 抱歉，{[character]agentID.name}。我无法完成这个使命。

messages.en: No, I'm sorry, {[character]player.name}. Sorry you don't have what it takes.
messages.zh: 不，我很抱歉，{[character]player.name}。你并不具备所需的能力。

messages.en: Any chance to wipe some Amarr off the roster is one I'll take. Count me in.
messages.zh: 任何能够消灭艾玛人的机会我都不会错过的。算我一个。

messages.en: Perfect: I thought this was your sort of job, my friend. It needs courage, skill, and heroism — and you've got 'em all.
messages.zh: 很完美，我觉得这份工作很适合你，朋友。它需要勇气、技巧和英雄主义——这些你都一一具备。

messages.en: Heh. I wondered why your security officers were being so nice, {[character]agentID.name}. Continue the trend and give me a decent job, why don't you?
messages.zh: 呃，你的保安人员真亲切，{[character]agentID.name}。好人做到底，给我一份体面的工作吧，怎么样？

messages.en: Infiltrate the secret Amarr deadspace complex in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy the communications hub found there.
messages.zh: 潜入位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的秘密艾玛死亡空间复合体，并摧毁那里的通信中心。

messages.en: Get out the firewater, boys, 'cause we got reason to celebrate. Mission complete: Minmatar victory.
messages.zh: 把好酒拿出来，小伙子们，我们要庆祝一番。任务完成，米玛塔尔获胜。

messages.en: That is good news… but let's not get too far ahead of ourselves. I've just got some disturbing news about that broadcast plot — come back in a minute, will you, and then maybe I'll have the details sorted out.
messages.zh: 这是个好消息……但我们不要跑题太远了。我刚得到一些有关那个广播阴谋的烦人消息——你能不能过会再来，到时候或许我能理出一些头绪。

messages.en: Sorry — I'm not flying into an Amarr base with anything short of a Ragnarok. Dying for a holo-reel isn't how I plan to go out.
messages.zh: 抱歉——我不会开着任何一艘低于拉格纳洛克级的舰船去艾玛基地的。我可不想为了一个全息信息盘而送命。

messages.en: Oh, I perfectly understand, {[character]player.name} — a mission like this requires courage, skill, and heroism… qualities you are clearly lacking. Have you forgotten you're one of the bloody immortals!?
messages.zh: 我很理解，{[character]player.name}——像这样的任务需要有勇气、技巧和英雄主义……正是你所缺乏的才能。你忘了你也是个不死的克隆人么？

messages.en:
A key element in sustaining an Empire is maintaining control, however illusory. This lesson of Imperial longevity has been much on the Amarr Empire's mind of late.

The Jovian War. The Minmatar Rebellion. Gallente interference. The Caldari threat. All of these and more have seemed to herald the twilight of the Empire, and even with the miraculous return of Heir Apparent Jamyl Sarum, many Amarr are skeptical. Faith can hold one for only so long, it seems.

The last thing the Amarr Empire needs now is civil unrest, and what better way to occupy the minds of its citizenry than a good, righteous war? To that end, Amarr Intelligence frequently provides footage of Amarr's victories over the rebellious Minmatar for an eager and appreciative public. The fact that certain critics claim much of the footage is (re)constructed by skilled holo-efx techs is irrelevant: All that matters is that the people are happy and not asking questions.

Because the last thing any Empire wants is people asking too many questions. The wrong questions can be hard to control.
messages.zh:
支撑一个帝国的一个关键因素是维持政权，不管是何种虚幻的浮云。帝国的长存仰赖于艾玛帝国近期的思想。

朱庇特战争，米玛塔尔的背叛，盖伦特的干扰，加达里的威胁；所有这些，以及更多的因素都预示着帝国的黄昏。对于继承人贾米尔·萨拉姆奇迹般的回归，甚至连很多艾玛人都持怀疑态度。看起来信任只能维持一段不长的时间。

现在只需要在民间引发骚乱就能催跨艾玛帝国，要得民心，有什么办法能比发动一场适时又必然的战争更好呢？针对这样的结局，艾玛情报局频繁地播放艾玛打败反抗的米玛塔尔并取得胜利的镜头，以此来安定民心。某些评论家声称许多镜头是通过全息技术制作出来的，这无关紧要：重要的是人们都很高兴，不再有什么顾虑。

但是其它国家都希望艾玛民众有许多顾虑。不当的顾虑就可能让艾玛难以控制局面。

messages.en: Keeping Up Appearances
messages.zh: 保持形象

messages.en:
A job, eh? Hm. Yeah, I've got something for you. Pretty urgent, too.

Seems the Amarr have been broadcasting holo-reels of their military "victory" over the Elder Fleet when that Sarum bitch returned to power. Thing is, we've found that someone has set up a broadcast hub to send the damned holos out here — into Minmatar space! I guess they're trying to intimidate us, or to play some kind of psychological war. Well, you know how happy that makes me. Which is to say, not at all.

Anyway, {[character]player.name}, I'd like you to head out there and blow that broadcast array of theirs to bits. Take your favorite ship, along with a couple friends, maybe, and head to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

Time to disrupt a lot of bedtime stories...
messages.zh:
哦，工作？呃… 是的，我确实有事可以让你做。而且这事也很紧急。

艾玛好像一直在播放片子宣传他们在萨拉姆那恶棍重掌大权时取得的所谓针对长老会舰队的军事“胜利”。关键问题是，我们发觉有人竟然在这里架设了一台广播发射器，向米玛塔尔领域播发那该死的片子。我觉得他们是想恐吓我们，或者是想来场心理战。我如果告诉你我现在很开心，你觉得像吗？当然不像。

总之，{[character]player.name}，我要你前往那儿，把那广播塔炸个稀巴烂。用你最喜欢的飞船，也许再带上一两个好友，前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。

又有人要家破人亡了……

messages.en: I waited for as long as I could, {[character]player.name}, but I had to go with someone else on this job. It's unfortunate you found this task beneath your notice — it could have led to bigger and better things. But, uh, I guess not for you!
messages.zh: 我已经等了够长时间了，{[character]player.name}，但是这份工作不得不得给另外一个人做。很遗憾这份工作提不起你的兴趣——它本可以给你带来更大更多的利益，但是，我猜它已经不属于你了！

messages.en: An Inconvenient Truth
messages.zh: 麻烦的事实

messages.en: This mission isn't really for me. I like blowing things up, not sneaking around like a... well, like a sneaky person. I'm going to do something a little more… uh, epic.
messages.zh: 这个任务不适合我。我喜欢炸东西，但不是鬼鬼祟祟的像个……呃，像个卑鄙小人。我要去做一些更……呃，更伟大的事情。

messages.en: Well, you gave it your best, {[character]player.name}. Keep telling yourself that. It'll ease the sting of cowardice you should be feeling.
messages.zh: 你尽力了，{[character]player.name}。你应该经常这样告诉自己，能够帮你缓解懦弱的苦恼。

messages.en: I'm at a loss, {[character]player.name} — I thought my directions were fairly straightforward. Perhaps I should maybe hold your hand next time?
messages.zh: 我迷路了，{[character]player.name}——我以为我是笔直朝前走的。或许下次我应该跟着你走？

messages.en: Lies, Bloody Lies
messages.zh: 谎言，血腥的谎言

messages.en: Now this is more like it! Consider that code acquired.
messages.zh: 差不多要到了！我一定能取回那代码。

messages.en: I'm happy you're happy, {[character]player.name} — but the timer's ticking. Now go!
messages.zh: 看到你高兴我也很高兴，{[character]player.name}——但是时间紧迫。出发吧！

messages.en: Well, you've got my interest: What's happened?
messages.zh: 你引起我的兴趣了：发生了什么？

messages.en:
Go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and retrieve the data chip with the encryption codes from the Angel Cartel ship there, and then return to your agent with the chip. 
<font color = #EE3B3B>Be sure you check the timer for this mission; you won't have too long before the Angels are sure to clear out.</font>
messages.zh: 去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，从天使集团的舰船上取回数据芯片和加密代码，并带回来给你的代理人。<font color = #EE3B3B>你要注意这次任务的时间点；天使们肯定会在离开前销毁那些东西，不会给你留下很长的时间。</font>

messages.en: I got a little singed, but the job's done. Here's the data chip — just wipe the Angel blood off and you're good to go.
messages.zh: 我有点烧伤，但是工作完成了。数据芯片给你——把上面的天使血迹擦干净就可以用了。

messages.en: You are amazing, no lie — and it looks like we need to you keep it up: More trouble, it seems.
messages.zh: 说实话，你很让人惊讶，感觉好像我们需要你来帮我们制造更多的麻烦一样。

messages.en:
You want me to take on the Angel Cartel? Here's an even better idea: you pay me for the holoreel job, and I walk away from this one.

Yeah… yeah, I like that idea better.
messages.zh:
你要我去对付天使集团？我有个更好的主意：你付我那份全息信息盘工作的钱，这活儿我不干了。

是啊，我觉得这注意挺好。

messages.en: Fine, {[character]player.name}. Some champion you turned out to be. You know, you could do with a new wardrobe. Something in yellow would be appropriate, I think.
messages.zh: 很好，{[character]player.name}。你开始有明星的样子了。准备个新的衣橱吧，我觉得黄色的不错。

messages.en:
Whatever their other gifts, the Amarr are very good at two things: piety and self-justification. Both of these qualities, but most assuredly the second, come in handy when one considers the issue of slavery.

Since slavery is a consistently inherent theme in their religious doctrine (and how can something be wrong if faith allows it?), the Amarr must contend at all times with the disgust other races feel toward slavery. Chief among their opponents are the Gallente, whose displeasure is undoubtedly fueled by the many transplanted Minmatar flooding their homeworlds and stations. In the halcyon days of the Empire, the Amarr would easily have dismissed such concerns — but recent history has brought to some Amarr, at least, both humility and prudence.

Yet the need for slaves has not diminished — and in fact, since the recent Elder Fleet "recovery" effort in Amarr space, that need has grown terribly. However, the Amarr tradition of collecting slaves has necessarily become problematic for those Heirs and Holders, who may face trade embargoes and similar punitive actions from other nations. So many Amarr look surreptitiously to more "independent" sources of slaves — sources who don't care for any optics outside of their own bank balances.
messages.zh:
艾玛人有两点天赋：虔诚和自我开脱。这两点，尤其是第二点，会在他们思考劳工制度的问题时派上用场。

由于劳工制度是艾玛人宗教学说中根深蒂固的思想（既然是信仰所允许的，又怎么会错呢？），所以他们必须时刻与其它种族对劳工制度的深恶痛绝作斗争。他们敌人中为首的是盖伦特，盖伦特的不满显然是由米玛塔尔移民大量涌入他们的家园和空间站所造成的。在帝国平静的日子里，艾玛本来可以轻易地消除这些顾虑——但是近来发生的事至少让一些艾玛人重拾了谦卑和谨慎。

然而对劳工的需求并没有减小——而且事实上由于最近艾玛领地里元老舰队的“恢复”，这种需求还大大扩张了。但是，继承人和皇室必然对艾玛招募劳工的传统存有疑虑，因为他们可能会面临其它国家的贸易战和类似的惩罚行动。所以许多艾玛人暗中关注“独立”的劳工来源——从这些源头购买劳工时他们只需要关注自己账上的余款，而不用在意其它任何东西。

messages.en: Modern Slavery in Amarr
messages.zh: 艾玛当代劳工制度

messages.en:
My techs here have come across some disturbing information. We were monitoring that holo-reel hub and its vicinity, and just before you neutralized the array, we intercepted a garbled message from a nearby Angel Cartel ship… sent to the Amarr homeworld. It was pretty broken up, but we did make out the words "Minmatar" and "payment." We must know more.

We've managed to track the Angel ship that made that broadcast to an outpost that's, surprisingly, not too far from here. We need the code to decrypt that message, and that ship seems our best bet.

Go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and get that ship's log, no matter what it takes.

And you'll have to make it snappy, 'cause I'm pretty sure the Angels won't hang around there too long — you won't have much time once you accept this mission!
messages.zh:
我碰到了一些烦人的情报。我们目前正在监控那个全息信息盘数据中心和它周围的情况。就在你把那些数据中和之前，我们截取了一条来自附近一艘天使舰船的信号，信号被修改过……是发往艾玛故乡的。这条信息很零碎，但我们确实找到了“米玛塔尔”和“支付”的字样，我们必须追查下去。

我们设法追踪了播放那条信息的天使舰船，令人意外的是它驶向了附近的一个哨站。我们需要代码来破译那条信息，那艘舰船看起来是我们最有把握的赌注。

你去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}不惜一切代价拿到那艘舰船的记录。

你必须赶快，我可以肯定天使们不会在那里待上很久——你不会有很多的时间！

{[character]player.name}：

这或许很让人吃惊，但是整个宇宙不会围着你转，我也不会围着你转——这就是我雇佣别人去帮我拿回数据芯片的原因。算你倒霉，你这个蠢货。

{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Data Chip? Encryption Codes? Not in My Hand?
messages.zh: 数据芯片？加密代码？不在我手上？

messages.en: This is getting way too hot for me, {[character]agentID.name}. To hell with the politics — break out the Fleet if you want that code bad enough.
messages.zh: 我快要忍不住了，{[character]agentID.name}。让政治见鬼去吧——如果你还想让那代码更糟，就炸掉那个舰队。

messages.en: Fine, just fine.  But a question before you go: How do you fit your tail between your legs inside that egg of yours? Is it kind of cramped? Or just kind of embarrassing?
messages.zh: 好吧，好吧。但你走之前我还有个问题：你在逃生蛋里的时候为什么要用腿夹着尾巴？是抽筋了还是难为情？

{[character]player.name}：

还记得我吗？我叫你帮我取得一个数据芯片用来解密一条被我们截获的通讯信息那次？你拿到了？我觉得你没，从现在开始在我这儿你就是对失败的最好解释。

{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: Mysterious Message Remains Mysterious
messages.zh: 神秘的信息依然神秘

messages.en: There are no worse scum than slave raiders. It'll be my pleasure to wipe them from the stars.
messages.zh: 没有什么比劳工猎头者更坏的了。我很乐意把他们从宇宙中清理掉。

messages.en: Spoken like a true warrior, {[character]player.name}.  Now make those pirate dogs beg for mercy. And offer none.
messages.zh: 说得像个真正的战士，{[character]player.name}。现在去让这些海盗像丧家之犬一样求饶吧，但是不要饶过他们。

messages.en: Yeah, I'm up for it. What do we need done?
messages.zh: 是啊，我打算要干了。我们要怎么做？

messages.en:
Eradicate all pirate ships at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and then rescue the slaves from the Cartel ships.

You might want to go in with some backup — intel says there's a bunch of the buggers out there.
messages.zh:
消灭{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的所有海盗舰船，从天使舰船的牢笼里救出所有的劳工。

你可能需要一些掩护——那儿有大量讨厌的东西。

messages.en: I've returned with the rescued slaves. And I've wiped out every single Cartel ship involved in their abduction. You have to admit, {[character]agentID.name} — I am pretty awesome.
messages.zh: 我把救下来的劳工们带回来了。而且我把所有参与诱骗劳工的天使舰船都消灭了。你必须承认，{[character]agentID.name}——我干得很棒。

messages.en: I'd have to agree with your rather modest assessment, yes. You have served both the Republic Fleet and our people with honor. Such exemplary work deserves an appropriate reward. Enjoy, hero!
messages.zh: 我必须认同你这个更合适的评价。你用出色的表现帮助了共和舰队和我们的人民。你应该得到一笔奖励。尽情享用吧，英雄！

messages.en: If rescuing our own people from slavers isn't a job for the Republic Fleet, then what is? I'm not risking my ship because the navy refuses to do its job.
messages.zh: 如果把我们的人民从成为劳工的命运中拯救出来不应该是共和舰队的分内事，那你觉得什么才是？我没有开着我的舰船去冒险是因为海军拒绝履行他们的职责。

messages.en: If blaming others helps you rationalize your cowardice, {[character]player.name}, then so be it. Take your "worthy self" and get out of my sight.
messages.zh: 如果你觉得责怪他人就能让你的懦弱变得合情合理，{[character]player.name}，那么你就继续责怪吧。带着你那“问心无愧”滚出我的视线。

messages.en:
In the heinous world of spaceship piracy, only the worst — or best, depending on your outlook — rise to the top and stay there. The Angel Cartel is among the very few pirate organizations that can claim this dubious honor.

The Cartel is the most widespread criminal organization blackening the space lanes. There are many reasons for this, chief among them being that the Angels fully embrace the sound business policy of diversity. Outside of common piracy, the Angels have their fingers in most illegal pies, be they protection rackets, industrial blackmail, or murder for hire. There are also rumors the Cartel is involved in even more despicable operations — yet attempts to investigate these claims have only produced numerous law enforcement corpses.

Most spacers know that to cross the Cartel is tantamount to suicide. Without mercy, without compassion, and allegedly armed with long-lost Jovian technology, the Cartel is best avoided by those with a fondness for breathing.

But sometimes even pirates can go too far....
messages.zh:
在宇宙海盗的罪恶世界观里，只有最差或者最好，这取决于你的观点——走上极端并坚持。只有少数几个海盗组织主张这种令人怀疑的荣誉感，天使集团就是其中之一。

天使集团是给太空航线蒙上阴影的犯罪组织中分布最广的。这有很多原因，天使的首领支持多样性的贸易政策。除了一般的海盗行为以外，天使们还染指许多其它的非法勾当，比如收取保护费、行业勒索、买凶。另外还有一些关于天使集团有染更卑劣行为的传言——然而对这些传言的深究只是让许多人丢了性命。

宇宙当中的大多数人都明白，与天使集团过不去，就等同于自寻死路。天使集团毫无仁慈和怜悯，而且据说还用失传很久的朱庇特科技武装了自己，想要活命的人都对他们敬而远之。

但是有时候即使是海盗也会做得过头……

messages.en: The Angel Cartel
messages.zh: 天使集团

messages.en:
My techs decrypted the rest of that message, thanks to the code you recovered. It seems those Cartel ships you destroyed were part of a gang that've been moonlighting as freelance slave raiders. They're supplying the Amarr with slaves from outlying worlds! They've been abducting entire families living in isolated areas so the alarm won't be raised for weeks to come.

That ends now.

We've managed to track the Angel slaver ships to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, with — according to the message — a hundred of our people on board. We could send in the Fleet, but frankly they're still reeling, and they just might not get there in time. I need you to rescue those people, {[character]player.name}. Bring in whoever you need to help you on this one: Just get it done.
messages.zh:
我破译了那条信息剩下的部分，多亏了你所恢复的代码。看起来那些你所击毁的天使舰船属于一个专门在夜间抓人做劳工的帮派。他们向艾玛提供从偏远地区抓来的劳工！他们曾经拐骗了居住在孤立地区的全家人，这样在此后的数周里都不会提高警戒。

现在这一切都结束了。

我们设法追踪天使的劳工舰船，追踪到了{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，根据信息，有一百个我们的人在船上。我们可以上报给共和国舰队，但是他们还在行动中，可能无法及时抵达。我需要你来拯救这些人，{[character]player.name}。带上任何你所需要的人手，只要你能够成功。

messages.en:
You leave me speechless, {[character]player.name}. I would have thought rescuing your own people from slavery would be a priority. Obviously not….

I just don't know what more to say.
messages.zh:
你让我无话可说，{[character]player.name}。我应该意识到你会优先营救自己人。可是显然我没有料到……

我不知道该怎么说下去了。

messages.en: Slave Raiders
messages.zh: 劳工猎头者

messages.en: I think I've done enough for the Minmatar people, don't you? It's someone else's turn to step up. I'm done with this job.
messages.zh: 我觉得我已经为米玛塔尔人民做了很多，你不认为吗？后面的事该交给别人去做了。我已经完成了我的工作。

messages.en: Fine. Know this, though: Your blatant selfishness may have condemned those poor souls to indentured servitude, or worse. Let that comfort you at night.
messages.zh: 嗯，我知道，但是：你或许自私地责备那些受契约束缚的劳工们可怜的灵魂，或者更糟。希望这样能让你晚上睡得好。

messages.en: I rather hope you're dead, {[character]player.name}, because there's no other excuse for allowing our people to be enslaved. I'd hate to think you just decided you couldn't be bothered.
messages.zh: 我宁可你已经死了，{[character]player.name}，因为没有其它理由能让我们的人民成为劳工。我不愿意看到你仅仅是懒得去阻止。

messages.en: Minmatar Slaves
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔劳工

messages.en:
For a career in business, you will need a basic understanding of crucial industrial processes such as mining ore and reprocessing it (along with a myriad of other materials) into its component minerals.

I want you to get onboard your new Venture, fit it with a mining laser and a turret weapon - the former for the asteroids, the latter for any pirates that might attack you - and head out to a certain set of coordinates, where you'll mine ore from Veldspar asteroids.

Once you get back, refine the Veldspar ore into Tritanium. If you had to deal with any pirates, you can also refine any modules you retrieved from their wrecks - though be aware that the reprocessing of ships and modules usually carries a hefty waste penalty.
messages.zh:
如果你立志从商，那你最好对各种矿石或材料的采矿、提炼之类的重要工业流程有个基本了解。

我要你登上新的冲锋者级，装配上用于采矿的采矿激光器和用于还击海盗攻击的炮台武器，前往一个特定坐标地点，从凡晶石小行星带中采矿。

回来后，把采集到的矿石提炼成三钛合金。如果你不得不干掉几个海盗，你还可以提炼从他们的舰船残骸中得到的装备。不过你要清楚，提炼舰船或装备通常有较大损耗。

messages.en: Excellent work. You're a quick learner. I'm going to manufacture something from that Tritanium you brought, but after that I'll have a new job for you.
messages.zh: 非常好。你学得很快。我马上就把你带来的三钛合金用于生产，之后我会再给你个新任务。

messages.en: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. I hope you put that ship I gave you to good use all the same.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，我给了你一个星期的时间让你考虑我的工作邀请。你却这么不主动，那肯定就是说你没有兴趣了。那我只好把这个任务交给别人去打理了。你可要好好用我给你的那艘船。

messages.en: I'm tired of waiting.
messages.zh: 我没耐心再等下去了。

messages.en: Since you seem to have forgotten, I asked you to mine and reprocess that Veldspar, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你可能是忘记了，之前我曾让你采些凡晶石并且提炼出矿物来。我给了你一星期时间，到现在什么结果都没收到。看样子我非得找别人不可了。你听好：以后要慎重对待你的承诺，没人喜欢被放鸽子。

messages.en: I'm tired of waiting.
messages.zh: 我没耐心再等下去了。

name.fr: De l'argent pour les capsuliers (9 sur 10)
name.ja: カプセラの支払い履歴（9/10）
name.ru: Наличные для капсулеров (Cash Flow for Capsuleers) (9 из 10)

messages.en:
We've come across a narcotics ring that we suspect is helping fund Steon's operations.

Make your way to their warehouse and destroy it, {[character]player.name}. Be ready for a fight, too.
messages.zh:
我们无意中发现了一个犯罪集团，怀疑是他们一直在资助史坦的军事行动。

去捣毁他们的仓库吧，{[character]player.name}。也要做好战斗准备。

messages.en: Excellent work! Those criminals were funding all sorts of illegal activities.

messages.en:
Let's move on to the next stage in the process. First, you'll need at least 100 units of Veldspar. Then, you can reprocess it here at the station using the Reprocessing Plant and give me the results.

If you succeed, I'll give you a new mining frigate.
messages.zh:

messages.en: Good work. Stick around!
messages.zh: 干得好。留着别走！

messages.en:
Now for some more complicated production. I want you to make me 20 units of Cap Booster 25.

You'll need the minerals Tritanium, Pyerite, and Mexallon which you can easily acquire by reprocessing ore from Scordite and Plagioclase asteroids.
messages.zh:
接下来是更复杂的生产项目。我要你制作20组电容注电器装料25。

你需要的矿物材料是三钛合金、类晶体胶矿和类银超金属，你可以通过采集和提炼灼烧岩和斜长岩轻松获得。

messages.en:
Now that I have those Cap Boosters, we've got a buyer lined up. Remember this: Your work doesn't just involve creating items, but being able to sell them and to deliver the goods on time.

That said, pick up the Cap Boosters from your hangar here posthaste, and bring them to my buyer at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Remember to let me know when you're done.
messages.zh:
我们有电容注电器装料出售，就有买家要货了。要记住：除了生产制造物品，还得能把它们卖出去并准时送达。

- 首先，将物品机库里的20个电容注电器装料25放入舰船货仓。

- 你需要把它们送往在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的买家手中。

- 跟着任务指引飞到目标地点。
（如果目标地点不在本星系，您需要“设置终点”后，在总览中右击黄色星门“跳跃”前往）

- 与收货人交谈后，即可完成任务。

messages.en: Quality of Mercy
messages.zh: 怜悯的精度

messages.en: You investigated a distress call from the starship Damsel.
messages.zh: 你调查了少女号发出的求救信号。

messages.en: Investigate the distress call from the Damsel.
messages.zh: 调查少女号发出的求救信号。

messages.en: We've just received a distress call from a ship called the Damsel, and you're the closest thing to aid available right now. Get out there and save some lives. Prove to me you're not just another murderous liar with a god complex.
messages.zh: 我们刚收到一条来自名为少女号舰船的求援信号，你现在是离救援点最近的人。快去那里救人，也好向我证明，你不是那种爱说花言巧语的罪犯。

messages.en: It seems CONCORD was faster to respond, but your backup was definitely appreciated. There were a handful of survivors picked up. They've been taken to various care facilities in the area – wherever vacancies could be found.
messages.zh: 统合部好像反应更迅速点，但也很感谢你的支援。现场有少量的幸存者得以获救，他们已经被分散运往多个医疗机构。

messages.en: Sometimes objects and entities found in space are not displayed in the default overview settings. Adding "Large Collidable Objects" in Celestials  and "Large Collidable Structures" in Entities to the overview can reveal details such as object names.
messages.zh: 在默认总览设置下，太空中的某些物体并不会出现在总览窗口中。在“天体”类中选“大型空间实体(LCO)”，在“空间实体”中选“大型可撞击的建筑”便可让这些物体出现在总览窗口里。

messages.en: Finding the Damsel
messages.zh: 寻找少女号

messages.en:
I ask for help, and they send me a capsuleer.

You are a capsuleer, aren't you? An immortal pilot who subverts the rules of life and death, who shapes the fate of empires? You'll have to excuse my skepticism.

I work with a humanitarian organization, the Sisters of EVE. I've seen your kind hasten the deaths of millions every day. You expect me to believe that you're different? To prove yourself, your actions will have to do the talking.

We've just received a distress call from a ship called the Damsel, and you're the closest aid available right now. Get out there and save some lives. Prove to me you're not just another murderous liar with a god complex. With all the power at your disposal, you certainly could be a force for good. And one thing is certain: Good is in dire need of allies these days.
messages.zh:
我请求援助，他们却给我送来了一个克隆飞行员。

你是克隆飞行员，对吧？就是那种不但死不了，还能影响帝国命运的飞行员？不好意思，我对你们确实不怎么信任。

我为一个人道救援组织做事情，该组织名叫“姐妹会”。我亲眼所见像你这样的人每天都在导致数百万人的死亡。你想让我相信你不是这样的人？那你就得证明给我看，用事实说话。

我们刚收到一求援信号，你现在是离救援地点最近的人。快去那里救人，也好向我证明，你不是那种爱说花言巧语的罪犯。凭你的能力应该能为正义而战。我们急需能够给予帮助的人。

name.ja: エージェントへの聞き取り

messages.en: You got in touch with an undercover CONCORD agent, who told you that the ship Damsel was registered to a pilot under the name Marihem Dagan.
messages.zh: 你与统合部的一位特工取得了联系，他告诉你少女号是注册在飞行员马里恒·哒加恩名下的。

messages.en: Talk to the CONCORD agent, Tevis Jak.
messages.zh: 找统合部代理人特维斯·雅克谈话。

messages.en:
No one fired on the Damsel. Something must have happened inside the ship.

We'd like you to track those survivors down. CONCORD is the first logical step. I've gotten in touch with CONCORD Agent Tevis Jak, who may have information for you. Go see if you can find a piece of this puzzle.
messages.zh: 没有人向少女号开火。肯定是船内部出了问题。我们要你跟踪那帮幸存者的下落。统合部自然是我们要依靠的首要帮助对象。我已经与统合部的特维斯·雅克代理人取得了联系，或许他能透露点消息。我已把他的位置上传到你的控制边栏里了。去吧，看看能否得到些线索。

messages.en: Ah, Sister Alitura said you'd be coming by. You're here about the Damsel, right? That ship's registered to a pilot under the name Marihem Dagan.
messages.zh: 啊，阿里桃拉修女说你会来的。你此行的目的是与少女号有关吧？那艘船是注册在一个叫做马里恒·哒加恩的飞行员名下的。

messages.en:
We got some interesting information out of your trip. It seems no one fired on the Damsel. Something must have happened inside the ship.

We'd like you to track those survivors down, see if you can get any information about the ship's path, pilot, or cargo. We need to know what caused this disaster.

CONCORD is the first logical step. I've gotten in touch with CONCORD Agent Tevis Jak, who may have information for you. His location is being uploaded to your NeoCom: he's currently acting as an ORE agent. Go see if you can find a piece of this puzzle.
messages.zh:
我们得知了一些有用的信息。少女号并未遭人袭。肯定是船内部出了问题。我们要你找到那帮幸存者的下落，看看能不能得到该船的飞行员、航迹或其货柜的信息。我们想要知道这场灾难发生的原因。

统合部自然是我们开始的第一步。我已经与统合部的特维斯·雅克代理人取得了联系，或许他能透露点消息。我已把他的位置上传到你的控制边栏里了。他现在的假扮身份是外太空联合矿业集团的一名代理人。去吧，看看能否得到些线索。

messages.en: You destroyed the pirates, and the CONCORD agent had information waiting for you.
messages.zh: 你消灭了海盗。统合部的代理人正等着向你通告情报。

messages.en: Kill the pirates and bring back anything interesting you find at the disaster site.
messages.zh: 去把海盗全都消灭，带回你在灾难现场找到的任何有意义的东西。

messages.en: A bunch of pirates have been scavenging the explosion site. Go and take them out for me. It shouldn't be too much trouble for a capsuleer, and you might even find some extra information.
messages.zh: 有一帮海盗正在爆炸现场转悠。你去把他们都解决掉。这事对你来说问题不大，而且说不定你还能搜获其他信息。

messages.en: Ah, you're done. Good timing.
messages.zh: 做完了？ 时机正好。

messages.en:
Yeah, I picked up the crew that outlived that explosion – pretty massive, whatever it was. I'll see if I can track down the facilities they were sent to if you can do me a favor.

A bunch of pirates have been scavenging the explosion site. Go and take them out for me. It shouldn't be too much trouble for a capsuleer, and you might even find some extra information. Hell, you can probably get it done in the time I'll need to look up the rest of this data. Damn legacy systems...
messages.zh:
是啊，我把那些在爆炸中幸存下来的船员救出来了。那爆炸规模不小啊。如果你能帮我一个忙，那我就能去查出他们原本要前往的地点。

有一帮海盗正在爆炸现场转悠。你去把他们都解决掉。这事对你来说问题不大，而且说不定你还能搜获其他信息。等你把这事搞定了，我差不多也就查出下落来了。全怪这破旧的机器……

messages.en: Tevis Jak sent you to find a man named Red. He was murdered by the time you found him.
messages.zh: 特维斯·雅克派你去寻找一名叫做红衣男的人。但当你找到他的时候，他已经遇害了。

messages.en: Find Red and deliver him to Tevis Jak.
messages.zh: 找到红毛并把他交给特维斯·雅克。

messages.en: I found your first guy, but it looks like he's shipped out already. He's down in the crew manifest as "Red". I'm giving you coordinates to intercept the convoy now. You should be able to catch them before they get too far. Go quick, though: I'm worried that they don't have enough security to deal with the number of 'rats – sorry, pirates – where they're headed. They might need your help.
messages.zh:
好了，我找到你一开始那个人了，不过他好像又出发了。真是个干劲十足的战士啊。他在人员编制名单上叫“红衣男”，护航队里的人也这样称呼他。

我现在给你坐标去追上那护航队，路上别耽搁。不过我有一点要提醒你：我担心他们人手不够，无法应付出现的老鼠——不好意思，我是指海盗。他们需要你帮忙。

messages.en: Dead, is he? Figures. I'll keep the investigation open, but unless something changes there's little CONCORD can do.
messages.zh: 他死了？早就料到了。我不会停止调查的，但只要事情没啥变化，那统合部几乎也无能为力。

messages.en: Dead, is he? Figures. I'll keep the investigation open, but unless something changes there's little CONCORD can do.
messages.zh: 他死了？早就料到了。我不会停止调查的，但只要事情没啥变化，那统合部几乎也无能为力。

messages.en:
Okay, I found your first guy, but it looks like he's already shipped out again. What a fighter, huh? He's down in the crew manifest as "Red", and his convoy has him listed under the same handle, so there you go.

I'm giving you coordinates to intercept the convoy now. You should be able to catch them before they get too far. Go quick, though: I'm worried that they don't have enough security to deal with the number of 'rats – sorry, pirates – where they're headed. They might need your help.
messages.zh:
好了，我找到你一开始那个人了，不过他好像又出发了。真是名干劲十足的战士啊。他在人员编制名单上叫“红衣男”，护航队里的人也这样称呼他。

我现在给你坐标去追上那护航队，路上别耽搁。不过我有一点要提醒你：我担心他们人手不够，无法应付出现的老鼠——不好意思，我是指海盗。他们需要你帮忙。

messages.en: You gave Sister Alitura the information you accquired while working with Tevis Jak. She informed you that their investigation of the strange datacore you recovered has suggested some kind of drone involvement, though they have been unable to decrypt the data itself.
messages.zh: 你把之前从特维斯·雅克那里获得的消息告诉了阿里桃拉修女。她跟你说她们对你带回的数据核心进行了研究，虽然她们无法破解该数据核心本身，但她们还是发现了无人机与此此事有牵连。

messages.en: You're returning to Sister Alitura.
messages.zh: 你回去找阿里桃拉修女。

messages.en:
Just got a message from Sister Alitura. I sent her that weird datacore you found at the site. She says they weren't able to decipher it. Pity.

Still, she's very interested in consulting with you. So go do what she wishes. The Sisters are good people.
messages.zh:
我刚收到阿里桃拉修女发来的消息。我之前把你发现的那个奇怪数据核心交给了她。她说没法破解那玩意儿。

不过她还是很想和你谈谈。快去见她吧，姐妹会的人都是好人。

messages.en: Ah, you've returned. I must say, you're proving to be quite helpful. We were not able to decode the datacore, but we have produced a few leads of our own. The structure of the datacore resembles that of rogue drone fabrications we've discovered previously, but there are enough variations that we believe this may be something rather different. We'll keep working on it.
messages.zh: 噢，你回来了。我得承认你有很有用。虽然我们没法将那数据核心解密，但我们还是获得了些新线索。那数据核心的结构与我们之前发现的无人机构造非常相似，但还是有足够的差异让我们认为这是完全不同的一种东西。我们还将继续研究下去。

messages.en:
Just got a message from Sister Alitura. I sent her that weird datacore you found at the site. She says they weren't able to decipher it. Pity.

Still, she's very interested in consulting with you. So go do what she wishes. The Sisters are good people.
messages.zh:
我刚收到阿里桃拉修女发来的消息。我之前把你发现的那个奇怪数据核心交给了她。她说没法破解那玩意儿。

不过她还是很想和你谈谈。快去见她吧，姐妹会的人都是好人。

name.ja: 猛スピードで用務員を救え

messages.en: You retrieved the janitor Nebben Centrien for Sister Alitura.
messages.zh: 你替阿里桃拉修女找到了看门人列本·森特恩。

messages.en: Retrieve the janitor Nebben Centrien.
messages.zh: 找到看门人列本·森特恩。

messages.en:
We have another crew member located. The ship's janitor, Nebben Centrien, is stationed at a small outpost. We hope he'll have a lead on where some of the other personnel are recuperating.

In light of what happened to Red, I'd like you to bring him back here once you've found him – for his own safety, you understand.
messages.zh:
我们又找到了另一名船员。他叫列本·森特恩，是船上的看门人和管理员，目前在一座小哨站里。但愿他知道其他人的下落。

至于“红衣男”，如果你找到他就把他带回来吧，这也是为了他好。

messages.en: Give me a moment to input Nebben's data. He's already providing us with good information.
messages.zh: 给我点时间输入列本的数据。他给我们提供了相当有价值的信息。

messages.en: Give me a moment to input Nebben's data. He's already providing us with good information.
messages.zh: 给我点时间输入列本的数据。他给我们提供了相当有价值的信息。

messages.en: If you think it's easy to find people to take on the janitor role between the stars-- well, it's not, okay? Janitors are in high demand, especially in places frequented by capsuleers, who are not exactly famous for cleaning up after themselves.
messages.zh: 如果你以为在这世界里找个看门人很容易，那你就错了。他们很抢手，尤其是在克隆飞行员常出没的地方，他们有头没尾的做事风格是人所皆知的。

messages.en: Janitors
messages.zh: 看门人

messages.en:
We have another crew member located. The ship's janitor, Nebben Centrien, is stationed at a small outpost. We hope he'll have a lead on where some of the other personnel are recuperating.

In light of what happened to Red, I'd like you to bring him back here once you've found him – for his own safety, you understand.
messages.zh:
我们又找到了另一名船员。他叫列本·森特恩，是船上的看门人和管理员，目前在一座小哨站里。但愿他知道其他人的下落。

至于“红衣男”，如果你找到他就把他带回来吧，这也是为了他好。

messages.en: You rescued Chef Aubrei Azil.
messages.zh: 你营救了大厨奥布雷·阿奇尔。

messages.en: Rescue Aubrei Azil.
messages.zh: 营救奥布雷·阿奇尔。

messages.en:
It appears Aubrei Azil, the ship's cook, has shipped out as well. There's no way they would all get reassignments so soon after an incident like this. They're being shuffled through the system so we don't find them. And then there're the drones….

You need to find Aubrei. If we follow this long enough, we might discover who doesn't want the truth uncovered.
messages.zh:
那船上的主厨，奥布雷·阿奇尔，好像也出去了。在这么短的时间里我们不可能再去找一个替代。其他厨师都散布在此星系其他地方，我们几乎不可能找到他们。而且还有无人机问题……

你去把奥布雷找回来。我相信我们追查下去就必定能揪出那想埋葬事实的人。

messages.en: This drone involvement is certainly worrying news. Let me see what other leads I have for you.
messages.zh: 这次无人机事件的确是一条让人困扰的新闻。让我看看还有什么别的线索能够提供给你。

messages.en: This drone involvement is certainly worrying news. Let me see what other leads I have for you.
messages.zh: 这次无人机事件的确是一条让人困扰的新闻。让我看看还有什么别的线索能够提供给你。

messages.en: A good ship's cook is a valuable asset. It's much easier to keep morale up when you don't have to rely solely on generic frozen food. Real chefs who are willing to work in the often-cramped conditions aboard ships are in high demand.
messages.zh: 好厨师对船员至关重要。他们能让你不依赖基因速冻食品而尝到新鲜美食，籍此提升士气。那些能在船上艰苦环境中做饭的厨师总是供不应求。

messages.en: Vital Staff
messages.zh: 重要员工

messages.en:
We got the information from Nebben, but there's a problem.

It appears Aubrei Azil, the ship's cook, has shipped out as well. There's no way they would all get reassignments so soon after an incident like this. They're being shuffled through the system so we don't find them. And then there're the drones….

You need to find Aubrei. If we follow this long enough, we might discover who doesn't want the truth uncovered.
messages.zh:
我们从列本那里获得了情报，但现在有个问题。

那船上的主厨，奥布雷·阿奇尔，好像也出去了。在这么短的时间里我们不可能再去找一个替代。其他厨师都散布在此星系其他地方，我们几乎不可能找到他们。而且还有无人机问题……

你去把奥布雷找回来。我相信我们追查下去就必定能揪出那想埋葬事实的人。

messages.en: You ransomed Dr. Lujia Elban.
messages.zh: 你赎回了鲁加·艾般医生。

messages.en: Ransom Dr. Lujia Elban.
messages.zh: 赎回鲁加·艾般医生。

messages.en:
We've located the doctor from the wrecked ship. Unfortunately, we've located her by way of a ransom demand. We want this doctor alive, so we're going to pay it. I'll put the money in your hangar when you accept this mission.

I need you to take the ransom to the designated drop location. They're to drop off the doctor as soon as you drop off the money. Be prepared for a double-cross, just in case.
messages.zh:
我们找到那被击毁的船里的医生了。不过我们是答应付钱给绑架方的。没办法，我们一定要让那医生活着才行。所幸绑架者只要当地行星上的通货，因此我们实际的星币付出代价并不大。我会把一个塞满钱的箱子放入你货柜。

你要做的就是飞往指定处，把钱放下，然后绑架者就会把医生交给你。你得提防他们中途变卦。

messages.en: You handled yourself well out there. Doctor Elban is cooperating with us.
messages.zh: 你干得很好。艾般医生现在已经答应同我们合作了。

messages.en:
We've located the doctor from the wrecked ship. Unfortunately, we've located her by way of a ransom demand. We want this doctor alive, so we're going to pay it. Luckily they just want planetary currency, so the real ISK value is minimal. I'll put the money in your hangar when you accept this mission.
