I need you to take the ransom to the designated drop location. They're to drop off the doctor as soon as you drop off the money.

That's the plan, anyway. I'd be prepared for a double-cross, just in case.
messages.zh:
我们找到那被击毁的船里的医生了。不过我们是答应付钱给绑架方的。没办法，我们一定要让那医生活着才行。所幸绑架者只要当地行星上的通货，因此我们实际的星币付出代价并不大。我会把一个塞满钱的箱子放入你货柜。

你要做的就是飞往指定处，把钱放下，然后绑架者就会把医生交给你。

至少表面上大家就是那样约定的，不过你得小心他们中途变卦。

messages.en: You rescued Engineer Tahaki Karin from the ship Heartbreak.
messages.zh: 你救出了怅望号上的工程师图哈基·卡林。

messages.en: Retrieve Engineer Tahaki Karin from the Heartbreak.
messages.zh: 在怅望号上找到工程师图哈基·卡林。

messages.en:
We've gone a long way, but we've found the key survivor. Her name is Tahaki Karin. She was the engineer on the main ship from the ruined fleet. She may be the only one who knows what really happened.

You know the drill by now: Get out there and get her before someone else does. I'm fairly certain there'll be someone there to shoot at you.
messages.zh:
我们辛苦忙了一圈，现在终于找到一名关键幸存者了。她的名字是图哈基·卡林，是被摧毁舰队主舰中的一名工程师，也就是怅望号的一名船员。她可能是唯一知道事情完整经过的人。

懂我要让你干什么了吧：抢在别人之前把她给带回来。我相信那里会有人给你设障碍的。

messages.en: Excellent. Karin is being transported to a more secure Sisters of EVE location for a full debriefing with our people. Don't worry, we'll keep CONCORD well informed of our progress.
messages.zh: 很好。卡琳已经被转送到一个更加安全的地方，由我们的人陪同着做汇报。不用担心，我会随时向统合部报告我们的进展。

messages.en: Excellent. Karin is being transported to a more secure Sisters of EVE location for a full debriefing with our people. Don't worry, we'll keep CONCORD well-informed of our progress.
messages.zh: 太好了。卡林已被转移到姐妹会的另一安全地点，正向我们人员汇报详情呢。别担心，我们会及时向统合部通报事情进展的。

messages.en:
We've gone a long way, but we've found the key survivor. Her name is Tahaki Karin. She was the engineer on the main ship from the ruined fleet, and she's signed on to the crew of the Heartbreak. She may be the only one who knows what really happened.

You know the drill by now: Get out there and get her before someone else does. I'm fairly certain there'll be someone there to shoot at you.
messages.zh:
我们辛苦忙了一圈，现在终于找到一名关键幸存者了。她的名字是图哈基·卡林，是被摧毁舰队主舰中的一名工程师，也就是怅望号的一名船员。她可能是唯一知道事情完整经过的人。

懂我要让你干什么了吧：抢在别人之前把她给带回来。我相信那里会有人想要阻止你的。

messages.en: You contacted the Gallente agent, Delphine Xarasier, regarding the drone connection to your investigation.
messages.zh: 你联系上了盖伦特的德芬尼·扎拉希，与她讲了有关无人机的事情。

messages.en: Talk to your Gallente contact, Delphine Xarasier, regarding the drone connection to your investigation.
messages.zh: 请与盖伦特的一位联系人，德芬尼·扎拉希对话。跟她讲有关无人机的事情。

messages.en: Remember the strange datacore you found? We've determined that it must have been made by rogue drones of some kind. I'm sending you to Gallente space, where I've contacted someone who can help you continue this investigation. Her name is Delphine Xarasier, an agent for CreoDron and the daughter of their chief researcher. We've tapped out our other leads for now, which leaves us in need of more information on drones, and she can certainly give you that.
messages.zh: 还记得你找到的那个奇怪的数据核心吗？我们认定它是由某种无人机制造的。我要你去盖伦特领域，我在那里联系了一位能帮你继续调查下去的人。她名叫德芬尼·扎拉希，是西顿的一位代理人，而且还是那里首席研究员的女儿。我们要知道有关无人机的更多信息，她应该能告诉你。

messages.en: Sister Alitura sent you? Very well, give me a moment.
messages.zh: 阿里桃拉修女派你来的？很好，请稍候。

messages.en: Remember the strange datacore you found? We've determined that it must have been made by rogue drones of some kind. I'm sending you to Gallente space, where I've contacted someone who can help you continue this investigation. Her name is Delphine Xarasier, an agent for CreoDron and the daughter of their chief researcher. We've tapped out our other leads for now, which leaves us in need of more information on drones, and she can certainly give you that.
messages.zh: 还记得你找到的那个奇怪的数据核心吗？我们认定它是由某种无人机制造的。我要你去盖伦特领域，我在那里联系了一位能帮你继续调查下去的人。她名叫德芬尼·扎拉希，是西顿的一位代理人，而且还是那里首席研究员的女儿。我们要知道有关无人机的更多信息，她应该能告诉你。

messages.en: Automaton Impediment
messages.zh: 碍事的机器

messages.en: You retrieved drone components.
messages.zh: 你取回了无人机部件。

messages.en: Retrieve drone components and return them to your agent.
messages.zh: 回收无人机部件然后带回给你的代理人。

messages.en:
Every drone in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has ceased responding to signals. That doesn't happen with Federation technology, unless the drones have been destroyed. Our research and development team needs whatever components still exist in order to analyze the remains.

Your job is to fly out there and bring me back one of the drones, or whatever remains you can find.
messages.zh:
{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系里的所有无人机都了无音讯。联邦造出的无人机质量不应该那么差的……除非有人摧毁了那些无人机。不管什么无人机部件，度沃勒实验室研发部门都要你带回来进行研究。

你的任务是飞往那里，带个无人机回来——或者是残存的部件。

messages.en: Wonderful! The R&D team has been waiting for your return. Are you available for another mission?
messages.zh: 非常棒！研发部门的人正等着你回来呢。准备好接受另一项任务了么？

messages.en: The first drones in the Gallente-Caldari war were little more than mines with proximity detonators and limited movement, but soon they advanced to a level where a single drone rivaled a solo-fighter's capabilities. The drones reversed the tide of the war and helped create a stalemate between the two empires.
messages.zh: 盖伦特加达里战争期间的早期无人机作用有限，与一个只能遥控的地雷差不多。现在情况大不一样了，无人机的作战能力已经可以比肩一架单人战斗机了。无人机的出现改变了战争走向，两国僵持局面由此形成。

messages.en: Early Drones
messages.zh: 早期无人机

messages.en:
Alitura said you needed more information about some kind of drone problem.

The Sisters have referred a few promising capsuleers in the past, so I'm willing to give you a chance, but I can't do anything else until this mess I'm dealing with has been taken care of. If you could retrieve some drones from {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, that would speed things up considerably.

You see, every drone in that system has ceased responding to signals. That just doesn't happen with Federation technology… unless the drones have been destroyed. Our research and development team needs whatever components still exist in order to analyze the remains.

Fly out there and bring back one of the drones – or any parts that might remain. You'll need to be careful. There were no signs of other ships in the system, so I have no idea what could have destroyed our drones.
messages.zh:
阿里桃拉说你想了解有关某种无人机的信息。看在姐妹会过去曾推荐过几名确有本事飞行员的份上，我就给相信你一次，但我得先把我手头上这堆乱七八糟的事清理干净才行。如果你能马上去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}拿些无人机回来，那无疑能加快我的速度。

那个星系里的所有无人机都了无音讯。联邦造出的无人机质量不应该那么差的……除非有人摧毁了那些无人机。不管什么无人机部件，度沃勒实验室研发部门都要你带回来进行研究。

你的任务是飞往那里，带个无人机回来——就是残存的部件也行。你要小心，那星系看上去没有任何船，我也不知道到底是什么东西在背后作梗，把我们的无人机给毁了。

messages.en: You took needed medical supplies to an impoverished Gallente colony.
messages.zh: 你将医疗补给品送到了急需增援的盖伦特殖民站。

messages.en: Take needed medical supplies to impoverished Gallente colony.
messages.zh: 将医疗补给品送到急需增援的盖伦特殖民站。

messages.en: A recently established colony still depends on Federation support for items they can't produce yet. Their last shipment of medical supplies was lost en route, and we think it may be due to rogue drone action. Regardless, this batch of supplies needs to get through. Lives are depending on it.
messages.zh: 最近一个新建的殖民地还不能自给自足进行生产，它要靠联邦政府进行供给。上次原本要带给它的一批医疗物资半路上丢了，估计是自由无人机搞的鬼。无论如何，这次的物资必须送达。人命关天啊。

messages.en: Good capsuleers are always in short supply. I have an urgent recovery mission that I could use your help with.
messages.zh: 好人不容易找。我这里有个紧急取货任务，希望你能帮忙。

messages.en: Good capsuleers are always in short supply. I have an urgent recovery mission that I could use your help with.
messages.zh: 好人不容易找。我这里有个紧急取货任务，希望你能帮忙。

messages.en: The Gallente Federation emphasizes personal freedoms and accomplishments, but they also believe in providing the tools for personal advancement. Gallente believe in ”investing in the future,” so shipments of supplies for new colonies are almost always supported by lobbyists and the government. History has shown that the returns generated over the years more than repay the initial investment.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦虽然注重人身自由，强调个人成就，但它为了能让人更快地取得成功，它也愿意伸出援手。盖伦特一直坚信“投资未来”，新开发殖民地上的物资基本上都由联邦政府提供。历史经验表明，政府往往在投资数年后便能获利颇丰。

messages.en: Colonial Supplies
messages.zh: 殖民地物资供给

messages.en: A recently established colony still depends on Federation support for items they can't produce yet. Their last shipment of medical supplies was lost en route, and we think it may be due to rogue drone action. Regardless, this batch of supplies needs to get through. Lives are depending on it.
messages.zh: 最近一个新建的殖民地还不能自给自足进行生产，它要靠联邦政府进行供给。上次原本要带给它的一批医疗物资半路上丢了，估计是自由无人机搞的鬼。无论如何，这次的物资必须送达。人命关天啊。

messages.en: You destroyed a Serpentis installation before they could use it to hold a hostage.
messages.zh: 你赶在天蛇之前消灭了它们的一个空间设施。

messages.en: Destroy Serpentis station and its guards.
messages.zh: 摧毁天蛇空间站及其守卫力量。

messages.en: The Serpentis Corporation has just kidnapped one of CreoDron's top minds, Dr. Aspasia Castille. Get to their research station first and destroy the structure and its guards before the transport ship arrives.
messages.zh: 天蛇刚绑架了西顿的一位顶尖科学家：埃斯帕西亚·卡斯蒂勒博士。我要你即刻飞往天蛇的研究站，赶在绑架船到达之前把那里的天蛇设施都摧毁掉。

messages.en: Very efficient, {[character]player.name}. If you're willing to take another job from me, I have more details on the location of Aspasia Castille.
messages.zh: 非常高效，{[character]player.name}。如果你愿意再为我完成别的任务，我还能告诉你有关于埃斯帕西亚·卡斯蒂勒更详细的位置信息。

messages.en: Very efficient, {[character]player.name}. If you're willing to take another job from me, I have more details on the location of Aspasia Castille.
messages.zh: 非常高效，{[character]player.name}。如果你愿意再为我完成别的任务，我还能告诉你有关于埃斯帕西亚·卡斯蒂勒更详细的位置信息。

messages.en: The Serpentis Corporation began as a Gallente research firm, developing over time into the notorious drug cartel that they are today. The Serpentis have an ongoing deal with the Angel Cartel to provide protection for various Serpentis research stations. There are substantial bounties issued by the Gallente Federation Navy on any ranking officer in the Serpentis Corporation.
messages.zh: 天蛇军团最初是一个盖伦特研究企业，后来发展成臭名昭著的违规药品供应商。天使与他们狼狈为奸，负责为他们各地的研究所提供安保服务。盖伦特联邦海军已发出了重金悬赏通缉令，要求捉拿天蛇军团里所有的官员。

messages.en: The Serpentis Corporation
messages.zh: 天蛇军团

messages.en: I told you I'd help if you helped me. Well, the Serpentis Corporation has just kidnapped one of CreoDron's top minds, Dr. Aspasia Castille. She was analyzing those drone parts that you recovered earlier. The information she has is critical to figuring out what's going wrong with the drones, but the Serpentis aren't going to let her go without a fight. They're planning to take her to their installation at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to get there first. Destroy their base and the ships guarding it before the transport ship arrives.
messages.zh: 我跟你说过，如果你帮我，那我也会帮你。现在天蛇刚绑架了西顿的一位顶尖科学家：埃斯帕西亚·卡斯蒂勒博士。她之前在分析你取回的一些无人机部件。卡斯蒂勒博士手上掌握的信息对我们找出无人机出问题的缘由至关重要。天蛇是不会轻易放人的。他们现在正把她带往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。我要你即刻飞往那里，赶在绑架船到达之前把那里的天蛇基地炸掉。

messages.en: You retrieved a CreoDron engineer's data.
messages.zh: 你取得了西顿工程师的数据。

messages.en: Retrieve the datacore and return it to Agent Delphine.
messages.zh: 取回数据核心然后把它交给代理人德芬尼。

messages.en: Go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, find the datacore, and bring it back to me. The data is encrypted, but if you succeed, I will give you a copy of any non-classified information related to these drones and point you in the direction of another valuable contact with regards to this research.
messages.zh: 请前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，找到那数据核心然后拿回来给我。这数据核心用了加密措施。如果你能成功完成此任务，我就会给你一份资料，其中包含了所有与这些无人机有关的非机密信息。除此之外，我还会向你透露另一条与此研究相关的重要线索。

messages.en:
I am glad to see you have returned in one piece.

Now it's time for you to decide if you trust me. I have a final mission to offer you, but it's risky for us both.
messages.zh:
很高兴能够看到你安然无恙地回来。

现在如果你相信我，那你就要做个决定。我这儿还有最后一项任务要你做，但这事对我们俩人来说都有点风险。

messages.en:
I am glad to see you have returned in one piece.

Now it's time for you to decide if you trust me. I have a final mission to offer you, but it's risky for us both.
messages.zh:
很高兴能够看到你安然无恙地回来。

现在如果你相信我，那你就要做个决定。我这儿还有最后一项任务要你做，但这事对我们俩人来说都有点风险。

messages.en:
The Guardian Angels are a division of the Angel Cartel occupied with guarding Serpentis space stations. 
The Angel Cartel is the largest and best organized of the space-based criminal factions. The Angels are divided into several groups, each with a distinct function. The Angels recruit members from all the races and are thus not bound to any one zone of operation.
messages.zh: 守护天使是天使集团中专门负责保卫天蛇空间站的一个分支机构。天使集团是宇宙中力量最强，组织最完善的太空犯罪组织。他们旗下有数个职责明确的分支机构。天使的成员来自四面八方，因此他们可以到处为非作歹。

messages.en: Guardian Angels
messages.zh: 守护天使

messages.en:
I'm glad you contacted me, {[character]player.name}.

Since you destroyed the Serpentis research station, the transport ship headed to another location to make the transfer. Though we were able to intercept, both ships were lost in the course of the ensuing battle. However, we believe a datacore containing Dr. Castille's notes may still exist.

Your task is to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, locate the datacore, and bring it back to me.

Be warned, all indications are that the ship was contracted by the Guardian Angels as part of their protection agreement with the Serpentis Corporation. I'm sure they'll send a ship to scan the wreckage and see what can be salvaged as well. They will be looking for some way to recoup part of their loss.
messages.zh:
我很高兴你来找我，{[character]player.name}。

你把那天蛇研究站毁了之后，那运输船就转投另一个地点去了。虽然我们后来把它给半路截下，但最终结果却是两败俱伤。不过我们相信存有卡斯蒂勒博士笔记的数据核心应该还在。

你的任务就是飞往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，找到那数据核心然后拿回来给我。

不过我要提醒你，守护天使与天蛇是有防务协议的，他们肯定会派船去现场勘查。他们也想尽量挽回点损失。

messages.en: You took the Creodrone data and delivered it to a Caldari scientist, Immuri Asaka.
messages.zh: 你把西顿无人机的数据交给了加达里的一位工程师，爱慕里·阿萨卡。

messages.en: Deliver the data to Immuri Asaka.
messages.zh: 将数据交给爱慕里·阿萨卡。

messages.en: You have been hired to transport a container of drone components and research files from Federation Space to Agent Delphine's contact in the Caldari State.
messages.zh: 你受雇去将一箱无人机部件及研究资料从联邦领域运达加达里，交给代理人德芬尼的线人。

messages.en: Welcome to the Caldari State. I must thank you for delivering that information from Ms. Xarasier. It will help us a great deal.
messages.zh: 欢迎来到加达里合众国。谢谢你将扎拉希小姐掌握的数据告诉我。这一定能派上大用场。

messages.en: Welcome to the Caldari State. I must thank you for delivering that information from Ms. Xarasier. It will help us a great deal.
messages.zh: 欢迎来到加达里合众国。谢谢你转交来自扎拉希小姐的数据资料。这一定会帮我们大忙。

messages.en: Caldari Prime is the homeworld of the Caldari people. It was claimed and occupied by the Gallente Federation for nearly two centuries, until recent actions by then-head of State Tibus Heth temporarily brought it back under Caldari control. The Gallente eventually loosened his grip on the planet, which is currently being monitored by the (relatively) impartial Mordu's Legion.
messages.zh: 加达里首星是加达里人的家园。但盖伦特联邦却占据了它近2个世纪，直到最近，在加达里前领袖提波斯·赫特的带领下，该星球才暂时重归加达里人的怀抱。盖伦特最终削弱了赫特的对该星球的掌控。该行星现由（相对而言的）中立方莫德团监管。

messages.en: Recent Gallente-Caldari Relations
messages.zh: 最近加盖关系情况

messages.en:
The datacore you recovered has proved interesting. Before her kidnapping, Dr. Castille found several oddities in the drone components. Honestly, it's created more questions than answers for CreoDron staff. As a sign of good faith, I'm going to share some information with you. Our drones are being corrupted by some other kind of drone. I need you to take some information to a friend of mine in Caldari space. They've also been suffering from drone problems recently, and this data may help him and his people. I need you to keep this quiet: Our friendship isn't exactly something we're broadcasting, not with both of our empires at each other's throats.

If you agree, I'll make sure the information is securely hidden onboard your ship. You'll never even know it's there; all you have to do is go and talk to Immuri Asaka, and he'll take care of the rest.
messages.zh:
你拿回的数据核心很有趣。在卡斯蒂勒博士遭绑架之前，她发现无人机部件中有几处异样。说真的，西顿的人觉得疑团是越来越大。出于诚心，我不妨向你透露几点信息。我们的无人机遭受了其他种类无人机的侵袭。我要你给我加达里的一个朋友带点资料去。他们最近也遭受了无人机问题，这数据资料或许能帮上他们的忙。这件事情你要低调进行：在目前两国敌对状态下，我们和这个的朋友关系是绝对不能张扬出去的。

如果你答应，那我就保证用很好地保密措施把数据放到你船上。我不会留下任何蛛丝马迹；你只要去那里，找爱慕里·阿萨卡就行，他会处理接下来的事。

messages.en: Shadow Puppets
messages.zh: 影子傀儡

messages.en: You scouted a drone hive and reported back to Immuri Asaka.
messages.zh: 你侦查了无人机母巢并向爱慕里·阿萨卡做了报告。

messages.en: Scout out the drone hive and report back on friendly vessels.
messages.zh: 侦查无人机母巢然后向友军报告。

messages.en: We are currently dealing with the same drone corruption Xarasier described. I need you to scout out the situation on the front lines personally. Fly over there and make sure that things are being adequately contained. If they aren't, report back to me.
messages.zh: 我们正在调查扎拉希报告的那种无人机侵蚀问题。我要你亲自去现场勘查一下，看看问题是不是已经得到了控制。如果没有就赶快回来向我报告。

messages.en: Then it's as I feared. Thank you for the report, {[character]player.name}. I'll need you again in just a moment, if you're still free to work.
messages.zh: 正如我所担心的一样。谢谢你的报告，{[character]player.name}。如果你接下来有空，我还有事要你帮忙。

messages.en: Then it's as I feared. Thank you for the report, {[character]player.name}. I'll need you again in just a moment, if you're still free to work.
messages.zh: 正如我所担心的一样。谢谢你的报告，{[character]player.name}。如果你接下来有空，我还有事要你帮忙。

messages.en: The Caldari are very protective of their way of life and tolerate only those foreigners that stick to the rules. Almost any time the Gallente seek to influence events inside the State, the Caldari are swift to label it as nothing less than a violation of their sovereignty. The Caldari paid a huge cost fighting the Federation, losing millions of people between the exodus from Caldari Prime and the war itself.
messages.zh: 加达里人非常重视保护他们固有的生活方式，只有愿意接受那些遵守他们生活规则的外国人。只要盖伦特试图向加达里施加影响，加达里就会说盖伦特不尊重其主权。加达里在与盖伦特的战斗中付出了损失百万人的巨大代价。

messages.en: Battle Scars
messages.zh: 战争伤疤

messages.en:
We've been dealing with the same drone corruption described by Xarasier. We've managed to contain the contaminated ones inside a deadspace pocket, but that is only a temporary solution.

I need you to scout out the situation personally. I've been trying to get updates from my colleague in the field, but apparently she is having trouble getting clearance for outside communication. Fly over there and make sure the drones are still adequately contained. If they aren't, report back to me. Do not enter into any confrontations with the security forces attempting to contain the drones. Am I clear?
messages.zh:
我们正在调查扎拉希报告的那种无人机侵蚀问题。我们虽然把无人机限制在了一个死亡空间里，但那只是权宜之计。

我要你亲自去现场勘查。我本来是想听我一个同事汇报的，但她好像没有对外通信的权限。你现在就去那里，看看无人机是否都被控制住了。如果没有就赶快回来向我报告。千万别和负责控制无人机的安保部队发生冲突，听到没有？

messages.en: You destroyed a group of mercenaries for Immuri Asaka.
messages.zh: 你为爱慕里·阿萨卡消灭了一队雇佣军。

messages.en: Kill the mercenaries protecting the Guristas facility then report back to Immuri Asaka.
messages.zh: 干掉保护古斯塔斯设施的雇佣军，然后返回向爱慕里·阿萨卡报告。

messages.en:
We can't go after Vitamala directly. Even though he doesn't really have a clue about what he's doing, he's too well-connected to displace without good reason. I'd expect this sort of thing from the Gallente, but not in the State. A man achieves rank because of his hard work and dedication, not because his father has friends in the bureaucracy. There is another commander I can reassign. The first difficulty is in freeing up his schedule.

He's currently on deployment in a nearby system, busy dealing with a mercenary force we believe to be funded by Guristas Pirates. If you can take out all of the Guristas ships, then I can arrange to have him reassigned to the drone problem.
messages.zh:
我们不能与维塔玛拉硬碰硬。虽然他现在脑子发昏，但如果没有一个好理由，我们是无法把这种有良好裙带关系的人赶下台的。我还以为这样的事只会在盖伦特发生，我们这里是绝不会沾染这种事情的。一个人应该靠能力与勤奋出头，怎么能靠朋友官僚入仕途呢？

看样子我们得找另一位有能力、有责任心的人来顶替他的工作才行。首先我们得帮这位能人卸下目前的肩头责任。如果你能帮忙，我就能搞定行政方面的事情把他给调来。

他现在附近一个星系对付古斯塔斯派去的雇佣军。如果你能干掉所有的古斯塔斯船，那我就能让他接手无人机问题。

messages.en: I'm pleased to inform you that everything went smoothly with the transfer. One of the first things our new commander did was to request frigate and cruiser backup for his fleet. They should be capable of defending themselves if the drones try to fight their way out.
messages.zh: 我想告诉你关于职位调动的事情现在一切进行的都还顺利。新来的长官做的头几件事情之一就是为这支舰队申请护卫舰和巡洋舰后备力量。这样当那些无人机想要突围的时候，他们就能很好的防御了。

messages.en: I'm pleased to inform you that everything went smoothly with the transfer. One of the first things our new commander did was to request frigate and cruiser backup for his fleet. They should be capable of defending themselves if the drones try to fight their way out.
messages.zh: 我想告诉你关于职位调动的事情现在一切进行的都还顺利。新来的长官做的头几件事情之一就是为这支舰队申请护卫舰和巡洋舰后备力量。这样当那些无人机想要突围的时候，他们就能很好的防御了。

messages.en: The Guristas Pirates have been a thorn in the side of the Caldari State for many years, constantly threatening the security of outlying systems and poorly defended convoys. The Guristas tend to shy away from prolonged and overt assaults, preferring instead to take down weaker prey during opportunistic raids.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯海盗是加达里合众国多年的眼中钉，他们不停地骚扰加达里边境及守卫薄弱的护航队。古斯塔斯欺强怕弱，属于打一枪就跑的类型。

messages.en: The Guristas Pirates
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯海盗

messages.en:
The situation we have is a delicate one. We can't go after Vitamala directly. Even though he doesn't really have a clue about what he's doing, he's too well-connected to displace without good reason. I'd expect this sort of thing from the Gallente, but not in the State. A man achieves rank because of his hard work and dedication, not because his father has friends in the bureaucracy.

Someone else can help with this situation, a true warrior and dutiful servant of the State. The first difficulty is in freeing up his schedule. If you can handle that part, I can deal with the paperwork for his reassignment.

He's currently on deployment in a nearby system, busy dealing with a mercenary force we believe to be funded by Guristas Pirates. If you can take out all of the Guristas ships, then I can arrange to have him reassigned to the drone problem.
messages.zh:
事情有点微妙。我们不能与维塔玛拉硬碰硬。虽然他现在脑子发昏，但如果没有一个好理由，我们是无法把这种有良好裙带关系的人赶下台的。我还以为这样的事只会在盖伦特发生，我们这里是绝不会沾染这种事情的。一个人应该靠能力与勤奋出头，怎么能靠朋友官僚入仕途呢？

看样子我们得找另一位有能力、有责任心的人来顶替他的工作才行。首先我们得帮这位能人卸下目前的肩头责任。如果你能帮忙，我就能搞定行政方面的事情把他给调来。

他现在附近一个星系对付古斯塔斯派去的雇佣军。如果你能干掉所有的古斯塔斯船，那我就能让他接手无人机问题。

messages.en: You retrieved information on a military commander from the House of Records.
messages.zh: 你成功地从国家档案所中取得了与那个指挥官有关的信息。

messages.en: Visit the House of Records archives and return with information on the military commander.
messages.zh: 请前去国家档案所，把与那个指挥官有关的信息都带回来。

messages.en:
I need to know more about the commander and why he doesn't seem to know what he's doing. I have a friend named Nachi Koruda working for the House of Records who should have those answers.

Fly over to the archives facility where she works and return to me with anything that might offer some explanations. It isn't glamorous work, but it needs to be done if we want to make informed decisions about how to proceed.
messages.zh:
我要了解那指挥官的更多背景，我要知道他为什么看上去连自己在干什么都不清楚。我有个朋友叫纳奇·克弩达，她在国家档案所工作，应该能提供我要的信息。

现在就去她工作的档案所那里为我带回一些有价值的信息。这不是什么特别伟大的任务，但如果我们想清晰计划我们下一步的行动方案，那这一步就必须得先做好。

messages.en: This says Vitamala got to his position thanks to family connections. Bad news for us.
messages.zh: 这么说维塔玛拉是靠家族关系爬到现在位置的，这对我们不是好消息。

messages.en: This says Vitamala got to his position thanks to family connections. Bad news for us.
messages.zh: 这么说维塔玛拉是靠家族关系爬到现在位置的，这对我们不是好消息。

messages.en:
The situation has gotten complicated. That current security deployment won't last long against those drones. The local commander, Vitimala, seems happy just to contain the drones, but that only buys the little bastards more time to escape or supplement their numbers.

I need to know more about the commander and why he doesn't seem to know what he's doing. I have a friend named Nachi Koruda working for the House of Records who should have those answers.

Fly over to the archives facility where she works and return to me with anything that might offer some explanations. It isn't glamorous work, but it needs to be done if we want to make informed decisions about how to proceed.
messages.zh:
事情变复杂了，现在的防御部署没法长时间抵抗无人机的攻击。那本地指挥官，维塔玛拉，好像觉得把无人机的活动限制住就行了。这不行的，这只会让那帮无人机有机会逃匿或者补充兵员。

我要了解这个指挥官的更多背景，我要知道他为什么看上去连自己在干什么都不清楚。我有个朋友叫纳奇·克弩达，她在国家档案所工作，应该能提供我要的信息。

现在就去她工作的档案所那里为我带回一些有价值的信息。这不是什么特别伟大的任务，但如果我们想清晰计划我们下一步的行动方案，那这一步就必须得先做好。

name.ru: Экономика под угрозой (An Economy Under Threat)

messages.en: You delivered farming supplies to a storage warehouse.
messages.zh: 你将耕作用具送到了仓库。

messages.en: Deliver the farming supplies to the storage warehouse.
messages.zh: 将耕作用具送到仓库去。

messages.en: Vitamala wasn't coordinating with the Navy's emergency logistics division. There's a colony nearby that missed a shipment of farming supplies thanks to the chaos caused by these drones. If we don't make the delivery ourselves, then we risk their entire agricultural economy. Once you take these goods over to them directly, we can turn our focus on the underlying cause for these problems. <font color = #EE3B3B>You will need at least 150m3 of cargo space to make the delivery. </font>
messages.zh: 维塔玛拉根本就没与海军的紧急后勤部门合作。就因为这些无人机的阻扰，附近一个殖民地没能收到我们送过去的农作物。如果我们就这样袖手旁观，那我们整个农业经济就会遭受威胁。你现在只要把这些物资交给舰队，剩下的事他们自己会处理；之后我们就会有精力找出这一切背后的原因了。

messages.en: Yes, I just received word from the colony. They should be able to stick to their production schedule, which is great news. Thank you, {[character]player.name}, you've done the Caldari people a great service today. If you need any further help with your drone investigation, just say the word.
messages.zh: 是的，我刚刚接到殖民站那边传来的消息。他们应该能够保证生产计划的完成，这对我们来说是非常好的消息。感谢你，{[character]player.name}，今天你为加达里人民做了一件好事。如果你对无人机的调查需要任何帮助，尽管告诉我。

messages.en: Yes, I just received word from the colony. They should be able to stick to their production schedule, which is great news. Thank you, {[character]player.name}, you've done the Caldari people a great service today. If you need any further help with your drone investigation, just say the word.
messages.zh: 是的，我刚刚接到殖民站那边传来的消息。他们应该能够保证生产计划的完成，这对我们来说是非常好的消息。感谢你，{[character]player.name}，今天你为加达里人民做了一件好事。如果你对无人机的调查需要任何帮助，尽管告诉我。

messages.en: Despite the existence of several popular political ideologies, financial concerns are the primary driving force among the Caldari people. Although the Federation often tries to paint the Caldari as soulless capitalists, most Caldari view any economic concerns as an extension of their pragmatic mindset, not as an inherent love for money.
messages.zh: 尽管加达里人民有着不同的政治理念，但财富永远是他们的原动力。盖伦特经常借题发挥，把加达里人妖魔化成没人性的资本家。不过加达里人还是坚持认为他们对财富的追求是务实的追求，绝非贪婪所致。

messages.en: The Caldari Mindset
messages.zh: 加达里的思维方式

messages.en:
Damn Vitamala! He wasn't coordinating with the Navy's emergency logistics division. There's a colony nearby that missed a shipment of farming supplies thanks to the chaos caused by these drones. If we don't make the delivery ourselves, then we risk their entire agricultural economy. Once you take these goods over to our fleet, they will deal with the rest; we can finally turn our focus towards the underlying cause of all these problems.  

<font color = #EE3B3B>You will need at least 150m3 of cargo space to make the delivery. Keep that in mind.</font>
messages.zh: 该死的维塔玛拉！他根本就没有真正的与海军紧急后勤部门通力合作。就因为这些无人机的阻扰，附近的一个殖民地没收到我们送过去的农作物。如果我们就这样袖手旁观，那我们整个农业经济就会遭受威胁。你现在只要把这些物资交给舰队，剩下的事他们自己会处理；之后我们就会有精力找出这一切背后的原因了。

name.fr: Une certaine idée de la terreur

messages.en: You re-established contact with Sister Alitura.
messages.zh: 你已经与阿里桃拉修女重新取得了联系。

messages.en: You need to contact Sister Alitura.
messages.zh: 你需要与阿里桃拉修女取得联系。

messages.en: Sister Alitura has asked for your help right away. Take this transponder beacon with you when you leave; that way I can know you've arrived safely.
messages.zh: 阿里桃拉修女要你立刻去帮忙。走的时候把这跟踪器带上；这样我就能知道你是否安全到达了。

messages.en: Thank you for coming so quickly. We need your help.
messages.zh: 谢谢你迅速赶来。我们需要你帮忙。

messages.en: Thank you for coming so quickly. We need your help.
messages.zh: 谢谢你迅速赶来。我们需要你帮忙。

messages.en: I've just been contacted by Sister Alitura – she wants you to get back in touch with her right away. Here, take this transponder beacon with you when you leave; that way I can know you've arrived safely.
messages.zh: 阿里桃拉修女刚和我联系了一下——她要你立即与她取得联系。拿着，走的时候把这跟踪器带上；这样我就能知道你是否安全到达了。

messages.en: You destroyed a swarm of drones to establish a quarantine area.
messages.zh: 你消灭了一大群无人机，并建立起了一个隔离区。

messages.en: Neutralize every drone inside the quarantine area.
messages.zh: 消灭隔离区的所有无人机。

messages.en:
Normally, the local security forces would want to handle this drone threat themselves, but we're willing to contract the job out to a capsuleer. You'll have to go in alone while our fleet holds the line.

I suggest you take some friends into the fight. The drones have been growing in number as more are corrupted and somehow find their way to the swarm. If you manage to neutralize the threat, then perhaps you will find something amongst the wreckage that offers some further clue.
messages.zh:
正常情况下，本地的安保部队会自己处理无人机问题，但我们想把这事承包给一个克隆飞行员。

你要自己去对付这帮无人机，我们的舰队将在后方守候。我建议你最好叫上些朋友一起去。已经有越来越多的无人机遭到侵蚀，它们都向老巢聚集去了。你把无人机清理完后，要注意寻找能提供调查线索的东西。

messages.en: Thank you for taking care of that drone problem. A capsuleer like you may not consider it a big achievement, but trust me, you've done what few others could. You clearly have a great future ahead of you. I hope you continue to use that talent to do good things, either within the State or elsewhere.
messages.zh: 谢谢你解决了无人机问题。像你这样的飞行员可能觉得此事没什么了不起，但请相信我，能完成此事的人真的不多。你前途光明，希望你能再接再厉，继续为合众国效力。

messages.en: Thank you for taking care of that drone problem. A capsuleer like you may not consider it a big achievement, but trust me, you've done what few other could. You clearly have a great future ahead of you. I hope you continue to use that talent to do good things, either within the State or elsewhere.
messages.zh: 谢谢你解决了无人机问题。像你这样的飞行员可能觉得此事没什么了不起，但请相信我，能完成此事的人真的不多。你前途光明，希望你能再接再厉，继续为合众国效力。

messages.en:
Normally, the local security forces would want to handle this drone threat themselves, but we're willing to contract the job out to a capsuleer.

You'll have to go in alone while our fleet holds the line. I suggest you take some friends into the fight. The drones have been growing in number as more are corrupted and somehow find their way to the swarm.

Once you neutralize the threat, you should search the wreckage for something that will help with your investigation.
messages.zh:
正常情况下，本地的安保部队会自己处理无人机问题，但我们想把这事承包给一个克隆飞行员。

你要自己去对付这帮无人机，我们的舰队将在后方守候。我建议你最好叫上些朋友一起去。已经有越来越多的无人机遭到侵蚀，它们都聚集到老巢去了。

你把无人机清理完后，要注意寻找能提供调查线索的东西。

messages.en: Queens and Drones
messages.zh: 无人机和女皇们

messages.en: You successfully saved the personnel of the Food Relief station, but the mysterious drone escaped.
messages.zh: 你成功地从粮食救济会空间站中营救出了被困人员，但是那个神秘的无人机溜掉了。

messages.en: Save the personnel of a Food Relief station.
messages.zh: 拯救粮食救济会空间站里的人员。

messages.en: The rogue drone you have been looking for was seen in a deadspace pocket near a Food Relief production station, building a swarm of drones. Sister Alitura thinks the swarm is going to try and destroy that station. Save the people, either by evacuating the station or wiping out the swarm. Bring the fifteen survivors back to the Sister.
messages.zh: 你寻找的那个无人机在粮食救济会空间站附近的一个死亡空间里出现过，它正在那儿大量的制造无人机群。阿里桃拉修女认为那无人机打算摧毁整座空间站。你要帮助它们，要么把站里人员都撤走，要么把那无人机群清理掉。最后还要把15位幸存者带回修女那里。

messages.en: Bless you for saving those people. I know you didn't do this out of charity, but your help is appreciated anyway. You have been paid, but when you're ready, I have another lead on this drone.
messages.zh: 谢谢你救了这些人一命。我知道你不是为了慈善才这么做，但我们还是要感谢你。我已经把钱付给你了。等你再次准备好后，我会告诉你有关这个无人机的另一线索。

messages.en: Bless you for saving those people. I know you didn't do this out of charity, but your help is appreciated anyway. You have been paid, but when you're ready, I have another lead on this drone.
messages.zh: 谢谢你救了这些人一命。我知道你不是为了慈善才这么做，但我们还是要感谢你。我已经把钱付给你了。等你再次准备好后，我会告诉你有关这个无人机的另一线索。

messages.en: The Food Relief corporation is owned and run by the Sisters of EVE. Food Relief (FR) is ostensibly responsible for delivering necessities (primarily food and medicine) to people in need in any empire. FR have never officially withheld their deliveries, but in recent times there have been occasions where their medicine drops were delayed or reduced due to unforeseen environmental conditions or a sudden outbreak of hostility on their caravan routes. Some political analysts maintain that these delays indirectly affected the outcomes of other factions' military campaigns.
messages.zh: 粮食救济会是姐妹会旗下所属机构。该公司主要负责向帝国区里需要救济的人发放食品、药品之类的必需品。粮食救济公司虽然从来没有正式扣押过任何救济物资，但最近却时常有传出救济不及时或不足量的消息，原因很有可能是自然条件限制或遭遇敌方偷袭所致。一些政治评论家说这种情况已间接影响到了势力战争的走向。

messages.en: Food Relief Corporation
messages.zh: 粮食救济公司

messages.en:
The rogue drone you and I both want has been spotted in a deadspace pocket near one of our stations, building a swarm of drones. I think it's going to try and destroy that station. There are fifteen people on that expedition-- bring them all back home safely.

You have a chance here to save some lives and deal with that drone once and for all.
messages.zh:
我们已经在一座空间站附近的死亡空间里看到了你我都在找的那个无人机，它正在那儿大量的制造无人机群。我看它是想摧毁整座空间站。那空间站里有我们15个人在勘察，你去把他们统统救回来。

这是个让你救人做善事的机会，你要把握机会，把那无人机彻底清理掉。

name.es: Tras el rastro de la reina (parte 1)

messages.en: You were able to rescue a Gallente reporter named Corin Risia, who led you to the station where he stashed the data.
messages.zh: 你找到了盖伦特记者克林·里西亚，此人又带你去了他存放数据的空间站。

messages.en: Rescue a Gallente reporter named Corin Risia in order to get some tracking data on the rogue drone.
messages.zh: 为获得自由无人机的追踪数据，前去搜救盖伦特记者克林·里西亚。

messages.en:
A Scope reporter named Corin Risia managed to get some tracking data off the drone two days ago. He's willing to sell the data in exchange for extracting him from Mordu's Legion space, as he believes the Legion wants to kill him. Go to Mordu's outpost and extract Corin Risia. He's afraid for his life, so expect anything.

If you want to avoid a confrontation with Mordu's Legion, prepare for a stealth mission. Otherwise, there's a good chance you may have to blast your way out of the situation.
messages.zh:
视角传媒一位名叫克林·里西亚的记者两天前得到了无人机的追踪数据。他认为莫德团要干掉他，如果我们能把他救出来，他就愿意把数据卖给我们。你现在去莫德团的哨站把他给带出来。他怕死，所以你要当心那里的守卫。

如果你不想与莫德团交火，那就要隐秘行事。否则你就只有跟人火并了。

messages.en: Risia said to thank you for the lift.
messages.zh: 里西亚感谢你把他带了出来。

messages.en: Risia said to thank you for the lift.
messages.zh: 里西亚感谢你把他带了出来。

messages.en: The Legion, mostly consisting of old Caldari veterans from the war with the Federation and young hotheads eager for action, is the largest and most famous mercenary corps in New Eden. They accept members from any race, as long as they are not known enemies of the Caldari State, and non-Caldari that have served in the Legion for a long time are offered Caldari citizenship on their retirement. The Legion is often employed by governments to settle issues that are not directly under anyone's jurisdiction, especially when fast deployment and swift results are needed. Their reputation as combat experts as well as fair and honest warriors has never been tarnished.
messages.zh: 莫德团是宇宙中名气最响、规模最大的雇佣军。他们的成员大多是来自盖伦特加达里战争时期的老兵及现有的热血青年。只要不是加达里的敌人，任何人都可以加入莫德团。非加达里人在莫德团退休之后还可转变为加达里公民。政府机构经常在不便于动用国家军队的情况下雇请莫德团来帮他们解决冲突，尤其是在需要立即产生结果的情况下。莫德团的公平诚信精神一直受众人推崇。

messages.en: Mordu's Legion
messages.zh: 莫德团

messages.en:
A Scope reporter named Corin Risia managed to get some tracking data off the drone two days ago; the holos you got allowed him to confirm that it's the same drone. He's willing to sell us the data in exchange for extracting him from a Mordu's Legion outpost. Mordu's Legion are generally an honest group, but for some reason Risia needs to get out of there quickly. He thinks the Legion wants to kill him.

Go to Mordu's outpost and extract Corin Risia. He's afraid for his life, so expect anything.
messages.zh:
视角传媒一位名叫克林·里西亚的记者两天前得到了无人机的追踪数据。他看了你获得的全息图像，确认确实是我们要找的无人机。他愿意把数据卖给我们，前提是我们把他从莫德团哨站里救出来。莫德团虽说是个诚信组织，但里西亚就是想逃得越远越好。他认为莫德团要干掉他。

你现在去莫德团的哨站把他给带出来。他怕死，所以你要当心那里的守卫。

messages.en: You acquired data on the drone left by one of the Sisters of EVE near the edge of Gurista space, and brought it back to Sister Alitura. She processed it to give you some leads to finding the rogue drone.
messages.zh: 你从古斯塔斯边境获取了无人机数据然后把它交给了阿里桃拉修女。她接下来告诉你一些有助于找到那自由无人机的线索。

messages.en: Pick up data from a canister near the edge of Gurista space and bring it back to Sister Alitura.
messages.zh: 去古斯塔斯边境取得数据箱，然后把它交给阿里桃拉修女。

messages.en: One of the Sisters of EVE immediately recognized the drone and was able to download her scanning data from her ship. However, she's on the edge of Guristas space and can't broadcast the data. Pick up the data from a canister near the edge of the pirate's space and bring it back to Sister Alitura.
messages.zh: 一位姐妹会修女立即认出了那无人机并且从船上下载了扫描数据。不过她身处古斯塔斯边境区域，无法把数据传给我们。去那帮海盗的边境处，取得数据箱把它交给阿里桃拉修女。

messages.en: You continue to surprise me, {[character]player.name}. Give me a moment to process this data, and then we can discuss our strategy.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你真让我喜出望外。给我点时间让我先处理一下这数据，然后我们再探讨下一步战略。

messages.en: You continue to surprise me, {[character]player.name}. Give me a moment to process this data, and then we can discuss our strategy.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你真让我喜出望外。给我点时间让我先处理一下这数据，然后我们再探讨下一步战略。

messages.en: The Guristas are probably the largest pirate faction in New Eden. They are infamous for their raids into civilized territory, something that very few pirate clans are willing or able to do. The mission of these raids is most often simply to steal cargo or passengers from freighters for ransom, but on numerous occasions their main intention seems to be to sabotage empire installations (mining facilities, sentry guns, and the like). This has led to speculations that some unscrupulous empire companies (or even governments) are hiring the Guristas to take out property of the competition.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯或许是新伊甸中规模最大的海盗组织。他们时常进犯帝国区，让人闻风丧胆。能这样做或者愿意这样做的海盗组织基本上没几个。多数时候，这帮海盗只是争抢物资，或者扣押人质，敲诈勒索。但在某些时候，他们好像就是瞄准帝国设施（矿场、岗哨炮之类）去的。这不禁让人怀疑，是不是帝国中有些不法军团（甚至政府）出钱让古斯塔斯去搞垮对手？

messages.en: The Guristas
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯

messages.en: I have a plan to help us track the rogue drone down. Up until now, we haven't had a chance to get a good look at the damned thing. The good news is that one of my Sisters was able to get holopics and scans of the drone that will help us  track it down. The bad news is that she's doing missionary work near Guristas space. She can't broadcast the data to us without raising suspicion from the pirates, so she's going to leave a canister with the data as close to the edge of their space as she can. I need you to get that data and bring it back to me.
messages.zh: 我有个计划可以帮我们追踪到自由无人机的踪迹。之前我们一直没有机会好好观察那该死的东西。现在好消息是我们的一位修女经获得了这些无人机的全息图片和扫描图片，这能帮助我们追踪到它们的踪迹。坏消息是她现身在古斯塔斯领域附近。她如果向我们传送数据，那古斯塔斯一定会起疑心的。所以她会把数据放入一个箱子里，然后把它留在古斯塔斯领域边际区域。我要你去把那数据箱拿来带给我。

messages.en: You chose which side to work with.
messages.zh: 你选择了合作对象。

messages.en: You must decide whether to work with the Gallente reporter Corin Risia or the Caldari mercenary Wolf Burgan.
messages.zh: 你必须选择是与盖伦特记者克林·里西亚合作还是找加达里雇佣兵沃夫·巴尔干帮忙。

messages.en: Sister Alitura has two leads. One is a Gallente reporter who claims to have tracked the drone after you were near the Food Relief station. Another is a Caldari mercenary spy who says he has a formula that can help you scan for the drone. You can only choose one option.
messages.zh: 阿里桃拉修女现有两条线索。一是那个盖伦特记者，他声称他在你去过那粮食救济会空间站后就找到了无人机；另一个是加达里的雇佣间谍，他说有办法帮你扫描到那个无人机。两者你只能选其一。

messages.en: As you continue to work with one empire over the other, you will gain favor with that empire and lose it with the other. Even simple decisions can lead to gaining standing with one faction and losing it with another.
messages.zh: 当你在为一个帝国效力的时候，这个帝国自然会高兴，但其对手就会对你产生不满。有时看似很简单的决定也会导致取悦一方激怒另一方。

messages.en: Picking Sides
messages.zh: 明确立场

messages.en: While you were acquiring the data, I found two leads. One is a Gallente reporter who claims to have tracked the drone after you were near the Food Relief station. Another is a Caldari mercenary spy who says he has a formula that can help you scan for the drone. Both offers are time-sensitive, and we have to pick one now. I leave the choice to you: Which do you want to pursue?
messages.zh: 在你拿数据的时候，我找到两条线索。一是那个盖伦特记者，他声称他在你去过那粮食救济会空间站后就找到了无人机；另一个是加达里的雇佣间谍，他说有办法帮你扫描到那个无人机。这两个任务对时间要求都很紧，我们现在只能选一个。你决定吧，要哪个？

messages.en: Work with the Gallente reporter.
messages.zh: 与盖伦特记者合作。

messages.en: Work with the Caldari spy.
messages.zh: 与加达里间谍合作。

messages.en: You retrieved the DNA of mercenary Wolf Burgan, for use in making a clone.
messages.zh: 你获取了可用来造克隆的雇佣兵沃夫·巴尔干的DNA。

messages.en: Retrieve Wolf Burgan's DNA.
messages.zh: 获取沃夫·巴尔干的DNA。

messages.en:
The Serpentis want Wolf Burgan's head in a bad way. Wolf may be a great captain, but he's not a capsuleer. If he croaks, there's no resurrection. The Serpentis know it.

We're going to use this to our advantage. Thanks to a previous indictment, the local law at a nearby station has a sample of Wolf's DNA. You should have no trouble getting access to it just by virtue of being a capsuleer. Bring me Wolf's DNA sample, and I can hatch my crazy scheme.
messages.zh:
现在天蛇要沃夫·巴尔干的人头。他可能是个好队长，但他可不是个克隆飞行员。如果他死了，那肯定不能复生。天蛇很清楚地知道这点。

我们也打算利用这一点。好在这家伙还吃过官司，位于附近空间站里的一个执法机构手上握有沃夫的DNA采样。你是克隆飞行员，拿到那DNA问题应该不大。快去把那东西拿给我，好让我继续我的疯狂计划。

messages.en: Let me just rush this over to the medlab...there. The body should be here in a minute.
messages.zh: 我速去速回。一分钟后你就能看到那身体。

messages.en: Let me just rush this over to the medlab...there. The body should be here in a minute.
messages.zh: 我速去速回。一分钟后你就能看到那身体。

messages.en:
Before we get the mercenary's help, we need to get him out of a jam.

This guy goes by the name “Wolf Burgan”. Yeah, it's stupid, but I'm willing to cut him slack because he's a damn good tracker. Wolf's been all over the universe and hunted damn near everything at some point.

You don't get that good without making a few enemies. Right now the Serpentis want his head in a bad way. Wolf may be a great captain, but he's not a capsuleer. If he croaks, there's no resurrection. The Serpentis know it.

We're going to use this to our advantage. Thanks to a previous indictment, the local law at a nearby station has a sample of Wolf's DNA. You should have no trouble getting access to it just by virtue of being a capsuleer. Bring me Wolf's DNA sample, and I can hatch my crazy scheme.
messages.zh:
在得到雇佣军的协助之前，我们必须先帮住一个人脱离险境。

这家伙用了一个叫做“沃夫·巴尔干”的名字。是的，我知道这名字听起来很傻，但他的追踪能力很强，所以就别去管那些琐事了。沃夫的足迹遍布全宇宙，基本上什么样的东西他都追踪过。

像他这样的强人肯定得罪了不少人。现在天蛇要砍他的人头。沃夫可能是个好队长，但他不是克隆飞行员。如果他死了，那肯定不能复生。天蛇很清楚地知道这点。

我们也打算利用这一点。多亏这家伙还吃过官司，位于附近空间站里的一个执法机构手上握有沃夫的DNA采样。你是克隆飞行员，拿到那DNA问题应该不大。快去把那东西拿给我，好让我继续我的疯狂计划。

name.es: Tras el rastro de la reina (parte 2)

messages.en: You transported Corin Risia to the Sisters.
messages.zh: 你把里西亚带到了姐妹会那里。

messages.en: You are to transport Corin Risia to the Sisters.
messages.zh: 你要带里西亚去姐妹会那里。

messages.en: You have rescued Corin Risia from Mordu's Legion, and now he needs to deliver his goods to the Sisters. Take him to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where he can transmit the drone's tracking data.</font>
messages.zh: 你已经将克林·里西亚从莫德团手中救出，现在他要把东西交给姐妹会的人。带他去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，他将在那里传送无人机的数据。</font>

messages.en: Risia said to thank you for the lift.
messages.zh: 里西亚感谢你把他带了出来。

messages.en: Thanks. That was the easy part.
messages.zh: 谢谢。这事还算简单。

messages.en: That was close. At least Corin's out of danger for the moment. We really want the tracking data for this drone. Luckily, he hid the data in a secure place. Can I trust you to take him to his hideout in a nearby station so he can transfer the data? Buying and selling information takes time, you know?
messages.zh: 真是太险了，不过克林现在已经脱离了险境。我们真的是非常想要得到这个无人机的追踪数据，还好他把数据放在了一个安全的地方。我想让你送他到他在附近一个空间站里的藏身处，这样他就可以传送这些数据。你知道，买卖信息是很花时间的。

name.es: Tras el rastro de la reina (parte 3)

messages.en: You delivered Risia's data to a secure Sisters of EVE location.
messages.zh: 你将里西亚的数据送到了一个安全的姐妹会地点。

messages.en: You are to deliver Risia's data to a secure Sisters of EVE location.
messages.zh: 递送里西亚的数据到一个安全的姐妹会地点。

messages.en: Take the drone's tracking data to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and drop it off at the requested deadspace location.
messages.zh: 请把数据带往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，运到指定的死亡空间地点。

messages.en: Risia said to thank you for the lift.
messages.zh: 里西亚感谢你把他带了出来。

messages.en: Thank you for the data and protecting our site. On behalf of my fellow Sisters, we are eternally grateful for your endeavors.
messages.zh: 谢谢你给我们数据并守护了我们的驻所。我代表全体姐妹感谢你。

messages.en: Information is the most precious commodity in the EVE Universe. But it comes at many costs: ethical decline, moral malaise, personal extortion, or even bodily harm. Some denizens consider these aspects to be major obstacles; others consider them personal challenges. Those that are successful, though, end up with monetary riches, but at what cost?
messages.zh: 情报是新伊甸中最值钱的东西。但要获取情报，却要付出不菲的代价：道德扭曲、情感颠覆甚至身体伤害。有人越不了这些关；有人觉得难度很大。而那些最终得手的人自然赚了个满盆，不过其中艰辛又有谁知？

messages.en: Knowledge is Money, Money is Power
messages.zh: 知识是钱，钱就是力量

messages.en: Now that we have the data, we can deliver it to a more secure, untraceable Sisters of EVE location. If you could take the data to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, I'd appreciate it. Don't worry, this is completely safe; you'll be fine.
messages.zh: 既然我们已经取得了数据，那就要把它转移到姐妹会一个更安全，别人无法查得的地方。请把数据带往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。别担心，这任务很安全，保你没事。

messages.en: You extracted Wolf Burgan from Gallente space.
messages.zh: 你从盖伦特空域找回了沃夫·巴尔干。

messages.en: Take the cloned corpse to Wolf Burgan and plant it in the wreckage of his ship.
messages.zh: 把仿造的尸体带给沃夫·巴尔干，放在他的舰船残骸里。

messages.en:
There's a small outpost that the Serpentis are convinced Wolf is hiding out in. Take the body and fly it to the outpost. Kill the Serpentis if you feel like it. You're going to place the fake body in the outpost, then fly away. This will activate the timed explosives Burgan planted.

To any observer it should look like you swooped in and took out Burgan yourself, and the charred body with his DNA should sell it.
messages.zh:
天蛇认为沃夫藏身在一座小哨站里，你现在就把这尸体运到那儿去。你可以随意干掉天蛇的海盗，但首要任务是把尸体放入哨站然后撤离。你离开后巴尔干放置的定时炸弹就会引爆。

外人看来这一切就好像是你飞进去然后把巴尔干亲自解决掉了一样。尸体拥有沃夫的DNA，这应该能把他们骗过去。

messages.en: I'm surprised that actually worked. Burgan says the Serpentis bought it. He's ready to help us out.
messages.zh: 我真没想到那还真管用。巴尔干说天蛇那帮家伙被骗过去了，他可以帮我们了。

messages.en: I'm surprised that actually worked. Burgan says the Serpentis bought it. He's ready to help us out.
messages.zh: 我真没想到那还真管用。巴尔干说天蛇那帮家伙被骗过去了，他可以帮我们了。

messages.en:
Yes, the body's done. I had the techs at the cloning lab imprint Wolf Burgan's DNA on one of their blank slabs of biomass. If you were to take a tissue sample, it would come back as one hundred percent Wolf Burgan. Of course, the slab is completely inert and only vaguely human-shaped, but that won't be a problem once we blow it up.

There's a small outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and the Serpentis are convinced that Wolf is hiding out there. Take the body and fly it to the outpost. Kill the Serpentis if you feel like it. You're going to place the fake body in the outpost, then fly away. This will activate the timed explosives Burgan planted.

To any observer it should look like you swooped in and took out Burgan yourself, and the charred body with his DNA should sell it.
messages.zh:
是的，弄好了。我让实验室把沃夫·巴尔干的DNA复制进了一具没有任何记录的尸体，如果对尸体进行采样将会百分之百显示那是沃夫·巴尔干的身体。虽然那尸体并不逼真而且几乎没有人样，但我们反正也要炸了它，所以问题不大。

{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那里有个小哨站，天蛇认为沃夫就藏身在那里。你的任务就是把这具尸体运到那儿去。你可以随意干掉天蛇的海盗，但首要任务是把尸体放入哨站然后撤离。你离开后巴尔干放置的定时炸弹就会引爆。

外人看来这一切就好像是你飞进去然后把巴尔干亲自解决掉了一样。尸体拥有沃夫的DNA，这应该能把他们骗过去。

name.ja: ナイトメアを追跡せよ

messages.en: You followed the drone through some kind of spatial rift.
messages.zh: 你跟随无人机穿过了某种空间裂隙。

messages.en: Check out the hotspots where the drone's been sighted.
messages.zh: 你去那几个经常有无人机出没的地点看看。

messages.en: We've secured Wolf Burgan's aid. Now all you need to do is fly out to a few of the hot spots where the drone has been spotted. Burgan's staying behind, but he'll be connected to your systems remotely. Wolf will update you as the situation changes. Listen to what he says. He'll point you in the right direction.
messages.zh: 我们已经确定能让沃夫·巴尔干帮我们了。你现在要做的就是飞往无人机的几处出没点。巴尔干会留在这里，不过他会和你保持联系。他会随机应变地向你反映情况。到时候注意他跟你说话的内容。沃夫会告诉你应该怎么做。

messages.en:
You followed it through a spatial rift of some sort? They aren't supposed to be able to do that....

Drones, I mean. Now, your next mission.
messages.zh:
你跟着它们穿过了某种空间裂缝？它们应该没法做那种……

我说的“它们”指的是无人机。好了，你马上要接手一项新任务。

messages.en:
You followed it through a spatial rift of some sort? They aren't supposed to be able to do that....

Drones, I mean. Now, your next mission.
messages.zh:
你跟着它们穿过了某种空间裂缝？它们应该没法做那种……

我说的“它们”指的是无人机。好了，你马上要接手一项新任务。

messages.en: We've secured Wolf Burgan's aid. Now all you need to do is fly out to a few of the hot spots where the drone has been spotted. Burgan's staying behind, but he'll be connected to your systems remotely. He'll update you as the situation changes. Listen to what he says. Wolf will point you in the right direction.
messages.zh: 我们已经确定能让沃夫·巴尔干协助我们了。你现在要做的就是飞往无人机的几处出没点。巴尔干会留在这里，不过他会和你保持联系。他会随机应变地向你反映情况。到时候注意他跟你说的内容。沃夫会告诉你应该怎么做。

name.fr: Mettre le feu à la ruche

messages.en: You defeated the swarm of drones, but the lead drone was destroyed by Marihem Dagan.
messages.zh: 你打败了无人机群，但是领头的无人机却被马里恒·哒加恩击毁了。

messages.en: You've been given the location of the drone and its swarm.
messages.zh: 你得到了无人机及其集群的位置信息。

messages.en: Sister Alitura has located where the drone is heading. Do whatever it takes to destroy it.
messages.zh: 阿里桃拉修女已经知道无人机的去向了。尽一切所能去把那无人机干掉。

messages.en: I can't... He's supposed to be dead! Are you telling me Dagan's been alive this whole time?
messages.zh: 真是难以置信……他应该死了呀！难道哒加恩一直活着的？

messages.en: I can't... He's supposed to be dead! Are you telling me Dagan's been alive this whole time?
messages.zh: 真是难以置信……他应该死了呀！难道哒加恩一直活着的？

messages.en: Based on the data you've provided me, I was able to locate where the drone and its swarm is heading: {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Do whatever it takes to destroy it.
messages.zh: 根据你给我的数据，我摸清了那无人机及其集群的去向：{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。尽一切可能把它干掉。

name.ru: За всем надо следить (An Eye on Everything)

messages.en: Shifting Foundations
messages.zh: 基础的变更

messages.en: You investigated a smuggling hub and gained information necessary to crack down on the smugglers.
messages.zh: 你调查了一个非法贩售站并获取了足够破坏非法贩售团伙的情报。

messages.en: Investigate the smuggling hub and report back to Keita Eslin.
messages.zh: 调查一下那个非法贩售站然后回去向凯达·伊瑟琳报告。

messages.en: The missing capsuleer you are looking for has been quite busy recently. He was almost caught smuggling something out of Minmatar space. Help us out, and we'll be there to help when you finally find your prey. Your first step will be to scout one of their major smuggling hubs and report back on the strength of security forces there. Once I have all the information I need, I'll give you the order to fall back.
messages.zh: 你在找的那个失踪的飞行员最近忙得很。他在从米玛塔尔空间向外非法贩售一批物品的时候差点给捉了。帮我们个忙，我们也会帮你找到你想要的人。首先你要做的是去侦查他们主要的非法贩售站，并把有关保安强度的信息报告给我们。一旦我拿到我需要的信息，我会叫你撤离那里。

messages.en: Good work on the recon there. When you're ready to go and do something about those smugglers, you let me know.
messages.zh: 你的侦查任务完成的很不错。等你做好准备去对付这些非法贩售者的时候，就给我打个招呼。

messages.en: Good work on the recon there. When you're ready to go and do something about those smugglers, you let me know.
messages.zh: 你的侦查任务完成的很不错。等你做好准备去对付这些非法贩售者的时候，就给我打个招呼。

messages.en:
The missing capsuleer you are looking for has been quite busy recently, as I'm sure you'll be interested to hear. The Krusual Tribe became aware of his actions just a couple of days ago, when he was caught smuggling something out of Minmatar space. We've seen a few of his accomplices since then, shifting back and forth between Minmatar and Amarr borders.

You want information, we want information. Help us track down his friends, and we'll help you anyway we can when you find your capsuleer. Your first step will be to scout one of their major smuggling hubs and report back what information you can about the strength of security forces there.
messages.zh:
你要找的那个失踪飞行员最近非常的繁忙，我想你一定要想知道他的事情。克鲁夏部族在几天前发现了他的行动，而且在他正将一些东西从米玛塔尔空域非法贩售出来的时候给捉住了。

你和我们都想要得到相关的情报，帮我们找到这个朋友，我们会在你找到你的克隆飞行员的时候尽可能的帮助你。首先你要做的是去侦查他们主要的非法贩售站，并把有关保安强度的信息报告给我们。

messages.en: You delivered surveillance images to agent Tarak Erand.
messages.zh: 你把监控图像交给了代理人塔拉克·依兰德。

messages.en: Deliver the surveillance images to Tarak Erand.
messages.zh: 把监控图像交给塔拉克·依兰德。

messages.en: I need you to take these surveillance captures over to a friend of mine. He'll want to see them before he commits his own forces to the fight. Once he has the information he needs, he'll probably want to send you in first to take out the heaviest security; then his people will follow in to clean up. I hope you're ready for this.
messages.zh: 现在你要把这些监控图像交给我的一个朋友。他要看到这些东西后才会答应派军队加入战斗。当我的朋友得到了他需要的信息之后很可能会先让你去清除最严密的一道防守；然后他的部队就会跟进。

messages.en: Give me a minute. I need a moment to go over this.
messages.zh: 稍微给我点时间。我需要花时间来看看这东西。

messages.en: Give me a minute. I need a moment to go over this.
messages.zh: 稍微给我点时间。我需要花时间来看看这东西。

messages.en: Alright, you'll need to take these surveillance captures over to a friend of mine. He'll want to see them before he commits his own forces to the fight. I'd have sent them over the network, but I'm afraid this mission is completely unauthorized. All of the evidence I've gathered so far has been through methods the Republic Fleet wouldn't turn a blind eye to, so we're reliant on his help.  Once he has the information he needs, he'll probably want to send you in first to take out the heaviest security; then his people will follow in to clean up. Are you ready to commit yourself to this task, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 好，现在你要把这些监控图像交给我的一个朋友。他要看到这些东西后才会答应派军队加入战斗。我本来可以自己通过网络传输这些图像，但这项任务毕竟是没有得到官方授权的。我收集这些证据所采用的手段肯定逃不过共和舰队的监视，所以我们就指望他能帮忙了。当我的朋友得到了他需要的信息之后很可能会先让你去清除最严密的一道防守；然后他的部队就会跟进。你准备好接受这个任务了么，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: You destroyed smuggler forces.
messages.zh: 你摧毁了非法贩售部队。

messages.en: Kill all of the mercenary forces.
messages.zh: 消灭所有的雇佣军。

messages.en: My men are currently standing by, ready to launch a secondary assault on a poorly defended base nearby. This should draw a good portion of the security forces off the base we're truly aiming for. That's when you sweep in. Kill everything that moves, {[character]player.name}. If you can take out their reinforcements and logistics, then we'll be able to clean up what's left.
messages.zh: 我的人手现在已经待命，准备向附近一个疏于防守的基地发起第二波进攻。这么做能够把防守力量从我们真正想要攻击的基地目标上吸引出去，那样你就能够乘机打进去。{[character]player.name}，你要消灭敌人所有的有生力量。如果你能把他们的后勤增援都歼灭，那我们就能料理剩下的事情。

messages.en:
My men finished cleaning up the remaining hostiles just a few moments ago. You'll be pleased to hear this though, {[character]player.name}.

We caught someone trying to flee the scene; we think he knows something about the guys running this whole operation. He's been taken into questioning. If he does know anything, we'll have the information ourselves very shortly.
messages.zh:
我的人刚刚解决完了所有的敌对势力。接下来希望你能喜欢这条消息，{[character]player.name}。

我们捉住了一个想要逃跑的人，他可能了解这次行动的背后指使。我们正在审问他。如果他真的

messages.en:
My men finished cleaning up the remaining hostiles just a few moments ago. You'll be pleased to hear this though, {[character]player.name}.

We caught someone trying to flee the scene; we think he knows something about the guys running this whole operation. He's been taken into questioning. If he does know anything, we'll have the information ourselves very shortly.
messages.zh:
我的人刚刚解决完了所有的敌对势力。接下来希望你能喜欢这条消息，{[character]player.name}。

我们捉住了一个想要逃跑的人，他可能了解这次行动的背后指使。我们正在审问他。如果他真的

messages.en: Smuggling is one of the larger illegal industries in New Eden. Each nation in the cluster has numerous underground distribution cartels sourcing all sorts of illicit goods. Tracking the movement of ships and their cargo across borders is a monumental task that often spreads customs agents thin. For this reason, it isn't hard for a determined smuggler to find loopholes that they can exploit in the busy shipping schedules.
messages.zh: 非法贩售是新伊甸中相当严重的犯罪行为。在这世界中，几乎每个国家都有自己的一个地下贸易集团，相互交换各种非法物资。在国界线上追查这些罪犯与他们的物资是一件浩大工程，你要到处部署海关力量。正由于此原因，一些狡猾的非法贩售者常常能利用繁忙的运输时段钻空子。

messages.en: Smuggling
messages.zh: 非法贩售

messages.en: Straight to business then, eh? Here's the plan: My men are currently standing by, ready to launch an assault on a poorly defended base nearby. This should draw a good portion of the security forces off the base we're truly aiming for. That's when you sweep in. Kill everything that moves, {[character]player.name}. If you can take out their reinforcements and logistics, then we'll be able to clean up what's left. I'm thinking that all this commotion should draw their leader out, or at least get his attention. We can see how it plays out once the bullets start flying. You'll receive updates on the field once we launch our assault. Ready to roll?
messages.zh: 开门见山，我们的计划是这样：我们的人已经待命，准备对周围一个防守薄弱的敌方基地展开攻势。这么做能够把敌方防守力量从我们真正想要攻击的基地目标上吸引出去，那样你就能够乘机打进去。去摧毁所有敌人的有生力量，{[character]player.name}。如果你能清除掉他们的援军和后勤部队，我们就能将剩下的残兵完全清除。我想这样大的动静应该能够把他们的头领给引出洞来，或者至少引起他的注意。让我们看看动了真格的事情会有怎么的变化。你会在前线收到我们开始进攻的消息，准备好出击了么？

name.es: A la caza de los tenientes

messages.en: You destroyed hostile forces and captured one of the smugglers' lieutenants.
messages.zh: 你消灭了敌人并逮捕了非法贩售队里的一个中尉。

messages.en: Clear the facility of hostiles and capture any of the lieutenants present.
messages.zh: 搜查整座设施，消灭敌对势力并逮捕任何在场的敌方中尉。

messages.en: We have the names of three lieutenants, supposedly the underlings for the man running this whole operation. If we can capture one of them, then maybe they'll know something about this missing capsuleer of yours. They are supposed to be meeting at a nearby deadspace facility, arranging some kind of “big deal”. Once you clear the area, we should be able to scan the structures and locate any of the lieutenants, assuming they're still hanging around. Fly by and pick them up. If they refuse to board, pop a few shots off into the facility shields. That usually convinces people you mean business.
messages.zh: 那些中尉现在应该在附近一座死亡空间建筑里会晤，讨论一些所谓的大事。我们不知道这大事会是些什么事情。违规药品，钱或者性命？一切皆有可能，反正他们肯定会加强保安力量。一旦你清除了那地方的所有敌人，我们就能对建筑进行扫描，找到那些军官的处所——前提是他们还没来得及逃脱。到时你就过去抓他们上船。如果他们拒绝登船，那你就打掉那建筑的护盾。这种方式通常是最具威慑力的。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. I had a feeling we'd find at least one of them there. We'll take him out back and encourage him to talk.
messages.zh: 干得很好，{[character]player.name}，我就知道至少能在那儿找到一个。我们会让他乖乖地合作的。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. I had a feeling we'd find at least one of them there. We'll take him out back and encourage him to talk.
messages.zh: 干得很好，{[character]player.name}，我就知道至少能在那儿找到一个。我们会让他乖乖地合作的。

messages.en:
That didn't take long. You can't get good mercenaries anymore. They crack before you even get to the fun stuff.

He gave us the names of three lieutenants, supposedly the underlings for the man running this whole operation. If we can capture one of them, then maybe they'll know something about this missing capsuleer of yours. If they don't, then they should at least know where we can find their boss.

The lieutenants are supposed to be meeting at a nearby deadspace facility, arranging some kind of “big deal”. We have no idea what this could involve: drugs, money, people. It might be anything, but it definitely means some more hired security to deal with. Once you clear the area, we should be able to scan the structures and locate the lieutenants, assuming they're still hanging around. Fly by and pick them up. If they refuse to board, pop a few shots off into the facility shields. That usually convinces people you mean business. So, feel like crashing the party, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh:
没有用多长时间，现在的雇佣军都是一群废渣，还没等到你找到乐趣就已经彻底招了。

他告诉我们了三个中尉的名字，大概就是策划这次事件的幕后小鬼。如果我们能够抓住其中的一个，说不定他还对你要找的那个失踪飞行员有所了解。就算他们都不知道，也至少能告诉我们他们的头在什么地方。

那些中尉现在应该在附近一座死亡空间建筑里会晤，讨论一些所谓的大事。我们不知道这大事会是些什么事情。违规药品，钱或者性命？一切皆有可能，反正他们肯定会加强保安力量。一旦你清除了那地方的所有敌人，我们就能对建筑进行扫描，找到那些军官的处所——前提是他们还没来得及逃脱。到时你就过去抓他们上船。如果他们拒绝登船，那你就打掉那建筑的护盾。这种方式通常是最具威慑力的。怎么样，准备好去砸场了么，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: You killed smuggling leader Izia Tabar.
messages.zh: 你消灭了非法贩售者的头目伊兹亚·塔巴尔。

messages.en: Assassinate Izia Tabar.
messages.zh: 除掉伊兹亚·塔巴尔。

messages.en: We've discovered the location of the lead smuggler, Izia Tabar. Kill him and I promise you that everything else will fall into place.
messages.zh: 我们发现了非法贩售者头目伊兹亚·塔巴尔的藏身处。只要你消灭他，我就能保证一切重归太平。

messages.en: You have done exceptionally well, {[character]player.name}. Our teams will head over to Tabar's compound now and comb the area for further evidence. Get back to me when you are ready for one last assignment. It is about time the Minmatar repaid you for all you've done, and I have some information about how we can make that happen.
messages.zh: 你超乎完美地完成了我们给你的任务，{[character]player.name}。我们的队伍正在前往塔巴尔的据点，将对那里进行地毯式的搜索，看能不能找出更多的证据。现在米玛塔尔将会对你的功绩做出奖励，我手上有些信息想必能够告诉出你这个奖励的份量。

messages.en: You have done exceptionally well, {[character]player.name}. Our teams will head over to Tabar's compound now and comb the area for further evidence. Get back to me when you are ready for one last assignment. It is about time the Minmatar repaid you for all you've done, and I have some information about how we can make that happen.
messages.zh: 你超乎完美地完成了我们给你的任务，{[character]player.name}。我们的队伍正在前往塔巴尔的据点，将对那里进行地毯式的搜索，看能不能找出更多的证据。现在米玛塔尔将会对你的功绩做出奖励，我手上有些信息想必能够告诉出你这个奖励的份量。

messages.en:
We've been working tirelessly over all the intelligence you delivered to me. A lot of it we already knew, but after some cross analysis, we discovered that there was a particular location that only Lieutenant Kirus and a few others had access to. Kirus caved when he saw that we knew the coordinates to his employer's hideout. This guy's alias is Izia Tabar. He's a battle-hardened smuggler baron; CONCORD's wanted him for a long time now.

We have his location, {[character]player.name}. Can we rely on you to end this? I'd expect his place to be well defended, but if we lose him now it all counts for nothing.
messages.zh:
我们日夜兼程地分析你送来的那些情报。其中大部分我们都已经掌握了，但通过交叉分析，我们发现了一个特殊的地点。这个地方只有克鲁斯中尉和其他少数几个有特权的人才能进入。克鲁斯在得知我们知道他雇主的藏身地后便立即招了。那雇主的化名是伊兹亚·塔巴尔，他是个久经战火洗礼的非法贩售团伙头目。统合部已经通缉他很长时间了。

现在我们已经有了他处所的坐标，{[character]player.name}。你能够搞定他么？我想那个地方的防守不会太薄弱，但如果我们这次让他给溜了的话，那就前功尽弃了。

messages.en: You assisted a Krusual spy in escaping with important information about Dagan.
messages.zh: 你在塔巴尔的训练营中找到了掌握哒加恩情报的克鲁夏卧底。

messages.en: Fly interference for the Krusual spy from Tabar's training compound.
messages.zh: 在塔巴尔的训练营中掩护克鲁夏的卧底。

messages.en:
Moments ago, we received word that our man is now trapped there. We had hoped the Tabar's assassination would scatter the remnants of his forces and provide an easy escape, but we had no such luck. One of Tabar's remaining lieutenants, an Ammatar by the name of Mizara Nefra, has returned to the facility and taken over.

Not only is our spy and your only lead caught in the spider's web, but this smuggling crew may operate again someday unless we put a stop to this. You must run interference for us. Kill Mizara and her followers so that our agent has a chance of escaping undetected.
messages.zh:
就在刚才，我们受到信息说那个卧底现在被困在了那儿。我们原本以为塔巴尔的死讯会让他的人做鸟兽散，但看来我们的运气并不是很好。塔巴尔的一个叫做米扎拉·纳法拉的艾玛达留守中尉现在已经回去并接管了那个训练营。

这不光光意味着我们的卧底会被逮住，你的线索也会随之消失。如果我们不搞定这事儿，这个非法贩售团伙用不了多久又会开始行动。你必须挺身而出了。消灭米扎拉和他的同伙，这样我们的卧底就有机会悄悄逃脱了。

messages.en: You've destroyed a pirate ring that would have taken us months to work through. High marks all around.
messages.zh: 你超乎完美地完成了我们给你的任务，干得真漂亮。

messages.en: You capsuleers really are the best. You've destroyed a pirate ring that would have taken us months to work through. High marks all around.
messages.zh: 你们这些克隆飞行员确实都是精英。这个会花上我们数月去对付的海盗团伙没想到瞬间就被你消灭了，真实不负众望。

messages.en:
Before you arrived, we managed to get one of our people inside Tabar's recruitment and training facility. He informed us that the missing capsuleer you seek passed through this place briefly.

Moments ago, we received word that our man is now trapped there. We had hoped that Tabar's assassination would scatter the remnants of his forces and provide an easy escape, but we had no such luck. One of Tabar's remaining lieutenants, an Ammatar by the name of Mizara Nefra, has returned to the facility and taken over.

Not only is our spy and your only lead caught in the spider's web, but this smuggling crew may operate again someday unless we put a stop to this. You must run interference for us. Kill Mizara and her followers so that our agent has a chance of escaping undetected.
messages.zh:
在你到达前，我们成功地将一名自己人送进了塔巴尔的招募训练营。他说那个你要找的那个失踪克隆飞行员曾在那里做过短暂停留。

就在刚才，我们受到信息说那个卧底现在被困在了那儿。我们原本以为塔巴尔的死讯会让他的人做鸟兽散，但看来我们的运气并不是很好。塔巴尔的一个叫做米扎拉·纳法拉的艾玛达留守中尉现在已经回去并接管了那个训练营。

这不光光意味着我们的卧底会被逮住，你的线索也会随之消失。如果我们不搞定这事儿，这个非法贩售团伙用不了多久又会开始行动。你必须挺身而出了。消灭米扎拉和他的同伙，这样我们的卧底就有机会悄悄逃脱了。

messages.en: You told Dovirch Anselm that Mizara was dead.
messages.zh: 你把米扎拉的死讯告诉了多利瓦奇·安瑟尔姆。

messages.en: Inform the Amarr of Mizara's death.
messages.zh: 向艾玛通报米扎拉的死讯。

messages.en: Keita Eslin wants you to leave Minmatar space to speak to Dovrich Anselm in Amarr space.
messages.zh: 凯达·伊瑟琳要你离开米玛塔尔去找位于艾玛的多利瓦奇·安瑟尔姆谈话。

messages.en:
Mizara is dead?

What will I tell her family?
messages.zh:
米扎拉死了？

那你叫我怎么向她家人交待？

messages.en:
Mizara is dead?

What will I tell her family?
messages.zh:
米扎拉死了？

那你叫我怎么向她家人交待？

messages.en: You've done good work for me, and I have one last request. Go and tell Mizara's Amarr masters that she will work for them no more.
messages.zh: 你已经帮了我不少忙，但我还有最后一个请求。请向米扎拉的艾玛主子通报她已经没法再为他们工作了。

messages.en: A Breach of Trust
messages.zh: 信任危机

messages.en: Mizara's family was given closure, however bitter it may be.
messages.zh: 不管多么难以接受，米扎拉的家人已经知道了悲剧的发生。

messages.en: The family of Mizara is grieving over their loss.
messages.zh: 米扎拉的家人正在缅怀他们的亲人。

messages.en: Take this toy. The mistress first arrived at my lord's estate with nothing to her name but this. As you destroyed her body, it is the only physical connection left in this world that her family will recognize as hers. Deliver this to the family, and with the utmost care. They have already suffered greatly.
messages.zh: 拿着这个玩具，夫人刚刚来到我主人的庄园的时候这是她唯一的行李。因为你已经毁坏了她的身体，这个东西就成为了在这个世界上唯一能够向她的家人证明其身份的物品。把这个送去交给她的家人，一定竭尽所能保护它的安全。她和她的家人所经历的已经足够痛苦了。

messages.en: Thank you for doing this, my friend. To see others suffer is never easy.
messages.zh: 感谢你做这些，我的朋友。我知道，这样活生生地看着别人痛苦不是一件好受的事情。

messages.en:
Thank you for doing this, my friend. To see others suffer is never easy.

Return to me in your own time.
messages.zh:
感谢你做这些，我的朋友。我知道，这样活生生地看着别人痛苦不是一件好受的事情。

有空的时候请到我这里来。

messages.en: Amarr society is popularly conceived as hierarchical and old-fashioned. True Amarr are thought to dominate all people they conquer, and treat their own people as little better than cattle. While that can be true in certain cases, the political realities of the Amarr Empire are far too complex to paint the Empire as a wholly evil power.
messages.zh: 大众普便认为艾玛社会是一个阶级森严的传统社会。艾玛所征服的所有人都由正统的艾玛人统治，而这些正统艾玛人却对他们的人民非常残酷。这种说法在某些条件下可能是对的，而从政治的角度来说，单纯地把艾玛皇帝描述成一个邪恶的暴君就远远地低估了帝国的复杂本质。

messages.en: Tradition
messages.zh: 传统。

messages.en:
I would speak with you about your search for Dagan, but first, a matter of decorum. The late Mistress Mizara's parents entrusted the safety of their child to my lord. He has attempted to make amends, but I am afraid my lord can be...indelicate. He would replace their daughter with reparations of gold and ISK. This must be handled with more care.

Take this toy. The mistress first arrived at my lord's estate with nothing to her name but this. As you destroyed her body, it is the only physical connection left in this world that her family will recognize as hers. Deliver this to the family, and with the utmost care. They have already suffered enough.
messages.zh:
在我谈关于你对哒加恩的调查情况之前，我要先和你聊聊礼仪风雅的问题。米扎拉夫人已故的父母将他们的孩子托付与我的主人，尽管他尝试弥补过失，但是我怕我的主人会……做出不得体的事情。他可能会用金子和星币作为补偿来替代他们的女儿。

拿着这个玩具，夫人刚刚来到我主人的庄园的时候这是她唯一的行李。因为你已经毁坏了她的身体，这个东西就成为了在这个世界上唯一能够向她的家人证明其身份的物品。把这个送去交给她的家人，一定竭尽所能保护它的安全。她和她的家人所经历的已经足够痛苦了。

messages.en: You contacted Canius.
messages.zh: 你联系上了伽流斯。

messages.en: The investigation leads to an archaeologist named Canius.
messages.zh: 调查的下一个线索是找一名叫伽流斯的考古学家。

messages.en: I do not know where Dagan himself is, but I do know the man who brought Dagan to my lord's attention: an archaeologist of some respect, by the name of Doctor Canius. You'll find him at the location provided. Be warned: he surrenders nothing for free.
messages.zh: 我虽然不知道哒加恩本人现在哪里，但我知道当初向我主人推荐他的人。这人名叫伽流斯，是一名小有名气的考古学家。你会在我告诉你的地方会见到此人。提醒你一下，这人做事是要谈条件的。

messages.en: What's this? Well, Lord Taphos's flunky has a flunky, does he? Look, if this is about Taphos's lovebirds runnin' off, I've got no idea where they are.
messages.zh: 这算是什么？噢，塔夫斯大人的仆人也有仆人？哼，如果这事与塔夫斯手下苦力的失踪有关的话，那你就省省吧，因为我也不知道他们在那里。

messages.en: What's this? Well, Lord Taphos's flunky has a flunky, does he? Look, if this is about Taphos's lovebirds runnin' off, I've got no idea where they are.
messages.zh: 这算是什么？噢，塔夫斯大人的仆人也有仆人？哼，如果这事与塔夫斯手下苦力的失踪有关的话，那你就省省吧，因为我也不知道他们在那里。

messages.en:
You have proven you respect our ways. My lord now believes he can trust you.

Yes, we know Dagan, and of your hunt for him. My lord hired him as a tutor for Mistress Mizara some ten years ago. Though my lord fancies himself a skilled pilot, he is very much of old Amarr stock. He wished the mistress to be better educated in the newly emerging technologies and political realities than he. Dagan proved a remarkable teacher. Sadly, he and Lord Taphos had a falling out after the coronation of Empress Sarum. There was an altercation, and both Dagan and the mistress fled.

I do not know where Dagan himself is, but I do know the man who brought Dagan to my lord's attention: an archaeologist of some respect, by the name of Doctor Canius. You'll find him at the location provided. Be warned: he surrenders nothing for free.
messages.zh:
你已经用我们的方式赢得了我们的尊敬。我的主人愿意相信你。

是的，我们知道哒加恩这个人，而且我们也知道你正在追查他的下落。我的主人十年前聘用他做米扎拉小姐的私人教师。虽然主人总是做梦把自己想象成一名优秀的飞行员，但他实际上是一名很传统的艾玛人。他希望小姐能接受新教育，学习新技术。哒加恩的教育能力很出众。可惜，在萨拉姆女王加冕后，主人与哒加恩的关系出现了裂痕。他们大吵了一场，然后哒加恩与小姐就都离开了。

我虽然不知道哒加恩本人现在哪里，但我知道当初向我主人推荐他的人。这人名叫伽流斯，是一名有一定知名度的考古学家。你会在我告诉你的地方会见到此人。提醒你一下，这人做事是要谈条件的。

messages.en: You survived an attack by the Blood Raiders and recovered an artifact for Canius.
messages.zh: 你顺利地逃脱了一帮血袭者的攻击，取得了伽流斯想要的人工物品。

messages.en: Canius is awaiting the recovery of his artifact.
messages.zh: 伽流斯正等着他的人工制品。

messages.en: There's a dig site a little ways from here: a small cluster of asteroids, containing artifacts from some of the first Amarr space lanes. I know there's at least one good piece left, but every time I hire a team, they get driven off by pirates. All you have to do is go in, get that artifact, and return it to me without dying.
messages.zh: 离这里不远的地方有一个挖掘现场：在一小簇小行星中间有一些艾玛第一条空间航道留下的人造物品遗物。中间肯定有一些物件被完整地保存下来，但每次我找人去挖掘都被一帮海盗给赶了出来。你要做的只是进去找到那个人工物品，然后活着回来。

messages.en:
Blood Raiders? You're lucky you lived. They're psychotic and bloodthirsty, literally. Their sect believes purity can only be reached by consuming blood, and clone blood is purest of all. I'm afraid that makes you Capsuleers their favorite snack.

But you're alive, and you've got the artifact, so we're good.
messages.zh:
血袭者？你应该庆幸自己还活着。他们都是一帮神经病。我担心像你这样的克隆飞行员会成为他们的盘中餐。

还好你活下来了，而且还拿到了那个人工制品，太好了。

messages.en:
Blood Raiders? You're lucky you lived. They're psychotic and bloodthirsty, literally. Their sect believes purity can only be reached by consuming blood, and clone blood is purest of all. I'm afraid that makes you Capsuleers their favorite snack.

But you're alive, and you've got the artifact, so we're good.
messages.zh:
血袭者？你应该庆幸自己还活着。他们都是一帮神经病。我担心像你这样的克隆飞行员会成为他们的盘中餐。

还好你活下来了，而且还拿到了那个人工制品，太好了。

messages.en:
Dead, is she? Damn. I was fond of her, and not in Taphos's way, mind you.

Yeah, I know. “He was purely her protector and patron, to mold her and shape her for a life of dedicated service to God and Empire.” Listen, I've been studying human history for a long while, and a platonic patronage between a “Lord” and “Mistress” hasn't happened since the time when the Reclaiming just involved stabbing our heathen neighbors with pointy sticks. But if that was all that was goin' on, nobody would fuss.

But that's enough story-time for now. You want more; you'll have to do somethin' for me. Hell, you don't want to hear more; you still have to do somethin' for me. Don't worry, it's real simple.

There's a dig site a little ways from here: a small cluster of asteroids, containing artifacts from some of the first Amarr space lanes. I know there's at least one good piece left, but every time I hire a team, they get driven off by pirates. All you have to do is go in, get that artifact, and return it to me without dying.
messages.zh:
死了？她死了？该死。我是很喜欢她，但不是塔夫斯的那种喜欢。

是啊，我知道。“他只不过是她的保护者和资助人，将她塑造成一个把生活完全奉献给神和帝国的人。”听着，我学习人类历史有很长一段时间了。像这种主仆之间的所谓柏拉图式的恩惠，自“归御”这个概念进入到艾玛宗教里来的时候就已经没有了。要真的像说的那样的话，就不会有人大惊小怪了。

故事讲完了，你要还想听更多的那就得为我办些事儿才行。不用担心，这些事情都是很简单的。

离这里不远的地方有一个挖掘现场：在一小簇小行星中间有一些艾玛第一条空间航道留下的人造物品遗物。中间肯定有一些物件被完整地保存下来，但每次我找人去挖掘都被一帮海盗给赶了出来。你要做的只是进去找到那个人工物品，然后活着回来。

name.de: Von Nächten still und längst vergangen
name.ru: О давно прошедших тихих ночах (Of Quiet Nights Long Past)

messages.en: You found a strange document bearing Dagan's name in an abandoned monastery.
messages.zh: 你在废弃的修道院中找到一份奇怪的文件，上面写有哒加恩的名字。

messages.en: Canius believes an old monastery may hold a clue to Dagan's location.
messages.zh: 伽流斯认为有一个古老的修道院里面隐藏了哒加恩藏身地的线索。

messages.en: This is the location of the monastery he stayed at. It's been abandoned for some time. I wouldn't be surprised if scavengers have moved in. Go reclaim the hell out of that place, and I'm sure you'll find something useful.
messages.zh: 这就是他所在的那个修道院的位置。它已经被废弃了有些时候，所以想必有些清道夫已经搬进去住了。你去把那儿弄个底朝天，肯定能找到些什么好东西。

messages.en:
Good job cleaning those guys out. I wouldn't worry about the ramifications of slaughtering some godless scavengers. The first rule of any good reclaiming is it's about souls, not bodies. You just happen to have a lot of the latter left over.

Now, let's have a look at that document you found.
messages.zh:
你把那些家伙除掉了，干的不错。我并不担心这些邪恶的清道夫小时过后会产生什么后果，重生的真正重点在于灵魂而不是肉体，而你收拾的只是一帮没有灵魂的肉体罢了。

现在，让我们看看你找到的那个文件都说了些什么。

messages.en:
Good job cleaning those guys out. I wouldn't worry about the ramifications of slaughtering some godless scavengers. The first rule of any good reclaiming is it's about souls, not bodies. You just happen to have a lot of the latter left over.

Now, let's have a look at that document you found.
messages.zh:
你把那些家伙除掉了，干的不错。我并不担心这些邪恶的清道夫小时过后会产生什么后果，归御的真正重点在于灵魂而不是肉体，而你收拾的只是一帮没有灵魂的肉体罢了。

现在，让我们看看你找到的那个文件都说了些什么。

messages.en:
The Reclaiming is a major part of the Amarr religion, and of the Empire itself. They believe that all people in the universe were once part of the same empire, and the Amarr Empire is the direct heir to that legacy. Through Empress Catiz Tash-Murkon the Amarr are given a divine mandate to reunify the peoples of the universe through any means necessary.

Historically, this has lead to numerous wars of conquest in which the Amarr decimate and then absorb civilizations. Each war is itself referred to as a Reclaiming to emphasize their divine mandate.
messages.zh:
归御是艾玛宗教的一个重要部分，对于整个帝国来说同样也是重要的。他们相信这个宇宙中所有的人曾经都同属于同一个帝国，而艾玛皇帝则是这个帝国的真正继承人。因此，借着帝国女皇贾米尔·萨拉姆艾玛人拥有了通过一切手段重新统一宇宙中所有人类的神圣权利。

在历史上，这个理念引发了无数的征战，艾玛不停的灭绝不同的文明，然后将之同化。每一次战争都被称作是归御，是艾玛神圣的权职。

messages.en: Reclaiming
messages.zh: 归御

messages.en:
You've done me a solid, so I'll return the favor.

A few years ago Lord Taphos tried to hit me up to tutor his new miracle girl. I declined, but I pointed him to Dagan. Dagan was holed up in this monastery at the time, part of some weird hermitage. So I introduce them, think nothing of it. Then I start hearin' rumors about how friendly Dagan is with Mizara. This doesn't go well with Taphos, particularly if you also believe what they say about Taphos and Dagan. Dagan was driven off, and truth told that's what probably turned Mizara against Taphos right then. So Taphos wants to keep a tight lid on the whole affair himself, keep the rumors still.

So that's his character history. Hope you wrote that all down. Nah, I don't care. There's no test or anything.

But what did Dagan do after? I honestly don't know, but five will get you ten that it has something to do with his life before Taphos. This is the location of the monastery he stayed at. It's been abandoned for some time. I wouldn't be surprised if scavengers have moved in. Go reclaim the hell out of that place, and I'm sure you'll find something useful.
messages.zh:
你为我实实在在地帮了个忙，我会要报答你。

几年前，塔夫斯阁下想要请我去做他宝贝女儿的老师。我拒绝了，但是却建议他找哒加恩。那时候哒加恩躲藏在这个修道院里，一座避世所的一部分。我没加思索地就把他介绍给他们。然后我就开始听到各种传言说哒加恩和米扎拉的关系如何如何好。这个传言对于塔夫斯来说可不是什么好事，特别是当你听到别人是怎么评价塔夫斯和哒加恩的关系的。这把哒加恩给吓退了，实际上情况是当时可能米扎拉正和塔夫斯作对。塔夫斯不想让这些事情传出去，所以什么都没说过。

这些就是他的故事，希望你已经把这些都记下来了。其实也无所谓，反正这些东西又不会用来考试。

至于哒加恩之后又干了什么，我确实是不知道了。但十有八九这整件事都和他与塔夫斯牵扯上之前的那些时候有关。这个是他住的修道院地址，它已经被废弃了有些时候，所以想必有些清道夫已经搬进去住了。你去把那儿弄个底朝天，肯定能找到些什么好东西。

messages.en: You informed Dovirch Anselm that Dagan was a spy. Anselm revealed himself to be from the Ministry of Internal Order.
messages.zh: 你把哒加恩是间谍的事情告诉了多利瓦奇·安瑟尔姆。他向你透露他是为内务府工作的。

messages.en: Dagan was a spy! You must inform Dovirch Anselm at once.
messages.zh: 哒加恩是名间谍！快去通知多利瓦奇·安瑟尔姆。

messages.en: I can only guess at what "pre-Jovian" qualifies as, but Taphos has clearly unwittingly provided Imperial secrets to a spy. You must deliver this information to him at once!
messages.zh: 至于什么才能算作是“朱庇特前”，我只能靠猜的了。但塔夫斯这家伙已经傻乎乎地把帝国机密抖露给了一个间谍。你要赶快把这事告诉安瑟尔姆！

messages.en: So you found out about Dagan? You capsuleers are impressive indeed. I was two years into this case before I got that far. I'm sorry, allow me to re-introduce myself. I'm Dovirch Anselm, Ministry of Internal Order.
messages.zh: 这么说来你知道哒加恩的底细了？克隆飞行员果然名不虚传。我花了两年时间才知道那事情。不好意思，我再重新介绍下自己，我是内务府的多利瓦奇·安瑟尔姆。

messages.en: So you found out about Dagan? You capsuleers are impressive indeed. I was two years into this case before I got that far. I'm sorry, allow me to re-introduce myself. I'm Dovirch Anselm, Ministry of Internal Order.
messages.zh: 这么说来你知道哒加恩的底细了？克隆飞行员果然名不虚传。我花了两年时间才知道那事情。不好意思，我再重新介绍下自己，我是内务府的多利瓦奇·安瑟尔姆。

messages.en:
This is fascinating. See this character here? It's only found in the Jovian alphabet. It's not proper Jovian, though. It's like they just were using the character set as a cipher of some sort. Unfortunate for Dagan, no cipher exists to stop a Hedion University man!

Let's see… that's strange. I can't tell who this is to, but it's definitely from Dagan. He says his mission went well, and that he fully earned the mark's— I assume that's Taphos's— trust. The mark willingly gave him passwords and clearance to Imperial archives, and… Emperors of old, he says he has sent all records pertaining to the Empire's knowledge of "pre-Jovian" weapons!

I can only guess at what qualifies as "pre-Jovian", but Taphos has unwittingly provided Imperial secrets to a spy. You must deliver this information to him at once!
messages.zh:
这真令人惊呀。看到这些的字了吗？它只有在朱庇特人的字典中才能找到。不过这并非正宗的朱庇特文字。好像他们把这作为一种加密字符来使用。哒加恩，你碰到我算是倒霉了，因为没有什么密码是赫迪农大学的人破解不了的！

让我看看……奇怪。我虽然不知道这收信人是谁，但这绝对是哒加恩发出的。他说他的任务进展顺利，已经完全取得了目标的……我想他是指塔夫斯的信任吧。目标主动把帝国档案的密码告诉了他，同时他还说已经向外发送了一些记录，这些记录与帝国所掌握的“前朱庇特”武器信息有关！

至于什么才能算作是“朱庇特前”，我只能靠猜的了。但塔夫斯这家伙已经傻乎乎地把帝国机密抖露给了一个间谍。你要赶快把这事告诉安瑟尔姆！

name.ru: Вызов на поединок (A Call to Trial)

messages.en: Taphos was defeated in direct combat. His death allowed Dovirch Anselm to close his investigation without damaging the Taphos' house.
messages.zh: 塔夫斯在面对面的决斗中被打败了。他的死让多利瓦奇·安瑟尔姆能够在不损坏塔夫斯王室声誉的情况下终结这个案子的调查。

messages.en: In order to protect his name, Taphos has challenged you to a trial by combat.
messages.zh: 为了维护自己的名誉，塔夫斯向你发起了决斗的挑战。

messages.en: I want you to go out there, meet Taphos, and kill him in combat. We've shut off access to his clones, so he won't be coming back. As you were challenged by a noble you'll suffer no consequences, legal or otherwise. His family line gets to keep their good name, and everyone can then go back to their nice, safe lives, confident that Imperial secrets are still safe.
