messages.zh: 我要你去会会塔夫斯，然后在战斗中灭了他。我们已经阻断了他和克隆体之间的链接。因为你是接受了一个来自贵族的挑战，不管发生什么事情你都不会遇到麻烦，无论是法律上的还是别的什么。他的家族一心想要维护自身的名誉，这样的话大家就能够回到自己快乐的正常生活之中，而不用去担心皇室的秘密是否会被泄露。

messages.en: It is done, then. I've already started making my calls. As far as the media is concerned, he accused you of contract fraud, but God proved your innocence through a lawful trial by combat.
messages.zh: 现在这事儿就解决了。我已经开始给各种媒体通电话，他们关心的是你身上的合同欺诈指控，但是通过这次合法的决斗，上帝证明了你的清白。

messages.en: It is done, then. I've already started making my calls. As far as the media is concerned, he accused you of contract fraud, but God proved your innocence through a lawful trial by combat.
messages.zh: 现在这事儿就解决了。我已经开始给各种媒体通电话，他们关心的是你身上的合同欺诈指控，但是通过这次合法的决斗，上帝证明了你的清白。

messages.en:
I'm sure you have several questions for me, but I'm afraid they'll have to wait. It seems Taphos caught wind of your investigation. I know because he has challenged you to trial by combat.

It hasn't been common for years, but Taphos considers himself an old-fashioned true Amarr, and blue laws still allow it. Luckily, this provides the perfect opportunity for us. With the information we've uncovered, namely this cipher, we have enough to bring Taphos on charges. Doing so, however, would cause a huge political uproar, the kind that we frankly don't have the time for.

I want you to go out there, meet Taphos, and kill him in combat. We've shut off access to his clones, so he won't be coming back. As you were challenged by a noble you'll suffer no consequences, legal or otherwise. His family line gets to keep their good name, and everyone can then go back to their nice, safe lives, confident that Imperial secrets are still safe.
messages.zh:
我相信你肯定有些问题想要问我，但恐怕你得要先缓一缓。塔夫斯好像已经知道你现在正在进行的调查，正因为这样他才要用战斗试炼的方式挑战你。

这种事情在近些年都很少见到，但是塔夫斯自持是一个传统的艾玛贵族，而蓝法也的确是允许这么做的。要是运气好的话，这对我们来说简直是一次完美的机会。现在有了这些信息，这个密码，我们已经有了足够的证据起诉塔夫斯。不过如果是那样的话，肯定会在政坛里搅起一滩浑水，而我们现在却没时间对付这种事情。

我要你去会会塔夫斯，借这次决斗的机会把他给灭了。我们已经阻断了他和克隆体之间的链接。因为你是接受了一个来自贵族的挑战，不管发生什么事情你都不会遇到麻烦，无论是法律上的还是别的什么。他的家族一心想要维护自身的名誉，这样的话大家就能够回到自己快乐的正常生活之中，而不用去担心皇室的秘密是否会被泄露。

messages.en: The Sisters of Eve confirmed that Dagan was Society of Conscious Thought.
messages.zh: 姐妹会确认哒加恩是理性思维社团的人。

messages.en: The Sisters have known Dagan was from the Society of Conscious Thought all along. It is time to confront them.
messages.zh: 姐妹会一直以来就知道哒加恩的底细。现在是质问她们的时候了。

messages.en:
Dagan's made a mistake. He's been cut off from his buddies. The Sisters have seen to that. If there's one group that keeps a closer eye on the Society than the Empire, it's the Sisters of EVE.

They knew the whole damn time who Dagan was. I'd say it's time to head back over to the Sisters and get the full story this time.
messages.zh: 哒加恩因为犯了错误而被踢出社团。姐妹会清楚地知道这点。宇宙中除了帝国政府，就数姐妹会最关心理性思维社团的情况了。她们对哒加恩的身份一直了如指掌。现在我看是返回姐妹会那里，向她们了解事情来龙去脉的时候了。

messages.en: You've returned. I told my sisters you were resourceful. Let's not tarry, then. Yes, we've always known that Dagan is a member of the Society of Conscious Thought. And yes, we knowingly kept that information from you for our own purposes.
messages.zh: 你回来了。我知道你不是傻瓜，咱们就开门见山地说吧。对，我们知道哒加恩是理性思维社团的人。而且我们确实是故意向你隐瞒这个事实的

messages.en: You've returned. I told my sisters you were resourceful. Let's not tarry, then. Yes, we've always known that Dagan is a member of the Society of Conscious Thought. And yes, we knowingly kept that information from you for our own purposes.
messages.zh: 你回来了。我知道你不是傻瓜，咱们就开门见山地说吧。对，我们知道哒加恩是理性思维社团的人。而且我们确实是故意向你隐瞒这个事实的

messages.en:
Thought they were just a giant think tank, yeah? That's their public side. Diplomats and the rich send their children to the Society for the best education money can buy. I have a cousin who graduated from one, and he's straight as an arrow.

Every once in a while, though, we get reports of Society ships showing up at the oddest places. Spatial anomalies, weird accidents, the like. They're Society, but almost a different breed entirely. These guys are ghosts. As soon as you think you've found one, they just vanish.
messages.zh:
你以为他们不过是个大型智库对吧？那是他们的公开身份。外交人员与有钱人都把自己的子女往那里送接受教育。我有个侄子就从那毕业的，他为人可诚实呢。

不过有时我们会收到零星报告显示他们的人出现在一些奇怪的地方。一会儿是死亡空间，一会儿又是离奇的事故，反正就是那些事。理性思维社团的人好像就是另一人种似的。这帮家伙像鬼魂一样。你只要一瞄到他们，他们就会消失。

messages.en: The Society of Conscious Thought
messages.zh: 理性思维社团

messages.en:
Now, about Dagan. We've had our suspicions as to who he is. With the cipher you found, we know for sure. I'm violating my oath by giving you this intel, but odds are good we'd never be able to act on it ourselves. See, Dagan is from the Society of Conscious Thought.

Dagan's made a mistake, though. He's been cut off from his buddies. The Sisters have seen to that.

Yeah, the Sisters. I've been curious why they were so interested in my case. Now I know: if there's one group that keeps a closer eye on the Society than the Empire, it's the Sisters of EVE.

They knew the whole damn time who Dagan was. I'd say it's time to head back over to the Sisters and get the full story.
messages.zh:
好，现在是该讲一下哒加恩这个人的时候了。我们对他的身份怀疑已有一段时间了。现在有了你找到的情报，我们终于知道确切答案了。我现在冒着风险向你透露以下情报，不过我们自己不大可能再去处理这事了。哒加恩是理性思维社团的人。

不过他因为犯了错误而被踢出社团。姐妹会清楚地知道这点。

对，没错，就是姐妹会。难怪她们对我这案子这么感兴趣呢。现在我明白了：宇宙中除了帝国政府，就数姐妹会最关心社团的情况了。

她们对哒加恩的身份一直了如指掌。现在我看是返回姐妹会那里，向她们了解事情来龙去脉的时候了。

messages.en: Closing In
messages.zh: 深入逼近

messages.en: You planted false records to substitute a spy for Tahaki Karin, the engineer you rescued earlier.
messages.zh: 你提交了假身份档案为图哈基·卡林的间谍行动做准备。她是你之前营救的那名工程师。

messages.en: Plant the false records.
messages.zh: 安插伪造的记录。

messages.en: Your anger is understandable, but we've got more reason to cooperate than to quarrel. Dagan's your real enemy. You'll be interested to know that some of his corpmates have been spotted at a nearby station. We've prepared an agent to gain their confidence and extract information on their further operations. To you, she'll be Tahaki Karin, a ship's engineer from the Damsel. Before our operative can infiltrate Dagan's group, Karin's identity records will need to be altered. Take these records to an archive station. Once they're updated there, our friends will make sure they're changed throughout the entire network.
messages.zh: 你生气是可以理解的，但我们现在更需要合作。哒加恩才是你真正的敌人。我想你一定想知道有人在附近一座空间站看到了他的同僚。我们已经准备派遣一名特工混入他们中间去获取情报。那名特工的名字是图哈基·卡林，她是少女号的工程师。在卡林潜入哒加恩那帮人之前，我们需要修改她的身份记录。你现在把这些记录送到一个档案馆去。只要将这些信息上传到那里，我们的朋友就有办法在全网范围内实施同样的更改。

messages.en: Excellent work, pilot. The altered records are being distributed as we speak.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。现在那更改好的档案已经被传送出去了。

messages.en: Excellent work, pilot. The altered records are being distributed as we speak.
messages.zh: 干得好，飞行员。现在那更改好的档案已经被传送出去了。

name.ru: Сестры и шпион (The Sisters and the Spy)

messages.en: You delivered a spy impersonating Tahaki Karin to the Society of Conscious Thought.
messages.zh: 你将扮演图哈基·卡林的间谍送到了理性思维社团。

messages.en: Deliver the false Karin.
messages.zh: 护送冒牌卡琳。

messages.en:
With those records replaced, our agent is Tahaki Karin.

What happened to real one? Electronically speaking, she's a non-person. She's alive and safe, though; if she wanted better, she shouldn't have joined the Society. Now, we need to get our Karin into place. I've filed a travel request in her name, which the Society has granted. All you need to do is rendezvous with a Society transport and drop her off.

Once that's done, we just have to wait for her to tell us where Dagan is.
messages.zh:
将这些记录替换过后，我们的特工现在就是图哈基·卡林了。

至于真正的那个发生了什么状况，我想从电子档案的角度来说，她已经不存在了，但是她很安全。要说这对她有点过分的话，那她一开始就不应该加入社团。现在，我们要把自己的卡琳送进去。我以她的名字提交了一份航行请求，社团已经同意了。

一旦成功，我们只需要等着她告诉我们哒加恩的情报就好了。

messages.en: Well done, capsuleer. I believe Karin has begun transmitting data already.
messages.zh: 很好，克隆飞行员。我想卡琳已经开始传送数据了。

messages.en: Well done, pilot. I believe Karin has begun transmitting data already.
messages.zh: 很好，飞行员。我想卡琳已经开始传送数据了。

messages.en: You destroyed a Society cruiser spying on the Sisters.
messages.zh: 你摧毁了一艘正在执行间谍任务的理性思维社团巡洋舰。

messages.en: Destroy the Society spy cruiser.
messages.zh: 消灭社团间谍巡洋舰。

messages.en: The Society of Conscious Thought has deployed a refitted cruiser, the Omnipresence, nearby… with a substantial escort. We think they may be recording our local communications. If they are, there's a good chance they'll be able to decipher them, and root out our agent. The Society will certainly murder our sister if they uncover her identity. We need you to locate the Omnipresence, and destroy her. If necessary, engage her escort, but try not to destroy them. The loss of human life would be catastrophic.
messages.zh: 理性思维社团的一艘改装巡洋舰，普照号潜伏在附近的空域执行侦查任务，我们认为他们正在监听和记录我们的本地通讯。如果真是这样，他们很有可能会破译这些通讯频道，以查出我们的特工人员。社团一旦发现了我们姐妹的真实身份，一定会毫不犹豫的害死她。我们需要你找到普照号并摧毁它。实在没有办法，就将他的护航舰一并消灭，但尽量不要要了他们的命，生命的逝去将是非常大的灾难。

messages.en: Excellent work. The Omnipresence has been destroyed, and there's no indication that she managed to inform her Society masters. We'll be resuming contact with Karin immediately.
messages.zh: 干得好。普照号已经被摧毁了，它应该还没能设法联系上社团的首脑。我们应该立即继续同卡琳取得联系。

messages.en: Excellent work. The Omnipresence has been destroyed, and there's no indication that she managed to inform her Society masters. We'll be resuming contact with Karin immediately.
messages.zh: 干得好。普照号已经被摧毁了，它应该还没能设法联系上社团的首脑。我们应该立即继续同卡琳取得联系。

messages.en: Karin's information is still coming in. But if you really want to find Dagan, you're going to have to help us deal with a little problem. The Society of Conscious Thought has deployed a refitted cruiser, the Omnipresence, nearby… with a substantial escort. We think they may be recording our local communications. If they are, there's a good chance they'll be able to decipher them, and root out our agent. The Society will certainly murder our sister if they uncover her identity. We need you to locate the Omnipresence, and destroy her. If necessary, engage her escort, but try not to destroy them. The loss of human life would be catastrophic.
messages.zh: 卡琳还在不断向我们送情报。但如果你真的想要找到哒加恩，那你得要帮我们解决一个小麻烦。理性思维社团的一艘改装巡洋舰，普照号，潜伏在附近的空域执行侦查任务，我们认为他们正在监听和记录我们的本地通讯。如果真是这样，他们很有可能会破译这些通讯频道，以查出我们的特工人员。社团一旦发现了我们姐妹的真实身份，一定会毫不犹豫的害死她。我们需要你找到普照号并摧毁它。实在没有办法，就将他的护航舰一并消灭，但尽量不要要了他们的命，生命的逝去将是非常大的灾难。

messages.en: You captured a pilot for interrogation.
messages.zh: 你找到了要拷问的飞行员。

messages.en: Destroy squadron and capture the leader.
messages.zh: 消灭船队并逮捕他们的头领。

messages.en: An independent Amarr pilot named Kritsan Parthus has recently dealt with Dagan. Unfortunately, he won't disclose Dagan's location to the Sisters. Destroy Parthus's ship and retrieve him for questioning.
messages.zh: 一个叫做克里斯坦·帕休斯的艾玛自由飞行员最近接触了哒加恩。不过他不愿意告诉姐妹会哒加恩的位置。摧毁帕休斯的飞船并将其带回接受审讯。

messages.en: I'll handle questioning Parthus. Rest assured, he will be treated humanely, and compensated well.
messages.zh: 我会负责审讯帕休斯。放心，我们会人道地对待他，也会好好补偿他。

messages.en: I'll handle questioning Parthus. Rest assured, he will be treated humanely, and compensated well.
messages.zh: 我会负责审讯帕休斯。放心，我们会人道地对待他，也会好好补偿他。

messages.en: Our agent hasn't been able to determine where Dagan is. But in decoding her sensory data, we managed to pick up a clue. An Amarr pilot named Kritsan Parthus recently delivered a cargo of drone parts to Dagan. These parts were black market, and may have been scavenged from some of your recent battles. We contacted Parthus. He's an independent operator, but wouldn't see the light. We've managed to locate him by tracing his communications signals. Unfortunately, it will be necessary for you to bring him in for a meeting under duress. Our archive data suggests that Parthus will travel with a small contingent of support ships. Identify his command vessel, destroy it and bring him to me, personally.
messages.zh: 我们的特工还没有找到哒加恩藏在哪儿。但是在破译出来的一些感应器数据中，我们还是发现了一些线索。一个叫克里斯坦·帕休斯的艾玛飞行员最近给哒加恩送去了一箱无人机部件。这些部件都是从黑市上收集起来的，甚至可能是从一些战场上的废船中回收来的。我们联系上了帕休斯，他是个体户，但他不愿意出来和我们接触。我们利用他的联络信号找到了他的位置。我想你可能需要跑一趟去把他带过来接受我们的审问。我们的资料数据显示帕休斯有一帮打手保护自己。找到他的指挥舰，然后将它摧毁，最后把他带回到我面前。

messages.en: You delivered smuggling lieutenant Irai Kirus to the Krusual.
messages.zh: 你把艾瑞·克鲁斯中尉交给了克鲁夏人。

messages.en: Deliver Irai Kirus to the Krusual.
messages.zh: 把艾瑞·克鲁斯交给克鲁夏人。

messages.en: Keita says she found something in the evidence you brought over from your tours around State and Federation space. She thinks it might help her people direct the interrogation of Kirus, so we need you to take him back to her. We will speak again perhaps, once Keita has gleaned some information from Kirus. If we don't, then let me say that it's been a pleasure having you as a friend and ally of the Minmatar people.
messages.zh: 凯达说她在你从加达里与盖伦特那里获得的证据中找到了些东西，并认为这将对克鲁斯的审讯很有用。我们要你把克鲁斯带到她那里。只要凯达能从克鲁斯嘴里逼出点东西，我们就会再次合作。就算不能，那我也觉得你是个不错的伙伴，你是米玛塔尔人民的友人。

messages.en: Lovely present you sent me.
messages.zh: 你送我的礼物真是太棒了。

messages.en:
Keita says she found something in the evidence you brought over from your tours around State and Federation space. She thinks it might help her people direct the interrogation of Kirus, so we need you to take him back to her. We have a strong overlap of aims here, {[character]player.name}. You want to find this capsuleer, and we want to hamper smuggling operations in our space. So long as your work takes you down this path, we will be happy to offer our assistance. We will speak again perhaps, once Keita has gleaned some information from Kirus. If we don't, then let me say that it's been a pleasure having you as a friend and ally of the Minmatar people. I hope the good work doesn't stop with the end of your investigation.

Good work and good luck. I hope you find the answers you seek. I'm sure Keita will help.
messages.zh:
凯达说她在你从加达里与盖伦特那里获得的证据中找到了些东西，并认为这将对克鲁斯的审讯很有用。我们要你把克鲁斯带到她那里。{[character]player.name}，我们有许多目标重合的地方。你要寻找这个克隆飞行员，而我们要打击自己领域里的非法贩售活动。只要你目标不变，我们就能继续互惠互助。只要凯达能从克鲁斯嘴里逼出点东西，我们就会再次合作。就算不能，那我也觉得你是个不错的伙伴，你是米玛塔尔人民的友人。我希望你的优秀表现不会随着调查的结束而消失。

祝你顺风，但愿你能找到你要的答案。我相信凯达会协助你的。

messages.en: You chose a faction to work with to apprehend Dagan.
messages.zh: 你要选择协助哪个势力抓捕哒加恩。

messages.en: You must choose which faction to work with.
messages.zh: 你必须选择一个合作势力。

messages.en:
We've finally determined Dagan's location. It appears that he's outfitting another expedition. If he successfully acquires more of those drones – and worse, maintains control of them – he and his clients will be able to wreak terrible destruction across the cluster. I'm sure you can take out Dagan yourself, but it looks like he's hired some muscle. You've made some imperial contacts, yes? They might be able to clear a path for you to engage Dagan.

The empires will want Dagan not just for justice, but for his knowledge. Accept their help, but consider delivering him into our merciful hands, instead. We'll spare him… and make sure his knowledge does no harm. You have to make a choice between the Empires: Which one do you want to help you in taking down Dagan?
messages.zh:
我们终于查到了哒加恩的位置。看起来他正在准备下一次远征。如果他再成功获得更多的无人机就不好了，或者是他还继续控制着它们就更糟了，哒加恩与他的客户便能在宇宙中横行肆孽。我知道你一个人能对付哒加恩，但他好像找了不少帮手。你已在帝国里认识了一些人是吧？他们可以帮你扫清出一条道路，让你直捣哒加恩。

我们找哒加恩不仅是为了讨个公道，更是要获得他掌握的情报。你可以接受帝国人员的帮助，但你要让哒加恩这个人活着回来。我们不要他的命……他有我们想获得的情报。你现在要做个决定：你愿意协助哪个帝国去对付哒加恩？

messages.en: You've made your choice. Let us pray it was a wise one.
messages.zh: 你已做出了决定。但愿这是个明智选择。

messages.en: Support the Gallente Federation
messages.zh: 协助盖伦特联邦

messages.en: Support the Minmatar Republic
messages.zh: 协助米玛塔尔共和国

messages.en: Support the Caldari State
messages.zh: 协助加达里合众国

messages.en: Support the Amarr Empire
messages.zh: 协助艾玛帝国

messages.en: You captured Dagan and ruined his plans.
messages.zh: 你逮捕了哒加恩，将他的计划一举粉碎。

messages.en: Destroy Dagan's ship and capture him.
messages.zh: 击毁哒加恩的舰船并将其逮捕。

messages.en: Based on your information, we've determined Dagan's location. He's preparing to depart, but he won't get far. We've assembled a small task force to disable the station. They won't stand a chance against a capsuleer, though, especially not one as slippery as he is. We're just clearing the way for you. Good hunting.
messages.zh: 根据你的信息，我们找到了哒加恩的位置。他正准备离开，但是肯定跑不远。我们集合了一支小部队去搞垮那座空间站。但他们肯定没法对付一个克隆飞行员，特别是像哒加恩那类狡猾的人。我们只是为你扫清前进的道路，接下来还得看你。

messages.en: Nice flying, sir. Genetic records confirm Dagan's identity, if you'd like to pass him along?
messages.zh: 挺漂亮的。DNA记录确认了哒加恩的身份，你愿意把他交给我们吧？

messages.en: Nice flying, sir. Genetic records confirm Dagan's identity, if you'd like to pass him along…?
messages.zh: 挺漂亮的。DNA记录确认了哒加恩的身份，你愿意把他交给我们吧？

messages.en: Based on your information, we've determined Dagan's location. He's preparing to depart, but he won't get far. We've assembled a small task force to disable the station. They won't stand a chance against a capsuleer, though, especially not one as slippery as he is. We're just clearing the way for you. Good hunting.
messages.zh: 根据你的信息，我们找到了哒加恩的位置。他正准备离开，但是肯定跑不远。我们集合了一支小部队去搞垮那座空间站。但他们肯定没法对付一个克隆飞行员，特别是像哒加恩那类狡猾的人。我们只是为你扫清前进的道路，接下来还得看你。

messages.en: You captured Dagan and ruined his plans.
messages.zh: 你逮捕了哒加恩，将他的计划一举粉碎。

messages.en: Destroy Dagan's ship and capture him.
messages.zh: 击毁哒加恩的舰船并将其逮捕。

messages.en: Welcome back, soldier. We've found Dagan. Couldn't have done it without those interrogation tapes. He's looking to leave the station you mentioned, but we can catch up to him. Our strike force is already on their way to the station. It'll take a capsuleer to shoot down a capsuleer, though. This is your show, pilot. Kick some ass.
messages.zh: 欢迎回来。我们找到了哒加恩，这要归功于那些审讯记录。看上去他准备要离开你说的那个空间站，但是我们应该能够追得上他。我们的突击部队已经准备好前往目标空间站，但是只有你才是真正有能力对付哒加恩的人。去吧，这是让你拽的机会，好好教训他。

messages.en: You gave quite a performance. Good work.
messages.zh: 你干得真漂亮！

messages.en: You gave quite a performance. Good work.
messages.zh: 你干得真漂亮！

messages.en: Welcome back, soldier. We've found Dagan. Couldn't have done it without those interrogation tapes. He's looking to leave the station you mentioned, but we can catch up to him. Our strike force is already on their way to the station. It'll take a capsuleer to shoot down a capsuleer, though. This is your show, pilot. Kick some ass.
messages.zh: 欢迎回来。我们找到了哒加恩，这要归功于那些审讯记录。看上去他准备要离开你说的那个空间站，但是我们应该能够追得上他。我们的突击部队已经准备好前往目标空间站，但是只有你才是真正有能力对付哒加恩的人。去吧，这是让你拽的机会，好好教训他。

messages.en: You captured Dagan and ruined his plans.
messages.zh: 你逮捕了哒加恩，将他的计划一举粉碎。

messages.en: Destroy Dagan's ship and capture him.
messages.zh: 击毁哒加恩的舰船并将其逮捕。

messages.en: We are ready when you are. My forces will disarm the station. Engage Dagan and retrieve him from his pod.
messages.zh: 我们随时待命。我的部队会攻击空间站的守卫，你进去找哒加恩，摧毁他的船，然后从他逃生舱里把他拖出来。

messages.en: You set a fine example. We will show reels of the fight in corps academy for years.
messages.zh: 你树立了一个好榜样。我们会把你的战斗录像送到军事学院做教材。

messages.en: You set a fine example. We will show reels of the fight in corps academy for years.
messages.zh: 你树立了一个好榜样。我们会把你的战斗录像送到军事学院做教材。

messages.en: We are ready when you are. My forces will disarm the station. Engage Dagan and retrieve him from his pod.
messages.zh: 我们随时待命。我的部队会攻击空间站的守卫，你进去找哒加恩，摧毁他的船，然后从他逃生舱里把他拖出来。

messages.en: You captured Dagan and ruined his plans.
messages.zh: 你逮捕了哒加恩，将他的计划一举粉碎。

messages.en: Destroy Dagan's ship and capture him.
messages.zh: 击毁哒加恩的舰船并将其逮捕。

messages.en: While we regret the need to trouble an Imperial citizen, we imagine that confession was good for his soul. We have dispatched an assault group to eliminate his allies. They will clear your way so that you may strike Dagan down.
messages.zh: 当我们为干扰帝国子民的生活而困扰的时候，我们何尝不能想想这实际上是为了他的灵魂着想。我派出了一支攻击部队前去消灭他的盟友，这会为你清除前进的道路，让你直捣哒加恩的老巢。

messages.en: Rarely is the wrath of God demonstrated in such fiery terms. Congratulations, pilot.
messages.zh: 天父的愤怒很难得以这样激烈的方式彰显出来。祝贺你，飞行员。

messages.en: Rarely is the wrath of God demonstrated in such fiery terms. Congratulations, pilot.
messages.zh: 天父的愤怒很难得以这样激烈的方式彰显出来。祝贺你，飞行员。

messages.en:
Shall we begin?

While we regret the need to trouble an Imperial citizen, we imagine that confession was good for his soul. We have dispatched an assault group to eliminate his allies. They will clear your way so that you may strike Dagan down.
messages.zh:
我们可以开始了么？

当我们为干扰帝国子民的生活而困扰的时候，我们何尝不能想想这实际上是为了他的灵魂着想。我派出了一支攻击部队前去消灭他的盟友，这会为你清除前进的道路，让你直捣哒加恩的老巢。

name.ru: Это ещё не конец (It's Not Over Yet)

messages.en: You contacted Keita Eslin and continued your investigation.
messages.zh: 你与凯达·伊瑟琳取得了联系，并继续你的调查工作。

messages.en: You need to contact Keita Eslin for assistance in tracking Dagan.
messages.zh: 你需要与凯达·伊瑟琳取得联系，让她协助你追查哒加恩的下落。

messages.en:
Dagan was the pilot leading the fleet that the drones first destroyed, and a known terrorist. He was supposed to be dead. It's very important that he is made dead. The Sisters consider this a top priority.

Dagan is heading for a system in Minmatar space. He can't have gone far. I'll connect you with Keita Eslin, Advisor to the Krusual Tribe. She can help you track down Dagan.

I've been to Minmatar space quite a few times myself, {[character]player.name}. It's not so bad there, but just be careful where you wander and what you say. Their way of doing things can be a little rough around the edges at times, but I've also never known a Minmatar to not get a job done. In case you don't know, the Krusual can be a little sly. Just make sure this one looks after your interests, too. Still, I'm sure you can handle yourself.
messages.zh:
哒加恩是那支第一个被无人机群摧毁的舰队的指挥飞行员，是个家喻户晓的恐怖分子。他必须要被消灭掉，这一点非常的重要，姐妹会也把他的灭亡放在非常高的重要级别上。

哒加恩目前正飞往米玛塔尔领域，应该还走得还不远。我已经帮你联系到了克鲁夏部族的一名顾问，她能协助你追查哒加恩的下落，这个顾问的名字叫做凯达·伊瑟琳。

我本人已经去过米玛塔尔空域好几次了，{[character]player.name}。那里的情况不是想象的那么差，但你为人处事还是要低调些比较好。虽然那里的人行事风格比较粗糙，不过还是蛮有效率的。另外需要提醒你一下，克鲁夏人会比较精明，你一定要确保伊瑟琳是在全力地协助你。我相信你行的。

messages.en:
Greetings {[character]player.name} and welcome to the Minmatar nation. My name is Keita Eslin, Advisor to the Krusual Tribe. I'm glad to see you arrived, and with an abundance of useful information as well.

You needn't worry, I have good information and if you follow through on it, then we will certainly be helping one another.
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}。欢迎来到米玛塔尔共和国。我的名字是凯达·伊瑟琳，是克鲁夏部族的一名顾问。我很高兴你能来，你一定还给我们带来了很多有用的信息。

别担心，我这里也有你想要的信息。如果你能帮我，那我也一定能帮你。

messages.en: You allied with Brus Colterne of the Gallente Federation.
messages.zh: 你与盖伦特联邦的布拉斯·科特内进行了合作。

messages.en: You have chosen to side with the Federation. Proceed to Brus Colterne.
messages.zh: 你选择了站在盖伦特联邦一边。请到布拉斯·科特内那儿去。

messages.en: The Gallente Federation have sent commander Brus Colterne to Sheroo as your contact. Colterne is an idealist, but effective. You will find him a reliable ally.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦已派布拉斯·科特内去了歇尔洛。科特内虽是位理想主义者，但做起事情来还是很实在的，可以说是位靠得住的盟友。

messages.en: So, you're the Capsuleer I've heard so much about? I was impressed with your humanitarian efforts for our citizens. Now it is time for darker deeds.
messages.zh: 你就是我常常听到的那个克隆飞行员？你对我们人民的人道关怀很是让我印象深刻，不过现在是时候要做点灰暗的事情了。

messages.en: The Gallente Federation have sent commander Brus Colterne to Sheroo as your contact. Colterne is an idealist, but effective. You will find him a reliable ally.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦已派布拉斯·科特内去了歇尔洛。科特内虽是位理想主义者，但做起事情来还是很实在的，可以说是位靠得住的盟友。

messages.en: You allied with Kitar Ang of the Minmatar Republic.
messages.zh: 你与米玛塔尔共和国的吉塔尔·安格进行了合作。

messages.en: You chose to side with the Minmatar Republic. Proceed to Kitar Ang.
messages.zh: 你选择了站在米玛塔尔共和国一边。请到吉塔尔·安格那儿去。

messages.en: Kitar Ang, a veteran of the Minmatar Republic Fleet, awaits you in Avyuh. She is a brilliant tactician, if impatient.
messages.zh: 吉塔尔·安格是米玛塔尔共和舰队的一名老将，他在奥维乌等着你。也许她耐心不好，但绝对是名出色的战术家。

messages.en: You are the one who destroyed the pirate Izia Tabar? You have my respect. Now it is time to end another threat to the Minmatar people.
messages.zh: 你就是那个消灭了海盗伊兹亚·塔巴尔的人？请接受我的敬意。现在清除米玛塔尔人民另一个威胁的时候到了。

messages.en: Kitar Ang, a veteran of the Minmatar Republic Fleet, awaits you in Avyuh. She is a brilliant tactician, if impatient.
messages.zh: 吉塔尔·安格是米玛塔尔共和舰队的一名老将，他在奥维乌等着你。也许她耐心不好，但绝对是名出色的战术家。

messages.en: You allied with Adani Yusev of the Caldari State.
messages.zh: 你与加达里合众国的埃达尼·约瑟夫进行了合作。

messages.en: You chose to side with the Caldari Empire. Proceed Adani Yusev.
messages.zh: 你选择了站在加达里一边。请到埃达尼·约瑟夫那儿去。

messages.en: Adani Yusev, a contractor with Ishukone, is eager to speak with you in Sosh. I've heard he is the very model of an efficient Caldari soldier.
messages.zh: 异株湖集团的一名承包商，埃达尼·约瑟夫，在索什星系等你去找他。我听说他是加达里士兵高效率作风的典范。

messages.en: You cleared drones from State territory. Admirable. Now we shall annihilate Dagan.
messages.zh: 你把国家领域里的无人机扫清了。很好。现在是解决哒加恩的时候了。

messages.en: Adani Yusev, a contractor with Ishukone, is eager to speak with you in Sosh. I've heard he is the very model of an efficient Caldari soldier.
messages.zh: 异株湖集团的一名承包商，埃达尼·约瑟夫，在索什星系等你去找他。我听说他是加达里士兵高效率作风的典范。

messages.en: You allied with Lear Evanus of the Amarr Empire.
messages.zh: 你与艾玛帝国的里尔·伊万纳斯进行了合作。

messages.en: You chose to side with the Amarr Empire. Proceed to Lear Evanus.
messages.zh: 你选择了站在艾玛帝国一边。请到里尔·伊万纳斯那儿去。

messages.en: The Amarr Empire has sent Lear Evanus, a commander of some fame, to Manarq. She is a firm defender of the Amarr faith. Her zeal will prove effective against Dagan.
messages.zh: 艾玛帝国派遣了小有名气的里尔·伊万纳斯指挥官前去马纳克星系。伊万纳斯是艾玛信仰的忠实追随者，她的热诚一定能够对付哒加恩。

messages.en: You are the one who defeated Taphos? Hah! God smiles on you, my friend. With you backed by Empress' army, what hope does Dagan have?
messages.zh: 你就是击败塔夫斯的那个人？啊！这是神明在向你微笑。有了以女皇的军队做后盾的你，哒加恩还有什么戏可唱？

messages.en: The Amarr Empire has sent Lear Evanus, a commander of some fame, to Manarq. She is a firm defender of the Amarr faith. Her zeal will prove effective against Dagan.
messages.zh: 艾玛帝国派遣了小有名气的里尔·伊万纳斯指挥官前去马纳克星系。伊万纳斯是艾玛信仰的忠实追随者，她的热诚一定能够对付哒加恩。

messages.en: You delivered Dagan into the Sisters' custody, from which he is unlikely to return. While delivering Dagan, a large rogue drone hive appeared but did not attack. Sister Alitura was suspiciously unalarmed.
messages.zh: 你将哒加恩交给了姐妹会看守，他可能再也没法回来了。正当运送哒加恩的时候，一个大型的无人机母巢出现在临近空域，但是却没有发起攻击。令人迷惑的是，当时阿里桃拉修女居然没有任何惊讶的反应。

messages.en: The Gallente Federation asks that you deliver Dagan to the awaiting Sisters of EVE ships.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦要求你将哒加恩运送至正在等待接送的EVE姐妹会船只。

messages.en: As per our agreement with the Sisters of EVE, we will turn Dagan over to their care. A Sisters of EVE ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura assures me Dagan will be treated humanely.
messages.zh: 根据我们同EVE姐妹会签订的协议，我们将会向她们引渡哒加恩。一艘EVE姐妹会的舰船正在等待引渡转运，阿里桃拉修女向我保证哒加恩将会受到公正的待遇。

messages.en:
The rogue drones did what? That's the damndest thing. I've heard they can think for themselves, but I've never heard of them just watching like that. There's something much larger going on than we realize.

Regardless, you've been a tremendous help to the Gallente Federation. Whether you continue your efforts defending the Empires or forge your own empires with your fellow capsuleers in the depths of lawless space, know that you have proven your worth as a demigod.
messages.zh:
自由无人机做了什么？那真是最无耻的事情。我听说它们能够自我思考，但我不知道它们就这样袖手旁观。看来事情的严峻程度已经超乎了我们的想想。

无须赘言，你给盖伦特联邦帮了个大忙。无论你是想要继续为大国服务还是想要在自由的空域铸就你自己的帝国，你已经证明你是个智勇双全的人才。

messages.en: As per our agreement with the Sisters of EVE, we will turn Dagan over to their care. A Sisters of EVE ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura assures me Dagan will be treated humanely.
messages.zh: 根据我们同姐妹会签订的协议，我们将会向她们引渡哒加恩。一艘姐妹会的船只正在等待引渡转运，她们向我保证哒加恩将会受到公正的待遇。

messages.en: You delivered Dagan into the Sisters' custody, from which he is unlikely to return. While delivering Dagan, a large rogue drone hive appeared but did not attack. Sister Alitura was suspiciously unalarmed.
messages.zh: 你将哒加恩交给了姐妹会看守，他可能再也没法回来了。正当运送哒加恩的时候，一个大型的无人机母巢出现在临近空域，但是却没有发起攻击。令人迷惑的是，当时阿里桃拉修女居然没有任何惊讶的反应。

messages.en: The Minmatar Republic asks that you deliver Dagan to the awaiting Sisters of EVE ships.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔共和国要求你把哒加恩移交到正等候着的EVE姐妹会船上。

messages.en: As payment for their aid, the Sisters of EVE have demanded we give them Dagan. I would rather see him stand trial for his crimes, but my superiors have agreed to the Sisters' terms. A ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura will accept nobody other than you to approach. Deliver Dagan to their hands, and let us be done with this.
messages.zh: 作为协助的条件，姐妹会要求我们将哒加恩转交给她们。我很希望能将他送上审判台，但是我的上级已经同姐妹会打成了协议。一只姐妹会舰船正在等待接走哒加恩，阿里桃拉修女只允许你接近她们。将哒加恩转交给姐妹会，让我们为这事儿做一个了断。

messages.en:
More drones appeared, but did not attack? That is a strange thing. I heard that they were truly sentient, but I never quite believed it. There's something much larger going on than we realize.

Regardless, you have proven yourself a friend of the Minmatar Republic. Whether you continue your efforts defending the Empires or forge your own empires with your fellow capsuleers in the depths of lawless space, know that you have proven your worth as a demigod.
messages.zh:
既然来了很多无人机，但是它们为什么不采取任何攻击呢？这真是奇怪的很。我听说它们实际上具有真实的感知能力，但我还从来没有亲眼见过。

无须赘言，你给米玛塔尔共和国帮了个大忙。无论你是想要继续为大国服务还是想要在自由的空域铸就你自己的帝国，你已经证明你是一个智勇双全的人才。

messages.en: As payment for their aid, the Sisters of EVE have demanded we give them Dagan.I would rather see him stand trial for his crimes, but my superiors have agreed to the Sister's terms. A ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura will accept nobody other than you to approach. Deliver Dagan to their hands, and let us be done with this.
messages.zh: 作为协助的条件，姐妹会要求我们将哒加恩转交给她们。我很希望能将他送上审判台，但是我的上级已经同姐妹会打成了协议。一只姐妹会舰船正在等待接走哒加恩，阿里桃拉修女只允许你接近她们。将哒加恩转交给姐妹会，让我们为这事儿做一个了断。

messages.en: You delivered Dagan into the Sister's custody, from which he is unlikely to return. While delivering Dagan, a large rogue drone hive appeared but did not attack. Sister Alitura was suspiciously unalarmed.
messages.zh: 你把哒加恩交给了修女去监管，他应该再也回不来了。在交接的时候，有一大群无人机出现在现场但它们并没有开火。奇怪的是阿里桃拉修女当作像是没看见一样。

messages.en: The Caldari State asks that you deliver Dagan to the awaiting Sisters of EVE ships.
messages.zh: 加达里合众国要求你将哒加恩移交到正在等待的EVE姐妹会船只上。

messages.en: The Sisters of EVE have asked for Dagan himself as payment for their intelligence. The State pays all its debts. A Sisters of EVE ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura demands that only you approach the Sisters ship with Dagan. I see no more fitting way to end this.
messages.zh: 姐妹会要求将哒加恩移交给她们处理作为提供情报的条件。合众国应许了他们的要求。一艘姐妹会的船只正在等待引渡转运，阿里桃拉修女只允许你带着哒加恩过去。让我们给这事儿做个了断吧。

messages.en:
The rogue drones did what? That's the damndest thing. I've heard that they can think for themselves, but I've never heard of them just watching like that. There's something much larger going on than we realize.

Regardless, you've been a tremendous help to the Caldari State. Whether you continue your efforts defending the Empires or forge your own empires with your fellow capsuleers in the depths of lawless space, know that you have proven your worth as a demigod.
messages.zh:
自由无人机做了什么？那真是最无耻的事情。我听说它们能够自我思考，但我不知道它们就这样袖手旁观。看来事情的严峻程度已经超乎了我们的想想。

不用多说，你给加达里合众国帮了个大忙。无论你是想要继续为大国服务还是想要在自由的空域铸就你自己的帝国，你已经证明你是一个智勇双全的人才。

messages.en: As per our agreement with the Sisters of EVE, we will turn Dagan over to their care. A Sisters of EVE ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura assures me Dagan will be treated humanely.
messages.zh: 根据我们同姐妹会签订的协议，我们将会向她们引渡哒加恩。一艘姐妹会的船只正在等待引渡转运，她们向我保证哒加恩将会受到公正的待遇。

messages.en: You delivered Dagan into the Sisters' custody, from which he is unlikely to return. While delivering Dagan, a large rogue drone hive appeared but did not attack. Sister Alitura was suspiciously unalarmed.
messages.zh: 你将哒加恩交给了姐妹会看守，他可能再也没法回来了。正当运送哒加恩的时候，一个大型的无人机母巢出现在临近空域，但是却没有发起攻击。令人迷惑的是，当时阿里桃拉修女居然没有任何惊讶的反应。

messages.en: The Amarr Empire asks that you deliver Dagan to the awaiting Sisters of EVE ships.
messages.zh: 艾玛帝国要求你将哒加恩运送到正在等待的姐妹会舰船上。

messages.en:
The Sisters of EVE have requested that we turn Dagan to their forces as payment for their aid. The Sisters may appear peaceful, but we are providing this Society member no mercy by delivering him to their care.

A Sisters of EVE convoy awaits the deliver of Dagan. They wish you to do the honors. I can think of no one more appropriate.
messages.zh:
作为协助的条件，姐妹会要求我们将哒加恩转交给她们，尽管姐妹会看上去是一个爱好和平的组织，但将哒加恩转交给她们可能会让我显得很无情。

一艘姐妹会舰船正在等待接走哒加恩，她们希望你来经手此事，你就是这个任务的最佳人选。

messages.en:
So the soulless drones returned. I confess their behavior is strange. I had heard that the automatons have a free will of their own, but I never gave it much weight until now. There's something much larger going on than we realize.

But that is a mystery for another day. You have been an ally to the Empress and the Amarr people. Whether you continue your efforts defending the Empires or forge your own empires with your fellow capsuleers in the depths of lawless space, know that you have proven your worth as a capsuleer.
messages.zh:
这么说那些僵尸般的无人机又回来了？我得承认它们的行为是相当诡异的，听说这些自动化机器有着自己的思维，但在这之前我完全没有意识到有这么厉害。看来事情的实际情况已经有些超乎我们的想象了。

那些事情就留着今后再去对付吧，今天你为艾玛人民帮了个大忙。以后无论你是想要继续为大国服务还是想要在自由的空域铸就你自己的帝国，你已经证明你是一个智勇双全的人才。

messages.en:
The Sisters of EVE have requested that we turn Dagan to their forces as payment for their aid. They're welcome to him. The Sisters may appear peaceful, but we are providing this Society member no mercy by delivering him to their care.

A Sisters of EVE convoy awaits the deliver of Dagan. They wish you to do the honors. I can think of no one more appropriate.
messages.zh:
作为协助的条件，姐妹会要求我们将哒加恩转交给她们，她们会好好的欢迎他的。尽管姐妹会看上去是一个爱好和平的组织，但将哒加恩转交给她们可能会让我显得很无情。

一艘姐妹会舰船正在等待接走哒加恩，她们希望你来经手此事，你就是这个任务的最佳人选。

messages.en: As proof to Katsen Isha of my reliability and discretion, I moved some potentially questionable cargo to the Nugoeihuvi HQ in Josameto. A biohazard team was on standby to receive the goods.
messages.zh: 为了向卡僧·伊沙证明我的可信度与判断力，我把一个可能有问题的包裹送到了纳基维集团的乔萨密陀总部。之后那里的一支生化核查队就把东西取走了。

messages.en: As his first task for me, Katsen Isha wants some kind of “delicate” cargo moved from his own station in Poinen to the Nugoeihuvi headquarters in Josameto.
messages.zh: 做为派给我的首项任务，卡僧·伊沙要我把他在波耶伦自己空间站里的某种“细巧”物品运到纳基维集团的乔萨密陀总部。

messages.en:
I'm glad to see you're enthusiastic, but let me make this clear; you're not the first egger I've worked with. I say this so you know that I am well aware of just how capable – and yet completely unreliable – your type can be.

If you work with me, I expect results and I demand integrity. I'll keep plenty of ISK flowing in your direction, but you're going to have to earn it. I don't pay for half-assed jobs. Forgive the bluntness, {[character]player.name}, but I would rather be proven wrong, than told that I am.
messages.zh:
很高兴你能这么热心，但我还是要把丑话说在前面：你不是我合作的第一位克隆飞行员。我这么说是为了让你明白：我清楚你们的能力，但我也知道你们这类人并不可靠。

你跟我合作，就得做出像样的东西来，而且为人要诚信。我这里有很多钱，但你必须要努力之后才能赚得它们。不要把屁股擦不干净的事情交差给我，那样我肯定不付钱。恕我爆了粗口，{[character]player.name}。我希望你还是能以行动证明我的错误观点，而不是嘴上说说。

messages.en: Some associates of mine have come across a fragile package which must be handled delicately, if you get what I mean. You needn't take it far and I've had your path cleared of any obstacles. Transport is simply a matter of discretion on your behalf. Once you have made the delivery, contact me again.
messages.zh: 我同事现在有个需要细心处理的易碎包裹，懂我什么意思吧。你不用把它送到很远的地方。我已经为你清除了所有路障。送不送完全由你自己决定。把东西送到之后就请联系我。

messages.en:
Thank you. It is good to see that even on the little tasks I can trust in your discretion. This is so often where it matters most.

Take some time to enjoy yourself in Onirvura, and get back in touch with me when you're ready to truly begin our work together.
messages.zh:
谢谢你。我很高兴你没有在这些小事上让我失望。我相信“以小见大”的道理。

你现在可以在奥尼尔瓦纳好好放松一下。一旦你觉得已经准备好要与我进行真正的合作，那就请速来见我。

messages.en: Goodbye then, {[character]player.name}, I don't have time to waste.
messages.zh: 那拜拜，{[character]player.name}。我没时间和你耗。

messages.en: Nicknamed the “Shadow HQ” after its curious location, the Nugoeihuvi station in Poinen sits just one jump out from their Headquarters and shares the system with Internal Security HQ, the security arm of NOH. For certain individuals, the station is ideally situated, offering fast and easy personal access to many of NOH's highest-ranking officials – whilst remaining on the periphery of things, unnoticed in the shadow of the 13th moon. To those who are charged with the defense of Nugoeihuvi interests, it is not Josameto but Poinen that is considered the nexus, the bustling heart of a corporation that is their whole world.
messages.zh: 纳基维集团在波耶伦的一座空间站离总部仅一跳之远，与集团安保力量“内部安全”总部共据一个星系。因其独特的地理位置，那座空间站被人戏称为“影子总部”。对某些人而言，该空间站地段优越：即能方便地供人接触纳基维集团众多高层，又因地处边际、暗藏于第十三颗卫星后面而不引人耳目。对于那些负责捍卫纳基维利益的人而言，乔萨密陀并非军团中枢，真正的中枢是波耶伦。

messages.en: Under the Radar
messages.zh: 幕后行事

messages.en:
Welcome to Poinen, {[character]player.name}. I've been expecting you. In fact, I was quite pleased to have someone offer their services so soon after I put the word out.

As I'm sure you know by now, my name is Katsen Isha. I work part-time as a lawyer and consultant for Nugoeihuvi Corporation here in the Onirvura Constellation, where much of our company's most important business is handled.

That brings me to the first task I have for someone, perhaps you. Some associates of mine have come across a fragile package that must be handled delicately. You needn't take it far, and I've had your path cleared of any obstacles. Transport is simply a matter of discretion on your behalf. Could you deliver the cargo to our headquarters in Josameto?
messages.zh:
欢迎来到波耶伦，{[character]player.name}。我很高兴能在我放出风声后没多久后就有人来为我工作了。

想必你已经知道，我名叫卡僧·伊沙，是纳基维集团在奥尼尔瓦纳星座这里的律师兼顾问。我们公司的许多重要事情都在这里做。

我现在要将第一项任务分给某人，或许就是你。我同事现在有个需要细心处理的易碎包裹。你不用把它送到很远的地方。我已经为你清除了所有路障。送不送完全由你自己决定。你能把这包裹运到我们的乔萨密陀总部吗？

messages.en: Then our business is concluded.
messages.zh: 那咱们之间也就没什么再可谈了。

messages.en: I have not yet received any word of a delivery to Josameto HQ. Until that point, I have nothing further to say to you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我还没有收到任何货物已达乔萨密陀总部的消息。你等那之后再来跟我说话，{[character]player.name}。

name.fr: Pertes pour eux et profits pour nous
name.ja: 彼らの損失、我らの利益

messages.en: Katsen Isha told me that Hyasyoda, a corporate competitor, had been renting out land owned by Sukuuvestaa. Not only that, but they lent it out to Serpentis scientists, who were producing some kind of booster. I was charged with taking down the facility and recovering one of their booster formulas – a task I carried out successfully. When I returned with the formula sheets to the Isha, he made no further mention of the facility or the research taking place there, only talking about how he was glad to have struck out at Hyasyoda. I was told to return to him when I wanted to discuss the sale of the stolen goods.
messages.zh: 卡僧·伊沙告诉过我一个叫做三岛集团的竞争对手正将斯库维塔的地皮向外租借。不光如此，他们还向天蛇集团的科学家提供了租赁，让他们生产某种增效剂。我摧毁了那个设施并拿走了他们的一个公式表；我确实成功地执行了那次行动。等我拿着公式表回去找到伊沙，他并没有提到那个设施里面在进行什么样的研究，只是说自己对打击三岛集团的事情是多么地开心。他告诉我等我想要讨论出售公示表的时候就回去找他。

messages.en: Katsen Isha has learned that Hyasyoda, a corporate competitor, has been renting out land owned by Sukuuvestaa. Not only that, but they've lent it out to Serpentis scientists, and have them producing some kind of booster. My assignment is to take down the facility and recover one of their booster formulas. Isha seems less interested in understanding what it is their researching than making some ISK out of it. Sukuuvestaa is on good terms with Nugoeihuvi, so they've agreed to turn a blind eye to anything I may have to do to recover the goods.
messages.zh: 卡僧·伊沙发现一个叫做三岛集团的竞争对手正将斯库维塔的地皮向外租借。不光如此，他们还向天蛇集团的科学家提供了租赁，让他们生产某种增效剂。伊沙似乎对他们在研究什么样的产品并不感兴趣，而对这些东西能赚多少星币更感兴趣。斯库维塔同纳基维的关系不错，所以他们就决定会对我去拿回这些东西的事情睁只眼闭只眼。

messages.en:
Excellent, here are the coordinates. You'll be flying into a heavily-guarded facility owned by Serpentis forces. Find their laboratories and take them out. Intel reports a large amount of Core Admiralty docked inside or patrolling nearby in battleships. They won't be flying alone, so expect smaller support craft wherever you see them.

Once you've recovered the formula sheets we can make arrangements to sell them. You'll need me for that, so don't get any smart ideas about keeping them for yourself. No successful Caldari ever worked alone.
messages.zh:
很好，这里是坐标。你要飞去这个被天蛇集团严密看守的设施。找到他们的实验室然后将其摧毁。情报显示，有大量的海军官员停靠或者在附近巡逻，他们不会是单独出勤的，当你遭遇他们的时候要准备好对付那些支援的战舰。

等你拿到了公式表我们就可以想办法把它卖掉，你会需要我在这上面帮忙的，所以就不要有将其占为己有的想法了。从来没有一个加达里人能独自取得胜利。

messages.en: I want you to acquire some valuable formulas for me. They're hidden away inside a heavily-guarded research facility owned by Serpentis forces. Once you've brought them to me we can make arrangements for their sale.
messages.zh: 我想让你为我找回一些重要的公式。它们被藏匿在一座由天蛇集团部队所有并被他们重兵把守的研究设施中。等你把它取回来给我，我们就可以想法把它卖掉。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. I have to say…it's somewhat pleasing to watch Hyasyoda executives seethe quietly about a theft they cannot report. Hopefully they've learned the same lesson we in NOH did many years ago. Well…no…actually, I hope they screw up this badly every day.

Get back to me when you're ready to discuss how we're going to sell this.
messages.zh:
干得不错，{[character]player.name}。我需要说……看到这些三岛集团的高层面对这样一个不能上报的案件只能在暗地里怒气冲天，这真是让人爽快。希望他们能学到我们当年在NOH里受到的教训。哎……要是他们学不会更好，我希望他们每天都这样把事情搞砸掉。

等你准备好和我讨论我们该怎么把这东西卖掉的时候就回来找我。

messages.en: It will not be hard for me to find another capsuleer to do this for me, {[character]player.name}. Suit yourself.
messages.zh: 要让我再找另外一个克隆飞行员来帮忙并不是一件难事，{[character]player.name}。请你自便吧。

messages.en:
Rivalry among the corporations of the Caldari State is a daily reality, even today. The breakdown of relations with the Federation, opportunistic Guristas invasions and countless other problems facing the Caldari people have done little to ease inter-corporate tensions, some of which predate the existence of the State itself.

In other situations, rather than unifying the Caldari people, external threats only cause further divisiveness, and it is not uncommon for such issues to be leapt upon and twisted towards serving the agenda of one corporation or another. Survival within the harsh political arenas of the State requires a mastery of political cunning. To succeed requires even more – not only the ability to deeply understand events, but the capacity to shape them as well.
messages.zh:
加达里合众国内部各个集团之间的争夺是每天都在上演的现实。与盖伦特联邦关系的恶化，机会主义的古斯塔斯的入侵，还有很多加达里人民所面对的问题都没有能够停止这些企业间的斗争，其中一些矛盾甚至要比合众国本身的历史更加久远。

另一方面，外部的威胁非但没有把加达里人民团结起来，反而更加的促成了分裂的产生，而往往这些事件中都不能同各个集团之间的相互争权夺利而分开来。要想在加达里合众国这样恶劣的政治环境中生存，就必须要具备熟练运用政治技巧。想要成功，则需要更多，不光光是具备对事件良好的洞察力，还要具备操纵事件的实力。

messages.en: Bad Habits
messages.zh: 坏习惯

messages.en:
Welcome back, {[character]player.name}. Now, before we get to anything else there's the matter of money. If I'm going to be paying for your services, then securing some funds is our first priority. My knowledge plus your capabilities equals ISK.

I want you to acquire some valuable formulas for me. They're hidden away inside a deadspace research facility not far from here. I managed to come across the coordinates after a booster-addled Hyasyoda employee let slip about an arrangement to one of my associates. It seems her superiors are allowing criminal types to carry out illegal research in exchange for a cut of the profits…and clearly some of the merchandise too.

As it turns out, our friends in Sukuuvestaa are the legal owners of the space where this little operation is underway, something that certainly helps our situation. They've agreed to have Peace and Order security forces busy themselves with other things while you get to work.

Very foolish of Hyasyoda to mix themselves up with criminals in someone else's backyard, I'm sure you'll agree. I like to see it as an opportunity, however. Not only will we be securing State borders, but also teaching them a valuable lesson about owning one's choices fully. What do you say?
messages.zh:
欢迎回来，{[character]player.name}。在我们开始做其他事情之前，还有一点点钱的问题需要解决。如果我要付钱给你，那就得先要筹措这么一笔资金吧。我的头脑加上你的能力就等于是星币。

我需要你去为我取回一些重要的公式。他们被藏匿在离这里不远的一个死亡空间复合体里面。一个吃错药的三岛集团员工不小心说漏了嘴，说一个我的熟人在同他们进行的接洽，然后我想办法找到了坐标。看来她的上司默认了那些犯罪分子进行非法的研究工作并从中分取利润……当然肯定还有一些货物也在其中。

实际上，我们在斯库维塔的朋友正好是他们所在空域的合法所有者，这绝对是对我们有利的。他们同意在我们开展行动的时候睁只眼闭只眼，让自己的安全部队去别处瞎忙活。

三岛集团在别人的地盘上和犯罪分子瞎搞，这种事情简直是愚蠢透顶了，你肯定也这么认为。我到觉得这是一个机会，我们不光光是在保障合众国边境地区的和谐，也是在给他们上一堂宝贵的课。你觉得怎样

messages.en: I could see that weakness in your eyes even as you accepted the assignment, how disappointing that my instincts proved right. Your replacement is already en route so kindly make yourself disappear, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 就算你接受了这个任务，我还是能从你的眼睛中看到一种软弱，让人失望的是事实验证了我的这个直觉。取代你工作的人现在已经在来的路上了，你从我面前消失吧，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: You have your instructions, {[character]player.name}. I've nothing further to say until you carry them out.
messages.zh: 这就是你的任务，{[character]player.name}。在你执行之前我没有什么还需要交代的了。

messages.en: I lied to Isha, telling him that I need time to think about our options for selling the formulas. In the meantime, I have taken the matter to Hyasyoda, and met with one of their representatives in Wuos. I have my doubts about Nugoeihuvi, just as I'm unsure that Hyasyoda will even hear me out, but I won't be sure of the full story until I've tried to hear both sides.
messages.zh: 我对伊沙撒谎，跟他说给我点时间考虑一下转卖配方的方案。虽然我之前袭击闯入了三岛集团的设施，但我还是决定把这事交给他们去处理。我对纳基维集团心存怀疑，也很怀疑三岛集团是否会真听我，但我必须在听取两方面的意见之后才能确定事情的真相。

messages.en: I lied to Isha, telling him that I need time to think about our options for selling the formulas. I plan to take this matter to Hyasyoda, even though it was their own facility I just broke into. I have my doubts about Nugoeihuvi, just as I'm unsure that Hyasyoda will even hear me out, but I won't be sure of the full story until I've tried to hear both sides.
messages.zh: 我对伊沙撒谎，跟他说给我点时间考虑一下转卖配方的方案。虽然我之前袭击闯入了三岛集团的设施，但我还是决定把这事交给他们去处理。我对纳基维集团心存怀疑，也很怀疑三岛集团是否会真听我，但我必须在听取两方面的意见之后才能确定事情的真相。

messages.en: Attempt to resolve the situation before it escalates. Stall Katsen Isha and buy more time to meet in secret with Hyasyoda. The path of diplomacy is not a lucrative one, but to many Caldari, the rewards that come from the pursuit of peace are one of the only lasting things in this world.
messages.zh: 你要乘事情还未升级之前解决它。拖住卡僧·伊沙，争取点时间去秘密会见三岛集团。外交努力很累人，但对许多加达里人而言，和平之后的成果是这世界上为数不多能长期存在的事物。

messages.en: What? I think I might just hire someone else. Thanks anyhow, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 什么？我看我还是请别人吧。谢了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: The second faction is the liberals, whose views are completely the opposite of the practicals in regards to interstellar trade. The liberals believe in fostering improved relations with all the other empires, creating a world where there are no trade barriers and free-flow of goods. They believe in trade deals that mutually benefit the participants and the empires can come together in a peaceful, prosperous future world only through cooperation. The liberals are led by the Ishukone Corporation and also include the Hyasyoda mega corporation. Their strong position within CONCORD is accentuated by their belief that it is their main vehicle in promoting universal peace and stability so that trade can flow freely and cultures mingle peacefully.
messages.zh: 第二派别便是自由派，他们对待星际贸易所持的态度与现行规则完全相反。自由派坚信加达里应与其他所有帝国都改善关系，以创造一个贸易通行无阻的世界。他们推崇具备互惠性的贸易，并坚信各帝国之间只有通力合作才能共创一个和平繁荣的未来世界。自由派由异株湖集团领导，三岛集团也属于这一派。他们推崇和平与稳定，相信只有如此贸易才能畅行无阻，不同文化才能顺利交融。也正是由于如此这般的信念才使得这两个集团在统合部中有着举足轻重的地位。

messages.en: The Liberal Faction
messages.zh: 自由派

messages.en:
You want more time? Very well, {[character]player.name}.

I'll hold the job for you a little longer, but if I get the impression that you won't be returning, then I'll just hand it off to someone less busy. Business is business, my friend.
messages.zh:
你还要跟多的时间？好吧，{[character]player.name}。

我再给你点时间。但一旦你让我察觉出你会一去不复返，那我马上就会把这任务交给别人。生意就是生意，朋友。

messages.en: What? I think I might just hire someone else. Thanks anyhow, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 什么？我看我还是请别人吧。谢了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you cleared your schedule yet?
messages.zh: 你把日程都安排好了吗？

name.ru: Скрытые пути (The Paths that are Hidden)

messages.en: Isha told me that the Hyasyoda's Corporate Police Force may start investigating us if we cannot quickly sell the Serpentis formula sheets we stole. I had to choose between taking it all the way out to one of their nullsec offices in Syndicate, to a bordering lowsec system, or back to Hyasyoda in the hope that I could resolve all the corporate infighting before it escalates.
messages.zh: 伊沙告诉我如果我们不能尽快把偷来的天蛇蓝图卖掉，那三岛集团的警卫队就会调查我们。我面前只有三条路：一、把蓝图带到他们在辛迪加0.0区域的一座办公室；二、去个接壤的低安全星系；三、返回三岛集团以期赶在集团内斗升级之前摆平此事。

messages.en:
Isha has told me that the Hyasyoda's Corporate Police Force may start investigating us if we cannot quickly sell the Serpentis formula we stole. I have three ways forward. I can take the formula all the way out to Syndicate; a fairly dangerous journey, but no doubt the most lucrative.

The second option isn't much safer, but Isha has let me know that – if I desire – I can take it only to the border of Syndicate, and his people will do the rest. That would let me avoid the nullsec systems altogether.

Alternatively, I could go speak with Hyasyoda. I'm not sure about their involvement in all of this yet. I can't shake the feeling that the facility Isha had me raid was already long ago commandeered by Serpentis, not being rented by them. Perhaps I should speak with Hyasyoda before taking any further steps.
messages.zh:
伊沙告诉我如果我们不能尽快把偷来的天蛇蓝图卖掉，那三岛集团的警卫队就会调查我们。现在有三条路摆在我面前。我可以一路把蓝图带到辛迪加去，这虽比较危险但拿到的钱绝对多。

另一条路也不怎么安全：我可以只把东西送到辛迪加边境，接下来的事交给他派去的人处理。这样我就可以不用去0.0区域了。

最后一条路：我直接去找三岛集团。我还不清楚他们在整件事里所扮演的角色。我至今还不敢相信伊沙要我袭击的那座设施早就不由三岛租借而是被天蛇强占了。或许我应该先去找三岛集团然后再采取下一步行动。

messages.en: Apparently Hyasyoda are more furious than I anticipated. I'm thinking we should probably move the formulas sooner rather than later. Ideally, I would like you to deliver the goods to our facility in KFR-ZE yourself, but I can make arrangements for the staff at KFR to retrieve it from a nearby low-security system if you prefer. That will, of course, reduce your cut of the profits. If you can fly a Covert Ops – or an Interceptor – anything like that, then I would recommend you make use of it now, but how you proceed in light of this situation is up to you. All I want is for the sale to be made; I care less about how.
messages.zh: 三岛集团明显比我预想地要更不满。我想我们还是快点把配方转移为好。我希望你最好能亲自前往KFR-ZE把东西送过去。但如果你不想，那我也可以安排KFR那里的员工到附近的一个低安全星系向你拿货。当然喽，这样做的话你能拿到的钱也会相应减少。如果你能驾驶隐形特勤舰或截击舰之类的船，那我认为现在正是派上它们用场的时候。但具体怎么操作还是你自己拿捏。我只要尽快完成这笔买卖，过程可以忽略。

messages.en: Alright then.
messages.zh: 好吧。

messages.en:
Apparently Hyasyoda are more furious than I anticipated. I'm thinking we should probably move the formula sooner rather than later. I don't exactly want their Corporate Police Force prying into our business.

I've already lined up a buyer for us. All you need to do is move the goods. There's a slight complication though. As I'm sure you can appreciate, my associates – that is, the ones with an interest in highly-illegal booster manufacture – they're stationed at a somewhat remote NOH office outside of CONCORD jurisdiction, where the Chief Executive Panel finds it difficult to keep a close eye on everything.

Ideally, I would like you to deliver the goods to our facility in KFR-ZE yourself, but I can make arrangements for the staff at KFR to retrieve it from a nearby low-security system if you prefer. That will, of course, reduce your cut of the profits. If you can fly a Covert Ops – or an Interceptor – anything like that, then I would recommend you make use of it now, but how you proceed in light of this situation is up to you. All I want is for the sale to be made; I care less about how.
messages.zh:
三岛集团明显比我预想地要更不满。我想我们还是快点把配方转移为好。我不想他们的警卫队来调查我们的商业活动。

我已经联系到了一位买家。你只要把东西送过去就行，只是有一点小麻烦。想必你能理解，我的副手们——他们对于违禁增强剂生产很有兴趣——驻扎在统合部管辖区域之外的一座偏远的纳基维集团办公室。CEO合作组织基本上管不到那片区域。

我希望你最好能亲自前往KFR-ZE把东西送过去。但如果你不想，那我也可以安排KFR那里的员工到附近的一个低安全星系向你拿货。当然喽，这样做的话你能拿到的钱也会相应减少。如果你能驾驶隐形特勤舰或截击舰之类的船，那我认为现在正是派上它们用场的时候。但具体怎么操作还是你自己拿捏。我只要尽快完成这笔买卖，过程可以忽略。

messages.en: Ready to choose?
messages.zh: 准备好做决定了吗？

name.ja: 地獄へのツーステップ
name.ru: Два шага в ад (Two Steps into Hell)

messages.en: I successfully delivered the stolen Serpentis formula to a Nugoeihuvi representative in the KFR-ZE system. We've made a good amount of money from the sale. Isha tells me he has someone he'd like me to meet when I'm ready.
messages.zh: 我成功地将被盗的天蛇配方送交给位于KFR-ZE星系的一位纳维基集团代表，获利颇丰。伊沙说等我整装待发后会让我见个人。

messages.en: I have committed myself to taking the stolen Serpentis formula out to KFR-ZE, a border system in the war-torn Syndicate region. Isha has suggested I travel in through Faurulle, which may make the route a safer one. He tells me there will be someone on standby at a facility in system to receive it.
messages.zh: 我下定决心要将被盗的天蛇配方送到KFR-ZE，它是浴于战火之中的辛迪加星域的边境星系。伊沙建议我走穿越法鲁里的这一条路，因为那条路比较安全。他告诉我会有人在目标星系的一座基地上接货。

messages.en:
I'm glad I can rely on you for something like this, {[character]player.name}. It seems so many capsuleers are becoming more risk-averse these days. It's a mindset I simply can't understand.

Remember that our cargo is precious and there is zero room for error here. If that formula goes missing, so will my desire to work with you. That is our ISK, and the entirety of our business together. Prepare yourself accordingly.
messages.zh:
我很高兴有你在帮助我办理这样的事，{[character]player.name}。看来很多克隆飞行员都越来越不愿意冒风险了，真是不知道这些人怎么想的。

记住，你运送的货物价值连城，我们不允许中间出任何的差错。如果那个公式丢失了，我也再不会和你合作了。那不光是我们的钱财，而且还是我们的整个生意。好好准备一下！

messages.en: Travel out to the nullsec system of KFR-ZE in Syndicate to make the delivery. Isha has highlighted a potential route via the Faurulle system, which will limit the amount of nullsec jumps to only two. Once you have arrived in system, there will be a Nugoeihuvi facility with crew on standby to receive the goods. Regardless of your path, a journey into Syndicate will be a risky one. Nugoeihuvi would pay well, however, for having the goods delivered directly in such a dangerous region.
messages.zh: 请去辛迪加星域的0.0星系KFR-ZE。伊沙已经给你指了一条途径法鲁里的路线，这条路线上只需经过两个0.0星系。你到了目的地后，会有纳维基基地上的人接货。无论你选什么路，去辛迪加都是危险之旅。不过纳维基给的报酬不错，只要你能把东西直接送到这么危险的地方就行。

messages.en:
I admit I am impressed. You have shown a surprising level of patience and commitment here, {[character]player.name}. Here is your pay; you have earned every last Kredit.

Take some time to relax, place a few bets, buy a few drinks…whatever it is you eggers do in your spare time. When you are ready to continue our work, I have someone I want you to meet.
messages.zh:
我承认你的表现超出了我的预料。{[character]player.name}，你展现出了让人意想不到的耐心与专注。这是你的报酬：你既赢得了钱也赢得了信任。

好好放松一下，小赌怡情一番，再叫几杯酒……反正就是那些你们克隆飞行员喜欢的娱乐活动。当你准备好接受下个任务时，我会让你见个人。

messages.en:
There is not much else I can offer, {[character]player.name}. If you cannot commit to this task, then there is no hope that you will be able to see the entirety of our business to its conclusion.

Take some time, train up, gain some confidence. If you find the courage to take this on, I may still have the job open for you. No guarantees, though — there are plenty of capable eggers out there who'd leap on a job like this.
messages.zh:
我这里没有什么其他事可让你干，{[character]player.name}。如果你连这件事都不想完成，那你绝对没希望坚持到最后。

慢慢来，再回去练练，给自己找些信心。如果你觉得你敢接受这任务了，那说不定我还会让你继续做。不过我可不敢打保票——很多能干的克隆飞行员都排队等在你后面呢。

messages.en: Cross the river before you laugh at the current.
messages.zh: 没有实践就没有发言权。

messages.en: Traditional Caldari Saying
messages.zh: 加达里谚语

messages.en:
I'm sure you're aware how dangerous a place Syndicate can be. Serpentis are everywhere, and your fellow capsuleers have given the region a reputation for constant violence and war. I have mapped a route you could take through Genesis, via Faurulle, that will limit the amount of lawless space you need to traverse. That will make the trip longer, but safer. I guess that depends on how you feel about the short route and the jump into PF-346 it entails. That one system alone must have claimed millions of souls over the years; it is notoriously dangerous.

Personally, I would advise discretion, and that you limit your risks. I suggest you take something evasive, be that through speed or cloaking, and avoid the busiest systems. I will have an agent on standby in KFR-ZE at a secure Nugoeihuvi facility near our Station offices. I suggest you avoid the station unless there is a need to dock there. Capsuleer pirates love to corner unaware travelers there; we have to deal with the combat on our doorstep all the time.
messages.zh:
我相信你应该知道辛迪加星域是个多么危险的地方。到处都是天蛇的人，你们这帮克隆飞行员更是让该星域背上了暴力打斗的名声。我已经给你规划了条通过法鲁里穿越吉勒西斯星域的路线，这路能让你少经过一些0.0地区。虽然路线会拉长，但走起来安全了。当然，如果你认为抄近路经过PF-346没啥大不了的，那就另当别论了。数年的时间里已有百万人命丧那星系，那真叫出了名的危险。

我的个人建议是谨慎行事，降低风险。最好利用速度或是隐身之类的规避手段前进，避免闯入人多的星系。我会叫我的一个代理人在我们KFR-ZE星系空间站附近的一座纳维基基地上等你。除非需要停靠，否则你不要去空间站。海盗们喜欢偷袭毫无准备的飞行员；我们必须时刻在自家门口做好作战准备。

messages.en:
There is not much else I can offer, {[character]player.name}. If you cannot finish this task, then there is no hope that you will be able to see the entirety of our business to its conclusion.

Take some time, train up, gain some confidence. If you find the courage to take this on, I may still have the job open for you. No guarantees, though — there are plenty of capable eggers out there who'd leap on a job like this.
messages.zh:
我这里没有什么其他事可让你干，{[character]player.name}。如果你连这件事都不想完成，那你绝对没希望坚持到最后。

慢慢来，再回去练练，给自己找些信心。如果你觉得你敢接受这任务了，那说不定我还会让你继续做。不过我可不敢打保票——很多能干的克隆飞行员都排队等在你后面呢。

messages.en: KFR-ZE, {[character]player.name}. That is your current destination. Our people are waiting for you.
messages.zh: KFR-ZE，{[character]player.name}。你现在该去那里。我们的人在等你。

messages.en: I successfully delivered the stolen Serpentis formula to a Nugoeihuvi representative in the Faurulle system. We've made a decent amount of money from the sale. Isha tells me he has someone he'd like me to meet when I'm ready.
messages.zh: 我成功地将被盗的天蛇配方送交给位于法鲁里星系的一位纳维基集团代表，获利颇丰。伊沙说等我整装待发后会让我见个人。

messages.en: I have committed myself to taking the stolen Serpentis formula out to Faurulle, a low-security system in Solitude that borders the war-torn Syndicate region. Isha tells me there will be someone on standby at a facility in system to receive it. He has suggested I keep my visit quick, to avoid getting scanned down inside the compound by any local pirates.
messages.zh: 我下定决心要将被盗的天蛇配方送到孤独之域的法鲁里低安全星系。孤独之域与浴于战火之中的辛迪加星域接壤。伊沙告诉我会有人在那星系的一座基地上接货。他建议我行动要快，不要被当地海盗用扫描抓住。

messages.en:
Very well — if you prefer to play it safe, I don't mind.

Even still, I'm sure you're aware that low-security space has its dangers. Carelessness out there will get you killed just as easily as jumping into a nullsec stargate blockade, so don't get complacent.

Remember, our cargo is precious and there is zero room for error here. If that formula goes missing, so will my desire to work with you. That ISK is the entirety of our business together. Prepare yourself accordingly.
messages.zh:
好，我不介意你选了个保命方案。

不过我相信你应该知道低安全区也存在风险。你只要在那里稍微放松一下警惕，结果就会像闯入一个被堵0.0星门一样：瞬间被干掉。所以切勿麻痹大意。

很好。但要记得，我们的货物很重要，容不得半点闪失。如果那配方没了，那我与你再合作的欲望也就没了。我们合作就是为了钱，你要做得像样才行。

messages.en: Travel out to the lowsec system of Faurulle in Solitude to make the delivery. Once you have arrived in system, there will be a Nugoeihuvi facility with crew on standby to receive the goods. You will lose a percentage of the profit if you decide on this route, although the remaining risk and time involved will ensure it is still quite lucrative.
messages.zh: 请把物品送往孤独之域的法鲁里低安全星系。你到了那儿之后，会有人在一座纳维基基地等着接货。虽然选了此路你获得的报酬会有所减少，但减去之后的报酬还是蛮有引诱力的。

messages.en:
I admit I am impressed. You have shown a surprising level of patience and commitment here, {[character]player.name}. Honestly, I think you could have made it all the way to KFR-ZE, but oh well. Here is your pay: you have earned every last Kredit.

Take some time to relax, place a few bets, buy a few drinks… whatever it is you eggers do in your spare time. When you are ready to continue our work, I have someone I want you to meet.
messages.zh:
我承认你的表现超出了我的预料。{[character]player.name}，你展现出了让人意想不到的耐心与专注。说实话，我觉得你应该可以一路飞往KFR-ZE的，不过现在算了。这是你的报酬：你既赢得了钱也赢得了信任。

好好放松一下，小赌怡情一番，再叫几杯酒……反正就是那些你们克隆飞行员喜欢的娱乐活动。当你准备好接受下个任务时，我会让你见个人。

messages.en:

我这里没有什么其他事可让你干，{[character]player.name}。如果你连这件事都不想完成，那你绝对没希望坚持到最后。

messages.en: Traditional Caldari Saying
messages.zh: 加达里谚语

We've lost a few convoys recently, trying to pass through PF-346 along the shortest route to State space. In case you don't know it, {[character]player.name}, the PF-346 system has been made notorious by bloodthirsty capsuleers. I think it is perhaps best for all involved that we take no risks on this one and use the Faurulle drop-off.

This is where you will be taking our formula. I will have my people on standby at a secure facility in-system. Please, though, do not linger there. There are no stations in system, so anyone noticing you will know that you're out in space somewhere. The very last thing we need is some pirate scanning you down in one of our own facilities, and especially not in that one.

我们KFR-ZE的人有时是通过法鲁里进入合众国领域的。这是从辛迪加出来的首选最快路线。最近我们试图飞越PF-346，想走一条到加达里的最短路线，结果却损失了一些船。我不知道你是否清楚，{[character]player.name}，PF-346星系被一群残忍成性的海盗搞得乌烟瘴气。我觉得为所有参与此事的人着想，我们不应该挺而走险闯这条道，还是走法鲁里这星系比较好。

你把配方带去那里。我会安排我的人在那星系的一个安全基地上等你的。你可不要在那里做任何滞留，那星系里没有任何空间站，因此注意到你的人都会知道你肯定飘在太空某处。我们可不想让某个海盗通过扫描查出你在我们的某座基地，尤其是那座基地。

messages.en:
What did I tell you?

Goodbye, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
忘了我跟你说什么来着？

再见，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Faurulle, {[character]player.name}. That is your current destination. Our people are waiting for you.
messages.zh: 法鲁里，{[character]player.name}。你现在该去那里。我们的人在等你。

name.ja: 地獄へのツーステップ
name.ru: Два шага в ад (Two Steps into Hell)

Our cargo is precious and there is zero room for error here. If that formula goes missing, so will my desire to work with you. That is our ISK, and the entirety of our business together. Prepare yourself accordingly.

我很高兴有你在帮助我办理这样的事，{[character]player.name}。看来很多克隆飞行员都越来越不愿意冒风险了，真是不知道这些人怎么想的。

记住，你运送的货物价值连城，我们不允许中间出任何的差错。如果那个公式丢失了，我也再不会和你合作了。那不光是我们的钱财，而且还是我们的整个生意。好好准备一下！

messages.en: Travel out to the nullsec system of KFR-ZE in Syndicate to make the delivery. 再见，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Faurulle, {[character]player.name}. That is your current destination. Our people are waiting for you.
messages.zh: 法鲁里，{[character]player.name}。你现在该去那里。我们的人在等你。

messages.en: Isha somehow learned of the Hyasyoda investigation team and even uncovered the location of their headquarters. He tasked me with leveling the place and killing the mercenary forces guarding it. I spoke with CPF Agent Arikio Kuretsu about the situation. Her people are coming up with a strategy to handle it.
messages.zh: 伊沙不知通过怎样的途径已经获悉了三岛集团的调查行动，而且更糟的是还了解到了调查队的驻扎地。他要求我去把守卫驻扎地的雇佣兵干掉。我向警卫队的代理人阿里可汇报了这一情况。她手下的人正在想对策。

messages.en: Isha has somehow learned of the Hyasyoda investigation team and worse yet, knows the location of their headquarters. He has tasked me with leveling the place and killing the mercenary forces guarding it. Hyasyoda assured me that any orders Isha gave over FTL comms would find their way back to the team, so I can only assume they're aware of the matter. I should head back to Arikio Kuretsu at the Hyasyoda HQ to see how she wants to proceed.
messages.zh: 伊沙不知通过怎样的途径已经获悉了三岛集团的调查行动，而且更糟的是还了解到了调查队的驻扎地。他要求我去把守卫驻扎地的雇佣兵干掉。三岛集团给我吃定心丸，向我保证他们的调查队会窃听伊沙下达的所有指令，但愿他们现在已经知道了此事。我应该回三岛的总部去见阿里可·库利茨，听听她有什么对策。

messages.en: Yes, I can understand your hesitance, but there is no other way to resolve this, {[character]player.name}. I will give you some time to reconsider the plan.
messages.zh: 我理解你的踌躇，但这是解决问题的唯一办法，{[character]player.name}。我给你点时间让你再考虑考虑。

messages.en: Time is our greatest enemy here, {[character]player.name}. You should get going. The CPF could replace their stand-in mercs at any moment.
messages.zh: 时间是我们最大的敌人，{[character]player.name}。你应该行动起来了。警卫队可能随时替换掉那批雇佣兵。

messages.en: Arikio has asked that I return to Isha, earn his trust, and do what I can to uncover the truth about the matter. I have agreed to take the task on. I've been given the formula blueprint back, which we'll use to learn more about Isha when we make a sale. A Hyasyoda counterintelligence team is now plugged into my comms systems and will be trailing me out of sight. I'm supposed to speak of this to nobody. Arikio says that if I need her, she'll be waiting in Wuos.
messages.zh: 阿里可要求我回到伊沙那儿获取他的信任，并尽一切所能查出事情的真相。我答应了该要求。阿里可把那配方蓝图又交于我手里。将此图卖出之后，我们便可以进一步深入了解伊沙。三岛集团的一直反侦队已在我采用的通信系统里安装了偷听器，将对我进行远程跟踪。按道理说我不能向任何人透露此事。阿里可说如果我需要见她，她会在乌欧斯等我。

messages.en: I have been asked to continue my betrayal of Nugoeihuvi and to spy on Katsen Isha. Arikio is convinced that it will be the only way we can get to the bottom of this mess.
messages.zh: 我被要求继续背叛纳基维集团，监视卡僧·伊沙的一举一动。阿里可坚信这是唯一能把事情查个水落石出的方法。

messages.en:
We have to bring Katsen Isha down, and we have to be exceptionally careful about how we do it. Dealing with Nugoeihuvi requires cunning and guile. You've shown sound judgment by coming to us early, {[character]player.name}. The problem is that it will only get worse if you leave things as they are now. We need answers to the questions you've brought to light.

We will count on you to earn Isha's trust, so you can uncover whatever you need to help us. We need you on the inside if we're ever going to see this resolved; Nugoeihuvi are too well trained at covering up their tracks.

We will be there every step of the way to assist you. I've granted you provisional support from one of our best counter-intelligence teams. They will observe your actions from a distance and monitor any relevant data from your fluid router cache. Anything Isha says to you over FTL, we will have. Anything your camera drones see, we will see.

You will have to keep your assignment strictly confidential, even from other Hyasyoda members. Nobody can know. Not your lover, not your mother, not even the Maker. If you need to get in touch, I will be here. Otherwise, act as if this conversation never happened.
messages.zh:
我们要把卡僧·伊沙除掉。不过我们得小心行事。对付纳基维集团要的是足智多谋。{[character]player.name}，你最初来找我们就证明你已具备正确的判断力，但如果你现在就撤的话，那事情只会朝坏的方向发展。我们要找到你发现的那些问题的答案。

我们相信你能获取伊沙的信任以便查出一切必要信息。如果要了结此事，我们必须要你打入他们内部。纳基维人受过良好训练，知道如何掩饰自己的行踪。

我们会在每一步都协助你。我已获得上级允许，可以派出我们最好的反侦队之一来临时协助你。他们会远程观察你的行动，密切监视你通信缓存里的任何有关数据。伊沙通过信道与你进行的任何通话我们都能窃听得到。你录像无人机所能捕获的画面我们也都能看得到。

你必须对此任务绝对保密，即使面对三岛的其他人员，你也不能漏得半点风声。你的爱人、母亲甚至上帝……谁都不能得知此事。如果你需要与我们联系，我会在这里等你。其他时候，你得装得现在这段对话像没发生过一样。

messages.en: Then why did you come here? What am I to make of this refusal? I think our business with one another is concluded.
messages.zh: 那你到这里来干嘛？你这拒绝算什么意思？看来我们的合作就到此为止了。

messages.en: Internal Security, the Nugoeihuvi Corporation's force, poses a curious irony in this regard. Though the Nugoeihuvi conglomerate's main preoccupation is the entertainment industry, they have consistently failed to change the prevalent cultural image of their troops as a pack of rough-and-tumble thugs culled from the Caldari underworld, given to the grossest abuses and atrocities. It's very rare for elements of the Caldari State to find the rumor mill outgrinding them in their efforts at propaganda, but that's what's happening to Nugoeihuvi. (In reality, for the record, Nugoeihuvi's soldiers are not any more or less savage than those of the other corporate forces, though broadly speaking they have been noted to harbor a slightly greater proclivity toward drink and drugs.)
messages.zh: 作为纳基维集团的武装部队，“内部安全”的存在多少有点讽刺意味。虽然该集团的主业是娱乐事业，但他们却无法改变众人对其部队的印象：一群饱受折磨、来自加达里黑社会的地痞流氓。在加达里合众国里，官方口径沉于流言蜚语绝对是件稀罕事，但这事却在纳基维集团身上发生了。（需要指明的是，其他集团的部队也差不多同样粗鄙。只不过从大体上说，纳基维的士兵更喜欢酒精药品一点而已。）

messages.en: Masks of Authority
messages.zh: 官方的面具

messages.en:
This Katsen Isha…he needs to be brought down, but we have to be exceptionally careful about how we do this. Dealing with Nugoeihuvi requires cunning and guile. You've shown sound judgment by coming to us early, {[character]player.name}, but it will only get worse if you leave things as they are now. We need answers to the questions you've brought to light.

Can we count on you to earn Isha's trust, so you can uncover whatever you need to help us? We need someone on the inside if we're ever going to see this resolved; Nugoeihuvi are too well-trained at covering up their tracks. If you could be there, making the sale of the formulas yourself, we would undoubtedly learn a great deal.

If you're willing to take this on, then we will be there to assist you every step of the way. I've been authorized to grant you provisional support from one of our best counter-intelligence teams. They would observe your actions from a distance and monitor any relevant data from your fluid router cache. Anything Isha said to you over FTL, we would have. Anything your camera drones saw, we would see.

You would have to keep your assignment strictly confidential, even from other Hyasyoda members. Nobody could know. Not your lover, not your mother, not even the Maker. If we need you again, we'll find a way to get in touch, but until that time you would only have to concern yourself with earning Isha's trust and acting as if this conversation never happened.

Do we have a deal?
messages.zh:
这个卡僧·伊沙……我们要把他除掉。不过我们得小心行事。对付纳基维集团要的是足智多谋。{[character]player.name}，你最初来找我们就证明你已具备正确的判断力，但如果你现在就撤的话，那事情只会朝坏的方向发展。我们要找到你发现的那些问题的答案。

你能确保获取伊沙的信任以便查出一切必要信息吗？如果要了结此事，我们必须有人打入他们内部。纳基维人受过良好训练，知道如何掩饰自己的行踪。如果你能去那儿亲自把这配方卖掉，那我们无疑会了解到很多信息。

如果你愿意接手此事，那我们会在每一步都协助你。我已获得上级允许，可以派出我们最好的反侦队之一来临时协助你。他们会远程观察你的行动，密切监视你通信缓存里的任何有关数据。伊沙通过信道与你进行的任何通话我们都能窃听得到。你录像无人机所能捕获的画面我们也都能看得到。

你必须对此任务绝对保密，即使面对三岛的其他人员，你也不能漏得半点风声。你的爱人、母亲甚至上帝……谁都不能得知此事。如果我们需要你，我们会有办法与你联系的。你现在只要全心全意、想方设法获取伊沙的信任就行。另外，你得装得现在这段对话像没发生过一样。

你愿意合作吗？

messages.en: I should have known better...
messages.zh: 我应该早就料到这点了……

messages.en: You shouldn't linger here, return to Isha as soon as possible. His agents could be following you even now.
messages.zh: 你不应该在此滞留了，快回伊沙那儿。他的特工说不定现在已经盯上你了。

messages.en: Isha somehow learned of the Hyasyoda investigation team and even uncovered the location of their headquarters. He charged me with leveling the place and killing the mercenary forces guarding it. I spoke with Arikio about the situation. Her people are coming up with a strategy to handle it.
messages.zh: 伊沙不知通过怎样的途径已经获悉了三岛集团的调查行动，而且更糟的是还了解到了调查队的驻扎地。他要求我去把守卫驻扎地的雇佣兵干掉。我向阿里可汇报了这一情况。她手下的人正在想对策。

messages.en: Isha has somehow learned of the Hyasyoda investigation team and, worse yet, knows the location of their headquarters. He has asked me to level the place and destroy the mercenary ships guarding it. Hyasyoda assured me that any orders Isha gave over FTL comms would find their way back to the team, so I can only assume they're aware of the matter. I should head back to Arikio Kuretsu at the Hyasyoda HQ to see how she wants to proceed.
messages.zh: 伊沙不知通过怎样的途径已经获悉了三岛集团的调查行动，而且更糟的是还了解到了调查队的驻扎地。他要求我去把守卫驻扎地的雇佣兵干掉。三岛集团给我吃定心丸，向我保证他们的调查队会窃听伊沙下达的所有指令，但愿他们现在已经知道了此事。我应该回三岛的总部去见阿里可·库利茨，听听她有什么对策。

messages.en: Good, then. Remember, {[character]player.name} — the Logistics Center is your only target. You can limit the loss of life here by taking it down quickly and then getting the hell out. If you linger, they will most likely swarm you with reinforcements and pin you down. Don't get complacent just because they're mercs; Hyasyoda is funding them and will make damn sure they get their money's worth.
messages.zh: 很好。记住，{[character]player.name}——你的目标只是后勤中心。只要你动作快点把它炸掉然后迅速撤离，那你就能将人员伤亡程度降到最低。如果你恋战，那对方极有可能叫来援兵将你穷追猛打。别以为对方是雇佣兵就掉以轻心；三岛出钱请来的肯定帮货真价实的家伙。

messages.en:
The Corporate Police Force investigation must be brought to an end before it can uncover anything that could lead back to us. The forces inside the facility right now are not Hyasyoda or CPF personnel, just some hired mercs. This gives us an opportunity to strike preemptively at the compound without causing an incident and further complicating matters.

If you can destroy the Logistics Center quickly, it will set them back weeks. The paths that lead back to us will have faded by the time they can resume their investigation. You can limit the loss of life here by taking it down quickly and then getting the hell out. If you linger, they will most likely swarm you with reinforcements.
messages.zh:
我们必须赶在警卫队找出与我们相关的线索之前终结他们的调查行动。现在设施内部的武装力量既不是三岛集团的人也不是警卫队的人，而是一帮花钱请来的雇佣兵。这样我们就能先发制人打击他们，不必担心事态升级。

你只要把那后勤中心迅速捣毁，那他们近几周的工作就会白费。等他们再组织起来调查时，就肯定查不到与我们有关的线索了。只要你动作快点把后勤中心炸掉然后迅速撤离，那你就能将人员伤亡程度降到最低。如果你恋战，那对方极有可能叫来援兵将你穷追猛打。

messages.en: Yes, I can understand your hesitance, but there is no other way to resolve this, {[character]player.name}. Good luck in your journeys, I've a replacement to find.
messages.zh: 我理解你的踌躇，但这是解决问题的唯一办法，{[character]player.name}。祝你一路顺风。我找别人去了。

messages.en: Hyasyoda is one of the oldest of the Caldari megacorporations, having been formed shortly after first contact with Gallente when the Caldari were still in their Industrial Age. Throughout State history, Hyasyoda executives have always been conservative and cautious. As a result the corporation has informally claimed as theirs the age old Caldari saying, “only the paranoid survive.”
messages.zh: 三岛集团是加达里历史最悠久的超级军团之一，于加达里与盖伦特接触后不久创建，那时加达里还处于工业时代。自加达里成立以来，三岛集团的高层一直行事谨慎，作风保守。因此该集团将一句加达里古谚语非正式地往自己脸上贴：多点担心总没错的。

messages.en: Paranoia
messages.zh: 神经质

messages.en:
Ah, you're back, {[character]player.name}. Good. I hope your journey out toward Syndicate hasn't left you too burned out; I'm going to need you to act quickly on something else. It turns out we have one more loose end to tie up.

My people tell me that Hyasyoda have already launched an investigation into the blueprint theft. Worse yet, I am hearing talk about the sort of funding coming their way. The amounts are disconcerting — enough to pay for a capsuleer's services in addition to a whole fleet of mercenaries and investigators. The situation is dangerous for us, {[character]player.name}. Our tracks are well covered, but, as they often say at Hyasyoda, only the paranoid survive.

They've deployed their security wing, the Corporate Police Force, into “various locations of interest.” I've learned that Onirvura was listed as an area to investigate. They're right here in the constellation, setting up a temporary base for interrogation and imprisonment. Fortunately for us, the CPF has hired a mercenary crew to handle facility defense while they set up. This gives us an opportunity to strike at them without it constituting a direct attack on Hyasyoda personnel. That is simply not an option.

I cannot guarantee how long these mercenaries will be on duty, however, nor what kind of reaction your arrival on scene will provoke. What I do know is that if you can destroy the Logistics Center quickly, it will set them back weeks. The paths that lead back to us will undoubtedly have faded by the time they can resume their investigation.
messages.zh:
哦，你回来了，{[character]player.name}。我希望辛迪加之旅没把你累趴下。我现在要你迅速解决另一件事，我们还有件事没摆平。

我的人告诉我三岛集团已经介入追查蓝图偷盗人了。对我们更不利的是他们这次调查资金很充裕。那数目真吓人——足够请一个克隆飞行员再加一支雇佣兵队伍及调查人员了。情况真的不妙，{[character]player.name}。我们虽然事情做得不露马脚，但——就像三岛集团自己人那个说什么来着——多点担心总没错的。

他们已经将其警卫队派向了“各重点区域”。听说奥尼尔瓦纳便是其中之一。他们目前就在本星座，正在搭建一个用于调查与囚禁的临时基地。还好，警卫队雇了一批雇佣兵来守卫建造中的基地。这样我们就可以不用直接袭击三岛的人员来端掉这基地了。三岛自己的人我们是绝对不能动的。

不过我也掐不准那批雇佣兵还能待多久，也无法估计出你到场后他们会有什么反应。我只知道你只要把那后勤中心迅速捣毁，那他们近几周的工作就会白费。等他们再组织起来调查时，就肯定查不到与我们有关的线索了。

messages.en: Well, ok then. Good luck in your journeys, I've a replacement to find.
messages.zh: 好吧算了。祝你一路顺风。我找别人去。

messages.en: Time is our greatest enemy, {[character]player.name}. You should get going. The CPF could replace their stand-in mercs at any moment.
messages.zh: 时间是我们最大的敌人，{[character]player.name}。你应该行动起来了。警卫队可能随时替换掉那批雇佣兵。

name.fr: Un peu de mise en scène

messages.en: I met again with Hyasyoda Agent Arikio Kuretsu, who tasked me with saving the investigation team's HQ. NOH had bugged the CPF compound, but we used their own taps against them. I hacked into their surveillance software, disabled it and quickly evacuated everyone. Hyasyoda agents then detonated each one as it emptied. As far as NOH should be aware, I have completed my mission successfully. I am to report back to Arikio when I am ready to be briefed about one final assignment that Hyasyoda has for me.
messages.zh: 我又与三岛集团代理人阿里可·库利茨见了面，她要我拯救调查队总部。纳维基集团在警备队基地中安放了偷听器，但我们可以利用那些东西。我破解掉了他们的监察软件，关闭了它，然后迅速将每个人都转移了出去。三岛集团的代理人然后引爆了炸弹。在纳维基集团的人看来，我成功地完成了他们交给我的任务。当我准备好接受三岛集团即将交给我的最后一项任务时，我会去向阿里可报到

messages.en: I met again with Hyasyoda Agent Arikio Kuretsu after learning that Isha had discovered the location of the investigation team's Headquarters. She told me that the CPF has a plan to deal with him personally, but for now I have been tasked with salvaging the situation. It seems that NOH have bugged the CPF compound, but we can use that against them. The strategy is to hack into their surveillance software, disable it, quickly evacuate everyone, and then clear the area before Hyasyoda agents detonate explosives laid inside. The explosions should register on the other bugging devices, and once each of them are destroyed, nobody will know that they were disabled a few moments beforehand, nor what happened in that small window of time after they were. At least, that's the plan.
messages.zh: 在获悉伊沙发现了调查队的总部之后，我又与三岛集团代理人阿里可·库利茨见了面。她告诉我警备队有解决他的打算，但我现在先要执行一项营救任务。纳维基集团似乎在警备队基地中安放了偷听器，但我们可以其人之道还至其人之身。我们的策略就是破解掉他们的监察软件，关闭它，然后迅速将每个人都转移出去，最后由三岛集团的人将埋藏其中的炸弹引爆。虽然基地里的偷听器会记录到此次爆炸，但它们一定会随之被毁。这样就没人知道它们之前被人关闭的事情，也没人知道它们关闭之后的这一小段时间内发生的事情。至少按计划就应该是这样的。

messages.en: Good. I will give you further instructions out there. Pay careful attention to them, everything rests on your shoulders.
messages.zh: 很好。你到了那儿的时候我会给你进一步指示的。你要对他们特别关注，一切的重担都落在你肩上。

messages.en:
We need to reposition our people out of Nugoeihuvi's way and not let Isha realize we're aware of his intentions in the process. You must convince Isha that you have destroyed the facility and everyone in it.

We have found a series of bugs implanted by NOH agents throughout our compound. We have not interfered with them in any way so far. Our plan is to have you disable them only moments before you move everyone out. Immediately after that point, we will trigger the detonation of explosive charges already set in each compromised facility. When Nugoeihuvi notice their surveillance has gone down, they'll suspect one of two things; that you have carried out your task, or that their bugs have been compromised. We want it to be the former.
messages.zh:
我们要转移我们人员以躲避纳维基集团，同时还不能让伊沙明白我们已经拆穿了其意图。你必须要让伊沙相信你摧毁了那座基地及其中的每一个人。

我们在我们的基地中发现了一系列由纳维基代理人安放的偷听器。我们目前还未对它们采取任何行动。我们的计划是让你在即将转移人员之前才去废这些东西。你把人都转出之后，我们会立即引爆先前放置在每座被暴露的基地里的炸弹。纳维基的人发觉他们的偷听器不再工作之后，要么就是以为你已经完成了任务；要么就醒悟过来知道他们的偷听器被人发现了。我们要他们出现第一种反应。

messages.en:
You know, {[character]player.name}, all I've ever seen from your kind is death and destruction, until today, at least. We are – and I am – humbled to have you working for us.

I will leave it at that, for now. You have done enough today that I would feel overbearing trying to dump yet more work on your shoulders. Whenever you are ready though, we would like to brief you on one last assignment before you return to Katsen Isha. Until then, rest well. You've certainly earned it.
messages.zh:
你知道吗，{[character]player.name}，我以前以为你们这类人只知道打来打去。但现在，我们——以及我个人——都为你能与我们合作而感到荣幸。

我现在就把话说到这儿吧。你今天已经尽心尽责，我不忍心再让你承担任何工作。但只要你准备好，我们就将在你返回卡僧·伊沙那儿之前派给你最后一项任务。现在请好好休息，这是你该享受的。

messages.en: You have come with us this far, {[character]player.name}, can you not see us through to the end? We cannot trust any other egger. If there was something else you needed to do then go do it. I will be eagerly awaiting your return.
messages.zh: 你已经和我们合作到这份上了，{[character]player.name}，难道你就不能和我们一起为这事画上句号吗？我们无法信任其他任何克隆飞行员。如果你确实有其他事要办，那就赶紧去做。我会等你回来。

messages.en: Altercations between the corporate forces exist on record, but in almost every case they have been small incidents based on misunderstanding, with warning shots the only ordnance released. A notable exception is an incident known as the Ingalles incident, where soldiers belonging to the Wiyrkomi Peace Corps opened fire on a Hyasyoda convoy being escorted by the Hyasyoda's agency, the Corporate Police Force.
messages.zh: 虽然军团间确实爆发过公开矛盾，但几乎每个矛盾都是由一些误会导致的，双方最多就是互发狠话，然后象征性地对轰一下大炮。但一个值得一提的特例就是伊格拉斯事件。在这起事件中，维克米和平工业的士兵向由三岛集团警备队护航的一支三岛集团运输队开了火。

messages.en: Masks of Authority
messages.zh: 官方的面具

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, welcome back. We've been watching.

You've done well so far, but this current situation threatens to undermine everything. This Isha character is far smarter than we gave him credit for and I fear he knows even more than he has trusted you with. We are working on something that should remove him from the picture, but for now we have to act quickly; our investigations team and their work must remain secure.

The task that lies ahead is a large one, {[character]player.name}. We not only need to reposition our people out of Nugoeihuvi's way, but we also need to convince Isha that you have destroyed the facility and everyone in it.
