After we learned that our location had been compromised, we did a full electronics sweep of the area. The loyalty of the staff working here was never in question, so we knew it had to be electronics surveillance.

Sure enough, we found a series of bugs in our surveillance systems. We have not interfered with them in any way so far. Our plan, {[character]player.name}, is to have you disable the surveillance only moments before you move everyone out. Immediately after that point, we will trigger the detonation of explosive charges already set in the compromised facility. When Nugoeihuvi notice their surveillance has gone down, they'll suspect one of two things; that you have carried out your task, or that their bugs have been compromised. We want it to be the former, understood?

There is much at stake here, {[character]player.name}. Your mission must be carried out flawlessly. Please be aware before taking it on, that you will need the ability to hack into hostile Nugoeihuvi surveillance systems. If you cannot hack, find someone who can, or quickly learn the basics yourself. That should be enough.
messages.zh:
欢迎回来，{[character]player.name}。我们一直在关注着你。

你迄今为止干得不错，但我们目前面临的形势却有可能让我们的一切努力化为乌有。伊沙这人远比我们之前以为的要聪明，而且我担心他还有事情瞒着你。我们正在酝酿把他除去，但现在我们还有更紧要的一件事要做。我们必须确保我们调查队的安全，让他们能顺利进行工作。

现在我们面临一项大任务，{[character]player.name}。我们不仅要转移我们人员以躲避纳维基集团，更要让伊沙相信你摧毁了那座基地及其中的每一个人。之前我们获悉我们的位置暴露之后，就对那里进行了一次电子设备大搜查。我们员工的忠心是不容置疑的，我们知道一定是电子监察设备在作祟。

果然，我们在监察系统中发现了一系列偷听器。我们目前还未对它们采取任何行动。{[character]player.name}，我们的计划是让你在即将转移人员之前废了这些东西。你把人都转出之后，我们会引爆先前放置在那座被暴露基地里的炸弹。纳维基的人发觉他们的偷听器不再工作之后，要么就是以为你已经完成了任务；要么就醒悟过来知道他们的偷听器被人发现了。我们要他们出现第一种反应，懂吗？

这事风险很大，{[character]player.name}。你必须完美地完成这项任务。在接受它之前，你必须具备破解纳维基集团监察系统的能力。如果你没能力破解，那就找个有这种能力的人，或者快点自己去学点这方面的基础知识也行。

messages.en: Then leave. If you cannot be trusted to help us in this time of need, then you cannot be trusted, period.
messages.zh: 那就请回吧。既然在我们需要的时候你无法帮上忙，那你就是个不值得信任的人。

messages.en: Head out to the investigation team's HQ, {[character]player.name}. I will provide further instructions once you're on-site.
messages.zh: 请前往调查队的总部，{[character]player.name}。你到了那儿的时候我会给你进一步指示的。

messages.en:
After hearing my story and speaking with her superiors, Arikio Kuretsu of Hyasyoda asked me to return the stolen booster formulas as proof of my sincerity. I complied and handed the formula back over. I seem to have earned her trust for doing so. She asked that I return to her when I'm ready to hear about what comes next.

My suspicions turned about to be justified, too. Arikio is claiming that Hyasyoda lost control of the research facility long ago. Her assumption is that Sukuuvestaa and Nugoeihuvi are somehow involved in the affair, since the Serpentis raiders who forced them out were too well established in the area to have been acting alone.
messages.zh:
在听了我的故事并与她上级谈过之后，三岛集团的阿里可·库利茨要求我将拿走的增效剂配方交还给她以表明我的诚意。我按照她说的把配方还给了她。看样子我已经获取了其信任。她说我可以再去找她问接下来的情况。

我的怀疑也得到了证实。阿里可称三岛早就不掌控那研究设施了。她认为斯库维塔与纳基维与那事有牵扯，因为天蛇在那里扎根蛮深的，不大可能单兵作战。

messages.en: I made it to Wuos and met Hyasyoda's representative, Arikio Kuretsu. As proof to Hyasyoda of my good intent, I have been asked to return the formula that I stole for Nugoeihuvi earlier. My suspicions turned about to be justified, too. Arikio is claiming that Hyasyoda lost control of the research facility long ago. Her assumption is that Sukuuvestaa and Nugoeihuvi are somehow involved in the affair, since the Serpentis raiders who forced them out were too well established in the area to have been acting alone. She has refused to provide any further information until I provide the formula.
messages.zh: 我到达了乌欧斯，见到了三岛的一位代表，阿里可·库利茨。为了证明我对三岛集团的善意，他们要求我把先前为纳基维拿走的配方交还给他们。我的怀疑也得到了证实。阿里可称三岛早就不掌控那研究设施了。她认为斯库维塔与纳基维与那事有牵扯，因为天蛇在那里扎根蛮深的，不大可能单兵作战。进一步详情只有在我交出配方之后才能知道。

messages.en: Very well. We look forward to continued cooperation with you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 很好，我们期待与你的进一步合作，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
The facility you were instructed to raid has not been under Hyasyoda control for almost a year now. I was told that if you do your research you should find that we also legally rented the area from Sukuuvestaa too, before Serpentis overran it and forced us out. Of course, SuVee could pay the House of Records and the Caldari Business Tribunal a few administrative fees to make that information disappear, if someone were to ever poke around.

What I think you may also find interesting to know, though, is that around the time our lease was coming up for renewal, Serpentis began to show up in larger numbers and with better equipment. We always suspected someone local was funding them, a rogue Guristas outfit or even Gallente extremists, but the idea that it might be one of our own corporations, at a time like this, it just never crossed our mind.

Something definitely isn't right here. I suspect Nugoeihuvi learned of the facility through Sukuuvestaa, who I can only guess, never wanted us to extend our lease for some reason. NOH, doing what it does best, brought in some thugs to clear the matter up. That's until you arrived and, I hope, saw that something wasn't adding up.

Now, the question is whether or not we can trust you. Obviously we are happy to share this information, but there is more to the story than we will share with an egger who has stolen from us. If you are serious about seeing this affair brought to a just end, then you will return what you took and prove your intentions.
messages.zh:
要你去袭击的那座设施不归三岛掌控已经快一年了。如果你仔细查，就会发现其实我们也向斯库维塔合法租借了那块设施，直到后来天蛇来强占。当然，为了不让别人知道这事，斯库维塔也可以向国家档案所与加达里商业法庭交点“行政管理费”来让它石沉大海。

但我还要告诉你一件更有意思的事情：就在我们当时快续租约的时候，天蛇的人突然开始携带精良装备大量涌现。我们本来以为可能是当地的某些古斯塔斯人或者盖伦特极端分子在背后资助他们，压根就没想到我国军团会与此有任何瓜葛。

很明显这事有蹊跷。我怀疑纳基维就是从斯库维塔那儿获悉我们设施情况的，而斯库维塔我猜出于某种原因根本就不想再与我们续约。纳基维随后带上一批流氓来完成斯库维塔的心愿，他们就擅长做这种事。然后就是你来了，我希望你也能看出这事的不对劲之处。

现在我们的问题是要不要相信你。虽然我们觉得把我们目前所掌握的信息告诉你没什么问题，但你毕竟是个从我们这里拿过东西的家伙，我们对你还是有所保留的。如果你真的很想为这事留个公正的结局，那你就把从我们这里拿走的那个配方还给我们以表明你的立场。

messages.en:
Hmm, that is indeed the formula. Good then, I suppose we are going to be working together after all.

Speak with me again when you're ready to talk about where we go from here.
messages.zh:
嗯，确实是我要的配方。很好，看样子我们有得合作了。

想知道下一步行动的话可随时来找我。

messages.en: Then why did you come here? What am I to make of this refusal? I think our business with one another is concluded.
messages.zh: 那你到这里来干嘛？你这拒绝算什么意思？看来我们的合作就到此为止了。

messages.en:
Hyasyoda Corporation CEO Ahtonen Osmon has announced a crash program of aid to assist the overstretched Ishukone Corporation, following the disaster in Malkalen. Hyasyoda, a long-time partner of Ishukone in the so-called 'Liberal Faction', will provide emergency enabling loans to Ishukone Corporation and direct relief aid to Malkalen system.

"The Hyasyoda Corporation will not stand by and see a great megacorporation of the Caldari State fall to an act of treachery and unprovoked aggression. We are therefore making funds available at preferential rates so that the Ishukone executives who survive can continue to run their organisation and oversee the relief efforts. We are also sending relief ships to the Malkalen system to directly assist the efforts at the Ishukone Headquarters," said Ahtonen Osmon.
messages.zh:
莫卡冷灾难发生之后，三岛集团CEO艾多恩·奥森宣布了对遭受重创的异株湖集团的一项紧急援助计划。作为所谓“自由派”中异株湖集团的一位长期合作伙伴，三岛集团将向异株湖集团发放紧急援助贷款并将援救物资与人员调往莫卡冷星系。

“三岛集团不会袖手旁观目睹在加达里中享有盛名的一个超级军团在遭暗算、被偷袭的情况下消亡。我们将向异株湖集团提供优惠利率的贷款，以便他们那些幸存下来的高层管理人员能继续维持公司的日常运作并安排救援工作。我们同时也将派营救船前往莫卡冷星系，直接参与在异株湖集团总部的救援行动。”艾多恩·奥森说道。

messages.en: Hyasyoda Corporation Announces Aid for Ishukone, Scope Article, May 17th
messages.zh: “三岛集团宣布援助异株湖集团”——一篇于5月17日发表的《视角》报道

messages.en:
Hmm, that's quite a story, {[character]player.name}. If you weren't a known friend of the State, I'd be inclined to think you were attempting some kind of scheme. Regardless, I should still throw your ass out of here and have Hyasyoda set your status to kill on sight. That will not get us anywhere, however.

My superiors have been informed of the situation and have asked me to request something from you, but before doing so, to also make something explicitly clear.

The facility you were instructed to raid? It has not been under Hyasyoda control for almost a year now. I was told that if you do your research you should find that we also legally rented the area from Sukuuvestaa too, before Serpentis overran it and forced us out. Of course, SuVee could pay the House of Records and the Caldari Business Tribunal a few administrative fees to make that information disappear, if someone were to ever poke around.

What I think you may also find interesting to know, though, is that around the time our lease was coming up for renewal, Serpentis began to appear in larger numbers and with better equipment. We always suspected someone local was funding them, a rogue Guristas outfit or even Gallentean extremists, but the idea that it might be one of our own corporations, at a time like this, it just never crossed our mind.

Something definitely isn't right here. I suspect Nugoeihuvi learned of the facility through Sukuuvestaa, who I can only guess, never wanted us to extend our lease for some reason. NOH, doing what it does best, brought in some thugs to clear the matter up. That's until you arrived and, it would appear, saw that something wasn't adding up.

Now, the question is whether or not we can trust you. Obviously we are happy to share the information we have so far, but there is more to the story than we will say to an egger who has stolen from us. If you are serious about seeing this affair brought to a just end, then you will return the formula you took from us and prove your good intentions.

Do anything less and you will still be considered an enemy of Hyasyoda Corporation. It's as simple as that.
messages.zh:
嗯，我接下来要说的故事非常错综复杂，{[character]player.name}。要不是你是合众国公认的一位朋友，我肯定会以为你在暗中策划阴谋诡计。即便如此，我还是可以现在就把你扫地出门，让三岛集团的人见你就打。不过我想这对大家都没好处。

我领导已经知道了情况，让我向你来求件事。但在正式求你之前，有些事情还是要说清楚。

还记得要你去袭击的那座设施吗？那地方不归三岛掌控已经快一年了。如果你仔细查，就会发现其实我们也向斯库维塔合法租借了那块设施，直到后来天蛇来强占。当然，为了不让别人知道这事，斯库维塔也可以向国家档案所与加达里商业法庭交点“行政管理费”来让它石沉大海。

但我还要告诉你一件更有意思的事情：就在我们当时快续租约的时候，天蛇的人突然开始携带精良装备大量涌现。我们本来以为可能是当地的某些古斯塔斯人或者盖伦特极端分子在背后资助他们，压根就没想到我国军团会与此有任何瓜葛。

很明显这事有蹊跷。我怀疑纳基维就是从斯库维塔那儿获悉我们设施情况的，而斯库维塔我猜出于某种原因根本就不想再与我们续约。纳基维随后带上一批流氓来完成斯库维塔的心愿，他们就擅长做这种事。然后就是你来了，我希望你也能看出这事的不对劲之处。

现在我们的问题是要不要相信你。虽然我们觉得把我们目前所掌握的信息告诉你没什么问题，但你毕竟是个从我们这里拿过东西的家伙，我们对你还是有所保留的。如果你真的很想为这事留个公正的结局，那你就把从我们这里拿走的那个配方还给我们以表明你的立场。

这事只要出任何纰漏，三岛集团就不会对你客气，很简单。

messages.en: I expected as much, I have to say.
messages.zh: 说实话我期望蛮高的。

messages.en: Well? We're waiting…
messages.zh: 恩？我们等着……

messages.en: The investigation team was able to make some progress after being relocated. Apparently Isha has been spotted making visits to some unknown Caldari Navy facility. Hyasyoda suspects he is involved in some kind of arms or information smuggling racket. I've been asked to gather more information about who Isha is meeting with. After returning to Isha yet again, I discovered that his friend is a highly-placed Caldari Navy official named Sinas Egassuo. This is, presumably, the same man Isha has been observed visiting.
messages.zh: 转移阵地之后，调查队取得了些进展。很明显，伊沙被发现造访了某个不明加达里海军基地。三岛集团怀疑他牵涉武器偷运或机密贩卖。我被要求去进一步搜集情报，以便搞清伊沙会面的到底是何人。与伊沙再次会面之后，我发现他的朋友是个名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索的加达里海军高级将领。也许他正是伊沙被发现会面的那个人。

messages.en: The investigation team was able to make some progress after being relocated. Apparently Isha has been spotted making visits to some unknown Caldari Navy facility. Hyasyoda suspects he is involved in some kind of arms or information smuggling racket. I've been asked to gather more information about who Isha is meeting with.
messages.zh: 转移阵地之后，调查队取得了些进展。很明显，伊沙被发现造访了某个不明加达里海军基地。三岛集团怀疑他牵涉武器偷运或机密贩卖。我被要求去进一步搜集情报，以便搞清伊沙会面的到底是何人。

messages.en:
We noticed something when you left towards Syndicate to make the blueprint delivery. Isha was on the move himself. Our surveillance team monitored a visit he made to an unknown Caldari Navy compound. The unmarked shuttle he flew there has now been sighted back inside Nugoeihuvi's docking bay at Poinen. Interestingly, it has been given priority docking position, meaning another launch is likely to happen soon.

We don't want to arrive at any conclusions just yet, but our first impression is that Isha is involved in some kind of black market activity, perhaps weapons or information smuggling. We noticed that he mentioned introducing you to someone – we think they may be the buyer. His visit to this Caldari Navy facility raises a lot of questions in that regard.

See what you can do about meeting this friend of Isha's, then discover what you can about them. We'll be watching closely {[character]player.name}, good luck.
messages.zh:
在你去辛迪加财团送蓝图的时候，我们还注意到了一件事情。伊沙自己也在行动。我们的监察队发现他去了一座不明加达里海军基地。他飞往那里驾驶的一艘普通穿梭机现已返航停靠在波耶伦的纳维基空间站里。有趣的他的停靠位置很靠前，也就是说他马上又要走了。

我们现在还不想妄下结论，但我们感觉他好像在进行某种黑市交易，也许是武器偷运，也有可能是机密倒卖。他说要将你介绍给某人——也许就是买家吧。他这次去这座加达里海军基地牵扯出一系列问题。

伊萨要你会见他的朋友，你就去应付一下，顺便了解一下他的这位朋友。我们会在背后密切监视的，{[character]player.name}。祝你好运。

messages.en: Then leave, I've nothing further to offer you if you won't see this to the end.
messages.zh: 那就请离开这儿。既然你不想有始有终，那我你待我这里也就没什么意思了。

messages.en:
Hyasyoda negotiators resumed talks with Zainou today after Ishukone Watch CEO Mens Reppola intervened personally over the weekend. The close friend of the late Otro Gariushi spoke extensively with Hyasyoda CEO Ahtonen Osmon both Saturday and Sunday. Though Ishukone did not disclose the details of the conversation, a press release from Osmon's office called the discussions with Reppola "productive and reassuring," and apologized to Zainou for the delay in resuming negotiations.

Political analysts, such as Taya Otnen, a corporate strategist with the Mercantile Club on this week's Games of State, have called this a shrewd move by the Ishukone Watch CEO. "He's used his authority over corporate security matters to take ownership of the negotiations, whether they succeed or fail," she told host Shiomiken Savalenta. "This may have actually been what Hyasyoda was hoping for; it's no secret that they support Reppola for the CEO seat. It was a very dangerous move, though; if Okalala wins the CEO fight, he'll remember what they did. Next time those contracts are up for review, Hyasyoda may find themselves passed over for another vendor like Sukuuvestaa or Kaalakiota."
messages.zh:
在异株湖安全部队CEO曼斯·雷普拉于周末亲自介入之后，三岛集团谈判人员重新恢复了与载诺的谈判。雷普拉与已去世的奥图·高伊斯曾是至交，他与三岛集团的CEO艾多恩·奥森在上周六与周日展开了深入交谈。虽然异株湖并没有披露谈话细节，但奥森办公室发布的新闻公告中称此次与雷普拉的谈话“让人放心且富有成效”，并且为拖延复谈一事向载诺致歉。

但政治评论家都称异株湖安全部队CEO此次的举动实为失策。在本周的“国家竞赛”节目上，商业俱乐部的企业战略策划员塔亚·奥特能向主持人茜欧米肯·萨娃兰塔这样说道：“他以保卫公司安全职责为由来主导谈判，全然不顾谈判得到是否会成功。也许此举正合三岛的胃口：大家都知道三岛集团一向支持雷普拉担任异株湖集团的CEO。但这步棋很容易走错。如果奥卡拉拉最后赢得了CEO职位，他绝不会忘记三岛现在的所作所为。以后一旦有合同要续签，三岛集团就只能眼巴巴地看着那些合同从自己眼皮底下溜走，转向斯库维塔集团或卡拉吉塔集团之类的其他供应商。”

messages.en: Hyasyoda Returns to Bargaining Table after Reppola Intervenes, Scope Article, February 23rd, YC111
messages.zh: 《三岛集团于雷普拉介入之后重返谈判桌》——“视角”新伊甸纪元111年2月23日的文章

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. Without any major interruption to our investigations the team has managed to cover a lot of ground. We now have a much better understanding of the situation, and who this Katsen Isha is.

For one, we have a possible future lead in the House of Records. Apparently some publicly available documents regarding Isha's earliest days at Nugoeihuvi have been archived. We just need to figure out which station has the hard copies and then we'll have it.

We noticed something else when you left towards Syndicate to make the blueprint delivery. Isha was on the move himself. Our surveillance team monitored a visit he made to an unknown Caldari Navy compound. The unmarked shuttle he flew there has now been sighted back inside Nugoeihuvi's docking bay at Poinen. Interestingly, it has been given priority docking position, meaning another launch is likely to happen soon.

We don't want to arrive at any conclusions just yet, but our first impression is that Isha is involved in some kind of black market activity, perhaps weapons or information smuggling. We noticed that he mentioned introducing you to someone – we think they may be the buyer. His visit to this Caldari Navy facility raises a lot of questions in that regard.

See what you can do about meeting this friend of Isha's, then discover what you can about them. We'll be watching closely {[character]player.name}, good luck.
messages.zh:
干得好，{[character]player.name}。我们队伍在没有受到任何大干扰的情况下取得了很大进展。我们现在对整个事件以及卡僧·伊沙是谁都有了更清晰的了解。

首先，我们可能会在档案局找到新线索。记录伊沙在纳维基集团早期一段历史的公开文档好像已经归入档案。我们现在只需找出哪座空间站拥有这些文档的拷贝，然后拿到手就行。

另外，在你去辛迪加财团送蓝图的时候，我们还注意到了另一件事情。伊沙自己也在行动。我们的监察队发现他去了一座不明加达里海军基地。他飞往那里驾驶的一艘普通穿梭机现已返航停靠在波耶伦的纳维基空间站里。有趣的他的停靠位置很靠前，也就是说他马上又要走了。

我们现在还不想妄下结论，但我们感觉他好像在进行某种黑市交易，也许是武器偷运，也有可能是机密倒卖。他说要将你介绍给某人——也许就是买家吧。他这次去这座加达里海军基地牵扯出一系列问题。

伊萨要你会见他的朋友，你就去应付一下，顺便了解一下他的这位朋友。我们会在背后密切监视的，{[character]player.name}。祝你好运。

messages.en: Then leave, I've nothing further to offer you if you won't see this to the end.
messages.zh: 那就请离开这儿。既然你不想有始有终，那我你待我这里也就没什么意思了。

messages.en: You should speak with Isha soon, {[character]player.name}, we don't want him wondering about your absence.
messages.zh: 你应该尽快和伊沙取得联系，{[character]player.name}。我们可不希望他对你失踪产生怀疑。

messages.en: Blackness Rising
messages.zh: 黑幕袭来

messages.en: I was sent by Isha to personally meet Sinas in the system of Astoh, Black Rise, where he is currently deployed with the Navy. I managed to find my way to his compound and discuss the work ahead of us.
messages.zh: 伊沙派我前往位于暗涌之域的阿希多星系与塞纳斯会面。塞纳斯现与海军一道驻扎在那里。我找到了其住所与他商讨了我们接下来的任务。

messages.en: Isha is sending me off to meet Sinas in person and handle whatever work he has for me. He advised me to bring a small vessel there, suspecting that the work ahead of me will rely on speed and discretion.
messages.zh: 伊沙派我去会面塞纳斯接受他派遣下来的任何任务。伊沙建议我驾驶一艘小船过去。他觉得我接下来的任务可能要仰仗速度与自我判断。

messages.en: Don't let my friend down out there, {[character]player.name}. You're representing us both.
messages.zh: 别让我朋友失望，{[character]player.name}。你代表我们两个人。

messages.en:
It sounds like Sinas is on to something. I want you there to help him in any way you can. He's headed back to his post in Astoh, so you're off to Black Rise to meet him.

From the sounds of it, Sinas will need you for something around there. My advice would be to start by flying an interceptor or frigate down that way. If on the off chance he needs you to do some heavy lifting, then you can go back for something larger. My impression is that he'll want speed and discretion here though; if it was something a fleet of Ravens could hit he'd have handled it with his own crew already.
messages.zh:
听起来塞纳斯好像知道些什么事情。我要你尽其所能去帮助他。他已经返回了其在阿希多的据点，因此你现在就出发前往暗涌之域吧。

看起来塞纳斯要你去那儿处理一件事。我建议你驾驶一艘截击舰或护卫舰去那儿。如果到了那儿他让你拉大货物，那你还可以回来换艘大船再去。但我觉得他那事情要办成需要的是速度与自我决断能力。如果他那事真需要动员一支乌鸦级战列舰舰队，那他自己手下就已经有人能干那样的事了。

messages.en: Fine. I will find someone else. You disappoint me {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 行，我去找别人。你让我失望了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A cursory glance at the Black Rise region reveals a great deal to those with even the most basic understanding of Caldari internal politics. Kaalakiota, Lai Dai and Wiyrkomi led the charge in colonization, each flanked by their private security forces. Supplemented by the Caldari Navy, the State War Academy and Caldari Constructions, the colonization has all the hallmarks of a Patriot faction power play.
messages.zh: 即便粗扫一下暗涌之域，一个哪怕已经对加达里内政有着最基本了解的人也会有众多发现。卡拉吉塔集团、莱戴集团及维克米集团肩负着殖民重任，他们各有一支武装力量保驾。再加上加达里海军、国立军事学院与加达里建筑集团，整个殖民运动就是场标准的爱国军阀角力。

messages.en: Black Rise
messages.zh: 暗涌之域

messages.en:
It sounds like Sinas is on to something. I want you there to help him in any way you can. He's headed back to his post in Astoh, so you're off to Black Rise to meet him, {[character]player.name}. If you've never been there, then you should know that it can be a dangerous place; the leadership of the Federation's capsuleer militia has set its sights on nothing less than total Gallentean occupation of the region. An absurd goal, but they're welcome to try.

From the sounds of it, Sinas will need you for something around there. My advice would be to start by flying an interceptor or frigate down that way. If on the off chance he needs you to do some heavy lifting, then you can go back for something larger. My impression is that he'll want speed and discretion here though; if it was something a fleet of Ravens could hit he'd have handled it with his own crew already.

Anyhow, fly out there, see what's up, and keep in mind what I told you about him. If you can trust me, you should trust him.
messages.zh:
听起来塞纳斯好像知道些什么事情。我要你尽其所能去帮助他。他已经返回了其在阿希多的据点，因此你现在就出发前往暗涌之域吧，{[character]player.name}。如果你从未涉足过那块地方，那我告诉你那是个很危险的地方。盖伦特联邦的国民卫队一心一意想独占那片星域。真是个荒唐可笑的想法，有种他们就试一下。

看起来塞纳斯要你去那儿处理一件事。我建议你驾驶一艘截击舰或护卫舰去那儿。如果到了那儿他让你拉大货物，那你还可以回来换艘大船再去。但我觉得他那事情要办成需要的是速度与自我决断能力。如果他那事真需要动用一支乌鸦级战列舰舰队，那他自己手下就已经有人能干那样的事了。

不管怎样，你现在就飞往那里，看看到底有什么事，并记住我跟你说的那些与塞纳斯有关的事情。如果你相信我，那你也应该相信他。

messages.en: Fine. I will find someone else. You disappoint me {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 行，我去找别人。你让我失望了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: You should see Sinas as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 你应该尽快去见塞纳斯。

name.es: El mejor amigo de un general
name.ru: Лучший друг генерала (A General's Best Friend)

messages.en: Isha expressed a desire for me to meet someone in his stead; a Caldari Navy officer named Sinas Egassuo, who he tells me is some kind of high-ranking, behind-the-scenes operative. It appears that the two of them cannot be seen associating with one another, thanks to the so-called “rumors” that follow Isha around. I eventually met with Sinas in a Caldari Navy compound and he promptly sent me back to Isha to borrow fifty million ISK. Isha sent the ISK over straight away, and requested that I stay on and help Sinas with whatever he needs.
messages.zh: 伊沙要求我去替他见一个人。那人是个名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索的加达里海军军官，伊沙说他是个幕后高官。由于所谓的“流言”，这两个人不能被别人知晓他们之间有关系。我最后在一座加达里海军基地里见到了塞纳斯，他立刻让我回去向伊沙索要5千万星币。伊沙很爽气地将星币汇了出去，并要求我留下来尽全力帮助塞纳斯。

messages.en: Isha expressed a desire for me to meet someone in his stead; a Caldari Navy officer who he tells me is some kind of high-ranking, behind-the-scenes operative. His name is Sinas Egassuo, apparently the brother of Toras, a well-known Commander in Motsu. It appears that Isha and Sinas cannot be seen associating with one another, thanks to the so-called “rumors” that follow Isha around.
messages.zh: 伊沙要求我去替他见一个人。那人是个名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索的加达里海军军官，伊沙说他是个幕后高官。他好像还是莫茨著名司令托哈的兄弟。由于所谓的“流言”，塞纳斯与伊沙这两个人不能被别人知晓他们之间有关系。

messages.en: Good then. Trust what I said {[character]player.name}, the State is lucky to have people like Sinas.
messages.zh: 很好。请相信我说的话，{[character]player.name}，国家拥有塞纳斯这样的人真是有幸。

messages.en:
There was someone I wanted you to meet. I'm afraid I can't do it myself; he and I must be careful not to be associated with one another. This is not for any good reason, {[character]player.name}, it is simply the way our judgmental world works. A Caldari Navy officer of his kind cannot afford the rumors that a friendship with me brings.

My friend's name is Sinas Egassuo. You will find him somewhere around {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, just look for the Caldari Navy compound in the system, and be careful. He may not be known and loved by the Caldari people, but the leadership of the Gallente Navy is well acquainted with him and his work, and has long wanted him dead. His outfit deals with assassins and bounty hunters on a daily basis. Expect nothing less when you find the compound.
messages.zh:
我要你见个人。我自己怕是没法见他；我和他都得注意保持距离。其实这里面也没有什么特别原因，{[character]player.name}，只是这世上人喜欢妄下结论而已。我和他是朋友的消息一经传出之后必将招徕流言蜚语，像他这样的加达里海军军官是受不起这种闲言碎语的。

我朋友名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索。你会在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那里找到他，只要去找该星系中的加达里海军基地就行，但你的行动须谨慎。这家伙或许在加达里人中名气不响，没人喜欢。但盖伦特海军的领导层对其为人与工作都了如指掌，一直想到除掉他。他手下的人每天都进行行刺追捕行动。你抵达他的基地之后便会发现这点。

messages.en:
He wants fifty million ISK? Hmm, it worries me when a Caldari navy officer with an almost limitless budget asks for money, usually means he needs to do something off the books.

Alright, tell Sinas the ISK is on its way. I want you to work with him on whatever he's got going on. You can keep an eye on how he's spending all that money while you're at it.
messages.zh:
他要5千万星币？嗯……一位掌握几近无限预算的加达里海军军官张口要钱，这让我有点担心，一般这意味着他打算私下里要做点事情。

好吧，告诉塞纳斯钱马上就给他汇去。我要你尽一切所能协助他，顺便看看他把钱都花在哪儿了。

messages.en: We were just about to begin the real work, {[character]player.name}! Well, fine. If you have other things to deal with, get to them. You would not be the first egger to walk out on a job barely started. I had expected more from you though, I am sad to say.
messages.zh: 我们这事情正要进入实质性阶段呢，{[character]player.name}！算了算了。如果你有其他事要处理，那就去吧。我料想以后还会有你这样的人出现。我原来还对你报以很高的期望呢。

messages.en: The patriot faction has become increasingly influential since the breakdown in relations with the Federation. The patriots are led by the mighty Kaalakiota Corporation although Lai Dai and Wiyrkomi are often just as vocal in their beliefs. The patriots cultivate the Caldari heritage, reminisce about the great Raata Empire of old and joyously celebrate the reclamation of their homeworld, Caldari Prime.
messages.zh: 自从与盖伦特联邦分道扬镳以来，爱国势力的影响力愈发强大。爱国势力由强大的卡拉吉塔集团领导，但莱戴与维克米也时常发表自己的意见。爱国势力利用加达里的历史鼓吹拉塔古王朝的伟大之处，还经常为重夺加达里首星一事唱赞颂歌。

messages.en: The Patriot Faction
messages.zh: 爱国势力

messages.en:
Ah, {[character]player.name}, welcome back. Word filtered back to me that the Hyasyoda investigation came to an abrupt and explosive halt. Good work.

Now that we're in the clear, we're free to pursue the matter I mentioned earlier. There's someone I wanted you to meet. I'm afraid I can't do it myself; he and I must be careful not to be associated with one another. This is not for any good reason, {[character]player.name}, it is simply the way our judgmental world works. A Caldari Navy officer of his kind cannot afford the rumors that a friendship with me brings. You will learn though, in time, how little truth there is to them. You've already shown a great capacity to see through the surface of things, to the heart. You wouldn't be here still if that wasn't the case.

My friend's name is Sinas Egassuo. He is a man in a similar position to me, working quietly in the engine room, seeking results, not glory. He too, works as an Advisor, and almost every important operation undertaken by our Navy in the last decade bears his imprint. You will hear talk of Caldari patriots in your time in the State, and doubtless already have. This man is a living definition of one.

You will find him somewhere around {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, just look for the Caldari Navy compound in the system, and be careful. He may not be known and loved by the Caldari people, but the leadership of the Gallente Navy is well acquainted with him and his work, and has long wanted him dead. His outfit deals with assassins and bounty hunters on a daily basis. Expect nothing less when you find the compound.

Oh, and if his surname seems familiar that's because you've probably met his sister. She works as a capsuleer liaison for the Navy's Command Division in Motsu. I wouldn't mention anything about her though; sisters are a sore spot for him.
messages.zh:
噢，{[character]player.name}，欢迎回来。我已经听消息说三岛集团的调查行动嘎然而止了。干得好。

既然现在没人碍事，我们便可以处理我之前提到的那个事了。我要你见个人。我自己怕是没法见他；我和他都得注意保持距离。其实这里面也没有什么特别原因，{[character]player.name}，只是这世上人喜欢妄下结论而已。我和他是朋友的消息一经传出之后必将招徕流言蜚语，像他这样的加达里海军军官是受不起这种闲言碎语的。你以后会明白类似这样的传言有多荒唐。你已经证明了你能洞察事物真相，否则你现在不可能还出现在我面前。

我朋友名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索。他和我的职责差不多，都是注重结果、不屑名气，在幕后行动的人。他也是顾问。在过去十年里，我们海军的每次行动策划几乎都有他的参与。你将来会听到一些有关加达里爱国者的事迹，而且我相信你对此其实已经有所耳闻。这人就是个活生生的例子。

你会在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那里找到他，只要去找该星系中的加达里海军基地就行，但你的行动须谨慎。这家伙或许在加达里人中名气不响，没人喜欢。但盖伦特海军的领导层对其为人与工作都了如指掌，一直想到除掉他。他手下的人每天都进行行刺追捕行动。你抵达他的基地之后便会发现这点。

哦，如果你觉得他的姓听起来耳熟，那可能是因为你已经见过了他的妹妹。他妹妹在莫茨的海军指挥部当克隆飞行员联系人。不过我可不会跟你说有关他妹妹的任何事；他对他的妹妹很头疼。

messages.en: I…already set things in motion. Your failure here has cost me much, much more than you realize. Go then, {[character]player.name}. If you cannot be relied upon, I have no desire to give you any further work.
messages.zh: 我……已经让事情进行起来了。你这次失败给我带来的损失远远超出你的想象。走吧走吧，{[character]player.name}。你既然靠不住，那我也不想再与你合作了。

messages.en: You have reached the Nugoeihuvi Corporation Advisory Office, Poinen. No-one is available to take your call at this moment. Please try again later.
messages.zh: 你已抵达波耶伦的纳维基集团咨询办公室。现在没人能接听你的通话。请过会儿再试试。

messages.en: I successfully brought the Corporate Police Force investigation to an end by destroying the facility they were offsetting up for their base. Isha tells me it will be some weeks before they can fully resume their inquiries. He is confident that we will have dropped off the radar long before then.
messages.zh: 通过捣毁警卫队正在建造中的基地，我成功地阻止了他们的调查行动。伊沙说他们得再花数周时间才能重整旗鼓。他认为在那之前我们会早已消失在他们视野之外。

messages.en: After making the sale in Faurulle, I contacted Katsen Isha once more. He tells me that Hyasyoda has launched an investigation into our raid on the facility. I must stop the Corporate Police Force investigation before it can uncover anything. Isha stated that there is a particular structure inside their compound that is crucial to their progress. If I can destroy it, then I will hamper their investigation for weeks — long enough for the trail back to us to dry up.
messages.zh: 在法鲁里完成交易之后，我又联系了卡僧·伊沙。他告诉我三岛集团已经针对我们袭击设施这一事展开了调查。我必须把这事消灭在萌芽状态。伊沙说他们的基地中有座建筑对他们的调查行动至关重要。如果我能摧毁那座东西，那必定能拖住他们数周时间——这些时间足以让我们留下的线索销声匿迹。

messages.en: Good, then. Remember, {[character]player.name}: The Logistics Center is your only target. You can limit the loss of life here by taking it down quickly and then getting the hell out. If you linger, they will most likely swarm you with reinforcements and pin you down. Don't get complacent just because they're mercs — Hyasyoda is funding them and will make damn sure they get their money's worth.
messages.zh: 很好。记住，{[character]player.name}：你的目标只是后勤中心。只要你动作快点把它炸掉然后迅速撤离，那你就能将人员伤亡程度降到最低。如果你恋战，那对方极有可能叫来援兵将你穷追猛打。别以为对方是雇佣兵就掉以轻心；三岛出钱请来的肯定帮货真价实的家伙。

messages.en:
The Corporate Police Force investigation must be brought to an end before it can uncover anything that could lead back to us. The forces inside the facility right now are not Hyasyoda or CPF personnel, just some hired mercs. This gives us an opportunity to strike preemptively at the compound without causing an incident and further complicating matters.

If you can destroy the Logistics Center quickly, it will set them back weeks. The paths that lead back to us to will have faded into the background by the time they can resume their investigation. You can limit the loss of life here by taking it down quickly and then getting the hell out. If you linger, they will most likely swarm you with reinforcements.
messages.zh:
我们必须赶在警卫队找出与我们相关的线索之前终结他们的调查行动。现在设施内部的武装力量既不是三岛集团的人也不是警卫队的人，而是一帮花钱请来的雇佣兵。这样我们就能先发制人打击他们，不必担心事态升级。

你只要把那后勤中心迅速捣毁，那他们近几周的工作就会白费。等他们再组织起来调查时，就肯定查不到与我们有关的线索了。只要你动作快点把后勤中心炸掉然后迅速撤离，那你就能将人员伤亡程度降到最低。如果你恋战，那对方极有可能叫来援兵将你穷追猛打。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. Truly. Our ISK is secure and nobody alive suspects us. You have done well, and the money we have secured will help us pursue important things.

Take some time to relax and recuperate. When you are ready, our real work can finally begin.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。真的很漂亮。我们的星币保住了，也没人怀疑我们。你干得很好，我们保住的那些星币将有助于我们完成更重要的事情。

你现在可以去放松休息一下。当你再次准备好后，我们就可以着手干正事了。

messages.en: Yes, I can understand your hesitance. Perhaps it is better to focus on misdirection instead. I will prepare your briefing for that task and you can judge for yourself. Speak with me again when you'd like to hear it.
messages.zh: 是啊，我理解你的犹豫。也许我们应该采用声东击西的方案。我去准备向你交代一下那方案的具体情况，然后你自己拿主意。想听的话就知会我一声。

messages.en: Hyasyoda is one of the oldest of the Caldari mega corporations, having been formed shortly after first contact with Gallente when the Caldari were still in the Industrial Age. Throughout State history, Hyasyoda executives have always been conservative and cautious. As a result, the corporation has informally claimed as theirs the age old Caldari saying that “only the paranoid survive.”
messages.zh: 三岛集团是加达里历史最悠久的超级军团之一，于加达里与盖伦特接触后不久创建，那时加达里还处于工业时代。自加达里成立以来，三岛集团的高层一直行事谨慎，作风保守。因此该集团将一句加达里古谚语非正式地往自己脸上贴：多点担心总没错的。

messages.en: Paranoia
messages.zh: 神经质

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, good. I hope the visit to Faurulle didn't take too much out of you. Once again, good work out there. Sadly, it turns out we have one more loose end to tie up.

My people tell me that Hyasyoda has already launched an investigation into the blueprint theft. I suppose this is a play to lend an air of legitimacy to the racket they've been running. The situation is an amusing one, yet also dangerous for us. Our tracks are well covered, but – as they often say in Hyasyoda itself – only the paranoid survive.

They've deployed their security wing, the Corporate Police Force, into “various locations of interest.” I have learned that Onirvura was listed as an area to investigate. They're right here in the constellation, setting up a temporary base for interrogation and imprisonment. Fortunately for us, the CPF has hired a mercenary crew to handle facility defense while they set up. This gives us an opportunity to strike at them without it constituting a direct attack on Hyasyoda personnel. That would muddy the waters a bit, as I'm sure you can appreciate.

I cannot guarantee how long these mercenaries will be on duty, however, nor what kind of reaction your arrival on scene will provoke. What I do know is that if you can destroy the Logistics Center quickly, it will set them back weeks. The paths that lead back to us to will easily have faded into the background by the time they can resume their investigation.
messages.zh:
很好，{[character]player.name}。我希望你已经从法鲁里之旅的舟车劳顿中恢复过来了。你干得真不错。不过我们还有件事没摆平。

我的人告诉我三岛集团已经介入追查配方偷盗人了。我觉得他们这只是在做表面文章而已。虽说可笑，但对我们来说也确实有点危险。我们虽然事情做得不露马脚，但——就像三岛集团自己人那个说什么来着——多点担心总没错的。

他们已经将其警卫队派向了“各重点区域”。听说奥尼尔瓦纳便是其中之一。他们目前就在本星座，正在搭建一个用于调查与囚禁的临时基地。还好，警卫队雇了一批雇佣兵来守卫建造中的基地。这样我们就可以不用直接袭击三岛的人员来端掉这基地了。这水虽会被趟混，但想必你能理解。

不过我也掐不准那批雇佣兵还能待多久，也无法估计出你到场后他们会有什么反应。我只知道你只要把那后勤中心迅速捣毁，那他们近几周的工作就会白费。等他们再组织起来调查时，就肯定查不到与我们有关的线索了。

messages.en: Don't worry, {[character]player.name}. I won't deny the assignment was a challenging one. Perhaps you should look into this misdirection plan I have in mind, instead. All is not yet lost.
messages.zh: 别担心，{[character]player.name}。我不否认该项任务难度很大。或许你可以考虑一下我那声东击西的方案。我们还有回旋余地。

messages.en: Time is our greatest enemy here, {[character]player.name}. You should get going. The CPF could replace their stand-in mercs at any moment.
messages.zh: 时间是我们最大的敌人，{[character]player.name}。你应该行动起来了。警卫队可能随时替换掉那批雇佣兵。

messages.en: I successfully brought the Corporate Police Force investigation to an end by destroying the facility they were setting up as their base. Isha tells me it will be some weeks before they can fully resume their inquiries. He is confident that we will have dropped off the radar long before then.
messages.zh: 通过捣毁警卫队正在建造中的基地，我成功地阻止了他们的调查行动。伊沙说他们得再花数周时间才能重整旗鼓。他认为在那之前我们会早已消失在他们视野之外。

messages.en: I have committed myself to thwarting the Corporate Police Force investigation. Isha tells me that there is a particular structure inside their compound that is crucial to their progress. If I can destroy it, then I will hamper their investigation for weeks — long enough for the trail back to us to dry up.
messages.zh: 我已答应把警卫队的调查行动消灭在萌芽状态。伊沙说他们的基地中有座建筑对他们的调查行动至关重要。如果我能摧毁那座东西，那必定能拖住他们数周时间——这些时间足以让我们留下的线索销声匿迹。

messages.en: Good, then. Remember, {[character]player.name}, the Logistics Center is your only target. You can limit the loss of life by taking it down quickly and then getting the hell out. If you linger, they will most likely swarm you with reinforcements and pin you down. Don't get complacent just because they're mercs, Hyasyoda is funding them and will make damn sure they get their money's worth.
messages.zh: 很好。记住，{[character]player.name}：你的目标只是后勤中心。只要你动作快点把它炸掉然后迅速撤离，那你就能将人员伤亡程度降到最低。如果你恋战，那对方极有可能叫来援兵将你穷追猛打。别以为对方是雇佣兵就掉以轻心；三岛出钱请来的肯定帮货真价实的家伙。

messages.en:
The Corporate Police Force investigation must be brought to an end before it can uncover anything that could lead back to us. The forces inside the facility right now are not Hyasyoda or CPF personnel, just some hired mercs. This gives us an opportunity to strike preemptively at the compound without causing an incident and further complicating matters.

If you can destroy the Logistics Center quickly, it will set them back weeks. The paths that lead back to us to will have faded into the background by the time they can resume their investigation. You can limit the loss of life by taking the target down quickly and then getting the hell out. If you linger, they will most likely swarm you with reinforcements.
messages.zh:
我们必须赶在警卫队找出与我们相关的线索之前终结他们的调查行动。现在设施内部的武装力量既不是三岛集团的人也不是警卫队的人，而是一帮花钱请来的雇佣兵。这样我们就能先发制人打击他们，不必担心事态升级。

你只要把那后勤中心迅速捣毁，那他们近几周的工作就会白费。等他们再组织起来调查时，就肯定查不到与我们有关的线索了。只要你动作快点把后勤中心炸掉然后迅速撤离，那你就能将人员伤亡程度降到最低。如果你恋战，那对方极有可能叫来援兵将你穷追猛打。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. Truly. Our ISK is secure and nobody alive suspects us. You have done well, and the money we have secured will help us pursue important things.

Take some time to relax and recuperate. When you are ready, our real work can finally begin.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。真的很漂亮。我们的星币保住了，也没人怀疑我们。你干得很好，我们保住的那些星币将有助于我们完成更重要的事情。

你现在可以去放松休息一下。当你再次准备好后，我们就可以着手干正事了。

messages.en: Yes, I understand your hesitance. Perhaps it is better to focus on misdirection instead. I will prepare your briefing for that task and you can judge for yourself. Speak with me again when you'd like to hear it.
messages.zh: 是啊，我理解你的犹豫。也许我们应该采用声东击西的方案。我去准备向你交代一下那方案的具体情况，然后你自己拿主意。想听的话就知会我一声。

messages.en: Hyasyoda is one of the oldest of the Caldari megacorporations, having been formed shortly after first contact with Gallente when the Caldari were still in their Industrial Age. Throughout State history, Hyasyoda executives have always been conservative and cautious. As a result, the corporation has informally claimed as theirs the age-old Caldari saying that “only the paranoid survive.”
messages.zh: 三岛集团是加达里历史最悠久的超级军团之一，于加达里与盖伦特接触后不久创建，那时加达里还处于工业时代。自加达里成立以来，三岛集团的高层一直行事谨慎，作风保守。因此该集团将一句加达里古谚语非正式地往自己脸上贴：多点担心总没错的。

messages.en: Paranoia
messages.zh: 神经质

messages.en:
This Corporate Police Force investigation must be brought to an end before it can uncover anything that could lead back to us, unlikely as that may be. The forces inside the facility right now are not Hyasyoda or CPF personnel, just some hired mercs. This gives us an opportunity to strike preemptively at the compound without causing an incident and further complicating matters.

I cannot guarantee how long they will be on duty, however, nor what kind of reaction your arrival on scene will provoke. What I do know is that if you can destroy the Logistics Center quickly, it will set them back weeks. The paths that lead back to us to will no doubt have faded into the background by the time they can resume their investigation.
messages.zh:
我们必须赶在警卫队找出与我们相关的线索之前终结他们的调查行动。现在设施内部的武装力量既不是三岛集团的人也不是警卫队的人，而是一帮花钱请来的雇佣兵。这样我们就能先发制人打击他们，不必担心事态升级。

不过我也掐不准那批雇佣兵还能待多久，也无法估计出你到场后他们会有什么反应。我只知道你只要把那后勤中心迅速捣毁，那他们近几周的工作就会白费。等他们再组织起来调查时，就肯定查不到与我们有关的线索了。

messages.en: I won't deny the assignment was a challenging one, but can I suggest that you look into safer work in the future? Speaking of which, I need to find your replacement. Thank you for the time you gave.
messages.zh: 我不否认该项任务难度很大，也许我该建议你以后只找轻松的活干？这样我就得去另寻他人了。谢谢你迄今为止付出的时间。

messages.en: Time is our greatest enemy here, {[character]player.name}. You should get going. The CPF could replace their stand-in mercs at any moment.
messages.zh: 时间是我们最大的敌人，{[character]player.name}。你应该行动起来了。警卫队可能随时替换掉那批雇佣兵。

messages.en: I managed to secure the Blood Raider Facility and safely deliver the Nugoeihuvi signal operators to the Communications Tower. Isha tells me that they have already begun their work transmitting the misleading intelligence to the CPF investigation team. We should be in the clear now. He also expressed a desire for me to meet one of his friends when I am ready for more work.
messages.zh: 我成功地控制了血袭者基地并将纳维基的信号发射工作人员安全地送入了通讯塔。伊沙告诉我他们已经开始向警卫队的调查队伍发送误导性消息。我们现在应该没事了。伊沙还希望当我休息完后能去见他的一位朋友。

messages.en: Upon speaking with Isha again, I have learned that the CPF investigation team is chasing up their only lead; a fragment of an intercepted transmission that suggests the culprits are in a nullsec system starting with “KF” and with a Z and E in the name. Isha wants me to fool them into thinking the system is KFIE-Z, the Blood Raiders HQ. From what he describes, the task will not be an easy one. I am told to expect the “very worst” of the Covenant given their silence, which Isha tells me is not a good sign.
messages.zh: 与伊沙再次交谈之后，我得知警卫队原来在跟进他们唯一的线索。他们截获了一段通讯信号，提示他们罪魁祸首在一个以KF开头，名字中带有Z和E的0.0星系。伊沙要求我对他们进行误导，让他们以为那星系是血袭者的总部KFIE-Z星系。我从他口中得知这次任务并不轻松。伊沙警告我血袭者没有动静并非好兆头，要我做好应付最坏情况的打算。

messages.en:
Misdirection, then. Good. This will give you a chance to appreciate how we often like to approach problems here in Nugoeihuvi.

Hmm, very well, {[character]player.name}. Try not to lose your ship out there; your crew would not like their new masters.
messages.zh:
你选声东击西，恩，好。你将会籍此了解到我们纳维基集团的人处理问题的常用方法。

恩，很好，{[character]player.name}。请避免损失你的舰船，不然你的船员不会爱戴你这个船长的。

messages.en:
The CPF investigation team is in Onirvura because of some intel – intel I believe we can manipulate. I have learned that they partially decrypted a communication between my people here and our blueprint buyers in KFR-ZE. Fortunately for us, they couldn't fully decipher the location we were transmitting to, so all they know is that this area is where the transmission originated and that the destination system started with KF and has a Z and E in its name.

Your assignment is to secure a nearby Blood Raider facility and safely deliver our own signal operators to the Communications Tower inside. They will use it to transmit fake intelligence to the CPF team, and hopefully, lead them to KFIE-Z.
messages.zh:
警卫队的调查队伍是在获悉了某个情报之后才来奥尼尔瓦纳的，我认为我们可以利用那个情报。我知道他们破解了我们与KFR-ZE蓝图买家之间的部分谈话内容。所幸他们没有完全破解出这次谈话信号的目的接收地，因此警卫队顶多知道这是一个以KF开头，名字中带有Z和E的星系。

你要做的就是掌控那片区域，然后把我的人送到那通讯塔里让他们向警卫队发条假消息，但愿这条消息能将他们引向KFIE-Z。

messages.en:
I heard you tore them apart, {[character]player.name}. I can't say I'm surprised, either by their presence or by their swift disappearance at your hands. You are a constant reminder of why I should bother with the hassle of enlisting capsuleers.

I've received word from the operators that the comms tower is onlining now. They'll begin transmitting shortly. It looks like we're in the clear. Excellent news, I'm sure you'll agree.

When you feel up to it, I still had someone I wanted you to meet, now that our first order of business is finally settled.
messages.zh:
我听说你把他们打垮了，{[character]player.name}。说实话我并不惊讶，既不对血袭者的出现感到惊讶，也不对他们仓惶出逃感到意外。你再次证明了我不怕麻烦雇用克隆飞行员这一决定是正确的。

我从我人员那儿得到消息说那通讯塔已经在发挥作用了。他们马上就可以开始传输信息了。看来我们没事了，想必你也会认同这是件大好事。

你准备好再来工作之后，我会让你见一个人。现在我们终于完成了开门第一件事。

messages.en: Refusal is unacceptable, I will find someone else. Goodbye {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我不能容忍被拒绝，我会另找他人。再见，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: It is not unheard of for Blood Raider vessels to stray into State space. Having something of a relationship with the Guristas in the north, the Covenant has erected various safe havens for members who make the long journey up to Venal through Caldari space.
messages.zh: 血袭者舰船飘入加达里领域并非是件稀罕事。由于与北方的古斯塔斯相勾结，血袭者同盟已经为许多途径加达里领域远道而至维纳利亚的同胞设立了众多避风港。

messages.en: A place to rest
messages.zh: 休憩地

messages.en:
It appears that the CPF investigation team is in Onirvura because of some intel – intel I believe we can manipulate. I have learned that they partially decrypted a communication between my people here and our blueprint buyers in KFR-ZE. Fortunately for us, they couldn't fully decipher the location we were transmitting to, thank the Maker. My guys re-encrypt their comms every few seconds, so all they know is that this area is where the transmission originated and the destination system started with KF, and has a Z and E in its name. Still, too close for comfort.

Ever heard of KFIE-Z, {[character]player.name}? It's a dead-end system in Delve. The Headquarters of the Blood Raider Covenant, in fact. It's the perfect decoy for us; we can make it look as if opportunistic Blood Raiders hit the Serpentis facility, and there was little more to it all than that. We just need to sell the lie.

There is an old Blood Raider compound not far from here. Inside it, there should be a transmitter system we can use. All you need to do is secure the area and deliver my people safely to the Communications Tower so they can send out a fake transmission. The CPF should pick it up and follow the signal down to Delve… if they're feeling suicidal, that is.

Rumor has it the place has long since been abandoned, but I've come to distrust intel I don't get first-hand. Besides, any time those Sani Sabik cultists are not making noise, you should be concerned. The quiet ones are the very worst. I suggest you go in expecting exactly that.
messages.zh:
我前面已经说过，警卫队的调查队伍是在获悉了某个情报之后才来奥尼尔瓦纳的，我认为我们可以利用那个情报。我知道他们破解了我们与KFR-ZE蓝图买家之间的部分谈话内容。所幸他们没有完全破解出这次谈话信号的目的接收地，在这我要感谢我们的加密人员。由于我们每隔几秒就要变换一种加密方式，因此警卫队顶多知道这是一个以KF开头，名字中带有Z和E的星系。不过我还是担心他们会猜出正确答案。

{[character]player.name}，你听说过KFIE-Z星系吗？它是绝地之域里的一个死角星系。事实上，那儿是血袭者同盟的总部，同时对我们来说，也是个绝佳的诱人场所。我们可以造一个血袭者袭击天蛇基地的假象，然后想办法让警卫队相信就行。

离此不远处有个血袭者的据点。里面应该有一个我们可以利用的信号传输系统。你要做的就是掌控那片区域，然后把我的人送到那通讯塔里让他们发条假消息。警卫队应该会收到这条消息然后一路追到绝地之域……如果他们想死的话，哼哼。

据谣传，那地方早就遭人废弃了。不过对于非一手情报我一概不相信。另外，萨萨比克那帮邪教人士没有动静并不是件好事，这极有可能是暴风雨前的宁静。你要做好相应准备。

messages.en: Failure is not an option, {[character]player.name}. I will find someone else.
messages.zh: 我们这里不容失败，{[character]player.name}。我将另行他人。

messages.en: I really hate Blood Raiders…
messages.zh: 我真的很讨厌血袭者……

messages.en: Blackness Rising
messages.zh: 黑幕袭来

messages.en: I was sent by Isha to personally meet Sinas in the system of Astoh, Black Rise, where he is currently deployed with the Navy. I managed to find my way to his compound and discuss the work ahead of us.
messages.zh: 伊沙派我前往位于暗涌之域的阿希多星系与塞纳斯会面。塞纳斯现与海军一道驻扎在那里。我找到了其住所与他商讨了我们接下来的任务。

messages.en: Isha is sending me off to meet Sinas in person and handle whatever work he has for me. He advised me to bring a small vessel there, suspecting that the work ahead of me will rely on speed and discretion.
messages.zh: 伊沙派我去会面塞纳斯接受他派遣下来的任何任务。伊沙建议我驾驶一艘小船过去。他觉得我接下来的任务可能要仰仗速度与自我判断。

messages.en: Don't let my friend down out there, {[character]player.name}. You're representing us both.
messages.zh: 别让我朋友失望，{[character]player.name}。你代表我们两个人。

messages.en:
It sounds like Sinas is on to something. I want you there to help him in any way you can. He's headed back to his post in Astoh, so you're off to Black Rise to meet him.

From the sounds of it, Sinas will need you for something around there. My advice would be to start by flying an interceptor or frigate down that way. If on the off chance he needs you to do some heavy lifting, then you can go back for something larger. My impression is that he'll want speed and discretion here though; if it was something a fleet of Ravens could hit he'd have handled it with his own crew already.
messages.zh:
听起来塞纳斯好像知道些什么事情。我要你尽其所能去帮助他。他已经返回了其在阿希多的据点，因此你现在就出发前往暗涌之域吧。

看起来塞纳斯要你去那儿处理一件事。我建议你驾驶一艘截击舰或护卫舰去那儿。如果到了那儿他让你拉大货物，那你还可以回来换艘大船再去。但我觉得他那事情要办成需要的是速度与自我决断能力。如果他那事真需要动员一支乌鸦级战列舰舰队，那他自己手下就已经有人能干那样的事了。

messages.en: Fine. I will find someone else. You disappoint me {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 行，我去找别人。你让我失望了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A cursory glance at the Black Rise region reveals a great deal to those with even the most basic understanding of Caldari internal politics. Kaalakiota, Lai Dai and Wiyrkomi led the charge in colonization, each flanked by their private security forces. Supplemented by the Caldari Navy, the State War Academy and Caldari Constructions, the colonization has all the hallmarks of a Patriot faction power play.
messages.zh: 即便粗扫一下暗涌之域，一个哪怕已经对加达里内政有着最基本了解的人也会有众多发现。卡拉吉塔集团、莱戴集团及维克米集团肩负着殖民重任，他们各有一支武装力量保驾。再加上加达里海军、国立军事学院与加达里建筑集团，整个殖民运动就是场标准的爱国军阀角力。

messages.en: Black Rise
messages.zh: 暗涌之域

messages.en:
It sounds like Sinas is on to something. I want you there to help him in any way you can. He's headed back to his post in Astoh, so you're off to Black Rise to meet him, {[character]player.name}. If you've never been there, then you should know that it can be a dangerous place; the leadership of the Federation's capsuleer militia has set its sights on nothing less than total Gallentean occupation of the region. An absurd goal, but they're welcome to try.

From the sounds of it, Sinas will need you for something around there. My advice would be to start by flying an interceptor or frigate down that way. If on the off chance he needs you to do some heavy lifting, then you can go back for something larger. My impression is that he'll want speed and discretion here though; if it was something a fleet of Ravens could hit he'd have handled it with his own crew already.

Anyhow, fly out there, see what's up, and keep in mind what I told you about him. If you can trust me, you should trust him.
messages.zh:
听起来塞纳斯好像知道些什么事情。我要你尽其所能去帮助他。他已经返回了其在阿希多的据点，因此你现在就出发前往暗涌之域吧，{[character]player.name}。如果你从未涉足过那块地方，那我告诉你那是个很危险的地方。盖伦特联邦的国民卫队一心一意想独占那片星域。真是个荒唐可笑的想法，有种他们就试一下。

看起来塞纳斯要你去那儿处理一件事。我建议你驾驶一艘截击舰或护卫舰去那儿。如果到了那儿他让你拉大货物，那你还可以回来换艘大船再去。但我觉得他那事情要办成需要的是速度与自我决断能力。如果他那事真需要动用一支乌鸦级战列舰舰队，那他自己手下就已经有人能干那样的事了。

不管怎样，你现在就飞往那里，看看到底有什么事，并记住我跟你说的那些与塞纳斯有关的事情。如果你相信我，那你也应该相信他。

messages.en: Fine. I will find someone else. You disappoint me {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 行，我去找别人。你让我失望了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: You should see Sinas as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 你应该尽快去见塞纳斯。

name.es: El mejor amigo de un general
name.ru: Лучший друг генерала (A General's Best Friend)

messages.en: Isha expressed a desire for me to meet someone in his stead; a Caldari Navy officer named Sinas Egassuo, who he tells me is some kind of high-ranking, behind-the-scenes operative. It appears that the two of them cannot be seen associating with one another, thanks to the so-called “rumors” that follow Isha around. I eventually met with Sinas in a Caldari Navy compound and he promptly sent me back to Isha to borrow fifty million ISK. Isha sent the ISK over straight away, and requested that I stay on and help Sinas with whatever he needs.
messages.zh: 伊沙要求我去替他见一个人。那人是个名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索的加达里海军军官，伊沙说他是个幕后高官。由于所谓的“流言”，这两个人不能被别人知晓他们之间有关系。我最后在一座加达里海军基地里见到了塞纳斯，他立刻让我回去向伊沙索要5千万星币。伊沙很爽气地将星币汇了出去，并要求我留下来尽全力帮助塞纳斯。

messages.en: Isha expressed a desire for me to meet someone in his stead; a Caldari Navy officer who he tells me is some kind of high-ranking, behind-the-scenes operative. His name is Sinas Egassuo, apparently the brother of Toras, a well-known Commander in Motsu. It appears that Isha and Sinas cannot be seen associating with one another, thanks to the so-called “rumors” that follow Isha around.
messages.zh: 伊沙要求我去替他见一个人。那人是个名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索的加达里海军军官，伊沙说他是个幕后高官。他好像还是莫茨著名司令托哈的兄弟。由于所谓的“流言”，塞纳斯与伊沙这两个人不能被别人知晓他们之间有关系。

messages.en: Good then. Trust what I said {[character]player.name}, the State is lucky to have people like Sinas.
messages.zh: 很好。请相信我说的话，{[character]player.name}，国家拥有塞纳斯这样的人真是有幸。

messages.en:
There was someone I wanted you to meet. I'm afraid I can't do it myself; he and I must be careful not to be associated with one another. This is not for any good reason, {[character]player.name}, it is simply the way our judgmental world works. A Caldari Navy officer of his kind cannot afford the rumors that a friendship with me brings.

My friend's name is Sinas Egassuo. You will find him somewhere around {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, just look for the Caldari Navy compound in the system, and be careful. He may not be known and loved by the Caldari people, but the leadership of the Gallente Navy is well acquainted with him and his work, and has long wanted him dead. His outfit deals with assassins and bounty hunters on a daily basis. Expect nothing less when you find the compound.
messages.zh:
我要你见个人。我自己怕是没法见他；我和他都得注意保持距离。其实这里面也没有什么特别原因，{[character]player.name}，只是这世上人喜欢妄下结论而已。我和他是朋友的消息一经传出之后必将招徕流言蜚语，像他这样的加达里海军军官是受不起这种闲言碎语的。

我朋友名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索。你会在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那里找到他，只要去找该星系中的加达里海军基地就行，但你的行动须谨慎。这家伙或许在加达里人中名气不响，没人喜欢。但盖伦特海军的领导层对其为人与工作都了如指掌，一直想到除掉他。他手下的人每天都进行行刺追捕行动。你抵达他的基地之后便会发现这点。

messages.en: You have reached the Nugoeihuvi Corporation Advisory Office, Poinen. No-one is available to take your call at this moment. Please try again later.
messages.zh: 你已抵达波耶伦的纳维基集团咨询办公室。现在没人能接听你的通话。请过会儿再试试。

messages.en: We were just about to begin the real work, {[character]player.name}! Well, fine. If you have other things to deal with, get to them. You would not be the first egger to walk out on a job barely started. I had expected more from you though, I am sad to say.
messages.zh: 我们这事情正要进入实质性阶段呢，{[character]player.name}！算了算了。如果你有其他事要处理，那就去吧。我料想以后还会有你这样的人出现。我原来还对你报以很高的期望呢。

messages.en: The patriot faction has become increasingly influential since the breakdown in relations with the Federation. The patriots are led by the mighty Kaalakiota Corporation although Lai Dai and Wiyrkomi are often just as vocal in their beliefs. The patriots cultivate the Caldari heritage, reminisce about the great Raata Empire of old and joyously celebrate the reclamation of their homeworld, Caldari Prime.
messages.zh: 自从与盖伦特联邦分道扬镳以来，爱国势力的影响力愈发强大。爱国势力由强大的卡拉吉塔集团领导，但莱戴与维克米也时常发表自己的意见。爱国势力利用加达里的历史鼓吹拉塔古王朝的伟大之处，还经常为重夺加达里首星一事唱赞颂歌。

messages.en: The Patriot Faction
messages.zh: 爱国势力

messages.en:
As I mentioned before, there was someone I wanted you to meet. I'm afraid I can't do it myself; he and I must be careful not to be associated with one another. This is not for any good reason, {[character]player.name}, it is simply the way our judgmental world works. A Caldari Navy officer of his kind cannot afford the rumors that a friendship with me brings. You will learn though, in time, how little truth there is to them. You've already shown a great capacity to see through the surface of things, to the heart. You wouldn't be here still if that wasn't the case.

My friend's name is Sinas Egassuo. He is a man in a similar position to me, working quietly in the engine room, seeking results, not glory. He too, works as an Advisor, and almost every important operation undertaken by our Navy in the last decade bears his imprint. You will hear talk of Caldari patriots in your time in the State, and doubtless already have. This man is a living definition of one.

You will find him somewhere around {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, just look for the Caldari Navy compound in the system, and be careful. He may not be known and loved by the Caldari people, but the leadership of the Gallente Navy is well acquainted with him and his work, and has long wanted him dead. His outfit deals with assassins and bounty hunters on a daily basis. Expect nothing less when you find the compound.

Oh, and if his surname seems familiar that's because you've probably met his sister. She works as a capsuleer liaison for the Navy's Command Division in Motsu. I wouldn't mention anything about her though; sisters are a sore spot for him.
messages.zh:
我前面已说过，我要你见个人。我自己怕是没法见他；我和他都得注意保持距离。其实这里面也没有什么特别原因，{[character]player.name}，只是这世上人喜欢妄下结论而已。我和他是朋友的消息一经传出之后必将招徕流言蜚语，像他这样的加达里海军军官是受不起这种闲言碎语的。你以后会明白类似这样的传言有多荒唐。你已经证明了你能洞察事物真相，否则你现在不可能还出现在我面前。

我朋友名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索。他和我的职责差不多，都是注重结果、不屑名气，在幕后行动的人。他也是顾问。在过去十年里，我们海军的每次行动策划几乎都有他的参与。你将来会听到一些有关加达里爱国者的事迹，而且我相信你对此其实已经有所耳闻。这人就是个活生生的例子。

你会在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}那里找到他，只要去找该星系中的加达里海军基地就行，但你的行动须谨慎。这家伙或许在加达里人中名气不响，没人喜欢。但盖伦特海军的领导层对其为人与工作都了如指掌，一直想到除掉他。他手下的人每天都进行行刺追捕行动。你抵达他的基地之后便会发现这点。

哦，如果你觉得他的姓听起来耳熟，那可能是因为你已经见过了他的妹妹。他妹妹在莫茨的海军指挥部当克隆飞行员联系人。不过我可不会跟你说有关他妹妹的任何事；他对他的妹妹很头疼。

messages.en: I…already set things in motion. Your failure here has cost me much, much more than you realize. Go then, {[character]player.name}. If you cannot be relied upon, I have no desire to give you any further work.
messages.zh: 我……已经让事情进行起来了。你这次失败给我带来的损失远远超出你的想象。走吧走吧，{[character]player.name}。你既然靠不住，那我也不想再与你合作了。

messages.en: You have reached the Nugoeihuvi Corporation Advisory Office, Poinen. No-one is available to take your call at this moment. Please try again later.
messages.zh: 你已抵达波耶伦的纳维基集团咨询办公室。现在没人能接听你的通话。请过会儿再试试。

messages.en: Interference
messages.zh: 干扰

messages.en: The Sansha ambushed and destroyed an MIO investigator.
messages.zh: 萨沙偷袭害死了一名内务部的调查员。

messages.en: Kandus Sandar's investigator is missing.
messages.zh: 堪都司·杉达尔的调查员失踪了。

messages.en:
I would fly out there, but a capsuleer like yourself will have less trouble should you encounter any complications. Plus, if you do encounter danger, you at least have a pod to save you. I do not have that luxury.

I have uploaded the location of the last communique to your NeoCom. Head over there immediately. I cannot have more delays.
messages.zh:
我自己可以亲自前往，但像你这样的克隆飞行员路上遇到点事肯定能比我更容易地逢凶化吉。另外，一旦你遭遇不测，你还有逃生舱保命。我就没那福气。

我已经把最近一次通信的位置上传到你的控制边栏。请立即动身前往那里。这事不能再耽搁下去了。

messages.en: I am waiting for one of my investigators. He is now several hours overdue in delivering his reports. I need someone to fly out to his last known location. Despite whatever you may find there, I need those reports.
messages.zh: 我在等我的一个调查员。他原本几个小时前就该回来向我报告了，但他没有。请前往他最近一次已知待过的地方。不管你在那儿发现了什么情况，我都要获得他的那些报告。

messages.en: A Sansha ambush is disturbing. The Sansha that frequent this region are usually nothing more than rampaging drones, salvaging for parts and human life wherever they can find it. But an attack on my investigator implies purpose.
messages.zh: 萨沙的这次偷袭让我不安。原本他们经常光顾此区域只是为了拣垃圾、捞尸体而已，就像一群无人机一样。但这次弄死了我的一名调查员，他们背后肯定有目的。

messages.en: I suppose I can't blame you. Tracking down a truant employee is not the most exciting work.
messages.zh: 也许我不应该怪你。追查一名失踪雇员的下落确实让人提不起精神。

messages.en:
Ah, a capsuleer, are you? Fortunate.
I am Kandus Sandar, the Ministry of Internal Order officer in charge of Pirate Affairs in this area. Under normal circumstances, I would send you to one of our many agents for proper work, but I have a special task for you.
I am waiting for one of my investigators. He is now several hours overdue in delivering his reports. Fly out to his last known location. Despite whatever you may find there, I need those reports.
messages.zh:
啊，来了一位克隆飞行员，对吗？我运气不错。

我是堪都司·杉达尔，内务部的人，负责处理此地区的海盗相关事件。正常情况下，我会把你派到我众多手下中的随便哪个给你安排份合适的差事，但我现在有项特殊任务要交给你。

我在等我的一个调查员。他原本几个小时前就该回来向我报告了，但他没有。请前往他最近一次已知待过的地方。不管你在那儿发现了什么情况，我都要获得他的那些报告。

messages.en: That is unfortunate. I was expecting you to finish this for me.
messages.zh: 真倒霉，我还以为你能替我完成此事的呢。

messages.en: Your story matches these reports. Sansha activity is on the rise. The Sansha that frequent this region are usually nothing more than opportunists, salvaging for parts and human life wherever they can find it.
messages.zh: 你的叙述与这些报告很吻合。萨沙的活动开始频繁起来。原本他们经常光顾此区域只是为了拣垃圾、捞尸体而已，就像投机商一样。

messages.en: The Sansha attempted to destroy an outpost owned by Lord Touraj Miyan.
messages.zh: 萨沙企图摧毁托拉杰·米雅安大人的一座哨站。

messages.en: A listening outpost owned by Lord Miyan is under attack.
messages.zh: 领主米雅安大人的一座监听哨站正遭受攻击。

messages.en: Remember, destroy any and all Sansha. We don't want any escaping this fight.
messages.zh: 记住，将所有的萨沙都一网打尽，全部消灭。

messages.en: A group of Sansha's Nation ships are attacking a listening outpost owned by Lord Touraj Miyan. Head to the outpost and stop them from destroying that outpost. I will retrieve logs from the fight from your ship's computer once you return.
messages.zh: 一群萨沙舰船正飞往托拉杰·米雅安大人的一座监听哨站。请前往那哨站，别让他们毁了那哨站。你回来后我会读取你的舰船记录。

messages.en: I've taken the liberty of examining your ship's logs. That outpost was unmanned, in disrepair, and not particularly valuable. There's no reason a group of marauders would attack it. There must be something more.
messages.zh: 我已经先看了一下你的舰船记录。那哨站无人值守、年久失修，没啥特别价值。一群强盗应该没理由去攻击它的。这事肯定另有蹊跷。

messages.en: What are risks to a capsuleer like you?
messages.zh: 这事对你这类克隆飞行员来说还有什么风险？

messages.en: These reports suggest that a group of Sansha's Nation ships were seen heading for a listening outpost owned by one Lord Touraj Miyan, a local Holder. The Sansha must have killed my agent to prevent this information from getting out. Head over to the outpost and give the Sansha a surprise.
messages.zh: 这些报告显示一群萨沙舰船正飞往托拉杰·米雅安君王的一座监听哨站。托拉杰·米雅安大人是当地的贵族。萨沙一定已经干掉了我的代理人以防消息泄露。你快赶往那哨站打他们个措手不及。

messages.en: Are you giving up so easily?
messages.zh: 你就这么轻易放弃了？

messages.en: The Sansha were driven away from one of Miyan's slave convoys, but the commander escaped.
messages.zh: 虽然萨沙从米雅尔的劳工运输队那里被赶走，但他们的指挥官却逃了。

messages.en: Sansha are attacking a slave convoy. Their commander is present.
messages.zh: 萨沙正在攻击一支劳工运输队。他们的指挥官也在场。

messages.en: Get to it.
messages.zh: 快行动起来。

messages.en: A Sansha's Nation fleet attacked a slave convoy belonging to Touraj Miyan. Their commander may be present at the conflict. Your primary objective is to discover the identity of their commander and destroy him.
messages.zh: 一支萨沙的舰队攻击了托拉杰·米雅安的劳工运输队。他们的指挥官可能也在场。你的首要任务就是找出那指挥官把他干掉。

messages.en: Good job, but it's not over yet. I've got a lock on the commander that ran away.
messages.zh: 干得好，但事情还没完。我已经盯上了那个溜走的指挥官。

messages.en: How could you refuse me? After all this?
messages.zh: 你怎么能在进行到这个地步之后还拒绝我的要求？

messages.en:
This needs to be taken care of quickly, {[character]player.name}. Another group of Sansha's Nation ships has launched an attack. This time, they targeted a slave convoy belonging to - take a guess - Lord Touraj Miyan.

However, we've got word that an unusual ship joined the Sansha in the attack. The transmission cut off before we could get concrete details on who or what it was, but I'm willing to bet it's the commander of the bunch. The fleet is large, but should be a non-issue for a capsuleer.

Stop the Sansha and their commander.
messages.zh:
这事需要尽快解决，{[character]player.name}。另一队萨沙的人已经发动了一场袭击。这次他们的目标是一个属于——你猜猜是谁——托拉杰·米雅安大人的劳工运输队。

不过据说还有一艘奇怪的船参与了萨沙袭击。那船上的通讯在我们尚未弄清楚其到底是谁之前就已经中断了。不过我打赌那船是艘指挥舰。那舰队规模虽大，但对克隆飞行员来说应该是小菜一碟。

请前往阻击萨沙及他们的指挥官。

messages.en: How could you let them get away?
messages.zh: 你怎么会让他们跑的？

messages.en: The commander escaped, aided by a third party flying Amarr ships.
messages.zh: 那司令在一个驾驶艾玛船的第三方的帮助下逃走了。

messages.en: The Sansha commander is on the run.
messages.zh: 那萨沙司令处于在逃状态。

messages.en: You handle the commander, I'll figure out how the Sansha are getting past our defenses.
messages.zh: 你去解决那司令，我去调查萨沙是如何躲过我们防守力量的。

messages.en: Chase down the Sansha commander.
messages.zh: 去追击那萨沙司令。

messages.en: I can't believe the commander got away again! Who was flying those Amarr ships? And where did that gate come from?
messages.zh: 我简直无法相信那司令又溜走了！那帮驾驶着艾玛船的人究竟是谁？还有那门是从哪儿冒出来的？

messages.en: We're so close to getting this guy and you quit now?
messages.zh: 我们离抓住这家伙只有一步之遥，而你现在却要退出？

messages.en: Okay, we have his location. Follow the bookmark and take him down.
messages.zh: 好了，我们知道他在哪里了。跟着这坐标走把他干掉。

messages.en: No! We were so close to catching him!
messages.zh: 不！我们差一点就抓到他了！

messages.en: Do you have the commander yet?
messages.zh: 你抓到那司令了吗？

messages.en: Spiderweb Politics
messages.zh: 错综复杂的政治

messages.en: You met Aralin Jick, your local contact.
messages.zh: 你与你的本地联系人阿拉林·基可见了面。

messages.en: Kandus recommends you speak with Aralin Jick in Nishah.
messages.zh: 堪都司建议你去见尼沙尔的阿拉林·基可。

messages.en:
He has a rather intimate knowledge of Sansha's Nation. I'll let him decide if he wants to share the details with you.

Since he works directly for the Kor-Azor Family, he is in a position to do more digging in the area than I can, and he'll step on toes if necessary.

Just remember: Whoever is leading these Sansha is targeting a Holder. There aren't many people we can trust, so be diligent.
messages.zh:
他对萨沙有非常深入的了解。但他是否肯把那些详情告诉你就看他自己愿不愿意了。

由于他直接为柯埃佐家族效力，因此他能比我查得更透彻，而且他也敢在必要时候冒犯高层。

记住：不管是谁在指挥这群萨沙人，他的目标都是贵族。这世上可信的人不多，所以你要时刻警惕。

messages.en: We need to get to the bottom of this. You can break this thing wide open. You need to talk to someone with both a knowledge of the Sansha and has local connections. Luckily, I have just such a contact: Aralin Jick.
messages.zh: 我们要把这事查个水落石出。你能把事情搞大。你需要去见一个与萨沙和当地人都有关系的人。所幸我已经为你找好了这样一个人，他名叫阿拉林·基可。

messages.en: Sandar sent you, eh? He probably sent you to me to keep an eye on me as much as anything else.  Did he tell you my history? No, of course not. I'm going to help you anyway, because despite whatever Sandar thinks, I want the Sansha gone.
messages.zh: 杉达派你来的？他派你来大概有事求我，但同时也想必是要监视我。他跟你聊过我的事迹吗？呵呵，应该不大会。不管如何，我还是决定帮你，因为我也想将萨沙除掉。杉达怎么想是他的事。

messages.en: You're giving up the chase now?
messages.zh: 你不会想中途而废吧？

messages.en:
We need to get to the bottom of this. Those Amarr ships came from somewhere and someone.

I can't do the legwork myself. My MIO clearance can open a lot of doors, but there's too much red tape for me to jump through. You, however, can do what I can't. You can break this thing wide open.

You need to talk to someone with both a knowledge of the Sansha and local connections. Luckily, I have just such a contact: Aralin Jick.
messages.zh:
我们要把这事查个水落石出。那些艾玛船是受了某人指使从某地而来的。

我自己没法追查。虽然本人在内务部中的级别能保证我查到很多资料，但要经过的官僚步骤太多。不过你能替我去查，因为你能把事情搞大。

你需要去见一个与萨沙和当地人都有关系的人。所幸我已经为你找好了这样一个人，他名叫阿拉林·基可。

messages.en: You're giving up the chase now?
messages.zh: 你不会想中途而废吧？

messages.en: You'll find Jick in the Nishah system. Follow his lead. Empress be with you.
messages.zh: 你可以在尼沙尔星系找到阿拉林·基可。按他提供的线索行动。愿女王陛下与你同在。

messages.en: An opportune attack by the Sansha convinced Security Chief Riff Hebian that Lord Miyan was the target of their attacks.
messages.zh: 一场来得正巧的萨沙袭击让警卫队长里夫·赫比安相信了米雅安大人确实是他们的目标。

messages.en: Aralin Jick wants you to convince Riff Hebian of the Sansha threat.
messages.zh: 阿拉林·基可要你想办法让里夫·赫比安相信萨沙威胁的存在。

messages.en: Excellent.
messages.zh: 太好了

messages.en: The Sansha attacks are obviously targeted at Touraj Miyan. Riff Hebian, Miyan's chief of security, is smart but skeptical. Head to Miyan's manor in Nebian and convince Hebian of the threat.
messages.zh: 萨沙的袭击明显是冲着托拉杰·米雅安去的。米雅安的警卫队长里夫·赫比安是个聪明人，但生性多疑。请前往米雅安在勒比亚的宫殿，让赫比安相信这场威胁的存在。

messages.en: The Sansha attacked? The Empress' grace is upon us, friend. If we weren't going to kill every one of them, I'd give whoever ordered that Sansha attack a medal.
messages.zh: 萨沙袭击了？没关系，女王陛下在保佑我们，朋友。如果我们不能把那群萨沙人一网打尽，我就给下令萨沙行动的人发去一份贺电！

messages.en: Very well. Go find someone else to bother then.
messages.zh: 很好，那我找别人去了。

messages.en:
Even though many Holder titles extend back thousands of years, the position is a precarious one. Families waxed and waned over the centuries. Most families realize the rule of fools is inevitable; all they can do is hope too much damage isn't done before a proper ruler can ascend again.

House Miyan has ruled much of the Jatari constellation for centuries. Miyan grew to be one of the top Holder houses, rivaling Kor-Azor in local influence. In 109, Lord Miyan died and passed his title to his only son, Touraj Miyan.

Touraj is considered a dolt, accused of being more likely to make a pass at subordinate Holders' wives than realize his chief advisor is dipping into senility. Lord Iraj Darabi, a minor but well-respected neighboring Holder, used Touraj's unpopularity and foolishness to his own advantage. In 110, he annexed two of the systems under House Miyan control for himself, sparking a minor conflict between the two Houses.

In the end, Darabi's superior commanders and advisors forced Miyan to surrender. So far, Miyan has managed to hold on to his remaining lands.
messages.zh:
虽然很多贵族头上的称号早在千年之前就已建立，但他们的地位并不稳固，正所谓“三十年河东三十年河西”。大多数贵族都明白昏君不可避免；他们只是希望在这样的情况下，能有个明君尽快出来救世。

米雅安皇族统治加塔利星座已有数百年之久。期间该族成了威望最高的皇族之一，在当地影响力足以与柯埃佐家族匹敌。109年，米雅安大人过世，王位传给了其独生子：托拉杰·米雅安。

人们都认为托拉杰是个白痴，并指责他无视其首席顾问年暮痴呆，反而花精力调戏其手下贵族的妻子。伊拉杰·德拉比大人尽管未成年，但却是一位受尊敬的毗邻贵族。他利用了托拉杰的愚蠢与低号召力。110年，他将原本由米雅安皇族控制的两个星系合并到了自己的势力范围内，导致两家之间产生小规模冲突。

最后，实力超凡的德拉比文武官员逼迫米雅安缴械投降。目前，那些剩下的领域还在米雅安的掌控之下。

messages.en: Lord Miyan
messages.zh: 米雅安大人

messages.en:
Sansha's Nation is targeting Touraj Miyan. Why? Miyan is a fool, yes, but the Sansha are unlikely to care about an ineffectual noble. The other Holders, however, are sharks. They can smell weakness. Miyan already lost about half of his domains back in YC 110. The Holders are just circling, waiting for their chance to take another bite.

If it wasn't for the efforts of Lord Miyan's staff, he'd be dead already. His current security chief, Riff Hebian, is a smart but skeptical man, and difficult to sway. Head over to Miyan's manor and convince Hebian that the Sansha are targeting Miyan directly. His help and trust would be invaluable.
messages.zh:
萨沙的目标是托拉杰·米雅安。我不明白这是为什么？虽说米雅安是个傻瓜，但萨沙不可能在意一个无用的权贵。其他的贵族才可怕呢，他们像鲨鱼一样，时刻寻找机会。米雅尔在110年时已经丢掉了大概其一半的领域。一朝天子一朝臣，其他贵族正在静候着他们称王的机会。

要不是米雅安大人的手下帮忙，这家伙早死了。他现在的警卫队长里夫·赫比安是个聪明人，但生性多疑且不易动摇。请前往米雅安的宫殿，让赫比安相信萨沙已经瞄上了米雅安。他的帮助与信任万分重要。

messages.en: Disappointing.
messages.zh: 真让人失望。

messages.en: Riff Hebian isn't going to believe me. A capsuleer, however....
messages.zh: 里夫·赫比安不会相信我。但如果换作克隆飞行员的话……

messages.en: Lady Jariza, a minor Holder who was rejected by Lord Miyan for political marriage, has been courting Lord Darabi in recent months.
messages.zh: 初级贵族札力萨女士提出与米雅安大人政治联姻而遭拒，近几个月来她一直在与德拉比大人套近乎。

messages.en: Lady Jariza was once rejected by Lord Miyan. Her communications array may hide signs of a revenge plot.
messages.zh: 札力萨女士曾在米雅安大人那里吃过闭门羹。她的通信阵列里可能暗藏着一项报复计划。

messages.en: Lady Jariza may be a minor noble, but she can still afford a small army. Don't mess with her guards directly unless you want a needless fight on your hands.
messages.zh: 札力萨女士虽说是个初级贵族，但她还是有召集一支小军队的能力。如果你不想打无谓仗，那就别与她的保安起直接冲突。

messages.en:
The first suspect is Lady Temari Jariza. She doesn't even technically own any land holdings, just a small, floating citadel in Amdonen.

I need you to hack the encrypted communications array in her territory. This should provide you with logs of all the communications and transactions in recent weeks. Bring these logs back to me.
messages.zh:
第一个怀疑对象就是特玛丽·札力萨女士。她甚至连寸土地都没有，只是在安姆多尼有座小堡垒而已。

我要你去破解她那儿的通信阵列。破解之后你应该能拿到最近几周完整的通讯记录，把它们带来交给我。

messages.en:
Let me look over these logs.

Strange. There's a lot of chatter between Lady Jariza and Lord Darabi, another local Holder. Been a lot of money transactions from him, too. Although Lord Darabi is a rival of Miyan, there's nothing here that appears sinister. Most likely Lady Jariza has merely given up on courting Miyan and is trying for the next titled family.
messages.zh:
让我看看这些记录。

奇怪，札力萨女士与当地另一贵族德拉比大人交谈甚多，还从他那儿获得了大笔资金。虽然德拉比大人是米雅安的对头，但这里看不出有什么作对的目的。很可能是札力萨女士放弃了追求米雅尔，转投下一显赫贵族了。

messages.en: Stopping Sansha's Nation is the utmost priority. If you have a weak stomach, I think you should look elsewhere.
messages.zh: 制止萨沙是头等大事。如果你胆小，那就请另寻出路吧。

messages.en:
Touraj Miyan has a lot of people who hate him. They want him dead, want his land, or just want to embarrass him. Some of these people are more powerful than others. It will take a while to investigate them all.

First up is Lady Temari Jariza. Among Holders, she's a nobody. She doesn't even technically own any land holdings, just a small, floating citadel in Amdonen granted to her five-times-great grandfather for exceptional service in putting down a rebellion.

Unlike her ancestors, Lady Jariza actually has ambitions. Unfortunately for her, she's not taken very seriously. She's attempted to improve her standing through most of the common channels, ranging from patronage to marriage. She's even tried to court Lord Miyan numerous times, but she has thus far been unsuccessful. It's for this reason that she's on the suspect list. She has motive, but I need to know if she's had the means and opportunity.

I need you to hack the encrypted communications array in her territory. This should provide you with logs of all the communications and transactions in recent weeks. Bring these logs back to me.
messages.zh:
托拉杰·米雅安招很多人嫉恨。有些人想要他的命，有些人想占他的地盘，还有些人只想嘲弄他而已。这些人中有些要比其他人强。把他们的底细都调查清楚需要花点时间。

我们第一个调查对象便是特玛丽·札力萨女士。在贵族中，她是个不起眼的角色。她甚至连寸土地都没有，只是在安姆多尼有座小堡垒而已。那堡垒还是从她老爸那儿继承过来的。她父亲的成就是她的五倍，曾因控制叛乱有功而获赠了那座堡垒。

与其前辈不同的是，札力萨女士是个有野心的人。可惜没人把她当回事。她利用各种常见手段试图高攀，包括塞钱与嫁人。她甚至还无数次地想与米雅安大人套近乎，但至今无功而返。就是因为这原因我怀疑她。她有这个动机，不过我不清楚她是否还具备相应的手段与机会。

我要你去破解她那儿的通信阵列。破解之后你应该能拿到最近几周完整的通讯记录，把它们带来交给我。

messages.en: You couldn't do it? I thought you were made of sterner stuff.
messages.zh: 你没法干？我还以为你是比较强悍的一类人呢。

messages.en: Have you retrieved those logs from the communications array yet?
messages.zh: 你从那通信阵列里的拿到那些记录了吗？

messages.en: Aralin Jick suspects the Amarr ships you encountered were mercenaries hired by Lord Manik. You successfully tracked the mercenaries back to their camp.
messages.zh: 阿拉林·基可怀疑你之前遇到的艾玛船是马尼克大人花钱请的雇佣军。你成功地跟踪那帮雇佣军到了他们的营地。

messages.en: You are to stake out a meeting between Lord Manik's people and mercenaries.
messages.zh: 你的任务就是去监视马尼克大人手下的人与雇佣军的会面。

messages.en: Good luck. I'll contact you remotely when you're done.
messages.zh: 祝你好运。你完成任务之后我会远程联系你的。

messages.en:
Remember those Amarr ships you ran into? It seems that one Lord Manik has been shopping around for mercenaries.

I'm giving you the meeting location I found while innocently perusing Manik's records. There should be a mercenary contact. You're going to find out who they are, and then we're going to wipe them out. I'll have more instructions when you reach the site.
messages.zh:
还记得你之前遇到的那批艾玛舰船吗？看起来马尼克大人正在挑选雇佣军。

我把我不小心查看其记录时发现的会面地址告诉你。那里应该会有个雇佣军的联系人等候着。你的任务就是去查一下他们是谁，然后我们就计划把他们灭掉。你到达那儿之后我会再教你怎么做的。

messages.en: I've got a lock on the contact. I know where he's going.
messages.zh: 我已经盯上了那个联系人。我知道他往哪儿去。

messages.en: You're backing out now? I can't believe you'd do that.
messages.zh: 你现在要退出？我真不敢相信你会这样。

messages.en: Manik Family History
messages.zh: 马尼克家族史

messages.en:
I have a few contacts in Lord Darabi's territory. Maybe something will turn up with this Jariza connection, but I doubt it.

I've learned of a more pressing lead for you. Remember those Amarr ships you ran into? It seems that one Lord Manik has been shopping around for mercenaries.

I'm giving you the meeting location I found while innocently perusing Manik's records. There should be a mercenary contact. You're going to find out who they are, and then we're going to wipe them out. I'll have more instructions when you reach the site.
messages.zh:
我在德拉比大人的辖区内认识些人。也许我们能从这联系中看出些端倪，不过我还是对此有所怀疑。

我现在有个更紧迫的线索要你去查。还记得你之前遇到的那批艾玛舰船吗？看起来马尼克大人正在挑选雇佣军。

我把我不小心查看其记录时发现的会面地址告诉你。那里应该会有个雇佣军的联系人等候着。你的任务就是去查一下他们是谁，然后我们就计划把他们灭掉。你到达那儿之后我会再教你怎么做的。

messages.en: We didn't even get to the blowing-stuff-up part.
messages.zh: 我们还没进行到动刀枪的地步呢。

messages.en: Has the deal happened? What's going on?
messages.zh: 那生意成了吗？事情怎么了？

name.de: Den Außenposten in Schutt und Asche legen

messages.en: You severely ruined the mercenaries' day.
messages.zh: 你把雇佣军整惨了。

messages.en: You know the location of the mercenary camp.
messages.zh: 你知道雇佣军的营地在哪儿。

messages.en: They're not Sansha, but popping mercs will do in a pinch.
messages.zh: 他们虽不是萨沙，但干掉这帮雇佣兵也行。

messages.en: I've got the coordinates to the mercenary camp. Tear down everything you find. Time to ruin someone's day.
messages.zh: 我已经拿到了雇佣军营地的地址。去那儿消灭你见到的一切东西。我们要好好整整他们。

messages.en: I wish I was there. Looking at the damage estimates, I bet that gang will never be able to rebuild.
messages.zh: 真希望我也在现场。从伤害预估来看，我看他们是无法东山再起了。

messages.en: Killing mercs isn't even morally objectionable!
messages.zh: 干掉雇佣兵不牵涉任何道德问题！

messages.en: I'm sending you the mercenary's coordinates. This should be the base they've been operating out of. Wipe them out. Leave no opportunity to rebuild.
messages.zh: 我把雇佣军的地址给你。这应该就是他们行动的基地。把他们全灭掉，打得他们再也爬不起来。

messages.en: Killing mercs isn't even morally objectionable!
messages.zh: 干掉雇佣兵不牵涉任何道德问题！

messages.en: How fare our mercenary friends?
messages.zh: 我们的那些雇佣军朋友如何了？

messages.en: Impetus
messages.zh: 促进工业

messages.en: I met with Gian Parele, an Impetus holoreel director. His next project involves filming scenes in space, and so he asked for my assistance. I accepted a job scouting out one of his team's shooting locations. The place was swarming with rogue drones, and I also noticed a gang of Minmatar pilots in combat cruisers loitering a good distance away. Gian figures them for vagrants and doesn't seem worried. It looks like his crew is going to head in and start filming there soon.
messages.zh: 我与促进工业的一位电影导演吉安·帕若勒见了面。他的下一部电影将涉及太空场景的拍摄，因此他要求我协助。他要求我去探查一下他们的一个拍摄地，我照做了。那地方滋生着自由无人机，我还注意到有一群驾驶着战斗巡洋舰的米玛塔尔飞行员游荡在离我很远的地方。吉安认为他们是捡破烂的，并不在意。看来他的人即将飞往那里开始他们的拍摄工作了。

messages.en: I met with Gian Parele, an Impetus holoreel director. His next project involves filming scenes in space, and so he needs the help of a pilot like me. I've been offered a job scouting out one of their shooting locations and making sure it will be safe for them to move in.
messages.zh: 我与促进工业的一位电影导演吉安·帕若勒见了面。他的下一部电影将涉及太空场景的拍摄，因此他需要像我这样的飞行员的帮忙。他要求我去探查一下他们的一个拍摄地，保证他们在那儿能安全。

messages.en: I appreciate you stepping in to help us out. I'll talk with accounting about sorting out some pay for your troubles; that shouldn't be a problem. I'll leave my comms link open; once you've scouted the area and it's safe to proceed, get back in touch with me.
messages.zh: 感谢你伸出援手帮忙。我会与我会计商量一下给你一些跑腿费，他应该会同意的。我会一直保持我信道畅通。你转悠了那地方之后如果觉得没事，就请回来与我联系。

messages.en: Your first task is to investigate a possible filming location. We're not expecting any major problems, but after an accident last week scouting a similar location, I'd rather have these matters handled by someone who really knows what they're doing. I'll leave my comms link open; once you've scouted the area and it's safe to proceed, get back in touch with me.
messages.zh: 你第一个任务就是去调查一下拍摄候选地。我们虽然不认为会出什么大问题，但上周类似这样的调查出了岔之后，我这次需要一个脑子好用的人来办这件事。我会一直保持我信道畅通。你转悠了那地方之后如果觉得没事，就请回来与我联系。

messages.en:
Rogue drones and Minmatar, eh? Hmm. Yes, well, I've heard rumors, but I thought that was all just a scary tale to keep people out of there. The place has a history, you see. That's partly why we wanted to film there in the first place, and probably what made those Minnie vagrants think it was a safe place to squat. I suppose we can shoot the area from certain angles to exclude the damn drone hive, but I'll have to check it out myself. At least we can proceed with that, thanks to your good work.

There's a few other favors I'd ask of you, {[character]player.name}, if you're still free. Get back to me if you're interested.
messages.zh:
自由无人机与米玛塔尔人？好吧，我之前是听说过这样的传言，但我以为那只是用来吓唬人，好让大家不去那儿的谎言。你知道那地方历史久远，这也是我们为什么要选址那儿拍摄的部分原因，也许这也是那帮米玛塔尔流浪汉将那儿作为避风港的原因。我认为我们能从某个特定角度拍摄以避开那群讨厌的无人机，不过我还得亲自去看看。无论如何，至少我们现在可以去那儿了，谢谢你的帮忙。

如果你有空，我还有其他事要你协助，{[character]player.name}。有兴趣的话就来找我。

messages.en: I understand, {[character]player.name}. Thanks for taking the time to listen, at least, and if you see anyone else in your travels who might be able to help, let me know.
messages.zh: 我懂，{[character]player.name}。至少谢谢你听完我的请求。如果你在旅途中遇见可以帮忙的人，请告诉我。

messages.en: Impetus is the main producer of holoreels in New Eden, creating anything from epic historical movies to cheap porn flicks. Their cadre of established directors alone number in the tens of thousands; the actors they employ are literally countless. On one hand, the near infinite nature of their resources allows for the production of many risky, experimental holoreel projects, and yet at the same time, it is all too easy for an aspiring holoreel actress to get lost among a thousand other beautiful faces.
messages.zh: 促进工业是世界上主要的全息电影厂，从宏伟的史诗电影到廉价的盗版影片，题材无所不及。他们那儿的知名导演数以万计，演员更是无数。另一方面，这种几近无限的资源能够让这些导演放手尝试拍摄风险大的影片，但同时在这一放眼都是美女的竞争环境中，一位有进取心的女星很容易被埋没。

messages.en: Impetus
messages.zh: 促进工业

messages.en:
Ah, the famous {[character]player.name}. Welcome! I don't get to mingle with an egger every day, so it's an honor to finally meet you face to face -- or close enough to it anyways.

I assume you've come to help with my next holoreel project here at Impetus? Yes, well, quite a few setbacks already, I'm afraid. As someone like you might appreciate, I didn't fully understand what I was getting into when I decided to film everything in space. Things have become a little more difficult than I expected. We could really use an experienced capsuleer like you to keep everything on track. Frankly, I don't know why we didn't consider the option sooner.
