If you're able to help out, then your first task would be to investigate a possible filming location. We're not expecting any major problems, but after an accident last week scouting a similar location, I'd rather have these matters handled by someone who really knows what they're doing. I don't suppose you'd be free and willing to scout the area?
messages.zh:
啊，久仰大名，{[character]player.name}。欢迎欢迎！我不是每天都有机会和一名克隆飞行员相识的，因此很荣幸能面对面地与你见面——至少咱俩现在距离已经很接近了。

我猜你是来促进工业协助拍摄我的下一部全息电影的吧？很好，不过我已经在这事上遇到了不少挫折。想必像你们这类人应该能理解，我对在太空中拍摄场景略感到有些不安。有些事情比我预计的更困难。我们可以利用像你这样经验丰富的克隆飞行员来确保事情进展顺利。说实话我就纳闷我们怎么没早点想到这个方法。

如果你能帮忙，那你第一个任务就是去调查一下拍摄候选地。我们虽然不认为会出什么大问题，但上周类似这样的调查出了岔之后，我这次需要一个脑子好用的人来办这件事。你愿意去调查一下吗？

messages.en: No problem, {[character]player.name}. I understand how precious an egger's time can be. Thank you for trying, in any case.
messages.zh: 没什么，{[character]player.name}。我知道你们克隆飞行员的时间宝贵。至少你试过了，谢谢。

messages.en: Any new information on the site?
messages.zh: 有那地方的新消息吗？

messages.en: Gian started by explaining to me that he'd hired a high profile child model to star in his next holoreel. The kid's name is Ralie Ardanne, and he's the son of a Senator. When I arrived at the senatorial residence, the place was in tatters. Most of the security had been disabled, and  I saw the same group Gian mistook for vagrants -- the Minmatar calling themselves the Pator 6 -- hovering around Ralie's ship before it was boarded. Gian tells me that Impetus would like me to head up the investigation and recovery effort.
messages.zh: 吉安告诉我他已经聘用了一位著名儿童模特作为他下部全息电影里的明星演员。那孩子名叫拉赖·阿丹，是一名参议员的儿子。当我抵达参议员住所之后，我发现那里废墟一片。多数保镖已经倒下，而且我看到吉安之前误以为是流浪汉的一群人——一群自称帕特六人组的米玛塔尔人——在环绕拉赖舰船之后登上了那船。吉安对我说促进工业希望我能先去进行调查营救。

messages.en: Gian has hired someone high profile to star in his next holoreel. His name is Ralie Ardanne, and he's the son of a Senator (and apparently a successful young model). I've been asked to fly over to the Ardenne senatorial residence and escort the kid back to the set.
messages.zh: 吉安聘用了一位著名人物作为他下部全息电影里的明星演员。他名叫拉赖·阿丹，是一名参议员的儿子（这孩子同时也是一位成功的模特）。我被要求前去阿丹参议员住所，将那孩子带回摄影棚。

messages.en: I will tell Ralie's guardian that you're on the way to pick him up. Let me know when you've arrived.
messages.zh: 我会通知拉赖的保镖你要去接他的事。你到了那儿之后告诉我一声。

messages.en: The shining star in this holoreel project of mine is a fairly high profile individual, as you might expect. His name is Ralie Ardanne, and he's the son of a low-profile Senator. He's looking to expand his already vast popularity into holoreels, which is where Impetus comes in. Of course, a boy his age and with his connections shouldn't be travelling the spacelanes unguarded. I was hoping you would be interested in meeting him at his father's senatorial residence. I'll let Ralie's guardians know that you are on the way to pick him up. Let me know when you've arrived.
messages.zh: 也许你已经料到，我这部全息电影中的闪耀明星将会是一个比较知名的人物。他名叫拉赖·阿丹，是一位低调参议员的儿子。他想进军电影界，正好促进工业可以帮忙。当然喽，像他这样年纪且人脉众多的男孩决不能没人保驾护航。我希望你可以去他父亲的参议员住所那儿去接他。我会通知拉赖的保镖你要去接他的事。你到了那儿之后告诉我一声。

messages.en: The Federation authorities have asked for your continued assistance, under the provisional direction of Impetus. I'm not sure if you were interested in sticking with us, {[character]player.name}, but we could use the help. Let me know if you're interested.
messages.zh: 联邦政府要求你在促进工业的临时带领下继续协助我们。我不知道你是否有兴趣继续与我们合作，{[character]player.name}，但我们确实有事让你做。请告诉我你是否感兴趣。

messages.en: Really? Huh, ok then {[character]player.name}. Safe travels, and thanks for all the time you spared.
messages.zh: 当真？哦，好吧，{[character]player.name}。祝你一路平安，并谢谢你花在我们身上的时间。

messages.en:
The shining star in this holoreel project of mine is a fairly high profile individual, as you might expect. His name is Ralie Ardanne; the son of a low-profile Senator. He's a real knockout at fourteen years old, and he already has a budding endorsements empire with all the major clothing labels. Now he's looking to expand into holoreels, which is where Impetus comes in. 
His parents have prospered from senatorial life, and they spared no expense on Ralie's cosmetic enhancements. It shows too: He really makes a mark in the 12-16 year old female demographic. Of course, a boy his age and with his connections shouldn't be travelling the spacelanes unguarded. I was hoping you'd be interested in meeting him at his father's senatorial residence? It wouldn't be every day you get to see a place like that, {[character]player.name}, even as an egger. What do you say?
messages.zh: 也许你已经料到，我这部全息电影中的闪耀明星将会是一个比较知名的人物。他名叫拉赖·阿丹，是一位低调参议员的儿子。这孩子年方14，但已经俨然是个明星。所有知名服饰品牌都想找他做广告。现在他想进军电影界，正好促进工业可以帮忙。他父母从政治事业中赚得了很多钱，对于拉赖的着装打扮消费毫不吝惜，教他作“秀”。拉赖在12到16岁的女性团体中很受欢迎。当然喽，像他这样年纪且人脉众多的男孩决不能没人保驾护航。我想也许你可以去他父亲的参议员住所那儿去接他？即便是克隆飞行员，也不是天天有机会能见到那种地方的，{[character]player.name}。你去不去？

messages.en: How disappointing. I actually expected better from you, {[character]player.name}. I'm afraid I won't be able to offer you any further work.
messages.zh: 太让人失望了。我对你期望原本蛮高的，{[character]player.name}。恐怕以后我是不会再给你任何事做了。

messages.en: You should go meet Ralie; the senatorial staff are expecting your visit.
messages.zh: 你现在应该去见拉赖；参议工作人员正在等你呢。

messages.en: After following a lead given to us by The Scope, I investigated a smuggling trade hub known as the Averon Exchange. Some members of the Pator 6 warband that kidnapped Ralie tried to ambush me. Despite destroying their ships, I wasn't able to recover any information about where Ralie might be now. Gian has been asked to hand the matter over to his superiors, who he can refer me to, if I'm interested.
messages.zh: 根据视角提供给我们的线索，我去调查了一个名为“亚维伦交易所”的贸易集散地。绑架拉赖的帕特六人组中有些人打算伏击我。虽然我击毁了他们的船，但却并没有找到任何可以提示拉赖位置的信息。吉安已经被要求将此事交由他的上级去处理，如果我仍有兴趣，他会将我引荐给他的上司。

messages.en: Gian has spoken with The Scope and learned that the Pator 6 gang that kidnapped Ralie will likely be found at a people-smuggling hub in nearby Averon system. I've been asked to investigate the area and find what leads I can.
messages.zh: 吉安已经与视角进行了接洽，从他们那里得知绑架拉赖的帕特六人组可能会在附近亚维伦星系的一个人口贩卖集散地里。我被要求去进行调查，尽全力找到线索。

messages.en: I had a feeling I could count on you. I'm giving you the coordinates now. Good luck out there.
messages.zh: 我就知道我能靠你。我现在就给你地址。祝你好运。

messages.en: We've hit upon a lead for you to follow. There's a place not far from here in the Averon system known as “The Exchange.” It's a hangout for lowlifes and criminals, a real nasty place. After talking with some friends in The Scope, they pointed us in that direction. Seems this Minmatar crew -- the Pator 6 -- is known around these parts for raiding unwary travelers. You would need to fly into the trading hub and see if you could find any further leads, and hopefully even locate one of those Minmatar gang members. Are you up to the task?
messages.zh: 我们现在有个线索要你去跟进。在离此不远的亚维伦星系里有个叫“交易所”的地方。那里是社会渣子与罪犯的休闲去处，是个龌龊不堪的地方。与视角的几位朋友谈过之后，他们建议我们去那儿。人们都知道帕特六人组这个米玛塔尔团体喜欢在那儿偷袭毫无防备的游客。你需要飞入那个贸易集散地看看是否能获得些线索，但愿还能找到那个六人组中的某一位成员。你能完成这项任务吗？

messages.en: I've spoken with my superiors, and they'd like me to hand this matter off to them now. I am only a low-level holoreel director, after all. You'd be better advised by people who have some experience with these matters. Let me know if you're ok with that, and I'll get the ball rolling.
messages.zh: 我与我上司谈过了，他们要我将这事交由他们处理。谁让我只是个底层电影导演呢。你最好还是让那些对此类事情有丰富经验的人来指引你。如果你觉得没问题，那就告诉我，我会做接下来的安排。

messages.en: Then I suppose this is where we part {[character]player.name}. Thanks for the help you contributed; here's hoping I can still salvage this holoreel.
messages.zh: 那我想现在就是我们说拜拜的时候了，{[character]player.name}。谢谢你付出的努力；但愿我还能保住这部电影。

messages.en:
Averon lies just a few jumps out from the Genesis border, and the intermingling of Gallente and Amarr cultures is evident on the system's station. Curiously, the station is a Caldari facility with a typically Caldari reputation for unscrupulousness. It's a melting pot of dark, cultural undertones, from the Gallente with their unrestrained hedonism, to the Caldari with their lust for ISK, and even Amarr slavers, ever keen to make some quick money selling captives and other tortured souls.

Although the cultural might of the Federation has influenced the bordering systems in the Genesis region, the reverse is also true, if lesser known. Catering to the endless hunger for flesh that exists in certain Gallente circles, the Amarr slavers have few qualms or problems smuggling people a little way inside Federation borders. It has been said that some of the Federation's most depraved nightclubs and bars can be found in the systems where cheap slaves are only a few jumps away.
messages.zh:
亚维伦离吉勒西斯边境只有数跳距离，在该星系里的空间站里，你可以明显感受到盖伦特与艾玛这两种不同文化的交织融合。有趣的是这里的空间站是座加达里空间站，而加达里则一向以不择手段而闻名。这里是各种地下文化的融合地。在这里你可以看到盖伦特的无节制享乐主义，加达里的拜金主义，以及艾玛通过贩卖劳工赚快钱的景象。

虽然盖伦特的强势文化影响着吉勒西斯的边境星系，但其他势力文化其实也在反过来影响着盖伦特联邦，只不过明白这点的人并不多而已。由于一些盖伦特人对女人有着孜孜不倦的追求，艾玛劳工主经常能畅通无阻将人偷运进盖伦特领域。据说在一些离廉价劳工贩卖场所只有几跳距离的星系，你能找到联邦里一些最挑逗的娱乐场所。

messages.en: Crossing the Line
messages.zh: 超出底线

messages.en:
We've hit upon a lead for you to follow, {[character]player.name}. Our proximity to the Amarr border attracts just the sort of criminals who might have masterminded this terrible act. People smugglers, pimps, slaveholders: There are all sorts of dark corners in the Elalan constellation, with darker motives strewn throughout these recesses.

There's a place not far from here in the Averon system known as “The Exchange.” It's a hangout for lowlifes and criminals, a real nasty place. After talking with some friends in The Scope they pointed us in that direction. Seems this Minmatar crew -- the Pator 6 -- is known around these parts for raiding unwary travelers.

Your assignment is a dangerous one, {[character]player.name}. You will need to fly into the trading hub and see if there are any further leads. Maybe even one of those Minmatar gang members is still flying around. Are you up to the task?
messages.zh:
我们现在有个线索要你去跟进，{[character]player.name}。由于靠近艾玛边境，我们这里会吸引一些可能会策划这起恐怖行为的罪犯。人贩子、非法贩售者、劳工主……所有这些人都暗藏于厄拉兰星座的阴暗角落，肚子里藏着一包坏水。

在离此不远的亚维伦星系里有个叫“交易所”的地方。那里是社会渣子与罪犯的休闲去处，是个龌龊不堪的地方。与视角的几位朋友谈过之后，他们建议我们去那儿。人们都知道帕特六人组这个米玛塔尔团体喜欢在那儿偷袭毫无防备的游客。

这是项危险任务，{[character]player.name}。你需要飞入那个贸易集散地看看是否能获得些线索。说不定那个六人组中还有人待在那儿呢。你能完成这项任务吗？

messages.en: Fine, but don't expect me to count on you again in the future.
messages.zh: 行，但将来别指望我再来找你。

messages.en: Have you managed to investigate the Averon Exchange yet, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你调查过亚维伦交易所了吗？

name.ja: 毛色の違うディレクター
name.ru: Иной директор (A Different Kind of Director)

messages.en: Gian Parele asked me to speak with the Regional Director for Impetus about the kidnapping of the Ralie Ardanne. I met with one of his secretaries at the Impetus offices in Stetille, who gave me the coordinates of his personal office complex.
messages.zh: 吉安·帕若勒要求我去和促进工业的区域总管谈拉赖·阿丹被绑架一事。我和他的一位在斯特提勒办公室的秘书见了面，她把那总管的私人办公室地址给了我。

messages.en: I've been asked to speak with the Regional Director for Impetus about the kidnapping of Ralie Ardanne. If I want to find him, I'll first have to meet with one of his secretaries at the Impetus offices in Stetille.
messages.zh: 我被要求去和促进工业的区域总管谈拉赖·阿丹被绑架一事。要找到他，我就得先去和他的一位在斯特提勒办公室的秘书会面。

messages.en: Thank you.
messages.zh: 谢谢。

messages.en: The person I've been instructed to refer you to is our Regional Director. I don't have his current location, but I can put you in touch with one of his secretaries.  You can find her at Impetus offices in Stetille, Planet 2.
messages.zh: 上级要我把你引荐给我们的区域总管。我不知道他人在哪里，但我可以让你和他的一位秘书联系。那位秘书现在斯特提勒星系行星II旁的促进工业办公室里。

messages.en: I understand. I'm sure I can find someone else to continue your good work. Thank you for your assistance, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我理解。我肯定能找到别人来接手你的工作。谢谢你的合作，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
I'm glad to see that you're willing to stick around with us on this, {[character]player.name}. The person I've been instructed to refer you to is our Regional Director. I don't have his current location, but I can put you in touch with one of his secretaries. You can find her at Impetus offices in Stetille, Planet 2.

I can tell them you're on the way, if you think you have time to make the appointment?
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我很高兴你愿意在此事上继续与我们合作。上级要我把你引荐给我们的区域总管。我不知道他人在哪里，但我可以让你和他的一位秘书联系。那位秘书现在斯特提勒星系行星II旁的促进工业办公室里。

如果你答应去见那秘书，那我现在就能通知他们你已经动身了。

messages.en: Don't worry, I'm sure I can find someone else to continue your good work. Thank you for your assistance, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 别担心，我肯定能找到别人来接手你的工作。谢谢你的合作，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: They're waiting for you at Stetille, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 他们在斯特提勒等你，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I met with Audalle Roire, the Sinq Laison Regional Director for Impetus. His assistant, Eron Viette, told me where I could find him. As soon as I arrived at his offices, we were ambushed by another pack of Pator 6 combat vessels, who I can only guess followed me to the location. I secured the area, but the Director didn't seem too pleased. He has referred me back to Eron, who can help me now that the Director is aware of what I'm after.
messages.zh: 我与促进工业的金纳泽区域总管奥达列·罗耶会了面。是他的助手厄隆·耶特把他地址告诉了我。我一抵达他办公室就遭到另一队帕特六人组的战船偷袭。我猜他们一定是背后一直跟着我。我把他们全部消灭，但那总管好像对我不怎么满意。他又让我回去找厄隆。现在既然总管已经获悉我的目的，那厄隆应该也可以帮我了。

messages.en: Eron Viette, the assistant to the Sinq Laison Regional Director, has offered to put me in touch with the Director, Audalle Roire. I'm told I can find him at their space-bound offices, if I am interested.
messages.zh: 金纳泽区域总管的助手厄隆·耶特帮忙让我与奥达列·罗耶总管取得联系。他告诉我，如果我想去，我可以在他们的太空办公室里找到这位总管。

messages.en: Very well, here they are. If you have any trouble finding him out there, just look for the Luxury Yacht on your scanner.
messages.zh: 很好，地址给你了。如果你找他实在有困难，那就看着你的扫描器，找艘豪华游轮就行。

messages.en: I understand that you're seeking a meeting with our Sinq Laison Regional Director. That would be Mr. Roire, Audalle Roire. He spends most of his time at our space-bound office complex here in Stetille. I'm afraid he's not very fond of the media, and since they have free docking access to any of our publicly-listed stations, you can most often guess he won't be in any of them. If you have any trouble finding him out there, just look for the Luxury Yacht on your scanner.
messages.zh: 我知道你希望与我们的金纳泽区域总管会面。他名叫奥达列·罗耶。他多数时间都在斯特提勒这里的太空办公室里。我知道他不是很喜欢被媒体骚扰，那帮媒体能随意进出我们的任意一座对外开放的空间站，所以你基本上可以确定他不会待在那些空间站里。如果你找他有困难，那就只需看着扫描器，找艘豪华游轮就行。

messages.en: You did well out there, {[character]player.name}. Don't worry too much about the Matari that followed you, they seem to know a thing or two about surveillance.
messages.zh: 你干得不错，{[character]player.name}。别太担心那帮盯梢你的玛塔利人，他们擅长这个。

messages.en: course, not a problem. On behalf of Impetus, let me thank you for your time so far
messages.zh: 没事。我代表促进工业感谢你已为我们做出的贡献。

messages.en:
Welcome to Stetille, {[character]player.name}. My name is Eron Viette. Gian said you'd been invaluable to us recently, so if there is any way I can further assist you, please let me know.

I understand that you're seeking a meeting with our Sinq Laison Regional Director. That would be Mr. Roire, Audalle Roire. He spends most of his time at our space-bound office complex here in Stetille. I'm afraid he's not very fond of the media, and since they have free docking access to any of our publicly listed stations, you can most often guess he won't be in any of them.

I'll patch the coordinates to the offices if you like?
messages.zh:
欢迎来到斯特提勒，{[character]player.name}。我名叫厄隆·耶特。吉安说你最近为了我们做出了巨大的贡献。如果有什么需要我帮忙的，请尽管说。

我知道你希望与我们的金纳泽区域总管会面。他名叫奥达列·罗耶。他多数时间都在斯特提勒这里的太空办公室里。我知道他不是很喜欢被媒体骚扰，那帮媒体能随意进出我们的任意一座对外开放的空间站，所以你基本上可以确定他不会待在那些空间站里。

我可以把他的办公室地址传送给你，想要吗？

messages.en: No problem, {[character]player.name}. On behalf of Impetus, we're grateful for what help you could give us already.
messages.zh: 没关系，{[character]player.name}。我代表促进工业谢谢你已经为我们帮的忙。

messages.en: you found Regional Director Roire?
messages.zh: 你找到区域总管罗耶了吗？

messages.en: After making the sale in Syndicate, I contacted Katsen Isha once more. He told me that Hyasyoda had launched an investigation into our raid on the facility. I committed myself to stopping the Corporate Police Force investigation before it could uncover anything.
messages.zh: 在辛迪加完成交易之后，我又联系了卡僧·伊沙。他告诉我三岛集团已经针对我们袭击设施这一事展开了调查。我答应把这事消灭在萌芽状态。

messages.en: After making the sale in Syndicate, I contacted Katsen Isha once more. He tells me that Hyasyoda has launched an investigation into our raid on the facility. I must stop the Corporate Police Force investigation before it can uncover anything. Isha says we can either simply kill the mercenaries defending their base of operations or else fool them into thinking the culprits are elsewhere, far away from Poinen.
messages.zh: 在辛迪加完成交易之后，我又联系了卡僧·伊沙。他告诉我三岛集团已经针对我们袭击设施这一事展开了调查。我必须把这事消灭在萌芽状态。伊沙说我们可以把守卫他们调查基地的雇佣兵干掉，或者把他们忽悠到远离波耶伦的别处去。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, good. I hope you've recovered from the Syndicate trip. Once again, good work out there. Unfortunately, it turns out we have one more loose end to tie up.

My people tell me that Hyasyoda have already launched an investigation into theformula theft. I suppose this is a play to lend an air of legitimacy to the racket they've been running. The situation is an amusing one, yet also dangerous for us. Our tracks are well covered, but – as they often say at Hyasyoda itself – only the paranoid survive.

They've deployed their security wing, the Corporate Police Force, into “various locations of interest.” I've learned that Onirvura was listed as an area to investigate. They're right here in the constellation, setting up a temporary base for interrogation and imprisonment. Fortunately for us, the CPF has hired a mercenary crew to handle facility defense while they set up. This gives us an opportunity to strike at them without it constituting a direct attack on Hyasyoda personnel. That would muddy the waters a bit, as I'm sure you can appreciate. Mercs or not, though, they're getting a little too close for comfort.

I should mention also that we can still resolve this peacefully too, if you prefer. The intel that has brought them here can be manipulated, perhaps, and lead them elsewhere. I care very little about how you want us to proceed, as long as this situation is dealt with. I want to go to sleep tonight knowing our assets and our reputations are safe.
messages.zh:
很好，{[character]player.name}。我希望你已经从辛迪加之旅的舟车劳顿中恢复过来了。你干得真不错。不过我们还有件事没摆平。

我的人告诉我三岛集团已经介入追查配方偷盗人了。我觉得他们这只是在做表面文章而已。虽说可笑，但对我们来说也确实有点危险。我们虽然事情做得不露马脚，但——就像三岛集团自己人那个说什么来着——多点担心总没错的。

他们已经将其警卫队派向了“各重点区域”。听说奥尼尔瓦纳便是其中之一。他们目前就在本星座，正在搭建一个用于调查与囚禁的临时基地。还好，警卫队雇了一批雇佣兵来守卫建造中的基地。这样我们就可以不用直接袭击三岛的人员来端掉这基地了。这水虽会被趟混，但想必你能理解。其实不管是否是雇佣兵，他们都近得让人不舒服。

当然，如果你不喜欢武力解决，我们也有和平解决的方式。我们可以散布假情报把他们赶到别的地方去。其实我对过程并不是很关心，我只要这事得到解决就行。我希望我们的资产与名誉都不受损，好让我今晚睡个安稳觉。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, good. I hope you've recovered from the Syndicate trip. Once again, good work out there. Unfortunately, it turns out we have one more loose end to tie up.

My people tell me that Hyasyoda have already launched an investigation into the formula theft. I suppose this is a play to lend an air of legitimacy to the racket they've been running. The situation is an amusing one, yet also dangerous for us. Our tracks are well covered, but – as they often say at Hyasyoda itself – only the paranoid survive.

They've deployed their security wing, the Corporate Police Force, into “various locations of interest.” I've learned that Onirvura was listed as an area to investigate. They're right here in the constellation, setting up a temporary base for interrogation and imprisonment. Fortunately for us, the CPF has hired a mercenary crew to handle facility defense while they set up. This gives us an opportunity to strike at them without it constituting a direct attack on Hyasyoda personnel. That would muddy the waters a bit, as I'm sure you can appreciate. Mercs or not, though, they're getting a little too close for comfort.

I should mention also that we can still resolve this peacefully too, if you prefer. The intel that has brought them here can be manipulated, perhaps, and lead them elsewhere. I care very little about how you want us to proceed, as long as this situation is dealt with. I want to go to sleep tonight knowing our assets and our reputations are safe.
messages.zh:
很好，{[character]player.name}。我希望你已经从辛迪加之旅的舟车劳顿中恢复过来了。你干得真不错。不过我们还有件事没摆平。

messages.en: Impetus needs my help, and I met with one of their holoreel directors. He has some important work for me. There's no telling what they would need a capsuleer for, but it had better be good. Or at least I'd better meet a holoreel star or two.
messages.zh: 促进工业要我帮忙。我与他们的一位导演见了面。他有件重要事情让我做。我不知道他们要我这样一个克隆飞行员有什么用，但愿是好事。即使不是，至少也得让我见上一两个影星吧。

messages.en: I am supposed to meet with Gian Parele, an Impetus holoreel director in Tolle. Apparently, he has some business suitable for a capsuleer. I can't imagine what it could be.
messages.zh: 我被指示去见一位名叫吉安·帕若勒、驻扎在托尔勒的促进工业的电影导演。他好像有适合克隆飞行员干的活。我真想像不出那会是份怎样的工作。

messages.en: Don't ask me what the title of the project is. I'm not allowed to divulge that. But let's just say it'll be epic.
messages.zh: 别问我那项目的名字。我不能透露此信息。但它一定会很棒。

messages.en: Impetus needs your help with our next holoreel. Can you go meet with one of our directors? If you do a good enough job, I'm sure we get you in the credits for that reel. You can find him over in Tolle. Look for the studio we have set up in that system. The director is probably in his pleasure yacht. You know, the holoreel lifestyle can be really difficult sometimes.
messages.zh: 促进工业要你帮忙搞定我们的下一部全息电影。你能去见一下我们的一位导演吗？如果你表现出色，那我肯定幕后致谢中会有你的名字。你可以在托尔勒找到他。注意找那星系里我们搭起来的一个摄影棚。那位导演可能在他的豪华游轮里。想必你也知道，演艺生涯有时很苦的。

messages.en: Fair enough. I'm sure I can find some other capsuleer interested in becoming a star.
messages.zh: 好吧。我相信我肯定能找到其他志愿当明星的克隆飞行员。

messages.en: Excuse me! Can I trouble you for a minute? Impetus needs your help with our next holoreel. Can you go meet with one of our directors? If you do a good enough job, I'm sure we can get you in the credits for that reel. You can find him over in Tolle. Look for the studio we have set up in that system. The director is probably in his luxurious pleasure cruiser. You know, the holoreel lifestyle can be really difficult sometimes.
messages.zh: 打扰了！能耽搁你一会儿吗？促进工业要你帮忙搞定我们的下一部全息电影。你能去见一下我们的一位导演吗？如果你表现出色，那我肯定幕后致谢中会有你的名字。你可以在托尔勒找到他。注意找那星系里我们搭起来的一个摄影棚。那位导演可能在他的豪华游轮里。想必你也知道，演艺生涯有时很苦的。

messages.en: I guess the glamour and allure of holoreels is not for everyone. The universe needs miners, too, you know.
messages.zh: 我猜也许演艺界的光鲜瞩目并不适合每个人。这世界也需要矿工。

messages.en: Have you met with Gian yet?
messages.zh: 你见到了吉安没有？

messages.en: I continued my efforts on Hyasyoda's behalf to uncover what Nugoeihuvi is up to. Isha was keen to have me shift the formula far away from his vicinity. I had to choose between taking it all the way out to one of their nullsec offices in Syndicate or to a bordering lowsec system in Solitude.
messages.zh: 我继续代表三岛集团调查纳基维集团到底在干什么。伊沙希望我能把那蓝图带到一个远离他的地方。我只有两个选择：要么把蓝图带到他们在辛迪加0.0区域的一座办公室，要么把蓝图带到他们在孤独之域的一个与辛迪加接壤的低安全星系。

messages.en: On the instructions of Arikio Kuretsu, I returned to Katsen Isha. He seems to have noticed a change in Hyasyoda's operations, but doesn't appear to suspect me personally of anything. Isha would like me to take the formula sheets all the way out to Syndicate, a fairly dangerous journey but no doubt the most lucrative. The second option isn't much safer, but Isha has let me know that – if I desire – I can take it only to the border of Syndicate and his people will do the rest. That would let me avoid the nullsec systems.
messages.zh: 按照阿里可·库利茨的要求，我回到了卡僧·伊沙那儿。他好像已经察觉到了三岛集团的运作变化，但对我还是不设防。伊沙要我把蓝图送到辛迪加。这段路比较危险但绝对赚钱。他给我指的另一条路也不怎么安全：我可以只把东西送到辛迪加边境，接下来的事交给他派去的人处理。这样我就可以不用去0.0区域了。

messages.en:
Welcome back, {[character]player.name}. I hope your time has been well spent considering our options.

Hyasyoda seems to have calmed down a little for now, but it's when they get quiet that I actually start to worry. They likely already have something in motion. I'm not interested in seeing if my instincts are right. We should shift these formulas as soon as possible.

As I told you before, I've already lined up a buyer for us. All you need to do is move the goods. As I also explained, my associates – that is, the ones with an interest in highly illegal booster manufacture – they're stationed at a somewhat remote NOH office outside of CONCORD jurisdiction, where the Chief Executive Panel finds it difficult to keep a close eye on everything.

Ideally, I would like you to deliver the goods to our facility in KFR-ZE yourself, but I can make arrangements for the staff at KFR to retrieve it from a nearby low-security system if you prefer. That will, of course, reduce your cut of the profits. If you can fly a Covert Ops or an Interceptor or anything like that, then I would recommend you make use of it now, but how you proceed in light of this situation is up to you. All I want is for the sale to be made soon; I don't care how.
messages.zh:
欢迎回来，{[character]player.name}。我希望你已经花了充分的时间考虑了我们的提议。

三岛集团目前好像已经静下来了一点，但他们这么默不作声反而让我有点担心。或许他们正在暗中行动呢。不过我没兴趣等着看事情到底如何进展。我们要尽快把这些配方转移走。

前面已经跟你说过，我已经联系到了一位买家。你只要把东西送过去就行。我前面还提到，我的副手们——他们对于违禁增强剂生产很有兴趣——驻扎在统合部管辖区域之外的一座偏远的纳基维集团办公室。CEO合作组织基本上管不到那片区域。

我希望你最好能亲自前往KFR-ZE把东西送过去。但如果你不想，那我也可以安排KFR那里的员工到附近的一个低安全星系向你拿货。当然喽，这样做的话你能拿到的钱也会相应减少。如果你能驾驶隐形特勤舰或截击舰之类的船，那我认为现在正是派上它们用场的时候。但具体怎么操作还是你自己拿捏。我只要尽快完成这笔买卖，过程可以忽略。

messages.en: I see. Let's discuss that option, then.
messages.zh: 懂了。那我们来谈谈那个方案吧。

messages.en: Mina Darabi, Aralin Jick's contact and the daughter of Lord Darabi, was successfully retrieved in your violent "kidnapping."
messages.zh: 通过你的暴力“绑架”，你成功地救出了阿拉林·基可的联系人与德拉比大人的女儿米娜·德拉比。

messages.en: Mina Darabi has information on the Sansha investigation, but must be rescued from her father's estate.
messages.zh: 米娜·德拉比有与萨沙调查有关的信息，但她必须先从她父亲的住所里被救出来。

messages.en: Lord Darabi's manor is in the Reteka system. Do what you must.
messages.zh: 德拉比大人的住所在勒特卡星系。请尽力而为。

messages.en: Daddy Darabi has kept Mina under tight surveillance because of a  scandal that occurred a few years ago. Thus, we have to stage a kidnapping. This is going to get bloody, but I trust Mina when she says her information is worth it. Fly to the Darabi estate where Mina is being kept and "kidnap" Mina Darabi. Any guards are expendable.
messages.zh: 由于几年前的一桩丑闻，德拉比把他女儿监控地很严。因此我们必须搞一次绑架。虽然这会是件流血事件，但我相信米娜掌握的情报值得我们这样去做。请飞往德拉比软禁他女儿的居住所然后“绑架”他女儿米娜·德拉比。挡道的门卫都可干掉。

messages.en:
If everything Mina says is true, then we're not going to blow this case wide open.

We're going to blow it up.
messages.zh:
如果米娜所言属实，那我们不会简单把这事揭露出来。

我们要把它搞大。

messages.en: What have I been paying you for?
messages.zh: 我付你钱是为了什么？

messages.en: Rumor has it that Lord Darabi was imprisoned by Karsoth for daring to publicly disagree (albeit slightly) with Karsoth's policies about the Succession. When Empress Sarum returned, Darabi was freed, but rumors persist that  he is not in the most stable condition.
messages.zh: 有传言说德拉比大人因胆敢公开发表对卡尔索斯继承政策的（略微）不同意见而被卡尔索斯囚禁。萨拉姆女王回来后，德拉比被释放。但仍有流言说德拉比的状况不佳。

messages.en: Lord Darabi
messages.zh: 德拉比大人

messages.en:
With the destruction of the mercenary camp, Lord Manik is denying he ever had any contact with them. I have a copy of your ship's logs from their meeting, but it may prove difficult to pin him with any conspiracy charges.

Good thing I've got a new lead. Remember Lord Darabi, Miyan's rival and the new target of Jariza's wooing? His daughter, Mina, has been one of my contacts. Mina says she has key information, but she will only tell me in person.

This is where the fun part comes in. Daddy Darabi has kept Mina under tight surveillance because of a scandal that happened a few years ago. Thus, we have to stage a kidnapping. This is going to get bloody, but I trust Mina when she says her information is worth it.

Fly to the Darabi estate where Mina is being kept and "kidnap" Mina Darabi. Any guards are expendable.
messages.zh:
雇用军被消灭之后，马尼克矢口否认与他们有任何联系。虽然我这里有你一份记录他们会面情况的舰船日志，但要指控马尼克大人涉嫌阴谋策划可能会很困难。

幸好我还另有线索。还记得那个米雅安的对手、札力萨的新追求对象德拉比大人吗？他的女儿米娜是我的一个联系人。她说她知道重要信息，但一定要当面告诉我。

接下来就是这件事有趣的地方：由于几年前的一桩丑闻，她老爸德拉比把她监控地很严。因此我们必须搞一次绑架。虽然这会是件流血事件，但我相信米娜掌握的情报值得我们这样去做。

请飞往德拉比软禁他女儿的居住所然后“绑架”他女儿米娜·德拉比。挡道的门卫都可干掉。

messages.en: Lord Darabi's forces were too much for me. I've got to quit your mission.
messages.zh: 德拉比大人的军队太强了。我不得不退出你的任务。

messages.en: Where's Mina?
messages.zh: 米娜人呢？

messages.en: Mina Darabi revealed that Jariza funneled money from Lord Darabi and was in contact with Rahsa Teff, the Sansha commander. You judiciously eliminated the Sansha base and captured Teff.
messages.zh: 据米娜·德拉比透露，札力萨一直从德拉比大人那儿获得资金，而且他还与萨沙司令睿萨·特夫有联系。你果断地摧毁了那座萨沙基地并抓获了特夫。

messages.en: Mina has revealed the location of Rahsa Teff, the Sansha commander who has continuously eluded capture.
messages.zh: 米娜已经透露了一直在躲避追捕的萨沙司令睿萨·特夫的方位。

messages.en: Once you eliminate the base, the Sansha will be without a central hub in this region.
messages.zh: 你把那基地灭了之后，萨沙在此星域就无集合地了。

messages.en: Thanks to Mina's information, we've discovered the location of the Sansha base and Rahsa Teff. Destroy the Sansha base and capture Rahsa Teff, and the Sansha will fall back into their pattern of mindless aggression.
messages.zh: 多亏了米娜提供的情报，我们得以获悉萨沙基地以及睿萨·特夫本人的方位。请摧毁那座基地，然后抓住睿萨·特夫，这样萨沙就群龙无首了。

messages.en:
You've eliminated the Sansha base? Excellent!

Now the question remains: What do we do with Rahsa Teff?
messages.zh:
你把那萨沙基地给捣毁了？好极了！

现在的问题是，我们如何处理睿萨·特夫？

messages.en: I don't understand. You've come this far, why are you backing out now? Bah, I don't have time for this! Get out of my sight.
messages.zh: 我搞不懂了。你都已经进行到这一步了，还要退出？哼，我不想再说什么了！从我视野里消失吧。

messages.en:
Mina has quite a story to tell. Jariza has been courting Lord Darabi for some time. Jariza's been so good at winning Darabi's trust that Mina became suspicious. Mina proved an amazing spy: She's not only traced funds flowing from Darabi to Jariza, but she also found an interesting communication from one Rahsa Teff.

Rahsa Teff is a known felon and former Blood Raider. The MIO lost track of him a year ago. Rumor was another pirate group poached him. It sounds as if the rumor is true. Not only is Rahsa Teff with the Sansha, but you met him already. He's the Sansha commander who kept eluding us.

I've traced the source of Rahsa's message. We know where he and the Sansha are located. Let's end this. Eliminate the Sansha base, and capture Rahsa Teff.
messages.zh:
米娜有件不寻常的事情要告诉你。札力萨最近一直在拍德拉比大人的马屁。这家伙太擅长讨德拉比欢心了，米娜已经起了疑心。米娜真是块当间谍的料：她不仅查到了德拉比向札力萨的资金转账记录，同时还发现了源自睿萨·特夫的耐人寻味的通信记录。

睿萨·特夫是个有前科的人，曾是血袭者的一员。他于一年前逃脱了内务部的追踪。据传他加入了另一个海盗组织。现在看来这谣传并非空穴来风。睿萨·特夫已经是萨沙的人，而且你已经见过了他。他就是那个一直躲着我们的萨沙司令。

我查到了睿萨通信的源头，已经知道了他与萨沙现在何处。让我们为此事画上休止符：摧毁萨沙基地、抓住睿萨·特夫。

messages.en: What do you mean he got away? Get out of my sight!
messages.zh: 你说他逃走了是什么意思？我不想看到你！

messages.en: Where is Rahsa Teff? Has the Sansha base been eliminated?
messages.zh: 睿萨·特夫人呢？那萨沙基地毁灭了吗？

name.ru: Все на своих местах (Falling Into Place)

messages.en: Luring his forces into the open using the head of Rahsa, you revealed the Amarrian traitor to be Terrius Harkan, former commander of Miyan's security.
messages.zh: 用睿萨的头颅将敌人部队引出之后，你发现艾玛的叛徒原来是前米雅安警卫队队长特里斯·哈坎。

messages.en: You possess a homemade Sansha beacon, perfect for trapping traitors.
messages.zh: 你拿到了一个自制的萨沙信标，很适合用来抓叛徒。

messages.en: Here's hoping his friends are looking.
messages.zh: 但愿他的朋友在找他。

messages.en:
Whoever Rahsa's friends were, they're probably looking for our departed Sansha right now. This device will mimic Rahsa's personal frequency. Just plug it in to a broadcast tower and you have a fake escapee Rahsa.

There's the perfect broadcast tower in Shaha. Place the homemade Sansha beacon in the tower, and wait to see if "rescue" arrives. Then blow them out of the sky.
messages.zh:
论睿萨的朋友是谁，他们现在可能就在找已经离开的真睿萨。这个设备可以模拟睿萨的声音：你只要把这玩意儿接入一个广播塔，别人就以为这是真的在逃中的睿萨。这东西真新颖。

萨沙里有个极佳的广播塔。请把这自制的萨沙信标放入那塔里，然后等着瞧是否有“救援”赶来。来了之后就把他们统统灭掉。

messages.en:
Harkan?! Terrus Harkan is the traitor? Harkan, former head of Lord Miyan's security and hero of the countless military campaigns, is the traitor?

This is very bad.
messages.zh:
哈坎？！特里斯·哈坎是叛徒？那个曾是米雅安大人身边的警卫队长，在无数军事行动中立下汗马功劳的哈坎竟然是个叛徒？

真糟糕。

messages.en: But my device is so awesome!
messages.zh: 但我的设备不要太好哦！

messages.en:
Hang on just a second. They must have changed socket sizes….

There. I present you one decoy Rahsa. Not a bad piece of work, if I do say so myself. Whoever Rahsa's friends were, they're probably looking for our departed Sansha right now. This device will mimic Rahsa's personal frequency: Just plug it in to a broadcast tower and you've got yourself an escapee Rahsa. Or the next best thing.

There's the perfect broadcast tower in Shaha. Place the homemade Sansha beacon in the tower, and then wait to see if "rescue" arrives. Then blow them out of the sky.
messages.zh:
等等，他们肯定改过插口的大小了……。

给你，这是假睿萨。要我说的话，这东西做得还真不赖。无论睿萨的朋友是谁，他们现在可能就在找已经离开的真睿萨。这个设备可以模拟睿萨的声音：你只要把这玩意儿接入一个广播塔，别人就以为这是真的在逃中的睿萨。这东西真新颖。

萨沙里有个极佳的广播塔。请把这自制的萨沙信标放入那塔里，然后等着瞧是否有“救援”赶来。来了之后就把他们统统灭掉。

messages.en: You're giving up?
messages.zh: 你想中途而废？

messages.en: How goes the hunt?
messages.zh: 守株待兔进行得如何了？

name.ru: Допрос: Идя по следу (Interrogation: Catching the Scent)

messages.en: The Old Guard
messages.zh: 老卫兵

messages.en: Interrogating Rahsa revealed that he had help within the Amarr Empire. You retrieved a Sansha command signal receiver for Aralin's plan to capture the traitor.
messages.zh: 睿萨经审问之后透露了其在艾玛还有帮手。你获得了一个萨沙指挥信号接收器以完成阿拉林的抓捕叛徒计划。

messages.en: Aralin has a plan to track down Rahsa's accomplice.
messages.zh: 阿拉林有个追捕睿萨同僚的计划。

messages.en:
So Rahsa has something more to say? Give my people a few minutes alone with him.... ah, there's a message coming in now.

Hm. I'll be damned. You were right. Someone else was working with him. He managed to activate some sort of suicide short in his socket before we got a name out of him. Too bad for him he's still useful to us.

What I need right now is a Sansha command signal receiver. They're found on Sansha ships to keep the crew going. And I know where some survivors of your last attack are right now. Eliminate these stragglers, and I'm sure you'll find a command signal receiver among them.
messages.zh:
就是说睿萨还有话要讲？让我的人与他单独待会儿吧……噢，我现在收到条消息。

哼，你是对的。这家伙还有同僚。不过他在把那同僚的名字抖出来之前已经自尽了。唉，真糟糕，这家伙还有利用价值呢。

我现在需要的是一个萨沙指挥信号接收器。萨沙的舰船上有这种东西，他们的船员就靠这指挥信号接收器来航行的。我知道你上次袭击中的逃亡者目前在哪儿。去把那帮脱离大部队的人干掉，然后你就能拿到一个指挥信号接收器了。

messages.en: What I need right now is a Sansha command signal receiver. They're found on Sansha ships to keep the crew going. And I know where some survivors of your last attack are right now. Eliminate these stragglers, and I'm sure you'll find a command signal receiver among them.
messages.zh: 我现在需要的是一个萨沙指挥信号接收器。萨沙的舰船上有这种东西，他们的船员就靠这指挥信号接收器来航行的。我知道你上次袭击中的逃亡者目前在哪儿。去把那帮脱离大部队的人干掉，然后你就能拿到一个指挥信号接收器了。

messages.en: This is exactly what I was looking for. Now, sit back and watch a master at work.
messages.zh: 这正是我需要的。现在就请坐在那儿看着大师大显身手吧。

messages.en: Are you really leaving? I suppose I'll have to go it alone.
messages.zh: 你真要走？看来我得单干了。

messages.en: So Rahsa has something more to say? Give my people a few minutes alone with him....
messages.zh: 就是说睿萨还有话要讲？让我的人与他单独待会儿吧……

messages.en: I can't believe you're giving up. If that's the case, I suppose I must continue using my own people.
messages.zh: 我无法相信你竟然要放弃。如果真是这样，那我想我必须用自己人了。

messages.en: You track down those stragglers yet? They're our best shot at thecommand signal receiver.
messages.zh: 你追上那残留部队了吗？我们获得指挥信号接收器的最大希望就在他们头上。

name.de: Das richtige Werkzeug für den Auftrag
name.ru: Подходящий инструмент (Right Tool for the Job)

messages.en:
After making my way to Astoh to meet Sinas, he asked for my help in making sense of something. He started by explaining that his work involves search and rescue operations, recovering Caldari P.O.Ws from Gallente Federation prison camps and similar operations. Although he can't find anyone to corroborate his claims, he seems certain that the numbers of Ishukone prisoners is frequently lower than the rest, conspicuously so.

He wants me to follow up on his hunch. My first task is to acquire a Federation Navy ID tag given out to P.O.W transports operating in Black Rise. I'll need to first secure, and then hack into a Shipyard in order to get my hands on one of these. Sinas tells me the job won't be an easy one.
messages.zh:
在去阿希多与塞纳斯见了面之后，他要我去弄清楚一件事情。他先是说他负责搜救工作，主要是从盖伦特联邦的牢狱里营救加达里战俘。虽然无人可佐证，但他好像很肯定异株湖集团的战俘数量经常比其他集团的战俘人数要少，非常可疑。

他要我亲自去看看他的怀疑是否正确。我首先要做的就是去取得一种特殊的安全身份铭牌，这种铭牌专用于在暗涌之域执行任务的联邦海军战俘运输船。我要先取得一座船坞的控制权，然后破解那里的计算机系统以便获取一个那样的铭牌。塞纳斯对我说此活不轻松。

messages.en:
Excellent.

Your first step will be to acquire a special type of security ID handed out to Federation Navy P.O.W transports operating in Black Rise. I'm uploading the coordinates of the facility where they can be found.

The target will be a shipyard that implants these ID tags on ships. First, you'll need to secure it, which may not be easy. I have reliable intelligence claiming that an initial strike on their Communications Array will mean they can't call out for reinforcements, however, so you may want to factor that in to your battle plan.

Once the area is cleared, you'll need to hack into the shipyard, so train up some basic hacking skills if you've never done so before. Even at the most basic level of training, a Data Analyzer in the hands of a capsuleer can tear most security systems into shreds, and that's all we need for this job.

In case I gave you the wrong impression earlier {[character]player.name}, this facility will be heavily defended. If you brought down a faster, smaller ship to Astoh then leave it here. We'll need it soon enough, don't worry. For now though, I suggest you arm yourself to the teeth. This won't be easy.

And that's it. Briefing over, {[character]player.name}. Good luck.
messages.zh:
非常好。

你首先要做的就是去取得一种特殊的安全身份铭牌，这种铭牌专用于在暗涌之域执行任务的联邦海军战俘运输船。我把能找到这种铭牌的一个地方的地址发给你。

你的目标就是一座喷涂那种铭牌的船坞。首先你要取得那船坞的控制权，这事有点难度。据我得到的一份可靠情报称，对方的通信阵列一旦被摧毁，那他们就无法再呼叫任何增援，你作战的时候可以把这点考虑进去。

取得船坞的控制权后，你就得破译那座船坞里的计算机系统。如果你还没有干过破译，那就先去练些基本技能。只要有了最基本的掌握，像你这样的克隆飞行员就可以用数据分析仪破解掉绝大多数的安全系统，这样就足够了。

希望我没有误导你，{[character]player.name}，这地方戒备森严。如果你是驾驶一艘小快船来阿希多的，那就先把它停在这里。我们之后便会用到它。你现在要把自己武装到牙齿。这事不简单。

好了，任务布置结束，{[character]player.name}。祝你好运。

It's never enough to be conspicuous or noticeable, but I notice it, and I find it conspicuous. I can't explain it though, and neither can the people we recover. I need you to investigate the matter for me and find out what's going on. messages.en: I can see why Isha is so fond of you. You certainly delivered on your promises there, {[character]player.name}, good work. Now we need to put that ID tag to use. I hope to see you again for another briefing on that.
messages.zh: 我明白伊沙为什么对你褒奖有加了。你不负众望，{[character]player.name}，干得好。现在我们要将那铭牌用起来。希望你能再来接受与其相关的下一个任务。

messages.en: From what Isha said about you, I didn't expect this. I guess I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 从伊沙对你的介绍来看，我真没料到会这样。看来我得找别人了。

messages.en:
In yet another twist in the recent events, multiple reports are coming in of new stargates appearing in systems on the fringes of Caldari and Gallente space. It would appear that the volume of space known as Black Rise - previously thought to be completely impenetrable - has been secretly colonized by Caldari forces.

Initial reports from capsuleers indicate that the new region contains a wealth of virgin systems, full of resources unexploited thus far by the four empires. Additionally, early cartography has revealed that the region opens an additional border between Caldari and Gallente sovereign space, something officials on both sides are scrambling to prepare for as they readjust strategies. Even as they do so, pod pilots both loyalist and independent are rushing into the area to stake a claim of their own.

It remains unclear exactly how the phenomena shrouding this area were penetrated, or indeed how the Caldari State has managed to colonize the area in complete secrecy. State officials have so far remained tight-lipped on any details, providing no explanations. After such startling events in recent times however, and with officials from all three Empires as well as CONCORD pushing for answers on the matter, it is something they will likely have to address in the nearby future.
messages.zh:
最近的事情想不到又出现了一个波折。现在有多份报告宣称加达里盖伦特接壤星系中冒出了新的星门。原先被认为是无法穿越的暗涌之域好像已经被加达里军队暗地里开发了。

从一些克隆飞行员的初期报道来看，那片星域里富含了众多处女星系，蕴含了尚未被四大帝国开采利用的大量资源。另外，据早期的地理探测资料显示，该星域将成为加达里盖伦特之间又一个新的接壤星域，双方因此目前都在重新调整战略以做新的准备。尽管如此，还是有一批克隆飞行员，无论是独立派还是势力派，都抢着要进这片星域为自己谋利。

目前大家还不清楚那星域的天然屏障是怎么被突破的，或者更准确地说，加达里是怎么做到悄然无息在那里殖民的。加达里官方目前仍缄口不言，不透露任何细节，也不提供任何解释。不过在最近那些报道出来之后，还有在其他三大帝国与统合部的联合压力之下，加达里或许必将在不远的将来对这一切做出解释。

messages.en: New Region connected to Stargate Networks by Caldari State, Scope Article, June 11th, YC 110
messages.zh: 《加达里合众国利用星门网络连接到了新星域》——“视角”于新伊甸纪元 110年6月11日发表的一篇文章

messages.en:
Welcome to Astoh, {[character]player.name}. I appreciate you coming by. Katsen just sent me the ISK, too. Thank you for being our middle man on that one. You may want to make yourself comfortable in that egg for a moment; I've a bit to cover here for your briefing.

As you know, my name is Sinas Egassuo. As you probably do not know, my job is to coordinate search and rescue operations, as well as the liberation of Caldari Prisoners of War taken during battle in Black Rise. This duty I have fulfilled without hesitation, and I am proud to have led such operations.

It is by carrying out this task, however, that I've come to notice something strange. Whenever we rescue people, there are often less Ishukone crew members and staff than the rest. It's never enough to be conspicuous or noticeable, but I notice it, and I find it conspicuous. I can't explain it though, and neither can the people we recover.

My suspicion is that Ishukone personnel are being taken elsewhere, perhaps being treated more kindly due to their Liberal philosophies and good history with the Gallente. It wouldn't surprise me to see the Federation trying to divide us over something like that, but we'd have to know about it first, and they don't seem keen on that happening.

I need you to investigate the matter for me and find out what's going on. I can brief you on the details of the assignment once you accept, but until I have that commitment, I'm not willing to trust you with the information. Sorry {[character]player.name}, but Katsen's recommendation only gets you so far.

So, are you committed to the fight ahead of us or not?
messages.zh:
欢迎光临阿希多，{[character]player.name}。感谢你的造访。卡僧也已经把星币给了我，谢谢你为我们牵线搭桥。你最好换个舒服的姿势坐在你的逃生舱里，我接下来还有蛮多的事要向你通报。

想必你已经知道，我名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索。但你可能不知道的是，我专负责协调搜救工作，以及解救那些在暗涌之域中被俘虏的加达里人。我对这份工作没有任何犹豫，且对能带领这样的行动而倍感自豪。

不过就在执行该项任务的过程中，我注意到了一件奇怪的事。每次救人时，异株湖集团的工作人员总是比别的军团的人要少。虽然怀疑或者注意说明不了什么，但我已经注意到了，而且起了疑心。究竟为什么我也不清楚，我们救回来的人也同样不知道。

异株湖集团的人一向怀有自由主义思想且与盖伦特的历史交往不错，我怀疑他们被带往了别处被人好生招待去了。虽然我不会对盖伦特想使离间计而感到惊讶，但我们还是得先确认这件事。不过他们好像不会让我们轻易达成这个目标。

我要你替我去对此事展开调查。如果你答应，那我就告诉你这项任务的详细安排；如果你不肯，那我也不会将那些信息透露给你。不好意思，{[character]player.name}，尽管你有卡僧的推荐，但我也只能说到此为止。

好了，你到底愿不愿意替我去调查？

messages.en: From what Isha said about you, I didn't expect this. I guess I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 从伊沙对你的介绍来看，我真没料到会这样。看来我得找别人了。

messages.en: Get going, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 快去，{[character]player.name}。

你首先要做的就是去取得一种特殊的安全身份铭牌，这种铭牌专用于在暗涌之域执行任务的联邦海军战俘运输船。我把能找到这种铭牌的一个地方的地址发给你。

你的目标就是一座喷涂那种铭牌的船坞。首先你要取得那船坞的控制权，这事有点难度。据我得到的一份可靠情报称，对方的通信阵列一旦被摧毁，那他们就无法再呼叫任何增援，你作战的时候可以把这点考虑进去。

取得船坞的控制权后，你就得破译那座船坞里的计算机系统。如果你还没有干过破译，那就先去练些基本技能。只要有了最基本的掌握，像你这样的克隆飞行员就可以用数据分析仪破解掉绝大多数的安全系统，这样就足够了。

希望我没有误导你，{[character]player.name}，这地方戒备森严。如果你是驾驶一艘小快船来阿希多的，那就先把它停在这里。我们之后便会用到它。你现在要把自己武装到牙齿。这事不简单。

好了，任务布置结束，{[character]player.name}。祝你好运。

messages.en:
Whenever my Navy teams rescue people, there are often less Ishukone crew members and staff than the rest. It's never enough to be conspicuous or noticeable, but I notice it, and I find it conspicuous. I can't explain it though, and neither can the people we recover. I need you to investigate the matter for me and find out what's going on. Your first step will be to acquire a special type of security ID handed out to Federation Navy P.O.W transports operating in Black Rise. The target will be a shipyard that implants these ID tags on ships. First, you'll need to secure it. I have reliable intelligence claiming that an initial strike on their Communications Array will mean they can't call out for reinforcements,, so you may want to factor that in to your battle plan.

Once the area is cleared, you'll need to hack into the shipyard, so train up some basic hacking skills if you've never done so before. Even at the most basic level of training, a Data Analyzer in the hands of a capsuleer can tear most security systems into shreds, and that's all we need for this job.
messages.zh:
每次我的海军救人时，异株湖集团的工作人员总是比别的军团的人要少。虽然怀疑或者注意说明不了什么，但我已经注意到了，而且我起了疑心。究竟为什么我也不清楚，我们救回来的人也同样不知道。我要你替我去对此事展开调查。你首先要做的就是去取得一种特殊的安全身份铭牌，这种铭牌专用于在暗涌之域执行任务的联邦海军战俘运输船。你的目标就是一座喷涂那种铭牌的船坞。首先你要取得那船坞的控制权。据我得到的一份可靠情报称，对方的通信阵列一旦被摧毁，那他们就无法再呼叫任何增援，你作战的时候可以把这点考虑进去。

取得船坞的控制权后，你就得破译那座船坞里的计算机系统。如果你还没有干过破译，那就先去练些基本技能。只要有了最基本的掌握，像你这样的克隆飞行员就可以用数据分析仪破解掉绝大多数的安全系统，这样就足够了。

messages.en: I can see why Isha is so fond of you. You certainly delivered on your promises there, {[character]player.name}, good work. Now we need to put that ID tag to use. I hope to see you again for another briefing on that.
messages.zh: 我明白伊沙为什么对你褒奖有加了。你不负众望，{[character]player.name}，干得好。现在我们要将那铭牌用起来。希望你能再来接受与其相关的下一个任务。

messages.en: From what Isha said about you, I didn't expect this. I guess I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 从伊沙对你的介绍来看，我真没料到会这样。看来我得找别人了。

messages.en:
In yet another twist in the recent events, multiple reports are coming in of new stargates appearing in systems on the fringes of Caldari and Gallente space. It would appear that the volume of space known as Black Rise - previously thought to be completely impenetrable - has been secretly colonized by Caldari forces.

Initial reports from capsuleers indicate that the new region contains a wealth of virgin systems, full of resources unexploited thus far by the four empires. Additionally, early cartography has revealed that the region opens an additional border between Caldari and Gallente sovereign space, something officials on both sides are scrambling to prepare for as they readjust strategies. Even as they do so, pod pilots both loyalist and independent are rushing into the area to stake a claim of their own.

It remains unclear exactly how the phenomena shrouding this area were penetrated, or indeed how the Caldari State has managed to colonize the area in complete secrecy. State officials have so far remained tight-lipped on any details, providing no explanations. After such startling events in recent times however, and with officials from all three Empires as well as CONCORD pushing for answers on the matter, it is something they will likely have to address in the nearby future.
messages.zh:
最近的事情想不到又出现了一个波折。现在有多份报告宣称加达里盖伦特接壤星系中冒出了新的星门。原先被认为是无法穿越的暗涌之域好像已经被加达里军队暗地里开发了。

从一些克隆飞行员的初期报道来看，那片星域里富含了众多处女星系，蕴含了尚未被四大帝国开采利用的大量资源。另外，据早期的地理探测资料显示，该星域将成为加达里盖伦特之间又一个新的接壤星域，双方因此目前都在重新调整战略以做新的准备。尽管如此，还是有一批克隆飞行员，无论是独立派还是势力派，都抢着要进这片星域为自己谋利。

目前大家还不清楚那星域的天然屏障是怎么被突破的，或者更准确地说，加达里是怎么做到悄然无息在那里殖民的。加达里官方目前仍缄口不言，不透露任何细节，也不提供任何解释。不过在最近那些报道出来之后，还有在其他三大帝国与统合部的联合压力之下，加达里或许必将在不远的将来对这一切做出解释。

messages.en: New Region connected to Stargate Networks by Caldari State, Scope Article, June 11th, YC 110
messages.zh: 《加达里合众国利用星门网络连接到了新星域》——“视角”于YC 110年6月11日发表的一篇文章

messages.en:
Welcome to Astoh, {[character]player.name}. I appreciate you coming by. Katsen just sent me the ISK, too. Thank you for being our middle man on that one. You may want to make yourself comfortable in that egg for a moment; I've a bit to cover here for your briefing.

As you know, my name is Sinas Egassuo. As you probably do not know, my job is to coordinate search and rescue operations, as well as the liberation of Caldari Prisoners of War taken during battle in Black Rise. This duty I have fulfilled without hesitation, and I am proud to have led such operations.

It is by carrying out this task, however, that I've come to notice something strange. Whenever we rescue people, there are often less Ishukone crew members and staff than the rest. It's never enough to be conspicuous or noticeable, but I notice it, and I find it conspicuous. I can't explain it though, and neither can the people we recover.

My suspicion is that Ishukone personnel are being taken elsewhere, perhaps being treated more kindly due to their Liberal philosophies and good history with the Gallente. It wouldn't surprise me to see the Federation trying to divide us over something like that, but we'd have to know about it first, and they don't seem keen on that happening.

I need you to investigate the matter for me and find out what's going on. I can brief you on the details of the assignment once you accept, but until I have that commitment, I'm not willing to trust you with the information. Sorry {[character]player.name}, but Katsen's recommendation only gets you so far.

So, are you committed to the fight ahead of us or not?
messages.zh:
欢迎光临阿希多，{[character]player.name}。感谢你的造访。卡僧也已经把星币给了我，谢谢你为我们牵线搭桥。你最好换个舒服的姿势坐在你的逃生舱里，我接下来还有蛮多的事要向你通报。

想必你已经知道，我名叫塞纳斯·伊佳索。但你可能不知道的是，我专负责协调搜救工作，以及解救那些在暗涌之域中被俘虏的加达里人。我对这份工作没有任何犹豫，且对能带领这样的行动而倍感自豪。

不过就在执行该项任务的过程中，我注意到了一件奇怪的事。每次救人时，异株湖集团的工作人员总是比别的军团的人要少。虽然怀疑或者注意说明不了什么，但我已经注意到了，而且起了疑心。究竟为什么我也不清楚，我们救回来的人也同样不知道。

异株湖集团的人一向怀有自由主义思想且与盖伦特的历史交往不错，我怀疑他们被带往了别处被人好生招待去了。虽然我不会对盖伦特想使离间计而感到惊讶，但我们还是得先确认这件事。不过他们好像不会让我们轻易达成这个目标。

我要你替我去对此事展开调查。如果你答应，那我就告诉你这项任务的详细安排；如果你不肯，那我也不会将那些信息透露给你。不好意思，{[character]player.name}，尽管你有卡僧的推荐，但我也只能说到此为止。

好了，你到底愿不愿意替我去调查？

messages.en: From what Isha said about you, I didn't expect this. I guess I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 从伊沙对你的介绍来看，我真没料到会这样。看来我得找别人了。

messages.en: Get going, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 快去，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Proof of Intent
messages.zh: 意图证明

messages.en: Upon the instructions of his intermediary Aursa Kunivuri, I met with Katsen Isha to discuss the possibility of future work with him and Nugoeihuvi.
messages.zh: 在卡僧·伊沙的中介人奥尔撒·库雷利的指点下，我与卡僧本人会了面并与他探讨了为其与纳维基集团将来工作的可能性。

messages.en: I met Aursa Kunivuri, a representative of Nugoeihuvi and an intermediary for Katsen Isha. He said if I was seeking work then I should go speak with the man myself.
messages.zh: 我会见了奥尔撒·库雷利，他是纳维基集团的代表兼卡僧·伊沙的中介人。他说如果我需要工作，那就得去找伊沙本人。

messages.en: Very well, {[character]player.name}. I don't have much in the way of ISK to give you, but my associates have some information that would not usually come cheap. You may find it useful when dealing with Isha. Here is a verification key, take it to the center a few kilometers from here and my subordinates will retrieve the relevant documents.
messages.zh: 很好，{[character]player.name}。我星币给不了你多少，但我的同事掌握着价值不菲的信息。我接下来给你的东西或许在你与伊沙打交道时能派上用场。这是验证密钥，把它带到距此地数公里远的一个中心。我的下属会取出相关的文件。

messages.en: Katsen Isha, over at the Nugoeihuvi Corporation station in Poinen, is the man you need to report to. I should warn you though; sometimes business dealings with Isha can get a little involved. He's the typical hard-working Deteis type and will expect the same of anyone on his payroll.
messages.zh: 位于波耶伦星系纳维基集团空间站的卡僧·伊沙才是你应该报到的对象。不过我得提醒你：为伊沙干活有时需要多点投入。他是典型的蒂泰斯工作狂，而且要求拿他工资的人也像他那样。

messages.en: Not interested? Makes no difference to me.
messages.zh: 没兴趣？其实少你一个不少，多你一个也不多。

messages.en:
The Caldari State's answer to the cultural powerhouses of the Federation, Nugoeihuvi Corporation (more commonly known as simply “NOH”) is one of the leading entertainment providers of the cluster.

Nugoeihuvi Corporation is rumored to have dealings with criminals and others of questionable moral character, although their working relationship with the real-estate giant Sukuuvestaa Corporation, for instance, has helped the company maintain at least the appearance of discretion at most times. Every day, all sorts of NOH goods flow freely to consumers across State space, frequently with little or no questions asked.
messages.zh:
盖伦特联邦的文化影响力巨大。作为回应，加达里中诞生了纳维基集团（人们通常简称其为“NOH”），该集团是宇宙中娱乐业的领头羊之一。

虽然纳维基集团与地产界巨头斯库维塔集团的合作关系让外人看起来纳维基在多数时候表现得至少还挺谨慎的，但还是有谣言说该集团与罪犯及一些道德有问题的人有来往。每天纳维基集团的作品都几近无障碍地自由流向加达里各领域。

messages.en: Nugoeihuvi Corporation
messages.zh: 纳维基集团

messages.en:
Ah, hello, {[character]player.name}. I suppose you heard that I was looking for work?

Well, that was half right. I'm just an intermediary; Katsen Isha is the man you need to report to. He asked me to arrange for some extra assistance with a few jobs he has in mind.

I should warn you, though: sometimes business dealings with Isha can get a little involved. He's the typical hard-working Deteis type and will expect the same of anyone on his payroll.
messages.zh:
噢，你好，{[character]player.name}。想必你是因得知我要人干活所以来的吧？

那消息只是一半正确。我其实是个中介。卡僧·伊沙才是你应该报到的对象。他要我为他策划的几份工作安排一些助手。

不过我得提醒你：为伊沙干活有时需要多点投入。他是典型的蒂泰斯工作狂，而且要求拿他工资的人也像他那样。

messages.en: Ok, I'll terminate the contract now then. Thank you for the notification.
messages.zh: Ok,那我现在就终止合同。谢谢你这么坦白。

messages.en: You're back? I thought I told you to go speak with Katsen Isha? There's nothing more I can do for you {[character]player.name}, he is the one who has the work, not me.
messages.zh: 你回来了？我好像已经跟你说过你应该去找卡僧·伊沙的？我已经帮不了你什么了，{[character]player.name}。卡僧那儿有活儿等着你干，我这里没有。

name.ja: デモンストレーション

messages.en: The Passage
messages.zh: 通途

messages.en: I met with a Brutor named Arsten Takalo. He seemed to have some real work for me, but wouldn't elaborate on it until I could prove myself. Upon his instruction, I acquired an “Olfei Medallion” and returned it to him. He seemed impressed with this, and said that if I was interested in getting started I should meet him again.
messages.zh: 我见了一个叫“阿斯顿·塔克洛”的布鲁特人。他好像确实有些正经事要我做，但非要我先证明自己能力之后才肯把事托付给我。我已经按照他的要求交给他一枚“欧菲大奖章”。他看起来很满意，并对我说如果我有兴趣跟他大干一场的话，就再去找他。

messages.en: I met with a Brutor named Arsten Takalo. He seems to have some real work for me, but won't trust me with it until I can prove myself. I have been asked to acquire an “Olfei Medallion” – whatever that is – and return it to him as proof that I can handle further work.  He suggested I should be exploring around the Sveipar constellation, scanning for its location. Alternatively, if I can't find it, he suggested that he wouldn't care if I simply bought one from the markets. Apparently, results are all that matters to him, and this task is supposed to prove that.
messages.zh: 我见了一个叫“阿斯顿·塔克洛”的布鲁特人。他好像确实有些正经事要我做，但非要我先证明自己能力之后才肯把事托付给我。他要求我先去拿得一枚“欧菲大奖章”——天晓得这到底是什么东西——然后交给他以作为我能胜任高级工作的证明。他提示我可以去斯维帕星座将其扫描出来。当然如果我实在找不到，他也不介意我去市场上直接购买此物品。很明显，他这人只关心结果，此项任务也就是为了证明这点。

messages.en: Alright then. Let's see what you got.
messages.zh: 好啊，来看看你拿到了什么。

messages.en:
We Matari are known for our ingenuity. Civilization owes us a great debt, and the Amarr owe it twice over. Before they came, we were by far the most advanced nation; our technological achievements were regarded with envy by the rest of the cluster.

Well, regardless of history, and regardless of your race, you will need to demonstrate an understanding of this if you want to work with us. Prove your resourcefulness by bringing me an Olfei Medallion. You will have to explore as only a capsuleer can and find one somewhere in the Sveipar constellation, near our homeworld Pator. Of course, some other egger can milk your wallet in exchange for doing the thinking and grunt work for you. That works too. Whether you scan it down inside an Angel Cartel fortress, or buy it for 2 ISK on the market - I don't really care. Results are what matter most.
messages.zh: 世人都知道我们玛塔利人拥有天才般的头脑。我们对人类文明做出了太多贡献，艾玛更是亏欠我们良多。艾玛人入侵之前，我们是当时宇宙中最强盛的国家；那时别人对我们的科技成就抱以崇敬又妒嫉的态度。你想与我们合作，就得以行动向我们证明你钦佩我们。为了检验你脑子是否聪明，我现在要你去给我拿一枚“欧菲大奖章”来。你可以在毗邻我们帕多尔家园的斯维帕星座里找到这样的东西。当然，有些克隆飞行员愿意替人做苦力，只要他们能拿到钱就行。你有钱你也可以这样干。无论你是在天使老巢里将其扫描出来，还是在市场上花2星币将其购得，这些都不是我关心的，我要的只是结果。

messages.en: I met with a Brutor named Arsten Takalo. He seemed to have some real work for me, but wouldn't elaborate on it until I could prove myself. Upon his instruction, I acquired an “Olfei Medallion” and returned it to him. He seemed impressed with this, and said that if I was interested in getting started I should meet him again.
messages.zh: 我见了一个叫“阿斯顿·塔克洛”的布鲁特人。他好像确实有些正经事要我做，但非要我先证明自己能力之后才肯把事托付给我。我已经按照他的要求交给他一枚“欧菲大奖章”。他看起来很满意，并对我说如果我有兴趣跟他大干一场的话，就再去找他。

messages.en: If that's too much for you then yeah, it's best we part ways now.
messages.zh: 如果你觉得这要求太高的话，那我们确实应该尽早说拜拜。

messages.en: The fortunes of the Minmatar have ebbed and flowed continuously. At one time they had a flourishing empire with a level of mechanical excellence never before or since seen anywhere. Later, however, they had to endure centuries of enslavement, toiling and dying for the benefit of foreign masters. Today most of them have regained their freedom, but the legacy of their enslavement has been the diaspora of the race.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人经历着命运的轮回。他们曾有一个机械技术位于尖端、经济繁荣昌盛的帝国。但后来他们遭受了长达数百年的奴役，为外国殖民者流汗出血。虽然如今大部分米玛塔尔人已重获自由，但仍有一部分处于奴役的梏桎之中。

messages.en: Former Selves
messages.zh: 曾经的劳工

messages.en:
A visitor, and a capsuleer no less. I can tell my day is about to get more interesting.

Hello {[character]player.name}. I'm guessing you flew out here because you heard I was handing out work, right? Well, I do have something for you. Nothing amazingly difficult and nothing someone without a pod could handle easily, either. If you can pull this off, we can see about maybe getting you in on some other things. Maybe.

We Matari are known for our ingenuity. Civilization owes us a great debt, and the Amarr owe it twice over. Before they came, we were by far the most advanced nation; our technological achievements were regarded with envy by the rest of the cluster. You eggers know a lot, but did you know that?

Well, regardless of history, and regardless of your race, you will need to demonstrate an understanding of this if you want to work with us. Prove your resourcefulness by bringing me an Olfei Medallion. You will have to explore as only a capsuleer can and find one somewhere in the Sveipar constellation, near our homeworld Pator. Of course, some other egger can milk your wallet in exchange for doing the thinking and grunt work for you. That works too. Whether you scan it down inside an Angel Cartel fortress, or buy it for 2 ISK on the market - I don't really care. Results are what matter most.

You'll go far with me if you keep that in mind.
messages.zh:
有人来了，看样子绝对是个克隆飞行员。终于能做些有意思的事了。

你好，{[character]player.name}。我猜你过来是因为你听说我正在招人做事对吧？事实上我确实有事情让你做。这事虽比不上上刀山下火海，但它也绝非是一般人能信手拈来的事。如果你能顺利搞定它，或许我们还能进一步合作，我说的是“或许”。

世人都知道我们玛塔利人拥有天才般的头脑。我们对人类文明做出了太多贡献，艾玛更是亏欠我们良多。艾玛人入侵之前，我们是当时宇宙中最强盛的国家；那时别人对我们的科技成就抱以崇敬又妒嫉的态度。你们这群待在像一个蛋一样的驾驶舱里的飞行员可谓见多识广，但你们了解玛塔利人那些昔日的辉煌吗？

好了，不去说历史了，也不追究你的种族。你想与我们合作，就得以行动向我们证明你钦佩我们。为了检验你脑子是否聪明，我现在要你去给我拿一枚“欧菲大奖章”来。你可以在毗邻我们帕多尔家园的斯维帕星座里找到这样的东西。当然，有些克隆飞行员愿意替人做苦力，只要他们能拿到钱就行。你有钱你也可以这样干。无论你是在天使老巢里将其扫描出来，还是在市场上花2星币将其购得，这些都不是我关心的，我要的只是结果。

记住这点的话，你和我还有得继续合作。

messages.en: If that's too much for you then yeah, it's best we part ways now.
messages.zh: 如果你觉得这要求太高的话，那我们确实应该尽早说拜拜。

messages.en: Keep searching, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 继续找，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: It seems I earned Arsten's trust, at least enough to be given another job…with a 5m ISK collateral. He told me about a Gallentean historian named Aillon Boufin who had been living in Minmatar space collecting documents for years, and  yet was now refusing to hand over a particular record to the Republic. I was sent in to recover it, and upon my arrival Boufin immediately retaliated. I had to kill him and recover the document forcefully.
messages.zh: 我似乎已经赢得了阿斯顿的信任，至少他又给了我一份需要缴纳……5百万押金的工作。他跟我说了一位住在米玛塔尔数年专收集文档的盖伦特历史学家埃隆·保费因的事，说他现在拒绝向共和国交出一份特定文档。我被派去拿回这份文档。我一到那儿就遭到了保费因的报复性打击。我不得已只能干掉他，用武力强行夺回了这份文档。

messages.en: It seems I've earned Arsten's trust, at least enough to be given another job…with a 5m ISK collateral. He tells me there is a Gallentean historian named Aillon Boufin who has been living in Minmatar space collecting documents for years, and  yet is now refusing to hand over a particular record to the Republic. Whatever it is, they're willing to have me kill him for it.
messages.zh: 我似乎已经赢得了阿斯顿的信任，至少他又给了我一份需要缴纳……5百万押金的工作。他跟我说了一位住在米玛塔尔数年专收集文档的盖伦特历史学家埃隆·保费因的事，说他现在拒绝向共和国交出一份特定文档。不管这文档到底是什么，他们反正宁愿让我去取了他的命也要将文档拿回来。

messages.en: Good. Let's see some results, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 好。请以实际行动来说话，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
There's this Gallentean guy, a historian named Aillon Boufin. The story is that he's been studying Minmatar history for years now, and as you'd expect, he's come across a whole shipload of information and documents in that time. Apparently he has one of the largest unofficial collections of documents and artifacts from our earlier days.

Now, I'm told that normally whenever we want to look at something of his, there aren't too many problems. Recently however, when some of our academics from the Republic University asked to see a particular document, they were denied. Since that time, they have bent over backwards for this guy. They have even tried to buy it back, repeatedly raising the price. Each of these times they were refused, and then things started to get ugly.

Boufin recently made a statement to the University, saying he is only trying to “preserve Minmatar heritage”. After that insult, they called us in. The implication that RU staff would somehow endanger our own history by simply studying a document...it's almost like he was trying to piss us all off.

Well, the insults stop here. The Brutor tribe has arrived, and with a capsuleer to back their word on the matter no less. It has been decided by the tribe that the return of this document to Matari hands represents a higher priority than staying on good terms with some overprotective historian, Gallente or not. You will see to this.
messages.zh:
有一个名叫埃隆·保费因的盖伦特历史学家，他研究米玛塔尔的历史已经好多年了，他收集到的资料信息足以塞满一艘船。他拿到了大量有关我们早期历史的资料与文物，在非官方认可的资料收集者中，他的收集数量处于顶尖行列。

本来我听说只要我们想去他那儿查一点资料，都不会有太多问题。但最近当我们共和大学的几位学者要求查阅一份特定文档时，却遭到了拒绝。然后他们就跪求这位历史学家，甚至还提出收购——要知道这份文档可是玛塔利人写的，是属于我们的啊。他们试了一次又一次、不断加价，却依然换不来对方点头。接下来双方就变得不客气了。

先是保费因向共和大学发去了一份声明，声称他是想“保护米玛塔尔的遗产”。然后共和大学就来找我们了。他的那份声明就是在暗示共和大学的学者会通过研究一份文档来销毁我们自己的历史……他根本就是想让我们大家都气得七窍冒烟。

够了。布鲁特的人已经来了，还请来了你这位克隆飞行员来帮他们。他们已经决定，为了让这份文档重新回到玛塔利人手里，即便牺牲这位保护倾向过于严重的历史学家也在所不惜，哪怕他是盖伦特人。你去执行这项决定。

messages.en:
So things spiraled out of control in there. Don't stress it, {[character]player.name}. It was to be expected, and if it wasn't you out there, it'd be Republic Fleet vessels with clone-less crews. You did a good thing, don't doubt it for a second.

Hopefully the foreign press will let this one slide, they've got enough of us in their own borders to sit on it, but there's always a few. So long as the big outlets hold their tongues I'm happy.

Here's your ISK back, plus some extra as thanks. Don't blow it all away though, you'll be doing other work that requires collateral. I may be starting to respect you, but trust is a damn long way off. We'll need a moment to pass this on to our friends from the University, but they've asked us to hang around, and by us, they mean you.
messages.zh:
看来事情还是失控了。别太在意了，{[character]player.name}。我们本来就料到会这样，要不是你，那我们就得派克隆飞行员不多的共和舰队的士兵出动了。你做了件正确的事，别怀疑自己了。

但愿外媒会让这件事沉下去。他们自己国家内已经有很多我们自己人可供他们做新闻题材。虽然期望所有的外媒都对此事保持沉默也不现实，但只要一些大媒体对此缄口不言就行了。

现在我把这些押金还给你，外加一些你应该获得的酬劳。但别把他们都花光了，你将来可能还要接一些需要押金的活儿。我现在或许已经对你起了敬意，但要说信任那还差远了。我们要稍微花点时间把消息通报给我们大学里的朋友，但他们也要求我们先别走。他们指的我们中也包括你。

messages.en: Ok, thanks, bye.
messages.zh: 好吧，谢了，拜拜。

messages.en: For many citizens of the Minmatar Republic, the friendship with the Gallente Federation has been a costly one. Some view the recent abandonment of the parliamentary system as the most potent symbol yet that the Federation's influence hasn't always been to their benefit. Indeed, there are some Matari who view the return to a Tribal Republic as the last necessary step out from under the shadow of foreign empires. Whatever the claims may be, few deny that the relationship still has some fundamental challenges to overcome.
messages.zh: 对许多米玛塔尔共和国的人来说，为了与盖伦特联邦维持伙伴关系，他们已经付出了太多。有些人认为最近放弃议会制一事已经很明显地显示，盖伦特对米玛塔尔产生的影响并不能确保米玛塔尔一直受益。事实上，有些玛塔利人还认为，重建部落共和国制度是摆脱外国影响力的最后必要一步。无论持什么样的观点，几乎每个米玛塔尔人都意识到他们与盖伦特之间的关系还有亟待解决的几大障碍。

messages.en: Rising Tensions
messages.zh: 愈发紧张的关系

messages.en:
Now that we're past the small talk perhaps you're ready for some proper work. I guess we'll see.

There's this Gallentean guy, a historian named Aillon Boufin…yeah, I know. The story is that he's been studying Minmatar history for years now, and as you'd expect, he's come across a whole shipload of information and documents in that time. Apparently he has one of the largest unofficial collections of documents and artifacts from our earlier days. We're talking real old here, {[character]player.name}, some of it - going back to when it was just us, alone against the Amarr.

Now, I'm told that normally whenever we want to look at something of his, there aren't too many problems. Recently however, when some of our academics from the Republic University asked to see a particular document known as the Hauteker Memoirs, they were denied. Since that time, they have bent over backwards for this guy. They have even tried to buy it back - this document that Matari people wrote, this document that belongs to us. They have tried that repeatedly, raising and raising the price and yet each of these times more refusals.

This is when things got ugly. Boufin recently made a statement to the University, saying he is only trying to “preserve Minmatar heritage”. After that insult, they called us in. The implication that RU staff would somehow endanger our own history by simply studying a document...it's almost like he was trying to piss us all off.

Well, the insults stop here. The Brutor tribe has arrived, and with a capsuleer to back their word on the matter no less. It has been decided by the tribe that the return of this document to Matari hands represents a higher priority than staying on good terms with some overprotective historian, Gallente or not. You will see to this. And before you go jumping in, there is a 5m ISK collateral to cover associated risks. The tribe is not willing to risk our own property falling into foreign hands again. Perhaps you can see why we're looking to hire an egger? With that kind of money it's not really an option.
messages.zh:
既然我们已经不用讲废话了，那或许就是给你正事做的时候了。希望你能以实际表现验证这一点。

有一个名叫埃隆·保费因的盖伦特历史学家，他研究米玛塔尔的历史已经好多年了，他收集到的资料信息足以塞满一艘船。他拿到了大量有关我们早期历史的资料与文物，在非官方认可的资料收集者中，他的收集数量处于顶尖行列。{[character]player.name}，我这里指的早期确实是很久以前的事，可以追溯到我们单枪匹马挑艾玛的年代。

本来我听说只要我们想去他那儿查一点资料，都不会有太多问题。但最近当我们共和大学的几位学者要求查阅一份名为“霍特克回忆录”的文档时，却遭到了拒绝。然后他们就跪求这位历史学家，甚至还提出收购——要知道这份文档可是玛塔利人写的，是属于我们的啊。他们试了一次又一次、不断加价，却依然换不来对方点头。

接下来双方就变得不客气了。先是保费因向共和大学发去了一份声明，声称他是想“保护米玛塔尔的遗产”。然后共和大学就来找我们了。他的那份声明就是在暗示共和大学的学者会通过研究一份文档来销毁我们自己的历史……他根本就是想让我们大家都气得七窍冒烟。

够了。布鲁特的人已经来了，还请来了你这位克隆飞行员来帮他们。他们已经决定，为了让这份文档重新回到玛塔利人手里，即便牺牲这位保护倾向过于严重的历史学家也在所不惜，哪怕他是盖伦特人。你去执行这项决定。在你动身之前，你得先缴纳5百万星币押金来确保风险。布鲁特人可不希望再冒险让其自身物品落入外人之手。现在你该明白我们为什么要找克隆飞行员了吧？那笔钱只有你们这种人才拿得出。

messages.en: Huh, after the Olfei Medallion I wasn't expecting that. Very well {[character]player.name}, I suppose I'll find another egger to take over. Shouldn't be too hard to find one with 5m in my pocket…
messages.zh: 啊，在欧菲大奖章那次行动之后，想不到你竟然会是这个态度。很好，{[character]player.name}，看来我得另找一位克隆飞行员了。我现在自己口袋里就有5百万，找个人应该不是太难……

messages.en: Any updates on the historian?
messages.zh: 那历史学家如何了？

name.es: La historia la escriben los vencedores

messages.en:
I was asked by Arsten to continue to help the Republic University with their historical research. The memoirs I recovered earlier had directions to a burial site in San Matar, which I was tasked with investigating. The site housed the remains of an old Ammatar family that died out. What made them important for us was a myth about one of their leaders being buried with some special kind of Khumaak. The RU academics expected to debunk the myth by sending me out there. They didn't think I would actually find anything.

Well, I did. I found something in one of the tombs; a “wildfire” Khumaak. The academics can hardly contain themselves – they think it could represent a major discovery. Arsten seems uneasy about all of this, and just wants the item escorted to somewhere safe as soon as possible.
messages.zh:
阿斯顿请求你继续帮助共和大学的历史研究。很显然我发现的回忆录中包含了姗玛塔尔埋葬地的位置信息。这个埋葬地理论上埋藏着已经消亡的古老艾玛家族成员的遗体。对我们来说最重要的是，那个家族的一个首领的随葬品中有一个被称为库马克的东西。共和大学想要证明这只是一个传说，但他们没想到我真的找到这个东西。

很好，我确实在其中的一个墓葬中找到了一样东西；一个“野火”库马克。那些学者们会很难控制自己的——他们会认为这是一个巨大的发现。阿斯顿似乎对这事有点心神不宁，只要求我们把这个物品尽快护送到一个安全的地方去。

messages.en: Arsten has asked for further help with the Republic University's historical research. Apparently the memoirs I recovered had directions to a burial site in San Matar. The site is supposed to house remains of an old Ammatar family that died out. What makes them important for us is a myth about one of their leaders being buried with some special kind of Khumaak. The RU academics want to debunk the myth, so my job is to fly out to the site and prove that it is empty.
messages.zh: 阿斯顿请求你继续帮助共和大学的历史研究。很显然我发现的回忆录中包含了姗玛塔尔埋葬地的位置信息。这个埋葬地理论上埋藏着已经消亡的古老艾玛家族成员的遗体。对我们来说最重要的是，那个家族的一个首领的随葬品中有一个被称为库马克的东西。共和大学想要证明这只是一个传说，所以我的任务就是飞过去然后证明那个墓穴中什么都没有。

messages.en: Excellent. Here are the coordinates. And uh…all jokes aside, {[character]player.name}, try to respect the dead while you're looking around, if only to keep a low profile and an old Brutor happy.
messages.zh: 很好，这是那个地址。然后……说实在的，{[character]player.name}，请你在调查那个墓穴的时候尊重死者，这是为了保持低调并且让那个年老的布鲁特人高兴。

messages.en: You guys just pick things up then put 'em right back down, don't you?
messages.zh: 你们几个家伙只是把这东西拿起来看看然后就会放回去，是吧？

messages.en:
Wait, you found a Khumaak out there? What the hell is a Wildfire Khumaak? I'm dying to look at it, I admit, but we can't screw around here. We need to get this thing somewhere safe before we start trying to figure anything out. I have a bad feeling about all of this {[character]player.name}. Boufin was strangely protective, Angels were all over the burial site, and the Amarr were plenty aware of its location too. With that many people involved, I doubt nobody noticed us lifting that thing out of the tombs.

I have an idea about where to take it, but I need to make a quick holovid call first. Talk to me again in a few moments, ok?
messages.zh:
等等，你在那儿找到了一个库马克？野火库马克到底是什么玩意儿？我承认我非常想看看，但是我们不能在这儿浪费时间。我们需要把这东西送到一个安全的地方，然后在去研究它。我有一种不好的感觉，{[character]player.name}。保费因的保护意识让人觉得很奇怪，而墓葬地点周围到处都是天使联合企业的人，此外艾玛人对这个地点的情况也非常的了解。这么多人都参与了进来，我怀疑肯定有人意识到我们把这东西从墓地里拿了出来。

我知道我们该把它送到哪儿去了，但我需要先打个电话。过一会儿就来找我，好么？

messages.en: You guys just pick things up then put 'em right back down, don't you?
messages.zh: 你们几个家伙只是把这东西拿起来看看然后就会放回去，是吧？

messages.en:
The Ammatars are descendants of Minmatar that collaborated with the Amarrians during the latter occupation of the Minmatar worlds. When the Amarrians were thrown out during the Minmatar Rebellion their collaborators fled with them. The Amarrians helped their Minmatar allies to settle in a few systems not far from the newly formed Minmatar Republic. The Ammatars regard themselves as the true rulers of the Minmatars, mainly based around the fact that a fair proportion of the old Minmatar aristocracy, or tribal leaders, were among them. In this vein they named their domain San Matar, meaning ‘true home'.

The term Ammatar was first used by the Gallenteans to distinguish between the two groups. Out of convenience even the Ammatars themselves started using it, stating that, with the help of the Amarrians, they had progressed beyond the old social structure of the Minmatar tribes. Indeed, the Ammatars have very deliberately abolished many age-old traditions of the Minmatar tribal society and embraced some Amarrian ones instead.

In the months following the Elder War of YC110, the Ammatar Mandate was beset with turmoil and uncertainty. During the war, its lucrative tsula plantations -- the Mandate's largest export crop and arguably the backbone of its economy -- were systematically destroyed by Chamberlain Karsoth's forces in retaliation for the Mandate government's harboring of Starkmanir Minmatar tribesmen, a clan lineage long-since thought extinct. After Empress Jamyl I rose to power in the Amarr Empire, however, appointing Royal Heir Yonis Ardishapur as Ammatar's savior and protector, the nation has entered into something of a renaissance. Aid now flows in a steady stream from the Empire's coffers, command hierarchies are being reinforced and morale is on the rise. It appears the star of Ammatar will soon shine bright once more.
messages.zh:
艾玛达是米玛塔尔的一支后裔族群，他们在艾玛占领米玛塔尔后期的时候曾经同艾玛人进行合作。当米玛塔尔抗争推翻艾玛殖民后，他们同艾玛人一起逃跑了。艾玛人帮助他们的米玛塔尔盟友在距离新成立的米玛塔尔共和国不远的地方建立了一些殖民地。艾玛达人认为他们是米玛塔尔的真正统治阶级，这种说法的根据主要是因为旧米玛塔尔中的大部分贵族和部落首领都在他们中间。处于这种想法他们把自己的领地称为“姗玛塔尔”，意思是“真正的家园”。

艾玛达这个词最早是盖伦特人开始使用的，用来区分这个两个不同的族群。出于方便，甚至艾玛达人自己也开始使用这个名词，表示他们在艾玛的协助下，他们已经超越了旧有的米玛塔尔部落社会结构。确实，艾玛达人自愿地抛弃了一些米玛塔尔部落社会的旧习俗，转而接受了一些艾玛人的风俗。

在新伊甸纪元110年长老战争过后的几个月里，艾玛达托管地受到了混乱和不确定因素的干扰。苏拉植物的种植是托管地主要的出口农作物，在一定程度上也是那里的经济支柱；在战争期间，原本利润丰厚的苏拉种植园遭受到了有计划的破坏。破坏它们的人是，宫务大臣卡索夫，目的是为了报复托管政府庇护斯塔科马米玛塔尔族人的行为，斯塔科马人是一支被认为消失很久的部族。艾玛女皇贾米尔一世登基过后，封皇族嗣子尤尼斯·阿狄莎波为艾玛达救主级保护者。救济金现在开始源源不断地从帝国国库中输送出来，指挥系统得到了强化，士气也开始回升。这样一来，艾玛达之星很快就能再一次发出闪耀的光芒。

messages.en: The Ammatar – Past and Present
messages.zh: 艾玛达的过去和现在

messages.en:
Good thing you're still about, we'll need you again for this one.

The Republic University guys had a look over the document and it has what they're after: directions. There's a mention in one of the sections of an old Nefantar bloodline, and where they buried their dead. I'm told they're important because of some old folktale about how they buried a special type of Khumaak with one of their leaders. Pretty odd stuff, but also kinda interesting.

They're on a myth-busting mission, though, that's the thing. There is no actual Khumaak, just a bunch of old Ammatar bones, probably. Still, you go there, check it out, and then they can say in their report that the area was inspected by a capsuleer and turned up nothing. They put that together with the proof in this old book that you inspected the right area and, I dunno, write an essay about how clever they are. The important thing for me was just getting our own history back, and that's what you should remember too.

So anyways, you feel like digging up some graves? The coordinates will be 2.5m in collateral, to cover associated risks yet again. If for some crazy reason there is actually a unique Khumaak out there, it belongs in a museum, not your cargo bay. 2.5m ISK would buy a lot of museums, you see. Whatever way it goes, our history won't lose out again.
messages.zh:
你做得很好，我们还需要你帮助我们解决这个问题。

共和大学的人看了这个文件，上面有他们要找的线索：目标的位置。其中一个提到一个古老的内凡达血亲族系，以及他们的墓地的坐标。他们告诉我之所以这很重要，是因为一些古老的传说中描述到他们在其中一个首领的墓地里陪葬了某种被称为库马克的东西。这是一个很古老的东西，但是多少有点意思。

共和大学的人想要让这个传说破灭，就是这样的。或许那儿根本没有什么库马克，只有一堆古老的艾玛达骨骸。尽管如此，你还是需要去一趟那里看个究竟，这样他们就可以在报告中说已经派遣过一个克隆飞行员去实地进行了考察也没有发现任何东西。他们会把报告和这本旧书一起提交上去，这本书能够证明你调查的地点是正确的地点。我不是很清楚，或许他们想要写一篇散文来谈论自己的功劳。你要记住的是，对于我来说，最重要的就是把我们的历史找回来。

那么，你准备帮我去挖这个坟么？坐标信息的担保金是250万星币，这是为了防止可能的损失。如果要真的在那儿找到一个什么库马克的话，这玩意儿应该是属于博物馆所有，不能让你扔在货柜舱里面烂掉。你知道，250万可以买不少博物馆了。不管怎样，我们的历史都不能再以此失落了。

messages.en: You guys just pick things up then put 'em right back down, don't you?
messages.zh: 你们几个家伙只是把这东西拿起来看看然后就会放回去，是吧？

messages.en: Let me know once you've inspected the site.
messages.zh: 等你调查了那个墓葬后就立即向我报告。

messages.en: Upon Arsten's instruction, I met with the Defiants, a rebel group thought to have been eradicated during their defense of the Thukker-Elder retreat. They have promised to safeguard the Wildfire Khumaak as we wait for academics to arrive and study it. The Brutor tribe is concerned for the artifact's safety after seeing so many groups already involved one way or another in the matter.
messages.zh: 在阿斯顿要求之下，我与挑战者组织见了面。挑战者是个抗争团，之前人们一直以为他们当年在掩护图克尔长老撤退的时候就被清剿了。挑战者答应会好好看管野火库马克直到学者来对它进行研究。在得知有那么多团体都对库马克感兴趣之后，布鲁特部落对自己是否能保住那玩意儿感到担心。

messages.en: After discovering the Wildfire Khumaak at the Hauteker burial site, I was asked by Arsten to deliver it safely to the Defiants, a rebel group thought to have been eradicated as they defended the Thukker-Elder retreat. The Brutor tribe has concerns for the artifacts' safety after seeing so many groups already involved in the matter.
messages.zh: 在霍特克的墓地发现野火库马克之后，阿斯顿要求我将那玩意儿安全地交给挑战者组织。挑战者是个抗争团，之前人们一直以为他们当年在掩护图克尔长老撤退的时候就被清剿了。在得知有那么多团体都对库马克感兴趣之后，布鲁特部落对自己是否能保住那玩意儿感到担心。

messages.en: I knew you'd say yes. Alright, here is their location, but don't waste time screwing around, they move constantly and won't be there forever.
messages.zh: 我就知道你会答应的。好，这就是他们的地址，不过你可别磨蹭，他们行踪飘忽，不会一直伺候在那里的。

messages.en:
Ever heard of the Defiants, {[character]player.name}? Well, either way, you're about to meet them – if you think you're ready for it. They're one of the few groups the Brutor tribe can trust these days. I once had the honor of meeting their leader, Karishal Muritor, before our own Fleet had him put down like a dog for daring to fight the Amarr. A shameful day for us all, it was.

Still, it showed us who will fight, and who can be trusted. There is no group of people I personally would want more than them to handle this. We don't know how significant this Khumaak is, but let me tell you friend, some of our people are very excited about its discovery. They think it may shed new light on our past. Me, I'm excited too I guess, but more concerned than anything. I'll relax once this is in the Defiants' hands, not any earlier.

So, can we count on you to make the delivery? I think you and I are past collateral now, {[character]player.name}. I'm happy to trust you with the current location of their camp, if only because you have no chance of finding them after this meeting. The Defiants are only discovered when they want to be.
messages.zh:
有没有听说过挑战者，{[character]player.name}？不管你有没有听过，你接下来马上就会见到他们——当然前提是你认为自己已经做好了准备。他们是布鲁特部落现今为数不多可信任的团体之一。我曾有幸见到他们的领导卡里煞·木里托，后来这家伙因胆敢对垒艾玛而遭到我们自己军队的打压。

不过我们还是从这件事情中看出了谁敢出战以及谁值得信任。我觉得只有让他们管此事才能让我放心。虽然我们还不知道这库马克的意义及影响到底有多深远，但你要知道，朋友，我们这里有些人对它的出现感到异常兴奋。他们认为那玩意儿将有助于我们肃清自己的历史。我本人也有点激动，但更多的还是担心。这东西只有交到挑战者手里才能让我安心下来。

怎么样，我们能放心让你去把这东西交给他们吗？我觉得你和我之间已经无需押金这东西了，{[character]player.name}。我可以放心地把他们目前的位置透露给你，反正见了这次面之后你就肯定再也找不到他们。挑战者组织只有在他们想露面的时候才露面。

messages.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}. I'm relieved to hear the Khumaak made it safely to the Defiants. I'm going to make a few arrangements to have some of the Republic's most trusted historians pay a visit to their caravan.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。听到库马克安全交到了挑战者手里终于让我舒了口气。我接下来要做些安排，让共和国里最值得信赖的一些历史学家去挑战者营地看看。

messages.en: Really? Ok then, {[character]player.name}, if you've had enough, then I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 当真？那好吧，{[character]player.name}，既然你已经受不了了，那我就去找别人。

messages.en: The Defiants were a splinter group of the Republic Fleet commanded by Admiral Karishal Muritor, a Brutor warrior and figure of great renown within military circles. Skirting the edge of all-out conflict with the Amarr Empire, the Defiants waged constant guerilla warfare with Amarr forces in the years leading up to the Elder Fleet Invasion of YC110, despite insistent urgings from the Republic to back down. Though the good Admiral is now fallen and most of his force gone -- lost while covering the retreat of the Elder Fleet -- a small contingent lives on, scheming to stamp themselves once again into the hearts and minds of freedom-loving Minmatar.
messages.zh: 挑战者是共和舰队里分离出来的一个组织，由在军事界享有盛名的布鲁特上将卡里煞·木里托领导。作为对抗艾玛的先锋，挑战者不顾共和国的撤退命令，不断与艾玛人打游击战直到新伊甸纪元110年的长老会舰队入侵。虽然那位骁勇善战的上将及其大部分部队早已在掩护长老会舰队撤退时阵亡，其剩下的一小撮队伍却仍计划有朝一日能在热爱自由的米玛塔尔人心里重塑地位。

messages.en: Defiance
messages.zh: 挑战者

They're one of the few groups the Brutor tribe can trust these days. I once had the honor of meeting their leader, Karishal Muritor, before our own Fleet had him put down like a dog for daring to fight the Amarr. A shameful day for us all, it was.
