messages.zh: 当真？那好吧，{[character]player.name}，既然你已经受不了了，那我就去找别人。

messages.en: Let me know as soon as you've made the delivery.
messages.zh: 你把东西送到之后就告诉我。

messages.en:
The Angel Cartel attempted to launch an attack on the Defiant base, most likely to take back what was stolen from them. Arsten was confident that the Cartel wasn't even aware what they were sitting on though, since basically nobody realized that Wildfire Khumaaks even existed. My job was to bring down the Angel's operational base, which I managed. That meant a fair fight for the Defiants being chased, so they stopped running, turned around, and then killed their pursuers, Arsten tells me.

Now we have another problem. The RSS had sent some kind of Spy to the camp to advise the Defiants on the Khumaak, but he's gone missing, right as the Angels showed up. The various leaders are talking it out now, but Arsten has a hunch I'm going to be called up to investigate the matter further.
messages.zh:
天使集团对挑战者的基地发动了一场袭击，可能是想夺回从他们那儿被拿走的东西。阿斯顿相信天使并不清楚他们占据的基地中蕴藏着的东西，因为几乎没人知道野火库马克的存在。我的任务就是捣毁天使的基地。我完成了那任务，为撤退中的挑战者组织创造了一个公平较量的环境。阿斯顿告诉我他们后来真的回头将天使一网打尽。

现在我们还有另一个问题。内务部原来有个间谍驻扎在那基地。他的任务是为挑战者在野火库马克一事上作顾问。但他现在失踪了，就在天使出现袭击的时候。现在上层正在就此事进行讨论，阿斯顿觉得我会被指派对此事展开进一步追查。

messages.en: The Angel Cartel just launched an attack on the Defiant base, most likely to take back what was stolen from them. Arsten is confident that the Cartel wasn't even aware what they were sitting on though, since basically nobody realized that Wildfire Khumaaks actually existed. My job is to bring down the Angel's operational base. That will mean a fair fight for the Defiants being chased – something I'm told they're not in any risk of losing.
messages.zh: 天使集团对挑战者的基地发动了一场袭击，可能是想夺回从他们那儿被拿走的东西。阿斯顿相信天使并不清楚他们占据的基地中蕴藏着的东西，因为几乎没人知道野火库马克的存在。我的任务就是捣毁天使的基地。这样就能为撤退中的挑战者组织创造一个公平较量的环境——听说他们从未在公平较量中败过阵。

messages.en: We're lucky to have you working with us, now go kick their teeth in. For Muritor!
messages.zh: 有你协助是我们的荣幸，为了木里托，去把他们的牙统统打落掉！

messages.en:
Only moments ago the Angel Cartel launched an attack on the Defiant base to recover what was taken from them. Seems they only realized now that they were sitting on something of value.

The Defiants have fled the camp, which has now been converted into a base of operations for the Angel's invasion fleet. The Defiants can easily evade a bunch of Angel thugs, but they have asked that we put this chase to an end quickly and violently. Your task will be to smash the Angel's operational base; our scouts traced their communications back to it, it's not far from here. That will sever the attacking forces from their reinforcements. As soon as that happens, the Defiants can stop running and turn to meet their attackers in a fair fight. They've never lost one, {[character]player.name}. Those Angels will drop like sacks of fedo crap once they have their support pulled out from under them.
messages.zh:
就在刚才天使集团对挑战者组织的基地发动了一场袭击以夺回从他们那儿被拿走的东西。他们现在好像只知道他们占据了一样有价值的东西。

挑战者组织逃出了营地，那里现在成了天使袭击队的基地。虽然挑战者组织的人能轻而易举地擒获一批天使流氓，但他们还是要求我们尽快用武力阻止天使的追击。你的任务就是粉碎那天使基地。我们情报人员已经查出了那基地的方位，离这不远。这样你就能切断他们的追击增援部队。然后，挑战者就回头与天使进行一场公平较量。{[character]player.name}，挑战者从来没有在公平较量中败下过阵来。只要切断其增援，天使就是一群乌合之众。

messages.en:
Nice flying out there {[character]player.name}. The Defiants dealt with the remains of the attacking fleet easily once you took out their support.

As for the situation with this RSS Agent, we're still discussing our options amongst the tribal leadership, but chances are that this guy was operating on his own. That means basically nobody knew what he was doing or why the Wildfire Khumaak grabbed his attention. You're probably going to have to take that guy's passkey and go in there yourself, if the RSS lets us. We're still talking with them about the situation. Some people are looking at his disappearance in an entirely different light, if you get me. RSS operative shows up and not much later so do a bunch of Angels. Yeah…still a few discussions yet to be had, I reckon.

Anyways, get back to me again soon and we'll have a plan ready for you. You've more than proven yourself now, so I'd be more than happy to trust you with whatever comes next.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。你把天使的增援力量解决之后，挑战者立即清理了其残余攻击舰队。

至于这个内务部的代理人，部族领导之间还在讨论处理方案，不过这家伙很有可能是单枪匹马地在单干。这就意味着没人清楚他在干什么，也没人知道为什么野火库马克会引起其注意。如果内务部允许，你或许还得拿着这家伙的通行证亲自前往那里一查究竟。我们还在与内务部商讨情况，有些人完全从另外一个角度在分析那家伙的失踪原因，但愿你能听懂我这话的意思。先是一个内务部代理人现身，然后又出现一帮天使的人…… 诸多谜团亟待解开。

不管怎么样，你要马上回来，我们会给你新的安排。你早已证明了自己，因此无论接下来的任务是什么，我都会放心交给你。

messages.en: Then rack off. We have work that needs doing here.
messages.zh: 那就闪吧。我们这里还有事要做。

messages.en: The Minmatar Republic and the Angel Cartel have a long and checkered history of locked horns and uneasy handshakes. A century back, when the Angel Cartel was building its reputation as a ruthless mercenary organization but had not yet crossed over into out-and-out piracy, the Republic was rumored to frequently contract the Cartel for operations deemed too politically sensitive for the Republic's armed forces. While these rumors have never been confirmed by either side, certain other occurrences -- such as the Cartel's immediate and unexplained withdrawal from their Skarkon sovereignty bid in YC110 -- seem to corroborate the idea of a nebulous connection between the two giant entities' top levels.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔共和国与天使集团长久以来一直维持着一段磕磕碰碰的关系。一个世纪前，当时天使集团作为一个雇佣军团体还处于创业期，没有进行彻头彻尾的海盗行动；据谣言称，米玛塔尔共和国当时经常将一些政治敏感的军事任务外包给天使集团。尽管双方至今都没有证实这一说法，但有些事情——例如在新伊甸纪元110年天使突然毫无理由地退出了对斯卡尔克恩星系主权的争夺这一事——似乎印证了两大势力高层之间存有的那种说不清的关系。

messages.en: The Republic-Cartel Relationship
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔共和国与天使集团之间的关系

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, you're not gonna like this. Only moments ago the Angel Cartel launched an attack on the Defiant base to recover what was taken from them. Seems they only realized now that they were sitting on something of value. Hell, we barely even know what we're sitting on right now.

The Defiants have fled the camp, which has now been converted into a base of operations for the Angel's invasion fleet. The Defiants can easily evade a bunch of Angel thugs, but they have asked that we put this chase to an end quickly and violently. Your task will be to smash the Angel's operational base. That will sever the attacking forces still chasing our brothers from their reinforcements. As soon as that happens, the Defiants can stop running and turn to meet their attackers in a fair fight. They've never lost one, {[character]player.name}. Those Angels will drop like sacks of fedo crap once they have their support pulled out from under them.

You have your orders, {[character]player.name}, will you accept them?
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，接下来的消息可能是你不愿听到的。就在刚才天使集团对挑战者组织的基地发动了一场袭击以夺回从他们那儿被拿走的东西。他们现在好像只知道他们占据了一样有价值的东西。哈，我们连我们自己手上掌握的是什么东西还不清楚呢。

挑战者组织逃出了营地，那里现在成了天使袭击队的基地。虽然挑战者组织的人能轻而易举地擒获一批天使流氓，但他们还是要求我们尽快用武力阻止天使的追击。你的任务就是粉碎那天使基地，这样就能切断他们的追击增援部队。然后，挑战者就回头与天使进行一场公平较量。{[character]player.name}，挑战者从来没有在公平较量中败下过阵来。只要切断其增援，天使就是一群乌合之众。

我已经给你下来命令，你接受吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Then rack off. We have work that needs doing here.
messages.zh: 那就闪吧。我们这里还有事要做。

messages.en: Get going! Those Angels won't stop chasing our boys until you cut their umbilical cord.
messages.zh: 还不快动身！你不把那帮天使的增援部队解决掉，他们是不会善罢甘休放过我们的人的。

messages.en:
Arsten was right in the end. I was asked to head into the RSS compound and look around for any explanation as to why an RSS agent wanted to advise the Defiants on the Wildfire Khumaak.

After a while spent searching emptied facilities, we found some data in the cache of the radio telescope – lots of communications from this agent. I'm not entirely sure what to make of it, but the impression given from the logs is that he was handling some kind of highly-placed spy in the Ammatar Consulate. He also appears to have been one of only two people who knew about the job, so secrecy is paramount here. The RSS staff on hand claimed to have been learning of this project as we were.

Given that we found the first Wildfire Khumaak at the burial grounds of an ancient Ammatar bloodline, I'm guessing this woman – whoever she is – knows something about their history too.
messages.zh:
阿斯顿最后被证明是对的。安全局一个代理人在野火库马克一事上为挑战者组织作顾问，我被要求前往该局的一个据点调查此事的原因。

在空无一人的据点里搜索一番之后，我们在射电望远镜的内存中发现了些数据，这些数据全是那代理人的通讯记录。我还不能从这些数据中得出一个确切结论，但初看起来，这人是在对付艾玛达领事馆内的一位高层间谍。除此之外，他好像还是知道此事的仅有两人中的一位，看来这事绝对是机密。和我们在一起的那帮安全局的人声称他们对此事的了解不比我们多。

鉴于我们是在一个远古血统艾玛达人的安葬地发现了第一个野火库马克，我猜这女人，不管她是谁，应该对那远古血统的历史也有所了解。

messages.en: It seems Arsten was right. I've been asked to head into the RSS compound and investigate things myself. Apparently my unique status and standing means I'm the preferred – and currently, the most trusted – candidate. My understanding is that various involved parties will be watching in through a camera drone feed. Arsten himself has promised to give further instructions once I get out there.
messages.zh: 好像阿斯顿的推断是对的。我被要求前往安全局的一个据点亲自调查。很明显，我独特的地位与声望决定了我目前是最值得信任的最佳候选人。我了解到很多人都将通过一个摄像无人机来观看调查现场。阿斯顿自己向我保证，只要我到了那儿，他就会给我进一步指示。

messages.en: Thanks {[character]player.name}. I owe you one.
messages.zh: 谢了，{[character]player.name}。我欠你一个人情。

messages.en:
Alright, we've talked it out and I was right. You're going in there. The RSS almost threatened to have you killed for attempting it, but with the accusations being leveled at them right now they're just gonna have to get over it. We needed someone independent, not tied to any one faction, and who we knew we could trust. You were the obvious answer; I didn't even have to suggest it.

The RSS has given us the location of the compound where this agent was doing his work. Your task will be to fly to Alakgur and investigate it. We're looking for anything that would give us further insight into why he was visiting the Defiants. All they could tell us was that he expressed an interest in examining the Khumaak and then suddenly showed up. The Angels followed shortly after.

It's a politically delicate assignment {[character]player.name}, but a pretty easy one from your end. Just fly in there, have a poke around, and bring back anything you think may be relevant to our investigations. I'll be plugged into your camera drones for this one, along with the rest of the RSS, heh. We'll tell you what to look for too, if we see anything in there. Sorry about the invasive measures, but it was either that or a 500m ISK collateral to the RSS.
messages.zh:
好啦，我和安全局的人谈过了，我的推断是正确的。现在我们要派你去行动。安全局本来还因为你想介入而威胁要除掉你，但由于他们现在是被指责方，所以也只好算了。我们要一个独立、不牵扯任何势力派别且能相信的人。很明显你就是我们要的人，我根本无需提及你的名字他们就点名要你了。

安全局已经把这代理人的工作地点给了我们。你的任务就是飞往阿拉库古星系去调查那地点。我们希望获得任何能揭示这人为什么要去拜访挑战者组织的线索。安全局只告诉我们这家伙对研究库马克很有兴趣，然后就突然冒出来了。之后没一会儿天使就出现了。

这是项政治敏感任务，{[character]player.name}，不过对你来说这事很简单。飞过去，看一下，带回任何你觉得能对我们调查有所帮助的物品。我与安全局的人都会连上你的摄像无人机。如果那里确实有东西，我们就告诉你应该搜索什么。很不好意思用这么私密的手段，但如果不这样做的话，你就得向安全局交纳5亿星币的押金。

messages.en:
Excellent work out there, {[character]player.name}. We're making copies of the data you recovered now. It looks like we'll have more than enough here to work from.

From first impressions, it looks like this RSS agent was working almost entirely alone on some operation involving a highly-placed Ammatar defector and the Wildfire Khumaak. The RSS people here with me are claiming they've never heard of this matter before. I'm seeing reports here to suggest that this Ammatar “sister” was a source for historical information on the Wildfire.

I don't like the name of that RSS operation though, {[character]player.name}. Stillwater? That's basically the opposite of “Wildfire”. We should be careful not to trust the RSS too much on this one, I think.

In fact, I have an idea. I'll speak with you again after I've made a few arrangements with the RSS.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。我们正在复制你拿到的数据。看样子接下来我们会有很多事要做。

初步来看，这个安全局的代理人几乎是单枪匹马地在执行一项牵涉艾玛达投靠者与野火库马克的任务，那投靠者原是艾玛达的一位高层人物。我这里的安全局的人都声称对此事闻所未闻。从我拿到的报告来看，这艾玛达“修女”好像知道野火库马克的历史。

但我不喜欢安全局的人搅合其中，{[character]player.name}。你以为让安全局的人参与进来一切就真的能平静如水了？你要记住，水克火，更能灭“野火”，让安全局插手此事结果肯定南辕北辙。我觉得我们不能在这件事情上太相信安全局的人。

其实我有个想法。让我先和安全局安排一下，之后我再找你。

messages.en: Really? I didn't see that one coming…alright then {[character]player.name}. I guess you have other things that need doing. Later then.
messages.zh: 你没开玩笑？我真没想到竟然会这样……算了，{[character]player.name}。我猜你也有你自己的事要照顾。后会有期。

messages.en: Perhaps less is known about the Republic Security Services than any other national intelligence agency in the universe of New Eden. Their numbers, their spheres of operation, the scope of their involvement in affairs national and international: all these things are hidden in a fog of silence and misdirection. In the absence of concrete recorded information, the only detectable pattern is composed of reports from those few times the agency has revealed itself. Pieced together, a picture begins to emerge: grim, humorless, determined and fierce, these men and women stalk the underworld and mingle with its demons so their brethren may live in the sunshine.
messages.zh: 在这世界上，或许没有一个国家情报机构像共和国安全局那样被人知之甚少。他们的情报人员总数、行动领域及在国际国内事务上的参与度——这些都被笼罩在团团迷雾之中。该机构没有具体的记录档案，唯一的线索也只能从该机构少有的露面记载中获得。把这些稀罕的线索拼凑起来，该机构给人的印象就是：严肃、无幽默感、坚定及犀利。机构的情报人员渗入黑社会，与流氓地痞打成一片，为的是能让那些善良的人们安心地活在阳光的照耀之下。

messages.en: The Republic Security Services
messages.zh: 共和国安全局

messages.en:
Alright, we've talked it out and I was right. You're going in there. The RSS almost threatened to have you killed for attempting it, but with the accusations being leveled at them right now they're just gonna have to get over it. We needed someone independent, not tied to any one faction, and who we knew we could trust. You were the obvious answer; I didn't even have to suggest it.

The RSS has given us the location of the compound where this agent was doing his work. Your task will be to fly to Alakgur and investigate it. We're looking for anything that would give us further insight into why he was visiting the Defiants. All they could tell us was that he expressed an interest in examining the Khumaak and then suddenly showed up. The Angels followed shortly after.

It's a politically delicate assignment {[character]player.name}, but a pretty easy one from your end. Just fly in there, have a poke around, and bring back anything you think may be relevant to our investigations. I'll be plugged into your camera drones for this one, along with the rest of the RSS, heh. We'll tell you what to look for too, if we see anything in there. Sorry about the invasive measures, but it was either that or a 500m ISK collateral to the RSS.

You down for this?
messages.zh:
好啦，我和安全局的人谈过了，我的推断是正确的。现在我们要派你去行动。安全局本来还因为你想介入而威胁要除掉你，但由于他们现在是被指责方，所以也只好算了。我们要一个独立、不牵扯任何势力派别且能相信的人。很明显你就是我们要的人，我根本无需提及你的名字他们就点名要你了。

安全局已经把这代理人的工作地点给了我们。你的任务就是飞往阿拉库古星系去调查那地点。我们希望获得任何能揭示这人为什么要去拜访挑战者组织的线索。安全局只告诉我们这家伙对研究库马克很有兴趣，然后就突然冒出来了。之后没一会儿天使就出现了。

这是项政治敏感任务，{[character]player.name}，不过对你来说这事很简单。飞过去，看一下，带回任何你觉得能对我们调查有所帮助的物品。我与安全局的人都会连上你的摄像无人机。如果那里确实有东西，我们就告诉你应该搜索什么。很不好意思用这么私密的手段，但如果不这样做的话，你就得向安全局交纳5亿星币的押金。

你答应干吗？

messages.en: Man…alright…but damn, you're lucky I talked the RSS outta that 500m ISK collateral. Sheesh.
messages.zh: 啊……算了算了，要不是我费了点唇舌之力，你现在就要将5亿星币白送给安全局了。哼。

messages.en: You should head out to Alakgur as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 你应该尽快前往阿拉库古。

messages.en: Rahsa Teff's fate was decided.
messages.zh: 睿萨·特夫的命运已定。

messages.en: Aralin Jick ponders the fate of Rahsa Teff.
messages.zh: 阿拉林·基可正在思量睿萨·特夫接下来的命运。

messages.en: Now that we have Rahsa Teff in custody, the question is what to do with him. We could keep him around for more questioning, but I'd just as soon blow him out the airlock. What do you think? Is his life worth it?
messages.zh: 现在睿萨·特夫已被我们扣押，接下来的问题就是如何处置他。我们可以把他留着以备进一步审问，但我更想现在就把他踢出这密封舱门。你有什么想法？这家伙命值得留吗？

messages.en:
So this man, Rahsa Teff, was behind it all. Rahsa Teff was a native to this region and wanted Miyan out. He knew his Sansha buddies were attracting attention, so he used Jariza to pull funds from Darabi. Rahsa then gave the money to Manik to fund his little mercenary gang. Manik's build up was a distraction the whole time, as were the Amarr ships you encountered when chasing Rahsa down.

Now that we have Rahsa Teff in my custody, the question is what to do with him. We could keep him around for more questioning, but I'd just as soon blow him out the airlock. What do you think? Is his life worth it?
messages.zh:
这个叫睿萨·特夫的家伙是整个事件的幕后黑手。他是本地人，想把米雅安赶出去。他知道大家都把注意力投到了其萨沙同僚身上，因此他乘机利用札力萨从德拉比那儿取钱。睿萨然后把钱给了马尼克，让他用在自己那支小规模的雇佣兵队伍上。其实马尼克的招兵买马行动与你在追击睿萨时碰到的那群艾玛舰船一样，都是用来转移人们视线的。

现在睿萨·特夫已被我们扣押，接下来的问题就是如何处置他。我们可以把他留着以备进一步审问，但我更想现在就把他踢出这密封舱门。你有什么想法？这家伙命值得留吗？

messages.en: Good guys. If you see this text in-game, defect it.
messages.zh: Good guys. If you see this text in-game, defect it.

messages.en: Bad guys. If you see this text in-game, defect it.
messages.zh: Bad guys. If you see this text in-game, defect it.

messages.en: You were sent to arrest Harkan before any more damage was done, but the traitor apparently committed suicide by destroying his own home upon your arrival.
messages.zh: 乘坏事还未发生之前，你被派去抓捕哈坎。但这叛徒在你刚赶到时就炸毁自己的居所自尽了。

messages.en: You are to arrest Harkan before he gets away.
messages.zh: 你要在哈坎逃脱之前抓获他。

messages.en: Be careful on this. Harkan has certainly already learned about the Rahsa trap. He is a skilled military commander and will most likely not go down without a fight.
messages.zh: 请前往哈坎的居所将其逮捕。你要小心。他应该已经知道了睿萨遭遇的陷阱。哈坎是位久经沙场的司令，不大会缴械投降的。

messages.en: Go to Harkan's manor and place him under arrest. Be careful on this. Harkan has certainly already learned about the Rahsa trap. He is a skilled military commander and will most likely not go down without a fight.
messages.zh: 请前往哈坎的居所将其逮捕。你要小心。他应该已经知道了睿萨遭遇的陷阱。哈坎是位久经沙场的司令，不大会缴械投降的。

messages.en:
No! We were so close.

He knew we were coming for him. By killing himself before we could make an arrest, he's effectively secured his legacy before it could be tarnished. No one will sully the name of a dead hero, guilty or not.
messages.zh:
唉！我们差点就抓住他了。

他知道我们去抓他。他这样自尽其实是保住了自己生前的名声。不管一个英雄生前是否有罪，只要死了，就没人再会去追究。

messages.en: Harkan was too daunting for you?
messages.zh: 哈坎把你吓倒了吗？

messages.en: Commodore Harkan is an old guard of the Kor-Azor family. After multiple tours with the Imperial Navy, he became the chief security officer for House Miyan. In his decades of service, he has only had one blemish. In YC 109, he led Miyan's forces into battle against those of Lord Darabi in Fensi, a battle which he lost when Miyan surrendered. Harkan's big mistake was objecting to Miyan's surrender in public. It was not long after that Harkan retired.
messages.zh: 哈坎司令是柯埃佐家族的老保镖。在帝国海军里服役多年之后，他当上了米雅安皇族的警卫队长。在其数十年的职业生涯中，他只犯过一次错误。新伊甸纪元109年，他率领着米雅安的部队与德拉比大人的部队在芬斯短兵相接，战斗最后以米雅安的投降告终。哈坎的错误就是当众反抗米雅安的投降命令。后来没多久他就告老还乡了。

messages.en: Terrus Harkan
messages.zh: 特里斯·哈坎

messages.en: Harkan must be dealt with immediately. His knowledge of Kor-Azor security and security codes make him a serious threat. I'll contact Kandus Sandar to get the MIO moving. Right now you need to arrest Harkan. He was granted a small fief upon his retirement. You have a good chance of catching him there.
messages.zh: 我们必须立刻处理哈坎这个人。他对柯埃佐的安全形势了如指掌，同时也掌握了该地区的安全码，这人对我们有潜在的威胁。我会与堪都司·杉达尔联系让内务部行动起来。现在你要做的就是去逮捕哈坎。他离退时获得了一片田地，去那儿应该有八九不离十的把握抓到他。

messages.en: You can't let Harkan get away with this.
messages.zh: 你不能让哈坎就这样溜了。

messages.en: Riff Hebian was informed of Harkan's death.
messages.zh: 里夫·赫比安获悉了哈坎的死讯。

messages.en: Riff Hebian must be informed of Harkan's death.
messages.zh: 里夫·赫比安必须知道哈坎的死讯。

messages.en: Hebian is on patrol in the Palas system. Godspeed.
messages.zh: 赫比安在帕拉斯星系巡逻。祝你顺利找到他。

messages.en: You must inform Riff Hebian of Harkan's demise. He was very fond of the man, so he should be informed personally. He can be found patrolling the Palas system in his battleship.
messages.zh: 你必须把哈坎的死讯告诉里夫·赫比安。赫比安对哈坎很赏识，所以你应当面告知他。他正驾驶着战列舰在帕拉斯星系巡逻，你去那儿找他吧。

messages.en: We weren't done yet.
messages.zh: 我们之间的事还没完。

messages.en: In Harkan's final years, he became a vocal critic of current Amarr slavery techniques. Though still in favor of slave labor, Harkan argued that the Empire's reliance on old methods of control such as Vitoc were too limiting. His views were cemented after the Elder invasion, which saw millions of slaves violently rebelling after they were freed of their Vitoc dependency. Harkan left the public eye after an outburst against Empress Jamyl's emancipation of ninth generation slaves cost him the favor of local Holders.
messages.zh: 在哈坎晚年时期，他对目前艾玛在用的奴役手段提出了激烈批评。虽然哈坎依旧支持这一制度，但他认为艾玛过度依赖崴砣柯之类药物实施操控的做法具有极大的局限性。当数百万劳工戒掉崴砣柯发动暴力反抗，也就是在长老会侵略之后，哈坎更加坚信了自己的这一观点。在公开表示对贾米尔女王释放第九代劳工这一做法不满之后，哈坎丧失了当地贵族的支持，之后便消失于公众的视野。

messages.en: Harkan's Short Political Career
messages.zh: 哈坎短暂的政治生涯

messages.en: You must inform Riff Hebian of Harkan's demise. He was very fond of the man, so he should be informed personally.
messages.zh: 你必须把哈坎的死讯告诉里夫·赫比安。赫比安对哈坎很赏识，所以你应当面告知他。

messages.en: We weren't done yet.
messages.zh: 我们之间的事还没完。

messages.en: Hebian can be found patrolling the Palas system in his battleship.
messages.zh: 他正驾驶着战列舰在帕拉斯星系巡逻，你去那儿找他吧。

messages.en: What was believed to be the last remnant of Rahsa's forces attacked a House Miyan outpost. After engaging the enemy the Sansha ran, revealing themselves to be a diversion.
messages.zh: 睿萨的部队袭击了米雅安皇族的一座哨站，我们认为那些是睿萨的残留部队。可是在与他们交火之后，他们就跑了。很明显这是个调转我们注意力的计划。

messages.en: The last remnant of Rahsa's forces are attacking a Miyan outpost.
messages.zh: 睿萨的余孽正在袭击米雅安的一座哨站。

messages.en: Get to it.
messages.zh: 快行动起来。

messages.en:
Only one task remains. With the destruction of their base and the deaths of Rahsa and now Harkan, the remaining Sansha are panicking. They're throwing a last ditch assault at one of Miyan's facilities. Miyan's perfectly safe. Per our heightened security measures, I've sent him to a hidden safe house.

The Sansha attacked my Holder and corrupted my predecessor. Annihilate them.
messages.zh:
现在只剩一件事要做。由于萨沙的基地被摧毁，紧接着睿萨和哈坎也相继死亡，萨沙他们开始慌了。他们试图袭击米雅安的一座设施以作最后挣扎。米雅安君王本人现在非常安全。我们现在加强了安保措施，我已经把他送到了一个离这儿很远的安全住所。

萨沙袭击我主，腐化我前辈，你要把他们统统除掉。

messages.en: God damn him! It was all a ruse!
messages.zh: 靠！原来是声东击西啊！

messages.en: I, too, am tired of the Sansha's meddling, but I have a job to do.
messages.zh: 我也对萨沙的介入感到厌烦了，但我必须完成我的工作。

messages.en:
Lady Jariza is under investigation for her role in all of this, but the only charge we could actually bring is conspiracy. And accusing a noble of conspiracy is about as useful as charging a Slaverhound with indecent exposure. It's the nature of the beast.

Lord Darabi has been cleared of any wrong doing. His daughter Mina has returned to their estate and is taking a larger role in family affairs.

Lord Manik and Lord Miyan reached a gentleman's agreement after the destruction of Manik's mercenary fleet. A number of Manik's agricultural worlds have been given as a gift to House Miyan. Lord Miyan accepted the gift, and has declared a clean slate between them.
messages.zh:
因其在整起事件中的角色，札力萨女士正在接受调查。但我们实际上也只能以阴谋罪指控她。指控一名贵族策划阴谋就像指控奴役犬没穿裤子一样，这是他们的本性。

德拉比大人被查出没有违规之处。其女儿米娜已经回到了他们的居所，在家族事务中有了更大的发言权。马尼克的雇佣军被消灭之后，他与德拉比大人已经达成了君子协定。马尼克将其众多农业领土赠给了米雅安皇族。米雅安大人对此欣然接受，称双方之间已经扯平。

messages.en: Loose Ends
messages.zh: 未尽之事

messages.en:
I have to apologize to you for my skepticism of your aims earlier. We've been increasing our security since the attack on Miyan's manor. But we never imagined one of our own was a threat. You have to understand that many of us have nothing but reverence for the Commodore. To find out he was a traitor...

But he's gone. The task of judgment is out of our hands now.

Only one task remains. With the destruction of their base and the deaths of Rahsa and now Harkan, the remaining Sansha are panicking. They're throwing a last ditch assault at one of Miyan's facilities. Lord Miyan himself is perfectly safe. Per our heightened security measures, I've sent him to a hidden safe house far from there.

The Sansha attacked my Lord and corrupted my predecessor. Annihilate them.
messages.zh:
我为之前怀疑你的动机表示道歉。自从米雅安的居所遭袭之后，我们就加强了防卫措施，但我们万万没有料到自己人当中竟然有一个会对我们产生威胁。我们很多人对司令都只有钦佩之情，可没想到他竟然是个叛徒……

他已经死了，我们不必再对他做是非评价。

现在只剩一件事要做。由于萨沙的基地被摧毁，紧接着睿萨和哈坎也相继死亡，萨沙他们开始慌了。他们试图袭击米雅安大人的一座设施以作最后挣扎。米雅安大人本人现在非常安全。我们现在加强了安保措施，我已经把他送到了一个离这儿很远的安全住所。

萨沙袭击我主，腐化我前辈，你要把他们统统除掉。

messages.en: I, too, am tired of the Sansha's meddling, but I have a job to do.
messages.zh: 我也对萨沙的介入感到厌烦了，但我必须完成我的工作。

messages.en: Are the Sansha finally defeated?
messages.zh: 萨沙被击败了吗？

messages.en: Lord Harkan emerged alive after all, and launched a surprise assault on Lord Miyan's safe house. You bravely broke through the corrupted defenses and turncoats. The traitor Harkan fell to your superior flying, allowing Lord Miyan to continue his rightful rule.
messages.zh: 哈坎大人还是活着现身了，并对米雅安大人的居所发动了一次突袭。你勇闯由投靠敌方的守卫组成的防御线。叛徒哈坎终于倒在你的枪下，米雅安大人得以延续正统。

messages.en: Lord Miyan's safe house is besieged by Harkan's forces.
messages.zh: 米雅安大人的居所正遭到哈坎部队的围攻。

messages.en:
Find Miyan's safe house in the Choga system. Consider every Amarr ship you find a traitor.

Be careful. Harkan is a fierce military commander.
messages.zh:
去查欧加星系找米雅安的居所。把你碰到的每艘艾玛舰船都当作叛徒。

请小心，哈坎是个凶猛的军事指挥家。

messages.en: Lord Harkan has launched an attack on Lord Miyan's safe house! He's bypassed automated defenses and has turned several of Miyan's security forces against their Lord. I can only trust you to aid Lord Miyan.
messages.zh: 哈坎大人对米雅安大人的居所发动了一场袭击！他闯过了自动防御系统，并策反了米雅安部队中的部分人倒戈。我现在只能相信你去救米雅安大人了。

messages.en:
Lord Miyan is safe. The political situation is returning to what passes for normal.

The few remnants of the Sansha forces are fleeing back to Stain. The crews of the Amarr ships that joined Harkan's failed rebellion have been stripped of their ranks and any titles. Their commanders have the Empress' justice to look forward to.

As for Harkan himself? His death allowed him to escape temporal justice. His name is being stripped from the Miyan records of service. My lord's men are tracking down Harkan's kin to end his line. In a generation, when the living memory of Harkan's betrayal fades with us, there will be no sign of Harkan's passing.

You, {[character]player.name}, will be remembered long after this. I envy your Capsuleer lifespan, and pray you continue your good works in the name of the Empire for years to come.
messages.zh:
米雅安大人没事了。政治形势也在恢复正常。

萨沙所剩无几的残余部队向混浊星域逃去了。那些参与哈坎反叛行动的艾玛船员已经被剥夺了军衔与称号。他们的指挥官将面临女皇的裁决。

至于哈坎，他的死将使他免于世俗的审判，但他的名字今后将不再出现在米雅安王族的档案里。我主手下的人正在追捕其亲眷将其满门抄斩。当过一代时光过去之后，当哈坎背叛的事迹在我们的记忆中慢慢消褪以后，这世界上不会再有哈坎逝去的迹象。

{[character]player.name}，你从今以后将被人牢记。我真羡慕你们克隆飞行员的生命周期，但愿你未来几年里能以帝国的名义继续你的出色表现。

messages.en: The situation is too dire for me to waste time on a quitter.
messages.zh: 形势紧迫，容不得我在一个逃兵身上浪费时间。

messages.en:
Harkan's not dead! He's just launched an attack on Lord Miyan's safe house! Lord Miyan is in danger!

He's already broken past the main acceleration gate. Harkan knows our systems inside out. Our automated defenses are useless. Worse, I've reports that several of our own security forces are helping him!

The safe house is in Choga. I need your help to rescue Miyan from Harkan's forces. I can't rely on my own security forces, because I don't know how many more will turn.
messages.zh:
哈坎没死！他刚刚袭击了米雅安大人的避难所！米雅安大人处境危险！

哈坎已经冲破了主加速轨道，他对我们的系统了如指掌，我们的自动防御系统毫无用处。更糟的是，有报告说我们还有内奸协助他！

避难所位于查欧加。我需要你帮忙将米雅安救出来。我自己的人都靠不住，谁知道接下来又会有谁叛变。

messages.en: The situation is too dire for me to waste time on a quitter.
messages.zh: 形势紧迫，容不得我在一个逃兵身上浪费时间。

messages.en: Is Lord Miyan safe?
messages.zh: 米雅安大人没事了吗？

messages.en:
Sinas wanted me to use the Federation Navy ID tag I recovered to infiltrate a Gallente prison and liberate the Caldari being held there. After some time scanning, I discovered the compound and managed to slip past the outer defenses and inside.

What I saw was rows of prisons, each of them dividing Caldari P.O.W into their corporate families. The Ishukone prison was empty. After evacuating just one of the prisons, self-destruct timers initiated on the rest. This wasn't a rescue mission, it was a mercy killing.
messages.zh:
塞纳斯要我利用取回的联邦海军ID铭牌潜入他们的一座牢狱并救出关押在其中的加达里人。一番扫描之后，我发现了那座牢狱并躲过那里的守备部队溜了进去。

里面都是一排排监牢，每一排按军团归类囚禁着加达里的士兵。异株湖集团的那一排里空无一人。在我救出其中一排人之后，定时炸弹引爆了其他监牢。这不是营救行动，而是带有可怜性质的加害。

messages.en: Now that I have recovered a Federation Navy ID tag, Sinas wants me to use it to infiltrate one of their prisons and liberate the Caldari being held there. I'm told that the facility is hidden somewhere in the Aokinen constellation, but where exactly, he doesn't know.
messages.zh: 由于我已经取回了联邦海军的ID铭牌，塞纳斯要我潜入他们的一座牢狱救出关押在其中的加达里人。听说那牢狱藏在奥吉能星座某处，但具体地点塞纳斯也不知道。

messages.en: Excellent, our Black Ops wing will stand down and let you proceed. I'll issue any further instructions over comms as the need arises. Good luck.
messages.zh: 太好了，我们的黑隐舰队会后撤让你前进。一有情况我就会通过通信器对你进行指挥。祝你好运。

messages.en:
It's time for you to put that ID tag to use and see firsthand what it is we're fighting against down here. We've been receiving reports of a new prison facility being erected somewhere in the Aokinen constellation.

Your mission is to discover the prison's location, bypass the security forces and slip inside. Once you've made your way through there will be people of ours to free. Your only concern is saving them. If you can expedite their recovery by avoiding conflicts in the outer perimeter then you should do so. Our priority is our people, above all else.

If you've never done any exploratory scanning before, then now would be a good time to learn. The Federation is skilled at hiding their secrets, but I have a feeling that a facility this size will be found easily enough. If you can't find it at first, don't lose hope - that's exactly what the enemy wants us to do.

You will need a Data Analyzer to complete this mission.
messages.zh:
现在是你使用那ID铭牌，去亲自看看我们所面对的敌人的时候了。我们接到一个报告说奥吉能星座某处新蹦出一座牢狱。

你的任务就是找到那牢狱，躲过那里的保安然后溜进去。你进去之后就去救那里被关押着的我们的人。你把人救出来就行，其他别管。如果你觉得你能躲过外围一圈保安，那最好。我们的目的是救人，其他都是次要的。

如果你以前从未进行过探查性的扫描工作，那这次你就有机会好好练一下了。虽然盖伦特很擅长隐秘工作，但我想这样大的一个牢狱应该还是比较好找的。如果你一开始找不到，别气馁——敌人就是要让我们气馁。

你需要一个数据分析仪才能完成此任务。

messages.en:
You did well, {[character]player.name}, despite the circumstances. I hope this operation has opened your eyes to the truth of this war.

The empty Ishukone facility you discovered is the strongest proof yet that there is something going on here. I'm beginning to see it in a new light, too. I hate to say it, but my suspicion is that Ishukone has some kind of prisoner exchange program with the Federation. It's the only explanation that accounts for everything I've seen so far.

Stick around, {[character]player.name}. I have another lead that you can follow up for me.
messages.zh:
在这么不容易的情况下你也把事情办好了，不错，{[character]player.name}。但愿这次行动让你看清了这场战争的真相。

你看到的那座空无一人的异株湖监牢是迄今为止整个事件存有蹊跷最有力的证明。我也开始从新一个角度看清了这件事。虽然不想说，但我还是觉得异株湖集团与盖伦特联邦之间达成了种囚禁士兵交换协议。只有这样才能解释我已目睹的一切。

请别走，{[character]player.name}。我还有一个线索要你去追查。

messages.en: Then our time together is over, {[character]player.name}. I need people who can commit.
messages.zh: 那咱们的合作就到此为止了，{[character]player.name}。我需要能付出的人。

messages.en:
“Look at each other,” Cold Wind told them. “How do you tell one man from the other? How do you know which man to kill?”

The men struggled to stand up and looked at their armors; the symbols of their Houses were torn and broken, not visible anymore.

“No two men on this field have the same face, but can you tell them apart now?”

The men gazed at each other trying to distinguish brothers from enemies, yet the blood covering their faces made all of them alike.
messages.zh:
“看看对方，”“冷风”对他们说。“你们还能相互辨认吗？你们还知道要对付谁吗？”

那些人艰难地站了起来，互视对方的盔甲；他们的团徽已经破损，再也看不见。

“这地上没有两个人的脸是一模一样的，但你们现在还能看出谁是谁吗？”

他们瞅着对方，试图辨别出敌友，但遍布脸庞的血迹让他们看似就像一个人。

messages.en: Two Bloodlines, one Race: the Raata spirit in the Deteis and Civire soul
messages.zh: 一族两类：蒂泰斯人与赛维勒人心中都具有拉塔精神。

messages.en:
It's time for you to put that ID tag to use and see firsthand what it is we're fighting against down here.

Though you've no doubt heard of the fearless and capable pilots in the Caldari Militia, I wouldn't make the mistake of thinking that the situation in Black Rise is a stable one. The region is a war-zone, and will probably remain that way for some time. Even though they're capsuleers like you, our militia cannot be everywhere at once, and it is in their absence that the Federation often makes progress.

We've been receiving reports of a new prison facility being erected somewhere in the Aokinen constellation. Your mission is to discover its location, bypass the security forces and slip inside. Once you've made your way inside, there will be people of ours to free. My suspicion though, is that you will not find any Ishukone crew to rescue. I suppose we'll see what happens.

If you've never done any exploratory scanning before, then now would be a good time to learn. The Federation is skilled at hiding their secrets, but I have a feeling that a facility this size will be found easily enough. If you are struggling to locate it, don't lose hope - that's exactly what the enemy wants us to do.

You will need a Data Analyzer to complete this mission.

What do you say, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh:
现在是你使用那ID铭牌，去亲自看看我们所面对的敌人的时候了。

尽管你肯定听说过加达里国民卫队中都是一帮不怕死有本事的飞行员，但我不以为暗涌之域已经被他们摆平了。那地方是个战场，而且这仗还有得打。虽然国民卫队的士兵都是像你一样的克隆飞行员，但你无法要求他们一下子出现在所有地方，而盖伦特人就钻了此空子。

我们接到一个报告说奥吉能星座某处新蹦出一座牢狱。你的任务就是找到它，躲过那里的保安然后溜进去。你进去之后就去救那里被关押着的我们的人。我担心的是你找不到任何异株湖的人可救。还是让我们等着瞧吧。

如果你以前从未进行过探查性的扫描工作，那这次你就有机会好好练一下了。虽然盖伦特很擅长隐秘工作，但我想这样大的一个牢狱应该还是比较好找的。如果你找不到那地方，别气馁——敌人就是要让我们气馁。

你需要一个数据分析仪才能完成此任务。

怎么说，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Then our time together is over, {[character]player.name}. I need people who can commit.
messages.zh: 那咱们的合作就到此为止了，{[character]player.name}。我需要能付出的人。

messages.en: Have you discovered the prison facility yet?
messages.zh: 你找到那牢狱了吗？

name.ru: Слухи о заговоре (Whisper of a Conspiracy)

messages.en:
Sinas is growing increasingly convinced the Ishukone have some kind of prisoner exchange arrangement with the Federation. He told me that Ishukone diplomatic vessels were spotted in Black Rise and tailed by Caldari Navy forces. One such diplomat vanished into an old research compound riddled with electromagnetic interference – the perfect place to hold a meeting without anyone tapping into your conversation.

I was asked to investigate the area and report back on anything I found inside. There wasn't much to be found there and the place was empty, but I did uncover a data node. Strangely enough, it used proprietary encryption software that appeared to be a mixture of Gallentean and Caldari designs. Sinas is going to arrange to have it decoded, after which he'll likely want me for another mission.
messages.zh:
塞纳斯越发相信异株湖集团与盖伦特联邦之间签署了某种战俘交换协议。他告诉我他们在暗涌之域中发现了异株湖的舰船，并派加达里海军尾随盯梢了他们。其中一艘异株湖的舰船摆脱了追踪，进入了一座有干扰电磁场保护的研究基地——对于不想让别人窃听其谈话内容的人而言，这是个畅所欲言的场所。

我被要求调查那地方，报告任何我在那里听闻到的事物。那地方空空荡荡，没什么东西，不过我确实发现了一个数据节点。奇怪的是，该数据的加密方式是一种利用了盖伦特与加达里各自加密方式的组合加密手段。塞纳斯将找人对其进行破解，破解之后他可能要派给我下一个任务。

messages.en: Sinas is becoming increasingly convinced the Ishukone have some kind of prisoner exchange arrangement with the Federation. He told me that Ishukone diplomatic vessels were spotted in Black Rise and tailed by Caldari Navy forces. One such diplomat vanished into an old research compound riddled with electromagnetic interference – the perfect place to hold a meeting without anyone tapping into your conversation. I've been asked to investigate this area and report back on anything I can find inside.
messages.zh: 塞纳斯越发相信异株湖集团与盖伦特联邦之间签署了某种战俘交换协议。他告诉我他们在暗涌之域中发现了异株湖的舰船，并派加达里海军尾随盯梢了他们。其中一艘异株湖的舰船摆脱了追踪，进入了一座有干扰电磁场保护的研究基地——对于不想让别人窃听其谈话内容的人而言，这是个畅所欲言的场所。我被要求调查那地方，报告任何我在那里听闻到的事物。

messages.en:
I knew you'd say yes.

I'm not sure how to advise you here, {[character]player.name}, but my suspicion is that this will rely more on scouting and less on combat, so perhaps a small and agile frigate is in order. We just have no idea what's in there though, I'm afraid, so there's no hard intel to support that assumption.
messages.zh:
我就知道你会答应的。

我不知道该怎么指导你，{[character]player.name}，但我想此项任务并不怎么需要战斗，更多还是要侦察，因此一艘灵活机动的护卫舰应该可以胜任。不过我们恐怕对那儿到底有些什么一无所知，因此并没有可靠情报可证明你驾驶护卫舰去那儿是万无一失的。

messages.en:
It seems Ishukone are playing a dangerous game here, {[character]player.name}. Before we make any moves though, we have to be absolutely certain that things actually are what they look like. I need you for another infiltration mission.

We've been monitoring the movement of selected Ishukone vessels over the last few days. Our focus is on the handful of diplomatic emissaries they've deployed inside Black Rise. Why does Ishukone have diplomats down here? We wondered the same thing, and that's why we had them followed.

While tracking one particular Ishukone vessel, our surveillance team lost them. They appear to have warped into a derelict research facility, conveniently located inside an area riddled with electromagnetic interference. Now, it's quite possible that their actions were entirely legitimate. We just don't know though, I ordered my men not to pursue.

Your task is to investigate this area and uncover anything you can to shed more light on Ishukone's recent actions. You will most probably only need a frigate for this, but we obviously have no intel to guide you one way or the other.
messages.zh:

不过在追踪其中一艘异株湖舰船的时候，我们把它给弄丢了。那船好像跃迁进了一个被废弃的研究所，那里被干扰电磁场包围着，对它十分有利。当然了，他们的行为完全合法也是有可能的。但我们就是不确定，我让我的人停止了追击。

messages.en:

哦，你拿到了一个加密的数据芯片，这加密方式好像还是加达里与盖伦特自主方式的集成品。光从这一点看，事情已经豁然开朗了许多，但我还不忙着下结论，我一定要等到把这数据芯片破解才行。

请稍等，让我与我妹妹托哈通个气。她能向卡僧哨个口信，让其知道我们需要一个能破解此芯片的人。我很快就回来，{[character]player.name}，请少安毋躁。

messages.en: I'll find someone else then. Thank you for all you did for us, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 那我就另寻他人。谢谢你为我们所做的一切，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you been to the meeting place yet?

name.ru: Слухи о заговоре (Whisper of a Conspiracy)

messages.en:
Sinas is growing increasingly convinced the Ishukone have some kind of prisoner exchange arrangement with the Federation. He told me that Ishukone diplomatic vessels were spotted in Black Rise and tailed by Caldari Navy forces. One such diplomat vanished into an old research compound riddled with electromagnetic interference – the perfect place to hold a meeting without anyone tapping into your conversation.

I was asked to investigate the area and report back on anything I found inside. There wasn't much to be found there and the place was empty, but I did uncover a data node. Strangely enough, it used proprietary encryption software that appeared to be a mixture of Gallentean and Caldari designs. Sinas is going to arrange to have it decoded, after which he'll likely want me for another mission.
messages.zh:
塞纳斯越发相信异株湖集团与盖伦特联邦之间签署了某种战俘交换协议。他告诉我他们在暗涌之域中发现了异株湖的舰船，并派加达里海军尾随盯梢了他们。其中一艘异株湖的舰船摆脱了追踪，进入了一座有干扰电磁场保护的研究基地——对于不想让别人窃听其谈话内容的人而言，这是个畅所欲言的场所。

我被要求调查那地方，报告任何我在那里听闻到的事物。那地方空空荡荡，没什么东西，不过我确实发现了一个数据节点。奇怪的是，该数据的加密方式是一种利用了盖伦特与加达里各自加密方式的组合加密手段。塞纳斯将找人对其进行破解，破解之后他可能要派给我下一个任务。

messages.en:

messages.zh:
我就知道你会答应的。

我不知道该怎么指导你，{[character]player.name}，但我想此项任务并不怎么需要战斗，更多还是要侦察，因此一艘灵活机动的护卫舰应该可以胜任。不过我们恐怕对那儿到底有些什么一无所知，因此并没有可靠情报可证明你驾驶护卫舰去那儿是万无一失的。

name.de: Der Schwere oder der Leichte Weg
name.ja: なだらかな道か、いばらの道か
name.ru: На распутье (The High or Low Road)

messages.en: I was given a choice: Go to the Feds, or go to the media.
messages.zh: 我面前有两条路：要么去联邦那里，要么就去媒体那儿。

messages.en: I have two options ahead of me: Go to the Feds, or go to the media.
messages.zh: 我面前有两条路：要么去联邦那里，要么就去媒体那儿。

messages.en: Very well.
messages.zh: 很好。

messages.en: There are two ways we can go about this situation, {[character]player.name}. The Regional Director has instructed me to offer you these two options. He would like you to know that this is a very important decision; he would also like to wish you good luck in your choice.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，针对目前的情况，我们有两条路可选。区域主管告诉我要让你自行做出决定。他希望你明白这将是项非常重要的决定；同时也祝愿你无论做出怎样的决定都能平安顺利。

messages.en: There are two ways we can go about this situation, {[character]player.name}. The Regional Director has instructed me to offer you these two options. He would like you to know that this is a very important decision; he would also like to wish you good luck in your choice.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，针对目前的情况，我们有两条路可选。区域主管告诉我要让你自行做出决定。他希望你明白这将是项非常重要的决定；同时也祝愿你无论做出怎样的决定都能平安顺利。

messages.en:
Due to the serious nature of this situation, our Regional Director greatly suggests contacting the authorities for further assistance. The FIO have a very strong presence in the area, and the Black Eagles have been extremely helpful to us in the past. I recommend talking to Mourmarie Mone, the Constellation Director for the Black Eagles. She is located in Noghere. Here are the coordinates of her office.

Good luck, and thank you for your continued business with Impetus.
messages.zh:
鉴于此事的严重性，我们的区域总管强力建议与政府机构联系获得帮助。联邦情报局在该地区势力很强，黑鹰过去帮了我们极大的忙。我推荐你去见黑鹰的星座总管摩尔马列·蒙。她在诺格希尔。这是她办公室的地址。

祝你好运，感谢你与促进工作继续合作。

messages.en:
Although our Regional Director would like this matter taken to the authorities, there is a more discreet option open to you in handing this delicate situation. As a universal leader in the entertainment industry, Impetus maintains many close ties with other media outlets. One of our many partners is the Scope, which has been very kind in reviewing our various blockbuster holoreels over the past few years. I can send you to Veine Coructie, a local editor for the Scope. He is very trustworthy, and he can provide a lot of information about suspicious activity in the area.

I must warn you that choosing this route will take you into low-security space. Though I do not recommend this choice, there may be more lucrative opportunities with the Scope than with the FIO. Any news agency would pay dearly for the information you have, and the Scope is without question one of the biggest news agencies around. There are more risks involved with this option, but I want to make sure you are aware of your choice.
messages.zh:
虽然我们的区域总管想让政府机构来处理此事，但你其实还能用一个更明智的做法来处理这件微妙的事情。作为娱乐界的老大，促进工业与其他许多媒体机构都有联系。其中一个便是“视角”。他们过去几年里对我们的众多大片都洋溢着赞美之辞。我现在派你去见维因·克鲁克帝，他是“视角”的一位当地编辑。他为人诚信，且能提供很多与该地区可疑状况有关的信息。

我得警告你，选这条路意味着你必将经过低安全地区。虽然我不推荐你选这条路，但“视角”提供的机会应该会比联邦情报局更诱人。任何新闻机构都会付大价钱以获取你掌握的信息，而“视角”又是其中规模最大的之一。不过希望你还是能明白，选此路风险真的很大。

messages.en: Eagle Grip
messages.zh: 鹰爪

messages.en: This situation is starting to get complicated, so I decided to go straight to the Feds. Eron Viette directed me to the Black Eagles, a relatively new division of the FIO. They have a dark reputation, but at least I know I'm covering my ass by talking to them. Wouldn't want this situation to get any worse than it already is.
messages.zh: 事情变得复杂起来，因此我决定直接去找联邦机构。厄隆·耶特建议我前往联邦情报局的一个相对新建部门，黑鹰。虽然这部门的名声不佳，但至少向他们汇报情况以后别人就再也怪不到我了。我可不想让事情变得越来越糟。

messages.en: I have reached a dead end with Impetus, so they directed me to the regional authorities, namely one Mourmarie Mone. I can't find any publicly listed file on her, but with a sensitive case such as this, it makes sense for me to go straight for the FIO. Eron has given me coordinates to Mourmarie's office; let's hope I made the right choice.
messages.zh: 我与促进工业的合作遇到了死胡同，因此他们建议我去找区域政府人员，即一个叫摩尔马列·蒙的人。虽然我没有找到任何有关她的公开资料，但鉴于目前情况的敏感性，直接去找联邦情报局还是有道理的。厄隆把她的办公室地址给了我；但愿我做出了正确决定。

messages.en: Good luck with your mission, {[character]player.name}. We appreciate your time with Impetus Development Studios. Have a good day, and remember to watch for the latest holoreel hits from Impetus, New Eden's leader in entertainment.
messages.zh: 祝你执行任务顺利，{[character]player.name}。我们感谢你抽出时间与促进工业发展电影制片厂合作。走好，记得要时刻关注促进工业的最新大片哦，我们是整个宇宙的娱乐业老大。
