messages.en: Do you need me to give you the coordinates to Mourmarie Mone again? I would be more than happy to help.
messages.zh: 你要我再给你一次摩尔马列·蒙的地址吗？我不介意的。

messages.en: Scoping the Scene
messages.zh: 勘察现场

messages.en: This situation is starting to get complicated, and I feel that this is the wrong time to go to the authorities. Eron Viette directed me to the Scope. They know the area better than anyone, probably better than the FIO. Plus, I know they can be discreet with situations like this. If nothing else, I can probably get them to pay handsomely for the information. You can always count on that.
messages.zh: 形势变得复杂起来，我觉得现在不应该去找政府。厄隆·耶特指引我去“视角”。他们比任何人、甚至比联邦情报局都要更熟悉该地区的情况。而且我知道他们对待这类事情的态度将更加灵活。即便他们不作为，那因我提供信息，他们也应会付我一大笔钞票。我对此深信不疑。

messages.en: I have reached a dead end with Impetus, so they directed me to a regional office of the Scope. Though my instincts tell me I should contact the authorities, I feel that the better option would be to keep this situation under wraps, or at least to have the option of using the media to snuff out the bad guys. This Scope office is in Vitrauze, a lowsec system. Let's hope I made the right choice.
messages.zh: 我与促进工业的合作碰到了死胡同，他们要我去“视角”的一座区域办公室。虽然我的直觉告诉我应该去找政府，但我感觉最好还是将此事包起来，至少也应留一条利用媒体揪出坏人的后路。“视角”的这座办公室在维查乌得——一个低安全星系。但愿我做出了正确的决定。

messages.en:
Although our Regional Director would like this matter taken to the authorities, there is a more discreet option for handing this delicate situation. As a universal leader in the entertainment industry, Impetus maintains many close ties with other media outlets. One of our many partners is the Scope, who has been very kind in reviewing our various blockbuster holoreels over the past few years. I can send you to Veine Coructie, a local editor for the Scope. He is very trustworthy, and he can provide a lot of information about suspicious activity in the area.

I must warn you that choosing this route will take you into low-security space. Though I do not recommend this choice, there may be more lucrative opportunities with the Scope than here with the FIO. Any news agency would pay dearly for the information you have, and the Scope is one of the biggest news agencies around. However, there are more risks involved with this option.
messages.zh:
虽然我们的区域总管想让政府机构来处理此事，但你其实还能用一个更明智的做法来处理这件微妙的事情。作为娱乐界的老大，促进工业与其他许多媒体机构都有联系。其中一个便是“视角”。他们过去几年里对我们的众多大片都洋溢着赞美之辞。我现在派你去见维因·克鲁克帝，他是“视角”的一位当地编辑。他为人诚信，且能提供很多与该地区可疑状况有关的信息。

我得警告你，选这条路意味着你必将经过低安全地区。虽然我不推荐你选这条路，但“视角”提供的机会应该会比联邦情报局更诱人。任何新闻机构都会付大价钱以获取你掌握的信息，而“视角”又是其中规模最大的之一。不过话还是要说回来，选此路风险真的很大。

messages.en: Thank you for your time, {[character]player.name}. We appreciate your continued business with Impetus Development Studios. Have a good day, and remember to watch for the latest holoreel hits from Impetus, New Eden's leader in entertainment.
messages.zh: 祝你执行任务顺利，{[character]player.name}。我们感谢你抽出时间与促进工业发展电影制片厂合作。走好，记得要时刻关注促进工业的最新大片哦，我们是整个宇宙的娱乐业老大。

messages.en:
Veine Coructie is in Vitrauze, a lowsec system of New Eden. CONCORD's presence is barely felt in that area, and pirates and other dangers lurk throughout. Be prepared for a fight while flying through lowsec.

However, the less secure the space, the more lucrative the opportunities. There are riches to be found in lowsec, if one can survive long enough to reach them.
messages.zh:
维因·克鲁克帝在一个叫“维查乌得”的低安全星系。统合部在那儿只是蜻蜓点水，那里海盗横行，危机四伏。在低安全区飞行要时刻做好迎战准备。

不过，一个地区越是不安全，那这地区蕴藏的机会越是诱人。低安全区里潜藏着黄金，但前提是你得在那里活着把它们找出来才行。

messages.en: Low-Security Space
messages.zh: 低安全地区

messages.en:
Although our Regional Director would like this matter taken to the authorities, there is a more discreet option for handing this delicate situation. As a universal leader in the entertainment industry, Impetus maintains many close ties with other media outlets. One of our many partners is the Scope, who has been very kind in reviewing our various blockbuster holoreels over the past few years. I can send you to Veine Coructie, a local editor for the Scope. He is very trustworthy, and he can provide a lot of information about suspicious activity in the area.

I must warn you that choosing this route will take you into low-security space. Though I do not recommend this choice, there may be more lucrative opportunities with the Scope than here with the FIO. Any news agency would pay dearly for the information you have, and the Scope is one of the biggest news agencies around. However, there are more risks involved with this option.
messages.zh:
虽然我们的区域总管想让政府机构来处理此事，但你其实还能用一个更明智的做法来处理这件微妙的事情。作为娱乐界的老大，促进工业与其他许多媒体机构都有联系。其中一个便是“视角”。他们过去几年里对我们的众多大片都洋溢着赞美之辞。我现在派你去见维因·克鲁克帝，他是“视角”的一位当地编辑。他为人诚信，且能提供很多与该地区可疑状况有关的信息。

我得警告你，选这条路意味着你必将经过低安全地区。虽然我不推荐你选这条路，但“视角”提供的机会应该会比联邦情报局更诱人。任何新闻机构都会付大价钱以获取你掌握的信息，而“视角”又是其中规模最大的之一。不过话还是要说回来，选此路风险真的很大。

messages.en: Thank you for your time, {[character]player.name}. We appreciate your continued business with Impetus Development Studios. Have a good day, and remember to watch for the latest holoreel hits from Impetus, New Eden's leader in entertainment.
messages.zh: 祝你执行任务顺利，{[character]player.name}。我们感谢你抽出时间与促进工业发展电影制片厂合作。走好，记得要时刻关注促进工业的最新大片哦，我们是整个宇宙的娱乐业老大。

messages.en: Do you need me to give you the coordinates to Veine Coructie again? I would be more than happy to help.
messages.zh: 你要我再给你一次维因·克鲁克帝的地址吗？我不介意的。

messages.en: My first step into the underworld produced few leads. At the insistence of Mourmarie Mone, a Black Eagle agent, I roughed up a colony of Minmatar refugees. After destroying a few of their buildings, I managed to bring out their Elder. He didn't have much to tell me, except to go look in a place called the “Underground Circus.” I've heard of this place, and Mourmarie appears to know it as well.
messages.zh: 我这次初涉黑社会几乎没有获得任何线索。在黑鹰代理人摩尔马列·蒙的要求下，我打死了一批米玛塔尔难民。在炸毁他们的几座大楼之后，他们的长老终于现身了。他没告诉我什么，只说让我去一个叫“地下马戏团”的地方。我听说过那地方，摩尔马列好像也对其有所了解。

messages.en: When stepping into the underground, you're bound to get your hands dirty. This mission is no exception. The Black Eagles asked for me to rough up a Minmatar colony, hoping that someone in there would have info on the Pator 6. These FIO agents mean business, and I don't think any of it is clean.
messages.zh: 一旦踏入黑社会，你就不得不干坏事。这次任务也不例外。黑鹰要求我捣毁一个米玛塔尔殖民地，希望那里有人能告诉我们有关帕特六人组的信息。情报局的这帮代理人可严肃了，要你干这干那，但我觉得没一件事是合法的。

messages.en: There's no room for pity when you're dealing with bottom-dwellers. The underground is a dirty, nasty place, and you have to adapt to its environments in order to destroy it. This is the price we pay for freedom, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你跟社会最底层的人打交道时可别有什么怜悯之心。他们居住的地方肮脏、混乱，要摧毁那样的地方，你也得不顾颜面，下手狠才行。这是我们为自由而必须付出的代价，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: We don't know much about this “Pator 6” gang except a few rumblings here and there. Look like we'll be fishing for information. Since it was some Minmatar thugs that took the senator's kid, I guess we'll pound some Matari heads first. This region is crawling with those people. I don't know who is a bigger drain on the Federation, the criminals or the Minmatar. There's a colony of them in Charmerout. Go in there and start shooting up buildings. Hopefully that'll scare up some leads for us. If not, well, we'll have a fewer Matari clogging up the Federation resources. Frankly, I'm fine with that.
messages.zh: 我们对帕特六人组了解不多，除了知道他们到处打群架之外，我们几乎对其一无所知。看来我们还得搜集更多的信息。鉴于这次带走参议员孩子的是一群米玛塔尔流氓，我想我们得先去问候一些玛塔利人。这地区到处都有这群人。一边是罪犯，另一边又是米玛塔尔人，我真不知道谁才是最让联邦头疼的人。查莫罗特星系里住着一群玛塔利人。你去炸掉那里的几幢大楼吓吓他们，让他们吐出些线索。如果没有……那也好，至少我们能清理掉一些吸食联邦资源的玛塔利人。说实话，我对此根本不以为然。

messages.en: Even though I feel we can't trust any information from the Matari, they're our only lead. The Underground Circus is a ruthless place, a stain on our region's image. But it's our only chance.
messages.zh: 虽然我们不能相信任何出自玛塔利人的情报，但他们是我们的唯一线索。地下马戏团是个不讲情面的地方，破坏了我们这地区的形象。不过它现在是我们唯一的机会。

messages.en: Figures that a capsuleer would balk at the first sign of danger. You're a disgrace to the Federation.
messages.zh: 我就料到你们克隆飞行员会知难而退的。你真是坍了联邦的台。

messages.en:
No time for small talk. We have a very serious situation on our hands, and I need the utmost discretion from you. That kid may be a goner if we don't act fast. Unfortunately, we don't know much about this “Pator 6” gang except for a few rumblings here and there. A lot of pirates use this area as a haven. Most of them are small-time criminals, no more than thugs looking for an easy mark. The Serpentis have some hold in this area, though I doubt we're looking at any sort of leech on the underbelly of the booster industry. No, this looks suspicious, and not like Serpentis at all. This sounds personal, or at least desperate.

Alright, so it looks like we'll be fishing for information. Since it was some Minmatar thugs that took the senator's kid, I guess we'll pound some Matari heads in first. This region is crawling with those people. I don't know who is a bigger drain on the Federation, the criminals or the Minmatar.

Anyway, there's a colony of them in Charmerout. Go in there and start shooting up buildings. Hopefully that'll scare up some leads for us. If not…well, we'll have fewer Matari clogging up the Federation resources. Frankly, I'm fine with that.
messages.zh:
没时间说闲话了。我们现在面临的形势十分严峻，我要你拎得清。如果我们不快点行动，那孩子就没了。但我们对帕特六人组了解不多，除了知道他们到处打群架之外，我们几乎对其一无所知。他们中的多数人是小喽罗，最多就是一帮想炫一下的小流氓而已。虽然天蛇在这里有一些据点，但我不认为帕特六人组在这里的目的是想分食增效剂产业大蛋糕中的一小羹。他们的行动看上去很可疑，一点都不像天蛇。他们好像是为了私人恩怨而来，拼了命似的。

这样看来我们还得搜集更多的信息。鉴于这次带走参议员孩子的是一群米玛塔尔流氓，我想我们得先去问候一些玛塔利人。这地区到处都有这群人。一边是罪犯，另一边又是米玛塔尔人，我真不知道谁才是最让联邦头疼的人。

算了，不去谈那个问题了。查莫罗特星系里住着一群玛塔利人。你去炸掉那里的几幢大楼吓吓他们，让他们吐出些线索。如果没有……那也好，至少我们能清理掉一些吸食联邦资源的玛塔利人。说实话，我对此根本不以为然。

messages.en: Figures that a capsuleer would balk at the first sign of danger. You're a disgrace to the Federation. In fact, some would say you're just as bad as them
messages.zh: 我就料到你们克隆飞行员会知难而退的。你真是坍了联邦的台。有人说你们和他们是一丘之貉。

messages.en: There's no time to hesitate. We need info ASAP.
messages.zh: 别犹豫了，我们需要尽快获取信息。

messages.en: Veine Coructie, an editor at the Scope station in Vitrauze, caught wind of this kidnapping business. I escorted Hodts Ergre, an investigative reporter, to a known Pator 6 hangout. We were ambushed, and Hodts was killed. He did not die in vain, however, as I managed to gain access to the hangout and place the covert recording device in their hideout.
messages.zh: 维因·克鲁克帝是“视角”维查乌得站的一名编辑，他获悉了这起绑架案。我将调查记者豪斯·厄格雷护送到了一个已知的帕特六人组据点。我们遭到了伏击，豪斯不幸身亡。但他没有白死，因为我顺利进入那据点，将隐蔽录像设备安放在了那里。

messages.en: Veine Coructie, an editor at the Scope station in Vitrauze, has caught wind of this kidnapping business and is willing to help. I'll accompany Hodts Ergre, an investigative reporter, and plant a bug in a known Pator 6 hangout. I'm in lowsec territory, so I need to watch out for pirates and other criminals.
messages.zh: 维因·克鲁克帝是“视角”维查乌得站的一名编辑，他获悉了这起绑架案。我会将调查记者豪斯·厄格雷护送到一个已知的帕特六人组据点，然后安放一个监视装置。鉴于我身处低安全区，我需要时刻提防海盗及其他不法分子。

messages.en: Use your cloaking device as much as possible when travelling in this area. You can't get hit if you can't be seen, right? Above all, be careful out there.
messages.zh: 在该地区飞行时最好多用隐身设备。别人看不见你自然就打不到你，对吧？你无论如何都要当心。

messages.en:
Our first course of action is to see if we can plant a bug in a known Pator 6 hangout. Hodts Ergre, one of our more experienced investigative reporters, managed to acquire an access code to this place. We'd like you to place a covert recording device in their hideout. Hodts will open the gate, and you'll sneak in and plant the goods. This is a stealth operation, so it would probably be best if you fly something inconspicuous. I'm not saying you should go out there completely defenseless; as you know there are more pirates around here than just the Pator 6.

You can take any ship you want, but I highly recommend a frigate-sized vessel. A battleship will definitely tip them off that you‘re up to no good.
messages.zh:
我们首先要做的就是去一个已知的帕特六人组窝藏地，看看能否在那儿安放个监视装置。豪斯·厄格雷是我们一个经验老道的调查记者，他拿到了进入那地方必需的密码。豪斯负责将门打开，然后你就溜进去安放那个监视器。由于这是项秘密行动，因此你最好驾驶一艘不会引起别人注意的飞船。我不是说你要手无寸铁地前往那里，因为想必你也知道，那里除了帕多尔六人组还有其他海盗。

你可以驾驶你喜欢的船，但我强烈推荐你驾驶一艘护卫舰级别的舰船。你开着战列舰去一下子就会让对方知道你来者不善。

messages.en:
Hodts is dead? Oh no. No. That is tragic. He was the bravest reporter I've ever worked with.

Please give me a minute. I'm rather shocked about this news. Come back to me in a few moments.
messages.zh:
豪斯死了？哦，不，不，这真悲剧。他是我合作至今见到的最勇敢的一名记者。

让我一个人静静。这条消息太打击人了。你待会儿再来吧。

messages.en: We can't keep this story under wraps for very long. Word has a tendency to spread rather quickly, and the difference between rumor and fact can get muddied. I'd hate to see something like that happen here, especially when there's a kid's life at stake. Would be a shame, you know?
messages.zh: 纸是无法永远包住火的。任何消息都会不胫而走，然后事实谣言就会夹杂在一起。我可不希望看到这样的事在我们这里发生，尤其是当一个孩子危在旦夕的时候。你不觉得这可耻吗？

messages.en:
Our sources have caught wind of the situation, {[character]player.name}, though I'm glad you contacted us. We won't go public with this information yet, as that would be against our ethics as journalists. However, we will aid you in uncovering information on the missing child. Senator Ardanne has not always been kind to the media, but there's no reason to hold a grudge against him in a time like this.

We've been keeping tabs on the Pator 6 for a while now. They're mostly low-level criminals, but their name has been popping up a lot recently, especially in relation to kidnapping cases. I haven't seen them do anything this high profile, though.

Our first course of action is to see if we can plant a bug in a known Pator 6 hangout. Hodts Ergre, one of our more experienced investigative reporters, managed to acquire an access code to this place. We'd like you to place a covert recording device in their hideout. Hodts will open the gate, and you'll sneak in and plant the goods. This is a stealth operation, so it would probably be best if you fly something inconspicuous. I'm not saying you should go out there completely defenseless; as you know there are more pirates around here than just the Pator 6.

You can take any ship you want, but I highly recommend a frigate-sized vessel. A battleship will definitely tip them off that you‘re up to no good.
messages.zh:
我们的消息灵通人士已经获悉了此事，{[character]player.name}，不过我还是很高兴你来找我们。我们目前还不能将此事公布于众，因为这有悖于我们记者的职业道德。不过，我们可以帮你发掘与那失踪孩子有关的线索。虽然参议员阿丹对媒体并不怎么友好，但在这件事情上跟他算老账是靠无道理的。

我们跟踪帕特六人组有段时间了。他们中的多数人都是些低档次的罪犯，不过最近经常能听到他们的名字，尤其是与绑架案有关的时候。我还从未见过他们如此高调。

我们首先要做的就是去一个已知的帕多尔六人组窝藏地，看看能否在那儿安放个监视装置。豪斯·厄格雷是我们一个经验老道的调查记者，他拿到了进入那地方必需的密码。豪斯负责将门打开，然后你就溜进去安放那个监视器。由于这是项秘密行动，因此你最好驾驶一艘不会引起别人注意的飞船。我不是说你要手无寸铁地前往那里，因为想必你也知道，那里除了帕多尔六人组还有其他海盗。

你可以驾驶你喜欢的船，但我强烈推荐你驾驶一艘护卫舰级别的舰船。你开着战列舰去一下子就会让对方知道你来者不善。

messages.en: We can't keep this story under wraps for very long. Word has a tendency to spread rather quickly, and the difference between rumor and fact can get muddied. I'd hate to see something like that happen here, especially when there's a kid's life at stake. Would be a shame, you know? Especially if it involved a frightened and shamed capsuleer.
messages.zh: 纸是无法永远包住火的。任何消息都会不胫而走，然后事实谣言就会夹杂在一起。我可不希望看到这样的事在我们这里发生，尤其是当一个孩子危在旦夕的时候。你不觉得这可耻吗？你身为克隆飞行员竟然被吓成这样，太丢脸了。

messages.en: Did you plant the covert recording device yet?
messages.zh: 你安放好那隐蔽录像设备了吗？

name.ja: アンダーグラウンドサーカス

messages.en: I visited the Underground Circus, a den of sin and pleasure, much of it questionably legal. I captured the owner/operator of the joint, a woman who calls herself the Ringmaster, and took her back to the Black Eagles for questioning. I hope that she'll provide us with some answers after a bit of questioning. I may not agree with the Black Eagles' tactics, but they sure know how to get the job done.
messages.zh: 我去了趟地下马戏团，那里充满了罪恶和糜烂，很多东西都不知道是否合法。我抓到了那儿的老板，一个自称为舞台导演的女人，并把她带回了黑鹰总部进行审问。我尽管并不是很赞同黑鹰所采用的手段，但是他们肯定是这方面的专家。

messages.en: The Underground Circus is an infamous den of sin in these parts, and it appears to be the best place for finding a lost kid. I'm supposed to find the Circus' owner/operator, the Ringmaster, whoever she is. Looks like the Eagles want to do some heavy-handed interrogation of her. I don't know what to expect from this place, but it can't be all that bad. I think this Mone woman may be a little too uptight, even for a Gallente.
messages.zh: 地下马戏团在这里是一个臭名昭著的罪恶场所，要想找一个丢失的孩子，这就是最佳的地点。我需要找到马戏团的所有者和经营者，也就是“舞台导演”，无论这是个什么人。看上去黑鹰想要对她采取某种严厉的刑讯手段。我并不知道会有什么样的结果，但是肯定不会太糟糕。我想这个满是铜臭的女人已经很有些气愤了，即便是对于一个盖伦特人来说、

messages.en: The glitz and glamour of the Underground Circus is a siren song for many people. Don't let yourself get trapped by its allure, no matter how decadent and desirable it may seem. That is the path to ruin, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 对很多人来说，地下马戏团的闪亮灯光和靡靡之音就是拉响的警报。你不要被它所引诱，无论那看上去是多么的有吸引力。那是一条通往毁灭的道路，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Looks like it's time to bring in the Ringmaster, the owner/operator of the Underground Circus. Don't let her name fool you: She's ruthless, cunning, and manipulative. I've worked with her before, back when she was a legit businesswoman. She's degraded into a broker cesspool of sin and filth, a mockery of what she once was. Find her and bring her to me. With a bit of heavy questioning, we'll get the right information from her.
messages.zh: 看来是时候把舞台导演带来了，她是地下马戏团的所有者和经营者。别让她的名字把你给忽悠了，她是个残忍、狡猾而且喜欢玩弄权术的人。我曾经和她一起工作过，那时候她还是个合法的工人。她现在已经成了一个腐朽堕落的掮客，干着邪恶肮脏的勾当，和当年的她相比简直是个极大地讽刺。找到她，并把她带到我面前。通过一些审问，我们能够从她的嘴里挖出我们想要找到的信息。

messages.en: It's good to see you again, Ringmaster. Been a long time. We have questions for you, and we'll make sure we get the answers we want. This will hurt you more than it will me, but I admit I'll enjoy it nonetheless.
messages.zh: 很高兴再一次见到你，舞台导演。我们已经很久没有见面了。我有些问题要问你，而且我们会确保你把我们想要的答案告诉我们。这过程会是相当的不好受，但是我想我会很享受的。

messages.en: I am wholly suspicious of your decision, and I have half a mind to report you to my superiors. I must warn you, {[character]player.name}, that if I catch you sniffing around the Circus, I will arrest you immediately. There is neither freedom nor pleasure in a Federation prison, though I relish the idea of watching a demigod like yourself rot in a jail cell.
messages.zh: 我对你的决定非常怀疑，我也很想向我的上级报告你的行为。我必须要警告你，{[character]player.name}，如果我再看到你在附近出现的话，我就会立即把你逮捕起来。在联邦牢狱里面可是既没有自由也没有快乐的，我会很高兴把你这样一个不死族送进牢狱，然你腐烂在里面。

messages.en:
“Guilt is unknown in the Gallente Federation. Pleasure, desire, lust, avarice: These are the rights of all people, laws be damned. Our economy is built not upon currency or scarcity, but on the supply and demand of needs, wants, and yearnings. A guilty pleasure is the highest right of the Gallente; my Circus is here to satisfy and fulfill this right. Let us redefine what it is to be guilty.”

-The Ringmaster, on the opening of the Underground Circus, YC 108
messages.zh:
“负罪在盖伦特联邦里是不存在的。享乐，欲望和贪婪：这是所有人应有的权利，法律应该得到诅咒。我们的经济不是建立在货币和萧条之上的，而是建立在供需关系，期望和向往之上的。一种有罪恶感的享乐才是盖伦特人的最高权力；我的马戏团就是为了满足这种权利的实现而存在的。让我们重新来定义什么是罪恶。”

舞台导演，地下马戏团开业演说，新伊甸纪元108。

messages.en: The Underground Circus
messages.zh: 地下马戏团

messages.en:
The Underground Circus represents everything wrong with our Federation, the exploitation of personal liberties for the sick desires of depraved “citizens.” True Gallente have respect for themselves and treat their freedom with dignity, respect, and class. I should have known that the Circus would have something to do with this kidnapping business: Children are commodities in a dump like that.

Looks like it's time for us to bring in the Ringmaster, the owner/operator of the Underground Circus. Don't let her name fool you: She's ruthless, cunning, and manipulative. I've worked with her before, back when she was a legit businesswoman. She's degraded into a broker of sin and filth, a mockery of what she once was. Find her and bring her to me. With a bit of heavy questioning, we'll get the right information from her.
messages.zh:
地下马戏团代表了联邦体制中的各种阴暗和缺陷，是堕落“公民”对个人权利自由的滥用。真正的盖伦特人是尊重自己的尊严的，并以端正负责的态度行驶自己的自由权利。我早就该知道这个马戏团和这起绑架案件有关系：儿童在这种肮脏的地方就是一种商品。

看来是时候把舞台导演带来了，她是地下马戏团的所有者和经营者。别让她的名字把你给忽悠了，她是个残忍、狡猾而且喜欢玩弄权术的人。我曾经和她一起工作过，那时候她还是个合法的工人。她现在已经成了一个腐朽堕落的掮客，干着邪恶肮脏的勾当，和当年的她相比简直是个极大地讽刺。找到她，并把她带到我面前。通过一些审问，我们能够从她的嘴里挖出我们想要找到的信息。

messages.en: Cowardice is a trait I've seen a lot in you capsuleers. That explains your immortality: Those who fear death cannot understand the honor of living. Go back to your mercenary ways, {[character]player.name}, and I hope I don't catch you around these parts again.
messages.zh: 我发现你这个人相当的懦弱，克隆飞行员。这或许能解释你的永生：那些吧不害怕死亡的人没法理解什么时活着的意义。回去干你的雇佣兵吧，{[character]player.name}，希望我以后别再在这里看到你。

messages.en: Don't let the Ringmaster and her Circus fool you. It's a trap that catches many people, all for naught. When you bring her to me, I'll make sure her penance is just.
messages.zh: 别让舞舞台导演和她的马戏团把你给忽悠了。这个陷阱害了很多人。你把她带来我这里，我保证她会受到公正的惩罚。

messages.en: The bug I planted worked as planned. Veine Coructie, using that device in conjunction with his massive network of contacts, managed to discover the Pator 6's headquarters. When I flew there, I witnessed a meeting between the gang and their criminal associates. Looks like the Syndicate are behind this. I don't know why they'd be involved in this region; this situation may be bigger than I imagined. Even though they attacked me, I managed to escape with some evidence that Ralie was with the Pator 6. This evidence should help in getting closer to that poor kid.
messages.zh: 我放置的那个偷听器按计划正常运转。维因·克鲁克帝利用它与其本人庞大的关系网，查到了帕特六人组的总部地址。我飞抵那儿的时候，看到了那群人与其罪犯同党会面。看起来辛迪加财团是幕后黑手，我不知道他们为什么会介入此星域。也许这事比我料想的要复杂。虽然他们攻击了我，我还是带着拉赖与帕特六人组在一起的证据得以全身而退。该证据将有助于我们早一步救出那可怜的孩子。

messages.en: The covert recording device appears to be working as planned. The Pator 6 is really busy in this region. With the information gleaned through the bug and Veine's incessant networking, the location of the gang's major headquarters was finally discovered. Or at least we think it's their HQ. A last minute message from the bug presages an important meeting between the Pator 6 and their associates. If I make it in time, I can learn who the gang is working for, or at least get some evidence of the kidnapping for use against them.
messages.zh: 那个录音设备按计划在正常运转。帕特六人组在此星域活动非常频繁。通过那监听设备以及维因的不间断情报，我们发现了该团体的总部地址。至少我们认为那是他们的总部。最后一刻传来的消息透露帕特六人组与其同僚之间将要进行一场会面。如果我能及时抵达会面地，那我就能获悉这六人组为谁效力，或者至少获得指控他们绑架的证据。

messages.en: The Pator 6 is working for somebody big. A high-profile crime like this is well above their level. I don't know who could have orchestrated this, but I think we're about to find out. Either way, we need hard evidence in order to corroborate our story. That's Journalism 101, my friend.
messages.zh: 帕特六人组为某个大人物效力。如此高调的犯罪行为绝非他们本身能做得出来的。我不知道究竟谁才是背后指使，但我们一定会查清这点。无论如何我们都需要证据支持我们的报道。这是做记者的原则，朋友。

messages.en:
While the Pator 6 has a rather large foothold throughout the region, we heard one system repeated over and over again: {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I asked some of my sources in that system, and they sent me the coordinates of some sort of junkyard with a lot of traffic from unlicensed Minmatar pilots. I have a distinct feeling that the kid is there, or at least he was at one point...

Hang on. We just intercepted a message from our bug. Looks like the Pator 6 is expecting company soon. Time to crash the party. See who the meeting is with, and try to bring back something we can pin on the gang. We need evidence that Ralie was there if we're going to bust this case open. Gotta warn you, though: A battleship won't be much good here. From what I've seen, they have a means of keeping battleships out of their hideouts. Thus, don't take one on this mission.
messages.zh:
虽然帕特六人组在此星域扎根很广，但总有一个星系被反复提及：{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。我问了我的一些在那星系的人，他们给了我一个地址，好像是某个有很多非正规米玛塔尔飞行员进出的垃圾场。我有个明显感觉那孩子就在那儿，至少曾经在那儿……

等等。我们刚新截获一条消息。帕特六人组好像在等什么人。你去砸他们的场子。看看他们要会面的是什么人，试着拿回可以指控六人组的东西。如果我们想让这事彻底公布出来，那我们就必须获得拉赖在那儿的证据。但我要警告你：一艘战列舰在那儿发挥不了什么作用。从我的观察来看，他们有办法把战列舰挡在他们藏身处之外。因此，不要和任何人交火。

messages.en: The Syndicate? In this space? That's practically unheard of. What would they want from Senator Ardanne? At least we have proof now, hard evidence that we can use. That's some great reporting, {[character]player.name}. You know, when this is over, we could use your investigation skills. You can't teach those at any Journo School.
messages.zh: 辛迪加财团？在此地区？我还是头一次听说。他们想从参议员阿丹那儿获得什么？不过我们现在至少掌握了可用的证据。你这调查报道工作干得真棒，{[character]player.name}。等这一切结束之后，也许我们可以充分利用你的调查本事。这本事可不是在学校里就能学到的。

messages.en: You'd make a terrible reporter, you know. No guts, no story.
messages.zh: 你要干记者这行肯定没前途。没感觉，不会抓故事。

messages.en:
The bug appears to be working well. We've been picking up a lot of messages from the Pator 6. For such a relatively small-time gang, they have quite a large network established. I don't know why we haven't noticed them earlier. We'll have to keep this bug going for a bit. There are a few breaking stories in there, or at least some info we could sell.

While the Pator 6 has a rather large foothold throughout the region, we heard one system repeated over and over again: {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I asked some of my sources in that system, and they sent me the coordinates of some sort of junkyard with a lot of traffic from unlicensed Minmatar pilots. I have a distinct feeling that the kid is there, or at least he was at one point...

Hang on. We just intercepted a message from our bug. Looks like the Pator 6 is expecting company soon. Time to crash the party. See who the meeting is with, and try to bring back something we can pin on the gang. We need evidence that Ralie was there if we're going to bust this case open. Gotta warn you, though: A battleship won't be much good here. From what I've seen, they have a means of keeping battleships out of their hideouts. Thus, don't take one on this mission.
messages.zh:
那监听设备发挥了很大的作用。我们截获了很多来自帕特六人组的消息。这么一个规模较小的团体却拥有这么庞大的网络，为什么我们没有早点察觉到呢？这偷听器我们还要继续用下去。他们那儿即使没有爆炸性新闻也会有我们可以出卖的情报。

虽然帕特六人组在此星域扎根很广，但总有一个星系被反复提及：{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。我问了我的一些在那星系的人，他们给了我一个地址，好像是某个有很多非正规米玛塔尔飞行员进出的垃圾场。我有个明显感觉那孩子就在那儿，至少曾经在那儿……

等等。我们刚新截获一条消息。帕特六人组好像在等什么人。你去砸他们的场子。看看他们要会面的是什么人，试着拿回可以指控六人组的东西。如果我们想让这事彻底公布出来，那我们就必须获得拉赖在那儿的证据。但我要警告你：一艘战列舰在那儿发挥不了什么作用。从我的观察来看，他们有办法把战列舰挡在他们藏身处之外。因此，不要和任何人交火。

messages.en: We were so close to the big scoop. Do you have any idea how big those ratings would have been?
messages.zh: 我们离获得独家新闻只差一步之遥。你知不知道它能给我们带来多高的收视率？

messages.en: Well, who is the Pator 6 working with?
messages.zh: 恩，这帕特六人组在与谁合作？

messages.en: The Ringmaster's lead was correct. I found the Pator 6 at the Intaki colony. Turns out they were working for the Syndicate all along. I was warned to stay away from Syndicate business, but I'm not afraid of their threats. At least I know the kid is still alive. There's hope yet.
messages.zh: 那帮主的线索正确。我在印塔基殖民处发现了帕特六人组。原来他们一直在为辛迪加财团卖命。他们警告我不要介入他们的事情，但我不怕他们。至少我知道那孩子还活着，还有希望。

messages.en: The Ringmaster gave us a lead on an Intaki colony with loose associations to the Pator 6. Mourmarie thinks that I'll find some info there. I can't tell if this is a legit lead or not: It is entirely possible that Mourmarie's prejudices are getting in the way of her judgment. But it's the only clue we have to go on, so I will move forward and hope something comes of it.
messages.zh: 那帮主给了我们一个印塔基殖民地的线索，那里的人与帕特六人组有着松散的关系。摩尔马列认为我会在那儿有所斩获。我无法确定这条线索的真假：摩尔马列的偏见很有可能在影响她的判断。但这是我们目前唯一可能取得进展的线索，所以我还是服从命令前往，希望真能有所斩获。

messages.en: You are doing a service for the Federation and its true citizens. There are a lot of criminals that must be brought to justice, and we are getting closer to punishing this bunch of them. Nobody we apprehend is innocent; everyone here is guilty.
messages.zh: 你这是在为联邦及其人民服务。这世界上有很多必须惩之以法的罪犯，我们很快就能将其中的一撮一网打尽。我们抓到的人中没有一个是无辜的；这儿的每个人都有罪。

messages.en: Go to Pemene and find those Intaki. Keep an eye out for the Pator 6, and report back with any information you receive about the senator's son. You may have to open fire on their settlement in order to get them to talk. If you run into any opposition, use force. You have the authorities on your side.
messages.zh: 现在请前往佩门勒找到那些印塔基人。要注意提防帕特六人组，回来向我报告任何与那参议员孩子有关的消息。你可能必须向那驻地里的人开火才能让他们开口说话。我们允许你武力还手。

messages.en: This information confirms my suspicions. Those damn Intaki are all criminals, and this proves it. I don't know why the Syndicate would involve themselves in this space; they know better than to enter this region. I don't know what they want with the senator's kid, either. But at least we know who has the kid, and that he's still alive.
messages.zh: 这条消息终于证实了我的怀疑。那帮该死的印塔基人全是罪犯，事实已经证明了这点。我不知道辛迪加财团为什么会涉足此星域；他们应该有更好的去处。不过我们毕竟知道了那孩子现在谁手里，他还活着。

messages.en: Are you a sympathizer with the Intaki cause? I'd get out of here real quick, unless you wanted the wrath of the Federation on you.
messages.zh: 难道你是在怜悯印塔基人吗？如果我是你，我肯定现在就动身了，除非你想让联邦来找你麻烦。

messages.en:
After a bit of interrogation, the Ringmaster gave us the information we're looking for. Funny, we barely put any effort into it: She succumbed pretty quickly. Oh well. Since we have her in custody, we'll use her for more questioning later, just as soon as she's rested up and ready for another round.

Anyway, based on her information, we've learned of a nearby Intaki settlement that has some loose association with the Pator 6. You know what the Intaki are like — one big mess of criminals. I don't believe the lies they tell us in the media: All Intaki are a part of the Syndicate, directly or not. If it were up to me, I'd lock all the Intaki up for good, or maybe just send them all back to their cesspool of a home planet.

Go to Pemene and find those Intaki. Keep an eye out for the Pator 6, and report back with any information you receive about the senator's son. You may have to open fire on their settlement in order to get them to talk. If you run into any opposition, use force. You have the authorities on your side.
messages.zh:
审讯进行了没一会儿，这位帮主就向我们透露了我们需要的信息。好笑的是我们还没用上真功夫她就招了。既然她现在处于我们的关押之中，那我们可以让她稍息一会儿，等她喘过气来的时候再继续审她。

反正据她透露，附近有一处印塔基人的驻地，他们与帕特六人组有着某种松散的联系。想必你知道印塔基是群怎样的人：不过就是一帮罪犯而已。我可不相信他们在媒体上吹嘘的谎言：所有的印塔基人，直接也好间接也罢，都与辛迪加财团有染。如果这事由我来定，我肯定把印塔基人都关起来，或者将他们统统遣送回他们那乌烟瘴气的老家。

现在请前往佩门勒找到那些印塔基人。要注意提防帕特六人组，回来向我报告任何与那参议员孩子有关的消息。你可能必须向那驻地里的人开火才能让他们开口说话。我们允许你武力还手。

messages.en: Are you a sympathizer with the Intaki cause? I'd get out of here real quick, unless you wanted the wrath of the Federation on you.
messages.zh: 难道你是在怜悯印塔基人吗？如果我是你，我肯定现在就动身了，除非你想让联邦来找你麻烦。

messages.en: Well? Did you find anything?
messages.zh: 嗯？你有什么发现吗？

messages.en: I delivered the evidence to the Scope station, but the Black Eagles intercepted the package shortly afterward. The Feds have stepped in and are forcing their agenda on me. I don't like the way they're handling this, but it looks like I have no choice. There's no use trusting authority.
messages.zh: 我将那证据视频顺利交给了视角的广播站，但黑鹰随后即将那视频截获。联邦已经插手此事，欲逼我按他们的想法去做。我虽不喜欢他们这种行事方式，但好像又别无他选。相信政府机构真是种浪费。

messages.en: The Scope is ready to run a full expose on this kidnapping case, direct via holovid from one of their secret satellite stations. I'm supposed to deliver the evidence to the station for the report. The hope is that this will shed the spotlight on the kidnapping, forcing it into the public arena and showing the Syndicate in a terrible light. If anything happens to Ralie from here, the Syndicate will never be able to live it down.
messages.zh: 视角集团打算通过其秘密人造卫星广播站，以播放视频的方式全面曝光这起绑架案。我被要求将该视频送往那座广播站。我们的期望是要让这起绑架案大白于天下，好好丑化一下辛迪加财团。只要拉赖一有闪失，他们肯定就会吃不了兜着走。

messages.en: Of course, we'll get plenty of good ratings, too. That's the most important thing.
messages.zh: 当然，我们还会获得很高的收视率。这是最重要的一点。

messages.en: We have a satellite station that we like to use for these important broadcasts. It's safely hidden in a secret location in case there's any blowback from our special reports. Take this evidence and drop it off at the station. We'll use that to raise awareness of this case, blow it right open, and turn the wrath of the unwashed masses on the Syndicate.
messages.zh: 我们有一座人造卫星广播站专用于发布这类重要内容。为了防止遭报复，我们将它暗藏在一个秘密地点。请带上这份证据将它送到那广播站。我们要高调揭露这件事，扩大其影响力，让大家都对辛迪加财团产生公愤。

messages.en: Damn Black Eagles. I don't know how they knew about our satellite location. This does not bode well for our business. Those rat bastards are no good at all. I might have to push my story on them a little earlier than expected. They'll learn how much power we really have…
messages.zh: 该死的黑鹰。我不知道他们是怎么获悉那人造卫星广播站地址的。这直接损害到了我们的利益。那帮畜生没一个好的。看来我得早先一步将我对他们的报道发表出去，这样他们就会明白我们到底有多厉害……

messages.en: This is our chance to put the spotlight on a delicate situation and you bail out at the last minute? I'll never understand you eggers.
messages.zh: 这是我们将一个敏感事件公之于众的好机会，而你却在这最后一刻撒手不干了？我永远没法理解你们这帮克隆飞行员。

messages.en:
Truth is the fundamental goal of any good reporter, and we've uncovered enough of it to create a media storm. The power of the press is unprecedented in its ability to sway the general public, create massive sympathy for an unknown issue, and to create a massive backlash against nefarious groups. When we present this evidence on the holovids, there's no hope for the Syndicate. Their reputation will be ruined if anything happens to the kid. This is the power of the media.

We have a satellite station that we like to use for these important broadcasts. It's safely hidden in a secret location in case there's any blowback from our special reports. Take this evidence and drop it off at the station. We'll use that to raise awareness of this case, blow it right open, and turn the wrath of the unwashed masses on the Syndicate.
messages.zh:
所有的优秀记者都将对真相的追求作为基本目标。我们现在获得的真相足以掀起一场媒体风暴。在左右公众想法、引发对不出名事件的共鸣及讨伐不良群体方面，媒体有着无可匹敌的力量。只要我们将这视频上的内容一曝光，辛迪加财团就没希望了。只要那孩子一有闪失，他们的名声就完了。这就是媒体的力量。

我们有一座人造卫星广播站专用于发布这类重要内容。为了防止遭报复，我们将它暗藏在一个秘密地点。请带上这份证据将它送到那广播站。我们要高调揭露这件事，扩大其影响力，让大家都对辛迪加财团产生公愤。

messages.en: This is our chance to put the spotlight on a delicate situation and you bail out at the last minute? I'll never understand you eggers.
messages.zh: 这是我们将一个敏感事件公之于众的好机会，而你却在这最后一刻撒手不干了？我永远没法理解你们这帮克隆飞行员。

messages.en: We need that evidence for our expose. Where is it?
messages.zh: 我们需要那份证据录像。它在哪儿？

messages.en: Things are starting to escalate, it seems. Sinas and Katsen made arrangements to have the data node decoded, but it required the knowledge of a man named Vira Mikano; one of Ishukone Watch's senior intelligence officers. There was no chance he was going to help us without being coerced, so the plan was to have Katsen's people “redirect” him from his office in Oipo to my personal hangar on the station. After that, I just burned it back down to Astoh before anyone could even realize he'd gone missing. Now I wait, and hope that he can decipher this thing.
messages.zh: 事情看起来已经升级了。塞纳斯与卡僧已经一致同意要破解那数据节点，但这需要一个名叫维拉·米卡诺的人帮忙才行。这人是异株湖安全部队的一位高级情报官，不给他来点硬的他是不会帮我们的。所以卡僧就让手下的人将米卡诺从其欧伊博办公室“引向”我那里的机库。之后我就赶在那里的人发觉米卡诺失踪之前把他疾速带回了阿希多。现在我就在等，希望他能把这玩意儿破解出来。

messages.en: Things are starting to escalate, it seems. Sinas and Katsen have made arrangements to have the data node decoded, but it will require the knowledge of a man named Vira Mikano. This guy works for Ishukone Watch, meaning he won't help us without being coerced. The plan is to have Katsen's people “redirect” him from his office in Oipo to my personal hangar on the station. After that, my job is to get the hell out of there and back to Astoh before people realize the truth about Mikano's absence.
messages.zh: 事情看起来已经升级了。塞纳斯与卡僧已经一致同意要破解那数据节点，但这需要一个名叫维拉·米卡诺的人帮忙才行。这人是异株湖安全部队的员工，不给他来点硬的他是不会帮我们的。具体做法就是让卡僧手下的人将米卡诺从其欧伊博办公室“引向”我那里的机库。然后我要赶在那里的人知道米卡诺失踪的真相之前，把他带离那里，送回阿希多。

messages.en: Here goes nothing then. I'll see you shortly, {[character]player.name}. Good luck.
messages.zh: 现在这里没事。待会见，{[character]player.name}。祝你好运。

messages.en:
Katsen is convinced that if anyone can decipher this data node, it will be Vira Mikano, a senior decryption analyst with Ishukone Watch.

Katsen's plan is to have some of his people “redirect” Mr. Mikano from his office in Oipo to your personal hangar on the station. From there, you will put him aboard your ship and safely escort him back here to Astoh.

Let me stress something before you leap in, {[character]player.name}. Mikano is a family man, and a well-respected Caldari too. . We need him to help us, and there is no chance in hell he'd do that without a little pressure, but he must not come to any harm whatsoever.
messages.zh:
卡僧说如果没有异株湖安全部队的高级解码分析员维拉·米卡诺，那这世界上也没有能破解这数据节点的人了。

卡僧的计划就是让他手下的人将米卡诺从其欧伊博办公室“引向”你那里的机库。然后你把米卡诺带上你的船，将他安全押回阿希多这儿。

{[character]player.name}，在你动身之前，我要再强调一遍：米卡诺是重家庭的人，也是在加达里备受尊敬的人。我们需要他帮忙，如果不给他施加压力，他绝对不会听我们的。但你要确保千万不能伤害他。

messages.en:
I think we may have just pulled it off, {[character]player.name}. Unbelievable, but then most of Katsen's plans are.

We'll take care of Mikano from here. He'll be more than safe, don't worry. Once he has given us what we need he'll be promptly returned to his families.

We've taken a scan copy of the data node you uncovered. Katsen says it won't be long before Mikano decodes it for us.
messages.zh:
我想你已经顺利完成了你的任务，{[character]player.name}。这任务虽让人难以置信，但卡僧想出来的计划多半都是这样。

接下来就把米卡诺交给我们吧。别担心，他的人身安全绝对有保障。只要他满足了我们的要求之后我们就立马把他送回他家人那里。

我们已经将你取回的数据节点扫描备份了一下。卡僧说米卡诺用不了多久就会把它破解出来。

messages.en: Pressure can make or break a Caldari. I'm surprised after everything you've done that this was too much for you. Very well, {[character]player.name}, I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 压力可以成就或压垮一个加达里人。在你经历了这一切之后，你竟然会扛不下这个。太让我吃惊了，{[character]player.name}。我找别人去了。

messages.en:
The glossy tropes of the public relations holoreels and the beige glamour of stylized war worship stand in stark contrast to the reality of these agencies, but most people have only a muddy awareness of the dichotomy.

A man can be rudely treated by a brusque and superior Ishukone Watch officer and silently curse him for hours, but as soon as he gets home that evening he is just as likely to prop his feet up and enjoy a rousing serial where the Ishukone Watch's superior technology and cunning allows it to root out Gurista spies and double-cross them into revealing their hideout. So pervasive is the propaganda that it is highly doubtful this man ever draws a parallel between the real thing and the image; the connection he draws, instead, is between the image and the mother corporation it represents.
messages.zh:
平时公众见到的公关宣传片中的那些冠冕堂皇之词以及那些被粉饰过的战争颂歌与现实实在相去甚远。可惜多数人都没有强烈意识到这一点。

一个人被异株湖安全部队的一位不讲理的上司粗暴对待之后可能会私下咒骂他数小时，但只要他晚上一回到家，或许就会立刻翘起二郎腿观赏起连续剧来。剧中尽是展示异株湖安全部队如何利用其先进技术与阴谋诡计清理古斯塔斯间谍，逼迫他们背叛同僚吐露出他们的藏身处。这招宣传手段很管用，以致于观众很难分辨出屏幕上描述的与现实中实际情况之间的差别，他们反而相信屏幕上的演绎即代表了现实。

messages.en: Masks of Authority
messages.zh: 官方的面具

messages.en:
I've managed to get a message over to Katsen. He's already begun to make some arrangements but I have to say {[character]player.name}, this is going to be a particularly dicey assignment, for all of us.

Katsen is convinced he knows the man for this job. In fact, he claims that if anyone can decipher this data node, it will be this man. His name is Vira Mikano, and he's a senior decryption analyst with Ishukone Watch.

Yeah that's right, I said Ishukone Watch.

Katsen's plan is to have some of his people “redirect” Mr. Mikano from his office in Oipo to your personal hangar on the station. From there, you will put him aboard your ship and safely escort him back here to Astoh.

Let me stress something before you leap in, {[character]player.name}. Mikano is a family man, and a well-respected Caldari too. Hell, I once had drinks with him. If the lives of many more Caldari weren't at stake here, I wouldn't consider abducting him for even a moment, but desperate situations call for practical solutions. We need him to help us, and there is no chance in hell he'd do that without a little pressure, but he must not come to any harm whatsoever.

Only accept this assignment if you're absolutely ready for it. I'll relay your acceptance to Katsen the moment you give me the nod. After that, there's no turning back.
messages.zh:
我已经给卡僧发了条消息。他已经开始做安排了，但我还是要告诉你，{[character]player.name}，这次任务对大家风险都非常大。

卡僧相信他已经找到了适合这个工作的人。他说如果这世界上只有一个能破解这数据节点的人，那一定是他。那人的名字叫维拉·米卡诺，他是异株湖安全部队的高级解码分析员。

你没听错，我说的就是异株湖安全部队。

卡僧的计划就是让他手下的人将米卡诺从他在欧伊博的办公室“引向”你那里的机库。然后你把米卡诺带上你的船，将他安全押回阿希多这里。

{[character]player.name}，在你动身之前，我要再强调一遍：米卡诺是重家庭的人，在加达里也备受尊敬。我以前还与他喝过一杯呢。要不是那么多加达里人危在旦夕，我根本连想都不会想去绑架他。可惜现在受形势所逼，我们必须把务实摆在首位。我们需要他帮忙，如果不给他施加压力，他绝对不会听我们的。但你要确保千万不能伤害他。

只有当你完全准备好接受此任务时，你才能去做。你点头之后我就会立马通知卡僧。我这里可没有后悔药让你吃。

messages.en: Pressure can make or break a Caldari. I'm surprised after everything you've done that this was too much for you. Very well, {[character]player.name}, I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 压力可以成就或压垮一个加达里人。在你经历了这一切之后，你竟然会扛不下这个。太让我吃惊了，{[character]player.name}。我找别人去了。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, move it!
messages.zh: 快动身，{[character]player.name}！

name.ru: Крыса в углу (Rat in a Corner)
name.zh: 卷缩于角落里的前科犯

messages.en: The Black Eagles have planted a rat in TransStellar with a history in human trafficking. Though she's legit now, the Eagles use her for information on the seedier parts of the region. I found her in Mesybier and will work with her on getting the kid back. The Syndicate will be able to see the Feds coming; they won't expect a one-man army, though.
messages.zh: 黑鹰在泛星船运里安插了一个有人口诱骗前科的人。她现已刑满释放，为黑鹰作线人，探查该星域监管薄弱地区的情报。我在美希比尔找到了她，将与其合作解救那孩子。辛迪加财团知道联邦部队将突袭他们，他们一定会做好准备。

messages.en: The Black Eagles have planted a rat in TransStellar with a history in human trafficking. Though she's legit now, the Eagles use her for information on the seedier parts of the region. I have to find her in Mesybier and work with her on getting the kid back. The Syndicate will be able to see the Feds coming; they won't expect a one-man army, though.
messages.zh: 黑鹰在泛星船运里安插了一个有人口诱骗前科的人。她现已刑满释放，为黑鹰作线人，探查该星域监管薄弱地区的情报。我在美希比尔找到了她，将与其合作解救那孩子。辛迪加财团知道联邦部队将突袭他们，他们一定会做好准备。

messages.en: Even though she's clean, I still wouldn't trust her fully. A rat is a rat: That's all there is to it. But in her case, she knows better than to betray us. She's had experience.
messages.zh: 尽管她已经洗手不干，但我还是不会完全相信她。坏人永远是坏人：这没什么可争辩的。不过就其而言，她还是知道背叛对自己没好处。她有经验。

messages.en:
Ascain Adeset served a few years in prison after we nabbed her for human trafficking. She saw the light and joined our side. Now she's one of our best informants in the area. I planted her in TransStellar to ensure that she keeps that company legit. We have a very close eye on her in case she decides to change sides again. If she does, she'll be lucky to make it back to prison at all.

You can find her in Mesybier.
messages.zh:
艾丝坎·艾得塞特因诱骗人口被我们抓获。蹲了数年牢之后，她刑满释放加入了我们。如今她是我在该地区最得力的线人之一。我将她安插在泛星船运让其确保该企业合法经营。同时我们也密切监视她以防其叛变。如果她真胆敢这样做，那她这次能否活着住进牢狱还是个问题。

你可以在美希比尔找到她。

messages.en: Turning your back and running at a critical time like this implies either cowardice or a complete lack of humanity. Both are crucial traits of a capsuleer.
messages.zh: 在这关键时刻临阵脱逃要么是懦夫的证明要么就是没人性。这两者都是克隆飞行员身上典型的毛病。

messages.en:
If we're going to get to the Syndicate, then you'll have to go undercover for us, {[character]player.name}. Otherwise, they would see us coming from an AU away.

Not to worry, though. I have a person in mind who can help: Ascain Adeset. We nabbed her a few years back for human trafficking. She was on some crazy booster as well, and took out four of our cruisers before we brought her down. We lost a lot of good officers in that raid. After serving a few years in prison, she saw the light and joined our side. Now she's one of our best informants in the area.

I planted her in TransStellar to ensure that she keeps that company legit. We have a very close eye on her in case she decides to change sides again. If she does, she'll be lucky to make it back to prison at all.

You can find her in Mesybier.
messages.zh:
如果我们要去拜访辛迪加财团，那你就得做我们的卧底，{[character]player.name}。否则，他们就会明白我们驻扎在距他们仅1AU远的地方。

但你也别担心。我想到了一个能帮忙的人：艾丝坎·艾得塞特。她几年前因诱骗人口被我们抓获。她当时也服用增效剂，因此我们损失了四艘巡洋舰后才将她制服。我们在那次追捕中损失了多位优秀警官。蹲了数年牢之后，她刑满释放加入了我们。如今她是我在该地区最得力的线人之一。

我将她安插在泛星船运让其确保该企业合法经营。同时我们也密切监视她以防其叛变。如果她真胆敢这样做，那她这次能否活着住进牢狱还是个问题。

你可以在美希比尔找到她。

messages.en: Turning your back and running at a critical time like this implies either cowardice or a complete lack of humanity. Both are crucial traits of a capsuleer.
messages.zh: 在这关键时刻临阵脱逃要么是懦夫的证明要么就是没人性。这两者都是克隆飞行员身上典型的毛病。

After that, I just burned it back down to Astoh before anyone could even realize he'd gone missing. Now I wait, and hope that he can decipher this thing.

我已经给卡僧发了条消息。他已经开始做安排了，但我还是要告诉你，{[character]player.name}，这次任务对大家风险都非常大。

卡僧相信他已经找到了适合这个工作的人。他说如果这世界上只有一个能破解这数据节点的人，那一定是他。那人的名字叫维拉·米卡诺，他是异株湖安全部队的高级解码分析员。

你没听错，我说的就是异株湖安全部队。

卡僧的计划就是让他手下的人将米卡诺从他在欧伊博的办公室“引向”你那里的机库。然后你把米卡诺带上你的船，将他安全押回阿希多这里。

{[character]player.name}，在你动身之前，我要再强调一遍：米卡诺是重家庭的人，在加达里也备受尊敬。我以前还与他喝过一杯呢。要不是那么多加达里人危在旦夕，我根本连想都不会想去绑架他。可惜现在受形势所逼，我们必须把务实摆在首位。我们需要他帮忙，如果不给他施加压力，他绝对不会听我们的。但你要确保千万不能伤害他。

只有当你完全准备好接受此任务时，你才能去做。你点头之后我就会立马通知卡僧。我这里可没有后悔药让你吃。

messages.en: Pressure can make or break a Caldari. I'm surprised after everything you've done that this was too much for you. Very well, {[character]player.name}, I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 压力可以成就或压垮一个加达里人。在你经历了这一切之后，你竟然会扛不下这个。太让我吃惊了，{[character]player.name}。我找别人去了。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, move it!
messages.zh: 快动身，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: Mikano deciphered the document and the results were conclusive: Ishukone has been involved in an unauthorized P.O.W exchange with Federation. Worse yet, they've only been focusing on the rescue and recovery of their own staff. I delivered a message to the Ishukone personnel involved in this, letting them know that their operation has been compromised. They didn't seem too pleased to have been figured out, but have agreed to halt their operations until another arrangement can be made.
messages.zh: 米卡诺破解了那文档，结果很明确：异株湖集团私下里在与盖伦特联邦进行战俘交换，更让人气愤的是，他们只管自己集团里的人，其他加达里人一概不顾。我向参与此事的异株湖集团人员送了封信，让他们知道其行动已经败露。他们不是很高兴，但还是同意了在新协议达成之前暂且停止目前的救援行动。

messages.en: Mikano deciphered the document and the results were conclusive: Ishukone has been involved in an unauthorized P.O.W exchange with Federation. Worse yet, they've only been focusing on the rescue and recovery of their own staff. I've been asked to deliver a message to the Ishukone personnel involved in this, letting them know that their operation has been compromised. The leverage this gives us will allow for the safe return of Mikano to Ishukone, as well as a temporary halt on all future exchanges. Sinas and Katsen don't want Ishukone alerting any more people to what they're doing.
messages.zh: 米卡诺破解了那文档，结果很明确：异株湖集团私下里在与盖伦特联邦进行战俘交换，更让人气愤的是，他们只管自己集团里的人，其他加达里人一概不顾。我被要求向参与此事的异株湖集团人员送封信，让他们知道其行动已经败露。捏住他们这个把柄之后，我们就能确保将米卡诺安然无恙地送回去，并且他们将暂停所有的人质交换行动。塞纳斯与卡僧都不想让异株湖集团知道他们的这一计划。

messages.en:
Thank you, {[character]player.name}. There are Caldari out there as we speak, sitting in the darkness, waiting in silence. I've been in their situation, and it's not easy to fight the fear and depression. I remember though, the thought I held on to in the darkness, the thought that kept me going. It was hope. Hope for rescue.

You alone give these people hope. Do not forget the duty that rests on your shoulders, it is the most sacred thing we Caldari know.
messages.zh:
谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。现在有很多加达里人都被关在黑暗里，在寂静中等待。我曾身处他们同样的境地，知道克服恐惧与绝望不是件容易的事。但我记得一样东西，一样我在黑暗中一直信守的东西，一样促使我屹立不倒的东西：那就是希望，希望获救。

你一个人就给这么多人带来了希望。请不要忘记你肩上的责任，这是我们加达里人最看重的东西。

messages.en:
We've got them. The decoded data from that node has given us undeniable proof. Ishukone has been engaged in the unauthorized exchange of Caldari prisoners of war, and worse yet, they've only been focusing on the rescue and recovery of their own people.

The next step from here is to let Ishukone know they've been compromised. The leverage that grants will allow us to return Mikano safely and without incident. More importantly though, it also means we can get them to stop this amateurish exchange they have going on, even if only momentarily. If they want to rescue our families, then they should be doing a proper damn job of it like the Navy, not this half-assed nonsense that leaves a paper trail extending across the cluster. This current setup will get everyone killed or blackmailed if it is allowed to continue.

You're off to another P.O.W holding ground, {[character]player.name}, same as before. This time though, you won't be liberating anyone. In fact there is not even a Federation presence inside this facility. It is where the Ishukone prisoners have been held before being escorted back home. Your job is simply to deliver a document from Katsen. In it, he explains the extent to which we could ruin Ishukone with this information, and then requests a meeting. Due to the extreme sensitivity of this information, we'd prefer by far if you could personally deliver the document.
messages.zh:
我们终于搞清楚他们在干什么了，{[character]player.name}。来自那节点的破解后的数据给了我们一个铁一般的证据。异株湖集团私下里在与盖伦特联邦进行战俘交换，而且更让人气愤的是，他们只管自己集团里的人，其他加达里人一概不顾。

接下来我们就要让异株湖知道他们的行动已经被人知道了。捏住他们这个把柄之后，我们就能确保将米卡诺安然无恙地送回去。但更重要的是我们能让他们停耍这种业余小花招，哪怕只是一会会儿。如果他们真想救人，那就应该做得像海军一样，哪能像现在这样到处留下足迹，屁股也擦不干净。现在这样搞下去大家不是都死在他们手里，就是被敲诈。

{[character]player.name}，你现在就像刚才一样，再去另一处战俘囚禁点。这次不是去救人，其实那里根本没有盖伦特联邦的人守候。那里是我前面说的异株湖集团救人的一个中转站。你的任务就是去送交卡僧的一份信件。卡僧在他的信里会告诉异株湖集团我们已经掌握了他们的真实行动，如果将其公之于众那就足以毁了他们。卡僧会要求与他们会面。鉴于此事的极度敏感性，我们希望由你去亲自递交此信。

messages.en:
Well that was interesting, eh? I could almost see how red-faced that Watch Commander was.

You did well, {[character]player.name}. Don't doubt it for a second. I need to relay another message back to Katsen and then we'll discuss how to proceed from here.
messages.zh:
啊哈，那场面一定很有意思吧？我完全能想像那司令那副气急败坏的表情。

你干得很好，{[character]player.name}，不要怀疑自己。我需要再回复卡僧，之后我们就谈接下来的行动。

messages.en: Then go. Just go.
messages.zh: 那就请立即动身。

messages.en:
According to Niteloho Koirolen, Kaalakiota Corporation chief spokesperson, the program will be conducted by both the corporation's intelligence division and the Home Guard, the goal being the development of a comprehensive resource database of the Black Rise region. The program will survey the planets and moons across 49 systems in 6 constellations.

"Today's announcement reinforces Kaalakiota's commitment to the development of the Black Rise region," said Koirolen. "Although the State had previously done an outstanding job in Black Rise, there is still a lot to discover. We are sure that our program will ultimately contribute to the welfare of the whole State."

The Black Rise region borders established Caldari and Gallente space and was previously deemed impenetrable, despite many efforts to map it. However, Caldari forces gained access to the region and secretly colonized it. Although it is clear that operations in Black Rise persisted for a longer time, experts claim that the region is still largely unexplored.
messages.zh:
据卡拉吉塔集团的新闻主发言人妮特罗·库诺棱称，该探测计划将由集团情报部与家庭保安公司合作进行，目的是要建立一个全面的暗涌之域的资源数据库。该计划将探测6个星座49个星系中的行星与卫星。

“今天这一消息的宣布再次印证了卡拉吉塔集团对暗涌之域开发的专注投入度”，库诺棱说道。“虽然国家已经在暗涌之域做了大量工作，但仍有许多地方尚待发掘。我们相信我们的这一计划最终将造福全国。”

暗涌之域接壤加达里及盖伦特边境。虽然以前也有很多人做过勘测尝试，但一直都无法触及那领域。不过加达里军队之前已进入了那片区域，悄悄地在那里搞殖民运动。虽然大家都清楚这殖民运动进行已有一段时间，但专家还声称该星域仍有大片区域未被开发。

messages.en: Kaalakiota unveils Black Rise survey program, Scope article, March 4th, YC 111
messages.zh: 《卡拉吉塔集团宣布暗涌之域探测计划》，“视角”YC 111年3月4日发表的一篇文章

Your job is simply to deliver a document from Katsen. In it, he explains the extent to which we could ruin Ishukone with this information, and then requests a meeting. We're pretty confident they'll make time to schedule us in.

{[character]player.name}，你现在就像刚才一样，再去另一处战俘囚禁点。这次不是去救人，其实那里根本没有盖伦特联邦的人守候。那里是我前面说的异株湖集团救人的一个中转站。你的任务就是去送交卡僧的一份信件。卡僧在他的信里会告诉异株湖集团我们已经掌握了他们的真实行动，如果将其公之于众那就足以毁了他们。卡僧会要求与他们会面。我们相信他们一定会答应这条件的。

鉴于此事的极度敏感性，我们希望由你去亲自递交此信。你已经证明你是个靠得住的人，我想让你这次跑个腿应该不算要求很高吧？

messages.en: Then go. Just go.
messages.zh: 那就请立即动身。

messages.en: Have you made the delivery yet?
messages.zh: 你把信送到了吗？

We're pretty confident they'll make time to schedule us in.

Due to the extreme sensitivity of this information, we'd prefer by far if you could personally deliver the document. You've proven so dependable that we hoped a quick flyover wouldn't be too much to ask?
messages.zh:
我们终于搞清楚他们在干什么了，{[character]player.name}。来自那节点的破解后的数据给了我们一个铁一般的证据。异株湖集团私下里在与盖伦特联邦进行战俘交换，更让人气愤的是，他们只管自己集团里的人，其他加达里人一概不顾。你获取的信息中显示了该集团将他们自己人运回合众国之前先要经过的众多中转地。

事实上，卡僧认为他们还救其他人只是想让总人数看上去比较正常而已，以便不让他人起疑心。我不知道卡僧的论断是否正确，但以我的经验来看，我认为他的怀疑有道理。

接下来我们就要让异株湖知道他们的行动已经被人知道了。捏住他们这个把柄之后，我们就能确保将米卡诺安然无恙地送回去。但更重要的是我们能让他们停耍这种业余小花招，哪怕只是一会会儿。如果他们真想救人，那就应该做得像海军一样，哪能像现在这样到处留下足迹，屁股也擦不干净。现在这样搞下去大家不是都死在他们手里，就是被敲诈。

{[character]player.name}，你现在就像刚才一样，再去另一处战俘囚禁点。这次不是去救人，其实那里根本没有盖伦特联邦的人守候。那里是我前面说的异株湖集团救人的一个中转站。你的任务就是去送交卡僧的一份信件。卡僧在他的信里会告诉异株湖集团我们已经掌握了他们的真实行动，如果将其公之于众那就足以毁了他们。卡僧会要求与他们会面。我们相信他们一定会答应这条件的。

鉴于此事的极度敏感性，我们希望由你去亲自递交此信。你已经证明你是个靠得住的人，我想让你这次跑个腿应该不算要求很高吧？

messages.en: Then go. Just go.
messages.zh: 那就请立即动身。

messages.en: Have you made the delivery yet?
messages.zh: 你把信送到了吗？

messages.en: The Black Eagles wanted me to talk to Ascain Adeset. She's a reformed human trafficker working for TransStellar in Mesybier. I don't trust her; she sounds like a rat for the Feds. I met up with her in Mesybier, on the border between Essence and Placid.
messages.zh: 黑鹰要求我去见艾丝坎·艾得塞特。她是个有诱骗人口前科、现为泛星船运在美希比尔打工的改造犯。我不信任她；她像是联邦的一只老鼠。我在精华之域与宁静之域两地交界处的美希比尔星系与其会了面。

messages.en: The Black Eagles want me to talk to Ascain Adeset. She's a reformed human trafficker working for TransStellar in Mesybier. I don't trust her; she sounds like a rat for the Feds.
messages.zh: 黑鹰要求我去见艾丝坎·艾得塞特。她是个有诱骗人口前科、现为泛星船运在美希比尔打工的改造犯。我不信任她；她像是联邦的一只老鼠。

messages.en: Good luck. Let me know when you find the kid. I'll make sure we spread the story across all the holovids in the Federation. You'll be a national hero, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运。找到那孩子后就告诉我。我肯定会让你的事迹通过全息视频传遍整个联邦。你会成为国家英雄的，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
That Black Eagle agent gave me the name of a TransStellar Shipping employee: Ascain Adeset. Looking in to our records, she's had a pretty nasty past, especially in the human trafficking business. She had a rather spectacular arrest about twenty years ago. Looks like she's been clean for a few years and is doing some legit business now. I'll bet that she turned rat in prison.

She's currently located in Mesybier. Best to follow the Feds and talk to her.
messages.zh:
黑鹰给了我一个泛星船运员工的姓名：艾丝坎·艾得塞特。从我们的资料上看，她过去有段很不光彩的历史，尤其是在人口诱骗方面。大概20年前，她在一次惊心动魄的追击行动中被捕。现在看起来她好像已经做了数年正人君子，在做正经生意。但我打赌她在牢狱里其实又变坏了。

艾丝坎目前在美希比尔。我最好还是照按联邦的意思去与她谈谈。

messages.en: I don't blame you. This rat sounds untrustworthy. But think of the kid, will ya?
messages.zh: 我不怪你，毕竟这前科犯给人感觉不牢靠。但请你想想那孩子，嗯？

messages.en:
That Black Eagle agent gave me the name of a TransStellar Shipping employee: Ascain Adeset. Looking in to our records, she's had a pretty nasty past, especially in the human trafficking business. She had a rather spectacular arrest about twenty years ago. Looks like she's been clean for a few years and is doing some legit business now. I'll bet that she turned rat in prison.

Ascain's currently located in Mesybier. Best to follow the Feds and talk to her.
messages.zh:
黑鹰给了我一个泛星船运员工的姓名：艾丝坎·艾得塞特。从我们的资料上看，她过去有段很不光彩的历史，尤其是在人口诱骗方面。大概20年前，她在一次惊心动魄的追击行动中被捕。现在看起来她好像已经做了数年正人君子，在做正经生意。但我打赌她在牢狱里其实又变坏了。

艾丝坎目前在美希比尔。我最好还是照按联邦的意思去与她谈谈。

messages.en: You can't quit now. What'll happen to that poor boy?
messages.zh: 你现在不能撒手撤退。那可怜的孩子怎么办？

messages.en: Have you talked to the Black Eagles' rat yet?
messages.zh: 你和那黑鹰的前科犯谈过了吗？

name.de: Rahsa zum Schweigen bringen: Der Weg der Nation
name.es: El fin de Rahsa: El camino de la nación
name.fr: Faire taire Rahsa : La voie de la Nation
name.ja: ラハサの口封じ:サンシャのやり方
name.ru: Устранить Rahsa: путь Нации (Silence Rahsa: The Nation's Path)

messages.en: Alike Minds
messages.zh: 想法相近

messages.en: You went with Rahsa's plan. His execution will be swift, and the Amarr will never discover the depth of the conspiracy. Krethar Mann, a minor partner in the scheme, became your new agent.
messages.zh: 你照睿萨的计划去做了。他很快将被执行死刑，然后艾玛将永远被蒙在鼓里。克列塔尔·曼因是这起阴谋的副帮手，她现在是你的新代理人了。

messages.en: Rahsa was sent for immediate execution. Rahsa's promised contact, Krethar Mann, wishes to speak to you.
messages.zh: 睿萨即将被处以死刑。他答应的那叫克列塔尔·曼因的联系人想和你谈谈。

messages.en: Krethar Mann may be able to communicate wirelessly. Worth a shot.
messages.zh: 克列塔尔·曼因可能可以进行无线通信。你去试试。

messages.en:
I got a message from a Krethar Mann. Seems your efforts have attracted her attention. Can't say I blame her. You did well. You've again proven yourself a stalwart friend of the Empire.
Krethar Mann is currently in her ship in Oguser. You may want to try communicating with her remotely.
messages.zh: 我从克列塔尔·曼因那儿收到一条信息。看起来你的表现已经引起了她的注意。我没法怪她，谁叫你干得这么出色呢？你再次证明你是帝国可信赖的朋友。克列塔尔·曼因现驾驶者船在欧古瑟尔星系。你可能需要与她进行远程交谈。

messages.en: Seemed like an innocent line for more work, but whatever.
messages.zh: 看起来你还是个不懂世故的人啊，随便你了。

messages.en:
You've proven yourself to me time and again. Rahsa will be sent for sentencing immediately. I love it when the system works quickly.

By the way, I got a message from a Krethar Mann. Seems your efforts have attracted her attention. Can't say I blame her. You did well. You've again proven yourself a stalwart friend of the Empire. Krethar Mann is currently in her ship in Oguser. You may want to try communicating with her remotely.
messages.zh:
你一次又一次地向我证明了你自己。睿萨马上就要被判刑了。我喜欢速判速决。

顺便说一下，我从克列塔尔·曼因那儿收到一条信息。看起来你的表现已经引起了她的注意。我没法怪她，谁叫你干得这么出色呢？你再次证明你是帝国可信赖的朋友。克列塔尔·曼因现驾驶者船在欧古瑟尔星系。你可能需要与她进行远程交谈。

messages.en: Seemed like an innocent line for more work, but whatever.
messages.zh: 看起来你还是个不懂世故的人啊，随便你了。

messages.en: Krethar Mann can be found in Oguser.
messages.zh: 你可以在欧古瑟尔找到克列塔尔·曼因。

messages.en: You assaulted a secured science facility and obtained a large supply of primordial biomass for the Sansha plot.
messages.zh: 你袭击了一座有防卫设施的科研基地，获取了大批用于萨沙阴谋的一级生物质。

messages.en: Your first mission is to retrieve a sample of primordial biomass from a secured science facility.
messages.zh: 你的第一个任务就是从一座有防卫设施的科研基地里拿取一个一级生物质的样本。

messages.en: It is refreshing to work with a client as reasonable as yourself.
messages.zh: 与像你这么明理的客户合作真让人觉得爽快。

messages.en:
What we require first is a supply of biomass. We cannot use standard clone-grade biomass; any common thug could acquire vats of that from the local medical station. We are looking for a variation known as “primordial biomass.” It is currently only used in controlled science labs for extremeophile research.

One of my ships will meet you at the acceleration gate. Head to the science facility and retrieve the primordial biomass. You may have to assault the facility directly. Once you have the biomass, return it to our ship at the entrance. When it has been transferred to the ship's cargo, I'll contact you with the next mission.
messages.zh:
我们首先需要生物质。那些标准的克隆级生物质我们不能用。任何一个土匪就能从当地医疗站里获得一箱箱这样的东西。我们需要的是“一级生物质”。现在只有严格监控的极端微生物研究实验室里才用到这样的物品。

我的一艘船会在加速轨道那里与你会面。到达那实验室之后就把一级生物质取出来。不过你可能得先攻击那实验室。拿到生物质之后就到入口把它交给我们的船。我们的船收到那东西之后我就会再联系你商讨下一个任务。

messages.en: Splendid. My associates will be very pleased to hear of your excellence.
messages.zh: 好极了。我的手下获悉你的出色表现之后必将很满意。

messages.en: Pity.
messages.zh: 可惜啊。

messages.en: Do not worry about your identity being decoded by the Amarr authorities. While you are acting in my employ, I will be masking your ID from their registered capsuleer database. I cannot protect you if you violate the law in other activities, but in any sites I specify you may engage Amarr without fear of retribution.
messages.zh: 你不用担心你的身份被艾玛当局知道。只要你在为我做事的时候，我就会掩饰你的身份，让艾玛无法通过其注册克隆飞行员数据库查到你的身份。你在干其他事情时违反我没法保你，但只要你在我指定的地点与艾玛交锋，你就无需担心遭受报复打击。

messages.en: Deniability
messages.zh: 矢口否认

messages.en:
Hello, Capsuleer. Rahsa spoke highly of your tracking skills. You should feel proud; his praise never came easily. And do not worry about Aralin Jick. He has not betrayed his blessed ideals. The Nation has had no influence over him for many years.

Myself? I am not Sansha, though for the purposes of our business I speak for their interest. And do keep in mind it would do no good to run back to the authorities to turn me in. You will find we are quite untouchable.

On to business. My associates are engaged in a certain project that you can contribute greatly to. What we require first is a supply of biomass. We cannot use standard clone-grade biomass; any common thug could acquire vats of that from the local medical station. We are looking for a variation known as “primordial biomass.” It is currently only used in controlled science labs for extremeophile research. I have the location of one such base.

Head to this location. One of my ships will meet you at the acceleration gate. Head to the science facility and retrieve the primordial biomass. You may have to assault the facility directly. Once you have the biomass, return it to our ship at the entrance. When it has been transferred to the ship's cargo, I'll contact you with the next mission.
messages.zh:
你好，克隆飞行员。睿萨对你的追踪本事持以高度评价。你应该感到自豪。他可不是随便表扬别人的人。阿拉林·基可你就别担心了。他还没背弃他的理想。多年来萨沙一直掌控不了他。

我？虽然为了生意我为萨沙说话，但我并不是萨沙人。而且你要记住回去向政府报告我对你没好处。没人可以动我们。

没人可以动我们。我手下正在进行一个项目，你可以帮上大忙。我们首先需要生物质。那些标准的克隆级原生物质我们不能用。任何一个土匪就能从当地医疗站里获得一箱箱这样的东西。我们需要的是“一级生物质”。现在只有严格监控的极端微生物研究实验室里才用到这样的物品。我这里有其中一座实验室的地址。

请前往该地点。我的一艘船会在加速轨道那里与你会面。到达那实验室之后就把一级原生物质取出来。不过你可能得先攻击那实验室。拿到原生物质之后就到入口把它交给我们的船。我们的船收到那东西之后我就会再联系你商讨下一个任务。

messages.en: Pity.
messages.zh: 可惜啊。

messages.en: Does my associate's ship have the primordial biomass yet?
messages.zh: 我手下驾驶的船收到那一级生物质了吗？

messages.en: Kandus Sandar's men destroyed a Sansha flotilla and briefly held the command signal receiver until you took it back.
messages.zh: 堪都司·杉达尔的人干掉了一支萨沙小分队并拿到了指令接收器。后来你又夺回了那接收器。

messages.en: The MIO destroyed a Sansha flotilla carrying a command signal receiver. You must destroy the Amarr ships and recover the item.
messages.zh: 内务部干掉了一支手上握有指令接收器的萨沙小分队。你必须摧毁那些艾玛船，夺回那接收器。

messages.en: I do so enjoy the ironies of life.
messages.zh: 我喜欢生活中的讽刺。

messages.en:
A very important flotilla carrying a command signal receiver was recently destroyed by the Amarr. This is a very specialized and controlled piece of Nation hardware.

This is the battle site. You will find the Sansha ships already destroyed, but the MIO ships are still surveying the wreckage. Eliminate the Amarr ships and find the command signal receiver. When the Amarr ships have been cleared, I will send one of my ships to pick up the device, same as before.
messages.zh:
最近艾玛干掉了一支手上握有指令接收器的重要小分队。这是萨沙的一个专用掌控物件。

这是战场。你会看到已毁的萨沙舰船，但内务部的打捞船也在那儿。去把艾玛的船都干掉，然后找到那指令接收器。你把艾玛的船都清理掉之后，我会像之前一样，派艘船过去拿那个接收器。

messages.en: We're one step closer to completing our project. More than that, you have earned my associate's trust.
messages.zh: 我们离完成项目又近了一步。更重要的是，你获得了我下属的信任。

messages.en: Never turn down an opportunity to improve your standing.
messages.zh: 你不应该放弃能提升你声望的机会。

messages.en:
Well, well, our friend at the MIO has been busy. We had assumed the authorities would have lost interest with the death of Rahsa, but they have proven persistent in assaulting the remaining Sansha forces.

A very important flotilla was recently destroyed by the Amarr. This particular group was carrying a very important component to our plan: a command signal receiver. This is a very specialized and controlled piece of Nation hardware. Only a rare few Sansha are implanted with one, and upon a Slave's death the device self-destructs. A number of very taught strings had to be pulled to procure this device, and we do do not want the Amarr to study the device in any detail.

This is the battle site. You will find the Sansha ships already destroyed, but the MIO ships are still surveying the wreckage. Eliminate the Amarr ships and find the command signal receiver. When the Amarr ships have been cleared, I will send one of my ships to pick up the device, same as before.
messages.zh:
哼，我们的内务部朋友最近很忙啊。虽然我们以为艾玛政府应该已经不再过问睿萨的死讯，但他们还是不依不饶地对剩余萨沙部队一网打尽。

最近艾玛干掉了一支非常重要的小分队。那支队伍手上握有对我们计划至关重要的一件东西：指令接收器。这是萨沙的一个专用掌控物件。只有极少数的萨沙人植入了该件物体，且劳工一死，这东西就会自毁。我们费了好大劲才把这东西搞到手，决不能让艾玛人把它带走去研究。

这是战场。你会看到已毁的萨沙舰船，但内务部的打捞船也在那儿。去把艾玛的船都干掉，然后找到那指令接收器。你把艾玛的船都清理掉之后，我会像之前一样，派艘船过去拿那个接收器。

messages.en: Never turn down an opportunity to improve your standing.
messages.zh: 你不应该放弃能提升你声望的机会。

messages.en: Do you have the command signal receiver?
messages.zh: 你拿到那指令接收器了吗？

messages.en: Krethar Mann revealed the Amarr contact to be former Miyan security commander Terrus Harkan. Harkan made a deal with the Sansha to sow discord and, amidst the chaos, replace Lord Miyan with a duplicate that could be controlled. You retrieved the final piece of the replacement: a mind scan from an Amarr databank.
messages.zh: 克列塔尔·曼因透露那艾玛联系人是前米雅安安全部队队长特里斯·哈坎。与萨沙商量过后，哈坎将制造混乱，然后浑水摸鱼用一个能被操控的米雅安大人克隆替换掉其本人。你完成了该计划的最后一步：从一个艾玛数据库中拿到了一个思维拷贝。

messages.en: Krethar Mann revealed the Amarr contact to be former Miyan security commander Terrus Harkan. Harkan made a deal with the Sansha to sow discord and, amidst the chaos, replace Lord Miyan with a duplicate that could be controlled. For the final piece, you are being sent to hack a communications array to gain access to the ideal mind scan for use with the replacement.
messages.zh: 克列塔尔·曼因透露那艾玛联系人是前米雅安安全部队队长特里斯·哈坎。与萨沙商量过后，哈坎将制造混乱，然后浑水摸鱼用一个能被操控的米雅安大人克隆替换掉其本人。为了完成这最后一步，你需要破解一个通信阵列以获得可用于那克隆的理想思维数据。

messages.en: Do not concern yourself with the mind's identity. The original personality was a close approximation for Miyan, and any variances will be overridden by our controls.
messages.zh: 那思维的主人身份不用你操心。那人性格与米雅安很相像，剩下的细微偏差由我们操控来弥补。

messages.en:
There is one more piece that is required before we make our final play. As you have likely guessed we are building a clone of Lord Miyan. There is one particular mind scan that is perfect for our use. This mind scan is kept on a planet side facility for psychiatric research. It has one vulnerable point, accessible by hacking the system's comm relay.

Find the comm relay at this location. Hack into the relay, and we can pull the mind scan directly to our server.
messages.zh:
在该计划成型之前我们还有一件事情要做。就像你可能已猜到的那样，我们正在造一个米雅安大人克隆体。我们已经找到了一个特别适合我们的思维拷贝。它现在一座行星设施里被用于精神研究。该设施有个弱点，通过破解系统通信中继器，你可以获取其中的数据资料。

请前往该地点寻找那通信中继器，找到后将其破解。这样我们就可以将那思维拷贝数据直接拖到我们服务器上了。

messages.en: Yes, we are receiving the data stream now.
messages.zh: 是的，我们已经在接收数据流了。

messages.en: Do not think you can return to the authorities with our identities. Not only are we untouchable, but you are the one who attacked all those Amarr facilities. It would be a shame if those records came to light.
messages.zh: 别以为你能向政府报告我们的身份。不但没人能碰我们，而且攻击所有那些艾玛设施的人正是你。你把事情抖出来对你自己没好处。

messages.en:
My associate is a man named Terrus Harkan. He was once the head of Lord Miyan's security forces and later an activist for slavery reform. After years of watching the Holders bicker and drag the Empire into pettiness and unrighteousness, he came to us with a fascinating plan. We are going to replace Lord Miyan with himself. Or something close.

Sansha's Nation has a solid lead in mind-body cybernetics. Using the appropriate combination of implants the Sansha can create an effective verisimilitude of a human intelligence, and that can receive directives from the Nation. With this replacement Harkan wishes to turn the Kor-Azor political landscape around and restore the honor Harkan believes it once had.
messages.zh:
我的副手名叫特里斯·哈坎。他曾是米雅安大人安全部队的队长，后来又成了一为倡导劳工改革的政治活动家。在数年目睹贵族将帝国引向下坡路之后，他来我们这里提出了一个大胆计划。我们要用米雅安将米雅安大人本身调包替换掉。

萨沙在心体神经学方面的造诣首屈一指。他们将多个植入体巧妙组合之后，创造出了能听从其指挥的逼真人类智慧。哈坎希望用了米雅安的替身之后能扭转柯埃佐的政治局势，让柯埃佐重塑尊贵地位。

messages.en: Harkan's Plan
messages.zh: 哈坎的计划

messages.en:
There is one more required piece before we make our final play. As you have likely guessed we are building a clone, a doppelganger of Lord Miyan that we control. This is an extremely complex creation, as it must be both technologically sophisticated and detection-proof. To make the illusion truly convincing, we need one final thing: a mind scan.

There is one particular mind scan that is perfect for our use. The man is long dead, executed, but the government considered his unique viewpoint still worthy of study. He was killed by the same mind scan process used by you capsuleers. This mind scan is kept on a planet side facility for psychiatric research. It has one vulnerable point, accessible by hacking the system's comm relay.

Find the comm relay at this location. Hack into the relay, and we can pull the mind scan directly to our server.
messages.zh:
在该计划成型之前我们还有一件事情要做。就像你可能已猜到的那样，我们正在造一个克隆，一个可由我们操控的米雅安大人克隆体。这是项非常复杂的过程，技术上既要精细，表面上也不能让人看出来。为了让此克隆做到100%可信，我们还需要最后一件东西：一个思维拷贝。

我们已经找到了一个特别适合我们的思维拷贝。那思维的原主人早就被执行死刑了，但政府认为其独特思维尚有研究价值。他是被你们克隆飞行员同样采用的思维拷贝手段干掉的。这人的思维拷贝现在一座行星设施里被用于精神研究。该设施有个弱点，通过破解系统通信中继器，你可以获取其中的数据资料。

请前往该地点寻找那通信中继器，找到后将其破解。这样我们就可以将那思维拷贝数据直接拖到我们服务器上了。

messages.en: Do not think you can return to the authorities with our identities. Not only are we untouchable, but you are the one who attacked all those Amarr facilities. It would be a shame if those records came to light.
messages.zh: 别以为你能向政府报告我们的身份。不但没人能碰我们，而且攻击所有那些艾玛设施的人正是你。你把事情抖出来对你自己没好处。

messages.en: Have you hacked into the comm relay?
messages.zh: 你破解那通信中继器了吗？

messages.en: It is done. You stormed Miyan's safe house, decimating the remaining defenders. After placing Harkan's artificial Miyan in the ruins, he was recovered by Riff Hebian. Nobody is the wiser; not that they would believe the truth. The question still remains whether Harkan or the Sansha control this new Miyan, or if anyone does.
messages.zh: 你完成了任务。你闯入米雅安的居所，歼灭了残余的守卫。在你把哈坎的假米雅安置于一片废墟之后，里夫·赫比安救出了这个替身。人都是容易被蒙骗的。至于现在到底是谁控制这个替身，是哈坎还是萨沙抑或是无人控制，没人知道答案。

messages.en: You are to assault the safe house of Lord Miyan, destroy it, and place the replacement Miyan in the ruins.
messages.zh: 你的任务就是袭击米雅安大人的居所，摧毁它，然后将米雅安的替身安放在一片废墟之中。

messages.en: After this is done, our foothold in this region will be secured, and Harkan will have his revenge.
messages.zh: 把这搞定之后，我们在此地就站稳了脚跟，哈坎也算报仇了。

messages.en: Meet my ship at the entrance to Miyan's safe house. It will provide you with Lord Miyan's "replacement." Fight your way through the levels of the compound until you find his safe house. Destroy the structure and any ships present, and in the wreckage place the replacement. The Amarr forces will find him in the rubble and believe that Miyan survived. Then your work will be complete.
messages.zh: 请在居所的入口处与我的船汇合。它会给你米雅安大人的“替身”，然后你一路打到那居所里去。摧毁看到的一切建筑与舰船，在一片废墟之中安置好那个替身。然后艾玛军队会在残垣断壁中发现他，还以为米雅安幸存了下来。这样你就算完成了任务。

messages.en:
Excellent! The new Miyan is awaking now. He will stand up to any medical scan and questioning. My clients can now influence this region as they see fit. The time may come when the Sansha need to be removed, but until then our position is good enough. Harkan is very pleased.

You have done well, Capsuleer. Perhaps one day my organization will make use of you again.
messages.zh:
太棒了！新的米雅安已经苏醒。他现在可经受任何医学检查与审问。我的客户现在可以随意对此地施加影响了。也许哪天萨沙不得不被除掉，但我们现在这样很好。哈坎很满意。

干得好，克隆飞行员。说不定哪天我的军团会再次用你。

messages.en: Do not think we will forget this betrayal.
messages.zh: 别以为我们会忘了你此次的背叛。

messages.en:
Now for the last step. The remaining Sansha ships are assaulting a Miyan station even as we speak. Riff Hebian believes this is the final battle against the Sansha, so he has committed the majority of his forces. While they are away, you will attack our true target: Lord Miyan's safe house.

Meet my ship at the entrance to the compound. It will provide you with Lord Miyan's "replacement." Fight your way through the levels of the compound until you find his safe house. Destroy the structure and any ships present, and in the wreckage plant the replacement. The Amarr forces will find him in the rubble and believe that Miyan survived. Then your work will be complete.
messages.zh:
现在进行最后一步。剩下的萨沙舰船目前在进攻米雅安的一座空间站。里夫·赫比安相信这是对萨沙的最后一战，因此他已经投入了绝大部分军队。你趁他们远去的时候去袭击我们真正的目标：米雅安大人的居所。

请在居所的入口处与我的船汇合。它会给你米雅安大人的“替身”，然后你一路打到那居所里去。摧毁看到的一切建筑与舰船，在一片废墟之中安置好那个替身。然后艾玛军队会在残垣断壁中发现他，还以为米雅安幸存了下来。这样你就算完成了任务。

messages.en: Do not think we will forget this betrayal.
messages.zh: 别以为我们会忘了你此次的背叛。

messages.en: Has the switch been made?
messages.zh: 那调换完成了吗？

messages.en: You met MIO investigator Kandus Sandar.
messages.zh: 你与内务府的调查员堪得斯·撒达见了面。

messages.en: Kandus Sandar, an MIO agent in Nahyeen, requires aid.
messages.zh: 位于纳伊恩的内务府的代理人堪得斯·撒达要求援助。

messages.en: Most excellent. You will find Kandus Sandar in Nahyeen.
messages.zh: 好极了。你会在纳伊恩找到堪都司·杉达尔的。

messages.en:
Greetings, pilot. Her Majesty's Ministry of Internal Order wants your aid.

My fellow agent, Kandus Sandar, is currently investigating Sansha activity in Kor-Azor, more specifically in the Miyan territories. Are you willing to lend help to his investigation?
messages.zh:
你好，飞行员。女王陛下统领的内务府要求你帮助。

我的一位代理人同僚，堪都司·杉达尔，正在柯埃佐，更准确地说是米雅地区，调查萨沙的活动情况。你愿意助他一臂之力吗？

messages.en: You will find Kandus Sandar in Nahyeen.
messages.zh: 你会在纳伊恩找到堪都司·杉达尔的。

messages.en:
Arsten told me that the Thukker and Krusual tribes have analysts poring over all the data I recovered from the RSS agent's compound. He thinks it will be a little while until they can sort out the good leads from the dead ends, though. In the meantime, he had me report to the RSS and continue the investigation into the Wildfire Khumaak alongside them. Our aim is to figure out the historical, and perhaps cultural, significance of the Wildfire Khumaak.

Arsten has also warned me about trusting the RSS too much. He remains suspicious about their involvement in this affair. In fact, this is part of the reason why he recommended me as the Brutor tribe liaison. I've made it to Aldrat in Metropolis and reported to the RSS Corporal. The next step is to see what the RSS needs of me.
messages.zh:
阿斯顿告诉我，图克尔和克鲁夏部落已经派来研究分析人员对我从共和安全局的代理人基地中拿来的那批数据进行了分析。他认为那帮人要从一团乱麻中理出新头绪还需要点时间。与此同时，阿斯顿要我去向共和安全局报道，与他们一起继续野火库马克的研究工作。我们的目的是要研究出野火库马克的历史或者还有文化上的意义。

阿斯顿提醒我不要太相信共和安全局。他对安全局在整个事件中所扮演的角色仍心存疑虑。事实上这就是他推荐我作布鲁特联络人的一部分原因。我已经飞抵了美特伯里斯的奥德拉特星系，并向那位安全局下士报了个道。接下来就看共和安全局要我做什么了。

messages.en:
Arsten tells me that the Thukker and Krusual tribes have analysts poring over all the data I recovered from the RSS agent's compound. He thinks it will be a little while until they can sort out the good leads from the dead ends. In the meantime, he wants me to report to the RSS and continue the investigation into the Wildfire Khumaak alongside them, with the aiming of figuring out its historical, and perhaps, cultural significance.

Arsten has also warned me about trusting the RSS too much. He remains suspicious about their involvement in this affair. In fact, this is part of the reason why he recommended me as the Brutor tribe liaison.

阿斯顿提醒我不要太相信共和安全局。他对安全局在整个事件中所扮演的角色仍心存疑虑。事实上这就是他推荐我作布鲁特联络人的一部分原因。

messages.en:
Firstly, an update on the documents you recovered from the RSS agent's compound. The Thukker and Krusual have flown in analysts to go over the copies. It may take some time to sift through the data and find the fresh leads, but I'm confident they'll find something useful in there.

In the meantime I have something else for you to do. I've made a few arrangements with the RSS and convinced them to let you continue to work on this Wildfire Khumaak business. Officially, you will be acting as the RSS liaison for the Brutor tribe, but in reality, you'll be on the front line working for the both of us to figure out what's going on. You're our go-to guy for this one and you got that job based on my recommendation. Don't make me look bad, alright?

I've been asked to point you towards Corporal Nilf Abruskur, who you can find in the system of Aldrat, Metropolis. I don't know the guy, but I do know the RSS, and my advice is not to trust them too much. In fact, part of the reason you've been recommended for this job is that I know I can rely on your judgment.

I want you to keep an eye on this RSS operation. My gut still tells me that they're keeping something secret from us.
messages.zh:
首先，我跟你讲一下与你取得的那些文档有关的最新消息。图克尔和克鲁夏人已经派来专家来分析研究那些文档。虽然他们可能需要点时间去查阅数据以便找到新线索，但我还是相信他们能出成果。

于此同时，我有其他事情要你打理。我已经说服了共和安全局,和他们商量安排好让你继续处理野火库马克这件事。官方口径上，你是布鲁特在共和安全局的联络人。但实际上你要为双方在前线打探情报。我们需要情报就来找你而且你是因我推荐才做得此事的。别让我丢脸，好吗？

按照指示，你得去找下士尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克，他在美特伯里斯的奥德拉特星系。我虽然不认识这人，但我很了解共和安全局。我建议你不要过于轻信那帮人。其实我推荐你的部分原因就是因为觉得我能相信你的判断力。

我要时刻注意共和安全局。直觉告诉我他们有事瞒着我们。

Arsten told me that the Thukker and Krusual tribes have analysts poring over all the data I recovered from the RSS agent's compound.
