messages.en: Well, I'll need to find someone else then, I suppose. How disappointing for us to come so far together and yet part ways now. Well, fly safe {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 好吧，看来我得另寻他人了。我们合作了这么久，现在却要分道扬镳，真是太让人遗憾了。算了，祝你一路顺风吧，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Excellent, you're back. Firstly, I have an update on the documents you recovered. The Thukker and Krusual have flown in analysts to go over the copies. It may take some time to sift through the data and find the fresh leads, but I'm confident they'll find something useful in there.

In the meantime I have something else for you to do. I've made a few arrangements with the RSS and convinced them to let you continue to work on this Wildfire Khumaak business. Officially, you will be acting as the RSS liaison for the Brutor tribe, but in reality, you'll be on the front line working for the both of us to figure out what's going on. You're our go-to guy for this one and you got that job based on my recommendation. Don't make me look bad, alright?

I've been asked to point you towards Corporal Nilf Abruskur, who you can find in the system of Aldrat, Metropolis. I don't know the guy, but I do know the RSS, and my advice is not to trust them too much. In fact, part of the reason I recommended you for this job was because I know I can rely on your judgment. That, and you know how to deliver results.

I want you to keep an eye on this RSS operation. My gut still tells me that they're keeping something from us. I suppose we'll see, right?
messages.zh:
太好了，你回来了。首先，我跟你讲一下与你取得的那些文档有关的最新消息。图克尔和克鲁夏人已经派来专家来分析研究那些文档。虽然他们可能需要点时间去查阅数据以便找到新线索，但我还是相信他们能出成果。

于此同时，我有其他事情要你打理。我已经说服了共和安全局,和他们商量安排好让你继续处理野火库马克这件事。官方口径上，你是布鲁特在共和安全局的联络人。但实际上你要为双方在前线打探情报。我们需要情报就来找你而且你是因我推荐才做得此事的。别让我丢脸，好吗？

按照指示，你得去找下士尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克，他在美特伯里斯的奥德拉特星系。我虽然不认识这人，但我很了解共和安全局。我建议你不要过于轻信那帮人。其实我推荐你的部分原因就是因为觉得我能相信你的判断力，而且你也知道如何做成一件事情。

我要时刻注意共和安全局。直觉告诉我他们有事瞒着我们。但我们早晚会知道，对吧？

messages.en: Well, I'll need to find someone else then, I suppose. You've disappointed me, {[character]player.name}, this isn't like you.
messages.zh: 好吧，看来我得另寻他人了。{[character]player.name}，你太让我失望了，这哪像你的为人？！

messages.en: Songs of the Past
messages.zh: 昔日之歌

messages.en: I met with an RSS agent named Nilf Abruskur. An RSS spy in the Ammatar Mandate was at risk of being compromised by the Mandate's own spy in the RSS. I only had a few minutes to get to his RSS post, kill him, and bring back the things he was making off with. I did so, and the Ammatar source expressed gratitude. Apparently, they have some info on the Wildfire Khumaak.
messages.zh: 我与共和安全局的一个叫尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克的代理人见了面。艾玛达特统区里有个共和安全局的情报官，她现在有被该局里一个艾玛达的间谍暴露的危险。我必须在很短的时间里就抵达那艾玛达间谍的住处，干掉他，然后带回他企图拿走的东西。我完成了这一任务，那艾玛达情报官对我表示感谢。很明显，他们知道一些与野火库马克有关的信息。

messages.en: I met with an RSS agent named Nilf Abruskur. Seems an RSS spy in the Ammatar Mandate is at risk of being compromised by the Mandate's own spy in the RSS. I only have a few minutes to get to his RSS post, kill him, and bring back whatever it was he was making off with. Lomar Vujik is his name. Abruskur assured me the RSS ships in the vicinity wouldn't fire on me, as they've been cut in on the loop.
messages.zh: 我与共和安全局的一个叫尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克的代理人见了面。艾玛达特统区里有个共和安全局的情报官，她现在有被该局里一个艾玛达的间谍暴露的危险。我必须在很短的时间里就抵达那艾玛达间谍的住处，干掉他，然后带回他企图拿走的东西。这家伙名叫喽马·维约克。阿布拉斯克向我保证附近共和安全局的船不会向我开火，因为他们已经知道事情原委了。

messages.en: Good. His name is Lomar Vujik. As soon as he emerges, terminate with extreme prejudice. Recover any data that wasn't destroyed and then report immediately back to me.
messages.zh: 很好。他名叫喽马·维约克。看到他，什么话都别说，直接干掉就行。任何留下来的数据你都要拿到然后回来向我报告。

messages.en: We have reliable information that an Ammatar counteragent is about to make his escape from one of our facilities sometime in the next fifteen minutes. I want you to stay outside his station and make sure he does not get away. As soon as he emerges, terminate with extreme prejudice. Recover any data that wasn't destroyed and report back to me.
messages.zh: 据可靠消息，15分钟后，来自艾玛达的一个间谍就将从其居所出逃。我要你现在就去他空间站外侍候，千万别让他溜了。看到他，什么话都别说，直接干掉就行。任何留下来的数据你都要拿到然后回来向我报告。

messages.en: It's good to know we're on the same page, {[character]player.name}. Our asset in Ammatar sends their thanks. They've been gathering information for us; there will be something shortly. Get back to me in a minute or two.
messages.zh: 很好，{[character]player.name}，看样子我们的想法都一致。我们在艾玛达的那个情报官对我们表示了感谢。他们一直以来都在为我们收集情报，很快他们就会取得新线索。你过一会儿就来找我。

messages.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.
messages.zh: 很好。你要记住你在这儿看到的东西是机密。千万别让我们以后为这事来找你。

messages.en:
Greetings {[character]player.name}, I'm Corporal Nilf Abruskur, I'm glad to have you working with us. Now, we have much to discuss and little time in which to discuss it, so if you don't mind I'll get straight to the point.

You conducted yourself with skill and cunning for Agent Takalo. Due to this, and due to the fact that you're already involved in this delicate matter we have decided to enlist your services, if you will provide them.

As you've no doubt learned by now, it appears we have an intelligence asset in the Ammatar Consulate, and their handler – our agent – has disappeared under mysterious circumstances as well. It is a messy situation at the moment, but I have little doubt that we'll clean it up one way or another.

Our Ammatar asset is the priority for now; if we can find her, we will be able to make sense of the Wildfire Khumaak you have discovered. The tribes have their best people working on those documents you recovered as well, trying to glean her identity from something in there, but even though we don't know her identity, they have shown us who one of her enemies is.

The data you have recovered has strongly supported existing evidence that we have an Ammatar counteragent in our midst, and now we have their name. We believe this person has gathered information that may compromise our own source in the Ammatar government. This traitor is currently residing at one of our residential quarters with his family, completely unaware that the world is about to come crashing down on him.

We've dissolved his ship's FTL link without his knowledge, and for the past twelve hours we've run a dead-end intercept on every transmission he's tried to make out of the area. We know he's about to make an escape with his family sometime soon.

Your task is to ensure that ship does not escape the area intact. Local agents will stand down, they know the score.
messages.zh:
你好{[character]player.name}，我是下士尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克，很高兴能与你合作。我们有很多要谈，但可谈的时间又太少，如果你不介意，咱们就直奔主题了。

你在为代理人塔克洛效力的时候展现出了你的技术与智慧。鉴于此，再加上你本身已经参与此事，我们决定正式加你入伙，当然前提是你愿意。

想必你已经知道，我们在艾玛达领事馆里安插了一位情报官，而该位官员的领导——也就是我们的代理人——也已经神秘地消失了。现在情况虽有点乱，但我相信我们肯定有办法解决。

现在我们的首要任务是要找到我们的艾玛达领事馆情报官。如果能找到她，那我们就能弄清楚你拿到的那个野火库马克究竟有什么用。部落里最优秀的人才现在都在忙着处理你拿到的那些文档，希望能从那些资料里找出她的身份。不过即便我们不知道她的身份，我们也已经知道她的一个敌人。

从你获得的那些数据来看，我们这里有艾玛达的间谍，我们已经知道了他的名字。我们相信这家伙已经搞到了能让我们那位艾玛达领事馆情报官露馅儿的资料。这叛徒现和他家人住在我们的一个居住区，完全不知道我们现在打算把他给端掉的计划。

我们在其不知情的情况下破解了他船上的通信设备。过去12小时里我们一直在侦听他发往其他地方的消息，他打算很快就携带家眷出逃。

你的任务就是别让他活着出去。本地的代理人不会阻扰你，他们都已经知道此事了。

messages.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.
messages.zh: 很好。你要记住你在这儿看到的东西是机密。千万别让我们以后为这事来找你。

messages.en: Remember, {[character]player.name} – extreme prejudice.
messages.zh: 记住，{[character]player.name}，不要跟他们废话，见了就打。

messages.en:
Nilf Abruskur, the RSS man, gave me another mission. I headed out to some merc dive pleasure complex and picked up a package from the Ammatar contact. The package contained information on the Wildfire Khumaak we recovered. At the pleasure complex I was accosted by some thugs on account of being an egger, but they were easily enough gotten rid of.

Abruskur says there's more information on the Wildfire incoming, and hinted at further work for me once it arrives.
messages.zh:
安全局的尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克给了我另一项任务。我前往了某雇佣兵娱乐场所，收取了艾玛达线人送来的一袋东西。那袋中含有与我们获取的野火库马克相关的信息。在那娱乐场所我因是一名克隆飞行员而遭到一群流氓的骚扰，不过他们很快就被我甩掉。

阿布拉斯克说我们很快便会获得野火的更多信息，并暗示一旦有了这些信息，我就还有进一步的事要做。

messages.en: Nilf Abruskur, the RSS man, gave me another mission. This time I'm supposed to head out to some merc dive pleasure complex and pick up a package from the Ammatar contact. Supposedly the package will have some information on the Wildfire Khumaak. I've been instructed to guard the artifact with my life.
messages.zh: 安全局的尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克给了我另一项任务。这次我的任务是前往某雇佣兵娱乐场所，收取艾玛达线人送来的一袋东西。那袋中应该会有与野火库马克相关的信息。我被要求用生命来保护这件东西。

messages.en: Excellent. You will be well rewarded for your efforts.
messages.zh: 太好了。你会获得与你努力相适应的报酬的。

messages.en:
We've had analysts from the Krusual and Thukker tribes going over the documents you recovered from our agent's private compound. They've made one promising discovery so far which we want you to follow up.

They found a recent communication from our source inside the Ammatar Consulate. It seems she sent a package of information on the Wildfire Khumaak to the system of Jark for pickup not long ago. Our guess is that due to the sensitivity of the information and the amount of attention it's attracting, our asset in the Consulate could only get it to the border, not across. This could play in our favor though. Due to its location in the San Matar constellation – the heartlands of Ammatar space - there's a good chance our agent didn't make it out there yet. We have to be careful where our operatives are seen sometimes.

The drop-off location inside Jark is a complex known as Tili's Red Light Palace. Initial intelligence is that it's just another merc R&R dive, nothing special. Once you have arrived to the area we'll forward the exact location of the cargo.

Speaking of which, I trust I needn't remind you how important those documents could be, or indeed, how sensitive. Proceed with caution, do not take any risks.
messages.zh:
我们已经让克鲁夏与图克尔部落的分析人员翻阅了你从我们代理人私人据点那儿获得的文档。他们又有了一项重大发现，我们需要你对此展开行动。

他们发现了一项最近的通讯记录，该记录来源于我们安插在艾玛达领事馆内的一名间谍。她好像不久前将一袋与野火库马克有关的信息送往了加尔克星系，以待人接收。我们猜想可能是因为该信息的敏感度及受关注程度，她只能将信息送到边境，而不是送入。但这对我们来说也是件好事。鉴于加尔克星系在姗玛塔尔星座中的位置——它位于艾玛达的腹地，我们的那位间谍应该没有走出艾玛达的领域。你知道我们有时候必须谨慎安排我们间谍的现身地点。

加尔克星系的那个信息接收点是个名为“逖利红灯宫殿”的地方。初步情报显示那地方没什么特别，只是个雇佣兵的娱乐场所而已。你到了那地方之后，我们会告诉你那袋信息的精确位置。

相信我无须强调这些文档的重要性以及敏感性。要小心谨慎，千万别冒险。

messages.en: Well done, {[character]player.name}, thank you. We'll need a moment to go over the information here, but I imagine we'll need you again, so don't stray too far.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}，谢谢你。我们需要稍微花点时间来过目一下这些信息。但我想我们很快还会用到你，因此别走远了。

messages.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.
messages.zh: 很好。你要记住你在这儿看到的东西是机密。千万别让我们以后为这事来找你。

They found a recent communication from our source inside the Ammatar Consulate. It seems she sent a package of information on the Wildfire Khumaak to the system of Jark for pickup not long ago. Our guess is that due to the sensitivity of the information and the amount of attention it's attracting, our asset in the Consulate could only get it to the border, not across. messages.zh: 很好。你要记住你在这儿看到的东西是机密。千万别让我们以后为这事来找你。

messages.en: The package must get here in one piece. Very important, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你必须将那袋东西完好无损地拿回来。这是重点，{[character]player.name}。

name.ru: Иже еси на небеси (Who Art in Heaven)

messages.en: I was given another assignment from Nilf. The RSS wanted me to head out to a forward outpost for an archaeological dig underway near here. I was supposed to be meeting some historians who were thought to have more information on the Wildfire Khumaaks, but instead arrived to a fleet of Angel Cartel ships slaughtering everyone and everything. Whatever information was here has been taken, and the people who knew anything of value are dead or captured. After I cleared the area, the Cartel sent Nilf a message asking for a meeting. I've been asked to report back to Aldrat to be briefed on how we'll proceed from here.
messages.zh: 尼尔夫又给了我一项任务。安全局要我前往这附近一个考古发掘地的中转站。按计划我应该见到一些掌握野火库马克信息的历史学家，但结果却碰到一支冷血非常的天使舰队。他们夺走了那儿的资料，而原本掌握一些有价值情报的人不是被抓走就是被打死。在我清空了那片区域之后，天使要求与尼尔夫会面。我被要求返回奥德拉特听候后续安排。

messages.en: Nilf has given me another assignment. The RSS want me to head out to a forward outpost for an archaeological dig underway near here. There I can meet some historians who supposedly have more information on these Wildfire Khumaaks.
messages.zh: 尼尔夫又给了我一项任务。安全局要我前往这附近一个考古发掘地的中转站。按计划我应该见到一些掌握野火库马克信息的历史学家。

messages.en: Excellent. You will be well rewarded for your efforts.
messages.zh: 太好了。你会获得与你努力相适应的报酬的。

messages.en: We're sending you to a dig site to rendezvous with a couple of archaeologists. The data you recovered earlier suggests that these people will have more concrete information on the Wildfire Khumaaks. Head out there and await further instructions once in position.
messages.zh: 我们现在派你去一座考古地与一群考古学家会面。你之前拿来的资料提示这些人掌握着与野火库马克有关的具体信息。请前往那里等候进一步指示。

messages.en: We have a transmission from the Angels. Those god-damned slime-excreting vermin. I think you better get back here right now. We're gonna need you for this next part.
messages.zh: 我们收到天使发来的一条消息。这帮应该去死的家伙！你最好立即回来。我们需要你进行后续行动。

messages.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.
messages.zh: 很好。你要记住你在这儿看到的东西是机密。千万别让我们以后为这事来找你。

messages.en:
We've gone over the essential details from the information you recovered, {[character]player.name}, good work on getting this back to us. Here's the decoded message from our Ammatar source:

"All right, my sources have traced the origins of that Khumaak and we've been able to get a little bit of information, but we're still digging. There's remarkably little mention of this stuff anywhere in official records.

"It's called a Wildfire scepter. Apparently, the Wildfires were a particular kind of Khumaak-like scepter that existed only in certain conclaves of Starkman Prime in the years while the planet was under Amarrian occupation. The physical details all match up; the holes in the shaft, the blood obsidian sun center, the slightly smaller sun spirals. Only one other has been found, ever, and has since gone missing.

“According to its previous owner, the Wildfires were all destroyed some years before the Starkmanir rebellion in 22947, and it's not even known for what purpose they were initially created or why, indeed, they were destroyed. We'll have our sources keep investigating.

“Lastly, I've cleared you for entrance to the ruins of St Arzad. I've attached the relevant security access codes. I give you my word that the people there will provide their full cooperation and discretion. I'm told that one of the historians even has a text that mentions this Khumaak of yours.”

There is nothing to suggest that our own agent ever made it out to those ruins. He did not pick up the package you recovered, and he has still not returned to base. As our temporary representative, you will be standing in for him.

Your task is to travel to an orbital forward point for an archaeological dig being conducted on a nearby planet. There's a team of historians and archaeologists there, a couple of which are supposed to have texts that reference the Wildfire Scepters. Make your way over there and await further instructions. We'll get to the bottom of this mystery yet.
messages.zh:
我们已经看过了你获取的信息中的重点，{[character]player.name}，你干得不错。我们已经把艾玛达线人发来的信息破解了出来，现在让我们来听一下：

“现在，我的情报人员已经追查到了那个库马克的源头而且已经获得了一些信息，不过我们还在查。官方记录中对它的提及少得可怜。”

“这东西叫野火权杖。初步来看，野火是种特殊的库马克之类的权杖，只在当年艾玛强占斯塔科马首星时在那行星上举行密会时才使用。这玩意儿的物理特征完全符合历史记载：这杆子上有洞，中央有个血色黑曜石恒星，还有较小的恒星螺旋。人们至今只发现过一根这样的权杖，而且现在已经丢了。”

“据其之前的所有者称，所有的野火都在22947年斯塔科马人抗争之前就被统统销毁了。谁都不知道当初为什么要造那些东西，也不知道它们为什么会被消灭。我们还得让情报人员继续追查。”

“最后，我已经帮你们扫清了进入阿尔扎德废墟的障碍。我附上了相关的通行密码。我保证那里的人会全面配合你们。我甚至听说那儿有个历史学家存有一段历史资料，其中提到了你们的库马克。”

这段录音中并未提到我们的代理人去了那废墟。他也没有拿到你取得的一袋信息，而且到现在为止还没回基地。我要你作为我们的临时代表去顶替他。

你的任务就是去一个附近行星的考古发掘地的轨道中转站。那里有一队历史学家与考古学家，其中有些人应该有野火权杖的历史资料。请前往那儿等候进一步指示。我们很快就能把这一切查个水落石出。

messages.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.
messages.zh: 很好。你要记住你在这儿看到的东西是机密。千万别让我们以后为这事来找你。

messages.en: The texts must get here in one piece. Very important, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你必须把那些资料完好无损地带过来，这点非常重要，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Nilf Abruskur, the RSS man, gave me another mission. I headed out to a major Angel Cartel staging outpost, intending to snatch back the documents the Angels stole from the historians. The outposts' defensive force was supposed to be tied up elsewhere, so this should have been a cakewalk for me. Unfortunately we had some bad intel, and the Angels showed up en masse. Regardless, I got the job done.
messages.zh: 安全局的尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克给了我另一项任务。他们要我前往天使集团的一个主要集结哨站，拿回天使从历史学家那儿夺走的资料。那哨站的防守部队应该会被牵制在别处，我的此次任务应该是很轻松的。倒霉的是我们的情报有误，哨站那儿有一批天使的人。不过我还是顺利完成了任务。

messages.en: Nilf Abruskur, the RSS man, gave me another mission. They want me to head out to a major Angel Cartel staging outpost and snatch back the documents the Angels stole from the historians. They'll have the outpost's main defensive force tied up elsewhere, so it should be a cakewalk for me to go in there, overpower what defenses there are and get the docs. They'll be in some data banks on the underside of the station. All I need to do is hack my way in, grab drive cluster EDF-285 and get out of here.
messages.zh: 安全局的尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克给了我另一项任务。他们要我前往天使集团的一个主要集结哨站，拿回天使从历史学家那儿夺走的资料。他们会在其他地方拖住哨站的大部分防守部队，这样我的哨站之行就将变得很轻松，把那儿的留守部队解决掉之后拿到资料就行。那些资料在空间站下方的数据库里。我要做的就是破解闯入，拿到那EDF-285磁盘簇，然后离开。

messages.en: We're counting on you, {[character]player.name}, not just for the information this time, but to help us keep our reputation and morale after being dealt such a blow by those Angel bastards. The RSS is hurting right now. I need you to fire my men up. Make us proud.
messages.zh: 我们就靠你了，{[character]player.name}。这次不仅是为了情报，也是为了能在遭天使重创之后保住我们的名声与士气。安全局目前日子不好过，我要你重振我手下人的士气，让我们找回尊严。

messages.en: We're sending you to the location where the Angel Cartel is keeping the Wildfire Khumaak documents they just snaked out from under us. We've set up a diversion elsewhere, so most of the force normally stationed at the base will be tied up with us. That should give you the leeway you need to bust in there, grab drive cluster EDF-285 from the data banks and get out well before they can muster any sort of reply.
messages.zh: 我们派你去天使集团的一个基地，那里匿藏了他们从我们手里拿走的野火库马克资料。我们在别处声东击西，这样原本驻扎在那基地上的大部分部队就会别吸引出去。这将给你闯入那里大开方便之门。请从数据库中拿取EDF-285磁盘簇，然后趁天使还没反应过来之前离开那里。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. The Republic Security Services are in your debt.
messages.zh: 好极了，{[character]player.name}。共和国安全局欠你一个人情。

messages.en: What a disappointment. I can see my initial misgivings about you were well-founded. Should have known, I suppose. You eggers are never to be trusted. In any case, do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.
messages.zh: 太让人失望了。看来我一开始对你存有的偏见完全正确。只怪我自己没有早点觉悟到。你们克隆飞行员永远不值得相信。不管如何，你都要记住你在这儿看到的东西是机密。千万别让我们以后为这事来找你。

messages.en:
We dropped the ball on this one {[character]player.name}, and those putrescent, motherless Angel freaks made sure to capitalize on it. Our only consolation is that it cost them, too. We've managed to root the Angel spy within our ranks – the one who tipped the Cartel off about your visit to the historians. They're in a world of trouble right now; you can trust me on that.

From our initial interrogation of this captured Angel agent, we have learned that just before the Cartel blew up the outpost, they managed to find and make away with the data we needed on the Wildfire Khumaak. The historian that was supposed to have a text for you relating to it was tortured into handing over his research and was then killed.

They're offering us a deal. We give them back their agent, and they give us the information we want. They tried to make a bid for the Wildfire, but there wasn't a chance in hell we going to entertain that idea, especially once we discovered who their agent was. We negotiated it down to the agent, but we have no intention of making a fair deal with them, simply because when it comes to the Angels, there is no such thing. They have no desire for the safe return of this traitorous scum; in fact if they could kill him right now to shut him up, they wouldn't hesitate.

In addition to providing us intel that the historical texts on the Khumaak have been taken, our captured agent has also revealed something else: it's location. His testimony and a good deal of other intelligence we're receiving is pointing to one of the Angels' main staging outposts in Metropolis.

The defense forces posted at this place are impressive, {[character]player.name}, beyond even your capabilities. We've come up with a plan to lure some out and reduce their numbers to something you'll be more easily able to manage. We forced subversion on our Angel prisoner, made him tell his superiors that we're sending a huge ambush fleet to the meeting point. This should goad them into bringing along a bigger reserve of manpower, most of which will be drawn from that base.

While we're having the meet, you sneak in, bypass the remaining resistance, and grab the texts that were taken. Underneath the central command center, we're told there will be several data banks. The documents we're looking for will be in one of these. You'll need to deactivate the security firewalls, which means some hacking. You're looking for a drive cluster called "EDF-285." Grab it and get the hell out of there before the Angels figure out the game.
messages.zh:
我们在这件事情上失误了，{[character]player.name}。那帮低贱没娘养的天使竭尽全力地利用了这一点。我们唯一的安慰就是他们也有所损失。我们已经把混迹我们之中的天使间谍揪了出来，就是他把你要拜访历史学家的事情告诉了天使集团。相信我，他们现在的日子也不好过。

在对这位天使间谍的初期审问中我们得知，天使集团在炸掉那座哨站之前，已经找到了我们需要的有关野火库马克的数据并将它带走了。那个本应向你提供资料的历史学家经过严刑拷打之后，将资料交给了天使，随后即被谋害。

天使想与我们谈判。他们要我们把那位间谍交还给他们，然后他们就提供我们想要的信息。天使想把库马克拿出来像商品一样卖，我们可不会满足他们这一想法，尤其是在我们发现了他们的间谍是何人之后。虽然我们向那间谍通报了这一情况，但我们不会和天使来一场公平交易。天使集团本身就是个不守信用的组织。他们其实并不渴望他们那人渣间谍回去。如果现在给他们机会灭口，他们一定会二话不说就这样做。

除了告诉我们与库马克有关的历史资料都被带走外，那间谍还招了另一个信息：资料的存放地。从他本人口供及我们多方收集的情报来看，存放地很有可能就是天使在美特伯里斯的一个主要集结哨站。

{[character]player.name}，那儿的防备力量可不一般，非你能力所及。我们已经想出了个计划，把他们大部队引出来，将他们的留守人数降到一个你可以轻松应对的水平。我们逼迫那天使间谍对其领导说我们要派一支规模浩大的舰队前往会面地点偷袭他们。这样天使集团必定会从那基地调动大部队出来与我们会面。

你乘我们会面的时候溜进去，躲过留守的防卫部队然后拿到那被带走的资料。听说在指挥中心下面有好几个数据库。我们要的资料应该就在其中一个数据库里。你需要先关闭安全防火墙，也就是说你得进行破解工作。你要找一个叫“EDF-285”的磁盘簇。拿到之后就赶紧趁天使还没回来之前离开那地方。

messages.en: What a disappointment. I can see my initial misgivings about you were well-founded. Should have known, I suppose. You eggers are never to be trusted. In any case, do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.
messages.zh: 太让人失望了。看来我一开始对你存有的偏见完全正确。只怪我自己没有早点觉悟到。你们克隆飞行员永远不值得相信。不管如何，你都要记住你在这儿看到的东西是机密。千万别让我们以后为这事来找你。

messages.en: Please make sure the correct drive cluster reaches us, {[character]player.name}. It's of vital importance.
messages.zh: 请确保拿到正确的磁盘簇，{[character]player.name}。这东西太重要了。

messages.en: Inertia
messages.zh: 惯性

messages.en: I met with Ascain Adeset, a former smuggler that focused on human trafficking. The FIO have been using her as an informant for years, and she has connections everywhere in the black market. Personally, I think the FIO are getting desperate by sending me to this rat, or they're really shaken up about the Syndicate's involvement with the kidnapping. Either way, Ascain offered me three places to visit: The Spintrix, a well-known brothel; Rattler Row, a sweatshop; and the Octomet Plantation. I made my choice and am ready to delve into New Eden's dark underbelly.
messages.zh: 我与艾丝坎·艾得塞特见了面，她以前专搞人口诱骗工作。联邦情报局多年来一直雇她做线人，她的人脉遍布整个黑市。我觉得联邦情报局要么是穷途末路了才让我与这人见面，要么就是对辛迪加财团牵涉绑架这事非常恼火。总之，艾丝坎给了我三个可选的去处：一、著名的娱乐站“思宾克斯”；二、作坊“响尾蛇之声”；三、奥科特梅庄园。我意已决，准备孤身深入调查这一地下勾当。

The FIO have been using her as an informant for years, and she has connections everywhere in the black market. Personally, I think the FIO are getting desperate by sending me to this rat, or they're really shaken up about the Syndicate's involvement with the kidnapping. Either way, Ascain offered me three places to visit: The Spintrix, a well-known brothel; Rattler Row, a sweatshop; and the Octomet Plantation.

messages.en:
Mourmarie sent you? How sweet. She hadn't used me in a while, but this kidnapped kid is kinda big. That's why the Black Eagles have pros like me on the, er, team. I'm in the freight business, and I'm completely legit now, I swear. My specialty used to be in sentient biomass freight, if you catch my drift, but now I focus on moving livestock. Not nearly as profitable, but it's honest.

Trafficking kids is a tricky business. Yeah, they're small, but people have a soft spot for a sad child, so you gotta find places where nobody will notice them or care. I know a few of these places around these parts, but this is grasping at straws, really. The kid could be anywhere at this point.

Check out one of these places, and I'll send some of my friends to the others. Some eggers like you owe me favors. So take your pick.
messages.zh:
摩尔马列派你来的？太好了。她已经很长时间没用我了，不过这次孩子遭绑架一事看起来还闹得蛮大的。知道黑鹰为什么需要像我这样的人入伙了吧。我现在跑运输，而且我发誓我现在做的事情完全合法。虽然我过去专职负责运送——呵呵，但愿你听得懂——有感知能力的生物体，可我现在已转业负责牲畜的运输工作。虽然钱赚得不再像以前一样多，但至少是个正当行业。

诱骗儿童是桩微妙的事情。没错，他们身躯细小，但人一般对可怜儿童都有恻隐之心，所以人贩子一般会把他们带往没人注意或睁只眼闭只眼的地方。我知道一些这样的地方，但你最好别期望太高。那孩子目前可能在任何地方。

你先去其中一个地方找找，剩下的其他地方我会让我的一些朋友去瞧。像你这样的克隆飞行员还欠我人情呢，快按我说的去做吧。

name.ja: オクトメットプランテーション

messages.en: The Octomet Plantation is a child farm, a plantation dedicated to the storage and herding of unwanted, or possibly stolen, child. A truly terrible sight. The plantation had no leads, though I did manage to take out some plantation keepers while I was there. Hopefully that'll lead to freedom for those kids, though I doubt I can truly change anything.
messages.zh: 奥科特梅庄园是个儿童农场，专用来匿藏一些遭抛弃或是被拐的孩子。那地方看上去绝对吓人。虽然我解决掉了该庄园的一些保安，但它并未给我带来任何线索。希望我给那些孩子带去了自由，虽然我知道我并不能真正改变什么。

messages.en: I chose to explore the Octomet Plantation, a known agricultural center that serves as a child farm. I'm not sure if Ralie is there, but of my three options, this seemed like the most likely place to hide a child. I've heard of the Octomets: They were practically a dynasty in this region. But news of them has been quiet in recent years.
messages.zh: 我决定去看看奥科特梅庄园。那地方是出了名的儿童农场基地。我不确定拉赖是否在那儿，但在我的三个候选地中，那里是最有可能藏匿孩子的地方。我听说过奥科特梅：他们是本星域的一个王朝家族。不过近几年他们的新闻曝光率很低。

messages.en:
Plus, you know, we can take out some of the competition. If I were still in this business.

I mean: I really care about those poor, poor kids and that hard life they lead. Tears at the heartstrings, et cetera, et cetera, blah blah blah.
messages.zh:
除此之外我们还能除掉一个竞争对手。唉，如果我还在从事这行就好了。

其实我想说的是：我真的确实很关心那帮可怜的孩子，为他们的遭遇心痛且流泪……反正就是那些套话啦。

messages.en:
There's a plantation nearby called the Octomet Plantation. From what I've heard, it's connected to the Syndicate, but who knows? All I know is that if you want to hide a kid, there's no better place than a child farm. To me, all kids look alike anyway.

Take a gander around the plantation and see if Ralie is there. Seeing as he's a high profile kid, odds are he's in their mansion. I could be wrong about all this, of course. But either way, you'll be taking out some bad guys, right? You'll probably have to fly to lowsec to get to this plantation. Gotta warn you beforehand so you don't come blaming me if some pirate takes you out when you're not looking. Better fit a battlecruiser or heavy frigate. You know, something sneaky.
messages.zh:
附近有个叫“奥科特梅”的庄园。我听说它与辛迪加财团有联系，不过究竟如何只有天知道。反正我只知道如果你想藏匿一个孩子，那儿童农场绝对是上佳之选。对我而言，所有的孩子都是一个模子里刻出来的。

请去那庄园看看拉赖是否在那儿。由于他是个大人物的孩子，因此很有可能待在一座别墅里。当然事实可能会有所出入，但无论如何，你都得先解决掉一帮坏人对吧？要到那庄园，你可能得飞入低安全区。我这是提醒你，不要到时候自己没注意被海盗爆船反而来怪我。你最好驾驶战列巡洋舰或者重型护卫舰之类容易潜入的飞船行动。

messages.en: Nothing? No kid? I got one more place to try. The Feds don't know about it because I never showed them before. But if we really need the info, it'll be there.
messages.zh: 什么都没有？没有孩子？我还有一个地方你可以去看看。联邦政府对此一无所知，因为我从来都没告诉过他们。如果我们确实需要知道那孩子的下落，那地方应该不会再错了。

messages.en: You can do whatever you want, just so long as you make sure to tell Miss Mone that I did my part.
messages.zh: 你爱怎么做就怎么做，反正你只要告诉蒙小姐我已经完成了自己的职责就行。

messages.en: The last known member of the Octomet family is Arnalen Octomet, a former executive in Quafe. He was the last member of a withering dynasty, and much like his family, he could not handle the lifestyle of a wealthy socialite. Drugs, especially Frenetix (a diluted form of the Frentix booster) took control of his life. Within a few years, all of the former Octomet properties were abandoned or foreclosed. Arnalen Octomet disappeared shortly afterward, assumed dead, though he has been spotted as a day laborer in some systems in Solitude.
messages.zh: 奥科特梅家族最后一位有名成员是阿尔纳棱·奥科特梅，他是酷菲的一位前高层，也是一个没落王朝的最后一名成员。像他家族里所有的人一样，他无法收敛自己奢华糜烂的生活作风。药物，尤其是福兰尼克斯（“疯癫”增效剂的稀释版）毁了他的一生。不出几年，所有奥科特梅的地产不是被废弃就是被银行收缴。阿尔纳棱·奥科特梅随后便人间蒸发。大家都认为他死了，不过有人称在孤独之域的一些星系里看到过他在干苦工。

messages.en: Arnalen Octomet
messages.zh: 阿尔纳棱·奥科特梅

messages.en:
What most people realize is that slavery exists everywhere around New Eden, not just in the Amarr Empire. Except around here we don't call it slavery; we call it farming. Children are great for the big bio-farms out in the border regions and tucked away in deadspace pockets. They can work the fields at practically no cost, and you barely have to feed them. Since they're kids, they don't get no paycheck. Plus, you can raise them like cattle. It's a great racket, if you're into that type of thing.

There's a plantation nearby called the Octomet Plantation. From what I've heard, it's connected to the Syndicate, but who knows? All I know is that if you want to hide a kid, there's no better place than a child farm. To me, all kids look alike anyway.

Take a gander around the plantation and see if Ralie is there. Seeing as he's a high profile kid, odds are he's in their mansion. I could be wrong about all this, of course. But either way, you'll be taking out some bad guys, right? You'll probably have to fly to lowsec to get to this plantation. Gotta warn you beforehand so you don't come blaming me if some pirate takes you out when you're not looking. Better fit a battlecruiser or heavy frigate. You know, something sneaky.
messages.zh:
很多人都意识到奴役在这宇宙中是普遍存在的现象，绝非艾玛的特产。只不过我们不叫它奴役，我们称之为“耕作”。对于那些边境地区与死亡空间里的大型生物农场来说，童工是最好的选择。他们在田里干活几乎不费成本，而且你基本上不用喂养他们。他们是孩子，所以不拿钱。你可以把他们当牲畜养。如果你有兴趣加入，这绝对是个来钱快的行当。

附近有个叫“奥科特梅”的庄园。我听说它与辛迪加财团有联系，不过究竟如何只有天知道。反正我只知道如果你想藏匿一个孩子，那儿童农场绝对是上佳之选。对我而言，所有的孩子都是一个模子里刻出来的。

请去那庄园看看拉赖是否在那儿。由于他是个大人物的孩子，因此很有可能待在一座别墅里。当然事实可能会有所出入，但无论如何，你都得先解决掉一帮坏人对吧？要到那庄园，你可能得飞入低安全区。我这是提醒你，不要到时候自己没注意被海盗爆船反而来怪我。你最好驾驶战列巡洋舰或者重型护卫舰之类容易潜入的飞船行动。

messages.en: You can do whatever you want, just so long as you make sure to tell Miss Mone that I did my part.
messages.zh: 你爱怎么做就怎么做，反正你只要告诉蒙小姐我已经完成了自己的职责就行。

messages.en: I chose to explore the Rattler Row, a sweatshop utilizing child labor. I knew places like this existed, but I never heard of one in this area. Though it doesn't surprise me: The more I hang around this area, the more I realize how close we are to the unseemly void outside the Federation. My visit to the Rattler Row didn't go well. Part of the factory exploded – I have no idea how many kids died in that explosion – and Ralie was not there. I can only hope that Ascain has a better lead for me.
messages.zh: 我决定去一探榨取童工的“响尾蛇之声”的究竟。虽然我听说过这种地方存在，但我之前还从来不知道本地区也会有这样的地方。正如我预料的那样：我在此地跑得越多，就越能意识到这地方离联邦无力管辖的真空区已经不远了。我的“响尾蛇之声”之行并不顺利。那厂被炸掉了一部分——我不知道有多少孩子命丧其中——拉赖也不在那里。但愿艾丝坎能再提供给我一个更好的线索。

messages.en: I chose to explore the Rattler Row, a sweatshop utilizing child labor. I knew places like this existed, but I never heard of one in this area. Though it doesn't surprise me: The more I hang around this area, the more I realize how close we are to the unseemly void outside the Federation. I'm hoping that Ralie is at the Row, though I am doubtful.
messages.zh: 我决定去一探榨取童工的“响尾蛇之声”的究竟。虽然我听说过这种地方存在，但我之前还从来不知道本地区也会有这样的地方。正如我预料的那样：我在此地跑得越多，就越能意识到这地方离联邦无力管辖的真空区已经不远了。希望拉赖在那儿，但我还是不确定。

messages.en: I remember my recruiting days. I made a lot of ISK back then. Probably my heyday, to be honest. Those were the days. I got so much because of those kids. Bless them.
messages.zh: 我记得我招募童工的那段日子，当时我赚了很多钱。说实话，那可能是我人生最辉煌的一段时光。不过这些都已经过去了。我能获得那么多也是因为那些孩子。谢谢他们。

messages.en:
The Rattler Row sweatshop focuses on manufacturing ammunition, though it's not always the legit product. They're really a front for counterfeit ammo, which is shoddily produced and sold to rubes all over the black market. Dangerous stuff, really. Kids seem pretty adept at making ammo, though, so they keep the product available at incredibly low costs.

Ralie could be there, working on the factory floor. Explore the Rattler Row. Look for any signs of Ralie. You'll probably run into some of their guards, so take them out. It's a long shot, but it's worth a shot.
messages.zh:
虽然“响尾蛇之声”主要生产弹药，但其产品并非一直是正品。那地方其实是盗版弹药的生产前线，将一些粗制滥造的东西卖给黑市里不识货的人。这样做的确很吓人。不过由于小孩子好像很能生产弹药，因此他们能将成本控制在不可思议的低水平。

拉赖可能正在那工厂里干活呢。你去视察一下那地方，看看是否有拉赖的影子。你可能会遇到些保安，只管把他们干掉就行。虽然拉赖不一定就在那里，但我认为还是值得一试。

messages.en: Nothing? No kid? I got one more place to try. The Feds don't know about it because I never showed them before. But if we really need the info, it'll be there.
messages.zh: 什么都没有？没有孩子？我还有一个地方你可以去看看。联邦政府对此一无所知，因为我从来都没告诉过他们。如果我们确实需要知道那孩子的下落，那地方应该不会再错了。

messages.en: You can do whatever you want, just so long as you make sure to tell Miss Mone that I did my part.
messages.zh: 你爱怎么做就怎么做，反正你只要告诉蒙小姐我已经完成了自己的职责就行。

messages.en: Technology levels vary throughout New Eden. Not every system, constellation, or even region is at the cutting edge of technology. Sometimes, factories rely on old-fashioned techniques and tried-and-true methods. Child labor is one of those methods. A child's tiny hands and little fingers are perfect tools for creating the high-end textiles of Gallente fashion, as well as reaching those hard-to-reach corners of ship armaments. Though not commonplace – or legal, for that matter – sweatshops like the Rattler Row can be found in the more backwards areas of New Eden.
messages.zh: 各宇宙角落里的科技水平各有高低。不是每个星系、星座甚至是星域都站在科技前沿的。有时工厂还依赖传统技艺与祖传手法。用童工就是其中之一。孩子的纤细手指很适合编织盖伦特的高档布品，也很适合触及那些成人触摸不到的舰船边边角角。虽然不常见也不合法，但“响尾蛇之声”一类的血汗工厂还是时常能在宇宙中偏远落后的地方看到。

messages.en: Sweatshops
messages.zh: 血汗工厂

messages.en:
Though I don't think it's the Syndicate's style – too obvious, if you ask me – there is one place very near here that could be holding the kid: the Rattler Row.

Rattler Row is, for lack of a better word, a sweatshop. Child labor is more common than you think, and not just at child farms like the Octomet Plantation. Much of the manufacturing produced throughout New Eden is based on the exploitation of the young. Is it legal? Debatable. Is it profitable? Absolutely. It's also the bread and butter of human smugglers, although sweatshop owners refer to them as “recruiters.”

The Rattler Row sweatshop focuses on manufacturing ammunition, though it's not always the legit product. They're really a front for counterfeit ammo, which is shoddily produced and sold to rubes all over the black market. Dangerous stuff, really. Kids seem pretty adept at making ammo, though, so they keep the product available at incredibly low costs.

Ralie could be there, working on the factory floor. Explore the Rattler Row. Look for any signs of Ralie. You'll probably run into some of their guards, so take them out. It's a long shot, but it might be worth it.
messages.zh:
虽然我认为这样太明显，不符合辛迪加财团做事的一贯风格，但说不定他们就把孩子放在离此处很近的一个叫“响尾蛇之声”的地方。

叫“响尾蛇之声”实在是因为想不出更好的词，其实那里就是个血汗工厂。童工这一现象不仅存在于奥科特梅庄园之类的童工农场，它比你料想的要更普遍。这宇宙里多数制造业都是在剥削年轻人。你要问它是否合法，目前大家还众说纷纭。你要问它是否赚钱，大家一致认同。童工也是人贩子赖以生存的基础，不过血汗工厂的厂长们都喜欢把这群人叫做“招聘人员”。

虽然“响尾蛇之声”主要生产弹药，但其产品并非一直是正品。那地方其实是盗版弹药的生产前线，将一些粗制滥造的东西卖给黑市里不识货的人。这样做的确很吓人。不过由于小孩子好像很能生产弹药，因此他们能将成本控制在不可思议的低水平。

拉赖可能正在那工厂里干活呢。你去视察一下那地方，看看是否有拉赖的影子。你可能会遇到些保安，只管把他们干掉就行。虽然拉赖不一定就在那里，但我认为还是值得一试。

messages.en: You can do whatever you want, just so long as you make sure to tell Miss Mone that I did my part.
messages.zh: 你爱怎么做就怎么做，反正你只要告诉蒙小姐我已经完成了自己的职责就行。

messages.en: I chose to explore The Spintrix, a well-known brothel in the area. Ascain says that it's a common place to hide children, at least as a safehouse for them. I explored the brothel, but was attacked by its very loyal clientele. I fought back and took care of the situation, but it was a moot point: Ralie was nowhere to be found. I hope Ascain has some better leads for me when I see her next, because this place was a complete dead-end.
messages.zh: 我选择去查看一下此地著名的螺旋设施娱乐站。艾丝坎说那地方常用来藏匿儿童，至少可以作为他们的避难所。我在娱乐站周围转悠了一下，立刻遭到其中客户的攻击。我开火反击，化险为夷，可惜这娱乐站没用：我在里面找不到拉赖，这完全是个死胡同。但愿我再见到艾丝坎时她能给我提供一些更有用的线索。

messages.en: I chose to explore The Spintrix, a well-known brothel in the area. Ascain says that it's a common place to hide children, at least as a safehouse for them. I'm supposed to check it out and see if Ralie is somewhere inside.
messages.zh: 我选择去查看一下此地著名的螺旋设施娱乐站。艾丝坎说那地方常用来藏匿儿童，至少可以作为他们的避难所。我的任务就是去那儿看看拉赖是否在里面。

messages.en: If you see any Spintrix coins, take them. They're tokens for good times, if you catch my meaning. And then there are the Spintrixiate ones…
messages.zh: 如果你看到螺旋设施硬币，就请尽管拿。它们象征着美好的时光——但愿你懂我这句话的意思——如今又是另一种硬币在当道……

messages.en:
There's a brothel that has been known to hide some kids. Not for working there, mind you: The flesh trade can be seedy, but they're not that immoral. At least, not that ones I know of. The place is called The Spintrix. Real nasty little place. I might have frequented there in my younger days, but their standards have plummeted. The men working there are way below even my meager standards.

Go to Archavoinet and visit The Spintrix. Poke around there and see if the kid is there. You may get some aggression from their clientele – they're practically animals – so take them out. If a whore loses business, it's no skin off my back. You will have to fly through lowsec to get to this destination. It isn't far, and The Spintrix is actually in a highsec system. If you think you can run the gauntlet in your current ship, go ahead, but watch out for pirates. Don't say I didn't warn you.
messages.zh:
我知道有个娱乐站藏匿儿童是出了名的。那地方叫螺旋设施，绝对是个垃圾场所。我年轻时常光顾那儿，不过现在那里档次降低了许多。

请前往位于埃察沃内特的螺旋设施。看看那儿是否有那孩子的踪影。那儿的顾客可能不会对你很友好，你把他们干掉就行。你必须途径低安全区才能抵达目的地。那地方离此不远，而且螺旋设施本身也在高安全区。如你觉得驾驶现在这艘船没问题，那就尽管前往，但要提防海盗。别到时候说我没提醒过你。

messages.en: Nothing? No kid? Well, it was a long shot, but I guess it was worth a try. I got one more place to try. The Feds don't know about it because I never showed them before. But if we really need the info, it'll be there.
messages.zh: 什么都没有？没有孩子？算了，这本来就是不确定的事，不过我希望此行还是值得的。我还有一个地方你可以去看看。联邦政府对此一无所知，因为我从来都没告诉过他们。如果我们确实需要知道那孩子的下落，那地方应该不会再错了。

messages.en: You can do whatever you want, just so long as you make sure to tell Miss Mone that I did my part.
messages.zh: 你爱怎么做就怎么做，反正你只要告诉蒙小姐我已经完成了自己的职责就行。

messages.en: The Spintrix is akin to an adult theme amusement park: Every ride costs a token, and The Spintrix has special tokens especially for their services. Spintrix coins are very difficult to come by, and they are worth a lot of money on the black market. Long time customers are said to receive a special coin that allows the access to the more exotic areas provided by this brothel.
messages.zh: 螺旋设施与游乐场很相像：每一项娱乐项目都要消耗一个代币券。螺旋设施为其服务项目提供特殊的代币券。要获得这些代币券并不容易，它们在黑市上值很多钱。老顾客据说能拿到一种特殊的代币券，凭此种券它们能进入该娱乐站中一些更为奇异的场所。

messages.en: The Spintrix Coin
messages.zh: 螺旋设施硬币

messages.en:
A strange habit found among body smugglers is to hide stuff at brothels. I don't know exactly why they do this. Maybe the flesh trade, whatever they're dealing with, just sort of attracts itself. I don't know.

Anyway, there's a brothel that has been known to hide some kids. Not for working there, mind you: The flesh trade can be seedy, but they're not that immoral. At least, not that ones I know of. The place is called The Spintrix. Real nasty little place. I might have frequented there in my younger days, but their standards have plummeted. The men working there are way below even my meager standards.

Go to Archavoinet and visit The Spintrix. Poke around there and see if the kid is there. You may get some aggression from their clientele – they're practically animals – so take them out. If a whore loses business, it's no skin off my back. You will have to fly through lowsec to get to this destination. It isn't far, and The Spintrix is actually in a highsec system. If you think you can run the gauntlet in your current ship, go ahead, but watch out for pirates. Don't say I didn't warn you.
messages.zh:
人贩子们都有一个奇怪的癖好，就是喜欢把东西藏在娱乐站里。我不知道他们究竟为何要这样做。

我知道有个娱乐站藏匿儿童是出了名的。那地方叫螺旋设施，绝对是个垃圾场所。我年轻时常光顾那儿，不过现在那里档次降低了许多。

请前往位于埃察沃内特的螺旋设施。看看那儿是否有那孩子的踪影。那儿的顾客可能不会对你很友好，你把他们干掉就行。你必须途径低安全区才能抵达目的地。那地方离此不远，而且螺旋设施本身也在高安全区。如你觉得驾驶现在这艘船没问题，那就尽管前往，但要提防海盗。别到时候说我没提醒过你。

messages.en: You can do whatever you want, just so long as you make sure to tell Miss Mone that I did my part.
messages.zh: 你爱怎么做就怎么做，反正你只要告诉蒙小姐我已经完成了自己的职责就行。

messages.en: The Carry On is a den of smugglers and thieves. According to Ascain, it's the hub of illicit activity in the region, particularly in relation to human trafficking. Ascain has been keeping this place from the Feds. When I got there, I experienced some very heavy opposition, but I was able to withstand the smugglers. They relented and gave me a location: Studio I.
messages.zh: 卡里昂是非法贩售者的温床。据艾得塞特所说，那地方是整个星域非法勾当进行的集中场所，特别是在人口诱骗方面这问题尤为严重。艾得塞特一直瞒着联邦政府，没告诉他们有这地方存在。我到那里之后遭到了非法贩售者的强烈抵抗，但我顶住了他们的炮火。他们放弃了攻击，给了我一个地址：“I 工作室”。

messages.en: The Carry On is my next location, a den of smugglers and thieves. According to  Ascain, it's the hub of illicit activity in the region, particularly in relation to human trafficking. Ascain has been keeping this place from the Feds, and she's using it now because there's no place left to look. There is bound to be some information here. Otherwise, we have no chance of finding Ralie.
messages.zh: 卡里昂是我的下个目标，那里是非法贩售者的温床。据艾得塞特所说，那地方是整个星域非法勾当进行的集中场所，特别是在人口诱骗方面这问题尤为严重。艾得塞特一直瞒着联邦政府，没告诉他们有这地方存在。她现在透露这地方是因为只剩那儿可找了。我必须在那里得到些信息，否则就没希望找到拉莱了。

messages.en: I have mixed feelings about this operation. It's like asking you to burn down my family home, you know? Even if some really bad things happened to me there…
messages.zh: 我对此项行动有种说不出的感觉。感觉像是要你去烧掉我家的房子一样，懂吗？即使那里曾发生过让我不愉快的事情……

messages.en:
The Carry On is a smuggler's haven, a collection of speakeasies and underground associations devoted to human trafficking. It was a home away from home for me back in the day. I don't think I can show my face there anymore, though. Too many enemies, too many friends. But you can.

Your best course of action is to find the Carry On hub, located at the heart of the complex. You'll probably meet some of the guards there, or even some smugglers looking to protect their own. If they hit you, strike back. Smugglers are cowards at heart. Approach the hub and see what you can find there. Attack it if you must. This pains me to think about it, but it's our only choice.
messages.zh:
卡里昂这地方是非法贩售贩的天堂，专供人口诱骗用。以前那里是我的第二故乡。但我现在已经不能再在那里抛头露面了。那里有我的众多朋友，更有我的无数敌人。不过你可以去那里。

你的任务就是去找那个位于死亡空间中央的卡里昂集中点。你可能会在那里遇到一些守卫，甚至还会有一些非法贩售者亲自出来守护。如果他们攻击你，你就反击。非法贩售人员心底里胆小得很。然后你就接近那集中点，看看有什么情况。如有必要就朝其开火。我一想到这事就痛苦，但我们别无选择。

messages.en:
Yeah, that's right. I got banned from there years ago after I got caught. Feels good to exact some revenge, though. Hope they got the message clear enough.

Anyway, I haven't heard of Studio I. I'll have to do some digging. Give me a minute while I check my sources.
messages.zh:
是的没错。三年前我被抓之后就被禁止涉足那里了。不过现在终于报了点仇，感觉不错。希望他们能识相点。

言归正传，我没听说过“I 工作室”。我要去做点调查，给我一会儿时间让我与我的人联系一下。

messages.en: Ok, good. Keep this information to yourself, though, and don't tell Mourmarie. She'll kill me for this holding this back from her. Literally.
messages.zh: 好。但这信息你自己吞进肚子里就行，千万别告诉摩尔马列，否则她真的会弄死我。

messages.en: If you found the Carry On token, you may find it useful at their illicit location. Even smugglers charge admission.
messages.zh: 如果你能找到卡里昂徽记，那它可能会在他们的不法之处那里派上用场。非法贩售贩也是收门票的。

messages.en: Carry On Token
messages.zh: 卡里昂徽记

messages.en:
Ok, ok. Don't tell Mourmarie, but I've been holding out on her. She's wrung me out of most of the info I have, especially some of the juicier leads from my former smuggling days. But this place is the mother lode, a veritable smorgasbord for the human traffickers in this corner of New Eden. You can't tell anyone about this place, though: A rat is only good if nobody knows she exists, if you catch my meaning.

The Carry On is a smuggler's haven, a collection of speakeasies and underground associations devoted to human trafficking. It was a home away from home for me back in the day. I don't think I can show my face there anymore, though. Too many enemies, too many friends. But you can.

Your best course of action is to find the Carry On hub, located at the heart of the complex. You'll probably meet some of the guards there, or even some smugglers looking to protect their own. If they hit you, strike back. Smugglers are cowards at heart. Approach the hub and see what you can find there. Attack it if you must. This pains me to think about it, but it's our only choice.
messages.zh:
好吧好吧，我是有东西没跟摩尔马列说，但你别告诉她。我向她吐露了不少信息，尤其是我以前干非法贩售时保留下来的重要线索。不过，我接下来要向你透露的这地方可不一般，那是人贩子的大温床。你可不能把此信息泄漏给别人：老鼠只有在别人不知其存在时才有用，懂我意思吧？

“卡里昂”这地方是非法贩售贩的天堂，专供人口诱骗用。以前那里是我的第二故乡，但我现在已经不能再在那里抛头露面了，因为那里有我的众多朋友，更有我的无数敌人。但是你可以去那里。

你的任务就是去找那个位于死亡空间中央的卡里昂中心。你可能会在那里遇到一些守卫，甚至还会有一些非法贩售者亲自出来守护。如果他们攻击你，你就反击。非法贩售者内心其实胆小得很。然后你就接近那集中点，看看有什么情况。如有必要就朝其开火。我一想到这事就痛苦，但我们别无选择。

messages.en: Ok, good. Keep this information to yourself, though, and don't tell Mourmarie. She'll kill me for this holding this back from her. Literally.
messages.zh: 好。但这信息你自己吞进肚子里就行，千万别告诉摩尔马列，否则她真的会弄死我。

messages.en: Ralie was taken to Studio I, an unlicensed studio hidden away in this area. I don't know what they film there, nor do I want to know. When I got there, the Pator 6 and the Syndicate were hanging around the studio. I think I saw some Impetus yachts there as well. The Pator 6 took Ralie, but it looks like I've caused a rift in their agreement with the Syndicate. All I have to do is chase those bastards down, and I can finally get the kid.
messages.zh: 拉赖被带往了摄影棚 I。那是个匿藏在此地未经注册的摄影棚。我不知道那儿在拍什么电影，也不想知道。我到了那儿之后，发现帕特六人组与辛迪加财团的人都在那儿转悠。我觉得我还在那儿看到了几艘促进工业的游轮。帕特六人组带走了拉赖，不过我好像已经让他们与辛迪加之间闹起了矛盾。我要做的只是一路跟着帕特六人组，这样就能彻底救出那孩子。

messages.en: We've finally tracked down Ralie's location, once and for all. He's been taken to Studio I, an unlicensed film studio. Who knows what seedy activity takes place in there. Time to investigate.
messages.zh: 我们终于彻底查到了拉赖的位置。他被带到了一个未经注册的名叫“摄影棚 I”的摄影棚。天晓得那里在搞什么名堂，得去调查一下。

messages.en: Sure, we're a salty bunch, to say the least, and despicable by any other means. Back in my day, we had some ethics, though. I don't know what happened since then.
messages.zh: 确实，我们再怎么讲也是一群喜欢寻衅滋事的人，遭人唾弃。但我们当年至少还讲点道德。我不知道之后发生了什么。

messages.en: This looks like a joint operation between Impetus and the Syndicate. I don't know how close that relationship is, or how high up on the corporate chain it goes. But we know the kid is there. Get in there and get him. Destroy the Studio, too. Nothing good can come from it.
messages.zh: 我感觉这像是促进工业与辛迪加财团共同参与的一项行动。我不知道他们两家之间的关系有多密切，也不会知道双方高层里有多少人了解这件事情。不过我们确信那孩子就在那儿。快去那里把他救出来，同时也要将那摄影棚摧毁。那里面肯定藏不了好东西。

messages.en: It's gone? Good. My sources tell me that the Pator 6 are flying towards Adacyne. Time to catch up!
messages.zh: 你把摄影棚摧毁了？很好。我的情报告诉我帕特六人组正飞往挨达辛。该去抓他们了！

messages.en: This may sound hypocritical, but you're a bad person for bailing out right now.
messages.zh: 虽然这听起来有些虚伪，但你现在撤了就说明你不是个好人。

messages.en:
Wow. I've never heard of this before. Studio I must be a recent development among traffickers. I really don't know much about it, but something feels off about the situation. I mean, I've been a part of some really nasty enterprises in my time – trafficking for drugs, medical experiments, slavery, you name it – but something like Studio I? No way; nothing like that.

This looks like a joint operation between Impetus and the Syndicate. I don't know how close that relationship is, or how high up on the corporate chain it goes. But we know the kid is there. Get in there and get him. Destroy the Studio, too. Nothing good can come from it.
messages.zh:
哇噢，我之前从来没听说过这个。摄影棚 I 肯定是人贩子最近搞出来的花样。虽然我确实对其没啥了解，但我总觉得这事有点怪。你想，我以前也干过一些非常低贱的勾当——非法贩售药品、药物实验及运劳工等等——但你要问我有没有搞过像摄影棚 I 之类的事情？没有，从来没有。

我感觉这像是促进工业与辛迪加财团共同参与的一项行动。我不知道他们两家之间的关系有多密切，也不会知道双方高层里有多少人了解这件事情。不过我们确信那孩子就在那儿。快去那里把他救出来，同时也要将那摄影棚摧毁。那里面肯定藏不了好东西。

messages.en: This may sound hypocritical, but you're a bad person for bailing out right now.
messages.zh: 虽然这听起来有些虚伪，但你现在撤了就说明你不是个好人。

messages.en: I don't want to talk about it anymore. Just let me know when you've destroyed that studio.
messages.zh: 我不想再说什么了。你把摄影棚捣毁之后就知会我一声。

messages.en: Ascain found the location of the Pator 6. I followed them to a junkyard. After a vicious battle against the gang leaders, Rosulf Fririk and Fardier Mante, I got Ralie and took him back to Ascain. The kid didn't look so good. Who knows what sort of nightmares he endured?
messages.zh: 艾丝坎查到了帕特六人组的位置。我跟着那帮人到了一个垃圾场。与他们的领头人物罗瑟夫·弗里力克与法迪尔·曼特一番恶斗之后，我救出了拉赖并将他带回了艾丝坎那儿。那孩子情况看上去并不佳，天知道他到底经历了怎样的噩梦？

messages.en: Ascain found the location of the Pator 6. Time to surprise them and get the kid, once and for all.
messages.zh: 艾丝坎查到了帕特六人组的位置。是时候给他们来一次出其不意的致命打击夺回那孩子了。

messages.en: What are you waiting for? Go get Ralie!
messages.zh: 你还在等时么？快去夺回拉赖！

messages.en: The Pator 6 are flying to Adacyne, and they've got Ralie with them. Time for a final showdown. Go knock them out and get the kid, once and for all. I'll start working on my contacts in the Syndicate and see if there's anything that can be done from their angle. Last thing we want is to have them go after me. Or us.
messages.zh: 帕特六人组正在飞往挨达辛，他们手上还握有拉赖。是时候来一次对决了。把他们彻底消灭，救出那孩子。我会与我辛迪加财团里的线人取得联系，看看他们能帮做什么。我最不想看到的事情就是他们来找我麻烦，或者是来找我们两人的麻烦。

messages.en: You've got the kid? Great. This will sound strange, but we have options…
messages.zh: 你救出孩子了？很好。虽然这听上去有点怪，但我们现在可以做个选择题……

messages.en: Are you kidding me? We're so close!
messages.zh: 你开玩笑吗？我们就差一口气！

messages.en:
You've really pissed off some nasty bad guys, my friend. Luckily, they're starting to turn against each other as well. That studio was the lynchpin in this whole operation, it seems, and its destruction unraveled all their carefully laid plans.

The Pator 6 is flying to Adacyne, and they've got Ralie with them. Time for a final showdown. Go knock them out and get the kid, once and for all. I'll start working on my contacts in the Syndicate and see if there's anything that can be done from their angle. Last thing we want is to have them go after me. Or us.
messages.zh:
你把一帮恶棍惹火了，朋友。所幸的是那帮家伙已经闹内讧了。那摄影棚看来是整起行动的中心，它的毁灭彻底打乱了他们原本精心安排好的计划。

帕特六人组正在飞往挨达辛，他们手上还握有拉赖。是时候来一次对决了。把他们彻底消灭，救出那孩子。我会与我辛迪加财团里的线人取得联系，看看他们能帮做什么。我最不想看到的事情就是他们来找我麻烦，或者是来找我们两人的麻烦。

messages.en: Too much for a simple egger like yourself? You're weaker than I thought.
messages.zh: 你这个克隆飞行员已经顶不住了？你比我料想的要弱。

messages.en: What are you waiting for? Go get Ralie!
messages.zh: 你还在等时么？快去夺回拉赖！

messages.en: Though it was difficult, I made my choice. I decided to return Ralie to his father. I gotta say: The money was tempting. When I dropped Ralie off, we were ambushed by the Syndicate. I don't know who tipped them off to our location, but I suspect a rat. Regardless, Ralie is safe with his father, and the Syndicate's plot was disrupted. There's bad blood in there somewhere, but where it comes from, I cannot say. All I know is that I saved a kid from a life of nightmares. Mission accomplished.
messages.zh: 虽说不容易，但我还是做出了决定。我决定将拉赖交还给他父亲。有点必须承认：那笔钱确实诱人。我把拉赖交还之后，立刻遭到了辛迪加财团的偷袭。我不知道是谁向他们吐露了我们的位置，但我怀疑可能是个贼眉鼠眼的家伙。无论如何，拉赖现在已经平安地回到了其父亲的怀抱，辛迪加财团的阴谋也已经破产。虽然还有家伙在暗箭伤人，但我不知道他到底是谁。我只知道我已经救出了一名孩子，免去了其一生可能遭受的痛苦。我大功告成。

messages.en: Though it was difficult, I made my choice. I decided to return Ralie to his father. I gotta say: The money was tempting. I'm off to Enedore, where I'll meet with Senator Ardanne.
messages.zh: 虽说不容易，但我还是做出了决定。我决定将拉赖交还给他父亲。有点必须承认：那笔钱确实诱人。我要去厄勒多尔那儿见参议员阿丹。

messages.en: If you can do me one last favor: Don't tell Mourmarie anything. A rat needs to keep her secrets, you know.
messages.zh: 请帮我最后一个忙：千万别跟摩尔马列说任何事。你知道，老鼠也是需要秘密的。

messages.en: Mourmarie and Senator Ardanne have given me a rendezvous location for you. It's somewhere in Enedore. When you return the kid, you'll get your reward. I'll contact the Syndicate and let them know that the deal is off. I wouldn't expect them to take that lightly, though, so watch your back.
messages.zh: 摩尔马列与参议员阿丹已经给了我一个你们要碰头的地点。那地方在厄勒多尔。你把孩子交还之后就会获得奖赏。我会联系辛迪加财团，告诉他们这事已经黄了。不过我觉得他们不会让此事轻描淡写过去的，所以你要当心点。

messages.en: The Syndicate showed up? No way. I don't know who would have tipped them off.  That's terrible. Anyway, that's it for me. Good bye.
messages.zh: 辛迪加财团的人出现了？不可能。我觉得没人会向他们通风报信的啊。太不幸了。算了，我就说到这里了，拜拜。

messages.en: Wait, what? What the hell am I going to do with this kid, then? He just sits there and stares at me. It's really sad, and kinda creepy.
messages.zh: 等等，你说什么？那接下来我该怎么处置这孩子？他就坐在那里瞧着我。真让人觉得难过，还有点纠结。

messages.en:
Mourmarie and Senator Ardanne have given me a rendezvous location for you. It's somewhere in Enedore. When you return the kid, you'll get your reward. I'll contact the Syndicate and let them know that the deal is off. I wouldn't expect them to take that lightly, though, so watch your back.

Either way, glad you got the kid back. Been nice working with you. Good luck in the future, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
摩尔马列与参议员阿丹已经给了我一个你们要碰头的地点。那地方在厄勒多尔。你把孩子交还之后就会获得奖赏。我会联系辛迪加财团，告诉他们这事已经黄了。不过我觉得他们不会让此事轻描淡写过去的，所以你要当心点。

不管怎样，我还是很高兴你救了这孩子。与你合作很愉快。祝你将来一路顺风，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Wait, what? What the hell am I going to do with this kid, then? He just sits there and stares at me. It's really sad, and kinda creepy.
messages.zh: 等等，你说什么？那接下来我该怎么处置这孩子？他就坐在那里瞧着我。真让人觉得难过，还有点纠结。

messages.en: Did you take Ralie back to his dad yet?
messages.zh: 你把拉赖交给他父亲了吗？

name.fr: Tout le monde a un prix
name.ru: Каждого можно купить (Everybody Has a Price)

messages.en: Though it was difficult, I made my choice: I gave Ralie back to the Syndicate. Why? The money, of course. Those pirates offered way more money than the kid is worth, and I'd be a fool not to take it. I expected them to ambush me when I gave the kid away, but they didn't. Rats can be surprising sometimes. I made sure I didn't look at the kid when I gave him back. I don't want to think about the horrors he's about to face. All I want to think about is all the money I just got. It's enough to keep me happy. Mission Accomplished. Though I wonder: Was it worth it?
messages.zh: 尽管艰难，但我还是做出了决定：我要辛迪加财团给的钱。为什么？当然是为了钱了。那帮海盗给的钱远远大于这孩子本身的价值，只有傻瓜才会不为钱所动。我本来还以为辛迪加会在我交出孩子的时候偷袭我，但他们没有。这样看来坏人有时也讲诚信。我在交出孩子的时候努力逼迫自己不去瞧那孩子。我不想去考虑他接下来会面对怎样的事情。我脑袋里只想我已拿到的钱，这些钱够我乐的了。我顺利完成了任务，只不过我在想：这一切值得吗？

messages.en: Though it was difficult, I made my choice: I'm going to take the money offered by the Syndicate. I'll probably regret doing this later, but the money's too good for me to walk away. Thus, I'm going to take Ralie back to the Syndicate for a handsome reward. If only the kid would stop staring at me like that…
messages.zh: 尽管艰难，但我还是做出了决定：我要辛迪加财团给的钱。也许我以后会后悔，但现在这钱给的实在是太丰厚，让人没法拒绝。因此我打算将拉赖交给辛迪加换取一大笔钱。但愿那孩子不要用那种眼神看着我……

messages.en: They'll give me my share once the kid is delivered. So go get me some money, and don't tell Mourmarie.
messages.zh: 把那孩子交出之后我也会拿得部分钱，所以你动作要快点，还有别把此事告诉摩尔马列。

messages.en:
The Syndicate wants to meet you at a specific location. You'll drop the kid off, take the money – which I'll get a cut of, of course – and leave quietly in the night. They have a special gift for you in addition to the money. Some sort of Syndicate-issue something or other. I dunno.

Take the kid to the warehouse and drop him off. We'll get paid and leave this whole mess behind us. It'll be a happy ending for us, to be sure.
messages.zh:
辛迪加财团要在一个特定地点见你。你去把孩子送到那儿，然后拿钱——当然我会分得一部分——最后于晚上悄悄离开。他们除了钱之外还给你准备了一样特别礼物，我也不清楚究竟是什么，也许是辛迪加财团型号的什么东西吧。

快去把孩子送往仓库。我们拿到钱之后就再也不用管这事了。我保证这会是件让我们皆大欢喜的事。

messages.en:
I've been in and out of this business for decades at this point. Do you know how many people I've moved? Thousands. Possibly even millions. More than I can count, anyways. And I've never been remorseful, not even once. It was all for the money, the very essence and soul of New Eden.

But I feel something now. Something uncomfortable. Is this what remorse feels like? Guilt? I don't know. I hope it was worth it. I truly do. Good luck, {[character]player.name}. Enjoy your money. Good bye.
messages.zh:
迄今为止我在这行当里已经干了几十年了。你知道我已经运了多少人了吗？数千人，说不定还上百万，反正我是数不清了。这么多年里我从来没有负罪感，一次都没有。一切都向钱看齐，因为这世界本质即如此。

但我现在好像感觉到了什么，这种感觉不是让人很舒服。难道这就是负罪感？搞不懂。反正我希望我们做的一切都是物有所值的。祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。好好花那笔钱，再见。

messages.en: Wait, what? What the hell am I going to do with this kid, then? He just sits there and stares at me. It's really sad, and kinda creepy.
messages.zh: 等等，你说什么？那接下来我该怎么处置这孩子？他就坐在那里瞧着我。真让人觉得难过，还有点纠结。

messages.en: New Eden is a dark place, populated by killers, thieves, heroes, lowlifes, saints, sinners, and everything in between. Morality is what you make of it. But when push comes to shove, heroism and villainy are measured by one thing: ISK, the heart and soul of New Eden.
messages.zh: 这世界是灰暗的，什么样的人都有：罪犯、强盗、英雄、流氓、圣人、罪人以及介于好坏之间的人。每个人都有自己的一套道德标准。关键时候，英雄与恶棍只需用一样东西来衡量：星币。

messages.en: The Dark Frontier
messages.zh: 黑暗前线

The Syndicate wants to meet you at a specific location. You'll drop the kid off, take the money – which I'll get a cut of, of course – and leave quietly in the night. They have a special gift for you in addition to the money. Some sort of Syndicate-issue something or other. I dunno.

Take the kid to the warehouse and drop him off. We'll get paid and leave this whole mess behind us. It'll be a happy ending for us, to be sure.

messages.en: Did you give the kid back to the Syndicate yet?
messages.zh: 你把那孩子交给辛迪加财团了吗？

name.ru: Так творится история (History In the Making)

messages.en: The information I recovered from the Angels, as well as the historical documents I found earlier, have led to a breakthrough in the research about the Wildfire Khumaak. Nilf Abruskur sent me to Hiva Shesha, a Krusual historian who has been working on the Khumaak from the beginning. She has a mobile research station somewhere in the San Matar constellation. Hopefully, her breakthrough will lead to our enlightenment on this relic.
messages.zh: 有人利用我从天使那儿获得的信息及之前发现的历史资料在研究野火库马克方面取得了突破性进展。尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克要我去哈哇·茜莎那里。茜莎是一位从一开始就研究库马克的克鲁夏历史学家。她在姗玛塔尔星座某处有座移动研究空间站。但愿她的突破性研究成果能让我们彻底明白该件古物的作用与意义。

messages.en: The information I recovered from the Angels, as well as the historical documents I found earlier, have led to a breakthrough in the research about the Wildfire Khumaak. Nilf Abruskur is sending me to Hiva Shesha, a Krusual historian who has been working on the Khumaak from the beginning. She has a mobile research station somewhere in the San Matar constellation. Hopefully, her breakthrough will lead to our enlightenment on this relic.
messages.zh: 有人利用我从天使那儿获得的信息及之前发现的历史资料在研究野火库马克方面取得了突破性进展。尼尔夫·阿布拉斯克要我去哈哇·茜莎那里。茜莎是一位从一开始就研究库马克的克鲁夏历史学家。她在姗玛塔尔星座某处有座移动研究空间站。但愿她的突破性研究成果能让我们彻底明白该件古物的作用与意义。

messages.en: The RSS is in charge of national security, not preserving its history. We leave that to the professors and academics. I'll take an autocannon over a datacore any day.
messages.zh: 共和安全局负责国家安全，不负责保留历史。历史保留是教授学者的事。如果你让我在加农炮与数据核心之间二选一，那我肯定永远都选前者。

messages.en:
Our historians have pored over the information found on the drive cluster EDF-285. There's a lot on there, but not all of it is pertinent to the Wildfire Khumaak. I've also been in contact with a Krusual historian who has spent some time researching the Khumaak. The historians cross-referenced each other's work and stumbled upon a lead. I guess those nerds are good for something, eh?

I'm sending you to Hiva Shesha, the Krusual historian. She's taken her poor interns with her to the San Matar constellation – right in the heart of Ammatar space. I don't know what she's discovered, but I'm sure it's important. Best you get over there and talk with her. Let us know what you've uncovered, and keep your eyes peeled for our missing agent. I have a feeling that he went to seek out his Ammatar contact. There's no telling what he's up to, either.

Anyway, good luck.
messages.zh:
我们的历史学家已经详细浏览了硬盘组EDF-285上的信息。信息虽然丰富，但并非都与野火库马克有关。我已经联系了一位研究库马克有段时间的克鲁夏历史学家。历史学家们总是互相参考对方的工作然后突然间发现一条线索。看来这帮不食人间烟火的人还是有点用处的，对吧？

我现在派你去一个名叫哈哇·茜莎的克鲁夏历史学家那里。她已经带上一帮可怜的实习生去了姗玛塔尔星座，那儿是艾玛达领域的正中心。我虽然不知道她发现了什么，但我相信她的发现肯定很重要。你最好亲自过去和她谈谈。把你了解到的一切都告诉我们，同时也请留意一下我们那失踪的代理人。我感觉他像是去找其艾玛达联系人了。他究竟要干什么目前谁都不知道。

不管怎样，还是祝你好运吧。

messages.en: Figures. Get out of here, egger.
messages.zh: 早就料到了。走吧走吧，你这驾驶蛋舱的飞行员。

I guess those nerds are good for something, eh?

I'm sending you to Hiva Shesha, the Krusual historian. She's taken her poor interns with her to the San Matar constellation – right in the heart of Ammatar space. I don't know what she's discovered, but I'm sure it's important. Best you get over there and talk with her. Let us know what you've uncovered, and keep your eyes peeled for our missing agent. Anyway, good luck.

messages.en: Figures. Get out of here, egger.
messages.zh: 早就料到了。走吧走吧，你这驾驶蛋舱的飞行员。

messages.en: Have you talked to Hiva Shesha yet?
messages.zh: 你与哈哇·茜莎谈过了没有？

messages.en: Revelation
messages.zh: 揭示

messages.en: I met with Hiva Shesha at her mobile research facility. She's been researching the Wildfire Khumaak since the beginning, and she seems to have come across some new clue to the relic's origin. She's asked me to go to the Church of the Obsidian, an Ammatar church. The missing RSS agent's source was a nun working in that holy place. I found an item in that church that Hiva thinks will be useful in our search. The item, an orb made of blood obsidian, was indeed located in the church; Hiva predicted that correctly. What she didn't predict was the amount of opposition I would encounter at that site. I never thought I'd get in a firefight outside a cathedral. Luckily, I managed to grab the orb and leave there relatively unscathed.
messages.zh: 我在哈哇·茜莎的移动研究基地与其见了面。她从一开始就在研究野火库马克了，现在好像已经找到了与该件东西起源有关的线索。她要求我前去一个叫“黑曜石教会”的艾玛达教堂。那个失踪的共和安全局代理人的线人就是一个在那教堂里工作的修女。我在那教堂里找到了一件哈哇认为会对我们研究有所帮助的东西。它是个由血色黑曜石组成的圆球，且正如哈哇所料藏匿在教堂之中。但哈哇没有料到我在教堂门口遭到了激烈反抗。我自己也没有想到教堂门口竟然也能动刀动枪。所幸我还是在成功地拿到了那个圆球之后得以全身而退。

messages.en: I met with Hiva Shesha at her mobile research facility. She's been researching the Wildfire Khumaak since the beginning, and she seems to have come across some new clue to the relic's origin. She's asked me to go to the Church of the Obsidian, an Ammatar church. The missing RSS agent's source was a nun working in that holy place. Hiva thinks there's some clue to be found in that church, an orb made of blood obsidian. Hopefully, this will be an easy task, a quick in-and-out mission.
messages.zh: 我在哈哇·茜莎的移动研究基地与其见了面。她从一开始就在研究野火库马克了，现在好像已经找到了与该件东西起源有关的线索。她要求我前去一个叫“黑曜石教会”的艾玛达教堂。那个失踪的共和安全局代理人的线人就是一个在那教堂里工作的修女。哈哇认为那教堂里藏有线索——一个由血色黑曜石组成的圆球。但愿此次教堂之行会是件速去速回的简单任务。

messages.en: Oh yeah. I may have forgot to mention that there are some armed guards there. I'm a scholar, not a fighter. Which one are you?
messages.zh: 哦，是的。我忘了说那里有武装守备力量。我是学者，不是战士。你呢？

messages.en:
The Ammatar “sister” that was the source of all the information was based in a nearby cathedral called the Church of the Obsidian. I've contacted the church, and she's no longer there. In fact, I have no clue where she went. She did make reference to some artifact located in the church. They've denied me access to the church grounds – those bloody lapdogs – but I think you might be able to persuade them. Get inside that church and get something called the “Blood Obsidian Orb.” I don't know what to do with it after that, but I think that's our first step.

Take this analyzer with you, and use it on the church. It should help you unearth the Blood Obsidian Orb.
messages.zh:
我们的情报都是由那个艾玛达修女提供的，她在附近的一个叫“黑曜石教会”的教堂里修教。我已联系过那教堂，那里的人是说她现已不在那儿了。她究竟去哪儿了我也不知道。不过，她倒是提到过有个古物藏在教堂某处。那里的看门狗不让我入教堂，但我觉得你应该有办法驯服那群狗。进入教堂后去拿一样叫“血色黑曜石圆球”的东西。虽然我还不知道之后应该怎么做，但我们首先要把这件事搞定。

请对那座教堂用这个分析仪。它应该能帮你找到血色黑曜石圆球。

messages.en: You found it? Really? Well, I guess it's kind of orb-like. I have no idea what its significance is, but I'm going to find out. Hang on real quick. I must look into this further.
messages.zh: 你找到它了？真的？啊哈，我猜那玩意儿就是个球状物。我现在还不清楚其意义究竟何在，但我会弄清楚的。请稍等片刻，让我把这玩意儿琢磨透。

messages.en: You don't care that much about history, do you? I guess you're doomed to repeat it. Sharpen your focus, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你不怎么关心历史，对吧？那你必将重蹈历史的覆辙。好好思考一下你该干什么，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Do you have any idea how tough this relic is to crack? You'd think something this simple would come with a manual. We've used the Khumaak for a long time as a symbol of our defiance. But the presence of one little rock adds a whole new level of meaning.

Oh yeah. Welcome, {[character]player.name}! I take it that Nilf sent you over? You've earned a lot of trust with the Republic, and I hope we can continue that trend.

I was one of the Republic University scholars to take a look at the Wildfire Khumaak for the Brutors. I was also sent to look over the documents you recovered from the RSS. So, essentially, I've been with you from the beginning, lurking in the shadows. That's what we historians do: Skulk about in dusty corners looking for information. It's a dirty job, but somebody has to do it.

The Ammatar “sister” that was the source of all the information was based in a nearby cathedral called the Church of the Obsidian. I've contacted the church, and she's no longer there. In fact, I have no clue where she went. She did make reference to some artifact located in the church. They've denied me access to the church grounds – those bloody lapdogs – but I think you might be able to persuade them. Get inside that church and get something called the “Blood Obsidian Orb.” I don't know what to do with it after that, but I think that's our first step.

Take this analyzer with you, and use it on the church. It should help you unearth the Blood Obsidian Orb.
messages.zh:
你知道要弄清这东西到底是做什么的有多艰难吗？你肯定还以为如此简单的东西一定会带张说明书吧？虽然我们一直以来都将库马克视作我们抗争的象征，但那小石块的出现必将能为其增添一层新的意义。

噢，欢迎你，{[character]player.name}！我猜是尼尔夫派你来的吧？你已经赢得了共和国的极大信任，但愿你能再接再厉。

我就是负责为布鲁特人研究野火库马克、来自共和大学的一位学者。同时我也研究你从共和安全局那儿获取的文档。总之我就是悄悄地在背后与你一直合作到现在。在尘土洒落的角落里寻找信息是对我们历史学家的一种真实写照。虽然这事吃力不讨好，但总得有人干。

我们的情报都是由那个艾玛达修女提供的，她在附近的一个叫“黑曜石教会”的教堂里修教。我已联系过那教堂，那里的人是说她现已不在那儿了。她究竟去哪儿了我也不知道。不过，她倒是提到过有个古物藏在教堂某处。那里的看门狗不让我入教堂，但我觉得你应该有办法驯服那群狗。进入教堂后去拿一样叫“血色黑曜石圆球”的东西。虽然我还不知道之后应该怎么做，但我们首先要把这件事搞定。

请对那座教堂用这个分析仪。它应该能帮你找到血色黑曜石圆球。

messages.en: You don't care that much about history, do you? I guess you're doomed to repeat it. Sharpen your focus, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你不怎么关心历史，对吧？那你必将重蹈历史的覆辙。好好思考一下你该干什么，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Where's the orb? Is it actually an orb? I can never tell when ancient texts are being literal or not.
messages.zh: 那圆球在哪儿？真是个圆球？说真的，我实在无法从古文字中读出这到底是实指还是虚指。

messages.en: Hiva had another task for me while she tried to decipher the Blood Obsidian Orb. She suspects that there are more relics and information located at a nearby Ammatar ruins, the remains of a church or other holy ground. She's especially looking for a Blood Obsidian Tablet, which is supposed to correspond to the orb I uncovered for her. That site was a goldmine for archaeological information. I uncovered the tablet – and some unfriendly fire to boot – as well as some other documents from the site.
messages.zh: 哈哇在研究血色黑曜石圆球的同时还要求我去办另一件事。她怀疑附近一座艾玛达教堂废墟里还藏有更多的古文物及信息。她特别想要与我之前拿到的那个圆球相对应的血色黑曜石碑。那片废墟是考古发掘的黄金地。我找到了那石碑与其他一些资料，同时还击退了一群不友善的人。

messages.en: Hiva has another task for me while she tries to decipher the Blood Obsidian Orb. She suspects that there are more relics and information located at a nearby Ammatar ruins, the remains of a church or other holy ground. She's especially looking for a Blood Obsidian Tablet, which is supposed to correspond to the orb I uncovered for her. Hopefully it's there: I'm getting rather tired of digging through ruins at this point.
messages.zh: 哈哇在研究血色黑曜石圆球的同时还要求我去办另一件事。她怀疑附近一座艾玛达教堂废墟里还藏有更多的古文物及信息。她特别想要与我之前拿到的那个圆球相对应的血色黑曜石碑。但愿那石碑就在那儿：我现在对挖掘废墟这件事已经感到烦了。

messages.en: Remember to use this analyzer on the area. It'll allow you to unearth anything hidden around those ruins. Good luck!
messages.zh: 记得要在那地方用上这分析仪。用它你就能在那片废墟中发掘出任何暗藏的东西。祝你好运！

messages.en:
Something was written on the orb as well, and I want you to go find what it is. There's a tablet that goes along with the orb and supposedly tells more about its purpose. The Church of the Obsidian did not have this tablet, as far as I can tell, but I was able to decipher a code on the orb that told of the tablet's location: the ruins of an old Ammatar church.

The church is an ancient place, and a prime spot for archaeology. Use that analyzer I gave you for the Church of the Obsidian. I expect there to be a lot of stuff to gather among those ruins. Bring back whatever you can, but I'm especially looking for the Blood Obsidian Tablet. When you come back, I expect that I can crack this thing wide open…figuratively speaking, of course.
messages.zh:
这圆球上写了点东西，我要你去查查到底写了些什么。这圆球有一块匹配的石碑，它应该能为我们提供些线索。据我所知，黑曜石教会并没有这块石碑，不过我还是通过破解圆球上的一个代码获知了其位置：它埋藏于一座旧艾玛达教堂的废墟之中。

那座教堂是座历史古迹，同时也是个考古热点。请带上我之前给你的那个用于黑曜石教会的分析仪，我觉得那里会有大量的东西供你发掘。带回你想带回的一切东西，不过我关心的还是那块血色黑曜石碑。希望等你回来后，我能把这东西大卸八块……当然，这只是一种比喻说法而已。

messages.en:
I can't believe what you found among those ruins. This is a historian's dream come true. Now that we've got the Blood Obsidian Orb and the Blood Obsidian Tablet, I think we finally solve this mystery. We're very close to uncovering the secrets of the Wildfire Khumaak.

By the way: Did you notice anything strange there? I could have sworn I saw an RSS ship flying about those ruins. Weird.
messages.zh:
我简直无法相信你在那片废墟中找到的东西。对一位历史学家来说，这是梦想成真的一刻。既然我们现在有了血色黑曜石圆球与血色黑曜石碑，我觉得我们应该能解开这一切谜团了。我们很快就能知道野火库马克暗藏的秘密。

哦，还有，你注意到那儿有什么异常情况吗？我很确信地看见有一艘安全局的船在那儿转悠。奇怪。

messages.en: You're walking away with half of the mystery solved. Don't you want to finish the puzzle?
messages.zh: 谜团解到一半你就走了？难道你不想知道谜底吗？

messages.en:
I'm still going to need some more time with the Blood Obsidian Orb, but I have managed to glean some information from it. My theory is that the orb acts as a protective case for something hidden inside of it. I'd hate to break open a priceless relic of the past, and I'm trying to avoid that situation as much as possible.

Something was written on the orb as well, and I want you to go find what it is. There's a tablet that goes along with the orb and supposedly tells more about its purpose. The Church of the Obsidian did not have this tablet, as far as I can tell, but I was able to decipher a code on the orb that told of the tablet's location: the ruins of an old Ammatar church.

The church is an ancient place, and a prime spot for archaeology. Use that analyzer I gave you for the Church of the Obsidian. I expect there to be a lot of stuff to gather among those ruins. Bring back whatever you can, but I'm especially looking for the Blood Obsidian Tablet. When you come back, I expect that I can crack this thing wide open…figuratively speaking, of course.
messages.zh:
虽然我还要再在血色黑曜石圆球上花点时间，但我已经看出了点名堂。我觉得这圆球只是层保护膜，里面肯定还藏着东西。我不喜欢把一块无价之宝敲碎，我会尽力避免这样的事情出现。

这圆球上写了点东西，我要你去查查到底写了些什么。这圆球有一块匹配的石碑，它应该能为我们提供些线索。据我所知，黑曜石教会并没有这块石碑，不过我还是通过破解圆球上的一个代码获知了其位置：它埋藏于一座旧艾玛达教堂的废墟之中。

那座教堂是座历史古迹，同时也是个考古热点。请带上我之前给你的那个用于黑曜石教会的分析仪，我觉得那里会有大量的东西供你发掘。带回你想带回的一切东西，不过我关心的还是那块血色黑曜石碑。希望等你回来后，我能把这东西大卸八块……当然，这只是一种比喻说法而已。

messages.en: You're walking away with half of the mystery solved. Don't you want to finish the puzzle?
messages.zh: 谜团解到一半你就走了？难道你不想知道谜底吗？

messages.en: Using the Blood Obsidian Tablet, Hiva Shesha deciphered the mysteries hidden inside the Blood Obsidian Orb. In fact, there was literally something hidden inside the orb: an obsidian datacore. According to the tablet, this datacore, if placed inside some holy ground, would uncover a secret history book. Hiva gave me the datacore, and the most logical place to look was the Wildfire Life Chapel, an innocuous church in the San Matar constellation. Undoubtedly, I placed the datacore inside the chapel, and… no hidden book. Instead, I got ambushed by Karkoti Rend, the missing RSS agent. He beat me to it! He's gone rogue and took the book with him. Now the chase is on, and I've got to catch up to him!
messages.zh: 哈哇·茜莎利用血色黑曜石碑破解了藏在血色黑曜石圆球中的秘密。事实上，那里还真有件实物：黑曜石数据核心。根据那块石碑的指示，如果把这数据核心置于某个圣地，那我们就能获得一本暗藏的历史书。哈哇把数据核心交给了我，按照最符合逻辑的推断，接下来该去的地方就是位于姗玛塔尔星座的一座名为野火生命礼拜堂的教堂。我按照指示将那数据核心放入了那教堂，结果……没有发现任何隐藏的书籍。我反倒是遭到了失踪的安全局代理人卡考迪·阿恩得的偷袭。他占了上风！这家伙不再听从指挥，将书带走了。现在要展开一场追击行动了，我必须抓住他！

messages.en: Using the Blood Obsidian Tablet, Hiva Shesha deciphered the mysteries hidden inside the Blood Obsidian Orb. In fact, there was literally something hidden inside the orb: an obsidian datacore. According to the tablet, this datacore, if placed inside some holy ground, would uncover a secret history book. Hiva gave me the datacore, and the most logical place to look is the Wildfire Life Chapel, an innocuous church in the San Matar constellation. I'm getting close; I can feel it.
messages.zh: 哈哇·茜莎利用血色黑曜石碑破解了藏在血色黑曜石圆球中的秘密。事实上，那里还真有件实物：黑曜石数据核心。根据那块石碑的指示，如果把这数据核心置于某个圣地，那我们就能获得一本暗藏的历史书。哈哇把数据核心交给了我，按照最符合逻辑的推断，接下来该去的地方就是位于姗玛塔尔星座的一座名为野火生命礼拜堂的教堂。我能感觉到我就快到了。

messages.en: You know, this could all be for naught. There could be nothing there, or the book could have been swiped long ago. If you don't get the book, that's ok: We're just trying to see if this works. History has a wicked sense of humor, sometimes, so be careful.
messages.zh: 你知道，这一切说不定是场闹剧也有可能。那儿可能什么都没有，或者那书早就被盗走了。如果你没拿到那本书，没事：我们只想看看这条路是否行得通。历史有时颇具讽刺性，所以你要当心。

messages.en:
I found this datacore inside the orb. According to the tablet, there's a church in this area called the Wildfire Life Chapel. Inside the chapel is something called the Book of St. Arzad. I think that was what you came across in those ruins: parts of this lost book. My, from the looks of it, this is heavy stuff. I haven't had the chance to piece it all together yet, but I have a feeling that this book goes beyond a simple relic like the Wildfire Khumaak and into much bigger territory.

This book must be recovered. I'm almost certain that it's in the chapel. Put the datacore in that chapel and see what comes of it. It's our only hope. See what happens.
messages.zh:
我在那圆球里面发现了一块数据核心。从那石碑上看，本地区有一个座名为野火生命礼拜堂的教堂。这教堂里有本圣阿尔扎德之书。我想你之前在废墟中见到的就是这本书的一部分。天哪，从其表面上看，这可是件圣物！我还没机会将这书完整地拼凑在一起，但我感觉，这书的意义将远大于野火库马克之类的简单古文物。

我们必须获得这本书。我几乎可以确定它就在那教堂里。请将此数据核心放入那里看看会出现什么。它是我们唯一的希望。

messages.en: That RSS agent showed up? That's no good. There's no telling what he'll do for the book. You have to catch him and get that book!
messages.zh: 出现了安全局的代理人？事情不妙啊。没人知道他拿那本书去干嘛。你必须追上他，将书夺回来！

messages.en: Oh come on, really? You're ditching me now?
messages.zh: 搞什么，你当真？你不想与我合作了？

messages.en:
I've been a scholar and a historian for many years now, so I know how to handle ancient relics. I will confess, though, that I was about to cut right into the middle of the Blood Obsidian Orb to see what was inside. Yes, I was getting rather desperate for answers. Luckily, the tablet you uncovered was more than just mystical mumbo-jumbo and flowery metaphors. Rather, it was practically an instruction manual to open the orb. Spirits be praised!

I found this datacore inside the orb. According to the tablet, there's a church in this area called the Wildfire Life Chapel. Inside the chapel is something called the Book of St. Arzad. I think that was what you came across in those ruins: parts of this lost book. My, from the looks of it, this is heavy stuff. I haven't had the chance to piece it all together yet, but I have a feeling that this book goes beyond a simple relic like the Wildfire Khumaak and into much bigger territory.

This book must be recovered. I'm almost certain that it's in the chapel. Put the datacore in that chapel and see what comes of it. It's our only hope. See what happens.
messages.zh:
我当历史学者已经多年了，所以我知道该怎样处理古文物。但我必须承认，我差点就要切开这血色黑曜石圆球看看里面到底藏什么了。对，我为了获得答案是有点抓狂了。好在你发现的那个石碑不只是个写满神秘甲骨文的石块，它实际上更是一本用来打开那圆球的说明书。感谢上苍！

我在那圆球里面发现了一块数据核心。从那石碑上看，本地区有一个座名为野火生命礼拜堂的教堂。这教堂里有本圣阿尔扎德之书。我想你之前在废墟中见到的就是这本书的一部分。天哪，从其表面上看，这可是件圣物！我还没机会将这书完整地拼凑在一起，但我感觉，这书的意义将远大于野火库马克之类的简单古文物。

我们必须获得这本书。我几乎可以确定它就在那教堂里。请将此数据核心放入那里看看会出现什么。它是我们唯一的希望。

messages.en: Oh come on, really? You're ditching me now?
messages.zh: 搞什么，你当真？你不想与我合作了？

messages.en: Well, what was in the chapel?
messages.zh: 恩，你在那教堂里发现什么了吗？

messages.en: Karkoti Rend, the missing RSS agent who originally worked on the Wildfire Khumaak project, has been following me all this time. When I was ready to uncover the mysteries surrounding the Khumaak, he swooped in and took the hidden book. He took it to an Angel Cartel base – I suspect he was working with them for some time – and would have sold the book to the highest bidder. I defeated him and retrieved the book. It was a vicious fight, but I was victorious. Before I left, he warned me about the book, saying its contents were too much for the Republic to handle. I don't know what he meant by that, but I'm sure I'll find out.
messages.zh: 卡考迪·阿恩得是那个现已失踪、原来从事野火库马克项目的安全局代理人。他一直在跟踪我。正当我要拨开围绕库马克的迷雾时，他窜了进来，把那本不为人知的书夺走了。他把那书带到了一座天使基地——我怀疑他为天使卖命已经有段时间了——他可能会把书卖给出价最高的人。我将其击败夺回了那本书。这是场恶斗，但我还是赢了。我走之前他警告我说那书中的内容会让米玛塔尔共和国受不了。我不知道那到底是什么意思，但我想我很快就会知道了。

messages.en: Karkoti Rend, the missing RSS agent who originally worked on the Wildfire Khumaak project, has been following me all this time. When I was ready to uncover the mysteries surrounding the Khumaak, he swooped in and took the hidden book. He's taken it to an Angel Cartel base – I suspect he's been working with them for a while now – and will likely sell the book to the highest bidder. I must get to him and retrieve the book before it's too late!
messages.zh: 卡考迪·阿恩得是那个现已失踪、原来从事野火库马克项目的安全局代理人。他一直在跟踪我。正当我要拨开围绕库马克的迷雾时，他窜了进来，把那本不为人知的书夺走了。他把那书带到了一座天使基地——我怀疑他为天使卖命已经有段时间了——他可能会把书卖给出价最高的人。我必须赶在这之前找到他把书夺回来！

messages.en: Karkoti Rend is an agent for the RSS, so he's bound to have some firepower with him. Be careful.
messages.zh: 卡考迪·阿恩得是安全局的代理人，因此他肯定备有武装力量。要小心。

messages.en:
We need that book, and that RSS agent has it. This is my worst fear realized: Karkoti Rend was trying to get his hands on the book. The RSS claims that he was working alone, but I don't know how true that really is.

Either way, I've tracked down his location to a nearby Angel Cartel base. This compounds the urgency of this mission. I barely trust the RSS as it is, but the Angels are outright scum. Go get the book from there, but make sure it's safe. The book is of the utmost priority!
messages.zh:
我们要那本书，那书现在那个安全局代理人卡考迪·阿恩得的手里。这是我最不想见到的事情，但现在竟然实现了。安全局称这是他的个人行为，但我实在不知道这话的真实度究竟有多少。

不管怎样，我已经查到了他现在附近的一个天使集团的基地里，这迫使我们必须采取更加果敢的行动。我几乎不怎么相信安全局，天使集团更是一个彻头彻尾的渣。快去那儿夺回那本书，但要确保它完好无损。这本书对我们至关重要！

messages.en: After all of the trials and tribulations, we finally have the truth at our fingertips. Now it's time to dig in and find out what the Wildfire Khumaak is all about.
messages.zh: 在辛苦奔波这么多次之后，我们终于把真相掌握在了自己手里。现在让我们看看野火库马克到底是什么吧。

messages.en: You can't leave! I can't take on an RSS agent and a bunch of pirates by myself! Are you crazy?
messages.zh: 你不能就这样一走了之！我没法对付一位安全局的代理人外加一群海盗！你脑子正常吗？

messages.en:
We need that book, and that RSS agent has it. This is my worst fear realized: Karkoti Rend was trying to get his hands on the book. The RSS claims that he was working alone, but I don't know how true that really is.

Either way, I've tracked down his location to a nearby Angel Cartel base. This compounds the urgency of this mission. I barely trust the RSS as it is, but the Angels are outright scum. Go get the book from there, but make sure it's safe. The book is of the utmost priority!

不管怎样，我已经查到了他现在附近的一个天使集团的基地里，这迫使我们必须采取更加果敢的行动。我几乎不怎么相信安全局，天使集团更是一个彻头彻尾的渣。快去那儿夺回那本书，但要确保它完好无损。这本书对我们至关重要！
