messages.zh: 你不能就这样一走了之！我没法对付一位安全局的代理人外加一群海盗！你脑子正常吗？

messages.en: Do you have the book?
messages.zh: 你拿到那本书了吗？

messages.en:
The book I recovered from Karkoti Rend is known as the Book of St. Arzad. According to Hiva Shesha, it tells the story of St. Arzad, an Amarr Holder tied to the Starkmanir. The book claims that the Wildfire Khumaak is a symbol of his benevolence, and that the Starkmanir Rebellion was started out of loyalty to their Holder rather than true defiance over the Amarr occupation. This information is troubling, as it goes against hundreds of years of Minmatar history, and even subverts the significance of the Minmatar defiance, their independence, and the formation of the Republic.

Hiva Shesha was deeply troubled by this book, and she was indecisive about what to do. She gave me two choices: Give the book to the Defiants or to a Gallente historian. messages.en:

The book claims that the Wildfire Khumaak is a symbol of his benevolence, and that the Starkmanir Rebellion was started out of loyalty to their Holder rather than true defiance over the Amarr occupation. messages.en:
I have devoted much of my life to history of all sorts, from its unflappable truths to its infallible lies to the nuanced information systems found throughout the chronicles, artifacts, disputed ruins, and subjective quagmires. Despite what people think, history is a shapeless void of nonsense, akin to space's vacuum or the cold, thoughtless smattering of stars that we call home. There is no meaning besides what we make of it; we do not know truth outside of the lenses we place over this shapeless void, the teeming nothingness, the endless morass of information.

This book troubles me. I do not know what to make of it, nor do I know how to proceed. If what this book says is true, and the chances are good that at least some of it is, then the Starkmanir did not begin their rebellion out of a thirst for independence, but rather out of loyalty to their Holder, a man known to them as St. Arzad. The Wildfire Khumaak, a symbol he stole from them, is not an enduring relic of independence, nor is it a glowing tribute to the spirit of the Matari people. Rather, it is an artifact devoted to the memory of Starkmanir captivity, an heirloom of oppression, but also an endearing homage to a fallen captor.

In other words, the Wildfire Khumaak subverts the defiance of my people.

That is, of course, if this is true. All we have is the relic and this book. The story of St. Arzad is practically hidden or buried in the Amarr history: I can't find a trace of it. For all we know, this is apocryphal heresy, a rash account of history, a fever dream from some demented Starkmanir, or an outright hoax.

I don't know. I honestly don't know. I'm torn on what to do, and thus I will put the choice in your hands. I don't want the responsibility for what happens to this text. There are two places we can take it: Return it to the Defiants and reunite it with the Wildfire Khumaak, or donate it to a Gallente historian I know. The former option gives the book back its people, though I don't know how they'll approach the text (or even if they'll release it to the general public, which to me seems a shame). The latter will keep the book safe and make it available for the greater good. Even though it's a troubling account, it's still history, and it still needs to be known.

The choice is in your hands.
messages.zh:
我这生钻研过各种历史。从传记、文物、遗迹及一些主观臆断中，我读到了所谓铁钉板的真相，看到了宣称揭不开的谎言。与一般人所想不同的是，历史其实很假、很大、也很空。这世上没有绝对的真相，因为每个人观察事物的角度都不尽相同。

这本书让我感到不安。我不知道该怎么评价它，也不知道接下来该怎么做。如果该书所言即实，或者至少部分属实，那斯塔科马人根本就不是因渴望独立而发动抗争，而是出于对一个他们称为阿尔扎德的贵族的忠心才这样做的。那人从他们那里拿走的那个野火库马克古物既不是独立的象征，也不是件歌颂玛塔尔人精神的物品。事实上，它只是一个为纪念奴役斯塔科马人而做的纪念品，一个压迫时代的见证品，反而体现了对一个死去劳工主的悼念。

换句话讲，野火库马克古物是对我族民众独立精神的诋毁。

当然，这一切论断都建立在书中所言是事实的基础上。阿尔扎德的事迹已经被藏匿或者埋没于艾玛历史之中了，我无从追查。就我们目前所知道的而言，这绝对是扯淡、戏说、某个脑残斯塔科马人的幻想，或者根本就是在吹牛。

但我还是不确定，真的无法确定。我快崩溃了，不知道该怎么办。这事还是交给你吧，你来选择把这书交给谁。我不想对此承担任何责任。你有两个选择：一、把这书还给挑战者，让它与野火库马克古物共聚一堂。二、把它交给一位我认识的盖伦特历史学家。前种做法可以让该书回到主人身边，但我不知道斯塔科马人将如何处理这本书（我很怀疑他们会把这书公示于众，太丢脸了）。后种做法可以确保该书完好无损，造福大众。这记载内容虽让人不安，但毕竟是历史，是历史就要让人知道。

究竟如何，就看你的了。

messages.en:
As I said, I leave the decision in your hands. This book is a remnant of the Minmatar people, and thus it probably belongs with my brethren. If you feel the same way, then take the Book of St. Arzad back to Oggur Marendei, the Defiant member you spoke with earlier. They have the Wildfire Khumaak, and they should have this book as well.

Like I said, this book is unsettling for me, not as a historian, but as a proud member of the Minmatar Republic. The resistance my people endured for the past years is very important to me, and our ultimate defiance of the Amarr people is crucial to our cultural identity. This book does not show our defiance in a positive light, or at least muddies the motivations behind it.

This text belongs with my people. I cannot attest to how they will handle it, nor can I say for certain that they will bury it. But the right thing to do is to give it to them and not to let any outsiders take possession of it. This pains me as a historian, but it feels right as a Minmatar.

The truth is not easy, nor is it absolute. We base our understanding on our perspectives, the ideas we wish to accept, and the data we acknowledge as correct. Everything else is information clutter obscuring our understanding of the world around us.

Take this book to Oggur Marendei at the Defiant base. Let them deal with it. It's out of my hands.
messages.zh:
我前面已经说过，选择权在你手里。这书归米玛塔尔人，应该属于我的同胞。如果你也这样认为，那就请把这本圣阿尔扎德之书交还给欧古尔·玛能德，也就是之前和你讲过话的那个挑战者组织的人。他们拥有野火库马克，这本书也应该归他们。

就像我前面说的那样，这本书让我深感不安，倒不是因为我是历史学家，而是因为我是米玛塔尔共和国骄傲的子民。我国人民过去进行的抵抗运动对我有着非常重要的影响，而我们对艾玛人的挑战也标志着我们的文化。这本书没有从正面展示我们对艾玛人的不屈不饶，或者至少贬低了我们的抵抗动机。

这书归我族人民所有。我无法预测他们会怎么对待它，也不能说他们一定会把这书给埋了。正确的做法就是把这书交给他们，别让外人染指此书。作为历史学家，我感到非常痛苦。但作为一名米玛塔尔人，我又觉得这样做是对的。

这世上没有一直让人舒坦的真相，也没有绝对的真相。我们对事物的理解总是基于自己的观察角度，习惯采纳我们乐于接受的想法，并且使用我们自以为正确的数据。除此之外，其他信息我们一律视为糟粕。

快去把让本书交给位于挑战者基地的欧古尔·玛能德。让他们去处理吧，这事我不归我管了。

messages.en: Posmon Aubenard is a friend of mine, a Gallente historian working with the University of Caille. He's a trusted academic, an astute scholar, and a respected member of the university's staff. If you take this book to him, I know that he will preserve it and keep it safe, possibly even put the book in the proper historical light with a best-selling book of his own in a few years. That might not sit well with my Minmatar brethren, but at least we won't lose the truth, or whatever part of the truth this book represents. The Defiants can keep the Wildfire Khumaak – although I'm sure Posmon would love to get his hands on it – but it's just an empty symbol without the book. Go and give the Book of St. Arzad to him, and let him keep it safe. It's the right thing to do. Isn't it?
messages.zh: 泊司曼·奥贝纳德是我的一个朋友，他是凯勒大学的盖伦特历史学家。他为人可信，是个聪明的学者，在大学里德高众望。如果你把这书交给他，我相信他会好好保存，说不准过几年就会出一本自己的畅销书细述此段历史。虽然这不会让我的米玛塔尔同胞们高兴，但至少我们保住了真相。挑战者组织可以继续保留他们的野火库马克——我知道泊司曼其实也很想得到这样东西——但那东西如果没有这本书辅佐就只是个摆设而已。请把这本圣阿尔扎德之书交给他，让他好生保管。这才是正确选择，对吧？

messages.en: I decided to give the book to the Defiants. They have the Wildfire Khumaak, and they deserve to own the Book of St. Arzad. Hiva is worried that they'll keep the presence of the book under wraps for a long time, fearful of the truths espoused within its pages. That isn't my concern. I just wanted to finish what I started and to return the book to its rightful owners. I made the drop. The Defiants gave me a gift for my efforts. The book is in their hands now, and they can deal with it however they want. Mission accomplished.
messages.zh: 我决定把书交给挑战者。他们有野火库马克，应该拥有圣阿尔扎德之书。哈哇担心挑战者会长期窝藏这本书，因为他们害怕其中蕴藏的真相。不过我对此无所谓。我在这里是为了完成我未尽的事业，将该书交给其理所当然的主人。我把书送到了挑战者手里，他们赠予我一件礼物以表感谢。这书现在到了他们手里，他们爱怎么处置就怎么处置。我的任务完成了。

messages.en: I decided to give the book to the Defiants. They have the Wildfire Khumaak, and they deserve to own the Book of St. Arzad. I'm here to finish what I've started and to return the book to its rightful owners. All I have to do is make the drop.

这世上没有一直让人舒坦的真相，也没有绝对的真相。我们对事物的理解总是基于自己的观察角度，习惯采纳我们乐于接受的想法，并且使用我们自以为正确的数据。除此之外，其他信息我们一律视为糟粕。

快去把让本书交给位于挑战者基地的欧古尔·玛能德。让他们去处理吧，这事我不归我管了。

messages.en:
The fate of the text is out of our hands. It's up to my people to determine what to do with the book. I have faith in my people: They will do what is right, though I can't say exactly what that is.

Thank you for your help, brave pilot. May the stars be kind to you.
messages.zh:
这本书的命运现在不归我们掌控了。我的同胞将决定如何处理它。我相信他们：虽然我还不知道他们会怎么做，但他们一定会做出正确的决定。

谢谢你帮忙，你是个勇敢的飞行员。愿星星福佑你。

messages.en: You're leaving me with this choice? I don't think I can make the proper call.
messages.zh: 你把这决定交给我做？我不觉得自己能做出正确的决定。

messages.en:
As I said, I leave the decision in your hands. This book is a remnant of the Minmatar people, and thus it probably belongs with my brethren. If you feel the same way, then take the Book of St. Arzad back to Oggur Marendei, the Defiant member you spoke with earlier. They have the Wildfire Khumaak, and they should have this book as well.

Take this book to Oggur Marendei at the Defiant base. Let them deal with it. It's out of my hands.
messages.zh:
我前面已经说过，选择权在你手里。这书归米玛塔尔人，应该属于我的同胞。如果你也这样认为，那就请把这本圣阿尔扎德之书交还给欧古尔·玛能德，也就是之前和你讲过话的那个挑战者组织的人。他们拥有野火库马克，这本书也应该归他们。

快去把让本书交给位于挑战者基地的欧古尔·玛能德。让他们去处理吧，这事我不归我管了。

messages.en: You're leaving me with this choice? I don't think I can make the proper call.
messages.zh: 你把这决定交给我做？我不觉得自己能做出正确的决定。

messages.en: Did you give the book to the Defiants?
messages.zh: 你把书交给挑战者了吗？

messages.en: I decided to give the Book of St. Arzad to Posmon Aubenard, a Gallente historian with the University of Caille. He's located at a branch of the university in Avesber. Hiva is positive that, by giving this book to Posmon, it will be safe and preserved for many years to come. I hope I've made the right decision. The Defiants won't be very happy with this decision, but I'm not one to sweep history under the rug, no matter how unnerving or heretical it may seem. Mission accomplished.
messages.zh: 我决定将圣阿尔扎德之书交给凯勒大学的盖伦特历史学家泊司曼·奥贝纳德。他位于该所大学在埃维斯贝尔的一座分校。哈哇确信，只要把书交给泊司曼，它就能完好地保存好多年。虽然挑战者不会对这个决定感到高兴，但对我而言，不管历史有多么让人不安或者多么地离经叛道，我都不能把它掩盖起来。我的任务完成了。

messages.en: I decided to give the Book of St. Arzad to Posmon Aubenard, a Gallente historian with the University of Caille. He's located at a branch of the university in Avesber. Hiva is positive that, by giving this book to Posmon, it will be safe and preserved for many years to come. All I have to do now is make the drop.
messages.zh: 我决定将圣阿尔扎德之书交给凯勒大学的盖伦特历史学家泊司曼·奥贝纳德。他位于该所大学在埃维斯贝尔的一座分校。哈哇确信，只要把书交给泊司曼，它就能完好地保存好多年。我只要把书交给泊司曼就行。

messages.en: Posmon Aubenard is in Avesber at a remote campus of the University of Caille. I trust him more than any other historian. Even though this bit of history will not be in the hands of the Matari people, it'll ensure its preservation. Sometimes the truth is too difficult to endure. Good luck.
messages.zh: 泊司曼·奥贝纳德在埃维斯贝尔星系凯勒大学的一座偏远校区里。在所有的历史学家中，我最相信他。虽然这段历史将不再由玛塔利人保管，但至少这样它能被保存下来。有些真相是无法被人接受的。祝你好运。

messages.en: Posmon Aubenard is a friend of mine, a Gallente historian working with the University of Caille. He's a trusted academic, an astute scholar, and a respected member of the university's staff. If you take this book to him, I know that he will preserve it and keep it safe, possibly even put the book in the proper historical light with a best-selling book of his own in a few years. That might not sit well with my Minmatar brethren, but at least we won't lose the truth, or whatever part of the truth this book represents. The Defiants can keep the Wildfire Khumaak – although I'm sure Posmon would love to get his hands on it – but it's just an empty symbol without the book. Go and give the Book of St. Arzad to him, and let him keep it safe. It's the right thing to do. Isn't it?
messages.zh: 泊司曼·奥贝纳德是我的一个朋友，他是凯勒大学的盖伦特历史学家。他为人可信，是个聪明的学者，在大学里德高众望。如果你把这书交给他，我相信他会好好保存，说不准过几年就会出一本自己的畅销书细述此段历史。虽然这不会让我的米玛塔尔同胞们高兴，但至少我们保住了真相。挑战者组织可以继续保留他们的野火库马克——我知道泊司曼其实也很想得到这样东西——但那东西如果没有这本书辅佐就只是个摆设而已。请把这本圣阿尔扎德之书交给他，让他好生保管。这才是正确选择，对吧？

messages.en: I think we did the right thing. Though I am deeply troubled by this situation, as a historian, I must confront it. Thank you for all your efforts in this investigation, {[character]player.name}. Though some of my people may be upset with you, the Matari people as a whole owe you their gratitude. Good luck in the future, brave pilot.
messages.zh: 我觉得我们做了件正确的事。不过我必须承认，作为一名历史学家，我对此感到忐忑。{[character]player.name}，谢谢你在本次调查中付出的心血。虽然我同胞中有部分人可能会对你不满，但总的来说，玛塔利人还是会感谢你的。祝你将来顺利，勇敢的飞行员。

messages.en: You're leaving me with this choice? I don't think I can make the proper call.
messages.zh: 你把这决定交给我做？我不觉得自己能做出正确的决定。

messages.en: Did you meet with Posmon in Avesber?
messages.zh: 你在埃维斯贝尔见到泊司曼了吗？

name.ru: Расхождение во мнениях (A Difference of Opinion)

messages.en: The Bottom Line
messages.zh: 底线

messages.en:
I returned to Sinas after visiting the Ishukone facility out in Black Rise. He isn't sure why Ishukone is unconcerned about the evidence we've gathered against them but assumes they've either paid the right people off, or that we're not sitting on what we thought we were.

He's come up with a change of tactics now, and wants to try forging a compromise between Ishukone and the other corporations, including Nugoeihuvi. Even though he asked for my help in this, he's aware that Katsen has other ideas. For his own part, Isha wants me to dig even further and truly corner Ishukone this time. In the end I had to decide between the two plans.
messages.zh:
去过暗涌之域的异株湖集团基地之后，我回到了塞纳斯那儿。他不明白为什么在我们收集到不利于异株湖集团的证据之后，他们依然表现出一副无所谓的样子。他猜要么异株湖集团已经把钱给相关人员塞到位了，要么就是我们获得的那些证据根本没用。

他现在要改变战术，试着让异株湖集团与包括纳基维集团在内的其他军团达成妥协。虽然他求我在此事上伸出援手，但他也明白卡僧还有其他主意。卡僧的想法是让我进一步深究此事，直到把异株湖集团逼上梁为止。我必须在这两个方案之间做出选择。

Even though he asked for my help in this, he's aware that Katsen has other ideas. Isha wants me to dig even further and truly corner Ishukone this time. The decision about how to proceed rests on my shoulders.
messages.zh:
去过暗涌之域的异株湖集团设施之后，我回到了塞纳斯那儿。他不明白为什么在我们收集到不利于异株湖集团的证据之后，他们依然表现出一副无所谓的样子。他猜要么异株湖集团已经把钱给相关人员塞到位了，要么就是我们获得的那些证据根本没用。

他现在要改变战术，试着让异株湖集团与包括纳基维集团在内的其他军团达成妥协。虽然他求我在此事上伸出援手，但他也明白卡僧还有其他主意。卡僧的想法是让我进一步深究此事，直到把异株湖集团逼上梁为止。下一步如何做的决定落到了我肩上。

messages.en: Very well.
messages.zh: 很好。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, good. I talked to that old friend of mine about a compromise between Ishukone and the other corporations, and we've managed to come up with a solution he believes they'll agree to.

We're meeting shortly, but I wanted to update you on the progress. I believe we can solve this amicably, without pushing Ishukone into a corner. I can't imagine a better result myself, given the current situation.

It comes down to you, though. I'm well aware that Katsen must have other ideas about how to deal with this. He likely wants you to keep digging, I imagine. Well, you're free to go off and start that war if you think it necessary, but I won't be there to fight alongside you.

Sometimes conflict isn't the solution. Take it from a man who has been fighting his whole life. There's some things my guns could never change, {[character]player.name}. Either you understand that, and you're with me, or you can go the other way and learn that lesson yourself.

I'll push for a compromise either way, but it would help to have you in my corner on this one, more than you might appreciate.
messages.zh:
很好，{[character]player.name}。我已经和一个老朋友商讨了一下异株湖集团与其他军团之间达成协议的可能性。我们想出了个解决方案，我朋友相信他们会同意的。

我们很快就要会面，但我先跟你讲一下事情的最新进展。我觉得这事能和平解决，不用非把异株湖集团逼到绝路。以目前形势来讲，我认为这是个再好不过的解决方案了。

不过这一切还得看你。我知道卡僧还有其他主意。我觉得他会让你继续追查，直到把异株湖集团逼到墙角为止。当然了，如果你认为有必要的话可以现在就走，去把矛盾闹大，不过别拉上我。

有些时候对抗并不能解决问题。这是一个打了一生仗的人总结出来的道理。{[character]player.name}，有些事是永远无法用枪杆子改变的。你要么明事理按我说的做，要么你反其道行之去得个教训。

无论如何我都要促成妥协。但如果有你帮忙，那事情就好办得多，希望你能明白。

messages.en: Very well.
messages.zh: 很好。

messages.en: Fine, {[character]player.name}. If you want to get out now, I can hardly blame you.
messages.zh: 没什么，{[character]player.name}。你现在退出我不怪你。

messages.en: There's still a great deal left to do, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 还有很多事要做呢，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
I returned to Sinas after visiting the Ishukone facility out in Black Rise. While there, an Ishukone officer told me that, thanks to my help, they were able to anticipate Nugoeihuvi's moves and ensure that nothing conclusive could be proven. I was also asked to meet with them and discuss how to proceed from here, ignoring all others requests for my involvement.

At the same time, my Hyasyoda contact Arikio Kuretsu also let me know she has a plan; something that she promised would intimidate Isha into silence. She wants me to kidnap his family, but provided no further details about how exactly I would pull that off.

For their own part, Sinas and Katsen seem to be fighting over me too, each man trying to get me to do his bidding. My time with them is over though, I know enough now to act. From what Sinas says about forging an agreement with his friend, and from what I gathered while visiting the Ishukone facility, it appears that they're now ready to compromise. I can either help facilitate that process with Sinas, report to Ishukone myself, or help Hyasyoda blackmail Isha into silence and secure the operations in Black Rise that way.
messages.zh:
去过暗涌之域的异株湖集团基地之后，我又回到了塞纳斯那儿。异株湖集团的一位官员告诉我，多亏我帮忙，他们已经预判出纳基维集团的下一步行动，将确保其证明不出任何实质性的东西。他们要求我推脱其他所有请求，与他们会面商讨接下来的行动计划。

与此同时，我三岛的联系人阿里可·库利茨说她也有个计划。她说那计划能吓唬伊沙让其不再吱声。她要我绑架其家人，但没说具体怎么做。

塞纳斯和卡僧好像也在抢着拉拢我，让我为其中一个服务。但我觉得是时候跟他们说拜拜了，我已经详细了解了整个情况可以自主行动了。从塞纳斯说要与他朋友达成协议来看，以及从我去异株湖那里听得的消息来判断，双方已经准备妥协。我可以选择帮塞纳斯促成双方妥协，自己回异株湖集团；或者协助三岛集团敲诈伊沙让其闭嘴，以确保在暗涌之域的行动。

messages.zh: 没什么，{[character]player.name}。你现在退出我不怪你。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, good. I talked to that old friend of mine about a compromise between Ishukone and the other corporations, and we've managed to come up with a solution he believes they'll agree to.

We're meeting shortly, but I wanted to update you on the progress. I believe we can solve this amicably, without pushing Ishukone into a corner. I can't imagine a better result myself, given the current situation.

It comes down to you, though. I'm not about to pretend that Katsen doesn't still have other ideas about how to deal with this. My guess is that he wants you to keep digging, to properly back Ishukone into a corner. Well, you're free to go off and start that war if you think it's necessary, but I won't be there alongside you.

Sometimes conflict isn't the solution. Take it from a man who has been fighting his whole life. There's some things my guns could never change, {[character]player.name}. Either you understand that and you're with me, or you can go the other way and learn the lesson yourself.

I'll push for a compromise either way, but it would help to have you in my corner on this one, more than you might appreciate.
messages.zh:
很好，{[character]player.name}。我已经和一个老朋友商讨了一下异株湖集团与其他军团之间达成协议的可能性。我们想出了个解决方案，我朋友相信他们会同意的。

我们很快就要会面，但我先跟你讲一下事情的最新进展。我觉得这事能和平解决，不用非把异株湖集团逼到绝路。以目前形势来讲，我认为这是个再好不过的解决方案了。

不过这一切还得看你。我知道卡僧还有其他主意。我觉得他会让你继续追查，直到把异株湖集团逼到墙角为止。当然了，如果你认为有必要的话可以现在就走，去把矛盾闹大，不过别拉上我。

有些时候对抗并不能解决问题。这是一个打了一生仗的人总结出来的道理。{[character]player.name}，有些事是永远无法用枪杆子改变的。你要么明事理按我说的做，要么你反其道行之去得个教训。

无论如何我都要促成妥协。但如果有你帮忙，那事情就好办得多，希望你能明白。

messages.en: Fine, {[character]player.name}. If you want to get out now, I can hardly blame you.
messages.zh: 没什么，{[character]player.name}。你现在退出我不怪你。

messages.en: There's still a great deal left to do, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 还有很多事要做呢，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I've left Astoh and Sinas behind. I decided to pass on his offer of working out a compromise with Ishukone. Instead, I plan to meet one last time with Katsen to discuss how we're going to prove the existence of their operations in Black Rise conclusively.
messages.zh: 我离开了阿希多，与塞纳斯分道扬镳。我决定不与他合作促成与异株湖集团的妥协。我要去见卡僧最后一面，与之商量如何确凿证明他们在暗涌之域的行动。

messages.en: I've left Astoh and Sinas behind. I decided to pass on his offer of working out a compromise with Ishukone. Instead, I plan to meet one last time with Katsen to discuss how we're going to prove the existence of their operations in Black Rise conclusively.
messages.zh: 我离开了阿希多，与塞纳斯分道扬镳。我决定不与他合作促成与异株湖集团的妥协。我要去见卡僧最后一面，与之商量如何确凿证明他们在暗涌之域的行动。

messages.en: Report to Katsen Isha and pursue further evidence to prove Ishukone's guilt. There is a high probability that the only remaining evidence is the original copies of the mission documents. These would be likely be stored in a central location close to Ishukone Headquarters and guarded ferociously.
messages.zh: 去向卡僧·伊沙汇报，并进一步搜集能证明异株湖集团不道德的证据。事实上，能证明那点的最后证据或许就是原始的任务文档了。那些文档可能藏在一个距异株湖集团总部很近的中央地点。那里或有重兵把守。

messages.en:
From the looks of things, you're not coming with me on this last leg, are you? I can tell you share Katsen's conviction on this. You want Ishukone to pay for looking after their own people and turning their back on the rest. Well, I can understand it, {[character]player.name}. It's admirable even, but not something I can support. You can't teach a Caldari ethics by holding a gun to their head; things just don't work that way, no matter how well-intentioned.

Well, like I say, this is something for you to figure out yourself. Maybe someday you'll recognize your error. Until then, safe flying my egger friend. Regardless of anything else, you've done more for me, and more for those people out there, than most others would do in a lifetime. I may disagree with how you're handling the endgame, but what got you here was a good head and a good heart.

Good luck with whatever you do, and try to remember what I said.
messages.zh:
看起来你是不会帮我这最后一个忙了，是吧？我知道，在这事情上，你与卡僧持有同样的观点。你要异株湖集团为只顾自己人而不顾其他人付出代价。我懂，{[character]player.name}。你这想法甚至让人钦佩，但我实在无法与之共鸣。你不能把一把枪指着加达里人的脑袋以期他们明白做人的道理。无论你的初衷有多好，这都行不通的。

算了，还是像我说得那样，这事只有你自己能想明白。或许哪天你就意识到自己错了。现在还是让我祝你一路顺风吧，朋友。撇开其他事不谈，你已经为我、为那些人做出了比多数人一生加起来都要多的贡献。虽然我与你在最后一件事情的处理上存有分歧，但正是因为你有一个好脑子、善心地才让你能与我合作至今。

不管你以后干啥，我都祝你顺利。记得我说的话。

messages.en:
I decided to return to Poinen and help Katsen Isha pursue the evidence we needed to get leverage on Ishukone. I stormed one of the Watch's most heavily defended facilities and successfully recovered the original Black Rise operational documents. We finally have them, without a doubt.

Even though he has no further use for a capsuleer, Isha shared his future plans with me. Firstly, Nugoeihuvi will extort Ishukone for enough ISK to compensate three times the estimated number of people left behind during their rescue operations. The ISK will be donated to various veterans' funds, disguised as donations from rich capsuleers.

In the future, Katsen assures me that Ishukone will broaden their operations, and operate under one simple guideline: the recovery of Caldari citizens.

Along with his thanks, he gave me the remaining ISK budgeted towards hiring me. Strangely enough for a man working at Nugoeihuvi, it didn't seem to have any value after serving its purpose. Given everything I've seen though, I'm no longer so sure that NOH are the soulless, money-hungry vultures that other corporations so easily paint them as. Then again, his other reward was a stash of modified blue pill, presumably made from the blueprints we stole. I guess some things won't ever change.
messages.zh:
我决定回到波耶伦，帮助卡僧搜集能用来制约异株湖集团的证据。我闯入了一座戒备森严的异株湖安全部队的基地，成功地拿到了与暗涌之域营救行动有关的原版文档。

虽然伊沙接下来已经用不到克隆飞行员，他还是把其后面的计划告诉了我。首先，纳维基集团将逼迫异株湖集团按被其置之不理人数的三倍来进行赔钱。这些钱将假借富豪克隆飞行员捐赠的名义注入各种退伍军人专用的基金。

卡僧向我保证以后异株湖集团会扩大他们的行动覆盖范围，并以“营救加达里公民”这一单一旗号来行动。

除了感谢之外，他还给了我原本就专为我预留着的钱。奇怪的是，对于一个为纳维基集团效力的人来说，这样做好像并没有什么意义。不过在经历了这一切之后，我不再那么坚定地认为纳维基集团像其他军团描述的那样，是个不讲情义、只赚钞票的团体。不过伊沙后来又给了我一些改造过的蓝色药丸作为附赠品。那些药丸看上去像是按照我们偷来的蓝图生产出来的。正所谓江山易改，本性难移啊。

messages.en: I've decided to help Katsen continue to pursue the evidence we need to get leverage on Ishukone. The plan is to storm a heavily-defended Ishukone Watch base and recover the original operational documents for the Black Rise rescues. Isha tells me evidence like that will ensure Ishukone's future compliance. Because of this, however, the place will be what he described as a “fortress”.
messages.zh: 我已经决定继续帮助卡僧搜集能用来制约异株湖集团的证据。我们的计划是闯入一座戒备森严的异株湖安全部队基地，从中拿出与暗涌之域营救行动相关的文档。伊沙告诉我类似那样的证据将确保异株湖将来对我们言听计从。不过也正是因此原因，伊沙说那将是个“戒备森严”的地方。

messages.en: Good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, it's good to see you again, particularly under these circumstances. To be honest with you, I had some concerns that your time with Sinas changed the way you see things. He's a good friend; a patriot, as I told you earlier, but this talk of coming to a compromise with Ishukone betrays the weaker side to him. There is no such thing as a fair deal from the likes of Ishukone – they won't agree to help others unless they get to help themselves first.

We Practicals know when to make and break deals, and we always remember the larger picture. It's time to forget about Sinas and remember the fighting men and women abandoned by Ishukone rescue teams. That won't stop until we make it stop, {[character]player.name}.

You're flying to Malkalen, to a major security headquarters for Ishukone Watch known as “Base 3”. This station acts as an archive for all Ishukone Watch operations in Black Rise. This is an internal archive, meaning it will house not only the original reports, but in their full, uncensored version too. As you might expect, that information is well guarded. They know they can't hide the evidence from Nugoeihuvi, all they can do is put it behind a fleet. You are our best weapon now, {[character]player.name}.

I won't lie. I'm sending you into a fortress. I have no more doubts about you though. You have come this far and not once strayed from the path we have walked together. I know you will deliver.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，很高兴再次见到你，尤其是在现在这种时候。说实话，我担心你与塞纳斯在一起时间久了会影响你处理事情的方法。我之前就跟你说过，他是个好朋友，一位爱国者。但他现在提出与异株湖集团达成妥协恰好暴露了其软弱之处。异株湖之类的团体根本不会与你达成公平协议——他们一定要先保全自己才肯帮别人。

我们务实派知道什么时候该签协议，什么时候该撕协议，并且总是着眼大局。现在是忘记塞纳斯、将被异株湖离弃的士兵同胞们放入心里的时候了。{[character]player.name}，他们一定要我们阻止他们才会停下来。

请飞往位于莫卡冷的异株湖安全部队的一个名为“第 3 基地”的大型安全总部。那座空间站存放了所有与异株湖安全部队在暗涌之域行动有关的档案。那些档案全是内部资料，不仅是原版，而且也未经删减。想必你已料到，那些资料都被严密保管着。他们知道没法在纳维基集团面前瞒天过海，因此只能将资料交由一支舰队看管。{[character]player.name}，你是我们目前拥有的最佳武器。

不瞒你说，你要去的是个戒备森严的地方。但我相信你能应对。你与我们合作了这么久，从来没有让我们失望过。我知道你这次也行的。

messages.en:
Simply impressive work, {[character]player.name}, but after seeing you come back to Poinen, I knew you would pull it off and make it look easy. Ishukone has played all their cards now; it's our turn to make the moves. My turn, more precisely. I've no further need for a capsuleer, but I have to say, you've been more than worth the ISK you cost. Since you've been with me for the long haul and, I believe, have as much of a personal interest in this matter as I do, let me tell you how Nugoeihuvi plans to proceed from here.

First, we will use the rock-solid evidence you recovered to extort the people behind this. My people are still doing the final calculations, but our figures are based on the average compensation given to a family who loses someone in battle, then multiplied for each person we estimate they left behind, then tripled.

Once they pay – and they will pay – that ISK will find its way into various Caldari State veteran's funds; a series of unrelated donations from a number of wealthy capsuleers. Your lot could do with some good press, and I will not allow Ishukone to milk their “donation” for any PR value.

In the future, Ishukone rescue operations will operate under one simple guideline: the recovery of Caldari prisoners of war. Ishukone may be a family of its own, I don't deny the way things work, but the larger family we are all a part of comes before anything else.

You have taught them this lesson, {[character]player.name}, reminded them of this simple truth. There are few who could have done so, and out of those, even less who would have been willing to try. I can't thank you enough, or offer anything that will appropriately compensate you for your troubles. I do have the remaining ISK I had budgeted for hiring you though, it's of no use to me now, so please take it.

I also have something interesting that arrived from KFR-ZE a few days ago. You could call it the fruits of our earlier labor. Consider it a gift, from one friend to another.

Fly safe out there, {[character]player.name}, and try to remember the things you saw in our short time together.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。在看你回到波耶伦之后，我就知道你一定能大功告成，把这事像切菜一样轻而易举地搞定。异株湖集团已经没有戏可唱了，现在轮到我们行动了。更准确地说，是轮到我行动了。我接下来用不上克隆飞行员了，但我必须承认，你绝对是物超所值。鉴于你已经与我合作了良久，而且我相信你与我一样对此事都有饶有兴致，我把纳维基集团接下来会怎么做告诉你。

首先，我们要利用你取回的铁证逼迫这起行动的幕后指使向我们赔钱。我的手下还在算这笔钱的具体数量，我们将用烈士家属的平均获赔金额乘以异株湖集团置之不顾的人数，然后再乘以3即是我们要求的数额。

一旦他们把钱付了之后——他们一定会付，我们就将把钱转到加达里合众国的各类退伍军人基金里，让它们看上去像是一群毫不相干的富豪级克隆飞行员的个人捐赠行为。你们克隆飞行员还能籍此获得些正面报道，我可不会让异株湖集团抢去任何风头。

以后，异株湖集团将只能打着“营救加达里战俘”的旗号行动。他们或许也算个大家庭，我不否认他们那种做法的效率，但我们都处在一个更大的家庭里，所有人都必须把她摆在第一位。

{[character]player.name}，你已经让他们认识到了这一点，让他们明白了这一简单道理。有能力做到这些的人本身就不多，其中愿意尝试的人更是少之又少。我对你有道不尽的感谢，也没有任何东西能弥补你遭受到的困难。但我还剩下一些原本就计划好要给你的钱，这些钱我用不着，请拿着。

我还要给你一件数天前从KFR-ZE拿来的很有意思的东西。你可以称其为我们之前的劳动成果。就当它是我赠予你的一件礼物吧。

祝你一路平安，{[character]player.name}。不要忘记我们短暂合作旅途中你所遇到的那些事情。

messages.en: Then you are betraying me. There is no other explanation for this behavior. Goodbye, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 那你就是在背叛我。我不要听任何解释。拜拜，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
“There once was a great rich merchant,” she began hesitantly, suddenly all too aware that all eyes in the room were on her. But she plunged on regardless, steeling her nerves. “He lived to a grand old age and possessed every wealth a man could dream of. Many looked to him in awe or envy, coveting his treasures and desiring to imitate his great successes. Yet the old man was never happy and on his deathbed, a young clerk working for him asked: ‘You must feel that your life has been one great success story, what with all the wealth you have accumulated.'

But the old man replied. ‘My life has been one of misery and sorrow. As a young man I chose wealth over family, discarding the love of my life. When I die all that I will leave behind in the world is money. But money is the same all over, mine is no different from anyone else's. Once my wealth has been scattered, all that I will be is dust and vague memories. My life is a failure young man, don't make the same mistakes I did.'
messages.zh:
“以前曾有一个很富有的商人，”她犹豫地张开了口，突然意识到房间里所有人的目光都投射到她身上。稍许壮胆之后，她继续起来：“他活到很大的年纪，拥有了每个人都梦想获得的财富。很多人都以崇拜或是嫉妒的眼光看待他，对其财富垂之以涎，梦想将其成功复制到自己身上。但那老人从来没有快乐过。在其岁月即将终结之时，有位年轻的职员问他：‘有了这么多钱，你肯定觉得自己的一生非常成功。'

可那老人答道：‘我的一生充满了痛楚与遗憾。年轻时我为了金钱放弃了家庭，把我一生的挚爱都给抛弃。我死后，所能留下的就只有钱。钱都是一个样的，我的钱与其他人的钱并没有什么不同之处。钱分完之后，我将化作一团灰，成为别人脑中依稀残留的回忆。我这一生是失败的，年轻人，千万别犯和我一样的错误。'

messages.en: Crielere; a parable told to all aspiring young Caldari
messages.zh: 克莱勒瑞；一篇讲给有雄心壮志的加达里年轻人听的故事

messages.en:

He's a good friend; a patriot, as I told you earlier, but this talk of coming to a compromise with Ishukone betrays the weaker side to him. messages.zh: 那你就是在背叛我。我不要听任何解释。拜拜，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Malkalen will test you, {[character]player.name}, make sure you are ready.
messages.zh: 莫卡冷之战对你来说将是一场考验，{[character]player.name}。请做好准备。

messages.en:
I decided to help Sinas come to an agreement with Ishukone. Our plan was to free Ishukone up for other operations by taking over the transportation of recovered prisoners, moving them back to Ishukone HQ in Malkalen. I successfully relocated month's worth of prisoners in a single trip, safely ferrying them from Teskanen to Malkalen.

Sinas tells me that the sheer amount of people I moved not only freed them up to pursue the recovery other Caldari than their own personnel, but was also cause for Ishukone to reflect about the wider operational viability of going it alone. I'm told that future operations will be undertaken as a joint effort between other corporations.

Sinas put in a good word for me to some “well-placed” friends of his, promising that my deeds would not go unnoticed. He also gave me some ISK, apparently it was part of the ransom that Ishukone would have been forced to pay to keep Isha silent.

He said my work was done now though; that I had in fact done more than anyone expected. He wished me well, and sent me back on my way.
messages.zh:
我决定帮塞纳斯与异株湖集团达成协议。我们的计划是将救出的战俘运回位于莫卡冷的异株湖集团总部，这样异株湖就能腾出人手去做其他事。我成功地将原本需一个月才能运完的人一次性地从特斯坎能运送到了莫卡冷。

塞纳斯告诉我，这次大人流运输不仅给异株湖集团腾出精力去解救其集团之外的加达里人，也逼迫他们重新审视一下继续单打独斗的可行性。听说异株湖集团以后将与其他军团通力合作了。

塞纳斯在他一些“身居高位的”朋友面前美言了我几句，向我保证我所做的一切不会无人赏识。他还给了我一些星币。那些星币是原本为了封住伊沙嘴巴而准备的贿赂的一部分。

他说这里已经没我的事了，还说我的表现让他喜出望外。最后他祝我一路顺风，就把我送走了。

messages.en:
I've decided to help Sinas come to an agreement with Ishukone. My task is to safely transport the thousands of prisoners already recovered and waiting to return home. They'll be transported from a Caldari Navy station in Teskanen to their Headquarters in Malkalen. Although the trip is a short one, it begins inside Black Rise, in low security space. Given the cargo, the stakes in keeping a low profile are significant.

Sinas is hopeful that if I can take care of this, Ishukone will broaden their recovery efforts to include all Caldari, not just their own personnel.
messages.zh:
我决定帮塞纳斯与异株湖集团达成协议。我的任务是运送数千名从牢中救出、等待回家的战俘。我将把他们从特斯坎能的加达里海军空间站运往他们的莫卡冷总部。虽然路程很短，但起点却位于暗涌之域的一个低安全区。鉴于这次运输对象的特殊性，低调行事非常重要。

塞纳斯希望我完成这次运送任务之后，异株湖能扩大他们的救援范围，将所有的加达里人都囊括进去，而不再只是他们内部自己人。

messages.en:
You made the right choice for the men and women still left out here, don't doubt it for a second.

Now that we have you on board, I'm going to get my friend to float the deal to his superiors. I've no doubt in my mind that they'll jump at the opportunity the moment they learn we have you by our side. By the time you make it to Teskanen, they should all be assembled in the Caldari Navy station there.

Take them home, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
你为滞留在那里的人做出了正确的决定，你不用怀疑自己。

现在既然你答应干了，那我就让我朋友向他上级去推销这一妥协方案。我相信只要他们一知道有你加入便肯定会满口答应。你飞抵特斯坎能之后，他们肯定已经在加达里海军空间站里把人准备好了。

请把那些人送回家，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Work with Sinas to compromise with Ishukone. He has a friend inside the corporation who believes that a deal can be struck if Ishukone can first receive assistance transporting many prisoners already recovered and waiting to return home. The liberated prisoners will need to be transported from low security space in Black Rise back to Ishukone Headquarters in Malkalen.
messages.zh: 请帮塞纳斯达成与异株湖集团达成协议。据他一位在该集团内部的朋友透露，如果异株湖集团能先获得帮忙，接到已经获救、等待回家的那些战俘，那双方之间就能达成协议。你需要把那些获救的战俘从位于暗涌之域的一个低安全区送到位于莫卡冷的异株湖集团总部。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}, remarkably well.

I remember when Katsen first sent you my way. I thought you would be just another egger looking for ISK and glory. There's something different about you though, I think. You at least seem to care about the rest of us, and given everything you're capable of and everything you must have in your life, that's not something I'm about to take for granted.

The word from Ishukone is that they've received everyone safely. They're more grateful than I've seen them in a long time. You have to understand, {[character]player.name}, before your arrival the evacuation process was little more than a trickle of loyal citizens back to their home. Once you arrived, the flood came – month's worth of people safely moved in a single trip. You've opened their eyes, showed them in a way only a capsuleer could have that a change was needed.

The next move from here will be to expand Ishukone's operations to include everyone, regardless of their parent corporation. They'll be collaborating with a few interested parties on that, to ensure none of us repeat the mistakes of the past.

You've done all you can here, though. More than most could have hoped for. I don't have much in the way to give you as thanks, but I've made a few calls. You might not think it to look at me, but I know a few well-placed people. Your selfless service to the Caldari people will not go unnoticed.

Also, Ishukone wanted to pass this ISK on to you as a token of thanks. Apparently that money represents part of the demanded ransom from Katsen for his silence. Ishukone can focus on everyone now, which means no more scandal, and no more opportunities for blackmail. A practical like Katsen could learn a thing or two about other ways to make a profit, eh? Ah well, take it. You deserve it more than he does, he said as much himself.

And that's it, {[character]player.name}. Debriefing over. You are dismissed.
messages.zh:
干得好，{[character]player.name}，非常好。

我还记得卡僧刚派你来我这儿的那一段日子。我当时以为你不过又是一位冲着名利而来的克隆飞行员。但我觉得你还是有与众不同的地方。至少你看起来挺关心我们的。如果把你的能力与你对生活的追求考虑在内，我觉得你能做到这样真的很不容易。

异株湖集团报告说他们安全接到了你送去的每个人。我已经很长时间没见过他们这么心存感激了。{[character]player.name}，我跟你说，在你没来之前，整个援救速度慢得像蜗牛爬一样。你一来就像带了双飞毛腿，原本需一个月才能送走的一批人现在被你一次性就运走了。你让异株湖的人大开眼界，以一种克隆飞行员独有的方式让他们知道其做事方式非改不可。

接下来异株湖集团应该会在救援行动中顾及所有人，不再管他们的母公司是谁了。他们会与有关部门合作，确保不再犯先前的错误。

这里应该已经没你什么事了。你的表现已经超出了我的期望。我除了表示感谢之外已经没什么可给你了，但我还是拨了几个电话。你可能从我长相上看不出来，我其实有些身居高位的朋友。我不会让你为加达里人民做出的无私奉献白费。

另外，异株湖集团让我把这些星币给你以表感谢。很明显这钱来源于原本为了让卡僧闭嘴而不得不支付的一笔贿赂。现在异株湖集团可以照顾到所有人了，这样就不会再闹丑闻，也不会再被别人敲诈了。像卡僧这么实际的人应该会因此学到其他的生财之道了吧？好了，拿着这笔钱。你比他有更充足的理由获得它们。他自己也这么说。

好了，该讲的都讲完了，{[character]player.name}。你可以走了。

messages.en: You've got to be kidding me…
messages.zh: 你跟我开什么玩笑……

messages.en:
“There once was a great rich merchant,” she began hesitantly, suddenly all too aware that all eyes in the room were on her. But she plunged on regardless, steeling her nerves. “He lived to a grand old age and possessed every wealth a man could dream of. Many looked to him in awe or envy, coveting his treasures and desiring to imitate his great successes. Yet the old man was never happy and on his deathbed, a young clerk working for him asked: ‘You must feel that your life has been one great success story, what with all the wealth you have accumulated.'

But the old man replied. ‘My life has been one of misery and sorrow. As a young man I chose wealth over family, discarding the love of my life. When I die all that I will leave behind in the world is money. But money is the same all over, mine is no different from anyone else's. Once my wealth has been scattered, all that I will be is dust and vague memories. My life is a failure young man, don't make the same mistakes I did.'
messages.zh:
“以前曾有一个很富有的商人，”她犹豫地张开了口，突然意识到房间里所有人的目光都投射到她身上。稍许壮胆之后，她继续起来：“他活到很大的年纪，拥有了每个人都梦想获得的财富。很多人都以崇拜或是嫉妒的眼光看待他，对其财富垂之以涎，梦想将其成功复制到自己身上。但那老人从来没有快乐过。在其岁月即将终结之时，有位年轻的职员问他：‘有了这么多钱，你肯定觉得自己的一生非常成功。'

可那老人答道：‘我的一生充满了痛楚与遗憾。年轻时我为了金钱放弃了家庭，把我一生的挚爱都给抛弃。我死后，所能留下的就只有钱。钱都是一个样的，我的钱与其他人的钱并没有什么不同之处。钱分完之后，我将化作一团灰，成为别人脑中依稀残留的回忆。我这一生是失败的，年轻人，千万别犯和我一样的错误。'

messages.en: Crielere; a parable told to all aspiring young Caldari
messages.zh: 克莱勒瑞；一篇讲给有雄心壮志的加达里年轻人听的故事

messages.en:
If I'm honest, I wasn't sure that you and I would ever see one another again. I know that Katsen probably offered you all kinds of things to continue pursuing Ishukone. You didn't take it though, so good work. Maybe there were other temptations, perhaps? A few other bets you were hedging on the side? Hmm, yes, don't worry, I won't push the matter, but something tells me perhaps you're starting to appreciate things many Caldari forget to.

So then…let me catch you up. My friend and I believe a deal can be struck easily if we can put aside the question of moving recovered Ishukone personnel to their Headquarters in Malkalen. If you were to offer your help, it would lend a tremendous amount of credibility to the operation. Ishukone may not trust you, but they trust the Navy, and they will trust that you have the ability to do the job, if not the loyalty. Personally, I know you'll do what's right. You wouldn't be here otherwise.

There's a huge risk here though, {[character]player.name}. You'll be moving people from a low-security system in a warzone through to the heartlands of State space. Thousands of lives will depend on your ability to maintain a low profile.
messages.zh:
说实话，我之前真不知道我们是否还能再见。我猜卡僧应该是想方设法拉拢你去追击异株湖集团。但你不为所动，很好。不过他应该还开出了不少诱人条件，你或许还在思量之中？哈，别担心，我不会强人所难逼你说的。我反而有种感觉：你开始恪守一些很多加达里人早已忘在脑后的做人原则。

好了，我现在跟你讲一下事情的最新进展。我朋友和我都认为如果我们能不计较把已救出的异株湖人送回他们的莫卡冷总部，那我们就能很容易地与异株湖集团敲定一份协议。如果你能帮忙，那便可极大地提升这次送人行动的可信度。异株湖集团或许不相信你，但他们信任海军，因此尽管对你的忠诚度或有怀疑，但他们还是相信你有能力办好此事。我自己觉得你也行，否则你就不会出现在这儿了。

不过这事风险还挺大的，{[character]player.name}。你要把人从一个低安全区战场运往加达里的核心区域。数千条命都在你手上，就看你能否低调行事了。

messages.en: You've got to be kidding me…
messages.zh: 你跟我开什么玩笑……

messages.en: You should head out to Teskanen, {[character]player.name}. They're assembling everyone in our station as I speak.
messages.zh: 你快去特斯坎能，{[character]player.name}。他们正在我们空间站里做准备呢。

messages.en:
I met once again with Arikio Kuretsu, the Hyasyoda agent I'd been working undercover with. She told me that the information I'd gathered on Katsen Isha has helped them a great deal, particularly one lead they followed up. Hyasyoda discovered that Katsen Isha has a family, and Arikio had possession of their location.

As Arikio said herself, the situation is unfortunate, but in the end our hand was forced by Isha's persistence. I was tasked with raiding a Nugoeihuvi storage facility and recovering his family. We have learned that Isha is man who has little in the way of weaknesses, the kidnapping was the only means of acquiring leverage against him.

Once I returned to Wuos with Isha's family in tow, I was met with praise from Arikio and all of Hyasyoda, who are confident that the current operations can now continue without harassment from Nugoeihuvi. She thanked me on behalf of the thousands of prisoners who could now continue to find their way back to the State, and gave me a gift – a research laboratory recovered from the same facility Isha had me raid all that time ago. She said it was a token of thanks, and to remind me that good things could come of bad situations, if only I worked at it.
messages.zh:
我再次见了卧底合伙人、三岛集团的代理人阿里可·库利茨。她跟我说我收集到的有关卡僧·伊沙的信息非常有用，尤其是其中一条他们已经追查下去的线索。三岛集团发现卡僧·伊沙有家人，阿里可已经掌握了那家人的住址。

就像阿里可她自己说的那样，事情发展至今实属不幸，但正是伊沙的顽固才逼得我们没选择。我的任务是袭击纳维基的一座仓库，抓住其家人。我们通过调查发现伊沙这人几乎没有弱点，因此绑架其家人成了我们唯一的选择。

我把那家人带回乌欧斯之后，阿里可及整个三岛集团都对我赞不绝口。他们相信他们目前的行动将不再遭受纳维基的干扰。阿里可代表数千名将获救的俘虏感谢了我，然后又送了我一件礼物——一个从伊沙之前要我袭击的基地中获取的研究实验室。她说那东西代表了感谢，并提醒我：只要用心去做，坏事也能有转机。

messages.en:
I've met once again with Arikio Kuretsu, the Hyasyoda agent I've been working undercover with. She told me that the information I've been gathering on Katsen Isha has helped them a great deal, particularly one lead they followed up. Hyasyoda has discovered that Katsen Isha has a family, and Arikio knows where they are currently located too.

As Arikio says herself, the situation is unfortunate, but kidnapping his family will undoubtedly assure us of his silence. As soon as Isha is removed from the picture, the operation to liberate prisoners will be allowed to continue.
messages.zh:
我再次见了卧底合伙人、三岛集团的代理人阿里可·库利茨。她跟我说我收集到的有关卡僧·伊沙的信息非常有用，尤其是其中一条他们已经追查下去的线索。三岛集团发现卡僧·伊沙有家人，阿里可已经掌握了那家人的住址。

就像阿里可她自己说的那样，事情发展至今实属不幸，但只有绑架卡僧的家人才能确保封住他的嘴巴。一旦伊沙不再挡道，那解救俘虏的行动便能继续。

messages.en:
Good. Here are the coordinates. I'll be in touch with further instructions as needed.

Good luck, {[character]player.name}, we're all counting on you.
messages.zh:
好。给你地址。我会在必要时与你联系做进一步指示。

祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。我们就靠你了。

messages.en:
Katsen Isha is a man gifted with considerable political acumen, and his known associates make for a long list of people I don't want to screw around with. We have learned a great deal from the information you've leaked us and uncovered much of the important details about this man. For the longest time, he seemed incorruptible and untouchable; a man with no bad habits, no sordid secrets and no exploitable desires, all surrounded by some serious corporate heavyweights. That impression of him has changed.

Although you helped us find a number of interesting things, we recently followed up on a lead you provided us and stumbled upon something that utterly dwarfs anything else so far unearthed. We have identified the one thing that he actually cares about; his family. We also have the coordinates of their current location in our possession.

It's unfortunate, I'm not about to pretend otherwise, but if capturing his family is the only way to get a genuine assurance of silence out of this man, then it is the path we must tread. Isha is skating damn close to treason, he deserves far worse. We cannot let Ishukone's operations be undone because of Nugoeihuvi's lust for profit.

If you are willing and able to assist us, then I can give you the coordinates of a central Nugoeihuvi Storage facility; a quiet, not-so-well-protected little area that NOH staff use to store their ships and documents. Nobody would ever want to live there, and nobody actually living there would ever be that comfortable. It's the perfect place for a man with many enemies to hide what he values most.
messages.zh:
卡僧·伊沙是个非常有政治天赋的人，他的那些同僚我惹不起。通过你透露给我们的信息，我们对他有了非常深入的了解。他好像一直都是两袖清风、动不得的人。他没有不良嗜好，没有见不得人的秘密，也没有可利用的欲望。他的周围全是一帮军团重量级人物。不过是人总有弱点。

虽然你已经帮我们发现了不少有意思的事情，但在最近追查了一个你提供给我们的线索之后，我们发现了一项影响力足以盖过其他任何事的东西：伊沙的家人。那家人的地址我们现在也已经知道了。

我承认这样做对其家人很不公平，但如果劫持那家人是唯一能让伊沙闭口不言的办法，那我们就必须得这样做。伊沙的行为基本上就是叛国，他被这样对待是罪有应得。我们不能让纳维基集团的赚钱欲望妨碍异株湖集团的行动。

如果你愿意帮忙，我就把一座纳维基中心储藏基地的地址给你。那是个安静、守备不怎么森严的基地。纳维基人用它来存放舰船与资料。没人想住那地方，住过那里的人觉得不舒服。对一个树敌众多的人来说，那地方是个藏匿其最珍视物品的绝佳地点。

messages.en:
You've done it, {[character]player.name}. You've actually done it. Those people are, without a doubt, Katsen Isha's family. We can guarantee his silence now, an absolutely excellent result.

You've brought a potentially disastrous situation to a clean and comfortable end. We are all indebted to you for it, particularly those whose lives will be spared when our rescue teams continue to find them out there, waiting for someone. Your actions give us all hope.

I know it hasn't been an easy journey for you; getting mixed up in the machinations of corporate agendas and personal grudges is never pleasant. It's the darker side to our society, and not something anyone ever wants to contend with. The way you handled everything however, it was exemplary. If only more Caldari would work for peace and stability like you did, we would be faring even better as a nation.

I'd like to give you something as thanks. I'm sure it's not much to a capsuleer like you, but all the same, we in Hyasyoda would like you to have it. We salvaged it from the research facility that Serpentis overtook – the same one you were misled into raiding. I like to think that it will remind you of everything you accomplished, and that good things can come out of bad situations if you only work at it.

Thank you once again, {[character]player.name}, and fly safe. We won't forget what you've done for us.
messages.zh:
你搞定了，{[character]player.name}，你真的搞定了。毫无疑问，那些人就是卡僧·伊沙的家人。这下他肯定会闭嘴了，你干得太棒了。

你摆平了一件原本可能会衍变成灾难的事件。我们欠你一个人情，尤其是那些我们将要去拯救的人，他们更是连感谢你都来不及。你的行动给我们所有人都带来了希望。

我知道你坚持下来不容易；没人喜欢被牵扯在公司与个人阴谋之间。这是社会的阴暗面，没人喜欢游走于其中。但你处理这些事情的方式绝对具有标榜性。如果能有更多的加达里人像你一样，为和平稳定做出贡献，那我们的国家会更美好。

我想给你样东西以表感谢。我知道这东西对你们克隆飞行员来说可能算不上什么，但我们三岛集团全体人都希望你能收下它。这东西是我们从天蛇曾占领的研究基地打捞出来的——那基地就是你之前被误导袭击的基地。希望这件礼物能让你想起你所有的成就，并让你记住这样一个道理：只要你用心去做，坏事也能有转机。

再次感谢你，{[character]player.name}。祝你一路平安。我们不会忘记你为我们做出的一切。

messages.en: So…you did get turned after all. What a waste of potential you capsuleers are.
messages.zh: 啊，你还是变想法了。你们克隆飞行员真是废才。

“以前曾有一个很富有的商人，”她犹豫地张开了口，突然意识到房间里所有人的目光都投射到她身上。稍许壮胆之后，她继续起来：“他活到很大的年纪，拥有了每个人都梦想获得的财富。很多人都以崇拜或是嫉妒的眼光看待他，对其财富垂之以涎，梦想将其成功复制到自己身上。但那老人从来没有快乐过。在其岁月即将终结之时，有位年轻的职员问他：‘有了这么多钱，你肯定觉得自己的一生非常成功。'

可那老人答道：‘我的一生充满了痛楚与遗憾。年轻时我为了金钱放弃了家庭，把我一生的挚爱都给抛弃。我死后，所能留下的就只有钱。钱都是一个样的，我的钱与其他人的钱并没有什么不同之处。钱分完之后，我将化作一团灰，成为别人脑中依稀残留的回忆。我这一生是失败的，年轻人，千万别犯和我一样的错误。'

messages.en: From Crielere; a parable told to all aspiring young Caldari
messages.zh: 来自克莱瑞勒，一篇讲给有雄心壮志的加达里年轻人听的故事

messages.en:
Welcome back to Wuos, {[character]player.name}, it's reassuring to see you here, I have to admit. After all that time undercover, we were starting to worry that you'd forgotten your loyalties. Here you are though, and you've come bearing all kinds of vital information. Your loyalty and commitment is not characteristic of your kind, but then, everything about you has exceeded expectations. I have little doubt that on this last, most important mission, you will not fail me either.

Katsen Isha is a man gifted with considerable political acumen, and his known associates make for a long list of people I don't want to screw around with. We have learned a great deal from the information you've leaked us and uncovered much of the important details about this man. For the longest time, he seemed incorruptible and untouchable; a man with no bad habits, no sordid secrets and no exploitable desires, all surrounded by some serious corporate heavyweights. That impression of him has changed.

Although you helped us find a number of interesting things, we recently followed up on a lead you provided us and stumbled upon something that utterly dwarfs anything else so far unearthed. We have identified the one thing that he actually cares about; his family. We also have the coordinates of their current location in our possession.

It's unfortunate, I'm not about to pretend otherwise, but if capturing his family is the only way to get a genuine assurance of silence out of this man, then it is the path we must tread. Isha is bordering damn close to treason already, he deserves far worse. We cannot let Ishukone's operations be undone because of Nugoeihuvi's lust for profit. The notion that he would try to blackmail us on such a thing speaks volumes about the values held dear by NOH.

If you are willing to help us, then I can give you the coordinates of a central Nugoeihuvi Storage facility; a quiet but well protected little area that NOH staff use to store their ships and documents. Nobody would ever want to live there, and nobody actually living there would ever be that comfortable. It's the perfect place for a man with many enemies to hide what he values most.

Thousands of Caldari prisoners are depending on us to save them, and now it comes down to you, {[character]player.name}. Either our operation can continue under the radar, and thousands can be saved, or it can become a scandal that costs us ISK, our reputations, and the lives of countless Caldari. Isha must be stopped.
messages.zh:
欢迎回到乌欧斯，{[character]player.name}。说实话，看到你我就放心了。本来我们还担心经历了那么长一段时间卧底之后，你会忘记忠诚这两个字。还好你现在来了，还且还带来了各种重要信息。虽然你的尽职尽责在你们这类人中实属罕见，但你已在各方面有着出乎意料的上佳表现。因此我相信在接下来这一最后、同时也是最重要的任务上，你必定不会让我失望。

卡僧·伊沙是个非常有政治天赋的人，他的那些同僚我惹不起。通过你透露给我们的信息，我们对他有了非常深入的了解。他好像一直都是两袖清风、动不得的人。他没有不良嗜好，没有见不得人的秘密，也没有可利用的欲望。他的周围全是一帮军团重量级人物。不过是人总有弱点。

虽然你已经帮我们发现了不少有意思的事情，但在最近追查了一个你提供给我们的线索之后，我们发现了一项影响力足以盖过其他任何事的东西：伊沙的家人。那家人的地址我们现在也已经知道了。

我承认这样做对其家人很不公平，但如果劫持那家人是唯一能让伊沙闭口不言的办法，那我们就必须得这样做。伊沙的行为基本上就是叛国，他被这样对待是罪有应得。我们不能让纳维基集团的赚钱欲望妨碍异株湖集团的行动。他敢在这件事上敲诈我们足以说明纳维基的价值观有多么龌龊。

如果你愿意帮忙，我就把一座纳维基中心储藏基地的地址给你。那是个安静、但守备森严的基地。纳维基人用它来存放舰船与资料。没人想住那地方，住过那里的人觉得不舒服。对一个树敌众多的人来说，那地方是个藏匿其最珍视物品的绝佳地点。

数千名加达里俘虏能否活下来都将取决于我们，现在就看你的了，{[character]player.name}。要么我们能继续秘密行动，挽救数千条性命；要么这事被抖出去，然后我们的钱、名声以及数千条加达里人的性命都将不保，因此我们决不能让伊沙得逞。

messages.en: So…you did get turned after all. What a waste of potential you capsuleers are.
messages.zh: 啊，你还是变想法了。你们克隆飞行员真是废才。

messages.en: You should head out to the storage facility as soon as possible, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你该尽快前往那仓库，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I've stalled Sinas for a day, getting me enough time to meet once again with Arikio at the Hyasyoda station in Wuos. She is confident that her plan to use Isha's family as leverage will guarantee his silence, and the security of Ishukone's operations inside Black Rise.
messages.zh: 我已经把塞纳斯拖了一天。期间我又去乌欧斯的三岛空间站见了阿里可一面。她相信她能利用伊沙的家人让其闭嘴，并确保异株湖集团在暗涌之域里的行动顺畅。

messages.en: I've stalled Sinas for a day, getting me enough time to meet once again with Arikio at the Hyasyoda station in Wuos. She is confident that her plan to use Isha's family as leverage will guarantee his silence, and the security of Ishukone's operations inside Black Rise.
messages.zh: 我已经把塞纳斯拖了一天。期间我又去乌欧斯的三岛空间站见了阿里可一面。她相信她能利用伊沙的家人让其闭嘴，并确保异株湖集团在暗涌之域里的行动顺畅。

messages.en: Quietly slip away from your assignments in Astoh with Sinas, and report back to Arikio Kuretsu in Wuos about Hyasyoda's plan to permanently silence Isha.
messages.zh: 你要悄悄地从阿希多、从塞纳斯给你安排的任务中脱身，然后返回乌欧斯向阿里可·库利茨汇报，听取三岛针对伊沙的缄默计划。

messages.en: You seemed shaky on this from the start, but I don't have the luxury of figuring out what's going on with you, {[character]player.name}. I have to find a replacement before this window of opportunity passes us. I'm sorry.
messages.zh: 你好像一开始就给人感觉不稳，不过我可没功夫研究你到底是怎么回事，{[character]player.name}。我必须赶在机会还没丢失之前找到一个接替人。对不起了。

messages.en: In any other situation, a request for more time would be fine, {[character]player.name}. But there are hundreds, thousands of people waiting on us. What am I supposed to tell my friend in Ishukone, too? That things have to wait because the capsuleer we've been depending on needs to deal with something else? Your request comes at a bad time, friend.
messages.zh: 要不是面对目前这情况，你想怎么拖都没关系的，{[character]player.name}。但现在有成千上百的人等在那儿，你让我怎么向异株湖集团的朋友交代，嗯？难道让我说“我们一直依靠的那个飞行员现在要去办点别的事所以我们现在只能干等”？朋友啊，你这要求提得真不是时候。

messages.en: You seemed shaky on this from the start, but I don't have the luxury of figuring out what's going on with you, {[character]player.name}. I have to find a replacement before this window of opportunity passes us. I'm sorry.
messages.zh: 你好像一开始就给人感觉不稳，不过我可没功夫研究你到底是怎么回事，{[character]player.name}。我必须赶在机会还没丢失之前找到一个接替人。对不起了。

messages.en: Let me know as soon as you're available.
messages.zh: 你准备好后就立刻通知我。

messages.en: Once a rat, always a rat. The Syndicate talked to Ascain and offered her a deal. In a surprising move, she didn't take it right away. Instead, she gave me a choice: Give the kid back to his father, or return him to the Syndicate for more money than I can count. The kid's fate is in my hands now. I made my choice, and I will have to live with it.
messages.zh: 坏人永远就是坏人。辛迪加财团向艾丝坎提出了一笔交易。奇怪的是她没有立刻答应下来。她反而给我出了个难题：要么把那孩子送回他老爸那儿；要么把他带到辛迪加财团那里领取一笔我数都数不清的钱。那孩子的命运落在了我手里。我已做出决定，只有面对了。

messages.en: Once a rat, always a rat. The Syndicate talked to Ascain and offered her a deal. In a surprising move, she didn't take it right away. Instead, she gave me a choice: Give the kid back to his father, or return him to the Syndicate for more money than I can count. The kid's fate is in my hands now.
messages.zh: 坏人永远就是坏人。辛迪加财团向艾丝坎提出了一笔交易。奇怪的是她没有立刻答应下来。她反而给我出了个难题：要么把那孩子送回他老爸那儿；要么把他带到辛迪加财团那里领取一笔我数都数不清的钱。那孩子的命运落在了我手里。

messages.en:
You've come a long way, {[character]player.name}. You found the kid, defeated the bad guys, and saved the day. Right out of a holoreel, right? Well, here's where real life comes in, and it's a complicated mess. They don't show you this part in the ‘reels.

While you were out taking care of the Pator 6, I contacted my Syndicate contacts. They're pissed, but they are willing to forget everything and leave us alone. They can still keep their deal with Impetus, but they need the kid. Apparently, Ralie's the crux of the deal. I have no idea why, nor do I want to know.

Thus, you have two options. First, you can do the right thing and give Ralie back to the Feds. Be the hero, save the innocents, gratitude heaped upon you by the Federation, the works. I'm sure Mourmarie has something fun to reward you for your assistance.

Or you can give Ralie back to the Syndicate. They've given me a very generous offer. Very generous. You're essentially signing an innocent kid's life away, but the money will be good. That's all you eggers care about anyway, right?

All I can say is this: You can give the kid his freedom and be the hero. Or you can give him away, an innocent kid to ruthless and depraved criminals, for a lot of money. I won't judge you on either choice, but I have to ask: Where do you draw the line?
messages.zh:
你进步不小啊，{[character]player.name}。你找到孩子，打倒坏蛋，成了英雄。呵呵，可惜这只是电影里的情节。我现在跟你说真事。这事真是乱成一团麻，你在电影里绝对看不到这样的事情。

就在你之前对付帕特六人组的时候，我联系了一下我在辛迪加财团里的人。他们很恼火，不过他们还是愿意不多计较，放我们一马。他们虽然还能保住与促进工业的交易，但他们需要那孩子。很明显，拉莱就是这场交易的关键。至于为什么我也不知道，也不想知道。

鉴于此，你目前就有两个选择。你可以做件好事把拉莱交还给联邦。这样你就拯救了无辜的人，作了回英雄。联邦一定对你感激不尽。我确信摩尔马列会拿出很有趣的东西奖励给你以感谢你伸出援手。

或者，你把拉莱交给辛迪加财团。他们给出的奖金非常丰厚。超丰厚。虽然这样做就等于出卖一个无辜孩子的性命，但获得的收入绝对爽。你们克隆飞行员最看重钱了，对吧？

我再重复一下：你要么做个英雄，放了这孩子。要么你就把这无辜的孩子交给无情无义的罪犯，大赚一票。我不会在这事上评判你是非，我只想问：你如何划分泾渭？

messages.en:
Mourmarie and Senator Ardanne have given me a rendezvous location for you. It's somewhere in Enedore. When you return the kid, you'll get your reward. I'll contact the Syndicate and let them know that the deal is off. I wouldn't expect them to take that lightly, though, so watch your back.

Either way, glad you got the kid back. Been nice working with you. Good luck in the future, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh:
摩尔马列与参议员阿丹已经给了我一个你们要碰头的地点。那地方在厄勒多尔。你把孩子交还之后就会获得奖赏。我会联系辛迪加财团，告诉他们这事已经黄了。不过我觉得他们不会让此事轻描淡写过去的，所以你要当心点。

不管怎样，我还是很高兴你救了这孩子。与你合作很愉快。祝你将来一路顺风，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
The Syndicate wants to meet you at a specific location. You'll drop the kid off, take the money – which I'll get a cut of, of course – and leave quietly in the night. They have a special gift for you in addition to the money. Some sort of Syndicate-issue something or other. I dunno.

Take the kid to the warehouse and drop him off. We'll get paid and leave this whole mess behind us. It'll be a happy ending for us, to be sure.
messages.zh:
辛迪加财团要在一个特定地点见你。你去把孩子送到那儿，然后拿钱——当然我会分得一部分——最后于晚上悄悄离开。他们除了钱之外还给你准备了一样特别礼物，我也不清楚究竟是什么，也许是辛迪加财团型号的什么东西吧。

快去把孩子送往仓库。我们拿到钱之后就再也不用管这事了。我保证这会是件让我们皆大欢喜的事。

messages.en:
Welcome, {[character]player.name}. Let's see if we can make an explorer out of you.
Once you've undocked into space, open your Probe Scanner and select the Warp To button for a location named "Anomaly Training Site". This is a Cosmic Anomaly, which means it'll be easy to find.
Warp to it and I'll give you further instructions once you've made it there. Don't worry about combat this time around - we've cleared out the area for you.
messages.zh:
欢迎，{[character]player.name}。让我们看看你能不能成为个探险家。

离站后，打开探针扫描器，点击某个名为“异常空间训练场”的地点的“跃迁至”按钮。这是个很容易找到的空间异常信号。

然后跃迁到那里去，我会给你下一步的指示。这次你不用担心会有战斗——我们已经把那个地方清理干净了。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. Finding anomalies will seem easy to you after a while, but those first few steps into exploration can sometimes be overwhelming all the same. Just keep it up and I'm sure you'll do fine.

Next up I want to run you through a training area that will teach you about another type of exploration site. When you're ready for that, let me know.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。用不了多久，你就能很熟练地寻找异常空间了。但作为进入空间勘探和探险领域迈出的前几步，这可能会非常的让人烦恼。但只要你坚持，我想你一定能成功。

接下来，我想把你带到一个训练区域来教授你其他的探索地点类型。等你准备好就告诉我。

messages.en: Cosmic Anomalies are commonly well-guarded. Those who hide away their in-space facilities usually have a good reason for doing so, and don't take kindly to trespassers, capsuleers or not.
messages.zh: 异常空间通常都是有重兵把守的。那些想要把自己的空间设施隐藏起来的人，通常都有一个不愿意为世人所知的目的，因此他们一定不会喜欢不速之客。

messages.en: Cosmic Anomalies
messages.zh: 异常空间

messages.en: Ah, leaving already, {[character]player.name}? Well, if you ever want to come back and try to pass the tutorial again, I'll be happy to take you back.
messages.zh: 啊，{[character]player.name}，这就要走了？如果你要是想回来继续完成训练课程的话，我会很高兴再次教授你的。

messages.en: Greetings, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]player.name}。

name.de: Eine Einführung zum Thema Kosmische Signaturen (2 von 5)
name.en: An Introduction to Cosmic Signatures (2 of 5)
name.es: Introducción a las señales cósmicas (2 de 5)
name.ja: 宇宙のシグネチャへの案内（2/5）

messages.en:
Your Probe Scanner easily tracks Cosmic Anomalies. Other types of sites, collectively called Cosmic Signatures, will be much harder to find, and you'll usually need to boost your scanner by using scan probes.

These Cosmic Signature sites contain various kinds of treasures: ancient ruins to sift amongst, secret data facilities to hack into, exotic gases to collect - there is a great deal out there for an explorer to uncover, and you need to understand how to react to each type of site.

Therefore, before we send you off to do complicated scans and potentially risk your ship in the ensuing discovery process, I'm sending you to a training facility where you'll encounter safe examples of what you might find out there. Use the ship I'm giving you, follow the instructions you're given on-site, and report to me after you're done.
messages.zh:
你的探针扫描器可以很容易地追踪到异常空间。而另一种叫做空间信号的地点就难找得多了，你往往需要使用扫描探针来增强你的扫描能力。

在这些空间信号地点中，你能找到多种的宝藏：可供挖掘的历史古迹、能被破解的秘密数据设施以及可供采集的奇特气云——总之能挖掘的资源非常丰富，你需要了解如何应对这些类型的地点。

所以，在我们派你去以身涉险进行复杂的扫描任务之前，我先让你去一处训练设施，在那里你可以进行一些模拟训练，而不会有什么危险。你要使用我给你的船，执行我在训练场下达的指令，完成后回来见我。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. Hopefully after all that, you've developed a basic understanding of the different types of Cosmic Signatures you can find out there. Next up, we'll look again more closely at each signature type. Let me know when you're ready for that.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。但愿从此之后你就对不同种类的空间信号都有了基本了解。接下来我们将仔细讲述每一种信号。你做好准备后就告诉我。

messages.en: There are three known types of Cosmic Signature: Data, Relic and Gas. Each unique signature type offers something different. You're about to travel to a training area that will introduce you to each type.
messages.zh: 空间信号有三种：数据、遗迹及气云。每种信号地点都藏有不同的东西。你接下来就将前往一个会向你介绍这三种信号的训练场。

messages.en: Cosmic Signatures
messages.zh: 空间信号

name.ja: 鉱石サイトのスキャン

messages.en:
So far you've proven you can discover a Cosmic Anomaly with the On-Board Scanner and that you understand in basic terms the difference between Cosmic Signatures. Now we're going to retread the steps you just took in more detail and have you properly scan down one of each signature type. This will demonstrate to us that you not only have an understanding of the different signatures, but also the skill to find each of them. Remember – you can only find Cosmic Signatures by using Core Scanner Probes.

Your first task is to discover an Ore signature somewhere inside this system. You will only find the target site in here, so don't waste your time searching anywhere else. This is not a real asteroid cluster you are looking for, {[character]player.name}, it is another controlled training environment, so there will be no hostile vessels inside and the asteroids themselves cannot be mined for profit. It is hidden though, just like a real one would be, and will need to be scanned down. This won't be easy, {[character]player.name}. Expect a much harder challenge than On-Board scanning. I'm confident you'll get the hang of it eventually though, just be patient and I'm confident you'll find the site. Once you have managed that, your only task is to recover another “Proof of Discovery” document from inside. It will serve as physical evidence that you discovered the area.

Take this passkey with you when you begin your exploration, you will need it to access the second room of the area with the “Proof of Discovery” documents inside. Obviously, we only want capsuleers-in-training to be able to get that far.
messages.zh:
至今你已经学会了使用舰载扫描器捕获异常空间信号，同时你也明白了它和空间信号的基本区别。现在我们将会重温这个过程，并详细地指导你扫描这两种不同的信号类型。这样，你不仅可以证明你知道这两种信号之间的区别，而且还表明你已经掌握了寻找和捕获它们的技巧。记住——只有使用核心扫描探针才能够帮助你找到空间信号。

你的第一个任务是要在这个星系里找到一个采矿信号。你只能在这里找到这个目标地点，所以不要在别处去浪费你的时间。你要寻找的并不是一个真正的小行星群，{[character]player.name}，而是一个受控的训练用环境，所以在那里你不会遭遇任何敌对舰船而且那里的小行星也不能被开采来卖钱。但同真实情况一样，这个地点是隐藏的，你需要用扫描技术才能够找到它们。这事不简单，{[character]player.name}。这件事会比舰载扫描设备的使用来的更加有挑战性。我对你能够掌握这种技术的能力非常有信心，只需要耐心的学习你一定会找到那个地点。一旦你成功寻获目标，你的任务就是要从中拿到另外一份“目标证据”。那将是你成功寻获目标地点的事物证明。

你开始探险的时候带上这个通行证，你需要用它进入目标区域的第二层空间，在那里你可以找到“目标证据”。你要明白，我们只想那些在接受训练的克隆飞行员进入那个区域。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. The discovery of untapped asteroid clusters can quickly lead a capsuleer to riches. I hope the knowledge to find ore sites serves you well.

When you're ready, I'll have another type of site for you to find.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。发现尚无人开采利用的小行星带可以让你迅速致富。但愿采矿地点的扫描方法能对你的未来有所裨益。

你准备好后，我会给你介绍你能找到的另一类地点。

messages.en: Ah, leaving already, {[character]player.name}? Well, if you ever want to come back and try to pass the tutorial again, I'll be happy to take you back.
messages.zh: 啊，{[character]player.name}，这就要走了？如果你要是想回来继续完成训练课程的话，我会很高兴再次教授你的。

messages.en:
- The lower the security status of a system, the better the ore you can find in such sites.
- Ore sites often have better ore than asteroid belts.
- In real, non-training Ore sites, you can expect pirates. They might not always show themselves immediately too, so be careful. Sometimes they will wait until you start mining.
- If the asteroids inside a site are mined out, the area will obviously no longer be detectable to scanners. No asteroids, no signature.
- Asteroid clusters shift over time. They will never remain in any one position for very long. Most miners agree that the time period is approximately three days. After that, signatures tend to vanish as debris and other slowly drifting matter obscures them and prevents a clear scan.
messages.zh:
—— 星系的安全等级越低，在目标地点中所能够找到的矿产就越好。
采矿地点所蕴藏的矿物通常要比小行星带要好。
实际情况下，非训练用采矿地点通常会有一定数量的海盗存在。你要小心，他们不一定会立即出现。有时候会等你开始进行开采后才会出现。
如果一个地点中的小行星被完全开采，这个地点将无法再被扫描器捕捉到。没有小行星就不会有信号。
——小行星群位移。小行星群不会长时间地停留在同一位置。大多数矿业人员都认为这个时间带大约是三天左右。之后，信号就会消失，碎片以及其他的一些漂浮物使得扫描无法精确完成。

messages.en: Hints and tips for Ore Sites
messages.zh: 采矿地点探测技巧和提示

messages.en:
So far you've proven you can discover a Cosmic Anomaly with the On-Board Scanner and that you understand in basic terms the difference between Cosmic Signatures. Now we're going to retread the steps you just took in more detail and have you properly scan down one of each signature type. This will demonstrate to us that you not only have an understanding of the different signatures, but also the skill to find each of them. Remember – you can only find Cosmic Signatures by using Core Scanner Probes.

Your first task is to discover an Ore signature somewhere inside this system. You will only find the target site in here, so don't waste your time searching anywhere else. This is not a real asteroid cluster you are looking for, {[character]player.name}, it is another controlled training environment, so there will be no hostile vessels inside and the asteroids themselves cannot be mined for profit. It is hidden though, just like a real one would be, and will need to be scanned down. This won't be easy, {[character]player.name}. Expect a much harder challenge than On-Board scanning. I'm confident you'll get the hang of it eventually though, just be patient and I'm confident you'll find the site. Once you have managed that, your only task is to recover another “Proof of Discovery” document from inside. It will serve as physical evidence that you discovered the area.

Take this passkey with you when you begin your exploration, you will need it to access the second room of the area with the “Proof of Discovery” documents inside. Obviously, we only want capsuleers-in-training to be able to get that far.

messages.zh: 啊，{[character]player.name}，这就要走了？如果你要是想回来继续完成训练课程的话，我会很高兴再次教授你的。

messages.en: Welcome back, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 欢迎你回来，{[character]player.name}。

name.es: Escaneo de zona de reliquias (4 de 5)
name.fr: Balayage d'un site de reliques (4 sur 5)

messages.en:
Next you need to use your Core Scanner Probes to find a Relic site. You'll need a Relic Analyzer to hack open what you'll find there and bring it back to me.

In general, Relic site loot is very useful for producing ship rigs - special enhancements permanently fitted to individual ships. Again, keep in mind that while this training site is perfectly safe, failed hacking attempts in other sites may cost you the container and lead to ship damage.
messages.zh:
下一步是用你的核心扫描探针找到一个遗迹地点。你需要一个遗迹分析仪来进行破译，然后把找到的东西带回来给我。

- 首先，装配舰船里的核心探针发射器和民用遗迹分析仪，并把舰船货舱里的核心扫描探针装填到核心探针发射器上。

- 离开空间站后，打开主界面中下方控制面板的“扫描器”，启动探针扫描器 。

- 找到发射按钮，发射探针 。

- 找到分析按钮，分析空间信号。
（你可以通过右侧面板调整探针位置来增强分析强度，直至100%分析出一个信号，按住SHIFT键可以分别调整每个探针位置） - 跃迁至一个遗迹训练地点 。

- 使用民用遗迹分析仪打开货柜，找到目标物品后，即可回来完成任务。

基本上，遗迹地点中找到的物品对舰船改装件的生产至关重要——这是一种永久装配在舰船上的强化装备。再提一次，虽然训练场很安全，但破译失败会导致货柜爆炸，伤害你的舰船。

name.es: Escaneo de zona de datos (3 de 5)
name.fr: Balayage d'un site de données (3 sur 5)
name.ja: データサイトスキャン（3/5）

messages.en:
Next, you will need to scan down each type of Cosmic Signature. To do this you will need your Probe Scanner loaded with Core Scanner Probes.

First up is a Data site, which means you will need your Civilian Data Analyzer fitted. Scan down the site with your Scanner Probes, hack into the container located there with your Data Analyzer, then bring its contents back to me.

Please note; while this training mission is perfectly safe, failed hacking attempts in other sites may cause the container to self-destruct and possibly damage your ship.

To learn more about how to use your Probe Scanner, visit the Help Section in the Agency, select Explorer and watch the Scanning Basics video.
messages.zh:
接下来，你要扫描各种宇宙信号。为此，你会用到装载了核心扫描探针的探针扫描器。

首先扫描的是数据站点，这需要安装民用数据分析仪。使用扫描探针扫描此站点，并使用数据分析仪破译货柜，然后把里面的东西拿回来给我。

请注意：虽然这次训练任务的安全性很高，但若是在其他站点破译失败，很可能导致货柜自爆并损坏舰船。

如需了解探针扫描器的使用方法，请访问星际代理处中的帮助部分，选择探险家并观看扫描基础知识视频。

name.es: Escaneo de zona de gas (5 de 5)
name.fr: Balayage d'un site de collecte de gaz (5 sur 5)

messages.en:
Your last assignment is to scan down a Gas cloud. We've created an artificial cloud pocket for you, and while you'd usually reap it with a Gas Cloud Harvester, our only concern is that you make it through to the second area and bring back the Proof of Discovery document.

The materials found inside these clouds are used to make biochemical enhancers known as boosters. It is a dangerous industry, populated by dangerous people. You're safe this time, but Gas clouds will occasionally be inhabited by pirates. Stay alert if you're on the prowl for them.

As soon as you accept the mission, we'll provide you with the passkey into the second area.
messages.zh:
你的最后一个任务是扫描一个气云信号。我们为你准备了一个人工气云层，通常来讲你需要装配气云采集器，不过这次我们只关注你能不能穿过那里到达第二层空间然后把目标证据: 气云文档带回来。

- 首先，把物品机库里的气云通行密钥放入舰船货舱，并把舰船货舱里的核心扫描探针装填到核心探针发射器上 。

- 离开空间站后，打开主界面中下方控制面板的“扫描器”，启动探针扫描器 。

- 找到发射按钮，发射探针 。

- 找到分析按钮，分析空间信号。
（你可以通过右侧面板调整探针位置来增强分析强度，直至100%分析出一个信号，按住SHIFT键可以分别调整每个探针位置）

- 跃迁至一个气云训练地点，并激活加速轨道 。

- 打开训练用的货柜，找到目标物品后，即可回来完成任务。

在这些气云中采集到的材料可以用于生产一种被称作增效剂的生物强化剂。这是一项危险的工业，只有危险的人才会从事。这次你不会遇到危险，但通常气云里面都有海盗活动。所以当你在气云中穿梭的时候，睁大眼睛。

在你接受任务之后，我就会把进入第二层空间所需要的通行证交给你。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.

With the lessons learned here, New Eden is yours to explore. There are anomalies and signatures across the cluster just waiting to be discovered, just check out the Exploration section in the Agency to see what's out there.

Alternatively, if you want to try out other career paths before you venture forth you can start a conversation with any of the other Career Agents in this station.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，干得漂亮。

吸取这次教训后，你就能尽情探索新伊甸了。宇宙中还有异常空间和信号在等待我们去发现，请查看星际代理处中的探索部分的内容。

或者说，如果你想在冒险之前试试其他职业道路，可与站内的其他职业代理人聊一聊。

messages.en:
Welcome, {[character]player.name}. Let's see if we can make an explorer out of you.
Once you've undocked into space, open your Probe Scanner and select the Warp To button for a location named "Anomaly Training Site". This is a Cosmic Anomaly, which means it'll be easy to find.
Warp to it and I'll give you further instructions once you've made it there. Don't worry about combat this time around - we've cleared out the area for you.
messages.zh:
欢迎，{[character]player.name}。让我们看看你能不能成为个探险家。

离站后，打开探针扫描器，点击某个名为“异常空间训练场”的地点的“跃迁至”按钮。这是个很容易找到的空间异常信号。

然后跃迁到那里去，我会给你下一步的指示。这次你不用担心会有战斗——我们已经把那个地方清理干净了。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. Finding anomalies will seem easy to you after a while, but those first few steps into exploration can sometimes be overwhelming all the same. Just keep it up and I'm sure you'll do fine.

Next up I want to run you through a training area that will teach you about another type of exploration site. When you're ready for that, let me know.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。用不了多久，你就能很熟练地寻找异常空间了。但作为进入空间勘探和探险领域迈出的前几步，这可能会非常的让人烦恼。但只要你坚持，我想你一定能成功。

接下来，我想把你带到一个训练区域来教授你其他的探索地点类型。等你准备好就告诉我。

messages.en: Cosmic Anomalies are commonly well-guarded. Those who hide away their in-space facilities usually have a good reason for doing so, and don't take kindly to trespassers, capsuleers or not.
messages.zh: 异常空间通常都是有重兵把守的。那些想要把自己的空间设施隐藏起来的人，通常都有一个不愿意为世人所知的目的，因此他们一定不会喜欢不速之客。

messages.en: Cosmic Anomalies
messages.zh: 异常空间

messages.en: Ah, leaving already, {[character]player.name}? Well, if you ever want to come back and try to pass the tutorial again, I'll be happy to take you back.
messages.zh: 啊，{[character]player.name}，这就要走了？如果你要是想回来继续完成训练课程的话，我会很高兴再次教授你的。

messages.en: Greetings, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]player.name}。

name.de: Eine Einführung zum Thema Kosmische Signaturen (2 von 5)
name.en: An Introduction to Cosmic Signatures (2 of 5)
name.es: Introducción a las señales cósmicas (2 de 5)
name.ja: 宇宙のシグネチャへの案内（2/5）

messages.en:
Your Probe Scanner easily tracks Cosmic Anomalies. Other types of sites, collectively called Cosmic Signatures, will be much harder to find, and you'll usually need to boost your scanner by using scan probes.

These Cosmic Signature sites contain various kinds of treasures: ancient ruins to sift amongst, secret data facilities to hack into, exotic gases to collect - there is a great deal out there for an explorer to uncover, and you need to understand how to react to each type of site.

Therefore, before we send you off to do complicated scans and potentially risk your ship in the ensuing discovery process, I'm sending you to a training facility where you'll encounter safe examples of what you might find out there. Use the ship I'm giving you, follow the instructions you're given on-site, and report to me after you're done.
messages.zh:
你的探针扫描器可以很容易地追踪到异常空间。而另一种叫做空间信号的地点就难找得多了，你往往需要使用扫描探针来增强你的扫描能力。

在这些空间信号地点中，你能找到多种的宝藏：可供挖掘的历史古迹、能被破解的秘密数据设施以及可供采集的奇特气云——总之能挖掘的资源非常丰富，你需要了解如何应对这些类型的地点。

所以，在我们派你去以身涉险进行复杂的扫描任务之前，我先让你去一处训练设施，在那里你可以进行一些模拟训练，而不会有什么危险。你要使用我给你的船，执行我在训练场下达的指令，完成后回来见我。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. Hopefully after all that, you've developed a basic understanding of the different types of Cosmic Signatures you can find out there. Next up, we'll look again more closely at each signature type. Let me know when you're ready for that.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。但愿从此之后你就对不同种类的空间信号都有了基本了解。接下来我们将仔细讲述每一种信号。你做好准备后就告诉我。

messages.en: There are three known types of Cosmic Signature: Data, Relic and Gas. Each unique signature type offers something different. You're about to travel to a training area that will introduce you to each type.
messages.zh: 空间信号有三种：数据、遗迹及气云。每种信号地点都藏有不同的东西。你接下来就将前往一个会向你介绍这三种信号的训练场。

messages.en: Cosmic Signatures
messages.zh: 空间信号

name.de: Eine Einführung zum Thema Kosmische Signaturen (2 von 5)
name.en: An Introduction to Cosmic Signatures (2 of 5)
name.es: Introducción a las señales cósmicas (2 de 5)
name.ja: 宇宙のシグネチャへの案内（2/5）

messages.en:
Your Probe Scanner easily tracks Cosmic Anomalies. Other types of sites, collectively called Cosmic Signatures, will be much harder to find, and you'll usually need to boost your scanner by using scan probes.

These Cosmic Signature sites contain various kinds of treasures: ancient ruins to sift amongst, secret data facilities to hack into, exotic gases to collect - there is a great deal out there for an explorer to uncover, and you need to understand how to react to each type of site.

Therefore, before we send you off to do complicated scans and potentially risk your ship in the ensuing discovery process, I'm sending you to a training facility where you'll encounter safe examples of what you might find out there. Use the ship I'm giving you, follow the instructions you're given on-site, and report to me after you're done.

messages.en: Cosmic Signatures
messages.zh: 空间信号

name.ja: 鉱石サイトのスキャン

messages.en:
So far you've proven you can discover a Cosmic Anomaly with the On-Board Scanner and that you understand in basic terms the difference between Cosmic Signatures. Now we're going to retread the steps you just took in more detail and have you properly scan down one of each signature type. This will demonstrate to us that you not only have an understanding of the different signatures, but also the skill to find each of them. Remember – you can only find Cosmic Signatures by using Core Scanner Probes.

Your first task is to discover an Ore signature somewhere inside this system. You will only find the target site in here, so don't waste your time searching anywhere else. This is not a real asteroid cluster you are looking for, {[character]player.name}, it is another controlled training environment, so there will be no hostile vessels inside and the asteroids themselves cannot be mined for profit. It is hidden though, just like a real one would be, and will need to be scanned down. This won't be easy, {[character]player.name}. Expect a much harder challenge than On-Board scanning. I'm confident you'll get the hang of it eventually though, just be patient and I'm confident you'll find the site. Once you have managed that, your only task is to recover another “Proof of Discovery” document from inside. It will serve as physical evidence that you discovered the area.

Take this passkey with you when you begin your exploration, you will need it to access the second room of the area with the “Proof of Discovery” documents inside. Obviously, we only want capsuleers-in-training to be able to get that far.
messages.zh:
至今你已经学会了使用舰载扫描器捕获异常空间信号，同时你也明白了它和空间信号的基本区别。现在我们将会重温这个过程，并详细地指导你扫描这两种不同的信号类型。这样，你不仅可以证明你知道这两种信号之间的区别，而且还表明你已经掌握了寻找和捕获它们的技巧。记住——只有使用核心扫描探针才能够帮助你找到空间信号。

你的第一个任务是要在这个星系里找到一个采矿信号。你只能在这里找到这个目标地点，所以不要在别处去浪费你的时间。你要寻找的并不是一个真正的小行星群，{[character]player.name}，而是一个受控的训练用环境，所以在那里你不会遭遇任何敌对舰船而且那里的小行星也不能被开采来卖钱。但同真实情况一样，这个地点是隐藏的，你需要用扫描技术才能够找到它们。这事不简单，{[character]player.name}。这件事会比舰载扫描设备的使用来的更加有挑战性。我对你能够掌握这种技术的能力非常有信心，只需要耐心的学习你一定会找到那个地点。一旦你成功寻获目标，你的任务就是要从中拿到另外一份“目标证据”。那将是你成功寻获目标地点的事物证明。

你开始探险的时候带上这个通行证，你需要用它进入目标区域的第二层空间，在那里你可以找到“目标证据”。你要明白，我们只想那些在接受训练的克隆飞行员进入那个区域。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. The discovery of untapped asteroid clusters can quickly lead a capsuleer to riches. I hope the knowledge to find ore sites serves you well.

When you're ready, I'll have another type of site for you to find.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。发现尚无人开采利用的小行星带可以让你迅速致富。但愿采矿地点的扫描方法能对你的未来有所裨益。

你准备好后，我会给你介绍你能找到的另一类地点。

messages.en: Ah, leaving already, {[character]player.name}? Well, if you ever want to come back and try to pass the tutorial again, I'll be happy to take you back.
messages.zh: 啊，{[character]player.name}，这就要走了？如果你要是想回来继续完成训练课程的话，我会很高兴再次教授你的。

messages.en:
- The lower the security status of a system, the better the ore you can find in such sites.
- Ore sites often have better ore than asteroid belts.
- In real, non-training Ore sites, you can expect pirates. They might not always show themselves immediately too, so be careful. Sometimes they will wait until you start mining.
- If the asteroids inside a site are mined out, the area will obviously no longer be detectable to scanners. No asteroids, no signature.
- Asteroid clusters shift over time. They will never remain in any one position for very long. Most miners agree that the time period is approximately three days. After that, signatures tend to vanish as debris and other slowly drifting matter obscures them and prevents a clear scan.
messages.zh:
—— 星系的安全等级越低，在目标地点中所能够找到的矿产就越好。
采矿地点所蕴藏的矿物通常要比小行星带要好。
实际情况下，非训练用采矿地点通常会有一定数量的海盗存在。你要小心，他们不一定会立即出现。有时候会等你开始进行开采后才会出现。
如果一个地点中的小行星被完全开采，这个地点将无法再被扫描器捕捉到。没有小行星就不会有信号。
——小行星群位移。小行星群不会长时间地停留在同一位置。大多数矿业人员都认为这个时间带大约是三天左右。之后，信号就会消失，碎片以及其他的一些漂浮物使得扫描无法精确完成。

messages.en: Hints and tips for Ore Sites
messages.zh: 采矿地点探测技巧和提示
