你的第一个任务是要在这个星系里找到一个采矿信号。你只能在这里找到这个目标地点，所以不要在别处去浪费你的时间。你要寻找的并不是一个真正的小行星群，{[character]player.name}，而是一个受控的训练用环境，所以在那里你不会遭遇任何敌对舰船而且那里的小行星也不能被开采来卖钱。但同真实情况一样，这个地点是隐藏的，你需要用扫描技术才能够找到它们。这事不简单，{[character]player.name}。这件事会比舰载扫描设备的使用来的更加有挑战性。我对你能够掌握这种技术的能力非常有信心，只需要耐心的学习你一定会找到那个地点。一旦你成功寻获目标，你的任务就是要从中拿到另外一份“目标证据”。那将是你成功寻获目标地点的事物证明。

你开始探险的时候带上这个通行证，你需要用它进入目标区域的第二层空间，在那里你可以找到“目标证据”。你要明白，我们只想那些在接受训练的克隆飞行员进入那个区域。

messages.en: Ah, leaving already, {[character]player.name}? Well, if you ever want to come back and try to pass the tutorial again, I'll be happy to take you back.
messages.zh: 啊，{[character]player.name}，这就要走了？如果你要是想回来继续完成训练课程的话，我会很高兴再次教授你的。

messages.en: Welcome back, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 欢迎你回来，{[character]player.name}。

name.ja: 鉱石サイトのスキャン

messages.en:
So far you've proven you can discover a Cosmic Anomaly with the On-Board Scanner and that you understand in basic terms the difference between Cosmic Signatures. Now we're going to retread the steps you just took in more detail and have you properly scan down one of each signature type. This will demonstrate to us that you not only have an understanding of the different signatures, but also the skill to find each of them. Remember – you can only find Cosmic Signatures by using Core Scanner Probes.

Your first task is to discover an Ore signature somewhere inside this system. You will only find the target site in here, so don't waste your time searching anywhere else. This is not a real asteroid cluster you are looking for, {[character]player.name}, it is another controlled training environment, so there will be no hostile vessels inside and the asteroids themselves cannot be mined for profit. It is hidden though, just like a real one would be, and will need to be scanned down. This won't be easy, {[character]player.name}. Expect a much harder challenge than On-Board scanning. I'm confident you'll get the hang of it eventually though, just be patient and I'm confident you'll find the site. Once you have managed that, your only task is to recover another “Proof of Discovery” document from inside. It will serve as physical evidence that you discovered the area.

Take this passkey with you when you begin your exploration, you will need it to access the second room of the area with the “Proof of Discovery” documents inside. Obviously, we only want capsuleers-in-training to be able to get that far.

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. The discovery of untapped asteroid clusters can quickly lead a capsuleer to riches. I hope the knowledge to find ore sites serves you well.

When you're ready, I'll have another type of site for you to find.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。发现尚无人开采利用的小行星带可以让你迅速致富。但愿采矿地点的扫描方法能对你的未来有所裨益。

你准备好后，我会给你介绍你能找到的另一类地点。

messages.en: Ah, leaving already, {[character]player.name}? Well, if you ever want to come back and try to pass the tutorial again, I'll be happy to take you back.
messages.zh: 啊，{[character]player.name}，这就要走了？如果你要是想回来继续完成训练课程的话，我会很高兴再次教授你的。

messages.en:
- The lower the security status of a system, the better the ore you can find in such sites.
- Ore sites often have better ore than asteroid belts.
- In real, non-training Ore sites, you can expect pirates. They might not always show themselves immediately too, so be careful. Sometimes they will wait until you start mining.
- If the asteroids inside a site are mined out, the area will obviously no longer be detectable to scanners. No asteroids, no signature.
- Asteroid clusters shift over time. They will never remain in any one position for very long. Most miners agree that the time period is approximately three days. After that, signatures tend to vanish as debris and other slowly drifting matter obscures them and prevents a clear scan.
messages.zh:
—— 星系的安全等级越低，在目标地点中所能够找到的矿产就越好。
采矿地点所蕴藏的矿物通常要比小行星带要好。
实际情况下，非训练用采矿地点通常会有一定数量的海盗存在。你要小心，他们不一定会立即出现。有时候会等你开始进行开采后才会出现。
如果一个地点中的小行星被完全开采，这个地点将无法再被扫描器捕捉到。没有小行星就不会有信号。
——小行星群位移。小行星群不会长时间地停留在同一位置。大多数矿业人员都认为这个时间带大约是三天左右。之后，信号就会消失，碎片以及其他的一些漂浮物使得扫描无法精确完成。

messages.en: Hints and tips for Ore Sites
messages.zh: 采矿地点探测技巧和提示

name.es: Escaneo de zona de reliquias (4 de 5)
name.fr: Balayage d'un site de reliques (4 sur 5)

messages.en:
Next you need to use your Core Scanner Probes to find a Relic site. You'll need a Relic Analyzer to hack open what you'll find there and bring it back to me.

In general, Relic site loot is very useful for producing ship rigs - special enhancements permanently fitted to individual ships. Again, keep in mind that while this training site is perfectly safe, failed hacking attempts in other sites may cost you the container and lead to ship damage.
messages.zh:
下一步是用你的核心扫描探针找到一个遗迹地点。你需要一个遗迹分析仪来进行破译，然后把找到的东西带回来给我。

- 首先，装配舰船里的核心探针发射器和民用遗迹分析仪，并把舰船货舱里的核心扫描探针装填到核心探针发射器上。

- 离开空间站后，打开主界面中下方控制面板的“扫描器”，启动探针扫描器 。

- 找到发射按钮，发射探针 。

- 找到分析按钮，分析空间信号。
（你可以通过右侧面板调整探针位置来增强分析强度，直至100%分析出一个信号，按住SHIFT键可以分别调整每个探针位置） - 跃迁至一个遗迹训练地点 。

- 使用民用遗迹分析仪打开货柜，找到目标物品后，即可回来完成任务。

基本上，遗迹地点中找到的物品对舰船改装件的生产至关重要——这是一种永久装配在舰船上的强化装备。再提一次，虽然训练场很安全，但破译失败会导致货柜爆炸，伤害你的舰船。

name.es: Escaneo de zona de datos (3 de 5)
name.fr: Balayage d'un site de données (3 sur 5)
name.ja: データサイトスキャン（3/5）

messages.en:
Next, you will need to scan down each type of Cosmic Signature. To do this you will need your Probe Scanner loaded with Core Scanner Probes.

First up is a Data site, which means you will need your Civilian Data Analyzer fitted. Scan down the site with your Scanner Probes, hack into the container located there with your Data Analyzer, then bring its contents back to me.

Please note; while this training mission is perfectly safe, failed hacking attempts in other sites may cause the container to self-destruct and possibly damage your ship.

To learn more about how to use your Probe Scanner, visit the Help Section in the Agency, select Explorer and watch the Scanning Basics video.
messages.zh:
接下来，你要扫描各种宇宙信号。为此，你会用到装载了核心扫描探针的探针扫描器。

首先扫描的是数据站点，这需要安装民用数据分析仪。使用扫描探针扫描此站点，并使用数据分析仪破译货柜，然后把里面的东西拿回来给我。

请注意：虽然这次训练任务的安全性很高，但若是在其他站点破译失败，很可能导致货柜自爆并损坏舰船。

如需了解探针扫描器的使用方法，请访问星际代理处中的帮助部分，选择探险家并观看扫描基础知识视频。

name.es: Escaneo de zona de gas (5 de 5)
name.fr: Balayage d'un site de collecte de gaz (5 sur 5)

messages.en:
Your last assignment is to scan down a Gas cloud. We've created an artificial cloud pocket for you, and while you'd usually reap it with a Gas Cloud Harvester, our only concern is that you make it through to the second area and bring back the Proof of Discovery document.

The materials found inside these clouds are used to make biochemical enhancers known as boosters. It is a dangerous industry, populated by dangerous people. You're safe this time, but Gas clouds will occasionally be inhabited by pirates. Stay alert if you're on the prowl for them.

As soon as you accept the mission, we'll provide you with the passkey into the second area.
messages.zh:
你的最后一个任务是扫描一个气云信号。我们为你准备了一个人工气云层，通常来讲你需要装配气云采集器，不过这次我们只关注你能不能穿过那里到达第二层空间然后把目标证据: 气云文档带回来。

- 首先，把物品机库里的气云通行密钥放入舰船货舱，并把舰船货舱里的核心扫描探针装填到核心探针发射器上 。

- 离开空间站后，打开主界面中下方控制面板的“扫描器”，启动探针扫描器 。

- 找到发射按钮，发射探针 。

- 找到分析按钮，分析空间信号。
（你可以通过右侧面板调整探针位置来增强分析强度，直至100%分析出一个信号，按住SHIFT键可以分别调整每个探针位置）

- 跃迁至一个气云训练地点，并激活加速轨道 。

- 打开训练用的货柜，找到目标物品后，即可回来完成任务。

在这些气云中采集到的材料可以用于生产一种被称作增效剂的生物强化剂。这是一项危险的工业，只有危险的人才会从事。这次你不会遇到危险，但通常气云里面都有海盗活动。所以当你在气云中穿梭的时候，睁大眼睛。

在你接受任务之后，我就会把进入第二层空间所需要的通行证交给你。

messages.en:

messages.en:
Your last assignment is to scan down a Gas cloud. We've created an artificial cloud pocket for you, and while you'd usually reap it with a Gas Cloud Harvester, our only concern is that you make it through to the second area and bring back the Proof of Discovery document.

The materials found inside these clouds are used to make biochemical enhancers known as boosters. It is a dangerous industry, populated by dangerous people. You're safe this time, but Gas clouds will occasionally be inhabited by pirates. Stay alert if you're on the prowl for them.

As soon as you accept the mission, we'll provide you with the passkey into the second area.
messages.zh:
你的最后一个任务是扫描一个气云信号。我们为你准备了一个人工气云层，通常来讲你需要装配气云采集器，不过这次我们只关注你能不能穿过那里到达第二层空间然后把目标证据: 气云文档带回来。

- 首先，把物品机库里的气云通行密钥放入舰船货舱，并把舰船货舱里的核心扫描探针装填到核心探针发射器上 。

- 离开空间站后，打开主界面中下方控制面板的“扫描器”，启动探针扫描器 。

- 找到发射按钮，发射探针 。

- 找到分析按钮，分析空间信号。
（你可以通过右侧面板调整探针位置来增强分析强度，直至100%分析出一个信号，按住SHIFT键可以分别调整每个探针位置）

- 跃迁至一个气云训练地点，并激活加速轨道 。

- 打开训练用的货柜，找到目标物品后，即可回来完成任务。

在这些气云中采集到的材料可以用于生产一种被称作增效剂的生物强化剂。这是一项危险的工业，只有危险的人才会从事。这次你不会遇到危险，但通常气云里面都有海盗活动。所以当你在气云中穿梭的时候，睁大眼睛。

在你接受任务之后，我就会把进入第二层空间所需要的通行证交给你。

name.ru: Враг моего врага (Enemy of my Enemy)

messages.en: Arment Caute, a Gallente Federation Navy official offered me a unique job: fly for the Guristas in order to sabotage the Caldari Navy's efforts in the outer regions. He told me that it would be dangerous business, and that the Federation would not acknowledge my efforts. But he also mentioned that there would be a big payout for my efforts. I decided to travel to Venal and fly for the Guristas. Caute advised me to fly in an interceptor and to be wary of bubble camps and the lawless rabble in nullsec.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦海军的一位名叫阿门·考特的官员给我交待了一份独特的工作：与古斯塔斯合作在偏远地区对加达里海军暗中使坏。他告诉这是项危险的任务，而且联邦也不会公开承认这件事。不过他也提到我会因此获得一笔丰厚报酬。我决定前往维纳利亚与古斯塔斯合作。考特建议我驾驶一艘截击舰，并要我当心0.0地区域里的虎视眈眈的海盗。

messages.en: Arment Caute, a Gallente Federation Navy official, offered me a unique job: fly for the Guristas in order to sabotage the Caldari Navy's efforts in the outer regions. He told me that it would be dangerous business, and that the Federation would not acknowledge my efforts. But he also mentioned that there would be a big payout for my efforts. I decided to travel to Venal and fly for the Guristas. Caute advised me to fly in an interceptor and to be wary of bubble camps and the lawless rabble in nullsec.
messages.zh: 盖伦特联邦海军的一位名叫阿门·考特的官员给我交待了一份独特的工作：与古斯塔斯合作在偏远地区对加达里海军暗中使坏。他告诉这是项危险的任务，而且联邦也不会公开承认这件事。不过他也提到我会因此获得一笔丰厚报酬。我决定前往维纳利亚与古斯塔斯合作。考特建议我驾驶一艘截击舰，并要我当心0.0地区域里的虎视眈眈的海盗。

messages.en: We never saw each other, and this conversation never occurred. I believe you're looking for Kori Latamaki, not me.
messages.zh: 我们从未见过面，这段对话也从未发生过。我想你是在找考利·拉塔马基，不是我。

messages.en:
Fly out and meet Kori Latamaki in the Venal Region. He's an agent for the Guristas. You will be working with the pirates in covert operations against the Caldari State Navy.

Warning: This is a high level, stealthy operation. You will need to fly an interceptor for these missions. The journey out into nullsec is a dangerous one, and you must be prepared for interdiction bubbles and the lawless rabble in that God-forsaken wilderness. Regardless, the Guristas asked that we send pilots in interceptors, so don't go out there without one.
messages.zh:
请飞往维纳利亚星域会见考利·拉塔马基。他是古斯塔斯的代理人。你将会与海盗进行秘密合作对抗加达里海军。

警告：这是项高级幕后行动。你得驾驶一艘截击舰前往。飞往0.0区是件危险的事情，你必须做好应对拦截泡及被打劫的心里准备。古斯塔斯坚持要驾驶截击舰的飞行员前往，因此你一定要遵照这点。

messages.en: We never saw each other, and this conversation never occurred.
messages.zh: 我们从未见过面，这段对话也从未发生过。

messages.en:
You seem like a trustworthy capsuleer, so I have an offer for you. The Federation Navy is working on a few covert operations against the Caldari in conjunction with a few “unseemly” organizations in the outer reaches of known space. Our Federation is not the only enemy of the Caldari State. What's that adage? “The enemy of my enemy is my friend.” Sometimes you just have to listen to the proverbs.

To be blunt, you'll be flying with the Guristas. Yes, I know. They're pirates. However, they've also been a massive thorn in the Caldari's side for years, and we have come to an understanding of sorts with them. I must emphasize this point, though: if you accept this mission, nothing you do will be recognized by the Federation. You will be flying for the pirates, not for us. We won't be bailing you out, nor will we acknowledge this conversation. Rather, consider this your foot in the door. You're working for pirates now.

Warning: This is a high level, stealthy operation. You will need to fly an interceptor for these missions. The journey out into nullsec is a dangerous one, and you must be prepared for interdiction bubbles and the lawless rabble in that God-forsaken wilderness. Regardless, the Guristas asked that we send pilots in interceptors, so don't go out there without one.
messages.zh:
你好像是位值得信赖的飞行员，鉴于此，我有个提议给你。联邦海军目前正在联合一帮“不守规矩”的组织在偏远地区进行一项针对加达里的秘密行动。加达里合众国的敌人不只我们联邦一个。有句话叫什么来着？“我敌人的敌人就是我的朋友”。有时多听听古训是很管用的。

把话挑明了说，就是我们要你去和古斯塔斯合作行事。我知道，他们是海盗，但与此同时，他们也是加达里多年的眼中钉，而且我们也与他们达成了某种形式的谅解。不过我必须强调一点：如果你接受此任务，那联邦会装做对此毫不知情。你与海盗合作，不是与我们合作。我们不会救你的，也不会承认这段对话的存在。你就把这当作是你的入门实习吧。你现在的合作对象是海盗。

警告：这是项高级幕后行动。你得驾驶一艘截击舰前往。飞往0.0区是件危险的事情，你必须做好应对拦截泡及被打劫的心里准备。古斯塔斯坚持要驾驶截击舰的飞行员前往，因此你一定要遵照这点。

messages.en: We never saw each other, and this conversation never occurred.
messages.zh: 我们从未见过面，这段对话也从未发生过。

messages.en: We never saw each other, and this conversation never occurred.
messages.zh: 我们从未见过面，这段对话也从未发生过。

messages.en: Yada Vinjivas, a covert agent working for the Guristas, recruited me to aid his organization in the Venal region. The Guristas will use my services in their ongoing efforts to rebuff the Caldari State in that region. Yada recommended that I fly an interceptor for these missions, warning me of the dangerous journey to nullsec. He also offered me handsome rewards, making my time well worth the risk involved.
messages.zh: 雅达·温基瓦斯是为古斯塔斯卖命的一位隐秘代理人。他出钱让我前往维纳尔星域协助古斯塔斯的工作。古斯塔斯将借助我的力量在那星域对抗加达里。雅达建议我驾驶一艘截击舰前往，以防路上危险。他给的报酬也十分丰厚，让我觉得这时间花得值。

messages.en: Yada Vinjivas, a covert agent working for the Guristas, recruited me to aid his organization in the Venal region. The Guristas will use my services in their ongoing efforts to rebuff the Caldari State in that region. Yada recommended that I fly an interceptor for these missions, warning me of the dangerous journey to nullsec. He also offered me handsome rewards, making my time well worth the risk involved.
messages.zh: 雅达·温基瓦斯是为古斯塔斯卖命的一位隐秘代理人。他出钱让我前往维纳尔星域协助古斯塔斯的工作。古斯塔斯将借助我的力量在那星域对抗加达里。雅达建议我驾驶一艘截击舰前往，以防路上危险。他给的报酬也十分丰厚，让我觉得这时间花得值。

messages.en: You'll be in good hands. Kori Latamaki is one of our best agents. We take good care of our people. Just be sure you have an interceptor; stealth is of the utmost importance.
messages.zh: 你会被好生招待的。考利·拉塔马基是我们最好的代理人之一。我们对自己人都很好。你只要保证自己有一艘截击舰就行；这件事一定要悄悄地做。

messages.en:
Fly out and meet Kori Latamaki in the Venal Region. He's an agent for the Guristas. You will be working with us in covert operations against the Caldari State Navy. You must bring an interceptor for this operation; stealth is of the utmost importance.

Warning: This is a high-level, stealthy operation. You will need to fly an interceptor for these missions. The journey out into nullsec is a dangerous one, and you must be prepared for interdiction bubbles and the lawless rabble you'll run into on your way to Venal. It's high risk, but also high reward. Either way, an interceptor is an absolute must-have for this operation.
messages.zh:
请前往维纳尔星域会面考利·拉塔马基。他是古斯塔斯的一位代理人。你会加入我们针对加达里海军的一些隐秘行动。你必须驾驶一艘截击舰前往，决不能暴露你的行踪。

警告：这是项高级隐秘行动，你需要驾驶一艘截击舰执行该任务。0.0区域里非常危险。只有当你要做好在前去维纳尔的路上面对拦截泡及遭受联盟围追堵截这类险境的准备。这事风险挺大，但报酬也丰厚。无论如何，截击舰是件必需品。

messages.en: We never saw each other, and this conversation never occurred.
messages.zh: 我们从未见过面，这段对话也从未发生过。

messages.en:
Hey, egger, I have an offer for you.

Are you tired of the empires and their constant bickering? Do you consider CONCORD to be a detriment to progress in our modern society? Are you looking for a life of thrills and adventure among the stars? Do you want to be rich and famous?

If you answered “Yes” to the above questions, then look no further: The Guristas are the organization for you! From high-stakes operations against the Caldari State, to plundering colonies and targets of opportunity in Venal, the Guristas will help you get a piece of the action. There's money to be made in the furthest reaches of space. Don't be left out of being an outlaw!

We're looking for a solid capsuleer to aid us in operations against the Caldari Navy. If you are interested, then accept this mission. You'll travel to Venal and work with our best agents.

Warning: This is a high-level, stealthy operation. You will need to fly an interceptor for these missions. The journey out into nullsec is a dangerous one, and you must be prepared for interdiction bubbles and the lawless rabble you'll run into on your way to Venal. It's high risk, but also high reward. Either way, an interceptor is an absolute must-have for this operation.
messages.zh:
嗨，飞行员，我有个活儿想让你干。

你是否对帝国以及他们之间的争斗感到了厌倦？你是否觉得统合部是现代社会进步的一大障碍？你是否想过一把刺激生活？你想既出名又有钱吗？

如果你的回答都是肯定的，那你无需再左顾右盼：古斯塔斯就是你的理想选择！我们这里有针对加达里合众国的冒险行动，也有在维纳尔进行袭击抢占的机会，只要你与古斯塔斯合作，你也能加入其中。宇宙边际到处都是黄金，别放弃了当恶人的机会！

我们需要一位能干的飞行员来帮助我们对付加达里海军。如果你感兴趣，就请接受此任务。你将前往维纳尔与我们最棒的一群代理人合作共事。

警告：这是项高级隐秘行动，你需要驾驶一艘截击舰执行该任务。0.0区域里非常危险。只有当你要做好在前去维纳尔的路上面对拦截泡及遭受联盟围追堵截这类险境的准备。这事风险挺大，但报酬也丰厚。无论如何，截击舰是件必需品。

messages.en: We never saw each other, and this conversation never occurred.
messages.zh: 我们从未见过面，这段对话也从未发生过。

messages.en: You've made the right choice, egger. Now go talk to Kori Latamaki.
messages.zh: 你做出了正确的决定。快去见考利·拉塔马基吧。

messages.en: Chapter 1 - Probationary
messages.zh: 第一章——试用期

messages.en: I ambushed a Minedrill expedition and took the Minedrill crew prisoners. Latamaki seems confident that they'll be providing useful information in the very near future. He presumes that Minedrill is gathering resources for the Navy, and that my help will be needed again soon.
messages.zh: 我偷袭了一支矿钻远征队，抓获了其中的船员。拉塔马基似乎很自信地认为他们很快就能提供有价值的情报。他猜测远征队在为海军获取资源，而我也很快会再次受命。

messages.en: I've contacted Kori Latamaki, a mission planner for the Guristas. He directed me to lie in wait for a Minedrill expedition. I'm supposed to dispose of the combat escorts and take the Minedrill industrial crew.
messages.zh: 我与古斯塔斯的一位名叫“考利·拉塔马基”的任务策划者会了面。他让我去守候一支矿钻远征队。我的任务就是摧毁他们的保驾战船，然后带回远征队的船员。

messages.en: We're not just a bunch of swashbuckling goons. Despite the slander from the empires, we know what we're doing, and we're damn good at it. Stick with us, egger. You'll get rich if you do.
messages.zh: 我们可不是一帮头脑简单的粗人。虽说帝国的人喜欢诋毁我们，但我们知道我们在干什么，而且干得还特别好。跟我们干吧，克隆飞行员，我们包你腰缠万贯。

messages.en: Wait for the Minedrill expedition. When they arrive, take out the expedition fleet and bring back the industrial's crew.
messages.zh: 等矿钻远征队的前来。他们现身之后，把整支队伍舰船都解决掉，然后带回工业舰上的船员。

messages.en: Great. We should be getting reliable intelligence from them soon. If I were you, I'd take it easy for a bit. Based on Minedrill's recent activity, it's fair to say they have a major contract with somebody; probably the Navy.
messages.zh: 很好。我们应该很快就能从他们嘴里获得可靠的情报了。如果我是你，我会比较放松一点。从矿钻远征队最近的行动来看，他们有可能在履行一项大合同；合同另一方可能就是海军。

messages.en: I knew that we were taking a gamble by using a capsuleer. Get out of here, and go back to your safety net. Good luck with those bubble camps, though.
messages.zh: 我就知道用克隆飞行员是件不靠谱的事。走吧走吧，回到你那“温馨”的家去吧。不过可别忘了路上要遭遇的海盗，为你自己祈祷吧。

messages.en:
So you want to fly for the Guristas? Welcome aboard, egger. You get to do some rookie stuff.

We've leaked information on the location of a particularly rich group of asteroids within Venal. We expect a Minedrill expedition to show up soon, and we want someone to be there to greet them. You can expect their expedition to be made up of several combat escorts and an industrial.

Take out the industrial and grab its crew. Knowing Minedrill, this'll just be a research team – they need to test the rocks first before sending in those expensive barges. But once we have their people, we can mine their personnel for any intelligence on future ops.

If you haven't picked up on this already, we're a cautious bunch. We like to make sure whatever op we run goes off right. We have weapon caches, safe houses, and agents everywhere we plan to operate, even in empire space. The Guristas have contingencies for everything, even in dealing with someone like you.
messages.zh:
这么说你想为古斯塔斯打工？欢迎欢迎，克隆飞行员。先让你干点起步活吧。

我们泄漏了维纳尔星域里一处矿产特别富饶的小行星带，估计矿钻远征队会很快前往那儿。我们要派个人去“迎接”他们。那支队伍应该会由数支战船与一艘工业舰组成。

你的任务就是摧毁那艘工业舰，将其中的船员带回来。 根据我们对矿钻远征队的了解，那应该只是支研究队——他们得先 勘测一下那些小行星然后才敢派遣价值不菲的驳船前往。一旦我们抓获了那批船员，我们就能从他们口中得知其以后各项计划。

如果你还没弄明白这样做的目的，那我就告诉你：我们为人谨慎。我们确保每一次行动都万无一失。我们到处都有武器库、藏身处及代理人。古斯塔斯对每件事情都做好了准备，其中还包括如何对付像你这样的人。

messages.en: I knew that we were taking a gamble by using a capsuleer. Get out of here, and go back to your safety net. Good luck with those bubble camps, though.
messages.zh: 我就知道用克隆飞行员是件不靠谱的事。走吧走吧，回到你那“温馨”的家去吧。不过可别忘了路上要遭遇的海盗，为你自己祈祷吧。

messages.en: Have they shown up yet? What's your status?
messages.zh: 他们出现了吗？事情怎么样？

messages.en: I have been tasked with infiltrating a Caldari Naval Shipyard. Kori offered me a few choices on how I can do this: I can navigate a minefield and sneak in the backdoor, or I can go in the front door, guns blazing. I made my choice.
messages.zh: 我被要求其潜入一座加达里海军船坞。考利给了我两条路让我选：我可以通过雷区走后门入，或者端起枪炮从正门闯。我做出了决定。

messages.en: I have been tasked with infiltrating a Caldari Naval Shipyard. Kori offered me a few choices on how I can do this: I can navigate a minefield and sneak in the backdoor, or I can go in the front door, guns blazing.
messages.zh: 我被要求其潜入一座加达里海军船坞。考利给了我两条路让我选：我可以通过雷区走后门入，或者端起枪炮从正门闯。

messages.en:
The miners were useful to us; we barely had to use our “persuasion tactics” on them. Though that didn't stop us from going the extra mile for some additional information, of course. Their stories all seem to corroborate each others' on a few key targets, but the most interesting one is a secret Navy shipyard operating nearby, right in our backyard.

According to our new friends here, Minedrill is working with the Caldari Navy to build up a sizable fleet in our territory. From the way these miners have been jumping for rocks, they may even be building a few Titan-class ships. All we know is that they're definitely building something large. The prisoners' stories agreed on that, and not just because we were beating them with jolt sticks.

I believe the Navy is building up to push into Venal, or to create pressure in Okkellen. The Navy just ought to know better. Regardless, I need someone to find out what they're building there; lucky for us, I think we can bypass a substantial amount of the security you'd be facing otherwise.

Here are your options :



Either by force or by subterfuge, we need those designs. I don't know which is more your style, so I'll let you choose.
messages.zh:
那群矿工透露了很多有用的信息；我们的“说服技巧”基本上没怎么用。当然了，为了获得更多信息，我们还是动用了点手段。这群矿工吐露的信息在一些关键点上都很吻合，其中最有意思的就是海军在附近秘密设了一座船坞，那地方正位于我们的后院。

据我们这里刚认识的人透露，矿钻远征队正与加达里海军通力合作在我们领地组建一支大规模舰队。从那批矿工开采的拼命劲来看，他们可能同时还在建造泰坦级别的舰船。我们唯一确信的就是他们在搞一个大动作。我们抓来的人也证实了这一点，这应该不单纯是使用电击棒的结果吧。

我觉得海军准备军力的目的是想深入维纳尔星域，或者想在欧克勒恩制造压力。反正想干什么只有他们自己最清楚。不过我还是需要有个人去查一下他们到底在搞什么；所幸我们有个方法可以绕开原本你必须面对的来自于他们的严防死守。

你现在有两条路可走：

不管你是采取强制还是连哄带骗，我们都要把设计方案弄到手。我不知道你喜欢哪种风格，所以你自己定吧。

messages.en:
Not interested in meeting the enemy face-to-face? Fair enough. This area might be a little creepy, but there's history in that station. The Navy requisitioned the area to combat Gurista encroachment. That's when the mines started to show up.

Be careful with those mines. Who knows how long they've been there or how effective they still are. Tread carefully, or shoot them with caution. If – er, once – you get past the mines, you'll see the station. Inside the station will be some capital ship designs for an upcoming Navy project, codenamed “Dictator.” Grab those designs and get out of there. You should be able to take them directly from the assembly station, according to the Minedrill prisoners. That is, unless there are no guards.
messages.zh:
不想与敌人硬碰硬？行。那空间站虽然有点阴森，但却饱含着历史。海军下令要把那儿建成抵挡古斯塔斯的缓冲带，所以那里会有一片雷区。

你要当心那些地雷。天知道它们在那儿存在了多久，更没人确信它们是否还管用。你要慢慢来，或者小心翼翼地用炮火将它们炸掉。如果——呃——一旦你通过了雷区，就能看到空间站了。空间站里有用于海军下一项目被戏称为“独夫”的旗舰设计方案。把那些方案拽在手中后就走。根据矿钻远征队那些人的说法，你可以从装配空间站里直接把方案带走，当然，前提是那儿无人把守。

messages.en:
We need someone to get in there, find their assembly station, and take their ship designs. Since you didn't want to go through the minefield, you'll be taking a more direct approach. We've scrambled your comms signal to a Navy frequency. You should, theoretically, read as one of them. This is, of course, according to our guests from Minedrill. You should definitely fit your ship like you're expecting a fight. Hopefully you'll get past the initial security. If not, then you'll have to do some fighting.

Grab those designs and get out of there. Guristas Production will examine them when you return, and we'll probably send some folks over there to level the place depending on what we find. It might even be you.
messages.zh:
我们要个人去那儿，找到他们的装配空间站，然后带出他们的舰船设计方案。既然你不想闯雷区，那就得采用一个更为直接的手段。我们已经把你的通信信号的频率调为了海军档。理论上讲，他们应该会把你当成他们的一员。当然这只是矿钻远征队那些人的说法。你还是应该按照迎战要求装配你的舰船。但愿你能通过首道防卫，如果不能，那你就得拿起你的枪炮了。

拿到设计方案后就离开那儿。古斯塔斯制造会在你返航后检验那些方案的，然后根据我们在那儿得到的发现，我们将派某个人前往那儿扫平那片区域。说不定那人还是你。

name.ja: サボタージュ初級クラス

messages.en: The Guristas suspect that Minedrill has been working with the Caldari Navy for quite some time now, supplying them with building materials in order to build a fleet in the area. Kori asked me to infiltrate this shipyard. Inside, there should be some top secret ship designs for a new capital ship project, codenamed “Dictator.” The base is surrounded by an old minefield, but there should be a route into the shipyard. I managed to traverse the minefield and retrieve these designs.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯怀疑矿钻已经同加达里海军勾搭有很长的一段时间了，他们为海军提供各种建造材料用于在这个区域建造一支舰队。考利让我渗透这座船坞。在船坞里面应该藏有一些高级机密的舰船设计资料，那是用于一项新的旗舰建造方案的，项目被定名为“独夫”。那座基地被一片很久前设下的雷区所包围，但应该有一条通道可以进入船坞。我已经设法通过那片雷区并取得了目标设计文档。

messages.en: The Guristas suspect that Minedrill has been working with the Caldari Navy for quite some time now, supplying them with building materials in order to build a fleet in the area. Kori asked me to infiltrate this shipyard. Inside, there should be some top secret ship designs for a new capital ship project, codenamed “Dictator.” The base is surrounded by an old minefield, but there should be a route into the shipyard.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯怀疑矿钻已经同加达里海军勾搭有很长的一段时间了，他们为海军提供各种建造材料用于在这个区域建造一支舰队。考利让我渗透这座船坞。在船坞里面应该藏有一些高级机密的舰船设计资料，那是用于一项新的旗舰建造方案的，项目被定名为“独夫”。那座基地被一片很久前设下的雷区所包围，但应该有一条通道可以进入船坞。

messages.en:
Normally an op like this would take quite a bit longer to plan, but having a capsuleer on board makes things a little easier. As I've stated when I told you about your options for this op, you'll need to fly through a mine field to infiltrate the shipyard. Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty.

This area might be a little creepy, but there's history in that station. For starters, it was one of the many State-run orphanages established after the exodus from Caldari Prime, focusing mainly on raising the products of the test-tube birthing program. Later, the Navy requisitioned the area to combat Gurista encroachment. That's when the mines started to show up.

Be careful with those mines. Who knows how long they've been there or how effective they still are. Tread carefully, or shoot them with caution. If – er, once – you get past the mines, you'll see the station. Inside the station will be some capital ship designs for an upcoming Navy project, codenamed “Dictator.” Grab those designs and get out of there. You should be able to take them directly from the assembly station, according to the Minedrill prisoners. That is, unless there are no guards.
messages.zh:
通常来说，像这样的一次行动会耗费很长时间来做计划的，但是如果有了克隆飞行员的帮助的话我们就能够比较轻松一些了。我想我已经在之前告诉过你关于这次行动的细节了，你需要穿过一片雷区才能够渗透进入船坞。不要为爆掉敌人几艘船而感到担心。

这个区域非常的危险，这种危险是同那座空间站的历史有关的。在最初，这座空间站是一家国立孤儿院，建立于撤离加达里首星后的一段时期，它的主要用途是抚育那些试管生育计划的产物。后来，海军取得了这个区域的使用权，将其作为同古斯塔斯对抗的阵地。这些地雷也就是在那个时期开始出现的。

你要当心那些地雷。天知道它们在那儿存在了多久，更没人确信它们是否还管用。你要慢慢来，或者小心翼翼地用炮火将它们炸掉。如果——呃——一旦你通过了雷区，就能看到空间站了。空间站里有用于海军下一项目被戏称为“独夫”的旗舰设计方案。把那些方案拽在手中后就走。根据矿钻远征队那些人的说法，你可以从装配空间站里直接把方案带走，当然，前提是那儿无人把守。

messages.en: Be careful with those mines. Who knows how long they've been there or how effective they still are. Tread carefully, or shoot them with caution. If – er, once – you get past the mines, you'll see the station. Inside the station will be some capital ship designs for an upcoming Navy project, codenamed “Dictator.” Grab those designs and get out of there. You should be able to take them directly from the assembly station, according to the Minedrill prisoners. That is, unless there are no guards.
messages.zh: 你要当心那些地雷。天知道它们在那儿存在了多久，更没人确信它们是否还管用。你要慢慢来，或者小心翼翼地用炮火将它们炸掉。如果——呃——一旦你通过了雷区，就能看到空间站了。空间站里有用于海军下一项目被戏称为“独夫”的旗舰设计方案。把那些方案拽在手中后就走。根据矿钻远征队那些人的说法，你可以从装配空间站里直接把方案带走，当然，前提是那儿无人把守。

messages.en:
Good work. We'll have Guristas Production have a look at those designs. We should know what the Navy's plans are in short order.

By the way, that was one of the most impressive feats of flying I've seen. Bringing you on board doesn't seem like a mistake, at least not right now. Stick around, and those pay days will keep coming.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮。我们会让古斯塔斯的制造部门看看这些设计的，我们应当知道海军近期的打算。

顺便提一下，那是我见过最厉害的飞行技巧了，看来把你拉进来并不是一个错误，至少说现在是这样。加油吧，钱不会少了你的。

messages.en: I let you take your pick of strategies. I thought – never mind. You'd be wise to leave Venal space. I don't know how friendly my pirate brethren will be to you anymore.
messages.zh: 我让你就用你自己的策略。我想……还是算了吧。如果聪明的话你应该离开维纳尔星域，我不知道我的海盗兄弟们还会对你有多客气。

messages.en: The Minedrill crew talked about a minefield near a long-abandoned Caldari station. The whole place dates back to an earlier conflict between us and the Navy. What's significant about the station now is an acceleration gate that should lead you into the heart of the shipyard. However, traversing the minefield will be difficult. Once inside, you should have access to the shipyard, and from there, you can sneak up and steal any designs that they're working on.
messages.zh: 矿钻集团的成员曾经谈到了关于一个被废弃已久的加达里空间站附近所埋设的地雷。那座空间站的历史可以追溯到我们同海军作战的早起时代。对于当下来说，这座空间站的重要之处在于它有一道可以带你通向船坞中心地带的加速轨道。不过，要穿越那片雷区并不是一件简单的事情。一旦你穿过去了，你就能够进入船坞，你可以在那里得到他们正在研发的各种设计资料。

messages.en: I let you take your pick of strategies. I thought – never mind. You'd be wise to leave Venal space. I don't know how friendly my pirate brethren will be to you anymore.
messages.zh: 我让你就用你自己的策略。我想……还是算了吧。如果聪明的话你应该离开维纳尔星域，我不知道我的海盗兄弟们还会对你有多客气。

messages.en: How about those mines?
messages.zh: 那些地雷怎么办？

messages.en: The Guristas suspect that Minedrill has been working with the Caldari Navy for quite some time now, supplying the State with building materials in order to construct a fleet in the area. Kori asked me to infiltrate this shipyard. Inside, there should be some top secret ship designs for a new capital ship project, codenamed “Dictator.” I chose the more direct route, infiltrating the base through its front line. I grabbed the ship designs and delivered the goods to Kori.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯怀疑矿钻远征队与加达里海军合作已久，为海军提供物资以供海军在该地区组建一支舰队。考利要我去潜入那建造船坞，里面应该会有一项名为“独裁者”秘密项目的旗舰设计图纸。我选了个更为直接的方式：闯入他们的前线。我拿到舰船设计方案后就将其交给了考利。

messages.en: The Guristas suspect that Minedrill has been working with the Caldari Navy for quite some time now, supplying the State with building materials in order to construct a fleet in the area. Kori asked me to infiltrate this shipyard. Inside, there should be some top secret ship designs for a new capital ship project, codenamed “Dictator.” I have chosen to go the more direct route, entering though their front line.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯怀疑矿钻远征队与加达里海军合作已久，为海军提供物资以供海军在该地区组建一支舰队。考利要我去潜入那建造船坞，里面应该会有一项名为“独裁者”秘密项目的旗舰设计图纸。我选了个更为直接的方式：闯入他们的前线。

messages.en: Good. We've got work to do. You should at least be able to get through the first acceleration gate described by our prisoners, if everything goes according to plan. Which, of course, it will. If not, you'll have a fight on your hands. Good luck.
messages.zh: 很好。我们有事做了。按照那批被我们囚禁的人的描述，如果一切顺利，你至少可以通过第一条加速轨道。不过我相信事情肯定会顺利的。万一不顺，那你就得跟别人动刀枪了。祝你好运。

messages.en:
We need someone to get in there, find their assembly station, and take their ship designs. Since you didn't want to go through the minefield, you'll be taking a more direct approach. We've scrambled your comms signal to a Navy frequency. You should, theoretically, read as one of them. This is, of course, according to our guests from Minedrill. You should definitely fit your ship like you're expecting a fight. Hopefully you'll get past the initial security. If not, then you'll have to do some fighting.

Grab those designs and get out of there. Guristas Production will examine them when you return, and we'll probably send some folks over there to level the place depending on what we find. It might even be you.
messages.zh:
我们要个人去那儿，找到他们的装配空间站，然后带出他们的舰船设计方案。既然你不想闯雷区，那就得采用一个更为直接的手段。我们已经把你的通信信号的频率调为了海军档。理论上讲，他们应该会把你当成他们的一员。当然这只是矿钻远征队那些人的说法。你还是应该按照迎战要求装配你的舰船。但愿你能通过首道防卫，如果不能，那你就得拿起你的枪炮了。

拿到设计方案后就离开那儿。古斯塔斯制造会在你返航后检验那些方案的，然后根据我们在那儿得到的发现，我们将派某个人前往那儿扫平那片区域。说不定那人还是你。

messages.en:
I bet they'll be more cautious in the future, but it's always gratifying to do some high-level sabotage. And that's exactly what you did. I think we can count on you in the future.

As for what they were building, it will be a while before we know. Based on flight recordings, it looks like they're building carriers. That's a break from tradition. My team will continue to look into it.
messages.zh:
我觉得他们将来肯定会更小心谨慎的，但做高级间谍这事真让人觉得很爽。你完成了任务，我想将来我们还能把更多的事交付给你。

至于海军他们到底葫芦里在卖什么药，我看得过会儿才能知道。从飞行日志上看，他们好像在造航母。他们一般不这样做的，我手下的人会对此展开深入调查。

messages.en: Your choice, I guess. I think I can find someone else to fly this one, but I have to say this: We're not going to forget this. The Guristas are presenting you with an opportunity. Let us know if you want to reconsider.
messages.zh: 这是你的选择。我应该还能找到别人来干此事，但我还是要说：我们不会忘记这点的。古斯塔斯给你机会，希望你能考虑再三。

messages.en:
We need someone to get in there, find their assembly station, and take their ship designs. Since you didn't want to go through the minefield, you'll be taking a more direct approach. If you can't go around it, then you might as well go through it, right?

We've scrambled your comms signal to a Navy frequency. You should, theoretically, read as one of them. This is, of course, according to our guests from Minedrill. You should definitely fit your ship like you're expecting a fight. Hopefully you'll get past the initial security. If not, then you'll have to do some fighting. But that's what you're good for, isn't it? And if the Minedrill guys were lying to us, then we'll take care of them for good.

You can take a more direct approach. You can approach the shipyard proper and try to either sneak past the sentry guns, or blast your way though. Sort of a run-and-gun operation. Same deal, though: once inside, you'll grab the designs and get out of there. Guristas Production will examine them when you return, and we'll probably send some folks over there to level the place depending on what we find. It might even be you.
messages.zh:
我们要个人去那儿，找到他们的装配空间站，然后带出他们的舰船设计方案。既然你不想闯雷区，那就得采用一个更为直接的手段。我们已经把你的通信信号的频率调为了海军档。理论上讲，他们应该会把你当成他们的一员。当然这只是矿钻远征队那些人的说法。你还是应该按照迎战要求装配你的舰船。但愿你能通过首道防卫，如果不能，那你就得拿起你的枪炮了。不过你不就是擅长那个吗？如果矿钻远征队忽悠我们，那我们一定会让他们吃不了兜着走。

你还可以更直接一点进入那里。到了船坞外面，你可以尝试偷偷进去或者一路打进去。都是小问题，总之，进去拿到设计方案后就离开那儿。古斯塔斯制造的人会在你返航后检验那些方案的，然后根据我们在那儿得到的发现，我们将派某个人前往那儿扫平那片区域。说不定那人还是你。

messages.en: I'll just send a crew round to reclaim the transponder. I was hoping we could work together more. Let me know if you change your mind.
messages.zh: 我去派人把那通讯收发器拿回来。我本来以为我们还能继续合作。如果你改变想法，请告诉我。

messages.en: Things going well? Remember, you can just grab the parts and run. Any other fighting is purely a perk.
messages.zh: 事情进展还顺利吧？记住，你只需拿到设计方案溜走就行，没必要与对方进行胡搅蛮缠的交火。

messages.en: Atma Aulato, a Caldari State  citizen, offered me a unique mission. He wanted me to help him turn against his nation by aiding the Guristas in their efforts in Venal. The agent claimed that the Caldari State has not treated him well as of late. I decided to fly to Venal and help the Guristas, starting with a pirate agent by the name of Kori Latamaki. Atma warned me that the journey there would be dangerous, advising that I fly an interceptor. But he also promised that the rewards would be plentiful, well worth the risk of going out there.
messages.zh: 加达里合众国一位名叫奥塔玛·奥拉托的人给我交待了一份独特的工作：在维纳利亚与古斯塔斯合作对抗其自己国家。他说加达里最近对他待遇不好。我决定前往维纳利亚帮古斯塔斯一把，先找他们名叫“考利·拉塔马基”的代理人。奥塔玛告诉这是项危险的任务，建议我驾驶一艘截击舰，不过他也答应我会因此获得一笔丰厚报酬，足以补偿相应的风险。

messages.en: Atma Aulato, a Caldari State  citizen, offered me a unique mission. He wanted me to help him turn against his nation by aiding the Guristas in their efforts in Venal. The agent claimed that the Caldari State has not treated him well as of late. I decided to fly to Venal and help the Guristas, starting with a pirate agent by the name of Kori Latamaki. Atma warned me that the journey there would be dangerous, advising that I fly an interceptor. But he also promised that the rewards would be plentiful, well worth the risk of going out there.
messages.zh: 加达里合众国一位名叫奥塔玛·奥拉托的人给我交待了一份独特的工作：在维纳利亚与古斯塔斯合作对抗其自己国家。他说加达里最近对他待遇不好。我决定前往维纳利亚帮古斯塔斯一把，先找他们名叫“考利·拉塔马基”的代理人。奥塔玛告诉这是项危险的任务，建议我驾驶一艘截击舰，不过他也答应我会因此获得一笔丰厚报酬，足以补偿相应的风险。

messages.en: We never saw each other, and this conversation never occurred. I believe you're looking for Kori Latamaki, not me.
messages.zh: 我们从未见过面，这段对话也从未发生过。我想你是在找考利·拉塔马基，不是我。

messages.en:
Fly out and meet Kori Latamaki in the Venal Region. He's an agent for the Guristas. You will be working with the pirates in covert operations against the Caldari State Navy. You must bring an interceptor for this operation; stealth is of the utmost importance.

Warning: This is a high-level, stealthy operation. You will need to fly an interceptor for these missions. The journey out into nullsec is a dangerous one, and you must be prepared for interdiction bubbles and the lawless rabble in that God-forsaken wilderness. Regardless, the Guristas asked that I send pilots in interceptors, so don't go out there without one.
messages.zh:
请飞往维纳利亚星域会见考利·拉塔马基。他是古斯塔斯的代理人。你将会与海盗进行秘密合作对抗加达里海军。你必须驾驶一艘截击舰，千万别让人追查到你的行踪。

警告：这是项高级幕后行动。你得驾驶一艘截击舰前往。飞往0.0区是件危险的事情，你必须做好应对拦截泡及被打劫的心里准备。古斯塔斯坚持要驾驶截击舰的飞行员前往，因此你一定要遵照这点。

messages.en: We never saw each other, and this conversation never occurred.
messages.zh: 我们从未见过面，这段对话也从未发生过。

messages.en:
I don't know if you're interested, but I need some help. How would you like to help me earn some money at the expense of the Caldari State? I know what you're thinking: I must be crazy. But, to be honest, the State hasn't been too kind to me as of late, and I need to pay them back for their indiscretions. They've already put some surveillance on my activities, so I need a proxy to aid me in taking them down. Are you interested in helping me, soldier?

To be blunt, you'll be flying with the Guristas. Yes, I know. They're pirates. However, they've also been a massive thorn in the Caldari's side for years, and I have come to an understanding of sorts with them. I must emphasize this point, though: if you accept this mission, I will not acknowledge your existence. I won't be bailing you out, nor will I admit that this conversation ever took place. Consider this your foot in the door. You're working for pirates now. If you are willing to undermine the Caldari State as much as I want to see them undermined, then this is your opportunity.

Warning: This is a high-level, stealthy operation. You will need to fly an interceptor for these missions. The journey out into nullsec is a dangerous one, and you must be prepared for interdiction bubbles and the lawless rabble in that God-forsaken wilderness. Regardless, the Guristas asked that I send pilots in interceptors, so don't go out there without one.
messages.zh:
我不知道你是否感兴趣，但我需要你的帮助。你觉得以损失加达里为代价，为我赚点钱怎么样？我知道你在想什么：我一定是疯了。但说实话，加达里最近对我并不好，我也得还以颜色。他们已经在监视我的行动了，所以我得依靠一位中间人来对付他们。你愿意帮我吗，士兵？

把话挑明了说，我要你去和古斯塔斯合作行事。我知道，他们是海盗，但与此同时，他们也是加达里多年的眼中钉，而且我也与他们达成了某种形式的谅解。不过我必须强调一点：如果你接受此任务，那我会装做对此毫不知情。我不会救你的，也不会承认这段对话的存在。你就把这当作是你的入门实习吧。你现在的合作对象是海盗。如果你和我一样都想把加达里弄垮，那现在正是时机。

警告：这是项高级幕后行动。你得驾驶一艘截击舰前往。飞往0.0区是件危险的事情，你必须做好应对拦截泡及被打劫的心里准备。古斯塔斯坚持要驾驶截击舰的飞行员前往，因此你一定要遵照这点。

messages.en: We never saw each other, and this conversation never occurred.
messages.zh: 我们从未见过面，这段对话也从未发生过。

messages.en: We never saw each other, and this conversation never occurred.
messages.zh: 我们从未见过面，这段对话也从未发生过。

messages.en: I met with Abdiel Verat, one of the Angel Cartel's capsuleer liaisons. She had a job for me: scout a nearby wormhole and report the presence of any hostiles. When I arrived I found a gang of Sansha ships already there. She wants it dealt with.
messages.zh: 我与天使集团的阿布戴尔·瓦拉特见了面，她专职负责联系克隆飞行员。她给我派了个任务：探察附近的一个虫洞，然后报告任何敌情。我抵达那儿之后见到了一群萨沙的舰船。她要我解决掉它们。

messages.en: I met with Abdiel Verat, one of the Angel Cartel's capsuleer liaisons.  She had a job for me: scout a nearby wormhole and report the presence of any hostiles.
messages.zh: 我与天使集团的阿布戴尔·瓦拉特见了面，她专职负责联系克隆飞行员。她给我派了个任务：探察附近的一个虫洞，然后报告任何敌情。

messages.en: The wormhole is in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Investigate the area and then report back to me with what you've found.
messages.zh: 该虫洞位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。请前去调查，然后将你的所见所闻报告给我。

messages.en:
Abdiel Verat, Angel Cartel.

I look out for talented people such as you who are interested in work. And times have certainly made our work interesting.

Since you're an egger, I'm guessing you know your way around wormholes, yes? While they've been a great aid for our scientists, they've also brought some problems to our doorstop, some of which is not good for business.

Our explorers have discovered a wormhole in a nearby system, but we cannot spare the manpower to lock it down. If you help us out by scouting the area, then I may have other more lucrative tasks to follow.
messages.zh:
我是天使集团的阿布戴尔·瓦拉特。

我在寻找像你这样对干活儿有兴趣的能人。我们所处的这个时代使得我们的活儿变得有趣起来。

鉴于你是为克隆飞行员，我猜你应该知道如何闯荡于虫洞之间吧？虽然虫洞帮了我们科学家的大忙，但同时它们也将危险带到了家门口，对我们的事业不利。

我们的探察人员已在附近一个星系里发现了一个虫洞，但我们目前没有足够的人力去将它封锁住。如果你能帮我们去勘察一下那虫洞周遭的情况，那接下来你还能从我们这里获得报酬更为丰厚的任务。

messages.en: Sansha. Alright, let me relay this information up the chain of command. Stick around; we'll be calling on you to deal with this.
messages.zh: 萨沙，好吧，让我把这信息传达给我上司。别走开；我们会安排你处理这件事的。

messages.en: Then stop wasting my time.
messages.zh: 这样的话就别再浪费我的时间了。

messages.en:
The sudden appearance of wormholes across New Eden proved to be a boon to scientific communities of all disciplines. Nearly everyone in the cluster has some vested interest in the wormholes.

The Angel Cartel has been investing heavily into wormhole exploration. They not only scavenge the Sleeper ruins for new technology, but also exploit the wormholes' ability to link otherwise distant points. A wormhole can potentially turn an eighty-jump trip from Curse to Fountain into a twenty-minute jaunt. Although these opportunities represent significant logistical advantages, they are always fleeting, and every effort to map wormhole space has thus far failed.
messages.zh:
新伊甸各地突然出现虫洞，对于各个领域的科研人员而言堪称福音。宇宙中的每个人几乎都能享有既得利益。

一直以来，天使都在斥巨资探索虫洞的奥秘。他们不仅研究冬眠者废墟来摸索新技术，还利用虫洞的能力实现远点连接。从诅咒之域到源泉之域需要跳跃八十次，但虫洞的存在可以将路程时间缩短至二十分钟。这些机遇虽然会带来巨大的后勤优势，但总是转瞬即逝，即便竭尽全力，至今也都没人能绘制出虫洞空间图。

messages.en: Wormholes
messages.zh: 虫洞

messages.en:
Abdiel Verat, Angel Cartel.

I look out for talented people such as you who are interested in work. And times have certainly made our work interesting.

Since you're an egger, I'm guessing you know your way around wormholes, yes? While they've been a great aid for our scientists, they've also brought some problems to our doorstop, some of which is not good for business.

Our explorers have discovered a wormhole in a nearby system, but we cannot spare the manpower to lock it down. If you help us out by scouting the area, then I may have other more lucrative tasks to follow.
messages.zh:
我是天使集团的阿布戴尔·瓦拉特。

我在寻找像你这样对干活儿有兴趣的能人。我们所处的这个时代使得我们的活儿变得有趣起来。

鉴于你是为克隆飞行员，我猜你应该知道如何闯荡于虫洞之间吧？虽然虫洞帮了我们科学家的大忙，但同时它们也将危险带到了家门口，对我们的事业不利。

我们的探察人员已在附近一个星系里发现了一个虫洞，但我们目前没有足够的人力去将它封锁住。如果你能帮我们去勘察一下那虫洞周遭的情况，那接下来你还能从我们这里获得报酬更为丰厚的任务。

messages.en: Then stop wasting my time.
messages.zh: 这样的话就别再浪费我的时间了。

messages.en: I'll be waiting for your report. You needn't return here, {[character]player.name}. Just open up comms once you have a clear idea of the situation.
messages.zh: 我等你的报告。你没必要回到这里，{[character]player.name}，只需打开信道向我通报那里的情况就行。

messages.en: Rapture
messages.zh: 欢天喜地

messages.en: Faced with the Sansha's Nation blockade around the wormhole, Abdiel offered me a choice of what to do next. I can either take the Nation on directly in the name of the Cartel, or I can provide direct support for their research project.
messages.zh: 在遭遇萨沙围堵虫洞的情况下，阿布戴尔让我选择接下来该如何行事。我可以代表天使直接对抗萨沙，也可以协助天使的一个研究项目。

messages.en: Faced with the Sansha's Nation blockade around the wormhole, Abdiel offered me a choice of what to do next. I can either take the Nation on directly in the name of the Cartel, or I can provide direct support for their research project.
messages.zh: 在遭遇萨沙围堵虫洞的情况下，阿布戴尔让我选择接下来该如何行事。我可以代表天使直接对抗萨沙，也可以协助天使的一个研究项目。

messages.en: Alright then.
messages.zh: 好吧。

messages.en:
At the moment I have more work than I have people, so you need to choose how you want to proceed.

Obviously, the Sansha need to be cleared from our wormhole site. If you can prove yourself on this, chances are I'll be able to request more assignments to give you. We have early reports of more problems abroad, so I'm sure we can keep you moving from target to target out there.

We also have a shipment of important research material that needs to make it to Serpentis hands. The Inquest scientists in charge of the operation have been delayed, and moving the goods is a high-priority task we need someone to take over. We may also require an investigation into the reasons for the delay at Serpentis' end.

Both tasks need to be followed up. I don't care what you choose; we'll give one to you, and one to the next egger brave or stupid enough to show up down here.
messages.zh:
目前的情况是僧多粥少，因此你要自己想好了接下来该怎么办。

萨沙绝对要从我们的虫洞站点那儿被清除。如果你能搞定此事，那我便有更大的希望申请到更多的任务让你做。从之前一些报告来看，国外还有很多事要我们处理，因此我们能保证让你忙得应接不暇。

与此同时我们还有一批重要的研究物资需要送到天蛇手里。原本负责此事的天蛇集团调查处的科学家到现在还没来，我们需要一个人来接手此项重要任务。或许我们还要展开一项调查，搞清楚天蛇这次放鸽子的原因。

这两件事都得有人去做。你随便选哪件都可以；一件给你，另一件给其他一个克隆飞行员，不管他是有备而来还是鲁莽奔来。

messages.en: Alright, I need to relay your decision to my superiors and arrange to have the work you've passed on taken over by someone else. Just one moment, {[character]player.name}…
messages.zh: 好吧，我要把你的决定传达给我上级，然后安排他人来接手你放弃的那份工作。请稍等，{[character]player.name}……

messages.en:
At the moment I have more work than I have people, so you need to choose how you want to proceed.

We also have a shipment of important research material that needs to make it to Serpentis hands. The Inquest scientists in charge of the operation have been delayed, and moving the goods is a high-priority task we need someone to take over. We may also require an investigation into the reasons for the delay at Serpentis' end.

Both tasks need to be followed up. I don't care what you choose; we'll give one to you, and one to the next egger brave or stupid enough to show up down here.
messages.zh:
目前的情况是僧多粥少，因此你要自己想好了接下来该怎么办。

与此同时我们还有一批重要的研究物资需要送到天蛇手里。原本负责此事的天蛇集团调查处的科学家到现在还没来，我们需要一个人来接手此项重要任务。或许我们还要展开一项调查，搞清楚天蛇这次放鸽子的原因。

这两件事都得有人去做。你随便选哪件都可以；一件给你，另一件给其他一个克隆飞行员，不管他是有备而来还是鲁莽奔来。

messages.en:
While I was in Sendaya, I came across an agent of the Imperial Navy named Arajna Ashia. She implied that the Angels were under attack in Curse and might need capsuleer assistance. She never came right out and said, however. That kind of treachery within the Navy would be punishable by death.

She dropped the name “Abdiel Verat” as the person I should talk to about this matter. It seems Verat is deep inside Curse, and that if I want to follow this matter up, I will need to be too.
messages.zh:
我在森达雅的时候遇到了一位名叫埃拉亚娜·阿诗雅的帝国海军代理人。她暗示我天使集团正在柯尔斯遭受袭击，需要克隆飞行员的帮助。当然她从没直截了当地将这件事说出来，否则她那种叛徒行为一旦被海军知道就是死罪。

她提到了“阿布戴尔·瓦拉特”这个人，暗示我应该去找他。看起来瓦拉特隐居在柯尔斯星域中，如果我想将此事办到底，就得去那儿找他。

messages.en: While I was in Sendaya, I came across an agent of the Imperial Navy. She seemed to be implying in a roundabout way that the Angels were under attack in Curse and might need capsuleer assistance. She never came right out and said, however. That kind of treachery within the Navy would be punishable by death.
messages.zh: 我在森达雅的时候遇到了一位帝国海军代理人。她暗示我天使集团正在柯尔斯遭受袭击，需要克隆飞行员的帮助。当然她从没直截了当地将这件事说出来，否则她那种叛徒行为一旦被海军知道就是死罪。

messages.en: Hmm? You're off then? Fly safe.
messages.zh: 嗯？你走了？一路顺风。

messages.en:
I don't know anything more about the Cartel than the next person. I have no idea about any pirate invasions that they could potentially need help with. And I certainly don't know that Abdiel Verat would be the person you should talk to if you wanted to know more.

As you can see, I can't help you, and even if I did have valuable information, it would be reported immediately to my superiors. I have a reputation to uphold.
messages.zh:
我对天使的了解不比众人多，不知道任何所谓“需要增援的海盗袭击”，更不知道阿布戴尔·瓦拉特能为你提供更多线索。

懂了吧，我帮不了你。即使我手上真有有价值的线索，我也会第一时间向我上级汇报。我做人很讲信誉的。

messages.en: Decline what? We're having a conversation, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 拒绝什么？我们不过是在闲聊而已，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
This is a high-level stealth operation that will send you to nullsec. It is strongly recommended that you use an interceptor to move about freely in the depths of 0.0 space and complete these missions.

The journey into nullsec is a dangerous one. You should only accept the assignment if you are prepared to encounter (and evade) high-risk situations such as interdiction bubble camps and entire alliances wanting to kill you.

The Imperial Navy is in no way liable for any assets or personnel lost as a result of accepting this assignment. The Imperial Navy does not endorse this assignment and will deny all knowledge of its issuance. If you have received this message in error, please consult the nearest Ministry of Internal Order bureau for assistance. It is your legal obligation to report erroneous messages within 7 days.
messages.zh:
这是一次高度机密的行动，需要你前往0.0地区。我们强烈建议你驾驶一艘截击舰执行该任务，

0.0地区非常危险。只有当你做好准备面对拦截泡及遭受大队人马围追堵截这类险境的时候，你才应该接受这项任务。

帝国海军对此次任务中可能会遭受的人员或财产损失概不负责。帝国海军从未批准此项任务，坚决否认任务委托。如果你错误地收到了此条消息，请联系内务府。你有义务在收到错误信息的7天之内向政府汇报。

messages.en:
Oh, great, another one.

Look, I don't know where you're getting your intel, but I've got absolutely nothing to do with the Cartel. I'm not your “connection” in any sense of the word. Some scumbag was envious of my service record in Curse and decided to come up with that little story to explain away my success. You've been played, {[character]player.name}.

I don't know anything more about the Cartel than the next person. I have no idea about any pirate invasions that they could potentially need help with. And I certainly don't know that Abdiel Verat would be the person you should talk to if you wanted to know more.

As you can see, I can't help you, and even if I did have valuable information, it would be reported immediately to my superiors. I have a reputation to uphold.

Now, if you don't mind, I have important Navy matters to attend to. I hope you understand.
messages.zh:
哦，好极了，又来了一个。

听着，我不知道你是从哪儿听来的，但我压根与天使集团没有任何关系。我可不是你所谓的“线人”。很明显这是有人心存妒忌，眼红我在柯尔斯的斩获，想妖言惑众诋毁我所取得的那些成绩。你被人耍了，{[character]player.name}。

我对天使的了解不比众人多，不知道任何所谓“需要增援的海盗袭击”，更不知道阿布戴尔·瓦拉特能为你提供更多线索。

懂了吧，我帮不了你。即使我手上真有有价值的线索，我也会第一时间向我上级汇报。我做人很讲信誉的。

如果你不介意的话，我手头上还有其他事要处理。希望你能理解。

messages.en: Quit what? I don't remember giving you any assignment. I think you have become confused, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 退出什么？我不记得我委托给你过任何任务。我想你是犯糊涂了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Yes?
messages.zh: 什么事？

messages.en: While I was in Konora I came across an agent of the Angel Cartel, Ellar Stine. She told me that the Cartel is looking for more pod pilots to help them out with their “battles” down in Curse. I've been given the name of a new contact down in Curse, Abdiel Verat. If I want to follow the matter up, I should meet with her.
messages.zh: 我在克挪腊的时候遇到了天使集团一位名叫“额拉尔·斯丁”的代理人。她告诉该集团正在召集克隆飞行员以便援助正在柯尔斯进行的“战斗”。她给我介绍了柯尔斯里另一位代理人，阿布戴尔·瓦拉特。如果我想跟进此事，那就应先与该人见面。

messages.en: While I was in Konora, I came across an agent of the Agent Cartel, Ellar Stin. She told me that the Cartel is looking for more pod pilots to help them out with the “battles” down in Curse. If I'm interested, she can arrange a meeting with one of her associates down there.
messages.zh: 我在克挪腊的时候遇到了天使集团一位名叫“额拉尔·斯丁”的代理人。她告诉该集团正在召集克隆飞行员以便援助正在柯尔斯进行的“战斗”。如果我感兴趣，她可以安排让其同僚与我会面。

messages.en: Good then, here's the details.
messages.zh: 很好，现在让我来跟你细讲。

messages.en:
Stin's the name, or at least, it's the one I'm using for this operation. I'm here to recruit some fresh blood for the battles in Curse. Seems you lot have started to wander off right when we need capsuleers the most.

If you're interested, I can hook you up with Abdiel Verat. She's the primary point of contact for capsuleers in Curse.
messages.zh:
斯丁是我的名字，或者说至少在这次行动中，这就是我的名字。柯尔斯星域里纷争不断，我是来为此召集新鲜血液的。巧的是，就在我们最需要克隆飞行员的时候，你来了。

如果你有兴趣，我会让你与阿布戴尔·瓦拉特会面。她是柯尔斯星域里，克隆飞行员的主要联系对象。

messages.en: Whatever.
messages.zh: 无所谓。

messages.en:
This is a high-level stealth operation that will send you to nullsec. It is strongly recommended that you use an interceptor to move about freely in the depths of 0.0 space and complete these missions.

The journey into nullsec is a dangerous one. You should only accept the assignment if you are prepared to encounter (and evade) high-risk situations such as interdiction bubble camps and entire alliances wanting to kill you.
messages.zh:
这是项高级隐秘行动，你会前往0.0区域。我们强烈建议你驾驶一艘截击舰执行该任务。

0.0区域里非常危险。只有当你做好面对拦截泡及遭受联盟围追堵截这类险境的时候，你才应该接受这项任务。

messages.en: WARNING!
messages.zh: 警告！

messages.en:
Welcome to my humble little shop, pilot!

Ah... sorry, the identifier system was lagging, an' I didn't see you were an egger, heh.

Stin's the name, or at least, it's the one I'm using for this operation. I'm here to recruit some fresh blood for the battles in Curse. Seems you lot have started to wander off right when we need capsuleers the most.

If you're interested, I can hook you up with Abdiel Verat. She's the primary point of contact for capsuleers in Curse.
messages.zh:
欢迎光顾我的小店，飞行员！

噢……不好意思，这识别系统有点慢，我没看清楚你原来是名克隆飞行员，呵呵。

斯丁是我的名字，或者说至少在这次行动中，这就是我的名字。柯尔斯星域里纷争不断，我是来为此召集新鲜血液的。巧的是，就在我们最需要克隆飞行员的时候，你来了。

如果你有兴趣，我会让你与阿布戴尔·瓦拉特会面。她是柯尔斯星域里，克隆飞行员的主要联系对象。

messages.en: Whatever.
messages.zh: 无所谓。

messages.en: Yes?
messages.zh: 什么事？

messages.en:
While I was in Egbinger, I came across a shipyard that was repairing some Republic Fleet vessels. One of the staff there, Aton Hordner, relayed a story about the Angel Cartel's woes in Curse. Apparently they're being slaughtered from two sides by Guristas and the Sansha.

Hordner is concerned about the balance of power there, and asked that I find some way to ensure the Cartel's continued dominance over Curse. His rationale is that the Angels make for better enemies than Guristas thugs and Sansha “zombies.” It's hard to find fault with his reasoning.

I've been given the name of a Cartel agent that the RSS repair crew pilfered from one of the ship's comms system. Abdiel Verat is her name, and I'll find her deep inside the Curse region.
messages.zh:
我在伊格贝格尔见到一座船坞，里面有人在修复共和舰队的舰船。其中一名叫艾通·霍德的员工向我讲述了天使集团在柯尔斯遇到的麻烦。天使他们好像正在遭受来自古斯塔斯与萨沙的两面夹击。

出于对势力均衡的考虑，霍德问我是否能出手相助，确保天使在柯尔斯的龙头地位。霍德的理由是比起古斯塔斯流氓与萨沙“僵尸”，天使相对来说还是个更让人“赏心悦目”的对手。他说的或许真的没错。

共和安全局偷看了那些停靠着的舰船中的通讯记录，看到了天使集团其中一位代理人的名字。他们把那人的姓名透露了给我，她叫阿布戴尔·瓦拉特，我要深入柯尔斯星域才能找到她。

messages.en:
While I was in Egbinger, I came across a shipyard that was repairing some Republic Fleet vessels. One of the staff there, Aton Hordner, relayed a story about the Angel Cartel's woes in Curse. Apparently they're being slaughtered from two sides by Guristas and Sansha.

Hordner is concerned about the balance of power there, and asked that I find some way to ensure the Cartel's continued dominance over Curse. His rationale is that the Angels make for better enemies than Guristas thugs and Sansha “zombies.” It's hard to find fault with his reasoning.

messages.en: Alright, good luck out there.
messages.zh: 好，祝你好运。

messages.en:
Hey man.

If you're out here in a shithole like Egbinger then maybe there's a chance you can help me out with something. We just had a bunch of Republic Fleet guys dock up and repair here. They'd been out in Curse dealing with some Angel Cartel raiders.

They were describing how the Cartel is having trouble right now with some other pirate groups. Seems there's a Guristas commander tearing them a new hole down there, as well as some Sansha meandering about causing problems. From the sounds of it, they're taking some significant losses too.

Anyways, I was hoping you could fly down and check it out. While the Fleet were docked up, I had my boys go over their comms system. We've got ourselves the name of a Cartel agent who is involved in dealing with the invasion. Abdiel Verat. It may sound strange to hear it, {[character]player.name}, but if you can find some way to deal with those Guristas and Sansha, I'd be thankful. The Cartel may give us grief, but they've done good things for the Minmatar people too, even if nobody has a damn clue why, or what's in it for them. All I know is that I'd prefer Cartel members to Guristas thugs and Sansha freaks. If you can, go and deal with their problems. Just don't go helping them too much, got it?
messages.zh:
嘿，你好。

如果你在伊格贝格尔待地不开心的话，你可以帮我点忙。我们这里刚来了一批共和舰队的人停靠修整。他们在柯尔斯对付一批天使的人。

据他们声称，天使集团最近与其他一些海盗组织在闹矛盾。好像古斯塔斯有个指挥官在其中闹事，还有萨沙也在其中煽风点火。天使集团为此也是损失惨重。

我要去你亲自前往那里去瞧瞧。共和舰队那帮人把船停靠在这里的时候，我让我手下一些人偷偷看了下他们船里的通讯记录，了解到负责处理此事的一位天使的代理人。她名叫阿布戴尔·瓦拉特。虽然这听起来奇怪，但如果你有办法去对付古斯塔斯与萨沙，那我会很感激你的，{[character]player.name}。虽然天使集团给我们惹了不少麻烦，但他们也为我们做了很多好事。很多米玛塔尔人根本就没意识到这点。

总之，比起古斯塔斯流氓与萨沙疯子，我更能容忍天使。如果没问题的话，就请出手替天使解决他们的问题吧。但不要对他们殷勤过头了，懂了吗？

messages.en: Fair enough.
messages.zh: 好吧好吧。

messages.en:
This is a high-level stealth operation that will send you to nullsec. It is strongly recommended that you use an interceptor to move about freely in the depths of 0.0 space and complete these missions.

The journey into nullsec is a dangerous one. You should only accept the assignment if you are prepared to encounter (and evade) high-risk situations such as interdiction bubble camps and entire alliances wanting to kill you.

The Republic Security Service is in no way liable for any assets or personnel lost as a result of accepting this assignment.
