messages.en: Fair enough.
messages.zh: 好吧好吧。

messages.en: Get going, {[character]player.name}. Don't forget an interceptor; chances are you'll need one.
messages.zh: 快动身，{[character]player.name}。别忘了驾驶一艘截击舰过去，你很有可能要用到它。

messages.en: Utopia
messages.zh: 乌托邦

messages.en: Naturally, I decided to take down the Sansha and clear the wormhole for the Cartel. I'd taken down bigger threats before. Abdiel told me that I needed to take out their Overseer, since without him, the rest of the Nation ships would be without clear direction. It took a little doing, the Overseer didn't want to stick his neck out just for one little capsuleer. But after I took down plenty of his men, he had no choice. He was tougher than I expected, but went down eventually nonetheless.
messages.zh: 当然喽，我决定铲除萨沙，为天使扫清虫洞里的障碍。我以前还清除掉过更巨大的威胁。阿布戴尔告诉我如果少了监察官，那剩下的跟班们就群龙无首了，因此我必须解决掉那监察官。这次行动花了点时间，毕竟监察官不会就为我这一位克隆飞行员抛头露面的。但当我消灭掉其众多手下之后，他别无选择，只得出面迎战。他比我想象的要强，但最终还是倒在了我的炮火之下。

messages.en: I decided to take down the Sansha and clear the wormhole for the Cartel. Abdiel told me that I needed to take out their Overseer, since without him, the rest of the Nation ships would be without clear direction.
messages.zh: 我决定铲除萨沙，为天使扫清虫洞里的障碍。阿布戴尔告诉我如果少了监察官，那剩下的跟班们就群龙无首了，因此我必须解决掉那监察官。

messages.en:
Alright, you want to pursue the Sansha? That works for me.

Once you've dealt with them report back to me. I'll keep my comms link open.
messages.zh:
好的，你想要追击萨沙？我没有问题。

把他们解决之后就回来向我汇报。我会保持信道畅通。

messages.en: Dislodging the Sansha won't be easy after they've already begun to settle themselves in, but we can focus on their weak points. If they're doing things by the book, the Sansha forces will have an Overseer there directing the group from a safe distance. Take out enough of the fodder vessels and you'll provoke its appearance. Once you destroy the Overseer their whole operation will fall apart. Think of it as a decapitation.
messages.zh: 在萨沙安居之后试图将他们撵走绝非易事，不过我们可以攻击其弱点。如果他们这次还是按教条做事情的话，那支舰队会由一位监察官隔着一定距离带领着一批舰船组成。尽量多消灭点跟班的那些船，这样监察官就会现身。只要监察官一死，他们就群龙无首了。就把这当作是斩首行动吧。

messages.en:
Nice flying, {[character]player.name}. I'll be sure to include your name in the report.

I'm ordering our exploration team to go in right now. They'll see if it links up to any systems near Fountain.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。我肯定会在报告中提及你的。

我现在派一只探险队前往那儿，让他们探察一下那虫洞是否与源泉之域附近的任何一个星系相连。

messages.en: You've wasted enough of my time then.
messages.zh: 那你真是浪费了我好多时间。

messages.en: Obviously, the Sansha need to be cleared from our wormhole site. If you can prove yourself on this, chances are I'll be able to request more assignments to give you. We have early reports of more problems abroad, so I'm sure we can keep you moving from target to target out there.
messages.zh: 很显然这帮萨沙必须要从属于我们的虫洞地点给清除掉。如果你能够成功，或许我还能够为你争取到更多的事情做。我们还有很多问题需要解决，所以我肯定能让你忙个不停的。

messages.en: You've wasted enough of my time then.
messages.zh: 那你真是浪费了我好多时间。

messages.en: Damn Sansha freaks...
messages.zh: 该死的萨沙疯子……

name.ja: サーペンティスの代理

messages.en: Heaven
messages.zh: 天堂

messages.en: I chose to aid Abdiel by delivering sensitive research data to the Serpentis myself. I managed to deliver the cargo without incident. The Cartel used a proprietary fullerene-based sealant on the cargo. They went to a lot of effort to keep the contents private.
messages.zh: 我选择帮助阿布戴尔把敏感的研究数据亲自运送到天蛇集团那里。我成功地完成了货物递送。联合企业在货柜上使用了一种特种富勒烯密封材料，他们花了大力气来保证这些货物的私密性。

messages.en: I chose to aid Abdiel by delivering sensitive research data to the Serpentis myself.
messages.zh: 我选择帮助阿布戴尔把敏感的研究数据亲自运送到天蛇集团那里。

messages.en: There's a high-priority shipment that has been sitting around waiting for someone capable enough to move it. It's headed to the Serpentis research facilities in Fountain, but Sarpati's crew is going to handle moving it from Curse over to their Headquarters. All you need to do is get it to nearby Serpentis Corp. transport hub, from there they'll handle the rest.
messages.zh: 我们这里有一个重要货柜正在等待有能力的人来承运。它的目的地是源泉之域的天蛇研究设施，萨巴蒂的队伍本来要负责将它从柯尔斯星域运送到他们的总部。你所要做的就是把它运送到附近的一个天蛇集团驻地，那里是一个运输中心，他们会接手剩下的事情。

messages.en: Serpentis acknowledged receipt of the goods, but they've asked for our help in another matter. That research team that you just filled in for is missing for a good reason, it seems.
messages.zh: 天蛇已经确认货物接收了。另外他们想让我们再帮他们一个忙。看来，被你所取代来送货的那个研究队一定是遇到了什么事情才失踪的。

messages.en: Then you are useless to me, goodbye.
messages.zh: 这样的话你对于我就没有任何用处了，再见。

messages.en:
The partnership between the Angel Cartel and the Serpentis is a perfect match. The Cartel has all the things the Serpentis lack: massive manpower, a gigantic network of dealers and thugs, a cold vicious enthusiasm for crime, and the organizational skills needed to help spread the Serpentis supply of boosters to new markets. Without the Cartel, the Serpentis would never have expanded to become as powerful and pervasive as it is today, and many say, the reverse is also true.

Despite all the success the partnership has brought the Serpentis, it may be the Cartel who got the better end of the bargain. Not only do the Serpentis supply the Cartel with the most-addictive and highest quality boosters in the cluster, they also provide unparalleled research. The Cartel has long had access to dozens of ancient Jovian ruins, but previously lacked the expertise to truly take advantage of them. The Serpentis changed all that, and many think the Cartel's latest ship designs – and many other secret breakthroughs – come straight from Serpentis minds.
messages.zh:
天使联合企业和天蛇集团之间的合作真是太完美了。联合企业拥有天蛇集团缺乏的一切资源：人力，庞大的增效剂分销和货物网络，邪恶气愤，还有组织管理的技巧，它将能有助于把天蛇的增效剂推销到新的市场上去。如果没有联合企业的帮助，天蛇永远无法成为一个像今天一样强大的组织，也很有很多说这样的提携对于天使联合企业来说也是具有同样效果的。

除开合作为天蛇所带来的这么多优势不谈，联合企业可能才是这桩交易中的真正受益人。不光光是这么久以来天蛇集团一直向联合企业提供数量巨大的高质量增效剂，他们同时也提供了不可比拟的研发团队。联合企业很早之前就发现了多个古代朱庇特的遗迹，但是苦于没有向天蛇集团一样专业的队伍来进行开发而始终没有任何进展。天蛇集团的参与改变了这些状况，更有很多人认为，联合企业最新的舰船设计以及很多其他的秘密技术突破都是从与天蛇集团的合作中获益的。

messages.en: Bedfellows
messages.zh: 同床异梦

messages.en:
Perhaps it's not worth the trouble to take down the Sansha encampment. They might have already gone in and destabilized the wormhole. We play by risk and reward, and the reward here looks like it'll be too low.

There's a high-priority shipment that has been sitting around waiting for someone capable enough to move it. It's headed to the Serpentis research facilities in Fountain, but Sarpati's crew is going to handle moving it from Curse over to their Headquarters. They were supposed to take it directly from this station but we've lost contact with the research team in charge of that operation. The job is yours if you want it. All you need to do is get it to nearby Serpentis Corp. transport hub, from there they'll handle the rest.

The cargo is small so you could easily fit it inside an interceptor or covert ops and I would suggest you do just that, {[character]player.name}. I will not accept any excuses for the cargo's disappearance.
messages.zh:
没有必要费功夫去清除萨沙的营地。他们可能已经进入了虫洞并造成了虫洞的不稳定状态。从风险回报的角度来看，这里的回报未免也太小了。

我们这里有一个重要货柜正在等待有能力的人来承运。它的目的地是源泉之域的天蛇研究设施，萨巴蒂的队伍本来要负责将它从柯尔斯星域运送到他们的总部。他们本来应该直接从这个空间站将它取走的，但是我们和负责这次运送的团队失去了联系。如果你愿意的话，你可以去运送这个货物。你所要做的就是把它运送到附近的一个天蛇集团驻地，一个运输中心，他们会接手剩下的事情。

货柜很小，所以你应该能够轻松地把它放到一艘截击舰或者隐形特勤舰的货柜舱里，你最好就按照我的建议做， {[character]player.name}。如果你把货物给弄丢了，我可不会接受任何的借口。

messages.en: A foolish move, {[character]player.name}. Your failure will be noted in our records.
messages.zh: 真是愚蠢的一步棋，{[character]player.name}。你的失败将会被记录在案。

messages.en: You have a delivery to make. Get to it.
messages.zh: 你有一个运送任务，快执行吧。

name.ru: Вылет на помощь (Ride to the Rescue)

messages.en: The Guristas raided a Serpentis research facility, decimating the Guardian Angel security force. The Cartel asked that I step in and put an end to the siege. I destroyed most of the Guristas, but a few warped off. Their commander was a capsuleer named Yukiro Demense. Verat has a plan to deal with him.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯攻击了天蛇集团的一座研究设施，消灭了在那里的守护天使安全部队。联合企业要求我去结束攻击事件。我消灭了大部分的古斯塔斯，但是有一小部分跃迁逃离了。他们的指挥官是一个叫做尤基利·戴蒙的克隆飞行员。瓦拉特已经有了对付他的计划。

messages.en: The Guristas are making trouble for the Serpentis, raiding one of their research facilities and decimating the Guardian Angel security force there. With no one else in the area who can handle the threat, the Cartel has asked me to step in and put an end to it.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯正在给天蛇集团制造麻烦，他们攻击了一个研究设施，把在那儿的守护天使安全部队给消灭了。由于在这个区域没有适合的人手去处理这个危机，天使联合企业要求我去了结这个事情。

messages.en: Good. I want you to send a clear message, {[character]player.name}. Let nobody survive.
messages.zh: 很好。我要你为我清晰地传达一个信息， {[character]player.name}。不要心慈手软。

messages.en:
I just discovered why that research team never arrived to pick up the goods you ferried: their labs are under siege by Guristas forces. I don't know what the hell the Guristas think they're going to achieve down here, but if we don't quickly shut them down we risk them gaining a foothold.

This attack was fierce and well-coordinated. They managed to overwhelm our defenses. All of our other forces are either too far away to assist or on other important missions they can't be diverted from. You're our best shot. I want you to save that research station from the Guristas assault.
messages.zh:
我刚刚知道为什么那个研究团队没能够抵达这里来取你运送的那个货物：他们的实验室被古斯塔斯的部队给封锁了。我不知道这些古斯塔斯能够在那种鬼地方得到什么，他们以为自己能得到什么么？但是如果我们不赶紧把他们搞掉的话，很可能他们就会得到一个新的落脚点，这对我们是一个威胁。

这次进攻是精心策划的一次猛烈进攻，他们想要以压制性的优势打垮我们的防线。我们其他的部队要么是太远，要么就是被派去执行别的重要任务了。你现在是我们最大的希望，我要你去拯救那座空间站，避免它遭受古斯塔斯的打击。

messages.en: Good work clearing off the remainders, but this “Demense” issue will have to be dealt with. Open comms with me again when you're ready to see to that.
messages.zh: 你把那些残余的敌人都消灭了，真是干得漂亮，但是这个“戴蒙”的问题依然需要被解决。等你准备好接受新的任务就和我进行联络。

messages.en: Then you're useless to us. Goodbye.
messages.zh: 那你对我们已经没有用处了。再见。

messages.en:
The Angel Cartel and Guristas have a lot in common on the surface. Both seem to be the classical thugs, engaging in all the brutish activities attributed to base criminals. But while the two do have some overlapping interests, their methods and core desires are different.

The Angel Cartel is closer to a criminal mafia, dedicated to pushing drugs, running protection rackets, taking out assassination contracts, and involving themselves in all manner of nefarious research projects. The Guristas, however, are opportunistic pirates. They prowl the space lanes and hit any target that looks half-valuable or vulnerable. They loot and plunder what they can, ransom off the valuable survivors, and then hit the bars to celebrate.

The Cartel sees the Guristas as chaotic malcontents, disrupting trade, causing economic difficulties, and generally making it more difficult for them to ply their illicit trades. The Guristas see the Cartel as dishonorable brutes, skulking in the darkness and using trickery and deception to dull the minds and sensibilities of their clients.
messages.zh:
从表面上来看，天使联合企业和古斯塔斯之间有很多的共同处。他们两个都具有典型的暴力社团性质，涉足各种暴力活动同时也渗透到底层的犯罪行为中。不过，即便是两者的兴趣爱好在很大程度上有一定的交集，但他们的手法以及核心的需求却是不一样的。

天使联合企业的形式更像是一个犯罪组织，犯罪，敲诈以及勒索，承接间谍业务，参与各种邪恶的研究计划。而作为古斯塔斯，则更加倾向于机会主义的海盗团体。他们游荡于宇宙的各个角落，寻找那些看上去值点价钱或者脆弱的目标。他们抢掠所有他们能够抢掠的对象，对有价值的幸存者进行敲诈勒索，然后再酒池肉林地庆贺自己的功劳。

对于天使联合企业来说，古斯塔斯充其量就是一帮混乱的杂碎，他们扰乱贸易，制造经济问题，甚至都已经影响到联合企业的非法贸易的正常进行。在古斯塔斯眼里，天使联合企业则是一帮手段卑鄙不讲信用的暴徒，潜伏在黑暗之中用各种坑蒙拐骗的手段来迷惑和愚化他们的客户。

messages.en: Gang War
messages.zh: 打群架

messages.en:
I just discovered why that research team never arrived to pick up the goods you ferried: their labs are under siege by Guristas forces. I don't know what the hell the Guristas think they're going to achieve down here, but if we don't quickly shut them down we risk them gaining a foothold.

This attack was fierce and well-coordinated. They managed to overwhelm our defenses. All of our other forces are either too far away to assist or on other important missions they can't be diverted from. You're our best shot. I want you to save that research station from the Guristas assault.
messages.zh:
我刚刚知道为什么那个研究团队没能够抵达这里来取你运送的那个货物：他们的实验室被古斯塔斯的部队给封锁了。我不知道这些古斯塔斯能够在那种鬼地方得到什么，他们以为自己能得到什么么？但是如果我们不赶紧把他们搞掉的话，很可能他们就会得到一个新的落脚点，这对我们是一个威胁。

这次进攻是精心策划的一次猛烈进攻，他们想要以压制性的优势打垮我们的防线。我们其他的部队要么是太远，要么就是被派去执行别的重要任务了。你现在是我们最大的希望，我要你去拯救那座空间站，避免它遭受古斯塔斯的打击。

messages.en: Then you're useless to us. Goodbye.
messages.zh: 那你对我们已经没有用处了。再见。

messages.en: Move out!
messages.zh: 出击吧！

messages.en: Abdiel received word that the Guristas have assaulted a convoy from Fountain containing recent research data. When I arrived at the scene the Angel ship was already destroyed. I destroyed every one of the Guristas ships. The Angels sent a recovery team when all the hard work was done.
messages.zh: 阿布戴尔得到情报说古斯塔斯袭击了一支来自源泉之域、载有最新研究数据的运输队。我抵达现场之后，天使的船已经全被歼灭了。我把古斯塔斯打了个片甲不留。之后天使派出了一支营救队。

messages.en: Abdiel received word that the Guristas have assaulted a convoy from Fountain containing recent research data. I am to drive off the Guristas attackers until the recovery team can arrive.
messages.zh: 阿布戴尔得到情报说古斯塔斯袭击了一支来自源泉之域、载有最新研究数据的运输队。我的任务是在营救队抵达现场之前把那群古斯塔斯人赶走。

messages.en: The Guristas are a tough bunch. They won't scatter if you pop the leader the way Sansha do. You're going to have to kill every one of the bunnies.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯是帮硬骨头。他们不会像萨沙一样，你把他们的头儿干掉，他们就会鸟兽散。你必须把古斯塔斯每个人都干掉才行。

messages.en:
Getting a report that one of our shipments coming back from Fountain just got hit by Guristas. It's always something.

There's a salvage crew nearby that can pick up the tech, but they aren't equipped to handle Guristas. If you clear out the Guristas, I can send in the recovery team. As always you'll be well paid.
messages.zh:
我得到一个情报说我们一个来自源泉之域的运输队遭古斯塔斯人偷袭。真是没有一刻太平的。

那附近有个打捞队可以拾取掉落物品，但他们无法对付古斯塔斯。如你把古斯塔斯除掉，那我就能派打捞队过去了，当然像以往一样，你的报酬不会低的。

messages.en: You're proving yourself to be a valuable asset to the Angel Cartel.
messages.zh: 你向天使证明了自己是有用之才。

messages.en: Sounds too tough, does it? Run along now. Find something more your speed.
messages.zh: 你觉得这事太难了，真的吗？走吧走吧，去找一份适合自己的活干去。

messages.en:
The Jove left Curse behind long ago. Their ruins in the form of stations and forgotten outposts. Centuries later the Angel Cartel moved.

The Angels have managed to scavenge a good deal of information from these Jovian relics. This is most obviously reflected in Angel ships, which bear striking designs and unique capabilities. But the Cartel has yet to understand more than a fraction of the old Jovian technologies. Even the Serpentis, whose research capabilities surpass the Cartel's by leaps and bounds, have great difficulty even understanding the principles of Jovian engineering.
messages.zh:
朱庇特很久很久以前就离开了柯尔斯。他们留下了早已被人忘却的空间站与哨站。数百年之后，天使集团驻扎了进来。

通过分析朱庇特留下的遗物，天使集团获得了大量信息。这点在天使的舰船上最容易看出来，他们的舰船总是有出人意料的设计，并且配备独特的性能。但天使至今也只是学到了冰山一角而已。即使是研究能力超过天使数倍的天蛇集团，也很难理解朱庇特技术的核心原理。

messages.en: Relics of Past Greatness
messages.zh: 远古文明的遗物

messages.en:
Okay, the exploration team is away. If the Serpentis eggheads are right, they should arrive in Fountain securely and in record time.

Speak of the devil. I'm getting a report that one of our shipments coming back from Fountain just got hit by Guristas. It's always something.

There's a salvage crew nearby that can pick up the tech, but they aren't equipped to handle Guristas. If you clear out the Guristas, I can send in the recovery team. As always you'll be well paid.
messages.zh:
OK，探险队伍已经走了。如果那群天蛇白痴是正确的话，那他们应该安全准时抵达源泉之域。

说到恶人，我得到一个情报说我们一个来自源泉之域的运输队遭古斯塔斯人偷袭。真是没有一刻太平的。

那附近有个打捞队可以拾取掉落物品，但他们无法对付古斯塔斯。如你把古斯塔斯除掉，那我就能派打捞队过去了，当然像以往一样，你的报酬不会低的。

messages.en: If I can't trust you to do a simply cleaning op, what use are you?
messages.zh: 如果连一件简单的清理任务你都不能完成，那你还有什么用？

messages.en: How's the mission going?
messages.zh: 任务进行的怎么样?

messages.en: A troublesome capsuleer named Renton returned from W-space with a stockpile of Sleeper relics. Abdiel sent me to find his base eliminate him. The base was sparsely defended, so taking care of the inhabitations was easy enough.
messages.zh: 一个叫做雷腾的克隆飞行员最近从虫洞里带回了一堆冬眠者的古代人造物品。阿布戴尔想让我找人去他的基地把他干掉。那儿的防御并不强，所以这应该是一项简单的任务。

messages.en: A troublesome capsuleer named Renton has recently returned from W-space with a stockpile of Sleeper relics. Abdiel wants me to find his base and eliminate him so that the Cartel can claim his cache.
messages.zh: 一个叫做雷腾的克隆飞行员最近从虫洞里带回了一堆冬眠者的古代人造物品。阿布戴尔想让我找人去他的基地把他干掉，这样天使联合企业就能够夺走那些东西。

messages.en: Renton's base is poorly defended by most corporation standards. Kill everyone you see.
messages.zh: 雷腾的基地防守非常薄弱，消灭你见到的所有人。

messages.en:
Our biggest competition in the Tech III race is not the Guristas or the Sansha. Hell, it's not even the empires. It's your kind. Capsuleers. I'll admit you guys have been giving us a run for our money. You're uniquely suited to wormhole space. Thankfully a few of you have been less than careful in normal space.

There's a capsuleer named Renton that makes his home nearby. We know he's been exploring wormhole space, and he's likely been stockpiling Sleeper tech at this base. He's only been a minor nuisance so far, but his tech cache could be useful. Find Renton's base. It's poorly defended by most corporation standards. Kill everyone you see. I'll be able to send an another recovery team once you've secured the area.
messages.zh:
在三级科技方面，我们最大的竞争对手不是古斯塔斯也不是萨沙，该死，那甚至不是帝国区的任何国家。我们最大的竞争对手实际上就是你们这些人，你们这些克隆飞行员。我要承认是你们让我们的钱包鼓了起来，但你们才是唯一适合于虫洞旅行的人。庆幸的是，你们中的一些人在自然空间里却不是那么小心翼翼了。

有一个叫雷腾的克隆飞行员，就居住在附近。我们知道他一直在探索虫洞空间，而且还在他的巢穴里堆积了大量的冬眠者物件。他本人目前倒还不是个大问题，但是他的那些货物却非常的有用。找到雷腾的基地，那儿的防御力量相较其他军团企业来说要低得多。歼灭你在那儿找到的所有人，然后我会派遣另外一支队伍去那儿搬东西。

messages.en: Excellent work. I'll have my men sort through Renton's haul. There's a lesson in there about complacency for you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，我会叫我的人去整理雷腾的物品。 {[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Then stop wasting my time.
messages.zh: 这样的话就别再浪费我的时间了。

messages.en:
Although there are many theories, few know what happened to the Sleepers. Their ruins were already old when the Amarr reached space.

For most, the Sleepers were little more than a curiosity; an ancient civilization lost and forgotten. Then wormholes opened across the cluster. Explorers that ventured into the strange space beyond were met with highly-advanced drones protecting relics that we now know once belonged to the Sleepers. Apart from the drones themselves, the only structures found are lifeless ruins. But the Sleeper drones themselves function all too well, despite what must be centuries of neglect.
messages.zh:
尽管有很多的说法，但只有很少人知道冬眠者到底发生了什么。他们的遗迹在艾玛人重新回到太空的时候就已经是年代久远的废墟了。

对于大多数人而言，冬眠者最多只是一个茶余饭后的闲话而已，一个被人遗忘许久的失落文明。后来，虫洞出现在宇宙的各处，探险家们穿过它们找到了那些被超先进技术无人机所守护的遗迹，这些遗迹曾经是属于冬眠者的。除了那些无人机之外，所找到的东西全都已经是没有生命迹象的废墟了。但是，这些无人机还完好如初地正常工作着，即便是被遗忘了数个世纪之久。

messages.en: The Sleeper Civilization
messages.zh: 冬眠者文明

messages.en:
Our biggest competition in the Tech III race is not the Guristas or the Sansha. Hell, it's not even the empires. It's your kind. Capsuleers. I'll admit you guys have been giving us a run for our money. You're uniquely suited to wormhole space. Thankfully a few of you have been less than careful in normal space.

There's a capsuleer named Renton that makes his home nearby. We know he's been exploring wormhole space, and he's likely been stockpiling Sleeper tech at this base. He's only been a minor nuisance so far, but his tech cache could be useful. We would do the raid ourselves, but it's more effective to have capsuleers take care of each other, much less bloodshed.

Find Renton's base. Eliminate him. I'll be able to send an another recovery team once you've wiped out all hostiles.
messages.zh:
在三级科技方面，我们最大的竞争对手不是古斯塔斯也不是萨沙，该死，那甚至不是帝国区的任何国家。我们最大的竞争对手实际上就是你们这些人，你们这些克隆飞行员。我要承认是你们让我们的钱包鼓了起来，但你们才是唯一适合于虫洞旅行的人。庆幸的是，你们中的一些人在自然空间里却不是那么小心翼翼了。

有一个叫雷腾的克隆飞行员，就居住在附近。我们知道他一直在探索虫洞空间，而且还在他的巢穴里堆积了大量的冬眠者物件。他本人目前倒还不是个大问题，但是他的那些货物却非常的有用。我们可以自己来完成这次攻击行动，但是如果有你去先解决掉那里的守军的话，我想就可以避免更大量的流血事件了。

找到雷腾的基地，歼灭他，然后我会派遣另外一支队伍去那儿搬东西。

messages.en: Then stop wasting my time.
messages.zh: 这样的话就别再浪费我的时间了。

name.es: La venganza es un plato que se sirve frío
name.ru: Лучший вид мести (The Best Kind of Revenge)

messages.en: The Guristas commander, Yukiro Demense, had a clone contract with a small cloning facility nearby. My slaughter of the staff there has sent a warning to other companies operating under the Cartel's protection in Curse. With the area cleared, I uploaded a virus engineered by Serpentis Inquest scientists. Demense's local clone is now compromised.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯的指挥官尤基利·戴蒙同附近的一座小型的克隆服务商签订了克隆协议。我把这个公司所有的人都干掉了，这是给所有柯尔斯星域里在联合企业庇护下干着这种买卖的公司的一次警告。这个区域被清理干净过后，我上传了一个由天蛇集团调查处特别制作的病毒到他们的数据中心里。戴蒙的克隆体现在已经被破坏了。

messages.en: The Guristas commander, Yukiro Demense, has a clone contract with a small facility nearby. Verat wants the staff at the facility killed for letting Demense establish himself down here. Their deaths will send a message to other companies operating under the Cartel's protection in Curse. Once I have cleared the area, I am to upload a virus to their central database.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯的指挥官尤基利·戴蒙同附近的一座小型的克隆服务商签订了克隆协议。瓦拉特要求我把这个公司所有的人都干掉，这是给所有柯尔斯星域里在联合企业庇护下干着这种买卖的公司的一次警告。在清理干净这个区域后，我需要上传了一个由天蛇集团调查处特别制作的病毒到他们的数据中心里。

messages.en: I'm uploading the data to your Fluid Router now. Good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我正在把数据上传到你的高效路由器里。祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Yukiro Demense is a capsuleer. With all those clones, he'll be a tough one to break, but we have plenty of experience when it comes to dealing with this sort of problem. Our friends over at Serpentis Inquest were also more than willing to offer their expertise on this matter after the Guristas attacked their research facility. This Demense punk just made some very powerful enemies.

You'll be travelling to a local black market cloning facility, one that we've been happy to ignore until now. The facility administrator took a heavy bribe from Demense to allow one of his clones access, and so of course, they had their license and all good standings with us permanently revoked. Intelligence indicates that Demense is reliant on this facility to support his raids. With a clone backup available locally, he has been able to return to the fight without re-cloning in Venal up north.

Your first task is to storm this facility and make an example of the people there. Let nobody survive; their deaths must send a message across Curse. Once you have dealt with this indiscretion, you need to deliver a special data payload into their central database hub. As soon as you approach the hub, the data will auto-transmit a special virus engineered by our Inquest friends.

Do this and report back to me. I will have further instructions for you at that point.
messages.zh:
尤基利·戴蒙是一个克隆飞行员。他有很多的克隆体可以重新激活，这让他变得非常难以对付，但是我们在面对这样的问题的时候也可以说是非常的有经验了。在古斯塔斯攻击了天蛇集团调查处的研究设施过后，天蛇集团调查处也非常愿意抽调他们的专业人士前来协助我们。这个愚昧的戴蒙还真是结交了很多有来头的敌人。

你将要前往一个当地的地下克隆设施，这之前我们都没有去关心过那里。这座设施的管理员看来是受了戴蒙不少的贿赂，竟然让他在里面插入了一个自己克隆体，当然，从此以后他们从我们这里得到的所有执照和友好关系都将化为乌有。有情报显示戴蒙正是靠着这座克隆设施来支持他的袭击活动的。有了一个就在当地的克隆作为后备，他就可以直接就近从克隆设施里回到战场而不需要克隆回到北方遥远的维纳尔星域。

你要做的第一件事情就是强袭他们的克隆设施，这也算是敲山震虎。把他们全部干掉，他们的下场将会传遍柯尔斯星域。等你完成了这些事情后，你还需要把一份特殊的数据载荷上传到他们的中央数据中心里。一旦你靠近那座数据中心，数据传输将会自动开始，它将会把一个由天蛇集团调查处特殊编译的病毒上传进去。

完成任务后就回来像我报到。到时我会继续给你下一步指示。

messages.en:
You've done well. The traitorous administrator and his peons were justly removed from the picture and Demense's local clone is now compromised.

The next step is getting him to reanimate into it.
messages.zh:
你做得很好，那个不知好歹的管理员以及他的马仔们都已经挂掉了。戴蒙在本地的克隆体也被破坏了。

下一步就是让他重生到这个被破坏的克隆体中。

messages.en: Then you are useless to me. Our business is concluded.
messages.zh: 那样的会你对我就没有任何用处了。我们的交易到此为止。

messages.en:
Hundreds of small companies exist in the fringes of space that cater to those who either can't afford or are banned from the big-name cloning companies. Naturally, there is a much greater risk with these organizations. No regulations means there are no guarantees of revival, and there are many stories of capsuleers waking up in distant backup cloning facilities after their local clone never activated. For most capsuleers this represents only a minor inconvenience, since very few are foolish enough to place their lives in the hands of questionable company.

For those criminals who can pay, the clones are nearly as safe as the Empire ones, a fact that has stymied efforts to curb the proliferation of capsuleer outlaws, and allowed them to move about the cluster with the freedom capsuleers are famous for.
messages.zh:
在宇宙边缘，存有数百个小型克隆公司。它们专为那些无力支付克隆费或者被大型克隆公司列入黑名单的人提供克隆服务。与这类公司打交道的风险自然很大。没有监管就没有保障。已经有多位克隆飞行员报道说自己被克隆到一个很远的后备克隆设施里，而本地的那个克隆体一直没被启用。对多数克隆飞行员而言，这只是个小麻烦。因为很少有人会蠢到将自己的性命交付给那些来路不明的公司手里。

而对那些有能力支付的罪犯而言，这些克隆的安全性不比帝国的差。这样一来，打击罪犯的努力也在很大程度上遭到了削弱。罪犯们几乎享有与克隆飞行员一样的自由行动能力。

messages.en: Black market clones
messages.zh: 地下克隆

messages.en:
Alright, you're ready to take care of this Guristas commander? Good.

Yukiro Demense is a capsuleer. With all those clones, he'll be a tough one to break, but we have plenty of experience when it comes to dealing with this sort of problem. Our friends over at Serpentis Inquest were also more than willing to offer their expertise on this matter after the Guristas attacked their research facility. This Demense punk just made some very powerful enemies.

You'll be travelling to a local black market cloning facility, one that we've been happy to ignore until now. The facility administrator took a heavy bribe from Demense to allow one of his clones access, and so of course, they had their license and all good standings with us permanently revoked. Intelligence indicates that Demense is reliant on this facility to support his raids. With a clone backup available locally, he has been able to return to the fight without re-cloning in Venal up north.

Your first task is to storm this facility and make an example of the people there. Let nobody survive; their deaths must send a message across Curse. Once you have dealt with this indiscretion, you need to deliver a special data payload into their central database hub. As soon as you approach the hub, the data will auto-transmit a special virus engineered by our Inquest friends.

Do this and report back to me. I will have further instructions for you at that point.
messages.zh:
你已经准备好要去收拾这个古斯塔斯指挥官了？很好。

尤基利·戴蒙是一个克隆飞行员。他有很多的克隆体可以重新激活，这让他变得非常难以对付，但是我们在面对这样的问题的时候也可以说是非常的有经验了。在古斯塔斯攻击了天蛇集团调查处的研究设施过后，天蛇集团调查处也非常愿意抽调他们的专业人士前来协助我们。这个愚昧的戴蒙还真是结交了很多有来头的敌人。

你将要前往一个当地的地下克隆设施，这之前我们都没有去关心过那里。这座设施的管理员看来是受了戴蒙不少的贿赂，竟然让他在里面插入了一个自己克隆体，当然，从此以后他们从我们这里得到的所有执照和友好关系都将化为乌有。有情报显示戴蒙正是靠着这座克隆设施来支持他的袭击活动的。有了一个就在当地的克隆作为后备，他就可以直接就近从克隆设施里回到战场而不需要克隆回到北方遥远的维纳尔星域。

你要做的第一件事情就是强袭他们的克隆设施，这也算是敲山震虎。把他们全部干掉，他们的下场将会传遍柯尔斯星域。等你完成了这些事情后，你还需要把一份特殊的数据载荷上传到他们的中央数据中心里。一旦你靠近那座数据中心，数据传输将会自动开始，它将会把一个由天蛇集团调查处特殊编译的病毒上传进去。

完成任务后就回来像我报到。到时我会继续给你下一步指示。

messages.en: Then you are useless to me. Our business is concluded.
messages.zh: 那样的会你对我就没有任何用处了。我们的交易到此为止。

messages.en: We're waiting, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我们正等着呢，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Yukiro Demense's clone was targeted for assassination by the Cartel. I carried out their will and brought its life to an end. Verat told me that the Inquest scientists confirmed his reanimation into the compromised clone. Verat remained coy about Yukiro's new fate, but trusted me enough to reveal that he has been infected with some kind of disease, one that will follow him from clone to clone.
messages.zh: 尤基利·戴蒙的克隆体已经被天使联合企业列为消灭对象了。我执行了他们的计划，把戴蒙的生命带向了尽头。瓦拉特告诉我调查处的技术人员已经确认他已经在被破坏的克隆体中复活了。瓦拉特现在对尤基利接下来的命运还不肯做出肯定的说法，但是相信我，他现在已经被某种病毒感染了,这种病毒会一直跟随着他，从一个克隆体到另一个克隆体，永远这样下去。

messages.en: Yukiro Demense's current clone has been targeted for assassination by the Cartel. I am to carry out their will and force his reanimation into a compromised clone.
messages.zh: 尤基利·戴蒙目前克隆体被天使联合企业列为了消灭的对象。我的任务就是执行他们的计划，然后再用暴力的手段让他回到那个被做了手脚的克隆体里。

messages.en: Be ready for a fight. Even the simplest of brutes can be competent fighters, and he likely won't go down so easily now he knows what you're capable of.
messages.zh: 准备好战斗吧，就算是最粗暴的残酷也能成为一个有挑战的战士，而他，绝对不是简简单单就会躺下的对手，况且现在他已经知道了你的能力。

messages.en:
Demense is still in Curse. I'd say his superiors have become aware that the hammer of a thousand Angels is about to come crashing down on him and are keeping the fool out here on “deployment."

Your task is to put the insolent little maggot down. Once he reanimates into that new clone, he'll be a non-issue. As I said before, {[character]player.name}, the man made some powerful enemies. We have chosen our friends wisely, and if you only knew what they were capable of doing to your clone, you'd understand why we want them on our side.

Go, kill him. If you succeed, perhaps I will share the true nature of Demense's fate with you.
messages.zh:
戴蒙依然还留在柯尔斯星域。我想他的上司已经知道有成千上万的天使战士就要把他们的拳头砸过来了，他们会重重地打在他身上，而那些蠢货却被派去外面执行什么“任务”。

你的任务就是去吧那个傲慢无礼的昆虫给消灭掉。一旦他被重生到那个新的克隆体内，他就会被完全废掉。正如我所说过的，{[character]player.name}，他结交了一些有权有势的敌人。而我们则在交友上显得格外谨慎，要是你知道他们能对你的克隆体做些什么手脚的话，我想你就能明白为什么我们会把他们拉到自己这一边来了。

去吧，干掉他。如果你成功了，或许我会把戴蒙遭受的命运的真正本质告诉你。

messages.en:
Serpentis Inquest just confirmed the reanimation of his local clone. You've done well, {[character]player.name}. Loyalty and a capacity to deliver results, these are both admirable qualities that will get you far within our organization.

You've caught the attention of my superiors, in fact. It seems they have a need for a capsuleer, and one who has already proven themselves trustworthy and capable. When you want the details for your new contact, I can pass them along.

Demense's fate? Let's just say that he has contracted a disease which is going to follow him from clone to clone. Eternity is not all it's cracked up to be.

Let me know when you're ready to move on.
messages.zh:
天蛇集团调查处刚刚确定了他在本地的克隆体已经被激活了。你干得非常漂亮，{[character]player.name}。忠诚和能力，这两个品质能够让你在我们的组织里步步高升的。

实际上，我的上司已经注意到你了。看上去他们现在正是需要一个克隆飞行员，特别是已经证明了自己的实用价值和可信度的克隆飞行员。当你需要新的联络人信息的时候，我会帮你传达的。

戴蒙的命运？只能说是他自己找来了一个病毒，这个病毒将会跟随着他从一个克隆到下一个克隆。这不光光是永恒的事情。

等你准备好了就告诉我吧。

messages.en: Then piss off and stop wasting my time.
messages.zh: 那就赶快滚蛋吧，别在这里浪费我的时间了。

messages.en:
Demense is still in Curse. I'd say his superiors have become aware that the hammer of a thousand Angels is about to come crashing down on him and are keeping the fool out here on “deployment."

Your task is to put the insolent little maggot down. Once he reanimates into that new clone, he'll be a non-issue. As I said before, {[character]player.name}, the man made some powerful enemies. We have chosen our friends wisely, and if you only knew what they were capable of doing to your clone, you'd understand why we want them on our side.

Go, kill him. If you succeed, perhaps I will share the true nature of Demense's fate with you.

去吧，干掉他。如果你成功了，或许我会把戴蒙遭受的命运的真正本质告诉你。

messages.en: Useless.
messages.zh: 没用。

messages.en: Move it, {[character]player.name}. You have your orders.
messages.zh: 动起来，{[character]player.name}。去完成使命吧。

messages.en: The research materials I helped secure have been transported up to Fountain. Before it left, Abdiel used it as bait to trap the Guristas. Waves of pirates poured through to take out the hauler, even a capsuleer named Yukiro Demense. I destroyed them all.
messages.zh: 我拿回来的研究材料已经准备好被运往源泉之域了。在它们被运走之前，阿布戴尔想将其用作鱼饵勾引古斯塔斯进圈套。古斯塔斯一又一波地派人前来妄图炸掉运输舰，甚至还派了一个名叫“尤基利·戴蒙波”的克隆飞行员。我把他们全部剿灭。

messages.en: The research materials I helped secure are ready for transport up to Fountain. Before it leaves, Abdiel wants to use it as bait to trap the Guristas. When the pirates warp in to attack the hauler, I'll be there to meet them.
messages.zh: 我拿回来的研究材料已经准备好被运往源泉之域了。在它们被运走之前，阿布戴尔想将其用作鱼饵勾引古斯塔斯进圈套。当那帮海盗跃迁袭击运输舰时，我会到场对付他们。

messages.en: Show those them how true professionals roll.
messages.zh: 让他们瞧瞧专业人士是怎么做事的。

messages.en:
All that's left to do is transport the tech you've helped us collect back up to Fountain. No, we're not asking you to haul. We've got a crew for that. Your job is more exciting.

We know there are Guristas still in the area, possibly with their Sansha pals. They want these parts badly enough to dare raiding in our territory. So, we decided to use their eagerness against them. We let the details leak about the timing of this shipment. They think they'll be ambushing a defenseless industrial. What they're going to find is you.

Kill every vessel that shows up.
messages.zh:
现在我们唯一要做的事情就是将你拿到的科技物资转移到源泉之域。别急，我们没有叫你去跑腿。我们已经找到人了。你的任务会更刺激。

我们知道此地区里还有古斯塔斯人，或许他们还在与他们的酒肉朋友萨沙厮混在一起。他们也十分渴望我们已拿到的那批东西，企图闯入我们的领域。因此，我们打算反过来利用他们这一猴急心理。我们故意走漏了这次运输的时间信息。对方以为他们可以偷袭一艘毫无还手之力的工业舰了，殊不知，他们到时候见到的就是你。

去把在场的船统统剿灭。

messages.en:
Even had a capsuleer show up, eh? Good. Nice to have a survivor to spread the story of their utter defeat.

You've done amazing work for us, and the Angels take notice of their friends. In fact, there's someone in the Dominations asking for you. Let me know if you want me to go ahead and arrange the meeting.
messages.zh:
连克隆飞行员都冒出来了？呵，很好。能有一个幸存者回去通报他们战败的消息真是大快人心啊。

你干都很漂亮，天使不会忘记你的。事实上，主天使部门里已经有人要求见你了。如果你也愿意去会见他们，那就跟我说一声。

messages.en: Goodbye.
messages.zh: 再见。

messages.en: Goodbye.
messages.zh: 再见。

messages.en: Get moving, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 动起来！{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: My success against Demense caught the attention of a local Dominations member named Kadeja Dulche.
messages.zh: 我击败戴蒙这一事引起了当地一位名叫“卡德雅·多切”的主天使成员的关注。

messages.en: My success against Demense caught the attention of a local Dominations member named Kadeja Dulche. I've been invited to meet with her back in K-QWHE.
messages.zh: 我击败戴蒙这一事引起了当地一位名叫“卡德雅·多切”的主天使成员的关注。我受邀将与她在K-QWHE会面。

messages.en: Fly safe, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 一路顺风，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
You've attracted the attention of Kadeja Dulche, one of the most important people in the Dominations. If he has a mission for you, the odds are good you'll be shooting some important people.

You best get going. I'd thank you for the assistance you provided, but an invitation to a meeting with a Domination agent says more than any words of mine will.
messages.zh:
你已经引起了主天使中一位非常显赫的人物卡德雅·多切的注意。如果她有任务要交给你，那基本上就要你去大展拳脚。

你现在就动身去她那儿吧。谢谢你提供的帮助，你现在收到了来自一位主天使代理人的邀请，这已经证明了你的能力。

messages.en: If that's how you feel, then yes, it's best we forego the meeting and send you on your way.
messages.zh: 如果你确实想那样，那好吧，我们还是取消会面，你可以走了。

messages.en:
The Dominations represent the command division of the Angel Cartel. The Dominations are elusive and mysterious, preferring to shroud their agendas in secrecy and obfuscation. Many of their membership seldom venture far from their bases in the Curse region, but CONCORD agents have reported sightings of highly-placed Cartel leaders as far north as Lonetrek.

Little is known about the identities of the Angel Cartel leadership, though it is understood that – as with the rest of the organization – they come from all the races and backgrounds.
messages.zh:
主天使是天使集团的指挥部门。该部门高深莫测，喜欢暗地里行事。该部门里的许多人基本上都在他们的柯尔斯老家活动，但统合部里也有人报告说最远曾在北面的长征星域看到过天使高级官员的身影。

人们对天使领导人物的身份知之甚少，不过像该组织中的其他人一样，这些领导都来自五湖四海，四面八方。

messages.zh: 主天使

messages.en: Talked to Ms. Dulche yet?
messages.zh: 你与多切小姐谈过了吗？

messages.zh: 我击败戴蒙这一事引起了当地一位名叫“卡德雅·多切”的主天使成员的关注。

messages.en: Fly safe, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 一路顺风，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Ready to move on then, I take it?

You'll be working with Kadeja Dulche of the Dominations from here on out. Don't ask me what he wants of you; it's not my business to know these things.

You best get going. I'd thank you for the assistance you provided, but an invitation to a meeting with a Domination agent says more than any words of mine will.
messages.zh:
那你的意思是继续了？

从现在开始，你将与主天使的卡德雅·多切合作。别问我他想要你做什么；这些事不归我管。

你现在就动身去她那儿吧。谢谢你提供的帮助，你现在收到了来自一位主天使代理人的邀请，这已经证明了你的能力。

messages.en: Never keep a Domination waiting, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 千万不要让主天使的人等你，{[character]player.name}。

name.ru: Меньшее из двух (The Lesser of Two)

messages.en:
I met with Kadeja Dulche, one of the chief field researchers for the Angel Cartel. She congratulated me on my good work with Abdiel. She wants my help to eliminate a Boundless Creations facility encroaching into Angel space.

I was faced with a choice. I can either make a direct assault at their full strength or first disable a communications array to lessen their ability to call reinforcements.
messages.zh:

I was faced with a choice. I can either make a direct assault at their full strength or first disable a communications array to lessen their ability to call reinforcements.

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, I've been waiting.

You've done well for us dealing with the Guristas and Sansha. Clashes with other frontier organizations come with the territory, however, and are never that much of a problem. The Archangels are more than capable of handling this aspect of daily operations. It is when other entities begin to stray outside their usual boundaries and establish themselves in our space that people begin to become rightly concerned. In these situations, we are called in to deal with them.

One Minmatar corporation, Boundless Creations, has made the mistake of conducting research in our space. They have come here on the misunderstanding that, just because their research is illegal, we will turn a blind eye to their presence. We've not corrected them on this false assumption. Rather, we've let them move in all of their assets and staff and slowly build themselves up. The time has now come to reveal to them where they truly stand with the Cartel.

Your mission is to destroy their research facility entirely, costing the interlopers billions. You can go about this whatever way you see fit. You can storm the facility head on, or weaken the defenses by knocking out their communications arrays first.

Either way, everyone in that place needs to be dealt with.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，我等你很久了。

你帮我们对付古斯塔斯与萨沙，为了我们立下了汗马功劳。事实上，只要我们与非法组织起冲突是由领土争夺原因导致的，那问题就不大。天使集团有能力处理好这些问题。只有当其他组织将他们的触角深入到我方领域，想在我们这里生根发芽，这才问题大了。在这种情况下，我们的任务就是要消灭他们。

一个名为“无限创造”的米玛塔尔军团竟然在我们领域里搞研究活动。他们想当然以为就因为他们的研究是非法的，我们就会对他们睁一只闭一只眼。我们没对他们及时进行处理，反而让他们把全体资产与人员都挪到了这儿，让他们慢慢壮大起来了。现在是清楚地向这些人表明我们立场的时候了。

你的任务就是去将他们的研究基地夷为平地，让他们付出数十亿金钱的代价。你可以按照自己喜好的方式来达成此目的。你可以单刀直入那基地，也可以通过先将其通讯阵列摧毁的方式来削弱他们的防守力。

总之，你必须把他们全部消灭。

messages.en: Paradise
messages.zh: 天堂

messages.en: I chose to storm the Boundless Creations facility head-on and destroy their data centers. I've crippled their research capabilities and left their million-ISK investment as nothing more than a scrap yard. Boundless Creations will be forced to abandon their projects in Curse.
messages.zh: 我决定直闯无限创造的研究基地，摧毁其数据中心。我这一弄让他们已经彻底搞不了研究，并且让他们的百万投资也打了水漂。无限创造将不得不撤出柯尔斯。

messages.en: I've chosen to storm the Boundless Creations facility head-on and destroy their data centers. This should cripple their research capabilities and leave their million-ISK investment as nothing more than a scrap yard.
messages.zh: 我决定直闯无限创造的研究基地，摧毁其数据中心。我将让他们彻底搞不了研究，并且让他们的百万投资也打水漂。

messages.en: Good, send a message.
messages.zh: 很好，给他们点颜色瞧瞧。

messages.en:
The base is split into three sections. Each section contains a data center that houses all of Boundless Creations' illegal research. You must destroy these. Each data center serves as a redundant backup for the others, so it needs to be all or nothing.

The Cartel is putting a lot of trust in you. If you're going to storm the front, you better be ready to deliver.
messages.zh:
该基地由三个部分组成。每个部分都含有一个存储该公司非法研究资料的数据中心。由于每个数据中心都存有备份，因此你必须把这三个中心都摧毁。

天使集团相信你能完成这一任务。如果你想正面袭击，那你就做好十足准备。

messages.en:
Most impressive.

When it comes down to it, I find most eggers to be rather disappointing. For immortals, so many of you have such petty fears and such trivial concerns. Only a few of you have managed to break free from that. It is those rare few that we in the Dominations value most.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮。

我发觉有的克隆飞行员让人很失望。你们虽是不死之身，但你们中有很多人都唯唯诺诺，担心这又担心那。没几个人能有大无畏精神的。我们主天使也就看得起那类人了。

messages.en: Your recommendations were overstated.
messages.zh: 你的推荐信言过其实了。

messages.en:
Going for the straight shot? You're a pilot after my own heart.

The base is split into three sections. Each section contains a data center that houses all of Boundless Creations' illegal research. You must destroy these. Each data center serves as a redundant backup for the others, so it needs to be all or nothing.

The Cartel is putting a lot of trust in you. Make it happen.
messages.zh:
打算单刀赴会？你真是想到我心里去了。

该基地由三个部分组成。每个部分都含有一个存储该公司非法研究资料的数据中心。由于每个数据中心都存有备份，因此你必须把这三个中心都摧毁。

天使集团相信你能完成这一任务，不要让我们失望。

messages.en: Your recommendations were overstated.
messages.zh: 你的推荐信言过其实了。

messages.en: Keep your enemies close, {[character]player.name}. Always.
messages.zh: 别让敌人跑远了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Paradise
messages.zh: 天堂

messages.en: I am to assault a base belonging to Boundless Creations. However, first I silenced a nearby communications array to prevent any calls for reinforcements.
messages.zh: 我是要攻击一座属于无限创造的基地。首先我关闭了附近的一座通讯阵列，以防他们呼叫增援部队。

messages.en: I am to assault a base belonging to Boundless Creations. However, the first step is to silence a nearby communications array to prevent any calls for reinforcements.
messages.zh: 我要攻击一座属于无限创造的基地。第一步我需要关闭附近的一座通讯阵列，以防他们呼叫增援部队。

messages.en: Good luck.
messages.zh: 祝你好运。

messages.en:
Boundless Creations has a communications array keeping tabs on the research base. If you attack the base now, they'll call in reinforcements and make your life difficult.

The good news is that they've attempted to hide the array inside a gas cloud rather than protect it in the open. They expect it to be undetected, and to most people it would be. Our scouts have uncovered the area though, and have observed engineers living at the compound. They will be carrying a security code which you must recover. You will be able to use it to deactivate the array without alerting the main Boundless Creation fleet.
messages.zh:
无限创造有一个通讯阵列一直在监视研究基地。如果你现在就去攻击那座基地，它会立即呼叫增援部队，这会给你的任务带来更大阻碍。

好消息是，他们尝试把通讯阵列隐藏到一片气云中，而不是在空旷的空间里。他们这样做是希望不要被发现，对于大多数人来说这个效果已经达到了。不过我们的侦查部队已经发现了这个秘密，并且也监视到有工程人员居住在那个据点里。这些工程人员都携带得有一种安全码，你必须要得到这样一个安全码。你需要用它来关闭通讯阵列，同时又不会引起无限创造集团的主力舰队的警觉。

messages.en: Good work. Now for the next step.
messages.zh: 干得好，现在就进行下一步吧。

messages.en: Useless.
messages.zh: 没用。

messages.en: Get moving, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 动起来！{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: With their communications array blinded, I devastated the Boundless Creations data centers. I've crippled their research capabilities and left their million-ISK investment as nothing more than a scrap yard. Boundless Creations will be forced to abandon their projects in Curse, and their failed venture should send a message to others.

messages.en: With the communications array blinded, I'm ready to go destroy the data centers of Boundless Creations. I don't have much time before they catch on to their communications problem.
messages.zh: 既然其通讯阵列已失灵，那我也准备好捣毁无限创造的数据中心了。不过在捣毁之后，他们也应该会很快察觉出的。

messages.en:
You have little time to waste. The Boundless Creations research base is cut off from its support. It won't be long before they figure out their communications aren't getting through any more.

The base is split into three sections. Each section contains a data center that houses all of Boundless Creations' illegal research. You must destroy these. Each data center serves as a redundant backup for the others, so it needs to be all or nothing.

The Cartel is putting a lot of trust in you. Make it happen.
messages.zh:
时间紧迫，抓紧行动。无限创造的研究基地现在处于孤立无援状态。不过他们应该过不了多久就会察觉出这一问题的。

该基地由三个部分组成。每个部分都含有一个存储该公司非法研究资料的数据中心。由于每个数据中心都存有备份，因此你必须把这三个中心都摧毁。

天使集团相信你能完成这一任务，不要让我们失望。

messages.en: Your recommendations were overstated.
messages.zh: 你的推荐信言过其实了。

messages.en: Get moving.
messages.zh: 快动身。

messages.en: I've been handed off to Kori Latamaki's superior, Cilis Leglise. She's a defected Gallente agent, brought into the Guristas years ago by Kori. She was pleased with my performance at the shipyard. My efforts so far have earned me some respect within the Guristas, and working for Cilis is considered quite the reward.
messages.zh: 我被委派给了考利·拉塔马基的上级，希利丝·拉基莱丝。她是在考利的影响下，于数年前从盖伦特联邦政府那儿转投加入古斯塔斯的。希利丝对我在船坞任务中的表现很满意。我迄今为止付出的努力在古斯塔斯组织中间已经赢得了一些尊敬，为希利丝效力也是一种首肯。

messages.en: I'm being sent to talk with Cilis Leglise. Kori Latamaki seems to think it was the only way to advance my involvement with Gurista affairs.
messages.zh: 我被派去与希利丝·拉基莱丝会面。考利·拉塔马基似乎认为这是让我进一步融入古斯塔斯的唯一方式。

messages.en: Cilis takes things very seriously, so don't let her down. She's a capsuleer, but in recent times, she's refused to update her clone. I've spent time trying to figure out her motives; most of them are beyond me. She's always been hard to read and doesn't talk about her experiences in the pod.
messages.zh: 希利丝做事很认真，所以别让她失望了。虽然她是个克隆飞行员，但最近她一直拒绝更新自己的克隆体。我花了时间想弄明白她到底在搞什么名堂，可惜我基本上都弄不懂。要读懂这人不容易，而且她也从不向人谈起她身为克隆飞行员时的经历。

messages.en: Travel to 6NJ8-V and talk to Cilis Leglise. She has more assignments for you. Consider this a promotion.
messages.zh: 请前往6NJ8-V与希利丝·拉基莱丝会面。她会给你安排任务。你就把这当作是提拨你吧。

messages.en: Not enough time? Too much pressure?  I'll let her know what you said. I'm sure she'll be thrilled with the news.
messages.zh: 没时间？压力太大？我会把这些话告诉她的。她听了一定会厥倒。

messages.en:
Nice work. You've proven yourself to be a competent pilot, and you've garnered some attention from the higher-ups. Being a capsuleer certainly helps your case. I requested that another agent handle your work with the Guristas. I feel that you have the potential to rise high in our ranks. One of my old associates jumped at the chance to have you. One of her lieutenants has gone missing, and she needs a capable pilot to assist her.

So it's done. Consider it a promotion. You'll be working with Cilis Leglise. I brought her in, actually. She was Federation Intelligence before I convinced her to turn against the Empires. I got her to defect, and she's risen through the ranks at breakneck speed.

Cilis and Irichi Tsunikabda are handling our work against the Navy in this section of Venal. The Navy's been making efforts to clean this region up recently. Every operation they attempt against us, CIlis is there to ruin their mission. Cilis is their unrelenting, ubiquitous scourge.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮。你证明了自己是个能干的飞行员，而且也已经引起了上级的关注。身为克隆飞行员果然让你沾了不少光。我要求让另一位代理人接手你在古斯塔斯的事务。我感觉你有上升的潜力。我的一个老同事自告奋勇地要接手你。她自己的一个助手失踪了，现需要一个能人去帮助她。

你就把这当作是提拔吧。你会与希利丝·拉基莱丝合作。事实上，这人也是我领进来的。她曾是联邦情报局的，后来才投靠了我们，入伙之后在我们内部窜得很快。

希利丝与伊里奇两人负责在维纳尔星域此片区块里对付海军。只要海军妄图打击我们，希利丝就能出面捣毁他们的计划。希利丝对他们来说就像驱不走的瘟神一般。

messages.en: I'm leaving my comms open in case you reconsider.
messages.zh: 我还是保持我的信道通畅以便你改变想法。

messages.en: She's waiting to hear from you. There was something in her voice, but I wouldn't make too much of it.
messages.zh: 她在等你。从她的语气来看，好像还有其他意思。不过我还不是不妄加猜测了。

messages.en: Chapter 2 - For Fun and Profit
messages.zh: 第二章——赚钱享乐

messages.en: Cilis Leglise asked me to approach the Venal Regional Comms tower, a logistics station that's been a nexus of increased naval communications activity. I hacked into the tower in order to reroute the signal. Afterwards, I got a comms message from another Guristas agent, Irichi Tsunikabda, who led me to a secret holoreel.
messages.zh: 希利丝·拉基莱丝要我前往维纳尔区域通讯塔。海军最近通信频繁，那儿是通讯信号的中转站。为了能对信号进行误导，我破解了通讯塔。之后，我得到了来自另一位名叫“伊里奇·逊尼卡巴”的古斯塔斯代理人的消息。他向我透露了一个秘密的全息电影盘。

messages.en: Cilis Leglise asked me to approach the Venal Regional Comms tower, a logistics station that's been a nexus of increased naval communications activity. I must attempt to hack into the tower in order to reroute the signal.
messages.zh: 希利丝·拉基莱丝要我前往维纳尔区域通讯塔。海军最近通信频繁，那儿是通讯信号的中转站。为了能对信号进行误导，我必须破解通讯塔。

messages.en: Great.  I can sleep a little better knowing you're on the case, {[character]player.name}. Don't get killed. Not like that'll matter much, really.
messages.zh: 很好。  很好。既然你已经接手了此事，{[character]player.name}，那我终于可以睡个安稳觉了。可别死啊。

messages.en:
According to our intel, the State uses the Venal Regional Comms tower to feed their forces about our movements within this region. I don't know: This is pretty dirty, even by Caldari standards. We can change this situation, though. If you hack the tower, it'll redirect the signal to follow the Navy's movements instead of ours.

Take this Data Analyzer and hack the tower. You'll have to hang around the tower for a bit once you've successfully hacked the signal. Something may turn up, possibly some more trouble. Roll with the punches on this one, and think on your feet. I assume you know what you're doing. After all, we capsuleers are invincible warriors, right?
messages.zh:
根据我们掌握的情报，加达里利用该维纳尔区域通讯塔向其部队不断通报我们在此区域的活动情况。我搞不懂加达里怎么会做如此偷鸡摸狗之事。但不管怎么样，我们都能搞定这件事。如果你破解了此通讯塔的防火墙，那你就能混淆对方视听，将信号锁定在他们自己的海军，而不是我们。

你把这数据分析仪拿着，用它来破解通讯塔吧。信号破解之后你还得在那儿滞留会儿。可能会有敌人出现。你要冷静沉着地将他们一一消灭。我相信你知道自己在干什么。毕竟，我们克隆飞行员都是无敌的战士，对吧？

messages.en: Goddamnit, what is Irichi doing? That bastard is losing his mind. He hasn't been the same since he lost his legs, and he blames me for that. Well, I guess he should. I was the one who tortured him when I was working for the Federation. But we're Guristas now, and we pirates have to stick together, right? It's the pirate's code. That, and “every pirate for herself."
messages.zh: 该死的，伊里奇在搞什么名堂？那家伙一定是疯了。自他断腿之后就没正常过，而且他还怪我。其实，他也没怪错。我还在为联邦效力的时候是我折磨了他。但我们现在都是古斯塔斯人了，海盗难道不应该并肩作战吗？不是有句什么格言叫来着？好像是“海盗都是自私的”。

messages.en: You're a capsuleer. I know what you're capable of. I guess you must be a coward.
messages.zh: 你是克隆飞行员。我知道你的能力。我想你一定是个胆小鬼。

messages.en: The Guristas code is simple: Everything goes.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯的格言很简单：不择手段。

messages.en: The Guristas Code
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯格言

messages.en:
I was hoping you'd contact me. You've made quite the impression among the Guristas ranks, so I had to jump at the chance of working with the hot, new capsuleer.

We've been picking up increased Navy activity in the region. It's really gutsy of them to come this far into Venal. This is our turf, after all. Before we can draw them into an ambush or respond in any meaningful (and hopefully humiliating) way, we need to know more about their activities. Luckily, Kori's provided me with some rather juicy information on a communications station that the Navy has erected. I need you to take it out.

According to our intel, the State uses the Venal Regional Comms tower to feed their forces information about our movements within this region. I don't know: This is pretty dirty, even by Caldari standards. We can change this situation, though. If you hack the tower, it'll redirect the signal to follow the Navy's movements instead of ours.

Take this Data Analyzer and hack the tower. You'll have to hang around the tower for a bit once you've successfully hacked the signal. Something may turn up, possibly some more trouble. Roll with the punches on this one, and think on your feet. I assume you know what you're doing. After all, we capsuleers are invincible warriors, right?
messages.zh:
我刚才还在希望你能来主动联系我呢。你的表现让古斯塔斯人大为赞赏，所以我就迫不及待地抓住这个与当今炙手可热的克隆飞行员共事的机会了。

我们已经发现海军在此区域的活动愈发频繁。他们敢如此深入维纳尔星域，胆子真是太大了。这里毕竟是我们的领域。我们要设下圈套偷袭他们，或者以一种有成效的（同时也是侮辱性的）方法去对付他们。但在此之前，我们得获得更多有关对方的情报。幸运的是考利向我提供了一条价值不菲的信息：他知道了海军最近搭建起来的一座通讯塔的位置。你的任务就是去摧毁这座塔。

根据我们掌握的情报，加达里利用该维纳尔区域通讯塔向其部队不断通报我们在此区域的活动情况。我搞不懂加达里怎么会做如此偷鸡摸狗之事。但不管怎么样，我们都能搞定这件事。如果你破解了此通讯塔的防火墙，那你就能混淆对方视听，将信号锁定在他们自己的海军，而不是我们。

你把这数据分析仪拿着，用它来破解通讯塔吧。信号破解之后你还得在那儿滞留会儿。可能会有敌人出现。你要冷静沉着地将他们一一消灭。我相信你知道自己在干什么。毕竟，我们克隆飞行员都是无敌的战士，对吧？

messages.en: I'll make sure your career with the Guristas is over. Leave Venal now, or pay the price.
messages.zh: 我不会再让你与古斯塔斯合作了。现在就离开维纳尔，不然你将付出代价。

messages.en: Found anything interesting?
messages.zh: 发现什么有用的信息吗？

messages.en: Using the information from the hacked Venal Regional Comms tower, Cilis discovered the location of burgeoning Caldari Navy fleet. Stationed at a fueling depot, gearing up for an imminent strike on the Guristas, the fleet is prone, an easy target to pick off. Cilis's plan is to have me attack the fuel silos, which will cascade and destroy the ships as they wait to refuel. Any damage done in this strike will take out a significant portion of the Navy fleet.
messages.zh: 凭着维纳尔星域区间通讯塔上破解出来的信息，希利丝发现了一支潜伏着的加达里海军舰队。该舰队现停靠在一个燃料储藏站里，准备袭击古斯塔斯，不过这也让他们成了活靶子。希利丝的算盘是让我袭击燃料罐，其引发的连环炮将能摧毁整支舰队。这次袭击将能极大地削弱海军的力量。

messages.en: Using the information from the hacked Venal Regional Comms tower, Cilis discovered the location of burgeoning Caldari Navy fleet. Stationed at a fueling depot, gearing up for an inclement strike on the Guristas, the fleet was prone, an easy target to pick off. Cilis's plan was to have me attack the fuel silos, so the explosion would cascade and destroy the ships as they wait to refuel. The damage done in this strike took out a significant portion of the Navy fleet.
messages.zh: 凭着维纳尔星域区间通讯塔上破解出来的信息，希利丝发现了一支潜伏着的加达里海军舰队。该舰队现停靠在一个燃料储藏站里，准备袭击古斯塔斯，不过这也让他们成了活靶子。希利丝的算盘是让我袭击燃料罐，其引发的连环炮将能摧毁整支舰队。这次袭击将能极大地削弱海军的力量。

messages.en: The Navy has a habit of locking their gates before a big strike so that only smaller ships can get through. This is a stealth operation: run and gun. You may be flying something small, but you'll take out so much more than your ship should be capable of. Wanton destruction is a rather satisfying feeling, to be sure.
messages.zh: 海军习惯在发动大规模袭击前锁住他们的门，所以只有小船能入。这是项隐秘行动：你要边跑边打。虽然你驾驶的是艘小船，但你要摧毁的却远大于你的舰船原有的能力。尽情地摧毁吧，那一定会让你感到满足的。

messages.en: The Caldari fleet is docked at a fueling station, preparing for their attack. They're sitting ducks, or fish in a barrel, or whatever cliché you want to use. What makes this a great opportunity for us is their fueling depots. Those silos have enough energy stored in them to take out three fleets, if they happen to catch on fire. And that's what you'll be doing. Destroy at least one of the fuel depots, which will cascade and destroy the surrounding ships. Ignore the big ships and go straight for the fuel depots. There may be some guards there, but your main targets are the fuel depots. This is way more bang for your buck than you were expecting, huh?
messages.zh: 加达里的一支海军舰队目前停泊在一个加油站，打算发动袭击。他们是铁板上的鸭子、桶里的鱼，反正随你怎么说吧。他们的燃料储藏站是我们的一大利好。如果那些燃料储藏站都着了火，那就足以炸毁三支舰队。你的任务就是摧毁至少其中一个燃料储藏站，然后其产生的连锁反应将炸毁那整个舰队。你不用管那些大船，径直往燃料罐奔去就行。燃料储藏站附近可能会有些守卫，把他们也一并解决掉。这下你爽了吧？

messages.en: Congratulations. Pound for pound, you have caused much more destruction than most pilots of your caliber. We've bloodied their noses with this strike. Now, it's time for the knockout punch.
messages.zh: 可喜可贺。连环炮，死光光。你消灭了强于你数倍的对手。我们这次把他们打了个鼻青眼肿，接下来就要给他们致命一击了。

messages.en: We'll make arrangements, but you'd be mistaken to think that we'll just forget this.
messages.zh: 我们会另行安排的，但如果你以为我们会轻描淡写的忘却此事，那你就大错特错了。

messages.en:
Thanks to your work back at the comms tower, we've discovered the locations of a budding Navy fleet. This Navy group is much larger than ones we've seen in recent times. It looks like they're trying to weaken our hold on the fringe systems and consolidate power in Venal.

Not quite a bad plan on paper, to be completely honest. But they're becoming cocky, expecting to sneak up on us and take out our forces with ease. We'll do them one better, though, and surprise them. If we strike first, they won't be able to muster their forces enough to overwhelm us. And that's where you come in.

The fleet is docked at a fueling station, preparing for their attack. They're sitting ducks, or fish in a barrel, or whatever cliché you want to use. What makes this a great opportunity for us is their fueling depots. Those silos have enough energy stored in them to take out three fleets, if they happen to catch on fire. And that's what you'll be doing. Destroy at least one of the fuel depots, which will cascade and destroy the surrounding ships. Ignore the big ships and go straight for the fuel depots. There may be some guards there, but your main targets are the fuel depots. This is way more bang for your buck than you were expecting, huh?
messages.zh:
多亏了你在通讯塔那儿的工作，我们现在发现了一支整装待发的海军舰队。这支海军的规模比我们近来所见的都要庞大。看来他们想削弱我们在边缘地带建立起来的势力，加强自己在维纳尔星域的控制力。

说真的，理论上这是个不错的计划。不过他们太自信了，以为可以偷袭我们，轻而易举地把我们端掉。我们要比他们棋高一招，打他们个措手不及。如果我们先发制人，那他们就无法召集起足够的人来压制我们。现在我们需要你来完成这个任务。

该舰队目前停泊在一个加油站，打算发动袭击。他们是铁板上的鸭子、桶里的鱼，反正随你怎么说吧。他们的燃料罐是我们的一大利好。如果那些燃料储藏站都着了火，那就足以炸毁三支舰队。你的任务就是摧毁至少其中一个燃料储藏站，然后其产生的连锁反应将炸毁那整个舰队。你不用管那些大船，径直往燃料罐奔去就行。燃料储藏站附近可能会有些守卫，把他们也一并解决掉。这下你爽了吧？

messages.en: We'll make arrangements, but you'd be mistaken to think that we'll just forget this.
messages.zh: 我们会另行安排的，但如果你以为我们会轻描淡写的忘却此事，那你就大错特错了。

messages.en: Having fun out there?
messages.zh: 在那儿打得开心吗？

messages.en: The Navy fleet suffered a significant blow at the fuel depot. They retreated and  locked themselves in a deadspace pocket. A carrier was there, and the Guristas organized a fleet of shuttles armed with “dirty” explosives to destroy the remaining Navy ships. This mission was a suicide run of sorts, but the result knocked the Navy fleet out of commission. Cilis gave me a shuttle, and I picked up a “dirty” bomb at the deadspace pocket, using the explosive in a kamikaze flight to destroy the carrier.
messages.zh: 海军舰队在燃料站遭受了惨重损失。他们丢盔弃甲，撤到了一个死亡空间里，并将自己封锁在里面。那里有他们的一艘航母，古斯塔斯为此召集了一支装有“脏弹”的穿梭机舰队打算将其摧毁。这任务基本上就是个自尽性袭击，但结果却把海军的最后一口气也给掐断了。希利丝给了我一艘穿梭机，我在死亡空间拿到了一枚“脏弹”，用它像神风特攻队那样冲向了海军的航母。

messages.en: The Navy fleet suffered a significant blow at the fuel depot. They are retreating and have locked themselves in a deadspace pocket. A carrier is there, and the Guristas have organized a fleet of shuttles armed with “dirty” explosives to destroy the remaining Navy ships. This mission is a suicide run of sorts, but the result is supposed to knock the Navy fleet out of commission. Cilis gave me a shuttle, and I am supposed to pick up a “dirty” bomb at the deadspace pocket, then use it to destroy the carrier.
messages.zh: 海军舰队在燃料站遭受了惨重损失。他们丢盔弃甲，撤到了一个死亡空间里，并将自己封锁在里面。那里有他们的一艘航母，古斯塔斯为此召集了一支装有“脏弹”的穿梭机舰队打算将其摧毁。这任务基本上就是个自尽性袭击，但结果却把海军的最后一口气也给掐断了。希利丝给了我一艘穿梭机，我接下来应该在死亡空间拿到一枚“脏弹”，然后用它摧毁海军的航母。

messages.en: This is one of the perks of being a capsuleer. When death isn't an issue, you can let yourself go with wild abandon. Ok, enough ruminating: Go deliver that knockout punch to the Navy!
messages.zh: 作为克隆飞行员有这样一个好处：死不足惧，任性而为。好了，不多废话了：去给海军致命一击吧！

messages.en:
Time for a suicide run. Doesn't that sound like fun? We'll give you a shuttle to take specifically for this mission. (We have quite a stockpile of useless Caldari shuttles, for some reason.) You can join our talented Guristas Capsuleer Fleet, which specializes in suicide missions. Meet with the fleet at the deadspace pocket, pick up some of our “dirty” explosives from a fellow fleet member, and fly at the carrier. You'll lose the shuttle, but you'll take out that carrier. I wish I could go on this mission, but I've got my own orders to follow.

You will lose this shuttle that we have provided you, but you won't get podded. However, you will be a very easy target for wayward pirates in the area. Not to worry, though: You can minimize the risk for this mission. Besides, I'll make sure that you're handsomely rewarded for this effort. Hell, the thrill of the kill should be enough, right?
messages.zh:
是时候来一次自尽行动了，怎么样，听上去很有趣吧？我们会专门针对此次任务给你一艘穿梭机（出于某种理由，我们这里存放着大批平时无用的穿梭机）。你去与擅长自尽行动的古斯塔斯克隆飞行员舰队并肩作战。 你先在死亡空间和他们碰头，然后从其中一人手中拿些“脏弹”，最后朝敌人的那艘航母飞过去。虽然你会不可避免地失去那艘穿梭机，但与此同时，你也能摧毁那艘航母。我真希望自己也能去，可惜我身上另有任务。

穿梭机虽会湮灭，但你的逃生舱能够逃过一劫。不过呢，你还是很容易成为飘忽不定、神出鬼没的海盗的劫持对象。但是话还是要说回来，你也不必提心吊胆，你可以将此任务的风险降到最小嘛。另外，我给你准备好的奖赏也应该值得你冒这次险。你这次将能体验到死亡的快感。

messages.en:
Beautiful. You just brought a tear to my eye. This is poetry in motion. Makes me want to get back in my pod again.

We took out that Navy fleet, but something isn't quite right. I'll explain more later. We have a spy to root out.
messages.zh:
漂亮，你的英勇之举都让人感动涕泣了，我现在自己都想再重操旧业了。

我们虽然歼灭了海军舰队，但事情总有点不大对劲。我们要清理掉一个间谍。我稍后再解释。

messages.en: You're declining this mission because you're scared, aren't you? Coward.
messages.zh: 你一定是害怕才拒绝这任务的吧？胆小鬼。

messages.en:
You have no idea how much you frightened the Navy with that last strike. They're completely demoralized and retreating to a rally point in a nearby deadspace pocket. Turns out, they had a carrier waiting in their midst to bring extra destruction to our members. Well, we'll take care of that.

The fleet is pinned down, but we're having trouble getting to them. They've locked themselves in the pocket, only allowing shuttles to get through their gates. We thought we'd have a large siege on our hands, but a rather brilliant idea came to me. I am, of course, a capsuleer like yourself; we think differently than the mortals we have to deal with.

Time for a suicide run. Doesn't that sound like fun? We'll give you a shuttle to take specifically for this mission. (We have quite a stockpile of useless Caldari shuttles, for some reason.) You can join our talented Guristas Capsuleer Fleet, which specializes in suicide missions. Meet with the fleet at the deadspace pocket, pick up some of our “dirty” explosives from a fellow fleet member, and fly at the carrier. You'll lose the shuttle, but you'll take out that carrier. I wish I could go on this mission, but I've got my own orders to follow.

You will lose this shuttle that we have provided you, but you won't get podded. However, you will be a very easy target for wayward pirates in the area. Not to worry, though: You can minimize the risk for this mission. Besides, I'll make sure that you're handsomely rewarded for this effort. Hell, the thrill of the kill should be enough, right?
messages.zh:
你上次把海军真的打怕了，可能连你自己都没法相信。他们现在士气全无，窝藏在附近的一个死亡空间里。不过那儿还有一艘他们本想用来打垮我们的航母，看来我们得对付它。

虽然对方海军已经被我们盯上了，但我们要接近他们却有很大的困难。他们把自己封锁在了那个死亡空间里，只允许穿梭机进出。表面上看，一场旷日持久的消耗战在所难免，但实际上我还有更高明的一招。我像你一样，也是克隆飞行员。我们的思路与那帮我们必须要对付的俗人不一样。

是时候来一次自尽行动了，怎么样，听上去很有趣吧？我们会专门针对此次任务给你一艘穿梭机（出于某种理由，我们这里存放着大批平时无用的穿梭机）。你去与擅长自尽行动的古斯塔斯克隆飞行员舰队并肩作战。 你先在死亡空间和他们碰头，然后从其中一人手中拿些“脏弹”，最后朝敌人的那艘航母飞过去。虽然你会不可避免地失去那艘穿梭机，但与此同时，你也能摧毁那艘航母。我真希望自己也能去，可惜我身上另有任务。

穿梭机虽会湮灭，但你的逃生舱能够逃过一劫。不过呢，你还是很容易成为飘忽不定、神出鬼没的海盗的劫持对象。但是话还是要说回来，你也不必提心吊胆，你可以将此任务的风险降到最小嘛。另外，我给你准备好的奖赏也应该值得你冒这次险。你这次将能体验到死亡的快感。

messages.en: You're quitting this mission because you're scared, aren't you? Coward.
messages.zh: 你一定是害怕才退出这任务的吧？胆小鬼。

messages.en: Having fun?
messages.zh: 爽吗？

messages.en: I met with Abdiel Verat, one of the Angel Cartel's capsuleer liaisons. She had a job for me: scout a nearby wormhole and report the presence of any hostiles. When I arrived I found a gang of Sansha ships already there. She wants it dealt with.
messages.zh: 我与天使集团的阿布戴尔·瓦拉特见了面，她专职负责联系克隆飞行员。她给我派了个任务：探察附近的一个虫洞，然后报告任何敌情。我抵达那儿之后见到了一群萨沙的舰船。她要我解决掉它们。

messages.en: I met with Abdiel Verat, one of the Angel Cartel's capsuleer liaisons.  She had a job for me: scout a nearby wormhole and report the presence of any hostiles.
messages.zh: 我与天使集团的阿布戴尔·瓦拉特见了面，她专职负责联系克隆飞行员。她给我派了个任务：探察附近的一个虫洞，然后报告任何敌情。

messages.en: The wormhole is in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Investigate the area and then report back to me with what you've found.
messages.zh: 该虫洞位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。请前去调查，然后将你的所见所闻报告给我。

messages.en:
Abdiel Verat, Angel Cartel.

I look out for talented people such as you who are interested in work. And times have certainly made our work interesting.

Since you're an egger, I'm guessing you know your way around wormholes, yes? While they've been a great aid for our scientists, they've also brought some problems to our doorstop, some of which is not good for business.

Our explorers have discovered a wormhole in a nearby system, but we cannot spare the manpower to lock it down. If you help us out by scouting the area, then I may have other more lucrative tasks to follow.
messages.zh:
我是天使集团的阿布戴尔·瓦拉特。

我在寻找像你这样对干活儿有兴趣的能人。我们所处的这个时代使得我们的活儿变得有趣起来。

鉴于你是为克隆飞行员，我猜你应该知道如何闯荡于虫洞之间吧？虽然虫洞帮了我们科学家的大忙，但同时它们也将危险带到了家门口，对我们的事业不利。

我们的探察人员已在附近一个星系里发现了一个虫洞，但我们目前没有足够的人力去将它封锁住。如果你能帮我们去勘察一下那虫洞周遭的情况，那接下来你还能从我们这里获得报酬更为丰厚的任务。

messages.en: Sansha. Alright, let me relay this information up the chain of command. Stick around; we'll be calling on you to deal with this.
messages.zh: 萨沙，好吧，让我把这信息传达给我上司。别走开；我们会安排你处理这件事的。

messages.en: Then stop wasting my time.
messages.zh: 这样的话就别再浪费我的时间了。

messages.en:
The sudden appearance of wormholes across New Eden proved to be a boon to scientific communities of all disciplines. Nearly everyone in the cluster has some vested interest in the wormholes.

The Angel Cartel has been investing heavily into wormhole exploration. They not only scavenge the Sleeper ruins for new technology, but also exploit the wormholes' ability to link otherwise distant points. A wormhole can potentially turn an eighty-jump trip from Curse to Fountain into a twenty-minute jaunt. Although these opportunities represent significant logistical advantages, they are always fleeting, and every effort to map wormhole space has thus far failed.
messages.zh:
新伊甸各地突然出现虫洞，对于各个领域的科研人员而言堪称福音。宇宙中的每个人几乎都能享有既得利益。

一直以来，天使都在斥巨资探索虫洞的奥秘。他们不仅研究冬眠者废墟来摸索新技术，还利用虫洞的能力实现远点连接。从诅咒之域到源泉之域需要跳跃八十次，但虫洞的存在可以将路程时间缩短至二十分钟。这些机遇虽然会带来巨大的后勤优势，但总是转瞬即逝，即便竭尽全力，至今也都没人能绘制出虫洞空间图。

messages.en: Wormholes
messages.zh: 虫洞

messages.zh: 这样的话就别再浪费我的时间了。

messages.en: I'll be waiting for your report. You needn't return here, {[character]player.name}. Just open up comms once you have a clear idea of the situation.
messages.zh: 我等你的报告。你没必要回到这里，{[character]player.name}，只需打开信道向我通报那里的情况就行。

messages.en: Chapter 3 - Internal Security
messages.zh: 第三章——内部安全

messages.en: I've chosen an agent to investigate. Cilis suspects this agent has been meddling in her affairs, and she would like me to search for exploitable weaknesses. She admitted that she is essentially asking me to screw up another agent's operations.
messages.zh: 我已经选定了一位代理人去追查。希利丝怀疑这代理人插手她的事情，要我去找出其可被利用的弱点。她承认其实就是要我去捣乱。

messages.en: I've been asked to choose between two other Guristas members who have been meddling with Leglise's operations in Venal.
messages.zh: 有两个古斯塔斯成员在维纳尔星域插手拉基莱丝的事务，她要求我从这两者中选一个去追查。

messages.en:
I've come across a problem in my operations. You may have noticed a lot of interloping on the part of other agents. Whether it's Kori trying to get you to show a modicum of mercy to the Navy or, as I strongly suspect, Irichi leaving those messages, I'm done with people trying to influence my business. I can't have all this politics messing with my operations, especially not where a valuable asset like you is concerned.

I want you to choose one of these offenders and follow their activity. They're both so eager to take you off my hands. I suspect one, or both, of them are actively betraying the Guristas in some fashion. Call me paranoid, but I just don't trust them. Thus, you will be my mole and try to determine who is undermining my operations. This previous operation went well, but I suspect some tampering from them. Operations like this don't normally go this well without a major disaster occurring directly afterwards. Let's try to avoid a fiasco, OK?

Once I have this information, I'll be able to send them the appropriate message. No, I'm not going to do anything extreme. I'm not going to do anything as stupid as encourage open infighting while the Navy is so active. Consider this a setting of boundaries; but yes, I'm essentially asking you to help me screw up another agent's operation. We'll see how they like it.
messages.zh:
我在日常工作中碰到了一些麻烦。你可能已经注意到有很多代理人都在互相插手对方的事情。不管是考利要你对海军施以一点善意，还是我极度怀疑的伊里奇留下的那些信息，我都受够了，我不要别人再来插足我的事情。我不能让这些政治斗争影响我的正常工作，尤其当这其中还牵涉到像你这么一位有用人才时。

我要你从那两个人中选一个出来，去追查他的行踪。这两人都极度希望把你从我身边拉拢出去。我怀疑其中一个或者两个都在以某种方式出卖着古斯塔斯。你可以说我是杞人忧天，但我就是不相信他们。我要你当我的间谍，去查明到底是谁在暗中跟我作祟。虽然之前的行动进展地很顺利，但我还是觉得他们不会善罢甘休的。一般来说，这种行动顺利进行之后总要来一次横祸的。我们要尽量避免这种情况出现，好吗？

我掌握情况之后，就会给予他们一个正确的回应。别担心，我不会干出极端事情来的。我可不会这么傻，在海军打击的风头浪尖上，还去引发内部纷争。我只是想告诫他们不要把脚伸到我这里来；但话还是要说回来，我其实就是你要去捣乱他们的行动，看他们怎么着。

messages.en: Ok, we'll go with your choice.
messages.zh: 好，就根据你的选择来。

messages.en:
You've made your choice then? Alright. Irichi. There is a small chance you may have worked with him before. He was a Lai Dai ordinance engineer who failed one of his annual psychological evaluations. From there, he stowed away aboard a capsuleer's ship heading into lowsec space. His mistake. The capsuleer's crew found him, and he became the capsuleer's toy for two years before he escaped, absolutely insane and missing half of his body parts. We've been taking care of him ever since, and when he's lucid, Irichi is actually quite brilliant. He has made some small recoveries, but we're not out to make him normal. If we did, he might not want to be a pirate any longer. See the problem in that?

The notes you found make a lot more sense under that context, don't they? The fact that he's sending you missives on his “transformation,” or whatever the hell he's calling it, means you're either his favorite culprit at the moment, as is any capsuleer that he comes across, or he suspects someone you're working with. That worries me. Fly out to meet him at his station, and see if he gives you anything to do.
messages.zh:
你做出选择了？好吧，是伊里奇。或许你以前与他合作过。他是莱戴的一名享有权威的工程师，但有一次他没有通过心理健康状况评估。之后他就偷偷登上了一艘克隆飞行员的舰船，进入了低安全区。这事全怪他自己不好。那船上后来有人发现了他，他就成了那名克隆飞行员的掌中玩物，过了两年之后才得以逃脱，当时精神已经崩溃，身体也裂了一半。他后来一直由我们照看着。这家伙脑子清醒时绝对是个天才。虽然他在我们这里小有成果，但我们不打算让他恢复正常。如果他正常了，就可能不想再当海盗了。懂了吧？

你发现那些的笔记里其实大有文章。就从他不断向你通报他那些所谓的“变化”这一事情上就可以看出，要么你就是他目前最喜欢的罪魁祸首——他对所有他遇到的克隆飞行员都持这态度，要么就是他在怀疑你的合作对象。这让我有点担心。请前往他的空间站去见他，看看他是否有些事要交待你做。

messages.en:
I have a hunch that Kori's our spy. I've been monitoring his transmissions to you in the field, and I'm very sure that he's working with the Navy.

He won't be willing to work with you directly right now. I've arranged for you to meet with one of his operatives, Eroma Eralen. You'll meet him in a deadspace pocket at these coordinates. Be careful, though: Eroma is renowned for his technological ability. He's not good at anything else, but he sure does know his way around illegal pirate tech, especially wavelength and frequency modulation. Meet with him and see what he knows. He owes me a favor, anyway.
messages.zh:
我的直觉告诉我考利是间谍。我一直在监察他与你的通信记录，我确信他与海军是勾结上了。

他现在不会直接与你合作的。我已经做了安排，让你去与他的一个名叫“伊洛玛·伊拉仑”的下属会面。你按照这地址去一个死亡空间见他。但要小心：伊洛玛的技术能力是出了名的。他对别的都不在行，但对于非法海盗科技了如指掌，尤其是波长与频率调制方面。你去见他，看看他知道些什么。他欠我一个人情呢。

messages.en: I've met with Irichi, and I am now working for him. While I'm under his assignment, Cilis will be monitoring his communications with me in the field to see if they match the signal type of the traitor or if he poses any particular threat to her operations.
messages.zh: 我见过了伊里奇，现在我为他干。即便如此，希利丝还是会密切监听我与伊里奇在现场的通话，以看一下伊里奇到底是个叛徒，还是个会对其自身行动造成威胁的家伙。

messages.en: Cilis has asked me to spy on one of two agents, and I selected Irichi Tsunikabda. He's not exactly stable, and I've been warned that he may try to get me killed. He's also been begging to work with me since the shipyard op. CIlis strongly believes that he's the one who has been leaving those recordings for me.
messages.zh: 希利丝要我从两位代理人中选一个去监视，我选了伊里奇·逊尼卡巴。他精神不是特别稳定，而且可能还想对我不利。但与此同时，自那次船坞行动以来，伊里奇一直想与我合作。希利丝坚信他就是那个给我留信的人。

messages.en:
Good. You're proving to be as trustworthy as I was hoping you'd be. Show up at his base of operations in PF-QHK. He should be ecstatic to see you.

One last thing: Keep an eye out for my missing lieutenant. I have come to believe that Irichi is somehow responsible for his disappearance.
messages.zh:
很好。你果然不出所料，是个值得信赖的人。现请前往其在PF-QHK的一座基地。他看到你应该会很高兴。

还有一件事：留意一下我那失踪掉的副手。我怀疑伊里奇与此事有关。

messages.zh: 这事必须得有人做。我可以另寻他人，但你最好将来别再让我继续失望。
