messages.zh:
好的，是伊里奇。或许你以前与他合作过。他是莱戴的一名享有权威的工程师，但有一次他没有通过心理健康状况评估。之后他就偷偷登上了一艘克隆飞行员的舰船，进入了低安全区。这事全怪他自己不好。那船上后来有人发现了他，他就成了那名克隆飞行员的掌中玩物，过了两年之后才得以逃脱，当时精神已经崩溃，身体也裂了一半。他后来一直由我们照看着。这家伙脑子清醒时绝对是个天才。虽然他在我们这里小有成果，但我们不打算让他恢复正常。如果他正常了，就可能不想再当海盗了。懂了吧？

你发现那些的笔记里其实大有文章。就从他不断向你通报他那些所谓的“变化”这一事情上就可以看出，要么你就是他目前最喜欢的罪魁祸首——他对所有他遇到的克隆飞行员都持这态度，要么就是他在怀疑你的合作对象。这让我有点担心。

每次他一这么起劲，有人就要活不了了。除非你觉得对你有利，否则别相信任何他对我的言论。即便他把你看作一个有用的人，也不能排除他对付你的可能。你要小心行事。

messages.en: Very well. I can understand that the prospect of working with Irchi might be off-putting. I'll have someone else look into it. I'll keep my comms open just in case you change your mind. I'm going to urge you to reconsider; this work has to be done, preferably by a knowing accomplice that I trust.
messages.zh: 行。我理解与伊里奇合作是件让人兴奋不起来的事。我会另寻他人，但我还是会保持我的信道畅通，以备你转变想法。我希望你能再考虑一下；这事必须得有人做，最好是由一位我能信任的人来担当。

messages.en: Have you reported to Irichi yet?
messages.zh: 你到伊里奇那儿报到过了吗？

messages.en: Irichi had a test for me to determine if he could trust me or not. The mission was to deliver a Dread Guristas strike force to an Ytiri base in order to take it over from the inside. While the strike force did its business, I handled the surrounding space, clearing the air while the ground support performed its duty.
messages.zh: 伊里奇给我安排了一次测试任务，想以此检验我是否可信赖。我的任务是带一支恐怖古斯塔斯的突击队飞往一座耶利基地，让他们抢占基地，然后我就趁这时负责歼灭太空中的敌舰。

messages.en: Irichi has a test for me to determine if he could trust me or not. The mission is to deliver a Dread Guristas strike force to an Ytiri base in order to take it over from the inside. While the strike force does its business, I'm supposed to handle the surrounding space, clearing the air while the ground support performs its duty.
messages.zh: 伊里奇给我安排了一次测试任务，想以此检验我是否可信赖。我的任务是带一支恐怖古斯塔斯的突击队飞往一座耶利基地，让他们抢占基地，然后我就趁这时负责歼灭太空中的敌舰。

messages.en: I'm feeling better about you already. Maybe all those things Cilis and Kori said about you were true after all. We'll see.  It's not as though I trust Cilis. Something about her silhouette is familiar, if you know what I mean? Do you? Come on, you know. You don't?
messages.zh: 我对你感觉不错。也许希利丝与考利对你的评价没错。让我们走着瞧吧。但这不是说我相信希利丝这个人。我总觉得她像某个人，你应该知道什么意思吧？你不知道？别装了，你知道的。难道你还真不知道？

messages.en: We're going to take that station over in the name of Gurista, and I have just the men to do it. I'll hand over a platoon of soldiers, trained professionals within our ranks. They're known as the Dread Guristas, and this is their strike force. Take them to the base, and let them do their magic. Wait for the strike force to take control while you eliminate any enemies in the sky. Don't worry: They know what they're doing.
messages.zh: 我们将以古斯塔斯的名义抢占那座空间站，我手下也有人能干那样的活儿。我将派我部受过训练的职业军人前往那儿。大家都称他们为“恐怖古斯塔斯”，我这次派出的将会是他们的突击队。请带他们飞往那座基地，让他们发挥他们的力量。你趁他们抢占基地的时候负责扫清太空里的敌船。别担心：恐怖古斯塔斯知道他们在干什么。

messages.en:
I'll admit I had doubts about you. You think you can do anything you want to anyone without reason or plan. I think you might be different. Cilis seems to think so. But then again, Cilis was an egger, too.

Anyhow, smash up job. I couldn't be more pleased. I like it when a target is surprised to see death waiting for him. It's one of the most beautiful things you can do as a pirate. The egger who held me taught me that. Her crew chief helped me get away, but the container I was in busted on impact. In the madness, I found myself re-forged. Even though I will kill the person who did this to me, I have to thank them as well for making me what I am.

The recordings you've received in the field are from me. Anyhow, what you did will certainly help, but there's a lot of work to be done, and I can promise you that I'll pay well. You had better have the stomach for it.
messages.zh:
我承认我对你们这种人心存不信任。你们总是以为无需任何理由或计划，就可以想干嘛就干嘛。我想也许你有所不同，希利丝似乎也这样认为。但话要将回来，她也是克隆飞行员。

说到底，你还是干得不错。我没什么可挑剔的。我就喜欢对方惊讶地发现原来自己离死亡已经不远了。对于海盗而言，这真是妙不可言。这些道理全是拜托囚禁我的那个克隆飞行员所赐。虽然她的首席船员帮我逃脱，但装着我的那个箱子就那样一直砸到地面上。在一片疯狂之中，我发现自己获得了重生。虽然我会干掉对我下此毒手的人，但我还要感谢他们让我变成了目前的自己。

你收到的那些信息都是我发来的。你已经给我帮了忙，但我这里还有更多的事需要帮助。当然我给的报酬不会低，就看你有没有胆量了。

messages.en: About as fickle as I expected. Clear out if you aren't going to contribute. You eggers make the place smell.
messages.zh: 你果然是个风头转向极快的人。如果你不想帮忙，那就快闪吧。你们克隆飞行员身上有股难闻的味儿。

messages.en:
I've been begging my handlers to let me get a hold of you. Just look at you, a genuine capsuleer . We have a lot of pretenders around here. They'll do a few things for us here and there and then they'll blow some of our boys out of the sky for the bounties on their heads.

I have my doubts, but we'll see.

I was sent to the Venal region a bit ago. The Navy and other State corps are moving in and trying to clean us honest rogues out, which is why we need to teach them fear.

Ytiri has a base they've built up in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We'll be taking it, but that's not where you fit in. It's not enough to simply take the base: We need to curtail their ability to operate in this region. We need to destroy all of the ships assigned to this base, let them know it's not worth the wasted time and resources in trying to reclaim their property or their territory.

We're going to take that station over in the name of Gurista, and I have just the men to do it. I'll hand over a platoon of soldiers, trained professionals within our ranks. They're known as the Dread Guristas, and this is their strike force. Take them to the base, and let them do their magic. Wait for the strike force to take control while you eliminate any enemies in the sky. Don't worry: They know what they're doing.

But so do you, I guess. Well, I'll give you the reins on this one.
messages.zh:
我一直求我上级让我与你见面。看看你：一位地道的克隆飞行员。这里假模假样的人特多。那些人会先为你做一点事，然后就冲着你头上的赏金把你给掐了。

我对你心存疑虑，但让我们先做起来再说。

不久之前，我被送到了维纳尔星域。加达里海军与军团现在也在往这里扎堆，想把我们这群本分的边缘人赶走。鉴于此，我们必须要给他们点颜色看看。

耶利集团在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}已经有座建造好的基地。我们会抢占该基地，但这不是你要做的事情。光抢占该基地还不够：我们还要削除他们在该星域的行动能力。我们要把属于这座基地的所有船统统摧毁，让对方不要浪费时间，妄图收复他们的财产或领土。

我们将以古斯塔斯的名义抢占那座空间站，我手下也有人能干那样的活儿我将派我部受过训练的职业军人前往那儿。大家都称他们为“恐怖古斯塔斯”，我这次派出的将会是他们的突击队。请带他们飞往那座基地，让他们发挥他们的力量。你趁他们抢占基地的时候负责扫清太空里的敌船。别担心：恐怖古斯塔斯知道他们在干什么。

我想你也应该知道。好了，我就把这事交给你了。

messages.en: Who are you?
messages.zh: 你是谁？

messages.en: What's your status, egger? You lure those ships to their end yet? Or have you lured our guys to theirs?
messages.zh: 克隆飞行员，你事情办得如何了？你把敌人引向末路了吗？还是你把我们的人交给敌人了？

messages.en: I met with Kori's operative, Eroma Eralen, though I didn't get the information I wanted. Instead, I got some background information on the relationships between Cilis, Kori, and Irichi – they have a long history together. Eroma Eralen is a master of technology, and he was able to string me along that deadspace pocket for quite some time. I finally met him, though, and he gave me some interesting information.
messages.zh: 我同考利的密探伊洛玛·伊拉仑见了一面，但是我没有拿到想要的情报。不过，我拿到了一些希利丝，考利和伊里奇这三个人之间的事情的背景资料：他们可是很有一些历史的。伊洛玛·伊拉仑是技术方面的高手，他曾经在那个死亡复合体空间层里糊弄了我好长一段时间。我终于见到这个人了，他告诉了我一些有趣的信息。

messages.en: I've selected Kori as the agent to investigate. I have to meet his operative, Eroma Eralen, and see if he knows anything about Kori's meddling. Luckily, Eroma owes Cilis a favor, so he should give some information without a hitch.
messages.zh: 我选择了考利作为参与调查的代理人。我需要同他的密探伊洛玛·伊拉仑见一面，看看考利是不是中间有什么不可告人的秘密。幸运的是，伊洛玛还欠了希利丝一个人情，所以他应该会耿直地告诉我一些事情。

messages.en:
Kori's aware that the two of you are meeting, though he doesn't know what this is about. I don't think he's suspicious. He should be. I want you to be careful on this one. Kori's operative has heard of you. He knows you've been working with me, and Kori teaches his people to be meticulous and paranoid in everything.

It's one of the qualities that I used to find so endearing about him.

In any event, all you have to do is meet with Eroma. Actually, though that sounds easy enough, he'll probably have some tricks up his sleeve.
messages.zh:
考利知道你们两个人正在开会，但他不知道具体的内容是什么。我想他应该不会起疑心。他倒是真应该怀疑一些。我要你这一次特别的小心，考利的探员听说过你，他知道你现在正与我合作，另外考利通常都要求他的手下在任何事情上都保持高度怀疑和一丝不苟。

我曾经觉得这是他的非常让我赞赏的优点。

不管怎样，你说要做的事情就是同伊洛玛见面。实际上这听起来再简单不过了，但他很可能会耍点什么花招。

messages.en:
I have a hunch that Kori's our spy. I've been monitoring his transmissions to you in the field, and I'm very sure that he's working with the Navy.

He won't be willing to work with you directly right now. I've arranged for you to meet with one of his operatives, Eroma Eralen. You'll meet him in a deadspace pocket at these coordinates. Be careful, though: Eroma is renowned for his technological ability. He's not good at anything else, but he sure does know his way around illegal pirate tech, especially wavelength and frequency modulation. Meet with him and see what he knows. He owes me a favor, anyway.
messages.zh:
我的直觉告诉我考利是间谍。我一直在监察他与你的通信记录，我确信他与海军是勾结上了。

他现在不会直接与你合作的。我已经做了安排，让你去与他的一个名叫“伊洛玛·伊拉仑”的下属会面。你按照这地址去一个死亡空间见他。但要小心：伊洛玛的技术能力是出了名的。他对别的都不在行，但对于非法海盗科技了如指掌，尤其是波长与频率调制方面。你去见他，看看他知道些什么。他欠我一个人情呢。

messages.en: Kipo? At the Rabbit Hole? Why would anyone go there? I wasn't expecting this information. This must mean that Kori is involved, somehow. Now it's personal.
messages.zh: 齐波？在兔子窝？为什么还有人要到那里去？真是出人意料，这就意味着考利一定参与了。这事情从现在开始就是我们个人之间的事情了。

messages.en: I'll leave my comms open in case you want to change your mind. But I'll be watching you: You may be a spy for Kori.
messages.zh: 我把我的通讯平道开着，如果你改变了注意就可以联系我。我会看着你的，说不定你是考利派来的奸细。

messages.en:
Kori is one of the reasons I came over to the Guristas. But he's become soft, and he meddles. I've been monitoring his transmissions to you in the field, and I'm sure he's working with the Navy.

He won't be willing to work with you directly right now. I've arranged for you to meet with one of his operatives, Eroma Eralen. You'll meet him in a deadspace pocket at these coordinates. Be careful, though: Eroma is renowned for his technological ability. He's not good at anything else, but he sure does know his way around illegal pirate tech, especially wavelength and frequency modulation. Meet with him and see what he knows. He owes me a favor, anyway.
messages.zh:
考利是我加入到古斯塔斯来的原因之一。但他现在变得软弱了，而且还瞎胡搞。我一直在监控他和你之间的通讯，而且我很肯定他是在为海军工作。

他现在不会再愿意直接的同你合作了。我安排了你同他的一个探员见面，这个人的名字是伊洛玛·伊拉仑。你可以在这个坐标处的死亡空间层里找到他。但你得小心，伊洛玛是以他的技术能力所著称的。在其他方面他没什么在行的，但是对于那些非法的海盗科技来说他可是个达人，特别是对波长和频率的改装上。去和他碰个头，看看他都知道些什么，要知道，他还欠我一个人情。

messages.en: I'll leave my comms open in case you want to change your mind. But I'll be watching you: You may be a spy for Kori.
messages.zh: 我把我的通讯平道开着，如果你改变了注意就可以联系我。我会看着你的，说不定你是考利派来的奸细。

messages.en: I'll be contacting you as soon as it's over.
messages.zh: 等事情结束后我就会立即联系你

messages.en: Irichi and Kori captured one of Cilis Leglise's lieutenants, hiding him at a place called “The Rabbit Hole.” An abandoned Guristas landmark, the place is a profane mockery of the Caldari State's patriotic public works. Irichi and Kori had been working together on this kidnapping, but when I went to retrieve Lt. Kipo, their deal went south. Kori's sentries attacked me, and the Caldari Navy turned up – Kori tipped them off. I recovered Lt. Kipo, whose body was mutilated by Irichi, and I delivered him to Cilis.
messages.zh: 伊里奇和考利抓住了希利丝·拉基莱丝的一个副手，把他藏在一个名叫“兔子洞”的地方。这地方虽是加达里公共爱国设施，但实际上却游走于黑白两道之间。伊里奇和考利合力实施了这起绑架，但当我去带回齐波的时候，他们之间的合作出现了裂痕。考利的岗哨炮攻击了我，加达里海军也随即出现——是考利向他们通风报信的。我发现了齐波，其肢体已被伊里奇肢解，我把齐波交还给了希利丝。

messages.en: According to Kori's operative, Eroma Eralen, Cilis Leglise's missing lieutenant is located at a place known as “The Rabbit Hole.” Cilis suspects that Kori was involved with his kidnapping. I am to visit this place and recover Lt. Kipo.
messages.zh: 据考利手下的一位工作人员——伊洛玛·伊拉仑——的说法，希利丝·拉基莱丝的失踪副手位于一个被称作“兔子洞”的地方。希利丝怀疑考利与这起绑架有关。我的任务就是前往那儿救出其副手齐波。

messages.en: You'll be with me soon, Foxfire. I hope.
messages.zh: 但愿我们很快便能团聚。

messages.en: Here are the coordinates for the Rabbit Hole. If Kipo is there, get him and bring him back. He's been missing for a long time, and I've had no leads on his whereabouts. I'll explain on the way. If Kori has anything to do with this, I'll make sure he pays for his this crime. Go get Kipo!
messages.zh: 这是“兔子洞”的位标。如果齐波在那里就把他带回来。他失踪已久，我没有他的线索。我路上会解释的。如果考利与此事有关，那我一定会让他付出相应的代价。快去把齐波带回来！

messages.en: Please give me a minute while I go talk to my lieutenant. We still have work to do. Kori has to pay for this.
messages.zh: 请给我点时间让我和我的副手交谈一下。我们并没有就此打住，考利必须为其所作所为付出代价。

messages.en: I can't believe this. Why aren't you helping me get my lieutenant?
messages.zh: 难以置信，你为什么不帮我找回我的副手？

messages.en: Here are the coordinates for the Rabbit Hole. If Kipo is there, get him and bring him back. He's been missing for a long time, and I've had no leads on his whereabouts. I'll explain on the way. If Kori has anything to do with this, I'll make sure he pays for his this crime. Go get Kipo!
messages.zh: 这是“兔子洞”的位标。如果齐波在那里就把他带回来。他失踪已久，我没有他的线索。我路上会解释的。如果考利与此事有关，那我一定会让他付出相应的代价。快去把齐波带回来！

messages.en: I can't believe this. Why aren't you helping me get my lieutenant?
messages.zh: 难以置信，你为什么不帮我找回我的副手？

messages.en: Kipo?
messages.zh: 齐波？

messages.en: Cilis required proof that Kori was working for the Caldari Navy. Lt. Kipo offered a clue about his next meeting with the State. Eroma Eralen was to meet with them soon, and using a special transponder to get into their base. My mission was to ambush Eroma, take the transponder, and sneak into the base. Once inside, however, Kori alerted the Navy of my presence. It was a scramble to get the evidence, but I eventually did. I received the proof, a correspondence log that included detailed information of Kori's deals with the Caldari Navy. Cilis will use this information to blackmail Kori. Looks like their feud won't end there, though. Cilis had nothing more to offer me, but thanked me for my services. Mission accomplished.
messages.zh: 希利丝想要得到证明考利是在为加达里海军工作的证据。齐波上尉提供了他下一次同加达里人会面的地点信息。伊洛玛·伊拉仑很快就要同他们海军的人见面了，他将会使用一个应答机来进入它们的基地。我的任务就是伏击伊洛玛，夺取他的应答机，然后再利用这个应答机潜入敌人的基地。当我进去的时候，考利向海军通告了我的存在。我基本上没有时间去寻找需要的证据，但是我最终还是找到了。我拿到了证据，那是一个联络记录，其中包括了考利和加达里海军的人联络的所有细节。希利丝会用这份情报来敲诈考利。看来他们之间的斗争还不会就这么结束了。希利丝没有更多的东西可以提供给我了，但是他对我的帮助表示了感谢。任务完成！

messages.en: Cilis requires proof that Kori is working for the Caldari Navy. Lt. Kipo offered a clue about his next meeting with the State. Eroma Eralen will be meeting with them soon, and he'll have a special transponder to get into their base. My mission is to ambush Eroma, take the transponder, and sneak into the base. Once inside, I am to grab a correspondence log that is proof of Kori's affiliation with the Caldari Navy.
messages.zh: 希利丝想要得到证明考利是在为加达里海军工作的证据。齐波上尉提供了他下一次同加达里人会面的地点信息。伊洛玛·伊拉仑很快就要同他们海军的人见面了，他将会使用一个应答机来进入它们的基地。我的任务就是伏击伊洛玛，夺取他的应答机，然后再利用这个应答机潜入敌人的基地。当我进去后，需要找到能证明考利同加达里海军秘密合作的通讯记录。

messages.en: Once you've completed this mission, I will reward you handsomely for your services. I may even have a lieutenant position available soon. We'll see how this goes.
messages.zh: 一旦你完成这个任务，我会好好地奖励你，对你的工作表示感谢。甚至很快我还会有一个上尉的官衔空缺出来，好好努力吧。

messages.en: Looks like Kori is sending our old friend Eroma to meet with the Navy very soon, and Eralen has a special transponder to get through the tough Navy security. Your mission is to ambush Eralen, grab the transponder, and enter the Caldari base. Once you have this Caldari Navy Overlay Transponder, the Navy ships won't hassle you. I think. I'm looking for a special dossier, Correspondence Log KL-513. That should be everything I need to blackmail Kori and get him out of the Guristas.
messages.zh: 看上去考利很快就要把我们的老朋友伊洛玛派去同加达里海军的人会面了，他身上带的有一个特殊的应答机可以用帮助他通过海军的层层保安措施。你的任务就是伏击伊拉仑，把这个应答机弄到手，然后再通过它进入加达里的基地。当你的船上载有这个加达里海军覆盖应答器的时候，海军的舰船就不会来骚扰你。我需要找到一份特殊的档案，叫做通讯记录KL-513.那上面应该有我需要的所用东西，我将以此要挟考利逼他离开古斯塔斯。

messages.en:
We're a big, happy family, aren't we? You thought a pirate's life was all fun and plunder, profit and murder, the thrill of being an outlaw. We have our own problems, our internal strife. Sometimes, I don't know why I chose this lifestyle.

But I'm a capsuleer, and life has a different quality to it. You probably know what I'm talking about. All this backstabbing and in-fighting, these land-grabs and territorial bickering. What does this matter for a demigod? For us, it's all a matter of attrition: The last clone standing wins all the worthless, empty space in the universe.

Oh well. It's fun while it lasts, right? Kori was right: This isn't over between us. It never will be. But I'll win out in the end. He'll die, I'll die, Irichi'll die. But then I'll hop into my next clone, and I'll win. That makes it worth it, right?

This feud is between us Guristas; you have your own battles to fight. So fly well, egger. Maybe we'll work together again someday.
messages.zh:
要知道，我们是一个大家族，一个快乐的大家族，是么？你或许认为海盗就是干些大肆破坏，牟取暴利的事情。实际上我们还有我们自己的问题要解决，我也不知道为什么我要选择这样的生活方式

但我是一个克隆飞行员，本身就有着不一样的生活，你应该知道我是指什么。所有的这些勾心斗角和内耗，底盘的争夺，对于一个神一样的永生的人来说有什么意义呢？对于我们来说，这都只是浪费：最后一个站着的克隆人可以得到所有这些没有价值的东西，得到这真空的宇宙。

算了，至少在过程当中还是有点乐趣的，对吧？考利说的对，我们之间的事情还没有结束。这些都还将被带到我的下一个克隆身体里，我一定要赢。只有这样才能物有所值，对么？

这是我们古斯塔斯的事情，你有你的仗要打。去吧，克隆人。或许我们有一天会再在一起工作。

messages.en: Get out of this space, coward. You don't belong with the Guristas.
messages.zh: 马上离开这空域，你这个懦夫。你不属于古斯塔斯的一员。

messages.en:
Lt. Kipo will never be the same again. He was my best operative, my closest lieutenant, and the best pirate under my command. He is a shell of a man, a mutilated sack of meat, nearly useless as a soldier. I'll have to take care of him, one way or the other…

In the meantime, Kori must pay. I know he's a traitor and has been working for the Caldari Navy. What I don't have is proof, however. Lt. Kipo, though he is mostly unintelligible at this point, was able to form a coherent sentence or two. And that dumb bastard Irichi told him of some of Kori's future plans. Looks like Kori is sending our old friend Eroma to meet with the Navy very soon, and Eralen has a special transponder to get through the tough Navy security. Your mission is to ambush Eralen, grab the transponder, and enter the Caldari base. Once you have this Caldari Navy Overlay Transponder, the Navy ships won't hassle you. I think. I'm looking for a special dossier, Correspondence Log KL-513. That should be everything I need to blackmail Kori and get him out of the Guristas.
messages.zh:
齐波上尉再也不会和从前一样了。他曾是我最好的一个探员，我最亲密的战友，他曾是我手下最为出色的海盗。现在他变成了一副躯壳，一个行尸走肉，变得和一个普通步兵一样没用。我还得照顾他，不管是用什么方式。

与此同时，考利必须要为此付出代价。我知道他是一个叛徒，他一直在同加达里海军暗地里合作。不过，我还没有证据来证明这一点。至于齐波上尉，他现在已经是动弹不得了，要说上一句两句话都是很困难的事情。而伊里奇那个笨蛋还告诉了他一些关于考利未来的打算。看上去考利很快就要把我们的老朋友伊洛玛派去同加达里海军的人会面了，他身上带的有一个特殊的应答机可以用帮助他通过海军的层层保安措施。你的任务就是伏击伊拉仑，把这个应答机弄到手，然后再通过它进入加达里的基地。当你的船上载有这个加达里海军覆盖应答器的时候，海军的舰船就不会来骚扰你。我需要找到一份特殊的档案，叫做通讯记录KL-513.那上面应该有我需要的所用东西，我将以此要挟考利逼他离开古斯塔斯。

messages.en: Get out of this space, coward. You don't belong with the Guristas.
messages.zh: 马上离开这空域，你这个懦夫。你不属于古斯塔斯的一员。

messages.en: Where're those logs?
messages.zh: 那些记录在什么地方

messages.en: Irichi and Kori captured one of Cilis Leglise's lieutenants, hiding him at a place called “The Rabbit Hole.” An abandoned Guristas landmark, the place is a profane mockery of the Caldari State's patriotic public works. Irichi and Kori had been working together on this kidnapping, but when I went to retrieve Lt. Kipo, the deal went south. Kori's sentries attacked me, and the Caldari Navy turned up – Kori tipped them off. I recovered Lt. Kipo, whose body was mutilated by Irichi, and now I am to deliver him to Cilis.
messages.zh: 伊里奇和考利抓住了希利丝·拉基莱丝的一个副手，把他藏在一个名叫“兔子洞”的地方。这地方虽是加达里公共爱国设施，但实际上却游走于黑白两道之间。伊里奇和考利合力实施了这起绑架，但当我去带回齐波的时候，他们之间的合作出现了裂痕。考利的岗哨炮攻击了我，加达里海军也随即出现——是考利向他们通风报信的。我发现了齐波，其肢体已被伊里奇肢解，现在我要把齐波交还给希利丝。

messages.en: Irichi and Kori captured one of Cilis Leglise's lieutenants, and they are now prepared to return him to Cilis. I will be their courier, retrieving Lt. Kipo at a place called “The Rabbit Hole.” Kori should be expecting me.
messages.zh: 伊里奇和考利抓住了希利丝·拉基莱丝的一个副手，现在他们打算将他还给希利丝。该任务将由我完成，我得前往一个叫“兔子洞”的地方接齐波副手。考利也应该在等我。

messages.en: I'll explain more when you get there. The Rabbit Hole is special to the Guristas. It was their first step to enlightenment. I will show them the rest of the path.
messages.zh: 你到那儿后我再跟你细说。“兔子洞”对古斯塔斯十分特别。那地方是他们迈向升华的第一步。之后我会告诉他们接下来的路该怎么走。

messages.en:
Cilis Leglise's lieutenant has been missing for quite some time, and nobody knows where he is. Except for Kori Latamaki and me. Kori helped me capture him and offered to hide him from Cilis. My intentions are pure: I want to cleanse his soul, and by extension, cleanse Cilis's as well. However, that required me to rebuild him, purify him, and make him stronger. You might think I'm a monster, but I assure you that I'm not. Rather, I am here to bring light to the pirates, to show them the true path, to evolve them. Lt. Kipo is the first step in this metamorphosis. His evolution mirrors my own; the others will follow suit.

We are holding him at the Rabbit Hole. I'll give you the coordinates. Fly there and retrieve them; Kori should be expecting you.
messages.zh:
希利丝·拉基莱丝的副手失踪已有段时间了，而且没人知道他现在哪儿。只有我和考利·拉塔马基知道。考利帮我抓住了他，并提出将他藏起来，不要让希利丝知道。我的动机很纯：我只想清洗他的灵魂，并籍此达到清洗希利丝灵魂的目的。但是，这要求我重塑他、清洗他并强化他。你可能以为我是个魔鬼，但我向你保证，我不是。事实上，我是来给他们指引真理道路的，让他们进化。齐波是这场进化的第一步。他的进步与我类似；其他人定会随后效仿。

我们现把他关在“兔子洞”里。我把那地方的位标给你。请飞往那里，考利应该在等你。

messages.en: I do not understand this betrayal by Kori. Of all my fellow pirates, he was the most visceral and real of them all. I don't know what he's planning. Either way, time to return the lieutenant off to Cilis. Hopefully, she will come to the light afterwards.
messages.zh: 我不理解考利为什么要倒戈。在我所有的海盗同僚中，他是最贴心、最真实的一个人。我不知道他到底想干什么。不管怎么样，先把齐波交给希利丝吧。但愿她之后会搞明白。

messages.en: Do you not want to achieve the sublime?
messages.zh: 难道你不想成就伟业吗？

messages.zh: 难道你不想成就伟业吗？

messages.en: Do you have Lt. Kipo?
messages.zh: 齐波在你这里了吗？

name.ru: С больной головы на здоровую (Passing the Buck)

messages.en: I delivered Lt. Kipo to Cilis Leglise. Shortly after he was returned to her station, it exploded, destroying Cilis's headquarters. Irichi had loaded Kipo's mutilated body with explosives, claiming that Kipo willfully allowed the sacrifice. While attempting to get the holoreel, a Caldari Navy fleet appeared, no doubt at the behest of Kori Latamaki. I fought through the ships and recovered the holoreel. This was the last assignment that Irichi had for me, though it appears that the infighting between the Guristas agents will not cease anytime soon. Regardless, I have completed my objectives with the Guristas pirates and aided them in their battles throughout Venal. Mission accomplished.
messages.zh: 我将齐波交给了希利丝·拉基莱丝。可没一会儿，那空间站就炸了，希利丝的总部也一并消亡。原来伊里奇在四分五裂的齐波身体里埋放了炸弹，并称齐波是自愿作此牺牲。我欲取出那全息电影盘的时候，一支加达里舰队出现了，毫无疑问是考利·拉塔马基叫来的。我与那批舰船展开了恶斗，最终拿到了全息电影盘。这是伊里奇交给我的最后一项任务，不过古斯塔斯内部纷争似乎远未结束。不管怎样，我已经完成了古斯塔斯海盗的要求，帮助他们在维纳尔星域作战。任务完成。

messages.en: Lt. Kipo, though heavily mutilated and modified by Irichi, is ready to be delivered to Cilis Leglise at one of her stations. Once I hand him over to Cilis, she will give me a special holoreel for Irichi.
messages.zh: 虽然齐波已经被伊里奇肢解改造，我还是已经准备好前往希利丝·拉基莱丝的一座空间站，将伊里奇交给她。我把人交出之后，她会给我一张要转交给伊里奇的全息电影盘。

messages.en: Humanity's inherent problem is its constant insistence on adhering to the primal instincts of nature, science, and the hidden rules of the physical world. Once we discover that mind, the inner void of thought and expression, is the ultimate key to enlightenment, then we will become the truly powerful beings of creation. Until then, all of our feuds, our battles, our quarrels, and our tensions will only contribute to the persistent nihilism of eternal space. In a way, my brethren in the Guristas have it right: Nothingness is the way. But they are going about it in the wrong manner. I hope you can help show them the truth.
messages.zh: 人类有一个千古传承的问题就是不停地要遵照自然本能与潜规则行事。只有当我们发现思想——即由思维表达组成的内部虚空——才是升华的关键时，我们才能成为真正具有力量的创造人。在这之前，所有的纠葛、战争、争吵与敌对都只是不断在加强这物质世界的虚空性质而已。从某种意义上说，我的古斯塔斯同僚们的做法是正确的：色即是空，空即是色。但他们用错了方式。但愿你能将真理传达给他们。

messages.en:
The transformation is nearly complete. We are on the road to a new future, the fourth stage of humanity. And it will start with the Guristas.

You have Lt. Kipo, yes? You will deliver him to Cilis. I have let her know that you are en route. Kori may show up, and if he does, I apologize. He has rejected the future and continues to stumble in this aimless void.

I forgot one thing. In exchange for the return of Foxfire, Cilis has promised to give me a special holoreel. This holoreel is very important to my development, and it must be returned to me. Drop Kipo off at the Cilis's headquarters, and then get the holoreel.
messages.zh:
进化即将完成。我们正大步迈向未来，也就是人类文明的第四阶段。这项进化将会从古斯塔斯开始。

齐波在你手里对吧？你把他交给希利丝吧。我跟她说你已经上路了。考利可能也会现身，如果他真的出现，那我还真是不好意思。这家伙不顾未来，决意继续做无意义的纠缠。

我忘了一件事。作为交换齐波的条件，希利丝答应给我一张特殊的全息电影盘。这张盘片对我自身发展非常重要，必须回到我手里。快动身吧，把齐波送到希利丝的总部，然后拿回那张电影盘。

messages.en:
Cilis must have told you that I was crazy. That might be true; who am I to say? You can judge for yourself, but remember what you have experienced here. I have mastered my transformation; I am now perfect. Can't you tell? Don't you understand?

This bickering among us, between Cilis and Kori and me, must come to an end. If they want to achieve my level of humanity, then this bickering must end, the feuds must stop, and they must trust in their fellow pirate. That is what I hoped to achieve with Lt. Kipo: He was the impetus for change. He accepted his mind, rejected his body, and willfully sacrificed himself for the betterment of the Guristas, and humanity.

The holoreel was a reminder of my life before this incarnation, when social interactions, my body, my loved ones were important to me. A memento mori of a forsaken existence. Thank you; it was the final piece to true understanding.

I doubt that my efforts were successful today. Cilis and Kori will most likely maintain their blood feud, their bitter struggle for supremacy in this meaningless void. I will not relent, however: As long as they continue down that path, I will be there to usher them into a new beginning, the perfect world, and the true way. This will never end until our bodies wither and our minds burn with truth.

Thank you for your services, capsuleer. I know how you demigods value material possessions, so please accept this gift. You have been immeasurably helpful in assisting the Guristas. I hope we may cross paths again in the future. If you ever want to achieve enlightenment, please come find me again.
messages.zh:
希利丝肯定跟你说我疯了。她说得或许没错；你让我跟谁去说？你自己判断吧，但别忘了你在这里的经历。我已经完成了自己的进化，现在我是个完人了。你看不出来？不懂？

希利丝、考利与我之间的纷争必须结束。如果他们想让自己的文明程度上升到像我这样的高度，那现在的这种对立与勾心斗角必须结束，他们必须相信自己的同僚。齐波就能做到这点：他推进了改变。他接受了自己的思想，放弃了自己的身躯，为了古斯塔斯与人类文明的进步，他自愿做出了牺牲。

那张全息电影盘里记录我的前生，那时我视自己的身躯、朋友及所爱的人皆为珍宝。那是一段已逝去的记忆。谢谢你，那东西是揭露真理的最后一环。

我不确定今日我做的努力是否已成功。希利丝与考利很有可能会在此虚无的世界里为争夺主导权继续他们无意义的流血斗争。但我不会袖手旁观：只要他们还是这样执迷不悟，我就会努力将他们引入一片全新的极乐净土，直到我身躯腐朽、思维顿悟的那天。

飞行员，谢谢你迄今流出的血汗。我知道你们这帮神人非常注重物质，因此请笑纳此件小礼。你帮了古斯塔斯大忙。但愿我们能后会有期。如果你有朝一日想升华思想，那就再来找我吧。

messages.en: Do you not want to achieve enlightenment?
messages.zh: 你难道不想得到升华吗？

messages.zh: 你拿到我的全息电影盘了吗？

name.fr: Camp de base d'extraction minière - Nugoeihuvi Corporation
name.ja: 採掘基地のキャンプ-ノゴエイハヴィコーポレーション
name.ru: Шахтерская база - корпорация Nugoeihuvi (Mining Base Camp - Nugoeihuvi Corporation)
name.zh: 矿产基地扎营——纳基维集团

messages.en: The Caldari must pay for their pride.
messages.zh: 加达里必须为他们的目中无人付出代价。

messages.en:
Nugoeihuvi is attempting to form a foothold in Iges. They've got the early stages of a mining base established and plan to begin production very soon. From the looks of it, Nugoeihuvi plans to be there for a long time. We need you to spoil their plans. Take out all the industrial vessels you can find at this base. Be wary of any escorts, though: they do not look willing to leave.

< font color = #EE3B3B >Be careful: This mission will take you into lowsec. I would recommend switching to a ship designed for inter-capsuleer conflicts, just in case your piratical brethren want a piece of you en route. Once you get to the site itself, though, you shouldn't receive very much resistance. The megacorporations aren't exactly known for the might of their security forces.
messages.zh:
纳基维集团想要在埃格斯扎根。他们已经初建了一个开采基地，打算很快就进行大规模生产了。看起来纳基维集团是想在那儿赖着不走，你要去把他们这美梦给搅了。你的任务就是将基地上所见的所有工业舰统统炸毁。不过你要当心他们的护驾：他们不会轻易将地方拱手相让的。

< font color = #EE3B3B >注意：该任务会将你引入低安全区。为了防止路上遭人打劫，我建议你驾驶一艘能抗击别人炮轰的舰船。但只要你闯入了那片基地，你就应该无甚大碍了。加达里超级军团的保安力量并不咋的。

messages.en:
The Caldari Providence Directorate has today announced the winning bids for their recent auction of Gallente space. Big winners include Kaalakiota and Sukuuvestaa, while Ishukone makes do with just a single system. The winning corporations are now authorized to exploit these systems to the fullest for as long as they remain in Caldari hands.

As expected, the "blind auction" format seems to have made it difficult for even comparatively wealthy sub-megas, such as perennially successful Ytiri, to gain any kind of foothold. All eight megacorps had at least one successful bid, with Suvee leading the charge and claiming fourteen systems. Meanwhile, in a move many are describing as "baffling," Ishukone has laid claim to a single system: Intaki, generally considered the least promising prospect in the auction due to its comparative lack of mineral wealth and vast native population. Sources believe that this was the only bid Ishukone made, and several political commentators have questioned where the financially struggling megacorp managed to find the money.
messages.zh:
加达里的普罗维登斯总督今天公布了在最近一次盖伦特领土拍卖会上，顺利成交的买主。这次的大买主包括卡拉吉塔集团与斯库维塔集团，异株湖集团仅购得一个星系。只要加达里掌控着这批星系，这些军团就能对它们任意开发。

正如预料的那样，“匿名拍卖”这种形式让耶利集团这种相对富有的小军团也无法从中获得任何利益。所有的8大超级军团都有斩获，其中斯库维塔集团更以购得14个星系独占鳌头。于此同时，异株湖集团这次仅斩获一个印塔基星系，许多人都大呼“看不懂”，因为该星系缺乏大量的矿物资源，同时还有大批本地人扎根在那里。有消息称异株湖这次就竞购了这一星系，一些政治评论家对这一经济上吃紧的超级军团的购买资金来源提出了质疑。

messages.en:
Listen, {[character]player.name}, the Federation is in dire straits. I'm sure you know that the Caldari megacorporations have “bought” some Gallente systems in Tibus Heth's illegal blind auction. Those bastards have some nerve. But it's time the Federation took it all back!

Nugoeihuvi is attempting to form a foothold in Iges. They've got the early stages of a mining base established and plan to begin production very soon. From the looks of it, Nugoeihuvi plans to be there for a long time. We need you to spoil their plans. Take out all the industrial vessels you can find at this base. Be wary of any escorts, though: they do not look willing to leave.

< font color = #EE3B3B >Be careful: This mission will take you into lowsec. I would recommend switching to a ship designed for inter-capsuleer conflicts, just in case your piratical brethren want a piece of you en route. Once you get to the site itself, though, you shouldn't receive very much resistance. The megacorporations aren't exactly known for the might of their security forces.
messages.zh:
听着，{[character]player.name}，联邦目前处境不妙。我相信你应该已经获悉，在提波斯·赫特举行的非法匿名拍卖会上，加达里的超级军团“购买”了一些盖伦特的星系。那帮家伙都是胆大包天。现在是联邦收复故土的时候了！

纳基维集团想要在埃格斯扎根。他们已经初建了一个开采基地，打算很快就进行大规模生产了。看起来纳基维集团是想在那儿赖着不走，你要去把他们这美梦给搅了。你的任务就是将基地上所见的所有工业舰统统炸毁。不过你要当心他们的护驾：他们不会轻易将地方拱手相让的。

< font color = #EE3B3B >注意：该任务会将你引入低安全区。为了防止路上遭人打劫，我建议你驾驶一艘能抗击别人炮轰的舰船。但只要你闯入了那片基地，你就应该无甚大碍了。加达里超级军团的保安力量并不咋的。

messages.en: I hope you don't expect me to show good favor toward you in the future. Declining this mission was a poor course of action.
messages.zh: 你可不要希望我将来再帮你什么帮。你这次拒绝绝对是个错误。

messages.en: Have you taken out the mining base yet?
messages.zh: 你把那矿产基地炸平了吗？

messages.en:

Big winners include Kaalakiota and Sukuuvestaa, while Ishukone makes do with just a single system. The winning corporations are now authorized to exploit these systems to the fullest for as long as they remain in Caldari hands.

All eight megacorps had at least one successful bid, with Suvee leading the charge and claiming fourteen systems. Meanwhile, in a move many are describing as "baffling," Ishukone has laid claim to a single system: Intaki, generally considered the least promising prospect in the auction due to its comparative lack of mineral wealth and vast native population. Sources believe that this was the only bid Ishukone made, and several political commentators have questioned where the financially struggling megacorp managed to find the money.

messages.zh: 你可不要希望我将来再帮你什么帮。你这次拒绝绝对是个错误。

messages.en:
The Caldari Providence Directorate has today announced the winning bids for their recent auction of Gallente space. Big winners include Kaalakiota and Sukuuvestaa, while Ishukone makes do with just a single system. The winning corporations are now authorized to exploit these systems to the fullest for as long as they remain in Caldari hands.

As expected, the "blind auction" format seems to have made it difficult for even comparatively wealthy sub-megas, such as perennially successful Ytiri, to gain any kind of foothold. All eight megacorps had at least one successful bid, with Suvee leading the charge and claiming fourteen systems. Meanwhile, in a move many are describing as "baffling," Ishukone has laid claim to a single system: Intaki, generally considered the least promising prospect in the auction due to its comparative lack of mineral wealth and vast native population. Sources believe that this was the only bid Ishukone made, and several political commentators have questioned where the financially struggling megacorp managed to find the money.
messages.zh:
加达里的普罗维登斯总督今天公布了在最近一次盖伦特领土拍卖会上，顺利成交的买主。这次的大买主包括卡拉吉塔集团与斯库维塔集团，异株湖集团仅购得一个星系。只要加达里掌控着这批星系，这些军团就能对它们任意开发。

正如预料的那样，“匿名拍卖”这种形式让耶利集团这种相对富有的小军团也无法从中获得任何利益。所有的8大超级军团都有斩获，其中斯库维塔集团更以购得14个星系独占鳌头。于此同时，异株湖集团这次仅斩获一个印塔基星系，许多人都大呼“看不懂”，因为该星系缺乏大量的矿物资源，同时还有大批本地人扎根在那里。有消息称异株湖这次就竞购了这一星系，一些政治评论家对这一经济上吃紧的超级军团的购买资金来源提出了质疑。

name.es: Refuerzo de las tropas: Corporación Nugoeihuvi
name.ja: 部隊の増強―ノゴエイハヴィコーポレーション
name.ru: Наращивание военных сил - корпорация Nugoeihuvi (Troop Build up - Nugoeihuvi Corporation)

messages.en: The Caldari have one cardinal sin: pride. Knocking out an invasion force will surely deflate their ego a bit. It's a first step in the road to recovering Gallente space, at least.
messages.zh: 加达里人有一个天大的错误：骄傲。摧毁他们的突袭队可以让他们有点自知之明。至少这将成为我们收复盖伦特领域的第一步。

messages.en:
Nugoeihuvi is sending its own security forces to Uphallant in an effort to bolster its influence. Seems like they were expecting a fight all along – they know the true tenacity of the Gallente people. We've tracked a caravan of troop transport ships in Uphallant; we think they're getting ready for a planetside invasion. Luckily, you can stop them in their tracks. Take out the transport ships while there's still time.

< font color = #EE3B3B >Be careful: This mission will take you into lowsec. I would recommend switching to a ship designed for inter-capsuleer conflicts, just in case your piratical brethren want a piece of you en route. messages.zh:
纳维基集团正向乌法兰特派遣一支其自己的安全部队妄图增加其在当地的影响力。看起来他们一直在为战斗做准备——他们知道盖伦特人民坚韧不拔的毅力。我们跟踪到了位于乌法兰特的一批运输船；我们认为对方是在为侵占行星做准备。所幸你有阻止他们的能力，乘现在还有机会去把那批运输船统统炸掉。

< font color = #EE3B3B >注意：该任务会将你引入低安全区。为了防止路上遭人打劫，我建议你驾驶一艘能抗击别人炮轰的舰船。但只要你闯入了那片基地，你就应该无甚大碍了。加达里超级军团的保安力量并不咋的。

messages.en: Crisis averted, for now. Nugoeihuvi will no doubt return and try again, possibly with an even larger force, but we have staved off their thrust for now. There's a lot of work to be done, but your efforts will not go unnoticed. The Federation is grateful for your efforts in our continuing war against the Caldari.
messages.zh: 危机已化解，至少目前是这样。虽然纳维基集团肯定会卷土重来，或许下一次还会带上规模更大的武装力量，但至少目前我们把他们的士气打压下去了。接下来还有很多工作，但你的功劳不会被埋没。联邦对你在我们与加达里的战争中做出的贡献深表感谢。

name.en: Troop Build up - Lai Dai Corporation
name.es: Refuerzo de las tropas: Corporación Lai Dai
name.fr: Rassemblement de troupes - Lai Dai Corporation
name.ja: 部隊の増強―ライダイコーポレーション
name.ru: Наращивание военных сил - корпорация Lai Dai (Troop Build up - Lai Dai Corporation)

messages.en: The Caldari have one cardinal sin: pride. Knocking out an invasion force will surely deflate their ego a bit. It's a first step in the road to recovering Gallente space, at least.
messages.zh: 加达里人有一个天大的错误：骄傲。摧毁他们的突袭队可以让他们有点自知之明。至少这将成为我们收复盖伦特领域的第一步。

messages.en:
Lai Dai Corporation is sending its own security forces to Evaulon in an effort to bolster its influence. Seems like they were expecting a fight all along – they know the true tenacity of the Gallente people. We've tracked a caravan of troop transport ships in Evaulon; we think they're getting ready for a planetside invasion. Luckily, you can stop them in their tracks. Take out the transport ships while there's still time.

< font color = #EE3B3B >Be careful: This mission will take you into lowsec. I would recommend switching to a ship designed for inter-capsuleer conflicts, just in case your piratical brethren want a piece of you en route. Once you get to the site itself, though, you shouldn't receive very much resistance. The megacorporations aren't exactly known for the might of their security forces.
messages.zh:
莱戴集团正向伊万伦派遣一支其自己的安全部队妄图增加其在当地的影响力。看起来他们一直在为战斗做准备——他们知道盖伦特人民坚韧不拔的毅力。我们跟踪到了位于伊万伦的一批运输船；我们认为对方是在为侵占行星做准备。所幸你有阻止他们的能力，乘现在还有机会去把那批运输船统统炸掉。

< font color = #EE3B3B >注意：该任务会将你引入低安全区。为了防止路上遭人打劫，我建议你驾驶一艘能抗击别人炮轰的舰船。但只要你闯入了那片基地，你就应该无甚大碍了。加达里超级军团的保安力量并不咋的。

messages.en: Crisis averted, for now. Lai Dai Corporation will no doubt return and try again, possibly with an even larger force, but we have staved off their thrust for now. There's a lot of work to be done, but your efforts will not go unnoticed. The Federation is grateful for your efforts in our continuing war against the Caldari.
messages.zh: 危机已化解，至少目前是这样。虽然莱戴集团肯定会卷土重来，或许下一次还会带上规模更大的武装力量，但至少目前我们把他们的士气打压下去了。接下来还有很多工作，但你的功劳不会被埋没。联邦对你在我们与加达里的战争中做出的贡献深表感谢。

messages.en: I hope you don't expect me to show good favor toward you in the future. Declining this mission was a poorly considered course of action.
messages.zh: 你可不要希望我将来再帮你什么帮。你这次拒绝绝对是个错误。

messages.en:
The Caldari Providence Directorate has today announced the winning bids for their recent auction of Gallente space. Big winners include Kaalakiota and Sukuuvestaa, while Ishukone makes do with just a single system. The winning corporations are now authorized to exploit these systems to the fullest for as long as they remain in Caldari hands.

As expected, the "blind auction" format seems to have made it difficult for even comparatively wealthy sub-megas, such as perennially successful Ytiri, to gain any kind of foothold. All eight megacorps had at least one successful bid, with Suvee leading the charge and claiming fourteen systems. Meanwhile, in a move many are describing as "baffling," Ishukone has laid claim to a single system: Intaki, generally considered the least promising prospect in the auction due to its comparative lack of mineral wealth and vast native population. Sources believe that this was the only bid Ishukone made, and several political commentators have questioned where the financially struggling megacorp managed to find the money.
messages.zh:
加达里的普罗维登斯总督今天公布了在最近一次盖伦特领土拍卖会上，顺利成交的买主。这次的大买主包括卡拉吉塔集团与斯库维塔集团，异株湖集团仅购得一个星系。只要加达里掌控着这批星系，这些军团就能对它们任意开发。

正如预料的那样，“匿名拍卖”这种形式让耶利集团这种相对富有的小军团也无法从中获得任何利益。所有的8大超级军团都有斩获，其中斯库维塔集团更以购得14个星系独占鳌头。于此同时，异株湖集团这次仅斩获一个印塔基星系，许多人都大呼“看不懂”，因为该星系缺乏大量的矿物资源，同时还有大批本地人扎根在那里。有消息称异株湖这次就竞购了这一星系，一些政治评论家对这一经济上吃紧的超级军团的购买资金来源提出了质疑。

messages.en:
Welcome, {[character]player.name}. I'm told you want to learn some of the more advanced aspects of warfare.

A friend of mine has been summoned to a face-to-face meeting by a local pirate cartel, who've recently been attempting to blackmail him. I want you to take my friend's place and kill these criminals.
messages.zh:
欢迎，{[character]player.name}。有人告诉我你想要学习些更高级的战斗技巧。

本地的一个海盗组织最近想勒索我的一位朋友，他们叫他前去见面。我想让你代替我的朋友去，把那些犯罪分子都干掉，

messages.en: Good work out there. As a show of thanks, my friend passed along part of the blackmail money he'd accumulated. You're clearly ready for bigger things, so let me know when you're ready to learn more.
messages.zh: 干得不错。为了感谢你，我的朋友把原本准备来缴纳赎金的钱拿出一部分给你做报酬。看来你已经做好准备迎接更大挑战了，准备好了之后就来找我。

messages.en: Excellent. I'll tell my friend to stand by while you deal with the problem. Good luck out there, {[character]player.name}. Show us all what you're made of.
messages.zh: 很好，我会让我的朋友在你处理问题的时候就做好准备。祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。让我们看看你到底有什么本领。

messages.en:
Welcome, {[character]player.name}. I'm told you want to learn some of the more advanced aspects of warfare.

A friend of mine has been summoned to a face-to-face meeting by a local pirate cartel, who've recently been attempting to blackmail him. I want you to take my friend's place and kill these criminals.

messages.en: Excellent. Here is the frigate, then. Good luck out there.
messages.zh: 很出色。这是你的护卫舰，祝你好运。

messages.en:
We've discovered the headquarters of the pirate group you dispatched in your last mission, and it's time to take them out for good. I'm going to give you a frigate loaded with proximity-based explosive charges, and your job is to fly it directly into their headquarters.

As your frigate explodes, you'll be perfectly safe inside your capsule, so just relax and get back to me when you're done.
messages.zh:
我们找到了你在上一个任务中歼灭的那些海盗的总部，是时候主持正义了。我会给你一艘护卫舰，上面装载有接近目标就会爆炸的炸弹，而你的任务就是飞到他们的总部去。

护卫舰爆炸后，你会安全地留在救生舱里，所以别紧张，完成任务后回来找我就行了。

messages.en:
Good work. You've now seen for yourself that losing a ship isn't the end of the world. You capsuleers have a saying, though: "Don't fly what you can't afford to lose." If you stick to affordable ships and modules, you'll be able to learn without risking everything you own.

When you're ready for another assignment, let me know.
messages.zh:
干得好。现在你知道爆了艘船也不是什么世界末日了。你们克隆飞行员中有句话：“只开那些你爆得起的船。” 如果你坚持只用负担得起的船和装备的话，你在成长的过程中就不会冒失去一切的风险。

如果你准备好进行下一个任务了，就来找我。

如果你准备好进行下一个任务了，就来找我。

name.ru: Ваше пристальное внимание (Your Undivided Attention) (3 из 10)

messages.en:
Great. Remember, I don't want him dead; just scare him and then get out. It'll send more of a message to the others than just killing him will.

But of course, if he has any escorts, feel free to wipe them out. We'll be watching from a safe distance to make sure you carry out these instructions properly.
messages.zh:
很好，记住，我不需要你把他击毁。只是要吓唬吓唬他就离开那里。那样就足够给他的同伙送去必要的信息了。

但是当然，如果他的身边还有什么护卫的飞船，你完全可以把那些人都消灭掉。我们会在远处观看你的表演，确保你严格执行了命令。

messages.en:
Next up is a kind of interdiction called warp disruption. When activated on another targeted ship, these kinds of modules "tackle" it, disabling its warp drive.

Tackling only works if you keep the target within your module's range and can overpower its Warp Strength. A Warp Disruptor lowers a ship's Warp Strength by 1, while the more powerful Warp Scrambler modules reduce it by 2.

I'll give you a Civilian Warp Disruptor to test out on a pirate that escaped from the headquarters you just blew up. Pin him down, but don't blow him up.
messages.zh:
下面来说说一种 称作跃迁扰断的拦截战术。对目标舰船激活跃迁扰断器会困住它，使它的跃迁引擎失效。

拦截时目标必须保持在你的装备的有效距离内，同时还要保证干扰强度超过目标舰船的跃迁核心强度。跃迁扰断器可以将目标的 跃迁核心强度降低1，更有效的跃迁扰频器可以 降低2。

我会给你一件民用跃迁干扰器，你可以在刚刚被摧毁的敌军总部中逃出的游寇身上试用它。拦截他，但是不要把他击毁。

messages.en:
Nicely done, {[character]player.name}. It looks like our pirate friends got the message loud and clear. Hopefully you understand the basics of warp disruption now. There's more to it, of course, but regardless of how each different type of module works, the principle is always the same – pin them down and keep them there.

Next up, I want to show you something a little more on the defensive end of things. Let me know when you're ready for the next assignment.
messages.zh:
干得不错，{[character]player.name}。看来我们的海盗朋友已经知道我们的厉害了。希望你也在这次行动中明白了跃迁干扰的技术。当然还有更多的细节需要了解，但是无论每种不同的装备如何工作，其中基本的原则都是相同的——捕捉你的目标让他们无法动弹。

接下来，我想要让你更多地了解一些关于防御的知识。等你准备好了就回来告诉我，我们就可以开始下一个任务。

name.ru: Друг познается в беде (A Friend in Need) (4 из 10)

messages.en: Good, but please hurry, his ship is venting oxygen as we speak.
messages.zh: 很好，但你动作要快，他船里所剩氧气已不多。

messages.en: A vessel nearby was attacked by pirates, with the only survivor left for dead in a disabled vessel. We need you to repair his ship with Remote Shield Booster modules, so he can return to safety. Let me stress again that you are to repair the vessel. Not blow it up. I know you capsuleers have an itchy trigger finger at the best of times.

messages.en: Logistics
messages.zh: 后勤

messages.en: Alright, here's the frigate. Don't come back here until you've made a stand against those pirates!
messages.zh: 好了，这就是护卫舰。在你对付过那些游寇之前，不准回来！

messages.en:
Alright, this next assignment is going to test your nerves. We're sending you into a much larger and better defended pirate base. It is unlikely you will defeat all their forces; just put up the best fight you can before being destroyed.

I'll provide you with a combat frigate, but you'll have to fit it with your own modules. I'd keep the fittings cheap — you're not expected to come out of this one intact, although we do expect you to make at least one kill.

Let me stress this point, {[character]player.name}: We want you to kill at least one pirate and then hold out as long as you can, so you may not leave the area until your ship has been destroyed or by some miracle, you survive the fight. Use the frigate I'm giving you since if you lose your own, I will not be replacing it.
messages.zh:
好了，下一个任务要检验你的勇气。我们将派你前往一个规模更大、防守更严密的海盗基地。你不太可能击败他们所有的部队，在被摧毁前拼尽全力就好。

我会为你准备一艘战斗护卫舰，不过你得装上自己的装备。如果我是你，我会选点便宜货——我们没指望你能脱身，但还是希望你能至少击杀一名敌人。

再强调一遍，{[character]player.name}：我们要你干掉至少一名海盗，然后尽可能地坚持下去，所以你不能离开这个区域，除非你的舰船被摧毁，或者你奇迹般地从战斗中幸存下来。用我为你准备的的护卫舰吧，如果你把自己的弄没了，我可不会给你换。

messages.en: Not bad, {[character]player.name}. You did well out there against overwhelming odds. Hopefully, that allowed you to wrestle with the threat of ship loss. In these early days, you probably won't find yourself in such challenging situations, but it's helpful to know how to face them. Whether you lose a ship or not, you can always rise to the next challenge.
messages.zh: 不赖啊，{[character]player.name}。面对这么庞大的敌人，你已经做得很好了。希望这能帮助你克服对于舰船损失的担忧。在目前阶段，你可能还不会遇到这样的考验，但这对于你来说是非常宝贵的经验，能够帮助你学会如何面对这种情况。无论是否损失舰船，你总能够积极地迎接下一个挑战。

messages.en:
There are various situations where you may end up drawing fire, either by accident or intention, and risking the loss of your ship.

You may be scouting a dangerous area that turns out to contain an enemy fleet, or acting as bait to draw fire from enemy ships. The rule remains the same: Never fly anything you cannot afford to lose.
messages.zh:
在各种情况下，你会有意无意成为敌人攻击的目标，冒着损失船只的风险。

你可能会在侦查一片危险区域时遭遇敌军舰队，也可能是装作吸引敌人火力的诱饵。但选择驾驶舰船的规则普遍适用：如果你承受不起这艘船的损失，就不要把它开出来招摇过市。

messages.en: Good luck out there. Just keep the Afterburner going and don't look back.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，记得让你的加力燃烧器全速运转，不要回头。

messages.en:
Welcome back. Now we're going for speed.

You can use two types of active propulsion modules: Afterburners and their bigger brother Microwarpdrives (or MWDs). We're about to teach you how to use Afterburners.

Afterburners don't increase your speed as drastically as MWDs, but they suffer less penalties: They use only a moderate amount of capacitor to run and cannot be disabled by Warp Scramblers. Afterburners are also much easier to fit to your ship - they use less power grid and less CPU, and have no fitting penalties.

We've got an area riddled with dangerous electromagnetic interference that will damage your ship periodically. Your task is to fly through the clouds of EM disturbance using an Afterburner, and make it to the other side in one piece.
messages.zh:
欢迎回来。现在我们要追求速度了。

你可以使用两种主动式推进装备：加力燃烧器和更加强大的微型跃迁推进器（MWD）。我们现在来教你如何使用加力燃烧器。

尽管加力燃烧器不能像微型跃迁推进器一样为你提供巨大的速度提升，但它们不会像MWD一样有很多的负面效果。加力燃烧器对能量的消耗也非常的适度，而MWD则会大量地消耗电容器的能量，而且还可能会受到跃迁干扰设备的扰乱而被关闭。加力燃烧器的装配也更加容易，他们对能量栅格和CPU的需求较低，而且没有惩罚。

我们准备了一个区域，里面充满了危险的电磁干扰，会周期性地对你的船造成损害。你的任务就是使用加力燃烧器穿越这片电磁干扰区域，安全抵达另外一边的终点。

messages.en:
Good work — you made it through the gauntlet alive.

You should take a moment to consider all that you've learned so far and how it all ties together. No module works in isolation. Warp Scramblers, for example (the close-range interdiction modules), don't work well unless you can close in on your enemy, and for that you need an Afterburner. Similarly, if you're using a Warp Disruptor, the long-range variants, you will perhaps want to keep your enemy away from you… so again, Afterburners become useful. Dictating range is a crucial aspect of any engagement, but when you are tackling, it becomes particularly important.
messages.zh:

messages.zh: 祝你好运，记得让你的加力燃烧器全速运转，不要回头。

messages.en:

messages.en: Excellent, good luck out there. I suggest you use the weapon I gave you — it's part of the training process.
messages.zh: 很好，祝你好运！我建议你使用我给你的那些武器，这是训练课程的一部分。

messages.en:
We Minmatar use projectile guns, the best option of all. We don't need any capacitor to fire our weapons, unlike Amarr lasers, which can run a ship dry of capacitor in a matter of minutes. We also have the best weapons for skirmish tactics, allowing us to hit and run with ease.

We've cornered a pirate nearby. I'll provide you with a Civilian Gatling Autocannon, and I hope you finish him off with it.
messages.zh:
我们米玛塔尔人使用射弹炮，这是不二之选。它的发射不消耗任何电容量，这与艾玛的激光武器有本质区别，激光器在数分钟内就会让你的舰船电容消耗殆尽。我们的武器也更加适用于局部小规模冲突，让我们能够轻易地打一枪换一个地方。

我们追踪到了附近的一个游寇。我会给你一件民用加特林自动加农跑，希望你能用它干掉他。

messages.en:
Excellent work out there. Ideally, you've built a little on your understanding of our nation's warfare methods.

Just keep in mind that if you prefer one system over another, you can train into it. None of the empires restrict access to their weapons technology. Of course, Minmatar weapons work best on Minmatar ships, which often give exclusive bonuses to fitting Projectile weapons — so if you tend to like any other type of weapon system, then chances are you'll want to train or cross-train into that race's starships as well.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮。你已经对我们国家的战法战术有了一些基本的认识了。

如果你特别喜欢使用某种武器系统的话，可以多花时间加以训练。没有哪个帝国会对自己的武器技术加以限制。当然，米玛塔尔的武器在米玛塔尔的舰船上能发挥出最佳效果，因为它通常会给与射弹武器一定的加成——所以如果你希望使用别的什么武器系统，那么你或许还需要同时训练那个势力的舰船技能。

messages.en: Excellent, good luck out there. I suggest you use the weapon I gave you — it's part of the training process.
messages.zh: 很好，祝你好运！我建议你使用我给你的那些武器，这是训练课程的一部分。

messages.en:
We Amarr use lasers, the best option of all. Lasers employ reuseable ammunition, which means you won't run dry in the middle of a fight. They deal Electromagnetic (EM) and Thermal damage, a particularly potent combination against ships that use shield boosting instead of armor repair. Shields are vulnerable to EM damage, and lasers can dish out a lot of it.

We've cornered a pirate nearby. I'll provide you with a Civilian Gatling Pulse Laser, and I hope you finish him off with it.
messages.zh:
我们艾玛人使用激光器，这是不二之选。激光器使用的是可以重复使用的弹药，就是说你不会在战斗过程中弹药打光。激光器能造成电磁和热能伤害，这种组合在对阵依靠护盾回充增量器而非装甲维修器的舰船时尤为有效。护盾对电磁伤害的防御很弱，激光器可以轻易打穿它。

我们追踪到了附近的一个游寇。我会给你一件脉冲激光器，希望你能用它干掉他。

messages.en:

Just keep in mind that if you prefer one system over another, you can train into it. None of the empires restrict access to their weapons technology. Of course, Amarr weapons work best on Amarr ships, which often give exclusive bonuses to fitting Laser weapons — so if you tend to like any other type of weapon system, then chances are you'll want to train or cross-train into that race's starships as well.

messages.en: Excellent, good luck out there. I suggest you use the weapon I gave you — it's part of the training process.
messages.zh: 很好，祝你好运！我建议你使用我给你的那些武器，这是训练课程的一部分。

messages.en:
Alongside Hybrid guns, we Caldari use missiles, the best option of all. While weapons from other factions damn near lock you into dealing a single type of damage - EM, Thermal, Kinetic or Explosive - Caldari missiles can deal any kind, and we can switch them out on the fly. We even have Auto-Targeting Missiles that don't require you to lock on to the enemy, which is particularly useful when your electronics systems have been compromised.

We've cornered a pirate nearby. I'll provide you with a Civilian Light Missile Launcher, and I hope you finish him off with it.
messages.zh:
加达里除了使用混合炮台之外还使用导弹，它是不二之选。与各大势力只能提供较单一的伤害类型（电磁、热能、动能或爆炸）的武器相比，加达里导弹拥有各种伤害类型，而且可以在飞行中直接切换。我们甚至还有无需锁定目标的自动锁定导弹，它在飞船的电子系统失灵时使用尤其有效。

我们追踪到了附近的一个游寇。我会为你提供一件民用轻型导弹发射器，希望你能用它干掉他。

messages.en:
Excellent work out there. Ideally, you've built a little on your understanding of our nation's warfare methods.

messages.en: Excellent, good luck out there. I suggest you use the weapon I gave you — it's part of the training process.
messages.zh: 很好，祝你好运！我建议你使用我给你的那些武器，这是训练课程的一部分。

messages.en:
Alongside Hybrid guns, we Gallente use drones, the best option of all. They are highly versatile, with different types capable of anything from head-on rush tactics to electronic disruption. Moreover, they can allow you to fight from a safe distance - in fact, if someone compromises your electronics system and you can't even lock them, your drones will sense that aggression and come to your aid. The only limits to their number are your ship's drone bay and its drone bandwidth.

We've cornered a pirate nearby. I'll provide you with a Civilian Drone, and I hope you finish him off with it.
messages.zh:
盖伦特除了使用混合炮台之外还使用无人机，它是不二之选。它的适用性非常广，有多种类型，能胜任从快速袭击到电子扰断等多项工作。此外，他们可以让你在安全距离之外攻击——事实上，如果你的电子系统被人瘫痪了，你连锁定都做不了，而你的无人机却可以对攻击你的目标实施反击。你能使用的无人机数量只受你舰船的无人机挂舱和带宽限制。

我们追踪到了附近的一个游寇。我会给你一架民用无人机，希望你能用它干掉他。

messages.en:
Excellent work out there. Ideally, you've built a little on your understanding of our nation's warfare methods.

Just keep in mind that if you prefer one system over another, you can train into it. None of the empires restrict access to their weapons technology. Of course, Gallente weapons work best on Gallente ships, which often give exclusive bonuses to fitting Hybrid weapons or drones — so if you tend to like any other type of weapon system, then chances are you'll want to train or cross-train into that race's starships as well.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮。你已经对我们国家的战法战术有了一些基本的认识了。

如果你特别喜欢使用某种武器系统的话，可以多花时间加以训练。没有哪个帝国会对自己的武器技术加以限制。当然，盖伦特的武器在盖伦特的舰船上能发挥出最佳效果，因为它通常会给与混合武器以及无人机一定的加成——所以如果你希望使用别的什么武器系统，那么你或许还需要同时训练那个势力的舰船技能。

messages.en: Alright, good luck then. Pay close attention to your orders as they are given; don't just charge in and start shooting.
messages.zh: 好吧，祝你好运。记住要仔细执行你的命令，不要傻乎乎的就这么冲进去乱射。

messages.en:
Fleet Warfare is common in New Eden, and in any fleet, the Fleet Commander (often referred to as 'FC') is the most important voice to listen to.

 For your next assignment, you will join one of our local anti-piracy fleets as auxiliary support for a hostage rescue. You will take your orders from a local CONCORD FC, and your job will be explained to you once you arrive at the perimeter of the base. Follow the instructions carefully; the lives of those hostages and the completion of your own training depend on it.
messages.zh:
这宇宙中舰队会战司空见惯。在任何舰队中，倾听舰队指挥官的发号施令都是非常重要的。

在下一个任务中，你要加入我们本地的一支打击海盗的舰队，协助执行一项人质救援任务。你要听命于本地的统合部舰队指挥官，在到达基地后你就会接到你的任务指示。你要想救出人质并完成任务，就好好听从指令。

messages.en: Well done out there. You followed your orders, as I hoped you would. There's a lot more to being a competent fleet pilot, of course, but so often it is these simple lessons that are forgotten the fastest. Discipline counts for a great deal.
messages.zh: 干得不错，正如我所期待的一样你完全地遵守指挥官的命令。作为一个舰队飞行员还有很多东西是需要学习的，但要知道，更多的时候正是这样简单的一些准则才是最容易被忽略的。纪律是飞行员最重要的素质。

messages.en: Capsuleer fleets fight each other by focusing their fire on a single enemy ship, killing it swiftly and moving on to the next target in a prioritized fashion. These priorities, with targets often designated "primary" and "secondary", will be communicated by the FC and should be heeded.
messages.zh: 舰队成员集中火力攻击敌方的某艘舰船，迅速击毁之后马上按照优先级集火下一艘。这种优先级会确定攻击的首要目标和次要目标，通常由舰队指挥官来下令，所有人听从。

messages.en: Fleet Warfare
messages.zh: 舰队战术

messages.en: Alright, good luck then. Pay close attention to your orders as they are given; don't just charge in and start shooting.
messages.zh: 好吧，祝你好运。记住要仔细执行你的命令，不要傻乎乎的就这么冲进去乱射。

messages.zh: 舰队成员集中火力攻击敌方的某艘舰船，迅速击毁之后马上按照优先级集火下一艘。这种优先级会确定攻击的首要目标和次要目标，通常由舰队指挥官来下令，所有人听从。

messages.en: Fleet Warfare
messages.zh: 舰队战术

messages.en: Alright, good luck then. Pay close attention to your orders as they are given; don't just charge in and start shooting.
messages.zh: 好吧，祝你好运。记住要仔细执行你的命令，不要傻乎乎的就这么冲进去乱射。

messages.en:
Fleet Warfare is common in New Eden, and in any fleet, the Fleet Commander (often referred to as 'FC') is the most important voice to listen to.

For your next assignment, you will join one of our local anti-piracy fleets as auxiliary support for a hostage rescue. You will take your orders from a local CONCORD FC, and your job will be explained to you once you arrive at the perimeter of the base. Follow the instructions carefully; the lives of those hostages and the completion of your own training depend on it.
messages.zh:
这宇宙中舰队会战司空见惯。在任何舰队中，倾听舰队指挥官的发号施令都是非常重要的。

在下一个任务中，你要加入我们本地的一支打击海盗的舰队，协助执行一项人质救援任务。你要听命于本地的统合部舰队指挥官，在到达基地后你就会接到你的任务指示。你要想救出人质并完成任务，就好好听从指令。

messages.en: Well done out there. You followed your orders, as I hoped you would. There's a lot more to being a competent fleet pilot, of course, but so often it is these simple lessons that are forgotten the fastest. Discipline counts for a great deal.
messages.zh: 干得不错，正如我所期待的一样你完全地遵守指挥官的命令。作为一个舰队飞行员还有很多东西是需要学习的，但要知道，更多的时候正是这样简单的一些准则才是最容易被忽略的。纪律是飞行员最重要的素质。

messages.en:
We're returning to interdiction tactics by having you test out a Stasis Webifier module. When activated on a target ship, the Stasis Webifier will encase it in a containment field and slow it down dramatically.

Time for you to see for yourself. We've chased a pirate down to a nearby hideout and we want you to pin him down. We'll provide you with a Civilian Stasis Webifier, and you may want to fit an afterburner, too.
messages.zh:
我们现在来学习拦截战术。你需要试用下停滞缠绕光束装备。 在战场上对目标舰船使用停滞缠绕光束，会在其周围形成一个力场从而大大降低它的飞行速度。

现在是时候让你亲身体验下了。我们最近在追踪一个游寇，已经把他逼到了一个在附近的藏身地点里，我们需要你去拦截他。我们将为你提供一件民用停滞缠绕光束，你可能也需要装配一件加力燃烧器。

messages.en:
Nicely done. You applied just the right amount of firepower necessary, something which can often yield more than outright slaughter.

You've almost completed your training with us. Once you're done, we plan to recommend you to our nation's capsuleer militia: The Tribal Liberation Force. What you have learned from us would be quickly overshadowed by what you could learn while fighting to free your brothers and sisters. You might think money would be a more suitable reward, but reputation matters a great deal in New Eden, and so does finding somewhere you can call a home.

To belong to the Liberation Force though, you must prove yourself as a combat pilot. That is what lies ahead, {[character]player.name} — get a combat ship fitted out and get yourself ready for a fight.
messages.zh:
做得很漂亮。你只用了恰到好处的火力就达成了目的，避免了造成巨大的弹药浪费和滥伤。

你在我们这里接受的训练任务就快要结束了。等你完成之后，我们打算把你推荐给我们国家的克隆飞行员国民卫队：部族解放力量。你从我们这里学到的东西很快就会被你在实战中所学到的技术所超越，这些战斗正是为了解放你的同胞，兄弟和姐妹们的战斗。你或许认为金钱才是最好的回报，但是在新伊甸里声誉才是真正值钱的东西，另外最重要的就是找到一个可以称之为家的地方。

要同部族解放力量一起战斗，你需要证明你作为一个战斗飞行员的真才实干。{[character]player.name}，接下来你要做的事情——就是搞到一艘战舰，并完成配置工作，时刻准备好迎击敌人。

messages.en: Stasis Webifiers are most commonly known as "webs" or "webbers".  They work very well in combination with Warp Scramblers - using them both on the same target will scramble it for two "points", halve its speed, and render it unable to use Microwarpdrives. Without a scrambler, a target may use its MWD to escape you.
messages.zh: 停滞缠绕光束被大家俗称为“网”。  它和跃迁扰频器配合使用效果极佳——二者同时作用于同一目标会起到双重“效果”，降低目标的速度并使它不能使用微型跃迁推进器。如果没有扰频器的配合，目标就很容易使用微型跃迁推进器逃脱你的“网”。

messages.zh: 关于停滞缠绕光束的更多信息：

messages.zh: 关于停滞缠绕光束的更多信息：

messages.en: Stay focused out there, {[character]player.name}. Once you commit yourself to this fight, it won't end until one of you loses a ship.
messages.zh: 你过去要当心点，{[character]player.name}。要知道一旦你发起了攻击，如果没有分出胜负的话，战斗是不会结束的。

messages.en:
Alright, time to apply everything you've learned. One of our patrols has spotted a group of suspicious vessels headed towards a local pleasure hub. One of the pilots is a known terrorist responsible for dozens of station bombings.

A CONCORD raid would alert them too early and we'd risk the terrorist escaping. We need this murderer taken out while we have his location, so you must move in by yourself and assassinate him.
messages.zh:
好，现在是检验你的学习成果的时候了。我们的一支巡逻队发现了一支可疑的舰队，它们正朝着本地的娱乐中心飞过去。这些人中的一个是有名的恐怖分子，与多起空间站爆炸袭击有关。

如果统合部派人去清剿的话，会打草惊蛇，可能会让恐怖分子跑掉。我们要在知晓那个恐怖分子的位置之后动手，所以你必须独自前去除掉他。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}! You've proven you know how to handle yourself in deadly situations.

We can always use good pilots like yourself, you should consider enlisting in Factional Warfare, where you can fight alongside other pilots pledged to the Republic. If instead, you would rather broaden your skills, you can start a conversation with any of my fellow Career Agents right here in this station.

Whatever you choose to do next, I thank you for the help you've given us. Fly safe, Captain.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，干得漂亮！你现在已经向大家证明了在致命环境下你有掌控局势的能力。

我们一直需要像你这样优秀的飞行员，你可以考虑参加势力战争，与其他誓死效忠共和国的飞行员并肩作战。反之，如果你更想拓展自己的技能，可与站内与我共事的其他职业代理人聊一聊。

无论你下一步选择是什么，我都非常感激你提供的帮助。一路顺风，舰长。

messages.en:
Be prepared for him to use a Warp Disruptor and Stasis Webifier. I do not suggest you fit Warp Core Stabilizers, though - they will negatively impact your locking time and locking range, and take up precious low power slots that could be used to increase your damage, your capacitor recharge, or your repair abilities.

Also, keep your eyes on the prize: Your primary target is the terrorist, not his wingmen, and it's your call whether you need to take them down as well. If you do, you may need to start by picking off the weakest targets from a distance, possibly with varying ammunition types.
messages.zh:
他会使用跃迁扰断器和停滞缠绕光束，你要做好准备。我不建议你装跃迁核心稳定器——它会影响你的锁定速度和锁定距离，而且占了一个宝贵的低槽位，你用这个低槽来提高伤害、电容回充速率或维修能力多好。

还有，时刻注意你的任务奖励：你的首要目标是那个恐怖分子，不是他的跟班，当然，是不是也送他们上西天你说了算。如果你打算这么做的话，你可能得从远处先挑最弱的目标下手，可能还得多带几种类型的弹药。

messages.en: Tactics for the fight ahead
messages.zh: 行动战术

messages.en: Stay focused out there, {[character]player.name}. Once you commit yourself to this fight, it won't end until one of you loses a ship.
messages.zh: 你过去要当心点，{[character]player.name}。要知道一旦你发起了攻击，如果没有分出胜负的话，战斗是不会结束的。

messages.en:
We're going to be stepping back on this one and letting you take control of the situation. One of our patrols spotted a small group of suspicious vessels headed towards a local pleasure hub. After processing their ship's ID tags, we've determined that one of the pilots is a known terrorist responsible for dozens of station bombings.

A CONCORD raid into the premises would be picked up by the terrorists well before the ships actually arrived. We need this murderer taken out while we have his location, so you must move in yourself and then assassinate him, understand?
messages.zh:
在这个项目里，我们会让你自己操控局势，而我不会进行干预。我们的一支巡逻队发现了一股可疑的舰队，它们正朝着本地的娱乐中心飞过去。经过对它们舰上的识别标记进行分析后，我们认定他们是隶属于一个恐怖组织的舰船，这个恐怖组织曾经参与了数次对空间站的攻击行动。

如果现在统合部进入这个区域实施拦截的话，在他们到达之前这些恐怖份子就会知道这个情报。我们需要在还能够追踪到这个罪犯的时候就把他干掉，所以你必须要赶快动身前去歼灭他，明白么？

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}! You've proven you know how to handle yourself in deadly situations.

We can always use good pilots like yourself, you should consider enlisting in Factional Warfare, where you can fight alongside other pilots pledged to the Empire. If instead, you would rather broaden your skills, you can start a conversation with any of my fellow Career Agents right here in this station.

Whatever you choose to do next, I thank you for the help you've given us. Fly safe, Captain.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，干得漂亮！你现在已经向大家证明了在致命环境下你有掌控局势的能力。

我们一直需要像你这样优秀的飞行员，你可以考虑参加势力战争，与其他誓死效忠帝国的飞行员并肩作战。反之，如果你更想拓展自己的技能，可与站内与我共事的其他职业代理人聊一聊。

无论你下一步选择是什么，我都非常感激你提供的帮助。一路顺风，舰长。

messages.en:
Be prepared for him to use a Warp Disruptor and Stasis Webifier. I do not suggest you fit Warp Core Stabilizers, though - they will negatively impact your locking time and locking range, and take up precious low power slots that could be used to increase your damage, your capacitor recharge, or your repair abilities.

Also, keep your eyes on the prize: Your primary target is the terrorist, not his wingmen, and it's your call whether you need to take them down as well. If you do, you may need to start by picking off the weakest targets from a distance, possibly with varying ammunition types.
messages.zh:
他会使用跃迁扰断器和停滞缠绕光束，你要做好准备。我不建议你装跃迁核心稳定器——它会影响你的锁定速度和锁定距离，而且占了一个宝贵的低槽位，你用这个低槽来提高伤害、电容回充速率或维修能力多好。

还有，时刻注意你的任务奖励：你的首要目标是那个恐怖分子，不是他的跟班，当然，是不是也送他们上西天你说了算。如果你打算这么做的话，你可能得从远处先挑最弱的目标下手，可能还得多带几种类型的弹药。

messages.zh: 你过去要当心点，{[character]player.name}。要知道一旦你发起了攻击，如果没有分出胜负的话，战斗是不会结束的。

messages.en: Tactics for the fight ahead
messages.zh: 行动战术

messages.en: Chapter 1 - Probationary
messages.zh: 第一章——试用期

messages.en: I ambushed a Minedrill expedition and took the Minedrill crew prisoners. Latamaki seems confident that they'll be providing useful information in the very near future. He presumes that Minedrill is gathering resources for the Navy, and that my help will be needed again soon.
messages.zh: 我偷袭了一支矿钻远征队，抓获了其中的船员。拉塔马基似乎很自信地认为他们很快就能提供有价值的情报。他猜测远征队在为海军获取资源，而我也很快会再次受命。

messages.en: I've contacted Kori Latamaki, a mission planner for the Guristas. He directed me to lie in wait for a Minedrill expedition. I'm supposed to dispose of the combat escorts and take the Minedrill industrial crew.
messages.zh: 我与古斯塔斯的一位名叫“考利·拉塔马基”的任务策划者会了面。他让我去守候一支矿钻远征队。我的任务就是摧毁他们的保驾战船，然后带回远征队的船员。

messages.en: We're not just a bunch of swashbuckling goons. Despite the slander from the empires, we know what we're doing, and we're damn good at it. Stick with us, egger. You'll get rich if you do.
messages.zh: 我们可不是一帮头脑简单的粗人。虽说帝国的人喜欢诋毁我们，但我们知道我们在干什么，而且干得还特别好。跟我们干吧，克隆飞行员，我们包你腰缠万贯。

messages.en: Wait for the Minedrill expedition. When they arrive, take out the expedition fleet and bring back the industrial's crew.
messages.zh: 等矿钻远征队的前来。他们现身之后，把整支队伍舰船都解决掉，然后带回工业舰上的船员。

messages.en: Great. We should be getting reliable intelligence from them soon. If I were you, I'd take it easy for a bit. Based on Minedrill's recent activity, it's fair to say they have a major contract with somebody; probably the Navy.
messages.zh: 很好。我们应该很快就能从他们嘴里获得可靠的情报了。如果我是你，我会比较放松一点。从矿钻远征队最近的行动来看，他们有可能在履行一项大合同；合同另一方可能就是海军。

messages.en: I knew that we were taking a gamble by using a capsuleer. Get out of here, and go back to your safety net. Good luck with those bubble camps, though.
messages.zh: 我就知道用克隆飞行员是件不靠谱的事。走吧走吧，回到你那“温馨”的家去吧。不过可别忘了路上要遭遇的海盗，为你自己祈祷吧。

messages.en:
So you want to fly for the Guristas? Welcome aboard, egger. You get to do some rookie stuff.

We've leaked information on the location of a particularly rich group of asteroids within Venal. We expect a Minedrill expedition to show up soon, and we want someone to be there to greet them. You can expect their expedition to be made up of several combat escorts and an industrial.

Take out the industrial and grab its crew. Knowing Minedrill, this'll just be a research team – they need to test the rocks first before sending in those expensive barges. But once we have their people, we can mine their personnel for any intelligence on future ops.

If you haven't picked up on this already, we're a cautious bunch. We like to make sure whatever op we run goes off right. We have weapon caches, safe houses, and agents everywhere we plan to operate, even in empire space. The Guristas have contingencies for everything, even in dealing with someone like you.
messages.zh:
这么说你想为古斯塔斯打工？欢迎欢迎，克隆飞行员。先让你干点起步活吧。

我们泄漏了维纳尔星域里一处矿产特别富饶的小行星带，估计矿钻远征队会很快前往那儿。我们要派个人去“迎接”他们。那支队伍应该会由数支战船与一艘工业舰组成。

你的任务就是摧毁那艘工业舰，将其中的船员带回来。 根据我们对矿钻远征队的了解，那应该只是支研究队——他们得先 勘测一下那些小行星然后才敢派遣价值不菲的驳船前往。一旦我们抓获了那批船员，我们就能从他们口中得知其以后各项计划。

如果你还没弄明白这样做的目的，那我就告诉你：我们为人谨慎。我们确保每一次行动都万无一失。我们到处都有武器库、藏身处及代理人。古斯塔斯对每件事情都做好了准备，其中还包括如何对付像你这样的人。

messages.en: I knew that we were taking a gamble by using a capsuleer. Get out of here, and go back to your safety net. Good luck with those bubble camps, though.
messages.zh: 我就知道用克隆飞行员是件不靠谱的事。走吧走吧，回到你那“温馨”的家去吧。不过可别忘了路上要遭遇的海盗，为你自己祈祷吧。

messages.en: Have they shown up yet? What's your status?
messages.zh: 他们出现了吗？事情怎么样？

messages.en:
My exploits caught the attention of a SARO agent named Treonis. Normally the Angels would handle the disposal of a CONCORD pilot on their own. After I fought other pirate factions, destroyed capsuleers, and drove out an empire corporation, someone high up in the Cartel wanted to use the extermination of a CONCORD pilot as a final test.

I passed.
messages.zh:
我的行动引起了一位名叫“特瑞欧尼丝”的SARO代理人的注意。通常情况下天使集团会亲自辗除统合部的代理人。但在我对抗过其他海盗势力、干掉了克隆飞行员并驱逐掉一个帝国军团之后，天使集团的上层给我安排了期终考试：只身前往处理掉那个代理人。

我顺利完成了任务。

messages.en: My exploits caught the attention of a SARO agent named Treonis. The Angels would normally handle the disposal of a CONCORD pilot on their own, but someone high up in the Cartel wants to use this as a final test. If I can eliminate Treonis, the Angels will reward me with a Cynabal BPC.
messages.zh: 我的行动引起了一位名叫“特瑞欧尼丝”的SARO代理人的注意。通常情况下天使集团会亲自辗除统合部的代理人。但在我对抗过其他海盗势力、干掉了克隆飞行员并驱逐掉一个帝国军团之后，天使集团的上层给我安排了期终考试：只身前往处理掉那个代理人。如果我能解决特瑞欧尼丝，天使就会送我一张“塞纳波级”的蓝图。

messages.en: I envy your chance to space a CONCORD pilot.
messages.zh: 真羡慕你能有修理统合部代理人的机会。

messages.en:
All the carnage you've inflicted on our enemies has caught the attention of a SARO pilot, Treonis. Taking you out is her bid at a promotion. My superiors want to see you handle this situation alone.

Treonis is waiting for you by an abandoned colony in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Destroy her, and the blueprint is yours.
messages.zh:
你的敌人面前的出色表现已经引起了SARO飞行员“特瑞欧尼丝”的注意。我猜她是要把你除掉，这样她就能高升了。我的上级要你自己去解决这事。

特瑞欧尼丝现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个废弃殖民地等你。干掉她，这蓝图就是你的。

messages.en:
My superiors are impressed. It's the rare pilot who can take on SARO agents and live.

Take this blueprint as a sign of our appreciation, not only for what you've done, but also for what you have become. I'm sure we'll be crossing paths again someday, whether you realize it or not.

Fly safe, {[character]player.name}. Remind the galaxy why they fear Angels.
messages.zh:
我的上级对你的表现大加赞赏。能解决统合部代理人并且又活着回来的飞行员实属不多。

你把这蓝图拿好，算是我们对你表示的谢意与首肯。我们肯定的不仅是你的贡献，还有你的成长。不管你是否会意识到，我相信将来我们一定能再见。

一路顺风，{[character]player.name}。让全宇宙都知道天使的厉害。

messages.en: My superiors will be disappointed. We do not offer our technology to just anyone.
messages.zh: 我的上级一定会对此倍感失望。我们可不会随便给予自己的技术。

messages.en: Despite CONCORD's strong association with empire space, they occasionally sponsor larger campaigns out in nullsec. These excursions are targeted at the "pirate" factions under the justification of returning the violence committed in high security space. CONCORD's Special Affairs for Regulations & Order (SARO) is uniquely suited for these campaigns. Their training, hardware, and skill make them a threat not to be taken lightly.
messages.zh: 虽然统合部与帝国的联系甚密，但他们有时也会在0.0区域出动。在“以暴制暴”的口号之下，这类行动的主要打击对象都是“海盗势力”。统合部旗下的“法规秩序特别事务局（SARO）”就专门负责此类事务。他们所经受的训练、配备的装备及掌握的技术都是他们成为一股不可小觑的力量。

messages.en: SARO
messages.zh: 法规秩序特别事务局（SARO）

messages.en:
Aren't you the lucky one? All the carnage you've inflicted on our enemies has caught the attention of SARO. They are the best that CONCORD has to offer, and they're not to be balked at.

This particular SARO pilot's name is Treonis, and she's been asking for you personally. My guess? Taking you out is her bid at a promotion.

Normally, we would launch a whole campaign to remove CONCORD scum from our space, but my superiors want to see you handle this situation. If you can destroy Treonis, I'm authorized to reward you with a single run blueprint for one of our rarer ships, the Cynabal.

Treonis is waiting for you by an abandoned colony in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Destroy her, and the blueprint is yours.
messages.zh:
你这家伙真幸运，你的敌人面前的出色表现已经引起了“法规秩序特别事务局（SARO）”的注意。他们是统合部中的精兵，绝对不容小视。

现在有位名叫“特瑞欧尼丝”的SARO飞行员要亲自审问你。你问我她想干什么？我猜她是要把你除掉，这样她就能高升了。

正常情况下，我们会发动一场大规模袭击将统合部清剿出我们的领域，但我的上级要你自己去解决这事。如果你能把特瑞欧尼丝干掉，我会把我们这里一种稀有船只“塞纳波级”的流程为1的蓝图送给你。

特瑞欧尼丝现在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个废弃殖民地等你。干掉她，这蓝图就是你的。

messages.en: My superiors will be disappointed. We do not offer our technology to just anyone.
messages.zh: 我的上级一定会对此倍感失望。我们可不会随便给予自己的技术。

messages.en: Is that SARO pilot, Treonis, still alive?
messages.zh: 那位名叫“特瑞欧尼丝”的SARO代理人还活着吗？

messages.en: Good, because there's no time to lose. We received a distress signal from a small operation. They were trying to get what they could from the field before the ORE hulks blew through. Something seems to have gone wrong. Find out what happened and save the crew, materiel and product that you can.
messages.zh: 爽快，我们时间本来就不多。我们收到了来自一支小矿队的求救信号。他们想抢在联合矿业的霍克级矿船开进之前尽量多采些矿石。但接下来好像出了意外。你去探个究竟，竭尽所能救出那些矿工，并运回他们的矿石。

messages.en: Travel to the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system where miners are in conflict over an asteroid field. Find out what's happened to a small, independent mining operation fallen silent. Also, keep an eye on any messages in your Local channel. I don't want you bringing the crew back here, but they might need to be moved to someplace safe.
messages.zh: 前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，那里的矿工们因为一片小行星带的归属权而起了冲突。一支小规模的独立矿队没了音讯，你要去查明真相。另外，你要时刻关注本地频道的信息，我不需要你把那些人员带回我这里来，但你要把他们送到一个安全的地方去。

messages.en: Yes, I suppose the blood money offered elsewhere might be more lucrative.
messages.zh: 好吧，看来别人给的不义之财对你更有吸引力。

messages.en: Hey, {[character]player.name}, ever been screwed over by the big corporations? Well, here's a chance for some payback. There's controversy out in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system, where ORE lays dubious mining claim to a massive asteroid field. Problem is, independent groups working the field are at risk of being consumed – literally. There's something strange going on out there. Interested in finding out what's happening, and striking a blow for the little guy?
messages.zh: 嗨，{[character]player.name}！你是不是曾经遭受过大军团的欺负？现在你有机会报仇了。{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系那儿出了点争端，联合矿业自称有一大片小行星带是自己的。现在的问题是，在那儿工作的独立矿工们面临被消灭的危险。那里好像不正常。怎么样？你有兴趣到那里探个究竟吗，顺便拔刀相助一下？

messages.en: Yes, I suppose the blood money offered elsewhere might be more lucrative.
messages.zh: 好吧，看来别人给的不义之财对你更有吸引力。

messages.en: What's your progress on offering aid to those miners? Without their independent streak, the big corps might take over that entire system. And don't be bringing any of the miners to my front door, either.
messages.zh: 拯救矿工的行动进展如何了？没有那些独立矿工的话，大军团们可能会霸占整个星系。还有，别把矿工带到我这儿来。

name.ja: セブンその後（1/5）『リプレイスメント』

messages.en: There's really no more time to waste with conversation.  Head out at once.
messages.zh: 咱们别在这儿废话了。你赶快去那里吧。

messages.en: A convoy of civilian ships traveling through a region known to be rife with pirate activity has become vulnerable due to its contingent of escort combat vessels not showing up for some reason.  Their distress signal has been picked up in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system.
messages.zh: 一支民用运输队正在穿越一个已知海盗横行的星域，然而随行的护航战舰们不知为何没有出现，运输队因此处境不妙。我们收到了他们从{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系发出的求救信号。

messages.en: Well done fending off those pirates. Some of them escaped, you say?
messages.zh: 你把那帮海盗击退了，干得好。你说还有些杂鱼逃掉了？

messages.en: What a surprise.  Yet another unreliable capsuleer.
messages.zh: 不出所料。你果然又是一个靠不住的克隆飞行员。

messages.en:
While I enjoy the tremendous service capsuleers provide agents like me, I can't begin to count how many times I've been let down over the years by those lacking the proper skills, judgment, diligence, or a rudimentary attention span. It seems that the last few I hired to provide an armed escort for a convoy of civilian transports has gone missing, probably lured away by a more lucrative job.

I need you to head to the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and meet up with the convoy at once. If they‘re in any kind of trouble when you arrive, please take care of it.
messages.zh:
虽说有些克隆飞行员能出色地完成代理人指派的任务，这点我很喜欢，但这些年来，也有另一些飞行员让我经历了数不清的失望，有的水平不够、有的判断力有问题、有的偷懒，还有的干脆没耐心。最近我雇佣了一些克隆飞行员去武装保驾一支民用运输队，可他们最后都像失踪了一样，也许都去转接待遇更好的任务了。

我现在要你前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，立即与民用运输队汇合。如果你在那里碰到有海盗骚扰，请把他们都解决掉。

messages.en: You're kidding me, right?
messages.zh: 你在和我开玩笑吧？

messages.en: You shouldn't be chatting with me when you have work to do.
messages.zh: 你要是手头有差事，就别跟我废话。

messages.en: Good, because there's no time to lose. We received a distress signal from a small operation. They were trying to get what they could from the field before the ORE hulks blew through. Something seems to have gone wrong. Find out what happened and save the crew, materiel and product that you can.
messages.zh: 爽快，我们时间本来就不多。我们收到了来自一支小矿队的求救信号。他们想抢在联合矿业的霍克级矿船开进之前尽量多采些矿石。但接下来好像出了意外。你去探个究竟，竭尽所能救出那些矿工，并运回他们的矿石。

messages.en: Travel to the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system where miners are in conflict over an asteroid field. Find out what's happened to a small, independent mining operation fallen silent. Also, keep an eye on any messages in your Local channel. I don't want you bringing the crew back here, but they might need to be moved to someplace safe.
messages.zh: 前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，那里的矿工们因为一片小行星带的归属权而起了冲突。一支小规模的独立矿队没了音讯，你要去查明真相。另外，你要时刻关注本地频道的信息，我不需要你把那些人员带回我这里来，但你要把他们送到一个安全的地方去。

messages.en: There's hope yet for the small entrepreneur! ORE's dismissive attitude toward miner claims in that system has brought a lot of bad publicity on the corporation. Your efforts have gone a long way toward causing that.
messages.zh: 看来小企业家还是有生存空间的！那些矿工宣称对那星系中的小行星带具有所有权，联合矿业却对此不屑一顾，这种态度极大地损害了该集团的形象。这其中的很多功劳都应该加到你头上。

messages.en: Yes, I suppose the blood money offered elsewhere might be more lucrative.
messages.zh: 好吧，看来别人给的不义之财对你更有吸引力。

messages.en: Hey, {[character]player.name}, ever been screwed over by the big corporations? Well, here's a chance for some payback. There's controversy out in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system, where ORE lays dubious mining claim to a massive asteroid field. Problem is, independent groups working the field are at risk of being consumed – literally. There's something strange going on out there. Interested in finding out what's happening, and striking a blow for the little guy?
messages.zh: 嗨，{[character]player.name}！你是不是曾经遭受过大军团的欺负？现在你有机会报仇了。{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系那儿出了点争端，联合矿业自称有一大片小行星带是自己的。现在的问题是，在那儿工作的独立矿工们面临被消灭的危险。那里好像不正常。怎么样？你有兴趣到那里探个究竟吗，顺便拔刀相助一下？

messages.en: Yes, I suppose the blood money offered elsewhere might be more lucrative.
messages.zh: 好吧，看来别人给的不义之财对你更有吸引力。

messages.en: What's your progress on offering aid to those miners? Without their independent streak, the big corps might take over that entire system. And don't be bringing any of the miners to my front door, either.
messages.zh: 拯救矿工的行动进展如何了？没有那些独立矿工的话，大军团们可能会霸占整个星系。还有，别把矿工带到我这儿来。

messages.en: Great!  You should depart at once if you're going to catch the Seven before the hostages are moved to another facility.
messages.zh: 很好！你应该趁着人质还没被转移到别处之前，立刻出发去追击七人组。

messages.en: After only being able to make off with a fraction of the civilians from their raid, The Seven were tracked back to their hideout.  Attacking them there should eliminate their local base of operations and allow for the remaining hostages to be rescued.
messages.zh: 在突袭中劫持了寥寥几个平民之后，七人组又撤回到了其藏身地。追到那里并攻击他们，这样应该可以打垮他们在当地的行动基地，同时救出剩余人质。

messages.en: I'd flatter you with congratulations, but there's still work to be done.
messages.zh: 我真想不停地夸你，但事情还没完。

messages.en: Whatever.  I'll find someone else to clean up your mess.
messages.zh: 无所谓。我会找其他人来为你擦屁股的。

messages.en:
The Seven? I was hoping it wasn't that particular gang again.

While we're very grateful that you managed to prevent most of the civilians from being kidnapped, there is still the issue of the ones that were taken. When they warped away from the last encounter, we were able to track them down and obtain the coordinates of that hideout. I'm prepared to grant you the authority, on behalf of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, to hunt down these criminals. What do you say? Are you still willing to help?
messages.zh:
七人组？我刚才还在想，最好不是他们。

你成功地让大部分平民都免遭绑架，我们对此深表感激，但还是有一小部分人被掳走了。七人组撤离的时候，我们对其进行了跟踪，然后成功获悉了其藏身地的具体位置。我准备代表{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}，批准你去追剿那帮犯罪份子。怎么样？你愿意出手帮忙吗？

messages.en: Hey, I understand.  We all have priorities in life.  Mine just happen to be productivity, compassion, and loyalty, while yours appear to be somewhere between lethargy and unscrupulousness.
messages.zh: 没事，我懂的。每个人都有自己的追求。我追求的是效率、同情心及忠诚度，而你追求的是不作为与没良知。

messages.en: It might be a good idea to maintain radio silence during this particular mission, don't you think?
messages.zh: 在这个任务中最好保持无线电静默，你觉得呢？

messages.en: Quickly, before he gets away!
messages.zh: 快，趁他还没溜走！
