messages.en: Phenod, the resident idiot of The Seven's organization, has stranded himself on his way to pick up some hostages.  With his DNA, a suitable transponder disguise can be forged allowing some undercover work against the gang.
messages.zh: 作为七人组里出了名的蠢货，菲诺德脱离了大部队，单独去取一些人质了。利用他的DNA，就能制作出一个伪造应答器，用于针对七人组的卧底行动。

messages.en: Stick around, there's more to do.
messages.zh: 别走，接下来还有事情。

messages.en: Am I going to have to take care of this myself?
messages.zh: 难道要我亲自出马？

messages.en:
One of those hostages you rescued turned out to be quite resourceful. While aboard the pirate's vessel, she hacked into its communication logs and discovered something interesting. One of The Seven's core members, a man named Phenod, has managed to strand himself in space on his way to pick up some victims that were kidnapped some time ago.

We have a golden opportunity here to not only strike a blow to The Seven, but recover some of our earlier losses as well. Head out to these coordinates at once and blast Phenod to pieces, but be sure to scrape some of his DNA off the front of your ship before returning. We'll use it to forge an identification transponder for your next mission.
messages.zh:
在你救出的那些人质中，其中有一个特别有脑子。在海盗船上时，她破解了其通讯日志，从中发现了一件很有趣的事。七人组中有一名核心成员叫“菲诺德”。他脱离了大部队，独自去领取前阵子被抓获的人质。

利用这个天赐良机，我们不仅能给予七人组一次痛击，同时还能挽回我们之前的一些损失。你赶快前往指定的位置，把菲诺德轰个稀巴烂。不过在返回之前，请务必从你的船前取得一些他的DNA样本。我们要用这样本去做一个假的身份应答器，可以方便你的后续任务。

messages.en: Seriously?  Phenod is too much for you to handle?  I've heard he's The Seven's resident idiot.
messages.zh: 开玩笑吧？你对付不了菲诺德？别人都说他是七人组里出了名的蠢货。

messages.en: Do you have a sample of Phenod's DNA yet?
messages.zh: 你取得菲诺德的DNA样本了吗？

messages.en: Not many capsuleers volunteer for this kind of duty outside the comforts of their preferred ship.  I admire your courage.
messages.zh: 很少有飞行员愿意离开自己舒适的舰船，并自愿接受这种任务。你勇气可嘉。

messages.en: Using Phenod's DNA to concoct a disguised transponder beacon, the shuttle provided by the agent should be large enough to retrieve the additional hostages and bring them to safety.  The only problem is that, if whoever shows up to drop off the hostages isn't fooled, the shuttle will be unable to respond.
messages.zh: 代理人提供的穿梭机上，装有利用菲诺德的DNA做出的伪造身份应答器，同时它具备足够的空间，可以承载余下的人质并将他们转移到安全地带。唯一的问题是，如果没能骗过那个前来送人质的海盗，那这艘穿梭机将无力招架。

messages.en: Now that was some really impressive flying, I have to admit!  The hostages are quite grateful to have been returned safely.  In fact, I have a message for you from one of them, if you can stick around for a minute or two.
messages.zh: 我不得不说，你这次行动太给力了！人质们都安全返回，他们对此很感激。现在我从其中一个人质那里获得了一条消息，你能再停留一下吗？

messages.en: So you've gotten this far only to give up now?
messages.zh: 你已经做了这么多，现在却要放弃？

messages.en:
I hope you didn't have too much trouble with Phenod.

Our engineers have completed the fake transponder and installed it in a shuttle, which is ready for you to take it to the rendezvous point. The story is that Phenod's ship was disabled and he's been forced to limp to the rendezvous point in an ordinary shuttle. I don't know who's going to meet you there, but it'll probably be another officer from The Seven, so try not to pick a fight. Remember, this shuttle is unarmed and doesn't have any real defenses, so if your disguise fails, you'll have to make a run for it.

Oh, and there's one last thing: That shuttle doesn't have the oxygen capacity to hold that many people for very long, so you won't be able to make it back here. We're sending a rescue vessel to linger nearby, but for obvious reasons it can't be anywhere inside sensor range of this meeting. Use the acceleration gate in the area to meet up with it and drop off the hostages.
messages.zh:
但愿菲诺德没让你费太多力气。

我们的工程师已经做好了一个假的应答器，把它装到了一艘穿梭机上。你会驾驶着它与海盗碰头。 我们要假装成：菲诺德的船已经废了，他现在只能开着一艘普通的穿梭机去他的会合点。 我不知道你在那儿会遇到谁，但有可能是七人组里的另一名官员，所以最好别起冲突。 记住，这艘穿梭机上不带任何武器，也没啥防御能力。如果你被看穿，那就拼命逃吧。

哦，还有最后一件事要提醒你： 这艘穿梭机中的氧气不够很多人用很久，所以你肯定没法直接回到这里。 我们会派一艘救援舰在你附近守候，但它显然不能待在对方扫描器可探测的范围内。 你到时候需要利用加速轨道与其会合，将人质转移到其中。

messages.en: Oh well, let's just hope CONCORD doesn't see you in that shuttle broadcasting a pirate faction signature.  Good luck!
messages.zh: 好吧。但愿统合部看不到你驾驶着一艘发出海盗势力信号的穿梭机。祝你好运！

messages.en: Shh!
messages.zh: 嘘！

messages.en: The former hostage will be very excited to hear you accepted the offer.  Here are Locced's coordinates.
messages.zh: 之前被你救出的那名人质知道你接受了他的请求一定会激动万分。这是罗赛德的位标。

messages.en: One of the hostages rescued during the previous mission has offered a reward for destroying Locced's ship and provided coordinates to his current location.
messages.zh: 先前任务中被救出的一名人质提供了悬赏，要求你去击毁罗赛德的飞船，而且他已经给出了罗赛德当前的位置。

messages.en:
What am I, your receptionist? Here's another message from that hostage you rescued:

“Trustworthy Capsuleer,

It's going to take Locced quite a while to replace that ship. Well done, and thank you again for all of your efforts against The Seven.”
messages.zh:
我都快成你的传话秘书了。之前那个被你救出的人质又给你留了条信息：

“可靠的飞行员，

罗赛德要花好一阵子才能弄到一艘新船。您干得真漂亮。再次感谢您在对抗七人组时所付出的全部努力。”

messages.en: That former hostage is going to be heartbroken.
messages.zh: 之前被你救出的那名人质会心碎的。

messages.en:
Here's the rescued hostage's message:

“Brave Capsuleer,

Allow me to offer my sincere thanks for your efforts to rescue me and my fellow hostages from the clutches of The Seven. If you would be interested, I've offered {[character]agentID.name} a sum of ISK to pay you in exchange for doing me a little favor.

During my time with The Seven, one of their officers was so cruel that I‘m inclined to seek revenge on a personal level. Seeing as you have become quite familiar with their organization and tactics, I can think of no one better suited for carrying out this task. Please destroy his ship for me.

If you‘re interested, the target‘s name is Locced and I happen to know where he‘ll be in the near future, as one of his lieutenants let the information slip during casual conversation when I was nearby.

Once again, thank you for freeing me from The Seven‘s clutches. I hope you find my offer appealing.“

Well, {[character]player.name}, what do you say?
messages.zh:
这就是那位被你救出的人质给你的留言：

“英勇的飞行员，

请允许我对您付出的努力表示诚挚的谢意，感谢您将我和其他人质从七人组的魔爪下救了出来。如果您有兴趣，请帮我一个小忙。我已经把相应的酬金交给了{[character]agentID.name}。

在我被七人组绑架期间，其中一个官员把我整得非常惨，我决定要以牙还牙。我知道您对该组织及其战术手段已经了如指掌，因此您最适合帮我做这件事：请把这家伙的船打爆。

他名叫罗赛德。他的一位副手在我周围闲谈时无意中透露了其行踪，所以我知道他接下来会出现在哪里。

再次感谢您把我从七人组魔爪下救出来。但愿您对我的提议感兴趣。”

怎么样，{[character]player.name}，你接受这任务吗？

messages.en: I'm going to assume Locced beat you down like a helpless child, at least that's what I'm going to tell every other capsuleer I deal with from this point forward.
messages.zh: 我猜罗赛德肯定是把你打得像只落水狗一样。从今往后，每见到一名克隆飞行员，我都会跟他们这样说。

messages.en: The former hostage is eagerly awaiting news of your victory.
messages.zh: 之前被你救出的那名人质正在殷切期待你的好消息。

messages.en: Good. You have no time to lose.
messages.zh: 很好。赶快行动吧。

messages.en: Travel to the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} here a disabled ship is in jeopardy. Save the crew by addressing whatever problem afflicts the vessel.
messages.zh: 请前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。那里有一艘船的处境很危险。查明该船的问题所在，然后解决问题，以拯救船员。

messages.en: Good work. Your efforts have not gone unnoticed. We'll try to get that model upgraded to avoid this kind of problem again.
messages.zh: 干得好。你的努力不会白费。我们会对那种型号的舰船进行升级，以避免将来再出现这种情况。

messages.en: What? Maybe I didn't make myself clear. There are lives at stake!
messages.zh: 什么？也许我之前没说清楚。这可是性命攸关的事！

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, a mission of mercy needs your immediate attention. One of our ships has suffered an almost complete power loss near a spatial rift, and is adrift toward the anomaly. There's no time to lose. Get to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, find the ship, and help get it operational again.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，有一个救人任务急需你的出马。在一个空间裂隙附近，我们有一艘船几乎丧失了全部动力，正在向那异常空间漂去。我们必须赶快行动。你马上赶往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，找到那艘船，然后帮助它重新运转起来。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, what are you doing? Our people are going to die out there. “Can't do it?” You mean “Won't do it”! Bloody pirate!
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你在搞毛啊？我们的人就要挂在那里了。你说“做不到”？其实是“不想做”吧！你跟海盗没啥区别！

messages.en: What are you doing? Our people are dying in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. There's no time for this!
messages.zh: 你在搞毛啊？我们的人就快死在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}了，别浪费时间！

messages.en: You're doing the right thing. Countless lives depend on you.
messages.zh: 你做出了正确的选择。那么多人能否活下来就靠你了。

messages.en:
A pandemic has broken out on a planet in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Fortunately, a cure was already developed and mass-produced. The contagion originated on another planet, you see, so the people of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have experience in dealing with this particular disease.

The Sisters of Eve sent a medical drone with the vaccine onboard down to the planet, but some degenerate pirates have intercepted the craft and are trying to ransom it. The SSoE say that if the drone is destroyed, it could be days before we can mass-produce more vaccine – something about being unable to accelerate the bacterial cultivation. A few more days with this disease uncontrolled could mean everything. We must recapture the drone.

Once you've secured the drone, they can deploy repair teams and send it back on its way.
messages.zh:
{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系中的一个行星上，爆发了一场传染病。好在我们目前已经有了一个治愈方案，并已将其投入大规模生产。该病最初起源于另一个行星，所以{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的人们已经有了对付该传染病的经验。

姐妹会已向那个行星派出了一艘载有疫苗的医疗无人机。但是一帮无耻的海盗半路截获了该无人机，然后开始索要赎金。姐妹会表示，如果该无人机被摧毁，那就需要数天的时间才能重新量产那批疫苗——因为他们无法提升细菌培养的速度。这病如果在几天内得不到控制，那后果不堪设想。因此我们必须夺回无人机。

一旦你夺回了无人机，姐妹会就可以派出维修队将其修复，然后送它重新上路。

messages.en: You've done a great thing! Countless people owe you their lives. We should have just enough time to get the medicine to the planet. The Sisters are coordinating with Mordu's Legion this time. They'll escort it safely to the people of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.
messages.zh: 你真是了不起！你拯救了无数人的性命。我们正好还来得及把疫苗送达那个行星。姐妹会这次与莫德团合作。他们会把疫苗安全交到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的人民手里的。

messages.en: What? You're telling me profit is more important than innocent lives?
messages.zh: 什么？你的意思是钱比无辜的生命更重要？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}? Good. I have a job that's probably outside your normal scope. This one is humanitarian.

A pandemic has broken out on a planet in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Fortunately, a cure was already developed and mass-produced. The contagion originated on another planet nearby, you see, so the people of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} already have experience in dealing with this particular disease.

The Sisters of Eve sent a medical drone with the vaccine onboard down to the planet, but some degenerate pirates have intercepted the craft, disabled it, and are now trying to demand a ransom for its release. The Sisters say that if the drone is destroyed it could be days before we can mass-produce more vaccine – something about being unable to accelerate the bacterial cultivation. A few more days with this disease uncontrolled could mean everything. We must recapture the drone.

We're depending on you here, {[character]player.name}. Once you've secured the drone, they can deploy repair teams and send it back on its way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}？很好。我有一个对你而言不同寻常的任务。这是一个人道主义救援任务。

{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系中的一个行星上，爆发了一场传染病。好在我们目前已经有了一个治愈方案，并已将其投入大规模生产。该病最初起源于附近的一个行星，所以{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的人们已经有了对付该传染病的经验。

姐妹会已向那个行星派出了一艘载有疫苗的医疗无人机。但是一帮无耻的海盗半路截获了该无人机，然后开始索要赎金。姐妹会表示，如果该无人机被摧毁，那就需要数天的时间才能重新量产那批疫苗——因为他们无法提升细菌培养的速度。这病如果在几天内得不到控制，那后果不堪设想。因此我们必须夺回无人机。

我们全靠你了，{[character]player.name}。一旦你夺回了无人机，姐妹会就可以派出维修队将其修复，然后送它重新上路。

messages.en: I should have known. Your kind disgusts me.
messages.zh: 我早该猜到才对。你让我觉得恶心。

messages.en: We don't have any time to waste. Get moving.
messages.zh: 没时间供你浪费了。快去吧。

messages.en: Excellent. There are at least three survivors who escaped in life pods. Find them, and we'll be able to figure out what went wrong. And be careful out there - it's an experimental ship, and we don't know what kind of threat it might pose.
messages.zh: 很好。至少有三个人利用逃生舱存活下来。你快找到他们，以便让我们知道到底出了什么事情。你要当心…它毕竟是一艘试验性飞船，我们无法预料它可能会产生怎样的威胁。

messages.en: You need to rescue The Paryi's survivors and learn what they know. The Anomaly was a very expensive project and some very powerful people are invested in figuring out how it vanished.
messages.zh: 你要去营救帕里号上的幸存者，从他们那儿了解到底发生了什么事。异常号是一个耗资巨大的项目。其投资人当中有一些极有权势的人物，他们迫切想知道其消失的原因。

messages.en: Great job, risking your neck like that! I mean, I'm sure there was no risk at all - in any case, we've already spoken with Dr. Ateshi about how to proceed.
messages.zh: 干得好，你差点就没命了啊！呃，我是说，这对你而言当然是小菜一碟…不管怎么样，我们已经与阿德什博士谈过，知道下一步该怎么做了。

messages.en: That's your call. Honestly, I don't blame you for backing out now - I'm not superstitious, but this situation spooks me out.
messages.zh: 我尊重你的决定。说实话，你现在退出我不怪你——像我这么不迷信的人都开始怕了。

messages.en:
Ever heard of The Anomaly? Lots of superstition around that name - it's one of our ships that vanished completely while testing an experimental jump drive. A trading vessel heard The Anomaly's signal last week and so we sent out a salvage crew, The Paryi, to investigate the site where it reappeared, but something went wrong. We received The Paryi's distress call yesterday and can't make sense of it. It seems some of them were killed in an explosion near The Anomaly, and the survivors escaped in life pods but are trapped there by gravity waves exuding from the ship. But the other things they said… well, some of them must have cracked under the stress. If there were any survivors from The Anomaly, they would've contacted us, after all.

You need to rescue The Paryi's survivors, especially Dr. Fajah Ateshi. Once we learn what they uncovered, we'll have a better sense of how to proceed. The Anomaly was a very expensive project, and some very powerful people are invested in figuring out how it vanished.
messages.zh:
听说过异常号吗？它是我们的一艘船。在它身上出了很多迷信事件，而且有一次在测试其试验性跳跃引擎的时候，它彻底消失了。上个星期，有一艘商船收到了异常号发出的信号，然后我们派出了一支打捞队，驾驶着帕里号前往其出现地点，但后来出事了。我们昨天收到了帕里号发来的求救信号，但它让人搞不懂。从求救信号的内容来看，部分人员好像丧命于异常号附近发生的一场爆炸，幸存的人员都在逃生舱里，但那艘船散发出的引力场却把他们牵制住了。信号中还提到那艘船中尚有人生还……我觉得打捞队的人一定是因为压力太大了在说胡话。如果异常号中真有幸存者，那他们早就该跟我们联系了。

你现在去营救帕里号上的幸存者，尤其是要把法娅·阿德什博士救出来。一旦知道我们到底发现了什么，那我们就能更明确地知道下一步该怎么办了。异常号是一个耗资巨大的项目。其投资人当中有一些极有权势的人物，他们迫切想知道其消失的原因。

messages.en: That's your call. Honestly, I don't blame you for backing out now - I'm not superstitious, but this situation spooks me out.
messages.zh: 我尊重你的决定。说实话，你现在退出我不怪你——像我这么不迷信的人都开始怕了。

messages.en: Have you rescued the crew of The Paryi yet? I've got some very important people breathing down my neck about this.
messages.zh: 你把帕里号上的船员救出来了吗？有些非常重要的人物一直在逼问我这件事啊。

messages.en: Good. Dr. Ateshi will accompany you to the ship and give you details on delivering the scanner. Get in, drop the scanner, get out.
messages.zh: 很好。阿德什博士会与你一同前往，然后教你如何处理那扫描器。你要做的就是，先飞往那里，然后释放扫描器，最后返航。

messages.en: Travel to The Anomaly and deliver the Neurowave Pattern Scanner.
messages.zh: 前往异常号并递交脑电波规律扫描器。

messages.en: Finally, we have all the information necessary to make an informed decision. I'll see what Dr. Ateshi has to say.
messages.zh: 我们终于得到了所需要的全部信息，可以做出明智的决定了。我去听听阿德什博士怎么说。

messages.en: I don't think you understand what you're turning down here. The fate of The Anomaly is important to a great many very powerful people, and they won't be happy.
messages.zh: 我觉得你肯定不知道这次拒绝的后果。异常号的命运关系着众多有权势的人物，他们肯定会大发雷霆的。

messages.en:
We've spoken with Fajah Ateshi about The Anomaly, and I'm afraid things look dire. Her readings were damaged from the explosion aboard The Paryi, and she needs to return to The Anomaly to get further information. Since the two of you are the only ones who've come near the ship and retained both your lives and sanity, we have to send you out again.

We're still not entirely sure if anyone is alive aboard there, though Dr. Ateshi insists that she heard garbled transmissions from survivors disoriented from radiation sickness. I tell you, all this mystery doesn't make me comfortable, and it makes the people at the top very, very unhappy. If you find survivors, excellent, but your survival and Dr. Ateshi's readings are more important. You need to attach her Neurowave Pattern Scanner to The Anomaly.
messages.zh:
我们已经与法娅·阿德什谈过了异常号的事情，我觉得情况不妙。她获取的数据由于帕里号上的爆炸而遭到破坏。她需要重返异常号进一步获取数据。鉴于你们两位是仅有的靠近过那艘船并且还能清醒地活下来的人，因此我们要再派你们去一趟。

虽然阿德什博士坚称，她听到了因遭辐射而失去方向感的幸存者发出的声调走样的通讯，但我们还是不能确定那儿是否真有幸存者。跟你说吧，出了这么多怪事让我感到很不舒服，而且高层对此非常非常不满。如果你能找到幸存者，那再好不过。但你要首先确保你和阿德什博士的数据都能顺利返航。你需要把她的脑电波规律扫描器与异常号接上。

messages.en: I don't think you understand what you're turning down here. The fate of The Anomaly is important to a great many very powerful people, and they won't be happy.
messages.zh: 我觉得你肯定不知道这次拒绝的后果。异常号的命运关系着众多有权势的人物，他们肯定会大发雷霆的。

messages.en: Have you delivered the Neurowave Pattern Scanner yet? There's a lot of pressure on me to get this done.
messages.zh: 你把脑电波规律扫描器送到那里了吗？我顶着很大的压力，你一定要把这件事完成。

messages.en: I'm so relieved to hear that. Keep your wits about you and you should do just fine. Remember, don't bother shooting until Dr. Ateshi has deactivated their shield rechargers.
messages.zh: 听到这些我很欣慰。保持镇定，你就能成功。记住，等阿德什博士让他们的护盾回充器停止运转之后，你再展开攻击。

messages.en: Destroy The Anomaly before it can do further damage. Bring Dr. Ateshi to the rogue drone hive where the ship is hiding so that she can deactivate its shields.
messages.zh: 在异常号还没有造成更大危害之前，把它毁掉。把阿德什博士带到那艘船赖以藏身的自由无人机母巢那儿，这样她就能让那船的护盾停止运转。

messages.en: Shame about Dr. Ateshi, but she knew the risks. Good job - you've earned everything coming to you.
messages.zh: 对阿德什博士的不幸遭遇，我深表遗憾，但她清楚地知道整个事情的危险性。你干得很好——所有的奖励与赞美之词都是你应得的。

messages.en: After coming so far? Do you know what they're going to do to me when they find out you quit?
messages.zh: 都到这一步了你还选择退出？你知不知道当我的上级得知有人半途而废，我会落得什么样的下场？

messages.en:
Dr. Ateshi has provided proof that The Anomaly is active and dangerous. The experimental warp drive successfully opened a wormhole, but it was unstable and the resulting radiation fried the crew's equipment, and their brains. They've been trapped in the darkest parts of space for two decades, slowly succumbing to the sickness - there's nothing human left about them. Now that they're back in our space, the radiation is a risk not just to us but everything for hundreds of kilometers around.

My superiors have determined that it's not worth the risk of retrieving the warp drive; you need to destroy the ship entirely before the damage spreads. Fortunately, we know where they went: They jumped into the middle of a rogue drone hive. Dr. Ateshi thinks they're trying to feed off the rogue drones' power to recharge. If you can get her to one of the surrounding ships, she can jam their equipment and make them vulnerable.
messages.zh:
阿德什博士已经提供了证据，表明异常号确实还在运转而且很危险。虽然其试验性跃迁引擎成功地打开了一个虫洞，但由于该虫洞并不稳定，因此其产生的辐射不仅烧焦了船上的设备，也让船员的大脑产生了变异。20年来，那些人一直被困在宇宙最黑暗的角落里，逐渐被疾病吞噬，最后完全丧失了人性。现在他们又回来了。不光是我们，在那船周围数百公里范围内的一切物体都有遭受其辐射的危险。

我的上级已明确表示，冒那么大风险去回收那跃迁引擎不值得。你现在要趁它还没有造成更大危害之前，把它毁掉。还好我们已经掌握了那艘船的行踪：它跳入了一个无人机母巢里。阿德什博士觉得，它是在吸取无人机的能量为己用。如果你能把她带到周围一艘船附近，她就能干扰异常号的设备，以便你可以攻击它。

messages.en: After coming so far? Do you know what they're going to do to me when they find out you quit?
messages.zh: 都到这一步了你还选择退出？你知不知道当我的上级得知有人半途而废，我会落得什么样的下场？

messages.en: Have you destroyed The Anomaly yet? It's essential that you do it before it has the chance to jump away again!
messages.zh: 你摧毁异常号了没有？你必须赶在它跳走之前把它给灭了！

messages.en: Great. You get out there, and you've got some rescue money coming your way. I don't really care who you rescue, just so long as you rescue someone. Fair warning, though – the ones you don't rescue are likely to remember it.
messages.zh: 很好。去吧，你很快就能获得援救资金了。只要你救人就行，救谁我不管。但有点要提醒你，没有被你救的人可能会记恨。

messages.en: A diplomatic station not far from here is undergoing a traumatic systems shut-down cascade. It's all going, and people need off that station.
messages.zh: 离这儿不远的一座外交空间站里，系统正面临全线瘫痪。已经没有任何补救方法，现在能做的就是把人员转移出去。

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}. Enjoy your reward, and the limelight for being a hero to those folks – you've earned it. You should know, however, that the folks you didn't save have already made it very clear that they're not happy with you.
messages.zh: 干得不错，{[character]player.name}。好好享受一下你的奖赏吧，还有别人对你的赞誉之词。你当之无愧。但你同时也要明白，没有被你救的那些人已经很清楚地表达了对你的不满。

messages.en: Can't say I blame you, though I'm going to have to let you go for now. Getting these kinds of jobs filled can bring an agent like me to the notice of important people, you know? Talk to you later.
messages.zh: 虽然不责怪你，但我还是要你现在就出发。我如果找到合适的人完成了这种事，那我就能引起重要人物的注意，懂吗？待会儿再说吧。

messages.en:
Hey there, {[character]player.name}. I've got a routine run for you...just a second. I've got emergency messages coming in. Hm. You up for a rescue mission?

I just received an alert across multiple communication channels asking for evacuation help. A diplomatic station, not far from here, is undergoing a traumatic systems shut-down cascade. It's all going, and people need off that station. The rescue requires a smaller ship than what they have available to get in past the field of debris now ringing the station.

That's what happens when none of the empires will trust the others enough to allow them to send in their best station engineers and construction teams, and so they all agree on a third-party freelance company to build their stations. Happens all the time, I hear. Ridiculous.
Anyway – are you interested?
messages.zh:
嘿，{[character]player.name}。我这里有件例行差事让你干…等等。我刚接到一条紧急消息。呃…你能进行一次援救行动吗？

我现在接到来自多方面的救援请求。离这儿不远的一座外交空间站里，系统正面临全线瘫痪。已经没有任何补救方法，现在能做的就是把人员转移出去。由于目前该空间站周围有一圈碎片环绕，他们现有的舰船都太大无法冲出重围，因此他们要求一艘小船前往营救。

当初帝国之间无法建立互信，因此他们都不向对方派遣最好的工程师与最有能力的建筑队，转而一致同意让第三方公司来建造空间站。现在自食其果了吧。听说这已经见怪不怪了。真傻X。
算了不说那些了——你有兴趣前往营救吗？

messages.en: Warning!
messages.zh: 警告！

messages.en: Really? That's it? You're quitting? Why'd you agree to do it in the first place, then?
messages.zh: 是吗？就这样了？你不干了？那你当初干嘛要答应？

messages.en: How's that rescue operation going?
messages.zh: 营救进展如何？

messages.en: Excellent. Be careful out there, {[character]player.name}. We've also had reports of unusual fleet movements around the refinery. You may not be the only one looking for this preacher.
messages.zh: 很好。你到了那里要当心，{[character]player.name}。我们接到报告说，精炼厂附近有舰队出没，这有点不正常。你可能不会是唯一的寻找那传教者的人。

messages.en:
Have you heard those crazy prophecies which have been picking up publicity? No, not Macaper's, I mean the ones delivered by this “prophet” who calls himself Tolmak?

In any case, all you need to know is that this fool is trying to create his own religion, and he's had some successes recently in building up his numbers. It seems each new day he lures more discontented people into his cult, and recently we've been affected by this new trend.

One of his acolytes set up shop in our little corner of the universe and began preaching to the locals. This “priest” is not exactly causing trouble, but he's making certain powerful people uncomfortable. Not only that, but we've heard reports of violence against this cult in other sectors. We'd like to quietly remove this preacher from the picture to avoid any possibility for backlash in our own areas. At the same time, we don't want to make a martyr out of him and build further support for this cult. The situation needs to be handled discretely.

He's currently preaching on Yunshin Z, a refining complex. This is a low population industrial center with little contact to the outside world. We can afford to make bold moves here. Your task is to find this preacher and return him to us. We'll handle the rest.
messages.zh:
你有没有听说最近被媒体热炒的那些荒谬预言？不，不是马卡柏的预言。我指的是一个自称托马克的所谓“先知”嘴里的那些话。听说过没有？

不管怎么样，我现在要告诉你，这个傻瓜打算自立一个宗教，而且他最近收了不少信仰者。现在他每天能骗到的人好像越来越多，那些人在加入之前都有这样或那样的不满。最近这件事已经影响到了我们。

有一个追随他的人在我们这里占了一小块地方，开了个教堂，开始向当地人传教了。虽然这位“牧师”本身并没有惹出什么事端，但他却让某些权贵人物深感不爽。不仅如此，我们还收到报告说，其他地方出现了针对该组织的暴力事件。因此我们想悄悄地除掉这个传教者，免得他在我们的地盘上引出更大的麻烦。但是，与此同时我们也不想把他搞得像烈士一样，以免给该组织制造有利声势。所以这件事情需要谨慎对待。

他目前在一个名为“陨星Z”的矿物精炼厂。那个工业中心人口不多，与外界联系极少。我们可以在那儿大胆行动。你的任务就是去找到他，并把他带回来。然后我们会处置他的。

messages.en:
Ah, you have him? Good work, {[character]player.name}. I hadn't heard any reports of conflict at the refinery, so I can only assume the mission went smoothly.

In fact, I'd rather continue to keep on assuming that, if you get me. My paperwork is going to indicate that Tolmak's friend came willingly, without a struggle, and that the entire operation was conducted peacefully and with the utmost respect to all involved parties.
messages.zh:
啊，你把他搞定了？干得好，{[character]player.name}。我没有收到任何有关精炼厂冲突的报告，因此我猜测事情一定进行得很顺利。

你就让我保持这种猜测吧，你懂的。我在报告中会说，托马克的朋友是自愿前来的，没有起任何冲突，整个行动中都未使用任何武力，所有相关人员都得到了好生照料。

messages.en: Very well, I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 好吧，我会另请高明。

messages.en:
Religious freaks like to spread all sorts of apocalyptic messages, and in recent times there are few who have captured the imagination of conspiracy theorists in the way that Tolmak has. The so-called “Prophet of the Seventh Sphere,” Tolmak is an enigmatic and elusive character. He has never shown himself publicly for fear of reprisal, and relies instead of proxies to spread his word. Others say his real strength comes from the media outlets that cover these preachers. Outlets that, for their own part, are mostly concerned with the profit to be made from the inevitable controversy his message brings.

Among other things, Tolmak's elaborate revelations paint a universe governed by demonic forces that secretly control the heads of all the empires. He reserves special bile for the capsuleer class, teaching that their clones are not actually the same person reborn, but are instead, demonic simulacra.
messages.zh:
宗教狂人总喜欢传播各种世界末日主题的预言。最近，几乎没有谁能够像托马克一样激起了阴谋论者的兴趣。被称为“第七域的先知”的托马克是一个让人捉摸不透的神秘人物。由于担心遭报复，他从未在公开场合露面，主要依靠中间人帮他传话。有人说，他厉害就厉害在那些报道其传教者的媒体。而媒体之所以愿意报道他们，多数都是因为这些人和理论本身具有的争议性，利用这一点能吸引眼球并赚钱。

在托马克众多的宗教言论中，他自圆其说地描绘了一个被邪恶力量掌控的宇宙，所有帝国的首脑们都暗地里受控于它。克隆飞行员们对他尤为憎恨。他宣称克隆飞行员的克隆并不代表真正的重生，只是一个遭恶魔附身的躯体而已。

messages.en: The Prophet of the Seventh Sphere
messages.zh: 第七域的先知

messages.en:
Have you heard those crazy sermons that people are talking about? The ones delivered by this self-proclaimed “prophet” who calls himself Tolmak? Yeah, that freak who's trying to create a religion. He's got a lot of converts among the discontents of our little corner of the universe. But he's also got a lot of enemies, people who don't like what he's been spewing. People who might try to kill him. Thing is, certain powerful people find him useful. A nice distraction from more political pursuits. They'd like him alive.

One of his acolytes set up shop in our little corner of the universe and began preaching to the locals. This “priest” is not exactly causing trouble, but he's making certain powerful people uncomfortable. Not only that, but we've heard reports of violence against this cult in other sectors. We'd like to quietly remove this man from the picture and avoid any possibility for backlash in our own areas. At the same time, we don't want to make a martyr out of him and build further support for this cult. The situation needs to be handled discreetly.

He's currently preaching on Yunshin Z, a refining complex. This is a low population industrial center with little contact to the outside world. We can afford to make bold moves here. Your task is to find this preacher and return him to us. We'll handle the rest.
messages.zh:
你有没有听说最近广为流传的那些荒谬预言？我指的是一个自称托马克的所谓“先知”嘴里的那些话。听说过没有？对，就是那个打算自立宗教的疯子。他在我们这里招到了许多信仰者。但他同时也树敌众多。有些人不喜欢从他嘴里说出来的东西。那些人都可能想干掉他。事实上，另外一些人还觉得他很有利用价值。他可以帮助他们转移政治上的注意力。所以，他们还是得留着他。

有一个追随他的人在我们这里占了一小块地方，开了个教堂，开始向当地人传教了。虽然这位“牧师”本身并没有惹出什么事端，但他却让某些权贵人物深感不爽。不仅如此，我们还收到报告说，其他地方出现了针对该组织的暴力事件。因此我们想悄悄地除掉这个传教者，免得他在我们的地盘上引出更大的麻烦。但是，与此同时我们也不想把他搞得像烈士一样，以免给该组织制造有利声势。所以这件事情需要谨慎对待。

他目前在一个名为“陨星Z”的矿物精炼厂传教。那个工业中心人口不多，与外界联系极少。我们可以在那儿大胆行动。你的任务就是去找到他，并把他带回来。然后我们会处置他的。

messages.en: Disappointing, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你真让人失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I hope the capture of this preacher is worth the cost of hiring you.
messages.zh: 但愿抓获这个传教者能对得起我们付给你的钱。

messages.en: They're as good as gone.
messages.zh: 他们死定了。

messages.en: Since the scouting party is dead and gone, we've got the primary fleet hanging around in space and practically begging for someone to blow them to pieces. Seeing as how you did such a thorough job with their scouts, you were naturally our first choice for taking on their big guns. Once you're finished with them, Okelle won't have anyone to help him except his brother. And once our interrogators are done with Okelle, he'll have given us all the information we need to hunt down Martogar. It's only a matter of time - that is, unless the primary fleet manages to deploy more scouts and continue their murderous rampage, so you better get on your way to stop them.
messages.zh: 由于侦察队已经被彻底消灭，现在就只剩主舰队孤零零地在太空里，就等着有人去把他们炸成碎片。既然你把他们的侦察队消灭得那么彻底，你自然就成为干掉那些大家伙的首选。只要你解决了他们，奥克勒就没有任何帮手了——除了他哥哥。在我们审问奥克勒之后，他会告诉我们追击马图卡所需的全部信息。这只是个时间问题——不过，要是主舰队设法部署更多侦察机并继续他们横冲直撞的暴行，情况就不一样了，所以你最好立刻上路去阻止他们。

name.es: La tumba de los soldados desconocidos
name.ru: Могила неизвестных солдат (Tomb of the Unknown Soldiers)

messages.en: Glad to have you onboard. I appreciate that you're willing to do this for the Gallente people. Symbols are important in these politically volatile times.
messages.zh: 你能来真是太好了。你愿意为盖伦特人民办这件事，我很感激。在政坛风云变幻的时代，民族的象征更显重要。

messages.en: Fly out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}  and retrieve the missing war dead. Destroy all Caldari standing in your way.
messages.zh: 飞往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}并且接回失踪的阵亡者。消灭所有阻挡你的加达里人。

messages.en: Good flying, egger. Thanks to you, we'll be able to put these soldiers to rest. It's long overdue.
messages.zh: 干的不错，飞行员。多亏了你，我们才能让这些战士们安息。这一天他们等待很久了。

messages.en: Well, they've waited this long. They can wait a little longer yet, I guess.
messages.zh: 好吧，他们等待了这么久。那应该还能再等一等。

messages.en:
Just when you think scars from the first Gallente-Caldari War begin to heal, something comes along and the old wounds reopen. We recently intercepted chatter about a missing contingent of Federation soldiers from that conflict who were recently recovered. They were stranded out in a 'roid field after engaging the enemy. Supplies ran out. Neither side came to the rescue.

It's a depressing story, sure, but there's a happy ending if you want to be a part of it. The Federation is willing to pay for secure, respectful transport for our war dead so they can finally be laid to rest in their respective homeworlds. This may sound easy, but it's not. The Caldari have also become aware of the battle site, and already have forces onsite. They refuse to allow us a proper retrieval.

You must go to the battle site and clear out the Caldari forces. Remember, they are invaders still, and recovering our soldiers is of paramount importance.
messages.zh:
正当你认为第一次盖伦特与加达里战争的伤口 开始愈合之时，意外之事再次发生，而旧的伤口再一次被揭开。我们最近截获的一段通讯显示，有人刚发现了那次战争中失踪的一支联邦军事小分队。那些士兵当时在和敌人交火后，被困在一个小行星带里。给养消耗殆尽。而交战双方都没有派人来救援。

这确实是一段悲伤的故事，不过，如果你能帮忙，它就可以有个美好的结局。联邦现在愿意付钱请人把这些阵亡者安全又庄重地接回来，让他们的英灵可以在故乡得到安息。这件事听上去容易，但实际上则不然。加达里人也获悉了那些战士牺牲的战场，并派出了武装进入该区域。他们拒绝让我们合理地运回遗体。

你必须前往该战场并清理加达里的武装。要记住，他们仍然是侵略者，而接回我们士兵的遗骨事关重大。

messages.en: Well, they've waited this long. They can wait a little longer yet, I guess.
messages.zh: 好吧，他们等待了这么久。那应该还能再等一等。

messages.en: How is the retrieval going?
messages.zh: 事情进展的怎样？

messages.en: You'll be joining them in the most dangerous leg of their journey, right in the middle of a remote outpost. I can't give you many details about this place, though. Push through this deadspace pocket and make sure the convoy gets to their destination. More instructions will follow when you get there.
messages.zh: 你将在他们航程最危险的地段与他们会合，就在一座边远的哨站中间。而我无法向你提供那个地方的细节。闯过那片死亡空间层，确保运输队抵达目的地。当你进入目标区域时，我会给出更多指示。

messages.en: Fly out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and clear the area for the humanitarian convoy.
messages.zh: 前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}并清理目标区域，以便人道主义运输队通过。

messages.en: You actually lost a few ships, but things could have been much worse if you hadn't been there. We'll consider this matter closed, though it looks like the navy will disavow any knowledge of this event ever taking place.
messages.zh: 有一些舰船损失掉了，但是如果没有你，事情可能会更糟。我们会认为此事已经了结，只是海军方面应该会完全否认此事存在过。

messages.en: That's all right. We can find other pilots if you don't like this job. Thanks for your time.
messages.zh: 没关系。如果你不喜欢这差事，我们可以另找别人。谢谢你抽空过来。

messages.en: “When you made a mistake as a child and you were in a rush to hide it, what did you do? You covered it with a blanket and hoped that nobody noticed. Sometimes, we never grow out of this line of thinking.” –Sister Evetelle Boun, organizer of Operation Hope.
messages.zh: “当一个小孩犯了错，并且急于掩饰它，会怎么做？把它埋在地毯下面，而且希望没人发现。有时候，我们的想法仍然和小孩一样。”——修女伊娃泰勒·布恩，希望行动的组织者。

messages.en: Blanket Operations
messages.zh: 地毯式行动

messages.en:
We need someone to escort a convoy running humanitarian aid into {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Well, mostly humanitarian aid. We're moving medicine and food, as well as aid workers from the Sisters of EVE. But, there're also military personnel and equipment hidden among those ships. There's a big operation planned in that system, and our forces will need all the help that they can get.

Essentially, there's sensitive cargo onboard, and not everybody needs to know about it. We're posing this convoy as a peaceful operation to keep the State off our backs, but that doesn't mean other groups would be interested in the convoy as a potential target. We don't want to lose it, and we certainly don't want to lose it to someone like the Syndicate or the Serpentis. Unfortunately, we don't have a lot of time before these things are needed, so please forgive me for omitting classified details. This is one of their “blanket operations,” whatever that means. We need you to make sure the coast is clear and that the convoy makes it to their destination safely.
messages.zh:
我们需要一位飞行员在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}护送一支人道主义援助运输队。呃，大部分算是人道主义援助。我们会运送药品，食品，以及姐妹会的援助人员。不过，在运输船队里也隐藏了一些军事人员和装备。该星系里计划有一次大的行动，因此我们的部队需要利用一切有利条件。

一句话，船上有敏感货物，不能让外界知道。我们宣称这支运输队代表一次和平行动，免得加达里合众国找麻烦，但是，其他势力仍然可能把它当成有油水的目标。我们不想失去它，尤其不想让它被辛迪加财团或者天蛇集团抢走。不幸的是，我们时间很紧迫，因此请原谅我省略了其他机密细节。这就是一次“地毯式行动”，别管它是什么意思。我们需要你保证航线的安全以及运输队顺利抵达目的地。

messages.en: That's all right. We can find other pilots if you don't like this job. Thanks for your time.
messages.zh: 没关系。如果你不喜欢这差事，我们可以另找别人。谢谢你抽空过来。

messages.en: What's your status?
messages.zh: 你那边是什么情况？

messages.en: Make sure that the Blood Farm can never be used to massacre our people ever again.
messages.zh: 绝对不能让这个血液农场再被用来伤害我们的人民。

messages.en: Destroy the Blood Raider installation and any ships trying to defend it. Bring back any tourists that are somehow still alive and in one piece. Remember, the Blood Raiders treat their victims like cattle to be drained and consumed. Therefore, search any cargo containers you discover. Each ship may have its own supply.
messages.zh: 摧毁血袭者设施以及任何试图保卫它的船只。带回仍然幸存的旅游者。记住，血袭者对待那些受害者就像对待牲口一样：把血抽光然后享用。因此，你要搜查所有发现的货柜集装箱。每艘船都可能带有储备。

messages.en: So few left alive. I can't imagine the horrors they faced. Thank you for your service. Now I must inform the families of those who didn't make it.
messages.zh: 活着回来的人太少了。我无法想象他们经历过的恐怖。感谢你的帮助。现在我要去通知那些遇难者的家属了。

messages.en: I understand. Defending the blood of our ancestors is a serious task. Most capsuleers simply cannot find the strength for that type of commitment.
messages.zh: 我明白。守护我们祖先的血液是一项严肃的任务。大多数飞行员都没有勇气承担这种使命。

messages.en: The Blood Raider Covenant is a particularly gruesome sect of the generally reviled Sani Sabik cult. While some modern Sani Sabik rituals use blood in some manner or another, the Covenant places particular value on the blood of cloned humans, and they are utterly ruthless in obtaining it, regularly boarding other spacecraft and abducting all aboard. From their base in Delve they launch lightning-fast raiding parties and surprisingly well-coordinated incursions deep into Empire space in pursuit of their goals.
messages.zh: 血袭者同盟是令人唾弃的萨萨比克异教当中一支极其可怕的派系。一些现代萨萨比克异教仪式上会以各种形式来使用鲜血，但是血袭者同盟特别偏爱克隆人的血液。为了取血他们丧尽天良，定期攻入各种飞船并绑走所有船员。他们从绝地之域的基地里派出行动迅速的队伍，对帝国区的目标发动组织异常周密的入侵。

messages.en: Dark Traditions
messages.zh: 黑暗传统

messages.en:
In the past several months, several cruise ships carrying close to 100,000 Amarr citizens have vanished without a trace. Of course, we first believed these disappearances to be accidents. We enlisted the help of several ISK-strapped capsuleers to poke around neighboring systems and scan the planets and moons for something.

One of these pilots discovered a Blood Raider installation in a system three jumps from the last known transport ship disappearance. Over the local comms channels, this brave pilot overheard the Raiders refer to it as a "Blood Farm."

We know now that the ships were hijacked and our citizens taken to this installation. There, they were systematically butchered.

I need you to go to this Blood Farm and eliminate anything that even smells like a Blood Raider operation. Don't stop until every last heretic has been utterly and completely destroyed. If there are any tourists still alive, bring them home.
messages.zh:
过去数月来，几艘载有将近10万名艾玛公民的游轮先后离奇失踪。当然，一开始我们以为那些船是遇到了意外。我们招募了一些缺钱的飞行员来协助搜寻邻近的星系，以及扫描行星和卫星。

其中一名飞行员发现了一处血袭者设施，位于一个离游轮失踪地点三个跳跃的星系。在该星系的本地通信频道，这名勇敢的飞行员偶然得知，血袭者把那座设施称为“血液农场”。

现在清楚了，我们的游轮和公民是被劫持到了那座设施。在那里，他们被有组织地消灭掉。

我需要你前往这个血液农场，消灭一切血袭者。那些异端分子必须被全部消灭。如果那里还有幸存的旅游者，就把他们接回来。

messages.en: Too much Amarr blood for you, eh?
messages.zh: 受不了目睹那么多艾玛人的鲜血么？

messages.en: We can't let them massacre any more of our citizens. Get to that station and wipe it from existence.
messages.zh: 我们不能让他们再伤害我们的公民了。前往那座空间站，然后把它夷平。

messages.en: Time is of the essence. Get going, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 时间紧迫。快去吧，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Stop the dissidents' fleet by destroying every last one of them.
messages.zh: 阻止反对派的舰队，摧毁他们每一个人。

messages.en: Good job. Now the two most prominent families in the Empire (and our hard-working military, of course) won't feel the loss of their favorite delicacies.
messages.zh: 干得好。现在艾玛帝国最显赫的两大家族（当然，还有我们威武的军队）不会再担心他们心爱的美食了。

messages.en: Better now than later. At least I still have time to find someone dependable.
messages.zh: 现在说出来还不算晚。至少我还有时间另请高明。

messages.en: Further Foodstuffs is a small agricultural company jointly owned by the Ardishapur and Sarum families. The products of Further Foodstuffs are mostly used by the subjects of these two families, while what little surplus is left is sold on the open market. This has curbed the expansion opportunities of the company, though it means the fleets of Ardishapur and Sarum will never lack for food.
messages.zh: 长足食品是家由阿狄莎波家族和萨拉姆家族共同拥有的小型农业公司。其产品大多被这两个家族的人所享用，只有剩余的一小部分允许在公开市场上出售。虽然这使阿狄莎波和萨拉姆家族还有他们的舰队永不缺乏美食，但也大大抑制了该公司扩张的机会。

messages.en: Further Foodstuffs
messages.zh: 长足食品

messages.en:
Perhaps you know the history of Further Foodstuffs? It provides food and supplies to both the Sarum Family and the Ardishapur Family, as well as to the Imperial Navy. Some dissidents, however, believe that this organization denies the military essential supplies that are necessary in the continuing struggles against our enemies.

Some of these low-life dissidents are attempting to disrupt the food supply to the royal families who run this corporation as a way of emphasizing their belief systems. How the scum were able to procure a fleet of ships is beyond my understanding. Perhaps they had help from members of the military who actually believe their propaganda? Regardless, they have amassed a great deal of firepower. If they hurt Further Foodstuffs, they hurt themselves. Does that make any sense to you?

Eliminate this rag-tag fleet.
messages.zh:
你大概知道长足食品的背景吧？这家公司向萨拉姆家族、阿狄莎波家族、以及帝国海军提供食品。有一些国内反对派却认为，该公司拒绝为军队提供长期对敌作战所必须的食品供应。

个别无耻的反对派试图干扰该公司向皇室家族的食品供应。要知道，皇室家族们创建这个公司是为了突出他们的宗教信仰理念。我不清楚那些反对派人渣是怎么获得一支舰队的。可能他们鼓动了军队里的某些人？无论如何，他们已经聚集了不少武装。如果他们伤害长足食品，就是伤害他们自己。我的意思你懂吧？

消灭这支无耻的舰队。

messages.en: Are you kidding me? I spent a great deal of time searching for a good pilot.
messages.zh: 你在扯淡吗？我花了很长时间就为了找一个靠谱的飞行员。

messages.en: Are you there yet?
messages.zh: 你到了吗？

messages.en: A hefty award awaits you upon successful completion of this mission.
messages.zh: 如果你成功完成任务，我不会亏待你的。

messages.en:
Apparently, a rival corporation is afraid of our rapid growth in the field of starship design. An “associate” of ours has informed us that a shipment of datacores heading to one of our research stations is to be intercepted by a fleet of Guristas mercenaries. What's disturbing is that an Amarr corporation has allegedly hired the pirates to do this dirty work.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the Guristas threat. What we need is proof that our rivals are pulling their strings or that they have nothing to do with this whatsoever.
messages.zh:
显然，我们的一个竞争对手对我们在星舰设计领域的快速成长深感不安。我们的一位“朋友”告知我们，一支古斯塔斯佣兵舰队将要拦截我们送往某个研究中心的一船数据核心。令我们不安的是，某个艾玛军团被指是这次肮脏行径的幕后指使者。

我们希望你去阻止古斯塔斯佣兵并且消灭他们。我们需要证据来表明，我们的竞争对手到底是幕后黑手，还是与此毫无干系。

messages.en: A job well done, friend! Here is that reward I promised.
messages.zh: 干得不错，我的朋友！这是我答应过你的报酬。

messages.en:
Apparently, a rival corporation is afraid of our rapid growth in the field of starship design. An “associate” of ours has informed us that a shipment of datacores heading to one of our research stations is to be intercepted by a fleet of Guristas mercenaries. What's disturbing is that an Amarr corporation has allegedly hired the pirates to do this dirty work. If that's true, there is a major shift in philosophy among our adversaries, both in the boardroom and in space. We need more information before we can act upon this.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the Guristas threat. Find out, if you can, who is behind this. What we need is proof that our rivals are pulling their strings or that they have nothing to do with this whatsoever.
messages.zh:
显然，我们的一个竞争对手对我们在星舰设计领域的快速成长深感不安。我们的一位“朋友”告知我们，一支古斯塔斯佣兵舰队将要拦截我们送往某个研究中心的一船数据核心。令我们不安的是，某个艾玛军团被指是这次肮脏行径的幕后指使者。如果这是真的，那说明我们对手对我们的策略有了一个重大转变，无论是在商场中还是在战场上。在进一步行动之前，我们需要更多信息。

我们希望你去阻止古斯塔斯佣兵并且消灭他们。如果可以，你要找出谁是幕后黑手。我们需要证据来表明，我们的竞争对手到底是幕后黑手，还是与此毫无干系。

messages.en: Coward! I knew I shouldn't have trusted you.
messages.zh: 懦夫！我知道我就不应该相信你的。

messages.en: Excellent. I have uploaded the coordinates to the mission details in your Opportunity interface.
messages.zh: 非常好。我已经把坐标上传到你“机遇”界面的任务详情中了。

messages.en:
It appears the Gallente have been making hostile moves again in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. They've been continuously launching attacks from a command vessel somewhere in a deadspace pocket. Our scouts have located the Federation admiral responsible for these raids and now we just need her taken care of.

We've dealt with this thing before, so we're confident that removing her from the picture will disrupt the rest of the Gallente operations in our area. The only issue is that the Navy won't be able to mobilize against her in time – they're the Navy after all, not a hit squad. I've been asked to recruit a capsuleer if possible, so we can bypass internal military procedures altogether.

That's where you come in {[character]player.name}. We need you to travel over to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, enter the deadspace pocket our scouts have found, then kill the commander and her fleet.

She'll undoubtedly be back at some point even if your mission is successful. The Gallente are a persistent enemy, so after you've killed her, leave the body in the communication array she's been coordinating the forces out of. That should send a message. It might even spook her into seeking reassignment elsewhere, away from our corporation's space.
messages.zh:
盖伦特联邦在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系又采取了一些敌对的行动。他们不断地从一艘指挥船上发动袭击，那船在一个死亡空间里的某个地点。我们的侦查员已经定位到主使这些袭击的那名联邦海军上将，现在我们要把她除掉。

我们以前也处理过这种情况，所以我们确信，除掉了她就可以打断盖伦特联邦在我们这一带的行动。唯一的问题是，我们的海军无法及时抽调兵力来对付她——毕竟海军不像突击队那么灵活。他们命令我尽可能募集一位克隆飞行员，这样我们就可以绕过一切正规军事手续。

你大展身手的时候来了{[character]player.name}。我们要你前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，进入我们侦查到的那个死亡空间，然后消灭那名指挥官以及她的舰队。

毫无疑问，即使你的任务成功完成，她过阵子还会卷土重来。盖伦特是我们的宿敌，所以你消灭她之后，要把她的尸体留在那座通信阵列里——那是她一直以来组织军事行动的地方。这相当于一个警告。她可能就会有所顾虑，甚至寻求转职到别的战区，远离我们军团的区域。

messages.en: Great work, {[character]player.name}. Intel places her at a cloning station deep inside Federation space. I imagine it will be a while before she tries that move again, and if she does, you've left a reminder on how it will end.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。情报显示她的克隆重生在深入盖伦特联邦的区域。我认为她近期不会再来滋扰了，就算她真的又来，你也给她留下了一记深刻的教训。

messages.en: I thought a patriot like you would be up for this. I'll leave your name out of my report to the Navy, but I am a little disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我原以为像你这样的爱国者是不二人选。我给海军发报告的时候不会提到你，但我对你有些失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Good to see you again, {[character]player.name}. We've got something you'd be perfect for.

It appears the Gallente have been making hostile moves again in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. They've been continuously launching attacks from a command vessel somewhere in a deadspace pocket. Our scouts have located the Federation admiral responsible for these raids and now we just need her taken care of.

We've dealt with this thing before, so we're confident that removing her from the picture will disrupt the rest of the Gallente operations in our area. The only issue is that the Navy won't be able to mobilize against her in time – they're the Navy after all, not a hit squad. I've been asked to recruit a capsuleer if possible, so we can bypass internal military procedures altogether.

That's where you come in {[character]player.name}. We need you to travel over to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, enter the deadspace pocket our scouts have found, then kill the commander and her fleet.

She'll undoubtedly be back at some point even if your mission is successful. The Gallente are a persistent enemy, so after you've killed her, leave the body in the communication array she's been coordinating the forces out of. That should send a message. It might even spook her into seeking reassignment elsewhere, away from our corporation's space.
messages.zh:
真高兴再次见到你，{[character]player.name}。我们有个任务很适合你。

盖伦特联邦在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系又采取了一些敌对的行动。他们不断地从一艘指挥船上发动袭击，那船在一个死亡空间里的某个地点。我们的侦查员已经定位到主使这些袭击的那名联邦海军上将，现在我们要把她除掉。

我们以前也处理过这种情况，所以我们确信，除掉了她就可以打断盖伦特联邦在我们这一带的行动。唯一的问题是，我们的海军无法及时抽调兵力来对付她——毕竟海军不像突击队那么灵活。他们命令我尽可能募集一位克隆飞行员，这样我们就可以绕过一切正规军事手续。

你大展身手的时候来了{[character]player.name}。我们要你前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，进入我们侦查到的那个死亡空间，然后消灭那名指挥官以及她的舰队。

毫无疑问，即使你的任务成功完成，她过阵子还会卷土重来。盖伦特是我们的宿敌，所以你消灭她之后，要把她的尸体留在那座通信阵列里——那是她一直以来组织军事行动的地方。这相当于一个警告。她可能就会有所顾虑，甚至寻求转职到别的战区，远离我们军团的区域。

messages.en: I'm afraid your name was already put forward to deal with this. This won't reflect well on you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 要解决这个问题，恐怕只能靠你。你的名字已经被呈上去了。你不会有好报的，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: The admiral isn't going to stay in that location for very long. Take her out as quickly as you can.
messages.zh: 海军上将不会在那里停留太久。你要尽快除掉她。

messages.en: Great to hear. I've uploaded the coordinates.
messages.zh: 听上去很好。我已经上传了坐标。

messages.en:
The Gallente have set up another mining operation near one of our asteroid belts. They bring in semi-mobile reprocessing stations and then mine the location dry. You have to recognize this as just another act of war, {[character]player.name}. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has lost millions of ISK to these Federation parasites. It's almost as damaging as a direct attack, but it doesn't draw the sort of military response an overt assault would, which is why we need capsuleer assistance to deal with this quickly.

We know they've set up mining outpost at one of the smaller deadspace asteroid pockets {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} frequents. They do this in the hope that nobody will come after them. I need you to send the Federation a message that they're wrong – that the State will pursue them every time. You must show them that there's no profit to be made from illegally mining belts we have claimed.

Go to the outpost and destroy absolutely everything; all the miners and any reprocessing stations you see. Level the place entirely. The loss of personnel and equipment will set them back and send a clear message to stick to their own space.
messages.zh:
在我们的一条小行星带附近，盖伦特人又搞了一处开采作业。他们带来了半移动式提炼站，然后把那个地方挖个精光。你只能认为这是另一种战争行为，{[character]player.name}。 {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}被这些盖伦特联邦寄生虫们抢走了千百万的财富。 这种行为造成的损害和直接攻击差不多，但是却无法像公开进攻那样引起军方的足够重视。因此要尽快解决此问题，就得靠飞行员的帮助。

我们知道他们建立了一个开采哨站，就在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}经常光顾的一个小型死亡空间小行星带里。他们以为这样做就不会有人跟随而来。我要你去告诉那些盖伦特人，他们错了——合众国每一回都饶不了他们。你必须要让他们知道，我们拥有的小行星绝不容许非法采掘。

前往那个哨站，摧毁一切；你懂的，所有矿工，所有提炼厂。把那里整个儿铲平。人员和设备损失会让他们破费不少，而且会清楚地警告他们：要乖乖待在自己地盘上。

messages.en: Great work; hopefully those thieves won't come back any time soon.
messages.zh: 干得好；那些小贼近期应该不会再出现了。

messages.en: I'm surprised that someone like you would be afraid to take on a few rogue miners.
messages.zh: 我勒个去，你竟然连几个流氓矿工都害怕。

messages.en:
I'm glad to see you made it over, {[character]player.name}. I have a problem with some Gallente miners that I think you'd be perfect for.

The Gallente have set up another mining operation near one of our asteroid belts. They bring in semi-mobile reprocessing stations and then mine the location dry. You have to recognize this as just another act of war, {[character]player.name}. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has lost millions of ISK to these Federation parasites. It's almost as damaging as a direct attack, but it doesn't draw the sort of military response an overt assault would, which is why we need capsuleer assistance to deal with this quickly.

We know they've set up mining outpost at one of the smaller deadspace asteroid pockets {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} frequents. They do this in the hope that nobody will come after them. I need you to send the Federation a message that they're wrong – that the State will pursue them every time. You must show them that there's no profit to be made from illegally mining belts we have claimed.

Go to the outpost and destroy absolutely everything; all the miners and any reprocessing stations you see. Level the place entirely. The loss of personnel and equipment will set them back and send a clear message to stick to their own space.
messages.zh:
你的来访真令我高兴，{[character]player.name}。一些盖伦特矿工给我找了个麻烦，我觉得你正好能帮我处理。

在我们的一条小行星带附近，盖伦特人又搞了一处开采作业。他们带来了半移动式提炼站，然后把那个地方挖个精光。你只能认为这是另一种战争行为，{[character]player.name}。 {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}被这些盖伦特联邦寄生虫们抢走了千百万的财富。 这种行为造成的损害和直接攻击差不多，但是却无法像公开进攻那样引起军方的足够重视。因此要尽快解决此问题，就得靠飞行员的帮助。

我们知道他们建立了一个开采哨站，就在{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} 经常光顾的一个小型死亡空间小行星带里。他们以为这样做就不会有人跟随而来。我要你去告诉那些盖伦特人，他们错了——合众国每一回都饶不了他们。你必须要让他们知道，我们拥有的小行星绝不容许非法采掘。

前往那个哨站，摧毁一切；你懂的，所有矿工，所有提炼厂。把那里整个儿铲平。人员和设备损失会让他们破费不少，而且会清楚地警告他们：要乖乖待在自己地盘上。

messages.en: I will have to find someone else more capable, then. I'm surprised you couldn't handle this, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 看来我只好另请高明了。你连这都搞不定，我太震惊了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Move quickly, {[character]player.name}. Every hour that passes means more profit lost.
messages.zh: 赶紧的，{[character]player.name}。每小时我们都要损失不少。

messages.en:
I knew I was right to choose you for this. I've added the command vessel's location to the mission details in your Opportunity interface.

I'd expect a difficult battle, {[character]player.name}. You're about the draw the attention of an entire Federation Navy division. You will likely have to fight your way through to the commander once they realize you've breached.
messages.zh:
我就知道找你准没错。我已经把指挥舰的位置添加到你“机遇”界面的任务详情中了。

我估计是场苦战，{[character]player.name}。你要面对的是联邦海军整整一个师的兵力。要是潜入时暴露，你可能得杀出一条血路才能接近指挥官。

messages.en:
Within the next week the Gallente Federation will officially claim sovereignty over the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} , citing a recent worker's riot as proof of “a desire for democracy”. The Federation has moved a division of their Navy into the system, and if we don't forcibly push them out soon the riots could escalate further.

Slip past the Navy forces from their rear flank and destroy the Gallente command ship and its escorts.. This will throw the rest of the division into disarray momentarily, and at that point, the Caldari Navy will move in.
messages.zh:
下周之内，盖伦特联邦会正式宣布对于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的主权，并会引用最近的工人暴动作为“民主欲求”的证据。联邦已经调遣了海军一个师到那个星系。如果我们不用武力尽快赶走他们，那么暴动还会进一步升级。

从海军部队后侧溜进去，然后消灭盖伦特指挥舰及其护卫。这样一来，他们剩余的部队就会陷入短期混乱，而那个时候加达里海军就可以开进来。

messages.en: Great job {[character]player.name}. We've already taken care of most of the forces in one decisive sweep. The Federation will surely be on the retreat soon.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。我们通过这次决定性的清剿行动铲平了大部分武装。联邦军队很快就会撤退。

messages.en: I set this task aside just for you, and you repay me by throwing it back in my face? We're done here.
messages.zh: 我专门给你挑的任务，你竟然给我甩回来？我们没什么好谈的了。

messages.en:
Formerly an extremist labor movement in the State, the Brothers of Freedom led a widespread revolt against corporate security forces on a number of Caldari planets in YC 109 – some time before Tibus Heth's vastly more successful revolt of a similar nature -- after 65,000 protesters were killed by Caldari paramilitary forces while trying to force their way onto a CEP station in the New Caldari system. After months of dogged pursuit by Caldari authorities, the riots were put down and most of the leaders were killed or arrested.

Some of the leadership, including the ringleader Melarius Torvil, did manage to escape the final Caldari Navy operation that crushed the Brothers' movement. Torvil and a small group of associates fled to the Minmatar Republic and applied for asylum from Caldari persecution, which was granted by the late President Midular's Gallente-friendly government.

Today, though they have been largely eliminated as a major force in the State, the Brothers of Freedom continue to spread anti-corporate propaganda and speak out against the CEP's government in the Gallente Federation and the Minmatar Nation, as well as outlying State settlements and facilities.
messages.zh:
自由兄弟会的前身是一场极端主义劳工运动。新伊甸纪元109年，在广大抗议者试图闯进新加达里星系中的一座CEO合作组织空间站的时候，有六万五千人死于加达里准军事部队之手。因此自由兄弟会在许多加达里的星球上开展广泛的对抗集团安全部队的运动，之后，提波斯·赫特领导了一次更成功的类似性质的反抗。在加达里当局长达几个月的执拗的追击后，暴动终于平息，而且大多数领导人都死亡或被捕。

不过有一些领导人，包括会长米拉瑞斯·托维尔，成功地逃脱了最后加达里海军对兄弟会运动的控制。托维尔和一小部分同伴都逃去了米玛塔尔共和国，并且申请免受加达里迫害的庇护。亲盖伦特的前任米杜拉政府准予了他们的请求。

今天，虽然这支重要的力量在加达里境内已基本被清除，自由兄弟会仍然在其他地区宣传反对CEO合作组织及其政府。他们的活动遍及盖伦特联邦，米玛塔尔共和国，和加达里偏远地区的定居点与设施。

messages.en: The Brothers of Freedom
messages.zh: 自由兄弟会

messages.en:
Sometimes it's easy to forget we're at war with the Gallente. Maybe not for you, of course, since it's you capsuleers who are doing most of the fighting, but for the rest of us things can seem awfully “business as usual” at times.

I'm saying this because we've had a development recently; something that's reminded a lot of senior people there's a war still going on. They've asked me to scout for capsuleers willing to deal with this situation, and that request has brought you to me, {[character]player.name}.

We have credible intel that sometime within the next week the Gallente Federation will officially claim sovereignty over the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and relocate an entire Navy division to support this claim. They will justify these actions by citing a recent worker's riot as proof of “a desire for democracy”. In reality, they just want to inflame the few unhappy people further and cost our entire corporation massive amounts of ISK in the process. They have no desire to genuinely help anyone but themselves.

The Federation has moved a division of their Navy into the system, and if we don't forcibly push them out soon the riots could escalate further. We must do everything we can to avoid a repeat of the Brothers of Freedom. The State has seen enough high-profile dissenters in recent years; yet another would not help our people. We obviously cannot allow this claim to ever happen, or for this Federation task force to gain any momentum whatsoever.

We need you to slip past the Navy forces and destroy the Gallente command ship leading them. This will throw the rest of the division into disarray momentarily, and at that point, the Caldari Navy will move in. We've discovered a deadspace route that will allow you to strike the command ship and its escorts from a rear flank. They shouldn't even see you coming.
messages.zh:
有时候很容易忘记我们和盖伦特联邦在打仗。你或许不会忘，当然了，你们飞行员总是在战斗。不过对其他像我这样的人来说，常常就是平静地上班过日子。

我说这些是因为最近事情有些变化；让很多老人都一下子记起来我们还在打仗。他们要求我寻找愿意来处理这个情况的飞行员，于是我就找到了你，{[character]player.name}。

据可靠情报，盖伦特联邦在下周内会正式宣布对于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的主权，并且会派遣联邦海军一个整师的军力来确保主权。他们为了粉饰这次行动，会引用最近的工人暴动作为“民主欲求”的证据。实际上，他们只想在那一撮不满的人群中煽风点火，让我们整个军团花大价钱来处理这个局面。他们不会真心想要帮助任何人，除了他们自己。

联邦已经调遣了海军一个师到那个星系。如果我们不用武力尽快赶走他们，那么暴动还会进一步升级。我们必须尽全力避免自由兄弟会那种事件重演。这几年来，合众国已经出现了太多的高调反对派；再出几个的话，对民众没有好处。显然我们绝不能让这种主权宣布发生，也绝不能让联邦军队感到有机可乘。

我们需要你从海军部队侧翼溜进去，然后消灭领导他们的盖伦特指挥舰。这样一来，他们剩余的部队就会陷入短期混乱，而那个时候加达里海军就可以开进来。我们发现了一条死亡空间路径，可以让你从后侧直取指挥舰及其护卫。他们甚至不会察觉你的出现。

messages.en: You've made us both look bad, {[character]player.name}, and if we don't stop that force, the entire State will look even worse. We do not have the luxury of failing. Someone more reliable will have to be found to replace you.
messages.zh: 你让我们很没面子，{[character]player.name}，如果我们不能搞定那支部队，整个合众国会更没面子。我们不允许失败。会有更能干的人来替代你。

messages.en: The Navy is waiting on you to take out that command vessel. As soon as you do, they'll make their move.
messages.zh: 海军在等你除掉那艘指挥舰。一旦你得手，他们就出击。

name.fr: Un mercenaire à la langue bien pendue

messages.en: The Amarr Empire thanks you for your assistance in this matter. Please use all speed and discretion in apprehending this degenerate.
messages.zh: 艾玛帝国感谢你的帮助。请你英明神武地摆平这个人渣。

messages.en: A Minmatar merc plans to kidnap an Amarr young noble, so we need you to take him out before he can even make the attempt.  We know where he is preparing his plan.  You need to get in and dispose of him before he can even make his attempt. . He's a crafty SOB, so expect not just a fight, but some unorthodox challenges when he realizes you're on to him. He's especially fond of drawing pursuers into hazardous clouds.
messages.zh: 一个米玛塔尔雇佣兵正在计划绑架一名艾玛年轻贵族，因此我们需要你在那个佣兵得手前干掉他。我们知道他在哪里谋划行动。你要前往那个地点，并且在他实施计划前把他处理掉。他是个狡猾的人渣，所以别指望直接交火消灭他。当他意识到自己被你盯上了，可能会使出一些非常规的招数。他最擅长把追击者引入有毒的云团。

messages.en: Great job, {[character]player.name}.  The Amarr Empire is in your debt.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。艾玛帝国欠你一份人情。

messages.en: I have to find a braver pilot than you, apparently.
messages.zh: 显然我得找一个比你更勇敢的飞行员。

messages.en: A significant number of Minmatar make their living on the darker side of the law, acting as pirates, smugglers and peddlers in all kinds of illegal goods. Many of the larger criminal groups in the world of EVE are run by Minmatar.
messages.zh: 有相当多的米玛塔尔人在黑道上谋生，他们从事海盗、非法贩售、犯罪等各种非法活动。新伊甸里的很多大型犯罪集团都是米玛塔尔人经营的。

messages.en: Minmatar Piracy
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔海盗

messages.en:
A confidential informant has warned us of an impending kidnapping attempt on a young noble by a notorious Minmatar mercenary. One of my associates, who owes me a lifetime worth of favors, discovered the plot during a card game. The merc's mouth and ego are both the size of New Eden itself. He talked openly about his plan without a second thought. We need your help in stopping him before he can carry out his plans.

His staging ground is at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Find and kill him with any and all means at your disposal. He's a crafty SOB, so expect not just a fight, but some unorthodox challenges when he realizes you're on to him. He's especially fond of drawing pursuers into hazardous clouds. Odds are good he'll have some ex-Navy Minnies flying back-up. He might be a braggart, but he's still a paranoid merc. Be careful.
messages.zh:
一名卧底警告我们说，有个臭名昭著的米玛塔尔雇佣兵正准备绑架一位年轻的贵族。欠我很多人情的一位同事在打牌的时候，听说了这个阴谋。这个佣兵真是个自大狂，而且口无遮拦。他竟然公开谈论自己的绑架计划。我们需要你的帮助，阻止他实施自己的计划。

他的落脚点在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。找到他，然后不惜一切代价干掉他。他是个狡猾的人渣，所以别指望直接交火消灭他。当他意识到自己被你盯上了，可能会使出一些非常规的招数。他最擅长把追击者引入有毒的云团。他还可能有一些海军退伍老兵做伴。虽然他喜欢吹牛皮，但是作为佣兵他也留了几手。要小心。

messages.en: Too tough for you, eh?  This merc has defeated greater men than you, so don't let it hurt your ego too much.
messages.zh: 这事情对你来说太困难了吗？这个佣兵打败过比你还强的人，所以你用不着感到伤自尊。

messages.en: The merc's sneaky.  He will use every trick he knows to escape.  Keep your eyes open for clues he may leave behind!
messages.zh: 这个佣兵很狡猾。他会用尽一切伎俩逃跑。仔细观察他可能留下的线索。

messages.en: Excellent.  Remember, this operation is classified as top secret.  You are not to discuss it with anyone.
messages.zh: 很好。  记住，这次行动属于最高机密。你不能跟任何人讲。

messages.en:
A maintenance team assigned to a top secret acceleration gate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has stopped transmitting progress reports. As this gate leads to one of our new listening outposts, alarm rang out in military circles.

Travel to the acceleration gate. Destroy any hostiles. Use the acceleration gate and check on the outpost. If the outpost's location has been compromised, you are ordered to eliminate the hostiles and then destroy the gate. You must ensure that the enemy cannot return to the exact location of our outpost.
messages.zh:
一支维修小队被派到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一座绝密加速轨道，但他们最近不再发送工作进展报告。由于那座加速轨道通往我们的一个新监听哨站，因此军方很紧张。

赶到那座加速轨道。消灭一切敌人。使用那座加速轨道，并查看哨站的情况。如果哨站的位置已经暴露，那么你要清除敌军，然后摧毁该加速轨道。你必须确保敌人无法再返回到我们哨站的具体位置。

messages.en: It had to be done.  We'll get another gate built out there and a military presence to protect it.  In the meantime, the citizens at the listening post will have to make due with the supplies they have.  Rest assured that we will do everything we can to get back to them as quickly as possible.
messages.zh: 必须要这样。我们会建造另一座加速轨道，并且派部队来保卫它。与此同时，监听哨站的公民们需要合理利用他们的贮备给养。放心吧，我们会尽一切努力早日与他们重聚。

messages.en: Very well.  I will find someone else.
messages.zh: 好吧。我会另请高明。

messages.en: As to those citizens stationed at the outpost, yes, they will be cut off from all outside contact until a new acceleration gate can be built.  The good news is that the outpost is equipped with a Stealth Emitter Array that will keep it hidden until we can return.  The not-so-good news is that those citizens could experience some long term side effects from the energies emitted by the array, but they knew the risks when they signed on.  Secrecy is paramount, both from a political and a military perspective.
messages.zh: 至于那个哨站里驻扎的公民们，他们会和外界失去联系，直到我们修建一座新的加速轨道。好消息是，那个哨站装备了隐形发射阵列；在我们返回那里之前，它可以一直保持隐身状态。坏消息是，那些公民会受到隐形阵列发射能量的长期副作用；那又怎样，他们签劳动合同的时候就知道这些风险。保密工作事关重大，政治上和军事上都要求如此。

messages.en: Citizens Stationed at the Outpost
messages.zh: 驻留哨站的公民们

messages.en:
A maintenance team assigned to a top secret acceleration gate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has stopped transmitting progress reports. As this gate leads to one of our new listening outposts, alarm rang out in military circles.

Travel to the acceleration gate. Destroy any hostiles. Use the acceleration gate and check on the outpost. If the outpost's location has been compromised, you are ordered to eliminate the hostiles and then destroy the gate. You must ensure that the enemy cannot return to the exact location of our outpost.

You have your orders. Will you execute them to the best of your ability?
messages.zh:
一支维修小队被派到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一座绝密加速轨道，但他们最近不再发送工作进展报告。由于那座加速轨道通往我们的一个新监听哨站，因此军方很紧张。

赶到那座加速轨道。消灭一切敌人。使用那座加速轨道，并查看哨站的情况。如果哨站的位置已经暴露，那么你要清除敌军，然后摧毁该加速轨道。你必须确保敌人无法再返回到我们哨站的具体位置。

命令就是这些。你能尽全力执行它们吗？

messages.en: Damn, just what I need.  Another political firestorm.  I had better find a way to fix this quickly.
messages.zh: 靠，不是吧。又要来一场政治风波。我最好赶紧把这件事摆平。

messages.en: Still nothing from the maintenance team.  Advise me on your status.
messages.zh: 仍然没有维修小队的消息。告诉我你的进展。

messages.en: I'll thank you later. Please get going.
messages.zh: 稍后我再感谢你。快去吧。

messages.en: A portion of the fleet is preparing a set of protracted war games  in the next few days. There was some mix up with a circuitry order that I only just found out about. Collect the custom circuitry from the production line in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The level of piracy in the area is unknown.
messages.zh: 舰队的一部分正在准备几天后的一次长时间军事演习。但我刚刚发现有一笔电路订单搞错了。从{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的生产线上取回自制电路。尚不清楚当地的海盗活动情况。

messages.en: You were attacked? What would they want with training drone AI ? Wonderful, now we'll have to hold up the war games   for a security check of the entire shipment. I didn't realize Angel Cartel could be subtle. Given how this went for them, maybe they should stick to the direct approach.
messages.zh: 你被攻击了？他们训练无人机人工智能干什么？好家伙，这下我们只好暂停军事演习了，整批货物都要进行安全检查。我没想到天使联合企业这么狡猾。从这事对它们的影响来看，或许他们应该坚持直来直去。

messages.en: Well so much for all that wasted time.
messages.zh: 那就不浪费时间了。

messages.en: Production for all types of goods can be found in all corners of New Eden. Every so often, though, something of a specific design is required that must be produced from a specific area. Sometimes this is due to patents, sometimes it's more to do with a sudden requirement for obsolete or cutting edge equipment.  Desperation on the part of the buyer can lead to major holes in market security.
messages.zh: 新伊甸的每个角落都在生产各式各样的物品。但是经常有时候，一种特殊设计的物品必须在一个特殊的地点才能生产。可能是因为专利，也可能是因为需要古老的设备或者最新的设备。心急的买家可以导致市场上出现重大的安全问题。

messages.en: Custom Parts
messages.zh: 定制零件

messages.en:
Glad my invitation reached you, {[character]player.name}. A portion of the fleet  is preparing a set of protracted war games in the next few days. I've been put in charge of constructing decoy ships and structures, but there was some mix up with a circuitry order that I only just found out about.
I found a replacement vendo. All my subordinates are too occupied to retrieve it.
You'll be picking up the goods direct from a production line, not through their public market. I haven't had time to check reports on local piracy though. There may be hostiles. Be ready for a fight. I don't care if you have to blow the storage facility apart, we need those chips.
messages.zh: 很高兴你收到了我的邀请，{[character]player.name}。舰队的一部分正在准备几天后的一次长时间军事演习。我负责打造诱饵船和诱饵建筑，但我刚刚发现有一笔电路订单搞错了。我找了一个替代零件卖家。我的下属们都太忙了，没空去拿货。你要从生产线上直接取货带回来，而不是从公共市场上买。不过，我还没来得及检查当地的海盗情况。那里也许会有敌人。要做好战斗准备。就算你把储藏设施打爆了我也无所谓，我们只要那些电路芯片。

messages.en: You're kidding. This is one disaster after another.
messages.zh: 你太假了。真是祸不单行。

messages.en: I don't have anything else for you {[character]player.name}. What are you waiting for?
messages.zh: 我的话说完了，{[character]player.name}。你还等什么？

messages.en: Thank you for doing this. Entertainment is becoming more and more important to the citizens of the Federation, and it's widely believed that whatever troubles may befall us, we'll overcome them based on our willingness to defend our culture.
messages.zh: 感谢你所做的这些。娱乐对于联邦民众们来说越来越重要了，而且很多人都认为，凭借我们捍卫本族文化的坚强意志，无论什么艰难险阻都能战胜。

messages.en: Fly out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, drop the band off at their manager's station, and take care of the pirates.
messages.zh: 前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，在他们经理的空间站上把乐队放下来，并且摆平海盗们。

messages.en:
Outstanding work, egger. The label was still willing to pay your fee, and the producer was recovered and brought up on charges.

On a side note, the entire band was psyched about what you did. I think you inspired a real creative explosion in them, and I hope we can look forward to better music.
messages.zh:
干得真不错，克隆飞行员。唱片公司仍然愿意支付你的费用，还有，那个制作人已经被找到并且会被审判。

顺便告诉你，整支乐队在领略你的强力之后，都激动万分。我感觉在你的启发下，他们爆发了一股真正的创作灵感。希望今后我们能听到更好的音乐。

messages.en: Well, thanks for your time. I'll just have to tell their manager to hold on while I find another reputable pilot. Lucky me.  You cap-pilots are common these days, but not ones I'd be willing to work with.
messages.zh: 好吧，还是感谢你抽空过来。我只好让经理再等等了，我得另找一位有名气的飞行员。真走运。这年头克隆飞行员多的是，却找不到一个跟我合得来的。

messages.en: This heavy metal rock opera band was made famous by their first album's cover, which depicted two naked individuals engaging in sexual intercourse while floating in space without spacesuits. Gallente politicians tried to have the album, called Unprotected, banned. Not because of the adult content, they claimed, but because it promoted unsafe extravehicular activities.
messages.zh: 这支重金属摇滚歌剧乐队首张专辑的封面让其名声远扬。该封面描绘了两个人一丝不挂飘浮于太空中秀恩爱。盖伦特政客们想封禁这部名为无防护的专辑。他们宣称理由并非是其中的成人内容，而是其公然鼓励不安全的舰船舱外行动。

messages.en: Quantum Entanglement
messages.zh: 量子纠缠乐队

messages.en:
Have you ever heard of the band Quantum Entanglement? They're a heavy metal rock opera group with a theatric, costumed stage presence. Seriously, they're all the rage among the Federation's youth. The front man is none other than Halo Axegrinder, who was one of the founding members of Starved Fedo. Remember them?

Okay, personally I can't stand that garbage, but billions of fans can't be wrong, right? Anyway, their manager is one of my old school chums and he's asked me for a personal favor. He says they thrive on adrenalin, and since most of their songs are about war, he thinks they might be inspired by experiencing a little combat action.

Coincidentally, I've got a little pirate attack that needs to be dealt with in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system; it's a task I would usually allocate to some rookie capsuleer far below your standing with the corporation. If you're packing the kind of firepower I think you are, you should be able to take this installation down without breaking a sweat. Let a few hits bounce off of your defenses to give these guys the ride of their lives and that should give them enough inspiration for a lifetime of edgy, hard-hitting chart-toppers. I think that's the right terminology.
messages.zh:
你听说过量子纠缠乐队吗？他们是一支重金属摇滚歌剧组合，演出时穿着戏剧式的服装。老实说，他们在盖伦特联邦青少年当中很受追捧。他们的领队不是别人，正是圣光·砺斧者，饥饿的费多组合的创始人之一。对他们有印象吧？

好吧，虽然我个人受不了那货，但广大粉丝的眼睛是雪亮的，对不？不管怎样，他们的经理跟我是老同学，这次是他托我帮忙。他说这乐队见到惊险刺激就来劲，写的歌曲很多都是有关打仗的。他觉得如果让乐队经历一点战斗行动，可能会带来很多创作灵感。

碰巧的是，我手头正好需要处理一点海盗袭击的麻烦，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系；通常这种事情我都找那些声望比你低的新手飞行员。如果你的火力跟我猜的一样猛，那些海盗对你来说就是小菜一碟。只要你的船挨上几下，就能让乐队的这些家伙爽翻，那样子激发出来的灵感，足够他们创作一辈子的“前卫劲爆榜首金曲”。那些词我没说错吧。

messages.en: What went wrong? You've put me in a spot here. I can't say I appreciate this but it's not like I can do anything about it.
messages.zh: 怎么了？你真把我难住了。虽然我很不爽，但是也没办法。

messages.en: Are they getting on your nerves yet?
messages.zh: 他们让你觉得烦了吗？

name.ja: サルベージに群がる獣をなだめる
name.ru: Укрощение дикого зверя (Soothe the Salvage Beast)

messages.en: It's all yours. We'll upload the identification beacons to your ship now.
messages.zh: 这都是你的了。我们会马上将识别信标装到你的船上。

messages.en: Find the lost fleet in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and recover the data cores; destroy anything that stands in your way.
messages.zh: 去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}找到那支失事的舰队，收回数据核心；干掉一切碍事的东西。

messages.en: That's fantastic news! Thanks!
messages.zh: 真是非常好的消息！谢谢你！

messages.en: Damn. We were hoping to attract someone of your reputation and firepower. We'll see if we can't settle for someone else.
messages.zh: 该死的。我们希望能找个像你这样有名望并且强力的人。如果我们找不到别人的话，就有好戏看了。

messages.en:
We just lost a fleet out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It's a waste of hardware and personnel, but at the very least, we'd like to recover the data cores of each ship. If the vultures haven't started in on the carcass yet, they will soon. We can't afford a whole recovery effort, but we'd rather hire a capsuleer like you than let those blood-suckers run off with our data.

Keep anything else you like from the site, and if a few raiders and pirates end up dead, I doubt anyone would complain, if you know what I mean.
messages.zh:
我们刚刚在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}失去了一支舰队。这是人力物力的极大损失，不过至少我们还可以收回每一艘船的数据核心。有句话说的好：如果秃鹰还没出现在尸体上，那说明它们就快到了。我们没有足够的精力去做回收工作，但与其让我们的数据落入一群拾荒者手里，还不如雇佣像你这样的一位克隆飞行员去把那些数据拿回来。

你要是找到些别的什么东西，尽管拿去。如果有几个血袭海盗什么的挂了的话，我想也没人关心的，你懂我的意思吧。

messages.en: Damn. We were hoping to attract someone of your reputation and firepower. We'll see if we can't settle for someone else.
messages.zh: 该死的。我们希望能找个像你这样有名望并且强力的人。如果我们找不到别人的话，就有好戏看了。

messages.en: Time is running out. By the time you get there, it might already be picked clean.
messages.zh: 时间不等人。等你到了那里，可能一切都被人捡光了。

messages.en:
Good. Head out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I've sent word, so they should know to hand him over to you when you get there. They haven't responded yet, but it's an old installation, and a busy one, too. I'm sure it's nothing.

When you get him, bring him back here.
messages.zh:
很好。前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。我已经发过讯息，所以你到那里时，他们应该知道把他转交给你。他们还没有回复我，不过那是一座老牢狱了，也很繁忙。应该没问题吧。

你接到他后，就把他带回来。

messages.en: Go pick up the Caldari operative from the penal station in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and bring him back.
messages.zh: 前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的牢狱空间站，接到并带回加达里探员。

messages.en: Good work. You really thought on your feet for that one. We'll be debriefing the operative shortly. Your payment is well deserved, unfortunately the Caldari did get away with a lot of prisoners.
messages.zh: 干得好。你表现得驾轻就熟。我们很快就会听取那个探员的任务报告。你完全对得起给你的报酬，不幸的是，加达里人还是放跑了很多囚犯。

messages.en: Sorry to hear that. You sure? Simple, lucrative work doesn't come around every day.
messages.zh: 令人难过。你当真吗？简单又来钱的工作可不是天天都有。

messages.en:
I've got a delicate yet dangerous task that just wouldn't suit anyone other than a capsuleer. Here's the situation:

We caught a Caldari operative trying to walk out of the University of Callie with, and I say this literally, an armful of data cores stolen from the university's research hospital. We've had him locked down at a penal instillation in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} since then, but our more convincing interrogators have changed his mind about giving up some information.

The catch is that he's demanded to be transferred to a more "dignified" location before he offers his full cooperation. That's where you come in.

Pick up the Caldari operative and bring him back here immediately.
messages.zh:
我有一项敏感又危险的任务，它对于一个克隆飞行员来说再合适不过了。情况是这样：

一个加达里探员从凯勒大学的科研医院里拿走了一大批数据核心，在试图溜走的时候，被我们抓住了。我们一直把他关押在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一座牢狱里，但我们的老手审讯员们现在想从他身上再榨取一些信息。

问题在于，他要求先转移到一处更“像样”的地方，才会充分与我们合作。这也就是我们要用你的原因。

接到那个加达里探员，并立即把他带回来。

messages.en: You're leaving me in a spot here. I'll have to get another trusted courier and contact the jail again.
messages.zh: 你真是给我找麻烦。我得另请一名可靠的通讯员，还得再次联系那座牢狱。

messages.en: What's your status?
messages.zh: 你那边情况怎样？

messages.en: Good luck out there.
messages.zh: 祝你好运。

messages.en: A drone network virus seems has taken over a mining colony and is infecting any ship that approaches. Eradicate all infected ships and destroy the virus before it infects yours.
messages.zh: 一种无人机网络病毒似乎控制了一处采矿殖民地，并且还在感染所有接近的船只。摧毁所有被感染的船只，并且在病毒感染你的船之前消灭它。

messages.en: That was close. A shame for those that lost their lives, but you did incredible work out there. We'll send a scuttle crew out to sweep up and find out what happened.
messages.zh: 真悬啊。对那些遇难者我感到很遗憾，不过，你的能力真是不可思议。我们会派一个小组去清理现场并查明原因。

messages.en: Can't say I blame you, but it still doesn't help me out any. You'll have to excuse me.
messages.zh: 我不能责怪你，但你也没帮上忙。失陪了。

messages.en: Rogue drones and wild drones are the terms used over advanced drones that mutated out of control. A few years ago some ingenious Gallente inventor had the idea of creating super-advanced drones that could think and act on their own - in essence acting in every sense like a regular space ship except being unmanned and computer controlled. First prototypes were encouraging, but then disaster struck. The drones became unruly, then unmanageable. Some of these were huge - the largest drones ever constructed, these drones were even equipped with warp drives and equipped with the latest advancements in artificial intelligence. These mother drones, as they were called, along with several lesser drones soon managed to spread out, not only within the same system as the research facility that birthed them, but also to other systems. Only later men discovered exactly how - the drones attacked and took over space ships, then used them to jump to other systems, the drones themselves safely hidden within the ship. Needless to say the super-drone research was soon abandoned by the Gallente.
messages.zh: 自由无人机和野生无人机是指那些因发生变异而不再受控的高级无人机。几年前，一位受人尊敬的盖伦特发明家产生了创造一种超级无人机的想法，这种无人机能够独立思考和行动——其行为在各方面都相当于一艘普通飞船，唯一不同之处在于，它由计算机控制，且无人驾驶。最初的原型机很激动人心，然而灾难随即降临。这些无人机变得不守规矩，后来根本就不听指挥。它们当中有一类体型巨大，是有史以来建造过的最大无人机，甚至配备了跃迁引擎和最新的人工智能技术。它们被称作母体无人机，并且和其他小型无人机一起开始扩张，不仅在它们诞生的星系内，还向其他的星系渗透。人们之后才发现它们是如何做到的——它们攻击并控制飞船，然后利用那些舰船向其他星系跳跃，同时它们把自己安全地隐藏在舰船内部。毫无疑问，盖伦特人很快废止了超级无人机的研究。

messages.en: Rogue Drones
messages.zh: 自由无人机

messages.en:
A rogue drone virus has gone live at a mining colony. The machinery is malfunctioning and the problem spreading throughout the entire network. We sent a small rescue crew and it took over their systems. The crews are still alive but they're held hostage by their own ships. Unfortunately, we can't let that cloud our judgment. The infection must be destroyed… completely.

We have reason to believe your capsuleer vessel will be able to withstand infection long enough to eradicate the problem.
messages.zh:
一种自由无人机病毒在一处采矿殖民地爆发了。机器全都失灵，问题蔓延到整个网络。我们派去了一个营救小队，然而病毒控制了他们的系统。队员们还活着，但是被他们自己的船扣作人质。不幸的是，我们要当机立断。传染必须被彻底清除。

我们有理由相信，你们克隆飞行员的舰船抗感染能力较强，从而争取到时间来解决问题。

messages.en: That doesn't leave me many options. You couldn't have told me earlier? No matter.
messages.zh: 你让我别无选择。难道你不能早点儿告诉我吗？算了。

messages.en: Please try to maintain radio silence during this mission; I don't want that virus ending up in our computers here on the station!
messages.zh: 执行此任务的过程中，请保持无线电静默；我可不想让那种病毒感染到我们空间站里的计算机！

messages.en: I don't think I need to remind you that, if you fail, a bunch of innocent people are going to get jettisoned into a cloud of acid, where they will be simultaneously decompressed, frozen, and dissolved.
messages.zh: 我就不多说了，你要是搞砸这件事，一批无辜的人就会被抛进酸性云团里。在那种环境下，他们的身体会瞬间膨大，冻僵，并溶解掉。

messages.en: A pirate faction in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system has taken hostages and plan on executing them shortly. The innocent people need to be rescued and returned to the agent as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系的一支海盗势力绑架了一些人质，并打算不久后处决他们。你要尽快营救那些无辜的人质，并把他们带回给代理人。

messages.en: Clever capsuleer, you've done it! On behalf of my corporation and the hostages you rescued, thank you very much!
messages.zh: 机智的飞行员，你办到了！我代表我的军团和那些获救的人质，向你表示深深的感谢！

messages.en: I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 我会另请高明。

messages.en:
I can tell you're a bit more experienced than the average capsuleer, which means you might be interested in something a little more challenging than the usual chores.

A small gang of pirates has carved a niche for itself in the evidence disposal business. They've setup a base near an uncharted acidic cloud, which allows them to charge huge sums of money to other pirate factions that need to get rid of salvage, bodies, data cores, or whatever in a discrete location.

Unfortunately, they're currently holding some hostages that we need to have recovered. I think you can figure out the rest on your own.
messages.zh:
我得说你比其他普通飞行员更有经验，这意味着你或许对一些有挑战性的工作感兴趣。

一小撮海盗创办了销毁证据的业务。他们在一块未勘测的酸性云团附近建立了基地，专门为其他海盗势力处理不想要的打捞物、尸体、数据核心等等，并收取高额费用。

不幸的是，他们现在准备处理一些人质。我们必须前去营救。我想你应该知道要怎么做。

messages.en: I'll find someone else.
messages.zh: 我会另请高明。

messages.en: I'm no starship pilot, but it seems like it would be a good idea to avoid the acid cloud.
messages.zh: 我不是飞船驾驶员，不过貌似避开酸性云团是明智之举。

messages.en: Thank you.  I have no idea who would be disrupting our space lanes like this. Whoever it is, they're bold to take on the Federation. We'll have medical specialists on standby to take of the survivors.
messages.zh: 谢谢你。我不知道什么人能这样干扰我们的空间航线。不管是谁，他们的胆子可不小，竟敢招惹联邦。我们会让医疗专家待命，以救治幸存者。

messages.en: Fly out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and look for signs of the missing passenger ships. Evacuate any survivors you find and bring them back here.
messages.zh: 前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}然后寻找失踪客轮的线索。营救一切幸存者，并把他们接回来。

messages.en: This mission was a bigger story than I imagined. Looks like the State was using these mercenaries as a source of domestic warfare within the Federation. That's low, especially for the State. But you know what they say about war, right? Anyway, I'll report this incident to the higher-ups in the FIO. They'll be very interested in the State's recent activities.
