messages.zh: 这次任务比我想象的要复杂。看来合众国想利用这些雇佣军在联邦内部挑起内战。合众国的这种行为太下流了。不过你也知道战争是怎么回事，对吧？无论怎样，我要给联邦情报处的头头们发报告来描述这次事件。他们会对合众国最近的活动很感兴趣。

messages.en: The Federation will not look kindly on your inaction.
messages.zh: 联邦对于你的无动于衷会很不满。

messages.en: "Honor does not exist in this day and age, not out in space and especially not among the capsuleer communities. The only honor left is down here, planet side, where we do not resort to domestic terrorism, and where respect for the basic rights of the private citizen still exists. The stars shine on fear."
messages.zh: “这年月，尊严并不存在。太空里没有尊严，克隆飞行员圈子里更没有尊严。唯一幸存的尊严在星球上，那里不实行国内恐怖主义，那里尊重公民的基本权利。而繁星闪耀在恐惧中。”

messages.en: A Quote from Admiral Edan Gore, Federation Navy
messages.zh: 援引自上将伊丹·戈尔，联邦海军

messages.en:
We've gotten reports of missing passenger ships in and around {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We've lost track of three of them just this week. We'd like you to go out and see what's happening to the ships. If possible, recover the crew as well. Thousands of people are missing because of these lost ships – the worst incident so far. I'm afraid that this situation could gain a lot of unwanted attention very quickly.

I want you to look into it. I'd like to be optimistic and say that they've simply had technical difficulties, but we're past the breaking point here. Bring back any survivors you can find.
messages.zh:
我们接到报告说，有数艘客轮在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}附近失踪。光是本周内就消失了三艘。我们希望你能前往该处，并查明那些船只的下落。如果可能的话，一并找回船上的人员。失踪的那些船上有好几千人——这是迄今为止最惨的事故。恐怕这种局面会很快吸引大量没有用处的关注。

我需要你去调查此事。我本来想乐观一些，说什么他们只是遇到了技术故障，但是等到现在大家都快要崩溃了。接回所有你能找到的幸存者。

messages.en: Sorry to hear that. You'll be happy to know that CONCORD has taken notice of this case and they'll be dispatching a squadron to look into the disappearances.
messages.zh: 令人难过。你应该会高兴：统合部已经记录了这些情况，并且将派遣一个中队来调查失踪事件。

messages.en: Any news yet?
messages.zh: 有什么进展吗？

name.fr: Le sang des hommes en colère
name.ru: Кровь яростных людей (The Blood of Angry Men)

messages.en: I hope you won't mind if I don't thank you outright. Oh, and don't expect the Amarr to welcome your assistance either.
messages.zh: 我不会立刻感谢你，希望你不要介意。哦，还有，别指望艾玛人会欢迎你的协助。

messages.en: Hunt down the rogue Minmatar in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  Destroy his pirated prototype ship and deliver his corpse to Minmatar caretakers.
messages.zh: 在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}猎捕米玛塔尔游侠。摧毁他偷来的原型舰船，并把他的尸体交给米玛塔尔代理人。

messages.en: Our rampaging kinsman is gone? His ship, too? If you'll take a bit of advice from a lowly mortal, {[character]player.name}; when unethical decisions are made, eventually you're left with nothing but unethical options.
messages.zh: 我们的游侠同胞已经挂了吗？他的船也一样，是吗？听听我这个卑贱之人的建议，{[character]player.name}；当做出了不道德的决定，结果就只有用不道德的手段去实现。

messages.en: You're leaving us with dangerously few options, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你让我们走投无路，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Reflecting on the personal toll invariably endured, a wise figure once offered this advice to anyone considering a career in politics: “Don't.” In New Eden, with so many different factions all delicately counterbalanced, such sage advice may have never been more humanitarian.
messages.zh: 考虑到肯定会承受的人间苦难，一位智者曾向所有打算从政的人建议说;"别去。"在各方势力勾心斗角、互相制衡的新伊甸宇宙中，这位贤者之言更显出人道主义的慈善。

messages.en: A Tangled Stasis Web
messages.zh: 错综复杂的网

messages.en:
You've shown a great deal of loyalty to the Republic, {[character]player.name}. I wonder if that speaks as much to your feelings towards the Amarr, or if it's a matter of convenience. It's been my experience that the older a capsuleer is, the more uncertain his or her motives become.

Mortals are slightly less difficult. Fervent extremists particularly. A particularly troubled Minmatar has apparently taken it upon himself to conduct a personal war against the Empire. Ordinarily, my superiors and I would quietly applaud his effort and wait for word of his death. This particular person, however, managed to commandeer a prototype stealth ship to carry out his war.

We can't let the ship fall into Amarrian hands, but we can't send the fleet in either. With him already in Amarr territory, they could easily construe it as a sanctioned act of war. As much as I want to cut out my tongue for saying it, we need you to help the Amarr kill one of our own. We'll have to smooth out the political mess through our liaison with CONCORD.

Reports place him somewhere in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. If you can manage it, bring back his remains. I don't want to think how those pious... how the Amarr would treat him.
messages.zh:
你对于共和国的忠诚有目共睹，{[character]player.name}。我搞不清这是因为你恨艾玛人呢，还是仅仅出于便利的考虑。据我多年观察，克隆飞行员的年纪越大，他/她的动机就越看不懂。

常人就比较好拿捏一些。狂热的极端分子尤其容易分辨。一个饱受麻烦的米玛塔尔人显然是走了极端，他要靠一己之力与艾玛帝国战斗。通常，我和我的上司对于这种举动只会暗自叫好，然后等待当事人挂掉的消息。但是这个人不同，他弄到了一艘原型隐身舰船，并驾驶它来展开战斗。

我们不能让那艘船落入艾玛人手中，然而我们也不能出动舰队来处理此事。他已经位于艾玛境内，如果我们派舰队过去，只会被曲解为向艾玛宣战。我真是不想说这句话：我们需要你去帮艾玛人干掉他。然后我们将通过统合部来消除此事在政治上的波澜。

报告说他位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。如果你能搞定他，记得带回他的尸骸。我不愿去想那些神棍…呃，那些艾玛人会如何处理他。

messages.en: I understand how distasteful the whole deal is, but this doesn't help.
messages.zh: 我知道这差事很讨厌，但也没办法。

messages.en: I have nothing else to tell you, {[character]player.name}. Please just contact me when this is finished.
messages.zh: 我说完了，{[character]player.name}。事成之后请联系我。

name.ru: Змей и рабы (The Serpent and the Slaves)

messages.en: That's what I like to hear. A capsuleer will really be able to send these slavers a message. Thank you for agreeing to be the voice of our culture.
messages.zh: 这话我爱听。克隆飞行员能够给那些劳工贩子们一个警告。感谢你为我们伸张正义。

messages.en: Fly out to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}  to monitor and disperse the slave trading operation that has set up shop there.
messages.zh: 飞往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，监视并驱散在该处进行的劳工贸易活动。

messages.en: I've dispatched ships to pick up the slaves. They'll receive counseling and be sent back to their respective home worlds, courtesy of Interbus. It's safe to say I'm not satisfied with this outcome. I've never heard of the Serpentis dealing in human traffic, but I hope that this isn't indicative of a larger trend in that organization. But we've got the information we need, and the Federation can move forward based on your intel. Good work.
messages.zh: 我已经派了船去接那些劳工。他们会接受咨询，然后通过星际捷运返回各自的故乡。说真的，我对情况并不满意。我之前没听说过天蛇集团也从事人口贩卖活动，而且我希望这次不是该组织大规模买卖人口的前兆。不过我们拿到了需要的信息，联邦可以根据你的情报展开行动。干得好。

messages.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Some other time.
messages.zh: 真遗憾下次吧。

messages.en:
We have a lead on a potential slave trade in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and I need someone to patrol that area and find out what's happening. We think they're trading Gallente citizens, which is an open act of hostility against the Federation, so we need to shut this ring down as soon as possible. But first, we have to know who's behind it.

Understand that you won't be trying to actually stop the slavers; all we need is information on who's behind it. If you encounter any hostiles, however, please take care of them.
messages.zh:
我们有一条线索指出{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}可能存在劳工交易活动。我需要有人前往该处巡逻并查明真相。我们认为他们在贩卖盖伦特公民——这是公然与联邦敌对的行为。因此我们要赶紧制止这帮人。但是我们首先得搞清楚幕后的主使。

要明白，你到那里不是为了阻止劳工贩子；真正目的是获取此事的后台信息。不过，你要是遭遇任何敌人，只管干掉他们就是。

messages.en: You're aware of what you're doing? These people need immediate help.  We'll scramble some pilots now, but you're leaving us high and dry.
messages.zh: 你知道自己在干什么吗？那些人们急需帮助。虽然我们现在会另招人手，但你让我们很不爽。

messages.en: Interesting that you should contact me. Is it done?
messages.zh: 你应该联系我的啊。事情怎样了？

name.es: Nueve décimas partes del agujero de gusano
name.fr: La majeure partie du trou de ver
name.ru: Девять десятых червоточины (Nine Tenths of the Wormhole)

messages.en: Good hunting. Personally, I suggested we just spray the area with used motor oil.
messages.zh: 战斗愉快。我个人建议彻底清理该区域。

messages.en: Wipe out the Sansha hijackers in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The more humiliating, the better.
messages.zh: 清除那些在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的萨沙强盗。让他们越丢人越好。

messages.en: What do you mean they came through from the other end? You're suggesting they were able to predict of the most random, unpredictable pathway in existence?
messages.zh: 你说他们从另一端传过来是什么意思？你认为他们能够预测这种宇宙中最具有随机性、最无法预测的通道现象？

messages.en: I expected someone with your reputation to jump at the chance for a little rough play. I'm sure some up and coming fleet captain will be eager for the assignment.
messages.zh: 我本以为，像你这种有名气的人巴不得从事此类高难度工作。我确信还有更牛X的舰长愿意接手此任务。

messages.en: The inner workings of a wormhole were apparently well understood at one time. Since the Dark Ages, however, the best New Eden has managed is basic reverse engineering of ancient jump gates, significantly less powerful than the natural phenomena. This makes the appearance of a natural wormhole a dangerously valuable occurrence, over which factions will openly oppose each other in order to study and utilize the anomalies exclusively.
messages.zh: 很久以前，人类显然很熟悉虫洞的内在原理。但是，自从黑暗时代以来，新伊甸的人们最多只是通过逆向工程重新发明了古老的星门技术，而距离掌握虫洞这种强大自然现象还差得远。这种情况下，一个自然虫洞的出现就显得既危险又珍贵。各方势力你争我夺，都想独占虫洞，好让自己研究和利用。

messages.en: Real Estate Disputes
messages.zh: 抢地皮

messages.en:
There is an old saying: “Money makes the world go round.” Actually, it's gravity and thermodynamics, among other things, but money and physics all come together in a big way when you're talking about wormholes.

However, wormholes rarely occur in civilized space; take a wild guess what that means. I hope you have some experience in dealing with pirates, {[character]player.name}. Specifically, the Sansha. They seem particularly fixated on wormhole research, so much so that they've been a major pain for scientific ventures regardless of ownership.

There's no word of sanctions against the “Nation,” so we'll have to take care of it ourselves. More work for you, anyway.

We'd send a fleet detachment to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to reclaim a wormhole we've been studying recently, but we'd rather outsource to a capsuleer like you and humiliate them.
messages.zh:
有句老话叫:“有钱能使鬼推磨。”虽然事物发展在实际上都遵循科学规律，但是对于虫洞现象，捞钱和物理学研究同等重要。

虫洞在文明空间里很少出现；想一想这意味着什么。我希望你有很多对付海盗的经验，{[character]player.name}，尤其是萨沙。他们似乎对虫洞研究很着迷：不管是哪个势力在进行虫洞科学探索，他们都要来插一脚。

针对萨沙共和国的行动还没有消息，所以我们只能靠自己来摆平他们。不过，这也给你们带来更多的就业机会。

我们原本计划派一支舰队到{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}去夺回一个我们最近在研究的虫洞，但是现在我们想把这个任务外包给你这种克隆飞行员，顺便也能好好地羞辱萨沙一番。

messages.en: You were supposed to embarrass those androids, not your employers. I'll call in the fleet.
messages.zh: 你应该让那些萨沙机械人难堪，而不是让我难堪。我要请舰队来处理。

messages.en: Our scientists can't safely get back to work until you've sent the cyborgs running, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我们的科学家无法回到那里安全地工作，除非你赶走那些萨沙怪物，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Perfect! Run over to the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and clean up those pesky drones.
messages.zh: 好极了！飞往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，清理那些害虫无人机。

messages.en: A rogue drone infestation in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system is causing problems and needs to be taken care of.
messages.zh: 在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系有一起自由无人机传播感染需要处理。

messages.en: You actually did it? You destroyed that infested station? Do you have any idea how many capsuleers lost their- Uhm, I mean, great work! I'll keep you in mind when I come across important missions like this in the future.
messages.zh: 你真的搞定了？你把那座被感染的空间站打掉了？你知不知道有多少飞行员为这个任务损——呃，我是说，干得漂亮！以后再遇到类似的重要任务，我还会请你出马哟。

messages.en: You flew all the way out here just to decline a simple task like this?
messages.zh: 你大老远地跑过来，竟然连这种简单任务都搞不定？

messages.en:
Hang on, I need to finish this call.

Really, another one? That same station, huh? Well, I don't know what the capsuleer was flying. What do you want me to do, hold their hands? No, don't even joke about that. One more? Do you really think it's going to be any different? Okay, but don't blame me if this one fails, too.

Okay now, where were we? Oh, yes, the exciting opportunity I have for you today! It's a bit run-of-the-mill, but I think you've earned an easy one, friend. It's just a tiny little rogue drone problem. There couldn't be more than half a dozen of the little bastards. I'll bet if you just zip in there and rattle off a few shots at the infested station, they'll scatter like frightened children. What do you say?
messages.zh:
稍等，让我打完电话。

不是吧，又有一起？同一座空间站吗？我不知道那个飞行员当时驾驶什么船。你想让我怎么样，抱住他们的大腿不让走？不行，根本没门。再来一次？你以为这样就能不一样？好吧，不过要是这回再失败了，你可别怪我。

OK，刚才咱们说到哪儿？哦，对，今天我有一个很过瘾的机会给你！虽然任务是普通了点，但我看你就当做捡便宜好了。只是一点小小的自由无人机问题。那里的无人机小混蛋不会超过十只。我敢说，你冲过去对着被感染的空间站随便开几炮，它们就会抱头鼠窜。你说怎么样？

messages.en: You flew all the way out here just to decline a simple task like this?
messages.zh: 你大老远地跑过来，竟然连这种简单任务都搞不定？

messages.en: How is that cleanup coming along?
messages.zh: 清理进行的如何呀？

name.ja: ポストモダンな原始人

messages.en: Don't expect them to roll over and hand you the formula. Leave no stone unturned, and what I mean by that is don't be afraid to destroy every structure you see in search of your objective.
messages.zh: 别指望他们会乖乖地交出配方。不要留下任何死角，在搜寻目标的时候，放手去摧毁一切你发现的建筑。

messages.en: Find the tainted tattoo chemical being developed in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  The exact location of the chemical is unknown.  Be prepared to destroy any number of large structures.
messages.zh: 在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}找到开发中的纹身用化学品。该化学品的详细位置尚不明确。准备好摧毁多个大型建筑。

messages.en: If you felt the least bit heartless blasting through them, remember which side consciously chose to use innocent victims as living shields, {[character]player.name}. We've already sent teams in behind you to rescue who we can. Or capture, as the case may be. I'll be interested to learn exactly what this substance is supposed to do.
messages.zh: 如果你执行任务时觉得这样做有点太狠心了，那就想想是哪一方曾蓄意选择无辜者做人肉盾牌，{[character]player.name}。我们已经派出队伍在你后面尽可能救援。或者逮捕，如果情势所迫的话。我很想搞清楚这种物质的功效如何。

messages.en: Discretion can be the better part of valor. I'm sure there's a less scrupulous capsuleer out there somewhere.
messages.zh: 谨慎即大勇。而我确信有的飞行员不会那么严谨。

messages.en: The Minmatar coming-of-age ceremony, known as the Voluval, involves an injection of a hallucinatory chemical which puts the youth in a trance. As the visions wear off, the individual finds him or herself marked with a tattoo of an unpredictable pattern on an unpredictable portion of body. The chemical used to induce trance and create the mark is so well guarded, even some Minmatar wonder if there is not more to the process than their elders admit.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔人的成年仪式也称为沃鲁瓦。该仪式中，参与的年轻人被注射一种致幻化学品，然后进入恍惚状态。当幻觉消退后，参与者会发现自己身上随机部位出现了一幅随机图案的纹身。用来导致幻觉和产生纹身的化学品被严格保密，连一些米玛塔尔人都想知道这个仪式是否真像长者们所说的那样单纯。

messages.en: Voluval
messages.zh: 沃鲁瓦

messages.en:
Tattoos are more than art to the Minmatar, {[character]player.name}. We have entire ceremonies built up around the markings we come to wear in our lives. Not to bore you with details, but ours aren't the simple ink-and-needle hatchet jobs most people think of. Exactly how the chemical process works is a closely guarded secret even within our own culture.

Word has reached my office that some Amarr splinter faction is working on their own chemical in order to contaminate Minmatar ceremonial supplies. It could mean anything from the appearance of Amarr propagandist symbols to some unexplored form of chemical dependence on the Empire.

The logistics of such a plan actually working are laughably impossible, and of course we'll never be able to tie anything back to mainline Imperial channels. Still, any threat to our freedom must be treated seriously. Well, that and the whole concept is just insulting.

We want you to bring us a sample of this chemical. I can't pinpoint exactly where the chemicals are being made. Our best information points to a deadspace complex in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

I mentioned the insult of the program. Tear through the place. I don't care how many structures you have to obliterate, just bring us this new ink.
messages.zh:
纹身对米玛塔尔人来说不仅仅是一种艺术，{[character]player.name}。围绕这些陪伴我们终生的纹身，我们建立了一整套仪式。我不想描述很多细节来烦你，我只想说它们绝不是大部分人想象中那种墨水加针刺的邪恶玩意儿。即使在米玛塔尔文化内部，纹身的化学原理也是一个严格保守的秘密。

我接到消息说，有一股艾玛分裂势力正在开发一种化学品，妄图用它来污染米玛塔尔纹身仪式专用品。它也许会造成各种后果，比如产生宣扬艾玛帝国的纹身，或者让使用者出现某种对艾玛帝国的药物依赖。

这个计划本身的可行性真是笑死人，而且我们肯定无法把它和任何艾玛官方行为联系起来。但是，我们必须严肃对待一切针对我们自由的威胁。哼，这个计划真是在侮辱我们。

我们需要你带回一份这种化学品的样本。而我无法精确地定位它的生产设施。我们得到的最具体信息是一个位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的死亡空间。

他们计划的侮辱性质我已经说明了。所以你要扫平那里。我不管你毁掉多少建筑，我只要你带回样品。

messages.en: I didn't expect a capsuleer to have a weak stomach.
messages.zh: 我没想到一个飞行员的承受能力居然这么差。

messages.en: Why haven't you brought me the chemical yet? Did you turn every structure inside out, because they probably won't be hiding it in some ship's cargo bay.
messages.zh: 为什么你还没给我带回那种化学品？你有没有检查所有的建筑？要知道他们不太可能把它藏在某个舰船货柜舱里。

name.ja: ライオンに囲まれた子羊

messages.en: Thank you for doing this. The convoy should be passing through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} very soon. There's still time to head them off!
messages.zh: 感谢你所做的这些。那支运输队很快就要经过{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}。还有点时间去拦截他们。

messages.en: According to your agent, a convoy was sent out with a group of pirates pretending to be security. Intercept the convoy and take out its escort.
messages.zh: 你的代理人透露，有一支运输队以及假扮护航的海盗船队已经出发。拦截运输队并消灭护航船只。

messages.en: I cannot properly express how helpful you've been, so hopefully this reward will do.
messages.zh: 真不知道该怎么感谢你，这些报酬请你笑纳。

messages.en: Damn it. I need to find someone to help and quick. Time is running out.
messages.zh: 我勒个去。我得赶紧另外找人来帮忙。马上没时间了。

messages.en: It's a common misconception that it is CONCORD that engages pirates with below -5.0 security status in high security space, while it is in fact the local navy that does so. CONCORD will only engage if the outlaw has incurred a GCC (Global Criminal Countdown) caused by committing a crime in Empire Space. The local navies are not as powerful as CONCORD and it is possible to survive their onslaught and limp back to the gate, or even escape before they warp scramble the ship.
messages.zh: 有一种常见的误解，认为在高安全地区是由统合部来攻击安全等级-5及以下的海盗；而实际上，履行该职责的是各族海军。在帝国区，统合部只会攻击那些带有违法标记（违法红色倒计时）的犯罪人员。各族海军并不像统合部那样强大。因此飞行员有可能扛着海军的攻击，挪到星门并跳过去，甚至在海军对舰船实施跃迁干扰之前就逃掉。

messages.en: Security Loopholes
messages.zh: 安全漏洞

messages.en:
Please, you have to help me! I hired a group of mercenaries to escort a friend's cargo shipment; however, I just learned that the people I sent are pirate agents!

I know it would be helpful if you knew who you were going up against, but all I have is a few fragments of information here; there are no specifics so be ready for anything!

I need you to intercept that convoy and eliminate the pirates!
messages.zh:
拜托了，你一定要帮帮我！我雇了一组佣兵去给一位朋友做货运护航；然而，我刚刚了解到那些佣兵其实是海盗特工！

如果能让你知道对手的背景，也许会有所帮助；可是我现在只有一点零碎的信息，详细情况还不清楚，所以请做好充分的准备！

我需要你去拦截那支运输队并且消灭那些海盗！

messages.en: Damn it. I need to find someone to help and quick. Time is running out.
messages.zh: 我勒个去。我得赶紧另外找人来帮忙。马上没时间了。

messages.en: What are you doing? Time is running out!
messages.zh: 你在搞什么？马上没时间了！

name.ja: 集中攻撃を受けた罪のない人々
name.ru: Невинные под перекрестным огнем (Innocents in the Crossfire)

messages.en: Understood. Be careful how you approach this, {[character]player.name}; the Guristas must be getting paid a fortune for such a brazen attack, and they will fight to the death for that money.
messages.zh: 了解。要当心哪，{[character]player.name}；古斯塔斯海盗一定是收了很多钱，才会干这种明目张胆的绑票。他们肯定要拼命战斗到底。

messages.en:
Only a few moments ago the CEO from one of our subsidiaries was attacked and ransomed by Guristas, right in front of our trade delegation. Local security forces were overwhelmed and the pirates managed to escape. Our scouts pursued the Guristas vessels back to a Federation detention facility, which suggests the Guristas are only acting as mercenaries and the Gallente are really the ones to blame.

We have scouts holding above the detention facility, and they're tapping communications to look for evidence of a connection, but in the meantime we want to make an attempt to get our people out using capsuleer assistance. We're concerned that more reinforcements could be on the way, and that if they arrive, we'll lose our people for good. You need to act quickly.

Your assignment is to assault the facility and return our people to us before things escalate any further.
messages.zh:
就在刚才，我们一个下属单位的CEO，当着我们行业代表团的面，竟被古斯塔斯海盗强行绑架。本地的安全部队没能制服那些海盗，他们逃走了。我们的侦查员追踪那些海盗直到一座联邦拘留设施，也许古斯塔斯这次只是作为佣兵，而盖伦特人才是幕后主使。

我们的侦查员潜伏在那座拘留设施附近，监听该处的通信，搜寻联邦涉及此事的证据。不过，与此同时，我们想请一位飞行员来尝试救出那位同胞。我们担心有更多增援敌军可能正在赶往那里，而且一旦到达，我们就会永远失去那位同胞。你要抓紧时间。

你的任务是突袭那座设施，并且在事态升级之前救回我们的同胞。

messages.en: The best possible result, and proof once again that hiring capsuleers is the way to get that. Thank you, {[character]player.name}, you've made us both look good. I'll be sure to pass my recommendations along, right after I take a few calls about some pay adjustments of my own.
messages.zh: 而请克隆飞行员来对付海盗，就成为了最佳的结论或者保证。谢谢你，{[character]player.name}，你让我们两个人都很有面子。我一定会为你写推荐信的，让我接几个电话先，我要调工资啦。

messages.en: What? I pray to the Maker that I can find someone else in time.
messages.zh: 什么？愿神保佑我能及时另请到高手。

messages.en: The Guristas are famous for their raids into civilized territory, something that very few pirate clans are willing or able to do. The mission of these raids is most often simply to steal cargo or passengers (for ransom) from freighters, but on numerous occasions their main intention seems to be to sabotage empire installations (mining facilities, sentry guns, and the like). This has led to speculations that some unscrupulous empire companies or even governments are hiring the Guristas to take out property of the competition.
messages.zh: 古斯塔斯海盗因为袭击文明区域而十分出名，很少有别的海盗组织愿意或者有能力做同样的事。这些袭击的目标经常是从货舰上抢夺财物，或绑架人质并勒索赎金。但是，也有不少次袭击是为了破坏帝国区的建筑（例如采矿设施，岗哨炮，等等）。有人推测，一些不择手段的帝国区集团甚至政府在雇佣古斯塔斯海盗去打击竞争对手的产业。

messages.en: Daylight Robbery
messages.zh: 光天化日的明抢

messages.en:
I'm glad you're here {[character]player.name}, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is in desperate need of your help.

Only a few moments ago the CEO from one of our subsidiaries was attacked and ransomed by Guristas, right in front of our trade delegation, too. Local security forces were overwhelmed and the pirates managed to escape. Our scouts pursued the Guristas vessels back to a Federation detention facility, which suggests the Guristas are only acting as mercenaries and the Gallente are really the ones to blame.

We have scouts hidden near the detention facility, and they're monitoring communications to look for evidence of a connection, but in the meantime we want to make an attempt to get our people out using capsuleer assistance. We're concerned that more reinforcements could be on the way, and that if they arrive, we'll lose our people for good. You need to act quickly.

Your assignment is to assault the facility and return our people to us before things escalate any further. Can we count on you for this?
messages.zh:
真高兴你能来，{[character]player.name}，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}很需要你的帮助。

就在刚才，我们一个下属单位的CEO，在我们行业代表团的面前，竟被古斯塔斯海盗强行绑架。本地的安全部队没能制服那些海盗，他们逃走了。我们的侦查员追踪那些海盗直到一座联邦拘留设施，也许古斯塔斯这次只是作为佣兵，而盖伦特人才是幕后主使。

我们的侦查员隐藏在那座拘留设施附近，监听该处的通信，搜寻联邦涉及此事的证据。不过，与此同时，我们想请一位飞行员来尝试救出那位同胞。我们担心有更多增援敌军可能正在赶往那里，而且一旦到达，我们就会永远失去那位同胞。你要抓紧时间。

你的任务是突袭那座设施，并且在事态升级之前救回我们的同胞。这件事你能靠得住吧？

messages.en: If that CEO dies, it'll be on your head! I don't know how you sleep at night.
messages.zh: 如果那位CEO挂了，我们唯你是问！不知道你还能不能睡安稳觉。

messages.en: Time is of the essence. Get moving {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 时间紧迫。动起来，{[character]player.name}！

name.ja: 忘れ去られたアウトポスト

messages.en:
I knew I chose the right person. I'm uploading the coordinates to you now.

Once you arrive at the archaeological site, I will issue further instructions.
messages.zh:
我就知道找对了人。我现在就把坐标上传给你。

等你到达那个考古地点，我会发出进一步指示。

messages.en:
Ah, {[character]player.name}, I'm glad to see you received my mail. I have something that requires complete discretion. It's entirely legal of course, but this will need to be kept quiet all the same. You've proven yourself trustworthy so if you want the assignment I'll hand it over to you.

During a routine system scan, some of my people stumbled upon something that may be a significant archaeological find. I can't just call in anyone to confirm it, though, that would risk a leak. I don't want anyone else claiming this discovery as their own, especially if it turns out to be a lucrative one.

What we could do is rig your vessel's camera drones to relay a live feed of the site back to me and my people. From there, we would be able to direct you around the area to observe places of interest. What you relay back could help us confirm or disprove our earlier findings. The site is in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, so you wouldn't be travelling very far to investigate, either. The only problem my scouts reported was a light pirate presence. I'm sure you can deal with a few Guristas.

Not the usual assignment I know, but one of potentially great importance…and profit. It would be ideal if we could rely on capsuleer assistance for this.
messages.zh:
啊，{[character]player.name}，真高兴你收到了我的邮件。我有一个任务，它需要非常谨慎地对待。这个任务当然是合法的，但是也需要小心保密。你已经证明了你很可靠，所以只要你想接手这个任务，我就把它派给你。

在一次例行的星系扫描中，我的几位同僚偶然得到一个信号，它有可能是个考古大发现。我不能随便叫个人去鉴定它，因为有泄密的风险。我不想让别人宣布这是他们的发现，尤其是靠这个发现可能会发大财。

我们可以改装你船上的摄像无人机，让它们把实时图像传回来给我和我的同僚。这样一来，我们就能指导你在那个地点移动，让我们观察有价值的区域。你传回的图像会帮助我们确认或者推翻之前的发现。那个地点位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，因此你不必跑很远的路。我的侦查员报告说，那里唯一的问题是少量海盗活动。我相信你肯定能搞定那一撮古斯塔斯渣子。

我知道这个任务不太平常，但是它的重要性和含金量都很有潜力。如果只靠一位克隆飞行员就能搞定，那再好不过了。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. Exceptionally well. It will take a little longer to fully confirm, but we believe we've discovered an ancient Caldari outpost – one of the first established after we broke away from the Federation. If true, this would be a welcome injection to the system's local tourism industry, and we'll get a commission on the money earned there. Here's your cut of the deal.

Even if it turns out to be a false discovery we're insured against the ISK, so I see no reason not to give it to you now. Thanks once again.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你的表现很好。非常好。虽然还需要一点时间来充分确认，但我们相信这个发现是一座古代加达里哨站——我们的种族在脱离联邦之后初次建立的哨站之一。如果情况属实，它将成为此星系的一个新旅游景点，而我们则可以参与景点收入的分成。这是你的酬劳。

就算最后证明这个发现不属实，我们也投了保险。所以我没有理由不报答你。再次感谢。

messages.en: Then it would be in your best interests to forget we ever had this discussion.
messages.zh: 你最好忘掉我们之前的谈话。

messages.en: Shortly after jump gate technology was jointly discovered by the Gallente and the Caldari a little over five hundred years before the Federation formed, the Caldari corporations had started their own interstellar surveying and colonization, separate from that conducted by the Gallente. It was these colonies, kept as a secret from the Gallenteans, that became the source of friction between the Gallenteans and the Caldari, culminating in the latter's defection from the Federation and an ensuing war between the two races.
messages.zh: 在联邦成立的五百年前，盖伦特人和加达里人一起发现了星门跳跃技术。加达里的各大集团随即开始跨星际的勘测与殖民活动；那些活动是独立进行的，不受盖伦特人主导。各个对盖伦特人保密的加达里殖民地，成为了两个族群摩擦的原因，并最终导致了加达里人脱离联邦以及盖伦特-加达里战争。

messages.en: Gallente-Caldari War: The early days
messages.zh: 盖伦特-加达里战争：初始期

messages.en:
Ah, {[character]player.name}, I'm glad to see you received my mail. I have something that requires complete discretion. It's entirely legal of course, but this will need to be kept quiet all the same. You've proven yourself trustworthy so if you want the assignment I'll hand it over to you.

During a routine system scan, some of my people stumbled upon something that may be a significant archaeological find. I can't just call in anyone to confirm it, though, that would risk a leak. I don't want anyone else claiming this discovery as their own, especially if it turns out to be a lucrative one.

What we could do is rig your vessel's camera drones to relay a live feed of the site back to me and a friend of mine at the House of Records. From there, my friend would be able to direct you around the area to observe places of interest. What you relay back could help us confirm or disprove our earlier findings. The site is in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, so you wouldn't be travelling very far to investigate, either. Our scouts reported there was a light pirate presence, and interference was making the use of microwarpdrives impossible in there, but I'm sure you can deal with a few Guristas and using afterburner.

Not the usual assignment I know, but one of potentially great importance…and profit. It would be ideal if we could rely on capsuleer assistance for this. What do you say?
messages.zh:
啊，{[character]player.name}，真高兴你收到了我的邮件。我有一个任务，它需要非常谨慎地对待。这个任务当然是合法的，但是也需要小心保密。你已经证明了你很可靠，所以只要你想接手这个任务，我就把它派给你。

在一次例行的星系扫描中，我的几位同僚偶然得到一个信号，它有可能是个考古大发现。我不能随便叫个人去鉴定它，因为有泄密的风险。我不想让别人宣布这是他们的发现，尤其是靠这个发现可能会发大财。

我们可以改装你船上的摄像无人机，让它们把实时图像传回来给我以及我在国家档案所的一个朋友。这样一来，我的朋友就能指导你在那个地点移动，让他观察有价值的区域。你传回的图像会帮助我们确认或者推翻之前的发现。那个地点位于{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}，因此你不必跑很远的路。我们的侦查员报告说该地点有少量海盗出没，并且由于环境干扰无法使用微型跃迁推进器。不过我相信你能搞定那些古斯塔斯渣子，而且你能使用加力燃烧器。

我知道这个任务不太平常，但是它的重要性和含金量都很有潜力。如果只靠一位克隆飞行员就能搞定，那再好不过了。你说怎么样？

messages.en: Fine. I will find someone else.
messages.zh: 好吧。我会另请高明。

messages.en: We stand to make a lot of ISK if that site is what we think it is.
messages.zh: 如果那个地点符合我们的设想，我们就会赚一大笔钱。

messages.en: Great to hear, {[character]player.name}. I have uploaded the coordinates to your NeoCom.
messages.zh: 太好了，{[character]player.name}。我已经把坐标上传到你的日志里。

messages.en:
Your agent's corporation suspects a rival corporation may have caused a transport crash. Go to the location in the mission details and investigate the wreckage you find. Bring any evidence back to your agent.

You will require a salvager.
messages.zh:
你的代理人所在的军团怀疑有敌对军团制造了一起交通事故。前往任务详情中标明的事故地点，调查剩余残骸。把所有证据带回去，交给代理人。

你需要一个打捞器来执行此任务。

messages.en: This is some interesting evidence. Now we can bring some people to justice.
messages.zh: 这件证据很有价值。现在我们可以让某些人得到正义的裁决。

messages.en: There are millions of ISK resting on this investigation. Who I am supposed to find to do this?
messages.zh: 这项调查的奖励有好几百万。我该找谁去执行任务呢？

messages.en:
Glad to have you here, {[character]player.name}. I have some work for you.

A few days ago, a passenger vessel was passing through an asteroid belt, when it had a critical failure of its navigational computer. The vessel slammed into the asteroids and suffered critical damage. Before the vessel's reactor went critical, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} personnel evacuated the passengers and got them to safety.

While this story has a happy ending, there seems to be something suspicious about the crash. A small corporation with alleged ties to the Guristas is having money troubles, and {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} suspects the incident may have not been an accident. Things just seem a little too perfect and well-timed.

{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} needs you to go to the crash site and investigate the wreckage. Look for any evidence that might hint at the real cause of the accident. Bring any evidence back to me and I will submit it to the proper authorities.

I don't want to tell you how to do your job, but a salvager might help you get to the bottom of this a little faster than just looking around with your on-board sensors.
messages.zh:
真高兴你能来，{[character]player.name}。我这里有些工作适合你。

几天前，一艘客轮在经过一个小行星带时，导航计算机出现了严重故障。那艘船撞到了小行星上，受到致命损伤。在船只的反应堆还没有失控前，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的人员疏散了乘客们，并把他们送到安全地带。

事情的结果令人欣慰，然而，那个船只故障有些蹊跷。一个据说与古斯塔斯有关联的小军团正面临经济上的困难，因此{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}怀疑这起事故并非意外。故障发生的时间点太完美了，就像是精心计算过一样。

{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}需要你前往事故地点，并调查船只的残骸。寻找一切可能指向事故真实原因的证据。把找到的所有证据带回来给我，然后我会转交有关部门。

我不想对你的工作指手画脚，我只想友情提醒一下，打捞器也许能帮你更快查明真相，它比舰载探测仪好用一些。

messages.en: I was relying on you to figure out what went wrong. I just hope the evidence is still there by the time I find someone else.
messages.zh: 我之前把查出事情真相的希望都放在你身上。现在我只能祈祷等我找到其他人来接手这项任务时，那些证据还在。

messages.en: I have a feeling there might be a cover up in the works, so get moving.
messages.zh: 我觉得有人想要掩盖真相，所以你要赶紧行动。

messages.en: Excellent. Here are the coordinates. Don't hesitate out there, {[character]player.name};  be ready for a fight.
messages.zh: 很好。给你坐标。别犹豫了，{[character]player.name}；准备战斗吧。

messages.en:
There's been an influx of neural boosters to our area recently, and {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is trying to stem the flow. We normally turn a blind eye to light drug trafficking but that only seems to have encouraged the local smugglers, who are now flooding the area with cheap, more dangerous drugs.

We know where they base out of, however, and have already taken the liberty of blockading their station in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. What we need is a capsuleer who can go in there and check out some of the larger vessels currently in holding. You are of course cleared to engage anyone caught with illegal boosters in their cargo, although if you catch anyone be prepared for them to start shooting.
messages.zh:
最近我们这个地区涌入了大量神经增效剂， 而{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}正试图截断这股暗流。对于少量的违规药品非法贩售我们通常睁一只眼闭一只眼，但是本地的非法贩售贩子最近越来越大胆了。他们在这个星系大量倾销便宜却更危险的违规药品。

我们知道他们的基地，是{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系里的一座空间站。我们已经自作主张先把它封锁了。 现在我们只需要一位飞行员赶到那里，并检查扣留的一些大型舰船。发现任何船只藏有非法增效剂，你就可以对其开火，不过那种船只一般都会武力抵抗。

messages.en: Great Work, {[character]player.name}. It should be a long time, or a lot of ISK in bribes, before they can re-establish themselves around here again.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。这下他们要花很长时间，或者很多贿赂，才能在这里重新开张。

messages.en: Very well, if you're not interested I can find others. An unexpected refusal though, I must say.
messages.zh: 好吧，你要是没兴趣，我可以找别人。真是想不到，你居然会拒绝我。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, thanks for stopping by. Every now and then I get handed another assignment to clean up our spacelanes and clamp down on narcotics smuggling. I was hoping I could count on you to handle this one as we've had some problems in the past with other capsuleers.

There's been an influx of neural boosters to our area recently and {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is trying to stem the flow. We understand that boosters will never truly go away; we're not trying to be overbearing here, quite the opposite in fact. We normally turn a blind eye to light drug trafficking, and usually this has proven to be good business, but that only seems to have encouraged the local smugglers in recent times. They've been flooding this system and others nearby with cheap, more dangerous drugs, which is absolutely not good for business.

We know where they base out of, a station in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system which we've already taken the liberty of blockading. We'd rather have the matter dealt with on a corporate basis though, before anyone goes alerting the Chief Executive Panel or CONCORD authorities, so your discretion is important here.

We've set up a check point outside the station. What we need is a capsuleer who can go in there and check out some of the larger vessels currently in holding. We're concerned that some of these vessels are not only heavily loaded with boosters, but also heavily armed. It would be best to have someone like you on standby for the inspection process. You are of course cleared to engage anyone caught with illegal boosters in their cargo, although if you catch anyone, be prepared for some shooting.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，多谢你来拜访。每过一阵子，我就会接到指令去清理空间航线，打击麻醉药品非法贩售活动。我希望这一次能派你去执行此任务，因为以前派去的飞行员出了些问题。

最近我们这个地区涌入了大量神经增效剂，而{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}试图截断这股暗流。我们知道增效剂从来不会真正绝迹；这次我们也不指望掐灭它们，其实我们的计划恰恰相反。对于少量的违规药品非法贩售我们通常睁一只眼闭一只眼，而且这是一个丰厚的买卖。但是，本地的非法贩售贩子最近越来越大胆了。他们在这个星系大量倾销便宜却更危险的违规药品，给行情造成了坏影响。

我们知道他们的基地，是{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系里的一座空间站。我们已经自作主张先把它封锁了。我们想把此事在军团层面上就处理掉，不必闹到CEO合作组织或者统合部那里，所以你要小心谨慎。

我们在那座空间站外建立了一个检查点。现在我们只需要一位飞行员赶到那里，并检查扣留的一些大型舰船。我们担心有些船不但装满了增效剂，还装备了强大火力。所以在检查的时候，最好能有你这样的高手在旁边以防万一。发现任何船只藏有非法增效剂，你就可以对其开火，不过那种船只一般都会武力抵抗。

messages.en: I heard you were having problems dealing with this. Well, thanks for letting me know of your failure first-hand, I suppose.
messages.zh: 我听说你曾经在这种事情上栽过跟头。好吧，我得谢谢你让我亲自体会到你的无能。

messages.en: There's a number of ships holding outside the station. They won't be able to dock until you inspect them for contraband. Try not to keep the innocent ones waiting.
messages.zh: 那座空间站外有不少舰船被扣留。除非你对它们实施过违禁品检查，否则它们不能进站停靠。别让那些清白的船等太久。

messages.en: I see your reputation was well-deserved! I look forward to adding my name to your list of recommendations, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你果然名不虚传！我会大力推荐你的，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Fly to the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and obtain the salvaged electronics, then return them to your agent in {[location]agentStationID.name}. Destroy any Angel Cartel ships that get in the way.
messages.zh: 前往{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系，取得回收的电子元件，然后返回{[location]agentStationID.name}你的代理人那里。消灭所有胆敢阻拦的天使联合企业舰船。

messages.en: Yes, this is perfect. You've done the Republic a great service, {[character]player.name}. When the time comes and you witness our greatest accomplishment, you'll be able to say that you had a small part in paving the way for the future of all Minmatar!
messages.zh: 嗯，干得漂亮。你为共和国办了件大好事，{[character]player.name}。当你见证我们的伟大成就之时，你可以说，米玛塔尔的未来也有你的一份功劳！

messages.en: I can't imagine what you have to do that's more important than this, but I understand.
messages.zh: 我无法想象你还有什么更重要的事情，但我能理解。

messages.en:
You're just the kind of capsuleer I've been waiting for, {[character]player.name}. If you're interested, I've got something important that needs to get done, something I can't trust just anyone with. Your loyalty to the Republic is becoming legendary.

We're working on something big, {[character]player.name}, something very big. I can't go into specifics, but I can tell you that {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has been tasked with gathering materials from anywhere we can find them. Luckily, two of our objectives coincide.

It just happens that our old friends, the Angel Cartel, are sitting on a veritable treasure trove of spare parts and salvage out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. What do you say we kill two birds with one stone? Swing out there, vaporize all the Angel clowns you like, and bring us back some salvaged electronics. Sound good?
messages.zh:
你正是我寻觅的那种飞行员，{[character]player.name}。如果你感兴趣的话，我有件重要的事想交给你去办，这事可不是随便谁都能胜任的。你对于共和国的忠诚真是天下皆知。

我们正在建设一个大工程，{[character]player.name}，很巨大的工程。我不能透露详细信息，但是我可以告诉你，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}受命在宇宙各地搜集材料。走运的是，我们的两个目标碰在一起了。

我们的老朋友天使联合企业，在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}坐拥着一座备用零件和打捞件的宝库。你说我们该不该来个一石二鸟？赶到那里，全歼那些天使二百五，然后给咱们带一些回收的电子元件。肿么样？

messages.en: Oh, so you're too good to help out the Republic when it needs you? You capsuleers are all the same.
messages.zh: 哦，当共和国需要你的时候，你居然袖手旁观？你们克隆飞行员都是一个鸟样。

messages.en: Sometimes I regret taking this desk job. Hey, while you're out there, blast a few Angel goons for me, would you?
messages.zh: 有时候我真后悔选择了文职工作。那啥，你到了之后，记得帮我痛扁那些天使人渣，好吗？

name.ja: 恐るべき海賊、スカーレット

messages.en:
Though I doubt she'll run from a fight, you might want to bring a warp scrambler or disruptor to stop her from running deeper into cover.

Oh, and if you see some merchant vessels loitering around, hold your fire. That's my surveillance team. They may have some further intel once you arrive.
messages.zh:
虽然我不觉得她会中途逃跑，但你最好还是带上一个跃迁干扰装备，以防她躲到深处。

哦，如果你在现场看到一些商船，别打它们。那些是我的侦察队。你到那儿后，他们可能会向你提供进一步情报。

messages.en:
Have you ever heard of Anire Scarlet? Well, she's practically an urban legend among the local pirates. It seems any outlaw with a clone bay and rhetorical skills can amass a following these days. The sorts of degenerates that hang around this area are easily impressed too, so apparently has built quite a posse, but then, that could just be another one of the myths about her.

As for where you come in: all this attention has earned her a CONCORD bounty. I'd very much like to claim that ISK, {[character]player.name}, with your help. I've hired an undercover surveillance team to locate her, and they've had some luck turning up a lead. If you're able to follow it up and take her out then we can split the bounty money equally. The surveillance team found her flagship vessel, The Crimson Dawn. She is sure to be either inside it, or very close by. If you think yourself capable of eliminating her, then I'll trade you the coordinates.
messages.zh:
你听说过阿妮蕊·斯嘉丽这个人吗？她在本地海盗界中享有传奇人物一般的声誉。这年头，貌似只要一个犯罪份子能克隆自己并且能说会道，就可以号令众人。本地的那帮地痞流氓就是被这种人忽悠了。阿妮蕊好像就是他们的领导，不过这也可能只是另一个谣传而已。

接下来说这事和你有什么关系：统合部已经悬赏通缉她了。我很想得到那笔赏金，{[character]player.name}，当然，这需要你的帮助。我已经花钱派了一支侦察队去探明她的位置，结果运气不错，还真获得了她的线索。如果你能顺着该线索找到她并把她解决掉，那我就和你平分赏金。我的侦察队发现了她那名为血红早霞的旗舰。她要么在船里，要么就在其附近。如果你觉得你能干掉她，那我就把相关位标发给你。

messages.en: Nicely handled, {[character]player.name}. I'll keep you in mind for another bounty contract if she ever shows her head again.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。如果她再出现，我会考虑再和你合作的。

messages.en: Well, I can't say I blame you. I hear Anire Scarlet's pirates are pretty rough. They're all hell-bent on impressing their “Queen.”
messages.zh: 好吧，也难怪。听说阿妮蕊·斯嘉丽手下的海盗都很勇猛。他们可是拼命想在他们的“女王”面前好好表现一番啊。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}, it's good to see you. I have something a little outside of the ordinary that needs taking care of. A personal business opportunity for the both of us, I guess you could say.

Have you ever heard of Anire Scarlet? Well, she's practically an urban legend among the local pirates. It seems any outlaw with a clone bay and rhetorical skills can amass a following these days. The sorts of degenerates that hang around this area are easily impressed too. It seems Anire has built quite a posse, but then, that could just be another one of the myths about her.

As for where you come in: all this attention has earned her a CONCORD bounty. I'd very much like to claim that ISK, {[character]player.name}, with your help. I've hired an undercover surveillance team to locate her, and they've had some luck turning up a lead. If you're able to follow it up and take her out then we can split the bounty money equally. The surveillance team found her flagship vessel, The Crimson Dawn. She is sure to be either inside it, or very close by. If you think yourself capable of eliminating her, then I'll trade you the coordinates.

What do you say? Do we have a deal?
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，很高兴见到你。我有一件不寻常的事情需要处理。我们两个都可以从中捞些外快。

你听说过阿妮蕊·斯嘉丽这个人吗？她在本地海盗界中享有传奇人物一般的声誉。这年头，貌似只要一个犯罪份子能克隆自己并且能说会道，就可以号令众人。本地的那帮地痞流氓就是被这种人忽悠了。这个阿妮蕊好像就是他们的领导，不过这也可能只是另一个谣传而已。

接下来说这事和你有什么关系：统合部已经悬赏通缉她了。我很想得到那笔赏金，{[character]player.name}，当然，这需要你的帮助。我已经花钱派了一支侦察队去探明她的位置，结果运气不错，还真获得了她的线索。如果你能顺着该线索找到她并把她解决掉，那我就和你平分赏金。我的侦察队发现了她那名为血红早霞的旗舰。她要么在船里，要么就在其附近。如果你觉得你能干掉她，那我就把相关位标发给你。

怎么样？干不干？

messages.en: Too much for you to handle, huh?
messages.zh: 你对付不了？

messages.en: You have a bounty to collect, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 快去挣赏金吧，{[character]player.name}。

name.ja: 恐るべき海賊、スカーレット

messages.en: Too much for you to handle, huh?
messages.zh: 你对付不了？

messages.en: You have a bounty to collect, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 快去挣赏金吧，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Good! There are several deadspace acceleration gates that and need to be unlocked one at a time in isolated deadspace pockets while a strike force moves in through the complex and finds Zazzmatazz.
messages.zh: 很好！进入复合体并寻找扎茨玛特的时候，有多个死亡空间加速轨道，在死亡空间的每层里一次只能解锁一个。

messages.en: Break Zazzmatazz out of Consolidated Holdings Inc.
messages.zh: 帮助扎茨玛特从统一控股集团越狱

messages.en: Zazzmatazz may have eluded you but our client might settle for his DNA instead. It is better than nothing at least. Contact me soon for his response, it shouldn't take long.
messages.zh: 尽管你没有弄出扎茨玛特本人，我们的委托人或许还能接受扎茨玛特的DNA。总比一无所获要好吧。我很快就有他的回话，稍后请联系我。

messages.en: Alright! It is a little disappointing, but it's your call. This kind of mission doesn't float by every day.
messages.zh: 好吧。虽然让我失望，但你已经做了决定。这种任务可不是天天都能遇到。

messages.en:
Hello {[character]player.name}, up for some action? I have just received an offer from followers of the notorious pirate Zazzmatazz. The mission is to break him out of a private prison, Consolidated Holdings Inc. , which has a contract with Concord. Zazz is being held there, somewhat unexpectedly, for a very short time.

The client warns that once you have broken into the prison complex you will need to FINISH IT IN ONE run. Retreating is failure! The upside is that the client has promised some significant rewards if you prove capable and as a bonus, Consolidated Holdings Inc. is rumored to hold many secrets.

Are you up for it?
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}，来找点活动？我刚收到一项任务，来自恶名昭著的海盗扎茨玛特的同伙。这个任务需要把扎茨玛特从一个属于统一控股集团的私有牢狱里救出来，该集团与统合部有联系。有点意外的是，扎茨玛特被关押在那里的时间不久。

委托人警告我们说，一旦你攻入了牢狱复合体，你必须一次成功。否则撤退就是失败！这件差事的好处在于，委托人承诺事成之后会给你一大笔报酬，另外据说统一控股集团掌握着很多机密。

你有兴趣吗？

messages.en: I guess I overestimated your abilities and the strength of your network of friends.
messages.zh: 看来我高估了你的实力和人脉。

messages.en: Bring Zazzmatazz back as soon as you spring him out. There is a lot of heat on us because of this and I'm trying to stay out of the limelight.
messages.zh: 你救出扎茨玛特之后，尽快把他带回来。这件事让我们饱受关注，我希望能低调些。

messages.en: Alright, the locations for both targets are in the mission briefing. I'll see you around.
messages.zh: 好吧，目标们的位置在任务介绍中已经给出。回头见。

messages.en: Deliver Zazzmatazz – or his DNA, to be more exact – to either Consolidated Holdings, Inc., or to the pirate Ragnar Bloodthorn. Consolidated Holdings has set up a meeting with your agent, and Ragnar Bloodthorn said he will be in touch. Both clients are very angry over the turn of events: Bloodthorn was expecting Zazzmatazz himself from your initial services, not his DNA, and Consolidated Holdings has lost a lot of assets and taken a blow to its reputation. Both have a score to settle with you, but they desperately need your cooperation as well, at least until they have secured Zazzmatazz's DNA.
messages.zh: 把扎茨玛特——准确地说是他的DNA——交给统一控股集团，或者交给海盗拉格纳·血棘。统一控股准备会见你的代理人，而拉格纳·血棘也说他会保持联系。双方对于事态的发展都很恼火：血棘本来想通过你之前的工作救出扎茨玛特本人，而不是他的DNA；统一控股则损失了一大笔资产，声誉也受到了影响。双方都想找你算账，但同时又都迫切需要你的合作，至少要拿到扎茨玛特的DNA再说。

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}; this played out nicely. Consolidated Holdings, Inc., and this Ragnar Bloodthorn now have something to yell into the emptiness of space – they both got what they deserved!
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}；这招真管用。统一控股集团和拉格纳·血棘这下要叫唤了——他们活该！

messages.en: Alright! Keep Zazzmatazz's DNA for yourself, then. I don't want anything more to do with it.
messages.zh: 行啊！那你自己留着扎茨玛特的DNA吧。我可不想再跟它有瓜葛。

messages.en:
Hello {[character]player.name}. Our client was furious about Zazzmatazz not being retrieved, but is willing to negotiate for his DNA. However, Consolidated Holdings, Inc., also contacted me about making a deal to get his DNA back. I'll leave it up to you who to deal with. I have arranged a meeting with Consolidated Holdings, but the pirate contact said he will be in touch with you. His real name is Ragnar Bloodthorn. When you've met them, make a decision quick, please — this is one problem I'd like out of my hands!

So, do you want to go to the meeting?
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}。没能救出扎茨玛特，我们的委托人很生气，不过仍然愿意商谈取回他的DNA。问题是，统一控股集团也联系我，说愿意做个交易，换取他的DNA。我把选择权交给你。我已经安排好了和统一控股的会谈，可是那个海盗联络人说他也要见你。他的真名叫拉格纳·血棘。你见到他们之后，要迅速地做决定——我想赶紧摆脱此事！

那么，你愿意去会一会他们吗？

messages.en: I thought you were taking care of that DNA business! Now I have both Bloodthorn and Consolidated Holdings breathing down my neck because of you.
messages.zh: 我本以为你能搞定这个DNA的事情！我现在被血棘和统一控股盯上了，全都怪你。

messages.en: Get back to me when you have delivered Zazzmatazz's DNA to either party.
messages.zh: 等你把扎茨玛特的DNA交给他们任何一方之后，回来见我。

messages.en: You're doing the right thing. Countless lives depend on you.
messages.zh: 你做出了正确的选择。那么多人能否活下来就靠你了。

messages.en:
A pandemic has broken out on a planet in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Fortunately, a cure was already developed and mass-produced. The contagion originated on another planet, you see, so the people of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have experience in dealing with this particular disease.

The Sisters of Eve sent a medical drone with the vaccine onboard down to the planet, but some degenerate pirates have intercepted the craft and are trying to ransom it. The SSoE say that if the drone is destroyed, it could be days before we can mass-produce more vaccine – something about being unable to accelerate the bacterial cultivation. A few more days with this disease uncontrolled could mean everything. We must recapture the drone.

Once you've secured the drone, they can deploy repair teams and send it back on its way.
messages.zh:
{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系中的一个行星上爆发了一场传染病。好在我们目前已经有了一个治愈方案并已将其投入大规模生产。该病最初起源于另一个行星，所以{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的人们已经有了对付该传染病的经验。

姐妹会向那个行星调遣了一艘载有疫苗的无人机，但一帮无耻的海盗半路截获了该无人机，然后开始索要其赎金。姐妹会表示如果该无人机被摧毁，那得需要数天的时间才能重新量产那批疫苗——原因好像是他们无法提升细菌培养的速度。这病如果在几天内得不到控制，那后果不堪设想。因此我们必须夺回无人机。

一旦你夺回了无人机，姐妹会就会派出维修队将其修复然后送它重新上路。

messages.en: What? You're telling me profit is more important than innocent lives?
messages.zh: 什么？你的意思是钱比无辜的生命更重要？

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}? Good. I have a job that's probably outside your normal scope. This one is humanitarian.

A pandemic has broken out on a planet in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Fortunately, a cure was already developed and mass-produced. The contagion originated on another planet nearby, you see, so the people of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} already have experience in dealing with this particular disease.

The Sisters of Eve sent a medical drone with the vaccine onboard down to the planet, but some degenerate pirates have intercepted the craft, disabled it, and are now trying to demand a ransom for its release. The Sisters say that if the drone is destroyed it could be days before we can mass-produce more vaccine – something about being unable to accelerate the bacterial cultivation. A few more days with this disease uncontrolled could mean everything. We must recapture the drone.

We're depending on you here, {[character]player.name}. Once you've secured the drone, they can deploy repair teams and send it back on its way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}? 很好。这份工作对你而言不同寻常，这是一个人道主义救援任务。

{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}星系中的一个行星上爆发了一场传染病。好在我们目前已经有了一个治愈方案并已将其投入大规模生产。该病最初起源于附近的一个行星，所以{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的人们已经有了对付该传染病的经验。

姐妹会向那个行星调遣了一艘载有疫苗的无人机，但一帮无耻的海盗半路截获了该无人机，然后开始索要赎金。姐妹会表示如果该无人机被摧毁，那得需要数天的时间才能重新量产那批疫苗——原因好像是他们无法提升细菌培养的速度。这病如果在几天内得不到控制，那后果不堪设想。因此我们必须夺回无人机。

就靠你了，{[character]player.name}。一旦你夺回了无人机，姐妹会就会派出维修队将其修复然后送它重新上路。

messages.en: I should have known. Your kind disgusts me.
messages.zh: 我早该猜到才对。你让我觉得恶心。

messages.en: We don't have any time to waste. Get moving.
messages.zh: 没时间供你浪费了。快去吧。

messages.en: Great. You get out there, and you've got some rescue money coming your way. I don't really care who you rescue, just so long as you rescue someone. Fair warning, though – the ones you don't rescue are likely to remember it.
messages.zh: 很好。去吧，你很快就能获得援救资金了。只要你救人就行，救谁我不管。但有点要提醒你，没有被你救的人可能会记恨。

messages.en:
I just received an alert across multiple communication channels asking for evacuation help. A diplomatic station not far from here is undergoing a traumatic systems shut-down cascade. It's all going, and people need off that station. The rescue requires a smaller ship than what they have available to get in past the field of debris now ringing the station. That's what happens when none of the empires will trust the others enough to allow them to send in their best station engineers and construction teams, and so they all agree on a third-party freelance company to build their stations. Happens all the time, I hear. Ridiculous.

Anyway – are you interested?
messages.zh:
我现在接到来自多方面的救援请求。离这儿不远的一座外交空间站里，系统正面临全线瘫痪。已经没有任何补救方法，现在能做的就是把人员转移出去。由于目前该空间站周围有一圈碎片环绕，他们现有的舰船都太大无法冲出重围，因此他们要求一艘小船前往营救。当初帝国之间无法建立互信，因此他们都不向对方派遣最好的工程师与最有能力的建筑队，转而一致同意让第三方公司来建造空间站。现在自食其果了吧。听说这已经见怪不怪了。真傻X。

算了不说那些了——你有兴趣前往营救吗？

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}. Enjoy your reward, and the limelight for being a hero to those folks – you've earned it. You should know, however, that the folks you didn't save have already made it very clear that they're not happy with you.
messages.zh: 干得不错，{[character]player.name}。好好享受一下你的奖赏吧，还有别人对你的赞誉之词。你当之无愧。但你同时也要明白，没有被你救的那些人已经很清楚地表达了对你的不满。

messages.en: You will lose standing with those factions you choose not to rescue. Fair warning.
messages.zh: 你不去营救的势力将降低你在他们眼中的声望。到时候别说我没提醒过你。

messages.en: Warning!
messages.zh: 警告！

messages.en: Really? That's it? You're quitting? Why'd you agree to do it in the first place, then?
messages.zh: 是吗？就这样了？你不干了？那你当初干嘛要答应？

messages.en: How's that rescue operation going?
messages.zh: 营救进展如何？

messages.en: That is very good to hear, thank you. We will transfer the cargo to your hangar immediately, along with a small element of the intelligence team, who have stated that they will provide security through to the final destination station. You'd best head to your ship quickly, as I wouldn't want those guys on board my ship without an escort, especially as the rather unique weapons they usually carry are easily capable of punching a nice little hole in your hull.
messages.zh: 真是好消息，谢谢了。我们会立即把货物转移到你的机库，与此同时还有一小批情报人员会跟随你，他们说会负责路上的保安工作。你最好快点回到你的船上。他们身上携带的武器能轻而易举地把你的船体打出个洞来，你应该赶快过去盯住他们。

messages.en: Our security and military ground forces have been experiencing a slow but steady increase in the numbers and severity of injuries suffered during a wide range of armed conflicts. A recent study by Amarr military scientists has determined that the primary cause of this has been a failure to adequately improve the lightweight body armor worn by millions of our soldiers, Marines, police, and other fighting forces. As fate would have it, one of our intelligence units has obtained what they claim to be a revolutionary new fabric that could provide fifty percent better protection across the board in all types of engagements. We need you to deliver this very sensitive cargo to a station we designate.
messages.zh: 在各类武装冲突中，我们的地面安保和军事部队的受伤人数与创伤程度，都在缓慢持续的增加。根据艾玛军事科学家们最近的一份研究报告，导致这一现象的主要原因是，数百万士兵、海军、警察及其他武装人员穿戴的轻型防弹衣未能得到有效改进。但我们的一个情报部门，最近却获得了一种被他们称为突破性的新型纤维。无论用于哪一种战斗，这种纤维提供的防护力都要比现有品种高50%，也许这就是神的护佑。我们现在要你把这个敏感的货物送到指定空间站。

messages.en: Outstanding, pilot. You were even a bit ahead of schedule. Our offloading team is en route to your ship, and the Intel guards will stay with the shipment until that has been completed. I will keep your name in my “go to” list should any more missions come up in the future.
messages.zh: 太棒了，飞行员。你甚至还提前了一点抵达。我们的装卸人员正在赶往你的舰船，情报人员会一直监护这批东西，直到卸载完成。如果将来我这里还有任务，你会是我的首选委派对象。

messages.en: I must say I am disappointed in your decision to turn down this mission. I vouched for you personally, given what I have seen in your files about your excellent mission completion record. I will not soon forget your refusal.
messages.zh: 你拒绝此任务，我深感失望。从你的档案来看，你的任务完成记录相当好。我为此还曾经极力替你说好话。对你的这次拒绝，我是不会轻易忘记的。

messages.en: Lightweight body armor is a common and often required element of any police or security forces' operational gear. Modern armor of this type can stop most projectile, laser, and other light weapon fire. However, as small arms weaponry continued to evolve with regard to the amount of damage it can inflict, so to must the defensive technologies designed to maintain parity with these weapons. On rare occasions, a corporation, military laboratory, or other entity will produce a light body armor system that represents nothing short of a generational leap in design and protection. The multilayered fabrics used in these latter applications are usually amongst the most highly guarded secrets of any civilization, for many reasons. The most advanced of these contain nanotechnology which also can change color and density depending on ambient conditions and/or input from the wearer.
messages.zh: 轻型防弹衣是警察或安全部队常用和必备的物品。这种现代的防弹衣能抵挡大部分子弹、激光及其他轻型武器发射的弹药。然而随着小型手持武器的威力越来越强，针对其的防御科技也必须跟上。少数时候，军团、军事实验室或其他组织能制作出一种在设计与防御力方面皆有划时代意义的轻型防弹衣。由于多种原因，每个国家都把防弹衣采用的多层纤维列为最高机密。最先进的那些纤维采用了纳米技术，能根据周围环境及/或穿戴者的指令来改变自身颜色与密度。

messages.en: Lightweight Body Armor
messages.zh: 轻型防弹衣

messages.en:
Thank you for coming, pilot. As you know, the Amarr Empire is in a constant state of conflict. Our enemies have included organized criminal gangs, drug traffickers, terrorists of every conceivable motivation, pirates, unpacified slave populations, and even the occasional low level skirmish against our fair-weather friends, the Caldari, Gallente, and, lest we forget, the Minmatar. This requires the Empire to always remain vigilant to any situations that may call for the use of force on levels ranging from simple urban pacification to outright military combat. What you do not know is that a high-level internal Empire report has revealed that our casualty levels have been steadily increasing over the last several years, often requiring evacuation to more robust – and already overburdened – medical facilities.

In the “recommendations” section of this report, the researchers concluded that the single most identifiable cause of these excessive casualties is a systemic problem with our lightweight body armor. This armor is standard issue for millions of police and security personnel, as well as our military reconnaissance units. Unless a drastic improvement in the quality and durability of this body armor can be found, we will continue to suffer the consequences.

This morning I received a priority communication from an Amarr Intelligence Officer claiming that his team had just “obtained” a revolutionary new fabric that, if properly processed, could literally double the strength of our existing armor. I know this officer only by reputation, and it is best not to pry any further into how his team came across this “miracle cloth.” Nonetheless, we have been advised that they will arrive at this station within moments to transfer the fabric here for transshipment to a more secure facility.

So, pilot, will you transport this prototype body armor fabric to the station facility we designate?
messages.zh:
谢谢你赶过来，飞行员。你知道，艾玛帝国里一天到晚都有这样那样的冲突发生。我们的敌人包括流氓组织、违规药品非法贩售贩、怀着各类动机的恐怖份子、海盗及未开化的劳工，甚至偶尔还得与面子上的朋友——加达里、盖伦特及米玛塔尔进行小规模的交火。这就要求我们时刻保持警惕，做好应对从平息城市暴乱到展开军事战斗的各种准备。你不知道的是，艾玛政府高层内部有一份报告指出，我方伤亡人数近些年来一直在增加，导致高级医疗急救站超负荷运转。

在这份报告的“建议”一栏中，研究人员做出结论称，我们在轻型防弹衣方面暴露出的系统性问题，是导致过度伤亡的最主要原因。我们目前采用的防弹衣是标准类型，数以百万计的警察、安保人员与军事侦察部队都穿戴这种防弹衣。如果它在质量与耐用性方面没有重大改善，那我们这种伤亡增加趋势就会继续下去。

今天早上，我突然接到一位艾玛情报官发来的急电，他称其手下的人已经“获得”了一种突破性的新型纤维，只要加以适当处理，就能使我们现有防弹衣的防护力翻一倍。我对这位官员了解不多，所以我们最好不要去追问他手下那些人究竟怎么得到这种“奇迹服装”的。我接到指令说，他们很快就会抵达这里，然后会将这种纤维分批装到不同的船上，运往一个更安全的场所。

怎么样，飞行员，愿意帮忙将这种试验型防弹衣纤维送到我们指定的空间站吗？

messages.en: Quitting mid-mission is not something I expected from you. Now I am going to have to answer to the intelligence team. Oh, and don't expect any further jobs from me until your failure here has been long forgotten. Damn… I need a stress pill….
messages.zh: 我没料到你会打退堂鼓。你让我现在怎么跟我们的情报人员交代？除非我将来淡忘了你这次的举动，否则你别想再从我这里接活儿。靠…我需要点镇静剂…

messages.en: Thank you for the update pilot, but no need to contact me until you arrive. The Intel security team on your ship is keeping me quite well informed.
messages.zh: 谢谢你提供最新情况，飞行员。但你最好等到抵达后再联系我。你船上的情报人员会一直向我通报最新进展的。

messages.en: Thank you for accepting this important, time-sensitive mission. You have been given priority clearance for station undock, so please leave as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 感谢你接受这份重要和紧急的任务。我们已经安排你可以优先离站，所以快点出发吧。

messages.en: A small, platoon-sized Caldari special operation team is in hiding on a Gallente planet and in danger of being captured or killed. They are low on water, food, weapons, and other equipment and will not last long unless they are extracted. We have a rescue standing by; however, we need you to deliver the required materials to their station so that they can then proceed with this critical rescue mission.
messages.zh: 一个排的加达里别动队正藏在一颗盖伦特的行星上，他们面临着被活捉或死亡的危险。他们目前缺水、断粮，没有足够的武器装备，不去救这些人的话他们肯定活不长。我们虽然已经有一支营救队做好了随时出发的准备，但我们还需要你将必需物资运到他们所在的空间站，这样他们才能继续开展这项至关重要的营救任务。

messages.en: We have received word that the extraction team has taken delivery of your cargo and is now en route to the planet. Given the speed with which you delivered this essential shipment, we assess a high likelihood that the stranded team will be safely extracted. Well done!
messages.zh: 我们接到消息说，营救队已经带着你送去的东西赶往那颗行星了。由于你及时交付了这批重要物资，我们认为那支受困的别动队被解救的可能性很大。干得好！

messages.en: Your refusal to accept this mission will almost certainly result in the loss of this Special Forces team, not to mention placing the now-dangerously unequipped extraction team at great risk.
messages.zh: 你拒绝这项任务，基本上宣告了那支受困特种部队的死刑，而且你还把装备严重不足的营救队推入了危险的境地。

messages.en:
One of our Caldari Navy Special Forces units conducting clandestine reconnaissance of a contested ocean planet – a Gallente-claimed planet, by the way, with extremely rare seabed minerals – sent an emergency burst communication to the covert ops ship in orbit above the planet, requesting immediate extraction. This signal was, in turn, transmitted to the classified comms center here on this station. When we attempted to contact both the team and the ship, however, we received no response. Our immediate reaction was to divert one of our long range Crow-class interceptors, which was in the region on an unrelated mission, to investigate. Soon after its arrival, its sensors confirmed that the covert ops ship had been destroyed.

There is nothing we can do for our lost covops ship; however, this series of events has left the Special Forces team alone and without a means to evacuate the planet. Even worse was a fragment from the original communication indicating that the team was on the run and low on food, water, weapons, and ammunition. They have taken refuge in a disused ocean mining facility, though it is doubtful that they will stay hidden for long. There simply aren't many places to hide on that planet, given the fact that it is mostly covered by massive oceans, with very little land mass. It will not take long for the Gallente to track down our team and either kill them or, worse, capture them for interrogation.

The good news in all this is that we have an extraction team in place, along with a shuttle-equipped vessel to deliver them to the planet. However, given the immediacy of this mission, they had to leave their original base without much of their usual equipment and weaponry. This is where you come in. We need you to transport several containers of highly specialized small arms and related equipment to the station at which the extraction team is currently located. Once you drop off this cargo, the team will gear-up and shuttle down to the planet to rescue the stranded team.

So, pilot, what is it gonna be? Will you help us?
messages.zh:
我们的一支加达里海军别动队在一颗主权有争议的海洋行星上进行秘密勘探，盖伦特宣称自己对这一蕴藏稀有海床矿物的行星具有主权。勘探进行到一半，那支别动队突然向轨道上的隐秘侦察舰发出了紧急求救信号，要求立即离开。那个求救信号也传到了这座空间站的一个机密通讯中心。可当我们试图与他们及他们的船取得联系时，却没有收到任何反馈。我们的第一反应就是调遣我们的一艘当时尚在那地区执行其他任务的远程黑鸦级截击舰，命令它赶赴现场调查。它抵达之后，我们很快就从它的扫描器中确认了那艘隐秘侦察舰已被摧毁。

船已毁，我们也无回天之力。但我们的那支别动队还被困在行星上。更糟的是，从他们最初发回的求救信号来看，他们一直居无定所，食物、水、武器、弹药……什么都缺。他们目前躲在一个弃用的海洋矿床，不过我怀疑他们坚持不了多久。由于那颗行星表面大部分都是海洋，基本上没有陆地，因此他们实在没多少地方可躲。按目前情况发展下去，盖伦特用不了多久就能找到他们，然后要么干掉他们，要么更糟的就是，活捉他们带回去审讯。

好在我们现在有一支可以随时出发的营救队，还有一艘载有穿梭机，可将他们送达那个行星的舰船。但由于该任务的紧迫性，他们不得不在没有携带大量武器装备的情况下仓促离开了他们的基地。这也正是你可以帮忙的地方。我们需要你将几箱非常专业的小型军械及相关器械送往那支营救队目前所在的空间站。一旦你把东西送到了，营救队就会立即出发赶往那颗行星搜救那支被困的队伍。

怎么样，飞行员？愿意帮忙吗？

messages.en: We are disappointed that you've chosen not to complete this critical mission. You've left our military personnel at great risk. It is doubtful that we will be able to find anyone else to get this critical shipment to the station in time.
messages.zh: 你选择在如此重要的一项任务中打退堂鼓让我们很失望。你这样做等于把我们部队里的人往火里推。我很怀疑我们能及时找到其他人将这一重要物资送往那空间站。

messages.en: Do not contact us until you have completed this shipment. There is simply no time for idle chatter, not to mention the likelihood that the enemy is almost certainly listening in.
messages.zh: 等完成了运输任务之后再联系我们。现在没时间瞎聊，而且我们的对话还有被窃听的可能。

messages.en: I certainly do appreciate your help, pilot. Hopefully, if we can get these drills into the hands of the miners in short order, the company should be able to retain its mining rights and return to profitability.
messages.zh: 非常感谢你能帮忙，飞行员。如果我们能在最短时间内将钻机送到矿工手里，公司就有望保住采矿权并且继续盈利。

messages.en:
Due to a recent series of inspections by the regional mine monitoring commission, we have found it necessary to purchase a large quantity of the latest generation of environmentally-friendly drills and related equipment.

In order to avoid financial penalties and the possible loss of our mining rights, that company must get these quite expensive new drills into the hands of the miners as soon as possible. If you can deliver this cargo to the station that serves as our logistical hub for this system, they can then have their own pilots transship them to the required planetary mining locations.
messages.zh:
依据星域矿业监管协会近期一系列的检查结果，我们现在有必要购入大量最新的环保型钻机及相关设备。

公司需要尽快把这些昂贵的钻机送到矿工手里，以免遭受罚款或是采矿权益上的损失。如果你能将这些设备送到我们在这个星系的物流中心的话，他们接下来就可以派人把货转运往各个行星矿点。

messages.en: Job well done. Our logistics teams are loading your shipment into their transport vessels as we speak, and we should have the drills and equipment in place shortly. We will definitely contact you again, should we require your services.
messages.zh: 干得好。如我所言，我们的物流团队正忙于把你送来的货装船，很快就可以把这些钻机和设备运往各处。我们仍然需要你更多的帮助，稍后会继续联系你的。

messages.en: Well, I must say we are quite disappointed that you would turn down this very easy contract. We shall find another pilot and move your name to the bottom of our list. Don't call us, we'll call you.
messages.zh: 这么简单的任务你也不愿意接受，我真的对你非常失望。我们会去找别人帮忙，你在我们心中的地位已经大大降低了。别再来烦我们，我们会去找你的。

messages.en:
Let me start at the beginning. As you have probably seen on the news channels, a prominent Caldari mining company is in the middle of a very nasty battle for economic survival with a new, up-and-coming mining company from within the same large conglomerate. Both of these companies specialize in the extraction of ores from some of the more inhospitable and dangerous locations in this and several adjoining systems. While this can be hazardous with regard to men and equipment, the profit potential from these largely untapped ore reserves can be quite significant, which brings me to our current predicament.

As you may know, the specialized manual labor required for some of these mines can be significant in terms of numbers. Well, the Mining Health and Safety Commission, or MHSC, for this region recently conducted a survey of the first company's operations, and found that their mining practices at certain locations may have resulted in excessive pollution, then further alleged a corresponding link to long-term miner health problems. The company has loudly complained that this is a ridiculous witch hunt brought about by their new competitor, which happens to have several “friends” on the commission. While they work to ensure they are equally “represented” on that commission, the recent finding has mandated that they immediately improve worker conditions and reduce pollution or risk losing their mining rights. To remedy this problem, they recently purchased a large number of the latest environmentally-friendly – and obscenely expensive – manportable drills, which seems to have assuaged the MHSC for the moment. They do, however, have a deadline for actually putting these new drills into the hands of the miners, which brings us to the reason I contacted you.

We need you to deliver a rather large shipment of drills and other related equipment to a station that serves as a central service hub. From there, logistics pilots will deliver this and other items to the various mines in the system. Will you take on this important job?
messages.zh:
我从头说起。你大概已经听过相关新闻报道，一家加达里矿业巨头正陷入一场险恶的，关乎生存的经济战争，对手是来自同一财团的一家崭露头角的新兴矿业公司。这两家公司都擅长从邻近的几个星系中的一些比较荒凉及危险的地区开采矿石并将之精炼。虽然这种开采方式对人员及设备都比较有害，但是大量矿石蕴藏的利润前景非常巨大，这也让我陷入了目前的麻烦。

你可能知道，在这些矿区里，人力操作显得极为重要。本星域的矿业健康及安全协会（MHSC）最近对那家矿业巨头进行了调查，发现他们在某些特定地区的开采行为可能会造成严重污染，并由此导致长期的矿工健康隐患。这家公司对此强烈抗议，并声称他们的新竞争对手在协会内部有“靠山”，这不过是对手耍的可笑伎俩。 与此同时，他们一方面在协会内部寻求公正对待，另一方面也不得不接受协会的指令：要马上改善矿工工作环境并减少污染，否则就有失去采矿权的危险。为了解决问题，他们近期购进了大量极其昂贵的最新环保型单人钻机，并藉此暂时缓和了协会对他们的态度。不过，他们必须在规定期限到来之前将这些新钻机交到矿工手中，这也正是我们找你来的原因。

我们需要你将一大批钻机及相关设备送往服务中心。那里的物流人员随后会将货物及其他设备送往星系内不同的矿点。你愿意承担如此重任吗？

messages.en: We are shocked to hear that you have chosen to quit this job in the middle of the contract. We will now have to pay another pilot double to pick up where you left off. You should have let us know from the outset that you could not take on this important job. Hopefully, we will never have to rely on you again.
messages.zh: 我们对你半途而废的行为感到十分震惊。现在我们被迫支付另一位飞行员双倍的报酬来接手你留下来的烂摊子。你早该在一开始就告诉我们，你干不了这么重要的工作。我们不会再相信你了。

messages.en: You seem to be on schedule and we look forward to the prompt delivery of the equipment to the designated station. Contact us through the usual channels after you have offloaded this gear.
messages.zh: 看起来你正在有条不紊地工作中，希望你能按时把设备送到指定空间站。你卸下货物后，就像往常那样联系我吧。

messages.en: Bless the Empress – I am very glad to hear you've decided to help. The RIT personnel will meet you in the hangar bay shortly.  Please feel free to take any of our religious literature with you for your enlightenment during the flight.
messages.zh: 天佑女皇——我很高兴你能伸出援手。反暴特勤组的人马上就会去机库等你。你可以在出发前从我这儿随便拿一本宗教文献上路，愿你能从中获得升华。

messages.en: There has been an uprising at one of our slave Labor Reeducation Centers, or LRCs, near a rather large ore mine. The slaves are almost wholly Minmatar, so we cannot afford to have this incident continue for even one more day. The longer it goes on, the greater the chances that some reporter or news agency will get wind of this and splash the story all over the region. Given that the Minmatar Republic may feel compelled to take action to aid their brethren, this can only lead to dire consequences. That, of course, is unacceptable. We do have a plan in place, however, that should end this uprising before it has a chance to truly take root. We need you to transport a large contingent of Riot Interdiction Team (RIT) personnel to a designated station. From there the assembled security teams will join up and embark a small fleet of frigates and cruisers to race to the prison, where they will use all necessary force to terminate this uprising before it gets completely out of control.
messages.zh: 在一座大型矿场附近的一个劳教中心里，发生了一场暴动。鉴于那儿的劳工几乎清一色都是米玛塔尔人，我们要迅速解决此事。这事拖得越长，新闻媒体就越有可能捕捉到此事的风声，然后整个星域的人都会了解此事。考虑到米玛塔尔政府可能会迫于公众压力出动军队来援救那帮劳工，这会引发极其严重的后果。因此绝不能让那种情况发生。还好我们已经有了应对方案，能将暴动终结在萌芽阶段。你现在要做的就是，把一批反暴特勤组人员送往指定空间站。然后他们会从那儿登上一小队护卫舰与巡洋舰，赶赴劳教中心，趁着形势尚未完全失控之前，动用所有必要力量扑灭此次暴动。

messages.en: The teams have begun to embark on a small fleet of frigates and cruisers for LRC-12A. With this amount of men and lethal weaponry, there is no doubt that we shall prevail!
messages.zh: 武装部队已经登上了一小队护卫舰与巡洋舰，往LRC-12A去了。有这么多人再加上致命武器，我们肯定能平息此事！

messages.en: Bah – I should have known you wouldn't help us. I could tell when I first met you that you were beyond salvation.
messages.zh: 靠，我早该猜到你不肯帮忙。我见你第一面时就知道，你是个无药可救的人。

messages.en:
The Amarr Empire, realizing many centuries ago that it could not simply work slaves to the point of death, instituted a number of improvements to worker conditions in an effort to prolong the usable lifespan of its slaves. These changes were not universal across the Empire, due in large part to the Empress's unwillingness to create what might have amounted to significant friction between slave -based companies. Therefore, these decisions were largely left to the Five Heirs and their subordinate regional offices. Thus, we can state here that history has shown a lack of consistent application of these worker improvement programs across the Empire. Those Amarr systems that have chosen to incorporate these adaptations have, however, consistently derived greater revenues due to these enhanced and ongoing pacification efforts.

These shortcomings led directly to the establishment of Labor Reeducation Centers (LRC). An LRC is designed much like a multilevel prison, with facilities for low, medium, and high risk inmates. The inmates are those slaves who consistently exhibit defiance or even outright hostility towards the managerial staff at the mine, construction site, or other location to which they are assigned as slave labor. Once we have identified these persons they are immediately removed from their job site and taken to the nearest LRC for corrective behavioral conditioning. This conditioning can include a wide variety of attitude modification methodologies, from intensive drug assisted counseling, to religious indoctrination, and from advanced torture techniques and a concurrent system of rewards - the so-called “carrot and stick approach” - and any number of programs in between. In this way, we break the individual slave's will so that he may be returned to the workforce as a docile and useful component in the labor pool.
messages.zh:
许多世纪以前，艾玛帝国就已经意识到，不能让每个劳工都蛮干到死。为了延长劳工们的使用期，帝国在劳工工作环境方面做了诸多改善。但这些改善并没有在帝国整个境内推广开来，很大程度上是因为艾玛女皇不愿看到那些使用劳工的企业相互间产生矛盾。这样一来，她便把决定权下放给五位太子及他们各自管辖的星域办公室。因此在艾玛境内，劳工劳工的工作条件改善方案并没有被一致采纳。而那些采纳了该方案的艾玛星系，却需要投入很大一部分税收用于其执行。

这也就是为什么后来会出现劳教中心的原因。劳教中心就像一座分区管理的牢狱一样，轻度危险、中度危险及高度危险的劳工各有一片专属区。收押在劳教中心里的劳工之前都在矿场、工地或者其他被分配到的地点工作，他们在那儿一直不服从命令，有的甚至还威胁管理人员。我们发现这样的人之后，就立即把他们撤离工作岗位，送他们到最近的劳教中心实施行为矫正。这种矫正运用多种态度纠正手段，包括大剂量药物辅助心理辅导、宗教灌输及“胡萝卜加大棒”的奖惩并用等等。这样我们便能摧垮每个劳工的意志，接下来他们就可以服服贴贴地重返工作岗位继续发挥作用了。

messages.en: Amarr Labor Reeducation Centers (LRC)
messages.zh: 艾玛劳教中心（LRC）

messages.en:
As you know, there are many hundreds of thousands of Minmatar slaves working to provide essential services to the Empire, just as they have for centuries. Given their considerable natural physical abilities, they have always made up one of the most important and valuable ethnic groups within the vast Amarr slave workforce. One unavoidable consequence of this, however, is that we have had to invest a considerable amount of money, not only in the health and welfare of these slaves, but also to ensure their obedience.

One important aspect of this latter effort has been the establishment of Labor Reeducation Centers, or LRC's, which are designed to house some of the more problematic slaves in order to facilitate their eventual return to the workforce. In recent months, however, there has been a significant increase in violent disobedience at certain LRC's, with some of the more severe instances leading to near-riots.

Our immediate problem is that one of these facilities, LRC-12A, has been taken over during just such an uprising. The slaves have reportedly killed and injured dozens of our personnel and taken the remainder hostage. They are demanding the immediate release of their fellow slaves at a nearby Amarr mining operation, along with transportation to a destination of their choosing. We have, so far, managed to keep this incident quiet; if the Minmatar Republic leadership were to learn of this, it could very easily lead to much more severe consequences for both races. The only way to ensure this does not happen is through the immediate application of overwhelming force.

Therefore, we need you to deliver a large contingent of specially trained Riot Interdiction Teams to a nearby station, from which they will join up with other security elements for final transportation to LRC-12A. Will you assist us?
messages.zh:
你知道，数十万计的米玛塔尔劳工在为帝国服务，几个世纪以来都是如此。由于他们身体素质出众，因此在艾玛所有的劳工劳工群体中，米玛塔尔劳工是最被器重的民族之一。但与此同时一个不可避免的后果就是，我们必须砸大笔钱，不但要保证这帮人的衣食住行，还得确保他们听话。

为了做到后者，我们建立了“劳教中心”，简称LRC。我们把那些闹事的劳工送入那里，以便让他们最终都能重返工作岗位。但最近，一些劳教中心里发生的暴力反抗事件明显增多，有些甚至严重到几乎要暴动的地步。

我们目前面临的首要问题来自LRC-12A这个劳教中心，那里已经被劳工们控制了。据称他们害死了我们数十位人员，并且把剩下的人都劫为了人质。那帮劳工要求我们立即释放在他们那儿附近一座艾玛采矿工地上工作的劳工，他们还要求我们把释放的人送往他们指定的地点。到目前为止，我们还没有让这件事走漏风声。如果米玛塔尔高层获悉此事，那很容易会产生对双方而言都很严重的后果。而防止这种后果产生的唯一方法就是，立即调用压倒性的武装力量。

因此你现在要做的就是，将一批受过特训的反暴特勤组送往附近一座空间站，他们会在那里与其他安保人员汇合，然后一道前往LRC-12A劳教中心。你愿意帮忙吗？

messages.en: You soulless coward! Without the men you agreed to deliver our assault on the prison will undoubtedly lead to unnecessary casualties on all sides.
messages.zh: 你这没良心的胆小鬼！缺了你本来要送去的那批人，我们的控制行动一定会给各方都造成不必要的伤亡。

messages.en: Good job, pilot. Please make all possible haste to the station as the other teams are waiting on you. The assault phase will begin after you deliver the RIT personnel and their equipment.
messages.zh: 很好，飞行员。请尽快赶往那座空间站，其他队伍的人都在等你们。等你把反暴特勤组的人与他们的装备都送到那儿之后，我们就会开始控制行动。

messages.en: We're very glad to hear you are willing to take on this important mission. If we can get these EM devices to the station in time, I know we can save many innocent lives.
messages.zh: 我们非常高兴你勇于承担如此重任。如果我们能及时把这些电磁设备送到空间站，将挽救许许多多的无辜生命。

messages.en: Following a string of suicide terrorist attacks yesterday, we managed to capture a high ranking member of their organization. Interrogations have revealed, however, that a devastating viral weapon, based on nanotechnology, is already in place and primed for release. We need you to deliver the only known countermeasure to this agent, manportable electromagnetic weapons. If we are successful, these weapons could eradicate the virus before it has a chance to spread and infect the entire station.
messages.zh: 昨天的一系列自尽式恐怖袭击发生之后，我们抓获了一名对方组织的高级成员。经过审讯，我们得知一种基于纳米技术的毁灭性病毒武器已经部署完毕，并随时准备散布。我们需要你来运送对抗该毒剂的唯一已知手段——便携式电磁武器。如果能成功，这些武器能够在病毒散播到整个空间站之前将其有效根除。

messages.en: Your bravery and skillful piloting without question, saved the lives of untold numbers of innocent people. We will definitely move your name to the top of our list for any future time-sensitive missions!
messages.zh: 你的勇气与才能挽救了无数无辜的生命。今后如果再有此类紧急事件发生，我们会第一个想到你的名字。

messages.en: We are all terribly disappointed in your refusal to transport these electromagnetic weapons to the station. We shall now have to find another pilot and another ship, and I fear even then we will be too late. I doubt you will be sleeping very well after you see what may become of that station.
messages.zh: 你竟然拒绝伸出援手，我们对你极其失望。我们要再去找其他人帮忙，我担心会来不及了。我觉得你在看到空间站的惨状之后也会睡的安然无比吧，冷血动物！

messages.en: Terrorists, working with criminal scientists, have developed a strain of viral weaponry that is based on nanotechnology. When combined, the "hive mind" of the viral strain works to seek out human tissue at which point the microscopic nanos begin to quickly disassemble the tissue, leading to a slow and painful death. Research into electromagnetic pulses has provided some promising leads with regard to countermeasures, but these have not yet been field tested.
messages.zh: 恐怖分子与那些邪恶的科学家合作，生产出了一种基于纳米技术的病毒武器。一旦生效，病毒体就像蜂群寻巢一样寻找人体组织并使其分解，导致人缓慢而痛苦地死去。研究表明，电磁脉冲似乎是一种有效的应对手段，但是还没有经过实地检测。

messages.en: Nanotechnology-based Viral Weapons
messages.zh: 基于纳米技术的病毒武器

messages.en:
Last night, a strike team of suicide terrorists from the Anti-Corporatist Revolutionary Front, or ACRF, struck at more than twenty Caldari offices and stations throughout the region. During one of these attacks a terrorist was captured with a well-shielded, improvised nuclear device hidden in his rucksack. Obviously this event represents an entirely new level of threat from the ACRF, now that they have proven themselves willing to carry out such a horrendous and indiscriminate mass casualty attack.

The only upside to this is that the terrorist has turned out to be the most notorious operative of the ACRF, a woman known as Commander Rachendia. Having her in custody has offered us an opportunity to gain information related to her group's future plans to strike at the Caldari State. During one of the more aggressive interrogations, she disclosed information about a pending attack against one of our nearby stations. The nature of the attack is not entirely clear; however, we know with certainty that it involves the surreptitious introduction of a viral agent into the life support and air circulation systems.

Our initial searches for these hidden canisters at that station have, so far, been fruitless – with the exception of one small aerosol-type canister. A preliminary test revealed that these viral weapons appear to be based on a self-replicating nanotechnology. Once released from stasis in their container, they seek out and consume human tissue, and leaving behind little more than dust. Our medical scientists have calculated that just one container, released into the central air processing vents, could result in the deaths of all human life aboard a medium-sized station within no more than four hours.
