The only good news is that these nanos are programmed to self-terminate within 12 hours. Of course, this would be far more time than would be necessary to kill everyone aboard all but the largest of stations.

Your role in this desperate situation is to deliver a cargo of electromagnetic weapons, modified to emit a short-range pulse that will literally "fry" any nanos within its range. So, we are asking: will you deliver these containers to the station immediately? Thousands of lives may depend on your answer.
messages.zh:
昨天晚上，一伙来自“反集团主义变革阵线”（ACRF）的恐怖分子对本星域中超过20个加达里办公室及空间站发动了自尽式袭击。袭击中，一名恐怖分子被捕，身上藏有一个保护完好的简易核装置。显然，ACRF组织对我们的威胁程度已进一步提高，他们已经开始实施可怕的大规模袭击。

唯一的好消息是，我们抓获的那个人居然是ACRF组织最臭名昭著的特工——被称为“雷琴迪娅长官”的女人。从她口中我们可以获知其组织未来对加达里的攻击计划。经过严刑审讯，我们得知，该组织即将对邻近的一个空间站发动袭击。这次袭击的性质还不得而知，但是我们确信，他们会暗中对生命保障及空气循环系统投放病毒。

我们试图在空间站中寻找那些隐藏的病毒容器，但只找到了一个小气雾罐。我们的初步检测显示，这种病毒武器似乎基于一种能够自我复制的纳米技术。被激活之后，它们将开始寻找并侵蚀人体组织，并且不留任何痕迹。我们的医学专家通过计算得知，一罐病毒通过中央排风口扩散的话，可以在4个小时之内害死一个中型空间站里所有的人。唯一值得欣慰的是，这种病毒会在12个小时之内自我毁灭。当然，这个时间足够害死一个普通空间站里所有的人了。

危难当前，你的任务就是运送这些电磁武器。它们经过改良，能发射短距脉冲，理论上可以烧焦射程内的所有纳米病毒。所以，你愿意马上将这些货物送往那座空间站吗？成千上万条人命就指望你了。

messages.en: We had placed all our hope in you completing this mission. It's too late now to find another pilot and another ship. I fear many thousands of lives may be lost due to what can only be your cowardice. Obviously, you are not a man of your word, and we won't forget that.
messages.zh: 我们对你倾注了全部的希望。现在再去找别人帮忙已经来不及了。由于你的懦夫行径，数以千计的生命即将逝去。你不配称为“人”，你的行为我们将永远不会淡忘。

messages.en: Pilot, there is simply no time to discuss this any further. Deliver the cargo to the station immediately, before that horrible weapon kills thousands of innocent men, women, and children.
messages.zh: 飞行员，没时间说更多了。在那种可怕的武器害死成千上万的无辜生命之前，尽快把货物送到空间站去。

messages.en: Thank you, pilot. You will be doing the Empire a great service in even such a brief undertaking as this.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，飞行员。此次任务虽然简短，但你却将为帝国帮一次大忙。

messages.en: The Imperial Navy recently made a final attempt to scour the battlefield graveyard of The Battle of Vak-Atioth. This battle pitted our brave Navy against the Jovian enemy; however, due to a number of unforeseeable factors, we did not emerge victorious. The graveyard itself has been picked over for decades by scavengers and others seeking some quick isk. The Amarr ships sent to perform this duty were attacked by pirates, and only one ship eventually returned. But when it did, it brought with it a valuable icon of Amarr military history: a selection of data chips holding recordings of a small part of that legendary battle. We need these chips delivered to a distant station for proper cleaning and processing.
messages.zh: 帝国海军最近进行了最后一次对“瓦克艾蒂斯大战”战场的打捞行动。那是一场帝国海军与朱庇特人之间的较量。但由于一系列无法预知的原因，我们未能获胜。那座战场上的遗迹几十年来一直遭到企图捞外快的拾荒者的光顾。被派去打捞的艾玛舰船遭到了海盗的攻击，最后只有一艘船返航。但那艘船却带回了一样对艾玛军事史具有至关重要价值的物品：一批记录着那场经典战役一小片段的数据芯片。我们需要有人将它们送到一座偏远的空间站，进行清洗与处理。

messages.en: You have made a significant contribution to the Empire, pilot. We cannot thank you enough. Of course, no record will be kept of your part in this episode, as we cannot be seen to have been even slightly concerned over the risk of attack and the potential loss of these chips. We will, however, fulfill our financial obligation, as outlined in the mission contract.
messages.zh: 飞行员，你为帝国做出了卓越贡献。我们对你感激不尽。当然，鉴于我们不想被人认为我们在危险面前怯场，不想让人看出我们担心失去这批芯片 ，因此在官方记录里我们不会提到你。但我们会遵守合同约定，付给你应得的报酬。

messages.en: I can understand your reluctance to undertake this mission, as we do not know who or what might be out there waiting to attack you in order to obtain these chips. This is a rare moment in that we bear you no malice for your fear.
messages.zh: 我理解你不愿意接受此次任务的心情，毕竟我们自己也不确定那儿会有谁或者什么东西，为了夺取这些芯片，守候着来袭击你。所以我们这次不会照例责怪你。

messages.en: Many decades ago, a large portion of the Imperial Grand Navy met the Jovians in combat at what today is referred to as The Battle of Vak-Atioth. It was our intention in opening that battle with the as-yet untested Jovians to destroy their fleet utterly, thus forcing their subjugation, as we had done with so many enemies in the past. Without going into great detail, the fearless Amarr fleet was utterly surprised by an enemy that possessed incredible destructive power and remarkably advanced battle tactics. This, coupled with the unforgivable impetuousness of our fleet's leadership, resulted in the near-total annihilation of our warships, at an estimated cost of only one-third of the Jovian armada. We were never again to take to the field of battle against that most dangerous and mysterious opponent. However, while some ships escaped, in less than six hours of battle we left behind a vast field of our dead and dying ships. Today, this system – known now only as Atioth – holds almost none of these battlefield remains, having long since been swept clean by Amarr salvagers and various scavengers. Nonetheless, this system remains an eternal reminder of the vigilance and bravery of our Grand Fleet and the sacrifices they are often called on to make in service of the Empire.
messages.zh: 几十年前，大批帝国海军与朱庇特人展开了如今被称为“瓦克艾蒂斯战役”的一场激战。我们原本的目的是要彻底摧毁当时尚未经受过任何考验的朱庇特舰队，就像我们过去对许多敌人的做法一样，逼迫他们屈从。但接下来……概要地说，无畏的艾玛舰队万般惊讶地发现，对方竟然具备不可思议的攻击力，并且掌握着高深莫测的战术。再加上我方舰队指挥不可饶恕的鲁莽行事，我们的战船最后被消灭得所剩无几，而对方的舰船估计也就损失了三分之一。之后我们就再也没能与那最危险最神秘的对手在战场上碰面。虽然最后有些船顺利逃脱，但在战斗开打后不到6小时的时间里，我们已经战损了相当多数量的舰船。如今在这一被改称为“艾蒂斯”的星系里，那些战场遗迹几近消失，基本上都被艾玛打捞队及各种拾荒者席卷走了。不过，只要一提到该星系，我们依然还是能想起我方舰队的英勇表现，追忆出他们为帝国所做出的牺牲。

messages.en: The Battle of Vak-Atioth
messages.zh: 瓦克艾蒂斯战役

messages.en:
As you almost certainly know, many decades ago our Grand Fleet met the hated Jovians on the field of battle in a system known as Vak-Atioth. Most unfortunately, our fleet was destroyed by the technologically superior Jovian ships and their advanced weaponry, marking one of the darkest moments in our history. Still, we learned much from this encounter, and the lessons learned there continue to benefit our military to this day, which brings us to why I called you here.

Several days ago, Imperial naval intelligence mounted a highly classified effort to revisit the Vak-Atioth system, now known simply as Atioth, to conduct a final intensive search for any remaining debris that might provide some insight into the tactics and weapons used by the Jovians. Needless to say, this once-massive floating graveyard has long since been picked over by not only our own salvage fleets, but by scavengers and opportunists alike. All has not been lost, however.

Much to our surprise, the Anathema covert ops ships sent to scan this system returned with a damaged but still readable supply of TIL-1A Nexus Chips. A preliminary review of the information they contain reveals only a portion of the great battle. We are hoping, however, that a more thorough analysis of these chips will reveal some insight into Jovian tactics and technology. If nothing else, they provide a very rare first-hand accounting of the battle which will add greatly to our historical archives and, when displayed at one of our leading military academies, will provide a stirring motivational icon for future generations of brave Imperial naval warriors.

Now that you understand the importance of these chips to the Empire, I must ask: will you transport this invaluable cargo to the designated station?
messages.zh:
想必你应该知道，几十年前我们的英勇舰队在被称为“瓦克艾蒂斯”的星系中与我们深恶痛绝的朱庇特人展开了一场激战。结果十分遗憾，对方运用技术上远胜我们一筹的舰船与武器将我方舰队击溃，书写了艾玛历史上最黑暗的篇章之一。不过我们还是从中吸取了诸多教训。这些教训让我们军团一直受益非浅。而这也正是我叫你来的原因。

几天前，帝国海军情报人员进行了重返瓦克艾蒂斯——现被称为“艾蒂斯”星系——的一次机密行动，目的是在这最后一次的清查行动中，找出任何有助于揭开朱庇特战术和武器秘密的残留物品。当然，这片曾经广袤的舰船坟场不仅被我们自己的打捞舰队光顾，它还吸引了其他拾荒者与机会主义者。但那儿并不是一无所有。

我们没有想到，前往该星系进行搜查的咒逐级隐秘侦察舰竟然带回了一批已损坏但还能被读取的TIL-1A关联芯片。我们初步看了一下其中记录的内容，里面只含有双方那场大战的一部分。但我们希望在对这些芯片进行更详尽的分析之后，我们能从中窥探得一些朱庇特技战术方面的深层次内容。即使最终一无所获，我们也至少获得了关于那场大战十分少有的第一手记载，这既能丰富我们的历史档案，也能于将来在重点军校展览时，对下一代英勇的帝国海军战士起到激发斗志的作用。

既然你已经明白了这些芯片对帝国的重要性，那我接下来的问题就是：你愿意将这个价值连城的货柜送到指定空间站吗？

messages.en: Well, pilot, I could have at least understood refusing this mission in the first place. At least that would have been somewhat understandable given the value nature of the threat. But to quit in mid-shipment is something we did not expect from you. We shall retrieve the chips and deliver them ourselves.
messages.zh: 飞行员，如果你一开始就拒接此项任务，那我还能理解。毕竟这事还是挺危险的。但你现在半途而废却是我们料不到的。我们会自己去取芯片然后亲自把它们送抵目的地。

messages.en: Please remain off this comms channel, pilot. While your voice is encrypted, the communication itself can be hacked. Contact us only after docking, or, of course in the event you are attacked.
messages.zh: 请不要在该频道里通话，飞行员。虽然你的声音被加密，但这些通讯本身还是能遭到黑客攻击的。请在你入站或者遭到攻击后再联系我们。

name.ru: Когти и клыки (Of Fangs and Claws)

messages.en: I had a feeling an easy job like this one might interest you. Good chance to flip on the autopilot and take a nap.  Just make sure the cages are secure and locked and your cargo bay doors are sealed.
messages.zh: 我之前就觉得这份简单的工作应该会让你感兴趣。你这次完全可以启用自动导航，然后打个盹儿。只要你确保笼子都放好锁紧了，并且你的货柜舱门也已经锁上了。

messages.en: Some decades ago, Amarr veterinary scientists achieved a milestone in genetic manipulation with the creation of hybrid slaver hounds. These new breeds are specifically designed to live and work in extreme climate conditions, which is a boon for all those slave labor facilities on ice planets and other harsh environments. Demand for these animals has been overwhelming and we are struggling to maintain our delivery schedule. I need a large shipment of these hybrid slaver hounds delivered to a nearby station. From there they will be transshipped to a desert planet and put to work as guard animals.
messages.zh: 几十年前，艾玛兽医学家成功地创造出了混血猎奴犬，它成为了基因改造的一个里程碑。这种猎奴犬专门被用来在极端气候条件下生活与工作，对于那些在冰体行星及其他恶劣环境中的劳工工地来说，这绝对是一个好消息。这种猎奴犬已经到了供不应求的地步，我们送货都已经送不过来了。我现在需要你将一大批这种猎奴犬送到附近的一座空间站。之后它们会被分批送往一颗沙漠行星，在那里用作看护犬。

messages.en: See? I told you this one was a no-brainer.  I would suggest, though, remaining in your ship until the hounds have been safely offloaded. I wouldn't want to be hanging around your cargo bay if one of them got loose, as the sedatives will have worn off by now.
messages.zh: 看到没有？我早就跟你说过，这是件不用动脑子的事情。但你最好还是等猎奴犬都被安全卸下之后再离船，因为现在他们体内的镇静剂应该已经失效了。

messages.en: I really am surprised that you're declining this one. It was a good chance to make some quick ISK with very little risk. Well, no bother. There is no shortage of pilots looking for an easy trip.
messages.zh: 你拒绝这任务让我深感意外。这原本是个低风险捞外快的好机会。算了，无所谓。反正很多人都会抢着干这种简单跑腿的活儿。

messages.en:
Amarr slavers on Syrikos V first learned to breed and train slaver hounds to provide an extra layer of low-cost security for their slave labor operations. These animals soon proved their worth, particularly as a last line of defense for any slave that managed to bypass a facility's security controls and escape into the whatever wilderness lay beyond the facility's walls. So keen are the senses of these animals, and so lethal their attacks, that most slaves will give up any hope of escape before even making the attempt. One problem that arose, however, was that many slave labor operations were located in some of the harshest imaginable environments, often so harsh that they were unsuitable for your average slaver hound.

So, it was with tremendous satisfaction that Amarr veterinary scientists reported recently that they had managed to create stable, obedient hybrids of the breed, each type adapted for a different geographic or atmospheric condition. Thus, if you are a slave owner on an ice planet, for example, you can now purchase slaver hounds with thicker pelts, greater body fat, and higher overall tolerance to cold and freezing wind. These new hybrids have proven remarkably adaptable, and have long since spread to slave labor facilities throughout the Empire.
messages.zh:
希尔库索行星V上的艾玛劳工主们最先学会了饲养和训练猎奴犬，他们将这种动物当作低成本的辅助保安去监管他们的劳工。这种动物很快证明了它们的价值，尤其是在面对任何躲过了安保装置、逃入荒野的劳工时，它们更被证明是最后一道防线。由于它们的知觉异常敏锐，攻击力十分致命，多数劳工基本上都会打消逃跑的念头。但有一个问题：许多劳工们都在最艰苦的环境下工作，而一般的猎奴犬都适应不了那些环境。

所以，当艾玛兽医学家最近报告说他们已经能培育出一批稳定听话、能适应不同地理或气候环境的猎奴犬时，大家都很高兴。这样一来，如果你是一个冰体行星上的劳工主，那你就能买到毛皮很厚、脂肪很多并且对严寒风潮有强忍受力的猎奴犬。实践证明，这种混血猎奴犬适应力极强，早已遍布帝国内的各个劳工工地。

messages.en: The Origins of Hybrid Slaver Hounds
messages.zh: 混血猎奴犬的起源

messages.en:
I'm not sure how much you know about Amarr slave labor installations, such as mines, agricultural harvesting fields, moon mineral extraction zones, and the like. Well, I can tell you that these facilities are often of such size and complexity that they cannot always be wholly secured against slave escape attempts. Certainly, all but the most primitive and poorly administrated of these locations feature any and all manner of perimeter alarms, security cameras, remote sentry drones, microwave motion detectors, infrared barrier fences, you name it. As you can imagine, though, this can get quite expensive given not only the capital outlay for the equipment, but for the manpower needed to operate and maintain them year-round, 24 hours a day.

It was during this search for lower cost alternatives to these technologies that the animals we call slaver hounds were introduced to the overall security plans of select slave labor facilities, used to detect, track, and interdict runaway slaves. Their acutely tuned senses coupled with their remarkable natural endurance and speed made them an ideal choice for many Amarr slave operations. However, it was not long before it was realized that the standard, purebred slaver hound was not suitable for all environments. This resulted in the creation of genetically modified breeds more at home in harsher environments such as swamps, frozen wastelands, jungles, and the like. Today, these more adaptable variants can be found on many such installations throughout the Empire, despite their comparatively high cost when compared to your usual slaver hounds.

This brings us to the reason I contacted you. I need a large shipment of these hybrid slaver hounds delivered to a nearby station for transshipment to an Amarr desert planet. As long as the hounds remain sedated and don't find their way out of their cages, this should be a simple, trouble-free courier job.
messages.zh:
对于矿场、农田及卫星开采区之类的艾玛劳工工地，我不知道你了解多少。但我可以告诉你，那些地方都非常辽阔及复杂，想要完全防止劳工逃跑，一般都是不可能的。当然，除了那些最原始、管理最差的工地之外，其他所有该类场所都配备了外围报警器、监控摄像头、远程岗哨无人机、微波运动探测器及红外线栅栏等你能想到的所有保安装置。但你应该也能想到，这些东西不仅代价高，而且还需要有人一年到头、全天候地去操控维护它们。

正是在寻求替代这些技术的低成本方案的过程中，我们引入了一种被称作猎奴犬的动物。在一批选定的劳工工地的总体安保计划中，它们被用来侦测、跟踪及拦截逃亡的劳工。凭着敏锐的感觉和与生俱来的超强耐力与速度，它们成了众多艾玛劳工工地上理想的安保力量。但没多久，我们就发现标准的纯种猎奴犬无法适应所有的环境。因此我们就利用这里的自然条件，在沼泽、冰冻荒地及丛林之类的恶劣环境下创造出了基因改良品种。如今在帝国境内，虽然这种适应性更强的猎奴犬相对纯种犬而言更贵，但许多劳工工地还是用上了它们。

现在我就和你谈谈为什么要你来的原因。我这里有一大批混血猎奴犬需要被运往附近一座空间站，然后它们会被分批送往艾玛的一颗沙漠行星上。只要这些家伙身体内的镇静剂不失效，没有逃出笼子，那这份运输任务就应该是小菜一碟。

messages.en: You're quitting this mission? You should know that quitting a mission as simple as this one does not look good on a pilot's record.
messages.zh: 你要退出这项任务？告诉你，退出如此简单的任务会给你的飞行员记录抹黑的。

messages.en: Good to know the hounds haven't caused you any trouble. Please contact me when you reach the station. Offloading has already been arranged.
messages.zh: 那些猎奴犬还没有给你带来任何麻烦，很好。等你到了空间站后再联系我吧。卸载工作已经安排好了。

name.ja: ローグドローンの中心
name.ru: Сердце восставшего дрона (Heart of the Rogue Drone)

messages.en: Good to hear, {[character]player.name}! I can't wait to see what we've got.
messages.zh: 真是好消息，{[character]player.name}！我迫不及待想看到我们的成果。

messages.en: While examining wrecked rogue drones following a failed attack, strange minerals were found which replaced some of the drones' usual systems. The compounds seem to run more efficiently than the parts they replaced, and your agent has hired you to take the find to researchers for examination.
messages.zh: 在查看一些因进攻失败而被摧毁的自由无人机时，人们发现有几种奇特的矿物替换了那些无人机通常包含的系统。这些奇特化合物在运作时，貌似比替换掉的部件更有效率。你的代理人委托你将此发现转交给研究者做进一步检查。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. We're one step closer to the forefront of technological advancement!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。我们又向技术发展前沿迈进了一大步！

messages.en: Sad, {[character]player.name}. I thought I could trust you for this.
messages.zh: 真令我难过，{[character]player.name}。我本以为这件事可以指望你。

messages.en: Once part of a Gallente scientist's experiments in self-controlled drone technology, rogue drones can now be found throughout the cluster, having escaped and begun to replicate themselves. In certain undeveloped parts of null-security space they thrive and expand their numbers from hives hidden deep within deadspace pockets and asteroid fields. These regions are called ‘drone regions', and the only people brave enough and confident enough to attempt to build out there are the capsuleers.
messages.zh: 自由无人机原本是盖伦特科学家进行的自控无人机实验的一部分，后来它们逃离实验设施并且开始自我复制，现在它们遍布整个星群。依靠位于死亡空间层和小行星带深处的各个母巢，它们在某些未开发的零安全区域茁壮成长并大肆扩张。那些区域被称为“无人机星域”，只有克隆飞行员才有勇气和信心在那里经营。

messages.en: Drones On Their Own
messages.zh: 独立的无人机

messages.en:
Yes, I think I have some work for you.

One of our research outposts in Molden Heath came under attack by rogue drones last week. This is highly unusual, since drones are rarely seen beyond Etherium Reach. The outpost's defense systems managed to keep our scientists safe, and the downed drones were retrieved for examination. They found unusual mineral deposits replacing the drones' original microboard networks, which appear to work far more efficiently.

Of course we don't want anyone else getting ahold of the samples before we can replicate them. The samples have been in transit via a series of drops in order to keep them safe. Take them on to the labs at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh:
没错，我猜我这里有件工作适合你。

上星期，我们在摩登赫斯的一座研究哨站遭受了自由无人机的攻击。这次攻击很不寻常，因为那些无人机很少在琉蓝之穹以外活动。该哨站的防御系统勉强维持了科学家们的安全，阵亡的无人机在事后被回收进行检查。他们发现：某几种罕见的矿物沉积取代了那些无人机原来的微基板网络，而这种新构造的工作效率要高很多。

当然，在我们能复制这些样本之前，不能让其他人掌握它们。为了保证安全，样本被分成一系列小块后进行运输。把它们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的实验室。

messages.en: Sad, {[character]player.name}. I thought I could trust you for this.
messages.zh: 真令我难过，{[character]player.name}。我本以为这件事可以指望你。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, have you done what I asked?
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，事情办得怎么样？

messages.en: Just make sure to tell him how sorry I am, okay?
messages.zh: 一定要向他表达我的歉意，明白了吗？

messages.en: I accidentally sent a client the wrong set of drones because they never specified what type he needed. Take the right cargo to him. Hopefully he won't ask too many questions.
messages.zh: 我不小心给客户发错了无人机，他们从来就没指明过他们要哪种嘛。你要把这些正确的机型送到他那里去。希望他别有太多问题。

messages.en: Excellent. I've been trying to get those old things off my hands for months.
messages.zh: 非常好。  我一直都想把这些旧东西处理掉。

messages.en: Fine. I can always find someone else.
messages.zh: 算了， 我找别人帮忙好了。

messages.en:
After the successes of the first drones in the first Caldari-Gallente war, every empire set out to design a combat drone that suited their particular combat needs, though the small, pilotless tools clearly suited some empires' needs more than others. The Gallente company, CreoDron, has flourished, while the Carthum Conglomerate in Amarr maintains drone production more as a counter to their rival, Khanid Innovation, which stresses a reliance on rocket technology. Minmatar-based Boundless Creation has profited easily from drone production, but not enough to justify a specialized branch of operations; similarly, Ishukone in the Caldari State produces drones simply because demand exists rather than a desire to encourage a reliance upon them.

Like any other drone, a mining drone is simply an extension of a pilot's control. Unlike combat drones, mining drones have no offensive or defensive capabilities. Wastage factors for individual drones can be quite high, but the speed and convenience of having several extra mining lasers at the pilot's disposal outweighs the mineral loss.
messages.zh:
在第一次加达里-盖伦特战争中，无人机首次投入实战并立下了赫赫战功。在那之后，所有的帝国都开始进行这种小型无人驾驶兵器的研发以满足战争需求——尽管它其实只适用于某些国家。盖伦特联邦的西顿工业由此迅猛发展，与此同时，艾玛帝国的天主凝聚会将无人机生产更多地看做是对他们的对手——致力于火箭技术的卡尼迪创新集团的一种反击。米玛塔尔所属的无限创造集团从无人机生产中获益颇丰，但其还不足以成为公司新的业务支柱。同样，加达里联邦的异株湖集团则是因为客观的市场需求而进行无人机生产，并没有将其推广至整个宇宙的雄心。

像其它种类的无人机一样，采矿无人机只是简单地作为飞行员操作的一种延伸。其与战斗无人机不同，并不具有攻击或防御的能力。无人机采矿的损耗颇高，但是它高速、便捷、还可以根据飞行员的意愿加装多个采矿激光器，远比矿物上的损失来的划算。

messages.en: Pilots' Little Helpers
messages.zh: 飞行员的小助手

messages.en: One of my clients asked me to send over drones to replace the ones his company's been losing in the line of work. That's all he said. He never said anything about needing mining drones; of course I sent him a set of scout drones, and he was very upset at me for not being able to read his mind. People should be more specific about things. Take these mining drones over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for him, and if he asks why the paint looks new, tell him they're fresh off the production line.
messages.zh: 我的一个客户要我给他送一批无人机去，以替换那些工作中损耗掉的。他就告诉了我这些，从来没说过需要的是采矿无人机，我当然给他送了侦察无人机，他对我很不满，觉得我无法猜透他的心思。我觉得是他自己没把话说清楚。把这些采矿无人机送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，如果他问起为什么涂装看起来这么新，就告诉他这些是刚下生产线的。

messages.en: I am very disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你非常失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you finished your work for me, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你干完活了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Thanks a lot, {[character]player.name}. I knew we could count on you.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。我就知道我们能依靠你。

messages.en: Our spies have succeeded in smuggling pieces of the latest experimental Amarrian starship technology back to the Republic. I need you to take the samples on to the lab where they can be properly analyzed.
messages.zh: 我们的间谍成功地把一些艾玛人最新试验的星舰技术偷运回了共和国。我需要你把这些样本送到实验室，以进行适当的分析。

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}. Our research team is saying the tech deflects target painter beams away towards an area of space just behind the ship it's fitted on. Our torpedoes will start missing targets if they manage to make this widely available. We need to find a way to counter this, and fast.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。我们的研究团队指出，这种技术能够把目标标记光束反射到使用标记装备的舰船后方区域。如果他们广泛应用此技术，我们的鱼雷就会丢失目标。我们要尽快找到对抗此技术的方法。

messages.en: I guess your loyalty isn't worth as much as I thought.
messages.zh: 看来你的忠诚度没有我想象的那样高。

messages.en: The Minmatar Republic's reliance on speed for the majority of its fleet comes at a cost: up close, high transversal speed reduces the chance to hit the target, while fighting at distance brings fleet ships to the edge of their falloff range. The more mass a target has, the less difficult it is to react and hit. Target painters were eventually developed for the Republic's electronic warfare division, low-yield lasers which increase the mass profile of a target and reduce the negative effects of fighters moving at high velocity.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔共和国的大部分舰队都依赖于高速度的舰船，而这种依赖是有代价的：在近距离上，高速横向运动会降低命中目标的机会；而在远距离上，高速舰船又面临超出失准射程的可能。目标的质量越大，就越容易被反击和命中。目标标记装置最终被开发出来，并装备于共和国的电子战部队。该装备实质上属于一种低功率激光器，可以增加目标的质量特征，并减少攻击者的高速度带来的负面影响。

messages.en: Weapon of Choice
messages.zh: 首选武器

messages.en:
You need to keep this quiet, {[character]player.name}. I know you capsuleers aren't accustomed to being told how to do your job, but this is bigger than anything else and if word gets out, all this effort will be for nothing.

We've acquired samples of the Amarr's latest experimental starship tech. Don't ask me how, I don't want to know, and neither do you. We're not sure what these pieces do; our source is suggesting it's a system that reduces the effectiveness of our electronic warfare systems. This could be bad news for us. Get the stuff over to the lab at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. And keep your trap shut. We don't want it getting back to the Amarr that we have this.
messages.zh:
你得为此事保密，{[character]player.name}。我明白你们克隆飞行员不喜欢让别人指手画脚，但这一次事关重大。如果走漏风声，我们就会前功尽弃。

我们获取了艾玛人最新试验星舰技术的一些样本。别问我是怎么得到的，我不想知道，你最好也别知道。我们还不确定这些技术样本有什么功能；有情报暗示说，它们可以削弱电子战装备。对我们来说，这可不是好消息。把货送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的实验室去。记住，行动要保密。我们可不想让艾玛人知道我们获得了这些东西。

messages.en: I guess your loyalty isn't worth as much as I thought.
messages.zh: 看来你的忠诚度没有我想象的那样高。

messages.en: Have you delivered that stuff to the lab, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把货送到实验室了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Good to hear, {[character]player.name}! Don't actually vent the ship, though. We need these guys.
messages.zh: 真是好消息，{[character]player.name}！不过也不要真的弄个船毁人亡什么的，我们需要这些家伙。

messages.en: Planetary officials have asked me to bring in a team of mercenaries they've hired to deal with a terrorist threat. Your job is to keep them in line en route.
messages.zh: 行星长官雇佣了一队佣兵以应对恐怖威胁，你的任务就是把他们送往目的地。

messages.en: Excellent, {[character]player.name}! I'll let the local government know their solution is on its way.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}！我会告知地方政府他们的对策正在被施行。

messages.en: Sad. Now I'll have to find someone else. You were the best option, too.
messages.zh: 很遗憾，现在我得去找别人了。你曾是我们的第一选择。

messages.en: Mercenaries often get a bad reputation from the few who go nuts while on assignment, cause unacceptable collateral damage and demand higher pay for the effort involved in discretion. The majority are reasonable businessmen, primarily ex-military, who take their work seriously and simply demand respect for the risks they take.
messages.zh: 佣兵的名声都是被一小撮败类给败坏了的，这些人总是不好好干活，经常给委托人造成难以接受的损失，而当雇主要求他们小心点的时候，他们又狮子大开口地要价。不过，大多数佣兵还是讲道理的，尤其是那些退伍军人，他们干活认真，要价也很合理。

messages.en: It's Only Business
messages.zh: 生意而已

messages.en: We have a planetary situation we need your help with. A group of pro-Amarr terrorists is wreaking havoc in outlying provinces, and the local government's hired a group of mercenaries to deal with them. You know mercs, I'm sure; they never really listen to anyone they think is softer than they are. We're having trouble finding an ordinary captain who's willing to ferry the guys over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for transit planetside. I think they'll be more likely to behave if the captain is someone who can and will follow through on a threat to vent the ship to vacuum. Someone like you, in other words. Can we count on you to keep the unruly lot in line?
messages.zh: 我们有件事需要你帮忙。一撮支持艾玛的恐怖分子正在一些边远省份大肆制造破坏，地方政府雇佣了一批佣兵来对付他们。你知道佣兵那些家伙，我敢肯定，他们绝对不会听从他们眼中的“弱者”的话的。我们很难找到一位愿意把他们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去的普通船长。不过我觉得如果这个船长随时都敢来个船毁人亡的话，他们应该会听话一点的。换句话讲，就是像你一样的船长。那么，你愿意接下这个棘手的任务吗？

messages.en: Sad. Now I'll have to find someone else. You were the best option, too.
messages.zh: 很遗憾，现在我得去找别人了。你曾是我们的第一选择。

messages.en: Those mercs aren't giving you too much trouble, I hope.
messages.zh: 我希望那些佣兵没给你找麻烦吧。

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}. It's not a glamorous job but someone's gotta do it.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。这不是什么体面的工作，但总得有人去做啊。

messages.en: Our salvagers have built up a load of industrial-quality scrap metal to be used in ship building. I need you to take it to the reclamation facility so we can recover the useable parts.
messages.zh: 我们的打捞人员找到了一些高品质的废金属，可以用来建造舰船。我们需要你将这些金属送到再生工厂去，这样我们就可以回收有用的部分。

messages.en: Good! You've been a big help, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 很好！你帮了我们大忙，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I am very disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你非常失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: In the early days of space travel, after so long under the yoke of Amarr, the Minmatar were required to make do with what little they could find, with limited facilities and funding. The ability to create space-worthy ships from the most unlikely of materials became legendary. In the present-day Republic, scarcity is no longer a problem, but materials are still stretched as far as engineers can make them go for the sake of pride in their efficiency.
messages.zh: 在星际航行的初期，米玛塔尔人摆脱了艾玛人多年的奴役后，以极其有限的设施及资金白手起家。他们将最没用的材料转化为星际舰船的能力在当时被视为传奇。如今的米玛塔尔，资源已不再缺乏，但是他们的工程师仍然尝试发挥材料的最大效能，并以此为傲。

messages.en: Reclamation and Improvisation
messages.zh: 回收与再生

messages.en:
Okay, here's one for you. Don't look at me like that. Yes, it's a load of metal scraps we need taken to a reclamation facility at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Contrary to popular belief, our ships are not made solely of scrap-metal, utility adhesive and chewing gum, but we do recycle extensively.

The reason I'm asking you to do this rather than hiring a much cheaper regular captain is that these bits are industrial quality, or they will be once they've been processed. They're worth a lot of cred on the black market – peanuts to you capsuleers, but a year's wages to anyone else.
messages.zh:
有些活要你做。别那么看着我，没错，这是一堆金属废料，我们要你把它们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的再生工厂去。我们的船不像大家想象的那样只是用废金属，胶水和口香糖做出来的，不过我们确实使用了大量的再生技术。

我不去雇一个超便宜的普通飞行员而来找你的原因是，这些东西质量很好。它们在黑市上值大价钱——可能对于你这样的克隆飞行员不算什么，对普通人来讲却抵得上一年的薪水。

messages.en: Sad, {[character]player.name}. I had hoped you were the reliable sort.
messages.zh: 真遗憾，{[character]player.name}。我还以为你是那种可以信赖的人。

messages.en: Have you finished your work for me, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你干完活了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}. If anyone asks where those came from, the manifest will show their usual station.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。如果有人问这些货是哪来的，就给他们看舱单。

messages.en: A Nefantar House is relocating to a planet within the Republic, and we've had a tip-off that they're working against us for someone in the Empire. We've planted surveillance nanobots in a shipment of materials for their planetside home; take it over to the depot. The logs will show nothing amiss.
messages.zh: 一个内凡达家族正迁徙往共和国内的某个星球，我们得到了情报，他们在为帝国的某些人卖命，意图与我们为敌。我们在他们的一批建筑材料中放置了监视纳米机器人，你的任务就是将它们送到仓库。从航行日志是看不出什么异样的。

messages.en: Thanks to your assistance, {[character]player.name}, we've been able to record some rather incriminating communications from these people already. They wasted no time in contacting their associates in the Empire to let them know they were settled in.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。我们已经能够记录到他们的一些犯罪证据了。他们很快就把他们迁居的消息报告给了帝国的联系人。

messages.en: I am disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
The day Drupar Maak struck down Arkon Ardishapur on Starkman Prime with the Heir's own sceptre began the darkest night for his people. In retribution for the death of his father and their attempted rebellion, Idonis Ardishapur ordered the annihilation of the Starkmanir tribe.

At the same time, the Nefantar tribe approached the Empire with an offer, making a bargain for mercy in exchange for assisting in the subjugation of the Minmatar. The tribe took on many aspects of the Empire, including open practise of their faith and owning Minmatar slaves, themselves. Despite the recent revelation that their conversion helped to protect the last Starkmanir to survive the purge, many within the Republic are hesitant to forgive the Nefantar for their actions.
messages.zh:
杜帕·马克在斯塔克曼首星行刺阿康·阿狄莎波的那一天，是他的人民悲惨命运的开始。为了控制叛乱并为父王复仇，伊多尼斯·阿狄莎波下令消灭斯塔克曼一族。

与此同时，内凡达一族与帝国达成协议，以协助控制米玛塔尔来换取宽恕。这个种族表现出来了很多帝国的特质，比如公开信仰艾玛宗教以及拥有米玛塔尔劳工——其实他们自己也是米玛塔尔人。尽管最近有消息披露，他们当初亲近艾玛的这一行为在一定程度上帮助斯塔克曼人逃过了灭顶之灾，但是共和国的许多人仍然不愿意原谅他们的所作所为。

messages.en: Strained Relations
messages.zh: 紧张的关系

messages.en:
I hope I can trust you to be discreet, {[character]player.name}.

As part of a goodwill gesture to the Nefantar tribe, the Republic has offered allotments of planetary territory within our space on which to build embassies or summer homes or whatever else they need land for. I don't care what it is, I don't trust ‘em, but the government is determined to make sure we all get along.

Yesterday I got an alert from one of my colleagues; it seems one Nefantar house is in collusion with elements from the Empire. Obviously we can't just point fingers without evidence, but I'm in a perfect position to obtain that. The contractor they hired to design and build a house on their new property is a friend of mine. He's given us one shipment of interior facing materials to seed with nanite spyware. Take the load to the depot at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; I know I can trust you to keep quiet about the additions to the cargo.
messages.zh:
我希望我们没看错人，{[character]player.name}。

为了对内凡达一族表示善意，共和国在我们的领域内为他们提供了一块星际领地，他们可以在那里建立大使馆、度假村或是别的什么设施。我不在乎他们建什么东西，反正我不信任他们，但是政府决定要与他们和平共处。

昨天我从一位同事那里收到警告，某个内凡达家族似乎正与帝国相互勾结。很显然我们不能空口无凭地去指证他们，不过我有办法得到证据。受雇给他们造新房子的承包商是我的一个朋友，他给了我们一个机会，可在一批建筑材料中放置纳米级间谍设备。现在，把这船货送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，我知道你值得信任，而且你会保守秘密的。

messages.en: I'm beginning to question your loyalty, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我开始怀疑你的忠诚了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you delivered your cargo for me, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把货送过去了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: One of our planetside subsidiaries has recently lost a lot of farming equipment to a storm. I need you to take these parts to the assembly plant so we can recoup our losses.
messages.zh: 我们的一家子公司最近在一场风暴中损失了大量的农用机械。我需要你将这些零件送往装配工厂，这样我们还可以弥补损失。

messages.en: Thank you for your help, {[character]player.name}. Our subsidiary has managed to save more than they first thought of the initial crops and they're good to go for the second growing season.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。我们的子公司成功地抢收了比预想中更多的作物，而且他们有足够的能力应付接下来的第二个种植期了。

messages.en: I am greatly disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你非常失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Recent decades have seen a resurgence in attempts to control planetary weather patterns on a full global scale, particularly on technologically advanced agricultural worlds. Ensuring a regular cycle of rain and sun enables farmers to plant crops throughout the year with a smaller margin for error.

Despite the advances, the most that can be claimed is weather ‘guidance'. The one successfully controlled year on Aforat in the Mishi system was followed by two years of raging, uncontrollable storms which flattened fields with hail and flooded river valleys. The blame was laid on aggressive methods exercised by the corporation in charge of the project; reactors placed within existing ocean currents prevented seawater from cooling regularly in the colder months, disrupting the planetary climate entirely.
messages.zh:
近年来，人们再次尝试控制整个星球的天气变化，尤其是那些农业技术发达的地区。通过规律性地控制降水及日照，农夫们可以更科学的安排全年的作物种植计划。

除了这些好处以外，这个项目最受争议的地方就是它对气候的“引导性”。米什星系的阿弗拉特星球曾经非常成功地控制了一整年的天气，但之后的两年里，无法控制的风暴带来了冰雹及洪水，将那里夷为了平地。负责这个项目的军团的激进做法备受指责，他们在洋流中放置的反应器会影响到海水在寒冷季节里的常规性冷却，从而使整个星球的气候陷入混乱。

messages.en: Acts of God
messages.zh: 天公不作美

messages.en: One of our subsidiaries has recently suffered a major setback, {[character]player.name}. A hurricane wiped out half their planetside crops and wrecked the equipment. Most of it was already falling apart, the storm just finished it off. Obviously, this is a big problem for them, and us, but it's still the early part of the first growing season. Deliver these parts to the assembly plant at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so we can replace the equipment before they lose too much from this harvest.
messages.zh: 最近，我们的一家子公司遭受了重大的打击，{[character]player.name}。飓风席卷而过，毁掉了他们半数的农作物，绝大多数的农业设备也被风暴撕成了碎片。很明显，这对他们、对我们都是很严重的问题，好在作物种植的第一季才刚开始。你要把这些零件送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的装配工厂去，这样我们就可以更换掉损坏的机械，以免遭到更大的损失。

messages.en: I am greatly disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你非常失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you delivered those parts yet, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把那些零件送到了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}. I knew I could count on you.
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]player.name}。我知道你靠得住。

messages.en: Against my better judgment, I've been asked to order several sets of educational packages of the Amarr Scriptures for the children of families who have been released by the Empire. It leaves a sour taste in the mouth, but maybe we can use the teaching materials to our own ends.
messages.zh: 上级要求我为那些从艾玛帝国中释放出来的家庭中的孩子订购数卷艾玛经文书籍，我心底里万分不愿意。这让我觉得很恶心，但也许，我们也能够好好利用这点。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. I know it's an unsavory business, but our instructions from on high are to try to get along and help these people adjust.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。我知道这不是什么光彩的事，但上级的命令就是要我们帮助这些人去适应。

messages.en: I'm very disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我感到很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: With the release of several generations of slaves from the Empire, Jamyl struck a blow at the heart of Minmatar culture, forcing the Republic to accept those who have known only the ways of Amarr and what little Minmatar tradition they had been able to maintain through the years. Inducting such people into modern Republic society has proven troublesome and at times outright frustrating; allowing released slaves to practice the religion they grew up with has been a bitter necessity as counselors struggle to help the people adapt to their new lives.
messages.zh: 艾玛女皇贾米尔从帝国释放了好几代劳工，但是这一行为反而对米玛塔尔文化给予了一次很大打击。米玛塔尔被迫接受那些在好几年的时间里都只记得艾玛传统，而对米玛塔尔本身却知之甚少的人。实践表明，要将这批人融入米玛塔尔社会并不容易，有时候甚至让人很火大。允许被释放的劳工们信仰伴随他们长大的宗教是米玛塔尔不得不咽下的苦果，与此同时，心理诱导师还要举步艰难地帮助那些人适应新的环境。

messages.en: Necessary Concessions
messages.zh: 必要的让步

messages.en:
I'm in a bit of an awkward position here, {[character]player.name}. With all the people being released from slavery in the Empire, we're getting more and more families who practice the Amarr religion. No thanks to Jamyl, she knew this would happen. The edict from our government is that we need to respect the poor deluded people and gently introduce them to a new way of thinking. It won't be easy, and it's putting a strain on all of us.

My problem right now is that a bunch of the refugee families have requested that some Amarr Scriptures be included in the course structure at the schools we've set up for their children. It's our own people doing the teaching, so we can slowly steer the education in the right direction, but we all still feel dirty for having to use it.

Do you think you'd be willing to take a shipment of books over to one of the schools?
messages.zh:
我现在处境有点尴尬，{[character]player.name}。随着从艾玛帝国中释放出来的同胞们的增多，我们国家里信仰艾玛宗教的家庭也越来越多。我们没必要对艾玛女皇说谢谢，她早就知道事情会这样。我们政府的官方态度是，尊重这些被误导的同胞，同时循序渐进将他们引上正路。这做起来并不容易，我们压力都很大。

我现在的问题是，一些从艾玛那儿解放出来的家庭要求将一些艾玛经文纳入我们为其子女设置的课程之中。老师肯定还是我们自己人，所以我们可以慢慢将那些孩子引上正道。不过，我们还是对此感到很不爽。

你愿意将一批书送往我们其中一座学校吗？

messages.en: I'm very disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我感到很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you delivered those books, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把那些书送抵目的地了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}'s R&D branch has been working on a more efficient version of Carbon-86 epoxy resin. I need you to take the latest batch to the testing facility.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的研发部门正在研制一种更高效的碳86环氧树脂。我需要你把最新一批装置送到测试设施。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. The testers have already submitted a preliminary report; looks like the formula needs some work. They say it's not enough of an improvement on the current industry standard to be worth producing on a large scale. One member of the team has suggested an application involving crystalline fullerides and dropping C86 entirely; it'll have to go up for review.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。测试员们已经提交了一份初步报告，看起来配方还需要加以修改。他们说，以如今的工业标准来衡量，这样的改进还不值得投入大规模生产。其中一位成员建议我们加入晶体碳化物并去掉所有的碳86，我们会认真研究的。

messages.en: I am most disappointed.
messages.zh: 我对你非常失望。

messages.en: Smaller ships rely upon their speed and smaller signature radius to make it difficult for larger ships to track and target them. The heat output from propulsion systems increases signature radius, making a small target much easier to track; the greater the speed, the greater the heat production. Specialized coatings help to reduce the effect and prevent expansion of the parts within propulsion systems, helping them to operate much more efficiently.
messages.zh: 小型舰船依靠它们的高速度和低信号半径来对抗大型舰船的跟踪及锁定。推进系统排出的热量会增加船只的信号半径，并使得小型目标更容易被跟踪；速度越高，热量释放越多。特制的涂层可以帮助减轻这种效应，并且能够防止推进系统中的部件膨胀，从而促使它们更高效地运转。

messages.en: Speed-Tanking
messages.zh: 速度抗

messages.en:
As you probably know all too well, speed is the lifeblood of the Republic's defense fleets, particularly for the smaller frigates and cruisers. There's a lot that goes into it: low-density reactor cores, kinesthetic maneuvering thrusters, hyper-responsive gyroscopic stabilizers. All the housings are built using nano-alloy rather than the more heavyweight materials the other empires use; it was simply more convenient back when the ships were first designed, but it gives them that little bit of extra boost that's become our signature.

Our R&D specialists have been working on a new formula for the C-86 thermal epoxy resin used on engine housings and other parts of the propulsion systems; I want you to take this batch over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for application and field testing.
messages.zh:
你应该很清楚，共和国的防卫舰队是靠速度吃饭的，尤其是护卫舰和巡洋舰。我们采用了多项技术，如低密度反应核心、动量感知机动推进器以及极速响应陀螺稳定器等。所有的船体都使用纳米合金来制造，而不是其他帝国使用的重型材料；最初这样设计纯粹是因为图省事，但纳米材料所带来的速度上的提升后来成为了我们的招牌。

我们的科研专家们一直致力于研制一种新型的碳86环氧树脂，它可以应用于引擎外壳或是其它的推进系统部件上面。我需要你将这些样品送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去进行实地测试。

messages.en: Disappointing, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你真让人失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I haven't received confirmation of your delivery yet, {[character]player.name}. Is there a problem?
messages.zh: 我还没有收到货物签收回执，{[character]player.name}。你碰到了什么问题吗？

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. Please hurry.
messages.zh: 谢了，{[character]player.name}。请快点。

messages.en: I have to request a difficult task of you: play nice with a swarm of Angel Cartel representatives and their entourage on your ship. Hopefully they won't try to cause you trouble.
messages.zh: 我想请你办一件有难度的事：礼貌地招待一帮天使联合企业的代表，并把他们接过来。他们应该不会给你找麻烦。

messages.en: Excellent, thank you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 干得好，谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I'm disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}, but I can understand why you might decline.
messages.zh: 你真让我失望，{[character]player.name}，不过我能理解为什么你拒绝这件事。

messages.en: The Angel Cartel's reputation for engaging in any activity regardless of its legality has earned it the DED's description of the most dangerous criminal organization in the cluster. With a corporate command structure and open recruitment policy, the Cartel are less thugs than sharks in pinstripe suits, capable of operating on all levels of society. With a major operational base in Etherium Reach on the edge of Minmatar space, the Cartel is held with deep suspicion within the Republic. Their annexation of the Skarkon system in YC 110 and sudden withdrawal left many unanswered questions regarding both the Cartel's intentions towards the Republic and what deals were forged under the table to make them leave... and what those deals might have cost.
messages.zh: 天使联合企业因为从事各类非法勾当而恶名远播，并且被DED描述为宇宙中最危险的犯罪组织。它以公司机制运作并且公开招聘成员，旗下人员们外表衣冠楚楚，在社会各个层面上都很吃得开。联合企业的主要运作基地位于琉蓝之穹，邻近米玛塔尔空域，因此共和国对他们疑心很重。新伊甸纪元110年，联合企业吞并了斯卡尔克恩星系，但随后又突然撤出该星系。这一举动引发了很多怀疑，例如，联合企业对共和国的企图，促成前者撤离的幕后交易内容…以及后者为了该交易所付出的代价。

messages.en: Borderland Outlaws
messages.zh: 边境歹徒

messages.en:
This is a list of people I want you to escort to a meeting. They have quite a large security entourage, and as you can see from some of the names, they have a reason for it. These people are members of the Angel Cartel. While the Cartel are thugs and pirate scum, and are not particularly welcome in Minmatar space, it does not mean that some corporations don't have certain dealings with them which require us to overlook certain... failings.

Escort them safely to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for me. It's nothing you'll be in trouble with the Republic for, but for the sake of our business relations, try to treat them politely.
messages.zh:
我需要你护送这份名单上的人去参加一个会议。这些人会有很多保安随行，而从名单上的名字你就可以看出，如此小心是有原因的。他们正是天使联合企业的成员。虽说米玛塔尔境内并不欢迎这些海盗、暴徒和人渣，然而总有一些军团还和他们有特定的业务往来，所以，我们不得不对有些事睁一只眼闭一只眼。

把他们安全地送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去。虽然共和国并不在意，但是为了我们的商业伙伴关系，你还是尽量对他们友善点吧。

messages.en: I'm extremely disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你太让我失望了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Hello, {[character]player.name}. Have you finished your work for me?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]player.name}。我托付你的事情办好了吗？

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}, I knew we could count on you.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。我知道你最可靠了。

messages.en: A pair of civilians too wealthy for their own good are holding a decadent reception for their wedding, and ordered a tremendously expensive champagne to keep their guests entertained. A regular pilot can't be trusted to ship the drinks in, but what's a thousand-ISK bottle of wine to a capsuleer?
messages.zh: 有一对新人，钱多得不知该怎么花，正要举行一场穷奢极欲的婚礼，而且订了一种极其昂贵的香槟来宴请宾客。这些酒不能托付给一名普通飞行员来运送，可是对克隆飞行员来说，一瓶几千块钱的酒又有什么意义呢？

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. I was able to secure an invitation to the reception thanks to your work. You should have seen the old man staggering around after hoarding several bottles of the champagne. He and Vann got into an argument towards the end of the night; turns out neither of them was as well-off as they appeared to be, even to each other, and they couldn't afford to pay the event bill. It's the latest scandal, the news services are all over it.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}，你让我保住了参加宴会的机会。你真该亲眼看看那老家伙跌跌撞撞地偷偷藏起来好几瓶香槟的样子。宴会结束后他和凡恩大吵了一架，看起来他们不像看上去那么有钱嘛，彼此之间都那么小气，而且听说他们都付不起宴会的账单呢。以上是最新的小道消息了，现在媒体都盯着他们呢。

messages.en: Fine, I'll find someone else, hopefully before it's too late.
messages.zh: 好吧，我再去找别人，希望还来得及。

messages.en: Nobody loves a good party more than the Gallente. The hedonistic stereotype is one that the Federation revels in and flaunts shamelessly. Public figures actively compete to host the wildest and most fashionable affairs, vying for the attention of news services and gossip magazines. Among the celebrity elite, a wedding, birth or even a funeral is simply another excuse to splash out and stand in the limelight.
messages.zh: 没人比盖伦特人更热爱聚会了。整个联邦热衷于享乐主义，他们彻夜狂欢并不知羞耻地四处夸耀。社会名流们竞相举办最狂放最时尚的聚会，以此来吸引新闻媒体及八卦杂志的关注。在这些“精英人士”看来，婚礼、新生儿甚至葬礼都是大肆挥霍并吸引眼球的好借口。

messages.en: The Entertainment Game
messages.zh: 娱乐游戏

messages.en:
You must have heard of Chaylie Vann. No? What rock have you been living under? She's a big-name actress, does a lot of calculated lobbying for various charities in Placid, and she's getting married to some seriously old-money geezer from Intaki – yeah, we all know how that relationship is going to end. Never mind that. They're paying big bucks for an extravagant reception at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and put in a massive order for Feille d'Marnne in order to keep their guests happy.

Feille d'Marnne is some seriously posh champagne, {[character]player.name}. Each case of this stuff costs as much as an Incursus, and they're buying more than one. Obviously, we can't trust anyone less than a capsuleer to deliver the lot – an ordinary pilot would be more likely to run the stuff onto the black market.
messages.zh:
你一定听说过夏莉·凡恩吧？没听过？你难道过着与世隔绝的生活？她可是个大明星，为宁静之域的多个慈善机构做过不少宣传呢。她要嫁给一位印塔基的有钱老头——当然，我们都知道他们不会长久的。别管那个了。他们花大价钱在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}举办了一场奢侈的宴会，为了让来宾高兴，他们还订了大量的马利菲勒。

马利菲勒是{[character]player.name}一种非常奢华的香槟酒，一箱酒值一艘因卡萨斯级。他们可不止买了一箱。那么很显然，除了克隆飞行员，我们不信任任何其他飞行员去送货，因为他们肯定会把酒直接运到黑市上去的。

messages.en: I'm not laughing, {[character]player.name}. I have a reputation to maintain, you know.
messages.zh: 这可不好笑，{[character]player.name}。你知道我可是要面子的。

messages.en: I haven't received a receipt for that champagne yet. What's the hold up?
messages.zh: 我听说香槟还没送到。怎么回事？

name.en: A Little Work On The Side
name.ru: Подработка на стороне (A Little Work On The Side)

messages.en: Good, good.
messages.zh: 嗯，很好。

messages.en: A friend and I are running a small holoreel bootlegging operation on the side. The shipments are bound for Syndicate, but I only need you to take them on to where my business partner is operating from.
messages.zh: 我和一个朋友私下也经营一些全息记忆盘非法贩售生意。这批货的目的地是辛迪加星域，但我只要你带一些货到我的合作伙伴那里就行。

messages.en: Thanks for your help, {[character]player.name}. Turns out our normal courier sold us out; the hangar we normally use was raided just after you left for your cargo run and officials from the Federal Performance Rights Union came around asking nosy questions. Good thing we were using your hangar, huh?
messages.zh: 多谢帮忙，{[character]player.name}。原来我们常用的那个快递员出卖了我们；就在你刚离开去送货的时候，我们平时用的机库被搜查了，还有几个联邦演出权利联合会的官员来问了一大堆话。多亏我们这次用的是你的机库，对吧？

messages.en: Fine. It's not like anyone would believe you if you told them, anyway.
messages.zh: 算了，反正你出去乱讲别人也不会相信你的。

messages.en:
The Syndicate is the underbelly of Federation society, filled with its outcasts and criminals; it's a place where they can move freely and openly, and even prosper outside the reach of the law. As a result, supplies of luxury items at affordable rates are hard to come by, leading to a thriving black market in everything from sweets and the latest fashions from the Crystal Boulevard to ship parts and broadcasting equipment.

For those who reside under the independent governorship of the station managers, life can be more expensive when acquired legally. Official companies within the Federation add a high tariff for the risk of shipping through low-security and lawless space; the more frequent the attacks, the higher the cost. Residents who aspire to a higher-quality life must live with a daily balancing act of legality and affordability. Even such minor offenses as purchasing necessities via the black markets can potentially bar an otherwise law-abiding citizen from finding an honest living within Empire space.
messages.zh:
辛迪加地区是联邦社会的阴暗面，充斥着各种边缘人群和犯罪分子；他们在此区域里无拘无束，更可以大发不义之财。于是乎，奢侈品价格都高得离谱，黑市买卖盛行。从糖果到水晶大街的最时尚物品，从舰船零件到通信设备……黑市上啥都有。

对于居住在独立管辖空间站里的人来说，如果样样东西都要选行货，那么生活成本会大幅增加。由于运输线要通过低安全地区和0.0地区，联邦的官方企业都对货物附加高额关税；航路上的袭扰越频繁，成本就越高。对于生活品质有追求的居民们，每天都要在精打细算与遵守法律之间做出选择。一个守法的公民，仅仅因为在黑市上买过一点生活必需品，就可能无法在帝国区找到一份体面的工作。

messages.en: The Syndicate Market
messages.zh: 辛迪加市场

messages.en:
I like nice things, {[character]player.name}. Who doesn't? Handing missions out to you people all day doesn't offer nearly enough to cover my expenses, so a friend and I run a shipping business out to Syndicate space. Nothing big enough to interfere with the Syndicate itself, mind you. We provide a humanitarian service importing the latest holos from the heart of civilization. It's the only way they can get the things for a reasonable cost – buying them direct from the companies in the Federation incurs immense shipping charges.

Our usual courier is out of commission today, with her ship in for repairs after a pirate attack. If you want to make yourself useful, take the latest shipment over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and ask for Amelyn. They'll know who you mean, just say that “Imba” sent you.
messages.zh:
我喜欢漂亮的玩意儿，{[character]player.name}。谁不喜欢呢？即使成天给你们这些人派发任务，我的收入也不够我花的。所以我和一个朋友还经营一些到辛迪加的货运业务。你要注意，我这只是点小生意，跟辛迪加财团没什么瓜葛。我们提供的是一项人性化的服务：从帝国中心地区进口最新的全息记忆盘。只有这样他们才能以靠谱的价格买到东西——直接从联邦的企业购买的话，要付出巨额的运输费。

我们常用的快递员今天无法接活儿，因为她的船被海盗打伤了，还在修理。如果你想找点事情做，就把最新一批货送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，然后找阿美林。他们会明白你找谁，只要说是“伊姆巴”派你来的就可以了。

messages.en: Fine. It's not like anyone would believe you if you told them, anyway.
messages.zh: 算了，反正你出去乱讲别人也不会相信你的。

messages.en: Amelyn hasn't contacted me yet, {[character]player.name}. What's the hold up?
messages.zh: 阿美林还没有联系我，{[character]player.name}。有什么事情耽搁了？

messages.en: Thanks a lot, {[character]player.name}. I doubt they'll give the peepers back, since they all escaped into the labs when the box was opened, but it's worth asking.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。我怀疑他们无法退还那些活叫蛙，因为箱子一打开，它们就逃进了实验室的各个角落。不过我还是问一下吧。

messages.en: I accidentally sent the wrong shipment over to another laboratory. I need to you take these frogs over; it's the right shipment, this time, I'm positive!
messages.zh: 我把送去另一个实验室的货物搞错了。我需要你接手这些青蛙；它们才是该送去的，这次我肯定没有搞错！

messages.en: You're a career-saver, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你保住了我的饭碗，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: You needn't get snooty about it. As if you've never made errors under the influence before.
messages.zh: 你犯不着这么拽吧。搞得好像你从来没有因为受影响而误过事一样。

messages.en: In laboratory work, animals are still used occasionally for testing in appropriate situations. The most popular subjects are Luminaire skippers, a common amphibian from Gallente Prime, and Harst's Greater Earless Rat, which is actually a kind of marsupial of indeterminate origin due to its habit of hitching rides in ship cargo holds.
messages.zh: 在实验室工作中，适当环境下仍然会使用动物来测试。使用最多的动物是：泛光之源跳蛙，它是盖伦特首星上常见的一种两栖类；哈氏大型无耳鼠，它是一种起源尚不明确的有袋类，经常寄居在舰船的货舱里。

messages.en: Animal Testing
messages.zh: 动物试验

messages.en:
Yes, yes, perhaps you could help me out.

A few days ago, I was at one of those parties - you know the type, where they shoot you full of stims if you start to drag, and you just keep going until reality starts to fold in on itself and turn into confetti, and there's the scent of rosewater and….

To make a long story short, I accidentally sent the wrong cargo over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. They were less than amused to receive a crate of live Intaki peepers rather than the cryo-stored Luminaire skippers they needed. One frog is much like another, but the pet-shop variety make very poor laboratory testing groups. Take these over, and they may forgive me enough to require my services in the future.
messages.zh:
嗯嗯，也许你能帮我一个忙。

几天前我参加了一个派对——那种活动你懂的，如果看你不爽，他们就不停地给你灌酒，直到你烂醉如泥，不省人事…

长话短说，结果呢，我把错误的货品发去了{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}。本来应该是冷冻保存的泛光之源跳蛙，但我发送的是活的印塔基叫蛙，因此他们不太高兴。虽说青蛙们本来挺相似的，不过宠物店的那种分类方法在实验室里可行不通。把这些送过去吧，如此一来他们可能会原谅我，并且以后还可以有业务来往。

messages.en: But what about my frogs?
messages.zh: 可是我的青蛙怎么办？

messages.en: Have you delivered those frogs yet, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把那些青蛙送到了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. Hurry up! This could be our biggest breakthrough yet!
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。抓紧时间！这也许会是我们目前最重大的进展！

messages.en: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has a number of outposts in w-space systems, exploring what lies beyond known space. They've turned up some unusual pieces which I need you to take to a more extensive laboratory for identification.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}在虫洞星系中安置了许多个哨站，用以探索未知空间。他们发现了一些不寻常的东西，所以我需要你把它们送到一个更大的实验室去检测。

messages.en: Excellent!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮！

messages.en: If it's not worth your time, you could have just said so.
messages.zh: 如果这不值得你浪费时间，你应该早点说。

messages.en: Capsuleers aren't the only people to explore the systems accessible via wormholes. Every corporation wants to be the first to make the Next Big Discovery, and then market the developments from researching it. Most corporations will categorically deny that this is what they're doing, creating an atmosphere of both paranoia and plausible deniability if their explorations turn up nothing of value.
messages.zh: 并不是只有克隆飞行员们在穿梭虫洞探索一个个星系，每一个军团都力争率先在星际探索领域有重大发现，进而可以出售研究的成果。但大多数公司都矢口否认它们在做这样的事情，这样如果他们什么都没找到的话也也有个台阶下。

messages.en: Corporate W-Space Exploration
messages.zh: 军团的虫洞空间探索

messages.en:
Yes, I have some work for you.

We have several research outposts in various w-space systems. It's one of those things that nobody discusses but everybody knows about anyway. They've recovered bits of ancient technology which seem to have unusual properties... well, compared to what we're used to seeing, at least. We're hoping these might be a clue to the Sleepers' technology... but it could easily be remnants of a scrapyard, for all we know. Take these samples over to the lab at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, so we can figure out what we've got.
messages.zh:
没错，有些活要你做。

我们在虫洞星系中有几个研究哨站，这种事情没人愿意提起，但是大家都心知肚明。它们发现了一点古代科技的线索，似乎有着极不寻常的特性......呃......至少比起我们以前的发现来是这样的。我们希望这些线索关乎到冬眠者的科技...... 当然，我们也知道这也可能不过是一堆垃圾。把这些样本送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的实验室去，这样我们就能知道它是什么了。

messages.en: This displeases me, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你让我很不爽，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I've not received a receipt for the cargo yet, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我还没收到货物签收回执，{[character]player.name}。

name.es: Las garras heladas de la muerte

messages.en: Thanks a lot, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A nearby station has suffered a life-support failure. They got the atmospheric regulators working again, but the interior temperature is starting to drop. Get the heating units over there quickly, before the place gets too cold.
messages.zh: 附近一个空间站的维生系统出了问题。他们修好了空气调节器，但是内部的温度开始下降。在那个地方变成冰窖之前，快点把这些取暖器送去。

messages.en: Great to hear, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 听上去很好，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: Well, I'm certain we can find someone who values their job more.
messages.zh: 好吧，我还是去找更认真工作的人来吧。

messages.en: The most vital systems on a space station or starship, life-support covers everything from atmosphere generation and recycling to environmental control to the recycling of drinking and pumping water. Originally a series of tanks containing specialized filters, as residence in space extended from long-term to lifetimes, advances in bioengineering developed hydroponics systems for stations which both produce and recycle air and water efficiently. Environmental control, which cycles water and air through the station and maintains an even internal temperature despite the cold of space outside nibbling at the edges, runs off the same generator as the internal electrical circuits. External electrical devices, such as guide-lights, shielding and containment fields, security systems and communications, run from separate generators with extensive backup arrays.
messages.zh: 维生系统是空间站或舰船内部最重要的系统，涵盖了空气再生循环、环境控制以及饮用及生活用水循环利用等方方面面。它由一些加装了特殊过滤器的容器组成，能长时间甚至终生为空间站提供生命支持。得益于生物工程科技的发展，溶液培植系统广泛应用于空间站，能提供高效的空气及水资源再生循环利用。环境控制系统致力于整个空间站的空气及水循环，无论外部的寒冷如何侵袭，它都能维持内部的温度，并和内部电路共用同一个发电机。外部的电子设备，比如指示灯、护盾及密闭力场、安全系统及通信系统等，分别使用不同的发电机，并备有多个备用阵列。

messages.en: Station-Side Survival
messages.zh: 空间站生存

messages.en:
A severe accident has occurred on another station, {[character]player.name}; they suffered a freak blowout in primary life-support and the station's environmental control shut down entirely. No, don't panic, they stabilized the atmosphere as soon as they could, so the people on the station won't asphyxiate. But the internal heating units have yet to be replaced. People are bundling up as their heat bleeds out – the external insulation is some protection, but it's not enough.

To help out, we've put together as many portable emergency heating units as we could find on such short notice. Take them over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and quickly!
messages.zh:
某个空间站发生了严重的事故，{[character]player.name}；他们的维生系统很奇怪地发生了爆炸，整个空间站的环境控制系统都停止工作了。不不，别慌张，他们竭尽全力搞定了空气循环系统，所以里面的人不至于窒息而死。但是他们的内部取暖器需要更换，热量流失的很快，里面的人都把自己裹得像个粽子一样。外部的隔离层能起到点保护作用，但是还不够。

一方有难，八方支援，我们已经在最短时间内集齐了所有能找到的便携式应急取暖器。你要把它们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，要快！

messages.en: You're heartless, {[character]player.name}. What about all those people?
messages.zh: 你真冷血，{[character]player.name}，你让那些人怎么活？

messages.en: Have you delivered the heating units yet?
messages.zh: 你把取暖器送到那里了吗？

messages.en: Good to hear!
messages.zh: 真是好消息！

messages.en: One of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}'s archaeological teams has uncovered a load of pre-Federation relics. I need you to transport the pieces to a laboratory for analysis.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的一支考古小队发现了一些先联邦时期的遗物。我要你将它们送到一个实验室去做分析鉴定。

messages.en: Excellent! We'll get started on the analysis immediately. This is so exciting!
messages.zh: 非常好！我们会马上开始分析鉴定。真是激动人心啊！

messages.en: Sad. I thought you'd have more interest than that.
messages.zh: 真遗憾。我还以为你会很感兴趣。

messages.en: Corporations often sponsor archaeological and research projects, paying for work permits and equipment when the people involved need them. In exchange, the corporations obtain exclusive rights to any discoveries which are made. This includes the right to display and charge viewing fees, or to make new developments based upon information obtained from the artifacts.
messages.zh: 公司经常会赞助一些考古研究项目，并为那些工作者提供所需的工作许可及设备。作为回报，公司可以独享考古的一切成果，包括举办收费性展览，或是依据文物蕴含的信息做进一步开发研究。

messages.en: Retro Revival
messages.zh: 古文明的复兴

messages.en: One of our archaeological teams has unearthed a load of pre-Federation tech from a moon in this system. We're really excited about this; I don't think I need to explain to you how the results of this find could give us a leg up on the competition. Get this lot over to the labs at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and don't tell anyone!
messages.zh: 我们的一支考古小队在本星系的某个卫星上发掘出了一些先联邦时期的科技。我们对此非常振奋，毋庸置疑，这样的发现会使我们在竞争中占得先机。把这些东西送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的实验室去，不许走漏了风声！

messages.en: This greatly displeases me, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你让我非常生气，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, have you delivered those artifacts yet?
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你把那些文物送去了吗？

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}. Do try to hurry, you don't want this stuff sitting around too long in your cargo hold.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。快去吧，你不会希望那东西在你船上停留太久的。

messages.en: This shipment of Cerrocentite needs to be taken to the manufacturer on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. The cargo is radioactive, and while the containment units are good enough for a short period, the mineral really requires an industrial containment in a stable and controlled environment.
messages.zh: 这些峰币岩要送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的工厂去。虽然它外面的容器能在短时间内有效抵御它的放射性，但是这东西真的需要在一个稳定而且受控的环境中长期保存。

messages.en: Good to hear, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 真是好消息，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: I am disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Security systems on stations are all-in-one, monitoring room occupancy, ambient temperature and humidity, and the gas mix from environmental control. It can be set to go on alert for various stimuli, and contains several redundant systems to ensure that an interrupt on one line does not prevent a problem being reported. Small pieces of radioactive material which are sensitive to various stimuli are an integral part of such systems.
messages.zh: 空间站的安全系统是一体式的，可以监测房间占用率、环境温度及湿度以及气体成分。它可以对多种刺激发出警报，并内置了几个冗余系统以保证能够不受干扰地报告危险。它里面有小块的放射性物质，对各种刺激都非常敏感。

messages.en: Redundant Systems
messages.zh: 冗余系统

messages.en: Okay, take a look at this. You know what this is? Yes, yes, it's a rock. It's a rare mineral, actually, called Cerrocentite. It has industrial applications, but it's mostly used in security systems. The reason it's in a special containment field is that it's also fairly radioactive. Take this shipment over to the manufacturers at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and don't bloody open it!
messages.zh: 好吧，来看看这个。知道这是什么吗？没错，没错，这是块石头。这是一种稀有矿物，叫峰币岩。可以用于工业生产，但更多的是用在安全系统上。为什么放在特制容器里呢？因为它有很强的放射性。现在，把这个东西运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的工厂去，千万别打开！

messages.en: I am disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you delivered that Cerrocentite, {[character]player.name}? You don't want to expose your ship to it for much longer.
messages.zh: 你把峰币岩送到那儿了吗，{[character]player.name}？你不会希望那东西在你船上停留太久的。

messages.en: Thanks a lot, {[character]player.name}. I'll make it worth your while.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。我不会让你白干的。

messages.en: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is hosting a fashion show for publicity, and your agent needs you to pick up the models. For some reason, they think you won't get fed up and drop them all off in orbit around the nearest moon.
messages.zh: 出于宣传目的，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}将要举办一场时尚秀，而你的代理人要你去把那些模特接来。基于某种考虑，他们觉得你不会因为受不了那些模特而把她们扔在邻近的行星轨道上或什么地方的。

messages.en: Good to hear, {[character]player.name}! Tonight's show should be spectacular.
messages.zh: 非常好，{[character]player.name}！今晚的秀场一定璀璨耀眼。

messages.en: Regrettable, but I can't say I blame you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 很遗憾，不过我也不能责备你什么，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Like most small corporate entities relying on creativity and artistry, Gallente fashion houses frequently accept patronage from larger corporations, which then sponsor shows and displays. The artists benefit from the visibility and the patron corporations gain another reason to be in the news. Occasionally, the artists incorporate symbols relating to their sponsors in their work, such as logos, corporate colors and mantras, or materials produced by the company.

As always, some art houses denounce the practice, stating that corporate ties bias the work produced by the artists, and accuse the other artists of “selling out,” sacrificing their autonomy for a little planetary cred.
messages.zh:
像大多数致力于艺术及创造的小型军团一样，盖伦特时尚工作室也常常接受来自大军团的赞助，举办一些走秀及展示什么的。艺术家们获得了曝光度，赞助商们也得到了上新闻的机会，可谓两全其美。有些时候，艺术家们将与赞助商相关的一些元素融入到了他们的设计中，比如标示、军团专用色及格言、以及它们生产的材料等等。

一般来讲，总会有一些艺术工作室谴责这种做法，它们声称这样会使得艺术创作不再那么纯粹，并且指责那些艺术家“出卖”了自己，因小失大。

messages.en: The Business of Art
messages.zh: 艺术交易

messages.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is playing host to a fashion show. It's just another publicity stunt, but we need something to gain the public eye again.

We need someone to pick up the models and fashionistas from {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. You can kind of guess what they're like – a normal pilot just isn't good enough for them, so I have to find a capsuleer I think is level-headed enough to not vent cargo into space if they get too annoying. I know you can handle it, it's not like you have to speak with them face to face, anyway.
messages.zh:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}正要举办一场时尚秀，其实这不过又是宣传的噱头罢了，不过我们还是需要以此来吸引公众的眼球的。

我们需要有人去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}把那些模特和时尚达人接来。你可以想像一下他们是怎样一副德行——普通的飞行员肯定是受不了他们的，所以我需要一位头脑冷静的克隆飞行员，至少不会因为那些人太烦而把他们从船上扔出去吧。我知道你能搞定这件事的，反正你也不用和他们面对面地交谈。

messages.en: I'm disappointed, {[character]player.name}. We have a reputation to maintain.
messages.zh: 我很失望，{[character]player.name}，我们可是要面子的。

messages.en: Have you picked up the models yet? The show's only a few hours away!
messages.zh: 你把模特接来了吗？表演几个小时后就要开始了！

messages.en: Just don't watch those, okay? They gave me nightmares.
messages.zh: 别看那些行吗？它们让我做恶梦。

messages.en: The Natural Way is a group which promotes a lower-tech way of life. They're throwing around a lot of cred to start a fitness initiative encouraging kids to stay away from body modding, and I see nothing wrong with encouraging them in exchange for a little ISK.
messages.zh: 自然之道是一个宣扬朴素生活的团体。他们花费巨资来推动一项健身计划，鼓励孩子们远离身体改装的行为。我觉得帮他们一把，同时挣点钱，没什么不好的。

messages.en: Thanks a lot, {[character]player.name}. My mother's been giving those to my kids for their birthdays every year, and I was afraid I'd never get rid of them.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。我母亲每年都把那些当作生日礼物送给我的孩子们，恐怕我永远都无法摆脱它们。

messages.en: What? Who doesn't want to take advantage of anti-tech crazies?
messages.zh: 什么？谁不想从这些反科技的二百五身上捞一笔？

messages.en:
There was a time when our children roamed free beneath the sun. They grew strong and healthy under the clear breezes and warm rains. But then technology arose, and with it pollution, sedentary lifestyles, and then the means to compensate for it artificially. But is this truly healthy? Instead of living naturally long lifespans, we turn to medicine and modifications to improve ourselves. Today's teenager spends their days in front of a holoscreen; many of them don't even leave the house of their parents to attend school, preferring to interface remotely.

My friends, is this how we want our children to live?” -- Excerpt from The Natural Way's introductory leaflet
messages.zh:
我们的孩子们曾经自由地在阳光下奔跑。曾经沐浴清风和暖雨，茁壮成长。然而科技随即兴起，带来了各种污染，宅腐的生活方式，以及对付这些负面问题的人工手段。问题是，这样下去很健康吗？我们不愿通过自然的生活来获得长寿，却要借助药物和改造来修补自己的身体。现在的青少年，整天抱着全息屏幕观看；很大一部分甚至完全不去学校，喜欢待在家里远程交流。

朋友们，难道我们就要自己的孩子们这样过生活？——自然之道介绍小册子节选

messages.en: The Natural Way
messages.zh: 自然之道

messages.en: There's a fitness initiative going through Federation schools. I'm sure you've heard about it? A weird luddite group called The Natural Way wants to get kids to stop relying on modding to stay in shape, and they're tossing cred around like water to do so. No school would turn down money in exchange for a couple hours' fitness classes a week. Take these {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} over to one of their facilities at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and we'll see some of that money, too.
messages.zh: 联邦的各个学校里正在开展一项健身行动。我相信你肯定听说过吧？一个名叫自然之道的怪异反主流团体，想让孩子们停止依赖身体改造来保持体形；为了实现目标，该团体可以说是花钱如流水。任何学校都不会因为每周增加几小时的健身课而拒绝这笔钱。把这些{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}带去他们位于{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的一处设施，这样咱们也能分一杯羹啦。

messages.en: Well, fine. But burn the holos. We don't want normal people watching that stuff.
messages.zh: 好吧。不过，要把那些全息盘烧掉啊。咱们可不能让普通人观看那些材料。

messages.en: You haven't WATCHED those, have you?
messages.zh: 你该不会是看了那些材料吧，有木有？

name.fr: Le temps de la guerre approche

messages.en: Do not fail us, {[character]player.name}. The Federation is depending on you.
messages.zh: 别让我们失望，{[character]player.name}。联邦这次就靠你了。

messages.en: Federation R&D specialists have been working to find counters for Caldari military tactics; the latest development is a special type of ammunition that works similarly to a lock breaker bomb, but on a single target. I want you to take it over to a navy base for testing, and you need to keep word of this development from going very far.
messages.zh: 联邦的科研专家们一直在寻找可以对抗加达里军队战术的办法；他们的最新成果是一种特别的弹药。该弹药的效能类似于锁定干扰炸弹，不过，它是对单个目标起作用。我需要你把它送到一处海军基地进行测试，而且你要对此项技术严格保密。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. You are a true child of the Federation.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。你真是联邦的好儿女。

messages.en: I'm disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}. I thought your loyalty might mean more to you.
messages.zh: 我对你十分失望，{[character]player.name}。我原以为你很看重自己的忠诚。

messages.en: Despite their origins in the same solar system, the history between the Gallente Federation and the Caldari State has been laced with conflict since the early days. Initially unified in reaching to the stars through the development of stargate technology, relations rapidly degenerated after the Caldari struck out on their own. Now, separated by a closely-watched border zone, the focus of the two empires lies in staying a few steps ahead of each other.
messages.zh: 虽然盖伦特联邦与加达里合众国起源于同一个星系，但是从很早开始他们就出现了矛盾。起初，两族联合开发星门技术并且进入了太空时代，其后，加达里人转向单干，双方关系随之恶化。今日，这两个国家被一片严密防守的边境地带隔开，彼此的焦点都是努力保持比对方些许领先。

messages.en: Brothers in Arms Race
messages.zh: 兄弟竞赛

messages.en:
I'm sure you're all too aware of our war with the Caldari State. It's been dragging on for years with no end in sight... until now, that is. We've been making some good headway on the active front and our research and development has been busy behind the scenes. Military scientists have developed a hybrid round that works like single-target burst ECM, and it's time to introduce it to the military for an active field-test.

Take these over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh:
我相信你很清楚我们在和加达里合众国交战。这战争延续了很多年，看不到休止…但现在情况有了变化。我们在前线取得了一些不错的进展，而我们的科研人员也在后方忙着出力。军事科学家们研制出了一种混合弹药，它就像一种针对单个目标的ECM脉冲波。现在是时候把它介绍给军方并进行实地试验了。

把这些样品送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去。

messages.en: I'm disappointed, {[character]player.name}. If we find that you've shared this with the Caldari, it will not go well for you.
messages.zh: 我对你十分失望，{[character]player.name}。如果我们发现你把此事告诉了加达里人，你的下场会很惨。

messages.en: Have you finished your delivery, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把货送到了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Thank you for agreeing to attempt the rescue of our civilian contractors. You must leave very soon if we are to have any hope of reaching them before the hit team arrives.
messages.zh: 非常感谢你勇于去营救那些幸存的人。如果想在清道夫赶到之前救出他们的话，你就必须马上出发。

messages.en: A small fleet of unidentified frigates has attacked one of our remote communications outposts, killing and injuring dozens of our personnel. Those who survived the attack managed to pilot a high-speed shuttle to the nearest station. However, we have strong reason to believe that a team of assassins is en route to their location to eliminate them before they can pass along the information about the organization responsible for this attack. We need you to make all possible haste to their location and rescue the survivors before this hit team arrives.
messages.zh: 一小支身份不明的护卫舰编队袭击了我们的远程通信哨站，造成了大量人员伤亡。那些侥幸生还的人驾驶着一艘高速穿梭机逃往了邻近的空间站。但是，我们确信，一伙袭击者正在追踪幸存者并企图封口，以防止袭击的幕后指使者身份暴露。现在，我们需要你火速前往幸存者的位置，在清道夫到达之前把他们营救出来。

messages.en: Your skillful handing of your ship in this vital rescue mission has saved the lives of many civilians who would have otherwise surely perished in the damaged outpost. We knew we could count on you and we will now move you to the top of our list for future missions.
messages.zh: 你在本次救援行动中表现出来的高超的驾驶技巧挽救了许多平民的生命，没有你他们将难以幸免。我们知道你是可以信赖的人，今后如果需要帮助，我们会第一个想到你。

messages.en: Your refusal to accept this mission will undoubtedly result in numerous civilian casualties. We must now try to find someone else to undertake this rescue operation.
messages.zh: 你的坐视不理无疑会导致无数的平民伤亡。现在我们必须去找别人执行救援行动了。

messages.en: The Caldari Navy, much like the military services of other races, operates a covert network of signals intelligence outposts along the borders of the Caldari State. The specific, primary mission of these stations is to provide advance early warning of any hostile incursion by the Gallente military. Beyond this vital mission, however, the outposts are also tasked with gathering intelligence on a wide variety of other targets, both military and civilian. Of particular interest is the regular provision of information on the movement of the commercial and industrial fleets of other races, given the competition between the Caldari corporate system and foreign companies. In this way, the outposts not only provide an essential early warning system for any hostile forces, but also provide data of immense economic value, thus better enabling the Caldari private business sector to better compete in the merciless realm of interstellar business.
messages.zh: 像其他势力的军事力量一样，加达里海军沿边境线建立了一个秘密的情报哨站网络。这些哨站建立的初衷是对盖伦特军队的入侵提供预警。除了这个重要的使命之外，它们也被用于收集其它各个势力的军事及民用情报。更特别的是，鉴于加达里企业同国外企业的激烈竞争，它们可以定期提供其它势力的商业及工业舰队的动向。可以说，这些哨站不仅能够对敌人入侵提供重要的预警，而且可以提供经济价值巨大的数据以帮助加达里私人企业在残酷的星际商业竞争中更好地生存。

messages.en: Caldari SIGINT Outpost Network
messages.zh: 加达里情报站网络

messages.en:
Earlier today, a small, unknown group of frigates attacked one of our remote signals intelligence (SIGINT) communications outposts, causing catastrophic damage and killing dozens of our personnel. This station belongs – or should I say belonged - to a small Caldari corporation with a poorly hidden contractual link to our military intelligence services. Fortunately, the survivors managed to escape, via their high-speed emergency shuttle and are expected to arrive at a nearby station within the hour.

As you might expect, we are working hard to determine the identities of the aggressors, but as yet we have no solid leads. Of course, this is not your concern. What is your concern, should you choose to help us, is a report we just received indicating that the surviving team of SIGINT contractors have been targeted for immediate assassination by the same mysterious organization behind the outpost attack. Apparently, someone does not want these individuals to provide us with whatever information they must have obtained during the course of their recent duties.

Within the last few hours, we intercepted a poorly encrypted communication indicating that a covert hit squad is en route to the station aboard an unspecified vessel – or may actually be at the station already! This station's security force, while well armed and highly trained, is insufficient to detect and defeat the kind of lethal operatives that we believe intend to kill our contractors. Therefore, we need you to rescue this team immediately and bring them back to us for an emergency debriefing and to ensure their safety.

After running a check of qualified pilots in our office database, your name was near the top of the list. We estimate there will only be sufficient time for this one rescue attempt before the assassins strike.
messages.zh:
今天早些时候，一小支身份不明的护卫舰编队袭击了我们的一个远程情报通信哨站，造成了灾难性的损失，许多人员丧生。这个哨站属于......或者说曾经属于一家加达里小公司，但明眼人都看得出来它实际上为我们的军事情报部门服务。幸运的是，一些幸存者驾驶一艘高速救生穿梭机逃了出来，应该会在一小时内到达邻近的一个空间站。

你一定也很想知道袭击者的身份，我们正在努力调查，不过还没有实质性的进展。当然，这个不是你要关心的。你需要关心的，也是需要帮忙的是，我们刚刚收到情报，袭击事件幕后的神秘组织随即派出了清道夫，目标直指那些幸存者。很明显，哨站的人最近一定获得了些什么信息，而有些人并不希望他们能活着把信息交给我们。

过去的几个小时里，我们截获了一条加密信息并获知：一支秘密突袭小队已经乘坐不明舰船向幸存者所在的空间站进发——或者，可能已经到了。那个空间站的安保力量，虽然装备精良并训练有素，但还是不足以应对那些危险的清道夫——他们的目的很明显，就是要干掉所有的幸存者。所以，我们需要你立即前往营救那些幸存人员并把他们安全地带回我这里来。

我们从数据库中查找出够资质的飞行员，你是其中最杰出的之一。我们估计，在清道夫行动之前，只有这一次营救机会了。

messages.en: We are disappointed that you have chosen not to complete this critical mission; you've left our contractors at great risk. We will have to find another pilot elsewhere, though I doubt this will be possible at this late stage.
messages.zh: 这么重要的任务你却半途而废了，我们很失望，你把幸存者们推向了危险的边缘。我们得去找别人帮忙，我怀疑已经来不及了。

messages.en: There is no time to discuss this mission further given the haste with which you will need to accomplish this. Please contact me only when you have delivered the contractors safely to the final destination.
messages.zh: 没时间讨论更多了，抓紧时间。等你把那些幸存者安全送到目的地之后再来找我。

messages.en: That is very good news, thank you. With your permission, we will begin loading pallets of the Ditanium plates into your hangar.
messages.zh: 真是好消息，非常感谢。既已获准，我们会将那些硬钛附甲板装载到你的飞船上。

messages.en: Amarr scientists, working at a clandestine engineering laboratory in a nearby system may have developed the hardest metal yet known to science, known as Ditanium. The potential applications for warfare, specifically, in hardening our warships, is simply too tempting to pass up. Therefore, the full weight of the Amarr military science machine is waiting eagerly for the results of the pending tests, in which the Ditanium plates will be affixed to a specially modified frigate for flight testing. Therefore, we need you to deliver a large quantity of these plates to a nearby station where it will be transshipped to a military shipyard for fitting to the Punisher testbed ship.
messages.zh: 在附近某星系的一个秘密工程实验室工作的艾玛科学家发现了可能是目前已知最坚硬的金属——硬钛。其在战舰加固方面的巨大潜力令人瞩目。接下来，一艘特别改装过的护卫舰将会加装硬钛附甲板进行飞行测试，而整个艾玛军事科研界都在期待测试的结果。所以，我们需要你将大量硬钛附甲板运往邻近的一个空间站，随后它们将被转运到一个军事船坞并加装到惩罚者级实验船上。

messages.en: Outstanding news, {[character]player.name}. Our scientists have verified receipt of the Ditanium plates and are right now moving those pallets to other ships for transshipment to the final destination. Well done and please contact us again in the future should you seek further employment. And remember: you were never here.
messages.zh: 真是振奋人心的消息，{[character]player.name}。我们的科学家已核实收到了硬钛附甲板，现在正装船转运往目的地。干的好，今后你再想找点活干的话，就来找我们吧。记住，刚刚什么都没发生过。

messages.en: Well, it is unfortunate that you've chosen not to help us. We trust that you will not discuss this meeting with any other parties, though we are confident that if you did, they would likely laugh you out of whatever station bar you frequent. And if we do hear of you babbling your mouth about this, be assured that we will find you and liquidate any chance of a future partnership, if you catch my meaning.
messages.zh: 嗯，很遗憾你不愿意伸出援手。我们相信你不会把今天听到的事情到处乱讲的，即使你讲了别人也不会相信。不过，如果我们得知你真的没管住自己的嘴的话，我们会上门找你算账的，希望你懂我的意思。

messages.en:
As you know, Amarr warships rely heavily on the various armors that we use in the construction and upgrading of our ships. For the most part, we rely on the same metals and alloys found in markets and hangars found in virtually every corner of the populated regions. Thus, it is a rare thing when a wholly new metal appears – and rarer still when only one race discovers it, unbeknownst to the others.

Such an occurrence, I can tell you now only in the strictest confidence, has indeed taken place at a remote clandestine Amarr metallurgical research facility.
