Masquerading as a routine ore processing laboratory near an otherwise uninteresting Veldspar-laden asteroid field, this facility has been conducting advanced research exclusively into an extremely rare and highly classified metal, found only in the ore of a small fraction of the asteroids present in that specific field: a new metal we call Ditanium. To date, this is the strongest naturally occurring metal yet encountered by our scientists. While we are confident that this metal exists elsewhere in space, to our knowledge, we are the first to actually find it.

Given the rarity of this metal and the significant complexities of its mining and processing, it has taken two full months to produce just enough finished metal plates to fit a single Punisher-class frigate. We intend to use this ship for Phase I field testing, which includes flight handling characteristics, radar cross-section analysis, temperature extremes testing, and other critical operational parameters. If successful, we are confident that we may be able to begin full scale production and ship fitting within two years.

However, before this test can take place, we need someone to courier these Ditanium plates to a station we designate. From there, it will be transshipped to a military shipyard for fitting to the Punisher testbed ship. We do not anticipate this shipment will present any problems, particularly given the high level of secrecy relating to the project, but with potentially many hundreds of billions of ISK riding on the successful integration of Ditanium into our armor plates and other protective ship components, we are taking no chances.

We need to know immediately if you will deliver this Ditanium to the designated station.
messages.zh:
如你所知，艾玛族战舰高度依赖于不同种类的装甲。在很大程度上讲，我们所使用的金属及合金几乎随处可见。所以，一种全新金属的发现将显得极为不寻常——更不寻常的是，只有一个种族发现了它，其他势力毫不知情。

这样巧合的事情，现在我可以满怀信心地告诉你，就在我们的一个偏远而秘密的艾玛冶金研究所实实在在地发生了。这个研究所位于一个毫不起眼的凡晶石小行星带附近，并伪装成一个常规矿石处理站，长久以来致力于对一种极其稀有并高度机密的金属的研究。这种新型金属被称为“硬钛”，只存在于行星带特定区域的极少数矿石中。它是我们的科学家迄今所发现的最坚硬的天然金属。我们相信这种金属在宇宙其他地区也有分布，不过到目前为止，我们是第一个发现它的。

鉴于它的稀少程度以及开采和熔炼的复杂工艺，我们花了两个月的时间才生产出仅够一艘惩罚者级护卫舰装配的成品附甲板。我们打算用这艘舰船进行第一阶段测试，其中包括飞行操控特性，雷达信号半径分析，极端温度测试，以及其它一些关键操作参数。如果获得成功，我们有信心能够在两年内投入量产并装配舰船。

不过，在测试开始之前，我们还需要有人把这些硬钛附甲板送到我们指定的空间站去。它们随后会被转运往一个军事船坞并装配到惩罚者级测试舰上。由于这个项目一直高度保密，我们认为运送货物应该不会有什么问题。不过，一旦成功地把硬钛结合到我们的附甲板以及其他防御性舰船配件里，将带来数以万亿计的经济收益，所以我们还是要谨慎行事。

我们现在就要你答复，你愿意把这些硬钛运往指定的空间站吗？

messages.en: I was just informed that you have chosen to quit this important mission prior to the agreed on completion conditions. Please return the Ditanium plates to the nearest Amarr station and we will consider this arrangement terminated.
messages.zh: 我刚刚得知你不顾协议而中途放弃如此重要的任务。请将那些硬钛附甲板归还给最近的一个艾玛空间站，我们将终止本次计划。

messages.en: Yes, well, we were quite confident that this would be a fairly routine mission, so we were glad to hear that is indeed the case. Fly safe, pilot.
messages.zh: 没错，我们相信这将会是一次再平常不过的任务，希望事实如此。一路平安，飞行员。

messages.en: I'm glad to you hear that you've agreed to help us out on this one. If you'll just confirm this manifest, we'll rally the Marines and have them report to your ship immediately. You'd better get moving – don't want to keep the troops waiting.
messages.zh: 我很高兴你愿意帮我们完成此事。只要你确认了这份名单后，我们就会让海军陆战队员立刻前往你的舰船。你最好动作快点——别让部队里的人等。

messages.en: We have reason to believe that a small team of Gallente saboteurs has managed to destroy one of our new – and not yet fully operational – Command Centers on a nearby ice planet. These facilities are critical elements in our overall plan to dominate the planet such that we can then exploit the vast and lucrative materials that we have identified there in abundance. We need you to deliver a large complement of Arctic Warfare Marines to a forward station so that they can then be transferred down to provide the security we so desperately need. Their massive amounts of equipment will be brought in on other ships, so we need you to deliver these men safely and securely – everything depends on their safe arrival.
messages.zh: 我们有理由相信，一小队盖伦特偷袭者在附近一颗冰体行星上摧毁了我们一座崭新但尚未完全运作的指挥中心。在我们掌控整颗行星这一计划中，这些设施是至关重要的组成部分。我们已经确认那颗行星上富含大量能卖高价的矿物。只有将这颗行星完全掌握在我们自己手里，我们才能充分挖掘那些矿物。我们要你将一支大规模的极地海军陆战连队送往一座中转空间站，他们之后会被转送到那颗行星上，提供我们急需的保安服务。他们的大量装备会由其他船运输，因此我们只需要你将他们安全送达目的地就行——一切都基于这一前提。

messages.en: I just got word that you delivered all the Marines safely to the station, great job! However, I must now coordinate the follow-on shipment of their equipment and weapons, which is going to mean another all-nighter here at the office. Oh well, business first, yes?  We will be in touch for future missions, so thanks again.
messages.zh: 我刚收到消息说你已经把所有海军陆战队员都安全送抵了那座空间站，干得不错！不过我接下来必须马上安排他们的武器装备运输，今晚这座办公室里的人肯定又要通宵达旦工作了。毕竟工作第一嘛。将来有新任务我们还会联系你的。再次对你表示感谢。

messages.en: That you have chosen to decline this mission has put this company in a very difficult position, to say the least. Well, get out of here then; let us hope the Marines don't hear about this and decide to give you a rather rough send-off.
messages.zh: 你拒绝该任务让本公司处境艰难，这已经是最轻的说法了。你快闪吧。但愿海军陆战队的人不知道这件事，否则他们一定会让你走得很不痛快。

messages.en: We have so far managed to keep this event a closely held secret, as we do not want to discourage the senior management of the company from further exploiting the extremely valuable materials that are in largely untapped abundance on the sea floor. If word of this was to get out at this critical stage, it might give them reason pack up and move to a safer location - perhaps even to another planet. Well, this would simply be unacceptable, as our new planetary industry efforts have so far generated record revenues - the one thing keeping our shareholders and investors happy. And we want to keep them happy, if you understand my meaning. We must allow nothing to interrupt that flow of ISK into our corporate coffers.
messages.zh: 到目前为止，我们还没有让这件事走漏风声，因为我们不想动摇公司高层对开采这些价值连城的矿物的决心。那颗行星的海床上富含大量这种矿物，它们基本上都未被开采过。万一这事在这关键时刻被他们晓得，那他们就有可能放弃现在的开采地，转向一个更安全的地方——甚至有可能是另一颗行星。我们没法接受这点，因为我们的行星开采行动至今已经为我们带来了前所未有的收入，我们的股东与投资者对此都很满意。我们要继续保持他们的满意度。我们不能让任何事阻断公司财源。

messages.en: Need to Know
messages.zh: 需知

messages.en:
Two days ago, a covert Gallente strike team infiltrated and destroyed a brand new Command Center on a nearby ice planet. We think they managed to infiltrate as local civilian workers due the fact that the facility's Personnel Security Identification Systems had not yet been fully brought online. This unforgivable lapse in security enabled the four-man team to gain access to a highly secure area that contains the controls for the counter-harmonic stabilizers which, in short, keep the entire facility level and secure in the very harsh climates encountered on that planet. A series of well-placed explosives damaged these stabilizers, however, taking them offline and causing the entire command center to collapse and sink through the ice to the ocean floor some two kilometers below. Fortunately, the bulk of the work force was not scheduled to arrive for two more weeks, so casualties were very light. The financial and economic costs were, however, staggering.

Now that you understand the gravity of the situation, we can proceed to the reason that we contacted you to help us in this critical moment in the company's ongoing rapid expansion phase. We need you to very quietly transport a company of our best Arctic Warfare Marines from this station to the destination station with all possible haste. From there they will flown to the ice planet to provide a very high level of security for this and other nearby command centers and facilities. It is just a matter of time before this disastrous event becomes public knowledge, and we need to prove to the senior management, shareholders, and investors that we have the security situation resolutely in hand.

So, {[character]player.name}, are you willing to help us out by delivering a large number of Arctic Marines to the designated station?
messages.zh:
两天前，在附近一颗冰体行星上，一支偷偷摸摸的盖伦特攻击队潜入并摧毁了我们一座崭新的指挥中心。他们伪装成当地平民工作人员，然后顺利潜入。这都要怪那座设施里尚未完全启用的工作人员身份验证系统。这一不可饶恕的失误为那支由4个人组成的队伍开了方便之门。他们进入了一个极度安全区，其中含有反谐波稳定装置的控制设备，而这反谐波稳定装置又确保整座设施在那行星的恶劣气候环境中平稳安全。但盖伦特的那支队伍在其中精心布置了炸弹，炸毁了所有稳定装置，致使整座设施都垮掉沉入了2公里左右深的海底。还好当时距大部分工作人员抵达还有2个多礼拜，因此死伤人员很少。但物质上的损失巨大。

既然现在你已经知道了整个情况的严重程度，那我接下来就告诉你为什么要你在公司高速发展的这一关键时刻来帮忙的原因。我们要你悄悄地尽快将我们最好的一支极地海军陆战连队从这座空间站送往指定的另一座空间站。到了那儿之后，他们会被带往那颗冰体行星，为这座及附近其他指挥中心提供高质量的保安服务。公众迟早会知道这场灾难事件。我们需要向高层、股东及投资者证明我们已经完全掌控了局势，不会再有这样的事情发生。

怎么样，{[character]player.name}，愿意帮我们将一大批极地海军陆战士兵送往指定空间站吗？

messages.en: How you can quit this mission mid-stream is absolutely beyond me. Do you have any idea the mountains of isk that this is going to cause my department and the Planetary Exploitation Division as a whole? Don't ever come back here for a while.
messages.zh: 我一点儿也无法理解你为什么会选择中途退出。你知不知道你这样会让我部门及整个行星开发部门经济上损失惨重？近期别再让我见到你。

messages.en: Are the Marines behaving themselves? Good. Please continue to make all possible haste in delivering them to the station. They tend to get a bit rowdy when they are cooped up too long.
messages.zh: 那些海军陆战队员没惹什么麻烦吧？很好。请继续将他们尽快送达指定空间站。你如果让他们在一个地方停留太久，他们会起毛躁的。

messages.en: Thank you for agreeing to help us. We will have the quantrium moved into your item hangar as soon as possible. You have already been cleared for emergency departure.
messages.zh: 谢谢你肯帮这个忙。我们会马上将量子合金送往你的机库中。你已经获准从紧急出口离开。

messages.en: The daughter of a Caldari executive was kidnapped this morning by a group of slavers while she was on holiday. They are demanding we provide them a large quantity of our rarest and most expensive metal, quantrium, in exchange for her life. There is no time to mount a rescue operation, so our only choice is to provide this shipment immediately. We will deal with those criminals once the girl has been released to us. However, time is of the essence, and our primary mission now is to deliver this shipment to a transshipment station for further transportation to the slavers' designated rendezvous point.
messages.zh: 一位加达里要员的女儿于今早在度假时被一伙劳工贩子绑架了。他们要求我们用大量的量子合金——我们最稀有，最昂贵的金属——来交换她的生命。已经来不及实施营救行动了，我们唯一能做的就是马上满足他们的要求。等那女孩平安归来之后我们再教训这些歹徒。但是，时间宝贵，我们现在的首要任务是将他们要的货送往一个中转站以转运至绑匪指定的接头地点。

messages.en: We just got word from the hotel security staff – the executive's daughter was returned to them safe and sound, as the kidnappers promised!  We owe you a debt I hope we can repay one day! We will not forget you!
messages.zh: 我们刚刚从酒店的安保人员那里获知，那位要员的女儿已经安全归来，看来绑匪遵守了诺言。我们欠你一个人情，希望以后可以报答你。我们不会忘记你的。

messages.en: We were counting on you. You were our only hope for the safe return of the CEO's daughter. I hope your cowardice here today will haunt you for the rest of your miserable life!
messages.zh: 我们曾经那么的相信你，你是我们拯救人质的唯一希望。我希望你今天的懦夫行为会令你可悲的余生饱受痛苦。

messages.en:
Time is a factor here, so I will get to the point. The daughter of a prominent Caldari industrialist, CEO of a large scrap metal corporation, was kidnapped while she was on holiday with her school classmates. At the time of her abduction, she was in a lowsec system she should not have been in, one well known for its hedonistic night life. Apparently, the girls each told a bit of a fib to their parents, indicating they were traveling to a much safer, highsec destination resort. Well, early this morning we received an urgent call from the executive's chief of security telling us that the daughter had been grabbed and thrown into a vehicle by some dangerous-looking men outside a bar after a night of drinking.

While we had hoped it was part of some prank or a misunderstanding as to what the girls really saw, our worst fears have been realized. We have been contacted, through a circuitous channel, by a notorious band of slavers. As proof of life, they have transmitted the daughter's DNA sequence to us. Analysis of this information has verified her identity.

The kidnappers have given us a very short window in which we can secure the girl's safe release, after which they will sell her into slavery – and I don't want to even imagine what horrors that might entail. As expected, they are demanding a very large payoff in exchange for her life. Specifically, they want our entire stockpile of our rarest and most expensive metal, quantrium – one found only in the wiring of electronic countermeasures (ECM) equipment of the Caldari Navy's Rook-class combat reconnaissance ships.

What I need you to do is to quickly move this quantrium to the designated station for transshipment to the slavers' rendezvous point. We will take it from there.
messages.zh:
时间宝贵，我就开门见山吧。一位杰出的加达里企业家，也是一家大型废旧金属企业的总裁的女儿，在与同学一起度假的时候被绑架了。这位女孩以她丰富的夜生活著称，被绑架时，她正身处一个安全状况很差的星系中，她本不该去那种地方的。很显然，她们对父母说了谎，声称她们会去一个非常安全的地方度假。今天早上，我们从那位企业家的安全顾问那里收到急电，并得知那女孩彻夜狂饮之后在沙龙外面被一群凶神恶煞般的人塞入一辆汽车掳走了。

开始的时候我们也希望这不过是一场恶作剧或是误会什么的，但我们最担心的事情随后还是来了。一伙臭名昭著的劳工贩子通过间接渠道与我们取得了联系，并且传来了女孩的DNA序列以证明她还活着。通过检测，女孩的身份已经得到证实。

绑匪只给了我们非常有限的时间来安全地救回女孩，时限一过他们就会把她卖做劳工——我真不敢想象那会带来怎样可怕的后果。如我们所料，他们索要大笔赎金来交换女孩。但比较特别的是，这笔“赎金”是指我们库存的所有量子合金——我们最稀有最昂贵的金属——你只能在加达里白嘴鸦级战斗侦查舰的电子对抗设备的线缆中看到它们。

你要做的就是马上将这些量子合金送往指定空间站以备转运往绑匪指定的接头地点。我们会在那里与你交接。

messages.en: The kidnappers have been listening to our comms, and have heard that you have chosen to quit. They have let us know that we will not see the executive's daughter again. I hope your reasons for quitting are worth the life of an innocent young girl.
messages.zh: 绑匪清楚地知道我们之间的对话，并且已经听说你选择不干了。他们已经扬言，我们再也见不到那位要员的女儿了。我希望你好好解释你退出的原因，那难道比一位无辜女孩的生命更重要吗？

messages.en: Please, pilot, do make haste. The quantrium must be delivered as soon as possible. If we are even one minute late to the rendezvous, the slavers will assume we have involved the authorities, and we will never see the young girl again.
messages.zh: 飞行员，请抓紧时间。必须尽快把量子合金送到他们手中。哪怕你只晚了一分钟到达接头地点，绑匪们都会以为我们通知了有关当局，那我们就再也别想见到那女孩了。

messages.en: We are relieved to hear that you've accepted this important mission. It is imperative that you deliver this cargo with all possible haste.
messages.zh: 你愿意接受这项任务，让我们感到如释重负。你必须尽快将这批货物送到目的地。

messages.en: Several days ago, an internal security team identified a Gallente deep cover saboteur working at one of our clandestine shipyards producing the current generation of Widow-class Black Ops battleships. During a routine quality control check, the shipyard's scientific team was shocked to discover a highly advanced nanite swarm that the saboteur had somehow introduced into the shipyard's stockpile of advanced adhesives used to bond sensor-absorbing coatings to the hulls of our newly-constructed Widows. The effect of this harmful agent is to slowly erode this protective coating, thus increasing the ship's sensor cross-section, making it much easier to detect and attack. Given the slow-acting nature of this particular breed of nanite, it is unlikely that this gradual loss of stealth capability would be noticeable under routine operating conditions, thus placing the ship and its crew at mortal risk when operating in hostile space. Therefore, we need you to immediately transport a large quantity of our new aerogel counteragent to a station for further distribution to the fleet.
messages.zh: 几天前，在我们一座生产当代寡妇级黑隐特勤舰的秘密船厂中，我们的一支内部保安队发现了一名深藏不露的盖伦特间谍。在一次例行质量检测中，船厂里的科学家们吃惊地发现，那间谍竟然通过某种方法将一种非常高级的纳米体掺入了用来将信号吸收涂层与寡妇级船体粘合在一起的高级胶水。这种纳米体的危害之处在于它会慢慢腐蚀那层保护体，而从导致舰船的信号半径增大，使之更容易被敌人侦测到并遭受攻击。由于这种纳米体行动缓慢，所以常规情况下很难察觉到受影响舰船信号半径出现增大这一情况。这样一来，当舰船驶入敌方区域时，这船与其中的船员都有被歼灭的危险。因此，我们要你立刻将我们的一大批新型气凝胶反作用剂送往一座空间站，之后它们会被分发给相关舰队。

messages.en: Your successful delivery of the prototype nanites will undoubtedly save the lives of many Black Ops pilots and crew. You have the makings of a good counter operative!
messages.zh: 你这次成功完成该任务无疑将会拯救许多黑隐特勤舰的飞行员与船员。你绝对是个做反间谍的料！

messages.en: We are disappointed that you've chosen not to accept this critical mission. We will have to find another pilot elsewhere.
messages.zh: 你拒绝如此重要的一项任务让我们很失望。现在我们不得不另寻他人。

messages.en: Produced by the Kaalakiota megacorporation, the Widow-class Black Ops battleship represents the current edge technology for Caldari military vessels used in covert operations. The primary function of the Widow is to conduct infiltration and espionage behind enemy lines. Specifically, when equipped with covert cynosural field generators and covert jump portal generators, the ship can create a “bridge” through which conventional ships are instantly transported, much like a jump gate. The effect of this is to surprise an enemy by instantly “hot dropping” a combat fleet into what was, moments prior, only empty space. In addition, it can also be fitted with ECM modules and cruise missiles such that it can provide jamming capabilities and supporting firepower if necessary. Using this technology, the Widow represents a significant force multiplier in the ongoing conflicts faced by the Caldari State.
messages.zh: 由卡拉吉塔集团制造的寡妇级黑隐特勤舰代表了加达里军事侦察型舰船的最尖端技术。寡妇级的主要作用是捣入敌人后方实施间谍活动。具体地说，就是通过使用隐秘诱导力场发生器以及隐秘跳跃通道发生器，生成一条可让常规舰船通过的跳跃通道，就像星门一样。结果敌方就会惊讶地发现，刚才还是空空如也的区域突然冒出了一支舰队。另外，这种船也能装配ECM装备与巡航导弹，这样便可在必要时提供辅助性的干扰与攻击力。具备如此先进技术的寡妇级因此被广泛运用于加达里参与的各种冲突中，成了该国战场上的中坚力量。

messages.en: Widow-class Black Ops Battleships
messages.zh: 寡妇级黑隐特勤舰

messages.en:
Greetings, {[character]player.name}. Several days ago, an internal security team identified a Gallente deep cover saboteur working at one of our clandestine shipyards producing the current generation of Widow-class Black Ops battleships. He swallowed a hidden poison tablet as we moved in to arrest him, so he is no longer a threat.

However, during a routine quality control check, the shipyard's scientific team was shocked to discover a highly advanced nanite swarm that the saboteur had somehow introduced into the shipyard's stockpile of advanced adhesives used to bond sensor-absorbing coatings to the hulls of our newly-constructed Widows. The effect of this harmful agent is to slowly erode this protective coating, thus increasing the ship's signature radius, making it much easier for our enemies to detect and attack.

Given the slow-acting nature of this particular breed of nanite, it is unlikely that this gradual loss of stealth capability would be noticeable under routine operating conditions, thus placing the ship and its crew at mortal risk when operating in hostile space. Essentially, the Widow's commander would not know that his ship had lost its critical operational advantage until he was detected and targeted by hostile combatants. Given the very specialized role of this ship, not only would the Widow be compromised, but it is possible than any ships he might be bridging in via its covert jump portal generator could be unknowingly hot dropped near a waiting enemy fleet, instead of empty space.

In order to remedy this critical situation, we need you to immediately transport a large quantity of our new aerogel counteragent to a station for further distribution to the fleet. This shipment represents our best and only hope to quickly repair the damage done by the Gallente spy and ensure the safety of our brave Widow pilots and crew.
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}。几天前，在我们一座生产当代寡妇级黑隐特勤舰的秘密船厂中，我们的一支内部保安队发现了一名深藏不露的盖伦特间谍。那家伙在我们正要去逮捕他的时候自吞了一颗毒药，所以也没法再对我们构成威胁。

但是，在一次例行质量检测中，船厂里的科学家们吃惊地发现，那间谍竟然通过某种方法将一种非常高级的纳米体掺入了用来将信号吸收涂层与寡妇级船体粘合在一起的高级胶水。这种纳米体的危害之处在于它会慢慢腐蚀那层保护体，而从导致舰船的信号半径增大，使之更容易被敌人侦测到并遭受攻击。

由于这种纳米体行动缓慢，所以常规情况下很难察觉到受影响舰船信号半径出现增大这一情况。这样一来，当舰船驶入敌方区域时，这船与其中的船员都有被歼灭的危险。也就是说，寡妇级飞行员只在被敌方侦测锁定之后才会意识到他所驾驶的舰船已经失去了以前的隐形能力。由于这种船职责特殊，所以除了其自身被暴露之外，它还可能导致被其隐秘跳跃力场发生器传输进去的舰船莫明其妙地出现在敌方舰队身旁，而不是一片空旷区域。

为了解决这一严重问题，我们要你立刻将我们的一大批新型气凝胶反作用剂送往一座空间站，之后它们会被分发给相关舰队。要迅速解决那个盖伦特间谍造成的问题并保证我们英勇的寡妇级飞行员与船员的安全，这批东西是我们最好同时也是唯一的希望。

messages.en: We are disappointed that you've chosen not to complete this critical mission. You've left our Black Ops teams at great risk. We will have to find another operative elsewhere.
messages.zh: 你放弃这重要任务让我们很失望。你这是把我们的黑隐特勤舰队往火坑里推啊。现在我们不得不另寻他人。

messages.en: Do not contact me on an open channel until this mission is complete. Remember, this is a clandestine operation!
messages.zh: 请等任务完成之后再通过这个公开频道联系我。记住，这是项秘密行动！

name.de: Auf der Jagd nach Black Dog
name.es: A la caza del Perro Negro
name.ru: В погоне за Черным Псом (Hunting Black Dog)

messages.en: Good. We appreciate your assistance in this matter. Please ensure this operation continues to enjoy the level of security that we've been able to sustain so far. Make no stops, scheduled or unscheduled, between this station and the final destination.
messages.zh: 很好。谢谢你能伸出援手。你一定要像我们一样谨慎行事，确保整个行动的安全。无论发生什么情况，都不要在中途做任何停留。

messages.en: A team of mercenaries led by a man calling himself “Black Dog” has killed one of our senior managers as he toured an asteroid field not far from here. Intelligence has indicated that he intends to continue these operations into the foreseeable future. To remedy this unacceptable situation, we need you to transport a trained assassin and his entourage to a station closer to the scene of the crime. Once this is done, you will have completed the terms of this contract. We appreciate your discretion in this endeavor.
messages.zh: 一群由一个自称“黑狗”的人带领的雇佣兵在我们的一位资深管理人员视察离这儿不远的小行星矿带时把他给谋害了。情报显示“黑狗”打算在可预见的将来继续这类行刺行动。我们不允许这样的事再发生，因此我们需要你将一位训练有素的清道夫及其手下送往一座离事发地很近的空间站。只要你把他人送到，你就履行了合同。希望你能谨慎行事。

messages.en: We just received word from Mr. Smith that you did indeed deliver him on time and without attracting any unusual inquiries. We hope the compensation for this mission was worth your time. The Caldari State can use more competent and discretionary pilots like you.
messages.zh: 我们刚收到史密斯先生传来的消息说你已经将他准时送到了目的地，中间没出任何岔子。希望这次任务的赏金能让你觉得物有所值。加达里需要更多像你这样能干谨慎的飞行员。

messages.en: Your unwillingness to assist us in this matter is going to cost this corporation a great deal of isk until we can find some other way to resolve it. Mr. Smith may soon take a personal interest in you, as you've now disrupted his lucrative contract. I certainly don't want to be in your shoes once he gets the word.
messages.zh: 如果我们找不到其他解决此事的方法，那你这次拒绝将让本公司在经济上损失很多。你可能很快就会引起史密斯先生的注意，谁让你断了他的财路呢？一旦他知道此事，你就等着挨教训吧。

messages.en: We all know the saying, “business is war.” Nowhere is this adage practiced more seriously than in the Caldari corporate world. The soldiers in this fight are typically thought of as the salesmen, managers, executives, and other boardroom warriors. However, from time to time a very special skill set is required to deal with an equally specific threat. For these situations, corporate assassins are sometimes required to resolve issues that cannot be otherwise remedied through conventional channels. In the most extreme cases, these highly-trained operatives, most of whom served particularly arduous and dangerous careers in the Caldari Special Forces and intelligence groups, are hired to carry out very selective missions with very limited goals. The missions they are paid, - highly paid at that - to undertake would rival any holovid espionage movie, though the consequences are, of course, much more serious. You don't want to mess with these guys, and gals, as it is usually the last thing you'll ever do.
messages.zh: 我们都知道这样一句话“商场即战场”。加达里军团是这句话的最典型代表。人们一般都把销售人员、经理、执行高层及其他董事会成员认为是这类战场中的士兵。不过有时为了对付某些不寻常的威胁，军团也需要运用具备同样不寻常技能的人。这种情况下，军团会要求军团清道夫去解决通过常规渠道无法解决的问题。这种清道夫受过良好训练，大多数都曾在加达里特种部队与情报部门里服过役。他们被雇佣去执行那些经过再三斟酌，目标非常明确的任务。这些任务的报酬极其可观，过程可以媲美谍战电影中的情节，不过其造成的后果可要严重许多。这些人都是惹不起的。

messages.en: Corporate Assassins
messages.zh: 军团清道夫

messages.en:
Before we begin, I must make one thing perfectly clear: You were never here, and this meeting never took place. You do understand what I mean, yes?

We are in need of a pilot who can deliver a very sensitive cargo from this station to a nearby station, without attracting any undue attention. You may have heard in the news or the local gossip channels that a Caldari regional director for mining operations was murdered yesterday by unknown assailants while touring an asteroid field in his personal shuttle. That much is indeed true. However, what has not been reported is that we have, in the last few hours, learned the identity of the assassin, a mercenary who goes by the name “Black Dog”, and that he and his team have already begun to plan for an ongoing hit-and-run campaign designed to try and scare off Caldari corporations from any future mining activities in the region.

Of course, we cannot allow this kind of disruption to what has proven a highly lucrative endeavor – the Board and our shareholders simply will not tolerate any further dips in revenues. To remedy this interruption, one of our sister companies that specializes in, shall we say, discrete solutions, has loaned us one of their most highly trained specialists to resolve this issue. His name, as you might expect, is Mr. Smith. His mission, in brief, is to liquidate Black Dog, along with any associates that may be operating with him at the time.

What we need from you, and need soon, is for you to transport Mr. Smith and his entourage to a station closer to the action – one with a hangar walkway the leads directly to an unmarked office. Once you have dropped him off, your role in this action will be complete.

So, what is it going to be, pilot? We need a yes or no right now if this operation is to stay on schedule.
messages.zh:
在我和你正式谈之前，让我先把一件事说清楚：首先，你从未来过这里；然后，我们之间也从未有过这次会面。怎么样，懂我什么意思吧？

我们现在急需一位做事谨慎、能将一批敏感物资从这座空间站运往附近另一座空间站的飞行员。你可能从新闻或者本地小道消息渠道中已经了解到昨天有一位加达里矿采作业区域长官遭不明刺客谋害，他们都说这事正好在他乘坐私人穿梭机视察矿场的时候发生。此事不假，确实已经发生。但报道中没有提到的是，过去几小时里，我们已经掌握了刺客的身份。他是一个雇佣兵，代号“黑狗”。他和他手下已经开始计划针对加达里军团的游击战，目的是要把这些军团吓得不敢再在该区域里从事任何采矿活动。

我们当然不会对此袖手旁观。我们不能让别人断了我们的财路——董事会和股东绝不允许收入缩减的。为此，我们已经从我们一个姐妹公司那儿租来了一名受过良好训练的特工来帮忙。那个姐妹公司的专长就是……做你想做又不敢做的事。那特工的名字，或许你猜得到，就叫史密斯先生。简要的说，他的任务就是把“黑狗”以及其任何在场同僚都给清理掉。

我们要你马上干的事就是把这位史密斯先生与他的手下送到一座空间站。那座空间站里有一个直通一座貌不惊人的办公室的机库走廊。他们将在离那儿很近的地方下手。只要你把他顺利送达，你的任务就完成了。

怎么样，飞行员，干不干？我们没时间耗，你得马上给个回答。

messages.en: We are disappointed that you've chosen not to complete this critical mission. You've left our executives and even our miners at significant risk from these mercenaries.
messages.zh: 你放弃这重要任务让我们很失望。你把我们的高层甚至那些矿工往那群雇佣兵的火坑里推。

messages.en: Why are you contacting me?
messages.zh: 你联系我干什么？

messages.en: I'm glad to hear you're going to help us out here. We aren't expecting any trouble with this one, but with corporate espionage, you never know – keep your eyes open.
messages.zh: 我很高兴你愿意帮忙。我们不希望出任何差错，不过谁知道商业间谍会做出什么事情来，你要提高警惕。

messages.en: One of our R&D facilities has been working hard to produce a new type of cloaking device for Covert Ops vessels that will allow those ships to remain cloaked while jumping stargates. However, it has recently been brought to our attention that a corporate espionage agent sent by a rival company is targeting this new technology, for obvious reasons. In order to flush him out and arrest him, however, we need to catch him in the act. So, we are asking you to transport a decoy prototype cloaking device from this station to one we designate. With such a juicy target, we feel the spy will not be able to resist making an attempt to steal it somewhere between here and there. We need you to fly this device to that station utilizing absolute secrecy.
messages.zh: 我们的一个研发中心研制出了一种新型的隐形装置，可以使特勤舰船在穿越星门时一直保持隐形状态。但是，最近我们注意到，我们某个竞争对手派出的一个商业间谍盯上了这项新技术，他的意图不言而喻。我们要当场抓住他作案才可以逮捕他。所以，作为诱饵，我们要你将一套隐形装置从这里送往指定地点。那间谍一定会抵挡不住如此大的引诱而试图拿走它的。我们需要你将装置送往那个空间站并保持高度机密。

messages.en: Outstanding job, {[character]player.name}! As you may have heard by now, the spy was caught trying to remove the device from the offload cargo bay on the station. Needless to say, he has a very uncomfortable future ahead of him in one of our interrogation facilities. Thanks to your piloting skills and discretion, our work on the new cloak remains a well guarded secret.
messages.zh: 干的漂亮，{[character]player.name}！你可能已经听说了，那个间谍在试图从空间站卸货舱拿走装置的时候被我们逮住了。毫无疑问，他在我们的审讯机构里的日子不会好过的。由于你杰出的驾驶技巧及谨慎的头脑，我们新隐形装置的研发仍处于高度机密中，非常感谢。

messages.en: Well, we are disappointed that you've turned this one down. We'll have to use one of our own transportation pilots to get this done.
messages.zh: 你不愿意干，我们很失望。我们得派我们自己的飞行员搞定这个了。

messages.en:
Our engineering scientists, working at our highly secure, clandestine R&D facility on a nearby planet have produced a new type of cloaking device that, when fitted to Covert Ops ships, could theoretically enable them to jump through stargates without uncloaking! And yes, I can see by the look on your face that you must think I've had far too many Extra Strength Quafe sodas today. However, I can assure you that, while it may be many years before this technology is perfected and suitable for even experimental use, the science behind it is quite real, and this is where this story takes a very important twist.

Our internal security teams have managed to uncover a plan formulated by one of our competitors to steal the prototype cloaking system at some point between the time it leaves the lab up until it arrives at the field testing facility over in the next system. Problem is, we don't yet know who the spy is, so we devised a plan to get that spy to expose himself so that we can then move in and make the arrest.

To this end, you will be delivering is a very detailed mock-up series of the actual prototype, one that will withstand an initial visual and electronic scrutiny on the part of the thief. In all practical terms, however, these devices could no more cloak a ship than it could cook your morning breakfast. We are naming this event Operation Doorstop, which is our planning team's attempt at humor, given the uselessness of this particular lump of metal and wires. What we do need, though, is your absolute confidentiality on this shipment. If the spy gets any whiff that this is a set-up, we will likely never know who he or she is, and we will remain at ongoing risk of one of our most important R&D projects potentially falling into the wrong hands.

So, what do you say, {[character]player.name}? Willing to take on this rather interesting assignment?
messages.zh:
我们位于邻近某行星的秘密研发中心的工程学家们研制出了一种新型隐形装置，用于装备特勤舰船，并且理论上可以使其在穿越星门的时候保持隐身状态。我明白，从你脸上看得出来你一定以为我喝多了。但是，我要告诉你，虽然这项技术离真正成熟或是用于实验阶段都还为时尚早，但它绝不是一个科幻产品，也正是因为这样，才有接下来的故事。

我们的内部安保力量已经发现了我们一个竞争对手的阴谋，他们试图在我们将装置样本从研究所运往位于邻近星系的试验场途中拿走它。现在问题是，我们不知道那个间谍的身份，所以我们制定了一个计划来引其现身，这样我们就可以去逮捕他。

基于这个目的，你要运送的是一个制作逼真的隐形装置仿制品，那窃贼用肉眼或是用电子探测都是无法辨别真伪的。事实上，这个赝品根本不会使舰船隐形，就像它也不会为你做早餐一样。它就是一堆没用的烂金属片和电线，所以我们的行动小组幽默地称这次行动为“引蛇出洞”。你要做的，就是保证本次运输的绝对机密性。如果那个间谍有一丁点察觉这是个陷阱的话，那我们很可能永远也不知道他是谁了，我们这个最重要之一的科研项目也会继续处于落入敌手的危险之中。

那么，你觉得怎么样，{[character]player.name}？你愿意接受这个蛮有趣的任务吗？

messages.en: By quitting mid-mission you've singlehandedly compromised the whole operation! I doubt we'll be able to flush out the spy now, given the fact that you've interrupted the shipment – no doubt he will sense something is up and simply remain unknown to us.
messages.zh: 你竟然半路打退堂鼓，你一手毁了整个行动！整个运输计划都被你打乱了，那个间谍一定会有所察觉并且躲的远远的，我不知道还能不能把他揪出来了。

messages.en: We know the mission is proceeding well, as we've got a cloaked Covert Ops ship following you at a discrete distance. Please contact me only in the event of an emergency.
messages.zh: 我们知道任务进行的很顺利，我们派了一艘隐形特勤船跟在你附近。有紧急情况发生的时候再来找我。

messages.en: Good, glad to hear it. I will immediately order the refrigerated secure containers moved into your cargo hold for your prompt departure.
messages.zh: 很好，就爱听这个。我马上会叫人将冰冻的安全货柜装入你的货柜舱里，以便你迅速出发。

messages.en: In order to get around the laws pertaining to the transportation of illegal drugs through Amarr Empire space, we have been forced to create new and unknown substances for use on, or by, rather, our various slave labor enclaves. This new drug, Blue Paradise, does away with many of the harmful chemicals previously used while actually increasing the pleasurable effects. We are certain that, properly controlled and distributed, introduction of this drug into the slave labor workforce will increase productivity by a substantial margin. We are counting on you to deliver it to the designation transshipment station as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 为了规避艾玛境内禁运违禁药物的法律，我们不得不开发尚未被人熟知的新药品，以用于我们的劳工劳工群体。与过去同类药品不同的是，这种被称为“蓝色天堂”的新药并不会产生有害副作用，反而能提升服药者的愉悦感。我们相信，只要正确监控并适量供给，这种新药能在很大程度上提升劳工劳工的生产力。现在就靠你了，快去把药品送往那指定的中转空间站吧。

messages.en: Excellent. We are transferring your cargo to a dozen smaller ships equipped for high speed runs to the more remote work sites in the region. I see a lot of profit in your future, {[character]player.name}, if you stick with us.
messages.zh: 很好。我们已经开始将你送去的货柜进行拆分，装到十几艘较小的舰船里，让它们快速赶赴该星域里那些偏远的工地。{[character]player.name}，如果我们能继续合作，我想你一定能赚大钱。

messages.en: Well, you have certainly wasted my very valuable time. I thought we could count on you, but obviously I was misinformed. Don't count on working for me any time soon.
messages.zh: 哎，你浪费了我宝贵的时间。原本还以为你靠得住，但明显我是被忽悠了。近期你是肯定从我这儿接不到活了。

messages.en:
We all know that there have been a long series of proclamations, laws, and rules banning the transportation of illegal drugs (and some legal drugs) in Amarr space for use in slave labor. These prohibitions have typically had no real teeth, unless of course the Empress herself sets forth an official decree specifically banning a given substance. The logical, time-tested way around this has been to create entirely new generations of performance enhancing biochemical drugs.

As slaves are typically wary of any pills or other obvious means of altering their behavior (recalling, as we must, the various slave uprisings that have occurred when we tried to openly force drugs on them), we've had to resort to less obvious methods. For example, we have surreptitiously and gradually delivered the drugs into laborer's systems through aerosols in their habitat ventilation systems, impregnated substances into their foodstuffs and water supplies, and other rather clever means, I won't go into here. What is important is that the result has almost always been a positive one, with significant increases in worker productivity.

The downside to this, however, has been a decline in overall slave lifespans due to the long term effects of these drugs. Normally, this would be considered simple attrition; a cost of doing businesses. However, as it continues to become more and more difficult to obtain new slaves (particularly given the intolerable and unjust interference of the other empires), this solution is less and less viable. We need them to live as long as possible. This reality, of course, leads us to the only other benign option – drugs as a part of a rewards system for those slaves who meet a certain work quota each day.

To this end, we shall continue to develop new substances to both avoid interference by Customs and police forces and to ensure the maximum possible output by our slave laborers.
messages.zh:
我们都知道有很多条款、法律及规定都严禁在艾玛境内运输用于劳工劳工的违法药物（有些合法药物也被禁运）。那些条条框框一般都得不到执行，除非是女皇亲自颁布谕旨，明令禁止某种药物。绕开这些限制的一个自然而然而又屡试不爽的办法就是开发全新一代的机能增强型生化药品。

由于对那些改变行为的药物或为达到这一目的而明目张胆施行的措施，劳工们一般都很排斥（我们不能忘记那些因让他们强行服药而爆发的抗争），因此我们不得不采取较为隐秘的手法。比如，我们曾通过劳工宿舍通风系统中的气溶胶将药物悄无声息地散布给他们，曾将药物溶在他们的食物与用水里……还有其他更聪明的手法，我这儿就不一一列举了。重要的是这样做之后总能收到奇效，劳工们的生产力大为提升。

但这样做的缺点就是这些药产生的长期副作用降低了他们的总体寿命。一般情况下这就当作是设备损耗，也很正常。但随着获得劳工的难度越来越大（这很大程度上要归咎于其他帝国在此方面进行毫无道理、让人无法接受的干涉），这样做的可持续性越来越低。我们因此要延长劳工们的寿命。这样一来，我们只能采取唯一一种温和措施——药物。将药物作为奖励机制的一部分，发给那些每天工作量达标的劳工享用。

为此我们必须继续新药物的研发。这样一来可以避开海关与警察的骚扰；二来也能确保劳工能以最高效率工作。

messages.en: Biochemical Agents for Improved Slave Workloads
messages.zh: 提高劳工工作产量的生化药品

messages.en:
History has shown us that a properly motivated slave work force can work harder and longer - especially in harsh conditions - if they are provided the means to enhance their everyday lives. Well, for many decades, the provision of various stimulant drugs to slave laborers was considered a standard method of doing business. However, the downside to this was that, while the use of stims typically increased productivity, more often than not it resulted in significant long term health problems for the slaves leading to shortened lifespans and, more importantly, to decreased profits. So, while the use of stimulants has largely been discontinued, the idea that drugs could increase slave output never entirely went away, though it did require a new approach.

To this end, my company recently developed an inexpensive new drug that works on the pleasure centers of the brain, providing what we might call a “reward” for hard work. Importantly, this drug, known as Blue Paradise, or "Beep" as the techs call it, has been proven in real-world testing to increase slave labor output by as much as twenty percent across the board, without any known long term health problems. As you can guess, the increased profit potential here is, well, staggering. Equally important is the fact that we have not reported this new drug to the various control boards; nor do we intend to at this juncture.

We need you to deliver a very large shipment of this drug to a forward logistics hub station from which it will be transshipped to ore mines, agricultural farms, and other slave-intensive operations. I can give you my guarantee that this cargo will not be flagged by customs or the police, as it is not yet deemed an illegal substance.

So, can we count on you to deliver this?
messages.zh:
历史告诉我们，只要我们有办法让劳工的生活变得丰富起来，我们就等于在激励他们，他们工作起来也会更卖力更持久，尤其是在艰苦条件下。几十年来，让劳工们服用各类刺激性药品是业界一贯的做法。但它有一个缺点：刺激性药品虽然能提升生产力，但这类药物也会经常引发劳工罹患促使他们早死的严重慢性病，从而直接导致我们利润减少。但话又反过来说，虽然业界基本上都已停用了这类刺激品，但利用药物提升劳工生产力的这一想法一直没有被全盘否决，不过如果真要再实践这一想法，确实需要一套全新的思路。

为此，我的公司最近开发出一种廉价的新药品，它作用于大脑的快乐中枢，对工作勤奋的劳工们来说，这也算是对他们的一种“奖励”。这种被称为“蓝色天堂”的药品其重要之处在于，经临床试验后，它的劳工生产力提升效果被证实高达百分之二十，且未导致任何长期副作用。或许不说你也知道，这药中暗藏的利润十分可观。另外非常重要的一点就是，我们还没有将该药上报给各监控机构，而且目前也没有这样做的打算。

我们现在需要你将一大批这种药送往一个后勤中转空间站，那个空间站之后会把它们分发到矿场、农场及其他使用大量劳工劳工的工地。由于这种药尚未被列入违禁品，因此我可以向你保证它们不会被海关或警察没收。

怎么样，我们能把这差儿交给你办吗？

messages.en: There are few things I despise more than a quitter. If you come back to my station I am sure we can find you a position on the station slave labor gang, scrubbing the personal hygiene tanks with a toothbrush for the next six months.
messages.zh: 半途而废的人是我最鄙视的几类人之一。如果你再来我空间站，我会让你干一份适合劳工劳工干的活：用牙刷清洗浴缸，干六个月。

messages.en: See, I told you this would be a smooth run. Customs and the police have been advised that you will be transiting their space and that you are not to be disturbed. Have a safe flight. Hell, you can practically autopilot this one!
messages.zh: 这次运输不会有什么麻烦。海关与警察已经知道你会经过他们的区域，他们不会来骚扰你的。祝你一路顺风。你这次甚至可以依赖自动导航！

name.fr: Le temps de la guerre approche

messages.en: Do not fail us, {[character]player.name}. The Federation is depending on you.
messages.zh: 别让我们失望，{[character]player.name}。联邦这次就靠你了。

messages.en: Federation R&D specialists have been working to find counters for Caldari military tactics; the latest development is a special type of ammunition that works similarly to a lock breaker bomb, but on a single target. I want you to take it over to a navy base for testing, and you need to keep word of this development from going very far.
messages.zh: 联邦的科研专家们一直在寻找可以对抗加达里军队战术的办法；他们的最新成果是一种特别的弹药。该弹药的效能类似于锁定干扰炸弹，不过，它是对单个目标起作用。我需要你把它送到一处海军基地进行测试，而且你要对此项技术严格保密。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. You are a true child of the Federation.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。你真是联邦的好儿女。

messages.en: I'm disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}. I thought your loyalty might mean more to you.
messages.zh: 我对你十分失望，{[character]player.name}。我原以为你很看重自己的忠诚。

messages.en: There has always been contention over the effectiveness of the Federation's sensor-dampening ewar tactics against the State's ECM. Some military scientists feel that, in adding ECM to the hybrid arsenal, the Federation would be admitting to a weakness and confirming the State's superiority; others argue that turning the enemy's tactics against them is an essential facet of wartime, and that rejecting the opportunity is effectively signing off on the Federation's defeat. The debate rages in both the staterooms and the laboratories even as research and development continues.
messages.zh: 联邦针对敌人ECM装置所采用的感应抑阻电子战术的效果一直饱受质疑。许多军事专家认为，在混合武器上加装ECM，就等于是承认了联邦的弱点并助长了敌人的气焰；另一些人则认为，“师夷长技以制夷”正是战争中不可或缺的部分，而且拒绝接受这样的机会就等于是不战而降。这种争论从国会内部一直蔓延到实验室，而与此同时，相关的研究工作仍在进行中。

messages.en: Electronic Counter-Countermeasures
messages.zh: 反电子战对策

messages.en:
I'm sure you're all too aware of our war with the Caldari State. It's been dragging on for years with no end in sight... until now, that is. We've been making some good headway on the active front and our research and development has been busy behind the scenes. Military scientists have developed a hybrid round that works like single-target burst ECM, and it's time to introduce it to the military for an active field-test.

Take these over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh:
我相信你很清楚我们在和加达里合众国交战。这战争延续了很多年，看不到休止…但现在情况有了变化。我们在前线取得了一些不错的进展，而我们的科研人员也在后方忙着出力。军事科学家们研制出了一种混合弹药，它就像一种针对单个目标的ECM脉冲波。现在是时候把它介绍给军方并进行实地试验了。

把这些样品送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去。

messages.en: I'm disappointed, {[character]player.name}. If we find that you've shared this with the Caldari, it will not go well for you.
messages.zh: 我对你十分失望，{[character]player.name}。如果我们发现你把此事告诉了加达里人，你的下场会很惨。

messages.en: Have you finished your delivery, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把货送到了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Our deepest thanks for taking on this mission. I can tell you that our best analysts feel that you should be fairly safe in this mission, as the terrorist will have to focus all their efforts on targeting the stricken cruiser. They simply won't have the ships or the time to even attempt to interdict your ship as you make your way to the destination station.
messages.zh: 你能接受该任务，我们对你感激不尽。我们最好的分析师觉得这次任务中你会比较安全，因为恐怖份子都把精力放在对付我们那艘损坏的巡洋舰上了。他们不会有多余的船或时间用来半路阻击你。

messages.en: While transporting Minmatar slaves from a recently close ore mine to a new mineral harvesting facility in nearby system, the convoy was attacked by terrorists, destroying the escort frigates and heavily damaging the Harbinger-class battlecruiser carrying the slaves. We believe it is likely that the terrorists will return, and in larger ships, to attempt a rescue of the slaves before we can respond with reinforcements. The window of opportunity for the terrorists is short, so it is imperative that we immediately render as much help as possible. What we need you to do is deliver a contingent of heavily armed marines recently trained in counter-boarding operations to a station closer to the site of the battle. From there, they will join other Amarr military and rescue teams for immediate transportation to the damaged cruiser.
messages.zh: 在将米玛塔尔劳工从最近刚关闭的一座矿场转移到附近一个星系中一座新的矿物开采基地时，整个舰队都遭到了恐怖份子的袭击。他们击毁了我们全部的护航护卫舰，并且重创了载有劳工的一艘先驱者级战列巡洋舰。我们觉得那些恐怖份子有可能开着大船卷土重来，趁我们增援没到之前夺去那些劳工。他们能下手的时间很短，所以我们必须立即派出增援。我们要你做的就是将一支最近刚受过反登陆训练的全副武装的海军陆战队运往靠近战场的一座空间站。他们到了那儿之后会与其他艾玛士兵与援救小队立刻赶赴被重创的巡洋舰。

messages.en: We've received confirmation that you did indeed fulfill your promise and deliver the Marines to the station. As we speak, the combined rescue team is loading into other ship for immediate transport to the Harbinger. Hopefully, we will reach them in time.
messages.zh: 我们收到确认消息，你已经兑现了你的承诺，将那些海军陆战队员送到了那座空间站。那支综合营救队正在登上其他舰船，马上就会赶赴那艘先驱者级。但愿我们能及时抵达。

messages.en: We will not forget this – the moment you chose to abandon our people in a time of great need. Your assistance could have turned the tide of this whole disaster. Do not contact me again.
messages.zh: 我们不会忘记你在我们迫切需要援助的时候对我们的人置之不顾。如果你能出手相助，应该可以扭转目前的灾难性局势。我不想再与你有任何联系。

messages.en:
A short time ago, Minmatar terrorists in a combined fleet of frigates and cruisers attacked one of our Harbinger-class strategic cruisers as it was transporting slaves from a recently closed mine to a new mineral harvesting facility in a nearby system. While all but one of the attackers was annihilated, our convoy's escorts were destroyed and our cruiser is burning. Making a bad situation worse, we are anticipating that the terrorists will return in force within the next several hours to attempt the theft of our slaves, as they almost certainly know the cruiser is alone and all but helpless.

Our concern is that if the terrorists feel that they have a window of opportunity to recover these slaves, it is likely that they will throw everything they have into the effort. Our intelligence assessments of the terrorists' fleet assets are even less reassuring: we believe that they could send as many as four battlecruisers into this fight – more than enough to wipe out the arriving frigates and forcefully board our heavily damaged strategic cruiser. However, we have calculated that if we can delay any terrorist boarding parties long enough, this should give us enough time for the much larger main rescue fleet to arrive.

The only bright side to this situation, in what is unquestionably an act of divine providence, is that a large contingent of marines are aboard this station as we speak, having just completed specialized refresher training in counter-boarding operations. We need you to deliver them to the station closest to the last reported position of our cruiser. From there, we will transport a combined team of marines, engineers, medics, and other essential personnel to hopefully stop the fire and save the ship - along with its cargo of highly valuable slaves. However, this mission must be undertaken immediately. Any delay will surely doom the Harbinger and her brave crew.
messages.zh:
不久前，一支由护卫舰与巡洋舰组成的米玛塔尔恐怖份子舰队袭击了我们的一艘先驱者级战列巡洋舰。我们的那艘战列巡洋舰当时正在将一批劳工从最近刚关闭的一座矿场转移到附近一个星系中一座新的矿物开采基地。虽然我们将对方消灭得只剩下一艘船，但我们的护航船只也遭到全军覆没，那艘战列巡洋舰也已经起了火。更糟的是，我们预计恐怖份子会在接下来几个小时里卷土重来，抢去我们的劳工，因为他们应该清楚地知道我们那艘战列巡洋舰目前正孤苦伶仃地被困在原地。

我们担心的是，一旦这帮恐怖份子觉得他们有机会夺回劳工，他们会倾尽全力跟我们死拼。而我们的情报人员对他们舰队的分析结果更让人不安：我们相信对方会派多达4艘战列巡洋舰投身战场，这将足以剿灭掉我们派去的所有护卫舰，而且还能让恐怖份子强行登陆我们那艘遭到严重创伤的巡洋舰。不过，我们也计算过，如果我们能把对方拖住并且坚持的时间够长，那我们就能确保我方援救大部队能在这段时间内及时赶到现场。

现在唯一对我们有利的一点就是，本空间站内正好有一大批海军陆战队员，他们刚刚完成了反登陆这一项特殊训练。这无疑是神在给我们雪中送炭。我们要你将这批人立刻送往离我们那艘巡洋舰最新一次报告位置最近的一座空间站。然后，我们会从那座空间站将一支由海军陆战队、工程师、医疗兵及其他重要人员组成的队伍送到那艘巡洋舰那儿，希望他们能及时将船上的火扑灭，将它与其货柜舱里的劳工一并救下。但你必须立马执行这项任务，否则那先驱者级与其上船员必死无疑。

messages.en: Quitting? Now?  You have placed our marines and hundreds of other personnel in grave danger by abandoning them mid-mission. We will have to find some way to get them to our damaged strategic cruiser, though I feel it is now too late.
messages.zh: 退出？现在？你在任务进行在一半时就抛弃了我们的海军陆战队员与数百名其他人员，你这是将他们往悬崖上送。虽然时间可能已经来不及，我们还是得另想法子将他们送到我们那艘被损的巡洋舰那儿。

messages.en: Excellent news, pilot, thank you for updating us as to your position and condition. Please make all possible speed to the destination so that we can then dispatch the combined rescue team package.
messages.zh: 真是个好消息，飞行员。谢谢你向我们报告你的最新位置及状况。接下来请全力以赴赶往目的地，这样我们才能派出我们的综合营救队。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. Please hurry.
messages.zh: 谢了，{[character]player.name}。请快点。

messages.en: I have to request a difficult task of you: play nice with a swarm of Angel Cartel representatives and their entourage on your ship. Hopefully they won't try to cause you trouble.
messages.zh: 我想请你办一件有难度的事：礼貌地招待一帮天使联合企业的代表，并把他们接过来。他们应该不会给你找麻烦。

messages.en: Excellent, thank you, {[character]player.name}. I think we got our point across to them; there are some things you do not try to push in the Republic.
messages.zh: 很好，谢谢，{[character]player.name}。我想咱们已经让他们长了记性；在共和国的地界上，有些事情不能犯。

messages.en: I'm disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}, but I can understand why you might decline.
messages.zh: 你真让我失望，{[character]player.name}，不过我能理解为什么你拒绝这件事。

messages.en: The Angel Cartel's reputation for engaging in any activity regardless of its legality has earned it the DED's description of the most dangerous criminal organization in the cluster. With a corporate command structure and open recruitment policy, the Cartel are less thugs than sharks in pinstripe suits, capable of operating on all levels of society. With a major operational base in Etherium Reach on the edge of Minmatar space, the Cartel is held with deep suspicion within the Republic. Their annexation of the Skarkon system in YC 110 and sudden withdrawal left many unanswered questions regarding both the Cartel's intentions towards the Republic and what deals were forged under the table to make them leave... and what those deals might have cost.
messages.zh: 天使联合企业因为从事各类非法勾当而恶名远播，并且被DED描述为宇宙中最危险的犯罪组织。它以公司机制运作并且公开招聘成员，旗下人员们外表衣冠楚楚，在社会各个层面上都很吃得开。联合企业的主要运作基地位于琉蓝之穹，邻近米玛塔尔空域，因此共和国对他们疑心很重。新伊甸纪元110年，联合企业吞并了斯卡尔克恩星系，但随后又突然撤出该星系。这一举动引发了很多怀疑，例如，联合企业对共和国的企图，促成前者撤离的幕后交易内容…以及后者为了该交易所付出的代价。

messages.en: Borderland Outlaws
messages.zh: 边境歹徒

messages.en:
This is a list of people I want you to escort to a meeting. They have quite a large security entourage, and as you can see from some of the names, they have a reason for it. These people are members of the Angel Cartel. While the Cartel are thugs and pirate scum, and are not particularly welcome in Minmatar space, it does not mean that some corporations don't have certain dealings with them.

This isn't your usual business meeting this time, however. Evidently, the Cartel overstepped their bounds, and the corporation took it to the Republic. Escort these Angel representatives to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; we'll take care of the rest. For the sake of appearances, try to treat them politely. We don't want them to know it's a set-up until they get to the boardroom.
messages.zh:
我需要你护送这份名单上的人去参加一个会议。这些人会有很多保安随行，而从名单上的名字你就可以看出，如此小心是有原因的。他们正是天使联合企业的成员。虽说米玛塔尔境内并不欢迎这些联合企业的海盗、暴徒和人渣，然而总有一些军团还和他们有特定的业务往来。

不管怎样，这次可不是一般的商务会议。很明显，联合企业的活动有些越界了，吃亏的军团于是告到了共和国。护送这些天使代表前往{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}；我们将处理后续事宜。为了保持形象，最好对他们客气点。在他们走进会议室之前，我可不想让他们察觉这是个圈套。

messages.en: I'm extremely disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你太让我失望了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Hello, {[character]player.name}. Have you finished your work for me?
messages.zh: 你好，{[character]player.name}。我托付你的事情办好了吗？

messages.en: Just don't watch those, okay? They gave me nightmares.
messages.zh: 别看那些行吗？它们让我做恶梦。

messages.en: The Natural Way is a group which promotes a lower-tech way of life. They're throwing around a lot of cred to start a fitness initiative encouraging kids to stay away from body modding, and I see nothing wrong with encouraging them in exchange for a little ISK.
messages.zh: 自然之道是一个宣扬朴素生活的团体。他们花费巨资来推动一项健身计划，鼓励孩子们远离身体改装的行为。我觉得帮他们一把，同时挣点钱，没什么不好的。

messages.en: Thanks a lot, {[character]player.name}. My mother's been giving those to my kids for their birthdays every year, and I was afraid I'd never get rid of them.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。我母亲每年都把那些当作生日礼物送给我的孩子们，恐怕我永远都无法摆脱它们。

messages.en: What? Who doesn't want to take advantage of anti-tech crazies?
messages.zh: 什么？谁不想从这些反科技的二百五身上捞一笔？

messages.en: Body modification, or "modding," is widely accepted throughout the Federation, primarily for cosmetic purposes. Color-changing tattoos which move, programmable "makeup" which is implanted in subcutaneous layers, piercings and body-shaping are the most common forms, so normal they're barely worth mentioning. The wilder forms of modding, however, can frequently give people the wrong idea. Parents who want to discourage their children from engaging in extreme modding may sometimes turn to groups which support lower-tech ways of life for educational programs, particularly in the tumultuous teenage years when youngsters start to seek their personal identity.
messages.zh: 基于美观需要的身体改造，或者“改装”，在整个联邦里被广泛接受。常见的例子有，可以浮动的变色纹身，位于皮下的可编程的“妆容”肤层，身体穿孔，塑形等。这些改造已经普通到了烂大街的程度。不过，更加夸张的改造类型经常会给人们留下错误的印象。那些不赞成自己的孩子们进行极端身体改造的父母们，有时会求助于某些提倡朴素生活进入学校课程的团体。此类课程尤其针对那些躁动的、开始追求自我形象的青春期少年。

messages.en: The Altered Generations
messages.zh: 改装的一代

messages.en: There's a fitness initiative going through Federation schools. I'm sure you've heard about it? A weird luddite group called The Natural Way wants to get kids to stop relying on modding to stay in shape, and they're tossing cred around like water to do so. No school would turn down money in exchange for a couple hours' fitness classes a week. Take these {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} over to one of their facilities at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and we'll see some of that money, too.
messages.zh: 联邦的各个学校里正在开展一项健身行动。我相信你肯定听说过这件事？一个名叫自然之道的怪异反主流团体，想让孩子们停止依赖身体改造来保持体形；为了实现目标，该团体可以说是花钱如流水。任何学校都不会因为每周增加几小时的健身课而拒绝这笔钱。把这些{[item]objectiveTypeID.name}带去他们位于{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的一处设施，这样咱们也能分一杯羹啦。

messages.en: Well, fine. But burn the holos. We don't want normal people watching that stuff.
messages.zh: 好吧。不过，要把那些全息盘烧掉啊。咱们可不能让普通人观看那些材料。

messages.en: You haven't WATCHED those, have you?
messages.zh: 你该不会是看了那些材料吧，有木有？

messages.en: Thanks a lot, {[character]player.name}. I'll make it worth your while.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。我不会让你白干的。

messages.en: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is hosting a fashion show for publicity, and your agent needs you to pick up the models. For some reason, they think you won't get fed up and drop them all off in orbit around the nearest moon.
messages.zh: 出于宣传目的，{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}将要举办一场时尚秀，而你的代理人要你去把那些模特接来。基于某种考虑，他们觉得你不会因为受不了那些模特而把她们扔在邻近的行星轨道上或什么地方的。

messages.en: Good to hear, {[character]player.name}! I imagine you're happy to have that lot off your hands.
messages.zh: 干的好，{[character]player.name}！甩掉那些家伙，你一定很高兴吧。

messages.en: Regrettable, but I can't say I blame you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 很遗憾，不过我也不能责备你什么，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: In a culture as materialistic and appearance-conscious as the Gallente, the ability to stay on the bleeding edge is a valuable asset. “Clothes,” fashion critic Marko Envaumier said in a well-known interview with the Scope, “are an outward expression of man's inner nature and outlook toward life. Professional secretaries study fashion alongside the other office skills ... to learn to gauge the worth of both potential clients and employees for the companies that hire them. Next time you walk into an office, remember that the boy or girl behind the desk is checking your tailoring.”
messages.zh: 在盖伦特人的物质主义和外表至上主义面前，游走于时尚最前沿的能力显得格外弥足珍贵。时尚评论家马可·恩瓦米尔在与《视角》所做的一次著名访谈中曾提到：“服装，是一个人内在本质及人生观的外在表现。专业的秘书会在学习其它工作技能的同时学习时尚，以学会衡量潜在客户以及公司雇员所能带来的价值。下次你再走进办公室时，要知道其他人正在打量你的穿着。”

messages.en: Gallente Haute Couture
messages.zh: 盖伦特高级时装

messages.en: The Federal Talent Showcase is upon us, that time of year where all the artists and “artists” come out of hiding and shove the products of the past year in our faces. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is playing host to a fashion show and we need someone to pick up the models and fashionistas from {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. You can kind of guess what they're like – a normal pilot just isn't good enough for them, so I have to find a capsuleer I think is level-headed enough to not vent cargo into space if they get too annoying. I know you can handle it, it's not like you have to speak with them face to face, anyway.
messages.zh: 联邦的时尚达人秀就要开始了，每年这个时候，所有的艺术家和“伪达人”们会一起跳出来并向我们推介过去一年来的时尚品。{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} 将要举办一场时尚秀，而我们需要有人去{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}把那些模特和时尚达人接来。你可以想像一下他们是怎样一副德行——普通的飞行员肯定是受不了他们的，所以我需要一位头脑冷静的克隆飞行员，至少不会因为那些人太烦而把他们从船上扔出去吧。我知道你能搞定这件事的，反正你也不用和他们面对面地交谈。

messages.en: I'm disappointed, {[character]player.name}. We have a reputation to maintain.
messages.zh: 我很失望，{[character]player.name}，我们可是要面子的。

messages.en: Have you picked up the models yet? The show's only a few hours away!
messages.zh: 你把模特接来了吗？表演几个小时后就要开始了！

messages.en: That is very good news, pilot. I will contact the governor's aide myself to let her know that you have accepted and will be departing shortly.
messages.zh: 很好，飞行员。我会亲自通知首长的助理，告诉她你已接受了任务，将会马上出发。

messages.en: We have recently been experiencing an increase in terrorist attacks by groups seeking to free Amarr slaves in this region. Their raids have become more complex and lethal, resulting in the loss of untold millions of ISK worth of valuable property. More importantly, one of the regional governors is having his annual gala event at his estate on a nearby planet. We need you to deliver a cargo of elite conditioned slaves to a station we will designate. From there they will be transported to the governor's estate by heavily armed ships.
messages.zh: 最近妄图在该地区解放艾玛劳工的恐怖份子团体对我们的袭击越来越频繁。他们的袭击手段越来越复杂，也愈发致命，导致我们损失了不知多少价值数百万的财物。更重要的是，在附近一颗行星上，该地区的一位首长打算在他的宅邸举办他的年度晚会。我们需要你将一批极品劳工运往指定空间站。他们到了那儿之后将被全副武装的舰船转运往那位首长的宅邸。

messages.en: Great job, {[character]player.name}. The slaves are being offloaded now and will be en route to the governor's estate shortly. I can't thank you enough for your reliability and promptness.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。劳工们现正被从船上卸下，很快就会前往首长宅邸了。你能如此安全及时地完成任务，我真是太感谢你了。

messages.en: While I must say I am rather shocked at your refusal to undertake this mission, we are fortunate in that we do have contingency plans in place. So, while we will have to risk the crew and slaves in another run, I feel confident that only you will bear the negative feedback for failing us here today.
messages.zh: 虽然我承认你拒绝这项任务让我大吃一惊，但还好我们还有后备方案。尽管这意味着我们得让船员与劳工再经历一次有生命危险的旅程，不过，我还是敢肯定，只有你会因今天不帮我们而遭到别人的唾骂。

messages.en: While it might seem impossible at first glance, there are indeed small bands of terrorists who seek to upset the very core foundation of our society by working to eliminate slavery throughout the Empire. We have had significant success in disrupting these groups, with many members killed or taken prisoner. Nonetheless, like a hydra they continue to grow and adapt to our tactics and operations, making them a quite annoying thorn in our side. The Amarr Empire is devoting increasing resources to the eradication of these groups; however, even the most optimistic analysts concede that it may be quite some time before this nascent insurgency can be eradicated.
messages.zh: 虽然初看上去难以置信，但确实有一小撮恐怖份子想通过消除艾玛帝国中的劳工制度来动摇我们社会的根基。我们在对抗这些组织的过程中取得过重要胜利，很多人不是死掉就是被俘虏。但是他们就像多头怪一样，阴魂不散，会根据我们的战术行动来调整他们自己的行动策略，这帮恐怖份子就像我们的眼中钉一样讨厌。艾玛帝国不断增派资源去消灭这些团体；但是，即使是最乐观的分析人士也不得不承认，要将这帮萌芽中的游击团体完全剿灭尚需时日。

messages.en: Amarr Anti-Slavery Terrorist Groups
messages.zh: 艾玛反劳工制恐怖组织

messages.en:
You are aware, no doubt, of the rumors of extremist antislavery terrorist groups within the Amarr Empire itself. Well, you know then that their loyalty to the Empire is indeed secondary to their overarching desire to see all slaves freed and made equal members of society. This is a condition that we, as the greatest state in all of New Eden, simply cannot tolerate. However, our efforts at arresting and reeducating those insurgents have largely failed to permanently change the mindsets of these rather fanatical individuals.

This system has been particularly hard hit by this and other like-minded groups. Most recently, an Anathema-class covert ops ship, specially configured to transport elite slaves to the estates of senior Amarr leaders in the region, was somehow decloaked, its weapons and sensors jammed, and ruthlessly attacked to the point of near-total structure failure. The terrorists then demanded the pilot transfer the slaves to this mystery ship, on threat of the total destruction of the covert ops vessel. The pilot complied, though he has since been punished for his cowardice.

It is for this reason that I called you here today. I need you to transport a new shipment of elite slaves to a nearby station for further transshipment to the residence of one of the regional governors. This shipment is of particular urgency as the governor is hosting his annual gala event at his estate, and the usual staff of slaves simply will not do. We need these specific slaves, as they have been trained in protocol, proper food and drink service, entertainment, and numerous other talents that I need not mention here.

Will you take on this courier mission on behalf of the Empire and deliver these highly trained and extremely expensive slaves to the designated station?
messages.zh:
我想你肯定知道艾玛帝国内部有反劳工制的极端主义恐怖份子。效忠帝国对他们而言是次要任务，他们的首要任务是解放全部劳工，让这些劳工成为社会中享有平等权利的普通公民。作为整个新伊甸宇宙中最伟大的国家，艾玛帝国自然无法接受这点。我们将这批人逮捕之后重新教化，但这样做并没有使他们彻底改变其狂妄想法。

这些人及其他类似群体对本星系造成的影响尤为严重。最近，一艘专用来将极品劳工运往艾玛本区域高层领导私宅的咒逐级隐秘侦察舰，在执行任务过程中突然被恐怖份子解除了隐形，武器与感应器都遭到了干扰，结构被轰击地所剩无几。然后他们要求我方飞行员立即将船上劳工都转到他们那神秘的船上，否则就将彻底摧毁侦察舰。那飞行员答应了对方的要求，不过他回来之后至今还在因其当时表现出的懦弱而遭受惩罚。

这也正是我今天要你来的原因。我要你将一批新的极品劳工运到附近一座空间站，他们之后将被转运往本地区一位首长的私宅处。这个运输任务非常紧急，因为那位首长要在他自己家里举办年度晚会，一般的劳工无法胜任。我们需要极品劳工的原因是因为他们在礼节、端酒送菜、表演及其他我不需要在这儿提的诸多技艺方面都受过良好训练。

你愿意接受此任务为帝国将这些经过高度训练，非常昂贵的劳工送往指定空间站吗？

messages.en: You must be kidding?!? I have already guaranteed the governor's office that you are en route and will arrive at the scheduled time. This act on your part is probably going to get me reassigned to some asteroid in an uncharted system a million light years from here. Well, I will make sure I'm not the only one who will feel the heat for this failure.
messages.zh: 你在开玩笑吧？！我已经向那首长保证你已经上路并且会按时抵达。你这样做可能会导致我被调往离这儿一百万光年开外一个没人涉足过星系中的某个小行星带上。我肯定我不会是唯一一个因此遭惩罚的人。

messages.en: Thank you for the update pilot, it is rather reassuring that you are flying without any interference from our unwanted friends. Please contact me again when you are being towed in to the dock, as only then will I feel assured that this courier mission was a success.
messages.zh: 谢谢你通报最新进展，飞行员。知道你路上没遭到任何恶意干扰让我很放心。接下来请等你进站之后再联系我，只有那时我才能确信地知道任务已被顺利完成。

messages.en: Thanks a lot, {[character]player.name}. I knew we could count on you.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。我就知道我们能依靠你。

messages.en: Our spies have succeeded in smuggling pieces of the latest experimental Amarrian starship technology back to the Republic. I need you to take the samples on to the lab where they can be properly analyzed.
messages.zh: 我们的间谍成功地把一些艾玛人最新试验的星舰技术偷运回了共和国。我需要你把这些样本送到实验室，以进行适当的分析。

messages.en: Good job, {[character]player.name}. Our research team is saying the tech deflects target painter beams away towards an area of space just behind the ship it's fitted on. Our torpedoes will start missing targets if they manage to make this widely available. We need to find a way to counter this, and fast.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}。我们的研究团队指出，这种技术能够把目标标记光束反射到使用标记装备的舰船后方区域。如果他们广泛应用此技术，我们的鱼雷就会丢失目标。我们要尽快找到对抗此技术的方法。

messages.en: I guess your loyalty isn't worth as much as I thought.
messages.zh: 看来你的忠诚度没有我想象的那样高。

messages.en: The current war between the Republic and the Empire is not solely left to warfare in space. Spies and sympathizers work behind the scenes to sabotage war efforts and uncover the Empire's secrets, helping the Republic to meet the Empire's forces equally. The Empire has its own spies, however, and the underlying conflict can sap morale and lead to high levels of paranoia.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔共和国和艾玛帝国之间的战争并不局限于太空中的战斗。共和国的间谍与同情者们在幕后破坏艾玛的战争努力，以及刺探帝国的机密。这一切都有助于共和国能够与帝国势均力敌。然而，帝国也有他们的间谍，暗中制造的矛盾会削弱士气，并导致严重的内部猜疑。

messages.en: Staying Ahead
messages.zh: 保持领先

messages.en:
You need to keep this quiet, {[character]player.name}. I know you capsuleers aren't accustomed to being told how to do your job, but this is bigger than anything else and if word gets out, all this effort will be for nothing.

We've acquired samples of the Amarr's latest experimental starship tech. Don't ask me how, I don't want to know, and neither do you. We're not sure what these pieces do; our source is suggesting it's a system that reduces the effectiveness of our electronic warfare systems. This could be bad news for us. Get the stuff over to the lab at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. And keep your trap shut. We don't want it getting back to the Amarr that we have this.
messages.zh:
你得为此事保密，{[character]player.name}。我明白你们克隆飞行员不喜欢让别人指手画脚，但这一次事关重大。如果走漏风声，我们就会前功尽弃。

我们获取了艾玛人最新试验星舰技术的一些样本。别问我是怎么得到的，我不想知道，你最好也别知道。我们还不确定这些技术样本有什么功能；有情报暗示说，它们可以削弱电子战装备。对我们来说，这可不是好消息。把货送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的实验室去。记住，行动要保密。我们可不想让艾玛人知道我们获得了这些东西。

messages.en: I guess your loyalty isn't worth as much as I thought.
messages.zh: 看来你的忠诚度没有我想象的那样高。

messages.en: Have you delivered that stuff to the lab, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把货送到实验室了吗，{[character]player.name}？

name.ru: Состояние Империи (The State of the Empire)

messages.en: Thank you a million times over, pilot, for taking on this mission. The hearts and minds of the Amarr faithful in that station and elsewhere will benefit immeasurably from your prompt delivery of these hallowed holoreels.
messages.zh: 非常感谢你愿意承担这项工作。如果你能及时将影像送往目的地，将给那里的艾玛支持者带去难以估量的心灵慰藉。

messages.en: The regional governor herself delivered an important State of the Region speech yesterday to all her billions of faithful followers. Due to technical problems, however, this message did not reach as many citizens as it should have. Fortunately, we have managed to correct this rather quickly through dispatching a small fleet of interceptors to the problem locations. We need you, however, to take a shipment of holoreels to the station we designate, as our usual contact there is indisposed at the moment and may not be available for some time. When you deliver these to that station, our contact's second-in-command will take charge of the cargo and facilitate further broadcasting.
messages.zh: 昨天，地方长官向她亿万虔诚的支持者们发表了一番关于地区现状的重要演说。由于技术原因，她的演说并不能传达给所有的人。幸运的是，我们很快找出了解决问题的方法——派一小支截击舰队前往不能接收到演说的地区。我们需要你将一些全息影像送往指定地点，那个地方一直联络不畅。你到达那里之后，我们的联络人的副手会接手并负责后面的工作。

messages.en: Thank you so very much, {[character]player.name}. The Amarr representative has already informed us that he is offloading the holoreels as we speak. We will not forget this service to the Empire.
messages.zh: 真是太感谢你了，{[character]player.name}。我们的艾玛信使告诉我们，他已经开始卸货了。我们不会忘记你对帝国的贡献。

messages.en: I must say we are quite disappointed. As you know, all of our pilots are gone, taking these 'reels to the faithful. Your refusal leaves a gap in this coverage that will leave many faithful Amarr without this important message from the governor.
messages.zh: 我必须要说，我们非常失望。你要知道，我们所有的飞行员都出发将这些影像送往各地的支持者手中了。你的拒绝会使得许多虔诚的艾玛支持者不能获得这么重要的信息。

messages.en:
{[character]player.name}! Glad you could make it on such short notice. Let me get right to the point: Yesterday, as you almost certainly know, a regional governor delivered her State of the Region address. Needless to say, we were quite excited and thus put forth a maximum effort to ensure that her speech was broadcast on every possible channel and to the maximum ranges of our civilian and military communications networks.

However, for various reasons at many remote locations, this signal did not reach many who would have otherwise benefitted from this opportunity. For all our efforts, there are some locations that can only be reached the hard way -- ferrying holoreels directly to each and every one of them. We have already dispatched messengers, primarily in interceptors and other fast ships, to these more dangerous destinations.

We need you to transport a quantity of holoreels containing the State of the Region speech to one station in particular and hand them over to an agent who will be waiting for them there. He will then handle all further distribution of the 'reels.

So, can you help us with what should be a straightforward courier job?
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}！很高兴你来的这么快。我们直入主题吧，你一定已经知道了，昨天一位地方长官发表了一番关于地区现状的演说。毫无疑问，我们对此非常振奋，我们尽了最大努力确保她的演说能够最大限度地通过每一个军事及民用频道传播到星域的每个角落。

但是，由于各种原因，许多偏远地区不能接收到信号，失去了这个大好机会。我们再三努力，对于某些地区也只能采用最笨的办法——把演说的全息影像一个一个送过去。我们已经派了信使乘坐截击舰等快船前往这些比较危险的地区。

现在我们需要你将一些记录了整个演说的全息影像送往其中一个空间站，并把它们交给一名已经先期抵达的信使。他随后会安排分配等相关事宜。

怎么样，你愿意承担这次简单的运输任务吗?

messages.en: Well, I was not expecting this. All we needed was for you to make a simple run from this station to the designated station and drop off our cargo. Well, suffice to say, you will not be receiving any prayers of blessing from me tonight!
messages.zh: 嗯，我没想到会这样。我们只不过是要你简单地把货物运到那里而已。告诉你，我今晚肯定是不会为你祈祷了！

messages.en: Our hearts are glad to know that you are en route to the station and will be docking there shortly. Please contact me on arrival.
messages.zh: 很高兴获知你正在前往空间站途中，很快就会抵达。到了那里之后再联系我。

messages.en: Thank you for agreeing to aid the Empire in this matter. My assistant will provide you all the details you will need to deliver these personnel to the designated station.
messages.zh: 感谢你在本次事件中对帝国伸出援手。我的助理会提供给你运送人员前往指定空间站所需的一切细节。

messages.en: During a high-level security assessment, a decoy maglev train designed to mimic the regional governor's chartered train was destroyed by unknown saboteurs while traveling at very high speed. Our investigation has yet to uncover the traitors; however, we are confident that a prompt scientific examination of the wreckage will provide the clues we need to resolve this internal security matter. We are sending a team of senior investigators to the wreck site so that they might help determine the identities of the attackers. We are counting on you to fly them to the designated station.
messages.zh: 在一次高级安全评估行动中，一列伪装成地方长官专列的磁浮列车在高速行驶中遭到不明身份人员摧毁。我们仍在调查并试图找出叛徒的踪迹。不过，我们将第一时间对列车残骸进行科学检测，一定可以找到些线索帮我们解决这次内部安全事件。我们派出了一队高级调查人员去事发地点，他们会帮我们找出袭击者的身份。现在，靠你了！你要把他们送去指定的空间站。

messages.en: Excellent work, pilot. The personnel you transported for us have already developed some interesting leads, and it seems – at least at this early juncture – that the assassins may be of Minmatar descent. Further testing, we expect, will confirm this. We will retain your contact information, should this incident require more of your courier skills.
messages.zh: 干的好，飞行员。你送去的调查人员已经发现了一些有趣的线索。从目前情况来看，袭击者似乎有着米玛塔尔血统。我们希望进一步的检测能够证实这一点。我们会与你保持联系，并可能需要你更多的帮助。

messages.en: We are disappointed in your decision not to assist the Empire in its hour of need. However, we do have another pilot waiting in the next room, so you may leave. And I need not remind you of the consequences should you discuss any of what you have been told here today.
messages.zh: 我们对你很失望，在帝国需要帮助的时候你却选择袖手旁观。不过，旁边房间里还有一位飞行员在等候为帝国效力，所以，你可以走了。我想我也不用提醒你如果你把今天听到的事情到处乱讲的话会有什么后果。

messages.en:
I know the security screening process at this station has been time-consuming and a bit, well, intrusive. Now that you have passed our various tests, however, I feel confident that I can now let you in on the reason you are here.

One of our regional governors had recently been planning an unannounced visit to one of the new planetary command centers in a nearby system. For security reasons, this information was restricted to only those in the governor's inner circle, to include the commander of his personal security detail. Well, this commander decided to test his internal security prior to this event, to best ensure the governor's safe travel. So, for this exercise, he created a painstakingly detailed agenda, identical in every detail to an actual state visit. In this scenario, the governor was to travel by chartered high-speed maglev train to a number of the new planetary command centers.

As the Governor's decoy train traveled through a large canyon, however, a series of explosive charges detonated on the rail line, sending the train off its track and into the canyon wall. As it turned out, the security commander's ruse had worked perfectly; someone in the governor's inner circle had tipped his or her hand and provided information to unknown assassins.

So far, however, we have not been able to determine the traitor's identity, and each member of the inner circle is vehemently denying any involvement, despite our best chemical interrogations. So, what this investigation will likely boil down to is to what clues can be solved from the train wreckage, the destroyed maglev track sections, and the soil around the site of the blasts.

We need you to transport several investigative teams, along with a considerable amount of equipment, to a nearby station where they will then be transported via shuttle to the planet. Will you take on this mission?
messages.zh:
我知道这个空间站的安全检查程序非常耗时间，并且有点......呃......有点烦人。既然你已经通过了各项检查，那我相信是时候告诉你你来这里的真正原因了。

我们的一位地方长官近期计划对附近某星系的一个行星指挥中心进行秘密访问。出于安全考虑，这个消息只有长官的核心幕僚知晓，其中包括了负责他人身安全的指挥官。这位指挥官决定在访问之前先行测试内部安全性，以确保长官出行万无一失。基于此目的，他费尽心机地制作了一份详尽的出行计划，一切细节都与一次真正的出访完全一致。根据计划，长官应乘坐高速磁浮专列前往几个新的行星指挥中心。

当这列“诱饵”列车行驶至一个大峡谷时，轨道上的一些爆炸物被引爆，使得列车脱轨并撞到峡谷的崖壁上。事件的发生，说明指挥官的计谋非常成功——长官身边有人叛变并把信息提供给不明身份的袭击者。

目前，我们还无法得知叛徒的身份，尽管我们严刑审讯，但每一位核心幕僚成员都在竭尽全力撇清自己和这件事的关系。所以，本次调查的未来走向完全取决于我们能从列车残骸、毁掉的磁浮轨道、或是事发地点周围的土壤中找到什么样的线索。

我们需要你运送几个调查小组以及一些仪器前往附近的一个空间站，在那里他们将转机飞往那个星球。你愿意接受这项任务吗？

messages.en: We are extremely disappointed in your decision to leave this mission. I am quite sure the Regional Governor's office will not soon forget this offense to the Empire.
messages.zh: 我们对你放弃执行任务的决定感到极其失望。我保证，长官办公室不会轻易忘记你对帝国的如此冒犯。

messages.en: Trust me, pilot, we are watching you, and we know you are on time and flying via the preprogrammed waypoints. Contact us only on your arrival.
messages.zh: 相信我，飞行员，我们一直关注着你，我们知道你很准时并且正按预设航径前进中。当你到达目的地，请与我们取得联系。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}'s R&D branch has been working on more efficient version of the inertial compensator units used in starship propulsion systems. I need you to take the latest batch to the testing facility.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的科研部门正在开发一种更高效的惯性补偿单元，用于星舰推进系统。我需要你把最新一批装置送到测试设施。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. The testers have already submitted a preliminary report. The results seem favorable towards our new design, and we've received permission to begin a small first-run production.
messages.zh: 感谢你，{[character]player.name}。测试员们已经提交了一份初步报告。测试结果肯定了我们的新设计，并且我们已经获准开始第一轮小规模试产。

messages.en: I am most disappointed.
messages.zh: 我对你非常失望。

messages.en: Smaller ships rely upon their speed and smaller signature radius to make it difficult for larger ships to track and target them. The heat output from propulsion systems increases signature radius, making a small target much easier to track; the greater the speed, the greater the heat production. Specialized coatings help to reduce the effect and prevent expansion of the parts within propulsion systems, helping them to operate much more efficiently.
messages.zh: 小型舰船依靠它们的高速度和低信号半径来对抗大型舰船的跟踪及锁定。推进系统排出的热量会增加船只的信号半径，并使得小型目标更容易被跟踪；速度越高，热量释放越多。特制的涂层可以帮助减轻这种效应，并且能够防止推进系统中的部件膨胀，从而促使它们更高效地运转。

messages.en: Speed-Tanking
messages.zh: 速度抗

messages.en:
As you probably know all too well, speed is the lifeblood of the Republic's defense fleets, particularly for the smaller frigates and cruisers. There's a lot that goes into it: low-density reactor engines, kinesthetic maneuvering thrusters, hyper-responsive gyroscopic stabilizers. All the housings are built using nanofiber rather than the more heavyweight materials the other empires use; it was simply more conveniently available back when the ships were first designed, but it gives them that little bit of extra boost that's become our signature.

The lighter construction does have the drawback of making the systems more fragile. Our R&D specialists have been working on a more efficient design for the inertial compensators which keep the drive components from shaking themselves to bits; I want you to take this batch over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for application and field testing.
messages.zh:
你可能很清楚，共和国的防卫舰队是靠高速度吃饭的，尤其是护卫舰和巡洋舰。这要求具备多项技术：低密度反应堆引擎，动量感知机动推进器，极速响应陀螺稳定器。所有的外壳都使用纳米纤维来制造，而不是其他帝国应用的重型材料；最初这样设计纯粹是因为纳米材料更容易获取，但后来它实现的那些速度提升变成了我们的招牌。

更轻的材料导致的缺点是更脆弱的系统结构。我们的科研专家们正在设计一种更高效的惯性补偿器，用于防止引擎组件抖动散落。我需要你把这批装置送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}以开展现场应用测试。

messages.en: Disappointing, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你真让人失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I haven't received confirmation of your delivery yet, {[character]player.name}. Is there a problem?
messages.zh: 我还没有收到货物签收回执，{[character]player.name}。你碰到了什么问题吗？

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}. Do try to hurry, you don't want this stuff sitting around too long in your cargo hold.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。快去吧，你不会希望那东西在你船上停留太久的。

messages.en: This shipment of Mesarchonite needs to be taken to the manufacturer on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. The cargo is radioactive, and while the containment units are good enough for a short period, the mineral really requires an industrial containment in a stable and controlled environment.
messages.zh: 这些潮湿岩要送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的工厂去。它外面的容器能在短时间内有效抵御它的放射性。这东西真的需要在一个稳定而且可控的环境中小心保存。

messages.en: Good to hear, {[character]player.name}!
messages.zh: 真是好消息，{[character]player.name}！

messages.en: I am disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Security systems on stations are all-in-one, monitoring room occupancy, ambient temperature and humidity, and the gas mix from environmental control. It can be set to go on alert for various stimuli, and contains several redundant systems to ensure that an interrupt on one line does not prevent a problem being reported. Small pieces of radioactive material which are sensitive to various stimuli are an integral part of such systems.
messages.zh: 空间站的安全系统是一体式的，可以监测房间占用率、环境温度及湿度以及气体成分。它可以对多种刺激发出警报，并内置了几个冗余系统以保证能够不受干扰地报告危险。它里面有小块的放射性物质，对各种刺激都非常敏感。

messages.en: Redundant Systems
messages.zh: 冗余系统

messages.en: Okay, take a look at this. You know what this is? Yes, yes, it's a rock. It's a rare mineral, actually, called Mesarchonite. It has industrial applications, but it's mostly used in security systems. The reason it's in a special containment field is that it's also fairly radioactive. Take this shipment over to the manufacturers at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and don't bloody open it!
messages.zh: 好吧，来看看这个。知道这是什么吗？没错，没错，这是块石头。这是一种稀有矿物，叫潮湿岩。可以用于工业生产，但更多的是用在安全系统上。为什么放在特制容器里呢？因为它有很强的放射性。现在，把这个东西运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的工厂去，千万别打开!

messages.en: I am disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you delivered that Mesarchonite, {[character]player.name}? You don't want to expose your ship to it for much longer.
messages.zh: 你把潮湿岩送到那儿了吗，{[character]player.name}？你不会希望那玩艺儿在你船上待太久的。

messages.en: Good to hear!
messages.zh: 真是好消息！

messages.en: One of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}'s archaeological teams has uncovered a load of pre-Federation relics. I need you to transport the pieces to a laboratory for analysis.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}的一支考古小队发现了一些先联邦时期的遗物。我要你将它们送到一个实验室去做分析鉴定。

messages.en: Thank you for your help, {[character]player.name}. The minerals that society was focusing on are pretty worthless to us -- it's just crystalline octenase, borealt and the like -- but it looks like they were used in the basic construction of the ship they used for the outpost. Who would have thought of coating low-density tritanium panels with a lassenium compound? With a little work, we can find out where their culture came from, and why they're not here anymore.
messages.zh: 感谢你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。那个学会专攻的矿物对我们来说没什么价值——它只是一些辛烯酶结晶，北金属以及类似物质。不过，貌似它们曾经作为基础材料，用于建造哨站的配套舰船。谁会想到使用拉森元素化合物来作为低密度三钛合金面板的涂层呢？只要再努力一下，我们就能查明他们的文化起源自何处，以及他们在此地消失的原因。

messages.en: Sad. I thought you'd have more interest than that.
messages.zh: 真遗憾。我还以为你会很感兴趣。

messages.en: Corporations often sponsor archaeological and research projects, paying for work permits and equipment when the people involved need them. In exchange, the corporations obtain exclusive rights to any discoveries which are made. This includes the right to display and charge viewing fees, or to make new developments based upon information obtained from the artifacts.
messages.zh: 公司经常会赞助一些考古研究项目，并为那些工作者提供所需的工作许可及设备。作为回报，公司可以独享考古的一切成果，包括举办收费性展览，或是依据文物蕴含的信息做进一步开发研究。

messages.en: Retro Revival
messages.zh: 古文明的复兴

messages.en: One of our archaeological teams has unearthed a load of pre-Federation tech from a moon in this system. We're really excited about this; I don't think I need to explain to you how the results of this find could give us a leg up on the competition. Get this lot over to the labs at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and don't tell anyone!
messages.zh: 我们的一支考古小队在本星系的某个卫星上发掘出了一些先联邦时期的科技。我们对此非常振奋，毋庸置疑，这样的发现会使我们在竞争中占得先机。把这些东西送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的实验室去，不许走漏了风声！

messages.en: This greatly displeases me, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你让我非常生气，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, have you delivered those artifacts yet?
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，你把那些文物送去了吗？

name.ja: ローグドローンの中心
name.ru: Сердце восставшего дрона (Heart of the Rogue Drone)

messages.en: Good to hear, {[character]player.name}! I can't wait to see what we've got.
messages.zh: 真是好消息，{[character]player.name}！我迫不及待想看到我们的成果。
