messages.en: While examining wrecked rogue drones following a failed attack, strange minerals were found which replaced some of the drones' usual systems. The compounds seem to run more efficiently than the parts they replaced, and your agent has hired you to take the find to researchers for examination.
messages.zh: 在查看一些因进攻失败而被摧毁的自由无人机时，人们发现有几种奇特的矿物替换了那些无人机通常包含的系统。这些奇特化合物在运作时，貌似比替换掉的部件更有效率。你的代理人委托你将此发现转交给研究者做进一步检查。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. We're one step closer to the forefront of technological advancement!
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。我们又向技术发展前沿迈进了一大步！

messages.en: Sad, {[character]player.name}. I thought I could trust you for this.
messages.zh: 真令我难过，{[character]player.name}。我本以为这件事可以指望你。

messages.en:
Rogue drones began innocently enough, as part of a Gallente scientist's research into drones that could learn and operate independently. The artificial intelligence he created was in itself fairly primitive and non-threatening, but in its self-perpetuation it developed beyond the scope of the scientist's work, and the drones began to truly think for themselves.
Using the justification that the results had produced extreme and life-threatening risk to human life, CONCORD declared all research into artificial intelligence illegal unless performed in a controlled and isolated environment under the watchful eye of DED experts. Proposals for engaging in such research are vetted carefully and the scientists presenting the proposals are subject to extreme background scrutiny.
messages.zh: 自由无人机并不是被刻意制造出来的。它们当时属于一名盖伦特科学家的研究项目的一部分。该研究的目标是独立学习和运作的无人机。那名科学家创造的人工智能本身是相当原始的，也没有危险。然而，在自我延续的过程中，它的发展超出了科学家研究的范围，无人机们开始真正拥有自己的思想。鉴于人工智能研究已经造成的极端与致命后果，统合部宣布所有此类研究是非法的，除非是在DED专家们的监视下，于受控和封闭的环境中进行。此类研究的提议会被仔细检查，并且提出申请的科学家们也要经过严格的背景审查。

messages.en: The Forbidden Science
messages.zh: 科学禁区

messages.en:
Oh! {[character]player.name}, perfect timing!

One of our research outposts in Molden Heath came under attack by rogue drones last week. This is highly unusual, since drones are rarely seen beyond Etherium Reach. The outpost's defense systems managed to keep our scientists safe, and the downed drones were retrieved for examination. They found unusual mineral deposits replacing the drones' original microboard networks, which appear to work far more efficiently.

Of course we don't want anyone else getting ahold of the samples before we can replicate them. The samples have been in transit via a series of drops in order to keep them safe. Take them on to the labs at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.
messages.zh:
噢！{[character]player.name}，来得正是时候！

上星期，我们在摩登赫斯的一座研究哨站遭受了自由无人机的攻击。这次攻击很不寻常，因为那些无人机很少在琉蓝之穹以外活动。该哨站的防御系统勉强维持了科学家们的安全，阵亡的无人机在事后被回收进行检查。他们发现：某几种罕见的矿物沉积取代了那些无人机原来的微基板网络，而这种新构造的工作效率要高很多。

当然，在我们能复制这些样本之前，不能让其他人掌握它们。为了保证安全，样本被分成一系列小块后进行运输。把它们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的实验室。

messages.en: Sad, {[character]player.name}. I thought I could trust you for this.
messages.zh: 真令我难过，{[character]player.name}。我本以为这件事可以指望你。

messages.en: {[character]player.name}, have you done what I asked?
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，事情办得怎么样？

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}. I knew I could count on you.
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]player.name}。我知道你靠得住。

messages.en: Against my better judgment, I've been asked to order several sets of educational packages of the Amarr Scriptures for the children of families who have been released by the Empire. It leaves a sour taste in the mouth, but maybe we can use the teaching materials to our own ends.
messages.zh: 上级要求我为那些从艾玛帝国中释放出来的家庭中的孩子订购数卷艾玛经文书籍，我心底里万分不愿意。这让我觉得很恶心，但也许，我们也能够好好利用这点。

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. I know it's an unsavory business, but our instructions from on high are to try to get along and help these people adjust.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。我知道这不是什么光彩的事，但上级的命令就是要我们帮助这些人去适应。

messages.en: I'm very disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我感到很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: With the release of several generations of slaves from the Empire, Jamyl struck a blow at the heart of Minmatar culture, forcing the Republic to accept those who have known only the ways of Amarr and what little Minmatar tradition they had been able to maintain through the years. Inducting such people into modern Republic society has proven troublesome and at times outright frustrating; allowing released slaves to practice the religion they grew up with has been a bitter necessity as counselors struggle to help the people adapt to their new lives.
messages.zh: 艾玛女皇贾米尔从帝国释放了好几代劳工，但是这一行为反而对米玛塔尔文化给予了一次很大打击。米玛塔尔被迫接受那些在好几年的时间里都只记得艾玛传统，而对米玛塔尔本身却知之甚少的人。实践表明，要将这批人融入米玛塔尔社会并不容易，有时候甚至让人很火大。允许被释放的劳工们信仰伴随他们长大的宗教是米玛塔尔不得不咽下的苦果，与此同时，心理诱导师还要举步艰难地帮助那些人适应新的环境。

messages.en: Necessary Concessions
messages.zh: 必要的让步

messages.en:
I'm in a bit of an awkward position here, {[character]player.name}. With all the people being released from slavery in the Empire, we're getting more and more families who practice the Amarr religion. No thanks to Jamyl, she knew this would happen. The edict from our government is that we need to respect the poor deluded people and gently introduce them to a new way of thinking. It won't be easy, and it's putting a strain on all of us.

My problem right now is that a bunch of the refugee families have requested that some Amarr Scriptures be included in the course structure at the schools we've set up for their children. It's our own people doing the teaching, so we can slowly steer the education in the right direction, but we all still feel dirty for having to use it.

Do you think you'd be willing to take a shipment of books over to one of the schools?
messages.zh:
我现在处境有点尴尬，{[character]player.name}。随着从艾玛帝国中释放出来的同胞们的增多，我们国家里信仰艾玛宗教的家庭也越来越多。我们没必要对艾玛女皇说谢谢，她早就知道事情会这样。我们政府的官方态度是，尊重这些被误导的同胞，同时循序渐进将他们引上正路。这做起来并不容易，我们压力都很大。

我现在的问题是，一些从艾玛那儿解放出来的家庭要求将一些艾玛经文纳入我们为其子女设置的课程之中。老师肯定还是我们自己人，所以我们可以慢慢将那些孩子引上正道。不过，我们还是对此感到很不爽。

你愿意将一批书送往我们其中一座学校吗？

messages.en: I'm very disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我感到很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you delivered those books, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把那些书送抵目的地了吗，{[character]player.name}？

name.es: Las garras heladas de la muerte

messages.en: Thanks a lot, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A nearby station has suffered a life-support failure. They got the atmospheric regulators working again, but the interior temperature is starting to drop. Get the heating units over there quickly, before the place gets too cold.
messages.zh: 附近一个空间站的维生系统出了问题。他们修好了空气调节器，但是内部的温度开始下降。在那个地方变成冰窖之前，快点把这些取暖器送去。

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}! The field-test was invaluable. Turns out the units couldn't handle consistent use for more than 16 hours, something we never tested for in the labs. The next version of the heaters will be much better!
messages.zh: 谢了，{[character]player.name}！这次现场测试的价值不可估量。结果发现这种取暖器无法连续工作16小时以上，这是我们之前在实验室里从未测试到的。下个版本的取暖器会好很多！

messages.en: Well, I'm certain we can find someone who values their job more.
messages.zh: 好吧，我还是去找更认真工作的人来吧。

messages.en: The most vital systems on a space station or starship, life-support covers everything from atmosphere generation and recycling to environmental control to the recycling of drinking and pumping water. Originally a series of tanks containing specialized filters, as residence in space extended from long-term to lifetimes, advances in bioengineering developed hydroponics systems for stations which both produce and recycle air and water efficiently. Environmental control, which cycles water and air through the station and maintains an even internal temperature despite the cold of space outside nibbling at the edges, runs off the same generator as the internal electrical circuits. External electrical devices, such as guide-lights, shielding and containment fields, security systems and communications, run from separate generators with extensive backup arrays.
messages.zh: 维生系统是空间站或舰船内部最重要的系统，涵盖了空气再生循环、环境控制以及饮用及生活用水循环利用等方方面面。它由一些加装了特殊过滤器的容器组成，能长时间甚至终生为空间站提供生命支持。得益于生物工程科技的发展，溶液培植系统广泛应用于空间站，能提供高效的空气及水资源再生循环利用。环境控制系统致力于整个空间站的空气及水循环，无论外部的寒冷如何侵袭，它都能维持内部的温度，并和内部电路共用同一个发电机。外部的电子设备，比如指示灯、护盾及密闭力场、安全系统及通信系统等，分别使用不同的发电机，并备有多个备用阵列。

messages.en: Station-Side Survival
messages.zh: 空间站生存

messages.en:
A severe accident has occurred on another station, {[character]player.name}; they suffered a freak blowout in primary life-support, and the station's environmental control shut down entirely. No, don't panic, they stabilized the atmosphere as soon as they could, so the people on the station won't asphyxiate. But the internal heating units have yet to be replaced. People are bundling up as their heat bleeds out – the external insulation is some protection, but it's not enough.

Fortunately for them, we've been developing some hyper-efficient portable heaters here. Donating a bunch will be good publicity for us. It'll also be a good field test for the heaters, and we may get a few preorders from it if people like them. Take these over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and make sure you let them know who donated them.
messages.zh:
另一座空间站发生了一起严重事故，{[character]player.name}；主要的维生设备挂掉了，而且空间站内的环境控制系统整个罢工。不不，别慌张，他们竭尽全力搞定了空气循环系统，所以里面的人不至于窒息而死。但是他们的内部取暖器需要更换。热量流失的很快，里面的人都把自己裹得像个粽子一样。外部的隔离层能起到点保护作用，但是还不够。

他们其实挺走运，我们这边开发了一种超高效便携式取暖器。送给他们几台，应该会成为很好的产品宣传。同时对于这种取暖器也是一次现场测试的好机会。如果大家喜欢它们，我们也许能接到几笔预订。把它们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，并且一定要告诉那里的人是谁在雪中送炭。

messages.en: You're heartless, {[character]player.name}. What about all those people?
messages.zh: 你真冷血，{[character]player.name}，你让那些人怎么活？

messages.en: Have you delivered the heating units yet?
messages.zh: 你把取暖器送到那里了吗？

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: One of our planetside subsidiaries has recently lost a lot of farming equipment to a storm. I need you to take these parts to the assembly plant so we can recoup our losses.
messages.zh: 我们的一家子公司最近在一场风暴中损失了大量的农用机械。我需要你将这些零件送往装配工厂，这样我们还可以弥补损失。

messages.en: Thank you for your help, {[character]player.name}. Our subsidiary has managed to save more than they first thought of the initial crops and they're good to go for the second growing season.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。我们的子公司成功地抢收了比预想中更多的作物，而且他们有足够的能力应付接下来的第二个种植期了。

messages.en: I am greatly disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你非常失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Despite the increasing popularity of fully-automated hydroponics farms, many planetary economies continue to rely on large-scale land-farming to provide jobs and food for local populations. On particularly fertile worlds even small start-up farms can be instantly successful, but in order to compete with larger farms in the market, these smaller farms frequently approach large corporations, offering to supply certain vital organic produce in exchange for controlling market shares.
messages.zh: 尽管全自动化液体栽培农场越来越流行，很多行星的经济系统仍然依靠大规模土地种植来为当地人口提供就业机会和食物。在特别富饶的地区，新办的小农场也能马上致富。不过，为了与大型农场竞争，这些小农场经常联系各大军团，为他们提供特定必需的有机产品，以换取支配性的市场份额。

messages.en: The Basics of Life
messages.zh: 生活基础

messages.en: One of our subsidiaries has recently suffered a major setback, {[character]player.name}. A hurricane wiped out half their planetside crops and wrecked the equipment. Most of it was already falling apart, the storm just finished it off. Obviously, this is a big problem for them, and us, but it's still the early part of the first growing season. Deliver these parts to the assembly plant at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so we can replace the equipment before they lose too much from this harvest.
messages.zh: 最近，我们的一家子公司遭受了重大的打击，{[character]player.name}。飓风席卷而过，毁掉了他们半数的农作物，绝大多数的农业设备也被风暴撕成了碎片。很明显，这对他们、对我们都是很严重的问题，好在作物种植的第一季才刚开始。你要把这些零件送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的装配工厂去，这样我们就可以更换掉损坏的机械，以免遭到更大的损失。

messages.en: I am greatly disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你非常失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you delivered those parts yet, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把那些零件送到了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}. If anyone asks where those came from, the manifest will show their usual station.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。如果有人问这些货是哪来的，就给他们看舱单。

messages.en: A Nefantar House is relocating to a planet within the Republic, and we've had a tip-off that they're working against us for someone in the Empire. We've planted surveillance nanobots in a shipment of materials for their planetside home; take it over to the depot. The logs will show nothing amiss.
messages.zh: 一个内凡达家族正迁徙往共和国内的某个星球，我们得到了情报，他们在为帝国的某些人卖命，意图与我们为敌。我们在他们的一批建筑材料中放置了监视纳米机器人，你的任务就是将它们送到仓库。从航行日志是看不出什么异样的。

messages.en: Thanks to your assistance, {[character]player.name}, we've been able to record some rather incriminating communications from these people already. They wasted no time in contacting their associates in the Empire to let them know they were settled in.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。我们已经能够记录到他们的一些犯罪证据了。他们很快就把他们迁居的消息报告给了帝国的联系人。

messages.en: I am disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你很失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
The day Drupar Maak struck down Arkon Ardishapur on Starkman Prime with the Heir's own sceptre began the darkest night for his people. In retribution for the death of his father and their attempted rebellion, Idonis Ardishapur ordered the annihilation of the Starkmanir tribe.

At the same time, the Nefantar tribe approached the Empire with an offer, making a bargain for mercy in exchange for assisting in the subjugation of the Minmatar. The tribe took on many aspects of the Empire, including open practise of their faith and owning Minmatar slaves, themselves. Despite the recent revelation that their conversion helped to protect the last Starkmanir to survive the purge, many within the Republic are hesitant to forgive the Nefantar for their actions.
messages.zh:
杜帕·马克在斯塔克曼首星行刺阿康·阿狄莎波的那一天，是他的人民悲惨命运的开始。为了控制叛乱并为父王复仇，伊多尼斯·阿狄莎波下令消灭斯塔克曼一族。

与此同时，内凡达一族与帝国达成协议，以协助控制米玛塔尔来换取宽恕。这个种族表现出来了很多帝国的特质，比如公开信仰艾玛宗教以及拥有米玛塔尔劳工——其实他们自己也是米玛塔尔人。尽管最近有消息披露，他们当初亲近艾玛的这一行为在一定程度上帮助斯塔克曼人逃过了灭顶之灾，但是共和国的许多人仍然不愿意原谅他们的所作所为。

messages.en: Strained Relations
messages.zh: 紧张的关系

messages.en:
I hope I can trust you to be discreet, {[character]player.name}.

As part of a goodwill gesture to the Nefantar tribe, the Republic has offered allotments of planetary territory within our space on which to build embassies or summer homes or whatever else they need land for. I don't care what it is, I don't trust ‘em, but the government is determined to make sure we all get along.

Yesterday I got an alert from one of my colleagues; it seems one Nefantar house is in collusion with elements from the Empire. Obviously we can't just point fingers without evidence, but I'm in a perfect position to obtain that. The contractor they hired to design and build a house on their new property is a friend of mine. He's given us one shipment of interior facing materials to seed with nanite spyware. Take the load to the depot at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; I know I can trust you to keep quiet about the additions to the cargo.
messages.zh:
我希望我们没看错人，{[character]player.name}。

为了对内凡达一族表示善意，共和国在我们的领域内为他们提供了一块星际领地，他们可以在那里建立大使馆、度假村或是别的什么设施。我不在乎他们建什么东西，反正我不信任他们，但是政府决定要与他们和平共处。

昨天我从一位同事那里收到警告，某个内凡达家族似乎正与帝国相互勾结。很显然我们不能空口无凭地去指证他们，不过我有办法得到证据。受雇给他们造新房子的承包商是我的一个朋友，他给了我们一个机会，可在一批建筑材料中放置纳米级间谍设备。现在，把这船货送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，我知道你值得信任，而且你会保守秘密的。

messages.en: I'm beginning to question your loyalty, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我开始怀疑你的忠诚了，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you delivered your cargo for me, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把货送过去了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. Hurry up! This could be our biggest breakthrough yet!
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。抓紧时间！这也许会是我们目前最重大的进展！

messages.en: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has a number of outposts in w-space systems, exploring what lies beyond known space. They've turned up some unusual pieces which I need you to take to a more extensive laboratory for identification.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}在虫洞星系中安置了许多个哨站，用以探索未知空间。他们发现了一些不寻常的东西，所以我需要你把它们送到一个更大的实验室去检测。

messages.en: The strangest thing happened when they got all the pieces slotted together: the light inside them stopped flickering and turned blue. We're not certain what that means, since nothing else happened, but it appears to be a sign we're on the right track!
messages.zh: 当他们把所有碎片插在一起时，最奇异的事情发生了：它们内部的光不再闪烁，而是变成了蓝色。我们还不确定这是什么意思，因为除此之外没有发生其他的事。不过，看样子我们在朝正确的方向前进！

messages.en: If it's not worth your time, you could have just said so.
messages.zh: 如果这不值得你浪费时间，你应该早点说。

messages.en: Capsuleers aren't the only people to explore the systems accessible via wormholes. Every corporation wants to be the first to make the Next Big Discovery, and then market the developments from researching it. Most corporations will categorically deny that this is what they're doing, creating an atmosphere of both paranoia and plausible deniability if their explorations turn up nothing of value.
messages.zh: 并不是只有克隆飞行员们在穿梭虫洞探索一个个星系，每一个军团都力争率先在星际探索领域有重大发现，进而可以出售研究的成果。但大多数公司都矢口否认它们在做这样的事情，这样如果他们什么都没找到的话也也有个台阶下。

messages.en: Corporate W-Space Exploration
messages.zh: 军团的虫洞空间探索

messages.en:
Yes, I have some work for you.

We have several research outposts in various w-space systems. It's common, one of those things that nobody discusses but everybody knows about anyway. A while ago, they recovered bits of ancient technology which seemed to have unusual properties.. We thought for a while it might be some sort of Sleeper computer core, but now it appears to be Talocan in origin. Another of our laboratories has more pieces, and they're suggesting it's actually the core of a station's life-support system, with multiple redundant modules that can back each other up and be easily replaced if they fail. They're setting up to test their theory right now at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. I need you to take our samples over so they can complete the network they've pieced together.
messages.zh:
没错，有些活要你做。

我们在多个虫洞星系中有研究哨站。这种事很平常，虽然没人愿意提起，但是大家都心知肚明。不久前，他们发现了少量貌似具有不寻常属性的古代科技…有段时间我们以为它是某种冬眠者计算机核心，然而现在它看上去更像是来自塔洛伽的科技。我们的另一个实验室拥有更多的碎片，而且他们主张，这其实是一座空间站维生系统的核心，它具备多个冗余模块，方便在系统失效时互相接替。目前他们正在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}做准备来验证他们的理论。我需要你把我们这里的样本送过去，好让他们完成网络的搭建。

messages.en: This displeases me, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 你让我很不爽，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I've not received a receipt for the cargo yet, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我还没收到货物签收回执，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Thanks a lot, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 非常感谢，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: A small startup that {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has recently invested in has been hired to build a water garden for a Gallente politician, but the frogs he wanted are too dangerous to the fish. Fortunately, there's a variety that are just as ornamental without the side effects. I need you to take them over before we lose our investment.
messages.zh: {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}近来投资的一个小公司受雇为一位盖伦特政客修建一个水景花园，但是客户需要的青蛙对水里的鱼来讲太危险了。好在，我们找到了另外一个品种的青蛙，既可以起到装饰作用，又没有任何副作用。我要你在我们的投资泡汤之前，把这些青蛙送去。

messages.en: Thanks to your work, it looks like Holistic Habitat, LLC is on its way up. The politician can't praise the quality of his water-garden enough.
messages.zh: 你的努力让这家公司走上了发展之路。那位政客会对他的水景花园不吝溢美之词的。

messages.en: I'm sorry to hear that, {[character]player.name}. I'll just have to find someone else.
messages.zh: 我真不愿意听这样的话，{[character]player.name}。现在我得去找别人帮忙了。

messages.en: Nothing boasts of a flexible wallet than a private garden within the walls of one's apartment. Society's elite will spend a great deal of money to obtain a perfect replica of the Intaki rainforests or Mannar seaside in which to entertain guests and impress prospective clients. Extra emphasis is placed on making such gardens self-supporting, including specially-engineered fauna to keep the flora happy.
messages.zh: 没有什么比私人别墅内的私家花园更摆显了。社会精英们会不惜血本去完美复制印塔基的雨林或是马纳尔的海景，以此取悦宾客并打动潜在的客户。这种花园的侧重点在于自给自足，包括精心设计的动物种群，可以使植物看起来更加有生气。

messages.en: Gallente Interior Design
messages.zh: 盖伦特室内设计

messages.en:
Yes, yes, perhaps you could help me out.

A well-known politician is having a vacation suite commissioned in another station, and decided that he just could not live without an ornamental water-garden. One of our daughter-companies was hired for the work, and it could be just the break they need to make a name for themselves in the interior design industry.

Thing is, on stations, such gardens need to be self-supporting ecosystems in their own right. He had a load of very pretty frogs shipped in to add color and control the inevitable insect populations, but those lovely little Leina's Darters are also beautifully toxic, and the fish that eat them are dying. We've finally discovered a variety that won't prevent the fish from reproducing. Take this load over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and quickly, before His Honor decides he wants a rock garden instead and we lose our investment.
messages.zh:
嗯嗯，也许你能帮我一个忙。

一位著名的政界人士在另一个空间站内有一个度假套房，不过他觉得没有水景花园做装饰的话他可不愿意去住。我们的一家姊妹公司接下了这个工程，这可是他们在室内设计行业扬名的大好机会。

问题是，在空间站里，这样的花园需要有能自给自足的生态系统。那位政客运来了一些非常漂亮的青蛙，用来为花园增添色彩并且能控制昆虫的数量。但是，那些漂亮的小家伙毒性很大，会毒死吃掉他们的鱼儿。我们最终找到了另一种青蛙，它不会影响鱼类的繁殖的。你要把这些小东西送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，要快，他要是再改变主意想要个石头花园的话，我们就血本无归了。

messages.en: But what about the frogs?
messages.zh: 那青蛙怎么办？

messages.en: Have you delivered those frogs yet, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你把那些青蛙送到了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}. It's not a glamorous job but someone's gotta do it.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。这不是什么体面的工作，但总得有人去做啊。

messages.en: Our salvagers have built up a load of industrial-quality scrap metal to be used in ship building. I need you to take it to the reclamation facility so we can recover the useable parts.
messages.zh: 我们的打捞人员找到了一些高品质的废金属，可以用来建造舰船。我们需要你将这些金属送到再生工厂去，这样我们就可以回收有用的部分。

messages.en: Good! You've been a big help, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 很好！你帮了我们大忙，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: I am very disappointed, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你非常失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
Since its dawning days, New Eden's landscape has been riddled with conflict, both political and physical. Battles waged and lost have left scars upon planets and littered constellations with floating wrecks. Close to where the Eve Gate lies in Genesis, abandoned stations pose navigational threats to pilots, and many stars are developing orbital rings of human-made space junk.

Despite the risks inherent in a single scrap of metal the size of a man, hurtling through space at just below light-speed – never mind something as vast as a wrecked starship – governments either cannot afford or cannot be bothered to send teams to clean them up. The most dangerous pieces are towed out of the primary space-lanes, then left adrift in deadspace, marked with tracking-beacons. Scavenging is publicly discouraged, though authorities tend to turn a blind eye when various pieces end up on the market. Most of the finds end up in the hands of artists, inventors and archaeologists. One large piece of hull-plating found on the market, still bearing the much-corroded legend MAF Commandant Aurora, was identified as belonging to one of the earliest Gallente interplanetary shuttles, and now forms part of a wall in a museum on Gallente Prime.
messages.zh:
自从它被发现的那一天起，新伊甸就充斥着政治及武力纷争。战争给许多星球留下了伤痕，并且在广袤的星际空间中遗弃了无数漂浮的残骸。在新伊甸之门所在的吉勒西斯星域，废弃的空间站威胁着往来飞行员的安全，许多星球的轨道中也充斥了人造宇宙垃圾。

那里充满了危险——一人多高的废金属片以接近光速在空间中自由穿梭，更不用提巨大的战舰残骸了。尽管如此，政府也没有足够的人力物力去清理它们。那些最危险的碎片被牵引出主要的航道，并被标上跟踪信标，扔在死亡空间里面四处飘荡。权力机关公开鼓励打捞残骸的行为，并对捞上来的碎片在市场上出售的事情睁一只眼闭一只眼。许多打捞品落入了艺术家、发明家以及考古学家的手里。市场上曾经出现了一大块船体装甲，上面还涂有锈迹斑斑的MAF极光指挥舰字样，它被认为是某艘最早的盖伦特星际舰船的一部分，人们把它做成墙壁的一部分放在盖伦特首星的一个博物馆里。

messages.en: Trash and Treasure
messages.zh: 垃圾和宝藏

messages.en:
Okay, here's one for you. Don't look at me like that. Yes, it's a load of metal scraps we need taken to a reclamation facility at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Contrary to popular belief, our ships are not made solely of scrap-metal, utility adhesive and chewing gum, but we do recycle extensively.

The reason I'm asking you to do this rather than hiring a much cheaper regular captain is that these bits are industrial quality, or they will be once they've been processed. They're worth a lot of cred on the black market – peanuts to you capsuleers, but a year's wages to anyone else.
messages.zh:
有些活要你做。别那么看着我，没错，这是一堆金属废料，我们要你把它们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的再生工厂去。我们的船不像大家想象的那样只是用废金属，胶水和口香糖做出来的，不过我们确实使用了大量的再生技术。

我不去雇一个超便宜的普通飞行员而来找你的原因是，这些东西质量很好。它们在黑市上值大价钱——可能对于你这样的克隆飞行员不算什么，对普通人来讲却抵得上一年的薪水。

messages.en: Sad, {[character]player.name}. I had hoped you were the reliable sort.
messages.zh: 真遗憾，{[character]player.name}。我还以为你是那种可以信赖的人。

messages.en: Have you finished your work for me, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你干完活了吗，{[character]player.name}？

name.en: A Little Work On The Side
name.ru: Подработка на стороне (A Little Work On The Side)

messages.en: Good, good. Get going, would you?
messages.zh: 很好，很好。快去做吧。

messages.en: A friend and I are running a small holoreel bootlegging operation on the side. The shipments are bound for Syndicate, but I only need you to take them on to where my business partner is operating from. The cargo has been disguised as standard holoreels, an effective disguise provided nobody looks too closely at the contents.
messages.zh: 我和一个朋友私下也经营一些全息视盘非法贩售生意。这些货是送往辛迪加的，你只需要将他们带到我的合作伙伴那里就好了。这些全息视盘看起来和普通的没什么两样，伪装的很好，不凑近点根本看不出两者区别。

messages.en: Thanks for your help, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Fine. It's not like anyone would believe you if you told them, anyway.
messages.zh: 算了，反正你出去乱讲别人也不会相信你的。

messages.en: Founded by Intaki exiles after the first Caldari-Gallente war, Syndicate rapidly became a safe haven for criminals and the more unsavoury sorts of businesses which can't operate as freely in Empire space. Anything and everything can be found on the market, including things people would rather not be shared openly. Secrets – both personal and professional – fetch a good price, and the sellers rarely care who the money comes from.
messages.zh: 第一次加达里-盖伦特战争结束之后，印塔基流放者们成立了辛迪加组织，它很快就成为了犯罪者的天堂，一些在帝国里上不得台面的生意也可以在这里堂而皇之地进行。市场里应有尽有，包括一些违禁品。而一些秘闻——小道的也好权威的也好，总是能值大价钱，而且卖家才不在乎是谁买走了它们。

messages.en: The Shadowy Side of Syndicate
messages.zh: 辛迪加的阴暗面

messages.en:
I like nice things, {[character]player.name}. Who doesn't? Handing missions out to you people all day doesn't offer nearly enough to cover my expenses, so a friend and I run a shipping business out to Syndicate space. Nothing big enough to interfere with the Syndicate itself, mind you. We provide a humanitarian service importing the latest holos from the heart of civilization. It's the only way they can get the things for a reasonable cost – buying them direct from the companies in the Federation incurs immense shipping charges.

Our usual courier is out of commission today, with her ship in for repairs after a pirate attack. If you want to make yourself useful, take the latest shipment over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and ask for Amelyn. They'll know who you mean, just say that “Imba” sent you.
messages.zh:
我喜欢漂亮的玩意儿，{[character]player.name}。谁不喜欢呢？即使成天给你们这些人派发任务，我的收入也不够我花的。所以我和一个朋友还经营一些到辛迪加的货运业务。你要注意，我这只是点小生意，跟辛迪加财团没什么瓜葛。我们提供的是一项人性化的服务：从帝国中心地区进口最新的全息记忆盘。只有这样他们才能以靠谱的价格买到东西——直接从联邦的企业购买的话，要付出巨额的运输费。

我们常用的快递员今天无法接活儿，因为她的船被海盗打伤了，还在修理。如果你想找点事情做，就把最新一批货送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，然后找阿美林。他们会明白你找谁，只要说是“伊姆巴”派你来的就可以了。

messages.en: What? Why now? Couldn't you just have refused at the start? Now we'll have to move our operation elsewhere.
messages.zh: 什么？为什么现在才说？你怎么不一开始就拒绝我呢？搞得我们现在不得不转移阵地。

messages.en: Amelyn hasn't contacted me yet, {[character]player.name}. What's the hold up?
messages.zh: 阿美林还没有联系我，{[character]player.name}。有什么事情耽搁了？

messages.en: Thanks, {[character]player.name}, I knew we could count on you.
messages.zh: 谢谢你，{[character]player.name}。我知道你最可靠了。

messages.en: A pair of civilians too wealthy for their own good are holding a decadent reception for their wedding, and ordered a tremendously expensive champagne to keep their guests entertained. A regular pilot can't be trusted to ship the drinks in, but what's a thousand-ISK bottle of wine to a capsuleer?
messages.zh: 有一对新人，钱多得不知该怎么花，正要举行一场穷奢极欲的婚礼，而且订了一种极其昂贵的香槟来宴请宾客。这些酒不能托付给一名普通飞行员来运送，可是对克隆飞行员来说，一瓶几千块钱的酒又有什么意义呢？

messages.en: Thank you, {[character]player.name}. That party isn't one the glitterati will soon forget; Selvah's daughter threw her entire glass of champagne in en Foilien's face and called him some very unflattering schoolyard names. Of course it was all caught on camera, and the media is having a field day.
messages.zh: 谢谢，{[character]player.name}。上层名流们不会很快忘记这次派对；塞尔瓦的女儿把满满一杯香槟泼到昂·福瓦良的脸上，还用学生群里的脏话来骂他。当然，这些都被拍下来了，媒体们真是不虚此行。

messages.en: Fine, I'll find someone else, hopefully before it's too late.
messages.zh: 好吧，我再去找别人，希望还来得及。

messages.en: Nobody loves a good party more than the Gallente. The hedonistic stereotype is one that the Federation revels in and flaunts shamelessly. Public figures actively compete to host the wildest and most fashionable affairs, vying for the attention of news services and gossip magazines. Among the celebrity elite, a wedding, birth or even a funeral is simply another excuse to splash out and stand in the limelight. Occasionally, an event will be engineered so a falling star can make a desperate final grasp at publicity and salvage a faded career.
messages.zh: 再没有谁能比盖伦特人更喜欢美好的派对了。盖伦特联邦沉迷于享乐主义的风气，而且还无耻地四处炫耀。公众人物热衷于攀比谁办的聚会最时尚最夸张，最能吸引媒体和八卦杂志的关注。在社会名流眼中，一场婚礼、一个小孩诞生、甚至一场葬礼，都是摆场面搏出位的好借口。有时候，一次精心策划的活动可以让某个过气的明星孤注一掷，夺回关注并保住饭碗。

messages.en: The Entertainment Gambit
messages.zh: 娱乐圈的规则

messages.en:
Do you read the gossip rags? I wouldn't expect you to; you capsuleers obviously have greater concerns than who's mocking whom this week. The big news right now is this wedding being planned by Ahvir en Foilien, the former co-star of Under Wraps. He's not been heard from since he got canned as the host of the Sugar Sweep game show, but now he's caused a ruckus by arranging a marriage to the daughter of Material Acquisition bigwig Hemy Selvah. A lot of money obviously changed hands to manage this, since Selvah's daughter isn't quite ten years old, and en Foilien already has a wife, a husband and a few playmates on the side.

If you believe what the tabloids say, that is. Who knows what the truth might be?

En Foilien has arranged a lavish party on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} which is undoubtedly meant to encourage the public and the reporters to overlook the dodgy circumstances and remind them that he used to be important. It doesn't really matter. He's ordered several crates of Feille d'Marnne champagne to loosen them up and assist with the memory loss.
messages.zh:
你看花边新闻吗？我猜你不会看；你们克隆飞行员明显不会关心“本周谁让谁出糗了”之类的鸡毛蒜皮的事。现在最热门的新闻是真相大白的联合明星阿维·昂·福瓦良筹办的婚礼。自从他在主持比赛节目糖果大扫荡时被封口后，就少有露面。但是现在他又引起了轰动，因为他要迎娶物资集团高层西米·塞尔瓦的女儿。这桩婚事肯定牵涉了巨额资金的过户，因为塞尔瓦的女儿才十岁不到，而且昂·福瓦良本身就已经有一个妻子、一个丈夫外加好几个玩伴。

反正娱乐新闻上就是这么说的。谁又知道真实情况是怎样呢？

昂·福瓦良在{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}安排了一场奢靡的派对，毫无疑问是想让公众和媒体忽视这婚事的离谱程度，并且提醒大家，他也曾是风光人物。其实无所谓。他订了好几箱马利菲勒香槟，有助于宾客们放松心情，忘掉过往。

messages.en: I'm not laughing, {[character]player.name}. I have a reputation to maintain, you know.
messages.zh: 这可不好笑，{[character]player.name}。你知道我可是要面子的。

messages.en: I haven't received a receipt for that champagne yet. What's the hold up?
messages.zh: 我听说香槟还没送到。怎么回事？

messages.en: Just make sure to tell him how sorry I am, okay?
messages.zh: 一定要向他表达我的歉意，明白了吗？

messages.en: I accidentally sent a client the wrong set of drones because they never specified what type he needed. Take the right cargo to him. Hopefully he won't ask too many questions.
messages.zh: 我不小心给客户发错了无人机，他们从来就没指明过他们要哪种嘛。你要把这些正确的机型送到他那里去。希望他别有太多问题。

messages.en: Excellent. I've been trying to get those old things off my hands for months.
messages.zh: 非常好。  我一直都想把这些旧东西处理掉。

messages.en: Fine. I can always find someone else.
messages.zh: 算了， 我找别人帮忙好了。

messages.en: The most common mining drone, the Spider Drone, is manufactured by Ishukone. The brainchild of Chief Foreman Jaartu Mediuri in the early days following the first Caldari-Gallente war, the first mining drones were little more than immense strip-mining factories which were deposited on the surface of an asteroid to chew through the surface and process useful minerals until their belly holds were full, then sending an alert to the foreman for uplift and unloading. It wasn't until advances simplified the operation of the mining laser that Mediuri proposed automating a laser and attaching directional thrusters. The project was shelved indefinitely after the initial models failed repeatedly, but after Ishukone headhunted the prodigy roboticist Vayan Hemitaru from Sukuuvestaa, the programme restarted with renewed energy and interest. Eventually a self-powered, mobile mining laser was produced. Some contention was held over its need for basic guidance from an operator, but Ishukone argued that full autonomy was unnecessary, particularly since use of capsule-controlled ships had become common and a capsuleer controller could, through experience and training, more than accommodate for the lack.
messages.zh: 应用最广泛的采矿无人机是由异株湖集团生产的蜘蛛无人机，它们是首席工头贾图·米迪瑞的杰作。在第一次加达里-盖伦特战争结束后，这些早期的采矿无人机数量基本上就是一座座大型的露天采矿工厂，它们张开大嘴吞噬行星表面的一切并分拣出有用的矿物，直到货舱装满为止，之后它们就发信号给工头，被收回并开始卸货。直到采矿激光的操作被大幅简化，米迪瑞才提议在无人机上使用自动激光器并加装定向推进装置。早期的原型机实验一直未能取得成功，这个项目也被无限期搁置，直到异株湖集团从斯库维塔公司那里挖来了天才机器人专家瓦耶·希米塔鲁之后，项目才重新焕发活力并得到重视。终于，一种自供能源的移动式采矿激光得以面世。这种机型在工作时需要操作员的引导，这也是备受争议的地方，不过异株湖集团声称全自动化是没有必要的，尤其是在如今克隆飞行员操控舰船司空见惯的情况下，只要经过培训与实践，克隆飞行员们完全可以掌控这种无人机。

messages.en: Development Pains
messages.zh: 发展之殇

messages.en: One of my clients asked me to send over drones to replace the ones his company's been losing in the line of work. That's all he said. He never said anything about needing mining drones; of course I sent him a set of scout drones, and he was very upset at me for not being able to read his mind. People should be more specific about things. Take these mining drones over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for him, and if he asks why the paint looks new, tell him they're fresh off the production line.
messages.zh: 我的一个客户要我给他送一批无人机去，以替换那些工作中损耗掉的。他就告诉了我这些，从来没说过需要的是采矿无人机，我当然给他送了侦察无人机，他对我很不满，觉得我无法猜透他的心思。我觉得是他自己没把话说清楚。把这些采矿无人机送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，如果他问起为什么涂装看起来这么新，就告诉他这些是刚下生产线的。

messages.en: I am very disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 我对你非常失望，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Have you finished your work for me, {[character]player.name}?
messages.zh: 你干完活了吗，{[character]player.name}？

messages.en: Good to hear, {[character]player.name}! Don't actually vent the ship, though. We need these guys.
messages.zh: 真是好消息，{[character]player.name}！不过也不要真的弄个船毁人亡什么的，我们需要这些家伙。

messages.en: Planetary officials have asked me to bring in a team of mercenaries they've hired to deal with a terrorist threat. Your job is to keep them in line en route.
messages.zh: 行星长官雇佣了一队佣兵以应对恐怖威胁，你的任务就是把他们送往目的地。

messages.en: Excellent, {[character]player.name}! I'll let the local government know their solution is on its way.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}！我会告知地方政府他们的对策正在被施行。

messages.en: Sad. Now I'll have to find someone else. You were the best option, too.
messages.zh: 很遗憾，现在我得去找别人了。你曾是我们的第一选择。

messages.en:
Despite centuries of enslavement and the systematic erasure of half their culture, some Minmatar advocate a return to “the old ways,” total service the Amarr. Many of these are adherents to the Amarr religion, others are simply willing to do anything for the right pay.

Activism can be as tame as preaching on street-corners or door-to-door, or as extreme as acts of violence and sabotage. The general population of the Republic resents being proselytized and threatened, and in some parts of the Republic clashes have occurred between demonstrators and bystanders. One notable clash on Huggar left 39 dead and hundreds hospitalized for shrapnel wounds and burns.
messages.zh:
尽管几个世纪以来饱受奴役及文化消融之痛，部分米玛塔尔人仍然大力倡导回归古老的生活方式以全身心为艾玛人服务。他们中的许多人是虔诚的艾玛宗教教信仰者，而其余的则是为了钱财出卖一切的人。

他们实现目的的方式有很多种，平和的如当街或者挨家挨户宣讲教义，激烈的如各种暴力及破坏活动。大多数共和国居民都很厌恶被他们煽动或威胁，在某些地方请愿者与旁观者还会爆发冲突。比较著名的一次发生在乌加尔，造成39人死亡，数以百计的人受枪伤或烧伤而住进医院。

messages.en: Insidious Rebellion
messages.zh: 潜在的叛乱

messages.en: We have a planetary situation we need your help with. A group of pro-Amarr terrorists is wreaking havoc in outlying provinces, and the local government's hired a group of mercenaries to deal with them. You know mercs, I'm sure; they never really listen to anyone they think is softer than they are. We're having trouble finding an ordinary captain who's willing to ferry the guys over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} for transit planetside. I think they'll be more likely to behave if the captain is someone who can and will follow through on a threat to vent the ship to vacuum. Someone like you, in other words. Can we count on you to keep the unruly lot in line?
messages.zh: 我们有件事需要你帮忙。一撮支持艾玛的恐怖分子正在一些边远省份大肆制造破坏，地方政府雇佣了一批佣兵来对付他们。你知道佣兵那些家伙，我敢肯定，他们绝对不会听从他们眼中的“弱者”的话的。我们很难找到一位愿意把他们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去的普通船长。不过我觉得如果这个船长随时都敢来个船毁人亡的话，他们应该会听话一点的。换句话讲，就是像你一样的船长。那么，你愿意接下这个棘手的任务吗？

messages.en: Sad. Now I'll have to find someone else. You were the best option, too.
messages.zh: 很遗憾，现在我得去找别人了。你曾是我们的第一选择。

messages.en: Those mercs aren't giving you too much trouble, I hope.
messages.zh: 我希望那些佣兵没给你找麻烦吧。

messages.en: Bless the Empress – I am very glad to hear you've decided to help. The RIT personnel will meet you in the hangar bay shortly.  Please feel free to take any of our religious literature with you for your enlightenment during the flight.
messages.zh: 天佑女皇——我很高兴你能伸出援手。反暴特勤组的人马上就会去机库等你。你可以在出发前从我这儿随便拿一本宗教文献上路，愿你能从中获得升华。

messages.en: There has been an uprising at one of our slave Labor Reeducation Centers, or LRCs, near a rather large ore mine. The slaves are almost wholly Minmatar, so we cannot afford to have this incident continue for even one more day. The longer it goes on, the greater the chances that some reporter or news agency will get wind of this and splash the story all over the region. Given that the Minmatar Republic may feel compelled to take action to aid their brethren, this can only lead to dire consequences. That, of course, is unacceptable. We do have a plan in place, however, that should end this uprising before it has a chance to truly take root. We need you to transport a large contingent of Riot Interdiction Team (RIT) personnel to a designated station. From there the assembled security teams will join up and embark a small fleet of frigates and cruisers to race to the prison, where they will use all necessary force to terminate this uprising before it gets completely out of control.
messages.zh: 在一座大型矿场附近的一个劳教中心里，发生了一场暴动。鉴于那儿的劳工几乎清一色都是米玛塔尔人，我们要迅速解决此事。这事拖得越长，新闻媒体就越有可能捕捉到此事的风声，然后整个星域的人都会了解此事。考虑到米玛塔尔政府可能会迫于公众压力出动军队来援救那帮劳工，这会引发极其严重的后果。因此绝不能让那种情况发生。还好我们已经有了应对方案，能将暴动终结在萌芽阶段。你现在要做的就是，把一批反暴特勤组人员送往指定空间站。然后他们会从那儿登上一小队护卫舰与巡洋舰，赶赴劳教中心，趁着形势尚未完全失控之前，动用所有必要力量扑灭此次暴动。

messages.en: The teams have begun to embark on a small fleet of frigates and cruisers for LRC-12A. With this amount of men and lethal weaponry, there is no doubt that we shall prevail!
messages.zh: 武装部队已经登上了一小队护卫舰与巡洋舰，往LRC-12A去了。有这么多人再加上致命武器，我们肯定能平息此事！

messages.en: Bah – I should have known you wouldn't help us. I could tell when I first met you that you were beyond salvation.
messages.zh: 靠，我早该猜到你不肯帮忙。我见你第一面时就知道，你是个无药可救的人。

messages.en:
The Amarr Empire, realizing many centuries ago that it could not simply work slaves to the point of death, instituted a number of improvements to worker conditions in an effort to prolong the usable lifespan of its slaves. These changes were not universal across the Empire, due in large part to the Empress's unwillingness to create what might have amounted to significant friction between slave -based companies. Therefore, these decisions were largely left to the Five Heirs and their subordinate regional offices. Thus, we can state here that history has shown a lack of consistent application of these worker improvement programs across the Empire. Those Amarr systems that have chosen to incorporate these adaptations have, however, consistently derived greater revenues due to these enhanced and ongoing pacification efforts.

These shortcomings led directly to the establishment of Labor Reeducation Centers (LRC). An LRC is designed much like a multilevel prison, with facilities for low, medium, and high risk inmates. The inmates are those slaves who consistently exhibit defiance or even outright hostility towards the managerial staff at the mine, construction site, or other location to which they are assigned as slave labor. Once we have identified these persons they are immediately removed from their job site and taken to the nearest LRC for corrective behavioral conditioning. This conditioning can include a wide variety of attitude modification methodologies, from intensive drug assisted counseling, to religious indoctrination, and from advanced torture techniques and a concurrent system of rewards - the so-called “carrot and stick approach” - and any number of programs in between. In this way, we break the individual slave's will so that he may be returned to the workforce as a docile and useful component in the labor pool.
messages.zh:
许多世纪以前，艾玛帝国就已经意识到，不能让每个劳工都蛮干到死。为了延长劳工们的使用期，帝国在劳工工作环境方面做了诸多改善。但这些改善并没有在帝国整个境内推广开来，很大程度上是因为艾玛女皇不愿看到那些使用劳工的企业相互间产生矛盾。这样一来，她便把决定权下放给五位太子及他们各自管辖的星域办公室。因此在艾玛境内，劳工劳工的工作条件改善方案并没有被一致采纳。而那些采纳了该方案的艾玛星系，却需要投入很大一部分税收用于其执行。

这也就是为什么后来会出现劳教中心的原因。劳教中心就像一座分区管理的牢狱一样，轻度危险、中度危险及高度危险的劳工各有一片专属区。收押在劳教中心里的劳工之前都在矿场、工地或者其他被分配到的地点工作，他们在那儿一直不服从命令，有的甚至还威胁管理人员。我们发现这样的人之后，就立即把他们撤离工作岗位，送他们到最近的劳教中心实施行为矫正。这种矫正运用多种态度纠正手段，包括大剂量药物辅助心理辅导、宗教灌输及“胡萝卜加大棒”的奖惩并用等等。这样我们便能摧垮每个劳工的意志，接下来他们就可以服服贴贴地重返工作岗位继续发挥作用了。

messages.en: Amarr Labor Reeducation Centers (LRC)
messages.zh: 艾玛劳教中心（LRC）

messages.en:
As you know, there are many hundreds of thousands of Minmatar slaves working to provide essential services to the Empire, just as they have for centuries. Given their considerable natural physical abilities, they have always made up one of the most important and valuable ethnic groups within the vast Amarr slave workforce. One unavoidable consequence of this, however, is that we have had to invest a considerable amount of money, not only in the health and welfare of these slaves, but also to ensure their obedience.

One important aspect of this latter effort has been the establishment of Labor Reeducation Centers, or LRC's, which are designed to house some of the more problematic slaves in order to facilitate their eventual return to the workforce. In recent months, however, there has been a significant increase in violent disobedience at certain LRC's, with some of the more severe instances leading to near-riots.

Our immediate problem is that one of these facilities, LRC-12A, has been taken over during just such an uprising. The slaves have reportedly killed and injured dozens of our personnel and taken the remainder hostage. They are demanding the immediate release of their fellow slaves at a nearby Amarr mining operation, along with transportation to a destination of their choosing. We have, so far, managed to keep this incident quiet; if the Minmatar Republic leadership were to learn of this, it could very easily lead to much more severe consequences for both races. The only way to ensure this does not happen is through the immediate application of overwhelming force.

Therefore, we need you to deliver a large contingent of specially trained Riot Interdiction Teams to a nearby station, from which they will join up with other security elements for final transportation to LRC-12A. Will you assist us?
messages.zh:
你知道，数十万计的米玛塔尔劳工在为帝国服务，几个世纪以来都是如此。由于他们身体素质出众，因此在艾玛所有的劳工劳工群体中，米玛塔尔劳工是最被器重的民族之一。但与此同时一个不可避免的后果就是，我们必须砸大笔钱，不但要保证这帮人的衣食住行，还得确保他们听话。

为了做到后者，我们建立了“劳教中心”，简称LRC。我们把那些闹事的劳工送入那里，以便让他们最终都能重返工作岗位。但最近，一些劳教中心里发生的暴力反抗事件明显增多，有些甚至严重到几乎要暴动的地步。

我们目前面临的首要问题来自LRC-12A这个劳教中心，那里已经被劳工们控制了。据称他们害死了我们数十位人员，并且把剩下的人都劫为了人质。那帮劳工要求我们立即释放在他们那儿附近一座艾玛采矿工地上工作的劳工，他们还要求我们把释放的人送往他们指定的地点。到目前为止，我们还没有让这件事走漏风声。如果米玛塔尔高层获悉此事，那很容易会产生对双方而言都很严重的后果。而防止这种后果产生的唯一方法就是，立即调用压倒性的武装力量。

因此你现在要做的就是，将一批受过特训的反暴特勤组送往附近一座空间站，他们会在那里与其他安保人员汇合，然后一道前往LRC-12A劳教中心。你愿意帮忙吗？

messages.en: You soulless coward! Without the men you agreed to deliver our assault on the prison will undoubtedly lead to unnecessary casualties on all sides.
messages.zh: 你这没良心的胆小鬼！缺了你本来要送去的那批人，我们的控制行动一定会给各方都造成不必要的伤亡。

messages.en: Good job, pilot. Please make all possible haste to the station as the other teams are waiting on you. The assault phase will begin after you deliver the RIT personnel and their equipment.
messages.zh: 很好，飞行员。请尽快赶往那座空间站，其他队伍的人都在等你们。等你把反暴特勤组的人与他们的装备都送到那儿之后，我们就会开始控制行动。

messages.en: That is very good to hear, thank you. We will transfer the cargo to your hangar immediately, along with a small element of the intelligence team, who have stated that they will provide security through to the final destination station. You'd best head to your ship quickly, as I wouldn't want those guys on board my ship without an escort, especially as the rather unique weapons they usually carry are easily capable of punching a nice little hole in your hull.
messages.zh: 真是好消息，谢谢了。我们会立即把货物转移到你的机库，与此同时还有一小批情报人员会跟随你，他们说会负责路上的保安工作。你最好快点回到你的船上。他们身上携带的武器能轻而易举地把你的船体打出个洞来，你应该赶快过去盯住他们。

messages.en: Our security and military ground forces have been experiencing a slow but steady increase in the numbers and severity of injuries suffered during a wide range of armed conflicts. A recent study by Amarr military scientists has determined that the primary cause of this has been a failure to adequately improve the lightweight body armor worn by millions of our soldiers, Marines, police, and other fighting forces. As fate would have it, one of our intelligence units has obtained what they claim to be a revolutionary new fabric that could provide fifty percent better protection across the board in all types of engagements. We need you to deliver this very sensitive cargo to a station we designate.
messages.zh: 在各类武装冲突中，我们的地面安保和军事部队的受伤人数与创伤程度，都在缓慢持续的增加。根据艾玛军事科学家们最近的一份研究报告，导致这一现象的主要原因是，数百万士兵、海军、警察及其他武装人员穿戴的轻型防弹衣未能得到有效改进。但我们的一个情报部门，最近却获得了一种被他们称为突破性的新型纤维。无论用于哪一种战斗，这种纤维提供的防护力都要比现有品种高50%，也许这就是神的护佑。我们现在要你把这个敏感的货物送到指定空间站。

messages.en: Outstanding, pilot. You were even a bit ahead of schedule. Our offloading team is en route to your ship, and the Intel guards will stay with the shipment until that has been completed. I will keep your name in my “go to” list should any more missions come up in the future.
messages.zh: 太棒了，飞行员。你甚至还提前了一点抵达。我们的装卸人员正在赶往你的舰船，情报人员会一直监护这批东西，直到卸载完成。如果将来我这里还有任务，你会是我的首选委派对象。

messages.en: I must say I am disappointed in your decision to turn down this mission. I vouched for you personally, given what I have seen in your files about your excellent mission completion record. I will not soon forget your refusal.
messages.zh: 你拒绝此任务，我深感失望。从你的档案来看，你的任务完成记录相当好。我为此还曾经极力替你说好话。对你的这次拒绝，我是不会轻易忘记的。

messages.en: Lightweight body armor is a common and often required element of any police or security forces' operational gear. Modern armor of this type can stop most projectile, laser, and other light weapon fire. However, as small arms weaponry continued to evolve with regard to the amount of damage it can inflict, so to must the defensive technologies designed to maintain parity with these weapons. On rare occasions, a corporation, military laboratory, or other entity will produce a light body armor system that represents nothing short of a generational leap in design and protection. The multilayered fabrics used in these latter applications are usually amongst the most highly guarded secrets of any civilization, for many reasons. The most advanced of these contain nanotechnology which also can change color and density depending on ambient conditions and/or input from the wearer.
messages.zh: 轻型防弹衣是警察或安全部队常用和必备的物品。这种现代的防弹衣能抵挡大部分子弹、激光及其他轻型武器发射的弹药。然而随着小型手持武器的威力越来越强，针对其的防御科技也必须跟上。少数时候，军团、军事实验室或其他组织能制作出一种在设计与防御力方面皆有划时代意义的轻型防弹衣。由于多种原因，每个国家都把防弹衣采用的多层纤维列为最高机密。最先进的那些纤维采用了纳米技术，能根据周围环境及/或穿戴者的指令来改变自身颜色与密度。

messages.en: Lightweight Body Armor
messages.zh: 轻型防弹衣

messages.en:
Thank you for coming, pilot. As you know, the Amarr Empire is in a constant state of conflict. Our enemies have included organized criminal gangs, drug traffickers, terrorists of every conceivable motivation, pirates, unpacified slave populations, and even the occasional low level skirmish against our fair-weather friends, the Caldari, Gallente, and, lest we forget, the Minmatar. This requires the Empire to always remain vigilant to any situations that may call for the use of force on levels ranging from simple urban pacification to outright military combat. What you do not know is that a high-level internal Empire report has revealed that our casualty levels have been steadily increasing over the last several years, often requiring evacuation to more robust – and already overburdened – medical facilities.

In the “recommendations” section of this report, the researchers concluded that the single most identifiable cause of these excessive casualties is a systemic problem with our lightweight body armor. This armor is standard issue for millions of police and security personnel, as well as our military reconnaissance units. Unless a drastic improvement in the quality and durability of this body armor can be found, we will continue to suffer the consequences.

This morning I received a priority communication from an Amarr Intelligence Officer claiming that his team had just “obtained” a revolutionary new fabric that, if properly processed, could literally double the strength of our existing armor. I know this officer only by reputation, and it is best not to pry any further into how his team came across this “miracle cloth.” Nonetheless, we have been advised that they will arrive at this station within moments to transfer the fabric here for transshipment to a more secure facility.

So, pilot, will you transport this prototype body armor fabric to the station facility we designate?
messages.zh:
谢谢你赶过来，飞行员。你知道，艾玛帝国里一天到晚都有这样那样的冲突发生。我们的敌人包括流氓组织、违规药品非法贩售贩、怀着各类动机的恐怖份子、海盗及未开化的劳工，甚至偶尔还得与面子上的朋友——加达里、盖伦特及米玛塔尔进行小规模的交火。这就要求我们时刻保持警惕，做好应对从平息城市暴乱到展开军事战斗的各种准备。你不知道的是，艾玛政府高层内部有一份报告指出，我方伤亡人数近些年来一直在增加，导致高级医疗急救站超负荷运转。

在这份报告的“建议”一栏中，研究人员做出结论称，我们在轻型防弹衣方面暴露出的系统性问题，是导致过度伤亡的最主要原因。我们目前采用的防弹衣是标准类型，数以百万计的警察、安保人员与军事侦察部队都穿戴这种防弹衣。如果它在质量与耐用性方面没有重大改善，那我们这种伤亡增加趋势就会继续下去。

今天早上，我突然接到一位艾玛情报官发来的急电，他称其手下的人已经“获得”了一种突破性的新型纤维，只要加以适当处理，就能使我们现有防弹衣的防护力翻一倍。我对这位官员了解不多，所以我们最好不要去追问他手下那些人究竟怎么得到这种“奇迹服装”的。我接到指令说，他们很快就会抵达这里，然后会将这种纤维分批装到不同的船上，运往一个更安全的场所。

怎么样，飞行员，愿意帮忙将这种试验型防弹衣纤维送到我们指定的空间站吗？

messages.en: Quitting mid-mission is not something I expected from you. Now I am going to have to answer to the intelligence team. Oh, and don't expect any further jobs from me until your failure here has been long forgotten. Damn… I need a stress pill….
messages.zh: 我没料到你会打退堂鼓。你让我现在怎么跟我们的情报人员交代？除非我将来淡忘了你这次的举动，否则你别想再从我这里接活儿。靠…我需要点镇静剂…

messages.en: Thank you for the update pilot, but no need to contact me until you arrive. The Intel security team on your ship is keeping me quite well informed.
messages.zh: 谢谢你提供最新情况，飞行员。但你最好等到抵达后再联系我。你船上的情报人员会一直向我通报最新进展的。

name.ru: Когти и клыки (Of Fangs and Claws)

messages.en: I had a feeling an easy job like this one might interest you. Good chance to flip on the autopilot and take a nap.  Just make sure the cages are secure and locked and your cargo bay doors are sealed.
messages.zh: 我之前就觉得这份简单的工作应该会让你感兴趣。你这次完全可以启用自动导航，然后打个盹儿。只要你确保笼子都放好锁紧了，并且你的货柜舱门也已经锁上了。

messages.en: Some decades ago, Amarr veterinary scientists achieved a milestone in genetic manipulation with the creation of hybrid slaver hounds. These new breeds are specifically designed to live and work in extreme climate conditions, which is a boon for all those slave labor facilities on ice planets and other harsh environments. Demand for these animals has been overwhelming and we are struggling to maintain our delivery schedule. I need a large shipment of these hybrid slaver hounds delivered to a nearby station. From there they will be transshipped to a desert planet and put to work as guard animals.
messages.zh: 几十年前，艾玛兽医学家成功地创造出了混血猎奴犬，它成为了基因改造的一个里程碑。这种猎奴犬专门被用来在极端气候条件下生活与工作，对于那些在冰体行星及其他恶劣环境中的劳工工地来说，这绝对是一个好消息。这种猎奴犬已经到了供不应求的地步，我们送货都已经送不过来了。我现在需要你将一大批这种猎奴犬送到附近的一座空间站。之后它们会被分批送往一颗沙漠行星，在那里用作看护犬。

messages.en: See? I told you this one was a no-brainer.  I would suggest, though, remaining in your ship until the hounds have been safely offloaded. I wouldn't want to be hanging around your cargo bay if one of them got loose, as the sedatives will have worn off by now.
messages.zh: 看到没有？我早就跟你说过，这是件不用动脑子的事情。但你最好还是等猎奴犬都被安全卸下之后再离船，因为现在他们体内的镇静剂应该已经失效了。

messages.en: I really am surprised that you're declining this one. It was a good chance to make some quick ISK with very little risk. Well, no bother. There is no shortage of pilots looking for an easy trip.
messages.zh: 你拒绝这任务让我深感意外。这原本是个低风险捞外快的好机会。算了，无所谓。反正很多人都会抢着干这种简单跑腿的活儿。

messages.en:
Amarr slavers on Syrikos V first learned to breed and train slaver hounds to provide an extra layer of low-cost security for their slave labor operations. These animals soon proved their worth, particularly as a last line of defense for any slave that managed to bypass a facility's security controls and escape into the whatever wilderness lay beyond the facility's walls. So keen are the senses of these animals, and so lethal their attacks, that most slaves will give up any hope of escape before even making the attempt. One problem that arose, however, was that many slave labor operations were located in some of the harshest imaginable environments, often so harsh that they were unsuitable for your average slaver hound.

So, it was with tremendous satisfaction that Amarr veterinary scientists reported recently that they had managed to create stable, obedient hybrids of the breed, each type adapted for a different geographic or atmospheric condition. Thus, if you are a slave owner on an ice planet, for example, you can now purchase slaver hounds with thicker pelts, greater body fat, and higher overall tolerance to cold and freezing wind. These new hybrids have proven remarkably adaptable, and have long since spread to slave labor facilities throughout the Empire.
messages.zh:
希尔库索行星V上的艾玛劳工主们最先学会了饲养和训练猎奴犬，他们将这种动物当作低成本的辅助保安去监管他们的劳工。这种动物很快证明了它们的价值，尤其是在面对任何躲过了安保装置、逃入荒野的劳工时，它们更被证明是最后一道防线。由于它们的知觉异常敏锐，攻击力十分致命，多数劳工基本上都会打消逃跑的念头。但有一个问题：许多劳工们都在最艰苦的环境下工作，而一般的猎奴犬都适应不了那些环境。

所以，当艾玛兽医学家最近报告说他们已经能培育出一批稳定听话、能适应不同地理或气候环境的猎奴犬时，大家都很高兴。这样一来，如果你是一个冰体行星上的劳工主，那你就能买到毛皮很厚、脂肪很多并且对严寒风潮有强忍受力的猎奴犬。实践证明，这种混血猎奴犬适应力极强，早已遍布帝国内的各个劳工工地。

messages.en: The Origins of Hybrid Slaver Hounds
messages.zh: 混血猎奴犬的起源

messages.en:
I'm not sure how much you know about Amarr slave labor installations, such as mines, agricultural harvesting fields, moon mineral extraction zones, and the like. Well, I can tell you that these facilities are often of such size and complexity that they cannot always be wholly secured against slave escape attempts. Certainly, all but the most primitive and poorly administrated of these locations feature any and all manner of perimeter alarms, security cameras, remote sentry drones, microwave motion detectors, infrared barrier fences, you name it. As you can imagine, though, this can get quite expensive given not only the capital outlay for the equipment, but for the manpower needed to operate and maintain them year-round, 24 hours a day.

It was during this search for lower cost alternatives to these technologies that the animals we call slaver hounds were introduced to the overall security plans of select slave labor facilities, used to detect, track, and interdict runaway slaves. Their acutely tuned senses coupled with their remarkable natural endurance and speed made them an ideal choice for many Amarr slave operations. However, it was not long before it was realized that the standard, purebred slaver hound was not suitable for all environments. This resulted in the creation of genetically modified breeds more at home in harsher environments such as swamps, frozen wastelands, jungles, and the like. Today, these more adaptable variants can be found on many such installations throughout the Empire, despite their comparatively high cost when compared to your usual slaver hounds.

This brings us to the reason I contacted you. I need a large shipment of these hybrid slaver hounds delivered to a nearby station for transshipment to an Amarr desert planet. As long as the hounds remain sedated and don't find their way out of their cages, this should be a simple, trouble-free courier job.
messages.zh:
对于矿场、农田及卫星开采区之类的艾玛劳工工地，我不知道你了解多少。但我可以告诉你，那些地方都非常辽阔及复杂，想要完全防止劳工逃跑，一般都是不可能的。当然，除了那些最原始、管理最差的工地之外，其他所有该类场所都配备了外围报警器、监控摄像头、远程岗哨无人机、微波运动探测器及红外线栅栏等你能想到的所有保安装置。但你应该也能想到，这些东西不仅代价高，而且还需要有人一年到头、全天候地去操控维护它们。

正是在寻求替代这些技术的低成本方案的过程中，我们引入了一种被称作猎奴犬的动物。在一批选定的劳工工地的总体安保计划中，它们被用来侦测、跟踪及拦截逃亡的劳工。凭着敏锐的感觉和与生俱来的超强耐力与速度，它们成了众多艾玛劳工工地上理想的安保力量。但没多久，我们就发现标准的纯种猎奴犬无法适应所有的环境。因此我们就利用这里的自然条件，在沼泽、冰冻荒地及丛林之类的恶劣环境下创造出了基因改良品种。如今在帝国境内，虽然这种适应性更强的猎奴犬相对纯种犬而言更贵，但许多劳工工地还是用上了它们。

现在我就和你谈谈为什么要你来的原因。我这里有一大批混血猎奴犬需要被运往附近一座空间站，然后它们会被分批送往艾玛的一颗沙漠行星上。只要这些家伙身体内的镇静剂不失效，没有逃出笼子，那这份运输任务就应该是小菜一碟。

messages.en: You're quitting this mission? You should know that quitting a mission as simple as this one does not look good on a pilot's record.
messages.zh: 你要退出这项任务？告诉你，退出如此简单的任务会给你的飞行员记录抹黑的。

messages.en: Good to know the hounds haven't caused you any trouble. Please contact me when you reach the station. Offloading has already been arranged.
messages.zh: 那些猎奴犬还没有给你带来任何麻烦，很好。等你到了空间站后再联系我吧。卸载工作已经安排好了。

messages.en: I certainly do appreciate your help, pilot. Hopefully, if we can get these drills into the hands of the miners in short order, the company should be able to retain its mining rights and return to profitability.
messages.zh: 非常感谢你能帮忙，飞行员。如果我们能在最短时间内将钻机送到矿工手里，公司就有望保住采矿权并且继续盈利。

messages.en: Due to a recent series of inspections by the regional mine monitoring commission, we have found it necessary to purchase a large quantity of the latest generation of environmentally-friendly drills and related equipment. In order to avoid financial penalties and the possible loss of our mining rights, that company must get these quite expensive new drills into the hands of the miners as soon as possible. If you can deliver this cargo to the station that serves as our logistical hub for this system, they can then have their own pilots transship them to the required planetary mining locations.
messages.zh: 依据星域矿业监管协会近期一系列的检查结果，我们现在有必要购入大量最新的环保型钻机及相关设备。公司需要尽快把这些昂贵的钻机送到矿工手里，以免遭受罚款或是采矿权益上的损失。如果你能将这些设备送到我们在这个星系的物流中心的话，他们接下来就可以派人把货转运往各个行星矿点。

messages.en: Job well done. Our logistics teams are loading your shipment into their transport vessels as we speak, and we should have the drills and equipment in place shortly. We will definitely contact you again, should we require your services.
messages.zh: 干得好。如我所言，我们的物流团队正忙于把你送来的货装船，很快就可以把这些钻机和设备运往各处。我们仍然需要你更多的帮助，稍后会继续联系你的。

messages.en: Well, I must say we are quite disappointed that you would turn down this very easy contract. We shall find another pilot and move your name to the bottom of our list. Don't call us, we'll call you.
messages.zh: 这么简单的任务你也不愿意接受，我真的对你非常失望。我们会去找别人帮忙，你在我们心中的地位已经大大降低了。别再来烦我们，我们会去找你的。

messages.en:
Let me start at the beginning. As you have probably seen on the news channels, a prominent Caldari mining company is in the middle of a very nasty battle for economic survival with a new, up-and-coming mining company from within the same large conglomerate. Both of these companies specialize in the extraction of ores from some of the more inhospitable and dangerous locations in this and several adjoining systems. While this can be hazardous with regard to men and equipment, the profit potential from these largely untapped ore reserves can be quite significant, which brings me to our current predicament.

As you may know, the specialized manual labor required for some of these mines can be significant in terms of numbers. Well, the Mining Health and Safety Commission, or MHSC, for this region recently conducted a survey of the first company's operations, and found that their mining practices at certain locations may have resulted in excessive pollution, then further alleged a corresponding link to long-term miner health problems. The company has loudly complained that this is a ridiculous witch hunt brought about by their new competitor, which happens to have several “friends” on the commission. While they work to ensure they are equally “represented” on that commission, the recent finding has mandated that they immediately improve worker conditions and reduce pollution or risk losing their mining rights. To remedy this problem, they recently purchased a large number of the latest environmentally-friendly – and obscenely expensive – manportable drills, which seems to have assuaged the MHSC for the moment. They do, however, have a deadline for actually putting these new drills into the hands of the miners, which brings us to the reason I contacted you.

We need you to deliver a rather large shipment of drills and other related equipment to a station that serves as a central service hub. From there, logistics pilots will deliver this and other items to the various mines in the system. Will you take on this important job?
messages.zh:
我从头说起。你大概已经听过相关新闻报道，一家加达里矿业巨头正陷入一场险恶的，关乎生存的经济战争，对手是来自同一财团的一家崭露头角的新兴矿业公司。这两家公司都擅长从邻近的几个星系中的一些比较荒凉及危险的地区开采矿石并将之精炼。虽然这种开采方式对人员及设备都比较有害，但是大量矿石蕴藏的利润前景非常巨大，这也让我陷入了目前的麻烦。

你可能知道，在这些矿区里，人力操作显得极为重要。本星域的矿业健康及安全协会（MHSC）最近对那家矿业巨头进行了调查，发现他们在某些特定地区的开采行为可能会造成严重污染，并由此导致长期的矿工健康隐患。这家公司对此强烈抗议，并声称他们的新竞争对手在协会内部有“靠山”，这不过是对手耍的可笑伎俩。 与此同时，他们一方面在协会内部寻求公正对待，另一方面也不得不接受协会的指令：要马上改善矿工工作环境并减少污染，否则就有失去采矿权的危险。为了解决问题，他们近期购进了大量极其昂贵的最新环保型单人钻机，并藉此暂时缓和了协会对他们的态度。不过，他们必须在规定期限到来之前将这些新钻机交到矿工手中，这也正是我们找你来的原因。

我们需要你将一大批钻机及相关设备送往服务中心。那里的物流人员随后会将货物及其他设备送往星系内不同的矿点。你愿意承担如此重任吗？

messages.en: We are shocked to hear that you have chosen to quit this job in the middle of the contract. We will now have to pay another pilot double to pick up where you left off. You should have let us know from the outset that you could not take on this important job. Hopefully, we will never have to rely on you again.
messages.zh: 我们对你半途而废的行为感到十分震惊。现在我们被迫支付另一位飞行员双倍的报酬来接手你留下来的烂摊子。你早该在一开始就告诉我们，你干不了这么重要的工作。我们不会再相信你了。

messages.en: You seem to be on schedule and we look forward to the prompt delivery of the equipment to the designated station. Contact us through the usual channels after you have offloaded this gear.
messages.zh: 看起来你正在有条不紊地工作中，希望你能按时把设备送到指定空间站。你卸下货物后，就像往常那样联系我吧。

messages.en: We're very glad to hear you are willing to take on this important mission. If we can get these EM devices to the station in time, I know we can save many innocent lives.
messages.zh: 我们非常高兴你勇于承担如此重任。如果我们能及时把这些电磁设备送到空间站，将挽救许许多多的无辜生命。

messages.en: Following a string of suicide terrorist attacks yesterday, we managed to capture a high ranking member of their organization. Interrogations have revealed, however, that a devastating viral weapon, based on nanotechnology, is already in place and primed for release. We need you to deliver the only known countermeasure to this agent, manportable electromagnetic weapons. If we are successful, these weapons could eradicate the virus before it has a chance to spread and infect the entire station.
messages.zh: 昨天的一系列自尽式恐怖袭击发生之后，我们抓获了一名对方组织的高级成员。经过审讯，我们得知一种基于纳米技术的毁灭性病毒武器已经部署完毕，并随时准备散布。我们需要你来运送对抗该毒剂的唯一已知手段——便携式电磁武器。如果能成功，这些武器能够在病毒散播到整个空间站之前将其有效根除。

messages.en: Your bravery and skillful piloting without question, saved the lives of untold numbers of innocent people. We will definitely move your name to the top of our list for any future time-sensitive missions!
messages.zh: 你的勇气与才能挽救了无数无辜的生命。今后如果再有此类紧急事件发生，我们会第一个想到你的名字。

messages.en: We are all terribly disappointed in your refusal to transport these electromagnetic weapons to the station. We shall now have to find another pilot and another ship, and I fear even then we will be too late. I doubt you will be sleeping very well after you see what may become of that station.
messages.zh: 你竟然拒绝伸出援手，我们对你极其失望。我们要再去找其他人帮忙，我担心会来不及了。我觉得你在看到空间站的惨状之后也会睡的安然无比吧，冷血动物！

messages.en: Terrorists, working with criminal scientists, have developed a strain of viral weaponry that is based on nanotechnology. When combined, the "hive mind" of the viral strain works to seek out human tissue at which point the microscopic nanos begin to quickly disassemble the tissue, leading to a slow and painful death. Research into electromagnetic pulses has provided some promising leads with regard to countermeasures, but these have not yet been field tested.
messages.zh: 恐怖分子与那些邪恶的科学家合作，生产出了一种基于纳米技术的病毒武器。一旦生效，病毒体就像蜂群寻巢一样寻找人体组织并使其分解，导致人缓慢而痛苦地死去。研究表明，电磁脉冲似乎是一种有效的应对手段，但是还没有经过实地检测。

messages.en: Nanotechnology-based Viral Weapons
messages.zh: 基于纳米技术的病毒武器

messages.en:
Last night, a strike team of suicide terrorists from the Anti-Corporatist Revolutionary Front, or ACRF, struck at more than twenty Caldari offices and stations throughout the region. During one of these attacks a terrorist was captured with a well-shielded, improvised nuclear device hidden in his rucksack. Obviously this event represents an entirely new level of threat from the ACRF, now that they have proven themselves willing to carry out such a horrendous and indiscriminate mass casualty attack.

The only upside to this is that the terrorist has turned out to be the most notorious operative of the ACRF, a woman known as Commander Rachendia. Having her in custody has offered us an opportunity to gain information related to her group's future plans to strike at the Caldari State. During one of the more aggressive interrogations, she disclosed information about a pending attack against one of our nearby stations. The nature of the attack is not entirely clear; however, we know with certainty that it involves the surreptitious introduction of a viral agent into the life support and air circulation systems.

Our initial searches for these hidden canisters at that station have, so far, been fruitless – with the exception of one small aerosol-type canister. A preliminary test revealed that these viral weapons appear to be based on a self-replicating nanotechnology. Once released from stasis in their container, they seek out and consume human tissue, and leaving behind little more than dust. Our medical scientists have calculated that just one container, released into the central air processing vents, could result in the deaths of all human life aboard a medium-sized station within no more than four hours. The only good news is that these nanos are programmed to self-terminate within 12 hours. Of course, this would be far more time than would be necessary to kill everyone aboard all but the largest of stations.

Your role in this desperate situation is to deliver a cargo of electromagnetic weapons, modified to emit a short-range pulse that will literally "fry" any nanos within its range. So, we are asking: will you deliver these containers to the station immediately? Thousands of lives may depend on your answer.
messages.zh:
昨天晚上，一伙来自“反集团主义变革阵线”（ACRF）的恐怖分子对本星域中超过20个加达里办公室及空间站发动了自尽式袭击。袭击中，一名恐怖分子被捕，身上藏有一个保护完好的简易核装置。显然，ACRF组织对我们的威胁程度已进一步提高，他们已经开始实施可怕的大规模袭击。

唯一的好消息是，我们抓获的那个人居然是ACRF组织最臭名昭著的特工——被称为“雷琴迪娅长官”的女人。从她口中我们可以获知其组织未来对加达里的攻击计划。经过严刑审讯，我们得知，该组织即将对邻近的一个空间站发动袭击。这次袭击的性质还不得而知，但是我们确信，他们会暗中对生命保障及空气循环系统投放病毒。

我们试图在空间站中寻找那些隐藏的病毒容器，但只找到了一个小气雾罐。我们的初步检测显示，这种病毒武器似乎基于一种能够自我复制的纳米技术。被激活之后，它们将开始寻找并侵蚀人体组织，并且不留任何痕迹。我们的医学专家通过计算得知，一罐病毒通过中央排风口扩散的话，可以在4个小时之内害死一个中型空间站里所有的人。唯一值得欣慰的是，这种病毒会在12个小时之内自我毁灭。当然，这个时间足够害死一个普通空间站里所有的人了。

危难当前，你的任务就是运送这些电磁武器。它们经过改良，能发射短距脉冲，理论上可以烧焦射程内的所有纳米病毒。所以，你愿意马上将这些货物送往那座空间站吗？成千上万条人命就指望你了。

messages.en: We had placed all our hope in you completing this mission. It's too late now to find another pilot and another ship. I fear many thousands of lives may be lost due to what can only be your cowardice. Obviously, you are not a man of your word, and we won't forget that.
messages.zh: 我们对你倾注了全部的希望。现在再去找别人帮忙已经来不及了。由于你的懦夫行径，数以千计的生命即将逝去。你不配称为“人”，你的行为我们将永远不会淡忘。

messages.en: Pilot, there is simply no time to discuss this any further. Deliver the cargo to the station immediately, before that horrible weapon kills thousands of innocent men, women, and children.
messages.zh: 飞行员，没时间说更多了。在那种可怕的武器害死成千上万的无辜生命之前，尽快把货物送到空间站去。

messages.en: Thank you for accepting this important, time-sensitive mission. You have been given priority clearance for station undock, so please leave as soon as possible.
messages.zh: 感谢你接受这份重要和紧急的任务。我们已经安排你可以优先离站，所以快点出发吧。

messages.en: A small, platoon-sized Caldari special operation team is in hiding on a Gallente planet and in danger of being captured or killed. They are low on water, food, weapons, and other equipment and will not last long unless they are extracted. We have a rescue standing by; however, we need you to deliver the required materials to their station so that they can then proceed with this critical rescue mission.
messages.zh: 一个排的加达里别动队正藏在一颗盖伦特的行星上，他们面临着被活捉或死亡的危险。他们目前缺水、断粮，没有足够的武器装备，不去救这些人的话他们肯定活不长。我们虽然已经有一支营救队做好了随时出发的准备，但我们还需要你将必需物资运到他们所在的空间站，这样他们才能继续开展这项至关重要的营救任务。

messages.en: We have received word that the extraction team has taken delivery of your cargo and is now en route to the planet. Given the speed with which you delivered this essential shipment, we assess a high likelihood that the stranded team will be safely extracted. Well done!
messages.zh: 我们接到消息说，营救队已经带着你送去的东西赶往那颗行星了。由于你及时交付了这批重要物资，我们认为那支受困的别动队被解救的可能性很大。干得好！

messages.en: Your refusal to accept this mission will almost certainly result in the loss of this Special Forces team, not to mention placing the now-dangerously unequipped extraction team at great risk.
messages.zh: 你拒绝这项任务，基本上宣告了那支受困特种部队的死刑，而且你还把装备严重不足的营救队推入了危险的境地。

messages.en:
One of our Caldari Navy Special Forces units conducting clandestine reconnaissance of a contested ocean planet – a Gallente-claimed planet, by the way, with extremely rare seabed minerals – sent an emergency burst communication to the covert ops ship in orbit above the planet, requesting immediate extraction. This signal was, in turn, transmitted to the classified comms center here on this station. When we attempted to contact both the team and the ship, however, we received no response. Our immediate reaction was to divert one of our long range Crow-class interceptors, which was in the region on an unrelated mission, to investigate. Soon after its arrival, its sensors confirmed that the covert ops ship had been destroyed.

There is nothing we can do for our lost covops ship; however, this series of events has left the Special Forces team alone and without a means to evacuate the planet. Even worse was a fragment from the original communication indicating that the team was on the run and low on food, water, weapons, and ammunition. They have taken refuge in a disused ocean mining facility, though it is doubtful that they will stay hidden for long. There simply aren't many places to hide on that planet, given the fact that it is mostly covered by massive oceans, with very little land mass. It will not take long for the Gallente to track down our team and either kill them or, worse, capture them for interrogation.

The good news in all this is that we have an extraction team in place, along with a shuttle-equipped vessel to deliver them to the planet. However, given the immediacy of this mission, they had to leave their original base without much of their usual equipment and weaponry. This is where you come in. We need you to transport several containers of highly specialized small arms and related equipment to the station at which the extraction team is currently located. Once you drop off this cargo, the team will gear-up and shuttle down to the planet to rescue the stranded team.

So, pilot, what is it gonna be? Will you help us?
messages.zh:
我们的一支加达里海军别动队在一颗主权有争议的海洋行星上进行秘密勘探，盖伦特宣称自己对这一蕴藏稀有海床矿物的行星具有主权。勘探进行到一半，那支别动队突然向轨道上的隐秘侦察舰发出了紧急求救信号，要求立即离开。那个求救信号也传到了这座空间站的一个机密通讯中心。可当我们试图与他们及他们的船取得联系时，却没有收到任何反馈。我们的第一反应就是调遣我们的一艘当时尚在那地区执行其他任务的远程黑鸦级截击舰，命令它赶赴现场调查。它抵达之后，我们很快就从它的扫描器中确认了那艘隐秘侦察舰已被摧毁。

船已毁，我们也无回天之力。但我们的那支别动队还被困在行星上。更糟的是，从他们最初发回的求救信号来看，他们一直居无定所，食物、水、武器、弹药……什么都缺。他们目前躲在一个弃用的海洋矿床，不过我怀疑他们坚持不了多久。由于那颗行星表面大部分都是海洋，基本上没有陆地，因此他们实在没多少地方可躲。按目前情况发展下去，盖伦特用不了多久就能找到他们，然后要么干掉他们，要么更糟的就是，活捉他们带回去审讯。

好在我们现在有一支可以随时出发的营救队，还有一艘载有穿梭机，可将他们送达那个行星的舰船。但由于该任务的紧迫性，他们不得不在没有携带大量武器装备的情况下仓促离开了他们的基地。这也正是你可以帮忙的地方。我们需要你将几箱非常专业的小型军械及相关器械送往那支营救队目前所在的空间站。一旦你把东西送到了，营救队就会立即出发赶往那颗行星搜救那支被困的队伍。

怎么样，飞行员？愿意帮忙吗？

messages.en: We are disappointed that you've chosen not to complete this critical mission. You've left our military personnel at great risk. It is doubtful that we will be able to find anyone else to get this critical shipment to the station in time.
messages.zh: 你选择在如此重要的一项任务中打退堂鼓让我们很失望。你这样做等于把我们部队里的人往火里推。我很怀疑我们能及时找到其他人将这一重要物资送往那空间站。

messages.en: Do not contact us until you have completed this shipment. There is simply no time for idle chatter, not to mention the likelihood that the enemy is almost certainly listening in.
messages.zh: 等完成了运输任务之后再联系我们。现在没时间瞎聊，而且我们的对话还有被窃听的可能。

messages.en: Thank you. That is a big load off my shoulders. We need all the good pilots we can get to help us get these people to safety before the terrorists attempt any suicide attack against this station.
messages.zh: 谢谢。你可为我卸下了一个大包袱。我们要趁恐怖份子还未对这座空间站进行自尽性袭击之前，用上所有我们能用的飞行员去把这批平民送往一个安全地点。

messages.en: Suicide terrorists have been attacking and destroying our commercial convoys as they have passed through their usual transit zones, despite the presence of heavy security escort vessels. A communications intercept, partially decoded, indicates that these individual intend to step up the level of their attacks by targeting the stations themselves. While we can defend against some of these attackers, based on analysis of their previous attack profiles, we have never had to defend against pilots and ships who fully intend to die by throwing themselves against us without regard for their own lives. Tactical analysis indicates that they will get through our defense and may cause catastrophic damage, likely killing hundreds if not thousands of our civilian workforce and their families. We need you to help us evacuate them immediately!
messages.zh: 虽然我们有全副武装的护航舰对商船保驾护航，自尽性恐怖份子还是袭击损毁了我们不少商船。从一份被截取并部分解密的通讯来看，恐怖份子已打算升级他们的行动，准备直接袭击空间站了。虽然我们自己能抵御一部分这些人，但他们之前的袭击历史已经表明，这帮恐怖份子是不要命的亡命之徒，我们以前可从来没有对付过这种人。从战术分析结果来看，他们会突破我方的防守，有可能造成灾难性后果，数以千百计的我们的平民工作人员及之家属可能遭遇不测。我们需要你立刻将他们转移走！

messages.en: I will never be able to thank you for helping us in our most dire hour. The Caldari Navy should be arriving soon to provide additional security, but that's no guarantee that the terrorists won't follow through with their insidious plans. I will be sure to pass the word throughout the comms networks of the great service you did for all of us today.
messages.zh: 在这最危急的时刻你能出手相助，我对此感激不尽。加达里海军马上会来这儿加强守卫，但这并不代表那帮恐怖份子会放弃他们的阴险计划。我肯定会利用整个通信网，好好表彰一下你今天为我们做出的贡献。

messages.en: I cannot believe what I'm hearing – you are refusing to help save these people? Well, I don't know where we are going to find another ship at this late hour.
messages.zh: 什么，你拒绝救人？我不知道我们能否在这么晚的时间找到其他飞行员。

messages.en: We have virtually no information on these new threats, other than that they have access to very fast ships filled to the brim with high explosives. Their tactics are simple – they seem to appear out of nowhere, then accelerate their ships to maximum velocity and, ignoring defensive fire, fly directly into the cargo bays of our freighters and other haulers. We are currently working with Caldari Naval Intelligence to determine the source of this scourge; however, early indications from their ship markings are that they belong to an extremists environmental cult that views the Caldari State as the ultimate evil in the universe. They will stop at nothing to destroy us, especially as we expand planetary industry and resource harvesting.
messages.zh: 我们对这些威胁几乎一无所知，只知道这帮恐怖份子拥有装满烈性炸药的高速飞船。他们的战术很简单——埋伏好后突然出现，然后不顾我方的阻击火力，以最大速度径直撞向我们的货舰与其他货船。我们目前正在与加达里海军情报部合作调查这帮恐怖份子的动机。不过，从他们船上的记号来看，他们应该隶属一个将加达里视为世界万恶之首的极端环保组织。他们会不惜一切代价摧毁我们，尤其是我们现在开始扩张行星工业采集资源的时候。

messages.en: Anti-Caldari Suicide Terrorists
messages.zh: 反加达里自尽性恐怖份子

messages.en:
I'm not going to beat around the bush with you on this one, as there isn't any time. We have a developing emergency in {[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}. Several of our commercial convoys have been ripped to shreds in the last few months by an extremely dangerous band of terrorists. As you can see from these camera drone recordings, they have even been willing to fly their ships directly into our freighters and other unarmed haulers. And yes, before you ask, we have been escorting these convoys with heavily armed security vessels, though to little effect.

As these terrorists are obviously willing to die for their cause, they aren't bothering to attack our warships. They simply seem to appear out of nowhere, accelerate to high speeds and slam into the cargo ships. Depending on the cargo, this action can, at best, tear open the cargo bays and release the contents into the vacuum of space, or, at worst, strike a shipment of fuels or ammunition, and destroy the freighter in one huge explosion. One such explosion destroyed an entire convoy.

However, an ultra-secure communications intercept satellite recently picked up a communication that we believe indicates the terrorists are now considering turning their deadly tactic against some unidentified stations in the region. Given our huge civilian population on these stations, the decision has been made to conduct a partial evacuation of all potential target stations.

What we need from you is your help in getting these civilians – mostly the spouses and children of station personnel – to a station that is further away from the terrorists' known area of operation. Normally, I would not ask this of a capsuleer, but I am begging you: will you help us evacuate these people until this threat has passed? We need to know right now, as we have already begun to organize the evacuation fleet; can we count you in?
messages.zh:
我现在没时间可以浪费，咱们直入主题。{[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}正发生一起紧急事件。我们的商船队在过去几个月里遭到一伙穷凶极恶的恐怖分子袭击，损失惨重。你从摄像无人机上记录下的内容就可以看到，他们可以无所顾忌的撞向我们的货舰与其他货船。而且这是在我们已经让装备精良的护航舰为商船队保驾护航的情况下发生的，现在看来没什么用。

这帮恐怖份子明显已经做好了为其目的殉身的准备，所以他们根本不会去攻击我们的战船。这群人也不知道从哪儿冒出来，出来后就加速直奔我们的货船，最后来个鱼死网破。根据货物不同，后果也不一样。最好的情况是货柜舱出现个窟窿，货物都飘入太空；最坏的情况是一船燃料或武器弹药被撞到，整个货舰都付之一炬。曾有一次爆炸导致整个船队都无一幸免。

但现在，通过一个超级安全的通讯拦截卫星，我们窃听到了对方的一次通信，他们打算将袭击目标转变为本星域中的某些空间站，具体哪些空间站目前尚不得而知。由于空间站内有我们大量平民，我们决定转移所有可能遭袭击的空间站内的人员。

我们需要你帮忙的地方就是，将这些平民——他们基本都是空间站工作人员的配偶与子女——转移到远离这帮恐怖份子行动范围的一座空间站。一般情况下我是不会麻烦克隆飞行员这种事情的，但现在我不得不求你：在我们还未消除这威胁之前，你能帮我们先把这些人转移走吗？请马上回答。我们已经在调遣营救舰船了。你要来帮忙吗？

messages.en: You are quitting on us now? In the middle of an evacuation? Fine. Just deliver those men, women, and children to the nearest safe location, and we will send someone to get them. You are a despicable coward and you'd better hope you never need to transit through this system ever again.
messages.zh: 你现在要退出？在你的营救工作进行到一半时？算了。你把那些男人女人及小孩都送到最近的一座安全空间站，我们自己会派人去接他们的。我鄙视你这种胆小鬼。你最好别再来这星系。

messages.en: Thank you for the update. I am glad to hear the passengers are doing well. I can't tell you how much it means to us that you are willing to divert from more profitable ventures to save these innocent lives.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的进展报告。得知乘客都安然无恙我很高兴。你能放弃利润更丰厚的工作来拯救无辜的百姓，我们对你感激不尽。
