我本来应该把这些报告送到{[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}的加达里海军空间站的，可是我现在抽不出时间。报告内容是关于我们最近招募的新人，但是必须保密。海军方面显然有多个职位在招聘飞行员，而且他们想考察应征者的背景信息。这就是我无法直接把信息发送出去的原因：由于通信可能被黑客入侵，加达里法律禁止直接发送个人信息。

如果你能替我跑一趟，我会给你丰厚的报酬。而且动作快的话还有加成奖励哦！

name.fr: Matériel pour la préparation de la guerre
name.ja: 戦争準備のための資源
name.ru: Средства для подготовки к войне (Materials For War Preparation)

messages.en: We are escalating our production so we can increase our military strength in light of recent political upheavals in the world. Increased production requires more minerals. I want you to get {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity} to one of our main production facilities. Your help will undoubtedly get a positive response from other corporate members.
messages.zh: 鉴于最近时局动荡，我们正在扩大生产，以增强军队力量。扩大生产就需要更多的矿物。我要你把{[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}送到我们的一个主要生产设施。你的帮助必将获得军团其他成员的赞扬。

messages.en: Great! Your achievements for us have not gone unnoticed.
messages.zh: 太好了！你对我们的贡献是有目共睹的。

messages.en: Mission 1 completed.
messages.zh: 任务1完成。

messages.en: Mission 1 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务1。

messages.en: Good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
At the moment, all you have to fly is a capsule. Our first priority is to get you into a starship.

Your assignment: Follow the tutorial steps, I will guide you to a hidden location in space.

If you ever get lost, remember to use the back and next buttons and read the tutorial slides or you can quit the mission and start over again from the beginning.
messages.zh:
现在，你所用过的飞行器就只有逃生舱一种。我们现在要做的第一件事，就是让你驾驶一艘舰船。

你的任务：遵照教程步骤，同时我会带你去一个隐秘地点。

如果你迷路了，别担心，只要单击教程上的前后按钮或者退出任务从头再来就行。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.

For completing the mission, you have received a reward. Note that for some missions this reward will be an item that the agent will drop in your hangar, while in others it will be a transfer to your wallet of Interstellar Kredits (ISK), the currency used by pod pilots.

Your next mission will involve combat, so you should learn to fit your new starship now. When you're ready for that, click the Request Mission button.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

由于你完成了任务，你已获得了奖励。注意，有些奖励会由代理人直接放入的你的机库，另外一些奖励则将以星币（飞行员使用的货币）的形式直接进入的钱包。

你接下来的任务将涉及战斗，因此你现在应该掌握如何装配你的新舰船。准备好之后，就请按我要执行新任务按钮。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:
Hello, {[character]player.name}. At the moment, all you have to fly is a capsule. Our first priority is to get you into a starship.

Your assignment: Follow the tutorial steps, I will guide you to a hidden location in space.

If you ever get lost, remember to use the back and next buttons and read the tutorial slides or you can quit the mission and start over again from the beginning.
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}。现在，你所用过的飞行器就只有逃生舱一种。我们现在要做的第一件事，就是让你驾驶一艘舰船。

你的任务：遵照教程步骤，同时我会带你去一个隐秘地点。

如果你迷路了，别担心，只要单击教程上的前后按钮或者退出任务从头再来就行。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Your ship and the item I've asked you to retrieve are located at a site in this system.
messages.zh: 你的船与我要你去取的东西都在本星系的某一处。

messages.en: Mission 2 completed.
messages.zh: 任务2完成。

messages.en: Mission 2 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务2。

messages.en: Good. Now you must learn how to fit modules to your ship.
messages.zh: 很好。现在你得学习如何装配你的舰船了。

messages.en:
You're doing well so far, {[character]player.name}. Your next test will involve some basic combat training.

When you are ready, you'll be provided with some modules to fit to your starship. Make sure to keep following the tutorial, I will explain how to fit the modules. Once you are fitted, you will fly out to a location in space to begin your combat training.

Once again, you will be provided with tutorials to guide you along the way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你目前的表现很好。你接下来的训练将涉及战斗的基本知识。

准备好后，你会得到一些可装配在你舰船上的装备。请一定要跟着教程走，我会教你如何装配。当你把它们装配好之后，你就将飞往太空中的某一处进行战斗训练。

同样，一路上你会获得相应指导。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}.

You're almost ready to begin your career as a capsuleer but there is one last task. You must retrieve your Pilot Certification from one of our local academies. Request the next mission when you are ready.
messages.zh:
你表现不错，{[character]player.name}。

现在离你克隆飞行员生涯的正式开始还差最后一步。你必须从我们的一座当地学院那儿获得你的克隆飞行员证书。准备好之后就请求下一个任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:
You're doing well so far, {[character]player.name}. Your next test will involve some basic combat training.

When you are ready, you'll be provided with some modules to fit to your starship. Make sure to keep following the tutorial, I will explain how to fit the modules. Once you are fitted, you will fly out to a location in space to begin your combat training.

Once again, you will be provided with tutorials to guide you along the way.

{[character]player.name}，你目前的表现很好。你接下来的训练将涉及战斗的基本知识。

同样，一路上你会获得相应指导。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Pirates are a blight on New Eden. Make sure you kill every last one, or they will scatter and regather somewhere else.
messages.zh: 海盗就像宇宙中的疟疾一般。你必须将他们一网打尽，否则他们便会卷土重来。

messages.en: Mission 3 completed.
messages.zh: 任务3完成。

messages.en: Mission 3 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务3。

messages.en: You're ready to depart? Excellent.
messages.zh: 你准备好出发了吗？非常好，

messages.en:
You've been learning quickly, {[character]player.name}. You're ready to start setting your own goals soon, but before you head out on your own you should stop off at a local academy of ours.

Follow the tutorial steps to guide you to a neighboring system where you will receive your certification documents proving you completed this course.
messages.zh:
你进步很快，{[character]player.name}。很快你就可以自主设定目标了，但在此之前，你还应该先去我们的一座职业学校。

请遵照教程，前往一个邻近星系。在那儿你会拿到一张表明你已完成本教程的证书。

messages.en: Congratulations, {[character]player.name}, you have graduated from the pilot's certification course. I'll be providing you with some basic information now on where to go. Request a new mission whenever you're ready.
messages.zh: 祝贺你，{[character]player.name}，你已经顺利学完了飞行员认证课程。接下来我会针对你今后的发展方向提点建议。准备好之后就来接受新任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

You've been learning quickly, {[character]player.name}. You're ready to start setting your own goals soon, but before you head out on your own you should stop off at a local academy of ours.

messages.zh:
你进步很快，{[character]player.name}。很快你就可以自主设定目标了，但在此之前，你还应该先去我们的一座职业学校。

请遵照教程，前往一个邻近星系。在那儿你会拿到一张表明你已完成本教程的证书。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Take your time at the academy, {[character]player.name}. There is a lot to see out there.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，到了学校那儿之后不要心急，自己要多摸索。你能从那儿学到很多。

messages.en: You're a little twisted. And I'm okay with that. Yeah, I'll get you your Augumene.
messages.zh: 你有点疯狂。不过我能够忍受。好吧，我会给你弄到奥古米内石的。

messages.en: Excellent. Go get me some of that magnificent ore.
messages.zh: 很好。去给我弄些那种华丽的矿石来。

messages.en: You seem happy. What is it?
messages.zh: 你看起来很高兴。这是什么？

messages.en:
I was talking to some blowhard in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} when his station was destroyed. So, I'm thinking raiders, right? But no, it's even better. I send a few probes out that way, 'cause I want to know who to send the thank you card to. Turns out there were no raiders. Turns out that the whole damn station was hit by an asteroid full of Augumene! Luckily, I know a guy who's willing to pay decent kreds for the stuff, even though it's pretty much worthless! Heh!

It's like some angry, ironic god came down and crushed that jerk with a giant wad of kred notes, all for me! I want you to go out there, and bring me back all of that Augumene.
messages.zh:
当我在和{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的一个家伙聊天时，他所在的空间站忽然遭受到猛烈冲击。我当时就想：是不是恐怖袭击？但事实并非如此，这其实是天上掉下来的一个大馅饼！我发射了几枚探针来寻找那些给他这“礼遇”的家伙。可结果表明没有任何袭击者。击中空间站的竟然是一块巨大的奥古米内石！幸运的是我知道一个愿意花大价钱来买这块矿石的人，虽然它事实上一文不值！哈哈！

这一切好像某个愤怒而又幽默的神明用一张面额不菲的支票把那倒霉蛋给压死了，而我便能坐收渔翁之利！你快去那边把那整块奥古米内石给我弄过来。

messages.en: Here's the Augumene. Where's my ISK?
messages.zh: 给你奥古米内石。我的星币呢？

messages.en: Ah, it even feels like providence. And cold, hard kredits. Speaking of which, here's yours.
messages.zh: 啊，这感觉甚至像上帝的眷顾。还有冰冷硬邦邦的钱。说到钱，这些是你的。

messages.en: You seem entirely too happy with all this. And that troubles me. I'm going to decline, I'm afraid.
messages.zh: 你对这一切似乎高兴过了头。这让我有所顾虑。恐怕我得拒绝。

messages.en: What? You don't like free ISK?
messages.zh: 什么？你不喜欢白捡的星币？

messages.en: Augumene is an extremely toxic ore; fortunately, it is also extremely rare. It can be mined safely from a starship, but proves very deadly when handled directly unless one takes very expensive safety precautions. For this reason, even black market operators generally won't deal in it, and it is never found for sale on the open market.
messages.zh: 奥古米内石是一种含有剧毒的矿石；幸运的是，它也极为稀有。从星舰中对它进行开采是安全的，但如果直接处理，将非常致命——除非采取费用高昂的安全防范措施。正因如此，就连黑市经营者都不会做它的买卖，而在正规市场上，它更是不见踪影。

messages.en: Augumene
messages.zh: 奥古米内石

messages.en:
I'm on the comm, talking to this blowhard I knew back from my days at the academy, right...? So he's going on and on about how his corporation in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} is going to make ISK hand over fist mining some rare ore, blah blah blah. Then all these alarms start going off on his end. And I'm thinking his stupid corp is getting raided or something. Then, all of a sudden, the wall behind him disappears and he's ripped away from the screen! The blowhard got spaced right in front of my eyes!

Now, here's the best part. I send a few probes out that way, 'cause I want to know who to send the thank you card to. Turns out there were no raiders. Turns out that the whole damn station was hit by an asteroid full of Augumene! Luckily, I know a guy who's willing to pay decent kreds for the stuff, even though it's pretty much worthless! Heh! It's like some angry, ironic god came down and crushed that jerk with a giant wad of kred notes, all for me!

So, anyway, I want you to go out there and bring me back all of that Augumene. Do that, and I'll have a nice reward here for you when your come back, alright?
messages.zh:
我当时正在那里和一个大学时代的朋友视频聊天。他正吹嘘自己在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}的公司正准备利用挖掘稀有矿石大赚一笔之类的事情。瞬间屏幕那端警铃大作。下意识我还以为这个可怜家伙的公司遭受了恐怖袭击之类的倒霉事儿呢。然后就在一瞬间，那家伙背后的墙消失了，他本人也直接被什么东西从屏幕前撞飞了！在我眼前人间蒸发！

别急，接下来的更精彩。我发射了几枚探针来寻找那些给他这“礼遇”的家伙。可结果表明没有任何袭击者。击中空间站的竟然是一块巨大的奥古米内石！幸运的是我知道一个愿意花大价钱来买这块矿石的人，虽然它事实上一文不值！哈哈！这一切好像某个愤怒而又幽默的神明用一张面额不菲的支票把那倒霉蛋给压死了，而我便能坐收渔翁之利！

你快去那边把那整块奥古米内石给我弄过来。如果你成功了我会给你丰厚的报酬。

messages.en: I don't have time to wait for you to decide whether you like ISK or not. I'll get someone else to mine my lucky rock. So you can just get lost, okay?
messages.zh: 我没时间等你决定是否喜欢星币。我会找别人去开采我的幸运石。所以，你可以消失了，懂了吗？

messages.en: My lucky rock
messages.zh: 我的幸运石

messages.en: This is more than a little weird. I'm not mining this Augumene anymore.
messages.zh: 这事实在太怪异了。我不会再挖这种奥古米内石了。

messages.en: Don't tell me you're scared of a little rock?
messages.zh: 别告诉我你害怕一块小石头？

messages.en: Great. You took just long enough for some other vultures to get all the Augumene. That rock was meant for me, but no, you had to prance around until it was too late. Thanks for nothing.
messages.zh: 很好。你耽搁太久了，其他的贪婪家伙已经把所有奥古米内石都拿走了。这石头本该是我的，但偏偏事与愿违，就是因为你到处闲逛，结果一切都太迟了。感谢你的……无所作为。

messages.en: The Augumene is gone.
messages.zh: 奥古米内石没了。

messages.en: Sounds like a good deal. I'm in.
messages.zh: 听上去是笔好买卖。好，我接受。

messages.en: Remember, move fast. Time's of the essence, huh?
messages.zh: 记住，行动要迅速。时间宝贵，知道吗？

messages.en: What "thing" might that be?
messages.zh: 那是什么“事情”呢？

messages.en:
Seems like every government around wants some of this Mercium stuff. I don't know why, but if they all want it, then it might be worth a bundle to me down the road if I can get it first. I mean, no one's willing to pay for it now, but I'm thinking ahead: All four sides bidding, you got any idea how high that might drive the auction prices?

Now, I happen to have the location of some of this stuff. Thing is, I don't have a ship to handle it, so I need you, and I'm willing to put some money up front against this future "investment." Get in, get me that ore, and get out before somebody else pops in there for it. Simple.

Be aware that this amount of raw Mercium ore may require multiple trips unless you have a large amount of cargo space.
messages.zh:
似乎当今的所有政府都想弄点莫西石。我不知道其中缘由，不过既然他们都想要，如果我能抢先得到它，那将来肯定能挣一大笔钱。我是说，现在没人愿意为它花钱，不过要是从长远考虑的话：假设四个政府一起开价竞标，你能想象那拍卖价格会涨成什么样吗？

我眼下碰巧知道一些这种东西的位置。问题是，我没有可以进行开采的飞船，所以我需要你的帮助，我愿意为这项未来“投资”先贴点钱。你去那里给我把矿石弄到手，然后趁没人来之前赶快离开。就这么简单。

另外请注意，这批莫西石矿藏数量巨大，除非你的货柜舱容量足够大，否则可能需要多次往返。

messages.en: Here's your Mercium. So, where's my cut?
messages.zh: 这是你要的莫西石。那么，我的报酬呢？

messages.en:
Here you go. Oh, this is gonna be just like hacking into that SCC station computer and making ISK for myself!

Uh, I mean, not that I've ever done that....
messages.zh:
拿着。噢，这就像侵入SCC空间站计算机，自己取星币一样！

呃，我是说，我可从来没做过那种事……

messages.en: I'm not interested in getting caught in a four-way crossfire just to mine some rocks that might be worth something to someone at some point.
messages.zh: 只是为了开采一些矿石，就要使自己陷入四方的交叉火力中，我可没兴趣。何况那些矿石可能只是对某些人在某些时候有某些作用而已。

messages.en: Not everybody's got what it takes. I knew that when I first looked at you.
messages.zh: 不是每个人都有能力取得成功。我第一眼看到你就知道了。

messages.en: Though Mercium is not commercially viable at present, it remains of scientific interest (and thus potentially of future financial interest) to agents of virtually all factions.
messages.zh: 虽然目前莫西石没什么经济价值，不过几乎所有势力的代理人对它都有科研兴趣（因此未来也可能会有价值）。

messages.en: Mercium Research
messages.zh: 莫西石研究

messages.en:
This thing: Seems like every government around wants some of this Mercium stuff. I don't know why, but if they all want it, then it might be worth a bundle to me down the road if I can get it first. I mean, no one's willing to pay for it now, but I'm thinking ahead: All four sides bidding, you got any idea how high that might drive the auction prices?

Now, I happen to have the location of some of this stuff. Thing is, I don't have a ship to handle it, so I need you, and I'm willing to put some money up front against this future "investment." Alright? You gotta get in, get me that ore, and get out before somebody else pops in there for it. Simple.
messages.zh:
话说似乎当今的所有政府都想弄点这种莫西石。我不知道原因，不过既然他们都想要，如果我能抢先得到它，那它将来肯定能值大钱。我是说，现在没人愿意为它花钱，不过我是从长远考虑：所有四个政府一起开价竞标，你能想象那会使拍卖价格涨到多高吗？

我眼下碰巧知道一些这种东西的位置。问题是，我没有可以进行开采的飞船，所以我需要你的帮助，我愿意为这项未来“投资”先贴点钱。怎么样？你要去那里，给我弄到矿石，然后趁别人没闯来之前赶快离开。就这么简单。就这么简单。

messages.en: I don't have this kinda time, {[character]player.name}. I gotta move on this Mercium before it's gone.
messages.zh: 我没这种时间，{[character]player.name}。我要在莫西石被别人得手前赶快行动。

messages.en: Going, going, gone
messages.zh: 没了，没了，没了

messages.en: Selling to all four of the big empires? Uh... even I don't want to piss off that many people. Nah, I quit.
messages.zh: 向全部四个帝国兜售？呃……即使是我，也不想惹恼那么多人。不了，我退出。

messages.en: Don't worry, I'll find someone who's willing to make some decent ISK.
messages.zh: 别担心，肯定会有人愿意赚一笔可观的星币的。

messages.en: Somebody else already beat you to that Mercium, bonehead. Way to go.
messages.zh: 有人已经抢在你前面把莫西石采光了，笨蛋。你可真行啊。

messages.en: Mercium's gone
messages.zh: 莫西石没了

messages.en: Yeah, I'm game.
messages.zh: 好，我愿意。

messages.en: Get it quick. I don't like waiting.
messages.zh: 快点。我不喜欢等待。

messages.en: You have anything for me?
messages.zh: 你有任务给我吗？

messages.en: Mine 18,000 units of Banidine at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and bring it to {[character]agentID.name}.
messages.zh: 去{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}采集18000单位的班尼德勒石，然后把它们交给{[character]agentID.name}。

messages.en: I've got your Banidine right here, pal.
messages.zh: 我把你要的班尼德勒石带来了，伙计。

messages.en: Nice job. I'll remember this.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮。我会记住的。

messages.en: I don't work for crazy people.
messages.zh: 我不为疯子干活。

messages.en: Most people don't go looking for Banidine: It's virtually worthless, so you won't find it on the market. If you're having trouble finding the Banidine at the mission location, you can right-click the "Banidine" icon in the mission details in your Opportunities interface  and select "Add to Overview."
messages.zh: 大多数人不会去找班尼德勒石：它几乎没有价值，所以在市场上根本看不到。如果在任务地点找不到班尼德勒石，那就右击“机遇”界面任务详情中的“班尼德勒石”图标，然后选择“添加至总览”。

messages.en: Finding Banidine
messages.zh: 寻找班尼德勒石

messages.en:
Look, I need some… ah, building materials, but I've got a client who's a bit particular. He wants it special, from some asteroids that already destroyed a shuttle of his, I guess. He gave me a location; you just go there, mine all 18,000 units of the Banidine that's there, and bring it back. Now, you won't find this stuff anywhere else, so don't go looking to bring me back something similar and easier to come across — you try and rip me off on this, and I'll know. Got it? Alright.

So, you game?
messages.zh:
听着，我需要些……呃，建筑材料，不过我的这个客户有点挑剔。他需要采自某些小行星的特殊材料，那些小行星好像已经毁了他一艘穿梭机了。他给了我地点；你只要去那里，采集全部的18000单位班尼德勒石，然后带回来。听着，你在别处都找不到这个东西，所以别费心去找些类似的而且容易弄到的东西——你休想骗得了我。懂了吗？好。

怎么样，干不干？

messages.en: I got no time for games. I'll find somebody who can get it done.
messages.zh: 我没时间陪你玩。我会找别人来做。

messages.en: I'm done waiting
messages.zh: 我已经等够了。

messages.en: I'm done with this weird stuff. Banidine? It's worthless! So I get to wondering… who the hell wants this stuff, and for what? And I decide, maybe I ought not to do this, huh?
messages.zh: 我受够了这种古怪的东西。班尼德勒石？它根本一文不值！所以我就想……到底是谁要这东西，又用要它干嘛？然后我决定，也许我不该做这事，不是吗？

messages.en: Thanks a bundle. I didn't pay ya to think. That's my job. Remember that next time.
messages.zh: 谢了。我花钱雇你不是让你来思考的。那是我的工作。下次记住了。

messages.en: I need this done yesterday. I found someone else who can do the job faster.
messages.zh: 我是要你昨天完成这件事的。我已经找别人做了，比你做得快多了。

messages.en: Too slow
messages.zh: 太慢了

name.fr: Comme des drones dans un nuage
name.ja: 雲へ向かうドローンのごとく
name.ru: Как дроны к облаку (Like Drones to a Cloud)

messages.en: Consider the cloud harvested.
messages.zh: 放心，你就当那些气云已经采集好了。

messages.en: Thank you. You wouldn't believe how difficult it is to find a good gas harvester around here.
messages.zh: 谢谢。你想不到在这一带找一部气云采集器有多难。

messages.en: You know me, ready for anything.
messages.zh: 你知道我的，我随时准备做任何事。

messages.en:
There's a Chartreuse Cytoserocin cloud over in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It's attracting all sorts of drones to it. We keep clearing them out, but new drones just take their place. I figure the best solution is to just remove the cloud. No cloud, no drones. Simple. If you can harvest that cloud out, I'll pay you well.

You gotta fit a Gas Cloud Harvester to do this mission. And you also gotta deal with any drones there. Fair enough?
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一片黄绿丝胶溶质气云正吸引着这些疯狂的无人机。我们不断地消灭它们，但是新的无人机很快又出现了。我觉得最好的办法就是除去那些云。没有气云，就没有无人机。就这么简单。如果你可以把那些云采集完，我会付一大笔钱给你。

你必须使用气云采集器来完成这个任务。而且你还得解决在场的无人机。这要求不过分吧？

messages.en: I've harvested the gas cloud. Hopefully the drones won't be so interested in the area now.
messages.zh: 我已经采光了那片气云。那些无人机现在应该不会再对那片地方如此感兴趣了。

messages.en: Great. We'll keep an eye on the area, but I think you've fixed our drone problem.
messages.zh: 很好。我们会监视那个地方的，不过我觉得你已经解决了我们的无人机问题。

messages.en: I'm afraid I can't do this. So... "no thanks."
messages.zh: 恐怕我做不了。所以……“不，谢谢”。

messages.en: Damn. I'll have to find someone else. Hey, thanks for being honest, though.
messages.zh: 该死的。我不得不找其他人了。不过，还是谢谢你的坦诚。

messages.en: Rogue drones and "wild drones" are the terms used for advanced drones that have mutated out of control. A few years ago, some ingenious Gallentean inventor had the idea of creating super-advanced drones that could think and act on their own in every sense like a regular space ship, except for being computer controlled, hence unmanned. The drones became unruly, then unmanageable. Needless to say, this research was soon abandoned by the Gallenteans.
messages.zh: 自由无人机和野生无人机是指那些因发生变异而不再受控的高级无人机。几年前，一位受人尊敬的盖伦特发明家产生了创造一种超级无人机的想法，这种无人机能够独立思考和行动——其行为在各方面都相当于一艘普通飞船，唯一不同之处在于，它由计算机控制，因此是无人驾驶的。这些无人机后来变得不守规矩，再后来根本就不听指挥。接下来谁都猜得到：盖伦特不久就放弃了这项研究。

messages.en: Rogue Drones
messages.zh: 自由无人机

messages.en:
There's a Chartreuse Cytoserocin cloud over in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It's attracting all sorts of drones to it. I don't know why. It's like insects to a flame or somethin'. We keep clearing them out, but new drones just take their place. It's annoying as hell.

I figure the best solution is to just remove the cloud. No cloud, no drones. Simple. If you can harvest that cloud out, I'll pay you well.

You gotta own and be able to use a Gas Cloud Harvester to do this mission. If you don't or ya can't, just say "no thanks." You can decline one mission about every 4 hours without pissing me off, so no worries.
messages.zh:
在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}有一片黄绿丝胶溶质气云正吸引着这些疯狂的无人机。我不知道为什么。就像火焰吸引昆虫一样。我们不断地消灭它们，但是新的无人机很快又出现了。真是烦得要死。

我觉得最好的办法就是除去那些云。没有气云，就没有无人机。就这么简单。如果你可以把那些云采集完，我会付一大笔钱给你。

你需要有并且可以使用气云采集器来完成这个任务。如果你没有或者不能使用气云采集器，只要说“不，谢谢”。你可以每四个小时拒绝一个任务而不惹我生气，所以不用担心。

messages.en: Mission 4 completed.
messages.zh: 任务4完成。

messages.en: Mission 4 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务4。

messages.en:
Excellent. These are the coordinates of the nearest training center, and here are your clearance papers. Take them with you to the station.

Good luck, {[character]player.name}, and remember: I'm never far if you need help.
messages.zh:
非常好，这些是离这儿最近的一座训练中心的坐标，另外我再给你一些可让你通过各项审查的文件。你把它们都带上，然后去那座空间站吧。

祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。记住：我随时都在你身边，有困难就来找我。

messages.en:
You've completed your basic training, {[character]player.name}. Now you're ready for something more involving.

There are a number of career training agents not far from here who can teach you about all the various activities and careers available to you. They'll let you get hands-on training and experience with everything from asteroid mining to deep space exploration.

When you're ready, I will refer you to them. You should take everything else with you as well, since you probably won't be coming back here afterward.
messages.zh:
你已经完成了基础训练，{[character]player.name}，这同时也表明你已具备了迎接更大挑战的能力。

在离这儿不远的地方，有许多职业代理人。他们可以就各种不同的玩法与职业与对你进行针对性的指导。他们会提供实践机会，让你亲身体验从采矿到探索的各种玩法。

当你准备好之后，我就会把你介绍给他们。另外你还应该将你所有的物品都一并带走，因为你可能没有再来这里的必要了。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. You've arrived. I'm relaying further instructions to you now.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}，你终于来了。我马上就把后续指令传达给你。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:
You've completed your basic training, {[character]player.name}. Now you're ready for something more involving.

There are a number of career training agents not far from here who can teach you about all the various activities and careers available to you. They'll let you get hands-on training and experience with everything from asteroid mining to deep space exploration.

When you're ready, I will refer you to them. You should take everything else with you as well, since you probably won't be coming back here afterward.
messages.zh:
你已经完成了基础训练，{[character]player.name}，这同时也表明你已具备了迎接更大挑战的能力。

在离这儿不远的地方，有许多职业代理人。他们可以就各种不同的玩法与职业与对你进行针对性的指导。他们会提供实践机会，让你亲身体验从采矿到探索的各种玩法。

当你准备好之后，我就会把你介绍给他们。另外你还应该将你所有的物品都一并带走，因为你可能没有再来这里的必要了。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: The career advisor agents will be able to help you choose what skills to train, and how to specialize as a capsule pilot.
messages.zh: 职业规划代理人会指导你选择学习哪些技能，并且还会就如何专攻某一特定领域对你进行指点。

messages.en: Mission 1 completed.
messages.zh: 任务1完成。

messages.en: Mission 1 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务1。

messages.en: Good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
At the moment, all you have to fly is a capsule. Our first priority is to get you into a starship.

Your assignment: Follow the tutorial steps, I will guide you to a hidden location in space.

If you ever get lost, remember to use the back and next buttons and read the tutorial slides or you can quit the mission and start over again from the beginning.
messages.zh:
现在，你所用过的飞行器就只有逃生舱一种。我们现在要做的第一件事，就是让你驾驶一艘舰船。

你的任务：遵照教程步骤，同时我会带你去一个隐秘地点。

如果你迷路了，别担心，只要单击教程上的前后按钮或者退出任务从头再来就行。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.

For completing the mission, you have received a reward. Note that for some missions this reward will be an item that the agent will drop in your hangar, while in others it will be a transfer to your wallet of Interstellar Kredits (ISK), the currency used by pod pilots.

Your next mission will involve combat, so you should learn to fit your new starship now. When you're ready for that, click the Request Mission button.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

由于你完成了任务，你已获得了奖励。注意，有些奖励会由代理人直接放入的你的机库，另外一些奖励则将以星币（飞行员使用的货币）的形式直接进入你的钱包。

你接下来的任务将涉及战斗，因此你现在应该掌握如何装配你的新舰船。准备好之后，就请按我要执行新任务按钮。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:

messages.en: Your ship and the item I've asked you to retrieve are located at a site in this system.
messages.zh: 你的船与我要你去取的东西都在本星系的某一处。

messages.en: Mission 2 completed.
messages.zh: 任务2完成。

messages.en: Mission 2 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务2。

messages.en: Good. Now you must learn how to fit modules to your ship.
messages.zh: 很好。现在你得学习如何装配你的舰船了。

messages.en:
You're doing well so far, {[character]player.name}. Your next test will involve some basic combat training.

When you are ready, you'll be provided with some modules to fit to your starship. Make sure to keep following the tutorial, I will explain how to fit the modules. Once you are fitted, you will fly out to a location in space to begin your combat training.

Once again, you will be provided with tutorials to guide you along the way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你目前的表现很好。你接下来的训练将涉及战斗的基本知识。

准备好后，你会得到一些可装配在你舰船上的装备。请一定要跟着教程走，我会教你如何装配。当你把它们装配好之后，你就将飞往太空中的某一处进行战斗训练。

同样，一路上你会获得相应指导。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}.

You're almost ready to begin your career as a capsuleer but there is one last task. You must retrieve your Pilot Certification from one of our local academies. Request the next mission when you are ready.
messages.zh:
你表现不错，{[character]player.name}。

现在离你克隆飞行员生涯的正式开始还差最后一步。你必须从我们的一座当地学院那儿获得你的克隆飞行员证书。准备好之后就请求下一个任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Good luck out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Mission 3 completed.
messages.zh: 任务3完成。

messages.en: Mission 3 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务3。

messages.en: You're ready to depart? Excellent. Don't forget to take your time out there. Study the ships closely. It will help when considering which one you would like to train for.
messages.zh: 你准备好出发了吗？非常好，记住，到了那儿之后要慢慢来。对舰船要多做研究。这对你日后选择技能的训练方向有很大帮助。

messages.en:
You've been learning quickly, {[character]player.name}. You're ready to start setting your own goals soon, but before you head out on your own you should stop off at a local academy of ours.

Follow the tutorial steps to guide you to a neighboring system where you will receive your certification documents proving you completed this course.
messages.zh:
你进步很快，{[character]player.name}。很快你就可以自主设定目标了，但在此之前，你还应该先去我们的一座职业学校。

请遵照教程，前往一个邻近星系。在那儿你会拿到一张表明你已完成本教程的证书。

messages.en: Congratulations, {[character]player.name}, you have graduated from the pilot's certification course. I'll be providing you with some basic information now on where to go. Request a new mission whenever you're ready.
messages.zh: 祝贺你，{[character]player.name}，你已经顺利学完了飞行员认证课程。接下来我会针对你今后的发展方向提点建议。准备好之后就来接受新任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Take your time at the academy, {[character]player.name}. There is a lot to see out there.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，到了学校那儿之后不要心急，自己要多摸索。你能从那儿学到很多。

messages.en: Mission 4 completed.
messages.zh: 任务4完成。

messages.en: Mission 4 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务4。

messages.en:
Excellent. These are the coordinates of the nearest training center, and here are your clearance papers. Take them with you to the station.

Good luck, {[character]player.name}, and remember: I'm never far if you need help.
messages.zh:
非常好，这些是离这儿最近的一座训练中心的坐标，另外我再给你一些可让你通过各项审查的文件。你把它们都带上，然后去那座空间站吧。

祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。记住：我随时都在你身边，有困难就来找我。

messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Take your time at the academy, {[character]player.name}. There is a lot to see out there.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，到了学校那儿之后不要心急，自己要多摸索。你能从那儿学到很多。

messages.en: Mission 4 completed.
messages.zh: 任务4完成。

messages.en: Mission 4 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务4。

messages.en:
Excellent. These are the coordinates of the nearest training center, and here are your clearance papers. Take them with you to the station.

Good luck, {[character]player.name}, and remember: I'm never far if you need help.
messages.zh:
非常好，这些是离这儿最近的一座训练中心的坐标，另外我再给你一些可让你通过各项审查的文件。你把它们都带上，然后去那座空间站吧。

祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。记住：我随时都在你身边，有困难就来找我。

messages.en:
You've completed your basic training, {[character]player.name}. Now you're ready for something more involving.

There are a number of career training agents not far from here who can teach you about all the various activities and careers available to you. They'll let you get hands-on training and experience with everything from asteroid mining to deep space exploration.

When you're ready, I will refer you to them. You should take everything else with you as well, since you probably won't be coming back here afterward.
messages.zh:
你已经完成了基础训练，{[character]player.name}，这同时也表明你已具备了迎接更大挑战的能力。

在离这儿不远的地方，有许多职业代理人。他们可以就各种不同的玩法与职业与对你进行针对性的指导。他们会提供实践机会，让你亲身体验从采矿到探索的各种玩法。

当你准备好之后，我就会把你介绍给他们。另外你还应该将你所有的物品都一并带走，因为你可能没有再来这里的必要了。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. You've arrived. I'm relaying further instructions to you now.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}，你终于来了。我马上就把后续指令传达给你。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: You should travel out to the career advisors as soon as you can.
messages.zh: 你应该尽快前往你的职业规划代理人那儿。

messages.en: Mission 1 completed.
messages.zh: 任务1完成。

messages.en: Mission 1 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务1。

messages.en: Good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
At the moment, all you have to fly is a capsule. Our first priority is to get you into a starship.

Your assignment: Follow the tutorial steps, I will guide you to a hidden location in space.

If you ever get lost, remember to use the back and next buttons and read the tutorial slides or you can quit the mission and start over again from the beginning.
messages.zh:
现在，你所用过的飞行器就只有逃生舱一种。我们现在要做的第一件事，就是让你驾驶一艘舰船。

你的任务：遵照教程步骤，同时我会带你去一个隐秘地点。

如果你迷路了，别担心，只要单击教程上的前后按钮或者退出任务从头再来就行。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.

For completing the mission, you have received a reward. Note that for some missions this reward will be an item that the agent will drop in your hangar, while in others it will be a transfer to your wallet of Interstellar Kredits (ISK), the currency used by pod pilots.

Your next mission will involve combat, so you should learn to fit your new starship now. When you're ready for that, click the Request Mission button.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

由于你完成了任务，你已获得了奖励。注意，有些奖励会由代理人直接放入的你的机库，另外一些奖励则将以星币（飞行员使用的货币）的形式直接进入的钱包。

你接下来的任务将涉及战斗，因此你现在应该掌握如何装配你的新舰船。准备好之后，就请按我要执行新任务按钮。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Your ship and the item I've asked you to retrieve are located at a site in this system.
messages.zh: 你的船与我要你去取的东西都在本星系的某一处。

messages.en: Mission 2 completed.
messages.zh: 任务2完成。

messages.en: Mission 2 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务2。

messages.en: Good. Now you must learn how to fit modules to your ship.
messages.zh: 很好。现在你得学习如何装配你的舰船了。

messages.en:
You're doing well so far, {[character]player.name}. Your next test will involve some basic combat training.

When you are ready, you'll be provided with some modules to fit to your starship. Make sure to keep following the tutorial, I will explain how to fit the modules. Once you are fitted, you will fly out to a location in space to begin your combat training.

Once again, you will be provided with tutorials to guide you along the way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你目前的表现很好。你接下来的训练将涉及战斗的基本知识。

准备好后，你会得到一些可装配在你舰船上的装备。请一定要跟着教程走，我会教你如何装配。当你把它们装配好之后，你就将飞往太空中的某一处进行战斗训练。

同样，一路上你会获得相应指导。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}.

You're almost ready to begin your career as a capsuleer but there is one last task. You must retrieve your Pilot Certification from one of our local academies. Request the next mission when you are ready.
messages.zh:
你表现不错，{[character]player.name}。

现在离你克隆飞行员生涯的正式开始还差最后一步。你必须从我们的一座当地学院那儿获得你的克隆飞行员证书。准备好之后就请求下一个任务吧。

messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Good luck out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Mission 3 completed.
messages.zh: 任务3完成。

messages.en: Mission 3 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务3。

messages.en: You're ready to depart? Excellent. Don't forget to take your time out there. Study the ships closely. It will help when considering which one you would like to train for.
messages.zh: 你准备好出发了吗？非常好，记住，到了那儿之后要慢慢来。对舰船要多做研究。这对你日后选择技能的训练方向有很大帮助。

messages.en:
You've been learning quickly, {[character]player.name}. You're ready to start setting your own goals soon, but before you head out on your own you should stop off at a local academy of ours.

Follow the tutorial steps to guide you to a neighboring system where you will receive your certification documents proving you completed this course.

messages.zh: 祝贺你，{[character]player.name}，你已经顺利学完了飞行员认证课程。接下来我会针对你今后的发展方向提点建议。准备好之后就来接受新任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Mission 4 completed.
messages.zh: 任务4完成。

messages.en: Mission 4 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务4。

messages.en:
Excellent. These are the coordinates of the nearest training center, and here are your clearance papers. Take them with you to the station.

Good luck, {[character]player.name}, and remember: I'm never far if you need help.
messages.zh:
非常好，这些是离这儿最近的一座训练中心的坐标，另外我再给你一些可让你通过各项审查的文件。你把它们都带上，然后去那座空间站吧。

祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。记住：我随时都在你身边，有困难就来找我。

messages.en:
You've completed your basic training, {[character]player.name}. Now you're ready for something more involving.

There are a number of career training agents not far from here who can teach you about all the various activities and careers available to you. They'll let you get hands-on training and experience with everything from asteroid mining to deep space exploration.

When you're ready, I will refer you to them. You should take everything else with you as well, since you probably won't be coming back here afterward.
messages.zh:
你已经完成了基础训练，{[character]player.name}，这同时也表明你已具备了迎接更大挑战的能力。

在离这儿不远的地方，有许多职业代理人。他们可以就各种不同的玩法与职业与对你进行针对性的指导。他们会提供实践机会，让你亲身体验从采矿到探索的各种玩法。

当你准备好之后，我就会把你介绍给他们。另外你还应该将你所有的物品都一并带走，因为你可能没有再来这里的必要了。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. You've arrived. I'm relaying further instructions to you now.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}，你终于来了。我马上就把后续指令传达给你。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.zh: 你应该尽快前往你的职业规划代理人那儿。

messages.en: Mission 1 completed.
messages.zh: 任务1完成。

messages.en: Mission 1 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务1。

messages.en: Good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
At the moment, all you have to fly is a capsule. Our first priority is to get you into a starship.

Your assignment: Follow the tutorial steps, I will guide you to a hidden location in space.

If you ever get lost, remember to use the back and next buttons and read the tutorial slides or you can quit the mission and start over again from the beginning.
messages.zh:
现在，你所用过的飞行器就只有逃生舱一种。我们现在要做的第一件事，就是让你驾驶一艘舰船。

你的任务：遵照教程步骤，同时我会带你去一个隐秘地点。

如果你迷路了，别担心，只要单击教程上的前后按钮或者退出任务从头再来就行。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.

For completing the mission, you have received a reward. Note that for some missions this reward will be an item that the agent will drop in your hangar, while in others it will be a transfer to your wallet of Interstellar Kredits (ISK), the currency used by pod pilots.

Your next mission will involve combat, so you should learn to fit your new starship now. When you're ready for that, click the Request Mission button.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

由于你完成了任务，你已获得了奖励。注意，有些奖励会由代理人直接放入的你的机库，另外一些奖励则将以星币（飞行员使用的货币）的形式直接进入的钱包。

你接下来的任务将涉及战斗，因此你现在应该掌握如何装配你的新舰船。准备好之后，就请按我要执行新任务按钮。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Your ship and the item I've asked you to retrieve are located at a site in this system.
messages.zh: 你的船与我要你去取的东西都在本星系的某一处。

messages.en: Mission 2 completed.
messages.zh: 任务2完成。

messages.en: Mission 2 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务2。

messages.en: Good. Now you must learn how to fit modules to your ship.
messages.zh: 很好。现在你得学习如何装配你的舰船了。

messages.en:
You're doing well so far, {[character]player.name}. Your next test will involve some basic combat training.

When you are ready, you'll be provided with some modules to fit to your starship. Make sure to keep following the tutorial, I will explain how to fit the modules. Once you are fitted, you will fly out to a location in space to begin your combat training.

Once again, you will be provided with tutorials to guide you along the way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你目前的表现很好。你接下来的训练将涉及战斗的基本知识。

准备好后，你会得到一些可装配在你舰船上的装备。请一定要跟着教程走，我会教你如何装配。当你把它们装配好之后，你就将飞往太空中的某一处进行战斗训练。

同样，一路上你会获得相应指导。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}.

You're almost ready to begin your career as a capsuleer but there is one last task. You must retrieve your Pilot Certification from one of our local academies. Request the next mission when you are ready.
messages.zh:
你表现不错，{[character]player.name}。

现在离你克隆飞行员生涯的正式开始还差最后一步。你必须从我们的一座当地学院那儿获得你的克隆飞行员证书。准备好之后就请求下一个任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Good luck out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Mission 3 completed.
messages.zh: 任务3完成。

messages.en: Mission 3 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务3。

messages.en: You're ready to depart? Excellent. Don't forget to take your time out there. Study the ships closely. It will help when considering which one you would like to train for.
messages.zh: 你准备好出发了吗？非常好，记住，到了那儿之后要慢慢来。对舰船要多做研究。这对你日后选择技能的训练方向有很大帮助。

messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:
You're doing well so far, {[character]player.name}. Your next test will involve some basic combat training.

When you are ready, you'll be provided with some modules to fit to your starship. Make sure to keep following the tutorial, I will explain how to fit the modules. Once you are fitted, you will fly out to a location in space to begin your combat training.

Once again, you will be provided with tutorials to guide you along the way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你目前的表现很好。你接下来的训练将涉及战斗的基本知识。

准备好后，你会得到一些可装配在你舰船上的装备。请一定要跟着教程走，我会教你如何装配。当你把它们装配好之后，你就将飞往太空中的某一处进行战斗训练。

同样，一路上你会获得相应指导。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Good luck out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Mission 3 completed.
messages.zh: 任务3完成。

messages.en: Mission 3 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务3。

messages.en: You're ready to depart? Excellent. Don't forget to take your time out there. Study the ships closely. It will help when considering which one you would like to train for.
messages.zh: 你准备好出发了吗？非常好，记住，到了那儿之后要慢慢来。对舰船要多做研究。这对你日后选择技能的训练方向有很大帮助。

messages.en:
You've been learning quickly, {[character]player.name}. You're ready to start setting your own goals soon, but before you head out on your own you should stop off at a local academy of ours.

Follow the tutorial steps to guide you to a neighboring system where you will receive your certification documents proving you completed this course.
messages.zh:
你进步很快，{[character]player.name}。很快你就可以自主设定目标了，但在此之前，你还应该先去我们的一座职业学校。

请遵照教程，前往一个邻近星系。在那儿你会拿到一张表明你已完成本教程的证书。

messages.en: Congratulations, {[character]player.name}, you have graduated from the pilot's certification course. I'll be providing you with some basic information now on where to go. Request a new mission whenever you're ready.
messages.zh: 祝贺你，{[character]player.name}，你已经顺利学完了飞行员认证课程。接下来我会针对你今后的发展方向提点建议。准备好之后就来接受新任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Take your time at the academy, {[character]player.name}. There is a lot to see out there.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，到了学校那儿之后不要心急，自己要多摸索。你能从那儿学到很多。

messages.en: Mission 4 completed.
messages.zh: 任务4完成。

messages.en: Mission 4 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务4。

messages.en:
Excellent. These are the coordinates of the nearest training center, and here are your clearance papers. Take them with you to the station.

Good luck, {[character]player.name}, and remember: I'm never far if you need help.
messages.zh:
非常好，这些是离这儿最近的一座训练中心的坐标，另外我再给你一些可让你通过各项审查的文件。你把它们都带上，然后去那座空间站吧。

祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。记住：我随时都在你身边，有困难就来找我。

messages.en:
You've completed your basic training, {[character]player.name}. Now you're ready for something more involving.

There are a number of career training agents not far from here who can teach you about all the various activities and careers available to you. They'll let you get hands-on training and experience with everything from asteroid mining to deep space exploration.

When you're ready, I will refer you to them. You should take everything else with you as well, since you probably won't be coming back here afterward.
messages.zh:
你已经完成了基础训练，{[character]player.name}，这同时也表明你已具备了迎接更大挑战的能力。

在离这儿不远的地方，有许多职业代理人。他们可以就各种不同的玩法与职业与对你进行针对性的指导。他们会提供实践机会，让你亲身体验从采矿到探索的各种玩法。

当你准备好之后，我就会把你介绍给他们。另外你还应该将你所有的物品都一并带走，因为你可能没有再来这里的必要了。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. You've arrived. I'm relaying further instructions to you now.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}，你终于来了。我马上就把后续指令传达给你。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Mission 1 completed.
messages.zh: 任务1完成。

messages.en: Mission 1 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务1。

messages.en: Good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
At the moment, all you have to fly is a capsule. Our first priority is to get you into a starship.

Your assignment: Follow the tutorial steps, I will guide you to a hidden location in space.

If you ever get lost, remember to use the back and next buttons and read the tutorial slides or you can quit the mission and start over again from the beginning.
messages.zh:
现在，你所用过的飞行器就只有逃生舱一种。我们现在要做的第一件事，就是让你驾驶一艘舰船。

你的任务：遵照教程步骤，同时我会带你去一个隐秘地点。

如果你迷路了，别担心，只要单击教程上的前后按钮或者退出任务从头再来就行。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.

For completing the mission, you have received a reward. Note that for some missions this reward will be an item that the agent will drop in your hangar, while in others it will be a transfer to your wallet of Interstellar Kredits (ISK), the currency used by pod pilots.

Your next mission will involve combat, so you should learn to fit your new starship now. When you're ready for that, click the Request Mission button.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

由于你完成了任务，你已获得了奖励。注意，有些奖励会由代理人直接放入的你的机库，另外一些奖励则将以星币（飞行员使用的货币）的形式直接进入的钱包。

你接下来的任务将涉及战斗，因此你现在应该掌握如何装配你的新舰船。准备好之后，就请按我要执行新任务按钮。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Mission 2 completed.
messages.zh: 任务2完成。

messages.en: Mission 2 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务2。

messages.en: Good. Now you must learn how to fit modules to your ship.
messages.zh: 很好。现在你得学习如何装配你的舰船了。

messages.en:
You're doing well so far, {[character]player.name}. Your next test will involve some basic combat training.

When you are ready, you'll be provided with some modules to fit to your starship. Make sure to keep following the tutorial, I will explain how to fit the modules. Once you are fitted, you will fly out to a location in space to begin your combat training.

Once again, you will be provided with tutorials to guide you along the way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你目前的表现很好。你接下来的训练将涉及战斗的基本知识。

准备好后，你会得到一些可装配在你舰船上的装备。请一定要跟着教程走，我会教你如何装配。当你把它们装配好之后，你就将飞往太空中的某一处进行战斗训练。

同样，一路上你会获得相应指导。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}.

You're almost ready to begin your career as a capsuleer but there is one last task. You must retrieve your Pilot Certification from one of our local academies. Request the next mission when you are ready.
messages.zh:
你表现不错，{[character]player.name}。

现在离你克隆飞行员生涯的正式开始还差最后一步。你必须从我们的一座当地学院那儿获得你的克隆飞行员证书。准备好之后就请求下一个任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:
You're doing well so far, {[character]player.name}. Your next test will involve some basic combat training.

When you are ready, you'll be provided with some modules to fit to your starship. Make sure to keep following the tutorial, I will explain how to fit the modules. Once you are fitted, you will fly out to a location in space to begin your combat training.

Once again, you will be provided with tutorials to guide you along the way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你目前的表现很好。你接下来的训练将涉及战斗的基本知识。

准备好后，你会得到一些可装配在你舰船上的装备。请一定要跟着教程走，我会教你如何装配。当你把它们装配好之后，你就将飞往太空中的某一处进行战斗训练。

同样，一路上你会获得相应指导。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Good luck out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Mission 3 completed.
messages.zh: 任务3完成。

messages.en: Mission 3 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务3。

messages.en: You're ready to depart? Excellent. Don't forget to take your time out there. Study the ships closely. It will help when considering which one you would like to train for.
messages.zh: 你准备好出发了吗？非常好，记住，到了那儿之后要慢慢来。对舰船要多做研究。这对你日后选择技能的训练方向有很大帮助。

messages.en:
You've been learning quickly, {[character]player.name}. You're ready to start setting your own goals soon, but before you head out on your own you should stop off at a local academy of ours.

Follow the tutorial steps to guide you to a neighboring system where you will receive your certification documents proving you completed this course.
messages.zh:
你进步很快，{[character]player.name}。很快你就可以自主设定目标了，但在此之前，你还应该先去我们的一座职业学校。

请遵照教程，前往一个邻近星系。在那儿你会拿到一张表明你已完成本教程的证书。

messages.en: Congratulations, {[character]player.name}, you have graduated from the pilot's certification course. I'll be providing you with some basic information now on where to go. Request a new mission whenever you're ready.
messages.zh: 祝贺你，{[character]player.name}，你已经顺利学完了飞行员认证课程。接下来我会针对你今后的发展方向提点建议。准备好之后就来接受新任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Take your time at the academy, {[character]player.name}. There is a lot to see out there.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，到了学校那儿之后不要心急，自己要多摸索。你能从那儿学到很多。

messages.en: Mission 4 completed.
messages.zh: 任务4完成。

messages.en: Mission 4 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务4。

messages.en:
Excellent. These are the coordinates of the nearest training center, and here are your clearance papers. Take them with you to the station.

Good luck, {[character]player.name}, and remember: I'm never far if you need help.
messages.zh:
非常好，这些是离这儿最近的一座训练中心的坐标，另外我再给你一些可让你通过各项审查的文件。你把它们都带上，然后去那座空间站吧。

祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。记住：我随时都在你身边，有困难就来找我。

messages.en:
You've completed your basic training, {[character]player.name}. Now you're ready for something more involving.

There are a number of career training agents not far from here who can teach you about all the various activities and careers available to you. They'll let you get hands-on training and experience with everything from asteroid mining to deep space exploration.

When you're ready, I will refer you to them. You should take everything else with you as well, since you probably won't be coming back here afterward.
messages.zh:
你已经完成了基础训练，{[character]player.name}，这同时也表明你已具备了迎接更大挑战的能力。

在离这儿不远的地方，有许多职业代理人。他们可以就各种不同的玩法与职业与对你进行针对性的指导。他们会提供实践机会，让你亲身体验从采矿到探索的各种玩法。

当你准备好之后，我就会把你介绍给他们。另外你还应该将你所有的物品都一并带走，因为你可能没有再来这里的必要了。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. You've arrived. I'm relaying further instructions to you now.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}，你终于来了。我马上就把后续指令传达给你。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.zh: 你应该尽快前往你的职业规划代理人那儿。

messages.en: Mission 1 completed.
messages.zh: 任务1完成。

messages.en: Mission 1 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务1。

messages.en: Good luck, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en:
At the moment, all you have to fly is a capsule. Our first priority is to get you into a starship.

Your assignment: Follow the tutorial steps, I will guide you to a hidden location in space.

If you ever get lost, remember to use the back and next buttons and read the tutorial slides or you can quit the mission and start over again from the beginning.
messages.zh:
现在，你所用过的飞行器就只有逃生舱一种。我们现在要做的第一件事，就是让你驾驶一艘舰船。

你的任务：遵照教程步骤，同时我会带你去一个隐秘地点。

如果你迷路了，别担心，只要单击教程上的前后按钮或者退出任务从头再来就行。

messages.en:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.

For completing the mission, you have received a reward. Note that for some missions this reward will be an item that the agent will drop in your hangar, while in others it will be a transfer to your wallet of Interstellar Kredits (ISK), the currency used by pod pilots.

Your next mission will involve combat, so you should learn to fit your new starship now. When you're ready for that, click the Request Mission button.
messages.zh:
干得漂亮，{[character]player.name}。

由于你完成了任务，你已获得了奖励。注意，有些奖励会由代理人直接放入的你的机库，另外一些奖励则将以星币（飞行员使用的货币）的形式直接进入的钱包。

你接下来的任务将涉及战斗，因此你现在应该掌握如何装配你的新舰船。准备好之后，就请按我要执行新任务按钮。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

你接下来的任务将涉及战斗，因此你现在应该掌握如何装配你的新舰船。准备好之后，就请按我要执行新任务按钮。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:
Hello, {[character]player.name}. At the moment, all you have to fly is a capsule. Our first priority is to get you into a starship.

Your assignment: Follow the tutorial steps, I will guide you to a hidden location in space.

If you ever get lost, remember to use the back and next buttons and read the tutorial slides or you can quit the mission and start over again from the beginning.
messages.zh:
你好，{[character]player.name}。现在，你所用过的飞行器就只有逃生舱一种。我们现在要做的第一件事，就是让你驾驶一艘舰船。

你的任务：遵照教程步骤，同时我会带你去一个隐秘地点。

如果你迷路了，别担心，只要单击教程上的前后按钮或者退出任务从头再来就行。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Your ship and the item I've asked you to retrieve are located at a site in this system.
messages.zh: 你的船与我要你去取的东西都在本星系的某一处。

messages.en: Mission 2 completed.
messages.zh: 任务2完成。

messages.en: Mission 2 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务2。

messages.en: Good. Now you must learn how to fit modules to your ship.
messages.zh: 很好。现在你得学习如何装配你的舰船了。

messages.en:
You're doing well so far, {[character]player.name}. Your next test will involve some basic combat training.

When you are ready, you'll be provided with some modules to fit to your starship. Make sure to keep following the tutorial, I will explain how to fit the modules. Once you are fitted, you will fly out to a location in space to begin your combat training.

Once again, you will be provided with tutorials to guide you along the way.
messages.zh:
{[character]player.name}，你目前的表现很好。你接下来的训练将涉及战斗的基本知识。

准备好后，你会得到一些可装配在你舰船上的装备。请一定要跟着教程走，我会教你如何装配。当你把它们装配好之后，你就将飞往太空中的某一处进行战斗训练。

同样，一路上你会获得相应指导。

messages.en:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}.

You're almost ready to begin your career as a capsuleer but there is one last task. You must retrieve your Pilot Certification from one of our local academies. Request the next mission when you are ready.
messages.zh:
你表现不错，{[character]player.name}。

现在离你克隆飞行员生涯的正式开始还差最后一步。你必须从我们的一座当地学院那儿获得你的克隆飞行员证书。准备好之后就请求下一个任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:
You're doing well so far, {[character]player.name}. Your next test will involve some basic combat training.

When you are ready, you'll be provided with some modules to fit to your starship. Make sure to keep following the tutorial, I will explain how to fit the modules. Once you are fitted, you will fly out to a location in space to begin your combat training.

Once again, you will be provided with tutorials to guide you along the way.

{[character]player.name}，你目前的表现很好。你接下来的训练将涉及战斗的基本知识。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Good luck out there, {[character]player.name}.
messages.zh: 祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。

messages.en: Mission 3 completed.
messages.zh: 任务3完成。

messages.en: Mission 3 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务3。

messages.en: You're ready to depart? Excellent. Don't forget to take your time out there. Study the ships closely. It will help when considering which one you would like to train for.
messages.zh: 你准备好出发了吗？非常好，记住，到了那儿之后要慢慢来。对舰船要多做研究。这对你日后选择技能的训练方向有很大帮助。

messages.en:
You've been learning quickly, {[character]player.name}. You're ready to start setting your own goals soon, but before you head out on your own you should stop off at a local academy of ours.

Follow the tutorial steps to guide you to a neighboring system where you will receive your certification documents proving you completed this course.
messages.zh:
你进步很快，{[character]player.name}。很快你就可以自主设定目标了，但在此之前，你还应该先去我们的一座职业学校。

请遵照教程，前往一个邻近星系。在那儿你会拿到一张表明你已完成本教程的证书。

messages.en: Congratulations, {[character]player.name}, you have graduated from the pilot's certification course. I'll be providing you with some basic information now on where to go. Request a new mission whenever you're ready.
messages.zh: 祝贺你，{[character]player.name}，你已经顺利学完了飞行员认证课程。接下来我会针对你今后的发展方向提点建议。准备好之后就来接受新任务吧。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en:

Follow the tutorial steps to guide you to a neighboring system where you will receive your certification documents proving you completed this course.

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
messages.zh: 你想重新开始该任务，{[character]player.name}？我明白。只要你准备好，你可以随时再与我联系。

messages.en: Take your time at the academy, {[character]player.name}. There is a lot to see out there.
messages.zh: {[character]player.name}，到了学校那儿之后不要心急，自己要多摸索。你能从那儿学到很多。

messages.en: Mission 4 completed.
messages.zh: 任务4完成。

messages.en: Mission 4 in progress.
messages.zh: 正在执行任务4。

messages.en:
Excellent. These are the coordinates of the nearest training center, and here are your clearance papers. Take them with you to the station.

Good luck, {[character]player.name}, and remember: I'm never far if you need help.
messages.zh:
非常好，这些是离这儿最近的一座训练中心的坐标，另外我再给你一些可让你通过各项审查的文件。你把它们都带上，然后去那座空间站吧。

祝你好运，{[character]player.name}。记住：我随时都在你身边，有困难就来找我。

messages.en:
You've completed your basic training, {[character]player.name}. Now you're ready for something more involving.

There are a number of career training agents not far from here who can teach you about all the various activities and careers available to you. They'll let you get hands-on training and experience with everything from asteroid mining to deep space exploration.

When you're ready, I will refer you to them. You should take everything else with you as well, since you probably won't be coming back here afterward.
messages.zh:
你已经完成了基础训练，{[character]player.name}，这同时也表明你已具备了迎接更大挑战的能力。

在离这儿不远的地方，有许多职业代理人。他们可以就各种不同的玩法与职业与对你进行针对性的指导。他们会提供实践机会，让你亲身体验从采矿到探索的各种玩法。

当你准备好之后，我就会把你介绍给他们。另外你还应该将你所有的物品都一并带走，因为你可能没有再来这里的必要了。

messages.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. You've arrived. I'm relaying further instructions to you now.
messages.zh: 干得好，{[character]player.name}，你终于来了。我马上就把后续指令传达给你。

messages.en: You want to restart the mission, {[character]player.name}? I understand. Just open a conversation again whenever you are ready.
