messages.zh: 你应该尽快前往你的职业规划代理人那儿。

messages.en: Take care to keep those seeds frozen at all times.
messages.zh: 一定要时刻保持那些种子处于冷冻状态。

messages.en: Colonists eking out a living on godforsaken rocks in space are finding it hard to maintain food production, so we're giving them a boost. The moment you've brought those crates of frozen plant seeds over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, our caravans will pick them up and haul them to those thankful pioneers.
messages.zh: 殖民者们正在太空中某些荒凉的岩石上艰难地生活着，他们很难维持食物的生产供应，而你，就要去帮他们一把。你要将这些装满了冷冻作物种子的箱子运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，我们的货运队会在那里接收货物并转送到那些充满感激的先驱者手中去。

messages.en: Excellent. Caravans will take the seeds to the colony. You have earned back some of your karma, capsuleer.
messages.zh: 非常好。我们的货运队会将种子运到殖民地去的。你做了件善事，飞行员，好人有好报。

messages.en: Really? Ah well, back to destruction it is.
messages.zh: 真的吗？好吧，你还是去玩枪弄炮吧。

messages.en:
You capsuleers spend so much time in the midst of mayhem and destruction, and you leave countless wreckages in your wake. Now, though, you and I have an opportunity to help sustain new life. I want you to transport some large crates of frozen plant seeds for me.

It will not surprise you that we are always trying to establish new colonies in even the most desolate parts of space. Colonization is always an exciting opportunity, not only for the settlers who dare venture out into space and stake their fortunes on some desolate rock, but for local entrepreneurs, businesses and politicians to support them. You won't hear of these, because your kind is so far up above piddly little local events, but it's a big deal for those involved.

Unfortunately, local support can't last forever. After the initial interest has waned, the citizens on those colonies have to fend for themselves. Sometimes they manage to create self-sustaining habitats where no outside intervention is needed. Occasionally they get lucky, and the outcome of their scientific experiments, ore search, or whatever else they were up to, makes them enough money that they can buy whatever they need off local orbitals.

All too often, though, we have to step in. Your cargo, once delivered to their colony, will hopefully enable them to bootstrap themselves to a self-sustaining life cycle. Colony life is hard enough as it is.
messages.zh:
你们这些克隆飞行员整天就知道打来打去，留下了无数的残骸废墟。不过，现在我们有个让你获得新生的机会。我要你为我运送这些装满了冷冻作物种子的大箱子。

说出来你一定不会感到惊讶，我们一直在建立新的殖民地，即使是在那些宇宙中最荒凉的地区。殖民计划是一项令人兴奋的机遇，不只是对那些勇于冒险、在荒凉的岩石上碰运气的开拓者来说是这样，对于那些留在后方为他们提供支持的企业家、商人和政客来讲也同样如此。估计你没听说过这些，因为你们这些人早已不关注这些地区事件，不过对于那些置身其中的人来讲，这是天大的事情。

不幸的是，后方的支持不会一直存在。在人们最初的兴趣消退后，那些殖民地的居民们就要自给自足了。有时候，他们希望能创造出能够自我维持、不需外界干预的生态系统。如果他们足够幸运，他们的科学实验、矿石研究以及别的什么工作能够带来足够的金钱，可以从后方的星球上购买任何想要的东西。

尽管这经常发生，我们有时还是要出手帮一把。你运送的这些货物，一旦送到殖民地去，将很有助于他们建立起自给自足的生命循环系统。殖民地上的生活，充满了艰辛。

messages.en: I am greatly disappointed. Their food stores were already running low.
messages.zh: 我非常失望。他们的食物已经维持不了多久了。

messages.en: Don't open any of those sealed special editions, you hear?
messages.zh: 不要打开任何一个密封的特别版影片，听清楚了吗？

messages.en: Some entertainment-hungry collectors out there are waiting for a lot of specially ordered holoreels that were manufactured, stamped, signed and compiled in special editions elsewhere in the cluster. I need you to bring these large holoreel crates to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} before they risk starting something silly like reading books.
messages.zh: 一些对娱乐产品如饥似渴的收藏家正在期盼一批特别的全息影片，它们是在宇宙中的某处生产、刻录、签字并编辑的特别版本。我要你将这些装满影片的大箱子运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，一定要赶在那些人做出什么傻事之前送到。

messages.en: Excellent. Your crew left the holoreels untouched, I trust.
messages.zh: 非常好。我相信你的船员没碰过那些全息影片。

messages.en: Very well. They'll just have to watch empty screens for a little longer.
messages.zh: 好吧。看来他们得再多看一会儿空白的屏幕了。

messages.en:
Most often we leave the shipment of entertainment material to the more slow-moving vessels in our employ. Every so often, though, we receive sufficient premium orders from other stations and the planets in their vicinity that we dispatch a special courier with the payload.

That courier is you, and the payload is huge stacks of holoreels, most of them ordered on some manner of timed interstellar delivery offer.

This isn't the primary business of our own corporation as such, but we have enough ties to the producers of all this material - as would any corporation large enough to have gone interstellar - that it's incumbent on us to find ways of delivering it to the customers.

Believe me, I wish we could just transfer all of this digitally, but for most of this cargo that is simply not an option. Some of these holoreels are under trade restrictions that prevent them from being beamed over and saved or stamped on the spot; others are special collectors' editions that may include anything from specially signed copies to boxed sets weighed down with any number of collectable objects.

Please ensure your crew doesn't open any of the crates, either. These people are collectors and paid a galactic premium for their items. If they so much as smell another human being's presence on the merchandise, they will resort either to lawsuits or assassinations.
messages.zh:
通常情况下，我们会使用速度较慢的舰船运送娱乐物品。不过有些时候，我们会从其它空间站或是邻近的星球接到足够多的高级订单，那我们就会派一位特别的快递员运送一批特别货物。

那位快递员就是你，而那些特别货物就是一大批全息影片，其中很多是属于星际间的定期订单。

这并不是我们军团主要的生意，不过我们与许多这种货物的生产商有联系——就像许多其它大型星际军团一样。我们有义务想办法将这些货物送到顾客手中。

相信我，我也希望能以数字方式传输这些东西，但是对大多数货物来讲行不通。这其中的一些影片是受到商业限制的，不允许现场播放、保存或是刻录。而另一些是特别收藏版本，从特别的签名版到内含众多收藏品的盒装版，应有尽有。

请确保你的船员不会打开其中任何一个箱子。这些人是收藏家，他们为自己的东西投了巨额的保险。一旦他们发现有别人动过了他们的货物，他们会采取法律甚至是行刺手段的。

messages.en: The customers will not be happy with this.
messages.zh: 顾客们会对此非常不满的。

messages.en: If your crew tells you that anything was moving in the garbage, don't believe them.
messages.zh: 如果你的船员告诉你那堆垃圾里面有什么东西在动的话，别相信他们的话。

messages.en: We have come into possession of large amounts of garbage, and since we can't legally rid ourselves of it here, I need you to transport it over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. They have some good people there who don't have ethical qualms about destroying any kind of trash, even if a limb or two is dangling out of the crate.
messages.zh: 我们这儿堆积了大量的垃圾。既然我们不能用合法的手段在这里处理掉它们，就只好派你把它们送到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去了。那里的人不会受到道德上的约束，可以处理掉任何种类的垃圾，即使箱子里有几只摇晃的手臂也没关系。

messages.en: Thanks. Now we have them off our hands. The garbage, I mean.  Off our hands.
messages.zh: 谢谢你。现在我们把那些人处理掉了。呃...我是说，垃圾。处理掉了。

messages.en: Look, it was just normal, everyday garbage. There was no reason for you not to take this on.
messages.zh: 你看，这只是些普通的日常垃圾。你没理由不接受的。

messages.en:
In all honesty, I find it just unbelievable that in this day and age we are expending actual capsuleer man-hours, not to mention the time and effort of your crew, and asking actual spaceships to travel interstellar distances only to shift around a cargohold of something as pitiable as actual garbage. Garbage. Especially the type we've got here, which takes up a bunch of room, has to be stored in nonporous containers, and, frankly, is starting to smell.

Nonetheless, here we are. We could have this cargo sent down planetside and destroyed, except that while those people are perfectly happy to toss up any number of shipments with whatever trinkets the station clientele is demanding that week, they have frothing conniptions if we so much as suggest that we might want to send anything like this back down in return. The merest whisper of it is enough for them to drag out the lawyers. It's not as if they don't have the space.

You aren't too big to help out, I trust. All we need you to do is haul this smelly, half-liquidized garbage to another station, where they'll have ways to get rid of it without endless complaints or moral qualms. I swear, if the PR department would just let us stop accepting all these colony refugees, we wouldn't have this problem.

Actually, forget I said that last part.
messages.zh:
老实说，我觉得很不可思议，这年头我们还要花费飞行员的宝贵人力，再加上船员们的时间与辛劳，动用飞船跨越星际去运送一些等同于垃圾的东西。垃圾。尤其是我这里的这堆东西，非常占空间，要装在密不透风的货柜里，而且说实话，开始发出难闻的气味了。

无论怎样，我们面临的情况就是如此。我们本可以把这些货物送到行星上去销毁，但是要考虑到这一点：行星上那些人愿意发送任意数量的货物——无论什么货物——来满足空间站客户的需求，而如果我们用些这样的东西作为回报的话，他们会抓狂的。仅仅是轻描淡写两句，就足以让他们请出律师了。他们装得好像自己没有足够的空间一样。

你不是那种坐视不理的人，我相信。我们只是要你将这些难闻的、半液体化的垃圾送到另一个空间站去，那里的人有办法处理这些东西，而不必受到没完没了的抱怨和道德上的谴责。我发誓，如果公关部门允许我们停止接收这些殖民地来的难民的话，我们就不会有这问题了。

呃，不过，忘掉我刚才后面那部分话吧。

messages.en: I am disappointed. I hope you didn't root around in the cargo.
messages.zh: 我非常失望。我希望你没对货物做什么过分的事情。

name.es: Subyugar a los habitantes de la estación
name.fr: Soumettre les habitants de la station
name.ja: ステーションの住人を鎮圧せよ

messages.en: I know you have plenty of firepower, too, but let's leave this one to station personnel.
messages.zh: 我知道你的火力也很猛，但咱们还是把这事交给空间站里的工作人员去处理吧。

messages.en: We have a small outburst of violent behavior to deal with on a nearby station. Refugees from interstellar violence have begun gathering forces and are demanding compensation, hearings and whatnot. Now, this is just a damn stupid situation, and we have people who can put it right, but they need a bit of a boost. That's where you come in. Transport these large crates of small arms to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and we'll take it from there.
messages.zh: 附近一座空间站内发生了一场小规模的暴动，我们需要将它摆平。最近许多星系都出现了难民暴动，并有愈演愈烈的趋势。难民要钱，要听证，还有其他一些乱七八糟的要求。我们现在所面临的情况不足为惧。我们有人手可以将它摆平，只要给他们稍许提供一点物质上的支援就行。这也就是我们要用你的原因。你只要把这一大批小型军械箱运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}，接下来就没你的事了。

messages.en: Thanks! And don't feel bad for those people - I'm sure there'll be some survivors.
messages.zh: 谢谢！ 你没必要为那些人难过——我相信会有幸存者的。

messages.en: Alright. We'll have to find other ways of subduing them, then.
messages.zh: 好吧。那我们得想其他办法平息此事了。

messages.en:
Our people at a nearby station are in need of more firepower. They are going to have to subdue unruly refugees from destroyed colonies and crews from recently destroyed ships.

I know it sounds ludicrous. The thing is, when you have near-death experiences of that kind, you may come to the realization that life is fickle, short and dangerous, and that everything you took for granted may be taken from you in the blink of an eye. It tends to upset people, make them aggressive and reckless.

That is, if they're mortal. You being a capsuleer, you'll just have to take my word for it. I'm sure death has a great impact on your sense of the world, but thus far in my experience, it doesn't make you half as crazy as near-death, and at least your type has the sense to take it outside when you feel the need to blow something up.

Incidentally, there are always claims - by silly local news outlets nobody listens to - that representatives of our corporation may not always react immediately when they hear that people are floating out there in escape pods, waiting in to be rescued. Do not let those claims bother you. Those same people are sitting in the midst of a deadly capsuleer battlefield and are in dire need of learning the blessed virtue of patience.
messages.zh:
我们附近空间站里的人需要火力支援。他们要负责控制一批刁蛮难民，这帮难民中有的来自被摧毁的殖民地，有的则是舰船爆炸过后幸存下来的船员。

我知道这事乍听上去荒唐又可笑。但是，当你像他们一样闯过一次鬼门关后，就有可能意识到所谓“天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福”，任何你习以为常的事物都有一眨眼工夫就消失的可能。这样一来，人就很容易受刺激，变得暴躁与鲁莽。

当然，这一切的前提是那人必须是一个会生老病死的凡人。作为不死克隆飞行员的你很难有这方面的切身体会，但我绝对没骗你。虽然我相信死亡这个现象影响着你们克隆飞行员对这个世界的认知，但至今为止我的经验告诉我，它绝不会把你们逼成像那帮难民一样的疯子。至少，你们不会在空间站内进行暴力发泄。

哦，顺便说一下，本地那些没有观众与听众的脑残新闻机构，散布消息说我们军团的代表在获悉大批人员驾驶着逃生舱，晃荡于太空等待救援后，有可能不会作出及时反映。你别听信这种说法。那些人身陷一个危险的克隆飞行员战场，我们要派人过去也不容易，他们得学会耐心等待。

messages.en: I'm disappointed. I hope you're not siding with these rebellious people.
messages.zh: 你让我很失望。但愿你没有倒向那帮匪众。

messages.en: Keep moving. I don't trust the sealants on those crates, and I'd hate for the Quafe to go flat.
messages.zh: 继续吧。我不太放心那些箱子的密封性，我可不想让酷菲的味道变淡了。

messages.en: You have a juicy and slightly sticky mission on your hands. Quafe is conducting one of their local marketing campaigns and are in need of exotic drinks - which in this case means another shipment of Quafe manufactured in another solar system. Bring these large crates of quafe over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and you'll make a lot of thirsty people very happy.
messages.zh: 我要给你一份美味多汁而又粘粘的工作。酷菲集团正在举行一场地区性的市场活动，需要一些异域饮品——其实就是在另一个星系生产的酷菲饮料。将这几大箱酷菲运到{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}去，拯救那里饥渴的人们吧。

messages.en: Perfect. Help yourself to a nice, cool, fizzy drink as a reward.
messages.zh: 非常好。这罐美妙的、泛着泡沫的饮料是你的奖励，拿去吧。

messages.en: You sure? But everybody loves Quafe!
messages.zh: 你当真吗？要知道人人都爱喝酷菲啊！

messages.en:
Quafe is preparing for one of their routine planetside campaigns, and as a premium they want to offer special bottles of the ubiquitous drink.

To be honest, there is nothing special about the drink. It's the same cola, with the same water, color, sugar, additives and perfectly legal trace elements, that you'd find on any civilized planet in the cluster. What's important isn't so much the brand as the bottles themselves . They were manufactured on another planet, so their design is subtly different from what's available where you're taking them, and the labeling indicates their origins.

People go crazy for this stuff. I'm serious. This will be hard for a capsuleer to understand, but most people don't even travel that much between the continents on their own planets. To hold in your hand an item that was manufactured in another solar system is an experience that's truly special to a huge number of people.

This only works for things like Quafe, mind you. Taking anything this thoroughly familiar and changing it just slightly has a higher excitement freakout value than even if you'd brought in some unknown artifact made by actual aliens.
messages.zh:
酷菲集团正在筹备例行的星际宣传活动，作为奖品，他们准备了一些特别的饮品。

老实讲，这些饮品并没有什么特别的。用的还是一样的可乐，一样的水、糖、添加剂以及一切的合法成分，就像你在这个星域中的其他星球上能找到的一样。其实重要的不是饮品本身，而是它的品牌。这些饮料是在另一个行星上生产的，所以它们的设计与你平时能看到的有着微妙的不同，而且它们的标签也标明了其原产地。

人们爱死这些东西了。我说的是真的。可能你一个克隆飞行员不太能够理解这些，但是大多数人甚至都没怎么去过他们星球上的另一块大陆。能够把一件从另一个星系生产的东西握在手中，对许多人来讲是非常特别的体验。

我要提醒你，这种情况只在酷菲这类的东西上发生。把一件你再熟悉不过的东西做一点小小的改变，会产生令人疯狂的价值，甚至比一件外星人制造的未知工艺品更让人兴奋。

messages.en: That's a disappointment. If you and your crew drank it all, it's okay to say so. You're not the only ones with a habit.
messages.zh: 真令人失望。不过如果是你和你的伙计把它们全喝了，这也说的过去。你可不是唯一一个有这种癖好的人。

messages.en: You'll ... not want to taste the cargo. Trust me.
messages.zh: 你......不会想要尝尝那货物的味道的。相信我。

messages.en: Our pod fluid vats in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} are in dire need of refilling, lest you find yourself floating in something that's more like a swamp lake after a hot summer. Collect from your hangar those large crates of ectoplasm we dredged up and haul them over there as soon as you can!
messages.zh: 我们急需重新注满位于{[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}的逃生舱流体槽，免得有天你会发现自己漂在一坨干得像暴晒了一夏天的沼泽一样的东西里。带上这些装填着外质的大箱子，以你最快的速度把它们送到目的地去。

messages.en: Wonderful. We'll happily let you try out the first batch.
messages.zh: 非常好。我们很高兴将第一批货物交付于你。

messages.en: Fair enough. Keep floating in your own goo, then.
messages.zh: 那好吧。你就继续漂在你那粘粘的液体里吧。

messages.en:
You capsuleers are amazing. Not only have you got the interstellar corporations doing crazy business in ore, minerals, modules and ammunition, but you also routinely exhaust our storages for the equipment that's required to even keep you people in the air. I need you to transport something that's vital for your own continued success.

I'm not referring to the capsules themselves or the unimaginably complex electronics that help you interface with your ship. No, this is something much more mundane. We need to replenish our vats of pod fluid, and for that, we need ectoplasm. This way, whenever you visit our fair station, we can drain and replace your capsule if our tests show that its contents have become a little too stale.

Also, should you have a clone contract with any of our stations and later on find yourself inconvenienced to the point of ... well, to the point of death, we want to ensure that we can put you into a new capsule filled to the brim with pod fluid that's proper, fresh and new. Nothing's quite as disgusting as waking up in a brand new body only to realize that it's been plunged into someone else's used pod fluid.
messages.zh:
你们这些克隆飞行员真是有趣。你们不仅帮助那些跨星际军团打理矿石、矿物、装备和弹药的大生意，你们也会定期消耗我们的储备——这些可都是你们生存所必需的东西。我需要你帮我运送一些对你们自身来讲都非常重要的东西。

我指的不是逃生舱本身，也不是那些帮助你们操控舰船的复杂得要死的电子设备。我想说的是一种更平常的东西。我们要对救生舱流体槽进行补充，所以，我们需要一些外质。这样做的好处就是，今后你无论什么时候来我们的空间站，如果检测表明你的救生舱里的东西变得有点“不太新鲜”了，你都可以重新更换一下。

而且，如果你和我们的任何一个空间站签订了克隆协议，而你不小心...呃...死掉的话，我们要确保你会在一个充满了新鲜流体的救生舱中获得新生。如果你醒来时发现你全新的身体正浸泡在别人用过的流体里面的话，那将是世界上最令人恶心的事情。

messages.en: Really? Alright, but don't be surprised if your pod starts to thicken up a little in time.
messages.zh: 真的吗？好吧，不过如果你发现你的逃生舱开始起了点什么变化的话，你可别感到惊讶。

name.de: Geflüster im Dunkeln - Erster Kontakt (1 von 4)
name.en: Whispers in the Dark - First Contact (1 of 4)
name.es: Susurros en la oscuridad: Primer contacto (1 de 4)
name.fr: Murmures dans les ténèbres – Premier contact (1 sur 4)
name.ja: 闇からのささやき―最初の連絡（1/4）
name.ko: 어둠 속의 속삭임 - 첫 번째 접촉 (1/4)
name.ru: Шепот в ночи: первая встреча (Whispers in the Dark - First Contact) (1 из 4)
name.zh: 黑暗中的密语—第一次接触(1/4)

messages.en: Watch your back out there, {[character]player.name}.  And whatever you do, don't let them take you prisoner, I've heard they have some insidious ways of making you spill your secrets...
messages.zh: 你要当心，{[character]player.name}。千万别让他们活捉你。我听说他们能运用一种阴险手段让你下意识地倒出你的秘密……

messages.en:
So good to see you, {[character]player.name}. I've been on a pretty tight schedule for the past two weeks, ever since we discovered the strange, and increasing, Serpentis activity in the system. Our CEO demands an explanation, yet we still don't know enough about the situation to determine what's really going on. And that's where you come in.

Serpentis activity on this scale in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} is unheard of, and quite frankly we aren't well enough prepared at the moment to deal with any major conflict with them. Not only that, but those greedy pirates are insatiable, and news of their appearance around here has sent the trade lanes into a state of panic. People are leaving this station already, making my superiors ... less than content if you know what I mean. We're losing good people because of this unacceptable situation and we need to put an end to it.

The first thing I want you to do is undertake a reconnaisance mission for us into an area where we have witnessed most of the Serpentis activity. We've already lost a few patrols that ventured into this area, so be careful. If you do find any Serpentis ships out there, eliminate them. We don't want any prisoners, interrogating these deviants won't do us any good. Report your findings to me a.s.a.p.
messages.zh:
很高兴见到你，{[character]player.name}。这两周我忙得焦头烂额，因为天蛇军队在这个星系的行动很不正常，而且愈演愈烈。CEO要我们对此给个说法，但目前情报非常匮乏，无法确定他们到底在干什么。这就是要你来这的原因。

以前天蛇军队从未在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}进行过如此规模的行动，坦白的讲，目前我们准备尚不充分，不能和他们正面冲突。不仅如此，那帮贪婪无厌的海盗十分疯狂，一些平民对他们到来的消息非常恐慌。甚至已经有人开始撤离空间站，这让我的上级……不怎么满意，我想你能明白我的意思。由于这些尴尬的事件，我们失去了优秀的人民，不能让这样的情况再继续下去了。

我要你做的第一件事情就是到据报天蛇活动频繁的地区进行侦察。你要特别小心，先前派去的巡逻队都有去无回。如果你确实在那里发现了天蛇的舰船，就消灭他们。留他们性命毫无意义，从疯子口中能问出什么呢。尽快把侦察情况回报给我们。

messages.en: You showed some class out there, {[character]player.name}.  Take your pay and report for your next assignment.
messages.zh: 你的表现很上档次，{[character]player.name}。这是你的报酬，下个工作正等着你呢。

messages.en: Because of your successful reconnaissance mission, we've managed to narrow down the location of the main Serpentis activity a bit.  The data that we extracted from your system scanner also revealed to us a few Serpentis ships that were not mentioned in your preliminary report.  It appears to be some sort of convoy, at least one of their ships was clearly an industrial.  Because of this we guess that it may be a routine shipment, meaning that they might get a convoy at regular intervals.  We'd like you to fly out there, preferably with a cloaking device, and lay in wait for any possible sign of another Serpentis convoy.  If you do see one, destroy it and bring back the contents of the industrials to me for inspection.
messages.zh: 由于你出色的侦察，我们已经进一步精确定位了天蛇的主要活动范围。分析人员仔细研究了你星系扫描仪中的数据，发现了一些你最初报告中没有提到的天蛇舰船。那似乎是某种护航队，其中至少一艘确定是工业舰船。因此我们猜想这也许是一次例行运输，也就是说每隔一段时间就会有一支护航队前来。我们要你飞去那里，最好带上隐形装置，守候另一支天蛇护航队的出现迹象。如果真有护航队出现，那就歼灭他们，并把工业舰上的货物带回来以供检查。

messages.en: Construction blocks?  I was afraid of that.  This doesn't seem to be a mere smuggling operation, but something much more sinister.  But we still don't know what they are building ... And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 建造模块？我就担心这个。这似乎不仅仅是非法贩售，而是些更邪恶的事情……可我们还是不知道他们在建造什么。先别离开，我还有另一项任务给你！

name.ru: Шепот в ночи: дроны-разведчики (Whispers in the Dark - The Spy Drones) (3 из 4)
name.zh: 黑暗中的密语—侦察无人机(3/4)

messages.en:
Now that we've established the general location of the Serpentis activity within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, it's actually time to find out exactly what they are building. In your last mission you destroyed one of their construction block transports, but this brings us no closer to finding their base of operations. We've had no luck interrogating these pirates before, and the surveillance teams we have sent to investigate the area have either found nothing or disappeared. This leaves us with very few options. But after brainstorming possible solutions to our problem, I came up with a devious plan.

We have in our possession so called 'spy drones', straight from our science labs, which attach themselves to a nearby ships hull and emits a low frequency signal which is picked up by one of our beacons which are strewn around {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, which in turn sends a high frequency signal to our control tower in {[location]agentStationID.name}.

Now we know that an agent of the Serpentis Corporation regularly picks up shipments of Ectoplasm at a certain station near here. If we can place the spy drone into his next shipment, this might allow us to track his ship to its destination.

Our men have placed beacons throughout our constellation, so everything is in place. All you need to do is take these crates filled with ectoplasm, and our spy drones, to the station specified in the mission details, our agents there will take care of the rest. With luck we'll soon know the location of the Serpentis base.
messages.zh:
我们已经掌握了天蛇在{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}的大致活动位置，现在该去查出他们究竟在建造什么东西。上次任务时你虽然摧毁了他们一艘建材运输船，但我们在查找他们的军事基地方面仍然无所进展。之前对这帮海盗的审问都一无所获，而派去那个区域的调查队不是无功而返就是彻底消失。这让我们几乎束手无策。在听取多方意见后，我决定采用迂回战术。

目前我们手头有一些所谓的“侦察无人机”，是我们的实验室研发的，能够附着在附近舰船的船体上，并发出只有位于{[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}附近的信标才能接收的低频信号，信标随后向{[location]agentStationID.name}里的控制塔发射高频信号。

我们得知天蛇集团的代理人会定期在附近的固定空间站中提取外质。如果我们能把侦查无人机安置到他的下一批货物中，说不定能追踪到他的目的地。

我们的人在整个星座内都部署了信标，万事俱备，只欠东风。你要做的就是把装有外质和侦察无人机的箱子运送到任务详情中提到的空间站，我们的代理人会处理好后续事宜。运气好的话，我们很快就能知道天蛇基地的位置了。

messages.en: Good job {[character]player.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!
messages.zh: 干得不错，{[character]player.name}。先别走，我还有个任务等着你呢！

messages.en:
After reviewing the intel we received from the spy drones which you transferred for us in your last mission, we managed to pinpoint the location of a military outpost they are building in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It appears to be a part of a defensive perimeter that they are setting up around their territory, which has elevated our fears that they have actually managed to erect a large colony inside our solarsystem.

But for now let's keep our sights on the current task, to breach a hole in their defensive wall. We believe that the outpost in question hasn't been fully built, and therefore will be a fairly easy target for you if it's defensive installations aren't complete. Contact with the spy drones was cut off before we could fully analyze the Serpentis forces in the area. But one thing's for sure, there will most certainly be guards nearby, and they will have to be dealt with. You will receive a bookmark to the location of the outpost, and your instructions are simple, destroy the habitat of their construction workers. That should slow them down a bit. Good luck.
messages.zh:
还记得上次任务里你运送的侦察无人机么，根据它发回来的信号，我们已成功定位他们在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}建造的军事哨站。似乎是他们建设中的领土防线的一部分。这意味着对方在这个恒星系里已经建造了一个大规模的殖民地，想到这个就让我不寒而栗。

不过现在还是把精力放到哨站上吧，我一直在考虑，如何能在对方的防御体系上开个口子。我们认为这个哨站并没有竣工，所以其防御设施相对比较薄弱，你可以应付。我们还没来得及从侦察无人机那里获取详细的天蛇军队布置，联系就中断了。有一点可以肯定，工地周围会有卫队，而你必须把他们都解决掉。哨站的位标已上传给你。指令只有一个，就是摧毁他们建筑工人的居住地，从而延缓工程的进度。祝你好运。

messages.en: Magnificent job, {[character]player.name}.  Those Serpentis really put up a fight didn't they?  However I believe you've done as much for us as we can possibly expect of you, the Serpentis data sheets you brought back with you have confirmed our worst fears, the Serpentis Corporation has a fully functional colony inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}!  It will take a massive force to take it out, and we can't expect you to handle a mission like that yet.  Good luck on your future endeavors.
messages.zh: 太漂亮了，{[character]player.name}。那帮天蛇抵抗得很激烈，是吧？不管怎样，我觉得你达到了我们对你的最大期望，你带回的天蛇数据单证实了我们最担心的事情，天蛇集团在{[location]dungeonLocationID.name}内拥有一座功能齐备的殖民地！扫平它将需要一支超大部队，我们还不能要求你来执行这样一项任务。祝你今后有好运。

name.ja: 反社会的なエージェント

messages.en: He's as good as dead!
messages.zh: 我会让他永远闭嘴。

messages.en:
I have a special optional mission for you, we won’t penalize you if you decline it.

A single individual, a rogue element of the Angel Cartel, has struck out on their own. We don't know why, but we want you to hunt them down.
They have all scans open, so we can't go there in force. We've acquired their coordinates and need someone to sneak in and take them out. It's you against them.

Only frigate sized ships can gain entry to the hideout, so don’t try to bring anything bigger.
This pirate will be flying a shield boosted Dramiel frigate, with an extremely small signature radius. He tends to deal most of his damage with Domination Fusion ammo, supplemented with Mjolnir rockets. Survivors of his previous attacks claim that he likes to orbit his opponents at very close range at high speed to make himself hard to hit. He always flies with a Stasis Webifier and Warp Scrambler fit.

A word of warning: this rogue pirate is extremely dangerous and has proven very capable of destroying capsuleer ships. If you choose to decline this mission or if you fail to complete it, you will not lose any standings.
messages.zh:
我这儿有个特殊任务给你，不过如果你拒绝我也不会惩罚你的。

天使集团中的一个危险分子脱离组织单独行动了。我们不知道原因，但我要你去把他干掉。
他的扫描器全开，所以我们不能大张旗鼓地去找他。我们已经获得了他的坐标，需要有人悄悄过去一剑封喉。所以你要和他一对一交手了。

他藏身的地点只允许护卫舰级别的船只进入，所以不要开大船去。
这个海盗驾驶着一艘护盾回充型的德拉米尔级护卫舰，信号半径非常小。他主要靠主天使聚变弹造成伤害，另外还会使用雷神火箭。如果他的第一波攻击没有奏效，他就会在离目标非常近的距离高速环绕，让你很难打中他。他还常常装备了停滞缠绕光束和跃迁扰频器。

事先提个醒：这名海盗极其危险，非常擅于摧毁克隆飞行员的舰船。如果你选择拒绝这个任务，或是没有能够完成它，你都不会损失声望的。

messages.en: He's dead, now where's my money?!
messages.zh: 他已经死了，我的钱在哪儿？

messages.en: No hard feelings, not everyone is capable of taking on a pirate this brutal.
messages.zh: 别为这事儿难过了，不是每个人都能干掉那么凶残的海盗的。

I advise you to do everything in your power to eliminate the Bursts early in the fight.

messages.en:
I have a special optional and extremely difficult mission for you, we won’t penalize you if you decline it.

It appears that a small group of Serpentis corporation test pilots have absconded with some prototype battlecruisers being developed for smuggling operations. We’ve located three of these pilots in a base they’ve established not far from here.
They have all scans open, so we can't go there in force. If you accept this mission, it's you against them.

Only medium sized ships can gain entry to the hideout, so don’t try to bring anything bigger.
These rogue pirates are flying advanced prototype battlecruisers capable of dealing damage at long range. Our intelligence reports indicate that they are armed with railguns loaded with Spike ammunition. Survivors of our last failed attack against their compound indicate that they use long ranges combined with powerful sensor dampeners to avoid danger. Their base is also equipped with a huge minefield of proximity-activated autoturrets. These turrets deal EM damage and will cause you problems if they activate, but they remain dormant unless a ship enters within 10km of them. Fly carefully to avoid the turrets. These pirates always fly with a Warp Disruptors fit.

A word of warning: these rogue pirates are extremely dangerous and have proven very capable of destroying capsuleer ships. If you choose to decline this mission or if you fail to complete it, you will not lose any standings.
messages.zh:
我这儿有个特殊且极其艰巨的任务给你，不过如果你拒绝我也不会惩罚你的。

好像有一小撮天蛇试飞员开着组织专门研发用于非法贩售活动的战列巡洋舰原型逃了出来。我们已经找到了其中的三个，他们在离这儿不远的一个基地中。
他们的扫描器全开，所以我们不能大张旗鼓地去找他们。如果你接受这个任务，就要独自前去面对他们了。

他们藏身的地点只允许中型舰船进入，所以不要开大船去。
这些海盗驾驶着先进的原型战列巡洋舰，擅于从远距离输出伤害。情报显示他们装配了载有钉刺弹药的磁轨炮。我们上次对他们基地的攻击以失败而告终，幸存者报告说他们依靠远距攻击以及强力的感应抑阻器来规避危险。他们的基地周围布满了自动炮台，会自行攻击接近的目标。这些炮台主要造成电磁伤害，被它们盯上了可是件麻烦的事情，不过它们只会攻击接近到10km内的 舰船，所以飞行时要小心避开炮台。这些海盗常常装备了跃迁扰断器。

事先提个醒：这些海盗极其危险，非常擅于摧毁克隆飞行员的舰船。如果你选择拒绝这个任务，或是没有能够完成它，你都不会损失声望的。

Our intelligence reports indicate that they are armed with railguns loaded with Spike ammunition. Survivors of our last failed attack against their compound indicate that they use long ranges combined with powerful sensor dampeners to avoid danger. Their base is also equipped with a huge minefield of proximity-activated autoturrets. These turrets deal EM damage and will cause you problems if they activate, but they remain dormant unless a ship enters within 10km of them. Fly carefully to avoid the turrets. These pirates always fly with a Warp Disruptors fit.

A word of warning: these rogue pirates are extremely dangerous and have proven very capable of destroying capsuleer ships. If you choose to decline this mission or if you fail to complete it, you will not lose any standings.
messages.zh:
我这儿有个特殊且极其艰巨的任务给你，不过如果你拒绝我也不会惩罚你的。

好像有一小撮天蛇试飞员开着组织专门研发用于非法贩售活动的战列巡洋舰原型逃了出来。我们已经找到了其中的三个，他们在离这儿不远的一个基地中。
他们的扫描器全开，所以我们不能大张旗鼓地去找他们。如果你接受这个任务，就要独自前去面对他们了。

他们藏身的地点只允许中型舰船进入，所以不要开大船去。
这些海盗驾驶着先进的原型战列巡洋舰，擅于从远距离输出伤害。情报显示他们装配了载有钉刺弹药的磁轨炮。我们上次对他们基地的攻击以失败而告终，幸存者报告说他们依靠远距攻击以及强力的感应抑阻器来规避危险。他们的基地周围布满了自动炮台，会自行攻击接近的目标。这些炮台主要造成电磁伤害，被它们盯上了可是件麻烦的事情，不过它们只会攻击接近到10km内的 舰船，所以飞行时要小心避开炮台。这些海盗常常装备了跃迁扰断器。

事先提个醒：这些海盗极其危险，非常擅于摧毁克隆飞行员的舰船。如果你选择拒绝这个任务，或是没有能够完成它，你都不会损失声望的。

messages.en: No hard feelings, not everyone is capable of taking on pirates this brutal.
messages.zh: 别为这事儿难过了，不是每个人都能干掉那么凶残的海盗的。

messages.en: They're as good as dead!
messages.zh: 他们死定了！

messages.en:
I have a special optional and extremely difficult mission for you, we won’t penalize you if you decline it.

It appears that some local Blood Raider conflicts over Sani Sabik religions doctrine have boiled over and caused a prominent pirate captain to declare herself independent from the rest of the Covenant. This particular pirate seems obsessed with the Drifters and is collecting capsuleer bodies to use as some sort of “bait” for attracting them. She has started to collect her own fanatical followers and this could get out of hand quickly if not dealt with soon.
They have all scans open, so we can't go there in force. If you accept this mission, it's you against them.

Only medium sized ships can gain entry to the hideout, so don’t try to bring anything bigger.
This rogue pirate is flying an extremely well fitted Ashimmu cruiser sporting powerful Nosferatu modules and long-range Stasis Webifiers. Our intelligence reports indicate that she is armed with beam lasers that deal EM and Thermal damage.
She also has two wingmen flying Sentinel class Electronic Attack Frigates. The Sentinel wingmen are equipped with autocannons loaded with Barrage ammo. They also sport extremely effective tracking disruptors and have been seen supporting their leader by destroying any hostile drones they see. These pirates always fly with a Warp Scrambler and long-range Stasis Webifiers fit.

A word of warning: these rogue pirates are extremely dangerous and have proven very capable of destroying capsuleer ships. If you choose to decline this mission or if you fail to complete it, you will not lose any standings.

我这儿有个特殊且极其艰巨的任务给你，不过如果你拒绝我也不会惩罚你的。

他们的扫描器全开，所以我们不能大张旗鼓地去找他们。如果你接受这个任务，就要独自前去面对他们了。

他们藏身的地点只允许中型舰船进入，所以不要开大船去。
这名海盗驾驶着一艘装配精良的阿什姆级巡洋舰，搭载了强力的掠能器装备和远距停滞缠绕光束。情报显示她还装配了能造成电磁和热能伤害的集束激光器。
她带有两名驾驶着哨兵级电子攻击护卫舰的帮手，他们装配了载有雷暴弹药的自动加农炮。此外，他们还加装了效果极强的索敌扰断器，而且会攻击敌对目标的无人机。这些海盗往往装备了跃迁扰频器和远距停滞缠绕光束。

事先提个醒：这些海盗极其危险，非常擅于摧毁克隆飞行员的舰船。如果你选择拒绝这个任务，或是没有能够完成它，你都不会损失声望的。

messages.zh: 他们已经死了，我的钱在哪儿？

messages.en:
I have a special optional and extremely difficult mission for you, we won’t penalize you if you decline it.

A team of thugs that have spent the past few years recruiting and transporting clone soldiers for the Angel Cartel have gone rogue and appear to be massing their ground forces for an operation nearby. We cannot allow this operation to go forward.
They have all scans open, so we can't go there in force. If you accept this mission, it's you against them.

Only medium sized ships can gain entry to the hideout, so don’t try to bring anything bigger.
These rogue pirates are flying four Dramiel frigates with strong shield tanks and extremely small signatures. They deal most of their damage using Domination Fusion ammo, supplemented with Mjolnir rockets. Survivors of their previous attacks claim that they like to orbit their opponents at very close range at high speed to make themselves hard to hit. They always fly with Stasis Webifiers and Warp Scramblers fit. To prevent their attack you will need to kill all four Dramiels as well as their nearby transport ship.

A word of warning: these rogue pirates are extremely dangerous and have proven very capable of destroying capsuleer ships. If you choose to decline this mission or if you fail to complete it, you will not lose any standings.
messages.zh:
我这儿有个特殊且极其艰巨的任务给你，不过如果你拒绝，我也不会惩罚你的。

一群恶棍在过去几年中为天使集团招募和运送克隆战士。最近他们开始单干了，纠集了他们的地面部队在这附近兴风作浪。我们当然不能听之任之。
他们的扫描器全开，所以我们不能大张旗鼓地去找他们。如果你接受这个任务，就要独自前去面对他们了。

他们藏身的地点只允许中型舰船进入，所以不要开大船去。
这些自由海盗开的是4艘德拉米尔级护卫舰，护盾防御坚固，信号半径却极其小。他们主要靠主天使聚变弹造成伤害，另外还会使用雷神火箭。如果他们的第一波攻击没有奏效，他们就会在离目标非常近的距离高速环绕，让你很难打中他们。他们常常装备了停滞缠绕光束和跃迁扰频器。要防止他们进攻，你必须把4艘德拉米尔级全部干掉，还有他们周围的运输舰。

事先提个醒：这些海盗极其危险，非常擅于摧毁克隆飞行员的舰船。如果你选择拒绝这个任务，或是没有能够完成它，你都不会损失声望的。

messages.en:
I have a special optional and extremely difficult mission for you, we won’t penalize you if you decline it.

The Wyvern-class Supercarrier Antero was recently stolen from the Caldari by a group of hijackers funded by the Guristas. They seem to have somehow double-crossed their employers, and now both the Caldari Navy and the Guristas are after them. Their Supercarrier is severely damaged, but still commands a powerful contingent of heavily modified fighters.
I wouldn’t normally care too much about this ship, except that it just showed up outside a nearby repair depot demanding repairs and threatening violence. If they damage that depot I’m going to personally lose a significant investment, and we can’t let that happen. If you accept this mission, you’ll need to get over there and convince them that there are better depots to hold up than mine. There’s no way that you’ll be able to kill it, but if you wipe out enough of its fighters I’m sure they’ll get the hint.

Only medium sized ships can gain entry to the repair yard, so don’t try to bring anything bigger.
These rogue pirates have waves of heavily modified fighters and fighter bombers with strong shield tanks and small signatures. They deal all four damage types, with their modified Dragonfly fighters spewing Explosive, Kinetic and Thermal at close range, and their modified Mantis fighter-bombers lobbing EM damage from longer ranges. They always fly with Stasis Webifiers and Warp Scramblers fit. To save my repair depot you’ll need to keep destroying waves of fighters until the Wyvern decides to cut its losses and leave.

A word of warning: these rogue pirates are extremely dangerous and have proven very capable of destroying capsuleer ships. If you choose to decline this mission or if you fail to complete it, you will not lose any standings.
messages.zh:
我这儿有个特殊且极其艰巨的任务给你，不过如果你拒绝，我也不会惩罚你的。

名为安特罗号的飞龙级超级航母最近在加达里被一伙由古斯塔斯海盗资助的强盗拿走了。他们好像连上家都出卖了，现在加达里海军和古斯塔斯海盗都在通缉他们。他们的航母已经严重损坏了，不过仍然保有一支经过大幅改装的强大的舰载机编队。
通常来讲我就不去理这艘船了，不过这次它跑到附近的一个维修站外面要求获得修理，并威胁动用武力。如果他们摧毁了那个维修站，我个人会损失一大笔投资，我绝不允许这种事情发生。如果你接受任务，你需要前往那里使他们相信别处还有比这更好的维修站。你没办法把他们都铲除，但是如果你能干掉足够的舰载机，我想他们会接受建议的。

那个修理场只允许中型舰船进入，所以不要开大船去。
这些自由无人机海盗驾驶着一波又一波的铁骑舰载机和铁骑轰炸机。它们经过大幅改装，护盾抗性优良，信号半径很小。经过大幅改装后，它们造成四种类型的伤害，蜻蜓铁骑舰载机在近处喷出爆炸、动能或热能伤害，螳螂铁骑轰炸机在远处投出电磁伤害。它们常常装备了停滞缠绕光束和跃迁扰频器。要保住我的维修站，你得击溃一波又一波的无人机攻势，直到飞龙级母船决定止住损失而逃离。

事先提个醒：这些海盗极其危险，非常擅于摧毁克隆飞行员的舰船。如果你选择拒绝这个任务，或是没有能够完成它，你都不会损失声望的。

messages.en: The Antero won't threaten your Depot any longer. Now where's my money?!
messages.zh: 安特罗号不会再威胁你的修理场了。现在我的钱在哪儿？！

messages.en: Several survey vessels are sent to collect asteroid data from nearby systems. We have lost contact with one of them. This happens occasionally and it's probably nothing to be worried about. Find the survey vessel and get their data dump. If worse comes to worst, just retrieve the black box. This mission requires a Data Analyzer.
messages.zh: 我们派了几艘测量船去收集附近星系的小行星数据，不过其中一艘与我们失去了联系。这种事情经常发生，可能也没什么大不了的。 我要你去找到那艘测量船，拿到数据，最坏情况下也要把黑匣子拿回来。 这个任务需要装配一个数据分析仪。

messages.en:
Our ships are armed so unless it's a serious threat, they should be able to handle most problems. Yet we've lost another one in the area.

We've narrowed it down to a listening post nearby. According to their latest reports, logistics say the post had been requesting more replacement parts than usual. Make of that what you will.

Good luck.
messages.zh:
我们的船装配精良，如果不是特别严重的局面，他们应该都能应对得了。不过，我们在那个地区又损失了一艘船。

我们将范围缩小到了附近的一座监听哨站。根据最新的报告，后勤部门反映该哨站比以往所要求的备件数量要多，我要你去看看怎么回事。

祝你好运。

messages.en:
Drones going rogue? How does this even happen? They've been stealing parts from our long-range survey towers for a while. Now they are attacking our survey ships. This has to stop.

Based on data from numerous sources, we've found a gathering of these drones. A nest, if you will. Destroy them.
messages.zh:
叛逃的无人机？怎么搞的？它们从我们的一座远距测量塔中偷零件已经有段时间了，现在还来攻击我们的测量船？不能再这样下去了。

根据多方面汇总的数据，我们找到了这些无人机的根据地，一座母巢，你现在去把那里掀个底朝天。

messages.en:
We have located a couple of wrecks. It doesn't matter to us what happened but we got the salvage rights. Well, it seems someone else has been stealthily salvaging them. That won't do.

Bring back the scrap metal and black boxes, you can keep the rest.
messages.zh:
我们找到了一些残骸，我不管发生过什么，但是我们可以打捞它们了。不过呢，好像有别人在偷偷地进行打捞，这样可不行。

把废金属和黑匣子给我拿回来，别的都归你了。

messages.en: The Missing Pilot
messages.zh: 失踪的飞行员

messages.en: You snuck onto an ORE work crew to retrieve information about the missing Sarnai. The data you found points to some unique mineral isotopes. Perhaps Elias knows someone who can help.
messages.zh: 你偷偷潜入联合矿业工作团队，取回了有关失踪的萨尔奈的相关信息。你找到的数据指向一些特殊的矿物同位素。或许伊利亚斯知道谁能够帮上忙。

messages.en:
Elias' friend Sarnai is missing, presumed dead, and he wants your help finding out what happened. 

Disguise yourself as a member of Sarnai’s old ORE work crew so you can hack their mainframe and steal any data on why Sarnai went missing.
messages.zh: 伊利亚斯的好友萨尔奈下落不明，据推测已经死亡，他想让你帮忙找出事情的真相。伪装成联合矿业的矿工，加入萨尔奈之前的工作团队，破译他们的主机，窃取所有和萨尔奈失踪相关的数据。

messages.en: Incredible, together we can figure out what is going on here. I will see you at the ORE site.
messages.zh: 太棒了，只要我们齐心协力，就能够知道到底发生了什么。那就在联合矿业地点再见了。

messages.en:
A close friend of mine who was working at ORE, Batya Sarnai, is missing, presumed dead. No one will tell me or her family what happened. I need your help to uncover the truth.

I’ve tracked down her old work crew and got you on their work roster. I need you to go undercover as an ORE miner, hack their mainframe, and steal any data on Sarnai.
messages.zh:
我的一位好友 Batya Sarnai 在 ORE 工作，现已失踪，被推定死亡。没有人愿意告诉我或她的家人到底发生了什么事。我需要你的帮助来揭开真相。

我找到了她以前的工作团队，并把你安排进了他们的工作名单。你需要伪装成联合矿业的矿工，破译他们的主机，窃取所有有关萨尔奈的数据。

messages.en:
Those ORE miners will not be happy that we stole their data, but it was worth it.

The data contains the details of some unique mineral isotopes. Why Sarnai’s name is listed alongside them, I don’t know, but I may just know someone who can help us make sense of this.
messages.zh:
要是那些联合矿业的矿工发现我们在窃取数据，肯定会勃然大怒，但我相信这样做是值得的。

数据中包含一些特殊矿物同位素的详细信息。我想不通萨尔奈的名字为什么会和这些矿物同位素出现在一起，但我知道有人能够帮我们捋清这件事。

messages.en:
I cannot say I am not disappointed.

If you change your mind, come back and see me. My friend deserves justice, and I need your help to get it.
messages.zh:
我只能说我相当失望。

如果你改变主意，尽管回来找我。我想要为朋友伸张正义，而这需要你的帮助。

messages.en:
Hello there, Captain. I could use your help.

A close friend of mine who was working at ORE, Batya Sarnai, is missing, presumed dead. No one will tell me or her family what happened. I need your help to uncover the truth.

I’ve tracked down her old work crew and got you on their work roster. I need you to go under cover as an ORE miner, hack their mainframe, and steal any data on Sarnai.
messages.zh:
你好舰长，我需要你的帮助。

我的好友巴特雅 萨尔奈曾在联合矿业工作，现已下落不明，据推测已经死亡。没有人愿意告诉我或她的家人到底发生了什么事。我需要你的帮助来揭开真相。

我找到了她以前的工作团队，并把你安排进了他们的工作名单。我需要你伪装成 ORE 矿工，入侵他们的主机，窃取 Sarnai 上的所有数据。

messages.en: I'm disappointed, but I understand. Fly safe.
messages.zh: 尽管我很失望，但我能理解你。一路顺风。

messages.en:
Need a reminder? No problem.

A close friend of mine who was working at ORE, Batya Sarnai, is missing, presumed dead. No one will tell me or her family what happened. I need your help to uncover the truth.

I’ve tracked down her old work crew and got you on their work roster. I need you to go undercover as an ORE miner, hack their mainframe, and steal any data on Sarnai.
messages.zh:
需要我给点提示吗？没问题。

我的一位好友 Batya Sarnai 在 ORE 工作，现已失踪，被推定死亡。没有人愿意告诉我或她的家人到底发生了什么事。我需要你的帮助来揭开真相。

我找到了她以前的工作团队，并把你安排进了他们的工作名单。你需要伪装成联合矿业的矿工，破译他们的主机，窃取所有有关萨尔奈的数据。

messages.en: Pioneering Spirit
messages.zh: 开拓精神

messages.en: With the help of Brother Jacques Quelouse of the SOE, you were able to determine the isotopes' origin, an explosion at an unknown Upwell facility. Investigating that sight may just give Elias the answers he seeks.
messages.zh: 在EVE姐妹会修士雅克·奎卢斯的帮助下，你成功确定了同位素的来源——一次未知昇威设施发生的爆炸。前往那个地方调查一番或许能给伊利亚斯带去他想要的答案。

messages.en:
Elias' friend in the Sisters of EVE has agreed to help us investigate these mineral isotopes. Even better, he says he’s managed to track some of them down. The only snag is that he needs your help to investigate them.

Elias has sent the coordinates to your ship’s computer. Meet the SOE scientist at the site. Bring a mining ship and a surveyor, and help him investigate the correct isotopes.
messages.zh: 伊利亚斯有个在EVE姐妹会的朋友愿意帮助我们调查这些矿物同位素。更妙的是，他说他已经设法找到了其中一些人。现在唯一的问题是，他需要你的帮助来调查这些同位素。伊利亚斯已经把具体坐标发到你舰船的计算机里了。在相关地点与EVE姐妹会科学家见面。驾驶采矿船并装配采矿勘测仪，帮助他调查发现的同位素。

messages.en: I was hoping you would say that. Now, let’s go see a man about some rocks.
messages.zh: 你能这么说真是太好了。走吧，去处理那些石头的事。

messages.en:
Good news, a friend of mine in the Sisters of EVE has agreed to help us investigate these mineral isotopes. Even better, he says he’s managed to track some of them down. The only snag is that he needs our help to investigate them.

I’ve sent the coordinates to your ship’s computer. Meet him at the site with a mining ship and a surveyor, and help him investigate the correct isotopes.
messages.zh:
好消息是，我有个在EVE姐妹会的朋友愿意帮助我们调查这些矿物同位素。更值得一提的是，他表示已经成功追踪到部分同位素的来源。唯一的问题是他需要我们的帮助来调查他们。

我已经把坐标发送到你们飞船的电脑里了。驾驶采矿船并装配采矿勘测仪，在相关地点与他见面，帮助他调查发现的同位素。

messages.en: Brother Jacques sent us the isotopes' points of origin. When you’re ready, come speak to me again, and we can finally find out the truth.
messages.zh: 雅克修士把这些同位素的起源点发给了我们。你准备好之后再来找我谈谈吧，这下终于可以找出事情的真相了。

messages.en:
Damn, without your help this data is just useless bytes.

If you change your mind, come and see me again.
messages.zh:
该死，要是没有你的帮助，这些数据就只是毫无用处的字节。

如果你改变主意，欢迎随时来找我。

messages.en:
We’ve got the data, now we just need to know what it means.

The good news, a friend of mine in the Sisters of EVE has agreed to help us investigate the mineral isotopes mentioned alongside Sarnai in the data. Even better, he says he’s managed to track some of them down. The only snag is that he needs our help to investigate them.

I’ve sent the coordinates to your ship’s computer. Meet him at the site with a mining ship and a surveyor, and help him investigate the correct isotopes.
messages.zh:
现在数据已经到手，我们只需要知道这些数据背后的含义。

好消息是，我有个在EVE姐妹会的朋友愿意帮助我们调查这些与萨尔奈数据一同出现的矿物同位素。更妙的是，他说他已经设法找到了其中一些人。唯一的问题是他需要我们的帮助来调查他们。

我已经把坐标发送到你们飞船的电脑里了。带着一艘采矿船和一名测量员到现场与他会合，帮助他调查正确的同位素。

messages.en: When we were so close...? Alright. Goodbye.
messages.zh: 我们曾经是那么亲近……？好的。再见。

messages.en:
Need a reminder? No problem.

The good news, a friend of mine in the Sisters of EVE has agreed to help us investigate the mineral isotopes mentioned alongside Sarnai in the data. Even better, he says he’s managed to track some of them down. The only snag is that he needs our help to investigate them.

I’ve sent the coordinates to your ship’s computer. Meet him at the site with a mining ship and a surveyor, and help him investigate the correct isotopes.
messages.zh:
需要提醒吗？没问题。

好消息是，我在 EVE 姐妹会的一位朋友同意帮助我们调查数据中与 Sarnai 一起提到的矿物同位素。更妙的是，他说他已经设法找到了其中一些人。唯一的问题是他需要我们的帮助来调查他们。

我已经把坐标发送到你们飞船的电脑里了。驾驶采矿船并装配采矿勘测仪，在相关地点与他见面，帮助他调查发现的同位素。

messages.en: Shattered Catalyst
messages.zh: 破碎的催化剂

messages.en: Batya Sarnai’s tale has come to an end. Elias has learned the truth and can be satisfied that he gave Sarnai’s legacy the honor it deserves.
messages.zh: 巴特雅·萨尔奈的故事到此结束。伊利亚斯了解到了事情的真相，他让萨尔奈的传奇故事得到应有的荣耀，悬着的一颗心总算是放下了。

messages.en: Whatever happened to Sarnai happened at this abandoned Upwell site. With your help, Elias can uncover the truth and give Sarnai’s legacy the ending it deserves.
messages.zh: 萨尔奈的遭遇就发生在这个废弃的 Upwell 遗址。有了你们的帮助，伊利亚斯就能揭开真相，让萨尔奈的传奇故事得到应有的结局。

messages.en: Time for the grand finale, let’s head out.
messages.zh: 是时候开始最后的表演了，我们出发吧。

messages.en: Whatever happened to Sarnai happened at this abandoned Upwell site. With your help we can uncover the truth and give Sarnai’s legacy the ending it deserves.
messages.zh: 萨尔奈的遭遇就发生在这个废弃的 Upwell 遗址。有了你们的帮助，我们就能揭开真相，让萨尔奈的传奇故事得到应有的结局。

messages.en:
Finally, I can put Sarnai to rest. It’s not what she deserved, she deserved to live a full life, grow old, and die in comfort. But, it’s what she would have wanted, and there’s honor in that.

Thank you, Captain, I couldn't have made it through without you.
messages.zh:
我终于可以让萨尔奈安息了。事情不应该像这样发展，她本应该过上幸福美满的生活，然后衰老，直到安详离去。但这样的结局也是她希望看到的，为了无上荣耀。

谢谢你，舰长，没有你我肯定撑不下去。

messages.en: What! We’re in too deep to quit now. Please, think it over, come back and talk to me. I know you’ll do the right thing.
messages.zh: 什么！事到如今你想要放弃，恐怕已经有点太晚了。请仔细考虑一下，然后再来跟我谈谈。我知道你会做出正确的选择。

messages.en:
This is it.

Whatever happened to Sarnai happened at this abandoned Upwell site. With your help we can uncover the truth and give Sarnai’s legacy the ending it deserves.
messages.zh:
没错，

萨尔奈就是在这个废弃昇威地点遭遇不幸的。有了你们的帮助，我们就能揭开真相，让萨尔奈的传奇故事得到应有的结局。

messages.en: Fine. Goodbye.
messages.zh: 算了，再见。

messages.en:
No need to wait around.

Whatever happened to Sarnai happened at this abandoned Upwell site. With your help we can uncover the truth and give Sarnai’s legacy the ending it deserves.
messages.zh:
不用等了，

萨尔奈的遭遇就发生在这个废弃的 Upwell 遗址。有了你们的帮助，我们就能揭开真相，让萨尔奈的传奇故事得到应有的结局。

name.es: Solicitudes de Paragon: Naves por recompensas
name.fr: Demandes de Paragon : vaisseaux contre astuces
name.ja: パラゴンのリクエスト：艦船でテクニックをご提供

messages.en: Paragon thanks you for your participation, Captain. Be sure to let me know once you are ready to deliver. Don't keep me waiting too long now.
messages.zh: 派瑞根衷心感谢你的参与，舰长。准备好运送后，请立即通知我。记得别让我等太久。

messages.en:
Paragon is offering you an opportunity to unlock cutting-edge personalization options.

Visit any Paragon station and fulfill our daily requests in order to earn rewards.

Paragon; be more.
messages.zh:
派瑞根现为你带来一个前所未有的机会，让你能够体验尖端的个性化选项。

前往任意派瑞根空间站，完成每日挑战，即可赢取丰厚奖励。

派瑞根，精益求精。

name.ja: ゴルゴザンフィールド

messages.en: Golgothan Fields
messages.zh: 格洛之域

messages.en: To experience the Amarr perspective on the Great Rebellion, you entered a simulation of the Battle of Golgothan Fields. Fresh from Jovian defeat, you helped a Dreadnought get back in the fight and take on the Minmatar. Sacrificing it all to claim victory, you proved the power of Amarrian faith.
messages.zh: 为了从艾玛的角度体验大起义，你进入了格洛之域模拟战。在与朱庇特的交战落败后，你帮助一艘无畏舰重新投入战斗，迎战米玛塔尔。为了夺取胜利而牺牲一切，你证明了艾玛人信仰的力量。

messages.en: The Amarr have invited you to relive their historic battle with the Minmatar at the Golgothan Fields. Travel to the simulation site and follow the instructions to be a part of this historic epic.
messages.zh: 艾玛邀请你重温他们在格洛之域与米玛塔尔的历史性战役。前往模拟地点，按照指示成为这段历史史诗的一部分。

messages.en: Empress be praised. Make your way to the simulation site. We will discuss further once you arrive.
messages.zh: 赞美女皇。前往模拟地点。等你到达后，我们再进一步讨论。

messages.en:
Witness our inevitable destiny and our rightful dominion over the stars. This simulation is a pale mirror of the glorious light of that destiny, and yet it shines so bright.

Travel to the simulation site, and I shall instruct you as you feel the power of our faith.
messages.zh:
见证我们不可避免的命运和我们对星辰的正当统治权。这场模拟只是那命运荣光的苍白倒影，然而它依然如此耀眼。

前往模拟地点，当你感受到我们信仰的力量时，我会引导你前行。

messages.en:
Witness our inevitable destiny and our rightful dominion over the stars. This simulation is a pale mirror of the glorious light of that destiny, and yet it shines so bright.

Travel to the simulation site, and I shall instruct you as you feel the power of our faith.
messages.zh:
见证我们不可避免的命运和我们对星辰的正当统治权。这场模拟只是那命运荣光的苍白倒影，然而它依然如此耀眼。

前往模拟地点，当你感受到我们信仰的力量时，我会引导你前行。

messages.en:
You have borne witness to the true meaning of faith, the strength it grants, and the sacrifice it demands.

If you are ready to stand for our holy Empress, seek out our campaigns or enlist at one of our militia offices.
messages.zh:
你亲眼见证了信仰的真正意义、它赋予的力量以及它要求的牺牲。

如果你准备好为我们神圣的女皇挺身而出，请寻找我们的军事行动或前往我们的国民卫队办公室应征入伍。

messages.en: You may turn towards the shadows, but the light shines still. Return when you are ready to give in to faith.
messages.zh: 你或许会转向阴影，但光明依然闪耀。当你准备好臣服于信仰时再回来。

messages.en:
Our past is but a stepping stone to our inevitable destiny and our rightful dominion over the stars. This simulation is a pale mirror of the glorious light of that destiny, and yet it shines so bright.

Travel to the simulation site, and I shall instruct you as you feel the power of our faith.
messages.zh:
我们的过去只是通往我们不可避免的命运和我们对星辰正当统治权的垫脚石。这场模拟只是那命运荣光的苍白倒影，然而它依然如此耀眼。

前往模拟地点，当你感受到我们信仰的力量时，我会引导你前行。

messages.en: You may turn towards the shadows, but the light shines still. Return when you are ready to give in to faith.
messages.zh: 你或许会转向阴影，但光明依然闪耀。当你准备好臣服于信仰时再回来。

messages.en:
Do you seek re-instruction?

The Amarr have invited you to relive their historic battle with the Minmatar at the Golgothan Fields. Travel to the simulation site and follow the instructions to be a part of this historic epic.
messages.zh:
你需要重新指导吗？

艾玛邀请你重温他们在格洛之域与米玛塔尔的历史性战役。前往模拟地点，按照指示成为这段历史史诗的一部分。

name.ja: カルダリプライム脱出事件

messages.en: Caldari Prime Breakout
messages.zh: 加达里首星突围战

messages.en: You entered a simulation of the Caldari’s exodus from Caldari Prime. You faced down the Gallente Federation, fought alongside a hero from Caldari history, and helped the people of Caldari escape to a new home.
messages.zh: 你进入了模拟加达里人从加达里首星撤离的场景。你直面盖伦特联邦，与一位加达里历史上的英雄并肩作战，并帮助加达里人民逃离到新家园。

messages.en: The Caldari have invited you to experience their proudest and darkest day. Make your way to the simulation site and follow the instructions to see what it was like to be a part of the Caldari Breakout.
messages.zh: 加达里邀请你体验他们最骄傲、但也是最黑暗的一天。前往模拟地点，按照指示，体验成为加达里突围一员的感觉。

messages.en: Excellent. Make your way to the simulation site. I will contact you on arrival.
messages.zh: 非常好。前往模拟地点。到达后我会联系你。

messages.en:
The Caldari State invites you to experience why we fight, and why you should join us. Learn the meaning of honor, of duty, of what it means to be Caldari, as you experience our greatest loss and our most epic triumph.

Travel to the simulation site. Once you arrive, we will speak again.
messages.zh:
加达里合众国邀请你体验我们为何而战，以及你为何应加入我们。在你体验我们最惨痛的失败和最史诗般的胜利时，了解荣誉、责任以及成为加达里人的意义。

前往模拟地点。等你到达后，我们再详细讨论。

messages.en:
Now you understand what we have lost and what we fight for still.

When you are ready to earn your honor, search out our campaigns or our militia offices.
messages.zh:
现在你明白我们失去了什么，以及我们仍在为何而战。

当你准备好赢得荣誉时，找到我们的军事行动或国民卫队办公室。

messages.en:
Now you understand what we have lost and what we fight for still.

When you are ready to earn your honor, search out our campaigns or our militia offices.
messages.zh:
现在你明白我们失去了什么，以及我们仍在为何而战。

当你准备好赢得荣誉时，找到我们的军事行动或国民卫队办公室。

messages.en: Understood. Return when you are ready to learn the meaning of honor.
messages.zh: 了解。当你准备好领悟荣誉的真谛时再回来吧。

messages.en:
The Caldari State welcomes your interest in our history. This experience will show you why we fight, and why you should join us. Learn the meaning of honor, of duty, of what it means to be Caldari, as you experience our greatest loss and our most epic triumph.

Travel to the simulation site. Once you arrive, we will speak again.
messages.zh:
加达里合众国欢迎你对我们历史感兴趣。这次体验将向你展示我们为何而战，以及你为何应加入我们。在你体验我们最惨痛的失败和最史诗般的胜利时，了解荣誉、责任以及成为加达里人的意义。

前往模拟地点。等你到达后，我们再详细讨论。

messages.en: Understood. Return when you are ready to learn the meaning of honor.
messages.zh: 了解。当你准备好领悟荣誉的真谛时再回来吧。

messages.en:
You have returned? So be it.

The Caldari have invited you to experience their proudest and darkest day. Make your way to the simulation site and follow the instructions to see what it was like to be a part of the Caldari Breakout.
messages.zh:
你回来了？那就这样吧。

加达里邀请你体验他们最骄傲、但也是最黑暗的一天。前往模拟地点，按照指示，体验成为加达里突围一员的感觉。

messages.en: Intaki Liberation
messages.zh: 印塔基解放

messages.en: In the most recent of the simulated settings, you fought alongside the Federation fleet that liberated Intaki. Taking out Caldari defenses, you helped free the people of Intaki from megacorporate control.
messages.zh: 在最近的模拟场景中，你与解放印塔基的联邦舰队并肩作战。成功摧毁加达里的防御，你帮助印塔基人民摆脱了超级集团的控制。

messages.en: The Gallente have invited you to join them in a simulation of the Liberation of Intaki. Travel to the simulation site and follow the instructions to fight for freedom side by side with the Federation.
messages.zh: 盖伦特邀请你加入他们模拟的印塔基解放行动。前往模拟地点，按照指示与联邦并肩为自由而战。

messages.en: Nice. Make your way to the simulation site. I will meet you there.
messages.zh: 很好。前往模拟地点。我会在那里与你碰面。

messages.en:
Fight for freedom in this simulation where you’ll learn just what it means to be on the right side of history.

Travel to the simulation sire, and let’s go on a journey of justice together.
messages.zh:
在这场模拟中为自由而战，你将了解站在历史正确一边的意义。

前往模拟地点，让我们一起踏上正义之旅。

messages.en:
The fight for freedom is a never-ending one.

Join our campaigns and serve justice, or enlist at one of our militia offices and fight the good fight.
messages.zh:
为自由而战的斗争永无止境。

加入我们的军事行动伸张正义，或者在我们的国民卫队办公室应征入伍，投身正义之战。

messages.en:
The fight for freedom is a never-ending one.

Join our campaigns and serve justice, or enlist at one of our militia offices and fight the good fight.
messages.zh:
为自由而战的斗争永无止境。

加入我们的军事行动伸张正义，或者在我们的国民卫队办公室应征入伍，投身正义之战。

messages.en: That’s your choice, and I respect it. Come back when you’re ready to fight for your freedom.
messages.zh: 这是你的选择，我尊重你的任何选择。当你准备好为自由而战时再回来吧。

messages.en:
The battle for freedom is a battle we must fight every day. In this simulation, you’ll learn just what it means to fight on the right side of history.

Travel to the simulation site, and let’s go on a journey of justice together.
messages.zh:
为自由而战是我们每天都必须进行的战斗。在这场模拟中，你将了解站在历史正确一边战斗的意义。

前往模拟地点，让我们一起踏上正义之旅。

messages.en: That’s your choice, and I respect it. Come back when you’re ready to fight for your freedom.
messages.zh: 这是你的选择，我尊重你的任何选择。当你准备好为自由而战时再回来吧。

messages.en:
Hey there, looking for a refresh?

The Gallente have invited you to join them in a simulation of the Liberation of Intaki. Travel to the simulation site and follow the instructions to fight for freedom side by side with the Federation.
messages.zh:
嘿，想重温一下吗？

盖伦特邀请你加入他们模拟的印塔基解放行动。前往模拟地点，按照指示与联邦并肩为自由而战。

messages.en: Battle of Pator
messages.zh: 帕多尔之战

messages.en: Entering a simulation of the Minmatar’s past, you took part in the Battle of Pator. You fought Imperial occupiers and faced down a supercarrier in a deadly battle. Ultimately, you defeated the Amarr and reclaimed the planet of Matar for the Matari.
messages.zh: 你进入模拟米玛塔尔的过去，参与了帕多尔战役。你与帝国占领军作战，并在一场殊死搏斗中与一艘超级航母正面厮杀。最终，你击败了艾玛，为玛塔利夺回了玛塔尔行星。

messages.en: The Minmatar have invited you to experience the Battle of Pator firsthand. Make your way to the simulation site and follow the instructions to experience the liberation of their homeworld.
messages.zh: 米玛塔尔邀请你亲身体验帕多尔战役。前往模拟地点，按照指示体验他们家园星球的解放。

messages.en: Well chosen. Make your way to the simulation site. I will see you there.
messages.zh: 不错的选择。前往模拟地点。我会在那里与你碰面。

messages.en:
Heritage is at the heart of what it means to be Minmatar. Join us in a simulation of the day our Republic was born, the legendary Battle of Pator.

Travel to the simulation site. I will explain more once you arrive.
messages.zh:
传承是米玛塔尔人身份的核心。加入我们，在我们共和国诞生的那天，也就是传奇的帕多尔战役。

前往模拟地点。等你到达后我会详细解释。

messages.en:
Much has changed since that day, but much has not. We are the Matari, and this is our Republic.

If you are ready to continue the fight for liberation, keep an eye out for our campaigns or find our militia offices.
messages.zh:
自那天起，许多事情已经改变，但许多事情依旧不变。我们是玛塔利，这是我们的共和国。

如果你准备好继续为解放而战，请留意我们的军事行动或找到我们的国民卫队办公室。

messages.en:
Much has changed since that day, but much has not. We are the Matari, and this is our Republic.

If you are ready to continue the fight for liberation, keep an eye out for our campaigns or find our militia offices.
messages.zh:
自那天起，许多事情已经改变，但许多事情依旧不变。我们是玛塔利，这是我们的共和国。

如果你准备好继续为解放而战，请留意我们的军事行动或找到我们的国民卫队办公室。

messages.en: A shame. Matar calls, I hope you will one day see the wisdom of answering.
messages.zh: 真可惜。玛塔尔在召唤，我希望有一天你能明白回应的智慧。

messages.en:
Understanding heritage is at the heart of what it means to be Minmatar. Join us in a simulation of the day our Republic was born, the legendary Battle of Pator.

Travel to the simulation site. I will explain more once you arrive.
messages.zh:
理解传承是米玛塔尔人身份的核心。加入我们，在我们共和国诞生的那天，也就是传奇的帕多尔战役。

前往模拟地点。等你到达后我会详细解释。

messages.en: A shame. Matar calls, I hope you will one day see the wisdom of answering.
messages.zh: 真可惜。玛塔尔在召唤，我希望有一天你能明白回应的智慧。

messages.en:
Welcome back. Need a reminder?

The Minmatar have invited you to experience the Battle of Pator firsthand. Make your way to the simulation site and follow the instructions to experience the liberation of their homeworld.
messages.zh:
欢迎回来。需要我给点提示吗？

米玛塔尔邀请你亲身体验帕多尔战役。前往模拟地点，按照指示体验他们家园星球的解放。

name.ja: アマーのもとに移動する

messages.en: Travel to the Amarr
messages.zh: 前往艾玛

messages.en: You made your way to the Amarr agent to enter the next simulation.
messages.zh: 你来到艾玛代理人处，准备进入下一个模拟。

messages.en: Make your way to the Amarr agent to enter the next simulation.
messages.zh: 前往艾玛代理人处进入下一个模拟。

messages.en: Be on your guard as you fly into the belly of the Amarr. Their insidious lies are everywhere.
messages.zh: 飞入艾玛腹地时，务必保持警惕。他们阴险的谎言无处不在。

messages.en: Make your way to the Amarr agent to enter the next simulation.
messages.zh: 前往艾玛代理人处进入下一个模拟。

messages.en: Have the tribes so won you over you are ready to stop here? I suggest continuing on to see the Amarr’s lies firsthand. Only then will you appreciate why they must be stopped.
messages.zh: 部落已经如此赢得了你的心，以至于你准备止步于此了吗？我建议你继续前进，亲眼看看艾玛人的谎言。只有这样，你才会明白为什么必须阻止他们。

messages.en: The next simulation in this series is the lies and propaganda of the Amarr Empire. Travel to their Imperial mouthpiece and see what they have to say for themselves. I suggest you study it carefully to better understand the enemy.
messages.zh: 本系列的下一场模拟是艾玛帝国的谎言和宣传。前往他们帝国的喉舌处，听听他们为自己辩护些什么。我建议你仔细研究，以便更好地了解敌人。

messages.en: Have the tribes so won you over you are ready to stop here? I suggest continuing on to see the Amarr’s lies firsthand. Only then will you appreciate why they must be stopped.
messages.zh: 部落已经如此赢得了你的心，以至于你准备止步于此了吗？我建议你继续前进，亲眼看看艾玛人的谎言。只有这样，你才会明白为什么必须阻止他们。

messages.en:
Are you prepared now to stare into the ugliness of false faith?

The next simulation in this series is the lies and propaganda of the Amarr Empire. Travel to their Imperial mouthpiece and see what they have to say for themselves. I suggest you study it carefully to better understand the enemy.
messages.zh:
你现在准备好凝视虚假信仰的丑陋了吗？

本系列的下一场模拟是艾玛帝国的谎言和宣传。前往他们帝国的喉舌处，听听他们为自己辩护些什么。我建议你仔细研究，以便更好地了解敌人。

name.ja: ホログラフィックによる再現

messages.en: Holographic Reenactment
messages.zh: 全息重现

messages.en: You made your way to the first in a series of simulations that tells the stories of EVE’s Empires from their own perspective.
messages.zh: 你已前往一系列模拟中的第一个，这些模拟从各自的角度讲述了EVE帝国的故事。

messages.en: You have been invited to try a series of super-advanced simulations that explore the histories of New Eden’s Empires from their different perspectives. Travel to the first Empire’s embassy system and make contact with their representatives through a holographic messenger
messages.zh: 你受邀体验一系列超先进模拟，从不同视角探索新伊甸帝国的历史。前往第一个帝国的使馆星系，通过全息信使与他们的代表取得联系。

messages.en: You won’t regret it! Make your way to the first agent and begin your journey into the experience of a lifetime.
messages.zh: 你不会后悔的！前往第一个代理人处，开始你一生难忘的体验之旅。

messages.en: Make your way to the first agent and begin your journey into these historic simulations.
messages.zh: 前往第一个代理人处，开始这些历史模拟之旅。

messages.en: A shame, you don’t know what you are missing out on. Come back and see me when you are ready for an experience like no other.
messages.zh: 真可惜，你不知道你错过了什么。当你准备好体验前所未有的经历时，再回来找我吧。

messages.en:
Capsuleer, how would you like to time-travel?

No, of course not literally, but with the help of AIR’s new advancements in holographics and coordinated drone actors, you can take a step out of the present and into the epic battles of the past!

Each experience has been crafted in cooperation with the Empire’s top military experts. Yes, perhaps they are more… cinematic, some might even say biased, than historical.. but that is what makes them such an incredible insight into the minds of the Empires!

Accept this offer, visit all four holographic agents and their simulated experiences, and learn the Empire’s truths for yourself!
messages.zh:
克隆飞行员，你想来一次时光旅行吗？

不，当然不是字面意义上的，但借助星空会在全息技术和协同无人机行动者方面的新进展，你可以踏出当下，进入过去的史诗战斗！

每次体验都是与帝国顶级军事专家合作打造的。是的，也许它们比起历史记录更具……电影感，有人甚至会说这是偏见……但这正是它们能如此惊人地洞察帝国思想的原因！

接受这个邀请，访问所有四个全息代理人及其模拟体验，亲自了解帝国的真相！

messages.en: A shame, you don’t know what you are missing out on. Come back and see me when you are ready for an experience like no other.
messages.zh: 真可惜，你不知道你错过了什么。当你准备好体验前所未有的经历时，再回来找我吧。

messages.en:
Need a refresher? Not a problem.

You have been invited to try a series of super-advanced simulations that explore the histories of New Eden’s Empires from their own perspectives. Make your way to the first Empire’s embassy system and make contact with their representatives through a holographic messenger.
messages.zh:
需要重温一下吗？没问题。

你受邀体验一系列超先进模拟，从他们各自视角探索新伊甸帝国的历史。前往第一个帝国的使馆星系，通过全息信使与他们的代表取得联系。

name.ja: ガレンテのもとに移動する

messages.en: Travel to the Gallente
messages.zh: 前往盖伦特

messages.en: You made your way to the Gallente agent to enter the next simulation.
messages.zh: 你来到盖伦特代理人处，准备进入下一个模拟。

messages.en: Make your way to the Gallente agent to enter the next simulation.
messages.zh: 前往盖伦特代理人处进入下一个模拟。

messages.en: Hold your faith close as you visit the simulation. Be not tempted by that false idol they call democracy.
messages.zh: 在体验模拟场景时，请务必守住自己的信仰。不要被他们所谓的虚假偶像“民主”所诱惑。

messages.en: Make your way to the Gallente agent to enter the next simulation.
messages.zh: 前往盖伦特代理人处进入下一个模拟。

messages.en: Are you ready to stop this simulated pilgrimage and embrace the faith? Praise be, yet I would counsel that you go on. Only once you have seen how the heretic thinks can you protect yourself against their lies.
messages.zh: 你准备好停止这场模拟朝圣并拥抱信仰了吗？值得称赞，但我建议你继续下去。只有了解异端的思想后，你才能保护自己免受其谎言的欺骗。

messages.en: Your final simulation will be some hollow entertainment put together by the godless Federation. Go and bear witness to the emptiness of their words, so that you may return to the Empire with a deeper understanding of the power of faith.
messages.zh: 你的最后一个模拟将是那个不信神的联邦拼凑出的空洞娱乐。去亲眼见证他们话语的空洞吧，这样你就能带着对信仰力量更深的理解回到帝国。

messages.en: Are you ready to stop this simulated pilgrimage and embrace the faith? Praise be, yet I would counsel that you go on. Only once you have seen how the heretic thinks can you protect yourself against their lies.
messages.zh: 你准备好停止这场模拟朝圣并拥抱信仰了吗？值得称赞，但我建议你继续下去。只有了解异端的思想后，你才能保护自己免受其谎言的欺骗。

messages.en:
Are you ready to complete this virtual pilgrimage?

Your final simulation will be some hollow entertainment put together by the godless Federation. Go and bear witness to the emptiness of their words, so that you may return to the Empire with a deeper understanding of the power of faith.
messages.zh:
你准备好完成这次虚拟朝圣了吗？

你的最后一个模拟将是那个不信神的联邦拼凑出的空洞娱乐。去亲眼见证他们话语的空洞吧，这样你就能带着对信仰力量更深的理解回到帝国。

name.ja: ミンマターのもとに移動する

messages.en: Travel to the Minmatar
messages.zh: 前往米玛塔尔

messages.en: You made your way to the Mimatar agent to enter the next simulation.
messages.zh: 你来到米玛塔尔代理人处，准备进入下一个模拟。

messages.en: Make your way to the Minmatar agent to enter the next simulation.
messages.zh: 前往米玛塔尔代理人处进入下一个模拟。

messages.en: Travel to the Minmatar now, see what they have to say for themself.
messages.zh: 现在前往米玛塔尔那里，看看他们为自己说些什么。

messages.en: Make your way to the Minmatar agent to enter the next simulation.
messages.zh: 前往米玛塔尔代理人处进入下一个模拟。

messages.en: You must be so excited to join the State you don’t need to go further. I would advise you to return and complete this journey, understanding an enemy is the only way to defeat them.
messages.zh: 你一定对加入合众国感到无比兴奋，以至于你觉得无需再进一步了。我建议你回来完成这段旅程，了解敌人是击败他们的唯一方法。

messages.en: You can travel to the next simulation now, and see how well the State stands up by comparison. I believe it is some foolishness made by the tribes of the Minmatar Republic.
messages.zh: 你现在可以前往下一个模拟，看看相比之下合众国表现如何。我相信这是米玛塔尔共和国的部落犯下的某种愚蠢错误。

messages.en: You must be so excited to join the State you don’t need to go further. I would advise you to return and complete this journey, understanding an enemy is the only way to defeat them.
messages.zh: 你一定对加入合众国感到无比兴奋，以至于你觉得无需再进一步了。我建议你回来完成这段旅程，了解敌人是击败他们的唯一方法。

messages.en:
So, you have chosen knowledge.

You can travel to the next simulation now, and see how well the State stands up by comparison. I believe it is some foolishness made by the tribes of the Minmatar Republic.
messages.zh:
那么，你选择了知识。

你现在可以前往下一个模拟，看看相比之下合众国表现如何。我相信这是米玛塔尔共和国的部落犯下的某种愚蠢错误。

messages.en: Agents working for the Serpentis recently managed to infiltrate one of our outposts in a nearby system. We have reliable information that they did manage to find classified information about our various operations in the area. Fortunately one of the officers at the outpost managed to slip a tracking device into one of their ships before they escaped. We know they are located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} at this very moment. I would like you to fly over there and ambush them immediately. Return to me once their ships have been turned to dust. But be careful, they are armed and dangerous.
